games.name: Secrets of Grindea
games.shortDescription: Secrets of Grindea is an old-school Action RPG with co-op support for up to 4 players. Journey through fantastical lands and battle tons of different enemies and bosses in your quest for truth, friendship and, above all, finding the world’s rarest treasures!
games.aboutText:
Secrets of Grindea is an old-school Action RPG with co-op support for up to 4 players. It is a tribute to and sometimes a parody of the old SNES games so many of us grew up with and loved! Journey through fantastical lands, and battle tons of different enemies and bosses in your quest for truth, friendship and, above all, finding the world's rarest treasures! Key Features

- A rich world filled with 300+ unique, colorful characters and an engaging story to drive your journey forward.

- Co-op support for up to four players! Enjoy the entire storyline with your friends or call someone in to help with the more difficult challenges.

- Customization, customization, customization - design a character that represents you, then mix and match any of the 31 spells and skills across 9 different categories.

- 30+ epic boss fights! Overgrown slimes, giant robots, mimics - we have it all!

- Side content - design your own home, fish, craft items, tame pets, partake in mini-games, grow plants - there’s plenty to keep you entertained when you want a break from the main story.

And last but not least:

- Arcade Mode - Separate from Story Mode, the game includes a full roguelite version where you need to battle your way to the top on a single life, building a town of your own as you progress. How far can you get?

games.name: No Signal: Chornobyl
games.shortDescription: No Signal is a strictly online co-op psychological horror game set in the abandoned Chornobyl Exclusion Zone. Explore decaying towns, solve tasks together, and question everything—because you and your partner may not be seeing the same reality.
games.aboutText:
You are the first in many years to breach the Chornobyl Exclusion Zone . Your main trials will be the space itself, the oppressive silence, and your own mind.

Immerse yourself in the chilling atmosphere of abandoned villages and towns, where there are no straight paths or trodden roads.

Key features:

- Co-op on the edge of paranoia: Your progress depends entirely on close cooperation with your partner. You will have to divide tasks and coordinate actions. But how can you trust each other when you see completely different things?

- Subtle psychological horror: The slowly maddening silence, paranoia, and distrust. Are you sure you can trust your partner?

- Everyday realism of the 2010s: Explore abandoned panel houses, rusty bus stops, and dilapidated village houses.

No Signal is a strictly online co-op experience.

games.name: [Redacted] The Safehouse
games.shortDescription: You're a detective. Investigate the haunting events surrounding the murder of Ann Peterson and her boyfriend. Explore an old safehouse for clues, deduce keywords and reveal redacted words as you search Ann's digital journal, and piece together your case report as this unfortunate story unfolds.
games.aboutText:
You're a detective. Investigate the haunting events surrounding the murder of Ann Peterson and her boyfriend.

Explore an old safehouse for clues, deduce keywords and reveal redacted words as you search Ann's digital journal, and piece together your case report as this unfortunate story unfolds.

This game takes approximately 1 to 1.5 hours to complete. If it's not for you, you can refund it.

games.name: Tavern Keeper 🍻
games.shortDescription: From the creators of Game Dev Tycoon comes Tavern Keeper 🍻, a cosy-chaotic management sim, featuring a powerful decoration sandbox and a magical storybook RPG!
games.aboutText:
Create Your Cosy Haven

Build and decorate your tavern, hire staff, stock your larder, meet the locals, be the boss and run the show! Whether you keep a cosy neighbourhood taphouse or a lean, mean gold-minting machine, the choices - and consequences - are yours.

Chaos Comes Knocking

Dozens of intertwined game systems create unpredictable emergent situations . Dirt, heat, noise, flammability, sickness and of course, a parade of colourful customers all keep the unexpected coming.

Today’s situation: Half of your staff are in bed with sleep-sickness. Orders are piling up and patrons’ tempers are getting heated. So is the tavern - because it’s on fire! A spark from a broken lantern landed on just the wrong patch of dirt with no one around to notice. Oops, perhaps it’s time to call the fire brigade...

An Unusual Journey Begins

An expansive narrative campaign lets you build taverns across a vibrant world full of your favourite fantasy cultures. Each new location brings fresh challenges and surprising stories . Meet immortal elementals, outwit halfling philosophers and aid a crazed orc inventor.

A Witty RPG Full of Choices

Experience a magical storybook fully-narrated by Steven Pacey . Encounter hundreds of bite-sized stories with a surprise at every turn. There’s always someone needing the guidance of a Tavern Keeper like you. What choices will you make?

Design Mode - Get Inn-Spired

Decorate every nook and hollow of your tavern to create everything from bustling taprooms to relaxing reading corners. Place and manipulate thousands of items anywhere with complete creative freedom and make the tavern of your dreams.

Your Own Item Workshop

Go beyond decorating and become a master artisan by using Tavern Keeper’s powerful Design Mode to craft unique furnishings. Combine pieces, add magical effects, then share your creations with the Tavern Keeper community.

Your Game, Your Way

Play the single-player campaign your way with adjustable game mechanics and storyteller settings or play in Freeplay for a custom challenge. Pick Challenging and strategize over every decision, barely making it through each day, or play a Relaxed game running the tavern of your dreams without pressure. The choice is yours.

Our Love Letter to Management Games

Made by Greenheart Games 💚 (Game Dev Tycoon), a tiny independent team , Tavern Keeper is a passion project more than a decade in the making. Every detail is handcrafted , from the art, sound, writing, animations, down to the 3D user interface and many quality-of-life features . We took no shortcuts to bring you an experience like no other . Come on Inn!

games.name: Afterbeat (Project Arrhythmia)
games.shortDescription: A musical bullet-hell where all things beautiful are deadly. Dodge well little nanobot, you don't have much time.
games.aboutText:
"Afterbeat" is a musical bullet-hell in which all things beautiful are deadly. A cacophony of lights, music, pulses and blocks, Afterbeat features tight bullet-hell style gameplay where up to 4 players in local co-op must navigate their way through evolving scenes and obstacles, all timed to the beat.

STORY

Set in 207X, a mysterious disease called "LMNS" has been ravaging the world. A lone Chiral researcher, Anna Schroeder, attempts to find the cure with her trusty supercomputer companion HAL. Stumbling upon various “Projects,” the duo decides to investigate the efficacy of a cure using a pulse/rhythm-based interface.

CURRENT FEATURES

- Complete Story Mode: Over 20+ hand-crafted, heart-pounding levels interwoven with an engaging story with multiple endings.

- Dodge The Beat: Stages consist of mesmerizing, musically timed scenes, each one telling a story. Feel the rhythm and feel your way around the hazards! Anna will judge how you do.

- Challenge Your Friends: Up to 4 players supported in local co-op mode.

- Robust Level Editor: A carefully designed level editor allows users to create their own levels and challenges using whatever music they wish.

- Huge Community: A Wealth of user-created content exists, fully integrated into the game through the usage of the level editor and user-made levels. Already, 2000+ community levels have been uploaded, and more are being made daily.

This game was previously named "Project Arrhythmia."

games.name: Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades
games.shortDescription: Do you like hot dogs? How about horseshoes? Hand grenades? (everyone likes hand grenades) Anyway, we've got all that, and guns. SO MANY GUNS. So if you like ordnance, meat, and far too many groan-worthy puns, this is the VR sandbox game for you.
games.aboutText:
Do you like hot dogs? How about horseshoes? Hand grenades? (everyone likes hand grenades) Anyway, we've got all that, and guns. SO MANY GUNS. So if you like ordnance, meat, and groan-worthy puns, this is the VR sandbox game for you.

Hot Dogs, Horseshoes and Hand Grenades (H3VR for short), is the heaping pile of our mad obsessive VR experiments. This has been an impressionistically developed experience, over 10+ years and a 120+ updates.

Gear Up

Assemble your ultimate range companion from over 600 Firearms and 250 Attachments. Customize your perfect loadout, be it tacti-cool or utterly cursed and save it for future play. Share your creations with your friends too!

Plink & Train

Try out your favorite platforms on H3’s suite of Firing and Demolitions ranges. Improve your aim and reaction time in the M.E.A.T.S. target shooting trainer and Compete on global leaderboards.

Meat Your Maker

Combat some of the most sophisticated AI Agents in VR (yup, even though they’re hot dogs), at range or in melee. Put your mastery of H3’s massive arsenal to the test, and even join the First 2 Wurst Tournament Community on Discord!

Explore a Meaty ‘Murica

Dive into a Wiener’s Weird World; a land overtaken by confused but affable sentient meat and the ruins of bizarre firearm themed attractions. Experience an absurd fragmentary tale told through multiple genres of game.

Celebrate

Enjoy the various goofball holiday event modes the game has gotten over the years, including our much beloved biennial Meatmas Firearm Advent Calendar.

Take & Hold

Battle your way through this Sci-fi Action Roguelite. In Take & Hold you are the intruder to the system. Equip yourself to take and then defend control points, while defeating Encryption Targets of escalating complexity. Earn tokens for your performance and spend them in item shops to prepare for the next wave.

Return of the Rotwieners

Awake outside the town of Wienerton, where a plague of rotten undead meat has beset the eccentric townsfolk of the Honey Hamlet. Find weaponry, craft powerups and explosives, and complete quests on your journey to discover the cause of the Rotwiener outbreak.

Meat Fortress

Fight in the Meat Fortress combat arena. Made with the official permission of Valve, this loving homage to one of our favorite games has Meaty parodies of Team Fortress 2’s 9 iconic classes, and VR adaptations of the entire original firearm set of the game, as well as over a dozen original creations made in the TF2 style.

Wurstwurld

Explore the ruins of the Wurstwurld amusement park. Solve puzzles, complete extreme horseshoe challenges, stand off against robit bandits and collect old logs that reveal the background on the most foolhardy and most assuredly not child safe amusement park doomed to failure.

Meat Grinder

Survive the Meat Grinder, the very first game mode added to H3 back in 2016. Navigate by flashlight through a surreal hellish fast food themed maze, collect precious ammo, defending against animatronic assailants, and dragging the ‘meat’ back to the Grinder in time.

games.name: Order of the Sinking Star
games.shortDescription: From director Jonathan Blow (Braid, The Witness), Order of the Sinking Star is a massive puzzle adventure set in a realm of magic and enigma. Solve over 1000 interconnected, hand-crafted puzzles, discover unique playable heroes, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher a grand mystery.
games.aboutText:
From legendary director Jonathan Blow ( Braid , The Witness ) comes Order of the Sinking Star , a massive puzzle adventure featuring more than one thousand hand-crafted puzzles designed to put your intellect to the test. You are transported to a realm of curious magic, dangerous contraptions, and vicious monsters. Explore four distinct worlds, each with its own mechanics, characters, and stories, and then watch as they all collide. As the worlds merge, and characters meet one another, puzzle systems intertwine, creating surprising new gameplay possibilities. Explore at your own pace, revisit worlds and return to challenges as you see fit. Discover unique playable characters, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher the deep mysteries of a sprawling, interconnected game world. Blending exploration, storytelling, and ever-progressing mechanics, Order of the Sinking Star invites you into a mysterious, living puzzle unlike anything you've played.

Embark on an innovative puzzle adventure with dozens of game mechanics and hundreds of hours of unique gameplay. Each puzzle builds on the last, introducing new game mechanics that reward curiosity and persistence.

Explore four mysterious worlds, each with its own characters, rules, dangers, and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Come and go as you like, you are free to take on the puzzles you discover at your own pace.

A queen, a thief, a warrior, a wizard, and a talking boat are just some of the heroes of this tale. Each character wields complementary abilities and has captivating stories to tell.

As playable characters begin to meet and worlds collide, the mystery untangles. Through gameplay and notes you collect you learn more about this enigmatic realm. Piece by piece and clue by clue, you’ll uncover the secrets of the Order of the Sinking Star.

History, Foundation & Design Contributions

Order of the Sinking Star has been in the making for nearly a decade since the release of The Witness , born from a desire to push puzzle game design past its traditional limits to create the largest and greatest puzzle game ever made. With Order of the Sinking Star , the development team created a "game design supercollider" – smashing together the ideas from multiple puzzle game designers to create a puzzle landscape that's much more intricate and vast than what has come before.

The foundation of Order of the Sinking Star is built upon these four brilliant titles:

- Skipping Stones to Lonely Homes by Alan Hazelden: A serene puzzle game about throwing stones into water to create stepping paths.

- Mirror Isles by Alan Hazelden: A clever top-down game focused on swapping places with reflections across islands.

- Promesst 1-3 by Sean Barrett: An abstract grid-puzzler about exploring a cave filled with mysterious beams of light.

- Heroes of Sokoban ( 1 , 2 , & 3 ) by Jonah Ostroff: A fantasy-themed puzzle game where you manage distinct hero classes (like warriors and mages) with unique movement and pushing mechanics to reach the exit.

While these games inspire and comprise the very beginning of Order of the Sinking Star and lay the foundation of its gameplay, the game as a whole explores the endless, unexpected possibilities of merging these worlds together.

The game also showcases design contributions from Zach Polansky ( Enigmash ), Patrick Traynor ( Patrick's Parabox ), Marc ten Bosch ( Miegakure ), and several others – including design contributions from Twitch followers over the years.

The Thekla, Inc. team is incredibly thankful for all the support they’ve had for the game over the course of development!

games.name: Satisfactory
games.shortDescription: Satisfactory is a first-person open-world factory building game with a dash of exploration and combat. Play alone or with friends, explore an alien planet, create multi-story factories, and enter conveyor belt heaven!
games.aboutText:
Satisfactory is a first-person open-world factory building game with a dash of exploration and combat. Play alone or with friends, explore an alien planet, create multi-story factories, and enter conveyor belt heaven! Construct

Conquer nature by building massive factories across the land. Expand wherever and however you want. The planet is filled with valuable natural resources just waiting to be utilized. As an employee of FICSIT it’s your duty to make sure they come to good use. Automate

Construct your factories with gracious perfection or build intricate webs of conveyor belts to supply all your needs. Automate trucks and trains to reach your faraway outposts and be sure to handle liquids properly by transporting them in pipes. It’s all about minimizing manual labour! Explore & Exploit

Venture on expeditions to search for new materials and be sure to put everything to good use. Nature is yours to harvest! You have vehicles, jetpacks, jump pads and more at your disposal to make the exploration easier. Equip the proper safety gear as well, just in case you run into the local wildlife. FEATURES

• Open World: Explore the huge (30km2) alien planet that is Massage-2(AB)b with its unique fauna and creatures.
• Co-Op: Build a factory yourself or share the joy with your friends. Up to you!
• Factory Building: Experience building a huge factory from a first-person perspective. Automate and optimize it to perfection for your personal satisfaction.
• Customization: Customize your factory to your own liking. Build at high altitudes or over wide plains, there is almost no limits in the making of your tailor-made factory.
• Vehicles: Travel the world with class. Use jump pads, factory carts, jetpacks, hypertubes, trucks or trains. The choice is yours!

games.name: Crimson Crisis
games.shortDescription: A fast-paced action roguelike where skill beats firepower. Outmaneuver swarms, harness Poison/Inflame/Traumatize, and expand the game with mods & co-op.
games.aboutText:
n Crimson Crisis, your weapons aren’t enough — to survive the swarm, you’ll need to twist, weave, and outmaneuver overwhelming hordes with pure skill. Every run throws you into escalating crises where enemies grow faster, deadlier, and more relentless than your firepower can handle. Success isn’t about how big your guns are — it’s about how well you control the chaos.

Battle through distinct warzones, each with its own enemies, hazards, and escalating crises. Adapt your tactics as swarms shift their patterns, forcing you to control not just your weapons, but the flow of the battlefield itself. Your arsenal inflicts powerful status effects — Poison, Inflame, and Traumatize — to weaken and disrupt enemies, buying precious moments to reposition and survive. With roguelike runs, randomized upgrades, and escalating intensity, no two crises ever unfold the same — but in every run, survival comes down to skillful movement.

Key Features

- Skill Over Firepower – Survive not by bigger guns, but by twisting, weaving, and outmaneuvering overwhelming swarms.

- Weapon Status System – Inflict Poison, Inflame, and Traumatize to weaken, disrupt, and control the horde while you reposition.

- Distinct Warzones – Each crisis throws you into a unique battlefield with its own enemies, hazards, and escalating challenges.

- Adaptive Swarms – Enemies shift patterns and behaviors, forcing you to manage the flow of the battlefield, not just your aim.

- Roguelike Replayability – Randomized upgrades, escalating intensity, and unique run-to-run challenges keep every crisis unpredictable.

- Climactic Survival Moments – Every escape is earned by mastery, delivering that heart-pounding “one more run” feeling.

- Drop-In / Drop-Out Couch Co-Op – Survive the crisis with a friend — join or leave runs instantly without breaking the action.

- Modding Support – Expand the crisis with community-made content, from new enemies and regions to custom upgrades and rules.

games.name: The Coin Game
games.shortDescription: A collection of ticket redemption arcades with realistic physics, a carnival, goofy robots, open world design, a global ranking system and silly prizes. Featuring 50+ modern inspired arcade machines and a pawn shop to keep money in your pocket. The Coin Game is made by a solo developer.
games.aboutText:
The Coin Game is a fun-filled arcade adventure on an island packed with ticket games, quirky robots, and endless activities. Explore realistic arcades with machines inspired by modern favorites and swap your tickets for prizes at redemption areas. Head to Larry's Arcade to jam with animatronics Teddy and the Ticket Eaters, or try UFO Arcade's space-themed games, Laser Tag, and Indoor Go-Karting. Don’t miss the ‘90s-style indoor mall with its own arcade, food court, shops, and even a cinema to watch your own movies. Just watch out for the minions – they’re big fans of Teddy and can challenge you in Laser Tag! Looking for more adventure? Make a splash at Lenny's WaterPark or show your skills at mini-golf and RC boat racing at pirate-themed One Eyed Billie’s. And don’t forget the Traveling Carnival with 20+ classic games, rides, and new prizes.

For a challenge, Survivor Mode lets you start with limited funds. Keep an eye on your health and energy (right on your wristwatch) by grabbing food around the island. Jerry’s got the healthy stuff if you can afford it, but junk food’s always cheap!

Run out of money? Scavenge dumpsters, hop on your bike and deliver newspapers around the island, or hit up the Pawn Shop to sell extra prizes. Otherwise you might have to beg Uncle Phil for some extra allowance!

If you just want to relax, activate Birthday Mode and live the good life with unlimited cash courtesy of Uncle Phil. Play however you like and enjoy your time at the arcades! Fill your belly with soda pop and cheesy poofs leaving sticky fingerprints on over 50 different games and machines.

There are plenty of ways to travel around the island. Take the bus, your very own golf cart, bike or Mom's van. Or maybe walk to burn all that fast food you just had at the mall. Be careful though, there is lots of highway traffic and tourist activity on the island so make sure to keep off the roads.

You can play The Coin Game with any mouse, keyboard or any Dual stick/pad controller. The game includes an easy to use key mapping system to support virtually any controller or peripheral. So you can play The Coin Game any way that you like.

Ready for the ultimate arcade escape?

Features:

- 50+ modern inspired arcade machines.

- 2 modes, Survivor and Birthday for more casual play.

- Open world full of side activities.

- Multiple ways to traverse the island in style.

games.name: Exit: A Biodelic Adventure
games.shortDescription: In the world of excessive biotechnologies, an epidemic is ravaging the human race, infecting people's neuronet implants and enslaving them to the mysterious Worm. Who are you: a fighter of the infection, or a hunter of new prey?
games.aboutText:
The game is like a cross between Cronenberg 's ‘eXistenZ’ and the good old-fashioned 'Goblins' game series: solve challenging puzzles in a world of living technology. It's an unhurried chamber point-n-click adventure set in a Smart House struck with achootecture; meet talking cursors, get humorous reactions to almost every player action, explore a surreal mix of science fiction and alchemical imagery! It's impossible to get stuck: built-in hints are always ready to lend a helping tentacle...

To overcome the challenges you’ll have to use your natural and implanted organs (nose, mouth, bioport, reference mollusc, caterpillar-injecta, etc.), which also communicate with each other. The game isn't very long, somewhere between 5-8 hours, but exploring the world is encouraged; even "wrong" actions generate unique reactions (and achievements too). You'll learn something new about this strange world, or maybe you'll just smile. Much of the game takes place in the spirit of fun classic quests like 'Space Quest' and 'Sam & Max Hit the Road' , but towards the end the mood shifts to the darker side in the spirit of 'Sanitarium' and 'I Have No Mouth And I Must Scream' .

Use them for poking, sniffing, and nibbling everything in sight.

Your bioport craves insectampules, and your ear can be detached and sent on a mission.

A naturmorph, a crocoquacker, an octopod, and other of Adem's eleven will help and hinder you.

Solve puzzles with sniffer snails, brain cartridges, pheromone pods, and all kinds of bioflashes.

Visit a rooflid, an ichthyoserver room, the lair of a love-struck shoggoth, and other achootectural landmarks.

The Worm's secrets are hidden in people.

Pervasive application "Jolly Jelly" is full of big ideas and a dubious sense of humor.

'Nano’ , ‘Bio’ , ‘Neuro’ , the slogans of the new age! Welcome to the world of living technologies: a world in which computers can be fed and cured, where insect hormones revitalize memory, biofactories exist that give birth to household utensils, and genetically-modified molds can generate virtual realities! However, this bizarre idyll is disrupted by a mysterious epidemic…

The implantation of neural networks into the brain served humanity for good, helping people sort information, clean their thoughts, and filter out odors and tastes. But some considered the experiment dangerous—what if instead of adjusting to an individual, it would rewrite them? Neural networks gathered data, learning from within about the weaknesses of their carriers, and optimized themselves. Then suddenly, an explosion! The Worm epidemic subjugated humanity to their neural networks, and took control. Now there are whole “worm” cities, whose inhabitants are busy with sinister rituals and searching for new victims.

Having entered this brave new world, can you find the Exit ?

games.name: Panic in Puzzle World
games.shortDescription: Panic in Puzzle World is an action-packed 2D platformer in the spirit of console classics. Play as Tide and breathe fire, slash with your claws, bounce on bad guys and glide with your wings to put a stop to the robot menace taking over the land, block by block!
games.aboutText:
Panic in Puzzle World is an action-platformer. The dragon, Tide, jumps, slashes, bounces and blasts to save the 4 Puzzle Masters from their captors, so that Puzzle World can be saved from the robot invasion!

- Ten densely packed levels of bumping, jumping and fire-blasting, each with novel mechanics to enjoy!

- Rad boss fights! Fearsome robots stand in your way, with tons of attacks to tango with!

- Made a mistake? Rewind at any time , if you'd like! (this difficulty feature can be toggled on/off )

- Fun hats, color-palettes, challenge levels and more to unlock! Gotta use those gems for something , right?

- A fun story delivered through in-game cutscenes (which are effortlessly skippable)!

- Replay any level and aim for S-Ranks and fastest times!

Kaboom! A fierce battle erupts at the foot of Shrine Mountain, and Tide's home is destroyed in the crossfire! He heads to the source of the commotion, encountering mysterious, hostile robots along the way!

Tide soon meets a rabbit, Violet, who explains that the ancient Puzzle Seal has been broken, allowing the robots to invade Puzzle World. With her help, Tide sets out on an adventure to rescue the four Puzzle Masters from their robot captors. If the Puzzle Seal can be repaired, there may just be a chance to stop this Panic... in Puzzle World!

games.name: Blossoming Yandere 満開 ヤンデレ
games.shortDescription: A girl was sleeping in the garbage outside of Kazuki's apartment, until he decided to take her in. Now a home for two, he must remember that all actions have consequences, and words can be laced with poison. But you know that all too well, don't you?
games.aboutText:
"I'd finally moved out of my parents place. I'd purchased an apartment online without telling them, and left while they were away. I was looking forward to living all by myself, but then I noticed her. She slept in the garbage outside my window, and I just couldn't ignore it. So I invited her in, my new roommate, Miki is her name."

Blossoming Yandere has you playing as Kizuki, a young man who's moved into his first apartment. As he settled into his new home, he spotted a girl named Miki sleeping in the garbage outside. Having always wanted to be someone's hero, he invited her to move in with him. She's a bit weird, obsessive maybe, but honestly he liked her company, treasured having her around. But awakening one night, he realized she was gone.

And thus properly begun the tale of poor Kizuki and the Blossoming Yandere .

Features:

- Yandere horror is rare, and full of untapped potential. I hope this spin on the strikes with you.

- Be the person of affection to a rather unique yandere girl who you found in your garbage.

- Your actions and words play into your fate.

- Full of twists and turns.

- Explore an apartment complex as you slowly put together a greater mystery.

- Strange sound design is crafted to allure you to immerse yourself into an odd atmosphere.

- A few different endings.

Do you ever think how cruel it is to tear off a flowers' petals...?

games.name: Still Above: Orbital Refuge
games.shortDescription: A 3D space-station survival builder. The Earth below is gone; your station is still falling. Salvage the orbital graveyard, fit out empty hulls rack by rack, and keep air, water, power and fuel flowing long enough to turn one fragile module into humanity's last refuge.
games.aboutText:
Earth is lost. You are still above.

The world below is ruined and silent, beautiful from orbit and unsafe to return to. You have one aging module, a tiny crew, and a station that is already falling out of the sky.

Still Above: Orbital Refuge is a survival and station-building strategy game. You start with a damaged module and several crises at once: CO₂ is rising, your orbit is decaying, food is short, and there are no batteries, so every orbital night is a blackout. You have almost nothing to fix any of it with. Work out what to dismantle, what to haul in and what to build first, and turn a dying outpost into a refuge for what is left of humanity.

If you liked The Expanse , Seveneves by Neal Stephenson or Delta-v by Daniel Suarez, you will like this game.

Key features

- Survive the opening. The start is a hardcore scramble where each problem shows live numbers instead of instructions. Expect to die and restart a few times before you find the order that works.

- Build in 3D. Snap modules together from a strategic view. Hulls get their purpose from the racks you fit inside: berths, life support, hydroponics, workshops and research benches. You can refit them at any time. Bolt solar panels, tanks, antennas and dishes onto the outside.

- Keep your orbit. Thin atmosphere drags the station down, and the lower it gets, the faster it falls. Reboosting burns propellant in proportion to your mass, so every module you add makes staying up more expensive.

- Every resource has a story. Scrap is finite. Salvage it, sort it, refine it, fabricate parts and build. A hull plate might become a new room or a critical repair.

- Manage a small crew. Each person has skills, needs, shifts and a condition. You give orders and never control anyone directly. No romance or relationship meters, only the pressure of keeping people alive.

- Build robots. Research Service, Builder and Long-range robots to take on interior work, external construction and unmanned salvage flights. They are extra hands, but they cannot replace your crew.

- Salvage and rescue. Send EVA hauls and shuttle missions to debris fields, dead satellites and derelicts. Rescue survivors from escape pods and wrecks, but only if you have the berths, air and food to keep them alive.

- Research your way forward. Interconnected tech branches cover life support, fabrication, power, automation and long-range operations. There are several routes to each goal.

- Choose what comes next. Build a lasting orbital civilization, launch toward another world, or work toward restoring Earth.

Hope, earned

This is grounded survival and engineering with a sense of wonder. The station should feel vulnerable and lived-in. Every module you add is a small victory against the odds. Progress means rebuilding, not just scaling up numbers.

games.name: In The Valley of Gods
games.shortDescription: From the creators of Firewatch, In the Valley of Gods is a single-player first-person adventure. Explore a remote and ancient valley in the Egyptian desert, uncovering treasure and treachery in pursuit of a discovery that could bring you fame and fortune—or leave you for dead, buried beneath the sands.
games.aboutText:
A single-player, first-person adventure set deep in the desert of Egypt.

About In the Valley of Gods

From the team that brought you Firewatch, In the Valley of Gods is a sprawling narrative experience in remote, 1920s Egypt. You are Rashida, a disgraced former explorer and filmmaker given one last shot at the adventurous life you desperately miss. Somewhere, beyond the endless miles of dunes, ruins, and tombs lies an incredible archaeological discovery—but it can't be found without the help of Zora, the former partner you vowed never to work with again. Gameplay

- A thrilling adventure in first person

- Navigate and rebuild a relationship with your companion, Zora

- Utilize an authentic 35mm film camera to document the world and story around you

- Climb, explore and traverse the wonders of the ancient world

Development Status

In the Valley of Gods is currently in development and does not yet have a release date or system requirements. Be sure to add it to your wishlist and follow development on the Campo Santo blog or twitter!

games.name: Odd Realm
games.shortDescription: Build a settlement in a realm recovering from the Fracture, a calamity that nearly destroyed the realm. Choose from several unique races, establish a new kingdom, and survive in a land filled with magic and strange creatures. Farm the land, fish the seas, or raid rival kingdoms for their treasures.
games.aboutText:
Features

- 5 races to start your kingdom with, each with unique playstyles

- Unlimited procedurally generated deserts, mountains, tropical islands, and frozen tundras

- Dynamic weather and seasons unique to each biome

- Hundreds of plants, animals, and items

- A research tree with options for each race that unlock new blueprints and rooms

- Outfit individual settlers with tools, weapons, and gear

- Manage your kingdom and view other kingdoms on an expansive world map

- Battle raiders, invading armies, and underground horrors

Choose from unlimited generated landscapes to make your new home. A desert oasis? The ribcage of a long-dead giant? A magical mountain range? Where you choose to settle will determine what resources you have at your disposal, what you encounter, and how challenging your experience will be.

Use the resources in your environment to build... well.. whatever you want! A sandstone castle in the desert? An underground fortress? Or, maybe, an island beach house? You decide!

Dig mines into the earth to uncover lost tombs, dormant gods, and lakes filled with creatures watching from the deep. Just make sure not to go too deep!

Welcome the less-than-friendly arrival of your neighbors with cold steel and hugs made of arrows. Ask questions later.

games.name: Seclusion: Islesbury
games.shortDescription: Seclusion: Islesbury is a new horror point-and-click adventure in the vein of genre classics such as Scratches and Dark Fall. Can a decade-old murder case be solved? Is it safe to wander on these streets? Will anyone help you in this town? Find it out in this tale of personal tragedy.
games.aboutText:
Seclusion: Islesbury is a new horror point-and-click adventure in the vein of genre classics such as Scratches and Dark Fall .

THE STORY

Bright morning sunlight washes over Detective Jason Endel's bed. The gentle silence does not bring comfort. Jason wants peace of mind, a way to make the pain go away. Something urges him to leave, but little he knows of the nightmarish journey awaiting.

Islesbury is a town fading away after a series of violent and unexplained riots. Empty streets, buildings in ruins, rumors of locals descending into madness, strange sounds around every corner that no one can identify...

And so Jason arrives one night heeding a dreamlike call, a reckoning of the past.

FEATURES

- Explore detailed locations ranging from desolated apartments to lonely streets, dark woods to dangerous cliffs, and more.

- Unravel the secrets of a mysterious town with a sinister past.

- Solve logical puzzles that will challenge you and reveal an engrossing story.

- Use a friendly inventory system and consult a journal to keep track of your investigations.

- Surrender to a haunting original soundtrack.

Can a decade-old murder case be solved? Is it safe to wander on these streets? Will anyone help you in this town? Find it out in this tale of personal tragedy.

games.name: Koboo: The Tree Spirit
games.shortDescription: Koboo is a fast paced action rogue-lite platformer where you battle against towering hunters as a small tree spirit by attacking their weak points. Forge powerful synergies, explore the Ancient Forest's branching paths, fish, catch bugs and garden to rebuild your home!
games.aboutText:
Koboo draws inspiration from the difficult 2D souls-like combat from Dead Cells, the scale of Shadow of the Colossus and the enchanting world of Princess Mononoke. Death is no longer the end! Strategic builds, skillful positioning and correct timings will get your further in your next run so you can restore balance to the ancient ecosystem .

Customize Your Build - Dual wield weapons that each have their own 4 upgrades paths to suit your playstyle. Learn Animal Abilities which will powerup through branching upgrade paths making you even stronger by the end of your run!

Collectables Galore! - Collect flower seeds, catch bugs, meet fish and befriend the forest animals to unlock Favor. Use Favor in the shop to unlock new Weapons, Animal Abilities, Infusions, Relics and upgrades so your future runs will have even more variety!

More Features

- Branching Paths - 7 worlds to explore each with their own enemies and final boss

- Specialize - Create a unique build by combining Weapon Upgrades, Animal Abilities, Relics and Weapon Infusions

- Collect - Go friendly fishing, catch bugs and plant your own garden after boss fights

- Secrets - Metroidvania inspired exploration to help you discover the secrets of the Ancient Forest...

- Accessibility - Many accessibility and gameplay options

- Controls - Full controller support and control rebinding

Koboo: The Tree Spirit wouldn't be possible without the incredible support of our amazing Kickstarter community. Their passion and constructive feedback continue to shape the game, making it even better than we ever dreamed! You can follow our development and talk to us live on Discord anytime, we will respond as soon as possible.

Thank you! ❤

- Jerome and Simon

games.name: Plague hunter
games.shortDescription: Plague hunter is an indie platformer game in the dark fantasy vein. In the game you’ll be using sword and gun to cut your way through hordes of zombies and other terrible monsters, avoiding deadly traps.
games.aboutText:
Plague hunter is an indie platformer game in the dark fantasy vein. In the game you’ll be using sword and gun to cut your way through hordes of zombies and other terrible monsters, avoiding deadly traps.

- Oldschool gameplay

- A variety of monsters

- Battles with giant bosses that require tactics

- Stylish graphics

- Character upgrade

Story:

It all began in the days of bicentenary war, when the Order of Crusaders led the campaign against the elder nations. The Order was victorious; it took no prisoners, exterminating one race after another. Dead bodies filled the streets of ravaged cities. And amidst this putrid stench the darkest evil came to our world…
A terrible curse caused people to go insane and rot alive, slowly turning into atrocious monsters. Cities hit by this epidemic turned into giant hives of the ones led by the will of the pack. Soon all the elder kingdoms were swallowed by the Plague.
The king ordered the Master of the Order to stop the campaign and to build fortresses against the infection, and 300 years since they are defending the northern land from the swarm of plague.
Sometimes infected crusaders kept themselves sane. Those who suffered such fate were setting off their last crusade. Struck with the disease, they became plague hunters and were heading to the very heart of the infected land just to fall in battle and take as many insane monsters as they could with...

games.name: Villages™
games.shortDescription: Villages™ is an Open-World Sandbox game that has rules to encourage People to make a complex society and economy.
games.aboutText:
Villages™ is a game that combines interesting mechanics from many other sandbox games.

It aims to let People face a variety of gameplay and scenario by conducting a few basic rules.

KEY FEATURES

- Economy, the game's world will have limited resources, so ones will not get the same resources and amount.
People will then form an economy by using the trading system in the game.

- You can make a product with different tiers, from hand-crafted to factory-made.
Each tier varies in cost and benefit and makes it dynamic to the whole economy.

- Construction differs from a traditional sandbox game. Villages™ lets you construct a building as if in real life by using construction sites, tools, and vehicles.

- Skill-Based, People can choose their skill to advance, but with limited skill points.
So you must balance your skill branches and benefit from them.
Everyone will depend on other People's abilities and form their society.

games.name: Football Story
games.shortDescription: Football Story is a cozy football RPG and life sim about growing up, friendship, and a dream. Develop your skills, explore the town of Lumen Bay, help its residents, and build your own street football team. Rise from your first neighborhood matches to victory over the pros!
games.aboutText:
MAKE A TEENAGE DREAM COME TRUE

The journey to the top of street football begins with a simple passion. Guide an ambitious teenager through daily training and backyard games, helping them turn their everyday hobby into a true success story and become a local legend.

GATHER YOUR STREET TEAM

A captain is only as good as their teammates. Finding unique neighborhood kids and building great chemistry turns a group of everyday teens into a highly coordinated and winning squad on the football pitch.

COZY AND CHARMING HOMETOWN

Lumen Bay is a beautifully detailed and welcoming place waiting to be discovered. Its nostalgic streets are packed with vibrant art, visual humor, and hidden spots for the curious explorer.

FRIENDSHIPS BEYOND THE FIELD

Life outside the game is filled with quirky residents and their daily routines. Lending a hand to locals with their everyday troubles builds strong community bonds and unlocks helpful rewards.

TRAIN, PLAY, AND TRIUMPH

Regular exercises and fun mini-games keep your character's stats sharp and ready for action. During thrilling street matches, smart tactics and quick decisions are the true keys to outsmarting rivals and claiming victory.

games.name: Ancient Warfare 3
games.shortDescription: Dive into a sandbox full of action and customization! Choose from different game modes like deathmatch, conquest, king of the hill, zombie survival and many more. Create your own scenarios and content in the easy to use in-game editors or use one of the 50k+ workshop items from other players...
games.aboutText:
Dive into a sandbox full of action and customization! Choose from different game modes like deathmatch, conquest, king of the hill, zombie survival and many more. Create your own scenarios in the custom battle editor. Choose your rules, change the environment, place units, objects or traps, choose your equipment and fight or just relax and spectate a battle. Content

Explore content from different eras starting in the stone age, medieval ages, WWI, WWII and the modern era up to futuristic sci-fi content. 3400+ units, 1100+ objects and 580+ equipment items await you.
In addition, the Steam Workshop integration allows you to share your creations and choose from 23000+ battles, 5900+ prefabs, 25000+ units, 2200+ campaigns and various equipment items and objects to use them in your own creations! In-game editors

The central idea behind the game is to let players customize everything and create their own content!
In the custom battle editor you can place units, objects and other items to create your own scenarios with various game modes and settings for each object and unit to adjust their behavior. Custom units

The custom unit editor allows you to create detailed and complex units with various equipment slots and settings like color adjustments for armor and clothing items. Custom items

The custom equipment and object editors allow you to import your own models into an easy to use in-game editor to create custom melee and ranged weapons, grenades, shields, armor, clothing and environment, consumables and various other functional objects to use them in the battle editor or to create more unique looking custom units. Scripting Engine

To give players even more control, there is an event based visual scripting engine which can be used to create custom behavior and rules for battles, units, objects and the player.

games.name: Tennis Elbow 4
games.shortDescription: Created by and for tennis fans, Tennis Elbow 4 is a true tennis simulation built around anticipation, positioning and risk management. Easy to start, demanding to master, it delivers exceptional gameplay depth and long-term progression.
games.aboutText:
Tennis Elbow 4 is the successor to Tennis Elbow 2013, acclaimed by many Steam reviewers as one of the most realistic tennis simulations ever made.

TE4 pushes the realism of tennis rallies even further with fully reworked ball, strike and player physics. The game is built around anticipation, positioning, player inertia, shot selection and risk management, while still letting you start playing quickly with the right assists and difficulty settings.

Created by and for tennis fans, Tennis Elbow 4 is a deep tennis simulation that can be enjoyed at many levels. You can play casually with helpers such as Auto-Positioning, Footwork Boost and Aiming Preview, or progressively turn them down to experience a more demanding and precise game.

Like real tennis, TE4 rewards players who learn to read the ball, prepare early, position themselves properly and choose the right shot under pressure. The basics can click quickly, but mastering the rallies, timing and movement gives the game its long-term depth.

To beat your opponent, you can use all the main shots available on a real court: safe strikes, accelerations, topspin shots, slices, drop shots, lobs, volleys and smashes. Cross-court rallies, changes of rhythm, defensive play and risky winners all emerge naturally from the physics and the tactical situation.

With many difficulty levels and sublevels, Tennis Elbow 4 lets you tune the challenge very precisely. Lower levels and assists are ideal to learn the controls and enjoy the career at your own rhythm, while higher levels bring the pace, pressure and consistency closer to professional tennis.

Tennis Elbow 4 features one of the most complete World Tours ever made in a tennis game. With over 3500 players evolving across several decades and more than 400 tournaments each year, from low-rank Junior events to top-level Pro finals, in both singles and doubles, you can experience the long-term progression of a real tennis career.

The Tennis Elbow engine is also very open to modding, with many Mods directly downloadable from within the game. Mods can add or improve players, outfits, courts, sounds and many other elements, letting the community push the game even further.

Tennis Elbow 4 is made for players who want deep rallies, realistic ball physics, meaningful positioning and a true learning curve.

Features:

- 9 different court surfaces : clay, green clay, grass, hard, blue-green hard, classic synthetic, NewLine synthetic, indoor hard and indoor synthetic; each with a specific rebound

- 21 Stadiums around the world

- 400+ tournaments, with 3500+ players evolving over 70 years, from 1973 for men & 1983 for women, to 2042

- Commentaries by Tennis TV commentator Darren Kilfara

- The Country Cup

- Singles & doubles competitions

- Junior & Pro Tours

- 6 difficulty levels, each split into 10 sublevels

- Full ranking system

- 3D male & female players, fully customizable

- Singles, 3, and doubles games

- Split screen

- Network : LAN and online games

- 1 to 6 games per set, in best of 1, 3 or 5 sets

- 7 camera modes

- Moving sun and Night session

- The game is very Modding-friendly

Warnings for the Online mode :

- You can play doubles with 4 human players on 1 computer, or on 2 computers with 2 players on each, via LAN or Internet — but not on four separate computers.

- Online play uses peer-to-peer (P2P) connections with no relay server. This means that if you're behind CGNAT, or if you cannot forward a UDP port or use UPnP on your Internet router, you won’t be able to host a match. You should still be able to join a host, though.

games.name: DECONSTRUCTION
games.shortDescription: DECONSTRUCTION is a fast-paced, hardcore, shooting game.
games.aboutText:
DECONSTRUCTION is a fast-paced, hardcore, shooting game. Feature

* Boss fight only - Direct select the boss you want to fight with.
* Easy to start - Nothing complex needs to learn, just open the game and start play. WIP & Thank You!

This is the first time I release the game on Steam.
I'm still working on how to make it better on Steam and increasing its content.

Sorry for the delay of original launch date, this game still contains many problems I'm working on.

And, thank you for waiting!

games.name: Rhythm Doctor
games.shortDescription: Save patients with your rhythm mastery! Rhythm Doctor is a rhythm game where you heal patients by defibrillating in time to their heartbeats. Learn each patient's unique heartbeat and defeat boss viruses trying to sabotage your rhythm, all set to heart-pumping, soul-soothing music.
games.aboutText:
Save lives with your spacebar!

Rhythm Doctor is a rhythm game in a world where defibrillating patients' hearts in sync with their heartbeats has healing properties. Slam your spacebar in perfect time on the 7th beat, and they might just come out okay. But beware - every patient has unique illnesses based on complex music theory: polyrhythms, hemiolas, irregular time signatures...if you don't know what they mean, don't worry. Rhythm Doctor is designed to make you learn music and rhythm theory without even realising it!

- 20+ handmade levels, each with their own story.

- Every level introduces a different concept of rhythm theory in an accessible way

- A large cast of doctors and patients feature in an overarching, character-centric storyline

- Play the story solo or grab a friend for drop-in drop-out local multiplayer throughout the whole campaign!

- Robust level editor to make, share, and play community levels! Use your own music, place notes snapped to the beat, and use 50+ different visual effects and backgrounds

- Challenging "Night Shift" versions of each level for the brave

(Note: 2P mode only works locally. Online 2P via Remote Play is enabled for this game, but it does not work that well right now due to varying latency)

Rhythm Doctor features flashing lights and colors. Please use caution if you have experience with epilepsy or any of its symptoms.

games.name: ANIMAL WELL
games.shortDescription: Explore a dense, interconnected labyrinth, and unravel its many secrets. Collect items to manipulate your environment in surprising and meaningful ways. Encounter beautiful and unsettling creatures, as you attempt to survive what lurks in the dark. There is more than what you see.
games.aboutText:
Hatch from your flower and spelunk through the beautiful and sometimes haunting world of Animal Well, a pixelated wonder rendered in intricate audio and visual detail. Encounter lively creatures small and large, helpful and ominous as you discover unconventional upgrades and unravel the well’s secrets. This is a truly unique experience that can make you laugh in fear, surprise, or delight.

- Dense atmospheric puzzle box world with tons of secrets

- Light candles for safety and gradually fill out your map

- Nonlinear -- explore and collect items in whatever order you choose

- Enemies, environment, and items interact in surprising and systemic ways

- All items have multiple uses

- Learn how innocuous details can become meaningful

- The main game is just the beginning. Players will be discovering hidden puzzles for years

- Assess for yourself what is safe and dangerous

- Focus on tension and suspense rather than action

- You are disempowered, but can make clever use of your environment and items

games.name: Aura of Worlds
games.shortDescription: Aura of Worlds is a chaotic, creative tactics rogue-lite platformer. Explore multiple dangerous worlds where you utilize creative abilities & wield the environment to your advantage. Blast, dash, grapple, fight, and charm your way through ever-changing labyrinths & outwit powerful guardians!
games.aboutText:
Aura of Worlds is a creative tactics rogue-lite platformer. Explore multiple worlds where you must utilize your creative abilities to twist adversity to your advantage. You'll need planning, wits, and reflexes to make your way through these ever-changing death labyrinths.

Expect to die. A lot. This isn’t just about reflexes—it’s about outsmarting the chaos. Each challenge has multiple solutions, and every failure is a step toward mastery. But don’t worry—no grind to win or unfair one-hit deaths here. You’ll always have a fighting chance… if you’re clever enough.

Escape flooding passages, outrun toxic pollen, and battle gargantuan bosses that have made entire mazes their domain. Will you play it safe with a spear and energy shield, or swing into danger with a boomerang and grapple hook? Will you scour the ruins for hidden relics, or dive headfirst into the unknown?

A demo of the game exists in the form of a more limited lite version: Rogue Worlds.

- Creative Problem-Solving – There’s always more than one way forward! Grapple across pits, explode barriers, slow time, or even turn enemies against each other. Every object has multiple uses—grab a lantern from the ceiling and use it as a portable light source or an improvised flaming Molotov.

- Diverse Combat & Playstyles: Wield an arsenal of weapons and abilities: slash with a sword, attack from range, enthral enemies, or manipulate the environment. Choose between fast melee strikes, ranged precision, or experimental tactics like warping time and cloaking.

- Ever-Changing Death Labyrinths: Procedurally generated worlds with shifting layouts, dynamic hazards, and unpredictable challenges. Explore 12+ unique level themes and 6 primary world types, each filled with unique traps, powerful enemies, and devious secrets.

- Over 100 Deadly Enemies & Traps: Battle relentless foes, dodge lethal hazards, and out think colossal bosses that test both quick reflexes and lateral thinking.

- Unlockables & Progression: Find powerful artifacts, equip game-changing perks, and unlock new starting gear and world shortcuts to expand your options in every run.

- Handcrafted Pixel Art & Unique Score: A stunning blend of retro visuals, fluid animations, and an atmospheric soundtrack brings each deadly world to life.

games.name: Lost Flame
games.shortDescription: Lost Flame is a modern roguelike game featuring unique and challenging turn-based combat. Find your way in the ruined kingdom of Hiraeth while fighting against legendary warriors of the past and spawn of the unfathomable Abysm.
games.aboutText:
Lost Flame is a modern roguelike game featuring unique and challenging turn-based combat. Explore the ruined kingdom of Hiraeth, fight against legendary warriors of the past and discover the reasons of the cataclysm.

The game takes lots of inspiration from classical roguelikes and includes stuff such as turn-based, permadeath, lots of procedural content.

There is a number of features which are something new in the genre, the most important one being a unique take on the turn based combat.
Melee combat focuses a lot on positioning and movement, it's not the typical bump into enemy until it dies.

Dodging attacks
Most of the enemy attacks are slow and you can usually dodge them by simply walking away:

It's simple at first area or two, but gets more difficult very quickly!

Big and unique enemies
Lost Flame features lots of multitile enemies

Most of the enemies have some unique traits or abilities and you cannot just apply the same approach to everything you meet.

Different weapons
Depending on which weapon you carry, you have access to, usually, 3 or 4 different special attacks.
For example

with long sword you can slash 3 grid tiles in one turn:

with short sword you can lunge - jump one grid and attack in one turn

with halberd you can slash around everything in a huge semi-circle

There are also other weapon types, such as spears, greatswords, all kind of axes and maces and a few more. Each with their own set of attacks.
Some unique weapons have completely new, unique attack types.

Each type of weapon requires a different strategy in combat, for example with short swords you are extremely mobile and can land quick hits on single targets, while dodging enemy strikes, with big weapons such as great axes or halberds, you usually want to position well and attack multiple enemies at once, because your attacks, while powerful, are slow.

Customization of character builds
Your character is completely defined by the items he carries.

You can empower your weapons by selecting which rings you want to wear, their effects are unique and usually it's not obvious which ring will suit best for your current build, below are a few ring types you can find:

Right now there are over 120 ring and amulet types possible to be found. Your character has 4 ring fingers and 2 amulet slots.

There are multiple magical item enchants (prefixes and suffixes), for example:

Another layer of customization are scrolls of enchant items. They are quite plentiful and you can use them almost on any non-consumable item - you can enchant weapons, armor, but also rings, wands and other usable magical items. What you will want to enchant depends on you and there are no clear-cut correct answers here.

SFX
Lost Flame features cinematic music, rich sound effects and recorded voice overs for NPCs.

Gameplay features

- Over 100 hours of content

- While the game gets more difficult in the later areas, the earliest areas also require some thinking, you cannot just autopilot through them.

- Mistakes are costly - when in combat usually single move, or attack can determine the outcome

- Power curve is quite flat - while with proper equipment your character can dish out significant damage, he still remains quite fragile and getting too cocky results in a quick death

- There is a small id game - there are unidentified potions and scrolls you can find, however they get identified every time you gain a level.

- All attacks consume stamina and if you run out of it, you can no longer use weapon special attacks (you can still use the basic "bump into enemy" attack) and you receive more damage

- There is rich lore behind the game world, however it's not "in your face" - if you are interested you can connect the dots about game world from the flavor texts of items and monsters (this one is work in progress, I have the lore and the story all laid out, however there are still lots of flavor texts to be written)

games.name: Code: Terraform
games.shortDescription: A deep automation and programming game on a frozen alien planet. Write real code to drive rovers, run power grids, fabricate parts, and fly drone fleets across the world. Your scripts run while you plan your next move. The more you terraform, the more the planet responds.
games.aboutText:
You've been sent to a frozen alien world. Your ship is silent. Sensors offline.

The only way to bring this place to life is to write code.

Code: Terraform is an automation/programming game where every action happens through scripts you write. Not visual programming. Not drag and drop. Real code, in a language modeled after Python, with a full editor, console, and documentation built into the game.

You don't click to mine. You write the mining script. You don't manage a power grid by hand. You script the policy that runs it. Solar trackers follow the sun because your code reads the clock. Drone fleets fly because your code dispatches them. The more systems you script, the more the planet responds.

Boot your systems

Bring your base online one script at a time. Calibrate sensors. Activate solar power. Read raw instrument data and turn it into meaning. Every system is a component you interact with through code.

Write scripts that run autonomously

Your solar tracker follows the sun. Your rover surveys distant sites and drills the ones worth mining. Your smelter refines what comes back. They all run at the same time, your code working while you plan your next move.

Solve engineering contracts

Earth sends contracts. Data processing challenges with real rewards. Parse signals, filter datasets, compute solutions. The harder the contract, the bigger the payout.

Refine, fabricate, deliver

Earn credits. Buy machines. Deploy modular rovers and Pioneers, swap nav and sonar and drill modules to suit the job. Smelt ore into ingots. Fabricate parts: pipe segments, machine frames, circuit panels, turbine rotors, cargo pods, thruster assemblies, battery packs. Ship orders to Earth's contractors for credits, recipe unlocks, and tech upgrades. Scale from a single solar panel to a planet spanning industry.

Power grids and fluid networks

Drill water from underground reserves. Tap oil wells. Cap geothermal vents for steam. Pipe each medium across the planet, balance backpressure, and feed tier three machines that demand continuous flow to run at full output. Bridge crossing pipes with overpasses. Wire power subnets with line segments. The infrastructure layer is tile by tile, and yours to design.

Tiers, upgrades, and the climb

Mark I machines bring you to a thin atmosphere. Mark II push you to breathable air. Mark III demand fluid input but unlock the climb to terraformed. Earn upgrade packs through orders, apply them to deployed machines, watch your output curve bend.

Construct what you need

Plan pipes, power lines, and outposts in a tile based blueprint editor. Send a Pioneer with a Constructor module to execute the plan. Lay infrastructure piece by piece, exact tile by exact tile, the same way a real engineering crew would.

Build drones. Fly the routes. Stand up outposts.

Assemble drones from chassis, thrusters, and modular pods. Plant outposts in the richest territory and operate them remotely. Write flight scripts that haul ore home, ferry supplies out, recover stranded fleets. Charging stations and refueling pads keep the fleet airborne. Recovery bays airlift the ones that don't make it back. Distance becomes a function of battery and fuel, not track. Share a route once as a library script and every drone uses it.

A real programming environment

Full code editor with syntax highlighting, autocomplete, signature help, type aware completions, rename refactoring, and inline docs that jump on Cmd+click. Multiple scripts running concurrently. Library scripts for shared code: import a function once, use it everywhere. Breakpoints, log points, conditional breakpoints, three step modes for real debugging. Dock the editor to code and watch the results side by side.

Something is wrong

Sensor readings that don't match. Warm patches where nothing should be warm. Structures that weren't there yesterday. Mission control asking questions they shouldn't need to ask. The more you terraform, the more the planet responds. Not to your equipment. To you.

A story told through your terminal

No cutscenes. No cinematics. Every story beat arrives through the systems you already use. Briefings, sensor data, encrypted transmissions, contract anomalies. The truth unfolds while you work. Pay attention to the details.

No hand holding

There are docs and hints. No tutorials. Figure it out, like a real engineer would.

games.name: Guns 'n Goblins
games.shortDescription: Face a deluge of monsters in this incremental horde survivor FPS. Build your Bastion, level up your character, and upgrade your arsenal to rise from Apprentice Bell Ringer to Master Dragon Hunter.
games.aboutText:
YOU ARE THE LAST BELL RINGER

“With every rising moon, tides of monsters wash over the land.

Long ago, a king constructed the Bell Bastions to draw these hordes away from the defenseless.

That kingdom has since fallen to ruin, but one single Bastion still stands.

You are the last Bell Ringer.
And this is your first night.”

CALL MASSIVE SWARMS

- Face torrents of creatures thousands strong

- Control the horde: Ring the bell as often as you dare to call a deluge of monsters

- Push your limits to reap even more rewards: XP, gold, and resources

UNLEASH YOUR FIREPOWER

- Level up to max out your stats and passive perks

- Unlock new weapons and upgrade them to reach even deadlier heights

- With each death, your strength grows : rise from Apprentice Bell Ringer to Master Dragon Hunter

REBUILD THE BASTION

- Call on and train a skeleton army to hold the fort

- Repair the base’s equipment and build your defenses

- Assemble some unlikely allies whose talents will prove vital

- - -

games.name: Outcast Tales: The First Journey
games.shortDescription: Experience the beginning of a grand adventure in Outcast Tales: The First Journey. Engage in deep tactical battles, make tough decisions, and choose your own adventures - write an Outcast Tale that’s unique to you!
games.aboutText:
The First Journey is just the beginning of a much grander experience (as the name sort of implies!). So, for now, familiarize yourself with the wasteland - you'll spend a lot more time in it when Outcast Tales is out! Be tactical (or mash buttons; might work just as well)!

Robots, mutants, desert raiders: almost all enemies have something up their sleeve. So do your characters: some abilities are most effective in combination with others. Find your opponents' weaknesses, humiliate them on the battlefield, and never ponder the moral implications of your actions! Use your strengths (if you can find any)!

Combine class and personality types to give each of your characters a unique set of abilities. A Preacher Mercenary and an Antihero Mercenary will behave quite differently. Create a balanced crew, or just try out the wildest combinations to see how they turn out! Overcome challenges (or mess everything up)!

Your characters will encounter dozens of unique situations that test their skill and wits. The Pacifist might talk his way out of trouble, the Egghead might try setting up traps, and the Daredevil will most likely just start blasting! In Outcast Tales, there are no wrong answers. Develop relationships (like in a dating game, but not quite)!

Your characters can develop deep bonds or even fall in love - but can also come to despise each other, all depending on your actions. Your journey can become a wholesome story about newfound friendship, or a gruesome tale of three strangers constantly at each other’s throats. Whatever sounds more fun… Let the chat join the action (or, more realistically, set you up)!

Connect the game to your Twitch account so that your viewers can influence the gameplay! The Twitch Integration feature will enable your chat to make crucial decisions during events, as well as choose your next destination or ability upgrade. And don't worry, your viewers won't ever try to harm you. They love you. Right..?

games.name: Burden of Command™
games.shortDescription: Can you lead? Burden of Command is an emotionally authentic tactical leadership RPG. You’re a company Captain in the historical Cottonbalers. Fighting psychology as much as bullets, you must build respect, trust, and battlefield experience to bring your brothers safely home.

games.name: Valheim
games.shortDescription: A collaborative exploration and survival game for 1-10 players, set in a procedurally generated afterlife inspired by Viking culture. Battle, build, and conquer your way to a saga worthy of Odin’s patronage!
games.aboutText:
Valheim is a collaborative exploration and survival game for 1-10 players set in a procedurally generated world inspired by Norse mythology. Craft powerful weapons, construct elaborate halls, and slay mighty foes to prove yourself to Odin!

Discover an immersive procedurally generated world, with different biomes that each have their distinct environments, unique resources and dangerous enemies. Become a Viking and sail the open seas in search of lands unknown, alone or with up to nine friends!

The Tenth World has been corrupted by hateful forces, in the shape of mighty regional bosses known as the Forsaken. Hone your skills with axes, blades and bows, and prepare yourself by crafting the very best equipment – for it is only by defeating these Forsaken that you will advance in your progress and prove yourself to the Allfather.

Raise Viking longhouses and build bases that offer reprieve from the dangers ahead. Whether you build a small shelter, an entire village or a mountain-side fortress, defence and structural integrity are important, as is decorating it for maximum comfort!

As you discover new materials, you will learn new recipes for crafting, building and cooking – all that a Viking might need! The food system is rewarding rather than punishing, granting you boons and benefits depending on what you eat, and is directly tied to the combat system, where your health and stamina might be just the thing that makes a difference between life and death.

Community-translated languages
In addition to the officially supported languages, Valheim has several community-translated languages. As the name would suggest, these are all translated by fans and members of the community, and the process is frequently ongoing. Thus, we cannot guarantee the quality or completeness of any specific translation.

games.name: Monomyth
games.shortDescription: MONOMYTH is an immersive, first-person dungeon-crawling RPG inspired by the genre's late classics. Embark on a journey through a vast and highly interactive game world as you unravel the mysteries hidden beneath the ancient fortress of Lysandria.
games.aboutText:
As the sun sets on the empires of mankind and civilization crumbles under great storms ravaging the world's surface, the people of Ariath retreat to the underground.

Amidst the chaos of this dying world your father, King Ferodin the Third sent an expedition to the fallen fortress city of Lysandria.

It is said, that within the ruins of the fortress lies the primeval seed - a divine gift that may calm the gods' anger and put an end to the roaring thunder in the sky.

Spearheaded by your own brother, the expedition hoped to retrieve the sacred object but was never heard of again.

Against your father's wish, you decide to travel to Lysandria yourself.

Find your brother and retrieve the divine gift, but beware: The ancient fortress is not as deserted as it seems...

MONOMYTH features a vast, interconnected game environment. Wander from the highest towers to the lowest caverns, find secret chambers, uncover hidden passageways and explore a multitude of differently themed areas.

Explore a highly interactive underworld, filled with items, puzzles, monsters and a variety of peaceful inhabitants. Talk to characters using a detailed keyword-based dialogue system and combine items to interact with your surroundings. Trade, pick locks, break doors or throw objects! You can even bake bread!

Swing your sword, cast spells, dodge, parry, and block. In MONOMYTH you move freely through the world, using a rich arsenal of deadly weapons and powerful magic.

In MONOMYTH you are free to develop a unique character build. Invest into six different character attributes and thirteen skills, unlocking dozens of different playstyles. Will you be a nimble assassin, a fearsome battlemage, or maybe something completely different? The choice is all yours!

Set in an apocalyptic fantasy world, MONOMYTH combines magic and technology into a new, unique setting. Open the gates to a dark, mysterious realm, beset by horrifying monstrosities and discover the secrets of the fortress city of Lysandria.

games.name: Mike goes on hike
games.shortDescription: Leave the city behind in a first-person hiking adventure. Explore mountain trails, take photographs, and fill Mike’s travel journal with memories — from a thrilling zipline ride to a quiet evening by the campfire.
games.aboutText:
Far from the world. Closer to yourself.

Leave the bustle of everyday life behind and set out on a hike through the wilderness.

Mike Goes on Hike is an atmospheric first-person adventure filled with breathtaking landscapes, forgotten places, stories of the past, and a mysterious voice at the other end of the radio.

Explore the wilderness

Follow forest trails, overcome obstacles, and explore your surroundings. Stray from the main route, discover hidden places, and notice the details that are easy to miss along the way.

Uncover stories of the past

Abandoned buildings and traces of human presence hold the stories of those who once came here. Study your surroundings, find unusual details, and piece together the lives they left behind.

Photograph your discoveries

Pick up your camera and capture striking landscapes, intriguing finds, and landmarks. Preserve moments from your journey and fill your journal with photographs of the places you discover.

Someone is at the other end of the radio

Even far from civilization, you are not entirely alone. Talk to a mysterious person on the radio, share your discoveries, and listen to their stories. Little by little, ordinary conversations become part of a journey that turns out to be less lonely than it first seemed.

Stop and catch your breath

After a long stretch of hiking, set up camp, rest by the fire, and enjoy the sounds of nature. Take a moment away from the trail and simply soak in the atmosphere of a real hike.

Your hike. Your discoveries. Your story.

Explore the wilderness, photograph unusual places, and uncover stories left behind.

Mike Goes on Hike — far from the world. Closer to yourself.

games.name: 3dSen VR
games.shortDescription: Built with passion for retro lovers, 3dSenVR turns iconic NES games into living 3D dioramas you can step inside. A fresh, heartfelt take on 8-bit nostalgia in full VR.
games.aboutText:
3dSenVR is a one-of-a-kind emulator that transforms classic NES games into fully playable 3D voxel dioramas, reimagined for Virtual Reality. Whether you're diving back into legendary titles or discovering hidden gems for the first time, 3dSenVR brings your favorite 8-bit adventures to life in a whole new dimension.
Explore timeless platformers, deep RPGs, intense shooters, beat 'em ups, puzzlers, and more—magically reborn in immersive 3D space.
If you only want to play in PC mode, check out 3dSen PC instead.
You must provide your own roms as 3dSen VR doesn't contain any rom. 🎮 Highlight Features

- Ever-Growing Game Support (100+ Titles) - Enjoy a hand-crafted and expanding library of retro classics and modern homebrew. Includes—but isn't limited to—Super Mario Bros, Punch-Out!!, DuckTales, Mega Man, Contra, Metroid, The Legend of Zelda series, Final Fantasy, Duck Hunt, Dragon Warrior, Batman, Castlevania, Battle Kid, Micro Mages, and more.

- VR & Desktop Support - Choose between full VR immersion or classic desktop mode. Runs on OpenXR: SteamVR headsets, Meta Quest (Link, Air Link or Virtual Desktop) and Steam Frame.

- Full Controller Support - Play and navigate everything with your VR controllers or a gamepad, and remap any button in Settings.

- Mixed Reality Mode (Meta Quest + Virtual Desktop) - Use your real-world surroundings as a dynamic backdrop for NES nostalgia.

- Enhanced Visual Style - Reflective floors, soft shading, pixel shadows and world curvature, right in your headset. The Classic style remains available.

- Retina Render Mode - A whole new way of sub-voxel modeling that sculpts smooth, rounded surfaces.

- Run Ahead - Lower input delay for more responsive controls.

- Quick Save/Load - Save your progress at any moment and jump right back in.

- Rollback & Fast Forward - Rewind to fix mistakes or fast forward through slow sections.

- Motion Controller Support - Use your motion controller as a Zapper in Duck Hunt, Hogan's Alley, and Wild Gunman. Full motion control support for Punch-Out!!—dodge, weave, and throw punches like you're in the ring.

- Intuitive VR Controls - Navigate menus effortlessly with laser pointers from either controller, or with a gamepad.

- Dynamic Skyboxes - Surround yourself with rich, animated environments that enhance immersion.

- Export 3D Scenes - Save in-game views as external 3D models for creative or archival use.

- Custom Cover Art - Personalize your library with custom box art for each game.

games.name: Catizens
games.shortDescription: Inspired by RimWorld and The Sims, Catizens is a colony management simulation game where you watch over unique cats with quirky personalities, as you help them build and grow their settlement while exploring new lands, facing off against wildlife and overcoming the challenges of each environment.
games.aboutText:
Herding cats is easy! Said no one…ever

Your main job in Catizens is to build your town around the personality traits of its inhabitants. Just like in real life, cats require personal attention and special treatment. Combinations of different personality traits and moods affect their proficiency and obedience. Catizens form relationships with each other and will occasionally issue personal requests, so you will need to learn what makes each cat happy in order to stay on their good side.

Create unique cats and design the perfect home

Pick from an assortment of facial and body features, as well as personality traits to create cats with distinct looks and temperaments. Design a place just for them by decorating your settlements with pieces of furniture, plants and other items. The better furnished a town is, the happier your catizens will be. So get creative!

Build and manage your settlement

Catizens can learn a variety of professions – from farming, to blacksmithing or offering protection from local wildlife. Different building types unlock depending on the traits and professions available. There’s no need to micromanage the entire settlement when it gets large. Invest your time and attention in a few outstanding cats and let them become town leaders.

Explore the wilderness

Develop your settlement, complete objectives and expand to areas with different environments that offer new adventures. Carefully examine your surroundings to find the best fishing spots, hidden treasures and quirky characters that may offer a quest.

games.name: Rogue Monster Rush
games.shortDescription: A unique Tower Defense game featuring Monster Collecting and Roguelike mechanics. Hatch, upgrade, and command a party of monster defenders, while unleashing player spells, to defend your base from the hordes of invading robots.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Rogue Monster Rush!
