Save your hard-earned money for useful supplies, or blow it on champagne in a fancy nightclub. Get wasted and participate in underground bar fights, assault innocent pedestrians, or destroy vending machines and ATMs to plunder their contents—just don't expect the police to sit idly by during your rampage. The decisions you make have lasting consequences. Will you fight for justice and defend the downtrodden, or become the ultimate delinquent and declare war on law and order?

games.name: The Séance of Blake Manor
games.shortDescription: The Séance of Blake Manor is a supernatural detective mystery, set in 1897 Ireland, where you investigate the disappearance of Evelyn Deane in a remote hotel full of secrets and other-worldly occurrences.
games.aboutText:
Ireland, October 29, 1897.

I’ll waste no time, since there’s none for wasting. I write from Blake Manor in Connemara.

Yesterday, a guest went missing – a young woman named Evelyn Deane. The owner and staff carry on as if nothing has happened.

She has not left, of that I am sure.

It is October 29th, 1897, and Private Investigator Declan Ward arrives at Blake Manor to find a missing woman.

What he finds is the Grand Séance and a group of mystics who have gathered from all corners of the world – waiting for All Hallow’s Eve, the night when the veil between worlds is thinnest. The night to tear down the barrier and speak to the dead.

Interview and interrogate your suspects, keep a record of all evidence, motivations, and clues in your journal, and confront them about their motivations when you’re certain of your deductions. Uncover the truth about Blake Manor and the mysterious séance that has brought everyone together.

Navigate Blake Manor's haunted corridors and uncover its secrets as you race against time to save Miss Deane.

Investigate the manor, solve environmental clues and reach the forbidden areas of the hotel…and beyond.

But be careful - each action counts the day down. Be in the right place at the right time to catch critical events pertinent to your investigation. Everyone has their own agendas and schedules – it could truly be a loss to miss out on a quick chat by mistiming your actions. And who knows what hidden secrets lie in wait once you’ve turned in for the night...

Brought to you by the creators of The Darkside Detective and Raw Fury, The Séance of Blake Manor is depicted by a beautiful comic-book art style. Inspired by Irish Mythology and the spiritualist movements of the Victorian era, players are cast into a first-person narrative adventure, blending the supernatural with a classic detective mystery. With its striking cutscenes, compelling narrative and dynamic soundtrack that reacts to the environment around you, Blake Manor and its secrets will leave you on the edge of your seat morning through night.

...I know the West of Ireland might as well be the far side of the world, for its distance from you but there is no one else to turn to.

I hear you are an honourable man, a steadfast investigator. And – perhaps most importantly – godly.

I pray for the girl that this is true...

This game is currently only available in English language.

games.name: Perennial Order
games.shortDescription: Perennial Order is a 2D plant horror boss rush with challenging one-hit-death combat. Set in an atmospheric Dark Age world plagued by nature-infested horrors, explore a lore-filled and eldritch land alone or in two player co-op, all in a realistic painterly style.
games.aboutText:
Perennial Order is a 2D plant horror boss rush , set in an atmospheric Dark Age world plagued by nature-infested horrors.

Explore a mysterious world alone or with a friend, uncover a story through unusual NPCs, and cut down terrifying eldritch bosses, all in a painterly 2D style.

David vs. Goliath Combat

- Uncover a unique boss around every corner that will test you in different ways.

- Intense combat that utilizes twin stick melee controls .

- One-Hit-Death . Respawn directly at the beginning of an encounter to learn quickly from your actions; spend your time fighting rather than walking .

Captivating 2D Style

- A painterly 2D art style with a dark fantasy inspiration.

- Themes and visuals akin to the world designs of titles like Dark Souls and Princess Mononoke .

- Painstakingly crafted by 1 artist and 1 animator . We are developing the visual identity of Perennial Order through realistic, painterly techniques combined with 2D Spine animation.

Plagued by Nature

- Immerse yourself in a dreary land where unspeakable horrors roam.

- Discover Unusual NPCs and unravel more about this mysteriously beautiful world.

- Explore a rich atmosphere through sounds and score, with musical themes distinct to each boss .

Bonded Journey

- Experience the entirety of Perennial Order from start to finish with a friend .

- Local and Online Co-Op .

Key Features

- Unique Bosses | Different mechanics to adapt to. Lovecraftian and terrifying battles.

- One-Hit-Death | Every combat choice matters.

- Minimal UI | Nothing to clog up the screen to add to the atmosphere.

- Intriguing NPCs and World | A world worth exploring.

- Online and Local Co-Op | Bonded Journey mode. 2 player adventure.

We like to describe Perennial Order as Hollow Knight meets Titan Souls - a beautiful dark atmosphere to explore, with boss-rush focused gameplay.

Developed by Gardenfiend Games

James Markiewicz | Programming

Vincent Van Hoof | Art

Miguel Félix | Animation

Julian Crowhurst | Music / Audio

games.name: Everafter Falls
games.shortDescription: Rediscover the simple life. Farm, fish, forge and fight to restore the peace in an all-new farming adventure. Features split-screen coop, a helpful pet, automated drones, resourceful pixies, a card-eating progression system, and dangerous dungeons to delve into!
games.aboutText:
You once had a serene and peaceful existence right here in Everafter Falls. Don't you remember?

You wake up to discover your previous life was nothing but a simulation. You've no memory of this place, your quaint animal neighbors, the refreshing wind and fragrant flowers, the little farm you had tucked away just outside town, none of it. But once you spend a little time with your forgotten friends and your helpful pet, doesn't Everafter Falls just feel perfect? Isn't it where you always wanted to be?

Sure, you'll need to farm, fish and fight your way back to prominence in the tiny, cozy town, but you know your way around a sword, right? You know how to water your farm and progress through the dungeons. You know how to upgrade your stats and beat back tougher and tougher enemies, don't you? Just give those cards a good chomp and you'll have everything you need!

Of course, if you need a little help, don't worry! Automated drones can expand your inventory, tend to your harvest, and even help you fight. And your pet missed you more than anything while you were under. They're here to help out around the farm, learning all sorts of neat things, like tilling your soil, watering your crops, and even teleporting you across the map. What? You've never heard of a teleporting cat before?

It's Everafter Falls! Things are peaceful here. There's nothing to worry about... right?

games.name: Defensia
games.shortDescription: Defensia is a turn-based strategy game. Build structures, Grow carrots, Recruit bunnians, Kill enemies, Keep your castle safe!
games.aboutText:
Defensia is a turn-based strategy game.

Build structures, Grow carrots, Recruit bunnians, Kill enemies, Keep your castle safe!

There are 4 kinds of bunnian jobs, Swordsman, Archer, Magician, Priest and Worker.

games.name: Battle Shapers
games.shortDescription: Battle Shapers is an action-packed, sci-fi FPS roguelite in which you shoot and smash your way through swarms of corrupt robots. Wield powerful weapons, abilities, and game-changing new powers stolen from ruthless Overlords.
games.aboutText:
You play as Ada, a reactivated Shaper tasked with reclaiming New Elysium from the cunning Overlords and their corrupted robots. Using advanced weapons and unique abilities, you will shoot & smash your way through dangerous towers and defeat the Overlords to put an end to their corruption of the city.

- Gun down hordes of enemy machines with relentless and punishing close-range combat in which every bot destroyed makes you stronger.

- Face the Overlords and adapt to their evolving powers and tactics by mastering highly customizable weapons, movement, and combat abilities.

- Steal the Overlords’ Cores and harness their powers to craft and transform both your playstyle and appearance.

- Unlock new weapons, abilities and talents to permanently increase your survivability and maximize your combat potential with every run.

- Deploy your own traps, power-ups and hacks in each Overlord’s tower to turn the tides of battle in your favor.

- Explore vibrant nostalgia-inspired locations to discover hidden upgrades and weapons throughout.

- Be warned! Just as you grow stronger by defeating Overlords, the journey ahead will also become more challenging.

- Defy the Overlords and save the city to the might of adrenaline-pumping rock music that will have you diving head-on and fist-first into action.

games.name: Endless Alice
games.shortDescription: Endless Alice is a third-person action-adventure game combining Roguelite elements, anime aesthetics, and endless possibilities. Choose characters with unique combat styles and embark on adventures! Play solo or with friends in cooperative challenges for up to 4 players!
games.aboutText:
SURVIVE A VIRTUAL WORLD

Battle your way through unique and beautiful locations. Packed with challenge monsters and enormous bosses bent on taking you out, don’t give them the satisfaction!

Pick one of six characters each with unique abilities and battle styles!

PLAY SOLO OR CO-OP

Challenge yourself by taking on enemies alone, or with up to four of your friends online and battle cooperatively!

games.name: Gelldonia
games.shortDescription: Gelldonia is a world full of secrets and dangers. You, armed with a musket and a saber, must face them. Travel, gather resources, craft items, trade and fight for glory and fame.
games.aboutText:
Story:
The struggle for dominance over the islands set on this blue sea planet continues. The faction of navy blue coats is in the lead in conquest. The other kingdoms have joined forces to face them together. You, as an adventurer or a mercenary, set off on a ship of red coats to attack the enemy's fort, which is still under construction. This is the last chance to conquer the northern lands.

Features:
- fight with weapons inspired by 17th and 18th century equipment
- collect resources and create new unique items
- play together with your friends in multiplayer mode
- earn gold and gain experience to advance to a higher rank and lead the squad yourself

games.name: Inferno
games.shortDescription: Your commanding officer betrayed you. Run, jump, dash, and FIRE as you hunt him down through a Genesis-style revenge mission.
games.aboutText:
Out of the ashes comes Inferno: a 2D platform action-adventure game heavily inspired by 16-bit platformers. In this militaristic setting, play as Kai; a sergeant in the Krorion Space Forces, searching for his ex-commanding officer, Ion, after a routine mission goes awry.

Tight and responsive controls deliberately designed to function on a 3-button Genesis controller, while keeping the same fluidity on modern gamepads.

Challenging gameplay and boss battles with escalating encounters that demand both quick reflexes and smart positioning.

Explore different, dangerous areas and interact with environments directly through gameplay.

Illustrated cutscenes that reveal Kai’s story without ever stopping the momentum.

games.name: Aquarist
games.shortDescription: Build beautiful aquariums, care for exotic marine life, complete creative customer jobs, and grow your own aquarium business into a world-class oceanarium in this relaxing sandbox simulation
games.aboutText:
Design, build, and manage incredible aquariums in Aquarist – a relaxing aquarium simulator where creativity meets business management.

Create beautiful freshwater and saltwater tanks, care for exotic aquatic animals, complete unique customer jobs, run your own aquarium store, and expand from a small local business into a spectacular oceanarium. Whether you enjoy creative building, management simulation, or relaxing sandbox gameplay, Aquarist lets you create the aquarium of your dreams.

KEY FEATURES

BUILD YOUR DREAM AQUARIUM

Create aquariums exactly the way you want.

Choose tank sizes, layouts, decorations, plants, rocks, backgrounds, and equipment to build anything from a peaceful nature-inspired aquascape to a luxurious underwater exhibit. Every aquarium is fully customizable—even the background can use your own photos.

Experiment with endless design possibilities and create unique aquariums that reflect your imagination.

RUN YOUR OWN AQUARIUM BUSINESS

Start with a small aquarium shop and grow your business.

Complete customer orders, earn money, unlock new equipment, purchase rare fish and decorations, and expand into larger locations. Every successful project helps you develop your aquarium empire.

CARE FOR AMAZING AQUATIC ANIMALS

Keep freshwater and saltwater species healthy and thriving.

Look after tropical fish, sharks, rays, sea turtles, octopuses, shrimp, cuttlefish, arapaima, corals, and many more fascinating aquatic creatures.

Maintain proper water conditions, feed your animals, and create environments where every species can flourish.

COMPLETE UNIQUE PROJECTS

No two jobs are the same.

Design aquariums for museums, bars, restaurants, private homes, and unusual locations around the world. Build turtle habitats, create decorative piranha tanks, renovate neglected aquariums, and solve increasingly creative challenges.

Every project introduces new mechanics, rewards, and opportunities to expand your collection.

GROW INTO AN AQUARIUM EMPIRE

Unlock new buildings and larger attractions as your reputation grows.

Expand beyond your aquarium shop into exhibition halls, an aquatic museum, and even a massive oceanarium filled with spectacular marine life.

Whether you prefer relaxing decoration, business management, or completing unusual aquarium projects, Aquarist offers hours of satisfying sandbox gameplay where every aquarium is your own creation.

games.name: The Girl from Arkanya
games.shortDescription: The Girl from Arkanya is a top-down treasure hunting RPG, mimicking the style and feel of 2D Zelda games. Explore the jungles of Amazonia as Marisa, alongside her capybara companion!
games.aboutText:
Join Marisa and Kapi as they journey into the jungles of Amazonia! The Girl from Arkanya is a pixel art action RPG that draws inspiration from 2D Zelda classics such as Minish Cap and Four Swords Adventures. Our tale begins in Arkanya, a city at the edge of the world. In a realm of danger and mystery, Marisa the Treasure Hunter strives to build a reputation for herself and carry on her family's legacy.

Along the way, a terrible turn of events forces Marisa to work alongside an unusual ally, a magical capybara known to the land as Ka'apiuara Yum Kaax. But you can call him Kapi!

Now they embark on an epic journey to save their home!
...And make some money doing it.

- Journey Through 7 Unique Zones! Each of The Girl from Arkanya's overworld zones have been hand-crafted and are filled with people to meet, landmarks to discover, and most importantly, treasure to find!

- Delve into 6 Challenging Dungeons! Each dungeon in The Girl from Arkanya has a unique theme, and tells an important part of the story. Find out what riches and perils await within!

- Unlock Dozens of Collectables! Amazonia is home to many valuable artifacts, and each one tells a different piece of the land's history. Become a part of that history by collecting them all!

- Obtain Unique Items! Use 15 equippable tools to solve puzzles, traverse terrain, and defeat your foes. Each item offers a new playstyle and allows you to progress in ways you couldn't previously, and some can be upgraded into even stronger versions!

- Learn Ancient Magic! With each dungeon you complete, Marisa obtains a new spell which can be activated by performing sacred dances. These dances provide new powers to both Marisa and Kapi, granting each of them special abilities!

- Swap Between Two Playable Characters! Alternating between controlling Marisa and Kapi is crucial to overcoming many of the challenges that await you in Amazonia.

- Bring a Friend! The Girl from Arkanya features local co-op, allowing a second player to drop in and out of the adventure at any time.

- Now You're Thinking With Capybaras! Creative use of the character-swapping mechanic creates endless opportunities for you to optimize your gameplay, and prove that you are truly the best treasure hunter out there!

So, what do you say, mate? Want to come to Arkanya for an adventure?

games.name: Territory: Farming and Warfare
games.shortDescription: From a small village of a dozen people to a small kingdom of thousands of people. Arrange for residents to work, gathering, fishing and hunting, farming and mining, processing and manufacturing. Trade, accumulate supplies, increase your strength, and fight evil forces and monsters.
games.aboutText:
The core gameplay of the game is village management + commanding and fighting. Players can develop from a small village of a dozen people to a small kingdom of thousands of people.

Internally arrange residents to work and carry out production and construction. Gathering, fishing and hunting, farming and mining, processing and manufacturing.

Players only need to arrange work tasks and assign occupations, and then the residents will complete them independently.

Conduct foreign trade, accumulate rare materials, increase strength, and fight against evil forces and monsters.

games.name: Level Zero: Extraction
games.shortDescription: Tactical extraction shooter meets immersive survival horror. Play as rival mercenaries fighting for loot, or as alien monsters hunting humans from the shadows. Solo or with friends, experience this unique dark take on asymmetrical PvPvE multiplayer.
games.aboutText:
EXTRACT

Alone or with friends, play as elite mercenaries tasked with extracting valuable items from several exclusion zones overrun by aliens and mutants. Explore three unique maps – the Space Station, Caves of Turion, and the Research Facility. Engage in visceral first-person combat using a vast arsenal of military-grade weaponry and gadgets. Fight both PvE and PvP threats – mutants, turrets, and other players controlling rival mercenaries or alien monsters.

SURVIVE

Use UV light to damage alien monsters, find valuable loot, and extract safely using one of the multiple evacuation points on each map. Equip grenades, gun attachments,

motion detectors, light traps, and neurochips that grant special perks before embarking on dangerous raids. Extract items, weapons, and crafting materials to raise your reputation with traders to unlock new items and cosmetic rewards.

HUNT

Play as an alien monster, a formidable extraterrestrial entity equipped with powerful abilities. Lurk in the shadows, use ventilation systems to ambush humans and place face-hugging traps. Use horrifying screams to startle enemies and EMP waves to turn off the lights. Hunt human players and level up your alien with ever-evolving mutations that will make you stronger. Tailor your playstyle by mutating the alien to unlock more effective ability variations.

games.name: Fakutori
games.shortDescription: Fakutori is a laid-back automation game with a lot more going on beneath the surface. Combine elements, build sprawling production lines, and chase down the Legendary Blocks that only the most dedicated builders ever find. All at your own pace.
games.aboutText:
Fakutori is a relaxing automation game that’s easy to pick up and hard to put down. Place your machines, discover new elements, and watch your factory grow in ways you never imagined. Whether it's your first factory game or you're already an expert builder, Fakutori's infinite world and constraints-free gameplay will satisfy that automation itch!

If factory games have always looked interesting but never felt approachable, Fakutori is your way in. Just don’t be surprised at how deep the rabbit hole goes…

Start with the four building blocks of everything: Fire, Water, Earth and Air. Put them together and watch them turn into something new – then combine those, and keep going. Straightforward at first… less so when you're making things you didn't know were possible!

Some blocks will interact with others in surprising ways. What happens if you drop a Wood block next to a Fire block? Or let a Shooting Star fall on top of an Earth block? There are over 100 elements hiding in here, each with its own recipe and its own quirks, and filling out your compendium is no small feat. Every one you find opens something new.

Once you know what you're making, let the machines take the strain. Combiners, programmable pushers, conveyor belts - each one makes sense the moment you see it, but string them together and you've got a production line humming away. Build it neat, build it sprawling, build it however you like. The world is infinite and there's always another machine to unlock, so there's no reason to ever stop.

Here's the part nobody mentions at the start - Fakutori goes further than you'd think. Push deep enough and you'll craft the concept of Time, summon mystical magic blocks, or even build a factory that runs on souls. And if you go deeper still? Lock nine Antimatter blocks into a grid and behold - you've just made a black hole!

And then there are the Legendary Blocks, possessing powers beyond mere elements. Discover the old prophecies, decipher them, and prove the stories are true! No pressure. (Maybe a little bit. A healthy amount of pressure.)

You won't be doing all this alone. The wakas are your tireless little workforce - loyal, well-meaning, and every so often up to no good. Fakutori has a whole cast of them, each with their own story, all wrapped up in the search for the Legendary Blocks and the secrets of their world... and themselves.

Or you could just ignore all that and focus on building your factory. Your choice, really. (A certain waka who shall remain anonymous wouldn't mind the free time)

We think you'll love Fakutori if you enjoy…

Shapez 2, Factorio, Satisfactory, Dorfromantik, Stardew Valley, Potion Craft, Little Alchemy, Opus Magnum, Townscaper, Spiritfarer, Slime Rancher, Modulus, Planet Crafter

games.name: Residuum
games.shortDescription: Defend your base on Mars from invaders in Residuum. A thrilling mix of tower defense and shooter gameplay, upgrade weapons and choose your crew for a unique experience each time. Play with a friend for even more excitement!
games.aboutText:
In Residuum, players take on the role of a team of miners on Mars, tasked with defending their base from unexpected invaders. With a combination of tower defense and shooter gameplay, players will build structures and mine resources to upgrade their weapons and crew. Each game session lasts 20-30 minutes and players can earn rewards that they can use to upgrade their base in between games.



With a futuristic setting and a variety of enemy types, players will need to use strategy and quick thinking to survive. The addition of unique crew members with special abilities adds another layer of depth to the game, allowing players to choose their team and tailor their strategy to each game session.



Residuum is a thrilling and fast-paced experience, perfect for players looking for a challenging and rewarding tower defense game. So grab a friend and get ready to defend your base on the Red Planet!

games.name: The Holy Gosh Darn
games.shortDescription: Play as Cassiel, a foul-mouthed angel trapped in a time loop with a mission to save Heaven. Use the magical clock bestowed upon you from Death (yes, that Death, from Manual Samuel, stop asking) to jump between timelines across Heaven, Hell, Earth and Helheim to stop Heaven from going boom. Again.
games.aboutText:
In just six hours, Heaven will be obliterated—unless you can save it!

From the team behind Manual Samuel and Helheim Hassle, in The Holy Gosh Darn, you play as the angel Cassiel on a mission to stop the destruction of the afterlife. To do that, you'll harness the power of time travel by using a mysterious magical clock given to you by Death. Jump freely between past and present as you uncover secrets across Heaven, Hell, Earth, and Helheim. Insights from the future could accelerate events in the past, so make every second count!

The Holy Gosh Darn is a riotous narrative adventure built around time-travel as a core mechanic. Wield your trusty time-traveling watch and hop any point during the day, uncovering the secrets of a mysterious artifact created by God himself. Along the way, you'll meet a hilarious cast of characters and explore ever-shifting locations as you try to prevent an army of Phantoms from overrunning heaven. Which is really annoying, because you live there.

This hilarious action-adventure blends time travel with Metroidvania progression, inventive puzzles and over-the-top set pieces. The Holy Gosh Darn will answer life's most burning questions - like why time travel makes you barf, why why swearing is reserved for angels, and why it's completely fine to rudely skip dialogue when you're racing against the clock to save Heaven. The trilogy of The Holy Gosh Darn, Manual Samuel and Helheim Hassle might all be in the same universe, but they can be played in any order you like!

Prepare for outrageous humor, brain-tickling puzzles, and a chaotic adventure that'll keep you grinning from start to finish!

Features:

- Over 6.5 hours of fully voiced dialogue - One dedicated “Shut up” button that can skip it all!

- Time travel game for everyone, even if you hate time travel games

- Sprint, dash and jump through the afterlife as you uncover secrets across both space AND time!

- Unique time-pressured narrative requires players to hurry along NPCs as they uncover new information.

- Uncover fresh narrative strands which are triggered by progression, time, space and logic.

- 23 Heavenly Elders to insult! Gotta diss them all!

- Exactly 4,250 dogs - none that you can pet.

games.name: Flock
games.shortDescription: Flock is a multiplayer co-op game about the joy of flight and collecting adorable flying creatures with your friends. Soar through beautiful landscapes, seeking out rare and elusive creatures to add to your flock.
games.aboutText:
Flock is a multiplayer co-op game where players take on the role of flying shepherds, each tending to their own unique herd of adorable flying creatures.

The game is an ode to the joy of flight and discovery. Starting with a small herd of hover-sheep, you nurture and fly them toward fresh, untouched pastures. Along the way, you will discover the secrets of the beautiful uplands and its wild creatures.

Weird flying creatures. Are they fish? Birds? Snakes? It’s a real mystery. They are mostly friendly though, and with a bit of skill you can charm them to join your flock.

As your flock grows and your sheep get woolier, you can use the wool you shear from them for hats, cardigans, even socks!

Will you find all the creatures? Even the super rare and elusive ones? Will you keep them to yourself or share them with your friends? Will you knit the longest scarf ever seen? Will you find all the hidden treasures stolen by the pesky Burgling Bewls?

games.name: Starlit Defender
games.shortDescription: Roguelike meets freely configurable tower defense!
games.aboutText:
📖Free-Placement Tower Defense × Roguelike

This is a free-placement tower defense game where there are no fixed enemy paths, allowing you to place units anywhere.
The placement of your units can influence the routes enemies take. Some enemies will attack you, adding enjoyment as you strategize while considering their unique traits.

During battles, you’ll face numerous choices.

What might be inside the treasure chests you open?👀

📖Give jobs to your cute companions and take command of the battlefield!

The 【Novices】 will fight hard even as they are,
but assigning them jobs will make them even more effective.
Level them up, and they’ll gain job-specific skills to shine even brighter.

games.name: 东方时裂空 ~ Numerology of Artifacts
games.shortDescription: 在一个本应该无事发生的冬季，幻想乡内各处发生了时空错乱的异变；不同区域的时间流动速度不一样，甚至还有其他时空的事物出现在幻想乡……但异变产生的原因和源头都不得而知，一切都是突如其来的。 不论如何都要解决掉黑幕，让这场异变停下来，要不然幻想乡就乱套了！
games.aboutText:
【游戏故事】

发生了时间错乱然后灵梦等人前去解决的简单易懂的故事。

登场的家伙们都是一群聪明的笨蛋，因此剧情的推进比想象中还要简单易懂。

不如说因为时间都是错乱的，这个游戏的剧情真的存在逻辑吗？

又是谁因为什么目的而引发的异变呢，这些问题连黑幕本人都不一定清楚（笑）。



因此请不要在意细节，愉快地进行游戏吧！



【操作说明】

这是个要不断回避敌人的弹幕，同时使用各式射击与Spellcard将敌人击破的游戏。

在每一关的最后设有BOSS，将其搞定就可以过关，被其搞定则Game Over。

简单来说，就是beat'n dodge的游戏。



操作方法：

・上下左右（↑↓←→）—— 操纵自机方向（自由自在）

・Shoot键（Ｚ键）—— 射击（充满个性）

・Spell键（Ｘ键）—— 发动符卡（请多多使用）

・Slow键（Shift键）—— 低速移动（冲动就会白给）

・Pause键（Esc键）—— 暂停（犹豫就会败北）

games.name: Runika: A World of Little Legends
games.shortDescription: Build a farm… to save the world. Runika combines a cozy 2D sandbox with a story about a world being drawn into the mysterious Rift. Grow crops at your own pace, build your farm, gather resources, craft your own equipment, and uncover what awakens within the Rift.
games.aboutText:
Build a farm… to save the world.

Runika is a cozy 2D sandbox RPG about farming, exploration and challenging boss battles. Inspired by classic SNES adventures, the spirit of the 90s can be felt in every corner of the world.

Cross the mysterious Rift between worlds, build your own farm and shape the land however you like, free from the pressure of strict day-cycles.

Discover what has awakened deep within the Realm-Between.

Features

- Create your own cozy farm without the pressure of daily cycles or seasonal deadlines. Grow crops and keep animals in your own enclosures.

- Shape a fully terraformable world to your liking. Dig irrigation channels for your fields, lay down paths and connect everything with minecart tracks!

- Experience a cozy adventure with challenging but fair boss fights that reward preparation and experimentation.

- Follow the paths of the Realm-Between and explore ancient ruins to uncover more about the threat emerging from the Rift.

- Gather resources, unlock recipes and craft hundreds of tools, decorations, meals and other useful items across many different crafting stations and ovens.

- Fill your home with furniture, carpets and decorations to slowly turn Runika into a place of your own.

- A modern pixel art adventure inspired by the 16-bit era, filled with small references to classic SNES games.

Developed live on Twitch

I’ve been developing Runika live on Twitch since 2020. Become part of the community and join me on this journey.

We speak English too! Mostly German though, hence just drop in and we’ll switch. <3

games.name: The Sugar Coast
games.shortDescription: An idle empire builder set on XVIth century Madeira. Manage supply chains, control Atlantic markets, and carve levada canals to keep your island productive.
games.aboutText:
Build the island's economy, one hex at a time

It is 16th century, and Madeira is still mostly forest. Start with a single laurel sawmill and a harbour at Funchal. Fell timber, plant vineyards, salt fish, grow woad and cane, and sell all of it at the dock. Then put the money back into the island. Production chains that make sense

Raw goods feed workshops, and workshops feed the export trade. Timber becomes planks and pitch, and those become ships. Cane goes to the sugar mill, whose molasses goes to the distillery to make aguardente. Wine and woad are turned into indigo dye. When a building runs short of inputs, you can see why and fix it.

Water and roads

Madeira is steep and dry. Dig levadas , the island's famous irrigation channels, down from the mountain springs. Water only runs downhill, so plan the route carefully. Lay roads so goods reach the port without the haulage cost eating your profit. Levadas and roads stay built from one generation to the next. Open the trade routes of the Atlantic

Funchal will only buy so much. To grow, send trial cargoes to win a royal charter: Lisbon first, then Flanders , and later Genoa and England . Each charter opens a bigger market and unlocks a new tier of buildings. Every port pays its own premium, and your reputation with each one carries over between generations.

An idle game that respects your time

Construction runs on real time, and your plantations keep producing while the game is closed. When you come back, you get a summary of what came in. You can check in for five minutes or spend an evening laying out channels. Generations and ruins

Once your fortune is large enough, start a new generation. Your old buildings stay on the map, decay over time, and can be restored before they fall to ruin. Spend Mercês , royal favours earned through milestones, on a permanent sky of perks that shapes every future run.

games.name: Olympius
games.shortDescription: Join the rebels in a third-person shooter with RPG elements and base-building mode. Fight against various combat drone models under the control of the supreme AI.
games.aboutText:
Join the resistance and conquer the top of Olympus of artificial intelligence that has equated itself with a god in a story-driven third-person shooter with RPG elements.

Variability of the world

The game's missions take place across different parts of the planet, so each sector differs from the previous one.

The game offers 30 campaign missions and about 35 hours of gameplay.

Rebel technologies

Collect resources, develop your character, improve your skills, and unlock new abilities to fight artificial intelligence.
The game offers over 60 weapon and costume modifications

Play together

The game supports two-player co-op in split-screen mode on the same computer or a simple network connection.

Mind control

Capture enemy robots, or make allied machines right on the battlefield.

Base building

Create, defend, and improve your base to extract resources in the additional game mode intertwined with the main storyline.

games.name: Memory Lost
games.shortDescription: Memory Lost is a story-driven fast-paced cyberpunk shooter where you are not just fighting enemies — you become them. Possess enemies, adapt their weapons and skills, and fight ruthless corporations. Uncover secrets, upgrade abilities, and shape your own fate in this world.
games.aboutText:
POSSESS. ADAPT. SURVIVE.

Welcome to Memory Lost, a thrilling fast-paced cyberpunk-style top-dawn shooter where you are not just fighting enemies — you become them.

A CYBERPUNK NIGHTMARE

In the sprawling, dystopian city of Detraxis , ruthless corporations rule, conducting inhumane experiments on the helpless. You are an AI, created by RedSky Corporation , now fighting to overthrow your own creators. But in this brutal world, survival demands more than just firepower—it requires intelligence, strategy, and the ability to seize control of your enemies .

BODY-SHIFTING COMBAT

Forget traditional combat — your body is your greatest weapon . As a digital entity, you can possess enemies , instantly adapting their skills, weapons, and abilities. Jump from host to host in rapid succession, combining 77 unique weapons and devastating melee attacks to wipe out your foes.

- Control and switch between enemies in real time

- 60 enemy types & 10 powerful bosses , each with unique abilities

- Five upgrade trees to customize your playstyle

A WORLD OF SECRETS & CHOICES

Memory Lost offers more than just action — it delivers a deep, choice-driven narrative with three different endings . Your decisions will shape the fate of Detraxis.

- Explore a rich cyberpunk world , divided into diverse hubs and levels

- Engage with unique NPCs and uncover hidden stories — some tragic, some darkly humorous

- Hack, infiltrate, and outsmart your foes to uncover the truth behind RedSky’s experiments

- Hand-drawn animated cutscenes bring the world to life

Control the minds of your enemies, and rewrite your destiny. The future of Detraxis is in your hands. Will you break free, or will you be just another lost memory?

games.name: The Use of Life
games.shortDescription: The Use of Life is a multi-ending adventure book style JRPG. The main character’s various attachments change in accordance with the choices the player makes, and the ending changes depending on “the use of life” you choose through your journey.
games.aboutText:
The Use of Life is a multi-ending adventure book style RPG. A Story Influenced by Your Use of Life

In this game, your choices as the player will influence Goshe, the main character, as well as his thoughts and various attachments in life, represented by flames.

Whether Goshe uses his life for his own selfish purposes or sacrifices himself to help others is entirely up to you. The endings of this game are simply the conclusions of the various ways of life, and there are no "Good" or "Bad" endings. Tense Battles that Balance Stasis and Action

The Use of Life features unique battles that combine the strategy of a turn-based battle system with the quick reflexes and action of a QTE system.

Each turn, both you and your enemy get to choose 3 actions, which you then take turns to perform. How will you deal with the enemy's upcoming flurry of attacks? How will you time your own attacks to deal the most damage? Your skill and strategy will determine the outcome of battle.

Even if you can't defeat an enemy, the game is designed so that you will gradually figure out how to deal with them and win. Boss battles are especially tense, where you frequently have to toe the line between life and death, and we strive to deliver the highest satisfaction you can possibly get after defeating a strong enemy. Adventure Book Style Events

Events in this game are narrated in an adventure book style, and some events come with TRPG-esque dice rolls that determine the event's outcome.

The same event will play out differently depending on your choices and the dice roll results.

You can choose to proceed cautiously and choose the safest options, or bravely throw yourself into every opportunity for battle you come across—it's all up to you, and your actions will affect Goshe's personality. Customization

Goshe, the main character, obtains incredible power through a certain Curse. Through encounters with death, he can gain experience which can be used to strengthen his own abilities.

Not only will you gain different advantages in battle depending on what abilities you choose to invest in, but the outcome of events outside of battle can also be heavily influenced by your stats.

On top of that, by leveling up and unlocking new levels for the various classes, you can learn a wide variety of Skills and Spells to use in battle.

----------------------------------------------------------------
・The "Fighter" carves up enemies with pure physical attack power and a high number of moves
・The "Samurai" unleashes unabashed power with Iai and lands fierce critical strikes
・The "Mage" specializes in high-risk, high-reward super-firepower using incantations and Spells
・The "Sorcerer" toys with their opponent by utilizing special attacks, including some that cause status ailments
----------------------------------------------------------------
A myriad of fighting styles can be utilized depending on the class you choose to upgrade. A “Good-New" Type of JRPG

While this title is technically a JRPG, we are not aiming for a "good old JRPG" style, but rather a "good 'new' JRPG" style, in hopes of showing that this kind of evolution is absolutely possible.
developers: だらねこげーむず/Daraneko Games

games.name: Renown
games.shortDescription: Renown is an intense medieval multiplayer survival experience set in a vast, ever-evolving world. Whether alone or rallying allies, gather resources, build powerful strongholds, and engage in brutal battles for dominance.
games.aboutText:
In Renown , the open-world is your battlefield, and only the strongest will rule. Gather resources, build sprawling castles, and lead your clan into battle against rival players. Whether you're crafting siege engines to crush enemy walls, clashing swords in intense duels, or rallying your neighbors to destroy your enemies, prove your strength and become truly renowned.

Survive and Explore

Hunt, gather, craft and build to carve out your stronghold in a world filled with those who want to take everything you own. Whether you prefer to farm the wilderness, forge weaponry for the frontline or build defensive structures for your group, there's always a job to be done to ensure your survival.

Expand and Conquer

From simple camps to mighty castles, they are all targets for your destruction. Fight for control over key points of interest, gather vital resources, and launch devastating sieges against rival strongholds. In the struggle for power, there can only be one winner.

Skill-Based Combat

Victory is earned through skill, not chance. Wield a variety of medieval weapons and armor as you step onto the fray, where precise, skill-based combat decides your fate. One perfect strike, or a single fatal mistake can turn the tide of battle.

Unique Customisation

Customize your knight freely with a vast selection of armor appearances, tabards, emblems, and color schemes. Whether you prefer to roam the battlefield as a robed monk or stand alongside warriors draped in red and white beneath a blood moon banner, the choice is yours.

Free and Lawless

The world of Renown is a place of little oversight, your decisions are yours to make and the only repercussions are those exercised by your enemies. Build anywhere, kill anyone, raid everyone, take everything!

Key Features

- Fast-paced PvP medieval survival with a strong emphasis on melee combat

- From building humble farms to huge fortresses, the choice is with the player

- Destroy all your neighbors with awe inspiring siege engines

- Group systems for making Claims, taking titles, giving ranks and more

- Customize everything from the helmet on your head to the banners on your base

- Server Progression and Wipe systems, for an engaging and vastly replayable experience

- Tools for Community Hosts to help tailor their servers. Future plans for extensive mod support

games.name: Isles of Krom
games.shortDescription: Isles of Krom is a dark fantasy top-down roguelike where progression is carved into the world itself. Master challenging, Souls-inspired combat as your Wards push back the Pestilence, claim each isle's lasting power, and reclaim the Krom Archipelago run after run.
games.aboutText:
THE ISLES REMEMBER

The Rift has opened and its Pestilence has swallowed the Krom Archipelago.

As a Ward of the Corvus, push it back isle by isle and reclaim what was lost. In Isles of Krom, progress isn't bought between runs. It's carved into the world itself.

RECLAIM THE ARCHIPELAGO

Pestilence has taken root across every isle, smothering everything it touches. Cleanse its clusters to uncover Vestiges, fleeting boons that shift with every run.

Somewhere in this corruption, crows lie caged. Break their chains and watch them fly home. Each one returns with a permanent relic, growing the power of the Corvus with every crow you save.

FIGHT LIKE IT MATTERS

Souls-inspired combat built on timing, positioning and poise. Break your enemies' guard, gather Will from the fallen, and unleash devastating weapon abilities.

FORGE YOUR WARD

No two Wards are alike. Combine traits with weapons, armor and the Vestiges you uncover to build a Ward strong enough to close the Rift.

Wishlist now and join our Discord to follow development.

games.name: Bring Me Hope
games.shortDescription: Bring Me Hope is a bittersweet adventure RPG about love, loss, and family (and boss fights!)
games.aboutText:
Bring Me Hope is an adventure RPG , drawing inspiration from titles such as Undertale and Enter The Gungeon . This is a story rich experience about love, life, and connection. Sink into the unique and bittersweet life of Alium.

Explosive combat that rewards quick reactions and split-second decisions. Enemies coordinate their attacks to thwart your efforts. Equip up to 48 active items to enhance your stats and abilities.

Find treasures and secrets in a world full of colorful characters. Every new tool you acquire expands the world, doors and pathways open up to undiscovered mysteries.

Catch all sorts of critters! Grunglers, Gub Gubs, and Chombos! Fishing points can earn you powerful new items!

Drive through serene forests and windy beaches. Drift into encounters to look extra cool!

About the game

This game is the product of 10 years of passionate development. If you like cutscenes , fast-paced combat , and secret bosses , then you should try out the demo!

games.name: Mortal Sin
games.shortDescription: Mortal Sin is a chaotic, blood-soaked roguelike where skill is power, and overconfidence is death. Carve through procedurally generated nightmares with brutal melee and flashy, satisfying combos.
games.aboutText:
Eyes locked on your prey.

You kill without remorse.

After all… it’s either you or them.

Sentience fades. This moment is your release .

REWARDING MELEE COMBAT

Mortal Sin is built around fast, visceral melee combat where every strike matters. Chain slashes, bashes, and kicks into devastating finishers as limbs fly and blood paints the walls. Combat thrives on momentum: move fast, hit hard, and never give your enemies a chance to breathe.

ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY

Descend into a surreal, ever-shifting nightmare. Procedurally generated levels, randomized quests, and hundreds of hand-crafted rooms make every run feel fresh. Unlock a growing roster of distinct classes, from the greatsword-wielding Berserker to the gun-toting Pirate, each with their own playstyle and wild synergies.

SINFUL VISUALS

Dive into a bold, graphic novel-inspired world that’s as stylish as it is deadly. Prefer a different look? Mortal Sin now features multiple visual modes and color palettes. Your nightmare, your way.

KEY FEATURES

- Brutal, skill-based melee with flashy, satisfying combos

- Beautiful comic-book visuals, now fully customizable

- Dozens of unique enemies that react to your every move

- Over a dozen playable classes, each with their own weapons and abilities

- A huge arsenal: greatswords, spears, guns, claws, and magic

- Hundreds of handcrafted rooms across procedurally generated maps

- Secret platforming zones with rare loot and hidden horrors

- Randomly generated quests with powerful rewards

- Multiple color palettes to match your vibe and mood

- Infinite runs and future updates to keep the chaos going

games.name: Dice Kingdoms
games.shortDescription: Compete against friends in games filled with unpredictable twists and turns. Roll the dice to gather resources and test your adaptability. Lead your kingdom to success through military power, religious knowledge, or architectural ingenuity.
games.aboutText:
Dice Kingdoms is a multiplayer turn-based strategy game where each player must develop their island and compete for victory through culture, military conquest or building an expensive wonder. Build

- Strategically prioritize what to build

- Efficiently layout your city, anticipating attacks and diseases while optimizing for space

Harvest

- Build specialized houses to have more dice

- Use rerolls to try to get the resources you need the most but risk natural disasters

Combat

- Automatic battles after choosing targets

- Pillage of strategic buildings yields many resources

- Use force to punish greedy development

Disasters

- Natural disasters are determined by the number of skulls rolled

- Some natural disasters affect yourself while some affect other players

games.name: Orc Warchief: Strategy Story
games.shortDescription: Carve a war camp out of an ancient forest. Grab, drop and rally an unruly Horde with the Hand of the Warchief. Rescue goblins, claim forgotten sites and storm human castles. Every conquest brings new power and a Kingdom eager for revenge.
games.aboutText:
The humans scattered your people. Build the Horde that makes them regret it.

A handful of goblins, a small clearing and the Old Forest: your return begins here. Orc Warchief: Strategy Story combines camp building, creature management and castle assaults. Grow your Horde, choose when to march and defend the home you leave behind. CARVE YOUR CAMP OUT OF THE FOREST

Mark trees for your goblins to cut, haul timber and build on the ground they clear. Raise shelters, food stores, forges and training grounds. Trees are resources and cover: opening more land can also open a path for trouble. RULE WITH THE WARCHIEF'S HAND

Pick up orcs and goblins and put them where they are needed. Keep your warriors fed, rested and paid. A sharp slap feeds Fury; unleash a Frenzy when the fighting turns against you. DISCOVER WHAT THE FOREST HIDES

Cut a route to captive goblins, reclaim a ruined forge and secure a shaman's grove. Human guards hold these places for a reason. Capture their outpost to stop the patrols it sends into your territory. BUILD YOUR WARBAND

Train fighters and bring archers, shamans, trolls and ogres into the Horde. Combine warriors and artifacts to shape your force. Decide who joins the assault and who stays behind to defend the camp. BREAK THEIR STRONGHOLDS

Choose a target on the war map and examine its defenses. Compare available approaches, weigh the danger and send your warband through gates, walls and courtyards to the lord inside. Review the losses and claim the spoils. HOLD AGAINST THE KINGDOM'S REVENGE

Conquest raises the Kingdom's anger. Prepare palisades, gates and traps before its soldiers arrive. The assault briefing shows the retaliation risk and the defenders you will leave at home. LEAVE A LEGEND

A fallen camp does not erase the Legend of the Warchief. Permanent upgrades carry into later runs, giving the next Horde a stronger beginning. Try a different camp, a different warband and a different route to victory.

Build the camp. Command the Horde. Make them remember.

games.name: 黑巢姐妹
games.shortDescription: 主角就是那种在人群中扯着嗓子接电话，占着2个停车位，蹲在马桶盖上撒尿，待人粗鲁，完全不顾他人感受的没教养的无赖，你要驾驭她，并干掉那些与她作对的那些家伙.
games.aboutText:
————————————————————————————————

Discord：ysDzgVjRS3

主角和她的妹妹俩人刚踏入社畜的世界，除了打工赚钱以外，
她还得时刻注意，乡下小镇糟糕的治安带来的各种危险，
当然，更多的危险来源自于主角她自己……
————————————————————————————————

————————————————————————————————

本作基于《OZ大乱斗NS》与《劳资的长假》系列的世界观，讲述了长假系列中登场的黑巢姐妹长大后的故事，
大幅改变了画风以外，也加入了换装系统等其他的要素，
时装里的每一个零件都可以更换，而且在不同角色穿着时都会以自己不同风格显示.
玩过系列其他作品的玩家一定会有不同的新体验.

————————————————————————————————

games.name: Oasis the Great
games.shortDescription: Ever imagine you could play with your fellows in Online co-op , discover a tremendous world,find the treasures,build freely,do some farming,fight with others,party around ! also there are other mini games.And all these happen in a physics based oasis!! (￣▽￣)~❤
games.aboutText:
Oasis the Great is an online multi-player physics based sandbox game that have infinite possibilities.

(≖ᴗ≖)✧ Yes! we combine the popular and great mechanics into this tremendous oasis. huge world for you to explore!

- the oasis is full off various place in different art style. lowpoly ,fantasy or realistic.From ancient culture temple to futuristic city

Physics based mechanics!

- what could be more interesting and more possibilities for you to trigger when you have a physics based character? not to mention it in online co-op .your little human can climb, trot, grab , hold a weapon with one hand,punch ,fly kick,head knock. and there will be First Person View mode for you to interact with stuff more accurately (finally dont have to grab things only in Third Person View mode(✪ω✪))

Up to 20 players PVP and PVE

- you can form a crew and go loot something,or start the gang fight with other players

farming and survival

- if you want to,you can grow some crops,use ur imagination to harvest more efficiently, stick your sickle on a vehicle and you know the rest(￣▽￣)／
also the survival mode can be turn on anytime you want

owning property and rebuild anywhere you like

- when you r rich you could purchase your favorite property and rebulid it anywhere you like .on a mountain with a beautiful view in front of u or even the roof of a Skyscraper, as long as the "cop" player wont give you a ticket.

watch online Videos or films with your fellows

- what if you want to watch a horror video and you are very scared of it? just invite your fellows and watch it together! if he spoil the ending you could punish him physically in game

customization!!

- you can customize your face with anything you can type ,well, we do recommend you use some lovely and emotionally understanding symbol.
also you can customize your vehicle or furniture with your favourite pictures on your disk.

Mini games!

- invite your mates or other players and play the mini games together. tanks,party fight, disco ,spaceship fight in the sky,solve puzzles in escape room, find the secret in the ghost land

games.name: Welcome to ParadiZe
games.shortDescription: Paradise isn't exactly what you hoped for: it's infested with zombies! Thankfully, you can control them. Capture them and teach them to farm or fight. They will help you defend our camp while you explore the world looking for… a new paradise.
games.aboutText:
Do you want your very own zombie companion? A faithful friend that protects you from its peers and accompanies you on all your adventures? At ParadiZe, we make it happen! Here, the zombies do all the dirty work.

In the beautiful country of ParadiZe, ingenious survivors are testing a technology that can be used to control the zombies that have overrun the world. Once hacked, they become invaluable allies, even though they are not that smart and sometimes rather unstable.
It's not all rosy in ParadiZe, but if you're reasonably clever and handy, maybe you'll manage to survive…

Explore ParadiZe and meet a colourful cast of extraordinary characters. The unusual flora and fauna will surprise you at every turn. Set out on adventure, in the snow or desert, alone or with your Zombot companions, and feel free to get rid of any pests that try to disturb your stay with us.
Fancy an expedition into the wilderness or would you prefer to laze about at your camp? It's your choice, so tailor your stay as you see fit!
However, we recommend not getting too close to the locals: they can be somewhat… aggressive.

Shortly after arriving, you must build your camp, a cosy little nest that you can gradually upgrade. Comfort is important, but don't forget to set up defences! Add multiple traps and fortifications to repel zombies, which have the bad habit of never leaving you alone.
It takes effort to maintain a camp, but if you don't like such menial tasks, don't worry: as we already told you, zombies do all the dirty work here.

You can be a loner during your stay or more sociable.
Invite up to three of your friends so they can enjoy this unforgettable experience with you.
ParadiZe welcomes everyone with open arms!

games.name: Dead Grid
games.shortDescription: Dead Grid is a turn-based strategy game set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies, infused with an 80s retro vibe. Lead a squad of elite mercenaries, fight relentless hordes, discover survivors, and build up your camp with hundreds of scavenged upgrades.
games.aboutText:
Recruit a squad of elite mercenaries, experts in post-apocalyptic zombie combat. Battle hordes of the dead as you explore a 3D world revealed through the cards.

» Go silent and keep the noise down, picking off enemies one by one.

» Go loud with guns and explosives, drawing the dead at a rapid pace.

» Set them on fire or blow them up. Slice and dice your orchestrated zombie funeral.

» 16 mercenary characters, each individually voiced with different personalities.

» 5 classes with 115 unique skills and special passive perks.

» Unlimited skill respec for endless experimentation.

» Reanimate the dead to transform into a special class, called Revenant.

» 17 character specific attributes to fine-tune the combat style even further.

» 370 Steam achievements, view progression directly in the game.

» 7 challenge modes with Leaderboards to replay the game with alternative rules.

» New Game+ mode.

» Find and upgrade hundreds of weapons, consumables and gadgets for your squad.

» Over 150 unique items that enhance your skills and transform your playstyle.

» Meet survivors to join your camp, where they’ll assist you in future missions.

» Complete 42 side missions with bonus rewards.

games.name: Terminus: Zombie Survivors
games.shortDescription: Terminus: Zombie Survivors is a 2D turn-based survival roguelike set during a zombie apocalypse. Each journey is unique, and every decision can mean the difference between life and death. Can you brave hunger, cold, and the undead in order to reach the Terminus and find salvation?
games.aboutText:
Terminus: Zombie Survivors is a turn-based survival roguelike set against the backdrop of a zombie apocalypse. Weeks have passed since the zombie virus took hold of humanity, and most of the population has already been infected. As one of the few remaining survivors, you must finally venture out to join up with the other survivors at the Terminus. Battle your way through hunger, frigid temperatures, and ravenous zombies to make it to the Terminus—escape the city through whatever means possible, or even develop a vaccine!

EXPLORE A RANDOMLY GENERATED MAP

Each journey for survival is different, as the very city you battle through to survive is procedurally generated. Over 150 different areas are generated, with numerous locations to discover, hundreds of items to scavenge, and endless zombies to evade or fight. No two games are ever the same, but the journey to the Terminus is uniquely challenging each time.

BE STRATEGIC IN TURN-BASED PLAY

Choose your next move carefully! Every movement, action, and decision you make deducts from your Action Points (AP). Strategic management of your AP is key to survival. Use too little, and you might not find the resources needed to survive. Use too many, and you may leave yourself open to attack.

CRAFT, COOK, AND SURVIVE

Maintain your condition to stay in fighting shape during this apocalypse. Surviving isn't easy—you'll need to eat, sleep, and stay warm. Scavenge for materials to craft tools and weapons, and cook meals to keep your energy up. Every action, from crafting to cooking, directly impacts your chances of survival.

FIGHT VARIOUS ZOMBIES

Choose from a vast arsenal of tools and weapons with which to attack the oncoming zombie horde. Pick which parts of the body you want to hit, and experiment with the countless options on offer—if in doubt, remove the head or destroy the brain!

EXPERIENCE MULTIPLE ENDINGS

Survive the unending hordes of undead through one of multiple escape scenarios: reach the Terminus safe zone, escape by boat or helicopter, join a group of survivors, or even develop the vaccine!

RECRUIT AND TRADE WITH NPCs

Clawing your way across the city, you’ll occasionally encounter other uninfected survivors. Band together with them on your journey, trade goods, or steal their supplies and find your own way to survive the end of the world.

DISCOVER YOUR FAVORITE SURVIVOR CLASS

Soldier, police officer, firefighter, farmer—each one will fare differently in an apocalypse, but it’s up to you to discover which one stands the best chance of surviving. Pick from 15 different classes, traits to unlock, and stats to upgrade as you build the ultimate survivor.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR SURVIVAL

Use sandbox mode to tailor your survival experience by adjusting settings like spawn rates and resource availability. Try surviving additional game scenarios such as Out of Stock, Crowd, and Frozen Zombies to discover new ways to play Terminus: Zombie Survivors.

ⴵ News from Longplay Studios

Wishlist Terminus: Zombie Survivors 2, the next game in the Terminus series, and get notified when it launches.

games.name: Farmer Against Potatoes Idle
games.shortDescription: Pick up your sword and fight off waves of Potatoes by upgrading your stats constantly, use Equipment, choose between different Classes, put your many Talents to good use, and so much more designed to keep you entertained for a long time.
games.aboutText:
Farmer Against Potatoes Idle is a game about an amnesic Farmer

With a past shrouded in mystery, that wakes up in the middle of a field and is attacked by a horde of mutated Potatoes. With no one else in sight, he takes it upon himself to try and keep the evil infestation in check.
Even since release there are over 5 worlds with 9 Areas of 100 Waves, each with 2 difficulty settings, so YES, “it’s over 9000” waves with more to come in the near future.
In the early stages of the game you will have two main currencies, Potatoes and Skulls, that you can use on over 30 upgrades that increase your stats or debuff the Potatoes, but don’t worry, this is just the start of the adventure. The Potatoes somehow have various Items

There is a set of Equipment in every Area so there are over 250 visually different items but due to the Item Rating, Enhancing Levels and Bonus chances, there are over 2M possibilities for unique Equipment in the game.
But worry not. We know storage management is not something a lot of people like in general but the whole system is custom made and with auto’s available to help you keep everything neat and tidy. The Farmer has a very particular set of skills

Skills that he has acquired over a very long career. Skills that make him a nightmare for Potatoes. And each and every one of his many Talents, are made for the sole purpose of ridding the world of all Potatoes. Even the non-combatant ones if possible, as they make one hell of a meal.
The Talent tree is huge, with choices that can change your play-style significantly. And the best part is that they are not permanent, so you can experiment to your heart’s desire. And everything’s visible from the start: no fog of war type of tree, no hidden talents … or are there? Besides the Daily Quests, Achievements and Challenges

There are many other features that you can play with, including a mini-game that you can play on a regular basis to get various timed buffs for your Farmer. The idea is simple: whack all the potatoes that pop their ugly heads out of the johns. Why, you ask? Because being a Farmer is a full-time job and enemies are everywhere! A feature that’s almost always present in all idle games

The Reincarnation system which Farmer Against Potatoes Idle also has. But every time you Reincarnate for bigger permanent bonuses, you can also change between 6 different Classes, each with their own strong points and Talent Trees. This creates a second layer of strategy decision making to make the game more enjoyable for various play-styles.

games.name: Bosslords
games.shortDescription: Gather an army of monsters and misfits to march on the Imperial Capital in this fantasy roguelite auto battler. Explore procedurally generated worlds filled with powerful weapons and artifacts as you gather new recruits to take to battle and show them who's boss!
games.aboutText:
The Empire has reigned uncontested for far too long and ruined the world under its banner! Tranquil woodlands? Babbling brooks? The constant sounds of laughing babies and loving families? The world is truly the worst it has ever been! Bosslord, this tyranny must come to an end, and your monstrous crew of miscreants is just the group to make that happen!

Bosslords is a roguelite auto battler where you lead the hardworking lowlifes and scoundrels of the world – command goblins and ghouls, raise the dead, and traverse across land, sea, and air to take on the Empire as it sends armies to hunt you down.

Take charge as one of several bosslords, each with their own storyline, abilities, and upgrade trees that will shape your runs alongside unique starting armies and spells. While each is able to recruit a wide range of units and employ varied strategies, they all have their own advantages, preferences, and unique mechanics:

- The Goblin General relies on mass numbers of well-trained goblins, able to turn the typically-weak minions into a disciplined mass of hardened troops

- The Undead Necromancer can bring an elite guard that recovers after every battle, even if destroyed, using enhanced necromancy to summon and empower additional warriors

- The Warlord brings a small but elite force of veterans, making up for their lack of numbers with heightened stats

- The Mage is a master of summoning creatures into battle, with more powerful spells and elementals to support him on his warpath

- The Dragon Tamer commands an army of lizardmen, ready to be trained into hardened warriors – or fed to his pet dragon to make her stronger as she consumes all

Despite your glorious purpose and unbeatable zeal, you’re nothing without your army. The inns and shops of the realm are full of would-be revolutionaries just waiting for the right person (and the right amount of coin), and you can even find lost souls wandering the lands in search of glory. Orc Drummers in your midst will hasten the attack speed of your units, while Banshees will paralyze enemies, and zombie banner-bearers will bolster allied health. Will you rely on a formation of skeleton bodyguards firing their rifles from the back lines as your spiders slow the enemy down with their webs? Or will your army be known for its dagger-wielding rogues and hulking Minotaurs supported by Goblin Sergeants that bolster their attack?

What kind of bosslord would you be if you didn’t have a few tricks up your sleeve? From the Goblin General’s Flintlock Pistol to the Necromancer’s curse that turns enemies into allied skeleton warriors, unique abilities set each bosslord apart! Gather scrolls on your journey and unlock powerful spells that aid your minions in combat – raise walls of fire, harness the power of lightning, summon a meteor from the skies above, or cause the ground itself to crack open with earthquakes! Further empower your troops with special items – a Potion of Regeneration can keep a formation alive in dire straits, while a healthy serving of Slime Jam will turn fallen allies into slime monsters! Whether you’re coating weapons in poison or cursing enemies’ souls, it sure is good to be bad.

games.name: Forgery Craft
games.shortDescription: Master the art of forgery in this story-driven simulation game. Start with altering documents by changing single signatures and dates. End up forging entire art pieces that could fool any museum expert.
games.aboutText:
Follow the story of Amelia - an aspiring artist who wants to make a name for herself. During her journey, she discovers that her talent and good eye can be put to better use than painting still life. After all, copying a signature isn't that different from copying a bowl of apples.

Creating a good fake is only half of the success. Now, you have to convince others it's authentic. Choose clever dialogue options and fabricate stories that will make everyone believe your version of the truth.

Some forgeries are more complex to make than others. With every fake you create, gather new tools and see how they affect the appearance of your work. Learn how to combine your tools' effects to achieve the result you want.

Creating a piece that is 100 years old isn't an ordinary task. But any ordinary object can become a part of it or help you make your work appear older than it is. Look around to see what could be useful and put it to the test.

games.name: Beyond Galaxyland
games.shortDescription: Beyond Galaxyland is a thrilling adventure-RPG combining cosmic exploration, strategic turn-based combat, and epic boss battle events across a vast solar system. Join Doug and his gun-toting guinea pig on an exhilarating quest to save Earth, itself.
games.aboutText:
Inspired by classic sci-fi movies, Beyond Galaxyland is an intergalactic, 2.5D adventure-RPG set among the stars. Step into the sneakers of high-schooler Doug, as he’s whisked away to ‘Galaxyland’ - a zoo-like solar system of planets - on an epic quest to save Earth itself.

An all-new take on the beloved RPG adventures of old, prepare for a journey like no other, skyrocketing through teeming jungles, neon-lit cities, and cybernetic casinos, with each new planet brimming with intriguing characters, fiendish adversaries, and many other surprises.

Accompanied by Doug’s pet guinea pig - the pistol-wielding Boom Boom - and a sentient robot called MartyBot, together you must defend the world against an all-powerful entity known only as ‘The End’, before it conquers the Universe itself…

No pressure.

A Bold New Take on the Classic Sci-Fi Caper!

Experience firsthand all the thrills and spills of a retro sci-fi adventure, in an all-new take on the fish-out-of-water tale that sticks you right in the centre of the action! Laughter, loss, peril and friendship, Beyond Galaxyland has it all and then some, dipped in a dazzling layer of neon-tastic pixels.

Explore a Solar System of Extraordinary Worlds

From the blizzard-swept planes of Arcos to the tropical jungle ravines of Erros, the neon-buzzing cities of Neo to the arid sand dunes of Xalm, explore a cosmic cluster of unique worlds, each with its own quests, environmental puzzles, and out-of-this-world characters.

Overcome Cosmic Foes in Tactical Turn-Based Combat

Engage in strategic turn-based battles against a vast range of galactic nemeses, with time-responsive defensive gameplay to minimise damage. Each party member has a range of unique abilities at their disposal, but for an additional tactical advantage, sneakily scan your enemy pre-battle to discover their strengths and weaknesses.

Experience Epic Boss Battles

Each planet boasts its own distinct perils, but none more so than the epic bosses you’ll encounter throughout your extraterrestrial travels, including colossal space dragons, flesh eating flowers, and the all-knowing bionic behemoth that is Nexus Mind.

Capture Enemies to Use in Battle

Successfully capture the many weird and wonderful creatures you encounter, to later unleash them in battle, with each possessing a number of exclusive abilities. Will you acquire every last one?

Features:

- Explore the many extraordinary worlds of Galaxyland in an adventure to save the Earth

- Experience a thrilling story that pays homage to your favourite retro sci-fi movies

- Form a party of diverse companions to overcome foes in tactical turn-based combat

- Capture enemies in combat to later unleash as allies or buffs during future battles

- Craft new armours and consumables to aid Doug and his pals on their journey

- Engage in over 25 epic boss battles with the Universe's most-feared adversaries

- A truly unique soundtrack unlike anything you've heard (at least on this planet) with over 50 diverse tracks spanning a myriad of genres from electronic to hip-hop to piano-heavy blues.

games.name: Squiggle Football
games.shortDescription: Squiggle Football is a deck-building football management roguelike, where you create a team and form powerful combinations of players, coaches, tactics and culture. Recruit, trade & innovate through nail-biting matches to reach & conquer the National League. Inspired by Australian Rules Football.
games.aboutText:
Build a team, choosing who to recruit, who to show the door, and who to invest in for the future.

Create monstrous powerhouses by fusing superstar players with the right coaches, gameplan, and team culture.

Fight your way through State Leagues to ultimate National League premiership success.

And do it before the Board gets restless!

GAME OVERVIEW

- You don't have time for details. You're a big-picture person. Choose who to sign and where they play. No contract negotiations. No cry-baby players. No surprise injuries.

- Recruit, Trade, and Delist

- Pick the eyes out of the Draft

- Heartlessly cut worn-out veterans

ENDLESS POSSIBILITY

- Over 850 unique players

- Endless combinations of players, coaches + gameplans

- Exploit synergies

- Robust match engine based on Australian Rules Football from Squiggle analytics

games.name: SkyCraft
games.shortDescription: Skycraft is an open-world survival game for 1-10 players, set in infinite procedurally-generated floating islands.
games.aboutText:
Skycraft is an open-world survival game for 1-10 players, set in infinite procedurally-generated floating islands. CONSUME ESSENCE

Possess your spirit to consume the essence of the skies. With each essence, enhance your abilities and expand your island. Embrace the essence and let your spirit soar. MAINTAIN YOUR ISLAND

Don't let your island run out of essence. Keep gathering essence to enhance astral dimension and expand island. Shape your sanctuary into a thriving haven and defend it from threats. GATHER RESOURCES

Discover rare resources scattered across islands, crafting essential tools and equipment. Each find shapes your destiny amidst the boundless skies. BUILD A BASE

Constructing a base to shelter you from dangerous creatures and unforgiving weather. Strengthen defenses against aerial predators and storms. Your sanctuary stands as a beacon of safety in the turbulent skies. EXPLORE ISLANDS

Embark on expeditions to explore diverse islands, uncovering their hidden secrets and untold treasures. With each step, unravel the mysteries of these uncharted lands and forge your own path amidst the wonders of the skies.

games.name: Slime 64
games.shortDescription: Slime 64 is a 3D collect-a-thon platformer inspired by the classics! Play as elemental Slimes and collect assorted Bells & Whistles to help these unlikely heroes combine their abilities, schmoove through 8 worlds, and dismantle the robotic Wurltson's evil enterprise.
games.aboutText:
Slime 64 is a 3D collect-a-thon platformer featuring elemental slimes who collect assorted Bells & Whistles, and who combine their powers to save the world from a Diabolical Robotic Enterprise. Inspired by retro classics, the game places heavy emphasis on exploration, schmoovement, and on creating a world filled with wacky, memorable characters!

Roll across obstacles as Tuff, the Earth slime:

Dash and weave through hazards as Ash, the Fire slime:

Glide through the skies as Winona, the Air slime:

...and cruise around at high speeds as Marsh, the Water slime:

Help these Slimes journey across the world thwarting the diabolical Wurltson's evil plans and dismantling his ever-expanding robotic enterprise. The Golden Keys, and assorted Bells and Whistles, will unlock new worlds to explore as you amass your strength in numbers (and your pile of goodies).

Choose a Visual Style

Some people prefer jaggy edges and scanlines, others prefer crystal clear sight. Play the game with visuals set to 64-Bit, 90s Arcade, HD Remaster, or put on your Nostalgia-Tinted Goggles.

Adaptive Soundtrack

Catchy tunes inspired by the style and tone of yesteryear combined with some smart programming help capture that classic exploration feel.

games.name: Sheepy: A Short Adventure
games.shortDescription: A Short Handcrafted Pixel Art Platformer that follows Sheepy, an abandoned plushy brought to life. Sheepy: A Short Adventure is the first short game from MrSuicideSheep.
games.aboutText:
Help Sheepy, an abandoned plushy brought to life, as he explores a forgotten and broken world. Sheepy: A Short Adventure is the first short game from MrSuicideSheep.

An Original Soundtrack

Weaved into the world is an incredible original soundtrack created by Seeking Blue artists Yoe Mase, Hahlweg and Tal Richards (formerly of Echos).

Mailing List

Join the Mailing List and be the first to learn about the future of Sheepy, limited edition merch and more.

games.name: Evolve Lab
games.shortDescription: In this roguelike auto battler, every enemy you face was created by another player! Modify and improve your creatures' behaviour after each battle and see how far down you can make it. Do you have what it takes to be the first to reach depths, where no one has gone before?
games.aboutText:
Program and improve your creatures’ behavior after each combat!

Customize your creatures using a unique state machine system. After every battle, you can add new actions to the state machine or enhance existing actions and their stats to refine your strategy.

Face enemies created by other players!

Every enemy you encounter was created by another player. When a creature is defeated, it remains in the ocean and becomes an opponent for other players, including yourself! This creates an ever-expanding roster of unique enemies and a dynamic meta that evolves over time.

Defeat is not the end!

Track how your creations perform even after your run ends. In the depth overview, you can watch how they are performing. Build something powerful enough, and your creature might even become an elite enemy for other players to face!

Endless build variety!

Create and evolve creatures with near-limitless possibilities. The game currently includes:

- 8 unique creatures to pick from

- 40 different actions that can be used by a creature

- 27 different modules and modifiers to further modify actions

- 48 different cores that provide the creature with unique special abilities

- 8 different items that can appear as battle rewards

More creatures, actions, modules, modifiers, cores and rewards will be added with every major update!

This results in millions of different ways to play the game!

games.name: Ever Fallen Empire
games.shortDescription: A Strategic Empire Collapser. As The Authority. Manage a living galaxy, and plan large-scale actions according to your needs. Collapse governments, inflame rebellions, seed new factions, and sacrifice your own. All for purposes grander than any Empire could hold.
games.aboutText:
Ever Fallen Empire is a turn-based galactic empire strategic management game.
( With significant "Custom Game" support. The main campaign is practically a mod resting on the framework. )

The galaxies of EFE are complex, and governed by a dense strata of Anchors Of Civilisation.
From the Integrity of Government, to the Cohesion of the Populace, and the Infrastructure of Industry. And 12 more.

Anchors that knock on to one another, causing waves of repercussions to sweep your territory. Waking people to the Empire's deep corruption.

As the Annihilationists rise from their holes seeking to end all life, as your rivals move to take your throne for their own cruel ends, and the freedom fighters marshal rebellions to free themselves. A galaxy inhabited by men and women that seek to survive and flourish. Or steal and murder.

Some heed the Creator's words.
Others, forge their own definitions of morality.

Factions of characters, join together. Funnelling their resources into effecting the galaxy at large.
Into assisting you, or fighting you.

You, the New Authority of the Ever Empire.

But you shall order vast operations.
To save Humanity from itself - and from you - for the last time in all history.

Cripple communication. Ruin space-travel. Shatter the very stars of our night's sky.
Build deep archives of our histories cemented into leviathanic super planets.
Coax Autonomous Intelligences into siding with your ideals.

This is your empire. Your people, they are your responsibility.
You shall not allow it to become, Ever Fallen.

You will bring down this rancid empire, forever.

- - -
