And all skills have their own unique story, contains the unique cultural connotation of the Touhou Project.
It is hoped that players can get the pleasure of defeating strong enemies, the satisfaction of collecting moves, and the enrichment of seeing and hearing.

● Mysterious and Psychedelic Adventure

As you go deep into the miasma overflowing magic forest, in order to fulfill the agreement, you will lose Ego and embark on a dangerous journey.

Meet enemies of different forms and styles.
Some will release high-intensity barrages;
Some will launch a pressing pursuit step by step;

Some are unfathomable magicians;
Some of them are swordsmen as quiet as water.

You may encounter companions who fight together during the adventure~

Explore the central hinterland of the deserted Gensokyo, feel the cruel law of the jungle, and confront the enemies who kill your sanity in the dark and distorted world. Use the "unconscious" ability to launch various assassination mysteries, show the skills of monsters, cut and shuttle up and down in the fierce bullet battle, and have a fierce confrontation with the enemy.

● Developer's Words

If《Halluci-Sabbat of Koishi》 is simple, it is absolutely deceptive, but it is not difficult for the sake of difficulty.
The original intention of this game is to let players have a considerable sense of achievement after completing something or discovering something.
High difficulty is one of the sources of sense of achievement.
This is SekiKoi ？

The battlefield is a place where corpses are piled up.
Only by holding onto the belief that one must die can one survive.
If one wants to survive, they will die

games.name: Mercury Abbey
games.shortDescription: In a mansion surrounded by mist, as the curse made by the Alchemist and Fairy reappears, the danger is quietly lurking in the darkness, awaiting its visitors.Follow Harrod and Willie to unravel an incredible story in Mercury Abbey, and go on an adventure that you would only find in mystery novels.
games.aboutText:
【1】Vintage pixel art and brilliant lighting

The game captured the essence of pixel art and partnered it with American comic-style illustrations.

The Fossil Hall, Greenhouse, Labyrinth of Shrubs, Botanical Garden, Underground Cave… and many more scenes will bring you to a visual feast. The unique lighting technology creates an engaging atmosphere, presenting an unforgettable and immersive experience.
【2】 Classic cultural elements and a unique worldview

The game fused mystery novels' early works and incorporated the classic cultural elements from the stories into the game. This world is created with an imaginative worldview and personified animal (Furry) characters; everything about this world, from the social construct, the custom and legends to the relationship between the ethnic groups, is waiting for players to discover.
【3】Intriguing stories

Bizzare things are happening in the mysterious abbey up on the mountain, and the curse of the Alchemy family is spreading everywhere.

The legends of Fairies, a Society that only appears during midnight, guests who all came here with different intentions. An investigation out of curiosity has led to the discovery of inconceivable secrets.

Clues dotted around the place will eventually join together to uncover the myths. Danger constantly surrounds our protagonists; how will they write the ending for this story...
【4】 There are many elements to collect and achievements to unlock

There are many things for you to collect, from character information to legendary stories, from collectable items to written notes and from pictures taken to gossip overheard. At the same time, exciting achievements are all over the place; each action and choice you make will take you one step closer to unlocking them. So be brave and try it out!

games.name: Island of Winds
games.shortDescription: Journey through a mystical 17th century Iceland inspired by authentic folklore and mythology. Play as Brynhildur, a young Balance Keeper who uses magic, empathy, and puzzle-solving to uncover ancient secrets and restore harmony to a fractured world.
games.aboutText:
Island of Winds is a narrative third-person exploration adventure set in a mystical version of 17th century Iceland, where folklore, magic, and nature intertwine. You play as Brynhildur, a young Balance Keeper whose peaceful life is shattered after an attack on her homestead and the disappearance of her mentor. Guided by ancient magic and empathy rather than violence, Brynhildur must journey across a fractured island to uncover forgotten truths, help troubled mythical beings, and restore balance to a world slowly falling apart.

Across windswept shores, frozen paths, hidden lagoons, volcanic highlands, and ancient ruins, explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Icelandic nature and mythology. Uncover secrets hidden throughout the island, discover stories of its inhabitants, and slowly piece together the mysteries surrounding Brynhildur’s past and the fate of her homeland.

A keeper of balance

Step into the role of Brynhildur, a young spellcaster learning to harness magical abilities tied to balance, empathy, and the forces of nature. Use your powers to interact with the world, help creatures in need, and calm hostile adversaries.

Explore a mystical Iceland

Travel through enchanting semi-open environments inspired by Iceland’s dramatic landscapes and rich folklore. From icy mountain trails and black-sand shores to hidden forests and mysterious ruins, every region of the island holds secrets waiting to be discovered.

Magic and puzzles

Wield the Staff of Balance to cast spells, solve environmental puzzles, and overcome obstacles throughout your journey. Observation, curiosity, and compassion are often just as important as magic itself.

Meet mythical creatures

Encounter spirits, beasts, ghosts, and magical beings inspired by Icelandic mythology. Discover what troubles the creatures of the island and help restore peace to a world consumed by imbalance.

An emotional journey

Experience a heartfelt story exploring themes of self-doubt, regret, violence, empathy, and personal growth. As Brynhildur searches for her missing mentor and clan, she must confront her own complicated past and discover what it truly means to restore balance.

Discover the island’s secrets

Explore hidden corners of the world to uncover forgotten lore, optional stories, and ancient mysteries connected to the island’s history and mythology.

A world inspired by folklore

Immerse yourself in a fantastical interpretation of 17th century Iceland, deeply rooted in authentic Icelandic folklore, history, and supernatural legends.

games.name: Geo Mythica
games.shortDescription: Embark on an 8-bit style JRPG quest to save Earth. Battle in unique party-based combat mixing real-time action and strategic commands. Join Gio and a team of lively characters as they unearth bizarre global events, forgotten legends, and battle mythical foes to unveil the secrets of Geo Mythica.
games.aboutText:
A GLOBETROTTING 8-BIT STYLE JRPG SET IN 90s EARTH

Embark on an 8-bit style JRPG adventure to save Earth circa 199X using a distinctive party-based combat system.

As the high school football team’s star, Gio Zachary never thought he would find himself on a globetrotting adventure to save the world.

Through a series of strange events, Gio embarks on a journey exploring Earth’s bizarre magical underworld to master the skills needed to defeat an evil corporation’s plans of global domination.

Team up with colorful characters from around the world and see what discoveries and secrets you’ll find on each continent. BATTLE

- Battle in a distinctive, fast-paced party-based combat system mixing real-time action and strategic commands.

- Manage characters and their class-based abilities in various ways for a compelling and immersive battle experience.

- Battle with hotkeys if you prefer fast action, or freeze time with the combat menu if you like a more turn-based-like experience. Or mix and match!

- Utilize and reallocate your character’s talent points to suit your playstyle, or adapt your strategies based on the challenges you encounter.

EXPLORE

- Travel to various cultural locations across the world, learn foreign languages and use local currency to purchase global cuisines that heal you and your party.

- Freely explore fun and magic-infected places around the globe in (largely) the order you choose - from art museums in Brazil to haunted jazz clubs in New Orleans to casinos in China!

- Meet other unforgettable characters while adventuring on a variety of optional, story-centered sidequests.

games.name: Dead Detective: Zombie Conspiracy
games.shortDescription: Step into the shoes of Margh, an undead private detective, in this hilarious and bizarre adventure that combines classic point-and-click gameplay with an elaborate “deaduction” system. Use your brain (or what’s left of it) to solve strange and unconventional mysteries in a world ruled by zombies.
games.aboutText:
This edition collects all 11 cases from the cult, award-winning investigative adventure series Dead Detective, originally released during the golden age of browser games, now brought together in a definitive version featuring improved graphics, an updated interface, and a refined deduction system.

WARNING: You do not need to be dead to play this game. But it might help.

We all knew it would happen eventually: zombies have taken over the planet, and their victory has been absolute.

But zombie society still has its problems.
First among them: crime.

Play as Margh, an undead private detective, and solve bizarre and unconventional mysteries with the help of his loyal but constantly hungry assistant Ghvnn, in this hilarious and offbeat point-and-click adventure featuring an elaborate “deaduction” system.

Visit crime scenes, interrogate rotting suspects and eccentric witnesses, solve puzzles, gather clues, and use your brain (or what remains of it) to piece everything together and reach the conclusion of each case. Hopefully the right one.

Between shady neuron dealers, the zombie mafia, gentleman thieves, and mysterious robberies, Margh will certainly have his hands full.

But who knows, between one case and another, he might even uncover the greatest mystery of zombie society: the one that lies behind its very rise to power.

And perhaps Ghvnn will finally manage to satiate his hunger for brains…though that might be asking a bit too much.

One thing is certain:

FEATURES

- 11 cases to solve , each stranger than the last

- at least 3 different endings for each case

- An intuitive “deaduction” system that will really make you use your brain

- A simple and modern point-and-click interface

- Instant translation from “Zombiesh” to English (be warned: zombies tend to say “brains” quite often)

- In-game hint system

games.name: Heroes of Abyss
games.shortDescription: Heroes of Abyss - a rogue-like tactics army battler. Guide the heroes through rooms full of different creatures. Equip and sacrifice your heroes in procedural dungeons as you fight your enemies!
games.aboutText:
Grab your heroes

Indirect combat

Prepare your heroes and let them fight on their own! Place stormtroopers in front, and snipers and stingers back. Equip your heroes with items to increase their characteristics or make them unique fighters.
Endless exploration

Dungeons are generated from scratch each time, and a new set of items is created for the heroes to use.
Death is not the end

Some rare items after the death of a hero can transform him into something different, sometimes even more powerful and terrible ...

games.name: Annihilate The Spance
games.shortDescription: An RTS base builder with huge battles, constant production, and autonomous ships. The Spance approaches, a vast and mysterious storm at the edge of humanity. Who shall claim its riches? Brave the perils of the depths in a story-rich singleplayer campaign with numerous distinct factions and bosses.
games.aboutText:
Featuring:

OE-Like

Constant endless unit production from your shipyards. Each ship is autonomous, they seek your opponents and prioritize what they are best suited to fight. Witness vast battles. Though you cannot directly control your units in the interference of the Spance, you can create waypoint chains to direct where shipyards send your fleets.

Inspired by the gameplay of Obliterate Everything by CWWallis.

Full Campaign

A fast-paced singleplayer campaign with over 40 missions where you fight both with and against each of the main factions. Delve the secrets of the Spance, and annihilate your opposition. Overcome the horrors of the storm and wield the might of interstellar armadas.

The Gameplay

Annihilate The Spance is a real-time strategy game focused on a singleplayer campaign that sees you handle base building, economy, and armadas of autonomous starships. In ATS your units cannot be commanded individually, but you have many solutions to direct them towards your goals. Each ship has its own intelligent AI, and will attempt to do its best alongside its brethren in the heat of battle.

Test your ability to respond to situations as they change and shift in the chaotic tide of a 3D battlefield. ATS features an unlocked height plane, allowing starships to fly up, down, and around their enemies. Battles are multiple stories high, and can bend and shift as new vessels with unique capabilities arrive upon the battlefield. ATS has a greatly varied unit scale, ranging from tiny drones to kilometers-long capital ships that can level entire bases multiple times over.

Each ship in ATS is autonomous, targeting and attacking on its own initiative while you focus on making higher-level strategic decisions. Plan your fleet composition carefully. Calculate build cycles. Make tactical positioning decisions. There is no single ship that can win this battle. Compose a mixture of ships from across your entire selection of blueprints. Exploit your enemies' weaknesses and capitalize on your strengths to annihilate the enemy.

The Story

ATS is set in a future embroiled in conflict following the discovery of a mysterious, ultra-dense nebula-like anomaly known as the Spance. An ancient, roiling storm of matter and energy, the Spance has roamed the galaxy for eons and dragged hundreds of solar systems into its depths. Extreme and inexplicable phenomena make navigation of the Spance treacherous, but the unfathomable riches contained within offer a lucrative new frontier full of promise. However, not all is as it seems.

Four interlinked campaigns will take you through the depths of the Spance. Encounter each of the major factions as they struggle toward their goals for the Spance and its treasures, all the while gaining access to new units and technologies. Learn the unique doctrines needed to command the military might of the Kontaalen Armada, the united fleets of the Vaalkorei Coalition mercantile guilds, and the experimental technologies of Emar's Tychon Division. Delve ever deeper into the impenetrable abyss of the Spance and unlock its secrets.

Skirmish, Custom Maps, and the Level Editor

Beyond the main campaign, you can jump directly into Skirmishes against AI opponents in custom maps and levels.

Additionally, our game features a full in-game level editor that can be used to create and share your own scenarios.

games.name: 30 Birds
games.shortDescription: Lantern City is on the verge of disaster: the Goddess Simurgh has been kidnapped by the evil Scientist! 30 Birds is a narrative puzzle game laid out on the surface of rotating lanterns. Wander through a gorgeous world inspired by Persian art, meet quirky birds, and solve puzzles to rescue Simurgh.
games.aboutText:
In 30 Birds, you play as Zig, a young detective sent to bustling Lantern City to track down The Scientist. Alongside Hoop, a talented hoopoe stand-up comedian, you'll encounter a whole madhouse of feathered friends and quirky characters as you explore dazzling Lantern City from top to bottom. Solve a variety of puzzles to foil the plans of the obnoxious Scientist behind the kidnapping to save the bird Goddess Simurgh.

Experience a seamless blend of 2D and 3D in this mesmerizing narrative adventure, with hand-drawn visuals inspired by Persian miniatures. Wander through the gorgeous neighborhoods of Lantern City while enjoying a ska - dub - reggae inspired soundtrack and help Zig gather thirty charismatic and chatty birds to save Simurgh! But beware, you might come across puzzling challenges on your way…

Discover a gorgeous universe laid out on the surface of rotating lanterns. Wander through a beautiful city inspired by Middle Eastern legends, meeting the local goofs, quirky djinns, and regular weirdos along the way. Solve puzzles and interesting challenges to help Zig rescue Simurgh!

- Meet riotous and (not-so) charming birds , collecting your new feathered friends' contacts on your phone. Thwart diabolical and (not-so) powerful foes and find the fabulous Goddess, Simurgh .

- Explore a mythical, colorful, and beautifully hand-drawn world inspired by Persian art! Uncover Lantern City's stunning sights and fantastic characters.

- Take on all kinds of thrilling challenges to advance the story! Solve intriguing and fun puzzles, wander around bars and cafes, create funky music using synthesizers, and play cards to gather clues and bring light to Simurgh’s kidnapping.

- Vibe out to the energetic ska - dub - reggae soundtrack , sprinkled with unexpected twists, as you stroll down the bright streets of Lantern City.

games.name: Loco Motive
games.shortDescription: There's been a murder aboard the Reuss Express, and you're the suspects! Prove your innocence in this comedy 'point n' click' murder mystery - packed with twists, laughs, and larger-than-life characters!
games.aboutText:
Welcome aboard the Reuss Express, a journey of a life-time derailed by an unexpected assassination.

On the eve of a landmark speech by the wealthy heiress Lady Unterwald, a straight-laced lawyer, a crime novelist-turned rookie detective, and an undercover spy find themselves embroiled in a murder, a mystery, and worst of all…

an adventure! Now stuck onboard a luxurious steam train, within stabbing distance of a cold-blooded killer, the race is on to prove their innocence once and for all!

Play as Diana, Arthur and Herman to unwrap the mystery and put your point and click puzzle-solving skills to the test...

- Take control of three characters aboard a 1930s steam train, in an interlinking comedy adventure!

- Uncover a deadly mystery, full of twists, turns and slapstick humour

- Meet a train-full of quirky and somewhat suspicious fellow passengers

- Stop at nothing to solve item-based puzzles, that won’t leave you head-scratching for hours

- Choose how you play — enjoy full controller support with direct character control, or use mouse & keyboard for a classic experience

- Beautifully detailed pixel art — bursting with charm and character!

- A little nudge in the right direction when needed - Telephone for assistance with an in-game hint call-line!

- An original soundtrack from composer Paul Zimmermann ( Wildfrost, Space Haven)

- Full Voice Acting with an all-star cast! ( Sean Chiplock, Kaitlyn Robrock, Samantha Béart, Jim Meskimen & More!)

- Verified on Steam Deck | Steam Machine

games.name: Kusan: City of Wolves
games.shortDescription: Kusan: City of Wolves is a high-octane hardcore top-down shooter where players fight through a brutal urban jungle ruled by gunfire and corruption to save Haru — a girl fitted with a city-grade atomic weapon.
games.aboutText:
Brutal, precise gunplay where every move counts. Stylish play is rewarded as you dominate tightly designed arenas.

Fight through 54 intense stages across multiple chapters with skill-based puzzles, challenges and S-ranks for perfectionists—for lone wolves and high score chasers.

Face towering foes with distinctive mechanics and high-stakes patterns. Learn, adapt and execute to survive cinematic duels that push timing and tactics to the limit.

Optimise and improvise - Chain kills, parries and get into the flow to earn Bolts and upgrade the War Hand, unlock firearms and blades and tailor loadouts to your playstyle.

Follow Jin’s missions through dynamic comic-panel cutscenes—sharp frames, cinematic pacing and a gritty tale of violence, corruption and fractured loyalties.

A rain-soaked pixel-art metropolis where Jin is ready to cross every line to save the girl.

Welcome to Kusan: City of Wolves , a brutal top-down shooter set in a neon-drenched urban jungle consumed by violence and corruption.

Kusan delivers hardcore action where one mistake means death. Master gunplay, perfect your movement, survive the streets and combat arenas ruled by furious kingpins that demand speed, precision and flawless execution. Every moment of action is intensified by Korean hip-hop heavyweight Loptimist’s adrenaline-fuelled soundtrack drenched with head-bopping loops and deep 808s pushing you forward without mercy.

You play as Jin, a skilled ex-soldier turned gun-for-hire, living in the heart of a city where the line between predator and prey has already been crossed. This isn’t just another job though, a mysterious girl with immense but uncontrollable power is linked to a violent conspiracy that threatens to shift the balance of power. As chaos erupts, Jin must save the girl, confront his past and the betrayal of a commander he once trusted without question.

Everyone in Kusan wants something and nobody plays fair.

For Jin, there is only one way forward: flawless planning, ruthless execution and saving the girl from criminals while relying only on his wit and unrelenting will to survive the battlefield.

With the whole city at stake, Jin knows it is time to not only clean-house but restore balance.

Features:

Hardcore top-down combat with style

Brutal, precise gunplay where every move counts. Stylish play is rewarded as you dominate tightly designed arenas.

54 Hand-crafted Stages & Mastery

Fight through 54 intense stages across multiple chapters with skill-based puzzles, challenges and S-ranks for perfectionists—for lone wolves and high score chasers.

Beastly Boss Battles

Face towering foes with distinctive mechanics and high-stakes patterns. Learn, adapt and execute to survive cinematic duels that push timing and tactics to the limit.

War Hand & Arsenal

Optimise and improvise - Chain kills, parries and get into the flow to earn Bolts and upgrade the War Hand, unlock firearms and blades and tailor loadouts to your playstyle.

Adrenaline-fuelled Soundtrack

An adrenaline-fuelled score from Korean hip-hop artist Loptimist serving heavy doses of energy.

Graphic-Novel Storytelling

Follow Jin’s missions through dynamic comic-panel cutscenes—sharp frames, cinematic pacing and a gritty tale of violence, corruption and fractured loyalties.

Neo-Noir Atmosphere

A rain-soaked pixel-art metropolis where Jin is ready to cross every line to save the girl.

Dive into Kusan: City of Wolves and descend into a city on the edge. It's more than just a fight, you are the last line between order and oblivion.

games.name: Abyssus
games.shortDescription: Choose your loadout, blast through the corrupted denizens of a sunken civilization, and wield godly powers in Abyssus – a fast-paced 1-to-4 players FPS and roguelite brinepunk adventure.
games.aboutText:
Gather your friends and dive into Abyssus ' fast-paced multiplayer shooting action. Fight through gorgeous hand-crafted levels in a roguelite adventure that will put your tactical skills to the ultimate test. Wield powerful brine-powered weapons and refit them with ancient technologies to gain an edge over your foes. Obtain divine blessings to enhance your firepower with elemental and mystic effects.

In a world powered by brine, a rare and powerful substance only found in the deepest fathoms of the sea, your team of daring brinepunk explorers is recruited to claim a massive deposit located beneath the ruins of an ancient civilization. However, your mission becomes a frantic battle for survival when the sunken kingdom’s corrupted inhabitants rise against you.

Will you survive to see the surface again, or will the abyss claim your life?

In Abyssus , cooperation means survival. Team up with fellow Brinehunters and carefully choose synergic loadouts, skills, suits, and weapon mods. Work together and fight through a merciless roguelite gauntlet, where no run is the same as the last.

Wield highly customizable, brine-powered armaments and infuse them with the might of ancient Gods. Master 8 weapons and 45 weapon mods, upgrading your skills and suit as you face the underwater kingdom’s mutated guardians.

Run after run, you’ll access more and more upgrades and tactical choices, but firepower alone won’t save you from the denizens of the depths. Mastering Abyssus 's visceral gunplay and fast-paced action will require tactical coordination, positioning skills, and cohesive teamwork.

The world of Abyssus is richly atmospheric and steeped in mystery. What untold secrets lie in the sunken kingdom? What gives brine its inexplicable powers? Can we weaponize an anglerfish? The answers lie deep down below…

- Visceral, fast-paced FPS action, with top-notch weapon feel and combat responsiveness

- Up to 4-players co-op

- Roguelite meta progression with advancements, rewards, and unlocks

- 70+ hand-crafted levels, procedurally sequenced to make every run a new experience

- 9 different weapons customizable with 45 weapon mods

- Over 140 Ancient Forge mods to further empower weapons and skills

- Extensive pre-run and in-run character customization options

- 36 different enemies and 12 bosses that will put your skills to the challenge

- Over 250 Charms and Blessings to craft the perfect build

games.name: Mirth Melody
games.shortDescription: Play as Dodo the duck exploring a beautiful little forest. Strum your favorite guitar and watch as the forest creatures happily vibe along to your music.
games.aboutText:
About

Mirth Melody is a small rhythm game set in the Mirth Island universe. In this game, you play as Dodo the duck, exploring a beautiful little forest. Strum your favorite guitar and watch as the forest creatures happily vibe along to your music. Features

- Explore the tiny forest as Dodo the duck
- Interact with various items and animals
- Play your guitar and watch as forest creatures gather and dance to your music

If you enjoy playing it, please consider checking out Mirth Island and adding it to your wishlist: Mirth Island Steam Page

games.name: Craftomation 101: Programming & Craft
games.shortDescription: Program a crew of tiny robots to turn a frozen planet into a living world. Connect visual code blocks, automate crafting, and build a workforce that fuels itself. Keep the heat flowing, refine your machines, and watch your ideas come to life.
games.aboutText:
Start with one hungry robot on a frozen planet and build the crew that will bring it back to life. Craftomation 101 is a visual programming and automation game : design a routine, watch your robots carry it out, then improve the system when the cold exposes a weak link.

Your tiny rocket has delivered you to a planet that needs a new beginning. Harvest and combine materials, discover new recipes, and turn a frozen landing site into a growing robot base. Terraforming a whole planet sounds like a 9000-year job. Fortunately, you can make robots do it for you. Give your robots a plan

Connect visual blocks to make robots gather resources, combine materials, and deliver supplies. You decide what happens and in what order. Test an idea, spot the problem, and turn a manual chore into a working routine.

Meet your CraftoMates: tiny robots that can be assembled and upgraded using the materials around them.

Program your robots to harvest and craft those materials, then use them to expand your crew. Gradually build a self-sustaining workforce that can gather supplies, make more robots, and keep itself fed. Build smarter systems

Develop reusable functions, work with variables and arrays, and coordinate a growing workforce. A useful program can become the foundation for your next machine and your next improvement. Keep the warmth flowing

Your robots need fuel, and your growing base needs heat. Automate both, craft tools, light fires, and push back the ice. Plant trees, produce oxygen, and work toward terraforming the entire planet . A new planet, a new puzzle

Try procedurally generated frozen planets with different layouts of resources, buildings, and volcanoes. Refine your approach on a new generation seed, or share a favorite seed with another robot engineer.

games.name: Hidden Kittens: Kingdom of Cats
games.shortDescription: Find the Hidden Kittens in the Kingdom of Cats and enjoy a cute, relaxing adventure that will warm your heart. 🐱✨
games.aboutText:
Get ready for a purr-fectly charming adventure in the Kingdom of Cats! 🐾
Your mission is simple, yet delightful: find all the adorable kittens hidden throughout this magical world. Every corner hides a fluffy surprise just waiting to be discovered! Key Features:

- 🐱 Find over 350 adorable kittens

- 🎨 Customize the scenery's colors

- 💡 Hint system

- 💾 Progress saving

- 🕵️‍♂️ Hidden riddles

- 🔍 Zoom feature

- 🎵 Original soundtrack

- 🏆 Steam achievements

Ready for loads of kitty fun? 🐱✨
Explore, discover, and enjoy every adorable moment as you find all the cute kittens in the Kingdom of Cats. The adventure begins now! Find the Hidden Kittens 🐾

Choose Your Favorite Color 🎨

games.name: Space Defender: Frontier Squadron
games.shortDescription: A top-down space shooter with deep RPG progression. Fly a voiced story in four acts, lead your wingmen, hunt pirate captains, hold a collapsing front. Solo or local co-op. Your Steam purchase also unlocks the full game on Android and iPhone (via sync, up to 3 devices).
games.aboutText:
Included with your purchase: the full game on Android and iPhone. In the Steam game, on the save screen, open Sync and press "Unlock my phones", then enter the same sync key on your phone: your saves follow you, and the full game unlocks there on up to 3 devices. You need to own the game: Family Sharing and free weekends don't count.

The frontier is falling. Hold the line.

A twin-stick arcade shooter in space. Lead a squadron, defend the stations, land on the planets and drive the rover, then dock at a spaceport for a drink, a rumour and a game of cards with the regulars. A story told over the radio in the middle of the fight, made by a solo French developer.

Fly, dodge, fire

Pick up the controller and you are in the fight. Every enemy attack is announced: read it, dodge it, hit back. Snipers keep their distance, minelayers leave traps, carriers launch fighters, jammers scramble your missiles.

Lead your squadron

- Up to three wingmen: order them to attack, cover you, hold or break, and they answer on the radio

- Each pilot has a trait that changes how they fight, and earns grades from Recruit to Ace

- A downed wingman ejects: pick up the pod before it is lost

Build your ship

- 20 ships and over 60 pieces of equipment: lasers, railguns, flak, guided missiles, turrets, shields

- Manage your energy: everything you fit changes how your ship flies and fights

- Research, mining, salvage and trade pay for the next hull; the Laboratory turns plans into new gear

A front that moves

The Drones push back. Stations come under threat, then under siege, then fall if nobody defends them. Take them back.

A story in four acts

Fly for Admiral Voss and Ilse Marin, with ARIA at your side, in a story voiced in six languages. Escort the Armada, make your choice at the Threshold, then head down into Kepler, the abandoned mining world of Act IV: gravity wells, dark shafts, heavy ships. Spare, enlist or shoot down the pirate captains: your choices lead to one of several endings.

Planetary expeditions

Scan a planet, pick a site and set down. Then the rover takes over: drive to wrecks, relics, caches and pirate outposts, take ground contracts, get past the traps of the ruins, and on ocean worlds open the gates of sunken cities. Bring back rare materials for the Laboratory.

Found a rich vein? Start the drill and hold out: the pirates come in waves. Place your turrets and mines, repair the drill under fire, and leave with the ore.

Pull up a stool at the bar

Every spaceport has its own bar and its own people. Buy a rumour from the informant: a signal on a distant planet, a pirate lieutenant's bounty, a vein, a hidden cache, the wreck of a legendary hull. Get to know the regulars, each with a story to follow, a job for you and a gift at the end. And sometimes, a dare.

The arcade room

- FRONTIER EIGHTS: a card game against the regulars, for fun or for credits, with 24 special cards to win and build into your deck

- A pinball table with its own squadron career, a rover race, air hockey and an asteroid shooter

- A high-score board in every port: become its champion

Your crew

Recruit pilots in port, put them in a wingman's cockpit or aboard your own ship, and talk with them: what they have to say changes as the story moves on. Send a team down to explore a signal. Not everyone comes back, and the memorial keeps their names.

Play together

Local co-op: a friend takes a second controller and flies a wingman at your side, on one PC or online with Steam Remote Play Together.

Play your way

- Controller or mouse and keyboard; Windows, macOS and Linux

- Four difficulty levels, a Veteran mode and 3 save slots

- Voiced in English, French, German, Spanish, Russian and Simplified Chinese

games.name: Concerto on White
games.shortDescription: Rhythm Action? No, this is MUSICIAN SIMULATION! Concerto on White is a musician simulation game featuring classical music. Unlike any typical rhythm games, players are required to actually play the main melody. In the main story, you will experience adventurous campus life in the academy.
games.aboutText:
Join us on Discord!

Rhythm Action? No, this is MUSICIAN SIMULATION ! Real performances are needed here at Concordia Academy of Music, where talented musicians make great music together.
- Easy-to-learn, hard-to-master gameplay mechanic
- The revolutionary “Infinite Improvisation” boss battle
- A powerful editor for customized pieces
- An adventure story in the academy where Baroque and Sci-fi co-exist

======20220321 Updates======
Map editor released! Find tutorial video below:

games.name: Back to the Dawn
games.shortDescription: Back to the Dawn is a story-rich RPG set in a high-security prison ruled by factions and buried secrets. Investigate two conspiracies from the inside, gather evidence, and outsmart a system designed to silence you. Make friends (or foes) with fellow inmates and with their help, break out of prison.
games.aboutText:
Back to the Dawn (动物迷城)

A gripping prison escape RPG woven with crime, corruption, and hidden agendas. Step into a maximum-security facility where every inmate has a past—and a plan. You'll have to fight to survive, investigate, and ultimately break free before the time runs out.

Uncover a scheme that threatens more than just your life—it could bring down the entire city. In this thrilling adventure, choices matter, and escape is your only salvation!

Choose between two protagonists — Thomas, a reporter caught in a web of lies, or Bob, an undercover agent sent deep into the prison system. Each storyline delivers over 20 hours of engrossing mystery, where your every choice matters. Navigate a prison ruled by three powerful gangs, interact with 47 uniquely crafted inmates, and uncover layers of intrigue through dozens of memorable NPCs.

With over 100 handcrafted quests, multiple escape routes—each with its own risks and rewards—several possible endings, and more than 500,000 words of gripping narrative, Back to the Dawn delivers a deeply replayable RPG unlike anything you've experienced.

Thomas the Fox is a journalist caught up in a dark conspiracy and who got thrown into a maximum-security prison for not playing ball. Working with your attorney friend on the outside, you must collect evidence to save yourself and the city from grave danger!

Bob the Panther is an undercover agent who has never failed on any of his missions, but he is growing exhausted of this line of work and wants out. But a personal tragedy drags him back for one last job in prison. Experience a hardboiled tale of betrayal, vengeance, and truth!

This is an enormous prison with lots to do and many places to explore, but make sure you follow the rules, or at least try not to get caught!

You’ll encounter all kinds of challenges as you explore your new environment. But will you be a model prisoner and just try to keep your head down, or will you leave a trail of chaos and destruction in your wake? It’s all up to you.

Meet a colorful cast of inmates in your prison, each with an interesting story to tell. You can either make them your friends or fight, bully and rob them into submission. Will you be part of a gang or a cunning lone wolf? Pick a side!

Are you a tough guy who lets his fists do the talking, a thief who hides in the shadows, or perhaps a smooth talker who manipulates the scene? Develop your skills, craft tools to suit your style, and climb your way from “new fish” to “top dog.”

In a place built to break you, your sharpest weapon is your creativity and cunning. Every inch of Boulderton Prison might hold the key to your escape, from your prison cell to the infirmary, to the sewers and even the rooftops. Can you break free?

games.name: REKA
games.shortDescription: Step into a cozy, witchy world inspired by Slavic folklore. Build, decorate, and customize your walking chicken-legged cottage as you wander through misty autumn woodlands. Help local villagers, tame forest creatures, and learn gentle witchcrafts under the tutelage of the great witch Baba Jaga.
games.aboutText:
Construct, style, and expand your enchanted ambling cottage using a variety of woods and other building materials. Turn a humble wooden room into a cozy, multi-story home filled with clutter, trinkets, furniture, and warmth to protect you from the quiet chill of the surrounding woods.

Step into an evocative world shaped by rich Eastern European folk tales. Play as Reka, apprentice to the mysterious Baba Jaga, as you meet local villagers, complete quests, and immerse yourself in a story steeped in authentic Slavic mythology.

Learn the old ways under the tutelage of Baba Jaga. Forage for herbs, brew potions, form bonds with animals, and practice quiet witchery. Choose how your powers affect the lives of the people and creatures you meet.

Explore wherever your curiosity takes you. Drift through foggy forests and quiet villages where old spirits linger. Free from danger or pressure, tread an unhurried path steeped in mood, music, and a dark fairytale charm.

🛖 Build Without Limits: Design and furnish your very own chicken-legged moving house with your choice of materials, furniture and flourishes to make it feel like home.
🌿 Cozy, Combat-Free Gameplay: Enjoy a stress-free adventure focused on decorating, crafting, foraging, and gentle questing.
🎻 Rich Slavic Atmosphere: Immerse yourself in authentic myths and legends, beautiful environments, and an acclaimed original musical score.
🍄 Woodland Crafts & Cooking: Forage wild flora, brew potions, cook traditional recipes, and practice witchcraft the old way.
🐈 Animal Companionship: Befriend forest wildlife – cats, foxes and more – and bring them back to live in your traveling home.
🧙‍♀️ Craft Your Identity: Design your apprentice witch and carve out your own peaceful path through the wilderness.

games.name: Death of the Reprobate
games.shortDescription: Explore a world built from the luscious landscapes, turbulent townscapes and preposterous portraits of real Renaissance paintings. Death of the Reprobate is a Rabelaisian adventure game from the creator of Four Last Things and The Procession to Calvary.
games.aboutText:
Thus the heavens and the earth were completed in all their vast array. By the seventh day God had finished the work he had been doing; so on the seventh day he rested.

“Did you have a nice week?” asked Mrs God.

“No.” Replied God. “I have birthed another pitifully substandard world. Destined, no doubt, to spiral over millennia into a violent capitalist nightmare, just like all the rest of them.”

“Never mind,” said Mrs God. “Chicken pie for dinner!”

Story

Immortal John is dying. As his last surviving heir, you have been summoned to hear his dying wish. Will he ask you to avenge his death!? To murder all those who have wronged him!!? To bring to fruition his life long plan to topple the ruling elite from within, shattering the balance of power, and ultimately saving the world!!!? Or will he simply ask you to stop being such a shit?

Only time will tell. Or me, I can tell you – It's the last one.

Death of the Reprobate is a gentle story about helping people and being a nice lad. Travel around a quiet, rural town - help the locals in their day to day tasks. Wander into the nearby woods - make idle chit-chit with a woman submerged neck-deep in a tiny pond. Climb to an idyllic viewpoint in the mountains, overlooking earth and sea and sky, the natural and the man-made, the eternal mystery held within the infinite depths of the distant horizon - help a man shoot some birds. This is a game full of slow burning simple pleasures...

...Until the Devil gets involved.

Features

- Pointing and Clicking – A traditional point and click interface, with a 'verb coin' interaction menu and a simple inventory from which you can drag and drop your preciously hoarded items.

- Renaissance Artwork – Renaissance, Rococo and even a hint of Romanticism, to be a little more precise. Hundreds of paintings, spanning hundreds of years, are all brought together into one consistent world.

- Classical Music – Music by Eduardo Antonello. Period appropriate music that adapts as the story progresses, recorded using real medieval/renaissance instruments.

- Standalone Story – Death of the Reprobate is set in the same world as Four Last Things and The Procession to Calvary, and features some recurring characters/themes, but it can be played independently.

- Highbrow Buffoonery – Lofty subject matter is treated with gleeful flippancy. Gags about butts are taken very seriously. But rest assured, while some of the jokes may be ridiculous, the puzzles make perfect sense! (or at least adhere to a consistent internal logic)

games.name: Fools, Maniacs and Liars
games.shortDescription: A narrative-driven game of suspense, crime, and dark humor. Amid exquisitely crafted art and a gripping story, the Wushan Great Buddha's demise unfolds.
games.aboutText:
Fools, Maniacs and Liars is a suspenseful narrative game set in China.

Background

- The story unfolds in the fictional ceramic county in southern Fujian—Wushan.

- Since ancient times, a giant Buddha known as "Mida" has stood upon Mount Wushan. Countless folk tales surround the statue—some even say Mida is alive.

- Then, one day in 2009, the Buddha vanished into thin air. And a half-century enigma was about to come to light.

Story

- This is a realist tale shot through with magical realism and absurdity—a story born of a tumultuous age.

- Woven from layers of suspense and dark humor, the chronicle of the Wushan Great Buddha's demise begins.

- The story twists and turns through constant peril and escalating mysteries, where nothing is certain until the final revelation.

Cinematic Narrative

- With cinematic visuals and carefully crafted sound design, you'll experience a feast of Chinese aesthetics.

- Comic-panel framing is woven throughout the game, lending a distinctive atmosphere and a smooth gameplay cadence.

Multiple Characters

- Step into the roles of six distinct characters—one after another—returning to the month before the Mida's disappearance to uncover the truth.

- Six characters, each with a markedly different personality, background, and way of getting by. Under the compassionate gaze of Mida, their fates seem preordained, yet still brim with possibility.

Light Puzzles

- Feel free to experiment. Our puzzles are designed to be readable and fair, not punishing. We respect your time.

- This is a story-driven experience complemented by light puzzle interactions. Every design choice exists to serve immersion.

games.name: Primitier
games.shortDescription: Primitier is a highly flexible VR sandbox game, where you can create tools and machinery by freely cutting and connecting objects in a vast world based on physics simulation.
games.aboutText:
Attention: This game is for VR only.

Primitier is a highly flexible VR sandbox game, where you can create tools and machinery by freely cutting and connecting objects in a vast world based on physics simulation. True Craft System

By striking a tree with a stone, the tree is cut at the point of impact. Attach a stone to the end of a cut piece of wood of a suitable length, and you have a stone axe. In this way, you can craft various tools with a realistic sense of craftsmanship, not only with wood and stone but also with almost all objects found within the game.

Expansive World

You can seamlessly traverse a vast, procedurally generated world. As you explore, you may encounter enemies—so be prepared to create weapons to defend yourself.

Advanced Physics Simulation

Including crafted tools, all objects interact through physics simulation. For example, the ease of swinging and destructive power of a stone axe depends on the handle's length and the stone's weight. You can also create machines like carts and airplanes that operate physically.

Simulations of air resistance, lift, and buoyancy are also included.

Avatar Importing

You can change your avatar by loading VRM format files (not all VRM files are supported). The avatar can be hidden if desired. Posting and Broadcasting Gameplay Videos

We allow the posting and broadcasting of gameplay videos within our guidelines. Please refer to the official website's guidelines for more details.
Note that you can output a third-person perspective video on your PC screen using the in-game camera.

games.name: Murders on the Yangtze River
games.shortDescription: "Murders on Yangtze River" is an Ace Attorney-like detective game that takes you on a journey through early 20th century China as you solve a series of intriguing cases. Use your logical reasoning and deduction skills to uncover clues, interrogate suspects, and solve the mysteries.
games.aboutText:
If you're a fan of "Ace Attorney", you won't want to miss "Murders on Yangtze River", a horizontal axis detective game developed by OMEGames Studio.

The game takes you on a journey through early 20th century China as you solve a series of intriguing cases along the Yangtze River. With its stunning brush painting art style and engaging storyline, it offers a unique gaming experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

Use your logical reasoning and deduction skills to uncover clues, interrogate suspects, and solve the mysteries. With challenging puzzles and interesting characters to meet, "Murders on the Yangtze River" will have you hooked from the very beginning.
Engaging Stories

Embark on a thrilling journey full of extraordinary cases and plot twists! Players take on the role John Shen, a traveling detective who seeks truth and revenge for his brother’s death. Along his journey, he encounters numerous cases that are full of mystery, drama and suspense.
Memorable Characters

The game has many unforgettable characters. John Shen, for instance, is a refined gentleman with a sharp intellect. But as you delve deeper, you discover that he harbors a darker side to his personality. His vivacious assistant, Frankie, is a beacon of positivity who is always eager to use his technological inventions in their investigations.
Rigorous Logical Reasoning

Investigate crime scenes, search for evidence, debate with suspects, and identify the murderer using collected clues. Find contradictions within testimonies and unravel the mystery. There are also many challenging puzzles. Get ready for a gripping adventure!
Easy Access

The game features an intuitive tutorial that starts off with straightforward controls and simple cases, gradually building up to more challenging scenarios. Whether you're a seasoned player or new to the game, it's designed to be easy to pick up and play at any skill level.
Pleasant Journey on a Chinese-style Ink Wash Picture Scroll

Journey through a beautiful ink wash landscape painting of China's mountains and rivers from a hundred years ago. Explore picturesque Dongting Lake, Yangzhou and Shanghai. Immerse yourself in local customs in this extraordinary picture scroll.

[Main Story]
John Shen, the protagonist of this story, studied law in London alongside his brother, who was studying biology. One day, Shen's brother was found dead in his dormitory, and the police ruled his death as suicide. But when Shen stumbled upon a newly published detective novel on Shanghai News that depicted a murder scene identical to his brother's death, he began to suspect foul play. Convinced that the amateur writer was somehow involved in his brother's death, Shen returned to China to uncover the truth.

games.name: Momodora: Moonlit Farewell
games.shortDescription: "Momodora: Moonlit Farewell" is the latest installment in the Momodora series. Join Momo, High Priestess of the village of Koho, as she embarks on a divine mission to save her people from imminent destruction at the hands of the demon hordes summoned by a malevolent bellringer.
games.aboutText:
"Momodora: Moonlit Farewell" is the latest installment in the Momodora series. Join Momo, High Priestess of the village of Koho, as she embarks on a divine mission to save her people from imminent destruction at the hands of the demon hordes summoned by a malevolent bellringer. Story:

Momodora: Moonlit Farewell presents the account of the greatest calamity to befall the village of Koho, five years after the events of Momodora III.
Once the toll of an ominous bell is heard, the village is soon threatened by a demon invasion.
The village's matriarch sends Momo Reinol, their most capable priestess, to investigate the bell and find the bellringer responsible for summoning demons. It is their hope that by finding the culprit, they will also be able to secure the village's safety, and most importantly, the sacred Lun Tree's, a source of life and healing for Koho... Features:

- Gorgeous pixel art and animation

- Action-packed gameplay focusing on melee combos, dodging enemy attacks, and firing arrows at enemies

- The "Sigil" system, which allows for greatly customizable play styles

- Intense and core-shaking boss battles

- Deep exploration into a world rich in lore and atmosphere

- Freely adjustable difficulty levels, allowing you to relax and explore the alluring world at your own pace or take on mighty foes for a real challenge

Developer's Voice:

Hello!

This is rdein, creator of the Momodora series. Recently my team and I have announced the latest installment in the series, “Moonlit Farewell”. This is a concluding story, following through from the events of Momodora 3. With this new tale, I also intend to close the book on many of the past games’ mysteries and questions.

I’m aware that many players are more familiar with the story of Kaho, which is set in a distant past. As such, I’m designing “Moonlit Farewell” to be as enjoyable as possible without prior knowledge of Momodora 1 to 3’s stories. Moreover, the series has always been focused on action and minimal stories. So please, don’t worry too much about “catching up”!
Lastly, we hope to bring you our best game with this new title, using all the knowledge we’ve learned in the past 10 years. Please look forward to it!

games.name: Lair Land Story 2: Mist of Sea
games.shortDescription: After traveling far to the southern end of Lair Land, seven knights have reached Chainch Bay. Settled in a small tropical fishing village surrounded by ruins, they will spend the next few years building a new life here while facing the most challenging quest they will ever meet.
games.aboutText:
-Story-

The foggy, gloomy Chainch Sea is infamous for dangerous waters, wherein shipwrecks happen all the time. Bizarre things often washed ashore on Chainch Village’s beach, drawing travelers to hunt for treasure and a trading place for pirates and merchants. This sea is the borderline that divides eastern and western areas. It is also the final glimpse of an ancient civilization. The mountains and forests surrounding this settlement provide a natural barrier, protecting the descendants of the Momo Tribe and pilgrims who have lived here for generations. The mysteries surrounding Chainch are far beyond understanding. Unexplainable supernatural events often happen in this mysterious land.

Seven knights were caught in the incoming conflict between two areas and cautiously watched the borderline upon arrival. Chainch Village is also the hometown of one of the knights, Lio, who has returned here accompanying his stepsister, Vanina.

If you ever happens to meet a bard from Chainch, they will tell you that “We are all just insignificant stardust. But you are a special one. The Goddess must have plans in store for you.”

-Features-

Lair Land Story 2: Mist of Sea is a Relationship Building Simulation RPG. Players take on the role of knight Lio and live with Vanina in Chainch village. Help Vanina gain and develop some hobbies or encourage her to make different friends. After several years of living together, both of you will embrace all different kinds of endings.

◎Careers and Development

The carrier you choose for Vanina will introduce unique gameplay and plots:

Lady Farmer: Focuses on farming and managing fields and plants.

Town Planner: Focuses on building and managing village blocks.

You can develop a variety of attributes, perks, and skills. Based on the carrier, you will face different kinds of super essential duties and challenges.

◎Stuffed Closets

There are many items Vanina can use to change her appearance, such as hairdos, clothes, pajamas, swimsuits. These costumes are not just about looking good! They will provide different kinds of special effects in-game. We plan to release more costumes for You to use in the future.

◎Parallel Socializing

There are dozens of NPCs in the Chainch Village to interact with. They are good at sharing their stories, but also they have many secrets. Vanina can join their circle to earn their support, while Lio can interact with some NPCs and provide daily assistance as a knight.

◎Living in Chainch

We have created Chainch Village in 2D that has a variety of details. You will never get bored exploring it! Experience the four seasons change during a year. There are plenty of tasks for you to do, including activities in the village such as auctions, mini games,, etc. You can also take a nap at home, focus on researching and collecting items.

Outside, You can observe how people live their lives or just watch the fireflies hovering over the country field while the night falls. Don’t be out when the storm is coming, though!

If you have played the first “Lair Land Story,” we are happy to inform you that “Lair Land Story II”’s content will be 5x more extensive than the first one. There are more than 2000 events, 30+ endings, and lots of rewards for completing the game.

◎Following Plans

New Modes: More game modes to extend the gameplay.

More NPCs: New characters with different personalities. Not all of them are human!

More Skills and Activities: Get ready to be surprised with our new content!

Japanese/English Localization: This will be a large job for us, but we will do our best to get it done.

games.name: Super Roboy
games.shortDescription: Delve into the world of Super Roboy, a hand-drawn Metroidvania in a post-apocalyptic setting! Learn enemy skills, explore an interconnected world, battle mutants and robots, and uncover the emotional story of a young robot searching for his father.
games.aboutText:
Dive into the hand-drawn Metroidvania world of Super Roboy !

Battle mutants and machines while exploring an interconnected map and learning enemies’ skills.

• Learn enemy skills

Defeat enemies to acquire a wide variety of skills, including movement upgrades and powerful new weapons.

• Face off against hand-drawn bosses

Challenge a variety of uniquely designed, hand-drawn bosses that test your skills and bring the world of Super Roboy to life with striking visual flair.

• Explore

Freely explore a richly detailed sci-fi, post-apocalyptic world. Stray from the main path to discover hidden rewards

• Uncover Roboy’s past

Experience a touching story inspired by Dante’s Divine Comedy and classic sci-fi novels, brought to life through comic-style cutscenes.

• Exploit enemy weaknesses

Master elements, inflict status effects, and learn unique attacks to deal devastating blows to tough opponents.

games.name: Rabbit's Tale
games.shortDescription: Rabbit’s Tale is a hand-drawn metroidvania where portals lead into roguelike runs, and every boss you beat brings back a new power for the open world. Hunt the oppressive Steam Order, search for your kidnapped family, and survive with a symbiotic companion.
games.aboutText:
In Rabbit’s Tale , portals hidden in a hand-drawn metroidvania world drop you into roguelike runs. Beat a run’s boss, and you bring a new power home — a permanent ability that opens the path forward in the overworld.

A threat grew each day, as a dark entity lurked closer and closer to Carrot’s Village. The Steam Order discovered the power of steam machines, propelling them to power and conquest.

They threatened and took by force all the land they could, expanding their dominion thanks to their terrifying steam machines and cold-hearted minions.

One afternoon, they arrived at Carrot’s Village. A warning they gave, but a short one.

By dawn everything was sacked, burning and destroyed. Families were torn apart by kidnappers with no soul.

Now, our Hero finds himself alone with a mission on his hands.

Game Features

- Metroidvania game: classic sidescrolling platform gameplay with an explorable, interconnected world.

- Engage in skilled fights and immersive action.

- Evolve new and powerful combat skills to fight your way through enemy waves and save Rabbit's family.

- Experience a Metroidvania mixed with Roguelike in a new way.

- Beautiful and intriguing landscapes.

- Mesmerizing soundtrack.

games.name: The Heroes Around Me
games.shortDescription: The Heroes Around Me tells a story of a family of 3: the hard-working and quiet father – Nan, his daughter Lili, and their pet dog Sesame. Players will experience the harshness and warmth in the simpler time of the 1990s, where lots of stories are untold.
games.aboutText:
Time reappears, childhood memories revive

The background of the story is that the author lived in a small town in southern China in the 1990s. In the gradually well-off era, all kinds of old objects and old shops were perfectly presented in a picture of pixel style. It elaborately depicts the environment of China in the 1990s; every picture was carefully prepared that players can’t help immersing in it.

Concise dialogue, rich foreshadowing

In the concise dialogue with people around you, you can skillfully get a lot of foreshadowing hidden in words; the real emotions come out slowly, and more stories are hidden in every detail of the game. When you tap slowly and relish carefully, you will gradually find that we are telling a warm story the meaning of Hero.

Interactive operation, childhood games

In the process of plot exploration, rich interactive games are interspersed, recreating the playing scenes in the old-fashioned game machines in childhood, recording those once beautiful game times and returning to the 1990s.

games.name: Nyaaaanvy
games.shortDescription: Physics sumo-wrestling game! A heated battle for dignity among mysterious cat-like creatures. Nyanvy who wins the battle can be a true cat!! Could it be...?
games.aboutText:
"Nyanvy" is a mysterious creature that looks a bit like a cat.
"Nyaaaanvy" is a game in which Nyanvies wrestle using their wiggly, physics-based bodies.

You can either get together with your friends and have fun, or you can fight your way to the top of the rankings!

Battle the mysterious Nyanvy army in one-player Arcade and Survival modes!
Records will be ranked online. Be a faster, tougher Nyanvy!

Customize your Nyanvy by changing its body pattern or wearing stylish glasses!
Some customizations are not cat-like. But no matter what they look like, Nyanvy are still a self-described cat.

Physics sumo-wrestling game "Nyaaaanvy"
Come on, fight everyone with your favorite Nyanvy!!
Nyanvy who wins the battle can be a true cat!! Could it be...?

***About live streaming and posting images***
You can post live streaming, videos and images with or without monetization.
For more detailed guidelines, please check the official website.

Nyaaaanvy official Discord

Nyaaaanvy official website

games.name: Contract Rush DX
games.shortDescription: Every character plays like an entirely different action game in Contract Rush DX. Explore a world inspired by 2000's flash animation, collect powerful upgrades throughout levels, and unleash them to defeat difficult boss battles!
games.aboutText:
Contract Rush DX is a hand-animated 2D action game, with multiple playable characters that play like entirely different games! Complete Contracts and collect power-ups that strengthen you immensely, all culminating in massive boss fights! With inspiration from flash cartoons/games of the 2000s, the visuals are hand-animated with a sharp and bold style.

Taking on Contracts will have you exploring large levels, all with their own set of enemies, NPCs, and secrets!

Power-ups will prepare you for the Contract's boss battle at the end of the level. Power-ups can increase movement speed, spread-shot bullets, fire rate, and much more!

Sub-Contracts will have you taking on smaller challenge levels with a variety of objectives. Earn all 3 stars in each and get rewards!

Multiple playable characters , all with unique play styles. Some are focused on pure shoot'em up gameplay, others centered around melee attacks. If you're having trouble on a level, sometimes trying out a new character is the key!

games.name: DRUDGE
games.shortDescription: You are a slave. A collar with three lights hangs around your neck: each one fades and shocks you for mistakes or disobedience. Your life is quotas: sorting waste, growing food, and expeditions into lower levels with zombies. Earn, unlock passages, buy gear, and seek a path to freedom.

games.name: Overbowed
games.shortDescription: Explore a kingdom overrun by evil magic as you fight foes with your own magical bow in this retro inspired action-adventure platformer.
games.aboutText:
The kingdom on the sea was once peaceful. But magic has since taken over the land, and only fools or followers of the Dark Sorcerer remain among the ruins. You arrive somewhat forgetful, but your purpose is clear: explore the once thriving kingdom, and fight your way past the servants of dark magic!

Equipped with a magic bow, in Overbowed you'll explore ruins and the dangerous foes that inhabit them. This Game Boy inspired game features a vast interconnected world, collectible items, fluid combat and platforming, and more! Controller support makes for a responsive and engaging gameplay experience.

Your journey will take you through derelict city ruins, overgrown caverns, flooded dungeons, and other perilous paths. Much has changed since you disappeared. However, the past will only become clearer the deeper you travel into these dark places. Uncover the kingdom's secrets in Overbowed .

games.name: Ghost Network : Dark Hacker
games.shortDescription: Hack your way up Neon City's underworld. Take contracts from 8 fixers, crack networks from the terminal or run them in a 3D dive, script your own hacks, steal the data and jack out before the trace finds you. A full single-player career.
games.aboutText:
Neon City never sleeps, and every door is a contract.

Ghost Network: Dark Hacker is a cyberpunk hacking game set in Neon City, the world of the Welcome To Neon City anime. You're a new hacker with your own handle, trained by Neon Ghost, the city's most wanted ghost in the wires. Build a name in single player, then take it online against real hackers.

SINGLE PLAYER: YOUR CAREER

Start with nothing but a street rig and a handle. Take contracts from fixers, break into networks, steal what's worth stealing and get out before the trace finds you. Every job pays, and every mistake follows you home.

- 8 fixers, each with their own clients, their own kind of work and their own side-job chains. Earn their trust and they hand you harder jobs and bigger payouts.

- 50+ job types: data grabs, record wipes, camera loops, message intercepts, identity scrubs, forged papers and full network break-ins.

- 12 security tiers, from a single device and corner shops to clinics, banks, police, military, corporate towers and the city's CORE.

- Live hacks: crew jobs where the clock is running and there's no second try.

- Heat and REP: every faction remembers what you did. Clean jobs build your name. Sloppy ones bring the NCSD to your door.

- Before every job you plan the run, and you're told if you're missing the kit for it.

TWO WAYS TO HACK

Terminal hacking. Hack like it's real. Scan the network, move node to node, crack firewalls, run your programs, pull the data and wipe the logs, all from the command line. The network map shows every move you make.

3D runner dive. Jack in and run it. Race through the network in 3D, hop traps, duck lasers, slip past firewalls and fire programs on the move while ICE hunts you down.

Same jobs, same rules, same stakes. Pick the way you play, job by job.

WRITE YOUR OWN SCRIPTS

GhostNet Script lets you write real automated hacks in a Python-style language. Build scripts that scan, crack, pull and clean up for you. Save them, refine them and build a toolkit that's yours alone.

SECURITY THAT FIGHTS BACK

Firewalls you have to crack the right way, Watchdogs on patrol, Hunters that chase you down, Scramblers, Blackouts and lethal countermeasures that burn your deck. Every network is different, and the deeper you go, the harder it bites.

EVERY FILE IS REAL

Every file you steal can be read: emails, chat logs, staff files, camera stills, voicemails. Read them closely. Codes and clues in one job open up the next, and some secrets are bigger than the contract you were paid for.

BUILD YOUR DECK AND YOUR SKILLS

- Decks from street rigs through consumer, professional, military and illegal custom builds, upgraded part by part.

- 15 programs: Icebreaker, Cloak, Hammer, Mapper, Decoy, Seal, Siphon, Backdoor, Spoofer, Sniffer, Logwiper, Worm and more.

- A 40-skill tree to shape the hacker you want to be: quiet, fast or brute force.

- Upgrade your den and shop the black market for exploits and gear.

GHOSTOS, YOUR HACKER DESKTOP

Everything runs through GhostOS. Boot your cyberdeck, take contracts, read your messages, study the city map, shop the black market and plan the job before you go in. Need practice? The LAB lets you train every command and technique on networks of every size.

MULTIPLAYER: FREE UPDATES AFTER LAUNCH

After launch, free updates bring online play to Neon City, with no servers needed. Everything you learn in single player carries over. The opponent is just human now.

- Den raids: hack other players' dens, online or offline. Build your defenses or wake up robbed.

- 1v1 duels: one attacks, one defends. Ranked, with seasons.

- Team modes: King of the Node, Capture the Data, Bounty Hunt and Worm Race.

- Crew wars: 5v5 network battles over territory, with a player market and world events.

PLAY YOUR WAY

- Terminal hacking or the 3D runner dive.

- Job guides you can turn on when you're stuck, and off when you're not.

- Steam achievements.

- Controller support and fully customizable controls.

- Accessibility options: color-blind palettes, UI scale, reduced motion, dyslexia-friendly font.

games.name: ZERO Sievert
games.shortDescription: Now with over 600,000 copies sold, ZERO Sievert is a tense top-down extraction shooter that challenges you to scavenge a procedurally-generated wasteland, loot gear, and explore what’s left of a devastated world. When the odds are stacked against you, you’ll need to do more than just survive...
games.aboutText:
Thank you for over 600,000 copies sold!

Half a million players have stepped into the radioactive ruins, scavenged for precious loot, and fought tooth and nail to make it out alive. That number represents not just sales, but stories. Thousands of extraction runs, loadouts tested, factions faced, and unforgettable moments of survival and chaos.

For those who are making runs into the radioactive wasteland, THANK YOU! And for those of you thinking if you should join them, well, I know 600,000 reasons why you should...

Happy hunting...

The world has ended. ZERO Sievert charges you with scavenging equipment across multiple areas, all set in an atmospheric fictitious post-apocalyptic Eastern Europe setting. Your base of operations, the bunker, is filled with traders, modding stations, and areas to make your own, providing you with progression across your excursions into the wild.

Once you’re out in the wilds of the wasteland, however, the situation becomes a lot less secure. Across the six biomes of the game, you’ll initially be armed with little more than a gun and a bottle of water, after which point it’s up to you to recover items, take out bandits, and most importantly, get back alive.

And be warned ; the nuclear fallout may have impacted some of the local wildlife…

Learn To Survive, Fast

With a complete new hunter experience, our tutorial takes you (loosely) by the hand and equips you with the knowledge, skills and guns you'll need to to survive and thrive in the world of ZERO Sievert.

A Wasteland to Explore

Procedurally generated maps make every journey different, with ever-changing hiding spots, loot locations, weather, and layouts. With six maps to explore, be sure to adapt and learn each one's secrets to get in, get out, and get better.

Full Weapon Modification

Hunt in a way that suits your playstyle, with over 50 unique guns and 150 mods that can be combined to make you the biggest threat in the wastes of ZERO Sievert. Create a weapon that suits your style or focus on stats to become the ultimate hunter.

Maximise Your Gear and Skills

As you survive the harsh wasteland you’ll gain experience, sharpening your skills and unlocking new ways to become a deadly hunter. The Weapon Skill System allows you to level up various weapon types, boosting stats such as reload speed, damage, movement speed, and even unlocking unique perks tailored to each weapon. Beyond weapon XP, you can level-up your hunter with unique perks to help navigate the wasteland, tackle tough challenges, and take on more enemies.

Choose your Faction

In Zakov you’ll encounter The Green Army, a group dedicated to maintaining law and order, or the Crimson Corporation, a global pharmaceutical and technology giant. As a hunter you can choose a faction, earn reputation, unlock unique faction quests, and collect special, high-tier loot to aid you in your journey throughout the wasteland!

Looting and Questing

Multiple questlines guide you through the world of ZERO Sievert. Through talking with a range of characters you’ll slowly unravel information and lore about the world that’s been left behind. Alongside this, there are more than 100 different items to loot which can be used to craft new items, upgrade your own base, and trade.

Modding & Steam Workshop

The Steam Workshop offers all new ways for you to experience the post-apocalyptic world of Zakov. Dive into a wide range of game changing mods that introduce new weapons to your arsenal, factions for you to work for, NPC’s to discover, quests, languages, and much more.

games.name: The Wolf Is Dead
games.shortDescription: The Wolf is Dead is a murder mystery game. When the Big Bad Wolf is found murdered at a party for his biopic, you're called in. Interrogate suspects, investigate the scene of the crime and use this to travel back in time and reconstruct the events of the evening. Who killed Alexander Wolff?
games.aboutText:
Detective work is never easy. When the body of Alexander Wolff is found floating face down in the pool at a party for the film about his life, there's only one man for the job.

You. It's you.

You’re going to need an edge and that cool tie isn’t enough.

Thank God they partnered you with Maxwell. His manners are questionable, but he can see all of space and time so it’s easy to forgive the little things.

With the right information and some light encouragement, Max will take you back to the exact moment you’re looking for.

You can’t just walk into a mob boss’ house. But the murder got you some breathing room and the Chief has made a deal. You've got one night to investigate the house.

It’s a gorgeous mansion. Eighteen rooms. A three-storey fish tank. A garage larger than your entire apartment and a pool overlooking the coast.

And they say crime doesn’t pay.

9 suspects, one evening. What did they do? What secrets are they hiding?

They’re not just gonna tell you, that’s for sure.

Interrogate, cross reference, or just wildly accuse them with no proof. You’re the detective, after all.

games.name: Love, Ghostie
games.shortDescription: Become a wholesome ghost matchmaker and grow relationships between the manor’s residents! Gift items to lift their spirits, set them up on dates, and watch love bloom! Discover cute romances with a unique story between every pair of residents! How will love blossom in your manor?
games.aboutText:
Love, Ghostie is a cozy management game with tons of wholesome romance! As a cute ghost in a manor, it's your job to set up residents and help them find love!

What romances will you create?

A single playthrough will be 3-6 hours depending on how much you want to spend experimenting with different couples versus immediately pairing the couples you want. You can pair up 6 couples per playthrough, which requires playing at least 11 times in order to see all the content available!

Features

♥ Create any romance you want - every resident is shippable with every other resident!

♥ Learn about each resident’s unique personality - read through their diary and give them gifts to discover what they love most!

♥ Resurrect some joy in a stranger’s life - set residents up on (not-so) secret dates, help decorate their rooms, and send them on tasks to lift their spirits!

♥ Help someone find their BOO - as residents get closer to each other, you’ll unlock adorable relationship scenes. Every pair of residents has their own unique story!

♥ Play with people's hearts - unlockable minigames deepen resident relationships and boost resident happiness!

♥ Large combination of couples - with a total of 12 residents, discover 66 combinations of couples with unique storylines!

♥ Take your matchmaking to the next level - unlock minigames, manor upgrades, ghostie hats, and more!

♥ New Game+ - not done matchmaking? The memories board retains the dates and relationship talks you’ve unlocked from previous runs. Other New Game+ features help you progress relationships faster!

games.name: Sorry We're Closed
games.shortDescription: Sorry We're Closed is an eccentric story-driven survival horror game about demons, angels and what happens when both sides collide. A mix of classic fixed-camera exploration and arcade-style shooting where Michelle must use her Third Eye to see between worlds, uncover secrets and solve puzzles.
games.aboutText:
Sorry We're Closed is a fusion of nostalgic survival horror with a new perspective on combat, combining atmospheric environments with fixed-camera angles and the thrill of arcade-style first person shooting. Collect items and manage resources to help Michelle survive. Optional tank controls are available for those who enjoy the classic survival horror experience.

ECCENTRIC NEON SURVIVAL HORROR

Follow the final days of Michelle as she battles to break the curse placed on her by a powerful archdemon looking for love. Help (or hinder!) the lives of the curious residents in Michelle’s bustling London borough as she pursues freedom from her own untimely demise.

Michelle’s time is split between the perilous demon world and mingling with the locals on her residential street. Everyone is battling their own inner demons and through Michelle you can help guide them. Multiple endings are available through RPG-style dialogue interactions with the extravagant cast.

SNAP YOUR FINGERS AND OPEN YOUR THIRD EYE…

Michelle gains the power of the Third Eye, allowing her to peer between worlds and learn about the hidden denizens in her neighbourhood. Peel away the boundaries to uncover secret identities and solve puzzles.

The Third Eye will be Michelle’s strongest tool while battling her most threatening adversaries - especially in boss encounters! It can expose a demon’s weak points to deal maximum damage. Take enemies down with perfect weak point combos to charge up for the ultimate shot.

A WORLD OF ANGELS AND DEMONS

Thrust into a world of celestial beings, you can follow Michelle’s story as she battles to break the curse placed on her by a powerful demon looking for love. See what it means to be an angel or a demon, and what happens when they mix.

With multiple endings to discover, influence Michelle’s fate as the choices you make will open new opportunities to avoid or embrace the allure of the archdemon. Is there a right or a wrong? The more Michelle meddles, the more the lives of those around her change too. She’s not the only one whose fate can change.

If Michelle can brave the demon world, and keep her Hellhound pistol loaded, she might find a way to reclaim her destiny.

games.name: Guns Undarkness
games.shortDescription: A command battle JRPG by Shoji Meguro, known for scoring and directing on the “Persona” and “Shin Megami Tensei” series. The adventure takes place in a near-future world on the brink of destruction. Become a member of the private military company BTI's Alpha Team, and carry out grueling missions.
games.aboutText:
A strategy JRPG helmed by lead developer Shoji Meguro (composer for the Persona and Shin Megami Tensei series’).

Customize your arsenal of unique firearms to dominate the battlefield and forge relationships with your team to bolster your combined abilities during intense turn-based combat.

・A turn-based tactical JRPG inspired by games like Metal Gear Solid and Persona

・A relationship system that boosts the protagonist as you grow closer with your teammates

・A story set in a futuristic world on the verge of global and societal ruin

・A meeting of the minds Shoji Meguro (Persona, Shin Megami Tensei), Ilya Kuvshinov (Ghost in Shell: SAC 2045, The Wonderland), and Lotus Juice (Persona Series)

The year was 2045 and humanity was in a state of abeyance that allowed technology to flourish, but deepened the social divide between the rich and the poor, the Haves and the Have Nots.

Within the ranks of the latter grew a faction who planned the Great Reset–an event steeped in primitivism that would change the course of humanity.
