- Descend and explore the long-abandoned dungeons that hide secrets of the island.

- Show off your culinary skills by cooking flavourful dishes.

What drew attention of the command to this planet? Is this really a paradise island, or is its allure merely a deceptive facade?

Get to know your new friends better and find the one who really holds a threat to everyone.

games.name: HEART ABYSS
games.shortDescription: Heart Abyss is a brutal action-platformer inspired by Japan during the 17th and 18th centuries. Wake up your inner beast and take vengeance on those who put a collar around your neck. Find your sister and uncover the mystery behind the disappearance of all jinkos.
games.aboutText:
You are a half-human, half-fox, the legendary Jinko, whose ancestors once saved the human Empire from an invasion of Yokai demons. Your name is Leon, and all you remember are the walls of the cage you were imprisoned in by humans.

But now, the collar is destroyed.

The Heart Abyss combat system is sharp and bloodthirsty, just like its main character. He needs to be in the thick of battle at all times to rip health from enemies and replenish energy for magical abilities. The KEY is not to stand still!

Thanks to his heritage, Leon possesses an impressive reserve of Qi energy. Rain lightning down on your enemies' heads, shoot them with deadly energy, and... who said foxes can't create a small singularity?

Visit various corners of the Empire – from the majestic Capital to the Temple of Death, lost amidst snowy mountains. Meet interesting people and mythical creatures from Japanese folklore. Tear them to shreds (if they are warriors of the Empire).

With Leon, immerse yourself in the aesthetics of Japanese folklore, ancient temples, and Yokai demons. Here, bloody katana battles coexist with delicious ramen, torii gates, and blooming sakura.

A hundred years have passed since the invasion of the Yokai demons. The Human Empire oppresses all other magical beings, and the legendary Jinko have not been seen for many years.

Leon must uncover the reason for his people's disappearance and, perhaps, save the Empire once again. Or, conversely, plunge it into the abyss of chaos.

games.name: Cryptid Farm
games.shortDescription: Cultivate a thriving farm to survive in this peaceful horror farming game! Play online with up to 16 players in the same lobby. Work together with your fellow farmers to repair your tractor and escape the farm, try not to fall victim to the eerie and mysterious creatures that lurk nearby.
games.aboutText:
A “peaceful” farming experience for you and your friends…

Cryptid Farm is a tense horror experience where you'll take care of your patch of land, growing crops from scratch and attempting to survive the mysterious happenings on the farm. Singleplayer or multiplayer, everyone shares a single farm space where they'll work together (or against each other) to grow their produce and use those funds to ultimately escape the farm.

Your main farming routine will involve planting, watering, harvesting, and then refilling your watering can at the corners of the field. You'll have access to a range of 8 different crops to try growing, each with unique looks and attributes. Progress your farming ability over time with upgrades that will allow you to manage bigger and larger farms.

There’s something moving out there. Is it after your crops… or after you?

Keep an ear out and stay alert, prepare yourself for any sign of danger. The farm is often visited by a variety of dangerous creatures which can pose a threat at any time, each hunting in a unique way. It’ll be up to you to pay attention to their behaviours and pick up on tips to help you survive. However, don't rely on patterns as the farm is brimming with unpredictable events that will surprise even the most steadfast worker.

Cryptid Farm is designed with multiplayer in mind and features online multiplayer for up to 16 players per room, perfect for any friend group or public server. The game uses Photon Networking and the Photon Cloud as it's server system. It can also be played singleplayer for those willing to brave it alone.

Do you think you can escape from Cryptid Farm?

games.name: Plan B: Terraform
games.shortDescription: Terraform a lifeless rock into a lush and habitable world. Build trucks, trains, and sprawling factories on an enormous hexagonal planet. Grow its population to millions. Enjoy a dynamic simulation of atmosphere, temperature, water, and forests.
games.aboutText:
Transform a Barren World into a Thriving Planet

Plan B: Terraform is a calm and contemplative sci-fi simulation game set in a near future where humanity must look beyond Earth for survival. Your mission: shape a newly discovered planet into a habitable world. Explore a vast, hex-based terrain with over a million tiles and harness a full ecosystem simulation.

Shape Climate, Water, and Life

Raise global temperatures with greenhouse gas generators, unlock underground ice to form flowing rivers and vast oceans, and restore vegetation across the land. Experience dynamic weather systems, including evaporation, wind patterns, and rainfall. Turn a lifeless rock into a living world covered in forests, rivers, and oceans.

Build Supply Chains and Grow Cities

Extract minerals, manufacture goods, and move them with trucks, trains, drones, and ships. Establish automated supply lines to support expanding cities, transforming small outposts into thriving metropolises with populations in the millions. Every stage of growth depends on your ability to manage logistics, optimize infrastructure, and keep automation running smoothly.

games.name: I Wani Hug that Gator!
games.shortDescription: I Wani Hug that Gator! Is a choice-driven narrative about teenagers struggling to find their way. Help Inco, loser highschooler extraordinaire, navigate his budding friendships (and romance!) while surviving being the only human in a dinosaur-filled school.
games.aboutText:
Wait, what do you mean we’re moving?!

Just great; just when Inco was getting ready to move on into his Senior year, his parents decide to uproot his life and move half-way across the country!

Guess it’s time to start all over. Sure, Inco didn’t have many friends (or any) back at his old school, and sure, he was so low on the social ladder that he had to get a deep-sea diving lesson…. Wait, why was he complaining about moving again?

I Wani Hug that Gator is a multi-ended, choices-matter visual novel about second chances and the power of accepting who you are. Shape how Inco makes the most of his final year, and how the relationships he makes along the way will develop. One relationship in particular has him feeling all fuzzy inside… The Prehistoric Romance a Million-and-One Years in the making!

If there’s one good thing to come out of Inco’s sudden relocation, it’s Olivia. Bold and brash, Olivia seems particularly gifted in getting under Inco’s skin. No matter how Inco slices it, he and Olivia seem destined to go together like a particularly scaly sandwich. But the outcome of such a pairing is yet to be determined… Wait, am I being graded on this?!

Make friends, reconcile enemies, and figure out how Inco could possibly repair his miserable excuse for a social life. But be warned: The choices you make expands the relationships with Inco’s classmates and determines which of the four unique endings you receive. Maybe Inco should’ve spent a little less time studying and a bit more time learning how to relate to people…

games.name: Dream Tactics
games.shortDescription: Dream Tactics is a GBA-styled strategy RPG with cunning card combos and deep character customization. Pick your party, manage cards to create unique playstyles, and outsmart hordes of pillows in turn-based combat to save the Dream World from its inevitable collapse.
games.aboutText:
Ready your decks, pick your party, and prepare for battle! Innovating on the tactical RPG genre, Dream Tactics delivers rich character customization, strategic combat, and tactical card combos to explore.

The Dream World is in peril! It is up to our unlikely hero, Neru, to assemble a formidable team to defeat Dream Eater and save the world from its imminent collapse.

The only problem? Neru may have slacked a bit on learning Reverie, the magic of the Dream World, and is almost out of time until its destruction!

- Over 100 Cards to Choose From! Cards are key to combat in Dream Tactics. Each character can play multiple cards a turn allowing you to perform devastating combos.

- New Turns Mean New Opportunities! Each turn, every character draws a completely new hand of cards to play. This provides you with a fresh selection of resources to utilize every turn.

- Overcome the RNG! Spend points to redraw cards and create the perfect hand right when you need it!

- Pillows Galore! During your adventure in the Dream World, expect to find all sorts of fluffy foes - but do not let their cuddly appearance fool you! These pillows are ready for battle and are sure to make the sharpest tactician think twice.

- Play Your Way! Find cards along your journey and use them to build decks for each one of your characters.

- Trade Cards Between Characters! Build unique play styles by trading cards between allies. Any character can use any card!

- Equip as Much as You Can Afford! Characters will be able to equip more items as they level up but each item has a cost - so balance your inventory strategically!

- Find Others to Join Your Cause! Along your journey, you will find a variety of allies who will accompany you on your quest.

- With Allies Come Options! Each ally you find brings a unique array of cards for you to weave into your strategy. Choose up to 4 party members to bring into battle which suit your tactics best.

- Venture Off The Grid! Forged by dreams themselves, the islands of the Dream World offer treasures for those willing to search. But watch out for the dangers that may get in your way!

- Use The Terrain to Your Advantage! The landscape of the Dream World offers plenty of options to outmaneuver your opponent. But don’t be caught sleeping - they can do the same to you!

- Meticulously Crafted With Love! Enjoy the beautifully surreal landscape of the Dream World. Inspired by the classics of the GBA era, Dream Tactics is our tribute to the greats that came before us.

games.name: Light Odyssey
games.shortDescription: Light Odyssey is a soulslike boss rush where every battle is a test of mastery. Play as Bandi and fight to restore light to a world consumed by shadows. Face off against towering colossi in three deadly phases that demand precision, patience, and adaptation.
games.aboutText:
When Light Fades, What Remains?

Play as Bandi, the last spark of light, in a universe consumed by shadows. With the darkness ever-increasing, you find yourself on the last remaining planet where a faint flicker of light draws near. Guided by its warmth, you set out on a journey to restore light to the universe.

A Fight for the Universe’s Survival

Towering and relentless, the Colossi stand between you and your goal. These stone-cold titans of annihilation will stop at nothing to extinguish your fading light. To them, you were never meant to exist. To them, you are a mistake they must correct.

Evolving Battles, Endless Challenge

Light Odyssey is a soulslike boss rush where you face each Colossus in three deadly phases. Fight for the universe’s survival as each phase brings new attacks, new patterns, and new stakes. Learn, master, and adapt as the darkness creeps up on you in total silence.

Uncover the Secrets of a Lost World

Between fights, explore the ruins of a long-lost civilization. Solve ancient puzzles, decipher cryptic messages, and uncover the true origin of the Colossi. Each discovery will pull you deeper into the history of a world that once knew light—and the price paid to keep it.

games.name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
games.shortDescription: Lead the members of Expedition 33 on their quest to destroy the Paintress so that she can never paint death again. Explore a world of wonders inspired by Belle Époque France and battle unique enemies in this turn-based RPG with real-time mechanics.
games.aboutText:
Once a year, the Paintress wakes and paints upon her monolith. Paints her cursed number. And everyone past that age turns to smoke and fades away. Year by year, that number ticks down and more of us are erased. Tomorrow she’ll wake and paint “33.” And tomorrow we depart on our final mission - Destroy the Paintress, so she can never paint death again.

We are Expedition 33.

Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is a ground-breaking turn-based RPG with unique real-time mechanics, making battles more immersive and addictive than ever. Explore a fantasy world inspired by Belle Époque France in which you battle devastating enemies.

In this evolution of JRPGs, real-time actions enhance the heart of turn-based combat. Craft unique builds for your Expeditioners that fit your playstyle via gear, stats, skills, and character synergies. Open an active dimension in combat - dodge, parry, and counter in real time, chain combos by mastering attack rhythms, and target enemy weak points using a free aim system.

With only one year left to live, join Gustave, Maelle, and their fellow Expeditioners as they embark upon a desperate quest to break the Paintress’ cycle of death. Follow the trail of previous expeditions and discover their fate. Get to know the members of Expedition 33 as they learn to work together against impossible odds.

Explore an enchanting realm populated by surreal adversaries. Wander through breathtaking landscapes, from the Island of Visages to the Forgotten Battlefield, discovering secrets and hidden quests along the way. Find allies of fortune in creatures of legend. Recruit special companions to access new travel methods and discover secret areas in the World Map.

Experience the debut game from Sandfall Interactive, fully realized in Unreal Engine 5 with stunning graphics and a heartbreaking soundtrack.

games.name: Absolum
games.shortDescription: Fight as the outcast heroes of Talamh in a fierce battle to retake magic from Sun King Azra’s grasp in Absolum, an original roguelite beat ‘em up by Dotemu.
games.aboutText:
Crafted with passion by the dream team that redefined side-scrolling beat 'em ups, Absolum mixes top-of-the-class combat action with modern roguelite elements, bringing all the vibes of the fantasy arcade hits of the past into an immersive adventure set in the original world of Talamh .

Talamh has been shattered by a magical cataclysm caused by ambitious wizards, leaving magic mistrusted by the common folk. Sun King Azra took advantage of this panic, enslaving wizards through his Crimson Order and placing loyal princes to rule over the conquered realms.

As Azra’s forces claim more and more lands, the high enchantress Uchawi and a small group of rebels rise from the shadows, wielding forbidden magic to challenge his oppressive regime and defy his absolute magic power.

Meet the outcast heroes of Talamh, each with their unique fighting style.

From the shadows of Yeldrim, Galandra emerges as an unstoppable force of nature. Her colossal sword strikes with deadly precision, combined with chilling, destructive necromantic powers. Her calm demeanor is a thin veil, barely concealing the furious anger brewing inside her.

Karl is the last free dwarf of Talamh. Armed with an ancestral blunderbuss and his bare fists, he’s a master of close-range brawls and explosive tactics. What he lacks in reach at mid-range, he makes up for with raw strength and quick thinking, making him a stalwart ally in the revolt against Azra's oppression.

During their ordeals, two mysterious heroes will join them on a quest to overthrow the Sun King: Brome , a wizard prodigy on a mission to preserve the future generations of his people, and the enigmatic Cider , a nimble skirmisher in search of answers among the scattered fragments of their own soul.

Absolum combines Dotemu and Guard Crush ’s mastery in beat ‘em up gameplay with Supamonks' best-in-class art and animation. With its fast-paced action and endless replayability, Absolum will challenge you with multiple paths to explore and unpredictable encounters for a new experience each time you play.

Take down Azra’s elite guard with a mix of rapid combo chains and spellcasting powers, unleashing moves that feel as raw as they are strategic. Use magical counters and rare items to turn the tide in your favor and experience a combat system that demands skill and timing, pushing you to craft new strategies at every run to wreak havoc among the enemy ranks.

Lead the uprising against Azra's regime as a lone hero, or team up with a friend on your couch or online. Combine your elemental powers and synchronize your attacks into incredible chained combos!

The world of Talamh is an intricate tapestry brimming with secrets, stories, and betrayals. From the majestic mines of Grandery to the lush forests of Jaroba, every step of your odyssey will be accompanied by a magnificent soundtrack by composer Gareth Coker (Ori, Halo Infinite, Prince of Persia), with collaborations from Yuka Kitamura (Dark Souls, Elden Ring), Mick Gordon (Doom Eternal, Atomic Heart), and more!

Controllers are required to use the local multiplayer feature.

games.name: Once Upon A Puppet
games.shortDescription: Control the strings of fate and embark on a grand adventure with Drev and Nieve. A magical, story-driven 2.5D puzzle-platformer where puppeteering mechanics and a whimsical, theater-inspired world intertwine.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Once Upon a Puppet, a 2.5D puzzle-platformer that unfolds within a vibrant world of theater. Take part in a magical tale that combines classic platforming with puppet-inspired gameplay, in a captivating story of friendship, self-discovery, and redemption.

Wear the glove of Nieve, a Stagehand exiled to the Understage, and wield control over Drev’s strings, a Puppet magically bound to her. As they journey to return to the Frontstage above, they will retell forgotten stories, uncover shadowy secrets, and learn their fate is interwoven with the kingdom of theater itself.

- Become Puppet and Puppeteer: Pull the strings and master the art of puppetry in this unique approach to action, movement, and creative puzzle-solving.

- A Troupe of Characters: Meet an ensemble cast of dozens of Major and supporting characters, featuring hundreds of lines of handcrafted dialogue.

- Deadly Shadows: Face a horde of villainous creatures who will do all they can to snuff out the lights and bring the show to an untimely end.

- A Meticulously Crafted World: Marvel at the stylized and detailed graphics and 2D cutscenes that reinforce the magic of theater, with stages that fluctuate between past and present.

- Set The Scene: Arrange and move props, backdrops and characters to rebuild theatrical stages, and re-enact scenes to unveil what befell the once proud World Stage.

- Enchanting Soundscapes: Be captivated by a rich, theatrical soundtrack and immersive sound effects that bring the world of Once Upon a Puppet to life...

- Collectibles : Observant players will find a variety of collectible surprises along the way!

Unwittingly bound together by spool and thread, Drev and Nieve reluctantly embark on a quest to reclaim their place in the theater, against a heartbroken King.

Nieve, a talented Weaver beset by self doubt, builds a strong bond with Drev, a naive yet ambitious Actor. With Drev's unbridled theatrics and Nieve's brilliance, they will conquer their deepest held fears to reveal the truth of the void harbored in their hearts.

games.name: BATTLESAGE
games.shortDescription: Fly, dash and strike to save a kingdom in peril, in this fast third- person aerial action-fantasy where movement is your only weapon. Dive into a fight, break away, keep your flow, and grow from novice flyer into a true BattleSage.
games.aboutText:
''Dive. Strike. Break away BattleSage is a third-person aerial action-fantasy where the way you fly is the way you fight, and every near-miss makes you better.''

THE LOOP

Dive into a fight, strike and break away without losing your flow. Speed, momentum and position are part of every attack. Thread fissures and skim past towers, with controller haptics that rise the closer you soar through the sky.

COMBAT

In BattleSage, speed, momentum and position are part of every attack. Dive into a fight, strike and break away without losing your flow, chaining flight and combat into one expressive loop. Every encounter, and every boss, tests how well you've mastered the air.

MASTERY

Start as a novice flyer in this easy- to-pick up, but hard-to-master, kinetic adventure. Each flight, each near-miss, and each encounter builds skill and carries into the next fight. “ How fast you earn the name BattleSage is up to you. ”

With 5 areas to climb, 30 skills to unlock and a flight model that rewards every journey, there’s always a tighter line to find.

THE WORLD

Soar through floating villages, ruins and invader spires, where every area is built to be flown and carved through. Handcrafted in an impressionistic style, the world of BattleSage is painted to be seen at speed.

JOIN THE FLOCK

Follow development and sign up for playtests on our Discord.
Thanks!

games.name: Badger Tactics
games.shortDescription: You stole and lost your sister's favorite figurines. Get them back or face her wrath! Fight, collect, and track down the missing figures before SHE finds you. In this retro turn-based tactical RPG, your fate is decided by the roll of the dice!
games.aboutText:
Find the missing figurines!

All you wanted was to steal borrow some of your sister's figurines of the latest popular game. But somehow, you've managed to lose them. Finding them is the only way to escape her wrath! The plan is simple: play games, build your reputation, explore this world, and hope you can get your precious loot back.

Roll the Dice!

Choose your tactics wisely in turn-based battles, build your team, and unlock new figurines. The rules are simple, but the strategic possibilities are endless. It's up to you to discover the best synergies!

Grow Your Collection!

Buy and trade figurines. Try your luck at finding legendary ones in the Gachapons! Who knows, you might even stumble upon the ones you've lost? And if your pockets are running empty, there's always a little job to pick up in Port-Marie for a few bucks!

Features

- A retro-inspired turn-based tactical game starring Badger and your buddy Rocky.

- 150 collectible figurines and 6 unique powers to discover.

- A story you can complete in just a few hours (collection fever not included).

- Handmade with human intelligence (no-AI), lots of love, and a few tears.

games.name: Deflectorium
games.shortDescription: Deflectorium: 2D sci-fi rogue-lite singleplayer. Deflect deadly shots back at your enemies to become unstoppable. With unique deflection system, you'll dominate battles while upgrading your skills and stats. Prepare for adrenaline experience where defense isn't just a tactic but an art.
games.aboutText:
Wishlist Deflectorium now . The galaxy needs you. Gameplay

Actively deflect incoming projectiles back at your enemies or spin them around yourself and throw them back. This can all be done within the deflection zone around your hero. Move freely across the arena in no time. Gravity won't bother you.
Arenas are connected to each other on a hexagonal map where a boss waits patiently at the end, opening the way to other sectors. With a new threat.

Along the way, you find various run upgrades that, to a greater or lesser extent, make the journey easier. And more fun. Resources found are perfect for permanent upgrades.

Features

- Bullet perfect game

- Instant movement by mouse

- Active deflection of enemy bullets

- Spin and release

- Permanent upgrades

- Passive run enhancements

- Special skills (curving space and time)

- Hexagonal progress map

- Boss fights

- Classes

games.name: Trinity Fusion
games.shortDescription: Three fractured realities. One collapsing multiverse. Fast, fluid combat in a dark sci-fi Roguevania where each run begins in a separate universe — then lets you fuse your parallel selves, powers, and worlds to create brutal, ever-evolving builds.
games.aboutText:
If you love tight combat, smart builds, and runs that feel wildly different every time — you’re home.

Fuse parallel characters, unlock new synergies, and tear through dark sci-fi worlds with speed, style, and precision.

A rogue-lite journey through the multiverse

The various branches of the multiverse are always changing. Fight through a combination of procedurally-generated levels as well as hand-crafted challenges and arenas that will put your skills to the test. Levels with 3D graphics are seamlessly constructed out of hundreds of custom-made rooms.

High-intensity combat

With weapons and attack systems that leverage our previous experience working on fighting games. You’ll slide, dash and dodge between enemy attacks and strike back with an arsenal of satisfying special weapons and abilities.

Three characters, three universes to explore

Each of your parallel selves has their own world with multiple biomes to explore, as well as their own sets of unique abilities and weapons. Travel through a universe of desolate wastes and caverns roamed by mutant creatures, escape the endless forges and labs of a world ruled by machines, and survive the dangerous sky cities of a post-human society.

Constant Progression

Unlock permanent upgrades in the Hub and discover new starting points for your run as you reclaim major locations in each universe. Finding yourself getting stuck in one area? Start your next run in a different one! No matter where you die, or which starting point you pick, you're making progress somewhere.

A Story That Persists Across Runs

The game’s characters and lore are crafted in collaboration with award-winning poet and sci-fi novelist Ada Hoffmann, author of The Outside , The Fallen , and The Infinite .

As the story unfolds, new starting points are unlocked across the multiverse, allowing each run to begin deeper into the journey. Even when a run doesn’t advance the narrative, players earn resources that can be invested in permanent upgrades back at the Citadel — steadily strengthening their characters, expanding their options, and ensuring meaningful progress toward the story’s conclusion.

games.name: Aftermath
games.shortDescription: The story of a soldier left alone in a bunker.
games.aboutText:
after·math [|æftərmæθ] 𝒏. A period or state of affairs following a significant event, esp. when that event is destructive or harmful.

The story of a soldier left alone in a bunker.

games.name: Slider
games.shortDescription: Slide chunks of the world to solve puzzles and help others. Control an ever-growing set of tiles and mechanics. Explore nine unique areas, unravel the mysteries of the universe, and reconnect the world -- one slider at a time.
games.aboutText:
Slider is an award-winning puzzle adventure game where the world faces cataclysm , and you must use The Artifact to solve puzzles, rearrange maps, help reconnect humanity, and, most importantly... find your cat.

- Free to play! 10+ hours of content.

- Solve tricky puzzles with a variety of mechanics.

- Explore 9 unique regions, each with their own twists.

- Cats!!!

Slide Tiles to Solve Puzzles

Use The Artifact to slide pieces of the world to your advantage, unlocking treasures and completing each area's grid. Watch as your collection of objects expands as you solve increasingly complex puzzles.

Explore 9 Unique Areas

The world is full of mysteries, with each new area presenting a unique twist on the 8-puzzle. Discover rotating environments, tactical combat, 3D grids, time travel, and more!

Help an Odd Cast of Characters

After the world has been shattered, it's up to you to reconnect everyone. Help those in need piece their lives back together.

Master Unique Mechanics

Solve puzzles of increasing complexity as your toolbox grows and mechanics build upon each other. From anchors to minecarts to buoys to lights, take control of the world around you.

games.name: Paper Perjury
games.shortDescription: It all started with a simple robbery. When that thread was pulled, a tapestry of mysteries was revealed. Solve cases and outsmart criminals in a detective story full of lies, confessions, and maybe even a murder or two.
games.aboutText:
Your first day as a police clerk... unveils a tapestry of mysteries!

You play as Justina Smith, a newly hired clerk at the Azure City Police Department, as she finds out the truth behind a series of suspicious crimes. Work with the eccentric detectives Ernest Hunt and Sophie Swift as you investigate crime scenes, interrogate suspects, and discover the secrets hidden among the paper trails. Five interconnected cases to explore!

From wealthy manors to parking garages, you'll get down in the weeds across five different cases, each with a connected narrative, as you work to expose one large mystery. Investigate Azure City's largest investment firm and expose the shady dealings they've tried their best to cover up. From robbery, to embezzlement, and even... murder!

Question the suspects... and shove the truth in their face!

As you explore the city, you'll be able to take the statements of the bystanders you come across. Review their statements carefully, as not everyone in this city is honest! When you finally catch the prime suspect, take them back to the station for interrogation, and expose their crimes! A bustling city with memorable characters and locations!

Azure City is a diverse place, teeming with all sorts of interesting characters. Explore a cast ranging from a tea-loving lawyer, a cowboy barber, a magician, and even... a cat? Each person you talk to has a wide range of dialogue for you to explore!
Collect evidence to solve the case!

Examine various crime scenes as you hunt for clues in even the most unlikely of places. Even the smallest piece of evidence could turn out to be crucial! You'll have to use logic to discover what bits of evidence you collect are useful, and which ones you need to solve whatever puzzle you're up against! Befriend a cat

The most important part of any game.

games.name: Orbit Or Beat Extended Edition
games.shortDescription: Get ready for new type of rhythm action game you may have never experienced before. Listen to various awesome music, control your ball, and dodge all the obstacles to get through all the levels. But be prepared to any unexpected and "unfair" gimmicks designed throughout the levels.
games.aboutText:
Get ready for new type of rhythm action game you may have never experienced before. Listen to various music, dodge various types of obstacles, and successfully finish playing each music to go on to the next level. Be warned, though, the more progress you make, the harder (and even impossible by the looks!) the level becomes for you to finish. How This Game Works

In each level, you will see a big circle and a small ball circling around the circle. Your main task here is to control the ball (i.e., put it either outside or inside the big circle) to dodge all the obstacles it encounters along the way and successfully finish the level. Each level is accompanied with certain background music, and it will be a lot helpful you listen to the music while playing the game since all the obstacles are positioned according to specific beats of the music.

But note that it won't be that simple; the game will do everything it can to prevent you from finishing each level. Most of the time, you will be required to "focus" on the beats and the obstacles no matter what the game does to you, such as changing the size of the circle, the position and/or speed of the ball, changing colors, and even showing off fake obstacles! Try to get through all those unfair gimmicks and eventually finish all the levels prepared just for you. Features

The game contains various minor features for you to fully enjoy it, including:

- Basic and advanced tutorial

- Key binding personalization

- Sync adjustment

- 3 selectable difficulties (easy, normal, hard) prepared for each music

- Special difficulties set for ones who are willing to go through challenge

- 20+ different music

- Online ranking system (To be implemented later)

- Remote multiplayer mode (To be implemented later)

Credits

The original version of the game was created and released by IMING via Flash in 2014. The developer of this game, GJ, sincerely thanks IMING for coming up with the idea of the original game and also for allowing the developer to create OOBEX based on the game.

games.name: Townframe
games.shortDescription: A relaxing puzzle game where you recreate towns from people's memories. These people will give you written puzzles and to solve them you'll be able to either modify the buildings or use different tools, such as one that makes wind, and many others. Each puzzle will surprise you in a different way.
games.aboutText:
In Townframe you will become a Townframer, whose task is to transform the appearance of towns according to the wishes of various clients.

Buy tools to uncover hidden things with a magnifying glass, change the wind direction in the scene, take interesting photos or listen to the soundscape of the towns to solve the little story puzzles in the world of Townframe.

And explore a world full of uniquely crafted locations and characters at your own pace.

KEY FEATURES

- Simple Controls
Play with just a mouse. Left / right mouse button for interaction and mouse wheel for zoom.

- Handmade Levels
All levels are uniquely designed to surprise you each time in a different way.

- Tiny Stories
Each character tells you a little story about their relationship to their town.

- Relaxing Music
It has a very cute and relaxing soundtrack composed by Peter Kirschstein.

- Kind & funny Characters
Many different characters that have their own personality.

- Humor
Some humor between the lines can also be found.

- Very playful and for all ages
The focus of the game is on the playful and fun experience, accessible to all genereations (reading is necessary).

- Optional Levels
You don't have to finish all puzzles to finish the game and you can also choose later on a map in which order you want to solve some puzzles.

- Perfect for a relaxing evening
The game is 2 - 3 hours long.

games.name: Prospector
games.shortDescription: Land on a distant planet in this chill resource management game. Harvest alien resources, build and automate machinery, uncover secrets across the stars and strike shipping deals with distant colonies for exclusive rewards!
games.aboutText:
Land on an alien world with nothing but your wits, your tools, and your drive to thrive. Build,

explore, and automate in this sci-fi resource management game.

From humble beginnings to a sprawling space base! Construct your base from scratch using

anything you can find - from primitive resources to unknown alien materials. Unlock

blueprints, optimize your workflow with automation, and push deeper into outer space!

Uncover the mysteries of distant worlds. From ancient relics to strange ecosystems, each

planet holds its own set of secrets.

Not every species welcomes visitors. Hostile wildlife and territorial species won’t let you

exploit their planet without a fight - have your loyal robot companion O.P.H.E.L.I.A and laser

guns at hand!

Discover colonies across the stellar system and participate in intergalactic cooperation. Aid

them, trade with them, or learn from them as you discover your place in the galaxy.

games.name: Wirm
games.shortDescription: Take a worm on a tiny adventure through this delightfully wiggly physics platformer :)
games.aboutText:
Wirm is a delightful physics climbing game about being a worm on a tiny adventure.

Use your soft squishy body to wiggle over obstacles.

Monch your way through the dirt, and find hidden objects underground.

Bring your friends and wiggle together in local multiplayer, or online through Steam's Remote Play Together !

hello there i am a wirm

come with me and watch me squirm

i would eat through dirt all day

climb rock, find shell, that's how we'll play

bring your friends — they'll be wirms too!

nice day for me and fun for you

:)

games.name: Escape From Mandrillia: Local Asymmetric VR+PC
games.shortDescription: Local VR+PC horror: as a VR player, escape an underground facility full of giant alien monkeys. Up to 2 PC players can help you out controlling friendly drones... or crush you by playing as the enemy Mandrillians.
games.aboutText:
Escape from Mandrillia is a local asymmetric VR + PC horror game. A single player using the VR headset takes the role of a robot escaping an underground facility full of alien apes known as the Mandrillians. Up to 2 players at the computer can either help the VR player fight the Mandrillians, or control the Mandrillians themselves.

VR vs PC LOCAL ASYMMETRIC HORROR

VR GAMEPLAY

On the VR side, the gameplay is a survival horror/stealth shooter.

- Evade the Mandrillians, or face them -just remember the odds are against you!

- Use your battery-powered Multitool to cloak, detect nearby enemies, or stun them if things get hairy.

- Search for any weapon you can get your hands on -there's over 20 unique weapons, from conventional firearms to flamethrowers, crossbows, chainsaws and more!

- Progress by locating keycards and solving minigames to open new sections until you can finally escape

- In coop mode, maintain, repair, and reload your drone allies

PC GAMEPLAY

The PC players control either the Mandrillians or friendly combat drones.

- Use your monkey senses to track down the VR player

- Augment your abilities with cybernetic military upgrades

- Quickly move around the map using the air vents

- Psychologically torture the VR player like a true apex predator

- Alternatively, join forces with the robot and fight the Mandrillian enemies

CUSTOMIZE YOUR EXPERIENCE

Match modifiers let you tweak every single parameter in the game: HP values, the way the PC players respawn, loot styles/progression, monster weakpoint calculations...

The included Match Presets are pre-curated clusters of match modifiers you can instantly apply. Think the PC players need a bit of an advantage? Use Mandrillian Bias . Or if you feel too overwhelmed, go for Robot Bias . Maybe you want a full survival horror experience where you start with no weapons and the monsters are almost indestructible? Horror Mode is for you. Or maybe you just want to unwind and let endless hordes of Mandrillians come at you and mow them down with heavy weaponry: Super Soldier got you covered.

You can mix and match all these settings and presets with no restrictions -sky's the limit!

PLAY WITH YOUR ONLINE FRIENDS USING STEAM REMOTE PLAY

Don't want anybody getting their filthy hands on your expensive computer? Not a problem! With Steam Remote Play, you are one invite away from playing with any of your Steam friends!

games.name: Eternal Remnant
games.shortDescription: Dive into the unforgettable tale of two siblings on the run in this emotional RPG journey. With only their wits and a cursed power too dangerous to control, they must fight, explore and scavenge to survive in an unfamiliar world. Will their bond be strong enough to endure the road ahead?
games.aboutText:
Join Arin and Vera, two siblings being hunted for carrying an unspeakable secret, as they start a perilous journey across the continent to the shining city of Sunspire - their only hope of salvation. Guide a memorable cast of characters and help them fight for their lives in this classic-style fantasy RPG adventure that you won't soon forget.

"I just need you to trust me."

- Enjoy a narrative-driven experience that is in equal parts heartwarming as it is breathtaking

- Fast and breezy combat with characters teaming up to unleash dazzling combo attacks

- A visually stunning adventure with a mix of blended environments and pixel art

- A world ripe for exploring, packed with treasure and a variety of fearsome foes

Eternal Remnant is a fluid experience from beginning to end, one which keeps the story moving and the gameplay evolving throughout your journey, and will leave you wanting more.

Conquer the past. Fight against darkness. Find your destiny.

games.name: sobosuba
games.shortDescription: sobosuba is a merge game with ultra-squishy soft-body physics. Satisfying and relaxing -but strategy, tricks, and skill matter for chasing high scores.
games.aboutText:
sobosuba is a merge game with ultra-squishy soft-body physics. Mostly satisfying and relaxing with no explicit time pressure -but strategy, tricks, and skill matter if you want higher scores.

Launch blobs softly to carefully position without disturbing others, or launch fast to push and squeeze through tight gaps.

Achievements and online leaderboard. Some achievements require different ways of playing.

Unlockable color styles with every achievement.

Trailer music credit: James Tubbritt (Sharp) / FXhome (CC BY 3.0)

games.name: Love In a Bottle
games.shortDescription: Ankora the Love Demon only has a month to prove she can make it on her own! Can she settle down and find love?!
games.aboutText:
GxG, Dating Sim/Point and Click, Fantasy

Ankora the Love Demon is tired of living underground in the shadows of her successful siblings, so she's decided to move up in the world and get an apartment in the Coral Sea Vivariums, an underwater series of domes populated by creatures of all kinds. She has a limited amount of time to prove she's able to make it on her own, but more importantly, there are HOT SINGLE WOMEN all over town, and she wants to make her presence (and availability) known to them. Can she adjust to a new place and find love before time is up?!

- Four different girls to pursue!

- Over 30 CGs to collect!

- A lively town to explore with something different happening every day!

- Beautiful original soundtrack by jaxcheese with guest tracks from hazel!

- Cosmetics to unlock for Ankora!

games.name: Calcium Chaos
games.shortDescription: Calcium Chaos is a casual Twin-Stick Roguelite that takes you on a journey by train to confront the necromancer and her skeleton army. Get ready to explore a world filled with crazy weapon combinations and unexpected allies as you embark on an epic quest to save the world!
games.aboutText:
Skeletons are invading, and your only defense is a toaster and a chicken! Embark on a whimsical adventure through a land plagued by pesky skeletons! Uncover weird and wacky weapon synergies to fight back against the bony baddies. Along the way, you'll gather a rag-tag group of heroes who will aid you on your mission- will you have the guts to stop the necromancer's plans and save the world?

Discover an arsenal of ONE MILLION different weapon combinations, from explosive toast to homing robot chickens, and customize your loadout to suit your playstyle as you wreak havoc on your enemies.

Recruit up to four friends to join your quest to defeat the necromancer, or measure yourself by playing alone.

Transform your train into a formidable base of operations for the friends you meet along the way, buy upgrades, decorate your train, and prepare your next mission!

Dive into procedurally generated levels filled with challenges!

Test your skills and adaptability as you strive to overcome the ever-growing threats that await you.

games.name: DearMyFriend
games.shortDescription: Set off to the unknown world Stargather Land now. The shadow of chaos is shrouding here for so long, a girl from another world shoulders the responsibility of saving this land. Travel with the power of elements until the end of destiny, only fight will lead her to the finish.
games.aboutText:
DearMyFriend is a beautifully pixel-art and story-driven sandplay exploration game developed by GuluGames.

On an ordinary day, a train from another world slowly stopped outside the classroom, as if sensing the call of lonely girl.
Stepping onto the train, the light and wind of the golden continent rushed towards you, indicating the beginning of your adventure.
At this moment, you would not know your footsteps would cover every corner of the continent, and the songs in the wind would sing your name.

The golden continent filled with maple leaves, the bitterly cold valley blanketed in endless snow, the deep abyss of dark flames, or the land of civilization high above the clouds... You will wander diverse areas of the Stargather Land, weave together the ancient tales behind the continent of stars.

Of course, interspersed between these exciting adventures is your dull real life. Sometimes you have to return to your small room, but this may let you figure out what you really want.

Battle is not just about using brute force as you know. Here are some combat suggestions from Stargather Envoy:
Observe carefully and find the chance to defeating the enemy quickly;
Allocate stamina reasonably, use different elemental powers at the right time, crush your enemies with one hit.

It seems you already know this. Stargather Land never let you down.
You have chances to take on an advanced challenge after you finished the normal one.

Numerous treasures and accessories are scattered throughout the Stargather Land, where never disappoint the brave. So find them as much as possible and try to use them, which will add endless richness to your adventures!

This is a fascinating fantasy world and a gripping growth story.
On the journey, there is always a moment that makes you stop and admire.

games.name: Star Stuff
games.shortDescription: Star Stuff is a deceptively cute programming puzzle game. Program and work alongside bots to tackle the most important (and undoubtedly safest) task in the galaxy: fixing a star factory. Ready for your first day on the job?
games.aboutText:
Star Stuff is deceptively cute programming puzzle game for curious minds of all kinds. Join Mija, a brand-new star engineer, as they take on over 150 mind-bending factory puzzles.

Looks cute, right? Making stars isn’t as easy as you might think, but you aren’t alone! Your work in the factory is supported by a variety of bots with many different capabilities. Some bots are able to lift heavy objects, and some can solve complex problems with lasers - which is a pretty enviable skill. Just make sure you keep your goggles on.

Once you’ve programmed your bots, join in on the manual labor fun! Unlike most automation and programming games, you have to work in sync with your bots from time to time. It’s a team effort here at the Star Stuff factory in order to get those stars made. If at first you don’t succeed, brush off that stardust and try, try again.

The star factory is extremely forgiving and you won’t even get fired. You can always reset, undo, and try puzzles over and over again. You can take breaks in this whimsical atmosphere with a stellar soundtrack. And remember, it’s only been 32,767 rotations since the last major incident. You can help maintain that record!

Key Features:

- Exercise your brain. Automating bots is tricky, despite their whimsical appearances. Every problem is a chance to learn something new.

- Over 150 celestial levels to tease your brain with even when you’re on your mandated lunch break.

- You are part of the puzzles! Your bots can’t do this on their own - you have to pitch in sometimes to help the machines solve the obstacles they face in the star-making process.

- Simple but deep mechanics make this title accessible and family-friendly. Try playing along with a friend or family member nearby!

- Unleash your creativity as you delve into coding logic to craft your own bot programs. And don’t worry! Programming is just puzzle solving at the end of the day.

There’s a whole cosmic universe out there waiting to be built if you’re up for the challenge. Shine on!

games.name: Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy
games.shortDescription: Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy is an indie game developed by GAMEPULSE.Step into the shoes of Cirno, the Hero of Ice, as she embarks on a journey against evil, liberating Gensokyo and saving her dear princess.
games.aboutText:
Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy is a 2D bullet hell action Touhou Project fangame.

In this Boss Rush game, the player steps into the shoes of Cirno, the Hero of Ice, as she embarks on a journey against evil, liberating Gensokyo and saving her dear princess.

● High-mobility Fighting

Move freely on the battlefield and engage in exciting danmaku battles!

● Stunning Danmaku

Dodge waves of beautifully designed danmaku patterns, each with stunning yet lethal bullets!

● Custom Builds

Create your own unique builds with a plethora of curious Items and Spell Cards!

● An Epic Adventure

Experience a hilarious and entertaining adventure to rescue the princess with Cirno and other popular touhou characters!

games.name: Islands & Trains
games.shortDescription: Craft tiny railway dioramas in a stress-free island sandbox. No rules or timers - just design, build, and enjoy.
games.aboutText:
Craft your dream railway line in locomotive sandbox Islands and Trains. From pootling past a seaside village to winding a track through wintery forests, this little story is yours to tell.

Design a train route around the island of your dreams and watch your diorama come to life. Go off the beaten track, winding around mountains and crossing lakes. Place animals and edit the surrounding countryside to your liking. There’s no goals, no timers, no missions, and no mistakes - just happy accidents.

We were inspired by beloved games such as Islanders, Dorfromantik and Townscaper.

games.name: Judero
games.shortDescription: A handmade action/adventure game based on the rich folklore of the Scottish Borders.
games.aboutText:
Judero is an action/ adventure game inspired by the rich folk history of the Scottish Borders. You play as Judero, a Celt who can establish a rapport with the nature around him. Travel with Judero through a handcrafted landscape as he discovers there is an evil at work manipulating the unguarded.

- Fast and Fluid Combat. Strike, and dodge your way through a myriad of foes culminating in exciting and unique boss challenges.

- Possess Enemies. Take on the form of lesser creatures to greatly expand your abilities. Use these enchanted minions in combat and to solve puzzles.

- A Rich Text System. Discover the world of Judero through branching dialogues and pithy, aphoristic NPCs.

- Mini Games. Through your adventures you will encounter a number of diverse Mini Games with differing mechanics and visual styles. Mini games also vary the pace of the game and allow us to explore other narrative tangents.

- Rewarding Exploration. There are many secrets and discoveries to find as you roam through the world of Judero . From collectables and pick-ups to whole optional story-lines and more.

Judero is made from handcrafted objects and bespoke figurines, animated in the stop-motion tradition. For us, this art style invokes something nostalgic; in part comical but perhaps a little bit creepy too. These real life elements are then rendered into a 3D world to evoke a unique visual style. Using this style we can bring in digital techniques like real-time lighting, shaders and post-processing effects. Cutscenes will be made using traditional stop-motion animation techniques with greater fidelity to give a more cinematic quality.

The music in Judero is an homage to traditional British folk music such as those documented by Francis James Child. Many of these songs are hundreds of years old and it has been an honour researching and learning them. We are keeping instrumentation acoustic and mostly authentic to the originals (mostly) but with contemporary arrangements and harmonies. Soundtrack on Bandcamp

You can purchase the soundtrack now over on Bandcamp!

games.name: Voracity
games.shortDescription: Voracity is a relaxing industrial game. Your objective is simple: crank the generator, produce meat cubes and feed it to the monster to meet your quota. Watch your step!
games.aboutText:
The objective is simple: Feed the voracious monster living in the hole.

Monstrous Appetite

- Crank the generator, haul and drop meat cubes into the pit until the quota is met. Then buzz the button to leave.

Upgrades & Equipment

- Unlock upgrades for the generator and tools for your own disposal to speed up the work.

Watch your step

- You never quite know where you might end up.

games.name: Crystals Of Irm
games.shortDescription: Crystals Of Irm is an old school RPG with a distinctive combat system and dungeon crawl elements. With three heroes you explore Irm, visit the different regions of the land and climb deep down into the darkest dungeons.
games.aboutText:
Crystals Of Irm is the definition of an oldschool RPG. The approach combines elements of the Dungeon Crawler from a long forgotten time with a classic Overworld Map to explore you know from legends such as Ultima. That's rounded up with a combat system which is easy to learn yet hard to master. Explore with your three heroes the world of Irm and visit the many regions of the country, go deeper into the Dungeons than anyone ever before and face the grim monsters down below!

Today, only legends surround the crystals of Irm. The red crystal of the mountains - once the fire of the great forge. The blue crystal - once the symbol of the knowledge of the eternal academy. And the green crystal - once the patron saint of the endless forests. They have all disappeared from the world for too long. But there is a legend which tells that they shall be reunited. So maybe they aren't lost forever...

Every once in a while, self proclaimed heroes are trying to follow the legend to find the crystals to bring them back to where they belong. But they all failed. Most were never seen again. It is said that three Dungeons are waiting for adventurers. And each of these Dungeons shall be the home of a crystal. Will you succeed?

It's worth exploring the world of Irm. It is full of treasures and adventures for brave heroes. In the huge cities there are waiting tons of citizens with their tasks and while exploring the world map you can always rest in your camp - but always watch your back! Grab your fishing rod or go deeper into the dungeons to loot some new spells or armor you might make use of.

While doing so, you can explore an oldschool worldmap and travel through the multiple regions of Irm. When visitng important landmarks such as cities, the game switches into a first person 3D experience which awaits adventurers with its unique look. And trust us: These places are all filled with weird characters you'll fall in love with!

The heart of Crystals of Irm is the complex combat system. Once a battle starts a separated combat screen appears in which you must lead your heroes to success. The grid is waiting for you. And your mission is to keep moving. Not only to avoid the attacks of your enemies but every move also fills up your own energy to cast new spells.

That way the combat feels on the one side inspired by classic turn based battle systems but also offers the adrenalin rush modern bullet hell experiences offer. The addictive system seems to be rather easy in the beginning and can be learned pretty quickly. But the further you progress, the more chaotic (but always fair) the game fights become. That way each fight is a small challenge.

Features

- A Unique Combat System: The movement based Grid Battles are fast and made for quick fights. Every movement counts and allows the player to charge spells and attacks of their heroes. At the same time you have to dodge enemy attacks like in a bullet hell experience.

- The huge world of Irm: Like in classic roleplaying games from the past there is a huge overworld which wants to be explored. From there you can enter impressive towns and grim dark dungeons!

- Grim colorful Dungeons: As it is expected from a typical RPG the number 3 plays an important role. Three crystals. Three heroes. And of course three dark (and yet colorful) dungeons are waiting for you!

- Character Progression as it should be: Your three heroes can be equiped with new spells and armor you can find hidden all over in Irm. Collect your equipment and become stronger to face even more dangerous challenges!

- A truly unique look: Crystals of Irm combines classic Overworld Maps with First Person Dungeon Crawling elements. And this world comes along very colorful - but it's just cute at first sight. Once you meet your first Lorg you'll understand that nothing is really cute here...

games.name: Portobugia
games.shortDescription: Portobugia is a management/survival/inspection game where you manage a port and must supply a city with goods and food. To do so you must unload boats, but, be careful, some of them could be infected! You will also face difficult events, to fight them, you can upgrade, construct and research!
games.aboutText:
Portobugia is a management/survival/inspection game where you manage a port and must supply a city with goods and food. To do so you must unload boats, but, be careful, some of them could be infected! You will also face difficult events, to fight them, you can upgrade, construct and research!

What happened!?

After the First World War, Eastern Europe has fallen into chaos... Bugs are eating all the crops, spreading diseases, and bandits are everywhere... There is no government to bring peace to the region which means cities must survive by themselves...

Inspect boats!

When a boat arrives in your port, you must inspect it before unloading or refusing it. You must verify the report by looking at the boat and comparing it to the report. If you correctly verify the report you will get some rewards. But if you don't pay attention enough attention to the infection, you will have problems with bugs that will eat some of your resources!

Manage your port!

You start with a very basic port, but this port will not be enough to survive in this post-WWI world. You must quickly develop your infrastructure if you want to last (and the city to survive). Construct new buildings, upgrade the ones you already have, or research new technologies! You can also hire employees to increase your building’s efficiency, but they will ask for a daily income. And don't forget to send some resources to the city, otherwise your citizens will die!

The world will not be kind!

You will need to be ready for all sorts of events that could happen in your port! One bad shipment could spell your doom! Prepare yourself for hard times, winter will be harsh!

Scenarios!

You will have multiple scenarios to achieve! Each scenario has its own specificities! Their goals and difficulties are different! For example, in the Battleship scenario, you will need to construct a battleship using two resources only available in this scenario: Steel sheets and Oil. In the Winemaker scenario, you must produce top quality wine! To succeed, you must master the delicate harmony between soil, aging, grape variety, and wine style.

Key features

- Boat inspections: inspect boats for any insects in them before unloading them!

- Random events: you'll have to make toughs decisions to save the city!

- Buildings: expand your base and unlock new ways to survive!

- Upgrades: upgrade your buildings to improve their efficiency!

- Employees: recruit or fire employees to manage your buildings' efficiency!

- Resources management: Pay attention to your resources, the city needs daily shipments of food and goods!

- Technologies: research technologies to unlock new upgrades and buildings!

- Artifacts: search on ships for precious artifacts! Once collected, you can sell or inspect them! You can also open an exhibition to gain daily resources!

- Scenarios: discover multiple missions with their own goals and difficulties! From the harsh lands of Siberia to a vineyard in southern France, passing through a military dockyard!

- Morale: your people will go on strike if you make bad decisions! But if you lead them well, they’ll become more efficient!

games.name: Dungeons of Hinterberg
games.shortDescription: Discover the magic and lore of the Alps in this acclaimed Action Adventure. Forge relationships with locals to help you solve puzzles, battle monsters and uncover secrets of the legendary Dungeons of Hinterberg!
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Hinterberg, a new tourist hotspot in the idyllic Austrian Alps! As Luisa, you escape from the treadmill of corporate life to go on a dungeon exploring vacation. However, you soon discover that not everything is as it seems. Will you restore peace to this once-serene alpine paradise, or be sent straight back to your humdrum life back home?

Every inch of Hinterberg has been crafted with a captivating art style you’ll want to savour. Whether you’re snowboarding down a glacier, climbing mountains, or taking in the lakeside scenery, there’s so much available to explore!

Hinterberg’s dungeons are packed full of playful puzzles designed to surprise and challenge you. Get your thinking cap on and use every spell at your disposal to tackle each dungeon’s unique puzzling twist!

Monsters lurk around every corner in Hinterberg, and your sword and magic skills are essential for keeping them at bay. Harness the wind, conjure a hoverboard out of thin air, or freeze your enemies in a jelly block!

Explore the world or conquer dungeons by day, then spend your evenings forging friendships with the locals and other adventurers in town. Some will help you get stronger, while others are here strictly for the excitement and the selfies!

Stop by Olivia’s Store in town and browse through a collection of stylish outfits! Once you’re decked out in your finest, simply fire up Photo Mode where you can apply filters, poses and overlays to capture a lasting memory of your very own Luisa.

Play through the game from the very beginning while keeping your last playthrough’s inventory, stats, and the majority of your relationship perks. Whether you choose to maintain old friendships or reset their progress, how you turn back the clock is up to you.

games.name: Infinitevania
games.shortDescription: A metroidvania that combines the visual style of classic retro games with the fluid gameplay of modern titles. Explore different worlds, face challenging enemies and bosses, and absorb their powers to destroy the Core of Infinitevania.
games.aboutText:
If you're interested, be sure to Wishlist the game - that helps a lot!

Infinitevania is a 2D platformer in the metroidvania style, heavily inspired by Castlevania: Symphony of the Night and featuring elements from Hollow Knight and Blasphemous. The game focuses on combat, exploration, puzzles, upgrades, and an breathtaking story.

Explore different worlds
Defeat the most powerful creatures in these worlds, absorb their powers, and grow stronger to destroy the core of Infinitevania and return to your own world.

Face challenging enemies

Develop unique strategies to overcome them, adapting to each battle as you progress on your journey.

Solve puzzles

Tackle intriguing enigmas to unlock new areas and hidden secrets.

Survive deadly traps
Navigate treacherous environments that test your skills and reflexes at every turn.

Collect Upgrades to Become Stronger

Enhance your abilities and equipment throughout your adventure.

games.name: This is a Ghost
games.shortDescription: This is a Ghost is an FPS psychological horror and investigation game for 1 to 4 players. Track down supernatural activity, identify demonic entities using specialised equipment, and banish them with crafted ammunition in solo or online co-op!
games.aboutText:
This is a Ghost pushes ghost hunting further by combining paranormal investigation with strategic banishment mechanics. Explore haunted locations, select your equipment carefully, and face the unknown alone or as a team. You're a ghost hunter !

- Identify the entity among 23 types[/p].[/p][/*]

- Gather 8 evidence types[/p].[/p][/*]

- Reveal its behavior: vengeful, residual, or lost.

- Trap and banish the entity from 69 possibilities[/p][/*]

- 12 maps with different atmospheres and sizes.

- 3 difficulty levels and an optional challenge.

- Alone or in co-op for up to 4 players.

- Entities and behaviors have unique abilities:

- Demon : possesses a player for a few seconds by attracting them or using their weapons.

- Banshee : screams and immobilizes its victim before attacking.

- Siren : sings and drains life and energy from nearby players.

- And more

Professional equipment

- 16 tools for your investigation.

- Track activity with EMF radar up to 50m range.

- Night vision and a paranormal filter to see activity and special events.

- L.S.S., motion sensor, Bobby to reveal nearby entities.

- And more

You can protect yourself or attack

- Shield

- Incense

- Pistol, Shotgun, Burning flash

- Rune

Complete your contract

Banishing the entity is only part of the contract. You must investigate this haunting in order to gather information about the ghost .

- 3 quests

- Identity

- Year of death

- Cause of death

- Favourite room

- Bloodstain

Photographing during your investigation

- Discover 75 unique photos.

- The value of a photo depends on its rarity and the distance from which it was taken.

- Some photos are linked to specific entities, behaviours or maps.

- You can collect 12 photos per game.

- Delete your photos to take better ones.

A well-stocked photo album can pay big money!
The reputation merchant offers you the chance to buy

- New entities. You gradually unlock the content and difficulty of your contract.

- Maps.

- Equipment upgrades.

- And more

A crafting system

To banish the entity, you need to craft the right ammunition. An additive will reduce the entity's speed, strength or overall activity. The choice is yours. Statistics and SpeedRun

- Detailed statistics system.

- Speedruns are automatically recorded.

games.name: 勇者与亡灵之都
games.shortDescription: 《勇者与亡灵之都》是一款在半开放世界探索的回合制RPG游戏，游戏借鉴了NPCDream、Blacksouls等rpg，采用了ATB行动条的设定，加快了战斗的节奏和策略性。 亡灵、魔物亦或是人类，只要阻挡在你面前的尽管杀光就是。勇者就是这样的存在啊... 游戏带有多结局与二周目元素，突出一个量大管饱。
games.aboutText:
东之大地弥漫着浓雾，死者们再度苏醒。

战争，战争，无尽的战争。

现在是胜者们付出代价的时候了。

你是一位来自罗伯里亚王国的勇者，你要终结这场由【亡灵之都】凡尔顿王国带来的灾难。

或者..........这其实并不重要？

希望你能斩断这悲哀的轮回。

※win10或者win11用户在进行游戏时，可能会出现游戏速度异常的问题，可以通过进入 系统→屏幕→高级显示器设置 将选择刷新率调整为60hz解决。

※玩家交流Q群：974464175

※游戏攻略与讨论：搜索 勇者与亡灵之都吧

games.name: Bubblegum Galaxy
games.shortDescription: Bubblegum Galaxy is a cozy narrative building game about rebuilding the galaxy tile by tile. Discover and design new planets, complete missions, explore your office and befriend your co-workers... all while trying to find out who deleted the galaxy!
games.aboutText:
From the creators of Teacup, Bubblegum Galaxy is a cozy narrative building game about rebuilding the galaxy by designing planets. Relax as you create colorful planets or spend hours trying to get a perfect score! BECOME A PLANET ARCHITECT

Your small but trusty computer will allow you to design planets by placing tiles. To create efficient planets, the software will suggest missions such as connecting similarly colored tiles or a specific number of trees. Each planet has its own quirks and special rules you will have to master to do your best work yet!

BEFRIEND YOUR CO-WORKERS

In-between planet designing sessions, you'll be free to roam the office, inspect your surroundings and chat with your co-workers. Encounter hundreds of unique story events as you get to know this quirky cast of characters.

DISCOVER WHO DELETED THE GALAXY

The day you started your internship the inter-dimensional universe server crashed for "unknown reasons", deleting the entirety of the Bubblegum galaxy. If you prove your skill as a planet architect you just might find out the truth behind why the galaxy was deleted...

games.name: Another Day with You
games.shortDescription: Another Day with You is an adventure game featuring mini-games galore. Explore this quiet corner of the city - time passes as you play, whether you are talking to locals, playing hide and seek, or at the arcade. Will you leave your date waiting? Did you bring flowers? It's Another Day with You.
games.aboutText:
You have a date to make! But, it looks like you got there too early... Explore a quiet corner of the bustling city by interacting with locals, playing games at the arcade, fishing, and much more. Leave your date waiting, or fail to impress them with your natural charisma, and you'll be left on "read" .

However, walk the walk and talk the talk? You may have just secured yourself a second date!

There are many minigames to find around the city. These include fishing, playing arcade games, hide and seek, and more! The activities you choose to partake in will affect the available topics of conversations with your date. Pay close attention, as your date may have some questions for you regarding these activities.

Whether you are spending the day in the arcade or picking out flowers for your potential lover, time marches on . Spend your time wisely to get the most out of your day. If you miss out on something, there's always Another Day with You , and another chance for love.

games.name: Closer the Distance
games.shortDescription: Closer the Distance is a slice-of-life sim that tells a deeply emotional story about the connections between family and friends in the face of tragedy. Unearth long kept secrets, repair strained relationships, and help your loved ones move on.
games.aboutText:
Closer the Distance is a deeply moving, slice-of-life sim that tells a story about the connections between family and friends in the face of tragedy. Following a fatal car accident, players take on the role of Angela, a young girl from the town of Yesterby, who finds herself watching over her loved ones as they navigate the grieving process. Using her ethereal ability to influence the townspeople she once knew, Angela’s choices will ultimately determine the fate of Yesterby.

Closer the Distance combines several key gameplay features for an immersive playthrough. The game's compelling narrative is emotionally charged and highlights themes of empathy, community, friendship, grief, and closure. Choices-matter gameplay allows players to make decisions that affect the outcome of the story, making each playthrough unique. Closer the Distance offers something for everyone, and its emotional depth and engaging gameplay will leave players wanting more.

CW: Closer the Distance deals with themes of death, illness and grief

games.name: Crow Country
games.shortDescription: The year is 1990. It’s been two years since the mysterious disappearance of Edward Crow and the abrupt closure of his theme park, Crow Country. But your arrival has broken the silence, Mara Forest. If you want answers, you’ll have to venture deep into the darkness of Crow Country to find them…
games.aboutText:
A survival horror game, where you’ll test yourself against puzzles and riddles as you investigate the eerie tranquility of the abandoned theme park. Don’t be deceived by the whimsical surroundings, something is awfully wrong in Crow Country.

As you unlock new areas, backtrack and discover more, you gradually piece together why Edward really shut down his park and where he mysteriously disappeared to. You’ve heard some pretty disturbing rumors, but they couldn’t possibly be true…..right?

For visitors to the park who are more interested in spotting crows and taking in the sights, Exploration Mode allows you to journey on without the fear of being attacked by the mysterious monsters roaming Crow Country. If you knew what those monsters really are…..

Just how far would someone go to follow their ambition? Are some sins too wicked for redemption?

A tale of reckless hubris and human greed, and now at the center of it all... you.

Who are you really, Mara Forest?

games.name: CATO: Buttered Cat
games.shortDescription: Puzzle platformer where you control both the cat and the toast, based on the famous "Buttered Cat Paradox". The game features 200+ levels, 70+ skins, plus boss fights and mini-games!
games.aboutText:
- Control the cat as it runs left and right, climbs the cat scratching broad, and even slips through pipes. Hey! cats are liquid!

- Guide the toast meanwhile with the cat, as toast jumps like projectiles. Hold down and power on, and the toast will jump farther!

- When the two combine, they can trigger the paradox, taking the cat to unreachable places!

CATO: Buttered Cat revolves around the two main characters, "Cat" and "Buttered Toast." You'll need to use the interactions between them to solve various puzzles at each game level. The full game is featuring over 140 main levels and more than 60 side levels. There are also hidden rooms, challenging boss battles, and fun mini-games. The full version will include an outfit system, with 70+ Cat and Toast skins waiting for you to collect!

CATO: Buttered Cat is an adorable puzzle platformer, inspired by the buttered-cat paradox meme: Cats always land on their feet, and toast always lands buttered side down. By strapping a piece of buttered toast to a cat's back, you create a paradox that results in an infinitely spinning, floating butter-cat perpetual motion machine!

CATO will take you to a brain-teasing adventure, exploring five different worlds, each filled with unique contraptions.

Including toaster(Toast: NO!!)to buttered trampolines and speed-boasting space pipes(Cat: Meow!!). Along the way, the two will also encounter some mysterious companions to help them with puzzles.

The game is about puzzles, with a little action elements. You don't need to perform difficult platforming for most of the time; just focus on solving the puzzles. However, some pesky enemies will be standing in your way during the adventure. Your abilities will help you defeat them.

As you progress through the adventure, you'll also unlock various mini-games. Once collected, these can be installed on the gaming console in your little hideout, allowing you to play them anytime.

In the world of CATO: Buttered Cat, there are many hidden rooms that can only be accessed through secret passages. Here, you can find Easter eggs from other worlds and mysterious drop items.

Take them back to your cozy little hideout, put on your favourite outfit, and set off again!

What exactly is the cat and toast searching for? Pieces of these stories are scattered along the adventure, waiting for you to explore.

About Developer

Team Woll is made up of leading programmer Blasin and leading artist Frank, who met during the BOOOM Gamejam 2022 hosted by GCORES. The positive feedback from the Gamejam project, CATO: Buttered Cat, made us officially establish our studio.

CATO: Buttered Cat is Team Woll's first game, a labour of love that took two years to develop entirely through remote collaboration. We hope you enjoy our game! We also want to express our gratitude to all the friends who have supported us along the way. Our indie game journey has just begun!

About Publisher

GCORES PUBLISHING is an indie game publishing business established by GCORES. In the future, we will continue to bring you outstanding indie games from the BOOOM Game jam. Welcome to our publisher site for more information.

About BOOOM

The BOOOM Game jam is a game development event held twice a year, where participants are given three weeks to develop a game based on a specific theme. After the development phase, we host an online game festival where all players can try out the games, and these games are also showcased at the G-FUSION offline video game carnival.

Welcome to Our Community

Feel free to reach out to us through our community channels to learn more about our game, stay updated, or share feedback or suggestions!

- Twitter (X): @Cato_TeamWoll

- YouTube: Cato - Buttered cat paradox game

- Join our Discord!

games.name: Time Flies
games.shortDescription: Time Flies is a little adventure about our limited time in this world.
games.aboutText:
In Time Flies, you’re a fly - your life is short and your bucket list is long! Learn an instrument, read a book, become rich, get drunk, or make someone smile. And if you don’t feel like pursuing your goals, you can just relax, clean your wings, and listen to music. Make the best of the time you have left, because we’re all going to die.

Features:

- Explore a painstakingly hand-drawn, densely detailed world

- Dozens of unique and obscure goals to accomplish

- Numerous intriguing ways to die

- Grimly variable life expectancy based on player location

- Delightfully accurate fly physics

- The most expansive game yet from the mind behind KIDS and Plug & Play

games.name: 吞食一统中原Tunshi  unifying plains
games.shortDescription: "The Conquest of China" is a RPG role-playing game centered around Liu Bei of the Shu Kingdom. Unlike other Three Kingdoms RPGs, the game does not start with the usual storyline, but instead begins with the murder of Liu's mother by the Yellow Turban Rebellion, setting Liu on a path of revenge.
games.aboutText: "The Conquest of China" is a RPG role-playing game centered around Liu Bei of the Shu Kingdom. Unlike other Three Kingdoms RPGs, the game does not start with the usual storyline, but instead begins with the murder of Liu's mother by the Yellow Turban Rebellion, setting Liu on a path of revenge. Along the way, he meets like-minded individuals such as Guan Yu and Zhang Fei, and together they pledge to save the people in a world of chaos under the peach blossom oath. The game has a total of thirteen main chapters, with a fourteenth chapter added in the third playthrough. Each chapter is based on historical events, and there are also numerous side quests that add to the game's depth. In addition to the familiar Three Kingdoms storyline, the game's lesser-known side quests provide a sense of freshness and novelty, making it a compelling experience to play.

games.name: XENOTILT: HOSTILE PINBALL ACTION
games.shortDescription: LIGHTNING STRIKES AGAIN!! XENOTILT, the sequel to the cult hit, DEMON'S TILT. Get ready for another PINBALL FANTASY. XENOTILT shreds the envelope with face-melting gameplay & graphics.
games.aboutText:
XENOTILT: HOSTILE PINBALL ACTION

Turbo-Charged Pinball Reloaded!!

FEATURES:

- AN EXPANSIVE 3 STORY TABLE

- NIGHTMARISH NEW BOSSES

- REALTIME LIGHTS, GORGEOUS SPRITEWORK

- 9 BALL MULTIBALL MATRIX

- BIG NUMBERS, BULLET HELL

- CAVERNOUSLY DEEP MECHANICS

- A MEGA-DRIVEN SOUNDTRACK BY EC2151

Multiball unleashed!!

3 TIER PLAYFIELD
Welcome to the SAMARITAN, A derelict ship turned HOSTILE, has anyone survived?

XENOPHAGE SWARM
A vicious infestation that plagues the SAMARITAN. THE TURRET SYSTEM
BIG BULLETS chew up baddies & smash enemy volleys.

THE PERK SYSTEM
Upgrade your WEAPONS, DEFENSE & SCORING POWER with 9 UNIQUE PERKS.

THE MULTIBALL MATRIX
Holds 9 Balls, Activates Perks, Unleash MULTIBALL!!

HARDCORE MODE
ONE BALL, MAXXED FIREPOWER.

EX-MODE
EX-CLUSIVE Bonus Rooms. EX-TREME power-ups. EX-TENDED challenge!!

EX-SURVIVORS
Rescue hidden SURVIVORS. Hire them for unique BONUS SKILLS!

CRISIS MODE
CHAOTIC TIME ATTACK. Go the distance and enter SUDDEN DEATH!

STEAMDECK:

GREAT ON THE GO! Gameplay that rocks the small screen.
Great for short bursts, or that long commute!

This might hurt...

THE XENOPHAGE:

HERA the Rogue Pirate A.I.
A sentient Malware has taken over the SAMARITAN. COSMIC PIRATE QUEEN.

CHRYSALIS
A bruiser of a XENOPHAGE bug, swarm protector.

T.I.G.E.R. SUPREME
Offensive security measures for the SAMARITAN.

STAR PILOT
Addicted to LIFE SUPPORT he functions now as the UNDEAD NAVIGATOR.

MECHA-NEKO
