- Learn recipes to craft various materials, items and also equipment for your towers.

- Improve your crafting abilities and effiency to use less resources while having
more/better/faster output.

- Discover more about the aliens and learn to craft special beacons, that attract much stronger species that may also yield much better rewards!

- Expand and improve your base to become a reliable resource hub for earth.

It's the year 2249, most resources on earth are nearly depleted and have lead to many conflicts in the past.
Despite those crises, humanity made huge progress in the fields of AI, which in turn allowed for enormous advances in space travel.
Scientists were even able to create a new kind of engine, which made it possible to travel faster than light. But on the downside humans were not able to survive this way of transportation.
In a last desperate attempt and in search for new resources, the EIRO (European Interstellar Resource Organization) built a brand new ship which was only controlled by an AI named "Athena".
Hoping that the AI can survive the jump and begin autonomous exploration and exploitation of resources, the ship is launched into an unknown future...

games.name: MEMORIAPOLIS
games.shortDescription: Memoriapolis is a historical city builder where your city grows organically across 5 ages, from Antiquity to the Industrial Revolution. Manage resources, interact with factions, and shape your dynasty toward building a final Wonder with easy, normal, or hard difficulty levels.
games.aboutText:
Memoriapolis is a historical city builder where your city grows across 5 ages from Antiquity to the Industrial Revolution.

Place the buildings. The city grows organically and districts expand. Manage resources, navigate faction demands, and guide your dynasty to its final goal : building one of three Industrial Revolution Wonders — the Eiffel Tower, Neuschwanstein Castle, or the Statue of Liberty.

Relaxed or challenging : difficulty settings adjust objectives, faction pressure, and resource balance to match how you want to play.

Banners & Wonders is the biggest update to Memoriapolis since launch.

Factions now have personalities: Altruist, Warrior, Expansionist, and more. They don't all want the same thing, and they won't all negotiate the same way.

Your dynasty's goal : reach the Industrial Revolution and build one of three final Wonders — the Eiffel Tower, Neuschwanstein Castle, or the Statue of Liberty.

The city is more open than before. No more cycle limits. No more closed districts. New maps, Steam achievements, difficulty levels have also been added and more!

At the heart of it all : the Dynastic House that grows with your city across every age.

Build your city across 5 ages

Memoriapolis spans five historical eras : Antiquity, the Middle Ages, the Renaissance, the Age of Enlightenment, and the Industrial Revolution. Each age transforms your city with new architecture, new challenges, new Monuments to unlock.

Watch your city grow organically

No rigid grid. Your city develops naturally, expanding through districts shaped by your choices and your citizens. No two playthroughs look the same.

Build monuments from history

Construct iconic landmarks like the Library of Alexandria, Windsor Castle, Leaning Tower of Pisa, Palace of Versailles and more to give your city a unique identity through time.

Interact with factions

Factions have personalities — Altruist, Warrior, Expansionist, and more — and they have demands. You can accept proposals directly, negotiate terms, or choose to favor one faction over another. Engage as much or as little as the game calls for.

How is Memoriapolis different from other city builders?

Your city grows organically and you guide your dynasty across the ages. Factions add depth but you are free to engage with these systems at your own pace.

I played Memoriapolis before, what has changed?

Banners & Wonders is the biggest update since launch. Factions now have personalities, construction is more open, new maps have been added, and your dynasty now has a final goal : build one of three Industrial Era Wonders.

Is Memoriapolis easy?

Yes and no! Select your difficulty at the start of a run: resources, faction pressure, objectives and more… all vary depending on the level you choose.

Is Memoriapolis replayable?

Each playthrough is different thanks to different maps, different factions, different Wonder to build at the end. The organic growth of your city means no two runs look the same.

games.name: Tiny Terry's Turbo Trip
games.shortDescription: Terry wants to launch himself into space using his new car. Doing something this cool and reckless will surely make him the talk of the town. Run, drive and glide through this small journey of big discoveries as Terry works towards achieving this goal.
games.aboutText:
Step into Terry’s flip flops in this short and delightfully sweet adventure of self-discovery as he uncovers what it means to be an inhabitant of ✨Sprankelwater✨ .

Key Features:

- Explore a densely packed, tiny open world town at any pace and in any way you like. Slow, fast, by foot, by car, by paraglider! It’s up to you.

- Uncover a wholesome story through hilarious interactions with weird Sprankelwaterians.

- Collect TURBO JUNK and upgrade the boost capacity of Terry’s very own car.

- Catch insects, dig holes, destroy cars, become rich, wear hats.

- Listen to a joyful and heart-warming soundtrack from the composer of Wuppo.

games.name: PizzaBoy
games.shortDescription: Take control of PizzaBoy as he delivers pizza to monsters in this precision platformer. Use all of PizzaBoy's smooth and snappy moves to navigate through dangerous levels or break away from the path to discover who PizzaBoy really is...
games.aboutText:
GAMEPLAY:

Take control of PizzaBoy, a nimble pizza delivery guy equipped with an air-dash that allows him to bounce off walls. This can be used to reach greater heights and distances than the standard run and jump. PizzaBoy must navigate dangerous environments to deliver pizzas to hungry monsters.

Pizzaboy must make it to the end of the level to deliver the pizza, but don't expect it to be too simple, as each area is full of pizza-hungry monsters. Don't get too close, or they might just steal a slice! The customer won't be happy with a half-eaten pizza.

The path to the customer won't always be straightforward either. Every level is a metroidvania style map with many secrets, collectables, and areas to explore. Alongside delivering pizzas, PizzaBoy may find opportunities to recover his lost memories and discover the dark secrets of the company he works for. The player's choice in how they tackle the level will determine the ending of each chapter and ultimately the end of the game.

If the customer is satisfied with your performance, you might just get a 5-star review.

CHARACTERS:

PizzaBoy is a loyal employee of 'Pizza Dawg's Pizza' who has recently been promoted to a more dangerous job (that pays an extra 60 cents an hour).

Not much is known about his identity, as he seems to have lost all memories of his past.

While delivering pizza, he falls in love with a vampire.

VampireGirl is one of the last surviving vampires on earth.

For unknown reasons, she has a burning hatred for pizza delivery guys. In her free time, she orders pizzas just to kill them.

However, she makes an exception for one...

Pepperoni Dog.

STORY:

In a world where humans and monsters have been in conflict for centuries, PizzaDawg's Pizza is trying to spread the word of peace through the most beautiful delicacy ever created (pizza). Over the past 20 years, PizzaDawg's has been successfully delivering pizzas to monsters.

Our protagonist, PizzaBoy, is one of the many staff members unfortunate enough to be promoted to monster deliveries. After he gets promoted, life gets a whole lot whackier. While delivering pizzas, he finds himself learning more about the company he works for and even about himself. There are many whacky characters to be found in the world of PizzaBoy.

The game's ending is determined by the player's choice to search for the truth or remain ignorant of the companies' dark secrets.

games.name: Thronefall
games.shortDescription: A minimalist game about building and defending your little kingdom.
games.aboutText:
Thronefall is a minimalist strategy game where you build a humble kingdom by day and defend it by night. Balance economy and defense by fortifying walls, recruiting troops, and charging into battle yourself to protect your stronghold from relentless waves of attackers.

Perfect for quick sessions or fortification marathons, step into a streamlined and endlessly replayable twist on tower defense!

- 10 Maps. From the mountainous Nordfels to the vibrant Wildbach, progress through a range of maps with different terrain, weather, enemies, buildings and challenges.

- 9 Unlockable Weapons. As a Warrior King, seize a weapon to take with you into combat, from Battleaxe to Blood Wand.

- Over 50 Unlockable Perks. Take up to 5 perks that bestow certain advantages, and optional Mutators to ramp up the difficulty.

- Protect your Kingdom with Walls, Barricades, Shrines and Towers.

- Expand your economy with Houses, Bridges, Gold Mines, Harbors, Mills and Fields. These buildings grant you gold every morning – if they survive.

- Research upgrades with the Castle Center, Blacksmith and Royal Forge.

- Build your military with Barracks, Archery Ranges and Hero's Quarters. Your forces include Knights, Berserks, Crossbowmen, Fire Archers, and special Heroes such as Golems and Mages.

- When night falls, an increasingly strong succession of foes threaten to overwhelm your Kingdom. The sun only rises when they're dead.

- From wooden Barrel Knights and Flying Mages to Ogres, Slimes, Wasps and Catapults, the land is teeming with danger.

- If your Castle Center is razed, you lose.

- As King, lead from the vanguard and defend your little Kingdom til you see the sun rise.

We think you'll love Thronefall if you enjoy...

Total War: MEDIEVAL II, Age of Empires IV, Bad North, Kingdom: Two Crowns, Against the Storm, Banished, Townscaper, 9 Kings, Super Fantasy Kingdom, Ball x Pit, Diplomacy is Not an Option, The King is Watching, and Northgard

games.name: RUBATO
games.shortDescription: RUBATO, an experimental, 2D physics-based take on the collect-a-thon genre!
games.aboutText:
RUBATO, an experimental, 2D physics-based take on the collect-a-thon genre!

The year is 12,012. Multiquadrillionaire monopoly "GSSAI CO." has been in power of the universe for centuries after a world-ending bioweapon was unleashed onto the masses. And now? The solar system has been destroyed by unknown celestial forces. A weapons development program run by the Earth subsidiary of "GSSAI CO." is fast progressing. And the world's denizens are disappearing.

That is until one man screws up a game of pool.

HERO OF THE STARS AND THE SKY

- Use your tongue to lick enemies and objects as you make your way through open metroidvania-like areas, whilst collecting "Planet Bits" to help fix the solar system!

WELCOME TO RUBATO WORLD

- 5 compact, densely packed areas ranging from a huge sprawling bakery to the world's most poorly planned city. Uncover secrets and shortcuts in every corner of the world.

IF I COULD ONLY LOVE

- A strange, funny plot with a deep focus on humour and character writing. It gets silly. It gets serious. Really concerningly serious. Uh. Is the guy who made this game okay..?

BUT FIRST, LOVE YOURSELF

- To save the world, you must save yourself first. Find yourself again.

RUBATO contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy.

games.name: Ratopia
games.shortDescription: Ratopia is a new game that has combined elements of both strategic survival and city building. With plenty of content available, and more planned, enjoy a vast world to adventure and populate with citizens! Build your own economical system to sustain your ideal city of Ratopia.
games.aboutText:
The citizens of Ratopia each have their own wealth and unique characteristics.

There is no such thing as a free lunch!

Supply jobs and services for your ratizens to make them all happy.

Make a detailed policy to tax them all!

Shouldn't the people all work tirelessly for more profit?

Create or prevent social disasters with your own policies.

Explore and find the remains of the great old rats.

Bring prosperity to the city through great expeditions.

Some adventures pose the possibility of awaking up apex predators, but who's to worry?

games.name: Revive & Prosper
games.shortDescription: A complex but not difficult voxel automation game with belts, trains, teleports, and even catapults for transport. Achieve efficiency through smart water control. Play with or without enemies. Produce materials and fuel for a spaceship. Deal with the toxic side effects. Can you Revive & Prosper?
games.aboutText:
Revive & Prosper takes you to a voxel world, where you'll be extracting resources and building a thriving base using belts and smart water control.
The complex production chains and tricky resource management will really put your strategy and simulation skills to the test.
There's nothing like optimizing and managing the perfect production line after a day full of adulting!

In this single-player automation game, you gather and manage resources, construct, automate and expand. A crew of mutants and their golem helpers will do all the manual work for you.

You'll shape the terrain to make paths for your crew and a place for your base.
Each map presents a challenge to plan efficient mining, harvesting, and production .

You'll also work extensively with water , which represents a source of energy, a necessary resource for production and growth, and also an effective weapon against aggressive Martian flora .

You go through technological ages from simple wood to chemical, atomic, and space.
You'll build a spaceship and expand your base to orbit, the Moon, and finally - Mars. Features:

- Expand your base to Orbit, the Moon and finally - Mars

- Revive the land with water then plan and construct an efficient and fully automated base

- First, gather resources manually then automate the process

- Deliver items over long distances with catapults.

- Weather can change in Revive & Prosper

- Plan the construction and your crew will do the rest

Unique features

- 3 difficulty levels: Builder, Survival, Battler

- Optional Martian enemies

- Real-time water flow simulation on modifiable voxel terrain

- Complex moisture system connected to natural vegetation cycles

- Dynamic weather bringing lightning storms that cause fires

- Sprinklers, light conductors and water cannons for firefighting

- Toxin spreads from factories and Martian Monoliths, with solutions for balance

- Automation of every production step

- Progress from the Wooden Age to the Space Age

- Various transportation methods, including belts, catapults, teleporters and trains

- Level editor for creating and sharing maps

- Golems doubling the workforce

- Complex and deep gameplay offering tens of hours of playing

games.name: Edenfall: Legacy of the First Wardens
games.shortDescription: Unveil a mystical action-adventure where you shift between human, wolf, raccoon, and raven. Weave fluid combos across forms, purge corruption, and awaken the land’s lost beauty. Together with your spirit fox companion, embark on a soulbound journey of transformation, memory, and inner peace.
games.aboutText:
A breathtaking metamorphosis awaits as you guide Venya through a world overcome by darkness. Use her shapeshifting powers to restore peace to a land that has gone without, for far too long.

Morph & Traverse

Switch seamlessly from human to wolf, raccoon, and raven. Each form offers unique traversal and combat mechanics. Glide like a raven through misty canopies, pounce like a wolf across beautiful landscapes, change into a raccoon to slip through tight ruins, and strike like a human with precision. Every form reveals new paths, puzzles, and secrets tucked across Eden.

Fluid form-blending Battles

Master an intricate combo system that blends attacks from different forms. Chain a raccoon’s nimble strikes into a wolf’s feral fury, then follow up with a human’s finishing blow. Master the flow of combat and help restore peace to the world.

From Blight to Bloom

Defeat enemies and conquer each boss to witness a corrupted area return to its natural beauty. Every victory restores a piece of Eden and reinforces the bond between inner peace and external hope.

Praised in early previews for its “soul-kindling environments” and “innovative multi-form combat system”, Edenfall: Legacy of the First Wardens is already turning heads among action-adventure and narrative fans.

games.name: Rhythia
games.shortDescription: Rhythia is a game about aiming and hitting musical beats with precision timing, within a dynamic 3x3 grid system. Use your reflexes to target flying blocks, combine accurate aim with perfect rhythm, and finally master the leaderboards against players who challenge your precision skills.
games.aboutText:
Rhythia on Steam, compared to other open source alternatives and implementations, is a completely new and refreshed client that aims to bring online and community features. The goal is to develop and improve on the familiar gameplay concept. More information and links are available on the Rhythia portal.

Rhythia is a game in which you aim and hit musical beats with precision. You will be targeting blocks, mastering timing, building combos, perfecting your accuracy and climbing leaderboards.

In the beginning you will find yourself learning the 3x3 grid layout, aiming at individual blocks and building basic combos by hand, but in short time you can become a rhythm master, with flawless accuracy, perfect timing and seamless aim transitions, all for those satisfying perfect scores. This intense focus on precision and timing rewards dedicated practice, so you will need to develop your aim and musical reflexes to achieve mastery.

Rhythia offers players unlimited customization of the game - to the smallest detail of gameplay, game interface and elements. It comes bundled with existing shapes, models and presets for you to choose from, and build your own experience.

games.name: The Witch's Cauldron
games.shortDescription: The Witch's Cauldron is a narrative roguelike game about being a medieval witch. Grab your cauldron and get brewing. Love, curses, laughter, wisdom for sale! Do what thou wilt shall be the whole of the Law. At least before the inquisitors come around.

games.name: ZWAARD
games.shortDescription: Explore a post-apocalyptic world overrun by dangerous technologies and whatever is left of humanity. Scavenge for parts to upgrade your modular sword and uncover why you are here.
games.aboutText:
Customize your blade with a wide range of components scavenged from the remnants of civilization. Engage in fluid combat , combining precision strikes and strategic maneuvers as you confront formidable foes. Explore v ast, open landscapes , uncover hidden secrets , and adapt your playstyle to the challenges that await you.

Customizing your sword can be done at different locations in the world and will effect various stats the sword has . The components you will be able to change depend on the kind of parts you have found and are inside of your inventory.

This will allow you to fully change and customize the weapon to your liking and playstyle . Different parts will allow you to create all sorts of combinations that can result in a great amount of strategies against multiple kinds of mutated creatures .

A century after a devastating outbreak transformed the world, remnants of humanity cling to survival in a shattered landscape. As a lone adventurer, you navigate the ruins, encountering mysterious relics of the past and uncovering the mysteries of an unknown disaster that destroyed this world.

Assemble the fragments of a forgotten history, battling mutated creatures and overcoming the remnants of a once-great civilization . Your journey is not just one of survival but a quest to reclaim lost knowledge and restore hope to a desolate world .

- Blade Customization: Modify your sword with an array of components, each affecting combat performance.

- Open World Exploration: Traverse a vast, atmospheric world filled with dangers and secrets.

- Engaging Combat: Master a dynamic combat system that combines precision strikes, dodges, and tactical play.

- Narrative: Unravel the story of a world plunged into chaos, discovering the origins of a destructive disaster.

- Post-Apocalyptic Aesthetics: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning hand pixelated world.

- Enemies: Defeat unique enemies with various attack patterns and overcome challenging bosses.

games.name: Farlands
games.shortDescription: Congratulations, you’ve bought your own planet! An agrarian rock at the edge of the galaxy that, for some reason, was practically being given away for free. So the time has come to leave your hectic, stressful life in an overcrowded metropolis for a more rural and rewarding life.
games.aboutText:
Seeking a lifestyle change, you saw an offer you couldn’t refuse: an entire planet going for a bargain price! An old agrarian rock in an outlying solar system that’s been lying abandoned for years. So, with little more than your worn-out ship and your personal assistance droid, you decide to embark on a new phase of your life in a lost corner of the galaxy.

Restore your planet!

Cut weeds, clear paths, reclaim fields, and fix what the passage of time has destroyed. Turn an old agrarian rock into a thriving homestead.

Explore the solar system!

Although your ship has seen better days, it can still help you move between the different planets in the solar system, explore them, and collect resources to improve your farm, your tools, and your ship.

Be part of the community!

Make contact with the handful of people who still live on the solar system’s planets. Learn their stories and the reasons why they decided to stay in such a remote part of the galaxy.

Save the solar system and restore it to its former glory!

A whole planet at a bargain price? Perhaps there’s a reason for that... Maybe things won’t be as simple as they first seemed!

games.name: Mind Diver
games.shortDescription: Investigate a broken mind to unravel a twisted case. Deduce the truth. Restore lost memories. Listen to private conversations. Draw your own conclusions. Mind Diver is a murder mystery, where the victim is love.
games.aboutText:
Explore the Mind Ocean to solve a twisted case

You are a Mind Diver.

Using experimental technology, you explore Lina's Mind Ocean, fixing her memories to solve an unprecedented missing persons case. Lina's subconscious hides many secrets, critical to unraveling the dark case.

Restore broken memories and uncover the past

Every memory you investigate is missing a key detail. Anything could be the solution. Fill out the correct detail to reveal more of the past.

Challenging and satisfying deduction

Every solution is logical, but not obvious. You'll need the right clues to deduce the truth. Listen to private conversations. Inspect small details. Slow down and engage your mind to make the right connections.

A heartbreaking love story

A couple deeply in love have both broken down. Lina is losing her memories and Sebastian has gone missing. A disturbing party seems to cover up something else. And a dark tragedy is buried deep in Lina's mind.

Beautifully executed

- Fully voice acted

- Unique 3D-scan style

- Award-winning story and puzzle design

- ~4-5 hours of tightly paced gameplay

Made by Indoor Sunglasses

We're a tiny team of curious game devs that love mysteries and discoveries. We wear Indoor Sunglasses so that no one can see us cry. Our games make people ask questions and solve harder problems than they thought possible.

We met through making the earliest school version of Mind Diver, a detective game based on our heartbreaks. It was nominated as Best Student Game at IGF 2023. We set out to make a grander Mind Diver that could make anyone feel smart and feel seen.

Hopefully we'll get to bring you many more mysterious games in the future.

games.name: Omega Crafter
games.shortDescription: Adventure in a vast open-world survival craft game with your programmable sidekick Grammi! Program the Grammi to collect materials, build your town, craft weapons and armor to challenge strong enemies! Play alone or with friends online!
games.aboutText:
Omega Crafter™ - a PFN™ crafting game is an open-world survival craft game set in an under-development game world that is being attacked by a mysterious program. Adventure, build a city, challenge mighty enemies with Grammi - your programmable sidekick - and friends in order to complete development of the game by the release date!

Fight and defeat various enemies!

Powerful monsters appear to be causing confusion and hindering the game’s development. Collect materials to craft powerful weapons and defeat these strong enemies! It looks like the Grammi will help too!

Program your Grammi!

Grammi’s actions can be easily programmed, allowing them to help you with tasks such as mining, logging, moving materials and crafting items. You can even program them to dance! What do you want to program the Grammi to do?

Build your city!

There are various resources to be found in this world, from stone and wood to mysterious materials that have never been seen before. Create your ideal city by automating the building process with your Grammi!

Explore!

There are multiple biomes in Omega Crafter where you can encounter different landscapes, monsters, materials, and hidden secrets. Adventure and explore this vast open world with the Grammi and your friends!

Play online with friends!

You can explore alone or invite your friends to adventure and fight together. Enjoy the endless possibilities of this vast procedurally generated world!

games.name: 最弱骸骨兵 The Weakest Skeleton
games.shortDescription: You wake up from the Evil Skeleton Legion as a skeleton soldier. Take control of female minions to help you fight, obtain human skins, blend into towns, and get resources. Explore dungeons, collect materials, expand your team, and become the sole master of this world in this land of danger!
games.aboutText:
The plot begins with a captain-level skeleton soldier in the army of the undead in another world who has gained a new consciousness and is suddenly summoned to a continent and begins to unfold...

The protagonist of the game is the Skeleton Soldier (you can name the Bone Soldier at the beginning of the new game) and then assign Trait Attribute Points.

Updated new Skeleton Soldier Standing Drawing (the original Human Image Standing Art has been cancelled, but it will appear on the image skin selection screen)
Look at personal preference assignments.

Strength increases physical attack power, all-round increases spell attack power, durability improves defense.

Balance will increase the hit rate (this attribute is very important, it will affect the probability of hitting the enemy) can be allocated more initially, each enemy will have corresponding hit requirements, these data will be displayed in the monster book, when you encounter the monster for the first time will be automatically added to the book.

Lucky stands for crit.

Crime is a very interesting setting, there will be NPCs in the game town, if the player is infected with an infectious disease and talk to the NPC will have a chance to infect the NPC, the NPC will disappear after getting sick, it will take a certain amount of time to refresh again, the crime will increase, this value will affect the additional attack damage of the skeleton soldier. (New changes may be added in the future, unchanged).

The game has a day and night cycle, there will be different quest lines NPCs and monsters appearing in different time periods.

Introduction to the appearance system

Under the image of the skeleton soldier, entering the town during the day will automatically change into a human form, and the human form will have skin options, and you can get the image skin of different classes through the mission.

Now you can also switch forms in the town at night, add some new tasks, and pass a certain medium pattern to accept tasks.

For example, the skeleton soldier form can take on the mission line of a certain force.

A new light source system has been added, and now the light and dark layers of the scene light source are stronger.
Of course, you can also turn off these effects in the settings.

It is planned that the Beginner Village will add another 10-15 tasks, mainly distributed at night (the number of tasks assigned by the Beginner Village is already 60+).

In order to better express the combat effect and the sense of blow, the battle SV diagram (characters and enemies) has been changed to a set of 4 frame actions.

Part of the heroine's SV battle diagram is displayed

The battle show incorporates wounded voices and wounded shocks from character and enemy individuals.

The combat effects have all been processed to a frame rate of 60 frames.

Added bow and arrow system, different bows and arrows have different attributes and starting methods, can be dropped by monsters or crafted, each long-range attack will consume the number of bows and arrows, the choice of bows and arrows can be selected in the arrow menu.

Stitching monster system
Captured monsters and human NPCs can be crafted
There is a chance that different powerful creatures will appear for you!

games.name: Black Gunner Wukong
games.shortDescription: Wukong Survivors" is a TPS + ROGUE game where players control Sun Wukong and his friends, sweeping through all visible enemies and rescuing their captured master.
games.aboutText:
Black Gunner Wukong is a Rougelike type shooting game.

In the game, the player takes on the role of Wukong , who enters a U.S. military base to rescue his master who has been captured by Diden.

In the game, all creatures are identified as armed helicopters and supermarket shopping bags, not as female and male!

Game Features:

A very rare TPS+Vampire survivor!

Can use 6 big guns to crush your enemies!

Can fly using the Nimbus Cloud!

Rich build options, gun bonds combinations.

Play as different forms of Wukong, with various active and passive skills.

Bullet storms, a true bullet hell!

Collect peaches from each round of battle, purchase enhancements, and ultimately engage in a showdown with the boss.

A comically themed background storyline.

games.name: BlazBlue Entropy Effect
games.shortDescription: Enjoy action-packed flashy combat with incredibly satisfying combos and responsive controls! Numerous characters, each with completely unique playstyles and loads of unlockable moves & upgrades! This action roguelike sets the bar for fluid fast-paced action.
games.aboutText:
Flashy Action Combat

Charismatic character designs with unique aesthetic styles and dramatic animations create an awesome combat experience.

Incredible Satisfying Gameplay

Smooth controls, infinite possibilities of combos and ultra-responsive combat feedback create one of the best action experiences out there!

Numerous Playstyles

13 playable characters in the base game and 4 DLC characters, each with distinctly unique combat styles and personalities to explore.

Hundreds of Moves for Customization

There are hundreds of moves for you to build around, plus countless elemental effects and legacy skills passed between characters. The possibilities are infinite. Time to make the best fighter of your own!

Iconic Crossovers, Fresh Thrills

Dive into free crossover content featuring two indie legends: ICEY and Dead Cells!

Reunite ICEY with the Narrator and embark on a journey guided by his voice... or, you know, just ignore him completely. :)

Alternatively, embody The Prisoner and slash your way through a specially crafted Metroidvania-style zone, uncovering a brand-new original story.

Please Note :

- All plotlines included in the collaboration content are completely unrelated to the original IP of the collaboration.

- Please be aware that this game contains visual elements such as flashing screens that may trigger photosensitive epilepsy.

games.name: Tower Builder
games.shortDescription: Tower Builder is online Co-op or single player building and design game.
games.aboutText:
Tower Builder is a building and design game. The main goal is to build the biggest tower while not going bankrupt. This is an engineering and cost management game. The beams, columns and floors have structural properties. The plan for this game is for either single player or multiplayer in three modes.



• Challenge mode: you play the role of a Developer, Engineer and Builder with limitation in place. You have to strategize to construct the tower tall and strong enough that the it does not collapse without going bankrupt.

• Free Build mode: you have no size limit and unlimited funds, but the tower has structural properties.

• Sandbox mode: you can build and decorate as you like.

games.name: Soul Mates
games.shortDescription: You’re trapped inside a haunted house, stalked by angry ghosts. To survive, you’ll have to run, hide, strategize, give gifts, chat, flirt… Wait, what kind of game is this? Oh right, it’s a point-and-click survival horror dating sim!
games.aboutText:
Please Note!

Full voice acting isn’t currently included and is planned for a future update.

About

Your friend is missing. She disappeared while conducting a paranormal investigation at the local abandoned manor. Determined to find her, you make your way to the property - ill-prepared for the oppressive darkness of the house, the unnatural cold of its rooms, and whatever malevolent power it is that locks you inside once you’re there.

Before you can find your friend, the angry ghosts that haunt the manor find you.

You must run, hide, do whatever it takes to survive as terrible specters chase you through the lightless halls. Your sanity won’t last long in the face of their psychic attacks. Soon you’ll be consumed by fear, your very life hanging in the balance, and… Hold up. Is that ghost kinda cute?

Soul Mates is a point-and-click survival horror game from the creators of the idle dating sim Crush Crush! Explore a crumbling haunted house to uncover clues, find hidden objects, and solve puzzles, all while fleeing (and maybe flirting with?) the wretched ghosts that seek to devour your soul. As you piece together the story of what happened here, you might find things aren’t quite what they seem… and the ending of your story might be happier than you predicted.

games.name: Tenebris: Terra Incognita
games.shortDescription: A turn-based tactical RPG. Experiment with the talent trees of 23 heroes. Combine abilities with equipment. Defeat 17 terrifying bosses and uncover the secrets of the planet Tenebris!
games.aboutText:
Tenebris: Terra Incognita is a challenging turn-based RPG set in a gloomy science fiction setting. Take command of the best fighters of humanity and save the expedition of the Solaris starship, which crashed on an uncharted planet infested with terrible monsters!

CHARACTERS

We are big fans of series like Darkest Dungeon, X-COM and Disciples, and we want to give players a similar experience through deep hero customization and career progression. Having 5 basic classes with easily recognizable roles at the beginning of the playthrough, the player will be able to choose character development branches from 17 advanced classes as they gain experience. Each specialization has separate talent trees, allowing the player to create unique characters within the same class.

The game has a full inventory system. Found or purchased items - weapons, armor, special equipment - can not only improve the basic characteristics of the characters, but also influence their talents or give new abilities.

- Experiment with the talent branches of the characters.

- Combine your abilities with equipment items.

- Create your own unique build, and conquer the world of Tenebris!

MONSTERS

The damaged hull of the ship turned out to be the least of the expedition's problems: the people, not having time to recover from the heavy landing, were immediately attacked by huge bugs. The size, speed and aggressiveness of the enemy would not be such a problem if not for the amazing organization of the swarm. These bugs, through chemical signals, are able not only to coordinate, but also to strengthen and accelerate each other. The more there are, the more dangerous each individual enemy is.

If you manage to defend the starship and gain a foothold in the insect-infested Misty Wasteland, your troops will be able to open other areas where the bug scouts do not dare to go. And if you learn from the swarm, you will understand: there, beyond the borders of the wasteland, you will need new abilities, different combat tactics and, most likely - bigger guns.

STARSHIP "SOLARIS"

The Solaris starship is your base and the only relatively safe place on the planet. Here you can purchase weapons and armor, awaken new recruits from cryo-sleep and send wounded heroes for treatment. The resources found in missions will allow you to improve the ship's bays and expand the capabilities of your squad.

In addition to the expedition commander and the head of the security service, together with whom you will solve the main task of escaping the planet, you will be assisted by the chief doctor, leading engineer and warehouse manager. Each crew member will have unique tasks for you, and solving them will allow you to obtain additional resources and technologies that can increase the chances of survival of the expedition.

Be careful - the ship's supplies are scarce, and you will have to fight for the planet's resources. You have to carefully choose what to spend the little you can get in battles.

Will you be able to conquer the dark planet and save the expedition?

The crew has left all the decisions to you - proceed at your own risk!

games.name: River Town Factory
games.shortDescription: If possible, would you like to go back to ancient times to start a factory, refine oil, or even build a large computer? With the accidental fall of a meteorite, you traveled back to River Town a thousand years ago and became a workshop owner. And the story will begin from here……
games.aboutText:
Create automated production assembly lines, from wooden planks to circuit boards, design every step of your production line.

Unlock future technologies gradually, from silicon purification to photovoltaic power generation, and build your futuristic workshop.

Use inter-district teleportation stations to receive products at various levels, expanding your factory's territory to the entire continent.

From brewing and oil pressing to manufacturing ovens, even producing watches and antibiotics, astound ancient people with your futuristic goods!

Reinforced concrete, rubber, and large-scale computers, these will be the mass-produced materials you use in the ancient times, a thousand years ago!!!

There are 12 characters that can be pursued in the game - the royal, the martial arts world, the merchant, etc. Unlock the secrets of each character and pursue the friendships and romances you desire. Choose your partner and discuss marriage, and together move into the workshop where they will provide powerful assistance. Make connections with nearly 30 historical figures, each with their own changing schedules throughout the four seasons. Participate in their lives and use modern knowledge to solve their problems. In the River Town, everything happens naturally, and you have the final say on when to work, explore, and engage in romantic pursuits.

A fast-paced combat system that is easy to pick up, combining evasion and offense to defeat your enemies through strategic maneuvers. Whether through formal training or adventures in the martial arts world, master more than 40 martial arts techniques including external skills, internal skills, light skills, and hard skills, allowing you to dominate the martial arts world.

Explore the four major villages on the map, complete village quests, and uncover their secrets.

Explore the mystical realms left behind by ancient predecessors, delve deep into them, and defeat bizarre creatures.

Explore the entire continent, discover treasures, explore bat caves, and punish bandits for the people.

Sign contracts with mine owners throughout the entire map, allowing ancient people to work for you.

Be a skilled craftsman or a social butterfly? Become the top martial artist or a versatile expert in everyday life? It's all up to you to decide.

Craft spiritual medicines, weapons, and clothing, becoming a master of ancient craftsmanship.

Create over 20 different dishes with various enhancements, such as Five Treasures Stew and Snowy Sunset Soup... Make them in your kitchen!

Fill the Heavenly Workshop with the products you create, allowing ancient people to visit and witness modern technology.

Utilize the power of future technology to repair the time machine and fulfill a mission that only you can accomplish.

games.name: Aeruta
games.shortDescription: A bread revolution across the world now begins! Aeruta is a side-scrolling action game with a shop management twist, fight monsters for materials and use them to make breads, then finally make the deserted town popular again!
games.aboutText:
The aroma of bread in memories... In this moment, let's start anew!
This is a world where bread is gradually being forgotten.
Until one day, in the corner of the world, an accidental explosion triggered by the main character Chaya, who was forced to stay in a rundown town where she is unfamiliar with the little store owner Effie to rebulid her bakery.
And the good smell from the insignificant oven is - the almost lost delicious food, BREAD ! Collect materials in areas with your style!

Use your weapon and skills to create a path!
There're multiple weapons to choose from,
They all have a unique skilltree to make your own playstyle!

- Multiple areas with different theme and challenges!

- The locals are cute but also dangerous!

- Rare materials! What bread can they make?

Delicious bread for the bakery!

Sell breads in your own bakery!

- Set up the rack of breads for most outcome!

- Customers are in need! Help them or lose the opportunity!

- Make sure there're breads to sell!

- Clean up that floor, or you might lose some money!

Develop deserted town, meet new friends!

With power of bread, new possibilities are opened!

- New friends will join the town with your progress!

- Research and upgrade the recipes to become top rated shop!

- Make deserted town great by developing new buldings!

games.name: Metropolis 1998
games.shortDescription: A fresh, modern city builder with charming aesthetics. Detailed agent-based simulation and scheduling. See inside buildings. Design and customize almost anything. Business-specific zoning, and mixed use zones too!
games.aboutText:
Welcome! Metropolis 1998 is a new city builder entrant that pushes familiar gameplay into unexplored territory.

Despite the charming retro aesthetics, this is a modern city builder. Every single citizen is it's own entity with their own needs, job, schedule, and family. As the mayor, you will manage infrastructure, utilities, citizen needs, municipal and emergency services, zones, traffic, pollution, and more!

The game offers extensive customization tools for players who enjoy designing, creating buildings, and customizing the look of their city.

New features Metropolis 1998 adds to the genre:

- See inside every single building and every individual floor. This includes the people living or working inside!

- Optionally design any building you want within the game world. Save it as a blueprint. Place copies or randomize the textures and colors. Share with other players.

- Citizens will demand specific businesses, not general zones.

- Businesses are individually placed and have a supply radius for residential customers (otherwise it's global).

- True mixed use zones. You can combine any mix of building types (excluding utilities).

- Residential buildings level up as their inhabitants' needs are fulfilled. Businesses level up when their customers do, and office and industry level up as the businesses they supply level up.

Other features include:

- Performant pathfinding. The engine can handle 80,000 to 150,000 sims (depends on your CPU).

- Beautiful 90s/00s isometric pixel art enhanced with shaders (optional).

- Complex agent simulation. They will eat, sleep, work, run errands, enjoy leisure activities, and more.

- Overlays to view detailed information about your city.

- Top down camera mode.

- All the classic features of the city builder genre: utilities, roads, transportation, municipal services, emergency services, citizen happiness, schools, economy, and more!

- Day/night cycle and weather (no precipitation yet).

Early access communication

Some features will not be implemented when the game launches (but are planned):

- Transportation options. Sims can only walk or drive.

- Placing roads or buildings on elevated terrain.

- Intricate road types, bridges.

- Functional bodies of water (i.e. no ships, ports, or water physics).

There are a lot of ideas planned for the game, which will soon be linked in the FAQ in the discussion forums.

Hardware requirements:

As a solo developer, this is really difficult to answer for everyone. The game is generally not CPU bound, though you will hit a CPU-restricted population cap (see above) eventually.

- ARM integrated graphics will not work! (e.g. Snap Dragon)

- Intel 1st-5th gen integrated graphics will not work!

The game will be GPU bound for low powered computers. I tested the game on an eleven (11) y ear old laptop (Intel 6th gen i5). This necessitated implementing a low-quality graphics mode (not available in alpha demo 05/22/2026). An empty map was used for the test.

- Integrated graphics :

- Low Quality: 30 FPS

- Same laptop using 4 GB NVIDA GPU :

- Low quality: 135 FPS

- High quality: 60 FPS

- My main PC uses a GTX 3060 and is more than enough for high quality mode.

games.name: Crab God
games.shortDescription: Crab God is an atmospheric underwater strategy game. Guide your Crabling colony through wild ocean depths, and defend the egg of the next Crab God.Restore and protect diverse coral reefs, making a difference in the real world as you progress in-game. Make waves, praise the claw!
games.aboutText:
Become the Guardian of the Abyss and lead the Great Migration to bring forth the next Crab God 🦀 Use your growing knowledge and great power to command your loveable crab babies (Crablings) to restore your ocean domain and protect your successor’s egg as you venture into the watery depths.

Grow Your Crabling Colony

Raise your Crablings! Nurture their personalities and potential as they worship you, build mighty coral reefs, fend off threats, and collect food for the journey ahead. Name them. Upgrade them. Grow your unique colony and guide them with your mighty claw as they become the next generation of ocean caretakers.

Lead the Great Migration

It is time for a new Crab God to rise and protect the oceans and it is your job to lead a successful migration, taking your egg to the depths where it can hatch. Balance the growth of your colony with the safety of your egg, otherwise, you will need to return to the shallows and start the migration anew.

Cultivate a Vibrant Underwater Ecosystem

Reintroduce a healthy and vibrant diversity back to the ocean, and protect it from predators seeking easy prey. Varied sea life will sustain your colony. Unlock new combinations of flora and fauna to create a beautiful underwater environment.

Real World Change

Working with dots.eco, your in-game progression will help contribute to actual ocean conservation efforts. As you cultivate the great reefs of the Crab God, you will also be helping to sustain the beautiful world environment that inspires games like ours.

!UPDATE! Crabling Customisation

Make each of your precious Crablings unique by customising their color, accessories, tools and more! You can even unlock little fish buddies to keep them company as you play.

games.name: Super Fantasy Kingdom
games.shortDescription: Rebuild your kingdom and explore a vibrant fantasy world in this roguelite city builder. Defeat hordes of monsters with a unique team of defenders as you harvest, build, mine, cook, brew, and grow. But if your defenses should fail, be prepared to watch it all burn!
games.aboutText:
Returning from a hunting trip to find your lands in ruin, you must rebuild your home while fending off hordes of monsters that attack your gates every night. Should your city fall and the forces of darkness sweep across the land, you will awaken to begin a new run where you carry forward the rewards of prior attempts – more heroes at your disposal, previously unexplored lands already uncovered, and every opportunity to push further as you uncover the mystery that has you trapped in a never-ending cycle of life and death.

As night falls, hordes of monsters emerge from the darkness in an attempt to destroy everything you’ve built, charging towards your gates and growing more vicious as the night draws on. Powerful bosses will test your defenses ruthlessly, and the only thing standing in their way is the collection of stalwart warriors, powerful creatures, and magical beings you’ve recruited to defend your lands.

- Each run you may choose a different powerful guardian to lead your defenses, each with their own strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities for unique strategies and growth through equipment and experience. Will your ice priestess freeze monsters in place for your crossbowmen and halfling to score easy shots from range, or will your knight charge into battle while a trebuchet flings rocks overhead?

- Explore the world to meet over 50 unique units that you can recruit into your cause to find the best combinations – vampires guarding halfling slingers, dinosaurs charging ahead of genie spellcasters, or crossbowmen supporting brave men-at-arms? Seek them out in the world, using your hard-earned resources to hire them to your cause and upgrade their abilities, or wait for wandering warriors to appear, with each run offering different opportunities for recruitment.

Careful planning and strategic choice will define each run as you manage resources, troops, and the kingdom at large. With limited locations for buildings, and more options than you’ll have space for, prepare to make simple but difficult decisions with lasting impact.

- Resource locations and availability are randomized with each run and you’ll need to make vital decisions on what to prioritize – quick access to raw materials is essential early on, but optimizing production chains is vital as time goes on.

- Unlock more advanced methods of acquiring resources over time to free up your workforce, but make sure you prioritize what you need for your planned strategy – will you scale up your defenses by focusing on forestry and plank production to build trebuchets and catapults, or will you prioritize the acquisition of stone to build strong walls? Or perhaps you seek optimal gold production to more quickly afford upgrades for your most capable warriors?

- As your heroes gather at the tavern to celebrate each night’s hard-fought victory, they grow stronger by eating the meals you have prepared. Build fishing huts, farms, mills, and more to feed your warriors and help them prepare for what lies beyond the walls!

Explore the world and uncover its secrets – from heroes and resources to quests, challenges, and more! The lands of Super Fantasy Kingdom are vibrant and alive, and you never know who or what you’ll find along the way. These elements mean that strategic choices for city building and combat will keep evolving and changing over time.

- Earn enough glory in battle to gain access to more strategic options within your kingdom – the longer you survive the further you’ll be able to explore and the more opportunities available for the next run.

- Your discoveries carry over to future cycles, unlocking entirely new starting options and strategic approaches that were previously several nights of battle away. These include powerful guardians, brave heroes, tricky relics, or even allies to help you out.

Super Fantasy Kingdom is designed for replayability with unpredictable opportunities and a variety of game-changing mechanics across worlds and kingdoms. Play endlessly with different strategies and approaches in a game that is easy to learn, but hard to master.

games.name: Beyond These Stars
games.shortDescription: Build a city on the back of a Space Whale and learn to coexist as you journey through the stars. Manage intricate supply chains and the needs of your people as you build outposts, meet aliens, and uncover the mysteries of the universe.
games.aboutText:
Recovering from uncertain times, your Peeps find themselves on the back of Kewa - a lonely Space Whale journeying across the universe. Building a city on the back of a sentient creature comes with its own set of challenges, but as you build your relationship and travel across the galaxy, you'll come across great opportunities for exploration and stable expansion. Meet other species, pursue the needs and wants of your Peeps, and seek the truth about their ancestors and the Space Whales alike.

The vastness of space is full of mysteries, and as you first arrive at your new home atop the Space Whale Kewa, your Peeps will quickly learn the need to work together – with each other, but also with their new home.

- A Home Among the Stars - Build a sprawling city on the back of a universe-traveling Space Whale as your Peeps seek places to live and work. Your new home is largely desolate and inhospitable when you arrive, save for a small patch of green by the water – work around the contours of the land as you plan your city, taking into account the efficiency of your production chains. Will you simply place buildings as the land allows, or will you change its very shape to take advantage of adjacency bonuses and reduced travel times?

- Reach Far and Wide - Terraform the land around you to better suit your needs. Create a thriving ecosystem by digging canals and adding top soil in preparation for farming. Plant trees to maintain a steady flow of raw materials, and maintain entire forests to help spread the atmosphere and facilitate the expansion of your city.

- A Fragile Equilibrium - Prepare to seek out additional resources as you research new technologies and gain access to advanced goods. Your people’s needs will grow, and complex logistics networks and mining infrastructure will follow, but Beyond These Stars is a game about balancing needs and wants – endless production can be as harmful, if not worse, than underproduction. The land on Kewa is fragile, and if not tended to with care, your habitat will shrink. Will you walk a fine line of sustainability by risking Kewa’s ecosystem, or will you seek opportunities to instead gather resources on other worlds to keep Kewa happy?

Unveil the shared history of the galaxy as you travel from system to system with Kewa – seek answers about your past, learn about the history of the Space Whales, and understand the unique relationships that bind everyone together.

- Reliable Outposts - Kewa’s environment is plentiful, but not without limits – there will often be a dearth of essential resources and space, and you’ll want to ensure the environment is not over-exploited. Seek out new worlds and space stations to discover other sources of materials and brand new resources – but unless you build a strong relationship with Kewa, you may find it difficult to predict how long you have at an outpost before Kewa decides it's time to leave a system behind.

- A Travel Companion - Kewa longs for connection, and is no mere pet – your home has hopes and dreams for the journey through space. Through understanding Kewa’s needs and desires you can better build a symbiotic relationship. This will give you the opportunity to work in collaboration and allow you to decide on a path together as you journey across the universe.

- Friends Along the Way - On your journey, you will cross paths with alien species offering unique opportunities – additional objectives and their subsequent rewards, opportunities for trade, and new technologies with the doors they open.

Balance your people’s survival, prosperity, and progress with the need to co-exist with Kewa in a journey across space. Beyond These Stars asks you to consider the logistics of your supply chains and production lines within the context of a living, breathing, sentient world.

games.name: Emberville
games.shortDescription: Awaken with no memories inside the Vitromotus, a vast underground world created as a magical dungeon where death no longer lasts. Explore its depths, battle dangerous creatures, rescue survivors, and rebuild the ruined town of Emberville while uncovering the truth behind this prison.
games.aboutText:
Tired and confused, you awake engulfed in darkness, in a prison that appears to have no end, known as the Vitromotus . Your memories are clouded, but your desire for freedom allows you to endure.

With nothing but your wits and might, you carve your way out with determination, eager to embrace the light of the sun. Yet, as despair slowly consumes your spirit, a ray of hope shines forward. Imprisoned like countless others, the denizens of a once thriving town, now ravaged by vicious forces, await your aid.

As you rescue them from various, terrible fates, they will lend their skills and help you rebuild their homes. You will learn their trades, secrets, and dreams while assisting them in their many quests. And perhaps, in time, become a legend in the chronicles of their land: Emberville .

Rebuild the town of Emberville

- Meet and rescue an array of quaint characters along your way. They will show you their gratitude with amazing rewards and useful teachings.

- Get to know the denizens of Emberville , hear their stories, and, if you dare, read their diaries while they are not looking; Fulfill quests, engage with townsfolk, unlock mechanics, and more.

- Aid the villagers in rebuilding their town through a large variety of gathering and crafting professions. As Emberville restores itself, it will become a living hub shaped by your deeds.

Venture into the eternal prison

- Intended as a magical confinement for the unwanted elements of a once great society, the Vitromotus stands instead as a testament to their arrogance and corruption. Find a way to escape it and, if you so desire, aid those unfortunate enough to have been left behind.

- Explore the knowledge hidden in its forgotten tunnels, ruins, survivors settlements and threatening environments, and unlock the secrets behind this energy known as kymia , a mysterious power born from emotions that brings those trapped within the Vitromotus back to life.

- Over the years, the influence of kymia reshaped the world inside the prison, bringing about strange biomes and bizarre monsters. Brave its depths and learn what hides beneath; you may discover that, perhaps, not all of these creatures are as terrible as you imagine.

Develop your own fighting style

- From sinister creatures to fearsome bosses, face enemies in action-focused combat that rewards positioning, timing, and knowledge.

- Unlock unique weapon-bound combos for a variety of weapons and chain different types of attacks to unleash devastating strikes on enemies.

- Learn, choose and use different skills from a big range of combat classes that can inherit passive and active skills from other learnt classes.

Customize and improve your character

- Enhance your character with an ample collection of skills and weapons that can be improved through leveling, items, and the help of villagers you rescue.

- As you gain experience in battle and complete quests, choose from a wide selection of classes that can be changed at any time, each with its own distinctive gameplay and abilities.

- The deeper you venture, the stronger your foes will be. You will have abundant opportunities to experiment with various fighting techniques to find the build and weapon category that better suits your playstyle.

- Create and customize your character with dozens of options of hair styles, beards, facial features, colors, and more.

Build your Estate

- Customize your personal space within Emberville where you will be able to craft anything needed to help your journey through the Vitromotous and transform your homestead into a comfortable place to relax, from buildings to furniture, plants, and decorations.

- Gather a myriad of unique materials to forge not only your combat equipment, but also useful potions, food, tools, and trinkets.

- Progress not only through combat, but also exploration, rebuilding, and the various choices you will have to make through your adventure.

games.name: Abathor
games.shortDescription: Abathor is a challenging 2D action platformer for solo play or up to 4 players. Embark on an epic 16-bit quest inspired by Golden Axe, Rastan, and Castlevania IV. Traverse Atlantis, battle demons, and defeat vicious bosses to save your progress! Enjoy an amazing OST from classic-era musicians!
games.aboutText:
"Know, oh prince, that in the years when Atlantis ruled the oceans, sins and arrogance unleashed fierce demons. When everything seemed lost, four heroes arrived to close the Gates of Abathor."

The Atlantean civilization has angered the gods. They have sent hordes of monsters to punish Atlantis by destroying the continent. Players must cooperate and compete to save Atlantis, going through a series of challenges of increasing difficulty. In their progress, our heroes will fight against ferocious demons and primordial gods, against the living and against the dead, against flying beasts and crawling horrors. They will dodge dangers and traps and descend into chilling abysses. But they will also compete against each other for the loot and the spoils, plundering treasures and offering them to the gods to receive their favor.

Features

- 2D platformer with action roguelite influences and up to 4 players in local mode.

- Fight against an army of monsters through more than 50 stages of increasing difficulty and incredible final bosses.

- Enjoy elaborate pixel art and an epic soundtrack with over 40 tracks.

- Traverse the entire continent of Atlantis and delve into lore based on Plato’s writings and Athanasius’ map.

- Re-live the arcades of the 80s and 90s, with features of retro 16-bit games and the influence of the metroidvania and beat ‘em up genre.

games.name: Axon TD: Uprising - Tower Defense
games.shortDescription: Axon TD lets you expand the map boundaries themselves. A huge arsenal of towers and a wide variety of enemies clash in a battlefield that grows to your whims. Engage in single, cooperative, and roguelite gameplay.
games.aboutText:
Axon TD infuses a new layer of strategy into Mazing Tower Defenses. Typically, you build towers on the path to obstruct enemies and make the path longer. But what if you could take control of the map layout itself and expand things directly? In Axon TD, you're given a brush, and the map is your canvas!

The name of the game is map manipulation. Place down tiles to make longer paths and support more towers. Tiles can also bridge to various islands scattered around the map; these provide entire new chunks to maze with. On various maps, you can even place a new destination point!

A roguelite mode where you face the gauntlet of randomized maps, towers, and techs. Adapt to a rapidly expanding map area and take advantage of an accelerated tower technology progression. Surviving earns you a place on the global leaderboard.

You play as a defense contractor on a routine mission. As you arrive, your ship is shot down, and you're attacked by a robotic force called the Axons. Your only way off the planet is to fight. Build towers against hoards of enemies, progress through a tech upgrade tree, and defeat epic bosses! You may even find out the truth behind the ongoing war…

While we have created a lot of singleplayer and co-op maps, there is no doubt that unique and novel experiences which we didn’t think of exist. One of the founders of our studio started game development by modding games back in WarCraft 3. So, we understand the importance of player created content. The map editor gives you all of the tools needed to create any singleplayer or co-op map that we could create ourselves.

Online co-op supports up to 4 players. With maps designed for 2, 3, and 4 players you'll find a wide variety of battlefields to conquer and make your own. A global leaderboard allows you to see how you compare to other teams. Will your team come out on top?

Both the Campaign and the roguelite Survival support 2 players.

With so many map layouts at your disposal, you want a huge arsenal of towers to play with. Dozens of towers, each with their own effect, fulfills that need. Towers also have three possible upgrades, and these upgrades add either new effects or change existing ones.

What complements a ton of towers and a lot of maps? A wide variety of enemies having different abilities, of course. From those that move faster around corners to those that teleport nearby enemies forward, the Axons are devious in their onslaught.

- 40 Towers and Traps

- 10 Castable Abilities

- Mechanics for Map Manipulation

- 35+ Unique Enemies

- Co-op with up to 4 Players

- Roguelite Survival Mode

- Campaign with 40 Levels

- PvP Mode with 4 Procedurally Generated Maps

- 21 Quickplay, 18 Co-op, and 4 Survival Maps

- Leaderboards for Quickplay, Co-op, and Survival

- Map Editor with Steam Workshop support

- Cosmetic customizations for Towers

With a wide selection of tower variations to upgrade and an array of complex strategic maps to test your defenses, even the most skilled Tower Defense players will meet a challenge in Axon TD.

games.name: Felvidek
games.shortDescription: In Felvidek, a JRPG set in 15th century Slovakia, you embrace the role of an alcoholic knight Pavol. Meet diverse and interesting characters to help you drive out the Hussites and Ottomans who blight this land.
games.aboutText:
Find out what unlikely events take place in this alternate history region of Slovak Highlands. This land is ravaged by Hussite pillagers and Ottoman spies while surreal horrors dwell in the dark. It's now up to Pavol, a fair knight with alcohol problems, to gather a party and stop those who oppose our kingdom.

GAMEPLAY

- Traverse the hand-painted world to explore castles, settlements, dungeons. Unveil secret doors and hidden passageways.

- Progress the story by meeting interesting characters, whether it be Catholics, Hussites or even more sinister folk.

- Fight your way through different enemies in turn-based RPG combat. Gather gear and supplies for your character.

- Completed in 3-4 hours.

games.name: Fiz and the Rainbow Planet
games.shortDescription: The unique little dragons run around with three buttons. A pixel art style 2.5D action game that goes beyond dimention! Fiz and the Rainbow Planet" is a 2.5D dot-picture action game in which players switch characters in a resourceful manner as they progress.
games.aboutText:
Control little dragons and explore a world full of gimmicks!



Fiz and the Rainbow Planet" is a 2.5D dot-picture action game in which players switch characters in a resourceful manner as they progress. In the work's "3D Protectorate Area" you can enjoy the distinctive game experience of progressing through a three-dimensional space while maintaining 2D graphics and controls.



~Story~

Somewhere in the universe is the planet Longa. One day, Fiz, a child dragon living on this planet, had a dream.

It was a terrifying nightmare in which the world turned black and white and all living creatures stopped moving.

When Fiz woke up, Taonga, the omniscient and omnipotent dragon who suddenly appeared in front of him, told him that the dream could happen in the future.

He also said that in order to change the future, Fiz, Taonga, and a total of seven other dragons must join forces to protect the orbs scattered throughout the world.

Hearing this, Fiz makes up his mind and sets off on an adventure to find his friends in order to protect the world. ......

games.name: The Button Effect
games.shortDescription: Every button has a purpose. In this short, minimalist first-person puzzler you explore a dense, interwoven architecture – a museum, full of hidden connections and spatial insights.
games.aboutText:
The Button Effect is a short, minimalist first-person puzzler in which every button has its purpose. Visit an elusive museum, full of hidden connections and spatial insights...

Challenge yourself to closely observe and interpret the effects of your actions to solve the exhibits on display. Every step and solution has the potential to teach you something new.

Open new doors to access deeply interconnected spaces and learn to appreciate the inner workings of its architecture. Let the calmness of this place encourage you to take your time.

Pay attention to the subtle details. Witness every change. Curiosity is rewarded with insight as you uncover meaningful links between all things. Discover secrets, hiding in plain view.

FEATURES

- Deeply interconnected puzzle exhibits designed to teach and intrigue you

- Various branching rooms to explore as you solve new sequences

- Collectible story fragments leading to a fully narrated ending

- Serene interiors complimented by pleasant piano music

- Simple control schemes to ensure accessibility

- Optional silent mode (muted voice-overs)

- Playable hints system

Note: This is a short (3-4 hour) game created by a solo developer.

games.name: Poke ALL Toads
games.shortDescription: A puzzle game starring mischievous fairies. Complete levels by working as a team, operating dangerous machinery and manipulating local wildlife.
games.aboutText:
A light-hearted game about mischief where you guide a band of fairies with a simple goal.

However toads don't like being poked and will not sit idle after the offense. Use the unique abilities of each fairy to get the upper hand or even turn the toads attack into your advantage. Protecting the blue fairy is all you need to worry about.

This is a puzzle game that puts its cartoony art as one of the main protagonists. Watch your fairies run around the world, sleep in inappropriate places, react to the environment or get flung into the air.

The game features over 100 levels in vibrant worlds, each one introducing new mysterious contraptions and tricky toad varieties. Learn how they work through observation and experimentation.

Learning, as well as getting punished by your actions, is part of the fun.

games.name: 花火与幽灵少女 - Hanabi and Ghost girl
games.shortDescription: 蝉鸣声中偏远的山中小镇，表面悠然而宁静，背后却隐藏着某个笼罩了这里数百年的黑暗秘密。女主角结城花火几年前跟随父母一同来到空铃镇，在父母的事故后因为内向的性格被排挤的她如今一个人生活在小镇上，直到在旧校舍邂逅本已死去的“幽灵”。
games.aboutText:
蝉鸣声中偏远的山中小镇，表面上随和实则却因封建迷信而变得十分异常的镇民。

几年前跟随父母一同来到空铃镇的女主角结城花火，在父母的事故后因为内向的性格被排挤的她如今一个人生活在小镇上，直到在旧校舍邂逅本已死去的“幽灵”。

从各种超自然现象的事件里找出隐藏在绚烂烟火中祭典之下的真相，在这个不同寻常的夏日里，体验此由制作者精心打造的日式像素风互动小说吧。

您或许可以从《花幽》体验到的：

- 时而有趣轻松、时而紧张刺激的剧情；

- 经典的日系RPG氛围，多结局分支的攻略；

- 常常会突破第四面墙的、各式各样有趣的ACG梗；

- 简单但并不无趣的解密等。

此外，游戏里还存在追逐战、一定程度的猎奇恐怖表现、轻百合、多个分支选项以及一些无厘头的奇怪要素。

通关游戏时长约3-8h左右（因个人游戏速度以及不同分支的收集数量会有一定程度改变）。

共拥有13个因选项分支进入的不同结局（含一个真结局）及13个被怪物杀死的死亡结局。

- 操作说明：

WASD键操控人物移动，ESC键可打开菜单（部分情况菜单会关闭），按下Enter与面前的物体进行互动

F4切换全屏/窗口，L键打开对话日志，在对话时，长按Enter或Ctrl可以以不同速度快进对话。

游戏也可以使用鼠标操作，但我们建议您只使用键盘。

- 游戏开始后，除自动存档外，需要玩家向游戏里出现的神秘小猫【米苏】投喂小鱼干，才能进行手动存档！

- 关于STAFF

制作人、编剧：怠怠Shina

美术：怠怠Shina、口蘑、愚者吃鱼、王潜、差异君

音效：怠怠shina

本地化（日语）：史泰达

玩家交流群：858937549

- （引用素材的来源可详见游戏内的ED）

games.name: Fragrance Point
games.shortDescription: What went wrong on Fragrance Point? Explore, hang out, and poke around where you're not supposed to.
games.aboutText:
We are speechless. After a hundred years of silence, research station Fragrance Point starts sending signals to earth. What does it mean? We are sending our most advanced security robot. Armed with lipstick, snazzy boots and a big heart, we are sure it will do the right thing. What will it find?

Fragrance Point is a digital paradise where you can do everything you want: Dress up, dance with aliens, and knock big things over. Make new friends, embarrass yourself in front of everyone, and you might just find a way into the station's core.

games.name: Elite Rogue
games.shortDescription: Elite Rogue – BOUNTIES. CHAOS. BETRAYAL. Every contract is a high-stakes gamble in this unpredictable roguelike! Hunt alone or with up to 10 players, earn Darkmatter to unlock game-breaking powers, manipulate reality, and outsmart rivals. Adapt or be erased. WISHLIST NOW!
games.aboutText:
CHOOSE YOUR CONTRACT

Every mission is a gamble—select from three randomized contracts before entering a new dimension. Each contract has a unique objective, from high-risk assassinations to dangerous extractions. Adapt, strategize, and survive against escalating threats. Succeed, and you’ll earn Darkmatter , a permanent currency that can be spent anywhere—during a mission or between runs—to unlock game-changing abilities, new classes, and cosmetics. But beware— the Contractor isn’t always on your side . Hidden risks lurk within each deal, and betrayal may come when you least expect it.

DEAL WITH SHADY TRADERS

Across dimensions, mysterious traders offer powerful gear —if you can afford their price. Weapon upgrades, gadgets, and rare artifacts can shift the odds in your favor, but some deals come with unseen consequences. Every item holds a piece of the world’s history, and hidden within their descriptions are cryptic clues about Mr. B, the enigmatic Contractor who controls your fate. Who is he? Why does he know so much? And more importantly—can he be trusted?

EVOLVE YOUR PLAYSTYLE

Choose from four unique characters , each with their own playstyle, strengths, and special abilities. Every dimension is different—face rogue AI warlords, space pirates, loot goblins, and other unpredictable threats. Side quests and hidden objectives reward risk-takers with rare loot and deeper secrets. With every contract, the universe reshapes itself, ensuring no two missions are ever the same.

PLAY SOLO OR WITH A CREW

Take on contracts alone or with up to 10 players in chaotic co-op action. Team up, combine abilities, and adapt to the ever-changing threats of each dimension. Choose from four distinct characters: Jack , the Scarecrow Bandit, a trickster with deadly precision; Roxan , the Time-Warped Mercenary, wielding futuristic tech; Roth , the Demigod, a force of raw destruction; and Bob , the Military Mechanic, a master of gadgets and heavy firepower.

games.name: GUNFIELD
games.shortDescription: GUNFIELD – A game that combines the genres: shoot 'em up, roguelite. Choose the perfect weapon combinations and upgrade your ship to destroy hordes of enemies and giant bosses, using strategy and a powerful arsenal.
games.aboutText:
Dive into epic battles! Choose the perfect combinations of different types of weapons and upgrade your ship throughout the adventure, creating unique combinations that will help you survive! Harness your skills to destroy hordes of alien ships and giant bosses, using strategy and a powerful arsenal.

GUNFIELD is perfect for fans of Vampire Survivors and lovers of vertical scrolling shooters like Tyrian . Combine your combat skills and tactical thinking to achieve victory in every battle!

What awaits you:

- Diverse builds: Create unique combinations of weapons and abilities in each run to become the true hero of the galaxy!

- Epic battles: Challenge entire alien armies and fight colossal bosses in dynamic, thrilling combat.

- Arsenal upgrades: Unlock and improve powerful weapons and abilities to become an unbeatable fighter!

- Variety of ships and pilots: Discover new ships, each with unique traits that influence your strategy.

- Exciting levels: Explore beautiful pixelated locations, uncovering new worlds and amazing adventures at every turn!

- Controls: Play using mouse, keyboard, joystick, or touchscreen – choose your preferred way and join the battle!

The time has come! Are you ready for the fight?

games.name: Neverway
games.shortDescription: After quitting her dead-end job, Fiona starts over on a farm and becomes the immortal herald of a dead god. Make friends, fight through horrors and pay your debt in this nightmarish life sim RPG.
games.aboutText:
Neverway is a blend of horror, life sim, and action RPG. After Fiona quits her job, she starts over on a farm and becomes the immortal herald of a dead god. Keep your life from falling apart while searching for Neverway, a nightmare reality that is slowly leaking into yours.

Co-directed by the pixel artist of Celeste and with music by Disasterpeace.

Meet (or date!) 10+ charming characters with unique routines and storylines. Each bond unlocks buffs and combat abilities that make your journey a little easier. Will you lie to them or tell them the truth?

Neverway features a top-down, fast-paced combat with an emphasis on player expression. Craft items to customize your playstyle, and unlock combat abilities through your friendship bonds.

Farm and craft items, prepare meals, or just decorate your homestead. Time progresses in three blocks, and you choose when to advance: morning, afternoon, and evening. One day at a time.

- Co-created by the pixel artist of Celeste

- Original soundtrack by Disasterpeace

- A slow-burning horror RPG with interactive cutscenes

- Meet or date 10+ charming characters

- Fast-paced combat, optimized for keyboard or controller

- Customize your playstyle with crafted items and combat abilities

- Farm, fish, craft, and build a new life on a remote island

Don't screw this up.

games.name: Genesis of a Small God
games.shortDescription: You have awoken as a small god. As you accumulate the faith and souls of your followers, you will learn incredible new abilities. Protect, guide your people and smite any threats that may arise. The fate of your world is in your hands.
games.aboutText:
" Genesis of a Small God is a god simulation !

Feel the power of being an all mighty god. Play on a generated island where you can do whatever you want. Learn how to be a god. Unlock mighty miracles and care for your faithfuls.

You are free to proceed however you want.

Will you grow food to feed them ?

Will you help them gather resources and build their village ?

Will you protect them from dangers ?

Will you use their remains to feed the remaining villagers ?

Miracles

Discover a wide variety of miracles. From the fireball that can burn an entire forest to summoning the rain that will grow the flora around, this game offers many different miracles. As you keep playing, you can unlock even more impressive miracles like throwing meteors or resurrecting the dead. You can even share them by ordaining priests.

A living island

You play on a procedurally generated voxel island you can modify it to your liking. The island is composed of a wide flora and fauna. The game offers simulated seasons where the plants bloom appropriately. Everything on the island is trying to survive and will react to your actions. Using the physics engine you can throw anything around. You can help, hinder or simply watch the creatures on the island.
