Care for your people

Your power comes from the faith of your people. Their belief will vary based on their living conditions. Are they fed ? Do they have shelter ? Are they being mangled by a hungry wolf ? The happier they are the more they will believe in you. Take care of them even when they die, you must reap their soul to prevent them from becoming angry ghosts.

Expanding village

Meanwhile the villagers will try to build and improve their village. You can influence their actions by terraforming the ground. And help them gather the necessary resources and even help them build their little economy. You can’t directly choose the building. But you can destroy any building you don’t agree with.

Wide variety of challenges

Protect your people from many dangers, from the horde of undead to abductions by an alien spaceship. There is never a dull moment. The game regularly triggers random events. You must react to those events or suffer the consequences. From invasive plants to strange astrological occurrences, you never know what’s going to happen.

Taking your time

The game is meant as a relaxing experience. You can always restart on a new island. You keep every unlocked power. You control the difficulty of the game to fit your play style. You can choose to play a stress free experience without any random event. Or you can choose a nightmarish experience where you are expected to solve multiple problems happening at once.

Speaking with me

Whether you prefer Discord or Steam forum, don’t hesitate to leave me a message. I am always on the lookout for feedback or cool new ideas to implement."

games.name: The Last Exam
games.shortDescription: Dylan hasn't left his home since the pandemic. As he struggles to move forward, his dreams pull him back to one day from his youth: the day of his final exam. Explore his memories in a hand-painted watercolor point-and-click adventure, solve puzzles, and uncover why he can’t let that day go.
games.aboutText:
Dylan is reliving the day of his final exam, a day that refuses to stay ordinary. In The Last Exam , you explore hand-painted watercolor scenes, talk to unusual characters, solve quiet observation-based puzzles, and move between reality and dreamlike versions of familiar places to uncover the memory Dylan has been avoiding.

Every location is created with traditional watercolor techniques, preserving the texture, warmth, and imperfections of physical materials.

Look closely, experiment with objects, and connect details in the environment. The puzzles are designed to feel woven into the story rather than separate from it.

Talk to people who seem real, remembered, exaggerated, or something in between.

Ordinary places shift into symbolic dream spaces shaped by memory, regret, and imagination. As fragmented memories resurface, you slowly piece together what really happened that day and why it still lingers.

🎮 Key Features

🎨 Hand-painted watercolor visuals on paper
Every scene is created with traditional watercolor techniques, preserving the texture, imperfections, and warmth of real materials.

🧩 Subtle, observation-based puzzles
Pay attention, experiment, and connect the pieces. The puzzles are quiet, intuitive, and woven into the world itself.

🌙 A dreamlike world between reality and imagination
Move seamlessly between grounded spaces and surreal interpretations shaped by memory.

🧠 A story about holding on and letting go
Explore themes of regret, self-forgiveness, and the difficulty of moving forward.

🎭 Unusual, quietly strange characters
Meet people who feel familiar… but not entirely real.

games.name: 1 Million Zombies
games.shortDescription: 1 Million Zombies is a casual arcade inspired game, where the players main goal is to destroy as many Zombies as possible with an Array of Vehicles and Weapons. Do you have what it takes to kill 1 Million Zombies?
games.aboutText:
1 Million Zombies is a post-apocalyptic action game where the player takes on a world overrun by hordes of the undead. The objective of the game is to survive as long as possible by driving a series of vehicles and eliminating as many zombies as possible.



The game features a variety of vehicles, from fast sports cars to heavy armored trucks, each with its unique strengths and weaknesses. The player must strategically choose the right vehicle for the job as they navigate through the different environments, such as city streets, rural areas, and highways.



The game is set in an open-world environment, and the player must explore different areas to scavenge for resources such as fuel, ammunition, and vehicle upgrades. Along the way, the player will encounter different types of zombies, each with its own unique abilities and weaknesses.



As the player progresses, they will encounter larger and more challenging zombie hordes, requiring them to use more advanced tactics and weaponry. The game also features a variety of missions and objectives that must be completed to progress to the next level.



1 Million Zombies is a thrilling and action-packed game that will keep players on the edge of their seats as they battle through waves of the undead. With its stunning graphics, intense gameplay, and challenging difficulty level, 1 Million Zombies is sure to be a hit with fans of the zombie genre.

games.name: Metal Bringer
games.shortDescription: In this roguelike action-adventure, control humanoid "Labor" and giant "Arms" to uncover the mysteries of the world. Create fully-customizable robots, strengthen them, and take down hordes of enemies!
games.aboutText:
In this roguelike action-adventure, control humanoid "Labor" and giant "Arms" to uncover the mysteries of the world.
A young girl named Suria wakes up in a laboratory and finds out that she has been put in cryosleep for 1000 years without her knowledge.
In order to search for the rest of humanity, she builds Labor with her trusty Buds, and sends them off to investigate... Highly Customizable Player Characters and Arms

Build and control android soldiers called "Labor", or have them pilot giant machines called "Arms". Each and every Labor and Arms you build is highly customizable. You can change the color and appearance of their features, or swap out parts to change their fighting styles. Create and fight with the mech of your dreams! Effortlessly Wipe Out Hordes of Enemies

Labor can be strengthened by installing different types of apps. App disks can be obtained by defeating enemies, but you lose all installed apps when you fall in battle.

However, by analyzing an app's data, you can use it when you customize your next Labor, allowing you to perform better each run until you can freely trample all over your opponents with ease. Obtain Enemy Arms Parts on the Go

Even the most powerful Arms will eventually wear down, but when that happens, you can use Arms parts left behind by the enemy.

What's more, you can analyze the blueprints of powerful Arms parts over the course of the game, which unlocks various customization options. Find out what kind of gear suits you best to build the ideal mech. Ray Tracing and Ever-Changing Music

This game uses the same retro art style as Samurai Bringer, but just like Samurai Bringer, it also implements a real time pixel art generating system, and will also feature the newest raytracing technology for beautifully lit environments.

The music too is made with the newest technology, as it is played in real time and changes according to the situation. The Story

The sky is blue, infinitely high, and infinitely vast...
Whose words were these again...?
Ah, I remember... It was about a virtual reality Rudra told me about.
A fairy tale.
How many years has it been since humanity took refuge underground?
No one alive has ever seen a blue sky.
And now, I'm trapped in the depths, in a small, lifeless room.
Just how long have I been here...?

games.name: FROM ASHES, BLOOM
games.shortDescription: A minimalist rogue-like tower defense where you protect Earth against humanity.
games.aboutText:
🌵 Protect the oldest tree on Earth from Humanity
🍀 Tear through hordes of enemies
🌷 Sow trees to help you
🌴 Active Tower Defense rogue-like gameplay
🌻 Personalize your creature with new attacks

🌿 Huge amount of upgrades
🏭 Various of starting situation with unique skins
👾 A never seen before character with 10/10 procedural animation
😇 Play as an invincible mass destruction weapon

games.name: Starship Colony
games.shortDescription: A deep starship colony sim. Build your starship, manage air, water, food, fuel, energy, temperature and psychology to keep your crew alive across vast distances. Closed-loop system in space. Mining, wiring, plumbing, in-ship factory, (alien?) radio signals & translation, diplomacy, combat, and more.
games.aboutText:
Starship Colony is a deep spaceship colony sim. Build your starship, manage air, water, food, fuel, energy, temperature and psychology to keep your crew alive across vast distances. Closed-loop system in space. Mining, wiring, plumbing, in-ship factory, (alien?) radio signals & translation, diplomacy, combat, and more.

Survival in Space is Hard

Resources are plentiful but you must journey across vast expanses of void to reach each oasis. This requires careful planning, efficient recycling, being self-sufficient, and a loyal crew. Beyond the human colonies there is nobody to call for help. Even the human colonies are full of dangers, with conflict and piracy rife in the outer regions. Desperate people do desperate things. And there are non-human radio signals that tell of dangers beyond.

You begin in command of a new starship with the very latest warp drive. You must assemble your ship and crew for the longest and greatest mission in human history. You start small, but pick up new crew members and expand your ship as you go.

- Build your starship, hull design, equipment, crew quarters, and furnishings.

- Manage air, water, food, fuel, energy, temperature and psychology to keep your crew alive.

- Closed-loop system in space. Recycle or die. Waste nothing.

- Mine ice to make water. Split it into O2 and H2 for air and rocket fuel.

- Mine ores and precious metals for trade or to expand your ship.

- Build a factory inside your ship to manufacture parts.

- Land on asteroids, moons and planets. Build outposts.

- Dock with space stations.

- Trade with human colonies and factions. Deal with (or engage in) theft and piracy.

- Realistic communications with radio signals. Decode (alien?) signals and decipher messages. Build your own language translation matrix.

- Pay your crew's wages and keep them fed to avoid them leaving or a full scale mutiny.

- Grow you own food, and try not to resort to cannibalism. (Having a friend for dinner can take on a whole new meaning!)

- Exploration of a vast galaxy with other factions and forces at work behind the scenes.

- And more!

Quick Backstory

It's been 30 years since the alien radio signal gifted humanity with warp technology, and humanity has spread like wildfire throughout the stars. But there are also other powerful forces that see our rise as a potential threat to be curtailed. We were warned about that too. Now that our understanding of warp technology has matured, it's finally possible to journey to more distant regions and get answers. Find the source of the transmission, make contact and seek their help against the threat. The Adventure Begins

Starship Colony is in development and hasn't been widely announced yet. However, the community is already building and we love getting feedback, so please wishlist and join our growing Discord server. It's a great opportunity to get involved and take part in alpha testing.

If you're looking for something like RimWorld in space, Oxygen Not Included, Dwarf Fortress, or Star Trek, we think you'll love this and would like to welcome you aboard. Please be patient though! Good things take time.. :)

Check out the website at BlackBeltSoftware dot com for dev log updates, join our Discord, and follow on Steam not to miss any important announcements, like play tests! ⠁⠇⠊⠑⠝⠀⠍⠑⠎⠎⠁⠛⠑⠎⠀⠁⠗⠑⠀⠑⠝⠉⠕⠙⠑⠙⠀⠊⠝⠀⠗⠁⠙⠊⠕⠀⠞⠗⠁⠝⠎⠍⠊⠎⠎⠊⠕⠝⠎⠲

games.name: Alpine Lake
games.shortDescription: Build, decorate, and customize every detail of your inn to welcome guests to your cozy escape in the woods. Entertain tourists, farm, cook meals, research wildlife, and ski, all while helping a colorful cast of townspeople save the struggling mountain town from a hostile takeover.
games.aboutText:
Shape your inn from the ground up by designing and constructing buildings entirely from scratch. Your imagination sets the limits, create any layout you can envision!

Many guest arrive with their own personality and narrative. Extend a warm welcome, provide them a cozy haven, and unravel the stories they carry within.

Embark on a journey through an expansive alpine region, uncovering hidden treasures and valuable resources. Bring along your faithful canine companion for a hike and see what buried goodies you might unearth along the way!

Engage with a lively community of townspeople, each with their own unique stories. Support your neighbors by sending your guests to local businesses, adding to the collective growth of the town.

Cultivate your own farm to harvest ingredients, ensuring delicious meals for your guests. Upgrade your kitchen and master an expanding assortment of recipes acquired on your journey! You may even build, decorate, and open a restaurant on your property for the best eating experience you can provide for your guests!

Lose yourself in one of the many relaxing activities, such as fishing, photography, and skiing.

games.name: Trackline Express
games.shortDescription: Embark on a thrilling journey through an unforgiving desert. You'll need to gather scarce resources and utilize your strategic and management skills to build a little train capable of overcoming attacks and fires.
games.aboutText:
Get your tickets to ride the Trackline Express today! Small disclaimer: there might be some missing rails sections. And occasional barbarian attacks. But don’t worry, our trains are the most reliable out there. Some just require a few upgrades here and there. Other than that, a perfectly fine ride is awaiting for you!
Did we mention wildfires?

Trackline Express is a train builder where you need to reach the stations while keeping your passenger safe from attacks and wildfires. Gather wood, rocks, ores, coal, and then transform them into various resources to create new buildings and equipment using blueprints that you unlock along the way.

The game offers a unique blend of gameplay elements that could appeal to players who enjoy strategy and resource management and to those looking for a more relaxed and cozy gaming experience with occasional exciting twists.

There aren't many resources in the desert, so you’ll have to think about how to use them in the best possible way.

You’ll need to collect enough coins to unlock blueprints in order to build anything. Once a blueprint is unlocked, it’s freely available. Coins are rare around there, so use them wisely.

With enough resources and the right blueprints, you can create multiple buildings and equipment to help you keep going forward and survive. What will you build first? A mine to get the coal for the train? Or maybe a well for your water tank? Unless you choose equipment to defend yourself against an upcoming threat... Each game is different and might require different prioritizations. Adaptation is key.

Attacks are frequent. You’ll have to fight to protect your convoy. Fortunately there are a few items you can use. As more passengers arrive, you’ll have to be more creative with how you use them.

Feed your train with coal, build new wagons and new equipment to defend against, well, basically everything. Try to automate things to keep moving as the game gets harder and harder with time and distance.

Bring your friends along for a ride! Join forces to tackle challenges on a journey to the final destination with Trackline Express multiplayer mode. Unite your strengths, strategically plan your next steps and defeat incoming threats!

You just want to play during a short break? We got you covered! The game comes with a Daily Challenge mode. Every day, a new randomly generated map will be available for everyone, so you can challenge yourself and your friends!

- high replayability value
- many items to gather and craft
- multiple game modes
- online and local (LAN) multiplayer mode (experimental)
- mini quests to complete
- random deterministic map generator

games.name: Space
games.shortDescription: A unique open-world space sandbox simulator set in the year 2343. Travel across the galaxy, trade, discover uncharted worlds, fight, build bases and factories, form alliances, and embark on new adventures!
games.aboutText:
About Space Game

Space is a unique open-world sandbox space simulator. You have complete freedom of decision and movement. You can travel to familiar places in the Solar System and adjacent systems, or explore over 6000 unexplored distant worlds.

All planets can be landed on and explored. Explore the universe, there are plenty of adventures waiting for you! Travel planets, cities, trade, fight, build factories and bases, colonise. You will also encounter alien life forms and experience many dangers.

History

The year is 2343. War has engulfed virtually the entire known galaxy. The entire free world has banded together to confront the ever-expanding aggressor, formed years ago by the merger of several major multinational corporations into a new state entity: the Holy Empire, headed by the Emperor. After the initial military successes of the Imperium, the forces have gradually become more evenly matched and everything is heading towards a long indecisive war. Until a mysterious new weapon is discovered that threatens the entire planet Earth.

Embark on an odyssey through the universe

Explore the universe, from our Solar System to 6 000 other planets. Discover barren moons and futuristic cities, witness black holes and anomalies as you roam among the stars.

Command spacecraft in thrilling space battles

Embark on lucrative military missions to earn your fortune, or venture to distant planets to hunt exotic creatures and unearth new life forms.

Master interstellar commerce

Forge alliances with over 30 nations and corporations as you build your reputation as a formidable trader. Upgrade your arsenal, sell new materials and earn a fortune.

Shape the universe

Establish thriving colonies and erect factories to sustain your prosperity. Delve into the depths of space to mine both known and mysterious materials.

Experience the universe in your own way

- Fly freely in the entire universe

- Explore Solar System and 6000 other planets

- Land and walk on any planet or star

- See black holes and other space anomalies

- Visit futuristic cities and bases

- Colonize and terraform planets

- Build factories to sustain your income

- Mine and sell know and unknow materials

- Earn money with military missions

- Fight in space with hostile vessels

- Hunt animals and new life forms on distant planets

- Trade with more than 30 nations and corporations

- Build your reputation

- Buy new space ships and weapons

- Create relationships with others

games.name: oneway.exe: Module 1.0
games.shortDescription: You’re stuck inside an abandoned video game, haunted by its own digital decay. In oneway.exe, uncover the mystery of UNTITLED.exe, its three developers, and the evolving Internet eras that once shaped their love. How does your story end? How did it ever begin?
games.aboutText:
oneway.exe is a first-person investigation puzzle horror game centered on story and internet culture. Explore the digital decay found within the unfinished game of UNTITLED.exe, and solve puzzles as you begin to piece together the story of the three developers who created it.

Face the internet horrors that haunt your past. The ones you've never heard of. They don't exist.

IS THIS THE WAY IT ALWAYS ENDS?

A Database Thriller.

Witness first-hand the horror genres that evolved alongside the digital world. Different corners of the internet tied by one story-line. One tragedy. One team.

games.name: Anseion - Fantasy MMORPG
games.shortDescription: Get ready for a journey to the world of Anseion, an immersive 2D MMORPG. Choose your faction: good or evil. Fight against players and monsters, explore the fascinating world, collect items and create your own. Make a unique character. Participate in events and faction battles, increase your rank.
games.aboutText:
ANSEION

Welcome to the extraordinary world of Anseion, where you decide which side you will stand on - good or evil. Choose your nation and start a great adventure! Fight against players of the opposing faction and monsters. Explore Anseion in search of new challenges and treasures.

CRAFTING

Collect valuable items, obtain raw materials and make new tools. Upgrade your equipment to strengthen your character and gain an advantage over your enemies.

PVP FIGHTS

PvP battles play a big role in Anseion. Fight against players from your own or the opposing nation. Advance in the rankings, becoming one of the most powerful players. Participate in cyclic battles between cities, where your skill and strategy will determine victory.

UNIQUE CHARACTER

Choose from a variety of attributes in which your character will excel. Decide whether a warrior would benefit from a few simple spells and a mage from the art of wielding a sword. Experiment and create a unique set of skills and equipment.

PVE FIGHTS

Many challenges await you as you fight a variety of monsters. Earn valuable experience and loot while fighting them.

TEAMS AND GUILDS

Fight as a team by creating teams and guilds. By acting together you will defeat tougher opponents. You will have the opportunity to meet new people and make friends.

COMMUNITY

Join a community where you can meet other players and have discussions about the game. I encourage you to share your opinions, suggestions and ideas about the development of Anseion. Together we can make it even better and more exciting!

ABOUT THE AUTHOR

As an independent game developer, I put a lot of work and passion into my projects. When designing Anseion, I used the knowledge and experience gained from developing two previous mmorpg games. Player feedback is very important to me, which allows me to improve the games.

Thank you for your support, and see you in Anseion!

games.name: Astrometica
games.shortDescription: Astrometica is a space exploration and base-building survival game. After a catastrophic event, explore vast space, gather resources, build bases, and uncover cosmic mysteries. Use advanced technology, craft tools, and discover new blueprints to survive and thrive in the unknown.
games.aboutText:
Immerse yourself in Astrometica, a space exploration and base-building survival game.

After an explosion at a mining space station, you awaken inside an emergency pod adrift in the vastness of space. To survive, you must harness your skills, explore the endless universe, and search for other survivors’ emergency pods or outposts.

Space Exploration:

Experience the thrill of exploring the vastness of space with cutting-edge technology. Navigate through asteroid belts, mysterious cosmic anomalies, and abandoned space stations using a variety of vehicles specially designed for deep space travel. Discover hidden secrets and uncover the mysteries of the cosmos as you chart a course through the unknown. Every corner of space holds a new discovery, whether it's a new resource, a signal from another survivor, or a piece of lost technology waiting to be found.

Base Building:

Build and expand your own bases across the stars. In Astrometica, base building is key to your survival and exploration. Construct modular bases to serve as safe havens, research facilities, or resource gathering outposts. Automate mining operations to extract valuable resources from asteroids and deposits. Design your bases to be both functional and fortified, ensuring they can withstand the harsh conditions of space and potential threats. As you explore, you'll unlock new blueprints to further enhance and customize your bases, making each outpost uniquely yours.

Mining and Tools:

Equip yourself with a variety of tools to mine for essential resources and salvage valuable materials. Craft and upgrade tools like drills, mining lasers, and scrappers to efficiently gather resources needed for survival and expansion. The more you explore and mine, the more you uncover rare materials that can be used to create advanced technologies and powerful equipment. Your tools are your lifeline in space; maintaining and upgrading them is crucial to your survival and success in the unforgiving environment of deep space.

Scanning Environment:

Utilize advanced scanning tools to survey your surroundings and discover new blueprints and technologies. When you come across other survivors' outposts or wreckages, use your scanner to analyze fragments and gain insights into new crafting recipes and tech upgrades. Scanning isn't just about finding new gear—it's about piecing together the story of what happened and understanding the universe around you. With each scan, you get closer to unraveling the mysteries of Astrometica and finding the means to thrive in space.

Astrometica is more than just survival—it's about exploring the unknown, building a life among the stars, and uncovering the secrets hidden in the vast cosmos.

games.name: Lost Hellden
games.shortDescription: Resist your Sin. Reclaim your fate. Lost Hellden is an action JRPG from a team of genre veterans, featuring a gorgeous hand-painted 3D art style, a vast world to explore, and a unique phased battle system that blends turn-based and real-time combat.
games.aboutText:
Under the religion of Unio, the people of Era live their lives bound to one of the Seven Deadly Sins. Those who resist their urges are promised eternity in the sacred land of Hellden. But for those who succumb, a fate worse than death awaits.

Lost Hellden is a classically inspired action JRPG set in a gorgeous hand-painted 3D world, featuring illustrations by Takeshi Oga ( Gravity Rush ) and a soundtrack by Hitoshi Sakimoto ( Final Fantasy XII, Final Fantasy Tactics, Valkyria Chronicles ). Follow eight highly customisable characters on a journey through Era and beyond, and master a phased battle system that balances real-time and turn-based combat.

A Story of Sin and Self-Discovery

The birth of twins is a terrible omen. The binding ritual fails, leaving Cyphel born without sin and Leht bound to all seven. The babies are hidden away in the Unio Temple to be raised as Arkhons, defenders of the faith.

Years later, Leht escapes, driven to overcome his unique burden. Cyphel must leave the safety of the temple to find him, and is thrust into a world of monsters, rebels, and celestial conspiracy. Lost Hellden tells a rich story of self-discovery, family, and fate, fully voiced in Japanese and English.

A New Form of Combat

A unique phased battle system combines the thrill of real-time action with the tactical possibilities of turn-based combat. Leverage timing, positioning, elemental attributes and whole-team commands as you attack and defend against enemies monstrous and divine. Utilise powerful Transcendence abilities to turn the tide of battle. Fine-tune your party with a multi-layered job system, ability tree, and a wide range of equipment options to secure victory.

A Hand-Painted World to Explore

Step into the box art of a classic JRPG thanks to a unique ‘Deep 2D’ art style, with contributions from Takeshi Oga ( Gravity Rush ). Lost Hellden’s aesthetics are underpinned by a gorgeous soundtrack by Hitoshi Sakimoto ( Final Fantasy XII, Final Fantasy Tactics, Valkyria Chronicles ).

Secrets lurk behind every corner: explore the world for hidden items, collectables, and enemies. Take advantage of changes in weather and special abilities to meet NPCs and new areas. Help those you meet on your journey, or while away the day mastering Era’s most popular board game, Hexaken.

games.name: Tempus Vitae
games.shortDescription: You are Alex, a time-displaced astronaut unraveling the space station Theia doomed in both the war-torn 2185 and the post-apocalyptic 2385 to find your lost brother. Master an arsenal of time travel abilities and weapons in this sci-fi metroidvania FPS: Tempus Vitae.
games.aboutText:
Separated from your brother, you, Alex, appear on an unknown, futuristic space station. The dead pile around you: a war seems to be going on. You are led to an impossible technology that allows you to travel 200 years into the future and back, only to find more destruction, more death, and unknown dangers. Where is Adrian?

Find the source of this century-spanning conflict. Rescue your brother. Save your life.

Explore multiple areas and times of the futuristic space station Theia

Where there once was a place of scientific research, Alex will find a hostile labyrinth to overcome and a conflict that is more complex than it seems. Jump in time between two dangerous periods:

- 2185 - The theater of a guerrilla war between rebel scientists and the ruthless Lawkeepers from Earth.

- 2385 - A dystopian post-apocalypse of dark, rusted ruins; devoid of human life but swarmed by mad monsters.

Use the differences to chart a way through and find resources, questions, answers, and the power to reshape history. Be careful: what you do in the present will affect the future.

An unprecedented crossroads: TIME TRAVEL, FIRST PERSON SHOOTER, METROIDVANIA

- Explore non-linear, interconnected paths and unlock new ones as you gain weapons and powers.

- Face formidable bosses with complex behaviors for fast-paced, precision combat.

- Follow a interwoven narrative with objectives, quests, and an NPC dialogue system.

- Explore different areas with clearly defined aesthetics, hazards and stories.

- Use save points and fast travel Anchors as the world grows bigger.

- Find currency, collectibles, shops and upgrades.

Master an arsenal of time travel abilities and weapons

How can a pistol that shoots back in time be used to open a locked door? Like keys to open a door, gather tools to advance and defeat your enemies. Stop time and freeze the bullets of your enemies in mid-air, find temporal anomalies to nudge history to your advantage, fast-forward in time to build momentum, use temporal displacement to travel from one corner of Theia to the other, and much more in the ultimate time travel game.

games.name: Hollow Home
games.shortDescription: A narrative survival RPG set in a city under siege. No weapons, no combat, just the choices you make and the people you make them for. Inspired by real events. Made in Ukraine.
games.aboutText:
When Maksym wakes up one morning, his country has been invaded and everything in his world has changed.

Hollow Home is a narrative survival RPG set in a city under siege. You are Maksym, 14 years old, alone and trying to survive. He must choose how to spend each day carefully, and every choice has consequences for him and those around him.

No Combat, Just Choices & Consequences

Survival means dialogue, difficult choices, and learning to live with the consequences. Manage Maksym's Resolve as the pressure mounts with every passing day. Every decision has a cost. Not all of them can be undone.

The City Changes More Each Day

Explore multiple districts, each changing a little more with each passing day. Buildings are shelled. Streets are cut off. Districts close. Familiar faces vanish.

Every Conversation Carries Weight

Deep dialogue and branching questlines. Every character has a story and your actions shape what comes next.

Each day forces you to prioritise, sacrifice and decide who matters most. You cannot do everything. You cannot help everyone. Multiple endings reflect the choices you made and the people you were and were not able to reach.

Built from Real Events

Hollow Home draws on real events from the 2022 invasion of Ukraine. It is developed by Twigames in Kyiv, a team living through the same war and researching the stories of those who survived the siege.

In partnership with Ukrainian Radio , Ukraine's public broadcaster since 1924, Hollow Home features real archive recordings from the first days of the full-scale invasion, letting players hear what the people of Ukraine actually heard.

After a successful campaign, Hollow Home was 140% funded on Kickstarter by players around the world. They helped this story to reach more people.

Features

- No combat , just choices and consequences. Survival through dialogue, choice and human connection.

- Manage Maksym's Resolve daily. Keep him going when the city and everything in it is pushing back.

- You cannot help everyone . Limited daily resources mean making difficult decisions about who to spend your time with and when.

- Deep dialogue and branching questlines . Multiple endings shaped by every decision you make.

- A city that changes daily . Multiple explorable districts closing in around you as the siege tightens.

- Real archive recordings from Ukrainian Radio . Hear what the people of Ukraine actually heard when the invasion began.

Awards & Recognition

- Games Gathering 2024 - Best Conference Game & Game Star (Winner)

- Nordic Game 2024 - Pitch Battle (Winner)

- Indie Cup Ukraine 2023 - Most Promising Game & Critics' Choice (Winner)

- GDWC 2023 - Studio Award (Nominee)

games.name: Neko's Rage
games.shortDescription: Neko's Rage is a pixel art rogue-lite platformer set in a post apocalyptic future overrun with dangerous biomechanical robots. Play as the cyber Neko-01 unit and collect always more loots to upgrade your Hub and character.
games.aboutText:
Neko's Rage is a very dynamic 2D action game in which you play as a cyborg. Fight hordes of robots and collect more resources to improve your character, your equipments and to restore your hub.
Rush to explode the bio-robotic creatures which are spreading more and more quickly in the differents biomes, the more time passes and the more hostile the environment becomes.
A post apocalyptic future

In 2130 human beings become obsolete and unadapted to the world's pandemic and climatic conditions, bio-mechanical creatures have become the dominant species, but to awaken they need one of the last biological sources of energy on earth , the humans ...
Neko Units are invented to fight and free captive humans of the machines's incubation nests.
Gameplay and a lot of action

You will gain powers with a lots of upgrades and equipments to buy in Gentech's laboratory but also in battle's stages with a lots of differents capacities amplificators or by killing enemies without taking damage.
The Neko-chain

A chain counter that totals the number of enemies killed in a row, this influences the player's luck rate and allows you to obtain more items and better qualities in chests or by killing enemies.
The overheat and enraged mode

When the destruction of enemies is linked without being hit your character will go into enraged mode, increased critical hit rate, more speed and the possibility of cross dash attacks to generate even more damage and experience.
Stage procedural building

The stages are proceduraly generated to make every run different and fun.

Find cracked walls for more resources

Find invisible chest

Fight dangerous foes

Buy upgrades and equipment at Gentech

Test your skill to collect more resources

games.name: Secrets of Magonia
games.shortDescription: In this tower defence game, you enter the world of Magonia and defend it against hordes of humans, orcs, ogres and other evil forces. Fight in different areas and adapt your strategy to the terrain and the enemy forces.
games.aboutText:
In this tower defense you enter the world of Magonia and defend it against hordes of humans, orcs, ogres and other evil forces. Fight in green graslands, dusty deserts, rocky hills, lush forests and icy tundras, adapting your strategy to the terrain and the enemy forces. Call down meteors from the sky or call reinforcements to assist you in the battle. Expand your arsenal of towers and equip them with items you loot from mighty bosses. Level up your house and learn skills to improve your towers or spells.

Important Features

- Around 20 unique maps

- Hundreds of enemies and bosses

- 8 unique base towers with three base tiers and two special tiers each

- Each special tower has four different upgrades

- An extensive skilltree with around 100 different skills and spellcards

- 5 completely unique spells with upgrades

- Items which can be equipped by towers

- Challenging endgame

- Dynamic difficulty system in form of wave modifiers (additional enemies, strengths etc.)

No chickens were harmed during the development of this game.

games.name: Outlaw Raiders
games.shortDescription: Lead your outlaw crew on raids to rob, steal, and fight for riches. Build up your camp and recruit more outlaws so you can become the ultimate outlaw.
games.aboutText:
Outlaw Raiders is Strategic Auto Battler with Roguelike elements. Lead your outlaw crew on raids to rob, steal, and fight for riches. Build up your camp and recruit more outlaws so you can become the ultimate outlaw.

Strategy is crucial in ambushing unsuspecting travelers. Outlaw Raiders allows you to plan your strategic ambushes in your style.

Enemies have their own strategies for ensuring safe travel. Watch the enemy patrols carefully to find the best opportunity for attack.

When you feel the time is right, signal groups of units to attack, sending them all in one go or sending out groups in waves.

Traverse the roads. Each run presents a new path filled with branching choices, dangerous encounters, events, and rewards.

Even outlaws need a place to call home, so build up your outlaw camp with new buildings, unlock additional outlaws.

Choose between 4 commanders that comes with unique playstyle, events, units.

games.name: Speed Crew
games.shortDescription: Arrange a pit crew of 1-4 members and, amidst total chaos, secure the gold in 4 decades of racing championships against the mighty Dominion Torrento. Retro vibes and buckets of stress blend in this friendship-testing party game, where you fix stylish sports cars in both local and online co-op.
games.aboutText:
Get ready

Gather your elite pit stop crew of 1-4 players for a high-octane experience, available both online and locally (likely on your friend's couch). Participate in racing championships, repair arriving cars, navigate challenges like shifting platforms and Dominion Torrento, and secure your victory. A fun and chaotic adventure spanning four decades, from the 70s to the 00s, awaits you.

Build your Crew

Build your pit crew with up to 4 members, assign tasks, and execute clean repairs to double your points and win championships. Teamwork is the key to your success! As a party game, we highly recommend playing it with your family and friends to unlock maximum mayhem. While enjoying it solo might seem less stressful, rest assured, chaos will still be your constant companion.

Fix Cars

Your task is to get your driver back on track as quickly as possible. With this in mind, you'll need to diagnose car issues, make efficient repairs using a variety of tools, and navigate dynamic, hazard-filled pit lanes. Aim for Gold in the championships and give a slap to annoying Dominion Torrento. Also, don’t forget to slap your comrades for proper motivation too.

Win races

Explore 48 levels in 4 Chapters, unlock sponsored races to find hidden prizes – there’s always a new challenge awaiting. Storm, rain, lava – nothing can stop your team! Discover the entertaining, voiced, and animated story of your crew and their rivalry with Dominion across four decades of championships.

Be stylish

Win races to unlock new characters, collect various looks and create your own fun way to mess with your teammates. Why limit yourself to the chaos on the pit lane when you can also make some of your own?

Unlock Arcade mode for more challenges

Ruin your teammates' championship while being Dominion Torrento himself. Spoil everything they are doing; your goal is to make them suffer sore losers, while their goal is to win no matter what and give you a slap. True friendship level unlocked!

KEY FEATURES:

- Local and online multiplayer options.

- Engaging storyline with animated and voiced cinematics, featuring 4 racing championships spanning 4 decades.

- Unique 48 levels to explore.

- Arcade mode for those seeking true challenges.

- Dynamic pit lane filled with a variety of tools, hazards, and car issues to keep the action intense.

- Customization: pick your character, hat, and costume color.

- Stylized 3D graphics with a retro touch and custom-made soundtrack for each decade.

- Suitable for all ages and skill levels.

- Slaps! Slap Dominion, slap cars, slap your teammates, slap that release button. Become a true pit stop tyrant!

[/url]
[b]Join the Speed Crew Discord community![/b
Join the Speed Crew Discord community!

games.name: ISLANDERS: New Shores
games.shortDescription: Welcome to ISLANDERS: New Shores. Build your island retreat in a calm, minimalist world with exciting new features that keep the classic charm while inspiring fresh creativity.
games.aboutText:
The next chapter in the beloved minimalist city-building franchise is here. ISLANDERS: New Shores invites you back to a world of tranquil creativity, now reimagined with expanded gameplay, stunning visuals, and a host of fresh features that build on the charm of the original.

Whether you're a longtime fan or a newcomer, prepare to explore, build, and strategise like never before. Build Your Dream Cities Across 50 Unique Levels

Explore over 44 building types across 6 diverse biomes, each available in 4 vibrant colour variations, letting you customise your strategy and create truly unique cities.

Choose your mode of play; High Score Mode for those who love a competitive twist, or Sandbox Mode to let your creativity run wild.

Experience a World of New Features

Photo Mode - Capture and share your stunning island creations with customisable filters and a turntable camera.

Expanded Soundtrack - Enjoy 75 minutes of original music that sets the perfect mood for your building adventures.

Dynamic Scoring Systems - Master innovative scoring methods - such as line of sight, distance bonuses, and inter-island strategies - to enhance your gameplay.

Boons - Unlock single-use power-ups that give you unique tactical advantages as you progress.

Twitch Integration - Streamers can now engage their audiences directly with interactive features built into the game.

A Visual Overhaul That Elevates the Experience

With a complete reimagining of the minimalist aesthetic, ISLANDERS: New Shores delivers a visual feast that complements its deep, strategic gameplay. Whether you’re here to relax or to challenge your building skills, every new shore offers a fresh canvas for creativity. Key Features

- Two modes: High Score and Sandbox (with separate saves)
- 44 unique building types and 7 island properties
- 50 dynamic island generators offering endless variety
- Photo Mode with filters and a turntable camera
- 75 minutes of original, immersive music
- Boons: new one-time power-ups for strategic gameplay
- Advanced scoring systems that reward clever tactics
- Twitch integration for an interactive streaming experience

ISLANDERS: New Shores - where every island is a new adventure, and every build is a chance to create something extraordinary.

games.name: Re:Night
games.shortDescription: Re:Night is a strategy game that blends turn based tactics with roguelike deckbuilding. In each run, build your deck, plan your tactics, and experiment with countless 3-character team combinations. Journey to a mysterious town, break the endless cycle of night, and bring dawn back to the world.
games.aboutText:
Re:Night is a strategy game that combines turn-based tactical combat with roguelike deckbuilding. Build your deck over the course of each run while navigating battlefields filled with tactical possibilities. Any combination of three characters can create more than 20 unique builds, and the interaction between multiple strategic systems delivers deep, rewarding, and highly replayable combat.

Travel to a mysterious town, break the endless cycle of night with your own hands, and restore dawn to the world.

Tactical combat introduces strategic mechanics such as frontline and backline positioning, flanking, blocking, and protecting allies. Combined with elemental counters, equipment, and item effects, these systems create countless opportunities for powerful combinations.

Command three characters simultaneously in every battle, each with a distinct role. Whether focusing on burst damage, battlefield control, healing, or environmental interactions, careful coordination and party synergy are the keys to victory.

Fire, Water, and Grass form a cyclical elemental counter system. Exploit elemental advantages to unleash devastating critical hits and deal massive damage.

Coordinate your three characters to trigger elemental critical hits while positioning them to deny your enemies the same advantage. Every move requires careful planning, but victory also depends on adapting to an ever-changing battlefield.

Every character features unique talents and an exclusive pool of character-specific cards. Combine more than 300 cards with over 200 pieces of equipment and items to create more than 20 distinct builds for any three-character party.

Become an unstoppable brawler, a demolition expert, or a relentless lancer. Even the stone walls of the battlefield can become powerful weapons. In Re:Night, your imagination is your greatest strength.

Undo your last action, rewind to the start of the current turn, or even restart the battle from the very beginning at any time. Never let a single mistake ruin your adventure, and face unfamiliar enemies with the freedom to explore different strategies.

Study enemy behavior, experiment with different positioning, card sequences, and elemental combinations, then use each rewind to test new ideas, refine your strategy, and discover your own path to victory.

Every run offers a fresh adventure, with diverse maps, random events, challenging battles, and unexpected encounters waiting to be discovered.

Begin your journey beside the stream outside the town, venture through the dangers hidden within the village, and ultimately ascend to a castle shrouded in mystery. With every adventure, you'll unlock new content, playable characters, and even greater challenges to overcome.

Each character has their own memory fragments, known as Chrono Shards. Collect them to unlock hidden cards and equipment, expanding your tactical options with every discovery.

Gather every Chrono Shard to uncover the truth behind the endless cycle of night.

games.name: Mercenaries of the Kingdom: First Blood
games.shortDescription: Party-based rogue-lite RPG set in Earthial, a fantasy world. Hire various races of mercenaries, equip them, create battle formations, and grab the loot! Kill tens of thousands of enemies using steel and spells!
games.aboutText:
INTRODUCTION:

In MOTK: FB, you are a mercenary who finds himself, for some still unknown reason, having to face hundreds of thousands of enemies he has never faced before.

To survive, you must recruit new mercenaries, feed, equip, and train them.
To do this, you need to collect coins and find out what fate offers you in various loot and dead enemies.

There are TWO modes:
- QUICK BATTLE : play a quick game without too many worries.
The most powerful weapons in the game are not included in this mode, and there is only one match type.
- ADVENTURE : face the enemy hordes day after day to collect their loot and increasingly improve your band of mercenaries.
All weapons are unlocked, there are multiple mission types, you have to manage your base and craft all items, but deaths are permanent.
To return safely home with the loot in battle, you will have to call a portal and extract it together with your men. CHARACTERISTICS:

- Customize the aesthetics and function of your mercenaries: model armored infantrymen, wizards, heavy knights, horse archers, crossbowmen, musketeers, ninjas, and thousands of other variations.

- 6 races: Humans, Orcs, Light Elves, Dark Elves, Dwarves, Goblins.

- 12 magical knowledge: Fire, Water, Earth, Ice, Electricity, Poison, Light, Darkness, Cosmos, Vampire, Demon, Hellfire!

- 210+ weapons, 650+ armor components, a large variety of magic items, and 4 types of mounts (horse, boar, wolf, elk)!!!

- Hire potentially hundreds of mercenaries in your group.

- You can create formations to deploy in battle.

- More than 140 different enemies!!! FACE THE HORDE, GRAB THE LOOT, CROSS THE PORTAL.

games.name: Mariachi Legends
games.shortDescription: Mariachi Legends is a brutal, pixel art, combat-oriented Metroidvania set in the heart of Mexico.You play as Pablo Cruz, a detective who has agreed to a deal with Death herself. She has given Pablo the ability to transform into the mighty La Sombra allowing him to fight back against evil.
games.aboutText:
Mariachi Legends is a brutal, pixel art, combat-oriented Metroidvania set in the heart of Mexico. You play as Pablo Cruz, a detective who has agreed to a deal with Death herself. She has given Pablo the ability to transform into the mighty La Sombra, allowing him to fight back against the criminals encroaching on his hometown. In return, Pablo has vowed to bring Madre Catrina the one thing that has eluded her grasp: the man who defied her power and became immortal.

- Test your reflexes and showcase your unique fighting style as you loot and level up.

- Perfect your parry skills and enjoy the brutal combat filled with finishers.

- Find and equip a vast array of weapons and sub-weapons to personalize your fighting style. From guns and swords to whips and magical casts, venturing through the alleys is sure to prove dynamic!

- Constantly obtain new abilities that will make you even more powerful as the story unfolds.

Welcome to Santa Mascota, a small town known for it’s lively streets, colorful residents and, most recently, a streak of bad luck laced with danger.

Somebody has to bring Santa Mascota’s good fortune back, and you’re best suited given your track-record.

- Embrace your detective skills to find abandoned corpses, interrogate suspects and ultimately solve the mystery surrounding several deaths in town.

- Watch as your hometown becomes alive and the townsfolk will open shops, share a drink, and even offer challenging side-quests.

- Have your fortune told by Madre Catrina at the beginning of the game to determine your unique circumstances and abilities.

- In the game, look for several Tarot cards during your journey and explore the different sorts of power they can provide. Find them all and become unstoppable.

- Explore a giant dual map that turns familiar paths into renewed challenges.

- The Day, Night, and Full Moon System offers numerous opportunities to revisit locations, each time with distinctive changes that renew your experience and redefine entire areas.

- Locate Sun and Moon gates and interact with them at the right time to unlock hidden areas and coveted collectables. And if you can brave those areas at night, you’ll find yourself hunted by all manner of nocturnal creatures that inject new life into conquered territories, reshaping your adventure.

- Discover recipes, collect ingredients, cook dishes and persuade NPCs.

- Explore the world around you to collect a variety of ingredients featured in Mexican cuisine and prepare traditional dishes to honor your ancestors.

- Find strength and power to help in your mission in every dish.

games.name: Mayor May Knott
games.shortDescription: A creepy-cozy 3D adventure game about solving puzzles, rebuilding a haunted ghost town, meeting weird creatures, and listening to ridiculous music!
games.aboutText:
Fix up a haunted ghost town!

Befriend terrifying monsters!

Solve lots of puzzles!

Listen to over 30 ridiculous original songs to learn crafting recipes!

Get your fortune told by a sandwich!

Mayor May Knott is a “ creepy-cozy ” 3D adventure game about a shy girl who accidentally becomes mayor of a haunted ghost town .

Initially, May runs in fear from the monsters lurking about! But as she explores the town, solves puzzles , plays minigames , and fixes up houses and buildings , she becomes more confident, overcomes her fears, and discovers that the monsters are actually all very friendly and would love to help May around town!

Eventually, with the help of her newfound friends, May turns the abandoned ghost town into a thriving community, filled with a variety of delightfully creepy creatures.

Over 30 Unique Characters!

Repair machines with Grandfather Clock , the clockwork retired rapper. Join Reel McKoi in fishing junk out of the polluted lake. Get your fortune read by the mysterious, sandwich-headed Madame Pastrami . And get insulted by Dick Tater , tyrannical owner of Glitzberg, the seedy apartment complex next door.

And that's just in the first 5 minutes!

Over 30 Ridiculous, Original, Professionally-Produced Songs!

Throughout the game, you'll find " records " to play on the Edjukebox in the Hall of Records . Those records teach you new recipes by playing original, professionally-produced songs spanning a huge range of genres -- from rap to rock , country to punk , girl-band to boy-band , and beyond !

Talk To Ghosts!

Early in the game, May finds and fixes up a device for talking to ghosts. An “ Ectophone ” if you will. With the Ectophone, May can talk to the many ghosts haunting the houses around town, and try to help them remember their names.

Listen to Records on the Edjukebox!

Once May knows a ghost’s name, she can find their “ record ” in the Hall of Records , a combination record store and city archives. The Hall of Records is also home to the “ Edjukebox ”, a machine used to play the original, professionally-produced song on each record!

By listening to a new record, May learns a new crafting or cooking recipe ! This is called “Edjuke-ation”.

Cook and Craft!

Armed with the recipes from the Edjukebox, May can cook and craft exactly what each ghost needs to move on, leaving behind the key to their house !

Invite Monsters to Live in Your Town!

The game cycles between day and night , and monsters have their own schedules of things to do. Sometimes the secret to making a new friend is to catch them at the right time, meet them in the right place, or build up the courage to talk to them!

By getting house keys from ghosts, and giving them to the monsters you meet, you can make them permanent residents of your town! Each new resident helps out around the town in some way, and as you add them to your town you gain new options and opportunities to meet new ghosts and monsters, solve puzzles, play minigames, and explore new areas!

Solve Puzzles!

Mayor May Knott is brimming with puzzles and minigames, whether it’s a puzzle to deduce the name of a ghost , a quest to find ingredients for a tricky recipe , or a minigame to befriend a new monster .

There’s even a spooky abandoned mine / bowling alley , a haunted mansion full of puzzles , and a creepy endless hallway stalked by a terrifying creature!

Build a Thriving Community!

As you unlock new areas, repair houses and buildings, and move new residents to your town, you breathe new life into your abandoned ghost town, turning it into a happy thriving community .

Perhaps eventually you can convince all of the monsters to live in your town… even the tyrannical Dick Tater !

games.name: Settlements Rising
games.shortDescription: Settlements Rising is a medieval city building and colony management game. It offers a lively colony experience with simulated villagers, dozens of professions and resources, natural disasters, and raids, while providing full control over the colony through trade, production chains and datas.
games.aboutText:
Settlements Rising is a city-building and colony management simulation game set in medieval times. The game offers extensive depth with dozens of professions and resources available to the player. Each profession features villagers with their own animations and work cycles, creating a living colony experience in the game. It allows for micromanagement through trade, limited resources, production chains, and production data.

Villagers have their own life cycles. They can work in over 35 different professions. Each villager has needs for hunger, energy, health, and warmth. When they're hungry, they eat, and when their inventory runs out of food, they purchase more. When their energy depletes while working or during cold weather, they return home to rest. They are born, grow, receive education, and eventually age and pass away. They gain experience in their jobs. They acquire character traits either from birth or later in life.

At specific intervals, you will be presented with a set of random cards from which you can choose the one that best suits your needs. You can use these enhancement cards according to your requirements. These cards are for single use, but you can choose to save them for future games. In each new game, you can start with a few of the cards you've saved.

In the game, you can earn gold by mining, trading, and conducting raids. Traders visit your village at regular intervals. They buy some resources and sell others. The prices vary from one trader to another, allowing you to buy low and sell high. Additionally, build trading ships and manage your resources by trading with neighboring villages based on the resources they import and export.

Construct exploration ships for exploration missions and send them out. Depending on the mission's risk, you can earn various rewards. These rewards can be gold, resources, or enhancement cards.

As the resources of your village increase, raiders will periodically attack, attempting to plunder your resources. To defend against raiders, build towers and walls. Train villagers as archers or swordsmen, hiring them as military units for a certain salary.

games.name: Balatro
games.shortDescription: The poker roguelike. Balatro is a hypnotically satisfying deckbuilder where you play illegal poker hands, discover game-changing jokers, and trigger adrenaline-pumping, outrageous combos.
games.aboutText:
Balatro is a poker-inspired roguelike deck builder all about creating powerful synergies and winning big.

Combine valid poker hands with unique Joker cards in order to create varied synergies and builds. Earn enough chips to beat devious blinds, all while uncovering hidden bonus hands and decks as you progress. You’re going to need every edge you can get in order to reach the boss blind, beat the final ante and secure victory.

- The definitive poker roguelike experience.

- Endless possibilities - every pick-up, discard and joker can dramatically alter the course of your run.

- In-depth campaign mode complete with 8 difficulties, as well as challenge and seeded runs.

Deftly deploy an array of potent tools: different Decks, Jokers, Tarot cards, Planet cards, Spectral cards, and Vouchers. Use these versatile instruments to ignite a combo frenzy and turbocharge your poker hands, crafting electrifying, adrenaline-fueled synergies.

- 150 Jokers, each with their own unique abilities

- 15 Decks with distinct modifiers to choose from for each run

- 5 potential variants of each Joker which add further abilities

- 22 Tarot cards variants that can enhance your regular playing cards

- 11 Planet cards that help level up your possible poker hands

- 32 Voucher cards to help provide permanent buffs for your current run

Immerse yourself in Balatro’s distinctive psychedelic world. Let the synthwave soundtrack wash over you - wind down, escape the daily grind and prepare to enter the ultimate roguelike flow state.

- Improve your collection and discover new cards and secrets with every single run.

- Make use of the in-depth stats screen to study your best hands, most used Jokers, and more!

- Immerse yourself in the CRT fuzz and enjoy detailed, hand-crafted pixel art.

games.name: Super 10 Pin
games.shortDescription: Strike your way through a world of bowling in Super 10 Pin! Use special abilities to jump, explode, and boost down 64-bit styled bowling lanes in this wild arcade bowling game!
games.aboutText:
Strike your way through a wild world of bowling in Super 10 Pin! Explore a diverse range of 64-bit styled bowling lanes, filled with curves, jumps, traps, obstacles and surprises! Make your ball grow, fly through the air, and even explode as you master unique ball abilities to overcome any obstacle thrown your way.

Features

- Control is Key
Master Super 10 Pin's unique bowling mechanics to steer your ball into the perfect position! Timing a perfect throw will fill up your invaluable "Spin" meter, used to control your ball as it speeds down the lane!

- Over 50 Wild Lanes
Bowl on lanes that defy gravity, challenge your skills in obstacle-filled gauntlets, and roll your way through unexpected surprises in locations you've never imagined!

- The Right Ball for the Job
Keep an eye out for special ball pickups as you head for a strike, they have powerful abilities that will help you surmount any obstacle on your quest for the perfect game.

- Collectables and Unlockables
Aim for perfect scores to unlock new worlds and lanes. Collect challenging bonus stars to score an immediate strike, and unlock stylish new bowling balls!

- Local Hotseat Multiplayer

Play with up to 8 local players and compete for the perfect game!

games.name: Shell of a King
games.shortDescription: Test your strength in Shell of a King! A precision bullet-hell adventure that will push your dodging skills to the limit. Challenge tough bosses, uncover secrets, and explore a world left to ruin in this top-down RPG.
games.aboutText:
The world crumbles, as it yearns for the presence of the old gods. Only the strongest and most depraved beings remain. Imprisoned beneath the royal capital of Agathara, can you fight your way to the surface?

Shell of a King is a top-down 2.5D bullet-hell RPG with an emphasis on tough boss fights, build customization, an original soundtrack, and an interconnected world to explore. A passion-project by a solo dev.

No AI was used in the creation of Shell of a King, in any shape or form.

Game Features

- Top-Down Bullet-Hell Action : Shell of a King blends precise bullet-hell insanity with robust souls-like mechanics in a unique adventure!

- Simple Responsive Controls With a Classic Souls-Like Dodge Roll: Triumph over your foes in a rigorous combat system that is easy to learn, but hard to master!

- Over 20 Tough Boss Fights: Battle depraved monsters, giant sentient cubes, and terrible wardens that will push you to your limit! Each boss is designed around a unique mechanic to keep encounters fresh and exciting!

- A Variety of Enemies to Face: Every area offers new and unique enemies that will keep you on your toes!

- Over 100 Items to Discover : In Shell of a King, each regular enemy has a unique item drop, many of which will change how you play! This leads to tons of variety across playthroughs.

- Level-System and Build Customization : Level up your stats and play your way! Whether that's a glass-cannon or a tanky damage sponge, Shell of a King supports your favorite play style!

- A Non-Linear Style Interconnected World: Explore how you like in a world design style reminiscent of a Metroidvania! Let your curiosity guide you to new areas, bosses, NPCs, items, and more!

- Tons of Secrets: Shell of a King is jam-packed with secrets to discover, rewarding thorough exploration, and clever problem solving!

- Multiple Endings : Your choices matter in Shell of a King! Follow the story, trust your gut, and let your actions dictate which of the 3 endings you obtain!

- NG+: Missed a boss or didn't get the ending you wanted? Start a new game, keeping all your items and levels from the previous playthrough!

- An Easy Mode: Want to experience Shell of a King without all the difficulty? Try Easy Mode, and vibe with the cozy 2D and 3D hand-drawn graphics!

Discord Community

Join the Official Shell of a King Discord Server! (link in social media section)

Official Wiki

Check out the Official Shell of a King Wiki! Be careful of spoilers! (link under 'Visit the website')

games.name: Aleph
games.shortDescription: Aleph is an enigmatic cube, a repository of human lore and simulacra. After the fall of human civilization, as a traveler, you depart from the space station and eventually reach the ruins of the dilapidated city, searching for scattered cubes to read the images and texts left behind by humanity.
games.aboutText:
Aleph is a short experimental creation, featuring four surreal vignettes, anchored by two elements: [Screen] and [Cube], illustrating a journey of future humans who gather fragmented relics of knowledge from bygone eras.

- Immerse yourself in a first-person cozy exploration journey with collecting elements

- User-friendly operating tips with game controller supported, could make it an ideal starting point for newcomer to first-person games

- Enjoy a leisurely adventure at your own pace, featuring minimal challenges and helpful hints, making it an ideal experience for all age groups

- Ambient music throughout, reading and listening excerpts from classic books

- A concise gaming experience, designed to be completed in a comfortable 45-minute session

The initial concept evolved from virtual exhibition spaces and has since been showcased in several exhibitions, where it drew inspiration and underwent further refinement.

[Credits]

Creator: Haoge Liu / Tan Tan

Graphic Design: Lifan

Music & Sound Design: suru

games.name: 琉璃烟火-Flame in Glass-
games.shortDescription: 他期待着事业的成果，她期待着追逐的爱情，她期待能给身边的人们带来笑容，他期待能成为故事的主角，他们生活的这座城市期待着海啸后的痊愈……可是，一场突如其来的爆炸扰乱了这一切。烟火暗淡，琉璃蒙尘，他们所期待的，能够实现吗？
games.aboutText:
The sea can nurture a city. It can also destroy one.

As Yiqing City struggles to rebuild after more than half of it was devastated by a tsunami, a sudden bombing casts yet another shadow over its people. Through it all, the sons and daughters of this city—washed, battered, and tempered by the sea—come together to write a story of sorrow, courage, and hope.

Four to five years spent polishing the script. One month living with the film crew. More than a hundred thousand production stills left behind when filming was over.

From them, we selected OVER TEN THOUSAND IMAGES to tell a story of roughly 600,000 CHINESE CHARACTERS. If you listen to the voiced dialogue without fast-forwarding, the complete game is expected to take around 35–40 HOURS .

“How much will it take to finish the shoot?”

“Ten million yuan.”

“I… I’ll sell my house.”

And that is more or less what happened.

With no outside investment whatsoever, the production was kept alive through selling a home, personal debt, company loans, and support from friends. Somehow, it became a production on the scale of RMB 10 million.

The upside is simple: no investor gets to tell us what to do. No one gets to restrain the story. We are free to put everything we have into making the best version of it that exists in our heads.

This project was first conceived nearly ten years ago, long before live-action interactive games became as common as they are today. So naturally, we chose an older way of telling this story.

As a traditional visual novel, it is simpler in form—and vastly more laborious to make. Every image has to be chosen with care and placed at exactly the right point in the text. But in return, the rhythm of reading belongs entirely to the player. You decide when to linger, when to move on, and how quickly the story unfolds.

That freedom is one of the reasons we love this form.

As the sole writer of the script and the person overseeing the entire shoot, I personally go through well over a hundred thousand stills, selecting the right image one by one and matching each moment with the right sound, so that every scene can be presented as precisely as possible.

Whether you are an old friend who has loved traditional visual novels for years, or someone who discovered this kind of storytelling through the recent rise of interactive live-action games, you are welcome to experience a large-scale production built with an old-fashioned craft.

This is not a chamber drama confined to a handful of interiors.

During our month-long shoot, the entire crew moved constantly, filming at dozens of locations throughout the city. There are all kinds of interior scenes, but also a great many outdoor sequences. We dodged typhoons and torrential rain, and on overcast days we sometimes waited for the few fleeting seconds when sunlight finally broke through.

And later chapters still have a certain secret weapon—■■■—waiting in reserve.

The scale, sweep, and emotional force of the finished work are only possible because it stands upon such a large and varied stage.

The story contains FORTY TO FIFTY NAMED CHARACTERS.

Each is a different color, and together they form a brilliant scroll depicting the city of Yiqing.

Some are mature; others inexperienced. Some are optimistic; others weighed down by life. Some are simple and pure; others deeply complicated.

Among them, there will almost certainly be someone you come to love—and someone in whom you recognize a part of yourself.

The story begins from the separate perspectives of several protagonists. As events progress, those viewpoints gradually cross, intertwine, and converge.

Different people carry different beliefs, different priorities, and different ways of acting. Fierce clashes are inevitable.

And the sparks thrown off by those collisions are the most colorful fireworks of all—fireworks that glitter like liuli, colored glass in the light.

Mystery. Passion. Comedy. Tragedy.

Stories of radically different tones shift back and forth as the viewpoint changes.

Follow these characters and witness the pasts they carry, the present they must confront, and the futures they still hope for. Through them, experience every joy and sorrow, every anger and delight, of the city that raised them.

Once the groundwork of the opening chapters is finally in place, the story suddenly accelerates like a snowball hurtling downhill, then surges forward like a breaking sea.

As the plot rapidly draws together, new clues, new turns, and new developments arrive one after another.

Our hope is that, at its most intense, it becomes the kind of story that makes you forget to breathe.

We filled this story with love between people, with private joys and private griefs.

And yet, perhaps presumptuously, we also wanted those small and delicate emotions to reach beyond themselves—to touch an entire era, and to capture something of the world through which we ourselves have lived.

When people face suffering and regret, it is individual coura

games.name: The Chef's Shift
games.shortDescription: The Chef’s Shift is a fast-paced typing game in a restaurant setting, where you’ll both cook & serve food to hungry customers, all done by TYPING.
games.aboutText:
Get ready to cook up a storm in "The Chef's Shift" - a fast-paced typing game set in a bustling restaurant! With your keyboard as your weapon, you'll need to cook and serve delicious dishes to hungry customers before they lose their patience. But that's not all - you'll also need to juggle all kinds of crazy distractions, from rat invasions to unruly customers.

- 1 teaspoon of chaotic, fast-paced gameplay

- 1 package of easy-to-pickup hard-to-master TYPING mechanic

- 1 cup of fun time management bits

And we mean it!

- Navigate through the menu by typing

- Prepare & serve your customers by typing

- Select your dialogue choices by typing

Embark on a culinary journey through 6 vibrant chapters, savoring the diverse flavors of cuisine all around the world, where each restaurant will represent different food culture, posing different quirks & challenges.

Throughout the game you will meet various characters, from customers with their own personality, to characters who propel the story forward.

games.name: Tall Trails
games.shortDescription: A chill exploration game where EVERYTHING goes in the boot! You're Alp, a lil' golem on a quest to find his purpose. Run, climb, and use items as fuel in your Rocket Boot to blast yourself into the air!
games.aboutText:
Tall Trails is a chill exploration game where EVERYTHING goes in the boot! You're Alp, a lil' golem on a quest to find his purpose. Run, climb, and use items as fuel in your Rocket Boot to blast yourself into the air!

- Blast off with your Rocket Boot! Use items as fuel in your Rocket Boot to blast yourself upwards! Jet pack with hot peppers, hover with whirligigs, or swing on webs with spiders!

- Explore a weird & wonderful world! Summit mountains, help out at camp, and search for treasure. Traverse 5 unique biomes, each full of new ways to move and explore.

- Find your purpose in life! Every golem has a purpose… but not you? What's up with that??

- Collect hats & badges! Find & upgrade powerful badges to increase your platforming abilities to unreasonable levels! Or just focus on collecting hats!

- Tons of Replayability! Once you're done with the main story, start your adventure anew in a randomly generated world. Explore islands no one else has seen before in New Game+ or Randomizer mode!

Additional features: full controller support, flexible difficulty settings, remappable keybinds, and an alarmingly high number of weird little dudes.

games.name: Angeline Era
games.shortDescription: Explore a secret-filled land in this 3D Action-Adventure, where every level is hidden in plain sight! Travel and fight through a vast, unmarked overworld. The next surprise is only a single search away!
games.aboutText:
Explore a vast world

Explore a secret-filled land in this 3D Action-Adventure, where every level is hidden in plain sight! Travel and fight through a vast, unmarked overworld. The next surprise is only a single search away!

The Angel's mothership, Throne, lays dormant behind a fierce storm. To reach it, unlock its secrets, and usher in the future, you must explore the land of Era and survive its trap-filled ruins, primordial forests, treacherous mountains, mines, and more! Overcome intense battles and hilarious hazards in this tale of betrayal, haunting lore, and fruitless yearning.

Hello, devs Melos and Marina here. Today, our hero Tets, and his ally Arkas will introduce the game, alongside the villainous Niamh!

Fight bosses in thrilling Bumpslash Combat

TETS: I’ve spent many years practicing the Art of Bumpslash — just bump me into enemies to automatically attack! It's fast-paced, and you’ll pick it up in no time!

PRINCESS NIAMH: HAHAHAHA!! Tets, my dear... aren’t you giving them false hope? After all, the Fae spirit “Melos” has prepared many vicious and hilarious tricks to guard our ancient secrets! My heart swells thinking of the suffering that awaits these unsuspecting players!

Uncover secrets around every corner

ANGEL ARKAS: Don’t forget the bigger picture: a vast world map you can search to find levels and zones. Follow your instincts to chart a flexible path. Go at your own pace — follow your spirit! Life's not a checklist, it’s an experience!!

A moving story, both arcane and emotional

TETS: Agreed! I can’t wait to escape into this world’s haunting lore , woven from Irish mythology, early Christian philosophy, and Japanese American history. By poring over ancient texts and researching on-location, Melos and Marina have grounded their world in truth!

ANGEL ARKAS: Truth is not limited to dusty details, Tets. You've forgotten about Angeline Era's tales of fruitless yearning, life-shattering betrayal and unsettling beauty ! Only the truths of the heart will bring forth the future...

PRINCESS NIAMH: What on earth are you two going on about? This is an action game. KILL, KILL!!

Features

- Explore a secret-filled land in this 3D Action-Adventure, where every level is hidden in plain sight! Travel and fight through a vast, unmarked overworld. The next surprise is only a single search away!

- "Bump the World!" with intuitive Bumpslash Combat . Walk into enemies to attack - no button needed! Fast-paced action levels AND exploration-and-lore focused levels will test your skills.

- Explore fearsome Fae forests, condemned buildings, trap-filled farms, spiritual mountains sites, mines, towns, and more!

- Fierce and uniquely designed bosses and enemies that will test your Bumpslash skills

- Follow wandering ex-soldier, Tets Kinoshta, as he allies with the Angel, Arkas Gemini, attempting to breach the storm guarding Throne: the Angel's crashed mothership. Will they unlock its secrets?

- Plenty of levels, each offering glimpses into the Fae, Angels and Humans living together in the country of Era.

- Mix up combat with subweapons and a gun, and visit towns to shop for items. Beat levels to get Scales and level up!

- On average, a first playthrough takes 20-30 hours, depending on how much of the world you want to explore and how fast you play. (Rushed playthroughs may be less - I've seen as low as 15-16, thorough playthroughs may be over 30)

- Low-difficulty setting for Beginner Bumpslashers, and nightmarish settings for the deranged!

- From Anodyne 2 and Sephonie's devs, Melos and Marina.

games.name: Rich Dad Simulator
games.shortDescription: Run your own chain of markets. Start from a small shop to the biggest business in town. Manage staff, control inventory, set prices, and keep customers happy. Build new locations and expand your retail empire. Can you succeed and become the king of retail?
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the exciting world of running your own store! In this game, you get to take on the challenge of building up your small shop into a massive retail empire, complete with your own chain of hypermarkets.

As you start off with a small shop, your first task is to keep the shelves stocked with inventory to ensure that customers keep coming back. You'll need to manage your finances carefully, as you'll need to purchase the right amount of stock to keep up with demand without overstocking and wasting resources.

As your business grows, you'll be able to expand your store and create a unique shopping experience for your customers. From the layout of the aisles to the color of the walls, you'll have full control over the look and feel of your store. You can even hire staff to help you manage your growing business, allowing you to focus on the bigger picture of expanding your brand.

But managing your store is only half the fun - you'll also get to explore the city around you. Whether it's attending local events or scouting out new locations for your next hypermarket, there's always something new to discover. You might even stumble upon new suppliers or rare items to stock in your store.

Of course, running a successful business is all about the people you hire. As you grow your business, you'll need to find the right employees to help you run your stores efficiently. From cashiers to stockers, each member of your team plays an important role in keeping your business running smoothly. You'll need to manage their schedules, salaries, and training to ensure that they stay motivated and productive.

Overall, this game is all about the thrill of building a successful retail empire.
