With so many different aspects to manage, from inventory to employees to store design, you'll have endless opportunities to flex your management skills and create a brand that customers will love. So what are you waiting for? Start building your retail empire today!

games.name: Crypt Custodian
games.shortDescription: Crypt Custodian is a charming metroidvania about cleaning up the afterlife. Play as Pluto - a mischievous cat who has died, and is sentenced to be the afterworld's janitor... FOREVER! Hang out with other doomed ghosts, battle beasts, and explore a vastly expansive landscape.
games.aboutText:
Crypt Custodian is a charming metroidvania/zelda-like about cleaning up the afterlife.

You play as Pluto - a mischievous cat who has just died, and landed in the afterlife's palace. After a brief and disastrous meeting with the Afterlife Guardian - Kendra - you are banished from the palace and sentenced to clean... FOREVER!!

Explore the vast grounds that surround the palace, battle beasts with your trusty broom, and gain new abilities to expand your map. Solve puzzles, discover secrets, and… organize an ambush to break back into the palace!

A Charming Cast Of Characters

Meet and befriend all the other bad ghosts who live outside the palace. Learn how they died, and what caused them to face eternal banishment! And then head on over to the local haunt- The Sinner’s Inn- to chat with the ghosts you meet, and upgrade your gear. Tons of Upgrades

Complete puzzles, battle epic bosses, and clean your way through ruined dungeons in order to collect new upgrades and abilities. Customize your play style by mix-and-matching your upgrades, and use the abilities you collect to expand your world. A Lively Interconnected World

Traverse a vast landscape with secrets hiding at every corner. Form your own path and discover the afterlife’s many secrets at your own pace.

games.name: SteamWorld Heist II
games.shortDescription: Skill-based gunplay meets turn-based tactics in SteamWorld Heist 2! Aim carefully, bounce bullets, and pull off trick shots in high-stakes heists. Choose your crew and utilize 150+ items to navigate real-time naval battles and daring missions in this 30+ hour adventure to stop a deadly water crisis.
games.aboutText:
All is not well on the waves— a water crisis is brewing! Mysteriously, this precious resource has become deadly, corroding metal limbs and mechanical hearts. As legendary Captain Leeway, it’s up to you and your ragtag crew of steambots to uncover the source of this threat and save botkind before it’s too late!

TURN-BASED STRATEGY AT ITS BEST

Dive into an upgraded tactical experience that builds on the beloved gameplay of SteamWorld Heist. Every move matters as you plan your turns, position your crew, and carefully aim each shot. Ricochet bullets off walls and use your surroundings to outsmart enemies, but remember—victory hinges on a well-thought-out strategy, not just a quick trigger finger.

NEW WATERS, NEW ADVENTURES
Set sail across the vast ocean in your trusty submarine. Face real-time naval combat challenges and steer your crew through tactical ship-to-ship battles while discovering hidden treasures in every wave. Your decisions as captain shape your journey through the Great Sea.

CUSTOMISE YOUR CREW, YOUR WAY
With over 150 weapons, utility items, and ship upgrades, the possibilities for crew customisation are endless. Equip your steambots for every strategy—whether you prefer a sharpshooting sniper or a hammer-wielding bruiser. Unlock new crewmates, jobs, abilities, and gear to perfect your team for each mission.

DIVE INTO A HANDCRAFTED WORLD
Immerse yourself in a beautifully crafted world filled with unique environments, eccentric characters, and a captivating story. And yes, Steam Powered Giraffe is back with an all-new soundtrack that will stick with you long after you’ve docked your ship. Plus, with over 30 hours of gameplay, your adventure will be as vast as the ocean itself!

FEATURES:

- Precision turn-based combat with satisfying ricochet mechanics

- Discover a vast world filled with real-time naval battles and hidden treasures

- Customise your crew with 150+ weapons, items, and upgrades

- Explore the rich new job system to create a crew that fits your playstyle

- A stunning new adventure set in the SteamWorld universe, with over 30 hours of gameplay

- Music by the fan-favourite Steam Powered Giraffe!

The fate of botkind rests in your hands—are you ready to lead your crew through treacherous waters?

games.name: Arctic Unrest
games.shortDescription: Arctic Unrest is a quest driven experience of survival set in a hand-crafted frozen arctic world. Hunting, fishing, building, crafting, farming & fighting are all covered. Vehicles to explore by Land, Air or Sea. "Old School" Far Cry like Story driven quests. Wishlist Arctic Unrest today!
games.aboutText:
Arctic Unrest is a quest driven experience of survival set in a hand-crafted frozen arctic world. Hunting, fishing, building, crafting, farming & fighting are all covered. Explore by Land, Air or Sea using all types of Vehicles or on foot leap, vault, and scale obstacles with ease using parkour to traverse the landscape

We ourselves play games and appreciate the time you will invest in playing Arctic Unrest. We are working hard each day to ensure its filled with content and exciting things to do. Wishlist the game today! and thank you for wanting to be part of our journey.

RadMods Studios (Jn3:16 Googleit!)

Survive the Arctic

- A HUGE beautiful Handcrafted world filled with content ready to be explored.

- Day and Night Cycle with a changing Weather System making everything feel alive.

Quest Driven Narrative Story

- A stoyy unfolds as you seek to discover what took place in the Arctic and what are these mysterious creatures of the night. Quests and Notes are a critical part of Arctic Unrest providing clues and drive the story.

- You will be faced with many types of Quests that are chanllenging: Timed Quests, Unlocking Quests, Multi Dependent Quests, Random AIr Drop Quests and more.

- NPCs play a large role in Arctic Unrest who have interesting Dialogs and share Rumors.

Picture and Bounty Quests

- A "Picture Quest" is a unique way to earn rewards while playing Arctic Unrest. Zoom, Focus, Click & get Paid!

- A "Bounty Quest" requires something to be tracked down and reported, eliminated or captured and delivered.

Explore using Vehicles (Land, Air and Sea) or by foot

- Explore and discover the vast Arctic world using Snowmobiles, Trucks, Helicopters, Boats, Planes or your boots!

- Vehicles need to be maintain, require Fuel & Repairs and have Storage.

- Leap, vault, and scale obstacles with ease using parkour to traverse the landscape.

Builder System w/ "Easy Snap"

- A builder is only fun if it's easy to use and works as expected and our Builder's "Easy Snap" feature fufills both.

- Beautiful structures which include glass can be created that allow you to take in the glory of a sunset!

Weapons with Attachments

- Lots of Weapons, Attachments & Ammo. Weapons Sound & Feel Great, Recoil causes wear requiring repairs.

Professionally Designed HUD and Widgets

- Arctic Unrest's interface (UI/UX) is Elegant & Clean and was a Core Design consideration from the beginning.

- Cash Economy: Buy and Sell goods to NPCs, Merchants and Traveling Traders.

Fishing, Hunting & Farming

- You have to eat! Hunt, Farm or Fish from a boat or shoreline. Catching a fish has a challenging minigame, too!

Click the GREEN BUTTON above

"Add to your Wishlist"

Our Story

We are excited for you to try out Arctic Unrest! Arctic Unrest has taken a year to get to this point and it would not have been possible without the help of my young son and a very talented developer living in Ukraine. Please pray for Ukraine they need our prayers!

My son has been a major force during development with his excitement, passion and drive pushing me to get to this point in Arctic Unrest. He often typed up ideas using a manual typewriter which he loves to use. Rember those machines? haha

I am thankful and praise God for reaching this point in our journey which has been a huge amount of work. Please let us now what you think we VALUE your feedback! A major goal was to create something that was not to violent which we could play Coop.

So here we are :) Enjoy!

Additional Details

- Exploration is Key : Use vehicles or travel by foot or swim & dive underwater.

- Enemies : Smart AI will fight against you and are a constant threat and will do their best to kill you.

- All types of POIs: Bases, Camps, Bunkers, Sewer Pipes, Oil Rigs, Wrecks, Underwater Areas and more!

- Durability System : Vehicle and Weapons and Tools wear are required repairs.

- Parkour and Traversal system : While on foot you will be engaged with smooth movements over obstacles which you can scale over or vault, climb and flip over.

- Character Customization : Clothing system, Gender (Male or Female), Facial Hair, Haircuts, Eyes, etc.

- Harvesting : Mining, Chopping, Farming of raw resources which need to be refined to get the highest value when sold.

- Crafting : Clean, Easy to use UI which makes crafting items fun.

- Cooking : Collect, Harvest, Scavenge Food items to eat, cook or to craft a recipe.

- Fishing : Catch fish if you do not break the line while trying to beat the fun fishing mini-game.

- Farming : Grow Crops from Seed and Harvest at the Correct Growth Stage.

- Animal Husbandry : Raise small animals for meat. Penguin meat is tasty!

- Weapons, Weapons and more Weapons!

Team Arctic Unrest

Keep Informed, Get Plugged In and Make New Friends

games.name: Glyphica: Typing Survival
games.shortDescription: Weaponize your WPM. Glyphica: Typing Survival is a single-player roguelite horde survival game that lets you mow down hordes of enemies in a minimalistic arena using your finger dexterity, your choice of weapons loadout, and sheer determination.
games.aboutText:
Typing meets horde survival in this fast-paced roguelite that challenges your speed, accuracy, and strategy. Step into a minimalist arena and dominate the battlefield using your typing skills and your trusty keyboard.

Not Your Ordinary Typing Test

Type the word above an enemy to finish them off. Challenge your focus and speed as bigger waves and wicked words try to slow you down and take you out.

These wily words also have a few tricks up their sleeves. Deterministic drones will simply edge closer towards you, but egregious enemies like Swarmers will fire their little bullets at you, while Shooters charge up to unleash hell on you.

Kit Out; Don’t Keysmash

Furiously fast fingers will never be enough! Upgrade your arsenal with unlockable weapons and loot that can help you make quick work of each wave of words.

Each build is uniquely yours. Set up your Oscillator and Sentry to take care of a large swathe of territory while you pick off the stragglers, or minmax your main weapon to evolve into an alphabet assassinator? The choice is yours!

(Hot)Swap your Strategies in Formidable Boss Fights

There are multiple trials for you to overcome, and a boss guarding the end of each trial. Defeating the trials unlock challenging Omens that make your enemies even more formidable. Can you out-type and outwit our orthographic overlords?

Control Freaks Rejoice!

Hate keyboards with a passion? Or are you just better with a controller? We have you covered with controller mode that works for any controller you might have, or even on the go with your Steam Deck!

Escalating Beats to Defeat Enemies to

Get into your flow state and provide your best typing performance under pressure, accompanied by pulsating techno beats to carry you to victory.

Key Features

- Ever-evolving Builds: Carve your own upgrade path through hundreds of combinations.

- Augmentation System: Unlock perma-upgrades and evolve your build across sessions.

- Typing Speedster: The higher your WPM, the more you destroy.

- Varied Arsenal: Experiment with an expansive collection of weapons, spoils, and upgrades.

- Quick and Accessible: Engage in 10-20 minute runs tailored for quick sessions.

- Couch mode: Words turns into quicktime sequences on controller.

games.name: NanoApostle
games.shortDescription: NanoApostle is a dark sci-fi boss rush action game featuring intense reaction-based combat and the unique "Destruction Point" system. Play as Anita, a child augmented with lethal nanomachines, as she battles against twisted cybernetic experiments to escape a top-secret facility.
games.aboutText:
Deep within the bowels of a shadowy research facility, Anita, a girl birthed from experimental procedures, is implanted with the sentient nanomechanical entity known as ‘Apostle’. Working together with her nanite allies Anita must defeat a series of dangerous prototype bio-weapons as she searches for a way to break free from her nightmarish prison.

Battle against merciless adversaries: Face axe-wielding mechs, fire-spewing behemoths, and psychokinetic terrors, in vicious encounters culminating in the brutal execution of your foes.

Evolving multi-stage battles: When threatened, the destructive bio-weapons feature a failsafe causing them to become more ferocious, and often warping environments to enhance their onslaught.

More than a weapon: The symbiotic relationship between Anita and Apostle grants her numerous abilities such as Dodge, Parry, a series of Slashing Attacks, and a deadly Projectile.

Master the Destruction Point system: Utilise Apostle’s nanites to identify structural weaknesses known as ‘Destruction Points’, and exploit your opponent’s vulnerabilities to land devastating blows.

Experiment with skills: Earn skill points through combat and challenge stages. Whether you favour a tactical or reckless approach, create unique skill combinations that resonate with your style.

Take on the Challenge System: Earn skill points by completing various tasks from defeating hordes of minions to demonstrating dexterity in the parkour challenges.

games.name: VISK
games.shortDescription: Enter the bleak world of VISK, an online co-op horror game for 1-2 players. You and your friend are sent to a desolate village. Uncover the dark secrets of this place and cautiously explore your surroundings. After all, you might not be alone…
games.aboutText:
Enter the bleak world of VISK, an online co-op horror game for 1-2 players.
You and your friend are sent to a desolate village.
Uncover the dark secrets of this place and cautiously explore your surroundings.
After all, you might not be alone… Play with a friend or in single player

- 2 player online co-op mode
Play alongside your friend and cooperate to progress.
Work together using walkie-talkies and proximity voice-chat.

- Single player mode
Go into this dreary experience alone.
No one will come to help you.

Uncover the truth

Who sent you here? What happened to this village? Are you really alone?
Discover unique environments as you search for answers.

Explore the past

Solve puzzles, search for key items and interact with the environment to gain access to new places.
Search for remains of a past life and figure out what happened here.

games.name: Emblems: Sunless Vow
games.shortDescription: Unravel a mystery where you know the outcome from the start…in this turn-based roguelite RPG. A strange mage and his two captives must regain their memories to escape from a hostile void. But can they stop *arguing* first? A playful character drama with unusual combat.
games.aboutText:
Help three unlikely friends destroy the void...before they destroy each other!

New allies Weapon, Spirit, and Magic have some big tasks ahead of them. Recover their stolen memories, defeat an ancient demon or two, and escape from the dreaded void between worlds! Assuming they can stop arguing, first...

Turn-based, but QUICK!

Emblems: Sunless Vow is a Roguelite Visual Novel set in a forsaken void where you must put your soul on the line to escape.

Its turn-based battles are designed to reduce decision-paralysis, allow short bursts of play, and offer an evolving stream of challenges as its story unfolds... Control three types of souls in a type-triangle combat system that rewards calculated risk! Allow or remove RNG with various difficulty settings... Take a Story-Only cruise, or heat things up with up to eight Tribulations.

Mystery + Drama + Comedy

"Weapon" and "Magic" remember nothing, as they wake in an unforgiving void where vengeful souls haunt every corner. A mysterious guide named "Spirit" appears just in time to save them... But doesn't he know a little too much? And just what is with that outfit...? Shenanigans abound in this novella-length drama whose secrets keep you guessing.

But wait! It's a roguelite too!!

Take your time with the carefully-balanced maps in Story Mode, and enjoy an emotional tale with a roguelite progression system... Or take your chances with the ever-shifting void - in procedurally-generated Chaos Mode!

Lost in the twists and turns of a voidrift, you'll face new enemy tactics, stack over 100 passive Buffs, and utilize special Promotions to give form to your ideal build. But be warned: even greater foes lurk in these depths...

A Labor of Love by two developers, over several years!

Art / Writing : Tonic

Coding / Music : Ikiru

With character barks by the following VAs: Jessie Starborne, Rob Milton, Joe Goffeney, Kendra Woods, and T Ivie

Suffice to say, the two of us have worn a lot of hats over the past few years... We are so happy to finally share these hand-painted artworks, dynamic character animations, carefully-crafted battles, and a hauntingly epic soundtrack.

Whether you thrive on tiny math, crave an engaging story with endearing characters, or just enjoy watching numbers go up... We hope you’ll find something to love in our game.

NOTE : All aspects of this game were created entirely without the use of generative AI. oldflowerGames does not condone the use of generative AI in creative works.

games.name: Money Glitch
games.shortDescription: Create and manage your own online shop in the shadows of the Darknet. Build factories, craft products, and ship orders by hand. Keep your reputation high to dominate the underground economy.
games.aboutText:
MONEY GLITCH

Run your own online shop and sell products directly to your customers. Build your empire from the ground up: acquire equipment, set up production facilities, and expand your network.
But be careful — too much attention can be dangerous. Authorities, competitors, and unhappy customers can quickly become your biggest problem.

Build your business

- Create production chains by hand — from sourcing raw materials to shipping finished goods

- Set up workstations, automate your processes, and optimize delivery times

- Craft products of varying quality and discover new recipes and combinations

Customer satisfaction matters

- Respond to reviews, handle complaints, and improve your product quality

- Deliver on time to earn positive feedback and boost your reputation

- Choose whether to play fair — or profit through manipulation and deception

Explore an open and digital world

- Purchase properties — from a damp mushroom cave to a full-scale industrial factory

- Gather resources locally or order them anonymously through the Darknet

- Experience a handcrafted Darknet system with shops, forums, and hidden markets

- Interact with shady users and uncover the risks and rewards of the underground web

Key Gameplay Features

- An interactive package system — pack, label, and track your deliveries manually

- A dynamic reputation and review system that shapes your public image

- A fully simulated economy , including fluctuating prices and changing demand

Will you become a legitimate entrepreneur — or the shadow mogul of the digital underworld?
Welcome to MONEY GLITCH.

games.name: The Strongest TOFU
games.shortDescription: Be The TOFU. The one and only Tofu action game created by a real Tofu Meister. You choose one of three varieties, and in its endless journey it gradually softens, crumbles, stews, and acquires bittern to become TOFU.
games.aboutText:
BE the TOFU.

Tofu is one of the most wonderful foods made from soybeans.

Tofu, also known as "meat of the field," is so rich in nutrients that it has been enjoyed by many people since ancient times.
Tofu can be transformed in any way depending on the method of production and preparation.

Tofu Action

This is the one and only Tofu action game created by a real Tofu Meister.
Cotton, silk, and koya. Three types of tofu to choose from, made in 3D using the latest technology.
Enjoy a game experience as simple as to-fu, with one-button operation for quick play.

The ultimate tofu experience

- Precise vibration/physical feedback to enhance the sense of oneness with the tofu.

- Tofu is fragile and crumbles when you push it. (Koya-dofu is hard, so it's not a problem.)

- With a determined tofu-fire📛, jump into the owan before it expires.

- A large amount of tofu trivia is included to help you learn more about tofu.

- Includes "Tofu Factory," a mini-game for infinite tofu production.

Volume

- The volume of the game can be played in an hour or two.

- No additives like collectibles or hidden routes, just a simple action experience.

- It is just like eating tofu straight from the pack...

Music

Become fully immersed with an original soundtrack composed by Ryo Nagamatsu of RH Music. Ryo’s versatile sound gives every level its own distinct ambience, captivating audiences as they progress through each course.

games.name: The Battle for Vega
games.shortDescription: Inspired by the classic Space Invaders, The Battle for Vega takes the old-school gameplay you know and love and adds new features that make it a fresh and exciting experience.
games.aboutText:
What is The Battle for Vega?

Inspired by the classics like Space Invaders, Galaga and Galaxian The Battle for Vega takes the old-school gameplay you know and love and adds new features that make it a fresh and exciting take on the old games.

In The Battle for Vega , you'll face off against waves of enemies and bosses across more than 100 levels . Each enemy type has a unique weapon, so you'll need to strategize and adapt to their attacks if you want to survive. But don't worry – you'll have plenty of weapons and ships of your own to choose from.

Ship Types

Play through the game, collect credits, and you can upgrade your ship. The bigger the ship, the bigger the potential firepower and endurance. The higher end ships can equip exotic weapon types, and even have an energy shield by default.

Weapons and Hardpoint types

Every player ship has specific hardpoints which you can equip with different weapons. Each hardpoint it’s in a few energy classes, which determine how big of a weapon you can equip there.

Choose from a wide range of options, including projectiles, lasers, plasma, missiles, and much, much more. As you progress through the game, you'll be able to upgrade your ships and weapons for better stats and performance. Will you focus on firepower or fire speed?

The choice is yours.

Enemies

But be careful – the enemies in The Battle for Vega are relentless, and they won't give up without a fight! You'll need to be quick on your feet and even quicker with your trigger finger if you want to make it through to the end.

The game will face you with many types of both the basic enemies, and their mini-boss variants, and at the end of each major story Act you will engage one of the major bosses.

Every enemy type have different attack type, some slower, some faster, and maybe even attacks with a status element!

With its classic gameplay, modern upgrades, and challenging levels, The Battle for Vega is a must-play for fans of retro shooters. Get ready to blast your way through the galaxy and emerge victorious in the ultimate battle for Vega!

Steam Deck Support

The game it’s fully playable via the Proton layer at full resolution and 60FPS . The Steam Deck version it's made to be as readable as possible. We have a full gamepad support both for Steam Deck, and any standard controller type on PC.

games.name: REAL WEB LEGENDS: Carter's Quest
games.shortDescription: Fight for your life in a SCANDALOUS fantasy world where anything is possible. With a devilish combat system, outrageous characters, and set-pieces galore; you never know what's next in REAL WEB LEGENDS: Carter's Quest.
games.aboutText:
The Story

The mysterious organization known only as "The Helix" is hatching a plan to capture an artifact of great power. The leader of Humanity is missing, presumed dead. The Elves are on the move, capturing territory once again. Tensions are high, all sides need a hero. The future of the planet Web lies in the balance.

Carter, a Human peasant from a remote village, is thrust into the center of a conspiracy to create the ultimate weapon: The Perfect Homunculus.

The Gameplay

Deep combat, inspired by the legends of the character action genre, strikes a delicate balance with exploration and puzzle-solving. Create your own Homunculus to serve as your faithful companion as you fight for your life against artificial machines, malformed creations of wizards long-deceased, and enemies of peace in the land of Web.

The World

Act 1, set in the Human province of Kaliere, takes Carter through the rebuilt Human capital. In the not-so-distant past, war once gripped these plains, and it threatens to do so once again. Learn the history of Humanity, complete side quests, solve puzzles, and walk away with rewards that unlock your true potential as a warrior.

games.name: Drill Keeper
games.shortDescription: Build impenetrable fortresses of mining to defend against relentless hordes of aliens and make a name for yourself as a famed Drill Keeper! Roguelike deckbuilding meets siege defense as you travel the galaxy and dig through fully destructible worlds to strip them of their riches.
games.aboutText:
Play as a heroic Drill Keeper in this roguelike deckbuilding siege defense game where you travel the galaxy in an effort to secure vital resources. As a dutiful symbol of the future, you will be tasked with protecting your Planetary Drill – build fortresses around your mining operation to protect it from the dangers that lurk in the depths of distant planets, placing defensive weapons and designing labyrinthine pathways to trap, stall, bewilder, and even kill the enemy as it approaches. And if a sense of duty isn’t enough of a motivator, you should know that your parent corporation has installed a neural implant that will kill you should your Drill be destroyed – it’s expensive equipment, after all!

Join the Orion Prospectors Team today!

Does the vast expanse of the galaxy call to you? Do you want to work with state-of-the-art drilling technology? Have you dreamt of strip-mining entire planets to their core while building massive defensive fortifications to hold back and gun down alien attackers? Then you’ll dig this gig!

- Each planet you visit will feature unique objectives that unlock additional tools for future use, and planetary modifiers that influence the procedurally generated dig sites you’ll be excavating in any given run. At times you’ll find yourself fortunate enough to be surrounded by bountiful treasures and easily removed brittle walls with only a distant enemy spawning pool, while at others, the riches may be distant, the soil well-packed, and the enemy right by your side. Surrounded by resources, enemy spawning pools, and unique points of interest, you will always have a fresh set of considerations to build your mining strategy around.

- Every tile around you can be destroyed, either in a calculated manner when digging in pursuit of gold, shards, and mysterious treasures, or by environmental effects that may inadvertently help or hinder your position. Manually digging between drill activations is the only way to secure resources that allow you to play your cards and purchase upgrades for future expeditions, but pushing too hard without rest can invite negative consequences. This means the need for a carefully planned approach as digging is also a powerful tool for defense.

- Every time you activate your drill, the mindless enemy swarm responds with ruthless aggression, moving along a predictable path – the shortest available from where they spawn to your drill. Influence this path by placing obstructions and digging alternative routes shaped in your favor – will you build long narrow corridors and place defensive buildings that fire piercing shots in straight lines, or pursue zig-zagging paths to maximize enemy travel time under fire instead? Different weapons at your disposal behave in completely different ways, and while anyone can find synergies among the cards in their deck, a true Drill Keeper will pair those synergies with the perfect dig strategy.

Make your mark as one of the greatest Drill Keepers ever known – adorn your rig with modules and relics of great power, earned through daring deeds or purchased through the sweat of your brow, and stay nimble as you adapt to a growing set of options during any given expedition, discovering new tools and unlocking them for future use as you do. Every famed Drill Keeper has their own calling card – choose yours today!

- Cards are the core tool in your hand, available for use between and during attacks, used to place and upgrade individual buildings, to apply status effects to the enemy, and to enhance your own capabilities. You will begin each run with a small starting deck, growing it with additional cards acquired through periodic supply drops and treasures found while digging during an ongoing run. This can fundamentally change your overall strategy. Will you focus on buffing your own abilities, using magic to dig and defend more efficiently? Will you prioritize barricades that influence enemy movement to funnel them into kill boxes? Or will you squeeze every possible ounce of damage output out of your deck, combining status effects and defensive buildings to overcome the vast hordes?

- Prioritize your current expedition by focusing on the acquisition of gold needed to activate cards, or plan for the future with a focus on acquiring shards and the runes they allow you to purchase and use in future expeditions. Bolster your economic capabilities, improve your damage output and attack speeds, or otherwise sway luck itself in your favor with the help of these magical attachments, and bring a variety of runes together to create powerful combinations and unique strategies, with upgrades available to make them even more powerful.

- Seek out artifacts buried deep within the planets and use their unique offerings to further bolster your expeditions – from modifying the outcome of familiar actions to providing buffs and debuffs, artifacts are another piece of the puzzle as you seek synergies and opportunities in what they have to offer.

J

games.name: The Truth
games.shortDescription: A psychological horror experience where a routine investigation turns into something far more unsettling. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth hidden within the house.
games.aboutText:
"The Truth" is a psychological horror game where you play as a police officer who is investigating a suspected criminal. You need to solve different puzzles to solve the case. Find out what happened to the family and the suspected criminal. As you delve deeper into the investigation, you begin to realize that things are not as they seem. The truth is elusive, and the more you uncover, the more terrifying the situation becomes. As you uncover the dark secrets of the family and the suspected criminal, you will be forced to confront your own fears and anxieties.

Singleplayer

The Truth features a singleplayer horror experience powered by Unreal Engine 5

Story

Discover secrets and find the truth about the case you are investigating.

Find out what happened and don't die .

Puzzles

The Truth features several puzzles and challenges to solve.

Highly detailed environments

The games features more than one simple house. It features several houses, a huge forest and more.

Checkpoint and save system

You don't need to start over when you close the game. There are many checkpoints that automatically save the game. There are also many save-devices that you can find during your journey.

games.name: Rogue Labyrinth
games.shortDescription: Fight through the ranks in a monster-filled labyrinth created by an egocentric billionaire colonist. Make friends (or enemies) with rivals, employees, fans, and monsters to improve your abilities. The crowd wants a show, so hype them up in this rogue-lite narrative adventure!
games.aboutText:
Get this. Your peaceful country of Lantanas has been taken over by an egocentric billionaire. Oh, and he built a colosseum labyrinth at the base of the largest Great Tree in the world! Now we're supposed to fight to become the next monarch of Lantanas?!

Battle up the ranks of the procedurally generated roguelite Labyrinth! Utilize hundreds of powers and artifacts against dozens of hired monsters and 7 unique rivals.

- Countries Have Come: The Labyrinth shifts and changes every run, with different choices generating new and exciting maps. Roguelite levels are split into 4 biomes with 100s of different rooms you can encounter throughout your run, each based on the countries participating. You're not only fighting against the labyrinth, but other rivals who all have their own reasons for being there.

- Make Everything a Projectile: There are multiple weapons and forms to choose from and builds to gain in each run, made different every time through given upgrades and choices. You can hit everything across the map like trees, rocks, other enemies, projectiles, and so on. It feels like a "controlled-bullet hell" which is unique and fun!

- Fight Your Way: Bash with your branch, throw thornballs, or use rival abilities like pulsing pillars, spiky bubbles, spinning boomerangs, and more!

- Play Politics: Make friends (or enemies) with rivals, employees, & monsters in-between fighting in the labyrinth to upgrade your abilities. Learn their battle techniques or maybe invite them to dinner?

- Attract the Audience: The more enemies you defeat, the higher your fan fame meter gets. Once the fans are hyped, they’ll watch you battle and may reward you.

- Benefactor Boons: Rich folks from around the world are betting on their favorites to win. Use their boons to enhance your abilities and make them look good!

- Fishing Minigame: Because ALL good games have a fishing minigame…

- 100+ unique abilities

- 4,000+ lines of dialogue

- 1 plant baby

- Pet frogs

games.name: Cento
games.shortDescription: CENTO is a game where you enter commands in time with music and activate skills to fight. Collect gifts while reinforcing your skills and fight on stages with a wide variety of songs!
games.aboutText:
Unique battle system | Enter commands in rhythm and activate skills. Play a clever beat according to the combination of cards in your hand and your opponent's attacks.

Variety of stages | Fight on stages with different BGMs, from the city to ruins. The playing experience changes depending on the tempo and beat of the music.

Customize your deck | Create your own deck by freely combining skills and gifts received from existing characters. Let's find the strongest combination.

Endurance mode | Aim for consecutive battles while reinforcing your skills and obtaining gifts. Unleash a powerful attack with new skills.

games.name: Goodnight Universe
games.shortDescription: From the creators of Before Your Eyes — You are Isaac, a 6-month-old baby, developing mysterious psychic powers. What you want most is to be loved and accepted by your family, but a secretive tech corporation wants you for their own.
games.aboutText:
From the creators of Before Your Eyes .

You are Isaac, a 6-month-old baby, developing mysterious psychic powers. What you want most is to be loved and accepted by your family, but a secretive tech corporation wants you for their own. The game features an immersive “camera as controller” mode, expanding on the innovative use of camera-based technology that the development team is known for.

games.name: Beastro
games.shortDescription: Beastro is a cozy culinary adventure where the fate of the world rests on what's for dinner! Farm and gather fresh ingredients, tackle cooking minigames, and create tasty recipes to fuel the Caretakers for deckbuilding battles as they seek to save the world.
games.aboutText:
Palo Pori is a beautiful and peaceful village of artisans and tastemakers. Beyond the village’s protective wall, darkness has begun to stir. Ravenous monsters have claimed the land and threaten to sink their teeth into this final morsel of hope and happiness.

Play as Panko, a young, talented chef, helping to run the local eatery. When Panko’s teacher goes missing, a mysterious visitor arrives with warnings of the dangers beyond the wall. It's up to Panko to step up and take over the restaurant and tend to the ingredients and patrons. But that’s not all, Panko also finds himself serving the Caretakers, brave adventurers, sent to save the world. In this adventure, preserving peace starts in the kitchen!

In Palo Pori, fresh is best! Gather ingredients and resources, care for animals and grow your own fruit and veg to build up your very own cozy town to table restaurant. Forage for wild herbs and unlock new seeds to grow to expand your meals.

Chop, flip, and sizzle your way through mouthwatering mini-games as you whip up delightful dishes for the townsfolk. Good food is always better with company, so work hard to improve your cooking and experiment with ingredients, to keep your patrons happy.

Tailor your restaurant to the tastes of your community, develop new meals, progress your know how through a skill tree and adjust the decor to increase your restaurant’s appeal.

You’ll also need to feed the hungry Caretakers; these brave denizens of the land will venture out into the wilds to fight the ravenous monsters threatening the peace of Palo Pori. Each Caretaker hails from their own flavour region, affecting their own tastes and preferences: some like it bitter, some like it sweet and some are just looking to fulfil their craving of the day! Craft thoughtful meals and balance the flavour profiles to boost their spirits, sharpen their skills, and unlock new abilities. Because let’s face it… Who can save the world on an empty stomach?

Now it’s time to put your meal to the test! This is where taste meets tactics. The dishes you serve will build your Caretaker’s deck – each ingredient unlocking a card. And once they’ve eaten, they’ll venture into the wilds to fight the monsters. Upon their return, they’ll recount their journey and play out their battles through a charming puppet theatre sequence. They might even bring you back some MONSTEROUS ingredients from their ventures. Fight the monsters in turn-based deck building combat, inspired by traditional trick-taking card games. Outplay the monsters, by matching their flavour magic or neutralising it with a balancing card. Add an enhancing card to power up your moves! Your magic can turn the tables!

Utilize the unique effects of your ingredients to put your enemies to sleep, blow away their cards, and more, but watch out, you’re not the only one with special abilities. If you’re not paying attention, you might get burned.

In this food-based fantasy adventure, it’s time to give peas a chance! - Are you ready to get cooking?

Unlock the magic in food.

games.name: Neva
games.shortDescription: Experience the moving tale of a young woman and her lifelong bond with a magnificent wolf as they embark on a thrilling adventure through a rapidly dying world.
games.aboutText:
Neva is an emotionally-charged action adventure from the visionary team behind the critically acclaimed GRIS.

Neva chronicles the story of Alba, a young woman bound to a curious wolf cub following a traumatic encounter with dark forces. Together they embark on a perilous journey through a once-beautiful world as it slowly decays around them.

Over time, their relationship will evolve as they learn to work together, helping one another to brave increasingly dangerous situations. The wolf will grow from a rebellious cub to an imposing adult seeking to forge her own identity, testing Alba’s love and their commitment to one another.

As the cursed world threatens to overwhelm them, Alba and her courageous companion will do whatever it takes to survive and make a new home, together.

games.name: Nom Nom: Cozy Forest Café
games.shortDescription: A decoration-focused café game where you bake and brew... TO THE BEAT!
games.aboutText:
Have you ever wanted to escape from the stress of urban life? Nom Nom: Cozy Forest Café is a cozy and relaxing decoration and rhythm game where you manage a café and befriend cute animals.

- Low stress, non confrontational, relaxing experience.

- 【Manage your own cafeteria】 Customize your place with furniture, decorations, lamps, wallpaper, and flooring. Take pictures of your favourite corners, dishes, and customers and share them on the café's website.

- 【Adorable customers】 Forge friendships and learn about their favourite recipes and decorations.

- 【Learn new recipes... To the beat!】 Prepare snacks and drinks, from waffles to sodas, to the rhythm of upbeat tunes and colourful animations.

- 【Unleash your creativity!】 Practice your skills whenever you like. Experiment with new ingredient combinations and sell them in your own vending machine to earn rewards!

- 【Use your own custom designs!】 You can customise different objects, as well as your dishes! Paint signs, posters and even T-shirts for your customers.

games.name: Fretless - The Wrath of Riffson
games.shortDescription: In this turn-based RPG, wield powerful legendary instruments, gather mighty riff attacks and save the land from Rick Riffson's devilish goons and musical hybrid monsters!
games.aboutText:
Play as Rob , a friendly musician trying to restore harmony in an off-tuned world where wacky villains are corrupting music .

Rick Riffson , boss of the evil Super Metal Records company, is using the Battle of the Bands contest to extend his hold on every last note, chord, and song by trapping the best musicians with deceptive soul-binding contracts .

Embark on an adventure with Rob and his zany rock-loving friend to end SMR's plans. Stay alert during your journey: Riffson’s devilish goons , monster-instrument hybrids , and legendary musical animals will try to get in your way!

Explore this musical land to add sick riffs to your deck , and wield your mighty guitar to unleash powerful crescendo attacks in epic music battles !

Carefully composed by Ritual Studios , Fretless is a pixel-art adventure set in Rob Scallon and his friends' diverse musical rock world .

GAME FEATURES

- Explore a musical world: discover whimsical biomes where flowers jingle, rocks really rock and beach waves have their own melody. Watch out for the percushrooms: they'll beat you up.

- Engage in rhythmic turn-based combat: orchestrate melodies of mighty musical riffs to bit crush your foes. Time attacks and blocks to the beat of the soundtrack, build your Crescendo, and unleash powerful rhythm-based special attacks!

- Fine-tune your strategy: Collect mighty riffs, add them to your deck, and compose the perfect bars to create unbeatable solos. Follow the beat of your own drum, whether it is high damage build, devastating musical effects, life-stealing combos, or even random chaos!

- Spice up your musical abilities with physical add-ons: Are you a metal-rock shredder or an indie-folk lover? Choose the best instrument and add bridges, strings, and more to match your own play styles.

- Band together for a wholesome ballad: embark on a story full of musical puns, zany characters, and Rob Scallon's coterie of music-loving friends

- Enjoy a hand-crafted Pixel Art symphony: progress through a visually enchanting world filled with gorgeous punchy animations and alluring scenery.

- Music is for everyone: from "simple" music enthusiasts to guitar gods, everyone can hit the right note at the right time! Whether you are already a fan of Rob or just looking for a fun lighthearted adventure, this game is made for you.

games.name: Living With Sister: Monochrome Fantasy
games.shortDescription: When your father goes off on an adventure, it's up to you to keep the lights on and take care of your sister.
games.aboutText:
Living in a fantasy world, it's always been your dream to grow up to be a famous adventurer just like your father. Reality proves to be more boring than fiction, however, as your days are mostly spent doing odd jobs for the villagers. With your friends by your side, you enter the Tournament of the Eights and strive for something greater: the chance to become the top guild in the country. Will you realize your ambitions, or will your hopes slip through your fingers and doom you to a life of monochrome monotony?

As a member of your town's Adventurers' Guild, it's your job to protect the townsfolk. Go on hunts, kill dangerous beasts, and hone your abilities to better tackle whatever challenges tomorrow brings.

Once you get home from work, you'll have your sister to attend to. She's a very sickly girl who needs a lot of help. Manage your household finances well, build up your relationship with your sister, and who knows, perhaps you might even be able to solve the mystery behind her illness.

Hand-Drawn Monochrome Art
Though it may lack color, this game's world is anything but colorless! The stunning black-and-white art is chock-full of personality and is sure to leave you with plenty of marvelous monochrome memories!

Unique Combat System
With tons of bizarre and ferocious monsters to fight and dozens of unique skills to unlock, your adventures are sure to be full of challenge and excitement!

Charming Characters
Build up your relationships with your guildmates and your sister to learn about what makes them tick and unlock character-specific abilities to further assist you in your quest to become the top guild in the country!

games.name: Power Network Tycoon
games.shortDescription: Power Network Tycoon is a physics based power grid simulation game where you build and maintain a high-voltage power network. Build power infrastructure, monitor resources, research upgrades, adapt to environmental challenges, keep up with energy demands and protect your island community!
games.aboutText:
Power Network Tycoon is a physics based power grid simulation game where you build and maintain a high-voltage power network. Build power infrastructure, monitor resources, research upgrades, adapt to environmental challenges, keep up with energy demands and protect your island community!

Start small by placing power generators, substations, and power lines. With greater demand brings resource constraints, safety risks, and exposure to natures challenges. Invest wisely in research, upgrades, and safety measures to ensure a stable and efficient power supply.

Developed by a Power Engineer

The game is a modern take on an often oversimplified genre, now with advanced power grid management and industry-inspired simulation mechanics. It uses advanced physics-based calculations found in industrial electrical design software and challenges you to make decisions that reflect industry best practices, built from the ground up to be easy to learn, but hard to master.

Protect Your Citizens

You'll be responsible for preventing electrical accidents and protecting your citizens. Assess ground potential rise under fault conditions, measure electromagnetic field strengths, and upgrade equipment to minimize the risk of electrical overloading. Failure to prioritize safety could lead to unhappy customers, outages, and worse!

Become An Expert

As the island community grows, your expertise running the Power Grid will be put to the test. You'll have the opportunity to upgrade and expand your network by building new power generators, power lines, substations and supporting infrastructure.

Overcome Challenges

Mother Nature can throw unexpected challenges your way, but as a resilient Engineer, you're always prepared. Storms, heatwaves and other extreme weather events will put your skills to the test. Upgrade your infrastructure, strengthen power lines and monitor the weather to mitigate the impact of these natural disasters. Balancing resilience and costs is crucial as you work to keep the lights on.

Every decision shapes how your network performs under pressure, how your power infrastructure holds up over time, and how your community grows. Plan carefully, think like an engineer, and see if your grid can stand the test.

games.name: Radix Chronicle
games.shortDescription: Radix is a tactical RPG inspired by SNES and Playstation classics. With dark themes but bright characters, this fantasy tale changes depending on how you fight! Your magic can even alter the land itself. Use your timing and skill, rather than your luck, to lead your party home safely each day!
games.aboutText:
Finally, a tactical RPG that has NO RNG to Hit, Miss, or Crit!

When you attack, use an item, cast a spell, or defend yourself, you'll face a Ring Trial. Click when the indicator is in the Blue Zone to succeed. Click when the indicator is in the Red Zone for a critical success! But, of course, try not to miss...

A living battlefield to change as you please!

Terrain has a massive impact on battles. Fortunately, you can change it freely with your magic! Just beware... your foes can do the same!

A story that changes based on how you fight!

Actions speak louder than words. There's no dialogue trees of options for you here... how your characters interact depends on how you fight. Your decisions (and your skill) will determine your party's fate—in more ways than one!

The party that never stops!

When the new king sent princess Sahana to the far-flung hinterlands of the kingdom via a "political marriage," she didn't expect a warm welcome. And that's great, because she didn't get one.

Her reluctant husband, Kadi, treats her well but mostly avoids her. Vexingly, he does not seem to be avoiding a beautiful mercenary named Celestora—who says she wants Kadi dead, but spends all her time with him anyway. Hana's "exile" isn't the worst, but she has had about enough of this little situation...

Join this band of misfits as they venture to quell the monsters that trouble the province...

Super Indie

Radix Chronicle is brought to you by the 2 person studio, Luna Flora. Ray handles the code, and Marcus handles the other stuff!

games.name: Starship Crafter
games.shortDescription: Take on the role of a starship mechanic and pay off the immense debt your father left behind. Craft components, build starships, and take contracts from factions. Follow galactic events, and pay the debt before the deadline.
games.aboutText:
Take on the role of a starship mechanic and pay off the immense debt your father left behind. Craft components, build starships, and take contracts from factions. Follow events across the galaxy, and pay the debt before the deadline.

Start by salvaging broken items for parts, then craft them into basic components. Unlock more advanced components and new starship blueprints, then build ships of your own.

Take contracts from rival factions, racing pilots, desperate strangers, or big shots across the galaxy. Each job builds your reputation, pays toward the debt, and pulls you into their stories.

Pour your earnings back into the workshop. Upgrade workstations and unlock underground hangar floors to build, repair, patch, and replace broken parts on starships. Restore the workshop to its former glory.

Uncover the truth behind your father's disappearance and the debt he left you. Earn the trust of rival factions, choose who to stand with, and shape how your story ends. All the while, a living galaxy moves around you, with elections, races, and conflicts unfolding in the news whether you take part or not.

games.name: ShantyTown
games.shortDescription: ShantyTown is a relaxing diorama-building game about finding beauty in everyday chaos. Bring new locations to life, stack your urban buildings high, and fill each little nook and cranny with your own touch. Try your hand at shaping a cozy little town that is unique to you.
games.aboutText:
Get ready to build upwards, fill the smallest gaps, and find clever ways to place light sources or decorations that breathe life into every corner.

This is a world where every balcony, interesting poster, and plant tells a story. And you’re the one organising it!

This game is inspired by my love for densely built cities around the world, which is why I packed in 20 distinct locations for you to explore, each with its own mood and identity.

Be it the warm glow of the Hotpot Casino, the charmingly cramped spaces of the Marshlands Pipe, or the solitude of the Lighthouse, every space gives you a new perspective.

How you place things together is entirely up to you.

Upgrades are available for larger structures like buildings and gates, but they’ll need a bit of care to reach their full potential. By providing light, utilities, and decorations, places like shops, apartment blocks, or gates can evolve into detailed spaces. Completing an upgrade unlocks new objects and decorations, giving you even more ways to shape the town.

When you finish a location, frame the shot, take a pic, then add it to your dossier before moving to your next blank canvas.

Each location presents a unique set of objects and a limited space to build within. Whether it’s food trucks, neon signs, or industrial smokestacks, players must carefully fit everything together to create a dense, living space that feels right.

This is a casual game through and through. There are no wrong answers here. Remember to make each placement personal, and every messy little corner adds to the charm.

With ShantyTown's added Creative Mode, you have unlimited building options with every unlocked location and item that you've acquired throughout your journey through ShantyTown. Stack buildings high, wide, and in any direction. We've also included a Blankspace with an enormous sandbox space to design custom towns and shops to your heart's desire.

Design custom creations with no restrictions whatsoever.

- Unique decorations across every map

- Discover each location’s story as you build

- A warm, relaxing soundtrack crafted by vaporwave artist Macroblank

- Optional goals to guide your creativity

- Peaceful, atmospheric scenery to unwind with

- In-depth camera settings to frame your creations

- Hidden objects waiting to be found

- No time or pressure. Please, enjoy everything at your own pace.

games.name: Talented
games.shortDescription: Slay waves of spooky enemies for 20 nights to survive 'The Demonic Conveyor Belt'. Talented is an arcade roguelite with randomly generated skill trees. Choose your upgrades and abilities wisely and you might just make it out alive. Are you truly Talented?
games.aboutText:
When Ed accepted the challenge of surviving exactly 20 days and 20 nights in The Demonic Conveyor Belt (D.C.B), he thought his Elite Mastery Professor had been exaggerating that it was 'the most feared dungeon of all'. This thought quickly disappeared into the fog surrounding him, when he passed through the gates of the dungeon to find the largest eyeball he'd ever seen. Would he forever remain just Ed, or could he become Talent Ed?

Talented is an arcade roguelite shoot 'em up with randomly generated skill trees. Survive 20 nights and defeat the dungeon to unlock all six classes, each with unlockable talents, abilities and challenges.

Send a hail of arrows, conjure powerful spells, brew unique potions, or call upon an army of snails to hold back the demons. The possibilities are endless.

- Craft your own builds, with over 500 Talents to learn

- Obliterate your foes, with over 100 abilities

- Explore a new talent tree every run with randomly generated skill trees

- Go Endless and push your builds to their limit

- Master six classes, each with its own playstyle

- Customise your character's loadout with class specific traits and skins

- Challenge yourself, with 25 mastery levels

- Explore new ways to play, with 10 challenges per class

games.name: Sephiria
games.shortDescription: Save Bunnyville from a doomed fate: a top-down action/RPG roguelite from the makers of Dungreed. Explore the depths of the tower, collect and upgrade artifacts, and defeat hordes of demons to keep your village safe.
games.aboutText:
On the Day of Destiny, a terrible omen strikes Bunnyville. The bunny villagers will be slaughtered by a horde of demons… unless you can stop them.

Sephiria is a fate-defying action roguelite following a brave bunny on a quest to save their town from doom. Master and upgrade different weapons, unlock new Talents each run, strategically arrange your inventory, and fight through hordes of enemies to uncover the threat waiting at the journey's end.

Features

- Strategic inventory system: Collect and arrange Artifacts and empower them with the different Tablets. Manage your inventory to suit your abilities!

- Custom combat: Master 6 distinct weapons, each with over 50 unique upgrades to unlock!

- Ever-changing threats: Face more than 60 distinct and dangerous enemies, and over 10 unique bosses. Across a journey spanning 6 chapters, the challenges ahead grow ever greater.

- Join forces: Team up with friends in online co-op for up to 4 players and explore the tower together. Trade items, revive fallen companions, and claim victory as a team!

games.name: Astra Hunter Zosma
games.shortDescription: A treasure-hunting RPG with a lifelong friend! Escape the Crescent Moon Tower and return to the surface world... and grab lots of treasure on the way!
games.aboutText:
The secrets and treasures of ancient civilizations have long eluded the Astra Hunters: a guild of explorers-for-hire tasked with uncovering the world's greatest riches. And Zosma is the greatest Astra Hunter of them all! Or at least he wishes, were he not ranked dead last as always.

What seems like a routine attempt to uncover more about Zosma's favorite adventuring ground becomes the beginning of a grand adventure as he plummets for miles to what should have been certain death! With no way up back to the surface except through the daunting Crescent Moon Tower, Zosma may just find his greatest discoveries ever... and get some help from a mysterious animal companion along the way!

Unleash the power of teamwork, collect valuables, and solve the mystery of the Crescent Moon Tower in this RPG adventure!

Astra Hunter Zosma is a short treasure-hunting RPG with a focus on dungeon exploration and a blossoming friendship between a buddy duo! Collect treasure as you climb the Crescent Moon Tower to help make Zosma the greatest Astra Hunter upon his return home!

- An RPG adventure with many special treasures to collect!

- Classic turn-based combat that you know and love.

- A combo-based battle system: Zosma can act multiple times per turn and chain abilities together to steadily increase their power, and even increase the effects of items.

- A companion helper with a customizable move set.

- Give your buddy a boost in battle by feeding them yummy treats!

- Equip class-inspired Sigils such as Warrior, Cleric, and more to change what moves Zosma has at his disposal.

- Discover and unleash powerful Astra abilities with the help of your companion!

- An optional dungeon that continuously expands as the story progresses. Dive deep to find even greater challenges and treasure to collect!

- Fully custom sound and visuals, and a stellar custom soundtrack!

games.name: Doggy Don't Care
games.shortDescription: What does your dog get up to when you're not home? In this bone-afide adventure, unleash adorable chaos, solve puzzles, and leave your mark (literally!) as a mischievous pup on the loose.
games.aboutText:
Doggy Don’t Care is a comedic 3D adventure where you step into the paws of an adorable but mischievous pup! When Charlie’s owner leaves him home alone, it’s his chance to explore, collect, and smash his way through four vibrant, interactive environments!

Solve puzzles and dig into a howl-arious list of fun-filled shenanigans in an attempt to impress Charlie’s feathered friends, who reward you with ✨Mischievous Badges✨

Charlie has one main mission: to cause as much adorable chaos as possible. By grabbing a roll of toilet paper, he can leave a trail of TP in his path, or by stepping in oil, he can leave paw prints over the roof of his owner’s car. She won’t be mad, right?

Across four vibrant cartoon-style levels, Charlie is free to run amok to his little heart’s content. Be sure to leave no pillow, chair or photo frame unturned!

It’s fun to cause adorable chaos, but what’s the goal?

Each stage features plenty of badges that reward Charlie’s shenanigans. Each badge is a puzzle for Charlie to solve, all relying on his ability to cause as much mayhem as possible.

As Charlie explores, he’ll find plenty of new and adorable pawjama outfits for him to wear. Dress Charlie in an entire puppy closet full of costumes, including a giraffe, a unicorn, or even (heaven forbid) a cat!

Ever wondered what goes on in our dogs' minds when they’re sleeping and their legs start twitching? Explore Charlie’s dreams and uncover their hidden meanings.

🐶 A pawsitively chaotic single-player adventure

🌈 Vibrant 3D cartoon-style graphics

🧦 Adorable pawjama outfits

🧠 Puzzles to solve using found items

⭐ Earn mischievous badges for being naughty

🐦 Impress your feathered friends

✨ You can pee everywhere!

✅ Fun for all ages

Experience the world through a dog's eyes in this game of exploration, problem-solving, and causing mischief. "Doggy Don't Care" is your invitation to unleash your inner pup!

games.name: Pale Coins
games.shortDescription: Journey into the ruthless open world of Pale Coins, an old-school fantasy RPG. Face punishing bosses, goblin-infested dungeons, and discover legendary weapons as you customize your champion and fight across Grenmark for the fabled Champion's Coin.
games.aboutText:
Grenmark is not a kind place, and it does not care who you are when you arrive.

Pale Coins is an old school Fantasy Action RPG with soulslike elements, built around challenging gameplay and well earned victories. Explore the lands, descend into punishing dungeons, and face boss fights with great creatures that test skill and resolve. Claim your loot, take on perilous quests, and uncover the lore of the world.

Prepare for battle as you venture beyond the safety of the capital and its villages, where many monsters wait in the wilds. Among them are formidable boss encounters that will test your wisdom and skill.

Unearth a wide arsenal of melee, ranged, and magic weapons, each with its own stats and skills, alongside a deep selection of armor sets that let you shape your character into something entirely your own.

Discover rare equipment scattered throughout the vibrant world of Grenmark that grants powerful skills while worn. Cast special magic spells, gain new movement abilities, summon minions, and unlock far more as you experiment with different items. Seek them out, learn what they can do, and master the skills that fit your style.

Explore a handcrafted fantasy world that does not offer comfort or certainty. Begin with nothing but an old weapon and the road ahead. Cross forests and ruins, climb inside volcanos, and descend into caverns where light struggles to follow. Along the way, meet strangers and learn their stories as you search for the long lost Champion’s Coin.

Key Features

- Gorgeous handcrafted pixel-art

- Expansive world to explore, filled with NPCs and dungeons

- Challenging combat and unique skills

- A variety of unique and difficult bosses to defeat

- Tons of equipment and items to discover

- Many branching storylines and quests to complete

- Old-school RPG with no handholding

games.name: Reinforced Machine
games.shortDescription: A fast-paced mech arena shooter mixing arcade intensity with skill-based unlocks. Unleash powerful ultimate forms, mix and match skills to define your playstyle, and master each unique combat machine to unlock their signature abilities.
games.aboutText:
Reinforced Machine is a fast-paced twin-stick mech shooter where you battle through waves of cyborg creatures. Each mech features unique weapons and skills—equip two skills from six available options to best suit your playstyle.

Every Reinforced Machine can unleash a powerful ultimate transformation, granting access to devastating legendary weapons and turning the tide of battle. As you master each mech through skill-based progression, you'll unlock their signature abilities. Choose from multiple Reinforced Machines: Combatron, Syntax, Mecha-Simian, Pylon, Firewall, and more!

games.name: Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector
games.shortDescription: A dice-driven RPG, in a human and heartfelt sci-fi world. You are an escaped android, with a malfunctioning body, a price on your head and no memory of your past. Get a ship, find a crew, and take on contracts while you navigate across the Starward Belt.
games.aboutText:
The highly anticipated sequel to one of 2022’s most acclaimed RPGs, Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector takes players to the Starward Belt, a richly realised, ramshackle set of habitats in an asteroid belt full of secrets, stories, and characters trying to make ends meet.

You are a sleeper, an emulation of a human mind housed in an artificial body. You are on the run from the corporation that made you and the gang that seeks to control you. Commandeer a ship, build a network of crew and allies, and take on challenging contracts as you seek to build a future for yourself.

Choose a class, configure your skills and assemble your crew in unique tabletop-inspired gameplay. Your future depends on the roll of a dice, as you make difficult choices in a complex world. Reinventing the award-winning systems of Citizen Sleeper, this dice-driven RPG will satisfy both fans of the original game and new players alike.

To stay one step ahead of your pursuers you’ll need three things: A belt-worthy ship, a tight crew and a contract or two.

The ship you stole. It’s a ragged old Rig that’s seen better days, but it’s all you’ve got. Upgrade your ship to extend its range, reach new locations and turn it from a hovel to a home.

Your crew starts with Serafin, your fellow escapee and a rock-solid pilot. But you’ll need scrappers, engineers and all sorts to take on the work that’ll keep you flying. From temporary contractors to new residents of the Rig, each of these characters has their own story, skills and troubles. Choose carefully.

Contracts take place far from the bars and shops of the Belt’s many hubs. These high-risk jobs each have their own challenges. From exploring treacherous derelicts and risky heists, to asteroid surveying and ship repair, you’ll need to make the most of your skills, crew and resources to complete the contract and get paid.

Soon after escaping from your corporate overlords, you fell under the control of a local criminal gang and its leader, Laine. Now, after a desperate attempt to free yourself from servitude by rewriting the very code that governs your system, you are on the run again, this time with a malfunctioning body, a price on your head and no memory of your past.

Each character class now has a unique “Push” ability, upgradable and customisable, that can help you turn the tide of a difficult job or send you into a dangerous spiral depending on how and when you choose to use it. Reroll your dice to change your fate, or focus a single die to bet everything on a big success. Each class offers different tactical possibilities.

Nothing in the Belt ever runs smooth, including your artificial body. Citizen Sleeper’s revolutionary dice system returns, revised for the sequel. Manage your stress or take damage to your dice. Deal with glitches as they accrue in your system. Push yourself to get lucky and make this cycle count.

Contracts offer a new kind of focussed, tactical gameplay to the Citizen Sleeper experience. You’ll need to prepare carefully and choose the right approach for these multi-cycle, high-risk, high-reward jobs, but you’ll also have to react and adapt to both the roll of the dice and the twists and turns of each task.

The Starward Belt offers a bigger, more varied world than the original game. Instead of living on a single station, you'll chart a course from hub to hub with complete freedom, taking on jobs and setting goals as you see fit. A living world, the Belt rewards curiosity and care, but it's up to you to decide which locations and stories deserve your time and resources.

Player choice is a massive part of the Citizen Sleeper experience, and the sequel deepens this with new skill checks that allow you to express your class and character in scenes, as well as branching storylines that will ask you to make hard choices. The future of your character is up to you.

ABOUT THE DEVELOPER

Jump Over the Age is a one-person game development studio founded by Gareth Damian Martin (they/them). Gareth is the winner of GDCA and Indiecade awards, and has been nominated for a Games Award, multiple IGF Awards, a GDC Award, and four BAFTAs. They have been named both “An accomplished world-builder” (Edge Magazine) and “one of the most exciting indie talents around” (Eurogamer).

For Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector Gareth is once again joined by renowned comic book artist, Guillaume Singelin and celebrated composer, Amos Roddy - the same exceptionally talented development team responsible for Citizen Sleeper’s moving narrative, eye-popping art and immersive music and sound.

games.name: StarShip-DF
games.shortDescription: Build a massive multi-deck starship and lead colonists across the galaxy. Gather resources in space or land on alien worlds for supplies. Defend your warm home from warships and beasts, use robots for labor. Tired of drifting alone through deep space? Bring a crew, and loneliness fades away.
games.aboutText:
his is a 3D multi-deck starship base management game. I have long sought the ultimate form of base building: a mobile fortress, freely navigable and built in multiple stacked decks.

Construct your colossal starship from scratch and lead your colonists across the galaxy. It can drift in the endless void, dock at asteroid belts, or touch down fully upon solid planetary surfaces. The viewport draws a dividing line: within, you arrange dining halls, quarters and workshops, filled with orderly light and the warmth of life; beyond lie frigid ice plains, pink-hued lakes, arid deserts and smoldering lava lands — wild alien worlds, vast, silent, and fraught with hidden danger.

In deep space, send your strike craft to harvest resources and salvage cosmic wreckage. Once landed, colonists step out from the safe, warm hull, venture into the alien wilderness to gather supplies, and encounter the unique ecosystems of these worlds.

The journey is never peaceful. Hostile warships may ambush you in space, and feral creatures lurk across alien landscapes. Build weapons and defenses to safeguard this small haven, so your colonists may work, dine and rest in safety. As technology advances, automated robots will take over grueling labor and help you maintain order aboard the ship.

On one side, the quiet warmth contained within your hull; on the other, the vast, lonely perils of the stars. This is the ultimate mobile base, free to sail to every corner of the galaxy.

Tired of drifting alone through the endless expanse of deep space? Bring a crew with you, and loneliness will fade away.

games.name: Cats on Duty
games.shortDescription: Cats on Duty is a🐱 purr-fect blend of RTS, tower defense, game genres. Manage two game fields, upgrade adorable cat towers, and watch your fluffy warriors bravely defend against foes. 🐾
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Cats on Duty, the purr-fectly hilarious and action-packed ultimate blend of real-time strategy, tower defense, and match-3 mechanics, where heavily armed battle-hardened cat veterans of rodent skirmishes and yarn tangles take charge in defending their homeland (and litter boxes) against the forces of great evil! Utilize a multitude of cat varieties to engage in combat against 50 types of fiendish creatures. Unleash the power of the whiskers and drive those zombies back to the depths of the underworld!

Tactical Tower Defense: Defend your territory with a brutal arsenal of weaponry. From powerful rifles that reach the enemy at a distance to death-defying ninjas with blades sharper than any groomer's scissors, strategically place your feline soldiers to ensure victory on the battlefield.

Unleash the Cattitude: Prepare for epic cat fights, playful antics, and adorable meows as your feline warriors show off their unique personalities and unleash their special abilities. Brace yourself for a blend of sass and strategy that will keep you entertained throughout the battles.

Match-3 Mayhem: It's not just tower defense; it's tower defense with a twist of addictive match-3 gameplay! Connect gems on the resource field to receive currency and purchase cat towers. Swap and combine cats on the battlefield to create upgraded towers and unleash devastating attacks. Inspired by Plants vs Zombies and Tower Swap, Cats on Duty takes the best of the genre and enhances it with captivating match-3 mechanics.

- Customize and Improve your Squad: Unlock and collect a variety of quirky cat characters, each with their own strengths and abilities. From snipers and assassins to shotgun-toting Rambo-like felines and even a battle version of Puss in Boots, tailor your team to your playstyle and create the ultimate squad of kitty heroes. Gather three kittens in a row and witness the birth of a SUPER BATTLE CAT!

- Epic Battles: Face off against formidable foes that will make your whiskers tremble. Zombies, skeletons, spiders, Baba Yaga, and EPIC bosses await your tactical prowess. Sharpen your claws, load your shotguns, and show them who's the real top cat on the battlefield!

- Unique Environments: Explore diverse and meticulously crafted levels, from deceptively cozy suburban backyards to mysterious desert. Each environment presents unique challenges that require cunning strategy to emerge victorious.

- Charming Pixel-Cat Graphics: Immerse yourself in a vibrant and whimsical world filled with colorful environments and adorable cat animations. It's a visual feast that will make you feel like you're right in the midst of a kitty adventure!

Get your paws on Cats on Duty now and let the cat-astrophe begin! And remember, in the world of Cats on Duty, some enemies may have nine lives, but they've never faced a cat army like yours before!

games.name: Crown Gambit
games.shortDescription: Play as three intrepid paladins through a terrible war of succession to save a sinister medieval kingdom from political turmoil. Pick a side amongst noble families to choose the future monarch and crush those who stand in your way through board-shattering tactical card combat!
games.aboutText:
Crown Gambit is a narrative tactical game in which you guide three paladins down an ominous path, through a capital plagued by chaos and political unrest.

Pledge allegiance to one of the pretenders to the throne and help them ascend to power. Follow your own principles but be careful , as your choices often come at a price!

Pick a side among plotters and use ancestral relics to defeat your foes, from power-hungry knights to cunning nobles and rebel commoners.

What will you sacrifice to save the kingdom? Which heir to the throne will you champion? The realm’s destiny lies in your hands.

CARVE YOUR OWN PATH THROUGH THE CHAOS

The kingdom of Meodred's tenuous balance of power is being shaken to its core by a terrible political crisis , while mystical forces appear to be pulling strings from the darkness. Each pretender to the throne is rallying their troops to seize the crown, as the commoners forment a revolt and the tide rises still... At the heart of this turmoil, you play as three novice relic-wielding paladins of the crown forced to make difficult decisions to ensure the kingdom doesn't descend into chaos.

Refine your paladins' personalities through dreadful choices along the story and stay true to your own principles. Pick your allies wisely and navigate through rivalries to foil conspiracies. But trust no one: in times of chaos, duplicity reigns supreme.

FEEL THE IMPACT IN EPIC BOARD-SHATTERING CARD COMBATS

Control a trio of paladins in close-quarter tactical combat: Aliza , the blood-bending swashbuckler, Hael , the mace-swinging cleric, and Rollo , the anchor-waving tanker. Experience the might of your blows through impactful attack animations as you smash through enemies with your sacred relic weapons. Stay on your guard, as other powerful paladins follow their own allegiances - and they won't go down without a fight.

Prepare yourself during your travels and build the deck of each paladin carefully to overcome any obstacle in your way. Become a well-oiled united team fighting their adversaries and making each blow count - with style.

POWER IS A DOUBLE-EDGED SWORD

Channel dark and ancient power through your holy relics and turn the tides of battle by calling upon Ancestral Grace . You will certainly slash through your foes quicker but beware, as the price for this godly strenght may well be your soul...

GAME FEATURES

- Influence Meodred’s fate: choose your allies and enemies carefully to unveil the story's many twists and turns, including its manifold endings.

- Play as a team of three fearless paladins entangled in this political chaos: Aliza, the blood-bending swashbuckler, Hael, the mace-wielding cleric, and Rollo, the anchor-waving tanker.

- Face low-life bandits, mighty knights, and unearthly beasts in tactical turn-based card battles, and unlock devastating techniques to shape each paladin’s combat style.

- Channel the dark powers of the Ancestral Grace to deliver powerful blows. Be careful: this magic’s influence might have more of a hold on you than you think.

- Journey through a mysterious dark-fantasy universe inspired by Celtic and Breton folklore, full of eldritch mysteries.

- Enjoy bold, expressionist hand-drawn illustrations by Gobert and a haunting medieval soundtrack with a modern twist.

games.name: Ticy Adventure Club : Queen of the Spring
games.shortDescription: 本作是一款RPG恐怖解谜游戏。在游戏中，玩家将扮演一群以解决灵异事件为课外实践活动的学生，在提西城里调查有关“春日女王”的事件。随着调查的深入，一场巨大的阴谋正徐徐展开……
games.aboutText:
提西探险社：春日女王

一群聚集在提西中学 “探险社” 的天才少年们，找到了关于三年前的一桩失踪案的线索。

但在他们思考如何采取进一步行动的同时，一个关于 “春日女王” 的传言，给提西城带来了史无前例的大危机，也让探险社陷入困境……

不过，事情并不会到此结束，因为提西城探案界冉冉升起的新星——

“提西侦探社” 的加丝蒂思与其伙伴们，也接下了这个案件。

最后的谜团将由谁来解开？提西城的命运又将会怎样呢……

操作说明

- 方向键 - 操控角色行走

- 空格键 / Z键 / Enter键 - 进行对话 / 交互

- ESC / X键 - 打开菜单栏 存档

- Shift + 方向键 - 跑步

请注意，本游戏 没有自动存档 ，需要手动存档。

控制角色自由调查的时候可以 随时存档 ，打开菜单栏找到对应选项即可。

另外，每个章节中间也会有存档提示，还请注意保存好游戏进度，非常感谢。

games.name: Skogdal
games.shortDescription: A deckbuilding adventure card game set in a rustic Norwegian town during the 90's. Recruit followers, draft cards and build powerful combos. Explore a hand-crafted world across multiple runs and uncover an unsettling mystery…
games.aboutText:
Something strange is afoot in the small rustic Norwegian town of Skogdal...
