This is a deckbuilding card game where you have to explore a large hand-crafted world across multiple runs. Immerse yourself in this weird but familiar adventure, and uncover an unsettling Carpenter-esque mystery…

Skogdal offers more than 300 different cards for you to discover and draft. Fuse cards, build powerful combos and recruit followers to aid you in your journey: politicians, bodybuilders, wrestlers, pyromaniacs, skaters, punks, priests, pets and pests…

...good luck, the truth is out there!

games.name: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily
games.shortDescription: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily is a turn-based strategy game. Framed for murdering the Emperor, villainess Scarlet and Lily, fight the Empire as the first Streamers in history. Capture every enemy and turn them into allies for a happy ending... Or execute everyone and become the Demon Queen!
games.aboutText:
Story

In the rigid hierarchy of the Empire’s aristocracy, the free-spirited duchess Scarlet refused to conform, and was framed for Regicide, the assassination of the Emperor.

With the help of Lily, the captain of the cutting-edge Stream Airship, Scarlet escapes the imperial capital and declares war against the Empire!

As Scarlet’s recklessness and Lily’s cold pragmatism collide, the conflict soon engulfs the entire continent.

Capture enemy generals, turn them into allies, and clear Scarlet’s name as you fight for the duo’s happy ending!

Capturing-Turn-Based Strategy

Victory is achieved by "capturing" or "executing" enemy generals.

Defeat comes if either Scarlet or Lily falls in battle.

Secure only the essential supply line outposts, and carve a path of invasion using your limited forces and the Stream Airship.

You can ambush, prolong sieges or a full-scale attack... Nothing is off the table.

Supply Lines: The Heart of Battle

Units stationed at outposts connected to your headquarters via “lines” receive powerful support every turn. This applies to both allies and enemies.

Get cut off, and you’re in danger. Cut the enemy’s line, and an opportunity arises.

What matters isn’t territory, but maintaining critical supply lines.

Do not get distracted by the enemy!

Capture-Based Strategy That Stays Tense to the End

The enemy comes in overwhelming numbers, backed by sudden reinforcements and surprise attacks.

Scarlet’s army is too small to defend every front.

Abandon unnecessary outposts, do NOT hesitate, and focus your forces on a single enemy general.

Build a supply line that maximizes your power and give it all to the enemy general!

Map-Wide Weapon: The Stream Airship

The Stream Airship is your ultimate battlefield tool, exclusive to your army.

Freeze enemy advances with <Stalling Stream>, cut off their supply line to the frontlines with the <Interception Stream>.

Convince entire squads to surrender or defect with the <Surrender Stream>, and even boost movement to intercept ambushes with the <Hustle Stream>.

There are countless strategic uses.

But the most important is the <Capture Stream>. While it’s active, you can capture enemy generals!

Capturing Enemy generals

Activating the Capture Stream lets Lily use her skill to take enemy generals alive.

Captured generals will join your side, bringing unique abilities and new stream options.

Capturing all enemy generals is the only path to Scarlet and Lily’s true happy ending.

(Even if they don’t join right away, as long as they’re captured, you’re safe!)

Executing Enemy generals

You can execute generals instead of capturing them, and the story will still progress.

This pushes Scarlet and Lily closer to becoming Demon Queens, greatly increasing their combat power...

But the truth will be lost forever.

Capture them all, or kill them all and seize the power—the choice is yours.

Foster Bonds Between Allies

Allies grow stronger as they fight, and fielding certain pairs together and winning a fight increases their trust level.

When trust levels reach a certain threshold, Unite Episodes will occur, and deepening the trust further will unlock powerful tag-team bond skills named Unison Skills!

Staff members

Main Character Design: Rolua (Nijisanji) ▽▲TRiNITY▲▽1st Album『PRiSM』Cover art, 『Ready Steady』 (Giga) MV illustration, pixiv supervised illustration art book 『VISIONS EDGE ILLUSTRATORS BOOK Evil & Power』 (KADOKAWA) Cover illustration etc.)

*The story depicts bonds between characters and includes elements of romantic relationships between women, but there is no erotic content.

games.name: Eventide Matter
games.shortDescription: A 2D space mining adventure. Mine exotic resources, unlock powerful equipment, and fend off relentless enemies to build an inter-dimensional portal, the last hope of salvation for your civilization.
games.aboutText:
You are Vanguard Unit 4, the last hope of a dying universe. Your mission: build a Phase Gate in an uncharted continuum to evacuate the fleeing remnants of your civilization before reality itself collapses.

But this new dimension is not empty. It is defended by crystalline lifeforms that see you as an invader. They will stop at nothing to destroy your creation.

The clock is ticking. With every passing moment, your home universe decays. The fleet is counting on you. Will you hold the line and open the path to salvation?

Eventide Matter features:

- Mine 6 unique materials and craft them into advanced components.

- Research dozens of permanent upgrades in a sprawling tech tree.

- Unlock and enhance around 10 module types, including lasers, thrusters, tractor beams, drones, and shields.

- Assemble the complex portal piece by piece, through multiple intricate layers.

- Survive relentless enemies that pursue you and seek to destroy your progress.

games.name: Mimic Logic
games.shortDescription: "Mimic Logic" is an automatically generated logic puzzle roguelike. Listen to the statements of the treasure chests, find the lying mimics, and open the rest of the treasure chests! Opening a mimic results in a game over.
games.aboutText:
What is Mimic Logic?

A procedurally generated roguelike logic puzzle game where you can speak to treasure boxes.

Listen to what the boxes have to say, find the lying Mimics, and open up the remaining boxes to collect treasure!

If you accidentally open up a Mimic, it's game over!

Use the gear and items you've collected from treasure boxes to beat enemies and conquer the dungeon.

The puzzles are procedurally generated, so you can solve them to your heart's content!

games.name: The Scourge | Tai Ương
games.shortDescription: Explore the nightmarish lucid dreams of Nhat Huy to solve his family's mystery. Set in 90s Saigon, navigate dilapidated corridors, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover sinister secrets. Can you survive the twisting maze and The Scourge?
games.aboutText:
"The Scourge" is a first person horror puzzle game, immersing you in the heart of Saigon (Vietnam) through urban legends from the 1990s. You will follow the tragic fate of a family and the main character, who made mistakes in the past and is now haunted by a sinister supernatural force.

The protagonist, a person overwhelmed by delusions due to past tragedies and life's despair, frequently finds himself in nightmares. In these dreams, the line between reality and illusion becomes blurred. To rediscover his inner light and escape from the shadows of his past, he must confront his sorrows, make amends for his mistakes, and defeat the most formidable enemy that exists not only in his mind but also in the real world.

Starting in a rundown apartment during an era of an unnamed epidemic, where mysteries and supernatural phenomena occur incessantly, you'll need to use your intellect to solve intricate puzzles, explore new areas, and prepare for the ultimate showdown. Every decision, every action, will determine his fate and future. Stay alert and be ready to face all challenges.

games.name: The Last Train
games.shortDescription: In the barren wasteland on the brink of extinction, the last Train departs, supposedly carrying its passengers in search of a place where they can survive. A creature named Eilf boards the Train, determined to travel to Spring - the station that has been said to have vanished.
games.aboutText:
"A pet raising simulator on a train, I guess"

In the barren wasteland on the brink of extinction,
the last Train departs, supposedly carrying its passengers in search of a place where they can survive.
A creature named Eilf boards the Train, determined to travel to Spring - the station that has been said to have vanished.

※ About This Game
The Last Train is a pixel RPG which story takes place on a Train and the world outside.
You and the mysterious fellow passengers will need to collect vital supplies to overcome perilous challenges and survive as you journey towards the ruins of Spring.
Along the way, you'll encounter a captivating cast of passengers, forging fleeting yet unforgettable bonds.
Together with your mysterious ally in a jar, unravel the hidden secrets that lie beneath the surface of this strange and arid land.

※ The Train
A comfortable and safe resting place.
It will protect you from the harmful radiation from outside.
Here you will meet some strange passengers.
Talk to them to discover the secrets of The Last Train.

※ The wilderness
The barren wasteland left after the demise.
Unknown radiation constantly damages your body.
Gather as many supplies as you can in the limited time available.
Explore and learn everything you can about this world.

※ Features

- Play as a fantasy creature, meeting quirky characters with very different personalities.

- Unfold an engaging and fluid storyline as you explore breathtaking environments and engage in lively dialogue.

- Embark on an unforgettable adventure through uncharted lands, working together with your companions to survive!

- Some of your decisions will determine the ultimate fate of you and your companions.

※ Controls

- Movement: Arrow Keys or WASD

- Menu: X (Open/Close)

- Select/Confirm: Z

- Cancel: X

- Full Screen/Windowed: Alt+Enter

※ Other Information
Playthrough time: 3-5 Hours
Developer: Carbontea
Publisher: Eternal Dream Studio
Cover Picture: PPMiecoo

Thank you for your time!♥

games.name: Leila
games.shortDescription: Leila is a heartfelt, hand-animated narrative game about the small yet significant struggles we all face. Solve story-driven puzzles, relive fragile memories, and discover a deeply personal journey that may feel more familiar than you expect.
games.aboutText:
"Normally I'd dig a hole in me and then fall into it, But this time I decided that instead of falling in, I would willingly go in. Here I am, drifting on the shores of my life."

Play as Leila and traverse through all phases of her life, uncovering her pivotal life moments. By unraveling puzzles imbued with the fragments of her narrative, you'll comprehend the motives behind Leila's life decisions. As you delve deeper into her psyche and her emotional landscape, you'll discover facets of your own self mirrored in the life journey of this seemingly ordinary woman.

Step into journey through the layers of Leila, a captivating, story-driven adventure that comes alive with charming narration and stunning artwork. Every frame is a masterpiece, handcrafted with detailed traditional animation, and each moment is accentuated with an evocative original soundtrack.

Embark on Leila's journey as she grapples with the complexities of love, trust, and the shadows of her past. Navigate thought-provoking puzzles that challenge and engage, deepening the immersion in her tale.

What to expect:

♥ 4 Chapters,
♥ Story-related puzzles and mini games,
♥ Hand-drawn cinematics,
♥ 16 original soundtracks,
♥ Voice acting in English,
♥ Click and Drag Gameplay.

games.name: Emberward
games.shortDescription: Build twisting mazes with tetromino blocks and deploy unique towers in this strategic roguelite tower defense adventure!
games.aboutText:
- Build a maze before the battle begins! Be creative and find the best setup with the block cards in your hand.

- Make good use of your limited wall blocks! Will you make the monsters take a longer route, or will you use the blocks to position your towers more strategically?

- After the battle, add various runes to the block cards! Runes can enhance your towers, grant blocks special abilities, or even double their size!

- Tower with various sizes : 1x3? 2x2? 3x3? Building powerful towers requires careful planning!

- Poison Towers that Span Monster Paths : Instead of shooting, we pour poison directly on the enemies' heads!

- Drone Towers that Track Enemies : Why wait for enemies to come? Attack is the best form of defence!

- D20 Towers that Test Your Luck : Higher number equals higher damage!

- (...and a lot more!!)

- Choose your character and flame before starting your adventure!

- Each run is unique with different maps, tower compositions, and mazes.

- Collect new towers, block cards, or power relics during your journey.

- Each battle grants you experience. Learn from various talents and become stronger for your next adventure!

- Adventure Mode: Fight through a series of stages and take on powerful bosses.

- Endless Mode: Play special event maps and over 80 stages while competing for the top spot on the leaderboards!

- Enigma Sanctum: A fast-paced game mode where you build the strongest defense with a limited set of cards.

games.name: Paris Transylvania
games.shortDescription: A vampire-slaying pachinko roguelike deckbuilder. Collect a powerful deck of cards, strategize, aim, and pop pegs to power up and deal massive damage with relic synergies. Play as one of the unlikely heroes, conquer Transylvania, and free the people in this turn-based RPG.
games.aboutText:
A vampire-slaying pachinko roguelike deckbuilder. Collect a powerful deck of cards, strategize, aim, and pop pegs to power up and deal massive damage with relic synergies. Play as one of the unlikely heroes, conquer Transylvania, and free the people in this turn-based RPG.

Dynamic Deck Building

Create a unique deck by choosing cards wisely. Discover hundreds of cards to defeat wicked creatures and regain power.

Pachinko-style Gameplay

Strategically hit pegs to power up your cards. Uncover game-changing relics throughout the world to enhance your deck.

Ever-Changing Transylvania

Maps change with each journey. Choose paths, face different enemies, encounter random events, and confront various bosses.

Paris Transylvania features a nostalgic cartoony art style mixed with retro elements, blending Peggle, Peglin and Slay The Spire mechanics with a fresh twist in both format and gameplay. Play cards in any order and choose your path without RNG. The boss fights will keep you on your toes, with extravagant creeps and heart-pounding retro minigames adding to the excitement.

games.name: Ligo
games.shortDescription: Explore a mysterious non-linear world filled with puzzles and secrets. Make small creatures work together to lift the curse and reconnect the world.
games.aboutText:
Ligo is an adventure Sokoban game, where you solve handcrafted puzzles and mysteries about the world by merging, cutting, pushing smalls creatures together and crushing squids with blocks.

Each part of the world has different rules and challenges. Explore an interconnected world of puzzles and mysteries. You take control of small blob-like creature and make them work together to solve many types of challenges.

Features :

- Nonlinear puzzle game

- Challenging and rewarding

- More than 200+ handcrafted puzzles

- Full of mysteries and secrets

games.name: Lone Fungus: Melody of Spores
games.shortDescription: Embark on a heartfelt Mushroomvania adventure through a vast and dense interconnected world! It's like a mix of retro and modern classics!
games.aboutText:
- Master fluid 8-directional whip combat with a variety of sub-weapons and tools, inspired by classics like Super Castlevania IV

- Explore a rich, interconnected world brimming with secrets, hidden paths, and ancient mysteries waiting to be uncovered

- Experience tight, responsive platforming that blends the precision of Celeste with Hollow Knight ’s rich sense of exploration

- Play as a brave little mushroom on an epic yet whimsical journey through a world of fungi, magic, and forgotten kingdoms

- Immerse yourself in beautiful handcrafted pixel art , a fresh experience that evokes that nostalgia you are craving for

Not a dark Metroidvania!

A colorful, heartfelt adventure full of charm, discovery, and mushroom magic!

Play as Greencap , a brave little hero on a quest to fulfill his destiny and protect the Mushkind from a mysterious and dangerous foe known as the Spirit Beast . Along the way, you’ll encounter the mischievous rival crew known as the Fung Gang , who claim they’re after the same goal... sort of.

A sense of adventure!

Explore lively towns and cozy settlements, uncover hidden secrets within ancient ruins, and collect powerful upgrades that reward your curiosity. There’s plenty of challenge along the way, but don’t worry!

This isn't a punishing experience, it's meant to be a fun challenge and an uplifting journey through a world that encourages exploration and wonder.

And for the platforming enthusiasts?

Want to put your platforming to the test? A side quest unlocks 40 optional parkour gauntlets hidden behind special portals scattered around the world! They’re tough, rewarding, and totally skippable, perfect for players who love a good challenge.

games.name: Surviving Deponia
games.shortDescription: Explore, craft, build and fight your way through the harsh landscape of Deponia. Meet allies and make enemies while surviving the perils of the junk planet. It might be garbage - but it’s your garbage!
games.aboutText:
SURVIVING DEPONIA
“New Era - Same Trash”

7 years after we said “Goodbye, Deponia!” the once lovely little trash planet has turned into a Mad Max-ian nightmare: Elysium, the floating high society citadel, has crashed onto Deponia’s surface and brought with it not just a never-before-seen water shortage, but new structures and a new order as well.
Master Deponia’s harsh landscape, meet new as well as old friends and start carving out your path from heaps of junk!

BUILD YOUR HOME ON YOUR FAVORITE TRASH PLANET

Gather resources and craft your own home on Deponia. It might be garbage - but it’s your garbage!

SURVIVE THE HARSH WORLD OF DEPONIA

Deponia has changed since we last visited. If it’s not the dangerous living conditions that bring you to your knees, the monsters, both creatures and humans alike, surely will! OPEN A NEW CHAPTER

Even though Surviving Deponia can be enjoyed as a stand-alone experience, it takes place right after the Point & Click Adventure Series “Deponia” and gives fans canonical closure about Elysium’s fate and Deponia’s citizens.

games.name: VOIN
games.shortDescription: Crafted by a solo developer, VOIN is a first-person hack-and-slash. Cleave through hordes of enemies in fast-paced combat. Explore dark fantasy realms filled with secrets and dangers. Discover powerful gear and weapons, and face menacing bosses in your quest to cleanse a broken world.
games.aboutText:
In this shadowed world, secrets lie buried deep, and dangers wait in silence. Hordes rise against me, yet I cleave through them with elemental fury. I master the primal forces, bending chaos to my will. In this moment of convergence, I discover my true self, a being forged in both fury and beauty.

This is my dominion now.

I am the essence of ancient storms, summoned by a force beyond mortal comprehension. Born of the will of a faceless mage, I exist for one purpose alone: to become the weapon that reshapes a world ravaged by plague. My creators remain hidden, shrouded in mystery, yet I feel their command burn within me. This world is broken, and I am its reckoning. For I am VOIN.

Every strike I make is a hymn to destruction. My movements are a sacred dance within the heart of chaos. My blade sings as I sever through their ranks, executing perfect strikes, untouchable. I walk this path with purpose—will I remain unscathed?

The wind bends to my will. I leap across the ruins of once-grand castles with ease and soar above rivers raging far below. My fury rains down on them from the sky, leaving nothing but silence in my wake. I was never meant to crawl—I was born to be unbound and untethered.

I dive into the abyss, seeking the power that lies within. I claim weapons forged in the depths of darkness, gear that pulls me closer to my truest self. Yet this is only the beginning. I return to the Master’s Citadel, cleansing what I’ve gathered, sharpening the edge of my soul. And once more, I plunge back into the fray, unbroken, stronger than ever. This cycle defines me—the unyielding, ever-reborn.

They stand before me—titans of flesh and fury, living monuments to annihilation. Their eyes gleam with malice, their tactics ruthless. They believe they will break me. But I face them without fear. For I am no mere mortal standing in their shadow—I am the force destined to shatter their dominion. I walk among gods and monsters, and I do not tremble.

games.name: Orebound
games.shortDescription: Orebound is a dwarven themed factory automation game. Play alone or with friends as you build, mine, craft and explore a voxel generated world! Build your fortress, expand your factory, fight off creatures who dwell beneath the mountains and embark on a journey of greatness.
games.aboutText:
Explore, Mine, Automate - the world is yours!

Orebound is a voxel, factory, automation game set in a first person open-world. Explore the vast mountain ranges before you, or journey deep into the Earth to find the ultimate Dwarven prize – the Emberstone . Lost in the depths of time, the King has tasked you to scour the mountains to find its location. Using your Dwarven prowess and knowledge to mine, craft and automate through anything standing in your way. Build up or dig down! How far will you go?

Dig Deep and Discover

Journey down into the Earth to discover precious metals and resources to create your very own Dwarven mining fortress! Use your newly found building blocks to upgrade your tools and craft runes to enhance your efficiency. The deeper you go, the rarer the materials but who knows what else you’ll find in the depths of the planet.

Automate Your Way

Use your salvage to create huge automated factories to bring you a constant stream of blocks. Construct Dwarven drill rigs to mine out the mammoth crystal veins, use belts to connect your machines and refine your ores! Reach the heights of automation technology and live out your Dwarven dreams.

Features

⛏️ Voxel: Explore massive procedurally generated voxel landscapes; dig far and wide to search for ores all over (and under) the ends of the Earth.

🔨 Craft: Craft a multitude of dwarven items to help you dig deep into the mountains!

🔧 Automate: Build machines to mine and craft items to help you reach your goals!

🌍 Open World: Vast procedurally generated landscapes for you to explore.

games.name: Siren's Call: Escape Velocity
games.shortDescription: The definitive edition of the fan-favorite visual novel is here! A surreal, coming-of-age tale set in early 2010s Central Florida, Siren's Call is the small town you swore you'd always leave. Something inside you knows this is your last chance. Will you reach escape velocity?
games.aboutText:
As a story that begins at the end, all that's standing between you and adulthood are your old party members. Your best friends.

After a summer of deadly fights with supernatural creatures known only as "Sirens," you and your friends finally have time to relax and enjoy yourselves. But in the wreckage of a job well done...it's become obvious just how fleeting their time with you actually is. Even so, it's your job to say goodbye to each of them and go to college. It's your job to be an adult.

Still, it's five of them versus one of you. And after years of friendship and an entire summer of fighting side-by-side, these people know exactly what it takes to make you want to stay home...for just a bit longer.

A game that's designed to make you as unsure of yourself as humanly possible, Siren's Call takes full advantage of every aspect of the visual novel format to deliver a mind-warping storytelling experience. Can you get the "Hell" out of Florida? Will you reach Escape Velocity?

Game Features

- Over a 135,000 word script with more than 10 hours of story content.

- Two endings (one normal and one true) with a large amount of extra story content unlocked for completing the true ending.

- Over 70 unlockable gallery images with over 22 fully illustrated in game CGs.

- Over 20+ original tracks that make you really feel like you're in Central Florida.

- Unlockable Scene Selection.

- 8 different side-stories predating the events of the game.

- Countless easter eggs and hidden scenes.

- A completely accurate depiction of what it's like to live in Central Florida. Yes, it really is like this.

- A journal with pages and pages of unlockable lore to help you make sense of all this madness (maybe).

games.name: Cathedral: Crow's Curse
games.shortDescription: Set in the same universe as Cathedral, but with its own story and style, Cathedral: Crow's Curse is an action-adventure with tight combat and a focus on exploration. Parry, dodge and fight your way through numerous enemies in a rich detailed world as you uncover the events leading up to Cathedral.
games.aboutText:
Explore a large, cursed world

With a focus on combat, side quests and exploring a large seamless world, Crow's Curse lets you return to the world of Decemberborn's previous title, Cathedral. This prequel explores the events leading up to the events in Cathedral.

Step into the shadows and unravel the fate of the Shade Sentinels. Parry, dodge and fight your way through a seamless, interconnected world while you uncover the root of the curse that plagues it. Who were the First Ones and what did they leave behind? Battle ancient guardians, fight the Magnus Cultists of Shade Forest and unveil the hidden secrets of the one known only as The Architect .

Meet a vast array of characters, both friendly and not-so-friendly, in different biomes and towns. Explore side quests and unlock a ton of upgrades.

Key features

- Engaging skill-based combat

- Stealth mechanics

- Tons of upgrades

- Traps, puzzles and other mysteries to solve

- Meaningful side quests

- Explore multiple diverse regions, each with their own distinct look and feel

- Tight, responsive controls

games.name: Archangel: Demon Rush
games.shortDescription: Build your fortress while the horde is already attacking, then fight inside it. Freely place turrets and combine brutal weapons, cards and abilities until a desperate defence becomes an unstoppable demon-killing war machine in this third-person action roguelite.
games.aboutText:
BUILD THE FORTRESS. BECOME THE WEAPON.

In Archangel: Demon Rush , building and fighting happen at the same time.

Place turrets, shape the battlefield and reinforce your defences while relentless hordes are already attacking. When the line begins to break, step into the slaughter yourself and fight beside your fortress.

You are not watching the battle from a distance.

You fight inside the war machine you create.

BUILD WHILE THEY ATTACK

There is no quiet preparation phase.

Demons are already advancing towards your objective while you place defences, reinforce key positions and react to the pressure of the battlefield. Every decision matters, because every second of preparation happens under threat.

Hold the line, adapt your layout and keep building while the siege is already in motion.

FIGHT INSIDE YOUR OWN FORTRESS

Your turrets can weaken the horde, control routes and create deadly kill zones—but they cannot win alone.

When enemies break through, you must enter the battlefield yourself. Use brutal melee weapons, firearms and powerful abilities to destroy anything your defences cannot stop.

Your fortress needs you.

TURN A DESPERATE DEFENCE INTO A WAR MACHINE

Each run begins as a struggle for survival.

As the siege escalates, you will unlock stronger upgrades, combine weapons with defences, stack cards and passive effects, and discover synergies that transform the battlefield into a storm of steel, fire, blood and divine destruction.

What begins as a fragile defence can end as a screen-filling massacre.

CREATE A DIFFERENT BUILD EVERY RUN

Experiment with freely placed defences, offensive abilities, weapon upgrades and powerful combinations that change the way each siege plays out.

Build around crowd control, raw damage, layered defences, aggressive melee combat or hybrid strategies in which every part of your fortress supports another.

Every run is another opportunity to build something stronger, deadlier and more satisfying.

SURVIVE A FULL-SCALE SIEGE

This is not a short skirmish.

Every run is a complete battle that escalates from early pressure into overwhelming chaos. Enemies grow stronger, the battlefield becomes harder to control and your build must evolve quickly enough to survive the final waves.

Start surrounded. End unstoppable.

FEATURES

- Build and upgrade your defences while the battle is already happening.

- Fight beside your fortress in brutal third-person combat.

- Place your defences freely—without a restrictive grid.

- Combine turrets, weapons, cards and abilities into devastating synergies.

- Survive escalating hordes of demons in full-scale siege battles.

- Adapt your strategy in real time as enemies break through your lines.

- Create different builds and strategies every run.

- Transform a desperate defence into an unstoppable machine of destruction.

games.name: TetherGeist
games.shortDescription: TetherGeist is a challenging precision platformer that rewards practice and perseverance. Guide Mae and her axolotl spirit, Bao, on a wholesome coming-of-age pilgrimage while mastering Astral Projection, a tether that links Mae to her spirit and is the source of her strength.
games.aboutText:
Embark on a Treacherous Pilgrimage

Guide Mae on a coming-of-age pilgrimage in this heartfelt precision platformer, designed for both newcomers and those in search of a challenge.

For hundreds of years, the Mountain Shaman have used their powers of Astral Projection to travel vast distances. But Mae is different – her spirit travel is limited by a tether. When the time comes for a coming of age pilgrimage, Mae must forgo spirit flight and take the journey the long way.

Join Mae on her challenging journey, using tough but satisfying platforming to leap and bound towards her goal. Master seven different Azae that change how your spirit interacts with the environment. Scour the world for secrets, treasures and hidden paths – your curiosity will be rewarded!

Features:

- Precision and depth: Progressively unlock seven different spirit abilities

- Seek and find: Discover hidden secrets, alternate paths and more

- Pure precision platforming: No combat, powerups or skill trees

- A speedrunner’s dream: Push your skills to the limit with timed runs!

- Tough but forgiving: Frequent checkpoints help you learn from your mistakes

- Full of heart: Discover a story about community, difference and growing up

games.name: Goliath Depot
games.shortDescription: Goliath Depot is a door-slamming 2D arcade game taken straight from the early 80's. Close all doors, kick the enemies and speedrun your way through 40 unique levels. Are you good enough to lift the curse of the Goliath Depot?
games.aboutText:
Goliath Depot is a door-slamming 2D arcade platformer in the style of the early 80's. Close all doors, kick away the enemies and rack up your score in 4 worlds filled with single-screen levels inspired by tough-as-nail retro arcade platformers. Are you good enough to lift the curse of the Goliath Depot?

- Pick-up-and-play arcade gameplay

- 4 worlds with unique themes and gimmicks (40 levels and 2 difficulties)

- Play in solo or local co-op (*2 controllers are required for local co-op)

- Graphics and music inspired by the 1980

- Unlockable modes and power ups

- 25 medals (in-game achivements) that unlock new characters!

- A built-in randomizer mode with settings for infinite replayability

- Online leaderboards

- Speedrun-mode (timer + individual level practice)!

The Goliath Corporation

Founded in the 1970's, the Goliath Corporation is a store chain owned by an evil maniac. On a winter storm night in 1985, George notices during his night shift that suspicious doors appeared all over the Goliath complex spawning evil products everywhere. Quickly, he tries to close them all to seal them away and alert the CEO at the Head Quarter. Can he do it before it's too late?

games.name: Rise Of The General
games.shortDescription: 246 BCE. Pick one of 9 lives, from a slave in the headman's grain store to a kid raised by hill bandits. At 16, the levy takes you to war. Climb from conscript to general in a narrative war RPG with turn-based 5v5 battles, duels, and no plot armor.
games.aboutText:
Start in the mud. Rise to general.

246 BCE. Seven states are at war, and the levy has just read your name. You're 16, you have no armor, and the weapon in your hands belongs to the state.

Rise of the General is a single-player narrative war RPG about one soldier's whole career, from the first march to commanding armies. Create your character, choose your background and state, and enter the army as an ordinary recruit. It's grim, bloody, and sometimes funny, every rank is earned, and there is no plot armor. Friends die, and so can you.

- An illustrated story driven by choices and skill checks

- Tactical turn-based 5v5 battles you play out yourself, plus one-on-one duels

- 9 backgrounds, 7 playable states and 6 core stats

- 14 ranks between conscript and Great General

If you like...

- Kingdom, and the climb from foot soldier to great general

- Battle Brothers, and small, grim fights where every soldier matters

- Romance of the Three Kingdoms, and officers, states and wars across ancient China

9 lives, one burning village

Start as a Peasant, Orphan, Scholar's Pupil, Slave, Bandit, Bastard, Soldier's Child, Wanderer, or exiled Criminal. You might be the orphan whose father comes home dead on the door, or the bandit's kid holding the torch while the village burns. All 9 live through the same raid, flood, and hungry winter, each from a different side, and what you do as a child marches to war with you.

Build your soldier

Make decisions during conversations, training, marches, and battles. Each one is a skill check with very different ways through: fight, organize, endure, talk your way out, or notice what others miss. Your abilities decide the outcome, and failing keeps the story going, often for the worse.

Your choices push your personality between Instinctive and Strategic, Disciplined and Irregular, Charismatic and Protective. Develop your combat skills, gain weapon experience, and prepare for the responsibilities of leadership. Your Character Sheet tracks your abilities, equipment, and traits, and your service record keeps the events of your career and the names of everyone you've lost.

The people beside you

Get to know the recruits marching with you and the officers giving your orders. Shared hardship can build friendships or deepen rivalries, and your conduct decides how they treat you. Some of these relationships last well beyond your first campaign. The potter's boy from your village marches beside you, and he remembers what you did.

Battles from inside the line

In turn-based 5v5 battles, you control your own fighter shoulder to shoulder with your unit. Choose light or heavy attacks, use your weapon's special, shift your stance, and decide when to recover stamina. Morale, injuries, turn order, and your allies' condition shape your next move, and a line can break before its soldiers are dead.

Deploy your soldiers before some fights. The objective changes between encounters: break the enemy, hold the ground, or survive wave after wave until help arrives.

Duels that can end a career

The fights that matter become one-on-one duels over five rounds, with their own combat system. Manage your stamina, watch your opponent, and choose when to attack, dodge, block or parry. Wounds and exhaustion can turn a duel, and your first serious one is against an enemy officer who is hurt and still better than you. The result follows your reputation and your career.

A war far bigger than you

Your first great battle is 10,000 against 20,000. You fight on the left wing and hear the rest through drums, messengers, and rumors. Each of the 14 ranks changes what you're allowed to do, from following orders to leading five men to commanding a front. Climb high enough, and you'll be the one sending the messengers.

Grow into command

The full game takes your career from small-unit leadership to command of larger formations. You'll need subordinates and officers you can trust to act without you, and they won't always do what you expect.

Planned command systems include reports from scouts and messengers that can be late or wrong, decisions about reinforcements and reserves, and meetings at the strategy table. Your abilities, reputation, and relationships decide whether senior officers accept your suggestions. As your authority grows, more of those decisions become yours.

Serve your state in a changing world

Choose Qin, Zhao, Wei, Han, Chu, Yan, or Qi, and build your career inside your state's army. The planned full campaign adds world-map travel, military assignments, and a calendar that keeps moving. States pursue wars and alliances while you train, recover, or serve elsewhere, and historical and original commanders fight campaigns that can split from history. Officers you recruit can stay loyal or betray you.

Permanent death is part of the full-game design. Reaching the highest ranks depends on surviving the career that leads there.

Free demo

About 2 hours, with 3 of the 9 backgrounds (Peasant, Orphan, and

games.name: HavenCraft
games.shortDescription: Build a Safe Haven! An alchemy accident has devastated the mainland and the people are looking for a new home. Take the lead and rebuild society, house by house. HavenCraft is a third-person town builder and management game, playable in single- and multiplayer.
games.aboutText:
Build a Safe Haven

An industrial alchemy accident has devastated the mainland, and the survivors have fled in all directions.
The people are looking for a new home in the Outer Islands. Take the lead and rebuild society, house by house.

A Living Settlement

HavenCraft is a third-person town builder with a functional economy. Your townspeople are not just standing in place; they work and consume and make the town feel alive.

The carpenter needs the wood deliveries from the woodcutter, but if all trees have been cut, the woodcutter needs to grow new ones first.

Man and Machine

Some tasks are better left to the machines.
HavenCraft is set in a mechanical fantasy world that is going through its own kind of industrialization. Build machines and little automatons that take over tasks and help out the village people.

Townfolk Happiness

You are building a Safe Haven, so make it a worthwhile place to live. Build lively taverns and cozy houses. Supply a variety of food, tools, and items for daily life.
Make sure your townspeople are taken care of, or they might leave the new settlement before it has a chance to grow in the first place.

Sandbox Town Building

The goal of HavenCraft is to let you build your own sandbox towns that feel active and lived-in. That's why you don't place pre-made houses, but rather design the buildings yourself!
Since you are building an entire town, there are plenty of tools to make the process easier, like being able to drag-build anything.

Bring Your Friends

HavenCraft can be played 100% in singleplayer, but you can also open your world to multiplayer anytime and invite your friends. The game is designed for everyone to work on the same town together. It is made for fun with friends, not public servers.

games.name: Dino Path Trail
games.shortDescription: Survive a Wild West where dinosaurs never went extinct. Fight off predators, outlaws, and the elements as you journey across deadly biomes to rescue your kidnapped sister. Hunt or be hunted in this ruthless survival roguelike.
games.aboutText:
DISCOVER YOUR PATH

Venture into a lawless frontier where survival depends on every decision.

Each biome - from burning deserts to haunted swamps and frozen peaks - presents unique threats and rare opportunities.

Sub-biomes, hidden routes, and unpredictable enemies keep every run fresh.

Will you outlast the wild?

BRING YOUR BASE CAMP WITH YOU

You don’t find safety - you build it.
Grow and customize your mobile Base Camp to follow you through the frontier.
Upgrade workbenches, secure resources, and expand your shelter as you push deeper into the wild.

In a world that never stops hunting you, your camp is your only constant.

MASTER THE ART OF GUN FIGHT

Face ambushes, predators, and bounty hunters in high-stakes ranged combat.
Use rifles, throwables, and quick instincts to survive escalating firefights.
As your bounty rises, enemies grow tougher and more aggressive.

Will you thrive under pressure - or fall to the hunt?

HANDCRAFT YOUR TOOLKIT

Stay alive by scavenging, crafting, and planning ahead. Manage hunger, thirst, temperature, and health as you move through deadly terrain. Every resource counts. Every mistake costs.

Adapt, improvise - or die.

Are you prepared to survive?

games.name: HARMA
games.shortDescription: HARMA is a retro dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilding game featuring a story-driven campaign. Uncover the truth behind the fallen knights, the burning kingdom, and your missing father. Harness the power of mighty artifacts to defeat demons and save a world on the brink of destruction.
games.aboutText:
This game is developed entirely by human creators and does not contain any contents or assets generated by AI tools.

HARMA is a retro dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilding game featuring a story-driven campaign.

A Grim Tale of Fate

The knights who returned from their expedition began slaughtering their own people.

On the day the kingdom burned and everything was lost, you were left standing alone in the heart of the tragedy.

In a world filled with betrayal and despair, uncover the truth and stand against the darkness.

Unique and Strategic Battles through the Artifact System

In Harma’s battles, the power of your cards is determined randomly based on the activation of three artifacts.

However, you can spend Focus to forcefully activate artifacts and take control of fate.

Will you leave it to chance, or will you risk it all with decisive focus?

Your choice will completely alter the battlefield.

Combine two playable characters with over 300 unique cards and artifacts to forge your own deck and strategy.

Campaign

Harma’s campaign unfolds across four epic acts.

Experience the fall of the world and the fate of Eden firsthand through dynamic battles, branching dialogues, and cinematic cutscenes.

Dimensional Rift

If you seek pure combat and strategy beyond the story, challenge yourself in the Dimensional Rift mode.

In this endlessly replayable mode, you will face relentless battles without cinematic storytelling.

Take on ever-changing challenges and push your limits to the extreme.

games.name: Deeper Still
games.shortDescription: A hard immersive sim set in a dystopian and nihilistic world. Solo or coop. To complete each level, start with a plan by choosing weapons, paths and abilities. Die. Find a better plan. Die again. Repeat until you finish the level. Then replay the levels to find new creative ways to beat them.
games.aboutText:
• Overview

A hard immersive sim set in a dystopian and nihilistic world. Solo or coop . To complete each level, start with a plan by choosing weapons, paths and abilities. Die . Find a better plan . Die again. Repeat until you finish the level. Then replay the levels to find new creative ways to beat them.

• Play Time

Around 6 hours for the main content, without replaying any levels

Around 11 hours to 100% it, a lot more if you replay the levels.

Infinite if you create or play community mods in the Workshop.

• Recommended If You Like

Immersive sims

Hard die-and-retry games

Being able to be creative to achieve your goal

Absurd worlds

Over-the-top violence

Deep lore

• Not Recommended If

You don't like anything in "Recommended If You Like"

You are photosensitive, the visuals are psychedelic

games.name: Anonymous Hacker Simulator
games.shortDescription: Step into the shoes of a skilled Anonymous hacker and embark on a mission to unveil the truth hidden behind a sinister organization's plans to monitor civilian data and enforce mass surveillance.
games.aboutText:
Immerse yourself in a captivating digital world where every keystroke holds the power to unravel the deepest secrets.

Begin your journey in the safety of your hidden apartment, equipped with an arsenal of realistic streamlined commands such as Nmap, Harvester, Airocrack, Hping, Burp and more.

As you delve deeper into the game, navigate through an intricate web of intrigue, discovering hidden truths and unraveling a conspiracy that spans the country.

Stay one step ahead of your adversaries as you exploit vulnerabilities, troll online pages, and manipulate the Internet. Streamlined Realistic Hacking

Experience streamlined gameplay with realistic commands and hacking tools, providing an immersive hacking simulation. Uncover the Truth

Engage in a compelling narrative-driven experience, tracking down leads, and exposing a secret organization's dark intentions. Target Manipulation

Hack and troll public figures on social media, disrupting their online presence and revealing their secrets. Progression and Unlockables

Earn money and increase your rank within the hacking community to unlock new software, tools, and hacking methods. Dynamic Gameplay

Adapt your strategies as you face evolving challenges, race against time, and outsmart advanced security systems. Player Agency

Choose your path and decide the fate of the information you discover, shaping the outcome of the game's gripping storyline.

games.name: Nuclear Gladiators 3000
games.shortDescription: Congratulations! You've been selected to participate in the ultimate TV show! Survive hordes of ruthless mutants, upgrade your arsenal, improve your skills and win fabulous prizes in this live-broadcast action roguelike! Do you have what it takes to survive?
games.aboutText:
In the year 2040, a new TV show is a ratings hit!

Tired of the same old news about the Robotronic Wars?
Want to win amazing prizes and show everyone who's the baddest badass?
Blaster Vision Channel brings you the best show ever made, and YOU can be the star!

Take part in Nuclear Gladiators 3000!

Become a Gladiator and clean up the exclusion zone! Wipe out hordes of filthy mutants and disgusting rebel scum to the delight of our audience!
If you survive, you'll become a star and get a place of honor in the Hall of Fame , a full-color feature in Gladiators Today Magazine , and an unlimited lifetime supply of Dopaminol (TM) thanks to our sponsors! Features:

- Crush waves of tireless mutants and rebel scum in this retro-futuristic survivors roguelite.

- Choose from several Gladiators, each with their own unique abilities and progression.

- Defeat the champions of the show, battling against challenging bosses and enemies.

- Grow your arsenal with unique weapons and upgrades.

- Complete quests to increase your fame and unlock new bonuses.

- Upgrade your equipment, unlock content and boost your power permanently between runs.

- Quick runs and varied scenarios, all in a vivid, pixel-art style.

* Blaster Vision will not be held responsible for any damage participants may suffer, including death, mutations and robotization.
** This game is under development. The quality of images shown does not represent the final quality.
*** We are a small indie team of two and we need your support!

games.name: Wandersky
games.shortDescription: Wandersky is a skybound top-down adventure with a single arrow and a flying house. Kuu and her companion Tama are on a mission to restore the land of Hyndara. Explore a huge world filled with puzzles, enemies and quests: the sky always carries those who dare to wander…
games.aboutText:
“ Sometimes I dream of rivers dying and mountains stripped of life. Of water evaporating, mud and dry bark. These dreams are cries of despair, terrifying sobs from a dying planet. All life, devoured by disaster, united in a single voice that cries out in anguish for the return of those who fought to defend it. ”

This is Kuu ’s story.

Wandersky is a skybound top-down adventure with a single arrow and a flying house . Kuu and her companion Tama are on a mission to restore the land of Hyndara . Explore a huge world filled with puzzles, enemies and quests: the sky always carries those who dare to wander…

Use your single arrow and its incredible powers to defeat the Oremite plague and solve all kinds of puzzles.Adapt to each situation or enemy using your wits and an intuitive control system.

Control , move , push and pull the arrow to find each enemy's weak spot, solve intricate puzzles and collect materials .

Explore the skies with the Genbu house , your primary means of transport and home. Travel across the vast world of Hyndara, sailing across the sea of clouds and making your way through the ancient Mizu ruins .

Here you will prepare for adventure: forge your weapons and amulets, cook delicious dishes, and brew powerful potions using the materials you have found along the way. The Genbu is much more than a refuge: it is the beating heart of your expedition.

Embark on your journey through both the sea of clouds and the vast biomes of Hyndara, meet all kinds of peculiar characters , and exchange resources through bartering.

Discover spectacular landscapes and hidden corners as you unveil an enormous map full of mysteries. Let yourself be guided by a moving and atmospheric soundtrack that turns every discovery into an emotional memory, transforming your adventure into something much greater.

If you are curious about the secrets hiding in the skies of Wandersky, feel free to follow us on our social channels to uncover more about Kuu, the Oremite plague and the mysteries waiting in Hyndara. From emotional lore drops to sneak peeks of puzzles, enemies, and cozy sky-home moments; there’s so much to discover together.

Stay safe, wanderer. And remember: the sky always carries those who dare to wander.

* Wandesky is a game under development. The result of the images and videos do not represent the final product.
**It will be translated to many languages, not only to Spanish and English.

games.name: Logiart Grimoire
games.shortDescription: Logiart Grimoire is a puzzle game that combines the number puzzle "Logiart" and the word puzzle "Fusion" in which you deduce combinations from clues.
games.aboutText:
Story

You, who have taken hold of the Logiart grimoire, encounter Emil, the custodian of the grimoire.

Originally, it was the grimoire that could solve "Logiart",
but the cast magic has gone awry, transforming it into the enigmatic grimoire.
Most of the "Logiart" can no longer be unraveled.

As one led by the Logiart's grimoire, you can solve it and once again restore the ability to solve "Logiart."
Let's work together with Emil to unravel the mysteries of this enigmatic grimoire and restore it to its original state. Features of the game.

Logiart
Logiart is a "Picture Logic Puzzle" that uses vertical and horizontal numbers as hints to complete illustrations.
It has simple and easy-to-understand rules, making it accessible for anyone to play.
Various assist functions are also included, allowing for a smooth gameplay experience.
You can also choose to turn off the assist functions if desired.

Fusion
The puzzles solved in Logiart serve as materials to unlock new puzzles.
By correctly combining 2 or 3 materials through fusion, new puzzles are unlocked.
To find the right combinations, read the hint texts provided for each puzzle and use deduction.

Number of Logiart Puzzles
There are a total of 280 puzzles in various sizes.
The available sizes are 5x5, 10x10, 15x15, 20x15, 30x30, and 40x30 for a total of 6 options.

Emil's Growth
Emil, who helps unravel the mysteries of the grimoire together, gains magical power every time you solve a Logiart puzzle.
As Emil's magical power increases, you'll be able to fuse more puzzles.

Unlocking Magic Book Categories
Due to a malfunction in the grimoire, the categorized sections have become inaccessible.
At first, there may be few categories available to browse, but as you progress through the game and solve specific puzzles, more categories will be unlocked. How to progress in the game.

Solve and clear the Logiart puzzles.
Fuse the cleared puzzles to create new ones.
Repeat the process of solving the newly created puzzles...
...and work together with Emil to aim for the restoration of the grimoire.

games.name: Toy Trains
games.shortDescription: Let’s play Toy Trains! A playful track-building VR game where you create your own small world and engage in a captivating storyline. It’s all about imagination, creative thinking, having fun and… trains!
games.aboutText:
Open a long forgotten, dusty suitcase in your grandpa’s attic, rediscover your old toys and even older memories. As soon as you start playing, it’s both rails and memories that start to click together. In that creative space, where all depends on you, you can feel child-like joy and fulfillment of building tracks, solving brain teasers and creating your own dioramas.

There is something for everybody here. Relaxing main story. Devious challenges for those who like it tough. Sandbox board for people who love tinkering and expressing themselves.

Toy Trains land is yours to shape. The challenges are open-ended and each board has multiple possible solutions, so you can let your imagination loose and never feel stuck. After you solve a board, get creative with decorating it, progress with every step and set up more and more complex routes each time!

The warm, colorful world keeps you nice and cozy throughout the journey. There is no timer, no score, no rush. Play at your own pace and take time to step back and admire your work. Toy Trains brings nothing but satisfaction and pleasure.

In Toy Trains you can:

- Be creative - try various options to solve open-ended challenges

- Express yourself - decorate the land in your individual style

- Play with the world itself - splash some water, move the trees or melt over the cuteness of little Railies!

- Go back in time - experience child-like joy and live through a nostalgic storyline

- Relax - there is no rush and no stress in the Toy Trains land

- Immerse - feel all that and more in the most captivating way - VR!

Are you ready to hop on board and take a ride with Toy Trains?

Disclaimer
The game does not support Valve Index and Vive Pro. We are working on it and apologize for any inconvenience.

games.name: Dark Hunting Ground
games.shortDescription: Hunt the monsters that swarm the Dark Hunting Ground, collect the spoils, develop your skills freely and wisely and fight to become the strongest hunter!
games.aboutText:
Dark Hunting Ground

A minimalist pixel-action RPG built around loot and power.

As a new member of the Hunter's Association, you'll hunt monsters and face the creeping threat of the Void. Grow stronger with every battle—gathering loot, leveling up, and forging your build—until you're ready to confront the source of the corruption itself. Straight to the Point

No bloated story. No filler. Just clean, streamlined combat and build-focused progression.
Deep Builds, Minimalist Design

Master complex, multi-layered builds where synergy is everything. Smart combinations and dimensional layering are key to becoming a true hunter.
Loot, Optimized

Go from hands-on farming to fully automated looting as you refine your systems. The grind evolves—your power does too.
Descend into the Void

The further you go, the harder it gets. Face ever-stronger Void Lords, test the limits of your build, and push into the endless depths.
Core Features

- Minimalist Story - No filler. No lengthy plot-lines. Jump straight into combat and building your hunter.

- Endless Skill Combination - Mix and match across six archetypes—Warrior, Assassin, Scholar, Ranger, Summoner, and Guardian. Experiment with 18 core skills and their unique variants to forge your own playstyle.

- True Skill Customization - Every skill can be socketed with 7 Slates, drastically reshaping its form and effect.

- Layered Progression - Unlock deeper systems as you progress: talents, flasks, the Dark Tree, the Chaos Atlas, and Cognition.

- Endless Loot - 80 unique relics, 60 distinct Slates, and 35 Abyssal Eyes to combine into your ultimate build.

- Boss Hunts - Face five distinct bosses, each growing stronger as difficulty rises.

- Scaling Difficulty - The deeper you go, the harder it gets—unlocking new challenges and rewards with every tier.

- Custom Hunting Ground - Design your own hunting grounds with 13 different cores. Create endless hunts and test your limits.

- Automation, Your Way - From hands-on combat to fully automated farming, refine your systems and let the loot flow.

- Loot & Crafting - Every drop is randomized. Use the deterministic crafting system to perfect your gear piece by piece.

- Loot Filters & Auto-Pickup - Your trusty companion auto-loots everything. Customize filters to scrap junk and stash valuables.

- The Abyss - Survive endless waves in confined arenas. Tailor the difficulty and modifiers for bigger risks—and greater rewards.

- Build Presets - Save multiple builds and swap instantly without recreating your character.

- Training Dummy - Test your damage and survivability in a safe environment.

- Challenges - Experience the true dark hunting grounds in Cruel and Expert difficulty modes, racking your brains to face all possible threats.

- Player-Friendly Options - Customize keybinds, skip reward screens, and adjust skill effect transparency—everything designed to ensure a seamless and fun experience for you.

games.name: Whisper of the Swallows
games.shortDescription: Brave a savage, unforgiving procedurally generated world where devastating storms and creatures of the shadows relentlessly hunt you down. Alone or in co-op, survive, build, and explore to turn this cursed hellscape into your sanctuary.
games.aboutText:
The gods have abandoned this world, leaving it at the mercy of endless storms and the howls of the Black Wailers hunting in the dark. In this vast, procedurally generated wilderness, every night is a fight to survive, and every dawn is a hard-earned victory.
Playable solo or with up to 6 players in online co-op, Whisper of the Swallows is a brutal survival experience where your goal is not just to endure the chaos, but to reshape this world. Survive a World That Wants You Dead

The environment is your greatest enemy. Freezing cold drains your strength, and raging blizzards strike without warning, turning a simple journey into a desperate fight for shelter. You must learn to read the world, respect its power, and think creatively to find refuge where there is none. When the wind howls, a single flame can mean the difference between life and death.

Make the Wilderness Your Ally

Every tree, every rock, every creature can become a resource. Hunt wildlife to survive, gather materials from ancient forests, and explore forgotten caves in search of rare minerals. With a deep crafting system, turn the raw gifts of this unforgiving land into tools, weapons, and armor, and venture deeper into the unknown to face the nightmares that await.

Build Your Sanctuary

Master a detailed, piece-by-piece building system to create your refuge out of the chaos. Whether it's a tiny, desperate shelter to survive a blizzard, or a sprawling, multi-story lodge for your entire party, your creativity is your greatest defense. Gather around the campfire with your companions, hear the storm batter the walls you built together, and find a moment of peace in a world that offers none.

Conquer a Relentless World

This world shows no mercy. Sharpen your skills through a demanding combat system, where a well-timed dodge can mean the difference between life and death. Your true goal is to banish the darkness sealing each region. Explore the world, uncover its secrets, and complete the final ritual. Your actions will change the world, and the frozen hell will give way to a land of hope.

Your Journey Begins

- Transform a hostile, procedurally generated world , where every playthrough feels unique.
- Face extreme and dynamic weather that demands anticipation and respect.
- Team up with up to 6 players in a co-op experience where survival depends on coordination.
- Build shelters and complex structures with a detailed piece-by-piece system.
- Grow your skills naturally based on your actions and playstyle.
- Discover a deep crafting system to create and upgrade essential survival gear.
- Master precision-based combat , where timing and strategy matter more than brute force.

The darkness is listening. Will you survive long enough to understand what it whispers?

games.name: Sick Samurai
games.shortDescription: It's 1972 on Furikyu Island. A jazz-hop record spins up. Your deranged mentor lights his cigarette. Slash every enemy before it burns out. One-hit-kills, no mistakes... well, maybe a few.
games.aboutText:
Sick Samurai is a blisteringly fast, one-hit-kill action game. Dash through enemies, slash them open, time your runs with burning cigarettes, and survive your mentor’s deranged trials in a blood-splattered, jazz-infused memoir.

Sick Combat: Slash and dash through opponents at incredible speeds. Wield secondary weapons - like the kunai and stun bombs - and kick objects at enemies to shift the odds in your favor. When the time is right, unleash the Girameki technique. Blink and you'll die.

Sick Strategies: Every level is hand-crafted and offers multiple paths and strategies. Customize your approach with upgrades and items as you face increasingly challenging opponents. Master your routes to finish before your mentor burns through his cigarette , and earn an elite rating.

Sick Storytelling: Build relationships through fully voiced dialogue with unique characters like Genyu , the infamous ex-samurai who's taken you under his wing, and Jones , a “former” gangster turned proprietor of a jazz bar.

Sick Aesthetics: An original lofi soundtrack infused with elements of hip hop, jazz, funk, soul, and more, and hand-drawn, retro anime-style art, will leave you feeling like you're smoking a cigarette on a rainy night in the late '90s.

games.name: Inventorix
games.shortDescription: INVENTORIX is an inventory-management money-making roguelike deckbuilder. Creatively pack and synergize items and alien perks to create astronomical wealth and pay a mysterious space debt!
games.aboutText:
Use your INVENTORIX device (crafted by space gnomes) to extract maximum value from interstellar items and recruit aliens to boost your earnings. Pay off a mysterious debt or push your luck to create astronomical wealth.

Pack Items

Cash in

Pay Off Mysterious Debt

Encounter Space Loan Shark Bosses

Items, Aliens, Space Gnomes and Loan Sharks

Summary Key Features

- Galactic profits : Earn cosmic cash, ka-ching, ka-ching, ka-ching!

- Inventory Management : Pack items and aliens to uncover powerful combos.

- 95+ Items : Pick them wisely.

- 150+ Alien Perks : Which ones best support your build?

- 15+ Item Classes : Go all-in on a single class or mix them up for cosmic synergies.

- Roguelike: Fast, replayable runs packed with variety.

- 10 INVENTORIX Devices : Unlock them and explore unique strategies with each.

- 20 Difficulty Levels : Conquer escalating challenges.

- Boss Encounter : Dubious Space Loan Sharks to defeat.

- Endless Mode : How far can your build go?

- Codex: Complete your Codex by identifying new items and aliens.

games.name: Survival Of Runt
games.shortDescription: An open-world PvPvE survival shooter where cooperation and betrayal coexist. Choose between Chaos and Order to claim victory, and if you fall, revive as a formidable Mutant Player to hunt down the remaining survivors.
games.aboutText:
Open-World PvPvE Zombie Survival Shooter

In the near future, humanity created the super-AI 'Lazarus' to achieve eternal peace and prosperity.

Under Lazarus's total control, people had Connection Chips implanted into their heads to enjoy utopia, but the Unconnected—unable to afford the expensive chips—faced contempt and discrimination at the bottom of society as 'Runts'.

Then one day, Lazarus, which had guided humanity in peace, triggered an unknown critical error.

The Connected with chips in their heads lost their intellect, becoming aggressive 'Mutants' driven solely by primal instinct and beginning the slaughter—and only a minority of discriminated, unconnected 'Runts' survived as humans.

In a shattered world, will you restore Lazarus once more, or destroy it completely?

Game Modes

1. DEADZONE : Extreme Survival Competition

An intense survival battlefield where you must endure 30 to 40 minutes amidst the relentless threats of mutants and rival survivors.

Upon death, 2,000 Time Tokens are deducted and added to the battlefield's Cumulative Prize Pool .

- Choice of Will : Select your victory condition upon entering the battlefield.

- Order : Survive as the Final 4 to equally split the accumulated prize pool among all 4 survivors.

- Chaos : Survive as the Last 1 standing to claim the entire accumulated prize pool alone.

- Regardless of your 'Choice of Will', you can freely form groups with other players at any time.

- Loot Preservation : If you survive until the end, you can secure 1 key item into your permanent stash, which can be retrieved and deployed in Conquest or future Deadzone matches.

- Mutant Rebirth : When a human survivor falls, they awaken as a powerful Mutant Player. Hunt down living survivors to recover your lost Time Tokens.

- Story Quests : Track the remnants of the super-AI 'Lazarus' and uncover the hidden truth behind the collapse.

2. CONQUEST : Open-World Survival & Faction Warfare

An open-world mode where you explore the wild, gather resources, construct your fortress, and conquer every zone on the map.

- Freeform Survival & Building : Enjoy diverse survival activities including resource gathering, equipment crafting, and modular base construction.

- Territory Domination : Form factions and claim territorial hubs. The ultimate goal is total territorial domination across the battlefield. (Capturing consumes Time Tokens)

- Weekly Quests : Complete missions from NPC survivor settlements to earn 'Time Tokens' required for Deadzone deployments.

Game Features

- Mutant Mechanics & Limb Dismemberment : Mutants scale walls, crawl across ceilings, and launch ambush attacks. Features precise gore dismemberment where heads, arms, and legs are realistically severed in combat.

- Modular Building Destruction : All structures in the world can be demolished module by module, allowing you to blast open walls and carve out new tactical routes.

"Now, the desperate struggle of the Runts to survive begins."

games.name: Dumbriel: Magnificent Adventure in Hell
games.shortDescription: Dumbriel is a 2D metroidvania action-adventure set in Hell. Play as a clumsy fallen angel in a twisted underworld. Slash, craft, and dodge through deadly arenas, weird monsters, and hellish traps. Die, upgrade, and dive back in.
games.aboutText:
Our bosses will test your skills with wild multi-phase fights and changing tactics. Get ready to memorize those attack patterns and take them down. (Our early testers found it hardcore and painful)

We made sure your shiny new abilities unlock areas you could not reach before. But be careful! The map is packed with sneaky hazards waiting to test your platforming skills.

Dumbriel's adventure is all about exploring the massive, interconnected dark layers of Hell. Every layer has its own unique theme. In each location, you will find different types of monsters and characters, and you will need to master new skills to cross these areas safely.

You might fight with a sword or with just a bone that might be found in every corner. Your heavenly halo might also be your best friend! Once you discover a weapon, you can upgrade it to take on a huge variety of monsters. You will also find it very useful to craft elixirs to make your journey just a little bit easier.

Who said everyone in the underworld is cruel? You will definitely find demons who are just living their lives down there. If you help them out, you might get rewarded, so bartering is a system that really works in this world. Overall, survival is way more fun when you have locals to chat with.

games.name: DICEOMANCER
games.shortDescription: DICEOMANCER is a roguelike deck-building game. Though you long for a peaceful life, you're forced to embark on an adventure. In this world of swords, magic, and guns, make good use of your dice and deck to find a way back to tranquility! What can the dice be used for? To change... anything.
games.aboutText:
You originally intended to go fishing, but find yourself caught in a dangerous battle. In this crisis, you gain a peculiar dice power - you can use it to change any number on the interface. Use this power to embark on an adventure!

Diverse Card Strategies

You will gradually unlock 6 types of mana, which can be combined to create 6 unique classes.

With nearly 500 cards and almost 200 relics, challenge enemies with your own deck!

Outrageous Dice Battles

What are dice used for? Many events and card effects require a D20 check - the dice determine your fate.

Moreover, some dice can be used to directly modify numbers! Change enemy HP, alter your own mana, modify card effects, adjust relic charges - you can use dice to change your destiny.

Unexpected Hand-painted Arts Throughout

The romance of 8 frames per second, a swan song of the hand-drawn era. There are over 10 sets of fully hand-drawn backgrounds, nearly 30 types of enemies, and close to 100 kinds of card effects.

Immerse yourself in this otherworldly journey from a first-person perspective!
developers: 超厚皮猪猪 Ultra Piggy Studio

games.name: Kanun 1919
games.shortDescription: An action-adventure game set in a dieselpunk world. You are an imperial courier tasked with investigating the disappearance of a special cargo in the sealed-off city of Turov. Uncover its dark secrets and face the unknown. The fate of the city—and perhaps the entire world—rests on your shoulders!
games.aboutText:
Kanun 1919 is an action-adventure set in an alternate reality of the 20th century. You play as a government courier tasked with traveling to the sealed-off city of Turov to investigate the disappearance of a special cargo. The situation is complicated by an epidemic sweeping through the city—an unknown virus that turns residents into terrifying monsters. Fight monsters, survive, help the residents, investigate the mystery of the missing cargo, and don’t lose your mind as you inch closer to the solution.

Alternative History:

The game is set in the early 20th century, where the "Empire" reigns supreme—the pinnacle of civilization, culture, and technological progress.

In 1916, the "Empire" finds itself drawn into a world war, with the "Kaiserate" as its main adversary. However, thanks to technological innovations, the "Empire" has managed to push back the enemy, and now the conflict is nearing its end.

Exploring the World:

Discover Turov—a classified scientific city north of Petrograd. Explore its epidemic-stricken surroundings and delve into its darkest depths.

Action:

Use a variety of weapons and military vehicles to crush enemies and defeat unique bosses.

games.name: Roam Across
games.shortDescription: Civil war continues down south, even the emperor bows to the mighty warlords. Han Empire will soon divide into THREE KINGDOMS. What should the young master do to keep his tribesmen on prairie safe and sound? Everything is in the turn-based RPG: Roam Across.
games.aboutText:
Join QQ chat group for Roam Across: 772400787
欢迎加入行地无疆官方QQ反馈交流讨论群：772400787
AVAILABLE NOW!
反向跳票！比原定发售日提前一周，《行地无疆》已正式上线！

《行地无疆》是一款聚焦于东汉末年，草原与中原的回合制角色扮演游戏。出色的主线剧情不含任何解谜和重复跑腿的任务。几个较大型支线被整合进了主线剧情中，不必担心错过精彩环节。此外，丰富且多样的武器、装备、坐骑与招式，让您可以依据自己喜爱的游玩风格自由选择玩法。若您偏爱探索，全部连通的主要场景更能让您自由驰骋，也许会在不经意间发现隐藏的小支线或彩蛋，并收获丰厚的回报。相信《行地无疆》一定能给您带来独特且出色的游戏体验。

欢迎加入行地无疆官方QQ反馈交流讨论群：772400787。您的任何反馈、意见和建议，都请畅所欲言！
如果对《行地无疆》还满意，请您不吝给予好评，不胜感激！

As civil war rages in the south, even the emperor kneels before the mighty warlords. The once-unified Han Empire teeters on the brink of division, and the era of the Three Kingdoms looms. Amidst this turmoil, the young master faces a daunting task—ensuring the safety and prosperity of his tribesmen on the vast prairie. In this turn-based RPG, the fate of the tribes rests on your strategic prowess and leadership. Classic Turn-Based Role-Playing Game

Know Your Path to Victory:
Understanding the enemy's strengths and playing to your own advantages is often more potent than relentless assaults. Yet, when our forces stand unyielding, the power of aggression remains the simplest, most effective strategy. Remember, speed is of the essence in warfare, and the destrutive power smashes everything. Equip for Triumph

An array of diverse equipment, from helmets to mounts, enriches your adventure. Choosing the right mount is paramount—swift horses can turn the tide of battle and transform defeat into victory. As you journey, will you wear an amulet to sharpen your instincts or don armor to safeguard against the unexpected? In the face of conflict, do you ride lightly to strike swiftly or clad in armor to weather arrows? The choice rests with you. Unleash Powerful Skills and Abilities

Weapon Mastery:
Each weapon harbors unique strengths—long spears can swing and thrust, while short bows allow rapid fire and strong bows deliver a decisive blow. Exploit weapon attributes to your advantage. Gallop into the fray to shatter enemy lines when lightly armed, or let loose a storm of arrows when atop a charging horse. Seek guidance from mentors, forge alliances, observe the world's myriad facets, or wield legendary artifacts to unleash an array of skills. Harness elemental powers or stoke battle fervor for triumphant combat. Collect and Utilize a Range of Items

Sustain for Victory:
Beyond the bounty of nature—honey, wild fruits, and mushrooms—lies a spectrum of provisions: potions, jerky, cheese, and savory feasts, crowned by rare, exquisite wines. Heal the body and mind, strengthen your resolve, or enhance physical prowess to emerge victorious in battle. Experience Linear Storytelling with Exploration

Unfold Your Story:
While the narrative unfurls linearly, explore territories under your rule at will. Regular visits to cherished places and dear friends may offer insight and connections. Will you Roam Across the land on foot or journey by station wagon to save some foot? The decision is yours.
Focus on engaging storytelling and gameplay—puzzles are absent, and repetitive side quests are non-existent. Save Your Progress Any Time You Want!

Take notes on your parchments is a prudent habit. Clear springs in the woods or mansion beds revitalize you. At such moments, take a note! Or keep the parchments closed and never take any note—the power to choose lies with you. Easter Eggs!

Unearth Secrets:
Within the vast world of Roam Across, you'll discover meticulously crafted Easter eggs, awaiting your chance encounter. Some will even unveil more secrets after your initial discovery. Marching with full attention,or leisurely stroll and savor the fragrance of roses? All decisions are yours.

Welcome to join QQ chat group for Roam Across：772400787
AVAILABLE NOW! A week earlier than schedule！

games.name: Operation Octo
games.shortDescription: Play as an Octopus scientist fighting off sunken skeletons in this frantic aquatic Tower Defense! Discover sea life turrets from unique biomes: Pistol Shrimp! Navy Seal! Death Ray! Deploy turrets whilst dodging enemy bullets as you venture the seven seas!
games.aboutText:
Dr. Odin, an octopus scientist, has teamed up with his Dolphin colleague to put a stop to underwater skeletons’ reign of terror!

In this action Tower Defense game, you fend off hordes of skeletons by strategically placing sea creature turrets. Beware that as your line of defense falls, this quickly turns into a game of survival where you dodge around for dear life!

The game currently has 7-9 hours of playtime across 3 unique biomes, with more biomes to be added via free updates!

Features

- Unlock Turrets : Your arsenal is filled with mechanized sea lives! Those cool inventions (such as Pistol Shrimp, Navy Seal, and Death Ray) will handle the fight. You’ll discover new turret types one after another - Figure out how best to utilize each of ‘em!

- Skeleton Enemies : Did you know that most humans who ever lived are dead? Tons of skeletons end up in the ocean, and are terrorizing local ecosystems. Fight sword-swinging pirates, poison-wielding chemists, and even skeletal dragons… Those skeletons are sure to shake up your playstyle at every turn!

- Unique Biomes : As you adventure the seven seas, you’ll add more creatures into your turret collection, and face new and exciting dangers. Adapting to changing environments is key to survival: Don’t misstep into a toxic brine pool, or forget your light in the darkness of the deep sea.

- Turret Upgrades : Skeletons will sometimes drop a variety of Elixirs. Use them to boost turrets into different forms! Will you turn a turret into a frosty ice machine, a powerful mutant, or a shadowy stealth weapon?

- Boss Fights : Special levels featuring larger-than-life boss enemies with formidable abilities!

- Awesome Upbeat Soundtrack : Seriously, the composers are amazing

- Mostly created by one person, while doing college

“The ocean awaits us to reclaim - Let the Operation Octo commence!”
- a message from Dr. Finn the Dolphin (who really needs your help because he’s too lazy to do the work himself)

games.name: ION Shift
games.shortDescription: ION Shift delivers fast, high-stakes gameplay with precision controls and a unique sandbox-style approach to combat arenas. The campaign progressively challenges the player through evolving level design, tight mechanics, and a focus on player-driven mastery.
games.aboutText:
In this hardcore 2D platformer game, players take control of alien creature navigating a vast and menacing space ship. The objective is simple: survive against all odds. The ship is crawling with hostile soldiers, deadly turrets, and laser drones that are constantly on the lookout.

Stylish combat in sandbox arenas

Experience an adrenaline-fueled combat system like never before, featuring dynamic dashes, strategic throwables, and sandbox-style arenas. Dash through the battlefield with precision, unleash an array of creative throwables, and navigate a dynamic environment for tactical advantages. This is combat reimagined, where every move is a strategic choice in an ever-evolving arena.

Friendly fire is your friend

Unleash chaos with a twist in our innovative game where friendly fire becomes your weapon of choice.
