Navigate a world where strategic mayhem reigns, as precision and skill are required to wield the power of friendly fire against your enemies. Turn alliances into explosive opportunities and master the art of calculated risk. Are you prepared to redefine the battlefield with the unexpected?"

games.name: Arcane Arena
games.shortDescription: Arcane Arena is a fast-paced multiplayer action game where spellcasters clash in team-based combat. Choose your class, master powerful abilities, and dominate the arena. Manipulate time, summon creatures, wield the elements, and combine magic with your team to claim victory.
games.aboutText:
WIELD THE ARCANE. MASTER THE ARENA.

Arcane Arena is a multiplayer action game where powerful spellcasters clash in fast-paced, team-based magical combat. Choose your school, master their abilities, comebine subclasses, coordinate with your team, and unleash devastating combinations of magic to control the arena.

Every school of magic brings a different approach to combat, giving you and your team new ways to attack, defend, support allies, and turn the tide of battle.

CHOOSE YOUR SCHOOL

Master a gowing list of schools, each with their own abilities, strengths, and playstyle.

NECROMANCER

Command the dead and overwhelm your enemies with summoned minions.

CHRONOMANCER

Manipulate time and disrupt the flow of battle.

ALCHEMIST

Use potions and volatile concoctions to support allies and punish enemies.

ELEMENTALIST

Harness destructive elemental magic to burn, freeze, and shock the battlefield.

Learning your own abilities is only the beginning. Understanding how different spellcasters work together can be the difference between victory and defeat.

FIGHT AS A TEAM

Arcane Arena is built around teamwork, positioning, ability combinations, and objective-based combat.

Coordinate attacks with your teammates, combine magical abilities, protect key positions, and adapt your strategy as battles unfold.

A well-timed combination of spells can completely change the outcome of a fight.

MASTER YOUR MAGIC

Improve your skills with your favorite school as you learn their strengths, weaknesses, abilities, and combinations.

Arcane Arena is designed to reward both individual skill and coordinated team play. Whether you're leading an attack, controlling the battlefield, supporting your allies, or disrupting the enemy team, every school has a role to play.

BUILT WITH THE COMMUNITY

Arcane Arena is being developed in Early Access, and the arena will continue evolving alongside its players.

We plan to expand the game with additional content, maps, spellcasters, abilities, gameplay systems, visual improvements, balance changes, and other features throughout development.

Player feedback will be an important part of that process as we work toward the full version of Arcane Arena.

CHOOSE YOUR MAGIC. JOIN YOUR TEAM. ENTER THE ARCANE ARENA.

games.name: Gunboat God
games.shortDescription: Become the all-powerful Gunboat God in this fluid shoot 'em up. Carve the waves as you stylishly fight hordes of monsters in hundreds of quick-fire missions. Transform your Gunboat and upgrade your weapons, skills and abilities to take on giant, challenging, multi-stage bosses!
games.aboutText:
Gunboat Goddamn! Get ready to shoot quickly, dodge even faster, and get to blasting in a chaotic 2D side-scrolling shoot ‘em up featuring guns, a whole boatload of freakin’ enemies, and rad tricks. It’s up to you to get the hull out of this unknown place to get back to the Citadel in the sky. Here’s to hoping you’ve got a plan to go with that Gunboat!

Master 100’s of frantic ‘just one more go’ missions as you hone your skills to become the all-powerful Gunboat God. Return with new weapons, abilities, and quick fingers to push your high score ever higher.

What would a Gunboat be without… GUNS! Good job you’re surrounded by water because you’ve got a hell of a lot of FIREPOWER!

Cannons, lasers, bombs and… [checks notes] THE VAPORISER?! Expand and upgrade your artillery in multiple ways including unique super moves, bigger explosions, and harder-hitting shots.

What the hell is that?! Looks like the depths of the ocean contain great evils, thankfully you’ve got greater artillery.

Take on challenging bosses in multi-phase battles that put your surfing, shooting, and smashing skills to the ultimate test. It’ll take quick control and mastery of your gunboat to put those… things, back where they belong, leagues beneath the surface!

What’s better than shooting stuff? Looking cool while you do it! Dash, crash, and bash enemies who get in your way.

Transform your gunboat on the fly to plunge to new depths and soar to new heights. With mines below the surface and acid rain above, it's up to you to take control of the damn situation, now ain’t the time to buckle under pressure!

It’s dangerous to go alone, thankfully you’ve got Yeti, the best crocodile mechanic and all-round good guy you could ask for!

Aid him on his journey to crank up your Gunboat to the max and you can bet he’ll do his darndest to get you back home.

- 200+ levels of rootin’ & tootin’ fast & fluid shooting

- 20+ mission types including Collision Course, Outlast and errr.. Boil?

- 70 enemy types gunning for your hull

- 8 different guns to master with their own level-ups

- 10+ abilities, augments, and powers for your ride

- 2 player local co-op!

- 1 talking crocodile!

games.name: Archi Vista
games.shortDescription: Dig, wash, and uncover the lost artifacts in Archi Vista, a relaxing first-person excavation game. Break through layers of earth, clean forgotten ruins, find hidden treasures, and restore extraordinary places one satisfying discovery at a time.
games.aboutText:
Archi Vista is a relaxing first-person restoration and discovery game about uncovering the past one layer at a time.

Step into forgotten places buried beneath years of dirt, rock and mud. Armed with specialized drills and high-pressure water tools, carefully excavate the environment, clean what you uncover, and reveal artifacts hidden beneath the surface.

Every location is a small mystery. Strange shapes beneath the soil might be worthless debris—or the remains of something extraordinary. Dig carefully, wash away the dirt, recover artifacts, and gradually transform neglected spaces into places worth exploring again.

Upgrade your equipment, experiment with different drill heads and water nozzles, and learn which tools work best for each type of material. Some discoveries are easy to reach. Others require you to think about how you excavate without damaging or burying what you're trying to uncover.

There are no monsters chasing you and no clock ticking down. Just you, your tools, and the satisfaction of turning a completely buried mess into something beautiful.

Dig. Clean. Discover. Restore.

games.name: The Rabbit Haul
games.shortDescription: Nurture your farm by day and defend your haul of crops from the thieving Trash Panda Posse at night. This farming and tower defense roguelite challenges you to grow powerful and symbiotic defenses to battle tough critters and rebuild your hometown one haul at a time!
games.aboutText:
Play as Sprout, a determined rabbit trying to rebuild their hometown after it has been torn apart by the mischievous Trash Panda Posse.

By day, Sprout farms with purpose. You grow crops, build defensive plant towers, and shape your garden into something that can stand strong when night falls. Smart plant synergies and well-placed defenses will be the difference between keeping your haul safe… or watching it disappear!

Take your time. Plan carefully. The night is just around the corner.

Before you know it, it’s dark out, and the Trash Panda Posse comes in waves.

Raccoons swarm Sprout’s farm, each with their own set of tricks and behaviors, all trying to steal away your hard-earned crops! As the days go on, waves grow tougher, enemies get smarter, and your garden will need all the help it can get. Upgrade your towers, explore for stronger weapons, and fight hard to make it through until morning.

Every night tests the care and thought you put into your garden during the day. So act, and choose wisely.

Each run pushes Sprout a little further.

The garden evolves and grows with every passing day - every run is an opportunity to try a new strategy. allowing you to explore, find treasure, quests, upgrades, weapons, and unexpected helpers or hindrances. When your run ends, all is not lost. You rebuild, unlock new options, and head back out better prepared for the next attempt.

Failure is not the end. It’s part of the plan. Starting over doesn’t mean starting from scratch.

Rebuild enough of the town and Sprout's map opens up.

There's the Tundra where the spots you plant matters as much as what. Knock a tundra raccoon down and it splits in two, and the Ice Prince freezes your towers solid before you ever see him coming.

On the Coast, the whole farm is one small island. Pirate crews shell your garden from range, and Cross Eyed Pete turns the beach into cannon fire. Three places. Three sets of problems. One very determined rabbit.

With a wide variety of crops, defensive towers, weapons, and upgrade paths, The Rabbit Haul encourages creativity.

Help Sprout build a farm that overwhelms enemies with raw plant power, or one that relies on clever synergies, or something entirely your own! There is no single right way to survive. Just different ways to grow your garden, learn new techniques, and better prepare for when the sun sets. What are you waiting for? It’s time to dig in!

Unlock outfits as you rebuild the town and progress through runs.

Try out a variety of looks, from cozy farmer to dripping in style, customize Sprout to reflect your mood! Match your weapon to lean into the vibe of your run! The more you play and explore, the more you unlock.

Because looking good while defending your haul ~ matters~ .

games.name: Reverb
games.shortDescription: Reverb is a multiplayer PVPVE extraction stealth shooter with a first-person perspective, set in a fictional Biopunk universe where there is a constant struggle for evolution.
games.aboutText:
Reverb is a multiplayer stealth tactical first-person shooter set in a fictional Biopunk universe, where there's a constant struggle for species evolution. Take on the role of a creature at the top of the food chain and evolve into a perfected organism for eliminating competitors. Players will have the opportunity to upgrade equipment, characters, and their own shelter by collecting the main currency - DNA elements. Destroy hostile creatures, harvest resources from their organs and parts, and improve your shelter and yourself.

Invisible to some, visible to others

While on the prowl, you'll never be sure if there's no one around you. The main feature of the game is the reverb effect, making players invisible. All players participating in the match are invisible until they take damage. Any damage received or noise made will highlight the player or part of their body, making them a visible target for other players. But don't forget, the creatures inhabiting the Reverb world not only see you in this state but also hear you!

Living Weapons

Weapons in the game are alive - literally. Each weapon is a living organism that adapts to its owner. If you wield a weapon that belonged to another player, it may not obediently obey you. The more you play with a specific weapon, the more it submits to you and unlocks new ways of use. Improve weapon parameters by literally growing additional attachments on it, such as an optical sight, new muscles for more accurate shooting, and so on. If the weapon is fully obedient to you, leave it anywhere and shoot from it by connecting to it through neural link.

Walk? Crawl? Or Fly?

Choose your gameplay by following one of your character's evolutionary paths. Speed or armor? Stealth or the ability to fly? The choice is yours and depends on your playstyle.

Shelter

By collecting valuable resource - RNA, upgrade your shelter. Build corridors using Cell blocks. Construct special chambers that allow you to upgrade your weapons and characters. Take care of them, repair them for more effective enemy destruction. Hang the corpses of defeated enemies as trophies, invite friends to your shelter, share resources, and boast your achievements with other players.

A World Where Enemies Evolve

Enemies inhabiting the Reverb world are in a constant state of evolution. Weak creatures become food for stronger ones, which, by consuming everything around, mutate into stronger representatives of the species. By killing creatures around you, players leave their bodies as food for other creatures, thereby influencing the development of stronger creatures. The more players play in one world, the stronger the creatures inhabiting it become.

games.name: The Chef's Shift: First Course
games.shortDescription: A fast-paced typing game in a restaurant setting, where you’ll both cook & serve food to hungry customers, all done by TYPING. Play through the Italian restaurant and get a taste of The Chef's Shift!
games.aboutText:
Get ready to cook up a storm in "The Chef's Shift: First Course" - a fast-paced typing game set in a bustling restaurant! With your keyboard as your weapon, you'll need to cook and serve delicious dishes to hungry customers before they lose their patience. But that's not all - you'll also need to juggle all kinds of crazy distractions, from rat invasions to unruly customers.

Embark on a culinary journey through the Italian restaurant in The Chef's Shift: First Course, and experience the start of Lorenzo's chef career. Savor the diverse flavors of the cuisine, where each dish will feature different quirks & challenges.

- 1 teaspoon of chaotic, fast-paced gameplay

- 1 package of easy-to-pickup, hard-to-master TYPING mechanic

- 1 cup of fun time management bits

And we mean it!

- Navigate through the menu by typing

- Prepare & serve your customers by typing

- Select your dialogue choices by typing

Throughout the game, you will meet various characters, from customers with their own personality, to characters who propel the story forward.

games.name: The Last Flame: Prologue
games.shortDescription: Recruit a party of unique heroes, fight deadly encounters, loot and craft powerful gear, discover and create thousands of synergetic builds! The Last Flame is an endless roguelike auto-battler in which you guide a righteous party of heroes through many challenges.
games.aboutText:
The Last Flame is a roguelike auto-battler which focuses on build creation, strategy and decision making. Recruit special heroes, fight deadly encounters, loot and craft powerful gear, discover and create unique synergetic builds! Every run, you will need to create powerful builds that will take down your foes!

The Last Flame offers an incredible amount of build diversity. Combine heroes, items, relics and origins together to create amazing builds! Hero and team building have been designed with flexibility and freedom at their core which allows you to discover and create unique synergetic builds every single run!

In between the automated combats, you will have to cleverly guide your heroes through the adventure by making the smart decisions! Manage your resources, choose the optimal path in the map, make powerful builds, and strategically position and plan the combat phase!

- Get access to a lot more stuff! Make amazing builds with 325 items, 65 heroes, 150 relics and 60 origins.

- Continue the adventure in the third act, and meet the final boss in a special act!

- Face 30 challenging enemies and 12 bosses!

- Progress through 5 difficulties which will challenge your knowledge and strategy!

- Push your builds to their limit in the endless mode, a mode where you try to reach the highest floor!

- Experience the game in diverse and fun new ways with the challenge modes!

games.name: Toy Shire: Room One
games.shortDescription: Are you prepared for a thrilling toy army tower defense adventure? Welcome to the Toy Shire! Battle diverse foes in various locations, defend your family, and repel foes from your area. Save the world by strengthening your defense with toy towers! FULL GAME AVAILABLE NOW!
games.aboutText:
Play through the three levels in Kevin's Room and defend your room against your old toys. Face Memphis-X in the final level and put a stop to his assault as he crushes your soldiers in an attempt to get to your base.

You received new toys from your family. Isn't that lovely? Oh, it's for sure...

Your old toys, though, aren't getting along as well. They are no longer cared for and have been forgotten. So what follows next? They're going to join together against you and assault your brand-new toys, so be prepared. But never worry! You're in luck since your brand-new toys are troops of green soldiers. They still require your aid though! Control, strengthen, and defeat the opposing forces! However, focus with care, the enemies you encounter might not be your old playthings!

Tower building alone won't be sufficient to repel incoming attackers. Build up your own troops in the best feasible positions, then unleash attacks into enemy territory. Never abandon your towers, and deploy your troops in accordance with the traits of the enemy. First, the attacking forces will attempt to get past your defenses. Build and improve towers to aid your army. By using unique abilities, you can support your troops and towers as well.

Safeguard your base against waves of attackers. You need to pick the right troops if you would like to prevail. Clean the paths and guard any open routes. Upgrade your troops and unlock new ones to take down the waves and claim victory.

Enter a world and a narrative built around the toys that enriched your youth, including toy soldiers, dinosaur sets, robots, building blocks, and more.

games.name: Ecosphere
games.shortDescription: A Fantasy / Steampunk Visual Novel in which you'll make hearts skip a beat! You are Arane Kross, a talented engineer capable of controlling nature with a machine: the Ecosphere! What will be your impact?
games.aboutText:
In a world where humans are born with an Affinity , the mark that gives them the power to control one of the four natural elements, Arane Kross grows up deprived of this gift.

Despite the taboos surrounding the use of technology, the young woman takes refuge in the design of machines to try to overcome her handicap until the day she inherits an orb capable of controlling nature : the Ecosphere.

Arane is then recruited by an order to protect the environment, the Green League , to fulfill her civic duty. A year full of dangers where any difference is perceived as a weakness.

In this Visual Novel, join the Green League and dive into a society filled with inequalities between those born with an Affinity and those without. As civil war looms between these two factions, a conspiracy brews to overthrow the established order. What will your place be on this chessboard?

Through your interactions with the many NPCs and the choices offered throughout the game, you'll impact this universe: between benevolence and resentment, the fate of the world is in your hands.

💚 You can enter into romantic relationships with any of the four companions who cross your path. Unless you prefer an adventure without romance? Love comes in many forms! The choice is yours .

🔀 Multiple Ends

In addition to influencing your romantic relationships, your choices will impact the world.

⚔️ Dynamic Choices

Based on Quick Time Events , dynamic buttons will appear during action sequences to determine the outcome!

👑 Exploration Phases

Explore and interact with various environments, thanks to a point-and-click system to unlock narrative content.

🎨 Interactive Computer Graphics

Clickable elements or short comic strip sequences will highlight key scenes.

games.name: King of the Bridge
games.shortDescription: Face off against the bridge troll in his bizarre game of chess! Decrypt, Twist and Enforce the rules as your devious opponent attempts to break them in King of the Bridge!
games.aboutText:
A BIZARRE GAME

Defeat the troll in his homebrew game "Advanced Troll Chess" so you can cross his bridge. But with over twenty mind-boggling rule changes to a classic game, this will prove to be quite a challenge. THE TREACHEROUS TROLL

This cunning foe will surely give you a hard time with his schemes, cheats and taunts! Can you defeat an opponent who has no regard for manners or rules? KNOWLEDGE IS POWER

Decrypt the mysterious rulebook with over thirty pages and discover countless mad strategies as you play! COUNTER THE CHEATS

Accuse your opponent if you suspect him of cheating! Guess correctly and be rewarded with the sweet taste of revenge! FEATURES

- Multiple Endings

- Speedrun Mode

- Speed Chess Mode

- Lots of Easter-eggs

- 20+ Unique Rules

- 30+ Rulebook Pages

- 100+ Lines of Dialog

- 30+ Achievements

- Atmospheric Audio Design

- Handcrafted Pixelart

games.name: Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree
games.shortDescription: Discover a once-thriving ocean, now tainted by enigmatic dark entities. Your quest: decipher the mystery and rekindle the ocean's radiant light.
games.aboutText:
Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree is a 2D adventure game deeply rooted in Arabian mythology. Dive into Ma'een, a stunning underwater realm. Once a thriving ocean, Ma'een is now corrupted by dark entities.

From vibrant, ecosystems of plants and coral, to decaying ruins of an ancient civilization, explore the vast expanse of the cosmic sea, Ma'een through smooth, seamless swimming. As you delve deeper into the depths of Ma'een, encounter more challenging environments and darker corruption.

After Ma'een is corrupted, it's up to you to harness the power of the light to illuminate the dark ocean. Shield yourself from lurking dangers in the depths, and dispel dark entities to restore the ocean's radiance.

Decipher ancient relics and inscriptions, solve puzzles rooted in ancient ruins, and uncover the secrets of an old, forgotten kingdom.

games.name: Defender Bros
games.shortDescription: Prepare your defenses during the day and survive until dawn. Defender Bros is a Top-Down Tower Defense Roguelike where you play as a Soldier defending your Base. Pick between multiple abilities as you level up to increase your power, then after each run buy perks and get stronger
games.aboutText:
Prepare your defenses during the day and survive until dawn. Defender Bros is a top-down tower defense roguelike where you play as a soldier defending your base, solo or with up to 3 friends.

As a Recruit of the Data Administration Corps, your job is to hold down a Base while it collects data on alien planets full of giant man-eating Insects . Every morning a drop box brings Scrap, Ammo and Medkits . Explore the map, dispatch any hostiles and collect loot for the night.

Spend your scrap on Barricades, Turrets, Flamethrower Turrets, Missile Turrets and even Mechs that you can control or have as a personal bodyguard.

Every level gives you a choice of randomized abilities , from flaming bullets to invulnerability. When you inevitably die, you get gold to buy permanent upgrades to all your stats for the next run.

Create your perfect space soldier with many customization options for your character model, skin color and building color.

You won't have to face the bugs alone. Bring up to 3 friends in local co-op, online or both. If you don't have any friends, you are automatically provided with a Canine Unit as your personal bodyguard.

games.name: Little Cheese Works
games.shortDescription: [Co-op Action × Voice Chat] Work together to carry cheese without waking the cat! Use voice chat—but be careful, even small sounds can alert it. As overworked mice in a shady company, can you overcome traps and escape to a peaceful life?
games.aboutText:
🐭 Team up with 2–4 players and risk your lives to bring the cheese back to the company!
One mistake means zero pay and a group scolding session for everyone!
Still, the mouse employees keep working like worn-out rags…
This is a company you should never apply to — a true black-hearted workplace!

🎤 Features voice chat !
Work together with your teammates and move quietly so the mysterious creature — the Cat — won’t notice you.
The moment someone speaks, hell begins!
One sneeze… and the whole company vanishes without a trace.

🧀 Packed with thrilling gimmicks!
Conveyor belts, toasty stoves, avalanches…
Each one is a “workplace” waiting for you.
Use them wisely for promotion — or fail and face instant (physical) resignation!

💥 No matter how hard they work, the mice are never rewarded.
Overtime today, overtime tomorrow.
Will peaceful days ever come to this black cheese company…?

🎥 Streaming Policy

Streaming Platforms
Streaming is permitted on any platform, including YouTube and Twitch.

Content Coverage
You may stream and publish the entire game. There are no restrictions or warnings regarding spoilers.

Monetization & Secondary Use
Monetization such as ad revenue, donations (e.g. Super Chat), as well as VOD archives, clips, subtitles, shorts, and re-uploads to other social media are allowed.

Credit Notation
Credit notation is optional and not required.

Prior Approval
No prior permission or notification is necessary. Please feel free to stream.

Collaboration Streams
Collaborative streams involving multiple creators are also allowed under the same conditions.

Prohibited Actions
Extraction or modification of game data, as well as any actions that infringe copyrights, are prohibited.

games.name: Alpha Nomos
games.shortDescription: It's time to wield the beat! Play as Cello and slice through an army of rogue puppets in a vibrant, melody-twisted world. Combat pulses to the soundtrack - time your moves to the beat to unleash show-stopping combos and perfectly choreographed chaos!
games.aboutText:
Who knew saving the world could sound this good?

Join Cello and her friends as they explore their ruined world, fight murderous puppets, and uncover the mysteries of the powerful force known as music. What shattered this world? What is music? What is Alpha Nomos? The answers are waiting — if Cello can fight her way to them.
Time your attacks to the beat and vanquish your foes! Rhythm meets action: you're rewarded for striking on the beat and crafting combos to the music — and for mixing it up. Don't just hit the downbeats; weave quick eighth notes and rests between strikes to unleash punishing combos.

Gather musical powerups that change not just how you fight, but how you sound! Combine them differently each run to grow deadlier — and to cook up funky fresh tunes along the way. Every upgrade is inspired by a real-world musical effect, making each run a unique sonic experience!

Explore a devastated world that reacts to the music you make! Breathe life back into your surroundings as you journey through new environments, uncover mysteries, and beat back the forces that broke your world - and took your friends!

games.name: Garden of Witches
games.shortDescription: Garden of Witches is a cute roguelike action game full of danger. Help the protagonist, Sil, as she tries to round up her unruly fellow witches and save the Garden.
games.aboutText:
Garden of Witches is a fast-paced action roguelike where you wield giant scissors and use witchcraft to bring down other witches in the Garden. You’ll need to master enemy attack patterns, create powerful builds, and fight to bring together all the witches before the Garden falls apart.

Beat Witches into Submission

As the Thread Witch, you need to gather all the witches for an annual tea party ritual, but they aren’t going to attend the tea party willingly. Face distinct bosses with their own personalities, transformations, and attack patterns. Learn how each one fights, and find the opening you need to beat them into submission.

Unleash Your Choice of Witchcraft

Choose your favorite Scissors, Spells, and Special Skills from your Armory and personalize how you fight to save the Garden. While going through the Garden, you will be able to strengthen the abilities you love with Imprints and Relics and reshape how familiar skills behave from run to run.

Bond with Your Coven

Explore a hand-drawn world of mesmerizing witchcraft and wayward witches, each with their own unique domain. Get to know them through the game’s main five-chapter story arc and continue your journey through a three-part epilogue arc.

Japanese Voice Cast

Defy Death and Return Stronger

A witch’s death does not end their story. Return stronger with permanent upgrades and knowledge of your past runs. Then experiment with other Spells and refine your favorite builds while pushing your mastery of witchcraft. Once you reach the peak, put your craft to the test by customizing the difficulty of the Garden.

Round up the witches. Save the Garden.

And try not to get yourself killed along the way, even witches don’t like dying too much.

games.name: Rock Star Life Simulator
games.shortDescription: Rock Star Life Simulator is an extensive fame simulation game. Start this adventure by playing the guitar on the street, form your own band. Protect the fame, money, and charisma you earned with the right decisions and become a world star!
games.aboutText:
Our game simulates the journey of a talented rock artist starting to play guitar on the street and trying to become a world star. The flow of the game will be shaped by the decisions we make in our game. You can either get caught up in this glamorous life and watch the ruin of your career, or you can live the rockstar dream.

If you want to be a rock star, of course you have to compose great songs and play the guitar well. Master your guitar playing and improve your stats. Upgrade your equipment and stats to play better venues and expand your repertoire.

Are you successful in your love life? Show your skills. Hang out at the bar, relax, and look for a partner. Don't forget to have a few drinks for courage.

Show your career progression not only in your city but around the world. Compete with other users on the world tour leaderboard.

Becoming a world star is not an easy journey, constantly improve yourself.

Expensive instruments, fast cars, luxury homes... Or continue living at grandma's house. The choice is yours.

games.name: U.V.S. Nirmana
games.shortDescription: U.V.S. Nirmana is a engineering puzzle game from Coincidence, the creators of Kaizen: A Factory Story and the inventors of the Zach-like. Set off on the Unreturning Void Ship Nirmana as it continues a journey of uncountable eons toward the edge of the universe.
games.aboutText:
U.V.S. Nirmana is an engineering puzzle game from Coincidence, the creators of Kaizen: A Factory Story and the inventors of the Zach-like.

Set off on the Unreturning Void Ship Nirmana as it continues a journey of uncountable eons toward the edge of the universe. Stop by distant worlds and ancient civilizations, helping them as part of your pilgrimage with your companions, the Renunciants.

The U.V.S. Nirmana awaits.

Thirty Zach-like Puzzles to Master

Conduits, signals, and constraints must be brought into accordance with optimal patterns. Design pipe networks that route energy flows from the vega drive engine and other sources. Modify their behavior with the control matrix while minimizing flux.

A Medium-Difficulty Pilgrimage

Too easy is too easy. Too difficult is not rewarding. For those already experienced with previous “Zach-like” games, a complete journey will take roughly 4–6 hours.

Twelve Tools for Expedient Means

Tools include sensors, valves, multiplexers and more. Their skillful use will be necessary to assist the various life forms and civilizations that you will encounter along the way.

Custom Puzzles

Continue exploring state space beyond the missions of the U.V.S. Nirmana by designing your own puzzles and observing as others solve them.

Eternal Solitaire

A solitaire variant inspired by the traditional game Oware is included. Strategic play rewards insight into the future and an understanding of cause and effect.

Histograms and Leaderboards

Optimal solutions are their own reward, however, those interested in comparing their work to others can do so with these features.

games.name: Joint Recall
games.shortDescription: Co-op horror extraction shooter. Explore abandoned buildings and hear the screams of a friend being choked by a monster. Crawl deeper into the unknown, fire into the darkness, send teammates to bait enemies, check every corner for supplies, and feel the rush from a successful extraction.
games.aboutText:
Co-op horror extraction shooter.
Explore abandoned buildings and hear the screams of a friend being choked by a monster. Crawl deeper into the unknown, fire into the darkness, send teammates to bait enemies, check every corner for supplies, and feel the rush from a successful extraction.

The Importance of Teamwork.
Working together is crucial as you and your friends navigate dangerous environments, using voice chat to stay connected and coordinate your actions. Whether guiding from afar or tackling challenges together, communication ensures survival. Utilize tools like walkie-talkies and traps to outsmart threats and keep your crew safe.

The Power of Scavenging.
Scavenge for valuable items, evacuate your finds, and transform them into powerful upgrades that will enhance your character's abilities. Customize and improve your gear to match your playstyle, sell surplus items for profit, and grow your arsenal as you conquer new challenges. Every item you collect can be the key to becoming stronger, smarter, and wealthier in the dangerous world of Joint Recall.

games.name: Keyframes
games.shortDescription: After chance meetings in your second year of college, decide how you want to spend the last two years of undergrad with your friends— both old and new— in this partially customizable amare visual novel.
games.aboutText:
An amare visual novel that focuses on what some have described as the “second” coming-of-age, the ephemeral nature of relationships and the work it requires to understand and empathize with one another.

Experience life as it happens, each chapter defined by the events and choices you make for yourself.

Play as one of four total personality types, changing aspects of your personality as the game continues. Forge close friendships, distance yourself from specific characters, bring in even more new faces, or choose love— that is, if you want to. Between an intricate system of impressions that depend on both the player’s decisions and a chosen combination of events and experience, no one playthrough will be quite like the others.

FEATURES

- Hundreds of variations established via player choices

- Play 3 of 5 possible events, in any order you choose (for a total of 60 possible combinations)

- 1+ CG per event (with variations based on in-game choices)

- Partial voice acting & original BGM

- In-story UI— use your phone to select events and text/call with other characters

- Quick time events (input-based and timed-choice) for added variability

- Dynamic relationships— not only do you choose your perceptions of other characters, but other characters also change their impressions of you based on your words and actions

- Reactive storytelling— dialogue and narration change in response to previously played events

games.name: NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound
games.shortDescription: A brand-new side-scrolling entry to the NINJA GAIDEN series from the team behind Blasphemous, NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound redefines the classic platformer saga in a spectacular, thrilling and challenging ninja adventure.
games.aboutText:
From the acclaimed team behind Blasphemous , NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound successfully unites the classic lore and gameplay of the Tecmo-developed (now KOEI TECMO GAMES) NINJA GAIDEN series from the 8-bit era with the depth and intensity of the modern 3D entries. The best of both eras come together to create an epic and thrilling adventure.

Our story begins when Ryu Hayabusa journeys to America to honor his father's will. While he is away, the barrier between the human and the demon worlds suddenly shatters, unleashing a terrifying army upon the Hayabusa Village, which now faces an unprecedented threat in Ryu's absence.

To stand against this new threat, Kenji Mozu , a young ninja from the Hayabusa Village, rises to the challenge! Trained by Ryu, he fights fiercely but soon finds himself in desperate straits. Forced to tap into forbidden power, Kenji sets aside centuries of animosity and forms an alliance with the sinister Black Spider Clan , convinced that combining their souls and skills is the only way to protect the world out of the Demon Lord's grasp!

Combining old-school feeling with modern precision, NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound retains the pick-up-and-play action of the classic titles, while introducing new layers of depth.

Alongside the new protagonist, Kenji Mozu, is the skilled assassin Kumori . Take control of these two powerful ninjas simultaneously and unravel their interconnected stories.

Use the Ninja Fusion to unleash devastating abilities and obliterate your enemies. NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound features impeccable mechanics that are easy to learn but hard to truly master, challenging the skills of even the most seasoned fans of the NINJA GAIDEN series!

Step into a reimagined version of the classic NINJA GAIDEN universe, brought to life through stunning, meticulously crafted visuals. Every enemy is recreated with a level of detail that was once impossible.

The brutal, nostalgia-filled aesthetic of NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound pays homage to the past while pushing the boundaries of modern pixel art, making every battle a feast for the eyes.

Do you have what it takes to become a true ninja master?

games.name: Midnight Ramen
games.shortDescription: In Midnight Ramen, you play as the owner of a late-night ramen stand and his apprentice. You interact with your customers, listen to their troubles, and help them out whenever you can. But as the bowls of ramen are cooked and served, troubles are beginning to brew in your own life as well...
games.aboutText:
Trigger Warning

This game contains some heavy themes, including topics related to death, loss, and suicide. If you are currently feeling sad or have recently experienced similar situations, we recommend that you wait until you feel better before playing.

----------------------

Regarding Steam Deck Support:

The game is fully playable with controller input; however, please note that some text may appear small on the handheld screen.

If you have concerns regarding readability, we recommend viewing the store screenshots directly on your Steam Deck to ensure the experience meets your expectations before purchasing.

Thank you so much for your support!

----------------------

"Midnight Ramen" is a narrative dialogue game inspired by titles such as VA-11 Hall-A: Cyberpunk Bartender Action and Coffee Talk, and is developed by the newly-established Cointinue Games studio.

In this game, players take on the role of a ramen stall owner and his apprentice Homura, operates a stand that only opens late at night, as well as. Together they work to run their stand, feed their customers, and help them solve their problems.

✦Cook Ramen✦

Making ramen is not as easy as it sounds. Customers each have their own preferences and, in order to satisfy them, players must combine the different types of broth, noodles, toppings and seasonings in just the right ways!

✦Chat with customers✦

The customers who come to your stand aren't just burdened by hunger, but by their personal thoughts and troubles. Besides serving them meals, try to have a conversation with them, and help them to resolve the challenges they face!

✦An unusually ordinary life✦

Your life at the ramen stand might seem ordinary and low-key. But beneath the surface lies an extraordinary secret...

---------------

Music licensing thanks

Pillars Of Creation by Purrple Cat

Silent Wood by Purrple Cat

Creative Commons / Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported (CC BY-SA 3.0)

Music promoted by Free Stock Music

games.name: KoroNeko
games.shortDescription: Roll your way through a cozy, kawaii world full of charming characters and challenging puzzles to save your siblings from Strawberry the Witch!
games.aboutText:
Roll, roll, and keep rolling the dainty jelly jar to free the kawaii family of Koro by solving the puzzle and beating every twist that Strawberry, the cutest villain, puts you in!

KoroNeko is a relaxing, wholesome, puzzle game with *•.¸♡ 𝕂𝕒𝕨𝕒𝕚𝕚 ♡¸.•* aesthetic. You play as Koro the kitty cat, who is trapped in a jar by Strawberry the witch so bring your cup of tea because KoroNeko has NO timer, NO step counter and ZERO pressure!

Strawberry tries to use every trick and wheeze under her sleeves to lock Koro's family. However, Koro finds herself responsible to free each of the siblings from the jars that they are locked in, to start her teeny-weeny journey through many worlds with new mechanics for each starting from a playground in the forest and flower filled desert to a haunted tea party inhabited by charming characters in fluffy cushions environments & bright delightful colors in a stress-free gaming experience with an easy breezy learning curve!

FEATURES:

- Journy across 5 colorful and lively worlds

- Easy to learn, Hard to master controls

- Over 100+ isometric puzzles to solve

- No Timer means you can play at your own pace

- Kawaii little characters with BIG personalities

- An immersive and cozy soundtrack

- The cutest villain you can meet. But be careful; she is planning to take over the world!

games.name: 冬日树下的回忆AFTER
games.shortDescription: 本作讲述了原作《冬日树下的回忆》中“真结局”之后发生的故事。 《冬日树》系列是由制作人xwu创立的社团「午后零时」推出的免费原创视觉小说，并由其旗下小组『MagicaLuv』协助运营。
games.aboutText:
本作讲述了原作《冬日树下的回忆》中“真结局”之后发生的故事。

《冬日树》系列是由制作人xwu创立的社团「午后零时」推出的免费原创视觉小说，并由其旗下小组『MagicaLuv』协助运营。

STAFF

企划·制作·演出·角色设计：xwu

协助运营：MagicaLuv

代理发行：黎羽科技

原画：瑛砸、xwu

SD：羽户

美术：六六七

主题曲原唱：yoe awa

剧本：月谣、久琉霧

剧本修正：秋秋（校对：xwu）

程序协助：日蚀、禾棉

测试：dishing oji、toyako、日蚀、pico

基本信息

文字量：5万字+

CG：21组+ （CG均有动态演出效果）

部分注意

没有配音，没有任何色情向内容；

您可以通过点击鼠标进行阅读，没有游戏操作性。

games.name: Mik
games.shortDescription: A narrative first-person platformer set inside a decaying megastructure. Traverse through ruined architecture, solve environmental puzzles, and descend into the depths of a dying world to uncover an unsettling truth.
games.aboutText:
Waking from an impossibly long dream, you find yourself in the decaying remains of a vast facility once built for testing and science. It is only one of thousands of layers in an impossibly large Megastructure, one that has been abandoned long before you arrived.

A slow, lonely descent into the depths of a dying world.

Untold centuries ago, the fabric holding the Megastructure together suddenly tore. Travel between layers became impossible, Reality itself became corrupted and humanity slowly started fading.

A facility built to last for eternity is falling apart around you. Run, jump and climb across collapsed pipes, broken walkways and the makeshift constructions humanity left behind, and make your way deeper into the structure.

Much of what was built here no longer works the way it was meant to. Stack crates, press buttons and shut down old machinery to get past what stands in your way. With Source-like physics, most things can be picked up and interacted with.

Time moved on while you were gone. Countless civilisations rose and collapsed.

Search the remains of the facility for the stories they left behind. Piece together what happened to the Megastructure, and what is waiting for you below.

COME A LITTLE CLOSER

Something is calling you from below. At the bottom, a choice is waiting

Descend into a dream within a dream.

games.name: Evolit
games.shortDescription: Take charge of the galaxy's defense! With strategic moves, stop waves of cute yet dangerous enemies and prevent them from reaching the end of the road. Enhance your tactics with a variety of cards and unique towers, and stand against Evo! Strategy and infinity await here.
games.aboutText:
Are you ready to defeat enemies by building your own path? In Evolit, we combine the classic Tower Defense style with Roguelike elements. Use a variety of cards to build strategic decks and defend against enemies that are as cute as they are dangerous!

Cute but Dangerous Enemies

There are countless enemies with incredibly adorable appearances. But don’t be deceived by their looks, they’re extremely dangerous! Some enemies have ranks, and their colors change as they grow stronger. Just another reason to call them cute!

Unique Towers

There are many towers with unique mechanics and fun designs. When positioned correctly, they provide the best defense. To upgrade them, you’ll need to collect a few. Crazy Professor, Giant Furball, Training Dummy, Flame and Water Wizards, Vine Man, and an Alien with eight weapons are just some examples. It even includes a tentacle arm!

Path and Defense

Build decks with diverse gameplay and strategies. Extend paths however you like using road cards and place towers strategically. You can design paths based on your towers’ attack styles. Remember, the longer the path, the more opportunities you’ll have to strike the enemies!

Chaos and Strategy

All these elements come together to create a fun, beautiful, and action-packed chaos. Battling these endless waves of enemy invasions won’t be easy. A solid strategy is essential…

games.name: BROKEN LIFE
games.shortDescription: BROKEN LIFE is an atmospheric, fully voiced Point-and-Click Adventure set in a war-torn world. Follow Leo, a former soldier, as he returns to his hometown to uncover the fate of his family, restore his home, and confront the dark secrets hidden within.
games.aboutText:
BROKEN LIFE is an atmospheric, fully voiced Point-and-Click Adventure set in a world torn by war. At the heart of this story is Leo, a former soldier returning to his recently liberated hometown. Leo's journey is one of loneliness, exhaustion, and the lingering scars of war. He needs to restore his broken life, cope with his grief, and uncover the fate of his family during the occupation. But what seems clear and simple at first quickly reveals itself as an illusion. The house hides many dark and mysterious secrets…

As a solo indie developer from Ukraine, I’ve drawn from my own experiences of living through war to create this narrative. Join Leo on his journey through dark and atmospheric 2D environments, solving puzzles intricately woven into a story filled with tension and emotion.

Some Key Features you may like:

- Emotional Storytelling: Experience a narrative that reflects my personal journey through the war in Ukraine. The script was written amidst the chaos and fear of bombs falling on my city and across my beloved country. It's a deeply personal story born from my struggles with depression, panic attacks, and the overwhelming grief of war. BROKEN LIFE is my way to express emotions.

- Atmospheric Design: Explore carefully crafted gloomy environments, where every detail is designed to evoke the haunting emotions of war—the senseless destruction and eerie emptiness left in its wake.

- Full Voiceover: All dialogues and cutscenes are voiced in each supported language. This feature is optional and can be turned off for a more text-focused experience.

- Meaningful Choices: Your decisions shape the story, leading to different outcomes. There are no right or wrong answers, only paths that reflect your choices.

- Immersive Puzzles: Solve puzzles that challenge your logic and creativity, seamlessly integrated into the narrative. Each puzzle is designed to enhance the story, not just serve the gameplay.

- Inspired by Cruel Reality: BROKEN LIFE was created in Ukraine - a country that has endured the brutal realities of war. This game is a reflection of those experiences.

- Crafted with Passion: As a solo developer, I’ve poured my heart, soul, and tears into every aspect of this game.

Wishlist now and prepare for an emotional journey!

games.name: Outcast Tales
games.shortDescription: The game is not Free-to-Play, it's genuinely free. It's a challenging post-apocalyptic roguelite turn-based RPG about the psychological stresses of adventuring with complete idiots. Lead a crew of flawed heroes against the consequences of their own terrible decisions.
games.aboutText:
Be tactical (or mash buttons; might work just as well)!

Robots, mutants, desert raiders: almost all enemies have something up their sleeve. So do your characters: some abilities are most effective in combination with others. Find your opponents' weaknesses, humiliate them on the battlefield, and never ponder the moral implications of your actions! Use your strengths (if you can find any)!

Combine class and personality types to give each of your characters a unique set of abilities. A Preacher Mercenary and an Antihero Mercenary will behave quite differently. Create a balanced crew, or just try out the wildest combinations to see how they turn out! Overcome challenges (or mess everything up)!

Your characters will encounter dozens of unique situations that test their skill and wits. The Pacifist might talk his way out of trouble, the Egghead might try setting up traps, and the Daredevil will most likely just start blasting! In Outcast Tales, there are no wrong answers. Develop relationships (like in a dating game, but not quite)!

Your characters can develop deep bonds or even fall in love - but can also come to despise each other, all depending on your actions. Your journey can become a wholesome story about newfound friendship, or a gruesome tale of three strangers constantly at each other’s throats. Whatever sounds more fun… Let the chat join the action (or, more realistically, set you up)!

Connect the game to your Twitch account so that your viewers can influence the gameplay! The Twitch Integration feature will enable your chat to make crucial decisions during events, as well as choose your next destination or ability upgrade. And don't worry, your viewers won't ever try to harm you. They love you. Right..?

games.name: Age of Goblins
games.shortDescription: AoG is a real-time strategy game (RTS) with simplified mechanics and cute visuals, but VERY challenging at times. Lead your goblin tribe into what they do best: expand, conquer, and exterminate each other. Any resemblance to humans is purely coincidental.
games.aboutText:
Age of Goblins is a casual RTS inspired by some classics of the genre, bringing chaos to the battlefield with frantic matches and a lot of tactical mastery while simplifying controls and mechanics, allowing you to sit down and have fun right away without spending hours learning how to play.

Your goal is to lead an expanding goblin tribe and conquer all stages, extinguishing rival tribes and keeping everything for yourself. It may sound a bit selfish, but they will also do everything to make you disappear from the map (literally), and you can't just stand there watching while arrows fly everywhere, right?

- Tactical Expansion: Conquer new caves, towers, and farms to grow your small empire of little creatures.

- Manage your stocks: Without food, goblins don't reproduce. Gather from nature or cultivate your own.

- Dozens of maps: Individually hand-drawn, with various biomes and different strategies for victory.

- Earn blessings: The gods reward those who do well in battle. Use abilities to turn the game in your favor.

- Chaotic pace: Hundreds of units crossing the map and invading your territories.

- Personal record: Record your best times and try new tactics to improve your performance.

- Build your tribe: Nothing like going to war with some visual customizations. It's good for self-esteem.

Don't be fooled by the cute visuals. Despite having simple commands, Age of Goblins can require a lot of agility and quick decision-making at times, just like the good old classic RTS games.
Some maps can be really challenging, so keep that in mind before playing, okay?!

* This is the dev's first published game, made solo and with a lot of love over the course of a year. By purchasing it, you contribute to the creation of new games and new experiences. My heartfelt thanks...

and may your tribe triumph!

games.name: Drift Scavenger
games.shortDescription: You are a soul lost in the Drift. Weaponize your momentum to defeat the greater demons and the devil ending your cyclical hell. Explore a procedural map, collect new weapons and escape to the refuge to stash your loot. Pack your knapsack carefully! If you die you'll lose everything you brought.
games.aboutText:
Drift Scavenger is a difficult game where death results in losing all your items, however if you find an exit and survive a run through the Drift you will get to add to your horde of items back at your Refuge.

The main goal in Drift Scavenger is to...

Defeat The Greater Demons and the devil

The only escape for a soul stuck in the Drift is to defeat the greater demons and the devil.

Greater demons roam the realms of Greed Hatred and Delusion. Defeating the greater demons will unlock new powers, transform the map for that run, and allow you to challenge the devil. These fights won't be easy so make sure you bring the right equipment to challenge each one.

Hoard Relics & Weapons

Collecting relics, and weapons in your stash will give you access to new synergistic strategies and plans for your next run.

Momentum Shooter Combat

While moving at max speed you reflect bullets and can slam into enemies. Blow back from your weapons can be used to increase your speed, Hook shots can be fired to quickly ram enemies, Various special effects are triggered by drifting depending on what Relics you choose to equip

Explore a large labyrinthine procedurally generated map

Each run you enter a new map at a new spawn location and must get to a new exit location to escape. There are special areas and exits to unlock. The map generates altars that will allow you to heal, exchange health for loot, get temporary special powers and much more.

Encounter Mysterious Characters

Completing bets, and requests with the various characters you come across will improve your chances by allowing you to purchase new items, expand your storage space and unlock new ways to interact with the procedural maps.

Rogue Like Extraction

When you die in Drift Scavenger you lose everything you bring in and everything you have collected during the current run, Except for a special limited space inventory that allows you to keep a couple items.

In order to beat the game you must defeat all bosses in one run. The more time you spend in a singular run the harder it gets as the hatred in the underworld grows so you need to make sure you bring the right items in and use them at the right times for one final perfect run.

games.name: Draco and the Seven Scales
games.shortDescription: Set sail on a voyage full of pirates, dark magic, and the thrill of discovery! Draco and the Seven Scales is a retro-inspired adventure that harkens back to an age of top down dungeon crawlers and lovable, crunchy pixel art.
games.aboutText:
Take on the role of a pirate captain as he sets sail to save his greatest treasure of all. Draco and the Seven Scales is a retro-inspired adventure that hearkens back to an age of top-down dungeon crawlers and lovable, crunchy pixel art. Melodic shanties will guide your way through this sprawling world full of dangerous enemies, items to collect, and a dark force that seeks to corrupt. Will you break free from a kraken's dooming bargain, or be another victim?

EXPLORE BY LAND AND SEA

Switch between traveling on foot and sailing your ship to discover all the secrets of an expansive overworld. There are variable paths through the seven seas, and with each route you’ll discover new dungeons, items, and challenging puzzles that will require interacting with the world in both forms.

DEFEAT FEARSOME BOSSES

In each dungeon, mighty foes will test your skills in combat through dynamic battles over land and sea. Show off your mastery in epic battles against the Great Macaw of Paradise, your rival Captain Henny, Her Majesty's Royal Armada, and more!

MEET THE LOCALS

Along your journey you’ll encounter quirky characters with their own stories to tell. Take a moment to chat. Some may ask for your assistance, with the promise of treasure as a reward.

Game Features

- 7 classic top-down dungeons crawling with enemies, items, and puzzles.

- Powerful upgrades to enhance your ship's capabilities and cannon prowess.

- Over 15 unique items to collect that will assist you in combat, puzzle solving, and fishing!

- Amazing Gameboy-inspired pixel art with colorful twists developed by artist Manelzin.

- A soundtrack full of melodic shanties composed by Tohomoko, with different themes to immerse you in each area you explore.

games.name: The Local
games.shortDescription: A fast-paced movement game, loosely inspired by Surf and B-Hop. Featuring 5 gamemodes, multiplayer, and a large, playground-like world. Master the movement, and conquer the leaderboards.
games.aboutText:
Key Features

- Mechanically rich and satisfying movement, loosely inspired by Surf and B-Hop

- 5 gamemodes

- Multiplayer

- A large, playground-like world

- Rail Grinding

- Sliding , Wall Running and Climbing

- Air Strafing and Bunny Hopping

- Timed - 15+ time trials

- Orders - Complete orders and go for the highscore

- Zen - Relax and practice

- ...and 2 multiplayer gamemodes

- Capture - A capture the flag-esque gamemode

- Infection - Infect, or avoid becoming infected

- Timed and Zen are also supported

- Proximity chat

- Public server browser

- Create levels for Timed, Capture, Infection, and Zen

- Play by yourself, or online

games.name: The Palace on the Hill
games.shortDescription: A heartfelt story of ambition, struggle, and friendship told from the perspective of a young boy in fictional 90s rural India. Explore ancient palace ruins, set up your garden, cook Indian food, run errands for quirky characters, and learn about your history by making art.
games.aboutText:
Features

- Vibrant hand-painted watercolour graphics.

- Indian Cooking and tea shop management.

- A relaxing play style with an open-world exploration and questing.

- Over 25 regionally & culturally diverse cast of characters to interact.

- A feel-good story of achievement despite social marginalization.

- 15th century Indian royal palace exploration.

games.name: Eden Genesis
games.shortDescription: Help Leah overcome a serious illness caused by her cybernetic implants. In this a platformer from the creators of Aeterna Noctis, you will face hundreds of challenges and secrets that unravel the mystery of Eden Genesis. Live this Cyberpunk 2D adventure.
games.aboutText:
Eden Genesis is a platform game focused on fast-paced trials, quick reflexes, and a rich story by the same dev team responsible for Aeterna Noctis. Take control of Leah, a young cyborg lady, and overcome challenging trials to liberate her corrupted mind!

A cyberpunk adventure

In the not-so-distant future, corporations rule the world providing ways of increasing the physical and intellectual capabilities of the common folk, at a high price...

Those who wear cybernetic implants are doomed. Their lifetime is coming to an end in a matter of time, but luckily for them, there may still be hope. The biggest tech conglomerate just announced a promising solution for this terrible disease!

You play as Leah, a young cyborg lady who joins this experimental treatment to find a cure for what is killing augmented people. Overcome the trials to unlock your full mind potential and eliminate the corruption born from the implants that are destroying your neurons.

Game mechanics

Fast-paced gameplay - Eden Genesis offers a wide world full of trials that require anticipation, quick reflexes, and nerves of steel. These sections contain both environmental and enemy hazards, besides frantic platforming puzzles. Players must overcome them to cure the illness suffered by the protagonist.

Responsive controls - The game features an intuitive level design for the players to enjoy precise movement controls. As you become more skilled and Leah liberates more neuron links, Eden Genesis allows you to get even faster completion times every time you enter a trial. In a game with such scale and platforming, responsive controls are a must-have, allowing precise movement and combat.

A balanced platformer - While any player will be able to reach the end of the game and complete the main story and numerous secondary phases, it is true that Eden Genesis offers some extra content for demanding players. Many of the trials are optional, and these offer a level of difficulty that only the most experienced will be able to overcome. However, the main playable and exploration core is designed to be accessible to all players.

Deep story - Eden Genesis features a stunning plot including philosophic themes and debates about what makes us humans and the limits of science and technology. As every good cyberpunk story does, Eden Genesis makes the player question reality, and have uncertainty about the future.

Futuristic setting - The world of Eden Genesis presents a future in which technological megacorporations dominate every aspect of everyday life. Neon lights and cybernetic implants are the protagonists of a unique 2D artistic design, which gives life to an immersive cyberpunk universe.

games.name: Nomad: Steppeborn Saga
games.shortDescription: Nomad: Steppeborn Saga is an open world co-op survival crafting adventure set in a vast, ever changing world of nomadic culture. Explore, trade, forge alliances, and face threats while packing up camp, migrating, and forging your legacy.
games.aboutText:
NOMAD calls you into a vast, open world shaped by the Silk Road era’s cultural crossroads, nomadic traditions, and mythical folklore. As a wandering survivor, forge your own destiny; hunt, trade, form alliances or rivalries, and face both natural and supernatural threats.Pack your camp, migrate across ever-changing lands, and build a legendary nomadic legacy in a world where survival must be earned.

The Heart of Nomadic Life: Horses

In nomadic culture, the horse is not just an animal. It is survival.

Your clan’s strength depends entirely on its herd. Establish a dedicated horse ranch, breed diverse horse types suited for different terrains and climates, and raise them with care. Endurance, speed, strength, and temperament all matter. The right horse can determine whether your people endure the winter or fall behind.

Migration defines your existence.

As seasons change, you must dismantle your tents, load your belongings, and move toward safer lands. Harness 2, 3, or 4 horses to a single wagon to transport your tents and supplies. The number and quality of horses directly affect mobility, cargo capacity, and travel efficiency.

You travel on horseback.
You fight on horseback.
You migrate because of horses.

Without horses, there is no movement. Without movement, there is no survival.

In this world, the horse is not a side feature. It is the core of your nomadic life.

Myth & Lore

Face creatures from ancient Asian mythologies, explore enchanted forests glowing with mystical flora, resonating with shamanic rituals, survive cursed groves haunted by spirits, and unlock hidden wisdom through sacred stone totems. Every encounter with a creature is a turning point; some demand combat, others offer cryptic paths through dialogue. You choose your stance: Hunt them. Hear them. Or become something else entirely.

Cultural & Economic Interactions

Engage with diverse factions across Asia’s vast trade networks. Trade refined goods in bustling border towns, barter with traveling caravans, or negotiate with roaming warbands. Players may form alliances or rivalries with each other, where cooperation can break down into direct PvP combat over territory, resources, and trade dominance.

Seasonal & Environmental Challenges

Experience a fully dynamic world with shifting seasons and weather extremes. Adapt to summer droughts, harsh winters, and changing wildlife behaviors that impact survival and trade.

games.name: The Last General
games.shortDescription: Lead thousands of units in this large scale modern war RTS as you manage economy and logistics, build your war machine, and fight across millions of procedurally generated scenarios, or jump into the battlefield controlling any unit in first or third person at any time.
games.aboutText:
Become a modern general commanding thousands of units and managing an entire war economy. Plan large-scale operations, manage logistics, construction and production, and fight across massive maps where every decision counts.
Engage in total wars, insurrections, assassinations, protection, rescue, escape, and survival missions or jump into the action to feel the intensity of combat firsthand.

MASSIVE SCALE

The Last General features millions of battlefields of up to 400km2 (154sq miles), each of them with dozens of towns and cities to take and protect.

HIGH LEVEL STRATEGIC ORDERS

Hand-draw your strategic orders directly on the terrain and watch your companies interpret, coordinate, and execute them as a unified war machine.

MODERN WAR ECONOMY

Capture strategic towns, cities and industrial areas to get the resources you need to take over enemy's territory. Damage their infrastructure, economic and productive capabilities, while defending and expanding your own.

CONSTRUCTION AND PRODUCTION

Build new defenses, factories, and infrastructure to produce additional resources, troops, and vehicles to support your war effort.

DIRECT CONTROL

Jump into the action and control any vehicle or soldier directly to be part of your own strategic moves.

PLENTY OF STRATEGIC CHOICES

As a general you will have hundreds of strategies at your disposal to achieve your goals. Will you burn entire enemy cities to the ground and lose international support? Will you rush to the enemy's capital and risk being surrounded? Will you perform targeted attacks on the enemy's factories and power plants? Will you conduct false flag operations to damage the enemy's reputation?

What are you willing to do to be the last general?

games.name: 20 Small Mazes
games.shortDescription: This is a puzzle game with twenty small mazes. They're good mazes, though.
games.aboutText:
This is a puzzle game with twenty small mazes. If you solve the mazes, you beat the game.

- It's about 1-2 hours long, maybe.

- You need a keyboard and mouse to play it on PC. There is some basic controller support, but at one point in the game you have to type something.

If you're playing it on the Steam Deck, the game is Steam Deck verified and the keyboard will automatically pop up.

- A few puzzles require knowledge of English. No puzzle requires sound or audio to solve it. No puzzle requires being able to recognize different colors.

I hope you enjoy it.

games.name: Underground Nomads
games.shortDescription: You command a drilling train, leading a dwarf clan through the underground depths toward the planetary core. Manage the crew, complete expeditions, gather resources, upgrade gear, and make tough choices to reach the abandoned city and bring your people back home.
games.aboutText:
Captain, attention! A clan of nomadic underground dwarves seeks a commander for their drilling train—the Great Machine that burrows into the earth’s depths.

Your courage and organizational skills are the last hope for fulfilling the dwarves’ cherished dream: to find the lost city and reclaim their home. Join the crew and prove that even in the darkest depths, a spark of hope can ignite!

Assemble a Team and Coordinate Operations

Each crew member has unique skills that affect efficiency in different compartments and the success of expeditions. Assign tasks wisely, build production chains, and manage logistics. Stay vigilant—resource shortages can halt production and jeopardize the mission.

Build and Handle Crises on the Go

Equip the train with new compartments and wagons to ensure constant, rapid movement and uninterrupted production. Repair breakdowns, extinguish fires, fix accidents, and tackle countless other issues to keep the crew alive.

Embark on Expeditions, Fulfill Contracts, and Gather Resources

Complete traders’ tasks, outfit expeditions, and go on raids to mine rare materials for construction and upgrades. Assemble squads, meet deadlines, and assist scouts with challenges to lead the team to success.

Conduct Research and Upgrade Equipment

Prioritize developing your own technologies. Invest resources, materials, and funds not only in buying components but also in creating new machines, crafting unique recipes, and modernizing equipment. This ensures self-sufficiency, adaptability to changing conditions, and greatly expands your capabilities.

Use Relics to Enhance the Train

Acquire special artifacts—relics—by completing traders’ contracts, embarking on expeditions, and going on raids. Integrate them into the train’s structure to boost its performance and build the Great Machine.

Explore Biomes and Find Valuable Materials

Encounter new biomes along the way, from petrified wastelands to fiery lava depths. Complete tasks, explore new territories, and gather unique materials essential for survival and progress.

games.name: DemonStar
games.shortDescription: The shareware legend DemonStar comes soaring back with new game modes and revised gameplay. Originally published in 1997, DemonStar has earned the Computer Gaming World's "Shareware Game of the Year 1999" award..
games.aboutText:
After many long years, Scott Host, the creator of Galactix and Raptor Call of the Shadows, has remastered his shareware legend DemonStar - and now it comes soaring back with new game modes and revised gameplay. Originally published in 1997 and later earning the COMPUTER GAMING WORLD's "Shareware Game of the Year 1999" award, DemonStar was and still is considered by fans as one of the best 2D space shooters on PC.

- New game modes include Legacy Mode and Enhanced Mode

- 60 or 120fps

- Original Soundtrack by Bobby Prince

- New Soundtrack by Pfeffermouse

- Graphic improvements

- Tate/vertical mode for vertical monitors

DemonStar is the most thrilling vertical scrolling shooter on the market! DemonStar takes shooters to the extreme with controller support, 3D rendered graphics, explosive sound effects and a brilliant soundtrack. To destroy each boss, you will have to search for many weapons such as lasers, homing missiles and many more. As you pilot your spaceship through each of the 18 progressive levels, you can build up an arsenal worthy of a match against the XIDUS empire.

games.name: Salvo Shuffle
games.shortDescription: Salvo Shuffle is a bullet-hell roguelike that mixes turn-based and action-based combat.
games.aboutText:
Salvo Shuffle is a turn-based bullet-hell roguelike with combat mechanics similar to Undertale . Enemies can only damage you by spawning individual bullet-hell attacks (aka. salvos ).
Defeat the most challenging foe to make your life easier or keep them all alive for a massive combo and coin multiplier . The choice is yours!
The salvos might be simple on their own, but because you fight many enemies simultaneously, the actual bullet hell can vary drastically from fight to fight.

Ascend the procedurally generated Firework City and collect various augments to assist you in your fights. Manage your coins and health until you make it to the top and defeat the final boss that is waiting for you there.
The City is composed of many interconnected spaces. Choose one of up to four spaces at a time until you reach the end, on the 30th space. Plan your route carefully!
Some spaces are dangerous fights, while others might give you a temporary buff, some coins, or health, or they might be a shop for you to purchase new augments or to upgrade your items.

Between dodging the enemy attacks, you can strike back by using your weapon or the many different augments you collected in Firework City.
Focus fire is of the utmost importance. If one threat is giving you more trouble than most, it could be a good idea to focus on killing that enemy first. However, you will also be rewarded for leaving enemies alive for longer. It's high risk, high reward.

Augments are the run-defining items of Salvo Shuffle. There are active augments that you can trigger manually and passive augments that either affect a stat or get triggered automatically under certain conditions.
Every augment is distinct from the next and changes the gameplay in a significant manner.
Applying status effects is one possible effect of augments. They can greatly impact how difficult the next wave of salvos is going to be.
Watch out though, most augments also have minor negative effects , so choose carefully!

The game offers many unique challenges to increase the difficulty of a run.
There are 10 challenges with up to 3 levels of difficulty. Although they make the game overall more difficult, they also grant you more exp and coins. So if you want to use more augments in a run, this is where you'd do it.

The game also features an action difficulty slider in the options to slightly decrease or increase the difficulty of salvos with no penalty or guilt attached.

Some achievements will also greatly affect your run and will reward you with a player cosmetic to use.

And best of all: Salvo Shuffle is completely free to play ! No in-app purchases, ads, or anything.
The game also has a public discord server (link on the right).

games.name: The Collage Atlas
games.shortDescription: Lovingly crafted with pen & ink, by one person over 4.5 years. In The Collage Atlas your presence, your gaze, your movements all matter. With these things you breathe life into this hand-drawn picture-book dream-world.
games.aboutText:
Drawn entirely by one person over the course of 4.5 years.

The Collage Atlas invites you on a journey through an entirely hand-drawn picture-book dream-world.
From the grass beneath your feet, to the butterflies dancing in the air, to the floating islands drifting overhead - every little detail has been lovingly-crafted with pen & ink on paper.
The result is a world the likes of which you’ve never seen before…

Your presence matters, your gaze matters, your movements matter.
With all these things you breath life into the world.
Through your efforts, forests will grow, flowers will bloom, structures will rise…and airships will fly.
Shape the soundtrack as you travel - your every move causes the soundscape to ebb and flow.
At its heart this is a journey exploring agency, memory, and hope. ■ Features

- Dozens of secrets are tucked away in all corners of the world, waiting to be discovered.
- A dynamic soundtrack that responds to your play
- Featuring vocals by Frankie Rose
- Includes an original illustrated book by John William Evelyn Please note - this is a short, focused experience.

Depending on your play-style you can play through in 1.5-2.5hrs. Allow more time if you intend to seek out all the secrets,
The Collage Atlas has been designed as a world I hope you will want to revisit.

games.name: Wacky West
games.shortDescription: It's time to grab your revolver! You are the only survivor in a world after a nuclear disaster. Don't wait for high noon. Get moving and fight mutants and zombies to get your cat back! Collect materials, craft weapons, upgrade your gear, and show those freaks they shouldn't mess with the sheriff!
games.aboutText:
Wacky West is a crazy roguelite set in the Wild West! You are the sole survivor in a dangerous post-apocalyptic world. Fight hordes of mutants and zombies, collect materials, and upgrade your equipment to face the toughest bosses. In the sun-scorched Arizona desert, every day is a fight for survival! Craft increasingly powerful weapons, upgrade your gear, and save your cat - your only friend in this unforgiving world!

Save the kitten

Imagine a world where you have no support except your furry friend. Well... At least your kitten will keep you company. Except that heartless mutants have abducted your pet, and you are its last hope !

Don't give up!

Run forward and become stronger with every run. Upgrade your equipment, create new weapons , and never give up! Each run brings new upgrades and materials that will bring you closer to defeating the most dangerous bosses . As is often the case in roguelite games, the further you run, the stronger your survivor becomes.

Very Wild West

Wacky West is the wildest west on Steam. You'll need a keen eye and quick fingers to take on the toughest bosses. The atmospheric music and desert landscape of the map will provide you with the highest level of immersion. Zombies and mutants won't let you go, but they don't know that justice has looong guns !

Key features:

- Create weapons: A unique arsenal of weapons, from auto-aiming machine guns to rocket launchers and flamethrowers.

- Gather resources: Use everything you find along the way - scrap metal, trash, and other materials - to craft tools and weapons.

- Fight bosses: None of them will go down without a fight. They'll throw grenades, unleash hordes of mutants, and do everything they can to stop you.

- Traps and power-ups: Avoid dangerous barbed wire, acid puddles, and other traps. Collect useful items—both consumable and functional—that will help you throughout the game.

- Test different modes: After defeating the final boss, you can continue playing in infinite mode, with greater challenges and double rewards.

- Grow in strength: Upgrade your equipment, create new weapons, and unlock maps. Each game opens up new possibilities for you.

games.name: RoGlass
games.shortDescription: RoGlass is a tile-based roguelite puzzle game where you place unique tiles to score points and unlock new spaces. Reset the board once you're out of tiles but keep progress on achievements, unlocks, etc. Keep expanding the board and try to unlock every achievement!
games.aboutText:
RoGlass is a stained glass, tile-based, roguelite puzzle game where you place unique tiles to score points and unlock new spaces. Each tile scores points based on a different set of rules.
Your goal is to earn achievements that unlock new tile types, upgrades for existing tiles, new features, board space, and more. Achievements consist of various challenges such as:

- Reach a specified high score

- Place tiles in a specific arrangement

- Get tiles to be worth specific values

- Combo tiles in a specific way

When you run out of tiles, you clear the board but keep your progress on achievements, upgrades, and spaces unlocked. Continue to expand the board and discover the secrets of RoGlass! Start with a single tile:

Earn achievements to:

- Add more spaces to the board

- Unlock new tile types

- Upgrade tiles

- Unlock more features

Use strategy to maximize your score:

Features:

- Unique achievement design where each of the 100 achievements unlock upgrades and expand the board space

- Upgrades change the rules, leading to over 50 stained glass tile variations that can be placed in millions of possible layouts

- Minimalistic controls with easy to play click, drag and drop UI

- Retain achievement progression and upgrades through roguelite elements

- Utilize powerful upgrades to manipulate randomness to your advantage

games.name: Promise Mascot Agency
games.shortDescription: Explore a cursed Japanese town! Recruit mascot friends and come to the rescue when disaster strikes! Solve the mystery of your exile!
