Help a living finger work through her many anger issues! Turn Promise Mascot Agency into the best agency in Japan in this open-world narrative adventure!
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Promise Mascot Agency

From the creators of Paradise Killer comes a mind-bending open-world narrative adventure mascot management simulator where mascots are more than just symbols - they’re unpredictable forces of nature! Step into the chaos, unravel the conspiracies, drive a tiny truck and try to keep it all together in Promise Mascot Agency !

Welcome to the Mascot Hustle

You thought mascots were just fluffy, innocent brand ambassadors? Think again. The Mascots are all living, breathing, fully formed personalities, with dreams, fears, and the occasional breakdowns of their own- just like us! Whether it’s Trororo , a charming cat who’s a little too obsessed with "adult video" or sweet, silken To-Fu , who can’t stop sobbing, your job is to befriend, mentor, and (hopefully) get these mascots to finish their jobs without causing a major catastrophe.

Play Your Cards Right

Sending your mascots out to work is never as easy as it sounds. One minute they’re promoting delicious food, the next they’re stuck in a doorway or starting a kitchen inferno. Need help? Good thing Kaso-Machi is full of intrepid everyday heroes ready to lend a hand (if you’ve managed to befriend them, of course). Unlock Hero Cards, featuring Kaso-Machi’s lovable local weirdos like Captain Sign , Japan’s only road-sign superhero (don’t ask questions), or Mama-San , a bar owner with a serious latex collection. These heroes will step in to provide help when your mascots inevitably lose control.

Tear Through Town in Your Upgradable Kei Truck

Kaso-Machi is a town full of secrets, and Michi isn’t just stuck in an office managing mascots - he’s on the road in his rusty (but upgradeable!) Kei Truck . This nifty little ride may look like a heap of junk, but with a few tweaks, it’ll have nitro boosts , glider wings , and even the ability to launch Pinky☆ - Michi’s maniacal mascot assistant - like a missile . Use your truck to explore the strange, forgotten town, unlock collectibles, and uncover hidden mysteries. Who knew a Kei Truck could be your best friend in a town where literally everything else hates you?!

Crime! Drama! A Walking Finger?!

Exiled after an ambush that left his clan in shambles, Michi finds himself piecing together the mystery of what really happened, while the town seems to actively conspire against him. Nightmare spirits seem a little too interested in your business, and there’s an ever-present sense that something’s very, very wrong in this place…

Buy Now... Or Pinky☆ Will Find You

Think you can resist? Think again. The mascots know where you live. Step into the world of Promise Mascot Agency and claim your place in this brave new world of mascot domination.

games.name: Endless RPG - Untold Tales
games.shortDescription: Craft a party of diverse characters, each with customizable skills and looks. Explore a living world with dynamic day-night cycles, changing seasons, and diverse biomes. Embark on an epic journey where you shape your destiny as the director of your unique story.
games.aboutText:
Main Points

- Procedurally Generated World

- Fully Customizable Characters

- No Class Constraints – Play Your Way

- Animated combat

Characters

Shape your characters exactly as you envision them with unparalleled creative freedom. Choose from diverse races and aesthetics, and develop their skills as they grow through their journey. Equip them with gear that defines unique combat styles, ensuring no two characters play alike. With no rigid class systems, your team reflects your strategy. Beyond individuality, foster bonds between characters, creating meaningful connections that enrich your adventure.

Combat

- Rock-Paper-Scissors attack and defense system

- 300+ unique skills to mix and match

- Tactical yet fast-paced turn-based battles

- Every fight is a chance to experiment and outsmart foes

Living World

With the power to generate multiple unique realms, it transports you to an open world of infinite possibilities. Witness the dynamic transformation of multiple realms, where your choices can usher in dramatic changes or let nature take its course. Navigate through diverse biomes that mirror the intricate tapestry of nature. Engage with a day-and-night cycle. Immerse yourself in a weather system, embracing the dance of rain and fog that adds an atmospheric touch to your journey. Towns evolve, trade, wage wars, and even strike alliances, painting a canvas of political intrigue. Encounter Evil Centers that spawn formidable adversaries, threatening the world's equilibrium. Explore the enigmatic Ruins, face the challenge of Obelisks, and delve into the mysteries of The Infinite Caves.

The world adapts, changing before your eyes, it presents a living, evolving environment that serves as a testament to your journey's impact, ensuring your adventures remain dynamic and utterly unique.

Rules

Meticulous care has been taken to ensure that every skill and item is finely tuned, creating an equilibrium that allows for diverse strategies and approaches. This meticulous balance not only guarantees fair and engaging gameplay but also cultivates a sense of agency, empowering you to overcome any obstacle that crosses your path. And yet the rules are also pretty simple and straightforward.

Agency

As the director of your own story, you'll navigate a world where every decision you make holds the potential to shape the course of events. In this dynamic realm, there are no rails to confine your choices. Forge alliances, shape destinies, and embrace consequences as you venture forth, seamlessly intertwining your personal narrative with the universe around you. Each quest, every encounter, and all pivotal moments are yours to shape, ensuring that no two players experience the same journey.

Compatibility

🐧 The game does not have a native Linux build, but it runs great via Proton on SteamOS and most Linux distros.

games.name: Dispatch
games.shortDescription: Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy where choices matter. Manage a dysfunctional team of misfit heroes and strategize who to send to emergencies around the city, all while balancing office politics, personal relationships, and your own quest to become a hero. All episodes out now!
games.aboutText:
From the writers & directors of Tales from the Borderlands and The Wolf Among Us ,
Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy set in modern day Los Angeles.

You play as Robert Robertson, AKA Mecha Man, whose mech-suit is destroyed in a battle against his nemesis, forcing him to take a job at a superhero dispatch center: not as a hero, but a dispatcher. In charge of rehabilitating a group of ex-supervillains, you must manage your roster while navigating office relationships and rebuilding your suit for a shot at revenge.

In Dispatch , every decision you make influences the unfolding narrative. From banter in the breakroom to life-or-death situations in the field, your choices affect your relationships with the heroes, their allegiances, and the path your own story takes.

Use the strategy map to review ongoing emergencies and deploy the right (or wrong) heroes to deal with them. Balance the risks and rewards as you make tactical decisions, knowing that each choice can have lasting consequences for your team and the city.

Managing heroes sometimes goes beyond their powers. Each hero comes with quirks, flaws, and baggage you’ll need to navigate to keep the team together. Upgrade their skills and unlock abilities to boost their effectiveness in the field.

Blending narrative, strategy, and humor, Dispatch explores what it means to be a hero, whether you're wearing a cape or behind a desk.

Featuring an all-star cast from every corner of entertainment

- Aaron Paul ( Breaking Bad, Westworld, Black Mirror )

- Laura Bailey ( The Legend of Vox Machina, The Last of Us II, Marvel's Spider-Man )

- Erin Yvette ( Hades II, The Wolf Among Us, Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon )

- MoistCr1TiKaL (Charles White)

- Jacksepticeye ( Sonic Prime, River City Girls 1 & 2, Bendy and the Ink Machine)

- Travis Willingham ( The Legend of Vox Machina, Critical Role, Lego Avengers )

- Alanah Pearce ( V/H/S Beyond, Cyberpunk 2077, Gears 5 )

- Lance Cantstopolis (Karate , Dancing , Actor)

- Joel Haver (Filmmaker , Actor , YouTuber)

- THOT SQUAD (Musician: Pound Cake , Hoes Depressed )

- Yung Gravy (Musician: Betty (Get Money) , oops! )

- Matthew Mercer ( Critical Role, Overwatch, Resident Evil 6 )

- and Jeffrey Wright ( American Fiction, The Batman, Casino Royale )

games.name: Figure Drawing Garden
games.shortDescription: Grab your sketchbook, relax, explore, and draw in your very own Figure Drawing Garden - an immersive virtual garden designed for you to practice and improve at figure drawing.
games.aboutText:
Draw together on Discord! (Link in sidebar or scan QR above) - Share your art, exchange feedback, and help shape the game’s future. Be the first to hear about updates, new modelpacks, and upcoming events.

An exquisite collection of 3D-scanned classical and renaissance sculptures to draw - curated to provide accurate anatomy, dynamic poses, and a variety of body types.

Explore your own infinite virtual garden of towering monuments, intricate fountains, and quiet courtyards - which expands as you draw .

Practicing your shading? Enter Dynamic Lighting mode and light the figure as you desire.

Discover rare Challenge Sculptures , which will introduce you to new techniques and help sharpen your skills.

New to figure drawing? The Simplified Form and Perspective Grid tools have you covered.

Through its tranquil environment and optional Soundscapes , Figure Drawing Garden is designed to help you reach a state of flow .

Scan QR codes in game to share your drawings to the Community Discord and see other artists practicing alongside you.

Personalize your garden and draw anything you can imagine - anime, fantasy, sci-fi, and more - with community-made Modelpacks .

games.name: Beautiful in Death
games.shortDescription: A first-person game with a focus on dialogue and historical accuracy, set in the Victorian Era. You will step into the shoes of a photographer with a stern mustache who specializes in post-mortem photography. The game is emotionally heavy, melancholic, and full of skeletons in the closet.
games.aboutText:
The Victorian era was full of death, and this game is no exception. The game primarily focuses on dialogue, the sorrow of losing loved ones, death, historical accuracy, and interesting facts about the Victorian era, or at least it tries to. In this game, you have the freedom to choose what you want to do. You can either sternly and grimly focus on your work, or take the time to explore the protagonist’s backstory.

The story of this game will immerse you in the Victorian era, specifically in the field of post-mortem photography. You are a photographer who comes from Ukraine to London to begin work as a post-mortem photographer. You will mostly witness the photographer’s later years, but you will also capture his early years when you first open your photographic studio. In your later years, you have become cold, harsh, and demanding, you are famous only for your work. People know that you are a master of your craft and have been practicing post-mortem photography for quite a long time, but there is not a single person who would speak well of you as a person. This story is mainly about a harsh and difficult man, the game does not necessarily focus on post-mortem photography, who knows what you will learn about the photographer.
Memento mori - remember you must die.

Your task is to photograph the deceased. Correspond and exchange experience with such renowned photographers as Vasily Sergeyevich Dosekin, A. M. Ivanitsky, Oscar Gustave Rejlander, and other photographers of that era. From the mid-19th century to the late Victorian era, you will be managing your photo studio. Of course, maintaining it is not mandatory (the main character may well end up becoming the subject of his own work after such a turn of events), any of us can suddenly change the course of our career, and it’s entirely up to you what you choose to do.

You will help families obtain the only photograph they’ll have of their deceased loved one. You’ll also have access to tools that will assist you in your work. Should you photograph the deceased sitting in a chair? Or perhaps place an object they loved in life on their lap? Well, the choice is yours, you decide how to photograph the departed.

games.name: Brickhaven
games.shortDescription: Create your gang from nothing. Start off with just yourself and take it from a single member to a sprawling criminal empire. Extort businesses, deal drugs, sell guns, and much more. Customize your gang to partake in whatever crimes you want them to. What kind of boss will you be?
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Brickhaven

Brickhaven is the very city you and your gang fight to thrive in. Explore the busy streets, check out the shops, and find some lucrative opportunities along the way.

The Empire

- Recruit your members right off the street

- Setup protection rackets, drug fronts, money laundering schemes, and much more to help maximize your profits

- Send members to defend your hard earned rackets and businesses in order to set a physical footprint in the city

- Be as hands off or on as you want, almost everything can be automated through delegation

Rule the Streets

- Fight off rival gangs moving in on your turf

- Send gang members to attack rival businesses

- Take over the enemy turf to continue your expansion

Delegate

- Order members to rob civilians, hold up a store, or even do a drive by

- Setup runners for your rackets to make cash drops at the gang stash

- Appoint members as dealers, guards of a business, to patrol routes, or even assign them as lieutenants to help you run your empire

Surviving the Police

- Create enough noise and the cops will catch on fast

- Survive police raids on warehouses or bribe the chief in order to keep them off your back

- Take out enough cops in an area and they may end up being too scared to come back for a quite a while

Engage In Turf Wars Online and Off

- Multiplayer mode where up to five players can join and all create their own separate gangs. Each player will start off with no money and no gang. They will then have to carefully build up their crews and strategically setup turf defense measures in order to maintain their foothold.

- There will be the ability to create fragile alliances as well as give businesses and turf up to rivals in order to avoid being crushed

- A solo mode will also be available for players who want to go up against the AI gangs

Houses / Apartments

- Players and NPCs will have their own homes and apartments

- Each residence will be available for you to break into and rob. That goes for players too, so watch your back

- Players will be able to purchase homes and customize them with furniture, have gang members hang out at the crib, or make it your place away from the streets depending on where you reside

- Player homes will not be made publicly available, so in order to figure out where a player lives, they either need to show you or you need to have them followed back to their home

Dynamic World

- Each NPC will have their own jobs and schedules

- Depending on what your crew is up to, it could shape the whole neighborhood. Selling hard drugs? Could cause an epidemic in the turf. Selling heavy duty guns? Could see a rise in violence among the citizens and other crews in the area.

Permadeath

- Making one wrong decision could mean losing your top members forever or even your own life. When the boss of a gang is taken out, then you will take the role of the next strongest member in your gang who will then take over. Your gang isn't gone until the last member is taken out.

Run Your Gang Freely

- Choose how you want to run your gang. Want to run guns, but ban drugs from your turf? Make the order. Want to squeeze your rivals into submission instead of dividing up the city? Do it. Nobody can tell you how to run your crew, show us what you are made of!

games.name: The Colony 2044
games.shortDescription: Balance survival with strategic combat in this unique simulation. Lead a bunny colony through a post-apocalyptic world infested with zombie bunnies. Manage resources, construct a thriving settlement, and navigate intricate social dynamics to uncover the cure held by one of your survivors.
games.aboutText:
In a world of bunny societies, existence was shattered when an evil pharmaceutical company, known for its sinister experiments, bioengineered a virus that unleashed a catastrophic zombie outbreak. In the aftermath of the outbreak, you find yourself leading a group of survivors in a world where fluffy tails and twitching noses now hide a dark and dangerous secret.

CRAFT TOOLS AND WEAPONS

Survive and thrive in a post-apocalyptic world! Gather materials, craft essential tools, and create powerful weapons to defend your colony.

FIGHT OFF HORDES

Prepare your colonists to fend off waves of infected! Craft weapons, fortify your defenses, and use tactical combat to survive against ever-growing hordes.

GROW YOUR COLONY

Expand and upgrade your colony by constructing new buildings, gathering essential resources, and training your colonists to improve their skills.

EXPLORE SECRET LABORATORIES

Venture beyond your colony into distant, dangerous worlds, searching for hidden laboratories that hold valuable research pages.

games.name: Isometria
games.shortDescription: Explore an isometric world solo or with friends. Battle goblins, giant crabs, mysterious machines, and powerful bosses to gain their powers. Build a community and help the locals take back their world!
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Isometria!

Embark on an epic journey into the realm of Isometria. Immerse yourself in this procedurally generated universe, where every step unveils new biomes, unique creatures, and a treasure trove of craftable items.

Craft

Craft powerful weapons, sturdy armor, walls, doors, tables, chairs, and an array of captivating trinkets. Brew potent potions and fashion exquisite jewelry to enhance your prowess in both battle and home life.

Build

Begin your adventure armed with just a handful of basic tools, and transform your surroundings through sweat and toil.

Fight

Encounter formidable foes, including slimes, goblins, fungos, skeletons, and more. Defeat mighty bosses to harness their powers and forge extraordinary weapons and items.

Explore

Venture deep into mysterious caves, goblin hideouts, ancient tombs, and haunting dungeons to uncover untold riches.

Multiplayer

Team up with friends in online multiplayer or host a dedicated server to invite others to explore your world.

Game Features

- Explore 9 distinct biomes, each with its own unique charm.

- Fight over 40 different enemies, each with their own strategies and challenges.

- Craft over 400 unique items.

- Choose melee, ranged, or magical combat styles.

- Dynamically generated world.

- Build your own base.

- Level up and gear your character.

games.name: Realm of Ink
games.shortDescription: Realm of Ink is an Ink-style action Roguelite game. While pursuing the Fox Demon, the swordswoman Red, unexpectedly finds that her life is dictated by the 'destiny' within the world of the book. Only by breaking free can she unveil the truth of her existence and challenge the constraints of fate.
games.aboutText:
Step into the shifting, treacherous realms as Red, the swordsman bound by her destiny. Wield the power of the Fox whilst confronting monstrous enemies and brutal bosses. Death is not the end; it's just a chance to redefine your destiny through cycles of death and rebirth. Take up your weapon and let your quest to escape the ever-changing realm of ink begin.

Experience infinite creativity. Dive into thrilling, fast-paced combat and invent a style that is uniquely yours .

- Mix and match dozens of different forms, weapons, and enhancements.

- With over 40 distinctive Ink Gems, every single run is a new opportunity.

- Unlock vast possibilities and enhance playstyles with over 200 artifacts

- Think you’ve mastered the realm? Prove it. Push your skill to the absolute limit in the Trial Valleys and earn high scores in the brutal Endless Challenge mode.

Adorable yet deadly. Meet Momo: your fiercely loyal companion. This mysterious Ink Pet fights tooth and claw alongside you every step of the way. But the real magic happens when you combine Ink Gems: witness instant, explosive transformations! Experience the unique changes with over 15 unique, striking forms, each one granting access to utterly unique move sets. Which combination will become your favourite?

An Eastern fantasy world, painted in ink.

Journey deep into stunning, diverse realms, from the vibrant, verdant forests to the hallowed, reverent ruins of the Mausoleum. Each environment is a breathtaking blend of classical Chinese ink-wash art and rich, vibrant colour palettes.

Draw your sword and venture into the unknown. Battle the enigmatic Realm Guardians to glimpse beyond the veil into their mysterious pasts. And prepare to face over 20 unique creatures, steeped in distinctive Chinese folklore and backstory, including the cunning Fox Demon, the elegant Peony Fairy and the elusive Mirror Sprite.

games.name: Tale of the Shadow World
games.shortDescription: Walking through the forest, the girl found an interesting book, after reading which her world turned upside down for a while. And maybe forever. The shadow flowers gently whispered to her, luring her further into the darkness. Will she be able to bear the moral of this tale?
games.aboutText:
Walking through the forest, the girl found an interesting book, after reading which her world turned upside down for a while. And maybe forever.
The shadow flowers gently whispered to her, luring her further into the darkness, rustling their petals reproachfully.
Will she be able to cope? Will she give peace or will she find it herself? Who will meet her on the way? Will She Be Able to Bear the Moral Of This Tale?

======

Tale of the Shadow World is a game that is based on the song MZLFF - "Сказка о Теневом мире".
In this game you will plunge into an atmospheric world that is filled with something unusual and creepy, but at the same time interesting..

We invite you to find out who the Shadow Prince is, where and how this world came from and finally tell you about the fate of the girl who fell into this shadow nightmare.

games.name: Please, Touch The Artwork 2
games.shortDescription: A handpainted cozy hidden object adventure. Explore a surreal world. Collect items for its quirky inhabitants. Fix damaged paintings and solve casual puzzles. Help a lost skeleton painter find his way home. This game is short but 100% FREE (no ads, no IAP).
games.aboutText:
Disclaimer: This is a short game made in 6 months . It's 100% FREE (no ads, no IAP), made by a solo dev in honour of James Ensor’s 75 year remembrance.

Touch the artwork and help a lost skeleton artist find its way home in a surreal, hand-painted universe.
Collect hidden objects for its quirky inhabitants, solve casual puzzles, and restore cracks in the fabric of the paintings.

This slow paced relaxing adventure was carefully crafted from works by James Ensor, a Belgian pioneer in the world of Modern Art.

Features:

- Hidden object adventure

- 5 unique worlds

- Hints when stuck

- Casual point & click gameplay

- Zoom-in for extra details

- Real hand-painted art

- Atmospheric relaxing sound

- Silly and quirky

- Slow-paced & relaxing

- Fit for ages 12-99

The game was created with the support of the Flemish Government on the occasion of the Belgian EU Presidency 2024.

games.name: CONERU -DIMENSION GIRL-
games.shortDescription: Feel-good, high-impact 2D action with two hearts as one. Time for a powerful, vivid “Action Date”!
games.aboutText:
Two Souls, One Body: A 2D Platformer "Date" Action !

Even though it's a single-player game, it feels like multiplayer?! In *"2D Platformer Date Action"!

Meet Socrates, your combat android. One day, his body ends up being shared with a mysterious dimensional girl named "Coneru"! They must navigate their new life, literally, together. Run, jump, punch, kick, laugh, cry, and maybe even take a detour or two on this quirky journey to save Shinjuku City from an alien invasion. This isn’t just 2D action―it's a "date"!

The adventure begins with a mission to protect the city from the mysterious invaders!

An odd and oddly cheerful alien group, the "Hateful Fruit Company," has begun its annoying invasion of peaceful Shinjuku City. Their motives? Unclear. But as you and Coneru progress through your action-packed date, the truth will unravel!

Weapon and Beam Combo Attacks!

You melee attack with your weapon! Coneru attacks from a distance with "Conerun Beam"!

　

You attack with close-range weapons, while Coneru fires her "Conerun Beam" from afar! You get to choose your weapon, but Coneru’s beam depends on her mood! Sometimes she'll come up with new beams in the middle of your date, because that’s what makes dating fun, right? Sync up your moves and unleash powerful combo attacks to blow your enemies away!

Coneru’s Energy Surge: "RunRun Mode"!

When Coneru gets in a great mood after certain conditions are met, she enters *RunRun Mode*! With insane, game-breaking speed and power, will you be able to keep up with her explosive excitement?

"Conerun Talk": Endless Chatter!

As you battle through this action-packed date, Coneru reacts to everything around with her expressions. After all, this is a date! Why fight with a serious face when you can chat, smile, and slash enemies while laughing together?

A Date to Remember

In this game, your soul and Coneru’s, two beings from different dimensions, unite as one. Embark on a special date that you can only experience in this unique 2D action adventure. It’ll be a date you'll never forget!

games.name: The Journey Home
games.shortDescription: Some answers can only be found by going within. In a world beyond the boundaries of time and space, your journey awaits. A stress-free atmospheric side-scrolling adventure.
games.aboutText:
The Journey Home is a deeply emotional, atmospheric side-scrolling adventure crafted by a husband-and-wife duo, with one half of the team bringing her experience as a USA TODAY bestselling author to the game’s story.

A World in Motion

Journey through an ever-evolving world where environments materialize and dissolve around you.

Hitch a Ride

No need to travel alone. Hitch rides with ethereal fireflies, giant birds, luminescent jellyfish, or take control of a flying car.

The Shape of Time

Shift between ages as you explore this world. Go from young to old, and from old to young.

Master Your Mind

Use telekinetic powers to interact with objects, structures, and living creatures.

Many Ways Forward

Climb, swim, walk, run, jump, push, and swing your way through a surreal world.

Find what you came for. This is your journey home.

games.name: Flawed Tactics
games.shortDescription: The autobattler where the market IS the balance patch. Build your team, cast your spells, create powerful relics, optimize synergies - but watch the ticker. Every minion you buy raises its price for every player. No permanent metas. No overpowered favorites. Just tactics, and flawed ones at that
games.aboutText:
Flawed Tactics is an async and live PvP auto-battler with a unique mechanic: a live market that automatically balances the game .

Every minion and spell has a price - and that price changes based on what every player on the server is buying. Popular choices get more expensive. Ignored options get cheaper. No patch notes needed. The market does it automatically, for every player, every game.

There's no such thing as a permanently overpowered strategy here. The moment everyone starts copying your build, it starts costing more than they can afford.

The deeper you go, the more Flawed Tactics opens up:

- Evolve — combine minions to unlock their most powerful form. Focus on synergies with other minions to create a team that scales over time and supports each other in battle.

- Spells — make your minions vampiric, give them haste, convert an enemy to a pacifist or just steal the minion outright. Spells are a critical element to the strategy and survival is not possible without mastery.

- Relics — created by spells they offer permanent benefits for the remainder of the game. Some give you an extra minion slot. Some alter how your entire roster fights. Some provide scale late game, but only if you can survive the early rounds.

- The shifting meta — because prices update in real time, your next build may need to adjust. The best tacticians aren't the ones who find the strongest combo. They're the ones who spot what's undervalued right now .

Before the first round begins, you make two key decisions:

- Your minion pool - choose 8 minions that will form your roster. Every random offer in the buy phase draws from your pool, not a shared one. Less chaos. More intent.

- Your spell pool - choose 8 spells. Some buff your minions, some curse your enemies, some create permanent relics that reshape your whole strategy.

Each round, spend gold to recruit minions and gems to cast spells. Combine identical minions to evolve them into more powerful forms. Cast spells to increase scaling or just survive the round.

Then position your team on the hex grid. Watch them fight. And plan your next move.

Async PvP - Take your time. Browse the market. Cast your spells. There's no turn timer breathing down your neck. Face the ghost teams of real players who played this same round, then move on when you're ready.

Live PvP - Play in real time. Your opponent is watching your formation right now. Every spell you cast, every minion you position - they see it. Counter or be countered.

Both modes available at the same time - queue for Live while playing Async. When the Live PvP game is complete, pick up right where you left off in your Async PvP game.

games.name: Shadow Mate
games.shortDescription: A horror action adventure game. Cynthia awakens in a ruined secret research facility with the vicious parasite “Belial” hidden inside her body. Surrounded by grotesque creatures and maddened researchers, she must use Belial’s power to escape and uncover the horrifying truth behind the laboratory.
games.aboutText:
About the Demo

This demo does not cover the beginning of the full game's story.

Instead, it features specially designed content that allows players to experience the world and combat action of Shadow mate .

A Girl and a Little Dragon Face the Horrors of a Research Facility

Shadow mate is a horror third-person shooter (TPS) action game set in a mysterious research facility.

Cynthia, a young girl who awakens inside the facility, and Belial, a little dragon living as a parasite within her, make their way through a facility crawling with grotesque monsters, drawing ever closer to the truth hidden deep within.

Cooperative Combat Between a Girl and a Little Dragon

Combine the powers of Cynthia and Belial to take on grotesque monsters.

Use a variety of Grimm bullets and biting attacks to corner your enemies.

Unleash the Dragon's Power

By releasing Belial's power, Cynthia transforms into a powerful dragon-human hybrid.

Unleash devastating attacks and dynamic combat abilities unlike those in her normal form to crush the enemies standing in your way.

A Research Facility Infested with Monsters

Dimly lit corridors, abandoned laboratories, and living creatures twisted into grotesque forms.

Once bustling with human activity, the research facility has now become a nest of dangerous monsters.

Explore the facility amid eerie silence and approaching threats, and carve out a path to escape.

The Truth Hidden Within the Research Facility

Cynthia, a young girl, and Belial, the little dragon living as a parasite within her.

As they venture through the facility crawling with grotesque monsters, they draw closer to the secrets concealed within.

What experiments were conducted here? And what truth lies hidden within Cynthia herself?

The story of a girl and a little dragon begins now.

games.name: DIGESTED
games.shortDescription: Strapped to a bodycam, you must escape a giant snake across isolated environments. Use various power‑ups to formulate an escape strategy, rely on the map and compass to locate your extraction pod, and don't get digested.
games.aboutText:
Our game is a short, intense, replayable horror survival game that thrusts you into a heart-pounding scenario: evade a relentless giant snake determined to consume you. The game's primary mission is to locate navigation points. These points are crucial, revealing the location of the correct extraction pod — your only means of escape. There will be no hand-holding or arrows to guide the way, only a map and a compass to navigate through the different environments.

As you uncover navigation points, you'll gather various power-ups, each offering a temporary advantage vital for outsmarting the snake that stalks you. Moreover, each playthrough offers an entirely new experience. Starting locations, navigation points, power-ups, and even the correct extraction pod location are randomized every time you play. Your strategy must adapt with each new game, challenging you to think on your feet, take calculated risks, and maintain focus.

Plan your actions carefully, navigate smartly, and whatever you do, don't get digested.

USE FIRST PERSON VIEW AS A THIRD PERSON VIEW

Keeping an eye out is a good way not to get digested.

AN ISLAND TO EXPLORE

Roam freely, but stay alert to the ever-looming danger of being digested.

WATCH YOUR STEP

You're only human. Stumbling around will get you digested.

THE TERROR OF BEING CONSUMED ALIVE

Jump scares end quickly, but a slower, more agonizing fate awaits in getting digested.

games.name: Travellin Cats in Jingle Jam
games.shortDescription: Find 200 cats hidden around a festive holiday village and a winter wonderland in this FREE hand-drawn hidden object game by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cat game creator! Can you find them all?
games.aboutText:
Travellin Cats in Jingle Jam (formerly Cats Hidden in Jingle Jam) is a free hidden object game made for the charity event Jingle Jam collaboration with The Yogscast.

🎨 The game features custom artwork created specially by Nina-Serena and given away entirely free for everyone to enjoy!

🐱 200 cats are waiting to be discovered in two custom hand-drawn backgrounds. Relax thanks to a chill soundtrack.

🐈 Found a cat? Click on it!

🎁 Please consider donating to the Jingle Jam this year — you will be supporting a range of great charities worldwide!

Features

🐾 2 Level

😺 200 cats

❔ Easter Eggs

💡 Hint System

🌙 Night Mode

☀️ Adjustable Brightness

⏰ Timer mode with leaderboard

🎨 Adjustable background & cats color

games.name: Snezhinka:Sentinel Girls2
games.shortDescription: A fast-paced shooter with simple controls. Enhance your character by purchasing cards and hold the line against waves of hostile mechs as an employee of a private military company.
games.aboutText:
[Game Overview]
Play as Snezhinka, a fixed-term contract employee at a private military company, and hold the line against waves of hostile mechs in a 2.5D dystopian world. In order to survive against increasingly powerful enemies, you’ll need to use what remains of your meager salary after taxes and other expenses are deducted to purchase cards and develop your combat capabilities.

This fast-paced shooting game can be enjoyed with a controller or a mouse and keyboard. The controls are simple: you’ll only need to move, aim, shoot, and use gadgets.

In addition to a robust story mode, this game also features two challenge modes—complete with online rankings—and a collection in which you can rewatch cutscenes and peruse information on the game’s characters and weapons.

[Story]
Snezhinka’s older sister is a member of the elite Molten Iron Squadron. One day, Snezhinka abruptly loses contact with her sister, prompting her to join the private military company Blue Peacock Co. and head for the front lines of the war in order to bring her sister home.

games.name: Cureocity
games.shortDescription: “People think battles need powerful weapons, but strategy at hand is key."The story follows a rookie adventurer and a new healer in a dungeon quest, with the core gameplay involving hand-picked methods using weapons and items. Fight or purify? Heal or alter? The choice is in your hands.
games.aboutText:
We are "Bread On Board," a collective of independent game developers spread across four countries, united by our passion and meeting during a GameJam.

Our game demo was born in the "BOOOM CHALLENGE", a GameJam by GCORES. With only 21 days, we created a game based on a given theme. After the competition, we even won the "Most Popular Game" award at an Online Game Trial Event.

The full playthrough of our game will take about an hour. We hope to give you a short, but super heartwarming and loving adventure❤️.

A rookie adventurer fresh on the scene and a former mercenary who was transferred into an adventurer due to injury. Two protagonists with contrasting personalities will embark on an adventure of fantasy and healing together. In the mysterious ruins of an underground dungeon that lies in the depth of a jungle, what awaits them will be...

According to the tavern's adventurer logs, the team heading into the dungeon features a rookie adventurer and an ex-mercenary who is now working as a healer. The adventurer looks as charming as a doll, and the enthusiasm never disappears; the healer is cool and a bit traditional, acting as a guiding figure for their adventure.

What stories have unfolded between these two contrasting characters, and what challenges will they face together in this adventure? The continuation of this adventurous story is yours to discover.

"People think battles need powerful weapons, but strategy at hand is key."

In "Cureocity," the power of your strategy is materialized as the numerical values of your hands in combat. You can swap different weapons or items held in your left and right hands to alter your character's attack and defense stats. You may also change "gestures" to focus attacks or land heavy blows on specific enemies.As you delve deeper into the dungeon, you will take the unique traits of monsters into consideration and discuss strategies with your allies.

In this adventure, you'll discover not only the secrets hidden within the dungeon, but also the truths about the world and the characters themselves. When faced with contaminated monsters, you can choose to either fight them or attempt to purify them. Of course, you also have the option to let things take their own course.

With each decision,the fate of the protagonists may change. The end of this adventure... is yours to decide.

About the Publisher

GCORES PUBLISHING is an independent game publishing venture formed by GCORES, committed to bringing you more outstanding indie games from the BOOOM CHALLENGE.

Feel free to follow our publisher webpage for future updates.

games.name: S4U: CITYPUNK 2011 AND LOVE PUNCH
games.shortDescription: This is a modern adventure of young adults seeking love and meaning. Return to 2011's Castor Yard, tap on your keyboard, and make those letters dance: Use your online persona to make meaningful decisions for your clients and yourself.
games.aboutText:
S4U: CITYPUNK 2011 AND LOVE PUNCH is a text-driven adventure game powered by immersive keyboard interactions. The story is set in Castor Yard, a fictional modern city in 2011. You play as Miki, who works part-time chatting on behalf of clients, meeting a variety of people and Cyber-Life online. Create your own memories in Caster Yard through countless small and big decisions made with each keystroke.

- Welcome to Castor Yard. Welcome to 2011.

- Let your finger tips dance on the keyboard as Miki, a daytime architect and part-time online mouthpiece. Make a living, fall in love, and do your best to earn your place in Castor Yard.

- It's more than just typing. Engage in unique gameplay experiences full of surprises, just as in life.

- Complete architectural projects, maintain multiple conversations at a time and solve tricky situations with smart thinking and quick keyboard responses.

- Your fates intertwined with more than 20 distinct characters in Castor Yard. More than 300 choices bring you unique experiences. Boys, girls, a successful businessman, a struggling artist, and more. Love comes in all shapes and sizes so muster your courage, go for the one your heart desires and hold on for a romantic roller coaster ride.

- Don't just stare into your computer screen, go downstairs, take a walk, chat with somebody, play with the vending machine.

What's the password for this photo album...

Well, forget it, just go downstairs and get one last smoke!

No, no, no...Those memories in Castor Yard, I still care for them…

- How the story ends and which memories you’ll want to hold onto are all yours to decide!

About the publisher

GCORES PUBLISHING is an indie game publisher established and owned by GCORES. We will continuously bringing you excellent indie games tested and proven in BOOOM game jam. For more amazing indie games, please follow our publisher page.

games.name: CYBERMATRIX
games.shortDescription: CYBERMATRIX is a fast paced game about movement. A place where the style of your moves really matters.
games.aboutText:
CYBERMATRIX is a game about speed and movement. A difficult and exciting adventure awaits you, which you will have to pass using one multifunctional knife and many different abilities. But the further you go, the more different techniques you will discover, and the stronger your opponents will be.

Movement is the key to victory. Use your movement skills to dodge enemy projectiles and rockets.

Use the environment to level up your movement!

games.name: The Hidden Art of Innkeeping
games.shortDescription: Transform an old farmhouse in a seaside village into a luxurious inn! Meet interesting guests, unlock delicious dishes, discover new areas and hidden treasures, configure rooms and amenities, uncover secrets, and rejuvenate the struggling village in this inn-management game!
games.aboutText:
After a disastrous stay at the only hotel by the beach, Elinor decides to convert an old farmhouse in a nearby village into an inn. However, renovating the inn doesn't come cheap, so she accepts a loan from a mysterious tycoon who demands payment by the end of the month.

Meet a colorful cast of characters as Elinor welcomes visitors to her new inn and recruits villagers and employees. Meanwhile, she discovers various treasures hidden around the village, and gradually learns more about the other villagers and the former owner of the farmhouse. Can Elinor uncover the secrets of the past, revive the fortunes of the struggling village, and turn the inn into a roaring success before the deadline?

Highlights

- Renovate the inn, and watch it transform from a dilapidated farmhouse to a luxurious inn!

- Meet unusual and fascinating guests, including biologists, adventurers, a pirate, and even a vampire - plus some familiar faces from The Lost Art of Innkeeping !

- Configure guest rooms, purchase amenities, hire employees, and upgrade the inn and its surroundings to keep your guests happy.

- Discover new areas, recruit new villagers, and unlock delicious dishes to be served to your guests.

- Find items and beautiful paintings that will be displayed at the inn, and that will help you uncover the mysterious background of the inn's former owner.

- Complete mini-quests such as getting seeds for the farmer, restoring a ruined monastery, helping kids build a sand castle, and more!

- Replay the game with a New Game+ and discover several exciting new items and guests, and experience different outcomes based on your choices and actions.

- Unlock achievements, master the art of innkeeping, and become the owner of a 5-star inn that caters even to royalty!

Playtime

About 7-12 hours for one playthrough (new game+ available with different outcomes depending on your choices). Note

This game is a sequel to The Lost Art of Innkeeping , but can be played as a stand-alone game without knowing anything about the previous game.

games.name: PortalSnake
games.shortDescription: Puzzle game about portals and snakes.
games.aboutText:
Puzzle game.



Bend each level by moving around portals and walls, then press play and watch the snake complete the level.



Portals can be used to scale, rotate and duplicate snakes.



50+ levels.

games.name: Witchroid Vania: A Magical Girl’s Fantastical Adventures
games.shortDescription: Join mage-in-training Lily on an epic adventure! Explore a multitude of worlds, including forests, deserts, and dungeons, in hopes of becoming a full-fledged mage!
games.aboutText:
A metroidvania action game depicting one young girl's journey to become a mage!

Freely explore huge open worlds!

Outside heroine Lily's hometown, you'll find all sorts of expansive lands. Make the leap to venture through East Village, Oak Forest, Hidden Cave, Dragon Ridge, Zalam Kingdom, and more. The order in which you proceed is up to you! Travel the world in search of new discoveries!

Battle ferocious foes!

Beware of mighty monsters and vile villains. Orc lords, assassins, sirens, and wicked dragons await you in battle. Gain experience through combat, defeating strong enemies to help Lily grow as a mage.

Power-up with magic and gear!

Use the magic and gear you acquire on your adventures to strengthen Lily!

・Master magic for each of the four elements—fire, ice, wind, and lightning—each with their own strengths and weaknesses.

・Make full use of support magic to breathe underwater, guard against missiles, and sacrifice HP to recover MP.

・Collect gear to enhance Lily's magical powers, defense powers, and more.

Joined by a loyal companion and mini-dragon!

Magical training can be a difficult journey, but Lily has a powerful companion to help her along the way: a mini-dragon who will lend you support during travel and battle. Plus, learn a range of skills by obtaining training books.

Jump into a world of magic and adventure with Witchroid Vania!

games.name: GESTALT: The Fifth Day
games.shortDescription: Wickeina 'Wicke' Gestalt lives in a haunted house. Trying to balance the stresses of life with the horrors of her home, play through a point-and-click psychological horror and multiple scenarios, where success and failure both progress the narrative of her story.
games.aboutText:
GESTALT: The Fifth Day is a story-driven point-and-click horror game solo-developed KINJAKO, with publishing and localization by 072 Project.

FEATURES:

- A grainy, black and white graphic novel aesthetic

- A point-and-click style of navigation and exploration

- Puzzles, problem-solving, and drag/drop sequences to solve problems and mysteries

- Ever-changing scenarios and story based on Wicke's choices that bare consequences with each mistake

- Multiple endings based on Wicke's actions

- Psychological horror based around dread, depression, and the unknown

- A story-driven narrative

- A short game meant to be finished within 2-3 hours (Appx. 29k words)

GAMEPLAY:

GESTALT: The Fifth Day is set entirely within a haunted house, which acts as Wicke's home. Inherited from an old dead woman she hardly knew, you play as Wicke, navigating house's everyday oddities and horrors while trying to balance it all with her day job and her deteriorating mental health. You will face many strange scenarios that you must overcome using your wits, pattern-recognition, and navigational skills as you steadily grow familiar with the strange house the more you are forced to live in it.

The game takes place over the course of five days spent within the house. During each day, both success and failure both progress the story, meaning you've got one chance per day to try and lead a normal life. The goal of the game is to simply help Wicke survive the strange horrors within, and get through the fifth day.

STORY:

Wickeina 'Wicke' Gestalt lives in a haunted house.

It can be difficult to find happiness when toiling away at your full time job. Combine that with a house full of entities and strange phenomenon that all seem to work against her, and it's clear that Wicke is stuck in a difficult circumstance. Inheriting the house from a dead, old woman that she hardly even knew, Wicke has lived in the house for some time now, trying to strike a balance between the hours toiled away by her job, and the strange horrors of the house. She is at her wit's end. The cannot keep living a life without control. During these five days within the house, what may be an ordinary week of lost autonomy and horror may just be her last chance to regain control of her life and overcome the decline of her mental state.

All will be decided on the inevitable fifth day.

A Game by KINJA

No AI was used in the creation of this game. Please support human art.

games.name: Minimalist Tower Defense
games.shortDescription: Collect resources and establish a defense line before dark And then Facing countless enemies
games.aboutText:
They... Are Coming...
Like a Tide...
...
Now...
... Gameplay

Gather resources and establish your defenses before darkness falls,
Then... Face countless enemies in their masses. Diverse Range of Defense Towers

Classic Tower Defense Gameplay

Experience the thrill of strategic placement and upgrading to thwart the enemy's advance.
Epic Scale with Thousands of Enemies

Brace yourself for massive battles against swarms of foes that will test your defenses to the limit.
Endure the Long Night Until Dawn

Hold the line through the darkest hours, persevering until the first rays of sunlight signal victory.
Contact us

games.name: BULLETHELL
games.shortDescription: BULLETHELL is an experimental, retro-hardcore, barely playable, ultra-fast-paced arena top-down shooter.
games.aboutText:
"How quick can a top-down shooter be before breaking the gameplay?"

BULLETHELL is an experimental, retro-hardcore, barely playable, ultra-fast-paced arena top-down shooter.

With the classic WASD+Mouse controls (UBERMOSH, QUICKERFLAK), the match starts with a duel that may be resolved in the first second. It gets progressively harder with more contestants entering the fight.
It can go endless, but each second is a victory that you can track with your personal best time and rank, scoring "SSS" in 30+ seconds.

Players can expect a hard-boiled gameplay experience with responsive controls, complex enemy AI, isometric pixel art, and awesome original music.

Welcome to BULLETHELL!

games.name: Highreach
games.shortDescription: When calamity struck, the world of Highreach was shattered. In this open-world survival game, build encampments, rescue survivors, and soar across the skies on your airship to explore a lost world and uncover the truth.
games.aboutText:
Step into the lost world of Highreach, a once-great continent now fractured and floating under a veil of ancient, dangerous magic that alters the very fabric of reality.

Explore this forgotten realm, where survival meets strategy, engage in combat, crafting, and watch as your camp evolves into a thriving settlement. Along the way, you'll meet companions with unique stories, manage your growing community, and embark on personal quests that shape your journey. Are you ready to build, survive, and uncover the secrets of Highreach?

Build your own airship and traverse through a continent of forgotten floating islands. Expand and upgrade your airship with different tech. Make it your flying mobile base, and use it to explore the skies, together with your friends and with settlers.

Explore unique combat styles with varied active skills and spells. Specialize your character with shareable items, allowing you to use diverse combat styles and stay flexible in your approach. Progress is shared among your group. Latecomers can simply equip your items, catch up instantly, and jump right into the action.

Rescue survivors of the shattered lands. Gradually expand your settlement into a thriving base. Your settlers will help with tasks like crafting, cooking, and gathering, making survival more manageable. Assign tasks to settlers, manage buildings, and expand your camp. Be sure to meet the needs of your settlers. Proper homes and the right jobs will keep them more than happy to help you on your journey.

Survivors you meet come with their own backstory and personal experiences here in Highreach. Bring them to your encampment and drive the narrative forward with their personal quests.

Dive into a visually captivating, procedurally generated world with diverse biomes connected. Build a network of connections with ziplines or portals for easier traversal. Each area offers new, unpredictable challenges and rewards, making every exploration unique with diverse points of interest.

Key Features

- Co-op Play : Up to 5 players can join together, with dynamic difficulty scaling based on the group size.

- Settlement Building : Construct and manage a customizable base with various structures and quality tiers. Use building blueprint placement to quickly deploy entire pre-designed buildings.

- Settler Professions : Assign roles like woodcutter, miner, and cook to automate tasks and support the settlement. Customize individual settler tasks within each profession for optimized efficiency.

- Airships : Use your mobile airship base to explore the world. Expand and improve it throughout your journey.

- Combat System : Engage in melee, ranged, and magic combat with dodge, block, and various attack options. Use supportive magic to heal and assist your team in battle and specialize in different types of skills matching your preferred playstyle.

- Narrative-Driven : Complete main and side quests that reveal settlers' personal stories. Chat with settlers to uncover more about their background and the game world.

- Randomized Dungeons : Delve into procedurally generated dungeons filled with unique challenges and rewards.

- Progression Through Exploration : Unlock crafting recipes, building structures, resources, quests, NPCs, and points of interest and new armor tiers by exploring the world and it's secrets.

- Day/Night Cycle : Dynamic cycle affecting visibility, settler activity, and environmental dangers.

- Dynamic Weather : Adapt to changing weather conditions that impact gameplay and survival needs.

- Procedural World : Explore a procedurally generated world with diverse biomes, points of interest, and environmental challenges.

- Resource Gatherers : Collect materials like wood, stone, and ore, with specialized settlers assisting in the process.

- Crafting : Create tools, weapons, and equipment using gathered resources at crafting stations, with settlers expanding the crafting capabilities.

- Survival : Manage hunger, thirst, health, stamina, and temperature to stay alive. Consuming food and drinks can provide buffs to health and stamina.

games.name: Project Real
games.shortDescription: The Real Project is a game where you shape your virtual life. Choose professions, build authentic relationships and explore a wide, vibrant world full of fascinating NPCs. Face challenges, explore stunning landscapes. Live a complete virtual life, full of unique adventures.
games.aboutText:
Join the Community

Serena Island

Discover a world full of possibilities in Project Real, an immersive life simulator. Embark on a journey on Serena Island, where every step you take defines your character's destiny.

Is it a farm game?
Real Project sets itself apart from other life simulators by offering a wide variety of careers and opportunities for you to explore. Become a fishing expert, run your own restaurant, create stunning jewelry - the choice is yours. Your success depends entirely on your choices.

Take part in the exciting seasonal events and festivals that animate Serena Island throughout the year. Celebrate local traditions, join in lively competitions and immerse yourself in unique experiences.

Project Real offers a diverse range of social interactions and relationships, allowing you to discover how each connection will shape your destiny. Every conversation, every action you take will influence the course of your life on the island. Find valuable resources while exploring

Collecting

Collecting and selling items such as fruit, objects and collected garbage are essential aspects of your progress on Serena Island. These resources play a key role in your initial growth Your Business!

You will have the opportunity to acquire your own store and carry out customized renovations. Collect!

Complete the main collections that will help you unravel the mystery of the stars on Serena Island. Explore the map of Serena Island.

- Central Beach

- Forest Corner

- Forest of Mists

- Recanto Condominium

- Waterways

- Serene Forest

- Moon Beach

Customize your character or your house

On Serena Island, if you want to buy or sell something, you'll need to look for a vendor or a specific store.

games.name: 东方希莲船 ~ Ultimate Fatal Octopus
games.shortDescription: A Touhou Project fan-made STG, also a collab game with Vtuber Syrena. Some day a random suspicious pink UFO showed up in Gensokyo. This must be an incident! As a result, Reimu and Marisa went on a journey to solve the incident.
games.aboutText:
A Touhou Project fan-made STG, also a collab game with Vtuber Syrena.
There is only one stage in this game, and its length is about the same as Touhou Ex Stages. But there are four difficulties you can choose from.

Some day a random suspicious pink UFO showed up in Gensokyo.
This must be an incident!
Therefore Reimu and Marisa jumped in directly to attack the UFO, without knowing the fact that the owner of the UFO was Sirena, just an alien passing by.
Since the UFO was damaged, there is no more to say. With that, a spell card duel has begun.

Recreated UFO system from Touhou Undefined Fantastic Object, but there is only one type of color for the UFOs. You won't collect the wrong UFO by mistake again!

★ 2 main characters
★ 4 shot types
★ 4 difficulties
★ A danmaku engine with better performance
★ Steam Leaderboard and anti-cheat
★ You can use auto dodging if you have Project Beril in your steam library

games.name: Blood & Chaos
games.shortDescription: Ancient sacrifices saved the world, but their legacy is unraveling. A party based roguelike inspired by classic '80s RPGs, where every descent into cursed dungeons carries permanent consequences.
games.aboutText:
Blood & Chaos is a party based roguelike RPG that puts you in command of a fellowship of adventurers. Build a team of up to six heroes and lead them through a perilous, ever changing world where every decision carries weight and every loss is permanent.

Explore cities, uncover quests, and descend into deadly dungeons as the past begins to resurface.

Will your fellowship rise to legend, or be consumed by chaos?

Tactical turn based combat

Engage in challenging battles where every move counts. Position your heroes wisely, exploit enemy weaknesses, and unleash powerful spells and abilities to turn the tide of battle.

Dangerous exploration

Delve into cursed dungeons filled with traps, secrets, and unpredictable threats. Each descent is different, shaped by chance and choice. The deeper you go, the higher the risk.

Build your party

Create and develop a party of up to six unique heroes, each with distinct skills and roles. Shape their progression, manage equipment, and adapt your strategy as challenges grow harsher. Losses are permanent, and every fallen hero matters.

A living world

Beyond the dungeons lie cities and other places of refuge. Interact with NPCs, uncover hidden quests, and navigate a world shaped by ancient conflicts, divine influence, and your own actions.

A classic soul

A tribute to the golden era of ’80s RPGs, Blood & Chaos blends classic depth and atmosphere with modern roguelike mechanics and quality of life improvements. Every run tells a different story.

games.name: BROODSAC
games.shortDescription: BROODSAC is a 2.5D survival management game where every visitor could save your community or destroy it. Manage your resources, interrogate strangers at your door, and decide who deserves your trust as an invisible threat spreads.
games.aboutText:
The bombs fell. No one died. It's much worse than that.

Ray, a retired sheriff, returns to the family farm to see his mother as war breaks out on television. Strikes hit major cities across the country. No casualties. Just people who, little by little, stop being quite themselves.

Quarantine sets in. The news stops adding up. And every time someone knocks, the same question comes back: who do you let in?

Any face could be hiding a threat — or a life worth saving

BROODSAC is a 2.5D survival management game where the scarcest resource isn't water or food: it's trust. Every survivor who knocks on your door could help you make it through one more day, or tear down everything you've built. You'll never get absolute certainty, only clues to piece together: a fever, a shifting gaze, a night that's too quiet.

Manage. Build. Doubt everything.

- Run your farm day by day — food, water, repairs, no HUD: everything is read straight from the environment, like a real survivor's home

- Interrogate every visitor before opening your door and your community to them, never with full certainty

- Build a living community — up to 6 residents, each with their own tasks, skills, and maybe secrets

- Send out expeditions to find what your farm can't provide, at the cost of fatigue and risk

- Live through every night on edge — keep watch, listen in, or sleep blind: the price of rest can be steep

- Never trust a single screen — the television is your only window to the outside world, and it doesn't always tell the truth

A horror you feel more than you see

90s atmosphere, painterly 2.5D visuals, a tone that stays grounded even in the absurd. BROODSAC isn't chasing cheap jump scares: the dread comes from what you think you know about the people you let into your home.

Hold on. Doubt. Decide.

No one will ever tell you who was right. It's on you to live with what you chose to believe.

games.name: United Penguin Kingdom
games.shortDescription: A city-building game where you build a penguin settlement and satisfy the various needs of your penguins while dealing with seals and killer whales. Enjoy the growth of your settlement, become the king, and lead the United Penguin Kingdom.
games.aboutText:
Build your settlement and satisfy the needs of your penguins with better food, elegant decorations, entertainment venues, high-tech coolers, and luxury houses while dealing with killer whales and thief seals.
Design your penguin settlement

Shape a settlement worthy of your penguins. Set up new energy generators to activate more houses, workplaces, and coolers. Build workplaces to produce materials, food, and medicine.
Protect your settlement

Build defense towers against killer whales and thief seals. Killer whales attack your buildings and try to destroy them. Seals come to the food storages to steal food.
Happy and educated penguins

Build some entertainment venues and let your penguins enjoy skating in the ice rinks, watching films at cinemas, playing video games in the game centers, racing in the karting tracks, exercising at gyms and in the fight clubs, visiting the museums, doing yoga, etc. Don't forget to focus on the spirituality of your penguins and increase their happiness with shrines and wishing wells. Focus on education and provide enough seats for your penguins at schools, high schools, and libraries. Make a huddle-up call to gather all your penguins and celebrate together.
Focus on economy

Please be careful with spending your gold and focus on finding ways to earn more. Purchase or make barter to reach rare resources, sell your products to increase wealth, and grow your settlement. If you become the king, you can use continuous trades with the help of your bazaars.
Become the King

Reputation score is the overall evaluation of your settlement in the kingdom. Meet the requirements, improve your reputation, and cheer up your penguins to level up from a village to a king. Become the king to explore new lands, find new settlements, and decide their joining approval to the kingdom.

games.name: United Penguin Kingdom: Huddle up
games.shortDescription: This free version of the United Penguin Kingdom covers the content from one year of in-game time. A city-building game where you build a penguin settlement and satisfy the various needs of your penguins while dealing with seals and killer whales.
games.aboutText:
Build your settlement and satisfy the needs of your penguins with better food, elegant decorations, entertainment venues, high-tech coolers, and luxury houses while dealing with killer whales and thief seals.
Design your penguin settlement

Shape a settlement worthy of your penguins. Set up new energy generators to activate more houses, workplaces, and coolers. Build workplaces to produce materials, food, and medicine.

Focus on education and provide enough seats for your penguins at schools, high schools, and libraries. Make a huddle-up call to gather all your penguins and celebrate together.
