Become the King

Reputation score is the overall evaluation of your settlement in the kingdom. Meet the requirements, improve your reputation, and cheer up your penguins to level up from a village to a king. Become the king to explore new lands, find new settlements, and decide their joining approval to the kingdom.

games.name: Snowman Story
games.shortDescription: Bundle up and get cozy with this warm winter tale about one snowman's journey to the North Pole. Can he make it there before spring arrives?
games.aboutText:
This is the story of a snowman named Chris.

Brought to life one cold winter's day by a lonely boy in need of a playmate, Chris is content with his simple existence. But when a cackling crow reveals to him one night that he'll melt away as soon as the weather warms, Chris must embark on a long journey to a paradise far to the north, where it's said that snowmen can survive even the coming of spring.

Along the way, he'll encounter a host of friendly woodland critters who'll guide him on his trek, and help him tackle tricky ice puzzles whenever things get slippery. (Note that these puzzles are fully skippable for players who just want to enjoy the story!)

He'll also come across other snowmen who tried but failed to make the very same pilgrimage, and gain the ability to read the memories embedded in their melted remains. Hopefully, by learning how they met their tragic ends, Chris can avoid the same fate.

After all—what meaning can there possibly be in a life that lasts but a single winter?

A wintertime tale of warmth and friendship that'll surely melt your heart, Snowman Story is the perfect game to curl up with by the fire this (or any) holiday season.

games.name: Gate of Torment
games.shortDescription: Gate of Torment is a top-down 2D hardcore dungeon crawler extraction shooter, where you are seeking a way to escape Hell. Armed with guns and black magic, you raid dark and dangerous dungeons by using a mysterious portal device.
games.aboutText:
Raid, explore and grind handcrafted dungeons by using the mysterious portal device 'Gate of Torment', searching for loot and Dungeon Keys to unlock new dungeons.

Slay demons and cultists by wielding firearms and black magic. Challenging and unique combat gameplay with 8-directional aiming that rewards tactical positioning and patience, but also fast reactive play when things get hot.

Extract back to your Hideout to store the loot you've found. In The Hideout you can replenish, modify your loadout and choose what dungeon to raid next.

If you're interested in early PLAY-TESTING or otherwise want to support and follow the development, please join the Discord server! Discord link in the sidebar ->

games.name: Duck Detective: The Secret Salami
games.shortDescription: Solving crime is no walk in the pond. You are a down-on-his-luck detective who also happens to be a duck. Use your powers of de-duck-tion to inspect evidence, fill in the blanks, and bust the case wide open! This is a short but twisty detective case.
games.aboutText:
Aggretsuko meets Return of the Obra Dinn in Duck Detective, a cozy mystery game about a down-on-his-luck duck searching for answers in a sinister sausage-based conspiracy.

Join the Duck Detective on his latest, greatest case:

Inspect and interview suspects to learn their hidden secrets, then use the information you’ve gathered (plus your own de-duck-tive reasoning) to locate the suspect and bust the case wide open!

- A 2-3 hour long mystery game!

- Interview suspects, fill in the blanks and crack the case!

- Fully voice-acted!

- Throw bread to the fine beak of lady justice!

- Judge everyone on first impressions, just by looking at them really, really hard! Get them to admit things by staring! Do ducks blink? You don’t.

games.name: The Legend of Lumina
games.shortDescription: A block pushing puzzle game with metroidvania style progression, set in a serene forest world.
games.aboutText:
Explore an ancient forest, push blocks to solve puzzles, and search for a way to end the curse on your land.



The Legend of Lumina is a sokoban style puzzle game with non-linear progression. It's inspired by early Zelda games, with an emphasis on puzzle solving instead of combat.



There are ~50 areas to explore, with nearly all having puzzles, many of which can be solved in different ways.

games.name: Arcane Eats
games.shortDescription: A roguelike deckbuilder with a delicious twist. Think like a master chef, balancing resources as you strategically combo ingredients to subdue hungry hordes. Recruit a legendary kitchen crew, and rise through the heroic cooking guilds—before The Hunger consumes us all!
games.aboutText:
The path to a demon’s heart is through its stomach

In Arcane Eats, the best deck-building mechanics get spiced up by cooking elements to add a new depth of flavor and strategy! Every turn is a strategic puzzle as you balance your energy and ingredient cook times, and try to keep your cool in the face of customer whims and whining.

→ Play ingredient cards onto enchanted cooktops
→ modify them with a kitchen of magical tools,
→ then serve your meals to the hungry hordes – and get paid!

Improvise fantastical meals like a master chef

Craft your own cuisine deck from hundreds of mythic ingredients, magical kitchen tools, and culinary spells. Then invite your customers to sit at the chef’s table as you cook up an adventurous meal full of juicy combos with the cards you have at hand. Flame broil some Red Dragon Ribs, forge golden delights in the Dwarven Deep Fryer, and draw a salt circle to perform the Happy Hour Ritual. No recipes required!

Survive a restaurant run and earn your fame

Running a restaurant is hard – you’ll have to satisfy hangry customers, balance the books, and keep the health & purity inspector at bay. Improve your menu by shopping in town and recruit a crew of waitstaff and sous chefs to optimize your kitchen. If you can impress legendary chefs like Guy Fairy, Wolfman Puck, and the formidable Gorgon Ramsey, you may finally achieve a coveted 3 Mythril Star rating.

Climb the ranks of the three heroic cooking guilds

Each guild has their own unique cards and style of play. Fire up hearty meals with the Hearth, weave elemental spices with the Grove, and master mise-en-place with the Order – but watch out, you may find yourself tempted to open the forbidden Gastronomicon.

Savor the endless flavor

There’s endless replayability with hundreds of cards, staff, upgrades, and unexpected phone calls making each restaurant run unique. Along the way, you’ll get to know the flavorful regulars. If you can learn how to satisfy each one’s special tastes, you’ll unlock new possibilities in town. And as your restaurant successes grow, you can ring the ancient Dinner Bell to add new challenges – but expect to draw the attention of The Hunger… Never forget, the path to a demon's heart is through their stomach!

games.name: Dead Weight
games.shortDescription: Face the Ancient Gods! Set the sails of your flying pirate ship and embark on a roguelite adventure in the steampunk world of Dead Weight. Explore floating islands in search of loot. Choose a class and enjoy turn-based tactical combat on tiny battlefields where every step matters.
games.aboutText:
A marvelous steampunk adventure awaits you in the roguelite world of Dead Weight . Board a flying ship, stock up on fuel, hire a trusty crew and get ready to explore dangerous islands and fight the Ancient Gods in turn-based combat. Unlock new skills, characters, get stronger and uncover the darkest secrets of this world.

FEATURES

- Face the Ancient Gods
The world is rapidly changing and you will have to change with it. Mighty creatures have risen from their eternal slumber. Will you fight them or follow them in pursuit of forbidden knowledge?

- Enjoy Turn-based Combat
The battlefield is tiny. Think ahead if you want to survive.

- Get Stronger
Upgrade your ship and train the crew. An extensive skill tree, 4 characters with unique gameplay. Combine different equipment to create a build that fits your playstyle.

- Explore the World Full Of Danger
Travel across the skies on your swift ship. Find ancient ruins and uncharted islands scattered across the steampunk world.

games.name: HoloParade
games.shortDescription: Collect your favorite characters, nurture them, and have fun just watching in this hololive fan game! It's a 2D tower defense game that offers depth for dedicated players, strategic elements, and easy enjoyment for casual players.
games.aboutText:
☆Over 100,000 downloads in the first month! Ranked 2nd in sales on Steam Japan!☆ A lively parade with hololive VTubers and mascot characters!

"HoloParade" is a fan game of hololive and the first title to serve as a test case for "holo Indie". Collect, nurture, and enjoy watching your favorite characters! It's a 2D tower defense game that offers depth, strategy, and can also be enjoyed casually.

To hololive fans:
This game is designed for players who enjoy strategy and trial and error, and involves exploring various formations and play styles suited to each stage. With stages featuring a variety of characteristics and characters having their specific strengths and weaknesses, please note that you cannot easily clear all stages with just your favorite characters. With careful character development and strategic gameplay, you can clear stages up to the end credits with a favorite formation, but subsequent high-difficulty stages will require formations tailored to the enemies. Feature 1: Simple Yet Deep, Lively Battles

The basic system is a classic 2D tower defense game where you summon characters from your base and march them forward to destroy the enemy's base to win. While the controls are simple, the gameplay is profoundly deep. With over 65 characters, each possessing a variety of abilities like ally healing support and self-destruct attacks, skillful combination and flexible formation are key to enjoying the game.

Additionally, there's an element inspired by parades called the 'Symphony Effect,' where various effects are activated based on the musical instruments played by the characters in march. This adds further strategic depth to the formation of your parade squad and the order of their summoning.
Feature 2: Comprehensive Development Elements

In addition to leveling up and limit breaking, there is a 'Skill' system that allows you to add special abilities not available through regular development. Since you can add up to three types of skills to each character and select them carefully, you can enjoy a unique development process! Furthermore, since you can reset levels and get a full refund of the coins spent, it allows for more freedom in restructuring formations and character development.
Feature 3: No Gacha Purchases, No Stamina System

The scout gacha, which allows you to acquire characters, can be used by consuming tickets obtained within the game, with no additional purchases required. Also, as there is no stamina system, you are not bound by time and can play as much as you like, whenever you like.

Moreover, the scout gacha allows you to choose from two randomly selected character candidates, enabling players to make selections based on their strategy or preference rather than leaving it entirely to chance.
Feature 4: Take a Break with Various Talents and Mini-Games in the Office

When you return to the office, the home screen, you'll be greeted by newly recorded voice lines from Harusaki Nodoka, a staff member of hololive. In the office, talents from hololive may also make appearances, and you might witness some unexpected interactions.

Additionally, mini-games with gameplay entirely different from the main story have been implemented. These games allow you to collect coins necessary for character strengthening. For now, the mini-games titled "Hurry Up! Miko-Chi!" and "Dancing Subaru" are available. In "Hurry Up! Miko-Chi!", Sakura Miko (a VTuber affiliated with Hololive), who has overslept, dashes at full speed towards her destination while avoiding obstacles.

This game is published under CCMC Corp(※1)'s Indie game brand "holo Indie".(※2)
This game is allowed to be monetized under the examination and terms of "holo Indie".
Please note that any monetized derivative work games that include Cover Corp.'s content outside of holo Indie is not covered by these terms and is not allowed.

※1. About CCMC Corp.
CCMC Corp. is entrusted with website management (ex: steam) including, examination, publishing and other necessary tasks by Cover Corp.

※2. About "holo Indie"
holo Indie's objective is to cooperate with hololive production fans and creators.
It is a game brand that offers "Game Creator Support Program" for the derivative work games.
For more details about "holo Indie", Please refer to the Cover Corp.'s "Derivative work guidelines".

games.name: Beyond the Curtains
games.shortDescription: "Beyond the Curtains" is a cozy idle game. Watch a town, train journey, or graveyard through a window. Click to interact, press "nap" to move time, or simply observe. No tutorials, no goals—witness changes across three themes and piece together their stories.
games.aboutText:
"Beyond the Curtains" is a cozy game about watching the world through a window.

No tutorials. No quests. No goals to chase.

Poke at anything on screen—the hourglass, passersby, objects in the room—and see what happens. Or do nothing at all, just watching people go by.

Like an aimless stroll with no destination in mind. Until one day, you notice something has quietly changed.

"Even so, the ordinary world keeps turning." Sometimes, just realizing this is enough to bring peace.

At Your Own Pace

Time only moves forward when you press the "nap" button. No rush, no FOMO—we don't want you to feel hurried.

Linger in a single moment as long as you like, or skip ahead to whenever you please. The view outside changes with time, and so does the room itself. Perhaps you'll piece together fragments of the room owner's story...?

Three Themes to Explore

After a long development journey, we've prepared three themes for you

The Last Leaf : Heartwarming daily life in a small town.

Scenic Tour : Travel by train through beautiful landscapes, accompanied by local delicacies.

Gravekeeper : A resting place for souls, where emotions linger at life's end.

Little Touches

There's a music player in the room—tune into whichever station you prefer. The interface hides in subtle places, keeping buttons minimal and immersion high.

Here's a window that's always sunny, just for you :)

games.name: Shanshui Haven
games.shortDescription: "Shanshui Haven" is a casual city-building game, offering a relaxing and engaging experience with strategic elements.
games.aboutText:
Why Made This Game:

* Craving the fun of city building without the burden of remembering complex building functions.
* Busy with work and study, unable to devote long hours to extensive games.
* A pure building experience, without dealing with the daily issues of virtual citizens.

《Shanshui Haven》 is a casual building placement game, every player can easily engage and enjoy the joy of building towns. Game Features:

* Randomly Generated Grid Map: Every game is a brand new challenge, bringing you endless exploratory fun.
* Strategic Building Placement: Choose the right locations to place buildings, maximize your population score, and showcase your strategic wisdom.
* Diverse Buildings: Each building has its unique footprint and scoring rules; use them flexibly to build your dream city.
* Ancient Chinese-style Architecture: Feel as if you are immersed in a flowing ancient Chinese scroll.
2 Game Modes:

* Casual Mode: Perfect for players looking to relax and unwind. A stress-free experience where you can take your time and enjoy the game at your own pace.
* High Score Mode: For those seeking to step up their game and tackle some tough scenarios. Test your skills and strategy in a more demanding setting.

Do not buy this game if you are:
* A hardcore city-building enthusiast
* Looking for a multiplayer gaming experience
* Expecting an epic storyline
* Interested in conquest and combat elements
* A severe OCD sufferer

Consider buying this game if you:
* Enjoy a relaxed and pleasant gaming atmosphere
* Like games that are easy to pick up and addictive
* Are mildly OCD-friendly
* Willing to support a couple of indie game developers for a coffee's price

In the game, you need to cleverly layout buildings and consider their interactions with each other. As your score steadily climbs, the level of your town will also gradually increase, unlocking new maps filled with challenges. At this point, you can continue to build your town, enhancing its level and unlocking more buildings. The game ends when there are no more plots or buildings that can be placed on the map. At that moment, you can proudly admire your architectural masterpiece, feeling the fruits of your wisdom and effort.

Small Tips:
* Sometimes, for the sake of potentially higher scores in the future, you might need to adopt long-term strategies rather than the best immediate options. Your patience and wisdom will be rewarded throughout the game's progress.
* Although the game itself is not competitive, you can compare your scores with players worldwide and experience more challenges and fun by viewing the player leaderboard.

After unlocking the new town, you can also choose to continue building it to achieve a higher score. Keep going until you run out of plots or buildings, and then take a look at the town you've meticulously crafted.

Inspired by the following games:
Minesweeper
Islanders
Tetris
Civilization

games.name: Slimes & Dusters TO
games.shortDescription: Lead an army of slimes on the offensive against the dusters that have invaded your planet and restore your home to its former glory in this Tower Offense game!
games.aboutText:
The planet of slimes was quiet until the dusters came here. Aliens from outer space, they turned blooming fields into a desert, gentle winds into sandstorms, and plants into dust. Gather the slimes and lead them into battle against the invaders. It is up to you to make this planet bloom again! Key features:

- Build slime squads using factories and send them into battle

- Collect the gel of fallen slimes and reuse it

- Improve your own factories and slimes between attacks

- Research new upgrades between battles

- Each type of slime is special, plan a wise strategy to overcome the enemy

games.name: Mizi NO!
games.shortDescription: In this free 2D puzzle game, you must reassemble broken objects that your cat has knocked over.
games.aboutText:
We love cats! They are simply the best.
But let's be honest: These little rascals can also drive you crazy!

You are sitting relaxed on the couch and see from the corner of your eye that your cat jumps on the table, on which there is also a glass of water. They approach curiously and push the glass closer to the table's edge with their paw. No matter how often you say NO, they push it over the edge, making "clink"....

Mizi NO! is about putting together the shards the beloved cat left behind. Sort and rotate the shards and reassemble the whole in classic puzzle style.

KEY FEATURES

- Handcrafted Puzzles
Handcrafted puzzles to tickle your brain and help you recover from a stressful day.

- Simple Controls
The game can be played by just clicking the left and right mouse buttons, which makes it very accessible for newcomers or seasoned puzzlers of any age.

- Relaxing Music
Mizi NO! has calming music - perfect for a relaxing puzzle session!

games.name: Ballads of Hongye: REBORN
games.shortDescription: 《东方：平野孤鸿》是一款休闲、轻度的“国风造景”游戏。游戏中包含大量细节精美的国风建筑，还原了许多祖国的大好河山和人文景观，你将沉浸在古建筑的精致美学和壮阔的东方情怀之中，并由此打造出自己心中独一无二的、充满东方韵味的古代盛世。
games.aboutText:
《东方：平野孤鸿》是一款休闲、轻度的“国风造景”游戏。

与《纪元1800》、《天际线》以及《庄园领主》等诸多优秀的模拟经营游戏不同，我们并没有设计非常严谨的经营逻辑与物流机制，而是将主要精力集中在造景方面，为此，我们制作了大量细节精美的国风建筑，并在场景中还原了许多祖国的大好河山和人文景观，此外，我们还加入了一点点轻度的经营玩法，请不要担心，它们的存在仅仅是为了让你的世界看起来更加生动鲜活。王小波先生曾在万寿寺一书中写道：“一个人只拥有此生此世是不够的，他还应该拥有诗意的世界。”，说得真好，而这也正是我们的初衷，希望大家可以凭借这些元素，在平野孤鸿的世界中打造出自己心中独一无二的、充满东方韵味的古代盛世。

亲爱的朋友，欢迎你来到鸿野县。

聚宝模式：

你需要通过合理经营获得更充裕的资金，以此来购买新地块扩大建造面积，在这个过程中，你可以抛开一些不必要的生存压力，安心地享受建造城市的快乐。

桃花源模式：

你将前往神奇的桃花源，这里没有任何生存顾虑，你完全可以安心地享受建造城市带来的快乐。同时，你还可以移山填海、劈地开河，打造独属于你的世外盛景，山川万物、镜花水月皆由你来掌控。

games.name: Godrop
games.shortDescription: One level of warning, cosmic droplet rampage! A roguelike game featuring impact piercing. Collect holy relics, build up your energy, and morph the droplets to invade the solar system and destroy the ignorant human fleet to the ground!
games.aboutText:
A special roguelike game that focuses entirely on ramming, piercing, and spraying as the core gameplay. You will play as Gotrop, a powerful unknown alien invasion weapon, facing the layers of barriers set up by the arrogant and ignorant humans in the solar system, using good movement and killing to steal the energy of human warships, driving our strong interaction force outer armor for invincible transformation, and destroying all the enemies in our way with incredible maneuverability and invulnerable ramming ability!

A combat system focused on energy. Just by being in motion you can generate a constant stream of energy, and mysterious alien technology also allows Gotrop to steal energy directly from his enemies. There is energy can be transformed into an invincible droplet state, invulnerable and unbreakable, our enemies can not cause any damage to us, but we can directly puncture the inside of their battleships havoc!

A large number of tech components have been beamed into the solar system, and Gotrop can access tech for morphing upgrades simply by cleaning up the battlefield! Whether it's a drill that can drill into enemy ships faster, outer armor that can reflect all attacks, or a spout that spews bullets, they can be acquired after sweeping through the enemy!

The solar system has been fortified by humans and is in crisis. Gotrop will break through layers of asteroids, energy stands and turret arrays until he completely destroys the human space fleet and takes over Earth!

games.name: For Sale
games.shortDescription: The year is 1998. Step into the shoes of a real estate agent, tasked with photographing a seemingly ordinary house for an upcoming sale. Explore the environment, use your camera to take pictur-- wait, what’s that in the last photo?
games.aboutText:
"Just another job. Shouldn't be too complicated."

FOR SALE is a first-person horror adventure game with a strong emphasis on atmosphere and exploration. Interact with objects, take pictures using your digital camera, and discover unnerving secrets all while exploring a seemingly normal house.

FEATURES

- A short and immersive exploration experience;

- Interact with objects, furniture, read notes and solve puzzles;

- Hidden collectibles, achievements and multiple endings;

- A nostalgic atmosphere inspired by PSX/PS2-era visuals, with handcrafted assets.

DISCLAIMER

FOR SALE is intended to be played in one sitting.

FOR SALE is best played with headphones on.

FOR SALE contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy.

games.name: Supurr Cat Cafe: Sandwich Rush
games.shortDescription: Stack towering sandwiches with the help of cute cat friends while building up your dream cat cafe. With plenty of hungry quirky customers around, you’ll need to upgrade your cafe, find new cats to help you and up your sandwich game to keep them happy!
games.aboutText:
Stack towering sandwiches with the help of cute cat friends while building up your dream cat cafe. With plenty of hungry quirky customers around, you’ll need to upgrade your cafe, find new cats to help you and up your sandwich game to keep them happy!

Enjoy 2 to 3 hours of arcade style gameplay where you can use the money you make selling delicious sandwiches to buy new ingredients, new customization options and, of course, fun toys and other items for your cat friends!

It’s a Cat Cafe after all

We, cat lovers, all know that each kitty is unique so each one you befriend will add something special to your cafe. Anything from keeping customers happy to helping you make delicious sandwiches!

Up your sandwich game

By upgrading your cafe you’ll be able to add new ingredients to the menu, unlock exciting new combinations and add fun new interactions! Enjoy discovering various unlockables throughout your cat cafe journey!

Hats, Decorations & More

In addition to upgrades you can spend your earnings on new beautiful decorations for your cafe as well as cute accessories for your team of kitties!

The more you know

- Many cats in our game are based on real pets from our lives! 😻

- Similarly, many customers are modeled after our amazing friends and family! ❤

games.name: Elta: Defy All Gods
games.shortDescription: Brawl your way out of corrupted worlds alongside your dragon-god companion in an adrenaline-fueled action-platformer blending free-form melee combat, fluid platforming and sci-fi exploration. Become the champion of your fallen god, Elta.
games.aboutText:
Chosen by your people to seek your lost god, you find yourself stranded on a hostile planet. With no way home, fight your way out alongside your newfound draconic companion. Slam every foe, defeat every god, brawl your way out of each challenge and escape - no matter what stands in your way

Elta: Defy All Gods is an adrenaline-fueled action-platformer from Afterburner Studios, the indie team behind Dreamscaper. Master a blend of free-form melee combat, fluid platforming and sci-fi exploration to embark on a divine mission to restore your god’s powers and save your people.

Engage in dynamic free flow combat and master three martial art stances in explosive group fights. Switch techniques on the fly to shatter enemy defences, build up energy to unleash devastating magic attacks, and dispatch survivors in style with anime-inspired finishers.

Explore three sprawling worlds featuring derelict temples and industrial ruins, all filled with hidden paths, secrets and collectibles. Weave your way across icy cliffs, desert canyons and cloud islands thanks to an evolving traversal toolkit. Flow through challenging courses by chaining double jumps, air dashes, wall runs, and more.

Unlock lethal fighting moves to expand your melee arsenal and find new traversal technology while exploring to reach new heights. As you get more powerful and defeat dangerous foes, Elta will evolve alongside you toward their true form, gaining versatile elemental abilities in the process.

You are a warrior monk hailing from a nomadic civilization, exiled from its home world for centuries. Your mission is paramount: find a place where your people belong. Your only hope is to find Elta, restore their former power and defeat the corrupted gods ruling these decrepit worlds.

games.name: Blood of Rome
games.shortDescription: Lead a Roman legion through enemy hordes in a survivors-like where every level-up adds a new soldier. Evolve your troops, strengthen your general, and build an unstoppable army. Conquer for Rome.
games.aboutText:
Every level-up brings one new soldier into your ranks. You choose their class.

Reinforce the classes you rely on or bring something different to the battlefield. Shape your legion one recruit at a time, and watch your choices become an army fighting at your side.

Claim chests to upgrade every soldier of a chosen class at once or make your general more powerful.

Invest in a class that fills your ranks and feel the difference across your legion. Spread your upgrades among your troops, or claim that power for yourself and lead the charge. Every chest gives you another decision about where your strength should lie.

Act I — Conquest. Lead Rome's legions through Egypt, Gaul, and Greece. Conquer new lands in Rome's name.

Act II — Betrayal. Stripped of your command and condemned to the arena, fight for survival as a gladiator in the Colosseum.

Act III — Rebellion. Escape captivity, raise a rebel army, and march on Rome. Make the man who betrayed you answer for it.

Wage your own war in an additional sandbox mode alongside the main campaign . Lead Romans, Egyptians, Greeks or Gauls , experiment with recruits and upgrades, and build an army that tears through the horde. Your faction. Your army. Your way to survive.

games.name: Aviassembly
games.shortDescription: Build and fly your own airplane! Complete missions to earn money, upgrade your plane, and discover new locations in an open world.
games.aboutText:
Build A Plane

Create your own plane . Balance fuel capacity, weight, speed, cargo space and more. Choose parts carefully to optimize your plane for the desired flight characteristics.

Complete Missions

Test your plane, complete missions, and earn money. You'll need to haul different cargo types, each with unique requirements, so plan your trips carefully and avoid running out of fuel.

Research and Upgrade

Research new parts and improve your designs to fly farther, faster, and carry more cargo. Upgrade your plane to handle bigger missions and explore new areas.

Explore

Explore an open world and find new airports and islands, each offering new challenges to test your plane designs and piloting skills.

Features

- Build your own airplane.

- Takeoff, fly and land your plane with simple controls.

- Explore and discover new biomes, each offering unique challenges and cargo types.

- Transport and sell different cargo types. Each cargo type offers its own unique challenge.

- Get creative in creative mode. Use your infinite resources to build anything you can imagine.

games.name: POOLS
games.shortDescription: Walking simulator. Explore, admire and listen. Uncanny. Relaxing. Unnerving. Eerie. Immersive. No monsters chasing you or jumping at your screen, but can feel oppressive at times by invoking fears of getting lost, the dark, tight spaces and liminal space architecture. Inspired by backrooms.
games.aboutText:
One could say POOLS is like an art gallery where you look around and listen to the sounds. Very few things to accomplish or solve, practically a few mazes. Sometimes POOLS can challenge your navigation skills. But mostly you're just... there.

Note: There are no monsters chasing you or jumping suddenly towards you, but the game can feel oppressive. POOLS plays on fears of getting lost, the dark, and tight spaces.

The game has no user-interface and no dialogue. No background music. Instead, the game uses sounds to make you feel like you're really there. The sounds and echo change depending on the room you're in. Walking in water is slower. All of these things makes the game feel more real and creates a tense atmosphere.

There's no typical story, no characters to meet, and you won't find any notes in game. But as you explore and advance further, you start to notice that the game's world changes around you. Rooms look and feel different. Each chapter has something unique. Constantly you're exploring new places, each with its own kind of mystery.

Base game has six unique chapters, each taking 10 to 30 minutes to play.

POOLS is inspired by a internet phenomenons " Liminal spaces ", " Found footage " and " Backrooms " - specifically " Backrooms Pools " or " Poolrooms ".

One of the original artists behind the Poolrooms concept is Jared Pike .

Other inspirations include:

- Matt Studios : Poolrooms videos from 2022

- Mortain Colors

- Anemoiapolis: Chapter 1 by Andrew Quist

- Kane Pixels : The Backrooms (Found Footage)

🗼🐾 WELCOME TO 100 ASIAN CATS – THE BEST HIDDEN OBJECTS GAME! 🗺️🌸

games.name: Wizdom Academy
games.shortDescription: A 3D builder management sim. You are the Headmaster: build your wizarding academy floor by floor, train students into accomplished wizards, and keep your school alive through mana droughts, staff drama and rival academies. Your school, your rules.
games.aboutText:
Step into the role of Headmaster and build your wizarding academy from the ground up. Design every room, recruit students from across the world, send professors on expeditions, and manage everything from mana reserves to staff ultimatums, all while the Directorium keeps a close eye on your results.

NEW IN 1.0

Full release completes your academy with:

- The Headmaster's Tower, your own tower to raise and enchant

- A refreshed interface: new menus, settings and loading screens, a brand new Learning Tree and new typography across the game

- A full sound pass, with more than 200 new sounds bringing the academy to life

- A cinematic intro narrated by Elara, and a narrated ending for the academies that go all the way

- Better performance, especially on large academies

- A balancing pass: the Directorium's Trust weighs more on your choices, and unpaid teachers and incidents now cost Trust

- 19 languages, now including Traditional Chinese, Thai, Ukrainian, Czech and Hungarian

Stack new floors, place classrooms and corridors, decorate your halls and choose what is taught where. Zoom out and watch your academy take shape: towers, courtyards, lecture halls and secret passages. No two academies look alike, and every layout changes how your school performs.

Recruit students from across the world and watch them grow over time. They come back to study, evolve with each decision you make, and accumulate traits that define who they become. With over 100 unique traits to assign and more than 50 Destinies to unlock, every student follows a different path through your academy.

Watch out for the pranks. Students want to enjoy academy life. The Directorium wants results. Keeping everyone satisfied while answering to their demands is the real challenge, a double pressure that never lets up.

Your students do not just pass through. They come back. You watch them progress from their first lesson to their final exam, make decisions that shape their path, and see the consequences play out over time.

The best graduates stay on as teachers, training the next generation. The faculty you build becomes the backbone of your academy, and the school you shape today produces the wizards of tomorrow.

Gather glyphite, shards and golem cores, earn learning points, and spend them across a comprehensive tech tree with hundreds of upgrades to discover. Every technology you unlock changes how your academy runs: new room types, more efficient staff, deeper student progression.

Meanwhile you answer to the Directorium's emissary, manage your staff's demands, and compete with rival academies for influence in the villages around you. Prioritise the wrong thing and the whole school starts to crack.

Key features:

- Build floor by floor: stack floors, design every room, and make an academy that is truly yours

- Shape every student: guide apprentices from first year to graduation, then keep the best as teachers

- Survive mana crises: droughts, blackouts and worse will test your school’s resilience

- Expand your influence: send professors to distant villages and compete with rival academies

- Manage a living staff: ultimatums, promises, resignations. Your people have demands

- Deal with the Directorium: its emissary travels to your school, inspects it and collects taxes

- Raise the Headmaster's Tower: build it floor after floor and choose a permanent enchantment as it grows

Wizdom Academy is for you if you love:

- Builder and management sims with creative freedom (Timberborn, Spellcaster University, Two Point Campus)

- Growing a community of characters with unique traits, aspirations and Destinies to discover

- Juggling resources, crises and rival schools in a fantasy world

- Building something that feels genuinely yours

games.name: Peggy's Farm
games.shortDescription: Combine the cozy crafting of a farming sim with the satisfying physics of a pachinko game.
games.aboutText:
What happens when a Farmer teams up with a Pirate? A whole new kind of farming game.

Whether you're a Peggle player, a cozy gamer, you won't be able to put it down.

Enjoy the non-stop, ball-bouncing fun of Pachinko mixed with the cozy and satisfying gameplay of farming sims.

Clear out space and collect materials with your pinball cannon . Watering your plants? Use your cannon for that! Taking care of animals? Your cannon does that too!

Get the most out of the day by lining up those trick shot ricochets. Then aim and fire your ball!

Welcome to Bountiful! This small town is vibrant and alive, and there are mysteries to unravel! After a long day of farming call in a little favor with the carpenter or the blacksmith— now you can stop by the sawmill or delve into the mines to mix things up

Take turns shooting - both the Pirate and the Farmer have unique abilities to help the farm.

Keep your eye out for 2-player mode coming soon!

games.name: BRUTALISTICK VR
games.shortDescription: The golden age of violent flash games now in your VR headset. Fully physics based combat with melee and firearms featuring copious amounts of blood, gore and destruction.
games.aboutText:
Imagine the golden age of flash games. Now imagine playing them with a VR headset. BRUTALISTICK VR aims to make that happen with copious amounts of blood, gore, destruction and weapon variety.

Realism does not define this game, the rule of cool does. However, that doesn't mean that realism has no place here. Weapons have weight and must be wielded with the intent to kill if you don't want to meet your demise. Firearms require precise aim to fit the bullet between enemy armor plates... Or just buy a weapon with a caliber that will go through anyone and anything that dares stand in its way, the choice is yours.
Everything is simulated physically, throwing your enemies through windows and off roofs, launching a stake through their torso and pinning them against the wall, slicing their body in half with a blade that's more of a large hunk of iron than a sword, and even climbing and using grappling hooks. Dismemberment is not limited to limbs or even joints, splitting someone's head in half vertically is not a question of if but rather when . Earn rewards to buy new gear or upgrade your stats and skills

Each mission earns you a reward that can then be used to buy new weapons. Or you can upgrade your stats and skills, from simply increasing your health or rewards to lifesteal and the power of your punches. Coat entire levels with the blood of your enemies

Blood never disappears so you can marvel at the carnage you've created.
Unlock new vendors with an entirely different stock

Each vendor has different types of weapons to complement their personality and the levels that they're unlocked from. From farming tools to experimental military armaments, everything is at your fingertips.

games.name: Kelp Keeper
games.shortDescription: Take on a vital role in the ecosystem in this action-packed bullet hell. Control a charming sea otter and protect the kelp forest from an endless onslaught of devious sea critters. Skillfully dodge attacks, grab your prey, and eat them all at the surface for a huge satisfying snack.
games.aboutText:
Become a Sea Otter

Take on a vital role in the ecosystem in this action-packed bullet hell. Control a charming sea otter and protect the kelp forest from an endless onslaught of devious sea critters. Skillfully dodge attacks, grab your prey, and eat them all at the surface for a huge satisfying snack.

Score-Attacking Arcade Fun

Kelp Keeper is a score-based arcade game with multiple levels that can be unlocked after achieving high enough scores on previous levels. Earn more points by eating multiple enemies at the same time!

Sea Food Combo Gameplay

The core gameplay revolves around dodging attacks and hazards while grabbing up enemies in the water, and then bringing them up the surface to eat. This gets a bit more interesting by grab meter mechanic: once the player grabs an enemy, a meter appears above their head indicating how long until they will drop what they are holding. If they do not reach the surface before it expires, they will drop everything. BUT: every time the player grabs another enemy, the meter gets completely reset. This allows the chain together huge combos while staying underwater as long as they are constantly snatching up new prey! Best of all, the bigger the combo, the more points they will score!

Eat Big Combos, Get Big Rewards

Points aren't the only reason to eat big combos. Players will get in-game buffs and abilities for scoring big:

4x Combo: Regen 1HP!

8x Combo: Temporary Speed Boost!

12x Combo: +1 Clambreaker Stock (use whenever you want to crack open a clam on your stomach and make a huge shockwave that clears bullets and stuns nearby enemies)!

16x and above Combo: the rewards start to loop! Never stop eating!

Multiple Game Modes, Multiple Levels:

The game will feature 3 main modes of play across multiple levels:

Arcade mode: Face off against hand-crafted sets of enemy waves uniquely designed for each level. Can you get the high score on each level?

Endless mode: Survive as long you can against endless procedurally-generated waves of enemies that get increasingly harder each wave. How many waves can you beat?

Onslaught mode: The ultimate otter challenge. 9 waves over 5 randomly selected levels with remixed enemies and ending on a boss.

Multiple Characters:

Unlock new otters to play as by completing levels in the arcade mode. Each otter has unique stats and benefits.

games.name: BLADECHIMERA
games.shortDescription: Explore a dark and sinister Osaka as the Demon Hunter Shin. Battle demons, regain lost skills, and uncover the truth of your forgotten past in this exciting occult-inspired cyberpunk metroidvania.
games.aboutText:
You are Shin, a demon hunter with no memory of his past. After striking an unusual partnership with Lux, a demon with the ability to shapeshift into a sword and manipulate time, you begin a quest to learn what happened to you and your loved ones. Fight brutal battles against terrible demons. Explore a corrupted and dangerous world. Regain what was once yours.

Gameplay Overview
The Demon Sword, Lux, offers a wide array of utilities. Not only can she perform powerful attacks and shield you from harm, but she can also act as a platform and restore objects from the past. Use your demonic companion to survive in a desolate, demon-ridden Osaka.

As Shin defeats demons and levels up, new skills can be unlocked via the skill tree. Unlock the "Warp" skill to travel anywhere on the map or the double-jump skill to get up to higher ledges and explore new locations with ease.

But Lux isn't the only weapon in your arsenal. In addition to firearms, Shin can also wield weapons such as greatswords and whips. Experiment with a variety of armaments and create your own style of combat.

Enjoy the latest metroidvania from Team Ladybug, the team behind such acclaimed titles as "Touhou Luna Nights" and "Record of Lodoss War: Deedlit in Wonder Labyrinth."

Explore a map far larger than past Team Ladybug projects, filled with side quests that both deepen your connection to and expand upon the world of "Blade Chimera."

The Story
It all began with the sudden appearance of a ghastly demonic horde. Humans fought against ghouls and ghosts in what would later be known as the "Demon War," and the world was changed forever.

Thirty years later, using their expertise in combating demons, a religious group called the "Holy Union" has carved out a small but stable enclave of survivors.

games.name: Beltmatic
games.shortDescription: Beltmatic is a casual factory game where you combine numbers using mathematical operations.
games.aboutText:
Beltmatic is a game where you build mathematical factories.

- Extract numbers from the map

- Construct buildings that perform mathematical operations

- Lay down an expansive belt network

- Deliver numbers to hub to reach the next level

- Build new production lines and reuse old ones

- Unlock new buildings and upgrade them.

- Expand your factory across a huge map

games.name: Decrepit
games.shortDescription: Decrepit is a first-person action game with souls-like combat where every death drags you back into the depths. Learn the dungeon, master the combat, and find your way out of the forsaken castle.
games.aboutText:
Decrepit is a first-person action game with souls-like combat about fighting your way out of a forsaken castle. Every death strips your gear and drags you back to the dungeons, restarting in a different cell each time.

Your only advantages are the knowledge you gain from each attempt and whatever gear you can loot from the undead. Learn the castle and its inhabitants well enough, and what once felt impossible becomes manageable.

Stamina-Based First-Person Combat

Combat is about positioning, timing, and reading enemy telegraphs. Each weapon has distinct attack patterns - light attacks, heavy strikes. Spells slot naturally into melee openings for strategic combinations. Manage your stamina, read patterns, and exploit openings. Mistakes are punished.

Master the Castle

Each run begins in a different cell. Memorize winding corridors, unlock elevators that stay active, and discover passages that shorten your route. Learn which threats might appear where. Early runs feel endless. Later, you're heading straight for the boss that stopped you last time. The castle compresses as you learn it.

Equipment Defines Your Build

You can carry one weapon, one staff, and one armor piece. These three slots define your playstyle. Find matching gear from the same archetype - Mage, Warrior, Rogue, or Shaman - and unlock set bonuses and unique abilities. Every slain enemy drops their gear. Adapt to what you find, or commit to hunting down a complete set.

A Decaying Medieval Prison

From suffocating dungeons to rain-soaked courtyards, fight your way up through interconnected areas. Prisoners still wear their chains. Guards still patrol their posts. The world is oppressive and unforgiving, but it follows rules. No maps. No quest markers. Just you and a castle that waits to be understood.

Features:

- Stamina-based first-person combat with melee and magic

- Challenging boss fights guard each new area

- Equipment-based class system with set bonuses

- Interconnected castle layout designed for mastery

- Rare permanent upgrades are hidden throughout

- Variable enemy encounters in a persistent world

- Dark medieval atmosphere with no hand-holding

- Full controller and mouse + keyboard support

- Singleplayer

games.name: Dark Lessons
games.shortDescription: Trapped in your teacher's home, your only defense against the dark is a flickering candle. Unearth a family’s twisted history and solve puzzles in this Lovecraftian nightmare to find a way out. But be warned: Something else is lurking in the shadows ... and a voice is pleading for your help.
games.aboutText:
Afterschool Class Is in Session—and the Curriculum Is Deadly.

You thought Mrs. Glower was just your biology teacher. But when she invites you into her home, the lesson takes a terrifying turn. A sudden blackout plunges the house into darkness, leaving you trapped in claustrophobic chambers where the only thing between you and the unknown is a single candle.

Illuminate the Truth

With the house swallowed by shadows, every flicker reveals a new nightmare. Peer into the darkness to find what you need to get out, but remember—some things are better left unseen.

Arcane Investigations

This house is a tomb for secrets that were never meant to be unveiled. Use classic point-and-click logic in a 3D environment to examine your surroundings and piece together the tragic history of the Glower family. Discover the remnants of a master’s failed experiments and decipher the truth behind your invitation. But be careful what you unearth—some lessons demand a price that can only be paid in blood.

Survival Has a Price

You are not alone. As strange phenomena warp the reality around you, a dormant horror begins to stir. Something malevolent is hiding in the dark, a relic of a ritual gone wrong. Now, you must navigate the shadows while a desperate voice pleads for help. Will you answer the call?

Features:

- Haunting low-poly aesthetic that evokes the golden age of psychological horror.

- Lovecraftian depth: A plot-driven experience inspired by cosmic lore.

- Classic adventure mechanics: First-person exploration meets inventory-based puzzle solving.

- A focused experience: Designed to be played in a single sitting (ca. 1.5 hours).

- Pick up where you left off: Autosave system ensures your progress is kept safe—even if you aren't.

- Adaptive Soundscape: Atmospheric sound featuring original tracks keeps you on the edge of your seat.

- Accessibility Features: Fully customizable experience with FOV sliders, gamma settings, and toggleable head bob.

- Modern Compatibility: Play with remappable controls for mouse and keyboard, controller or your Steam Deck.

- Localization: Subtitles in English, German, Spanish, Japanese and Simplified Chinese

Love What You See?

Add Dark Lessons to your Wishlist to stay updated on the ritual’s progress!

games.name: GLITCH DADDY
games.shortDescription: You have a strange dream where you meet a creature named Glitch Daddy, telling you that the world is ending very soon. Then, you wake up and go to unravel the truth through a wild, abstract psychedelic journey.
games.aboutText:
What's that sound coming from the basement....?

GLITCH DADDY

is the new fever dream of a game by Sad Mask Party , the twisted brains behind Mango and The Lotus Holidays . It is a surreal, elusive, highly immersive and just slightly distorted tale of mystery, friendship, romance, solitude, trying and failing, overcoming obstacles, and all around, love .

It is presented as a first person adventure, featuring atmospheric exploration , puzzles, some fun action sequences and fights , interactive dialogue, deconstructed psychology, dreamy psychedelia , a big variety of off-beat characters , terminally weird vibes and an equal mixture of horror(ish) and humorous elements . The graphics are PS1-inspired, but with a healthy dose of surrealism and liminality.

The story starts through a dream where you meet Glitch Daddy , a strange creature informing you about the world's end coming really, really soon . You go on to wake up, and embark on a wild journey where the truth will be revealed, through a series of weird , unexpected twists and turns.

Drenched in a thick vibe of nostalgia , Glitch Daddy seamlessly jumps from the memories of an idealized childhood, to a complicated adulthood, and the cosmic, deconstructed dreamscapes of a timeless oblivion.

Also, you get to kill monsters and pet doggos. ;)

games.name: 真夜的居所 - Chanye's Home
games.shortDescription: Lam ChoTung, who runs a maid cafe in Shenzhen, discovered a girl sitting unconscious on the ground at the storefront as she prepared to return home from the shop. This girl not only had unclear consciousness but was also dressed in peculiar maid attire. This is a love story about these two girls.
games.aboutText:
"Chanye's Home" is a visual novel-style game. Lam ChoTung, who runs a maid cafe shop in Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, China, discovers a girl sitting unconscious at the storefront on Halloween night as she prepares to close the shop. This mysterious girl not only has unclear consciousness but is also dressed in peculiar maid attire.

"Where does the girl come from?"

"Why is she suddenly lying in front of the shop?"

Despite the girl's unknown origin, ChoTung decides to take her in and provide shelter in her own home.

Thus begins the cohabitation with a maid from another world.

​​

[Game features]

Yuri (Lesbian)

Shenzhen citizens may find it familiar

Fans of otherworldly themes may find it intriguing

​​[Contact us]

Weibo: 柚原堂

BILIBILI: 柚原堂

Twitter: 柚原堂

Lilymagic: 柚原堂

For relevant information and inquiries, please contact us primarily through our Weibo/Bilibili accounts.

​​[Appreciation]

"Chanye's home" is 柚原堂 (YauYuenTong) 's third work. (We changed our name from "GouLauTong" to "YauYuenTong.")

Our second work, "Fleeting Summer's end" received positive reviews from many players.

Before the release of FSE, we were full of anxiety.

The results, be it the game's rating or the peripheral sales, though not outstanding, were much better than we initially anticipated.

We believe that Yuri (lesbian) games have a certain "public good" nature.

Like how anyone can freely use a "library" as a "public good," now, anyone can watch our works on platforms like Bilibili, and anyone can even download our works from some pirated game sites.

All narrative-focused works (including but not limited to Anime, Comic, Games, Novel) seem to have become something with a certain "public good" nature, whether the authors are willing or not.

Even so... just as many people are willing to pay taxes or donate to the government for the construction of libraries, many Yuri players are willing to consume our works to support our continued creation.

Therefore, the support of these players is very, very precious for us.

In the past year or so, the members of the production team have been busy and mentally exhausted due to their real-life responsibilities.

2023 has been a special year for us, and the time and energy we can invest in the new game production have become even less.

However, because of your support for "Tinheung & Sayuri" and "Fleeting Summer's End," because of your expectations for our new work, "Chanye

s home" was born under extremely difficult circumstances.

It's because of you that this work exists.

Thank you very much!

Although the overall quality of the work is inevitably limited by our time and money we believe that within a certain timeframe, using extremely limited resources, we have tried our best to tell the story of the encounter between Lam ChoTung and Lam Chanye.

Of course, there are inevitably some regrets in the work. If possible, please criticize us with gentleness.

The estimated playtime for this work is 2-3 hours.

If all goes well, we will start producing a work with a higher scale and playability. This not only requires a significant amount of time and effort from us but also relies on your support and encouragement.

Hope to see you in the next work!

Thank you!

多謝！

[Updated June 30, 2025]

We have added an English version.

English translation: redsh & friend. Thank you!

games.name: GRIDROAD
games.shortDescription: GRIDROAD is a traffic optimisation puzzle/simulation game. Build roads, place road markings and tweak traffic lights to build the most efficient traffic junction!
games.aboutText:
GRIDROAD is a traffic optimisation puzzle/simulation game. Build roads, place roadsigns and tweak traffic lights to build the most efficient traffic junction!

Remember that time you were stuck in traffic for the umpteenth time at that idiotically designed junction? Remember how you swore you could have designed a better intersection in your sleep? Well look no further, GRIDROAD is the game for you!

games.name: Journey of Realm：Dawn Dew
games.shortDescription: "JOR: Dawn Dew" is a 2D turn-based game with a box-like map. In the game, act "Dew" to adventure. On adventure, collect and freely choose your way of fighting. As the exploration progresses, deter the threat of the black beast tide, and finally defeat the monstrous malice.
games.aboutText:
「Persisting in kindness, some people say it is absurd and dismiss it; But in the Realm where wedge energy and will intertwine, it brought us you and rally you.」

As a kind soul that comes to the realm, begins a journey of redemption in the realm of the raging tide of black beasts.

「When greed and violence destroy the nameless flower, we know why the Dawn Dew comes......」

In the process of continuous progress, discover the history of the realm and uncover the truth of the Black beast tide.

Explore box style maps with designs, collect various resources in the scene, and make yourself stronger.

Don't worry about boring lost time. You have clear map guidance and can teleport at any time.

Free to form your combat style

Collect nearly a hundred skills, experiences, props, dozens of postures, and support units to freely explore, form, and integrate combat methods.

Use a posture to change the attributes and combat style of Dew, and establish your combat style;

Use self assembling skills to strike enemies and enrich your combat strategy;

Reasonably matching experiences to maximize their effectiveness, even becoming the core of the battle;

Props provide attribute bonuses and can be actively used; Props will not be consumed, only have a limit on the number of uses (which can be restored)

Summon support to assist in combat. Once properly matched, support can also become the main force in combat.

Extra combat modes

In Counterattacking enemies in traditional turn based systems - as long as the technical level is sufficient, it will be the best weapon for defeating the strong with the weak;

(Counterattack exists as a posture mechanism, and even if you never use it, it does not affect the gaming experience. All other turn based elements are waiting for you to explore.(This commitment only applies to normal and simple difficulty levels))

AI Content Description

This game is handcrafted by a solo developer, no any AI Content

games.name: Halcyon Days at Taoyuan
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Taoyuan Village to heal your loneliness. Here, you can lead a carefree, self-sufficient life: farm, tame animals, raise livestock, fish, and build a prosperous homestead. Or, immerse in village life, meet kindred spirits, find love, and influence their destinies with your choices.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Taoyuan Village to heal your loneliness.

Here, you can lead a carefree, self-sufficient life: farm, tame animals, raise livestock, fish, and build a prosperous homestead.

Or, immerse in village life, meet kindred spirits, find love, and influence their destinies with your choices.

Whether it's the labor you put in or the relationships you cultivate, every drop of sweat you shed will bear fruit. In Taoyuan Village, no effort goes unrewarded.

There are nine major occupations: farming, forestry, animal husbandry, fishing, tailoring, cooking, construction, mining, or martial arts. Which one do you want to excel in?

Upgrade your house, furnish it with decorations, and create your ideal countryside compound. "Where the heart finds peace is home."

Befriend wild creatures—train them as assistants or keep them as companions. The world may be frayed, but little paws mend it stitch by stitch. (And yes, those with hooves or wings count too!)

The villagers may be few, but each has a past, a story, and their own flaws and virtues—just like real people. Treat them with sincerity, and their attitudes toward you will change. You might even alter the course of their lives.

Experience vibrant festivals—Spring Festival, Qingming, Dragon Boat, Mid-Autumn—along with grand Chinese-style weddings . Immerse yourself in the most traditional Chinese flavor.

games.name: Minami Lane
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Minami Lane! Build your own street in this tiny cozy, casual management sim! Unlock and customize buildings, manage your shops, and maximize the happiness of your villagers to complete quests and fill your street with love!
games.aboutText:
Minami Lane is a small, wholesome management game set on a Japanese-inspired street. Create and manage your own street, make sure everyone is happy, and watch the villagers live their lives! Enjoy 2 to 4 hours of playtime, cute tanukis and lots of cats!

Build your street

Build homes to add villagers to your street, then improve their happiness by beautifying every inch and building a variety of shops & attractions! These include ramen shops, boba cafes, bookstores and more, each with unique inventories and effects.

Manage your shops

Attract customers with everything from floral bouquets to karaoke! Shops you create will need your careful guidance to offer the right products at the right prices. Lead them to success and make your neighborhood thrive.

Watch your villagers live their lives

Once you start the day, you'll get to see each villager react to your street and offer helpful feedback on how to improve! Memorize their preferences and refine your street the following day.

Reach your objectives

Complete missions to unlock new levels with more buildings, villager types, and other surprises.

What Minami Lane offers:

- 2-4 hours of play time

- Create and customize your own adorable street

- Manage shops by adjusting their inventory, recipes, and prices

- Play strategically to complete each level's mission objectives

- Keep the streets clean by picking up trash

- Tanukis and cats!

What Minami Lane does not offer:

- Hardcore strategy

- Multiplayer

- Tons of missions

- New levels after release

In Minami Lane's missions, you'll need to strategically plan each day and use elements such as random events to your advantage to complete multiple objectives.

The sandbox mode focuses on creativity and relaxation, allowing you to immerse yourself in the peaceful, cozy world without the stress of objectives.

Minami Lane is the collaborative effort of Dorian (Doot), Doriane (Blibloop) and Antoine (Zakku). Doot, a former data scientist turned game developer, brings light strategy and management gameplay, while Blibloop breathes life into the isometric world with her Studio Ghibli-inspired, hand-drawn designs. Zakku adds the finishing touches with joyful, wholesome music compositions and soundscape. We really hope you will enjoy this tiny game we made with love 💕

games.name: Chromatic Isle
games.shortDescription: Discover the peaceful beauty of Chromatic Isle, a 30-minute getaway where music and puzzles unite in the four seasons. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or new to puzzles, this harmonious journey awaits. Unveil the secrets of each season in Chromatic Isle.
games.aboutText:
About This Game

Embark on a serene journey through the musical realms of Chromatic Isle, a short 30-minute low-poly 3D puzzle game intended to be completed in one sitting. Explore four distinct areas, each themed around a different season and offering a unique music-focused puzzle. Unwind and let the music guide your way.

Key Features

Winter, Spring, Summer, Autumn : Traverse through four enchanting seasons, each with its own distinct charm and puzzle inspired by the season's theme.

Harmonious Puzzles : Engage in a variety of music-centric puzzles that immerse you in the melodic ambiance of Chromatic Isle.

Non-Linear Design : Enjoy the freedom to roam and choose your own path, creating a non-linear adventure tailored to your preferences.

Low-Poly Aesthetics : The island's tranquil low-poly visuals provide a serene backdrop to your non-linear journey.

Musical Soundscapes : Let the soothing soundtrack accompany you throughout your adventure, enhancing the overall experience.

Chromatic Isle invites you to embark on a non-linear journey through the seasons, where music and puzzles intertwine. Whether you're a seasoned puzzle enthusiast or new to gaming, this adventure offers a peaceful and meditative experience that may have you scratching your head from time to time.

games.name: NOIR BLOOM
games.shortDescription: NOIR BLOOM is a high-octane 2D Gun-Fu action game, where adrenaline-fueled gunfights and skull-crushing close combat collide in a neo-noir rhapsody. Embark on a deadly rampage to honor the vow—strike, disarm, and turn foes into weapons. Every move is a calculated ballet of bullets and blood.
games.aboutText:
"A lone charge into the dragon's den, where gunfire ignites the deadly dance again."

NOIR BLOOM is a high-octane 2D Gun-Fu action game, where adrenaline-fueled gunfights and skull-crushing close combat collide in a neo-noir rhapsody.

NOIR BLOOM SEALS YOUR FATE, AND THERE'S NO ESCAPE

The girl who reignited your fractured humanity has been taken by a ruthless crime lord.

For her, you will become the "White Wraith" once more, to settle the blood debts of your past.

This is not a hero’s tale. It’s Kow Wing’s own bloody verse.

A SPLASH OF RED, A SPLIT SECOND FROM DEATH

Enter the fray with iron fists, seize their guns to turn the tide, counter their attacks and seal their fate.

Choreograph every move in your head, then perform it as a live-fire ballet of bullets and blood.

THE DRAGON'S EYE OF ORIENTIS—A CITY THAT NEVER SLEEPS

Skyscrapers cast long shadows where neon cuts through the night. Sin and desire run rampant in the eastern

metropolis of "Kow Wing."

Sprint through shanties, downtown markets, and opulent towers—waging a blood-soaked battle amidst the vibrant, living pulse of Kow Wing’s streets.

games.name: Where Jellyfish 水母在哪里

games.aboutText:
Search for 100 Jellyfish.
A carefully hand drawn 4K scene filled with cute characters.
The process is short and won't take up too much player time.
You can choose your favorite dyeing for the convenience of color blind players.
Extremely easy to achieve.
Automatically save and read files.

No punishment, easy and enjoyable.
You can play games with family and friends on the same computer, suitable for all ages.

games.name: Pastel☆Parade
games.shortDescription: Pastel☆Parade is an exhilarating rhythm game with easy controls! Get into the rhythm with cute, poppy music!

Pastel☆Parade is an exhilarating rhythm game with easy controls!

Play a comfortable rhythm to the cute and poppy music.

The controls are very intuitive: just press the buttons with the right timing according to the song's beat!

//////////////////////////////////////////////////////

🎵 30 groovy original songs!

Enjoy Pastel☆Parade's catchy, cute, and unique songs!

Some of them can be quite challenging! Each play session only lasts about a minute, so you can try your hand at the songs as many times as you want.

🌟 Fun gameplay! Four bright, poppy characters!

Your rhythm influences how the characters in the game move! Their animations are lots of fun whether you can keep the beat or not!

Challenge yourself to a rhythm adventure with them!

📖 A little story too...?

As you progress through the game, its story is revealed little by little.

The world is divided into four areas, each with a different atmosphere. How far can you go?

//////////////////////////////////////////////////////

Join this fun parade with its cute characters!
