games.name: Tower of the Dragon
games.shortDescription: Tower of the Dragon is a story-driven, turn-based combat RPG. Treasures and secrets lie in the mysterious tower which appeared after the death of a young dragon.
games.aboutText:
Garcharius, the young dragon, is dead.

Tower of the Dragons is a story-driven, turn-based combat RPG. Join your companions and defeat monsters to uncover the secrets of the tower left behind by the dragon!

Suspicious tower and hidden treasures

A tower has emerged after the mysterious death of a mighty dragon.
It is told that whoever conquers the tower will be rewarded with the invaluable treasure the dragon has left behind......
Is this a challenge or just a trap? What is the true purpose of this tower? Strategic battles with a variety of enemies

Each battle has its own unique opponents. No repetitive battles.
Strategize your moves to defeat opponents efficiently! Chibi Characters

Cute characters drawn in chibi art style await you!
(Enemies may not be cute) Beginner Support

Have you ever wished to progress main scenario but stuck at a hard boss fight? Don't worry this time.
If you lose the same battle more than once, you'll be compensated with the best recovery item in the game.

games.name: Notanote
games.shortDescription: Feel the rhythm of the music in the story, and witness their stories in the game!
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the world of Notanote!
Notanote is a rhythm game that emphasizes visual performance.
It blends melody and beat into the visuals, providing an immersive experience of music!

Game Features:
Full Keyboard Judgement
Notanote adopts full keyboard judgement, allowing you to catch notes with any key.
You don’t need to worry about which key corresponds to which note. Just find the rhythm and press the corresponding number of keys.
You can hold down one key to catch all drag notes; When faced with multiple long notes, you only need to press the corresponding number of keys at the beginning, and then keep one key pressed down.

Multiple Difficulty Design
Want to try different performances under the same music? Some tracks have multiple difficulty options, allowing you to choose different difficulty levels according to your needs.

Casual Mode
Feeling too difficult? You can use the casual mode in the settings to get a more relaxed gaming experience.

Collection System
During the process of playing the tracks, you will also obtain collectibles and unlock relevant plots.

games.name: Strange Pong
games.shortDescription: Strange Pong is a classic Pong game with the addition of new game mechanics. This game is a game of tennis, the player controls a racket and must hit the ball. However, each level has its own features that make the game more interesting.
games.aboutText:
Strange Pong is a classic Pong game with the addition of new game mechanics. This game is a game of tennis, the player controls a racket and must hit the ball. However, each level has its own features that make the game more interesting.

Features

- Single-player campaign mode

- Various modifiers that affect gameplay

- Boss fights

- Two-player game mode

- Music in different genres

- Ability to change the game's visuals

games.name: CRUEL
games.shortDescription: A fast run and gun horror shooter with roguelike elements
games.aboutText:
CRUEL drops you into a twisted world. One where you must embrace a demonic entity brought on by well yourself, choose what you truly desire and brace yourself for the horrors ahead.

Survive a Living Nightmare: Battle through 10 dynamic, ever-changing levels filled with bloodthirsty enemies who won’t stop until you’re dead. The building itself is your enemy and it’s trying to consume you.

Run, Fight, and Adapt: Speed is your only ally as you race against a constantly shifting environment. Keep an eye out for cans , which serve as both health boosts and currency for powerful upgrades. Stack them up and unleash a devastating attack when you need it most.

Pulse-Pounding OST: Feel the adrenaline surge with a hard-hitting electronic soundtrack that keeps you on edge. The relentless beats and aggressive synths mirror the intensity of the gameplay, immersing you deeper into the chaotic, surreal world of CRUEL .

A Blast from the Past: Inspired by the adrenaline-pumping classics of FPS and arcade games, CRUEL delivers fast-paced action with a twist of dark humour. It's a nostalgic thrill ride that doesn’t take itself too seriously, offering a fresh experience with a comedic kick.

games.name: 垃圾桶军团
games.shortDescription: The pioneers have been salivating at your trash can for a long time! They have formed a garbage can army and are preparing to launch an attack on your home! Reasonably use your characters to resist the repeated attacks of the Garbage Can Legion! Or...... Join the Garbage Can Legion!
games.aboutText:
This game is a free casual tower defense game.

The pioneers have been salivating at your trash can for a long time! They have formed a garbage can army and are preparing to launch an attack on your home! Reasonably use your characters to resist the repeated attacks of the Garbage Can Legion! Or ...... Join the Garbage Can Legion! Rich characters and enemies!

● 18 available characters, choose characters reasonably to resist enemies!
● Over 30 different enemies, the game will be more challenging!
● Two giant bosses, powerful bosses will make the battle more intense! 42 independent levels!

● 27 standard levels to resist the attack of the Garbage Can Legion!
● 9 attack levels, join the trash can legion!
● Six small game levels, experience different gameplay!
● Two boss battle levels, detonate your adrenaline in a big scene!
● Multiple uniquely designed maps bring you a brand new experience! Random mode

● Using your character card will randomly appear any character, even enemies! This will make your gaming experience full of surprises! Endless mode

● How long can you persist under the relentless attacks of enemies? There is more to it......

games.name: Idlescape
games.shortDescription: Idlescape is an MMORPG combining idle mechanics with RPG elements. Progress continues offline, allowing mastery of skills like Mining, Fishing, and Combat. Engage in crafting, gathering, and strategic battles. Perfect for casual and hardcore gamers alike.
games.aboutText:
Idlescape is an innovative MMORPG that seamlessly blends idle mechanics with deep RPG elements, offering a unique and engaging gaming experience. Whether you're actively playing or away, your character continues to progress, making it ideal for both casual and hardcore gamers. With development taking over seven years we hope you enjoy our game.

Key Features

- Idle Mechanics: Progress continues even when offline, allowing for a flexible playstyle.

- Diverse Skills: Master a variety of skills, including Mining, Foraging, Fishing, Farming, Smithing, Cooking, Crafting, Runecrafting, Enchanting, and Combat.

- Crafting and Gathering: Collect resources and craft items to enhance your gameplay.

- Engaging Combat: Fight a variety of monsters, each with unique challenges.

- Community Interaction: Join the vibrant community on Discord and Reddit, share tips, and stay updated with the latest news.

Gameplay Elements

- Mining: Explore different locations to extract valuable resources.

- Foraging: Gather herbs and natural materials for crafting.

- Fishing: Catch fish for cooking or selling.

- Farming: Cultivate crops and manage your farm for sustainable resources.

- Smithing: Forge powerful weapons and sturdy armor.

- Cooking: Prepare meals to boost your stats and performance.

- Crafting: Create a variety of items to support your adventures.

- Runecrafting: Craft runes that enhance your abilities and skills.

- Enchanting: Apply magical enhancements to your gear to gain an edge in combat.

- Combat: Engage in strategic battles, gain experience, and collect loot from defeated foes.

Regular Updates

The game is actively maintained with frequent updates that introduce new features, balance adjustments, and quality-of-life improvements. We have spent seven years working towards a Version 1.0, which will be the full release with updates happening every one to two weeks after launch.

Community and Support

Become part of the Idlescape community by joining the official Discord and subreddit. Engage with fellow players, share strategies, and get the latest updates directly from the developers.

games.name: Dawnsbury Days
games.shortDescription: Lead a group of childhood friends through their first adventures in a turn-based tactical RPG played under the rules of PF2E, the second edition of a powerful OGL ruleset. Customize their builds, acquire loot, and level up, and ultimately defeat the sinister enemies who threaten your hometown!
games.aboutText:
Dawnsbury Days is a turn-based tactics roleplaying game with cRPG elements that's based on the rules of PF2E, the second edition of a powerful tabletop ruleset originally published under the OGL.

You play as the Dawnsbury Four, a group of four young heroes from a small town. You choose their class, feats, spells, and other abilities as you lead them through a quest to save their home town from a multitude of dangers, and then further adventures beyond.

You will fight monsters and face dangers, yes, but you will also make friends, acquire loot, and level up, and eventually — hopefully — you will defeat whatever sinister force is behind all the dangers that have beset Dawnsbury for the last seven years.

The main adventure can take about 4 hours for a single playthrough (about 13 hours total including expansion follow-up adventures), but you can then replay it with different party compositions and besides the main adventure path, you can also try and defeat some of the powerful foes in additional scenarios in free encounter mode.

Features

- A complex rule system which makes for strong strategic gameplay, highly faithful to the tabletop rules

- Extreme character customization

- 9 ancestries (Dwarf, Elf, Gnome, Goblin, Halfling, Human, Leshy, Oozekin, Orc)

- 17 classes (Alchemist, Barbarian, Bard, Cleric, Druid, Fighter, Champion, Kineticist, Magus, Monk, Oracle, Psychic, Ranger, Rogue, Sorcerer, Strategist, Wizard), each with different play patterns

- 300+ feats and 450+ spells to further customize your characters

- More available through mods

- 20+ encounters in the main adventure path telling a story of childhood friends braving their first serious challenges in adventuring, and 30+ additional scenarios in free encounter mode (more available with the Profane Barrier and Good Little Children Never Grow Up DLC expansions)

- Full voice acting for every single line, with cutscenes at the beginning and end of every encounter

- Character level cap is 4. (It increases to 9 with the DLC expansions; and to 15 with the upcoming Four-Leaf Clover expansion.)

- Highly moddable: Support for custom maps, encounters, campaigns, portraits, rules, classes and more

Tactical combat

Each turn, you get three actions to spend on moving, attacking, casting spells, taking combat maneuvers, drinking potions, and defensive or other actions.

You can preview the effects and success probability of all actions before you commit and weigh your options. All combat encounters are balanced, but many are difficult: To win the game reliably and consistently on harder difficulties, you will want to make use of almost all of your options.

Every +1 matters: Buffing your allies, and demoralizing or flanking your enemies are often better options than making a third attack in a turn which would be affected by a very punishing multiple attack penalty anyway.

Fully-voiced cinematic experience

This game is a cinematic experience, where you fight one combat encounter after another, and these fights are interspersed only with (fully voiced!) cinematic cutscenes. The game doesn't waste your time: animations are lightning fast, cutscenes skippable, and you can really focus on the engaging combat experience.

Or you can choose an easy difficulty, and enjoy the story of the Dawnsbury Four, young adventurers full of hope and optimisim grappling with their first real challenges.

Story of the Dawnsbury Four

Ever since the Night of the Shooting Stars seven years ago, the small town of Dawnsbury has been beset by dangers. The nearby volcano hasn't ceased erupting, support from neighbouring towns has lessened and kobold brigands terrorize the countryside. What's more, the Golden Candelabra, an artifact that protected Dawnsbury for generations, has been lost that same night.

But now new heroes may rise up: you play as the Dawnsbury Four, a group of childhood friends who have trained for years under the tutelage of the town mentor Roderick, and you are now finally ready to embark on your first quest: to find and retrieve the Golden Candelabra and bring it back to Dawnsbury where it belongs.

But even that may only usher in further dangers and provoke whatever sinister force is behind all these woes...

Accurate to tabletop

Dawnsbury Days uses the rules of PF2E, the second edition of a powerful tabletop ruleset originally published under the OGL, and strives to remain as faithful to them as possible, so that the gameplay of Dawnsbury Days mirrors your experiences when playing with friends around the table.

You play exclusively in turn-based mode on grid-based battlefields, and you can preview and review all dice rolls required to make attacks, saving throws or to deal damage.

The game also aims to replicate the elusive 'feel' of a tabletop roleplaying game, with story, characters, and encounter design all in service to that goal.

Deep character customization

You choose your characters' ancestry, heritage, background, class, subclass, ability

games.name: KILL KNIGHT
games.shortDescription: KILL KNIGHT is an ultra-responsive arcade-inspired isometric action shooter. Condemned to eternal sufferance, deep within the voids of an eldritch arena, you must wield an arsenal of devastating weaponry to obliterate swarms of otherworldly horrors - and MASTER THE DEMON WITHIN.
games.aboutText:
Once a loyal knight, betrayed, and banished to the Abyss. A desecrated corpse inside reanimated armor. You rise to an eternal death. Branded KILL KNIGHT, you have one purpose - KILL THE LAST ANGEL.

FIVE ELDRITCH LAYERS

KILL, OR BE KILLED

Dance with death in the Abyss, and unveil intricate layers of gameplay lurking beneath the surface. Exploit enemy weaknesses, enact brutal executions, weave through your arsenal to tactically manage resources, and unleash destructive wrath blasts to turn the tide. Every encounter is testament to your mastery.

KILL KNIGHT’s polished, minimalist aesthetic, and retro visuals pay homage to the neon-soaked arcades and shooters of the 90’s. Set across five relentless, hand-crafted eldritch arenas, KILL KNIGHT embraces lo-fi brutalism and revels in the dread and dream-like ruins that surround your descent into the Abyss.

Survive the otherworldly onslaught and complete challenges to unlock powerful new equipment for your Knight’s Arsenal, and evolve your unique playstyle. Learn to harness the special abilities and fire-modes of KILL KNIGHT’s array of pistols, heavy weapons, swords, and armor. Take your fight to the global leaderboards against friends and foes alike. Enter if you dare, Knight, and revel in the carnage.

- Fast and visceral top-down, push forward combat that rewards aggression and precision

- An immersive otherworld dripping in corrosive atmosphere with a retro-inspired aesthetic

- Descend through five fatal layers , each more deadly than the last

- Choose your challenge, with four distinct difficulty settings to overcome

- Survive long enough to raise your Kill Power , increasing speed and damage

- Complete challenges to unlock your Knight’s Arsenal, and evolve your playstyle

- Dive into Sever Mode , combining all five layers into one extended arena challenge

- Ascend the global leaderboards , and compete with friends for high-score supremacy

Join the community on Discord!

games.name: Piece Quest Idle
games.shortDescription: Shape a party that keeps growing while you’re away. Gather resources, upgrade your base, craft gear, customize hero skill trees, and tune auto-battle strategies to conquer powerful bosses
games.aboutText:
BUILD YOUR ENGINE

Assign workers, collect resources and transform your settlement into a growing source of power.

SHAPE EVERY HERO

Customize skill trees, equip crafted gear and assembly heroes into specialized parties.

HUNT BIGGER THREATS

Assemble complementary parties and take on increasingly dangerous hunts and bosses.

RETURN STRONGER

Resources and progression continue while the game is closed.

Piece Quest is a premium idle RPG with no microtransactions.

games.name: Pru the Pigeon
games.shortDescription: Pru the Pigeon is a bite-sized 3D platformer with precise and expressive controls. Join Pru on his quest to save his land Asasco. Explore and collect everything in sight!
games.aboutText:
Pru the Pigeon is a bite-sized 3D platformer collect-a-thon that draws inspiration from the classics.

Embark on a journey through Asasco, the realm of pigeons and hot dogs. Collect everything in sight, and aid the locals to rescue their land.

Key Features:

- Charming environments and characters
- 15 main courses
- A fully explorable hub world
- An expansive and expressive moveset
- Bonus levels

games.name: Maestro
games.shortDescription: Maestro is a unique VR rhythm game where you conduct a symphonic orchestra using just your hands. Every gesture matters, your hands are precisely tracked to keep the tempo, cue the instruments, and shape the music in real time. The music is yours to direct, not to follow.
games.aboutText:
Become the Maestro!

Conduct a full orchestra in VR with groundbreaking hand-tracking, using real conducting technique!

Step onstage in fully rendered interactive concerts and experience total visual and auditory immersion in epic symphonic performances.

Shape your experience ! Unlock dozens of stages, costumes, gloves, and batons to customize every concert!

Meta's "Game of the Year 2024", Maestro redefines VR rhythm games, praised by both players and critics for its innovative gameplay and emotional depth.

From Beethoven to Vivaldi, from Star Wars to Harry Potter, play through 30 unforgettable tracks. Classical, cinematic, iconic…

Choose your experience: Start with the base game and add the DLCs you like, or get the complete bundle at a special price.

games.name: Strange Jigsaws
games.shortDescription: A game of strange jigsaws.
games.aboutText:
Strange Jigsaws is a puzzle game where you solve strange jigsaws.

- Solve around 50 or so strange jigsaws, each with their own surprising way of being solved.

- Explore unusual puzzle worlds themed after jigsaws.

- Enter the Jigsawverse, maybe.

This is a spiritual sequel to my game "20 Small Mazes", but it's a little bit harder.

I recommend playing the game using keyboard and mouse.

Notes on puzzle accessibility:

- The game is color-blind friendly. There are two puzzles that use color and they both have a "colorblind mode" toggle on the puzzle itself.

- The game has accessibility options for hard of hearing or deaf people. There are three separate track of subtitles: background music, sound effects, and voices.

- Some puzzles require knowledge of English.

games.name: TETRACHROMA
games.shortDescription: TETRACHROMA is a block stacking puzzle action game with a new color changing mechanic inspired by Reversi. Manage the constantly changing colors of the board to clear 15+ lines with a single piece.
games.aboutText:
TETRACHROMA adds a new dimension to the block stacking action of classic tetromino stacking games: the colors of the blocks matter! Pieces appear in two or more colors, and to clear a line, every block in the line must match.

Transform the board with a new color changing mechanic inspired by the classic board game Reversi. Placing a piece adjacent to a line changes the color of the line to match. Plan ahead to maximize your score and clear 15+ lines with a single piece.

FEATURES

- Modern stacking mechanics with wall kicks, lock delay, spins, perfect clears, and combos

- 40 hand designed puzzles

- 5+ different gameplay modes playable in 400 line marathon and 100 line versions

- STANDARD: balanced for general play

- CONSOLE: classic retro console stacking mechanics

- BIG: double sized blocks for extra challenge

- CELL: square board with modified piece set

- Unlock 10+ block styles and 20+ color palettes by clearing modes

- Speed settings for all skill levels: Peaceful, Easy, Normal, Hard, Master, and Death

games.name: Aliya: Timelink
games.shortDescription: The player connects to a girl in distress in space thousands of years later? How will they resolve the crisis and discover the truth? Through the mechanism of real-time synchronization, the game breaks through the dimensional wall and creates an immersive dialogue across time and space.
games.aboutText:
Game Team

【Game Developer】TDGame Studio

- Game Producer: wuli

- Game Designer: VK

- Game Programmer: YangBan, Yuze, MZ

- Game Artist: PicPicky, Anjiujiu, Sirick, 470

- Game Musician: Azure_Lag, Ganjuwei

- Game Operator: Steve, Qutaibai, Luosu, Kaidaku

【Game Publisher】Another Indie

games.name: Stoneguard
games.shortDescription: To protect the magical Lifestone, you must strategise, manage and build a fortified settlement. Lead your fellow survivors into battle against waves of nocturnal monsters who wish to take this precious Lifestone from your world.
games.aboutText:
Stoneguard is an immersive strategy game set in a grim medieval apocalypse, where you must defend the magical Lifestone.

Protect the Lifestone

You start with nothing but the will to survive in an apocalyptic world. You protect humanity's only source of magic, the lifestone, from falling into the wrong hands. To defend the last glimpse of hope: Craft walls, build towers and fortify.

Experience Traumatic Injuries & Gruesome Encounters

Accurate weapon tracing detects which body part has been hit. You must be tactful in combat to protect your vital limbs and choose which parts of your enemies to sever. Every lost limb carries severe consequences, hindering your performance in both battle and daily survival. But as long as the Lifestone is protected, there are ways to heal your battle wounds.

Craft with the Remains of Monsters

Strategize your defenses before nightfall, then command and fight alongside your survivors in battle. Issue orders amid the chaos as you face five distinct boss encounters, each summoning new hordes of enemies. Craft and research powerful weapons forged from the limbs of your fallen enemies.

Basebuilding and Resource Management

Hunt and gather resources from the world around you, recruit survivors to join your settlement, and work together to gather, craft, and build. Expand your community with housing, farms, workshops, and more as you create a thriving community amid the apocalypse.

A Unique and Immersive Strategy Game

Experience a strategy game from a third person point of view, with a dynamic day and night cycle which aligns with the three phases of gameplay; day time, preparation phase, and night time.

games.name: Some Goodbyes We Made
games.shortDescription: I have some memories of saying goodbye that I don't want to forget, so I turned them into 11 minigames and backed them up in this collection.
games.aboutText:
"Some Goodbyes We Made" is a minigame collection about saying goodbye. It consists of 11 short minigames, each preserving a precious farewell memory.

In this game, players will experience many different farewell stories, including moving houses, graduation ceremonies, quarrels with friends, and more. You'll see how the protagonist preserves the sadness and profundity of their goodbyes through these minigames, and feel the unique complexity, heartache, or beauty of each one.

The minigames in the collection include visual novels, platformers, and even character creators. In this one-hour experience, you might also revisit the goodbyes of your own life.
Here are some of games you'll get to play in Some Goodbyes We Made:

Bye Bye Bye Bye

Wave your mouse to say goodbye as a train takes you away.

The Graduation Performance

You are giving a vocal performance at your graduation ceremony. Choose between staying calm and focusing on your singing, or remembering the times here and releasing your emotion.

I Don't Want To Move

Play as a seven year old making trouble on moving day, and play with all your favorite things before your parents pack them into the car.

games.name: Goodboy Galaxy
games.shortDescription: A vibrant sci-fi platform adventure game where you help Maxwell the dog explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces - by jumping, shooting, slicing, shrinking, warping and drilling.
games.aboutText:
Help Maxwell explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces.

Maxwell's homeworld is nearing collapse. In a last-ditch effort to find help, he hyperjumps where no dog has gone before. Stranded, he finds himself at the edge of a hostile system - if there's any hope of return and rescue he'll need every friend (and every weapon) he can find. Like all underdogs, the odds are stacked against him, but you can't keep a good dog down.

- Explore jam-packed levels with multiple routes

- Make 50+ friends & collect their friendship cards

- Upgrade your blaster with special abilities

- Find hidden areas and take on a variety of boss battles

games.name: KRAMPEN
games.shortDescription: Immerse yourself in the winter forest and help a lost soul to find a piece of itself. What is awaiting you there.. or who?
games.aboutText:
You are a victim of circumstances in a winter forest, where every step echoes in the silence. Will you be able to find the way out, or will you remain in this silent nightmare forever?

What awaits you there.. or who?

KRAMPEN is a digital horror-adventure game in which you will immerse yourself in a winter forest and help a lost soul regain a piece of itself. Uncover all the secrets that go beyond the gaming experience and discover the truth about the main character!

The winter forest is deeper than it seems..

..it remembers all your deeds. The further you go into the forest, the more firewood there is. You will encounter a talking bush, a drunken stone, a psychologist fish, and many others. What secrets does the mysterious winter forest hold, once a witness to brutal violence, leaving its marks on the pristine canvas of winter?

This place is filled with a dark atmosphere of confusion and anxiety..

games.name: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons
games.shortDescription: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons is a First Person Idle Dungeon Crawler with 9 unique races, robust combat, a grand saga spanning a continent full of unique dungeons, a classless skill system, and extensive guild management system to master as you uncover the secrets of the world of Dragaea!
games.aboutText:
Beyond the jagged seas lies the the land of Dragaea, you arrived on it's shores called by a mysterious force in a dream to discover it's secrets and become a legend in your own right. Legends of Dragaea is a First Person Idle Dungeon Crawler, where you form parties of heroes and plumb mysterious dungeons in search of glory, wealth, and loot.

- Discover unique dungeons from dank caves, abandoned catacombs, and magical labyrinths

- Complete quests from from Adventurer's Guild quest board

- Advance through adventuring tiers and reap greater rewards

- Encounter dangerous enemies that will test your might

- Confront calamitous bosses in epic 9-man raids

- Defeat enemies to grow your Beastiary to boost hero effectiveness in combat

- Build your own guild from the ground up with your own custom banners, name, and heroes

- Unlock guild upgrades to enhance your capabilities and combat efficiency

- Grow your town and unlock new services and features like bigger rosters, better shops, and the ability to send out expeditions

- Robust free-form and classless system with 22 combat and utility skills to specialize your heroes's combat roles

- Augment your heroes with 25+ unique abilities and equip any 5 abilities in any combination

- Form multiple 3-person teams to tackle dungeons and challenges and unlock expeditions to adventure while the game is off

- Discover and upgrade over 200+ different weapons, armor, accessories, items, and consumables

- No two pieces of equipment are the same with unique rarities and stat combinations

- Upgrade your favorite gear to its max potential and manage your collection with a full-featured inventory and shop system

games.name: Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping
games.shortDescription: You are the one and only Duck Detective, a depressed and recently divorced duck who must quack the case. Inspect evidence, make de-duck-tions, and solve this no-murder mystery!
games.aboutText:
The Duck Detective is back! Get ready to interview suspects, inspect evidence, and deduce the truth in another stand-alone mystery!

This campsite might have ghosts, but the real thing haunting Eugene McQuacklin is his failed marriage and bread addiction. Can he escape the shadows of his past?

To the annoyance of the Duck Detective, he is joined by a new partner in (solving) crime. Work together to unravel the truth and nibble on the crumbs of justice!

- A 2-3 hour long cozy mystery game!

- A stand-alone sequel to the acclaimed ‘Duck Detective: The Secret Salami!‘

- Interview suspects, fill in the blanks and crack the case!

- Fully voice-acted cast of suspiciously secretive characters!

- Dive into a murky pond of delinquency and dredge up the truth!

- Throw bread to the fine beak of lady justice!

games.name: The Rise of the Golden Idol
games.shortDescription: The Award-winning detective saga returns in this standalone sequel to The Case of the Golden Idol. Uncover the truth behind 20 strange cases of crime, death and depravity in the 1970s. The world has changed dramatically - the sins of humanity have not.
games.aboutText:
The Idol was lost — but not forgotten. In this followup to the award winning detective game The Case of the Golden Idol, you are an observer that must investigate 20 strange cases of crime, death and depravity - all somehow connected. Use your detective skills to make sense of a grand mystery that unfolds across an age of hallucinogens, disco, fax machines and parapsychology.

200 YEARS LATER… THE IDOL RISES

Two hundred years after the unspeakable fate of the Cloudsley family, the Idol's legend lives on only in whispers and myth… but some are determined for this to change. Discover the mysterious forces connecting a tenacious treasure hunter, a team of scientists, the members of an enlightenment-seeking cult and corporate profiteers drawn to the all-powerful artifact.

FEATURES

LEAD YOUR OWN INVESTIGATION

The Rise of the Golden Idol is a new type of detective game where you freely explore each crime scene at your own pace, using logic to build your own theories. Click to collect clues and analyze each discovery to determine what happened, why, and who was responsible.

A CURIOUS CAST OF CHARACTERS

Convicted prisoners, new age cult leaders, corporate middle management and many more figures have a role to play in the wider mystery that unfolds — each driven by their own agenda. Scour each scene for key details to put names to faces and deduce their motives.

A NEW APPROACH TO SOLVING CRIMES

A reworked interface lets you quickly gather key terms from observations and witness testimonies, greatly expanding the depth and variety of each scenario. Upon the conclusion of each chapter, a new type of puzzle lets you revisit past deductions, recap the events of these interconnected cases, and investigate the threads that unify them.

games.name: Don't Fret
games.shortDescription: A sentient guitar trapped inside a nightmare music school. Hide, distract, and survive horrifying creatures as you tune your way through musical puzzles and fractured memories to uncover the truth.
games.aboutText:
You wake as Fret, a sentient guitar trapped at Harmonic Heights, a prestigious music school with a dark secret. Evade the enemies hunting you, use music to complete puzzles and uncover hidden memories that explain why you’re here.

Use stealth, logic and an evolving guitar tuner to survive long enough to piece together your past and escape the school.

Core Gameplay

- Uncover the story: Search through a world of atmospheric tension and musical mysteries to piece together why you are here and how to escape.

- Sound is your Weapon: Enemies react to noise; use objects and environmental sounds as decoys to mislead them.

- Evade to Survive: When cornered you’ll need to dodge, stun and outsmart your attackers to live.

Music Driven World

- Musical Puzzles: Solve piano, guitar, drum and other instrument puzzles to unlock your journey and reveal secrets.

- Memory Devices: Collect and play back memories to learn the story behind Harmonic Heights.

- Tense Puzzles: Can you handle the pressure of completing puzzles while danger closes in?

What makes Don’t Fret unique is the music itself is the core mechanic, with sound shaping the world, the puzzles and the story in ways you’ll feel as much as see.

games.name: Mirage Feathers
games.shortDescription: 「Maybe one day, I won't have to fight when I fly.」
games.aboutText:
◆Story

Notari had expected one day she would be separated from her best friend. Nothing prepared her for what happened that day.
Did the Institute take away Miroita? Did the military, or the Federation itself?
The distinction no longer seemed important. All must pay. Notari desperately fought on.
Luciolla, the AI created by Miroita, was Notari's only companion.
"Miroita lives" said her.
Must see her. The thought is germinating, growing more powerful by day.
It is a better reason to live each day to the fullest, knowing someone is out there, waiting to see her once more.
Must not abandon her.
Must not let her down.
Fight on, to find one another again, one step at a time.
She knows the day will come.
And then, the other one showed up. But... ◆Gameplay

You are FEATHER
Mirage Feathers is an anime themed pseudo-3D rail shooter. You are Notari, a cybernetic air-superiority fighter of the Federation's FEATHER program. You will experience fast tempo combat as you destroy enemy aircrafts wave after wave. Even though the whole world is against you, your ammo is infinite. So fight on, and prove your superiority!

Fire!
Notari's advanced fire control system automatically locks on a target when it passes your crosshair. Your attacks will then home in on the locked targets.

Variable Combat Styles
As the story progresses, AI companion Luciolla will acquire weapons specs from stronger opponents, allowing Notari additional main weapon options. They all have different effects, and offer a range of playstyles.

Initiating OVERDRIVE!
FEATHERs may unleash incredible power by initiating OVERDRIVE, enough to destroy everything in sight. Moreover, when in OVERDRIVE mode, your weapons system will have upgraded performance, all your attacks will be buffed.

Game Modes
This game includes Story Mode and Endless Mode. Story Mode has scripted levels, and explores the characters outside battle with text-based dialogues and cute character art. Endless Mode gives you access to the full arsenal, and pits you against infinite waves of progressively more challenging enemies that spawn randomly.

Cheat Codes
Is the game too hard? No problem, we have made um… Oh! Sorry, that's classified. ◆Characters

Notari
One of the two FEATHERs from the Institute and best friend of Miroita. Outgoing, hot-tempered, fiercely independent. She is often frustrated by the reality that surrounds her, and is willing to act.
She really likes to stick with Miroita. Most people always see the two together.
Protagonist in the story, player character.

Miroita
One of the two FEATHERs in the Institute and best friend of Notari. Calm, obedient and reserved, she likes to err on the side of caution.
Miroita often requires Notari's support to boost confidence, even though her abilities are Notari's match.

Luciolla
Notari's companion originated from Miroita's own mind, but with a completely different personality. Her main strengths are intelligence gathering and planning. In combat she invades enemy systems to help Notari.
She talks like a real person, and would not make you feel alone.

Professor
Leader of the Institute, and the creator of both Notari and Miroita. Even though she was hard on the pair, she deeply cared for them. Notari thought otherwise, though. ◆Support

Should you experience motion sickness during gameplay, please adjust the setting in the Options menu.
This game supports controller and mouse + keyboard. Mouse setting can be enabled in the Options menu.

games.name: Xplorite
games.shortDescription: Explore, fight, and uncover the secrets of planet Nargal in Xplorite, a hand-drawn action-exploration Metroidvania. Battle enemies, discover powerful upgrades, and explore hidden paths. The research team disappeared. Now it’s your turn to find out why.
games.aboutText:
Xplorite is a action-exploration metroidvania set on the planet Nargal , home to the almost extint Anunnis , a beautiful but dangerous place.

Your mission is to investigate the disappearance of the research team sent by the GSO, while trying to avoid the hazards of this world and the robotic enemies populating its areas.

For your mission to succeed you will need all the help you can get, and you will find it here in the form of abilities, modules and upgrades. Each will improve or change the way you fight your way to the A.I. Tower.

WORLD

Explore the planet to find places to improve your abilities, lots of power to be gained

ENEMIES

Fight against aggressive robots under the influence of an evil A.I.

ABILITIES, MODULES & ITEMS

Improve your abilities and gain more power by collecting items through the world

DRONES

Enhance your combat with different Drones as they expand your abilities when equipped

NPCs

Talk with the locals to find out more about the planet, they might help you out in your journey

games.name: Grunn
games.shortDescription: A gardener gets hired for maintenance work over the weekend. A simple task, but strangely some tools are missing… The owner of the garden isn't around, and their house is off-limits. Perhaps new tools can be found in the mysterious town, or maybe some of the reserved townsfolk have seen them?
games.aboutText:
You’ve been hired to do some maintenance work on a garden deep in the Dutch countryside. There’s plenty to do: trim the grass, water the flowers, pick up trash, and of course enjoy the lovely scenery. There’s also a small town nearby if you’d like a stroll.

Except… Most of your tools are missing. The owner isn’t around. Going out after dark is forbidden. And no matter where you go, you can't escape the sense you're being watched.

You have until Monday. Good luck!

Features

- Explore a scenic village 🏡

- Enjoy the lovely weather ☀️

- Listen to the birdsong 🐦

- Satisfying gardening 🕹️

- Discover multiple endings 📖

- Try not to die ✔️

games.name: Afterplace
games.shortDescription: Made by one person, an open world adventure game filled with silly characters and terrible secrets. Explore the woods, find hidden paths, hack and slash through strange monsters, and try very, very hard not to break reality. Or don't. You do you.
games.aboutText:
Afterplace is an adventurous retro game for those who like to get lost. It's a huge open world, full of hidden secrets, treasures, and creatures. Explore the woods, fight monsters, talk to ostensibly shady characters, walk away from those characters mid-conversation (if you want to), and get so lost you fall out of the world entirely (and maybe even into another). You never know what the forest might be hiding, and not all trails are paved. Labyrinths and dungeons are tucked away in the most concealed nooks. There are no waypoints in Afterplace. You'll have to forge your own path.

Afterplace strives to bring an experience that feels both small and immense at the same time. The game has simple, fluid controls, allowing you to focus on exploration and discovery. Characters are happy to chat - or you can run right past them! You get to choose what story to explore, if any at all (we are not responsible for the consequences of ignoring the story, whatever they may be).

- About 10 hours of unique gameplay (and much more if you lose your way)

- No overworld map

- An open world that lets you explore any path in any order

- Tons of friends, enemies, and at least one frenemy

- The ability to upgrade weapons, purchase armor, and ingest hazardous chemicals to increase your power

- Okay maybe there is an overworld map

- Multiple endings, decided by choices you probably don't even know you're making

- Like 25 unique enemies? That's a lot, right?

- Wait, no, this overworld map is written on a napkin with crayon. That won't do.

- Secret paths that will take you to completely normal and fun places

- A cat that you can pet. With your sword.

- The 25 unique monsters are really special though. They have sparkling personalities, and aren't like other monsters.

- At least two overworld maps.

About the Author:

Afterplace was made entirely by Evan Kice , a former software engineer from Austin, TX. He quit his job in 2019 to work on the game full-time. Originally released on mobile in 2022, Afterplace brought an actual indie experience to a platform better known for handholding and microtransactions.

Evan continues to support and polish Afterplace on PC, where it remains unique: a handcrafted world with no handholding, hundreds of hidden scenes, and countless surprises depending on who you talk to (and how often you do). No two playthroughs will ever be the same.

games.name: From Nava
games.shortDescription: Uncover the secrets of an abandoned research laboratory by drawing patterns to cast powerful spells in order to escape a puzzle and monster-infested world.
games.aboutText:
From Nava is a 2D action puzzle game, set in the remains of a mysterious laboratory. You are equipped with only a seemingly ordinary pen that possesses the extraordinary ability to unleash magic attacks by drawing specific patterns. You must escape from this abandoned research laboratory by gathering all the keys and polaroids left behind in the aftermath of an unknown incident. Navigate through all 9 sectors using spells learned from fighting enemies or interacting with nearby objects. Various monsters and puzzles are all that stand in your way from fulfilling a stranger's final wish and unravel the mysteries of the world and yourself.

Features

- 2D Movement and Action

- Casting Spells by Drawing Specific Patterns

- Customizable Patterns

- 9 Areas

- 5 Secret Rooms

- 5 Main Spells

- Detailed Pixel Art

- Various Puzzles with Multiple Solutions

- Assortment of Collectables

- Achievements

This game is best played with a mouse and keyboard.

games.name: Öoo
games.shortDescription: A Bomb Caterpillar's Big Adventure! "Öoo" is a charming yet mysterious exploration puzzle platformer where you discover creative ways to use bombs!
games.aboutText:
A Bomb Caterpillar's Big Adventure!

"Öoo" is a charming yet mysterious exploration puzzle platformer where you discover creative ways to use bombs!

A Variety of Solutions Using Bombs!

Discover unique ways to use bombs!

Uncover hidden paths with clever bomb usage!

Traverse the map to find hidden routes!

Features

- A dense experience that can be enjoyed in just 2–3 hours

- A cute yet oddly mysterious world

- Diverse puzzle solutions that change depending on how you use bombs

- No text — enjoy the game without language barriers

- So cute that even people who dislike bugs can enjoy it comfortably

games.name: Desktank
games.shortDescription: A cozy idle aquarium that lives on top of your screen. Watch fish swim, grow, and interact while you work or relax. Desktank turns your desktop into a peaceful underwater world — float it in the corner or let it take over the whole screen. Just sit back and enjoy the calm.
games.aboutText:
Desktank is a cozy idle aquarium that lives right on your desktop.

Inspired by the charm of idle games like Rusty’s Retirement , Desktank brings a peaceful underwater world to your screen — whether you’re working, browsing, or just taking a break.

You decide how you want to experience it:
🖥️ Keep it tucked in the corner like a cute screen companion,
🌊 Or let it float freely across your whole desktop for a full aquarium takeover.

🐟 Features:

- Idle Aquarium Gameplay – Fish swim, grow, and interact while you focus on other things.

- Desktop Integration – Always-on-top mode lets your tank float over your workspace.

- Customize Your Fish – Change fish colors and styles to create your perfect underwater vibe.

- Dynamic Ecosystem – Watch your tank come alive with fish behaviors and interactions.

- Peaceful & Non-Intrusive – No stress, no pressure — just ambient chill.

- Fully Customizable View – Resize, position, and theme your aquarium to match your mood.

games.name: Nientum - Op.ZERO
games.shortDescription: A 2D action-adventure rhythm game where the story unfolds by tuning the stage with music. A play by Aleph and Liora, who have lost their memories. A beautiful yet eerie stage, and the secret of the forgotten theater await. Your choices will determine the play's ending — and their fates.
games.aboutText:
"—To fade away... was it hope for you and me, or despair?"

『Nientum – Op.Zero』 is a 2D action-adventure music game that combines platformer, action, and adventure elements.

Tune the stage through musical interactions and experience a unique journey to breathe life back into a theater that has settled in a gray stillness.

A Strange Play Created Without Memories

A theater once filled with songs and stories is now filled only with silence.

In this desolate place, Aleph and Liora, who have lost their memories, become the Director and the Actress to raise the curtain on a new play.

On a stage that is beautiful yet foreboding, warm yet sorrowful, they discover lost clues one by one.

What truth will they face in the final scene of this play?

Prepare the Stage Through Action — The Power of 'Tuning'

The gems scattered throughout the stages are fragments of broken notes.

Use Aleph’s ability to tune them, play their restored notes, and restore stage devices to complete the preparations for the performance.

As platforming, puzzles, and action naturally intertwine, the theater begins to regain its vitality.

The Performance Unfolds on the Stage You Tuned

The Wizard of Oz, Cinderella, The Legend of King Arthur...

Familiar tales are reinterpreted, and sometimes twisted, into musicals that unfold before your eyes.

With each of Liora’s successful performances, a fresh glow of life returns to the theater. And their journey continues to the next act.

Truth Brought to Light — Endings Shaped by Your Choices

Nightmares and hope, wishes and despair, new encounters and farewells.

The fragments of memory lost by Aleph and Liora are revealed one by one, following your choices.

Depending on the direction of your choices, the end of the story takes a completely different turn, drastically altering their fates.

Please, join them in their journey and help raise the curtain on this strange play.

Music and Voices that Bring the Stage to Life

The stage is filled with music composed by renowned artists such as
Kagetora., Halv, and seatrus , delivering a deeply immersive experience.

The main characters—including Aleph and Liora—are brought to life by talented voice actors such as
Chika Anzai, Yuuki Takada, and Takehito Koyasu , vividly expressing the beauty and strangeness of the theater.

Additional Content

- Director's Room: A space where you can record and view the various collectibles gathered while completing the play.

Free Play Mode: A dedicated mode where you can enjoy tracks built with the rhythm-action expertise of Quesera Games, separate from the main story.

games.name: ENDER MAGNOLIA: Bloom in the Mist
games.shortDescription: Decades after the events of ENDER LILIES, Homunculi — sorrowful, artificial life forms — roam the land. In this dark fantasy Metroidvania, face formidable enemies and explore a bewitching post-apocalyptic world. Humans and Homunculi — what awaits at the end of the quest for their salvation?
games.aboutText:
STORY

Set in the Land of Fumes, this prosperous magical superpower is home to vast quantities of magical resources lurking underneath the surface. In hopes of advancing their kingdom's development, artificial life forms known as Homunculi came into being. Regrettably, toxic Fumes from the underground drove the Homunculi to madness, turning them into feral monsters.

You play as Lilac, an "Attuner" who possesses the power to save the Homunculi. Upon waking, you find yourself in a laboratory deep in the underground. There, you will become acquainted with the Homunculi closely involved in the kingdom's downfall. Together with the Homunculi, set out in search of your lost memories and precious friends in the Land of Fumes. Follow the journey of destruction and rebirth in a post-apocalyptic world, decades after the disastrous Rain of Death.

SCENARIO

ENDER MAGNOLIA is a dark fantasy 2D side-scrolling action RPG where you venture through the desolate Land of Fumes trying to save both humans and Homunculi. At the forefront of magical and mechanical development, the kingdom comprises of a hierarchical societal structure. Here, you'll come across abandoned cities, discover laboratories oozing with heinous mysteries, a grand Sorcerer's Academy, colossal factories, and much more. The hauntingly beautiful yet gruesome world of ENDER MAGNOLIA will unfold before you.

Journey with Homunculi and help those who have lost their minds to the Fumes. Fight fearsome, powerful enemies, purify their souls, and rally your companions. Who will you save at the end of your quest — humans or Homunculi?

GAMEPLAY

■ Experience the revamped battle system that elevates your gameplay and exploration beyond that of ENDER LILIES.

・Explore the mesmerizing yet grim world at your own pace and take on menacing enemies with the help of your companions.

・Find your battle style using 30 different unique skills acquired from your companions.

・Collect and upgrade loads of equipment, relics, and items.

・Featuring new difficulty levels, you can choose to have a challenging experience or enjoy the gripping storyline at your leisure.

■ Gorgeous 2D art, animation, and music all come together to create a whimsical world.

・Humans and Homunculi live together in the kingdom known as the Land of Fumes.

・Venture out, get to know people, and help one another while unraveling the mysteries of the world.

・Witness poignant cutscenes and enhanced character interactions with your companions.

MUSIC

After lending their sweet and somber music to ENDER LILIES, 'Mili' is back with new compositions that bring the mysterious world of ENDER MAGNOLIA to life.

games.name: Die Erdnussbutter
games.shortDescription: Shoot, dash, and power your way through enemy lines in the arcade-style 2D side scroller, Die Erdnussbutter!
games.aboutText:
Shoot, dash, and power your way through enemy lines in the arcade-style 2D side scroller, Die Erdnussbutter! Use the power of peanut butter to destroy enemy rations, battle bosses, and spread the smooth (or crunchy) flavor of freedom throughout the battlefield. Peanut butter not included.

Key Features:

- 4 weapons, each with their own special and ultimate abilities

- 3 stages

- 3 bosses

- 14 unique upgrades to power up with

- Randomly generated levels for non-stop replayability

games.name: Windowkill
games.shortDescription: Windowkill is a twin-stick shooter, but the game window itself is constantly closing in on you. Shoot the window edges to push it around your screen as you fight and dodge enemies and bosses in their own windows.
games.aboutText:
Something's wrong with the window...

Windowkill is a twin-stick shooter, but the game window itself is constantly closing in on you.
This game is experimental, your screen itself is the play area. Windows move and shift around on your screen as you play.

Gameplay features

- Twin-stick shooter controls

- Roguelike permadeath

- Shop screens

- Upgrades and Perks

- Hordes of enemies and bosses

- Several unique characters

- Local co-op

- Unlocks

- Secrets

Multiplayer

Unlocks, Stats, and More

Mouse and keyboard is preferred, but gamepad is supported.

A game by torcado
Music by keestak

games.name: Kona & SnowRabbit: Pilot
games.shortDescription: Kona, an ice artist with a reputation for mischief, and Snowrabbit, a white-furred snow rabbit full of desire. After hearing the story of Aquus, the mermaid goddess, the two down-on-their-luck artists break into the monastery of Aquus, nicknamed "the sea on land," to make a statue of a goddess.
games.aboutText:
Kona, an ice artist with a reputation for mischief, and Snow Rabbit, a snow-white rabbit.
After hearing rumors of the mermaid god Aquis, the two young artists set out to create the ultimate ice sculpture of the mermaid god and to break into the monastery of the mermaid god, known as the "sea on land".

Quarter-view casual "frozen" shooting action with a twist on the arcade genre.

- Cool 'Frozen' action

Frozen Action Is A Must to Defeat Enemies!
Your snobbish but reliable partner, Snow Rabbit, has the ability to freeze enemies by firing ice bullets.
Once frozen, you can freeze them a second time to break them, or smash them with your hammer to send them flying!

- Nostalgic arcade gameplay

We've included all the "yummy" elements of the arcade genre!
Intuitive controls with the attack button to attack and the dash button to dash,
Stage-by-stage progression through rooms filled with menacing enemies,
And an item that gives you access to a powerful attack for a brief moment!

- Personalized Comedic Elements

Rabbit with ice coming out of its mouth is used as weapon and the rabbit turns into hammer,
Enemies get frozen in the air and sink underwater, the protagonist is a villain who makes his enemies suffer...
Enjoy the humorous atmosphere of this game with its comedic elements!

games.name: GlitchSPANKR
games.shortDescription: GlitchSPANKR is a comedy-driven narrative adventure full of secrets, chaos, minigames, and unexpected choices. Spank, spare, or smooch your way through a corrupted 90s game haunted by a lonely, unstable virus. Every level is different. Every choice matters. Your future is in your wiggly hand.
games.aboutText:
This game is "Safe For Work", generally rated as ages 13+! While there is a theme of Spankin', it's all in fun, get your mind out of the gutter!

OVERVIEW

You're a 12 year old gamer in the 90's. You snuck your Mom's forbidden game, Big Booty Slapper 6 , onto your dusty bedroom PC while she was asleep. But when you boot it up, something’s wrong. A shapeshifting virus named Spunk has taken over, and he's eating your precious game from the inside out.

Armed with GlitchSPANKR antivirus software (and a floppy pink hand on a stick), dive into corrupted worlds of broken code where every level plays differently to hunt the virus.

But Spunk isn’t just a villain, he’s lonely, unstable, and might just hold the future of the world in his non-existent hands. You can destroy him. You can befriend him. You might even.... fall in love?

Choose your path, unlock hidden endings, customize your SpankStick, decorate your digital HQ, and maybe even save your game from total deletion. Or don’t. Your future is in your floppy, flailing hand.

Your trusty weapon is a floppy pink hand on a bendy metal rod, and it's got one job: spank everything. Use it to solve problems, punish viruses, and destroy almost anything in your path. It wiggles. It whistles when you whip it around. It breaks stuff.

With physics-based smacking and destructin’, almost everything is breakable or interactive. Is your hand wet? Find an air blower. On fire? That’s your problem now. Lights, furniture, emotions: smack that crap outta here. Especially that talking toilet.

Every decision reshapes the story. Will you try to destroy Spunk for corrupting your beloved Big Booty Slapper 6? Spare him and try building a friendship? Or follow your instincts into something you were never meant to find?

GlitchSPANKR features fully branching paths with wildly different levels, mechanics, secrets, and endings. Hunt him. Love him. Regret everything. Then start over and choose differently. You might even stumble upon a deeper conspiracy along the way.

Secret folders. Forgotten levels. Strange messages buried beneath the code. GlitchSPANKR is packed with things the virus doesn’t want you to find.

Complete challenges, collect loot, and unlock new customizations for your SpankStick. Decorate your SPANKR HQ, show off trophies, and maybe, just maybe, uncover the real reason the virus is devouring your game.

Unlock weird furniture, customize your SpankStick at the Spankulator 9000, collect rare loot and questionable trophies. Then bring them all home to SPANKR HQ. It’s your customizable clubhouse, your digital bedroom, and your memory vault rolled into one.

Display your secrets. Lovingly spank your unlocked pets. Blast your favorite unlockable songs. Choose your outdoor backgrounds. Visit the Fan Art Gallery (and submit your own). This is your safe space… probably. Just avoid that scary evil demon door in the basement.

games.name: Cats and Seek: Dino Park
games.shortDescription: Hi, this time we're going to follow John and Emily on a date to Dino Park. Turns out, not only are there lots of dinosaurs, but there are also many cats playing and hiding there 🐱🦕 ! Let's play hide and seek with the cats in Dino Park!   Can you find them all? ❤️
games.aboutText:
This is the second title of Cats and Seek series.
Hi, this time we're going to follow John and Emily on a date to Dino Park. Turns out, not only are there lots of dinosaurs, but there are also many cats playing and hiding there! Let's play hide and seek with the cats in Dino Park!

games.name: Vending Dokan!: Kozy Kiosk
games.shortDescription: Build a vending machine empire in this cozy idle sim! Manage staff, decorate locations, and watch your business thrive. Play actively or let it run passively in the background with relaxing music to enjoy while you work or unwind.
games.aboutText:
Immerse yourself in Vending Dokan!: Kozy Kiosk , a charming idle simulation game for creating and managing your very own vending machine business.

Place your machines in various spots around the city, design each location to match your style, and build a thriving business whether you're playing actively or letting it run passively in the background while you work or play other things.

Transform ordinary streets alleys into bustling hotspots and create destinations that the locals can vibe with. Decorate each vending location with various items, plants, and themes that attract more customers and boost sales.

Every detail adds a touch of personality and flair to your growing business and creates a vibe that is uniquely you.

Hire and manage staff to keep your vending business running like clockwork. Assign different workers specific responsibilities such as restocking, cleaning, or repairs, and balance their needs to keep morale high.

A happy team makes for a growing business!

Whether you're actively managing every detail or letting your business thrive passively, Vending Dokan! is designed for cozy gaming at your own pace. With soothing music and a laid-back vibe, it's perfect for multitasking or unwinding.

Key Features:

- Build and Customize: Strategically build and personalize vending machines across various locations, each with its own unique ambiance and customer base.

- Staff Management: Hire and oversee a dedicated team to ensure smooth operations, from restocking to general maintenance.

- Decorate and Enhance: Adorn your vending locations with delightful decorations to attract more customers and boost sales.

- Passive Gameplay: Whether you're actively engaged or letting the game run in the background, your business continues to flourish while you enjoy a soothing soundtrack that's perfect for multitasking.

- Relaxing Atmosphere: Enjoy a serene gaming experience with cozy visuals and calming ambiance sounds, making it an ideal companion during work, study, or other activities.

games.name: Dungeon Automata
games.shortDescription: Dungeon Automata「Algolemeth」is an "autologic": a JRPG dungeon crawler meets auto battler where you control your party with visual node-based programming. Program your party and conquer dungeons automatically. Master the dungeon through trial and error!
games.aboutText:
Connect the nodes and hack the Dungeon!

Dungeon Automata「Algolemeth」is an "autologic": a new twist to the dungeon crawler genre. It’s an auto battler meets logic-based visual scripting, where you control golems’ behavior through programming. By analyzing enemy actions, optimizing your party members’ blueprints and studying how they support each other, you will conquer the dungeon through trial and error.

The world of Syntaxia is in peril

Monsters have emerged alongside The Tower of Corruption, threatening the way of humanity. Pushed to stop whatever evil resides within, you turn to your alchemy - synthesizing a powerful party of golems and programing them to autonomously challenge the complex labyrinth leading to the tower’s summit.

Decode the Dungeon

Each handcrafted level of the tower presents a unique set of challenges. Program your blueprints to handle all kinds of cases and situations: from traps to bosses. Once the golems are sent into the dungeon to automatically explore, all you can do is watch. Repeat again and again to decipher the challenge.

Find improvements and enhancements

Find catalysts to increase the golems physical abilities and nodes that allow for new action or targeting logic. Customize your party by creating your own unique golems with the parts you find!

Much more than monochrome

The world of Dungeon Automata is an expressive fantasy world with beautifully handcrafted 8-bit pixel art. Accompanying the incredibly striking visuals is a powerful soundtrack by none other than the legendary composer Yuzo Koshiro – known for his true Genesis synth style.

games.name: Block Shop
games.shortDescription: Block shop is an automation puzzle game in which basic blocks are transformed and combined to create increasingly complex blocks.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Block Shop

You are one of the final candidates in our search for the new Block Shop Operator. Do you have the problem-solving skills, resourcefulness, and intellect to fill this important role? Only one way to find out...

About Block Shop

Block shop is an automation puzzle game in which basic blocks are transformed and combined to create increasingly complex blocks.

Key features

- Multiple worlds to unlock.

- 10 distinct block-transforming machines.

- Over 100 increasingly complex puzzles.

- Level Editor to create your own levels.

games.name: Soul's Chronicle: Immortal Slayer
games.shortDescription: 这是一款砍杀刷宝类的ARPG游戏，我们将修仙成长体系和刷宝游戏进行有机融合，多样的装备体系，构建专属于您的修仙刷宝bd，喜欢刷宝类游戏的玩家不容错过
games.aboutText:
"Dark Soul Chronicles: Immortal Slayer" is a hack-and-slash ARPG game where you collect ancient divine weapons, magical armor, and rare treasures hidden deep within lost treasure troves. Whether you enhance your cultivation, refine golden elixirs, or slay demons... the path to immortality is entirely in your hands. There are countless paths to the Dao, all leading to the same destination. Whether you are an immortal, a demon, or a monster, you can achieve the supreme Dao, cultivate an immortal body, and let your soul roam freely between heaven and earth.

【Pure cultivation experience + dark loot-hunting gameplay】

Combining the exhilarating experience of flying on a sword with authentic dark fantasy loot-hunting gameplay,

Break through your cultivation level, withstand tribulations, and prove your destiny is in your own hands!

【A unique "Five Elements Mutual Generation" profession - Spiritual Cultivation】

A unique "Five Elements Mutual Generation" mechanism, fully automatically triggered, with extremely high stat caps, perfectly combining cultivation and treasure hunting, creating a treasure hunting profession with Chinese characteristics.

【Unlimited Attribute Development - Nine Dragons Plate】

More comprehensive attribute growth, more diverse skill bonuses, all in--Nine Dragons Plate

【The Wisdom of Cultivation - The Cave Heaven of the Four Divine Beasts】

Activating different of the Four Divine Beasts and creating the optimal attribute boosting strategy within a limited number of slots—the Cave Heaven is the most intelligent way to adjust character builds.

【Rich gameplay + collection and achievements】

Through various treasure-hunting gameplay modes such as Blood Moon Illusion, Gluttonous Altar, Asura Dungeon, Cursed Dragon Spring, and Nine Dragons Coil,

defeat dozens of different monsters to collect materials and hunt bosses

write your own immortal cultivation journey.

Feel free to leave a message in the community and discuss gameplay.

games.name: 神魔决之九黎剑EA
games.shortDescription: 该游戏是一款独立制作的仙侠风格的战棋角色扮演游戏，游戏的故事围绕一把魔剑展开，神秘人盗走了封印在门派中的魔剑，为了找回魔剑，主角弈剑秋离开门派，途中遇到女主顾梦瑶，随后二人一起展开一段冒险。
games.aboutText:
该游戏是一款独立制作的仙侠风格的战棋角色扮演游戏。



游戏的故事围绕一把魔剑展开，神秘人盗走了封印在门派中的魔剑，为了找回魔剑，主角弈剑秋离开门派，途中遇到女主顾梦瑶，随后二人一起展开一段冒险。



游戏中会遇到各种各样的队友，可以邀请总共20位不同定位的角色入队，不同角色之间会有羁绊效果（制作中，尚未完善），可以根据自己的想法合理搭配阵容。



游戏中有丰富的装备可以选择搭配，同时可以通过重铸功能，重铸装备的随机词条，使得装备搭配更加多样性。



游戏中除了装备，还有魂石系统，不同的魂石搭配也会有不同的效果。



游戏中还有其他的养成要素，就不一一列举了，感兴趣的朋友可以自己来体验一下。



游戏QQ群：634019932

games.name: Emery Hearts
games.shortDescription: Step into the shoes of Lug, an ordinary boy with the power to shape the fate of humans and machines in a world on the brink. A retro-inspired action JRPG where you explore a vibrant voxel world, battle deadly mechanoids, solve puzzles, and uncover a story of legacy, mystery, and heart.
games.aboutText:
In a world on the brink of extinction, where the last human colonies endure the relentless assault of robots corrupted by an ancient virus. Lug, a young villager, fights to protect his people in a land ruled by despair. After a mysterious earthquake, his fate is forever changed when he discovers powerful energy crystals that connect him to the consciousness of his long-lost mother and to the Vital Thread, the force that binds all life on the planet.

Traverse a stunning voxel-art world brimming with life and secrets, engage in fast-paced real-time battles against relentless mechanoids, and tackle clever puzzles that challenge both your wits and courage. Every choice will drag you closer to a defining dilemma: save the robots at the cost of all organic life, or forge a fragile balance where both can coexist.

The fate of the world rests on whether Lug can break the cycle of hatred and choose a new future for all.

FAST-PACED AND VARIED COMBAT

Real-time combat where you can use different weapons, skills, magic and items.

UPGRADE YOUR CHARACTER

Find different weapons that you can upgrade and evolve, amulets, and all kinds of items that will make you more powerful.

CLASSIC RPG PUZZLES

Every true warrior must strengthen both their body and mind.

SEMILINEAR WORLD WITH GATED PROGRESSION

Gain new powers to progress through different areas.

The fate of the planet is in your hands. Can you change it?

games.name: Frostrain
games.shortDescription: Be the last train conductor roaming the postapocalyptic frozen world! Expand, strengthen, and build synergies on your train. The promised land beyond the toxic zone awaits you and your passengers.
games.aboutText:
Roam the frozen world

Climate change has turned the world white and frozen, and the only thing moving on the planet is you, your passengers, and your train. It's a dead world, but ironically, it's all the more fascinating for it. A vivid landscape awaits you to explore. Keep your passengers happy

The passengers on your train will work diligently at your command, but be careful: if you don't manage their happiness properly, they might throw you off the train. Build your own train with card decks

Each time you pass through a city, you'll be able to add new train cars by launching a heavy lift drone. Be careful with each choice you make. If you are lucky, you'll be able to build a better, more synergized, happily-ever-after train deck, but it won't always go as you planned. Reach the Promised Land

Lead your passengers in search of the Promised Land, somewhere on the eastern edge of the world. But the journey to the Promised Land isn't all smooth and pleasant. You'll have to pass through toxic areas, and a severe storm is brewing behind you. Pay attention to your passengers' happiness levels and lead them safely to the Promised Land. The journey is in your hands.

games.name: Glowfall
games.shortDescription: Glowfall is a co-op survival shooter for 1–4 players. Head into an abandoned laboratory, fight off failed experiments, grab what loot you can and make it out alive — then sell your haul, gear up and go back in.
games.aboutText:
A co-op survival shooter

Glowfall is a first-person co-op survival shooter for 1–4 players. Your squad heads into an abandoned laboratory to search for valuables, fight off the failed experiments that still roam its halls and make it back out alive. Sell what you bring back to the trader, buy better gear and go in again. Features

- Co-op for 1–4 players — play solo or team up online with up to three friends via Steam.

- A different lab every raid — the laboratory is procedurally generated: dark tiled halls, drained pools and long corridors change their layout every time you go in.

- Raid and extract — explore, search every room and get out alive. Loot only counts if you make it back.

- Failed experiments — several kinds of hostile creatures roam the lab.

- Assault rifles — fight your way through with several variants of assault rifles.

- Scavenge to survive — ammo and medical supplies have to be found in the lab, and backpack space is limited, so decide what is worth carrying.

- Trader — sell your haul between raids and buy better weapons and equipment.

In development

Glowfall is being built in the open. This page will grow with every update.

games.name: Hidden Cats in Berlin
games.shortDescription: HALLO! Our cats are now in the awesome city of Berlin! Let's search for them. A short and pleasant experience in a big and lovely illustration! Start with a Beautiful monochromatic scenario, relax, and find all the cats to reveal the final colored art.
games.aboutText:
Our cats are now in the awesome city of Berlin! Let's search for them.
A short and pleasant experience in a big and lovely illustration! Start with a Beautiful monochromatic scenario, relax, and find all the cats to reveal the final colored art.

More than 970 hidden objects to find!!!
Play through different modes, find special cats, and unlock bonus levels!

NORMAL MODE

- Find 120 cats in fixed positions.

- 5 hints.

ADVANCED MODE

- Find 200 cats in semi-random positions.

- 12 Special cats that unlock Bonus Levels and give hints.

- 20 city people to find and earn hints.

Bonus levels with different sizes and numbers of kittens to find. One use of hint for helping.

Accessibility
