games.name: Crystals
games.shortDescription: Crystals is a RPG game where you travel to another Dimension and have to fight multiple enemies using a turn-based combat system and avoid attacks like a platformer.
games.aboutText:
In Crystals, you play as a kid who accidentally traveled to another Dimension, which is being terrorized by a ruthless Dimensional Warrior. It's up to our protagonist to defeat Dimensio and restore peace in the Dimension, so that he can return back home.

In Crystals, you can:

- Explore areas based on elements such as fire, water, earth, electricity (bet you didn't expect this one) and sky

- Fight original enemies and avoid their attacks with a platformer-based system (don't worry you don't actually kill the enemies)

- Unlock abilities throughout the game by collecting crystals

Encounter special characters, fight against challenging enemies and intimidating bosses, live a story that you'll enjoy (how could you not like a game about a kid who barely knows basic math going to fight a bloody warrior who's able to tear apart a whole Dimension?)

games.name: Kimekyawa♥GenkaiBeat-chan!!
games.shortDescription: Smash the cute monsters with fun! This is a rhythm game with easy controls!
games.aboutText:
Kimekyawa♥Genkai Beat-chan! is a rhythm game in which you crush fruits and monsters and use the funds to open up functions!

Beat-chan, who works in a factory, crushes fruits to the rhythm to create juice.

When you enter Wonder Mode, the world changes completely! Start crushing cute monsters.
The world is chaotic and cute! Let's get kitted out and crush them all together in high tension! Usually an easy job!

Let's crush the flowing fruits in a rhythmical manner.
You'll get paid as much as you crush them.

You can get bonuses for crushing the occasional gift box, and on rare occasions, you can enter the wonder mode.
In wonder mode, cute monsters start to flow at high speed instead of fruits.

Smash as many monsters as you can with your bare hands to earn more money! Shop with your wages! Open up power-ups and additional elements!

You can spend the money you earn as wages in the store.
Unlock additional patterns, unit price increases, bonus increases, and more!

games.name: PIGGY ONE SUPER SPARK
games.shortDescription: PIGGY ONE SUPER SPARK is a single-player action game starring Xiamy, Yuez, and a lost newborn baby they happen to find. Follow the trio in their chaotic but heart-warming adventure!
games.aboutText:
The Story

Xiamy and Yuez find a lost baby. A lost newborn baby.

They start on a journey to find who this baby belongs to, while fending off the dark monsters chasing after it. As they travel using a sort of phone booth as their vehicle of choice, they meet a bunch of unique people, make friends, and they give and receive help here and there.

The Game

PIGGY ONE SUPER SPARK mixes the satisfying, fast-paced action of a 2D scroller with the feeling of adventure of a road movie—all with poppy, colorful art to boot.

Xiamy has got her blazing speed, Yuez has got her incredible strength, and the baby... Oh, the baby has some powers as well.

With their abilities and the powers of magnets and electricity, there's no enemy or puzzle that they can't take on.

Tighten your seatbelts. This rollercoaster of an adventure is going to hit you with all its heart and all its thrills.

games.name: DragonLoop: Prologue
games.shortDescription: The heroine who lost her memory was trapped in a five-day loop. Connect with your partners to travel through a world with strange time changes, continue to become stronger, retrieve memories, and understand the truth. The game is a time loop Metroidvania.
games.aboutText:
This is the prologue of DragonLoop.
The prologue version is the first hour of the official edition.
DragonLoop is a 5-day timeloop metroidvania, with the prologue being a specially customized 3-day timeloop of 1 hour content. Players will be able to play some of the areas in this episode over a 3-day timeloop.
Please wishlist the DragonLoop if you like this game.

The heroine who lost her memory was trapped in a five-day loop.
Together with your partner, travel through a world with strange time changes, escape from reincarnation through exploration and combat, and learn the truth about the world!
In the cycle, you will regain your memory and continue to become stronger.
You can take advantage of new abilities, explore new areas, and defeat new enemies.
You can also go back to the old area, defeat enemies that are different from what you remember, and try to change your known destiny.
The game is a time loop Metroidvania.

Change of time
Dynamic world! Enemies, maps, NPCs... many contents will change over time. The game has a special timing method that allows you to explore as much as you want.

Fight happily
Easy-to-learn, fast-paced and smooth combat! Use the flexible [Link] to dash forward quickly, combine combos, and summon practical plants to assist in combat.

Boss battle
Use your powerful performance to engage in high-speed duels with dangerous bosses with different styles!

games.name: CAT & ONION
games.shortDescription: Talk to a stone. Cover yourself in butter. Befriend a flying onion. Take a short break from life and go on a feel-good cat adventure!
games.aboutText:
CAT & ONION is a short adventure game. Find items, talk to to characters and help a friend in need. It's a bit of a fever dream, while also making just enough sense.

You play as a cat who wakes up with a craving for PANCAKES. However, this quest for pancakes does not go as planned and you have to make a tiny cosmic detour.

The game takes 30-60 minutes to complete and I hope it will leave you with a smile.

- You play as a cat!
- Talk, find items and befriend the SPACE ONION
- Meet a cast of entertaining characters
- No combat, unless you count smacking stuff with a baseball bat
- An imaginative world
- Takes 30-60 minutes to finish: You'll experience a lot in a short time!
- A jazzy soundtrack
- Secret cat things for curious cats
- Made by one person
- Enjoy chunky pixelart, with a grand total of 8 colors!
- Cat

games.name: 100 Cats New York
games.shortDescription: Find 100 Cats hidden in New York! Can you find them all? 😺
games.aboutText:
WELCOME TO 100 CATS NEW YORK – THE BEST HIDDEN CATS GAME!

It's 100 Cats hidden in New York! Go get them! FEATURES

🎮 1 Level
😻 100 Hidden Cats
😸 Real cat sounds
⌛️ Timer Mode
⚙️ Settings ✅😻 Follow our Dev Page! 😻✅

games.name: Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse
games.shortDescription: The open-world survival role-playing game "Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse" tells the story of Delta Team and his comrades as they work to rebuild a world devastated by humans and their race turned into zombies.
games.aboutText:
◆ Features

■ Survival game in a post-apocalyptic open world filled with zombies
■ Vast Open World RPG! An expanded world to explore!
■ Exploration, Gathering, Fishing and Crafting for survival!
■ 3 times as many items and weapons than the previous game
■ More detailed character customization and appearances
■ Countless maps and regions to explore!
■ "World Missions" that take place across the globe
■ Create and upgrade your own special forces team
■ Artillery Support, Air Support, and Powerful Drones!
■ Embark on the giant mech "BattleArmor" and engage in combat!
■ Advanced graphics and upgraded systems ■ About “Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse”

'Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse', the official sequel to 'Bad 2 Bad: Delta' and 'Extinction', has been released on multiple platforms, featuring a boarder stage, vaster world and richer content. Apocalypse follows the story of the Delta Team, led by Major Pan, saving and reconstructing the world ravaged by a virus from the Human Forces. Join the Delta Team on their journey from survival to rebuilding the world.
■ Survival and Rebuilding

With the core contents of Exploration, Gathering, Fishing, and Crafting for survival, upgrade your Base Camp and craft equipment to defeat powerful enemy forces and virus-infected Wilders to rebuild the world.
■ Upgraded Customization

From weapon remodeling to character appearances, much more detailed customization is possible. Night Vision and many accessories have been added to increase the depth of customization compared to previous games.
■ Your Own Special Forces

With a more powerful customization and squad system, in addition to being able to flexibly change tactics to fit the situation, the importance of each squad member and tactical changes are more important than ever in Apocalypse.
■ Powerful Support Weapons

Artillery support from self-propelled artilleries, air support from attack helicopters, and combat drones can be part of the squad, in addition to the powerful tactical weapon "Battle Armor", which you can embark on and ride into battle.

games.name: Teeto
games.shortDescription: Explore a world of mayhem and Michaels! Join Teeto the blob and Nory the bunny in this 3D adventure platformer to stop the shadow corruption from spreading. Absorb wild powers, help eccentric characters, and save the world - one Michael at a time!
games.aboutText:
Teeto’s got a talent for absorbing all sorts of objects - and turning them into wild new forms! With Nory’s Vionite-powered backpack, they unlock unique abilities to outsmart enemies, solve puzzles, and discover hidden secrets. Mix it up, get creative, and see what strange new powers you’ll unleash!

Life’s better with a buddy - and so is saving the world! Grab a friend and dive into split-screen co-op, where you’ll absorb, transform, and explore together. Solve puzzles, help each other out, and take on this wild adventure side by side!

Chaos is spreading, and the shadow creatures are behind it! Teeto and Nory must team up, using their unique powers to stop the mayhem, restore balance, and keep the world from tipping into complete disorder!

It started with one Michael - Nory’s first experiment. But Michael couldn’t stay simple… he split into two, then four, then eight! Now there are too many Michaels for anyone to handle. Track them down, rescue them, and bring the tiny mischief-makers home!

Teeto and Nory aren’t the only ones in need of help. Along the way, you’ll meet a colourful cast of quirky characters, each with their own oddball dilemmas. Lend them a hand, and they might just return the favour with useful items, hidden secrets, or unexpected abilities.

Teeto’s got a wardrobe full of wild outfits, from stylish to downright ridiculous. After all, saving the world is important - but looking good while doing it? That’s just as crucial. Unlock new costumes and bring your own flair to the adventure!

games.name: Greatest Dungeon
games.shortDescription: Soulslike PvPvE medieval Dungeon-crawler, with extraction possibility and incoming zone. The Combat is Physicbased and has dismemberment, higher speed-stats of yours slowdown enemy's, and projectiles, you can find rare Items or NPCs in the Dungeon that give you Quests or fight Bosses.
games.aboutText: A medieval styled Dungeon crawler with an extraction mechanic and incoming zone, the Combat is Physics based and allows you to dismember your enemy's or pick up they're body's and use them as shields or throw them as some kind of weapon, everything can be picked up with enough stat-points invested into strength, but it can also be damaged and/or destroyed when hit with something that's attack is higher then its defense. When your Speed-stats are higher then your opponents in Pve or PvP they get slowed down a little to simulate the difference in your movement speed, which will not that overpowered as it sounds but a very interesting to experience. The shop-system allows Players to set buy or sell orders for specific items and watch they-re price hystorie, in the PvP Arena players can bet in game money, items or they're inventory on themselves or other players or fight just for fun without losing something. After each round you will be able to enter a village where the PvP arena is located and also some NPCs that trade or give Quests, also you will be able buy a plot and design a house and interior with the trophy's of your adventures. Crafting materials will come from the dungeon and allow you to level your crafting skill the craft even better weapons and armor. some basics like fish, wood or vegetables will also be harvest-able in the village by fishing, farming or wood cutting, however, the best resources will come from the most dangerous places and bosses, which are balanced based on they're unique attack patterns and mechanics. The village is placed on an Island, together with an castle and a forest, future updates will maybe allow access to more islands which will be filled with unique enemy's and resources, and deadly Boss-fights with new interesting attack patters and mechanics. System requirements will be much lower when the game gets published, it will get a mode with potato graphics, graphics setting "potato" will be available at launch :)

games.name: Infinity Knights: Xross
games.shortDescription: A 3-player couch co-op action-adventure RPG. A King and his Infinity Knights wield The Armaments - weapons capable of reviving slain enemies. Xross, the newest Infinity Knight, will embark on a life-changing adventure as he experiences both the thrill and dark reality of what it means to be eternal.
games.aboutText:
Whether you’re looking for a solo experience or to team up with friends and family, an unforgettable adventure awaits in Infinity Knights: Xross! Lovingly developed by three brothers, this multiplayer RPG immerses players in a lush fantasy world filled with rich lore and challenges. Form strong bonds and band together with allies to take on epic quests, craft powerful items, and challenge colossal bosses, where teamwork is your greatest weapon!

The Armament System allows for finely tuned adaptive combat, enabling players to switch between elements and weapons mid-combo. Sync with allies to combine attacks and customize special abilities and boosts. The Kingdom’s most challenging trials and bosses await those who choose to master the art of combat!

Experience the tales of a King and his Infinity Knights who bravely fight to maintain peace with The Armaments - ethereal weapons that allow King Brandt to revive those they have slain. Xross, the newest Infinity Knight, will embark on a life-changing adventure as he is confronted by both the thrill and dark reality of what it means to be eternal.

games.name: Skeleton War
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Skull Wars. This is a top-down rogue's anti-skull time survival game with rich and interlinked map enemy character weapon skill props. Each game contains a number of well-designed levels, exploring each unique gameplay experience in repeated rounds of exhilaration and excitement.
games.aboutText:
After experiencing various crises created by small skulls, face the final boss head-on and defeat it by combining your maneuvering skills with the unique builds you've accumulated from previous levels!



Game Features

Weapons preset to auto-fire!

Fast-paced (about 30 minutes or less)!

There are dozens of skills waiting to be unlocked by you, so I'm sure you'll be able to come up with a satisfying play style out of the whole thing (High Risk Output, Iron Bastard, Running Fast, Spell Mechanic Style, and many other categories)!

Hundreds of props and weapons for you to pick from (Judge's Pen, Grand Wizard's Staff, Water Gun, Samurai Sword, and many more)!

Each skeleton wave lasts 25~120 seconds, find a way to destroy as many enemies as you can in that time and survive!

Pick up Skull Coins for upgrades and get some items from the store in between each wave!



Free to choose your start

Starting Character of Your Choice: You can choose from a number of characters with different styles of gameplay and experience, each with their own unique talents and growth mechanisms, bringing differentiated and enjoyable interactions!

Initial weapon of your choice: Before entering a new adventure, you can choose the initial weapon you want and the only one you can rely on in the first level (slingshot is highly recommended for newbies, version T0), and find out which one suits you best to start your journey!

games.name: Skyward Extraction
games.shortDescription: A light horror roguelike adventure through a post apocalyptic world, with airships.
games.aboutText:
Relencost is a world ravaged by ancient conflict. The surface has been rendered unlivable by a permanent chaotic magical storm.
The survivors in this post apocalyptic world have ascended above the cloud layer, finding safety upon the tallest mountain peaks and the floating islands scattered around the world.

One place remains treacherous above all others: The Stormwall.

A place so dangerous that it's shifting depths are rarely explored and only the bravest or most greedy dare to travel.

Each day, a new safe passage will shift into being, opening or closing the path to different locations.

You and your colleagues will delve into the depths of The Stormwall, locating and retrieving lost treasures from Pre-War Relencost while completing contracts from the Ranadeen Empire.
You'll use numerous tools and gadgets to increase your odds of survival, and more importantly: Loot. You will use your hard earned wealth to upgrade your ship allowing you to move deeper into the storm for greater rewards and precious Skystones.

*Sail over chasms with the Glider

*Reach untold heights with the Grapple pack

*Use your hard earned gold to purchase new and more powerful tools in the supply outpost.

*Unlock permanent character upgrades with Skystones given as rewards for completing the Ranadeen salvage contracts.

Gather your fellow Stormtreaders and work together to survive The Stormwall.
Ancient locations are filled with terrible enemies intent on making each trip your last.
Keep your eyes peeled and your wits sharp to get your loot back to the ship.

Move quickly as activity inside of the storm wall attracts the unwanted attention of Mighty Goliath's called Stormbeasts.
Few things can survive a direct conflict with a stormbeast, so make sure that you, your ship, and your goods have left before they show up.

**Features**

*Procedurally Generated Maps, Dungeons, and Events for infinite replayability

*Permanent Character progression

*Proximity Voice Chat

*Co-Op Multiplayer

*Dozens of Unique Pieces of Equipment

games.name: Twilight Survivors
games.shortDescription: A time-limited survival game infused with rogue-lite elements and an adorable art style! The world has plunged into darkness, and you are its sole beacon of hope. Will you endure until dawn, or succumb to repeated deaths in your quest? Fear not, for you can collect more coins to arm yourself!
games.aboutText:
Follow us on [noparse][/noparse] and get news on the latest developments.
@doridori_studio

********************************************************

Welcome, all survivors to Bonder Continent in its ever-present darkness!

A time-limited survival game infused with rogue-lite elements and an adorable art style! The world has plunged into darkness, and you are its sole beacon of hope. Will you endure until dawn, or succumb to multiple deaths in your quest? Fear not, for it is possible to collect more coins to enhance yourself!

A full 3D survivors-like game!

Features characters and monsters in full 3D, along with stunning effects. With its novel, cute characters and monsters, there are hints of warmth even in the darkness across three different types of terrain. Plains! Snowy mountains! Deserts! And More!

Dazzling super weapons! Strike your enemies down with style!

Take your time to unlock 20+ weapons, 20+ skills, and combine them to create over 20 super weapons. Mow your enemies down in the most magnificent style possible!

Eleven characters with distinct styles!

Every character has unique weapons and individual Talent Trees, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Find your favorite character, and challenge yourself by trying out different ones!

Spend coins to strengthen your characters with the self-contained Talent Tree, Kwent Card, and Lore system. Create a unique gaming experience that's yours alone.

Current version includes:

- 13 playable characters

- 30+ weapons, 20+ skills, and 20+ super weapons

- Individual Talent Tree system

- Over 150 Kwent Cards

- 6 maps, 30 levels

- Over 70 types of monsters

games.name: Cozy Caravan
games.shortDescription: Grab your backpack and climb on in, it’s time to hit the road! Head out on a gentle journey in your reliable old caravan, crafting hearty meals, running market stalls and sharing goodies with local townsfolk. Spread kindness, share, and help prepare for the annual Whizz Bang Fair!
games.aboutText:
Grab your backpack and climb on in, it’s time to hit the road! We’ve got cakes to bake, clothes to make, as folks prepare for the Whizz Bang Fair!

As fresh-faced Guild Rookies, you and your best friend Bubba will travel through picturesque landscapes in your reliable old caravan, helping communities along the way. Craft a variety of handmade items—from hearty meals to stylish outfits—then set up your market stall and share goodies with the local townsfolk.

Meet an eclectic mix of characters, each with their own stories and needs. Cultivate connections across Harvestvale and uphold the mission of the Guild—help those in need and spread kindness!

Express Yourself

In Cozy Caravan, you can be whoever you want to be. Create your own adorable character from dozens of animal species and even more colour variations.

Curate countless outfit combinations, making your character feel like the coziest version of you.

Life on the Road

Your caravan is your home, transportation, kitchen, and more. Customise your ride and journey how you like—help hitchhikers, collect crafting resources, and explore the nooks and crannies of Harvestvale and beyond. Keep an eye out, you never know where you might find someone who could use a lift!

Spread Happiness

In Harvestvale, happiness grows from even the smallest interaction.

Spreading happiness is the goal of every Guild Rookie. Happiness brings growth, enabling you to upgrade your caravan, learn new crafting recipes, and more! If you’re looking for ways to help, there’s always someone in need.

Share The Fun

Take a break and say “ hoyo !” to the local townsfolk and join in on fun activities! Test your stone-skipping skills by the water, or drop a fishing line in a nearby pond. Build connections with local townsfolk by joining games of Hide & Seek or Hopscotch. You can even help cafes with their lunchtime rush!

Fair Game!

The annual Whizz Bang Fair is just around the corner, but it’s all gone awry! Help folks along the way as they try to get things ready for the big day!

games.name: Ale Abbey - Monastery Brewery Tycoon
games.shortDescription: Build and expand your monastery, craft recipes and brew holy ales in this unique brewery tycoon. No pre-made recipes in Ale Abbey, oh no. It's a canvas for true beer alchemists. It's as simple as: brew, sip, repeat. Welcome to Ale Abbey!
games.aboutText:
Give your brew a unique name, experiment to discover special traits, and ensure your ales reach unprecedented popularity! Dive into a vast array of over 20 European styles, meticulously choosing the equipment that best suits your needs. Adjust the quantity, quality, and mash temperature to blend the perfect brew. Decide whether to store it for aging, or sell it at the market. Put your trust in your monks’ brewing skills, and let them create the holy ale.

Make sure your monastery prospers and ascends to glory! Above ground, build living quarters for your holy crew, production hubs like Libraries and Breweries, and some all-purpose spaces, including the Refectory and the Abbot's Office. Beneath these heavenly floors, it's all about your monastery’s cold cellars (the most sacred of spaces for your brews). Design, build, and turn your monastery into a hub of holy hops!

It's not only about crafting ales, it's about curating a brewing legacy. At Ale Abbey, happy monks will need more than just a good workplace, they will require a steady flow of tasty ales. But that's not all! Appease Lords, befriend neighboring Abbeys, and handle bandit encounters... A tale of challenges unveils in the frothy world of Ale Abbey!

games.name: Space Sprouts
games.shortDescription: Launch into a chaotic spaceship adventure: bend the rules of physics, experiment with unusual gadgets and toss everything around. With each journey, you will have limited time to reveal the mysteries aboard your solar punk spaceship - how much will you discover before you arrive home?
games.aboutText:
Welcome Aboard!

You’re Oda, a first time space traveler, forging their own story aboard a mysterious solar punk spaceship. Explore a strange ship filled with cozy cosmic chaos, master a physical world full of unexpected situations and uncover the traces left behind by former inhabitants - one journey at a time.

A mysterious ship of wonders.

Explore the strange rooms of a vast, organic spaceship - through flying, floating or walking on walls. Uncover the interwoven layout of a ship full of mysterious machines, peculiar plants & odd objects.

Cozy cosmic chaos.

Experiment with playful physical chaos, take care of potent alien plants, set up logical signal chains and master bizarre black hole science. Exploit the chaos to venture deeper into the ship.

Limited time, unlimited knowledge.

By replaying your journey, you gather more and more knowledge to progress faster and further with each run. Become a master of handling your environment - one short hyperlight jump at a time.

Features:

- Everything is physical.

Everything around you is physically simulated. All objects have weight and react to impact and gravity - and so do you.

- All items are connected.

Fruits emit signals, signals activate buttons, buttons activate machines, machines convert items, items get thrown into black holes and… well good luck. In space no one will stop you creating chaos.

- Dynamic gravity.

Use and change each room's gravity to walk on the walls, ceiling or just fly around in 0G to explore places normally out of reach.

- Fill in the blanks.

Collect all the memories and piece together what really happened during Odas first journey into space.

games.name: The Devil is in the Details
games.shortDescription: A survival horror spot-the-difference game set in a twisted Hell gameshow. Demons will distract you, torment you, or try to kill you. The Arbiter is your mysterious guide—sometimes helpful, sometimes...not so much. Spot the anomalies or suffer the consequences.
games.aboutText:
CAN YOU SURVIVE THE DEVIL'S GAME?

In The Devil is in the Details , is an Anomaly detection -meets- Escape Room - meets Survival Horror hybrid, played from a first-person perspective. You find yourself trapped in a hellish mansion. Each step forward is a gamble in this ever-changing nightmare, where no two playthroughs are alike. Explore and investigate your surroundings and try to beat the devil at his own game, by placing talismans on cursed objects, while trying to survive with limited resources against the many deadly traps and foes that lurk in the shadows, as well as having to deal with the pranks demons and the devil throw at you.

Key Features:

- 4 distinct campaigns: Each one of the 4 trials features a large, sprawling and distinct mansion, each with unique trials to conquer, offering many hours of gameplay.

- The Prank System™ : Introduces randomized pranks, ensuring a fresh, unpredictable experience and keeping players on their toes. There's a lot of variety in these, ranging from sliding on the floor, reversed controls, and other unexpected modifiers that will provide a fun challenge for players.

- Side quests: Each trial has 30 mini-arbiters hiding throughout the mansions waiting to be collected, as well as a secret side quest that will be hard to crack. These provide countless more hours of gameplay for completionists.

- Randomized Cursed Objects: Every venture into the game offers a unique challenge, ensuring a fresh experience with each playthrough.

- Time is your most precious resource: Time is your health. Explore the different mansions while keeping an eye on the time, and beware of enemies that will try to consume it. Use potions to increase time, just keep in mind they come in limited quantities.

- Summon your inner Detective: Sharpen your observation skills as you observe and recall changes in your environment to progress.

- Talisman Placement: Use mystical talismans to cleanse objects twisted by demonic influence.

- Demonic Traps: Navigate, outwit, and disarm devilish traps that lurk around every corner.

- Eerie Atmosphere: Immerse yourself in a chilling game against the forces of darkness, set against a backdrop of haunting visuals and sounds.

- Survival: The demons will do whatever it takes to prevent you from finalizing the rituals, from physically assaulting you to engaging in mind games. You must use your wits and utilize your environment to trap or destroy the demons.

- Limited Resources and Route Planning: Create the best plan of attack to avoid foes(or lead them to traps) while managing the limited environmental resources at your disposal as well as your time.

- Customize your Experience: Completely customize the game to your needs and liking. If the game is too difficult, intense, or you just want to focus on doing side quests without the nerve-wrecking intensity of the default experience, you can individually turn off enemies, traps, jump scares or ghosts, thus providing everyone with lots of modifiers to really give you an unique experience fitted to your needs.

The Devil is in the Details offers a gripping blend of psychological horror and puzzle-solving, wrapped in a veil of mystery. Are you ready to challenge the devil in his own game?

games.name: Iron Inc.
games.shortDescription: Iron Inc is an interplanetary factory automation game where you colonize, build, and fight on planets across the galaxy while developing inter-planetary logistics systems. Create massive bases and engage in combat on the ground and in space.
games.aboutText:
BUILD YOUR FACTORY

Set up a basic factory on your first planet to facilitate research and rocket production for space exploration! Build easily with a ghost-marking system, where you can pre-plan your factory out before you have the resources to build everything. Belts are double-sided and you can distribute your items using splitters and underground belts. You use loaders and unloaders to load items to/from belts and buildings - multiple loaders/unloaders can be chained together to feed the same destination, allowing for very dense factory setups.

MIND YOUR NEIGHBORS

Sometimes the locals on yours planets don't take too kindly to all the pollution and automation happening there. Fortunately, you have defenses at your disposal to fend off the attacks. Once you're ready, you can also produce your own troops from barracks and use them to attack the spawners. Eradicating all enemy nests will stop all future attack waves on that planet.

COLONIZE MORE PLANETS

Boil some water and you can go to space! Deployer rockets can be used to colonize new planets, after which you'll gain a clone of yourself on every planet you colonize to instantly switch between. Each galaxy has hundreds of planets you can (and eventually need) to set up base on, and you'll need better rockets to venture further than your home system.

INTER PLANETARY LOGISTICS

Different planets have different natural resources. Extract and ship these resources between manufacturing hubs on various planets to build a conglomeration of inter-planet logistics.

PILOT YOUR FLEET

Produce and manage hundreds of ships to do your bidding across planets both friendly and hostile. All ships have expendable fuel and ammo - you need to maintain proper logistics and refueling stops, unless you want to frequently send rockets to bail out your stranded ships.

BUILD BEAUTIFUL FACTORIES

Sometimes it's a vibe to just observe your factory at work. Just make sure you don't stare for too long and get attacked or run out of ore!

games.name: Greenfeet Haven
games.shortDescription: A friendly fantasy colony sim where you manage halflings. Start with nothing, launch expeditions into the wilds, experiment with crafting to discover new items, and evolve your settlement into a thriving, self-sufficient town! Inspired by the genre of RimWorld and the ambience of Stardew Valley.
games.aboutText:
Tired of intense and demanding sci-fi colonies or endless underground mines? Take a break and come build your own halfling village! While challenge is not absent from the game, it is meant to be experienced at a more relaxed pace. Your villagers expect warmth to survive the winter and comfort to thrive. Greenfeet Haven is inspired by RimWorld's depth and Stardew Valley's atmosphere.

You'll start with a handful of halflings, or greenfeet as they call themselves, to establish your camp. Explore, build, and discover new items to grow your outpost into a full town as newcomers join you along the way.

What you can do

- Grow crops and cook food

- Raise animals

- Build houses, warehouses, and workshops

- Combine items in the research system. What happens if you mix a stick and some straw?

- Explore to expand the map

- Trade goods with other civilizations

- Design zone-based automation for your growing town

Important note from the developer

Hi! I'm developing Greenfeet Haven solo and have been for several years now! It started as a hobby project and quietly evolved into a full game that I really wanted to make right. My plan is to launch in early access with a solid core experience, then expand the game around QoL and thematic updates.

I hope this game can become a place you'll enjoy spending time in, as much as I do while making it.

games.name: No Love No Money
games.shortDescription: Love or Money? Or destroy them both? No Love No Money is a comedy visual novel that starts as a school dating sim and ends with a socialist revolution. Or maybe not.
games.aboutText:
Plot

Blandon is an ordinary student at an ordinary school for future game developers.
When terrorist attacks begin to occur in the city, Blandon finds himself at the very center of events.

Characters

A caring girl who considers herself the protagonist's mother.

The protagonist's ex-girlfriend, who became a superheroine — Super Ex!

The daughter of the CEO of a major video game corporation.
A troublemaker always on the brink of life and death.

A radical communist and indie developer.
Her plans are unknown to everyone.

Key Features

- Four heroines, each with their own storyline.

- Choices that determine the plot's direction.

- Five endings: four main ones and one secret one.

- 2-4 hours of gameplay.

LOVE WILL BE DESTROYED
MONEY WILL BE DESTROYED
ROCK 'N' ROLL IS ALREADY DEAD

games.name: Dollmare
games.shortDescription: You've accepted a shady job offer at a doll factory. Inspect dolls for defects and anomalies. Follow strange protocols. Don't get fired and stay alive.
games.aboutText:
You were desperate for money to pay the rent, so you've accepted a job offer at a doll factory. What seemed like a way to make an easy buck, turned out to be something much more sinister.

Carefully inspect each doll for strange defects and eerie behaviors. Spot every anomaly, from subtle flaws to unsettling movements, and ensure only the 'safe' dolls make it through.

You will not be chased by monster. Nothing will scream or jump into your face. You don't have to fight anyone or strive for resources.

At the same time, this is not a chill game. It's still a horror game. You will feel scared, unease and oppressive feelings, like you're being watched or something will happen to you. Something definitely will.

This game was made by developers who are too scared to play other horror games, so they made this.

In this horror game, every playthrough is slightly different. Many events in the game are not scripted, meaning that what you encounter is shaped by the moment.

No two players will experience the game the same way, ensuring that your journey is distinctly your own. Explore and uncover the factory's secrets, where each moment keeps you guessing what will happen next.

During your work hours at the factory you will:

- Inspect dolls for defects and anomalies.

- Explore the dark and mysterious corners of the factory.

- Maintain production equipment.

- Follow strange protocols (just do, for your own safety).

- Uncover the mystery behind the dolls and the factory.

- Try not to lose your sanity and your life.

games.name: CountDown
games.shortDescription: CountDown is a casual, semi-idle, 2D tower-defense. Waves of enemies are advancing, it's your job to bolster your city, or rather, ammunition, and wipe them out. Will you rise to the challenge, or let your city crumble?
games.aboutText:
Prepare for a thrilling subterranean adventure in CountDown , a casual pixel-art rogue-like that puts you in control of an omnipotent GLOVE GOD! Set in a charming underground village, devoid of light, you are the last bastion between your townsfolk and the encroaching hoards of mutated fauna. As night falls, your duty is to defend your people, by any means necessary. Will you rely on your "trained" soldiers, or will you unleash your god-like strength to turn the buildings, objects, and even citizens into projectiles to hurl at the oncoming threats?

Delve further into the depths of this chasm to gather resources from the flora which can further fortify your defenses. You'll encounter five unique enemy types in the demo, culminating in an epic boss battle! So don't wait, immerse yourself in the brief yet exhilarating experience of CountDown now!

For any issues or further inquiries about the game, please check out the community discord! There's also information posted here frequently about upcoming updates, as well as sneak peaks at future additions.

games.name: The WereCleaner
games.shortDescription: Kyle is a Janitor. He's also a Werewolf. And now he's got the night shift. Try not to kill anyone while working to get your paycheck - in a stealth-comedy game with surprises around every corner.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Howlin' Hugs

The WereCleaner is a stealth-comedy game about cleaning messes and fighting your own instincts. Explore an ever-expanding office space and master an arsenal of gadgets to clean the office of messes, accidents... and the carnage of your own ongoing rampage. Features

- One unique and interconnected game world, filled with secret routes and handcrafted details

- A dynamic NPC system, with dozens of characters to avoid, trick or kill if needed

- 7 levels of wacky scenarios, shifting layouts, and hilarious surprises

- 3 multipurpose tools to dispose of every kind of mess - intentional or not

games.name: INtLOVErt Game Club
games.shortDescription: A lot of unique Japanese nerds appear one after another! Let's enjoy the exciting daily life with him, a member of the nerds circle who is interested in you!
games.aboutText:
This is a romance-style novel game in which all the characters to be attacked are only shady characters.

A lot of unique Japanese nerds appear one after another!

Let's enjoy the exciting daily life with him, a member of the nerds circle who is interested in you!

In this world where cheerful people abound

Everyone dreams at least once...

It's...

To captive all the nerds!

All of the targets are “Japanese nerds”!

A new sensation! A novel game in the style of romance!

＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝

You, the main character, are a university student who truly loves the “Japanese nerds”.

Spring break is over, and for the first time in two months, you step into Eisei University, the school you attend,

There...

Mr. Japanese nerds was bullied by the harmful cheerful people!!!

I just helped Mr. Japanese nerds with my hot pathos,

He asked me to be the next president of a circle of Japanese nerds... ？？？？

＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝

This work is a work of fiction.

It is in no way related to any real person or organization.

This work contains the following depictions by characters.

This work does not affirm the following.

Violence

Discrimination

Sexual descriptions (no stills that exceed the all-ages classification, which prevents distribution, etc.)

Other descriptions that may be offensive. Please be careful when playing.

games.name: The Midnight Walkers
games.shortDescription: Fight, loot, and escape in a hardcore FPS world filled with deadly zombies and valuable loot. Craft weapons, armor, and consumables, trade items, and survive your escape from the massive Liberty Grand Center complex.
games.aboutText:
<SEARCH, FIGHT, AND ESCAPE>

The Midnight Walkers is a hardcore PvE zombie extraction FPS .

Play in Solo or Trio Mode as you search for valuable loot, gear up, fight off zombies, and make your escape.

Escape successfully and you can use the materials you find to craft items or buy and sell more powerful equipment. Die, however, and you will lose everything you collected.

<LIBERTY GRAND CENTER>

Liberty Grand Center, a massive complex in Golden County, features a different theme and unique loot on every floor, including a hospital, shopping mall, casino, and more.

Zombies are not the only threat lurking inside. As time passes, toxic gas spreads through randomly selected floors, forcing you to move between levels using elevators and stairwells.

<CHOOSE YOUR CLASS>

Brick , a steadfast warrior armed with a massive hammer and heavy armor,

Crow , an agile assassin who catches enemies off guard with swift movements and deadly daggers,

Lockdown , a marksman who uses a bow to strike enemies from a safe distance,

Bartender , a support specialist who mixes cocktails to heal and empower allies,

Choose the class that best suits your playstyle.

<FACE YOUR ENEMIES>

Every zombie in this place is deadly.

Even the Walker, the weakest of them all, can become a serious threat when it surrounds you with the horde. Beyond the relentless Runners that pursue survivors without mercy, even deadlier mutations await.

But no matter what you encounter, the greatest threat will always be the other survivors. Fight alone or alongside your teammates, defeat your rivals, and claim even more loot.

Golden County’s greatest show—and its only show!

We look forward to seeing what you can do in The Midnight Walkers.

games.name: Illusion Carnival
games.shortDescription: A lost soul wanders through a whimsical, eerie pop-up book like amusement park. Dive into fun-filled stages, encounter unique characters, fend off spirit erosion, and uncover the park's hidden secrets. The enchanting yet dark Illusion Carnival begins now.
games.aboutText:
This game marks the inception of the "Illusion Carnival" series.

Content warning: flashing lights and themes of psychological horror.

"Illusion Carnival" is a stylized 2.5D role-playing adventure game that captivates with its unique visuals and character-driven narrative. Immerse yourself in levels reminiscent of carnival games, where puzzles and light action/bullet hell elements await. Characters with distinct personalities and dark fairy-tale-like narratives craft an immersive atmosphere reminiscent of a bizarre amusement park adventure with hints of psychological horror.

Trapped within the whimsical and eerie confines of an amusement park, a lost soul transforms into a tiny paper boat embarking on a unique journey, striving to break free. Confettia, once a dazzling amusement park, now stands corrupted and riddled with anomalies intent on consuming your spirit. What befell the park's previous visitors, and what draws you here? In a realm with no death and no escape, what fate awaits should your spirit succumb to utter madness?

Navigate enchanting 2.5D pop-up book-style landscapes that transport you into a realm of fantasy and fairy tales. Admire the cute yet slightly ominous art style, where vibrant hues give way to unsettling anomalies, evoking a theater-like ambiance with thematic visuals throughout.

Embark on a journey through diverse sections of the amusement park, each with various carnival aesthetics, from roller coasters to whimsical minigames. Engaging in dialogues between characters, adding charm to your park adventure. Interact with adorable yet enigmatic anomalous dolls, unravel puzzles concealed within toy boxes, and gradually unveil the park's mysteries.

Partake in thrilling yet manageable combat encounters as you dodge the anomalies' assaults, endeavoring to restore the park to its former glory.

Experience a narrative that seamlessly intertwines light-hearted comedy with dark fairy tales. Meet a cast of distinctive residents and fellow park visitors, relishing in their endearing performances and immersive storylines, all while engaging in jovial conversations with them.

games.name: The Magus Circle
games.shortDescription: Magic is Art. The Magus Circle is a narrative, rogue-lite game where you draw to cast spells! Meet other mages and unlock their abilities. Discover the secrets hidden inside the Circle. Draw the sigil, protect the circle, save the cosmos.
games.aboutText:
The Magus Circle is a narrative, rogue-lite game where you draw to cast spells!

When fate comes knocking, will you open the door?

Once you’ve already ruined just about everything, is there really much harm in trying again? Magic itself is under siege and you have found yourself caught in the midst of a cosmic war you did not sign up for. With nothing but your wits and your best scribing hand, you have been charged with protecting humanity's greatest ally: The Magus Circle.

Key Features

- Hand Drawn Spellcasting: Actively draw your arcane sigils to cast your spells. You don't need to be an artist. Even the most crudely drawn sigils still hold magic within.

- Diverse Build Paths: Draw magic sigils, casting 20 unique spells augmented by 600 possible upgrades.

- Maps & Content: Battle hordes of foes across 4 unique planets to face off against colossal bosses. Play as the 6 mages of the circle, each with their own skill trees, abilities and emotional baggage.

- Progression: Unlock familiars, wager your winnings, concoct potions, grow a garden and more!

- Story: Explore the manor, get to know your fellow mages and uncover the secrets of The Circle.

- Controls: The Magus Circle supports drawing tablets, touch screens, and controllers. If your drawing tablet uses Microsoft Ink, disable the setting for your drawings to work. We recommend using a mouse, drawing tablet or touch screen for the best play experience. The Magus Circle features accessibility settings to slow or freeze time when drawing or a button press mode. We recommend using one of these features for controller play.

games.name: Bagel Love Story
games.shortDescription: A light-hearted and enjoyable short romance VN! The protagonist, Fan Tong, struggles to lose weight in hopes of finding a job, but the journey is far from smooth. Until one day, a cute and sunny girl named Bagel comes into his life, kickstarting a story of weight loss, cross-dressing, and romance!
games.aboutText:
The protagonist, Fan Tong, majored in law in college, but even after a year of graduation, he still couldn't find a job.
He wanted to work at his mentor's law firm, but was asked to lose weight and then cross-dress as a test?!
The weight loss journey was anything but smooth... Eventually, Fan Tong completely lost confidence.
Fortunately, an accident led him to meet a cute and sunny girl named [Bagel].
Thus begins a story of weight loss, cross-dressing, and romance!

- Celebrating the 10th anniversary of "Gaokao Love 100 Days," a special short game set in the same universe.

- A short Visual Novel with a runtime of 3-5 hours.

- Beautiful CGs and adorable chibi-style art.

- A light-hearted and heartwarming romance story.

- Includes the author's real-life weight loss experience!

games.name: 幻兽骑士
games.shortDescription: Want to open a blind box? Want to DIY match equipment? Do you want to hatch phantom beast elves? Are you bored and even want to catch a big lobster? Become the Phantom Beast Knight, and you will personally compose the adventure and thrilling fantasy of the other world continent!
games.aboutText:
In the kingdom of the Phantom Knights, the mysterious and magnificent star spiritual energy of nature gave birth to humans and green dwarves. At the beginning of the story, the two tribes also had close ties and affection. They each selected the most outstanding and powerful knights within their tribe, and worked together to explore this vast but perilous wilderness of another world, ultimately establishing the Star Dome Knight Kingdom. However, one day, many treasure chests fell from the sky, which was not a gift from heaven, but Pandora's magic box. After prying open the treasure chest, people were surprised to find many valuable and powerful equipment treasures inside. The seeds of greed gradually spread and sprouted, and many people of the Knight Kingdom violated their original creed of "vowing to maintain the unity of the kingdom and world peace to the death.". In order to profit from the treasure chest, they plundered not only the chest but also their lives recklessly.

A young knight found an ancient prophecy parchment note in an inconspicuous wooden box next to the ruins of his ancestors. He gently brushed away the dust, carefully read the text on it, and slowly read, "Go find the sword that emits a rainbow like halo, you will end the infinite chain of this dispute." Brave knight, the boy who found the rainbow light in the treasure chest, could it be you?

[Game features]
As newcomers to the Knights, the first gameplay that knights encounter is blind box unboxing. By opening the treasure chest, the knight can quickly obtain equipment that can enhance his combat power and arm himself. As more and more treasure chests are opened, the knights will constantly eliminate old equipment and sell it. The gold coins obtained during this process can be used to upgrade the treasure chests and increase the probability of obtaining top-notch equipment; Or enhance the cool cloak to make your little knight stronger.

In addition to their adventures on the continent of the early Knight Kingdom, knights gradually became exposed to various other types of looting and combat system gameplay. Territory plundering not only allows for the collection of massive resources, but also triggers intense battles between knights. And through the Peak Arena, everyone can compete with excellent knights from all over the world, using their solid combat power to win the championship!

Of course, it doesn't matter if you're tired of adventure. The Knights Continent also has a variety of leisure and entertainment gameplay that can relax the body and mind of the knights. Leisure "fishing" gameplay can help you obtain rich fishing catch. Collecting fishing guides may make you the next king of fishing. The "Dance Companion" gameplay allows you to easily make vows with multiple cute girls, further enhancing your attribute combat power, and your unbreakable bonds will become the foundation of victory.

games.name: LastDitch
games.shortDescription: "LastDitch" combines 2D tower defense and auto-chess, immersing players in a futuristic clash against void creatures. Strategically choose pieces barricades for defense, barracks for minions, fortresses for high damage. Experience intense battles, unique pixel art style, profound strategic depth.
games.aboutText:
Click on the image below to join discord!

🌌 Face the invasion of the Void and march forward bravely. In this unknown world, the invasion of Void creatures has brought an unprecedented crisis. As the last line of defense for humanity, you are the guardian of light, and you must bravely resist this force of darkness!
________________________________________

🛠️ Build an invincible lineup, showcase strategic wisdom. Combine with the bonds of other races and leverage the strengths and abilities of your pieces. Thoughtfully design your tactics, as each deployment may alter the course of battle, determining the balance between victory and defeat.

________________________________________

🔥 Dive into a deep Roguelike experience, face ever-escalating challenges. Each battle brings new trials and opportunities. Choose from three technology enhancements, adapt to the ever-changing battlefield, and demonstrate your tactical depth and adaptability.

________________________________________

🎭 The fate of humanity is in your hands. In this life-and-death struggle, you are not only a commander but also a decision-maker. Choose the right strategies, cooperate closely with allies, and collectively resist the invasion of the Void, securing the last living space for humanity!

________________________________________

🌠 The outlook for the future holds infinite possibilities. "LastDitch" is a continually evolving world. With the passage of time, new races, pieces, bonds, technologies, and game modes will constantly be introduced, providing you with a more enriched and immersive gaming experience.

________________________________________

⚔️ Join "LastDitch" now and become the guardian of this strategic world, resisting the invasion of the Void, and writing the final legend of humanity!

games.name: Heave Ho 2
games.shortDescription: Get a grip, it’s Heave Ho 2! The insane 2-4 player party game sequel takes the couch co-op mayhem online for the first time. Grab what you can and swing to win!
games.aboutText:
The bedlam is back, and now it’s online too. Grab and swing through all-new weird and wonderful worlds with up to four players in online and local co-op and versus play.

Take your partners by the hand (or head) and swing your ungainly chain from platform to pillar and beyond. Let go at the wrong moment and meet your splattery end, but a solid grip and pro swinging will take you over the finish line in sweet harmony!

Online Pandemonium

Adding to the game’s couch co-op roots, Heave Ho 2 takes the chaos online for the first time. Get a grip on faraway friends, then drop them into the void from a safe distance!

Wild Worlds

Launch yourself and your friends through eight themed worlds of fiendish fun, from weightless space and kitchen chaos, to medieval mayhem, ninja nonsense, and much more.

Push, Pull, Shoot, Squeeze

Pop guns, drones, space ships, ski lifts, keys, and ketchup are just a few of the items you’ll play with on your swinging travels. And lasers. Of course lasers.

Fight Among Friends

Take revenge on your underperforming co-op teammates in versus mode through a series of frantic challenges, cunningly designed to start a completely different argument every time!

games.name: Why do you love me?
games.shortDescription: A short romantic novel about modern relationships. We took some situations from life and tried to answer the question "why do people love each other?".
games.aboutText:
" Why do you love me? " - is a short kinetic novel in the " romance " genre.
Apparently it is about love and relationship. About the difficulties that come within and how to overcome them.
Players are given five stories.
We hope our gane will help players in their relationship including self-reflection. On Valentine's Day and just everyday.

- Five unique sketches from our lives.

- Graphics made with love.

- A script made with heart.

- Music made with money.

The game was created by two developers, Pasha and Sasha, who want to take this opportunity to say hello to their moms and dads.

games.name: 100 Dino Cats
games.shortDescription: 🦖🐾100 Dino Cats - Join the cutest adventure in the Dino themed 🦕🐈 locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of the Dino places and Cats as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🕵️‍♂️❌ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈✅

Test your attention and observation skills in this cozy and delightful hidden object game.
Each cat is more charming than the last, and every discovery brings a smile to your face. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

games.name: Gaming Cafe Life
games.shortDescription: Manage your very own gaming cafe!
games.aboutText:
Embark on an epic journey to become a successful gaming cafe owner, with the help of the charismatic Mayor Egas and his tech-savvy grandson, Ray! Transform your cafe from the very humble beginnings into a thriving hub for gamers!



Features:

♦ Build It Up: Craft custom gaming setups including PCs, consoles, VR experiences, and even classic arcade cabinets to cater to every gamer's preference ️🖥

♦ Gear Up, Ride Out: Build and customize your own motorcycle for a touch of personal style🛵

♦ A Welcoming Hub: Attract a diverse cast of characters to your cafe, from seasoned pros to enthusiastic newbies 👪

♦ Fuel the Fun: Keep your customers happy with a delicious selection of food and drinks 🍜

♦ Grow Your Empire: Earn profits to expand your cafe, unlock new features, and become the ultimate gaming destination 💰

♦ Express Yourself: Personalize your cafe's decor to create the perfect gaming atmosphere 🎀

♦ Home Sweet Home: Design your own home to reflect your unique personality 🏡

♦ Intuitive Gameplay: Simple first-person mechanics with surprising twists and turns 💥

♦ Unravel the Story: Follow the engaging storyline and unlock exciting rewards along the way 😱

♦ Forge Friendships: Deepen your relationships with the game's characters through unique quests

♦ Sharpen Your Skills: Upgrade your skills and tools for a smoother gameplay experience 📈

♦ Explore and Discover: Uncover the secrets of the bustling town 🏙

♦ Exciting Minigames: Play the special minigames to get wonderful items 🃏

♦ Offline Fun: Enjoy the game anytime, anywhere, with no internet connection required 👏

games.name: Tiny Garden
games.shortDescription: Tiny Garden lets you grow a pocket-sized garden inside a magical toy passed down through generations. Nurture plants, trade them for furniture, and customize your space in this relaxing mix of farming, puzzles, and strategy. No scores or time limits - let your creativity bloom!
games.aboutText:
Tiny Garden lets you cultivate a pocket-sized garden inside a magical toy passed down through generations. Grow a variety of plants, trade them for unique furniture, and customize your garden in this calming mix of farming, puzzle-solving, and strategy. With no scores or time limits, it’s all about relaxing, experimenting, and letting your creativity bloom !

EVERYTHING IS A TOY IN TINY GARDEN!

Tiny Garden is a soothing, stress-free mix of farming, puzzles, and discovery - all inside a charming toy. Grow a variety of plants, from colourful vegetables to whimsical flowers, each with its own unique mechanics waiting to be uncovered. As your garden flourishes, trade your harvests for fun, toy furniture, and design your very own magical space.

With no scores, no time limits, and no game-overs, Tiny Garden is all about relaxation and creativity. The more you explore, the more you’ll discover.

A TOY WITH HISTORY

Before you got your hands on Tiny Garden, others have played with this toy. Through letters, you'll uncover a heartfelt story that reminds us that objects aren’t just things - they hold the traces of lives lived and stories shared. Each new discovery offers more than just a piece of furniture or a plant - it’s a glimpse into a deeper connection.

RELAX, DISCOVER, CREATE

Tiny Garden invites you to turn the crank, make things happen, and enjoy a wholesome but thoughtful experience. Each turn should be carefully considered - each decision and each new plant can reveal hidden surprises or unlock the next step in your garden’s evolution. There are no wrong choices here - just a relaxing journey where you can unwind, explore, and create without pressure.

Let your creativity bloom in Tiny Garden, where the only limit is your imagination .

games.name: MoonWhite
games.shortDescription: Moon White is a short and easy action game featuring Chinese Kungfu. It tells about a journey how two elves compete with each other, looking for the harmony of traditional dance in each movement and posture.
games.aboutText:
Moon White is a short and easy action game featuring Chinese Kungfu. It tells about a journey how two elves compete with each other, looking for the harmony of traditional dance in each movement and posture.

Features

* Up to 48 postures with different pace and speed to explore.

* Low difficulty and no health point. Try any times if you want.

* Feel different seasons in the three different levels.

Rules

* Play the role of Luna to respond Blanc's continual movement and action.
* Press the guard key at the perfect time to resolve the difficulty.

* The more combo you get, the higher stage you will reach.

games.name: Hollow Floor
games.shortDescription: Hollow Floor is an exploration-based single-sitting Metroidvania inspired by VVVVVV and REDDER. Hollow Floor is a relaxed game that is full of secrets and hard challenges that can be tackled at any moment in the game or completely ignored.
games.aboutText:
Hollow Floor is an exploration-based single-sitting Metroidvania inspired by VVVVVV and REDDER. Hollow Floor power-ups are based on adding movesets that will expand the player's ability to explore all three different dangerous biomes. Hollow Floor world is full of secrets and hard challenges that can be tackled at any moment in the game or completely ignored. All you need to finish is to collect any number of power gems to power up the portal and escape this dangerous dimension.



Controls:

- Arrows: Move

- X: Special/Respawn

- X + Down: ????



Features:

- Single-sitting Metroidvania where you can finish it in an hour.

- 99 optional coins to collect which provides extra challenges for challenge seekers.

- Secret passages and shortcuts to explore the whole world.

- A huge world with more than 100 rooms to explore.

- Powerups change the way you play and traverse the full world.

- Three different main biomes that feature different game mechanics and challenges related to them.

- A final biome where the player can test their skills acquired during the previous three biomes.

- Finally, the game doesn't contain any time restrictions which allows for more relaxed play.

games.name: Yaoling: Mythical Journey
games.shortDescription: Yaoling: Mythical Journey is a creature collecting Eastern fantasy RPG featuring an world filled with rich stories and unique Yaolings. Tasked to uncover a mysterious evil, you embark on a journey with your Yaolings, forming new friendships, engage in intense battles, and face countless challenges!
games.aboutText:
A Mythical Journey

"Yaoling: Mythical Journey" takes place on the mysterious Land of the Ancients, where unique environments gave birth to different types of Yaolings. With the combined efforts of the Divine Jade Tree and Yaoling Keepers, Yaolings have become inseparable friends and companions to humans. However, a dark power brews behind the seemingly harmonious veil, stirring up unease among the Yaolings…

Diverse and Unique Yaolings

The Land of the Ancients is home to over 300 types of fantastical Yaolings of unique species, characteristics, and abilities. Every Yaoling is unique due to their combination of stats and talents. As they gain combat experience, Yaolings can evolve into more powerful forms, many of which might bring you unexpected surprises!

Yaoling Keeping Mastery

No Yaolings are weak in the hands of an adept Yaoling Keeper! On your journey to become an outstanding Yaoling Keeper, you must learn the abilities and talents of different Yaolings, be flexible in creating strong lineups, and devise strategies against different opponents and situations.

Rare Yaoling Encounters

In rare circumstances, you may encounter Yaolings with unusual colors, shiny appearances, or larger sizes during your journey. Rumor has it that some Yaolings may even possess all these traits simultaneously! These unique features will be retained through level-ups and evolution. One would wonder what other surprises await Yaoling Keepers on this mythical journey?

Forging a Home

Rescue companions in times of crisis and invite them to help build up your village. They will unlock useful buildings such as restaurants, training grounds, breeding dens, and more! In addition to their excellence in combat, some Yaolings make great helpers for farming, mining, cooking, and crafting.

Dangerous Demon Lords

For unknown reasons, Yaolings are becoming restless and transforming into demons, with some even becoming unique demon lords. Defeating these demon lords will help them regain their consciousness, turning them back into their innocent baby forms to fight alongside you.

Unfold Your Story

As a destined Yaoling Keeper, you will venture through the beautiful land alongside your Yaolings, procuring hidden treasures, challenging Schools of Yaoling Keepers, and face off against powerful Demon Lords. You can catch and document Yaolings you encounter, explore different line-ups during battles, or simply fish along the waterbanks. Your journey is for you to unfold!

The Magic of Charms

Knowing the right time and place to use charms is an essential skill for a Yaoling Keeper. Spells casted through charms can both provide buffs and healing for allies, while damaging and crippling enemies. Some are even used to forge bonds with Yaolings. Casting charms outside of battle may bring about many surprises!

games.name: World Turned Stone
games.shortDescription: Civilization has turned STONE. Revive the people, terraform the world, defend against the apocalypse, and rebuild civilization from the stone age to advanced technology! Prologue link below.
games.aboutText:
Civilization has turned STONE. Prologue (Apocalypse) link below!
Revive the people, terraform the world, defend against the apocalypse, and rebuild civilization from the stone age to advanced technology!

Dust and statues are all that’s left - it’s up to you now, survivor.

A Survival Crafting Base Building Game

- Gather dust and craft your way up to rebuilding civilization, from the stone age to advanced technology.

- Revive people from the stone and build homes for them to work at your base.

- Build new workstations and machines.

- Make water and food to maintain your character in the harsh apocalypse.

- Defend your base against mutants from the apocalypse using melee/ranged weapons and defense structures like wooden spikes and castle walls.

- Terraform the world by building machines to alter the atmosphere and watch the world transform to its original state.

- Follow a tech tree to advance your technology and always know what to do next.

Prologue (Apocalypse) link below!

games.name: Trivia Deal
games.shortDescription: Trivia Deal is the world’s first trivia roguelike. Answer fast. Play smart. Use lifelines, swap cards, and relics to survive the Rainbow Reaper. Each run is unforgiving, one wrong answer can end it all. High-stakes strategy with random questions, categories, and rewards that keep every run fresh.
games.aboutText:
Trivia Deal is the world’s first trivia roguelike.

Answer fast. Play smart. Use lifelines, swap cards, and relics to survive the Rainbow Reaper. Each run is unforgiving, one wrong answer can end it all. High-stakes strategy with random questions, categories, and rewards that keep every run fresh.

Build Your Trivia Deck

Each run is unique. Choose your path through randomised columns, optimising for well timed reward chests and categories you know best.

Purchase Unique Items

Between rounds, spend earned gold on lifelines, relics, and swap cards.

Combine Powerful Abilities

Use lifelines like 50/50, Frenzy, and Double Dicey. Stack lifelines for big rewards, or massive fails.

Swap the Odds

Always get stuck with that one topic? Use a Swap Card to trade unwanted trivia for something you actually know.

Defeat the Reaper

Face the Rainbow Reaper in twisted boss rounds that test more than just your trivia knowledge.

Demo features:

- 2,000+ multiple choice questions

- 12 trivia categories

- 12 lifeline abilities

- 90+ swap packs

- 3 levels to defeat

- Original soundtrack

games.name: Center Station Simulator
games.shortDescription: Mine, farm, manufacture components and build a wide range of machines in an infinite basement. Forget primitive tasks thanks to automation! And sell your products to your customers! Build a parking, a gas station...
games.aboutText:
You inherit a shopping center in the middle of the desert, an oasis for your customers crossing this hot road. Renovate it, make your own products in your expandable underground laboratory! Your Shopping Center is autonomous, manage your production of electricity, water, oil, resources. Build your LABORATORY

Manufacture numerous industrial machines for your personal and commercial production! Expand your underground laboratory without limits. From the mine, to the ores, to the foundry, to manufacture advanced components essential to your development! Freely place your constructions, and destroy them to better organize your space!

Set up your SHOP

Thanks to numerous construction plans, arrange your shop to perfection! Sell many products previously manufactured in your laboratory! Automate your payment checkouts. Improvements are available to boost your sales!

Expand your PARKING

Build a parking lot for your customers using materials previously made in your laboratory! Equip your parking spaces with ticketing to charge your customers! Improve their comfort and earn more money!

Industrial autonomy

You are cut off from the rest of the world! Thanks to numerous technologies, manage your production of electricity, water, oil and raw materials! Roadmap

Next updates to come: Gas station, car wash, laundromat, computer store, car garage, hotel, pets, arcade, clothing section, restaurant!

games.name: last seen online
games.shortDescription: Look through someone else’s computer. Inspired by early “escape room” flash games.
games.aboutText:
You were always a snoop, weren’t you? That’s why you bought an old computer you saw lying among piles of junk at a garage sale. You didn’t even bother to format the computer before you turned it on. You were curious. After all, a personal computer is an extension of a person’s soul – all their secrets, projects, interactions.

“last seen online” is a psychological horror escape room, based on early flash games. Look through someone's computer files. Solve puzzles and discover the secrets that lie within the computer.

games.name: Terry's Other Games
games.shortDescription: Hi, I'm Terry Cavanagh! You might remember me from such videogames as Dicey Dungeons, Super Hexagon, and VVVVVV. Here are a few other things I've made over the years!
games.aboutText:
Hello there! I'm Terry Cavanagh, and I'm a game designer. Maybe you've played some of my games before? I made the C64-inspired gravity-flipping platformer VVVVVV, the minimal action game Super Hexagon, and the dice placement dungeon crawler Dicey Dungeons.

Those are my commercial releases. But I've been making games since I was a kid, and along the way I've worked on a lot of stuff! Most of these games are very hard to get running nowadays, even some of the ones that are only a few years old - computers change and things slowly break.

Making these other games has always been a really important part of how I work, and they include some of my very favourite projects. So I decided to bring some of the best of them together in one big easy-to-play collection, as "Terry's Other Games"! It's a little window into what making indie games has been like for me, from where I started to where I am now.

So what's in it?

The collection includes a few reasonably substantial games, including:

- Don't Look Back : a retro platformer from the Flash game era

- At a Distance : an exploration/puzzle game for two players

- Naya's Quest : an isometric puzzle game about weird perspectives

- Tiny Heist : a fun and fairly tricky roguelike stealth game

- Mr Platformer : he jump on the platforms

But it also includes a bunch of smaller, messier games - experimental games made in a weekend, an unfinished prototype, joke games I made for game jams, a game I made as a teenager. Here are a few titles at random: The Hunt , Radio Silence , A Proper Cup of Tea , memrrtiks suashem, Maverick Bird .

I hope you find something here you like!

games.name: Yawnoc
games.shortDescription: Destroy hordes of strange machines that have invaded the forest. Yawnoc is a chaotic top-down shooter roguelite focused on immersion into the world of Conway's Game of Life and other cellular automata.
games.aboutText:
EMBRACE CHAOS

The forest (filled with suspicious quantities of ammunition) has been invaded by cellular automata! Use various weapons, abilities, and upgrades to purge the machines in the forest before the machines take over.

The enemy machines in Yawnoc are living on the rules of Conway's Game of Life and other cellular automata. Will you carelessly attack the machines and die to a creature of your own making or destroy the machines with precision and restore peace to the forest?

FEATURES

FIGHT CELLULAR AUTOMATA

Fight machines from different automata algorithms including Conway's Game of Life, Brian's Brain, and LowDeath. As you progress through the forest, the machines will begin to follow different cellular automata rulesets that change their behavior. Master each algorithm to learn how to quickly exterminate machines in every area!

POWERFUL WEAPONS & UPGRADES

Choose from tons of weapons and upgrades to give yourself the best chance at pushing back the machine invasion! Every weapon behaves differently with unique abilities that suit different enemy types and combat styles. Over 50 different upgrades are waiting to be discovered!

ENCHANT, ENCHANT, ENCHANT!

Permanently upgrade your weapons with powerful enchants! Every weapon is truly unique to you through enchanting with thousands of different enchantment combinations. Enchantments persist between runs and can always be improved! A sniper that calls down lightning strikes on your enemies? Yep! A sword that gives you super speed? Of course! A shotgun that raises up an army of centipedes? Why not?

PARTNER UP

Join up with the locals to increase your firepower! The forest's residents are fed up with the machines and eager to assist in their extermination.

games.name: TORSO TENNIS
games.shortDescription: A grid-based action roguelike with autobattler-inspired synergy systems. Break the game and become a TENNIS GOD.
games.aboutText:
YOU ARE A TORSO.

Acquire limbs and tattoos to get better at tennis.

TORSO TENNIS is a grid-based action roguelike with autobattler-inspired shop and synergy systems.

FEATURES

- 💪 Acquire Limbs: Buy them, upgrade them, and YOINK them from defeated opponents.

- 🖋️ Get Horrible Tattoos: passive boosts that alter your playstyle.

- 🎾 Break the Game : become a Tennis God.

Builds To Try:

- Spawn CRITTERS that serve tennis balls, upgrade them to max capacity for an extremely offensive build that showers your opponent with tennis balls.

- Run a debuff build by removing the limbs from your opponent and throwing TRASH onto their court.

- Go full Defense mode with a DINO build, protect your court with SHELLS, then find an opening to unleash a full clip of tennis balls.

games.name: WOWOWOW KORONE BOX
games.shortDescription: A hololive fangame featuring Inugami Korone of hololive GAMERS! Collect as many Korone Boxes as possible while contending with an endless onslaught of enemies and bosses using whatever weapons you happen to pick up!
games.aboutText:
"WOWOWOW!"

WOWOWOW KORONE BOX is a fanmade hololive top-down shooter featuring Inugami Korone, member of hololive GAMERS ! Collect Korone Boxes to increase your score and equip random weapons, while fending off ever-increasing numbers of enemies and various bosses. Take one hit and it's game over, so exercise your dodging skills to the limit! More weapons can be unlocked by collecting more boxes in total or reaching higher scores! All the while, jam out to arrangements of various official and fanmade tunes.

WARNING: This game contains some flashing lights and pixelated depictions of insects. Player discretion is advised.

games.name: Twilight Tails
games.shortDescription: Twilight Tails is a captivating game where you become a raccoon navigating a challenging forest. Fight for territory, survive changing seasons, and evolve in multiplayer adventures. Conquer the jungle, rule survival!
games.aboutText:
Twilight Tails is a thrilling interactive adventure where you step into the paws of a raccoon fighting to survive in the mysterious wild. Venture into the unknown, where every bush, tree, and underground tunnel hides secrets and challenges.

Key Features:

- Realistic Wild Environment : Immerse yourself in a picturesque world of forests, mountains, and waterscapes, competing for survival among other wild animals.

- Weather and Seasonal Changes : Experience the effects of storms, snowfall, and spring blooms on your survival strategies.

- Shelter and Trap Building : Showcase your survival skills by building shelters and placing traps to outsmart predators and secure your territory.

- Co-op Mode : Survive solo or form alliances with other players to share responsibilities like gathering food and defending from predators. Available within a month after release

Twilight Tails takes you to the heart of nature, where every day is a new challenge and an unforgettable adventure. Explore the mysterious forest with your own paws, prove your survival prowess, and master the art of shelter and trap crafting.

games.name: 100 Romantic Cats
