games.name: River Town Factory: Prologue
games.shortDescription: If possible, would you like to go back to ancient times to start a factory, refine oil, or even build a large computer? With the accidental fall of a meteorite, you traveled back to River Town a thousand years ago and became a workshop owner. And the story will begin from here……
games.aboutText:
River Town Factory: Prologue vs. Official Version Differences
*Special Note: Prologue save data can all be transferred to the official version.

- In the Prologue version, players can increase the favorability of all romanceable NPCs up to 4 hearts.

- In the Prologue version, players can increase the favorability of all regular NPCs up to 4 hearts.

- In the Prologue version, players can access up to T1 node in the Oracle Temple.

- In the Prologue version, 15% of buildings and technologies are available.

- In the Prologue version, players can explore the Central Region, including martial arts and relic caves within the region.

- In the Prologue version, players can reach a maximum of Level 2 on the SwordWay Sect and River Town Bounty Board (Somewhat Famous).

- In the Prologue version, players can participate in the Spring Festival, including the Flower Festival and Qingming Festival.

Create automated production assembly lines, from wooden planks to circuit boards, design every step of your production line.
Unlock future technologies gradually, from silicon purification to photovoltaic power generation, and build your futuristic workshop.
Use inter-district teleportation stations to receive products at various levels, expanding your factory's territory to the entire continent.
From brewing and oil pressing to manufacturing ovens, even producing watches and antibiotics, astound ancient people with your futuristic goods!
Reinforced concrete, rubber, and large-scale computers, these will be the mass-produced materials you use in the ancient times, a thousand years ago!!!

There are 12 characters that can be pursued in the game - the royal, the martial arts world, the merchant, etc. Unlock the secrets of each character and pursue the friendships and romances you desire. Choose your partner and discuss marriage, and together move into the workshop where they will provide powerful assistance. Make connections with nearly 30 historical figures, each with their own changing schedules throughout the four seasons. Participate in their lives and use modern knowledge to solve their problems. In the River Town, everything happens naturally, and you have the final say on when to work, explore, and engage in romantic pursuits.

A fast-paced combat system that is easy to pick up, combining evasion and offense to defeat your enemies through strategic maneuvers. Whether through formal training or adventures in the martial arts world, master more than 40 martial arts techniques including external skills, internal skills, light skills, and hard skills, allowing you to dominate the martial arts world.

Explore the four major villages on the map, complete village quests, and uncover their secrets.
Explore the mystical realms left behind by ancient predecessors, delve deep into them, and defeat bizarre creatures.
Explore the entire continent, discover treasures, explore bat caves, and punish bandits for the people.
Sign contracts with mine owners throughout the entire map, allowing ancient people to work for you.

Be a skilled craftsman or a social butterfly? Become the top martial artist or a versatile expert in everyday life? It's all up to you to decide.
Craft spiritual medicines, weapons, and clothing, becoming a master of ancient craftsmanship.
Create over 20 different dishes with various enhancements, such as Five Treasures Stew and Snowy Sunset Soup... Make them in your kitchen!
Fill the Heavenly Workshop with the products you create, allowing ancient people to visit and witness modern technology.
Utilize the power of future technology to repair the time machine and fulfill a mission that only you can accomplish.

games.name: Incremental Island
games.shortDescription: Build and expand a vibrant civilization on a procedurally generated island. Trade and conquer with other island nations to grow your wealth.
games.aboutText:
Demo Available: Download the demo from the demo button on this page.

Game Overview: This is a clicker game inspired by CivClicker. Manage resources and develop your civilization. Each game features unique procedurally generated islands. Click on tiles to interact with resources and the environment. Gather and manage resources to expand your civilization. Trade and conquer with other island nations to grow your wealth.

First things: When you first start, click on the land tiles to collect and manage basic resources like food and wood. Early on, focus on constructing tents and huts to increase your population capacity. As resources flow in, begin to explore and unlock new tiles. Unlock the Port to explore the world...

Goal of the Game: Lead your island to victory by expanding your civilization, building an army, and conquering all other islands. Once you win, you can either keep playing in Freeplay mode or aim for a higher score in a new world.

Original Music: by Mike Langston

games.name: Pup Champs
games.shortDescription: Lead a team of puppy soccer players, solve 170+ challenges and score goals in this cozy tactical puzzle game!
games.aboutText:
Pup Champs is a cozy tactical puzzle game from the makers of Railbound and inbento. Use your wits to become a coach, guide a team of adorable pups and solve over 170 hand-crafted challenges!

PLAN YOUR ACTIONS

Position your players just right, clear their passing lanes, avoid hazards, outsmart the opponents and lead the pups to victory.

BECOME A PUZZLE CHAMPION

Each chapter brings in unexpected challenges - balls get stuck in the mud, monkeys mimic your movements, bunnies react to passes, and more! Where some players see an obstacle, a skilled coach can spot an opportunity...

A STORY ABOUT BONDS

In between solving puzzles discover a tale of friendship and sports told through interactive motion comics. As a retired soccer coach use your experience and wits to help out a bunch of clumsy pups come together and form a great team!

FOR PUZZLE NOVICES AND EXPERTS ALIKE

We designed Pup Champs to be accessible to everyone. A series of carefully crafted puzzles will guide you to shine on the field and score game-winning goals. Want an additional challenge? We've got plenty of bonus levels to satisfy you!

games.name: Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance TD
games.shortDescription: While a formidable evil emerges, an unexpected alliance is taking shape! It will take the finest warriors of Linirea and the relentless Dark Army to stop it. Beware! Though they may journey side by side the ever-changing winds of fate could swiftly alter their course.
games.aboutText:
With greater power and menace than ever before, Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance offers a fresh, exhilarating experience, building upon the fast-paced and captivating gameplay that made its predecessors award-winners.

As a formidable evil arises, an unexpected alliance is taking shape! It will take the finest warriors of Linirea and the relentless Dark Army together to stop it. Beware! They may journey side by side for now, but the ever-changing winds of fate could swiftly alter their course.

Prepare to harness the formidable might of two heroes on the battlefield!

YES, you can now play with TWICE the dragons!! Double the fire-breathing fun, double the chaos—just make sure they don't argue over who gets to hoard the most gold!

Boss around all the heavy hitters like Paladins, Archers, Mages, Necromancers, and a bunch more. Just watch out they don’t start arguing about who's the real hero of the party as the enemies sneak by!

Are you poised for the ultimate clash? Embark on an epic journey alongside the brave warriors of Linirea and the relentless Dark Army as they unite to conquer a colossal foe.

Features:

- 32 upgradeable characters:

- 17 Towers with special skills. Create a wide range of strategies by building towers such as precise archers, lethal paladins, and even demon pits.

- 15 Epic Heroes; Play with 2 heroes in each stage, upgrade them to unleash their powerful abilities and bolster your defense. Who knew heroes could be such close roommates?

- Face action-packed challenges across 5 different exotic landscapes.

- 22 Campaign stages, with different terrains and challenges. Explore diverse landscapes and defend them against hordes of enemies. Each stage offers a new adventure!

- 3 different game modes. Who doesn't love a good challenge?

- 56+ Achievements: show off your skills and unlock rewards!

- 40+ different enemies to test your mettle: 4 enemy races and 5 colossal boss fights of epic proportions. Who will prevail: you or the baddies?

- Easter eggs and Ironhide's usual lighthearted humor. Because what's a game without a few hidden surprises and a good laugh?

games.name: The Dream Within
games.shortDescription: A pixel-graphics open world survival craft RPG, where player is locked in a deep dream world, survive in this elusive world, forage, hunt, mine, and build up shelters. Find a way to escape.
games.aboutText:
This is a pixel open world survival craft ARPG. It is not a casual style farming simulator. It needs more actions in combat. The game has a linear progress with free world exploration. It needs 30-40 hours to finish the full game.

- Building Base

- Farming and Crafting

- Hunting

- Fighting

Nightmare

Nightmares comes at regular intervals, dark monsters will attack the base, its challenging fights and players must prepare well and use everything to survive.

games.name: Golden Warden
games.shortDescription: A rogue-like battle game with easy controls. Pick a card each turn as you aim for the dungeon depths and attempt to claim the treasure that the Golden Warden protects as your own.
games.aboutText:
Golden Warden is a rogue-like battle game set in a dungeon generated like the Japanese board game of sugoroku.

Choose Action Cards that combine dice movement with various attacks using swords, magic, bows, bombs, and even blunderbusses. Conquer dungeons full of traps that change each time you enter.

Get upgrades, collect gold to strengthen your weapons, take down (or avoid) enemies, and aim for the depths of the dungeon to claim the treasure that Golden Warden is said to guard.

Action Cards

Choose one Action Card each turn that combines movement and attack. Choose wisely as it's what will get you out of your predicaments!

Dungeons of Tiles

The dungeons are filled with tiles containing various effects. Use the effects of the tiles to your advantage and wipe out the enemy.

Varying Playstyle

As you progress through the dungeon, you can acquire new weapons and upgrades, gradually morphing the way you play. Find the playstyle that suits you and aim for the dungeon's depths.

games.name: Dumb Ways to Party
games.shortDescription: The world’s dumbest party game is here! Play as your favorite Bean, and go head-to-head with up to three other players to become the Dumbest of the Dumb. Will you use skill, sabotage or sheer dumb luck to win?
games.aboutText:
Dumb Ways to Party throws contestants into the The Dumbest of the Dumb game show - a whirlwind of wacky challenges, hilarious mishaps, surprise twists, big wins and even bigger fails!

The challenge? Out-dumb the competition and take home the prestigious title of Dumbest of the Dumb!

Are you here for glory? Fame? Or just to make a fool of yourself? Let’s find out!

MINI-GAME MAYHEM

40 outrageous Mini-games to hurl at contestants, each one as wild and unpredictable as the last!

PARTY WITH YOUR FRIENDS

Whether you're playing solo or with up to three other players, the thrill of victory fuels the fun… and competition. Let the sabotage begin!

HILARITY IN UNCERTAINTY

Game Show Moments will completely shake up the round! One minute you’re close to victory, then, BAM! An item with chaotic effects leads to your comical downfall.

Whether you're playing or watching the chaos unfold, dumb fun is guaranteed!

FEATURES

- Four player action awaits in couch co-op and online multiplayer - get ready for wacky head-to-head challenges!

- Play as iconic Dumb Ways characters, such as Numpty, Botch and Clod, each bursting with their own quirky personality.

- Use a variety of items to make every Mini-game even dumber than before!

- Compete in the Game Show mode or enjoy non-stop action with back-to-back Mini-games in Freeplay.

- Pick up and play mechanics that keep the fun and competition centre stage!

- Experience the beloved Dumb Ways art style, reimagined in vibrant 3D.

games.name: Chocolate Factory
games.shortDescription: Build your dream Chocolate Factory among candy cane forests and gumdrop hills to produce the tastiest sweets. A delicious first-person factory automation game with a little exploration and combat. Confectionary conveyor belt heaven awaits!
games.aboutText:
Build your dream Chocolate Factory among candy cane forests and gumdrop hills to produce the tastiest sweets.
A delicious first-person factory automation game with a little exploration and combat.
Confectionary conveyor belt heaven awaits!

- Produce all types of sweets as you fill the world with massive factories!

- Automate with conveyor belts to exploit the world's resources!

- Immersive first-person perspective factory building!

- Travel in style with jump pads, glider, factory boots, and jetpacks!

- Build sprawling castles easily from pre-made building pieces!

- Open world but not massive, as you play you'll be able to see the entire world fill up with your factories!

- Follow a tech tree to know exactly what to work on next!

- Utilize drones in the end-game to transport items farther!

- Customize the color of your factory!

games.name: Enemy Metal
games.shortDescription: 2.5D Roguelite Shooter with Unique Gameplay, Powerful Weapons and a Killer Soundtrack. Battle the dangerous enemies and defend the planets of the Sunstar System! Gather crystals and destroy turrets to level up and unlock exciting new Starships on each planet!
games.aboutText:
2.5D ROGUELITE SHOOTER WITH UNIQUE GAMEPLAY AND A KILLER SOUNDTRACK

Easy to play yet difficult to master, Enemy Metal features unique starships and vibrant planets. Destroy enemies to unlock new starships and planets and gather crystals to power up your starships.

Battle for Survival

Begin your campaign on Planet Aureus and fight to survive with unlimited time. Compete against players around the world with a global leaderboard on each planet. Battle against Time

Progress and discover new game modes on Ignis, the Planet of Fire and Glaceus, the Planet of Ice with limited time and increased damage. Battle the mysterious enemy in a race against time in the final challenge on Arcana, the dark moon.

Power Up

Reach high levels on each planet to permanently upgrade your starships and unlock exciting new planets and starships as you defend the Sunstar System. Gather crystals to restore health and energy and increase your speed, firepower and shields. Achieve Greatness

Complete achievements on each planet to earn permanent boosts for all your starships.

games.name: Lake Minnewaska
games.shortDescription: Lake Minnewaska is a narrative driven first person fishing game. Fish, explore, and uncover the secrets of Lake Minnewaska as you guide Sosa's journey in becoming a better father.
games.aboutText:
Cast your line and join Sosa on an emotional journey as he navigates the mystical waters of Lake Minnewaska to fish and reconnect with his daughter. Lake Minnewaska is a narrative driven first person fishing game. Fish, explore, and uncover the secrets of Lake Minnewaska as you guide Sosa's journey in becoming a better father.

Embark on a Personal Journey

Join Sosa on his quest to reconnect with his family. Learn more about Sosa and his daughter Rue while uncovering the mystical secrets of the lake.

Fish up Fantastical Creatures

Search for the correct fishing hole based on clues in your journal and then fight to reel in the fish you've hooked. Tire out all sorts of fish by pulling your rod in the opposite direction and then reel them in to add them to your journal. Catch all the types of fish in the lake to complete Rue's fishlist.

Explore Extreme Environments

Travel through a variety of lush, stormy, and mystical environments all while listening to a jazzy soundtrack. Get caught up in the ambience of the lake and the vibrant colors of the fishing holes you visit.

Lake Minnewaska is an Advanced Games Project (AGP), a student-run game out of the University of Southern California, where students from the USC School of Cinematic Arts and USC School Viterbi School of Engineering, collaborate on large projects from all over USC, including Thorton and Marshall. This project is Lloyd Campbell III's MFA thesis capstone at USC in which he to tell an emotional story through a narrative-heavy fishing game. Lake Minnewaska was made over the course of a year by a team of 35 students.

games.name: Omen
games.shortDescription: Infiltrate the remnants of a fallen empire, extract valuable loot, establish defenses against hostile fanatics, and unlock the gateway to a dimension of cosmic dread that defies comprehension.
games.aboutText:
Still traumatized by the catastrophic destruction of the Second Great Collapse, Voidborn cling to life aboard what megastations still survive among the Shattered Systems. Now, threatened by an otherworldly calamity known simply as The Veil, the Samarin Empire crumbles under its ceaseless advance.

Take the role of an Astral, an immortal starship pilot sent to investigate the collapse of the Samarin Empire.

- A roguelite campaign that takes you from the edge of the empire, into its crumbling heart, and into The Veil.

- More than a dozen regions to explore and secret stargates leading to lost pockets of space.

- Base defense and building mechanics.

- 4 total enemy factions to battle against. Including: pirates, legions of traitors, and cultists. Each with their own set of ships and tactics.

- Large scale fleet battles as you fight alongside the remnants of the Samarin loyalists.

- Over 80 weapons and ship abilities.

- Plenty of other quests and side quests.

- Hordes of pirates, a legion of traitors, and an armada of cultists want you dead. Embark on expeditions throughout the ruined Samarin Empire to raid your enemies for resources. Craft a variety of defensive structures and upgrade your base to hold off waves of enemies.

- Every region of the empire has unique challenges, quests, and loot. Collect as much as you can and extract without dying to build your arsenal. Countless combinations of weapons and abilities await.

- Open a gateway into a corrupted realm that is spewing abominations into our dimension. Delve deep, defeat the terrors within, uncover its secrets, and end this apocalypse.

games.name: Warota: I Live Next to The Demon King's Castle LOL
games.shortDescription: 【Village-Building Action RPG】Reincarnated into a ravaged world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, and swap hats to change classes! But when the Idol Demon King throws a live concert, a massive wave of hyped-up monsters stampedes straight toward your village!
games.aboutText:
< Story >

"I got reincarnated, and the Demon King's Castle is right next door?! LOL"

Your fading soul is rescued by a goddess, and you're summoned to another world, Luna.

As a "Bounder" gifted with the power of creation, you arrive at a single dilapidated house.

Fix up the house, gather allies, tend the fields, and grow your village. Then, one night, the monsters suddenly start going wild...

"This world belongs to us! ♡ Listen up, my lovely monsters! Go wild, break whatever you want, and have some fun! ♡"

That voice belongs to the Demon King, a pop idol adored by monsters everywhere. Her announcement marks the beginning of the "Demon King Live," sending a massive wave of hyped-up, frenzied monsters stampeding straight toward your village.

< Build Up Your Village Base >

Gather materials and craft furniture, structures, and more, with over 30 buildings to construct in all! The more you build, the more villagers arrive, and the stronger you and your village become.

< Pick Your Hat, Change Your Job Class >

In this world, hats carry the goddess's power. The hat you wear determines your Job Class.

Ranging from gathering/crafting professions like Farmers and Lumberjacks to combat roles like Warriors and Mages! Choose from more than 20 Job Classes. Experiment freely, swap your hats to match any situation, and find a playstyle that's uniquely yours.

　

< Team Up with Your Villagers and Assign Them Jobs >

Assigning a hat to a villager unlocks their true potential. Whether it's a Farmer tilling and harvesting the fields, a Chef keeping everyone fed, or a Guard defending the village from invading monsters, set them to work and watch your Village thrive completely on its own. Bring them along on your adventures, where they will fight by your side, each with their own unique traits and strengths to offer!

< Build Your Fighting Style with the Goddess's Blessings >

Offer prayers to the Goddess Statues scattered across the land to receive powerful blessings that aid your journey.

These divine Blessings offer a wide variety of buffs, from boosting attack power and accelerating health recovery to granting uniquely powerful elemental attributes. By stacking multiple Blessings together, you can forge a combat style entirely your own!

< Fend Off the Demon King Live Concert! >

"This world belongs to us! ♡"

Your next-door neighbor? Yeah... it's the Demon King's castle.

Every time the Idol Demon King holds a concert, hordes of frenzied monsters descend on your village.

Team up with your villagers, fortify your defenses, and hold back the waves of monsters threatening your home.

Defeat the powerful bosses standing in your way, and the hidden truth of this world will slowly come to light.

games.name: Escape From The Past
games.shortDescription: A scientist is stranded in the Bronze Age with a dead time machine and a pocket knife. Raid the valley for materials, survive Scythian warriors and wild animals, and work through the history of technology, from a sharpened stick to the first battery, to get back home.
games.aboutText:
The past won't let you go

You built a time machine, and it dropped you in the Bronze Age. The machine is out of power, and all you have is a field tablet and a pocket knife. While you lay unconscious, the locals opened the machine and took its glowing heart, the Resonator, as a gift from the sky. It now sits on top of a giant totem in a fortified hillfort above the lake.

To get home, you have to make electricity in a world without a single power socket. It took humanity nearly three thousand years.

The assistant in your tablet talks you through it: she gives hints, explains what you find and tells you about the world around you.

Risk everything to bring back knowledge

You head into the valley for clay, copper ore and hides, and any trip could be your last. The valley hears your noise. Stay out too long and night catches you, and a greedy haul can keep you from making it back.

- PvE extraction, no PvP. The world itself is the threat, and it reacts to your noise, your kills and your greed

- Your bag stays where you died. It's marked on the map, so you can go back for it on your next trip if you dare

- Weight. A heavy backpack slows you down, so choose what's worth carrying home

- Rope seat shortcuts. Repair one and your own weight takes you down, while a winch hauls you back up

A skill tree made of real history

You won't find a steel sword at level 5. Progress follows real science: why charcoal burns hotter than wood, how tanbark turns hide into leather, why copper hides inside a green stone, and how two metals and vinegar make a current.

- Knowledge unlocks recipes. Find the materials and work out the idea on your tablet before the recipe appears

- A real production chain: hide → leather → bellows → copper → the first galvanic cell

- The base grows with you: workbench, furnace, campfire and tanning vat first, then a water wheel, a generator and the first wire to the machine

Survive the Bronze Age

The locals are better armed than you. Bandits carry real weapons, slingers hit from range, and a stone spear barely dents a Scythian warrior's bronze. Wolves hunt in pairs, and the big animals won't get out of your way.

- Hunger, thirst and poisoning. Cook your food at the campfire or take your chances

- Injuries: bleeding, fractures, concussion and pain. You can stabilise them in the field, but only the base can heal them

- Ancient weapons: spears, bows, knives and Scythian trophies like the akinakes and the Scythian bow. Weapons go dull but never break

- Build your own weapon from a base, a working element and a modifier. The modifier adds fire, poison or an electric charge to a blade or arrow

- The scientist's blunderbuss is a home-made muzzle-loader that fires shot or ball. It hits hard, and the whole valley hears every shot

games.name: 東方资志疏 ~ Immortal Immanuel. (东方资志疏)
games.shortDescription: 中国风东方Project二次同人STG游戏,剧情承接虹龙洞之后,古代帝王穿越到幻想乡发动异变！开始紧张刺激的弹幕游戏吧！
games.aboutText:
游戏类型及难度：

一款中国风东方二次同人stg(弹幕射击)游戏，总体难度低于东方正作。



背景故事：

是幻想乡狂热宗教热潮还没退去吗，

抑或是都市传说还在各处流传呢。

人间之里，正在发生着不为人知的变化。

——人间之里

这里正举办着热闹的集市，而恶作剧的主谋们正在暗处悄然地注视着人们。



操作方法：

玩家使用键盘的上下左右键控制移动方向

shift键控制高低速,z键射击,x键放符卡(bomb),c键释放天命充能



玩家操纵角色：

令人安心的守护者「金」

不得不加班的玉造巫女

博丽 灵梦

Hakurei Reimu

种族：人类

能力：主要拥有在空中飞翔程度的能力

熟悉的巫女小姐。博丽神社的巫女小姐。



伦纳德般耀眼的进攻者「火」

收集受阻的收集狂

雾雨 魔理沙

Kirisame Marisa

种族：人类

能力：使用魔法程度的能力

住在幻想乡的普通的魔法使。有收集癖。



喷薄狂气的狂乱者「木」

狂气的恶作剧妖精

克劳恩皮丝

Clownpiece

种族：妖精

能力：使人发狂程度的能力

地狱的妖精，赫卡提亚的部下，现在暂时是纯狐的部下。



天地异象的混沌者「土」

翻转一切的天邪鬼

鬼人 正邪

Kijin Seija

种族：天邪鬼

能力：让任何事物都翻转过来程度的能力

一直没有放弃下克上企图的天邪鬼。

games.name: Neural Shock
games.shortDescription: Control your Hero to aid your Turrets and Traps in battle in this grim, dark Tower Defense & Action RPG with a scifi-grindhouse aesthetic. Create deadly weapon barrages and fuse together Bleed, Burn, Shock, Freeze, Stun and many more elements to annihilate your enemies.
games.aboutText:
Neural Shock

Build, Fight, Improve, Obliterate. Create bloody mayhem in this ARPG / Tower Defense hybrid by building turrets and traps in strategic positions and fighting waves after waves of ferocious clones and creations of immoral research. As you gain experience in the battlefield, improve and develop your characters and weapons to get more and more powerful and decimate your enemies.

Combining the classic Tower Defense gameplay, graphic pixel-art violence and elements of character building action RPGs set in a grim, dark world, Neural Shock offers the perfect action-packed slaughterfest experience in a scifi-grindhouse setting.

Main Features

- Controllable Hero with a class-specific Special Ability and a Skill Tree with Active & Passive skills

- Floor Traps and Turrets, unlocked within the Trap & Turret Skill Tree. Turrets are placeable only on fixed-position Turret Pods - Floor Traps can be placed anywhere except on pods

- Four Levels of Upgrades to Traps and Turrets, unlocked at specific Skill Levels

- No "mazing" - turrets do not block enemies

- Basic turrets shoot in lines, while most advanced turrets have 360-degree auto-aim

- Weapon types are Physical, Small Arms, Heavy Weapons and Elemental

- 41 Missions (+ tutorial), each with their own Mission Challenges & Side Objectives

- Six different Mission Modifiers to adjust the Difficulty and Experience Reward

- Character Armor and Weapon Rewards for completing Challenges

- Dozens of different viable builds to tinker with - low-Tier and high-Tier weapons can be smoothly combined together

- Skill Points can be reallocated to experiment with different builds

- Challenging but fair Mission and Enemy Design - Become more and more powerful as you learn to know your enemies from head to toe

Class-based Character Building

Pick your favorite class, delve into the monster-filled world and exterminate the horrid creatures to level up and create your optimal build by selecting the best Passive & Active skills for your playstyle. Each Class has their own devastating or crowd-managing Special Ability that can be triggered after stacking enough kills.

As you gain Experience, you gain Levels and Skill Points to allocate in the Character Skill Tree. Gaining a level also rewards you with a Trap & Turret skill point - the Trap & Turret skill points are shared between characters, so it is encouraged to try different characters to stack up your skill points. The skills can be reallocated at any time.

Playable classes in the full release are Sniper and Engineer. The Sniper class is aimed towards players seeking more action and maneuvering, while the Engineer's talent tree serves a more traditional Tower Defense type of gameplay.

Engaging Tower Defense Puzzles

Unique tower defense missions in an engaging, dark and futuristic world, complemented with captivating side objectives that require razor-sharp senses and wits to complete in the most optimal ways. Find the deadliest combinations from a fine selection of over 20+ different turrets and traps.

Visceral Pixel-Art Violence

Tens of different ways for each monster to meet their maker, ranging from getting shredded, electrocuted, burnt to a crisp, melted to a pile of goo, and many others, visualized and animated with crunchy pixel art graphics that don't hide any ounce of blood or drop of gore. Let your creativity run wild as you discover new ways to eradicate the murderous cretins that run amok in this vicious world.

Neural Shock: Total Destruction (v1.1)

The first major content update designated as Neural Shock: Total Destruction was released on March 7th, 2025. The update adds more endgame content, improved replayability of existing missions, as well as numerous visual improvements.

The key features of the update are:

- Chapter 2 with 15 new missions, bringing the total to 42 missions (incl. tutorial)

- New enemies and mini-bosses

- Challenge Mechanic & Equipment Rewards

Skill Tree & Trap/Turret Balance Overhaul

Check the Steam News for more details on the Neural Shock: Total Destruction update.

Story

In 2304, CyTech, a scientific research corporation and defense manufacturer revolutionized warfare after discovering ways to integrate artificial neural networks into humans, allowing soldiers to rapidly develop extraordinary abilities that would far exceed the opposition. However, after multiple generations had been tested in combat with great success, one generation found a way to surpass all other generations by multitudes by altering the genetic composition of the subjects. The subjects started experiencing mutations in their bodies, and over time were found to have experienced a rapid evolution into completely different beings.

This generation was found to be highly aggressive and hostile even towards the creators. Quickly the specimen, who viewed themselves as a superhuman race, rised against humanity and began creating clones of themselves to achieve superiority and control over the h

games.name: Crystallium
games.shortDescription: Crystallium is a furry-themed rhythm game where you build a team of warriors to fight monsters. Vanquish corruption from the dungeons and unearth the ancient mystery that has faded from everyone's memory.
games.aboutText:
Crystallium is a rhythm game where you explore the world with different companions and fight against monsters from the dungeon.

Sync Your Actions to the Beat

In Crystallium, each song becomes a thrilling battle against deadly monsters. Get ready to test your skills by pressing keys and moving your mouse simultaneously. Like other vertical-scrolling rhythm games, you'll use assigned keys to hit the notes within their respective areas. However, in Crystallium, you can utilize not just one key per area, but your entire keyboard! Moreover, when bullets and traps appear, swiftly move your character away using your mouse to ensure your team's victory in battle.

Crystallium offers four difficulty levels: "Crescent", "Lunar", "Astral", and "Bloodlust". Whether you're a beginner or a pro in rhythm games, you'll be able to enjoy a variety of levels. It also features various well-known and small and growing artists across the rhythm game scene, with around 50 songs featuring a wide variety of genres available.

Forge Bonds and Brave the Unknown

As the main character living in a village, you have become a warrior upon reaching your 18th birthday. However, your adventure takes an unexpected turn when your friend's invitation to explore the dungeon leads to a dire situation. To save your friend, two other warriors, Lycurgus and Vermithrax, step in and extend a helping hand, inviting you to an adventure...

Unlock stories, challenges, and rewards anytime. Not in the mood to finish the main story? You can always leave them aside and do quests for rewards.

Conquer Dungeons and Uncover New Tracks

Embark on a Rouguelike dungeon exploration mode to uncover new songs and rewards. Whenever you encounter a monster, defeat it by completing a song. Be careful though, as restrictions might appear to make your exploration more difficult!

games.name: Magic Research 2
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Magic Research 2, an incremental RPG from the creator of Magic Research. Learn countless spells, face powerful foes, and command a team of Wizards who can cast spells for you as you journey to find or create the Philosopher's Stone.
games.aboutText:
Experience the long-awaited sequel to Magic Research!

In Magic Research 2, you are a rookie wizard with a single ambition: to find or create the Philosopher's Stone, a legendary magical item that is said to be able to cure any illness. As you do so, you will learn more than you ever imagined about Magic and about the world around you. What kinds of adventures await you? Features

- Use your arsenal of more than 120 distinct spells to make progress. Create resources, strengthen yourself, launch magical attacks against enemies, and much, much more.

- Study the Elements! Learn new ways to use Magic in your path to mastery. Each Element is distinct, from strengthening your attacks with Fire to improving your Mana regeneration with Water - and you will need them all!

- Transmute (magically craft) over 250 different items to help you on your journey. There are countless synergies - find the best set of equipment for your current build!

- Control a team of Wizards that will cast Spells for you. Automate almost your entire gameplay - your Wizards can even Transmute items for you!

- Enjoy a deep, semi-automated combat system as you make your way through dozens of areas to explore. Fight over 40 unique, challenging bosses, and strategize on how to defeat them.

- Discover tons of secrets, in the form of over 120 Storylines . Obtain permanent bonuses. Many of them will provide powerful bonuses, change the rules of the game, or unlock entirely new features that change the way you play the game . Can you find them all?

- Restart the game and make progress faster each time with retirement bonuses. Re-live the content you have already gone through - but in a fraction of the time it took you at first. And when you catch up, you'll be stronger and ready for the next challenge!

- Over 60 hours of addictive gameplay - with a clear ending! (Or perhaps more than one...?)

You do not need to have played Magic Research in order to enjoy Magic Research 2!

games.name: DEPERSON
games.shortDescription: Aaron wakes up in a nation where obedience is survival. As reality bleeds into a surreal nightmare, he isn’t just running from a regime. He is fleeing something far worse. Unravel Aaron's fate. Confront yourself.
games.aboutText:
DEPERSON is a self-reflective psychological horror adventure where following Aaron's fate through Indrija means confronting your true self.

Depersoned

Aaron is afraid of everything. Even himself.

He wakes up in Indrija, a nation consumed by surveillance and fear, with no memory of who he is.

As reality twists into a surreal nightmare, Aaron begins to fear what might be waiting for him.

Build or Break Him

Explore this twisted world, uncover hidden truths, and shape Aaron into someone stronger, crueler, or even more broken through your choices.

Your decisions will not only shape Aaron’s fate, but the fate of everyone drawn into his journey.

Watch Your Step

Sometimes you’ll need to run. Sometimes you’ll need to think carefully.

Observe your surroundings, use each character’s unique abilities, and manipulate the environment to overcome puzzles and dangers ahead.

Be careful. DEPERSON is not a forgiving game.

games.name: Card Survival: Fantasy Forest
games.shortDescription: Card Survival: Fantasy Forest is a card-based deep survival simulator and the next installment in the Card Survival Series. Carve yourself a home in a primordial forest that has a will of its own. A day-to-day life simulator in a world where nature reigns with mystery, beauty and sometimes cruelty.
games.aboutText:
Card Survival: Fantasy Forest is a card-based deep survival simulator and the next installment in the Card Survival Series.

Experience what life would be like in the primordial forests of old. Carve out a home in a world teeming with beasts, spirits and monsters - where humans have yet to find their place.

Key Features:

Simple but deep System:

A deep and detailed survival simulator in a visual card-based format that benefits from its mechanical simplicity and the power of your imagination.

All interactions are done by using cards or combining them together.

A Living Forest Ecosystem:

Engage with a complex ecosystem featuring dynamically simulated forces (including animal and plant populations) that operate autonomously yet can be meaningfully influenced by your actions. Experience the cyclical nature of life through four distinct seasons and a full weather system.

Realistic Character Simulation:

Simulating the digestive and immune systems, detailed wounds and healing processes, and a mental health model that includes anxiety, mania, depression and altered mind states. Tracking everything from body weight, to calluses, stool consistency and more.

A large variety of content including:

Herbalism:

Forage for different plants, learning where and when to find them, their uses and cultivation methods. Brew and prepare concoctions ranging from immune system boosters to stimulants, analgesics and spiritual enhancers.

Agriculture:

Cultivate a diverse range of crops, considering factors like season, soil nutrients, humidity and light and wind exposure. Utilize different preservation methods to preserve your harvests throughout the year. Grow animal feed, grains for bread and alcohol, seeds for oil, fibers for textiles and more.

Hunting:

Employ traps, spears, and bows to hunt a variety of animals, from small game to dangerous predators and even some of the unique beasts that roam the deeper parts of the forest.

Animal Husbandry:

Raise chicken, pigs, sheep and cows for products like milk, wool or eggs, or slaughter them for their meat and leather. Ensure their safety and comfort by building suitable facilities and attending to their health and well-being.

Cooking:

Create an array of dishes using ingredients like vegetables, fish, meat, cereal and dairy. The taste of your meals will depend on ingredient freshness and quality, spice choice, utensils and your own culinary skills.

Crafting:

Gain proficiency in woodworking, stone knapping, pottery, metalworking and tailoring to create a multitude of different tools and items. Craft your own tools, furniture, clothes, weapons, instruments and decorations.

Building:

Build yourself a forest dwelling, ranging from a rustic hut out of mud and reeds to a cozy wooden cottage. Add extra rooms, improve its insulation, fill it with comfortable and practical furniture and make it yours with meaningful trophies and decorations.

Combat:

Engage in fights against wild animals, monsters and spirits using diverse weapons, skills and techniques. Fight beasts after tracking them through the woods, defend yourself in ambushes or defeat any obstacles in front of you. Overcome your enemies by inflicting fatal wounds or by breaking their will to fight.

Magic:

A grounded, complex and creative system centered around the interaction with elemental, bestial and conceptual spirits. Bind spirits to your soul to gain new abilities, albeit at a personal cost, or craft magical items by trapping spirits within.

games.name: Monster Prom 4: Monster Con
games.shortDescription: Can you find love at the nerdiest convention ever? "Monster Con" goes back to the multiplayer dating sim formula: go through absurd and funny situations as you find love among six sexy monsters! Who will you romance? The mimic who cosplays? The idol clown? Or the eldritch cutie? (There's also Liam)
games.aboutText:
GET READY FOR THE MONSTER CON!

"Monster Prom 4: Monster Con" goes back to the classic dating sim formula from the beloved Monster Prom franchise: you have limited time to find a date among six sexy monsters!
This sequel brings you into a wacky new setting: the Monster Con, a massive convention filled with video games, comic books, anime… and more than a few paranormal activities.
You can expect a multiplayer narrative adventure full of colorful characters and hilarious dialogue!

Explore the Con and fulfill your nerdiest fantasies! Get to know the Con’s crazy staff and visitors: annoying streamers, famous authors, washed-up actors, networking game developers… and so many more! Hang out with your old friends Zoe and Liam, and meet four brand new characters who might win your heart by the end of the Con!

Grab up to three friends or play by yourself. Enjoy the beautiful art and the witty dialogue. Unleash your inner nerd and make the right choices to find a date at the craziest monster-filled convention you'll ever visit!

What can you expect to find at the Monster Con?

- The signature style of the Monster Prom franchise: unique, charming characters and irreverent humor

- New mechanics! During the Con, you’ll get a chance to build your own comic book that you'll get to see by the end of the run.

- Intimate conversations to get to know your favorite characters.

- TONS of beautiful art!

- You can play with friends via local and online multiplayer!

- Compete for the heart of a character! If you share your romantic tastes with your friends, be ready for some stiff competition.

- There's a sexy clown. Honk!

games.name: Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo
games.shortDescription: Are you ready for the first Yoyovania?! In this 2D top-down adventure you'll explore a sprawling urban landscape, reinterpreting your surroundings through your mastery of yoyo tricks. Navigate the city's many districts, fight rival crime bosses, and regain the influence of the Pipistrello family!
games.aboutText:
Explore a vast urban landscape in this exciting 2D top-down platforming adventure!

Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo combines combat, platforming action, puzzle-solving, and exploration — all enveloped in a delightful character-driven story about corporate shenanigans! Face off against the rival crime entrepreneurs and their underlings using the weapon you know best: your prized yoyo! With Yoko Shimomura contributing as guest composer, you're in for a truly authentic nostalgia blast!

Pay close attention to your surroundings to discover new ways to traverse the terrain! With each newly-learned yoyo trick, you'll come to reinterpret the cityscape, and by chaining these maneuvers together, you'll be able to dexterously reach places you could never have imagined! Many challenges have multiple solutions — so come up with your own novel routes in this mouth-watering adventure!

Features

- Explore the city's 4 districts with over 1000 screens' worth of challenges and secrets!

- Infiltrate the businesses of the 4 crime bosses! Navigate their labyrinthine buildings, take on foes, and solve action puzzles!

- Master over 10 yoyo tricks and Special Moves to create your own yoyo-parkour routes and pulverize your enemies in combat!

- Collect over 40 equippable Badges that alter the way you play!

- Unlock over 20 passive Upgrades through a shady loan shark!

- Find over 80 other collectibles throughout town, from life upgrades to precious treasures!

Corporate shenanigans abound!

Pippit, the self-declared yoyo master, has never meshed well with the rest of his family: the powerful and influential Pipistrellos, headed by his auntie, Madame Pipistrello. The family's had a firm grip on their city for over a decade, owing to the monopoly on electricity that they hold.

It just so happens that, when Pippit finally drops by for his annual visit to the Pipistrello Manor, he gets caught up in the rival companies' nefarious plot to dethrone the Madame and take the source of energy generation for themselves! After the attack, Pippit and the Madame find themselves having to cooperate in a completely new arrangement......

The Big City

Your journey takes place across a huge, bustling city run by rival crime entrepreneurs. From shopping districts to industrial complexes, to a geek culture convention and a sports-addicted neighborhood, you'll track down these dastardly crime bosses that have challenged your own family's dominion over the city!

Get ready for the first Yoyovania!

It never hurts to be on the lookout for secret nooks and crannies! Carefully explore the city's districts with the aid of your map, and carve your own path towards the bosses' places of business! Venture into their dangerous lairs, crack puzzles, and be prepared for epic showdowns!

games.name: Pih
games.shortDescription: Pih🥀 is the one and only pig-physics based shooter! Defeat enemy pigs, and don't get "HAMMED🍖" or "SAUSAGED" Oh... also make sure you don't get "GOLD HOGGED", "BOAR'ED" or..."LIL PIGGED" Shoot and punch those hawgs like your life depends on it! And the music is 🔥 Hop on Pih🥀hawg!
games.aboutText:
Pih is a really simple game that you can play on PC or VR.

The goal is to complete each level by collecting all the food , without being killed by the enemy pigs.

The game has 68 levels and 5 bosses. The levels are split into 4 seasons with 1 boss per season + halloween and christmas dlc.

No story, no loading screens, no cutscenes, just gameplay.

Enemies have satisfying ragdoll physics:

Chaos destruction:

Amazing worlds:

games.name: The Real Face of a VTuber
games.shortDescription: A narrative courtroom adventure all about VTubers! Players will take the role of prosecutor Justin Truth and investigate a murder at a VTuber agency, doing their best to uncover the identity of both the killer and VTuber's real face.
games.aboutText:
Story

A grisly murder took place at the offices of Lilien Entertainment, home of famous VTuber "Kuripa," resulting in the death of its founder. The killer can only be one of the company's six employees.

What's weird, though, is that multiple employees all claim to be Kuripa's real face, saying they were streaming at the time of the murder—which is, of course, impossible. As prosecutor Justin Truth, it's your job to get to the bottom of this mystery.

A Hardboiled Detective Comedy

This is a serious detective game, but that doesn't mean it takes itself too seriously. Each suspect has their own colorful personality, and may occasionally get a little ridiculous. But don't let their humor catch you off guard—these are suspects, after all, so anyone could be lying right to your face!

Hunt for Leads Online

You can also hop on the internet to search for clues when necessary. If you're a VTuber fan, you can even hunt for Easter eggs on Kuripa's very own channel. We made a full-fledged social media investigation system, and there's a CAT... which should be enough for you to wishlist this game right now.

Court without the Boring Parts!

Our courtroom segments rely solely on questioning witnesses and presenting evidence! It's court without any of the boring slow parts!

Friendly Witnesses

You'll be working together with your witnesses, guiding them to provide testimonies that will help your case. Make sure you follow the rules, though, or the defense attorney will object and stop you in your tracks!

Hostile Witnesses

When the defense attorney questions her witnesses, it's your turn to poke holes in their testimonies. The second they say something "objectionable," well... you get to say the magic word!

Cross-examinations

Once the defense attorney is done, you can cross-examine her witness. If they say anything that conflicts with evidence you have on hand, don't be shy! Present that evidence and show them who's boss!

Who's the Killer!?

Remember your goal—this whole game is about finding the killer. It's up to you to choose who you think it is, a decision that will directly influence the game's ending. There's only one true killer, of course, which means there's a very real chance of you choosing the wrong one.

Livestreaming Restrictions

Some portions of our game cannot be streamed. Please check our streaming rules in the Community Hub.

Special Note

Even though this game is about uncovering a VTuber's real face, we don't actually condone doing that in real life.

No VTubers were harmed in the making of this game, except for the one in this game.

games.name: Squeakross: Home Squeak Home
games.shortDescription: In Squeakross: Home Squeak Home, solve and transform 800+ puzzles into furniture to decorate the perfect home for your rodent friend. Collect hundreds of decorations, accessories and stickers in this cozy game full of charm!
games.aboutText:
Ever dreamed of being a home owner? Welcome to the Squeakross: Home Squeak Home program!

You just got into a fresh new home for your tiny rodent friend, but… it’s empty! Solve puzzles from the Home Squeak Home Catalog and transform them into splendid furniture and accessories to dress it up!

- Relaxing Puzzle Solving : Learn how to play in 5 minutes, and solve logic-numbers puzzles at your rhythm , no time pressure.

- Scared of puzzles? Worry not! Your rodent friend is here to help. Customize your game experience: Toggle hints , Solve a random cell, or use the brand new Logic-Assist system that lets you preview possible solutions!  

- No assistance needed? You can disable all those options if you prefer to be challenged.

Our Home Squeak Home catalog features many different styles of interior decor, from basic housing supplies to extravagant ones to match a broad range of tastes. You will also find many accessories to dress your rodent friend.

Aaah… The joy of seeing a Squeakross puzzle transform into a beautiful object is so satisfying!

Shape your rodent to your liking in the world's first Rodent Editor (we think??). From snout to tail, decide what kind of friend you want to have by your side!

Made for rodent lovers by rodent lovers, we made sure to offer plenty of options for you to be able to recreate your beloved pets in game.

FEATURES:

- A Nonogram game like no other.

- 800+ puzzles to solve!

- Relaxing puzzle-solving, with no time limit, mindful of new players.

- Logic-Assist system that lets you preview possible solutions.

- Decorate your home with hundreds of unique furniture.

- Create and customize your own rodent with accessories.

- Customize your user interface with unlockable stickers made by Eon.

- Receive tips and lore from Nini, the owner of Home Squeak Home Inc.

- "Streamer mode" to turn off Content ID tagged music

Note: NO generative AI was used during the making of the game. We have a firm no-AI stance for ALL of our games, past, present and future.

games.name: Dungeon Dev
games.shortDescription: Under the Demon Lord's orders, following a secret deal with the human kingdom, you must create a special dungeon that will satisfy the kingdom's heroes. Strategically place monsters and traps according to the roles of the heroes, such as "Tank," "Dealer," and "Healer," to design this unique dungeon!
games.aboutText:
After striking a secret deal with the king of the human kingdom, the Demon Lord has commanded you to create a special dungeon.

A dungeon where the heroes of the kingdom will be satisfied as they clear it!

As the dungeon developer in the Demon Lord’s castle, your task is to strategically place monsters and traps to craft this unique dungeon.

According to the secret deal with the human king, your goal is to 'lose' to the heroes invading the dungeon.

While fighting in the dungeon with monsters and traps, you must still ensure the heroes emerge victorious.

Design a dungeon that allows the heroes to successfully clear it!

Simply losing to the heroes isn't enough.

To keep the secret deal with the human king hidden, you must also meet the expectations based on each hero's role.

Consider the roles of 'Tank,' 'Damage Dealer,' and 'Healer' and create a dungeon that fulfills their needs!

From the Royal Knights of the human kingdom, wild creatures invading the dungeon, ragtag heroes, noblemen's private soldiers, to veteran warriors...

As you design your dungeon, you'll face numerous heroes and obstacles.

Use your keen judgment to overcome these challenges and create a dungeon that satisfies every hero!

Inspired by the experience of a game developer’s level design process, this game challenges you to design a dungeon that satisfies all the heroes while maintaining the right difficulty.

Experience the work of a game developer firsthand with 'Dungeon Dev'!

games.name: Sojourn Past
games.shortDescription: Sojourn Past is an exploration game, a journey of finding hope in the face of adversary. Set in a handcrafted world, discover it’s mysteries, overcome its tough bullet-hell inspired challenges and embrace hope in this action-adventure.
games.aboutText:
Sojourn Past is an exploration focused action-adventure about overcoming loss.

Journey through an intricately connected world as you embark on a path of adversity and growth. Overcome its many bullet-hell inspired challenges, uncover secrets, discover hidden paths, and awaken new abilities along the way.

MASTER UNIQUE ABILITIES

Master abilities like the teleportation dagger to break through enemy lines, escape danger, or reach otherwise inaccessible places.

EXPLORE AN INTERCONNECTED WORLD

Venture through a seamlessly connected world filled with handcrafted environments. Uncover hidden routes, discover powerful artifacts, and unlock new paths and abilities to traverse it.

BULLET-HELL INSPIRED COMBAT

Dash, dodge, and fight your way through intense bullet-hell inspired combat that tests your abilities.

FIGHT CHALLENGING BOSSES

Engage in fast-paced, skill-based combat against challenging enemies and difficult bosses that push your skills to the limit.

UNCOVER SECRETS AND HIDDEN MYSTERIES

A world of discovery awaits those who look deeper.

FROM A SMALL TEAM

A passion project from our small indie team at ReDimension.

games.name: TouHou Makuka Sai ~ Fantastic Danmaku Festival Part III
games.shortDescription: "Touhou Makuka Sai ~ Fantastic Danmaku Festival Part III" is a bullet hell shooting game with a distinctive, glamorous presentation style. It is the third game in the Touhou Makuka Sai series. The strange moon seems to hide a new conspiracy. Charge into the deep world on the eternal night!
games.aboutText:
Even without experience in shooting games, you can easily enjoy the unique danmaku art and experience the thrill of bullet-hell battles!

"Touhou Makuka Sai ~ Fantastic Danmaku Festival Part III" is a bullet hell shooting game with a distinctive, glamorous presentation style. It is the third game in the Touhou Makuka Sai series. The strange moon seems to hide a new conspiracy. Charge into the deep world on the eternal night!

★ The story

Under the influence of the second spring snow "incident", Gensokyo passed a brief summer and welcomed the autumn wind. The annual Mid-Autumn Festival event - the Lunar Capital Exhibition - was held as scheduled, but this year seemed livelier than usual. As the full moon, emitting strange moonlight, rose, a huge curtain that spanned Gensokyo had quietly fallen. Before everyone could react, the night sky of Gensokyo had completely paused, and many youkai that were usually only heard in rumors had appeared. And tonight's Lunar Capital Exhibition banquet was attracting batches of nearby youkai to come...

★ New character

Coming Soon

★ About Fujiwara no Mokou

For her, countless deadly battles took place in the bamboo forest every day, and sudden large-scale conflicts like this were nothing out of the ordinary. However, as she watched the youkai uprising gradually escalate to a point where both Keine and Mokou were struggling to cope, and even Keine began to act strangely, she finally decided not to stay out of it any longer.

"Gensokyo may have already been enveloped in the chamber created by Eientei, it seems that individual intends to expand this grand event to the entire place."

★ Game feature

֍ Enhanced art effects bring you a greater sense of detail

֍ Fiercer and more intense bullets provide you with a thrilling experience

֍ More friendly beginner guides allow even inexperienced players to enjoy the game

֍ Brand new storyline performances accompanied by exhilarating music

֍ New difficulties and systems, along with more content waiting for you to explore

games.name: Planetka
games.shortDescription: You play as a tiny sentient planet. Maintain your ecosystem, create new plant species and discover the hidden powers inside you. You’ll need them soon, because there is a human spaceship approaching with the intention to mine all your resources and they don’t care if it kills you in the process.
games.aboutText:
Play as a tiny planet defending itself against mining expeditions.

- Experience a game from the point of view of a planet

- Fight the invaders in a hectic and strategic gameplay experience

- Control the environment to deal with the invaders

- Discover various plant species and their effects

- And maybe even find the secret peaceful ending

games.name: Imitosis
games.shortDescription: A free 5-minute visual novel. A security concern demands your attention.
games.aboutText:
Imitosis is an experimental 5-minute visual novel. You are a synthetic IMI-X unit that has been brought out of cold storage to respond to a pressing security matter aboard the IMI-29 space station.

Thank you for keeping IMI-29 safe.

games.name: 100 Funny Cats
games.shortDescription: 🤡🎪🐾100 Funny Cats - Join the cutest adventure in the funny themed locations full of cats! 🤣🎈🐈 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of the Circus and Cats hidden throughout the game. 🕵️‍♂️❌ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈✅
games.aboutText:
🤡🎪🐾 WELCOME TO 100 FUNNY CATS – THE BEST HIDDEN OBJECTS GAME! 🤣🎈

Join the cutest adventure in the Funny world full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of circus themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.
Test your attention and observation skills in this cozy and delightful hidden object game.
Each cat is more charming than the last, and every discovery brings a smile to your face. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

⚙️ Key Features ⚙️

- 🎮 1 Level

- 🐈 100 Hidden Cats

- 🎮 1 Extra Level

- 🐈 100 Extra Hidden Cats

- 🎵 Awesome Soundtrack

- 🎨 High Quality Resolution Artworks

- 🌗 Brightness Settings

🏆 START YOUR AMAZING JOURNEY IN THE WORLD OF CATS RIGHT NOW 🏆
