games.name: Mohrta
games.shortDescription: Mohrta is a nonlinear FPS adventure through the strange and otherworldly. Explore a vast selection of unique environments, slay an enormous cast of bizarre creatures, and upgrade your arsenal of multifaceted weapons.
games.aboutText:
Explore a unique FPS game unlike any other

Mohrta is a tempered and atmospheric FPS adventure, where you delve into unique and bizarre dimensions, fight gnarly creatures, and defeat deific bosses. Tackle these areas and bosses in any order that you choose, build and upgrade your arsenal to suit your playstyle, and uncover a hidden truth behind the events of the game’s story.

Game Features

- Play through the game's five enormous and differently-themed dimensions in any order you choose.

- Soak in the otherworldly atmosphere and lovingly-crafted level design.

- Fight though a myriad of highly-detailed environments that push the limits of GZDoom.

- Explore unusual settings, characters, and enemies fleshed out in beautiful signature Scumhead detail, featuring designs by Osiol.

- Acquire a huge roster of weapons, each with multiple functions and utility.

- Upgrade your equipment to defeat greater challenges.

- Over 50 diverse enemies and 20 challenging boss fights to dodge, shoot, and strike through.

- Befriend a huge cast of strange and loveable NPCs, each with their own quests and storylines.

The Story So Far...

The Great Strange- a zone in which supernatural phenomena occur at an abnormal rate, where echoes of other worlds and ethereal beings converge and contort reality.

A special military group known as "The Hayward" was formed to investigate and destroy the anomalies within The Strange. For years, the Hayward had done an admirable job of monitoring, handling, and reverse-engineering elements of the Great Strange into their work. Among these Hayward operatives is where your remains found new life.

You are Hayward Generation VII 81363-7, a corpse swathed in iron and arcane. Though a newer model, you are no guest to the Strange and a formidable veteran of its wilds.

Recently, the Great Strange has begun to rapidly expand- its phenomena intensifying to an unseen degree. Current leads suggest the involvement of Hayward Generation I "Avlan", whose disappearance synchronizes with the Strange’s sudden proliferation.

Mission Objective: Enter the mining village of Kozanoda where Avlan was last spotted and apprehend the missing Gen I.

Use of lethal force is authorized. Use of paranormal apparatus is authorized. Exercise extreme caution when confronting Avlan. Minimize injuries to civilians and infrastructure. Attempt capture where possible. Mission subject may be terminated if need be.

games.name: Holy Shoot
games.shortDescription: Holy Shoot is a fast-paced roguelite action FPS set in a satirical version of Hell, packed with chaos, blessed heroes, and demonic bosses. Pick your hero, dive into hell, upgrade your build, and shoot your way through sin.
games.aboutText:
Holy Shoot is a fast-paced roguelike FPS packed with chaos, style, and comedy. Start as a Sanctum warrior and battle through sin-themed levels filled with traps, demons, and bizarre bosses. Upgrade your powers, unlock new heroes, and blast your way through hell one ridiculous run at a time.

Fast-paced Rogue-lite FPS

Holy Shoot is all about speed, chaos, and humor. Blast your way through randomized level layouts filled with cursed enemies and explosive surprises. Every run offers a fresh challenge and new ways to bring the pain.

Play as Sanctum’s Finest Misfits

Start your journey as Supersonic Samuel, a lightning-fast warrior with divine reflexes. As you progress, unlock new heroes like Toshiko Techno. From divine speed to tech-powered tricks, every character brings something different to the battlefield. Their strengths shape how you play, and the rest is up to what you find along the way.

Build, Upgrade, and Adapt

Unlock powerful perks mid-run and earn currencies to buy permanent upgrades back at HUB. Mix and match upgrades to suit your style, and build your own flavor of divine destruction.

A HUB Full of Sanctum Oddballs

After each chaotic run, you return to your home base. This lively headquarters is where angelic blueprints are drafted, cakes are sliced, and tea is definitely preferred over coffee. Chat with quirky NPCs as you regroup, unlock permanent upgrades, and prepare to dive back into hell even stronger.

Weapons with Personality

From chunky shotguns to nail-spitting rifles and boom-happy grenade launchers, every weapon feels unique. Each one packs a punch, looks cool, and delivers comic-style chaos with attitude.

Stylized Visuals and Comedic Chaos

Each level is themed around a different Deadly Sin, with hand-painted environments, stylized hazards, and comic-style effects. From crumbling ruins overflowing with gold to wrath-filled lava chambers, every setting cranks up the absurdity. Combat stays fast and flashy, delivering chaos with a chuckle.

games.name: SuperTaxCity
games.shortDescription: A new sensation!? City-building × Roguelike game *Super Tax City*. Choose and place your favorite facilities from randomly drawn options! The combinations are endless! Create a profitable city that's uniquely yours!
games.aboutText:
A new sensation!? City-building × Roguelike game *Super Tax City*.

Choose and place your favorite facilities from randomly drawn options!

The combinations are endless! Create a profitable city that's uniquely yours!

Rules

Choose a facility from three options and place it on the map!

When randomly moving residents enter a facility, they perform tasks and earn rewards!

When the time limit expires, it's tax time.

Pay your taxes with the money you've earned!

About the Facilities

Over 100 types of unique facilities with distinctive effects are featured!

About the items

Enhance your city even further with over 100 different items!

The combinations are endless!

Create a profitable city that's uniquely yours!

Streaming Guidelines

1) You are free to stream and upload gameplay videos without prior notice, regardless of whether you are an individual or corporation, and regardless of whether your activities are for profit or not.

2) If possible, please include the URL of the Steam page in the description.

3) We take no responsibility for any damages that may occur as a result of streaming this game. Additionally, the content of these guidelines may be changed without prior notice.

games.name: DEVIL BLADE REBOOT
games.shortDescription: An immersive pseudo-3D shoot 'em up experience that pushes the limits of pixel art. Push your score higher with the innovative Berserk System: the closer they are, the more points you get!
games.aboutText:
DEVIL BLADE REBOOT

●Overview

Devil Blade, a 1996 indie shmup released only in Japan,

has received a full remake almost a quarter century later by the original creator,

taking advantage of the latest technology.

Dive into an immersive pseudo-3D experience that pushes the limits of pixel art.

With a perfect fusion of background music and evolving stage design,

you can experience a feeling only possible in a SHMUP!

Devil Blade Reboot is presented in a seamless and cohesive package,

for the first time in English!

Simply "dodge, shoot, and destroy" without any extra baggage.

Devil Blade Reboot strictly follows a strict design concept that pursues

catharsis of shmups to the extreme.

But, as they say... no pain, no gain! If you want to enhance your score,

you will have to shoot down enemies in close proximity. The closer they are,

the higher the score multiplier. With the Berserk System,

dangerous play is the way to climb the ladder, as high risk brings high reward.

●Features

【2D pixel art graphics with an obsessive level of detail.】

Rendered in the original native 320x240 resolution of the classics,

but with visuals that defy the limits of pixel art! Experience immersive pseudo-3D,

making use of modern techniques such as multiple parallax scrolling and zoom effects.

【Berserk System】

The closer you let them get, the higher your score will climb!

Dramatically increase the score... and the difficulty, by destroying enemies in close range!

The difficulty level changes drastically depending on the way you play the game.

From beginners who just want to clear the game,

to advanced players chasing the highest score possible,

Devil Blade Reboot is designed to be enjoyed by anyone interested in the genre.

【Retro and Reboot Mode】

While the enhancements of Reboot are visually stunning,

some may want to look back in history to see the origins of Devil Blade. We have you covered.

Included is an Arrange mode of the original "Devil Blade" created in Dezaemon+ in 1996

with the Berserk system added but the original atmosphere preserved.

Experience this retro recreation of a classic shmup,

delivered here for the first time outside of Japan.

●Specs

・Ultra-hardcore, 100% pure, mechanics-focused vertical scrolling shmup

・Two types of shots + bombs - back to basics

・Berserk System increases score when enemies are destroyed nearby

・Story mode to play through all 6 stages in order

・Stage select to choose any stage to replay

・Four levels of difficulty that can be changed at the player's discretion

・Retro Mode that recreates the original Dezaemon+ version is included

・Unlockables that reward repeat playthroughs

・STEAM achievements and global rankings

・Multilingual localization handled by passionate shmup fans

・Heavily customizable settings to tune the game to your liking

・Built using the dedicated shmup game engine Shooting Game Builder

・Intense soundtrack by hasu drives the gameplay

※Dezaemon Plus is a shmup creation tool,

originally released in Japan for PlayStation on May 24, 1996.

●Support

・The "Guidelines for Live Streaming" are intended as a consideration and a request,

　and are not intended to be legally binding.

games.name: Doll Impostor
games.shortDescription: Doll Impostor is a horror game where 1-4 players take on the role of guardians of possessed dolls. Work together to identify the impostor doll before 9 a.m, or face dire consequences. Every hour counts in this tense, fear-filled race against time.
games.aboutText:
Attention: This game contains Jumpscares! (can disable it)

Your objective is to find the impostor doll, which will play with you to avoid being caught. Perform the following steps:

- Find clues and evidence that the impostor leaves behind

- Study and analyze their movements

- Discard candidates

- Find the impostor before 9 AM

The dolls have their own objectives, preferences, friendships, enmities, loves, and hatreds towards circumstances, events, or other dolls.

Traps will help you catch conservative dolls; perhaps tempting them by turning on music or a television will make them react, allowing you to better interpret their tastes and appreciations.

Do not trust their actions; these dolls are much smarter than you think. They are capable of moving others from their place and annihilating other dolls in order to confuse you, especially if you do not know each doll well.

You might assume that everything is over if you find a single doll out of its box. However, it may not have moved on its own; another doll might have moved it, or even moved many others while it remains completely still.

It's extremely important that you keep the door closed; failing to do so could have catastrophic consequences, from letting the impostor escape to altering the order of your eliminations, or even preventing you from making it through the night.

games.name: BattleCap
games.shortDescription: Dive into an exhilarating maritime battle for 1 to 4 players! Assemble warships with a variety of bottle caps, allowing the warships to transform and break, experiencing flexible physics that brings a refreshing maritime battle! Fight monsters together, or engage in a battle with your friends.
games.aboutText:
BattleCap is a casual naval combat shooting game suitable for 1 to 4 players. Come on, become a top BattleCap sailor, pick up the caps floating on the sea, and assemble your own battleship! Engage in thrilling battles with friends or join forces to defeat those furious sea monsters, enjoying the endless fun of the clash of various warships and tactics!

Collect Caps and Naval Combat Shooting

Bid farewell to the rigid control of traditional naval warfare; the Nymph's battleship offers a refreshing experience. The operation is simple, allowing you to master it in just a few minutes!

Gather the scattered caps, glue them into a powerful turret, and craft a giant battleship capable of extending and transforming!

Three Major Battle Zones, Diverse Maps

From mysterious ruins to devilish whirlpools, experience a variety of environmental features and tactical shifts. Utilize the scene's mechanisms to gain an advantage!

Roguelite Elements Throughout the Party

Want to be stronger? Acquire powerful caps from airdrops or purchase blessings and relics from the store to bestow more special abilities upon your battleship!

Cap Party (Party PVP Mode, Multiplayer only)

- In the Party PVP mode, experience the intense and exhilarating three-round tournament, challenging multiple meticulously designed map stages.

- The selection of your battleship and the random map will jointly determine your subsequent tactical strategy—will you charge recklessly or develop cautiously?

- Also, look forward to the mid-game mini-games that could spike your blood pressure!

Sea Monster Fishing (Cooperative PVP Mode, Single Player or Multiplayer)

- Even more Roguelite elements: Collect rare blessings and relics to fortify your BattleCap flagship and embark on an unprecedented naval battle!

- Defend the Nymph's camp against waves of enemy assaults!

- In addition to solo challenges, you can also invite friends to collaborate, sharing the pressure from the sea monsters and offering mutual support.

Join BattleCap now and assemble your battleship!

games.name: Novice Dungeon Master
games.shortDescription: A dungeon management sim in a fantasy world of adventurers and dungeons. Become master of the Novice Dungeon and run it your way. A popular dungeon adventurers flock to, or a deadly one full of monsters and traps? The choice is yours. But every choice has a price. What ending awaits your dungeon?
games.aboutText:
A fantasy world where adventurers and dungeons coexist.

By sheer chance, you've become the Master of the Novice Dungeon , and you have just 30 days.

Can you turn this dungeon into an A-Rank dungeon, as the contract demands?

Lure in Adventurers

Herbalists, Miners, Elves, Wizards, even Goblins. Every adventurer who visits your dungeon wants something different.

Place herbs, ores, and all kinds of facilities to satisfy adventurers and raise your dungeon's Popularity.

Defend Your Dungeon with Traps and Monsters

Adventurers seeking dangerous thrills call for a fitting response.

Summon monsters to fight off adventurers.

Lure treasure hunters straight into your traps.

Raise and Evolve Your Own Units

From Slimes to Griffins, there are over 30 units and more than 100 traits.

Are your monsters too weak to defend the dungeon? Don't worry. They can grow stronger.

Uncover hidden conditions and evolve them.

Beyond the Dungeon: Expeditions

When night falls, set out through the World Tree with your dungeon's units to faraway lands.

Conquer new regions and discover rare rewards.

7 Endings Shaped by Your Choices

A popular dungeon everyone wants to visit, or a deadly dungeon no one returns from alive.

The story changes depending on the dungeon you build and the bonds you form.

What ending awaits you after 30 days?

Again and Again

Want to take on higher difficulties, run your dungeon endlessly, or meet every unit?

Multiple difficulty levels, Endless Mode, collections, and New Game Plus await.

games.name: Undusted: Letters from the Past
games.shortDescription: Undusted: Letters from the Past is a casual game in which you clean and restore dirty items. What is her story as she returns to a long-neglected house? Enjoy the satisfying audiovisuals featuring sensually designed sounds and graphics.
games.aboutText:
IIn Undusted: Letters from the Past, you are tasked with cleaning items that have fallen into disrepair.

Dust, scrub, and polish your way through the chapters to learn the personal backstory behind each item.

Adora returns home after her mother's passing.

She starts to clean long-neglected items inside her family home.

As those items are restored to their original conditions, they start whispering memories of the past.

As Adora cleans, she discovers a myriad of forgotten stories, some hidden away.

What kind of stories will she experience?

Virtual ASMR

Experience carefully crafted sound effects that capture the essence of each tool you use.

Each chapter's ambient audio will wholly immerse you in the game!

A Touching Story

Recall the memories associated with each item.

When did Adora and her mother's relationship start to fall apart?

Will she be able to finally understand her mother after her passing?

A Charming Art Style

Appreciate a captivating art style that is uniquely expressed through pixelated textures.

Game Features

- Experience a heartfelt and emotional story about family.

- Forget about time limits and failure—just relax and enjoy! The items won't break like they would in real life!

- Admire beautiful artwork that charmingly portrays Adora's story.

- Listen to original background music that complements the relaxing gameplay.

- Enjoy the oddly satisfying feeling from ASMR and restoration videos, but in a game!

games.name: Not an Aim Trainer
games.shortDescription: Not an Aim Trainer is a Cozy Aim Trainer with heart warming story and cute minigames.
games.aboutText:
A
STORY

Yasma escapes into new realities through video games and her art, adventuring through different aim training scenarios; she aims to be the best.

ABOUT

Play through visually rich aim training levels portrayed as moments of escapism in Yasma’s world. Each collection of levels has their own stand alone narrative like Yasma saving the Princess in the handheld console game, Yasma’s drawings unveiling themselves through the levels and Yasma dance battling the characters from the console game

Like a traditional Aim Trainer, there will be varying familiar aim training scenarios you can play through. There will also be a few unconventional levels that cater more to the story!

FEATURES: - 3 Story Modes
- Unique Aim Training Levels
- Mini Games
- An Original Soundtrack

Header art by @mizrii_ (twitter) <3

games.name: Pieced Together
games.shortDescription: Pieced Together is a cozy scrapbooking game that takes you on a heartfelt journey about friendship and getting older. Sort items, solve gentle puzzles, and decorate the scrapbook as you uncover the story piece by piece.
games.aboutText:
Discover a heartfelt story through the pages of a beautiful scrapbook.

Sort through mementos and solve light puzzles on every page to discover the real-life-inspired story of Connie and Beth’s friendship. Enjoy 1 to 2 hours of carefully crafted playtime full of emotional highs and lows - and plenty of cats!

Meet Connie , a 30-something looking back on a difficult time in her life: at 10 years old, her family was uprooted to the city, leaving her feeling lost and alon e. Just as she was at her lowest, a new friend came into the picture - bold, confident Beth ! The were inseparable all through their school years.

Now, it's been years since they spoke. Connie is using her scrapbook to sort through her memories, and her feelings, about this friendship from the past, penning an emotional letter to her former best friend as she goes.

Connie needs to decide: does she want to reach out, or is the past best left behind?

Enjoy a variety of scrapbooking activities and light puzzles - every page is unique!

You'll find yourself doing all sorts of activities in the book's pages, whether its sorting mementos , reassembling torn up photos, or solving gentle logic and word puzzles - the scrapbook is full of surprises! As you uncover the story, you'll also step into Connie's shoes as she relives the past through unique emotional moments.

Of course, it wouldn't be scrapbooking without decoration - unlock new stickers in every chapter and use them to customise pages!

What Pieced Together offers:

- 1-2 hours of light puzzles

- A carefully crafted, poignant story about life, friendship and getting older

- Beautiful illustrations and hand-drawn animations

- Stickers to decorate with

- An original acoustic soundtrack

- High quality voice acting

It doesn’t offer:

- Hardcore brain-teasers

- Branching narrative

- Free-form creative mode

Glowfrog Games is a tiny company of two people, Kate and Ellie, who left the world of free-to-play to make more meaningful games together. Pieced Together is the studio’s first game, built with the help of a talented freelance team. We poured a lot of our personal experiences into the story and its details, and we hope you enjoy playing it as much as we enjoyed making it!

games.name: Reclaim The Living
games.shortDescription: Reclaim The Living is a zombie horde-survivor roguelike where you play as Dr. J. Ferret, an eccentric scientist who developed a cure capable of turning the infected back to normal. Expand your laboratory and upgrade your arsenal of gadgets to save humanity!
games.aboutText:
Reclaim The Living is a zombie horde-survivor roguelike where you play as Dr. J. Ferret, an eccentric scientist who developed a cure capable of turning the infected back to normal.

Cure zombies, lead survivors to safety and rebuild your secret laboratory to grow your arsenal of gadgets.

A Zombie Curing Roguelike

Armed with the wonder cure, return the zombies back to humans and lead them to safety.

For your efforts, the survivors will reward you with 100+ unique upgrades to customize your build.

Zombie Virus Mutations

In Reclaim The Living, the zombies grow in power alongside you.

During your run, you'll need to choose how the virus mutates. These mutations can range from giving zombies resistance to the cure to spawning special zombies with unique mechanics.

Rebuild your Secret Laboratory

Your Lab was destroyed by the apocalypse but, with the resources you collect on the surface, you'll be able to return it to its former glory.

Build various stations and machines to grow your arsenal of gadgets and unlock a range of meta progression upgrades.

games.name: Trizna
games.shortDescription: “Trizna” is a classic plot-driven 2.5D metroidvania filled with intense battles utilizing the unique features of weapons, evasions, parries, and counterattacks. Explore the mysterious and eerie realm deeply intertwined with pagan beliefs, with blade, magic and a keen mind.
games.aboutText:
The Game

A nameless fallen warrior, not buried according to the rite and raised by a powerful ancient witch, becomes a mindless tool to help her achieve goals hidden behind an arcane veil.
By exploring the world and becoming stronger, the hero will get an opportunity to gain will and start to pursue his own goals, willingly side with the witch or her equally obscure opponents, or remain a puppet, driven by the will of ancient forces.

The world of the game is a hidden domain of embodied ideas, the materialization of mythological tropes, human fears and aspirations that have taken on flesh.
A crucial part of the plot and gameplay will also be the Shadow Realm - the unstable state of this world, where fears and aspirations are not yet fully realized and formalized.
The setting is inspired in many aspects by Slavic culture and mythology. Features

- A world tailored from several radically different settings, allowing you to freely move between locations to advance through the plot, explore and find secrets.

- At any moment hero is able to shift to the Shadow Realm - an unstable and distorted state of the world, inhabited by even stranger creatures, allowing one to overcome otherwise impassable obstacles and hiding many treasures and answers to questions.

- Intense combat based on the search and exploitation of enemy weaknesses and use of different combat techniques, including dodging, rolling, blocking, parrying and using the features of various types of weapons.

- Special acquired skills that will not only allow you to overcome previously impassable obstacles, but will also be woven into the combat system, expanding the arsenal of available techniques and their combinations.

- Secrets stuffed with secrets with a secret sauce.

- A modular equipment system that includes body armor, helmets, arm and leg armor, amulets, shields, one-handed, two-handed and ranged weapons.

- A system for developing combat and magical skills that allows you to form your preferred fighting style.

games.name: Puffin Planes
games.shortDescription: A casual airline management game set on Earth and Mars. Supports singleplayer and Steam co-op.
games.aboutText:
Fly from Tokyo to LA, the short way.

Build your dream airline network on a custom-made globe of the Earth as you listen along to the game's original music. Or if you want, you can even play on terraformed Mars!

Compete with other airlines.

Advertise, construct hotels or steal concourses at airports to gain the upper hand against your competitors. Then, kick them out of your hub airports or purchase them outright in a hostile takeover.

Hub-and-spoke or point-to-point?

You decide. You can centralize your network to build a hub or utilize the game's flexibility to send your planes on long multi-city cycles.

Airports are ever-evolving.

At the start of the game they can spawn with random bonuses, and as the game continues you must make decisions such as building hubs, lounges and more in order to optimize your network.

Choose your flyer.

Play as the luxurious Flamingo, which receives bonus income from all lounges. Soar further than others with the Eagle, who gets a boost to plane range. Play as the Crow, Gull, Ostrich or more...all with their own unique bonuses.

Play with your friends.

Invite or join your friends through Steam and build a global airline network together.

games.name: 星影の館殺人事件
games.shortDescription: 1935年の洋館を舞台に織り成す、レトロな雰囲気の怪異ホラーミステリーアドベンチャー
games.aboutText:
あらすじ

1935年　ある秋のこと・・・

仕事へ向かう道中、腹痛に見舞われ
Ｔ県のある診療所に入院していたアナタは、
町人たちとの会話から《探偵》であると勘違いされていた。

無事退院し町を去ろうとしたとき、
ある少女が息を荒げてアナタに声をかける。

「助けてください！」
「人が・・・殺されたんです！」

アナタは導かれるまま、
事件のあったという《星影の館》へやってくる。

被害者は密室で死亡していた。

アナタは事件性があると推測するが、
家の者たちは不慮の事故だと思いこみ、
死体を早々に片づけようとしている。

だが、少女はあくまで《殺人事件》を主張した。

彼女の元に、差出人不明の
《手紙》が届いていたからだ。

《この事件は人為的なものである》
《ただちに現場を保存し、診療所の探偵を頼れ》

《さもなくば・・・》
《新たな　死者　が出るでろう》

アナタは素人ながらも、
現場や関係者から情報を集め、
複雑に絡み合った事件の謎を解きほぐしていく。

games.name: An alt girl for skoof
games.shortDescription: There is a rumor that any skuf can legally receive a fee alt girl from the state; to do this, you just need to log in to a special service and enter your personal data.
games.aboutText:
You don’t have a wife, you’re well over forty, your worldview is firmly formed, but there is no happiness in your life? Don’t worry, you just need to remember your Skoofuslugi password, and in a few clicks you can get your rightful alt girl!

Immersive first-person skoof simulator in a visual novella format, cobbled together within one month – it’s the best you can get in this genre with this amount of money. Okay, you can find better things. You’re right. By the way, what’s “immersive”?

SKOOF - In Russian contemporary slang, the word means a kind of nasty man about 30-50 years old, looking older than he actually is, due to bad physical condition, obesity, baldness, smoking, bad job, ugly wife and three kids etc. (Urban Dictionary)
ALTOOSHKA - literally means alt girl, but in more Russian way. Alt girls are supposed to be girls that wear alternative fashion (goth, emo, etc.), listen to non-mainstream music, and are usually left winged. Game features:

- It’s the first game about skoofs and alt girls.

- Feel like a forty year old unmarried man, overweight and lacking hair.

games.name: Cheap Car Repair
games.shortDescription: Cheap Car Repair - go back in time to Poland of the 90's. Run your own Cheap Car Repair shop. Look for savings wherever you can. Make lots of money and avoid angry customers!
games.aboutText:
Step into the shoes of a small-town mechanic running a shady little car workshop somewhere deep in the Polish countryside of the 1990s.
Except this isn’t just any village… this is “Bumfuck Nowhere” — the kind of place where nothing works properly, everyone knows your business, and common sense was abandoned years ago.

And right in the middle of this glorious dump stands you… covered in grease, broke as hell, and trying to keep your garage alive.

Money is tight, so you’ll need to get creative and cut corners wherever possible:
- Dent in the fender? Just slap some filler on it!
- Pantyhose instead of a fan belt? Good enough!
- Watered-down fuel? The customer probably won’t notice!

As long as the car survives long enough to leave the garage, you make a profit.
But things don’t always go according to plan. If your repair job falls apart, angry customers may come back looking for more than just a refund…

Become a master of questionable bodywork. You can fix things properly… or just cheaply. Painting over rust never hurt anybody, right?

If it’s round enough, it can probably be used as a steering wheel. Genuine parts are for rich people anyway.

Got a steering wheel? Perfect — time for a ride! Explore the open world of Bumfuck Nowhere, discover hidden secrets, side missions, and all kinds of weird local activities.

A kitchen sponge works just as well as an air filter. If you can’t see the difference, why pay extra?

Diluting fuel with water doesn’t surprise anyone around here anymore… but somehow getting a car running on beer and vodka is still impressive.

Shady traders, annoying neighbors, village weirdos, and countless other characters are waiting for you. Some will help you make money — others will make your life miserable.

Looks like you made somebody angry. Your workshop has been trashed, so it’s time to renovate the place and get back to business.

Repair rusty old Polish cars using all kinds of bizarre and creative methods:
- patch up bodywork, fill dents, paint panels, clean dirt, and scrape away rust,
- replace broken parts using either proper components or suspiciously cheap substitutes,
- disassemble and reassemble car parts, remembering that every bolt matters,
- jack up vehicles, remove wheels, and slowly turn complete wrecks into barely functioning machines.

Running a garage isn’t just about repairs.
You’ll have to balance costs, quality, and profit, because every shortcut can come back to haunt you.

Outside the workshop, additional story-driven missions await, letting you experience the life of John the Mechanic, explore the surrounding countryside, and meet the strange people living in this forgotten place.

So what are you waiting for? Grab your wrench and start cutting corners!
Rusty junkers, furious customers, broken parts, village drama, and pure automotive chaos — welcome to the world of “Cheap Car Repair”!

games.name: Astrometica: Prologue
games.shortDescription: Astrometica: Prologue is the free game about surviving in space. You need to use your skills and tools to stay alive. There are many challenges to face, and you need to fight to survive. You also need to build a new base in space.
games.aboutText:
SURVIVE IN SPACE

Dive into Astrometica Prologue, a free space survival adventure where you're tested against the cosmos's harshest environments. This prologue offers a taste of our full game, featuring innovative systems for battery management, vehicle operation, crafting, and research to enrich your gameplay. It's more than survival; it's about strategy, adaptation, and exploration in the vast unknown—now accessible for free. Welcome to your cosmic playground and battlefield. Embark on this journey and conquer the mysteries of space.

🌠COLLECT USEFUL RAW MATERIALS:

In Astrometica Prologue, the cosmos is rich with resources waiting to be discovered. You'll venture into the vast recesses of space and abandoned bases to collect dozens of raw materials, each integral to your survival and progression. Elevate your resource gathering with advanced technology: deploy drills to bore into the heart of asteroids and set up automatic miners, sophisticated machines designed to autonomously extract raw materials. This intricate system of resource collection not only fuels your journey but also immerses you in the role of a space pioneer, strategizing the best ways to utilize these assets for survival, crafting, and beyond. Embark on this adventure, where the wealth of the cosmos is yours to claim—all in the free prologue of Astrometica.

⚙️ CRAFTING AND TOOLS:

In Astrometica Prologue, crafting is at the core of survival and exploration. With the resources you gather from the depths of space, you have the power to craft essential tools for your journey. From drills that penetrate asteroid cores, to lasers that cut through the unknown, and base builders that allow you to establish your own corner in the cosmos—each tool is vital for survival. But it doesn’t stop there; modifications are available to enhance every tool’s efficiency and adaptability to the challenges you face.

Moreover, your survival kit can be expanded with crafted items crucial for enduring the harsh space environment. Shield modules to protect against cosmic hazards, oxygen tanks for extended ventures, and a jetpack to navigate the zero-gravity realms with ease. Each crafted item is designed to boost your capabilities—whether it’s speeding across asteroid fields, bolstering your defenses against unforeseen dangers, or expanding your carry capacity to hoard more resources.

Astrometica Prologue invites you to leverage these crafting opportunities to tailor your survival strategy. Strengthen your arsenal, optimize your gear, and ensure your survival in the sprawling universe of Astrometica. Your ingenuity and resourcefulness are your best allies in this grand space adventure.

🏗️ BASE BUILDING:

Base building in Astrometica Prologue transcends mere survival—it's about creating a stronghold that reflects your strategic prowess and innovative spirit. Even in this free version, you are empowered to establish a robust base that serves not just as a shelter, but as your operations center against the backdrop of space's infinite challenges.

Living quarters are just the beginning. Here, you can rest, plan your next moves, and safeguard your collected resources. Energy is a critical aspect of survival, and Astrometica Prologue allows you to harness the power of the cosmos through solar panels. These installations ensure your base remains operational, powering everything from life-support systems to research labs.

A vehicle station adds another layer of depth to your base, serving as a hub for crafting, upgrading, and deploying vehicles essential for exploration and resource collection. It's not just about building a base; it's about creating a foundation for expansion, exploration, and domination of the cosmic frontier.

In Astrometica Prologue, your base is more than a sanctuary—it's a testament to your journey, growth, and resilience in the vastness of space.

🔭 SIGNAL FOLLOWING:

In Astrometica Prologue, your adventure is guided by the pursuit of signals and the exploration of enigmatic territories. Within this free version, two primary types of signals beckon you into the unknown, each promising new discoveries and challenges. These signals might lead you to resource-rich asteroids, abandoned outposts, or reveal new mysteries to unravel within the cosmic expanse.

🚀 SPACE SHIPS:

In Astrometica Prologue, you'll have access to two types of spacecraft, each designed to enhance your exploration and survival in space. First, the fast space bike: sleek, agile, and perfect for quick reconnaissance or darting between asteroids and mysterious islands where gravity binds you to the surface. It's your go-to for speed and efficiency.

The second is a more advanced ship, a versatile vessel equipped not only for travel but survival. It serves as a mobile base of sorts, providing a crucial source of oxygen and basic protection against the harshness of space. This ship is ideal for longer voyages, offering safety and sustenance as you delve deeper into the unknown

games.name: Dissimilar
games.shortDescription: Investigate a sprawling, maze-like castle where engaging tactical battles hide long-buried family secrets. A unique blend of mystery, turn-based combat, and exploration.
games.aboutText:
Amelia expected her evening to be perfectly ordinary. What she did not expect was for her best friend to hack her car and bring her against her will to the Haven , the ancient castle her family used to holiday in when she was a child.

Far for being a sentimental visit, this improbable return to the place of her childhood finds Amelia forced to take part in a game she knows nothing about: not the how, not the who, and certainly not the why... And this game just might uncover secrets her family would have rather left hidden.

The Haven is yours to roam freely and in any order you want. Search through its handcrafted rooms, find secret passages and open forbidden doors . Uncover the castle's history and that of Amelia's family on this larger-than-life, intricate playing board.

Your observation skills and a keen sense of curiosity will be the keys to truly know the Haven and uncover every last of its secrets.

Create your own strategies, organise your team, position your fighters wisely and anticipate enemy patterns in exciting tactical battles where every choice matters.

Each enemy has a unique behaviour , and learning them is the key to mastering this unique battle system at the crossroad between puzzle games and RPGs.

Defeat is not the end: explore other paths, gather your strength and establish new strategies with a myriad unique fighters and skills.

Delve into a piece of speculative fiction that questions technology, ethics, and the weight of unspoken family trauma . Investigate both the present and childhood memories to find out the truth between Amelia's kidnapping, and the true reasons behind the mysterious game she finds herself playing.

This entirely hand-drawn world comes alive to a soundtrack that blends epic orchestra and synth music , creating a unique atmosphere where ancient history meets futuristic technology .

👉 Wishlist and follow Dissimilar now for updates!

games.name: This Curse Is Metal as Hell! | Kusodeka Bayashi
games.shortDescription: This Curse Is Metal as Hell! is a first-person horror comedy game. As the game’s child protagonist, master the special powers hidden within your dad’s MP3 player to rush your way through a world of pure terror. Do you have what it takes to defeat the curse that plagued your family for generations?
games.aboutText:
This Curse Is Metal as Hell! | Kusodeka Bayashi is a first-person horror comedy game where you take on the role of a young child who must confront the horrific entity assaulting his grandparents’ countryside residence.

Story

You’ve gone to stay at your grandma and grandpa’s house on the countryside so your mom can give birth to her baby in peace. Surrounded by such beautiful nature, Sodehiki Village is the perfect place to take a load off and relax... Or at least it was supposed to be.

An overwhelmingly menacing aura awaits you upon your arrival. Eerie statues line the town. Burly men dressed from head to toe in leather absolutely ruin the village’s quaint and charming atmosphere. And to top it all off, there’s a local faith in an evil god that has some deep connection with your family...

“Oh man! A family curse? An evil mountain god? Give me a frickin’ break!”

Will you ever be able to get to that slow-paced lifestyle you’ve been looking forward to in this quaint country village?!

Game Details

An action adventure game where you search the environment from a first-person perspective.

As you unveil the truth behind the hidden curse that has plagued your family for generations, you must search for a way to fight back.

Play Time: About 1-1.5 hours
Endings: 1

games.aboutText:
Platypus Reclayed is the highly acclaimed, clay-animated arcade shoot-em-up from original Platypus creator Anthony Flack. The family friendly cult classic returns with full high definition artwork physically rebuilt from scratch, along with new content, a glorious Retro64 chiptunes soundtrack, and full modding support. With multiple game modes, official mods including a 4:3 as-is remake of the original Platypus, as well as single and 2 player co-op support, it's the definitive version of the handcrafted indie original.

The once-thriving metropolis of Colossatropolis is now bursting at the seams. Towering skyscrapers dominate the skyline, while pollution chokes the air - and parking is a nightmare. Desperate times call for desperate measures, and Colossatropolis sets its sights on neighbouring Mungola for expansion. But little do they know, Mungola isn't going down without a fight. The legendary F-27 "Platypus" are the Mungolan people's last hope for freedom.

- Multiple game modes across 25 different areas

- 2 Player co-op simultaneous action

- Adjustable difficulty settings, including an easy mode for all age range accessibility

- Perfect for the entire family

The original handmade shooter!

games.name: Welcome to Maison Chichigami
games.shortDescription: Deep in the mountains, there is said to be a legendary hot spring: called the Spirit Spring. Becoming lost on the way to the spring, you are rescued by a mysterious, reclusive family. But what secrets does this family hide away in their manor?
games.aboutText:
On a quest to restore your weary body in the mountains of Japan, you nearly perish and arrive at the steps of Maison Chichigami. A rebuilt version of the acclaimed puzzle adventure game, now playable on Steam Deck and Windows!

With an entirely new engine, new UI, new hidden collectibles, support for more platforms, and more, OneShot WME features world-bending puzzles, intriguing denizens, surreal environments, and a captivating story that reveals the truth of the game's reality.

Players will interact with a strange computer operating system--a window into an alternate world. Together with Niko, a child who is also a stranger to this place, they work to rekindle the long dead sun and – hopefully – save everyone.

games.name: Tower of Mask
games.shortDescription: Tower of Mask is a thrilling survival horror in the spirit of the 80's dungeon crawlers. The most claustrophobic dungeon in modern times is yours to venture through alone. Hero, face the ancient tower where eerie masked humans prowl.

An innovative survival horror imbued with the eternal brilliance of dungeon crawling

In a confined space with no escape, face relentless attacks from masked humans.
Use your limited resources and wits to survive this desperate situation!

Simple combat system with grid-based movement and free camera control.

Adventurers must solve the mysteries hidden in the dungeon as they progress.

Dungeon Exploration
Explore the ruins, find weapons and armor, and discover ways to survive.

Strategic Combat
Grid-based movement is crucial for predicting enemy actions and positioning yourself to avoid attacks. Once cornered, there's no escape.

Ancient Weapons
Use melee weapons like swords and spears to defeat fierce enemies. The power to save the world is in your hands.

Elements and abilities
Players can allocate ability points through level-ups and equipment. It's up to you to decide which abilities to enhance.

Difficult puzzles
Solve puzzles involving switches, pressure plates, and trapdoors. Items and a handy map feature will be helpful.

Words of the Unknown Brave:

In this age where even legends are forgotten,
I heard an intriguing rumor about the Tower of Mask.
In that tower, which stands in a place unknown to people, there lurks an evil that heroes should challenge.
And those who step in are attacked by humans wearing bizarre masks.
I have never heard of anyone who returned safely from the tower.
Can I survive and escape from the tower...?

games.name: ChopChop
games.shortDescription: Pick up your axe and chop wood without thinking.
games.aboutText:
ChopChop is a game where you endlessly chop wood.

Don’t think about anything—just repeat one simple action.

Progress

- Logs to chop are automatically generated and fall from above.

- When a log touches the chopping block, swing your axe to chop it.

- Keep repeating this process.

- The camera remains fixed.

Additional Information

- You are welcome to stream, record, and upload content featuring any part of this game (including the beginning, ending, and credits).  Monetization activities such as donations and ad revenue are also allowed.

- You're not required to credit the game, but we truly appreciate it if you do!

games.name: Cozy Island
games.shortDescription: Go wild with your BFFS in your ultimate cozy getaway! Yank up hilariously plump veggies, reel in giant flappy fish, bump into adorable little animals, and unlock a bunch of weird and wonderful toys! If you feel like it, doing absolutely nothing on the beach is exactly what you're supposed to do!
games.aboutText:
Welcome to our Discord channel: haAuNAhBsg

Sprawl out like a starfish on the sun-baked beach and just zone out. Soak up the warm rays and listen to the rhythmic lull of the waves. Today, tomorrow, or even all day long—if you want to, you don't have to lift a single finger.

Cruise through fragrant flower fields or just lounge on a bouncy mushroom for hours. There are no deadlines, no timers, and absolutely no rush. Your time here is yours to spend on pure, unadulterated joy.

Plant a seed, get something bizarre! You’ll be harvesting everything from vibrant blooms to truly derpy crops. They’re weird, they’re quirky, and honestly? They’re impossible not to love.

Every nook and cranny of the island is packed with cheeky secrets. Rummage through every corner to collect useless but adorable toys. Because let’s be real—being cute and happy is the only thing that matters.

Bring your best friends along for the ride! Sweep them right out the door with a broom, or drag them into the water for a dip. Even the simplest moments become memories you'll treasure when you're together!

games.name: Dale & Dawson Stationery Supplies
games.shortDescription: In "Dale & Dawson Stationery Supplies," play as a Manager, Specialist, or Slacker in an office setting. Slackers blend in, mimicking Specialists to avoid the Manager's suspicion. Uncover or cause deception to win.
games.aboutText:
The Manager

The Manager is the office's ultimate authority figure, tasked with ensuring productivity and firing the Slackers hiding among the Specialists.
Slackers

The Slacker's goal is to goof off without getting caught. Whether it’s playing Minesweeper, or taking a dump, Slackers must blend in to avoid the Manager’s wrath.
Specialists

Specialists are the backbone of the company, assigned various tasks that keep the office running smoothly. But even the hardest workers know that productivity sometimes requires a coffee break.
Gameplay Mechanics

- Objective-Based Gameplay: Specialists are tasked with completing objectives to contribute to the company's success, whereas Slackers engage in activities to appear busy while avoiding actual work.

- Social Deduction and Strategy: Players utilize proximity voice chat for real-time discussions, alliances, and accusations, making social interactions crucial to gameplay.

- Managerial Oversight: The Manager must observe, deduce, and decide who to fire, with each choice potentially altering the game's balance.
Experience the Office Like Never Before:

games.name: Astrum Vanguard
games.shortDescription: Pilot your ship with thrust and rotation, and coast through gaps in enemy fire. Survive 20 waves in this space survivors-like arena shooter. Combine auto-firing weapons and shape your build in the shop between waves.
games.aboutText:
Your weapons fire. You find the way.

Rotate your ship, engage your thrusters, and find gaps between enemies and incoming fire. Keep your distance for precise attacks or dive into the thick of battle.

Turn a single shot into an entire attack pattern

Combine lasers, plasma, rockets, mines, projectile weapons, and drones. Upgrade your weapons through five tiers: single shots become spreads, and heavy projectiles become full volleys.

Specialize in one weapon category to benefit from its bonuses, or combine different weapons to cover your build’s weaknesses.

Every shop visit changes your next battle

Will you invest in a new weapon or improve your existing arsenal? Buy more firepower, additional healing, or an item that brings your strengths together?

Features:

- 10 playable ships with distinct stats, starting weapons, and unique abilities

- 25 weapons across six categories with upgradeable attack patterns

- Weapon type bonuses that reward specialization and carefully chosen combinations

- Evolving attack patterns — turn single shots into spreads, volleys, and more

- Over 50 items for distinctive builds and powerful synergies

- 20 enemy waves per run , with boss battles on waves 5, 10, 15, and 20

- 9 different bosses , each with its own attack patterns

- A shop between waves to buy weapons, upgrade your arsenal, and refine your build

- Ships unlocked through challenges that encourage new ways to play

- Direct ship control using thrust and rotation , while your weapons fire automatically

- Hand drawn Sprites

games.name: Cultivation Realm: Card Survival
games.shortDescription: Cultivation Realm: Card Survival is a cultivation survival game built around card-based interactions. Trapped in a mysterious realm that drains your lifespan but brims with spirit power, you must cultivate, survive, fight, and find a way to escape.
games.aboutText:
Cultivation Realm: Card Survival is a cultivation survival game built around card-based interactions. Trapped in a mysterious realm that drains your lifespan but brims with spirit power, you must cultivate, survive, fight, and find a way to escape.

- Explore different areas, including lakeside plains, dense forests, scorching deserts, and volcanic lands. Each area has its own Five Elements attributes, resources, and harsh weather conditions.

- Built around card-based interactions, the game lets you use resources such as Wooden Sticks and Stone to craft tools and buildings. Gather Mushrooms, Clams, Citrus, and other ingredients to cook meals and unlock more recipes. You can also collect spirit herb seeds and cultivate your own Spiritfield.

- The outside world has long been depleted of Spirit Power, while the Illusion Realm is rich with it, greatly increasing the speed of cultivation. Train here, and you may even break through to the realm of a mighty cultivator. Meditate to cultivate, study cultivation manuals to learn new Arts, and once you break through to a higher realm, you will no longer need food or rest. Refine pills and weapons to strengthen yourself, then slay Heart Demons and demonic beasts.

- In the Illusion Realm, every item affects the Five Elements. The Five Elements, in turn, influence a cultivator’s Spiritual Root. To break through to the next realm, cultivators must meet the required Five Elements conditions and practice the corresponding Arts.

- A realistic survival system built around a mortal’s path to cultivation. You must manage mortal needs such as Wellness, Hunger, Stamina, and Sleep, while also keeping a close eye on cultivation-related attributes like Mood, Spirit Qi, and lifespan. If negative states persist for too long, Heart Demons may invade, and your path to cultivation may come to an end.

- Resources in each area are not endless. As time passes and you continue exploring, resource yields will dynamically change. If you fish too often by the lakeside, you will need to wait for the fish to reproduce. Old Gourds may dwindle from near extinction to complete disappearance. Plan your resources as carefully as possible.

- Survival pressure comes not only from your own condition, but also from the demonic beasts that arrive with the Blood Moon. Gather resources, refine Pills and Artifacts, and keep cultivating to survive in the Illusion Realm.

- The game features hundreds of cards for Tools, Buildings, Cooking, and Equip, divided into Outer Sect Tools and Celestial Crafting Artifacts. Together, they cover the items you need for both survival and cultivation. You can also experiment with using and combining different cards. For example, Stone can be sharpened against a Boulder to create a Stoneblade, or combined with Wood to build a Campfire.

games.name: Cats Around Us: Giant Cat
games.shortDescription: We've hidden numerous cats in a silent comic about a giant cat causing chaos in a village. Can you find all those cats?
games.aboutText:
- 🎮 4 pages comic and jigsaw Puzzle

- 😻 204 cats

- 📷 Photo mode

- 🔆 Brightness setting

- 🎨 Choose your favorite color

- 🎵 4 Musics

- 🔔 Free hints

- 💾 Save system

- 🔍 Zoom

- 🔉 Cute cat sounds

- 🎮 Gamepad compatible

Hi, welcome our experimental hidden cat project. Cats Around Us is a series that introduces wholesome silent comics as a new medium for gameplay.

"Giant Cat" unfolds across four pages of silent comic panels by Kathrinna Rakhmavika, offering a heartwarming tale about a giant cat causing chaos in a village. A young witch must step in to resolve the situation. Throughout each page, we've hidden numerous cats for you to find while enjoying the story.

Additionally, we've included a photo mode for players to capture intriguing moments from the comic, allowing them to colorize and share their creations with the world.

games.name: Chocolate Factory: Prologue
games.shortDescription: Build your dream Chocolate Factory among candy cane forests and gumdrop hills to produce the tastiest sweets. A delicious first-person factory automation game with a little exploration and combat. Confectionary conveyor belt heaven awaits! The free prologue for the full game!
games.aboutText:
Build your dream Chocolate Factory among candy cane forests and gumdrop hills to produce the tastiest sweets.
A delicious first-person factory automation game with a little exploration and combat.
Confectionary conveyor belt heaven awaits! This is the prologue to the full game and only the early game content is available.

- Produce all types of sweets as you fill the world with massive factories!

- Automate with conveyor belts to exploit the world's resources!

- Immersive first-person perspective factory building!

- Travel in style with jump pads, glider, factory boots, and jetpacks!

- Build sprawling castles easily from pre-made building pieces!

- Open world but not massive, as you play you'll be able to see the entire world fill up with your factories!

- Follow a tech tree to know exactly what to work on next!

- Utilize drones in the end-game to transport items farther!

- Customize the color of your factory!

games.name: Fleshinsane
games.shortDescription: Fleshinsane is a narrative-driven, top-down biopunk roguelike shooter set inside a living, decaying spaceship. Kill, die, upgrade, repeat. Will you survive long enough to escape the flesh?
games.aboutText:
Fleshinsane is a top-down biopunk roguelike shooter set deep within the bowels of a living spaceship. After the crash of the imperial dropship "Orbita", you take control of Oteg, an elite soldier cursed with an endless cycle of resurrection. Shoot your way through the living flesh, gather biometric keys, and repair the escape ship.

Narrative Driven Roguelite

Experience a grim, linear narrative woven into unforgiving roguelike mechanics. The story has a definitive end, and your skills directly determine its outcome.

You are not just fighting the mutating ship - you are trapped with the worst of humanity. As resources dry up, the camp descends into madness, executions, and a bloody mutiny. If you are too weak, your comrades will fall one by one to either the ship's decay or the cruelty of their own crewmates. Master the cycle and save them from the monsters outside and the people within.

Fast Paced Brutal Shooter

Survival requires relentless aggression. Tear through hordes of mutated abominations in high-speed, top-down combat. The heavy gunplay is unforgiving, turning every encounter into a bloody massacre.

Unique Biopunk Artstyle

Infusing biopunk aesthetics into both visuals and gameplay, not being mere set dressing but meaningfully represented by the mechanics themselves.

Meta Progression

Death is just part of the cycle. Use the resources harvested from the slaughter to permanently unlock and upgrade your armory. Unlock crazy new weapons and evolve Oteg's loadout to ensure you drop into the next run stronger, faster, and deadlier.

games.name: AOKAKI
games.shortDescription: A disgraced ronin returns to his homeland to find it ravaged by war. Taking up his sword once more, he must battle through the feudal forces of the shogun and take on foes he once called friends. Parry, pogo, and dash your way through a land of insect samurai in this platformer.
games.aboutText:
Take on the role of Aokaki, a tokusatsu inspired ronin that must travel through a huge feudal land facing outlandish insect enemies both great and small. Upgrade your isopod ronin, rebuild your homeland, and parry and pogo your way to victory.

Features

Parry, Deflect, Strike!

Use a blend of samurai techniques to vanquish your foes. Deflect ranged attacks, parry blows to build up a powerful counter-attack, and strike when your enemies are most vulnerable.

Platform and Puzzle

Pogo from enemies, torches and spikes to reach ever greater heights. Dash to avoid traps and propel through the air. Curl yourself into a bouncing, speeding ball to unlock secrets and solve puzzles.

A Beautiful Pixel World

Explore this feudal, insect inhabited world with adorable allies and frightening enemies. Every area is lovingly crafted after feudal inspired settings and backdrops. Find all the secrets of this Japanese-inspired land as you rebuild it from ruin.

games.shortDescription: 0 2 8 is a first-person inspection and management game set at a vertical passenger transit station. Serve a penal shift, inspect arriving train modules, manage limited holding space, and decide who goes up, who waits, and who is sent back down.
games.aboutText:
You decide who goes up, who waits, and who is sent back down.

0 2 8 is a first-person inspection thriller set at Station L028 — a vertical transit checkpoint separating the lower levels from the world above.

Passenger trains arrive carrying sealed modules. Inspect permits, return tickets, luggage limits and life-support readings. Assign each module one of three outcomes: clear it for upward transit, hold it at the station, or send it back down.

The regulations are simple. The people inside are not.

Your waiting area has limited space. Delayed modules consume oxygen, accumulate waste and block slots that may be needed for the next train. Missing documents take time to replace, complaints cost money, and violations you ignore may be discovered at another station.

Passengers, officials and unknown senders will contact you through your service pager. They may ask for help, offer rewards, issue threats or order you to ignore the rules entirely. Some are telling the truth. Others are not.

Every decision has consequences — but they do not always arrive immediately.

INSPECT THE MODULES

Examine passenger records, permits, tickets, baggage and system readings from a moving inspection platform inside a colossal vertical station.

MANAGE THE WAITING AREA

Hold problematic modules, restore their oxygen supply, empty waste tanks, request missing documents and attach cleared modules to later trains.

FOLLOW THE RULES — OR BREAK THEM

Obey official procedure, help the people trapped inside, accept secret deals or protect yourself. There is rarely enough time, money or space to do everything.

EARN YOUR RELEASE

Complete your penal assignment and collect enough release credits to leave Station L028.

Fail to meet the target, and the loop begins again tomorrow.

games.name: Cat Bait
games.shortDescription: Cat Bait is a casual game with cute pixel graphics. Control the Cat Bait, dodge enemies, and use the unique abilities of helper cats.
games.aboutText:
Get ready for exciting battles in the world of Cat Bait , a casual game with cute pixel graphics inspired by Vampire Survivors and Brotato ! Control the brave Cat Bait , dodge hordes of mice and other rodents while your loyal helper cats destroy enemies with their unique abilities.

Main Features:

- Unique Helper Cats: Each helper has its own special abilities and characteristics. For example, summon the Druid Cat to slow down enemies with roots and deal periodic damage. And who said you can summon only one helper?

- Upgrade System: Upgrade your helpers during each run. Increase damage, add more projectiles, and unlock other unique upgrades for each cat.

- Meta-Progression: Collect coins from defeated enemies to upgrade your character and helper cats between runs, making each new attempt more powerful.

- Skins and Abilities: Unlock new skins for the Cat Bait that not only change the appearance but also add new active abilities. For example, the standard skin allows repelling enemies.

- Epic Bosses: Fight unique bosses, like the mouse rider on a rat. Each boss has its own set of moves and attacks, making each battle unpredictable.

- Interesting Locations: Choose from various locations, each offering its own challenges and variety of enemies. Start with an empty character and choose your first helper cat to begin the adventure.

- Session Gameplay: Short gaming sessions make it easy to jump in and out of the game, continuing from the same wave you stopped at.

Fight waves of enemies, upgrade your helper cats, and conquer all locations in Cat Bait . Are you ready to take on the challenge and become a true hero among cats?

games.name: Neighbor's Wife
games.shortDescription: Your neighbor is always busy and doesn't have much time to spend with his wife, which makes her feel lonely and sad. You are the only one who can save their marriage!
games.aboutText:
"Wife of my Neighbor" is a visual novel in which you have to help your neighbor in a special way. His wife needs more attention, and you are the only one who can help her.



How exactly - that's up to you! You can either help the couple by becoming their "family therapist" or just help the wife with her lack of attention. Either way, you are sure to make your neighbor's wife happy!



Spend time with her, help her with her morning jog and household chores, prove that you can be trusted in everything!

games.name: 100 Korea Cats
games.shortDescription: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in the 🇰🇷 Korea 🍙, full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of Korean 🥟🥢🍢 themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🕵️‍♂️❌ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈✅

🇰🇷🍙🐾 WELCOME TO 100 KOREA CATS – THE BEST HIDDEN OBJECTS GAME! 🥟🥢🍢

games.name: [Nightmare Files] Clap Clap
games.shortDescription: Clap Clap is a short indie horror game that puts you in the shoes of a house sitter, experiencing strange occurrences in a seemingly ordinary home.
games.aboutText:
You see a newspaper ad about a house-sitting job. Since you're short on money, you decide to sign up. What awaits you...

Did I mention that the house you'll be staying at has the latest home automation systems of the 80s!? Now you know! Simply clap twice in any room in the house to toggle the lights on/off. We sure are lucky that there are no entities around that can take advantage of this.

Immerse yourself in the environment with amnesia-like physical interactions, volumetric audio and PS1 style graphics.

It ain't much, but it's honest work.

I suggest you don't go snooping around too much, it's for your own good.

games.name: CatboyZOOM
games.shortDescription: Zoom through the many handcrafted worlds in this FPS Platforming Speedrunner! Master your control over the Source-inspired movement system and leave your best times for others to challenge!
games.aboutText:
Zoom through the many handcrafted worlds in this FPS Platforming Speedrunner! Learn to master your movement kit and leave your best times for others to challenge!

Designed from the beginning to be approachable for players new to the genre, while still retaining the nuance and high skill ceiling that veterans can appreciate. Levels are designed to teach you everything you need to know, and will gradually push your skill level and nudge you to do things just a bit faster. By the end of the game, you'll be zooming through levels like it's nothing.

Features movement tech such as air-strafing , bunnyhopping and surfing , popularized by Source-Engine titles such as Counter Strike, Half-Life, and Team Fortress 2! However, the game builds off of this movement drastically with its own mechanics such as sliding , surf jumps , wallkicks and more!

Five unique worlds and over 75 carefully thought-out levels. Each levels teaches something new, brings a new idea to the table, presents a new challenge - no filler!

Fight for the best times against your friends and globally! Show off your times on the leaderboards, watch how others beat your times through the replay system, and race against other players' ghost times.

CatboyZOOM is a passion project developed primarily by myself, falsey, with additional programming from my partner, Brae.

We're both avid enthusiasts of FPS platformers, particularly Source-movement, and have both been involved in movement gamemode communities for over a decade. Most of our time has been spent in the Team Fortress 2 jump community, where together we've published over 25 custom maps (and spent over 25k hours of our lives), and are core contributors to the Source movement community project Momentum Mod.

We both care deeply about making movement platforming that is extremely fun, satisfying, and rewarding - something that gives you the joy of just going really fast and executing a route well, but that also makes you wanna grind a single level for hours upon hours until you get that perfect run.

We reserve the right to wipe leaderboard times until full release!

games.name: Travellin Cats in Christmas

Travellin Cats in Christmas (formerly Cats Hidden in Christmas) is a free hidden object game set within a festive scene.

100 cats are waiting for you to be discovered within a hand-drawn background.

games.name: Travellin Cats in England
games.shortDescription: Find many cats hidden across England in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cat game creator! Can you find them all?
games.aboutText:
Travellin Cats in England (formerly Cats Hidden in England) is a cute hidden object game set in England.
