games.name: Pocket Idler: Fishing Pond
games.shortDescription: Craft your dream fishing experience in this engaging tycoon idler. Stock your pond with rare fish, build and upgrade your shop, attract eager customers, and manage your business to become a legendary fishing haven.
games.aboutText:
Welcome, aspiring angler!

Pocket Idler: Fishing Pond is the first cast in a series of relaxing and casual idle games designed to deliver bite-sized satisfaction.

You've just acquired a quaint pond nestled amidst a tranquil forest, and with it, the chance to build a legendary fishing haven.

Stock your pond with an ever-growing variety of aquatic friends, from the commonplace to the curiously rare. Upgrade and rent top-notch fishing gear to ensure your customers snag success.

Spruce up your shop with an array of charming decorations, each adding a unique touch to your piscatorial paradise and establishing a permanent popularity boost. Every satisfied customer leaves a positive review, further propelling your reputation and unlocking even more exotic fish to stock your waters.

Gameplay Features:

- Hybrid Tycoon & Idler gameplay.

- Stock and manage your very own pond with increasingly more rare fish.

- Upgrade your rental rods and bait to increase customers success and happiness.

- Upgrade your shop building to increase customer expectations.

- Install decorations to improve your overall visual flair.

- Receive positive/negative reviews that effect popularity.

- Push to get the highest popularity level through upgrades and review and drive up customers rate and unlock new fish types for stocking the pond.

- Earn money for every fish caught.

- Set your ticket prices and markup on your fish.

- Relaxing atmosphere and calm, casual idle gameplay.

- Adorable and minimalistic pixel art.

games.name: 5 Minute Raid
games.shortDescription: A boss raid where the boss is also a player! A team of 3 guardians, 6 classes, 12 perks. An abomination from the 3rd dimension, ready to singlehandedly destroy the world. Only 5 minutes until the destruction of the 2nd dimension! A casual quirky 1 vs 3 asymmetrical PvP experience: 5 Minute Raid!
games.aboutText:
A boss raid where the boss is also a player!

A team of 3 guardians. 7 classes, 12 perks, and 36 abilities.

An creature from the 3rd dimension, ready to singlehandedly destroy their world.

Only 5 minutes until the collapse of the 2nd dimension!

A casual quirky rogue-like 1 vs 3 asymmetrical PvP experience: 5 Minute Raid!

- The most 'humanlike' boss you'll ever find in a raid game!

- Squash those puny 2D 'heroes' as the raid boss from the 3rd dimension!

- 2-4 party game with your friends at custom match

- Level up as much as possible within 5 minutes to gain abilities and power up

- A total of 36 unique abilities for Guardians.

- 5 different Bosses with completely different playstyles.

- 12 Boss perks to customize your playstyle further!

games.name: Unfriendly Friend
games.shortDescription: Go on an adventure with your friends to the abandoned St. Mercy Hospital and uncover its secrets. Can you save your friends or at least save yourself from the horror that awaits?
games.aboutText:
Play as Dakota, a high school student who goes to explore the abandoned St. Mercy Hospital with her friends.

Uncover the secrets that St. Mercy and your friends are hiding .

Features:
- A story-driven horror adventure
- Chapters 1 and 2 available now , with more chapters to come!
- Chapter 2 has three different endings , based on your choices
- Completely hand-drawn art
- Explore the hospital, solve puzzles and find clues hidden in notes and journals
- Someone in St. Mercy wants to play a few games with you …

games.name: Galactic Disharmony
games.shortDescription: A Sci-fi First-person shooter and Strategy game. Command and control your fleets and planets, build troops and extract resources in the solar maps' turn-based strategic mode. Then head into battle with your troops in large-scale first-person warfare to conquer planets.
games.aboutText:
Galactic Disharmony is a Sci-fi First-person shooter and Strategy game. Command and control your fleets and planets, build troops and extract resources in the solar maps' turn-based strategic mode . Then head into battle with your troops in large-scale first-person warfare to conquer planets.

STORY MODE:

In Galactic Disharmony's story mode, you play as a new commander in a galaxy torn apart by the disappearance of Earth. Quickly learn the ropes of commanding fleets and deal with an unexpected threat which puts humanity's remaining settlements at risk.

BATTLE MODE:

Fancy instant action? Play custom battle mode to jump into FPS battles of your making. Set up any combination of units, map and other settings. Jets, infantry, tanks, super units and leader powers such as bombing runs are all available to you.

CUSTOM MISSION MODE:

In custom mission mode, set up your own solar system-wide conflict against the AI, with control over factions, the number of planets in the system and starting resources.

LEVEL EDITOR:
Create and share FPS battle maps in the game's built-in level editor and Steam Workshop. Edit terrain, place objectives and objects, and change the environment to your liking. All the tools used to create the game's levels are available to you.

games.name: Under Canopies
games.shortDescription: Forget the stress of survival. In this cozy open-world sim, you don't fight nature, you join it. Build your dream cabin piece by piece, cook complex meals with crops you watered yourself, and fill your photo album with rare wildlife. A serene experience where the only enemy is inefficiency.
games.aboutText:
Explore without fear

Step into a serene, vibrant forest full of mysteries. There’s no hunting or violence here exploration is about discovering unique resources, observing wildlife, and recording each find in your journal.

Build your refuge

Raise your cabin from scratch and customize it with furniture, decorations, and handmade items. Create a cozy home where every detail reflects your style.

Cook and cultivate

Gather plants, tend your garden, and combine ingredients to prepare over thirty recipes. Each dish is a new way to satisfy your hunger and enjoy the flavors of nature.

Live with animals

From chickens and sheep to bees and wild creatures, animals are part of your daily life. Raise them, watch them, and live peacefully alongside them, finding companionship and unexpected rewards.

A unique experience

Under Canopies redefines survival by leaving behind combat and danger. Here, you don’t fight against nature you thrive with it.

games.name: Lunarium
games.shortDescription: Lunarium is an atmospheric fantasy A-RPG. Play as Ave, a light-armored knight, who teams up with Lune, a mysterious Starfarer. Together, they journey to save a dying world, engaging in challenging battles to retrieve the lost glow of the stars and forsaken memories, unveiling cosmic secrets.
games.aboutText:
On the brink of collapse in the world of Lunarium, two girls—Ave and Lune step forward.

To save their dying homeland, they embark on a perilous journey into the unknown. Across multiple worlds, they must overcome countless trials while piecing together the ancient secrets of this realm—and ultimately uncover the truth hidden within themselves.

Play as Ave , a light-armored knight, and journey alongside Lune , a flaxen-haired girl with mysterious powers.

Together, they set out to save a world on the brink of collapse. Sword and magic echo between them as they fight side by side, weaving a bond that belongs to them alone.

- Ave

An agile knight skilled in close-quarters sword combat. With precise dodges and well-timed parries, she turns enemy attacks aside and strikes back. She is the party’s blade — and the one who stands at the front when danger closes in.

- Lune

A girl who wields mysterious magic. She can weaken enemies, enhance Ave’s attacks, and break through obstacles in the environment. She is an irreplaceable source of support — and the key to moving forward.

Players can adjust Ave’s combat style through Embroidery , the Skill Tree , and Cloaks , building a flexible progression system for different ways to fight.

- Cloak System

Cloaks offer both unique appearances and ability effects. Players can choose different cloaks to match their preferred way of fighting.

- Embroidery System

Embroidery works like charms, each carrying a different power. Equipping them grants Ave passive enhancements that can support different combat styles.

Step into unguarded temples, the ruins of fallen kingdoms, and churches shrouded in dark mist. Each area has its own atmosphere, terrain, and combat rhythm.

Explore forgotten lands, observe your surroundings, learn the mechanics, and press onward through a journey filled with danger.

"Our journey begins with parting, and perhaps it will also face parting in the end. The hardships along the way will surpass your understanding and imagination... You might even feel pain because of this."

"Even so, will you still come with me?"

games.name: Bloobs Adventure Idle
games.shortDescription: A massive RuneScape-inspired idle RPG built for long-term progression. Train 24 skills, defeat bosses, collect over 500 souls, and bank offline time to accelerate your progress whenever you choose.
games.aboutText:
Bloobs Adventure Idle is a massive RuneScape-inspired idle RPG built around endless progression, powerful account growth, and thousands of goals to pursue.

Train 24 interconnected skills, defeat powerful bosses, collect over 500 souls, complete thousands of challenges, and scale your character through a deep prestige system designed for hundreds — and eventually thousands — of hours of progression.

Whether actively managing your build or progressing while offline, every action pushes your account further toward true endgame power.

Skilling and Crafting

Train 24 unique skills — including Woodcutting, Mining, Fishing, Cooking, Magic, Thieving, BeastMastery, and more.

Skills feed into one another through layered progression systems where every upgrade strengthens your entire account. Gather resources, craft stronger equipment, unlock new systems, and push deeper into increasingly rewarding content.

Prestige skills to gain permanent bonuses, accelerate future progression, and continue scaling far beyond the early game.

Combat and Equipment

Combat is automated — but power is earned.

Build your character, craft stronger gear, optimize your progression, and challenge increasingly dangerous bosses designed to test your stats, equipment, and preparation.

Rare drops, unique equipment, soul collection, and permanent progression systems create an endless climb toward greater power.

The stronger your account becomes, the faster the world opens around you.

Challenges, Collections, and Discovery

Bloobs Adventure Idle is built for players who love long-term progression and meaningful discovery.

Complete thousands of challenges across combat, skilling, exploration, progression, and collection systems to unlock milestone rewards, permanent upgrades, and hidden memories scattered throughout the world.

Track your journey through the Beastiary, Item Compendium, Thief’s Log, Achievements, and Souldex — featuring over 500 collectible souls with unique variations and bonuses.

Recover lost memories to expand the Lore Book and uncover fragments of the world hidden behind your progression.

There is always another goal to chase, another reward to unlock, and another mystery waiting to be discovered.

Banked Time System

Progress on your schedule.

Store up to 36 hours of offline time and spend it whenever you choose to accelerate skills, combat, crafting, and progression. Dexterity Prestige increases the cap by 6 hours per level, up to a maximum of 96 hours.

You don’t just idle.

You control when progression accelerates.

Bloobs Adventure Idle combines familiar RuneScape-inspired skilling with layered systems designed for long-term progression. Prestige, skill synergy, and exploration come together in a steady loop that continues to grow with you.

games.name: SNØ: Ultimate Freeriding
games.shortDescription: SNØ is a minimalistic freeriding game. Push your limits for the high score, or simply enjoy the unforgiving procedural wilderness.
games.aboutText:
SNØ is a simple game about downhill skiing. Carve your way down procedurally generated mountainscapes and try to score as many points as possible by pulling off high-risk proximity maneuvers and tricks. Mastering the controls and terrain is key to achieving high scores, making every run a test of skill and flow.

SNØ offers endless procedural mountains to explore. Choose whether you want to chase the top spots on the leaderboards, or just enjoy the ride in Zen mode.

Message from the creators:

SNØ is made in Norway by two people. We designed it to capture the essence of downhill skiing in a minimalistic and playful way. SNØ is perfect for short gameplay sessions, focusing on rewarding gameplay systems, instant action and smooth controls.

Special message to all Steamdeck users:

We have optimized SNØ for the Steamdeck. The game runs at 60-90 FPS on High quality settings. Enjoy.

Things you will find in this game

- Fast and smooth freeriding gameplay

- Endless procedurally generated mountains

- Three ride styles: Skis, Snowboard and Sit-ski

- Countless skins requiring skill to unlock

- Share and revisit mountains by seed

- Full keyboard and gamepad support

- Optional Zen-mode - No scoring, just you and the mountain

- Online global and friends leaderboards

- Visit top scoring mountains directly from the leaderboards

- First person, third person and drone camera modes

- Photo mode

Things you will not find

- Online multiplayer

- Prepped slopes

- Loading times

games.name: Dustland Delivery
games.shortDescription: Dustland Delivery is a post-apocalyptic survival business simulator. Scour the wastes for profit, complete missions to grow your trading empire, and assemble a rag-tag band of adventurers to turn your city into the capital of the Dustlands. Danger lurks around every corner—but no risk, no reward!
games.aboutText:
Dustland Delivery is a post-apocalyptic survival business simulator. Scour the wastes for profit, complete missions to grow your trading empire, and assemble a rag-tag band of adventurers to turn your city into the capital of the Dustlands.

Dustland Delivery 1.0 features an all new map—Twilight Valley—with tons of new main story and side story events, new recruitable characters, new bosses to fight, and even more places to explore.

Marshal Resources to Build Your Dustland Empire

- A vast game world with a rich narrative to explore

- Establish trade routes across unique settlements to become a kingpin of the wastes

- Control resource flows to build magnificent cities

Transform Your Truck for Apocalyptic Adventures

- Create your own mobile base to cruise through the Dustlands

- Install mods to turn your truck into a deadly weapon against infected swarms

A Cast of Unique Companions

- Recruit a rag-tag group of adventurers with distinctive traits

- Assign different roles to help build your city

- Tool up and train animal companions to boost your team's stats

- Undead? No excuse not to show up for work...

Random Events, Freedom to Choose

- Countless random events: armored motorcades, undead raids, unknown signals from mysterious locations...

- Your Dustland, your way: become a warrior for justice, a money-grubbing merchant, or an infamous bandit

Struggle for Power, Rebuild the Wastes

- 6 major factions with a web of complex relations

- Exploit power struggles and trading rivalries to come out on top

- Form alliances, stir up trouble, and build your own power base

Complex Weather System

- Forge a path through the Dustlands while fighting storms and hidden dangers

- Set up camp to shelter from the elements, then ride out at daybreak

About the game mechanics: please check Steamcommunity - guides

We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to the player who contributed to the guide of the game, with special thanks to XJ.Chen for the invaluable input.

games.name: Arcade Space Survivor
games.shortDescription: Fight against waves of enemies to become the ultimate space survivor. Arcade Space Survivor is an arcade-styled action-roguelike. The game offers an innovative and unique experience within the survivors-like genre.
games.aboutText:
Arcade Space Survivor is an arcade-styled action-roguelike.

Collect EXP, upgrade your spaceship and survive in this retro-inspired shooter.

Arcade Space Survivor offers an innovative and unique

gameplay experience in the existing Survivors-like genre.

Features:

- Online Leaderboard

- Gamemodes: Survival, Daily Run, Challenges

- 8 Attacks - 76 Upgrades - 197 Levels (additional content planned)

- 15 different enemy types (additional content planned)

- PowerUps & Point of Interests

- Deadly meteors for player and enemies

Special:

- No mouse required ( perfect for laptop ) ( controller r ecommended)

- Instead of HP the player has LIFES ( like in old arcade games ).

- EXP will disappear after a certain time (around 10 seconds ).

Game by: Marvin Woelke / MAWO

games.name: Unless
games.shortDescription: Challenge yourself and master 4 Distinct worlds with 66 finely tuned level screens and climb to the top of the Steam Leaderboards in this retro pixel art speedrunning platformer!
games.aboutText:
The Forest of Worlds is withering, and along with it; the creative spark of every living thing. Venture into fantastical levels, gather the Golden Leaves within, and use them to avert the fate of a world devoid of imagination!

Tackle 66 finely-tuned screens built for newcomers and speed-runners alike.

Collect Crystal Berries by clearing levels quickly to unlock Bonus Levels .

Race for the World Record using a dedicated Speedrun Mode to display an in-game timer, speed up level transitions, and auto-skip dialogue sequences.

Generous checkpoints and a co-operative Assist Mode help players of all ages and ability see everything the game has to offer.

Unlock Shuffle Mode to randomize level connections and Leaf positions. Share seeds and race friends, or try to top the leaderboard of the Daily Challenge .

Unless also includes the following accessibility features:

- Adjustable Game Speed

- Customizable Inputs

- Tweak jump and wall-cling behaviour

- Font selection and Text scaling

- High contrast UI & reduced distraction modes

Discuss the game, share record-breaking runs, and be the first to get news on the development of Unless!

JOIN OUR DISCORD via the invite link in the right sidebar.

games.name: Janosik 2: Prologue
games.shortDescription: Pick up the mantle of the plucky maiden getting ready for her date night that is unceremoniously interrupted by the dastardly duo of Countess Bathory and Baron de Blonde in this prologue to the colourful Janosik 2 retro action-platformer…
games.aboutText:
Janosik 2: Prologue is an introduction to "Janosik 2", presenting a separate story that takes place right before the events of the main game.

Take on the role of Janka, Janosik's beloved, who is getting ready to meet up with her boyfriend. Little does she know that her plans are about to be disrupted by the evil Baron de Blonde, acting on behalf of the even more wicked Countess Bathory.

Use Janka's abilities to overcome various obstacles and enemies.

Metroidvania-style gameplay allows exploring previously visited locations to discover new secrets and bonuses through newly acquired skills. Features:

- Play as Janka: Step into the shoes of Janka, Janosik’s beloved, on an exciting adventure

- Unlock New Abilities: Gain powerful abilities like double jump, freezing enemies, dashing through air, illuminating darkness, and wall climbing, with the help of Baba Yaga and her shop

- 8 Challenging Levels : Explore 8 unique levels filled with challenging obstacles and deadly enemies

- Metroidvania-style gameplay: Revisit previously explored areas and uncover hidden secrets and treasures with the help of newly unlocked abilities

games.name: Bite Night
games.shortDescription: Bite Night is a comedic first-person horror game that explores the idea of what if the big bad monster was bad at their job of being scary.
games.aboutText:
Bite Night is a comedic first-person horror game that explores the idea of what if the big scary monster was bad at being big and scary. You play as a gas station attendant who must work the night shift in a rural gas station when things start to go bump in the night. You must try to juggle your responsibilities as a worker while dealing with a monster who may be much less scary and more of a pain in the neck but no one knows how many monsters lurk in the night.

Key Features:

- First Person

- Blend of Comedy and Horror

- Approx: 30mins playtime

- Retro Graphics

games.name: Rhythm Witch: Beat Death
games.shortDescription: Rhythm Witch: Beat Death is a game that melds rhythm and survival. Attack to the rhythm of the music while dodging monsters who move and attack to the beat. On your journey to eternal beauty, defeat dancing freaks, ghouls, dragon, and more!
games.aboutText:
In Rhythm Witch, music is not just background—it’s the heart of battle! Players must follow dynamically generated beats, striking enemies with precision while dodging attacks. Hitting the beat accurately quickly builds weapon energy, allowing for powerful skill releases. Maintaining a combo will trigger Frenzy Mode, significantly increasing attack speed and rhythm tempo, creating a seamless, exhilarating combat experience.

Enemies in the game also move and attack in sync with the beat. Face waves of rhythm-synced monsters and enjoy the thrill of effortlessly clearing the screen in a hack-and-slash style. Adapt your skill build to tackle dynamically escalating difficulty, as enemy numbers and attack patterns intensify. Success requires both quick reflexes and strategic planning to dominate the battlefield.

STORY

Rhythm Witch: Beat Death is a game that melds rhythm and survival. Attack to the rhythm of the music while dodging monsters who move and attack to the beat. On your journey to eternal beauty, defeat dancing freaks, ghouls, dragon, and more!

Sibel the Rhythm Witch is a necromancer whose one and only goal is eternal beauty.

Dyeing her hair, bathing in blood, collecting magic and mystical herbs, modifying her body... She'll do anything if it'll make her more beautiful!

Of course, the hard and dirty work is left to the skeletons she summons. On her quest for beauty, she hears tell of the Deathless Tower, which spawns an endless stream of monsters, and—so the rumor goes—holds a treasure that grants immortality.

If she gets her hands on that treasure, she can stay young and beautiful forever!

What's there to wait for?

Skeletons! To the Deathless Tower!

games.name: Leap Year
games.shortDescription: Leap Year is a clumsy platformer about knowledge and discovery. Explore a compact, hand drawn world filled with hidden paths. Understand the game’s secrets to reach new areas and collect all the pages of your calendar.
games.aboutText:
Leap Year is a clumsy platformer about knowledge and discovery.

Explore a compact, hand drawn world filled with hidden paths. Understand the game’s secrets to reach new areas and collect all the pages of your calendar.

Features

- About 2 hours of playtime

- 40+ rooms

- 6 audio tracks

- 12 Steam achievements

- Dancing friends

Leap Year was commissioned by Sokpop Collective, an indie game studio from the Netherlands who create playful, experimental games for $3 a month.

games.name: Travellin Cats Around the World 2
games.shortDescription: Find 2000 cats hidden in 20 iconic locations such as Rome, Dubai or Bangkok in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cat game creator! Can you find them all?
games.aboutText:
Travellin Cats Around the World 2 (formerly Cats Hidden Around the World 2) is a cute hidden object game set worldwide!

Travel to the sandy beaches of Dubai, linger around the ancient streets of Rome or enjoy the bustling life of Bangkok.

Found a cat? Click on it!

Features

🐾 20 Level

🐈 2000 cats

❔ Easter Eggs

💡 Hint System

🌙 Night Mode

☀️ Adjustable Brightness

⏰ Timer mode with leaderboard

🎨 Adjustable background & cats color

games.name: Rat Quest
games.shortDescription: In this platformer, jumping will be your main mechanic as you climb the level, each jump matters, if you miss a jump, you have to restart. You may be small but so are the platforms.
games.aboutText:
About this game: Rat Quest is a game about a rat platforming up the level to get his sweet sweet cheese.

Difficult platforming:

The platforming in this game is very difficult! Every jump matters, if you fall, its right back to the bottom.

Not as it seems: everytHing is finE, no reason to worry in the sLightest. very Pleasant game.

games.name: 100 Crime Cats
games.shortDescription: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! 😻 Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈
games.aboutText:
🐾 WELCOME TO ANOTHER ONE OF 100 CATS SERIES GAME 🐈

Join the cutest adventure in the world full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.
Test your attention and observation skills in this cozy and delightful hidden object game.
Each cat is more charming than the last, and every discovery brings a smile to your face. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

Key Features

- 🎮 2 Levels

- 🐈 200 Hidden Cats

- 🎵 Awesome Soundtrack

- 🎨 High Quality Resolution Artworks

- 🌗 Brightness Settings

- 💾 Progress Saves

- 🔍 Zoom

- 😺 Real Meow Sounds!

- 💥 Combo Counter!

- 💡 Tips

- 🌐 No Text

games.name: Musgro Farm
games.shortDescription: Start a farming empire in this incremental factory builder. Plant crops, combine them into recipes, and distribute them for sale. Optimize your layouts and reinvest in your infrastructure to maximize your output. Gain experience to unlock new technologies and expand your ever-growing automated farm.
games.aboutText:
Musgro Farm is a 3D incremental farming factory game. Start off with a modest farm on a small plot of land and grow it into an automated farming empire. You start with only a couple basic crops to sell, but you'll soon unlock more crops, recipes, and increasingly complex systems.

Fields grow crops over time. Buildings assemble recipes. Vehicles pick up, deliver, and sell products. You can invest in improving the efficiency of each one, but you'll need to balance your choices to avoid overwhelming any individual part of the chain. If you wish to pursue peak efficiency then you'll need to optimize your layouts, invest in the right upgrades, and plan out your technology choices. Or, you can just relax and watch as the farm runs and the numbers go up.

Musgro Farm incorporates elements from both incremental games (near-infinite upgradability, exponential level growth, huge numbers) and factory games (logistics, supply chains, recipes, layout planning) . While the game has a relatively chill atmosphere, there are a plethora of optimizations available to accelerate your progress. Build in whichever style you want: a simple farm following market trends, or a massive farming empire spanning for miles and churning out a vast array of complex recipes.

games.name: Nightmare House: The Original Mod
games.shortDescription: Wake up, it’s time for the real nightmare to begin. Make your way through a terrorizing house, uncover the secrets of a haunted hospital, fight through hordes of the undead, and try to escape Nightmare House.
games.aboutText:
Enter the haunting world of Nightmare House. This is the definitive edition of the highly acclaimed horror classic "Nightmare House 2".
Initially released in 2010 as a Source mod for Half-Life 2, the Nightmare House series captivated players with its intense atmosphere and gripping gameplay.

After fighting your way through an abandoned house, you wake up in the teared down, ironically named hospital ‘Never Lose Hope’. As you navigate these eerie halls, encounter terrors and enemies, team up with otherworldly allies and try to survive the unending hordes of horrors coming your way. If you manage to pull through, you might finally escape. Key Features

- The Full Package: Combining the original “Nightmare House 1”, its sequel “Nightmare House 2”, and “The Lost Files” into one accessible complete game. For free.

- Legacy of Horror: An old school horror game that became a cult classic. Rather than cowering from the terrors, fight back against the jump-scares. If you've yet to experience classic Source horror - this is probably the best way to begin.

- Lost And Confused: You are trapped in Nightmare House, with a haunting ghost following your every step. She’s out to get you, but you must get out of here. Never Lose Hope.

- Auto Scare System: Engineered to catch you off-guard, this system delivers dynamic scares to ensure you're never truly safe.

games.name: Atomic Exile
games.shortDescription: Atomic Exile is a top down post-apocalyptic extraction shooter set in the desert wastelands of near future America. You will visit enclaves, explore devastated ruins and encounter NPCs such as other survivors, raiders, mutated beasts and rogue machines.
games.aboutText:
Atomic Exile is a top down post-apocalyptic extraction shooter set in the desert wastelands of near future America. You will visit enclaves, explore devastated ruins and encounter NPCs such as other survivors, raiders, mutated beasts and rogue machines. Each run is a new experience with procedural generation ensuring that exploring the same area twice is never the same.

Equipment

You will start with the bare essentials. Scavenge clothing and food from the wasteland. Return to town and trade for supplies. Find valuable items to turn into cold cash. Stock up on medicine food, water and bullets. If you want to drive don’t forget fuel and tools.

Driving

The ruins are full of abandoned vehicles. With a little ingenuity some of these cars may be made to run again. Bring along fuel and tools and try your luck with repairs. Be warned a running engine is noisy and may attract trouble. Don’t forget to search the trunk. The previous owner may have left something useful behind.

Weapons

Find weapons to modify. Add enhanced sights, improve handling with better grips, swap out magazines and more. Craft the weapon that’s right for each situation.

Stealth

The denizens of the wasteland are on alert for wayward travellers. Keep out of sight and keep quiet unless you want to be diner. To much noise will bring unwanted attention. Even turning a door handle can alert nearby enemies.

Health

The wasteland is a dangerous place. Look after your health with medical supplies, food and water. Rest when you need to, run if you have to and drive when you can.

games.name: PROXIMATE
games.shortDescription: Congratulations, contractor! You've been approved to trial our cutting-edge AI visor. Use it to explore the Neuras lab and recover the staff's research. Your visor is safe, reliable, and up to 99% accurate. Just don't ask why the "ketchup" in the corner makes such a horrible crunching sound.
games.aboutText:
the optimist says it’s half human

the pessimist says it’s half monster

and the project manager says, “when can we ship it?”

PROXIMATE is a dread-driven narrative game where you investigate a deep sea laboratory and piece together the events that lead to the research team’s demise.

You'll be required to wear an image recognition visor that only tells you the bare minimum information you need to succeed — and sometimes less. Use text information, proximity data and audio clues to form a mental map of your surroundings and pray that your technology won't fail you when you need it most.

FEATURES

- There is no monster.

- Assignment timeboxed to 90 minutes . If you’re here longer than that, we might have to dock your pay.

- Your visor says that the red stain on the wall is ketchup. It was coded by some very smart people, so you should definitely trust it.

- Collect chat logs from the research team, but don't read into them too much. We're not paying you to figure out some kind of sinister mystery here.

- I mean, we haven’t seen the monster. So it’s probably not there.

- Receive helpful calls from your manager , voiced by Luke Austin, who's here to make your job easier. Probably.

- Connect with a cast of queer characters , who we definitely cared about and will miss dearly. Oh hey, have you signed that waiver yet?

- If you hear it, turn away.

THE STORY

After labor rights movements sweep large parts of India and Southeast Asia, companies around the world lose their supply of cheap exploitable workers. Melbourne-based tech startup Neuras decides to attempt the impossible: installing AI drives into the freshly dead to create a cheap and endless supply of workers.

After a year of disappointing results, the Neuras lab suddenly cuts all contact with their investors. You, a contractor for the country's largest investment firm, have been tasked with investigating the lab and recovering the firm's rightful IP. But it's the firm's other investment project -- the SONA visor -- that might end up being your bigger problem.

That, and the breathing you keep hearing behind the door.

games.name: Matelotes
games.shortDescription: The Royal Hen has disappeared! Lead a group of enthusiastic (though unqualified) sailors on a quest for glory, riches, and, as fate would have it, poultry. Visit a variety of islands, resolve political conflicts, and upgrade your boat in this narrative adventure game inspired by RPGs.
games.aboutText:
A chicken has disappeared, and the whole kingdom has been turned upside down. But have no fear, a group of sailors is on the case, hoisting anchor to explore the kingdom's islands in search of the animal.

…but they could really use some help.

MANAGE A CREW THAT LEAVES A BIT TO BE DESIRED

Some unscrupulous folk might call your crew a lost cause… Prove them wrong: get the team to muscle up by training in the barracks, have them chit-chat at the tavern to boost their charisma, or jump at an unexpected opportunity to improve their skills.

You'll quickly discover that each crew member has their own strengths and weaknesses. Assigning them to the tasks that suit them best will be crucial to the success of your endeavor or, failing that, keeping the damage to a minimum.

But make no mistake: even though your sailors might not always stand out for their strength or their wit, they've got heart and a story to tell. Some might even have a checkered past… but you know what they say about rumors.

And, because teamwork makes the dream work, you can recruit up to 10 different sailors to help out during your epic quest (note: the word "epic" is not legally binding).

INFLUENCE MAJOR POLITICAL DISPUTES (OR NEIGHBORHOOD GRIEVANCES)

The Kingdom of Sauzic is teeming with conflict, some larger than others, and the disappearance of the Royal Hen is really not helping.

Every island explored will give your sailors a chance to set off on new adventures, where each decision you make will determine the future of the kingdom, your ship, or what you'll be eating for breakfast tomorrow.

Four different factions will cross your path, each with their own ambitions and problems, and all of them, let’s be honest, are much better prepared than your crew. It's up to you to decide to help them (even if that means giving them a leg up in the hunt) or make waves instead, at the risk of facing the consequences later.

After all, if rocking the boat means you'll find the Hen first, who could blame you? You might even uncover evidence of a conspiracy with stakes far greater than the simple disappearance of a bird, however noble said bird may be. No offense to any chickens reading this.

SAIL AROUND SAUZIC, AN ANCIENT KINGDOM WHERE NO ONE HAS YET MANAGED TO ACTUALLY DRAW A MAP

While the Hen may be the pride and joy of Sauzic, the same cannot be said of its cartographers. Since no one has yet to make a halfway decent map of the area, your crew will have to set sail across a sea that's never fully visible, procedurally generated with each new game.

Map out your journey: decide to either make land or go full steam ahead to try and outpace your rivals. But don't go overboard! Sailing is no walk in the park, and your sailors have limits: keep a weather eye on their hunger and fatigue, or else you might just find yourself on the other side of a mutiny…

Fortunately, all is not lost. For a few coins, the shipwright can upgrade your ship to make it faster, sturdier, and, with a little luck, able to weather the crew’s antics.

Features:

- EXPLORE a procedurally generated sea and chart a course from island to island.

- TRAIN your team and assign each sailor to the tasks that suit them best.

- INFLUENCE four rival factions through alliances, acts of sabotage, and the decisions you make.

- UPGRADE your ship while managing your crew's hunger, fatigue, and a variety of different statuses.

- FIND the Royal Hen, and figure out what's really going on beneath the surface in the Kingdom of Sauzic.

games.name: Tempus Triad
games.shortDescription: In Tempus Triad, dive into an ancient first-person horror scenario where a scientist is thrust into an era where huge predators dominate the land.
games.aboutText:
Synopsis:

In a secret facility located deep within a remote island, scientists experiment with a rare substance capable of manipulating the boundaries of space and time: dark matter. The goal is to create revolutionary technological advancements, but the tests begin to produce anomalies, such as the appearance of prehistoric flora and the disappearance of objects, revealing the unpredictable dangers of time manipulation.

The team leader is a physicist who lost everything he loved when his wife and daughter died in a tragic accident. He sees time manipulation as an opportunity to correct the past and bring his family back. However, when he uses the technology for his own purposes, the experiment fails, and the temporal continuum ruptures, transporting him to a distorted world where time is unstable, and prehistoric predators roam freely.

Now, with the timeline on the brink of collapse, the scientist must face his choices and the monstrous creatures lurking around, while desperately seeking a way to restore the balance of the universe — and his own redemption.

Features:

- Realistic and optimized graphics for full immersion.

- First-person action for an engaging experience.

- Discreet HUD to maintain total immersion.

- Enemies with intelligent AI.

- Microphone detection.

- Jumpscares.

______________________________________________________________________

This game was developed by one person. If you wish to participate in the development or support the developer, you can find everything on Discord. Thank you!

games.name: Stairway
games.shortDescription: Get out of the building via the stairway. Observe the levels carefully for a successful exit.
games.aboutText:
This game is an anomaly finding (difference finding) walking simulator.

Game description:
Get out of the building via the stairway. Observe the levels carefully for a successful exit.

- If everything is consistent in the level with the baseline state, proceed.

- If you observe any anomalies, turn back!

Once you're out of the building, you can start the game all over again to experience all the anomalies!

---

Attention!

This game is a result of learning Unreal Engine. All sound files, 3D models, and textures are sets of free resources downloaded with some modifications.

Have fun!

games.name: Dünnes Eis - Das Spiel zum Song
games.shortDescription: Dünnes Eis is a point-and-click short story by award-winning game designer Jan “Poki” Baumann, who has won numerous awards for games such as the Deponia series. Since 2021, Poki has dedicated himself to his music and band Baumann Bergmann Pokinsson.
games.aboutText:
Dünnes Eis is a point-and-click short story by award-winning game designer Jan “Poki” Baumann, who has won numerous awards for games such as Edna & Harvey: The breakout and the Deponia series. Since 2021, Poki has been fully dedicated to his music and band Baumann Bergmann Pokinsson .

Dünnes Eis bridges the gap between Poki's music and his games: it is an interactive music video for the well-known song of the same name, which Baumann Bergmann Pokinsson re-released in 2024.

In the usual Pokiesque manner, the game deals with the themes of the song in three densely narrated chapters. Players accompany South Pole explorer Cliffi on his lonely work at an Antarctic station. Both the song and the game are about missing and being missed.

Anyone who misses Poki's games will love Dünnes Eis .

games.name: Shotgun Cop Man
games.shortDescription: GO TO HELL, ARREST SATAN. Propel yourself to justice and glory on a journey through hell in this punchy, crunchy, son-of-a-gun precision platformer from the creator of My Friend Pedro.
games.aboutText:
Blast your way through hell in Shotgun Cop Man , a precision platformer where your weapons are your wings.

Embark on a mission to arrest Satan armed with a devastating arsenal and a relentless thirst for glory. Propel yourself through hordes of irritable demons, devious traps, and thrilling challenges using the only two things you can trust: your wits and your weapons.

Conquer the handcrafted campaign or dive into user-generated levels in this fire and brimstone-fueled mission to serve justice.

Firepower Propulsion

Master your movement through the twisted corners of hell as every shot propels you forward. Whether dodging enemies, scaling walls, or leaping impossible gaps, your weapons are the key to both survival and traversal. Explosive Campaign and Challenges

Dive into an action-packed campaign in over 150 levels and face off against intense boss battles, then put yourself to the test and beat all the No Damage, Speedrun, and Kill All challenges.

Create Your Own Hellish Playground

Let your creativity shine with the built-in level editor and Steam Workshop integration. Craft, share, and conquer custom levels to push the game and your peers to their limits.

games.name: Game Designer Simulator
games.shortDescription: Game Designer Simulator is a pixel game based on real-life themes, with a non-linear storyline and card battles. Players will take on the role of a newly graduated college student in a fictional city based on Shanghai, experiencing everything from interviews to becoming a novice game Designer.
games.aboutText:
Inspired by Shanghai, Luoshandu is a lively pixel-art metropolis—and the place where your game development dream begins.

In Game Designer Simulator , you play as a fresh university graduate. With limited savings, a few belongings, and dreams of joining the games industry, you move into an unfamiliar rented apartment.

Take on part-time jobs to make ends meet, study the craft, face job interviews, and finally join a development team. Through the laughter and tears of city life, you’ll grow from a clueless rookie into a true game designer.

But landing the job is only the beginning. Workplace pressure, personal relationships, and constant clashes of ideas will test your abilities and choices. Once you’ve gained enough experience and found companions willing to stand beside you, a new path will open: secure funding, build your own team, lead a project, and create the “10/10 masterpiece” you’ve always dreamed of!

Game features

Explore a beautiful pixel-art city at your own pace. Make a cozy rented apartment your home and meet a cast of unforgettable friends.

Becoming a game designer may be your greatest dream, but life always offers more than one path. Enjoy over 10 different minigames and a wealth of side stories. Plan your time wisely and pursue the future you want!

Roadside bicycles, plane trees, utility poles, stray cats, storefronts, benches, and passersby—almost everything you see can be interacted with! Wander through Luoshandu’s bustling streets and quiet neighborhoods. Explore shops, alleyways, and distinctive city landmarks, and discover new details hidden within familiar scenes of everyday life.

Build meaningful relationships with more than 20 neighbors and over 20 coworkers at game studios! Get to know a rich cast of NPCs—their joys, frustrations, hopes, and fears. As your bonds deepen, you’ll discover sides of them few people ever see and hear the worries and dreams they rarely voice. From strangers to trusted friends, every relationship will become a treasured part of your life in the city.

During the Employee Phase, choose a company and begin your career as a game designer. Experience in-depth management gameplay and entertaining minigames. Meet different colleagues, face different events, and make choices that shape your career. If the company isn’t right for you, you can always change jobs—or save enough money to start your own game studio.

During the Producer Phase , you can finally create a game of your own. Will you stay true to your vision, or put everything else aside and focus on profit? Battle passes and lucky wheels may make money, but they don’t always make a game more fun. You’ll need to carefully balance how each feature affects your project. Recruit and train employees, and even invite old friends from earlier in your career to build the game alongside you.

Game Designer Simulator is more than a story about building a career. It is a love letter to everyone who loves games, who has ever been moved by one, and who has ever wondered:

“What if I made a game of my own?”

The evening breeze is rising over Luoshandu. Your journey as a producer is about to begin.

Add Game Designer Simulator to your wishlist now!

games.name: The Witch's Bakery
games.shortDescription: The Witch's Bakery is a 2D narrative Adventure RPG where you live a magical life as a witch-baker in Paris! Serve customers, visit iconic streets and heal people's heart with your croissants 🥐
games.aboutText:
The Witch's Bakery is a cozy narrative Adventure RPG about a joyful witch who opens her bakery in modern Paris . She has one special power: she can see into people's heart and heal their emotions through magic!

YOUR DAILY LIFE AS A WITCH-BAKER IN PARIS!

You play as Lunne, who has just arrived in the city! Each day is split into three phases:

- Daytime , where Lunne works in the bakery and helps customers through their troubles with a little magic.

- Evening , where Lunne explores Paris, builds relationships, discovers the city's secrets and goes inside her friends' troubled hearts.

- Night , where Lunne rests, improves her magic, decorates her bakery and spends time in her cosy atelier.

The story progresses through the days as you earn experience, money, and fame, meet new friends and heal their heart.

A COLORFUL PARIS IN A JOYFUL ADVENTURE!

Once your work day is done, you can visit several districts of Paris to meet with main characters , engage in activities to get to know them , buy books for new recipes , etc.

The above example is "Le Quai des Bouquinistes" located in the 6th arrondissement of Paris! This place is known for its book sellers and its collectors of various entertainment goods, like vinyls, posters, old magazines... But also, of course, for the beautiful Notre-Dame.

Each district has its own characters, activities and shops!

A STORY ABOUT EMOTIONS AND VULNERABILITY

For some people, their emotion is locked away so strongly than Lunne needs to go inside their heart to help them. She enters their "Heart Palace" , a magical space where emotions and thoughts take shape . Lunne needs to guide the personified Emotion back to the Heart's Cradle .

Inside the Heart Palace, Lunne discovers the person's deepest struggles and finds the key ingredient she needs to make a bread that will heal them !

ABOUT SUNNY LAB

We are an indie team of experienced developers from France ! We have gathered to create hopeful stories , filled with lovable characters, happy smiles and deep emotional journeys . We are always reachable on our socials @SunnyLabGames!

We are so happy to share our first game "The Witch's Bakery" with you! We are still at the beginning of production and we'll be sharing all our progress with you! Feel free to ask us any question!

THE WITCH'S BAKERY DISCORD SERVER

Join our community of bakers on The Witch's Bakery Discord! It’s the best place to find all the latest news regarding the game and where you can find a community of likeminded people to chat to. You can find the link to join the server in the FAQ pinned in the Steam Discussions page!

games.name: Palpus X Annihilation
games.shortDescription: Isometric action shooter with light RPG elements. Brutally kill tons of alien monsters, find over a dozen powerful weapons, skill up your hero & stop the blood thirsty invaders in a classic handcrafted campaign. Never ending waves await you in horde-mode!
games.aboutText:
THOUSANDS OF EVIL ALIEN MONSTERS ATTACK CONSTANTLY! BE ON YOUR TOES, STEER THE MASSES AND REACT FAST TO ENEMY AMBUSHES!

- 12 unique enemy types

- 14 weapons to find on your mission

- Relentless hordes want to eat you

- Avoid constant laser fire, rockets and mortars!

- Watch your back at all times! (especially in the dark )

AUTOMATIC CHAINGUN TOWERS, HEAVY ARMED TRUCKS, HUGE DEFENSE TURRETS.

- Play a handcrafted Campaign and Horde Mode

- Control turrets and chaingun trucks

- Explore different locations and find secret areas

- Use explosives and turrets to your advantage

- Skill up your characters abilities: Health, Strength, Accuracy and Speed

- Leave nothing but a bloody mess behind!

BLOOD, BODIES, BULLET CASINGS... ALL DESTRUCTION STAYS FOREVER

- Tons of chunks, splats, smoke and fire fill the screen.

- Accompanied by the sound of your chaingun and a Heavy Metal soundtrack

- Beautiful dynamic light system

(Ohh and there's also a story):

The company has assigned you to investigate the sudden halt in communication from one of their high-tech research facilities.

They've picked up some strange bio-signals down there...

games.name: Checkout: Cashier Simulator
games.shortDescription: Step into the shoes of a supermarket cashier in this cute point-and-click game. Scan and bag over 300 unique products to earn as many points as you can before your shift ends! Between shifts, unwind by getting to know a cast of quirky coworkers.
games.aboutText:
Congratulations on your new position at Coopers Supermarket. Today marks the first day of your exciting career as a cashier. We hope you're as excited as we are to have another employee. Let the cute art, fun sound effects, and exciting race for points distract you from the soul-crushing reality that is working in retail.

Here at Coopers we strive for excellence, fairness, and quality...for our customers. For our employees, we offer a paycheck at the lowest possible minimum wage we can get away with. Your job is to be the best cashier you can be. Don't let us down!

Scan. Bag. Take Payment. Repeat.

Scan a wide variety of products, place them all in a bag, and finish up the transaction by taking cash, check, or card payments. Check out as many customers as you can within the time limit to earn more points.

"The most riveting gameplay loop I've ever experienced." - An employee reading a card their manager handed them

Earn Points.

The faster, more accurate, and organized you are, the more points you earn. Group items from the same department to get bonus points. There are over 20 departments with 300+ products, so you'll always see something new.

Meet Your Coworkers.

Between shifts, get to know the colorful cast of characters who have worked here longer than they’d like to admit. Everyone has new dialogue each shift, so you can learn more about them and their story. Welcome to the family!

Top the Leaderboards.

Challenge your friends and coworkers to see who’s the best at their job. Working Overtime Mode (whether you signed up for it or were pressured by your manager) means an opportunity to earn double points and a chance to get your name on the Top Employee Leaderboard. "Participating in overtime shifts don't actually give you any benefits and the pay is your standard wage." -Note from the manager

We look forward to working with you! ™

games.name: HOLE
games.shortDescription: Casual & Hard FPS. Be careful with jam.
games.aboutText:
■Overview.

HOLE is a low-resolution, gun jamming, single-player FPS.
This is a small but hard gunfight.
Let's clear jam with swearing. ■Play time

5 to 30 minutes per stage.
No time limit.
Assume 2-3 hours to unlock all stages (3 in total). ■Recommended for

- Who do not have a lot of time to play, but want to enjoy hard fps

- Who want to enjoy fps casually without fear of losing equipment.

- Who want to play small single-player fps

■Cautions

- No story.

- There is no "clear" in the stage. Enemies spawn infinitely.

- There are 3 stages in total. You can challenge only one at the beginning.

- There are 4 guns in total. You can use only one at the beginning.

■How to play

- Access the floating microwave oven and jump into the hole.

- The stage is full of dangers. Try to stay alive.

- When you want to return home, find the microwave oven again and jump into the hole.

■Streaming

Streaming of this game is available with or without monetization.

games.name: Devious Path
games.shortDescription: You are trapped in an endless astral world. Keep a close eye on your surroundings to get out of the astral world.
games.aboutText:
PLUG INTO THE ASTRAL WORLD

The player will visit the astral world which is full of horrors and nightmares, Keep a close eye on the changes in the otherworldly tunnel, don’t lose sight of any anomalies. Beware of any who wants to kill you, death in the astral means that these entities can take over your body, and they will wreak havoc and destruction when they enter our world. Under any circumstances we can’t let them escape. Be careful, the mistake might be unforgivable. GAMEPLAY

▸ You have been given a location with two rooms and a common corridor
▸ Each room has its own history and inhabitants
▸ Keep a close eye on your surroundings, the changes are anomalies
▸ You must choose one of two doors to pass to the next level
▸ Move forward if you don’t see any anomalies
▸ Go back if you see an anomaly
▸ You need a key, which is hidden among the location, to open any of these doors
▸ One key - one level
▸ There are 13 levels, not counting (0) the training level (the instruction level)
▸ Death in the astral is a real threat
▸ Passage of the game based on the principle of searching for anomalies and keys Play Time

60-120 minutes

games.name: hololive Treasure Mountain
games.shortDescription: Stack the Love of Captain Marine! A Simple yet Exciting 3D Physics Puzzle Game!
games.aboutText:
Stack the Love of Captain Marine!

Hololive members transform into adorable treasures!

Stack the 3D Hololive characters without letting them overflow to create your very own mountain in this must-play 3D puzzle game for Hololive fans!

How to Play

Just toss the treasures and stack them on the island!

Combine identical treasures to transform them into larger ones!

The game ends when a treasure falls off the island!

Create bigger treasures and make consecutive combinations to boost your score through chain reactions!

And when you create the largest treasure, something amazing happens…!?

Treasure Exchange

The treasures that appear in the game can be swapped with other members!

Customize to your liking and create your own unique mountain of favorite characters!

Rankings

Compete with players from around the world and test your skills.

Aim for the high score and keep challenging yourself!

This game is a participant in the indie game brand ""holo Indie"" (※2), developed by CCMC Inc. (※1.).

It has been approved for distribution and monetization under the guidelines and regulations of ""holo Indie"".

Please note that the monetization of derivative games using content owned by Cover Corporation outside of ""holo Indie"" is not permitted.

CCMC Corp. is entrusted with website management (ex: steam) including, examination, publishing and other necessary tasks by Cover Corp.

games.name: Krypta FM
games.shortDescription: Can you solve the mystery of the Beast of Gozdary?
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the first game by Under The Sink - KryptaFM! We're very honored to greet you all in front of your devices. We'll begin with a message after which you'll be met with plenty of useful tips, in case you'd like to start your adventure.

We're going to move to Gozdary, a small village in Poland. The residents have noticed a lot of weird, paranormal things going on. The areas have been haunted by an alleged cryptid from Gozdary, who leaves tracks that are leading us to solving this puzzle. Listen to the broadcasts - valuable intel might be hidden within the messages!

We'd love to invite you on our studio's social media platforms where you can share your experiences with KryptaFM! Happy hunting! . Gameplay contains:

Nostalgic climate of a Polish village from early 2000s

Nod to early-internet webforum era

Full voiceacting of radio broadcasts!

...and much more to discover!

games.name: Blighted
games.shortDescription: Battle through a psychedelic Western nightmare in this Metroidvania action RPG from the creators of Guacamelee! and Nobody Saves the World.
games.aboutText:
Battle through a psychedelic Western nightmare to reclaim the memories of your people in Blighted , a Metroidvania action RPG featuring intense combat and a twisted, mysterious world.

The abomination known as Sorcisto consumed your village and infected the world with a deadly Blight. As the lone survivor of his rampage, you must fight through surreal environments to defeat monstrous bosses and recover the memories of your people, before your own Blight overtakes you.

Learn to harness your Blight, which can serve as a source of both power and danger, challenging players of all skill levels. Play solo or with a friend in local or online co-op, and uncover the secrets of a corrupted world.

GAME FEATURES:

- Intense, Technical Combat: Combat in Blighted is methodical, nuanced and deadly. Carefully time your attacks to weave through enemies, chain together combos, exploit openings and set up powerful finishers.

- Surreal, Interconnected World : Explore a vibrant, psychedelic landscape filled with secrets. Meet bizarre characters as you uncover the way forward.

- Challenging Boss Encounters : Confront the monstrous, blighted creatures who have come to rule these lands. Absorb their memories to become more powerful.

- Harness your Blight : Learn to master Blighted powers and systems, such as Frenzy, a dynamic difficulty system that changes enemies, environments and your abilities based on how well you're playing.

- Co-op Multiplayer : Optionally team up with a friend in fully playable local or online co-op.

- Haunting Original Score : Blighted features a new soundtrack by Jim Guthrie, whose previous work includes Superbrothers: Sword & Sworcery EP, Below, and Nobody Saves the World .

games.name: SignaNota
games.shortDescription: Experience charming pixel art and a new style of combat — unfold a rogue-like adventure with 'Slingshot Action' in SignaNota.
games.aboutText:
SignaNota is a rogue-like game brought to life with charming pixel graphics.

In SignaNota , a unique ' Slingshot Action' offers
thrilling battles where a single choice can turn the tide of combat.

Guide Signa , the fallen god of light, and shape her destiny.

Your choices will forge a new myth.

Features

- A totally new combat system awaits you. Pull and launch Signa !

- We have more than a hundred short - animations!

- You're not limited to just one companion. There are six heroines to accompany you.

- There are multiple endings. Each heroine offers a unique ending.

- Perhaps, there might even be a hidden ending to uncover.

games.name: Break the Empire
games.shortDescription: Fight your way to the capital and slay the emperor! Choose from a variety of characters with unique spells and skills! Featuring permadeath, interactable terrain, distinct builds, wild combos, and endless replayability.
games.aboutText:
Be the villain! This game will tickle that action-magic-fantasy-nerve , and if you are looking for hours of entertainment: give this game a try !

A fast-paced, yet tactical, action-roguelite!

Storm castles with hordes of undead!

...or turn the Empire against itself!

...or just smash it all with brute force!

Customize your playstyle:

Detailed features: (so far, as more will be added)

- 8 playable characters , each very different from the next. Each has six unique spells, six unique passive skills, and there are 12 base skills anyone can choose from.

- Terrain matters : Fires spread rapidly on grass, water can be frozen, pits can be fallen into.

- Wild skill combinations , allowing for completely unique playthroughs.

- Unique items with randomized qualities , exponentially adding combos and variety to the game.

- 70 Steam Achievements , which offers varied meta-progression!

- Each playthrough is a mini-campaign , starting at a small village and ending in the halls of the emperor's castle. The path will vary, taking you through magical glades, towns, fortresses, or dwarven mines.

- New game mode : Last Stand - Survive as long as you can during relentless attacks!

- 11 unique bosses!

- Dozens of enemies , each with variable stats, traits and skills.

- Hand-pixeled coziness , details, and indie warmth!

- A unique and adventurous original soundtrack.

- Hours of fun at a cheap price!

games.name: VARYZNEX
games.shortDescription: classical horizontal scroll 2D Shmup
games.aboutText:
*The DEMO version is under production and may differ from the product version.

A horizontal scrolling shooter where you defeat enemies using BITs that can change attack direction.

Defeat enemies to release energy items.
Approach them to draw them in automatically, but releasing the attack button will also attract distant items.
(The faster you collect them, the more points and energy you gain.)

Once your energy gauge is full, Hyper mode becomes available.
While Hyper is active, your ship’s shot changes to a powerful laser and enemy point values are doubled.
BITs can also block pink enemy attacks during Hyper.

Continuing to collect energy even further unlocks Double Hyper.
in Double Hyper, homing shots are added to your arsenal and points are quadrupled.
(Colliding your Hyper laser with a boss or large enemy’s laser creates a massive amount of energy items and deals heavy damage with powerful energy balls.)

Medium and larger enemies offer a time bonus — the faster you defeat them, the higher the point multiplier.
Combining this with Hyper multipliers allows for a maximum of 32x points.

In boss battles, bosses release energy items every time they lose 1/4 of their health.
The fewer seconds that have passed, the more items appear.
Defeating them quickly also grants additional “Destruction Bonus Energy.”

Clear a stage with no deaths to earn a NO MISS BONUS.
The bonus doubles with each consecutive no-miss stage, and the final stage bonus is doubled again.

3 Game Modes × 2 Difficulties (NORMAL / HARD)

NORMAL / HARD

The Hyper gauge also functions as shield energy.

At full gauge: NORMAL allows up to 6 hits, HARD allows up to 3 hits.
In HARD mode, enemy attacks become more intense, but the number of energy items that appear is doubled (though each item provides half the energy).

X-mode (X-NORMAL / X-HARD)

You can hold up to 2 shields (1 on HARD).
Even if you lose them upon taking damage, you can redeploy them by accumulating gauge after activating Hyper.
Hitting enemies with shots outside of Hyper increases the gauge.
Activating Hyper while holding a shield grants bonus points.

VX-mode (VX-NORMAL / VX-HARD)

Energy gain is 1.5× higher than other modes.
You have 1 automatically regenerating shield that works even during Hyper.
When respawning, the energy gauge retains the amount it had before the player ship was destroyed.
Gauge increase from shooting enemies outside of Hyper is higher than in X-mode.

Settings Screen Options

BLUR: Toggle blur effects
SHAKE: Toggle screen shake
EFFECT: Set to MIN to reduce explosion debris and other objects
BLASTTINT: Choose explosion effect color intensity
WALLWARN: Turn terrain collision warning ON/OFF
LOW SPEED: Choose from 4 types of low-speed movement behavior
BIT Control: 6 types (TYPE-A to TYPE-F) — forward fixed, free movement, hold-style, etc.

〇 TYPE-A・TYPE-B
Press the R button (default) to cycle through BIT positions.

〇 TYPE-C (Recommended)・TYPE-D
Hold R and move the control stick to adjust BIT position. Release R to confirm the position.

〇 TYPE-E・TYPE-F
When R is not pressed: BITs stay in front.
When R is held: BITs move to a different fixed position (position changes depending on lever input or lack thereof).

Config Screen

Separate from the Settings screen, you can access it with ESC or the START button (default).

Here you can configure key mappings, controller vibration, volume, toggle between fullscreen/windowed mode (window size settings are independent of fullscreen), and exit the game.

*Replay playback may not be normal depending on the content of the game update.
Thank you for your understanding.

games.name: PROJEKT GODHAND
games.shortDescription: ULTIMATE TOOL ASSISTED BULLSHITTING KEYBOARD DESTRUCTION RHYTHM GAME
games.aboutText:
ULTIMATE TOOL ASSISTED BULLSHITTING KEYBOARD DESTRUCTION RHYTHM GAME

Experience the thrill of egregiously cheating at an extremely hard 8 button rhythm game! Worried about hitting the right button? Any key on the same half of your keyboard will do. Unbelievably fast streams? Just hit them as chords, it's fine. GODHAND takes care of all that pesky "thinking" so you can concentrate on the important stuff: rapidly smashing your keyboard like a crazed gorilla.

But of course, there have to be limits to such overpowered abilities. Too many inputs will fill up the heat gauge, which *checks notes* vastly increases your score...? Who came up with this??

Well, whoever it is... they've packed it to the brim with over 50 songs of base content. That's right: somehow, none of the stuff in this graphic is DLC. It's probably got at least one VTuber you like. Collabs with with vivid/stasis, Rotaeno, UNBEATABLE, WACCA, and ADOFAI. And we're literally just getting started...

(if you destroy your keyboard in the game, you destroy your keyboard in real life.)

"I ALSO HEARD THIS GAME HAS GIRLS KISSING IN IT"

It does. There's a compact VN in here about girls kissing and other related activities. Please use the included "SFW Mode" if you think that sounds like a thing you should use.

games.name: 机械恋心
games.shortDescription: 当科技突破伦理的局限，当天才的火花和机械的纯洁相遇，当积久的矛盾与必然的巧合共鸣，不受祝福却被期待的恋爱就此展开......
games.aboutText:
故事简介

世界大战的硝烟远去，新千年的钟声敲响，人们再也不用为生存而担忧。
能源、医疗、机械，各个领域的科研人员共同建立了国际科学城，将人类的科技推向新的高峰。
在科学城光鲜温暖的外表下，冷酷的优胜劣汰是这里的法则，只有真正的天才和强者得以留下。

年轻的研究员陈京，凭借聪明与努力，终于进入了国际科学城人工智能领域的顶级实验室。
然而等待他的是优中选优的淘汰制度，谁都不会关心旁人的去留。

陈京的科研工作遇到重重阻挠，他也明白这并不是他想要的生活。
幸运的是，有一位慷慨的雇主，给他带来了另一份梦寐以求的工作。
以此为契机，陈京终于和“那位少女”相遇了…… 角色介绍

游戏说明

《机械恋心》是Lunatic Works的第二部作品，游戏类型为文字冒险。玩家将选择故事走向，达成不同的结局。全篇剧本量约25万字，分为10章。
我们的美术和演出都比首作《青箱》有了不小的提升。相比《青箱》中的无选项单一路线，这次我们有三条主要路线可供选择。
角色的配音目前还没有制作完成，将会在后续版本中添加。

我们自研并开源的框架Nova，相比《青箱》时也有了更多的功能与优化，其他使用Nova制作游戏的朋友可以通过《机械恋心》来体验Nova能够扩展的各种功能。比如我们在设置界面中增加了更多可供玩家自定义的内容，在鼠标菜单中也加入了更多功能，并且支持了手柄操作。
Nova的发布地址为GitHub上的 Lunatic-Works/Nova 。

本制作组微博和b站账号为LunaticWorks，QQ群为876212259，欢迎关注并反馈问题和建议。 制作人员

音乐：冬勺
演出：woctordho、小小童鞋、人果角虫、Ibukilin
音效：Gliese
程序：小小童鞋、zhouhy
UI设计：匣中猫
