games.name: Hypogea
games.shortDescription: Escape from a mysterious underground megastructure in this short atmospheric 3d-platformer.
games.aboutText:
Hypogea is a short, atmospheric 3D platformer where you play the role of a staff-wielding automaton trying to escape from an abandoned underground megastructure.

Travel through the mysterious structure using your hooked staff to pole-vault, swing, climb, catch yourself and more.

Restore the puzzling mechanisms of the facility and help its automaton inhabitants.

Explore the cavernous halls and dark corridors of a mysterious subterranean complex through visuals inspired by games from the early 2000s.

Piece together the eclectic narrative via the game's environmental clues and wordless storytelling.

games.name: ISO-CORE
games.shortDescription: Farm, craft, build, and explore a Beautiful isometric pixel art world. Explore new places and find new biomes to expand your list of items, buildings, and recipes.
games.aboutText:
The Game is in development, So the name and/or important aspects of the game may change before release.

Explore a procedurally generated 2D isometric pixel art world. Build And Craft your own base, find new places and biomes, fight mobs and expand your world.

games.name: Rita
games.shortDescription: Rita is a cozy adventure where a little chicklet solves word-based puzzles to transform the world around her. Follow her story across generations, meet her grandchicklet, and be a part of her legacy.
games.aboutText:
Rita is one smart chicklet, with a knack for solving crosswords and other word puzzles. As she explores the delightful world around her, she’ll collect letters to fill out newspaper pages which progresses and shapes her legacy.

From hopping through light platforming challenges to interacting with endearing characters, Rita's world is full of surprises, warmth, and plenty of a-ha moments. Guide her to grandparenthood, meet her grandchicklet, and learn about the loving bond they shared.

Engaging Word-Based Puzzles

Solve classic and creative word puzzles, including crosswords, word searches, rebus, anagrams, and more. Use letters Rita finds in the world in order to progress her story.

A Cozy World to Explore

Begin Rita’s adventure in the picturesque town of Aspendale in 1933, filled with secrets, collectables, and quirky characters. Light platforming segments add a touch of adventure, but nothing a little chicklet can’t handle!

Light Metroidvania Mechanics

As Rita solves puzzles, her clever solutions will bring the world to life, transforming the environment in meaningful ways. Watch as ramps appear, bridges repair themselves, trains manifest, time passes, and palm trees grow, revealing exciting new areas just waiting to be explored!

Life Lessons and Memories

Uncover the lessons learned and taught by Rita throughout her life expressed as bite-sized puzzles in a quasi-out-of-this-world experience.

Relaxing Atmosphere

With its cozy art style and soothing soundtrack, Rita offers the perfect escape for puzzle lovers and fans of heartwarming stories alike.

games.name: Dreamlike Love with Seira
games.shortDescription: Enjoy the memories with a beautiful maid in your dreams and heal your fatigue in reality.
games.aboutText:
Dreamlike Love with Seira is a light visual novel, featuring renowned illustrator rubisama as the director and original artist.

This visual novel presents a single linear story, with text dialogue, manga-style illustrations, 2D character art, and voice acting.

It does not include branching storylines.

❤Hope you could experience the sweet service and warm dreams with Seira within the brief durations❤

Planning, Artist:Rubi-sama (るび様)

Scenario: Orisuke (オリスケ)

A Story about Sweet Dream

The protagonist, Haruto Watari, finishes a stressful day of work.

He goes back home, exhausted, to a cluttered room that only makes him all the more fatigued.

But unable to find the drive or will to clean up, he collapses into bed and falls asleep.

Then, he has an unbelievable dream... A dream where he's the owner of a luxurious Western mansion.

And in that dream mansion, he meets a maid named Seira.

A maid whose duty is to serve him, her master—

Be it brewing a delicious cup of black tea or comforting him with kind swords, she heals his tired soul.

A dream of sweet, passionate service is about to begin...

A Maid Providing Perfect Service

☕️ Seira ☕️ Voice Actress: Hana Kagehotaru

Miss Seira, the maid who appears in Haruto's dream.

With proper etiquette and versatile domestic skills, she excels at brewing exquisite black tea.

She patiently listens to Haruto's work-related complaints, embodying a truly perfect woman.

" Please don't hesitate. After all, you are the owner of this mansion."

Join our discord

games.name: Metro Gravity
games.shortDescription: Explore, fight, solve puzzles and bend gravity to escape the dream-like world of the Halls! Metro Gravity is a mind-boggling musical adventure with rhythmic combat and compelling lore.
games.aboutText:
Explore the twisting passages and alleys of the Halls, a liminal manifestation of the subconscious of many.

After clicking a shady looking hyperlink and filling out a survey , you find yourself in a non-sensical place where gravity implies no "up" or "down." The unfortunate residents encourage you to find your way out by facing your regrets and getting stronger.

Gain abilities, jam with foes and conquer the Halls!

- Walk on walls, use your gravity beam and other abilities you unlock to traverse the Halls how you please.

- Solve puzzles! Test your wit with perplexing and disorienting challenges.

- Explore a cute low-poly environment with retro-inspired pixel graphics.

- Make friends with the cast of characters in the same situation as you! Help them out with tasks, and they might just reward you with items and lore.

- Fight a plethora of enemies to the beat of unique soundtracks !

- Time your parries, dodges and jumps to the beat of the song!

- An expansive list of scores dictate tempo and feel of the combat!

- Almost every sound effect, from abilities, to dialogue, to combat sounds are in tune with the melody!

games.name: Battle of Goldfish Scooping
games.shortDescription: "Battle of Goldfish Scooping" is an asymmetrical multiplayer action game. Players take on the roles of scoops and goldfish to aim for high scores. Based on your previous play results, you can acquire skills and enhance parameters to aim for even higher scores!
games.aboutText:
"Battle of Goldfish Scooping" is an asymmetrical multiplayer action game inspired by kingyo-sukui , the classic goldfish scooping game from Japanese fairs.

Scoop with Delicate Skill

Use your poi —a fragile paper scoop—to catch goldfish and drop them into the bowl.

Scoop them one after another to trigger combos and earn bonus points!

Play as a Goldfish and Escape!

Take on the role of a goldfish and dart through the water to avoid the poi.

Collect glowing orbs to raise your score—and even if you’re scooped up, bounce your way to freedom!

Grow Stronger Each Time You Play

Earn new skills and boost your stats based on your results after each match.

Keep playing, keep improving, and aim for the high score!

Join the Festival Online

Dive into a shared tank with players from around the world!

But be careful—other players might steal your catch!

A playful twist on a timeless Japanese festival tradition.

Will you scoop—or be scooped?

Regarding Streaming and Video Content

We welcome gameplay streaming and the posting of gameplay videos for this game.

There are no specific restrictions on monetization.

games.name: Pocket Waifu: Desktop Pet
games.shortDescription: Elevate your desktop experience by adopting a desktop waifu! Similar to a tamagotchi, she will keep you company on your desktop while you work or play other games! Pat her head, feed her snacks, give her plushies, or go fishing. Bring a little joy and cozy vibes to your daily routine!
games.aboutText:
Want a cute little friend to keep you company during those long work or gaming sessions?
Pocket Waifu is your new adorable 3D chibi desktop companion! She'll hang out on your other monitor while you're working, or entertain you while you play other games! Adopt little Silvy and interact with her in various ways while she hangs out on your desktop.

Features:
• Achievements!
• Simple and easy to use UI
• Gorgeous 3D model and physics interactions
• Many settings options to customize your experience and performance optimizations.
• Over 80 unique animations and a variety of expressions, custom props, and foods.
• Compatible with all other games, software, and live wallpapers

Pat her head, boop her nose, or yeet her across your screen when she gets in your way!

Play video games, ride a roomba across your screen, or dance to keep her entertained!

Stream, clean the screen, catch bugs and mine minerals to earn money for food, gifts and upgrades!

Come back everyday, pet her head, and make her discover new food to increase her affection for you!
When she loves you enough, she'll draw you a cute sketch and you'll unlock a gorgeous new background and new fun interactions!

Planned Features:
• CHAOS MODE (she will be very disruptive in very fun ways!)
• More interactions
• More gaming and work activities
• Accessories, outfits, and customizations earned through gameplay
• To Do list and Pomodoro timer
• Other language translations

games.name: Fireside Feelings
games.shortDescription: Share your thoughts and discover those shared by others, in Fireside Feelings. Gather around the welcoming warmth of the campfire and take part in conversations between real people separated in space and time. Sometimes, we all need a good talk under the stars.
games.aboutText:
Fireside Feelings is a mental wellness experience that promotes empathy, connection, and positivity among players. So grab a blanket, your favourite hoody, and a nice beverage and come chat around the campfire.

“Do your childhood dreams still echo in who you’ve become?”

“Do you prefer to cook food, or have someone cook food for you?”

Share your thoughts on a range of topics - sometimes sweet, sometimes profound - to help create a rich and meaningful tapestry of thoughts and feelings that are personal and authentic.

Unlock objects to furnish your campfire, and make it your place to stop and take a breath.

Share experiences, express your emotions, and be a part of a caring community.

Conversations are with real people, but are not live, and there is no direct interaction with others. Discover their thoughts at your own pace.

Answers are moderated and filtered to ensure your safety. Content warnings can be set according to your preferences so certain topics are avoided.

games.name: Z Rush
games.shortDescription: Z Rush is an exciting strategic 3D game where your task is to place zombies in such a way that they can destroy all the turrets on the level.
games.aboutText:
Z Rush is an exciting strategic 3D game where your task is to place zombies in such a way that they can destroy all the turrets on the level.



Progress through levels, fight against various types of turrets, use different types of zombies and their abilities to achieve victory. Choose the right strategies to overcome all obstacles and reach your goal.



Zombies, turrets, the environment - all of this awaits you in "Z Rush".



Are you ready for the challenge and can you destroy all the turrets with your zombies? Test yourself in this exciting strategy game and see if you have what it takes!

games.name: Wool at the Gates
games.shortDescription: A minimalist tactical base defense game where you fight as a hero, command troops, and build powerful class synergies while fortifying your city against relentless waves of invading sheep.
games.aboutText:
Inspired by games like Thronefall , SNKRX , and Warcraft III , Wool at the Gates blends strategic base building with fast-paced hero combat and deep class synergy systems that evolve across each run.

Gameplay

- Base Building: Construct and upgrade towers, walls, barracks, and economy structures to strengthen your defenses. Limited build slots mean every choice matters.

- Round-Based Strategy: Plan your defenses during calm build phases, then survive increasingly difficult waves of enemies.

- Class Synergies: Combine building types to unlock powerful auto-battler-inspired class bonuses and define your playstyle.

- Faction Perks: Choose between Human, Orc, and Elf structures to unlock unique faction-specific upgrades and strategies.

- Real-Time Combat: Fight alongside your army as a powerful hero, using abilities and positioning to hold the line during chaotic battles.

Replayability & Game Modes

Campaign

Progress through handcrafted maps featuring escalating waves of enemies, tactical challenges, and multiple difficulty levels. Each map requires you to adapt your strategies to overcome unique encounters.

Wild Mode

A fully randomized mode where heroes, maps, enemies, and available options change each run, creating unpredictable scenarios and emergent strategies.

Endless Runs

A continuation of the Campaign where you face continuously scaling waves of enemies to test how long your defenses can hold.

games.name: Escape from Hornhead
games.shortDescription: Escape from Horn head is 3D horror game. You need to find the keys and potions before he catches up with you. Explore the rooms, look for objects and avoid the pursuer. Try to find the best way, remember the movement of the Horned-headed demon chasing its victim, that is, you.
games.aboutText:
Escape from Horn head

A game "find a way out of the room"-like, for those who love the horror genre. You are being chased by a Hornhead. You need to find the keys and potions before he catches up with you.

The oppressive atmosphere is conveyed through the gloomy soundtrack, the dark and mysterious interior of the old mansion and the constant feeling that you are being watched.

Some keys will be hanging in the most visible place, and some are hidden better. Explore the rooms, look for objects and avoid the pursuer. Try to find the best way, remember the movement of the Horned-headed demon chasing its victim, that is, you.

games.name: Dungeons & Desserts
games.shortDescription: Dungeons & Desserts is a roguelite dungeon crawler where you also run a cosy bakery. Journey through candy-themed realms, gather rare ingredients and craft mouth-watering desserts to sell across your counter, cafe and relic room, all while a greedy landlord keeps raising your rent.
games.aboutText:
Dungeons & Desserts is a cozy dungeon crawler meets bakery sim. Crawl candy-themed dungeons for ingredients, craft desserts to sell, and try not to miss rent, or your landlord takes your furniture.

Running a bakery isn’t easy, especially with a greedy, micromanaging landlord breathing down your neck. Every week, they make up new fees and increase the rent, forcing Crispin to work harder just to keep his business afloat. Don’t miss too many payments, or you could lose everything.

Features

- Explore the candy-themed dungeons, fight candy foes, and collect exotic ingredients for your bakery.

- Craft mouthwatering desserts, stock your displays, and serve customers to keep your shop running.

- Upgrade your kitchen, attract more customers, and boost productivity to stay ahead of the ever-increasing rent.

- Race Against Time – With limited daily actions, you must balance exploration, baking, and shopkeeping before the next rent deadline.

games.name: BLOODSAINT
games.shortDescription: "BLOODSAINT is not a remaster of a 94's retro-hardcore minigame about a cleric performing a ritual for a ruthless synthetic deity, but pretty close."
games.aboutText:
"BLOODSAINT is not a remaster of a 94's retro-hardcore minigame about a cleric performing a ritual for a ruthless synthetic deity, but pretty close."

Fueled by saturated guitars in a punchy soundtrack, BLOODSAINT was created following a decade of players feedback on Walter Machado's topdown arcade titles, mainly UBERMOSH, and it happens 10.000 years after the events of the classic series.

games.name: Echoes From Below
games.shortDescription: Echoes From Below is a mystery dungeon tactical RPG. Lead four hunters into the dungeons, where every fortune you bring home comes at a price. Fight side by side as bonds grow into love, rivalry or grief that changes how they fight, and the dead never return. How many will you bring home?
games.aboutText:
Echoes From Below is a mystery dungeon tactical RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Lead a party of four hunters into the dungeons, where every fortune you bring home comes at a price.

Explore dark and mysterious dungeons, fight monsters and collect resources. Grow your guild, deepen the bonds between your hunters, and above all, come home alive.

Beware: not everything down there is gold, and death is permanent.

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

The Story

"Beneath the village of Hollowmere, the dungeons swallow whole guilds. Great disasters have broken the strongest hunters in the land, and two years on, the village is still counting its dead. Now you lead its newest guild: a handful of hunters and a charter to earn.

But the Below isn’t the only thing hunting. Someone is slaughtering the hunters, people who know more than they say keep begging you to turn back, and every secret you uncover seems to echo from somewhere deeper.

The answers are down there. So is everything you can lose."

⚔️

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Game Features

Bonds Forged in Battle

Hunters who fight together grow closer. Rivalries, love and mentorships grow from what happens in battle, and they change how your party fights. But be careful: death is permanent, and the loss leaves scars on those who remain.

Body-Swap Tactical Combat

Swap between your hunters to shape your tactics. Every turn runs on AP, so position your party on the grid, plan your moves and chain skill combos for powerful damage.

Be a Guild Master

You run the guild, and you decide who goes below. Choose and manage your hunters, each class with its own skills and abilities, and build the party that fits your playstyle: Knight, Barbarian, Scout, Mage, Miner, Priest, Gourmet and more.

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

More Features

- Morale System: Hunters can flee or turn on the party if their morale hits zero.

- Ailments and the Infirmary: Sick hunters need treatment before it's too late.

- Hand-crafted 2D Fantasy Art: Lantern-lit depths and detailed sprite work.

How many will you bring home?

games.name: Dofamine VR
games.shortDescription: Dofamine VR is a first-person sci-fi puzzle adventure. Explore a mysterious research facility, manipulate experimental devices, redirect energy beams, and solve interconnected puzzles using VR interactions. Uncover the truth behind a catastrophic scientific experiment.
games.aboutText:
Dofamine VR is an immersive first-person VR puzzle game set in a sci-fi environment, where you navigate a dark laboratory to uncover the cause of a catastrophic event. Blending exploration, logical puzzles, interactive environments, and tense atmosphere, this game offers a memorable journey.

Story
In a scientific facility experimenting with the “God Particle” (the Higgs boson), something catastrophic occurred. You take the role of an investigator trying to piece together what happened: find clues, reconstruct hidden connections, and reveal the truth behind the disaster.

Gameplay
Each level combines puzzle-solving and exploration:

- Analyze surroundings and gather clues

- Reconstruct links, information blocks, decode relationships

- Interact with scientific devices and lab elements

- Story delivered via environment and audio cues

Features
• VR puzzles and exploration: complete immersion in virtual reality.
• Sci-fi atmosphere and high-tech laboratory setting.
• Emphasis on thought over action: logic, combinations, intuition.
• Single-player narrative experience with deep ambiance.
• Audio design and music heighten suspense.

vr puzzle, vr mystery, vr science game, virtual reality lab, higgs boson experiment, vr investigation, vr exploration, vr logic puzzles, vr atmospheric, vr sci-fi

games.name: The Town of Downpour
games.shortDescription: 먼 옛날, 끝없이 비가 내리는 세상 속에 한 여행자가 있었습니다. 점점 물 속으로 잠겨가고 있는 세상에서, 여행자는 여정을 시작했습니다. 당신은 슬픔과 분노로 잠겨가는 세계에서 '상냥한 빛'을 찾기위한 모험을 떠납니다. 하지만 그것만이 이 이야기의 전부는 아닙니다...
games.aboutText:
비가 내리는 나라(The Town of Downpour)는 탑 다운 및 횡스크롤 어드벤처가 결합된 짧은 내러티브 게임입니다. 현대 배경의 도시와 비가 그치지 않는 판타지 세계, 두 공간을 오가며 모험하세요. 주인공 캐릭터를 조작해 주변 환경과 사물을 조사하면서 주어진 이야기를 따라나가 보세요. 시놉시스

먼 옛날, 끝없이 비가 내리는 세상 속에 한 여행자가 있었습니다. 점점 물 속으로 잠겨가고 있는 세상에서, 여행자는 여정을 시작했습니다.

당신은 슬픔과 분노로 잠겨가는 세계에서 '상냥한 빛'을 찾기위한 모험을 떠납니다. 하지만 그것만이 이 이야기의 전부는 아닙니다... 특징

- 탑 다운 어드벤처와 횡스크롤 어드벤처의 결합

- 스토리 중심의 내러티브 게임

- 손으로 그린 유려한 그래픽

- 약 2시간 분량의 단편 이야기

games.name: Bang Bang Barrage
games.shortDescription: Survive the treacherous sea in this quirky multiplayer shooter game! Play solo or team up and fight off Cthulhu's minions. Master a unique recoil-based mechanic to blast enemies and chart your course. Mix and match upgrades to craft the perfect sea-surviving strategy!
games.aboutText:
You've awakened the Unnamable, and now hordes of enemy minions encircle you! Take aim, shoot them down, and use the recoil to dodge for your life! Your power grows over time, yet hallucinations and visions never cease. Will you navigate your way out of these treacherous waters? Caution Survival Tips:

- Fire at anything that looks suspicious (even if it appears friendly).

- Your guns won't misfire, but their recoil might backfire.

- Avoid unnecessary physical contact.

- Embrace moments of unexpected wonders.

- Swapping outfits might cause illusions (stay calm if this happens).

- Team up with your allies (or "drag-ons") for thrilling adventures!

- Facing off against Cthulhu? Well, there's a slim chance of success... fingers crossed!

P.S.: A kiss from your friend can bring you back to life (in-game only).

games.name: Come to my party!
games.shortDescription: Jimin dreams of finally having her first birthday party, but what begins as a childhood wish unravels into social pressure, fragile friendships, family expectations, and consequences that hit closer than you’d like. Join Jimin in this coming-of-age story where every choice carries weight.
games.aboutText:
"If you become class president, I'll throw you a birthday party."

10-year-old Jimin always has to share. From hand-me-down clothes to the rice straight out of her bowl, nothing feels like it’s truly hers. Invisible between her honor-student older sister and her adorable little brother, she is suddenly presented with a special offer from her mom — if she becomes class president, she can have her very own birthday party. Maybe, just maybe, this could be her chance to finally have a moment that's all her own.

Quirky Classmates

To become class president, she first needs friends. Jimin begins approaching her classmates, each with their own personality, background, and stories they've never shared. From the shy Eunji to the mysterious Daeun, each friend carries their own inner burdens and motives.

Always Stuck in the Middle

At home, Jimin is always in the middle. Between her older sister, who excels at everything and the youngest, who monopolizes all the attention, little is left for Jimin. The hurt and conflict she feels within her family follows her within the classroom walls. Will becoming class president change things? Will throwing a birthday party make anything different?

Lighthearted Humor, Deeply Rooted Emotions

Come to my Party! blends lighthearted humor with themes that hit hard. Live through the eyes of ten-year-old Jimin — experience the bittersweet memories of childhood, the painful indifference of adults, and tangled emotions, often immediately followed by Jimin’s persevering humor and charm. Experience emotional whiplash as you find yourself tearing up from both laughing and crying.

12 Endings, Your Choice

The choices you make in conversations change Jimin's relationships and her day. Whose side to take, what words to say — a single choice that seems trivial can lead to an entirely different ending. Friendships may grow closer or fall apart beyond repair. Whether Jimin can make friends, become class president, and successfully throw her birthday party is in your hands.

Immerse Yourself in 90s South Korea

Before cellphones and the internet, kids connected much differently, and Jimin is no different. Play a variety of mini-games that let you share in Jimin's daily life, from playing ddakji with friends to vandalizing a rival K-Pop group’s posters. Experience a day in the life of a '90s elementary schooler in South Korea up close.

Handcrafted with Heart

Come to My Party! is a deeply personal coming of age story created by a solo developer, featuring entirely hand crafted art and storytelling.

games.name: Solace Creek
games.shortDescription: A PSX-stylized horror mystery set in the lonely Taraset Station. Haunted by a monstrous presence, with six mysterious red coins, you embark on a tense and deliberate journey. Solace Creek is a retro-inspired horror title with a focus on exploration, atmosphere & puzzle solving.
games.aboutText:
You awaken in a strange, abandoned research station. Disoriented and alone, clutching a handful of mysterious crimson coins. But you're not truly alone...something lurks in the shadows, watching your every move.

Solace Creek is a PSX-style horror mystery that strands you in the oppressive isolation of Taraset Station. Stalked by a monstrous threat and guided by six cryptic red coins, you are tasked with navigating a tense, atmospheric journey driven by deliberate exploration and retro puzzle-solving. Uncover the mysteries of the station, encounter esoteric and strange residents, and even receive some help from an unexpected companion.

The Secrets of TARASET Station

Something terrible has happened here... But what is this place? And how did you get here? The creeping darkness of Taraset Station remains an overwhelming presence throughout the game, one where you must uncover secret after secret, with the north star of escaping being paramount.

An unsettling Shadow

A sinister entity dwells in the station's dark corridors, drawn to noise and light. Hide when necessary and try to escape, though that may prove more difficult than it sounds. Be tactful, move slowly, and grab your opportunity; only then may you yet survive the looming darkness that lurks within.

Drawing on Inspirations

Solace Creek calls forth not only cramped, oppressive hallways and puzzles from survival horror greats, but it also takes you outside the confinement of Taraset. In Solace Creek, you will be faced with exploring a mysterious, foggy dwelling that not only hides its own horrors, but should not be considered a place for comfort or leisure. As always, respect and, in many cases, beware the fog.

Will you escape this dark place... or become its prey?

What secrets does Solace Creek hold?

games.name: Palettopia
games.shortDescription: Paint beautiful island cities with a brushstroke in this cozy puzzle game. Explore endless islands and solve puzzles while balancing the serene landscapes and your growing urban districts. Discover vibrant biomes and their adorable inhabitants as you paint your own perfect utopia in Palettopia.
games.aboutText:
Splash color onto infinite islands to create vibrant cities. Meet the needs of your citizens by placing required city districts in specific locations in Puzzle Mode or paint your city any way you want in Creative Mode. The world is your canvas. Simply select a district from your color palette and brush it across the land, instantly turning your strokes into bustling city districts.

Solve the island puzzle by placing required districts with limited paint resources, fulfilling the need requirements of each district to earn more paint and create harmony with the land. Scale your challenge by difficulty and map size and increase your score by placing districts in their optimal environments.

A new canvas, every time. Never paint the same city twice. Use the procedural engine to craft unique island layouts by combining 5 different terrain features - Mountain, River, Lakes, Woodlands & Wetlands. In Puzzle Mode, select map size and difficulty to generate an infinite number of islands to solve.

Immerse yourself in the world of Palettopia as you watch weather roll across your city, discover the local wildlife, and explore multiple island biomes to unlock your digital diorama.

What Palettopia Offers:

- 🎨 Intuitive City Painting

- 🧩 Harmonious Puzzles

- ♾️ Infinite Replayability

- ✨ Creative Freedom

What Palettopia Does Not Offer:

- ⚔️ Combat or Violence

- ⏳ Timers or Pressure

- 🌋 Volcanic Eruptions (…yet)

Palettopia is lovingly inspired by games like:

- Islanders

- Dorfromantik

- Townscaper

💌 A Note from the Team:

Palettopia is crafted by a small team of friends and family united by a passion for video games, art, and creativity. Together, we aim to share the joy and wonder of building beautiful things with others.

We are pouring our hearts into this, and your support means the world to us. We hope our little island builder brings you a moment of joy!

games.name: OPERATIVES: Revolve
games.shortDescription: Every card is both cover and weapon. In your hand, they block bullets, blades and death itself. It’s a visually intense deckbuilder built on strategic play. Your cards are destructible, their position, sequence and play matter more than just the cards you pick during a run.
games.aboutText:
Sacrifice Cards To Defend
Cards have a unique health system, indicated by their Wheel. They can be destroyed in combat, adding a unique strategic layer to how you manage your cards.

Two-Sided Combat , with each operative guarding one side. Distributing and planning your card placement for defense is critical. Additionally, attacking with a card discards it, leaving you vulnerable.

Toolkit System
Each card can be upgraded by installing unique Chassis and Wheel toolkits. Each toolkit boasts its own distinct design and effects.

Intense Strategic Combat
Swap card upgrades, adjust your play order, and balance protection with sacrifice. Small tactical tweaks can completely transform how a battle ends, turning brutal defeats into hard-earned wins through mastery.

200+ Cards

200+ Items
Combine over 200+ cards with 200+ items to create exponentially bigger variety of play.

Chain Mechanics
Master complex synergy chains where timing, placement, and tactical depth matter just as much as deckbuilding. Built for dynamic experimentation, not locked archetypes/builds.

5 Operatives
Each run is different. Select 2 operatives and combine their deck.
Each Operative has their own set of unique cards, designed to synergize differently when paired with a different Operative.

Evolving Challenge
Difficulty and mechanics are highly adjustable. Enemies come in varied forms and employ dynamic attack strategies.

Meta Progression
Unlock more cards, toolkits, artifacts and mechanics as you progress.

Optimization
This game is optimized to run smoothly on older devices, it can lasts for around 4 hours on steamdeck.

Play as Operatives, secret agents chosen to enforce the will of the Machine Doctrine. In this world, humanity didn’t invent technology; it was placed into our hands when the Doctrine descended in our most primitive age, propelling civilization forward and sowing the chaos that followed.

games.name: Legend vs. Legion
games.shortDescription: Legend vs. Legion is a roguelite HERO defense! A twist on the traditional tower defense game, play as a legendary hero empowered by a random arsenal of powerful spells and artifacts. Defend against hordes of monsters using strategy and reflexes, and save the realm of Valia.
games.aboutText:
THE WORLD'S LAST HOPE...

Kingdom Valia is in ruin. Roads are infested with bandits and ratfolk marauders. Safe havens are safe no longer, having been overtaken by vicious orcs, cunning goblins, enchanted golems, bomb-hurling automata, and ... animated crops?!

Legend... you must clear the land of this evil!

A VAST ARRAY OF SPELLS AT YOUR DISPOSAL...

Gather potent spells and mystic artifacts as you conquer mighty foes. Strategically choose among choices of spells and artifacts to develop your own unique playstyle. As you grow stronger, use your new powers to keep enemies from passing!

SLASH, DODGE, AND ROLL YOUR WAY TO VICTORY...

.

Survive the onslaught of arrows, fireballs, bombs, swords, slime ooze, and eggplant seeds that come your way - and then strike!

A UNIQUE BLEND OF GENRES...

LEGEND vs. LEGION blends elements of arcade, roguelite, base defense, and bullet hell gameplay into one chaotic adventure. Journey through strange lands and prevent enemies from passing, by sword and spell. Choose your arsenal to fit your desired fighting style - whether as an adept spellsword, a mighty warrior, a dextrous fighter, a well-rounded druid, and so on.

FEATURING...

-

Roguelite gameplay - each playthrough offers a unique challenge with randomly chosen abilities + artifacts

- Character progression - unlock and upgrade your arsenal by completing side missions, to become the most powerful defender of the realm.

- High replayability, countless synergies - over 160+ enemies and 20+ bosses to encounter across 10+ biomes, and dozens of spells and artifacts that synergize in unique ways.

- Easy to pick up, hard to master - you'll need strategy, reflexes, and resilience to survive against the Legion.

games.name: Polylylyrhythm
games.shortDescription: The much-talked-about "Polyrhythm" on social media has finally been officially released! Can you handle the 3/4, 5/4, 7/4... and all those crazy polyrhythms!? It’s simple yet incredibly challenging! A new kind of rhythm game is here! Come and test your rhythm skills in this beat-pounding madness!
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the enchanting world of polyrhythms!
We thought nobody could beat this rhythm game, but the rhythm game gods proved us wrong and crushed it! So we’ve cranked up the volume and quality, and it’s back with a vengeance!
Can you conquer this rhythm? Bring it on!

It’s a simple game where all you have to do is press the corresponding key the moment a circle reaches a vertex of a shape!
Well... the number of shapes will gradually increase, though...

Stage select offers even more complex modes like Rest Mode and Offbeat Mode for those looking for a challenge.
Compete with your friends and see who has the best rhythm in the rankings!

Aim to become the next legendary composer

games.name: Fangtopia
games.shortDescription: Sink your teeth into Fangtopia, a cozy and relaxing tile puzzle game where you assemble landscapes to craft a monsterrific paradise for friendly ghouls and ghosts. Design a carefree, scare-free world of gentle chills.
games.aboutText:
Sink your teeth into Fangtopia, a cozy and relaxing tile-laying puzzle game! Build magical landscapes, raise spooktacular landmarks, and craft a monsterrific para dise for friendly beasties. Design a carefree, scare-free world of spooky delights.

Build the most beautiful worlds you can or try to construct the highest-scoring kingdoms. It’s entirely up to you!

A MODE FOR EVERY MOOD

🧩Fangtopia Mode🧩 Jump right in and craft delightfully spooky worlds in short, restful sessions

🧛 Ghoulish Mode 🧛 Settle in and build bigger, bolder worlds with a wider spread of tile types

🏝️ Island Mode 🏝️ Connect an ocean of archipelagos by laying down railway track tiles for the 🚂Ghost Train🚂

🎨 Creative Mode 🎨 No goals, just ghouls! Build a world without limitations using unlocked landscape tiles

HOW TO PLAY

MATCH TILES

Place land tiles from a stack, connecting terrain of the same type to score points and expand your kingdom. Watch as your world grows into a hauntingly beautiful landscape filled with misty mountains, dark woods, ghostly railways, snaking rivers, charming towns, and more!

BUILD LANDMARKS

Meet score goals to acquire a wide array of weird and wonderful landmarks, then complete their special objectives to unlock more tiles and expand your world. What new and devious discoveries will you make as your kingdom expands?

DISCOVER MONSTERS

Complete portal objectives to draw friendly monsters into your world, then place their habitats! Where does the werewolf's forest belong? Which mountain cluster is just right for the yeti? All manner of quirky creatures are out there, just waiting to find their perfect home!

ALL TREATS, NO TRICKS

👻 100% scare-free: Fangtopia’s fiends are friendly, not frightening!

⏱️ No time pressure: Relax and build your world at your own pace

🧩 Collect them all: Unlock over 80 unique titles for your kingdom

👑 Global & Friends leaderboards: Compete for the crown of Fangtopia

🦇 Interactive sticker book: Fulfil special goals to grow your cozy collection

🎧 ASMR Audio Mode: Relax your senses and switch on ASMR settings for added comfort

games.name: Powerplay
games.shortDescription: Powerplay is an RTS with a focus on resources and industry. Create supply chains, transport, and explore in this thrilling base builder. Grow into a powerful industrial nation, but don't spread too thin! Resources are finite and "the others" can reclaim what is theirs at any time.
games.aboutText:
In Powerplay, you will manage the economy and the military strategy of an industrial nation. Build your base and secure key resources, while advancing through a classic technology tree. Define your way to survival in the finite, merciless world of Powerplay.

Build, equip, and deploy huge armies using the resources and technology you've developed. Expand your territory or defend your strongholds. Every decision matters, from choosing which weapons to produce to leveraging terrain and supply lines.

Building efficient supply chains is the backbone of Powerplay. Design and optimize networks of conveyor belts to transport raw materials to factories, where they’re transformed into intermediate resources and weapons. The challenge lies in balancing resource allocation and space management.

A core feature in this game is raw resource locality. You must strategically extract and transport resources to processing facilities to sustain your nation. You must create supply lines and protect them to maintain control of the land.

Features

- Classic RTS combat featuring hundreds of units

- Isometric camera

- Conveyor belts

- Fog of war mechanic

- Game editor with elevation support

Game modes

- Campaign (PvE)

- Skirmish (single player PvP)

- Game editor sandbox

Military

- Command armies in all domains: Land, air, and sea

- Nuclear weapons

games.name: Primordialis
games.shortDescription: Primordialis is a physics-based roguelike fish builder. Unleash your creativity to defeat creatures using venomous tentacles, electrical shocks, or exploding children. The possibilities are endless. Explore the primordial depths to reveal its secrets and discover what lies beyond.
games.aboutText:
Primordialis is a physics-based roguelike fish builder. Unleash your creativity to defeat creatures using venomous tentacles, electrical shocks, or exploding children. The possibilities are endless. Explore the primordial depths to reveal its secrets and discover what lies beyond.

================================= Create ==================================

The core of Primordialis is its simple yet deep creature creation system. Your body is constructed out of cells which each have unique properties and functions. With over 60 cell types to place and combine, there are countless creative combinations you can use to engineer your perfect fish.
You are given the freedom to play how you want, whether you want to be a massive serpent that swallows other creatures whole or to tinker with complex mechanisms and circuitry. Your only limit is your imagination.

================================= Survive =================================

In the main rogue-like mode, you embark on a difficult journey of growth and evolution. Explore the world and learn to deal with a diverse ecosystem of hand-crafted enemies, all built using the same creature creation system as you. Discover cell types, mutations and more to help you survive in this harsh and brutal world. Traverse the 5 main biomes and discover what lies at the end.

You can also play in sandbox mode if you want to perfect your creature design plans before a run, study the biology of your enemies, or just enjoy some relaxed creature building.

games.name: Bunny Space Odyssey: FlopHop
games.shortDescription: Embark on a pixel adventure with Ponchee the bunny in "Bunny Space Odyssey: FlopHop". Solve puzzles, protect plants, and uncover deep mysteries with Usagi-01 on an uninhabited planet.
games.aboutText:
"Bunny Space Odyssey: FlopHop" is an adventure pixel art indie game with platformer and puzzle elements. You will play as Ponchee the bunny, who finds herself on an uninhabited planet called FlopHop. She has no memories except for current events, and her teacher and friend becomes her spacesuit Usagi-01, which tells her about the past, the future, and her destiny.

Gameplay
In the world of FlopHop, you will experience an exciting story told through quests and lore, during which you will be engaged in platforming gameplay: Ponchee must protect capsules with plants to eventually green the planet. You will also encounter many puzzles of various kinds that will stand in Ponchee's way as she learns about the history of the world, the universe, and her home planet.

Why is Ponchee alone on this planet? Who created Usagi-01? What happened to her home planet, and how did she end up on FlopHop? Ponchee will uncover all this together with our players! But this journey of discovery might not be so sweet – along the way, there will be many disappointments, moments of loneliness, contemplation, and reflection.

games.name: The Jiang Shi 2 ：Curse of  Soul
games.shortDescription: The Jiang Shi 2: Curse of Soul "is an independently developed game set against the backdrop of the Chinese folk legend" Jiang Shi ". It tells the story of a brave female Taoist and her former junior sister engaged in intense martial arts battles on Penglai Island.
games.aboutText:
The Jiang Shi 2: Curse of Soul "is an independent game that combines traditional Chinese Taoism with supernatural elements, innovatively introducing Russian roulette gameplay, making every battle full of variables and excitement. The immersive first person perspective, thrilling plot, and rich environmental interactions make this game a dual challenge of thought and courage. If you dare to face your inner fears and challenge the impermanence of fate, then this game will be your best choice.

Immersive gaming experience

Players will personally take on the role of a female Taoist and immerse themselves in the tense atmosphere of yin-yang fighting. This game adopts a first person perspective, allowing players to fully immerse themselves in the tense and oppressive atmosphere.

Classic Russian roulette style gameplay

In order to increase the challenge and immersion of the game, this game combines the "Russian roulette" mechanism, where each round of choices is full of unknowns and risks. You not only have to deal with enemy attacks, but also face inner fears and doubts. Through multiple decisions, you will face choices on the brink of life and death, testing your strategy and psychological resilience.

Rich plot and multiple endings

According to the player's choice, the game will present multiple different endings. Can you successfully stop your junior sister, or will you ultimately succumb to the demon path? Every decision is crucial.

The Jiang Shi 2: Curse of Soul "official communication group QQ: 752209909

games.name: 100 Egypt Cats
games.shortDescription: Join the cutest adventure in Egypt, full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of Egypt locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.
games.aboutText:
🐾 WELCOME TO ANOTHER ONE OF 100 CATS SERIES GAME 🐈

Join the cutest adventure in the world full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.
Test your attention and observation skills in this cozy and delightful hidden object game.
Each cat is more charming than the last, and every discovery brings a smile to your face. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

Key Features

- 🎮 2 Level

- 🐈 200 Hidden Cats

- 🎵 Awesome Soundtrack

- 🎨 High Quality Resolution Artworks

- 🌗 Brightness Settings

- 💾 Progress Saves

- 🔍 Zoom

- 😺 Real Meow Sounds!

- 💥 Combo Counter!

- 💡 Tips

- 🌐 No Text

games.name: Fishing Grind
games.shortDescription: Fishing Grind is a first person 1-6 player co-op fishing game with a twist. The place you are fishing may not always be safe...
games.aboutText:
Fishing is not a hobby, it's a mindset. It is only reserved for the most dedicated among us. The extensive knowledge and experience required to be a full-time fisherman weeds out the weak and discourages even the strong. This job is not an easy one, but if you think you are up to it then... Who is stopping you?

Hop on the Fishing Grind.

Fishing Grind is a Coop/Singleplayer experience where you and up to five friends can fish in the various environments of the North American wilderness. Most of the locations you visit are relatively safe, but some places have threats. Bears, sharks, and even other humans that will test the limits of your strength. How far will you go to get just one more catch?

GAMEPLAY

Partake in riveting and innovative fishing gameplay. Start your journey with almost nothing and steadily build up your collection of rods, lures, and hooks! Realism can be fun in some games, but when working on Fishing Grind our team found that a less "realistic" approach turned out to be more fun. This creative choice also allowed for us to simplify some mechanics; these decisions will hopefully make the game easier to pick up for new players while still keeping veteran players invested!

CO-OP

Fishing by yourself can get pretty lonely, so Fishing Grind supports six player lobbies!

What are you waiting for? Download Fishing Grind and start playing!

DISCORD

Join our Discord server to get involved with the community, report bugs, and request features!

games.name: Mouse Holme
games.shortDescription: Your precious mouse home has been destroyed! 🐭 Start from scratch, build a thriving nest... and defeat the villainous cats! 🐈
games.aboutText:
Your precious mouse home has been destroyed! 🐭
Flee, start from scratch, build a thriving nest... and defeat the villainous cats! 🐈

BIG JOBS FOR TINY PAWS

Start with two humble mice and grow your nest by assigning and reassigning field mice to become parents, parents to researchers, or crafters. But lo! Beware the attack of a prowling cat! Then it's time to don the thimbles helmets and be the brave guards that scare the cat away!

TINY BRAINS WITH BIG IDEAS

Research and upgrade your nest to unlock new roles, mouse abilities, and technologies. Dig tunnels to fit in more mice. Stash away more food in little corners. Learn to farm. Get pointy sticks. Discover individuality. 🐭💡🤯 Gather a party to go on mousey missions. Or apply first aid. Little by little as your nest gets more clever, features and possibilities unlock, allowing you to get harder, better, faster, stronger. Until the world (by which we mean of course the cats!) shall finally acknowledge murine superiority!

VICTORY BELONGS TO THE MIGHTY TINY

A successful nest is well defended, fed, and clever. To win the game, achieve one of three possible victories:

- Military Victory - scare away all the cats including the final boss 🐈

- Science Victory - unlock every technology in the research tree 🔍

- Cultural Victory - build the Pyramids of Cheeza to leave your mark on the world forever 🧀

COSY INCREMENTAL RESOURCE MANAGEMENT

Cuteness overload. Numbers go up. Brain goes brrr.

If you like little indie games made with a love, Mouse Holme has bags of it. 💖

INGREDIENTS

90% solo developer (art & code)

10% help from friends (audio, QA)

Follow our updates to see the love & craft put into this.

games.name: Savara
games.shortDescription: In this colorful action roguelite, participate in the festivities organized for the pleasure of the warrior god. Equip your best weapons, prove your valor against powerful monsters, and permanently engrave your name in history!
games.aboutText:
In this dynamic and colorful action roguelite, delve into a fascinating universe where each decision matters and where strategy is rewarded. You've been invited to take part in grandiose festivities organized for the pleasure of Iop the warrior god. These aren't your typical celebrations – they were designed to put the most valiant fighters in the dimension to the test.

Get ready for a major challenge by arming yourself with your best weapons and selecting your equipment with care. Each weapon has its own characteristics and advantages, and choosing your arsenal wisely will be vital for your survival and success.

Each victory brings you closer to even more fearsome challenges, and each defeat is a lesson that will make you stronger. Use the resources you obtain during your fights to bolster your weapons, improve your equipment at the blacksmith's, and make offerings to the divine statue to garner additional favors.

Seek out glory by showing your bravery and skill in this festival of fighting. Each skirmish is an opportunity to prove that you are worthy of the god Iop's attention and blessing. Immerse yourself in this vibrant world teeming with danger and emerge victorious, celebrated as one of the greatest warriors in this unique dimension.

Play as Savara, the warrior god Iop's newest champion, face off against epic creatures, and forge your own legend!

Become an expert fighter, find your opponents' weaknesses, and strike your enemies at the perfect time to claim victory.

Collect the materials dropped by defeated monsters and build up the perfect arsenal to jump back into the fray.

Thrusting or slashing, one-handed or two-handed, choose from four styles and six variations with hundreds of possible combinations – exploit the full potential of your weapons.

Pledge your allegiance, unlock over 90 divine blessing powers, customize your talents and skills, and upgrade your equipment in a gameplay experience packed with replayability! In Savara, falling is allowed but rising again is an order!

Join Savara and set out on an epic crusade in which every battle brings you closer to ultimate glory!

games.name: Idea Fix
games.shortDescription: Incremental physics based game about pushing levers, clicking buttons and coming to terms with obsession.
games.aboutText:
Incremental game where you click buttons, pull levers and learn to deal with obsession.

Explore the Machine, understand what makes it tick, become a gear in its perfect system.

Operate the modules of the Machine in an intuitive and tactile way.

Repair broken Mechanisms, upgrade, unlock and buy new ones.

Pull levers and rotate valves using physics, type in commands in a realistic terminal.

There's more to the Machine than meets the eye.

Uncover its secrets, search for the hidden truth that lies beyond the cold exterior.

Use Scanner to see the unseen. Solve escape room style puzzles and learn the inner workings of your Mechanisms.

Take a break from your Sisyphean task.

Tune out the ever present noise of the machinery and fill the silence with some chill music.

Go outside, unwind, relax.

But remember:

games.name: Nordhold
games.shortDescription: Enemies are coming! Every decision matters: build your city, grow the economy, and prepare for enemy waves. Strengthen your defenses, adapt your strategy, and unleash your hero’s full potential. This unique Tower Defense will test your skills – are you worthy to claim a place at Valhalla?
games.aboutText:
Nordhold is a tower defense game for strategy enthusiasts who crave high replayability through endless combinations. Build and manage a cozy medieval Nordic village while enjoying deep tactical gameplay that doesn't require extensive learning.

With over 20 buildings offering diverse strategic development options through unique upgrades and meta-progression, find the balance between economic growth and defending Nordhold.

9 towers with unique abilities offer numerous customization options. Fine-tune your tactics to protect Nordhold effectively.

100+ custom upgrades offer versatile customization options, providing strategic depth and countless combinations.

Which general should defend Nordhold? Choose from hundreds of hero combinations! Relics grant you bonuses across the board, whether for your economy or defense. The oracle always gives you a different choice, for example: 5 waves of stronger enemies, which also offer higher rewards, or 5 waves of cheaper tower construction?

The snowball effect becomes reality. Smart decisions create synergies that let you conquer ever-stronger waves of enemies and bosses in a firework of effects.

Compete globally or with friends in our ranking system. Can you reach the Valhalla rank?

games.name: Slash/Jump
games.shortDescription: How do you platform if walking and jumping aren't an option? With a sword of course! Bounce and slash your way through this short and sweet, uniquely controlled precision platformer!
games.aboutText:
Using your sword as your only method of traversal, jump and slash your way through obstacles and hazards to master this unique platforming movement system!

Use the recoil from your sword swings to get from place to place and figure out the complexities of these deceivingly simple controls. Features:

- A simple 2 button + Joystick control scheme

- Controller rebinding

- No walking!

- A short and sweet 20-40 minute experience

games.name: Shine On, My Little Sun
games.shortDescription: When the Sun fell, darkness covered the world. In the snowy wasteland, the town of Svargo thrived under its faint light. But the Sun did not go out. The small Sun sleeps atop a grim lighthouse. What happens when the Sun awakens, seeking a few days of simple childhood?
games.aboutText:
When the Sun fell from the sky, and the world was covered in darkness and cold, it seemed that there was no more hope for people. But even after leaving its domain, the Sun did not go out. It sank into a deep slumber and continued to shine. Although not as majestic as it once was, this light was enough for people to build a new home in the middle of the snowy wasteland — the town of Svargo. Residents honor and protect their little Sun, which still sleeps at the top of the grim lighthouse.

But what will happen when the Sun wakes up and abandons the heavenly grandeur for a few days of simple childhood?

— Branching narrative. Your decisions will result in one of 14 endings.

— Enchanting small town atmosphere. The people of Svargo will gladly share their stories with you, so hear them out. You never know when a good listener can change someone's life.

— Interactive backgrounds with hidden objects. Try to find them all and piece together the lore of this world.

— A diary with colorful and funny entries that change depending on your choices.

— Masterful pixel art to immerse you in the fabulous world of the game.

— A heartfelt journey filled with childlike wonder, intriguing worldbuilding and life-changing discoveries.

— Original soundtrack to invoke the magic of Svargo.

— Oh, one more thing! If the weather is good, the one and only adventurer (whose name is yet to be learned) will invite you to join the quest for the legendary frog! Just don't go into the mines, even if you hear a distinct "ribbit" from there.

Shine On, My Little Sun is a visual novel where players read text, make choices, and influence the story's outcome. The game features branching paths, character portraits, and an emotive soundtrack. Save and load functions allow for replayability.

games.name: Katanaut
games.shortDescription: Katanaut is a fast-paced, Metroidvania-inspired action roguelite blending fluid combat and cosmic horror. Slash, dodge, and wield powerful abilities as you battle through a station sprawling with twisted, once-human horrors. Adapt, survive, and descend into the shadows to uncover dark secrets.
games.aboutText:
Katanaut is a fast-paced , Metroidvania-inspired action roguelite set aboard a massive space station falling into cosmic chaos. With the station slowly spiraling out of control, and its once-human inhabitants twisted into terrors, you’re the unlucky one tasked with uncovering what is going on... assuming you’re able to survive the station's violent halls with souls-like combat.

As Naut , you explore the corridors of this once vibrant station... or what's left of it. The deeper you descend into the station, the environments become more haunting, and the enemies less human.

Through advanced time-manipulation, you’re brought back to life whenever your bio-metrics are no longer detected. In the future where humans are able to download new abilities on demand, the station is now scattered with memory fragments from the fallen. Each one having the potential of being a lost skill or talent waiting to be unlocked.

Every run offers a new pivoted challenge with ever-changing pathways to explore, and pits you against hordes of enemies. Each ride down the station's elevators carries forward progress from the memory fragments you scavenge along your exploration.

In Katanaut, each clash of your blade echoes through the station's empty and flickering corridors, where every corner feels like is a surprise watching you... Whether you thrive in precision combat or prefer dealing with enemies from a safe distance, this is one cleanup job you won't forget.

games.name: Tavern Manager Simulator: Prologue
games.shortDescription: Restore your fantasy tavern to its full glory. Repair, improve and expand the establishment. Try running a tavern for a day in Prologue.
games.aboutText:
FULL VERSION IS AVAILAIBE ON STEAM

In Prologue you will be able to experience the limited version of "Tavern Manager Simulator". Don't forget to add to your wishlist and follow us for the full version of the game.

Restore the Tavern

Take over an abandoned tavern in a fantasy kingdom and restore it to its former glory! Get rid of the trash and cobwebs, wipe off the dust, buy new furniture and decor, and furnish the place to your liking.

Serve your customers

Fast and quality customer service is the key to your Tavern's prosperity. All customers expect their table to be filled with mugs of beer and appetizers at once, as if by magic.

Features

- Run your abandoned tavern in a fantasy kingdom

- Renovate, improve, expand your establishment

- Pour beer into huge mugs

- Clean up, wash dishes

games.name: Is This Seat Taken?
games.shortDescription: Is This Seat Taken? is a logic puzzle game where you play matchmaker for groups of hilariously particular people. Each character has pet peeves that make seating them a delightful challenge. Find the perfect spot for each person to unlock new levels in this cozy, silly, and relatable experience.
games.aboutText:
Window seat or aisle? Booth or table? Lone wolf or life of the party? In Is This Seat Taken? , your mission is to organize groups of people according to their preferences. It’s a cozy, no-pressure logic puzzle game where you’re in charge of who sits where.

Whether it’s the cinema, a crowded bus, a wedding reception, or a cramped taxi cab, every setting introduces new characters with specific tastes. A party guest with a sensitive nose won’t be happy sitting next to a stranger who’s wearing too much cologne. A sleepy passenger won’t be happy trying to nap on the bus next to someone listening to loud music. It’s all about reading the room to find the perfect placement!

Nat is an aspiring actor whose world gets turned upside down when they see a shape just like them on the big screen. This discovery sends Nat on a global journey to meet their hero and figure out how to fit in. Experience Nat's heartfelt story as you travel from city to city, each with its own levels, characters, and charm.

- Play seating matchmaker to please picky characters.

- Discover each character’s unique traits—relatable, outlandish, and everything in between.

- Piece together satisfying puzzles with no timers or leaderboards.

- Unlock fun new scenarios as you progress—from bus rides to banquets!

games.name: Backrooms
games.shortDescription: Explore an abandoned liminal space. Uncover dark secrets through eerie exploration and environmental storytelling. Evade unpredictable supernatural entities and face psychological horror. Will you reveal the truth or become another lost soul?
games.aboutText:
Welcome to an immersive horror experience where the familiar becomes unsettling, and the mundane turns into a waking nightmare. Explore an abandoned liminal space trapped in the eerie twilight of darkness, where reality blurs and the past refuses to let go.



Game Overview:



In Backrooms you take on the role of a lone explorer drawn to a forgotten neighborhood by cryptic messages and haunting visions. As you delve deeper into the desolate streets, you’ll uncover the dark secrets that led to its abandonment. Every corner and hallway holds pieces of the puzzle, but be warned: you are not alone. Shadows move in the periphery of your vision, and echoes of the past resonate through the empty halls.



Key Features:



Eerie Atmosphere: Immerse yourself in a meticulously crafted environment where the ordinary becomes sinister. The game's ambient soundscape and chilling visuals create a palpable sense of dread.

Exploration-Based Horror: Navigate through an open-world liminal space. Each corner hides its own story, revealed through environmental storytelling and hidden clues.

Unravel the Mystery: Piece together the history of the suburb through journals, photographs, and artifacts. Uncover the truth behind the mass disappearance of its residents and the malevolent force that lingers.

Dynamic Encounters: Encounter unpredictable, supernatural entities that stalk the shadows. Use your wits to evade them, as direct confrontation is rarely an option.

Psychological Horror Elements: Experience a narrative that plays with your mind, challenging your perception of reality and making you question what is real and what is imagined.



Survive the Shadows!



Your journey will test your courage and resolve. Will you uncover the truth behind the abandoned suburb, or will you become another lost soul wandering its streets? Backrooms invites you to face your fears and explore the thin line between reality and the supernatural.



Dare to enter the shadows?

games.name: Fantasy Map Simulator
games.shortDescription: Fantasy Map Simulator: Create and watch imaginary worlds evolve over centuries. Design maps, simulate nations and their politics, and control destinies. See empires rise and fall on your desktop wallpaper. A unique simulation for history buffs and creative minds.
games.aboutText:
Fantasy Map Simulator: Witness the Rise and Fall of Dynasties on Your Wallpaper

In this innovative simulation game, you'll become the creator and witness of a fantasy world, allowing imaginary history to unfold in your daily life.

Key Features

1. Generate or edit custom fantasy maps, building your unique imaginary world

2. Simulate internal affairs, diplomacy, development, and wars between nations, observing historical evolution over hundreds or even thousands of years

3. Control the fate of nations as you see fit, shaping the world order.

4. Unique Windows desktop wallpaper mode - empires rise and fall in the background while you work or rest

Whether you're a history enthusiast, a fantasy world creator, or someone seeking a unique desktop experience, "Fantasy Map Simulator" offers an unprecedented simulation experience.

Create, observe, intervene, and let imaginary history coexist with your daily life - your fantasy world is right before your eyes!

games.name: Misericorde Volume Two: White Wool & Snow
games.shortDescription: White Wool & Snow is the second visual novel in the Misericorde series.
games.aboutText:
Sister Hedwig is having a bad time.

It wasn't long ago that the Mother Superior dragged her out of her cell, forcing Hedwig to break her oath to God as an Anchoress and face the outside world. Acting as a spy for the leader of Linbarrow Abbey, Hedwig was given one seemingly simple task: Discover who really murdered Sister Catherine.

Hedwig has tried her best, but she is no closer to solving the mystery. Things just keep getting more and more complicated: Why can't any of the Sisters give her a straight answer about what happened the night of the murder? Who--or what--is the mysterious figure that haunts the abbey? And just who was Sister Catherine?

In White Wool & Snow , Sister Hedwig must steel herself. Time is running out, and so is sympathy for her situation. It's understandable that being thrust into the waking world after a life of quiet reflection as an anchoress would require some adjustment, but if Hedwig wants to save an innocent man she will have to get serious fast. Can she navigate increasingly difficult social situations, maintain her cover, and make the progress the Superior demands?

White Wool & Snow is a kinetic visual novel.

games.name: A Case of Fraud
games.shortDescription: A short, non-linear detective adventure where every clue is hidden in plain sight. Carefully read and cross-reference documents to unravel a CEO’s disappearance and expose a case of fraud.
games.aboutText:
A short, non-linear detective adventure. Investigate the mysterious disappearance of a successful CEO by analysing documents from her home and office. Examine evidence, connect clues, and make your own deductions to uncover a case of fraud.

Zoolingo is a seemingly successful startup company aiming to build a translation app that allows people to understand their pets. After landing an enormous amount of investor funding, the CEO has disappeared under suspicious circumstances. The only evidence you have is a whole lot of documents. Piece together the identities and roles of the family and employees, figure out who had motive and opportunity, and construct a case to unravel the fraudulent scheme.

Inspired by open-ended narrative deduction games like The Roottrees are Dead.

Features:

- Non-linear gameplay

- Progression is in your mind! Explore evidence however you want. Connect clues and form your own theories with no hand-holding

- Deep reading

- There is no searching or hunting for hidden clues. All documents are provided throughout the game, and the puzzle is in how you interpret them.

- A complex case

- Exposing the fraudulent operation won’t be easy. You’ll need to discover missing identities, decipher clues from the past, and make logical deductions to bring it all together and crack the case.

- Lots of cute pets

- Deduce the identities of the employees’ adorable animal companions!

Note: the art was hand drawn in Procreate using an iPad and Apple Pencil

games.name: Pawn Planet: First Sales
games.shortDescription: Manage your own pawn shop in the weird galaxy. Purchase and sell different items, attend auctions, stop thieves and keep the shop going!
games.aboutText:
Dive into your own pawn shop in this free shop management game! Though it may not feel like home yet, it soon will as you tidy up and launch your business. In this unique shop, you'll meet customers from all corners of the galaxy. Master the trade of alien artifacts, earthling relics, and more, as you aim to buy low and sell high for the greatest profits.

Your adventure isn't just about buying and selling. You'll also need to source parts to repair and restore the broken treasures that arrive in your shop, adding value and earning you even more Galactic Credits .

Your path to becoming a legendary interstellar entrepreneur begins here. Welcome to the galaxy's hustle, where every transaction can either catapult you to wealth or leave you floating in space.

FEATURES

- Do business with a diverse array of customers from across the galaxy.

- Source repair parts, fix broken items, and increase your earnings.

- Protect your shop against thieves.

- Take part in storage auctions. Risk your credits to possibly find treasures or end up with junk!

- Upgrade your shop, unlock new crafting recipes, and explore different planets to find rare items.

- Perform daring heists.

games.name: 100 Waiting Cats
games.shortDescription: ⏳🐾 Join the cutest adventure in the funny waiting situations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artworks of While Waiting themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.🕑🐈 🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈✅

Partnered with While Waiting

⏳🐾 WELCOME TO 100 WAITING CATS – THE BEST HIDDEN OBJECTS GAME! 🕑🐈

Join the cutest adventure in the While Waiting themed locations! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of While Waiting locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.
Test your attention and observation skills in this cozy and delightful hidden object game.
Each cat is more charming than the last, and every discovery brings a smile to your face. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

games.name: Bees vs Zombees
games.shortDescription: A fast-paced roguelike tower defense where you choose your Queen Bee with unique skills and the Artisan to build turrets and cast powerful spells to defend your hive through regions infested with zombees. Face bosses with insane mechanics and survive the Zumbeecalypse!
games.aboutText:
Choose your Queen Bee with unique skills and recruit an Artisan to build powerful turrets on the battlefield. Equip accessories, cast devastating spells, and defend your hive in this chaotic and personality-packed roguelike tower defense.

In each run, explore maps filled with clever references, traps, and unique mechanics. Face unpredictable bosses and unlock magical cards of accessories and spells that can completely turn the tide of battle.

Manage your resources, build strategic defenses, and experiment with millions of combinations to survive the endless Zombee swarms. Survive the Zumbeecalypse!

• Choose your Queen, each with unique abilities
• Recruit Artisans with different towers and skills
• Build towers with distinct effects and functions
• Collect accessory and spell cards to create absurd synergies

• Face varied enemies with unpredictable behaviors
• Defeat bosses with unique mechanics and challenging phases
• Survive swarms, traps, and dynamic events

• Explore regions overrun by chaos, with unique visuals and obstacles
• Discover references, secrets, and fun interactions around every corner
• Restore Meltopia and make the continent safe once again

games.name: Elite Exorcist Miko
games.shortDescription: A bullet hell shoot 'em up featuring hololive’s Sakura Miko! hololive has been possessed by evil spirits! Combine melee and ranged combat with a variety of items to fight your friends and set them free!
games.aboutText:
Elite Exorcist Miko is a bullet hell shoot 'em up featuring Sakura Miko, the one and only elite shrine maiden of hololive ! Evil spirits have possessed your fellow hololive members, causing them to wreak havoc! It's up to you to bring them back to their senses by facing them in direct combat and freeing them from the spirits' influence. Do you have what it takes to challenge and harness the powers your friends have at their disposal?

FACE THE FIRE!

Use a combination of melee, shooting, a variety of equipment and 3 distinct battle styles to fight a multitude of enemies and bosses in intense bullet hell combat! RESCUE THEM ALL!

Find and challenge over 30 hololive members across 8 stages, with more to come! No two runs will be the same; encounter different bosses, equip different items, improve your skills and test your mettle across multiple runs! BECOME STRONGER!

Your abilities are limited on their own, but you can make use of the power of your foes-returned-friends! Use materials obtained from runs to increase your strength and craft new equipment, preparing you for greater challenges ahead! ASSIST OPTIONS!

Optional toggles such as Auto Aim and Easy Parry are available for players who prefer a more casual experience! An Easy Mode is available as well, simplifying enemy and boss patterns! A VARIETY OF CHALLENGES!

Take on boss battle after boss battle in Boss Rush, or endless waves of enemies in Shrine Sweep! Optional Extra Stages are also available as high difficulty trials; currently two, with more in store for the future!

WARNING: This game contains some flashing lights. Player discretion is advised.
