games.name: Light Up the Dark
games.shortDescription: Light Up the Dark is a colony survival sim set in a dark world filled with unseen horrors. Collect, build, automate, research techs, and explore the procedural map. Manage three classes of colonists; keep them sane, or make use of their insanity. Solve endless interesting problems, your way.
games.aboutText:
Light Up the Dark is a colony survival sim set in a dark world filled with unseen horrors. Collect, build, automate, research techs, and explore the procedural map. Manage three classes of colonists; keep them sane, or make use of their insanity. Solve endless interesting problems, your way.

Survive Against the Darkness

There is no natural light source in this pitch-black world. And staying in darkness means death. To survive, build artificial lights and gather the necessary resources to keep them running. Research new technologies to improve them or to innovate more powerful light sources.

Deep and Complex Trait System

Their experiences shape your colonists. Their lifestyle, routine, euphoric moments, or traumas give them various traits. Traits can be a blessing or a curse; sometimes, this is just a matter of perspective, though not always.

Manage Three Classes of Colonists

There are three classes of colonists: Worker, Craftsman, and Artificer. They have different skills, strengths, weaknesses, and preferences. You must find ways to ensure harmony among them.

Endless Problems and Many Ways to Solve Them

- Wide variety of resources: Plenty of resources to collect, produce, or consume. To process resources use miscellaneous skills such as mining, crafting, farming, ranching, alchemy, engineering, and various energy sources such as steam, combustion, geothermal, and electric.

- Advanced logistics: Improve your logistic network with advanced technology like automatons, zeppelins, and portals.

- Dark powers: Find ways to harness the power of the Void, the essence of the thick, suffocating darkness surrounding your base. However, the cost may be dire for such an attempt.

- Insanity mechanics: Adopt a strategy to deal with mental instability, especially for the criminally insane. Lock them up, try risky cures, or just let them wander around doing their things, such as arson, murder, suicide, or exhibitionism.

- Replayability: Play your way. Various strategies, playstyles, and even roleplaying are possible. Together with a procedurally generated map, and complex game mechanics, this means an insanely replayable game.

games.name: Age of Defense: Prehistory
games.shortDescription: The most addicting tower defense game, packed with monsters and tough defenders, all of which fit perfectly into the cartoonish environment. Prehistory is a prologue for the main story Age of Defense.
games.aboutText:
Tribe big trouble. Еnemies want kill tribe. Player call defenders. Defenders kill enemies. Enemies bring meat. Meat bring new defenders. Good player kill all enemies!

Hold enemy. Easier to kill.

Stones and sticks - friends.

Be caveman. See it? Kill it. Eat it! Repeat this million times.

games.name: Ten Bells
games.shortDescription: You're trapped in an old English pub. Unravel a chilling tale by identifying anomalies while trying to escape. Confront the horror as you survive the endless loop of Ten Bells.
games.aboutText:
Ten Bells is an anomaly horror game set in a timeless English pub. This unsettling escape room game draws you into a world of surreal anomalies and a hidden story, where every detail matters and the ghostly past lingers.

On Ten Bells:

- “ For real; W game no lie. ” - CaseOh

- " I started the game half-hearted and taking the p***, but by the end, I was fully tensed up and immersed. Nice job, Ten Bells! " - Yahtzee, SecondWind

- " This Is THE BEST Anomaly Horror Game Ever Made. " - The Outer Middle Show

- " [Clapping on stream to 14m followers] This is one of the best anomaly games that i've ever seen." - Windah Basudara

- " The SCARIEST Anomaly Horror Game... " - POiiSED

- " The BEST Anomaly HORROR Game EVER Made" . - SWOL

- " I've played almost every single anomaly loop game out there, and I can safely say this one surpasses them all by an enormous amount. " - Thorlar

Ten Bells is a Spot-the-Difference Anomaly Horror

- Explore the eerie timeless pub

- If you don't find any anomalies, progress onwards

- If you spot an anomaly; go back the way you came

- Evade traps and the inhabitants of the pub

- Unravel the mystery through collected items

- Reach and eventually escape the Ten Bells

...if you can.

Over 55 Anomalies: Discover anomalies to progress and uncover the story. Anomalies can be subtle, surreal, scary or deadly.

Unfolding Narrative: Discover objects that contain story elements, helping you piece together the spooky tale of the pub’s ghostly inhabitants.

Play Time: Perfect for a captivating stream or a chilling solo session, with gameplay ranging from 20 minutes to an hour. Full game from 1 hour 20 minutes to 3 hours.

Will you escape the pub and uncover the dark secrets of Ten Bells? Scour the pub, find the anomalies, and experience the horror for yourself.

games.name: Nazi Zombies
games.shortDescription: Nazi Zombies is a cooperative survival game where players fend off escalating waves of Nazi zombies, earning points by killing zombies and repairing barriers to buy weapons, upgrades, perks, and unlock new map areas to maximize their survival.
games.aboutText:
Nazi Zombies is a cooperative survival game where players fend off escalating waves of Nazi zombies, earning points by killing zombies and repairing barriers to buy weapons, upgrades, perks, and unlock new map areas to maximize their survival.

- Fight alone or with friends.

- Level up and unlock new rewards.

- Climb the leaderboards to become number 1.

- Enter "prestige mode" to start again from level 1 with special unlocks!

games.name: Plentiful
games.shortDescription: Plentiful is a nature sandbox. You shape the land and everything responds—water, plants, animals, and your people. Learn how this world works. Your tribe’s survival depends on it.
games.aboutText:
Move blocks to shape the terrain. Redirect rivers, create lakes, and build fertile land. Water flows dynamically through the world—your changes determine where life can grow.

Grow food, support wildlife, and keep your tribe alive as you manage resources, changing seasons, and natural disasters. Each level presents a new landscape with its own challenges and multiple ways to solve them.

Plentiful is a god game where you shape the land and create the conditions for life to thrive.

- Stone stacking terrain building

- Flowing water simulation

- 20+ Levels and multiple game modes.

- Built-in level editor.

- Steam Workshop integration.

- Nurture animals and plants to feed your tribe

- Dynamic seasons and day/night cycle

- Natural disasters: volcanoes, lightning, floods, locusts, plagues, fire

games.name: Beatblock
games.shortDescription: THE BEAT REVOLVES AROUND YOU in Beatblock, the headspinning rhythm-action game! Move your paddle and block to the beat in simple yet deviously bombastic levels, each complete with their own unique theming and visuals.
games.aboutText:
Beatblock is a headspinning rhythm game with a simple goal: hit blocks to the beat as the paddle-wielding Cranky. The song revolves around you, and it's your job to keep up. Twist your way through a variety of tracks, hone your skills with different block types, and groove to the music!

Meet the Atom Map, your guide to the beats and blocks you'll face. Start with the Intro to pick up the basics, then twirl through four different block types to get the hang of things! Every single song has its own unique visuals and style, so there's something for everyone to enjoy.

Once you've mastered the mechanics, you'll be ready for the Fusion levels- where block types get combined, and experts are forged. Push your endurance even further in the Marathon mode against a back-to-back selection of songs and maybe discover the unknown...

Put your creative skills to work with the built-in level editor, the same tool our development team uses for the main game's levels. Chart to your favorite songs, and take advantage of the editor's robust effects & functions to let the music shine!

FEATURES

- Explore new mechanics across 40+ songs in the Atom Map, from learning the basics to tackling challenges!

- More songs are planned for future updates, with our song count already nearly doubled through free updates!

- Flow with the music in different ways with multiple block types.

- Tailor-made visuals for every song to set the scene (or mess with you...)

- Customize Cranky however you want with unlockable costumes!

- Chart a new path on your own songs with the built-in level editor!

- Accessibility options to tweak the game and have fun on your own terms!

games.name: SHATTERFARMS
games.shortDescription: Farm. Forage. Fight. SHATTERFARMS is a first-person farmcore roguelike where you'll scavenge and fight through the Calamity, while cultivating a mysterious farm to survive and grow stronger. Creatures are untamed, magic unstable, and horrors unimaginable. Welcome to SHATTERFARMS.
games.aboutText:
And repeat... Or die trying .

Resources are scarce, but the seeds of your salvation lie scattered beyond your farm. Venture into the Calamity, battle vicious creatures, and claim rare seeds guarded by fang and claw. Plant them. Harvest them. Grow stronger with every season.

This is FARMCORE gameplay.

"You've been kept from the truth ."

An isolated girl, finally freed from her mother's imprisonment and experimentations, discovers an irradiated wasteland brimming with colossal mechanisms and constructs, unexplainable magical artifacts, and horrific feral creatures that want nothing more than to erase her.

Succumbing to the horrors means going back, and that's a fate worse than death .

Wield the scythe not just to reap, but to rise .

Your scythe is more than just your primary weapon and farming tool, it's your fast and fluid way to navigate through the Calamity. Slice through the air with the SCYTHE-DASH action to weave through hordes of enemies, ascend the shattered landscapes, and ride raw momentum back to the safety of your farm with spoils in hand.

- Customizable weapons, player builds, and playstyles.

- Build up and repair your farmland to permanently increase your powers.

- Soar through the skies using momentum based movement.

- Discover the dark and twisted secrets hidden across the Calamity.

- Fishing. 🎣

There's still a way out, but it won't be easy.

games.name: Dagger Froggy
games.shortDescription: Dagger Froggy is a small action Roguelike, Where you face hordes of enemies... Cute? With each round you get stronger, But so do the cute creatures. >:)
games.aboutText:
Dagger Froggy is a small roguelike with very simple gameplay, throw the dagger at enemies and retrieve it to defeat the next one!, try to survive for 10 minutes, creating incredible builds!

FACE INCREASINGLY POWERFUL ENEMIES

The further you get, the more difficult enemies appear!

UPGRADES

At each end of the horde you choose between 4 improvements, which will help you survive against these adorable creatures.

There are 30 Base Improvements, which combine with each other, making incredible Combos!

SPECIALS

When you maximize an improvement, you release a Special. Each Special is unique and has effects that can improve your character or the daggers

THE FROGS

Each little frog has its own skills, so you can start with 2 points of some improvement, in addition to each one having its own unique style. 😎

THE SCENARIOS

Each Scenario/Map has its own style and can be unlocked as soon as you win a match on the previous map.

STORE

With the coins that fall from enemies, and those you earn after finishing a match, you can unlock improvement points, so you can start with some improvements now!

games.name: 10 Second Mixtape
games.shortDescription: Make mini music with other people online! A creative, low-stress game with async co-creation. Make unique songs with crazy instruments, or just hang out and watch other players' bands take the stage!
games.aboutText:
🎹 🎸 🥁 🎤 Make mini music with other players!

10 Second Mixtape is a casual game about making super-short, super-fun songs using tiny loops created by you and other real people from all over the world. All of the thousands of songs in the game are 100% player-made!

Don't worry if you're not musically inclined! Making music is as easy as tapping a key on your keyboard. There are no wrong notes! No, seriously! 🙆‍♂️ No winners or losers here - it's all about having fun and making silly sounds. 🎵

👨‍🎤🧑‍🎤👩‍🎤🔊 Watch other bands!

The Infinite Venue is where you can watch and rate other players' bands! Your cheers and boos will affect how often that band is booked for shows for everyone else. The playlist is never-ending, and your creations will show up here, too!

Songs are also shareable through our website, so anyone (whether they have the game or not!) can hear and save your tracks.

🎟️Get the Backstage Pass DLC

Unlock 12 additional instruments and more advanced song creation tools. These tools give you full control over the track arrangement and also allow you to collaborate with other players in real-time!

Rock on! 🤙

games.name: speak of my sin
games.shortDescription: Speak of My Sin is a word reasoning game - players are supposed to find the truth of the cases, restore the story in a number of interrelated cases and finally detect the identification of “me”, speaking out “my” sin.
games.aboutText:
Discord:

With the help of the inspector, you are expected to unravel the mysteries and cases of both recent and old years, and then recall and speak out your sins as you get closer to the truth of the story.

In this game, you have three goals:

The fundamental and most important thing is to extract key information to find the truth of the case through the text description searched by the police department.

Each piece of information can be a key clue to the real killer, including the layout of the room at the scene of the crime, the footage from surveillance cameras, the chat logs of the suspect and so on.

The core task [/u] is to connect the facts of multiple cases and restore the whole story. In this game, figuring out the story behind the case is more important than finding out the real killer.

If you encounter difficulties in a certain chapter and can’t find out the truth, please be patient and move on to the next chapter, the answer may be concealed in it .

Characteristics of the Game

- Complicated plots
In the game, everyone has their own purpose and hidden story, they cross together for their own purpose, forming a chaotic chess game. But these complex stories are not meant to challenge the player's intelligence, each character in the game has his own beliefs and dreams, abide by his own code of conduct, I will try to make them into flesh and blood.

- Immersive character experience
In order to make the main characters more realistic, there are fewer characters in the game than in other games in the genre, which makes the game less difficult.

- Strong Sense of Substitution
Although the background of this game is in a virtual world, there are many parallels and similarities with real life. I hope that the human behavior of the characters in the story will make the player feel more involved.

- Low Difficulty of Reasoning
Compared with games of the same kind, the answers of the game will have more obvious hints and clues, and the suspects' methods of crime are not sophisticated and complex. And inside the game, even if the answer is wrong, it does not delay the continuation of the story.

I'm sorry that you can't see the English localization on the display of the game screen, because our English translation is not that fast, but I promise that English localization will be added to the final product.

If this game has caught your interest, please also help me add a wish list, it is very important to us.

games.name: Ghetto Zombies: Graffiti Squad
games.shortDescription: Expect blasts of green zombie goo painting the screen in this top-down shooter packed with crazy guns that blow the heads off some… freaky zombies. Your mission is simple: graffiti the whole city before these mutants dog-pile you
games.aboutText:
A squad of mutant kids from the hood is humanity’s last hope in this colorful, humor-packed zombie apocalypse. Blast freaky zombies with ridiculous guns, spray wild graffiti across the city, and face a monstrous Zombie Boss at the end of every mission.

Each hero in the squad offers a unique playstyle: choose yours, dig the weirdest guns out of dumpsters, and enjoy the insane headshot animations.

Four young mutants, each with their own powers and playstyle, ready to blast some zombies! Pick your favorite (or the one with the collest look) and go wild!

A Ketchup Blaster, a Gumball Shooter, a Shark-Head Shotgun, and even a Witch’s Broom, you’ll find all sorts of crazy guns to make zombies deeply regret their life (and death) choices.

The writer definitely went off the rails here. Expect cute puppy zombies, tentacle-armed chonks, jacked-up cop zombies, and even an Frankenstein with underwear. It doesn’t make much sense, but hey, it’s hilarious.

Painting graffiti in a zombie apocalypse isn’t easy. Every time you try to tag a wall, you might just summon an entire horde of the undead. Art has never been so dangerous (or colorful)!

This zombie clearly had a different breakfast. It’s stronger, meaner, and keeps coming back stronger each time. Beat the Boss Zombie and show it who’s the real monster here!

games.name: Path to Perdition
games.shortDescription: Path to Perdition is a challenging roguelike auto-battler. Assemble and lead a party of adventurers through unforgiving lands. Equip them with items to unlock skills, modify those skills with relics to create unique effects, and combine those effects using tactical positioning to crush your enemies.
games.aboutText:
Path to Perdition is a challenging roguelike auto-battler. Assemble and lead a party of adventurers through unforgiving lands. Equip them with items to unlock skills, modify those skills with relics to create unique effects, and combine those effects using tactical positioning to crush your enemies.

Tactical Auto-Battler

Master preparation and unit positioning to defeat monsters in battles that play out automatically.
Watch, learn, plan, and adapt. Build the most devastating synergies tailored to each fight and claim victory!

Party-Based

Recruit a group of Adventurers, each with their own Race, Class, personal backstory, and unique set of Traits. As your adventure progresses, you’ll be able to add new members to the party, unlocking more and more power... if you can keep them alive.

Flexible Builds & Customizable Skills

New skills are unlocked by weapons and armor looted from enemies or bought from merchants. Swap equipment between battles to completely reshape your party’s play-style.

You can also modify skills using special items called Relics. Each skill has three Relic slots, which allow you to experiment with a wide variety of custom effects to create the ultimate combos.

Living Map

Chart your way through the ever-changing ecosystem of the Corrupted Lands and watch it react to your actions, with routes closing, new ones being revealed, and enemies adapting to their environment. Choose your path wisely, as there are multiple possible ends to your journey.

Resource Management

Carefully manage your resources as you navigate through dangerous biomes, encounter strange characters, uncover forgotten secrets, and grab your fair share of loot. You’ll need camp supplies to rest and recover, and gold to trade.

Hardcore Strategy Roguelike

Featuring permadeath and a procedurally generated world, each run is unique and will force you to adjust your strategy to vanquish the twisted forces plaguing this region. But don’t despair. Learn from your failures and try again!

As you hone your skills, you can attempt more difficult challenges, venturing along more treacherous paths toward the darkest corners of the Corrupted Lands, where ancient gods and nameless horrors await you.

games.name: Mr. Rightaway
games.shortDescription: 古风多结局乙女向文字冒险游戏，完全免费
games.aboutText:
剧情简介

本游戏完全免费，如果您喜欢的话，也请支持同制作组的作品《灭魂~误佳期》。

自小在小言小黄书中摸爬滚打长大的女主——司马丽苏，一直将大师兄兼表哥吴有为视为人生中“天作之合”的官配。

可是在她厚脸皮去表白时，却晴天遭到霹雳——
有为表哥要结婚了，新娘就明显不是她。
气在头上的司马丽苏，在婚礼上对有为表哥“小惩大诫”一翻，而后便潜逃下山。

在逃亡的路上，女主似乎跌入了某著名连锁店的中奖陷阱之中。
是不是陷阱还不清楚。
只是那各种口味的“奖品”，
会给她带来真正的天作之合吗？ 关于此游戏

- 古风女性向恋爱冒险游戏

games.name: Duriano
games.shortDescription: Duriano is a top-down arena roguelite game where the player will be a hero durian of the Norse wielding a weapon to fight upon a god of Norse mythology. From different weapons, Durian hero, God’s trail, items will lead the player to create a build and defeat the giant of fire.
games.aboutText:
Duriano: Epic Durian Heroes

The Great War of Ragnarök is over, and a new creation has begun... but the cycle of life is broken.

A strange and powerful magic has warped the reborn world, inflicting a bizarre curse that transforms every being body and soul into fruits and vegetables

You are the Durian Hero, one of the few warriors resurrected after the war. Reborn in the spiky, armored form of a Durian, you are the champion chosen by the gods to solve this strange affliction

You must travel to the heart of the chaos, Muspelheim, the unforgiving Land of Fire. Only there can you find a way to lift the curse.

Prepare your run, fight your way through legions of monsters, and confront the giant who destroyed the old world to save the new one!

Durian Hero Variants

Diverse Durian Heroes… Unleash the Power of Gods!

Choose your Durian hero! Each variant embodies unique powers and abilities inspired by Norse Gods and mythical creatures. Tailor your playstyle, harness their divine essence, and embark on your epic quest!

Fate's Flavors & God's Trails

Choose Your God's Trails… Unlock Ultimate Power!

Empower your Durian Hero with "Fate's Flavors", granting powerful buffs and unique abilities! Select a "God's Trails" to unlock spectacular combat skills and customize your hero to perfection!

Mythic Weapons

Mythical Arsenal Awaits… Unleash Devastating Power!

Discover and collect all of "Mythic Weapons," each with unique attributes and game-changing effects! Fuse weapon power with your Durian Hero's abilities to create unstoppable combos!

Face your Enemies

In the mountains of fire... The swarm of monsters is awaiting

Muspelheim, the land of flame, is filled with extremely dangerous creatures, including those born from the power of the fire giant, Surtr. Face a variety of enemies that are ready to take your life at any moment. Be prepared and defeat them!

Adaptive Strategy

Every Run Unique… Conquer the Ever-Changing Challenge!

Experience the thrill of Roguelite gameplay where every run is different! New environments, new enemies, new challenges await! Adapt your strategy on the fly and overcome every obstacle!

Progression and Customization

Powerful Upgrades… Evolve Your Hero to Godlike Status!

Keep playing to unlock new Durian Hero variants, God, and weapons! Collect and upgrade your power to make your hero stronger and face even greater challenges!

Prepare for Battle

Get Ready to Rumble! Dive into the mystical Norse realms, embark on an epic action-packed adventure, master devastating combos, and lead your Durian Hero to victory over the giant of fire!

Are you ready to become the ultimate Durian Hero? Join the fight in Duriano and etch your legend into the annals of Asgardian history!

games.name: Exorcist: Reviewer of Minds
games.shortDescription: Everyone must resist the relentless unfairness with the cards they've been dealt. Use the randomly distributed holy verses to identify the names of the 10 demons. Save 5 people and exorcise the sixth threat lurking in the shadows. This is a compact game of continuous gambles and judgments.
games.aboutText:
Do You Like Exorcism?

Calling the name of the demon.
That is the essence of exorcism.
What is the identity of the demon possessing the child?
Using information about the demon's origin and rank from the list of demons recorded in the holy texts, combine logical reasoning with a bit of luck to choose the demon's name.
If you get it right, you win. If you get it wrong, you'll be cornered.

Exorcist Seeking Names V.S. Demon Seeking Sins

Up to 10 demons can invade your house, approaching to learn about your greatest sins.
You must identify which demon is possessing the child while avoiding interference.
Each play session lasts about 30 minutes, but you can enjoy the strategic back-and-forth multiple times.

Challenge Fate with Everything Given

With over 20 different "holy verses" that can be randomly obtained, you can gain various pieces of information and advantages.
Using the gathered information, identify the demon in front of you.
Even if you throw all your saved holy verses into the fight, there aren't many moments where you can be 100% sure.
There will be times when you must challenge with a success rate of 50%, 30%, or even 10%.
Pray that you're right. This is a slightly complex game of chance and a battle spiced up with some "divine intervention."
Do you like games of chance?

Holy Verses Carved as the Last Weapon

Each time you save a child, you can carve a holy verse into the cross.
This allows you to control which holy verses you can obtain to some extent, supporting your gameplay against luck.
If you save 5 children and exorcise what lies beyond the 6th door, you can leave the house of demons.

【Streaming and Broadcasting Guidelines】

We welcome game play videos from individuals and corporations, but please make sure to read and comply with the following guidelines:

・Include the game title "Exorcist: Reviewer of Minds" in the title of your videos or live streams.
・Provide a link to the store page in accessible places such as the description section.
・Monetization through features provided by video sites (advertising revenue, donations, etc.) is allowed.
・Do not include content that defames or slanders others, or that is contrary to public order and morals in your game commentary or broadcasts.
・727 NOT HOUND is not responsible for any damages or issues that arise from the commentary or broadcasting of the game.
・These guidelines may be changed without notice, and the revised guidelines will apply to videos created after the change.

games.name: MR. RECORDS
games.shortDescription: ​Meet George, an old dreamer with an extraordinary gift that lets him transcend through music. After a lifetime of standing still, he breaks free from routine and opens the store he always wished for. ​
games.aboutText:
​

​MR. RECORDS is an uplifting adventure where every vinyl transports you into a world of memories and emotion, where you will jump, slide, and move though psychedelic landscapes in time with the music.​

Alongside his loyal dog Buzz, George welcomes a colourful cast of characters to his record store each day. As new records are unlocked, each sale deepens his connection with customers, uncovering heartfelt stories, revealing important life lessons, and forging lasting friendships along the way.

​When the shutters come down and the store closes for the night, the records come alive. Each track transforming into a playable rhythmic trip through George's imagination. ​

​Some songs will make you smile. Others will hit far deeper the moment the needle drops, reminding you that it’s never too late to finally start living​.

- Connect with Customers in the Record Shop - Hidden behind the simple act of selling a record, the record shop is filled with quirky customers, hidden stories, and musical riddles. Learn each record, recommend the perfect album, unlock new stock, and turn George’s tiny dream shop into a place where music changes lives.

- Relax in George’s Bedroom Hub - Between musical journeys, unwind in George’s personal bedroom above the shop. Review memories, track progress, take calls, and spend quiet moments reflecting on the story and the music shaping your adventure.

- A Soundtrack Worth Living In - Explore a huge range of original music styles including funk, progressive rock, hip-hop, electro, world music, and 80s pop, all composed by the developers themselves.

- Step Inside the Music - Every record George plays becomes a fully playable rhythm journey through surreal dream worlds inspired by memories, emotions, and moments from his life. Run, jump, slide, dodge, and chain actions together in sync with the music across 40+ handcrafted levels.

- Endless Variety Beyond the Beat - MR. RECORDS constantly introduces new gameplay twists, from rhythm battles and surreal mini games to environmental changes, visual disruptions, chase sequences, and side activities with George’s loyal dog, Buzz.

- Every Record Tells a Story - Meet colourful characters and uncover George’s memories through music, photographs, notes, and emotional discoveries from his past. Some songs are joyful. Others reveal regrets, lost love, and the life he never truly lived.

- Create and Share Your Own Musical Levels - Use the built-in Level Editor to add your own music, generate gameplay, place obstacles, remix experiences, and share custom levels with the community. Build anything from chaotic rhythm gauntlets to beautifully choreographed musical journeys.

games.name: GRIDHACK
games.shortDescription: GRIDHACK is a sci-fi puzzle RPG where hacking = fighting nonogram battles. Chase a rogue program and chip away at the galaxy's strongest firewall to uncover the conspiracy about what happened to Earth!
games.aboutText:
- In GRIDHACK, hacking = fighting nonograms battles.

- Solve the logic puzzles to attack the firewall.

- The nonogram battle system adds action, tension and new strategies to traditional puzzle solving.

- Use module abilities to defend, attack or manipulate the grid. Experiment with different loadouts to fit to your play style .

- A sci-fi mystery awaits: Crack the galaxy's toughest vault to uncover the conspiracy about what happened to Earth.

- Use your hacking skills to take back computer systems, open locks, reveal secrets.

- It's a big galaxy out there. Thankfully, you're not alone: Get to know a rag-tag crew of eclectic characters.

games.name: Identifile: Desktop Dungeon
games.shortDescription: Become the ultimate desktop cursor in a deeply infected operating system! Navigate folders like dungeon rooms, delete viruses, and level up with EXEs in this action-packed roguelike.
games.aboutText:
Your PC has been infected severely by an unknown virus, causing your antivirus to fail. The next thing, you became a cursor and now it's up to you to save your computer from being overrun by viruses. Dive into your files and identify the viruses causing the chaos!

Identifile: Desktop Dungeon is a cursor-based action roguelike set inside your own infected operating system. It blends the frantic action of a bullet hell with the exploration of the file system.

Dive into a world where folders become treacherous dungeons. Files hold secrets, treasures and dangers. Navigate through procedurally generated levels, fending off relentless viruses and uncovering powerful EXE files that aid your adventure.

Battle your way through swarms of malicious viruses using the many different playable cursors, each with their own unique playstyle. Lurking at the end of each corrupted drive is a brutal boss fight. Are you ready to face them and save your system from crashing for good?

- Explore a file system like a procedurally generated dungeon

- Cursor-based combat

- Unpredictable events to keep you on the toes

- Game modifiers and difficulty modes for adjustable player experience

- Over 30+ unique viruses (including shiny variants!)

- Over 4 unique boss fights!

- 12+ playable cursors

- 100+ randomized loot drops to be discovered

- 30+ EXEs to suit every play-style

- Cursor Cosmetics

- Virus Database that keeps track of viruses you identified

- Secrets?.. and more

games.name: DevilConnection
games.shortDescription: Punish the little bastard demon and being punished too! Cemo-Summoning Adventure Game
games.aboutText:
Switching Languages

・To change the game language, select your preferred language in the Steam game's properties menu.

・When loading save data from a different language, data such as playthrough count and unlocked endings will carry over, but text display issues may occur. This is due to limitations with the game engine. When playing in a different language, we recommend that you do not use your existing save data and instead start a new game.

✦Story✦

In the magical world, "Magirisia"...

You, the summoner, have summoned a demon. You give him your own name to make a contract, but the demon does not give his name.

He, named "Debirun",summon the people throughout Magirisia to gather magical power and terrorize them to regain his true form!

✦Game System✦

Summon unique characters to collect magical power by converting their "emotional aura" into magical power.

There is a phase in which you have to choose one of two options to heighten the emotions of the person you summoned in any way. However, you do not choose blindly. Use Debirun's special ability, “Evil Eye Search,” to look into your opponent's mind. By reading their thoughts, you will naturally find the correct answer, or you may even catch a glimpse of an unexpected side of them...?

The most important feature of this game is the large number of endings. The wrong choice can result in an immediate ending... Use the magic of save and load to explore all possibilities and find the true ending to this story!

You know it's a bad choice, but you can't help but want to see how they react in order to collect the ending... Is it OK to do this? This is a story about doing “immoral things” with the devil.

↑An example of unique characters

✦Camera & Deco✦

The game features a camera function that allows you to take unique photos with the characters and a decorating function that allows you to decorate the photos you take with stamps. Take pictures with various characters in various poses and with various filters, and decorate them with various stamps that are unlocked as you progress through the story!

✦Features✦

- More than 30 characters can be summoned.

- All facial expressions are fully animated. The characters are fully animated, making you feel as if they are right in front of you.

- Tap the character's body to enjoy various reactions.

- Cute and dark gothic and fantasy music that fits the magical world.

- The scenario is filled with the indie author's favorite, and you can feel a sense of immorality.

* This game has some mature expressions.

* Please feel free to post videos and still images using captured game works, regardless of whether you are an individual or a company, and whether or not you are monetizing your work. Please use the hashtag #deviconnect. Please refer to the official website for detailed guidelines.

- If you encounter any issues while playing, please report them on the bug report forum.

✦Contorl✦

The game primarily uses mouse controls and some keyboard input for text entry, but shortcuts are provided.

- Right-click: Clear message window

- Mouse wheel down: Next message

- Enter: Send message, control for Evil Eye Search/Magic Recovery

- Display menu (except title screen), quit game (on title screen)

- Space: Clear message window

- B: Display backlog

- L: Display load screen

- S: Display save screen

- F10: Take screenshot

games.name: Deck of Memories
games.shortDescription: Deck of Memories is a nostalgic deckbuilding adventure about the stories your grandfather left behind. Explore fragments of his life as a lighthouse keeper, manifested inside atmospheric dioramas. Craft and combine cards to restore these memories and discover the secrets they hold.
games.aboutText:
Deck of Memories blends card-based gameplay with an evocative tale about fading memories.

Play as Mina, a young woman returning to her grandfather's post at the lighthouse. Looking through his belongings, she discovers a wondrous deck of handcrafted cards. Suddenly, scenes from a memory begin to emerge…

Each short story features multiple card encounters on an immersive diorama board.

Discover new gameplay twists across every diorama, from shifting tides to moving machinery.

Combine your cards carefully to stabilize the memory, and recover every detail before it fades.

Tinker with cards at the crafting table using your grandfather's old supplies.

Collect and attach various trinkets to discover powerful synergies and refine your deck for greater versatility.

Spend memory shards to unlock new cards, crafting tools, and other curious collectibles.

What Deck of Memories offers:

- Original, soft take on deckbuilding with lots of nostalgia baked in

- Collection of lovely short stories based on thoughtfully designed card encounters

- Campaign-style playthrough inspired by Inscryption Part 1 and Hearthstone Adventures

- Calming atmosphere and beautiful artstyle, fully hand-painted (no AI)

- Seamless blend of strategic and relaxing gameplay

- Many unlockable cards, trinkets and tools

What Deck of Memories is not :

- Roguelike (difficult challenges and endless runs)

- Fast-paced, combat-heavy or violent

- Walking Simulator

- ​Multiplayer

Wishlist now to get notified when the demo is out, and try for yourself!

games.name: LOOTPLOT
games.shortDescription: Re-arrange items, discover synergies, bend the rules, and break the game! LOOTPLOT is a points-based, inventory builder Roguelite centered around items, which all have a unique twist.
games.aboutText:
LOOTPLOT is a Roguelike where you generate points by arranging items in slots.

Gameplay:

The objective is simple: You must earn enough points to make it to the next round, or else you lose.

Buy items, re-arrange your items, discover synergies, and break the game!
The rules are open ended, and will bend to your will.

Creativity = power!

Features:

- Over 300 unique items to discover, of varying rarities

- Starter-items that provide unique starting scenarios

- Dozes of unique slot types to work with

- Highly emergent gameplay, with many overlapping systems

- Easter eggs and secrets

- Excellent Modding support

- Open ended strategies

- Seasonal items (Christmas, Halloween, Easter)

Modding Support!

Lootplot has excellent modding support!
In fact, ALL of the game content was implemented as series of mods, which is source-public.

Join our discord if you have questions!

⚠️⚠️ CAT WARNING!!! ⚠️⚠️

Ready to bend the rules? So are these cats.

They might look like your friends—but these cheeky lil dudes are complete wildcards. (Just like real cats)

You have been warned, my friend.

(Yes, I, the dev, have been soft-locked by cats in the past. No, I am not proud of that)

⚠️⚠️ YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED. ⚠️⚠️

games.name: CROPS!
games.shortDescription: CROPS! is an async autobattler in which your fruits and vegetables come alive! Craft a deck with awesome synergies, plant your crops in specific patterns and place them strategically on the battlefield to defeat your opponent.
games.aboutText:
Each round you grow crops in specific patterns. Planting them correctly will make them come to life!

- Unlock 50+ new crops, avatars and skins.

- Ranked PvP and leaderboards.

- Invite a friend to ranked 2v2

- Build your own unique deck of 9 crops.

- 5 different PvE islands with unique bosses and enemies.

- Unlock Expert Mode and Endless Mode.

- Steam achievements.

- Endless strategies with random field layouts and special buff fields.

games.name: HARK THE GHOUL
games.shortDescription: Emerge from a cocoon under the light of an ominous star. Just who were you before your rebirth? HARK THE GHOUL is a first-person dungeon crawler based on freeform exploration and discovery, set in an amber-crazed city full of secrets, shortcuts, and adversaries.
games.aboutText:
Make use of your equipment and ingenuity to traverse a twisting, interconnected world filled with secrets and shortcuts. Throw yourself down a mine shaft, barter passage through the Ratman’s Horrid Holes, or get lost in the Sacred Marsh’s eerie fog… You’re free to wander wherever your adventure takes you.

Wield swords, whips, pistols, cannons, magicks, and your mighty kicks to overcome your adversaries and reach places you shouldn’t. Each tool in your arsenal features a dynamic moveset: grapple enemies with your harpoon gun, plant your spear in a wall to use it as a platform, stack boxes created out of thin air, or dream a bridge with the puff of a pipe.

The Astre’s foreboding light illuminates a city driven mad by amber-sickness, but some still retain their sanity. You will meet peculiar allies, face ghastly monstrosities, and square off against daunting bosses as you seek out your past life and fulfil your mysterious purpose.

HARK THE GHOUL is a neo-gothic love letter to the graphics and games of a bygone era, complete with customizable visual filters and a 72-page in-game artbook with developer commentary.

games.name: Odds Chronicles
games.shortDescription: Defy impossible odds in a tactical roguelite RPG where every dice roll shapes your fate. Master grid-based battles, forge powerful builds, and uncover a world inspired by tabletop adventures.
games.aboutText:
Odds Chronicles is a tactical roguelite RPG where dice-driven unpredictability meets precise strategy. Play as Evryn, a former royal bodyguard whose kingdom has fallen, and unlock more unique heroes during your journey, each with their own starting abilities and personalized dice loadouts.

Click to roll or throw the dice yourself, then use every face like a weapon. Generate resources - Strength , Dexterity and Arcane - to fuel abilities. Charge powerful skills over time or unleash them immediately. Unused resources fill a bonus gauge, granting Wild Dice that can shift the tide of battle.

Battle on diorama-style battlefields where positioning, line of sight, and ability synergy matter. Assign dice to abilities, adapt to unpredictable rolls, and chain creative combos to turn the tide.

The deeper you go, the deadlier it gets. Upgrade and swap abilities during your run to adapt on the fly. Experiment with new combos, uncover synergies, and build a playstyle that fits how you fight.

Collect dice enhancements , abilities , consumables , and relics to craft a strategy that’s entirely your own.

Every run draws from memories , yours and others’.

Discover shifting paths, altered events, and familiar faces in circumstances changed by your past choices. The world of Lynn changes as you do.

Tackle events your way: with stealth, magic, or brute force, the choice is yours.

At the end of each journey, powerful enemies await, tied to the fate of the world itself. Defeat them to reshape the future. Win or lose, you return to the Tavern outside of Time with earned Memory Shards to gain permanent new powers.

Recruit unique characters bringing new features and upgrades in the Tavern . Your first ally, Kau’i the blacksmith, will join you with his forge and help you shape new builds.

Between journeys, spend Memory Shards to unlock new skills , consumables , and talent trees . Hone your playstyle or experiment new ways to play and prepare for what’s to come.

As a royal bodyguard, you failed your King, and lost your honor. A tyrant now rules, her lieutenants crushing the realm. You returned too late... but revenge still burns.

Your revenge against the tyrant ended in defeat. But instead of dying, you awaken in the Tavern Outside of Time , a a mysterious place forged from memories.

Your first mission: return to Karab’s Peninsula , where you once fell. The land has changed, but your enemies remain. To reclaim the kingdom of Lynn and restore your legacy, you must fight through ever-shifting regions and confront the truth behind your revenge.

The revenge you seek is only the beginning. The Tavern holds deeper secrets, and so does your fate.

Key Features

- A branching adventure with choices on the path and in encounters, plus evolving story events at key Points of Interest,

- Grid-based tactical combat with terrain elevation, and line-of-sight depth,

- Persistent meta-progression with XP, upgrades, and unlockable abilities,

- Replayable roguelite structure with evolving challenges,

- Atmospheric, tabletop-inspired visuals that bring the world to life,

- Strategic relics and consumables ( potions, flasks, and scrolls) to turn the tide in battle,

games.name: Backspace Backspace Backspace
games.shortDescription: In an AI-powered age where original authors have become largely redundant, play as a dejected writer on the brink of losing their creative drive forever.
games.aboutText:
Immerse yourself in Backspace Backspace Backspace, a narrative-driven game that explores the inner turmoil of a struggling writer in an age where AI has made the written word wholly automated.

Game Features:

- Narrative-focused visual novella putting the player in the shoes of a tortured creative soul.

- Homemade pixel art direction reminiscent of the GBA era.

- Full soundtrack of chiptune-style music.

- Meaningful choices.

- Dialogue available in nine languages (so far!): English, Arabic, Turkish, French, Chinese (traditional & simplified), Korean, Russian, Vietnamese, and Japanese! Get in touch if you can help localize the game in other languages.

- Two endings. Try to get both!

We made this game in one week. Debugging and further touch-ups took two months. We never created pixel art or original music before, but we used this project as an opportunity to push ourselves outside our comfort zone and grow more independent as a team of two. Above all else, Backspace Backspace Backspace is our love letter to every creative soul out there. Keep making!

Because we appreciate transparency, and to help you save your money, here's what this game is not :

- A "long" game. We made this game with compactness in mind. Expect no more than 20 minutes of gameplay.

- A flawless game. Backspace Backspace Backspace is a small project made in a limited time frame, with limited experience, and virtually no resources, with the intent of learning how to make a game from scratch. Naturally, it will have technical issues. We are still working on them, but we don't want this game to hold us back from focusing on our next project. If you encounter a bug, please let us know.

We have many more games lined up in the near future. If you already purchased Backspace Backspace Backspace and would like to support us further, we would be immensely grateful to you. Leave us a review, tell your friends about this game, or purchase the Backspace Backspace Backspace soundtrack (which is also available on YouTube for free).

games.name: Hexagod
games.shortDescription: A tile-placement number-go-up style roguelike where you build your own mini world. Place hexagon tiles, exploit adjacency bonuses, and discover powerful relics to create game breaking synergies.
games.aboutText: A tile-placement number-go-up style roguelike where you build your own mini world. Place hexagon tiles, exploit adjacency bonuses, and discover powerful relics to create game breaking synergies.

games.name: Sculplings
games.shortDescription: A creature-collecting roguelike where every monster is sculpted in real clay and brought to life! Collect and battle a random assortment of hand-sculpted monsters in order to become the #1 Sculpling Champion!
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the world of Sculplings! Here, trainers collect monsters in order to become the #1 Sculpling Champion!

Sculplings is a mashup of roguelikes with traditional monster fighter games! Each run has players collecting and battling a random assortment of hand-sculpted monsters in the hopes of reaching the Sculpling Champions!

Sculplings features a simple-yet-deep battle system similar to other monster battlers! A variety of different monster types and moves must be used if you have any hope of becoming a Sculpling champion!

Every monster, every item, every blade of grass is completely hand sculpted and scanned into the game! We’ve made over 300 sculptures to help bring the unique world of Sculplings to life, with plenty more on the way!

Each run of Sculplings features a new set of randomized paths. Players must strategically choose which path to go down to have the best chance of reaching the Champion’s Arena. In addition, each run features random monsters and a variety of zones players can enter, each with its own set of unique Sculplings to capture!

Sculplings features over 100 unique, hand-sculpted monsters to discover and collect, each with their own strategies and playstyles. The trick is to discover which collection of Sculplings will give you the best chances of reaching the end!

Collect ‘Pins’ during your runs to add all sorts of passive benefits! The balance between the monsters you choose to have on your team and the items you get could be the key to victory!

FEATURES:

- Over 100 hand sculpted monsters to collect and battle!

- Over 30 unique passive items to aid you on your runs

- 5 unique environments to explore, each with their own monsters and battles

- Over 15 unique bosses to battle

games.name: Fishlike
games.shortDescription: High speed microgames involving fish, fishing, and fishlike activities.
games.aboutText:
Fishlike is a WarioWare-inspired microgame compilation featuring 120+ different microgames themed around fish, fishing, and everything in between!
Test your skills in various fish themed genres as the games increase in both speed and mechanical difficulty, chasing high scores and defeating challenging boss stages.

- 120+ microgames , each with 3 separate speed and difficulty levels.

- 8 main levels with their own music, themes, and boss stages.

- Challenging remix stages that mix and match games of different types.

- Online leaderboards: Compete globally or against your friends.

- Practice mode : Play any specific microgame as much as you like.

- Fishing minigame.

games.name: Pixel Dungeon VR
games.shortDescription: Pixel Dungeon is a fast-paced, multiplayer social VR adventure where dungeon-crawling action, physics-based combat, and chaos with friends collide.
games.aboutText:
Pixel Dungeon is a fast-paced, multiplayer social VR adventure where dungeon-crawling action, physics-based combat, and chaos with friends collide.

🏆 A Meta Quest Essential

Recognized in Meta’s Best of 2025 , Pixel Dungeon stands as a premier title in the Action and Adventure categories with 4.8-star rating . Join a legendary community and see why it’s a Meta Quest must-play.

Search "Pixel Dungeon: Prologue" on Steam, try out co-op gameplay and limited map content!

⚔️ Squads Up & Dungeon Chaos

- Team up in 4-player squads or hang out in 10-player lobbies ！

- No Limits : Full game owners can host their friends—even those who haven't purchased yet—to explore the entire dungeon together!

💥 Epic Boss Battles, 2nd Stage Power-Up

- 4 Bosses to Conquer : Skull King slashes his axe. Ghost Lord shoots bullets that chase you. Fight them!

- Second Stage : Angel becomes a giant eye monster, firing deadly lasers that burn the ground beneath you. God of Time shatters the ground, forcing everyone into a new arena —battles upgrade are so exciting!

⚔️ Rich Weapons & Heroes

- Hack-n-slash with Katana, claws and bows that feel real. Every hit, block, and strike is based on physics!

- BOSS Weapons: Crush your bosses with legendary gear and feel the power!

- Unique Heroes : The Witcher, Black Knight, Bird Man...choose your heroes!

games.name: Trizon
games.shortDescription: Trizon is a roguelike deck-building game. Fuse any two cards together to play crazy combos. The game combines auto-battler mechanics, where creatures attack on their own, with instant-effect spell cards. Battles are fast-paced and dynamic, set against a simple and restrained art style.
games.aboutText:
Trizon is a rogue-like deckbuilding game. Players take on the role of an escapee relentlessly pushing forward to find a way out. The game combines auto-battler mechanics, where creatures attack on their own, with instant-effect spell cards. Battles are fast-paced and dynamic, set against a simple and restrained art style, making both in-battle and out-of-battle decisions equally significant and thought-provoking.

Players can...

- Use creatures and spells to control the battlefield, defeating all enemy creatures to secure victory.

- Fuse any two cards in your deck to create completely overpowered single-card combos.

- Merge countless creatures to cultivate your own unique, ultimate fusion monster.

- Plan your route and take risks to achieve greater rewards.

- Anticipate the flow of battle, triggering a series of fully automated chain reactions.

- Craft infinite loops, defeating any opponent in a single turn with limitless combos.

- Encounter adorable card illustrations, making your adventure feel less lonely.

games.name: Lucky Coin Pusher
games.shortDescription: Lucky Coin Pusher is a coin pusher simulator focused on deck-building. Combine characters, coins (or bowling balls), stickers, items and other elements to build unique synergies and hit the jackpot.
games.aboutText:
Choose from multiple characters with different mechanics. Earn G-Coins from each victorious run to unlock new costumes and abilities for your characters.

Build your coin pusher with hundreds of objects: bowling balls, disco balls, or even watermelons.

Take the fight to the coin pusher and create more explosive turns.

games.name: Labyrinth of Touhou Tri -The Dreaming Girls & The Mysterious Orbs-
games.shortDescription: The girls of Gensokyo weave together a DRPG with not-so-easy boss fights! Form a party of 12 allies out of a pool of 40+, and create with 1000+ skills to choose from! Hack, slash, and grow stronger, then make builds (or counter-builds!) to take down powerful bosses awaiting you in the dungeons!
games.aboutText:
- A Fanmade Touhou Project DRPG With Not-So-Easy Boss Fights!
The girls of Gensokyo weave together a dungeon RPG with an estimated playtime of 30~50 hours.
Pick a frontline of 4 and a rear of 8 to form a party of 12 characters out of a pool over 40+ and conquer extensive dungeons!

- The True Thrill of DRPGs – Hacking, Slashing, and Character Growth!
Among the enemies wandering dungeons, you'll find especially troublesome (and tasty!) Rare Enemies that give much more EXP,
Giant Enemies that are several times as stronger than regular ones and tens of times more rewarding,
and Special Enemies that possess various unique aspects to their fights and hold special item drops!
Raise and lower the spawn rate of various enemies, waiting in ambush for some and running from others as you explore vast dungeons!
Find the perfect hunting ground for your party and go farming for a while!
Use various means to devise certain, consistent strategies for powerful foes and grind, grind, grind to grow stronger!

- Builds and Counter-Builds Are the Key to Beating Bosses!
"They'll do this thing every X turns!" "They'll always use this attack at X% HP!" "They have a 1500% party-wide nuke!"
"They stop time and attack 4 times for 500% damage each!" "They buff every turn with no cap!"
The bosses blocking your way may be powerful, but there's always a solution!
Defeat countless powerful foes with special traits by ascertaining their patterns and weaknesses,
then going at them with a well-trained party and a finely-honed battle plan!

- Utilize Boss Refights to Use Bosses to Farm and Challenge Even Fiercer Battles!
By progressing through the game, you'll unlock the ability to refight bosses to your heart's content!
You can either treat them as tasty sitting ducks to farm them and get their drops,
or you can subject yourself to level restrictions to gain extra rewards from battling them!
There are even some powerful special rewards you can only obtain by beating bosses with restrictions attached!
Boss fights make for really intense battles with restrictions on, so be ready before you attempt them!

- Skill Trees With Over 1000 Skills For Designing Your Own Synergies!
Everyone loves Skill Trees! Each of the 40+ characters has their own massive tree exclusive to them!
Which of the many girls will you choose? Which skills will you teach them? Who will battle in tandem with who?
Form your own unique party and devise your own unique battle strategy!

games.name: 皇帝游戏：天下-皇游天下
games.shortDescription: 《皇帝游戏》是一款将皇帝扮演与卡牌构筑相结合的roguelike游戏，在这款游戏中，在这里，您将穿越时空化身千古帝王，亲自执掌乾坤，打造您独一无二的能臣良将班底，亲自排兵布阵，合纵连横。运筹帷幄之中，决胜千里之外。是宵衣旰食开创盛世，还是酒池肉林沦为昏君，都在您的一念之间！
games.aboutText:
书写属于你的帝王史诗！

《皇游天下》是一款以中国历史为背景的 皇帝模拟+牌组构筑 游戏。在这里，您将化身千古帝王， 招募名臣良将 ， 打造奇观伟业 ， 运筹奇谋妙策 ，开创独属于您的 太平盛世 ！

跨越时空，汇聚英豪！

历朝历代的能臣良将皆听您调遣，辅以 卡牌锻造、伟业建造、计策谋划 ，走出一条 前所未有的帝王霸业之路 ！

丰富内容，自由构筑：

- 30+位中国帝王 ——从秦皇汉武到唐宗宋祖，任君选择

- 150+位文臣武将 ——五虎上将、四大才子，打造最强班底

- 40+种计策谋略 ——合纵连横、暗度陈仓，智取天下

- 50+座奇观伟业 ——修建长城、开辟运河，功盖千秋

- 沉浸历史剧本 ——亲历真实事件，改写王朝命运

帝业模式

- 基础游戏模式，以坚持25个回合为目标，期间应对种种挑战

- 丰富的随机要素，每局都会带来全新体验

- 通关帝业模式，逐步解锁全新皇帝

剧本模式

- 历史玩法：亲历王朝兴衰，复刻经典历史图景

- 挑战玩法：扮演各色历史人物，打破既定宿命

- 幻想玩法：无双式快意征战，爽玩不受束缚

- 通关历史玩法，逐步解锁全新大臣

激活羁绊，扭转战局！

集齐 五虎上将、四大美女 等关联名臣，即可触发强力羁绊效果——哪一组传奇组合，将成为您问鼎天下的关键助力？

无尽模式

- 继承帝业模式全部配置

- 挑战更高统治分数

- 探索最强阵容极限

games.name: Keep Leapin'
games.shortDescription: A challenging yet satisfying parkour game about Harry, a heartbroken worm who wants to become more attractive to the ladies by mastering the art of Leapin'. Unfortunately for Harry, becoming a Leaper is tough business.
games.aboutText:
WORMS WHO PARKOUR!

You play as Harry, a heartbroken worm with one goal: become a Leaper.

Leapers are worm-athletes trained in the art of parkour. They're fast, skilled, and apparently irresistible to the ladies.
After losing his crush to a Leaper, Harry sets out to improve his chances on the dating market by becoming a Leaper himself. All he has to do is to beat the Leaper Gym.

LEAPIN' IS TOUGH BUSINESS

Leapin' is all about flow. Roll across floors, launch yourself up walls, swing from grappling hooks and much more. A true leaper chains together moves maintain momentum. With enough skill, you can pull off some incredible movement. But it all comes with a risk of tumbling and smashing face-first into the environment.

The gym is not recommended for worms who can't handle setbacks. Leapin' is for worms who refuse to back down from a challenge. In other words: This is not an easy game.

games.name: Love Curse: Find Your Soulmate
games.shortDescription: Love Curse is a GL visual novel. You’ve fallen under a curse, and the only way to break it is to find your soulmate! The clock is ticking… Will you find true love? And what secrets will you uncover along the way?
games.aboutText:
Story

You’re entering your junior year of college. Your first two years went by quickly— You were an average college student, living an average college life. However, after almost getting hit by a car, you meet a mysterious woman who says you’ll die if you don’t find your soulmate soon! Now you have to juggle school, work, and your impending doom?!

Fate works in mysterious ways. You bump into your childhood best friend who you haven’t seen in years. Your friend’s sister takes a keen interest in you. The senior you occasionally bump into helps you get an internship. And even the CEO at your new job seems to have her eyes on you…

Who will be your soulmate, and who holds a hidden vendetta against you? In this twisted, passionate game of emotions, what will come to light? Love, possessiveness, manipulation, and obsession swirl together… Will you discover the truth behind it all?

Characters

Selene Yan (*First name can be customized)

A junior at Ocean City University. You’re a soft and sweet person with a big heart who’s always willing to stand up for what they believe in. Kind and empathetic, your caring nature is adored by those around you.

Nyx Xia
Your childhood best friend. You two previously had an arranged marriage, but that fell through pretty quickly. You ended up moving away and not seeing her for years. She’s changed— She’s bubbly and energetic, but sometimes grim… Maybe there’s more to her than the eye can see.

Iris Wen
The student council president. She’s a year above you and about to graduate. Iris helps you with an internship opportunity. She’s nice and friendly, but don’t be fooled— her gentle nature is simply a façade. She struggles to let anyone in, keeping her heart locked up in a cage. Perhaps there’s a hidden side to her she’s keeping a secret…

Eleanor Si

She’s your classmate from another university, and the twin sister of your friend. Eleanor’s always eager to learn more, so she’s agreed to attending lectures in place of her sister. She’s been interested in you since the day you two met.

Victoria Qi

The CEO of Huanyu. She’s a genius who graduated with dual degrees. Victoria pays extra close attention to you, making sure you’re thriving at work. She’s strict and dedicated to her job, often appearing impersonal to others.

Details

Love Curse is a lesbian visual novel spanning across a variety of genres, including romance, fantasy, and historical elements.

The final version of the game will be paid. The storyline will span over approximately 200,000 words, with over 40 exclusive CGs (chibi versions included), 4 romanceable characters, and 7 supporting characters.

More Information

1. The romanceable characters are not perfect. They each have obvious negative personality traits which will be revealed during the game.

2. The game may contain a few bugs. These can be reported to the production team via “Option.”

games.name: Blasterbug: Last Bug Standing!
games.shortDescription: Bzz bzz! Hop in chaotic bomb-fueled battles inspired by arcade action classics we all love! Blaster up to 8 players locally with ant-astics Pome-grenades in this bomb-em-up party game and bee the last bug standing!
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Blasterbug: Last Bug Standing!

Throw out explosive Pome-grenades and punch out your opponents to become the ultimate bug ! Be careful not to get caught in the blast as you navigate evolving arenas , or you might end up as just another splatter on the arcade wall.

Play as 15 colorful ant-stoppable bugs with dedicated special moves .

Fly your way out of deadly situations with the… Fly , trap your enemies with your web as the sticky Spider or roll a destructive flaming dung ball with R. Beelte .

Each bug has a very particular set of skills and mastering them can be a game-changer. Which one will worm up your heart?

Beetle your way into 15 playable areas , each bringing their own gameplay twist .
Escape the dangerous hazards of the Temple , trap your opponents on the fast lane in Bugville , avoid getting hit by spoons in the Kitchen …

Get spotless wins by using each environment to your advantage and creating buzzing chaos !

5 fantas-tick game modes are available: last-bug standing Death Battle , richest-bug-wins Coin Battle , hold on to your hat Crown Battle , splatter-spreading Paint Battle and the ultimate mix it up Party Battle combining all of them together with random modifiers.

Blasterbug: Last Bug Standing! is designed for immediate quick-fire fun for up to 8 players locally .
Perfect for tussling with friends, loved ones and co-workers.

Bring your hive-mates and bzz, ziip and tsizz!

games.name: Apartment Story
games.shortDescription: A third-person thriller about three people and a gun in a single apartment. Navigate escalating real-time narrative events whilst managing Sims-esq stats to stay strong for an inevitable showdown. You play as Arthur, a young man trying to make it day to day before a gun turns his life upside down.
games.aboutText:
Apartment Story is a feature-length, single-player, third-person thriller set in a single apartment. You play as Arthur, a person alive in 2023 trying to keep his head above water, when you receive an unexpected call at the door from your old roommate, Diane. She stays, you party, but soon you will meet Blondey and good times turn bad very quickly. Will you participate in a dangerous and dramatic narrative? Or keep the front door closed, eating and masturbating until you’ve shut the world out for good? Whatever you choose, the cold metal of a gun is hidden within the darkness of your apartment somewhere.

Features

- Absorb yourself in a fast-paced, dramatic thriller that centres around 3 distinct personalities which develop as the gun is introduced and stakes are raised.

- You are invited to take an active role in Arthur’s life and welfare through a deep and immersive needs management system. Eat food, pee, wash your hands, sleep, smoke, write, watch TV, shave, change clothes, nap, shower, take drugs, wash the dishes, turn off the lights, drink beer, listen to music, top up your electric, answer the door and shoot someone with a real gun. Engaging in these activities will keep your Life stats up and Arthur poised for the drama coming his way.

- Tidy and organise the objects within your apartment however you desire by picking up any small object and placing them anywhere within reach.

- Real-time night and day cycles.

- This Videogame is a feature-length experience, which means you can grab yourself a drink and complete the game within a single night. Playtime: approximately 90-120 minutes.

games.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
games.shortDescription: Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.
games.aboutText:
TCG Card Shop Simulator is a trading card shop simulation where you sell card booster packs to earn money and build your card shop business.

Manage Your Shop:

Design your own TCG shop. Organize shelves and card packs to make the customer shopping experience smooth and easy.

Card Collection:

Open the booster packs yourself and collect the cards. Find rare cards and sell them to make a fortune, or keep them to complete your card collection.

Host Game:

Set your card game format and fee, invite players to play card games in your shop. Be sure to keep your store clean and hygienic for the players or they might leave!

Order Products:

Stock up on different booster card packs and card game products. Keep track of popular trends and adjust your inventory to cater to the ever-changing demands of your customers.

Expand Your Business:

Earn profits to reinvest in your shop. Expand your space, unlock new card sets, and upgrade your facilities to attract even more customers and increase revenue.

games.name: Master Lemon: The Quest for Iceland
games.shortDescription: A tribute to a friend who has passed — and to the adventures we still need to live. A story-driven adventure about a young polyglot traversing mystical islands and using the power of words to confront his own fate and save a world tamed by darkness.
games.aboutText:
A tribute to a friend who passed away

In this touching pixel art adventure, help Lemon, a young polyglot, save the world's languages from a memory-devouring plague. The game is inspired by the life of André Lima — "Lemon" — an adventurous polyglot whose love for languages and cultures knew no bounds. His dream of living in Iceland to learn Icelandic was cut short after a car accident. This is a tribute to André's life, and an invitation for you to reflect on your own destiny.

The Power of Words

Words have power in the Bashir Islands. During your journey, you'll learn words from over ten languages that grant Lemon special powers.

Ratljóst — "enough light to illuminate the path" in Icelandic — dispels the darkness ravaging the world.

Gambiarra — "an improvised solution" in Brazilian Portuguese — allows you to creatively combine items to solve unique puzzles.

Each word carries cultural authenticity. Each word is a tool.

Simple and Intuitive Mechanics

With accessible interface and cozy gameplay, reminiscent of classic handheld adventures, you will:

- End the darkness tormenting the world

- Solve ingenious puzzles

- Collect hundreds of humanity's relics

- Explore every corner of the beautiful Bashir Islands Embrace the spirit of resilience and curiosity. This adventure celebrates life, language, and friendship.

Collect relics of the world

The Bashires — island inhabitants and language creators — are personifications of real cultures from our world. By helping them, you form authentic connections and celebrate humanity's linguistic and cultural diversity. Find over 100 precious relics, forgotten by the darkness. Save them and watch your collection grow in the Bashir Library.

Challenge your destiny

But sometimes, destiny is a choice. While saving the Bashir Islands, you'll be confronted with decisions that echo far beyond the game. For the true adventure isn't just saving a world — it's understanding your own.

What is your dream? How far are you willing to go to achieve it? And what is the price of simply living?

Master Lemon transcends entertainment. It's a mirror to your own journey.

games.name: WARAG
games.shortDescription: A modernized old-school boomer shooter with progression, upgrades and a gory combat system. Fight in a dark Byzantine-Gothic setting, gain experience, power up your weapons, build your playstyle and become a true Varangian berserker.
games.aboutText:
A modernized old-school boomer shooter with progression, upgrades and a gory combat system. Fight in a dark Byzantine-Gothic setting, gain experience, upgrade your weapons, create a build and become a true Varangian berserker.

- Fast and gory combat - Move, shoot, cut enemies down up close and keep the pace high as foes burst into chunks of meat.

- Progression and upgrades - Gain experience, choose upgrades, create a build from 20+ upgrades, unlock alt-fire and shape your own playstyle.

- Dark and brutal Byzantine-Gothic setting.

- Retro atmosphere and interface - VHS/CRT effects.

- Soundtrack - true metal.

- The game is based on UZDoom, which was previously based on GZDoom.

games.name: FAKEBOOK
games.shortDescription: Point-and-click mystery adventure on the virtual Social Media! Find secrets hidden by family, friends, companies, and idols.
games.aboutText:
Dive into the virtual world of social media in this point-and-click mystery adventure!

Uncover secrets hidden by families, friends, corporations, and idols on a virtual social media platform where millions share their daily lives.

“Fakebook" is a social impact game designed to explore both the bright and dark sides of modern social media culture.

Within its vast world, millions of virtual users form intricate relationships, posting their lives for all to see. But beneath these posts lie hidden truths, waiting for you to discover. stimulating stories you find and post, the more followers you have on your account!

THE STORY

Your sister, accused of defaming a beloved national idol, became the target of relentless online harassment. Unable to bear all the pressure, she chose to take her own life.

Determined to reveal the injustice that led to her tragic death, you set out to grow your own social network account, gather followers, and expose the truth to the world.

Craft posts by uncovering intimate and provocative stories and watch your follower count soar. The more secrets you reveal, the closer you get to justice.

GAMEPLAY FEATURES

Interact with Virtual Accounts

Exchange DMs to receive requests, and choose from over 30 intriguing requests.

Explore and Investigate

Examine profiles, timestamps, and even ad banners to uncover crucial clues.

Grow Your Influence

Solve requests, write posts, and attract more followers.
Every secret uncovered can boost your account.

Open-World Freedom

Dive into the Fakebook universe without restrictions. Investigate whatever sparks your curiosity.

IMMERSIVE OPEN-WORLD

Fakebook is an open-world social media experience filled with hidden elements and surprises, including cameos by real-life influencers reimagined as virtual personas. New stories and updates keep the world of Fakebook ever-evolving.

Log in now and uncover the secrets of Fakebook!

games.name: Hoptale
games.shortDescription: Hoptale is a Roguelite adventure that fuses hopscotch with a slot machine. Play as Tuby, a rabbit whose only weapon is his jump, against the awakened God of Chaos. In battle the tiles below spin into reels — call the stop, line up attacks, strike. Collect tiles, build your run, outsmart chaos.
games.aboutText:
Hoptale is a Roguelite adventure that blends hopscotch with slot machines. Play as Tuby the rabbit and stand against the awakened god of chaos.

Hop to Save the World

Hopping is Tuby's only weapon. Fight, explore, gather, fish, and solve puzzles — all by hopping from tile to tile.

Combat, Slot Machine Style

In battle, the tiles beneath your feet become a slot machine. Watch the spinning symbols, call your stop at the right moment, and line up the attack tiles to land a lethal blow.

Stack Tiles, Build Your Style

Collect tiles with wildly different effects and combine them into builds that feed off one another — then beat the chaos of the reels at its own game.

Adorable Animals vs. Grotesque Horrors

Our heroes are a troupe of cute little animals — both Tuby and Meowchi are playable. On your journey you'll meet a bird butler whose speeches keep getting longer, and a fox merchant who coughs up gold coins when you rub his belly. You'll also run into a cultist cat that swallows small animals in its embrace, a Lady of Blood who lifts her skirt to lure you closer, a music angel performing a funeral march, and a tall, thin silhouette hiding deep in the forest.

games.name: Bat Galaxy
games.shortDescription: Half on-rails shooter, half exploration-driven adventure. Zoom into a world where billions of bullets surround you and your handy punch feature can send enemies flying.
games.aboutText:
Bat Galaxy is half on-rails shooter, half exploration-driven metroidvania style adventure inspired by 32-bit action games. Zoom into a high octane world where you'll weave through billions of bullets and use your handy punch feature to send enemies flying.







Mao and Kou, two fighter pilot trainees, are unavoidably thrust into a mission that only they can complete. They'll charge through linear stages with hordes of enemies surrounding them, explore colorful and mystically beautiful ancient worlds for technology and power-ups, and take on massive bosses built by a society their world forgot.

games.name: Super reaKtor
games.shortDescription: Super reaKtor is a bullet hell focused on difficulty with a twist: original controls and 2 differents weak points to manage. Collect green energy pellets, and avoid or absorb the various threats.
games.aboutText:
Super reaKtor is a fast-paced Bullet Hell with original controls, where you must survive by collecting green energy pellets, and avoid or absorb various types of hostile TRI-SKL bullets.

BUT WHAT MAKES IT SPECIAL?

- THE CONTROLS : You can Move, Rotate, but also change the Size of your laser beam.

- THE GAMEPLAY : Your 2 weak points are located on each side of your laser beam. Your central beam can absorb hostile bullets !

FEATURES

- ARCADE MODES: 3 major game modes, over 500 hand crafted patterns across 5 levels

- ONLINE LEADERBOARDS: Compete with the world and your friends

- TRAINING MODE: Master the patterns in a safe zone

- ACHIEVEMENTS: Collect them all

- TRISKELS: A lot of them

games.name: Farming and fighting on Island
games.shortDescription: When the Black Calamity falls, monsters hunt by night—devouring livestock and crops alike. Farm, fortify, hire mercenaries, and defend your remote island in Farming And Fighting On Island.
games.aboutText:
When the Black Calamity comes, night is no longer safe.

Monsters live on blood and flesh. After dark they strike without mercy—slaughtering animals, trampling fields, devouring crops. Anything edible is their feast. Trade routes crumble, and remote towns starve.

To secure food, you arrive on a lonely island to clear land, plant seeds, and survive.

In Farming And Fighting On Island , you will:

- Farm the island — till, sow, harvest, and build a life from the soil.

- Fortify your home — raise defenses, set traps, and prepare for nightly raids.

- Trade with villagers — earn gold and turn it into supplies and opportunity.

- Hire and arm mercenaries — forge weapons, equip your fighters, and hold the line.

Farm by day. Fight by night.
On this island, farming and fighting are one path—plant hope, and defend tomorrow.

games.name: Chromatic Conundrum
games.shortDescription: Chromatic Conundrum is a first person puzzle game where you manipulate light. Combine different colors and form shadows to illuminate your way through an enigmatic world.
games.aboutText:
Chromatic Conundrum is a first person puzzle game where you manipulate light. Combine different colors and form shadows to illuminate your way through an enigmatic world.

Bonus Features

- Visual hints integrated into each level to nudge you in the right direction if you get stuck.

- Colorblind mode to allow you to more easily distinguish similar looking colors.

- Steam achievements!

NOTE: Chromatic Conundrum is a 1-4 hour experience.

games.name: Chrono Gear: Warden of Time
games.shortDescription: Turn back the clock and fight to repair Time itself in this cinematic action platformer with fast sword combat and time-based powers. You are the Warden of Time, Ouro Kronii - be proud and fight hard!
games.aboutText:
You are Ouro Kronii, the Warden of Time. Your desire to become the strongest being in the universe led to the creation of the Chrono Gear, an artifact with the power to preserve timelines.

But where power lies, evil will seek to control it.

A fierce battle against the demonic Alter Laplus has shattered the Chrono Gear, scattering its Golden Gears across the stars. As Kronii, you must fight against the darkness that shattered your universe, find the Golden Gears, and repair the space-time continuum.

Chrono Gear: Warden of Time is a retro 2D action game that mixes speedy platforming and sword combat with explorable hub areas and a dramatic story.

Features:

- Control the flow of time with Kronii's special abilities, using Haste to accelerate time and Stasis to slow down time

- Speed your way through missions to achieve the fastest time records or explore for hidden collectibles; The game caters to either play style!

- Relax in central hub areas that connect you to each destination in your journey and become increasingly populated with hololive talents and fans as you make progress in the story

- Jam out to a pulse pounding soundtrack with over 75 pieces of collectible music, including remixes of popular hololive originals

This game is published under CCMC Corp(※1)'s Indie game brand "holo Indie".(※2)

This game is allowed to be monetized under the examination and terms of "holo Indie".

Please note that any monetized derivative work games that include Cover Corp.'s content outside of holo Indie is not covered by these terms and is not allowed.

※1. About CCMC Corp.

CCMC Corp. is entrusted with website management (ex: Steam) including, examination, publishing and other necessary tasks by Cover Corp.

※2. About "holo Indie"

holo Indie's objective is to cooperate with hololive production fans and creators.

It is a game brand that offers "Game Creator Support Program" for the derivative work games.

For more details about "holo Indie", Please refer to the Cover Corp.'s "Derivative work guidelines".
