- Fixed-Camera, High-Speed, High-Impact, Brutal Combat

- Blood Sucking

- Brutal Finishers

- Versatile Counter

- Character Customization

Blood Sucking

Feed on your enemies to recover health and stay in the fight

Brutal Finishers

Execute weakened enemies with brutal, stylish finishers

Reactive Counters

React to different enemy attacks with unique counters and turn their offense against them

Character Customization

Earn credits through combat and unlock new customization options

games.name: SketchBrawl
games.shortDescription: Sketchbrawl is an auto-battler: draft squads from six factions, deploy them on the grid, and watch hundreds of units clash on their own. Promote squads to ★★★, let your commander’s skill turn the tide, and survive ten rounds to clear the Arena.
games.aboutText:
Sketchbrawl is a fast auto-battler with a hand-drawn pixel look: draft an army, place it on the battlefield, and watch hundreds of units clash on their own.

ARENA — THE MAIN MODE

- Pick one of 6 factions, each with its own commander and 12 units across Common, Rare, Epic and Legendary tiers.

- Every round, pick unit cards from the shop and deploy them on a grid. Front line or back line, ground or air: where you place them matters.

- Field 3, 6 or 9 squads of the same unit and every one of them is promoted to ★, ★★ or ★★★.

- Battles play out automatically. Your only weapon is the army you built.

- Rarer units unlock as the run goes on. Win 10 battles before you lose 5 lives to clear the Arena.

COMMANDER SKILLS

- Each commander brings a passive bonus and an active skill that charges during battle and fires on its own: orbital strikes, poison fog, hatching broods, psionic blasts, overload and holy resurrection.

- Skills grow stronger as the battle goes on, and a well-timed one can turn a losing fight.

6 FACTIONS, 6 WAYS TO FIGHT

- Human Expedition: ranged firepower, armor and air support.

- Brood Swarm: overwhelming melee swarms that keep growing.

- Undead Scourge: the fallen rise again to fight for you.

- Cyber-Matrix: precise machines and devastating focused fire.

- Astral Energy: elusive units and wide-reaching psionic attacks.

- Holy Vanguard: shield walls, healing and resurrection.

EVERY BATTLE IS A SHOW

- Commanders trade taunts before each fight, rivals have words for each other, and every battle ends with a slow-motion K.O.

- Climb the ranks from Bronze to Diamond; tougher opponents wait at the top.

SANDBOX

- Place any units from any faction, in any numbers, and watch huge battles unfold. Test matchups or just enjoy the chaos.

ALSO INCLUDED

- Rock-paper-scissors counters between armor types and attack types: kinetic, explosive and energy.

- English and Simplified Chinese.

Sketchbrawl sends anonymous match data (factions, lineups, round results and screen size) after each Arena run to help us balance the game. No account, name or personal information is collected.

games.name: Chroma Zero
games.shortDescription: Explore a unique and connected world. Understand its fragile balance, uncover its deepest questions, and find more than just the answers.
games.aboutText:
Explore a unique and connected world. Understand its fragile balance, uncover its deepest questions, and find more than just the answers. Chroma Zero immerses you in a universe of mystery, color, energy, and movement, and challenges your expectations and intuition. There are no levels, the puzzles are integrated into the fabric of the space itself, and everything can change in the blink of an eye. Exploration and curiosity are rewarded.

Key Features

- Knowledge Based Progression – Learn the rules of the space, and you can progress farther in the world and deeper into the mystery

- Open-world Puzzles – Explore everywhere, the world itself is the puzzle. There are no levels.

- Extremely Dynamic Environment – The world reacts to your actions in dramatic fashion

- An enchanting and beautiful Original Score by Adam Kromelow and Dan Rufolo

- Narrative with charm and wit, and at times, wit and charm

Gameplay

Players generally take between 6 and 12 hours to finish the game, and a bit more to explore everything. Most progress is gated only by knowledge, which is gained by exploring and experimenting.

This is an immersive, non-linear, risk-taking and moderately challenging "Metroidbrainia" game, made by a solo developer (hi there). The narrative is mostly light-hearted, but can be impactful at times. The puzzles ramp up in difficulty, though the game helps to guide you as well. So if you're exploring everywhere, you will know what to do -- maybe just not how to do it! I was inspired by games like Antichamber, Outer Wilds, Myst/Riven, and the discovery elements of Tunic. I hope to bring more games like these into the world, since by their nature they are focused on giving you a wonderful and surprising first-playthrough.

Extras

- Controller Support – This game works 100% with controllers except for adjusting items in the 'Settings' subsection of the main/pause menu system. So, if you want to do stuff like change your resolution, adjust the sensitivity, adjust the key-bindings, turn on/off motion blur, etc. etc. it is ALL THERE for your fiddling pleasure, but you need a mouse to do it. Please forgive me this one trespass, dear gamer.

- Color Vision Deficiency Mode – An overlay can be positioned in any corner of the screen, or in the center, which describes the point-of-interest you're currently looking at.

- Photosensitivity Modes – A Brightness Offset adds range to the in-game brightness slider, and adds low-contrast animations to soften otherwise high-contrast events. An intro-animation offset adjusts the way the game starts, which typically involves a symmetrical pattern repeating across the screen. The offset makes it asymmetric.

- Speedrun Timer – A reposition-able timer starts on Play, and stops during dialogue sequences, but otherwise continues until game-over. Also, if this timer is enabled, the button-hold to delete your save file is sped up so fresh restarts can happen more quickly. Visit our discord for more speedrunning discussion and leaderboard links.

- Secrets – (..uh, spoiler!..)

- You can pet the cat(s)

games.name: The Qubit Factory
games.shortDescription: The Qubit Factory is an open-ended puzzle game incorporating real-life concepts from the cutting-edge field of quantum computing. Design and build logic circuits that manipulate bits and qubits (quantum bits) to solve devious computational challenges!
games.aboutText:
// New Employee Onboarding: Quantum Computing //

Below are classical bits , which all regular computers operate on. Boooooring!

Much more exciting are quantum bits (or qubits for short), which are not limited to simple {0,1} states.

Qubits are so hot right now! They are the building blocks of newfangled quantum computers . As newly-minted employees of The Qubit Factory you will have the privilege of processing qubits in our state-of-the-art production lines. By harnessing the power of quantum entanglement and superpositions you will help up deliver exciting new computational products to our valued customers!

// ---------------------------------------------- //

The Qubit Factory is an open-ended puzzle game about building logic circuits to solve computational tasks, inspired by classic titles from developer Zachtronics. Based on authentic representations of quantum bits and components, The Qubit Factory features puzzles based on key concepts and algorithms from the field of quantum computing.

Open-Ended Puzzles - Factory employees are encouraged to design their own unique solutions to given tasks. Bonuses will be awarded to those meeting strict efficiency criteria. Convoluted and/or poorly-optimized solutions will be frowned upon.

Faithful Physics - Designed and programmed by a real (semi-successful) research scientist in the field of quantum computing: key concepts and algorithms from quantum computing are conveyed accurately, allowing players to build genuine knowledge about quantum computing!

Accessible - Core concepts are built slowly, with players encouraged to build foundational understanding in classical computing before progressing to quantum analogues. No prior computer/physics knowledge is assumed!

games.name: Moon Princess
games.shortDescription: 🌙A daughter-raising game in a world of wuxia and mythology — raise her as a martial arts master in a rich wuxia world. Train, fight, manage, and shape her future! With 50+ branching endings and 60+ story characters, forge your one-of-a-kind heroine and change the fate of the Jianghu!
games.aboutText:
🌙 Moon Princess is a daughter-raising game set in a world of wuxia and mythology. In Mingyue, a land where wulin heroes thrive, you play as a great hero who personally raises your young daughter into adulthood.

Over 50 career endings and 20+ relationship outcomes, all shaped by your guidance—

- Will she train to become a legendary hero? Or fall to darkness and become an enemy of Jianghu?

- Perhaps she’ll live a peaceful life, spend her days with music, chess, calligraphy, and painting?

- Or pursue fame and a life of service, climbing the ranks… even…dare we say, ascending to the throne?

- More branching endings — same endings can be achieved through different story paths depending on your choices and relationships.

- New game features — unlock hidden content across multiple playthroughs: martial arts skills, new characters, new plotlines, and new endings...With each playthrough, more hidden truths emerge. Unresolved fates and mysteries in one lifetime may find answers in the next...

During the New Moon Era , a Blood Moon suddenly dominated the sky, staining the earth in red and plunging earth inhabitants into fear. Simultaneously, eerie disturbances emerge from deep within the Forsaken Valley, unleashing rampaging beasts and demons that brought devastation to all.

To restore peace, the great sects of the Jianghu came together to form the Three Swords Alliance. Talented heroes from across the land gathered, vowing to unravel the mystery of Forsaken Valley. Yet, unknown to them, a vast ancient conspiracy lurks beneath it all...

Amidst a turbulent Jianghu, the truth you uncover may decide the fate of Mingyue.

You'll encounter 60+ unique characters , each with their own allegiances and stories.

12 "Zodiac Descendants" — with whom your daughter can develop deep relationships that could possibly end in marriage.

This game offers 2-3 times more text volume and events than our previous one, with richer stories awaiting —

- Meaningful Character Interactions — NPCs actively engage in your daughter’s life, from classes, duels, sect activities, and festivals, to sharing meals, tea, theater, and baths, creating precious memories together.

- A Complex Social Network — NPCs can become friends after adventures or entangle your daughter in complicated romantic dramas.

- A living Jianghu — This world remembers every grudge and favor. Sects rise or fall by your actions. Heroic deeds may be repaid; but vendettas could lead to deadly pursuits...

30+ explorable locations , each offering more complex mechanics —

- Train your daughter in martial arts, study esoteric techniques, brew medicines, take disciples, and grow your sect.

- Earn coin by street vending, appraising antiques , or by running inns and clinics, expand your Jianghu business.

- Hunt, fish, sail, relax in hot springs, or seek thrills at theaters, The Joyous Terrace, or The Ghost Alley.

- Embrace rural life—farm, raise animals, cook, craft, and live in peace.

- Exploration — Discover hidden treasure chests, secret locations, and random encounters! Sneak into an immortal’s cave, stumble upon the imperial harem of 3,000…? If you can’t get the treasure by force, try picking the locks, sleuth infiltrating, or maybe have you tried poisoning the guards?

Enjoy the tranquil life of Mingyue with your daughter!

- Sect Training — Your daughter can join one of three great sword sects , each with unique legacies shaping her growth, skills, Jianghu connections, and even the main storyline.

- The Hundred Sects — Whether they are orthodox or forbidden, your daughter can learn from sect masters through formal training, or secretly study in the dead of night!

- Duel Battles — Challenge randoms for fame and riches in arena battles!

- Underground Exploration — Building on our previous turn-based combat system, this new strategy is more complex & diverse, your daughter and her teammates can trigger combo techniques together!

- Slay Demons and Monsters — Purge demons from Forsaken Valley, or even tame them as loyal companions!

- Parent Life — On rest days, you can train or work, cook for your daughter, teach her martial arts, or plan outings. The game focuses more on warm family moments and unlocks different content depending on whether you play as father or mother.

- Travel Adventures — Each year, you and your daughter go on family trips, visiting famous mountains, secret realms, encountering special events that unlock hidden stories. Every choice you make in front of her can influence her personality.

Remember, no matter how you do, you'll always be the one she treasures most!

Enjoy raising your daughter in Moon Princess !

Hi everyone!

We’re Egg Hatcher — the creators behind Volcano Princess , and we're thrilled to finally present the store page for our second daughter-raising game: Moon Princess !

To retain the unique style of our games, the main producers are still just the two of us.

Moon Princess has been in development for over a year and a half,

games.name: 领航员计划 Navigator Project
games.shortDescription: A twin-stick bullet hell roguelite with anime-style Navigators to meet and evolve. Dodge barrages, combine weapons and upgrades, chart branching routes, and take on massive bosses. Unlock new Navigator forms and discover their stories.
games.aboutText:
A cosmic cataclysm known as the Great Flood is sweeping across the stars. Set out with your anime-style Navigator companions and pilot a ship through alien battlefields. Shape your combat build around changing routes and loot, search for a path to safety, and uncover the secrets behind the disaster.

Move, aim, and fire in top-down battles. Weave through gaps in the barrage and find your moment to strike back. Navigator skills and weapon effects fill the battlefield, from swarming enemies to the sweeping beams of massive bosses. Every encounter demands a new decision.

Choose weapons and buffs from battle rewards and shops. Buy new weapons and merge them into stronger versions to refine your build. With different resources available each run, you can strengthen your current arsenal or change direction when new gear appears. Experiment with combinations and find your own firepower.

Each Navigator has unique dialogue and story moments with the bosses. Bring different companions into these encounters to discover their attitudes and stories before the fighting begins. Then read each boss's attacks and bullet patterns to find an opening.

Humans, insectoid species, Eos, and a wide range of distinctive civilizations make up this universe. Follow the main story and chance encounters to learn what they face and piece together the mystery of the Great Flood.

Meet Navigators from different civilizations and unlock new forms and appearances as they level up and evolve. Get to know them through animated character art, voice acting, and story dialogue. Spend time with them beyond the battlefield and follow their growth.

Choose a ship in the hangar, pair it with a Navigator and gear, and prepare for your next voyage. Ships from different civilizations have their own distinctive designs. Permanent research unlocks more ship types and loadout options. Try new combinations and find a fighting style that suits you.

Anime-style Navigator progression · Twin-stick bullet hell combat · Ship and weapon builds · Branching star maps and chance encounters · Permanent research upgrades

games.name: Nonentity Galaxy
games.shortDescription: Fight, Scavenge, Survive, and File Your Taxes. A grim yet hilarious space strategy roguelite where you must balance hull integrity against your company's relentless profit margins. Warning: Contains lethal doses of dark humor and corporate exploitation.
games.aboutText:
WORK. DIE. REPEAT.

Take a contract → choose how to handle encounters → salvage & recycle → refit your fleet → return, settle the bill, and head out again for bigger risks and bigger rewards.

This isn’t a lone ship run—it’s fleet deployment and tactical decision-making . Let the AI handle routine combat, or take manual control to focus fire and reposition for an edge:

- Formation & positioning shape your damage coverage and survival

- Target focus changes the pace of fights

- Fight when you must—retreat when you should (getting home is part of winning)

Roguelite resource strategy: salvage, rebuild, repeat

Every sortie is a gamble. Routes, battles, and encounters come with different rewards and costs. Winning isn’t enough—you must manage expenses, attrition, and salvage value , because what you bring back is how you grow stronger.

- Module builds : swap better modules on the spot—power spikes you can feel immediately

- Route gambling : safer paths offer stability; riskier ones can yield rarer modules and bigger payouts

- Cut your losses : retreating is a strategy—but deductions are real, and the settlement will tell the story

Dark humor, written into the rules

The galaxy’s glory belongs to “civilization.” The mess is for field agents.

You’ll face absurd incidents, faction politics, and corporate bureaucracy—where dark humor isn’t just dialogue, it’s the system itself:

- Sometimes you think you’ve “paused”… and it turns out you just triggered another procedure and another cost

- Sometimes you win the battle… then watch your earnings get sliced before they reach your pocket

Here, the enemy isn’t only enemy fire. It’s also the rules.

games.name: Fio and the Doomed City
games.shortDescription: A “city-building” x “tower defense” SLG by a young girl, Fio. Fio and her guardians, the Flora Bears, are building a city in the last city of humanity. Increase facilities, residents, and resources, and prepare for battle. Withstand enemy attacks and defeat the boss with your big beam cannon!
games.aboutText:
A “city-building” x “tower defense” simulation game featuring Fio, a girl who protects a dying world.

The multi-island forest world of Morin is on the verge of extinction due to the invasion of hot winds and monsters blowing from far away.

Fio and his guardians, the Flora Bears, are tasked with building the last human city while protecting the “ark dwellers”.

They can build various facilities to increase the number of inhabitants and resources, build defense facilities needed for battle, and strengthen their characters.

To protect your city from powerful bosses, hold out until you are ready for a support attack with a ridiculously large beam cannon, and defeat the bosses with super-exhilarating attacks!

Translated with (free version)

City building

Consume building materials and money to build facilities. Building houses increases the number of residents, and residents can use facilities such as fields and logging camps to produce more and more resources. You can use the collected resources to build defense facilities and strengthen your allied units, Florabears.

Battle flow

Battles basically begin by accepting a quest.

There are three basic operations: "Place Flora Bears", "Retreat", and "Activate Skills".

Each type of Flora Bear has a different attack and defense range, so understand the characteristics of the enemy units attacking you and place them appropriately according to the situation.

Skills that become available over time can also greatly affect the battle situation when activated.

As the story progresses, a boss battle will occur. The boss is very tough, but you can use your trump card, the "Giant Beam Cannon". Buy time until the boss is ready to fire, then fire the beam and win!

Strengthen Flora Bears

There are 7 types of Flora Bears, and you can set up to 5 skills for each. Skills have a big impact on battles, so create more powerful combinations.

Florabear's status will become stronger as the level increases, and can also be strengthened during town building.

Planting "roses", "pansies" and "tulips" around Florabear's habitat will increase the corresponding parameters. Arrange the flowers wisely to grow them efficiently.

About defense facilities

Defense facilities are one of the important elements in clearing quests. Building several of them in the town building part will give you an advantage in battle. Defense facilities have set HP and effective ranges, so build them in places where they can be used to the fullest.

Synopsis

Morin, an archipelago forested world. This land was once covered with lush forests, but the hot winds and beast attacks from far away are taking away people's homes one by one.

The "Ark Dwellers" escaped the winds of destruction and reached an island at the edge, where they built their last hope. The last habitable city of humanity, with its giant beam cannon and towers reaching the sky. It was also a symbol of the determination to resist the fate of destruction.

The grave keeper girl Fio also loses her foster father Ozzy to death on the harsh journey to escape the winds of destruction. However, she is entrusted with one hope.

"If nine flowers bloom on that seedling, one wish will come true."

At the time of parting, a "mysterious seedling" that only Fio can see sprouts from the seed that Ozzy entrusted to her. As she holds the mysterious seedling, Fio remembers Ozzy's last words in her heart. "You will save the world!"

Eventually, Fio, along with the "Florabears," who appear out of nowhere and stay by her side, takes on the mission of being a "guardian" who protects the "Ark Dwellers" from the winds of destruction.

However, Fio has another wish. To regain the days of memories she lost with Ozzy. Should she grant her wish, or do her best to save the people?

As the "life she must protect" and "her wish" intersect, what will Fio ultimately choose? The saga of a girl's growth and determination, woven together with her gigantic beam cannon, begins now!

games.name: Lelu
games.shortDescription: Get your gears in motion for a captivating monochromatic adventure where you play as Lelu, a small but determined clockwork toy who has gained consciousness and found a taste for freedom!
games.aboutText:
Get your gears in motion for a captivating monochromatic adventure where you play as Lelu, a small but determined clockwork toy who has gained consciousness and found a taste for freedom!

Navigate your way through the toy factory, a labyrinthian tower filled with puzzles and traps set by the factory’s eccentric guardian. Use your wits and agility to overcome challenges, from conveyor belts and electrifying circuits to sentient toys and towering titans.

As you delve deeper into the world, uncover hidden abilities to aid you in your quest, alongside a variety of secrets and other toys sharing your desire for freedom.

Will you find your way to the elusive exit, or will you just be another toy on the shelf?

Face off against an army of twisted toys and mechanical monstrosities lurking within the abandoned factory. Each encounter brings its own challenges, demanding quick reactions and a clever use of your abilities to overcome the threats standing in your way.

Unlock and master a range of unique abilities to overcome obstacles, outsmart enemies and uncover new paths. Every new ability opens up possibilities for exploration, helping you push further on your quest for freedom.

Solve puzzles, search every corner, and put your skills to the test to see if you have what it takes to escape this strange and mysterious place.

games.name: Heian City Story
games.shortDescription: A city-building sim with a historical twist
games.aboutText:
Travel back to olden times and become Director of your own city!

Attract new residents and try to become the greatest city in the land! Add buildings like restaurants and teahouses to make your town a place where samurai and commoners alike will want to live.

This is the past, so don't forget to add some touches of traditional culture! Features like temples and gaming halls can give your city a lot of personality, especially when arranged in harmony with the surrounding environment. You might end up attracting tourists to the town, who will move in if they like it enough.

It's not all fun and games in the mists of history. Sometimes ghost, demons, and other baddies will come to attack your city. You'll have to summon your own Guardian Spirits to banish the evil ones and keep your townsfolk safe. Consider your spirits' abilities and placement for the best effects - strategy is the key word!

With a whole host of land expansion options, facilities, and residents to collect and customize, it's never been easier to create a city that will go down in history.

Start building your ancient city today!

▼Game Flow

Build and manage your own city! Grow the population and add new stores to earn money. Add plants and other buildings to increase the value of your land and create the greatest city history has ever known!

▼Increasing Population

New residents will move in when you add new buildings, raise your Land Value, or increase your city's Progress level. Tourists may also recommend your city if they leave satisfied.

▼Facilities

Improve residents' stats, and earn Gold and Research Points using facilities. Once enough people are using a facility, it can be leveled up and remodeled.

▼Facility Combos

Placing facilities with good compatibility near each other can give a street a whole new personality! Combos you've discovered are saved in your Street Index and can be carried over into New Game Plus.

▼Items

Items can be used to upgrade your residents and facilities. Using an item on a facility will affect all facilities of that type.

▼Yearly Rankings

At the end of every in-game year, your city's Culture level will be evaluated and assigned a score. Getting a star rating comes with special bonuses, so do your best to work your way up to five stars!

▼Protecting Your City

Monsters and animals will try to attack your city from time to time. You can drive them away with certain defensive facilities, or by using Guardian Spirits. Defeating enemies may also earn you Research Points.

▼Ending

The game "ends" at the end of Month 3, Year 12. Your money and points will then be saved as your high score, but you can keep playing as long as you like.

--

Try searching for "Kairosoft" to see all of our games!!

Developer Homepages. Feel free to follow me♪

games.name: Backwater Eulogy
games.shortDescription: Musings on grief, moving on, and a life made and lived in the rural Midwest. Features a collection of lovingly hand-drawn panels and pixel art.
games.aboutText:
Backwater Eulogy is a stream of consciousness, autobiographical exploration of loss and the double-sided nature of grief. Told as a linear narrative, there are no choices, and there are no alternate endings. Sit and stay for a moment, before leaving.

Taking the form of a short visual novel, this is a short story of sorts about grief, moving on, and life in the rural Midwest. As a "kinetic novel" there are no alternative routes or choices- just one storyline to follow to its inevitable conclusion. Placing an emphasis on a small, curated experience, it is best experienced in one sitting.

Features:

- 2000+ words (10-15 minute run time)

- 10+ panels of highly rendered, hand-pixeled scenery

- Hand-animated elements

CW: Contains mentions of animal death.

games.name: Tiny Terraces
games.shortDescription: A cozy idle farming game, watch tiny guys do tasks around the terrace, expand, progress, and decorate your Tiny Terrace.
games.aboutText:
Tiny Terraces is an idle-farming game , where you can watch tiny guys do different tasks around the terrace as you work on things outside the game.

Grow Crops:

Plant crops and watch as the tiny guys manage the garden plots by watering, weeding, and harvesting.

Craft Tiny Guys:

Use certain crops and tiny guy parts to craft more tiny guys to help manage the terrace.

Decorate:

Use money produced from crops to buy decorations to detail your terrace.

Wishlist :)

games.name: Steam & Heather
games.shortDescription: A cosy railway management builder set in 19th-century Scotland. Shape the land, lay track, connect industries, and watch towns grow as steam reshapes the Scottish landscape.
games.aboutText:
🚂 Build Railways Across 1850s Scotland

Lay tracks across rolling hills, connect remote villages, and shape the growth of rural Scotland during the dawn of steam.

Steam & Heather is a relaxing railway builder inspired by model railways, Scottish landscapes, and the golden age of steam travel.

🌄 Grow Towns & Communities

Small villages slowly grow into thriving towns as new railway connections bring passengers, goods, and industry.

- Connect isolated settlements

- Deliver passengers and resources

- Watch towns evolve over time

- Expand across the Scottish countryside

🎨 A Living Painterly World

Explore a handcrafted world inspired by classic landscape paintings and miniature railways.

- Dynamic seasons

- Warm painterly visuals

- Atmospheric Scottish weather

- Cozy rural scenery

🚂 The Dawn of Steam Rail

Experience the early days of Scottish rail travel:

- Stone-built stations

- Coal yards and industry

- Early steam locomotives

- Expanding rural rail networks

- Remote Highland communities

games.name: D3AD HAND
games.shortDescription: Satirical point-and-click adventure set during the Cold War in a Soviet bunker. Crack the code, feed Stalin (the cat), save the world. And save it again in the free R3D STAR DLC included in the game.
games.aboutText:
D3AD HAND now includes R3D STAR - a full new bonus and more challenging adventure featuring hours of new content!

Crack the code, feed the cat, save the world.

D3AD HAND is a darkly comedic point-and-click adventure set in a crumbling Cold War missile base deep in Siberia. You are Yuri Spraytyvich , freshly appointed Junior Strategic Missile Force Manager, tasked with holding together the decaying Čerëmuški Command Post.

But when PERIMETER -the Soviet automatic defense system-mistakenly initiates a nuclear launch, it’s up to Yuri (and your wits) to stop the end of the world. Navigate sabotage, radiation, worker strikes, and absurd bureaucracy in a race against doomsday.

R3D STAR: Uncover the fate of Sputnik and thwart the devious plans of Major Perestrova in your continued quest to prevent global annihilation.

◉ Unique alternative history setting and pixel art style.

◉ Tongue-in-cheek humour.

◉ Elegant point 'n' click control of character.

◉ Ideal for newcomers to the genre, familiar and nostalgic for veterans.

◉ Multiple different endings to discover.

◉ Play as Stalin (the cat) in R3D STAR to help Yuri using your feline skills!

games.name: 100 Fantasy Cats
games.shortDescription: 100 Fantasy Cats - Join the cutest adventure in the Fantasy themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of Fantasy places and Cats as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?
games.aboutText:
🐾 WELCOME TO ANOTHER ONE OF 100 CATS SERIES GAME 🐈

Join the cutest adventure in the world full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.
Test your attention and observation skills in this cozy and delightful hidden object game.
Each cat is more charming than the last, and every discovery brings a smile to your face. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

Key Features

- 🎮 1 Level

- 🐈 100 Hidden Cats

- 🎵 Awesome Soundtrack

- 🎨 High Quality Resolution Artworks

- 🌗 Brightness Settings

- 💾 Progress Saves

- 🔍 Zoom

- 😺 Real Meow Sounds!

- 💥 Combo Counter!

- 💡 Tips

- 🌐 No Text

games.name: Financial Freedom
games.shortDescription: Why can't games teach as much as books? I read 50 business books and trainings and made a short funny game about a businessman's journey. Follow the story from a factory worker 🧑🏻‍🏭🏭 to a millionaire! 💸💸
games.aboutText:
Financial Freedom is a linear funny experimental game about the entrepreneur's journey. Follow the challenging path from factory worker to a millionaire.

This experimental and useful game is based on numerous business cases from books and courses by authors such as Robert Kiyosaki, Oskar Hartmann, Ayaz Shabutdinov, George Samuel Clason, Donald Trump, Brian Tracy, and others.

This story-driven platformer is not a retelling of the aforementioned books, but rather my personal interpretation.

In the game, the protagonist attempts to become a successful businessman, buying and selling goods and services, building a business, earning money, and increasing their cash flow. As an entrepreneur, you'll face numerous difficulties and setbacks, starting out as a factory worker and gradually learning financial literacy and increasing your income.

The game also features a house-hopping mechanic similar to Night in the Woods, allowing you to interact with optional characters or find diaries with useful information.

Financial Freedom is a linear and cozy story-driven platformer about the difficult path to success.

games.name: WEBFISHING
games.shortDescription: WEBFISHING a multiplayer chatroom-focused fishing game! Relax and fish (on the web!)
games.aboutText:
WEBFISHING is a multiplayer online casual fishing game where you relax, hang out, make friends, and catch fish!

CATCH THEM ALL!

Nearly 100 different creatures to catch- from the smallest snail to the biggest shark- you can catch it! Complete your journal, find rare fish, get loads of money, and get tons of special rewards!

UPGRADE AND CUSTOMIZE!

Become the ultimate fisherman! Upgrade your gear with new baits, lures, and rods- and collect tons of different cosmetics and props to show off your personality!

PLAY WITH FRIENDS!

WEBFISHING is designed around being social and hanging out with friends and strangers in the camp! Meet new people, find hidden spots, make awful fish puns, and catch fish together!

PLAY WITH TOYS!

Play REAL Guitar! Punch your friends! Draw with chalk! There's many tools and toys to play with in the sandbox of WEBFISHING!

games.name: Abnormal1999:The Compass and the Sand
games.shortDescription: The fate of exile, like an endless river, carries Ann to a distant and unfamiliar land. A flame of unwavering determination burns within Ann's heart. She knows that one day, either Sam or SU will surely find her. Until then, Ann must find a way to escape this place.
games.aboutText:
About the Game

Abnormal 1999: Sand Realm is a suspenseful puzzle-solving game. You will play as "An", who has been exiled by the compass, to uncover the secrets of the exiled land, activate the compass, and escape.

Story Background

The fate of exile is like an endless river, taking An to a distant and unfamiliar place. A flame of unyielding spirit burns in An's heart. She knows that sooner or later, either Sam or SU will find her. Until then, An must first find a way to leave this place.

Game Highlights

- Dynamic Perspective Experience: Freely switch between first-person and third-person perspectives, observe the environment from different angles, and discover hidden clues.

- Intricately Designed Puzzles: Each puzzle is meticulously crafted, testing both logical thinking and keen observation, bringing you pure puzzle-solving pleasure.

- Gripping Story: As you delve deeper into the journey, you will gradually uncover the secrets behind the exile, experiencing an adventure full of suspense and emotional resonance.

- Immersive Atmosphere: Exquisite visuals and sound effects create a mysterious and captivating sand world, making you feel as if you are truly there.

Made by a Solo Indie Developer

Hello everyone, my name is Uncle Q. Welcome to the puzzle game world of QZQ Studio. "The Compass and the Sand" is the sixth installment in the Abnormal 1999 series. I am a passionate solo game developer who has been creating suspenseful puzzle games. My previous works include the "MeiQi" series and the "The Adventures of Lin Shanhai" series. I enjoy what I do, and I am active on social media and in groups. You can find me on Bilibili/Xiaohongshu/Douyin/QQ groups. Feel free to interact with me.

To learn more about Sand Realm and other puzzle games and benefits from QZQ Studio, you can join the QQ group: 190122625

Abnormal 1999 Series

This game, "The Compass and the Sand", is the sixth episode of the first season of the Abnormal 1999 series. The previous five episodes are "With in the Obscurity", "Apartment of Death", "SU - Unlocking the 4th Dimension", "Hyperspace", and "Sector 49". You can enter the Abnormal 1999 series from any episode in this series, and I will provide a fresh experience in each episode.

games.name: Oneiro Man
games.shortDescription: Oneiro is an office worker who is forced to stay up all night writing reports to avoid losing his job. The game combines typing mechanics with various mini-games. It’s a 30-40 minute experience with multiple endings depending on your performance.
games.aboutText:
Oneiro is an office worker who is forced to stay all night drafting reports to avoid being fired from his job. His boss asks him to draft 8 reports and submit them every hour and a half.

Each time Oneiro finishes a report, he will fall asleep and have a dream that he must overcome to avoid getting stuck in the dream world (and completely asleep at work).

What you can find:

- It can last 40 minutes or more, depending on your skill.

- It has 4 endings that depend on the number of mistakes you make.

- It has 3 difficulty levels.

- It has 7 challenges (achievements).

- It has 7 unique minigames.

- Custom music for each minigame.

- It has 3 cinematics.

games.name: Penelope Pendrick and the Art of Deceit
games.shortDescription: Pick up your magnifying glass as writer-turned-detective Penelope Pendrick in this first-person point and click mystery adventure! Three people have suddenly vanished from the sleepy town of Carlisle. Follow the clues, interrogate suspects, and solve puzzles to end this case - before it ends you.
games.aboutText:
A phone call from a small, out of state police force was the last thing writer Penelope Pendrick was expecting that morning. But, it wasn't long after that she was boarding a flight to the quaint old town of Carlisle, Connecticut. When debriefed, Penelope learns her job is to join the search for three missing people; an older man who owns a local bookstore, a mysterious woman who keeps to herself, and a troublemaking teenage boy – the only common link between them being that they disappeared from the same town, within the same week. The Sergeant is stumped.

Once she begins to unravel the case, Penelope realizes that there’s something deeper – stranger – going on here. Unusual ties form between four deceptive suspects, each with something to gain and each with something to lose. Motives and suspicions weave in and out as Penelope uses her wits and penchant for rule-breaking to search for answers; some of which died with an eccentric and mysterious local artist fifty years ago. As the danger escalates, a timer begins to tick down on the lives of the missing. All that Penelope knows for sure is that there’s more to the town of Carlisle than it would appear, and that one wrong move could make this first case her last.

Game Features

- Explore the town of Carlisle

- Interrogate four unique suspects

- Steer the conversation with non-linear dialogue

- Your choices matter - speak wisely!

- Solve unique puzzles inspired by a famous artist

- Don't get caught when you snoop!

- Check every corner with your magnifying glass

- Watch the clock to know who's around and when...

- Use the landline to call friends or order pizza!

- Examine any inventory item for details

- Choose between two difficulty levels

- Read in-game notes and check off your checklist

- Type in answers to questions to progress the game

- Join Penelope on her first official case!

Game Characteristics

- Point & Click Gameplay

- First Person Point of View

- Single Player Game

- Fully Voice-Acted

- Detailed Environments

- Complete Closed Captioning

- Mystery Adventure Genre

NOTE: The game is NOT Steam Deck Verified. Some users with the Deck experience issues with character and cutscene animations, such as blurriness, pixilation, or missing animations.

games.name: Скуф на рыбалке
games.shortDescription: Рыбалка никогда не была скучным занятием и она никогда не была на столько весёлой и иммерсивной! Присоединяйся к рядам настоящих скуфов, лови рыбу и веселись
games.aboutText:
Стань настоящий скуфом и прочувствуй процесс ловли рыбы на полную. В этой игре всё происходит как и на настоящей рыбалке. Алкогольные напитки, комары, радио и жена которая не даёт расслабиться каждые пять минут. А так же можно ловить рыбу!

На радио ты услышишь рыбацкие подкасты, анекдоты и комедийные песни с ненормативной лексикой, а жена будет от души материть тебя на чём свет стоит! А ещё не забудь заглянуть в гости к медведю и поделиться с ним ништяками

games.name: Dragon Spirits 0
games.shortDescription: A skeleton from my childhood, the original edition of Dragon Spirits, which I developed in middle school, is a creature collector RPG that serves as the origin of the Dragon Spirits series. I still keep it as a memento. (Almost) no one can make a good game from the very beginning.
games.aboutText:
Overview

This is a 3 VS 3 creature collector turn-based RPG with dozens of Dragon Spirits to collect.
In battle, every point of damage and healing value will attract "Aggro", causing one of your Dragon Spirit to be focused by the enemy.
You need to arrange the Build reasonably, protect the healer and attacker to win. Plot

Ralph, the main character, is fed up with the dull routine of school and decides to hop on his dad's automatic ship to the paradise - DS Islands.
DS Islands is the site of a prehistoric civilization that was discovered in 20XX and shocked the world.
There, people have no life limit, and use magical "Spells" to command a creature called "Dragon Spirits" and live a peaceful life.
Actually, DS Islands is an area opened up on the Earth by Andes, the creator of our three-dimensional world and the executor of the Big Bang.
Andes created the illusion of dinosaur extinction and teleported them to the DS Islands.
Under the influence of Andes' energy, dinosaurs gradually turned into Dragon Spirits with magical powers.
In order to prevent being discovered by outsiders, Andes created a barrier to protect the DS Islands.
Only people who know that area can enter, otherwise time and space will be warped.
In 20XX, human civilization finally came into contact with the civilization on the DS Islands...

This game is the origin of the Dragon Spirits series. It was completed in 2010 (approximately). The quality isn't worth charging for. I posted it on Steam as a self-reminder. 1. Don't be too obsessed with marketing.

Marketing plays a big role, just as good wine also needs a bush. But numbers are only numbers. I read on a forum that if you focus too much on numbers, they lose their effectiveness as a tool. So, focus on what's important and give it your all. 2. Don't be too obsessed with game quality.

Game quality matters a lot too, good quality shows my responsibility for players. But creators also need to be responsible for themselves. I should create games that can sustain a healthy attitude over time. It's okay to make trash, at worst, release it as a free-to-play.

In 2010, when Shanghai was hosting the World Expo, Pokémon did not have an official Chinese version, and Yu-Gi-Oh cards were printed by ZZ Youth Pavilion.
Everyone's copyright awareness was relatively weak. We gathered in forums and made various games with RPG Maker in our spare time.
Back then, there were not even many platforms to upload games, and we used Drive to ship games. A game had only a little downloads, dozens of downloads for the better ones, and close to a thousand downloads for the most.
I developed this game in such an environment. Almost all the players were classmates. At that time, the series was not even named "Dragon Spirits".
Now it seems that this game is so stupid. I don't know why I thought I did a good job back then. It's not that I haven't played popular games when I was a child, but I just wouldn't compare them with my own works.

In 2024, Dragon Spirits' engine was upgraded to Unity, one of the most used commercial game engines, and the game was indeed played by many people, even made money.

But I lost
That kind of pure Happiness

games.name: Trombone Champ: Unflattened
games.shortDescription: It’s time to step up and fulfill your destiny in Trombone Champ: Unflattened! A rhythm game where every note is yours to command. With more than 58+ unforgettable tracks, an all-new campaign, collectible cards, and wild trombones, you’re not just playing along with the music—you’re creating it! 🔥🎺
games.aboutText:
You are a Tromboner…

It’s finally time to step up and fulfill your destiny in Trombone Champ: Unflattened! A rhythm game where every note, slide and triumphant toot is yours to command. With 58 unforgettable tracks, custom song support, campaign mode, collectible Tromboner Cards, and wild trombones with unique sounds to unlock, you’re not just playing along with the music—you’re creating it!

FIND YOUR GROOVE

Play the trombone your way—every note, every slide, every majestic honk is yours to control. You’re not just keeping up with the rhythm; you are the rhythm.

A ROAD PAVED IN BRASS

Toot your way through an all-new campaign packed with surprises, unlock fresh challenges, and climb the leaderboards on your way to glory.

HOARD OF HORNS

Amass a treasure trove of trombones, each one wilder than the last. With 25+ unique designs and new trombones regularly, there’s always another horn to hunt!

IF YOU PLAY YOUR CARDS RIGHT...

Build your ultimate deck with 50 Tromboner Cards packed with absurd trivia and legendary trombone lore.

Trombone Champ: Unflattened! lets you wield your virtual trombone across over 58 tracks, spanning anthems, marches, classical bangers, and folk classics. Each piece is handcrafted to keep you honking and sliding to your heart’s content, with plenty of surprises and unlockables along the way to keep you coming back for more.

games.name: Roboquest VR
games.shortDescription: The future is in flames, overrun by ruthless machines—but you’re built to fight back. Roboquest VR is a lightning-fast roguelite FPS where speed, firepower, and reflexes are your best weapons. Adapt, survive, and reboot the future!
games.aboutText:
Strap In, Guardian: The Acclaimed Hyper-Speed Roguelite Explodes into VR!

The "Overwhelmingly Positive" rated flatscreen roguelite is here, specially rebuilt for VR, Roboquest VR delivers the fastest, most fluid, and deepest roguelite FPS in VR, period.

TOP FEATURES:

⚡ BLISTERING HYPER-MOBILITY

🔫 INSANE ARSENAL & TACTILE COMBAT

🛠️ DEEP ROGUELITE CUSTOMIZATION

♾️ ENDLESS CHAOS

💥 VIBRANT CEL-SHADED APOCALYPSE

🤝 2-PLAYER "BROBOT" CO-OP

The World is Broken. Time to Reboot It.

Step into the metallic boots of a rebooted Guardian and dive headfirst into a fast-paced, roguelite FPS experience like no other. With intuitive VR controls, you'll feel every shot, every dodge, and every exhilarating moment as you battle hordes of robots. Team up with a brobot and save the world!

Feel the most kinetic combat available in a headset as you sprint, slide, and grind across scorched canyons and futuristic cities.

Total Immersion: Physically weave through bullet hell, dodge incoming plasma fire with your own body, and return the favor with pinpoint precision.

Fluid, High-Octane Action: The movement is buttery-smooth, the combat is explosive, and the action never stops.

Unleash an Insane Arsenal

Your fingertips are the trigger. Every run is a new experiment in devastation.

Visceral Firepower: Feel the kick of high-powered shotguns, physically draw back a high-tension bow, or shred bots up close with razor-sharp melee weapons.

Master Your Tools: Utilize interactive weapon handling and manual reloading to stay in the fight. Mix and match your loadout and turn the robotic legion into molten slag.

The Chaos Never Repeats

Blast through levels that shift and evolve with dynamically generated enemy encounters. The bots adapt, and so must you. Discover hidden secrets, face down colossal bosses, and uncover the mysteries of a long-forgotten civilization.

Are you fast enough, Guardian?

games.name: Hydroponics Farm & Store Simulator
games.shortDescription: Transform your passion into profit with hydroponics! Design, build, and manage your own sustainable farming and business system. Experiment with different plants and fish, customize your setup, supply the market needs, and harvest your success. Dive into the future of farming today!
games.aboutText:
Choose various hydroponics systems with various grow bed styles, including Raft model and PVC pipe model. Customize your setup to suit your specific needs and preferences, ensuring an efficient and productive system. Whether you're aiming for a small-scale home setup or a larger commercial operation, the flexibility in grow bed styles allows you to create a hydroponics system that perfectly fits your goals and space requirements.

Experiment with different species of plants and fish, each offering unique growth rates and profitability. Regularly care for your hydroponics setup to ensure the healthy growth of both plants and fish. By staying vigilant and proactive, you can maintain a thriving hydroponics environment that consistently produces high-quality produce and fish.

When your commodities are ready, harvest and sell them in your store. Develop efficient harvesting techniques to minimize waste and maximize yield. Transport your products to the in-game store, where you control the sales process. Arrange your fresh goods strategically to attract customers.

Step into the role of a cashier, assisting customers as they purchase your carefully harvested goods. Ensure correct pricing and smooth transactions, handle payments, provide change, and keep the line moving with friendly, efficient service.

Whether you're a beginner or an expert, Hydroponics Farm & Store Simulator provides the tools and knowledge to turn your hydroponics dreams into reality. Create a sustainable and profitable venture by nurturing plants and fish, managing your store, and processing groceries.

games.name: Spook-A-Boo
games.shortDescription: Spook-A-Boo is a ghost hunting couch co-op game for 1-4 players. Play with friends and family to seek out and capture ghosts hiding in plain sight. Detect, scan, hook and trap all the troublemaking ghosts and have a spook-tacular time.
games.aboutText:
Welcome Cadets!

Detect, scan, hook and trap ghosts with your fellow hunters and stop them from causing havoc across the galaxy. Travel through wacky worlds and dizzying dimensions to find and capture every ghost.

A spook-tacular 1-4 players couch co-op experience where you detect, scan, hook and trap clever ghosts before they escape. Race against time across 28 levels through four themed worlds and discover why the ghosts are wreaking havoc.

Spook-A-Boo is a fun family adventure with laughter, cooperation and a ghostly good time.

Use Cutting-edge Tech

State of the art devices to seek, locate and capture the trouble making ghosts.

Detector s locate the pesky phantoms.

Scanner s spook the specters into running!

Hook and pull those poltergeists!

Trap the ghosts in their final resting place.

Encounter a Diverse Variety of Ghosts

Normie, Doughy and Zappy aren't the only ghosts in the galaxy! They come in various shapes, sizes and with wicked powers. Make sure you're capturing them and not the other way around!

Overcome Obstacles Together

Work with - and against! - your teammates to trap every ghost you run into across the four unique worlds you play through.

Please note that additional controllers would be required to play this game in local multiplayer mode.

games.name: Baba Yaga
games.shortDescription: A turn-based roguelike game of strategic combat and sinister magic. Decimate the king’s loyalist forces, grow your powers, and discover the reimagined origin story of Baba Yaga, the most feared witch of Slavic folklore!
games.aboutText:
In this turn-based strategy roguelike, you’ll face hordes of loyalist forces who are after your head! Play as Baba Yaga, the enigmatic witch from Slavic folklore, and uncover her reimagined origin story within a dark medieval fantasy setting.

- Each turn, your enemies draw nearer… Plan your moves carefully, and eliminate each wave to progress through the game.

- Choose from a wide variety of spells to expand your dark magic arsenal. Will you cripple your foe? Bolster yourself? Rain down destruction? No two spells are the same!

- Draw power from three separate mana pools of Hatred, Sorrow, and Spite - use your resources efficiently.

- Seek synergies, exploit weaknesses, and unleash raw diabolical power!

- Each run is unique and procedurally generated. It takes up to 30 minutes to complete a run, so you can experiment freely and learn faster.

- Learn from your mistakes, master the game mechanics, and explore new choices every time.

- Each potential encounter has different enemy types and rewards: spells, mana upgrades, or powerful perks. Choose your path wisely!

- You will be offered a changing set of spells and perks in every run. Test new builds, and remake the witch you wish to be.

- Ascend through higher difficulty modes that provide novel challenges, even for seasoned players!

- Delve into an emotional story that takes you to the seven circles of hell itself.

- See through the eyes of a villain in an age of strife and chaos.

- Rediscover Baba Yaga: originating from Slavic folklore, she is often depicted as an old witch. This is her reimagined origin story, set in the days of her youth - a tale of love lost, demonic deals, and furious vengeance.

games.name: HSS:Reload
games.shortDescription: This is a very fast God's perspective roguelike shooter, the player will pilot the mech, explore the alien frontier, enjoy the "Crimsonland + Vampire Survivors (Vampire Survivors)" endless killing!
games.aboutText:
Unlock the true potential of your mech and witness its constant growth and upgrades! In deserts, ice and even satellites, kill thousands of swarms to strengthen your mech!
At the end of each battle you will gain valuable resources to upgrade your mech's weapons and armor, unlocking new skills and powerful equipment.
Through battles, you'll gain the bonds of your mech's pilots, forming modules in different directions to shape your unique fighting style.
Grow and upgrade your mech in real time to make it more and more invincible and become the ultimate weapon against the swarm!

Monsters are coming at you like wave after wave, and as your mech's guns move, the monsters explode into a fog of blood and fall in pieces, painting the earth in scarlet. Operate your mech to dodge attacks, kill through the siege, and find a way to survive among hundreds of enemies!

Explore your own powerful combat combo by unlocking more and more powerful weapons and skills! Become stronger by killing and choosing, picking up resources, choosing the most suitable enhancements, and finally killing the terrifying bosses head-on!

offers a rich arsenal of multiple primary and secondary weapons, as well as numerous skills with unique features. These weapons and skills will provide endless possibilities for your battles. In the future, there will be even more powerful mechs waiting to be harnessed by you!

The game already offers 3 challenging maps, each with unique enemy combinations and powerful bosses waiting to be challenged for a completely different leveling experience. As the game continues to update, you will meet more new maps and new modes of play to make your Meat Pigeon adventure even more colorful.

games.name: Six-Ear Macaque: Awakening
games.shortDescription: Six- Ear Macaque: Awakening is a casual role-playing game based on the Chinese classic novel Journey to the West. The protagonist is one of the Six- Ear Macaque, is one of the "mixed four monkeys", ability and Sun Wukong equal. In the game, you will explore the legendary path of your destiny.
games.aboutText:
Six-Eared Macaque: Awakening is a casual role-playing game inspired by the Chinese classic Journey to the West . The protagonist, the Six-Eared Macaque, is one of the "Four Mixed Monkeys" whose powers rival those of Sun Wukong. In the game, you'll embark on a legendary journey to explore your destined path.

Core Gameplay Features

Boundless Supernatural System

Master different Five Elements spells , movement techniques, and staff styles, with combo moves offering deep strategic depth.

Attribute Equipment Matching

Combine equipment with diverse attributes to enhance the character's base stats. Equipment can also be upgraded at the NPC Refining Workshop.

Secret Realm Exploration Challenges

- Raging Fire Dungeon of Inferno

- Mistmire
Venture into mysterious realms where opportunities and dangers coexist. As the saying goes, "One flower, one world; one tree, one floating life" — welcome to the mythical world of Journey to the West where reality and illusion intertwine!

Story & Combat Highlights

The Six-Eared Macaque will travel through secret realms of varied styles to pursue their fated legend. Encounter demons and ghosts, each with unique abilities, from powerful foes to fearsome rivals. Witness how the Six-Eared Macaque:

- Battles heaven and earth, breaking through challenges with unique supernatural powers, movement techniques, and staff styles;

- Utilizes the Five Elements equipment system and refining enhancement system to slay demon lords as quests progress, treading the path of destiny.

games.name: Ravenous
games.shortDescription: Spin the world to control the horde, compress enemy remains into the ultimate "Scrap Bomb," and smash it down on their heads! Experience the new-sensation rolling action of Ravenous!
games.aboutText:
Ravenous is a new-sensation rolling survival action game where you take control of the crow Enlil to fight off endless swarms of robots.

◆ The World-Turning "Rotation System"

Harness Enlil's power to "rotate" the world and manipulate gravity at will. Spin the terrain to adapt to the tide of battle and control the enemy hordes.

◆ World-Flipping "Scrap Bombs"

Combine the "Scrap" dropped by defeated enemies to grow it into a massive weapon!

Even when cornered, you can flip the world to drop an ultra-dense, gigantic Scrap Bomb directly onto your enemies' heads for a thrilling, table-turning strike.

◆ Tactical Shifts via "Styles" and "Scarves"

Your playstyle changes drastically based on your combination of a "Style" (determining starting gear and traits) and a "Scarf" (providing passive effects). Discover the perfect custom loadout to match the stage and your preferences.

◆ The "Upgrade System" of Infinite Possibilities

Leverage a diverse array of upgrade cards to craft the ultimate build. Special weapon evolutions triggered at specific levels will forge unexpected and devastating synergies.

◆ Death as Fuel: The "Permanent Upgrade System"

Survive grueling battles and use the rewards you bring back to unlock permanent power. Repeat the cycle of upgrading and challenging to crush the Elite Enemies standing in your way at the abyss!

games.name: Space Cycle
games.shortDescription: Space resources are the battleground for warring factions. As a Space Defense Officer, protect your faction's assets in a vast, hostile universe. Allocate resources, upgrade defenses, and repel relentless enemy attacks! With over 50 unique units and deep strategy, experience real-time tower defense!
games.aboutText:
Games taking too long? Strategies too complex? Not here! Build your unique defense base in real-time with simple yet strategic space defense facilities!

Repel the enemy, keep our energy cycle running!

In Space Cycle, every choice matters. Pick and upgrade your defenses wisely!

Let luck and strategy lead you to victory!

games.name: Schedule I
games.shortDescription: From small-time dope pusher to kingpin - manufacture and distribute a range of drugs throughout the grungy city of Hyland Point. Expand your empire with properties, businesses, employees and more.
games.aboutText:
Schedule I drugs, substances, or chemicals are defined as drugs with no currently accepted medical use and a high potential for abuse.

- The Drug Enforcement Administration

You're a small-time drug dealer rolling into a fresh town with no cash, no product and no connections. Build your drug empire from the ground up in the grungy west-coast city of Hyland Point. Contend against intensifying law enforcement and deadly cartel competitors to expand your empire and reach the peak of the underworld.

Produce a range of drugs to satisfy your customers, each one with it's own unique production process. Discover special recipes to create new drug variants with special properties.

Walk, skate or drive throughout Hyland Point to get product into the hands of customers. Hire dealers to handle distribution for you.

Purchase new properties and hire employees to expand the scope and scale of your operations. Work with suppliers to build a fully automated production and distribution chain.

This is a dangerous line of work - you'll have to contend with increasing law enforcement , as well as deadly cartel competitors. Fight with fists, melee weapons or firearms .

A growing empire needs skilled management. Reach new heights in co-op multiplayer .

games.name: Grime&Gold
games.shortDescription: Fancy some cards, alchemist? Grime & Gold is a small game about stacking and mixing cards to craft strange recipes. Open boosters, delve into dungeons to find rare resources, hire goblins to help you to craft the Holy Grail and save the city, and don't forget to serve your shady clients!
games.aboutText:
Grime and Gold is a small game where you play as a street alchemist, crafting potions by stacking and mixing cards . Your goal is to discover new recipes, manage scarce resources, and race against time to serve demanding clients. The game blends strategy and time management in a gritty, tense atmosphere, where every decision could lead to success or disaster.

Grime&Gold is

- an intense stacking game focused on management and survival.

- a 1-2 hour experience.

- featuring 96 unique cards with 9 different boosters type and 25 recipes to discover.

What Grime&Gold is NOT

- Not a deckbuilder.

- Not a roguelike.

Discover many cards and recipes

Want some ingredients for your potions ? Manage your ressources and go to dungeons to find rare ones. If you manage well, you'll complete quests and get rewarded ! If you don't, be prepared. By progressing toward the holy grail, you'll discover more recipes, and more places to learn from... or to die from.

Make potions and serve clients

A good alchemist should always thrive in discovering new weird brews. Use your ingredients in the right way with your trusty cauldron to make potions and whatever the clients need, because in here, the client is king, and a bloody one... You can also hire gobelins to work for you and keep yourself safe from those clients.

Find new recipes

Open your grimoire and find how to make everything that the clients need, and maybe find new potions to make ! You can also check some hints and scribbles that Calis put there just in case... and collect all the cards !

games.name: Grumpy Gaffer
games.shortDescription: Join Mr. Gaffer on his mission to protect the peace of his home in this dynamic strategy game. Test your wits and reflexes as you face intense waves of enemies, and compete in thrilling mini-games against other players.
games.aboutText:
After a long and laborious life, Mr. Gaffer just wants to spend his days playing sudoku, far away from anything that bothers him. But his peace is constantly interrupted by his annoying neighbors, so he'll have to face one last battle.

It's time to clone, mutate, and scare them all away!

Help Mr. Gaffer defend the peace of his home in this strategy game where your knowledge and agility will be necessary to face frantic waves of annoying invaders.

Features:

- Gameplay: Very simple mechanics of drag, drop, and tap.

- Characters: 20 characters with unique abilities.

- Power-ups: Around 20 different power-ups to help you progress through the levels.

- Stages: 3 completely different stages with unique features, for a total of 90 levels!

- Endless Mode: In this mode, you can play dynamically generated levels. How far will you go?

- Nightmare Mode: Ultra-challenging levels where your skills will be tested to the max.

- Smash Storm: A dynamic and fun minigame where you can directly smash the invaders.

- Sudoku: To keep Mr. Gaffer happy, we’ve included a fully functional sudoku game where you can customize the difficulty and earn extra rewards.

- Coliseum: Want to prove you're the best? Compete weekly to reach the highest score and get rewards!

- Gallery: A complete catalog where you can get to know each of the characters and power-ups in-depth, which will assist you in battle.

And this is just the beginning. Stay tuned for future updates where you’ll be able to meet more characters, explore new scenarios, and enjoy new game modes.

games.name: Dragons Invade Scotland
games.shortDescription: Match-3 Tower Defense. Defend real Scottish castles from waves of dragons. Real Scottish stories and legends. Includes a full map of Scotland to scale where 1 tile is 19.5 meters.
games.aboutText:
Match-3 meets Tower Defense! Your matches become towers. Defend each real castle in Scotland! Learn about real Scottish castles/stories/legends while playing. The game takes place on full map of Scotland made of 5 million tiles, where each tile is 19.5 square meters of the real world.

From the creator of Tower Swap. This game isn't released yet, so here's some reviews of Tower Swap:

"It's a perfect blend between the match-3, merge, and tower defense genre, so if you like any of those genres and you want to venture forth with a twist this is a perfect game with a great gameplay loop and great mechanics. It's super addicting... I enjoyed my time with Tower Swap so much that I lost track of time and got a super long gameplay recording." - MintCity Review

"This is a hidden gem and belongs in the best-of list of indie match 3 mobile games alongside Triple Town, 10000000, and Puzzle Craft." - Loren Hernandez

"Never have I ever played a game for such a long time continuously as this game. It's so simple and sooo good. 10/10 would recommend everyone ever. My grandma would love this game and my grandchildren would someday still love this game. ok I'm done. But seriously, play it."

"One of the most well-designed games I've ever played! Game is easy for beginners to play but it takes quite a bit of skill to attain higher levels, as success requires using both match-3 and tower defense strategies."

100s of castles are planned with real folklore from each:

Did you know that there was a castle ruled by a Viking princess, and it was on an island, and she put up a chain reaching to the mainland to stop ships?

Did you know that there was a castle that was said to have been built by a wizard using an army of goblins?

Did you know that there's a fairy flag that still exists today in Dunvegan castle, and it is said that it can only be used 3 times, and it has already been used twice in medieval times to summon fairies to their defense?

All of these and hundreds more are planned to be added to the game.

About Pricing

Note that the game is priced low because it contains IAPs. If you don't want to pay you can play for free on the web but with banner ads, coming soon. You are essentially paying to remove the banner ads, and to be able to load up the game without internet, and to make sure your progress doesn't get cleared from your browser's storage. The Steam version doesn't have any banner ads. There will also be mobile versions with the same structure.

games.name: Escape From Duckov
games.shortDescription: Escape from Duckov is a PVE indie survival RPG — in a duck's world!. Scavenge for resources, build your hideout, and upgrade your gear in the world of Duckov. Start from nothing and rise to the top. Outwit hostile ducks, survive, or make it out alive.
games.aboutText:
You wake from a strange dream to find yourself in the world of Duckov.

Beyond the safety of your base, enemies lurk in every corner. In this seemingly peaceful yet perilous world, you must tread carefully, exploring and scavenging for supplies.

Start your journey as an Average Duck—ordinary stats, one basic gun. Gather all sorts of curious items, build your hideout, upgrade your gear, and struggle to survive in the world of Duckov—until you make it out alive.

Vast Maps, Random Adventures

Across five unique maps, ever-changing loot, elusive enemies, and shifting weather ensure no two expeditions are the same. Every raid is a surprise, offering a unique experience each time.

But don't forget to extract in time, or you might lose everything...

Scavenge and Thrive

Scour the maps for valuables—meds, gear, rare collectibles. You never know what you'll uncover! Bring them back, sell for profit, and use your earnings to upgrade your Base and grow stronger.

Think it's all junk at first glance? With the right touch at your workbench, scrap can become treasure.

Mod Your Weapons, Fight Your Way

Choose from over 50 weapons, ranging from top-tier firearms to a common wooden stick. Go loud in close combat, pick off enemies from a distance, challenge them head-on, or set up an ambush. And with an extensive mod system, you can build your ultimate weapon.

Dominate the battlefield your way. Go quackers!

Gear Up, Power Up

Start with nothing? No worries. Collect blueprints scattered across the maps to craft stronger weapons and gear. Diversify your abilities through expansive skill trees, upgrading your ranged, melee, and character attributes, and unlocking your true potential.

Each day makes you stronger than the last!

Complete Quests, Uncover the Truth

With 50+ hours of content for a single playthrough, you'll chat with various NPCs and complete quests to gather clues. Piece them together to unravel the truth of Duckov. To be or not to be? Perhaps a third answer awaits.

Whatever path you choose, proceed with caution. Good luck, and watch your tail.

Mods & Steam Workshop

With the Steam Workshop, you can shape Duckov in countless new ways. Add weapons, craft custom maps, design fresh quests, and more. Mods keep Duckov fresh, surprising, and full of life.

But there's even more waiting for you in Duckov!

Dive deep into the game to discover all sorts of hidden easter eggs!

(Alright, no more spoilers! We'll let you discover the rest!)

So gear up, venture into the last refuge for ducks, and uncover the truth of Duckov!

games.name: True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part 3
games.shortDescription: True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part 3 is the final chapter of the psychological thriller trilogy. With point-and-click mechanics, intricate puzzles, and cinematic cutscenes, immerse yourself in a dark horror experience that redefines the genre.
games.aboutText:
True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part 3 is the long-awaited conclusion to one of the most acclaimed psychological horror mystery trilogies. Building on the tension, atmosphere, and emotional storytelling of the first two games, Part 3 delivers the final chapter of Holly Stonehouse’s journey - a dark and unsettling investigation where every answer raises new questions until the truth can no longer be avoided.

Crafted with a stronger narrative focus, deeper world-building, and more complex emotional stakes, Part 3 closes the story that has captivated millions of Players. As Holly follows the last threads of her family’s past, she finds herself drawn deeper into a mystery where memory, trauma, and reality cross. The final search brings the trilogy to its darkest, most revealing point - a place where the line between psychological and supernatural horror becomes razor thin.

True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part 3 is a single point-and-click adventure in the tradition of the True Fear series, designed for players who enjoy atmospheric horror, investigation, and puzzle-driven storytelling.

After uncovering the secrets of her childhood home and surviving the horrors of Dark Falls Asylum, Holly’s search leads her beyond the familiar locations of the past and into the final layers of the mystery surrounding her family. Letters, photographs, reports, and long-hidden evidence piece together a story that Holly has spent her entire life trying to understand - but this time the danger is more real, immediate, and personal.

Players will explore a large variety of environments, reconstruct timelines, interpret conflicting pieces of information, and unlock intricate chains of puzzles designed to mirror Holly’s descent into the truth. True Fear’s signature balance of cinematic storytelling, psychological tension, and nonlinear clue-hunting returns with more depth and detail than ever before.

Part 3 offers a significantly longer, richer, and more intricate adventure, designed to answer the questions that have been haunting players since the very beginning.

KEY FEATURES:

- 119 locations, 237 close-up scenes, and 29 in-engine cutscenes.

- The chilling conclusion to the True Fear trilogy.

- A dark, emotional story filled with twists, revelations, and long-buried secrets.

- An incredible music score tailored to each scene.

- 72 smart puzzles, deeper exploration, and an ever-present sense of dread.

- Bonus content includes wallpapers, figurines, and much more, along with an incredibly engaging behind-the-scenes section that is sure to capture the interest of anyone who loves this trilogy.

games.name: Never Second in Rome
games.shortDescription: Never Second in Rome is a turn-based historical game with RPG and management elements. You are a Roman centurion in the army of Julius Caesar. You will control both your character and the unit under his command.
games.aboutText:
Never Second in Rome is a turn-based historical game with RPG and management elements. You take the role of a Roman centurion in the army of Julius Caesar.

In a Republic dominating the Mediterranean World and yet shaken by internal strife, still traumatized by the horrors of the civil war that marked the previous generation, the arrival of a new governor in your province will initiate a succession of events that will ultimately define the future of Rome and its empire.

Starting right before the beginning of the Gallic War, you will assume command of a century in a newly raised legion.

Key features

- In addition to the main character, you will control the small army unit in your charge, your century.

- Train yourself and your century, appoint your staff and discover the most remarkable individuals at your service.

- Fight and lead your legionaries in real historical battles relying on a complex system of intertwined stats.

- Turn-based individual combat involving not only your main character, but also the soldiers under your command.

- Text-based events and narrative sections with many Attribute and Skill checks.

- Great care and attention to historical detail and accuracy.

Free demo available

You can download and play the free demo directly on Steam. It allows you to explore the first three chapters of the game at your own pace. I recommend trying it before you buy, it's the best way to find out whether this game is up your alley.

games.name: Factories in Factories in Factories
games.shortDescription: Build a fractal world. Automate the automation of your automation. Put Factories in Factories in Factories.
games.aboutText:
Factories in Factories in Factories is a game where you build Factories in Factories in Factories.

- Mine resources and craft components

- Built belts, miners, splitters and chests to automate mining

- Unlock all building types

- Mine infinitely zooming fractal trees

- Construct Factories to automate the production of Factory-components

- Copy Factories into Factories to automate the production of Factories in Factories

games.name: Haneda Girl
games.shortDescription: Haneda Girl is an action-platformer game with brutal and frantic action. Clean stages swapping between two playable characters. Bullets or Slashes, your choice, but be creative. A wide variety of ways to solve each encounter are at your disposal. Dance the waltz of destruction, end the threat.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Data Empira Pilot Haneda!

ALARM! Data Empire is being invaded by the Hackernauts!

Help Chichi Wakaba (pilot Haneda Girl) to save Data Empire from the frightening (and intense) Hackernauts. Dive into this adventure with an exquisite game feel along with M.O.T.H.E.R., Haneda Girl’s combat tactic mecha. Slashes or bullets, control both characters and play in a creative and frenetic way. Tight controls, an addictive loop and the best techno music you’ll hear this season. Are you in?

Haneda Girl is a stylish 2D action (precise) platformer. Swap between characters and clean up the menace in the faster, smarter and most efficient way. Each encounter can be solved in very different manners. Be creative! From speed runners to casual players, this game is designed for EVERYONE!

"Learn from your mistakes"

Replayibility is the essence of the experience, but don´t worry! An exciting game feel, short rounds and tight controls will make you enjoy every pixel of this addictive and challenging game.

"The challenge is not the path itself but how you make your way through it”

Slashes or bullets, play safe with M.O.T.H.E.R or fast and dangerous with Haneda (Insta-kill). But remember:

“You can go faster alone but further together”

Instructions:

I am fearful and conservative = use M.O.T.H.E.R

Some days I get the nerve = Swap between M.O.T.H.E.R and Haneda

I am very forward = Haneda Girl (no doubts)

Get better rank

Also collect medallions with additional LORE to dig into the game storys and collects items to unblock NEW ballistic weapons designed for the mecha M.O.T.H.E.R

New weapons = tactic advantages

Also collect medallions with additional LORE to dig into the game story

History

Chichi Wakaba is the best player of Haneda Girl, an arcade machine located at Mr Hinata’s coffee shop. When she comes back home from school, and if she hasn’t got many homeworks, she uses to stop at the coffee shop and save Data Empire again and again. She is so good that professor Nakamura, the creator of the game, chooses her to travel into the game and make her an authentic Haneda Girl pilot. Along with the tactic combat mecha M.O.T.H.E.R. they are the scourge of the Hackernauts, the worst known threat to Data Empire. Would you like to help them, erase once and for all these annoying invaders and ensure a longlasting peace in Data Empire? We wait for you!

¡Enroll and fight the devil after school!

An easy and cute story along with a powerful techno soundtrack complete the Haneda Girl experience. Intense game play sessions full of dopamine secretions guaranteed.
