"In a world made of cortisol, try to be the dopamine"

Key features:

"Move like in CELESTE

Destroy like in BRO FORCE

Slash like in KATANA ZERO

And die like in HOTLINE MIAMI"

Are you in?

games.name: Cat Me If You Can
games.shortDescription: Cat Me If You Can is a charming and cozy game where you explore beautifully handcrafted black-and-white worlds, searching for hidden cats to photograph and bring their colours back into the world.
games.aboutText:
Cat Me If You Can takes you into black-and-white comic style 3D worlds filled with countless feline friends and charming secrets to discover and get lost in.

Immerse yourself in cozy, handcrafted worlds teeming with charm. Seek out hidden cats and capture their adorable moments with your camera.
Stay sharp - only the keenest observers can uncover the most cleverly concealed fluffballs!

Not every cat is easy to spot! Some are hiding behind riddles, locked doors, or curious contraptions just waiting to be figured out.

Solve clever puzzles, decode clues, and uncover hidden pathways to reveal even more elusive feline friends. Every puzzle you crack brings you one paw closer to completing your collection!

Unwind as you take a peaceful journey through atmospheric locations filled with charm and mystery, and, of course, cats. From the sun-soaked sands of Ancient Egypt to the intimate streets of modern Japan, and the quiet corners of majestic medieval castles, each destination invites you to slow down, look closer, and discover every hidden furball.

Packed with content:

9 handcrafted levels spread across 3 uniquely themed worlds.

Over 725 cats to find, photograph and love.

More than 50 quests and puzzles to solve.

Levels full of detail:

Each scene is inspired by real-world cultures, with unique details waiting to be discovered in every corner.

A world of their own:

Ever wanted to see cats working medieval jobs?
Or cats reimagined as creatures from Japanese folklore?
Now you can, in Cat Me If You Can!

games.name: ニコニコさん | Niconico-san
games.shortDescription: "Niconico-san" is a first-person, fast-paced horror game set in a Japanese residential area. Players must escape from the smiling man of urban legend, "Niconico-san," and find their way out of a terrifying otherworld.
games.aboutText:
"Niconico-san" is a first-person, fast-paced horror game set in a Japanese residential area. Your goal is to escape from the terrifying otherworld, evading the smiling man of urban legend, "Niconico-san." Story

A creepy rumor has been spreading around school recently.
“There’s a smiling man who beckons you over at a warehouse down a certain alley.”
Those who see him are drawn to the warehouse and go missing.

One day, you find yourself needing to take that very alley on your way home.
As you approach the warehouse, the door suddenly swings open, and a hand reaches out. The moment it pulls you in, you lose consciousness. When you wake up, you find yourself in a terrifying otherworld…

Trapped in this otherworld, you must find the items necessary to escape and return to the real world.
Can you find a way out of this horrifying place? Gameplay

This game is an "action-adventure."
Players explore a hidden otherworld within a Japanese residential area from a first-person perspective, searching for essential items to escape while evading the smiling man, "Niconico-san," from the urban legend.

Number of Endings: 2

Estimated Playtime: About 30 minutes, depending on your play style. Controls

Move: WASD
Look: Mouse
Action: E
Options: ESC
Use Drink: SPACE About Streaming and Let's Play Videos

They are very welcome! No prior contact is needed.
We would appreciate it if you could include a link to the store page in the description.

games.name: Sips and Sonnets
games.shortDescription: Run a tea shop in the British countryside in this heartfelt visual novel voiced by Bethan Dixon Bate (Baldur's Gate 3) and Lenval Brown (Disco Elysium). Play as Ms Meadows as she prepares for her best friend’s long-awaited visit. Brew tea, listen to customers’ stories, and craft poems.
games.aboutText:
Story

In a quiet English town, Ms. Meadows runs a cozy tea boutique. Once an accomplished journalist, she used her modest savings to open the shop. With no family and a few customers, Ms. Meadows fills her days listening to the stories of those willing to share. Each night, inspired by her encounters at the tea shop, Ms. Meadows writes her latest poem, after the nurse arrives to administer her medication.

Sips and Sonnets lets you:

- Be a nice old lady. The "nice" part is not optional.

- Make a variety of teas. Learn more about each kind of tea as you play!

- Chat up customers from all walks of life.

- Draw inspiration from your daily interactions with your clientele to write your latest poem!

- Your choices matter! Choose wisely and see all multiple endings!

What to Expect:

- Fully voiced acted with talents from Baldur's Gate 3 ( Bethan Dixon Bate ) and Disco Elysium ( Lenval Brown ).

- About 2-4 hours of gameplay.

- Multiple endings.

- Several minigames.

- Original soundtrack.

Inspired by our personal experiences with local tea shops across the United Kingdom, as well as countless wholesome interactions with kind and wise role models in our lives, this heartfelt visual novel tells a side less told, of a life well lived, and a youth come and gone.

Sips and Sonnets is brought to you by Blue Tango Street, the same team that gave you the brief and humble experience of Backspace Backspace Backspace. This visual novel was made possible thanks to collaborating with a group of talented artists!

games.name: PUMPKIN PANIC
games.shortDescription: COME TO THIS COZY FARM! Plant crops, take care of the plants, go fishing, or whatever you prefer, but have a good time! But be carefull, they say that strange things are happening in the area...
games.aboutText:
Enjoy life on your small farm

You have a lot of work to do. Plant, water, and harvest. This cozy and peaceful farm nestled in the heart of the forest has much to offer.

Relax with some fishing

Need a break? Fishing is just what you need! It's also a great way to earn some extra money.

Beware of the darkness

Perhaps things weren’t as pleasant as they seemed, it's become a bit eerie.
Will you manage to survive? It won't be easy.

games.name: Bioweaver
games.shortDescription: Bioweaver is an RPG game with the main content of treasure hunting and character building. You can use basic programming logic to deeply customize your skill sets, and you can also create organs with different attributes and functions with the special crafting system.
games.aboutText:
In a mysterious underground laboratory, dangerous creatures have escaped. The road to the surface is blocked by many obstacles, but top scientists never complain about the environment. The organs and genes of unknown creatures can be your power. Make good use of them and create yourself a path of flesh and blood.

Use simple programming logic to build organ links. The skill building process is highly visualized and can be easily debugged.

The game includes hundreds of organs with different functions. Each organ can also be mutated to obtain additional affixes which can further generate more unpredictable changes.

The difficulty of the game can be automatically adjusted to the progress of the game. After completing the main acts, there are still more difficult challenges, more modes and content to explore.

games.name: Mall Simulator
games.shortDescription: Turn your building from a small shopping center into a huge city mall! To avoid going bankrupt, you’ll need to build new stores and restaurants, set smart prices, and keep up with trends. 15+ stores, dozens of machines & services, and hundreds of brands waiting for you!
games.aboutText:
Mall Simulator is a chill first-person simulation where you will experience a giant mall tycoon with various stores that you run yourself:

👕 Clothing ⚽ Sports 💻 Tech 🧸 Toys 🛒 Supermarket 💄 Cosmetics
🎬 Cinema 🍔 Burger Shop 🕹️ Arcade 🏠 Home Goods 🎮 Game Store
🥐 Bakery 💍 Jewelry 🌸 Florist 🍣 Sushi Bar 🥤 Vending Machines 💵 ATMs

…and so much more to explore in your mega mall!

Design matters! Create the best design for your mall and manage your stores. Showcase your best-seller stores and create the perfect mall for your customers.

Zero to hero! Open new stores of the most famous brands and sell their products in your mall. Expand your stores in the mall from a grocery to a jewellery.

Out of stock? Always supply new products and follow new trends to keep your customers in your mall.

Time is money! Your mall may be busy, take payments and hire new workers so you don't keep your customers waiting.

Smash the walls! Open up new spaces and make room for more stores and brands in your mall.

In Mall Simulator, customer satisfaction is neccesary. You have to keep up with trends, build new stores, set smart prices and grow your mall to avoid going bankrupt.

games.name: A la Card
games.shortDescription: Buckle up for a food truck deckbuilder boiling over with card mutation mischief, questionable recipes, and limitless synergies.
games.aboutText:
A la Card is a food truck deckbuilding roguelike where you'll mix and match the best aspects of every card you find to create absurd synergies and make new discoveries every time you play!

Stick the effect of one food onto another . Change what triggers that effect in the first place. Swap stats, inherit flavours, and cook up clever combinations no one else will .

Every run is an ebb and flow of cramming as many calories as possible into the window before hittin' the road to slap together the most powerful cards you can conceive of. These people want food? Oh you'll give them food.

But it won't be enough to just make a really big burger. Zany bosses bring self-contained puzzles to navigate, testing your deck's flexibility. They'll slip you a card and refuse to leave until you serve it to them or clog the window with half-eaten scrap. You'd better be able to improvise .

Served with a garnish of tasty tunes made to order by Josh Whelchel.

Features:

- Sequence your cards to make the most of their effects. Skilled players are rewarded for clever plays.

- Combine the calories of your ingredients using powerful recipes , creating space to serve even more food!

- Random special events provide opportunities to change each and every detail of your cards: the colours, calories, effects, how you trigger those effects, and more!

- Each starting deck has a unique and powerful trinket that deeply impacts how it plays, and you'll find more trinkets to mix and match throughout your runs.

- Presiding over each location is a memorable boss with a unique ability . When big numbers aren't enough, you'll have to get creative!

- Win runs to unlock more starting decks, trinkets, and release even more cards into the pool for future runs.

- Revisit your favourite decks to take on special challenges and earn coveted stars!

With hundreds of cards and dozens upon dozens of mid-game events and upgrades, no two runs are ever the same.

games.name: Skyline Urban Story
games.shortDescription: From barren land to towering metropolis, every decision you make shapes the destiny of your city. Industrial flow, global trade, surging land values, and growing wealth, offers deep management gameplay, perfect for players who love strategic city-building and economic simulation.
games.aboutText:
*Skyline Urban Story* is a city-building simulation game centered on macro-level planning. There’s no traditional “build roads, then place buildings” process—this is a true city management experience. As the mayor overseeing everything, the lifeblood of every industry, citizen, and economy flows under your command.

💠 Master Planning, Beyond the Ordinary

Say goodbye to old-school road-based layouts. On a grid-based map, you can freely design the entire city—from overall structure to industrial distribution—all under your control.

🏙 A Real Economy Driven by Demand Chains

Jobs bring people, people bring consumption, and consumption drives industry. As education improves, office demand rises, industries evolve, and tax revenue grows—all naturally following the laws of economics.

🏭 From Farmland to High-Tech Industries

Food, iron ore, chips, automobiles—every industry produces tangible resources. Supply and demand determine trade flow: surplus leads to exports, shortages to imports. Your city’s economy becomes a finely tuned machine.

📈 Sign Trade Contracts, Build an Export Powerhouse

Carefully choose what to export and import to maximize profit. With limited contract slots, every deal matters—each signature could shape your city’s destiny.

💰 The Pulse of Land Value and Wealth

High-value downtown districts attract wealthy residents and premium jobs, while the outskirts nurture everyday life. Manage land values wisely to watch skyscrapers rise and witness the evolution of your city’s social fabric.

📊 GDP and Global Competition

Every tile contributes to your city’s GDP. Will you become an industrial powerhouse or a financial hub? The data will tell the story. Climb the global leaderboard and compete with mayors around the world!

🏘 Zoning System: Give Your City a Soul

From agricultural zones to creative districts, from shopping streets to towering CBDs—each zone type brings unique benefits and aesthetics, shaping your city’s identity and purpose.

🔬 Research and Civic Progress

Taxes aren’t just income—they’re fuel for innovation. Invest in research to unlock new technologies and push your city into higher stages of civilization.

⭐ Mayor Rating & Citizen Satisfaction

Your decisions will be judged by your citizens. Manage the city well, and they’ll reward you with prosperity. Fail them, and even taxes may stop coming in.

👔 Officer Assistant System

As your city grows, hire officers to help with administration. Let them handle the details while you focus on the big picture.

🕰 Time Machine Review System

From your first cottage to a skyline of skyscrapers, from a humble village to a megacity—relive your city’s entire journey and the pride of building a world with your own hands.

This isn’t just another city-builder about stacking and decorating—it’s a living experiment in economy, strategy, and humanity .

When you gaze upon your shining skyline, remember—every breath this city takes begins with your decision.

games.name: Wish Of Hers
games.shortDescription: Fall asleep with up to three friends and fight through a dream world of islands. Combine abilities, aspects and perks into absurd builds, crush nightmares and take on Captain Flint.
games.aboutText:
Wish of Hers is a co-op action roguelite for 1 to 4 players. Fall asleep together, wake up in a dream world of islands rising from a glowing sea, and fight your way through until nothing is left standing.

Revive downed friends, hitch a ride on their backs and drop all your ultimates on the same boss at once. Everything breaks better with four people.

Every run hands you new abilities. Bend them with aspects, top them off with perks, and watch Mom's Slipper, a Black Hole and a Potato Gatling turn into something nobody planned.

Pick your route on the map and Prof. Cloud's airship takes you there: sunny standard islands, treasure islands full of gold and nightmare islands where the night never ends. Captain Flint waits at the end.

Someone has to stay awake. While the others dream, one of you guards their beds in the lab. Watch the security cameras and set traps like spikes and bear traps before the intruders reach the sleepers.

Crystals your friends break in the dream turn into REM points. Spend them in DreamWare and send help straight into the dream: a Dream Bomb on the horde, a Healing Rain that brings the downed back.

- Solo or online co-op for up to 4 players

- Abilities × aspects × perks: a new build every run

- Standard, treasure and nightmare islands

- The Night Shift: guard the sleepers with traps and help them from the lab

- Minibosses and Captain Flint, a pirate boss with his own ship

- A hub ship with perks, the Reality Shaper and the Dream Condenser

- Pixel-art characters in a toon-shaded 3D world

games.name: 我打不过漂亮的她们
games.shortDescription: Shi Lei once ruled the underground world and retired at his peak. Years later, unsettling truths emerge, disrupting his peace. Will he resolve old issues or break free from fate to uncover the secrets behind these truths? This time, he won't face it alone; she will help him.
games.aboutText:
The Fist of Fate, Your Choice is the Rule

The strongest punch will eventually strike at the most vulnerable part of fate. In this world, your choice is the only rule. The crossroads of fate have already been paved, and the outcome awaits your choice - whether to return to the pinnacle of the boxing world or sink into the maze of love? The story begins from here on, writing your own chapter in life.

The interweaving of three threads reveals the hidden truth

The three parallel trajectories of fate in time and space, namely "redemption of life", "retirement of the boxing champion", and "revenge in the boxing world", unfold one by one due to your choices. Is it to uncover the dark secrets and seek revenge for the departed lover, or to let go of obsession and welcome a new life? Or can we inherit our dreams in the mentorship and return to the glory arena? At the crossroads of conscience and interest, fate is determined by you.

Multiple interactions, immersive experience of the boxing world

Over 600 minutes of live action footage, consisting of 19 chapters on three main storylines and more than 20 endings to explore, with the entire process lasting over 16 hours. Players can freely choose to unlock different storylines, experience numerous human trials, witness different female lead combinations move from opposition to coexistence, and ultimately assemble into a complete truth map. The game contains rich interactive experiences: boxing competition, truth investigation, fate decision-making, and life and death escape Immersive storyline experience, taking you into a legendary boxing world where passion and emotions intertwine!

Crafted with ingenuity, presented with sincerity

We collaborate with a professional film and television team, using one shot to the bottom film level filming technology, and invite talented actors to star passionately, with millions of fan level guests surprised to participate. The collision of acting skills and the tension of the opposing scenes will bring you an immersive plot impact.

About Us

Friends who are familiar with particles still remember our first interactive video game product "Reverse 21g". As the first science fiction themed interactive video game in China, we have received a lot of support and valuable suggestions, which have become the driving force for us to continue to move forward on the road of video games. This time, we are returning with 'Can't Beat' and innovatively launching a 'parallel time and space' multi line narrative. At the same time, each storyline has added more judgment mechanisms and interactions, striving to bring everyone a richer immersive experience.

If you also like this work, it will be our greatest encouragement. We will continue to improve in our future works and bring more high-quality content to everyone!

For more game information, please follow:

Official Q group: 906288657

Official Tiktok: 我打不过漂亮的她们

Official Bilibili: 我打不过漂亮的她们

games.name: Short Trip
games.shortDescription: A hand-drawn, interactive illustration about a scenic tramway, windswept mountains and cats with places to be.
games.aboutText:
A short, scenic railway for cats. Hand drawn over 5 years.

The cats living along the mountain railway have places to be. You, the sole cat operating the tram, have the delightful duty of transporting them.

- A hand-drawn world five years in the making

- Perfect if you need to relax

- Short and sweet

- Earn a high score in new scheduled mode

Short Trip is an interactive illustration created by me, Alexander Perrin. Use the left and right keys to drive a scenic tram across a tranquil hand-drawn mountainscape, picking up and dropping off cat passengers as you go.

Since the initial free launch, Short Trip has been enjoyed by millions of players. This complete version includes all the content of the original while adding a new “scheduled” mode that integrates your computer’s clock to create a tram timetable. Reach each station at the correct time and rack up a high score! I’ve also included a little peek behind the scenes at the development process for the curious.

This is a “slow play” game designed to help players relax and unwind from the bustle of the day. I hope you enjoy your trip.

About me
I’m an Australia-based artist with a passion for meticulous dynamics, detailed digital rendering techniques, and cats (Short Trip is an expression of all three). I also make indie games as one half of 2pt Interactive.

games.name: Mini Mini Golf Golf
games.shortDescription: Mini Mini Golf Golf is an indie storytelling experience that goes beyond the lanes of the here and now into distant memories of a future planetary collapse. Destabilize the present and plunge into a neon psychohistory of a bizarre entity in distress. This is not a game about minigolf.
games.aboutText:
Mini Mini Golf Golf is a sci-fi narrative experience like no other. As you discover tunnels through spacetime and unravel memories of inevitable climate collapse, identity and responsibility collide at the fault line of our planet’s future.

The metaphor of a childhood memory – a perfectly normal round of Minigolf – rips open the fabric of spacetime and connects you with a mysterious and bizarre entity from the future, injecting thoughts and ideas into your trails as you navigate a virtual underworld of memories and resonances.

Climate Fiction

Grind away at tectonic plates and build up tension points, both geological and psychological, as you converse with the mind that perpetually upholds our future climate. Lift their burden for a while and uncover how they will have become the being that they are then. In their future, climate collapse is met with enormous geoengineering projects that create a new equilibrium by re-shaping plate tectonics.

A once-human mind

The psychohistory of the entity you encounter is fragmented, tainted and biased. It is incomplete, more than human, and tired. It finds comfort in your company and in the common memory of simple and safe games of Minigolf. Weave your way through memories of their life, uncovering thoughts and traces about their coming of age on a planetary scale.

Mini Mini Golf Golf is…

- A unique blend of mystery, sci-fi and experimental storytelling

- An intriguing connection with a future queer entity

- A spark of resilience in a dystopian future

Join us on Discord to build these sparks of resilience and community in a future where the equilibrium between the planet and humanity is at stake!

games.name: Epoch Reset
games.shortDescription: Unravel a narrative-driven 2.5D anime adventure as Hector, a dirt-poor genius and creator of the world’s first time machine. Travel between timelines, meet intriguing characters, and explore futuristic cityscapes as you seek to save reality from time-bending forces beyond imagination.
games.aboutText:
Hector Rodriguez is the bumbling scientist who, between making ends meet with odd jobs, has created the world’s first working time machine - the very invention that will one day destroy the world. At least, that’s what he’s told by the killers chasing him from the future.

When a victim of his future legacy, Nyx, reaches back into 2032, it’s up to Hector to heed her warning and fix the disaster he’s destined to cause.

From the bustling crosswalks of Hong Kong to the cyberpunk back-alleys of Tokyo, you’ll explore sprawling cityscapes across futures as you seek to prevent an unfolding temporal catastrophe.

Embark on a quest to unravel the truth, and leave the world as you know it behind. Experience time-bending triumphs, backstabbing betrayals, and all of the mysteries awaiting in-between.

Use your wits to navigate a variety of challenges, from card games and street karaoke to cyber-hacking and android surgery. Push your luck, flex your skills, and do whatever it takes to elude the time-traveling assassins who are hot on your trail.

Encounter a diverse cast of unique characters, each with their own opinions, desires, arcs, and flaws. Conquer the twists and turns of time paradoxes until you finally save those who are close to you and break the loop, once and for all.

games.name: Trainee Death Simulator
games.shortDescription: You will play as a Trainee Death, harvesting Souls to pay off your debt. Random choice events offer you various options: Lie in bed and slack off since the debt is endless anyway, Or follow your senior to earn some extra Souls, collecting outfits to switch up your style.
games.aboutText:
About this game

You will play as a Trainee Death, harvesting Souls to pay off your debt. Random choice events offer you various options: Lie in bed and slack off since the debt is endless anyway, Or follow your senior to earn some extra Souls, collecting outfits to switch up your style. The life of an apprentice Death is hardly living, with limitless chances for dying and reliving. Game play: Choices Above

You will encounter various random events that impact four attributes: Faith, Energy, Strength, and Evil. Every choice you make can alter the course of events, whether it’s getting lost in the Forest, falling into the void in the Death Tower, or turning into a monster in the Dreamworld—since you can always start over, feel free to make the choices you want. Unique Worldview

Hundreds of years ago, the "Lord of Night" vanished without a trace from the Death Tower. With their top-tier combat power lost, the Deaths were unable to maintain the balance between Dreams and Reality. While other Deaths were struggling desperately, a Great Death followed the prophecy and brought in a large number of Trainee Deaths as 'expendables,' turning the tide of the situation for the better... Integrate Historical Events

What I want to tell you is that Deaths truly exist, and every death is nudged along by one of them. Just look at history, at how those Deaths orchestrated deaths or joined in the harvest—wait a second, did you take part in it too? Collect and Customize

Complete objectives in random events to earn new outfits and customize them freely. Even Death needs to dress well——I know you might not want to join me, but if I were... Divine Artifacts

There are "Gods" in the celestial realm of this world, and by gazing at the stars, they will bestow Oracles upon those who are called.
Oracles have various effects, they might help you rise from the dead or make your situation worse - after all, there's no rule that says Gods must be benevolent.

games.name: City of None
games.shortDescription: A metropolis crumbles into ruin as powerful Barons satisfy their greed upon souls lost in time. You are but one spirit, with a wooden body left to rot in the wild…
games.aboutText:
Adventure through a metropolis filled with strange spirits, wicked beasts, ferocious robots, and more than one friend as you wrest life — and the city’s future — back from the grip of ravenous Barons.

A platforming adventure game from the co-creator of Celeste.

- Discover unique items and power ups that grant you new platforming abilities.

- Venture by train to the city’s five sectors and explore their many pathways.

- Meet many friendly - and not so friendly! - city inhabitants through your adventure.

games.name: Stellarcraft
games.shortDescription: Stellarcraft is a sci-fi tower defense adventure: explore alien planets, gather resources, build defenses, and fend off waves of enemies, solo or in 4-player co-op. 🚀
games.aboutText:
Stellarcraft – Sci-Fi Tower Defense Adventure

Stellarcraft is a sci-fi tower defense game where you explore different planets, gather resources, and complete missions. Build and upgrade defensive structures to fend off waves of enemies while developing your character. Strategic planning and technological upgrades are the key to survival.

Play solo or in co-op with up to 4 players and face the challenges of the universe together!

🛰 Defend your Base

Protect your base from increasingly powerful enemies. Place your towers strategically, upgrade their abilities, and adapt your defenses to every new wave.

🌌 Explore Unique Planets

Each planet features distinct biomes, resources, and enemies. Use your exploration to find the best strategic locations for your defenses.

⛏ Gather Resources

Collect minerals, energy, and rare metals. Resources are essential for building and upgrading your towers.
Some planets hold special resources required to craft advanced technology.

🛡 Build and Upgrade Towers

Construct a variety of towers and defenses, each with unique abilities. Place them strategically to maximize efficiency and save resources.

Upgrade your towers with shields, extra ammo, or new abilities to tailor your defenses for every wave of enemies.

⚙ Automation

Use miners, drones, and automated ore production systems to collect resources efficiently. This lets you save time and focus on expanding your bases and defenses.

🎮 Game Modes

Stellarcraft offers all exciting game modes with coop:

- Campaign – Experience the story and complete missions across different planets.

- Roguelite & Endless – Survive increasingly difficult waves and improve your character between runs.

- PvP Mode – Send your enemies against other players and test your strategy in competitive battles.

games.name: Fight For Mi
games.shortDescription: A story-driven indie adventure game. Lead an army of cute blobs into a war they don’t know why they’re fighting. Can you give them PURPOSE? Also what is mi?!
games.aboutText:
Death is killed.

Reality changes. Now, people no longer die. They can still fall on the battlefield. But their will, their conviction, their determination… It will now last throughout history.

What does that mean? Mi!

Mi mi mi!!!

The Mi Alliance is an army of cute blob-like soldiers. In this indie story adventure, you are the Leader Mi. You awaken in the middle of a forsaken battlefield where your comrades fell in battle. You are alone and outnumbered… But Mitopia shall prevail, whatever the cost!

Meet four friends- The Veteran, The Rogue, The Knight, and The Preacher, each with their own ideals. Lead your people through forsaken battlefields, lush forests, and other eerie environments, in search of your Purpose.

Why do we fight?

Make choices that decide the fate of Mi. Should you fight for peace, embracing the irony? Should you fight for the ultimate revenge against those that wronged you? Should you fight to appease the Angels and sacrifice innocent villagers to do so?

Are the Mi valorous crusaders or a death cult?!

The choice is yours. Can your choices change the ending?

Does war need any justification?

Maybe we should just kill the Enemy because they're called, well, the Enemy.

FORMATION!

Wave your flag proudly up high! Your army is your clay, and you are the sculptor. You will lead your Mi in battle by selecting Formations which decide how your Mi fight. Order a reckless Charge into the enemy, and Regroup on time for your Mi to heal and recover their wounds.

Learn through trial and error to find the greatest transitions, and minimize your losses.

Life is ephemeral. Experiences are temporary.

You’ve got only a single chance at this. That is the nature of life, after all.

This handcrafted three to four hour campaign tells the full soldier’s tale, full of heartwarming camaraderie, glorious determination, and great tragedy.

All features

- Four Mi heroes to meet and befriend

- Mi are cute and brave. They are your people. Lead them!

- More than fifty choices and eight main story routes: Experience YOUR story

- Eight Formations

- Simple controls: No big brain strategy required

- More than six unique types of Mi to lead into battle

- Grab a gun and personally fight the Enemy

- Ancient monks

- Lots of lore

- Original soundtrack to create your immersive experience

- Learn something about why people like fighting each other so much

- Meta plot

- Controller support! Currently, you can plug a controller in and play fully on controller. There might be a few rare text input segments for which you'll need your keyboard. The same goes for a Steam Deck- except you'll need to manually activate the on-screen keyboard.

games.name: Nubby's Number Factory
games.shortDescription: A plinko-style roguelike where you work at a number factory. Launch your spherical friend, Nubby, down a pegboard to make bigger and bigger numbers! But beware, if you fail to meet your number quota, the sun will explode.
games.aboutText:
Welcome aboard to Nubby's Number Factory! Your only job here is to make numbers, so you can make bigger numbers, so you can make even BIGGER numbers!

In this plinko-style roguelike, you'll launch your spherical friend, Nubby, down a pegboard to rack up increasingly large numbers. However, it's not all fun and games. You're still a low-ranking employee at this facility, which means that you need to meet your production quota. To make stakes even higher, your work at the number factory is directly responsible for keeping the fabric of space and time intact. One screw up could cause the sun to immediately explode.

Luckily, you can increase your output of numbers by harnessing the magical powers of over 50 unique items. You can use these items to create diverse and creative solutions to surpass your ever-expanding quotas. Feel that sweet surge of dopamine as the components of your factory synergize to make those numbers big!

games.name: Time Snatcher Handy
games.shortDescription: The universe's greatest cat burglar? The ultimate phantom thief across dimensions? Nah... Time Snatcher Handy, that's me! A time-stop bullet-hell action roguelike starring “Handy” the stylish cat burglar! Stop time to dodge bullets, gather items to get stronger, and escape the Time Museum!
games.aboutText:
“Handy,” the feline phantom thief, has stolen a clock hand from the Time Museum.

Wield its mysterious power to freeze time, slip through merciless curtains of bullets,

outsmart patrolling guards, and claw your way out of the Time Museum!

At do-or-die moments, stop time to dodge patterns, line up the perfect strike, and take control of the battlefield.

Master the rhythm between frozen instants and live danger to turn the tide!

Every action spends “time.” When the clock hits zero,

the clock hand's power rewinds the run to the moment Handy first touched it.

Time is your only resource — it pays for Time Stop, for every hit you take, and for everything you buy.

Defeat enemies and gather “Timeshards” to extend your escape!

The museum is packed with exhibits beyond the clock hand!

Borrow and combine items to create powerful synergies and grow stronger!

The closer Handy gets to freedom, the tougher the enemies and bosses.

Each area introduces unique level mechanics and attack patterns.

Use Time Stop and your borrowed loadout to overcome every roadblock!

Costumes don't just make Handy look cool. They also remix gameplay with distinct twists!

Find the style that fits you and crack the museum's defenses in your own way!

games.name: ZOMBIE KEBAB VR
games.shortDescription: Cook kebabs and fight zombies in this fast action game. Explore streets, gather ingredients, and feed survivors. Unlock new tools and recipes as you survive each night. Fast, funny, and brutal. Known online as the “4 a.m. fast-food simulator”
games.aboutText:
Zombie Kebab is a fast VR action game set during a zombie apocalypse. You run a small kebab stand and try to survive each night by cooking food, fighting off zombies, and searching for new ingredients.

Cook kebabs for the few humans still hiding in the city. Prepare orders quickly, keep your grill running, and manage limited supplies. The faster you cook, the more money and upgrades you earn.

When the horde attacks, switch from cooking to combat. Use frying pans, knives, and improvised weapons to defend your food truck.

Unlock new tools and guns to survive longer waves.

Between shifts, explore the city in search of ingredients and materials. What you find affects what you can cook the next night.

Zombie Kebab combines fast cooking gameplay with first-person VR action. Quick decisions, chaos, and dark humor make it feel like working at a real 4 a.m. food stand — just with more zombies.

FEATURES

- VR cooking and combat gameplay

- Wave defense core loop

- Playable district (city center)

- Realistic motion-based cooking interactions

- Physical melee and throwing combat

- 10+ weapons and tools

- Ingredient scavenging between waves

- Food management system

- Score-based progression

- Dynamic audio and environmental sound

- Semi-realistic, dirty neon visual style

- Endless replayable structure Local high-score system Optimized for VR arcade sessions (10–30 min survival runs)

games.name: 鲤氏奇人异闻录
games.shortDescription: 《明日方舟》同人游戏，以原作角色“老鲤”为主角，在二十年前的龙门，展开一系列解谜探案故事。
games.aboutText:
Due to the limited capacity of the production team, this game does not have an English mode, please understand.

Chinese users can switch to the "Chinese Simplified" mode to view the introduction.

《鲤氏奇人异闻录》（以下统称“本作”）是《明日方舟》（以下统称“原作”）的同人游戏。

本作以原作角色“老鲤”为主角（本作中名为“鲤”），玩家将以“鲤”的视角展开一系列解谜探案故事。

本作为同人作品，同人倾向为：老鲤中心，无CP，剧情向，一般向。

tips：本作剧情相对独立，即便您对《明日方舟》没有了解，也可以将本作当作一款普通的文字解谜游戏游玩！

本作主要故事发生在炎国龙门，故事时间在原作主线序章（1097年）约二十年前，世界观及背景设定尽量贴近原作，但在原作基础上进行了一定的 必要延展 ，如有错漏，敬请谅解。

本作登场人物中，鲤（老鲤）、老董（董阿伯）、林（鼠王林舸瑞）、魏彦吾、蔡老板（菜贩老蔡）为原作角色，由于故事发生在二十年前，本作对他们进行了少量重新演绎，OOC之处，敬请谅解； 其余人物均为本作原创角色 。

除“源石”及“源石技艺”相关设定外，本作所涉及的基础科学原理均与现实相符。

本作完全免费 ，无任何商业性质，不包含任何收费项目。

本作为悬疑解谜游戏，剧情涉及凶杀案件，包含少量血腥画面及血腥暴力相关的文字描写，推荐16岁以上玩家游玩，建议18岁以下玩家谨慎游玩。

二十年前

年轻的老鲤初至龙门

被卷入一起凶案

案情复杂奇诡

引来龙门黑白两道重要人物关注

为尽早脱困

本无意招惹是非的鲤

决定主动追查真凶

找到真相

这一遭 究竟是

天命难违 亦或 人定胜天

且看他 回首处

但思善恶 笑语 无问吉凶

在本游戏中，玩家将 扮演年轻时的老鲤 ，作为一名侦探，调查发生在龙门的数起案件。

游戏基本形式为阅读故事（类似《明日方舟》剧情部分）。

初入龙门，就从结识新朋友开始吧！

【问询】： 与案件相关角色对话，收集线索。
