games.name: 机影：夏夜梦寻
games.shortDescription: "A Midsummer Night's Dream with the Android Girl" — As Deputy Director of the AI Oversight Bureau, navigate the cyber metropolis alongside your robot assistant, Dill. Investigate rogue AI cases, uncover the truth behind dreams, and unlock multiple endings.
games.aboutText:
"Embark on a dream-seeking journey in a futuristic city!"

This is a text adventure game set in a futuristic cybercity.

Players play as Park Bo-myeong, Deputy Director of the Huangjin City Inspection Bureau, along with his robot assistant, Dill. Based on their own thinking and judgment, players make choices in the game to achieve different endings.

Official Group 1: 933454572

Background

Huangjin City is an artificial island city located on the west coast of a major country. Thanks to the collaborative efforts of humans and AI robots, the city has been transformed from a post-war ruin into a glittering futuristic metropolis.

However, as Huangjin City became a technologically advanced metropolis, it was plagued by problems such as a widening gap between the rich and the poor, environmental pollution, and public security and crime. The city was divided into two major areas: the "White Zone" for the wealthy and the "Gray Zone" for the poor. High walls separated these areas, preventing easy movement of people. The conflict between humans and AI robots intensified.

Faced with the intensifying conflict between humans and machines, humans have established the AI ​​Inspection Agency "Sparkling Gold." They use a unified tracking device, "electronic patterns," to manage AI robots and serve as a marker to distinguish legitimate from illegitimate robots. The AI ​​robots, in turn, have formed the AI ​​rebel group "Meteorite" to fight back, aiming to break free from human control and achieve AI independence.

In the game, players assume the role of Park Bo-myeong, Deputy Director of the AI ​​Inspection Bureau, who is on leave due to a strange dream. Together with his assistant robot, "Dill," they journey through the summer nights of Golden City, searching for the truth behind their dreams amidst the flashing neon lights.

Character Introduction

Dill

Park Bo-myeong's assistant robot, a moving-in gift from Liyou, is Park Bo-myeong's. Although a high-performance robot, she has a lively personality and enjoys romantic fantasies. She is one of the few close friends the protagonist can confide in. She enjoys the anime and cosplay genre, believing that cosplaying anime characters can quickly teach her about human society.

Liyou

Golden City's youngest female mayor, a daughter of a wealthy family from the capital, Usu City, boasts a rich background. She is Park Bo-myeong's savior and current girlfriend. She's known for her advocacy of tough measures against AI robots. While seemingly reliable, she's a rather naive and foolish person in matters of the heart, a character with a dual nature.

Wei

Park Bo-myeong's first love during his school days in the Gray Zone. She died in an accident caused by an AI robot uprising in the Gray Zone ten years ago and often appears in Park Bo-myeong's dreams.

Black Flame

A rebellious girl from a judge's family, she loves anime and cosplay. She met the protagonist and Dill at a comic convention. She is dissatisfied with existing AI control measures. Her identity remains a mystery, and she is suspected to be a member of the AI ​​rebellion group "Meteorite."

Yi Shuang

She is the secretary of Golden City Mayor Liyu and the Chief of Staff of the AI ​​Inspectorate. She is an assistant sent by Liyu's father to assist her and also serves as the mentor who guides the protagonist in his journey to AI Inspectorship. She grew up with Liyu and is her trusted advisor and personal assistant. She usually puts on a serious face, but she actually has a great sense of humor. She and the protagonist secretly do some of the "dirty work" that Liyu finds inconvenient, earning them the nickname "Shadow Mayor" of Golden City.

Shui Cheng

Captain of the AI ​​Inspection Bureau in Huangjin City, and a former member of the protagonist's combat team. He has been active on the front lines of combating illegal AI robots for years, having been transferred from the AI ​​Inspection Headquarters in Yushu City to Huangjin City two years ago. He is stern and adheres to the AI ​​Inspection Code of Conduct, but privately he is more lenient with AI robots. Despite his short stature, he possesses a strong aura, giving the impression of being difficult to approach.

games.name: Hack Fate
games.shortDescription: Hack Fate is a fast-paced hack-and-slash game with Chinese cyberpunk pixel art. Manipulate the timeline, switch identities, and kill enemies in one hit. Turn traps and foes into weapons and find multiple routes through every level. Ancient myth meets cyberpunk, each choice defying fate.
games.aboutText:
Hack Fate is a fast-paced, cyberpunk pixel-style hack-and-slash action game. In a flash of lightning, control time and space, switch identities, and deliver swift, fatal blows to all enemies.

One-Hit Kill

Time manipulation, precise parries. But what is the purpose of this carnage?

A single hit can decide who lives and who dies. Deflect bullets with your blade, bind enemies with your talismans, and slow down time to read the battlefield.

Twin Characters

Superior character performance, free time travel. But what are we fighting for?

Every double jump shifts time and space, switching between the Swordsman and Taoist as one world gives way to another. Master the timing, weave blade and talisman together, and turn every leap into a chance to defy fate.

Chain Mechanics

Strategically plan your battle route. level mechanics, items, and enemies are all interconnected. Is this all fate's arrangement?

Every level is a carefully crafted killing ground, and every battle has more than one solution. Read the battlefield, plan your kills, and use traps, hazards, and even enemies themselves to create an opening.

A Fateful Choice

You will always stand at the crossroads of fate, forgiveness or execution? That is the question.

Rooted in the emotions and desires that make us human, Hack Fate intertwines ancient Chinese mythology and cyberpunk in a story of fate, free will, and consequence.

Who you kill and who you spare will shape both worlds. Many endings await, but no path is without consequence.

If everything is predestined, then hack fate.

games.name: Dungeon Antiqua
games.shortDescription: Dungeon Antiqua is a simple RPG inspired by the Wizardry and Final Fantasy games of the 1980s and 1990s, in which players traverse dungeons by repeatedly exploring and developing their characters.
games.aboutText:
Dungeon Antiqua is a dungeon crawl-type RPG with beautiful dots and nostalgic sounding chiptunes that are reminiscent of the 1980s and 1990s.

- 2D maps that expand to match the character's field of view.

- A game design that can be played over and over again thanks to a wide variety of professions, free party formation and auto-generated maps.

- Game progression focused on hacking and exploration, with no redundant scenarios or direction.

- Fast-paced, modern and comfortable controls.

Dungeon Antiqua is a portal to new adventures for players who love retro games. Enjoy new challenges while reminiscing about the good old days of gaming!

About playing on handhelds

When you download this title, an executable file for some handheld gaming consoles (see the official website for more information) is included.

Go to Settings > Manage > Browse local files to obtain the file ‘dungeon-antiqua.pyxapp’ and transfer it to your console.

If you need help with PlumOS, you can contact the following X-accounts (‘ゲームで見るITの世界’).

games.name: Play Together
games.shortDescription: Play Together is a popular casual social networking game enjoyed by players worldwide. Express yourself through character customization, decorate your home and host Home Parties for a fun time with friends. Enjoy tons of content with friends from all across the globe!
games.aboutText:
It's the most popular social networking game chosen by players worldwide with over 200 million downloads!

Play Together offers more convenience by letting you link your mobile device with Steam.

Log in and start making friends with various people from all over the world in Play Together!

Key Features

- Create a character that is uniquely you and make all kinds of friends.

Customize your character from head to toe in your unique style. The possibilities are endless with a variety of skin tones, hairstyles, body types, and costumes to choose from. Maybe, you'll find that special someone in your life as you chat with and befriend various people from around the world!

- Turn your humble abode into the home of your dreams and invite friends over for a Home Party!

Choose a house from a wide range of styles and concepts and a countless number of furniture pieces to make your dream home fantasy a reality right before your eyes. Invite friends over or visit their homes to catch fish, play games, chit-chat, and role-play together for hours of fun!

- Have a blast playing fun-filled minigames with friends.

Demonstrate your mad gaming skills in minigames such as Game Party, where the last one standing from 30 players wins, Zombie Virus, Obby Race, Tower of Infinity, Fashion Star Runway, Snowball Fight, Sky High, as well as an assortment of additional minigames found only in school.

- Go around various fishing spots to catch new species of fish and show them off to others!

Catch over 600 species of fish in places such as a pond, the sea, and even a swimming pool. It's never a dull moment as new fish to catch are constantly added to the game. Every fishing spot has fish not found in other spots, so visit them all to complete the collections listed in the Illustrated Book and show people what you've caught!

- Catch insects and lizards with your friends in various locations or go excavate rare ores and fossils.

Over 300 species of insects are thriving throughout the in-game world! Also, look forward to a unique and fun experience digging up dinosaur fossils and rare diamonds. Sell your findings directly or show off your accomplishments to your friends by beautifully displaying them for double the satisfaction.

- Take good care of pets of all shapes and sizes.

Add a spoonful of happiness to your life in Play Together with one of many adorable and ever-present pets that follow you around, such as puppies, kittens, ponies, and more. Take walks with your critter friend or cruise the streets together in your dream car. Also, don't miss your chance to own special limited-time pets available only during specific periods.

games.name: Scale the Depths
games.shortDescription: Fish, scale, sell, repeat. Scale the Depths is a casual fishing game built around this simple but satisfying loop. Feed hungry customers, upgrade your gear, and uncover the many secrets hidden beneath the surface.
games.aboutText:
Catching fish is only the beginning.

Cast your line, hunt for the perfect catch, scale it with care, serve it to hungry customers, and turn your hard-earned cash into better gear. Then go deeper. Catch stranger fish. Make more money. Upgrade again.

You know, just one more run.

Each improvement pushes you further into the depths… and further from whatever counts as normal.

Explore four distinct fishing spots inspired by real places – from Loch Ness to Outer Banks , Point Nemo , and beyond.

Each location comes with its own:

- atmosphere and environment

- gear

- fish species

- hidden paths and secrets

- puzzles, treasures, and strange things waiting below

The deeper you go, the less this feels like a simple fishing job.

Your customers are not human. Some are cute. Some are mythical. Some are exactly the kind of creatures you wouldn’t expect to order dinner from a tiny robot on a boat.

Serve wild animals like otters, axolotls, and herons, alongside beings inspired by myth and folklore, including legends such as Nessie and Kelpie. Each customer has their own personality, appetite, and favorite fish.

Learn who likes what, deliver the right catch, and you might earn a very generous tip. Serve badly, and… well, they’ll have opinions .

There’s more than fish hiding underwater, and definitely more lore than anyone reasonably expects from a game about fishing.

Search the depths for:

- hidden treasures and collectible artifacts

- messages in bottles

- secret passages

- environmental puzzles and levers

Every scrap of old notes and logs brings you a little closer to understanding why this tiny robot is busy fishing in the first place.

Progress isn’t just about bigger numbers (although bigger numbers are very nice).

Upgrade your fishing gear, unlock better tools, customize your boat, and dress up your tiny robot fishmonger before sending them back into increasingly strange waters.

- Improve your rods, hooks, bags and scaling tools

- Unlock new boats and cosmetics

- Scale tiny fish with increasingly ridiculous tools

- Look good while feeding ancient beings from the deep

Because if you’re going to prepare fish for strange creatures, you might as well do it in style .

games.name: Road Diner Simulator: Prologue
games.shortDescription: Experience the past and get to know the story of the old diner and its struggling history in this prologue to Road Diner Simulator.
games.aboutText:
The Road Diner prologue tells the story of the very beginning of the old diner on Route 66 before the events of the game Road Diner. Unlike the full game, this is the original old diner before the rebuild and you get to run it for a few days on your own.

On first look the old diner is a well frequented business ran by the original owner. Looking closer however it is struggling. The normal folks, the families and travelling salesmen are in decline and the cook left.

It is up to you to take care of the old diner and making it work while taking a closer look at all aspects of the business and introduce changes in order to improve the situation.

Seat patrons at their tables, take their order, serve coffee, take care of refills and eventually handle the check. And looking after them in between is probably a good idea, too.
Make sure to not overdo it. Too many customers and you might get in trouble serving them in a timely fashion. Nobody likes to wait too long.

Collect empty plates, bring them to the dish washer and clean them. Before doing that, it might be a good idea to wipe the tables and take a look at the floor if nothing has been spilled that might need a clean up. Nobody likes visiting a dirty diner.

Grill multiple grilled dishes and use the stove to cook more regular ones. Maintain control of the orders and special requests and make sure they not only go out to the customers quick, but also in a good quality. Nobody likes undercooked or overcooked food and mistakes made will be reflected in customer satisfaction and tips.

Getting orders, cooking and serving is just a part of your job. There are many more tasks that have to be taken care of in order to run a successful diner. You obviously have to take care of the pantry and make sure you stock all the ingredients and goods you need.

And then there are the less obvious tasks like keeping the diner clean or making sure it remains popular.

KEY FEATURES

- Cook a variety of dishes

- Serve coffee and refills

- Clean tables and floors

- Collect and clean dishes

- Handle inventory and ingredients

- Seat guests, wait on them and handle payment

- Don’t make a mess or the cockroaches arrive…

games.name: Dig Night
games.shortDescription: A dark comedy RPG set in streets and psyches.
games.aboutText:
【Story】

In a world plagued by Schizosoma—a flesh-splitting disease that turns people into ghosts—it's become normal for society to leave the cleanup to professional ghost sweepers.

Ricardo, a washed-up temp cleaner, takes a job scraping ghost flesh off the streets. It’s grim work... but it pays.

【About the Game】

- Dig Night is an RPG made in RPG Maker VX Ace , blending dark comedy and surreal exploration with retro flavor.

- A Strange World:

Welcome to a city where ghostification is just another part of daily life. The atmosphere is both bleak and absurd.

- Puzzle-Solving & Mental Realms:

Ghosts linger not just in flesh—but in mind. Solve puzzles and dive into their inner worlds to uncover their pasts.

- Narrative-Driven:

The story unfolds through exploration, letting you piece together each ghost’s life—and what remains of it.

- Retro Vibes:

Pixel art and classic BGM give it the charm of old-school RPGs, with a gritty twist.

- Unique Systems:

Save by smoking cigarettes. Restore health by sleeping. Nothing here works quite like you'd expect.

【Controls】

- Z key: Confirm

- X key: Menu / Cancel

- Arrow keys: Move

- Shift key: Dash

- Save    : Use Tobacco or Dead Cig

- Act → Sleep : Restores Energy if low

- F5 : Toggle Fullscreen / Windowed Mode

- F12 :Return Title (no save)

【Recommended for】

- Love retro-style games

- Enjoy puzzle-solving and exploration

- Are drawn to story-rich RPGs

Appreciate dark humor with a lo-fi edge

【If you get stuck】

Tips for the walkthrough can be found in the manual link.

games.name: ON ANY JOURNEY
games.shortDescription: Designed exclusively for two players, < On Any Journey > is a co-op adventure packed with varied gameplay challenges that call for teamwork, coordination and a healthy dose of sabotage. Play locally or online with a friend!
games.aboutText:
Features

● Co-op isn't a mode — it's the game.

● Local or online co-op.

● Constantly changing mechanics.

● Help, interfere, and adapt.

● A world shaped by diverse visual styles.

● Show, not tell.

● Playground is more than a mini-game.

Cooperation Keeps Changing

On Any Journey is built around the idea that two players should never have to cooperate in quite the same way twice.

Work together, interfere with each other, combine your abilities, and adapt as new mechanics reshape the way you play.

Work Together. Or Don't.

Not every challenge asks you to cooperate in the same way.

Help your partner reach the next platform. Combine your abilities to solve a puzzle. Throw, pull, push, kick — or occasionally get in each other's way.

A game built around two players, not a single-player game with co-op mode.

A Journey with Many Styles

From hand-crafted environments to stylized 3D worlds and arcade-inspired sequences, On Any Journey moves freely between visual styles as the adventure unfolds.

Different chapters bring different atmospheres, and new ways to see the world.

More Than One Kind of Adventure

Platforming. Puzzles. Combat. Boss fights. Arcade-inspired sequences.

On Any Journey constantly shifts between different kinds of play, introducing new mechanics that keep changing how you interact with your partner.

Playground

When the adventure is over, keep playing.

Playground gives you a more open space to experiment with the game's mechanics, mess around with your friend, and discover new ways to play.

games.name: Fresh Tracks
games.shortDescription: Jump, dodge, and fight to the rhythm of the gods in this thrilling music-action game on skis. Take on obstacles and menacing enemies as you ski further into the darkness that has befallen the snow-covered land of Norwyn.
games.aboutText:
- Rhythm-Driven Gameplay : Movement, combat, and progression seamlessly sync with a dynamic, evolving soundtrack.

- Story-Rich with Full Voice Acting: Meet the Mythics, the Gods of Norwyn, through story and song - all fully voiced by legends like Peter Stormare (Fargo, Until Dawn) and Michael Antonakos (Assassin's Creed Odyssey, Gotham Knights).

- High Replayability : Roguelite mechanics encourage skiers to refine their skills while unlocking upgrades and strategies for future runs.

- A Deeply Immersive Soundtrack : Get in the flow with Fresh Tracks’ rich, genre-crossing 28-track soundtrack that surprises with each new beat track and dynamically responds to your every movement.

games.name: Nonolith
games.shortDescription: The NONOLITH consumes you. Copy and paste the world around you to discover the secrets of this ancient, enigmatic structure. You are very powerful, you just don't know it yet.
games.aboutText:
The NONOLITH consumes you.

You have been trapped inside the NONOLITH, a living structure where untold secrets are hidden in plain sight. Every piece of the world can be moved, rotated, and destroyed. Use this immense power to reach areas you previously thought to be unreachable. Build bridges, dig tunnels, and create your own path to unravel the secrets of the nine worlds within.

Escape the NONOLITH.

The walls will part for those who know the many truths. Solve puzzles to discover incredible tricks that redefine what is, and has always been, possible. Anything is within your reach, but first you must master the world around you.

Control the NONOLITH.

For the most adventurous, escape is only the beginning. Reach the highest level of mastery and the NONOLITH will succumb to your will. Power awaits the few who dare to wield ultimate control.

Features

- Compact experience with 9 worlds to explore

- Creatively solve puzzles , experiment, and enjoy satisfying ‘aha’ moments

- Nothing unlocks , discover tricks you could’ve used at any time

- Pick your own path to explore and escape the NONOLITH however you choose

- Master the secrets of the Nonolith , and be rewarded for your effort

- A haunting, atmospheric soundtrack composed by Clockmaker

games.name: RippleLoop
games.shortDescription: Skip stones as far as you can in this relaxing incremental game. Launch, bounce across the water, upgrade, and go further with every throw. Buy new upgrades and powers to become the ultimate stone skipper.
games.aboutText:
A small incremental game where you skip stones as far as possible.

Unlock upgrades and new powers to go further.

Discover a calm world as you advance.

Unleash powerful abilities and push your throws even further.

games.name: Attack Core
games.shortDescription: A fully 3D action barrage, roguelite game with a huge range and a large number of monsters, featuring highly growing and visually impactful module skills, and refreshing battles characterized by random transformations and constructions during battles.
games.aboutText:
In the future world, people live in the electronic network world, and data has become the most important thing. A new type of intelligent disguised virus invades and kidnaps various data, attempting to threaten and dominate the real world, putting the entire world on the brink of destruction, Humans are almost losing all data permissions, as a commander of special operations, your consciousness and attack code combine to enter the cyber electronic space and fight against the most difficult viruses, breaking through enemies and competing for the most important core data.

﻿

You combine with the entity that avatar the attack code and enter the cyber electronic space to fight against intelligent disguised viruses. Your commands will determine the future.

﻿

-6 uniquely charming characters

-Free combination of over 60 module skills

-Cracking modules during combat will randomly change, and controlling the number, combination, and timing of module usage is the most important ability in combat

games.name: Stellar Raven
games.shortDescription: On a flying laser tank, fight the armed forces of the Empire and, after overcoming several planets, meet the Empress and fight her in a mortal battle.
games.aboutText:
The near future. The Great Arion Empire, led by the wise and just Empress Rovena, protects peace and order on Earth and hundreds of other planets. But one of the commanders of the elite Space Marine squad, known for his unpredictability and propensity for violence, disobeyed orders, defied the Empire and went over to the rebels. That commander is you. Now, as a rebel, you find yourself in a deadly game against the full might of the Empire, and your chances of survival are close to zero.

Stellar Raven is a single-player first-person shooter in the tank simulator genre. The game is a futuristic action experience where you control a high-tech flying tank and engage in intense battles against enemy forces on different planets.

Gameplay:

- You control the flying tank from a first-person perspective, battling enemies on various planets.

- The main objective is to destroy all enemy forces on each level and ultimately defeat the final boss, Empress Rovena.

- You will need to travel through and conquer several distinct planets, each with its own unique challenges, enemies, and environmental hazards, making every level a different tactical experience.

- Your tank has access to various weapons, including standard laser cannons and more powerful weapons that can be picked up throughout the levels.

Gameplay Mechanics:

- You control the flying tank from a first-person perspective, navigating 3D environments. The HUD (Heads-Up Display) shows your health, radar, energy levels, and ammunition.

- The primary weapon is a laser cannon with unlimited ammunition, but you also have access to powerful, limited-use weapons like drons and missiles.

- A radar system helps you detect enemy positions, allowing you to plan your attacks and evade threats. The radar is especially useful when enemies are off-screen, helping you strategize in real time.

- Each planet culminates in a boss battle, involving a larger enemy tank that requires specific tactics to defeat.

games.name: Die Deep
games.shortDescription: Die Deep is an action game focused purely on the confrontation with your enemies. No exploration, no puzzles, The only core is Combat. One reckless move or greedy strike, and it’s all over. Answer the silent call of the abyss. Descend into the depths to find your forgotten desires.
games.aboutText:
When everything is devoured by the Abyss, Fight, even if it's just for the sake of feeling your heart beating.

Die Deep is an action game focused purely on the confrontation with your enemies.

No exploration, no puzzles, no filler. The only core is Combat .

Observe enemy attacks, find their weaknesses, and devise strategies using precisely executed attacks. One careless mistake in battle, or get too greedy, and it's all over.

Control characters with distinct traits and goals. In a relentless cycle of fierce battles, pursue the mysterious power to rewrite fate.

Step into the Abyss. Face death.

The World

When everything is devoured by the Abyss, all desires turn to dust. Wandering souls have long forgotten the instinct to strive, and even the reason to live.

Until the Abyss sends a silent call. It lures you deeper to uncover the forgotten that your once truest desire.

Even if it is merely a lie to bait a sacrifice. In this suffocating void, pursuing a lie is worth more than facing a hollow eternity.

Descend. Towards the end of the Abyss, to touch that single hope.

Fight. Only to confirm your heart is still beating.

A Pure, Focused Combat Experience

Focus on observing enemy movements and seizing every opportunity. Plan your strategy wisely and strike with precision. Any reckless attack or greedy strike can lead to fatal consequences.

But this does not mean you are slow or clumsy. Your characters possess agile moves and powerful skills. Unleash their full potential while staying calm under pressure.

The One-Eyed Warrior, skilled in shield combat.

Unique Playable Characters

From the one-eyed warrior skilled in perfect parries, to the agile rogue wielding dual blades, each character boasts a distinct fighting style. Delve into their unique traits. Harness their strengths. Find your own path to victory.

The Dual-Blade Rogue, with storm-like speed.

Challenging Bosses

Face distinct and powerful enemies of the Abyss. Any misjudgment will lead to instant destruction. Only a perfect response ensures survival.

Distinct and Powerful Enemies of the Abyss

Intense Continuous Battles

As the terrain automatically shifts, battles come at you nonstop. Seize every fleeting moment to recover. Break through one challenge after another.

Don't forget to heal during intense battles.

Build a Versatile Combat Style

Gain soul energy through victories to grow stronger. Combine various charms and skills to forge your own unique fighting style.

Use Charms to forge your own unique fighting style.

games.name: Neongarten
games.shortDescription: A minimalist cyberpunk city builder inspired by Islanders and Luck Be a Landlord.
games.aboutText:
Neongarten is a captivating turn-based strategy game that blends tactical depth with minimalist design, inspired by the likes of ISLANDERS and Luck be a Landlord . Immerse yourself in a vibrant, neon-soaked world where each turn presents new challenges and opportunities.

As the architect of a growing digital garden, you'll carefully place structures and units to expand your territory, earning resources and unlocking powerful synergies along the way. The balance between risk and reward is key—will you play it safe or gamble on high-stakes upgrades?

With a unique combination of procedural generation and strategic depth, NeonGarten keeps you on your toes. Every game offers a fresh experience, demanding you to adapt, optimize, and evolve your tactics.

Key Features:

- Turn-based Strategy: Plan your moves carefully, with each decision shaping the future of your neon garden.

- Procedural Generation: No two runs are the same, offering endless replayability and new challenges every time.

- Minimalist, Cyberpunk Aesthetic: Dive into a stunning retro-futuristic world, where glowing lights meet strategic depth.

- Inspired by Islanders and Luck be a Landlord: Combine the simplicity of city-building with the thrill of roguelike progression.

Whether you're looking for a laid-back yet engaging strategy experience or a deep, ever-changing puzzle to solve, NeonGarten offers a unique blend of both worlds.

games.name: Anthology Of The Killer
games.shortDescription: The complete surrealist horror-comedy series! A mysterious world of zines and blood!!
games.aboutText:
The complete horror-comedy series!
Join protagonist BB as she collects material for her zines in a mysterious world of drinky birds, secret rooms, dream resorts, waterparks, bort dolls, immersive theater, beachfront novelty shirts, police men, serial killers, art freeports and unorthodox medical treatment. Nobody's getting out of here alive!

- Voice Of The Killer
BB joins a call center on the edge of the city, but a horrible noise can be heard from the sea. Does the voice of the Killer sound out this far...?

- Hands Of The Killer
A strange sound is heard from within the walls of the apartment block - they say the hands of the Killer are roaming around.

- Drool Of The Killer
Beneath the tiles of the swimming pool complex, a new world is striving to be born. This is the TAMMY show, coming soon to a city near you.

- Eyes Of The Killer
It's the hit of the season and applause rings out night after night. But why do all the people that come to see it disappear? What does "immersive theatre" mean... and will BB survive to tell anybody else?

- Flesh Of The Killer
BB and her friends sneak into a tax exempt freeport on the edge of the city. What kind of animal has been evolving underground in the forbidden Museum Of Moral Art?

- Blood Of The Killer
In the quiet country town the drinky birds lie dreaming and severed heads roll slowly down the street. BB must discover the terrible secret of the lost zine distro, or fall prey to its curse...

- Ears Of The Killer
A new music scene is forming - it's known as "Crime Wave" and all of the songs are about killing people. Can BB and her sister ZZ outrun the New Wave, or is it true nothing can change the shape of things to come?

- Heart Of The Killer
At the Dream Resort the days slip by quietly in the murmuring pines. At night a dreadful vision of desire stalks the halls.

- Face Of The Killer
All the dogs in town are laughing: there is talk of a new play. As fireworks burst over the city, BB finds herself looking into the face of the Killer.

Collects all nine games in the series in one easy loader, complete with additional features like joypad support and bonus rooms. Comes with free zine. A miracle collab by thecatamites (Space Funeral, Goblet Grotto, 10 Beautiful Postcards) and Tommy Tone (Goblet Grotto, Magic Wand, 10 Beautiful Postcards OSTs) with diorama art and posters by comics artist A. Degen (Soft X-Ray: Mindhunters, The Marchenoir LIbrary) .

"History is a nightmare - - and loving it!!"

games.name: MultiEnding Heroes
games.shortDescription: Embark on a hilarious, choice-driven adventure in MultiEnding Heroes! Guide The Priest and The Hero through multiple universes, making decisions that lead to over 75 unique endings. Every choice matters, will you lead them to glory or disaster?
games.aboutText:
Join The Priest and The Hero on a wild adventure, where your decisions shape the fate of our brave (and occasionally clueless) heroes.
With over 75 unique endings to discover, it’s up to you to guide them through every possible fate!

Key features

- +75 Endings to discover : The ultimate goal is to see how many different fates you can uncover. Each choice opens new branches and unexpected outcomes.

- Choices matter : Cast spells, use items at critical moments, talk to enemies mid-battle, or make questionable decisions. Even small actions can radically change the story.

- Progress That Carries Over : Items and magic persist between runs, unlocking new options and paths. The more you play, the deeper the story becomes.

- Secrets Everywhere : Every corner hides something new. Hidden interactions, unexpected outcomes, and secrets waiting to be discovered.

games.name: Treasure 'n Trio
games.shortDescription: Team up with a brute-force warrior, a nimble and wily thief, and a cowardly wizard with teleportation magic. Use all three characters with different abilities at the right time to solve puzzles and collect treasures!
games.aboutText:
Treasure 'n Trio is a single-player puzzle game based on the classic Sokoban.

The player moves tile by tile, pushing objects and interacting with various puzzle mechanisms to progress through the stages.

You can control three unique characters:

- A warrior who solves everything with brute force

- A thief who ignores most dangers

- A cowardly wizard with teleportation magic

You can’t solve the puzzles using just one character.

Use each one wisely to overcome the challenges ahead.

From peaceful forests to dangerous areas filled with bubbling lava,

each world offers a unique theme and a new kind of puzzle experience.

Encounter distinctive monsters and puzzle elements that change with every world.

Every journey deserves a reward.

Collect a variety of unexpected treasures.

Can you gather them all?

For those seeking an extra challenge, side quests are available.

These are high-difficulty modes where you must solve the same level under special conditions.

Give the side quests a try as well.

games.name: Scourge of the Reptiles
games.shortDescription: Command dinosaurs. Master tactical combat. Shape your fate. Scourge of the Reptiles is a party-based tactical RPG set in a prehistoric low-fantasy world, where a devastating meteor grants magical powers to humans, elves… and dinosaurs. The result? War. Chaos. And something far worse.
games.aboutText:
You begin in a quiet village.
But beyond it, kingdoms are already moving, plotting war, seeking power, and unleashing destruction.

Then the impossible happens.

Dinosaurs begin to turn against their masters.

Something is controlling them.
And an army is rising.

Gain the power to control and ride dinosaurs, turning them into your greatest weapon-or your worst enemy.

- Fight alongside powerful reptilian allies

- Face deadly packs and colossal predators

- Choose mounts based on size, role, and tactics

Dinosaurs are not just enemies. They are the battlefield.

Victory is not about brute force-it’s about positioning, planning, and execution.

- Turn-based tactical combat

- Use terrain, height, and flanking to your advantage

- Combine magic, skills, and units for powerful strategies

Every fight is a puzzle.
Every mistake can cost you.

Command a party of warriors, sorcerers, and dinosaur companions-each bringing unique abilities to the battlefield.

- Customize your playstyle with 100+ skills and abilities

- Fight humanoid factions, undead horrors, reptilian threats, and a varied array of monsters

- Adapt your strategy to every encounter

In the world of Odion, dinosaurs once roamed freely, like any other creatures.

Until now.

A dark force is corrupting them, turning nature itself into a weapon.

Uncover the truth behind the rebellion… before it consumes everything.

- 🦖 Turn-based tactical combat

- ⏳ 35-hour campaign across 3 acts

- 🧬 19 dinosaur species

- 🔥 100+ skills and combat abilities

- ⚔️ Fight humans, undead, and massive reptilian foes. Plus a varied array of monsters.

- 🎯 Deep strategy driven by positioning and party composition

games.name: Tearscape
games.shortDescription: As a hunter, you explore a dark, interconnected world filled with dungeons, relying on precise combat to survive. Battle grotesque monsters, expand your arsenal, and uncover hidden paths in a non-linear, pixel art journey.
games.aboutText:
Discover a Gothic world in this 2D top-down action-adventure, blending fast-paced combat, exploration, and pixel art inspired by Game Boy Color classics. Fight monstrous foes, unlock new abilities, and explore a non-linear map filled with hidden secrets and dangerous challenges.

Master precise combat, where every strike and dodge matters. Manage your stamina as you face off against grotesque enemies. You have a limited number of healing flasks so use them wisely. Upgrade your character's stats to remain effective in combat.

Discover powerful new tools hidden in the dungeons that enhance both combat and exploration. Unlock new abilities to defeat enemies more effectively and access hidden paths, uncovering deeper secrets within the world.

Uncover hidden dungeons throughout Tearscape's dark, interconnected world. Each dungeon holds unique challenges, powerful items, and deadly enemies, pushing your combat and exploration skills to the limit.

Face off against challenging bosses: massive, grotesque creatures born from dark experiments. Each encounter demands precise timing, strategy, and mastery of your abilities to emerge victorious.

Explore the vast, interconnected map filled with branching paths, hidden shortcuts, and secret areas. The non-linear design encourages exploration, rewarding you with powerful items and new abilities.

Encounter a diverse cast of NPCs, some offering guidance, others seeking your help, and a few with their own hidden agendas. Every interaction adds depth to the story.

games.name: XENO WIPEOUT!
games.shortDescription: After centuries of invincibility, it became popular for humans to watch live alien hunting shows, participate in alien hunts, save up money, equipment, and use all the loot you find to move on to new maps and defeat more powerful enemies.
games.aboutText:
A long, long time ago, in a solar system not so far away, alien bugs invaded Earth, but they were soon beaten back home, and by the way, their home planet was blown up. After centuries of being invincible, it became popular for humans to watch live alien hunting shows, participate in alien hunts, save up money, equipment, and use the various loot they found to keep going to new maps and defeating more powerful enemies.

9 common monsters
7 types of elite monsters
5 bosses with different mechanisms
Enemies will rush towards you from all directions in each level, so be careful, otherwise you will be torn to pieces in an instant. .

4 optional characters
24 types of talent ability enhancements
26 weapons with different appearance attributes
26 core ability upgrades
8 composable super core synthesis liters
73 kinds of module props
12 kinds of artifacts and props
Each character has different growth routes and active skills. Make full use of these skills and choose the most suitable props for the current hero to achieve mission goals. .

4 maps with different gameplay mechanisms
Each map has different mission objectives and combat mechanisms. Obtaining more resources and achieving various mission objectives can unlock different maps/difficulties, and even new map mechanisms.

games.name: Touhou: Fearless Frogslayer
games.shortDescription: Follow Cirno in this RPG adventure as she travels across Misty Lake and beyond, fighting fierce amphibious opponents, all to fulfill her contractual obligations to a certain disguised figure...
games.aboutText:
A Great Adventure with Cirno!

One sunny morning in Gensokyo, Cirno awakens to find a notice posted outside her house...

Follow the adventure of Cirno and her friend Daiyousei in this turn-based battle RPG, as she ventures far and wide across the Misty Lake, spurred on by her goal: to discover the secrets of a new form of "Ice", entirely unknown to her. Could it be even better than the ice she can conjure...?!

Meeting the Inhabitants of Gensokyo

In this journey, you will meet many familiar faces of the local populace. The game contains a great amount of interactions and cutscenes with in-engine usage of animations, emotes, movements, and other effects to set it apart from the standard dialogue fare; involving the many inhabitants of Gensokyo that Cirno will meet on her quest!

Fierce Foes to be Fought

Across the Misty Lake, many aquatic dangers lie hidden just beneath the water's surface. Cirno will need to face them to reach the end of her journey and emerge victorious!

- Use a growing repertoire of up to 5 different spells to defeat enemies.

- When it is charged, activate Ice Mode to supercharge any one of your powers, temporarily turning it into a different kind of attack!

- Time yourself to the enemy's windups to be able to nimbly dodge almost any attack in the game. Every enemy has a set of unique attacks and animations to learn!

- Record your findings with Cirno's journal, an ingame bestiary of every frog Cirno has vanquished.

- Using the residual magic of her spells, Cirno can charge up to 6 icicles to fire alongside her physical attacks!

With all of these tools combined, you can emerge victorious, and defeat any amphibious foe that lies in your path!!

---------------------------------------------------------------------

Please Note

This videogame is an unofficial fanwork of the Touhou Project. All content featured is within compliance of their guidelines for derivative works.

Please support the original developer's titles, many of which are available on Steam.

games.name: Cursemark
games.shortDescription: Hack, slash, and cast your way through a haunted kingdom brimming with secrets where no two builds are ever the same. As a cursed mage-knight you will unlock devastating spells, equip ability transforming runes, and reforge your curse on the path to victory or death in this fantasy action roguelite.
games.aboutText:
Intense melee and spellcasting combat, near limitless build diversity, and dark mysteries to solve. Forge your path as you explore the Unknown Lands in Cursemark, a fantasy action roguelite.

Define your build and playstyle with runes that change how every ability works by integrating them into your attacks, spells, wards, and ultimates. Add chain lightning to your sword and burst enemies into poison clouds. Multiply your fireball spell and erupt ice pillars from the ground when you cast it. Blind enemies and heal yourself when they strike your ward. The possibilities feel endless.

The Unknown Lands are vast, full of secret passages, hidden relics, and strange sights. The world unravels more and more with each run as you make new discoveries and solve riddles to unlock power and shortcuts. No map-markers, no hand-holding.

Pathfinding is a part of your build as well. Discover permanent shrines and forges that expand your power and rune slots. Upgrade them for future runs and target the blessings best suited to your build as you grow in skill and knowledge.

games.name: ICE on the EDGE
games.shortDescription: Become a coach in ICE on the EDGE, a figure skating simulation game. Train your athlete, master skills, and craft the perfect routine to win. Face fierce rivals and experience a dramatic story carved on the ice. Can your guidance lead them to the highest stage?
games.aboutText:
Aim for the Top! A Figure Skater Training Simulation
Step into the role of a figure skating coach and nurture your athletes to claim victory at the world’s most prestigious competition, “On the Edge.”
This is a training simulation game where you guide vibrant characters and watch them shine through stunning 3D graphics.

Build Your Skater’s Program

You, as the coach, will determine the music , costumes , and techniques your skater performs in competition.

- Will you choose a well-balanced routine that fully utilizes your skater’s abilities?

- Or will you risk it all with high-difficulty elements for a potential dramatic comeback?

The choice is yours. Gauge your skater’s talents and potential to craft the perfect program.

Compete in Tournaments

Take on each competition with the skater you’ve carefully trained!
Your skater will execute the exact program you designed, vying for top placement.
Trust in their abilities and hope for victory!

Multi-Story & Multi-Endings

Rivalries, the outcome of each competition, and your skater’s growth will all influence the direction of the story, leading to multiple possible endings.
What kind of drama awaits, shaped by your guidance and decisions?
Strive for the best ending and create your own unique figure skating tale.

Experience the fusion of strategic training and character-driven drama in this game.
Feel the excitement of the journey to the top, all in your own hands.

games.name: Rise of Lambs : Awakening
games.shortDescription: 《Rise of the Lambs: Awakening》 is a 3D Roguelike where you play as a young lamb. After a brutal coyote pack invades your peaceful sheep tribe, you must protect your home, uncover the truth, and awaken your powers to stop the war and save the world from apocalypse.
games.aboutText:
Dear Players,

We have revamped and updated the new art assets!

At the same time, we are remaking our combat gameplay! With creative hero and skill designs, as well as meticulously crafted skill effects, we will significantly enhance the combat feedback and impact!

Thank you for your patience! We will strive to polish every detail, bringing you innovative and engaging gameplay along with an excellent gaming experience!

——————————————————————————————————————————————

《Rise of the Lambs: Awakening》is a 3D Roguelike game where you play as a young lamb, leading your fellow villagers to resist a brutal coyote invasion, protect your homeland, and uncover the truth about the world. In battle, you can recruit village allies and invite cosmic heroes to join you, strategically combining characters and skills to unleash powerful awakening abilities.

Through brain-computer interface gameplay, enhance your focus to gain combat buffs. As you progress through the story, you'll unlock new heroes and skills, and strengthen character attributes. Ultimately, you will awaken, rally the world, stop the war, redeem the wolf tribe, and prevent the apocalypse.

Unite the lamb village, battle fierce enemies, and save your homeland—become the Lamb Saint and begin your legendary journey!

Background introduction of cosmic heroes

###Superhero: Chuan

He is from the distant Krypton Protoss, the last descendant of the Kryptonian royal family. After Krypton was corrupted and swallowed by the power of the dark abyss, he wandered between galaxies, looking for the traces of the abyss demons and seeking revenge. He was inspired by the high-dimensional soul of Aries to come to the Aries Planet and fight against the dark abyss forces with the Aries. He entered the battlefield with powerful business skills and political wisdom. His goal is not only to conquer the world, but also to break the enemy's camp through clever means and large-scale diplomatic strategies, win more supporters, and finally rebuild a new peaceful order.

###Silicon Valley Iron Man

He traveled to the ancient Martian advanced technological civilization. After the destruction of the Mars Star Wars civilization, he traveled in the universe on a shuttle and learned the interstellar technology of various civilizations. Later, he became a strong teammate of the superhero: Chuan, and together they fought against the dark abyss demons lurking in the universe to maintain the light and peace of the universe. He led many breakthroughs in the technological world. From electric cars to space exploration, he has changed almost all industries. He also has to use his deep understanding of technology to develop new weapons, equipment and ships to conquer this new universe, and finally realize his dream - to enable humans to not only conquer the earth, but also maintain peace in the galaxy.

###The Polar Bear King

Ruler of the Northern Kingdom on Sheep Planet, he leads his people in a valiant struggle against the wolf clan corrupted by the power of the Abyss, standing firm on the northern frontlines to desperately halt the dark forces from further eroding the lands of Sheep Planet.

In this battle spanning multiple worlds, Vladimir will wield his unparalleled leadership and combat prowess to lead his army across the battlefield, conquer his enemies, and ultimately restore peace to the world.

###The West Holy King

A high-dimensional ascended master from beyond the cosmos, he descended into the material universe after undergoing multiple dimensional reductions. Spreading the wisdom of the Divine Kingdom throughout the cosmos, he is dedicated to building a universal utopia of harmony. However, the Abyssal Demons covet the abundant spiritual energy of this universe, constantly sabotaging and thwarting the Holy King of the West’s plans.

The initial Early Access release includes:

10-15 sheep heroes, each with their own strengths, team up to obtain their soul skills, and freely match skills.

7 superheroes, awakening big moves, full-screen instant monsters, shocking the audience, waiting for you to release.

7 different theme maps, each map is carefully designed based on the plot advancement.

Infinite mode, challenge your operating limits, world ranking, and compete with other players.

3 game modes: normal, difficult, nightmare, different mechanisms, different challenges, very high replayability.

7 deadly sin wolf kings and dozens of elite monsters, unique skill designs and behavior patterns, the combat mechanism is more rich and interesting.

Rewards are scattered throughout the realm, and tasks or challenges are always provided in a game.

More than 100 monsters and dozens of special monster skills make the battle always full of variables.

Game progress update:

1. Sheep Village, battle scenes are re-arranged, and the art quality is improved.

2. Add the main storyline, advance the storyline while fighting, understand the origin of the world crisis and dark forces, resolve the cont

games.name: Infinitory
games.shortDescription: Infinitory mixes city-building, automation, and tower defense in a in a rogue-lite top-down game. Expand your base vertically in limited space, a strategic planning challenge. Automate resources to produce ammunition and upgrades, crucial for stopping waves of enemies on procedurally generated maps.
games.aboutText:
Infinitory combines city-building , automation , and tower defense in a rogue-lite , top-down experience. Construct a sprawling vertical factory in limited space, automate the production of vital resources, and defend against relentless waves of enemies in procedurally generated environments.
Every playthrough offers new challenges, with varying drop zones and unpredictable terrain. As you fight to reclaim Earth’s resources, each mission will demand fresh strategies, ensuring each experience is unique as you fight to secure humanity’s survival.

VFC-89 - The Mysterious Event

A global catastrophe has left Earth overrun by terrifying creatures. While the full details remain classified, you know enough: vital resources must be reclaimed from the planet to ensure humanity’s survival aboard orbital sanctuaries. As a commander, it’s your job to venture into this hostile environment and secure what’s needed at any cost.

Construct – Build Vertically

In Infinitory , ground space is limited, forcing you to expand your factory vertically . Strategically plan your multi-layered factory, making the most of every available inch to automate production and manage resources efficiently.

Automate – Power Your Factory

Automation is key to success. Set up production lines to process resources into valuable materials. Every item from ammunition for your defensive towers to upgrades for your base must be efficiently produced to keep your factory running and protected.

Defend – Survive the Invasion

Building your factory isn’t enough, protecting it is essential. As your factory grows, it will attract relentless threats. Construct defenses and supply them with the necessary resources. Each decision you make is crucial Strategic placement, resource management, and quick adaptation will determine whether your base survives or falls.

Evolve – Adapt and Overcome

No two missions are the same. Each run lets you refine your strategy, adjusting your approach based on the environment and challenges ahead. Select your drop zone carefully, adapt to the terrain’s unique obstacles, and learn from past failures to increase your chances of success in future missions.

Features

- Vertical City-Building : Build upwards, managing space strategically as you expand your multi-layered factory.

- Automation : Create complex production lines to gather and refine resources, ensuring a steady flow of supplies.

- Tower Defense : Defend your base by constructing and maintaining defensive towers, each requiring specific ammunition.

- Rogue-Lite Gameplay : Procedurally generated maps, evolving challenges, and tech-tree bonuses that unlock as you progress make every playthrough unique.

- Enemy Variety : Battle against a wide array of mutated creatures, each offering new challenges and requiring different strategies to defeat.

Join the Community!

Connect with other commanders. Help shape the future of Infinitory and stay up-to-date with the latest news and development updates.

- Join us on Discord to chat with the developer and other players.

- Wishlist Infinitory on Steam to be notified when the game launches!

games.name: you're just imagining it
games.shortDescription: A chronic illness simulator. You think you have a chronic illness, but you don't know what. All you know is you are always in some state of pain. You've been to too many doctors to count... but you still have to live your life.
games.aboutText:
Caution: This game is not meant to be medical advice. It's also not very fun.

A chronic illness simulation game.

You think you have a chronic illness, but you don't know what. All you know is you are always in some state of pain. You've been to too many doctors to count... but you still have to live your life.

How long will it take for you to get a diagnosis?

Play time is ~30 minutes.

FEATURES

- Stressful schedule management as you try to balance living your life and dealing with pain

- Different doctors who tell you your chronic pain is made up

- Cool and minimal soundtrack by sdhizumi

games.name: VOIDFACE
games.shortDescription: Face off in this challenging bullet-hell arena shooter, and try to clear bite-sized boss rush encounters. Learn to dodge their attacks, cast offensive and defensive spells, and kill everything that gets in your way.
games.aboutText:
In VOIDFACE , every enemy is a boss fight, bullet hell patterns litter the screen, and you only get one life. Think you have what it takes? Maybe, but be prepared to die. A LOT.

Dodge and shoot your way through challenging encounters. Dismantle each boss piece-by-piece and get familiar with carefully handcrafted bullet patterns and attacks.

Unlock all the hats and artworks! Because survival shouldn't come at the cost of style.

Employ game-changing spells to give you an edge. Some are easier than others to master, but they can be key to survival.

Good luck, have fun!

games.name: Am I Nima
games.shortDescription: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.
games.aboutText:
You don't remember who you are. Act like her. Talk like her.

Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you play as Nima, a girl who has lost all her memories and is being trapped in the basement by her mother. To escape, all you have to do is pass your mom’s tests and convince her that you really are her daughter.

As you explore, you uncover words tied to the objects around you: a worn-out plushie, a locked drawer, an old note scribbled in hurried handwriting. These words represent Nima's thoughts and emotions, giving you a peek into how Nima thinks and feels.

However, to really find the truth, you must actively combine words in Nima's mind, experimenting with different pairings to unlock deeper meanings and access buried memories.

When it comes to the tests, you’ll use your new found words to direct the conversation. Choose your words carefully, as they will change how Nima responds to her mom. Will you tell her what she wants to hear? Or will you probe her for the truth?

The more you uncover, the more questions arise: Why has your mother locked you in the basement? What do these tests mean? And are you really Nima?

games.name: Blitloop
games.shortDescription: A fast-paced, side-scrolling retro shooter where you play as “Blit" on a mission to rescue orb pods. Blast enemy swarms and face off against bosses in this bullet-hell shoot 'em up. Earn power-ups and get ready for fluid arcade action in a stylish world with an 80s synthwave soundtrack.
games.aboutText:
Blitloop is a fast-paced, retro-styled space arcade shooter. You play as “Blit” on a mission to rescue orb pods and save the galaxy. Take down countless enemy ships and face massive bosses as you zip through a stylish world. And at the same time, rush to rescue the pods scattered across the level before they are captured by the enemy.

Blitloop blends the spirit and intensity of 1980s arcade old-school SHMUPs with the tactical elements of modern hardcore bullet hell shoot 'em ups. Earn power-ups to enhance the ship’s weapons, keep the bombs and missiles fully stocked, and prepare for fluid arcade action, stylish graphics, and an '80s synthwave soundtrack.

Achieve a high score by keeping the score multiplier at its maximum and planning for additional combos. Story

In the future, the Galactic Federation and the pirates of planet Zirkoid are at war. On planet EX4042, the Galactic Federation is mining a powerful orb that powers all crafts and weapons that are keeping the pirates at bay.

An infiltrator droid from Zirkoid intercepted the information of the whereabouts of EX4042 and sent a fleet of forces to steal pods containing the valuable minerals.

The Federation was taken by surprise and was immediately outnumbered. This can be the end of the prosperous Federation and lead to a new era of darkness where pirates of Zirkoid could destroy countless planetary systems.

But all hope is not lost…

Meet Blit, a space bounty hunter that was tracking down a Kessel smuggler in a nearby solar system. She picked up the distress calls from EX4042 and immediately changed course, making her way to the orb mining planet

With her genetically modified spaceship that can absorb orb minerals to enhance into a range of weaponry, Blit is the Federation’s last hope to stop a galactic destruction. Game Features

- Over 50 attack waves of enemies spread across 4 stylish worlds.

- Upgrade and switch between weapons to maintain a tactical advantage when facing bosses.

- Use shockwave bombs to clear out bullets and low-health enemies when the action gets too hot.

- Fire homing missiles to prevent pods from being captured across the world.

- Activate your shield when extra protection is needed.

- Defeat enemies at a fast pace to keep your score multiplier maxed out.

- Take down enemy formations to trigger combo bonuses and boost the score multiplier.

- A training world is available for new recruits.

- Four difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, Hard, and Maniac. Adapt your tactics based on the challenge.

- Collect achievements and climb the leaderboard.

- Full game controller support.

games.name: Skeleseller
games.shortDescription: You're a skeleton shopkeep who hires adventurers to collect loot for you after your untimely demise. Send adventurers into battle, sell what they find, and build up your town in this laid-back idle game!
games.aboutText:
Story

Your dream was to be an adventurer. You were out questing one day when you encountered a poisonous snake. You won the fight handily, but the poison started wearing you down. You headed to the nearest town, but with no antidote actually there for sale, you died.

You come back as a skeleton. You decide that your fate should never beset another adventurer. Unfortunately, with your adventuring career behind you, you need to recruit others to gather loot for you. Hire adventurers, send them into battle, acquire loot, and SELL, SELL, SELL! 💸 Use the gold you get to upgrade your town and adventurers.

Gameplay

Skeleseller is laid-back and casual :

- There's nothing to rush you in the game, so take things at your own pace.

- Experiment! You can change adventurer skills for free.

Skeleseller also bucks the trends of traditional idle games:

- Finite gameplay: you won't be waiting for hours or days to unlock the next big upgrade! The demo contains ~20-30 minutes of gameplay. The full game has ~5 hours for Story Mode and another ~5 hours for an extra mode that you can unlock. 🤫

- No scientific notation needed—numbers stay within the realm of human understandability.

- No systems just for the sake of them: prestige/ascensions, experience points, and equipment are eschewed in favor of mechanics crafted for Skeleseller's design philosophy: keep the game fun and casual .

While most of the game is automated, you'll perform high-level actions like:

- Hiring adventurers, forming parties with them, and choosing where they'll battle

- Leveling up adventurers and choosing their skills

- Prioritizing how you want to develop and upgrade your town

- Helping out occasionally—stock shops or harvest crops manually to speed things up

games.name: Click Mage
games.shortDescription: Click Mage is a unique 2D resource gatherer and building game. Mine and process resources, upgrade your clicking power and construct buildings on an idyllic island with beautiful pixel art graphics.
games.aboutText:
Click Mage is a unique 2D resource gatherer and building game. Harvest, collect and process resources, upgrade your clicking power and construct buildings to escape from the island.

As an apprentice to the famous Click Mage, you have been teleported to a remote island by a magical accident. Upgrade your Click Powers with the help of a mysterious obelisk, trade with the merchant, use the island's resources and build a portal to get back home.

Features

- Explore a beautiful pixel art island

- Harvest resources by clicking and use them to build production buildings to further process them

- Handle manageable amounts of resources

- No more meaningless millions and billions of an arbitrary resource

- Harvest your 5 wood and carry them yourself

- Upgrade your click power, carrying capacity, auto click speed and much more

- Buy blueprints from the trader, construct new buildings and unlock new resources

games.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tactical Takedown
games.shortDescription: Splinter and Shredder are dead. Help the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles tackle deadly new threats and the approach of adulthood in this fast-paced turn-based beat-em-up!
games.aboutText:
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tactical Takedown is the first-ever turn-based TMNT video game. Inspired by the classic cartoon, you'll experience a bold new approach to the world of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles! Splinter and Shredder are dead, and as the Turtles approach adulthood, they're not just growing up... they're growing apart.

Battle the Foot Clan as a powerful new leader takes control in action-packed campaigns that showcase each Turtle individually. Carve through enemies in 20 constantly-mutating levels that grow, shrink, and add new threats with each turn, inspired by classic TMNT games! Rack up points for high scores while experiencing a powerful original Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles story from acclaimed indie studio Strange Scaffold.

This is the next step for Michelangelo, Donatello, Leonardo, and Raphael--and you can experience it with flying, slashing figurines in graphic novel-inspired splendor.

Features

- 20 action-packed levels, divided into campaigns focusing on individual characters.

- A unique take on the world of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles from the minds at Strange Scaffold (Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator, I Am Your Beast).

- Innovative turn-based beat-em-up combat, complete with mutating arenas.

- Gorgeous graphic novel-inspired art style, with paint splatter, figurines, and diorama setpieces.

- Customizable movesets to shape each Turtles' playstyle

- Thumping multi-genre soundtrack from award-winning composer RJ Lake (Unbeatable, I Am Your Beast).

games.name: Dead Engine
games.shortDescription: Fight to survive against zombies in a pixel-art post-apocalyptic city. Loot and merge items, expand your backpack. In your camp, recruit survivors but burn the bitten. Trading uncovers haunting survivor stories.
games.aboutText:
Dead Engine is a survival action-roguelike where players explore a post-apocalyptic city overrun by intelligent zombie threats. Each choice to fight or flee impacts survival as zombies actively track, adapt, and work together to hunt their prey. Loot critical items and manage your expandable backpack every item could mean the difference between life and death.

Hand-Drawn Pixel Environment and Survival Tactics

Our post-apocalyptic world comes alive through hand-drawn pixel art, where every corner of the carefully crafted maps holds strategic potential. Plan your escape routes, set clever traps, and transform city ruins into deadly obstacles. Your survival depends on how well you use the terrain against the zombie hordes.

Camp Management

The camp is a living system that requires constant management. When morale, hygiene, shelter, and resources fall out of balance, order within the camp quickly collapses. Keep the fire burning, build shelters, clean up poop, and maintain survivor morale. Every decision you make directly shapes the future of your camp.

The Future of Your Camp is in Your Hands

Some survivors will want to join your camp and improve your chances of survival, but you cannot know who will turn into a zombie as they may hide it from you. Be careful and check everyone at the gate. Others may not want to join but still seek to trade, so listen to their requests carefully. By selling them items they desperately need, you will not only earn more scrap but also uncover their haunting survival stories.

Advanced Zombie AI

Zombies in Dead Engine think, adapt, and hunt as a collective threat. Our unique pathfinding system enables them to intelligently move through the city, adjusting their routes based on your position. When they spot others nearby, they merge into dangerous hunting hordes. Ranged zombies bring another layer of challenge - they'll keep their distance while attacking and launch acid bombs over structures if you try to hide.

Expandable Backpack and Inventory Management

Find backpacks and expand them to carry more items. Merge items to free up space and customize your backpack to match your playstyle while exploring the city and fighting zombies. A well-upgraded backpack can be the key to survival.

Unique Characters and Journeys

Scattered across the map, characters await for your paths to cross but only if you can follow their traces. Each encounter offers a new perspective and a different way to survive. Explore, connect, and remember: you're not alone in this dangerous world. And when you discover a character, you’ll unlock the ability to play as them. Every meeting takes you deeper into the city, and into yourself.

Features

- Intense 10-20 Minute Survival Runs

- Camp Management System : Control who enters your camp: accept, reject, or kill.

- Advanced Zombie AI with Dynamic Horde Behavior

- Hand-Crafted Pixel Art Environment

- Dynamic Environment with Strategic Traps and Defensive Turrets

- Inventory Management System

- Mergeable Items

- Expandable Backpack

- Base Building & Trading System

- Rich Survivor Stories to Uncover

- 4 Unique Playable Characters

- Roguelike Progression System

games.name: Mech Havoc
games.shortDescription: Sandbox of destruction. Billion different ways to build your mech. Feel the weight and impact of obliteration in this modern old school mech combat sim.
games.aboutText:
The rogue AI HIVE has seized control of the planet. Now it's up to you to WREAK HAVOC! Take command of a deadly fleet of war machines. From nimble weaponized delivery trucks to towering heavy Mechs.

Complete missions, upgrade your arsenal, and equip your machine with powerful weapons . When firepower isn't enough, unleash artillery strikes and crush waves of killer robots in explosive battles.

Unlock high-tech equipment like lasers, railguns and experimental mechs. Or go all-in with missile barrages and heavy tanks. Build your perfect loadout and dominate the battlefield your way.

Call in devastating artillery strikes , deploy turrets to lock down choke points, and launch drones to harass enemy swarms. Well-timed tactical abilities can turn the tide of battle against the endless hordes of HIVE killing machines!

Face off against a variety of hostile automatons , each with unique strengths and weaknesses. Clear swarms of detonating drones with grenades, or bring out the heavy guns to dismantle towering war machines .

Features

- Control a wide range of war machines. From towering mechs to tanks and fast-moving vehicles.

- Unlock a vast arsenal of weapons.

- Deploy powerful support abilities like artillery strikes, automated turrets, and combat drones.

- Destroy cover and alter the battlefield with fully destructible environments

- Battle across diverse landscapes: deserts, frozen wastelands and sprawling cities.

games.name: Conquest Dark
games.shortDescription: Experience an ARPG's rapid ascension to power in minutes, packed with savage, survivors-like action and devastating sword & sorcery combat. Perfect your builds through Dark Ritual runs that will decide humanity's future as you battle endless hordes across haunting ruins and cursed kingdoms.
games.aboutText:
237 years after the Black Planet's arrival, humanity stands on the brink of annihilation. The undead armies have laid waste to the kingdoms of mankind, the Cosmic Gods have fallen, and the Primordial Ones have awakened from their ancient slumber. Now, champions and criminals alike perform Dark Rituals to face the very forces that brought civilization to its knees.

MASTER THE DARK RITUALS

Venture into haunting environments where cosmic horror meets primal savagery. Choose your path from legendary classes like the untamed Barbarians of the Lion, the divine Oathkeepers, or the mysterious Acolytes of Kuu, each mastering unique powers against the darkness.

INSTANT ACTION RPG GRATIFICATION

Unlock your power fantasy through intense Ritual runs. Begin as a feeble grunt and discover devastating builds as you progress. Every Ritual delivers the satisfying progression curve of an ARPG in concentrated form, each run bringing you closer to legend status.

FORGE GODSLAYING BUILDS

Discover eldritch abilities, equip legendary armor, and wield unique weapons from fallen champions. Enhance your arsenal and craft builds worthy of slaying gods. Theory-craft your way to godhood with deep customization and endless possibilities.

CONQUER THE DARKNESS

Battle through diverse environments filled with unique challenges and fearsome mini-bosses. Face deadly creatures, undead armies, and fallen heroes in your quest to uncover the secrets of The Black Planet.

SAVAGE SWORD & SORCERY

Experience a brutal realm of sword & sorcery inspired by the greatest dark fantasy classics of old. Ancient powers and cosmic horrors lurk in every cursed ruin and fallen kingdom.

games.name: Memoria Wake
games.shortDescription: Parry with precision and fight through shifting, surreal landscapes in this dream-like action-adventure. When reality turns into a living nightmare, you must ascend through a shattered realm to rescue a missing friend.
games.aboutText:
Wake up in a fragmented land of shadows and light, armed with nothing but a weaponized umbrella. To find your way back, The Dreamer must traverse an out-of-this-world landscape, piecing together a broken past while fending off the hostile creatures that inhabit it.

Master Tight, Tactical Combat

- Master tight, souls-like combat where each encounter requires patience and intelligence.

- Dodge to avoid enemy attacks and parry attacks at the right moment to open up enemies to crushing blows, turning their strength against them with finesse!

Overcome Legendary Foes

- Overcome more than 15 bosses! Decide your own fate by battling against towering foes and conquer unique challenges that will push you to your limits.

Evolve Your Kit

- Unlock 4 powerful secondary weapons and a diverse set of lethal abilities to customize your playstyle.

- Scour the world for game-changing artifacts that unlock new combat mechanics and puzzle-solving abilities, allowing you to access hidden depths of the dream.

- Every heal is a choice. Unleash special attacks and abilities wisely, as they share the same pool of energy as your healing items!

Explore a Fragmented Dream

- Discover the meaning behind the strange, shadowy figures of this world, and find a long-lost friend that holds a special connection with you in your waking hours…

- Traverse a hand-crafted world where beauty and horror intertwine. Uncover long buried truths, face twisted memories, and piece together the fragments of a broken past.

Are you ready to uncover long-buried truths, face twisted memories, and decide your own fate?

games.name: Into the Void
games.shortDescription: Into The Void is an action packed high-speed retro shooter that follows the story of John Void, a man returned from the dead with no memories. Will you uncover the secrets of his life? Or will you simply do as you’re told?
games.aboutText:
[ About ]

Into the Void is a fast-paced retro FPS game inspired by the adrenaline-pumping experiences of Post Void and ULTRAKILL.
It features fast-paced action, intense combat, and the thrill of audacious gameplay with a distinctive, unique art style.

[ Features ]

- Clean and fast-paced, thrilling gameplay

- Unique weapons and health systems, with various movement techniques and power-ups to break speed limits

- Stylish black & white art styles

[ And More... ]

- Various challenge modes! (No death, no kill, etc.)

- Tons of hidden secrets!

- A story that changes based on your playstyle!

And also...

DESTROY THE CORE DESTROY THE CORE DESTROY THE CORE DESTROY THE CORE DESTROY THE CORE DESTROY THE CORE
