games.name: Psychopomp GOLD
games.shortDescription: Psychopomp is BACK. The catacombs stretch down farther than ever before. Your entire life has been a lie. Delve into the depths, and discover the horrors that lie below. More realms, more modes, more secrets. An ancient voice calls to you from the center of the earth. Will you answer it?
games.aboutText:
Return to the world of Psychopomp .

Hidden under every building, under every place, is a catacomb.

Labyrinths stretching down into the bowels and guts of the world.

Everyone has known about them. Everyone has lied to you about them.

Descend into the depths, discover what awaits.

The hit horror dungeon crawler is BACK!

Now with all sorts of new horrifying cool stuff to see!

Explore a classic 3D dungeon crawler world, discover secrets below, and find the truth that awaits. Bizarre, unique creatures are at every turn, and even weirder things lie below!

Psychopomp GOLD features:

- All new levels - Delve deeper than ever before!

- Remastered Levels - See the horrors in a brand new light!

- New Modes and Secrets - Discover what is to be seen. Find what has been hidden from you.

- New Endings!

- Improved old Endings!

- Mod and Custom Level Support - The Catacombs will Never End!

- New Prerendered Cutscenes - Get a Cinematic Feel.

- Third Person Mode - A new view on life!

Enter the catacombs, and immerse yourself in a world that only grows darker the deeper you get. This meat is what the world is made of.

Keep your wits about you, watch your back, and survive.

Warning: Psychopomp is designed around the Vulkan renderer, which may not work on older PCs. The game can run on OpenGL, but it is not recommended.

games.name: Starfinder: Afterlight
games.shortDescription: Starfinder: Afterlight is a party-based RPG that brings Paizo's beloved science-fantasy universe to life. Battle across the Pact Worlds, lead a legendary crew where your choices shape their destiny, and well, save the galaxy while you're at it!
games.aboutText:
Gather your crew and venture into the Pact Worlds in a tale of unlikely heroes, cosmic wonders, and the bonds that define us.

The galaxy faces annihilation, your captain has vanished, and doomsday looms. Assemble a crew of misfits from across the stars and become the legends in this single-player party-based RPG .

Find 6 unique companions scattered across the stars, from android assassins to mystic prophets. Each brings personal stories and moral dilemmas. The bonds you forge through triumph and loss will determine their destinies, and whether the galaxy survives.

Experience turn-based tactical combat with Starfinder's classes, Soldier, Envoy, Operative, Mystic, Solarian and Witchwarper. Use Paizo's critically acclaimed three-action system to fuel endless strategies. Level up and collect alien gear while battling everything from Hellknights to digital ghosts .

Experience a branching narrative where choices matter. Nothing is forbidden, everything has consequences. Choose salvation or profit, mercy or vengeance. Factions remember your deeds, companions judge your heart, Your legend is yours to write.

From Absalom Station to Eox's undead empire, from digital gods to cosmic dragons. Explore the Pact Worlds across 40-60 hours of adventure where magic and technology unite. In this universe, everything is possible, and probably is trying to kill you.

games.name: Shooters, Ready!
games.shortDescription: 「青春 x スポーツシューティング」がコンセプトの アーケードスタイルFPSゲームです。連続した部屋を素早く駆け抜け 点在するターゲットを倒しましょう。素早く 精密に 連続して倒すことが出来れば より高得点が狙えます。
games.aboutText:
――「これが私達の　青春だ！！」――

『シューターズ レディ！』 は　 「青春 x スポーツシューティング」 がコンセプトの
アーケードスタイルFPSゲーム です。

舞台となるのは　スポーツシューティングが国民的人気を博している　並行世界の現代日本。
3人の女子高生を主人公にした　汗と涙と硝煙の世界へようこそ！！

いわゆる『腰だめ撃ち』や『スプリント』を廃した　個性的ながらもとっつきやすい操作系と
他に類を見ない　ひときわ強いリコイル（女子高生なので）が特徴！

連続した部屋を素早く駆け抜け　点在するターゲットを倒しましょう。
素早く　精密に　連続して倒すことが出来れば　より高得点が狙えます。

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ストーリーモード

2009年　夏　群馬県かみかわ町。

周囲を山に囲まれた　この小さな温泉街に　東京生まれ・東京育ちの高校1年生
「吉本 恵那」が引っ越してくるところから　物語が始まります。

付近の高校から　生徒が集まって活動しているという『かみかわ合同射撃部』で待っていたのは
なんだか頼りない「飯田 茜」部長と　やたらグイグイ来る「瑞浪 芽衣」副部長。

順風満帆に見えた部活動ですが　どうやら一筋縄では行かないようで……！？

たった3人で全国を目指す　青春ショートストーリー！！

（プレイ時間：30分～60分程度）

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

アーケードモード

ハイテンポなスポーツシューティングに　ランダムなカードの購入／成長要素を盛り込んだ
本作のメインコンテンツです！

残り時間を消費してカードを購入し　武器をカスタマイズしたり　ステータスを成長させて
より高難易度のステージへ挑みましょう！

初期ステータスの異なる　3人のプレイヤーキャラクターと
個性豊かな　3種類+シークレット1種類の武器を　自由な組み合わせで選択可能。

お気に入りの組み合わせを見つけて　ハイスコアを目指しましょう！！

（プレイ時間：1プレイ10分程度）

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

その他

更に　こだわりの機能として　アーケードモードでは
各キャラクターに眼鏡を掛けさせたり　制服を選択することが可能！！

更に　ストーリーのその後を描いた　おまけコンテンツも同時に収録！
（ゲームを進めると開放されます）

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Q&A

Q. アップデートの予定はありますか？

　→　バグフィックス等のアップデートは必要に応じて検討致しますが、新たなコンテンツを追加していく予定はありません。予めご承知おき下さい。

Q. アーケードモードのランキングは　オンラインランキングに対応していますか？

　→　対応していません。ローカルランキングのみとなります。

Q. ゲームパッドに対応していますか？

　→　対応していません。

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

配信ガイドライン

以下の内容に抵触しない範囲であれば　自由に配信して頂けます。
配信者／投稿者の所属の如何や　収益化等の有無は問いません。

- 特定の信条や宗教、または政治的な目的のために本作品を使用すること

- 本作品の開発／販売元を騙ること

- その他、本作品及び関係者の社会的品位を著しく下げうるような表現や使い方をすること

games.name: 7 Days
games.shortDescription: Step into a world where dreams and reality mix. You find yourself in a dream-like world, and explore a different traumatic experience each day. Your choice determines if the boy accepts these moments and moves on, or stays in the past.
games.aboutText:
Step into a world where dreams and reality mix.

Play as a boy trapped between waking life and a dream, exploring his memories each day. Each day uncovers a different part of his life, from school and family to love and loss. Your choices influence his journey: will he find hope and awaken, or remain lost in darkness?

- Explore hand-drawn environments that bring the boy’s memories to life

- Shape the boy's fate with your choices: confront trauma or remain stuck in the past

- Uncover flashbacks by becoming a ghost and witnessing moments from the boy’s life

- Solve simple puzzles and overcome challenges to progress through the story

- Experience a soundtrack that contains 84 tracks and reflects the game’s atmosphere, blending calm, energy, and emotion

- 4 Main routes

- Option to reduce cutscenes' brightness/speed

- K-pop!

games.name: Mycopunk
games.shortDescription: Cut through fungal aliens in this hyper-customizable, mission based looter shooter. Hundreds of hand-crafted upgrades, 4-player co-op, and a little roach man. What’s not to love?
games.aboutText:
A ragtag squad of robot rejects is hired by the SAXON corporation and given one last shot at profitable glory (and avoiding the scrap heap). They are the New Atlas Hazard Crew, a ramshackle squad of exterminators sent to uncover the mysteries behind a planet-wide fungal catastrophe.

Embark on a series of dangerous planet-side missions to drive back the mycological menace. Could this be a simple natural disaster like they claim? And did SAXON really misfile your taxes? Or was that your own fault?

Choose from an outrageous arsenal of advanced futuristic weaponry (and some power tools), then supercharge them in a one-of-a-kind grid-based upgrade system to create the ridiculous sci-fi super-weapon of your dreams.

Slaughter hordes of enemies as they corrupt and weaponize the planet's technology against you. Pick crawlies apart piece by piece — but be wary, whatever they drop could be grabbed up by another enemy.

Every mission grants new mods to jam into your upgrade grids. Mix em, match em, and stack em. Whatever upgrades you can fit in are fair game. Piece by piece, your scrappy robots and weapons mutate into finely-tuned death machines (or horrible mistakes of engineering, up to you). Spec into being a healing support, put a deflector shield on a chainsaw, or turn yourself into a bomb (we don't really care).

Let off steam between missions in an orbital dropship packed with toys and games. Hang out with your friends, uncover more about the galaxy, and shoot the breeze with the insectoid SAXON veteran Roachard Cox.

games.name: Virtual Interactive Fireplace
games.shortDescription: A cozy, retro-inspired hearth to warm your screen and your spirit.
games.aboutText:
Settle in by the crackling glow of Virtual Interactive Fireplace , a nostalgic and cozy simulation that turns any screen into a peaceful hearthside retreat. With just a click, light the fire and let the warmth of retro-inspired graphics fill the room. Listen as gentle pops and flickers mingle with ambient crackles, offering a sensory escape perfect for cozy autumn nights, chilly winter evenings, or festive holiday gatherings.

Whether you use it to create ambiance during a holiday party, unwind after a long day, or enjoy a moment of peaceful solitude, this interactive fireplace fills your space with calm and warmth. Perfect for gamers, holiday lovers, or anyone seeking a little peace, this cozy simulation captures the spirit of gathering around a fire without ever needing to leave your seat.

How to Play:

- Place the tinder in the fireplace first.

- Light a match and use it to ignite the tinder.

- Use the burning tinder to light the logs.

- Logs will catch fire, and your cozy fire will start!

games.name: Piece by Piece
games.shortDescription: Piece by Piece is a literal puzzle platformer where each level is fragmented into puzzle pieces. Clear each puzzle by connecting and unconnecting each piece to make your way through each of our 100 handcrafted levels. Discover new themes and mechanics along the way!
games.aboutText:
Piece by Piece is a literal puzzle-platformer where each level is fragmented into jigsaw pieces.

With 100 handcrafted levels across 12 puzzle box, Piece by Piece will test even the most hardcore of puzzle solvers with new types of puzzle pieces that combine in puzzles the deeper you get. A cozy art style and an ethereal soundtrack keep you in flow as you solve your way through each puzzle box.

12 Puzzle Boxes. 100 Puzzles.

Explore 12 puzzle boxes that introduce a new theme and mechanic that changes the way you solve each puzzle.

Advanced Puzzle Boxes

Hybrid puzzle boxes combine themes and mechanics into a single level, testing your mastery of each new mechanic. Can you make your way through all 100 levels? Make sure to collect the gold puzzle piece in each level!

games.name: Bloxpath
games.shortDescription: A minimalist roll playing puzzle game. About 10 unique puzzle mechanics, around 200 puzzles, and satisfying smooth procedural animations.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Bloxpath — a puzzle game centered around rolling blocks , inspired by the classic Flash game Bloxorz. If you love pure puzzle challenges or are tired of the monotony of pushing boxes, this game will bring you a whole new level of fun!

Game Features

- A Wealth of Puzzles to Solve : Includes approximately 200 meticulously designed puzzles and over 20 unique gameplay mechanics , featuring a large map divided into regions. Each region offers puzzles with distinct styles, challenging different aspects of your thinking.

- 10 Core Mechanics : From simple block rolling to complex multi-block interactions, the gameplay progresses layer by layer, continuously sparking your curiosity.

- Tree-like Unlocking System : Puzzles are unlocked in a tree structure, allowing you to switch to other regions for exploration when stuck, keeping the game flow uninterrupted.

- Ultimate Control Experience : Supports keyboard, mouse, and controller inputs, with input buffering and configurable repeat input delays to ensure smooth and fluid controls, letting you focus on solving puzzles.

- Zero Loading, Seamless Transitions : Except for the initial launch, the game has no loading screens throughout, with all scenes and animations switching in real-time.

- High-Performance Optimization : With vertical sync turned off, the frame rate is fully unlocked, allowing players with high-refresh-rate monitors to enjoy the ultimate smoothness of block rolling.

- Visual Delight : The game is themed around blocks, with natural and smooth state transition animations and meticulously polished level transition effects, satisfying the aesthetic needs of OCD players.

Puzzle Design Philosophy

When creating Bloxpath, my goal was to immerse players in the pure joy of puzzle-solving without being bogged down by cumbersome rules. Here are my core principles:

- Challenging but Not Overwhelming : Puzzles are designed to be concise and efficient, avoiding lengthy steps, with a moderate difficulty level suitable for players with puzzle experience.

- Progressive Difficulty : Early puzzles help you get familiar with the mechanics, while later ones challenge your inspiration and insight.

- Diverse Approaches : Puzzles in different regions have unique solutions, allowing you to experience a variety of puzzle-solving fun rather than a single routine.

A Word from the Developer

As a programmer, I am almost obsessive in my pursuit of performance and experience. Bloxpath is not just a puzzle game; it is my dedication to detail. From seamless scene transitions to smooth controls, every aspect has been crafted with care. I hope you find the thrill of puzzle-solving in the game and enjoy every "aha" moment.

"Tired of pushing boxes? Come roll some blocks and give your brain a new challenge!"

games.name: 异世轮回录：If
games.shortDescription: 诸君！这个世界很无趣。生为牛马，我只是一个行走的NPC。谁不想当主角？ 在地球OL已经不可能办到了。但至少在异世轮回录中，我们可以！《异世轮回录：If》是一款多结局多周目轮回式人生模拟团队卡牌肉鸽游戏。你被女神召唤来到剑与魔法的异世界，新的人生你要选择怎么样的天赋？本以为是一次王道转生，但没想到这个世界危机重重，选错一步就只能迎接死亡。无数次轮回，你一点点探寻这个世界的隐秘，在最后的世界线，或许就是所有人都能幸福的Happy End?
games.aboutText:
《异世轮回录》是一款多周目轮回式Rougelike人生模拟养成类游戏。

你被女神召唤，转生到一个剑与魔法的异世界。

本以为是王道剧情，没想到这个世界的诡秘超乎你的想象。

从零开始，挖掘这个世界的秘密。

每一次死亡，都将引导你前往新的世界线。

qq群：832191057，欢迎来催我进度。

- 开局自选天赋

每轮回人生开始，玩家可以自选天赋，确保每一局的新奇体验。

- 多选项随机事件

每回合多种随机事件，多个选项决定事件发展，每一次选择都至关重要。

- 多周目剧情

每一周目都有不同的随机事件，玩家通过上一个周目收集的信息可以改变下一个周目剧情的走向，以达成不同的结局。

- 好感度系统

游戏中有NPC好感度系统，玩家可以培养NPC的好感度，解锁相应的好感度剧情。

- 探索未知的深渊地下城

在这个剑与魔法的异世界里，有一个巨大的深不见底的深渊，玩家需要组建队伍去探索深渊，击败深渊中的魔物，获得强力的装备和遗物，提升自己。以待后续未知的挑战。

- rougelike卡牌构筑玩法。

游戏的角色养成是一个颇有深度的卡牌构筑玩法。并且在其中加入了一点点rouge，玩家所操控的角色在升级之后将会随机三张技能卡中挑选一张加入自己的牌组。在深渊探索之中，也有机会获得一些技能卡牌。通过玩家的抉择，一步步构建自己的最终流派。

- 回合制卡牌战斗

游戏的战斗系统是回合制卡牌战斗，每回合获得抽卡，在自己的回合内根据战斗场面策略性地打出卡牌，触发多样的效果，对敌人造成伤害，击败所有敌人获得胜利。

- 迎击宿命之敌

在玩家的轮回故事中，迎击宿命之敌，解开这个世界的秘密。

- 我的自述

各位新朋友，老朋友。

我是落花路人。简称路人。

这是我的自述。

出生的时候，我是个胖墩。但是后来长成了瘦小子。

不知道几岁的时候，跟着表姐去河边看洪水，结果掉进了河里。

幸好路过的大人将我捞起。我只是昏迷了一个下午而已。

小学太过于普通，所以没什么记忆。

中学被送进了爸爸所工作的学校。

高中远赴他乡。然后考上了个不错的大学。

后来，我从土木工程专业本科毕业。茫然地进入了职场。

很快我就裸辞了。我开始自学美术，编程，开始独立开发游戏。

相继上线了《下一站，我的大学》，《乡村老师》，《异世轮回录》之后。

这是我的第四部作品，《异世轮回录：If》

————

地球OL很无趣。

在名为现实的游戏里，我只是一个行走的NPC。

出生，上学，工作，娶妻，生育，衰老，重病，求医，死去。

数十年后，没有人会记得有个活生生的人他曾经存在，曾经思考，曾经也有灵魂。

我很清楚，这就是我未来的一生。

这就是为什么我前两年做了《异世轮回录》。

如果是在异世界中，我一定是主角吧。

如果是主角的话，就能成为英雄吧。

如果是主角的话，人生就一定有意义吧。

所有的人，都会围着主角转吗。

就连命运之神，都要给主角写一个传奇的剧本不是吗。

如果是主角的话。。。。。。

————

当时，我抱着这样的想法开发了《异世轮回录》

但是由于资金和能力的问题，我只能全方面地简化了自己的设计。

所以我说为什么《异世轮回录》是一个阉割的版本。

两年过去了，现在我有了一些积蓄，也更加强大了。

或许当下就是补完遗憾的时机。

还有一个契机，让我坚定了制作《异世轮回录：If》。

开发《异世轮回录》之前，我的游戏《乡村老师》办理版号遭遇停发。

窘迫，无助，迷茫的这段时期，我看了好多异世界转生厕纸番（笑）。

这才让我萌生了开发一款转生异世界题材的游戏。

而现在，版号已经发布恢复正常，依然没有《乡村老师》版号的影子。

从21年9月《乡村老师》办理版号到现在，已经整整三年。

人生有多少个三年？

我开始独立做游戏到现在也才六年，

三年啊，如果一个人能活九十岁，那么这就是三十分之一的生命。

诚然，我微不足道，所以我的生命也微不足道。我的三年也微不足道。

但是微不足道的我，也想发出自己羸弱的声音。

我是个话唠。每次发新游戏，我都有好多话想对玩家们说。

因为只有在这个时候，会有人倾听我微不足道的话语。

我虽然微不足道，但是我会拼尽全力，

在我转生到异世界之前，一定会做出真正的好游戏的。

以上就是我的自述。

games.name: Diner Bros 2
games.shortDescription: The Diner Bros are back! With the same hectic cooking and serving, and now customization of your bustling restaurant! Serve quirky customers, earn cash to buy equipment, and discover new recipes in Diner Bros 2. Team up for 4 player local co-operative fun. No friends? Hire servers!
games.aboutText:
HECTIC KITCHEN ACTION

Are you ready to put your culinary skills to the test? Open a bustling restaurant in the fast-paced, fun, and frantic Diner Bros 2. Juggle orders, cook tasty meals, and race against the clock to satisfy your hungry customers!

KNOW YOUR CUSTOMERS

In Diner Bros 2 , it's not just the orders that get crazy — it’s also the Unique Customers who will keep you on your toes! Each character has their own quirks and demands that will test your multitasking skills:

- No loitering! The Teenager thinks she can stay all day!

- Always on the move, the Jogger wants their food quickly - and we mean fast!

- Watch out for the sneaky Punk looking for an opportunity to dine and dash!

- The Kid only eats drumsticks - Annoying!

... and many more! It's up to you to keep the orders flowing!

UPGRADE YOUR RESTAURANT

- Purchase New Equipment : as your diner grows, you'll need better tools to keep up with the increasing demand.

- Optimize Your Kitchen Layout : Efficiency is key when it comes to earning cash, so make sure your kitchen is set up for smooth operation. Or don't!

- Expand Your Restaurant : Can you impress the Food Critic and earn the coveted 3-star award?

NEED MORE STAFF? HIRE YOUR FRIENDS!

In Diner Bros 2 , you don't have to do it alone — hire servers to take some pressure off or Invite your Friends to join the chaos in full 4-player local co-op campaigns!

KEY FEATURES

- Cook and Serve meals as fast as you can! Keep your customers happy!

- Manage and Expand Your Restaurant for maximum efficiency

- Get New Equipment and Learn New Recipes

- Serve Special Customers such as the Jogger, Teenager, Construction Worker, and Colonel...

- ...and Watch out for Dishonest Customers who will try to steal or eat for free!

- Grow your Diner in Burger Bros, Chicken Bros, and the 100% Free DLC Wok Bros and Donut Bros

- Hire Staff in the single-player or 2-player campaign…

- …or ask your friends to help out in the frantic 2-4 Player Couch Co-op experience!

games.name: Rhythm Hotel
games.shortDescription: Rhythm Hotel is a rhythm game where history's most famous figures check in, and all hell breaks loose. bursting with wildly unpredictable, absurdly hilarious storylines. No skill barriers, no finger-melting difficulty: simple controls, catchy beats, and pure foot-tapping chaos.
games.aboutText:
🎵「Rhythm Hotel」is a rhythm game bursting with wildly unpredictable, absurdly hilarious storylines.

The playable demo offers a taste of the bizarre, darkly humorous rhythm challenges waiting inside this fantastical inn bursting with whimsy and beats.

The full version will deliver over 20 wildly unique rhythm mini-games, each with its own ridiculous story.

Step into 🎵Rhythm Hotel🎵 — where every tap launches a rhythm-fueled adventure!

One-Button Controls, Instantly Addictive

- The rules are simple: every level runs on a single button. That one design choice lets your hands keep time before your brain catches up, so the rhythm gets into your body right away. One button is all you need, you could almost

play it with your eyes closed.

Eccentric Cast, Hilarious Tales

- The hotel is packed with bizarre guests from every corner of history and the globe, each with a laugh-out-loud story and a signature rhythm skill to match. Check in for a delightfully absurd adventure where every tap sends the story somewhere you didn't expect.

Ever-Evolving Rhythm Challenge

- No two levels play the same. Test your timing, your rhythmic memory, and your precision as new mechanics pile up and get trickier, easy to pick up, and genuinely hard to master.

Musical Universe

- Explore music from all over the world: pounding EDM, retro disco, earworm pop, and gleefully oddball sound effects. Any genre can become a rhythm playground.

A Message from the Devs:

🎵 We're a three-person indie studio that started with rhythm games, but we dream bigger. We want to push the boundaries of the genre, exploring how rhythm can fuse with different mechanics, styles, and emotions.

Close your eyes. Catch the beat with your ears, let your fingers dance to the melody. Open them, and every tap has turned into an unexpected twist in the story.

🎵 Rhythm Hotel is currently in development, targeting a release by the end of the year. If it looks like your kind of chaos. please 「Wishlist it now」 ! Your support means the world to us, it's the fuel for our late-night crunch sessions!

games.name: We Grew Up in War
games.shortDescription: This narrative adventure tells stories of children from Sarajevo and Ukraine based on locals’ testimonies. See contemporary war from an overlooked perspective, highlighting resilience and imagination of kids whose future was taken from them.
games.aboutText:
"All the children who spent their childhood in war grew up way too fast."

Meet Anna, Mak, and Melisa, piece together fragments of their lives, and uncover how war changed their fates. We Grew Up in War shows everyday routine in a besieged city, what it's like to be displaced again and again, and to be forced to reimagine your dreams by war.

But in this story – just like in real life – kids are not just helpless victims. They are resilient and creative beings who have unique ways of coping with the hardships around them.

By playing, you'll help us make the stories of children from Ukraine and Sarajevo heard – part of the game's revenue goes directly to the historykeeping and educational efforts of the award-winning War Childhood Museum. Sales will also fund the game's integration into educational programs and exhibitions worldwide.

- transforms real testimonies of those who were children during the Siege of Sarajevo (1992–1996) and the war in Ukraine (2014–ongoing)

- presents a non-linear narrative in which players have to unpack boxes of memories and sort them correctly to discover the whole story

- is being created in collaboration with War Childhood Museum, based on interviews and years of historical research, with input from Ukrainian and Bosnian communities

- offers over 20 interactive micro-stories – from battling imagined monsters to facing hunger and loss huddled inside bomb shelters, or merrily playing in a car wreck; each level draws from authentic childhood experiences of war

- features light puzzle gameplay and an interactive story where you pick emotions, not words

Our protagonists might have different fates, but they have a lot in common. Unravel their interconnected stories – witness Mak grow up under a siege that lasts for years, follow Melisa as she leaves her home behind, and join Anna and Valerie as they desperately try to break free from the war alongside their family. How do these kids cope with the scars that war has left them with? Explore how past and present conflicts have shaped these children's lives.

How do you get by when everyday sounds become threats, shadows twist into monsters, and a derelict playground offers fleeting refuge from the shelling outside? Unpack boxed memories full of hardships, but also of joy and friendship. See history and the present from a perspective often missing in the media, based on the experiences of real children.

We Grew Up in War is being developed by Charles Games in collaboration with War Childhood Museum in Sarajevo.

games.name: Grave Seasons
games.shortDescription: Grave Seasons is a narrative farming sim with a terrifying twist – someone in the town is a supernatural serial killer. Farm, romance, and investigate your way through the unsettling town of Ashenridge.
games.aboutText:
Grave Seasons is an isometric pixel murder mystery farming/life sim, where you play the role of an escaped convict attempting to live peacefully in the small mountainside town of Ashenridge. Unfortunately, things take a turn for the worse when a supernatural serial killer begins attacking your fellow neighbors.

Grave Seasons is a narrative-driven supernatural horror wrapped lovingly in a farming/life sim. You will have one year to protect victims from a supernatural serial killer that lurks in town. Using farming , foraging , crafting and investigation , you are tasked with discovering methods that ward off monsters. Unravel the truth behind the supernatural murders, discover the secrets the residents of Ashenridge keep hidden away, and save those that you can…

Or let chaos reign. The choice is yours.

Just know that each decision has its consequences, both positive and negative. Unlock new stories upon the death of characters, discover storylines with their survival. Decisions are checked (and autosaved) to weave a story of your time in Ashenridge. With only a year, how will you leave your mark?

Inspired by farming sims of old, your farm in Ashenridge sits at the very top of the mountain. There you can:

- Farm and grow seasonal crops using different types of farm plots

- Craft recipes in your kitchen or your shed, as well as mysterious occult items that could save potential victims of the killer

- Upgrade your tools and the buildings on your farm and select potential aesthetic customization options

- Unearth pieces of history in Ashenridge as you farm, harvest and forage

Ashenridge holds 30+ residents and 70+ interior locations to explore, with seven major locations to visit:

- Your Farm

- The Mountainside

- The Forest

- The Local District of Ashenridge

- The Commercial District of Ashenridge

- The Coast & Docks

- The Mines

Explore all that Ashenridge has to offer and discover how things change depending on which killer is active, which residents are alive, and what season it is.

Every playthrough of Grave Seasons selects a potential supernatural killer from a pool of candidates. Each killer has their own campaign, their own reasoning, their own kill styles and their own targets.

Uncover the hidden sides of the townsfolk (and even romance them) while they're a killer OR while they're a victim. Will you let them run rampant? Or put an end to their rampage?

- Customize your character

- Collect, discover or craft over 600+ items

- Fish and mine, discovering new ingredients that will help unravel the mysteries of town

- Break and enter into the homes of the locals, just don’t get caught

- Stay awake for 24+ hours, experiencing both the day and the night of Ashenridge

- Changing seasons that impact the world around you

- Get to know the 30+ residents of Ashenridge

- Romance one of the 12 potential folks that capture your heart, with a few having the potential to be the killer…

- Replayability where your work is tracked from your previous year

- And much more!

games.name: These Darker Tides
games.shortDescription: Welcome [EMPLOYEE] to your new job protecting Deep Sea Cables from creatures of the deep. We're not liable for loss of limbs, sanity, or life while on the job. Don't forget to keep your desk clean and your eyes on those cameras!
games.aboutText:
Here's what Deep Sea Cable Management taught me about B2B sales:

Time Managment

While on the job it's important to maintain your equipment. If any of those cameras break or get dirty then you can't perfom to the best of your abilities! Make sure to pick the right time to perform repairs though as something might be creeping up on you without you even knowing it.

Diversification of Skills

In todays fast paced environment you have to be up to the task of taking on multiple roles if you want to get ahead and face any challenge that life throws at you. Try 3 distinct challenging game modes.

Observation

A keen eye and attention to detail is needed to pick up on the slightest of changes in your environment. If you aren't paying attention, then I'm not paying you! So watch those cameras for any problems and ward them away with your trusty flares or soon you'll find yourself without a job ŏ̷̡r̵̦͝ ̸͚̾y̸̼̑o̶̥͋u̷̞͆r̶̰̃ ̷̨̄l̸̠̊i̴̯͝f̸̣̀e̸͚͂ !

games.name: 井底-与奇迹邂逅的井底之人
games.shortDescription: 《井底》是一款2024年3月立项的文字类galgame，题材是“超能力悬疑推理故事”，画风是日系校园风格的 故事主要讲述了游戏女主王语韴作为一个业余“侦探”，遇到各种疑难问题，并在侦探事务所所长天翔及其妹妹天音的帮助下，解决案件的故事。 游戏主要使用鼠标点击来推进剧情
games.aboutText:
- Bottom of the Well "is a text-based adventure galgame that was launched in March 2024, with the theme of" superpowered suspenseful detective stories "and a Japanese campus style art style

- The game adopts the gameplay of AVG visual novels, where players can advance the plot progress by clicking the mouse to play the game content. The game has a text volume of about 200000 words and has a dual line ending. Players can experience the desired game ending by selecting the corresponding branch events

- The story mainly tells the story of the female protagonist Wang Yuyi, as an amateur "detective", encountering various difficult problems and solving the case with the help of the detective agency director Tianxiang and his sister Tianyin.

games.name: Shardbreakers
games.shortDescription: Start with a spell. Build a storm. Combine magical shards into a spell engine that turns one hit into a barrage, then unleash it on hordes and bosses. An action roguelite where you don't find combos - you design them.
games.aboutText:
In Shardbreakers, you don’t just collect upgrades - you build a spell engine. Socket Shards to decide what triggers what and chain spells together. Your weapon attacks automatically and lighter spells trigger on their own, while your most decisive spells remain under your control.

Build your spell engine

Each lane is a row of slots with endless possibilities. Choose Skill Shards from Fire, Ice, Lightning, Arcane, and Physical. Then combine them with Modifier and Condition Shards to decide how your skills play out.

Prove your build in combat

You design the rules how your spells trigger, chain, and cascade in real time. From rapid-fire embers to devastating thunderfalls, all answer to your order.

Fight the enemies using your own spell engine. A crowded battlefield isn't just danger... It's fuel for a working build!

Expand what you can build

Pick your start with the Hunter, Arcanist, or Knight, then shape each run through the engine you build. Unlock new Shards, then change the trigger, change the arrangement, change the result.

WHAT’S IN THE DEMO

The Shardbreakers Demo lets you experience the core buildcraft and combat loop across one biome , with branching routes and runs that typically last around 30 minutes .

Play as Hunter, Knight, or Arcanist , each with their own weapon, class mechanic, abilities, and elemental pool.

Build your spell engine with 50+ Skill Shards, 30+ Modifier Shards, 15+ Condition Shards, and 15+ Relics , alongside the Resonance system.

Each run can take you through different room types, from Normal and Elite encounters to Shops, Reforge rooms, Transmuters, the Camp, Harbinger encounters, and the final Boss.

As you keep playing, you can unlock new classes, weapons, Shards, and additional build options.

The Shardbreakers Demo is live now. Play it on Steam and start building your spell engine!

games.name: Celestial of Dolls
games.shortDescription: Lead a humanoid squad from a roaming settlement base into a Dyson megastructure built by runaway AI under a binary star system. Fight the AI Guards, the Empire, and the Humanoid Cult, use Scarlet Particles and terrain tricks, and escort Io to rewrite civilization’s fate.
games.aboutText:
- QQ Group：119433755

Post-Apocalyptic Megastructure, Sci-Fi Anime, and Tactical Strategy RPG

『Celestial of Dolls』is an anime Sci-Fi SRPG set in a post-apocalyptic megastructure world.

Powered by the endless energy of a binary star system, an unfinished Dyson megastructure now envelops an entire star. Extreme cold, famine, humanoid disease, rogue AI, and endlessly self-expanding architecture have become humanity's final habitat. You will lead a surviving settlement clinging to the outer shell, deploying a roaming mobile base and a tactical humanoid squad to travel through the frozen outer zones, transport spines, and inner light wells in search of food, energy, Scarlet Particles, and node access rights. Along the way, you encounter and escort Io, a messenger girl from a pre-civilization, and decide the final fate of one branch of the Celestial Project.

These battlefields are not only vast, but defined by dramatic verticality and colossal structures. You must survive the pressure of three opposing forces at once: AI security guards, the Empire, and the Humanoid Cult. Megastructural terrain, vertical elevators, AI alert reinforcements, and most importantly, humanoid shell transformations make every mission of exploration, capture, sabotage, escort, and extraction feel intense and oppressive. You will need to carve out a path to survival through brutal objectives and complex terrain, and live long enough to reach the next orbital line.

Features

- Fight across a layered Dyson megastructure spanning frozen outer wastes, industrial mid-belts, inner light wells, and tower labyrinths

- Experience SRPG combat built around massive verticality: capture points, time limits, defense, destruction, multi-faction battles, and dynamic terrain

- Activate “Regulated Humanoid” combat forms and switch between silicon-carbon fusion states powered by Scarlet Particles

- Manage a roaming orbital base with energy blocks, food blocks, structural resources, module upgrades, and settlement morale

- Make choices between settlements, the Empire, and the rogue AI system to unlock branching missions and multiple endings

Wishlist『Celestial of Dolls』and enter a dyson world of endless construction by runaway AI.

games.name: Papa's Pizzeria Deluxe
games.shortDescription: Top, bake, and serve delicious pizzas in Papa's Pizzeria Deluxe! Craft pizzas for Papa Louie's loyal customers while earning tips, points, and Special Recipes. Unlock holiday ingredients for seasonal pies, and take a trip in the Food Truck to serve your own unique creations!
games.aboutText:
Papa Louie is off on another adventure, leaving you in charge of his wildly popular pizza parlor! Customers will arrive to order both seasonal specialties and all-time classics at the Pizzeria. You'll need to choose from a variety of crusts, sauces, and cheeses, then top each pizza with a mouthwatering selection of ingredients. But be warned -- Papa's customers are famously picky! You'll need to carefully place the perfect number of toppings in exactly the right spots. After baking the pizza, slice it just right and box it up for your hungry customers. With multiple stations to run, each providing a unique, hands-on experience, the orders will keep you constantly on your toes as you juggle tasks throughout the Pizzeria!

Welcome back to Tastyville! In this deluxe reimagining of Papa's Pizzeria, you'll unlock new ingredients, new customers, and new seasonal flavors as you play. Even more customers have arrived in Tastyville for Papa Louie's award-winning pizza, so you'll see some fresh faces along with your Pizzeria regulars. There are also a variety of new features for the pizza parlor, including new Daily Specials, helpful Score Details, a Pizzeria Food Truck, new holiday ingredients, and more!

Roy doesn't have to manage the Pizzeria all by himself! Hire a custom worker — or even his sister, Joy! — to handle the phones and take delivery orders. Once the pizza's ready, your Driver will deliver it right to the customer's door! The Driver can also lend a hand in the brand-new Dining Room, where customers can relax and enjoy their hot and fresh pizza in a cozy booth at the Pizzeria.

Once you hire a Driver, you can send them to the bustling streets of Downtown Tastyville in your brand-new Pizzeria Food Truck! Between workdays, unleash your creativity by crafting the wildest and most delicious pizzas imaginable, then serve them straight from the truck to see who stops by for a taste. You can also mix and match ingredients from different holidays in the Food Truck for truly unique combinations!

- Hands-on gameplay for topping, baking, and cutting pizzas

- Custom chefs and delivery drivers

- Food Truck for open-ended free play mode

- 12 separate holidays to unlock, each with more ingredients

- 7 exciting Mini-Games to play after each workday

- Tons of furniture and clothing to decorate your shop and workers

- Earn and master 40 unique Special Recipes

- View Score Details to learn from your mistakes

- Customer Coupons to entice customers to return

- 90 colorful Stickers to earn for completing tasks

- Unlock alternate outfits for every customer

- 151 customers to serve with unique orders

- 99 ingredients to unlock

games.name: A Tiny Wander
games.shortDescription: An exploration mystery adventure where the setting and narrative become the riddle. Hurry through the night, lantern in hand. And occasionally respite with a cup of coffee. Explore, discover, gather insight from interactions, delivering your parcel to the farthest reaches of the forest.
games.aboutText:
“A Tiny Wander” is a mysterious adventure of deciphering and unraveling the riddles of the forest’s secrets, through exploration, discovery, and interactions with the locals.

This non-linear narrative’s most distinctive characteristic is that riddles don’t feel like riddles, due to its deep connection of setting, unfolding mysteries, and story.

A Journey Surrounding a Forest’s Mystifying Secrets

Constantly crowded with those who lose their way, a forest of enormous trees one day became feared by locals as the “Awry Forest,” severing it from the outside world. And yet, a certain traveling delivery pigling thoughtlessly accepts a delivery to such a precarious forest.
Fulfill the delivery to the farthest reaches of the forest, guiding the traveler via conversations and the truth behind observations of unusual events encountered.

Camp, Coffee, and a Full Moon

Realizing that the delivery to the farthest reaches of the forest is not a walk in the park, the traveler sets up camp at the edge of the forest to gather clues. Residents like a grumbling furry friend and a fishing fanatic mushroom have worries, and resolving these “slightly quirky” residents’ troubles could connect to important leads. On top of that, the time treating these locals to coffee, and being absorbed in light-conversation around a campfire under the full moon are the valuable moments of a journey.

The Setting is the Mystery Itself

Holding a lantern in hand, look closely, listen carefully, and move cautiously. Illuminate signposts too dark to read, and perk your ears to the hints concealed in the residents' stories. The terrain thwarts your exploration, haul materials, and set up bridges. Do this and you’ll realize the connection to everything as you come to know the world and expand your “Memories.”
That trek of steps will surely guide the traveler to the farthest reaches of the forest before long.

Characteristics

- The protagonist, Buie, is an admirable pigling with brawn

- Riddles feel unlike riddles, through the use of the environment and the setting

- A non-linear design where it’s possible to go straight to the end based on how puzzles are solved

- The environment and sky slowly shift into night

- Cute characters are simple and have an abundance of expressions

- Making other things besides coffee can be enjoyed

- Depending on the situation, “coffee time” can be enjoyed with every character

- An original soundtrack by Takao Masaki that is soothing to the ears

- Furigana features allow young children and Japanese learners to play with ease

- There are no elements of horror, so exploration can be enjoyed in comfort

Onward to a Warm Yet Mysterious World

This is a journey of slowly finding your bearings, uncovering the secrets hidden within a forest that is set in a world both warm yet harsh. As a spin-off born from the director’s art book “Quaint Places: Chronicles of Exploration,” a short night-fall adventure paired with a sense of unexpectedness and approachability awaits you.

We Have a Discord Server

The development progress of “A Tiny Wander” can be checked every day on the development team’s official Discord server. We’d also be overly pleased if you added “A Tiny Wander” to your wishlist, and recommended it to a friend who might enjoy the game.

games.name: The Spire of Mech Zero
games.shortDescription: A lite roguelike card deck building game inspired by Slay the Spire. You can experience battles of robots with cards and components! Try to conquer the spire with one perfect run, every choice matters!
games.aboutText:
A lite roguelike card deck building game inspired by Slay the Spire. You can experience battles of robots with cards and components!

Turn-Based Card Battle

You will draw cards at the beginning of your turn and regenerate energy. Make smart and precise decision on energy consumption and cards to play, you will need to be flexible among Attack cards, Defend cards and Ability Cards to fight against enemies' attack and skills.

Classic Roguelike Deck Building

If you have played Slay the Spire, you are already familiar with all the basic rules of this game. All the classic designs are reserved. You can start with some basic cards, defeat enemies to collect new powerful cards and components to build you own deck!

A New Way To Start

We like Hearth Stone Arena mode, if you enjoy it, you can start the game with a card selection process. Every round, you choose 1 card from 3, after 8 rounds, you will have your initial customized beginning deck!

High Difficulty Boss Fight

Boss fight should not be hard in terms of super high damage or HP, it should be hard in a more interesting way. We have designed 5 Bosses with special abilities you need to learn to kill it.

games.name: ZaciSa: Idle Defense!
games.shortDescription: A Tower Defense game mashed with Idle Clicker mechanics set inside a wonderful world of crayons. Build out your defenses, go grab a snack and watch your forces take on enemy units.
games.aboutText:
Tower Defense meets Idle Clicker

This is a Tower Defense x Idle Clicker game set inside the Crayon Empire. Each new level you progress will award you Points that can be used in the Shop to purchase new tower placement spots, new weapon types and more. Build up your defenses, let the game play out then come back to upgrade and unlock new opportunities!

The Idle Special

As you let the game idle in the background, the "Idle Special" bar will slowly fill up. When it is fully ready, click that button! It will unleash a powerful attack on all the unsuspecting enemies trying to harm your base. Impatient and can't wait for it to fill up? Click click click and fill it in faster! Might unleash even powerful attacks.

Auto Defenses Deployed

Got something else to take care of? Step away and let the game handle your defenses for you! Your base and the weapons you placed will slowly level up and upgrade over time allowing your defenses to keep up advancing stronger enemy types.

Features

- Over 20 different custom Maps

- 2 different Game Modes: Idle and Death

- Leaderboards

- Music Player

- Achievements

- Cloud Saves

games.name: Touhou Dystopian
games.shortDescription: Touhou Project's Brand New Action Roguelite Fan Game! Strange incidents erupt in the Animal Realm and Primate Spirit Garden. Embark on an unknown journey, uncover the truth behind the anomalies, and break through this 'Touhou Dystopian'!
games.aboutText:
This is a third-person action roguelite game. Players will play one of several protagonists to challenge powerful enemies in the Animal Realm and solve the source of the incident.

The game will include 4 protagonists with different fighting styles to unlock, 9 boss battles based on various Touhou characters, and nearly 100 kinds of enhanced abilities.

●EXCITING BATTLE

In terms of combat, the operation is simplified, while the operation threshold is minimized as much as possible, while retaining the tension and excitement brought by action games.

Clear all obstacles with flawless skill!

●RICH TALENT ENHANCEMENT

During the process, each protagonist has a unique enhancement ability to choose from, and some powerful enhancement abilities will directly change the character's fighting style.

Face all challenges with the strongest attitude!

●HIGHLY ANTICIPATED CHARACTERS

As the Primate Spirit Garden is restored, it will attract visitors of all kinds.

Players will meet visitors of different characteristics in the game and get their help.

Let’s liven up the Primate Spirit Garden!

games.name: City Tales - Medieval Era
games.shortDescription: City Tales is a medieval city builder, allowing you to unleash your creativity and shape vast cities that break outside a traditional grid. Plan each district for your citizens needs and aid your companions in their tales, creating a city to be proud of!
games.aboutText:
Become the leader your people need, shaping their districts and providing them with the means to thrive and expand your grand kingdom. But don’t fret my Liege; you are not alone. Companions with invaluable skills will aid you in this endeavour as their fates become intertwined with your City Tales.

- Multiple maps to choose from : Start your new realm in one of the two beautiful locations available.

- Organic cities : Forsake rigid grids and shape large cities that evolve naturally with a unique district zoning tool.

- A relaxing pace with challenges: Enjoy rewarding play in a beautiful medieval world, where challenges emerge from the evolution of your city and it's economy.

- A leader of the people: With your companions, who's skills develop with your guidance, create a city to the peoples needs and desires.

For all walks of life

Each district has its own needs and desires, depending on the people who live there. Some citizens will love a tavern, whilst others prefer the peace of a church. But each area will evolve based on your choices.

A Swift and Impactful Economy

Guide the pulse of a bustling economy. Balance resources with swift, wise decisions and lay the groundwork for your city to rise like a beacon of medieval progress.

Beautify your glorious city your own way

With a variety of decorations, truly make this city your own by customizing your buildings and streets. Show off your prosperity!

Advisors by your side

With 9 companions, bring strength and knowledge to your city’s economy and story alike. By placing them in charge of vital points of production, they train them to become autonomous and add bonuses. Help them in their own missions to bring even more depth to your city and it's people.

A canvas full of tales

City Tales is graced with a gentle atmosphere and a hand-painted vibrancy, breathing warmth and wonder into every stone and timber. Discover how you'd like to flow with this land to paint your own story.

New ways to customize

Change the layouts and exteriors of select buildings and wonders!

games.name: PIPELINE
games.shortDescription: PIPELINE is a 1-6 player online co-op, physics-based, action FPS, rogue-lite where every bullet counts. Progress levels, ride around in the shopping cart, discover game-altering upgrades, get strong, fight even stronger enemies. Death is not the end. The cycle will repeat.
games.aboutText:
You are an expendable nobody tasked with one thing: returning a baby. Find loot, weapons and upgrades to kill dangerous monsters and bosses. But most significantly, protect the baby at all costs. Endure the vast, hazardous environments and physics-based chaos of the PIPELINE, alone or with friends.

FIGHT YOUR WAY THROUGH THE PIPELINE

Explore and discover corrupted data shrines around the levels, find them, extract them, grow stronger.

PLAY WITH YOUR FRIENDS... OR SOLO

This world is dangerous, but less so when you have friends. Gather up to 5 friends and see how far you can get. Unless you prefer to do it alone.

GROW STRONGER

The PIPELINE grows more unstable... Pick and choose your augments, upgrade your weaponries and unlock unique abilites. Get stronger before it's too late.

DEFEAT BOSSES

Every exit is protected by challenging entities. To proceed deeper, you will have to defeat them. Make sure you are prepared.

REPEAT THE CYCLE

Every death is a learning opportunity for growth. Learn how to adapt and overcome your weakness through countless trials. Death is only the end for some... But is it for you?

FEATURES

- Up to 6 player co-op

- Rogue-lite gameplay loop

- Hand-crafted levels

- Multiple guns & weaponry

- Powerful augments that alter the gameplay

- Unique NPCs

- Shopping cart™

- Proximity chat

- Unlockable cosmetics

games.name: Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors
games.shortDescription: From the creators of Vampire Survivors comes a turbo-charged, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder! Deal world-ending combos, blitz through infested dungeons, and master the Turboturn to obliterate hordes of familiar foes with a chaotic hand of cards.
games.aboutText:
From the BAFTA winning creators of Vampire Survivors comes a brand new adventure. Explore maps, level up powers, and obliterate monsters in this turn-based, card-driven BLOBBER with roguelite elements.

A Brand New Experience!

Vampire Crawlers turns the snowballing thrill of the original hit into a tactical deckbuilder where you build busted decks, explore familiar dungeons from a new perspective, and unleash world-ending combos.

Create Devastating Combos!

Play cards in ascending mana order to land devastating combos, where each step multiplies the next card's effect. Use Wilds to extend the stack to 10, 20, or even 30 cards. You choose the pace: take your time to be perfectly tactical, or play turns as fast as humanly possible for absolute snowballing carnage. Accumulate experience to level up and gain new cards.

An Entire Dungeon to Explore!

Headbutt chests for power-ups and gems to augment your cards. Chase legendary weapon evolutions and summon iconic survivors to trigger cascades of effects that break the game. Dive into dungeons packed with functioning walls, unique treasures, and bizarre interactions. Find the shovel to dig to the next floor and prepare to Master the Turboturn™!

games.name: The Mystery of Doomsday Valley
games.shortDescription: Mind-controlled squirrels! Alien abductions! Monsters in the forest! Are the rumors true - or is it just an elaborate hoax?  Help Maya Harper unravel this comedy point 'n click mystery and escape Doomsday Valley alive.
games.aboutText:
Doomsday Valley is a comedy point 'n click mystery game with hand-drawn animations and object-based puzzles. It has a hand-drawn, stylized look that mixes quirky humor with a slightly eerie undertone. Inspired by classic 2D point 'n click games, the visuals are packed with expressive characters and interesting locations. The Mystery of Doomsday Valley will drag you into a world full of mystery , oddball moments, and a touch of the supernatural .

You are Maya Harper: a young journalist always on the lookout for 'THE BIG SCOOP'. Rumors of Alien Abductions and Monsters in the Forest has drawn her to Doomsday Valley - rumors she is 100 % ready to believe if there is just a hint of evidence. But what seemed like a beautiful valley full of quirky people soon turns out to be a real mystery - but not necessarily the mystery she was expecting.

The Features

- Hand-drawn HD artwork and traditional frame-by-frame animation

- Simple one-click interface

- In-game hint system, hot-spots and fast-travel

- Suspenseful and atmospheric soundtrack

- Inspired by classic adventures from the 90`s

- Designed to appeal to both experienced players and newcomers alike

The Demo

The demo showcases what we want to achieve with Doomsday Valley, but it should be viewed as a work in progress . This will give you a first impression about how the game will play.

- Professor Nebulius. Professor in astrophysics and advanced mathematics. He is already investigating the valley and this might or might not upset the sinister forces at work... (hint: it does, it angers the spirits greatly)

- Mortimer Darkwood. Manager of the Doomsday Hotel. He has no real interest in running a hotel and it shows. This is a fallback job for him after some misfortunes and he is working some angles to get away from the hotel.

- Rosie. Owner of Rosie's Diner. She knows the ins and outs of the town and the people living here and is never too busy. Her recipes stem from a long tradition of local cuisine, as her family has been living in the area literally forever.

- Theodore Penwright. Journalist working at The Times. Always on the lookout for the next big article. He is semi-famous in his field and makes sure people he meets recognise that in every way possible.

- Cletus. He is a local farmer who recently had some nasty experiences that led him into a depression. Self-medicates with moonshine and excessive eating but also enjoys long walks with his dog.

- Dave. He claims he got sick by accidental exposure to some unknown substance and is now hiding out in his camper van. He used to install smart tech solutions, like surveillance cameras and security systems, but is now running a telephone-based food-related startup.

games.name: Melted Time
games.shortDescription: Candle, your path is full of puzzles. Can you handle it? Hurry, your time is already melting away.
games.aboutText:
You are a candle, slowly melting in real time. Your mission is to explore a series of eerie and atmospheric locations, solving intriguing puzzles along the way. But be quick—time is not on your side! To survive, you’ll need to bend time and space, think creatively, and use every element of your surroundings to your advantage.

As you progress, you’ll unravel a gripping tale filled with unexpected twists, betrayal, and... vegetable murders? That’s right! In this bizarre world, you’ll uncover dark secrets, witness berry dismemberment, and experience other absurd yet strangely captivating events.

Features:

- Real-time melting mechanic.

- Atmospheric locations filled with mysteries and secrets.

- Time and space manipulation to solve puzzles.

- An unusual story with elements of dark humor and absurdity.

You made it to the end? Wow! Most people just watch the trailer. Some check the screenshots. Almost no one reads the description. ◕‿◕

Have a great day! If you try the game, may your candle burn bright (but not too fast!). And please, add the game to your wishlist. I'm a small indie dev, and it means a lot to me. (｡◕‿‿◕｡)

games.name: Locomotive 115
games.shortDescription: It's difficult to know how many locomotives have been swallowed by the suffocating blizzards of the Widow's Run. Cursed with creeping tales of things that lurk in the dark and overshadowed by frequent casualties, it now stands as your only path forward. Will you be able to survive?
games.aboutText:
Navigate Through the Storm

Not every train that sets out on the Widow's Run is fortunate enough to return. Few conductors have braved this cold expanse and survived, fewer still have braved it and kept their wits intact to tell the tale. Desperate accounts told by men driven to the edge; stories of madness, storms, deadly cold… and strange creatures lurking in the darkness. Fight your way to escape the rails and outrun the storm in this single-player, survival horror game.

Test Your Skills

As the sole engineer on this journey, you must maintain your locomotive's heat, steam, and speed levels to progress. Be careful, as too much, or too little, of any of these resources could end in disaster.

Fend off the Horrors

As if managing an operational locomotive wasn’t difficult enough, you will also have to contend with the creatures haunting Widow’s Run. These creatures are rumored to be attracted to heat and movement, making you and your locomotive a prime target among the icy wastes of the mountain pass.

And Survive

Only through careful balance will you be able to pilot and defend your train on the treacherous path through Widow's Run. So with your only way out being forward, will you be able to make it to the end?

Key Features

• Manage the Heat, Steam, and Speed of Your Train - Each dial is a careful balancing act to keep your train moving.

• Defend Yourself - Armed only with a double-barrel shotgun and the sound of the train’s whistle, you must fight off the various creatures who will stop at nothing to end your journey.

• Explore the Mysteries of Widow's Run and Discover its Secrets - Not everything is as it seems. Will you be able to discover the hidden secrets of the mountain pass?

• Short Horror Narrative - Approximately 40 minutes of Playtime.

games.name: Shiina Taki's Decameron
games.shortDescription: Shiina Taki's Decameron is a doujin interactive fiction based on anime「BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!」. The story concentrates on Shiina Taki, the drummer and song writer of MyGO!!!!! and her fight against fate till the last breath.
games.aboutText:
简介

- 《鼓手余命十日谭~Shiina Taki's Decameron》是基于原作动画「BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!」，以鼓手「椎名立希」为主角的互动小说。

内容

- 在6~7小时的游戏流程中，玩家将以立希的视角体验动画本篇时间线七年后的故事，接触数名熟悉而陌生的角色。

- 游戏拥有多结局，角色支线间存在一定的关联、互动，甚至随机性，部分选项也会造成较为深远的影响。

- 全流程共可解锁近二十张CG与动画片段，大部分由同担老师倾力贡献。

创作团队

- 主创：Ottergeist 、余怀仁

- 主美：夜蚺

- 程序：Ottergeist

- UI及宣图设计：BKK

- 主视觉图：瓜美仙子

- 美术：Dd玩苏、告白 、绿羊流 、猫又猫又猫 、Raito、Ringo 、弱火三味治 、依末 、Yannn

- 剧本：大树Taiki、呵唔昂、杰尼鳖 、Ottergeist 、生姜、跳池塘 、TAGAR 、TK、一只枕头、余怀仁

- 文学顾问：北宫弱羽、橘子被窝

- 游戏测试：水晶、Retarded

- 动画制作：面包娟子

- PV制作：BKK、Milaro、余怀仁

- 插曲《柔賛語》——WealthGod

声明

- 本作为爱好者共同出资制作的免费同人游戏，非盈利目的，也不存在任何周边制作的相关企划，如果您发现与《鼓手余命十日谭》相关的收费内容，请务必参考此声明。

- 游戏部分资源来自互联网，如无意间侵犯到您的权益，请联系制作人修改，在此向您表达真挚的歉意。

团队寄语

- 粉随正主，少说多做。

- 小心长崎素世。

games.name: Shroom and Gloom
games.shortDescription: Gather and grow cards in Shroom & Gloom, a moody first-person, roguelike double-deckbuilder bursting with fungal foes and mountains of mega-combos!
games.aboutText:
Shroom and Gloom is a first-person, roguelike double-deckbuilder that brings you mobs of monstrous mushrooms and mountains of mega-combos!

Unleash cards to hack, slash and roast your way through hand drawn dungeons of fungal foes! Build devastating decks, and grow cards into massive abominations as you fight your way into the heart of The Gloom!

Build 2 distinct decks! Use the combat deck to survive fierce battles! Use the explore deck to navigate dungeons, modify your cards, and unlock new weapons and abilities!

Hand-drawn art and animations collide with rich 3D spaces, bringing you into a surreal world of mushrooms and madness!

Shroom and Gloom offers unique ways for players to grow and modify their cards infinitely. Grow low level starting cards into over-powered attacks, or modify rare cards into game-breaking super-weapons!

Why block your enemies when you could eat them instead! Shroom and Gloom features a bounty of ways for you to season, skewer or roast your foes, then eat them to restore lost health. Better yet, throw your roasted enemies into a pot, and cook up some game-changing soups!

games.name: Seasonala Cemetery
games.shortDescription: A meditative experience that invites players to explore the serene beauty of a living, breathing cemetery as it changes with the seasons.
games.aboutText:
Seasonala Cemetery is a meditative experience that invites players to explore the serene beauty of a living, breathing cemetery.

Using your system’s real date and time, the game changes dynamically – visit in the summer to see the cemetery bustling with life, or explore in the quiet, snowy winter. Observe and interact with NPCs and animals as they visit Seasonala Cemetery , all while listening to ambient sounds recorded from a real-life cemetery.

Seasonala Cemetery is a peaceful yet poignant reflection on life and death.

Features

- See how the cemetery changes through the seasons, time of day, and weather.

- Learn about the city’s history through its gravestones.

- Interact with the animals that call the cemetery home and the people who visit the cemetery at different times of the day, month, and year.

- Listen to ambient sounds recorded from a real-life cemetery alongside a beautiful soundtrack composed by halina heron.

- Pick up flowers, rocks, pinecones, and more and place them on gravestones you visit.

- A completely free experience for Windows and Mac.

games.name: Awaria
games.shortDescription: Awaria is a short game about working in haunted maintenance tunnels.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the tunnel maintenance crew. If the generators fail, it's your job to fix them. Check what's wrong, craft all the needed parts and deliver them. It's simple. Just stay clear of anything that randomly cracks bolts of electricity, spews fire, throws sharp pieces of scrap at high-velocity or radiates with ominous green light. Features:

- Enjoy claustrophobic penal labor.

- Break and panic under constant time pressure.

- Dodge deadly projectiles and safety violations.

- You may even... kiss a ghost?

games.name: Chronoquartz
games.shortDescription: In Chronoquartz, every move matters! You have 10 turns per loop: explore, solve puzzles, and use your past knowledge to progress. Strategy, critical thinking, and time management will be your allies in this unique temporal adventure. Will you succeed in saving time?
games.aboutText:
In Chronoquartz, every move matters! You have 10 turns per loop: explore, solve puzzles, and use your past knowledge to progress. Strategy, critical thinking, and time management will be your allies in this unique temporal adventure. Will you succeed in saving time?

Every Move Counts

In Chronoquartz, your number of moves is limited. You'll need to be clever to make the most of the 10 turns you're given.

Time Loops

You'll need to use the knowledge gained from previous loops to progress further in the game. This will allow you to open coded doors, take secret passages, know the location of objects, and discover the fastest paths to reach your destination.

Strategic Choices

With each loop, you'll need to decide which path to take and which object to retrieve to reach your goal. Your number of turns is limited, so choose wisely.

Temporal Puzzles

To gain new insights into the game, you'll need to solve puzzles that span one or more loops. Meticulous planning is essential, because remember: every move counts.

Save Time

All the information you gather might help you thwart Morthas' plans. He wants to seize the Chronoquartz and manipulate history. Time needs you: will you succeed to save it?

games.name: Feed The Pit
games.shortDescription: JOIN THE SOCIETY in this story-driven, investigative horror game. Hunt down wealthy humans in a deadly forest in order to Feed The Pit. Act 1 is available at launch. Acts 2 & 3 will release as free updates in the coming months!
games.aboutText:
ACT 1 is available at launch. Acts 2 & 3 will release as free updates in the coming months!

FEED THE PIT is a linear, story-driven, investigative horror game where you hunt wealthy individuals through a dangerous card game in order to Feed The Pit, all while avoiding relentless horrors.

A STRANGE INVESTIGATION - THE GAMEPLAY

THE PIT hungers. To feed it, we're sending you to kill people in Carrister Valley. Hidden deep in the woods, your only hope at finding them is with magical cards--each of which asks a unique question about the target's location.

With the right inquiries, you'll narrow down the map until only one possible spot remains. Your card selection is limited--you'll have to play the hand you're dealt. No two investigations are the same.

RELENTLESS MONSTROSITIES

Every mission brings a new monster, acting as your nemesis for the day. Their behavior is a mystery. Take dangerous gambles and pay close attention to discover how they work, and more importantly--how to survive.

WELCOME TO E.C.C.

THE PIT is here to save us. And you've been invited to join his Chosen Circle. We have a higher purpose to serve. A new world order to execute. For Brotherhood. For The Pit.

A complex and branching story lies ahead. What will you do?

This game features music that is in the public domain.

games.name: The Happyhills Homicide
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Happyhills, the town where you can indulge your deepest desires, make your wildest dreams come true, and slaughter anyone in your path. In this case, all three of these are the same. Welcome the citizens of Happyhills in your way!
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Happyhills, the town where you can indulge your deepest desires, make your wildest dreams come true, and slaughter anyone in your path. In this case, all three of these are the same.

Play as a stylish 80's style slasher and kill your way through different levels. The game offers 20 completely varied levels, each with an entirely different playstyle and way of killing. Do you like a challenge? Don't worry. The game wil increase in difficulty with every level, not every victim is as easy as the other. From a simple sleeping man in his armchair to fighting off a gang of bikers in a bar.

And don't think for a minute you can carry out these heinous acts without an ambitious detective on your back.

The game features:

- 20 varied levels with each a different approach, different murder weapons and puzzle elements.

- Mixed gameplay of stealth, action, horror and puzzle solving.

- A twisted story with revealing motivations.

- Numerous interesting characters to kill or to love.

- Crime solving sub-levels as a detective.

- Tons of dark humor and horror movie references.

- Lots of gore and guts.

games.name: Arisen Force: Life Devotee - Initial Ver.
games.shortDescription: Enjoy a stylish action combat experience as you explore a chapter storylines from Journey to the West.
games.aboutText:
Arisen Force: Life Devotee is an challenging A-RPG game featuring exquisite high-definition pixels ,it combines the engaging Stylish Actional combat experience.

The levels design is base on one part of storylines of Journey to the West .

Features

- Action Battle : Experience high-octane, stylized action designed for maximum enjoyment and tactical depth..

- Seamless Blend of Old and New : Encounter a unique mix of classic gameplay elements and modern design, featuring challenging adversaries and ingenious level architecture.,

- Immersive Battle Environments : Journey through each hero’s distinct thematic setting, enjoying diverse and visually stunning combat scenarios.

Battle

There are numerous combat skills to explore in action games, including Evade, Charging Attack, Block, Counter, Punish, Just System, Cancel, and Throw/Execute. Dive in and discover your favorites!

games.name: Liber Magus
games.shortDescription: Liber Magus is a magic extraction game where every dungeon run is a test of your magical talent. Build your own spells, push through dangerous dungeons and extract with your reward.
games.aboutText:
You were sent to an island with one mission eliminate a dangerous mage. Where he's hiding is unknown. The dungeons scattered around the island are your only lead.

Open up the spell editor and build your own spell. Pick an element, add a couple modifiers, and go. Just try not to kill yourself with it happens more than you'd think. 84% of all mage deaths are self-inflicted!

Prepare well. Water the crops, feed the critters, brew a potion heading into a dungeon without a spare bottle of mana is a bad idea.

And then the dungeons themselves (which aren't always dungeons, technically). Get in, grab what you find, get out — nice, it's all yours. Don't make it out you wake up back home, loot gone, some of your coin gone too. Sucks, but that's how it works here. Prep better next time.

games.name: Muri: Wildwoods
games.shortDescription: Play as Pelle, a curious cleaner muri tasked with restoring an island back to life! Explore mysterious ruins, clean away corruption, befriend cute critters, collect sketches, and save the Wildwood’s forest spirit in this cozy cleaning-sim adventure!
games.aboutText:
Play as Pelle, a quiet, creative, and pretty average creature. In Muri: Wildwoods you stumble upon your very first solo-mission as a cleaner - saving the Wildwoods’ fauna and flora.

With the support of your quirky cleaning crew on TeamSqueak, you explore and restore a mysterious, unknown location, but are you really the first muri to set paw in this place?

Cleaning is your job, but who said it can’t be fun and fulfilling? Use your trusty watergun and its different nozzles to wash away the corruption, one satisfying ding at a time!

Start with your Bubble Spray and Pressure Washer, later unlock 2 more nozzles!

Pelle may not be the biggest creature, but they can sure make a sizable difference. See flora sprout, critters become happy, and color return when you splash away the corruption!

Wildwoods is filled to the brim with interesting places and spots to explore. Reach them by performing some light platforming or small watergun challenges.

Pelle takes notes of what they discover by drawing sketches. Gather Pelle’s works of art, collect new colors for your outfit, and save all the pixies hidden around the island!

Track cleaning progress, steps, pixies, sketches, outfits, and water consumption in your Digidial!

The Wildwoods island is dripping with critters, small and large, thin and wide, soft and spiky, but all sick from the corruption. Save them and the forest spirit to restore balance!

Make sure to give them all a warm hug or pat on the head before continuing your mission!

Whether it be a critter or your crew on TeamSqueak, you’re never alone in your adventure. Get tutorial tips, lore drops, or just random chat messages from your cleaning crew as you explore Wildwoods.

Read chat history or find team profiles for Pelle, Bea, Sixten, & Rika in your Digidial.

- Run, jump, doublejump, roll, interact, climb, and bounce as Pelle

- Pet, hug, and play with the critters

- Track your cleaning tasks in the Digidial

- 3 unlockable outfit colors

- 2 watergun modes + 2 additional unlockable nozzles

- 100+ collectibles

- 1000+ objects to clean

- Electric-orchestral original soundtrack

You’ve reached the end of our Steampage.

Take a well-deserved break, just like Pelle.

games.name: Bit-Cremental: Fishistry
games.shortDescription: Grow fish with a gachapon twist in this bite-sized idler! Feed, nurture, and watch as fisher people reel in mature catches, earning money to upgrade things like feeding, growth, and fishing speeds for even faster profits.
games.aboutText:
Dive into the delightful world of fish farming and fishing in this short experimental idler, Bit-cremental: Fishistry!

Grow and feed your stock, earn money as fisher people reel in mature fish, and upgrade to unlock rare species and colorful new designs, all set in a charming Game Boy-inspired style.

Gameplay Features:

- Fish Growth: Grow your fish and aquatic creatures from tiny eggs to fully grown wonders.

- Fish Discovery System: Encounter 24 different fish types based on rarity, and strive to discover them all!

- Idle and Active Gameplay: Play actively or let your fishery grow while you’re away with automatic idle progression.

- Game Boy Inspired Graphics and Sounds: Play a piece of nostalgia with a retro inspired pixel art from the 90's handheld era with a crunchy audio track.

- Customize: Add a personal touch to your fishery with unlockable backgrounds and color palettes.

- Upgradeable Fishery: Improve your fishery with upgrades like better feed, fish value, and fish capacity.

- Simple & Relaxing Play: A short, laid-back gameplay experience perfect for casual gaming with incremental progression.

games.name: ELISSA ：Body in the bedroom
games.shortDescription: Detective novelist MEL Gideon, whose career is facing difficulties, receives a strange letter claiming someone is in trouble and needs her help. Intrigued, she decides to investigate. As she digs deeper, she starts to realize that her past is far more complicated than she ever imagined...
games.aboutText:
- 《ELISSA ：Body in the bedroom》 is a black and white hand-drawn Suspense inference interactive narrative game.

- Detective novelist MEL Gideon waits anxiously in the cafe for the mysterious letter writer to show up, but what happens next is unexpected - a cold dead body in a dilapidated, narrow room. Unlike the complicated and bizarre death scenes she writes about, real death is so simple .....

①Pointing and clicking:

you can investigate items and item details during exploration

②Acquiring items:

easy to check items and use them at any time

③Information recording:

character information and text clues obtained will be automatically recorded in the notebook

④Cracking puzzles:

get hidden clues by cracking puzzles

- Simple to play: The game is easy to use, but you still need to gather clues, solve puzzles, analyze and think to uncover the truth.

- Fine Arts: Unique visual design featuring black and white hand painted illustrations that create a retro and weird atmosphere.

- Music: Each score is independently composed for the character and plot development, presenting a rich and profound auditory experience through delicate melodies and harmonies.

More is waiting to be revealed, start your own 19th century suspense and deduction journey.

games.name: Paddle Cats
games.shortDescription: Paddle Cats is a cozy two-player couch co-op fishing adventure where two cats share one boat. Paddle together, explore the waters, catch fish and bring your haul back to camp.
games.aboutText:
A game about two cats in a boat.

They row around.

The water is nice.

Fish are tasty.

Sometimes they catch one.

Some fish are hard to catch.

Some fish are too strong.

Maybe one cat can reel while the other rows.

...

That usually helps.
---------------------------------------------------------

Paddle Cats is a cozy local co-op fishing adventure about two cats sharing one boat.

Work together to paddle across the water, find promising fishing spots, cast your lines, and wrestle your catch back to the boat. Both players occupy the same boat and can paddle or fish at the same time, so every trip becomes an exercise in cooperation and occasionally complete chaos.

Share One Boat

Each player controls one of the two cats aboard the boat. Coordinate your paddle strokes to steer, avoid rocks, and reach new fishing spots. You can work together carefully or accidentally crash your boat.

Fish Together

Aim and cast your rod, manage the line, and reel in fish with different sizes and behaviors. Hooking a fish is only the beginning: powerful catches can fight back, pull the boat through the water, and drag both players toward danger.

Protect Your Boat

Land, obstacles, and unruly fish can damage the boat. Pay attention to your surroundings while fishing.

Choose What to Bring Home

Caught fish take up space in your shared cooler. Decide which catches are worth keeping before returning to camp.

A Cozy Cooperative Adventure

Paddle Cats combines relaxed exploration and fishing with physical, cooperative boat handling. It is designed as a controller focused couch co-op experience for two players playing together on one screen.

Early Access

The Early Access version includes the game’s core local co-op loop: paddling a shared boat, exploring the water, catching fish, managing your cooler, and returning with your catch. We plan to expand the experience during development with additional progression, NPC requests, unlockable items, fish, and environments.

games.name: Hacky
games.shortDescription: The ultimate "Hollywood Hacker" simulator for when you want to look busy, dangerous, and incredibly tech-savvy.
games.aboutText:
Look like a master hacker. Type like a caffeinated squirrel.

This is the "I'm in" simulator designed for one purpose: making you look like a high-stakes cyber-criminal while you're actually just typing "asdfghjkl" over and over. No networking degree required, just a laptop and crowded cafe.

Most of the gameplay involves you typing nonsense commands and pretending to be an "I'm in" type of hacker. And when it comes to hacking, just randomly spam your keyboard at the target speed to bypass fake security and watch as totally-legit-looking code floods your screen. Complete with unnecessary sci-fi bleeps and bloops, because that's definitely how cybersecurity works.

Key Features:

- Effortless Hacking : Feel like a genius by simply typing easy commands on screen! Hack networks, steal valuable data, and navigate through cyberspace with intuitive keyboard controls.

- Stylized Puzzles: Unlock target security with satisfying visual challenges.

- Strategic Gameplay: Balance your actions against the rising System Alert. Push your luck to grab more loot, or play it safe and escape with what you've got!

- Roguelike Sessions : Each hacking run is a unique challenge. How deep can you penetrate before the system locks you out?

- Unlock and Upgrade : Collect CHIP DATA to unlock new hacker OS types, command lines, and powerful upgrades between sessions.

Perfect for:

- Casual gamers looking for an accessible hacker game yet thrilling experience

- Sci-fi enthusiasts who've always wanted to live out their hacker dreams

- Anyone seeking a fun and engaging way to improve their typing skills

No coding experience required – just bring your imagination and good keyboard. Can you become the most notorious hacker in the cyberpunk underworld?

Boot up Hacky now and leave your mark on the digital frontier!

games.name: AN OUTLAND VILLAGE
games.shortDescription: Father and mother visited their daughter's home in Beijing to discuss their father's understanding of life and memories of their past relationship with their mother. The Story of Chinese Families
games.aboutText:
This game is a free independent short narrative game. We hope to bring players a unique immersive experience through a concise and profound plot. Although the game time is not long, we have devoted our efforts to every detail. Thank you for taking the time to enter our world. We hope that your journey can arouse some touching and thinking in you.

Story summary

My father retired, and he, who had been living with his mother, finally had some free time. I thought it would be better to go find my children who were far away, and they just happened to move back to Beijing. The mother was unwilling to leave this rural town, but her daughter persuaded the mother to finally leave.

"My father and mother visited their daughter's home in Beijing. They talked about my father's understanding of his own belonging and the memories he had with his wife in the past."

Although the family members in the past memories are separated by a long distance, they feel the warmth during the two phone calls apart.

But the two people who came to Beijing felt that distant village

Game features

Story style of literature in the 1990s

Advance the plot through dialogue and exploration

Beautiful hand-drawn art style

Operation mode

WASD: moving character

Enter: confirm/select

games.name: ReVamp
games.shortDescription: A Tower Defensevania where you rule as Dracula. Shape your fortress room by room, command an army of monsters, and step into battle yourself to protect your throne from relentless mortal invaders. A war waged for eternity, for the love you couldn’t save.
games.aboutText:
You are Dracula. Not a monster in the shadows, but the sovereign of a castle under siege. Cursed by Achlys, goddess of the night, you are condemned to defend your throne without end. Mortals return night after night, and every siege becomes another chapter in an eternal war of blood and sacrifice. But you do not merely watch from afar. You move through your halls, strike down invaders with devastating abilities, and tip the balance of battle when your forces begin to falter. All for the love that was taken from you.

The castle is yours to shape. Expand it room by room, reconfigure its structure between attacks, and transform open halls into calculated gauntlets.
