Each room alters the flow of battle, forcing invaders into choke points, layered defenses, and brutal confrontations. Invest the blood of fallen mortals to strengthen your fortress, empowering chambers, enhancing effects, and acquiring new units. With every placement and every upgrade, the labyrinth deepens, becoming less a structure… and more a weapon.

Mortals march in waves, blinded by a foolish sense of justice. Armored knights, unyielding barbarians, or zealous priests, each deserving a punishment tailored to their arrogance. Your answer? An army of the night. Skeletal swordsmen and archers form disciplined ranks, while swarming rats flood narrow corridors and winged harpies strike from above.

When your legion wavers, step into the fray yourself. Move through the castle as Dracula and unleash devastating special abilities, and turn certain defeat into victory. The better you build, the more lethal you will be. Design your fortress with intention and exploit the shortcuts you carved into your own design.

You are not just the ruler of the castle. You are its final defense.

Each moonrise brings a new assault. Enemy formations shift, elite leaders emerge, and your defenses are tested in new ways. No two sieges unfold the same, and survival demands adaptation. When the castle falls, the night begins again. Yet defeat is not oblivion. The blood spilled in your halls becomes power. Between cycles, invest it to unlock new chambers, command stronger creatures, and access deeper layers of strategic possibility.

games.name: Loot Before Dusk
games.shortDescription: A cozy top-down extraction shooter. Raid the corrupted Wildwood, bonk goblin loot crews, purify the Gloam, and get out before dusk, then rebuild your village with everything you bring home. Solo or with up to 3 friends.
games.aboutText:
Bramblewick is half swallowed by the Wildwood, and every dusk the Gloam rolls in. Each day you raid, you scavenge, purify, and slip out of an open exit before the Gloaming closes the last one. Everything you bring home mends the village. Nothing dies on screen: creatures are purified, goblins are bonked.

Every raid is about ten minutes. Exits open one after another, then close for good. Reach one, ring the bell, and hold out for 20 to 30 seconds while the noise draws everything nearby. Push your luck, or leave?

Twin-stick, readable, fair. Six hotbar slots hold your weapons, food and throwables. Roll through a telegraphed attack, swap to the Shortbow, lob a Clay Bomb. Enemies show what they will do before they do it.

Slimes, skeletons and mushroom monsters burst into sparkles and leaves. Goblin loot crews get bonked, stars circling, and drop their bags. Nobody dies and nothing bleeds. Goblins also fight the creatures, and empty containers before you do.

Search crates and barrels, decide what fits your pack, and tuck the best thing in your Safe Pouch, because anything else is lost if you fall. Switch on Cozy mode and you keep your gear and your hotbar weapons.

Sell finds to Mira, Wren and Old Tobb at prices that shift each day, craft with Hazel and Pip, cook at the hearth, and fish in the pond. Every raid repairs something you can see: a smithy, a loom, a lantern.

Mother Gloop, Chief Grubnose, the Elder Treant and the weeping Gloam Heart each guard a zone. Learn the telegraphed phases, then cleanse and calm them. The woods remember who cared for them.

Gentle rain, morning mist and golden sunshine change the sound and the sight lines. At dusk the light shrinks and stronger creatures appear. No minimap: you read the hand-drawn map instead.

Host a co-op world over Steam with friends. The raid scales with your crew: more creatures, tougher bosses, a longer timer. Co-op worlds are their own saves, and the host keeps each player's character.

Mouse and keyboard or full gamepad. Play in English, Tamil, Hindi, Simplified Chinese or Spanish (Latin America). One price, no microtransactions.

games.name: Flibbius McDoogle and the Mysterious Flying Machine
games.shortDescription: Flibbius McDoogle and the Mysterious Flying Machine is a short adventure puzzle game. Use your wits, creativity and puzzle solving ability to help Flibbius take to the skies!
games.aboutText:
Our intrepid, ingenious crafter and explorer Flibbius has always dreamt of taking to the sky!

Can you use your wits, problem solving and creativity to help him find the Mysterious Flying Machine and finally make Flibbius' dreams come true?

This is a short puzzle adventure game where you meet characters, craft items and solve puzzles! The game should take between 2 and 3 hours to complete, depending on your playstyle.

- A short, delightful, adventure featuring our tortoisey protagonist Flibbius

- Puzzles! Find items, craft new ones & use them to solve puzzles

- Meet a variety of wacky, wonderful and quirky characters

- A journal with secret puzzle hints in case you get a bit stuck

- No time pressure

- Full controller support

- Works fantastically on steamdeck!

Please join our discord channel if you want to keep up to date with our progress or ask us any questions! or follow our journey on any of our other social channels.

Hi! This game was made by a husband and wife team and is completely independent and self-funded. We hope you enjoy playing it! Your support means so much to us and we'd love to hear what you think.

games.name: Häxeri
games.shortDescription: Häxeri is a grid-based first-person dungeon crawler DRPG with turn-based combat. Form your own party, explore and map the sprawling corridors of the dungeon, and battle the monsters therein. Gain extra turns by exploiting their weaknesses, but be careful or they will exploit yours!
games.aboutText:
Häxeri is an old-school style DRPG with turn-based combat. Form your own party, explore and map the sprawling corridors of the dungeon, and battle the monsters therein.

Far beneath the kingdom, in the depths of a labyrinthine dungeon, the soul of a monster has been trapped. Now the gate to the dungeon has been opened and its magical seal broken. Rumor has it that a cult is trying to resurrect the evil being... The king has called for adventurers to investigate!

Party building

Create your own party, customizing each of your adventurers. Choose from six different classes: Berserker, Paladin, Rogue, Bard, Priest and Sorcerer. Distribute attribute points, unlock skills in the class tech trees, and equip gear to fit your strategy. How you form your party will determine your fate in the dungeon!

Exploring and mapping

Explore a classic grid-based first-person dungeon filled with monsters, loot and mysteries, across five different biomes. Draw your own map, or use automapping if you prefer.

Turn-based combat

Engage in turn-based battles with a variety of foes using tactics such as buffs, debuffs and ailments to your advantage. Exploit enemy weaknesses to gain extra turns, but hit a resistance and you'll lose them instead! And watch out: your enemies will use the same tactics on you!

Häxeri: an old-school style indie DRPG

Häxeri (Swedish for Witchery ) is a DRPG inspired by classics such as Etrian Odyssey, Shin Megami Tensei and Wizardry. Built for dungeon crawler fans who love methodical party-building, careful mapping and turn-based combat with strategic depth.

games.name: Fearwoods
games.shortDescription: Fearwoods is a 4 co-op survival horror where light and silence are your only weapons. Explore the cursed forest, uncover Aveline’s story, evade a relentless demon, and fight for escape before the darkness consumes you.
games.aboutText:
FEARWOODS

A co-op survival horror where the forest becomes your enemy.

Step into the cursed woods. Silence lives here. And the shadow watches.

Will you save Aveline… or condemn her forever?

Explore.

The forest breathes. The fog thickens.
Every step echoes, as if something listens.
Sometimes you hear whispers. Sometimes it’s just the wind... or maybe not.
The light flickers. The ground creaks.
You are not alone among these trees.

Find your path between fear and silence.
Every trail could be your last.

Find.

Everything matters – a torn notebook, a glint of metal, a voice on the radio.
Search for GPS fragments, Aveline’s journal, and the clues that lead deep into the cursed forest.
The more you discover, the less you want to know.

Each piece of the story brings you closer to the truth.
Or closer to something that cannot be stopped.

Face it.

Silence shatters.
Something steps out from the dark.
It doesn’t breathe. It doesn’t blink.
It just watches.

Light is your life.
But even that won’t always save you.
Not every fight is meant to be won – sometimes survival means running.
Hide. Turn off your flashlight. Don’t move.

The demon senses fear. And it feeds on it.

See what remains.

The door opens slowly. The smell of blood, smoke, and ash.
Signs of struggle. Bodies.
A mark on the wall – the same one you’ve seen before.

You know it’s the demon’s work.
But why? Who was it looking for?
You keep moving forward, because there’s no other choice.
Only answers might lead to escape.

Survive together.

Three players. One night.
Each of you holds the light. Each of you could be the last.

Help each other – or watch your friends fall one by one.
Sometimes silence saves. Sometimes it betrays.
Only teamwork gives you a chance.

Trust becomes the currency of survival.
But remember… something always watches from the trees.

Tracks. Fear. Choices.

You see footprints that don’t belong to humans.
You hear something moving behind you.
Is it the demon? Or just the echo of your fear?

Together you decide – direction, light, silence.
Every choice has a price.
Not every path leads to salvation.
Not every silence is safe.

Escape... if you can.

The GPS signal grows stronger.
The radio crackles – someone answers.
A helicopter awaits... or maybe it lies.

Your heart races. The demon is right behind you.
The light flickers, your scream drowns in the forest.

This is the final run.
The final chance.
Don’t look back.

Key Features

- 🌲 Dark, haunting forest – silence, whispers, and fear.

- 👥 4-player co-op – share the light and the panic.

- 📖 Aveline’s story – uncover her fate and decide her salvation.

- 🔦 Light & noise mechanics – shine wisely, or die trying.

- 👹 Relentless demon – stalking, hunting, killing.

- 🗺️ Exploration & survival – puzzles, traps, and the struggle for every GPS piece.

- 🚁 Climactic escape – radio chatter, rescue signals, and a desperate sprint to freedom.

😈 Will you dare to enter the forest?
The darkness waits. You decide who returns from it

games.name: No Such Place
games.shortDescription: Welcome to the Unknown Research Consortium (U.R.C.), where you’re tasked with conducting reconnaissance missions, terminating unknown threats, gathering crucial information, and reaching the evacuation point in this treacherous top-down extraction shooter.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the U.R.C. — the Unknown Research Consortium.

The operation is about to begin. Stay combat-ready.

Explore anomalous zones — from abandoned facilities and deserted outposts to forests locked in eternal flame and deadly high-altitude snowfields. Scavenge weapons, medicine, gear, and supplies while recovering ancient artifacts, unknown biological samples, and hidden encrypted documents. Bring back valuable intel, then reach the Extraction Point and return to the Safe House before time runs out.

The twisted species emerging within these zones are only one of the obstacles standing in your way. You will also encounter agents from rival factions, mercenaries, and madmen whose minds have been swallowed by the void. When order disappears, the deadliest threat is not always the beast in front of you.

Above all else, remember the first rule of every operation:

Survive.

Use the Gunsmith system to turn whatever you can find into something deadly. Every unorthodox build is yours to test, and the answer will reveal itself the moment you pull the trigger — whether you have created a battlefield-dominating superweapon or a metal coffin that detonates in your hands.

When dark violet corruption patterns begin to crawl across the weapon’s surface, it means the gun has broken free from traditional specifications. “Compatibility” no longer applies. You might craft an engineering miracle that defies logic. Or you might end up with a dangerous piece of scrap fit only for an accident report.

Even after rigorous training and time spent adapting to this alien environment, an agent’s growth is never complete. Greater strength, agility, and firearm control help you carry more, move faster, and react before the threat does. Every sprint, strike, and shot sharpens your body, instincts, and weapon proficiency.

Bring back resources, maintain your gear, reinforce your facilities, and turn that “junk” into another chance to survive. Never underestimate the value of logistics. Once you transform your Safe House into a fortress, your next step into the abyss will be steadier than the last.

Venture into Dimensional Fragments alone, or form an exploration squad with up to three other U.R.C. agents for multiplayer missions. Close coordination can greatly improve your extraction rewards and survival odds. Here, watching each other’s backs is not just a virtue. It is essential for survival.

Your squad’s contributions to humanity’s survival and advancement have been noted.

—U.R.C. Joint Committee

games.name: Snow Resort Simulator
games.shortDescription: Start with nothing but a ticket booth in the mountains. Clear snow, chop wood, crack ice off rooftops, all by hand, all in first person. Serve drinks, cook meals, repair ski gear, and turn a rundown mountain stop into a full-blown resort with a hotel, restaurant, bar, and shop.
games.aboutText:
You don't manage this resort from a menu. You run it with your own two hands.

Snow Resort Simulator drops you at the foot of a mountain with nothing but a run-down ticket booth. Every improvement starts with physical work: shovel snow off walkways, chop firewood and feed it to the fireplace, crack ice off rooftops with snowballs, and haul supplies through the cold. As your resort grows, so does what you can do.

Keep the energy high all day long at the après-ski party zone. As a steady flow of guests drops by to grab quick snacks and refreshing drinks, step into the DJ booth on the upper balcony to keep the crowd moving. Hit the rhythm to the beat of the music, entertain the partygoers, and earn extra bonus tips to boost your daily income.

Shape the mountain to your liking by building ski lifts and carving out custom slopes. Place lift towers across the terrain to transport skiers to the top, then carve out downhill trails of any length or shape. Personalize your runs with custom boundary colors, directional arrows, and unique slope names to create a world-class resort experience.

Build guest houses and rent rooms to overnight visitors. Clean up after checkout, restock supplies, and watch as hotel guests flood your bar, restaurant, and shop with extra business.

Open a repair shop and fix broken ski gear by hand. Diagnose the problem, grab the right tools, and get it done. Upgrade your shop to take on bigger jobs and stock new equipment for sale.

Run the bar during après-ski hours. Pour beers, shake cocktails, and keep the drinks flowing while guests unwind after a long day on the slopes.

Open a retail shop and sell winter gear to your guests. Stock the shelves, price your inventory, and handle the checkout yourself. Bigger orders mean bigger profits.

Hop on a snowbike and explore the mountain. The map is large, the snow is deep, and there's always a reason to head out, whether it's chopping wood, hauling supplies, or just enjoying the ride.

Run the kitchen yourself. Take orders, cook meals, mix drinks, and clear tables before the next wave of hungry guests arrives. Upgrade your menu and equipment to serve more customers and earn more per order.

Sell lift tickets to incoming skiers and get your first income flowing. It's simple work, but it's the foundation of everything you'll build.

Clear snow and debris to unlock new areas. Chop wood and keep fireplaces burning. Repair ski nets after storms. Track down lost wallets and phones. Collect pinecones across the mountainside. Throw snowballs at guests, just because you can.

Snowstorms will pile up work and break your equipment. Keep the resort open through a blizzard and earn your reputation. Stay up late enough and you might catch the northern lights. Hang Christmas decorations during the holiday season for a revenue boost.

games.name: HER TREES : PUZZLE DREAM
games.shortDescription: HER TREES : PUZZLE DREAM is a unique point-and-click puzzle game where you move and combine objects to solve puzzles. Unravel the strange puzzles hidden in your dreams.
games.aboutText:
HER TREES : PUZZLE DREAM is a unique point-and-click puzzle game where you move and combine objects to solve puzzles. Unravel the strange puzzles hidden in your dreams.

　

This is the third game in the series, but it can be enjoyed as a standalone title for newcomers.

　

　

Main Features:

- Over 40 unique puzzles

- Puzzles that can be solved through intuition and observation, with no tedious calculations or note-taking required.

- Hints and solutions available after a certain amount of time

- Approximately 1.5-3 hours of playtime

　

For a diverse range of players:

- Non-verbal game

- Entirely monochrome design, with puzzles that can be solved regardless of color perception

- No puzzles that rely on sound

games.name: Wild Terrain
games.shortDescription: You're a wild pig on a quest to find all of your missing piglets. Smash obstacles, forage through trash for food, discover special mushrooms, and poop flowers to restore balance as you grow closer to your piglet family and the wild around you.
games.aboutText:
Wild Terrain is an animal adventure where you play as a wild boar searching for your missing piglets. Explore a vibrant natural world and experience the life of a wild animal in a wholesome, playful way.

Use your strength to smash, toss and forage through the environment. Charge through obstacles, knock over trash bins for food, and uncover secrets hidden across the land.

🐗 Key Features:

- Wild Life - Be a wild boar, living freely and causing chaos.

- Piglets - Find and rescue your lost piglets, then travel, play and interact with them.

- Playful Chaos - Knock over trash bins, smash objects, and reshape the environment.

- Animals - Make friends with foxes, frogs, deer, ants, and more along your journey.

- Poop Anywhere - Eat food to charge your poop and grow new plants.

- Rewilding - Use mushrooms to heal toxic areas and restore natural balance.

- Natural World - Explore a lively world full of surprises at your own pace.

- Fruit Hats - Wear silly hats, gain weight, and customize your appearance.

Help the forest recover by using mushrooms to heal toxic areas, and poop new flowers to rewild nature. Reunite with your piglets, travel together, and become a part of the living symbiosis between animals, plants and mushrooms.

games.name: Back in the Swamp
games.shortDescription: A first-person point-and-click adventure set in a mysterious post-apocalyptic swamp filled with giant insects and abandoned robots. Explore the ruins, observe your surroundings, and find what you need to move forward. Now featuring an expanded ending and a new area above the ruins.
games.aboutText:
A first-person, point-and-click adventure set in a retro-futuristic, post-apocalyptic world where giant insects and abandoned robots reign supreme.

Take your time to explore and find your way.

Combine specific items to create new ones in your inventory.

Pick up items that can be used later.

Engaging narrative that invites you to explore and understand the world's secrets and history, including discovering lore by collecting pages of drawings in a journal.

FEATURES

- Explore atmospheric locations brought to life with immersive environmental sound and detailed scenery.

- Observe your surroundings carefully — subtle cursor animations reveal hidden objects and interactive elements.

- Interact through hand-drawn sketches that visually show the actions your character can perform.

- Find and use objects to trigger events and uncover new paths forward.

- Combine certain items in your inventory to unlock new interactions.

- Trigger cinematic sequences that reveal the story and open new areas to explore.

- Travel between locations using a fast-travel map once areas are discovered.

- Collect illustrated sketchbook pages that gradually reveal the world’s history.

games.name: Effulgence RPG
games.shortDescription: Effulgence RPG is a party-based RPG where symbols form 3D visuals. Enemies are more than obstacles - they ARE the resource 💀. Destroy them to forge better gear!
games.aboutText:
A WORLD MADE OF CHARACTERS

Everything you see in Effulgence RPG is built from text characters arranged into 3D forms. Landscapes, creatures, machines and effects come to life as these forms move, rotate and transform throughout a strange sci-fi world.

ENEMIES ARE THE RESOURCE

Defeated enemies break apart into particles. Collect them and use the matter printer to create new weapons and equipment. You can even print during battle, turning fallen enemies into tools for the fights ahead.

FIGHT AS A PARTY

Control four heroes in tactical turn-based battles, each with their own strengths and abilities. Upgrade their skills, combine weapons, cartridges and mechanisms, and adapt to enemies and bosses with their own rules and mechanics.

A COMPACT RPG ADVENTURE

Effulgence RPG is a focused adventure that doesn't demand a hundred-hour commitment. A typical playthrough takes around 5–7 hours , with varied locations, story encounters, secrets and bosses along the way.

- Three types of mini-games woven into the adventure

- Deploy unusual mechanisms, from a combat sparrow to a flamethrower copter

- Bosses built around unique mechanics

- Dozens of blueprints for printable weapons, gear, and mechanisms

games.name: Conscience
games.shortDescription: Jack Beckham is found dead, hanging in his apartment alone. Police rule it a suicide. His father, refusing to accept the conclusion, hires you to investigate. Delve into the clues left behind in his apartment to discover what really happened.
games.aboutText:
Conscience is a noir detective mystery where you play as a private investigator hired to uncover the truth behind Jack Beckham's death. Initially ruled as a suicide, Jack’s father believes otherwise and hires you to search Jack’s apartment for clues to reveal what really happened.

Investigate and explore Jack’s apartment, searching every room, shelf, and drawer for evidence and clues.

Inspect the evidence , uncovering hidden details and piecing together crucial clues.

Deduce what truly happened using the clues you’ve gathered to solve the mystery.

Solve the Mystery...

games.name: Mansion of the Dead
games.shortDescription: Step into the shoes of Agent Kim, drawn into a chilling mystery deep in the wilderness. Find hidden clues, solve intricate puzzles, and outsmart the relentless zombies that roam the estate. Will you make it out alive, or will you too vanish without a trace?
games.aboutText:
Step into the shoes of Agent Kim, a seasoned private investigator drawn into a chilling mystery deep in the wilderness. Nine people have vanished from an eerie villa over the past 20 years, including your latest client’s adventurous relative, Mr. Lin. The police have failed to uncover any leads, leaving the task of solving this haunting puzzle to you.

After sneaking into the villa, you’re struck by an unknown force and awaken in a cold, desolate room. The air is thick with dread as you realize you’ve become the latest prisoner of this cursed mansion. With danger lurking around every corner and the undead stalking your every move, it’s a race against time to escape.

Explore the villa’s dark corridors, uncover its sinister past, and piece together the terrifying truth behind the disappearances. Find hidden clues, solve intricate puzzles, and outsmart the relentless zombies that roam the estate. Your only hope is to escape before becoming another soul lost to the mansion’s curse.

Will you make it out alive, or will you too vanish without a trace?

games.name: Infinite Ball Well
games.shortDescription: INFINITE BALL WELL is a Pachinko Roguelite Deckbuilder with fast-paced runs. Launch Pinballs into Pegs to score points, mix and match hundreds of distinctive Pegs and Relics, and explore endless build possibilities as you clatter and ricochet ever deeper underground!
games.aboutText:
Big news! A certain goblin has discovered a mysterious ancient mine and claims that untold dwarven riches lie at its deepest point. Adventurers are flocking there in droves—but wait! Could this be yet another goblin scheme?

Gameplay

INFINITE BALL WELL is a Pachinko Roguelite Deckbuilder. Aim, launch, score! It is easy to pick up and hard to put down. Each run takes only around 15 minutes, delivering a fast-paced strategic deckbuilding experience. With hundreds of mechanically distinct Pegs and hundreds of gameplay-changing Relics, the game offers a wealth of strategies and endless build possibilities.

Build Your Deck Wisely

- 100+ Pegs with unique mechanics

- Adapt on the fly by adding, removing, Exhausting, and Transforming Pegs to build a Deck that suits you

Relics Rewrite the Rules

- 100+ gameplay-changing Relics

- Treat Poop as an ingredient so your frying pan can cook it, or stick firecrackers into Poop and send poop balls flying everywhere. Hmm...

Crack Open Ore and Upgrade Your Pegs

- Score high to trigger a Level Skip and obtain mysterious ore

- Crack open mysterious ore to uncover dozens of Essences that grant special effects to your Pegs

And More!

- Collect cola caps to improve all kinds of abilities

- Try different starting Pinballs and take on multiple difficulty levels

- Push your build to its limits in Endless Mode

- Explore new strategies under different starting rules in Challenge Mode

- And when you need a break, the goblin will even buy you a cola!

games.name: Lonely House
games.shortDescription: Lonely House is a cozy little game about home decorating. It's just you, pleasant music, and a solitary building at a crossroads. Decorate it to your liking and forget about your troubles.
games.aboutText:
Would you like to immerse yourself in a cozy atmosphere with unobtrusive Lo-Fi music and express your creativity in home decoration? Go ahead!
­
In our little game, you can:

­

- Use various plants and other objects to decorate the house

- Adorn the walls with different graffiti

- Add stylish signs and control their lighting

- Change the walls styles and adjust the building's height

- And even take control of the sun and weather!

And don't forget to simply admire the cherry blossoms ⌛

games.name: Sky End Market
games.shortDescription: This is a game to manage a supermarket. Set up shelves, arrange products, and make your store bigger and bigger!　Sell your goods to the remaining people, animals, and robots in the last place on earth just before the human race is exterminated.
games.aboutText:
Sky End Market” is a supermarket management game.

Sell your products to cute customers, animals, and robots drawn with pixel.

Your store

Build your own supermarket by freely setting up shelves, checkout counters, shopping baskets, decorations, and more.

Display

Unlock new products, stock them and put them on the shelves.

Cashier

At the cash register, scan items and receive payment. Enjoy a variety of payment formats, including cash, cashless codes handled by robots, and acorns handled by animals.

The future just before human extinction

This is a time just before the extinction of the human race. It is the last place on earth where survivors, robots, and animals are huddled together for the last time.

You will help them by managing the world's last supermarket.

About the development

The exciting feeling you had as a child when you played shop with money made out of paper.

I want to express that in a 2D world of cute dots.

That's why I'm making this game.

This game is made entirely by one developer.

Only one person, but I will update frequently and do my best !!!!!

Please support me !!!!!!!!!!!

games.name: Zombie Must Dead!
games.shortDescription: Guizi Must Dead is a historical FPS with Tarkov-like gameplay and survival base-building. Infiltrate enemy lines, loot supplies, fight foes, and extract safely. Use resources to farm and fortify your base. Inspired by WWII guerrilla resistance, supports up to 4-player co-op.
games.aboutText:
Guizi Must Dead is a historical FPS with Tarkov-like gameplay and survival base-building. Infiltrate enemy lines, loot supplies, fight foes, and extract safely. Use resources to farm and fortify your base. Inspired by WWII guerrilla resistance, supports up to 4-player co-op.

Tarkov-like guerrilla warfare.

Play as a guerrilla fighter, ambush enemy convoys to seize supplies, and escape successfully from enemy encirclement.

Diverse weapons system

including the dadao (Chinese broadsword), the Mauser C96, the Kar98k, the MP40, the PPSh-41, and other classic WWII weapons.

You can also obtain powerful period weapons through black-market dealers and by reproducing them from blueprints.

All weapons can be upgraded at your base — for example, the Mauser C96 (broomhandle) can be fitted with a fire-selector to convert it to fully automatic.

Base building and farming

Be self-sufficient — build and expand your base and farm to secure food.
Raise livestock for meat; animal manure can be processed into fertilizer to improve your fields.
Cooked food restores health and grants temporary attribute boosts.
Your base can also mine and smelt ore, and use recovered weapon blueprints to manufacture and upgrade firearms and equipment.

games.name: Chronocracy
games.shortDescription: Build a unique civilization in a flat world! Explore, extract resources, expand, and battle enemies. Use your time management skills to fend off attacks and face a mysterious threat. Are you ready to create a world that can survive?
games.aboutText:
Chronocracy is an exciting real-time strategy game where you'll lead a small civilization, developing its society and surviving on a whimsical flat earth disk.

Lead your tribe, wisely allocate forces and resources to fend off neighboring attacks, uncover secrets hidden in time, and save your civilization from destruction.

- Explore both the surface and underground depths, build mines, and gather rare resources.

- Develop your cities and master the planet.

- Harness technologies ranging from agriculture to advanced scientific achievements.

- Discover new tools for efficient management of resources and settlements.

- Assemble a powerful army, from squads of archers and spearmen to modern helicopters and megatitans!

- Form diplomatic alliances with other peoples.

- Travel through time to rewrite the destiny of your tribe.

Lead one of three tribes and bring it to greatness by building a network of prosperous cities and exploring the entire planet! Start with a town hall and a handful of loyal followers, and create a highly developed civilization ready to face not only fluffy plump birds but also fearsome invaders.

Hire scholars and research the sciences to unlock new technologies and buildings. More than 15 unique buildings await you, each bringing your civilization closer to planetary greatness. Develop basic infrastructure: build housing, ensure food and resource production. Create economic buildings for trade, extraction of rare materials, and production of unique resources. Build powerful military structures to defend your lands and arm your people, from bows and spears to firearms and cavalry of plump bird riders.

The flat world of Chronocracy may seem peaceful and cozy, but behind its charming facade lie threats that could destroy your civilization. You will encounter multiple enemies, from treacherous local fauna, including plump birds and larvae, to unfriendly neighbors and mysterious dark guests from afar.

To survive, organize efficient resource extraction and production, maintain a balance between combat and peaceful units, uncover the secrets of mysterious foes, and eliminate threats before they become irreversible. Can you protect your civilization and turn it into a powerful force capable of conquering this strange world?

Resource extraction and production are key to the survival and development of your civilization. There are more than 20 different types of resources that will provide everything you need to thrive.

Some resources will need to be mined on the surface or deep in the earth, while others can only be created through scientific discovery and advanced technology.

Once you master time management, you will gain access to a unique resource—Metamaterial—which will become the basis for creating powerful Titans and defense against formidable invaders.

Become a master of resource management and use it to turn your civilization into an invincible force. Forward to great achievements!

The game runs in windowed mode on ultrawide displays.
Designed for keyboard and mouse. Controller support and Steam Deck compatibility are not available.

games.name: As Long As You're Here
games.shortDescription: What if you lost all your memories? An emotional family drama seen through the eyes of a woman with Alzheimer's disease. As Annie’s life slowly unravels, uncover memories of her deceased brother as her past bleeds into the present.
games.aboutText:
What if you lost all your memories? An emotional family drama seen through the eyes of a woman with Alzheimer's disease. As Annie’s life slowly unravels, uncover memories of her deceased brother as her past bleeds into the present.

STORY

Inspired by personal stories. You play as Annie, an elderly woman whose memory is starting to betray her. Annie and her children cope with reversed caretaking roles as she moves from her long-time home. While her children clash over how to care for her, old memories of Annie’s long-dead brother start to emerge.

As Long As You're Here is a subtle reflection of what life with dementia might look like, and a story about complex sibling relationships.

SHORT & PERSONAL

As Long As You're Here is a short and personal experience made with care by a small team of developers.

The aim is to create a mature and nuanced experience that shows the difficult repercussions of losing not only your memory, but also your agency and sense of time and place.

What disappears when we forget?

... and what resurfaces?

FEATURES

- Short & Subtle: A short and subtle experience designed to be enjoyed in one sitting.

- Personal : Inspired by real stories and includes real-life photos of the developers' own family members - some of whom suffered from Alzheimer's disease.

- Story Rich: Explore Annie's life through dialogue, mementos, and letters from the past. Meet family members and unpack the tensions and dynamics between them.

- Subversive Vignettes: The player's own memory comes into play. As the world around Annie shifts and changes, players share in her failing faculties.

- Immersive Audio & Original Music

ABOUT AUTOSCOPIA INTERACTIVE

Autoscopia Interactive is a small and diverse game studio based in Copenhagen, Denmark, with developers from Denmark, The Netherlands, and the U.S.

Our studio name comes from the word "autoscopy" — an experience of "watching yourself" from a distant point of view. We make introspective games that put players in underrepresented roles, and hope to give you a glimpse of yourself from another perspective.

------------

DISCLAIMER

As Long As You're Here shows life through the eyes of someone with dementia, and while it can be a cathartic experience for some, it might be unpleasant for others.

If this is not a topic you are ready to engage with, skip As Long As You're Here for today and take care of yourself.

games.name: Bento Blocks
games.shortDescription: Craft delicious lunch boxes in this cozy-yet-challenging ingredient-cutting puzzle game.
games.aboutText:
Bento Blocks is a cozy puzzle game about slicing and packing ingredients neatly into lunch boxes using the fewest cuts.

...

Test your culinary creativity by exploring over 180 hand-crafted levels , each with its own quirky twist and satisfying solution.

...

Play how you like! Unwind with gentle music, bite-sized challenges and calming visuals. No pressure, no timer, play the game at your own pace.

...

Fewer cuts mean more stars for your recipe book ... but it might not be so shrimple after all.

...

FEATURES

- Pack delicious ingredients into a variety of quirky bento boxes.

- The fewer slices you make, the more stars you'll earn.

- Play through 180+ hand-crafted puzzles and unlock new scenery as you progress.

- Unwind with live-recorded music and soothing hand-painted art.

- No pressure and no timers -- play entirely at your own pace.

Thank you for reading! Support us by wish-listing the game and join our cozy community on Discord!

games.name: Fishing The Abyss
games.shortDescription: This is a relaxing atmospheric game where you simply watch a robot catch creatures. Place it at the edge of your screen like a vertical desktop accessory and observe the ecosystem. It’s neither an idle game with mountains of stats nor an exciting fishing game.
games.aboutText:
Note 1: This is not an idle or clicker game.

Note 2: There is no exciting or active fishing experience in this game.

A relaxing desktop accessory with idle elements that lets you sink into the depths of a fishing pond.

This is more like a desktop accessory than a traditional game, so it might not even qualify as a "game" in the usual sense.

It’s designed for people who are too busy to play games. You can place it on the side of your screen, glance at it occasionally, and feel a small sense of accomplishment as you level up or complete minor tasks.

You might find yourself surprised by changes in the environment or discover eerie creatures caught on your line—those are the moments to enjoy.

Gameplay

- A small robot will start fishing on its own.

- You can let it fish idly or actively assist by clicking.

- Catch various creatures to earn points.

- Use points to level up various abilities.

- Level up to reach deeper parts of the fishing pond.

That’s all there is to it.
The main purpose is to enjoy discovering various creatures and changes in the fishing pond environment throughout the process.
There’s also a collection feature, so have fun completing it.

Note

This game and the store page use machine translations.

While the game has minimal text, some translations might be unclear. Please keep this in mind.

People who may not enjoy this game:

- Thalassophobia: Fear of the ocean or large creatures.

- Dislike of insect elements.

- Trypophobia: Aversion to eerie creatures with many eyes or clusters.

As you descend into the abyss, the atmosphere becomes increasingly unsettling, and the creatures inhabiting it change accordingly to more eerie forms.

Please consider carefully before purchasing.

For those expecting a stimulating gaming experience or an overload of stats and numbers:

This game is not for you.

It’s a game where most progress happens over time, even if you barely interact with it.

The most it offers is the possibility of feeling like you’ve “played” a game, even when you’re too busy to actually play one.

Frequently Asked Questions and Answers

Q: I want to read setting texts that explain the creatures or the game’s world.

A: While this may not concern buyers, as a solo developer without a publisher, I cannot afford the cost of preparing explanatory texts. I understand that such texts are a standard feature in many games. Instead, I focused on creating more creature types to provide visual variety and enhance the atmosphere for players to enjoy.

If you absolutely must read such texts, I recommend refraining from purchasing.

I apologize if buying and playing the game leaves you disappointed.

Q: The idle time feels too short.

A: This game is not designed to be as focused on idling as games typically categorized as "idle games."

It is better to think of it as a game with "idle elements" rather than a fully idle game.

If you wish to increase the idle time, it is recommended to prioritize upgrading the point capacity limit over other elements.

(We are considering whether better adjustments can be made without compromising the experience.)

Q: The translation feels rough.

A: This game uses machine translation for its localization.

While we make efforts to ensure the content is as clear as possible through reverse translation and other checks, if the drawbacks of machine translation are a concern, we recommend refraining from purchasing.

games.name: TinyCraft Town
games.shortDescription: TinyCraft Town is a simple 2D pixel art survival game focused on light resource management, crafting, and exploration. Gather materials, cook food, fish, build workstations, craft weapons and restore a small ruined village. Inspired by games like RuneScape and Conan Exiles—without the complexity.
games.aboutText:
🏝️ TinyCraft Town is a simple 2D pixel art survival game focused on light resource management, crafting, and exploration. Gather materials, cook food, fish, build workstations, craft weapons and gear, and restore a small ruined village. Inspired by games like RuneScape, Valheim, and Conan Exiles—without the complexity.

This is a relaxing crafting sim with satisfying progression, cozy visuals, and no pressure — just you, your tools, and a world to rebuild.

🪓 What will you do?

🛠️ Gather & Craft – Chop wood, mine ores, and create workstations and tools to fuel your progress.
🏘️ Rebuild the Town – Fix abandoned buildings to unlock new features, recipes, and characters.
🌱 Explore & Expand – Discover new lands and resources as you repair bridges, docks, and passageways.
📦 Strategic Resource Flow – Optimize your village's productivity and balance your economy.
🎵 Chill Atmosphere – A cozy pixel world with a soothing soundtrack, perfect for relaxed play sessions.
♻️ Early Access Evolving World – Frequent content updates and new systems on the horizon.

If you enjoy games like Forager , Travellers Rest , or Stardew Valley , but want something more focused on crafting and calm progression , TinyCraft Town is the perfect escape.

🧰 Whether you're here to optimize or just to unwind — your village awaits.

Thank you so much for your visit! I'm a solo indie game developer and I am doing my best to improve the game based on the community feedback. By purchasing the game you are encoraging me to keep making games even better. Best wishes!

games.name: Rocket Squad: Infinity
games.shortDescription: Rocket Squad is a team-based first-person shooter. Infiltrate perilous planets, gather resources, and return safely to your shelter. Utilize each character's unique abilities and strategically form your team to restore order to the universe.
games.aboutText:
For the Peace and Order of the Universe!

Rocket Squad is a team-based first-person shooter.

Infiltrate perilous planets, gather resources, and return safely to your shelter.

Utilize each character's unique abilities and strategically form your team to restore order to the universe.

Agents

Each character possesses unique abilities.

Analyze their strengths and assemble your team strategically.

Budget Management

Every action consumes funds, and lack of resources can severely hinder mission performance.

Manage your finances carefully before and after each operation, and use your team’s budget without waste.

Efficient financial management is the key to victory.

Planet Infiltration

The economic order of the universe has collapsed.

The development of the Infinity Quantum Core has enabled infinite cryptocurrency mining, causing this catastrophe.

Infiltrate dangerous planets to restore peace and order to the universe.

Combat Against Robots

The robots have monopolized the Infinity Quantum Core, bringing ruin to the universe's economy.

They are no longer mere machines.

Face off against the wealthy robots who have become enemies of the universe.

Economic Recovery

Obtain valuable items and escape safely.

Raid the vaults of the affluent robots and secure the future of a struggling universe.

Player Enhancement

Enhance your character’s abilities with a variety of artifacts.

Combine artifacts that suit your character’s traits to develop your own unique playstyle.

Shelter Customization

Your shelter is your safe haven.

Decorate it with various furniture and ornaments to make it truly yours.

Multiplayer

Form a squad with up to four friends and save the universe together!

games.name: Big Winner
games.shortDescription: In a future where the financial system has collapsed, the lottery becomes a lifeline for survival, with luck as the only currency. As an ordinary person in this predestined world, can you leverage the "Luck System" with courage and wit to rise from obscurity and attain the wealth others covet?
games.aboutText:
Contact email: ifasupport@cedong.com.cn

In the modern city of Jiangcheng, social classes are rigidly defined, and people's hearts are in turmoil. Here, luck has replaced money as the true measure of wealth, and the lottery has become a vital source of daily necessities. The "Battle of the Big Winners," where luck serves as capital, has emerged as the sole pathway to ascendancy. Only through continuous victories can one break through the class barriers and reach the coveted "Pinnacle of Citizens."

The Big Winner - A Clash of Luck and Strategy

This unique version of poker, infused with a twist, allows you, equipped with a system, to peer into your opponent's hand using "Causality Cards." At critical moments, you can secretly swap out "junk cards" for winning hands like flushes or three-of-a-kinds, turning the tide of the game! Engage in psychological warfare, leveraging your powerful "verbal skills" to instill doubt in your opponents before the cards are revealed, causing them to fold or impulsively raise their bets, making you the king of mindset in Jiangcheng.

Your survival hinges on scratch cards

From chocolate-spiced chili to creamy steamed eggplant, whether you can whip up a decent "dish" depends entirely on your luck. Your fashion sense, whether it’s a suit paired with yoga pants or a pleated skirt with a grandpa tank top, is dictated by what you can scratch off. You can also scratch for housing, furniture, electric bikes, and cars... In Jiangcheng, making it this far is all about luck. With hundreds of different hairstyles, outfits, ingredients, and vehicles, boost your luck to play a vibrant dress-up game!

Experience a romantic story in a fantastical world

Set in a unique worldview centered around "luck," this contemporary urban fantasy diverges from the norm. Across various sectors—work, sports, healthcare, cuisine, and gaming—nine romantic interests from different social strata await. Each character embodies both good and evil, resistance and struggle, with their own intricate backstories. Choose your life partner and join hands with them to uncover the hidden secrets of River Town.

The game currently features 9 dateable NPCs, and we will be releasing the 10th NPC in the future. Stay tuned!

Exploring New River City to become the ultimate winner

Roam freely through the bustling streets and hidden alleys, relying on your luck to scavenge for treasures; even a beggar can survive in River City.

If you prefer not to depend on luck or the lottery, you can choose to work hard and earn a living, taking steady steps to accumulate wealth.

In the turbulent currents of River City, a miraculous ascent from the bottom to the top awaits your realization.

games.name: Lilac 0
games.shortDescription: The machine world of Molybdion has fallen into disarray. As Nidhogg eats the root of the planet, unending wars rage on the surface! Slice your way through hordes of metallic foes in five frantic levels, defeat fearsome bosses, and dodge countless bullets in this vintage vertical shoot 'em up.
games.aboutText:
The machine world of Molybdion has fallen into disarray. As Nidhogg eats the root of the planet, unending wars rage on the surface, and machines fight endlessly in the sky above. Slice your way through hordes of metallic foes in five frantic levels, defeat fearsome bosses, and dodge countless bullets in this vintage vertical shoot 'em up.

Key features:

- 2 playable characters for different playstyles

- 3 difficulty levels for broader accessibility

- 5 increasingly complex levels

- Overkill enemies to gain more score

- Local and online leaderboards

- Tate options for vertical monitors

- Choose between 8 different color pallets

- Enjoy the chiptune metal soundtrack by Withered Media

- A vintage pixel art and CRT style evocative of the arcade era

games.name: Truxton Extreme
games.shortDescription: Take down hordes of alien invaders with your Power Shot, Truxton Beam, Thunder Laser, Homing Shot, Star‑mine Shot, and more! Don't forget to breathe as you face off against gigantic bosses in the ultimate battle for humanity’s survival!
games.aboutText:
IT'S ON LIKE TRUXTON!

Truxton Extreme delivers white-hot shooter thrills for masters and novices alike. Take down hordes of alien invaders with your Power Shot, Truxton Beam, Thunder Laser, Homing Shot, Star‑mine Shot, and more! Don't forget to breathe as you face off against gigantic bosses in the ultimate battle for humanity’s survival

RETRO FURY, MODERN FIREPOWER

The game’s content, sound, and visuals have all evolved since the 80s. Truxton Extreme is now fully rendered in 3D while preserving the series’ iconic design. Staring insect-like faces, writhing metal tentacles, long mechanical serpents, glowing eye-like lights, and spikes… In Truxton Extreme, you’ll face your worst nightmares—and blow them to pieces!

A SOUNDTRACK TO SAVE THE WORLD

Truxton has always been famous for its soundtrack, and Truxton Extreme is no exception. Original mastermind Masahiro Yuge returns with an explosive new score, packed with excitement and atmosphere. Experience iconic Truxton tracks reimagined from the original games alongside brand-new music. It’s the best of both worlds!

TOGETHER OR ALONE?

There are multiple ways to enjoy Truxton Extreme. The main mode is Story, where you follow three characters, level up as you go, and experience the narrative through an epic (and animated) manga series. For traditionalists, there's Arcade, and if you want more firepower, Team will let you play together with a friend and share your lives and score. Then there's a blistering score-attack Arena, Training and Tutorial too!

THE MASTER OF UNLOCKING

Do you love unlocking bonus content in games? Well, it’s your lucky day! In Model Viewer, you can check out the enemies you’ve defeated. And don’t forget to visit the mysterious Pipiru Village, home of all the cute Pipiru creatures. What happens when you evolve their home…?

THE PIANO PROGRAMMER WITH LASER DREAMS

Truxton was conceived by Masahiro Yuge during his time at Toaplan, with the goal of creating a scrolling shooter where muscle memory was key. But Yuge wasn’t just a programmer, he was a classically trained pianist, bringing a unique and critically acclaimed approach to game design

games.name: Kats Trigger
games.shortDescription: "Kats Trigger" is story-driven, hyper-speed action. Shoot, slash, and fly through explosive combat. In a beautifully crafted pixel art world, witness the bond between Otter and Stray Cat.
games.aboutText:
"Kats Trigger" is a game inspired by masterpieces of games, films, manga, and anime from the 1980s to the 2020s, created with deep respect and admiration for the great creators behind them.

Experience hyper-speed noir action that pushes the limits of intensity, while enjoying a quietly unfolding story delicately woven within.

■ Slash, shoot, stab, and wipe them out. If no one survives, it’s an assassination.

Cut down swarms of enemies with your blade, and deliver holy bullets to cowards who snipe from afar.

Evade attacks with quick dashes or deflect them with your sword to counterattack.

Combat rewards flexible thinking and unconventional actions. Above all, it should feel satisfying.

■ Grappling with a wire is one of the core mechanics of the game.

Pin it into walls to move rapidly, use it on specific objects to maximize mobility,

or fire it at enemies to restrain and disable them.

Dominate your enemies with free, three-dimensional movement in all directions and enjoy the overwhelming sense of speed.

■ Flashy combat is not the only answer. Sometimes, one clean slash is enough.

Avoid enemy sightlines, slip behind them, and take them down in a single strike.

Attacks from behind instantly kill weaker foes, and even larger enemies cannot avoid severe damage.

■ Enjoy combat with a wide variety of weapons.

You may find special ammunition placed around the battlefield.

Shotgun rounds that dominate at close range, missiles specialized in destroying machines, flamethrowers that burn wide areas—

use different types of ammo to gain the upper hand in combat.

■ Enemies are not limited to humans.

Massive demolition machines that smash through buildings, fighter jets that rule the skies, and crop harvesters modified for unknown purposes.

These colossal, living weapons appear as bosses, completely changing the scale of battle.

games.name: Constantine Scores
games.shortDescription: Constantine Scores is a single-player heisting Sci-fi First Person Shooter. Upgrade your arsenal to gain more abilities, weapons, and perks to keep the playing field equal. Fight against three separate factions, spanning multiple contracts, and randomized multi-day campaigns.
games.aboutText:
Constantine Scores is a single-player heisting first-person shooter. Set in the Year 2375, you work as a freelance agent, handling contracts for the United Earth Federation. As a mercenary, you fight against three factions in short contracts or randomized campaigns.

Sent alone you must complete the objectives given to you by the director. With a contractor to help guide you in your missions. Upgrade your arsenal to gain more abilities, weapons, and perks to keep the playing field equal.

Player Customization

Players can customize their agent using the credits they earn from missions.

- Weapons such as your primary, secondary, and melee.

- Augmentations that give special perks.

- Armors that give different stat boots.

- Alternative attacks utilizing a shoulder cannon.

- Abilities that give passive boosts when activated.

- Drones that assist in combat.

- Operator Ranks are a prestige system that gives rewards.

Contracts

Contracts are short, replayable single-day missions. Fourteen missions will be available on launch. Each contract has randomization, including layout and objective location changes. Each mission pits you against one of the three factions and can only be completed by going loud.

Campaigns

Campaigns are randomized multi-day contracts, utilizing solo contract missions and shuffling them to form a mini-campaign. This allows players to experience missions back-to-back in a random order that escalates from smaller missions to larger ones. On launch, you can expect to play three to five-day campaigns.

Factions

- Constantines Empire. Constantine was a rogue military general turned emperor. Uniting many disgruntled colonies to join the Empire, with an ambition to consolidate his power in the galaxy. Considered a main priority threat to the United Earth Federation.

- Orion Cartel. An underground syndicate ruled by five families. They operate in the Constantine System. They are rapidly militarizing, and controlling the black market in the galaxy. Considered a secondary priority threat to the United Earth Federation.

- Syn Corporation. A security and research company. They provide valuable technology to Constantines Empire, in return for autonomy to work in their systems. Considered a tertiary priority threat to the United Earth Federation.

games.name: Ithya: Magic Studies
games.shortDescription: Ithya: Magic Study is a cozy background app combined with productivity tools. Customize your room and relax with lofi or fantasy playlists in beautiful, hand-drawn environments. Perfect for a focused or creative session in a magical world.
games.aboutText:
Immerse Yourself in a Fantasy World

Unlock beautifully crafted scenes, from serene forests to mystical ancient cities, each providing a calming background for study and creative pursuits. Discover a world created by artist ‘Blue Turtle’ featuring unique, hand-drawn illustrations.

Set the Perfect Ambience

Set the tone for each session by adjusting the environment to match your mood. Choose between day, night, or rainy settings, and enjoy ambient sounds alongside relaxing music.

Personalize Your Room

Make the space your own with customization options. Decorate your room and collect Elementals to add personality to your virtual study space.

Use Productivity Tools

Stay organized and inspired with built-in productivity features, like a task lists and a pomodoro timer, perfect for focused study sessions, creative writing, art, or even planning D&D campaigns. Ithya: Magic Study provides a distraction free space to enjoy your work, art and hobbies.

An amazing Soundtrack

Listen to carefully curated music composed by incredibly talented indie composers. Embark on an epic journey or relaxing moment, feel inspired and creative with no distraction from ads.

All the Music & Art are 100% human made and without AI.

Key features

- A Customizable room

- 10 Playlists, from cozy Lofi to epic fantasy soundtrack

- 10 Elementals to find

- Beautiful, hand-drawn animated environments and characters

- Focused session with productivity tools (timer, pomodoro, to do list, journal)

- Night, day, rain and sunset settings

- A fantasy world, with a map, lore and multiple locations to unlock

games.name: Blade of Dawn
games.shortDescription: This is a third-person hack-and-slash roguelike game. You will play as a Knight of Light defending against the invasion of the Shadow Empire. Using the power of holy light, you can convert shadow-infected enemies into allies. Try to survive until dawn!
games.aboutText:
This is a third-person hack-and-slash roguelike game. You will play as a Knight of Light defending against the invasion of the Shadow Empire. Using the power of holy light, you can convert shadow-infected enemies into allies. Try to survive until dawn!

Disclaimer

"Blade of Dawn" is a demo we developed in 14 days as part of a game development event. We hope to showcase it on Steam to gather more feedback, which will be very useful for our future game development. We welcome everyone to try it out!

Hack and Survive

Enemies keep coming in the darkness. Slash them freely with multiple skills that let you dominate among crowds.

Choose Your Upgrade Path

After defeating a certain number of enemies, you'll get a chance to upgrade. You can enhance your attributes or gain new traits.

Convert Your Enemies

Use your ultimate skill (T) to potentially convert enemies into allies. Use this to survive in the sea of enemies!

Controls Instructions

Use WSAD to move, Left-click to attack, QERT to use skills.

games.name: Feng Shui Meowjong
games.shortDescription: Looks matter? Fun doesn’t?When cat memes collide with roguelike mahjong, a brand-new Meowjong is born! Feng Shui Meowjong is a fresh, lightweight roguelike puzzle game that blends classic mahjong strategy with quirky cat memes and feng shui elements.
games.aboutText:
Feng Shui Meowjong is a unique light roguelike card game that fuses traditional mahjong mechanics with roguelike progression and mystical Feng Shui-inspired tactics.

In this strategic turn-based system, you reinterpret classic mahjong gameplay using a fixed set of 14 tiles to form combinations such as Chi (Chow), Pong (Pung), and Pair. At the same time, you activate powerful Feng Shui treasure effects, manage skill cards, and take on increasingly challenging enemies. Every run tests your planning, adaptability, and strategic thinking.

Easy to Learn, Deep to Master

- No mahjong experience required. Simple to pick up yet deeply strategic.

- A seamless blend of Eastern tradition and modern roguelike design.

- Difficulty and complexity scale as you progress, constantly evolving your strategy.

- Unlock new treasures, cards, and effects by defeating enemies.

- Boost score times fan through treasure synergies to unleash massive score explosions.

- Collect and use skill cards to manipulate tiles, increase scores, or modify treasure effects.

- Treasures interact to create powerful synergies, enabling varied deck-building paths and playstyles.

- High replayability. Every run offers new combinations, new builds, and new challenges.

- Drag and arrange tiles to form Chi (Sequences), Pongs, and Pairs.

- Every adventure is different. Randomized tiles, enemies, treasures, and card choices keep each run fresh.

- Break traditional limitations and experience the joy of playing all 14 East tiles at once.

- Place mystical treasures across the eight directional slots while minding Feng Shui Dos and Don'ts.

- Internet-famous cat memes meet pixel art aesthetics. “Wait, that cat has this ability.”

- Feng Shui treasures link together to create powerful synergies and signature playstyles.

games.name: Cubic Cosmos
games.shortDescription: Cubic Cosmos is a thrilling fast-paced roguelike card game. You have been trapped in a deadly game. One wrong move could see you reduced to a plaything of the goddess. Can you free yourself from the endless cycle and escape your fate?
games.aboutText:
Cubic Cosmos combines roguelike deck building with fast-paced tower defense gameplay. Build an unstoppable army of pawns, chain together massive combos, and enjoy endless possibilities!

Mix and Match Countless Exciting Strategies

- Create an army of unstoppable pawns and build up their attributes to beat down the strongest of bosses!

- Chain together abilities to unleash awesome combos, take endless turns, and deal massive damage... anything is possible!

- Team up pawns to unlock incredible synergies and clear whole battlefields in a single shot!

Build an Unbeatable Deck

- Combine cards and Relics to build an unstoppable deck.

- Clear runs to unlock 12 different heroes across 3 classes with unique abilities.

- With 240+ cards, create lethal combinations that are unique to you!

- Explore unique effect combos with 50+ equippable Relics.

- Tons of random events make each run a new adventure.

Rise to the Challenge in Multiple Game Modes

- Endless Adventures: With fixed and random boss fights and daily challenges, you'll find new thrills in every run!

- Scaling Difficulty: Prove yourself in 10+ difficulty levels and emerge stronger than ever.

- Mastery Mode: Are you a true master of the cosmos? Put your perfectly crafted deck to the test in this high-pressure game mode.

Share Pawns and Matches With One Click

- Doll Code System:

- 11 different Doll types grant incredible buffs!

- Share your beloved pawns with the world and let them marvel at your strength!

- Match Share: Generate a Battle Code to share your best moments!

games.name: Coconut Simulator
games.shortDescription: Coconut Simulator is a game in which you can become a coconut.
games.aboutText:
Coconut Simulator is a game in which you can become a coconut.

This game will give you a meditative gameplay. You can stand and contemplate the beauty of the beach around you living your life as a coconut. You can also perform actions that coconuts usually perform (stand in the same place).

Features

- You're a coconut

- You're on the beach

- There are other coconuts around you

- And not only coconuts

Other Features

- 2 game mods: arcade and realistic

- Simple control

- Realistic graphics

games.name: Tiny Isle
games.shortDescription: Tiny Isle is a cozy island-building simulation game. Grow crops, collect crystals, expand and customize your magical island, and welcome sprites and animal residents. Play actively with hands-on planning, or relax with full idle progression as your island comes to life at your own pace.
games.aboutText:
🌿 Tiny Isle is a cozy island-building simulation where you care for a magical, secluded island. Discover a mysterious sprite civilization and help them rebuild their home.

🌱 Grow adorable magical crops, collect sparkling crystals 💎, catch fantastical fish 🎣, and welcome charming animal villagers and sprites. Use crystals to expand your island, unlock cute plants like magical mushrooms 🍄 and flowers, and freely decorate the island as it slowly comes back to life.

⏳ Play actively with hands-on systems, or relax with full idle progression. Enjoy a calm, shared moment.

✨ If you’re looking for a soothing game with depth, charm, and a gentle pace, Tiny Isle might become your little haven.

🎮Easy-to-learn gameplay with no complex stats or overwhelming management systems.

🏝️Full terrain and decoration customization to create your unique island.

💎Cultivate crops across your island to harvest Crystals, then spend them to unlock new plant varieties and gradually expand your territory!

🌱Every crop has its own superpower! Some produce, some deliver, others boost your yields—mix them right to skyrocket your Crystal output!

🌳In addition to the island's indigenous inhabitants, new residents can also be recruited through tree hollows to temporarily settle on the island.

🧚‍♀️Each resident possesses unique appearances and personalities, and they will assist with the island's production in their own distinctive ways.

🏘️Become besties with the locals, and they’ll put down permanent roots on your island!

🎣Cast your line around the island for a relaxing fishing trip!

🐟Reel in all kinds of fish, then—once you've honed your skills—aim to break size records and even challenge legendary Fish Kings!

☀️Your island shifts moods with time and weather—sunny vistas, stormy drama, even magical sky surprises!

🌟 Thank you for your interest and support for Tiny Isle !

If you run into any issues while playing—or if you have fun ideas and creative thoughts to share—you're warmly welcome to join our official Discord . Let’s make this little island even more wonderful, together!

games.name: GIRLS MADE PUDDING
games.shortDescription: "When there's nobody there to see you, you disappear." In Girls Made Pudding, two girls tour a series of towns that people have disappeared from.
games.aboutText:
"When there's nobody there to see you, you disappear."

In Girls Made Pudding, two girls tour a series of towns that people have disappeared from. Follow them on the road as they find out the mysteries of this world.

The Gameplay

Come for a Ride

In most games, you're always trying to reach a destination. In Girls Made Pudding, everything happens during the journey.

Nothing will happen if you stay where you are, and the more you travel, the more dialogue you'll get.

Keep the bike moving and the girls chatting and eventually you'll unfold this story's mysteries.

Gathering and Cooking

While you're traveling, you'll find ingredients that you can cook with.

Eating those dishes will lead to new dialogue branches for the two girls.

Try cooking whatever fits the mood of the story in that moment.

Hunger and Sleeping

As they travel, the girls slowly get hungrier. Make sure to keep them fed. However, you can turn off the hunger mechanic in the difficulty settings.

Also, after a while, night will fall, ending your journey for they day. You'll need to find an empty home to sleep until morning.

The Story

"When there's nobody there to see you, you disappear."

It's weird, but it's been like this for a while now. Almost half a year.

The journey started with Sumibi's wish—"I want to eat that pudding again."

She and Nikomi go on a bike trip, traveling from town to town while looking for ingredients and meeting new people. Little by little, they start understanding what happened to the world.

They keep traveling and they keep looking at each other... lest they disappear.

The Characters

Sumibi

A bike-riding girl on a journey. She was a regular at the café where Sumibi use to work.

Nikomi

A girl traveling along with Sumibi. She used to work at a café but she's not very good at baking and cooking.

The Staff

Production: KAMITSUBAKI STUDIO

Scenario and development: Kazuhide Oka

Character design and concept art: Zumochi

Art and character models: Zumochi

Soundtrack: Daijiro Nakagawa

Logo art: JEFF99

English Translation: Marco Godano

Simplified/Traditional Chinese Translation: flankoi

games.name: Hidden Winter Things
games.shortDescription: Enter a winter fairy tale with cat people, elves and cute atmosphere. Explore a cozy forest and Santa's workshop, uncovering over 300 hidden objects, from winter sweets to magical surprises. Relax with hand-painted scenes and soothing melodies in this enchanting seasonal adventure.
games.aboutText:
Enter our winter fairy tale, the world of cat people to find hidden elves having fun, winter sweets and other and other attrbutes of winter in enchanting snowy landscapes. Explore a cozy winter forest on the edge of town and a house with Santa's workshop.

Hidden Winter Things includes:

- Hidden Elves Quest : Find mischievous elves and delightful winter surprises hidden in every corner.

- 2 Hand-painted Winter Scenarios : Experience two enchanting locations with a beautiful glow.

- Over 300 hidden items : Find elves, snowflakes, toys, candy, Santa envelopes and more. Can you find them all?

- Relaxing winter tunes : Perfect for immersing yourself in the winter atmosphere.

- Looped location: You can rotate the scene endlessly in a circle as you like.

Would be very happy to be added to your wish list. This is our first game and for our small team it is very important. Thank you <3

games.name: your wife
games.shortDescription: Your Wife is an anime desktop companion game. Choose a character whose gaze follows your cursor, adjust her position and size, and pair her with static or animated wallpapers. Subscribe to and share characters and wallpapers through Steam Workshop.
games.aboutText:
A familiar desktop, a welcome companion

Your Wife is an anime companion game for your Windows desktop. Find a spot for your favorite character, choose a background you love, and let her keep you company as you work, study or unwind. Move your mouse now and then, and catch her eye.

Choose who keeps you company today

Choose your favorite look from 8 built-in characters, or use characters you have subscribed to in the Workshop. Natural blinking, gentle breathing, and animated hair and clothing bring your desktop companion to life. Her gaze follows your mouse, too.

One character is displayed at a time. Switch whenever you like from the menu, and save a corner of your desktop for today's companion.

Her position and size are up to you

Drag your character to a comfortable spot, then use the mouse wheel to adjust her size from 55% to 450%. Keep her at the edge of your screen, or enlarge her to enjoy the details.

Mouse clicks pass through the character's transparent areas. To keep using the windows behind her, enable lock mode and let clicks pass through the entire character. Unlock her from the system tray when you want to interact again. You can also hide the character separately while keeping your wallpaper active.

Make your background part of the scenery

The built-in original Moonlit Violet Rose Terrace wallpaper combines moonlight, roses and violet hues to complement the character's silver hair and black-and-white dress. Choose the static version for a peaceful scene, or switch to the animated version to watch petals fall and twirl, fireflies drift, and moonlight gently shift.

You can also use local GIF or MP4 files as animated wallpapers, or choose static and animated backgrounds from the Workshop to create your own character and desktop combinations. MP4 wallpapers loop without sound.

Discover more combinations in the Workshop

Browse and subscribe to characters and wallpapers shared by other players, then manage and use your subscriptions in the game. You can also upload compatible character assets, static images or animated wallpapers to share your creations with others, and update or delete your own uploads.

Make it fit your routine

- Your character choice, position and size are saved automatically, so your setup is ready the next time you launch the game.

- Choose whether the character stays on top, the taskbar icon is shown, and the game starts with Windows.

- Choose from 30 interface languages and switch at any time in settings.

- Includes 100 Steam achievements, which you can start unlocking one by one from the menu.

A few things to know

This desktop companion is designed for the Windows desktop. To keep your character visible while playing other games, windowed or borderless fullscreen mode is recommended; exclusive fullscreen may cover her. Animated wallpaper playback compatibility depends on the file's encoding, your system's decoding support and your desktop environment.

games.name: OFF
games.shortDescription: “I’m the Batter. I’ve been entrusted with a sacred mission.” -- One of the most influential RPGs of the last 20 years is finally coming to Steam. Take control of the Batter as he seeks to purify an uncanny and hopeless world haunted by specters, guided by a cryptic, grinning cat called The Judge.
games.aboutText:
Allow me to confess that I find you quite tangible for a phantasmagorical being.

I must say, this is really quite strange. You are the first living being I have ever met in this place. Nevertheless, I will introduce myself. I am the Judge.

The Batter has a sacred mission to fulfill.

He seeks to purify the world. You, then, the controller, the soul that he harbors, must aid him in this laudable task. Alongside my sportive companion you will find it necessary to solve puzzles, rain blows upon certain hostile individuals of our wild zones, and oversee the headways and logistics of a network of swan boats and interurban locomotives.

I, too, travel widely among the zones of this world.

Open your wings and fly toward the zones ahead without hesitation! All of them are filled with strange and enchanting beings as well as every modern convenience. All of them appear, it must be said, to require the beneficient application of our friend the Batter’s muscular wrist. Do not worry, my dear phantasm—I, the Judge, will be with you (in spirit and body) at all the most crucial moments of your quest.

I'm going to cut that insufferable smile right out of your face

How dare you talk to me? Why have you decided to be such a pain in my ass? The Queen chose me to protect Zone 1, and I've dedicated my whole life to it.

Listen. Get out of here, and take those ghosts with you, or I am going to kill you. I hope that's clear enough.

games.name: WendyQuest: Legend of the Four Corner Stones
games.shortDescription: Welcome to WendyQuest - a well-done 2D adventure RPG from Wendy’s packed with crispy combat, handcrafted pixel art, and fresh, never frozen puzzles. Play as redheaded warrior Wendy & battle evil mech-monsters to save a culinary kingdom in peril.
games.aboutText:
Wendy's rewards are only available in the U.S.

WendyQuest is 100% fresh and 100% human made!

When mechanized monsters invade a culinary kingdom, it’s up to Wendy to save Savoria from mech-trouble. Welcome to WendyQuest, an epic original adventure where you earn real food as you play.

Play as Wendy and battle Mech Corp’s mechs, solve puzzles, and embark on an epic quest to unite four magical stones to save Savoria. Will you restore order to a realm in peril? The fate of flavor is in your hands.

Dr. Mechborg and his mechs have spread a curse called “Mechtosis” across Savoria using soggy fries, frozen beef & other culinary atrocities. Only Wendy - armed with sacred spatulas, fresh beef, and an ancient prophecy - can restore order to Savoria’s people and end the mechademic once and for all.

Square off against flavorless foes like Golden Archers, Hot Sludge Sundaes and other fast food fiends in strategic turn-based battles. Time your attacks perfectly to deal supersized damage.

Team up with tasty pals including a French Fry Archer, Spicy Chickeneer, Frosty Mage, and more. Each ally brings their own flavor to the table that deals extra damage against specific enemy types.

Journey across five food-themed regions including salty forests, seasoned deserts, rugged beefy bluffs, and Frosty-capped peaks - each filled with hidden secrets waiting to be discovered.

games.name: 100 New Year Cats
games.shortDescription: 🐾 Join the cutest adventure in the 🍾 New Year 🌲, full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of New Year🥂 themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🕵️‍♂️❌ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈✅
games.aboutText:
🍾🥂🐾 WELCOME TO 100 NEW YEAR CATS – THE BEST HIDDEN OBJECTS GAME! 🌲🎆🥳

Join the cutest adventure in the New Year, full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of New Year themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.
Test your attention and observation skills in this cozy and delightful hidden object game.
Each cat is more charming than the last, and every discovery brings a smile to your face. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

⚙️ Key Features ⚙️

- 🌈 Colored Mode

- 🏴 Black & White Mode

- 🎮 1 Level

- 🐈 100 Hidden Cats

- 🎮 1 Extra Level

- 🐈 100 Extra Hidden Cats

- 🎵 Awesome Soundtrack

- 🎨 High Quality Resolution Artworks

- 🌗 Brightness Settings

- 💾 Progress Saves

- 🔍 Zoom

- 😺 Real Meow Sounds!

- 💥 Combo Counter!

- 💡 Hints

- 🌐 No Text

🏆 START YOUR AMAZING JOURNEY IN THE WORLD OF CATS RIGHT NOW 🏆

Don't miss out on the cutest and exciting puzzle game ever! Start your amazing adventure today! ✅😻 Follow our Dev Page! 😻✅

games.name: PIGFACE
games.shortDescription: You wake up with an explosive headache in a pool of your own blood. You're Exit, a terrible woman whose awful past has finally caught up to her. Fulfill contracts for the people who drilled into your skull — guns-blazing, slow and tactical — it doesn’t matter. They know you’ll do whatever it takes.
games.aboutText:
“Hello, Exit …”

You’re a terrible person who has done awful things, and now your past has finally caught up to you. As you wake up in an abandoned warehouse covered in your own blood, you hear a phone ring from across the room.

They’ve drilled a bomb into your head, and now they have a job for you.

PIGFACE is a kinetic, fast-paced, ultra-violent first-person shooter where you fulfill contracts for those holding you hostage. Use shotguns, rifles, pistols, hammers, landmines, grenades … it doesn’t matter.

Just Get The Job Done.

IT’S BLACKMAIL…

They know what you’ve done and now they have a job for you. Complete combat sandbox style missions to earn money, expand your loadout, and get closer to whoever’s pulling the strings.

ARMED TO THE TEETH

Purchase anything from hammers to grenade launchers to kevlar vests from the Black Market.

WEAR DIFFERENT FACES

Find and unlock a variety of masks that enhance your ability to kill.

games.name: Dino Quake
