games.shortDescription: Join Mina and Kiwi to stop an alien invasion from outer space! Dino Quake is a platformer arcade game where you hit the ground to create quakes, stun enemies, then kick them to trigger epic avalanches. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op!
games.aboutText:
Dino Quake is a platformer arcade game where you hit the ground to create quakes, stun enemies, then kick them to trigger epic avalanches. The more enemies you catch, the bigger your avalanche becomes. Explore a prehistoric world with multiple stages, with different paths and replayable runs. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op.

- Pure arcade gameplay

- Unlockable characters

- Multiple paths

- 16-bit aesthetics

- Charming music tracks

games.name: Fill Up The Hole
games.shortDescription: Turn trash into cash in a dystopian world! Fill Up The Hole is a short incremental game where you build a city, automate garbage production, and toss it into a magical hole for profit.
games.aboutText:
Fill Up The Hole is a short incremental game where you help peons create as much garbage as possible and toss it into a hole. Watch your village grow and evolve as you unlock visual upgrades and new features.

Throw Garbage

Your peons automatically gather garbage and throw it into the hole. The more they throw, the more progress you make!

Create a Village

Expand your village, put your peons to work, and maximize the amount of garbage produced and thrown.

Upgrade

Unlock upgrades and abilities to enhance your buildings and peons.

Gameplay

- Produce trash in different ways

- Find the best way to put it in the hole

- Acquire different resources and upgrades

Multiple Strategies

- Expand your base by taking the time to remove rocks

- Create and upgrade different buildings

- The order of the buildings can make a difference

- Enhance the abilities of your peons

- Gain new research, talents, and skills

Features

- 10+ unique buildings

- Skill tree of upgrades to explore

- Experiment with different strategies

- Short experience (around 2h30m playthrough)

- Two endings

- Extended and relax mode (for players who prefer a longer or more idle experience)

.

games.name: Rendagor
games.shortDescription: Rendagor is a 2D Top-down Shooter starring a service bot. Just a simple machine... or something more? Uncover dark secrets in Story Mode or master the challenge of Arcade Mode. Shoot, smash, and demolish enemies and destructible environments with a devastating arsenal.
games.aboutText:
​Rendagor is a 2D Top-down Shooter starring a Rendagor Corporation service robot. Just another robot... or maybe not?

Discover Rendagor Corp.'s secrets in Story Mode or try your hand at the Arcade Mode.

Either way, shoot, smash, and blast enemies (and the game environment) with a large set of weaponry.

Story Mode:

The 'free-will.deb' virus has corrupted Rendagor Corp's core, twisting the AI-CEO into a sentient, merciless tyrant. Infiltrate the headquarters, neutralize the madness, and save humanity from the cold grip of a machine god gone rogue.

- Fight against the failed experiments of Rendagor Corp.

- From bone-crushing Rocket Fists to high-tech lasers: wield a devastating arsenal to tear through Rendagor Corp's defenses.

- Scour every corner and crack environmental puzzles to uncover hidden caches.

- Order on the fly with R-Coins. Watch the skies—your R-Shipping courier is already en route.

- Upgrade your chassis and overclock your power with rare R-Chips.

- Test your arsenal against massive, unique bosses at the end of every zone.

Arcade Mode:

Unleash chaos with rocket fists and lasers! Battle through unpredictable waves of Rendagor Corp's minions, solving puzzles for loot and spending R-Coins on drone-delivered supplies. Draft powerful upgrades, customize your robot, and annihilate the ultimate boss to reclaim your freedom.

Test your reflexes against dynamic waves of enemies.

Reap the spoils of war: collect R-Chips and select powerful perks to prepare for the next onslaught.

No story, just action. Survive the waves and scrap the Final Boss.

games.name: Lethal Dungeon
games.shortDescription: Lethal Dungeon is a roguelike card game. Win every battle using only the cards in your opening hand to defeat all enemies in a single turn.
games.aboutText:
Lethal Dungeon is a roguelike card game. Win every battle using only the cards in your opening hand to defeat all enemies in a single turn.

Using as few cards as possible will earn you more rewards, and if you get stuck on an enemy, you can use money to shuffle and draw.

Upgrade your deck using the money you earn! Defeat stronger enemies to earn more money! Repeat this process until you clear the dungeon!

games.name: Progress Racer RPG
games.shortDescription: An incremental game with meta-unveiling secrets and a bangin' soundtrack. Race along an obstacle-ridden track to gain resources, then spend them to level up and purchase upgrades. Drive to reunite with your true love- if the entire world doesn't fall apart before then...
games.aboutText:
The Distance You Travel Is Your Currency

Rack up Kilometers as you automatically drive forward, then spend them to upgrade your vehicle. The further you drive, the faster you drive, which lets you drive further, faster.

Choose Your Preferred Build

Maneuver your way around obstacles with Handling or brute force your way through them with Armor. Select upgrades that let you combo Boosts or opt to automate them entirely. Whether you prefer an active playstyle or want to sit back and idle, there exists a build you can enjoy.

Reinforce Upgrades Exponentially

Scroll through an extensive array of upgrades, then decide which ones to strengthen, improving their power, duration, effectiveness, and more. Uncovering additional secrets will let you promote upgrades even further beyond.

Save The Girl...?

Race back to your childhood friend- a trusting girl who's been hurt one too many times. You can't seem to remember how you got separated, but her overprotective friend won't hesitate to remind you of all the times you screwed up.

games.name: Cat Gladiator
games.shortDescription: Cat Gladiator is a hardcore 2D slow-paced Monster Hunter-like action game! 4-player co-op, a wide variety of weapons, equipment, and items to aid in arena Boss battles. Become an adorable gladiator cat, team up with friends, conquer tough Bosses, and savor victory!
games.aboutText:
Welcome to join our Discord.

Gameplay:
This is a 2D Monster Hunter-like co-op action game that supports solo play or online co-op for up to 4 players.
Observe boss attack patterns, leverage your weapon's unique traits, and use items wisely to defeat powerful bosses. After a victory, use boss materials to forge new equipment, take on even stronger bosses, and climb your way to become the top gladiator cat in the arena!

20260922 Update: Introducing a brand-new weapon — Heavy Staff!

The balanced Sword & Shield; the elegant Longsword; the sustained-damage Cannon; the devastating charged Greatsword; the cyclone-spinning Dual Blades; and the note-playing Harp.

Each weapon has its own rhythm and unique moves, offering a completely different combat experience when facing enemies.

Arena foes demand respect! Observe their attack patterns, exploit your weapon's unique traits, and strategically counter. Equipment bonuses and tactical item usage are key to victory.

Struggling alone? Team up with up to 3 friends for 4-player online co-op! Enjoy the thrill of dominating your foes together.

Need a break from the challenges? Try your hand at fishing! Different fish grant different stat bonuses—don't forget to grab a bite before battle!

Traps, BoomBuckets, healing potions, basketball bombs, secret recipe grilled fish... Using items wisely can greatly reduce the difficulty of battle!

Forge armor from boss materials to boost stats (attack/defense/crit) or enhance item efficiency (CD/casting speed). Experiment with synergistic builds!

About Us
Cat Gladiators is developed by a small three-person team. We love Monster Hunter, so we wanted to create a "2D co-op hunting game." We simplified the weapon mechanics to make it "easy to learn but hard to master," while also enhancing the role of items—so more players can easily jump into the co-op action!

games.name: Rat Game
games.shortDescription: Asymmetrical horror comedy co-op for up to 8 players. Play either a pack of Rats trying to sabotage a restaurant, or the Chef determined to stop them.
games.aboutText:
OVERVIEW 📙

- Asymmetrical online co-op with 1 Chef vs 2 to 7 Rats

- Play against a human or robot-controlled Chef

- Interconnected map filled with tasks & secrets

- Around 3 hours of playtime

OH, RATS!!!!!!!!!🐀

Chef has been trying to exterminate the rats, leaving them no choice but to ruin his restaurant. Crawl through hidden shortcuts and hide in dark corners in a vast human-scale map. Work in teams of 2-8 to nibble through wires, clog the toilet, hack the PC – anything to get this place shut down for good!

YOU’RE COOKED!!!!!!👨‍🍳

Rats are destroying your treasured family restaurant. Stomp around listening for the tell-tale sound of scrabbling claws, waiting for the right moment to grab them and throw them in the cage. If all else fails, you also have a gun. Time for some pest control!

DEFEAT THE ROBO-CHEF!!!! 🤖

Co-op only mode sets you and your rat friends against the mighty mechanical Robo-Chef. He’s programmed to cook, clean… and to kill!

Rat Game is an asymmetrical comedy horror with a dynamic soundtrack, an interconnected map, squeaky proximity chat, and plenty of cheese. Last one standing wins.

games.name: InKing
games.shortDescription: is a fast-paced 2D top-down action game. Players take on the role of an ink bottle warrior on a journey to become the king of tools. Use your fast attacks, moves, and powerful skills to defeat the tools that stand in your way, prove that ink and pen are the best tools, and become the King of Tools.
games.aboutText:
InKing is an fast-paced ink action rogue-lite . Scatter and absorb the ink to win the crown.

The Journey of the Ink Warrior

As an Ink Warrior , embark on a journey to become the king of tools. Use your fast attacks, moves, and powerful skills to defeat the tools that stand in your way and prove that ink and pen are the best tools!

Absorb Ink!

Utilize the ink splashes to unleash powerful skills. Ink splatters in different ways, so make sure to time your ink splatters correctly for a smooth battle.

Don't let your guard down!

Don't stop until the waves of enemies stop coming. Because there will be a break.

Power Up Yourself!

Improve yourself as you take down your enemies. From simple stats to a variety of attributes, customize your skills the way you want them to work for you and take on stronger enemies.

Face Diverse Bosses!

To claim the crown, the Ink Warrior must overcome monumental challenges. Defeat bosses by overcoming their unique attack patterns!

games.name: Tinker Shot
games.shortDescription: A turn-based skill-crafting dungeon crawler roguelike, where you combine crazy effects and upgrades for your skills and use them on enemies. With a strategic physics-based gameplay, unlock and grow your arsenal of spells and items to overcome the challenging dungeon of Underground Ruins!
games.aboutText:
Tinker Shot is a turn-based skill-crafting roguelike where every fight becomes a little experiment in chaos. Explore a mysterious world filled with strange creatures and clever encounters, and take them down using skills you build entirely from scratch.

Build Wildly Broken Skills

Craft new abilities by mixing parts, effects, and upgrades to create wild combos, from surprisingly effective to delightfully broken. Each run pushes you to invent new strategies, adapt to unusual situations, and discover unexpected synergies hidden in your arsenal.

Every Run Feels Fresh

Physics-driven encounters, unpredictable scenarios, and a constantly evolving toolkit make every run feel fresh, playful, and full of discovery. No two battles play out the same, and no two skills you craft will ever be alike.

Dive Into the Underground Ruins

Build, fire, experiment… and dive deeper into the Underground Ruins. Fresh challenges await in every corner, with unpredictable encounters and hidden surprises designed to keep each run feeling new. The deeper you go, the stranger the enemies and relics you find become, ensuring there’s always something unexpected waiting beneath the surface.

Don't forget to wishlist Tinker Shot to be notified when the game is released!

games.name: Dead Take
games.shortDescription: Find your missing friend. Uncover the secrets within. Brave a luxurious and haunting mansion in Dead Take, a first-person psychological horror crafted by Surgent Studios.
games.aboutText:
EXT. MANSION - NIGHT "FIND VINNY"

Night falls and he still won't pick up the phone. You arrive at the mansion: the last place he went. It's oddly quiet for the site of a glamorous party the night before. Your invite must have gotten lost in the mail. In any case, you make your way inside to find your friend.

Actors have to look out for each other in this industry.

Feed me something real

INT. MANSION - NIGHT "PLAY YOUR PART"

An abandoned film set. A broken home cinema. Searching the mansion and unlocking its secrets requires the fullness of your ingenuity. Pay attention.

INT. HOME CINEMA - NIGHT "A SPLICE OF LIFE"

Your search reveals a number of USB drives and memory cards containing corrupted video files. Some can be spliced together to reveal what really happened within these walls. Try not to lose yourself in your work.

INT. HEART OF HOLLYWOOD - NIGHT "TAKE YOUR SHOT"

The house is watching. It seems to haunt your steps. Piece together what really happened last night as you discover a side of the entertainment industry only discussed in whispers.

The cruelty. The sordid gossip. The auditions gone wrong. The shadowy figure with the power to make or break your career.

There's only one way to guarantee your success: feed me something real.

games.name: Bakso Simulator 2
games.shortDescription: Build, manage, and scale your very own Bakso restaurant in this first-person simulator. Design your layout, hire and train various staffs, upgrade your gear, expand your place and satisfy every customer to become the best Bakso empire in the world!
games.aboutText:
After the massive success of the first journey, it is time to return and become the ultimate Bakso Tycoon. In Bakso Simulator 2, you are not just selling meatballs, you are building a culinary empire from scratch in a bustling city full of secrets and excitement.

Experience the thrill of prepping ingredients, cooking, and serving bakso to your customers. Over 8 unique recipes to discover and create!

Hire staff to help grow your business! Each employee has their own unique background story. Train them to be the fastest and most efficient crew in town.

Chase away restaurant troublemakers! From thieves and dine-and-dashers to annoying brats and even mythical Tuyul ghosts. Use your tools to kick them out!

Explore a vast new town filled with quirky NPCs, hidden secrets, and plenty of fun activities.

Fully customize everything to your liking! From floors, ceilings, and roofs to decorations, bakso carts, and even your own staff's outfits.

- Follow a deep, funny, and even supernatural main story and side quests?! Help the locals and solve mysteries to earn special rewards.

- Play various fun mini-games around the city to take a break from the kitchen.

- Immerse yourself in an authentic Indonesian atmosphere that feels truly alive.

Start your delicious journey and watch your business flourish in the most exciting restaurant simulator game yet!

games.name: Exoplanet Outpost
games.shortDescription: Establish a base on a distant planet. In this immersive sci-fi colony building sim, you'll balance economic growth, tourism, and defense against hostile alien forces. Your decisions shape the fate of your settlement and its inhabitants. Are you ready to thrive on the frontier of space?
games.aboutText:
In Exoplanet Outpost, you will establish and manage a thriving colony on a distant exoplanet, balancing economic growth, tourism, and defense against relentless alien threats. Begin with a team of intrepid pioneers and transform your base into a bustling hub of commerce and culture.

- Resource Management : Mine resources, research technologies, and build infrastructure to support your colony's growth.

- Tourist Attractions : Create stunning attractions to draw interstellar tourists, from casinos to mystical temples.

- Alien Combat : Defend your outpost from diverse alien species with advanced technology and strategic defenses.

- Dynamic Economy : Engage in interstellar trade and manage a complex economy, balancing production, consumption, and resource allocation.

- Advanced Technologies : Research and develop cutting-edge technologies to enhance your colony's capabilities and defenses.

- Campaign Missions : Embark on focussed scenario missions that challenge your strategic thinking and decision-making skills.

- Environmental Challenges : Adapt to harsh planetary conditions, unexpected events, and alien ecosystems that test your colony's resilience.

Experience the ultimate blend of economic strategy, tourism management, and thrilling combat in Exoplanet Outpost.

STORY

In the not-so-distant future, humanity's quest for survival and expansion has reached the stars. Faced with dwindling resources on Earth and the discovery of habitable exoplanets, the Galactic Federation has launched a series of ambitious colonization missions. Among these is "Exoplanet Outpost", a critical initiative aimed at establishing a sustainable human presence on a distant, resource-rich world.

As the commander of this outpost, you are tasked with transforming a wild alien landscape into a thriving hub of economic activity, interstellar tourism, and robust defenses against unforeseen alien threats.

The planet holds untold riches and ancient mysteries, but it also harbors unknown dangers. Alien species and rebel bandits roam the planet, posing both opportunities and threats to your fledgling colony. You must navigate these challenges and harness its resources to build a prosperous and self-sustaining settlement.

As you expand your outpost, you'll engage in interstellar trade and attract tourists from across the galaxy with unique attractions and experiences. Your success will depend on your ability to balance economic growth, maintain defenses, and foster a harmonious community amid the stars.

The fate of Exoplanet Outpost lies in your hands. Will you rise to the challenge and lead humanity's next great chapter in the cosmos?

games.name: Game Quest: The Backlog Battler
games.shortDescription: This Arcade Hack & Slash answers the age old question: "What if the games you never play could attack you?" Fight back your backlog! The more you paid, the more damage they will do to you! (just like in real life).
games.aboutText:
Armed with your trusty keyboard and mouse, battle the games you never play! The more you paid for them, the more damage they will do to you (just like in real life).

Fight in an arena surrounded by your well-played spectator games, while the immortal royalty (the games you have never played) lord over you at the end of the arena.

Games you played for up to two hours will attack you in waves - but watch out for flying enemies (high Metacritic score), Platform supported enemies, DLC enemies and Controller Supported enemies; amongst many more!

** IMPORTANT ** To get the most out of this game (Play your game list instead of the Default/Friends game lists), you will need to set your "Game details" to public on your Steam profile (Your Profile->Edit Profile->Privacy Settings->Game Details). You can set it back to private after you load the game for the first time.

games.name: The shield of the Kingdom
games.shortDescription: "The Shield of The Kingdom" is a defense strategy game where player needs to protect their realm from enemies. Within the game, player controls 3 heroes and command troops in battle to repel invasions. Effective hero combinations and masterful tactical control are keys to achieving ultimate victory!
games.aboutText:
"The Shield of the Kingdom" is a strategy + light action game, which sets itself apart from traditional tower defense games. In addition to supporting the classic rich pairing of heroes, skills, and troops, "Shield of the Kingdom" also offers extra features such as hero's signature gear and movement in the battlefield . Beyond exploring and devising combat strategies to counter different types of enemy forces and bosses, players can also enjoy a unique gaming experience distinct from tradition through hero role transformations brought by signature gear, battlefield positioning, and the deployment of reinforcements.

In the game, enemies will attack the player with unpredictable formations and strength. Try different hero combinations and their skill synergies to fend off the enemies! Additionally, selecting the necessary allied troops to deploy can compensate for weaknesses in the battle situation, achieving twice the result with half the effort.

Every hero has their own unique signature gear system, and each piece of signature gear can make the hero "feel brand new," offering players additional ideas and solutions for building their lineups! Collecting all the signature gears for certain heroes can even increase their effects where one plus one is greater than two, awaiting players' development and exploration!

Players can maximize damage or effects by controlling one or more heroes. At the same time, by controlling the heroes' positioning, players can avoid damage, focus on key enemy units, or disrupt the enemy's advancing formation.

Join "The Shield of The Kingdom, leading your team to write your own glorious chapter in this epic battle.

QQ Group：743471834

games.name: KuloNiku: Bowl Up!
games.shortDescription: Prep your stations for a cozy cooking game with attitude! Prepare unique meals for quirky small-town locals, upgrade and customize your shop, compete in thrilling cooking battles to become top chef, and protect your family’s long-running restaurant alongside a cast of curious companions!
games.aboutText:
Ready to battle for the title of top eatery? Yes, Chef!

You’ve just inherited your grandma’s once-famous meatball restaurant in the cozy town of KuloNiku. Now it’s up to you to bring it back to glory as the top eatery! Take on eccentric orders from townsfolk, serve delicious meals, and restore your family’s legacy.

Beware—there’s fierce competition from the town’s flashiest rival: Souper Starz, run by the menacing rockstar chef, Stella!

- Chop, boil, fry, torch, pour, sizzle, slice, and skewer , and more with immersive, tactile controls that make every action tickle your brain and make your mouth water. Endless Mode lets you cook to your heart's content!

- Want to add an extra punch of garlic or a sprinkle of salt? Go for it. You’re the chef – find multiple ways to prepare your customers the perfect dish and rack up those juicy tips ! 💰

- But your customers aren’t just customers. Some may become your friends 🤝, rivals ⚔️, or even part of your story 📖.

- Rival chefs want the top spot, and there’s only one way to settle things: Meatball Brawls!

- In these thrilling culinary duels, you’ll go head-to-head to impress a panel of rotating judges. It’s not just about speed - it’s about strategy, creativity, and mastering every step of the cooking process.

- Play mini-games to impress both the judges and the crowd watching live, who will issue on-the-spot requests to boost your score!

- Keep things fresh! Unlock new tools, purchase higher-quality ingredients, and discover brand-new recipes to keep your menu exciting.

- Personalize your restaurant with fun decorations in a variety of styles - even buy full sets! Decor isn’t just cosmetic; some items give gameplay perks to impress your customers.

- Unlock special decorations by playing in special festivals or raising your friendship level with town residents!

- An eclectic cast of characters awaits you in KuloNiku - No matter friend or rival (or both??), they've all got stories to tell!

- Raise your friendship level with a cast of companions to unlock special illustrations and decorations.

- Uncover the mystery of your eye-raising past and save your grandmother's restaurant alongside your friends!

games.name: Dodo Duckie
games.shortDescription: Waddle into a reality-bending odyssey where simply being a duck is your greatest superpower. With the help of your magical cap, switch instantly between 2D and 3D to uncover hidden paths, outsmart aliens, and rescue your kidnapped chicken friends in this wholesome puzzle platformer adventure.
games.aboutText:
Quack the code of reality as the clumsy yet courageous duck Dodo and traverse bizarre yet charming planets to rescue your kidnapped chicken kin and master impossible new abilities with every waddle to solve puzzles.

What begins as a lighthearted rescue mission unfurls into a profound, heartfelt journey of self-discovery, where perhaps even a clumsy duck can find a home.

Key Features

It was a peaceful day on the farm… until a giant alien beam yoinked your chicken family into the sky. With nothing but his waddle, his will, and a very special cap, Dodo dives into a glitched dimension to bring them back.

Two dimensions, one adventure. With Capie the Capybara's magical cap, you can flip between side-scrolling and 3rd Person view whenever you like. Swap perspectives to reveal hidden paths and surprise platforms, and use them to crack every puzzle and peek into every corner of the world.

Dodo does a lot more than waddle. Glide over gaps, splash through water, float, flop, and improvise your way through each puzzle. Every move fits into the way you explore, experiment and solve weird little alien puzzles. And yes, there is a dedicated quack button. Hit Q to QUACK, scare some aliens, and calm your own brain at the same time.

Hop from one odd and adorable planet to the next, each stranger and cuter than the last. Collect shiny stardust, uncover secret routes, and meet Capie, the chill shopkeeper who sells very good caps. Don’t forget to take advantage of every very silly photo opportunity.

Dodo wobbles, trips, and occasionally face-plants, but never gives up on its chicken family. Underneath the clumsy feet is a very determined little heart. Ready to accompany this adorable little duckie? This adventure is full of quacks, caps, and chaos, so grab the hat and jump in. Your next adventure (and your next cute screenshot) is waiting.

games.name: Salvage Protocol
games.shortDescription: A short horror about exploring abandoned space stations and collecting junk in order to pay off your S.R.P.O debt.
games.aboutText:
Salvage Protocol is a single-player horror game about infiltrating abandoned space stations. Break anything in sight, recover valuable components, dodge traps and fight off terrifying monsters hiding in plain sight!

And maybe one day YOU will pay off your debt to the S.R.P.O. mega-corp.

Sneak through vents, climb unstable structures and reactivate ancient machines to open new paths.

Every station is a handcrafted maze where death is lurking just around the corner.

If it looks like you can break it, you probably can.

Wreak havoc and collect scrap to satisfy S.R.P.O’s endless appetite for worthless junk.

Put your hard earned credits to good use, upgrade your gear and buy new tools to make the job easier!

- 5 handcrafted locations 🛰️

- Dangerous monsters and traps😱

- A variety of tools and upgrades ⚙️

- Satisfying prop DESTRUCTION 💥

- The joy of paying off your debt (maybe) 💸

games.name: Wendigo Blue
games.shortDescription: Action-packed 2D beat-em-up with intense boss battles and a large variety of customizable equipment and skills. Up to 4 players with local co-op.
games.aboutText:
As members of the Vanguard, defend your home from invading gods in this action-packed brawler set in the world of Valdis Story.

Customize your character in each playthrough with over 80 unique items and skills. Go head to head with invading gods in intense boss battles alone, with a CPU partner, or up to 4 players in local co-op.

Reina, Goddess of Death, has been shielding Erebus from invading gods for decades, but their numbers have become overwhelming, and foreign gods are slipping through her barrier, aided by traitorous cultists. Each god slain brings you closer to the dark truth behind the invasions.

games.name: おしゃべりキング！コミュ力診断ゲーム
games.shortDescription: A game that tests your ad-lib verbal skills using a microphone. You can test your word power with various subjects, such as handling a bank robbery with just the power of words, or becoming a weathercaster and ad-libbing your way through a weather forecast.
games.aboutText:
■How Good Is Your Communication Skill?

A new kind of game where what you say freely is scored!

■Basic Game Flow

① A prompt is displayed → ② The player answers via microphone or keyboard → ③ The AI scores it out of 100 points

■Four Types of Prompts with Different Ways to Enjoy

There are four types of prompts, each offering a different style of fun.

- Articulation & Brain Training
Tongue twisters, word association games, and other prompts that are easy for anyone to enjoy.

- Serious Thinking
Prompts that test what you say.
For example, explaining modern concepts in a way that Oda Nobunaga would understand, giving gift advice, and other challenges where the content of your answer itself is tested.

- Role-Playing
Prompts that test how you say things.
Examples include ad-libbing a weather forecast as a TV weathercaster, or giving a sports day speech as a school principal—becoming a version of yourself you normally wouldn’t be.

- Conversation Battles
Prompts where you exchange lines with the AI several times to achieve a goal.
Examples include verbal arguments, debates, and job interviews.

■Two Modes with Different Goals

Test Mode : For those who want to seriously measure their communication skills
Stage Clear Mode : For those who want to enjoy a variety of stages while having fun

■Co-op Stage Clear Mode (Offline Multiplayer)

This mode allows 2 to 4 players to play the Stage Clear Mode together.

Players take turns speaking in a relay format to create a single answer.

Enjoy the unique improvisational feel as you try to connect your response to the previous player's statement.

※ Currently does not support online multiplayer (designed for sharing one microphone on a single PC)

※ The topic content is the same as the single-player Stage Clear Mode.

Translated with (free version)

■Test Mode

Test Mode measures your language ability.

You will take on 10 prompts, and your language skills will be graded from Level 1 to Level 5.

You can compare your scores in each skill area with the national average to see your strengths and weaknesses.

You can also see your position in the national rankings—so give it a try!

- Test Mode can only be played once per day.

- Test Mode is only playable via microphone input.

■Stage Clear Mode

Stage Clear Mode lets you enjoy various situations while pushing your communication skills to the limit.

Unlock stages as you go and play about 40 different prompts across four difficulty levels: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, and Superhuman.

■Volume

- Test Mode : About 20–40 minutes per playthrough

- Stage Clear Mode : Playing every prompt once takes about 2 hours

■Notes and Play Restrictions

- This game uses the functionality of the conversational AIs ChatGPT (provided by OpenAI) and Gemini (provided by Google). Depending on the status of ChatGPT’s or Gemini’s servers, gameplay may be delayed.

- If OpenAI’s ChatGPT or Google’s Gemini undergo changes to their features or services, the game service may be suspended or terminated without prior notice.

- This game uses the AmiVoice speech recognition service provided by Advanced Media, Inc. for transcribing microphone input. If AmiVoice’s servers are down, the game may not be playable.

- If AmiVoice undergoes changes to its features or services, the game service may be suspended or terminated without prior notice.

■Streaming Guidelines

We welcome video streaming and gameplay commentary.

Monetization is also allowed, with no restrictions on the scope of streaming.

Both individual and corporate streams are permitted.

When streaming, please include the URL of this game’s Steam store page in the video description.

(If the platform’s rules prevent adding a URL, please mention where the game can be purchased within the video.)

We would greatly appreciate your help in promoting the game so that viewers may take interest—and hopefully purchase it.

However, the following actions are prohibited:

- Videos that violate the laws of any country

- Videos that infringe on the intellectual property rights of this game or others

- Defamatory or slanderous videos

- Videos recorded with illegally obtained game data

These guidelines may be updated or changed without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

■Location of Image Assets for Streaming and Other Uses

Game Title Screen > ‘Documents’ > ‘Streaming Guidelines’ → Link at the very bottom

※This will take you to Google Drive. Please download and use the assets.

※The terms of use for image assets are outlined in the in-game document ‘Streaming Guidelines’.

■Important Notice for Voice Changer Users

Regarding the ‘Play’ button that replays player responses in-game: Depending on your environment, the original unaltered voice may be played.

If you use a voice changer for streaming, we recommend testing the ‘Play’ button once before going live.

■Bug Reports and Inquiries

Bug reports will be addressed and posted sequentially on the [Bulletin Board] found on the store page

games.name: Coal LLC
games.shortDescription: Fill your quota or die. Mine increasingly absurd amounts of coal using some dubious, but effective, mining techniques. Or relax and mine at your own pace in peaceful mode.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Coal LLC, your friendly-everyday-evil-coal-mining-corporation.

With only a shoddy pickaxe to start, you must hire and promote employees, upgrade equipment and dig deep below the earth to fill your coal quota each day. Or else.

Feed the factories.

The underground world magically refreshes each day, so you must race to mine as much of it and as deeply as you can before nightfall. Using some very exciting and hyper-realistic methods for doing so. Your world might deteriorate as you grow, however.

Hire BILLIONS of employees.

You heard that right. Hire and promote employees into specialised roles in your organisation, each type having exciting and game-changing bonuses and equipment. Grow your organisation into hundreds, thousands, millions and even billions of miners willing to go out and bring back coal for the cause.

Don't be afraid of the consequences.

Many different maps, professions and tools means endless ways of growing your operation. Do you have what it takes to grow the greatest coal mining corporation of all time?

games.name: SIMPWALK
games.shortDescription: A very short, 2D side-scroller collect-a-thon game that lets you play as the cute HOLORO mascots!
games.aboutText:
A very short, 2D side-scroller collect-a-thon game that lets you play as the cute HOLORO mascots!

It's the HOLORO's anniversary day!

It's HOLORO's anniversary day! Ollie, Reine, and Anya want to party, but they don't have any money, so they ask Udin, Mr. Akyat, and Toaster-kun for help.

And so, the mascot trio goes on a short walk~

GAMEPLAY - Play through 3 stages!

- UDIN stage — Play as UDIN, Kureiji Ollie's mascot. This blue and purple stitched small bear will navigate around the forest with her versatile jumps!

- MERAKyats stage — MR Akyat is a devoted follower of Pavolia Reine, and this gentle peafowl will follow her wherever the wind sweeps. He can fly, and he will reach the top to help his lady.

- TOASTER-KUN stage — Toaster-kun is Anya Melfissa's prized toaster machine that somewhat alive. He has a unique way of traversing the stage, powered by electricity and making use of the environment around him.

This game is published under CCMC Corp(※1)'s Indie game brand "holo Indie".(※2)

This game is allowed to be monetized under the examination and terms of "holo Indie".

It is a game brand that offers "Game Creator Support Program" for the derivative work games.

games.name: Twinkleby
games.shortDescription: Twinkleby is a cozy decoration game where you map out an archipelago of floating islands and build dioramas for a society of spacefaring Neighbours. Expand your collection, discover antique secrets, decorate, and when you change your mind – evict everyone and throw their furniture into space!
games.aboutText:
Twinkleby is a laid-back decoration game set in a nostalgic, cozy universe with an absurdist twist; you progress through an archipelago of floating islands, build neighbourhood dioramas, and throw whatever items and creatures you don’t want over the island’s edge. Twinkleby is a universe where the mood changes on a whim, where you create elaborate environments by controlling the soundtrack, scenery and lighting, and build dreamscapes that range from eerie and gothic to adorable and romantic.

In Twinkleby, the world is your inventory. Throw anything you don’t want off the side of the island, and it will be returned to your collections. Rebuild, redesign, and unlock the full range of customisation for scenery and items, including colours, backdrops, weathers and seasons. As you customise the scenery you change the soundtrack, and gradually gain full control over the ambience of your dreamscapes.

Your islands and decoration choices will attract a variety of whimsy new residents, who all have traits that affect how they interact with the environment and each other. Some of these neighbours are rare sights in the archipelago, and only the most dedicated player will collect them all. Like everything else in Twinkleby, any neighbour can be evicted at any time – just throw their luggage off the side of the island, and they’ll take the hint.

It might be a good idea to not be too hasty with the evictions though, because every neighbour carries gifts in their bag, and should you make them happy, they will reward you in return.

✦ Progress along Twinkleby’s star chart to unlock new islands to make your own, and gather map fragments to discover hidden islands along the way.

✦ Grow your item collection to decorate your islands, and return items to your inventory by throwing them off the island’s edge.

✦ Furnish your houses to attract and collect new neighbours (common and rare), and should you grow tired of their company – evict them at a moment’s notice!

✦ Make your neighbours happy, and they’ll reward you handsomely with a variety of items, including paintings, keys, and even houses!

✦ Compose the soundtrack of your dioramas using the weathers, seasons and backdrops, and create unique audio-visual dreamscapes for each new island.

✦ Collect the shooting stars known as Stellars and spend them in Molligan’s Antiques on whatever catches your eye! Generate more Stellars by making your neighbours happy, and find new, secret ways to make the stars fall.

✦ You’re not the only one throwing things into space in the Twinkleby archipelago; catch chests that fall past your islands, and loot them to expand your collections.

✦ When you have delved deep into space, you will be able to play on parallel islands – new clean-slate versions of the islands you've found. Keep exploring new, creative ways to decorate with all the stuff you've gathered!

✦Capture your magnificent creations and adorable moments in the photo mode.

games.name: Flan's BN
games.shortDescription: 《Flan's BN》is the prequel to 《Flan's MS》, which combines JRPG and deckbuilder mechanics. Experience Flan's story of self-discovery
games.aboutText:
《Flan's BN》is the prequel to 《Flan's MS》, which combines JRPG and deckbuilder mechanics. Experience Flan's story of self-discovery.

It all happened before the Scarlet Mist Incident.

The girl came in and out of library in her activity time.

She had read countless books over hundreds of years.

Recently , she came up with a question,

"Who am 'I' ?", she asked herself.

With this question, she decided to write a story about herself.

Maybe she will find the answer…

The game has four chapters and playthrough time of more than five hours.

Gameplay consists of two parts: Activity Time and Bedtime Story.

Activity Time:
Every night, you can explore Scarlet Devil Mansion. Try to find new books, friends and special cards. Also, you may have a chance to uncover the hidden truth of this mystery vampire mansion.

Bedtime Story:

Inside the worlds of each book, you can meet different friends, choose your cards freely for battles and experience amazing stories with your friends.

- Unique pixel art

- Build your team and card deck freely

- Free exploration of Scarlet Devil Mansion

- Entertaining adaptations of classic literature works

Special Note:

As with the previous title, this series will offer a free version in the future that differs from the Steam version. A free mobile port of this installment is also under consideration.

About Geism:

A portion of the revenue will be allocated to charitable causes, and both the game's income and development expenses will be made public.

This is an individual project. Please approach it with appropriate discretion.

games.name: Fischer's Fishing Journey
games.shortDescription: Put Fischer on your desktop as your ultimate study and work buddy. He'll fish quietly in the corner, taking care of it all—you just drop in occasionally to collect your rewards, unlock new fish, upgrade your rod, while enjoying that calming, healing atmosphere.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to "Fischer's Fishing Journey"! Set Fischer on your desktop to be your best work and study companion. Whether you run the game as a live wallpaper with Fischer quietly fishing in a cozy corner or pin it up on your screen, he's here to brighten every day. With dynamic backdrops that shift from day to night and weather that changes from sunny to rainy, you'll be immersed in a soothing environment complete with gentle breezes and the soft murmur of flowing water—adding a touch of tranquility to your busy routine.

Take a break from the hustle and join Fischer on a little journey to explore diverse landscapes across the globe. Marvel at unique natural sceneries and enjoy a leisurely, laid-back fishing experience.

Forget complicated controls—Fischer handles all the fishing fuss for you! Just check your bait and fish basket during your downtime and relish the laid-back fun of fishing. Your catches can be sold or kept in your tank to earn Fish Coins, which let you buy more bait, upgrade your rod, expand your tank, and unlock a host of unique fish and fresh fishing spots!

Your fishing haul is shaped by the location, time, weather, and even the bait you choose. From common fish to mysterious, rare species, dozens of unique types are just waiting for you to discover and collect!

Drop your catches into your personal fish tank and sit back to watch them swim gracefully. Not only does it look cool, but your tank also earns you extra rewards. Upgrade and expand your tank to create an even richer underwater world!

On your journey, you'll meet all kinds of new characters and get the chance to chat with them and hear their stories. Help your new pals fulfill their wishes and uncover long-forgotten tales on this planet—discovering the warmth and surprises hidden behind its tranquil vistas.

games.name: Rich Flavors
games.shortDescription: Rich Flavors is a game in which you deliver "goods" to "customers" and get paid in "coupons". Can you collect enough to buy your dream cake before your contract ends?
games.aboutText:
Sui wants to buy cake. Luckily she landed a job at the famous Rich Flavors Co. delivering goods to the inhabitants of the scorching-hot city. If she works hard, she can just barely save enough to buy it.

In this game, you will guide Sui as she works shifts for Rich Flavors Co. Choose the right item the customer needs and deliver it to the correct address. Do this enough and she can have her cake, and eat it too.

Out of Context Features

- Daily watermelon

- Accurate simulation of what having a job is like

- Coworkers who look like they're hiding something?

- Boring office work

- Fun, non-office work

- Missing people reports?

- Cake

games.name: Misty Judgment
games.shortDescription: This is a suspense reasoning interactive work with real people. You will play the protagonist "Qi Yi", find evidence in a series of murders, piece together the truth, and find the ultimate murderer, all of which will lead you to an unpredictable future.
games.aboutText:
You wake up from a nightmare and find that your memory has become ambiguous, and you can't even confirm your name. You can only rely on the name "Qi Yi" called by people around you to find your own survival, but the bizarre events that followed have made your identity more and more confusing. Is the truth hidden behind the fog really what you expected?

After a burst of inexplicable dizziness, you returned to college, but everything around you is not the same as your vague memory. Just when you want to know your own situation, a strange murder case of falling from a building brings those familiar and unfamiliar people together with you, and the real murderer is also hidden among you ...

When you wake up in a mental hospital, the familiar faces appear in front of you in different identities, but their memories are not the same as yours. In a controlled state, you want to find a way out of this environment, and at this time, the same group of people have triggered a new murder ...

Game features

※ Infinite flow's suspense reasoning

Connect the cases with different story backgrounds, find clues and catch the real murderer hidden among the partners!

※ Daily communication and interaction

In the gap time outside the copy, you can have a unique story with the female characters and have a deeper emotional connection with them.

Role introduction

● Qi Yi

The name someone told you seems to be a mystery writer. You have no real feelings with vague memories and are trying to find your true self.

● Su Yunyao

Reporter, gentle in character, but also does some small practical jokes on familiar people. She is curious about your identity and story and is trying to get you to provide her with more information.

● Zhao Yan

A promising young painter and a rich family environment have cultivated her into an arrogant young lady. She is not very good at expressing her kindness directly and will use indirect methods to get your attention.

● Xu Yueran

Online celebrity, a minor celebrity, has two faces in front of and behind the camera, and has a dream of becoming a big star. She has gained a lot of attention because she accidentally interacted with you in the live broadcast. Now she is pestering you in various ways and wants you to live with her again.

● Wen Yishu

The woman who suddenly moved next door claimed to have taken care of your sister since she was a child, but you have no memory of her and always cook something for you, saving your stomach from being tortured by Lin Busheng all the time.

● Lin Busheng

Your college classmate, now roommate, likes sports, but his brain doesn't seem to be very smart.

● Gu Wenhan

The boss who runs a biotechnology company is very strict with you for some reason.

● Chen Shengran

I was once helped by you, and I admired you very much when I learned that you were a novelist.

games.name: Berry Bury Berry
games.shortDescription: A juicy first-person incremental game about growing berries and tossing them down an ominous hole. Earn money and upgrades. Make new friends with sentient berry pals. Grow and control the hole as you unearth why nobody leaves this accursed garden. Bury it all, Berry everything.
games.aboutText:
Berry Bury Berry is a surreal first-person incremental game about growing berries and putting them in a hole. Lots and lots of berries.

BERRY BERRY BERRY BERRY BERRY BERRY BERRY BERRY BERRY BERRY BERRY BERRY

Make and Upgrade Berry Buddies to grow higher and higher tiers of berries!

MONEY MONEY MONEY MONEY MONEY MONEY MONEY MONEY MONEY MONEY MONEY MONEY

Use all that sweet sweet money earned to unlock upgrades and tools to help increase profits and explore more of the accursed garden!

BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY BURY

Grow and gain control of the Hole to bury things deep below, where nobody will ever find them...

Additional Features

- Multiple endings! Unearth the secrets of the accursed garden and its inhabitants!

- Expansive upgrade tree with unlockable gadgets and tools

- Highly addictive incremental game fun, in a bouncy and squishy world

games.name: You Sure You Wanna Drink This?
games.shortDescription: A charming picture-book style interactive story with light puzzles and turn-based combat. After the Pharmacist’s knowledge vanishes, experiment on your partner to learn! Analyze potion effects to deduce ingredient properties. Enjoy vibrant art and story. Reclaim your lost knowledge!
games.aboutText:
Field trip gone WRONG? Stumbled into a spine-tingling forest where mythic beasts lurk?

Herb-hunting disaster? Now you’re face-to-face with a giant crimson legendary monster ?

As the academy’s rising pharmacy star , you’re destined to triumph… until—

“Wait—where’s my herb pouch? How do I even mix potions now？Why can't I remember anything??!”

"Believe in us! We've got this!"

POOF! Your genius? Gone. All that’s left? Panic and a sword-crazy warrior buddy!

Dive into our hand-drawn picture-book world—crafted with love!

Every cozy corner tells a story! Unwrap our tale and enjoy this adorable adventure!

Combine the materials obtained on the adventure, and based on the reactions of your partner and enemies after drinking the potion, figure out the effects of the herbs.

Grow your herbal know-how while untangling all sorts of puzzles that come your way! No worries—there’s always a solution waiting to be found…

Facing a puzzle? Play it safe to avoid nasty potion side-effects... or chase that wild surprise boost?
Dose your buddy? Or lob it at a foe?

Every choice you make isn't just about cracking puzzles—it’s about unlocking the secrets of every herb!
So don’t fear slip-ups! Experiment boldly!
After all—it’s all in the name of discovering the MAGIC in every mix!

You may find other adventurers along the way, are they friends or foes, and what are their goals?

Share a ‘Friendship Potion’ with them—
Gulp!
POOF! Their true colors can’t hide!

Trust the brew—truth always bubbles up!

Special thanks to the G4G (Game for Good) Fund for their funding and support of this project.

games.name: Requiem of Reuinis
games.shortDescription: A Magic Tower-style Strategy RPG with alchemy and progression. Play as Tasia and explore lost ruins with your companions. No unwinnable dead ends — plan your days freely, build your loadout, gather resources, and uncover the truth behind the [Calamity].
games.aboutText:
The brilliant civilization of the old era was reduced to ash in the [Calamity]. Now, guided by the Church, humanity has gradually built a new order for a new age. The holy scriptures define that chapter of history as "punishment for defying the gods," and any attempt to explore it has become an untouchable taboo.

Yet as natural disasters grow frequent and monsters run rampant, cracks have begun to form in this fragile peace. On a stormy night, a young noblewoman named Tasia stumbles upon a hidden cave entrance. This forgotten place may hold the truth behind the [Calamity]……

Magic Tower Strategy — Every Step Counts

Requiem of Reuinis inherits the core of classic Magic Tower games, but shifts the focus from tedious individual battles to broader zone planning and resource management. The goal isn't to win every fight — it's the careful weighing of routes, keys, and resources. Do you spend keys to bypass tough enemies and grab resources early? Or grind steadily to build your strength? Every decision you make will shape the outcome of your exploration.

Alchemy & Research — Turn Resources into Power

Blindly charging at powerful enemies is never a good strategy. Built around a daily cycle, the game establishes an "Explore - Alchemize - Research" growth loop. Venture deep into ruins to gather materials, use alchemy to produce vital consumables and higher-tier resources, then solidify those resources into permanent stats and powerful equipment through research. Every day of accumulation becomes the confidence to challenge bosses and conquer ever-harder zones.

The Day System — Advance or Retreat on Your Terms

Say goodbye to the dread of a single wrong step ruining your run. The game's unique day system lets you retreat from the map at any time . Even better, there's no forced time penalty — the passage of time brings no doom, so you never need to agonize over small setbacks. Combined with in-run retreat, you're free to boldly experiment with every possibility. Chase the ultimate challenge with a minimum-day speedrun, or become an alchemy master — repeatedly exploring and researching to amass power, then crushing all obstacles with overwhelming stats.

Hundreds of Builds — Limitless Strategy

With 300 pieces of equipment and 80 skills, you can craft a truly unique playstyle and loadout. There is no "correct answer" here — every zone is a new strategic puzzle waiting to be solved.

We are committed to continuously expanding the world of Requiem of Reuinis, bringing you fresher and deeper strategic experiences. We are eager to hear every player's voice. Join our Discord to share your valuable thoughts and suggestions — let's polish this game together and write the final chapter of this adventure side by side.

games.name: Roulette Hero
games.shortDescription: Roulette Hero is a strategic roguelike deckbuilder where you assemble animal companions to defeat towering mechanical beasts. Line up the perfect squad on your roulette wheel, spin to activate your animals' abilities, trigger game-changing synergies, and turn the tide of battle!
games.aboutText:
Roulette Hero combines the mechanics of Luck Be A Landlord and Slay the Spire, and is a brand new form of deck-building roguelite strategy game.

Pull the lever, spin the roulette and trigger some killer combos! Each pull of the lever is full of surprises. Will you start a chain reaction, deal crushingly high damage, demolish your enemy and come out on top?

Craft the Ultimate Synergy

Build your dream team of extraordinary animal companions

Position them wisely and combine their abilities

Unleash devastating combos to wipe out the battlefield

Every Spin is a New Adventure

Multiple player character and swappable levers, all with unique special abilities

13 animal types, 100+ animal tiles to arrange on your board

100+ power-up cartridges to mix and match

Each spin could turn the tide... or send you scrambling for a comeback!

See You at the Top, Challenger!

Fight your way through all 20 difficulty levels

Compete for the top spot on the leaderboard

Tinker Around in Steam Workshop

Subscribe to mods you're interested in

Add a new quirky character, thrilling power-up cartridge, or a crazy synergy

See where your imagination takes you!

*There are currently playable mods on Steam Workshop

games.name: Tower Wizard
games.shortDescription: Help a wizard build and upgrade a wizard tower in this incremental game! Use the tower to study magic, summon spirits, create buildings, and influence the world.
games.aboutText:
Gather magic and build your wizard tower

Summon spirits to help gather resources

Construct buildings using the resources you gathered

Master magic to create greatest wizard tower!

- An active incremental/upgrade game

- Prestige to replay and progress faster

- Tons of upgrades and unique mechanics

- Definite ending

games.name: Look Outside
games.shortDescription: Look Outside is a survival horror RPG set in a single apartment building. A mysterious event turns anyone who looks out the window into grotesque monsters, leaving the world in absolute chaos. Scavenge the building to seek food, supplies, and weapons while encountering strange characters.
games.aboutText:
Look Outside is a survival horror RPG set in a single apartment building. A mysterious event turns anyone who looks out the window into grotesque monsters, leaving the world in absolute chaos. Scavenge the building to seek food, supplies, and weapons while encountering strange characters - human and otherwise.

Survival Horror & Resource Management

Plan tense expeditions outside your apartment as you fend off grotesque monsters dwelling in and around your building. Return to your home with gathered resources and partial answers to your questions to recuperate by playing games, making dinner, crafting tools, and getting to know your neighbors turned allies.

Inventive Turn-Based Combat

Clash with over 150 hand-crafted creatures in turn-based combat that accounts for space between you and your foes as you wield makeshift weapons and items you've gathered in the corridors of the building.

Impeccable Body Horror Aesthetic

Meet your macabre fate in a bizarre world teeming with an unconventional and occasionally psychotic cast of characters - some of which you can recruit and offer safe harbor in your apartment as the mystery unravels.

Small, Experimental, and Unwaveringly Weird

Offering 10 - 12 hours of playtime with a dozen boss encounters, friends to recruit, and visitors to invite back to your home, Look Outside offers different experiences for every player on their way to uncover several different endings.

games.name: Ogre Chambers 2222
games.shortDescription: BATTLE in a transforming arena against ALIEN OGRES in this ROGUELIKE BULLET-HELL 💥 MODIFY your gun, make smart upgrade decisions and master your spaceship's controls to conquer the OGRE CHAMBERS!
games.aboutText:
SURVIVE in a TRANSFORMING ARENA

These transforming arenas are filled with ROGUELIKE -style RANDOMIZED LOOT, where you're forced to make the most out of what you find. Waves of enemies will keep coming for you, despite how strong your gun is. SURVIVE long enough and eventually overcome the final OGRE !

MODIFY and MASTER

MODIFY your gun and MASTER your spaceship. Make smart decisions about when to swap out your gun core for a new one, which shot modules to install and what upgrades to choose. Good decisions aren't enough to quarantee success, as you will also need to know how to maneuver your spaceship to dodge the complicated enemy attack patterns! Once you've mastered both, you might be able to conquer the OGRE CHAMBERS

games.name: Little Chef: Cozy Cooking
games.shortDescription: Little Chef: Cozy Cooking is a short physics-based cooking game full of discovery and playful chaos. Experiment with everything in the kitchen and unlock over 300 recipes on your way to becoming a master chef!
games.aboutText:
Little Chef: Cozy Cooking is a short game where you experiment in the kitchen.

You can drag, toss, and combine ingredients in fun and surprising ways, to fill your cookbook with over 300 recipes, ranging from the gourmet to the gross. The game is about 3 hours long.

KITCHEN SANDBOX

G et messy in the kitchen! Everything has weight, motion and personality. Drag and drop items, or throw them around. So, mix and match, toss and break things to complete your to do list.

COUNTLESS SECRETS

Not all ingredients are easy to find. Every cabinet and shelf is chock-full of hidden ingredients waiting to be uncovered. Some are hidden, others are locked away, and solving these puzzles might mean thinking creatively.

CHAOTIC ACHIEVEMENTS

Behind every kitchen nook and cranny are achievements that reward you for bending the rules of the kitchen. To solve the game’s most challenging puzzles, players will need to throw out the recipe book, roll up their sleeves, and think outside the box.

FEATURES:

- Around 3 hour of playtime to complete all 3 levels in 3 different kitchens.

- Cook everything from comfort foods and gourmet dishes to strange, surprising experiments.

- Play with satisfying physics as every ingredient and object reacts in fun, surprising ways.

- Solve playful kitchen puzzles to uncover hidden ingredients, secrets, and new ways to cook.

- Collect fun achievements that reward curiosity, chaos, and breaking the rules.

- Follow a heartfelt story by unlocking each recipe.

THE TEAM

Hello! We are a small group of friends who wanted to make a cute game about cooking. We started this project in the end of 2024 and this will be is our first commercial release!

Our team is Julien (game designer & co-creator), Erika (artist & co-creator), Danny (programmer) and Kristin (narrative desiger) and Tumult Kollective (audio design).

Most of us work on this project part time but we love experimenting, learning, and pushing their ideas as far as their own skills, time, and personal investment allow us. And we hope you will enjoy our creation :)

games.name: Nighthold
games.shortDescription: Sandbox survival RPG where days are for preparation and nights are for survival. Gather resources, build and fortify your shelter, fight the Rot and raiders - solo or with friends in online co-op.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Sandrax-66b

Cosmos Colonisation Corp™ grants you the opportunity to become a pioneer of the planet Sandrax-66b.
An unknown world, mysterious creatures, strange flora… and humans who clearly should not be here.

Build a camp before nightfall. At night, certain creatures will begin to attack you. Try to collect as much data about them as possible. Optionally - survive.
We have invested significant resources in your transportation.

The Expedition Did Not Go According to Plan

Did your ship explode in orbit? Did the landing happen “however it happened”? That occurs.

Gather enough valuable data and samples - and perhaps we will return for you.

In exchange for your reports, the corporation provides technologies and blueprints to increase your chances of survival.

Nighthold - Your Base and Your Way to Survive

Night is the ultimate test of your decisions. Stay away from the ground. Seriously.

The optimal solution is to build a stilted shelter: Nighthold .
Fortify it, adapt it to new threats, and prepare for the next night.

A World Without Restrictions

Everything you see can be dismantled, destroyed, or set on fire.
Fire spreads freely, gets out of control, and is equally dangerous to everyone.

Every Problem Has Multiple Solutions

Cosmos Colonisation Corp™ values not only strength, but ingenuity.

You may sneak, attack head-on, open the gates at night and let the environment decide the outcome… or simply burn everything to the ground.

The corporation supports any approach. Ethical evaluation is not part of the mandatory report.

Survival Is More Efficient Together

You may not be the only survivor. Contact others via radio and work together in online co-op.

Different characters offer different roles and perks. Team play provides tactical advantages and allows you to collect twice as much valuable data.

games.name: Backroom Cleaners
games.shortDescription: Purge the unknown Backrooms in this 4-player co-op TPS roguelike. Experience endless combat with fresh build combinations every run.
games.aboutText:
The Backrooms Out of Control.

Backroom Cleaners is a co-op roguelike TPS for up to 4 players where a battle for survival clashes between the unknown horrors of the Backrooms and the Cleaners, soldiers specialized in making the hunter their prey.

As a Cleaner for Axiom Corporation, you are deployed into the Backrooms. Secure uncontrollable zones, eliminate hostile entities, and venture into the deeper layers of the Backrooms.

Build a unique growth build with every operation, and cooperate with your teammates to fight back against the threats

You Are Hired to Fight.

In Backroom Cleaners, you are not the hunted.
As Axiom Corporation's Cleaner, your job is to eliminate hostile entities, secure operational zones, and purge the threats of the Backrooms.

Carry out operations with fellow agents, each bringing their own specializations to the field.
Hold the line at the forefront, support your allies, and dominate the battlefield with massive firepower. The threats of the Backrooms cannot be faced alone; proper role distribution and cooperation are the keys to operational success.

Your mission is not to survive the unknown, but to conquer it. Together.

Utilize the cultures secured from the Backrooms to acquire new abilities.

Every operation presents different growth choices and tactical paths, where unexpected synergies can completely turn the tide of battle.
Depending on the abilities you choose and the zones you enter, even the same agent can offer a completely different combat experience, fitting your preferred playstyle or catering to what your team needs from you to create the most lethal combinations.

Beware, however, because the Backrooms reject human presence.

Numerous entities will interfere with your mission, and the deeper you go, the more hazardous the threats become.

A momentary lapse in vigilance can lead to fatal consequences.

The Backrooms Constantly Reject You.

The Backrooms reject human presence.

Numerous entities will interfere with your mission, and the deeper you go, the more hazardous the threats become.

A momentary lapse in vigilance can lead to fatal consequences.

The Backrooms are more than just an unknown space.

Axiom Corporation has discovered infinite possibilities within and is actively deploying Cleaners to secure the deeper sectors. Its reasons are currently unknown, but it must be something of high importance if they are willing to send so many Cleaners into that place… Use any means necessary to complete the operation and get out of there alive.

Your sacrifice is already specified in the contract.

games.name: Dark PGT
games.shortDescription: Dark PGT – A Souls-like game in an alternate universe of future USSR on Unreal Engine 5. You will play the role of alcoholic-schizophrenic experiencing psychological disorders and hallucinations. Travel to a village in 2030 to unravel all its secrets and solve all its problems.
games.aboutText:
PS: The game was developed by one person.

Dark PGT – A Souls-like Comedy Mini-Game on Unreal Engine 5

Mad Journey: A Ticket to the Unknown

Welcome to chaos!

How far are you willing to go? And is there a way back?

Choose your path, make insane decisions, and try not to lose your mind.

You take on the role of a military alcoholic with a mysterious gift—or perhaps a curse—seeing glimpses of the future… or just suffering from hallucinations. Travel to USSR village in the year 2030 to uncover its dark secrets and lift the curse haunting this strange settlement.

Dive into a nightmarish future and try to understand: what is really happening here? How did the world descend into this madness?

You'll face hordes of mutated inhabitants—madmen, street prophets, and mysterious mutant grannies unleashing chaos from their balconies. Survive, fight, tear through enemies, and carve your way to the truth. Is this reality, or just the product of a delusional mind?

Or are you ready to live your entire life in a place where every day is Groundhog Day?!

Are you ready to take on one of the toughest games on the planet without losing your sanity?!

We are giving you one of the rarest gifts that no one else will ever give you – the experience of completing Dark PGT.

A brutal game world— The enemy is ruthless, tearing through everything to destroy you. Your end is near.

Extreme difficulty—worthy of a Souls-like game. But much worse.

No character progression—you, your sword, and your combat experience in similar games are all that matter on the battlefield.

games.name: Estella
games.shortDescription: A brand-new 3D rhythm game for mouse & keyboard. Ride a golden comet through the cosmos and compose your own adventure with every song and every note.
games.aboutText:
About the Game

In the vast universe of the rhythm music game Estella, you take on the role of a comet flying through the stars and traveling through planets on a musical adventure. You will hear, play, and experience the stories of distinct characters on each planet—revealing a story in which fate and music are intertwined.

🎵 The Ideal Combination of Mechanics and Music

An inventive octagonal hitbox interface is a feature of the game. To hit rhythm notes precisely, players need to be adept at using both the mouse and the keyboard.

You'll encounter a variety of gameplay actions, including tapping, holding, and dodging, with notes of different colors and shapes.

A completely immersive visual and rhythmic experience is provided by the Sky Notes that appear above, adding an additional layer of difficulty.

🪐 Planet System: Story Progression Based on Chapters

With a number of distinctively styled songs and narrative components, each chapter symbolizes a planet.

In order to delve into the stories of the characters on each planet, players will progressively unlock narrative segments and musical tracks.

Once you reach significant milestones, you will need to pass certain phases in order to continue.

Non-main-story content, such as separately updated levels and additional tracks, is available on the Chaos Planet.

games.name: DISCOPUP
games.shortDescription: DISCOPUP is a mystery game about a seal who wants to sneak inside a dogs-only party. Explore the city and meet shady characters as your search for the perfect dog costume.
games.aboutText:
In DISCOPUP , you're a seal eager to party, making your way to the most famous nightclub in the city: DiscoPup . However, tonight, the bouncer is only letting dogs in. How will you make it past him?

Costumes! Find the right accessories and combine them in such a way that will make you look just like any other party dog. Put your fashion sense to the test against DiscoPup's bouncer.

Meet quirky characters! A mouse that speaks in tiny words. A suspicious wolf granny. A cowboy puppy with a big plastic on his paw. A mind-reading ferret. They all have something to say and they might help you in your search for the perfect dog costume.

But you only have so much time... DiscoPup closes its doors at 2:00 a.m. Whatever you do, make sure it brings you closer to your goal. Investigate and figure out which actions are worth your time. The best night of your life depends on it.

games.name: Queen of treasure isle
games.shortDescription: Poor Windy has come to search for the treasure hidden on the island. The queens who protect the island are not afraid of her as long as she doesn't do anything unnecessary.
games.aboutText:
Queen of treasure isle is a simple, small-scale metroidvania that mainly consists of bomb throwing and jumping.

You can retrieve the treasure hidden in various places and return home in a balloon when you are done.

There are some strong queens waiting for you on the island, but you don't have to fight them. If you are not confident, avoid them.

Distribution Terms and Conditions

We permit both individuals and corporations to distribute and monetize gameplay videos as long as you include the name of the game and the URL of the store page in the summary section, etc.

games.name: Broken Relic
games.shortDescription: On his first day as an archive intern, Tim unleashes an ancient conqueror and gets fired. Now the boss who fired him is relying on him to save the world. A fully voiced fantasy point-and-click comedy.
games.aboutText:
A VERY BAD FIRST DAY

Tim was supposed to find three missing books. Instead, he broke an ancient seal and released Kaelvorn, the Cursed Devourer.

His boss has asked him to recover the three scattered pieces of the Broken Relic™ and save the world.

He has also fired him.

MEET THE LOCALS

Explore forbidden archives, mountain towns and the goblin settlements of the Abyssal Depths. A fantasy adventure across three acts, with detailed pixel art and full English voice acting.

Help a runaway goblin bride, enter a gladiatorial tournament and break into a bank with a thieves’ guild run by rats (It’s a secret guild, they have a sign.)

NOT EVERYONE IS HAPPY WHEN YOU GO AROUND SOLVING PUZZLES

Inspect your surroundings, follow conversations for clues and combine items to solve puzzles across connected locations. Choose which of the three shards to pursue first.

You might uncover an ancient secret. You might finally open a passage that has been sealed for centuries. You might then have to explain yourself to the goblin who was being paid to fix it.

A NOTE FROM THE DEVELOPER

Hi, I’m Pablo. I design, write, draw and code Broken Relic, with collaborators helping with the music, animation and voices.

I’m making the game around my day job. Tim’s employment situation is considerably less stable.

games.name: Ascent DX
games.shortDescription: Crashed on a desolate but mysterious planet you find yourself eye to eye with an ancient civilisation. Explore the planet, find powerful upgrades, and fulfill your destiny.
games.aboutText:
Ascent DX is a tiny metroidvania brought to life in glorious 64 x 64 pixel art and soothing chiptune music. Crashed on an unknown planet you have to explore lush jungles, lifeless deserts, and luminescent caves in search of anything that can help you understand what has happened to the planet and how to get off it.

While the game is a bigger version of the original Ascent, with almost twice as many locations to explore, it is still quite a short game. With the same celebrated gameplay and atmosphere, the DX versions also brings more items to find, more platforming puzzles, and more lore to uncover.

FEATURES

- A world brought to life by tiny but expressive pixel art

- Explore the planet's many biomes in your own pace and direction

- Find new powers and abilities that help you on your way

- Uncover the fate of the planet as well as your own

- Different endings based on how much was discovered

CREDITS

Design, code, & pixel art: Johan Peitz

Music & sfx: Brent Houston

Capsule art: Jon Nielsen

games.name: DebugDebut
games.shortDescription: A debugging simulation game in which you complete debugging requests from a game generation AI that suddenly appears. Debug games of various genres and aim to win high rewards.
games.aboutText:
[Overview]

"DebugDebut" is a simulation game where you earn money by doing serious debugging work.
An app that suddenly appears on your desktop.
When you start it up, an AI that generates games starts up.
This AI is still new and doesn't seem to be able to make games well.
So you become the debugger and start pointing out bugs in the game to fix them.
Can you point them out without making any mistakes?
And what is the true identity of this app?

[Game Description]

You need to find all the bugs in the game.
Read through the game description written on the checklist
Operate and check the game while comparing it with the description and materials.
Find all the behaviors that don't match the game behavior and the checklist items.
Bugs include simple ones such as

- The character doesn't move

- No sound

- The UI isn't reflected

- Only enemy D is invincible

- Only block E is hit and miss

- If you leave a certain screen for 2 minutes, it suddenly crashes

and more.
There is more than one game to debug.

- Shooting

- Puzzle

- Card

- Action

- Horror

And many more.
If you miss a bug three times while debugging all the games,
you will lose the AI's trust and the debugging process will end.
Check carefully to avoid mistakes.
You can also use the rewards you get from debugging to make
extensions to make debugging easier.
Aim for the best debugging environment by preparing cheat tools that suit the game and asking for help from friends. [Play time]
