games.name: Puff Love Story
games.shortDescription: 轻松愉快的短篇恋爱AVG！男主角阿逅是个烘焙师傅，他刚经历事业爱情的双重打击一蹶不振。就在此时，一位爱吃泡芙的女孩出现在他的面前，这段吃泡芙、做泡芙的恋爱故事就此开始！
games.aboutText:
男主角阿逅是个擅长做泡芙的烘焙师傅

他供养前女友考公，结果对方上岸当天就把他甩了

同时他上班的咖啡店也发不出工资，濒临倒闭

经历了事业和爱情双重打击，他逐渐变得消沉

就在此时，一位爱吃泡芙的女孩出现在他的面前

这段吃泡芙、做泡芙的恋爱故事就此开始！

- 高考恋爱100天十周年特别小短片

- 剧情时长4-6小时的短篇AVG～

- 精美的CG和可爱的Q版本美术～

- 轻松治愈的温馨恋爱故事～

games.name: Bake Until Done
games.shortDescription: Bake Until Done is a baking-themed, turn-based roguelite. Take control of a muffin as you battle devious desserts to break the spell of a magical bakery that is endangering your town. Fight back with your muffin’s morsels, but be careful not to lose too much…
games.aboutText:
A new bakery has opened down the street from your bakery. Your once bustling shop is now empty, and something odd is happening to your old customers. You sneak in to investigate and find a magical cookbook and the sinister sweets that it has brought to life. Take a page out of that magical cookbook and bake wholesome muffins to stop these devilish desserts from putting the town in a trance.

Explore the Kitchen

In this roguelite, explore expansive kitchens, moving between countertops, tables, and carts. Move along a grid in turn with other baked goods and elements in the game. Each level offers different challenges as you find your way from your muffin tin to a muffin box that takes you to the next level.

Fight Desserts

Throughout each kitchen level, you’ll find less than savory treats trying to stop your progress from cinnamon buns unraveling to whip you to macarons shooting their filling at you.

Fight off desserts by pulling morsels off of your muffin and throwing them at your enemies. Some morsel types have special effects. For example, banana morsels make enemies or objects slip. Berries can alter the physics of the world around you and be used against enemy and puzzle alike.

Upgrade Your Muffins

Power up your muffins by gaining the Gifts of generous rodent friends found around the levels. These Gifts can add to your basic stats, unlock new abilities, and trigger magical and powerful effects. Meet goals for these Gifts and gain more powerful variants for your next set of muffins. Find powerful items as you make your way through the levels to upgrade your muffins (and your baking) in even more ways.

Find Ingredients

Gather ingredients throughout each level to bake new muffins when your muffin tin starts to empty. Some ingredients are common with straightforward effects. Others are rare with exotic effects, like granting your muffin abilities such as dodging or a periodic extra turn.

Bake New Muffins

Every few levels you’ll have the opportunity to bake new muffins with the ingredients you’ve gathered along the way. Learn about the magical properties of different ingredients and their combinations to give yourself an edge as you progress.

Some ingredients will make your muffin harder to hurt. Others will boost your attacks. Each mix-in, like blueberries or chocolate chips, offers a different kind of morsel to throw.

games.name: Moon River
games.shortDescription: Moon River is a short RPG adventure with an emphasis on music and atmosphere. Perhaps some secrets too... Explore the remains of an quiet, empty world & find the river's end.
games.aboutText:
Moon River is a short RPG adventure featuring a classic top-down perspective and light RPG / puzzle elements

You are someone called the Mariner , a sailor who's been out at sea for an incredibly long time. You are headed to Elapse Island, one of the last known places of the world. There, it is said the people only exist in the moonlight, as well as the river that runs through the island: " Moon River ." For whatever reason, the Mariner desperately seeks something at the end of the river.

As the Mariner, your objective is to travel to the river's end before dawn. Deep shadows obstruct each area of the island, so you must find any sources of pure light to dispel them and proceed down the river.

Along the way you'll find new people to meet, sights & sounds to experience, and secrets to uncover.

Atmospheric RPG Experience

Moon River forgoes combat and heavy narrative, instead primarily consisting of exploration and puzzle solving with optional secret events scattered throughout.

Interactive Events

Occasionally, there are special interactive events and actions to perform, such as operating a machine. These events briefly break up the regular gameplay for a more varied experience.

Hidden Narrative

Beneath the main story, there is a hidden history of events from the past which can only be uncovered within the world's secret spaces and unchecked corners. Only the highly dedicated can piece the entire story together.

Moon River is an atmospheric experience with very light narrative and gameplay elements. You'll explore different areas of Elapse Island, searching for ways to dispel dark shadows that block your path along the river. This is not intended to be thrilling or challenging, but rather to evoke emotions through the colors and sounds of this environment.

games.name: Firefly Village
games.shortDescription: The Firefly Village awaits! A bite-sized, streamlined farming sim that focuses on moments that matter, without wasting a single second of your time. Build a homestead, raise crops, tend to livestock, make friends, and enjoy a pocket of paradise where farming is a delight and friends plentiful.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Firefly Village! As its newest arrival, discover the joy of a simple, rural life, where there's no rush, no deadlines to meet, no arbitrary demands to fulfill, just you, a plot of land, and wholesome neighbors to meet, make friends, and become a part of this tight-knit community.

With 4-minute days and 7-day seasons, you’ll experience clear progression without the overwhelming tasks. Whether it’s the satisfying pluck of a harvest or the gentle splash of fishing, every action is crafted to bring joy - all at your own pace!

Firefly Village is built around streamlined gameplay, allowing you to relax and enjoy each passing day while tending to your little plot of land, meeting interesting people, or just watching the land flourish as the seasons pass - free of the pressure of conventional farming games.

🦋 Build a Cozy Life: There's no mass farming in Firefly Village. This small, loving community focuses on intentional farming, with a diversity of crops and livestock, living in calm harmony with the land.

🌱 Relax and Enjoy: Enjoying your time at the farm, instead of grinding your time away. Crops grow quickly, animals don't require much, and you can simply take a break, go fishing, mine some ores, or meet the neighbors, without worrying that something will break in the meantime.

✨ Streamlined and Polished : Every system has been designed to make it pleasant, rather than frustrating, focusing on moments of joy that everyday farm work brings: Harvesting crops, catching fish, mining ores and simply tending the land and watching it bloom.

🕰️ Easy to Pick Up and Put Down: Whether you just want to pass away a few minutes watching your crops grow or kick back for an evening and get to know the community of Firefly Village, there is no stress or arbitrary goals you must fulfill. This is your homestead and you enjoy it however you like.

games.name: DUET
games.shortDescription: DUET illustrates the Hifuu Club's first encounter. It is a wordless, narrative-driven experience about connection and small moments in life. Step into the subtle yet fateful daily interactions that intertwine Renko and Merry's lives.
games.aboutText:
DUET is an interactive story illustrating the Hifuu Club's first encounter. It is a wordless, narrative-driven experience about connection, small moments, and the quiet magic of two lives intertwining.

Renko Usami lives a simple life, endlessly cycling through studying, eating, and sleeping at university. She gazes at the starry sky alone, trying to fill the emptiness in her heart. Then, one day, Maribel Hearn appears—a girl who seems to have stepped from beyond the boundaries of the world...

Features & Content:

- Wordless, Interactive Storytelling : Experience Renko & Merry's subtle yet fateful daily moments through a series of light, meaningful interactions.

- Handcrafted Atmosphere: Immerse yourself in lovingly crafted hand-drawn visuals and a gentle soundtrack that enriches the story’s warmth.

- A Delicate Story to Explore : Step into and witness Renko and Merry's encounter that intertwines their lives. Catch the quiet warmth hidden like a butterfly in the stillness of their shared world.

- Short, Sweet Experience: DUET is crafted to be completed in a single sitting. It invites you to slow down and enjoy a calm, quiet, and heartfelt experience.

DUET is a Touhou Project fan game, inspired by the indie masterpiece Florence . It paints a story that is sweet, delicate, and profoundly touching.

games.name: Yap Wizards Tower Defence
games.shortDescription: Dynamic tower defence with an ever-scaling battlefield and unexpected twists!
games.aboutText:
Mad machinations are underfoot on the Dirt Path. Take up arms and defend the Dirt Path with divine arms.

- Broaden your horizons and dynamically scale up the battle after each wave!

- Learn about the the yapping wizards aiding in your Tower Defence!

- Survive the overwhelming hordes and be granted epic ranks from the Grand Tutorial Wizard!

- Upend the corruption of the system and enact social change, one Gnoblin at a time... Or ruin the fields by enacting zoning for the Ballistas. Again.

games.name: Mashina
games.shortDescription: A little robot digs to repair her world. Dig, build, discover and mend in a chill, stop-motion world.
games.aboutText:
Mashina is a digging adventure by the developers behind Judero. You play as Mashina, a friendly mining robot tasked with finding minerals to help mend, build and nurture her quirky robot community.

Gameplay

The Gameplay in Mashina is divided into two distinct sections; a deep, mysterious underground full of trinkets and minerals and a vibrant, fully explorable 3D Overground.

Underground

A lot of the game will be spent exploring, discovering and reclaiming the underground world.

- Use your radar to scope out objects of interest.

- Dig to excavate rare minerals.

- Store the rare minerals safely in Mashina's backpack

- Deposit those minerals in your underground base

- Build helpful machines to aid your excavations

- Find robot pals, treasures, trinkets and more

Explore the underground and discover an adventure waiting to happen.

Overground

- Meet locals and get missions

- Upgrade your equipment

- Decorate your surroundings

- Explore and find collectables and secrets

Art Style

Everything in Mashina is handmade out of various materials and animated using traditional stop-motion techniques. We then turn the animations into textures and sprites we can use in game, adding normal maps which let us have dynamic lighting and shadows.

Music and Sound

Music is an important part of our work. For Mashina we are making the extensive soundtrack using retro synths to make a sublime soundscape to chill out and dig to. All the sound effects are made using old synths too, to keep in keeping with the score.

Our robots are all fully voice acted and are voiced by some very talented people from across the gaming world and beyond.

games.name: I Write Games Not Tragedies
games.shortDescription: An emo-inspired narrative rhythm game exploring growing pains, addiction, romance and music. Scream with Ash as he makes the transition from baby bat to elder emo, guide him through his crash outs and help him navigate his (teenage) dirtbag life through music.
games.aboutText:
“Sometimes I wish all of my pain was fake ”

I Write Games Not Tragedies is a narrative-driven rhythm game that pays homage to British emo and goth subcultures. Follow Ash’s journey of self-discovery from young goth in the early 2000s to elder emo in the 2020s, via a battle with addiction in the 2010s.

Welcome to the goth parade

Like most baby bats, Ash’s secondary school life is not so great. Trapped and feeling misunderstood by so-called friends and the awful popular kids, his only solace is the punk music playing through his Skullcandy headphones… and maybe a certain beautiful blonde normie - except why does he have to be so nice?!

From eyeliner to exhaustion and everything in between, Ash tells it all. Explore his past and present while glimpsing into his future all in characteristically cringe glory.

Give them hell

When life feels like it’s becoming all too much, just take to the stage inside your head and rock out! Hit the important lyrics to the beat and sing or scream your lungs out during the chorus. Try to get the emo thermometer to the max, the louder the better!

Key Features

- A witty, sarcastic and self-depreciating narrative about growing up while struggling with romance, addiction and self-acceptance

- Sketchy, messy art that represents our fractured soul.. we’re in the business of misery, folks

- A vibes-based rhythm game, just feel the beat pulsing through your veins!

- Original music by indie punk rock artists from the United Kingdom, Japan and Hong Kong

- Enough cringe to set you free

games.name: Liminal City: Axiom of Maria - Chapter One
games.shortDescription: A 3D Metroidvania set in Seoul, left empty as humanity dwindled and now tended only by AI. Chain wall runs, air dashes, and a growing set of movement abilities to uncover hidden places and the stories tangled within them.
games.aboutText:
AI Dystopia

Humanity chose euthanasia — they stopped marrying, stopped having children, and withered away. AI tended to the empty reality they left behind. It filled waterless aquariums with whale bones, and hung theater entrances in midair. Like the awkward hands early AI once drew — careful, and wrong. The reality humanity left behind became AI's unconscious, and humans became something akin to monsters wandering through it. You follow a voice you cannot trust, and step in anyway.

Metroidvania Exploration

As you gain new abilities, walls become paths, chasms become passages, and gaps become entrances. Newly opened spaces loop back to where you've already been.

Combat & Boss Battles

Great trials stand in your way. Each one you pass makes you more whole.

games.name: Ant Mill Inc
games.shortDescription: Feed the nest. Grow the swarm. Devour the world. A dark incremental ant colony game where one ant becomes thousands. Gather food, upgrade the nest, uncover strange offerings, and fight for survival. Face the HUNGER - or become it...
games.aboutText:
FEED NEST. GROW SWARM. DEVOUR WORLD.

Nest almost empty. One ant still moves. Outside waits food, enemies, and strange offerings. Somewhere in dark, something hungry.

Ant Mill Inc is a dark real-time incremental ant colony game. Gather food. Grow nest. Fight enemies. Begin with one ant. Become thousands upon thousands.

COLONY THINKS FOR ITSELF

No controlling ants one by one. You shape the colony. The colony decides the rest.

Each ant sees only nearby things. Food. Danger. Nest. Pheromones. Ants explore, find resources, carry them home, call more ants with trails, and fight whatever gets in way.

Good trail gets stronger when many ants follow. Food gone? Smell fades. Ants find new way. Thousands of tiny minds become one great swarm.

GROW COLONY

Make ants spawn faster. Make ants move quicker, see farther, and carry more. First, few workers. Then, black tide.

SHAPE COLONY

Build vast upgrade tree. Find new resources. Tear down barriers piece by piece. New lands wait beyond.

FIGHT FOR COLONY

Crush hostile creatures. Break rival nests. Kill mighty bosses. Colony fights same way colony lives. More ants. Better ants. No stopping.

SAVE COLONY FROM HUNGER

The great worm never full. Feed it resources, or sacrifice ants at altar for Souls.

Challenge worm when you dare. Come weak, worm eats colony.

WHAT GAME HAS

- Many ants, each with its own small mind

- Pheromone trails that grow strong, then fade

- Vast upgrade tree

- Creatures to fight

- Barriers to tear apart piece by piece

- Strange offerings and powerful artifacts

- Wildlife, bosses, and rival ant colonies

games.name: Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi! This is a relaxing and enjoyable idle fishing game that can sit at the bottom or any corner of your screen, allowing you to enjoy a leisurely sea fishing time in your busy life.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi! A laid back fishing idler that lives on your desktop, along the bottom of your screen, or just about anywhere else you'd like. Take a moment to ease your mind as you take in the sea breeze, and wait for a bite! In Fish to Dish, you're a fisherman taking to the seas to reel in weird and wonderful creatures of the deep, and then serve them up as sushi. All kinds of customers await, their bellies rumbling... So upgrade your rod, unlock new bait, sail the seas, and even build your own aquarium tank!

• Start a relaxing fishing adventure from the bottom of your desktop screen. Watch as your boat sails the waves, reeling in new fish.

• Play at your own pace, and feel that sense of satisfaction as your boat heaves with awesome catches!Tap your keyboard or click your mouse to speed up the bite and reel in fish even faster!

• Cast your rod in a range of bays and isles, each with their own unique sea life. You'll see everything from everyday fish, to rare leviathans of the depths.

• What's that floating over there...? Spot starfish, turtles, walruses, even rubber ducks and much more floating out on the waves!

• Fill out your bestiary as you haul in new species, and expand your sushi bar's menu.

• Prepare your prize catches, and sell a delectable range of sushi dishes to earn gold.

• Level up your sushi bar and spruce it up with furniture and decorations. Make it your own to draw in all kinds of customers, and... cats?

• Buy rod upgrades to fish more efficiently, and return to shore with a deck chock-full of fish!

• Pick out the right bait for the fish you're after, and reel in elusive rare varieties.

• Float in relaxation, taking in the joy of fishing as the tides ebb and flow.

• Fill the hatchery with catches, and gaze over your rare fish as they flit within an aquarium ecosystem of your own creation.

• Bid stress farewell, and be at one with nature in Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi. Take time to fish at your leisure!

Game FAQ

Q: Screen flickering after Steam pop-up or pressing Shift+Tab?

A: Disable the Steam Overlay: Right-click Fish to Dish in your game library → Properties → General → Uncheck "Enable Steam Overlay while in-game." This only affects this game; others are unaffected.

Q: Game background is black?

A: Visit the store page → "Discussions" for a solution in the pinned post.

Q: Can DEMO save files be carried over to the full version?

A: No, carrying over saves may cause bugs.

games.name: FACE LOVE: Face Designer
games.shortDescription: ITS VALENTINES SEASON AND EVERYONE'S FACES GOT BLOWN OFF!
games.aboutText:
New Recruit! It's time to get Mug-Making and keep the face factory afloat in FACE LOVE: Face Designer! Take a shift at the Face Tec factory, using strangers' Love Profiles' as inspiration to make them brand new faces.

A new selection of customers and face parts each time you play! Get creative and work with the parts you're given to complement the customer's personality.

Save high quality images of your customers in Photo Mode . Choose from a selection of backgrounds to find one that matches your customer!

Brand new ways to customize your saved faces, with the Renamer tool, body and head recoloring , and a gallery of over 200+ face parts . Make a brand new face, or improve an existing customer.

All your faces from Play Mode and Creative Modes are saved to the Library. Browse your creations, or return and edit them further!

C'mon recruit, there's money to be made!!!

LimboLane is a creative duo making silly games that squish and bounce, comprised of designer Day Lane and animator Yugo Limbo. They have a love for the kitschy, the surreal, and the utterly bizarre. They're known for the nod-and-shake puzzle game Smile For Me and the a-pocky-lips stopping adventure Great God Grove .

games.name: Screen Cat
games.shortDescription: Милый кот на вашем рабочем столе. Он будет мурлыкать, когда вы устали. Он будет охотиться за курсором, когда вы работаете. Он будет спать, пока вы играете.
games.aboutText:
Let a cozy kitty settle right on your desktop!
This is not just a virtual pet — it's your new furry companion who will live beside you while you work, study, or play.

Features:

🐾 11 unique cats to choose from
Choose your perfect pet! From a striped mischief-maker to a fluffy aristocrat — there is a kitty for every taste.

🖥️ Free behavior
The cat freely roams around your desktop, explores the screen, and interacts with you.

🍖 Care and maintenance
Feed, pet, put to sleep, and play with your cat. Caring keeps it happy and active.

💓 Purring adjustment
Adjust the volume of purring to perfectly fit into your work rhythm.

🎮 Toys and entertainment

Place a scratching post , litter box , give a ball or a teaser stick . Watch how it interacts and entertains itself.

🌌 Exploring beyond the screen

Sometimes the cat goes "beyond the screen" — into its mysterious adventures.
It might return with rare collectible items , each with its own little story .

🎨 Full customization
Change the appearance of the cat, add hats, beds, new sounds.
Supports Steam Workshop — create and install mods!

games.name: Your Daughter
games.shortDescription: desktop mascot
games.aboutText:
User Manual

Before using the product, please read this manual carefully and keep it safe.

games.name: Maltese's Fluffy Onsen
games.shortDescription: Run a bathhouse visited by animals! Maltese's Fluffy Onsen is a relaxing simulation game that you can enjoy while doing other tasks, as it sits at the bottom of your screen. Place baths with different temperatures and rest areas to help a variety of animal friends unwind.
games.aboutText:
Run a bathhouse visited by animals! Maltese's Fluffy Onsen is a relaxing simulation game that you can enjoy while doing other tasks, as it sits at the bottom of your screen. Place baths with different temperatures and rest areas to help a variety of animal friends unwind.

- A Cozy Bathhouse
Help your animal guests relax and unwind with a warm bath. Set the water temperature to your liking—cold, warm, or hot—or create special baths using bubble machines and herbal bags.

- Refreshing Drinks and Snacks
Create a relaxing space for animals to rest after a good soak. From vending machines with thirst-quenching drinks to snack stands that fill their tummies, you have plenty of options to keep them happy.

- Your Very Own Bathhouse
Have you ever dreamed of owning a bathhouse? Design it your way, from nostalgic tiled interiors to open-air baths that warm you up just thinking about them. Make your dream bathhouse a reality.

- A Variety of Animal Guests
Cats, dogs, rabbits, hamsters, and more. Many different guests from the animal world come to relax and unwind. Run your bathhouse and meet all kinds of wonderful visitors.

- Helpful Staff to Lend a Hand
Great service takes effort and care. Manage your staff to keep the floors dry and safe, restock supplies, and make sure every guest has a fantastic experience.

(*Please note that the bathing habits of animals in the game may differ from those of real animals.)

games.name: Metronome
games.shortDescription: Metronome is a short semi auto-biographical interactive story about the life of a British musician spanning from the early 90s to the late 2020s.
games.aboutText:
Metronome is a short semi auto-biographical interactive story about the life of a British musician spanning from the early 90s to the late 2020s.

You play as musician Sam through 15 vignettes at pivotal moments in their life, each with a unique musical mechanic.

The game is designed to be started and finished in the same sitting and will not save your progress. Total length is around 40 minutes.

After completing the game you have the opportunity to replay any particular scene to try to perfect the trickier mechanics.

Features

- 15 vignettes spanning over 20 years

- Professional voice acting starring Rich Keeble (Clair Obscur: Expedition 33), Naomi MIller (Yes, Your Grace 2: Snowfall), Daniel Davis (Jobsworth Weekly) and Comedian Jacob Hawley

- 3 original tracks by my old classmate at school and very skilled musician, Lex Vervain

- Beautiful hand drawn art by my very talented friend, Erin Williams

games.name: Assetflip attorney
games.shortDescription: Assetflip attorney is a murder mystery satire visual novel, Solve crimes in a world where everyone has gone insane and everything feels like a fever dream, interrogate witnesses, hunt for clues and take down the criminal organization that threatens to destroy reality
games.aboutText:
The objective is simple, defend people being accused of murder and find the real killer... the only problem is everyone involved in these murder cases are completely insane and helping you solve the case is the last thing on their mind, on top of that there is an mysterious organization conducting all these killings behind the scenes who will stop at nothing to make your job a living hell so it is your mission to expose take down and expose this mystery!

The courtroom is a puzzle where you will be put to the test, analyse what the witnesses claim to have gone down on the night of the murder and prove them wrong , check your evidence and compare it with what there saying to see if there telling the truth, find contradictions and make objections to prove there lying!

The courtroom has a long dark conspiracy hidden within that you have unknowingly been trapped in, slowly descend down its layers of lore and escape, watch your back

- Four chapters. that amounts to 10+ hours of gameplay over the course of which the narrative gets increasingly more chaotic (also featuring a secret chapter)

- A huge cast of characters . all with unique personalities and interconnecting backstories but beware... not all of them survive

- The strongest character in fiction... Mr monkey

he co wrote the game but doesn't know grammar and the difference between his theres, theirs and they're's so blame him for the bad grammar

games.name: Teamcrafter
games.shortDescription: Gather resources, craft powerful gear, and build the perfect adventuring party in Teamcrafter, a cozy crafting roguelite where your heroes fight the battles, but you craft the victories. Explore serene procedural biomes, optimize your team’s build load out, and uncover the mystery of the Portals.
games.aboutText:
In Teamcrafter , you are not the warrior charging headfirst into danger. You are the Craftist - the builder who gives heroes what they need to win.

Gather rare resources, craft weapons, armour, accessories, and powerful equipment, then equip your Adventurers for the battles ahead. They may be the ones facing monsters beyond the Portals, but every victory starts at your workbench.

Explore a corrupted world, uncover the mystery behind the strange magical Portals, and prove that the true hero of the story is not always the one holding the sword.

Born from years of passion for crafting and inspired by the experience behind creating the FFXIV Teamcraft tool, Teamcrafter is a game for players who love preparation, optimization, and the quiet satisfaction of making the perfect tool for the job.

Venture through beautiful procedural biomes filled with forests, plains, caves, swamps, deserts, snowy mountains, magical places, and more. Take your time, breathe in the scenery, and gather what you need while living the peaceful life of a Craftist surrounded by nature.

Teamcrafter gives you the calm satisfaction of a cozy crafting game with the strategic depth of an ARPG. Gather resources at your own pace, then craft weapons, armour, accessories, and equipment that shape your Adventurers’ roles, strengthen their synergies, and prepare them for the challenges ahead. With more than 150 pieces of collectables , over 40 talents , and 50 passive items , every run gives you new ways to build the perfect team.

You are not just making gear - you are solving battles before they begin. Once your Adventurers are equipped, send them into automated turn-based battles and watch your preparation unfold. Study each fight, learn what worked, refine what failed, and return to the workbench with an even better plan.

The Portals made travel easier for everyone… but nobody truly understands how they work. As corruption spreads across the biomes, your journey as the village’s new Craftist will uncover secrets far bigger than a simple equipment order.

games.name: Magic Wands Workshop
games.shortDescription: A unique wand workshop simulator where you can create amazing combinations of wand elements and test their power! Immerse yourself in the world of magic and match wands to your demanding clients.
games.aboutText:
"Magic Wands Workshop" is an engaging wandmaker workshop simulator.

Relax as you create your unique masterpieces step by step. Start by selecting the right branch, refining it, adding a core, embellishments, and finishing with magical pattern rituals.

Purchase unique components: feathers, hairs, fangs, scales, and other elements from fantastic creatures.

Test your creations every time, ensuring the highest quality and beautiful appearance.

Match wands to your clients based on their personality traits, needs, and experience. Become the most renowned wand-making master in the entire magical world.

games.name: Palm Cracker
games.shortDescription: Delve into a gripping world of puzzles, true ciphers on an old PalmPilot system. Will you uncover the Crypt Killer’s confession and bring him to justice, or will he escape the law?
games.aboutText:
Uncover secrets hidden in a relic of the digital age.

You’ve acquired a mysterious PalmPilot from the notorious Crypt Killer, the smartest serial killer of the century. Somewhere in this device lies the key to unraveling his confession. But it won’t be easy. You’ll need to crack codes, solve cryptic riddles, and learn real-world decryption techniques in this immersive and challenging detective game.

Are you ready to unlock the truth?

From the creator of OS simulation titles like 128k, DISOWN95, After Hours, and Atom☭grad.

Features

- Authentic PalmPilot Simulation : Explore the quirks and charms of this iconic device, re-created with loving attention to detail.

- Puzzles with Depth : Engage with brain-teasing challenges that blend logic, intuition, and real cryptographic concepts.

- Retro Nostalgia : Relive the magic of 2000s tech, complete with classic games, vintage apps, and handwriting recognition. Prefer your keyboard? That works too!

What is the PalmPilot?

The PalmPilot was a revolutionary personal digital assistant (PDA) released in the late 1990s and early 2000s. Designed for managing contacts, calendars, and notes, it became a favorite of tech enthusiasts for its portability, handwriting recognition, and early mobile games. In many ways, it was the first glimpse at the modern smartphone—just without the phone.

I used to play with my dad’s PalmPilot all the time, and I recently found it in a storage unit. What do you know—after 20 years, it still had battery left! I turned it on and knew right away that I wanted to use it for a computer simulation. Palm Cracker is the result!

Is the game really free?

Yes! Palm Cracker is 100% free to play, own, and beat. There are no hidden fees or in-app purchases.

Wishlist now!

games.name: Inferno Cafe
games.shortDescription: A compact rom-com visual novel with roguelite elements — let yourself be devoured and forge bonds with the monster maids!
games.aboutText:
🍰 "I want to be devoured by the one I love" 🍰

Let monster maids "devour" you, and fall in love —

a short ADV with roguelite elements.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

◆ Monster Maids, Every One a Handful

Devils, werewolves, slimes, zombies, dolls, vampires —

wildly different species and personalities, each with her own troubles.

Rendered in pop-style art, it's a dark and cute romantic comedy.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

◆ The World of Inferno Cafe

The Demon World's No. 1 maid café chain, "Infelis", run by the Demon Lord CEO himself...

...and its lowest-selling location: "Branch 0."

An isolated facility where troublemaking maids serve out their penal posting.

Guide these girls toward the No. 1 spot in sales —

your strange new life in the Demon World begins.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

◆ The Maids of Branch 0

🩷 The Klutzy Devil Princess

Zatahnia

The Demon King's daughter — sky-high ambition, rock-bottom results.

Word is she got banished to Branch 0 for constantly causing catastrophic screwups.

The Rabid Wolf Girl

💜 Rachel

A werewolf with a strong sense of justice who can't help nearly killing troublesome Masters.

Too feral to play the maid, she was shipped off to Branch 0.

The Melty Slime Idol

💚 Gelatina

A corrosive slime maid who keeps throwing guerrilla idol concerts at the café.

Her bodily fluids go flying mid-performance, causing chaos every time — so she was banished to Branch 0.

💛 The Tongue-Tied Zombie Chef

Hibana

A shy, teary-eyed zombie who runs the kitchen.

Panic around new people sends her into an eating frenzy — devouring anything and everything — so she was banished to Branch 0.

🤍 The Doll in Love with Love

Simone

The assistant manager — a bisque doll with an unhealthy obsession with other people's love lives.

She collects couples' sweet nothings with a wireless bug hidden inside her own body — and was banished to Branch 0.

💙 The Mad Chemist Vampire

Virginia

A genius of food chemistry — and a vampire who, by some cruel twist, can't drink blood.

She put a drink that turns your whole body rainbow on the menu, and was banished to Branch 0.

🖤 The Manager Who Stans Her Staff

Belle

The branch manager — surrounded by her maids, she forgets she's their boss and starts acting like their customer instead. She calls them "my little stars."

After one branch too many, even she was banished to Branch 0.

A true education professional... when she bothers to show up.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

◆ To Get Closer, Let Them Eat You

You're a mysterious cake that grants small wishes to whoever eats you.

Let the maids "devour" you, and they'll grow — and so will their affection.

Bake yourself sweeter for the one you're falling for —

she's bound to notice...

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

◆ But If the Café Goes Under, There's No Tomorrow

To keep spending your days with them, the café has to survive first.

Raise your maids to hit the sales Quota while building affection along the way.

Balancing both is the core cycle of the game.

- Raise your maids and hit the sales Quota!

- Choose ingredients and items to earn affection and stats!

- Once a day, feed yourself to a maid with EAT ME for a big growth boost!

- Keep the café alive AND win her heart! Go for both the Quota and her personal ending!

How you combine a limited hand is the key to winning.

The smarter your combos, the more the maids grow ― and the closer you'll get to them.

Every run reveals a new side of the maids —

a character game you'll love more the more you play.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

◆ Streaming & Content Creation

Streaming and making videos of Inferno Cafe is welcome — please include a link to this store page in your video or stream description.

Monetization is totally fine!

Note: Game content is subject to change without notice.

games.name: Rogue Worlds
games.shortDescription: Rogue Worlds is a chaotic tactical roguelite platformer where you wield the environment and creative abilities to overcome challenges. Outwit powerful guardians and blast, dash, grapple, fight, and charm your way through ever-changing labyrinths! This is the Lite edition of Aura of Worlds.
games.aboutText:
Rogue Worlds is a roguelite platformer where you use the environment and creative abilities to overcome challenges. You'll need planning, wits and reflexes to make a way through these ever-changing death labyrinths.

The game provides a free (lite) edition of Aura of Worlds, with a shorter campaign and shared progress ( A " Demo" in a way ) .

Explore strange biomes, escape flooding poison, outwit gargantuan bosses. Do you play defensively with a repeater and energy shield, or swing into the fray with a boomerang and grapple hook? Do you scour the levels for potions and runes; or dive headfirst into the chaos?
Along the way, unlock starting gear options, shortcuts, character perks, pets, and more. The friends you rescue on your journey will help you. Each procedurally generated run presents new hazards, layouts, and tactical decisions. You can further customize your build with runes, and gear modifiers that synergize in a myriad of ways. Veterans can push their limits by disabling perks or cranking up the difficulty for greater challenges—and greater rewards.

Features

- Diverse Level Themes : Tidal corridors lined with mines, flickering lights in underground ruins, rising lava pits, and carnivorous gardens. Each environment brings unique dangers and opportunities.

- Creative Abilities : Master parkour, cloak from enemies, or even enthrall foes to fight on your side.

- Multi-Use Objects: Light your way with a lantern—or throw it as an improvised flaming Molotov.

- Challenging Boss Fights: Outsmart colossal adversaries by using both your reflexes and the environment to your advantage.

- Handcrafted Pixel Art & Animations: Beautifully detailed pixel visuals bring the world to life.

- Unique Musical Score: An immersive soundtrack that evolves with your adventure.

- Permanent Progression : Unlock new items, character backgrounds, and more to customize your journey.

And much more awaits…

Rogue Worlds is the free (lite) edition of Aura of Worlds ( A " Demo" in a way ), with a shorter campaign and shared progress.

games.name: Kero Quest 64
games.shortDescription: Kero Quest 64 is a Collectathon 3D Platformer inspired by other games in the genre, especially those from the late 90s. You take control of Kero, a blue frog seeking to stop a prince from spreading evil Shards across the Kingdom of Bunnabaria!
games.aboutText:
Overview

Kero Quest 64 is a Collectathon 3D Platformer inspired by other games in the genre, especially those from the late 90s.

You take control of Kero, a blue frog seeking to stop a prince from spreading evil Shards across the Kingdom of Bunnabaria !

A Big World

In this game, you must find your way through 20+ Open Levels , each with its own Retro 3D aesthetic.

On your quest to gain Shards , you will collect various things such as Gold Coins and Costumes for Kero to wear!

Features

- Simple controls with some advanced movement options.

- Simple, light-hearted story that can be enjoyed by anyone.

- Retro graphics inspired by the late 90s.

- Over 20 levels to explore.

- A variety of things to collect in every level.

- Optional content such as Costumes to unlock.

games.name: Retro Endurance 8bit
games.shortDescription: Created by zsKnight of ZSNES is this really neat retro game collection containing a fun shuffler story mode and a challenging arcade mode. Features 52 different 8bit style games which includes local competitive multiplayer and various different game modes to play and enjoy.
games.aboutText:
"That game is called Retro Endurance 8bit. It's on Steam... I think you should give it a look. I think it's really neat. It's really neat."

- Jeff Gerstmann (former editorial director of Gamespot, co-founder of Giant Bomb)

About Retro Endurance 8-bit:

Retro Endurance is a really neat one-of-a-kind retro game collection with an exciting and fun shuffler story mode featuring 52 different classic 8bit style retro games. Many of these games can be unlocked and played as standalone full arcade games.

Features:

- Rapid-Fire Shuffler Mode: Play lightning-fast mini-games, with a unique and fun shuffler/randomizer style story mode with 52 different games in its collection!

- Arcade Mode: Unlock and play challenging full length arcade games, each with its own pixel designed cabinet, multiple custom music jingles, and curated stages. No save states or continues here, just pure skill! Currently includes 20 full length arcade games.

- Diverse Game Genres: Features a variety of game genres, ensuring there’s something for everyone.

- Classic 8bit Feels : All games utilize the classic NES palette with music composed using FamiStudio to get that classic 8bit feel.

- Multiplayer Fun: Compete in split-screen local competitive multiplayer mode

- Daily Challenges: Perform and climb the high-score leaderboard with a new challenge each day.

- Speed Run Mode : Play against the time as you accumulate score as fast as you possibly can. (Unlocks at level 15 in shuffler mode.)

- Insane Mode : This mode is insane! In a single game session, you are likely to play almost every single game in this collection. (Unlocks at level 30 in shuffler mode.)

- Unique shuffle boss battles : Battle the boss while switching between different game genres until you completely deplete its hit points.

- Special Gameplay Events ; As you beat bosses in shuffler mode, you unlock special gameplay events which occasionally appears and changes how you play the game.

- Accessibility Options: Customize your gameplay experience by customizing the difficulty.

About the Shuffler/Randomizer Mode:

The Shuffler/Randomizer Mode plays with a board game like progression. It picks a few randomly chosen games and each game plays for 3 rounds with the 3rd round playing at a faster speed. The main goal of Shuffler Mode is to get as high of a cumulative score as possible between the chosen games. The games are all designed to work well within this mode by keeping the controls and game mechanics simple, yet still be engaging and fun.

The Games:

Retro Endurance 8bit features many games based on favorite classic 8bit games. Games based on popular genres such as platformers, puzzles, brawler, racing, RPG, and much much more! No two games play alike and they are all designed to be fun as possible.

Currently, there are 52 games in Shuffler Mode and 20 full arcade games in Arcade Mode with more being added as the game is updated. New games are first added to Shuffler mode, then eventually added to Arcade Mode as full multi-stage arcade games.

About the game:

- Solo developed game. Designed, coded, drawn, and composed by zsKnight of ZSNES.

- Random generation algorithms in nearly all games so they will feel different each time you play them.

- More games will be added and included free in future updates.

- Many secrets and easter eggs to be discovered!

games.name: Destiny Code
games.shortDescription: Beautiful girls and thrilling card battles, all in one RPG! As factions clash over the relics of a lost civilization, the fate of the world — and your companions — hangs on your choices. A dramatic tale where your strategy and decisions shape destiny!
games.aboutText:
Spend your school life with beautiful, unforgettable heroines!

Hart Grancer, a former mercenary turned agent of the Ancient Prehistoric Civilization Central Intelligence Executive Agency (A.C.E.), has infiltrated the Academy, a school run by the very agency he serves.

But what seemed like a simple assignment at first — coaching a group of girls, each with their own mysterious reason for being there, and handling miscellaneous tasks from the A.C.E. — quickly turns into something far more dangerous than anticipated, as Hart is tasked with recovering a Grimforge — an ancient artifact at the heart of a massive conspiracy.

Birthday: October 12. Height: 156 cm (5'1"). Weapon: Darts and rapier. Hometown: District 7, Moomoo.

Cheerful by nature and a lover of all things pretty, Akina is a perfectly ordinary girl. Despite her hard work, she can't help but feel overshadowed as she is often surrounded by people with extraordinary talents. There's nothing particularly remarkable about her — except for her surprisingly large breasts.

Birthday: August 15. Height: 156 cm (5'1"). Weapon: Gun and sword. Hometown: Imperial City of Invoa.

The third daughter of a former noble family — as her constant, unprompted quoting of her family mottoes often reminds everyone — Elise is the very picture of haughtiness and pride. Yet despite her airs of superiority, she doesn't handle pressure or criticism well, and a little flattery is often all it takes to wrap her around your finger. Contrary to what one might expect from a well-bred lady, she has a soft spot for all things flashy and sparkling.

Birthday: February 4. Height: 141 cm (4'7"). Weapon: Yoyo. Hometown: District 212, Tajine.

Lively and full of energy, Ling has a small frame and a playful, childlike personality. However, she's actually the oldest member of the group and naturally slips into the role of a caring big sister. Headpats are her weakness, and her quirk is slapping stickers on people, marking them as approved.

Birthday: March 3. Height: 151 cm (4'11"). Weapon: None. Hometown: District 351, Caldoverde.

Shy and quiet by nature, Alesha is more likely to be found tucked away in a corner with a book than engaging in small talk with coworkers or friends. Her reserved temperament shows through in her difficulty with social interactions, and she's utterly hopeless in crowded settings.
Although she's the type who looks slim in clothes, Alesha is actually quite well-endowed.

Birthday: May 3. Height: 141 cm (4'7"). Weapon: Railgun blade. Birthplace: Unknown.

Often seemingly lost in her own world and hard to read, Selene is actually full of passion and a little clingy beneath the surface. Animals are naturally drawn to her, and she cherishes them just as much. Petite in build, she's surprisingly fit and toned.

Birthday: January 18. Height: 158 cm (5'2"). Weapon: Stun rods and heavy pistols. Hometown: District 81, Yamato.

The honor student heroine. Gifted with brains and beauty, her academic prowess and perfect figure have earned her the admiration of her classmates — both men and women. Although serious on the outside, Saki indulges in small pleasures, like secretly writing romance light novels, a hobby she hasn't shared with anyone.

Fragments scattered across the world stand as silent witnesses to the pain of a forgotten age.
Each time our heroines reach for them, they find themselves caught between what once was and what is yet to come.
Within the flow of their ordinary days, desires take root, compelling them to make their choices that will shape their fate.
Thus begins our story, shaped equally from their sins and their prayers.

Hart Grancer, a former mercenary turned agent of the Ancient Prehistoric Civilization Central Intelligence Executive Agency (A.C.E.), has infiltrated the Academy, a school run by the very agency he serves.

But what seemed like a simple assignment at first — coaching a group of girls, each with their own mysterious reason for being there, and handling miscellaneous tasks from the A.C.E. — quickly turns into something far more dangerous than anticipated, as Hart is tasked with recovering a Grimforge — an ancient artifact at the heart of a massive conspiracy.

Amid the rush of their busy days, brief moments of calm appear. In these quiet moments, subtle gestures and fleeting smiles come to light. It is here that the distance between you and the heroines narrows — a small promise of a future yet to be written.

Play the cards that reflect the heroines' personalities and skills, and claim victory in every battle!

Your actions in battle add new cards to your hand.
Will you play your best move now, or save it for the battles ahead?
Every fight is a chance to build your deck!

Equip your characters with artifacts to compensate for their weaknesses or enhance their strengths — the choice is entirely in your hands!
Make your favorite heroine as powerful as possible!

You can also synthesize artifacts to create new ones that inherit the abilitie

games.name: Ropuka's Idle Island
games.shortDescription: A cozy idle game that sits anywhere on your desktop. Watch the frog cut grass, upgrade his tools, and decorate the island while you work or relax.
games.aboutText:
Ropuka's Idle Island is a playable sticker for your desktop. Put it anywhere on your screen and focus on work or fun while the little frog tends to his garden.

Cut grass

While not sleeping, Ropuka is always cutting grass. Use it as a currency to upgrade his tools, improve the grass' quality or spend it decorating the island.

Decorate

Unlock new buildings and plants to create your own unique island. Can you get every item and complete the collection?

Co-working buddy

Ropuka's Idle Island is the perfect game for multitasking. Put it anywhere you want on the screen, resize to take as little or as much space as you want, and the little frog buddy will always be with you when you work, play games, or relax.

Lofi and ambient music modes

If you need help focusing, Ropuka's Idle Island includes a custom-made lofi track and ambient sounds of nature. Mix and match the audio sources or play in silence to create the perfect workspace.

games.name: Cross The Boundaries
games.shortDescription: This is a Touhou Fangame. Maribel Hearn is a girl with unusual experience with ghosts and supernatural beings. In Cross The Boundaries, you will solve riddles while trying to stay alive, and looking for a way out of the nightmare.
games.aboutText:
Maribel Hearn is a girl with unusual experience with ghosts and supernatural beings. However, one night she meets a strange woman who turns her life upside down. In Cross The Boundaries you will solve puzzles while trying to stay alive, looking for an answer to what the strange woman desires. Explore the dreamworld and learn about the forgotten fantasy of the modern world, but beware of it's dangers.

Cross the Boundaries is a puzzle and exploration game with horror elements and Visual Novel-like story telling. You will explore different stages, pick up items, and solve puzzles to advance. While progressing the game you will learn more about the characters, their fears and hopes.

This is a Touhou Fangame but no prior knowledge of the franchise is needed to enjoy it.

Features

- Unique-looking monsters.

- Interesting puzzles to solve.

- Explore eerie dream worlds.

- Deep Story.

Main Characters

Known as Merry by her friends, she is a psychology major with a big interest in myths, legends and the supernatural. Merry is shy and often doesn't speak with other people unless they are close to her. However, she has a big secret, since she was a child Merry has seen supernatural beings like ghosts and monsters.

Renko is a physics major who paradoxically is interested in supernatural phenomena. She is very smart and outgoing, Renko is the president of the occult club in university. She are Merry are the only members of said club, and often have club activities searching for supernatural phenomena, in a world that has already forgotten about it.

Translated as "the gap woman", is a urban legend that stalks people from places too narrow for a person to fit inside. However, there is something more to this strange woman. She is heavily interested in Merry, and since her first appearance, Merry has been having strange nightmares.

Disclaimer

- This game is a derivative work of Touhou Project created by Team Shanghai Alice.

- This game complies with the guidelines for releasing Touhou doujin games on Steam.

games.name: Hell of a Birthday
games.shortDescription: IT’S YOUR BIRTHDAY!!! and nobody came to celebrate with you… Hell of a Birthday is a First-Person comedic horror game where you play as the Birthday Boy trying to survive your special day. From the maker of Bite Night and Invasion of the Halloween Fiends comes another unique adventure.
games.aboutText:
IT’S YOUR BIRTHDAY!!! and nobody came to celebrate with you… Hell of a Birthday is a First-Person comedic horror game where you play as the Birthday Boy trying to survive your special day. Weird stuff starts happening around the house and you begin to realize that maybe it really was better off being alone on your birthday. From the maker of Bite Night and Invasion of the Halloween Fiends comes another unique adventure.

Key Features

- First Person

- Blend of Horror Comedy

- Retro Graphics

- Approx: 45 min - 1 Hour Playing Time

games.name: Shattered Divinities
games.shortDescription: Begin your adventure in Shattered Divinities to reveal the truth! Traverse the land where deities have perished, explore abandoned divine realms, battle mutated monsters, gather divine power to awaken your strength, and unveil the truth behind the deities’ fall.
games.aboutText:
The Divine War has ruined the world. Mutated creatures roam the land and through frozen time, while the remaining lives struggle to survive on the edge of oblivion and despair. The secrets of the deities before their fall lie buried beneath the broken temple, the stagnant current of time, and endless ruins.

Shattered Divinities is a 2D pixel-style Metroidvania action-adventure game. You play as a warrior awakened amid the ruins, braving perils such as the tainted Land, the lightless abyss, and the formidable stairways. Challenge powerful foes that stand in your way, claim the powers left behind by the fallen deities, and uncover the forgotten truth.

Nine broken lands with different styles and over a hundred intricate maps.

Amid those sacred divine realms now roam 20 powerful bosses corrupted by divine power, as well as creatures of various shapes.

The bloodstains left by the Guide, the notes of the Researcher, the unfulfilled duty of the Gatekeeper… their meaning will be retrieved with your blade.

Gather divine marks and reach your full strength with their might.

Dodge attacks with [Phase Step], nimbly maneuver with [Ethereal Step], counter foes with impenetrable defense via [Bulwark], strike your enemies like a rainstorm with [Assault], and summon creatures to aid you with [Invocation].

Strengthen your marks. Use the moves and combinations derived from the five marks to forge the build that suits you best!

And harness mighty divine possession to become unstoppable in battle!

You must keep exploring this land to gain more powerful abilities. Once you can wield these abilities flexibly, you may become a new god!

The ability shards scattered across the land hold immense power capable of turning the tide of any battle.

Harness the abilities of the deities, and you may freely forge a unique combat style and craft your very own exclusive combos!

Whether you seek reckless devastation that trades damage for victory, dance on the blade’s edge to whittle away enemies with precise techniques, or unleash an unending storm of high-speed strikes to suppress all who dare approach—every choice is yours to make.

As the final drop of divine blood drips from your blade,

will you accept redemption,

or ignite the flame that belongs to all mortals?

games.name: The Regreening
games.shortDescription: Restore a deserted world in a cozy soilpunk simulation. Grow plants, rebuild wildlife habitats, and revive entire ecosystems. Upcycle abandoned junk into tools and decorations, befriend ancient nature spirits, and hug ALL the animals as you transform a forgotten world into a thriving paradise.
games.aboutText:
Restore the world with your hands, your heart, and just a touch of magic. Watch seeds turn into trees and the desert turn into a green oasis. Feel the change as it happens: warm breezes ripple through freshly sprouted meadows, frogs return to singing wetlands, and it finally rains.

- Plant & Cultivate: Discover new seeds, choose which animal habitats to restore, learn powerful plant synergies, and create beautiful living biomes according to your vision.

- Recycle & Craft: Clean up old junk to collect crafting materials and upcycle them into beautiful decorations for your home, or powerful watering systems for your plants.

- Befriend Folklore Spirits: Meet mythical nature spirits willing to give you mighty abilities in exchange for your help (and maybe a few shiny objects.)

- Enjoy the Fruits of Your Care: Harvest flowers and berries to plant in new areas or to give as gifts to your favourite animals and friends.

- Restore at Your Own Pace : No timers, no pressure

- Feel your impact: Help animals return and nature recover.

- Rich atmosphere: with an adaptive soundtrack and soothing nature sounds that changes as you restore the world

- A Soilpunk Fairytale: Discover a world inspired by nature, sustainability, and folklore.

games.name: Dark Gun
games.shortDescription: Dark Gun is a modern roguelite survivor where guns clash with dark magic. Survive endless waves, build unstoppable power, and fight the abyss in stylish, fast-paced chaos.
games.aboutText:
🌌 Step Into the Abyss

Dark Gun is not just another survivor game. It’s a modern roguelite bullet hell where sleek gunplay collides with ancient darkness. One gun. Endless waves. Infinite ways to grow stronger.

The rules are simple: survive, upgrade, and dominate.
The challenge? The night never ends.

⚔️ Features That Hook You Instantly

- Survivor Action, Reinvented – Pure adrenaline wave survival with the modern edge of tactical gunplay.

- Guns Meet Dark Magic – Unlock assault rifles, shotguns, cursed pistols, and weapons infused with forbidden power.

- Endless Enemy Waves – Fight skeletal hordes, armored knights, and nightmare bosses. The longer you last, the deadlier they become.

- Roguelite Growth – Every run gives new skills, perks, and weapon synergies. Find broken builds, experiment, and outlast the darkness.

- Easy to Pick Up, Impossible to Quit – 10-minute bursts of action that can turn into hours of “just one more run.”

🎮 What Makes Dark Gun Different?

Where other survivor games stop at gimmicks, Dark Gun delivers polished modern graphics, stylish design, and commercial-scale intensity.
It’s built to be the Counter-Strike 2 of survivor roguelites — crisp, modern, instantly viral.

🔥 Built For Millions

Fans of Vampire Survivors, Brotato, and Halls of Torment will feel at home — but with a darker, sharper edge.
If you crave the rush of mowing down hundreds of enemies with guns that glow with forbidden magic , this is the game you’ve been waiting for.

🚀 The Call To Action

Eternal night has fallen. The abyss is watching.
Lock, load, and survive.

✅ Add Dark Gun to your Wishlist now — be there on Day 1.

games.name: Garden Ink
games.shortDescription: Paint, combine and discover! Garden Ink is a cozy sandbox game. Combine decorations and use painting tools to customize your world. With hand-painted graphics and a relaxing soundtrack, it’s time to discover every cute surprise.
games.aboutText:
A BLANK CANVAS

You begin in an empty world, and it’s up to you to fill it with life.

Discover adorable creatures and other surprises as you breathe life into your growing garden.

MERGE & CREATE

Find over 150 combinations to shape your garden.

Many combinations don’t just look great, but also come with little secrets :)

COLOR YOUR WORLD

The world is your personal coloring book.

Unlock new palettes and color everything to make the garden truly feel like your own.

PLAY & DISCOVER

Charming minigames and hidden secrets are scattered throughout the game.

Play minigames and solve little puzzles to unlock new colors, decorations, and minigames.

ENJOY

Let the gentle music, playful sounds, and peaceful atmosphere invite you to stay a while.

Garden Ink is a cozy world made for slowing down and simply enjoying the moment.

games.name: Firework War
games.shortDescription: Use a variety of fireworks to fend off misfortune and protect your family!
games.aboutText:
During the Spring Festival, light up fireworks to drive away the Badluck Entities !

Firework War combines the traditional custom of lighting fireworks with the strategy of tower defense, delivering a fresh and exciting experience.

Classic fireworks like the Rainbow Fountain, Flash Shooter, Fire Wheel, Golden Basin, and Firecrackers take center stage in the game. Your task is to ignite these fireworks, unleash their dazzling effects, and fend off malevolent spirits to protect your home.

As you light up the sky, you'll also rack up plenty of joy value . Use it to buy more fireworks and keep the fun going! Immerse yourself in this unique taste of Chinese New Year tradition!

games.name: Prize Denied
games.shortDescription: Prize Denied! In this cozy-evil claw machine roguelike, assemble rigged setups and play shady cards to stop customers from ever winning! Discover quirky combos to trap them in an endless addiction loop, draining their pockets dry until they finally win… or go completely broke!
games.aboutText:
The previous owners were too nice to the customers, so they got kicked out. Now, it's your turn to run the arcade.

Make your customers addicted! Maximize their addiction score to keep them playing, and drain their wallets until you hit your daily income goal.

Build the perfect trap. Pack your machine with prizes and obstacles to create satisfying combos that skyrocket addiction, while making it impossible for them to actually win.

Play rigged cards to sabotage the machine and increase their addiction. But be careful, blatant cheating drains their Trust. If you get caught, they will leave immediately!

- 50+ unlockable prizes and obstacles to rig your machine.

- 50+ shady cards to manipulate the claw and the score.

- 20+ Boss Customers to scam, each with unique abilities.

- 5 distinct Arcades featuring different machines and cards

- 7 Days of escalating difficulty to survive in each arcade.

games.name: I Have No Change
games.shortDescription: “I Have No Change” is a first-person narrative game that immerses players in the atmosphere of a night kiosk filled with stories, melancholia, and the reflections of residents from Russia’s regions.
games.aboutText:
Winter. New Year's Eve. A night kiosk.

This is where 27-year-old Matvey works, serving all kinds of customers — from familiar faces to wandering strangers.
On the other side of the kiosk’s window, their stories unfold: about good and bad, life and death, how Vitya cheated on Masha, and how the building on Stroiteley Street is once again without hot water.

During these festive nights, alone with his thoughts, Matvey keeps asking himself:
How did he end up in this kiosk? Did he ever dream of such a life? Is he ready for change?

Let’s step into Matvey’s world and see how a vast universe fits within this small kiosk.

“I Have No Change” — a first-person narrative-driven game that combines:

- A grounded, slice-of-life dramatic narrative

A quiet, personal story that lingers long after it ends, touching on stagnation, lost dreams, and fragile hopes;

- Premium visual presentation

Realistic visuals with a strong focus on detail and colour, deepening the sense of place and narrative immersion;

- Expressive characters

Brought to life by real actors. Most of them have their own story – warm, melancholic, or quietly reflective;

- Thematic soundtrack

Music and songs by local artists enhance the emotional connection to the story and shape the atmosphere of each scene.

games.name: 追曙
games.shortDescription: Officer Yang Fan receives a distorted radio distress call during his shift.The signal traces back to an abandoned apartment building—one linked to the records of a young girl's suicide years prior. As his investigation unfolds, he uncovers a dark secret buried so deep,no one dares speak of it.
games.aboutText:
追曙ZhuiShu is a horror narrative puzzle game set in Southeast Asia, weaving together elements of traditional Chinese folklore.

A buried death. Two interwoven fates.

Story Synopsis

Yang Fan, a righteous police officer, receives a cryptic radio distress call during his night shift: "...the mountains...save the children..." The signal originates from an abandoned apartment building - official records show it was the site of a young girl's suicide years ago.

Jiang Yufei, an ordinary teacher, gets drawn into the mystery after her student's inexplicable death. Each clue she uncovers pulls her deeper into a dangerous truth no one dares confront.

When their fates intersect across time, they must confront a cruel truth—death is not the end, but the beginning of a greater conspiracy.

Gameplay

Light puzzle-solving seamlessly woven into the narrative flow creates an immersive experience that propels the story forward naturally.

Explore meticulously crafted environments to gather clues and items, unraveling hidden truths through intuitive puzzle-solving that progresses organically with the plot.

Key Features

- Dual Narrative : Alternate between detective Yang Fan and teacher Jiang Yufei to uncover a deliberately erased past

- Psychological Horror : Oppressive environments, eerie whispers and fragmented clues slowly reveal a suffocating truth

- True-Crime Inspired : Drawing from real cases, the game blends Eastern cultural elements with profound themes of fate, choice and human nature beneath its terrifying surface

ZhuiShu , meaning "Chasing Dawn" in Chinese, symbolizes the relentless pursuit of light and hope amidst overwhelming darkness. It embodies the journey of uncovering hidden truths, facing inner fears, and striving for clarity in a world shrouded in mystery.

games.name: Cinema Theater Tycoon
games.shortDescription: Tycoon game where you manage your movie theater through more than 100 years of history. Build and customize your cinematic empire without being overtaken by the evolution of the 7th art.
games.aboutText:
Cinema is your empire

Start your journey in 1906 in Paris, just after the first screenings by the Lumière brothers, and thrive for more than 100 years of cinematic evolution. Whether managing a small independent cinema or the world's most prestigious theater, every decision you make will shape the future of your business.

Design the cinema of your dreams

In Cinema Theater Tycoon, customization is at the heart of your success. Build and modify every aspect of your cinemas, from floor to ceiling, with hundreds of items. Create unique screening rooms, upgrade your equipment, and choose every detail with precision.

A journey through 100 years of movie magic

Relive the key moments in cinema history. From silent films to modern blockbusters, each era is represented with its movies, technologies, and trends. Cult classics, world premieres, and seasonal events will bring your cinema to life across the decades. Host premieres, masterclasses, and film clubs to attract stars and moviegoers.

Manage, optimize, expand

Manage every aspect of your cinema, from programming to staff, ticket and popcorn prices, and ensure your theaters are always ready for the next big premiere. Send your film buyers across the globe to find THE perfect movie.

games.name: Bloodfly Keeper
games.shortDescription: Breed unruly bloodflies, craft forbidden cures, and rise from outcast to underground healer in a city ruled by a corrupt medical regime.
games.aboutText:
Bloodflies are large, volatile and aggressive insects known for building pulsating nests and producing a resin formed around their egg.

BREED THE SWARM (ALONE OR WITH FRIENDS)

You are a former biologist, erased by a corrupt medical regime. You call yourself a Bloodfly Keeper because you dare to breed these dangerous colonies inside the city walls. Whether alone or with a team of up to 4 keepers , you must manage their hunger, experiment with blood types, and extract their raw resin without getting devoured.

MANUFACTURE CURES

From a hidden workshop, process the raw extract into stable compounds. Refine your production lines to create vials, balms, and supply desperate clients while staying out of sight of the authorities.

EXPAND YOUR EMPIRE

Move your operation into new districts, from freezing cellars to industrial facilities. Upgrade your equipment and rise from a forgotten scientist to the city’s most vital underground healer.

games.name: Fairy Love Story
games.shortDescription: Fairy Love Story is an Eastern fantasy puzzle adventure blending spot-the-difference gameplay with a multi-character story. Play as a young Taoist in a world where humans and demons coexist. Meet mysterious girls, uncover hidden secrets, and shape their fate through your choices.
games.aboutText:
Game Introduction

Fairy Love Story is an Eastern fantasy puzzle adventure that combines spot-the-difference gameplay with a multi-character story.

You play as a young Taoist traveling through a world where humans and demons coexist. Along the way, you will encounter girls with unique personalities through strange stories filled with ambiguity, danger, and temptation, gradually uncovering the secrets hidden behind them.

Observe subtle differences in each scene, discover hidden clues, and advance the story.

Every choice you make will also affect the relationships between the characters and ultimately determine the ending.

Will you exorcise the demons and protect humanity, or walk alongside them?

The answer to your destiny is yours to decide.

Character Introduction

🐍 The Green and White Snake Sisters

Two snake sisters who approach you near West Lake.

On a quiet bridge in the rain, a fateful encounter quietly unfolds.

Beneath a traditional paper umbrella, a strangely familiar scene gradually emerges in your mind…

🧟‍♀️ The Zombie Girl

A mysterious zombie girl slowly approaches you in a chaotic graveyard.

The scars covering her body seem to silently tell the tragic story of her past.

🦋 The Butterfly Demon

A girl named “Yingtai,” whom you happen to meet in a garden.

She is desperately searching for her lost memories—and the person she has spent her entire life seeking.

🐱 The Cat Demon

A cat demon girl who suddenly appears in your room late at night.

Under the moonlight, her glimmering eyes quietly gaze at you.

🧝‍♀️ The Demon Tamer Girl

A girl in traditional attire whom you encounter in another world.

Meeting her may be the key to uncovering the truth behind the mysterious “Demon Tamers.”

Game Features

● 30+ beautifully animated CGs

● Unique and extensive CG interaction features

● A variety of soothing and memorable BGM tracks

● 20 different branching endings

games.name: Typewriter Monkeys
games.shortDescription: Infinite monkeys with infinite typewriters will eventually write Shakespeare... right? Find out in this cozy automation idler! Strategically place different kinds of monkeys with typewriters then level them up as you type longer and longer words!
games.aboutText:
Infinite monkeys with infinite typewriters will eventually write Shakespeare... right? Find out in this cozy automation idler! Strategically place different kinds of monkeys with typewriters then level them up as you type longer and longer words!

SMASH THAT KEYBOARD

Place a typewriter next to a monkey so they can start using it! They'll just press random letters but eventually they're bound to stumble across a real word...

SELF-PUBLISHED AUTHOR

Earn money for each word you type, then use the money to upgrade your monkeys! Buy more monkeys and more typewriters so you can expand your literary horizons!

TO THINE OWN MONKEY BE TRUE

Upgrade your monkeys enough to eventually write the works of Shakespeare!

Featuring:

- Multiple species of monkeys and apes!

- Plenty of upgrades!

- Strategic monkey placement!

- Endless replayability!

- Idle elements, the monkeys keep typing while you sleep!

games.name: Dinoblade
games.shortDescription: Dinoblade is an intense action RPG set in a prehistoric world forever changed by a cataclysmic event. Step into the role of a young Spinosaurus, wielding a colossal Great Sword. Confront rival dinosaurs, some armed with weapons of their own, all in a desperate fight to prevent a looming extinction.
games.aboutText:
Dinoblade is an intense action RPG set in a prehistoric world forever changed by a cataclysmic event, one that redefined the very nature of Dinosaurs. Step into the role of a young Spinosaurus, wielding a colossal Great Sword forged from ancient power. Confront rival dinosaurs, some armed with brutal weapons of their own, all in a desperate fight to prevent a looming extinction.

Venture across a sprawling world filled with awe-inspiring biomes, from dry canyons to dense, mist-shrouded jungles. Each region is ruled by a ferocious Alpha, an apex predator who guards the path forward. Defeat them, or be devoured.

Every victory unlocks strength. Master new skills, unleash devastating abilities, and forge your own combat style. Chain together powerful combos, time your dodges, rolls, and parries, and discover legendary weapons hidden across the lands.

At the heart of this savage world lies a mystery — one that could save your species, or doom them forever. Rise as a Legend, conquer the wilds, and decide the fate of your home.

Become the blade and rewrite history before your world is lost to the shadow of extinction.

- Conquer the Challenge: Defeat the final boss to unlock the ultimate Boss Rush Mode

games.name: Songs of the Shore
games.shortDescription: Explore a mysterious island full of musical shells and secrets to discover in this point-and-click 3D collectathon. Immerse yourself in an ambient and serene soundtrack which is remixed as you collect more shells.
games.aboutText:
Songs of the Shore is a point-and-click, 3D, immersive Adventure-Collectathon! Collect sea shells and solve puzzles to discover the secrets of the island.

Explore a mysterious island full of musical shells and secrets to discover. Immerse yourself in an ambient and serene soundtrack which is remixed as you collect more shells.

games.name: 叛逆の守護者
games.shortDescription: A classic war-chronicle fantasy SRPG set on the continent of Falnea, where beings known as “Guardians” wield power beyond mortals. Lead Arzes—the son of a Guardian—against the Ruzeroa Empire’s bid for unification and the shadowy forces stoking the war.
games.aboutText:
A grand fantasy SRPG where weighty storytelling meets razor-sharp tactics.

On the land of Falnea, blessed by the Goddess Shufarnias, a new war chronicle begins.

Long ago, the Dark God and its monstrous vassals ravaged the world, pushing humankind to the brink. The goddess bestowed divine power upon three heroes—the Guardians—who sealed the Dark God and restored peace.

Ages passed. As technology and magic advanced, the Guardians faded from memory.

Then, a sudden imperial regicide. In retaliation, the Ruzeroa Empire marches, wielding the long-lost power of the Guardians alongside modern engines of war, igniting a brutal campaign to unite the continent.

And in that maelstrom… the story of Arzes, a young mercenary captain, begins.

Justice vs. loyalty. Freedom vs. nation. A bitter rift with his father.

The path he chooses will shake Falnea’s future to its core.

Think. Command. Overcome.

You are the field tactician. Issue orders each turn and clear diverse objectives.

- Win in many ways: Defeat the enemy commander, Seize strongholds, Escape , Escort , and more.

- Make the map your weapon: Exploit terrain and unit traits to outmaneuver superior forces.

50+ Allies, One Interwoven War Drama

- Recruit your rivals: Foes can join you if conditions are met.

- Bond through Support: Discover surprising pasts and convictions through character supports.

- Clashing ambitions: Faction agendas collide in a heated ensemble narrative.

Deep Battles, Satisfying Growth

- Capture & Collect: Seize enemy weapons with a unique Capture system.

- Build your way: Learn skills and Class Change for flexible growth paths.

- Forge the best: Weapon Fusion and upgrades craft your ultimate loadouts.

Play Your Way with Multiple Modes

- Musou Mode: Power-level and mow through foes for cathartic fun.

- Casual Mode: No permanent death—perfect for newcomers.

- Normal / Hard: Classic tension where losses carry weight.

- Lunatic / Abyss: Post-clear, punishing challenges for veterans.

Endgame & Extras

- Optional superbosses: High-stat elites prowl beyond chapter bosses.

- Rare hunts: Track rare monsters and rare drops for collectors.

- True Ending: Master the story to unlock the path beyond.

- New Game+ rewards : Exclusive characters and post-game Extra Maps await.

A Massive Campaign

- 70+ hours for a single run—an epic war chronicle built to satisfy.

- 50+ main chapters plus dedicated training skirmishes.

- Replay bonuses keep the experience fresh across multiple playthroughs.

Should the game receive strong support, we’re open to localizing not only the UI but also the full story and additional content into English.

games.name: Withering Realms
games.shortDescription: A ghost and her doll guardian explore the mysterious town of Penwyll and the sprawling graveyards, tombs, caves and rotting estates that surround it in this Horror Action RPG from the solo developer of Withering Rooms.
games.aboutText:
It is 1926, ten years after an immense “occult event” halted the Great War and transformed the world overnight. The dead walk, spirits roam, and a gifted few can even cast spells.

9-year-old Clover awakens alone in a decaying mansion just miles from the epicenter of the occult event, and soon discovers that she is a ghost.

Her only companion is a strange and powerful doll constructed from wood, metal, and human remains.

In this Horror Action RPG from the creator of Withering Rooms , join Clover and her doll guardian as they explore the mysterious town of Penwyll and the sprawling graveyards that surround it, seeking a way to bring her back to life.

- Descend into tombs, caves and rotting estates in search of treasure, upgrade materials and magical artifacts

- Craft weapons and machines to slot into the doll’s missing right arm like the Enchanted Candelabrum, Chain Rock, Machinegun, or Flamethrower

- Expand the world map by defeating massive perimeter guardians

- Make allies such as the daring freelance investigator Althea who will do anything to uncover Penwyll's dark secret including interrogation, lockpicking and forgery

- Return to any area at night to encounter new, horrifying creatures and secrets

games.name: The Chroma: from the wasteland
games.shortDescription: A western occult FPS game against the unknown on a train speeding through the western wilderness.
games.aboutText:
is an FPS game that races over a western train and takes on a gang eroded by an unknown presence.

Run over the western train!

Be a Western-era outlaw, deal with a gang that's occupying the train.
Will you be able to get to the end of the train safely?

Take away the enemy's weapons!

Quickly bring the weapon that the enemy drops with the chain.
The weapon you brought is free to use!

Try a total of seven distinctive weapons.
You'll be able to run the train more easily!

Face the unknown!

A gang devoured by the unknown and into madness appears...
Fall into the occult elements of only!

games.name: FIND ALL 6: Netherlands
games.shortDescription: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure in the Find All 6: Netherlands game! You will explore the unique landscapes, historical cities and famous landmarks of the Netherlands. Look for hidden objects and color this painted world.
games.aboutText:
