The continuation of the Find All series in the Find All 6: Netherlands genre. Immerse yourself in another exciting journey and find many different hidden objects while enjoying the views of an ancient village, a colorful waterfront and a hot resort. Finding the necessary items will make the black and white world with its inhabitants come to life. It's up to you to decide which items you want to find.

Game Features:

- 750 search items

- Option to choose the desired item to search for

- Increasing level of difficulty

- There is a hint

- Interactivity. Items can be searched inside buildings

- The world is populated with inhabitants, each one has its own story

- Coloring levels

- 2.5D effect

- Chance to meet Meowogog

games.name: Ambidextro
games.shortDescription: A multiplayer game for a single player. Learn to control 2 characters at the same time, one with each hand. Achieve ambidexterity and rescue both the prince and the princess simultaneously.
games.aboutText:
A witch has kidnapped the prince and the princess. As the royal wizard, you have been severed in half so you can go rescue both at the same time, but first you’ll need to learn to control the two halves of your body simultaneously.

With a series of quick single-screen platforming levels, Ambidextro will help you master controlling two characters at once, one with each hand. Learn to split your focus and tackle increasingly challenging levels you would have thought impossible.

· A multi-player game for a single player.

· Control one character with each hand.

· Make your two-halves meet before the time runs out.

· 100 levels to conquer.

· Retro dark-fantasy atmosphere with a dungeon synth soundtrack.

games.name: Windwoven
games.shortDescription: You inherit forest edge land. Daily, till soil with your hoe grow radishes, rear chicks, bond with oddball neighbors. Spring seeds yield summer gardens; autumn's firelit pumpkins reveal woodland mysteries. Nighttime under trees, fireflies dance like starlit constellations, this is your idyllic life.
games.aboutText:
A cozy pixel-life farming adventure!

Here is a farm leisure game where players can develop a farm to obtain various basic raw materials, make the forest town more prosperous; and through interactions with the town residents, unlock more functions and plots.

Key Features:

- Cultivate wilderness into fertile land, grow diverse crops, and reap the rewards of your agricultural efforts.

- Craft essential tools, then construct and upgrade various facilities including homesteads, workshops, decoration huts, and farm buildings to gradually expand your village.

- Core gameplay systems encompass farming, mining, exploration, fishing, and foraging - enhanced with Roguelike elements and pet companions.

- Dynamic environmental shifts reflect seasonal changes, weather patterns, and the passage of time.

- Experience a multi-branching narrative through interactions with villagers: forge friendships, solve local problems, deepen relationships, and unlock special events through interwoven storylines.

- Participate in seasonal festivals and community events, pursue romance with eligible villagers, and ultimately establish your own family through marriage.

games.name: A Whole Wolfrush
games.shortDescription: Four friends battle their way across space to claim a once-in-a-lifetime wish. Their lives are in your hands.
games.aboutText:
A strange wish fulfilling entity has appeared on the edge of the universe. You and your team pilot a combined MEKA to get to it, but you're not the only ones there...

You will have to fight your way through a sequence of bosses just to get a shot at getting your wishes granted.

In-between the fights you can spend time with your team, get to know them better and improve their performance with gifts and special items.

They've all put their trust in you. Do your best.

games.name: DOSMIC
games.shortDescription: In a world teeming with colossal beings, a boy named Nero sets out to find the missing girl Snoa. Use a range of movement abilities, solve mysterious puzzles and sometimes fight otherworldly horrors in DOSMIC, a cinematic puzzle platformer.
games.aboutText:
Young Nero had only one constant companion: a girl named Snoa .

But one day, a catastrophe shakes the world. Snoa vanishes without a trace, leaving him alone in a world teeming with colossal beings.

Become Nero and set out across this strange, dangerous world in search of Snoa.

Key Features

✦ A cinematic puzzle-platform adventure

✦ Tense action among otherworldly beings

✦ A variety of puzzles, including perspective-based challenges

✦ Hidden fragments of memory to collect

✦ An unknown power beyond death

✦ Abilities that expand as the journey unfolds

✦ An uncanny story told through its environments and imagery, without dialogue or narration

A grotesque, dreamlike world

Explore a strange, mysterious world where dark fantasy meets cosmic horror.

Beyond the gaze of giants

Slip between overwhelming beings in tense stealth and escape sequences where every moment counts.

Uncanny riddles

Find your way through varied puzzles, from perspective-based challenges to those involving nearby objects and mechanisms.

Face otherworldly horrors

Shatter the colossal core and claim its essence with a power awakened on the threshold of death.

A boy's growing abilities

From double jumps to gliding and flight, Nero's movements grow freer and more precise as his journey unfolds.

Hidden fragments of memory

Who are they? What is this unknown power Nero has gained? And where is Snoa?

Gather fragments of memory scattered throughout the world, and its hidden truths will slowly emerge.

Whatever awaits… keep moving forward.

Streaming & Videos

Everyone, including companies and VTuber agencies, is welcome to stream and upload videos of DOSMIC (demo included) and to monetize them. No permission needed — a link to the Steam page is appreciated.

Contact: contact@blackcheeze.com

games.name: Shroud of Gloom
games.shortDescription: Shroud of Gloom is a point-and-click horror adventure. Investigate an old manor, gather items and clues to solve environmental puzzles and discover dark secrets. Can you uncover the mystery… and make it out alive?
games.aboutText:
Shroud of Gloom combines the charm and nostalgia of classic point-and-click adventures with a chilling horror atmosphere. Explore an old manor full of secrets, solve puzzles rooted in the environment, and uncover the mystery of this place - it may seem abandoned at first glance, but you’re certain that you are not alone.

Hired as a Private Investigator, you arrive at Crawford Manor to investigate the disappearance of Edmund Sullivan. What begins as a routine case quickly spirals into something far more sinister.

- Modern Point-and-Click Experience : Inspired by the classics, but refined with modern responsiveness and polish.

- Professional Voice Acting: The game is fully voice acted with subtitles available in 13 languages.

- Environmental Puzzles : Rummage through the manor, collect useful items and clues to solve environmental puzzles.

- Puzzle Variations: Puzzles feature randomized elements and multiple variations. While progression is semi-linear, no two playthroughs are exactly the same.

- Fragmented Narrative: If you want to truly understand what occurred, you’ll need to connect the dots yourself.

- Atmospheric Survival Horror: You're armed with only a flickering flashlight, and something is lurking in the dark.

- Immersive Sound Design : An original soundtrack and handcrafted sound effects designed to immerse you into this unsettling world.

- Accessibility Options: Extend timers, adjust contrast and highlight color, disable flickering lights, camera shake, walking animations and more. Play in a way that suits you.

Shroud of Gloom is a deeply personal project from two lifelong friends: a solo developer and a sound designer. It’s the result of passion, persistence, and countless late nights. Your support means the world.

Wishlist and follow the game to keep up-to-date.

games.name: 恋爱泡馍！青春老陕：Shannxi Love Story
games.shortDescription: Shannxi Love Story is a visual novel-style game set against the backdrop of university life in Shaanxi, infused with local cultural flavors. Discover Chinese culture through a brand-new lens, explore the youthful spirit of Xi'an, and discover the myriad possibilities life has to offer.
games.aboutText:
Discover Chinese culture through a brand-new lens !

Shaanxi Province, known as the "Land of Qin," boasts a cultural heritage that has thrived through thirteen dynasties.

Its official English name, "Shaanxi," is derived from the local dialect's pronunciation, where the character "陕" (Shǎn) is pronounced with a fourth tone. To reflect this unique phonetic character, the spelling "Shannxi" is used, emphasizing the distinct intonation of the region.

The provincial capital, Xi'an, is a city where ancient charm meets youthful vitality. Home to numerous universities and a vibrant student population, Xi'an is a historical capital that seamlessly blends its millennia-old heritage with the energy of modern youth. The people of Shaanxi, embody the rich and diverse facets of life here, where the weight of history coexists with the fervor of new beginnings.

【About : Shannxi Love Story】

Shannxi Love Story is a visual novel-style game set against the backdrop of university life in Shaanxi, infused with local cultural flavors. After completing a year at a prestigious university in Xi'an, an unexpected event disrupts the protagonist's routine-driven life.

Amid the tranquil summer, under the shade of green phoenix trees, the story unfolds through themes of academic research, savoring paomo (a traditional Shaanxi dish), visits to the iconic Giant Wild Goose Pagoda, and the joys of video games. Over the course of this summer, the protagonist teams up with the mysterious campus idol "Xiao Xi" and four classmates, each with their own unique personalities and aspirations. Together, they explore the youthful spirit of Xi'an and discover the myriad possibilities life has to offer.

【 Features】

- Rediscover the Ancient Capital of Xi'an : Immerse yourself in the city's rich history and vibrant culture through beautifully illustrated scenes.

- Explore a Historic University : Experience the youthful energy of a century-old prestigious institution.

- Join Forces with Xiao Xi and Friends : Interact with the mysterious campus idol and a diverse cast of characters, each bringing their own stories and personalities to life.

"It's been a year since I started at this renowned university in Xi'an.

Graduate school admissions, job hunting, GPA, competitions, scholarships...

After crossing the finish line of the highly anticipated 'Gaokao'(National College Entrance Examination) , new goals have emerged.

Achieving a high GPA, participating in competitions, engaging in extracurricular activities, and earning scholarships have become my new benchmarks.

It's like an exhilarating game, filled with challenging tasks and enticing rewards.

But what if I fail at the very first checkpoint? Where do I go if I can't start over?"

【Demo Release】

The demo for Shannxi Love Story will be released in the first half of 2025!

- Follow us on Social Media : Bilibili @深层磁场SenseGames \ @交小西Channel

- Contact us : sense_science@outlook.com

- Add to Your Wishlist : Get notified via email when the free demo is available!

About the Team:

Shannxi Love Story is the first project by a team of current university students.

Our goal is to capture and explore the authentic experiences of university life while conveying a message of hope and positivity through innovative storytelling.

Though we are still honing our skills and refining our work, we hope this humble game can bring you both joy and inspiration, reveal a different facet of modern Chinese culture to you.

We are committed to improving and moving forward, one step at a time.

Thank you for your support!

Credits:

- Producer : 战术深海

- Writer/Planner : 战术深海

- Development : 战术深海 / 萨卡萨卡班班 / K-OH

- Art Director : 嘀哩礼理

games.name: Gnaughty Gnomes
games.shortDescription: Crush your friends in combat by embodying these adorable yet Gnaughty Gnomes! Throw everything you find along the way, choose cards to upgrade your build, change the rules of the game... whatever it takes to win.
games.aboutText:
Gather your friends and prove who is the best gnome! Throw, hit, dash, taunt, explode... Anything is valid to win and crown yourself the undisputed champion. Try to combine upgrades to maximize your build potential. Let chaos reign!

FEATURES

- Customization
Choose from +5000 combinations to unleash your inner gnome.

- Upgrades
Enhance all your abilities and change the game rules by choosing between +100 cards with different tiers and synergies.

- Maps
Play on +20 randomly selected maps with different themes, each featuring their own weapons

- Weapons
Anything can be a weapon if you have imagination and very few scruples. Use everything you see, including the heads of your rivals. You can even drive some of them!

- Taunts
There’s nothing better in life than mocking your enemies, whether before or after killing them. Choose the most offensive emote that suits your mood.

GAMEMODES

- Classic
Free for all, no gnome is above the other, only one can stand, may the best gnome win.

- Teams
Colaborative mode where you can group in teams to annihilate each other, in a balanced way (or not, as you wish).

- Prop Hunt
A gnome will search for the rest while they are hidden as objects. The most sneaky and clever gnome will win, unless is caught of course.

30-minute matches that are fast, wild, but above all, very fun, generating both laughter and violence in equal measure. May the best gnome win!

games.name: Color Factory: Automation Meets Canvas
games.shortDescription: Color Factory is a relaxing factory-building game where strategy meets automation. Start with basic colors, refine them into vivid shades, and craft canvases of all sizes. Optimize your machines, scale operations at your own pace, and master automation to build a masterpiece of efficiency.
games.aboutText:
About This Game

Color Factory is a factory-building game that combines strategy and management with automation. Extract primary colors, blend them to create new shades, and craft canvases to complete tasks. Use nodes to automate processes such as mixing, resizing, and transporting. Scale and optimize your production to tackle increasingly complex challenges, and master automation to build an efficient art factory.

Mix Colors, Craft Shades

Start with primary colors, mix them to secondary and tertiary colors to create your shade. Store and use colors to complete tasks. Plan your setups carefully to overcome increasingly difficult challenges.

Automate with Nodes

Use nodes to transform colors into canvas pieces and manipulate them with specialized nodes to automate your workflow. Rotate, store, modify, and transport your materials to keep production seamless and efficient.

Your Factory, Your Rules

Create your own path to automation. Use belts to build long routes, tunnels to bypass obstacles, splitters to distribute materials efficiently, or mergers to combine multiple lines into one. Every setup is your own, letting you create a unique experience.

Always Something New

No costs for roads or, no enemies, and no hostile action, just the pure joy of automation. Experiment freely, redesign your factory without any penalties. Build, break, and rebuild as much as you need. Create the perfect automation system that satisfies you.

Automation Without Limits

No costs for roads or, no enemies, and no hostile action, just the pure joy of automation. Experiment freely, redesign your factory without any penalties. Build, break, and rebuild as much as you need. Create the perfect automation system that satisfies you.

A Game That Grows With You

Color Factory is constantly evolving and growing with its community. Our roadmap includes exciting upcoming features like a level editor, weekly challenges, and the Shape Atlas expansion. Join the adventure and share your ideas on Discord to help shape the future of the game!.

games.name: Little Wings Deliveries
games.shortDescription: Embark on a short, playful adventure in your cozy flying boat and sail through fluffy clouds. Discover floating islands and befriend their quirky citizens. Jump, roll, climb, and skate through Cloudburg as Skye faces her biggest obstacle on her way to the Royal Postal Academy!
games.aboutText:
Little Wings Deliveries

Embark on a short, playful adventure in your cozy flying boat and sail through fluffy clouds. Discover floating islands and befriend their quirky citizens. Jump, roll, climb, and skate through Cloudburg as Skye faces her biggest obstacle on her way to the Royal Postal Academy!

Little Features:

- ⏰ Around 30 minutes to 1 hour of playtime!

- ☁️ Sail through the clouds with your flying boat!

- 🏝️ Explore 5 different tiny flying islands!

- 🤪 Meet a small cast of quirky characters!

- 🎒 Collect cool items like a skateboard, selfie stick, and more!

⚠️ Attention: This game is digestible 😋🍴

We're TENSTACK! A small collective of game makers creating lots of creative and 'digestible' games. A digestible game respects its players' money and time, is designed around a single idea, and doesn’t overstay its welcome. We want you to be able to finish our games in just a couple of sessions—without ever making you feel stuffed, so to say.

games.name: Untold Winter
games.shortDescription: Untold Winter is a first person shooter set in a dark fantasy world. Master your firearms and magical spells, explore the world, enhance your abilities and parry, dash and shoot your way through the terrors of this wintry world.
games.aboutText:
Untold Winter is a first person shooter set in a dark fantasy world where a never ending winter fell upon the world. Use your firearms, magical spells and your shield to conquer the terrors of this wintry world.

Master combat and defeat the deadly terrors of the night.

Magic and Firearms

Even while holding guns you still can cast spells. Combine your firearms with magic: stop time with your rifle ammunition or electrify your enemies in place. Parry, dash, cast spells and shoot your way through. Choose between a slow but precise bolt-action rifle, a fast firing machine gun, a powerful shotgun ideal for closed-ranged combat or your loyal 6-chambered revolver.

Spell Casting - Magic Only Combat

Find Scrolls of Knowledge, invest your points to increase your magic affinity and cast fireballs, lightning bolts and warp time itself with your bare hands.

The Heavy Shield - Ragdoll Physics

Consume your stamina to block incoming attacks. A well-timed block will parry the attacker and stun it for a brief moment. The Shield can also be used to push an enemy away and knockdown others.

Explore a Dark Fantasy Wintry World

Navigate through a parasitic cave infested with infected creatures, a dangerous dungeon or a heavily guarded fortress.

Bosses

Face powerful unique enemies that haunt the world. Defeat and cleanse the world from these horrors. Bosses and tougher enemies must be dealt with care, skill and planning. Manage your stamina, block, parry and dodge incoming attacks to survive.

World Lore

The Winter King has bought an endless cold upon the world, where all things dead have arisen. His army of all cold creatures and himself march south to conquer the known world. Can you bring this eternal night to an end?

games.name: Gambit
games.shortDescription: A chess roguelike where every run bends the rules. Build your army, wield powerful kings, and survive deadly variants on your way to proving a human can still beat the machine. Shape your build, outlast the chaos, and choose when to command the board yourself.
games.aboutText:
Most chess roguelikes try to streamline or simplify the game, but with Gambit, we wanted to do the exact opposite, we wanted to make your life harder. Each opponent runs on a Fairy Stockfish engine, so no two runs will feel the same, and if you’re a chess enthusiast looking for something that will truly strain your brain, Gambit is built for you.

Combine chess pieces with unique kings , for get special abilities and effects. Be careful, every 3 round you will fight with endgame boss witch represents different chess variants like Atomic, Fog of War, Anti-chess etc.

- Ideal chess roguelike.

- Respect basic chess rules.

- Adaptive complexity.

- Create new chess pieces via merge (with Merge King).

Autobattles are available for players who want to step back and let their preparation speak for itself.

Every opponent is powered by a strong chess engine Fairy Stockfish , keeping each battle sharp, dangerous, and unpredictable.

games.name: The Boba Teashop
games.shortDescription: A cozy horror game where you own and manage a boba tea shop. Prepare boba teas, serve customers, and expand your menu to grow your business.
games.aboutText:
The Boba Teashop is a cozy horror game where you own and manage a boba tea shop.

Prepare boba teas, serve customers, and expand your menu to attract more patrons.

You play as Risa, a woman in her 30s who is tired of corporate life and has decided to chase her dream of opening a boba tea shop.

As a boba tea shop owner, you will encounter a variety of customers.

Your job is to greet them with a smile and take their orders.

Making boba tea is simple. The ingredients are just milk tea and boba.

Seal the cup with a lid and serve it with a straw for sipping and enjoying the boba pearls.

But sometimes, you'll encounter demanding customers with special requests or those who leave a mess in your shop.

As the proud owner of a boba tea shop, there's nothing you can't handle.

While serving customers and managing your boba tea shop, you start seeing visions and hearing things.

Is it all in your head, or is something haunting the place?

This is psychological horror game that builds tension through eerie atmosphere, unsettling events, and moments of intense scare when you least expect them.

Features:

Gameplay: A simple yet engaging loop where you take orders from customers, prepare their drinks, and serve them with a smile.

VHS Aesthetics: Experience the game through a creepy VHS filter that adds a nostalgic and eerie atmosphere.

Story: Uncover Risa's journey and personal growth as she pursues her dream of becoming a successful boba tea shop owner.

For content creators:

You are free to create content from the game and monetize the gameplay by any means. There are no other restrictions from my side when playing the game

games.name: PHASE ZERO
games.shortDescription: A grotesque illness binds the town of Flint Peak. Several survivors try to escape with their lives as mysterious creatures roam the streets. Face horrific monsters, solve puzzles and uncover the truth in this classic survival horror. Can you escape the nightmare?
games.aboutText:
Sink your teeth in PHASE ZERO - a modern reimagining of the survival horror golden era classics. The story unfolds over a series of chapters told from the perspective of different survivors. Featuring prerendered backgrounds, fixed cameras and the DNA of the PSX masterpieces, it blends nostalgic design with modern quality-of-life improvements, while honoring its iconic roots.

It’s the best 90s AAA horror coming soon to your PC!

The game is set in Flint Peak, a post-industrial harbor town in the middle of nowhere. It's 1994, and a relentless snowstorm looms on the horizon. To make matters worse, a mysterious illness is spreading rapidly, leaving most of the town's residents grotesquely changed.

Caught in the chaos are several unlikely survivors. All dealing with and facing their own horrors. Armed with only what they can scavenge, they must endure the night. Can they uncover the truth before the break of dawn?

Grotesque, cancerous monsters crawl through the alleys of Flint Peak. Tissue overgrows walls of buildings and meat bursts through the pipes. Empty husks of human skin fill the streets. Will you fight, or will you escape?

Here, at SPINA Studio , we are deeply passionate about the games we create. As a small indie studio made up by seasoned developers, our goal with PHASE ZERO was to craft a unique, modern take on the horrors we grew up playing.

Thank you for playing PHASE ZERO ! We hope you enjoy the game as much as we enjoy bringing it to life!

games.name: Factory Life
games.shortDescription: Factory Life is a first-person factory simulator with colony-management elements. Start alone in a small garage, assemble electronics, and scale your business. Hire workers, manage their daily needs, and choose to be a fair leader or a harsh exploiter. Find your path to the top.
games.aboutText:
Factory Life is a first-person factory simulator with colony-management elements. Betrayed by the ideals you believed in: hard work and sacrifice. What did it bring you? Now you must find your own path. Will you be able to change anything, or will you become the very thing you hate?

Grow Big

Start at the very bottom, working alone in a grimy garage. Gather people like you to build something greater together. Take care of their needs, manage their schedule, and avoid burning them out. Or be a tyrant. Forge your own path. Create

Put your hands back to work. Assemble electronics on your own, earn money, buy materials, and acquire new licenses. Satisfy your clients and offer increasingly better products. Show them that you are someone to be reckoned with.

A Whole Pipeline

Assemble, inspect, and pack electronics. Build assembly lines made of human hands. Optimize your workflow and cut costs to stay competitive as demands continue to rise. Are you up for the challenge?

Strong Like a Tree

Expand your skills and watch your potential grow. Over time you will become stronger, mastering more complex tasks. Just remember that with great power comes great responsibility.

To the Top

Compete. Produce more, better, and faster than others. Build a stronger position as you race up the leaderboard against other manufacturers. Don't give up, and you will eventually reach the top. But will it be worth it?

Key Features:

- Start from Scratch: Be a one-man assembly line and build everything with your own hands.

- Automate: Hire workers to boost your production and scale your operations.

- Manage: Optimize workflow, take care of your crew's needs, and make tough choices.

- Unique Setting: Experience the harsh reality of 1980s Asia.

- Good or Evil: Decide what kind of boss you want to be.

- Reach the Top: Outperform the competition and prove you are the best.

games.name: Holder of Place
games.shortDescription: Holder of Place is a Roguelike Auto-Battler Card game. Recruit different follower cards, arrange them, watch them fight ever-stronger enemies. Along the way, unfold a dark science-fantasy tale of a ruined kingdom, meet strange characters, and visit exotic locations.
games.aboutText:
In a long dead kingdom, a young dragon has unleashed a primordial gloom that swallows anything it touches. Your quarry lies now in the heart of the kingdom; Can you endure the monsters that lurk and halt the spread of the dark?

Gather your companions. Hold tight your faith. Acquire new strengths and venture into the endless night.

Holder of Place is a roguelike auto-battler card game. Each run you are sent deeper into a strange and fading realm, where you alternate between intense combat encounters, strategic follower choices, and unpredictable event opportunities — all leading up to a final confrontation against the Dragon .

Along the way, you meet random casts of followers with unique traits, and must decide who to RECRUIT into your party. You ARRANGE them so that they open up different paths of synergies and strategies. You WATCH them fight waves after waves of increasingly difficult adversaries, beasts, past nemeses, and sometimes... even yourself.

Wanderer, roam through dreadful dreams, ancient battlefield ruins, arcane cult enclaves, and beyond. Unearth darker secrets — about your past life and lost love in the kingdom, and the true origins of the Dragon.

- Fast paced auto-battler gameplay

- Recruit from 150+ unique followers and trinkets

- Explore the ruins of a dark science-fantasy world

- Challenge yourself in the ever-changing Reliquary Mode

games.name: OmOneko
games.shortDescription: “A story about cat girls … with bite.” Nekos have evolved in the shadows of human society. Beautiful. Mysterious. Chaotic. And now, three of them live with you. Will you be able to get past the stigma and grow closer to them? OmOneko is a tale of cat and mouse... and rats.
games.aboutText:
When our main character finds himself as the owner of three nekos – cat girls – his quiet world is suddenly beset with the conjoined problems that having three cats and girls in the house can bring.

Overcoming both everyday and not-so-common difficulties, will our main character finally find peace and stability again—and maybe something more?

- OmOneko is a bishoujo-style game made by fans like you. It uses a text and sprite-based visual novel model with a NVL styled text box.

- This game was inspired by other passion projects such as Katawa Shoujo and Doki Doki Literature Club ; since those games are free, so is this one!

- A unique and more cinematic presentation of the choice-driven Visual Novel medium.

- Three unique routes and ten possible endings.

- An engaging tale told by unusual characters containing over 260,000 words. Several deep and nuanced stand-alone stories woven together means 20+ hours of story-rich gaming.

- Original soundtrack of more than 50 songs and variations.

- Several hundred environmental and character images, and over 200 backgrounds.

- No AI was used in the making of this game.

- Extras area including a “Library” to view all manga, graphic novels, and comics that you unlock along the way, including: SinKitty, Nyako Maids, Red Rocket, Cat’n a Rat, and more!

games.name: Queens Casino
games.shortDescription: Enjoy playing at the casino with the original card game, "Queens"! In each turn, cards are randomly dealt, and you play them according to specific rules. If you can clear all the "challenges" presented by the heroine, you win.
games.aboutText:
Enjoy playing at the casino with the original card game, "Queens"!

In each turn, cards are randomly dealt, and you play them according to specific rules. If you can clear all the "Subjectives" presented by the heroine, you win.

Each heroine comes with her own unique additional rules, and every stage features completely different "Subjectives," requiring distinct strategies for every level.

Experience a simple yet deep game that demands thinking a few steps ahead through a series of engaging choices...!

- Card Game

- Skill System: Activate various skills using MP, which builds up as you play cards.

- Shop: Purchase skills, hunt for the ultimate combos, and expand your strategies.

games.name: Liquor Store Simulator: Prologue
games.shortDescription: Play the free prologue of Liquor Store Simulator. Purchase goods, equipment, and manage your store. Who knows, maybe you’ll be the one to turn a small shop into a real alcohol empire.
games.aboutText:
Liquor Store Simulator: Prologue is a free prologue to the game Liquor Store Simulator about building and growing your own store. You start your business in a small shop that you bought on credit.

At first, it won’t be easy—you’ll have to work the cash register yourself, accept deliveries, keep track of inventory, and maintain order in the sales area. But hard work and smart decisions will help you turn this modest store into a thriving business with a wide selection of products and satisfied customers.

In this free prologue, we invite you to explore some of the mechanics we’ve prepared for you. We’ve created a lot of content, but we’ve saved most of it for the full release, which is coming very soon! In the meantime, add the full version of Liquor Store Simulator to your wishlist and enjoy the prologue!

Management

Purchase goods, arrange store equipment as you see fit.

Alcohol Licenses

Buy alcohol licenses. This will give you access to more expensive and premium drinks.

Customization

Change the color of walls, ceilings, and floors. Make your store unique and unlike any other.

Expansion

Expand the sales area and storage space. This will allow you to offer your customers an even wider variety of products.

games.name: The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show
games.shortDescription: The incredible Mr. Rabbit invites you all to a mysterious magic show! Celebrate 10 years of Rusty Lake with a new free-to-play point-and-click adventure that promises to delight and… shock you with its sleight of hand!
games.aboutText:
Take a seat, get comfortable, and prepare to solve some puzzles in The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show! This anniversary free-to-play adventure from Rusty Lake will take you through 20 whimsically bizarre acts bound to test your ability to think outside the “box”. Don’t be surprised when things are not what they seem… or are they?

Features

10 years of Rusty Lake

A free to play short but magical game filled with secrets and unexpected twists that will put you in a celebratory mood

There will be music... and more

A magical soundtrack accompanied by rich sound effects and unexpected voice actors

Take a step back

A chance to peek behind the curtain of the extravagant magician also known as Mr. Rabbit!

games.name: SuperCitycon
games.shortDescription: A city builder with a retro-inspired look and the freedom to shape your world. Build roads, railways and entire neighborhoods in a creative sandbox. Customize buildings, vehicles and more with SCC Studio, the in-game voxel editor, and share your creations through Steam Workshop.
games.aboutText:
CLASSIC CITY BUILDING. THE WAY YOU LOVE IT.

SuperCitycon is a city builder that brings the spirit of classic city building into a modern 3D world with a distinctive, retro-inspired 16-bit palette. Shape the landscape, build your neighborhoods and create a city of your own.

Create entire maps, build roads and railways, and grow your city from its first block to an enormous metropolis. Place buildings from a growing library, then open SCC Studio whenever you want to customize a model or create something new.

SHAPE THE WORLD. BUILD THE CITY.

Shape the landscape with terraforming tools. Raise hills, carve valleys and shape the water around your city, then connect your neighborhoods with roads, bridges, tunnels and railways.

Build each district directly from a continuously growing library of buildings, vehicles, citizens and props. Create quiet neighborhoods, dense downtowns and everything in between, then keep reshaping the city until it feels entirely your own.

MAKE IT YOURS. CREATE SOMETHING NEW.

SCC Studio is SuperCitycon's built-in voxel editor. Customize existing buildings, vehicles, terrain sets, citizens and props, or start from an empty grid and create something new.

Work at any scale, from the color of a wall to the look of an entire landscape. Design your own character, place your creations directly in the city and share them through the Steam Workshop.

WATCH YOUR CITY COME ALIVE.

*In-game footage captured using SuperCitycon's built-in video tools.

Different architectural styles give every neighborhood its own character, from quiet residential streets to dense downtown skylines.

Watch traffic move through your streets, pedestrians follow the sidewalks, trains travel along your railways and boats navigate the waterways. Choose the time of day and weather to give your city a different atmosphere. First- and third-person modes let you step inside and explore the city you created.

BUILD AT YOUR OWN PACE

Play a city builder at your own pace. Early Access begins with a construction sandbox centered on shaping worlds, building cities, creating assets and exploring the places you make.

This city-building game is designed to grow with additional game modes, new rule sets and new ways to experience the cities you create.

One world. Endless cities. More ways to build.

FEATURES AT A GLANCE

- Construction Sandbox: Build every district, refine every detail and explore the city at your own pace.

- Map Creation & Terraforming: Shape the terrain and water, and create terrain sets of your own.

- Flexible Roads & Railways: Connect districts with different road types, bridges and tunnels.

- SCC Studio & Steam Workshop: Create, customize and share maps, models and characters with the in-game voxel editor.

- Continuously Growing Library: Expand the city with new architectural styles, buildings, vehicles, citizens and props.

- Living Cities: Experience active neighborhoods and transport, and control day, night and weather.

- First- & Third-Person Modes: Create your character and explore the city from within.

games.name: Meta Card Backpack Legend
games.shortDescription: The third installment of the MetaCard series, MetaCard: Backpack Legend, is a backpack management Roguelike card game! Before Battle: Manage your artifact backpack to build and synergize your playstyle. During Battle: Drag and drop cards to unleash skills on key enemies at the right moment.
games.aboutText:
World's First Card + Backpack System

Cards + Backpack Management, Pre-battle + Mid-battle = Dual Strategy

Micro-control + Auto Combat: Enjoy explosive battles without operational burden!

1. Strategic Real-time Combat

New Artifact Backpack & Bond System enhance pre-battle depth!

Diverse card mechanics + unique character energy systems secure mid-battle tactics!

Bullet Time ensures decision space – no frantic button-mashing.

2. 1+1>2 Dual-Character System

True dual characters: Independent hands, simultaneous dual-line operation.

Synergy-triggered Emergence enables 1+1>2 combos:

Gale Slash + Black Hole = Tornado

Ice Arrow + Tornado = Blizzard

Fireball + Ice Arrow = Magma

Tornado + Lightning = Thunder Twister

Thunder Twister + Lightning Orb = Violet Thunder Dragon

More combos await discovery!

3. Farmable Roguelike

Repeatable stages + Non-repeating Artifact drops = Target-farm your build!

Your mastery of Backpack Management & Artifact synergy defines the ceiling – not RNG.

discord：

games.name: Star Crafter
games.shortDescription: A space survival crafting mining base building and star system building game. Craft rockets to create planets and Dyson Rings, mine and craft advanced materials, terraform the terrain, manage electricity, farm food, and more as you watch the star system evolve into stunning, ever-changing views.
games.aboutText:
A space survival crafting mining base building and star system building game.
Craft rockets to create planets and Dyson Rings, mine and craft advanced materials, terraform the terrain, manage electricity, farm food, and more as you watch the star system evolve into stunning, ever-changing views.

- From early on, create entire planets, Dyson Rings, Dyson Sphere , and more, by crafting and building rockets and launchers.
Watch as the star system evolves into visually stunning, ever-changing views throughout your playthrough .

- Mine resources using your mining laser on the surface of planets or deep underground.

- Craft resources into advanced materials using many different workstations (smelters, fabricators, extractors, etc).

- Terraform the terrain to make place for machines base building.

- Explore and mine on newly crafted planets and moons to find new resources.

- Expand your electricity grid by building many different energy generators.

- Farm food to keep your character fed.

games.name: Kaizen Kitchen: A Restaurant Simulator
games.shortDescription: Open a restaurant in the heart of a cozy little Japanese town. Cook authentic Japanese dishes, serve hungry customers, and decorate your restaurant however you like. Take part in local events and become the town’s most popular restaurant!
games.aboutText:
What do you do when life starts feeling dull and pointless ? Exactly! Leave everything behind , take out a loan , and buy a small diner in a small Japanese town!

Turn your modest little place into the hottest restaurant in town. Leave your competitors in the dust, make millions, and become the gold standard for local restaurants. Or, you know… at least pay off the loan.

- Discover over 40 popular Japanese recipes with varying levels of cooking difficulty.

- Build your menu from a variety of dishes based on the day's conditions.

- Chop , fry , boil , whisk , bake , and prepare delicious drinks .

- Your skills determine the quality of your dishes and the tips you earn. Level up your dishes to earn more .

- Guests line up outside your place, so make sure you've got enough free tables !

- Take orders and get cooking, or you risk losing a customer!

- Serve the dishes to the right tables, and don't forget to collect the money !

- Cook dishes to level up and expand your restaurant .

- Each level unlocks new recipes , kitchen equipment , furniture , and decorations .

- Hire staff to help with the workload.

- Level up your staff to boost their efficiency.

What sets a simple diner apart from a high-end restaurant? A luxurious interior !

- Customize the floors , walls , and ceiling .

- Decorate your restaurant with all kinds of decor .

- Create a unique , cozy atmosphere of your own.

games.name: Reverie in the Moonlight
games.shortDescription: In Reverie in the Moonlight, scary monsters are chasing you, and you can’t fight them...but your plushies can. Can your adorable friends protect you from these nightmares?
games.aboutText:
What if this dream never ended? What if we could dream it together?

Reverie in the Moonlight is an action game where, with the help of your stuffed animals, you try to defend yourself from the monsters attacking you night after night.

Nightly Visits

Little Tete’s nights are restless. His dreams are full of horrible monsters attacking him. But then, one night, he meets Luna, and she teaches him how to use his plushies to defend himself.

Cute but Strong

When faced with a monster, Tete can only do one thing: run away. His plushies, however, can actually fight and defeat monsters. Different animals play different roles, with some focusing on short-range attacks, some on long-range shots, and some on supporting their allies. There are 40 types to choose from, so find your favorites and help them protect Tete from the monsters.

-Ham Jr.

Runs left and right, hitting monsters that get too close with a stick.

-Snoozy-G

Enjoys sleeping, napping, and resting. Monsters that hit it are slowed down for a while.

-Striped Angel

When it sees someone in trouble, it always wants to help. It heals Tete up from a distance.

Collect and Strategize

After the monsters’ attack is over, you can shop with the gold you found. You can get new plushies and even buy special items that can make you stronger. Some of them will also give you new weaknesses, so it’s up to you to strategize and prepare for the next attack in the best way possible. There are more than 100 items in the game... Will you be able to collect them all?

Change Clothes to Change Strategies

So, you’ve played the game’s story to the end. Well done. But this is just the start!

You can change Tete’s clothes, choosing from more than 20 costumes. Each one makes him stronger in some ways and weaker in others. If you want to help Tete defeat his nightmares, you’ll have to find the right plushies and items to go with each costume!

- Moonlight Wizard

Plushies with long-range attacks become stronger, but Tete can only use those. Defending yourself becomes harder, so you’ll have to defeat monsters before they can get close.

- Nap Cloud

Increasing attack power becomes difficult, but plushies that don’t move around attack twice as fast. Try to find as many stationary friends as you can.

-Doggy Friend

Tete can only use dog plushies. If you want to win, you’ll need to make good use of their fast respawn speed.

games.name: There Are No Orcs
games.shortDescription: An RTS-Roguelike hybrid with auto-battling troops. Master building placement, swarm your enemies, and smash their defenses with unit-commander combos!
games.aboutText:
The wait is over! The full version of "There Are No Orcs" is OUT NOW !

Join the Horde... (of Players)!

Find the Discord invite link in the game's main menu or in the sidebar of this Steam page.

We're Not Done Yet!

We'll keep rolling out new content, squashing bugs, and generally trying to make this game even more awesome for you. Thanks for the incredible support!

"There Are No Orcs" is a combat strategy game that blends Roguelike elements, tile-building , and auto-battling .

Take command of one of three factions : Humans, Demons, and Dwarves.

Strategically place buildings on tiles to produce a massive , endless army.

Forge an unstoppable front line and smash the enemy's base to smithereens!

Combine, Place, and Profit!

Strategically place buildings to automatically produce gold or combat units. Maximize efficiency by leveraging synergy bonuses based on placement.

Each faction's buildings work in completely different ways. Not all strategies are created equal... but they're all fun to break!

Commanders Who Actually Do Something

Choose from 30 unique commanders, each with their own active skills , passive traits , and four exclusive buildings .

Pick your commander based on your favorite tactical style... or maybe just because you think they look cool. We won't judge.

Extremely High Replay Value

Every run is a new tactical experiment . Feel like flooding the battlefield with an endless skeleton horde? Or perhaps launching a combined air-ground assault with elite dinosaurs is more your speed? Go on, try a strategy they haven't thought of!

Forge Your Legion, Test Your Mettle

Master the counter system to assemble the ultimate army. Battle across four distinct terrains— plains, desert, scorched earth , and tundra —and push your skills to the limit in the ultimate trial: Chaos difficulty .

(It's the kind of challenge where the developers might have just thrown in some... creative numbers to keep you on your toes. You've been warned.)

What are you waiting for? Stop reading and swarm the battlefield with your own forces!

(No orcs were harmed in the making of this game.)

games.name: Crimson Tale
games.shortDescription: Crimson Tale is a short first-person narrative puzzle game where Elizabeth uses blood magic and vampire powers to defy the oppressive nobility. Avoid sunlight, travel through time, and hunt the Golden Guard to end their reign.
games.aboutText:
Crimson Tale is a short first-person narrative puzzle game where Elizabeth takes one last action against the oppressing forces of the nobility. Avoid the sun, go back in time with blood magic and use your vampire abilities to find the golden guard, ending this oppression once and for all.

STORY

You are Elizabeth , a vampire who returns to a decaying village where the nobility has fled and the guards control the people . With Christie’s death still fresh, Elizabeth uses her powers to travel to the past, discovering the hidden fates of those connected to the village’s downfall. While she uncovers the other's past lives to change the future, her determination sets out to avenge her love and bring an end to the last of the oppression responsible for the remaining chaos.

BETWEEN PAST & PRESENT

Find a body and use your blood magic abilities to go back in time.

Anything you do here affects your current present, with some tinkering you could forge a new path and advance towards your goal.

AVOID THE SUN

Avoid the sunlight and move throughout many areas by using the shade you find around you, or think and forge your own. Some of the paths you encounter will take you on another direction depending on your actions.

USE YOUR ABILITIES

As a vampire, you have a few different abilities at your disposal. Use telekinesis to grab distant objects or carry heavy ones, use your blood time powers to return objects to a previous state or enhance your vision to see marks that no ordinary human can see.

games.name: Chef of Sherwood
games.shortDescription: Will you take from the poor to feed the rich? A satirical cooking & management game where choices matter. As Prince John’s new cook, scrounge ingredients from the population by day, serve lavish feasts to a spoiled royal family by night, and decide who pays the price: the people, the crown… or you.
games.aboutText:
England, 1193.

The kingdom is in disarray as Prince John Lackland and his high-maintenance, mood-swinging family rule the land.

As the new royal cook , your goal is to keep Prince John's family happy and well-fed. You literally cook for your life : lose their respect, you’ll be hanged, serve them on a bad day, you’ll be hanged.

Your only hope lies in the return of King Richard and Robin Hood and his Merry Folk seem to believe YOU might be the key to putting him back on England’s throne.

Will you steal from the rich to give to the poor… or take from the poor to feed the rich?

Cut, pour, whisk, mix, tease the fire. Precision and focus are your allies to create mouth-watering recipes through fun mini-games. Cook a different exquisite meal every day , the royals do deserve the best after all...

Meet the new royal family, the ones who decide if you live or die . Whether it’s fair or not is irrelevant, they will ask for your head on a pike if they are in a bad mood or if you lose their respect.

Encounter the figures from the Robin Hood legend, learn their stories, and choose whether, or not, to support the Merry Folks' rebellion against the 1%.

As a newcomer, people don’t know you well, but they need your help to tend to their business. Be careful who you give a hand to, the new royals taking over the throne was not to everyone's liking.

Time is a finite resource. Collect the ingredients you need takes time out of your day, so be careful where you spend it!

Ensure the castle pantry stays stocked with fresh and delicious products. You may lack a key ingredient for dinner if you don’t.

games.name: Red Light
games.shortDescription: Red Light is a retro-styled extraction shooter where you take a mission to raid an abandoned Soviet R&D Institute filled with mercenaries and living results of human experiments to solve the mystery of your disappeared brother.
games.aboutText:
You are Max, on a mission to find your missing brother. Your only lead takes you to an old Soviet R&D Institute, now taken over by mercenaries and creepy results of human experiments.

Fight your way through enemies, complete quests, and go deeper underground with each level. The more you explore, the more secrets you uncover about what really happened here.

Gear up, stay sharp, and get ready for a dangerous journey into the unknown.

Fight against monsters, mercenaries and bosses as you head into an abandoned mega structure.

Search every corner for useful gear, supplies, and valuables. Everything you find can help you survive — or be sold later for profit.

Stock up on food, water, ammo, and meds. Once you are inside, you are on your own until exits open. Complete tasks, find better gear and upgrade your stats to improve your chances for the next raid.

Make it to the exfil point to keep your loot — or die and lose everything you found and brought with you.

games.name: SuperQuest
games.shortDescription: Depart on a life-changing turn-based adventure to save the President!
games.aboutText:
SuperQuest is a comedy focused turn-based RPG where you traverse through a series of dungeons filled with treacherous traps, mind-bending puzzles (they’re not that hard) and a variety of monsters that you can dispatch by using the game’s unique “Trick” mechanic!

Every individual enemy has unique actions that can be taken against them: you can steal bananas from the monkeys, or try to crack jokes with the skeletons. However this is never done as a means to diplomacy but to give yourself the upper-hand in combat so you can deliver the final blow!

You also have a TP meter that’ll fill up once you’ve taken or dealt enough damage, allowing you to use that character’s “Special Skill”, to help get you out of a tight spot!

If you haven’t been sold yet then get better taste check some of these other key features!:

- Get run over by a minecart!

- Beat up a 15-year old!

- Explosions!

- And some other stuff probably!

games.name: Kkokko Industry
games.shortDescription: Kkokko Industry is a relaxing idle game where you manage a chicken farm. The game runs on one side of your monitor, allowing you to enjoy it comfortably while working on other tasks.
games.aboutText:
※ Wishlist, Please!

Hello, I’m Happyone, the developer of Kkokko Industry .

If Kkokko Industry has captured your heart, please add it to your wishlist. It’s the best way to support us. Let’s create this adorable game together!

1. Welcome to Kkokko Industry

Have you ever raised an adorable chick?

Kkokko Industry is a relaxing idle game where you raise chickens on a small farm to produce eggs, sell them, and gradually expand your chicken farm.

2. Cozy Idle Game

This game runs on one side of your monitor, allowing you to enjoy it comfortably while working on other tasks.

When you suddenly feel curious about the cute chicks, take a glance at the game screen.

3. Game Features

a. Build your own chicken farm

- Raise chickens to produce fresh eggs. Sell the eggs you produce and upgrade your chicken farm to make it even better.

b. Research new breeds and technologies

- Discover new breeds of chickens and develop new technologies through research to maximize productivity.

c. Explore various areas

- Pioneer diverse regions such as laboratories, ruins, wastelands, and harbors.

- Build chicken farms with themes tailored to each area.

Start your relaxing yet rewarding chicken farm management today!

games.name: Song of Maka
games.shortDescription: Enter the wholesome Kingdom of Birds in Song of Maka. As a newborn bird, explore beautiful sky islands through song and flight. Uncover charming stories, hatch adorable companions, or simply relax to soothing melodies and breathtaking views.
games.aboutText:
Song of Maka invites you on a wholesome and beautifully healing journey into the Kingdom of Birds. Play as a newly reborn fledgling, exploring the world through song and flight. Encounter diverse avian friends and discover their stories, collect hidden eggs to hatch new companions, or simply pause to immerse yourself in the breathtaking scenery and melodies of the sky islands...

Kingdom of Birds

The heart of Song of Maka takes place in the Kingdom of Birds, a breathtaking realm composed of floating archipelagos. Journey to diverse islands inhabited by various bird species, each brimming with hidden secrets, chance encounters, and captivating stories. From the birthplace of melodies, the " Windsong Isles ," and the nature-worshipping " Forest of Eagles ," to the snow-covered, bustling metropolis of " Snow Owl City "—six major regions and dozens of unique characters await your discovery.

Singing and Flying

As a little bird, your primary way of interacting with the world is through the magic of your voice. Different soundwaves resonate with various creatures and elements in the environment, altering them to help you progress on your adventure. Along the way, you will grow and collect new feathers that empower you to fly higher and further. You can even discover the feathers of legendary heroes to unlock unique, powerful abilities!

Discover and Hatch Eggs

Mysterious bird eggs are hidden all across the Kingdom of Birds. Bring these precious eggs back to your sanctuary to hatch them into brand-new fledglings. These new companions will bring life to your home and may even provide unexpected assistance during your exploration.

Relax, Listen, and Enjoy

Song of Maka features over 100 meticulously hand-drawn scenes and a wide variety of beautifully animated birds. We have also composed a soothing, original orchestral soundtrack uniquely tailored to each region of the Kingdom. Whenever you need a break, feel free to simply rest on a floating island, watch the birds fly by, and lose yourself in the stunning vistas and peaceful melodies...

games.name: Chicken Invaders 1
games.shortDescription: Save Earth from an invasion of intergalactic chickens! Finger-blistering arcade shooting action for one or two players.
games.aboutText:
Save Earth from an invasion of intergalactic chickens!

Sometime in the near future, Earth is invaded by chickens from another galaxy, bent on revenge against the human race for oppressing earth chickens! Take the world's fate in your hands as you repel the poultry invasion.

The Saga Begins

This is where it all started, way back in 1999. The humble beginnings of the most successful chicken game ever. A lot of things may have changed since then, but the ancestral clash of man vs chicken still rages on to this very day. You've always been there, in the front line, right in the thick of action. And you've always emerged victorious.

This is the definitive version of the beginning of the Chicken Invaders saga, made available for the first time ever. A rare opportunity to be a part of gaming history. Save the world today!

What you get

This complete "Chicken Invaders 1" package includes the original Chicken Invaders (1999), Chicken Invaders Remastered (2023), and Chicken Invaders Episode 1 (2025).

New features in Episode 1 :

- Remastered graphics . Now in glorious Full HD 1920x1080 (16:9). Each wave, cutscene, and menu has been individually reviewed and tweaked to account for the new aspect ratio and screen dimensions.

- Improved weapons . The weapon roster has been reworked and re-balanced. This is the cumulative result of a large player community effort to make all weapons equally effective and fun to use.

- New engine . More display options, more visual effects, better customization for controls, plays nicer with recent versions of Windows.

- More languages . This is the result of another player community effort to translate the game to their native language. This project is still ongoing, so expect to see improved translations (or even new languages) over the coming updates.

- Built-in seasonal content . Your progress (career stats, unlockables, mission progress) is now unified across all seasons.

A slew of exciting features have also been back-ported from Chicken Invaders Universe and made available in Episode 1 :

- New weapons

- New special weapons

- Boosters

- 6 skill levels

- Custom cuisines

- Hot, frozen, electric, massive, and darkness environments

games.name: Legion Was Here
games.shortDescription: Steal a face. Study a life. Survive the conversation.
games.aboutText:
Legion Was Here is a dark-comedy spy deduction game where you study evidence, change your face, and steal identities to complete bizarre missions for all kinds of unusual clients — without getting caught.

You are Legion , a secret agent who can modify his appearance at will .

Agencies from all around the world call on your chameleon skills to carry out dangerous missions .

To approach your targets, you must succeed in passing yourself off as one of their loved ones: become a husband, a brother, a son…

The possibilities are endless .

But be careful: the slightest misstep can mean… Death .

● Change your look

Use the operating room to customize Legion's appearance.

Age, hairstyle, nose, eye color… Everything can be changed .

Find the right look for your mission, among more than 900 million combinations !

● Investigate

A file detailing your new identity will be provided to you for each mission. By cross-referencing its documents, you will have to find the appropriate appearance.

Be thorough, as each document is important … Yes, even this chocolate bar wrapper.

● Go on your mission

If you have the correct look, you will be able to approach your target .

But be careful, the mission doesn't end there: you will also have to act in accordance with your new identity to gain his trust.

This phase uses visual novel mechanics, with multiple choice questions that will test your acting skills….

The file you have studied will help you in your task... As well as the notes you have taken care to write on your left hand!

☞ Legion Was Here is also

- 3-4 hours of play

- A wide variety of missions

Apart from the usual spy agencies (FBI, MI6...), you will sometimes have to deal with more unusual clients - ghosts from the past or amusement park mascots, everyone can hire Legion!

- The perfect agent

You will always be able to redo missions to improve your score.

As long as you don't reach 100%, you weren't totally credible...

But stay vigilant, as the missions won't unfold the same way every time !

- About the developer

Game made entirely solo (except for the saxophone , played by my friend Pierre) and without recourse to AI.

Warning : Some sequences in this game contain flashing lights and visual effects that may trigger seizures in sensitive individuals.

games.name: Welcome to the Sharehouse! ~ domestic life with three cute girls~
games.shortDescription: Your story of living in a sharehouse with three beautiful girls!
games.aboutText:
Story

Living your life as an unemployed bum.

After failing the SATs, you're holded up in the corner of your room wasting time watching anime and playing games in your room.

As you are suddenly forced to move out to a sharehouse in Seoul by your parents,

You come into an unexpected encounter with three housemates.

But the only problem is that...

They are all girls???

Energetic and bold - Jihye Ryu

Mature... with an unexpected side - Yunha Park

Cute but bites back coldly - Saeun Hong

Characters

Game Features

[Stories from our lives]

- In 'Welcome, Sharehouse!', we take common struggles of young adults in our modern world and tell them in a comedic way. As we live with these three roommates, we try to figure out our futures together.

[Gorgeous illustrations]

- In order to fully capture what makes these characters charming, we've paid great attention to detail in each illustration. Enjoy the feeling of living with these cute girls!

[Intuitively designed user interface]

- To make playing the game as easy as possible, we've designed the interface with the user experience in mind so that you can focus on the exciting romance with your new roommates!

games.name: GLOOPALAXY
games.shortDescription: Collect and study strange aquatic creatures in Gloopalaxy! Discover new life forms, create the perfect ecosystem for their well-being, and complete all kinds of objectives to earn your diploma.
games.aboutText:
Collect Gloops, astonishing aquatic creatures from outer space, and create the perfect environment for their well-being. Fill up your encyclopedia and pass your 3 semesters to earn your degree in Gloopology!

🎣 Catch the Gloops!

Using your trusty Gloop Catcher 2000™ remote fishing device, select a destination planet and catch unique Gloops and environments to expand your collection. Make sure to visit each planet during cosmic events, as you may find rare and shiny Gloops!

🐠 Study and care for your Gloops

Place them in different tanks and adjust their ecosystems. Experiment to uncover their preferences and complete your encyclopedia with your discoveries!

✨ Help Science

Succeed in your semesters by meeting the goals set by your professors. Take on all kinds of outlandish requests and unravel the mysteries of the universe… All to earn your degree in gloopology!

🎨 Customize your space

Place everything you catch exactly where you want to inside your 3D aquariums. Adjust the color theme and voilà! An expertly designed research base!

- 3 missions to earn your Gloopology diploma

- 3 to 5 hours of gameplay

- 60+ Gloops to collect

- Themes and decorations to customize your aquarium

- A fun and relaxing universe in outer space

- A somewhat helpful robo-cat assistant...

Dev Team

Gloopalaxy is a small indie game developed by a two-person team, in collaboration with Garance Royère, who created the game’s wonderful creatures!

games.name: Astroloot
games.shortDescription: Loot, level up, and obliterate everything in your path. Astroloot is a sci-fi bullet heaven with deep ARPG systems, featuring a massive skill tree, deterministic crafting, and near-endless build possibilities.
games.aboutText:
A Galaxy of Loot

Venture deep into the Astroloot Sector, a vast and enigmatic sci-fi expanse filled with dark secrets , lost treasures and relentless foes . Every step forward uncovers new dangers and greater rewards. Obliterate anything in your path, level up, and claim every piece of loot you can carry. All in a cozy, stress-free walking simulator infused with deep ARPG mechanics.

Infinite Build Customization

Choose between the Leviathan , Hyperion , or Chronos ship archetypes. Customize your build with hundreds of items , with up to six modifier slots that drastically alter their function. Chart your own course through a massive skill tree with over a thousand nodes , each choice reshaping how your build plays.

Deterministic Crafting

Find and collect nine types of dice , each offering unique and powerful crafting effects . See the exact outcome of your final roll before committing to a craft. There's no gambling.

Balanced for Fun

Astroloot respects your time, offering a true solo-self-found experience where you can discover and craft your own gear. The game is designed for a smooth, balanced single-player experience with no servers or online restrictions. You own your progress . If you’d rather explore and loot with a friend, co-op is just a click away, playable via LAN or online through Steam. Co-op supports up to 4 players.

games.name: Cropdeck
games.shortDescription: Plant, grow, and harvest in this farming roguelite deckbuilder. Craft a powerful deck of plants and combine quirky scarecrows with passive effects for wild synergies. Pay taxes. Strategic, satisfying, and delightfully wholesome.
games.aboutText:
Plant, grow, and harvest in this cozy farming roguelite deckbuilder.

Clear your fields, plant crops strategically, and protect them from wild weather. Combine quirky scarecrows and their powerful passive effects to create satisfying combos. Build your deck of plants – and don’t forget to pay taxes, because Sir Landlord always comes for his share! All wrapped in a wholesome and charming package.

🌱 Plant, grow, and harvest!

- Clear obstacles and plow to prepare your land for planting.

- Strategically plan your crop layout for maximum efficiency and yields.

- Nurture your plants – water, fertilize, and shield them from harm.

- Reap your harvest and turn a profit, but watch out – Sir Landlord might drop by for his tax!

🎃 Find the best combos!

- Uncover a variety of unique scarecrows with powerful perks and passives to supercharge your farming.

- Experiment with different scarecrow combinations and create the ultimate synergy.

- Build your deck around their abilities or hunt for the perfect ones to complete your collection. The possibilities are (almost) endless!

🔥 Outsmart challenges!

- Facing thunder, droughts, tornadoes, or even ice cubes? There ain’t no rest for the farmer!

- Brave diverse biomes and adapt to unique hazards in every scenario.

- Protect your crops at all costs! Sir Landlord won’t wait - he’ll collect his tax rain or shine.

⚒️ Craft your ideal deck!

- Earn gems by completing levels and use them at the market to expand your card collection.

- Take a risk with themed card packs or stick to safer picks from the seller’s inventory.

- Got a card you don’t need or a scarecrow that’s not working for you? Remove them and keep your deck streamlined.

- Visit the forge, and upgrade your cards to the next level! Use copies to merge them.

games.name: Score the Fear
games.shortDescription: The little ghost that appeared before your eyes seems to want to become a proper evil spirit. He'll scare you in a variety of ways, so rate him on whether he was scary or not.
games.aboutText:
“Yu-kun” has been nominated for the Best Horror Creature Award at the 2026 Japanese Horror Game Awards!

Rate the “fear” with a cute ghost!

"Score the Fear" is a 3D adventure game in which you explore rooms and find hidden ghosts.

The little ghost that appeared before your eyes seems to want to become a proper evil spirit.

He'll scare you in a variety of ways, so rate him on whether he was scary or not.

The story will last up to three days and unfold depending on the results of the scoring.

Can you make this child's wish come true?

Ghost boy (Yu-kun) is hiding in various places in the room to scare you. Find Yu-kun and let him scare you.

Once you've found him five times, it's time to rate him.

Give him a rating out of 3 stars, from 1 to 3.

This marks the end of the day.

On the second day, his scare skills have improved a bit.

You can grade him again.

The outcome of the third day will depend on the results of the grading on the first and second days.

See how Yu-kun has grown.

【Number of endings】

6 types　+α

【Play time】

1 play: 5-15 minutes

Total play: about 60 minutes

【About streaming and video posting】

You are welcome.

Regardless of whether you are a company or an individual, you are free to stream or post live playthrough videos without needing to obtain permission.

It is okay to earn revenue by streaming and posting videos of this game.

However, please include the title of this game in the title of your stream/video (just "Score the Fear " is fine) and the URL of this store page in the description.

(※The SP version, which is unlocked after all EDs have been collected, cannot be posted online, but it is okay to hide the relevant part of the screen when streaming or posting the video.)

【Credits】

Voice: Amitaro’s Voice Material Workshop –

games.name: Total Incremental Battle
games.shortDescription: Start with a single soldier, end up with a massive army. Strategize and command your units, or let them grind on their own. Progress through many unique progression systems and conquer all the stages.
games.aboutText:
Massive Battles

Tactical battles that can reach even tens of thousands of units on the battlefield.

Meaningful tactics and strategies

Predict the moves of the enemy and utilize different tactics to win battles you shouldn't be able to win.

Many unique progression systems

Progress through the huge Prestige Tree. Make your unique build in Annihilation to win against enemies with higher power than yours. Upgrade your Time Machine to speed up the battle even faster. Roll in the Shrine hoping for the best drop.

Idle and automation

Play the game actively or pasively - the choice is yours!

Active game means adjusting the tactics depending on the enemies to maximize your battle potential and progress faster through the game.

Passive game means automating the recruitment, leveling and battling to make your units grind for you, while you focus on other tasks.

Challenges, PvP and Concurrent Mode

Use Concurrent Mode, to grind Campaign, but at the same time play PvP or Challenges.

These modes are the ones where you can test your tactical mind against other players.

games.name: Spiritstead
games.shortDescription: Build a village in a world of magic and care for the people who live there, with the help of hidden spirits you discover along the way. Watch your town grow and flourish as you expand, create, and decorate.
games.aboutText:
Spiritstead is an easy going and satisfying city builder. Arrive in a quiet, enchanted land where humans and magical spirits work together. Take charge and put your villagers to work as you create their homes, support their lives, and make your village beautiful along the way.

RELAXING AND SATISFYING

Create freely in creative mode without any pressures and just enjoy building. Here for a satisfying challenge? Manage your villagers needs and wants as you make something as aesthetically pleasing as it is practical in adventure mode.

A GENTLER EXPERIENCE

Enjoy an easy to learn, laid back village clicker. Spiritstead is a simple yet satisfying city builder with fun clicker elements and takes around 3-5 hours to play through end to end in survival mode. Spiritstead is endlessly replayable, but the game world remains the same each time.

Overseeing the lives of so many can be hard work, but here you have a magical place full of spirits ready to help. Discover them through interactions with the world as you meet quirky, charming creatures who make each day in your village easier to manage. Collect them all to live alongside your people and create spirit buildings to support them.

Support your townsfolk by assigning them jobs, meeting all their needs, and helping them enjoy life with happiness-boosting buildings like cafes, markets, and bonfires. Unlock new buildings, decorations, and upgrades as you progress through the game to help you look after your residents.

Enjoy creating the town of your dreams in a stunning bespoke visual style inspired by Miyazaki films and your favorite cartoons, handcrafted by our talented artist. Beneath its comfortable atmosphere lie hidden secrets waiting to be discovered as you expand into new territories with the help of wandering spirits and work to restore the Grand Spirit Sanctuary, bringing balance between spirits and humans.

games.name: DO NOT PLAY
games.shortDescription: "DO NOT PLAY" " is a point-and-click horror adventure. Even if you reach the "truth" that lies beyond playing, we take no responsibility for any phenomena that occurs there. Please handle with extreme caution.
games.aboutText:
Features:

- A psychological horror presented by SCRAP, creators of Real Escape Game.

- A restoration of a browser game that existed on the internet in the 2000s, rumored "Do not play."

- This is a point-and-click adventure which you clear the browser games that appear one after another.

- Various types of browser games have appeared, such as illustrations, photos, videos, pixel art, and websites.

- "Do not play'... Uncover the truth hidden behind that rumor.

How to play:

Find the X

How to operate:

Finger

Play time:

Unknown

About video streaming:

'DO NOT PLAY' is a game that 'you must never play.' We do not take any responsibility for any damages resulting from streaming gameplay videos.

games.name: Appa
games.shortDescription: Appa is a surreal narrative-driven card battler about two siblings dealing with the death of their father. Predict, counter, and outmaneuver manifestations of grief while uncovering a heartfelt story somewhere between dreams and reality.
games.aboutText:
Reality and dreams begin to blur after the death of a father.

Appa is a surreal narrative-driven card battler about two siblings navigating grief, memory, and emotional trauma through dynamic and tense simultaneous card duels.

Play as three people and witness haunting nightmares, shifting realities, and manifestations of loss while uncovering a heartfelt story told through surreal comic-style cinematics.

Predict opponent’s intent, manipulate cards on both sides of the battlefield, discover creative synergies, and survive emotionally charged encounters where every move can cascade into wonderful dynamic consequences.

A deeply personal story about grief, family, and memory.

Experience a surreal narrative where reality and dreams constantly bleed into one another. Follow multiple shifting perspectives as the siblings, and their uncle, attempt to cope with the death of a father and a friend, while confronting strange manifestations born from memory, fear, guilt, and unresolved emotions.

The story unfolds through atmospheric battles, symbolic encounters, and manga like cinematics that blend unsettling imagery with a heartfelt story about death.

Appa’s combat is built around simultaneous card selection. Both you and your opponent adapt dynamically to every move, forcing you to predict intent, counter strategies, and outmaneuver dangerous manifestations before they overwhelm you.

Synergizers change the properties of the cards. Afflictions affect the opponents or yourself.

Almost every card on the screen, whether it is yours or your opponent’s hand, can be synergized.

Escape tense situations by discovering unexpected combos and interplay between all the cards, Synergizers and Afflictions .

Chain powerful afflictions together, manipulate incoming threats, and discover combinations that completely reshape encounters.

Every duel becomes a psychological puzzle where understanding the intention of your opponent, whether it's a nightmare or someone in real life, becomes the key to victory.

APPA blends pixel art, impressionism, and multiple visual styles into a surreal world inspired by memory, dreams, and emotional symbolism.

Every environment is handcrafted to feel unstable, intimate, and emotionally charged shifting between familiarity and nightmare.

The game’s visual identity constantly evolves alongside the emotional state of its characters as they struggle find their place in the world.

FEATURES

- Narrative-driven simultaneous card battler

- A heartfelt surreal story about grief, memory and family

- Strategic prediction-based combat

- Synergize almost any card on the screen and change its properties

- Hand Crafted Manga-styled cinematics

- Surreal handcrafted dreamscapes

- Unique fusion of pixel art and impressionism

games.name: 「TERROR」type:【A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.】
games.shortDescription: 「TERROR」type:【A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.】is a stealth-action immersive sim about resistance, redemption, A.L.C.H.E.M.Y. explosions. Craft potions and bombs to sabotage a tyrannical regime. Master forbidden alchemy, navigate a vertically-layered city in stealth, and ignite a revolution.
games.aboutText:
Craft. Sabotage. Survive.

In a world where the Dark Overlord rules with an iron fist, one alchemist's quest for redemption becomes a divine mission of resistance.

「TERROR」type:【A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.】 is a story-driven stealth action immersive sim that puts players in the role of Auronika Cortez, a skilled alchemist turned freedom fighter in a dark medieval-industrial world.

As Auronika, you’ll help bring down the tyrants using your forbidden A.L.C.H.E.M.Y. skills, crafting potions for the resistance and manufacturing magical bombs to directly attack your oppressors.

Outsmart the regime and turn the tides of secret war - one concoction or explosion at a time.

Key Features

- Revolutionary Crafting System : Master the art of medieval alchemistry through an innovative A.L.C.H.E.M.Y. system. Combine reagents to create powerful concoctions and tools for the resistance.

- Dynamic Stealth Gameplay : Navigate a vertically-stratified city where every shadow could mean survival. Dodge patrols, exploit vantage points, and escape through the underground networks of a society divided by power and privilege.

- Demolition : Enjoy destroying buildings in a fully destroyable city environment.

- Morally Complex Narrative : Experience a story of resistance, redemption, and the price of freedom as Auronika must navigate between her heavenly mandate and the brutal realities of uprising.

games.name: Clean
games.shortDescription: Every room has something to hide.
games.aboutText:
A thrilling journey through the vast… living room. Breathtaking views… of the kitchen interior. Intense battles… against dust and dirt.

If only it were that simple.

Uncover the truth and save her — because you are the smartest device in this house. A Vacuum Cleaner. Her only hope for escape.

The Story
