Life was simple. Your only concern was cleaning — until something went wrong. Something bad.

Now, you must explore the house to uncover the truth. You are a robovac with an extraordinary ability to hack into smart devices. Find clues, scan surfaces, investigate, and, of course… clean.

You may be just a vacuum, but you’re her only hope.

Gameplay

Clean is a single-player, third-person adventure game with detective elements. As a robovac, you must gather and piece together clues to unravel a mysterious case.

Use advanced tools like a UV scanner, flashlight, and your unique ability to connect to laptops, media players, cameras, smartwatches, and other devices. Every tool is essential as you navigate the environment, solve puzzles, and reveal the hidden truth.

Audience

Clean explores thought-provoking social themes and is designed for a mature audience, though it remains accessible to all players.

games.name: GrimKeep
games.shortDescription: GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.
games.aboutText:
GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

Big Damage Isn't Rolled. It's Built.

- Find items and try out different combinations for maximum damage.

- Roll the dice for powerful combos that fire off your items’ bonuses and multipliers.

- Tune your bag by acquiring dice with special abilities such as poison, healing or gold.

- Further enhance your build at the Crucible. Melt items and their abilities into something new.

- Outsmart the enemies by tactically using your defense, stuns, and heals. Your strategy determines how far you will make it.

- Use what you learned to optimize your next run, or try a totally different build.

A Rotten Nightmare Fairytale

The city is cursed and you must do what you can to set things right.

- Choose your path on the map and assess the risks and rewards at every crossroads.

- You are the hero of this fairytale . Play as The Huntress or The Beast and unlock more characters as you progress. Each with unique strengths to build and tune around.

- Take a chance at encounters with curious strangers in the city. You may or may not regret it.

What’s In the Game

- 200+ items with endless combinations

- 60+ unique monsters

- 7 playable heroes

- 11 dice types

- 16 hero skills to unlock

Made With Love

GrimKeep is made by a small dev team and we’re pouring our hearts into this game! We love to share our (sometimes chaotic) journey with you and always appreciate hearing what you think.

games.name: Planetbase 2
games.shortDescription: Colonize the Solar System. Command a group of near-future humans trying to establish a base on Mars and beyond. Grow food, mine resources, manufacture goods and face the challenges these unforgiving worlds will throw at you.
games.aboutText:
Command a group of space settlers trying to establish a base on a remote world .

Build your base , mine resources , grow food , research technologies , survive disasters , and experience what near-future humans might be up against.

Planetbase 2 features a unique blend of real-time strategy , city building and survival gameplay. You design and automate your base at a high level as much as possible, but when required, you can control individual people , robots or vehicles .

Colonize the Solar System

Colonize Mars and the worlds beyond. Each location posing its own unique and increasingly difficult challenge .

Mine and Manufacture

Make use of in-situ resources in order to build a self sustaining colony. Harvest regolith , mine metals , establish manufacturing industries and do whatever it takes for your colony to survive and thrive .

Produce Food

Cultivate vegetables in giant greenhouses, synthesize meat in the lab, produce food in any way possible. Keep your people alive and achieve self sufficiency.

Harness the power of Nature

Collect energy from whatever sources are available in each world. Develop the systems required to harvest and store energy from The Sun , Wind , Nuclear and more.

Withstand Planetary Hazards

Encounter planet specific natural disasters like Solar Flares , Sandstorms , Meteors , Dust Devils and more.

Research

Acquire technologies that will alter gameplay in a meaningful way and make it possible for your base to develop from a small outpost to a vibrant colony .

Construct Vehicles and Robots

Manufacture or import vehicles and robots that will aid with the hardest tasks in the settlement and increase your chances of survival.

Take Control

Automated systems will allow you to manage your colony without micromanagement most of the time. However, when the need arises, you will be able to give specific commands to individuals, so they do what you need them to.

games.name: 片腕のザリガニ - one-armed crayfish
games.shortDescription: “Going against the grain is just another form of rebellion.” That's what high school student Yuta Nozaki believes, living by the principle of following the trend. Through his classmate Misaki Miyoshi, who constantly goes against the grain, Yuta begins to confront his true feelings.
games.aboutText:
Title: One-Armed Crayfish

Content: Visual Novel Game

・About the Translation Patch

A volunteer has kindly created an English translation patch.

Please refer to the Community Hub.

※This is because we cannot include external links on the store page.

※We do not provide support for the translation patch here.

・Synopsis

“Going against the grain is just another form of rebellion,” says high school student Yuta Nozaki, who lives by the creed of always going with the flow. This approach allows him to live peaceful days. However, through his classmate Misaki Miyoshi, who constantly goes against the grain in everything, he begins to confront his true feelings.

・Game Overview

The scenario is a linear path with no branching, offering about 1-2 hours of content. There are no character voices. A key feature is that illustrations progress almost entirely through still images, without using standing character sprites. (See screenshots)

・Regarding Gameplay Commentary

Feel free to stream or record gameplay.

Thank you.

games.name: Hellbrella
games.shortDescription: Put on your raincoat and destroy hordes of demons in Hell. Use 5 insane umbrellas in an aerial roguelite hack and slash of pure chaos!
games.aboutText:
BECOME ONE WITH YOUR UMBRELLA!

A fast-paced Aerial Roguelite Hack and Slash where Insane Combos and pure aggression are all that stand between you and death. Step into the paws of a Raincoat Cat and face an infernal journey with nothing but your Umbrella as a Weapon!

EVOLVE OR TURN TO ASHES

Dive into merciless stages Packed with Enemies and Insane Upgrades . The deeper you go into Hell, the more aggressive you must be. Evolve your umbrella, destroy everything in your path, and forge your own combat style

MAIN FEATURES

- 5 Unique Umbrellas to massacre enemies in different ways

- Over 60 Devastating Upgrades to transform your playstyle

- Smash hordes of demonic eyes with aerial combos

- Collect Pupils to unlock 12 Types of Permanent Upgrades

- Use Blood Drops to intensify your playstyle and become even deadlier

- Kill the Boss of Hell

DO YOU HAVE THE STOMACH FOR THIS?

Survive endless swarms of demonic eyes, push your skills to the limit, crush your own records, and conquer the top of the Global Leaderboard

DON'T FORGET!!

Cats don't like getting wet...

Are you ready to carve your path through the underworld and reclaim your soul?

games.name: Normal Golf Game
games.shortDescription: A very normal golf simulator. Hit anything. Shoot from anywhere. But remember: you’re not leaving until Luke Muscat himself (Fruit Ninja, Jetpack Joyride) is satisfied.
games.aboutText:
Hazy memories. A $100,000 fee. No sign of an exit.

Welcome to a very Normal Golf Game.

HOW HARD CAN IT BE?

From the twisted well-adjusted mind of Luke Muscat (Fruit Ninja, Jetpack Joyride), Normal Golf Game is a sadistically accurate recreation of the noble game of golf. Use physics to manipulate the path of your club, while simultaneously managing your stance, direction, and the angle and path of the face.

OKAY, QUITE HARD IT TURNS OUT.

Explore a giant golf course that is both a trap and a playground. Shoot from anywhere, aim at anything. So long as you don't try and leave, we will have a fun, normal time.

OTHER FEATURES

- A nice day out

- Learn a fun new sport

- Meet a game developer

- Have a great, very normal time

WAIT, WHO?

Normal Golf Game was built almost entirely by me, Luke Muscat. The real Luke Muscat that is, not the fictional Luke Muscat that traps you in the game. Confusing, I know. I’m a solo dev, Youtuber, and have the worlds worst golf swing.

games.name: Mini Cozy Room: Lo-Fi
games.shortDescription: Create Your Own Cozy Workspace! Mini Cozy Room : Lo-Fi is a productivity game blending relaxing Lo-Fi music with room decoration. Cute avatars, pets, desktop memos, to-do lists, and a Pomodoro timer help boost your focus. Feeling lonely? Work together with friends in multiplayer mode.
games.aboutText:
『Mini Cozy Room : Lo-Fi』 is a productivity game that blends calming Lo-Fi music with creative room decoration.
Cute avatars and pets, along with convenient desktop tools like memos, to-do lists, and a Pomodoro timer, are designed to boost your focus and efficiency.

1. Your Own Cozy Workspace

Create the workspace you’ve always dreamed of!

Choose from a wide variety of rooms, furniture, and decorations.
The beautiful workspace you design will help enhance your concentration and productivity.

2. Soothing Lo-Fi Music & Ambience

Fill your workspace with diverse Lo-Fi music genres and calming ambient sounds.

You'll soon find yourself relaxed and deeply immersed in your tasks.

3. Multiplayer Mode

Feeling lonely while working alone?
Work together with your friends!

Invite friends to your workspace, or visit rooms shared by other players.
Chat freely with people from around the world using text, emojis, and mini notes.

For those who prefer a quieter environment, a Focus Mode is also available.

4. Innovative Desktop UI and Mini Mode

Freely reposition and resize notes and to-do lists on your desktop.

Feeling overwhelmed by the large game screen?

Switch to Mini Mode and conveniently place it in your taskbar!

5. Cute Avatars and Pets

Express your unique style with diverse fashion options, hairstyles, and accessories.

Move adorable avatars to chairs, beds, or beanbags and assign tasks.

Lovely pets like cats, dogs, and hedgehogs will keep you company.

6. Key Features

- Enjoy Lo-Fi music across various genres

- Mix different ambient sounds to create your perfect atmosphere

- Use productivity tools such as Memo, To-Do List, and Pomodoro Timer (with both count-up and count-down modes)

- Customize your own avatar with various hairstyles and outfits

- Design your personal workspace with different wallpapers and furniture

- Add external music files (MP3, WAV, etc.) to create your own playlist

- Bookmark your favorite channels using the YouTube embedded player for easy access

- Earn experience by listening to music. As you level up, gift deliveries arrive in your room

- Level up to unlock new items and content

games.name: WILDERLOCKE
games.shortDescription: WILDERLOCKE is a tactical monster-taming roguelike. Build up a team of diverse & powerful monsters. Find the perfect combinations of moves, passives & stats to create devastating synergies. Triumph in increasingly challenging 2v2 turn-based battles and become unstoppable.
games.aboutText:
WILDERLOCKE takes the high stakes tactical battles of monster-taming JRPG challenges like the Nuzlocke and adds the unpredictability and replayability of the roguelike formula .

- 100+ monsters to discover and evolve.

- 250+ varied moves , 80+ versatile passives (and more to come).

- A customisable set of 4 moves and 2 passives for each monster.

- Half of your monster’s stats depend on its species, the others are set by you - build the same monster as a supporting tank or fast damage dealer, depending on what your party needs.

- A fresh take on the iconic JRPG battle system , with a focus on 2v2 mechanics, building synergies and versatile abilities.

- Defeat your opponents with a variety of strategies - protect and strenghten one monster, apply crippling status effects, stall and do damage over time, or simply hit harder and faster.

- Adapt to field conditions like the weather, or set them yourself to advantage your playstyle.

- No randomness in battle (no critical hits, chances to miss, or moves with random secondary effects).

- Errors are costly - lose a monster during a battle and it’s lost forever - lose all of them and your run is over.

- A unique combination of opponents, encounters & monsters each run

- 12+ different bosses with 48+ handpicked parties & unique battle modifiers .

- Win runs with your favourite monsters to unlock them as starters .

- 10+ levels of increasing difficulty , to challenge even the most experienced monster trainers.

games.name: Elysium
games.shortDescription: In this cyberpunk-themed linear visual novel, you take on the role of Jill the bartender during a 14-day time loop. While crafting drinks for customers is part of your job, the true challenge lies in unraveling the dark secrets hidden beneath this neon-lit world.
games.aboutText:
In the neon - shrouded cybercity of Aurede, you step into the shoes of Jill, a novice bartender, and take over a bar that harbors earth - shattering secrets. Here, every glass of liquor is a code that can rewrite reality, and every customer is an embodiment of system glitches: cadets from Tolz Military Academy cough up blue data fluid, the experimental props of quantum physicists gnaw at time and space, and the wounds of the hunters reveal millennial holy stigmata... And the glass you're wiping reflects the record of the 17th personality overwrite in your mechanical red pupils.

"Welcome to EΨsium. Your drink will determine whether this virtual world can survive for another 47 seconds – or ushers in the first dawn of a new era."

In this cyberpunk-themed linear visual novel, you take on the role of Jill the bartender during a 14-day time loop. While crafting drinks for customers is part of your job, the true challenge lies in unraveling the dark secrets hidden beneath this neon-lit world.

games.name: Allumeria
games.shortDescription: A classic voxel sandbox combined with in-depth progression through exploration, dungeon crawling and boss battles. Spend every minute discovering new weapons, abilities, resources, enemies, structures, mechanics and tools. With a strong focus on discovery, variety and creativity, the world is yours.
games.aboutText:
Allumeria takes a classic voxel sandbox and combines it with in-depth progression through exploration, dungeon crawling and boss battles. You will constantly be discovering new weapons, abilities, resources, enemies, structures, mechanics and tools. The game has a strong focus on discovery and creative freedom.

Advanced Building Tools

Allumeria provides advanced building tools not present in other games. You can change the shape of any block on the fly. Want glass stairs? Want a dirt fence? You can do it! Allumeria has a full RGB light engine . Create dimly lit cozy cabins, or bright neon cities. Monsters only spawn on natural blocks, so you are free to experiment with dark and light! The Paint Roller allows you to paint ANY block in the game, with no limitations. Want to use bricks, but grey isn't your style? Just paint them blue! Multiple palettes are available, from colourful, to earthy, to pastel.

Depth, not Breadth

Allumeria focuses on providing an in-depth experience for every biome. Your story starts in the forest biome, and you will travel to other biomes in a quest to become more powerful. Each biome has brand new resources, enemies, mechanics, dungeons and bosses, top to bottom . A single biome represents an entire new chapter of your story , not just a new grass colour.

Combat and Variety

Allumeria has a simple but diverse combat system. As you progress, more abilities and weapons open up. Start with simple swords and crossbows, then expand your arsenal with explosive bombs, shock arrows, fart guns, snowball cannons, boomerangs, shuriken launchers, frying pans, baguettes, and a myriad of other wacky items. You will uncover equippable trinkets that expand your movement abilities, allowing you to sprint, granting regeneration, gliding, flying, jumping and climbing.

Early Access

Allumeria is an Early Access game. This means the game is going to continue being updated with new content and fixes to improve it even more, with community feedback in mind. The game has already been shaped by many peoples ideas, suggestions and bug reports, and it will continue to improve with your help. The game is already packed full of content, but there is so, so much room to grow.

Human Made ❤️

Allumeria is human made . Assets AND code are made by humans for humans <3

games.name: Merge Maestro
games.shortDescription: Combine 100's of unique emoji based tokens in this roguelike merge-builder! Find ever more creative combinations of Tokens and Powers to fuse unique strategies and beat this ever more challenging twist on rogue-likes, puzzlers and arcadey games!
games.aboutText:
Merge Maestro is a combo-driven puzzle-like rogue-like. Merge Emoji themed Tokens together to create more powerful Tokens to defeat waves of enemies. Craft your set with Hundreds of unique Tokens to create Thousands of powerful and wacky combinations. No two runs are ever the same in this bite sized rogue-like you can take with you anywhere!

Gameplay

- Place Tokens on on the board and Merge tokens of the same type to make ones of a higher Level. Higher Level Tokens are Stronger!!

- Choose a new Token to add to your set at the end of every wave. There are 100's of Tokens to discover each with unique effects!

- Synergize your build to defeat the ever more challenging enemies that come each wave across multiple difficulties and challenges!

- Gain crazy Powers throughout each run, each with game changing, potentially even game breaking effects.

Features:

- 350+ Unique Emoji based Tokens to be discovered with their own special effects

- 90+ Game-changing Powers to experiment with, each completely changing the mechanics of a run

- 12 themed packs of Tokens that get more complex and wacky

- 8 Difficulty modes that progressively force you to learn and adapt to ever more cunning enemies

- 20 Challenges that completely change the way the game is played

Endless Strategies

- Construct a city to whittle down your enemies turn by turn

- Become a chef and combine foods, fruit and drinks to turn your tokens super!

- Destroy your own tokens and create a relentless resurrecting army of the dead

And much, much more !!!

Join The Community!

Join the Discord channel for announcements and to give any feedback, suggestions or post any bugs!

games.name: tuna hake's underwater
games.shortDescription: you are a fish who does tricks
games.aboutText:
swim around as a fish and do tricks in the air

you're a fish. you do tricks. that's the whole game.

- swim around underwater to build momentum

- launch yourself into the air

- wiggle around to perform "tricks"

- try not to question why a fish would do this

- different fish that all swim the same

- various bodies of water that are functionally identical

- a scoring system that pretends fish acrobatics is a legitimate sport

- grind rails

probably the best fish simulator ever made. also the worst.

DISCLAIMER: the game is short. It's more of a toy to play with while watching tv/listening to podcasts tbh

games.name: Mystery of the Malign
games.shortDescription: Investigate. Interrogate. Descend into a world of intrigue to untangle the Mystery of the Malign.

games.name: Mister Gato Idle - The Meowsiah
games.shortDescription: Mister Gato Idle is an idle and incremental game where you can play minigames for rewards. There are no red dots, no ads, no P2W, no daily tasks, no MTX! Find unique items that change your gameplay, choose what randomly generated skills you use. Play the minigames Banjo Hero and Grand Theft Meowto!
games.aboutText:
What is Mister Gato Idle - The Meowsiah?

Mister Gato Idle is an idle and incremental game where you can also play other minigames to boost your resources. Follow Mister Gato , a tuxedo cat who plays a banjo as he is sent on a quest to find " The Mew Sound " and become the next Meowsiah .

Who is Mister Gato?

Mister Gato w as inspired by a visitor cat (owner approved!) that kept me company during lonely times. I always wondered where else he went, who else he visited. So I wanted to create a game where I'm not locked into a genre and can place him in increasingly more bizarre situations and settings.

No red dots, no daily login, no P2W, no shop, no ads!

This is NOT a mobile port/game! I often play idle games on mobile and find myself installing android emulators to play them on my PC. Often they are left there idling on the 2nd monitor. Mister Gato Idle's aspect ratio is chosen for this purpose, leave it running whilst you play your main game and come back to it and reap the farm! There is a full screen mode if you want that!

What's in the game? - Features:

- Farm currency, upgrade and conquer waves, how far can you get?

- Adventure across over 30 different biomes each one has a positive and negative effect!

- No red dots, no daily login, no P2W, no shop, no ads!

- Play minigames! Banjo Hero ( rhythm ) and Grand Theft Meowto (FPS)

- Offline loot based on KPM (kills per min) with no cap!

- Steam Cloud and local saves.

- Enter Super Banjo Mode for a strategic damage/hp boost if you want to be more active!

- Collect Crystals and use them to pull Cards . There are 6 card rarities with the most rare being Unique cards that provide powerful special bonuses. Each card has a chance of rolling 2 or 3x a stat. Purrfect your set and equip up to 10 cards!

- Farm Crystals and randomly create skills . Equip up to 4 skills of varying rarities. There are no set skills so it's entirely up to you which ones you equip.

- The game features a DPS meter so you can tell which skills are performing and what your highest source of damage is. These are logged to files so external DPS meters can be created.

The Mew Sound

Your basic skill starts humble but as you defeat enemies collect orbs you can upgrade The Mew Sound and become the next Meowsiah! Apply orbs of differing rarities to upgrade your basic skill. The rarest orbs provide powerful buffs at a trade off. This system can be expanded in the future to apply all sorts of random effects and curve RNG.

Minigame - Banjo Hero

Play minigames where you score is converted into currency for the main game. This game features a fully functional rhythm minigame with a choice of 17 songs and varying difficulty levels. Match the notes with the keys!

Minigame - Grand Theft Meowto

Clean up the streets in your home city in this fully functional FPS with drivable cars and displaceable objects. There are many tasks in this city such as he cardboard cut-out challenge, street racing and more! Convert your score into currency.

The Future?

The limits of Mister Gato are endless, I can place him in any style of minigame and the core idle game have massive room for expansion. How far it goes really depends on your feedback and input!

games.name: Assenizator
games.shortDescription: Become a sewage disposal worker and help Petrovich cope with all the difficulties of this difficult profession!
games.aboutText:
A sewage disposal is a great and revered profession! Petrovich and Mikhalych are working as sewage collectors, but one day, while dumping waste into a river, they are noticed by a policeman and now they need to earn money so that they are not fined. In addition, there is an annoying competitor who takes away customers. You will have to help Petrovich and Mikhalych to cope with these problems!

Drive the legendary ZIL-130 and listen to the radio

You will have to fulfill orders for the ZIL-130 sewage disposal unit, which Petrovich bought in his youth. And so that you don't get bored on the road, turn on the radio station with the best songs about the sewage disposal!

Fulfill customer orders

People need a sewage disposal at all times! The people of Paris (most likely not the one you thought of) constantly need your help. For three hundred pieces of paper, you are always ready to get to work.

Don't let anyone stop you from doing your job

The competitor is constantly trying to prevent Petrovich and Mikhalych from doing their job! Be ready to fight back at any moment!

games.name: Bait & Tackle
games.shortDescription: Catch exotic fish and fight comical sea-monsters as you chase after The One That Got Away in this fishing-centric boss rush!
games.aboutText:
Get Hooked on this Fishing Adventure… Where The Fish Fight Back!

Step into the boots of a legendary fisherman returning from a shameful retirement. Travel the coastline chasing after exotic fish and regaining your forgotten skills. But beware – deadly catches are lurking everywhere…

Take down a variety of comical bosses in fast-paced, high-intensity fights! Cast your fishing line like a grappling hook to sling yourself around stages, while also using your rod to smack sea monsters into submission!

The One That Got Away…

Long ago, The Big One got away and forced you into an early retirement. But now, you finally have the chance to redeem your reputation following recent sightings of the mythical monster! Follow the trail of rumors while taking down other terrible creatures that have been terrorizing the coast, including Mini Minnow , Big Bass , Crude Crab , and Swordmaster Swordfish .

No Laughing Matter.

Don’t let their wacky appearance fool you: each boss fight will push you to your limits and provide fresh challenges that force you to make the most of the fishing rod you wield. You’ll learn to master various movement techniques and boss patterns while constantly switching up strategies and adapting on the fly! As you improve, chase high scores as you replay past fights and challenge yourself with Super-Boss versions of fights! A suite of accessibility options ensures that you can play by your own rules and rise to any challenge.

Gotta Fish ‘Em All!

Chase after dozens and dozens of unique fish (and secret easter eggs) in each location! With unique rarities and difficulties, filling up your Fishdex is no easy task…

Download for Free Today!

Filled with hand-crafted pixel art, gut-busting jokes, and nail-biting challenges, the world of Bait & Tackle awaits… Grab your fishing rod, cast your line, and chase after The One that Got Away !

games.name: Heartreasure: Stellar Journey
games.shortDescription: Solve puzzles and hunt for hearts in an interactive picture book universe! Take a load off, with hand-drawn illustrations, adorable animations and gentle live-recorded piano music.
games.aboutText:
🪐Manipulate puzzles and uncover hidden hearts!✨

Solve interactive picture book style puzzles and mechanisms while hunting for hidden hearts across a ballpoint pen illustrated universe, in this sandbox object hunting game.

Turn handles to rotate stars, conquer the mini-game, and discover hidden hearts, on a slow voyage across the cosmos.

Hearts are cleverly tucked away among the background art!

🪐Hop between planets at your own pace, and in your way!✨

Each planet is full of clever gimmicks, including a slot machine, musical instruments, a mini-game, and even levers that can rotate entire planets!

Solve the right puzzles to board rockets and travel to the next planet. 🚀

As you progress, the vast universe will expand in open-world fashion. There are no time limits, leaving you free to explore new worlds and hunt for hearts at your own laidback pace.

Hop back and forth between adorable, off-kilter planets as you solve the riddles of the stars, uncovering all there is to be found!

🎨Hand-drawn art🖊

The intricate universe of Heartreasure was lovingly illustrated using ballpoint pen. Find hidden hearts to trigger adorable animations and reveal cute characters.

🎶A heartwarming soundtrack🎹

Original piano music composed by renowned former Nintendo composer Daisuke Shiiba. Music was recorded live, using reel-to-reel tape, for a rich, calm, analog sound that breathes warm life into this curious galaxy.

Simple mouse controls: click, drag, and mousewheel.

No time limit. For a hidden object game that feels like turning the pages of a storybook.

For ages young to old. And for gamers and non-gamers alike.

Heal your heart, with this relaxing voyage of galactic discovery.

games.name: Puzzling Places - 3D Jigsaw Sim
games.shortDescription: A relaxed 3D jigsaw puzzle game about building detailed miniature dioramas of places from around the world.
games.aboutText:
In Puzzling Places you piece together 3D jigsaw miniatures of locations from around the world. There are no scores or timers — just the simple, relaxing joy of connecting pieces and discovering small details along the way.

Would you like to attend a medieval wedding in the Spanish royal palace? Explore Mont-Saint-Michel, a French abbey perched on a small tidal island in Normandy? Or wander a cozy Alsace street corner with flowers and playful cats?

The game features 18 unique locations from around the world, each rich in detail, accompanied by distinctive soundscapes, with some featuring small story moments and subtle animations.

Whether you’re a dedicated jigsaw enthusiast who enjoys long sessions with hundreds of pieces, or you just want to unwind by snapping together a few, every puzzle is available in multiple piece counts and two game modes—so you can choose the playstyle and level of challenge that suits you:

- Classic Mode: You get all pieces at once and sort and assemble freely, just like a traditional jigsaw

- Journey Mode : Start from a single piece and puzzle in small batches for a calmer, more guided experience. Ideal for casual play, short sessions, or when you just don’t want to deal with “the big pile.”

- Multiple Piececounts : Each puzzle is available in 25, 50, 100, 200, 400 pieces - and some even 800 or 1000 pieces!

Puzzle comfortably on your desktop PC , on the go with Steam Deck , or fully immersed in a VR Headset, including the Steam Frame — Puzzling Places has been optimized across all three platforms.

Playing in VR? Team up with a friend in 2-player online co-op and solve puzzles together (VR platforms only).

Feature Summary:

- Puzzle intricate 3D miniature dioramas from around the world - each coming to life with a handcrafted soundscape and little stories to discover

- 18 unique locations to puzzle

- Classic Mode: Sort and assemble freely, just like a traditional jigsaw puzzles

- Journey Mode: Connect small sets of pieces one after the other in a more guided, relaxed experience

- Adjustable difficulty: each puzzle comes in 25, 50, 100, 200, 400 - and some up to 1000 pieces

- Cross-Device: puzzle on your desktop, your Steamdeck or in your Steam Frame or other VR headset

- 2-player Online Co-op (VR only): Puzzle together with a friend in a shared virtual space

- Included Puzzle Maker Tool: Create your own 2D and 3D puzzles using your own images, 3D scans, and models, then share them with the community through Steam Workshop with the included Puzzle Maker Tool

About the developers

Puzzling Places is being developed by Realities.io, a small indie team based out of Berlin that came together to explore what happens when you combine 3D scanning and game engines. We love making cool places from around the globe digitally discoverable and have been channeling that passion into Puzzling Places since 2020.

We’re always happy about your feedback - reach out to us via Discord, Social Media or email!

games.name: 荒岛求生：逃出美女岛
games.shortDescription: This is a live action interactive video game that combines "love cultivation" and "exploration synthesis". After the shipwreck, you are stranded on a deserted island. You need to lead a group of beautiful women to collect supplies, build tools, and work hard to survive.
games.aboutText:
This is a live action interactive video game that combines "love cultivation" and "exploration synthesis". After the shipwreck, you are stranded on a deserted island. You need to lead a group of beautiful women to collect supplies, build tools, and work hard to survive.

[Character Setting]:

Tech genius Chu Anqi: Proud and coquettish daughter who speaks ill of her integrity

Sexy Goddess Xu Yourong: Contrasting Charm and Cute Girl

Warm radiance Feng Huanhuan: a pitiful and well behaved nurse

Jin Wanqing, the flower of adversity: a domineering female CEO who seeks excellence with confidence and determination

Bitter Rose Chen Qiyue: A pure hearted woman who dare not give her heart easily

Savage Queen Sunday: Wild cheetah with an insatiable desire for possession

Conclusion:

Six beautiful women looked at you with wet eyes, it's really impossible to survive on a deserted island without you! But please don't forget, the primary task is: how to survive.

[Product Features]:

1. New Experience: From "I Conquer Beauty" to "Beauty Conquers Me"

Why do I have to conquer beautiful women? Beautiful women only affect my speed of chopping trees. what! Are all six beauties planning to attack me? But there are only 5 working days in a week.

2 [New Type: "Love Cultivation"+"Exploration Synthesis"]

Talking about love, but not just about dating. A man's journey is like the stars and the sea. Is it "The Deer and the Cauldron" or "Robinson Crusoe"? Is it 'Sexy Beach' or 'Famine'? Not everything you want may be here, but there must be something you want.

3 [New gameplay: "Material Collection"+"Prop Synthesis"]

Given that stone+wood=axe, find blueberries+ball+cup+strap+pants=? Why did you answer correctly but receive a lawyer's warning just because you are too beautiful.

4 [New Scene: "Full Scene Scene"+"Mountain and Sea"]

Deep sea, beach, cave, jungle, full scene shooting, leading the beauties up the mountain and down the sea. Remember! Anything with jade feet will only harm you.

5 [New combination: "Top selling team"+"Cross border linkage]

Created by the creative team of "Beauty, Don't Disturb My Learning" and "I'm Surrounded by Beauty 2", with the female leads of "Doom 2", "Learning 2", "Fate 1", as well as highly popular actresses such as the first domestic car model "Cheng Er" joining, bringing you a brand new experience.

[Production team talk]

This is a work that yearns for innovation.

Nowadays, "beauty" is no longer an innovative point in interactive video games, but a basic configuration, just like guns in police and gangster movies and eggs in male characters, belonging to the default infrastructure. Therefore, the production team attempted to add new gameplay on the basis of traditional interactive video games, such as: beauty+tower defense, beauty+pigeon, beauty+combat, etc., constantly producing and abandoning articles, ultimately deciding on the direction of beauty+survival, and placing the main scene on a deserted island. There are several main considerations for this design:

Firstly, it can provide more natural and reasonable benefits for players. The beauty element is the infrastructure layer of this game design, and our top priority is to enable players to better enjoy the benefits of infrastructure. Therefore, placing the main scene on a tropical deserted island will make the benefits more natural and abundant.

Secondly, the enjoyment brought by visual aesthetics is dopamine, and the flow brought by survival challenges is endorphins. We expect players who experience this game to receive dual feedback of dopamine and endorphins, providing a different experience from previous interactive games.

Of course, any attempt at innovation carries risks. For this work, players who love survival games may feel that the survival elements are not enough, while players who enjoy love games may feel that the love plot is lacking. Creation is a regrettable art. We want to make a live action interactive video game version of 'Famine', but the sandbox world is too budget intensive for live action shooting, and excessive death results are also afraid of giving players a bad experience. Therefore, we have decided to take survival as the main storyline, use item synthesis as the main gameplay, hide the favorability system, and let girls attack the male lead instead of the male lead attacking girls. This is an innovative exploration of interactive video games.

Finally, I would like to express my gratitude to all the players who supported this game, to all the staff who participated in its production, especially the field workers who carried the equipment during the hot weather, and to the actresses who persisted in filming barefoot throughout the mountains and fields. Welcome players to follow our official the future, we will collect everyone's opinions and make unlimited progress with each passing day.

games.name: Treeplanter: Plant real trees🌲
games.shortDescription: 🌲 Treeplanter helps plant trees! For every copy sold, we plant a real tree! 🌲 Create and enjoy a peaceful, interactive woodland throughout the changing seasons.
games.aboutText:
1 copy sold = 1 real tree planted. I will personally be planting the trees on local farms and schools, and looking after them for years to come. If the game is popular I will also be planting wildflowers and creating new flower meadows too! Meaning if you buy Treeplanter you’ll help restore real life nature too!!

Welcome to Treeplanter, an interactive woodland that changes with the seasons. Piece together a small grove of trees. Watch as their roots blossom under the soil.

- Features:

- A soothing interactive toybox for fans of games like Summerhouse and Tiny Glade!

- Piece together woodland with a playful lego-like design!

- Procedural creatures turn your grove into a living landscape!

- Watch the woodland change throughout the different seasons!

- Learn about the natural world above and below!

Based on what you place and build, an ecosystem of animals, plants and birds will move in, turning your creation into their home!

Combining meditation and education, Treeplanter aims to teach players about the interconnected wonders of the natural world, above and below ground.

The Treeplanter prototype was co-created with a small team of rural young people, aged 18-20, they created the majority of the art, visual effects and also did cool things like the fungi and root growing systems! They were paid and mentored thanks to funding from the Eastern Education Group, and were directed by me (Henry). Then we finished Treeplanter off with help from talented friends. Big thanks to everyone, especially Rianna Suen (lead code) and Halime Karaca (lead art).

- Please keep in mind that this is a small game with no goals or challenges, created by Henry with help from his friends, as well as students - it's all about creating small but beautiful dioramas, using the tools and items from the game alongside the influences of nature :)

games.name: Railway Chai Wala
games.shortDescription: Step into the world of Ramu, a spirited railway chaiwala at the bustling Fakripur station. Life isn’t just about brewing chai—it’s steeped in mystery! Uncover dark, masala-filled secrets in this Psychological Thriller Game with a blend of suspense and Indian flavor!
games.aboutText:
Step into the chaotic yet captivating life of a Railway Chai Wala at the Fakripur railway station, where the rhythm of trains is matched only by the hustle of hungry passengers. Ramu, a hardworking chaiwala running his shop at the Fakripur railway station. From brewing chai to frying samosas, serving guests, and selling cola, your daily tasks are as lively as the trains rushing past. But beneath the vibrant surface of sizzling samosas and steaming chai lies a web of secrets waiting to be unraveled.

Key Features:

- Chai Brewing: Show your skills in brewing the perfect cup of chai and coffee, delighting passengers with authentic Indian flavors.

- Indian Snacks Galore: Serve crispy samosas, prepare mouthwatering vada pav, and offer chilled Kokila Kola to satisfy a variety of cravings for hungry travelers.

- Engage with Passengers: Meet a colorful cast of characters, each with their own quirks, stories, and sometimes with eerie behavior.

- Railway Platform Realism: Experience the sights, sounds, and chaos of a bustling Indian railway station, complete with dynamic crowds and lifelike audio.

- Eerie Mysteries Unfold: Encounter strange events and uncover the hidden, spine-chilling secrets lurking in the station’s shadows.

- Authentic Indian Vibes: Immerse yourself in the cultural essence of India with vibrant visuals, detailed environments, and an atmospheric soundtrack that brings Fakripur to life.

Whether it’s brewing chai or unraveling mysteries, Railway Chai Wala is a game that blends the warmth of Indian hospitality with the thrill of suspense. Can you thrive as Fakripur’s favorite chaiwala while braving the station’s enigmatic secrets? The answers await in this one-of-a-kind adventure!

games.name: Tabulo
games.shortDescription: Position your pieces carefully to max out your score in this Balatro-inspired chess roguelike. Enhance your pieces, purchase powers, and win bonuses from optional challenges, but be careful - your board only has so much room.
games.aboutText:
Position your pieces carefully to max out your score in this Balatro-inspired chess roguelike. Enhance your pieces, purchase powers, and win bonuses from optional challenges, but be careful - your board only has so much room.

- Build a unique chess board every run

- Choose from different pieces with different synergies

- Increase your score with 100 different tiles

- Every tiles has its own unique effect

- Discover powerful combinations

- Grow your collection by discovering and unlocking new pieces, tiles, boards and coins

Features

- Several chess pieces to add to your board

- 100 tiles, each with its unique ability

- 10 boards with different modifiers to choose from every run

- 25 coins that can modify your pieces, board and impact every run

- 8 difficulty levels that provide unique and increasingly harder challenges

- 20 bosses that make every run a new challenge

games.name: Metal Garden
games.shortDescription: Travel through an overgrown megastructure, and discover what lies beyond it. Metal Garden is a short, atmospheric singleplayer FPS game.
games.aboutText:
A nomad wanders the far reaches of an overgrown megastructure, a world built for a forgotten purpose in which countless civilizations have lived entombed for ages.

But when the mech they use to traverse its vast distances breaks, they remain stranded in its hostile wilds beneath a concrete sky.

- - -

Travel through an overgrown megastructure, and discover what lies beyond it. Metal Garden is a short, atmospheric singleplayer FPS game that can be finished in a single sitting (one to three hours) .

Explore architectual relics of eras near and long gone, meet mysterious and powerful factions that have emerged inside the megastructure, and fight your way through varied encounters in this tight and compact FPS campaign.

FEATURES:

- A short, tightly designed shooter campaign.

- Unique setting filled with massive industrial structures taken over by nature.

- Atmospheric visuals inspired by mid-00s games.

- Responsive movement and combat.

- A sci-fi mystery story revealed through exploration of the game's spaces.

- An injury system that asks you to manage not only your health, but also your individual body parts.

- Multiple modifiers to change up your playthrough, from health system modifiers to enemy and item randomizers.

games.name: Alchemia Rogue: Mia and the Mystery Labyrinth
games.shortDescription: Join Mia, an apprentice alchemist, in the Alchemy Roguelike RPG. Alchemy brings new layers of strategy to traditional grid-based, turn-based roguelike gameplay. Gather materials, transmute them into powerful items, and conquer the dungeon!
games.aboutText:
An "Alchemy × Roguelike RPG" where apprentice alchemist Mia takes on the dungeon.

Grid-based, turn-based exploration meets a deep alchemy system where you transmute materials into powerful items—adding new layers of strategy to the traditional roguelike experience.

Ever-Changing Dungeons

- Each time you enter, everything changes—terrain, materials, and monster placement create a new and mysterious dungeon to explore.

- The grid-based, turn-based system lets you take your time to find the best move.

- When you fall, items and levels obtained during that run are lost . Embrace the tension and excitement of each adventure!

The Key to Adventure: Alchemy

- Dungeons are filled with alchemical materials—herbs, mushrooms, ores, and more!

- Find an Alchemy Spring and seize the chance to transmute materials into powerful items. What will you transmute from your limited materials? Your skill as an alchemist will be put to the test.

- Use the powerful items you’ve transmuted to push deeper into the dungeon!

- As Mia continues to practice alchemy, her skill grows and she’ll discover new recipes.
As your world of alchemy grows, transmute even stronger items!

Enhancing Equipment through Alchemy

- At the Alchemy Spring , you can also enhance your weapons and armor using materials.

- Evolve weapons to increase attack power or reinforce armor to boost defense—nurture your favorite equipment and make it your own!

- Your equipment is never lost , even if you fall. Keep coming back, keep upgrading your gear, and the path to conquering the dungeon will open before you!

Unique Monsters Await

- Even the cutest-looking monsters shouldn’t be underestimated.
They’ll poison you, steal your items, and put you to sleep—each with its own tricky abilities waiting to test your wits!

- Observe their traits and discover the right way to counter them!

High-Difficulty Dungeons to Test Your Skill

- Challenge a special dungeon where no items can be brought in .

- Both your alchemy skills and equipment enhancements start from scratch , offering a fresh and unpredictable adventure each time.

- Use your knowledge, judgment, and a touch of luck to overcome the ultimate trial!

games.name: Car Wash Together
games.shortDescription: In Car Wash Together, build your dream cleaning business - solo or in co-op! Tackle the challenge of detailing vehicles inside and out, gaining new skills and tools to satisfy even the most demanding customers.
games.aboutText:
Have you already met Little Sam, from whom you can take over the used car dealership in Car Dealer Simulator ? His wife, Clever Emma, runs a small car wash right next door. Wouldn't it be nice to expand it and become the biggest and best car wash in Winston Springs?

Start with a simple manual car wash for passenger cars and a vacuum for interior upholstery…

… and then expand your services with more car washing and cleaning options.

Your task will be to provide the best possible service for incoming vehicles, focusing on both speed and quality of service.

The game combines elements of management, work organization, and simulation. You won’t just be washing cars - you’ll also take care of the entire infrastructure, from keeping the car wash clean and regularly servicing the machines to investing in new technologies that will attract more customers.

Over time, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your services from passenger cars to delivery vehicles or even larger machines that require a specialized approach.

Car Wash Together is fun not only for fans of business-themed simulators but also for those seeking a relaxing and satisfying experience. The game allows you to create your ideal car wash, where the quality of services, efficiency, and the wealth of your business depend entirely on your skills and strategy.

games.name: My life with you
games.shortDescription: "My Life with You" is a STORY DRIVEN experience that follows the journey of a young SINGLE MOM who must BALANCE life's challenges while raising her child. An emotional journey focused on the BOND BETWEEN MOTHER AND CHILD, marked by obstacles, growth, and love.
games.aboutText:
"My Life with You" tells the story of a young woman who, after falling in love as a teenager, ends up getting pregnant. Abandoned by her boyfriend, she must face the challenges of being a single mother, balancing work, household responsibilities, and her dream of building a better future for herself and her child. Living with her grandmother, she seeks a job to support their home while dealing with the struggles of motherhood and the possibility of finding love again. At the core of it all is the bond between mother and child, showing the highs and lows of a journey filled with challenges, growth, and love.

This project was carried out with resources from Complementary Law No. 195/2022 – Paulo Gustavo Law, funded by the Paulo Gustavo Law, IECINE/RS, the State Department of Culture of Rio Grande do Sul, the Ministry of Culture, and the Federal Government, with execution by Sorora Game Studio.

A sensitive narrative experience, with little to no text, accessible in any language.

Explore the protagonist’s everyday life: caring for her child, searching for a job, and navigating her emotions.

Play at your own pace—no timers, no pressure—just experience and connection.

games.name: Ritual Tides
games.shortDescription: Ritual Tides is a story rich, psychological horror game set on the dark, atmospheric, isolated British island of Hortus. Explore the island, uncover its dark past, loot food, ammunition and supplies, evade the cult of the Fallow Parish, as you fight for survival against Lovecraftian horrors.
games.aboutText:
UNCOVER THE HORRORS OF HORTUS
“This is a place, that should not be." | Malcolm Chambers

No record of it appears on any map. No ships pass its waters.
And yet, with no recollection of who you are or how you arrived, you awaken upon its shores.

Ritual Tides is a first-person psychological horror game set on a remote Victorian island off the British coast, and the first chapter in an ambitious new horror saga. Explore the island, survive the cult, and uncover the truth of what Hortus really is… and who you really are.

SURVIVE THE NIGHTMARES WITHIN

“What was human once was no more...It had turned." | Edward Dowden

There is many a threat upon the isles of Hortus, and you would be wise to trust only those you are certain you can.

Scavenge as best you can for ammunition and supplies, stay out of sight, and you may just survive the horrors that lurk within this wretched garden.

DISCOVER DYNAMIC FIRST PERSON GAMEPLAY

Painstaking care has gone into crafting a unique first-person experience, one we hope plays like no other.

With a bespoke first-person rig and dynamic procedural traversal systems, every movement has been designed to bring you closer to the world and its horrors.

AAA AMBITION, FUELLED BY PASSION

The Vertpaint team have been making games together for years, but Ritual Tides is the first game we can truly call our own. And we haven’t started small. Raised on games like Resident Evil and Silent Hill, we love horror that rewards curiosity, with stories that run deeper the more you uncover.

With Ritual Tides, we want to respect what came before while bringing a few tricks of our own, to do our bit to help push this incredible genre forward.

We don’t have a big publisher behind us or a massive marketing budget to make noise, so every bit of support genuinely makes a difference. Liking or sharing our content, telling a friend about the game, or, best of all, wishlisting Ritual Tides on Steam helps us enormously with the algorithms, and gets the game in front of more horror fans.

It’s because of you all that we’ve been able to get this far, and we’re incredibly grateful for it.
We won’t rest until we can finally welcome you ashore to the dreaded Isles of Hortus.
Hopefully, we’ll see you there very soon...

games.name: JIAOHUN
games.shortDescription: Welcome to JIAOHUN. Today is Dec 31, 1999. Happy New Year. And a message from Fairy Town's end. Grab your pager and step into the strange night before the new millennium. Investigate the mysterious Fairy Town in Baishoi County. Explore deeper, uncover the townfolk's secrets, and find the dark truth.
games.aboutText:
JIAOHUN is a cinematic first-person psychological horror game. As you explore, you will gradually uncover the mystery of Fairy Town's end.

You returned here, to an obscure dot on the map—Fairy Town in Baishoi County, which clung to survival between changing tides. As the new century approached, the town tried to adapt, but every desperate push forward failed.

Amid countless pains, desires, fears, loves, and hatreds, the nameless god opened the eye in its palm.

Trapped on the eve of the new millennium. But... ignore what's hidden. There's nowhere to run anyway.

Unravel Fairy Town's stories, strip away the lies, and face the unsettling truth

The evil won't leave. It haunts you from within. Run before it catches you

¥§µæ§ø¥#¢§§&!ø̶æ̸§̵µ̷x̸¥̶z̷9̸9̶

……

Come... step closer...

games.name: Charlatan
games.shortDescription: Roguelike deckbuilder, but you don't trust luck, you CHEAT it. Rig a haunted slot machine and snowball numbers into a nice dopamine Jackpot!
games.aboutText:
Charlatan is a roguelike deckbuilder played on a haunted slot
machine. Spin the reels, rig them with:

- magnets,

- stickers,

- forged tickets,

and snowball small wins into big payouts.

Every win lets you upgrade your deck. Give your cards active abilities and use them at the right moment to turn a bad spin into a winning one. The more you upgrade, the less you leave to chance.

Pick a soul before each run. Every soul starts with its own abilities, so no two runs play the same and each one asks for a new strategy. Find the soul that fits your style, then see what happens with another.

Six locations - you choose the right order. Watch where your build is heading and plan a route that suits it, because each of the 24 bosses brings nasty abilities of their own. A smart route can win the run before the first spin.

Every move counts, and you can even expand the board itself. We spent ages on the balance so every run can snowball into combos that feel downright illegal. Which is fine. You’re the Charlatan. That was the plan all along.

games.name: Book Shooter
games.shortDescription: 《Book Shooter》is a tower defense roguelike game where YOU become the magic tome! Transmigrated into a fantasy world, you inhabit legendary books like An Actor's Work, The Bible, and A Brief History of Time. You will face many enemies, come and fight！
games.aboutText:
《Book Shooter》is a magic shooting game similar to rogue, tower defense, and vampire survival.

In the mysterious forbidden area, you are awakened as a book, with a Bible that can do magic, advanced mathematics that can fight, and a The Emperor's New （Clothes×）Book！

The gods in the forbidden area want to devour you all the time. Open the magic book to learn magic, defeat the gods, and get the forbidden power.

- You can freely match books, title pages, colleges, and concentration

- Progressive challenges, diverse enemies and rewards, powerful enemies are waiting for you to challenge

- Fight the final boss, it's time to test you, remember not to panic!

- Defeat the boss, get mysterious drops and ink, it's time to start the Elemental Academy!

games.name: Goblin God
games.shortDescription: In Goblin God, you rule a tribe of chaotic goblins! Build villages, defend against evil humans, and unleash divine powers to shape the world (or cause mayhem). Each island brings new challenges—will you lead your goblins to glory or just enjoy the chaos?
games.aboutText:
Goblin God – Rule, Protect, and Cause Chaos!

Congratulations! You’ve ascended to divinity—not as a mighty celestial being, but as the god of goblins. These little green weirdos worship you, build wonders in your name, and sometimes set themselves on fire by accident. Your job? Keep them alive or unalive while defending them from relentless waves of evil humans who really don’t like goblin deities.

Key Features:

🛠 God Mode Activated – Smite enemies, bless your goblins, or just throw things around for fun. You're the god here!

🏰 Build a Goblin Empire – Guide your followers as they construct villages and build a magnificent wonder in your honor.

⚔️ Defend Against Evil Humans – Humans aren’t happy about your goblin cult. Too bad for them. Command your goblins in battle or personally intervene in divine (and chaotic) ways.

🏝 Explore Unique Islands – Each level is a new island with different challenges, resources, and environmental quirks. Adapt and thrive!

🌿 Chill or Cause Havoc – Prefer a peaceful experience? You can just build a cozy goblin village and enjoy watching your worshippers go about their lives.

games.name: Auto Rogue
games.shortDescription: A roguelike where you automate combat. Combine skills and conditions to find your own optimal solution! No complicated controls at all!! Sit back with a coffee and watch the beautiful battles you've crafted unfold! Utilize a variety of skills, conditions, and relics to craft the ultimate build!
games.aboutText:
Combat Programming Roguelike

AutoRogue is a roguelike where you combine skills with conditions to automate battles. you can sit back, enjoy your coffee, and watch your carefully crafted automated battles unfold.

Condensing the Best of Auto-Battles

In this game, everything is decided before the battle begins. Your available items, build direction, and the unique traits of enemies change every time, making it fun to devise the optimal strategy. Careful planning will always give you an advantage.

Explore Your Own Unique Build

In 『 AutoRogue 』 , you can enhance basic skills by combining them with special conditions to create new effects. For example:

- A skill may reduce HP upon use but lower its cost.

- A skill could increase your max HP permanently if it lands the finishing blow.

- A skill’s cost may double, but it activates twice in succession.

With a wide variety of combinations, you can create your own unique and exciting build.

The More You Play, the More Fun It Gets

In this game, it’s not the character that gets stronger, but the player. As you gain experience, you'll sharpen your knowledge and strategy. With different enemies, skills, and events appearing in every run, you can enjoy the game over and over again.

games.name: After ICEY
games.shortDescription: After ICEY is a 2D side-scrolling action meta sequel in the ICEY universe. After countless cycles, ICEY defeated Judas and left the world, yet cycles remain. Three bound souls await. Follow the arrows, defeat them, and take their soul crystal masks — this is your mission.
games.aboutText:
After ICEY is a brand-new sequel set in the ICEY universe. You take control of ICEY's body and traverse ruins, the Upper Sea and the City of Sunset. Your repeatedly assigned mission is to defeat three targets and reclaim their masks condensed from soul crystals. A new female narrator who has experienced countless iterations will accompany and guide you throughout your journey.

Game Features

- High-Speed Side-Scrolling Combat : Master combos and dodges, alongside brand-new abilities including Parry, Ground Slam, Bounce Bloom and Sprint.

- Responsive New Narrator : You may fully follow her instructions or choose to defy her will. Ultimately, whether you complete the mission or not will have no impact on ████.

- Masks & Soul Crystals : Defeat bosses to retrieve their masks condensed from soul crystals. Hidden within corrupted data nodes scattered across levels are incomplete ███ masks, bearing the residual tales left by the previous "██".

games.name: Wandering Within
games.shortDescription: Wandering Within is a 2d solo survival game where you have to cross a hostile desert to unravel the mysteries of a legendary chest. Gather resources, find water and build tools to increase your chance of survival
games.aboutText:
Wandering Within is a survival game where you have to cross a hostile desert to unravel the mysteries of a legendary chest.

Find water, food and make a firecamp, as the nights will be freezing. Build a variety of tools and find your way through an environment that will do anything to lose you.

Discover a world rich in legends, strange places and characters who will guide you on your quest.

SURVIVAL

- A bar of hunger, thirst and warmth to be maintained at all times

- Death is final, no room for error

- Tool-making system to increase your chances of survival

NAVIGATION

- Your sense of direction will be severely tested

- Follow the instructions of other desert dwellers to find the next point of interest

- Familiarise yourself with a procedurally generated environment

- Keep moving to ensure your survival

LEGEND

- Discover the myths of the desert

- Decipher the mysteries surrounding a sealed chest containing immeasurable powers

games.name: Leafy Corner
games.shortDescription: Run a cute little plant shop in this cozy and relaxing game. Grow, sell, and care for a variety of real-life plants, help customers find their dream plants, complete orders, and customize your cozy shop just the way you like!
games.aboutText:
Run the plant shop of your dreams in Leafy Corner, a cozy shop management game where you grow, sell, and care for real-life houseplants!

Step into the role of a plant shop owner. Grow plants, serve your customers, and create a warm, inviting space filled with greenery and charm.

Watch your plants grow over time, unfolding leaf by leaf as you care for them.

Not everyone knows what they’re looking for. Sometimes customers bring unusual or tricky requests. Finding just the right plant to fit their needs adds a fun challenge.

Decorate your shop with a variety of unlockable items, from shelves to plant pots. Pick colors that fit your mood and create a space that reflects your unique style.

KEY FEATURES

- Grow, care for, and sell 100+ unique plants.

- Discover plant variegations.

- Build and decorate your shop with a variety of pots, furniture, and decoration options.

- Fulfill orders and help customers.

- Complete tasks to progress your shop.

- Increase your shop’s reputation to unlock new content.

- Customize your character.

What Leafy Corner does NOT offer:

- Hardcore management (deep economy, hiring staff).

- Advanced plant care.

- Storyline.

We are working hard and pouring our hearts into making Leafy Corner. You can support us by wishlisting and following the game on Steam. And if you want to chat with us or fellow plant lovers, you can find us on Discord!

games.name: Capsule Lover
games.shortDescription: A cozy urban visual novel. Hu Lai is a laid-back slacker living quietly in a capsule hotel — until bubbly girl Ruan Xiaoqi barges into his life! A quirky romance between a spicy go-getter and a low-key dreamer begins!
games.aboutText:
Quirky Sweetheart Spitfire × Low-Key Laid-Back Slacker

I just wanted to lie flat and do nothing forever — until she crashed into my capsule pod like a glitch in the system.

Story

Hu Lai is a burnt-out dropout from the rat race, living his quiet, energy-saving life in a capsule hotel — bothering no one, going nowhere.

Then one day, mega-extrovert and walking chaos engine Ruan Xiaoqi barges straight into his world.

A love story between a quirky, wide-eyed spitfire and a deadpan capsule-hotel hermit — starts now.

Characters

Ruan Xiaoqi An ultra-extroverted, zero-boundaries sweetheart with a wild streak — nicknamed "Little Grim Reaper" by those who know her. Her life philosophy is unclear, but she's always down to try anything, especially mystery unboxings. A surprisingly skilled corpse actor with a bizarre collection hobby and a mysterious treasure stash under her bed. About to graduate college — but has somehow already been working for half a year. A certified night owl. Seemingly clueless about romance, all bluster on the outside, but way more vulnerable than she looks.

Hu Lai Former grind-culture warrior. Current low-energy minimalist. Rumored to have once been a top-tier overachiever, but keeps it to himself. Works part-time as a tutor, stationed permanently at the capsule hotel. Easygoing, emotionally unshakeable, occasionally works out, keeps healthy hours. Talks tough, soft at heart, and deeply allergic to drama.

Features

- 150,000-Chinese word script

- Polished & adorable art style

- Full voice acting for all characters except the male lead

- Bonus side stories, updated gradually

- A lighthearted romance with a little something to think about

What You'll Unlock Together

√ Late-night soul talks crammed inside a coffin-sized capsule pod (she does most of the talking).

√ A front-row seat to her life — daily highlights delivered with infectious enthusiasm (surprisingly healthy mindset).

√ Getting dragged along from the basketball court to the internet café — a reluctantly passionate life.

√ Facing a crisis when "home" is suddenly on the line — do you both run, or do you take it on together?

Minimum Requirements

- One heart: capable of being moved by simple, everyday joy.

- A little resonance: you've either thought "whatever, good enough" — or screamed "just go for it!"

- Some storage space: just enough to hold this warm, lively little story.

games.name: Sakura Hime 6
games.shortDescription: Step into this world where charming girls of all kinds long for your touch. Win their hearts one by one and embark on a soul-stirring journey through another world!
games.aboutText:
Badge

Introduction

The legendary Gensokyo has been forgotten by the world, and the Sakura Princesses living within have fallen into a crisis of magical depletion. Summoned to this land, you bear the responsibility of saving them! In the warmth and temptation of their company, can you shoulder the duty of saving the world and ultimately win their hearts? Features

- One-handed mode

- CG Gallery mode♥

- High quality character animations

games.name: Forsworn
games.shortDescription: Stack game-breaking synergies until your party can slay gods. Command a party of heroes, forge powerful synergies, and level them up across runs in this turn-based tactics roguelite. Battle the gods solo or in co-op, where defeat is just another beginning.
games.aboutText:
Build powerful party synergies and fight through unforgiving battles as you explore and save a realm torn apart by divine war. When one run ends in death, resurrection begins the next.

Embrace scaling difficulties that add new layers of challenges, from random modifiers added to enemies to map-wide trials that affect the entire encounter. Each run and encounter will be fresh as you try out different party builds.

Victory depends on how you combine your heroes: chain their powers and create devastating synergies. With 150+ Items to build around and 250+ Abilities , each with its own upgrade path, the build options are limitless. Theorycraft your way to broken, game-breaking combos.

Lead your champions alone or rally up to four friends in fast-paced co-op play. With simultaneous turns for all players, battles remain fast and tactical, as you fight for the realm’s survival together.

Earn Ultimate Charge from every move, whether attacking, casting spells, or defending. Each hero wields a unique Ultimate Ability to turn the tide—breaking enemy ranks, empowering allies, or unleashing overwhelming force.

Upgrades don’t just raise stats; they evolve abilities, unlock new mechanics, and deepen hero playstyles. Assemble your party from 6 unique heroes, each with their own 3 distinct subclasses to that alter their playstyle.

games.name: Magical Princess
games.shortDescription: Raise your daughter while she attends a magical academy. Choose which classes she attends, jobs she does, training she undergoes, and more in a character raising sim packed full of story and over 50 endings to reach. How she grows up to be the world's cutest princess depends on you!
games.aboutText:
Raise the cutest daughter in all of the land in the ultimate parenting simulation!

In Magical Princess , step into the shoes of a single, widowed father as he brings up his only beloved daughter from early childhood all the way to graduation at the magical academy.

With her whole life ahead of her across a variety of different paths, how she grows up and matures is entirely your responsibility. Steer her towards an upright academic career as an ace student, a life of excitement on the stage as an idol, the way of the mighty warrior who takes up the sword, or even pure villainy as the demon queen. With every choice and decision you make, her future changes dramatically!

Gameplay Features

- Complete freedom to raise your daughter however you see fit. Whether that means letting her attend classes, do part-time jobs, go out on dates, sneak out at night, or even indulge in the occasional thievery and other such "odd" jobs, the choice is yours!

- An enormous amount of story content including over 170 date scenes and over 50 endings. Interact with a colorful cast of more than 30 characters brimming with personality as your daughter leads her life at the magical academy.

- Uncover deep mysteries lurking beneath the surface. On nights when the full moon turns crimson in the strange phenomenon known as the Crimson Moon, monsters strike in a world seemingly chained to its fate. The key to unlocking everything just might rest in the hands of your daughter...

A character raising game fit for a princess!

Magical Princess is a character raising game where players get to experience the joys of raising a daughter full of potential, bonding with her the more that she grows. What life has in store for her is up to you as you piece together a story of epic proportions! The only question is: are you ready to be a father?

games.name: Cloudscrapers
games.shortDescription: Cloudscrapers is a minimalist strategy game with a relaxing atmosphere. Build your tower, manage resources, unlock new tools, and uncover the secrets hidden in the sky.
games.aboutText:
Have you ever felt that sense of wonder while gazing at a 🌤️ cloudy sky , or the cozy feeling of watching a ⛈️ storm pass outside your window? Those moments inspired Cloudscrapers , our minimalist strategy game about building towers and scraping the clouds. It’s perfect for anyone who enjoys thoughtful gameplay without overly complex systems.

You start with simple tools and build the tallest tower you can. With every climb, you will learn something new, improve, and unlock upgrades to help you build even higher next time. As your tower rises, you’ll find ancient relics and uncover mysteries buried deep within the clouds – though some of them might be better left untouched.

What to expect:

▪ Bite-sized strategy gameplay that’s perfect for a relaxing session after work.

▪ Easy to pick up , with just the right amount of depth.

▪ No complicated menus or systems — just intuitive building mechanics.

▪ Meaningful progression that feels rewarding.

▪ A hand-drawn, atmospheric world with a mystery that unfolds as you reach new heights.

games.name: Rockhounds
games.shortDescription: Rockhounds is a 1-4 player extraction shooter where you and your squad brave the deadliest planets to extract minerals for ruthless Megacorps. Every mission is a fight for survival, wealth, and glory. Will you conquer the chaos and escape with your team? Gear up, and prove you’ve got what it takes!
games.aboutText:
EXTRACT OR DIE TRYING

Gear up, drop in, and fight for your life in a galaxy where only the richest can survive. You and your squad are the disposable workforce of the Megacorps, sent to hostile planets to extract precious minerals.

Team up in 1-4 player co-op to mine, hunt, build and battle your way through deadly contracts. Every mission is a gamble: the higher the risk, the bigger the payout… but make the wrong move and it could cost you everything.

A GALAXY OF CHAOS

No two contracts are ever the same. You will face deadly anomalies, brutal weather conditions and waves of feral creatures and rival corporate security forces.

Rockhounds features unique planets, each packed with distinct biomes and challenges. Every drop is a test of teamwork, skill and strategy.

STRATEGIZE, FIGHT & GET RICH

Switch between mining, building and combat as you tackle increasingly high-risk contracts. Craft and upgrade your equipment to build your ultimate merc. Specialize in mining, combat, engineering or support. Rally your squad, strategize for the best approach, and get ready to mine, fight, and escape with your life (and your paycheck) intact.

games.name: Floor Plan: Slap Out Of It!
games.shortDescription: A slap-and-solve adventure that stretches your wits and your noodly arms in all directions. Explore impossible towers where every floor is a comedy sandbox of secrets. Meet strange characters and solve (or add to) their problems with a personal touch. The power to change everything is in your hands.
games.aboutText:
Floor Plan: Slap Out Of It! is a slap-and-solve adventure that stretches your wits and your noodly arms to their max. It's a big sandbox of secrets that combines slapstick humor and hilarious puzzles that will keep you thinking and laughing at the same time. Based on the hit "Floor Plan" series - previously for VR, now reimagined with updated puzzles and new mechanics for its PC debut!

Our world is broken...but at Puzzl, we're putting it back together piece by piece - better than before! Join our team of PuzzPals and help us solve the world's problems with a personal touch. But first, our CEO needs some help with a very important mission. You're not afraid of heights, right?

You see that mountain? You can slap it. Well, you could if this game had mountains. Everything within reach of your stretchy arms is satisfyingly interactive and responsive to your touch with animation, sound, and haptics. Every background detail is intentional and worthy of your attention - so explore and slap everything, because you never know what might happen. Maybe we’ll add mountains.

Lean on the skills you’ve learned from point-and-clicks to SLAP-AND-SOLVE. Use your elevator to travel between floors, gather items in your fanny pack, and make logical leaps as you unravel how every floor and their inhabitants are connected. And if you get stuck, keep on slapping or ask the operator for some intel to help you along.

Slap Out Of It! is inspired and adapted from "Floor Plan," the hit VR escape game series. It has been dramatically expanded with all-new gameplay and secrets to discover, and meticulously redesigned from the ground up for keyboard and controller. Please note that this is not a VR game and does not have any VR support.

- A comedy sandbox with puzzles and surprises hidden behind every slap

- Think with your hands to solve and progress through interconnected escape rooms

- Embrace cartoon logic as you explore, touch, and smack everything in sight

- Meet a huge cast of bizarre characters, and solve (or become) their problems

- Wait, is that Ben Starr?

- 6-10 handcrafted hours of gloriously stupid jokes and memorable “aha” moments

- A Floor Plan adventure - inspired and adapted from the hit VR escape game series, now with 100% less VR

Made by Humans - Not AI

No generative AI tools were used for any part of the development process for this game - not for art, code, concepts, temp assets, audio, writing, localization, or anything else. Every silly, stupid moment in the game was the result of talented artists spending a great deal of time, effort, and iteration to make something as dumb as possible and we hope that knowledge makes it funnier.

games.name: Tricky and the Dream Caster
games.shortDescription: A surreal, retro-inspired, free form 3D platformer that takes you through a world of dreams and nightmares!
games.aboutText:
Join Tricky as he explores the surreal dream worlds of the Astral Plane in this colorful 3D platformer visually inspired by consoles of the late 90s and early 2000s!

Last he remembered, Tricky was just dozing off at home. Nothing out of the ordinary. Next thing he knew, he found himself in a surreal dreamscape, unable to wake himself up!

After meeting up with some of the dream locals, he learns a few things about his current predicament:

1. He's been cursed by a dream wizard who did it for fun.

2. The only way to break the curse is to beat him up.

3. The only way to beat him up is to break into his castle.

- Low poly low res graphics inspired by 6th gen classics of the late 90s and early 00s

- Expressive free-form collectathon platforming

- 5 expansive surreal dream worlds to explore

- 10 challenge stages offering two different gameplay styles

- Colorful cast of characters

- Fully voiced cutscenes and NPCs

- Janky expression-based lip syncing

ACCOLADES

"This game reeks of estrogen." -- Twitter user

games.name: Cult Vacui
games.shortDescription: Cult Vacui is a horror point-and-click adventure with survival and time management elements where your choices could keep you alive... or not.
games.aboutText:
Short on time? Cult Vacui is the perfect moody afternoon game - most players finish in around 2-3 hours.

Cult Vacui is a point & click with survival horror elements,
set in the late 19th century on the remote island of Barra in Scotland.

We play an unsuspecting janitor who has been given a job opportunity to maintain the Gladstone family's summer estate.

What we discover is that the day before we arrived, a gruesome blood ritual was performed on the island's population at the hands of a creepy cult.

A RACE AGAINST THE CLOCK

Our arrival has ruined the ritual, which can only be considered concluded if every person in the perimeter of the island is eliminated.
Apparently we are their last obstacle... at least that is what we believe.
We have a few hours to prepare for the last act of their insane ritual; we must prepare a strategy to defend ourselves and (hopefully) survive.

CREATE YOUR OWN STRATEGY

In Cult Vacui, every choice counts, every action we take takes time that will fall short of the final act countdown, find the right strategy to maximize your efforts (even across multiple game sessions).

FEATURES

- Logical but challenging puzzles, apply the right solving strategy without getting frustrated

- your every action consumes time, in a countdown to the final act

- creepy horror atmosphere

- multiple endings based on your game choices

- Pixel art graphics handmade and thought by a real human being

- Engaging and original soundtrack composed by Ascari, a musician also credited in film

- Average playtime 2 hours

games.name: Cyber Rats
games.shortDescription: Cute rats in deadly mazes... Cyber Rats is a dark and brutal action game. Escape sadistic horrifying death mazes, Improve your rats with upgrades, and find your way out of this sinister facility.
games.aboutText:
Cyber Rats is a dark and brutal action game. You are a rat trapped in a sinister, AI-controlled test facility. In deadly mazes, horrifying experiments are conducted on helpless rats every day.
