Can you complete the objectives of the maze, and escape with your life intact? Can you stop the evil AI, and save the lives of yourself and your fellow lab rats?

Death is part of the experiment • You are a lab rat trapped in a nightmarish AI-controlled facility, where every corner hides a gruesome death.

Procedural generated death maze • A constantly shifting labyrinth. Procedural generation ensures no maze is ever the same, and you never know, what will be hiding in the shadows.

Nowhere to hide • Find the cheese. Avoid the traps. Outsmart the Cyborg Hunters. Survive the maze… or become another failed experiment.

Upgrade your rats, and unlock new colours and rat types • Unlock twisted new rat experiments, zombie rats, cyborgs rats, mutants, and more!

• Upgrade, evolve, survive. Give your rats the edge they need to escape the AI’s deadly experiments!

Can you find the way out of this sinister place? • Every rat matters. Every death counts. Survive the horrors, and break free from the AI’s twisted experiment!

games.name: The Blackout Project
games.shortDescription: Manage your contry energy requirements, avoid blackouts, sustain industrial developpement, avoid civilization collapsing.
games.aboutText:
From 19th to early 22th century, manage your country energy requirements

- Explore map and seek new energy source sites.

- Build and manage energy source sites.

- Organize foreign purchases and national market energy prices.

- Build warehouses.

- Start researches to improve energy production, exploration, consumption.

- Promote laws and taxes to influence companies developpement.

- Hire characters and assign them different missions.

- Handle diplomatic and geostrategic incidents.

- Anticipate climate variations.

- Face changing populations aspirations.

- Control industrial developpement and its consequences.

- Avoid humanity to collapse.

games.name: Shooting Range Simulator: Prologue
games.shortDescription: Run your own Shooting Range. Manage your supplies, rent guns, and sell ammo packs. Expand and upgrade your shop; level up your popularity to get even better equipment. Open various cases and sell the skins you got from them. Join shooting tournaments and much more!
games.aboutText:
On running your own Shooting Range Shop Adventure you will

Host customers every day and try to fulfill their orders; expand and upgrade your shop to even host more customers. You can buy better guns and ammo as your level goes up; customers will always want more! Buy cases and sell what you got from them. Join shooting races and win prizes. You need to manage your resources to grow every day and remain in these hard business environments.

Rent various guns and sell ammo packs that fit the gun. You can unlock new guns and ammo types as you level up. Fill your shop with pistols, SMGs, and rifles!

Open various cases to hunt rare gun skins. You can sell the skins you got in your shop to open more. As you level up you can open different types of cases, explore new skins!

games.name: Pocket City 2
games.shortDescription: A city-building game with a unique twist—step inside and experience your city firsthand! Plan roads, zones, and infrastructure while growing your economy, managing resources, and unlocking special buildings. Host events, build mega projects, and watch your city thrive in a dynamic world.
games.aboutText:
Pocket City 2 adds a playful twist to city-building, giving you more ways to create, explore, and have fun! Construct your ideal metropolis with intuitive tools, then step inside and experience it firsthand. You're not just managing a city—you’re part of it. Walk, drive, and fly through your streets, meet citizens, and even stir up a little mayhem!

Plan roads, zones, and landmarks while balancing strategy and creativity. Optimize your city's growth with special buildings, expand its borders, and bring it to life with events. Whether you're developing a booming economy, hosting festivals, or simply wandering your world, Pocket City 2 offers a fun and dynamic way to build and play.

Features:

🏙️ Build & Expand – Create a thriving city with zones, special buildings, and unique landmarks.

🚶 Jump In & Explore – Control your avatar, walk the streets, and interact with NPCs.

🌆 A Living World – Enjoy seasons, a day-night cycle, and dynamic events.

🎮 Minigames & Activities – Race cars, fly planes, and take on quirky challenges.

🎉 Lively Events – Host block parties, respond to disasters, or see what happens!

🏠 Customize & Collect – Decorate your home, unlock outfits, and personalize your city.

💰 Grow & Upgrade – Complete quests, invest in mega projects, and earn rewards.

🌍 Creative & Challenge Modes – Relax in Sandbox Mode or test your skills in Survival Mode.

Updated for PC:

🎮 Updated Controls & UI – Optimized for a seamless PC experience.

🏙️ Larger Maximum City Size – Build bigger and better than ever.

🎨 Updated Visuals & Audio – Enjoy improved graphics and sound design.

🏗️ New Buildings – Expand your city with fresh additions.

Build, Expand, and Shape Your City!

Plan and develop a thriving metropolis by zoning residential, commercial, and industrial areas while managing power, water, and new systems like waste and sewage. Gather natural resources for upgrades, research, and income. Unlock new buildings by completing quests and improving relationships with citizens through encounters and city events. Take on massive Mega Projects —time-intensive investments that bring major benefits to your city.

Explore and Interact in 3D

Step inside your city as your custom avatar and roam freely! Walk through neighborhoods, interact with NPCs, and discover loot scattered around town. Drive through your streets, visit interiors, and experience your city in a new way with a full day-night cycle and seasonal changes.

Minigames and Activities

Take a break from city management with fun and dynamic minigames. Race through the streets, fly planes, pilot a fire helicopter, run businesses, and more! Level up your city to unlock new challenges and rewards.

Customize Your Avatar and Home

Create your own character and buy a home in the city! Furnish and decorate it with furniture from shops and quest rewards. Host house parties to boost your relationships with citizens.

Events and Challenges

Keep your city lively with block parties, festivals, parades, and more . But be ready—disasters like fires and storms can strike, causing chaos to your economy and buildings. Quickly rebuild and keep your city thriving!

Face Off Against Rival Cities

Compete in City Competitions against NPC-controlled cities to prove who’s the better mayor. Win and unlock new special buildings to enhance your metropolis!

games.name: The Dark Rites of Arkham
games.shortDescription: A macabre ritual murder puts Arkham PD detectives Jack Foster and Harvey Whitman to the test. As the investigation progresses, they will unveil a disturbing connection between the Salem witch trials of the 17th century and the end of humankind.
games.aboutText:
Detective Jack Foster rejoins the police department after a traumatic incident to take over the investigation of what appears to be mere political blackmail. Soon, however, he's faced with the discovery of a gruesome ritual murder that took place in a sealed room, from which no one could have gotten in or out without being seen. Along with his new partner, Harvey Whitman, an expert on cults, Foster dives deep into the shadows of the city of Arkham.

The case will get even darker when they find out it is related to three witches that escaped the Salem trials in 1693, and a conspiracy that could put an end to the world as we know it.

- Pulp & Click adventure based on dialogue and inventory puzzles.

- More than 90 detailed pixel art backgrounds to explore.

- A story inspired by the works by H.P. Lovecraft, where we will meet well-known characters such as Herbert West, Keziah Mason, Doctor Eric Moreland, and Henry Armitage.

- Jazzy ambient music composed by Matías J. Olmedo ( An English Haunting ).

- Visit the Arkham Museum of the Unusual and lose yourself in its chambers, the biggest attraction of which is the artwork of the sensation of the moment: painter Richard Upton Pickman.

games.name: Gravethorn
games.shortDescription: Gravethorn is a 2D platformer that combines soulslike and metroidvania elements with deep storytelling. The story follows an Inquisitor who has lost his memory, searching for his forgotten past along with his regrets.
games.aboutText:
Gravethorn is set in a city slowly being overtaken by a living curse.

Roots spread beneath the ground and through human flesh, binding the land, the church, and its people to a cycle of decay. The faith meant to contain the curse has long since begun to rot.

You play as an Inquisitor tasked with confronting what remains. Not to save the world, but to understand what went wrong, and decide how far you are willing to go.

Explore a non-linear, interconnected world of decaying chapels, haunted forests, and ruined strongholds. Paths overlap, shortcuts reveal themselves over time, and the land quietly records the damage left behind.

Brutal, Adaptive Combat

Fights emphasize timing, positioning, and commitment. Enemies are dangerous, and recovery is limited. Progress comes from learning patterns and respecting the space you are given.

Adapt your approach as encounters unfold. Patience and restraint matter as much as aggression. Openings must be earned.

Build Your Inquisitor

Discover trinkets, sigils, and remnants tied to the curse itself. Equipment and passive effects allow you to shape your Inquisitor without locking you into a single style.

Power is gained gradually, often at a cost.

A World Shaped by Loss

Throughout your journey, you will encounter individuals shaped by faith, fear, and regret. Their stories are fragmented, often contradictory, and never fully explained.

Lore is uncovered through observation, environment, and implication rather than direct exposition.

Relentless Boss Fights

Boss fights serve as major turning points, each reflecting a different aspect of the curse and the institution that failed to contain it.

Defeating them does not bring relief. It only allows you to move forward.

Gravethorn is a game about persistence, consequence, and the quiet weight of unfinished penance.

games.name: Lovely Lady RPG
games.shortDescription: Lovely Lady RPG is a visual novel about wandering around and just sort of seeing what life has in store for you. After waking up with a hole in her ceiling, a cosmic space Orb embedded in her chest and no recollection of basically anything, Ghost sets out to continue her life as best she can.
games.aboutText:
Ok listen up. Fine. It's on Steam now.

Lovely Lady RPG is a game about wandering around and just sort of seeing what happens. After waking up with a hole in her ceiling, a cosmic space Orb embedded in her chest and no recollection of basically anything, Ghost sets out to continue her life as best she can.

Features

- A several hour long branching narrative with multiple intersecting storylines and a bunch of hidden content

- Ghost has a limited number of actions per day, it's up to you to make sure she doesn't irrevocably wreck her life with them

- Variable ending

- A ton of gorgeous artwork

- Gamer achievements to hunt for

- Weird and offputting women

games.name: Golemcrafter
games.shortDescription: Golemcrafter is a single-player survival crafting game where you, as a golem, explore a magical world, gather resources, build a base, harness the local wildlife, and craft powerful golems like yourself. Make friends, gain powers!
games.aboutText:
Something cold-forged stirs in the magical wilderness... and it's you !

Explore as a sentient golem, gather resources, build your sanctuary and craft helpful companions. The world is older than those who made you... and it remembers. From the humble first little friend to towering magical guardians, every creation changes how you leave your mark.

Explore The World

Roam across procedurally generated worlds of diverse biomes. Through lush meadows, old forests, steep mountains, rolling hills draped in eternal autumn, and beyond.
Each expedition brings new crafting opportunities, stronger upgrades, and mysterious discoveries.

Craft and Awaken Your Golems

Combine elemental materials to forge golems and imbue them with runes that grant them magical abilities. Build specialized golems to gather resources, defend your sanctuary or explore dangerous regions with.

The Tether System

Resources don't sit in menus here. Tether resources, golems and structures - all through the same system. Haul resources home, manifest crafting stations into place, and keep your golems close and moving with you. Equip your golems with tether runes to share the load.

Build Your Sanctuary

Turn the wilderness into a thriving magical home. Construct workshops, storage systems, magical structures and defensive walls to keep you safe.

The World Bites Back

Wild creatures roam the world, magical resources are limited, and dangerous enemies threaten both you and your creations.

Unlock Your Potential

Upgrade yourself and your golems to stay ahead. However, choose your upgrades carefully. Every node in the skill tree shifts how you build, fight, and craft.

games.name: Rocket delivery: Space Wok
games.shortDescription: A backpack building run-and-gun game! Fill your backpack with guns, blast away space bugs, and deliver noodles to hungry customers!
games.aboutText:
Off to Deliver noodles...

But the road ahead is swarming with crazed space bugs!

Upgrade your steel delivery backpack, arm yourself, and fight your way through to complete the delivery!

Game Features

Run & Gun

Break through endless swarms of alien bugs and push forward to your destination.
Dodge relentless attacks from all sides, find enemy weak points, and strike back with precision!

Backpack Building

Unleash the true power of your seemingly ordinary steel delivery backpack !
With each stage cleared, expand your backpack, optimize deadly weapons and items, and create powerful synergies.
Build your ultimate weapon system to exploit enemy weaknesses!

Evolving Enemies

The closer you get to your destination, the stronger and more unpredictable the space bugs become.
Adapt your combat style to counter their relentless mutations!

Dodge... and Fire!

May you survive and complete your delivery mission!

games.name: Catgirl
games.shortDescription: Catgirl! The RPG where you're a cat and also a girl. I bet you'd like that, wouldn't you? You little freak. Haha jk, ur good.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Catgirl. In this RPG, you control a cat whose dog gets kidnapped by an evil demon queen. Now you must rescue your best friend... and maybe some other ppl too.

features:

- Story focused game play (but you can body slam absent fathers too).

- Short & sweet, just a couple hours.

- Lots of mini-games

- Charming original art and soundtrack..

- Idiot-rich story with an emphasis on humor and pain.

- Created by 3 people, that's over 2 brains worth of game.

- Be friends with an orange doggy named Mopmop.

- You can make beats with a caveman.

- 猫娘

- There's a really handsome guy in the game

- Sometimes i can't help but feel like a failure, no matter how hard i try

- Super fun epic adventure filled with fantasy and friends!!!

games.name: Upfall
games.shortDescription: Upfall is a game about bouncing, dodging, and near death experiences. Burst bubbles to progress upwards, but be careful to dodge the hazards in the depths. How far will your upfall be? A free game for the in betweens.
games.aboutText:
Escape the depths by bouncing on bubbles and avoid the hazards which slowly present themselves. Glowing red = danger... at least to start with! Each new depth you reach causes the colours to change and the hazards to increase, with enough random generation so each upfall is never the same. It's not easy, it's sometimes mean, but with fast restarts, lots to discover, and quick rounds you'll find yourself coming back over and over.

Can you find your way back to the surface?

Totally, utterly free – The world isn't great right now for a lot of people so we wanted to give back. Upfall is completely free - no ads, no monetisation, no catch

Quick rounds – Each fall takes between 2 and 10 minutes so you can play between other games or on your lunch break

Unlocks and customisation – Unlock colour palettes, audio styles, ambiences, and characters to customise how the game looks and sounds

Keyboard or controller – Play keyboard only, feel the controller vibrate, or watch the DualShock 4/DualSense controller light change colour to reflect the game state

Chill but eerie – Simple rules to discover with a creepy, no-jump scares, atmosphere to keep you engaged and coming back

Do you want to know what playing a game might sound like in a massive underground oil tank? How about in an otherworldly gasometer , a 60 meter tall silo , or played through a slinky ? Upfall experiments with convolution reverb to put the game into real, strange places around the globe that you can explore as you play.

A game by Amicable Animal with art from eggysworld and piano samples from Luci Holland.

Made for humans, by humans.

(Just so you know: this game is provided as is, and we can't offer support as it's free. It is built in Unity so if you can play Unity games it should run fine!)

games.name: CARIMARA: Beneath the forlorn limbs
games.shortDescription: A mute little thing with borrowed magic. A house that murmurs back. Ask wrong, and you might wake something that remembers your name.
games.aboutText:
I had a blast creating this little game. It's a short experience, and I hope the secrets and little surprises I hid in it will stay with you for a long time!

- Bastinus Rex

You are the Carimara. Small, mute, sorcerous. Born of moss and mirrorlight, skilled only in the art of asking. Wandering a house stitched from grief and riddles; you don't speak, you don’t chant, you don’t fight. You hold the house by its dead hands and conjure questions from dust, from bone, from whatever’s left behind. Be careful not to press too far, or wake you might, what's sealed afar.

You Are Mute, But You Have A Gift Of Conjuring Questions

You speak through cards with glyphs long lost, in halls where kindness hides its cost.

Some smile, some sneer, some simply stare, but all who watch know you are there.

Every Object Is A Memory

Within these walls, let silence guide, where cards bloom from what things once hide.

Ask gently now, with ghostly touch. Some secrets crack when pressed too much.

A Stillness Dressed In Dust And Flame

Candlelight flickers on furniture worn, in rooms where silence was weathered and torn.
It waits in the gloom with a breath held tight, a hush that has lingered far past the night.

A Tale In Threads Of Quiet Dread

No blades to swing, no foes to fight. Just riddles wrapped in candlelight.

For those who seek what lies askew, where stories murmur back to you.

games.name: Ministry of Order
games.shortDescription: Inspect the parents’ medical record and match the newborn who can only be theirs — that is the day’s work in this 1920s dystopian puzzle. A fire burned the birth records, and the Ministry put you in charge of giving the children back. Your choice goes into the report.
games.aboutText:
Ministry of Order is a 1920s dystopian inspection puzzle: read the parents’ medical record, weigh what a child could inherit from them, and name the one newborn who can be theirs. A fire destroyed Victory Harbor’s birth records, and the Ministry does not consider restoring them a difficult task.

Decide who belongs to whom

You work from inherited traits — blood type, Rh factor, eye and hair color, skin tone, freckles — and which of them are legible changes from day to day. Match the record to the child, and the lamp on your desk turns green.

Not every trait is legible

The reference book on your desk holds the rules of inheritance, and you will need it: a father in glasses has no readable eye color, a gray-haired mother tells you nothing about her hair color. Get it wrong and a report lands on your desk, naming the traits you ignored and the size of the fine.

Talk carefully

Before the shift you meet people in the hospital canteen; after it you go home and answer the door. Colleagues, inspectors and neighbors all want something, and not all of them say what. Branching dialogue lets you earn trust, make enemies, take a risky favor, or stay out of it. Say the wrong thing and the answer arrives later — a letter in the door, or a heavy knock after dark. Be careful what you say, and to whom.

The system is watching

The New Albion Times prints the official version of events. Some evenings the radio gives you static instead of the evening news, and a letter follows to say the new broadcast-compliance filters are working as intended. Read enough of both and the contradictions start to show — between what the state announces, what your neighbors tell you, and what you saw at your own desk.

Live inside the machine

Accuracy is income, and income is safety. A correct placement pays £5. Rent is £40. The levy for the exiled leaders of friendly nations is voluntary in name only, and the Office of Voluntary Levies keeps a record of who found it inconvenient. A day takes minutes to play, and the decisions in it decide which ending you reach.

Report to the maternity ward archive of Victory Harbor. The reference book will be provided. Decisions you make there are not subject to reconsideration.

— Office of Hereditary Clarity

games.name: Milo's Tiny Fish Pond
games.shortDescription: Create a vibrant, personal fish pond right on your desktop! Easily raise idle fish, collect cute species, and customize your digital space. Earn continuous rewards even while offline, decorate freely with simple taps and soothing sounds, build your serene desktop oasis effortlessly.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to "Milo's Tiny Fish Pond" – Your Personal Cyber Fish Pond!

Tired of complicated controls? Craving a moment of relaxing, healing fun? This unique desktop idle fish-keeping game lets you own a vibrant underwater world, even amidst your busy schedule.

- Relax & Idle, Earn While You Chill: Say goodbye to grinding! Your fish grow, play, and accumulate "Mili" (in-game currency) for you 24/7. Even when the game is closed, offline earnings continue, bringing pleasant surprises every time you return.

- Surprise Packs, Collectible Fun: Open various magical fish packs to discover adorable fish of different shapes and rarities. Nurture them carefully, watch them grow from fry to profitable adults, and satisfy your collector's itch!

- Interactive Feeding, Faster Growth: Want your fish to grow faster? Simply right-click on the water surface to feed them delicious fish food. Watching them eagerly compete for food is incredibly soothing.

- Pond Upgrades, Infinite Possibilities: Unlock and upgrade more uniquely styled fish ponds. Not only can they accommodate more beloved fish, but they can also house different species, creating diverse underwater ecosystems.

- Personalized Decor, Style It Your Way: Use a dazzling array of decorations to turn your fish pond into a unique landscape. From aquatic plants to rockeries, backgrounds to ornaments, everything is defined by you. Unwanted decorations can even be sold back at their original price, making it easy to experiment with different styles!

- Desktop Companion, Real-time Charm: Let the fish pond become part of your dynamic desktop. See your fish swim gracefully whenever you glance down during work or study, adding a touch of life and ease to your digital world.

【Gameplay Summary】

- Visit the shop to purchase your desired fish packs and ponds.

- Open fish packs and place the cute fish into the corresponding ponds.

- Feed your fish periodically to speed up their growth and increase earnings.

- Upgrade ponds and unlock decorations to create your personalized underwater world.

- Manage your fish collection, selling surplus fish for Mili.

- Enjoy the continuous income and collecting fun from effortless idling!

Join "Milo's Desktop Pond" now, start your desktop fish-keeping journey, and let these lovely little fish brighten your every day! 🌿

games.name: Revive! Onsen Town!
games.shortDescription: Revive! Onsen Town! is a cozy life simulation set in the Japanese countryside. Play as a girl on summer vacation or the mayor revitalizing the village. Catch bugs, fish, work part-time, cook, and help locals. Shape the town with your choices and bring this quiet hot spring town back to life.
games.aboutText:
As the scenery outside your window slows and fades into the distance, you finally arrive at your summer destination—Onsen Town, a quiet and remote village hidden away from the bustle of the city.

With no internet due to its location, you’ve traveled here with your mother, who was transferred for work, to help the town build its first communication tower.

Along the journey to restore the town’s vitality, who will you meet, and what stories will unfold? A warm and healing summer awaits—filled with possibilities for you to discover.

In Onsen Town, you leave behind the noise of the city. Here, you’ll be greeted by star-filled night skies, endless blue oceans, and—most of all—the peaceful moments shared with the people who live here.

In this small village with limited connectivity, lift your gaze, listen to the gentle music, and discover the beauty hidden in everyday life.

To help revive the town, you’ll earn money through various daily activities while enjoying the slow pace of countryside life. From fishing and bug catching to part-time jobs, running a stall, or sharing posts on SNS—there are countless ways to contribute to the town’s restoration.

And of course, what would rural life be without farming and fishing? Harvest the vegetables you’ve grown, cook meals with your freshly caught fish, and savor the simple flavors of the countryside.

On your third day in the town, you can choose to live as the Mayor or Kyoko, the visiting girl. Once selected, you will play as that character for the day, while the other will go about their own life based on your choices.

Whether it’s the hometown Mayor or the newly arrived Kyoko—both are part of this little community, each experiencing their own journey in Onsen Town.

Note: The game is currently in development. All art assets and gameplay shown are work in progress and may not represent the final version. We will continue to expand and refine the content before release, so stay tuned. If you are interested in the game, feel free to join our official Discord server for the latest updates and to connect with other players.

games.name: Guardians of the Wall
games.shortDescription: Guardians of the Wall is a co-op action RPG where players fight through hordes and bosses beyond humanity’s last fortress. Fast hack-and-slash combat, unique heroes, and dynamic progression await.
games.aboutText:
For ages, the Wall has protected the last remnants of humanity from the horrors beyond.
Now, cracks have formed — and through them, the Abyss is spilling into our world.

You are a Guardian — one of the few brave enough to venture beyond the Wall, where nightmares roam free.
Fight side by side with your allies, slay what lurks in the dark, and push back the endless tide before all is lost.

Master the Art of Combat

Combat in Guardians of the Wall is fast, furious, and built for chaos.
Charge headfirst into battle, cut through hordes of enemies, and unleash devastating abilities that turn the tide in an instant.

Switch seamlessly between melee and ranged attacks, throw grenades, and chain abilities for explosive combos.
Use dashes to stay mobile, blocks to withstand crushing blows, and let your aggression lead the way.

Each Guardian brings a unique playstyle. From brutal frontline fighters to ranged specialists and elemental casters, making every team composition feel dynamic and powerful.

Grow Stronger After Every Battle

No victory comes without scars — but every fight makes you stronger.
Collect resources, essences, and rare materials to unlock new weapons, upgrade abilities, and awaken new heroes.

Each Guardian has their own strengths, abilities, and ultimate powers.
Experiment with builds, combine your skills with your allies, and grow into an unstoppable force ready to face the next onslaught.

Progression Within Each Raid

Every expedition beyond the Wall brings its own opportunities and risks.
During each run, players can discover temporary upgrades , weapon modifications , and session-based perks that enhance their Guardian in unique ways.
Adapt your build on the fly — stack bonus damage, elemental effects, or defensive boosts — and transform your hero into a powerful force before the run ends.

When the raid is over, only permanent rewards carry back to the Bastion… but the choices you make mid-battle can decide whether your team survives to see it.

Defend Humanity’s Last Fortress

Beyond the Wall lies a dying world — filled with ruined strongholds, forgotten graveyards, and cursed battlefields .
Each mission drops you into a handcrafted arena or procedurally generated zone where the undead rise in endless waves.
Face epic bosses , gather loot, and uncover secrets buried in the ashes of civilization.

Between raids, return to the Bastion — a place of refuge, upgrades, and preparation for the next descent into chaos.

Because when the bells toll and the darkness returns…
The Wall must stand.

Key Features

- 4-Player Co-op Action – Join forces with friends or fight solo against overwhelming hordes and epic bosses.

- Fast Hack-and-Slash Combat – Mix melee, ranged, grenades, and abilities for explosive, fluid battles.

- Hero Abilities & Builds – Each Guardian features a distinct combat style and customizable skills.

- Raid and Survive – Tackle handcrafted missions and procedurally generated encounters that keep every run unpredictable.

- Progression and Power – Gather resources, craft weapons, and unlock new heroes as your strength grows.

- Dark Fantasy Setting – Explore haunted ruins, frozen wastelands, and cursed battlegrounds beyond the Wall.

- Evolving Challenges – Prepare for massive world events like The Breach of the Wall that change the battlefield forever.

games.name: SUPER ADVENTURE
games.shortDescription: Turn around to parry and block! Equipped with a shield on your back, jump your way through vivid levels, meet funny characters, and face challenging bosses. Fight using a quick-firing Alien Blaster or a melee-focused sword! Choose the path you want to go in this SUPER ADVENTURE!
games.aboutText:
SUPER ADVENTURE is a playful Run 'n' Gun Fun Platformer with great emphasis on bullet blocking , cool boss fights and a wacky story . WOOAHH CAN'T WAIT!

Your sleep was interrupted by Aliens! Oh no! They destroyed your house, and kidnapped your best cow friend Mumu! So you head out to find them! On your way you are given an irreplaceable item that holds great importance on your journey!

THE SHIELD is an defensive Mechanic that is always active and locked to your backside.

To block you just have to TURN AROUND!

You’re about to get shot!? Turn around !
Someone trying to stab you!? Turn around !
Taxes trying to ruin your life? JUST TURN AROUND! (maybe not this one...)

Whatever attack may come your way, you can count on your SHIELD!

BUT DEFENSE ALONE WON'T WIN NO BATTLE!

Grab your SWORD and engage in close quarter combat. Juggle your enemies and go for satisfying COMBOS ! Style on your Opponents

Or switch to the ALIEN BLASTER and attack enemies form afar. Go for consecutive hits, charge the blasters Engine, MAKE IT OVERHEAT and LEVEL UP your ATTACK POWER ! But be careful! Being too passive will make the blaster revert back to level 1!

You can switch freely between the 2 weapons at any time! Approach any Situtation however you like!

Help your friend and find new ones one the way!

Not everyone you meet on your journey is of evil nature. Meet the inhabitants of 5 different Worlds, hang out and befriend them!

GET LOST IN A linear WORLD FULL OF WACKY CHARACTERS

Woah you read all the way down here...
Thats crazy
Its like we are friends already! tehee

games.name: Jacksmith: Weapons and Warriors
games.shortDescription: Fire up the forge and craft your finest weapons in Jacksmith: Weapons and Warriors, a reforged adventure! Equip the local warriors with custom swords, bows, shields and more in your hands-on blacksmith shop. Follow the soldiers into battle as you push onward toward the evil wizard Dudley!
games.aboutText:
Fire up the forge and craft your finest weapons in Jacksmith: Weapons and Warriors, a reforged adventure! As a determined donkey blacksmith, your journey takes you across the land — but treacherous monsters block the way. Rally the local warrior clans and equip them with custom-crafted swords, bows, shields and more in a completely hands-on blacksmith shop. Once your soldiers are armed, send them into battle to clear the path forward! While the warriors fight, you'll gather loot and help out with your trusty cannon. Collect better ores and parts to forge even stronger weapons, and keep honing your craft as you push onward toward the ultimate showdown with the evil wizard Dudley!

Local warriors specialize in certain weapon types, but it’s up to you to craft the perfect weapon for the battle ahead! The forging process is entirely hands-on—choose your ore, select a weapon mold, then melt and pour the metal. Construct and hone the weapon before attaching various parts, ensuring it's battle-ready for the awaiting soldier.

As you journey down the trail, you’ll unlock new weapon molds and encounter warriors skilled in using them. Your trusty assistant, Scout, will provide insights on upcoming monsters and their weaknesses, helping you choose the most effective weapons and parts for the fight. From swords and axes to shields and beyond, use your gathered materials to forge powerful gear and maximize your impact in battle!

Once the local warriors are armed and ready, it’s time to join them on the battlefield! As they wield your handcrafted weapons against the monsters blocking the trail, you'll follow along in your blacksmith battle wagon, collecting loot from fallen enemies. The quality of your weapons directly impacts how far the soldiers can push forward, making your craftsmanship essential to their success.

But you're not just a spectator—your trusty cannon lets you provide support during battle, with new cannonball types unlocking as you progress. If your troops fight their way to the end of the trail, you'll be rewarded with powerful Epic Weapon Designs, giving you new blueprints to craft even stronger weapons for future battles!

The original game has been fully updated and optimized for widescreen and full-screen play, making Jacksmith: Weapons and Warriors the most immersive way to experience the adventure!

One of the most useful updates is the enhanced Bookmark system: When you bookmark an Epic Weapon design, the bookmarks are now color-coded by weapon type, making it easier to track the parts you need while crafting. Bookmarks also appear on metals and molds, helping you manage your inventory and streamline the forging process. Additionally, weapon parts will now indicate if they're required for any Epic Weapon designs you currently have, whether bookmarked or not—so you'll always know which materials to use and which to save for later.

Whether you're a longtime fan or discovering Jacksmith for the first time, Jacksmith: Weapons and Warriors delivers the ultimate blacksmithing adventure!

- Hands-on weapon crafting for the local warriors

- Gather parts in battle to build better weapons

- Team up with 6 unique clans of warriors

- Unlock new weapons and cannonballs

- Battle across 7 enchanting lands

- Learn to craft over 80 Epic Weapons

- Battle over 135 enemies with their own unique stats

- Earn 80 in-game badges

- Find over 275 unique parts to use during crafting

- Strategically craft to battle Elemental Enemies

games.name: Farm to Table
games.shortDescription: A farming & restaurant management sim with base building elements. Grow in backyard to cook & serve! Discover new recipes by exploring ingredients on the island; gather, fish, raise animals & produce with machines. Manage resources, hire staff & grow your organic business into a 5-star restaurant!
games.aboutText:
Farm to Table is a farming and restaurant management sim where you build a restaurant from scratch and grow food in the backyard. Explore a colourful island where you can grow and gather food, raise animals, go fishing, produce better food with machines and cook delicious recipes for your hungry guests! Build and customise your dream place, hire staff and grow your organic business into a 5-star restaurant!

Build From Scratch

Build your restaurant from scratch on a coastal hill overlooking a colorful island! Customize each corner of your kitchen and farm, indoors or outdoors. Choose from a wide variety of wall, flooring, window, decoration, and furniture styles.

Grow, Raise & Harvest

Grow fresh crops and raise animals right by your kitchen! Collect fresh produce and adopt pet companions. One harvest at a time!

Cook & Serve

Cook and Serve or Sell at your Farmers’ Market. Discover new recipes by exploring ingredients on the island! Create diverse menus, cook, bake, grill and serve flavoursome dishes to raise your reputation and attract even more customers!

Gather & Fish

Gather all kinds of wild flavours like mushrooms, berries and much more or go fishing in the open seas for rare catches!

Produce

Get useful machines to turn harvest into more advanced ingredients and unlock new recipes.

Manage

Manage resources, hire chefs, waiters and farmers, upgrade and grow the reputation of your place.Take it slow on the farm, then pick up the pace in the kitchen, turn your cozy humble spot into a 5-star restaurant!

games.name: Night Crew
games.shortDescription: A co-op horror game where you and up to 5 friends clean, fix and survive, in a lo-fi mall with high-key problems. Welcome to the Night Crew - you are NOT paid enough for this!
games.aboutText:
"Explore Twilight Palms Mall, a pure-blooded American retail paradise! Frequented by happy customers, cannibals, spiritual beings, and our lovely mall staff."

With proximity voice chat , ragdolls and up to 5 other friends , complete your shift as a member of the Night Crew !

You are being hunted. Run or hide from nocturnal monstrosities that track with you not only with sight, but sound and smell too . That pie you pinched from the bakery, may mean you end up in the next batch.

Hide in lockers, under tables or just in the shadows. Just remember to turn off your flashlight, and hold your breath if they come close!

Management have a couple of boxes they want ticking. Luckily, they have several suckers 𝚝𝚊𝚕𝚎𝚗𝚝𝚎𝚍 𝚊𝚜𝚜𝚎𝚝𝚜 to sort them out. Fix cabling, clean up trash, 𐌄𐋄Ꝋ𐌐𐌂𐌉𐌔𐌄 𐌔Ꝋ𐌌𐌄 𐌔𐌓𐌉𐌐𐌉𐌕𐌔... Whatever it takes to keep the suits happy.

And If you or one of your companions meets an unfortunate end, well... someone will have to clean up that mess.

You're on the clock. Earn money by completing your tasks, selling valuables or strange anomalies found in the mall - or for the brave, hitting the slots. Just remember, you have as much chance to win as to lose. And losing, can have severe consequences...

Sacrifice your cash to pay off more debt to avoid interest, or keep it to purchase powerful items to help make your next night easier. The earlier you pay it off, the easier of a time you'll have.

The mall shifts every night. The halls, courts and shops get more unhinged with every shift. What starts as a typical 80's shopping paradise twists and malforms, until Twilight Palms is unrecognisable.

Explore the shop fronts, the back offices and the maintenance corridors. Keep your eyes peeled - there are dark and dangerous things crawling all over the mall.

Communicate with high quality VOIP , with simulated audio bouncing your voices through doorways and echoes into wide open courts.

Maximise your drip, and your tools. purchase supply contracts from the After Dark Depot to fill your vending machine every night,

Complete challenges set by management to unlock exclusive new items, and unlock new skins for each character by clearing your debt (among other things!).

Here's what you can experience already:

- 👻 16 unique enemies

- 𝚐𝚛𝚎𝚊𝚝 𝚓𝚘𝚋 𝚜𝚊𝚝𝚒𝚜𝚏𝚊𝚌𝚝𝚒𝚘𝚗

- 🏃‍➡️ 6 iconic crew members

- 𝚠𝚘𝚗𝚍𝚎𝚛𝚏𝚞𝚕 𝚌𝚘-𝚠𝚘𝚛𝚔𝚎𝚛𝚜

- 🎩 18 cosmetics

- 𝚌𝚘𝚖𝚏𝚘𝚛𝚝𝚊𝚋𝚕𝚎 𝚞𝚗𝚒𝚏𝚘𝚛𝚖𝚜

- ⬆️ 11 skills

- 𝚌𝚊𝚛𝚎𝚎𝚛 𝚙𝚛𝚘𝚐𝚛𝚎𝚜𝚜𝚒𝚘𝚗

- 📦 21 items

- 𝚒𝚗𝚍𝚞𝚜𝚝𝚛𝚢 𝚜𝚝𝚊𝚗𝚍𝚊𝚛𝚍 𝚌𝚘𝚖𝚙𝚎𝚗𝚜𝚊𝚝𝚒𝚘𝚗

- 💀 Normal, Hard and Nightmare difficulties

- 𝚑𝚎𝚊𝚕𝚝𝚑𝚢 𝚠𝚘𝚛𝚔-𝚕𝚒𝚏𝚎 𝚋𝚊𝚕𝚊𝚗𝚌𝚎

We're already adding new content , our first big update will drop within a few weeks of launch, with new monsters, brand new mall biomes, new items and stylish new cosmetics!

Support us by wishlisting or getting a copy of the game!

FAQ

- Will the game feature microtransactions?

- No, we have no interest or plans for microtransactions.

- Will the game feature modding?

- Yes! We've got plans for extensive modding support dropping very soon.

- What is your stance on AI?

- We believe AI has no place in art and do not use it in our creative work.

- Are Steam inventory items marketable?

- No, and we don't currently have plans to make them marketable. Some items will be tradeable, but that's as far as we plan to take it!

- When will cross-play be available?

- When we launch on consoles, it'll be available day one!

- Who are Upstart Games?

- We're a small indie game developer and publisher located in the United Kingdom.

Got any more questions? Come talk to us on Discord - we'd love to chat to you!

games.name: 5 NIGHTS AT BOBR KURWA
games.shortDescription: Beaver Lyolik ate too many mushrooms and became a KURWA! Only the chosen ones can survive these 5 nights!
games.aboutText:
Beaver Lyolik was once a good guy, but one night everything changed! He became BEAVER KURWA! His fangs came out, and his eyes swelled up! The evil beaver ate all the cows and started hunting his brother!

And how it all began... We are sitting with the beaver at the table, preparing a log for dinner, but what happened, happened... Zhorik called the special agencies to combat such monsters! A superhero, Hamster Saveliy, is rushing to help! Now our hero will have to hold out for 5 nights until help arrives! Help Zhorik not to become lunch for his brother!

In this scary horror game about an evil beaver, you survive in a hut, from which you can leave in order to get the resources necessary for survival. Manage to saw boards and board up the windows before Beaver Kurva gets you! You will also have to brew a potion and light the fireplace, while looking into the cameras to assess how far away the scary beaver is! Keep the house boarded up, poison the beaver with a potion, or a scary screamer will come out!

The game is a survival horror in the style of "point-and-click". You control the character from the first person by clicking the mouse. You have the ability to move left and right, go outside to get resources. It is extremely important for you to calculate your time correctly, because one awkward movement and a scary screamer will not keep you waiting long!

games.name: Crashout Crew
games.shortDescription: Time to clock in at DE NILE SHIPPING, the world’s “most efficient” warehouse! Work together in online co-op with up to 4 players to fulfill orders of increasingly chaotic, physics-based boxes. Time is money, and safety is no concern… just try not to crash out!
games.aboutText:
At DE NILE SHIPPING, things move fast. And if they don’t, you’re the problem. Make a crew of up to 4 overworked friends and drive into a frantic co-op forklift experience where teamwork is key, and disaster is inevitable.

MULTIPLAYER WAREHOUSE MAYHEM

Research shows the best way to hit impossible deadlines is to build for speed, not safety. That’s why our warehouse isn’t just a workplace, it’s a full-blown raceway ! Our forklifts come tricked out with boost and drift capabilities for maximum productivity (and employee enrichment). Just try not to smash into each other.

GRAB IT, STACK IT, SHIP IT

Thanks to our forklifts’ patented “ Easy-Grab ” functionality, sorting and stacking is a breeze. Remember to constantly yell at your coworkers to keep the warehouse organized to avoid becoming buried under a pile of missed quotas. And chickens.

FULFILL RIDICULOUS ORDERS

Our warehouse is equipped to handle the most outlandish orders from across the globe. Lemons, anvils, explosives, primates… if you can dream it, we can deliver it! Fulfill a variety of unique contracts with over 20 types of boxes guaranteed to make your job a physics-based nightmare!!

DE NILE SHIPPING understands that customer convenience comes at the cost of employee safety, so please handle any volatile orders with care. Any damages will come out of your paycheck!

UPGRADES, UPGRADES, UPGRADES!

We might be out of budget for warehouse improvements, but you’re still welcome to spend your own hard-earned cash on new devices and forklift upgrades that are sure to make your job easier, if not a little safer!

FEATURES

- Online, lobby-based co-op physics chaos for up to 4 players

- A variety of contracts to complete, each with a unique set of crazy boxes to ship

- Manage your stress, and don’t crash out - or you’ll end up making your friends’ lives even tougher!

- Upgrade your warehouse and forklift to make the job easier! It’ll all reset after the contract, so no need to hoard your money!

- Additional Safety Violations modify the warehouse to add even more chaos! If the shift was tough before, just wait until the lights go out!

games.name: Hell Loop
games.shortDescription: A rogue-like dungeon crawler with Chinese mythic horror. Play as an ancient butcher, trapped in the cycles of the underworld. Seek redemption, gain the aid of heavenly gods, and fight for freedom—and for the wife you still love.
games.aboutText:
This is a Chinese-style monster hell rescue roguelike dungeon game.

- Ingenious level design

The game consists of 5 chapters and over 100 random levels. Meanwhile, we innovatively incorporate more random generation algorithms within each level to create a more interesting level experience, allowing you to enjoy unique fun in every cycle.

- Schools of thought with diverse styles

The game features a plethora of divine blessings such as archer, summoning, lightning, Bloodthirsty, and more, as well as a unique and powerful awakening skill. Understand these complex mechanisms and build your own Rampage genre.

- Rich props and relics

There are over 50 rare relics. They only function for a few rounds, but don't be small. Maybe one of their effects can save you from danger. At the same time, be careful of those enemies who have turned into evil spirits. Once you are injured, you will be cursed. They will limit your abilities and even pull you directly into the abyss.

- Branching out an interesting plot

The game features a meticulously designed storyline, and we have also incorporated some random plot elements: encounter characters with diverse personalities in scenes such as the secret realm created by the backlight, the eerie and terrifying hell palace, and the village and mountain forests of past lives, communicate with them, give gifts, and engage in mutual slaughter. Embark on a series of interesting love and hate, reconcile with past lives, and ultimately repent and be reborn.

- The bloodthirsty gun fired firmly

Destroying any creature or entity will send particles flying. Survive in the perilous situation of bullets and shells, enhance your abilities and pour out those merciless magic balls!

- A destructible and highly free open experience

Your attacks all have the potential to destroy walls or plots, demonstrate superb body skills on changing terrains, or dig for mysterious hidden rewards (including traps).

games.name: this game will end in 205 clicks.
games.shortDescription: What does a SUPERVILLAIN do, when he is forbidden from doing anything evil for the day? WARNING: This is not the type of game where you can make meaningful choices.
games.aboutText:
👑 What does a SUPERVILLAIN do, when he is forbidden from doing anything evil for the day? 👑

This is it!!! ROYAL the SUPERVILLAIN has finally completed his SUPER KINGLY WEAPON. Thanks to it, he can finally end the reign of the heroes of CITYVILLE, the GIRLS!

But, what's this? There's a maintenance? Because of it, he can't enact any evil deeds today ?

Well, it's all fine! There's lots to do today. So watch ROYAL yap on and on about his job, about his past, about what it means to be ☒☒☒☒☒, and smile at his funny antics !

FEATURES:

- ROYAL , the most ☒☒☒☒☒ SUPERVILLAIN of CITYVILLE!

- Hover over pink words to learn more about ROYAL! What's his SUPER KINGLY WEAPON? How many PARTIES has he been to? How many games has he starred in?!?

- This game is so short , you can finish it in less than 30 minutes! You will have the rest of the day free for all your subquests.

- A counter on the bottom right of the screen...?

- WARNING: This is not the type of game where you can make meaningful choices.

games.name: Heroic Songs: the Remix!
games.shortDescription: Travel through fantasy worlds and build an idol sanctuary! An idol × city-building simulation game where you create your very own fan sanctuary alongside adorable idols to restore the lost connections between worlds!
games.aboutText:
● Build a fan sanctuary in the Void between worlds!

Heroic Songs: the Remix! is an Idol x City-building simulation game where you develop a barren land and act as the idol manager for Akari Sunohara to become a top idol.

● Design your ideal fan sanctuary with over 50 types of buildings!

Transform a barren land into an idol fan sanctuary (Fanctuary) where fans flock in droves. Enjoy strategic city building by managing resource flows and growing both the city and the idol, Akari.

Build the city's foundation: Construct residences and attract diverse fans from other worlds to the city.
Create your resource flows: Connect facilities to collect and process resources, which will further drive your city's development.
Turn passion into "likes": Convert fan passion into idol power at entertainment facilities!

Whether your prefer fantasy, sci-fi, or Japanese-style... As you unlock new technologies from other worlds, you can funnel your inner architect to create a unique and magnificent stage all your own!

● Set up the stages, and your idols will perform for their fans!

While each idol shines on stage, their energy will spread to the surrounding facilities, drastically increasing the city's vibrancy.
Live Performances and Tours: Challenge yourself with Concerts and Tours with the idols you've placed on the stage!
Power Up with Experience Points: As their level increases, their impact on surrounding buildings becomes even stronger.
Skill Customization: Use skill points to customize how you want to decorate your city and customize your idols' growth!

● A 30-second showdown! Thrill your fans with the best Concert!

Test your skills in a rhythm game that proves the idols' brilliance. Achieving high scores will retain fans, and both the idols and the city will grow significantly!
As the story progresses, special concert costumes for the idols will be unlocked!
Succeed on stage and get new stories and luxurious rewards!

● The path to idoldom is rough, and you can experience it through the scenario!

The development of the town and the success of their concerts weave a new story for for each character. The miracle of an ordinary girl, helping the world feel hope again, and the unexpected true faces behind the idols she befriends and looks up to...
You're sure to be moved by their passionate stories.

■■ Story ■■

You were at the brilliant performance of top idol Ruri Tsukuyomi , and in the next moment, you awaken in an unfamiliar land.
There, someone extends a hand to you. Akari Sunohara , a girl who loves idols with all her heart.
And then there's the unfortunate truth revealed by the flower fairy, Moku-san . This is a place called the Void, a space between worlds, and there is currently no way to return to your original world.
The only hope lies in the idol potential dormant within Akari. Idols are special beings who can connect the different worlds and become a light for those sinking into despair. You'll need to help Akari shine if you have any hope of returning home to your original world.

And, with your own two hands, build the ultimate fan sanctuary in this void between worlds!

■■ Characters ■■

● Protagonist (You)
You’re the one who was transported to the Void alongside Akari. As the central figure in this world, your role is to support Akari and the other idols on their journey.

● Akari Sunohara / voiced by: Seika Hirose
An ordinary girl with an extraordinary love for idols. She possesses the innate potential to become one herself, and must step into the spotlight to find a way home.
At first, she struggles with doubt and frustration, but grows through her encounters with veteran idols and her fans in the fantasy worlds.

● Ruri Tsukuyomi / voiced by: Risae Matsuda
The Ultimate Idol, reigning at the top with an overwhelming presence and voice. Her legacy echoes throughout the various fantasy worlds Akari explores.
　

● Lynalelle Singulant / voiced by: Hitomi Sekine
The idol of Seven Falls, a fantasy-themed world. She’s a king, an idol, and a passionate idol superfan all in one!

● Haru / voiced by Yuka Amemiya
The idol of Discordia, a sci-fi-themed world. She’s a trusted senior to Akari, but seems to be hiding some complicated circumstances. 　

● Kaguya / voiced by Risae Matsuda
The idol of Karan Ashihara, a world with a traditional Japanese aesthetic. As the wild and fearsome Behemoth of Befoulment, she stands in Akari’s path as a powerful rival.
　

■■ Guidelines for Streaming and Fanwork ■■

● Streaming and Video Content Guidelines Both individuals and organizations are welcome to stream Heroic Songs: the Remix! on video-sharing platforms, as well as upload gameplay footage. This includes live streams, Let's Plays , and other related content. No prior approval from Frontier Works or Emma Create will be required, and monetization of the content (such as via ad revenue) is permitted.

However, the content must be adapted for the intended audience in a way that could be considered transformative.
Examples

games.name: Heidi's Legacy: Mountains Calling
games.shortDescription: Heidi's Legacy is a cozy narrative sim where you care for goats, craft mountain goods, and help villagers rebuild their lives. Experience a peaceful pastoral life, inspired by the Heidi novels, celebrating nature, healing, community, and self-discovery.
games.aboutText:
Play as Heidi , a young woman who escapes the city life by returning to the mountains of her youth. Taken in by your grumpy but kind grandfather, you are entrusted with caring for his goats and gradually become part of a small alpine village, where you take part in shaping its future.

Through branching dialogue and personal choices, you'll support villagers in rebuilding not just their homes but their lives. Will you embrace slow living or push for bolder change?

As Heidi settles into mountain life, bonds deepen and hearts open. Your relationships may grow into friendship or something more romantic : who Heidi chooses to love is yours to decide.

Inspired by the spirit of the Heidi novels, the narrative explores themes of healing through nature, the importance of helping one another, and the different ways to rebuild a community.

Guide your goats through blooming meadows, help them find the best flowers to graze, and keep them happy with toys and attention. In return, they'll provide milk and wool, which are precious resources for the village's revival.

Use what nature provides to create artisanal products like cheese, wool clothing, herbal remedies, and wooden crafts. Trade or share these with villagers to help improve their homes and livelihoods. Every choice helps shape your relationship with the community.

Wander across lush valleys, quiet forests, and high-altitude lakes. Herd goats, forage for herbs and mushrooms, and fish in peaceful alpine waters. As you aid the village, you'll unlock new abilities that make it easier to climb, leap, and uncover parts of your newfound world.

games.name: Robot Hospice
games.shortDescription: "Robot Hospice" is a 2D pixel art adventure game where beloved robots spend their final days in a hospice. As a new staff member, you will gently yet painfully bid farewell to these cherished machines that once lived alongside humans.
games.aboutText:
For everyone who wishes to be kind, and for those who can only live with kindness.

　　　　　　　

"Robot Hospice" is a heartfelt adventure game about bidding farewell to beloved robots.

⬜︎ Welcome to Robot Hospice!

A place where cherished robots spend their final days, the Robot Hospice .
As Elis , a new staff member, you will interact with these robots, share their memories, and face both partings and self-discovery along the way.

⬜︎ Your Role

Your goal in this game is to see all five robots through their final moments .

By talking to the robots and strengthening your bond with them,
you will learn about their past and their final wishes.

🖤 Your choices in conversations and actions will shape how you say goodbye.
Do your best to give them the most peaceful farewell possible.

⬜︎ A Nostalgic and Heartwarming World

The story unfolds in a world depicted with charming 2D pixel art and accompanied by classic Famicom tunes .
Immerse yourself in an atmosphere filled with warmth and nostalgia.

⬜︎ Estimated Playtime

🕒 1 to 2 hours

games.name: Long Live My Lady! 🍻 Tavern Simulator
games.shortDescription: A lone gnome, a sleeping princess and a sea of beer. Take care of your mistress by becoming the manager of the only tavern in the entire Dungeon!
games.aboutText:
Long Live My Lady! - is the story of a gnome who runs the only tavern in the Dungeon. The tavern was once run by his landlady, but now she has fallen into a deep slumber. Bring the tavern back to its former glory, rebuild it, create items, cook food, run errands for the locals and of course brew beer!

Furnish the tavern to your liking

It's been a long time since the last customer left the tavern. The tavern has fallen into disrepair. Create interior and decorative items and furnish it as you wish! Decorative items have a positive effect on the visitors and who knows, maybe they will look at this beautiful statue and leave a good review of your place!

Serve your tavern visitors

Your guests expect you to serve them to the highest standard. Serve them a glass of cold beer or a plate of delicious stew. But be careful, visitors won't like it if you stay in the kitchen too long or don't keep an eye on your tavern. Follow proper time management and plan ahead. And remember - the customer is always right!

Complete your tasks

The duties of a tavern owner include more than just brewing beer. Talk to the visitors and explore the tavern's surroundings. This is a great way to find a couple or two quests that will lead you to new discoveries!

Farm and cook your meals

There's nothing better than a good beer appetizer. Grow vegetables and plants to make dishes that even the pickiest of diners will enjoy. And fishing and livestock farming are a great way to diversify your menu!

Combine recipes with additional ingredients

Who says you can't diversify your dishes a little? After all, no one can see what you're doing in your kitchen. Add extra ingredients to your recipes to achieve new effects. Maybe you have a picky customer who is always dissatisfied with something? Pour a spell potion into his beer and he'll leave satisfied no matter what. Or maybe he has something you want. Add sleeping pills to his food and rummage through his pockets while he sleeps. Find additional ingredients and study their effects on your customers!

Take care of your princess

The princess is long asleep, but her spirit is still with you. Present her with gifts to keep her awake, and in gratitude she will help you expand and improve the tavern. But be careful - your mistress will not tolerate mistakes, and if you disappoint her, you won't get away with it so easily.

games.name: Billy the Hero
games.shortDescription: Billy woke up on Hell Island as a bear. No memories. No regrets. Apparently, this is just who he is now. A Dark Fantasy Turn-Based RPG where math kills, heroines are unhinged, and the truth about Billy is the one thing the game won't hand you easily.
games.aboutText:
😈 Welcome to Hell Island... This Hell is My Harem and Paradise!

When there are too many so-called "Heroes of Justice"! Dive into madness with this Dark Fantasy Turn-Based RPG ! Meet "Billy," the world's worst criminal embodying all 7 Deadly Sins, who wakes up on the mysterious "Hell Island" in the body of a muscular bear with zero memories...

To others, Hell is a place for penance. But for Billy, his primal instincts tell him to turn these ruins into his "Personal Paradise" and rise as the supreme ruler of the island!

⚔️ "Lethal Math" Combat & The Greed System

Break the traditional RPG rules! There's no MP/SP for casting spells here. Instead, we use a "4-Color Gem" combat system where you must use your brain to choose between safety or pure greed!

- 💎 Greed Mechanic: If you're "greedy" enough to risk your life and hoard Gems until the end of the battle, each Gem will convert into a flat 10% Bonus EXP immediately! Will you take the pain for faster farming, or spam your skills just to survive? The choice is yours!

- 🎯 Trigger Hit: The "Death Number" floating above characters' heads! Every skill has a hidden numerical value. Calculate your attacks to reach a sum of "9" to trigger devastating effects (Double Drop) . But miss the math and hit "0" , and your attack is instantly nullified! (Beware... enemies can use this system to smash your head in, too!)

💔 Psycho Therapy: Collect a Harem of "Beautiful(?)" & Dangerous Girls

What's an island adventure without girls? Meet our Heroines , bringing you a mix of cuteness and their own unique "Psychological Disorders." From a narcissistic nurse and a socially anxious vampire to a psychopathic chef and a paranoid zombie!

They aren't just your standard party members. You must handle and satisfy them through bizarre conditions. The deeper you build your relationships, the more powerful and insane their "Synergy Attacks" with Billy will become!

🏗️ Manage Your Hellish City via "Hunger" (Base Building & Hunger Economy)

Turn an abandoned mall into a capitalist empire! Find and recruit hilarious and cheeky "Zobiimon" demons to populate your city. But remember, nothing is free on this island!

- 🥩 Hunger for Wealth: Your citizens generate money based on their "Energy" levels. Higher energy means the cash flows endlessly. But let them starve to 0 Energy... and your income halts immediately!

- 🧑‍🌾 Feed to Greed: Embrace your inner hell-farmer. Grow crops, cook food, and stuff it into your citizens' mouths so they can keep working and grinding money for you non-stop!

🌍 A World You Can't Trust & Dethroning "The 7 Lords of Sin"

Explore a ruined land filled with horrific races, including:

- 🧟 The Mindless (hordes of brainless mutants)

- 👾 Zobiimon (eccentric mutants)

- 🧍 Original Human (normal humans - who might just be the most dangerous and untrustworthy of all!)

Your ultimate goal is to trample the old regime. Overthrow the boss syndicates known as "The 7 Lords of Sin" to claim absolute supremacy over the island for yourself.

💊 The Ultimate Choice: A Conclusion of Truth or Illusion

As your journey progresses, horrific memories of your past will begin to surface as hallucinations . Your trusted assistant will offer you a "Pill" to erase those nightmares and grant you eternal bliss... The decision is yours:

"Will you choose to sleep in your beautiful harem dream... or wake up to face your own dark reality?" Every action and choice you make will lead to a different ending!

💌 Developer Note

This game was born from a deep passion for Handmade / Hand-drawn Art . The core character art, sprites, enemies, and environments are 100% drawn and designed by human hands . (We utilize Generative AI tools strictly for upscaling specific image assets to enhance sharpness, and to assist with initial localization drafts—all of which are subsequently reviewed and polished by human developers.) Rest assured, you will experience a meticulously crafted, classic, and truly soulful artistic journey!

🎭 Inspiration from the Mundane: A Wickedly Dark Social Satire Beyond the classic retro games we grew up with, the wacky designs of these monsters actually come from "everyday objects" you'd never expect! The storyline and enemies are crafted to deliver a biting satire of modern society.

You won't find any overly poetic dialogues here. Every character communicates in "everyday human speech" that is raw, real, and intensely emotional!

games.name: SPACEROCKS
games.shortDescription: Mine asteroids, find rare loot, upgrade & modify your ship, build space factories, and destroy your enemies!
games.aboutText:
SPACEROCKS is an action/adventure game with incremental aspects and heavy ARPG influence. Highly satisfying mining and looting, diverse and powerful upgrades, space factory building and fast-paced intense combat awaits you!

As a mining drone gone rogue, your ultimate goal is to build the Wormhole Machine and escape from the reaches of The Corporation. To accomplish this, you will need many supporting factories constructing the necessary parts and Generators to power them.

To fund this colossal construction project, you will need a vast amount of resources, obtained primarily by blasting asteroids to pieces. You'll also collect rare loot from destroying enemies and random events you encounter.

To survive the relentless assault from your fellow drones, you'll also use your precious mined resources and spoils of combat to upgrade, modify, and boost your ship's power.

- Explore : Seven procedurally generated areas with infinite asteroids to mine and enemies to blast.

- Upgrade : 24 different ship components to upgrade individually.

- Modify : More than 80 ship modifications (and more coming!) which fundamentally change how the ship behaves, or how you will play.

- Construct : Buildings which help you to multiply your resources and accumulate the wealth needed to manufacture Wormhole Machine parts.

- ARPG-Style Looting : Tons of loot to mine from asteroids and collect from enemies including materials for upgrades/construction, gems which give temporary buffs when used, asteroid cores with randomly rolled upgrades to equip, ship modifications and more.

- New Game Plus : Progress through 3 difficulties Diablo 2-style while keeping your upgrades, and find increasingly powerful loot and difficult challenges.

- End Game : Endlessly scaling bosses and other endgame activities await the truly hardcore.

- Stats & Leaderboards : Track all the numbers from your playthrough in the Statistics panel, and opt-in to the Leaderboards to measure yourself up against other players in dozens of different categories.

- In-Game Guide: Have a question? Open up the guide and dive into a wealth of information on the game's many mechanics.

games.name: Di Renjie:  The Legendary Investigator
games.shortDescription: Become a legendary detective of ancient China! In "Di Renjie: The Legendary Investigator", play as Di Renjie, solving thrilling cases across Bianzhou and Bingzhou in the Tang Dynasty and uncovering the truth.
games.aboutText:
Please Note:
1.The story and plot of this game are entirely fictional and have no relation to any real persons, groups, or historical events.

2.Even though Steam does not consider the use of AI assistance in code to be a case requiring disclosure, we still place this statement here for players to choose. To improve development efficiency, some program code (and only the program code portion) of this work used AI assistance during development. Please take note.

Game Description

During the reign of Emperor Gaozong of the Tang Dynasty, an unexpected turn of events thrusts the young official Di Renjie into the role of a judicial officer. Renowned for his almost supernatural skill in solving cases during his tenure, he earns the moniker "The Legendary Investigator."

In this mystery-text adventure game set against the backdrop of China's Tang Dynasty, you will step into the shoes of the judicial officer Di Renjie. Your task is to crack a series of baffling cases across the prefectures of Bianzhou and Bingzhou, drive the story forward, unravel the enigmas, and uncover the truth hidden behind each case.

Character Introductions

Di Renjie:
Destined to serve as the Legal Affairs Administrator (Facao Canjun) of the Bingzhou Governor's Office in the future, Di Renjie finds himself imprisoned at the start of the story, framed by villains. Strong-willed and even stubborn—can he find a way to free himself from jail?

Qiao Tai:
He crosses paths with Di Renjie during a case and later becomes his subordinate. A coroner with snow-white hair and beard, Qiao Tai appears cold and mysterious. What secrets lie beneath his stern exterior?

Ma Rong:
A future subordinate of Di Renjie, Ma Rong is a female vigilante roaming Bingzhou before she meets him. Lively, warm-hearted, and imbued with a chivalrous spirit, she is always ready to help.

Zheng Chongzhi:
A future colleague of Di Renjie, also serving as a Legal Affairs Administrator. Gentle, sensitive, and seemingly frail, Zheng Chongzhi nevertheless possesses a inner strength that surpasses most.

Yan Liben:
A renowned painter of the Tang Dynasty, but in this story, Yan Liben appears not for his artistry. As the Imperial Inspector of Henan Circuit, he is a key patron who recognizes Di Renjie's talent—it is through his recommendation that Di Renjie embarks on his path of solving mysteries.

Game Features

- Set in ancient China's Tang Dynasty, this detective drama blends historical legends to deliver an immersive experience as authentic as possible.

- Over 200,000 words of text and 5+ hours of gameplay for you to explore.

- Investigate crime scenes from Di Renjie's perspective and uncover the truth behind each case!

- Click-based exploration, QTE mechanics, witness testimony analysis to spot contradictions—enjoy a unique and varied gameplay system!

games.name: MOCHI-O
games.shortDescription: A doomsday land defense adventure in which you raise MOCHI-O, a weapon of annihilation that looks a lot like a hamster, to protect your country. Pet and raise MOCHI-O to defeat the oncoming enemies and fight through the tender post-apocalypse.
games.aboutText:
A homeland defense adventure to raise and fight kawaii annihilation weapons!

Handheld annihilation weapons to defeat invading enemies

Hold MOCHI-O in your right hand, aim at the enemy, and attack. Enemies you defeat will drop seeds.

As you accumulate experience gained from picking up the seeds, you will gain skills from random choices.

Strengthen your MOCHI-O in battle to destroy the approaching enemies and defend the defense line.

Throwing Seeds to Breed MOCHI-O

Spend the money you earn in battle to strengthen MOCHI-O.

You can also unlock weapons, which will give you an advantage in battle.

Giving seeds to MOCHI-O will increase its trust level and strengthen its status.

What is MOCHI-O?

A cute hamster......but a handy annihilation weapon for homeland defense.

The player's mission is to raise MOCHI-O as a keeper and protect his country from foreign enemies.

The heartwarming dialogue between the characters is also a highlight of the game.

Creator Profile

Zxima

Zxima started game development as an independent developer in 2017,

He has released 10 games, including “Parasite Days” and “Post-apocalypse Bakery”.

His games are set in a tender post-apocalypse world, and feature game systems and a mysterious worldview created by his unique sensibility.

“Catastrophe Restaurant” won the Top 3 award at the Google Play Indie Games Festival 2022.

[Creator's comment]

Wouldn't it be great if you could go on a rampage with a small, cute, and extremely strong character?

That's what I had in mind when I created this game from start to finish.

I would be happy if you could go on a rampage with a small, cute, and extremely strong character.

games.name: Grail
games.shortDescription: In this deckbuilder your deck plays automatically. Upgrade, enchant and stickerize your cards to create clever cascading effects that defeat monsters and other players. Can you reach the Grail?
games.aboutText:
Grail is a fantasy autobattler where your deck plays automatically! Take on foes in pitched card battles that play out before your eyes.
Test your deck building prowess against monsters and other players. Stack wins together and climb your way from lowly blade-for-hire to a master of the auto-battling arts!

Overview

- PvP autobattler deckbuilder

- Fast runs that take between 15min - 45min

- Multiple playable characters, each with their own unique pool of cards

- 250+ cards and 100+ traits

- Unlock all characters and cosmetics by playing the game

Fights play out automatically. Focus entirely on creating clever synergies by strategizing in between battles. Collect new cards, make them stronger by upgrading, adjusting or enchanting them. Gain specialized traits or find secret events. Then watch another fight unfold!

Pick a hero from a growing roster of characters each with their unique pool of cards and playstyle.
Collect trophies by winning games, which you can use to unlock cosmetics for your characters!

Is it even real? Why is everyone after it? Find out by unlocking pieces of lore for winning games with different cards. And who knows, maybe you will find it after all!

games.name: HOMESICKNESS
games.shortDescription: HOMESICKNESS is a point-&-click psychological horror indie game exploring the nuances of nostalgia. Play as Theo, trapped in CHILDREEF’s daycare, descending floor by floor; surviving the remnants of time. Use the Kids' multi-tool, listen to obscure tapes, and make your way to the lot. She's waiting.
games.aboutText:
A psychological computer game by jnity, assisted by celesware

WILL THE FAMILIAR FACES RETURN?

HOMESICKNESS is a solely developed point-and-click free-roam psychological horror game that delves into the depths and nuances of nostalgia and primitive online media.

Step into the shoes of Theo as he explores the empty, desolate halls of CHILDREEF , making his way to the lower floors. With the Kids' Multi-tool, uncover hidden exits and find your way down as you attempt to make sense of what is happening.

Explore, collect items, find special tools for survival, and overcome what awaits in the seemingly empty corridors of CHILDREEF .

With each game over, things begin to change. Previously visited paths become blocked, and disorientation starts to set in.

Keep an eye on unseen corners; you are not alone.

LEST THE UNSEEN CORNERS HARBOR HIDDEN TRUTHS

You play as young Theo, awakening in a place long forgotten. In his possession is a lone tape, left behind by a loved one who holds a place in his heart.

The remnants of the tape serve as your only guide, leading you deeper into the daycare of CHILDREEF. As you listen to the tape's fragmented messages, clues begin to emerge.

The voice that speaks on the other end is the one that will guide you. She waits for you to come, on your way down.

CORE FEATURES

- Point-and-click free-roam exploration spanning three segments, where every corner must be checked; every item has a purpose.

- Varied mechanics for each threat , each centered around a different tool at your disposal.

- A deep dive into the nuances and symptoms of nostalgia , portrayed through an abstract, surreal lens.

- A flexible, carefully crafted 2000s aesthetic that reinforces the core themes and atmosphere of HOMESICKNESS .

- Lite gameplay randomization ; with every death, room functions shift, previous exits disappear, and items appear in different locations.

- An emotional, psychological story , woven into every aspect of the game.

- Expansive post-game content , directly expanding on the main narrative; once you finish the game, there will still be much to discover.

- Accessibility options and a highly customizable UI ; playable with both mouse and keyboard or mouse only. The game does not rely on sound, though audio enhances the experience.

- Optimized performance , ensuring smooth gameplay on most mid-range modern computers.

A minimum of 1GB of RAM is required to run the game.

games.name: IZEA:10puzzle Rogue-Lite RPG!
games.shortDescription: "Make 10 is mightier than the sword!" IZEA is a fresh strategic battle game that fuses “Make 10” × Puzzle Calculation × RPG × Roguelite. Use number cards and arithmetic operators to calculate the enemy’s designated Weak Number and fight your way to victory!
games.aboutText:
"Make 10 is mightier than the sword!"

IZEA is a fresh new strategic battle game that fuses “Make 10” × Puzzle Calculation × RPG × Roguelite × Deckbuilding.

Use numbers and arithmetic operators to hit the enemy’s designated Weak Number and deal damage strategically.
Your calculation skills and creativity are the keys to victory!

The enemy’s weakness is numbers !
Attack with math in this brand-new turn-based battle system!

Simple commands, deep strategy

Your only commands are numbers (1–9) and operators (+, −, ×, ÷) .
The closer your equation’s result is to the enemy’s Weak Number, the more damage you’ll deal.

Match the number exactly , and unleash a powerful strike that hits all enemies while also nullifying their skills!
Which enemy’s skill will you counter? Can you line up the perfect result?
Your math skills will be put to the test!

Build your favorite strategy!

Form a party from 7 cute and quirky allies

Throughout the story you’ll meet 7 unique characters, each with their own traits and skill cards—over 50 kinds in total .
From classic roles like attacker and healer, to special IZEA-only abilities such as “change a number,” every character brings something different.
It’s up to you who to team up with!

Customize your numbers!

Power up skill cards at the Skill Shop

Having trouble winning? Power up your numbers!
As you progress, you’ll unlock the ability to add special effects to number cards.
Which effect attaches depends on the character, making every setup unique.
Find your favorite number and make it yours!

A pop, fun, and dystopian story across 7 chapters!

Embark on the main scenario “To the 4tress of 10ebera” , where you and your allies take on the evil Demon Lord Tenebrer .
Uncover the pasts, flaws, and hidden sides of the cute-but-complex characters as you face various incidents and stories.

In addition to multiple endings from the main story, every ally also has special scenarios and endings unlocked through building bonds with them.

Face endless entertainment!

The roguelite “ To the 10pest ” mode

IZEA also features an endless roguelite mode.
Bring your strongest party and skill set, and use the upgrade items you earn in battle to survive against enemies that grow stronger without end.

Track your progress with rankings for defeated enemies, highest damage dealt, and damage taken.
Pull off an amazing combo or massive damage? Show it off to the world!

games.name: Funi Raccoon Game
