games.shortDescription: Explore a series of whimsical, interconnected worlds to steal everything not nailed down. Make a garbage bin a garbage home :)
games.aboutText:
Funi Raccoon Game , a 3D Platformer Collectathon. You play as a raccoon who has recently acquired a new home (Dumpster).

Home is where the stuff is, but your home is pretty empty. Fill up your dumpster with cool, unique stuff. The more stuff you have, the more places you can go! Travel the lands, "help" the locals, and solve puzzles -- all in the aim to get more stuff!?!

- Pick Up and Throw Stuff

- Use that stuff for problem solving

- The more stuff you have, the more new areas you unlock

- Your stuff enables a multitude of traversal possibilities for those willing to seize the keys of opportunity

- Travel to various microworlds all interconnected in whimsical ways

hi o/

games.name: Sinker sound
games.shortDescription: Fish in the strange domain of the mermaid, and find many strange fish with their own unique original music! You must REEL to the beat of the song! This is a fishing game with a musical rhythm gimmick!
games.aboutText:
This is a Fishing game with a Rhythm gimmick!

Fish here are all move to the rhythm of the music!

REEL TO THE BEAT!

Fish here are all move to the rhythm of the music!

Reeling is essential, and you must reel to the beat of the song!

- Catch several fishes each with their own original song!

- Cute retro 3D graphics!

- Visuals inspired by early 2000's aesthetics!

- Explore strange locations in the lake, how much deeper does this lake go?

Story

You are a curious fisher who felt the calling to come to this mysterious lake.

Fish here are affected by the power of the mermaid, and you must learn to sync with their music in order to fish for them.

Eventually you will find out how much deeper this lake can go.

Features

Unique Rhythm gameplay! - Fishing in this game will be to the beat of the song and you must maintain the line tension at all cost!

Make melodies along with the music! - Reeling in this game will also play melodies along with the music. Making music feels unique every time you fish!

Explore many strange environments! - You may get to fish in a place that you never thought to fish before!

A strange collection of fish! - Many fish aren't anything you've seen before! They can be quite strange.

a Custom fish chart editor! - you can create your own custom fish and share them to other players!

games.name: Skating Rink Story
games.shortDescription: Make your wildest ice dreams come true with this skating rink management game.
games.aboutText:
Let the elegant sound of carefully sharpened metal on meticulously maintained ice ring through your ears as you manage your very own ice skating rink. Train up your eager staff and enter them into competitions.

But first things first—you're going to need a huge rink, a place where your customers can glide with glee. And you never know when a carefully placed object on the ice may lead to an impromptu photoshoot.

Make sure your skaters are warm and happy off the ice with a heated room and soup bar. Some people might even post their experiences on social media, too!

Keep customers coming back by listening to their requests, like increasing the food choices at your rink. And with the right combination, who knows what amazing dishes you may discover! You can't skate on an empty stomach, after all!

You're also going to need a capable instructor or two to teach skaters all kinds of amazing tricks and bring out their full potential! And once they master the basics, have them create a figure-skating program and enter competitions! Their success on the ice will mean more business for your rink!

Looks like even the mayor from the town over has heard about your rink and come to check it out for themselves! With this kind of popularity, it won't be long until you have people coming from all over the world!

Now, get ready to create countless wonderful memories with your skaters, and aim to turn your rink into an unforgettable, 5-star facility!

--

Try searching for "Kairosoft" to see all of our games!!

Developer Homepages. Feel free to follow me♪

games.name: Clear the Snow
games.shortDescription: Play with up to 4 friends and help clear the city of snow. Work together using shovels, snow blowers, and heavy machinery to complete jobs and upgrade your gear. Enjoy cozy winter vibes, and the freedom to play your own way!
games.aboutText:
Clear the Snow with Friends

From casual players to perfectionists — everyone will find something for themselves. Enjoy the calm rhythm, cozy atmosphere, and meditative satisfaction of clearing snow one patch at a time.

Have Fun with up to 4 Friends

A shovel isn’t just a tool — it’s also a ride!

Slide down snowy hills with your friends and prove who’s the fastest to reach the bottom. Have snowball fights, build snowmen, and take on fun challenges — there’s always something to do together!

Choose the Right Tool and Enjoy the Process

Watch as every movement reveals a perfectly clean surface beneath. Layer by layer, the heavy snow disappears, leaving behind a sense of order and peace. It’s more than just cleaning — it’s a mesmerizing, soothing experience.

Use Powerful Equipment

You’ll have access to shovels, snow blowers, melting trucks, anti-ice chemicals, and even heavy machinery! Each tool you use earns experience points you can spend on upgrades and skill improvements.

Clear the Snow and Earn Money

Start with simple tools and take on snow-clearing jobs around town. Complete tasks, earn money, and gradually improve your equipment. As you progress, unlock new machines, access larger contracts, and expand your snow-removal capabilities step by step.

Wishlist and Follow for Updates!

games.name: Adult Life Yuri Bundle by Team ANPIM
games.shortDescription: Collection of 4 yuri stories by Team ANPIM, featuring women who are 23 years and older! No longer students, they are finding romance while balancing the responsibilities of working, rent, and adulting.
games.aboutText:
Four couples, four yuri stories

Want to read yuri? Here's not only 1, but 4 yuri stories featuring women who are 23 years and older! No longer students, they are finding romance while balancing the responsibilities of working, rent, and adulting.

Developed by Team ANPIM: Your quick fix for short, cheesy, and fluffy yuri kinetic novels.

Total length: ~112,000 words My Dream Is To Be a Model, Not a Maid!

Tanaka Akane is a stubborn and hot-headed 24 year old still chasing her lifetime dream of being a model, but after countless amounts of interviews, she still hasn't landed a permanent modeling job at an agency yet. To make matters worse, she accidentally spills coffee on a rich CEO's daughter and now this stranger demands Akane to be her maid to pay off the damages. How will Akane fare as a maid for this snobby and impossible rich girl? Will she even be able to last a day?

Length: ~28,000 words There’s No Way I’d Fall in Love With a Womanizer, Right?

Being the type that cares too much to a fault, Asahina Umeko helps out a supposedly drunk girl one night, and she soon finds out that this girl is the hot new celebrity worker at the mall she works at. She's instantly attracted despite their weird first meeting, but all that goes down the drain when Umeko finds out that this girl is a serial womanizer that breaks one too many hearts and with everything pointing to red flags. Umeko swears off falling for her, but can she really resist getting swept up by this womanizer's charisma, or will she end up getting drunk off her?

Length: ~30,000 words The Moon That Fell for the Star

Tsukimiya Minami is just an ordinary convenience store worker trying to make ends meet—another day, another dollar. But things takes an unexpected turn during a late-night shift when she encounters a mysterious stranger in need of help. Against her better judgment, Minami offers her a place to stay. Little does she know, her new and annoying (yet surprisingly captivating) roommate is more than meets the eye (and ear) with a plate full of troubles. Yet, Minami can’t seem to resist lending a hand. As Minami gains a new temporary roommate, she soon also ends up gaining something else unexpectedly…

Length: ~28,000 words Love Goes Toward Love

When a new cafe opens right in front of the one Chiyoda Juri works at, tensions begin to rise between the two competing owners. After a fateful encounter, Juri falls in love at first sight with the beautiful and charismatic stranger that saved her life—who just so happens to be the new worker at the rivalling cafe. To make matters worse, her savior already has eyes on someone else! How will Juri deal with these overflowing feelings for someone she shouldn’t have feelings for?

Length: ~26,000 words

Content warning:
Some characters consume alcohol in the story. There is no sexual content in the stories. One character has slightly revealing outfit but no nudity is mentioned or depicted in-game.

games.name: Deus Exia
games.shortDescription: “Before your planet gets blown into smithereens, take this sword and protect yourself.” Embark on a colorful 2D pixel action adventure in Deus Exia! Slash, parry and combo through four distinct lands. Collect cards and skills to craft powerful builds — then overcome deadly enemies and bosses.
games.aboutText:
“O dweller of another world, you have opened the seal of the Exiles. They are fiercely aggressive, we had no choice but to banish them. Before your planet gets blown into smithereens, take this sword and protect yourself.”

After ‘accidentally’ breaking a dangerous seal, Exia is entrusted with the Sword of Deus, a powerful extraterrestrial weapon. Now she must fend off an impending alien invasion.

Gameplay

Wreak destruction on your foes with ground combos, air combos and 50+ types of active skills.

Decide when to knock enemies down. Some enemies retaliate when getting back up, so look out!

Master your parry, use it to block melee attacks or reflect enemy projectiles back at them.

Strengthen your abilities by collecting and upgrading 100+ types of cards scattered throughout the world.

Journey across four regions: Dravendale City, Eremoth Desert, Ulthar Tundra and Stelaria Isles, each featuring unique environments and new characters.

Face overwhelming threats: will you emerge victorious?

Features

- 2D pixel sidescrolling action platformer.

- 16+ levels, each introducing new environments, enemies and bosses.

- An elaborate combo and knockdown system.

- 100+ cards to enhance your abilities.

- 50+ active skills for handling different situations.

- 60+ cutscene illustrations.

- Available in English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Japanese.

games.name: Whisk
games.shortDescription: Whisk is a two-player platformer about shared movement and communication. Coordinate jumps, climbs and throws with a partner to get every Dreamcat home.
games.aboutText:
Scout your route. Dash, leap, throw. Trust.

Whisk is a two-player platformer about shared movement and communication. Dash through surreal worlds as Luna and Foam. Rescue Dreamcats by launching them into interdimensional portals.

Stages are short and sweet

Laugh off your misses and run it back. The fastest runs demand coordination, timing, and the confidence to commit.

Save ‘em all!

features

- Work together in split screen or online coop

- 8+ stages in the demo to ascend through

- 10+ secret lost cats to rescue in the demo

- Fast and fluid movement mechanics and physics

- Achievements and time trial badges for every stage

- Friends and global leaderboards for every stage

- A stylized watercolor world

- Original Soundtrack by Pizza Hotline

games.name: Horsey Game
games.shortDescription: Collect Horses. Breed Horses. Race Horses. Genetically Modify Horses. Create a Horse paradise or just get rich!
games.aboutText:
Do you like Horses / Money?!

Can I interest you in Horse racing!?

What's better than owning a Horse?

If you have two horses you can breed them

or use CRISPR if you're in a hurry

So get in the balloon!

Don't watch TV that's lame

Wouldn't you rather play some

Horsey Game

games.name: Dining Deck
games.shortDescription: We fused co-op strategy, deckbuilding, and restaurant chaos into the ultimate roguelike dining experience! Build your deck, serve customers, master the kitchen, and secure your place amongst the Hall of Taste!
games.aboutText:
Dining Deck is a turn-based cooperative deckbuilder where players must work together to run a restaurant, balancing the chaos of the kitchen and the needs of demanding customers. Synchronize your decks, manage service encounters, and tackle unpredictable challenges as you strive to serve every meal on time

Full Release Features

🔥 Real-Time Co-op Deckbuilding – Work together in perfect harmony! Synchronize your builds, balance the restaurant, and adapt to the chaos as you and your partner manage the kitchen and floor in real time.

📜 Dynamic Deck Construction – Choose from 300+ unique cards to craft the perfect strategy. Discover powerful team cards to assist your partner and keep the service running smoothly.

🍳 Manage your restaurant with Appliances – Unlock and choose from 50+ appliances , from high-tech grills to magic-infused dishwashers, to enhance your restaurant’s efficiency.

👥 Face Unique Service Encounters – Adapt to different service challenges ranging from demanding VIP customers to food critics who hold your fate in their hands.

🔺 Ascension Levels – Increase difficulty and master the art of restaurant management through escalating challenge levels.

✨ Sprinkles & Card Upgrades – Customize your deck with Sprinkles , a unique system to enhance, modify, and personalize your cards for ultimate synergy.

🏠 Three Distinct Restaurants – Choose between American Diner, Asian Cuisine, and Turkish Doner , each offering a unique playstyle with exclusive card pools and mechanics.

🔥 An Ever-Changing Service – No two runs are the same! Each shift presents different customers, unexpected events, and new opportunities to build your deck and restaurant.

🚀 High-Stakes Strategy, Fast-Paced Fun – Plan ahead, improvise on the fly, and keep up with the dinner rush. Every decision matters in the fast-paced world of Dining Deck !

games.name: Ultimate Lemon Basket
games.shortDescription: 🍋 A Speed-Running platformer where you can’t drop any lemons.🍋 Between you and the goal are Ghosts, Cows, Acid Rain Clouds, Monster Trucks, Hopes, Dreams and other things AS WELL!! There are leaderboards.
games.aboutText:
Ultimate lemon basket is a Speed-Running platformer where you lose if you drop any lemons on the ground.

If you get the end flag you win!! Which is great!!

Each level has online leaderboards so you can compete with your friends and everyone else!

There are ~110 levels, each containing one or more things from the list below 👇

- Cows

- Ghosts

- Acid rain

- Car

- Fire

- Big lemons

- Robot Cows

- Mysterious Alien Oil

- and other things as well that are secrets

The game has boring features as well, like controller options, Steam leaderboards, and achievements!

games.name: DIGGY DIGGY
games.shortDescription: In DIGGY DIGGY, you dig up rare fossils, collect shiny minerals and showcase your findings in a museum. Explore unique locations and bond with eccentric townsfolk in this delightfully silly, cozy adventure.
games.aboutText:
Run around, dig up holes (and occasionally trip over them :P) and build the ultimate museum collection!

For some strange reason, the local town has a massive museum, but it's completely empty. Clearly, this is a job for a hero with a shovel.

Explore a whimsical, silly little world, meet the quirkiest townspeople you've ever seen and unearth ancient secrets in this short, cozy adventure.

Perfect for a relaxed evening or two. No stress, no rush, just good vibes.

🦕 Dig for Hidden Treasures

Grab your (t)rusty shovel and search for buried treasure. Dive into a satisfying, nostalgic excavation mini-game to carefully chip away and reveal rare fossils, shiny diamonds and mysterious artifacts.

🗺️ Explore Five Unique Biomes

From sunny beaches and cozy villages to green grasslands, lush forests and rocky canyons. Each location hides its own unique minerals and treasures waiting to be discovered.

👥 Help the Townsfolk

Talk to the eccentric locals! Help them with their oddly specific requests to unlock new locations or get mysterious hints about the rarest finds on the island.

games.name: Hypnostasis
games.shortDescription: Hypnostasis is a retro survival horror FPS rooted in Jungian psychology. Explore a semi-open nightmare, manage your sanity and scarce resources, and master Goldsrc-style movement to survive. Uncover buried memories across multiple endings — face your shadow, or lose yourself to it.
games.aboutText:
"Who looks outside, dreams; who looks inside, awakes." — C.G. Jung

You wake in your apartment to find the world warped into something sinister. The rooms you knew now stretch into nightmares, and the creatures wandering them are merciless.

- EXPLORE A SEMI-OPEN NIGHTMARE — Navigate expansive, nonlinear levels that reward curiosity. No corridors holding your hand: find your own path while your sanity slowly slips away.

- FIGHT WITH EVERYTHING YOU HAVE — High-stakes combat where every bullet counts. Read your enemies, manage your sanity, and know when to run.

- SCAVENGE, CRAFT, SURVIVE — Scarce resources force hard choices. Customize your loadout from a wide range of weapons and equipment to match your playstyle.

Will you lose yourself to madness and delusion, or confront the truth and find salvation?

More Key Features:

- 10+ hours of single-player content.

- Semi-open level design with a high degree of exploration freedom.

- A sanity system that turns your own mind into a threat.

- Multiple endings shaped by your choices.

- Goldsrc-style movement.

- Built-in developer console.

- Rooted in Jungian analytical psychology.

games.name: Resort Island Simulator
games.shortDescription: A world filled with tricksters, pirates, zealots, and treasures. An ocean full of danger and prize. Face dilemmas and encounters. Manage a resort in this wild world and build a thriving business. An Explorer, a Survivor a Resorter or a Trader? Forge your own path to wealth. Make Resort Prosper!
games.aboutText:
The war between clans is over. The island is yours
Turn a massive island into a thriving resort empire. Explore, survive, manage and trade in a world full of opportunity and danger

Guests arrive with expectations and coins to spend.

Hunt, farm and produce to keep your island running.

Every decoration increases comfort, value and profit.

Unlock new areas and expand your services and resort empire.

A world that feels truly alive.

Some visitors will test your judgment.

Discover hidden areas, resources and new opportunities.

“War’s broken pirates fiercer than you’ll ever be.
And peace? Peace has lined the pockets of men who had nothin’.”
-Captain Old Salt

games.name: Sisyphe's Backspace
games.shortDescription: A 5 minutes game about love and hesitation. Use Backspace to play. Hope you will never experience this hesitation.
games.aboutText:
A narrative game about love and hesitation—about the words that you wish to say but never could.

Features:

- Minimalistic art-style with text-only presentation.

- Minimalistic gameplay, using Backspace button to progress.

- A short yet meaningful experience narrative experience, witness a five-minute conversation between friends.

Made by Koway

games.name: Mr Magpie's Harmless Card Game
games.shortDescription: A surreal corporate horror deckbuilder where you gamble your life for cash, dodge murderous JERRY cards, and “maximise synergies” to climb the company ladder in Mr Magpie’s office nightmare.
games.aboutText:
Mr Magpie’s Harmless Card Game is a surreal corporate horror deckbuilder hosted by a deranged puppet with a very warped performance management program.

You are trapped in Mr Magpie’s workplace, where your only choice is to earn cash and climb the corporate ladder. Flip cards, stack your deck, exploit strange synergies, and push your luck for bigger payouts.

Just avoid the JERRY cards.
JERRYs will kill you.
Everyone hates JERRY.

Flip the Cards

Reveal cards to earn money, gather clues and survive each round. Read the board, follow the hints, and decide when to cash out before your poor decisions result in a workplace incident.

Invest in Your Future

Spend your hard-earned cash in Mr Magpie’s supply closet to improve your run. Add powerful cards to your deck, unlock game-warping global Perks, and create deeply irresponsible combos that would make HR very nervous.

Greed is Good

Every run gives you new cards, new Perks, new risks, and new ways to make a terrible decision look like a brilliant strategy. Learn the systems, build around your luck, and make enough money to survive another day at the office.

Do Not Fail

Push your luck too far and you will be terminated.
Permanently.

Features:

- A surreal corporate horror deckbuilder about greed, deduction, and extremely unsafe workplace practices.

- Push-your-luck card flipping mixed with logical deduction. Think Minesweeper roguelike, if Minesweeper was a shareholder with unreasonable quarterly targets and a dangerous appetite for risk.

- Stack your deck with powerful cards, unexpected synergies, and global Perks that can completely reshape your run.

- Avoid JERRY cards. They are evil. This is not up for debate.

- Multiple character classes that dramatically change how you play.

- Explore the workplace between runs, poke around its stranger corners, and discover whatever Mr Magpie left out of the employee handbook.

- Cryptic but approachable systems designed to be discovered, understood, and exploited.

- A “just one more run” structure built around quick decisions, terrible risks, and very questionable corporate incentives.

games.name: Paws Against the World
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Paws Against the World (PAW), where the last humans are gone, and it’s up to the animals to claw their way through hordes of relentless zombies. Think fast-paced, loot-grabbing action, but with a wild twist—play as cute critters fighting for survival.
games.aboutText:
The humans are gone. The world has fallen to the undead, and only the animals remain. In a world overrun by zombies, nature’s fiercest survivors must rise up and fight back! In PAW , you and up to three friends take control of powerful animals, scavenge for upgrades, and battle against relentless zombie hordes in a fight for survival.

Survive, Defend, Evolve!

- Choose Your Animal : Play as different animals, each with unique abilities and playstyles.

- Scavenge & Upgrade – Collect loot and Essence from fallen zombies to power up your skills and abilities.

- Unique Weaponry & Placeables: The game features quirky, animal-themed weapons like Banana Toss, Acorn Artillery, and placeable Sunflower Plant or Cactus.

- Roll up the slot machines and see what you can get, and visit the friendly beaver shop!

- How long can you last against an endless zombie onslaught? Protect vital strongholds from being overrun!

- Permanent Progression : Leftover Essence can be spent in the Library , unlocking permanent upgrades that make each new run stronger than the last.

- Multiplayer : Local Shared Screen Co-Op for up to 4 players

The fate of the world rests on paws, claws, and fangs. Fast, chaotic, and endlessly replayable, PAW is the ultimate test of survival instincts. Are you ready to take back the world?

games.name: The people of Sea, Sun & Salt
games.shortDescription: Will you create a lasting civilization or see it collapse into the sea? In Sea, Sun & Salt, you build a city on a small mediterranean island. Define the tenets of your culture, deal with your subjects' needs and withstand the forces of the elements.
games.aboutText:
Will you create a lasting civilization or see it collapse into the sea?

In Sea, Sun & Salt, you build a city on a small mediterranean island. Define the tenets of your culture, deal with your subjects' needs and withstand the forces of the elements.

Build

Progress through the game and build a magnificent city. The further you go, the more complex your city's needs will get.

Survive

If you fail your subjects, your city will not last long. Water lowers when times are good but when things go wrong, beware of the rising tide.

Decide

As your city's population grows, your subjects will look up to you for answers. How was the world created? What do they worship? When's the best time to bathe? Make these choices, and more, to direct your people.

Also features:

- A gentle difficulty progression fit for all players

- Over 100 unique buildings

- Travel through this culture's History with 15 distinct historic epochs

- Complete runs of more than 10 hours

- 30 achievements that introduce new challenges for the more hard-core players

- A relaxing sound track to accompany your city building

- And many secrets hidden in the depth

games.name: My Card Is Better Than Your Card!
games.shortDescription: Become the coolest kid of the playground in this playful roguelike deckbuilder. Craft every card yourself with adorable stickers and wow your rivals in tug-of-war card battles full of wonder!
games.aboutText:
My Card Is Better Than Your Card! is an adorable yet challenging sticker sticking roguelike deckbuilder. Create your own cards with a colorful catalogue of stickers combining their effects. Collect more and more stickers, discover synergies and find your own playstyle with a deck full of your own creations to defeat your rivals in whimsical card duels. 

Turn-based gameplay, delightful events and free-form card crafting bring about a wholesome experience while presenting a challenge. 

Features:

- Over 400 super awesome and adorable stickers to stick onto your cards!

- Play against more than ten unique opponents, from best friends to playground princesses and bug enthusiasts!

- Choose from over 10 starter packs on what kind of cards and playstyle you want to start your run with!

- 9 challenging bosses to truly test your deckbuilding skills at the end of every week

- Over 80 toys to collect and synergize with your cards!

- Over 15 different types of fun events to visit, like digging for forgotten sticker treasures and trying your luck at a claw machine

- Super special Story Events to spend time with your friends from the neighborhood! Challenge them to water fights or go on an adventure in the forest! Who knows what’ll happen!

- More than 15 themed booster packs to rip open and enjoy

- Three special sticker types that change how the stickers play and make them even cooler (or lamer)

Each sticker has its own effect, allowing for endless creativity and strategies for you to play with! But be careful, too many stickers and a card will become too expensive to play. 

It’s time for a tug-of-war of coolness! Play your cards right to gain favor over your rivals and leave them in awe of your creations! Make use of the FEVER multiplier to turn the tide at the right moment! 

Between card battles you can take part in all sorts of activities to spice up your deck. Dig for hidden prizes in Treasure Hunts! Try your luck at the Vending Machine for that perfect super shiny sticker! Get to know your friends around the neighborhood in Story Events! Grab some new toys at the Claw Machine! Fill up your summer days with different fun events.

Each run alters the challenge. You’ll encounter different neighborhood rivals, with a different set of cards to take them on. Figure out new synergies and combos to gain the edge over your opponents to become the playground champ!

games.name: Flock Around
games.shortDescription: Flock Around is a multiplayer bird watching game. Explore a nature sanctuary with friends, snap pictures of birds, and fill out the guide book!
games.aboutText:
Flock Around is a co-op birdwatching game where you explore a nature sanctuary. Solo or with friends, snap pictures of funny birds, and fill out the park guide book!

Snap them all!

Goose Lake Sanctuary is home to numerous bird species, and if you can see it, you can take a picture of it. Fill out the guide book with pictures of each bird in its various poses, from the common Robin, to more rare and exotic birds. Explore a variety of biomes, perform actions and use items to lure in species, and mess with your friends!

Flock Together!

Flock Around is designed to be a shared social space where you and your friends can work together to get pictures of birds or each other! Birding is best with others, so you can play with up to 10 friends!

Customize your birder!

Collect cosmetics and make your birder unique, expressing your personality and eagle eyes to your friends. After taking your pictures, develop them for money to spend on outfits so you can go birding in style!

games.name: Pronoun Palace
games.shortDescription: Pronoun Palace is a word-spelling roguelike set in a dystopian future where the government has taken your pronouns. Use spells to manipulate letter tiles, catch fish, and abuse amphetamines to defeat the Party and get your pronouns back!
games.aboutText:
Pronoun Palace is a word-spelling roguelike set in a dystopian future where the government has taken your pronouns. Use spells to manipulate letter tiles, catch fish, and abuse amphetamines to defeat the Party and get your pronouns back!

Gameplay

- Strategize your spelling; use wooden tiles to attack and plastic tiles to defend. Activate spells to manipulate tiles to your favor—shift letters across the alphabet, turn tiles into candy, and watch words spell themselves with wildcards.

- Retransition as different characters in the face of an oppressive bureaucratic collectivist state. Take advantage of their unique abilities to hole punch tiles and submit multiple words at once, weave through fish to catch specific letters, or juggle ticking bombs against a racing clock!

- Battle a wide variety of enemies that each change the game. Manage tiles afflicted with effects such as poison, trigrams, and capital letters. Solve mystery letters through deduction, keep yaoi and yuri tiles from touching, or spell words long enough to make an enemy heel!

Features

- 6+ playable characters

- 50+ unique enemy encounters

- 95+ different spells

- 90+ unlockable achievements

- 10+ difficulty levels

- Daily runs, complete with leaderboards

- Over an hour of incredible music by RENREN

games.name: Trick Eight
games.shortDescription: On a remote village shrouded in bloody tradition, a centuries-old ritual endures. You are a detective with unique skills, yet branded as a traitor. Will you surrender your limbs to ascend like an immortal? Or risk everything at the edge of science and plunge into the abyss of truth?
games.aboutText:
Trick Eight is a narrative-driven mystery and deduction game blending New Chinese Style with Neo-orthodox storytelling.

You will play as two intertwined roles, investigating a series of serial murders on an isolated village, gradually uncovering the chilling truth hidden behind the faith.

"Eight is division. All things named by the eight stem from separation."

Heaven and Earth are governed by the Eight Trigrams, yet mankind dares to divine fate through the number.

On a remote, isolated village, a century-old blood ritual continues without end.

Generations of zealous followers uphold a legacy steeped in sacrifice.

As outsiders begin to vanish mysteriously, fate draws two girls together:

A gambler detective, and a lone survivor who once escaped a sacrificial fate.

Together, they must uncover the truth hidden beneath the veil of tradition and folklore.

Who seeks to play god?

Who dares to defy the boundaries of science?

And when the so-called truth rises to the surface...

Will you still have the courage to reveal it to the world?

Solve intriguing puzzles through a series of dynamic comic-style scenes, each frame uniquely styled and brimming with creativity.

Experience a realistic deduction system inspired by classical logic - use intuition and reasoning to unravel cases that once seemed airtight.

Classic comic-style expressions come vividly to life - immerse yourself in a deeply engaging visual novel experience.

Forge bonds, break illusions, and navigate a cast of characters whose desires collide unpredictably.

Uncover the hidden truths behind every mask and motive.

games.name: Midnight Souvenirs
games.shortDescription: Find unique artifacts and solve charming puzzles in this cozy yet mysterious Hidden Object Game with a Lovecraftian twist! Explore a Victorian mansion, interact with strange visitors, and unravel the house’s dark, eldritch past in this all hand-painted 2D game.
games.aboutText:
Step into a whimsical Victorian mansion where cozy atmosphere meets creeping mystery. This indie hidden object game invites you into a lovingly painted world of uncanny cluttered rooms, small puzzles, and occult influences that feel charming… and just a little strange.

Explore and search through the mansion's rooms packed with hidden treasures

Find unique objects for the mansion’s otherworldly visitors in need

Solve fun arcane puzzles, with cozy, unhurried pacing to unlock new rooms

Strange happenings may occur, shifting the rooms and some characters into eldritch forms

Need a hint? Get help finding objects from your mysterious cat companion

Search through beautifully hand-drawn rooms filled with hidden objects, everything from ordinary antiques to eldritch artifacts. Expand your collection with every object you find and discover the mansion’s mysterious corners and magical details. Call your mysterious cat companion to help you find objects even in the trickiest hiding spots…

Beyond the hidden object search, you’ll solve engaging puzzles to progress through the mansion. Take all the time you need finding the solution to unlock sealed doors that reveal new chambers—bringing fresh rooms to explore as the estate’s mysteries unfold.

As you unlock hidden chambers and follow the trail of clues, you'll uncover the intriguing and sometimes strange history behind the estate. Let your curiosity guide you through an atmospheric world with an occult vibe.

While searching, you’ll encounter strange happenings inspired by Lovecraftian tales. Some NPCs spread their madness through the house, warping rooms, items, and hiding spots into new eldritch versions. Uncover a new challenge of hidden object gameplay, from the whispers of the deep sea, to being covered in eerie moth silk, and even the realm of Carcosa.

You are not alone in this eerie tale. Engage in brief dialogs while searching for objects, and fulfill your visitors' strange pleas. Some appear to be ordinary, curious about the mansion, others are touched by eldritch forces. Meet them one after another, until the bell rings once more!

games.name: Prophet Margin
games.shortDescription: How far can you push one trade route? Connect villages, trade resources, and find clever routes to bigger profits. A thinky strategy city-builder inspired by Euro board games. Grow your network, optimize every connection, and please the gods.
games.aboutText:
Prophet Margin is a cozy board game-inspired city builder where you design trade routes to please the gods. Clean decisions, meditative vibes and satisfying strategy puzzles. Inspired by the deep logic of "Eurogame" tabletop classics, it’s a thinky sanctuary where you weave a perfect system of trade routes to grow your settlements and your purse. Can you master the art of the divine margin?

- Place with purpose. Position complementary settlements so inputs feed outputs without waste.

- Weave profitable trade routes. Chain together multi-stop caravans that snowball in value with every city they pass.

The gods hunger for tribute! Each temple demands a single sacred resource associated with its god. Your job is to weave long, efficient trade routes that end with the right goods at the right shrines. Optimize your web of settlements to deliver the exact resources each god demands then watch divine gifts reshape your possibilities. Unlike traditional strategy games or supply chain sims, Prophet Margin challenges you with a single, elegant task: perfect route design and resource management.

- Serve the pantheon. Deliver the exact resource each temple wants to receive divine gifts.

- Grow by connection. Every incoming road upgrades a settlement, unlocking tougher choices and bigger payoffs.

Build and optimize at your own pace. Through Real-Time with Pause gameplay and the dedicated, limited Undo button, you are free to experiment with complex logistics and automation without the fear of a permanent misstep.

- Strategic, Not Frantic: Take all the time you need to weave the perfect web.

- Board Game DNA: Clear systems, readable resource chains, and strategic depth.

- The 30- to 60-Minute Session: High-impact strategy distilled into a rewarding run respectful of your time.

Every settlement is a gear in a celestial machine. Link them together through complex automations, grow your towns, and deliver the sacred tribute the gods demand.

- Input & Output Loops: Manage growing complexity as your settlements evolve and demand different goods.

- Value-Add Logistics: The longer and more efficient the route, the greater the reward.

- Divine Boons: Please a God to receive game-changing gifts that twist the rules and open entirely new lines of play.

With unlocking new winning conditions and procedurally generated maps, no two ascensions are the same. Whether you’re building to beat the turn limit or aiming to achieve a tricky set of quests in your run, Prophet Margin rewards the strategic planner in you.

- Relaxing & Stylized: A quirky, high-contrast art style that makes your logistics easy to read and beautiful to behold.

- High Replayability: Adapt your strategy to the cards you're dealt and the terrain you're given. Different god combinations demand novel resource chains. Unlock new quests and win conditions for you to beat.

This game is for you:

If you spent hours upon hours playing games like "Dorfromantik", “Let them Trade”, "Islanders", “Slipways”, "Mini Settlers" or "Mini Motorways", or you enjoyed weaving trade routes in classics like “The Settlers” or “Anno” then Prophet Margin is the god-like, boardgame inspired lovechild you'll enjoy!

games.name: Paper Bride 7 Lethal Bond
games.shortDescription: Speak not of love untouched by passion's fire, as it's a torturous journey.  If lovers would remain faithful evermore,On Peony Pavilion’s road they’ll meet for three lives more. Paper Bride 7: Lethal Bond is a Chinese horror puzzle game, and the 7th title of the Paper Bride series.
games.aboutText:
Speak not of love untouched by passion's fire, as it's a torturous journey.

 If lovers would remain faithful evermore,On Peony Pavilion’s road they’ll meet for three lives more.

Paper Bride 7: Lethal Bond is a Chinese horror puzzle game, and the 7th title of the Paper Bride series.

This time, we follow a new protagonist seeking his suddenly-departed lover in a mysterious town that treads between two realms. On this eerie trip, in addition to the addition of Qingqing and Tongtong from Paper Bride 3: Mandarin Pact, many familiar faces also make their return.

Our latest title continues to break new grounds:

* Folk Culture Enhancement — Featuring the same beloved traditional folklore elements fans have come to expect.

* Storyline Expansion — Beloved characters from the Paper Bride universe return in meaningful roles, not merely as Easter eggs.

* Visual Refinement — Everything is heightened: beauty becomes more breathtaking, handsomeness more striking, ugliness more disturbing, and strangeness more unsettling.

* Suspense Intensification — Veterans may be numb to our scares by now, but we still recommend playing before bedtime!

We thank everyone for your continued love and support for the Paper Bride series! We've always wanted our stories to present a Chinese, folk-inspired world to our players. In this latest title, you'll not only be immersed in a tapestry of rich folklore and customs, but also a torrent of paper creatures, surprises, and scares!

Prepare to have your heebies be jeebied in Paper Bride 7!

games.name: 33 Days till Extraction
games.shortDescription: 33 Days till Extraction is a top-down sci-fi action RPG shooter with roguelike progression. Harness brutal firepower and necromantic skills to survive.
games.aboutText:
33 Days till Extraction is a top-down sci-fi action RPG shooter with roguelike progression, set on a distant planet shattered by orbital bombardment. You are a Space Desant death-chaplain stranded on a hostile world and hunted by spec-ops elites and lowlife bounty hunters alike. Extraction is 33 days away.

Daylight means death. Patrols sweep the surface relentlessly, forcing you to hunker down in basements and ruins. Only at night can you emerge — to raid, scavenge, fight… and raise the dead. Necromancy may not be your primary calling, but out here, you take every advantage you can get.

SHOOTER MEETS ROGUELIKE

Each run sends you into procedurally generated zones filled with unpredictable enemies, events, and rewards. Learn the planet’s rules, adapt your build, and push further with every attempt.

Death is not the end. Through forbidden rites and battlefield improvisation, fallen fighters can be raised again — letting you experiment, recover, and evolve instead of starting from zero.

ACTION RPG WITH TECH-MAGIC

Harness brutal firepower and unholy abilities alike:

– Plasma, laser, ballistic, and experimental weapons

– Necromancy, vampirism, and energy manipulation

– Tech-magic hybrids that blur the line between science and sorcery

Customize your loadout with gear, perks, and powers — forging deadly synergies between weapons and the undead forces at your command.

BUILD YOUR BASE

Between runs, return to your base to construct and upgrade facilities, recruit new fighters with unique traits, prepare loadouts for different playstyles and unlock long-term progression and new possibilities.

Your base is your last refuge — and your staging ground for the nights ahead.

A BROKEN PLANET TO EXPLORE

Explore the remains of a shattered world: abandoned installations, military strongholds, and ruined urban zones — all procedurally generated for high replayability and constant surprise.

This game contains no AI-generated models, textures, or other images, nor does it contain AI-generated code, sound effects, or written content. All such materials were created exclusively by human artists, developers, writers, and other members of the development team.

games.name: Fingerdance
games.shortDescription: The game that simply confuses your fingers.
games.aboutText:
Fingerdance is a finger-twister that tests your dexterity.

Place five fingers of any hand comfortably on your keyboard. You have to press and release each finger according to the given patterns. It’s a bit like a rhythm game—but there’s no need to match the beats precisely. Take your time!

The faster you complete each pattern, the higher your rank will be. Try getting an S-rank on every stage!

games.name: KAZ
games.shortDescription: Pure score-chasing. Psychedelic neon. Four buttons. Instant retries. Leaderboards, weekly challenges, and special rewards. For fans of flashy arcade experiences who want deeper roguelike progression: 110+ items, 6 weapons, and builds that actually matter. Runs are short. The addiction is long.
games.aboutText:
Score chasing in its purest form.

KAZ is a score-chaser through and through. There's no final boss, no ending screen, only staying in the higher places of the leaderboard. You play to beat your best, climb the leaderboards, and prove you're the fastest, smartest player out there. Weekly and monthly challenges keep the competition fresh and top performers earn leaderboard fame.

Four buttons. Infinite Depth.

A minimalist 4-button setup means anyone can pick it up in seconds. But beneath the surface: 110+ items, 6 weapons, 35+ maluses, and active spells that combine into wildly different builds. Find the synergy that pushes your score higher than you thought possible.

Short runs. Instant retry.

Each run is quick and intense. Die? You're back in instantly! No loading, no waiting, no punishment. Just the pure itch of the next run until you nail it.

For fans of Super Hexagon or Geometry Dash, this game will tickle the same senses! Plus... 25+ unlockable themes (each with its own special ability), 145+ quests, and 5 game modes give you reasons to keep coming back, but the real goal is always the same: beat your score.

games.name: Islantiles
games.shortDescription: Islantiles is a cozy but compulsive roguelike deckbuilder. Unlock powerful technology cards, shape your deck to craft game-breaking combos, and grow your settlements to glory in this ultra-satisfying roguelike!
games.aboutText:
Islantiles is a cozy roguelike deckbuilder where players craft, combine and strategize their way to success! Starting with a single island, you’ll gradually expand your settlement into a thriving town. As you settle a chain of beautiful islands, you’ll unlock, swap, and combine powerful technologies that reshape your entire strategy. How far can you go?

Place buildings, gather resources, shape your deck and trigger satisfying card combos. Technologies don’t just improve your deck – they twist the core rules, changing how tiles interact, how you score and what kind of strategies you can build. Buy new technologies or sell old ones to adapt to special challenges and pivot your strategy.

Every island is unique, and no two runs are the same. Master the art of cozy efficiency and grow your settlements to glory!

Islantiles offers:

- A unique blend of city puzzler and deck builder

- Cozy but compelling roguelike gameplay

- Develop and refine different strategies

- Six different difficulty settings

- 100 hand-crafted islands to develop

- More than 100 technologies, each with unique rules

- Highscores & Leaderboards

- Roguelite progression: no two runs are the same

games.name: Contagion Protocol
games.shortDescription: Survive an endless undead horde in this brutal auto-battling roguelike. Slash, upgrade, and evolve your arsenal as chaos unfolds to the pulse of an industrial metal soundtrack. Contagion Protocol is fast, bloody, and built for replayability.
games.aboutText:
Contagion Protocol is a brutal, stylish bullet-hell roguelike where survival is never guaranteed and the infected never stop coming.

The world has fallen to the contagion. Civilization is gone. You’re what’s left - a lone survivor cutting through endless undead swarms in a fight that never truly ends.

A Bullet Hell in the End Times

Mow down waves of the infected with an arsenal that grows as fast as the horde.
Start with a single survivor and basic gear. Fight, evolve, and adapt - then extract or lose everything. Every run is a desperate sprint between carnage, upgrades, and the looming chance of failure.

Extraction Survival

Survive long enough to face the final boss.
Defeat it, and one of several extraction points activates. Reach it before time runs out and hold your ground for two relentless minutes to escape alive.
Only a successful extraction earns you Contagion Credits , used to unlock powerful permanent upgrades back at the Safehouse.

The Safehouse

Your base between runs - the only place untouched by the plague.
Spend earned credits to unlock passive and active upgrades: ricochet bullets, explosive ammo, extra companions, or new character abilities.
Every survivor can be rebuilt and specialized - but if a character dies in the field before extraction, they’re gone until rediscovered, stripped of their progress.

Weapons and Chaos

Experiment with dozens of evolving weapons and brutal passives:

- Cleavers, rotating blades, boomerang axes, reverse shotguns, radial bursts, and more.

- Stack upgrades for speed, damage, armor, regeneration, and bleed effects.

- Watch chaos unfold as blades orbit, bullets explode, and the screen fills with blood and motion trails.

The Infected Horde

Every run pits you against an ever-growing swarm:

- Over fifteen zombie types: runners, tanks, soldiers, acid spitters, healers, and summoners.

- Enemies evolve and grow stronger the longer you survive.

- No waves, no downtime - just constant escalation until extraction or death.

Maps and Settings

Explore vast, open environments ranging from rural Americana wastelands to crumbling cities.
Each map offers unique pacing, hazards, and spawn patterns that demand new strategies.

Developer

Contagion Protocol is developed solo by an active-duty military member - built during off-hours, late nights, and early mornings.
It’s a passion project designed for players who crave raw, replayable destruction and unrelenting combat.

Features

- Endless enemy spawns - dynamic, escalating chaos.

- Dozens of melee and ranged evolutions with deep upgrade synergy.

- Permanent progression via Safehouse unlocks.

- Four survivors at launch, each with unique playstyles.

- Industrial metal soundtrack driving every gory encounter.

- Massive replayability - every run ends in destruction or extraction.

If you thrive on pure action and games like Vampire Survivors , 20 Minutes Till Dawn , and Rogue: Genesia , this is your next obsession - until the horde gets you.

Ongoing Development

Contagion Protocol is a continuous, community-driven project.
Player feedback from demos and early builds will directly shape new content, balance updates, and features.
The goal is simple: keep improving, expanding, and refining - no abandonware, no empty promises, just steady progress fueled by the players who join the fight.

games.name: 4D Intuition
games.shortDescription: Build your intuition for four-dimensional space, starting with walking and jumping. Master a wide variety of interactions and solve challenging 4D Sokoban-style puzzles.
games.aboutText:
A 4D Geometry Puzzle Game

4D Intuition is a unique 4D geometry puzzle game. Starting with simple movement and jumping, you'll gradually build an intuition for 4D space through a series of interactive challenges. Along the way, you'll learn how to navigate and manipulate 4D objects before ultimately solving challenging 4D Sokoban-style puzzles.

How is understanding 4D space possible?

Humans don't understand 3D space through calculation—we rely on visual intuition.

From flat 2D images, our brains automatically reconstruct 3D structure.

In the same way, 4D space can be explored through 3D views.

In 4D Intuition , you interact with 4D space using a virtual "3D display" that provides a form of virtual 4D vision.

By learning to read the hidden spatial relationships inside these 3D views, you will begin to develop genuine 4D intuition.

Game Features

The game consists of 5 chapters and 64 levels , where you'll develop your 4D intuition through a variety of engaging challenges:

- Walk, jump, and collect targets.

- Photograph 4D objects from different perspectives.

- Build stacks of hypercubes.

- Push 4D objects to their target locations.

- Combine spatial reasoning to solve challenging 4D puzzles.

The game includes a variety of guidance systems, including 3D analogs of 4D scenes, animated demonstrations, and more. Whether you're completely new to 4D space or already familiar with it, you'll enjoy a smooth learning curve and plenty of challenging puzzles.

games.name: One More Depth
games.shortDescription: A fast-paced, 4-player co-op action RPG. As an orphan, dive into twisted realms to retrieve the legendary "Precious." Don't let the cute art fool you—lethal threats await in the abyss. Dual-Class Builds: Mix and match classes with diverse loot to craft thousands of unique combat styles.
games.aboutText:
"The village elder says that as long as we retrieve the lost 'Treasure,' everything will return to how it used to be."

As orphans raised by the village, you carry the heavy expectations of your people, venturing deep into layers of twisted, unknown realms. In this intense 4-player co-op loot-fest, you must constantly acquire powerful gear and refine your skills to carve a path through the dungeons.

However, as you rescue more villagers, the cracks in your collective memory begin to show: the truth about your "forgotten past" and the reason why everyone has lost their memories seem to be inextricably linked to the 'Treasure' guarded by the deep-sea lord

- 4-Player Co-op Chaos: Team up with friends to conquer the depths.

- Dual-Class System: Mix and match to define your combat style.

- Massive Loot Pool: Hundreds of items and gear to collect.

- Endless Builds: Experiment and craft your own ultimate setup!

games.name: Talas
games.shortDescription: Shoot your way across deep space. Shred through waves of enemies, unravel the secrets hiding beneath the surface, and explore the endless synergies in this retro-inspired action roguelike.
games.aboutText:
Discover countless combos between 100+ unique items and choose the playstyle that suits you. Improve endlessly on your mission to defeat enemies and discover new ways to play with each defeat.

Talas features an expansive modular drone-building system that allows you to bring tiny friends along the journey to keep you company while traversing the galaxies.

Create a shield made of robots, have them accompany your ship, let them have a mind of their own, and much more! Make complex formations and obliterate everything in your path with your own personal army.

Voyage across space and discover colorful biomes full of resources and dangerous aliens. Loot and shoot your way through them and get to know each biome's different quirks and risks.

Experience distinct handcrafted encounters, challenging puzzles, high-stakes chases, or just... fish.

Make tough split-second decisions and experiment with the world around you. Uncover long forgotten relics of the past and bring them back to life, but be careful, because it may cost you yours.

And who knows, maybe you'll even meet some comrades along the way!

games.name: Servant of the Lake
games.shortDescription: Begin your new job as a servant at the mysterious Vanderboom estate. Solve puzzles, serve the family and uncover their dark alchemical secrets in Servant of the Lake, a new upcoming single-player point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the Vanderboom house, home to the infamous Vanderboom family! Visitors are arriving soon, and you are meant to start your housekeeping duties immediately!

Solve the puzzles needed to fulfil your daily tasks, look after the household, welcome the visitor and ensure their comfort while helping the family achieve their alchemical ambitions!

Servant of the Lake is the new premium point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series from the creators of the Cube Escape series, The Past Within and Underground Blossom.

Features:

- Going back to our Roots - Servant of the Lake is a classic single-player Rusty Lake point-and-click adventure set in the infamous Vanderboom house during the era of Aldous and William Vanderboom.

- Solve surreal puzzles – Expect to go from simple tasks such as straightening the family portraits and doing the laundry to assisting in complex experiments and cleaning up the aftermath.

- Unravel a dark narrative – Live through events set decades before Rusty Lake: Roots! As the servant of the Vanderboom estate, you can explore each room of The House while making sure the family is looked after. Do you think you can survive the weekend?

- Immersive soundtrack - Haunting melodies composed and performed by Victor Butzelaar to keep you company while puzzling your way through your daily, usual and unusual tasks.

games.name: This is Interesting
games.shortDescription: This is Interesting is a psychological horror mystery based game with roguelite elements. You are being watched, and you aren't really sure why. Delve through the depths of memory to uncover the mystery behind the gray purgatory you find yourself in.
games.aboutText:
This is Interesting is a psychological horror narrative based game with roguelite elements. You are being watched, and you aren't really sure why. Delve through the depths of memory to uncover the mystery behind the gray purgatory you find yourself in.

Knowledge-based progression

While each run of the game will differ, the true progression of the story comes from knowledge gained in previous runs. Only by gathering all of this knowledge can you actually see where the ending of this tale lies.

Hidden Stats

Your decisions are tracked throughout the game via stats, and these stats drastically alter the way the game can end. You'll have to experiment with every type of choice in order to see everything the story has to offer.

Immersive Sound

Featuring a custom soundtrack and uneasy ambience, you'll never feel quite safe roaming the halls of this prison.

games.name: Magecraft: Spellbuilding
games.shortDescription: Craft spell cards, collect new effects, and build the perfect deck as you fight through rounds of turn-based combat. Survive randomly-generated dungeon layouts by countering enemy attacks with your own spells, and make the most of the powers and scrolls you pick up along the way.
games.aboutText:
Magecraft: Spellbuilding is a deckbuilder with a focus on crafting your own spell cards and creating unique decks to take with you into the turn-based combat of the Dungeons.

While you have control over the cards you start with, the randomized Dungeon layouts, enemy encounters, passive powers, and scrolls ensure that no two runs are the same.

Take on enemy attacks, destroying them to keep yourself safe from harm - or take the hit and attack enemies directly to do as much damage as possible.

Fight your way through three distinct, themed dungeons, each with its own sets of enemies to defeat, powers and scrolls to collect, and events with with different choices to make.

Combine over 50 Sigils - with effects that deal damage, inflict debuffs, grant buffs, summon allies, and more - to craft custom spell cards for your deck.

Choose between a variety of appearances, color palettes, and unique Background powers when creating a character - and unlock new character colors to change into, as well as new characters with powerful abilities.

The Abyss is a separate mode with randomized characters and starting decks, where unlike the main game, dying means starting a new run from the very beginning.

games.name: GONE Fishing
games.shortDescription: GONE Fishing is a 1-8 player survival horror game where you and your friends must work together to stay alive, by fishing. The only way to survive is to keep feeding the lake’s insatiable hunger before it feeds on you. Can you satisfy the hunger... or will you become the next offering?
games.aboutText:
Cast your line to feed an ancient eldritch beast. Bring friends or go solo. It doesn’t care who is feeding it, only that it is fed. With over 100 different species of creatures to catch and dozens of live animals to use as bait.

Grill it, smoke it, turn it into a pearl, or bet it all in the gambling pit. Sell the extra fish you catch and spend the profits on upgrades, better gear, and items from the traders found around the map.

You must sacrifice a certain amount of fish to the beast every day if you want to survive, but the beast is not the only thing out there. Be wary of territorial beasts, stalking nightmares, and ambushing predators. Learn the creatures of the land to avoid being killed, you can't feed the hungering abomination if you are dead...

Drink beer, explore multiple maps, customize your characters, play instruments, catch fish and legendary creatures like the Lochness monster, explode monsters (and people), AND GAMBLE.

Fight back against the Lake Entity and stop the beast!

games.name: Roofgrown Life
games.shortDescription: Roofgrown Life is a cozy idle farming game. You can collect fruits in various regions, plant and harvest them, complete customer orders, upgrade your vehicles and house, and explore to unlock new points of interest on the map.
games.aboutText:
Planting

Wait for the truck to return, click to plant and feed the cute kitten to get more coins

Collection Guide

Dozens of different decorations to collect

Region

Unlock fruits and small animals in different maps

Make different juices for customers to buy

Fish can provide water nutrients and reduce planting time

games.name: Dream Walker
games.shortDescription: "Dream Walker" is an RPG game that combines survival, scavenging for extraction, and turn-based combat. Every time you explore within the dream, you might acquire valuable treasures, but you could also lose everything.
games.aboutText:
About "Dream Walker"

"Dream Walker" is an RPG that blends survival, extraction-based exploration, and turn-based combat. With every descent into the dreamscape, you stand to gain priceless treasures—or lose everything you have. As you delve deeper, an ancient and terrifying secret begins to unfurl before you...Utilize every resource at your disposal to craft powerful gear and weaponry. Only then can you hope to overcome the twisted and eerie abominations that lurk within.

Features:

· Over a hundred unique weapons and gear, each offering a distinct combat experience.

· A deep crafting system: from armaments to tactical items, everything can be forged at your workbench.

· A unique progression system where you sacrifice your levels to awaken powerful skills.

· Strategic turn-based combat: exploit enemy weak points to gain additional action opportunities.

· Player-driven narrative where your choices shape the story and lead to multiple endings.

In the world of "Dream Walker", you will explore a dreamscape teeming with both riches and ruin. If you successfully find the exit, the treasures you've scavenged are yours to keep in reality! Yet, the dream is infested with lethal enemies. You can choose to flee, bypass them through stealth, or face them head-on! Remember: only by surviving and reaching the exit can you grow stronger. You are not alone in the dreamscape; other factions lurk within. Whether you choose to cooperate or descend into hostility, your decisions will have monumental consequences.

games.name: The Wellmonts Case
games.shortDescription: The Wellmonts Case is a first-person psychological horror game set in 1993, Northern Maine. As a private detective, you explore the abandoned Wellmont farm, search for clues, photograph unsettling evidence, and uncover the truth behind a family's unexplained disappearance.
games.aboutText:
"Some truths were never meant to be found."

Step into the shoes of a private detective sent to investigate a family's mysterious disappearance in 1993, Northern Maine. Uncover evidence, document your findings, and face the creeping horror hidden within the abandoned Wellmont farm.

The Wellmonts Case is a psychological horror in the genre of "walking simulator".

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

When the world itself turns against you.
Perception falters as the environment distorts and logic begins to collapse. Details no longer add up, time slips between moments, and you begin to question if any of this is real.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Not everything you hear is in your head.
Darkness deepens, sounds grow sharper, and something unseen begins to close in. The house itself starts to feel alive, reacting to every breath and every step.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Every answer unlocks a darker question.
Interact with notes, locks, and clues to progress and piece together the case. What seems like evidence soon raises suspicion, and even the simplest objects begin to feel intentionally placed.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Uncover what was left behind.
Step carefully through silent rooms, untouched belongings and forgotten memories. Every corner holds a trace of the family’s life and offers a glimpse into what might have ended it.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Features:

- First-person psychological horror

- Investigation-focused exploration

- Atmospheric sound design and tension

- Puzzle solving with narrative impact

- Tightly paced, immersive experience

WARNING:

Epileptic seizures associated with increased sensitivity to light are Possible. Some people may experience seizures when exposed to flashes of light and flashing images that appear in a video game. People who have not previously experienced such attacks may not be aware of their illness. A reasonable restriction of the game audience is recommended.

games.name: Little Corners
games.shortDescription: Peel, place, and arrange stickers across tiny windows into different worlds. Relax and unwind to lofi beats, collect unique stickers and share your cozy creations with the world.
games.aboutText:
In Little Corners , we’ve tried to capture the magic and satisfaction of sticker books. You’ll be able to build endless tiny worlds from the ground up using just your imagination, and thousands of stickers. We hope you enjoy peeling, placing and discovering all our little game has to offer.

Begin with a blank space and let your creativity bloom as you bring these corners to life. Chill out to lofi beats as you satisfyingly place furniture, trinkets and fluffy animals around the room.

Discover 8 little corners of fantastical worlds to get lost in, including a boisterous adventurer’s tavern, a mystical alchemist’s tower and the quarters of a ruthless sea captain. Each room features hidden stickers for you to discover, try some different combinations, who knows what you might find?

We’ve included a range of customisation options including cursor size and transparency, audio settings and you can even customise your workspace with a range of backgrounds and mats. Once you’re happy with your design, use the in-game screenshot feature to share your creations with the community and get inspired for your next creation.

games.name: PancitoMerge
games.shortDescription: Drop, stack, and merge colorful pan dulce into bigger, tastier treats in this cozy puzzle adventure! With charming visuals and simple gameplay, it’s a sweet celebration of Mexican baking, perfect for quick sessions and high score chases.
games.aboutText:
Step into a warm, flour-dusted world where pan dulce takes center stage. Merge adorable conchas, cuernitos, and more to discover delicious new treats in this whimsical puzzle game. With a dash of strategy and a sprinkle of tradition, PancitoMerge blends the joy of classic falling block games with the vibrant spirit of a neighborhood panadería. Great for cozy breaks or climbing the leaderboards, no baking skills required! *Caution - May cause sudden cravings for pan dulce.

Bready, Set, Merge!

The goal is simple: merge matching breads to create higher-level ones, aiming for the highest score possible while unlocking every type of bread in a single run. But be careful, the game ends if the breads stack up to the top of the bag!

A Tasty Twist

Every 5 drops, a customer arrives with a specific bread request. Fulfill their order by clicking/tapping on the requested bread in the bag.

Rooted In Tradition, Baked With Love

PancitoMerge is a love letter to Mexican culture and the joy of pan dulce. From colorful conchas to buttery cuernitos, each bread is inspired by real treats found in local bakeries, celebrating the warmth, tradition, and creativity of Mexican baking.

The idea for the project started when Fáyer (the game director) saw Vanila's pan dulce illustrations, he made a note about making a game that used that art, possibly on a casual puzzle like suika. Then, a whole year after, he found himself with some free time and decided to prototype the concept. He then reached out to Vanila to invite her to collab on it and she really liked the prototype, so they both started working on the web version. The main plan was to make it and if people liked it enough, they would see if it made sense to make it into something bigger. People really liked so here we are working on a bigger version for all of you!

Feature-Filled and Oven-Ready

- A charming Mexican bakery theme with authentic breads to discover.

- Simple yet addictive gameplay with a strategic customer mechanic.

- Perfect for quick sessions or long playthroughs.

- Unlock new bakeries that have different themes, breads and customers!

games.name: Jelly Bubble
games.shortDescription: Stick with the same color, bounce off the rest! Snatch the soap, sabotage your friends! Adorable jelly critters are here for chaotic, hilarious showdowns! Supports 4-player local and up to 6-player online battles, plus a map editor so you can jump into laugh-out-loud matches anytime!
games.aboutText:
Stick together, bounce apart. Grab soap, mess with your friends.A cute but chaotic multiplayer party game where jelly creatures compete, collide, and betray each other. Play with up to 6 players online or 4 players locally, and jump into wild matches—or build your own with the map editor

In this chaotic playground, soap is power. Pick it up from the ground. Steal it from others. Or lose it the second you grab it.That’s just how it goes.More soap = stronger abilities. Bigger size = more control. Bring your soap back to the scoring point and climb the leaderboard — if you can make it there alive.

Your bubble is both shield and weapon.Same colors attract—get close, steal resources, or even absorb your opponent. Different colors repel—bounce enemies away or save yourself at the last second.Switching colors at the right moment can turn the fight around.

Soap doesn’t just make you stronger.It can blast enemies away, swap positions, or save you in critical moments.Every piece of soap is a tactical choice.

Supports up to 6 players online or 2–4 players in local multiplayer. Dorm room gaming? Friends’ party? Just gather your crew and it’ll quickly turn into a chaotic friendship-destroying showdown. With multiple game modes and fun-filled challenges, every match brings a fresh experience!

The game features a DIY map editor.

Create:

- A trampoline-only arena

- A full-speed boost racetrack

- Or something even more ridiculous

Then share it with friends and see what happens.

Features

- Easy to pick up, fast-paced, light competitive gameplay

- Multiple competitive and cooperative modes

- Unique core mechanic: attract (same color) / bounce (different colors)

- 20+ types of soap with different effects

- Custom map creation

- Fun customization and mix-and-match outfits

- Up to 6-player online

- 2–4 player local multiplayer

games.name: Deadly Deals
games.shortDescription: You're a merchant in an antique shop. Buy, sell, develop. Easy as that. Just don't die. One little detail of a profitable location that realtors don't usually tell you...
games.aboutText:
Everything used to be peaceful until an ancient artifact appeared in your shop. From that moment on, unexplainable things started happening. Strange fog, rustles and stares... It's like someone's staring at you from behind your back. Just try to survive and stay afloat, and don't turn back when you feel a breath from behind you, THEN RUN!

You should be careful when buying new and unusual “stuff” from now on. Who knows what you'll buy this time, an ordinary antique ring that you'll repair and resell x2 the price, or a cursed monk's skull that carries only death?

We've got it figured out, the main focus is to survive and avoid bankruptcy. But you still haven't solved that crazy mystery. Gods? Demons? Or the evil spirits of cursed things? Who have you enraged? Go and find out! Or die like the previous owner... It's up to you.

games.name: Island Off Outer Darkness
games.shortDescription: A narrative delivery simulator following the Postman, a Postal Worker new to a small fishing village off the coast of a volcano. They begin to experience space-warping aberrations as the village withers.
games.aboutText:
Island Off Outer Darkness follows the narrative of the Postman, a resident Postal Worker new to a small fishing village in Antarctic waters off the coast of a volcano (the titular Outer Darkness). They start new to the job, and must deliver packages to residents day-by-day, week-by-week. As they learn more about the island and its townsfolk, aberrations in space begin to appear. More broadly, Island Off Outer Darkness is an exploration of the grief of community collapse and personal withering. Featuring a 31-track OST by CalamityRhapsody and visual artistic work by several people, Island Off Outer Darkness is the story of this town, and these people.

Features:

- Live out the life of a kind of antisocial government employee in an alien place.

- Act out thrilling strand-type delivery simulator gameplay.

- Chat with townsfolk in a menuing and dialogue system inspired by classic RPGs.

- Go green with the gardening and hybridizing of over 15 otherworldly crops.

- Chum fast by fishing in the ocean, with over 60 reelable fish, plants, and rocks.

- Keep your ears peeled for a 31-track OST composed by the artist CalamityRhapsody.

- Experience an unfolding story full of intrigue... and mystery.

- Discover the world of Kolob, via its effects on the isolated fishing village.

Meet the townsfolk:

- Pluripotent Fester, a former freedom fighter and political writer for the liberation of Argyre for Pluripotentkind. Depressive, and in exile.

- Brucehilda, a grandaunt, plumber, and resident of the island for over 60 years. And a doppelgänger, of her "twin sister".

- The Postman, a gender-nonspecific mid-twenties youth from the mainland, new to their Postmanly job on the island.

- Leonargo, a scholarly sea people from the depths, fished up and localized a few years before Island Off Outer Darkness takes place.

- Aleks, an awkward farmer on the desolate rock and lover of his devoted partner Bucephalus.

- Bucephalus, Aleks' partner-turned-horse who has a love for botany and the culinary arts.

- And many more!

At absolutely no point in development was generative AI used, and Island Off Outer Darkness is 100% human-made .

games.name: Sandboxels
games.shortDescription: Falling-sand sandbox game with 500+ elements, chemistry, fire, life, food, and anything you can imagine.
games.aboutText:
Sandboxels is a falling-sand game featuring heat simulation, electricity, density, chemical reactions, cooking, and fire spread. With over 500 unique elements to play with, Sandboxels is a great simulator to pass the time and relax.

Play the classic Sandboxels browser game on Steam with extra perks:

- Steam Workshop support - Browse and publish saves directly in-game

- Unlimited save file management - No more save slots!

- No advertisements

- Bigger screen space

- Rich Presence for Discord

- Support the developer!

There are thousands of interactions between the many materials, plants, animals, fluids, and powders in the game. Experiment with chemistry, cook food, grow an ecosystem, and more.

Simply click or use your touchscreen to select a category, like Liquids , then pick an element, like Water . Drag on the canvas above to place your pixels, and watch them interact with others!

games.name: Sucks To Be In The Sticks
games.shortDescription: A teenage vampire getting hooked on blood in a world that traded it for energy. See the absolute worst of what humans do to one another in every drop. It destroys you. You hate it. And yet, crawl back for more. A narrative adventure about a rather short eternity.
games.aboutText:
Sucks To Be In The Sticks is a game where the supernatural bleeds into the personal. You play as 19-year-old Ilo, whose life is turned upside down when they become a vampire. You’ll uncover the stories of small, everyday people — the things they won’t say out loud, or even admit to themselves. Each time you drink human blood or energy, you experience their darkest moments or unlikely dreams through emotional mini-games

As you explore all that your vampire life has to offer, try to hold on to what remains of your humanity: have late-night conversations with your mom while helping her at the flower shop, navigate a childhood friendship strained by your new secret, work odd jobs and spend your earnings on feeding stray cats.

You’ll meet diverse characters too often overlooked in small-town settings — queer people, ethnic minorities, migrants. The game engages with social and political issues through both metaphor and realism: how structures punish autonomy, suppress empathy, and erase resistance. You’ll witness the efforts of local activists, power struggles behind closed doors, and ultimately find your place in this strange, broken world. The game art captures the bleakness and beauty of a dying town that many will find hauntingly familiar. STBITS invites you into the full spectrum of (non)human life — pain, comedy, fear, joy, love. To survive, its characters must laugh at the absurd, sit with their grief, and find hope where none was meant to be.

games.name: The Deadseat
games.shortDescription: A horror game where you play a hand-held console in the backseat during a long drive home.
games.aboutText:
You are in the backseat of your parent's car during a long drive. As your parents begin fighting, your hand-held game is your only source of entertainment. But the game begins to mirror real life... Collect items on your hand-held game to send them to your world, and use them to defend against the monstrosity that's trying to make its way in.

The Deadseat includes a terrifying, short Main Campaign, and a Hard Mode which continues the story at a horrifying level of difficulty.

Survive The Night Drive

Your drive home from grandma's is interrupted by an unexpected detour. Play a hand-held game in the backseat as your parent's drive.

Retro Gaming

Your hand-held game is beginning to mirror reality... Supplies you collect in the game will be sent to the backseat.

Trapped in the Deadseat

A deadly monstrosity wants to join you in the backseat. Juggle your supplies and defend all sides. In this car, there’s only onwards to drive, and nowhere to run.

The Story

The story tackles themes of escapism and a difficult childhood. Your parents can't get along, and you can’t ignore it, no matter how deep you immerse yourself in your game. If only you could get away from it all and escape to somewhere better... And seemingly, the voice in your game says you can.

Hard Mode

Continue the Story in a far more challenging difficulty. One life, faster monster, remixed levels, No mercy.

Challenge Mode

Battle through 8 unique presets (or go fully custom) as you battle many different challenges, from the game's easiest difficulty to it's hardest possible settings. Customize your character, your enemy, and your environment, and see if you can unlock all the hidden lore...

games.name: Heroes Against Time
games.shortDescription: Heroes Against Time is the ally-drafting game where you build a team and power up in a dangerous enchanted forest. Navigate events, fight enemies and dig through ruins while trying to avoid the creeping magical fog… Will your team endure… or be lost to the mist?
games.aboutText:
Create the Perfect Team

Each ally has their own ability, event outcomes and synergies...

However, draft carefully: because without knowing how to scale your team to victory, you'll end up as a snack for the bigger threats which lurk further within the woods...

Snappy Runs, Deep Strategy

Beneath the quick pace is a layered roguelite system that rewards planning and adaptability.

- Runs take only 10 minutes once mastered
