- Build powerful scaling combos as your run unfolds

- New mechanics unlock over time

- Easy to learn, endlessly replayable

Map Navigation

Tread carefully, for the forest is fickle... and the fog will always follow. Every tile is a choice.

- Prioritize the right tiles for your team's needs while knowing when to improvise

- Watch out for the creeping fog which closes in from the edge of the map

- Clever decision-making can make (or break!) your run

Easy to Learn, Hard to Master

Deceptively simple rules combine into a game that's both familiar and unique, full of secrets and challenges... do you believe you have what it takes to overcome the enchanted forest?

games.name: Star Soraight Fantasy: Magic to reach the sky
games.shortDescription: Tokino Sora zaps into another world mid-live! Join her Hololive friends in a thrilling Metroidvania-style action-adventure, blending 2D and 3D. Explore a mysterious realm, recover scattered items, and guide Sora’s epic tale to a dazzling finale!
games.aboutText:
🌟 Star Soraight Fantasy: Magic to reach the sky

Tokino Sora-chan is suddenly whisked away to another world in the middle of her live performance!
A mysterious realm where her Hololive comrades and their precious items are scattered.
Can Sora-chan unravel the secrets of this strange world and make it back to her stage!?

Guide Sora-chan’s story to a dazzling finale with your own hands!

🌟 Explore and Conquer!

Journey between the vibrant “The Nun Nun Square” and the enigmatic “Mysterious Tower” in a blend of 2D and 3D.
Tackle intricate terrains, battle formidable foes, and dive into dynamic action and exploration alongside Sora-chan!

🌟 Team Up with the Holomen!

Sora isn’t alone—her Holomen friends have also been transported to this strange world!
Find them, harness their unique skills, and band together to conquer the tower’s depths.

🌟Power Up with Holomen Items!

Scattered throughout the tower are special items imbued with the Holomen’s powers.
Collect them to enhance Sora’s abilities and unlock new paths in your adventure.
The more you find, the stronger you become!

🌟Ride the Sora Train and explore the tower with total freedom!

This incredible train whisks you instantly from the tower’s base to its deepest reaches, letting you move as you please.

Aim for a 100% exploration rate as you uncover every corner of this tower!

🌟Uncover the Secret of the Sora Coins!

Hunt for elusive “Sora Coins” hidden within the tower.
Gather as many as you can and deliver them to a mysterious character for exclusive rewards!

🌟Sora’s Irresistible Charm!

Beyond the thrilling main story, revel in Sora’s adorable dance moves, expressive poses, and vibrant emotions.
Customize her look and soak in her charm at every turn!

Join Sora and the Holomen in Star Soraito Fantasy for a sparkling adventure filled with action, exploration, and heartwarming moments.
Solve the mysteries of another world and return to original world!

games.name: Alchemy Factory
games.shortDescription: Start small, team up with friends, and automate production with conveyor belts, pipes, and magical devices. Stock your shop with potions, jewelry, and relics, complete commissions, and build an alchemy empire! Alchemy Factory 1.0 is out now with the Wagon Logistics System and revamped shopkeeping.
games.aboutText:
Alchemy Factory is a medieval-themed automation game.

Start with a small shop and team up with friends. Use conveyor belts, pipes, and magical devices to build automated production lines, then stock your shelves with potions, jewelry, and relics. Fulfill commissions, amass wealth, build your own medieval alchemy factory, and become a renowned alchemy tycoon!

Let Conveyor Belts Drive Everything

In Alchemy Factory, conveyor belts connect every corner of your factory, carrying materials and products around the clock.

Grind, extract, distill, smelt, and process materials. Link devices into complete production chains and automate every tedious step of alchemy. Balance inputs and outputs, tune production, clear bottlenecks, and keep your factory running efficiently.

Build a Multi-Level Alchemy Factory

Your factory does not have to stay on a single floor.

Freely arrange conveyor belts, pipes, devices, and your shop. Build production chains at different heights and in every direction, keeping resources flowing efficiently through a three-dimensional layout. As your factory expands, extend production upward or downward and integrate scattered functional zones into a tightly connected automation network. Ultimately, you can create a vast multi-level factory with every floor working together.

Produce, Sell, and Expand

Production is only the beginning.

Stock your shelves with potions, jewelry, and relics, serve customers, and complete commissions. As sales become automated, you can focus more on planning your factory, researching recipes, and scaling up. Use the coins you earn to buy land, research equipment, and upgrade technology, further boosting efficiency and capacity, driving sales, and setting your factory on a cycle of continuous growth.

Build with Friends

Plan production lines, build your shop, and manage logistics with friends as you create a sprawling alchemy factory together.

Whether you excel at optimizing production lines, mastering management sims, or designing efficient spaces, you will find a role that suits you in co-op. For long-term play with friends, you can also host a dedicated server to keep the factory running, ready for everyone to return and continue building at any time.

Get Started Fast with Blueprints

Alchemy Factory supports Steam Workshop!

Subscribe to blueprints shared by other players, from beginner-friendly starter layouts to complex production plans for veteran players. These blueprints can help you learn Alchemy Factory's production systems faster and draw inspiration from other players' designs. You can also upload your own blueprints and share your factory layouts with alchemists around the world.

V1.0 Available Now

Alchemy Factory v1.0 is out now!

The full release delivers the Early Access roadmap's major features: the Grand Portal, Wagon Logistics System, rebuilt Reputation System, and revamped shopkeeping!

Production, transport, and sales are now more tightly connected. Expand your factory, grow your shop, build your reputation, and forge your own path through alchemy. Create a truly thriving alchemical empire and become a master alchemist whose ventures in potion-making, metallurgy, jewelry, and more bring wealth to rival a kingdom!

games.name: Noir Lords
games.shortDescription: A fast-paced single-player card battler with tactical choices, quick rounds, and upgradeable cards. Build your deck and outsmart the city’s crime lords.
games.aboutText:
Tactical card showdowns in the gritty streets of Noir City.

🔥 Why Play Noir Lords?
Quick matches. Deep tactics. Bold noir flair. Perfect pick-up play with strategic punch.

- Snappy Matches – Win or lose in under 5 minutes. No downtime.

- Deck Your Way – Select cards, level up agents, craft brutal combos.

- Brain Over Luck – Every card matters. Mistakes are unforgiving.

- Noir Art – Moody cityscapes, bold characters.

- Roguelite Replays – 50+ cards. Endless combinations. Evolving challenges.

You’re an agent on a mission to dismantle a rising criminal empire. Your deck is your squad. Your cards are your bullets. With each decision, you're one card closer to survival or the end.

Wishlist now to reclaim the city, one card at a time.

games.name: Sashimi Slayer
games.shortDescription: Sashimi Slayer is a casual arcade rhythm game with an open-source IRL sword controller. Prove your sword (and rhythm) skills facing down some crazy sea creatures. Parry their strikes and land the perfect cut!
games.aboutText:
Sashimi Slayer is a casual arcade rhythm game with an open-source IRL sword controller. Prove your sword (and rhythm) skills facing down some crazy sea creatures. Parry their strikes and land the perfect cut!

Featuring

- Three levels to slice your way through

- Simple but satisfying rhythm gameplay inspired by rhythm heaven

- Hand-drawn art and original music

- An open-sourced game & sword input device for DIY players

games.name: The Honours Project
games.shortDescription: The Honours Project is an autobiographical walking simulator. Enjoy a narrative experience, adventuring through dream-like levels, solving an occasional puzzle and listening to the dark and sometimes comical dialogue that acts as a commentary about being a student and game development.
games.aboutText:
The Honours Project is an autobiographical walking simulator about a moment where I was struggling to come up with an idea for my University project in 2024. You are tasked with helping, by inspiring me with music. Enjoy a narrative experience by adventuring through dream-like levels, solving an occasional puzzle and listening to the dark and sometimes comical dialogue that acts as a commentary about being a student and game development. Move along at your own pace, enjoy the audio experience in a fully 3D soundscape. Find notes that explore extra lore, and get an extra sense of who I am.

The year was likely the toughest I have ever faced, and I wanted to depict these moments as an audiovisual experience with light puzzle mechanics and gameplay. The game takes around about 25 to 35 minutes to complete. The aim of this game was to help others who are in education to understand that it is okay not to know, and that the ideas will come. I too wanted to express myself in the only way I know how, and figured this would be the best platform to be able to do so.

Voice work done by the talented Josef Boon

While the game is completed, I am still relatively new in the world of game development and I expect bugs and issues, which I will hopefully have a chance to iron out. I am also not the best at optimizing due to Audio Design and narrative being my field of expertise. The game was created over the course of 5 months and was submitted as my fourth year University project that focused on how audio and narrative work together to better player experience.

This game should work with mouse + keyboard, and an Xbox controller.

Controls

- WASD to move

- E to Interact

- ESC to bring up more options

Developers Note

This game will forever be free, and hopefully everyone can find their own level of enjoyment. I am forever learning and always open to feedback so please let me know what you think in the reviews!

games.name: Blossom’s Grove: An English-Learning Game
games.shortDescription: A cozy life-sim where farming and learning English grow together. Plant, craft, and explore a vibrant world. Each conversation and discovery naturally builds your language skills. Befriend charming villagers in a peaceful valley.
games.aboutText:
Blossom’s Grove is a relaxing farming & life sim where English grows with you — no flashcards, no tests.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Gather & Farm
Forage in the wild, mine ores, fish, and clear land to collect resources.
Plant seeds, water crops, and harvest

• Build Your Grove
Collect blueprints from villagers and quests. Craft furniture, tools, and facilities, then place them anywhere on your land.

• Shop & Supply
Visit the general store, food truck, and ice cream cart to buy seeds, ingredients, and decorations. Sell your harvest to fund your expansion.

• Befriend the Town
Talk with villagers daily. Each conversation displays English dialogue + your subtitle language (ZH/ES/FR/JR/KR/RU/PT/DE).
They’ll give you requests — complete them to earn rewards and unlock story events.

• Learn Without Trying

- Pick up or use any item → hear its English word spoken aloud

- All encountered words are auto-saved to your in-game Word Book

- Open the Word Book anytime to review pronunciation and meaning

No pressure. Just plant, build, chat, and let the words sink in.

games.name: BACKROOMS
games.shortDescription: Escape the backrooms levels as reality warps with every step; listen, for the whispers behind the walls may guide you out. Enjoy an unbelievable co-op Backrooms experience.
games.aboutText:
In this atmospheric psychological horror experience, you awaken in the liminal expanse known only as the Backrooms . Welcome to the Backrooms: a place outside of time and space. It’s a game with real depth, with an adventure mode and a range of social game modes.

Go alone or bring up to 5 friends (1-6 players). Stay close and talk over cross-platform proximity voice chat . And yes, your hazmat suit has exactly one very serious emote.

Built in Unreal Engine 5, the Backrooms look and sound like the stories you’ve heard. It all starts in Level 0, and every level gets stranger the deeper you go.

You’re not alone down here. Entities roam the levels, and each one is a threat of its own. Watch, listen and keep moving.

Every level has more than one exit, and each one leads to a different level. Every path you take leads to a different experience, so no two runs play out the same.

Build your own levels with the in-game editor and publish them on Steam Workshop, or play levels and game modes made by the Backrooms community. Anyone can contribute, so there’s always something new to play.

Just want to unwind? Grab your friends and jump into Sandbox mode for party games.

games.name: Decay of Worlds
games.shortDescription: A tactical fantasy defense game with RPG elements: Deploy powerful units, wield magic, and lead a band of heroes through dark missions filled with meaningful choices.
games.aboutText:
Decay of Worlds

A turn-based fantasy defense game with RPG elements

The world is crumbling — and you are its last line of defense. Decay of Worlds blends tactical depth with meaningful choices. Deploy defensive units, unleash powerful magic, and lead a group of unique heroes through dark, perilous missions.

🗺️ Explore missions filled with unique challenges

- Each mission introduces new enemy types, terrain effects, and tactical decisions.

- Heroes have individual abilities that can turn the tide of battle.

- At the end of every wave, make choices that shape future events.

🎲 Spend Fate Points to manage your resources strategically

- Invest in magic, skills, or unit upgrades.

- Adjust your strategy before each wave — adaptability is key to survival.

🛡️ Build your defense with tactical precision

- Combine melee fighters, ranged units, and support roles for maximum effectiveness.

- Enemies attack from up to two directions, forcing constant rethinking of your strategy.

- Use abilities like scouts or buffs to prepare for the next wave.

🔥 Master elemental magic in combat

- Fire: Deals damage over time.

- Ice: Slows enemies and reduces their attack speed.

- Air: Inflicts direct magic damage.

- Earth: Lowers the damage enemies deal.

📜 Make impactful decisions

- Respond to events with multiple-choice outcomes.

- Discover hidden objects and relics that empower your heroes.

Decay of Worlds offers deep strategy, dark fantasy atmosphere, and a world on the brink of collapse. Will your defenses hold?

games.name: FALLSTRUKTUR
games.shortDescription: It takes a while to go back to sleep, but inevitably, you return. To dream of the Fallstruktur.
games.aboutText:
FALLSTRUKTUR - Descend through a world of dream-like geometry

- Explore an interconnected vertical world

- Avoid splintering into a thousand pieces

- Savor the dense atmosphere

- Discover secret paths

- Master the first person physics-based control scheme

- Immerse yourself in the experience of falling

- 20-60 minutes of playtime

- Struktur Development Kit (w/ Steam Workshop support)

games.name: Goblin_Gnome_Horn
games.shortDescription: A 2D side-scrolling action game with hand-drawn graphics and a fun, surreal world view.
games.aboutText:
"Goblin Gnome Horn" is a casual 2D side-scrolling action game.

Players control a small goblin named "Nekbi" and aim to defeat the Demon King by collecting acorns through various mini-games such as "chopping firewood" and "cleaning the toilet."

Game Contents

"Labor" - Simple mini-games such as only clicking or only moving up, down, left and right.

"Battle" - Side-scrolling action battles against the demon king.

Play Time

It is estimated that it will take about 2 hours to complete. It can be enjoyed casually.

Labor (Mini-game)

・There are a total of 6 types of labor (mini-games).

・You can earn acorns depending on how well you do in the mini-games.

・If you get an S rank in a mini-game, you'll get a lot of acorns and new mini-games will be unlocked. Aim to get an S rank.

Trading (shop)

・You can purchase equipment and skills with acorns.

・You'll need a lot of acorns to purchase powerful equipment, so play the mini-game multiple times.

Battle

・The only enemy is the Demon King. He is in the next room, so you can challenge him anytime and as many times as you like.

・The game is cleared when you defeat the Demon King.

- Left click to attack, right click to parry.

・You can recover stamina by consuming acorns.

・It's up to you whether you defeat the Demon King by working hard and using strong equipment, or by using your own strength.

▶︎Text can be switched between Japanese and English.

▶︎Gameplay can be streamed.

games.name: Royal Lord - 王权领主
games.shortDescription: In "Kingdom Monarch", you are a monarch and can build the kingdom of your dreams! You need to build city walls, assign jobs to villagers, recruit soldiers, repel hordes of monsters at night, and expand your village during the day.
games.aboutText:
In a fantasy continent torn apart by war, the rise and fall of royal power depend on choices made between day and night —— Lord of the Crowns integrates the in-depth management of city-building with the real-time gameplay of tower defense strategy. As a lord, you will construct cities and expand territories by day, and defend against enemies to survive by night. From a temporary camp to an iron dynasty, every decision will be inscribed into the kingdom's legend.

Game Features

- Multi-dimensional strategic combination of Heroes + Technology + Units, ensuring distinct gameplay in each match.

- Immersive day-night cycle mechanism, enabling seamless switching between the "sense of construction achievement" and "combat tension".

- Global overview + countdown warning for precise and efficient decisions, eliminating ineffective operations.

- Growth line from camp to dynasty, witnessing the complete epic of the kingdom's rise.

Initial Choice: Heroes Define Tactical Direction

Before entering the game, choose a hero that fits your strategy —— directly setting the core gameplay direction for the entire match. Whether you are a steady defensive player or an aggressive fast-attack expander, it's all up to you!

Technology Empowerment: Unlock Soldiers' Combat Limits

Technology is the key to defeating enemies! Choose from dozens of tactical technologies: "Swift Stride" allows soldiers to maneuver flexibly on the battlefield, "Armor-Piercing Blade" tears through the enemy's heavy armor defenses, and "Fortress Reinforcement" turns city walls into impenetrable barriers. Precisely matching technology with units can exponentially enhance troop combat effectiveness, laying a solid foundation for resisting waves of powerful enemy invasions.

Infrastructure Layout: Terrain-Adapted Offense and Defense

Site selection, planning, and placement —— every step is crucial to the kingdom's survival! Farms and sawmills need to be close to resource points to ensure output, barracks must rely on location to seize tactical opportunities, and city walls are the top priority for early defense. Reasonably planning the direction of city walls can not only block enemy sneak attacks but also divide the battlefield to form a natural defense line. Through the global building overview panel, optimize the layout in real time to achieve seamless connection between production and defense.

Nighttime Defense: Pre-Battle Deployment Decides Victory

When the territory's development is on track, raids by dark forces will arrive as scheduled! Rely on the enemy attack countdown system to deploy troops in advance, and use carefully planned tactics and technology-boosted units to defend every inch of the territory. Surviving the night is victory!

Territory Tour: Freeze Your Exclusive Royal Glory

After the war subsides, slow down and admire the kingdom you built with your own hands —— from the initial temporary camp to the now densely packed city-states and impregnable defense lines, every building embodies your strategy and efforts. Activate the UI-free photo mode to freeze the exclusive glory moment of your lordship!

games.name: Fish Fights Back
games.shortDescription: A fishing game where the fish fights back — properly. Rod, drag, line stretch and the fish's own stamina are all simulated, so every hook-pull and snapped line is something you did. Fish matches on one lake against friends, and find out who can actually read the water.
games.aboutText:
The fight is the game

Most fishing games resolve a fish with a meter or a button prompt. This one runs a physical simulation thirty times a second: the rod's curve, the drag slipping, the line stretching and taking abrasion, and a fish with its own stamina, temper and idea of where it would rather be.

That has one consequence worth stating plainly. A lost fish is always traceable to something you did — wound in against a run, held the rod where it could not cushion, set the clutch on a line already worn by a snag. There is no dice roll to blame.

One lake, and everything in it

Six species, each with their own weight range, speed and behaviour, in water that has depth, weed, snags and a bed. Where you cast matters. What you feed matters. The hour of the day and the sky overhead change what is feeding and what is willing.

Tackle you commit to

Choose a way of fishing — float, ledger or lure — then the rod, reel, line and bait that suit it. Every combination is a real trade: a heavier line survives a snag and puts fish off; a soft rod protects a hook-hold and costs you control. You lock your choice before the whistle and live with it.

Then there is the drag, and it is the decision that decides matches. Set it light and a fish runs where it likes; set it hard and the line goes before the fish does. The right answer is different for every line you could have tied on, and you are setting it with a fish already moving.

Matches, not leaderboards

Host a match for up to eight anglers on one lake. Everybody fishes the same water, stocked the same way, arriving in the same order — so what separates two anglers is what they did, not what turned up. Set a length, a scoring format, or name a target species and make it a hunt.

Or open the session, drop the clock and the scoring, and just fish. The lake outlives whoever opened it.

A record book that remembers

Every fish you land goes in your book with its weight, where it came from and what it took. Personal bests, species you have never met, and a specimen grid that quietly tells you how good that carp actually was.

games.name: Kaguya
games.shortDescription: Not a regular shmup player? No worries! This is a super chill, low-difficulty, fully voiced bullet hell shooter just for you! Wipe out the AI machine armada attacking from all directions!
games.aboutText:
----------------------------------------------
Currently, the Playtest version only supports Xbox controllers (X-Input compatible controllers).
----------------------------------------------

Kaguya – A Bullet Hell STG That’s Friendly for Beginners!

◆ About the Game
Kaguya is a classic vertical-scrolling bullet hell shooter with a gentler difficulty curve.
Battle your way through six stages (planned) using bombs and power shots to take down waves of enemies from all directions!

Join Akari and Akane on a fully-voiced journey as they chat their way through intense battles, wiping out an army of AI machines!

This game was created by a developer who loves bullet hells but isn't great at them , so it's built with accessibility in mind.
If you've ever felt overwhelmed by the genre, this is your chance to enjoy a "kinder, gentler bullet hell experience!"

Of course, for seasoned players, we’ve got you covered too—with three difficulty modes: Normal, Hard, and Hell !

The game features full voice acting throughout!
...But since dodging bullets might keep you a little busy, we’ve included a Library Mode so you can enjoy all the voiced lines at your own pace.
Dialogue will also change depending on how you play— try to collect them all!

◆ Characters

Akari Mikado
A third-year student at Kaguya High and the game's main heroine.
She puts on a cool and stoic front, but deep down she’s earnest—and secretly obsessed with mechs and giant robots.
She enters the battlefield wielding the “En-Tetsu” blaster gun, built in her father’s humble machine shop.

Akane Hiiragi
Akari’s tactical navigator and longtime childhood friend.
She’s energetic, outspoken, and keeps Akari grounded—especially when her inner mech geek starts to spiral out of control.
Snarky comments and teasing are just part of their daily banter.

games.name: Evolve or Die
games.shortDescription: A co-op voice-controlled action game where yelling is the combat system. Team up, scream into your mics, and unleash absurd sound-powered attacks. Coordinate, panic, or just shout nonsense until the enemies—and your friends—totally melt down.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the world’s loudest co-op action game — a place where your voice is the controller , your microphone is a weapon, and your teammates are the reason everything falls apart.

This is a co-op voice-controlled chaos simulator where yelling, humming, chanting, coughing, or accidentally sneezing can all trigger actual in-game skills.
If you've ever wanted a game that rewards you for being loud and punishes you for laughing mid-battle, congratulations — you found it.

Team up with friends, shout nonsense into your mics, and try your best to survive enemies who definitely deserve better than whatever sounds you're making.

Your Voice = Your Skill Set

Forget keyboards. Forget buttons.
In this game, everything is voice-activated :

Want to attack? Make a noise.

Want to heal? Make a different noise.

Want to cast your ultimate? Good luck keeping a straight face.

Chaotic Co-op

Play solo if you dare…

…but the game shines when 2–4 players team up and attempt “communication.”

Expect conversations like：

“Was that your attack or your sneeze?”

“Stop laughing, you’re triggering your ultimate!”

“Bro your mic sensitivity is a war crime.”

This is not just co-op — it’s surviving your friends.

games.name: Diner Simulator 🍔
games.shortDescription: Run your own cozy diner solo or with friends! Cook, serve, clean, and manage the chaos in this fast-paced restaurant sim. Expand your café, customize your menu, and turn kitchen mayhem into delicious fun — or total disaster!
games.aboutText:
🍔 Diner Simulator — Welcome to Your Dream (and Maybe a Bit of a Nightmare)
You finally did it — your very own cozy little diner is open for business! The locals are lining up, hungry and curious. But are you ready to handle everything yourself?

In Diner Simulator, you're not just the chef — you're the server, the cleaner, the stock manager, and the heart of the whole operation. Cook meals, serve guests, keep your supplies in check, and make sure the place stays squeaky clean before the next lunch rush hits.

Feeling overwhelmed? Call in reinforcements! In online co-op (up to 4 players), kitchen chaos turns into hilarious teamwork. Divide the duties, create your own strategies, and see who cracks under pressure first.

Will your humble café grow into a restaurant empire... or will it all go up in smoke? The grill is hot — time to find out.

🧾 Features:
🍳 Solo or Co-Op Mayhem – Run the entire diner by yourself or team up with friends for a co-op experience full of laughter, yelling, and last-second saves.

👨‍🍳 Cook Like a Pro – Master dozens of recipes, customize your menu, and serve everything from greasy breakfasts to gourmet dishes — all under pressure.

🧼 Keep It Clean, Keep It Running – Manage supplies, clean up messes, fix broken gear, and do all the behind-the-scenes work that keeps the place from falling apart.

🏗️ Upgrade & Personalize – Expand your diner, decorate the space, add new appliances, and build the ultimate neighborhood hotspot.

🔥 Hilarious Kitchen Chaos – Slip-ups, shouting, grease fires, picky customers — experience the true madness of running a diner where anything (and everything) can go wrong.

Whether you’re chasing five-star reviews or just trying to keep the toast from burning — Diner Simulator is your ticket to delicious disaster.
Ready to take the heat?

games.name: Creepy Support
games.shortDescription: Save people from terrible paranormal dangers as a support operator of a secret SCP-like organization! Ask questions, give advice and watch the consequences of your choices... multiple endings in each story ;-)
games.aboutText:
Have you ever wanted to shout at the hero of a horror movie "don't go down into that basement"?! Friendly advice to the creepypasta hero not to check what's knocking at the door and just call the police? Explain to buyers of a haunted house that you shouldn't wait until the last minute to call an exorcist? Creepy Support gives you such a chance ;-)

In it, you get a job in online support for people who have encountered anomalous-creepy paranormality. And whether they will be able to escape depends only on your advice. Choose your questions carefully, carefully study the photos and audio recordings sent by clients - and perhaps they will be able to survive until dawn...

- 30 stories with multiple endings in each

- several endings in the global plot

- quotes from classic horror films and creepypastas, along with the breaking of their tropes and templates

- retro interface

- kilotons of text, written by a professional programmer

- references to the SCP Foundation universe - [DATA EXPUNGED]

games.name: Dice Hoarder
games.shortDescription: Dice Hoarder is a cozy organizing game where you restock a mysterious dice shop. Sort every die in the shop, match them into complete seven-piece sets, and uncover what is hidden behind your new job.
games.aboutText:
You are the perfect fit for the job!

You've been hired to stock a mysterious dice shop. Pick them up, examine their colours and materials, and rebuild 400+ seven-piece dice sets. Each set needs one of every classic polyhedral die: a percentile die, D4, D6, D8, D10, D12, and D20.

Take All the Time You Need

There are no timers and no need to rush. In Story Mode, the next day begins only after you have stocked the required value of dice. Search every corner, plan your sets, and work at your own pace while a cozy ambience and relaxing original soundtrack accompany every shift.

Unlock New Skills

As the days pass, mysterious floppy disks begin to appear. Use them to unlock strange new powers that make your work easier. Track down the remaining dice needed to complete a set, or pull them directly into your hand as if by magic.

The disks are certainly useful. Who keeps leaving them for you is another question...

Who Hired You?

You were given a job, a shop full of scattered dice, and very little information about your employer. Keep completing your shifts, follow the clues left behind, and uncover the truth behind your unusual new workplace.

Key Features

- Cozy first-person organizing gameplay.

- Pick up and stock thousands of colorful dice.

- ASMR, satisfying click-clack dice sounds.

- Story Mode with shift-based progression and no timers.

- Mysterious floppy disks that unlock special sorting abilities.

- Uncover the mystery and the secrets behind the shop.

- Chill Mode for one uninterrupted, story-free organizing experience.

- Magical dice, cozy ambience, a relaxing original soundtrack, and a cat.

games.name: Deadliest Pigeon
games.shortDescription: Unleash total destruction to avenge the little chick! Soar through chaos, weaponize yourself to obliterate physics-based enemies and everything in your path.
games.aboutText:
Deadliest Pigeon is a physics based action shooter where you play as a vengeful pigeon!

Packed with various actions , offering short yet intense gameplay.

His rage is unleashed! There’s no turning back.

Forget the breadcrumbs . Albert the Pigeon wants blood.

Weaponize yourself with various weapons .

Obliterate everything in your path!

Key Gameplay Features:

- Lethal Arsenal: Snatch and equip a variety of weapons to eliminate all the physics based enemies.

- Acrobatic Movement: Fly , run and use your grappling hook to navigate through fast paced mayhem .

- Level Elements: Utilize destructible environments , deadly traps , and explosives to your advantage.

There is no escape.

games.name: Hyperflex ULTRA
games.shortDescription: Dodge obstacles, switch gravity in ways you never even thought possible and see just how hard you can FLEX in this endless action platformer. Think you've got what it takes to master all four levels and achieve the VIBE?
games.aboutText:
Hyperflex ULTRA is an ultra fast-paced, ultra challenging ultra action game that will seriously test your reflexes and precision.

FLEX through twisting tunnels, dodge deadly obstacles, switch gravity in ways you never even thought possible and see just how hard you can FLEX in this endless runner.

Features

- 4 procedurally generated levels, each with its own unique twist

- Groovy original chiptune soundtrack by Purely Grey

- Tons of unlockables

- A caring [REDACTED] that watches your every move. Wait, what!?

Remember, true mastery of FLEXING means gliding through each level like it's second nature – or in other words, VIBING. Think you've got what it takes?

games.name: All About Chopsticks
games.shortDescription: This is a game where you can learn about chopsticks while challenging physics-based puzzles with handling chopsticks. Inspired by 'Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy'.
games.aboutText:
This is a game where you can learn about chopsticks while challenging physics-based puzzles with handling chopsticks.

- Pick up and move food from plate to plate with chopsticks to solve puzzles.

- The movement of chopsticks are accurately based on physics.

- 3-second rule: Even the food you dropped is still OK for 3 seconds.

- There is no known correlation between performing well in the game and improving actual chopstick skills.

This game is inspired by the game below:

- Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy

Guidelines about Streaming / Uploading Video

It is OK to stream/upload clips about review/playthrough of this game and you are free to monetize them.

However, I would appreciate it if you could follow the guideline below:

- Please introduce URL to this store page with your clip or its description

games.name: Woolly
games.shortDescription: Raise a flock of colourful sheep in this slow-paced idler. Look after your sheep, gather their fleeces and complete your collection.
games.aboutText:
Gameplay

Woolly can be played in the background while you do other things. Wait for your sheep to grow then gather their fleeces to earn money. Occasionally tend to your sheep, cleaning up after them and feeding them treats to help them grow faster.

Collect

Not all sheep are the same! Their fleeces are random - discover each colour and pattern to complete your collection and find out which ones generate the most income.

Features

- Idle game for running in the background while you work or relax.

- Simple mouse-only controls.

- 50+ fleece patterns to find and collect.

- Unlock breeding to discover even more fleeces.

- Upgrades to help automate tasks.

games.name: Swamp Keeper
games.shortDescription: Swamp Keeper is a Korean-style bow action arena shooter inspired by one-shot, one-kill gameplay. You are the "Swamp Keeper," defender of the sacred swamp, armed with only a bow to repel invading enemies. Master the art of archery, defeat waves of foes, and take down their commander.
games.aboutText:
Swamp Keeper is a Korean-style bow action arena shooter inspired by one-shot, one-kill gameplay.

You are the "Swamp Keeper," defender of the sacred swamp, armed with only a bow to repel invading enemies.

Master the art of archery, defeat waves of foes, and take down their commander.

Ho’s forces have invaded the sacred swamp, targeting its precious resources!

Wielding iron and fire, the enemy has already reached the heart of the swamp shrine.

As the sworn guardian of these wetlands, it’s your duty to drive them out.

With support from your allies, traverse the battlefield and restore peace.

Pull, aim, release — experience the high-stakes tension of one-shot, one-kill charging bow action.

Craft arrows that suit your style, select your skills, and prepare for combat.

Enjoy charming Korean-style anthropomorphic characters and beautifully rendered backgrounds.

games.name: Bioprototype
games.shortDescription: Bioprototype, a Roguelike & Skill Customizing Rhapsody! This is an auto-bomber with programming elements. Customize your character skills with visual programming, utilize enemy organs to finish the mutation, and construct the ultimate prototype, one can survive in the endless wave of flesh.
games.aboutText:
• Set your own skill trigger logics
• More builds: Bullet Master, Flesh Army, Virus Master, and more
• 24 unique characters with different skills
• 80+ organs with different functions
— Unlock unlimited combos universe

• Wild bullet storms
• Battlegrounds crawling with spores and offspring
• Venom is spreading everywhere
It’s not just a combat – create art with your organs!

games.name: Asterika: Phantom Rose Refrain
games.shortDescription: Asterika is a challenging bullet hell rhythm game! Forget falling notes. Move to the beat instead! Weave through bullet patterns, and master the chaos on the grid!
games.aboutText:
◆ Bullet Hell Rhythm Action!

Get ready for a demanding challenge! With no lanes or notes, find your own path on a 6x6 grid. Each beat brings a new threat, and every measure of music is a test of your mastery! You need to move on the beat, react, and dodge!

◆ Prove your mastery

From geometric traps to complex bullet patterns, learn every track to turn chaos into a perfect combo. See where you stand among the global player base in the Rank mode. Fight for your place in the Top 1% of Engineers.

◆ The chase

Take a breath between beats with an illustrated story mode. Each chapter unfolds through page-by-page prose, following Klare, a Soul Rose Engineer caught between Iris, a Phantom Hunter, and Vignette, a mysterious thief.

◆ Your stage your rules

Enjoy a curated selection of piano and electronic tracks from talented artists with varying difficulties. Whether you’re here for the hardcore bullet hell inspired challenge or just to vibe, adjustable difficulties and modes let you find your zone. But go further and use the built-in beatmap editor to create your custom stages and share!

The stage is set. Wishlist Asterika today!

Content Creators: You are fully permitted to stream and monetize content from playing "Asterika: Phantom Rose Refrain". To reduce likelihood of potential Content ID issues, it's recommended to enable "Streamer Mode" in the settings menu before going live or recording your videos.

games.name: Odd Dorable
games.shortDescription: An open-world exploration, puzzle game made from my 4-year-old daughter's drawings. Step into a vibrant, hand-drawn world and help the princess find all her magical candies.
games.aboutText:
Odd Dorable is a game created from my 4-year-old daughter’s drawings.

Embark on a short, playful adventure through this cozy and welcoming open world filled with different puzzles to solve . Uncover hidden secrets and help the princess find all her lost candies. Rediscover your inner child as the game evokes a sense of wonder and curiosity.

Little Features:

⏰ Around 30 minutes to 1 hour of playtime!

☁️ Step into a world of pure imagination, lovingly crafted together with my daughter!

🏝️ Explore different playful locations and solve puzzles!

🤪 Meet a small cast of quirky characters!

🎒 Find all six magic candies and help the princess reclaim her magical powers.

This game uses visual storytelling, so no language is needed to play and fully enjoy the experience.

⚠️ Attention: This game is digestible 😋🍴

A digestible game respects its players' money and time, is designed around a single idea, and doesn’t overstay its welcome. We want you to be able to finish our games in just a short session without ever making you feel stuffed, so to say.

games.name: The New Flesh
games.shortDescription: Explore the strange world within the screen in this ambient exploration experience featuring the music of Red Vox.
games.aboutText:
Explore the strange world within the screen in this ambient exploration experience featuring the music of Red Vox.

- A first person playable music video-like experience, spanning 3 songs from the upcoming Red Vox album.

- Meet those who inhabit this world and help them, but to what end?

- Collect Red Vox Records, can you find them all?

- Features a selection of 15+ additional songs spanning the history of Red Vox, each in their own unique environment.

- Now features a Red Vox song exclusive to the game which is to be found.

- There are secrets to find for those willing to explore.

games.name: Concerto on White: Cajon Story
games.shortDescription: Rhythm + Rich Story & Characters. You play as a new student in Concordia Academy of Music, facing a crisis on your first day joining the Cajon Club. Music dueling, co-op jamming, or even play with a real cajon!
games.aboutText:
Join us on Discord!

Rhythm + Rich Story & Characters. You play as a new student in Concordia Academy of Music, facing a crisis on your first day joining the Cajon Club.

Here you can play all kinds of music: Jazz, Rock, EDM, Classic, Country, Flamenco - Name your genres!

In addition to the story mode and free play mode, players can also engage in personal one-on-one conversations with their partners, deepening their bond while learning about music. They may visit the academy’s arcade to play mini-games, redeem gifts for their partners at the store, or enjoy quiet reading in the library with short articles about music.

Three Unique Features

- Boss Fight: Music Duel
Boss fights are reimagined as live music showdowns. Use your ears to dissect the opponent's patterns, then replicate and dominate the groove. (Music school veterans will recognize this twist on audition-style rhythm dictation!)

- Co-op Jamming
Up to 4 players can jam together locally. Not mirrored charts, but a true ensemble with separate instrumental parts.

- Play with a Real Cajon
Crush beats using actual acoustic cajons. Works with most standard cajons right out of the box.

games.name: Voidwood
games.shortDescription: Voidwood is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game, where your voice can save your friends or give them all away. By day, you scavenge an inviting, cursed forest. By night, you survive the hunt. Push your luck, go deeper, and speak carefully. The forest is listening.
games.aboutText:
Voidwood is a co-op survival horror game for 1-4 players. You and your friends are children trapped in a cursed forest. While daylight lasts, scavenge for supplies, venture farther into the forest, and prepare for what comes after dark. At night, The Beast begins its hunt, tracking every sound you make as you try to escape.

Get out alive. Bring your haul back to camp. Craft new tools, open new paths, and return better prepared to uncover what the forest is hiding.

TALK TO SURVIVE. WHISPER TO STAY HIDDEN.

Your voice is part of the game.

Call out supplies. Warn a friend. Whisper a plan when The Beast is close. Every sound can help your group survive, but the forest is listening too. Make too much noise at the wrong moment, and you may bring danger straight to you.

SCAVENGE BY DAY. SURVIVE THE NIGHT.

Daylight gives you time, not safety.

Search the forest for what you need and decide how far you are willing to push before darkness falls. When night comes, the rules change. Hide, run, and survive the hunt until you find a way out.

Escape with what you collected, and it is yours to keep. Stay too long, and risk losing everything.

THE FOREST CHANGES. CHANGE YOUR PLAN.

Every trip into Voidwood prepares you for the next.

Return to camp with the resources you recover to build and improve your base, craft new tools and equipment, and prepare for the days ahead. Expand your camp, unlock new strategies, and open new paths through the forest.

Changing conditions mean the same plan won’t always work twice. And the farther you go, the more dangerous the forest becomes.

UNCOVER WHAT THE FOREST IS HIDING.

You are not the first children to enter Voidwood.

Search its forgotten places, recover what others left behind, and piece together what happened to the children who came before you. The answers are hidden throughout the forest, if you can survive long enough to find them.

Speak carefully. The forest is listening.

FEATURES

- 1 to 4-player online co-op

- 20-minute survival runs

- Proximity voice chat that can attract enemies

- A relentless Beast that hunts by sound

- Collect resources and escape back to camp

- Unlock new tools, defenses, and strategies between runs

- Open new paths and push deeper into an expanding forest

- Run modifiers that change each expedition

- Brutes, Husks, mages, and other hostile forest creatures

- Private room codes and online matchmaking

- Hidden collectibles that uncover the story of the forest

- Chaotic escapes with friends when the plan falls apart

games.name: Haunted Room : 205
games.shortDescription: To save money, you rent an unusually cheap apartment, believing you could coexist with “them” as you always have. But you soon discover that the disturbances here run far deeper—and are far more dangerous—than anything you’ve encountered before.
games.aboutText:
This is a first-person walking simulator + life simulation game with horror and thriller elements.

Story:
You are a young man gifted with the ability to sense the supernatural. To save money, you rent an unusually cheap apartment, believing you could coexist with “them” as you always have. But you soon discover that the disturbances here run far deeper—and are far more dangerous—than anything you’ve encountered before. Each sleepless night in this eerie apartment brings you closer to the truth…

Features:

Supernatural Perception: Play as a protagonist born with the ability to sense the paranormal, and close your eyes to dispel supernatural occurrences in the apartment.

Sanity System: Paranormal phenomena will steadily erode your sanity, while sudden scares could push you over the edge instantly. Learn to close your eyes at critical moments and maintain your mental state by eating and drinking.

Life Simulation: Open doors, switch on lights, eat, drink, sleep… Interact with your surroundings in detail to gradually build immersion.

Immersive Horror Atmosphere: Built with Unreal Engine 5, combining realistic lighting and high-precision modeling to create an oppressive indoor setting rich in Asian cultural elements. Paired with lifelike environmental audio, it delivers a truly immersive horror experience.

This game does not contain any puzzle elements.

[Warning: This game contains jump scares and sudden loud sounds that may cause discomfort. If you have heart disease, epilepsy, anxiety disorders, or similar conditions, please play with caution.]

games.name: On Donuts and Holes
games.shortDescription: A psychological adventure through a dreamy landscape. Face unanswerable questions to reach the ultimate enigmas: Who are you? Who am I?
games.aboutText:
A psychological adventure through a dreamy landscape. Face unanswerable questions to reach the ultimate enigmas: Who are you? Who am I?

There is a mysterious creature donning a flower wreath, and it only refers to itself as I .

I will ask you questions, and the conversation will progress based on your answers.

"What would you do if you could meet your past self?"

"If you could buy other people's experiences with money, would you?"

Some of the questions will be things that you may have asked yourself already. Some may lead you to unexplored parts of your mind.

There is no right answer. What matters is what you believe.

After answering a question, you will be shown everyone else's answers.

How many chose as you did? And why did the others choose differently?

Dive into your own mind as you try to glance at someone else's.

Every door is connected to an answer. Go through the one you chose.

Your choices will change the room that you are in. Take a stroll through this visual representation of your own mind.

Maybe, after you've gone through enough doors, you will realize this world's secrets.

Many questions await you. Some will be about common food items, while some will be about matters of life and death. None of them, however, have clear-cut answers.

You might wonder: why am I being asked these things in the first place?

If you realize the reason between all of those questions, you may choose to face the reality hidden behind that simple donut hole.

But do so at your own discretion. If you go too deep, there's no guarantee you'll be able to come back up.

This is I .

A creature that loves talking, but remains vanishing and mysterious.

I would like to ask you some questions.

This is you .

The choices you will take belong to you , as they come from your own memories and experiences.

- Over a hundred new questions.

- A new, expanded plot.

- Complex interactions between your answers and the plot.

- Improved graphics and new stages.

- Backlog functions to see past questions and dialogue.

- English and Chinese (simplified and traditional) support.

games.name: Hidengen
games.shortDescription: Hidengen is an atmospheric PvP shooter featuring stealth and vertical combat. Only one will survive. Victory requires not just strength, but cunning. Use your jetpack, shadows, height, and weather conditions to your advantage.
games.aboutText:
Hidengen is a multiplayer PvP shooter that blends stealth, parkour, and vertical combat. The action takes place on a mysterious alien planet where a scientific expedition has vanished without a trace. You are a volunteer sent to investigate — but something went terribly wrong. Now, only one can survive, and the evacuation ship has room for just one.

Key Features:

- Battle Royale with a twist : A last-player-standing PvP experience with no teams — only one survivor makes it out alive.

- Jetpack traversal : Use your jetpack with an overheat system to move quickly and gain vertical advantage. Time your flights carefully.

- Stealth and realistic lighting : Hide in shadows, ambush your enemies, and adapt to dynamic lighting that affects visibility and tactics.

- Vertical level design : Giant mushrooms, cliffs, and industrial structures create multi-level battlefields. Height is a strategic asset.

- Dynamic weather and day-night cycle : Sandstorms, rainfall, snowfall, and transitions from bright daylight to pitch-black night change every match. Adapt on the fly.

- Light parkour elements : Climb, slide, and maneuver around the terrain. Mobility gives you an edge.

- Win with cunning, not just firepower : Outsmart your opponents. Use the environment and clever tactics to turn the tide.

- Short, intense matches : Each game lasts 10–15 minutes. Every choice matters.

There is no between-match progression — all players start equal. Your survival depends entirely on skill, strategy, and adaptability.

Coming soon : Additional game modes including Deathmatch and Extraction are planned for future updates.

games.name: Well Dweller
games.shortDescription: Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania, full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer - a tiny bird armed with a matchstick - who must burn the wicked queen to save his family.
games.aboutText:
Deep within the forest, at the bottom of a well, lives the only creature brave enough to kill the queen...

WELL DWELLER is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania made by the creators of Crypt Custodian and Islets!

Play as Glimmer - a tiny bird armed with a matchstick- who must burn the wicked queen to save his family. Explore a dark fairy-tale landscape and befriend the charming characters who reside in the kingdom’s underbelly. Battle terrifying beasts and gain new abilities to expand your map. Solve puzzles, discover secrets, and unravel the mysteries that lie in this rotted kingdom.

Among the rotting ruins are a charming cast of characters just trying to get by. Go camping with Ilda, a tiny mouse who is on the run from the queens grasp. Explore an abandoned castle with Looter, a mysterious scavenger who searches the kingdom for the best wares to steal. And find and reunite with all of your sheltered siblings who were snatched up one night by a crazed hunter.

Light up your matchstick to illuminate the world and aid in combat. Collect trinkets to upgrade your abilities, and mix-and-match them to customize your game play. Solve puzzles, defeat vicious bosses, and forge your path to the queens quarters to save your family.

games.name: The Devil's Due
games.shortDescription: You lost your soul in a poker game against the Devil. Now, trapped in the infernal depths, your only hope is to fight your way back to freedom. You’ll face a diverse gallery of monstrous foes in nearly impossible poker battles - but luckily, you’re a cheater.
games.aboutText:
Engage in intense one-on-one poker battles against gruesome demonic monsters, each with unique abilities. The strength of your poker hand determines your damage, and the sum of your cards’ values is your defense..

Unlock and master an ever-expanding arsenal of cheat tricks as you shape your run around a constantly evolving deck. Conceal and swap cards mid-battle, boost key values to force powerful hands, sabotage the enemy’s draw, and bend the odds toward carefully crafted synergies.

But there’s a devilish twist: you and your opponent draw from the same deck. Every card you add, remove, duplicate, or modify affects both sides of the table. To survive, you must deliberately build and refine a deck that amplifies your current cheats and relics while minimizing the enemy’s advantage.

Every trick raises your foe’s suspicion meter. Push your cheating too far, and they’ll lash out with devastating fury.

Death means starting over, but not empty-handed. Earn new cheat cards, powerful relics, and fresh strategies with each run. Adapt your deck and cheat arsenal to tackle deeper levels of Hell and inch closer to ultimate redemption.

At the start of each level of Hell, the Devil lays out tarot cards dictating your path through monster and boss fights, shops, healing shrines, and mini-games. But you were never one to let others determine your path…

games.name: StarFear
games.shortDescription: Fly. Die. Improve. Repeat. StarFear is a brutal space extraction roguelite where loss is learning, skill is the answer, and nothing feels better than getting out alive, alone or with your friends.
games.aboutText:
Your chosen gear goes in with you. It doesn't come back if you don't.

StarFear is a 1-4 player 2D space extraction roguelite built around two core ideas: quick reflexes and permanent loss. Venture into hostile zones, scavenge weapons and equipment, and fight your way to the extract. Die, and everything you brought is gone.

- Take the best loadout for every run or hoard the fancy loot for later.

- Fuel powers your run. Run empty and you're drifting.

- Fly solo or bring your friends, then endure being asked to "go find my stuff."

- Die. Learn why. Survive long enough to defeat the Kessari.

- Gain experience to advance your pilot's level and raise the threat (NG+).

This Isn't Bullet Hell

It's a 2D space twitch shooter. Hard. Fast. Fair. Hard games make you feel something, and we want you to feel something.

Become the best version of your pilot self. Duck and dodge, time your defenses, and hit your shots. When you die — and you will — it'll be because of a decision you made. The combat asks you to improve, and when you do, you'll feel it.

Fly. Die. Repeat. Get better.

A Simple Reason to Fight

Your father's ship. A dead transmission. A sister gone missing. The Kessari are destroying your family — can you survive long enough to take your revenge?

Track down black market contacts, decode transmissions, and hunt the people responsible across escalating encounters that end in a final confrontation.

The Extraction Loop

Between missions, outfit your ship from a shared hub. Choose your weapons, configure your systems, stock up on fuel, and decide what's worth risking. Then drop into a hostile zone.

Enemies patrol with detection ranges and heat sensitivity — fire your engines near a patrol and they'll investigate. Push deeper for better loot. Complete objectives to advance the story. Extract successfully to keep everything. Fail, and it's all gone.

Escalating threat levels unlock harder zones, tougher enemies, and better loot.

Your Ship Is a System

Fuel powers everything — engines, weapons, shields. Run dry mid-run and you're floating in the black. Oxygen depletes with every crew member aboard. Take enough damage and your ship starts failing: thrust misaligns, weapons lose accuracy, fuel burns faster than it should.

Repair what you can. Replace what you can't. Push forward with failing systems if you have to or trade your cargo for speed and get out while you still can.

The Arsenal

Every run is a decision about what you're willing to lose. Rapid-fire machine guns, precision snipers, shotguns, explosives, devastating beam weapons that ramp damage over time, and force weapons that push enemies into walls.

Engines that trade speed for fuel efficiency. Shields that drain your tank faster than you'd like. Utility slots for dodges, blinks, tow cables, enhanced sensors, and more.

For more anxiety, mod your favorites and experience even greater pain of loss.

Fly Solo or Bring a Crew

StarFear plays as a tight solo experience. It's even more fun with friends.

Bring up to 3 players. Harass your enemies as a squadron of fighters, or crew a single vessel and split its systems between you. Your stash is shared — argue over which equipment to bring or sell when fuel reserves run low.

Divide responsibilities for the objectives at hand, then carefully coordinate or don't and apologize later.

Progression That Persists

Your perk tree and account level carry over between runs. Your gear does not. Spend perk points in a branching tree of 60+ perks across weapons, engines, and defense — with specialization gates that force meaningful choices.

Equipment power increases alongside new and harder enemies. Complete objectives to unlock new items in the hub store, open new zones, and advance the story. Save your game and return to it later.

Features

- 1-4 player online co-op

- High clarity 2D geometric art style rooted in the lineage of Asteroids, Xpilot, and Geometry Wars

- Extraction roguelite: extract to keep your loot, die and lose it

- Risk/reward tradeoffs: choose what to leave at home in case you don't come back

- Run economy: equipment and fuel are finite; each run ends when your fuel does

- Shared hub for you and your crew to see each other's loadouts, practice, and compete in a speedrun gauntlet

- AI enemies with detection ranges and heat sensitivity

- System simulation streamlined for combat: fuel, oxygen, mass, and malfunctions

- Multi-act story with handcrafted zones and increasingly difficult enemies

- Wanted Level (NG+) for escalating risk and reward

- Perks that grow your power the more you play

- Save your run and come back later

DISCLAIMER:

StarFear is in active development and subject to massive, unexpected changes based on the game's vision and most importantly: your feedback . Some systems are in a more prototype state than others, but the skeleton is in place and the bones are good. We've been having fun and we're ready to share.

games.name: Bombunter
games.shortDescription: Bombunter is a 2D platformer where you play as a fearless treasure hunter exploring mysterious underground dungeons.
games.aboutText:
Bombunter is a 2D platformer where you play as a fearless treasure hunter exploring mysterious underground dungeons. Equipped with a giant wrench, you will fight against dangerous enemies and use powerful bombs to destroy obstacles blocking your way to hidden treasures.

Throughout your journey, you will encounter various traps and unexpected surprises that will test your skills and reflexes. The game features a moody lo-fi soundtrack that creates a unique and immersive atmosphere. Combined with pixel-art graphics, Bombunter offers a nostalgic retro experience as you uncover the secrets buried deep within the dungeons.

Prepare yourself for an adventure full of action, exploration, and challenges!

Game Features:

- Bomb-based obstacle destruction

- Trap-filled dungeon exploration

- Atmospheric lo-fi soundtrack

- Retro pixel-art graphics

games.name: Numeral Strike
games.shortDescription: A turn-based roguelite where battles take place on a field of numbers. Find pairs — either matching numbers or those that add up to 10 — to attack, defend, and overcome enemies in a world of magical medieval fantasy!
games.aboutText:
Numeral Strike is a turn-based roguelite where every battle unfolds on a grid of numbers and pairs! Victory depends on your sharp eye and your ability to think ahead!

Features:

- A unique combat system unlike any other roguelite

Use the number grid to perform actions — find matching pairs or pairs that add up to 10. Every valid pair lets you attack, heal, defend, or trigger powerful special effects.

- A variety of unique foes to face

Enemies shape the battlefield as much as you do! Each one demands thoughtful tactics and a fresh approach to win. Get ready for true duels against the most cunning villains!

- Chapter-based structure

No more losing all your progress in a single long run — this roguelite takes a different path! The game is divided into chapters, each with its own unique theme. One chapter pits you against goblins, the next throws you into battle with the undead, and later — with deadly mages. With each chapter, enemies grow stronger and offer new kinds of challenges. And your progress is saved between chapters!

So what are you waiting for? Dive into a vibrant world of medieval adventure as a mercenary hero: carve your path through increasingly challenging enemies, discover powerful artifacts, and craft your strategy for every foe — every turn!

games.name: Become
games.shortDescription: Become is a short single-player third-person adventure where you embark on life's most fantastical journey, as one of millions of sperm. Survive the perilous microcosm, wiggle, dash, and outcompete rivals through the human reproductive system to create new life.
games.aboutText:
Embark on Life's Greatest Tiny Journey

Each of us is a champion. We all triumphed in the most epic, microscopic race against millions to win the ultimate prize: life itself. We just don't remember the crazy ride.

Become is a short single player, third person adventure. Experience this tiny grand journey as one of millions of sperm. Learn, adapt, and grow stronger as you explore the fascinating but dangerous microcosm of the human reproductive system. Be the one to create new life.

Only the Strongest Survive

Survive a treacherous journey through acidic baths and antibody attacks. Master the currents, collect sugars and proteins, and evolve your cell to be the fastest, toughest, and most efficient swimmer to achieve the miracle of life.

Be Smart. Find Your Way.

It will take more than just speed and resilience. Become the leader of the pack to secure your genetic legacy. Customize your unique look and dive into a thrilling and playful adventure.

Features:

- 2-3h linear experience

- Gather resources to improve and develop

- Rescue buddies and use them to overcome obstacles

- Explore, wiggle, hop, push, penetrate and surf or fight currents

- Escape immune cells, acidic traps and break through membranes

- Customize your sperms look

- Learn about the reproductive microcosm

games.name: TCG Card Collection: Tidy Up
games.shortDescription: Organize and restore a special collection of 3,200 TCG cards. Clean each card and reveal their true glory. Match and sort them to sixteen themed sets. Turn a room full of chaos back to a collector's gallery.
games.aboutText:
Your glorious collection has been forgotten, now it's time to restore to it to its true form. Pick each card, inspect them, clean them and store them in their own cabinets. Each card has a thematical set, archetype and rarity; there are even foil cards! Watch and relax as all the chaos slowly turns into an orderly gallery.

Luckily not every card got dirty, but there are definitely some filthy ones. Take them to your cleaning table and watch as the dusty card transitions into a smooth, shiny and beautiful piece.

Collecting and cleaning your cards isn't enough, you have to put them into their own place. Put the cards into their right set cabinets, archetype cabinets and holders. Carefully inspect each card and determine where they belong!

Key Features

- A relaxing and stress free gameplay loop with no timers or penalties.

- Satisfying ASMR card cleaning.

- Cozy first-person tidying, sorting, cleaning gameplay.

- Four-hundred unique cards to discover and display.

- A graceful transformation of chaos and order.

games.name: Lost Arsenal
games.shortDescription: Lost Arsenal is a challenging movement-heavy melee action game. Stylishly maneuver through areas by teleporting to your thrown weapons, and use each weapon's unique power to carve your way through a summoner's invasion.
games.aboutText:
As an armament-slinging enchanted doll, mobility is your deadliest weapon and fragility is your biggest threat. Just one misstep could spell your end.

However, using your limited resources wisely will allow you to navigate every situation flawlessly.

Along with your weapons and abilities, you gain speed from constant actions. Meaning quick thinking, fast acting, and effective use of your resources will allow you to flow through your enemies with ease.

Make your way through the invasion of this unfamiliar castle and uncover how you came to be. Gather the Arsenal that the bloodline of the castle has protected for generations and use it to weave through opposition and danger.

games.name: Ye Guild Clerk!
games.shortDescription: The local Adventurer's Guild is hiring!... Not for adventurers, but for guild clerks! You play an important role in handing out quests, gold, and equipment as your actions shape the stories of these animal adventurers for better, or for worse..!
games.aboutText:
Ye Guild Clerk! is a short 2.5D, interactive narrative game, where you play as a newly hired guild clerk in a world full of cute animal adventurers! Perfect for players who love character-driven stories, cute animals, and cozy medieval fantasy worlds.

Features

- Meet a cast of cute animal adventurers, each with their own stories and quirks!

- Have 5 days to prove you're a good fit for the role! .. or suffer the consequences and get fired...

- As a guild clerk, you'll hand out quests, rewards and equipment!... But be wary:

- Your choices matter , each action you take shapes the outcomes and stories for each adventurer you run into... for better or for worse!

- Over 40+ individual endings between all of the adventurers you can meet!

- Decorate your clerk booth with various customizations and decorations!

- Select from 3 different music tracks to listen to!

Controls:

- Point & Click Controls - Drag, Select, & Camera Movement

- WASD/Arrow Keys - Camera Movement

- Click/Space - Continue Dialogue

- ESC - Pause/Settings Menu

Please Note:
There is no current way to save your progress . It is highly recommended to play in one sitting. The average playthrough can take from 35 - 50 minutes.

games.name: Infinite Alliance
games.shortDescription: Heroes and villains from 17 Indie JRPGs collide, in this story rich Crossover Event! Chained Echoes, Jack Move, CrossCode, 8-Bit Adventures 2, Beloved Rapture, Quartet, and more unite for a totally FREE adventure!
games.aboutText:
Featuring characters from Chained Echoes, Quartet, CrossCode, Jack Move, 8-Bit Adventures 2, Beloved Rapture, and many more!

Pulled from their homes and stranded on a dead world, a disparate group of champions must face their past, redeem a failed hero, and slay a dark force which threatens all creation...

Engage in stylish turn-based battles with a party of 9 unique heroes, and encounter familiar friends, foes, and environments re-imagined. Plus, test your mettle against warriors from CrossCode, Seed of Nostalgia, Cosmic Star Heroine, and Geo Mythica in over-the-top superboss battles!

Infinite Alliance showcases the creative variety of the Indie JRPG scene, and we hope you'll discover your next favorite game through this epic FREE adventure!

Heroes

- Glenn from Chained Echoes

- Dustin from Kingdoms of the Dump

- Noa from Jack Move

- The Warrior (named by the player) from 8-Bit Adventures 2

- Alexandra from Quartet

- Rio from Shrine’s Legacy

- Chel from For a Vast Future

- Whoopis from My Familiar

- Vera & Arin from Eternal Remnant

- Gio from Geo Mythica

Villains

- Drago from Beloved Rapture

- Montam from Venaitura

- The Fateshifter from Ephemeral Tale

- Qliphoth - an original villain.

Guest Battles

- Lea from CrossCode

- Alyssa & Chahn from Cosmic Star Heroine

- Atilla from Seed of Nostalgia

- Gio, Liliana, and Drake from Geo Mythica

Cameos

- Blitz from Godless Avalon

games.name: Cozy Crunch
games.shortDescription: A cozy, upgrade-filled, adventure that goes from curious kitty to unstoppable leaf-crunching beast. Stomp, explore, and uncover cozy forest secrets with your magical fairy guide.
games.aboutText:
A cozy, upgrade filled, adventure that goes from curious kitty to unstoppable leaf-crunching beast. Stomp, explore, and uncover cozy forest secrets with your magical fairy guide.

Time your triple stomps to the music for a special attack

Collect hidden treasures

Survive wild winds

Customize your character

Cozy Crunch is a gentle, whimsical adventure where you guide a curious cat through a crunchy leaf-filled forest using a magical fairy (your mouse cursor). Stomp leaves, uncover secrets, and explore hand-crafted areas filled with cozy atmosphere and charming surprises.

Features:

- Simple point and click controls

- 4 hand crafted areas

- A hidden rhythm mechanic - time your triple stomps to the music to unleash powerful waves

- Relaxing original soundtrack

- Character customization (50+ variations)

- Multiple progression paths with quests, hidden items, and upgrades

- Steam achievements

Game Duration : ~3-4+ hours

Wishlist Cozy Crunch and prepare to leaf your worries behind

What Streamers are Saying

“I’ve come to the conclusion this game is weirdly therapeutic!” -ImCade

About the game

Hi! I’m Jo, a solo indie developer, and this is my first game. Cozy Crunch is inspired by the charm of classic online flash games. Simple, relaxing, and designed to be enjoyed in a single cozy evening. I hope it brings you a bit of calm and delight, just like it did for me while creating it.

Note: A HUGE thank you to our fans for providing the German, Italian, Russian, and Brazilian Portuguese in-game translations! To make the game accessible to everyone, the store page and all other translations were created with AI assistance. We always welcome new fan translations!

games.name: Last Term
games.shortDescription: You’ve been trapped in a school by a mysterious God. Memorize your surroundings, spot the anomalies, and reach floor 0 to earn your escape.
games.aboutText:
Last Term is a spot the difference horror game. Trapped in a school, each floor appears the same. But is it? Look out for any anomalies to determine if it's different than the last. Progress to floor 0 to uncover how you ended up here.

The final bell has already rung, but something won’t let go...

Navigate through the school and familiarize yourself with the surroundings.

There's 3 areas the game revolves around:

- Hallway

- Classroom

- Bathroom

Uncover a variety of anomalies. Some are subtle, others far more disturbing.

- Certain anomalies are interactable, leading to unexpected moments

- If you spot any anomalies, go downstairs

- If everything feels normal, head upstairs

Making the right decisions will put you closer to reaching floor 0.

The anomaly book allows you to track which anomalies you have encountered and work towards spotting them all!

- Over 50 unique anomalies

- 4 endings

- Full English voiceover

- 30-60 minutes playtime

games.name: Regions
games.shortDescription: Build a living region, from the first street to a network of towns and cities. Shape the land, grow neighborhoods, plan public transport, and guide the economy. Follow residents through their daily lives in a deeply simulated city builder where every connection matters.
games.aboutText:
BUILD A PLACE WORTH COMING HOME TO

A quiet street becomes a neighborhood. A new connection opens up a town. A growing community gives someone a reason to stay.

Regions is a deeply simulated city builder about the places you create and the people who make them home. Shape the landscape, grow towns and cities, connect them with roads and public transport, and guide an economy built around everyday life. Build your region from the ground up, then get close enough to see what your decisions mean for the people living there.

START WITH THE LAND

Follow the curve of a river, build into the hills, or leave a forest untouched. Shape terrain and waterways, plant trees, and find the spot where your first neighborhood belongs.

Draw straight, curved, and freeform roads. Carry bridges across valleys, connect highways with ramps, and turn empty parcels into homes, workplaces, and places to gather. From the sweep of an avenue to its sidewalks and parking, make a place with its own character.

MAKE EVERY CONNECTION COUNT

Give people better ways to reach the places that matter. Bring neighborhoods together with bus routes, connect communities by rail, and plan the stops, stations, and transfers that turn individual lines into a public transport network.

Think beyond the route on the map. Where do people walk? Where do they change services? Does a connection make the morning commute easier? Coordinate roads, transit, and development as travel patterns change around you.

FOLLOW LIFE AT STREET LEVEL

Everyday journeys give your region its rhythm. Residents have homes, families, jobs, and daily plans. Follow someone from their front door to work and back, watch a household arrive, or see where the traffic at your new intersection is going.

Look inside the community you are building. Inspect people, vehicles, homes, and businesses to understand the lives and journeys behind the numbers. Zoom out to plan the next district, then return to street level and watch an ordinary day unfold.

GROW AN ECONOMY. KEEP A COMMUNITY THRIVING.

Homes need incomes. Businesses need workers and customers. Growing neighborhoods need infrastructure they can afford.

Guide an economy of households, employers, wages, bills, and taxes. Balance public finances, support new development, and weigh the cost of expanding roads and services against the opportunities they create. Your transport decisions, land use, and local economy shape each other.

THINK BEYOND THE CITY LIMITS

Build the relationships between places: a small town beside the river, a busy neighborhood near a station, a growing center of employment. Plan power, water, and the connections that help them grow together.

Start with a piece of land. Make it somewhere people belong.

Wishlist Regions and build your own vision of a living region.

games.name: Far Fishing
games.shortDescription: Far Fishing is a short and relaxing fishing game. Set off on a journey to the edge of the world, catching a variety of fish and upgrading your boat along the way.
games.aboutText:
Far Fishing is a short and relaxing fishing game. Set off on a journey to the edge of the world, catching a variety of fish and upgrading your boat along the way.

Catch Fish

The core fishing mechanic is simple and easy to learn.

Chase fish with your small boat and try to keep them inside the circle.

Locations

Explore a variety of unique places — from coral reefs and active volcanoes to dense jungles!

Upgrades

Write your own story on the way to the edge of the world by unlocking new abilities and upgrades.

Features

- Relaxing, repetitive gameplay

- Upgrade tree

- 9 unique locations

- A short and enjoyable experience (~2 hours of playtime)

games.name: Paperwork
games.shortDescription: Paperwork is a first-person office-building incremental game where you optimize an office to generate more and more money. Step into the office of Clarity, become a productive worker and watch profits grow.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Clarity ™

Paperwork is a game about corporate growth.

- Discover the office of Clarity ™ as you join the company to lead a new division towards profit.

- Build and place desks of various kinds, supports and meeting rooms to increase the office productivity.

- Optimize your income using different synergies between adjacent desks.

- Grow, grow and grow!

Clarity ™ is expecting big and you are not letting us down.

Features:

- 4 office levels to explore and build into!

- 40+ upgrades to unlocks.

- 10+ desks, machines and rooms to place.

- 15+ different synergy bonuses that can be combined for the most efficient profit.

games.name: Your Second Wife
games.shortDescription: Think you've had your fill of virtual waifu? It's Okay, step into the world of Your Other Waifu... She's developed a passion for dress-up and is waiting for you to join her in some delightful little games!
games.aboutText:
As the day winds down, she's there on your desktop, quietly awaiting your return. Will you choose to spend some special time with your other waifu tonight? (She might just be wearing something special...)

The card table is her stage, reserved just for you. Win each game to unlock enticing outfits, letting your other waifu glow with captivating charm under the evening lights. Can you see that hint of a blush?

Simple keyboard taps and mouse clicks could speed up unlocking your other waifu's next outfit. Every action builds towards gifting her a new look... Want to see her shine even brighter? Feel free to interact as you work or study – she'll be patiently waiting. And when night falls again, she'll be right there on your desktop, ready for your next "secret game".

games.name: Citrus Summer
games.shortDescription: Citrus Summer is a yuri visual novel set in the urban workplace. Play as Rachel, a single corporate worker stuck in overtime, and navigate unexpected romance with three women—a sharp boutique owner, a talented new colleague, or your childhood best friend. Your choices decide whose heart you capture.
games.aboutText:
Story

Rachel, 27 years old. This is her fifth year working overtime in the game industry.

Weekends are a luxury. Life moves like a wound-up machine, spinning day after day.

Her old dreams, the starting point of her future—all blurred by overtime and exhaustion.
