Until one late night at work, a strange plush toy appears before her—

And from that moment, things begin to change.

A coworker she barely knew starts having meals with her, slowly growing closer.
A woman she meets at a friend’s birthday party looks at her with a certain glint in her eye.
Even her longtime best friend grows more clingy, more intimate than before…

Could this be the chance to break free from her numb, repetitive life?

No. What matters now is—

Faced with three love stories that seem to fall from the sky, what choice awaits her?

Characters

Rachel (Playable Character)
A single corporate slave stuck in endless overtime in the game industry. She once loved writing, but her dreams have been worn down by the grind.

Scarlett
A sharp and capable boutique owner. She met Rachel at a friend’s birthday party, and from the very first meeting, she showed a special interest in her.

Ivy
Rachel’s cheerful, sunshine-like best friend since high school. She always sticks close to Rachel, and lately, she seems even more affectionate than before.

Lyra
A newly hired programmer at the company, exceptionally skilled. After they started having meals together, she and Rachel gradually grew closer.

Game Info

This is a visual novel set in urban workplace life. It is a yuri-themed game featuring romance, workplace, and other elements.

The game includes approximately 200,000 words of story, over 20 CGs, and three romanceable characters.

games.name: Book of Fei
games.shortDescription: Lead adorable warriors to form an adventure team to work and adventure on the computer desktop. Defeat the warriors to save the world. Rich nurturing and collection elements, idle and slack off to earn money and fight monsters!
games.aboutText:
《Book of Fei》 is a cute and casual idle RPG played directly on your computer desktop. The game interface appears at the bottom of your system desktop, offering adorable companionship during busy work hours!

Explore Worlds, Battle and Work on Your Desktop

Adventure through different regions in the book world, challenge monsters, defeat the Demon King, and uncover the truth of this realm.

Your heroes battle, level up, and work part-time jobs at the bottom of your desktop.

Interact with heroes to deepen bonds.

6 Characters, 24 Advanced Classes, Hundreds of Equipment & Card Gear

Command heroes to adventure in various regions for leveling up and unlocking advanced classes to become the ultimate warrior. Collect rare card gear with different effects to modify heroes' abilities and build the strongest party.

Assign heroes to work in different areas to earn gold, then purchase and collect superior equipment, combat mechanisms, and enhancement badges to fully boost your team's power!

Collect Badges & Props to Perfect Your Team

Acquire badges and scene props with various effects to optimize your hero squad!

Lightweight Leisure Gaming, Tailored for Office Workers

Specially designed for busy professionals, featuring core functions like screen resizing, interface scaling, one-click interface hiding, and instant game window concealment.

Core Gameplay

- 6 heroes, 24+ advanced classes, level cap of 2000

- Battle tiles for auto-farming, work tiles for idle gold earning

- Hundreds of equipment pieces and cards for team building

- Decoration system, desktop pet

- Transparent window design, one-click hide to system tray

Equipment & Badge Enhancement

Equipment can be enhanced to raise its level, with different quality tiers offering different enhancement caps. The badge system provides additional stat bonuses with enhancement up to +100 levels. Soul Badges are a separate advanced badge line with their own progression curve and visual glow effects.

Awakening System

All 6 heroes can Awaken into ultimate classes with new combat mechanics and skills. Each Awakened class plays differently.

Endless Defense

Tower-defense style wave combat. Build-craft with the affix system. Each hero has a dedicated defense talent tree.

Paragon Talents

Endgame progression system unlocked after all heroes are Awakened. Hexagonal talent board with a shared talent point pool.

Artifact System

12 Zodiac constellation artifacts, each with unique combat effects. They drop naturally over time and are displayed in your Artifact Cabinet.

Forge Temple

20+ difficulty tiers of challenge dungeons. Enemies have Demonic Shields that must be shattered. Choose heroes for training, collect materials, and craft Mythical Equipment with random stat affixes.

Auto Challenge

Hands-free stage progression with main-story-only mode, automatic work-for-gold switching, and auto-harvest.

Builds & Synergies

Awakened classes, cards, defense affixes, talents, and artifacts can combine in interesting ways. For example:

- Awakened Archer with talents and the Sagittarius artifact, multi-shot melting enemies

- Awakened Priest with passives and Paragon talents to wipe the entire screen

- Awakened Guardian stacking reflect and shields — the more enemies hit you, the stronger you get

- Awakened Warrior burning HP with lifesteal, getting deadlier the closer to death

- Awakened Dancer stacking evasion to 100% for permanent invincibility, grouping enemies and detonating them all at once

Different build paths lead to different combat experiences — worth experimenting with.

Major Updates Since Launch

- Endless Defense mode and Defense Talents

- All 6 Class Awakenings

- Paragon Talent system

- 12 Zodiac Artifact system

- Forge Temple and Mythical Equipment

- Dragon Continent (Elemental Dragon hatching, dragon pet training, elemental attribute system)

- Auto Challenge system

- Soul Badges and equipment enhancement system

- Transmog system (free appearance switching)

- Decoration building system

- Save management and auto-backup

- More updates in progress

games.name: A Simple job
games.shortDescription: 💼 A simple task: Don’t press the red button. Sounds easy? 😏 Featuring an annoying voice, absurd endings, and too many achievements. Free. Pointless. Glorious. 🤡🔴
games.aboutText:
🔴 A Simple Job – A game that slowly drives you insane... for free! 🌀

Welcome to your new dream job! Your task? Super simple:
Just don’t press the red button.

Sounds easy, right? 😇 Well... it would be if it weren’t for that annoying voice constantly yapping in your ear.
Imagine Clippy from the 2000s had too much coffee, a podcast mic, and zero chill. 🎤😵

Explore the many ridiculous ways this “simple” game can end — there are more endings than you’ll have reasons to distrust that button. 💣

🏆 Features:

🔴 One (suspiciously good-looking) red button that can ruin everything
🧠 Multiple endings, ranging from “meh” to “WHAT JUST HAPPENED?!”
🥇 A small but mighty list of achievements — more coming if people like it!
😵 A narrator voice you’ll regret meeting (and it regrets you too)
💸 100% free (because even we know this got out of hand)

So... do you accept the job?
🔕 Don’t press the button.
🔔 Or... maybe do? 👀
(And if you like it, we’ll make it even worse. Promise.) 😈

games.name: Explosiovania
games.shortDescription: Rocket-jump using exploding fireballs, unlock abilities and master an ever-growing movement system. Explore the non-linear corners of the underworld, find secrets, defeat demons and reclaim the Eye of Evil.
games.aboutText:
Rocket-jump using explosive fireballs, unlock abilities and master an ever-growing movement system. After descending into a broken underworld, you must learn to traverse Satan Hill. Explore the non-linear corners of the underworld, find secrets, defeat demons and reclaim the Eye of Evil.

Featuring

- 12 zones

- 24 abilities

- 43 secret items

- 9 golden keys

Master movement

- Master the deep, interconnected movement system

- Discover how abilities interact with each other in surprising ways

- Traverse the world the way you like, using precision, momentum and creativity

Explore

- Unlock abilities that open new routes and shortcuts

- Nonlinear -- explore and collect items in whatever order you choose

- Follow the intended path... (if you feel like it)

games.name: Pippa and Your Phantasmal Problem
games.shortDescription: Find out who's been messing up your home with this troublesome witch!
games.aboutText:
★ Story

Ms Ester's beautiful and neat house has been mysteriously wrecked in the past few weeks and nobody knows why. Patches of dirt on the carpet, things gone missing, and all sorts of mess keeps happening around the house. The police was called to investigate, a priest was invited to bless the house, and a group of ghostbusters was hired (they were so expensive!) and none of them found anything. How useless!

If this problem isn't solved by the time Ms Ester returns from her short trip, she'll kick you out. You have to find someone who can help: anyone will do, even this unreliable looking, self-proclaimed witch you just randomly met.

" Pippa is going to save the day! Hehehe~ "

★ Features

- Around 15,000 words in total.

- 3 endings: 1 bad ending and 2 good endings.

- Choose what to feed Pippa: the food chosen affects Pippa's magical energy, which will influence the story.

- Cute character art and cute soundtracks.

- Cute dogs!

★ Credits

- story, art, programming: Konayachi

- soundtrack composer: Dalton Attig (special thanks to Bristol!)

- proofreaders: S.B.Hunter, ebi-hime, Wan-chan

- misc. programming help: an anonymous family member

- sfx: freesfx, pixabay

- background art references: pxhere, minikle

- tools: ActionEditor3, guiManipulate

- other software: Krita, VSCodium

- engine: Ren'Py

This VN is made in a month for Spooktober Visual Novel Jam 2024!

games.name: ORMS
games.shortDescription: An atmospheric narrative puzzle-adventure set on a surreal Nordic island. Guide young Sam and his companion Kira through two shifting realities - switching between a world of terrifying shadows and a world of light to solve puzzles and reignite the broken lighthouse
games.aboutText:
A soul-searching adventure through fear and courage, light and shadow

Welcome to ORMS, a mysterious narrative puzzle game where two children navigate the dual realities of light and shadow. Set on a surreal Nordic island steeped in forgotten memories and ancient myth, you’ll guide young Sam and his fearless companion Kira through handcrafted landscapes, atmospheric challenges, and emotional moments.

Inspired by Inside, Little Nightmares II, and Machinarium, ORMS blends layered puzzle mechanics with emotionally resonant storytelling in a world shaped by childhood fears and hope.

About the Game

You play as Sam, a quiet 8-year-old boy lost on the island of Orms, a dreamlike place shaped by his fears and fractured memories. Accompanied by courageous Kira, you must explore the island, uncover its secrets, and bring light back to the darkened lighthouse, a symbolic beacon for reconnection and healing.

Through seamless transitions between two perspectives, you’ll discover how fear and courage intertwine, and how trust can illuminate even the darkest paths.

Features

Switch Between Realities

Experience the world through two distinct lenses: Sam’s shadowy, distorted version and Kira’s calm, grounded reality. Use their differences to unlock paths, reveal secrets, and solve intricate environmental puzzles.

Solve Emotional Puzzles

Navigate surreal challenges crafted around fears like abandonment, the dark, and conflict. Each level embodies a specific fear, culminating in a symbolic confrontation and emotional growth.

Explore a Living, Handcrafted World

Inspired by Estonian nature and Nordic folklore, each area pulses with symbolic meaning - underground bunkers, sacred forests, and ancient graveyards become metaphors for inner healing.

Emotion-First Game Design

More than just a puzzle game, ORMS is a meditative, story-rich experience that resonates with players of all ages. Whether you’re uncovering lost childhood emotions or simply exploring a beautiful world, ORMS invites you to slow down, reflect, and connect.

Enter Memory Worlds

Dive into distorted, first-person memory sequences through seamless infinite zoom transitions. Reframe traumatic past experiences by stabilizing Sam’s memories with Kira’s guidance.

A Central Hub of Healing

The Prime Well connects all levels. Completing each area gradually restores power to the island's broken lighthouse, symbolizing emotional recovery and connection.

A Journey for the Heart

This is a story about fear, memory, and the courage to face the things we hide from.

games.name: Pact, Passion, Puchimon!
games.shortDescription: Journey across a continent teeming with diverse monsters! Capture them through intense bullet-hell battles and grow stronger together. With an in-depth nurturing system, you can build bonds with your "Puchimon" to unlock exclusive storylines and turn them into your ultimate battle partners!
games.aboutText:
These lands are home to all kinds of monsters. What looks like a harmless, pitiful creature just might unleash a brain-blasting barrage of bullets. Stay on your toes...or die! Fortunately, you possess a unique ability—you can capture any monster and have them fight for you! Each monster has its own distinctive shooting style. Make good use of their abilities and adapt on the fly to gain the upper hand on the battlefield.

There are a total of 12 puchimon that can transform into stunning humanoid forms. Build bonds with them and unlock a variety of exclusive, amazing events!

Moraphina

The omniscient, omnipotent mother goddess of the puchimon, she has existed for thousands of years. Her magic is awe-inspiring—she can freely wield the powers of various puchimon, and she also has...godlike titties.

Mimosa

Flower spirits are known to be a fragile race, yet Mimosa possesses formidable magical power. Despite this gift, she is perpetually haunted by self-doubt.

In your presence, she shyly conceals her intense emotions and primal desires. To preserve her purity, she has chosen a life of abstinence, struggling to suppress the yearning that burns deep within her soul.

Camerys

With a fickle and ever-changing personality, Camerys loves to stay in control. Driven by a powerful urge to dominate, she is the embodiment of a pure hedonist.

She unashamedly unleashes her desires in every possible way. Far from seeing you as her master, she believes the reality is quite the opposite—you are the one under her thumb.

Yurin

A Puchimon dwelling in an ancient underground fortress, Yurin commands formidable magical power. At its peak, her influence can reach the surface, plunging the world into a cataclysmic ice age.

Due to her frigid exterior and overwhelming strength, both humans and Puchimon alike keep a respectful distance. In reality, she is merely a lonely, innocent girl who yearns for companionship.

Sif

Driven by a powerful protective instinct, Sif views the care of all aquatic life as her sacred duty, the very embodiment of a compassionate mother.

While she is gracious toward all creatures, she harbors a deep-seated hatred for humanity, plotting her revenge by any means necessary. However, consumed by her own obsession, she has unwittingly become the very source of the calamity plaguing the oceans.

Silothia

A spider Puchimon who's initially friendly attitude made it seem she was just another motherly puchimon, but the truth is she needs a man's essence to reproduce. In truth, she relies on men’s essence for reproductive energy.

She stops at nothing to seduce the protagonist, constantly claiming her previous husband has died, though her story of how he died changes every single time...

Silatie

Silatie belongs to a species of beings that have existed in the ocean for eons. She is highly intelligent and in possession of much lost knowledge.

She deals with the protagonist using unwavering reason and rationality. Therefore, they have established a contract for "sharing magical power and relieving sexual desire."

Silatie also secretes a special slick slime that serves as a highly effective lubricant.

Embark on a journey to discover more Puchimon hidden across the continent!

Long ago, humanity used the power of lustan to restrain monster babes endowed with immense power, and were thereby able to live in peaceful coexistence with them for hundreds of years.

However, for reasons unknown, humans gradually lost the ability to wield lustan. The monster babes fell into a state of chaos and began attacking humans, leading to the collapse of civilization.

You are an ordinary young man living in the declining kingdom of Solowon. One day, fate would have it that you accidentally awaken the long-lost power of lustan, allowing you to subdue the dangerous monster babes.

To avoid being drained of your essence, you are forced to strike back against the swarms, and must actively explore the four major regions of the land. Capture monster babes, form contracts with them, and search for a way to stop the chaos.

●Get ready to capture 25 types of puchimon with over 50 different visual variations. Each puchimon has its own unique attack style!

●A total of 12 puchimon can evolve into sexy, seductive humanoid forms. Grow closer with your monster babes and unlock a wide range of spicy events!

●Over 70 pieces of gear that can be freely mixed and matched. Combine to create a shooting style that's uniquely yours!

●Explore ever-changing labryinths—every adventure is a brand-new experience!

games.name: Cyan Heart
games.shortDescription: A psychological horror adventure experienced through a "selfie-cam" perspective. Contradictions in the timeline, subtle anomalies in the footage—every detail holds the key to the truth. Reconstruct her fragmented records, and uncover what was truly left behind.
games.aboutText:
Cyan Heart is a unique “selfie-perspective” horror exploration puzzle adventure.
Guiding a girl who keeps filming herself, you’ll solve puzzles, avoid hazards, and lead her to her goal with the distinctive challenge of having no direct view of the path ahead—checking behind and below her only through the camera’s screen.

A World Dyed Cyan

Life in this world once relied on a peculiar energy called the Magenta Heart —a power that could eternally mimic any physical phenomenon.
Mimic the heat of a flame, and it would become a heat source that burned forever at a constant temperature.
Mimic a heavy blow, and it would turn into a rock drill that never stopped working.

But one day, this energy transformed into a cyan hue.
Known thereafter as “Cyan” , it remained functional yet unstable, and became a dangerous force that turned any tangible object into cyan matter.
Its influence warped both machines and living beings alike.

To the Depths of an Abandoned Facility

Rumors speak of something hidden within a facility that could halt Cyan’s spread.
Alone, the girl sets foot inside.
Due to Cyan’s “eternal” property, the seemingly deserted facility still behaves as if its long-gone occupants remain.
You must guide her through the camera, avoiding—or at times exploiting—Cyan’s mimicked phenomena, to retrieve the mysterious object said to lie at the very end.

The Recording Device "CSZ8x2"

The girl’s multi-functional camera, CSZ8x2 , can record video, enable voice communication, and log data.
Pointing the camera at objects allows her to examine them or access machinery.
Hints can be received through voice transmissions from her companions.
Sometimes, looking up or down with the camera will be crucial.

Why is the girl exploring alone?
What is this thing she seeks?
And what is the true nature of Cyan?
You will discover the answers through the lens she holds.

＿＿＿＿＿＿Witness the record she wished to leave behind.

----------------------------------------------------------------
Streaming & Content Creation Guidelines

Streaming, recording, and monetization are 100% allowed without restrictions. A link to this Steam page in your description is greatly appreciated!
----------------------------------------------------------------

games.name: The Great Hatch
games.shortDescription: Help goblins take down a giant floating egg
games.aboutText:
Egg appears in the goblin camp. Naturally, the goblins decide it must be destroyed! Harvest it to gain resources, upgrade your town and get strong enough to take it down!

It's big. It's mysterious. They must break it!

Recruit goblins, assign their roles and combine their unique skills.

Get Rich

Grow your economy by collecting different type of eggs.

Upgrade

Goblins are not very smart. Boost their productivity, upgrade their abilities and unlock new units and mechanics

Prestige - Meta progression

Do it again! Customize your future runs with unique abilities.

games.name: Neon Dystopia
games.shortDescription: Raid the underbelly of Neon Dystopia with your crew. Grab all the loot and extract! Or die and lose it all... A co-op synthwave/cyberpunk extraction roguelike.
games.aboutText:
Drop into a cyberpunk city that wants you dead. Bring your friends, grab everything you can carry, and get out alive... or leave it all down there.

Bring everyone

No 4-player cap. Cram as many friends into a run as you want. The more of you there are, the harder the city comes at you.

Every grab is a gamble

The good stuff is always a little deeper in. Push your luck or bail? Die before you reach the exit and you walk away with nothing.

Your hideout between runs

No dropping back to a menu. You land in a shared hub where the crew crafts, gears up and plans the next run. Whatever you extracted is safe here. The rest? Tough luck.

It all ends up on the workbench

Weapons, mods, scrap, you grab all of it. Haul it to the workbench to upgrade your gear and prep your next run. The weapon pool grows with every patch, and the community votes on it.

Never the same run twice

Every run, the city reshuffles: rooms move, traps change, and the way out is never the same. From neon-soaked streets to filthy factory floors, every biome has its own way of killing you.

Pixel art and synthwave

Hand-crafted pixel art, neon cranked all the way up, a synthwave soundtrack that slaps. Best played in the dark.

Made by a small indie team. Backed by its community.

Neon Dystopia is built in the open. Weapon balance polls, build votes, public roadmaps and demos shaped by the people playing them. We test, you break it, we patch, repeat. If you want a roguelike that grows with its players, you're in the right place.

Add it to your wishlist

Wishlist Neon Dystopia to keep up with demo updates and release. Try the demo, bring your crew, and see how far you can get.

games.name: Life, the Universe, and Restaurants
games.shortDescription: Run a restaurant in a bizarre universe and cook for customers who call themselves "gods"! Expand your restaurant, deploy robots, and automate your kitchen. Keep business booming—and be ready to deal with any unruly customers.
games.aboutText:
Open your restaurant for business in the vast reaches of space, take orders, and prepare every dish by hand! Gather ingredients, prep and process them, plate each dish, and serve it—all while racing between the kitchen and Customer Tables to keep up with an ever-growing stream of orders.

Too much for one person to handle? Leave the work to all kinds of robots! Record your cooking routine, and your robots will repeat it endlessly. They can take orders, cook, serve dishes, transport Coins, and clean up.

Unlock higher-tier Recipes with increasingly complex preparation steps, then arrange multiple Cooking Robots to work together in sequence. Transform a frantic little kitchen into the most efficient automated production line in the cosmos!

Your goal is to complete the business objectives at each stage and upgrade your restaurant from 1 Star all the way to 5 Stars.

Earn Coins, unlock Recipes, purchase new cookware, and acquire new plots to expand your restaurant. Build more Customer Tables and production facilities, and hire additional robot staff. As your restaurant’s Star Rating increases, you'll unlock more purchasable plots, Recipes, structures, robots, ads, talents, and management systems.

As your kitchen grows, your dishes will become more complex—and your customers' demands will become increasingly outrageous. Keep purchasing new plots and expanding your restaurant. Refine your layout, optimize traffic flow, increase production capacity, and take on each Star Upgrade objective. Turn your humble little restaurant into a luxurious, highly efficient 5-Star establishment!

Running a successful restaurant takes more than knowing how to cook. You'll also need a sharp mind for business.

Use different ads to increase the profits from specific dishes—or even reshape your entire business strategy. Build Posters to make customers more likely to order particular dishes, or use TVs to steer them toward a carefully selected menu. Guide your business in exactly the direction you want.

Create your own business build around dish prices, order rates, serving speed, and automation efficiency. Promote the same dish day after day, rotate your menu, specialize in Veggie Dishes or Meat Dishes, and use queue length, your current Coin balance, or even "special events" to keep pushing prices higher. Find your own winning strategy and watch your daily revenue climb!

The customer is always right? Well, the customers here really are "gods"—but keeping every last one of them happy isn't necessarily the best way to run your restaurant!

Trash Bins, lighting, and other unusual methods can all drain your customers' patience. Once they completely lose patience, they'll fly into a rage and become impossible to reason with... which is exactly what you want!

Under the Cosmic Regulatory Bureau's "self-defense" provisions, you may legally kill unruly customers and harvest their valuable Brains.

Use the Brains of these "gods" to upgrade talents and unlock more powerful brain-based robots. Then deploy Turret Robots, Guards, and other Defense Facilities to protect your restaurant. After all, in this bizarre universe, it was never going to be just about cooking...

games.name: Fourmiworld
games.shortDescription: Carve your own path through Fourmiworld - an "open-world-ant-farm-metroidvania". Play as an interdimensional urban explorer girl, collect Gamut to unlock new abilities, and discover the sights, plights, & soundbites of a surreal alien dimension.
games.aboutText:
"In times of boredom, there's only one logical thing to do...

...travel to another dimension, recreationally!"

- A. Wandereye (probably)

Fourmiworld

Fourmiworld is a free game all about exploring a strange world orbiting a dying star. Along the way you'll discover the remains of a lost civilization, encounter bizarre creatures, unlock tools to aid your expedition, and more.

If you'd like to support us, consider checking out the Wandereye's Writings DLC . It isn't necessary, but we recommend it if you want the definitive Fourmiworld experience.

Should you play?

If you enjoy at least 7 of the following points , we think you'll really click with Fourmiworld :

- Games with destructible environments and secrets to discover.​

- Open-world exploration and nonlinear progression.

- Insects , bugs and Sci-Fi ecosystems.

- Piecing together the history of a long-gone alien race.

- Atypical artstyles , collage, girls with flowers for eyes.

- Growing stronger and gaining abilities to better navigate your environment.

- Games that don't hold your hand and just let you figure things out.

- Atmospheric , ambient music that adapts to where you are.

- Personalized experiences, seeing things other players will not see.

- The word "Frondosity" invokes a certain joy in you.

Inspirations

These games inspired us a lot during development. We think you should give the game a try if you enjoy at least two of these:

Metroid - Game-altering upgrades & lonesome alien atmosphere.

Terraria - Digging anywhere & obtaining resources to get new abilities.

Hylics - Surrealistic stylization & unconventional vibe.

Yume Nikki - Exploring exactly how you want to & seeing weird/cool/scary things.

Starseed Pilgrim - Lack of hand-holding & tile interaction aspects.

games.name: Tower Tactics II
games.shortDescription: The fusion of deck-building roguelike and tower defense returns, bigger than ever! Build your deck with powerful new cards, unlock unique trinkets, and deploy enhanced towers to overcome relentless waves of enemies and new strategic challenges.
games.aboutText:
Tower Tactics II, the fusion of deck-building roguelike and tower defense returns, bigger than ever! Build your deck with powerful new cards, unlock mythical powers, and deploy an ungodly amount of creative towers to overcome new strategic challenges and relentless waves of enemies.

Tower Tactics II enters Early Access already bigger than its predecessor, with a massive amount of content to master:

- 5 playable characters with unique card pools and gameplay strategies

- 10 Ascension levels to conquer

- 190+ tower and spell cards

- 150 trinkets to shape your builds and give every run a unique spin

- 15 story quests

- 100+ hours of gameplay

- 4 additional game modes: Survival, Maze Builder, Sandbox, and Crystal Mines

- Steam Workshop integration

- Full controller and Steam Deck support

No plan survives every wave. Face the relentless Sal'koth and stop them from turning the universe into a cold, dark void. Build your defenses around an arsenal of towers, spells, then adapt your strategy as new threats emerge.

Deploy Hero Cards , make use of powerful relics , and turn status effects like Burn, Poison, and Frail to your advantage. Face new combat types, golden elite enemies, and challenging encounters that force you to rethink your strategy from one wave to the next.

Every run starts before the first card is drawn.

Customize your loadout with different starting Hero Cards and trinkets to shape your strategy. Between runs, return to the Sanctuary and place Offerings to expand your options and prepare for the challenges ahead.

We will continue to grow with new cards, enemies, tiles, decks, game modes, maps, trinkets, and more.

Your feedback is key to making Tower Tactics 2 even better, which is why we're launching in Early Access! Join the conversation, share your ideas, and help shape the future of the game on the Steam Forums and the official Discord server !

games.name: Mushroom Clicker
games.shortDescription: An Idle Incremental Clicker game with cosy magical vibes. You are the newest Mushroom Wizard Initiate 🧙‍♂️ Cast spells 🪄 harvest mushrooms 🍄 and level up to become more powerful! Hire little creatures 🐿️ to help you harvest and unlock different types of shrooms and skills!
games.aboutText:
Collect different kinds of Mushrooms all based on real-life Mushrooms you may find in the wild!

You are the newest Mushroom Wizard Initiate!

Hand in your Mushrooms to Archmage Psilocybe to earn XP and level up!

You can hire little creatures of the forest to harvest your Mushrooms for you, so you don't have to do anything except sit back, relax, and watch that number go up!

As you level up, spend your skill points on lots of different skills and spells to customize your playthrough, find crazy synergies and make that number go up even faster!

games.name: Pocket Gecko
games.shortDescription: A cute gecko lives on your screen! Capture bugs, keep them for special bonuses or sell them to buy upgrades and customize your gecko. Watch it wiggle while you work or play!
games.aboutText:
Help your adorable gecko catch bugs

Unlock 4 unique islands, with over 80 different bugs to collect!

Sell the bugs to buy upgrade

To catch rarer bugs with ease

Or keep some of them for special bonuses

That make catching rare bugs even easier

Customize the gecko to match your personality

And watch the islands grow as you collect more bugs

Interact with your gecko, anytime

games.name: Game Saloon Simulator
games.shortDescription: Step into the world of fun and become the boss of your own game saloon! In this game, you’ll serve customers, enjoy interactive games, and get a taste of the relaxing and enjoyable experience that awaits you.
games.aboutText:
Game Saloon Simulator invites you to become the boss of your own entertainment hall!
Are you ready to turn a small bar into a giant gaming complex?

In this game, you will serve customers their orders and manage a wide variety of arcade machines. By purchasing and placing classic arcade machines, you can increase your saloon’s appeal and expand your venue by unlocking new areas.

But that’s not all — just like your customers, you can also enjoy the games! Grow your business while having fun in your own game saloon.

Key Features:

- Expandable saloon system

- Interactive entertainment equipment

- Service mechanics that increase customer satisfaction

- Freedom to design your own play area

- Relaxing, humorous, and enjoyable simulation experience

Build the "Game Saloon" you’ve always dreamed of — manage it and have fun!

games.name: Gothic Scythe
games.shortDescription: 敵の猛攻を掻い潜り、撃破していく高難易度アクション。大鎌使いとなりホムンクルスに支配された街を取り戻しましょう。
games.aboutText:
Please note that the English translation is a machine translation and is not supported.

Gothic Scythe はオーソドックスな高難易度アクションゲームです。

敵の猛攻を掻い潜り、エリア最奥で待ち構えるボスを撃破しましょう。

《計7ステージ》

マップは移動・戦闘のシンプルな構成になっており、約1時間～2時間でクリアできるボリュームとなっております。

games.name: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster
games.shortDescription: Play a sneaky, ruthless Skaven assassin and slay your way up the ranks of the ratmen in this grim and dark new 2D stealth-action platformer. Escape. Kill. Ascend. Become a Deathmaster.
games.aboutText:
Explore the unsettled realms of the Warhammer Age of Sigmar through the eyes of Vihneek, a Skaven assassin of the Clans Eshin .

In the tunnels and lairs of Skavendom, stealth is not only about hiding . It is about control, observation, and ruthless, grisly violence.

You are no hero, and life is cheap in the disturbed world of the ratmen.

Descend into the fractured depths of the Gnaw and the paranoid underworld of the Skaven .

Navigate shifting tunnels , hostile clans , and environments shaped by corruption and warpstone instability .

Each clan territory brings its own rules , threats , and behavioural patterns . Learn. Observe. Exploit openings. Or die unnoticed.

Feel the precision , speed , and deadly efficiency of an Eshin assassin with simple, intuitive controls inspired by masters of the 2D stealth-action platform genre.

Use heightened senses based on smell and hearing and devious strategies based on the Skaven's unique nature to eliminate your prey

Stand out from the swarm and rise through the ranks by honing your skills and upgrading your gear . Gather warpstones to unlock deadly abilities and secret tools that unveil new, unpredictable ways to hunt your prey.

Experiment with unique gameplay strategies shaped by the Skaven’s instincts & cunning behaviour to dominate your enemies. Develop new abilities specific to the clans you infiltrate.

Only one in a thousand ratmen will achieve greatness. Make sure it's you.

Accomplish deadly commands from Clan Skrell elites to climb the hierarchy . The more you kill, the closer you get to becoming the most feared and respected assassin: the ultimate Deathmaster .

And if it happens to please the Great Horned Rat, all the better…

But in a deeply conniving faction, every rise comes with consequences and no ascent is ever without a price.

Escape, Kill, Ascend and Become a Deathmaster.

games.name: The Ratline
games.shortDescription: A murdered priest. A secret list. Hunt Nazi fugitives across the globe in this gritty 1971 detective thriller. Analyze evidence, follow leads, and make sharp deductions before the trail goes cold. From the creators of Family, Rivals, Conspiracy, Echo Beach and Riley & Rochelle.
games.aboutText:
Quotes

"I loved every minute of the demo"
Lucas Pope , Return of the Obra Dinn

"Delivers layers of clever puzzles and satisfying reveals all the way through to the end"

Jeremy Johnston , The Roottrees are Dead

“Roottrees fans will really enjoy sleuthing in The Ratline”
EvilTrout , The Roottrees are Dead .

“If you love the Golden Idol games, you'll love the Ratline”
Will Ackerman , Lead Designer, Rise of the Golden Idol .

Note on Compatibility

The Ratline is not optimised for Steamdeck. Please use Mouse and Keyboard for optimal experience.

Summary

1971. A dead priest. A list of Nazi fugitives. The hunt begins.

When a Catholic priest is found murdered in Budapest, a secret list is discovered —names of Nazi war criminals who escaped justice through a covert network known as The Ratline . Now, the case is yours.

In this gritty detective thriller set in 1971, you play an investigator chasing shadows across continents. Use your wits, intuition, and network of contacts to follow leads, dig through documents, and piece together the truth.

You will:

- Examine documents, photographs, and recovered artifacts

- Make independent deductions with no hand-holding

- Act like a proper sleuth , working contacts and shaking down sources from Rome to Buenos Aires

- Hunt down your marks - put together their identities, check your work and bring them to justice.

Made by Owlskip , the studio behind acclaimed narrative detective games Family , Rivals , Conspiracy , Echo Beach , Life & Crimes , and Riley and Rochelle .

The war may be over—but the reckoning has just begun.

The Ratline

games.name: Street Dog Legend
games.shortDescription: STREET DOG LEGEND is a flash-game inspired cooking simulator with a satirical storyline and multiple endings. Manage your street cart, meet interesting characters, play minigames, and more!
games.aboutText:
Welcome to New Frankfurt, big dog! In STREET DOG LEGEND, you can manage your very own hot dog cart! But like it or not, something strange is brewing in the city... and you may stumble right into the middle of it.

Features:

- Art style inspired by flash games from the 2000s

- Manage the street cart your way: Buy upgrades, set up shop at busier locations, and franchise to maximize cash; or just keep things simple - it's up to you!

- Make life-or-death decisions in a city-wide conflict between the government and its... er... "adversaries."

- Discover secrets, play minigames on your laptop, and forge your own path as a street dog legend!

A classic cooking simulator

Nothing beats a day slinging dogs. Fast and high-quality orders served to customers will earn you LOTS of money and - more importantly - fill that empty hole in your heart.

Explore New Frankfurt

At your apartment, spend your hard-earned cash on cart upgrades and location permits so you can discover new locations and make even MORE money!

Respect the powers that be (or not)

Unfortunately, you're not the ultimate authority on hot dogs. Manage the expectations of city officials (and other interested parties), cooperate or disobey, and choose your own path.

Become legend

All things must come to an end, and you can decide how. Will you be forgotten just like any other average joe, or will you go down in history as a legend? Which path will you choose?

games.name: Necrofane
games.shortDescription: A dark power is rising. Defeat the necromancer and his generals before they conquer the kingdom. In this old school dark fantasy RPG, explore cursed dungeons, battle monstrous foes, master forbidden magic, and gather powerful loot in a world teetering on the edge of ruin.
games.aboutText:
Necrofane is a dark fantasy dungeon crawler RPG set in a crumbling kingdom on the brink of ruin. Chosen by the crown in its darkest hour, you are a legendary knight tasked with stopping a necromancer who seeks to plunge the world into shadow.

Traverse a cursed land overrun by the undead, monstrous beasts, and the necromancer’s ruthless generals. Explore forgotten fortresses, ancient crypts, and decaying ruins to uncover legendary loot, unlock arcane powers, and become strong enough to challenge the necromancer himself.

Will you rise as the kingdom's savior or become another corpse in the necromancer's army?

Key Features

- Online Co-op – Team up online with 2–4 players and tackle dungeons, bosses, and quests together.

- Open World Exploration – Traverse a dark, interconnected kingdom full of secrets, ruins, and monstrous threats.

- Classic Dungeon Crawling – Descend into handcrafted dungeons teeming with traps, treasures, and nightmarish foes.

- Old-School RPG Mechanics – Level up your character, improve your stats, and customize your combat style.

- Magic & Melee Combat – Wield devastating spells or strike down foes with steel in fast-paced, deadly encounters.

- Loot & Upgrades – Discover rare weapons, armor, and artifacts to upgrade and enhance your power.

- Epic Boss Fights – Face off against the necromancer’s deadly generals, each guarding key regions of the kingdom.

- Deep Lore & NPCs – Meet strange allies and enemies alike in a world full of history, sorrow, and dark mystery.

games.name: Star Squadron
games.shortDescription: Star Squadron is a narrative-driven space combat simulator built for maximum immersion. Command your wing with freeform voice recognition and experience a dynamic campaign that calls you by name using our proprietary Voice Mimic System. Don't just play the game—live it.
games.aboutText:
We encountered the Garudans at the edge of known space.

A highly advanced xenophobic avian race, the Garudans consider humanity's polluting ways an abomination. Perhaps they have a point… but we have no choice but to fight against them for our survival.

Star Squadron is an immersive, narrative-driven space combat simulator that thrusts you onto the front lines of a brutal interstellar war. Brief with your commander. Fly intense combat missions. Afterwards, celebrate or commiserate with your fellow pilots in the rec room. Your choices, your flying, and your victories—or failures—will shape the face of the war. What will your story be?

KEY FEATURES

NEXT-GEN VOICE COMMAND SYSTEM

Communicate with your wingmen through natural language voice input. No keywords or hotkeys to memorize, just speak naturally and your squadron will understand and react.

PERSONALIZED DIALOGUE

Star Squadron incorporates your name and stats into fully voiced conversations. Our proprietary Voice Mimic System seamlessly integrates dynamic details into pre-recorded dialogue, immersing you in the game like never before.

A TRULY BRANCHING 40-MISSION CAMPAIGN

Shape the course of a massive war spanning a dozen star systems. In Star Squadron , there is no "Game Over" screen for failing an objective—the narrative dynamically adapts to your wins and losses, changing the fate of the galaxy.

SEAMLESS CARRIER-TO-COMBAT IMMERSION

From carrier life to space combat and back, Star Squadron presents a continuous seamless experience, with no cutaways, transitions or loading screens.

LIVING, BREATHING WINGMEN

Your squadmates aren't faceless AI drones. They are distinct characters with unique personalities and dynamic flying styles. Share a drink with them in the rec room, learn their quirks, and watch their backs in the void.

A DIVERSE, LETHAL FLEET

Take the stick of a wide array of spacecraft, from nimble, high-speed interceptors to heavy-hitting, armored bombers, each tailored for specific tactical operations.

THE HAUNTING BEAUTY OF DEEP SPACE

Dogfight through stunning cosmic environments, from soaring above vibrant ocean worlds and weaving through dense asteroid fields, to losing your sensors in choking nebulae and battling in the shadow of massive gas giants.

What will your story be? Join the fight and find out. Enlist in Star Squadron today.

games.name: Pawsome Resort
games.shortDescription: Pawsome Resort is a cozy life sim where you run an animal hotel in a charming pixel-art village. Design your resort, care for cute animals, grow crops, craft things, complete quests, and bond with villagers. With farming and RPG elements, it's a perfect cozy escape.
games.aboutText:
• Run your dream animal hotel in a cozy pixel-art world!

• In this top-down farming RPG, you’ll care for adorable animals, grow crops, craft items, and expand your resort. From cats to crocodiles, every guest is unique!

• Meet and interact with quirky villagers, build friendships, and uncover charming stories as you discover the Pebble Town!

Game Features:

• Customize your office and build spacious outdoor habitats for animals of all kinds. Design the perfect resort just the way you want.

• Feed, love, and care for a wide range of animals, from fluffy cats to exotic wild ones. Keep them happy and healthy during their stay at your animal hotel!

• Strange events are affecting the village, and it’s up to you to uncover the truth. Complete quests, meet mysterious characters, and restore harmony as the story unfolds.

• Get to know the charming residents of Pebble Town, each with their own stories, quirks, and secrets. Strengthen your bonds through heartfelt conversations and meaningful interactions.

games.name: Dungeon Raid: Zero Floor
games.shortDescription: Dungeon Raid is an adventure card roguelike. Dive deeper and deeper into the dungeon. Use everything you find to defeat enemies and kill the final boss. Good luck! And try not to die... from hunger.
games.aboutText:
Dungeon Raid is an adventure card roguelike. Dive deeper and deeper into the dungeon. Use everything you find to defeat enemies and kill the final boss. Good luck! And try not to die... from hunger.

SPECIAL FEATURES

- A unique progression system. Find the door to the next floor and use the key to proceed. But be careful! Just one wrong decision could lead you to death. Choose your next card that will make you one step closer to victory!

- Instinct-based roguelike. Make decisions at every turn. Find useful cards and combine objects found in the chests and bought at the shop to power up your character. But beware the traps and dangerous enemies!

-There's always one more try. You'll never feel fully prepared deep down the dungeon. The game is created for replay. Every new playthrough is unique and will feel fresh even to the most experienced players. Use your instincts and your character's unique abilities to fend off the dangerous creatures that lurk deep under the earth.

- Fully compatible with all gamepads, including Steam Deck.

- Stylish 2D pixel art.

HERE'S A TASTE OF WHAT YOU GET IN THE GAME

- 6 unlockable heroes. Each with unique passive abilities and spells that allow you to change your game style with every playthrough.

- Lots of colourful and detailed cards and items to unlock.

- More than 10 unique bosses, each requiring a special approach to defeat.

- If the game feels too challenging, you can use card upgrades to make your playthrough an easier experience.

games.name: Space Savory
games.shortDescription: Not that far away, in a galaxy… A diner with questionable hygiene, bubbling with dark secrets and darker humor, in the middle of cosmic nothingness. Welcome to Space Savory. Don’t be fooled by appearances, the best flavor in the universe is cooked right here. (Only within the observable part.)
games.aboutText:
Space Savory – '' Questionable hygiene. Unquestionable flavor. ''

★★★★★

– Andromeda Times

This isn't your typical sci-fi story. A bit of science, a whole lot of fiction.

Our tale begins with an astronaut on one of Earth’s earliest space missions crash-landing on an unknown planet.
Luckily, the place has oxygen, water, and decent gravity.

The only way home? Fuel... which means money... which means customers.

Space Savory — Suspicious hygiene, questionable meat, but taste? Absolutely out of this world. ★★★★★

— @Palp-Eat-tine34

What’s on the menu?

- We cook the customers. (Yes, you read that right.)

– Each alien carries unique ingredients inside them. Essential for preparing the meals, desserts, and drinks we sell.

Collecting these ingredients isn’t easy... but don’t worry, we’ve got a cloning machine.

- Every dish and drink is crafted through its own mini-game. Based on reflexes, attention, and a bit of luck, these games let you actively prepare each recipe. From mechanical salads to ion-charged energy drinks, no dish feels the same.

- Then we serve them back... to the customers. (Seriously.)

Small note: Aliens are not vegan.

– This way, we capture customers who carry the ingredients we need and earn money for the fuel.

Showtime!

Engage with a variety of unique customers, interesting conversations, and tough decisions.

But steer clear of galactic pirates... Their sense of humor is non-existent and they only care about your money.

What’s on the side menu?

- Gamble with shady space-flies. (They usually cheat.)

- If you spot one of the galaxy’s most wanted alien criminals, call the space police!

Yes, there are cops in space. Be careful. (Between us... they do take bribes.)

- Snitch on celebrity aliens to paparazzi. (For cash, of course.)

- Fight off thief pirates trying to steal your money.

- ...and more!

So no, it’s not just about cooking.

It’s a test of ethics, an inventory management thriller, and a culinary game show...

Space Savory - The best flavor in the universe.
(But first, you’ll have to catch the customer.)

------------------------------- ---------------------------------

games.name: Voidwatch
games.shortDescription: Voidwatch is a silky-smooth space shooter roguelike. Hop from planet to planet, facing off against the Cult of the Void as you fight to free the galaxy from their clutches. Collect new weapons and powerful modifications to improve your Voidhawk Infiltrator starship & lay waste to your foes!
games.aboutText:
Cut Through the Void at the Speed of Light!

You are a member of Voidwatch, the galaxy's greatest fighting force! Traverse a vast galaxy, excising Cult influence, and pilfering upgrades and materials from their defeated legions. Dodge, drift, and dash through hordes of enemies using Voidwatch's unique movement system as you do battle around a variety of planets.

Features

- Dodge, Dash, and Drift using Voidwatch's innovative movement system.

- Upgrade your ship with over a dozen powerful modifications.

- Fight the Cult of the Void, battling 10+ enemies, and terrifying alien bosses.

- Traverse a variety of planets, each with its own deep lore.

Story

The year is 2365. The Human race has unified into one intergalactic and all-powerful government - Terra Nova - ushering in an era of relative peace and prosperity. After the discovery of the ancient extraterrestrial VOID ENERGY , Terra Novan scientists were unable to resist the potential power this energy could yield. In their experiments, the VEIL between realities was weakened, allowing primordial beings of hideous proportions to invade our reality. These VOIDBORNE GODS began capturing Terra Novan planets, snatching the minds of billions to create the mighty CULT OF THE VOID .

In a last-ditch attempt to retain humanity's freedom, VOIDWATCH was established, an elite military force tasked with eliminating the VOIDBORNE threat. Though cult-occupied planets are heavily fortified, Voidwatch has a secret weapon: the VOIDHAWK INFILTRATOR . With its void-enhanced capabilities, the Infiltrator can slip past the Cult’s orbital cannons to excise the worlds under Voidborne influence, clearing the way for the rest of the Voidwatch fleet to liberate humankind.

Humanity’s counting on you. Don’t let them down.

games.name: Plush Time
games.shortDescription: Plush Time is a 1-6 player online and local multiplayer party game where cuddly meets chaos! Customize your adorable plush, then throw down with friends or AI in a wild board game packed with ridiculous minigames guaranteed to wreck friendships and spark hilarious mayhem.
games.aboutText:
Plush Time is a 1-6 player online and local multiplayer party game where cuddly meets chaos! Customize your adorable plush, then throw down with friends or AI in a wild board game packed with ridiculous minigames guaranteed to wreck friendships and spark hilarious mayhem.

ONLINE AND LOCAL MULTIPLAYER

Play your way. Plush Time supports 1 to 6 players, whether you're online or huddled around the same screen. No matter how you play — solo, with friends, or against ruthless plush-brained AI — it’s all the same chaotic, friendship-testing fun.

MINIGAMES

From sugar-fueled scrambles to full-blown food fights, Plush Time serves up a deliciously wild variety of minigames. Fight for cake dominance in Sugar Rush , shove your way through a crowded restaurant in Tippy Waiters , hurl unwanted toppings in No More Olives , and build the tallest dessert disaster in Sundae Stackoff . Cute on the outside — pure competitive chaos on the inside.

BOARD MODE

There’s only room for one winner, and let’s be honest — it better be you. Race across unpredictable boards, collect absurd items, and use every dirty trick in the book to outplay, outwit, and out-chaos your plushy rivals on the road to victory.

SOCIAL HUB

The calm before the chaos. In the Social Hub, you can chill out, chat with other players, customize your plush, talk to quirky NPCs, or even watch YouTube videos together in the cinema room — all while waiting for that one friend who takes forever to join the game. It’s the perfect place to vibe before the chaos kicks in.

BOTS

No friends? No problem. Plush Time’s got fully functional bots with adjustable difficulty — from harmless fluff to full-blown plush assassins. Whether you're practicing solo or just pretending your friends showed up, the AI is always ready to rumble (and probably cheat a little).

DEVELOPED BY A SINGLE PERSON

Built by one very tired human. Plush Time was created entirely by a solo developer — every feature, every detail, every bug lovingly handcrafted. If something breaks, just remember: it was probably held together with coffee and determination.

games.name: Turnfall
games.shortDescription: Every step could be your last.
games.aboutText:
Every step could be your last.

Turnfall which is an arcade game, throws you into a grid-based adventure where danger lurks in every corner. Traverse trap-filled levels, dodge deadly enemies, and make split-second decisions that could mean survival — or death.

Each level is a tactical maze. Will you fight your way through or outsmart your foes and sneak past? The path is yours to choose — but there's no room for hesitation.

Weapons are your lifeline, but nothing lasts forever. Swords dull, shields break, and every hit counts. Scavenge for new gear and power-ups to stay one step ahead, because when your defenses fail, you're vulnerable.

Enemies are relentless, each with unique abilities and behavior. Some chase, others ambush — and all of them want you gone. Outsmart them with clever moves or run when things get tight. Sometimes retreat is the only way forward.

Features:
– Stylish, vibrant visuals
– Challenging, turn-based arcade gameplay
– Smart enemies with unique tactics
– Fragile gear and high-stakes choices

Test your instincts, plan every move, and survive the fall.

games.name: 暴杀残雨之夜
games.shortDescription: On a rainy night, it's all up to you whether to show love or be cruel.
games.aboutText:
- Game Introduction:

You're staying at your uncle's house as a guest, juggling high school studies and part-time work to save up some cash. At school and work, you'll meet all kinds of people: a junior who’s a bit creepy but always seems to follow you around, a senior who used to act like a prince but got demoted to your class, a really kind bookstore manager, and even a mysterious dog-person boxer. You can choose how to interact with them—be friendly, serious, or maybe even take advantage of the situation. It’s all up to you!

- Character Introduction:

Yuexiang Lihua - She’s got cat-like features and can transform pretty well. Her last name comes from her mom. Her name fits perfectly with her brother’s, especially under the moonlight in the mountains where flowers bloom. After her family faced a tragedy, she ended up living with her uncle. Right now, she’s just a regular high school student trying to make ends meet while saving for college.

(The character played by the player cannot have its name changed due to the plot requirements, but a nickname or pet name can be customized.)

- Playable Character Introductions:

Meixing Ji- He’s an orc with salamander-like abilities and can transform quite a bit. He’s a rich kid who just transferred to Orchid Middle School. His family doesn’t seem to care much about him, so he’s pretty quiet and shy. But don’t underestimate him—he’s incredibly persistent when he sets his mind on something. Once he latches onto you, it’s hard to shake him off. Kind of like morning glory vines that won’t let go unless... well, you know.

Fenghe She- He’s got snake-like qualities and can transform too. He’s like a prince at Orchid High School, super smart and doing great in school. But then he failed an important exam in his senior year and got moved down to your class. One day, you accidentally found out he has pica (yeah, eating weird stuff). Since becoming your classmate, he’s been acting extra interested in you, even writing you this strange love letter. What’s going on with him?

Yushan Jiao - She’s another orc, but she’s really good at transforming. She runs the Moonlight Bookstore and is like a big sister figure—kind and caring. But sometimes, she feels distant, like looking at a mountain through fog.

Shanye Lihua- This one’s a beastman with canine features and not much transformation ability. He’s a new boxer in the underground arena, mysterious and cold. But when you see him, you feel strangely close to him. Turns out, he’s actually your long-lost brother who was kidnapped years ago. Now, he’ll stick by you no matter what—as a lover or as a brother.

Game Type and Play Method:

This is a Yotsuba AVG visual novel. Your choices will lead to different endings, with lots of branches and twists. Every decision you make affects what happens next.

- Production Team Info:

茶斩刀制作组

- Lightning Warning: Be Alert and Take Precautions

Some choices might be selfish, dramatic, twisted, or morally questionable.

It also includes disturbing content like crime, self-harm, suicide, blood, weird stuff, and messed-up emotions. All the characters have either mental or physical issues. And there’s one female character who could become a potential love interest.

games.name: Sin Hunter
games.shortDescription: An innovative roguelike deckbuilder with a fresh card combat system and character-driven relationship stories. Become a Sin Hunter, slay the Original Sins, meet four demon girls, uncover the secrets of Hell City, and become their salvation—you are this world’s “Hope.”
games.aboutText:
Power up in the middle of battle! No need to protect your HP, worry about energy costs, or discard cards!

Deal damage to gain cards

No need to wait until the battle is over! Add the cards you want directly to your hand and play them immediately!

Exploit enemy weaknesses with your cards

Land critical hits! Disrupt enemy actions!

Play cards without spending energy — they only occupy space in your Stamina Zone

Play as many cards as you want each turn!

No hand size limit. No discarding at the end of your turn.

Plan your moves freely and decide how to approach every turn!

Build bonds with demon girls and fight alongside them!

Meet four demon girls and give them gifts to win their affection and forge lasting bonds. Bring their Support Cards into battle and hunt down the Original Sin together!

Become a stronger Sin Hunter as you continue your hunt against the Original Sin!

Complete Hell Corporation's Sin Hunter Training Program to unlock even more powerful weapons, cards, and relics, and venture into increasingly dangerous depths of the Abyss!

games.name: Seaworks: Trap Season
games.shortDescription: Seaworks: Trap Season is a hands-on crab fishing life sim set in the remote pacific northwest in the 1990s. Take fishing bounties by fax, maintain and customize your boat, brave changing weather, sort your catch and build a small life on the edge of the sea.
games.aboutText:
The fax machine spits out another bounty. The weather is turning. Your boat needs work. And somewhere out there, beneath the cold northern water, your traps are waiting.

Seaworks: Trap Season is a hands-on crab fishing life sim set on the remote pacific northwest in the 1990s. Start small, earn your fishing license, take jobs, work the waters and build a life around your boat, your cabin and the sea.

Head out when the conditions are right, place your crab traps and return later to haul in your catch and sort it. Back on land, sell them fresh or process them for better profit. Every trip earns you money, experience and the next step toward a better setup.

But the sea does not wait for you. Weather changes the water. Waves affect your trips. Your stamina is limited, and your boat needs care. Barnacles slow you down and burn more fuel. Repairs, maintenance and smart timing matter just as much as a full trap.

Between jobs, improve your home, customize your boat, repair useful island structures and prepare for the next season. With a randomized world, shifting conditions and different bounties, every run brings a new route through island life.

This is not a story about getting rich overnight. It is about work, weather, routine and the small satisfaction of doing things right.

Work the trap season

Accept fishing bounties, earn your license and build your routine around crab traps, weather windows and the next faxed job.

Fish, sort and sell

Set traps, haul in your catch and sort your crabs by hand. Sell them fresh or process them to earn more from a good day’s work.

Maintain your boat

Your boat is your most important tool. Repair it, keep the hull clean, manage fuel and customize its look with your own colors.

Watch the weather

Changing weather affects the sea, the waves and your plans. Choose when to head out, when to wait and when to make it back before conditions get worse.

Build your island life

Improve your small cabins around the world, repair structures like lighthouses and turn a rough island setup into a place that works.

New islands, new seasons

A randomized world keeps each playthrough fresh, with different routes, jobs and challenges waiting across the water.

Make a living where the sea makes the rules.

games.name: Grow a Girlfriend
games.shortDescription: You accidentally grew a mushroom girl! Overcome your social anxiety to help her live her brief life to the fullest! Or don't.
games.aboutText:
You accidentally grew a mushroom girl who only lives for 3 days. Can you navigate both existential dread and a budding relationship?

Welcome to MeetnEat™

"Fungal experts have created mushrooms girls. Eat them, love them, hurt yourself with them - It's all up to you, dear consumer!"

"With a lifespan of only 3 days, they'll conveniently dry up and die before the nagging wears you down."

Mushroom Girls in Stock:

Grow Button , an upbeat and playful mushroom who is perfectly fine with you eating her! Beginner-friendly and mostly stable, expect a wholesome experience.

Or Alice , our toxic mushroom designed to prioritise your satisfaction, no matter what. Due to her genetically enhanced drive, she is only recommend to customers seeking an intense experience.

(We are not liable for mental or physical injury.)

Or Sai , a psychedelic mushroom that sees the world on a higher level, and if you eat her, you will too. Just don't peer too deep into the abyss. For customers seeking a spiritual companion.

- Go on dates and fall in love with mushroom girls, or become each other's downfall.

- Cook them into dishes like omelettes and smores, eat them, or let them rot.

- Hand holding, kissing, snuggling, sleeping, or complete abandonment.

- Guide or neglect them through various existential crises.

- Heal or damage your own mental health.

- Spray them every day so they stay nice and wet!

- Obsessive love, emotional manipulation, self-fulfilment, and more!

3 Mushrooms. 23 Endings.

Manage your mushroom's mental health and affection carefully. All characters have their unique struggles - including you! Make your story as horrific or as heart-warming as you desire!

games.name: Fracturefront
games.shortDescription: Fracturefront is a fantasy-themed third-person 3D action Roguelike. Centered on random equipment, it delivers highly variable, deeply strategic, and thrilling combat through unique character skill synergies. From barren deserts to tech planets, every rift traversal is a life-or-death gamble.
games.aboutText:
Travel across dimensions to stop the collapse of the energy core!

diving deep into corrupted realms to destroy sinister energy-draining altars and face the mastermind behind the chaos. From scorched deserts to futuristic worlds, each jump through the rift is a high-stakes battle for survival.

Time is running out. Dimensions are crumbling. Will you be the one to end this interdimensional disaster?

Rich Exploration × Thrilling Combat × Countless Equipment Combinations

Beat cute yet silly mobs → Collect energy → Explore the map (hunt for gear) → Brawl with the next wave of cute creeps!

Earn energy by defeating monsters to unlock in-map treasure chests, gain gear, boost your combat power, stop the evil Dimensional Reaper "Chaos", and restore cosmic order.

▶ Explore Multiversal Worlds

Explore perilous, distinctively styled multi-dimensional scenes, and challenge ever-evolving monsters and colossal beast-like Bosses!Traverse unique dimensional worlds: Barren Wastelands, Shadowy Forests, Frigid Mechanized Cities... Enemies of all shapes and sizes await your encounter!

- Grooving little zombies lost in the beat

- A music-obsessed chubby fellow ( Warning: Interrupt his headphones at your peril! )

- A badass biker babe roaring on her ride

- All kinds of ugly-cute and quirky little monsters

- Explore opportunities that are neither clearly good nor evil!

▶ Multiple Character Choices

The game features a variety of characters with unique mechanics and traits for you to choose from!

- Mage: Master of powerful control magic

- Baseball Player: Swing with courage and strength

- Werewolf: Unleash primal fury and bloodthirsty instincts

- Mecha Warrior (Gunner): Wield heavy firepower

- Archer: Agile, graceful, and never misses a shot

Each character boasts exclusive powerful skills and passive effects. Their skills can form clever synergies—rational combinations unlock gorgeous combos and devastating damage output!

▶ Customized Character Progression

Equipment System: The game features nearly a hundred types of various equipment awaiting your collection! Match different equipment with different classes to forge your unique build and savor the thrill of exciting loot grinding.

Collect energy core shards from diverse worlds to craft brand-new gear.

Companion System: Immense vitality lies within the damaged energy arrays. Use shards of these arrays to forge your ultimate supportive allies—Offensive "Armed Cat", Healing "Little Dragon", and Exploration Support "Huaihuai"! Take them with you to traverse the rifts, making combat and exploration a breeze.

▶ Epic Boss Fights

Face off against the Dimension Reaper, Kaos, a villain who manipulates rifts to devour entire worlds.

Multi-phase Boss Battles – Kaos summons echoes of fallen worlds and uses powerful skills like rift teleportation and energy siphoning.

games.name: Witch & Dragon: Hope of Elements
games.shortDescription: Harness elemental chains to defeat foes, collect treasures, and craft unique builds in high-risk, high-reward adventures. Witch & Dragon: Hope of Elements is a roguelike with elemental gameplay, RPG mechanics, and turn-based tactics. Join Elise and dragon Pipi on their magical journey.
games.aboutText:
Wield the elements to defeat your enemies.

Gather resources in perilous domains.

Weigh risk and reward, and retreat before it’s too late.

Combine elements and treasures to create unique builds.

Witch & Dragon: Hope of Elements is a roguelike turn-based strategy RPG built around elemental chain reactions.

Play as Elise, a witch who commands all five elements, and journey alongside the young dragon Pipi to the homeland of the True Dragons, where the truth hidden beyond the clouds awaits.

- Fire, Water, Earth, Wood, and Lightning combine to create a highly flexible elemental interaction system.

- When any two different elements come into contact, they trigger a wide variety of elemental reactions.

- Reactions behave differently depending on whether they affect objects or terrain, and different environments can lead to entirely different outcomes.

- Cast your magic and discover the limitless possibilities of elemental reactions!

- Every spell you cast can become the starting point of a chain reaction. The energy released by one elemental reaction can trigger others, spreading across the battlefield and setting off massive cascades.

- Create explosive elemental combos with a single spell and wipe out waves of enemies in one turn!

- Choose freely between safe exploration and pushing deeper into dangerous territory. Experience the full “explore, fight, retreat” adventure loop as you challenge stronger enemies and claim rarer treasures.

- Even if an expedition ends in failure—or you choose to retreat on your own—you can still bring back part of the treasure you collected and return to the Origin Ground to recover and prepare for your next run.

- Set your own pace, choose your own path, and shape your own adventure!

- After every battle, choose one treasure from a random selection to strengthen your build.

- Whether you prefer collecting treasures to create powerful long-term meta builds, or starting fresh each run and improvising your strategy on the fly, every playstyle offers its own unique rewards and strategic depth.

- Freely combine more than 200 treasures with a wide range of effects to create your own signature combat build!

- Each of the five elemental domains contains dozens of exclusive events. Even if you revisit the same area multiple times, new event content can still appear.

- As the main story progresses and your choices shape the journey, events will continue to evolve, gradually revealing the ancient secrets hidden within each realm.

- Every expedition brings you one step closer to the truth!

- Defeat enemies to collect resources and elemental seeds, then return to the Origin Ground to cultivate them and harvest rare materials.

- Use the alchemy system to combine materials into powerful potions, unlock new abilities, and craft a variety of useful items. The rarer the materials, the stronger the effects.

- Every round of cultivation and crafting will help prepare you for the challenges ahead!

The game is currently in active development, and even more content will be added before launch. If Hope of Elements interests you, feel free to join our official community to get the latest updates, share your thoughts, and send feedback directly to the development team.

games.name: 7 Jobs at the Same Time
games.shortDescription: A Point and Click work simulator where you juggle 7 jobs to pay your debt. Start by doing simple spreadsheet and progress to more important job like overseeing a nuclear bomb.
games.aboutText:
Congrats you just graduated! But now you have pay for your student loan.
Time to get a job .

Let's start with something basic : filling out spreadsheets, easy enough

But the bills keep coming and one job isn't enough, time to get another one

File sorting, sort files to the correct folders, sounds manageable.

But 2 jobs is still enough, time to get a third, and maybe even a fourth and fifth one, at this point you might as well get the sixth and seventh job.

But since your time is limited, you have to do to them at the same time!

Key Features :

- Play through 7 days, with each day getting more hectic than the last

- 7 different jobs for you to juggle

- Your time is limited, so do your jobs quickly and efficiently!

- No music! Just the calming sound of a busy office next to a construction site

- Chat with your employers, receive or send them files, tell them you've finished your job, or alternatively you can send them some very kind words

games.name: Torebia Online
games.shortDescription: Torebia: Island Odyssey is an old-school sandbox MMORPG. No classes, no pay-to-win. Craft, fight, trade, and rise through the Adventurer's Guild ranks your way. One shared world. Pure adventure.
games.aboutText:
Discover The Endless Blue, an endless sea of islands that shift and grow with the ambitions of those who explore them. Join the Adventurer's Guild, defy the Sovereignty, and carve your legend in a world where trade is king and freedom is earned.

Built for players who want challenge, community, and freedom. Torebia focuses on combat, exploration, and player-driven builds without chores or filler.

A SINGLE SHARED WORLD

One persistent archipelago with rare spawns, open dungeons, and world bosses for everyone to contest. Each server has its own community of players, so you will know each other and forge your legend together.

SLOW AND MEANINGFUL COMBAT

Unlike many modern MMORPGs, in Torebia your main path to progression is killing hordes of monsters. Combat is simple, deliberate, and focused on kill efficiency and character improvement.

EVERY ITEM IS TRADEABLE

In Torebia, all items are tradeable. There is no bind-on-equip and no bind-on-pickup. Everything can be traded, which means the economy actually matters.

CLASSLESS SYSTEM

In Torebia, there are no fixed classes. There are archetypes, but you decide how you want to play your character.

REFINE YOUR GEAR

Refine your gear to make it stronger, but be careful. One signature feature of Torebia is that gear BREAKS if the refine fails, so refine with caution.

ENDLESS MONSTERS TO DISCOVER

In Torebia and its Endless Blue, there are many different islands, each with its own biomes and monsters to discover.

games.name: Keep on Mining!
games.shortDescription: Keep on Mining! is a short incremental mining game. Mine rocks, gather materials, find artifacts, craft pickaxes and spend your materials on permanent upgrades inside the big skill tree!
games.aboutText:
Mine rocks!

Keep on Mining! is a simple incremental game. Hover your cursor over rocks to automatically mine them. Any rock inside the mining area will spawn pickaxes that mine for you!

Gather materials!

Mined rocks drop ores, which are crafted into bars. There is a variety of different material rocks to be mined!

The skill tree!

Spend your material bars to unlock upgrades inside the skill tree. These upgrades permanently boost your stats, letting you mine rocks with more power!

Craft pickaxes!

Use different materials to craft new pickaxes. Each new pickaxe has better stats, helping you mine faster and hit harder!

Talent cards!

Every time you level up, you earn a talent point. Spend talent points to reveal 3 random talent cards — pick one to keep! Choosing a card increases the talent level, but also increases rock HP.

The Mine!

Once you unlock the mine, it will automatically mine rocks and instantly craft bars for you. The Mine is the idle mechanic of Keep on Mining!

games.name: Giant’s Heart
games.shortDescription: Giant`s Heart — roguelike dungeon crawler with gardening elements. Discover powerful artifacts, make critical path choices - time is your most precious currency. A Giant marches toward the castle... You have just 5 minutes to descend into the dungeons, find and destroy its heart!
games.aboutText:
Giant`s Heart is a roguelike dungeon crawler with gardening elements.

DESTROY THE HEART

Pass through 3 unique biomes and reach the heart.

Fill your backpack with artifacts and create the strongest and fastest build.

Collect materials and plant seeds.

GROW A GARDEN - BECOME STRONGER

Between expeditions, grow plants - they make you stronger.

Craft new weapons and upgrade old ones.

TIME IS THE MAIN CURRENCY

Make critical decisions where the main stake is time - a currency more valuable than gold and artifacts.

games.name: Gunlands
games.shortDescription: Gunlands is an FPS action roguelike about crafting weapons and fighting an evil cult ready to overthrow the world with an army of ascended, mind-controlled soldiers. Find gun parts, assemble them into weapons of mass destruction, and let the chaos rain down upon your enemies.
games.aboutText:
Gunlands is an FPS roguelike in which players explore hostile dungeons teeming with enemies. Scavenging gun parts and weapons, players can turn simple weapons into absurd, one-of-a-kind machines of destruction. Extremely customisable and infinitely expandable weapons mean no runs feel the same.

Procedural Dungeons

Explore endless dungeons filled to the brim with cultists and guns; no two dungeons are the same, and each has its own unique challenges and items. Explore the cult, level by level, and explore the aesthetically rich environments.

Infinite Guns

Hundreds of gun parts mean endless possibilities for gun combos and run potential.

Features

- 100,000+ gun combinations from a variety of part stats and effects!

- Procedurally generated cultist lairs + guns to find in the dungeon

games.name: Desktop Defender
games.shortDescription: An idle auto-battler that sits in the corner of your screen while you do other things.
games.aboutText:
Defend your desktop in this idle auto-battler that sits quietly in the corner of your screen.

Fend off endless waves of enemies, upgrade your lone tower, and grow stronger across ascensions while you go about your day.

Level up and unlock

Gain XP, level up, and earn rewards such as permanent upgrades, powerful loot, or new weapons.

Hunt for loot

Enemies drop rare gear with huge bonuses. Equip the best and create broken builds.

Ascend and grow stronger

Reset your run to earn Ascendium, unlocking cross-ascension upgrades that boost your progress.

Always on, never in the way

Runs in a small corner of your screen so you can work, browse, or game while defending.

Customize your play

Adjust size and position to fit your setup. Stay passive or play actively. It's up to you!

games.name: DOGWALK
games.shortDescription: Explore a hand-crafted winter forest as a big adorable dog and a little kid in tow. A short, free, open source project brought to you by Blender Studio.
games.aboutText:
Blender Studio's official game project is a short casual interactive story.
Play a big, adorable dog traversing through winter woods and help out a little kid decorate a snowman with colorful items hidden in the environment.

Explore

You are let loose to roam camping grounds, forest paths, idyllic creeks and a frozen pond in this miniature open world.

Bound together

Guide or drag around your little kid owner that you have in tow. Help each other out, be a menace or be a good boy.

Play your way

Dive straight in and have the game react to your play-style and choices.
There are no fail states. Only player driven moments.

A paper craft world

Traverse an environment made of real-life paper crafted models, scanned and recreated to be played with.

Free for everyone

Brought to you by the Blender Studio as the new free and creative commons "Open Project".
Made with, and available as free and open-source software.

The project was used to test and improve both Blender and the Godot Game Engine.

Find out more or support our work on the Blender Studio website!

games.name: Replicomica
games.shortDescription: A short, atmospheric experience set inside a handcrafted dream. You are a small, solitary citizen drifting through augmented memories. Boot up your LonelyOS and let the robots guide you.
games.aboutText:
LONELY EXPLORER™
