A short, atmospheric experience set inside a handcrafted dream. You are a small, solitary citizen drifting through augmented memories. Boot up your LonelyOS and let the robots guide you.

VIBE INCLUDED

- Explore a quiet dream-fragment with platforming and puzzle elements

- Discover a gallery of 100+ surreal illustrations

- Immerse yourself in an original soundtrack composed by The Foreign just for this story

ALMOST HIGH-TECH

- English & Russian languages supported

- Gamepad supported

- Steam Deck supported

- Universal macOS supported

games.name: The Legend of Zen Town
games.shortDescription: The Legend of Zen Town is a classic turn-based RPG driven by a rich narrative. Explore a world where Chinese folklore blends with vibrant street culture, hidden beneath a modern city. Uncover supernatural mysteries and ancient secrets through striking art and storytelling.
games.aboutText:
"The Legend Of Zen Town" is a classic turn-based RPG driven by an unfolding narrative. Explore a world that blending Chinese folklore with vibrant street culture, hidden right under the nose of a modern city. Uncover its supernatural mysteries and navigate an ancient world of secrets and martial arts – all brought to life by its captivating story and striking art style.

✨ Key Features

1. Modern Urban-Fantasy with Chinese Supernatural Themes

A rare blend of traditional Chinese mythology and gritty modern life, inspired by real folk beliefs like spirit possession, exorcism, and ancient rituals.

2. Cultural Art Style with Depth

Visuals merge 1970s Chinese architecture, neon-lit backstreets, and spiritual symbols—creating a grounded yet eerie atmosphere in the fictional city of Zen Town.

3. Narrative-Driven Exploration & Mystery Solving

More than just combat—interrogate NPCs, examine clues, and use “spirit sight” to solve layered supernatural cases and uncover the city’s hidden truths.

4. Multiple Endings Based on Your Choices

Your actions shape the fate of Zen Town. Choose who to trust, what to sacrifice, and whether to confront or escape your destiny. No ending is truly good or bad—only consequences.

5. Immersive Audio & Original Eastern-Inspired Soundtrack

Experience atmospheric sound design featuring guqin, temple bells, and modern electronic tones that blend tradition with mystery.

🎮 Gameplay Mechanics

1. Classic Turn-Based Combat

Engage in strategic, turn-based battles against supernatural foes. Master each character’s unique skills, use items wisely, and plan team combos to survive deadly encounters.

2. "Spirit Sight" Investigation System

The protagonist’s ability to see the spirit world allows players to uncover hidden clues, detect cursed zones, and interact with entities invisible to ordinary people.

3. Seven-Day Countdown

The story unfolds over seven days. Every day matters—your choices, actions, and discoveries directly affect the outcome.

4. Branching Quests Inspired by Chinese Lore

Beyond the main story, explore numerous side quests based on Chinese superstitions, folk deities, and urban legends—like corpse revival, ghost temples, and yin-yang pathways.

5. Companions and Relationship Bonds

Travel with unique allies, including a stoic Taoist priestess and a mysterious brawler. Strengthen bonds through dialogue and battle to unlock special events and combo skills.

Hang, a sales manager with a hidden gift for seeing the unseen, moonlights as a special consultant solving supernatural cases. During one investigation with a Taoist priestess, a violent explosion erupts—involving multiple factions—leaving Hang critically injured.

He awakens the next day to a shocking twist: he, the priestess, and a mysterious, burly youth are now wanted criminals, publicly accused of stealing a sacred relic. The youth reveals they must recover the relic lost that night: a crucial ritual involving it begins in seven days—a ritual deeply connected to the priestess's own fate.

With one week to clear their names, retrieve the relic, and alter their destiny, a desperate race against time begins...

"Fengshan" was an ancient imperial ritual where emperors offered sacrifices to Heaven. Though this story takes place in a modern city with no emperors, it is still intimately connected to this ancient ceremony. Behind the ritual lies a web of mystery, fantasy, and conflict. The word "Ji" (记) means "record" or "chronicle" much like a travel journal. As players explore the open city and unfold the plot step by step, they will uncover the hidden truths. That’s what we aim to present — a modern urban fantasy RPG full of supernatural intrigue and eerie folklore.

[Zen Town]

Zen Town is a fictional coastal metropolis with a population of five million. The city features a unique blend of traditional Chinese architecture and old buildings from the 1970s and 1980s. The urban layout mixes bustling areas with extensive, aging residential districts, where most streets are lined with buildings over 30 years old.

Roughly three-quarters of Zen Town is composed of working-class neighborhoods, with the remainder being modern, more prosperous districts. Regardless of social class, the residents of Zen Town share a deep-rooted belief in folk religion. Shrines and temples are scattered throughout the city, and it’s common to see incense burning on sidewalks and offerings made to local deities — part of everyday life in this spiritually saturated metropolis.

Though Zen Town has generally been peaceful, a series of bizarre incidents begin to occur. Residents suddenly go mad and die on the spot. These cases are usually dismissed as rabies or acute psychosis leading to organ failure. However, autopsies reveal something far more disturbing: the victims continued to move even after death, showing signs of temporary reanimation.

With no medical history to support such explanations, and several cases happening simultaneously, the

games.name: Post Apocalypse Microbe Lab
games.shortDescription: This is an idle game you can leave in the corner of your desktop. Watch at your leisure as an android girl researches microbes in a post-apocalyptic world.
games.aboutText:
Leave the window somewhere on your desktop and watch as an android named Lyse continues with her research in a post-apocalyptic world. Her job is to collect microbe samples; your job is to lend a hand when you can. If you're looking for a simple game you can keep running on the corner of your screen which you can play with whenever you're free, this is the game for you.

What you can do:

・Click on microbes to help collect them

※ Lending a hand will help increase research levels faster

・Update laboratory facilities using coins

・Salvage for junk by clicking on Lyse

※ You can "fish" for just using a magnet

・Look through your collection of microbes and junk in your Archive

Game details:

・Leave the game in a corner of your desktop and play whenever you like

・Retro inspired pixel art and occasional chiptune music

・The variety of microbes you can find will increase as research levels rise

・Salvaged junk will be converted to coins automatically

・Your facilities are simple; just a salvage magnet, Bait dispenser and a tank to collect microbes

※ Your lab equipment can be automated from the beginning

・Lyse may be hiding a secret……

You can change Lyse's appearance.

Once your research levels reach 10, you are able to unlock Skins.

Change Lyse's appearance to your favorite Skin and continue with the research.

Lastly:

・This game doesn't have an objective

・There are no fancy functions such as a ToDo list or a Pomodoro timer

・There is no large-scale, dramatic storyline to follow

・Lyse's diary entries will tell you a little more about the world she is in

・Once your archives are full, there will be a small ending

・Enjoy the game at your leisure

・Have fun in the post-apocalyptic world

Bonus:

・You might find easter eggs from other worlds created by Skipmore, such as “Kamiko” and “Transiruby.”

※This game is played using a mouse. It does not support controllers or Steam Deck. Thank you for your understanding.

games.name: No Death In Wild West
games.shortDescription: Play as time travelers wiping out cowboys with high-tech weapons. Overcome brutal terrain against an unforgiving timer. Master unique heroes with different movement styles to conquer the Wild West.
games.aboutText:
“No Death in Wild West” invites you into the dangerous and opportunity-filled wilderness of the West. Race against time to complete missions, escape disasters, acquire powerful skills, collect gold coins, and achieve time-limited objectives. Craft your own unique ability builds, push your speed to the limit, and set ever-faster records.

Can you escape before the apocalypse?

【Time is your greatest enemy】

Time is your greatest enemy. Push forward in intense time-limited challenges, complete missions, and fight to survive. As time advances, enemies grow more lethal and the environment becomes increasingly unforgiving. Only those who master both speed and skill will make it to the end.

【Build Your Own Hero】

Choose your character, upgrade your abilities, unlock new skills, and combine powerful item effects to create insane synergies. Whether you prefer high-speed dashes, precision shooting, or agile dodging, you’ll find a combat style that suits you.

【Bullets vs. Speed】

Use dashes, slides, and special abilities to dodge enemy fire, pulling off heart-stopping dodges at the very last second. Master the rhythm, break through wave after wave of enemies, and experience the exhilarating thrill of high-speed movement.

【Rich Scenes & Dynamic Levels】

Explore vast desert canyons, traverse cursed forests, race across red-soil wastelands, and even storm the divine realms of the heavens. Each environment features unique map mechanics, enemy types, and special events.

"There's a snake in my boot!"

The Wild West is packed with excitement and breakneck pacing. Experience intense one-against-many battles, push forward in time-attack challenges, compete with players around the world, and strive for the fastest completion times and highest scores!

games.name: Mingle
games.shortDescription: Mingle is a hidden object puzzle game where you move through a crowd to find your identical twin. Each match transforms you into someone new, with hundreds of chatty little characters and surprising level twists.
games.aboutText:
Mingle is a character-matching puzzle game where you move through a crowd to find your twin. After finding your match, you merge to become someone new, and the search continues until everyone is matched.

Meet hundreds of chatty little characters, each eager to tell you something strange. There are over 400 to collect!

Every level mixes up the rules. Some characters move super fast, some shrink away, some grow into trees, and others even copy your every move.

Grab a friend for 2 player local co-op. Work together to earn a perfect three-stars, while also competing to see who can get the most merges.

• 1-2 player couch co-op

• 400+ characters to unlock

• Unlockable wallpapers and challenges

• Easy to learn, tough to master with a three-star rating system

• Great for fans of hidden object and tile-matching games

games.name: Kuny-Kuny Hog
games.shortDescription: A porky bullet hell, as chaotic and radioactive as it gets. Go after your acorns while you blast through by shooting and using your trusty roman shield to bounce back projectiles and mutant squirrels. Grab all the power ups you can in the midst of the battle!
games.aboutText:
Kuny is a pig who got mutated and fights for the Acornatom , a space nut that fell into the wrong hands, those of General Otto Von Squirro and his army of rabid squirrels.

Kuny will face not just the invading squirrels that messed up his farm, but also every enemy, god and force of nature that dares get in the way of him and his precious acorns.

Kuny-Kuny Hog combines frantic arcade game action with the crazyness that can only be found in bullet hell type games.

Shooting is essential but players will have to do it in both directions as enemies can appear from the front and the back (or any place really). The shield isn't only for blocking either: players can also bounce back projectiles and even whole enemies , sending them back so they blow up their teammates. Among enemy troops, sometimes a squirrel floating with a balloon will appear. These love gacha games. Their balloon keeps changing colors from red to green and vice versa. Getting the balloon while it's green will grant a random power up that lasts for a set amount of time, but grabbing it while it's red will net the player a power down, also with a random effect, like making enemies stronger or weakening players' defense until the effect fades .

Managing every gameplay mechanic at every moment is key to survive the chaos.

Each level has a main boss whose stage presents a series of challenges (usually with checkpoints in between) with dialogue scenes intersecting. The comic style panels tell the story at the start of each level, giving context to the different gameplay sections which in turn include some unique mechanics, different to the standard bullet hell gameplay.

Depending on the situation (and Kuny's abysmal luck), players will find themselves in challenges such as fleeing from an overgrown shark or fly over a hellish scape while turned into a sausage with wings . The game offers constant variety , to keep things spicy in between bullets and power ups.

Each character, enemy, attack and explosion has been hand drawn and animated by people with love, passion, and lots of humour. Many of the situations run on rule of comedy, escalating the absurdity over the game . Narration unfolds through comic panels and a series of dialogue cutscenes , with hilarious voice acting in both Spanish and English .

Artstyle is heavily inspired by 90s cartoons , with a touch of Spanish comic books

Frantic arcade action with bullet hell gameplay

Shielding mechanic for blocking and deflecting enemy attacks (and enemies themselves)

Power-ups and even power downs Collision and chain reactions between enemies

Bosses straight out of a fever dream

Character voices in Spanish and English

Wacky stages

Animation and art hand drawn in a cartoon style

Story told through comic book panels

Many acorns

Don't let Kuny starve.

games.name: Elfie: A Sand Plan
games.shortDescription: Want to help a small rotund elephant build some sand castles? Enjoy spending time relaxing at the beach with your new friend while solving spatial sand castle puzzles!
games.aboutText:
Elfie: A Sand Plan is a cute and relaxing geometric puzzle game.

Meet Elfie, a small rotund elephant, and help her build some sandcastles.

Given a set of sand blocks in each level, you will need to match your sand sculptures with what Elfie has in mind.

And with no timers or fixed solutions, you can take your time and enjoy solving each puzzle in the way you like. Elfie isn't too demanding, as long as it matches her vision she will be happy!

Features 🏖️

- Over 180 Levels and Additional Challenges : The game features a total of 186 levels and 3 different difficulties. Looking to improve your 3D visualization skills? Try out the No Hints mode to challenge these spatial puzzles!

- Cozy Relaxing Summer Vibes : Let yourself be transported by water by its cute, colorful and nostalgic pixel art, and joyful beach-appropriate soundtrack.

- Simple Controls and Mechanics : Designed to be fully playable with only a mouse or touchscreen and with intuitive mechanics, the game is approachable by people of all ages and gaming experience.

- Elfie : Enjoy spending time with her, talking to her, unlocking all her swimsuits, and experiencing your new friendship with this small rotund elephant.

About Pressed Elephant

Pressed Elephant is a small 2-person independent team that collaborates remotely. Solomar, based in Quebec, is Elfie’s core developer and Silent Swimmer, based in California, is Elfie’s composer. Both are driven by creativity and share values in regards to creative freedom and creative ownership. They are firmly against generative AI at any stages of the creative process.

If you'd like to support us, please make sure to

games.name: POJANGMACHA : Korean Street Food Management Simulator
games.shortDescription: Under a snowy overpass, people gather around warm lights. In this cozy management simulation game, run your own POJANGMACHA and serve Korean street foods like tteokbokki and ramyun. Handle quirky events and grow your tiny stall into a street food success!
games.aboutText:
Beneath the snowy, dim overpass, warm lights draw people one by one.

The protagonist, once unemployed abroad, and his uncle, pressured by the mother’s insistence, begin running a Korean-style Pojangmacha.

The protagonist takes charge of management and operations, while the uncle, skilled in cooking, satisfies the customers with ramen, fish-shaped cakes, and a variety of Korean street foods.

This is a first-person, single-player street food management simulator.

Face unexpected events, manage customers, secure ingredients, and grow your Pojangmacha into a thriving business!

games.name: DungeonBox
games.shortDescription: A fantasy party game for up to 8 players, where everyone joins in from their phones. Type what you want to do, vote for the best idea, and roll dice to see if it works!
games.aboutText:
DungeonBox is a party RPG for up to 8 players. Everyone plays from their own phone: submit your funniest ideas, vote for the best one, and watch the story bend around whatever your party decides.

Your Dungeon Master (run by your choice of a player or computer DM) sets the scene and everyone answers at once: heroic, clever or completely unhinged. Players join from their phone's browser with a room code. No app, no account, no extra controllers.

Every answer lands on the big screen. The party votes, the best idea scores, and the winning move becomes the story, consequences and all.

Pick a lock, spot a trap, slap a gnome. Risky moves call for a skill check rolled right from your phone, and your class, stats and items tip the odds. A natural 20 is legendary. So is a natural 1.

Descend into the Lion's Labyrinth, a papercraft dungeon crawl where every player steers their own hero. Search chests, sniff out hidden keys, outwit trolls and mimics, and fight turn-based battles on the way to the Gilded Serpent's hoard.

When a quest turns violent, the whole party votes on cards: back your heroes' attacks and block the enemy's nastiest moves. Loot a million gold, survive a Super Blast, or simply stand there looking cool.

- Up to 8 players, one phone each – join with a room code, or fill empty seats with CPU players.

- A Dungeon Master who never runs out of ideas – every answer changes the story, narrated aloud.

- Draw it into existence – sketch magic items and monsters on your phone and watch them come to life in the dungeon.

- Build your character – choose from 12 heroes, earn XP, raise your stats and unlock abilities like Fireball, Pickpocket and Diss Track.

- Hand-written quests, endless outcomes – from tavern brawls to pirate-ship escapes, with 100 random events waiting to shake things up.

- Your table, your rules – set the Content Rating anywhere from “Family Friendly” to “Anything Goes”.

- Made for streaming – extra viewers join as the audience and vote, and the room code can be hidden on stream. Remote Play Together supported.

- 12 languages – menus, quests and narration fully localized.

games.name: Underfishing
games.shortDescription: You just arrived in hell. Nothing left to to do but contemplate the life you lived, and fish. Fish out ancient treasures, upgrade your fishing abilities, and face your biggest regrets in this narrative fishing game! Will you manage to fish out Lucifer's crown and earn another chance at life?
games.aboutText:
Fishing! Dialogue! Upgrades! The unbearable weight of a lifetime's worth of regrets!

Enjoy a bite-sized narrative fishing experience! Fish out a variety of ancient treasures, make small talk with your local low-level demon companion, and attempt to come to terms with the fact your will never get back all the time you wasted, or reconcile all the bad choices you made in life.

That is, of course, unless you can fish out Lucifer's crown and earn another chance at life. Many have tried for thousands of years, but you will be the one to finally do it, right?

Featuring:

Fun dialogue with your assigned demon

A variety of fishing upgrades

Tons of ancient treasures to fish out

Enjoy your afterlife! Trust me, it gets better after the first few centuries.

Attributions:

Zombie icons created by Freepik on FlatIcon ,

Sea icons created by Khoirul Huda on FlatIcon :

Stylized Old Fishing Rod Low Poly by alexi.smnd on Sketchfab

Fish hook icons created by Ehtisham Abid on FlatIcon :

games.name: Over the Radio
games.shortDescription: Local co-op game about flying a plane. One player is the pilot, the other the navigator. The pilot has no map. The navigator guides the pilot using only words. Work together to reach your goal in a remixable national park map.
games.aboutText:
Reach your destination using only words!

A pilot and a navigator work together to fly the plane. The pilot watches the screen and controls the aircraft, while the navigator reads a physical map. Since neither can see the other’s information, only sharp communication will get you there!

Replays let you relive the flight!

Celebrate success. Or laugh at moments like “Wait, that’s what you heard!?” and those unexpected detours.

Use every sight and sound as your guide!

From the cockpit, the pilot can spot mountains, lakes, and other landmarks to navigate. Entering certain airspaces triggers unique sounds as audio clues. With each player seeing different information and clues, clear communication is key to a successful flight.

Boost immersion with a paper map

Print out the custom map, mix and match the pieces, and explore fresh terrain every time. The mix of paper and digital creates a unique, hands-on play experience. The map will be available to view and download from our website.

Play anywhere with your own conversation style

Over the Radio is designed for local play, but with an external voice or video call, you can enjoy it even when you're far apart.

games.name: Coasteroid
games.shortDescription: Build stellar rollercoasters across alien worlds, carve tunnels through planets, and launch trains into orbit. Customize every track element, scenery decoration, and environment before subjecting riders to the forces of the universe! The galaxy is your theme park!
games.aboutText:
Build Coasters Out of This World

Coasteroid lets you design the most advanced rides in the universe! Construct gravity-bending coasters that loop across alien landscapes, tunnel through asteroid craters, warp between planets using wormholes, and launch trains straight into orbit. Not even the sky is a limit anymore!

Decorate Your Dream Park

Plant trees, bushes and rocks to give your planet its own biosphere and make your park feel more alive. Place down scenery props to give your rides a distinct theme, and construct modular buildings with ease using a piece-by-piece snapping system! Further customize the look of your park by painting building items in any color you want!

Shape Your Own Planet

Use the terraforming tool to sculpt mountains, valleys and caves, and paint the ground to change the look of your environment. Further customize your planets by tinkering with biomes, liquids and atmospheres to create truly exotic worlds! Immerse yourself in your creations by experiencing the coasters you built with the first-person ride cam!

- 7 unique coaster types: Each with distinct track designs, trains, and properties.

- Flatrides and water rides: Build a space elevator droptower, or an alien log flume!

- Multiple planets to build on: With varying gravity and terrain.

- Highly flexible coaster editor: Move, curve, and roll track in any direction you want.

- Special track elements: Launch riders off the rails with rocket launches, wormholes and more!

- Decorate your dream park: Place scenery items or building pieces and customize their colors.

- Terraforming tools : Sculpt landscapes, paint biomes and even customize planet atmospheres!

- Design your infrastructure: Connect rides and plazas using a curve-based pathway tool.

- Ride your creations: Switch to first-person view and experience every drop, twist, and loop yourself.

- Guest simulation.

- Park management and finances.

- Career mode with several scenario's.

- A wide range of new rides including coasters, flatrides and trackrides.

- New scenery items and themes.

- Steam Workshop support for sharing your creations with the galaxy.

games.name: Lingering Soup
games.shortDescription: Lingering Soup is a deckbuilding and management roguelite. Unwilling to be reborn, you run a spicy hot pot stall for Meng Po, serving souls one last meal. Combine cooking cards and relics to help them let go of the past. Can you do the same?
games.aboutText:
One last craving before crossing over.

The broth bubbles as souls take their seats, still clinging to their past lives. With Meng Po as your guide, turn cards into food and help your guests let go, ready to be reborn.

Even ghosts are picky. Play your cards right.

Five pot compartments, plenty of picky souls. Guests choose their own food, so plan ingredients around their tastes and patience. Help them let go before they get fed up: wrong flavors cost popularity, and long waits mean they leave without paying. Fail to satisfy a demanding VIP, and your run is over.

Good cards make a good broth.

Build a deck around ingredients and flavors. Use cooking cards to alter the food in your pot, and drinks and action cards to control the pace. Choose different card upgrades to make the same ingredients work in new combinations.

Closing time is planning time.

Plan shopping trips and card upgrades on the calendar. Buy cards and seasonings, and find relics: special items whose effects last throughout the run. Resources are limited, so every purchase shapes your next strategy.

A taste of the underworld.

Fish from underworld waters, red-scaled snakes, even dishes made with lizards from volcanic craters… Then a guest calls: “A medium drink, light ice, lightly sweetened!” Even ghosts know exactly how they like it.

There's more simmering out on the street.

Explore the food stalls for odd jobs—or meet a chef who once cooked for state banquets, now furious about cilantro. Your decisions affect money, cards, relics, and popularity, shaping the rest of your run.

Wishlist Lingering Soup and come to Naihe Bridge when the broth is ready—there are hungry souls to serve.

games.name: Mimi's Restaurant Helper
games.shortDescription: Put on your chef's hat and make food, clean the dishes, take orders and more in Mimi's Restaurant Helper. Become a chef and serve beautiful, hand drawn dishes!
games.aboutText:
Step into Mimi’s Restaurant Helper , a charming 2D cooking game that brings the nostalgic energy of 2000s anime and flash games to life! Master the art of crafting stunning dishes, tackle engaging challenges, and dive into fun mini-games that keep the kitchen excitement flowing.

Make pizzas, prep ingredients, fry food, clean up, take orders, and more! A fun mix of puzzles, time management, and cooking challenges in one game.

Support the pre-launch kickstarter campaign!

games.name: 重生之我亲爱的妹妹复仇计划
games.shortDescription: 在前世被“妹妹们”毁掉一切的你，重生回到悲剧发生前。面对撒娇、腹黑、洗脑甚至怨念成魔的“妹妹大军”，你必须斗智斗勇，守护家庭，上演一场荒诞爆笑的兄妹逆转剧。
games.aboutText:
游戏简介

“哥哥，我最讨厌你了。”

一觉醒来，你重生回了几个月前——那个你亲妹妹还活着，继妹和义妹还没彻底毁掉你人生的时间点。

上辈子的你太天真，被两位“妹妹”玩弄于股掌之中：财产被卷走、父亲被关进精神病院、最爱的亲妹妹死于车祸，最后你跳河自尽——完美结局。

这一次？你有了外挂—— 亲爱的妹妹System ！

在这个系统中，只要和真正的妹妹相处，就能积攒“妹驱力”，解锁各种荒诞离谱的技能与道具。从“读档存档”到“妹妹侦探技能”，再到“斗地主必胜牌技”，甚至可以发动“欧尼酱之惊叹”——一切只为拯救妹妹，拯救家庭，完成一场甜蜜又惊心动魄的复仇！

角色介绍

games.name: Rebounder
games.shortDescription: Nail the run. Deliver your line. Rebounder is a hand-crafted precision platformer about a roughneck worker recruited for a hazardous job on a distant planet. A tough-but-fair gauntlet set in a surreal comic-book world of ink, paper, and print.
games.aboutText:
What's a Rebounder?

On a remote lunar worksite, valuable resources from an ancient age flow underfoot, and shareholders demand extraction. Contract workers fly-in and fly-out; blue collar labourers from around the galaxy all trekking to the edges of civilization for the next gig.

A Rebounder runs lines. They pull up their boots each day and speed through hazardous terrain to deliver precious cargo from point A to point B by any means necessary. It’s the gnarliest trade in the universe.

One cold night, a fledgling Rebounder pulls into town looking for work...

Gameplay

Grab, throw, and bounce off alien flora and fauna to deliver your line to its destination. Nail precise combos of trickshots, ricochets, and wall slides to finish the run.

Weave through exploding spores, razor thorns, dodgy scaffolding, hallucinogenic fluids, and gnashing gates. Utilize the tools-of-the-trade (detachable jetpacks, ‘zookas, and some perfectly healthy looking fish) to complete your objectives.

Levels are fast, replayable, and satisfying. Certain areas hide secret platforming challenges for the real sickos.

Rebounder is a love letter to the platforming gameplay pioneered by speedrunners and kaizo creators. Rapid respawns, unlimited attempts, and carefully tuned controls make daunting-looking challenges surprisingly approachable.

Ink and Noise

Made four inks at a time. Rebounder draws inspiration from vintage sci-fi comics, zines, and the world of physical print — Ben Day dots, misregistration, ink-bleed, and paper.

Synth-punk melodies, fuzzy drums, intercepted transmissions, and musical sound design turn your movements into music.

Features

- 500+ hand-crafted screens of trick-shot platforming.

- 6 distinct chapters across an unforgiving worksite, packed with hidden, extra-tough challenges if you go looking.

- An immersive story that will keep you guessing until the end (and after.)

- Fast respawns, unlimited tries. Nail the perfect run, as many lives as it takes.

- A multitude of accessibility options to cover players of all skill levels.

- Expressive vibes with pulpy art and comic-book inspired world.

games.name: Sails
games.shortDescription: Plunder, craft and live the pirate’s life. This is a multiplayer pirate survival game where you mine, craft, trade and plunder to survive. Form alliances with other players to strengthen your crew and wage war on your enemies. Fight to keep what’s yours before others take it.
games.aboutText:
Set sail and live the pirate’s life. The multiplayer pirate survival game where you mine, craft and plunder to survive. Form alliances to strengthen your crew and wage war on your enemies. Fight to keep what’s yours before others take it.

In Sails, you step into a multiplayer world where piracy rules the seas and every decision can mean life or death. Navigate a vast world alongside friends and build your stronghold to secure your place in this world. Explore islands, raid large forts, and form powerful alliances to survive the constant threats from other crews . Command your ship through intense naval battles where strategy and teamwork decides the victor . In Sails the open ocean is yours to conquer, only if you’re ready to face the dangers lurking beyond the horizon.

SAIL THE SEAS

Explore a dynamic world ruled by rival factions with each controlling specific regions. Command a variety of ships, from small sloops to powerful galleons. Customize the interior of your ship to suit your playstyle. Navigate treacherous waters and chart your course through danger and opportunity.

- Large Open world

- Territories ruled by factions

- Multiple Ships

- Buildable Ship interior

RAID AND PLUNDER

Battle rival crews across land and sea in exciting raids. Lay siege to enemy bases, steal their loot, and defend your own from other pirates. Attack on land or use naval bombardment to soften targets. When you're not fighting players, raid NPC towns, tribal villages, and strongholds for extra rewards.

- Raid rival crews for their loot

- Explore abandoned ships and shipwrecks

- Plunder towns, villages, and forts

- Find hidden dungeons

BUILD AND CRAFT

Shape your world from the ground up. Build coastal bases, island forts, or hidden hideouts with your crew. Craft anything from weapons and armor to tools and ship upgrades. Fortify your base, set traps, and prepare for enemy raids. Whether you're the builder or a fighter, survival starts with what you create.

- Craft weapons, tools, armor and ships

- Construct your fortress

- Form a crew with friends

- Build traps and fortifications

games.name: Blood Bear
games.shortDescription: Blood Bear is a single player survival horror game. You must get to the bottom of what occurred the night before. Navigate the map, interact, and avoid the park’s residents. Use and upgrade items from around the park in your search for answers.
games.aboutText:
Blood Bear is a single player survival horror game. You wake up at your campsite, alone, within what seems to be a completely deserted State Park. You must get to the bottom of what occurred the night before. Navigate the map, interact, and avoid the park’s residents. Use and upgrade items from around the park in your search for answers.

- Immersive Experience: Put your survival skills to the test in a highly realistic environment. Maintain hunger and stamina levels with the help of food and drink items from around the park.

- Equipment: Collect a wide variety of items from around the forest to aid you. Use this equipment and even make upgrades, satiate hunger, replenish stamina, and fight off your enemies.

- Terrifying Atmosphere: Survival gameplay taken to the next level with frightening visuals, darkly lit environment, and eerie sound design.

- Unique Storyline: Interesting storytelling with many cutscenes, enhancing your gameplay and explaining the antagonists motivations.

- Character Interaction: Encounter the game's characters, good and bad, that can either help or hurt your chances of survival.

- Non-Linear Map: Explore an extremely detailed, hand crafted world, with each asset intentionally placed in over 20 unique locations. Have the advantage of total control over your exploration.

- Difficulty: Want a tougher challenge? Change the intensity of your survival experience based on your ability. Endless replayability options with the ability to customize the difficulty in many interesting ways.

Blood Bear can be completed in roughly 1.5 - 2 hours.

*Please note that this is the first of many games made by a 19 year old solo game developer. *

games.name: Cassette Beasts 2002
games.shortDescription: Record, battle, and fuse with 250+ beasts as you adventure alongside diverse companions in this monster-collecting RPG. Set in London in 2002, play in single-player or online to unmask an enigmatic occultist who threatens the realms of man and beast! When worlds collide, take the leap beyond!
games.aboutText:
The critically-acclaimed monster-collecting series returns with a brand new story, perfect for both new and returning players alike!

After arriving in a quiet neighbourhood of London, you soon find yourself pulled down a rabbit hole to Nodnol, a land of beasts and high strangeness that exists in the shadow of our own. When the past collides with the present, one question must be answered: Who is the mysterious occultist Westerley, and what are they planning for both worlds?

Enter the story as a newcomer or import your character from the first Cassette Beasts game to continue your creature-collecting journey!

Adventure to a massive new soundtrack from returning Cassette Beasts composer Joel Baylis, including vocals from Shelby Harvey (Cassette Beasts), Johnny Gioeli (Crush 40) and more!

Record beasts with cassette tapes and play them back to take on their form in battle! Fuse with your companions to gain the upper hand - any two beasts can be combined to produce over 57,000+ powerful and fully-animated fusion forms! Take advantage of alchemy in battle to apply extra buffs and debuffs alongside your attacks or even change your opponent’s elemental type.

Befriend, recruit, and romance from a roster of twelve companions with full voice acting from a celebrated cast. Each companion has their own motivations, stories, and gameplay perks. Each bond deepened allows for more powerful fusions in battle!

Explore the beast world of Nodnol alongside your friends with online multiplayer. Trade tapes, record beasts, and fight alongside other players in any encounter, including story battles!

Beasts you encounter have a chance to break out of their rigid roles and rebel against you. Rogue beasts learn from your battle techniques, adapt, and return to challenge you anew!

games.name: RhythmStrike
games.shortDescription: Vertical-scrolling rhythm game inspired by modern Japanese arcade titles, featuring hybrid keyboard and mouse controls, music-synced visual effects and community chart support. Climb the global leaderboards and unlock new content through specialized challenges!
games.aboutText:
RhythmStrike is a vertical-scrolling rhythm game inspired by modern Japanese arcade titles. Play songs from renowned rhythm game artists such as t+pazolite, LeaF, and EBIMAYO using hybrid keyboard and mouse controls.

[ GAMEPLAY ]

Tap incoming notes with your keyboard while moving your mouse. Master hybrid charts that shift between standard 6K and 3K+Mouse sections. As you play, visual effects trigger in sync with the track, altering the visuals in real time. The entire game is designed for maximum fun without requiring any special controllers.

[ MISSION MODE ]

Take on a special challenge campaign. Clear songs by surviving miss limits, hitting combo thresholds, or maintaining precise accuracy to unlock bonus content.

[ CUSTOM SONGS ]

RhythmStrike features full Steam Workshop integration and an official chart editor. Create custom charts for your favorite tracks, download creations from the community, and compete for the top spot on global leaderboards.

[ FEATURES ]

- Unique keyboard and mouse controls.

- Licensed tracks from artists like t+pazolite, LeaF, and EBIMAYO.

- Chart editor and Steam Workshop support.

- Mission Mode: Progress through challenges to unlock new content.

- Music-synced visual effects.

- Global leaderboards and a personal skill rating system.

- Deep customization settings.

- Community Discord server for sharing scores, and feedback.

games.name: Industronaut
games.shortDescription: A survival engineering game where you build life support habitats, mine resources, and automate production chains on a radiation heavy planet. No rescue. No support. Just engineering.
games.aboutText:
You weren’t rescued. You weren’t forgotten.

You were left behind because the main ship ran out of power and your pod never opened.

Survive Through Engineering

Industronaut is a survival engineering game set on a hostile, radiation heavy planet. You are the only active engineer on the surface. There is no evacuation plan and no external support.

Build a self sufficient habitat, keep life support running, and turn raw resources into the systems that keep you alive.

Build a Habitat That Keeps You Alive

- Build sealed habitat modules

- Produce oxygen, water, and food

- Connect rooms with corridors and doors

- Expand from shelter to industrial base

Mine, Process, Expand

- Mine raw planetary resources

- Refine materials through production chains

- Unlock new machines and recipes

- Push your industrial network forward step by step

Automate the Work

- Use drones to search for ore deposits

- Move resources between machines and storage

- Design layouts that keep production flowing

- Scale from manual survival to automated industry

Try the Demo

Play the early survival engineering loop. Build your first habitat, produce oxygen, water, and food, mine the first resources, and start automating production before your space suit gives out.

Demo progress is separate and is not guaranteed to carry over to the full game.

No Combat. No Rescue. Just Systems.

There is no combat focus and no scripted rescue. Progress comes from engineering decisions, efficient layouts, and continuous expansion.

The planet is hostile. Your habitat is the only safe place.

If it works, you survive.

games.name: The Piper of Dawn
games.shortDescription: Grow magical crops—and your own workforce. Run an alchemy shop in a city trapped in a time loop, forge bonds with humans and non-humans, and shape its fate. A dark fantasy management sim with branching stories and multiple endings.
games.aboutText:
Become an alchemist in Diamond City, where growing a business means growing your own workers. Farm, craft, and sell your creations as you build relationships and navigate a dark fantasy story with multiple endings.

- Build Your Alchemy Business: Grow magical crops, craft valuable goods, and put your homegrown workforce to work.

- Meet the City's Unusual Residents: Discover over 40 NPCs and relationship paths for six central heroines.

- Shape the City's Fate: Earn the trust of six factions and explore branching stories shaped by your choices and reputation.

Grow ingredients, turn them into valuable creations, and sell them to fund your next expansion. Along the way, fulfill orders, build relationships, and uncover the city's stranger side.

Cultivate the Extraordinary

Grow over 100 crops and experiment with traits to improve your harvests. Expand underground and use alchemical circles to build a flourishing, self-sustaining farm.

Turn Curiosities into Profit

Decorate your shop and stock its shelves with crops, potions, and rare curiosities. Build your reputation to attract non-human customers and unlock lucrative special orders.

Grow Your Own Workforce

Meet the Peoplesprouts: workers you grow yourself. Assign them to farming, retail, and manufacturing to automate your business.

Match their talents to the job—and give them time to recover. Overwork takes a toll on their Sanity.

Turn Experiments into Opportunity

Transform materials into valuable goods or grant your Peoplesprouts powerful abilities. Experiment with volatile elements and combine alchemy with Oracles to discover extraordinary results.

Borrow the Power of Ancient Gods

Collect and combine divine blessings for powerful bonuses during each time rewind. Just beware of the gods behind them—and the influence of their whispers.

Decide Who to Trust

Win the favor of six rival factions to unlock special orders and new story possibilities. Your reputation and choices help determine how Diamond City's story ends.

Oracle Summons

Try your luck summoning blessings from Ancient and Outer Gods. Their gifts could be just what your next experiment needs.

The Golden Cage Card Parlor

Challenge the city's residents to Blackjack. When luck fails, remember your two favorite gods: Save and Load.

Fishing

Cast your line across Diamond City and reel in fish, strange surprises—even an Ancient God.

Sissi

A barmaid blessed with superhuman strength—and your very first full-time hire. She originally dreamed of becoming a housemaid, only to discover a surprising natural talent for farming.

Nene

The daughter of a mathematician, Nene has a brilliant mind, razor-sharp intuition, and the combat skills to back them up. But her true talent shines through in the end: after becoming a Peoplesprout keeper, Nene finally found the perfect place to put her skills to use.

Gretel

Feel like adventuring alone is far too safe? Then bring this amazing trouble magnet along! She'll bring a never-ending stream of danger your way.

With shimmering rose-gold fur, a fluffy tail, and incredible marksmanship, Gretel seems to encounter mysterious incidents wherever she goes, recording each one in her Field Notes.

Jimo Li

Meow? Meow, meow!

Aurora Ludwig

Princess, goddess, sacrifice... Aurora bears many identities and possesses extraordinary magical power that greatly influences Diamond City itself.

A woman shrouded in mystery, her true nature remains impossible to discern.

？？？？？

[FILE CLASSIFIED] ///// EXTREME DANGER /////

About Bone Nail Studio

Bone Nail Studio is a team of passionate game developers (and cat lovers) dedicated to creating fun and engaging games. We strive for quality in everything we do, though we occasionally go a little off the rails. This is our fourth game and the official sequel to Yog-Sothoth's Yard. Anyway, we hope you enjoy exploring the world we've created!

Thank you all for your continued support!

—Bone Nail Studio

games.name: Harventure
games.shortDescription: Harvest, collect and upgrade! Harventure is a short incremental game about harvesting and using resources on upgrades to purify islands from corruption.
games.aboutText:
Harventure is an incremental game inspired by To the Core and Nodebuster . Harvest resources, explore unique islands, and upgrade your skill tree.
Collect all the resources from each island to finally destroy the corruption that plagues it.

The corruption runs deeper with every new island. Will you be able to cleanse them all?

Enjoy 3 to 4 hours of relaxing harvesting and satisfying upgrades.

The islands are rich in resources, be prepared to harvest them all.

You will start from wood and stone up to more precious resources, use them to upgrade the skill tree or learn new abilities.

Upgrade your skill tree, spend resources to unlock new upgrades, learn powerful abilities, and unlock automation for harvesting.

Unlock new islands each with its unique biome and resources.

games.name: Non-violent Hero 非暴力系勇者！
games.shortDescription: A hero rescues a princess without violence. Weapon: microphone
games.aboutText:
A hero rescues a princess but refuses to use violence. His weapon is a microphone.

Features

- No violence at all. Defeat enemies with reason.

- A beautiful map hand-drawn by the king, just in case the hero gets lost.

- A castle that can only be entered once . There is absolutely nothing inside.

- You can freely enter the villagers’ houses, as if they were your own.

- You can rescue the princess… or not .

- You can obtain a handsome photo of the hero.

- A total of eleven endings.

Non-Violent Hero is a pixel RPG. You play as a charming yet stubborn hero who refuses to use violence, helping the king rescue his daughter kidnapped by the Demon King. Through different choices, you can reach different endings and shape the story in your own way.

games.name: Ctesiphon
games.shortDescription: A retrowave/mecha-inspired sci-fi first-person shooter featuring fast-paced combat in old-school style open-plan levels packed with pickups, keys, and secrets.
games.aboutText:
You play Ethelyn Dax, Galactic Bounty Hunter extraordinaire. Finally settling in for a long-awaited vacation on the resort world of Ctesiphon, the moment is ruined by the surprise arrival of the Black Death mercenary company.

Taking the capital city and every surrounding resort hostage as part of a payment dispute, the mercenaries expected to meet no physical resistance.

Ethelyn would be perfectly content to simply get her money back and leave the resort to sort things out with the mercenaries themselves, but as it turns out the force is led by a shadow from Ethelyn's own past that she can't simply let get away.

The Black Death mercenaries have brought so many troops, clones, drones, and mechs that they expect absolutely no resistance from the resort patrons. You will prove that complacency unfounded.

Take advantage of the mercenaries' inattention with Ethelyn's trusty Data-Spike, perforate them with the versatile Submachinegun, blast them around corners with the Gyrobuster's homing minirockets, or bring out the Jetgun to cut through heavy armor as if it were mere paper.

Ethelyn is highly nimble and can run circles around most enemies who will have to resort to overwhelming force to try and stop you. The game features seven mainline levels built in a non-linear layout allowing you to flank enemies and search for secrets.

Made in bits and pieces over the course of nearly a decade by a single developer on Linux using C/C++, OpenGL, and open-source Quake mapping tools, Ctesiphon's custom engine allows for the game to run reliably on low-spec systems. It's built to withstand large firefights with dozens of enemies, hundreds of blood spatter and bullet impact decals, and piles of giblets and scrap as you blow the enemies apart into clouds of particles and debris.

Ctesiphon has been developed on Linux first and supports virtually all controllers connected to it. On Windows only XInput-compatible controllers are supported natively, but others will work fine with SteamInput enabled. The big exception is for the Steam Deck and Steam Controllers, these won't be natively supported on Linux/SteamOS until after release but in the meantime they should work fine if you play the Windows build by setting compatibility to any version of Proton.

games.name: Rabona
games.shortDescription: Rabona is an online multiplayer soccer game with physics-based gameplay. Take total ball control with precise touches. Join the real football action with your friends. Feel the game.
games.aboutText:
Rabona is an online multiplayer soccer game where physics define every moment. No scripts. No predetermined outcomes. From precise ball touches to heavy tackles, you're in total control. Join the real football action with your friends and own every moment.

PHYSICS-BASED GAMEPLAY

Forget pre-recorded animations. Your player's movement is calculated in real-time, giving you full agency over your body to move freely and react instantly. The ball is a free-moving physical object, never 'glued' to a player, making every loose ball a true battle of physics and reaction.

CURVE THE BALL

Every pass, long ball, and shot is 100% unique. Apply realistic spin to curve the ball into the top corner or chip it over a rushing goalkeeper. Master skill moves like the Rabona, Trivela, or Elastico to dominate the field.

RAGDOLL PHYSICS

Football is a contact sport. Feel the weight of every challenge with a robust active ragdoll system. Time your slide tackles to intercept the ball or take down opponents, then watch players fall, roll, and stand up in a continuous, physics-driven loop.

REACTIVE GOALKEEPING

Face off against goalkeepers that react like humans, not robots. They physically jump and dive to reach the ball, creating unpredictable and exciting save moments instead of playing preset animations.

ATMOSPHERE & DETAILS

Immerse yourself in a realistic stadium environment with detailed grass and dynamic goal net physics that react to every shot's power and angle. Feel the tension when the ball hits the post.

games.name: ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs
games.shortDescription: Run a quaint electronics repair shop in mid-2000s Tokyo. Grow your business by carefully restoring iconic video game consoles, cell phones, music players, and other nostalgic devices. Talk to customers, hear their stories, and see how your decisions impact both their lives and your shop.
games.aboutText:
ReStory is a chill, narrative-driven shop management simulator from the creators of I Am Future, set on the bustling streets of mid-2000s Tokyo and featuring an in-depth device repair system.

In this game, you run an electronics repair shop, meticulously restore nostalgic Y2K-era devices, including officially licensed Atari consoles, and interact with customers to experience a branching storyline with multiple endings that depend on your choices.

Greet customers, take their devices in for repairs, manage your finances, and surf the web for spare parts. Relax and enjoy running your own small shop in a game created with love and respect for the one-of-a-kind vibe of the Japanese urban life in the mid-2000s.

Fix a variety of nostalgic devices inspired by iconic game consoles, handhelds, phones, cameras, music players, and home appliances. Carefully take each gadget apart, clean it, replace faulty parts, and assemble it back together using your trusty toolset.

The way you interact with each customer can change their lives forever. Will you report on a disturbing find inside the former gangster’s phone, or help a lovestruck student confess to his crush? Make your own choices and see how they impact the branching storyline.

Key Features

- Relaxing electronics repair shop management

- A wide range of nostalgic 2000s devices to repair

- In-depth device cleaning and restoration system

- Y2K-era web browser to hunt for spare parts

- A variety of in-person and online orders to fulfill

- Multiple tools for device repairs

- Iconic Atari consoles, officially licensed for the game

- Customers with unique stories and dialogues

- Replayable branching storyline with choices impacting the ending

- A distinct, chill vibe of urban life in Japan

games.name: BLOK
games.shortDescription: BLOK is an Orwellian psychological horror game set in post-communist Poland. You play as a political exile who fled the country during the communist regime. Years later, after the system’s collapse, a strange letter from your mother draws you back home. But something is deeply wrong.
games.aboutText:
BLOK is a first-person psychological horror game that takes inspiration from Orwell's '1984'.

Years after fleeing the country for political reasons, you return to your old apartment block, brought back by a strange letter from your mother. The neighborhood seems to be the same. But something is not right. It is almost too perfect. And the more you search the more cracks you find.

Explore the neighborhood, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the truth shaped by fear, silence, and control. Traces of life under a regime based on secrecy and repression. As you investigate, the world subtly transforms around you.

BLOK offers:

First-person atmospheric exploration in retro aesthetics that perfectly fit the tone and memories of 90s eastern european neighbourhood.

Story-driven gameplay with environmental storytelling that touches on life under a regime and historical events

Meaningful puzzles integrated into the narrative and the story

Changes in space and tone as the story and the mystery unfolds

Hauntingly familiar yet nostalgic world inspired by post-communist Poland

Customization of a "retro" look. Adjust pixelation, color precision etc. in the settings

The story doesn’t tell you everything. It lets you find it. Hidden in walls, staircases, basement and buried in layers of memories and silence.

games.name: Koloboke: Sickness Simulator
games.shortDescription: Only Up + First-person rolling mechanics. This combo is pure madness. Try not to fall!
games.aboutText:
Before you play, take a deep breath and be patient - you can do it!

In this game, you can roll and jump - and that’s it. With practice, you’ll be able to overcome any obstacle without pain or suffering. At this stage, go ahead and tell your friends about the game.

Fox Traps

Master insane jumps, overcome hilarious obstacles, and try not to lose your cool as you tumble your way to victory!

Meme characters

games.name: miniopolis
games.shortDescription: Create, shape, and customize a miniature metropolis with intuitive and satisfying tools. Construct towering cityscapes, fine-tune their look and layout, and give every structure its own distinctive character. Build the way you want in this resource-free city-building sandbox.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Miniopolis, the minimal city builder where you create small cities using intuitive voxel-like tools. The controls are simple: Drag a selection box and extrude (or subtract) blocks. In addition to the six main building blocks, lights, trees, and utility blocks let you add detail and life to the world.

Miniopolis has detailed graphical and Ray-Tracing options, and the weather/environment settings are always under your control. Enjoy your city in bright sunshine, at sunset, or set the mood with nighttime fog and rain. Want to make your city feel like a miniature model, or prefer to walk through it on foot? Multiple lighting environments, optional post-processing filters, and full control over depth of field settings help set the scene.

Sit back and relax as you construct a city/structure/whatever-you-like with no worries about zoning, utilities, or unhappy citizens. Focus on perfecting a single building at a time, or rough in an urban layout with roads and boxy structures, then refine each part in whatever order you want.

games.name: Soulscape2 Fragments of The Present
games.shortDescription: Dive into a dark cyber noir conspiracy in this solo developed, story rich CRPG. Set in a dystopian near future, guide Blake Turner and his squad through isometric exploration, deeply strategic turn-based combat, branching dialogue, and infinite post game progression.
games.aboutText:
The Year is 2194. Union Spire, an American West Coast metropolis, is choking under the grip of Cyberpulse, a ruthless, profit-driven mega-corporation. You are Blake Turner, a former Cyberpulse special ops operative who survived a corporate assassination attempt and was left for dead. Saved in your dying moments by a loyal group of friends and former colleagues, you must band together to expose the dark, secret project that put a target on your back.

Soulscape 2: Fragments of the Present is a story-rich, turn-based CRPG set in a gritty dystopian future. Built from the ground up as a solo developed passion project and brought to life by a full human voice cast, this psychological adventure forces you to confront heavily armed corporate hit squads, complex relationships, and your own inner demons.

Turn-Based Combat

Battle using an old-school turn-based tactical combat system that will force Blake and his party to go head-to-head against mechanized robotic defense systems. Designed by Cyberpulse - these machines, as well as their agents, are trying to stop the party from uncovering the truth.

Point and Click Adventure Mechanics

Explore, investigate and uncover the truth about the world surrounding Blake and his companions. Unravel what's really happening in these eerie corporate settings, grungy bars and mystical science fiction research facilities.

Different Narratives, & Relationships

Take charge of relationships with your squad members by romancing or distrusting them as you journey together. Your decisions will impact whether the party will grow closer or the conflict will cause a rift. Different endings will influence how you shape your story.

Rich Cutscenes and Cinematic RPG

The CRPG experience is supplemented by a rich variety of gameplay cutscenes to immerse and engage. Blake will feel the wrath of his enemies as he faces unparalleled internal and external threats. Will you succumb to your demonic lone-wolf tendencies and face threats alone? Or will you band together with your party and win as a team?

The story takes place in the year 2194 where Union Spire (U.S.) an American west coast city is under the clutches of a morally lacking, profit-driven nefarious corporation called Cyberpulse. You play as Blake Turner, a former Cyberpulse ex-operative who has survived an attempted assassination by his corporation and left to die. Joined by a group of childhood friends and romantic interests from Cyberpulse who save you in your dying breath to uncover the secret project of Cyberpulse that led to Blake’s attempted assassination, you must fight your way to find out the truth.

KEY FEATURES :

- Tactical Turn-Based Comba t: Engage in old-school, deeply strategic party combat. Go head-to-head against Cyberpulse 's mechanized robotic defense systems and elite corporate agents trying to bury the truth.

- Infinite Post-Game Progression : The battle doesn't stop when the story ends. Continue playing after the credits roll, with Blake and his companions' stats scaling infinitely for massive tactical replay value.

- Point & Click Investigation : Explore, investigate, and unravel the mystery. Scour eerie corporate setups, grungy neon-lit bars, and mystical sci-fi research facilities to piece together the conspiracy.

- Deep Relationships & Romance : Take charge of your squad's dynamics. Choose to romance, trust, or isolate your companions as you journey together. Your decisions will either forge an unbreakable team or cause a fatal rift.

- Cinematic RPG Narrative : Immerse yourself in a branching storyline supplemented by rich gameplay cutscenes. Will you succumb to your demonic lone-wolf tendencies, or band together and survive as a team? Your choices directly shape the multiple endings.

games.name: Flowers and Deities
games.shortDescription: Flowers and Deities is a roguelite auto battler where you command a blood-soaked lizardman army through escalating arena battles, spending every drop of spilled blood to cast spells, summon creatures, and survive long enough to earn the favor of the Gods.
games.aboutText:
Flowers and Deities is a roguelite auto battler set in a rainforest world ruled by bloodthirsty gods. Build your army, arrange your formation, and fight your way through deadly arenas. Sacrifice your soldiers, spill blood, and use it to cast spells and summon creatures.

Choose from 4 origins and faiths that define your playstyle from the first fight. Battle across multiple grand arenas against 15+ races and 125+ unique unit types. Face noble legions, barbarian tribes, underworld horrors, and alien visitors. Defeat them, and conscript them into your own ranks.

The build space is expansive: 12 tactical archetypes, 300+ magical items, 100+ divine blessings, and 50+ status effects. A flexible equipment and slot system lets you experiment freely, counter enemy weaknesses mid-run, and find combinations the gods never intended.

Blood is your most precious resource. Every unit lost - no matter yours or theirs - fills the pool. Spend it to turn the tide. Combat arena getting dry? Sacrifice your kin and claw out that victory with the power Gods bestow upon you.

Key Features

- 4 origins and faiths - distinct starting builds that shape your entire run

- 125+ unique units across 15+ races - recruit enemies you defeat and grow your legion

- Vast build space - 12 archetypes, 300+ items, 100+ blessings, 50+ status effects

- Blood is resource - every death fuels your next move

- 6 grand arenas - escalating enemies including barbarian tribes, underworld horrors, alien visitors, and legendary beasts

games.name: BAKU -バク-
games.shortDescription: BAKU is a single-player spot-the-difference game. Save the troubled animals by eating their nightmares. However, there is a secret to this story.
games.aboutText:
Spot the Difference × ADV (Adventure Game)

You are Baku.

Today, once again,
an animal has come to you
complaining of insomnia.

Eat their nightmares
and save these troubled animals.

However, there is a secret to this story. Overview

'BAKU' is a
single-player mistake-finding game.
Compare the illustrations on the left and right to find the mistakes.
The ending will branch depending on the results of the mistake-finding.

Playing time
1–2 hours

*Our circle creates games with playing times that are easy to play in live videos and streams. 【Notes】

games.name: Megastore Simulator
games.shortDescription: Megastore Simulator is a first-person management & tycoon game. Choose your starting department and build a massive two-floor megastore! Unlock 1,000+ unique products across 11 departments, from clothing to butchery. Hire staff and manage warehouse logistics with forklifts and pallet jacks.
games.aboutText:
BUILD YOUR MEGASTORE

Start with $400 ; choose a department from butchery , clothing, toys, bakery, sports, grocery, or music ; buy your first shelves and products, open for business, and grow.

EXPLORE 1,000+ UNIQUE PRODUCTS ACROSS 11 DEPARTMENTS

Your starting department is just the beginning! Unlock over 1,000 products across 11 departments , from groceries, clothing, and electronics to toys, bakery, seafood, butchery, seasonal goods, and more. Keep expanding your megastore with new products and departments!

KEEP EVERY SHELF STOCKED

Monitor all departments, refill shortages fast, and don’t miss sales.

DEPARTMENT-SPECIFIC FEATURES

Some departments offer unique, hands-on mechanics! Bake fresh goods in your bakery, cut and grind meat in the butchery, and prepare seafood for your customers.

MORE BOXES, FEWER TRIPS

Forget carrying boxes one by one! Use hand trucks, pallet jacks, forklifts, and more to transport multiple boxes at once, reduce unnecessary trips, and make restocking faster and easier.

GROW & EXPAND

Expand your megastore in any direction by purchasing new sections.

UNLOCK THE SECOND FLOOR

Open the upper floor to offer more space to your customers. Place departments wherever you like and make sure everything stays accessible.

MANAGE YOUR TEAM

Hire cashiers, restockers, unloaders, bakers, seafood clerks, butchers, and more! Review job applications, hire the best candidates, and manage shifts to build an efficient team that keeps your megastore running smoothly.

WAREHOUSE & LOGISTICS

Build and manage a massive warehouse with 8 truck loading docks and cold storage facilities.

Equip your warehouse with forklifts, reach trucks, pallet jacks, and pallet stackers to handle your growing inventory.

Hire unloaders and restockers to manage deliveries, organize stock, and keep your shelves filled. Monitor your entire operation with stock control panels and warehouse displays as your megastore grows!

AND MUCH MORE

- Attract more customers to your megastore with ads and product promotions .

- Bring your store to life with talking, reactive NPCs .

- Boost satisfaction with a returns desk .

- Buy recycling bins and turn empty boxes into cash .

- Decorate your megastore the way you like with department-specific decorations and furniture : fitting rooms, various wall and floor customizations, a bakery tray rack , and much more.

games.name: The Dream Globe
games.shortDescription: Idler game inside an antique dream globe, build the small home and help the mini dream world grow
games.aboutText:
As a dream world guardian, help to build the tiny home inside your globe.

No deep strategy or buildings—just a cute little world you can check in on every now and then.

Game Features:

- F ull Idler
They live independently within the Dream Globe

- Strategic Assistance
Help buy upgrades to boost efficiency

- Treasure Trove
Discover 100+ gemstones, crops & foods

- Various Dream Region
With different scenes and resources

games.name: Touch of Madness
games.shortDescription: In this 2D Survival-Horror, you switch between two protagonists as you advance through the story: Neo, a man lost in his own mind, trying to survive an endless nightmare, and Lavina, a loyal friend who will do anything to try to save him.
games.aboutText:
- A deep, abstract story with multiple subliminal messages for player interpretation, featuring hand-drawn cutscenes .

- With a minimalist art style , at certain points you will traverse the same environments in different realities.

- Neo – Gameplay focused on combat against enemies using firearms.

- Lavina – Gameplay focused on exploration , uncovering more about the story and hiding from enemies when necessary.

games.name: Stellar Witch
games.shortDescription: "Stellar Witch" is a grid-dodge action game with inventory management. Become a star-powered witch on a journey to become the Grand Mage. Collect gold in battle, buy and place constellations, and use their powers and synergies to fight ever-stronger enemies.
games.aboutText:
Become a Stellar Witch and engage in magical battles across the cosmos!

Harness the power of constellations and grow into a powerful grand sorceress!

Defeat waves of powerful enemies, collect gold, and acquire even stronger constellation tiles.

How long can you survive against increasingly stronger foes?

Game Overview

Stellar Witch is a unique inventory-management + dodge-action roguelike game where you become a witch mastering the power of constellations.

It features strategic constellation placement and fast reflex gameplay.

Game Features

- Strategic Inventory Management

- Collect constellation tiles in five tiers: Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Mythical.

- Each constellation has a unique size, shape, ability, and adjacency effect.

- Placing constellations next to each other can trigger special synergy effects.

- Find the optimal layout within limited space!

- Grid-based Real-Time Dodge Action

- Intense 1:1 battles against monsters

- Step on constellation tiles to instantly activate their powers.

- Combine attack, defense, and debuff abilities to your advantage.

- Read enemy patterns and move quickly to survive!

Try new constellation setups each time and see how long you can survive against ever-stronger enemies!

games.name: Stop Breaking My Castle!
games.shortDescription: A peaceful demon castle is attacked daily by heroes who smash walls and defeat monsters, turning it into a hunting ground. As the Demon Lord, you summon and evolve monsters to defend your home and stop the relentless heroes.
games.aboutText:
"Stop Breaking My Castle!" is a game designed from the perspective of monsters who are always getting beaten up.

Every day, heroes invade the peaceful Demon Lord’s castle, killing monsters and smashing the castle walls before leaving.
The Demon Lord and the monsters just want to live normal lives, but it’s been a long time since their home turned into someone else’s hunting ground for leveling up.

As the player, you become the Demon Lord, summoning and evolving monsters to stop the heroes.

Summon and place monsters.

Summon monsters to defend against invading heroes!

Heroes, driven by money and fame, have attacked the demon tribe who were living peacefully.

Summon monsters to stop the heroes and protect the peace of the demon tribe.

Auto Battle

Punish the heroes with the summoned monsters!

It's time to show the heroes, who were after gold and experience, the bitter taste of fear.

Monsters fight automatically, so strategic placement is necessary!

Evolution

Evolve your monsters and make them stronger!

It’s not just the heroes who get to level up.

Punish the heroes who invade for experience points with even more powerful monsters!

Over 20 powerful types of monsters are waiting to be summoned!

Grinding

Defeating heroes drops gold!

You can collect it with your mouse (a cute bat can help you, too).

Looting isn’t just for heroes. Invading heroes must leave everything behind.

Of course, if a monster falls, you can gather their souls to gain experience!

games.name: Deckstination
games.shortDescription: Deckstination is a real-time combat and deck-building hybrid. In this action roguelike, players use customized skill decks to overcome enemies in battles. Combine randomly drawn skills to survive intense encounters and take control of the battlefield with your own actions and strategy.
games.aboutText:
Build Your Own Skill Deck

Remove unnecessary skills and create powerful skill chains to control the flow of battle.

Collect and combine skill cards to craft your perfect deck.

Moment-to-Moment Decision-Making Leads the Battle

The battle never stops.
In the midst of randomly appearing cards every moment, choose the skill you need most right now.
Resources are limited, and opportunities are fleeting.

Strategic Synergy in Card Combinations

Winning is not just about having the strongest cards.

You must quickly judge and combine cards to create powerful chains.

Your Decisions Are the Art of Battle

Instant judgment, perfected decks.
Your choices and your deck are the key to survival.

Key Features

- Real-time card selection and tactical action

- Pressure of limited resources and spontaneous choices

- Strategy design based on synergy between cards

games.name: Wastelanders
games.shortDescription: Survival looks ugly, but the ugly survive. Wastelanders is a dystopian turn-based deckbuilder where desperation corrupts deeper than the alien Waste. Defend Humanity's last haven, and pray they never look too closely, lest they see the Waste has already taken your beauty.
games.aboutText:
Uncover the Wasteland’s secrets… and find your mom?

A catastrophic meteor strike brings civilization to the brink, covering the planet’s surface in an alien substance known as the Waste. The city of New Haven, the sole beacon of humanity, stands alone amidst a desolate Wasteland, held afloat by harnessing the Waste’s extraterrestrial power and defended by an intrepid force of explorers and researchers – the NITES. But all’s not well in the desert, and in the wake of her mother’s disappearance, Jackie, an aspiring NITES soldier, is determined to follow in her footsteps and uncover what’s really out there in the Wasteland.

Key Features

Dual-Deck Synergy : Each weapon deck boasts a unique theme with a powerful identity-defining buff, like the Staff's Flow and the Pistol's Accuracy. Draft skill cards from two weapon decks at once to assemble the combat deck, harnessing their unique buffs to discover devastating synergies within the web of carefully designed tactical possibilities. Selecting the right cards allows you to chain together devastating combos, dish out damage, and prevent your enemies from retaliating during a Clash.

Unique Turn-Based Clashes : Meet your opponent’s attacks head-on by countering their moves with your own! Gone are the days of standing idly by as you politely wait for the opponent's attacks before you make your own. Opponents go head-to-head on the battlefield with their attacks, forming Clashes where only the strongest move connects! Consider the order of your actions carefully to sequence buffs, blocks, and combos to ensure enemy attacks never stand a chance at landing. Offense is the best defense! Learn to exploit Clashes and the Waste creatures will never stand a chance against you.

Fully hand-drawn pixel art : Wastelanders showcases a modern twist on the classic 8-bit pixel art.

Immersive narrative : Experience the story of Jacqueline "Jackie" Page and leave your mark in the pages of New Haven. Adventure into the Wasteland, defeat Waste creatures under overwhelming odds, and find the traces left behind by Jackie's Mom. The Wasteland hides its secrets deep in its alien landscape, but the NITES hide something even more horrifying within the walls of New Haven. Perhaps the two are more entwined than they let on.

games.name: Starshard Brigands
games.shortDescription: Starshard Brigands is a first-person dungeon crawler with grid-based movement, where shifting loyalties and hard choices shape your fate. As a nameless mercenary in a fractured world, decide where you stand—or stand alone.
games.aboutText:
Forge your gear, feast at the tavern, take up the guild's quests.

Plunge into the abyss, seize its treasures, slay the masters that lurk within.

Every relic you claim — offer it to the factions, or keep it as your own arsenal.

Alliances forged, grudges earned, rivals breathing down your neck.

A shifting power map, redrawn by your every choice.

Turn it all into strength, and descend even deeper——

Your Choices Determine Friend and Foe —— Dynamic Agency

- Relic Offerings : Surrender your treasures to earn a faction's trust — or keep them hidden and turn them into power. Your call shapes the story and the rewards.

- Rival Party Encounters : Other parties roam the dungeon with their own agendas. Cross paths with them, and anything can happen.

- Faction Hub Expansion : The more you contribute to a faction, the more they offer in return — exclusive gear unlocks, facility upgrades, and growing influence.

Read the Battle, Turn the Tide —— Tactical Command Battle

- Break & Follow-up System : Exploit enemy weaknesses to shatter their guard, triggering ally follow-up attacks that lock them down and leave them helpless.

- Counter & Parry : Time your inputs to nullify incoming damage and immediately strike back with a devastating counterattack.

- The Crawl & Craft Cycle : Gather materials in the dungeon, craft and appraise gear at your hub — then dive back in stronger than before.

Push Past Your Limits —— Build & Loot

- Classless Character Creation : Mix and match race, stats, appearance, weapon proficiency, and backstory to forge a playstyle entirely your own — no class restrictions, no compromises.

- Vast Constellation Skill Tree : Chart your own path through a sprawling, non-linear skill tree to build combinations that transcend any single class archetype .

- Random Affixes : Every piece of equipment rolls its own set of abilities — even two weapons of the same name can play completely differently.

games.name: Oeuf
games.shortDescription: 3D physics-platformer where you are an egg! Roll, hop and slide your way back home.
games.aboutText:
- Simple controls: just roll and jump!

- Explore co-op with your friends online!

- Snazzy LEVEL EDITOR with Steam Workshop support! (needs keyboard+mouse)

- Calm, rainy atmosphere: No enemies, no timers; you can take your time and soak up the atmosphere.

- A medium-sized adventure: 4-10 hours playtime for a new player.

- Original soundtrack: four hours of mostly chill music :)

Roll home, little egg! <3

games.name: Kaelaverse: Pemascape
games.shortDescription: Kaela Kovalskia of Hololive ID has gone missing! Play as her army of assistants, the Pemaloe, and set off to explore caves, dungeons, and mazes and discover the truth about Kaela's whereabouts!
games.aboutText:
In the countryside lived a renowned blacksmith and her band of assistants. This blacksmith's forge was well known by many to be one of the best in the land!

One day, the blacksmith known as Kaela Kovalskia has suddenly gone missing! Completely lost on what to do, Kaela's assistants, known as the Pemaloe, sets off to find her.

Play as Pemaloe in this action puzzle platformer to adventure through caves, dungeons, mine shafts, and more to find the hidden secrets of the ancient underground forge. Solve puzzles, fight off possessed monsters, and jump your way through dungeons to learn the truth of Kaela Kovalskia's whereabouts.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
