games.name: Sujefa
games.shortDescription: Sujefa is co-op puzzle platformer where two players can play as Rock, Paper or Scissors. Work together to solve puzzles and reach the end. Play online or locally on a shared screen.
games.aboutText:
Sujefa is a cooperative 2D puzzle-platformer made specifically for two players. Every level is designed around teamwork: communicating, coordinating, and using each character’s strengths and weaknesses to solve challenges together.

Each player chooses to play as Rock, Paper, or Scissors. Rock must avoid Paper, Paper must avoid Scissors, and Scissors must avoid Rock.

Solve 40 levels filled with platforming, cooperating and puzzle solving built around rock, paper and scissors.

You can play online with a friend or share a single screen locally.

games.name: Wheelchair Wizards
games.shortDescription: Wheelchair Wizards is a 2-8 player party game where you battle your friends while upgrading your wizard.
games.aboutText:
Wheelchair Wizards is a 2-8 player party game where you battle your friends while upgrading your wizard.

- 3 Maps with 17+ Levels

- 20+ Spells

- 30+ Upgrades

- Team Gamemode

- Workshop Support

- Award Winning Rapping

games.name: Infinite Cards
games.shortDescription: Discover infinite cards in this roguelike deckbuilder. Every card is unique, every run a new experience. Craft, combine, and build your deck completely freely to defeat enemies and bosses, or take on cleverly designed puzzle challenges!
games.aboutText:
Infinite Cards is a truly unique and innovative card game.

In this roguelike deck builder, every card is unique. Cards are generated randomly based on defined rules, creating an endless number of possible cards to discover.

Focus on Synergies

Play units, relics, or spells to overwhelm your enemies.

Strong synergies between cards lead to deep gameplay with countless tactical options.

Choose a commander with unique abilities that shape your strategy, and unlock new commanders as you progress through the game.

Progression and Deck Building

The further you advance in a run, the stronger your card rewards become.

This creates a dynamic experience where you keep evolving your deck until the very end.

Thanks to completely free deck building, you can add or remove cards at any time to perfectly adjust your strategy.

Features:

- Infinite cards and massive replay value

- Beginner friendly with interactive tutorial

- Adjustable difficulty with increasingly challenging Torment levels

- Deep, tactical gameplay through complex card synergies

- 20+ commanders with unique playstyles

- 10+ factions: Play as humans, dragons, skeletons, and many more

- 7 locations with their own enemies and bosses across 5 difficulty tiers

- Find, buy, create, and upgrade cards during your run

- Fully flexible deck building: Add or remove cards at any time

- Additional puzzle challenges for strategists

- Customizable runs with preset game modes or your own challenges using Modifiers

- Customize your cards with your own images using custom artwork

Puzzle Challenges

For tacticians and puzzle fans, the game offers a special puzzle mode:

Start with a preset battlefield and win in just a few turns.

Perfect for exploring new combinations and card synergies.

games.name: Lucid Clowder
games.shortDescription: A fast paced weapon based movement shooter, keep on moving and try to predict your opponents movements.
games.aboutText:
!!! Important !!!

this game will not get content or bug fix updates anymore. please do not spend your money.

? This is a fast paced shooter with emphasis on movement, keep on moving and try to predict your opponents movements.

? Choose between a selection of weapons, each with their specialties and a secondary skill.

? Wepons change the move and reload speed of the user depending on their weight class. wepons have infinite reserve ammo and reload automatically when you dont attack for a while.

? How to play :

- Move with w a s d,

- Jump and double jump with space,

- Shoot with left click,

- Use secondary with right click,

- Dash with shift. You can also perform a super jump by pressing the jump button at the end of a dash to cover great distance,

- Scracth with R or mouse 4

games.name: Bitsies: I Caught a Strange Creature Roaming on My Desktop and Now I Raise Them in My Tiny Garden
games.shortDescription: A desktop hunting game. Catch tiny creatures that appear on your desktop, bring them to your peaceful garden 🏝️ Take care of them as they grow, evolve, and fill your space with quiet cozy life.
games.aboutText:
Strange little creatures begin appearing on your desktop, soft, curious, and harmless.
Catch and bring them home to your tiny garden, and watch as they settle into their new habitat.

Bitsies offers a calm and comforting experience, turning your desktop into a small living world that grows alongside your day. Whether you’re working, relaxing, or simply taking a break, your garden is always there, peaceful, warm, and full of quiet surprises.

🌱 FEATURES (Cozy & Relaxed Tone)

- Gently Catch Desktop Creatures
Bitsies wander across your screen from time to time, waiting to be discovered.

- Grow Your Own Tiny Garden
A soothing little space that lives on your desktop, always nearby.

- Care for Your Bitsies
Feed them, nurture them, and create a space where they feel safe and happy.

- Watch Them Grow & Evolve
See your creatures change over time as they flourish in your garden.

- Breed New Variations
Encourage your Bitsies to form new bonds and create unique offspring.

- Collect Many Different Species
Find rare Bitsies, discover gentle personalities, and build your own peaceful ecosystem.

- A Calm Desktop Companion
Enjoy a soft, relaxing presence that accompanies you throughout your day.

games.name: Tainted ground
games.shortDescription: Co-op horror mystery for 2-4 players with no combat, only clues. Search a tainted forest by day, hold the cabin through paranormal nights, and solve co-op puzzles to uncover the ritual that changes every run.
games.aboutText:
The forest won't forgive. The night will consume you. The only way out is to understand how.

A ritual lies hidden within the forest. The conditions needed to perform it change every run. To escape, your team must investigate, interpret the clues, and uncover the truth before the forest claims you.

Daylight is your only ally, and it won't last long.

Split up across the forest and investigate its key locations: abandoned ruins, forgotten graves, and some others. Search for clues scattered across the world in ways you won't expect.

Every discovery is recorded in a shared diary. Every clue matters. What seems insignificant could be the missing piece that changes everything.

When the sun sets, return to the cabin.

It is the last refuge left in the forest, but safety is never guaranteed. Paranormal events manifest throughout the night, testing everything you've learned during the day.

Identify the threat. Find the correct countermeasure. Act before the cabin pays the price.

At the same time, you'll need to keep the generator running, manage the electrical system, and prevent darkness from taking over. Surviving the night requires knowledge, coordination, and calm under pressure.

There is a way to purify the forest.

Each session generates a unique ritual built from shifting variables. Success depends on observation, deduction, and communication, not combat, upgrades, or equipment.

The answers exist within the world. Finding them is up to you.

- Co-op Multiplayer (up to 4 players): cooperation is at the heart of every investigation.

Split up to cover more ground, share discoveries, compare theories, and decide which clues matter before nightfall. Survival depends on what the group can figure out together.

- Cooperative investigation for up to 4 players. Split up, share what you find, and piece together the mystery as a team.

- Knowledge is your only weapon. No combat, no upgrades. Progress comes from understanding, not from gear.

- A living, threatening cabin. Manage the generator, counter paranormal events, and keep the darkness at bay. Every night is a new fight.

- Every clue exists within the world. No menus, no quest markers, no handholding. If you want answers, you'll have to find them yourself.

- A procedural mystery system. Each run generates a different ritual, forcing players to investigate, adapt, and draw new conclusions every time. There are no shortcuts. The only way forward is to understand how the forest works.

- A structured day/night cycle that creates rhythm, escalation, and a constant sense of urgency.

Investigate. Endure. Escape.
The forest has swallowed many before you. Whether it swallows you too depends entirely on what you can figure out.

games.name: Magical Greenhouse
games.shortDescription: Magical Greenhouse is a cozy simulation game where you manage your own potion shop. Your clients, creatures and adventurers of all kinds have strange requests. You will have to be inventive to create the perfect potion for every situation!
games.aboutText:
Welcome Young Alchemist! 🌿

Magical Greenhouse is a cozy simulation game where you manage your own potion shop. Take care of your plants in the Greenhouse, use the Workshop alembic to make potions, organize your shop and grow your business!

Take care of Plants 🌿

Buy magical plants, take care of them and harvest the fruits of your work! You have to manage your Energy wisely to be able to take care of all your plants, and even boost them with your magic power.

Experiment with Potions 🔮

Use ingredients to make potions and remedies via the alembic. You have the choice to craft potions following known recipes or to create potions in an empirical way, losing sometimes the ingredients but also discovering new potions.

Customize your Greenhouse 🎉

Add some decors and customize the plant pots so it matches the color theme you want! Decors are pretty but they’re also useful, as they have special effects boosting your business capacities (plant growth, craft, energy, automation...)

Fill the Quests 📚

The Villagers, creatures and adventurers of all kinds living nearby, have strange requests for you. You will have to be inventive to create the perfect potion for every situation!

Features

In Magical Greenhouse, you will expect:

- a Chill Adventure of 3 to 5 hours were you control the game rhythm 
- 24 Magical Plants to Collect, Grow and Harvest 
- 70 Potions to Discover and Experiment with 
- 15+ Decorations to Customize your own shop 
- 85+ Quests from Villagers where you’ll influence the village storyline

Development Team

We’re a small indie team : Lya Mgtt (Illustrator & Designer) creating this colorful universe and Yorack (Developper) bringing our idea to life. We’ve been passionate by video games since a long time, and Magical Greenhouse is our first commercial project ! Our objective is to create a bubble of softness, a short adventure in a peaceful universe, and we hope you’ll like it! ✨
Music by the amazing Samantha van der Sluis 🌸

games.name: Don't Let Me Fade
games.shortDescription: Don't Let Me Fade is an interactive adventure about memory, identity, and loss. Piece together fragments of a life - even if a simple teddy bear is the last symbol of connection to oneself in a world without time.
games.aboutText:
Don't Let Me Fade: adventure, interractive narrative [created in 48 hours as part of GG-jam 2025 ]

A narrative exploration game about memory, identity, and the slow unraveling of time.

Created during a 48-hour game jam, Don’t Let Me Fade invites players into a poetic and emotional journey through the mind of a man losing himself to Alzheimer’s.

A World Without Time

The jam's theme, "A World Without Time," is interpreted here as a metaphor for Alzheimer’s - a fading world where memories slip away, and the boundary between past and present becomes unclear. Time has no meaning when memory itself is dissolving.

The Story

You play as an elderly man wandering through surreal, dreamlike environments stitched together from fragments of his memories… or is it his present reality?
As you explore, you’ll piece together the outline of a life once filled with love, family, joy - and inevitable loss. The man is searching for a teddy bear, convinced it’s his last remaining link to who he truly is.

Gameplay & Mechanics

- Short narrative experience (~10–15 minutes)

- Interactive story fragments reveal themselves as you explore

- No combat or puzzles - just presence, memory, and atmosphere

- Simple first-person movement through fading spaces

Soundtrack

An atmospheric, emotionally layered soundtrack by Aink aka. Anna Glaid guides you through the shifting tone of the journey - from warmth and clarity to uncertainty and silence. The tracks Forget-Me-Not and Why does the heart beat were composed and recorded entirely during the jam.

A fragile farewell to memory, identity, and everything we hold dear.

Will you remember what he cannot?

Play now, and step into a fading world.

games.name: Imouto Paradise! 3
games.shortDescription: Imopara 3 is a visual novel developed by MOONSTONE Cherry, a sub-brand of the renowned Japanese bishoujo game company MOONSTONE. With themes of youth, growth, and adventure, this heartwarming classic is now available on Steam with Simplified Chinese support.
games.aboutText:
《极乐妹土！3》是由日本知名美少女游戏公司 MOONSTONE 的旗下品牌 MOONSTONE Cherry 制作的以「青春」「成长」「冒险」为主题的视觉小说游戏。本次 Steam 版支持简体中文，繁体中文，兼容最新的 Windows 系统，旨在作为一款温暖人心的经典作品，为每一位玩家带来心灵上的感动！

游戏简介

暑假期间，七濑家的父母

因工作关系出差在外。

主人公——也就是哥哥你

要和五位妹妹一起在家度过暑假。

主人公希望趁此机会

与妹妹们增进家人间的默契和配合，

妹妹们也格外热情地参与家庭活动，

一家人在暑假里发生了许多有趣的小插曲……

七濑家的兄妹们

究竟会在彼此陪伴的过程中收获多少成长与感动呢？

登场角色

- 七濑樱

●配音声优：花澤さくら

●专属台词：“早上好哥哥，早饭马上就做好咯”

●基本信息：

七濑家的大女儿。

有着包容一切，温柔的性格。

对主人公有关的事物十分上心

凡事都会优先考虑他的感受。

不擅长训人和生气。

家务全包绰绰有余，其中最喜欢做饭。

- 七濑理香

●配音声优：結城ほのか

●专属台词：“真是的，哥！别老乱开腔啊！！”

●基本信息：

七濑家的二女儿。

认真又品行端正，在学校担任班委的优等生。

对吊儿郎当的主人公会有点爱唠叨。

因其傲娇的性格，

有的时候嘴会比较毒，

虽然嘴上总是抱怨，其实最尊敬主人公了。

- 七濑日向

●配音声优：赤井リア

●专属台词：“哥哥，日向向可是个‘小大人’哦？”

●基本信息：

七濑家的小女儿。

性格文静乖巧，深受大家喜爱。

虽然有点笨手笨脚，

但做什么事都会拼命努力。

特别在意被认为幼稚的行为，总是装出一副大人的模样。

- 七濑阳春

●配音声优：水瀬ゆき

●专属台词：“哥，来玩呀♪ 或・者・说，来・玩・游・戏？”

●基本信息：

七濑家的四女儿。

性格超级开朗，天真烂漫。

特别喜欢运动、游戏和漫画。

对其他事情兴趣寥寥，平时懒懒散散地混日子。

被当作女孩子对待时，会表现出可爱的一面。

- 七濑若榴

●配音声优：みたか りん

●专属台词：“兄长大人是我重要的家人哦……呵呵呵”

●基本信息：

七濑家的三女儿。

表面是冷艳美人，内在却难以捉摸的神秘系女子。

拥有独特感性，永远我行我素。

学生身份却已是出道小说家。

是擅长创作情感类故事的资深作家。

制作团队

- 企划·专属场景原案：伊東ライフ

- 原画：日向奈尾

- 剧本：藤井和敏

- Q版角色：桜坂つちゆ

- CG：rastel、芝、八月朔日 珈瑠、るきつら。、日向奈尾

- 设计：アルトステージ

- 背景美术：アトリエてっち

- BGM：solfa

- 专属场景动画&OP视频：菱野優希(JamJamHouse)

- 系统监修：薫(retouch.info)

- 协力：呉

- 监制&导演：恋純ほたる

- 制作·著作：MOONSTONE

games.name: POSTAL 2 Redux
games.shortDescription: POSTAL 2 Redux lets you loose in the most chaotic sandbox shooter ever, fully reimagined for a new generation. Survive a week in Paradise, Arizona - buy milk, return books, or go completely POSTAL with an arsenal of weapons. The choice is yours…but good luck staying out of trouble.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Paradise—Try Not to Burn It Down.

You’ve got a week’s worth of errands. Buy some milk. Return an overdue library book. Maybe get Gary Coleman’s autograph. Simple enough, right? But this is POSTAL 2 Redux - where a normal day can spiral into absolute carnage at a moment’s notice, and the only thing more unpredictable than your to-do list is the lunatic freakshow that calls this town home.

For the first time ever, POSTAL 2 is fully reimagined for the new generation, bringing its dark humor, open-world mayhem, and unapologetic absurdity to an entirely new level. Step into the well-worn boots of The POSTAL Dude, a hapless everyman just trying to get through the week in the bizarre town of Paradise, Arizona. Whether you choose to play it cool or go completely POSTAL is entirely up to you.

Unleash Chaos—Or Don’t.

Paradise is your playground, and how you interact with it is entirely up to you. Be a law-abiding citizen or let loose with an arsenal of insane weapons, from gasoline and matches to the infamous cat silencer, lob grenades, or take a more… personal approach with physics-driven melee combat. Every choice you make fuels the town’s dynamic AI, leading to unpredictable encounters, spontaneous riots, and absolute bedlam.

A Living, Breathing Open World (Full of Weirdos and Trouble)

Explore the world at your own pace, taking on daily errands in a non-linear sandbox filled with unpredictable NPCs, interactive environments, and absurdly detailed physics. Meet (or antagonize) eccentric residents, dodge rampaging elephants, or take in the sights, including Krotchy’s Toy Store and Uncle Dave’s heavily armed religious cult.

So… how will you spend your week in Paradise?

games.name: Dogpile
games.shortDescription: Dogpile is a roguelike deck builder about merging cute dogs into bigger dogs. Play dogs, get money, customize your dogs with special Traits, refine your deck, PLAY MORE DOGS! DOGS!
games.aboutText:
When two of the same dog touch, BAM! You get a BIGGER dog. With careful placement, some clever purchases, and a can-do attitude, you can merge pups strategically and achieve the biggest dogs imaginable.

You really shouldn't adopt a dozen dogs, but now you can! Dogpile gets you to wrangle a cute collection of canines into the perfect deck, customize them, and play them expertly. Manage the clutter, upgrade and improve your cards as you go, and strive for the BIGGEST dogs.

Like in real life, dogs come with quirks and untapped potential! You’ll discover any variety of weird traits such as Barky, Sleepy, Timid, Cool and more. Take your dogs to the Dog Wash to add even more traits, and find Dog Tags that bolster and benefit from Trait synergy!

Utilize a clever array of powerful Dog Tags to modify how your dogs and their Traits function. Find interesting synergies and unique combos to aid you in all of your merging endeavors. And always remember your ultimate goal: BIGGER!

games.name: Tiny Birdtopia
games.shortDescription: This is not Bird Game 3! Build and manage a relaxing bird sanctuary. Collect and raise diverse bird species, and unlock hidden species by gathering feathers. Customize your Birdtopia with themes like forests and islands, and watch your birds thrive in this casual, idle game.
games.aboutText:
In Tiny Birdtopia , your PC desktop isn’t just your workspace—but your very own bird sanctuary! Whether you’re in a meeting, drafting a report, or browsing the web, you can effortlessly manage your feathered paradise. Collect and nurture birds, unlock hidden species, and customize your birdtopia to your heart’s content—turn every work break into a chorus of birdsong!

Every bird boasts its own unique plumage—gather their feathers to unlock secret, rare species! Explore the in-game Birddex to learn about each bird’s habits, habitats, and even listen to their distinctive calls. Whether you’re looking for a moment of calm or you’re a dedicated bird enthusiast, Tiny Birdtopia is the perfect pick-me-up between tasks!

As a relaxing idle game, your birds will grow over time while you focus on your work—just sit back and watch them thrive!

games.name: BLIGHTFALL
games.shortDescription: A fast-paced roguelike FPS built on momentum. Slide-jump, air-strafe, and bunny-hop through relentless hordes, chain mid-air dash-executions, charge shrines for loot, and break the game with stacked builds before time runs out. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.
games.aboutText:
╱╲ THE BLIGHT IS FALLING ╱╲

Spore and void reshape the realms into glowing fungal hellscapes. Blightcaps gather. Weepers call through the dark. Things not meant for living crawl from the rot.

Feed the shrines. Reap the wounded. Descend until the void claims what remains. ※ SLIDE // SHOOT // REAP ※

BLIGHTFALL is a fast-moving first-person horde shooter for 1–4 players. Slide beneath the swarm, dash through the wounded, and keep firing as the realm closes around you.

Weaken an enemy, then dash through it to REAP — an execution that restores health and can chain into your next victim.

Elites buckle. Bosses bleed. The horde keeps coming.

── THREAT // RISING ──

◆ time makes them stronger
◆ every realm raises the stakes
◆ every loop breaks the ceiling

keep moving // keep killing // do not be consumed ※ FEED THE SHRINES [▰▰▰▱▱] ※

Every realm is a gauntlet:

- THIN THE HORDE — carve through the swarm

- CHARGE THE SHRINES — hold the circle under pressure

- LOCATE THE RIFT — find the hidden teleporter

- BREACH THE VEIL — summon the guardian

- FACE THE ABYSS — kill the boss

- EMBRACE THE VOID — rearm and descend again

Leave a shrine and its charge begins to bleed. Stay inside and become the center of the horde.

Optional hunts, elite purges, challenge shrines, and hostile world events offer greater risks for greater rewards. ※ STACK THE BLOOM ※

Every item stacks. Every level changes the build.

- Draft upgrades across Vitality, Damage, Tempo, Mobility, Armor, Arcane, and Luck

- Collect stackable items from Common to Mythic

- Trigger lightning, fire, poison, frost, explosions, and void rifts

- Build for faster slides, additional jumps, longer dashes, and extra dash charges

- Equip a spell and an ultimate

- Spend Essence on chests and rerolls as prices climb

One stack begins the idea.

Ten stacks become the problem.

COMMON → UNCOMMON → RARE → EPIC → LEGENDARY → MYTHIC ※ GEAR UP // DESCEND ※

Choose a weapon, spell, and ultimate before entering the first realm. Survive and return to the shop between stages to rearm for the next descent.

The realm gets harder whether you are ready or not. ※ SOLO // 1–4 ONLINE CO-OP ※

Enter alone or bring up to three friends. Host through Steam or join with a lobby code. Enemy pressure and shrine progression scale with the party, while respawn shrines can restore fallen allies.

If everyone falls:

╳ CONSUMED ╳

the void claims all ※ LOOP // DESCEND // REPEAT ※

Complete challenges to unlock new items for future runs. Clear the realms, defeat their guardians, and enter the loop with everything you have built.

The threat does not reset. Each loop drives it higher until your build becomes unstoppable — or the blight eats the run.

FIRST-PERSON HORDE SHOOTER // ROGUELIKE RUNS // ONLINE CO-OP // REAP EXECUTIONS // SHRINE HOLDS // RIFT BOSSES // STACKABLE LOOT

games.name: ShellMobile: Titan Rampart
games.shortDescription: On the cosmic frontier, humanity has fought alien species for a century. As traditional defenses fall to new-gen alien mechs, tech giant ShellMobile—human-centered at its core—kindles new hope via breakthroughs in extraterrestrial titanium ore research.
games.aboutText:
Core Concept: Mechs as shells, guarding civilization.

ShellMobile takes its name from the idea that tech—like a nut protecting its pulp—sees mechs, warships, and stations as life's shields. Upholding "Machines for humanity," the company developed the Titanium Rampart Defense System after titanium refining breakthroughs, forming the unbreakable Titanium Rampart Line against aliens.

Core Element: Titanium

- Titanium Lifeline : Extraterrestrial titanium is humanity’s tech foundation. Players send miners to extract it for defense upgrades and mech production.

- Titanium Rampart Line : 5th-gen alloy walls blend alien materials with quantum lattice tech, equipped with self-adaptive nano-repairs that instantly rebuild plasma-damaged structures and deploy antimatter against "Ether-Eater" flyers.

Core Gameplay: Civilizational Clash, Tech Counterattack

After a decade’s hibernation, aliens return with "Venomfang" ground mechs (plasma drills) and "Ether-Eater" swarms (gravitational maneuvering). As commander, players must:

- Deploy Defenses : Install pulse EM cannons between titanium walls to intercept flyers.

- Mech Strikes : Lead Nut Shell forces in "Dawnbreaker" mechs with antimatter missiles.

- Resource Warfare : Dispatch agile miners for rare titanium, refined by the Titanium Matrix into:

- Energy Crystals (super units), Nano Components (repairs), Quantum Blueprints (tech unlocks).
Unlock weapons like Titanium Railguns and Dimensional Shields to fend off the horde.

games.name: Adorable Adventures
games.shortDescription: Play as Boris, a curious baby boar who must learn how to use his nose to reunite with his family after a forest fire. Explore beautiful landscapes, track scents, and uncover secrets as you slowly reconnect with nature in this cozy animal adventure.
games.aboutText:
Adorable Adventures is a relaxing third-person exploration game where you play as Boris, a curious baby boar who must learn to use his nose to reunite with his family, who were separated after a forest fire.

Across rolling meadows, sun-dappled forest paths, deep caves, and rocky highlands, identify scents and follow trails to learn more about the world around you. Search for your brothers and sisters, uncover secrets, and expand your library of smells against the backdrop of a gentle and heart-warming story.

A boar’s life

Play as a mischievous baby boar brimming with energy! Dash through open fields, root around dense undergrowth, scrabble over rocky ledges, and splash about in cool riverbeds.

Explore the park

Traverse beautifully detailed environments inspired by the Cévennes National Park in Southern France. Take your time to enjoy its peaceful atmosphere and soothing natural sounds.

Follow your nose

Use Boris’s developing sense of smell to follow scents and identify their source. Filter the smells that you have learned to navigate the park and make exciting discoveries.

Reunite with your family

Search far and wide for your wayward brothers and sisters, and convince them to join in your adventure by solving puzzles that match their individual personalities.

Easily distracted

Discover a collection of playful side activities. Compete in time trial races, master photography challenges, tidy up the park, and maybe even solve the mystery of a local legend?

A heart-warming tale

Let Maxime, the park ranger, guide you through Boris’ journey of growth and self-discovery, featuring adaptive storytelling and full voiceover.

Reconnect with nature

Track down and collect every scent in the park to unlock handwritten entries in Maxime’s journal, and decorate Boris with adorable accessories!

games.name: 缘之绳
games.shortDescription: 《缘之绳》是一款角色扮演多结局养成游戏。你自灵木中醒来，被清冷的剑仙师尊带回门派，成为了她唯一的弟子。在这未来的日子里，选择自己的道路，无论是刀枪剑戟、琴棋书画；还是采药掘矿、狩猎捕鱼，又或是锻打缝纫、制丹谱曲，相信你都能成就一番不俗的伟业。因缘际会之下，这段找寻身世的成长之旅，会邂逅怎样的故事，最终又会走向何方？
games.aboutText:
💖《缘之绳》是一款模拟养成类角色扮演回合制冒险游戏，你可以在游戏中尽情的选择喜欢的成长方向进行角色培养，邂逅性格迥异的侠女，找寻自己的身世之谜。

本作拥有着多达40种以上的职业结局，15种以上的感情结局，150张以上的剧情CG。

在这未知的江湖：

🔹你会选择怎样的趁手兵器与功法，在这世界闯荡，去寻找属于你的身世与意义？

🔹抓抓鱼、打打猎、挖挖矿、采采药，或许也能成就不俗的伟业？

🔹又或许你偏爱那琴棋书画，以文入道？

主角拥有多种养成路线可选择，并且拥有5种不同的武器类型，每种武器对应的招式与特性都完全不同，并且可根据解锁的队友灵活的进行队伍搭配来攻克更难的战斗。

故事背景：

数十年前，正魔纷争不休，世间水深火热。双方终约战于天倾谷，誓要一决雌雄。

是日，两道精锐尽出，激战天昏地暗，日月无光。然众人万万未曾料到，时至正午，苍穹蓦然一暗，空中竟裂开一道巨隙，无数域外天魔自其中蜂拥而出，见人便杀。

正魔两道至此境地，只得联手抗敌。奈何天魔战力凶悍无匹，各派人马死伤惨重。危亡之际，隐世多年的江湖巨擘纷纷来援。太玄掌门趁天魔势弱，联合众人拼死结阵，终将天痕弥合，逼退天魔，还得此世安宁。

此役过后，正魔两道偃旗息鼓三十载，休养生息，亦为防天魔再度降临。

江湖中诸多门派因失却支柱，传承遗落，逐渐消散于时光之中。

唯太玄与百相二宗，依然屹立于两道之巅。

数月前，太玄现任代掌门任念，自一处秘地激战中带回了尚还年少的你——“建木生”。

自你从灵木中苏醒之日起，这源洲停滞已久的命运之轮，已再度缓缓转动。

游戏特色：

🔶 每位角色独立故事线 ——我们设定了9位以上的可攻略女性角色，她们性格各异，有着各自的故事，你将如何与她们相识、相知、相爱？

🔶 与她们一同冒险 ——不同的角色到达一定的好感度之后即可邀请进入队伍，与她们一同携游江湖吧。

🔶 当然也少不了惊喜 ——不管是角色剧情中，还是日常交往中，你都有机会获得来自她们的心意，可能是一颗精心炼制的丹药、一件辛苦打造的装备、一块璀璨夺目的宝石，又或是——独属于她们的定情信物？

🔶 多周目 ——在多周目我们也设置了许多新内容，也许也会结识到新的朋友，让一些事件出现预料之外的变化呢？

🔶 邀约 ——到达一定好感等级后可以邀约对应的角色出游，在不同的场景里去尽情的培养感情吧。

游戏中有多种养成玩法

好感玩法 ——与场景中偶遇角色，触发各式各样的小事件，获取各种奖励。

小游戏 ——多项养成小游戏玩法，无论是狩猎、捕鱼，还是寻药采矿，总有一款是你的菜，舒适的成长曲线，还会有上百种普通、稀有、隐藏素材掉落。

场景探索 ——场景中会藏着各种各样的宝箱与隐藏道具供你寻找，也有某些特定时间才会出现的奇遇。

制造 ——丰富的制造系统，让你不管是锻造缝纫、还是炼药谱曲，都能收获不菲。

我们的缝纫/锻造/炼药系统拥有超200种配方，可在各种玩法渠道获取，不同的材料与灵材亦会解锁不同的效果，高等级的锻造更是会出现各类隐藏属性与词条，等您来体验！

悬榜系统 ——提升能力，接取各种各样的悬赏任务吧，也许会有非凡的际遇？

职业系统 ——数十种不同的职业，每种职业有着属于自己的天赋，快快来提升职业等级吧。

天赋系统 ——提升等级可以获取天赋点，是选择战斗类的进攻、防御、治疗？还是选择生产类？又或是社交类天赋路线？

种植系统 ——秘境中找到的奇异种子？商店里贩卖的枯枝？寻药获得的幼苗？快来峰内的田地里种下吧，会结出怎样的果实呢？

天气/季节系统 ——特定的天气当然会带来特定的事件，种植系统也会受到天气的影响。

商店 ——每回合会刷新各种各样的道具，还有隐藏商店等你去寻找。

喜欢战斗——秘境探索可以充分满足你，各种各样的怪物与奇遇等着你。

期间活动——锻冶大会、捕鱼大赛、炼药大赛、四艺大会、秋季围猎、七峰会武、少年英雄会，百无禁忌，皆可参与，若能取得名次，还将获得各种奇珍异宝。

小游戏——你是否厌倦了一成不变的小游戏玩法？本作设计的所有小游戏不仅好玩，还有大量成长空间，不同的专长等级会遇到上百种猎物、作物、渔获与矿物，不同的专长装备和天赋可以提升角色的各种性能，还有许多隐藏的稀有要素等你来体验，玩法中可获取的材料和其他数值也会随等级而提高！

秘境探索——秘境迷宫我们也设置了许多的随机要素，同样有着成长性，并且除了不同的迷宫地图，还有着难度等级的设置，随着选择难度的提高，会遇到更多的稀有精英与隐藏奇遇，掉落各种设计图纸、打造材料、成品装备、强化道具、武功秘籍等等奖励。

战斗系统：

经典的2D回合制战斗，会不会有点乏味？

那当然不会，我们设计了一套全新的战斗系统，让养成可以在战斗中充分提现的同时，也拥有优秀的体验感。

目前游戏还处于比较早期的状态，所以上图中并没有展现UI和战斗系统，还请大家稍微等待我们释出新的内容啦。

游戏内容：

内容——本作拥有至少120W字以上的文本量，每位可攻略角色都有不同的，属于他们的故事，并且拥有着数十种的表情差分。

角色互动——即使是日常课业中，也会随机遇到已经结识的角色，会有各种各样不同的事件和效果。

配音——本作暂定为重要剧情全配，非重要剧情用语气词配的形式去推进（看后续研发情况...）

剧本——本作主线和角色线路相对独立，所以在方向上会各有侧重。当然，角色线路这块基本都是甜甜的恋爱故事。

作者的话：

即使世界每天都变模样，但总得有不变的东西守候在时间的起点，不是吗？

大家好，我是记天，本作开发以来，其实满打满算，也只经过了4个月。

本作是一款比较重养成向的养成类武侠游戏。

从还没立项开始，我就已经思考了许许多多个日子，因为我本身也是一位非常喜欢养成类游戏的玩家，尤其是重养成类，但迟迟也见不到有新作面世，心灰意冷之际，也就想着自己动手做了。

于是下定决心，便一个人开始把制作组拉起来开工。

但真的开始做以后才发现，将这么多复杂的系统整合到一起，这真的不是一件简单的事，前辈们真的非常厉害，但我还是希望尽最大可能把它做完，做好。

目前的UI其实也不是很满意，不排除后面有推倒重来的可能。

没有什么大的梦想，也没有什么文学的抱负，只是想写一些大家看着能开心的故事罢了。

DEMO预计会在9月左右上线，还请大家耐心等待，后续也会开放众筹渠道（跪谢了！

games.name: Battle On! Hero Academy
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Battle On! Hero Academy! In this desktop idle game, you are the dean. Recruit heroes and plan their careers from swordsmen to paladins. Your heroes battle and grow. Reap the rewards, then lead your upgraded team against epic bosses. Enjoy deep strategy and satisfying idle progression!
games.aboutText:
Hello, Dean! Welcome to your Hero Academy. This is a desktop simulation management idle game designed specifically for PC players. Inspired by classic Kairosoft gameplay combined with lightweight desktop idle mechanics, you won't need to micromanage every battle. Instead, as the supreme decision-maker of the academy, you'll focus on planning building layouts, recruiting promising heroes, and paving their path to legendary careers. Enjoy watching heroes grow, fight, and live autonomously while utilizing the unique "Iteration and Legacy" system to turn each graduation into permanent assets for the academy, ultimately building the continent's premier hero training institution!

Plan a One-of-a-Kind Hero Academy

From an empty plot to a renowned educational sanctuary, every inch of your academy is planned by you. You will construct various Hero Huts for heroes to recover their stamina, a Trial Grounds that provides a ceaseless stream of combat opportunities, a Canteen for powerful buffs, and a Library to accelerate growth. Each building serves a unique function, and a strategic layout will vastly improve your heroes' efficiency. This isn't just about construction; it's about creating the perfect home for your heroes to thrive.

Witness an Automated Hero Ecosystem

Once "enrolled," your heroes come to life. They will automatically head to the Trial Grounds to fight monsters, feast at the Canteen when hungry, and return to their dorms to dream when exhausted. This vibrant ecosystem is fully automated, freeing you from tedious operations. You only need to focus on the macro-development of your academy and, when the time is right, launch an all-out assault on the powerful, periodic Bosses lurking in the Trial Grounds, leading your entire academy to win glory and prestige!

Cultivate Future Legends with Diverse Personalities

Every hero is a unique treasure. They possess Talents ranging from D to S rank, which determine their growth potential, and are randomly assigned "Personality" traits like "Valiant," "Scholar," or "Lone Wolf," which profoundly influence their combat style. Through academy research, you can unlock a vast class promotion tree, allowing you to develop a swordsman into a team-guarding "Paladin" or a damage-dealing "Berserker." Discover their potential, combine their traits, and cultivate an invincible team of legends!

Graduation Is the Beginning of an Eternal Legacy

The core design philosophy of this game is "Iteration & Legacy," turning your every investment into permanent accumulation. When heroes reach their level cap, you can choose to have them "graduate." This is not a loss, but a strategic investment. Graduated heroes leave behind precious [Legacy Letters], which are used to unlock permanent global buffs in the academy's tech tree. Build the [Hall of Fame], and your graduated legends will continuously generate gold for you. Every graduation helps build a better academy, giving your next generation of heroes a higher starting point!

games.name: Simulators, strategies and pigeons
games.shortDescription: A free collection of six independent games that explore the “simulator” genre from the most unexpected angles. From a medieval carrier pigeon to an alternative Slavic realm, from flower breeding to stick collecting — this games offers six unique gameplay experiences created by indie teams
games.aboutText:
Simulators, Strategies & Pigeons

A free collection of six independent games that explore the “simulator” genre from the most unexpected angles.

From a medieval carrier pigeon to an alternative Slavic realm, from flower breeding to stick collecting — Simulators, Strategies & Pigeons offers six unique gameplay experiences created by indie teams. Each game stands on its own and dives into a different aspect of simulation: humor, emotion, exploration, or strategy.

💌 Carrier Pigeon Simulator

Experience like a brave bird in the Middle Ages! Deliver letters between warring villages, evade obstacles, collect golden eggs! Establish peace and prosperity on the island!

Genre: Simulator / Action-Adventure

Setting: Medieval era

Mechanics: Time management, quests, flight navigation

📰 Unbelievable Times

You're a tabloid editor who's made a career faking stories about the paranormal — until it turns out they’re all true. Reptiloids are real. And now… you work for them.

Genre: Simulator / Strategy

Setting: 1960s America, sci-fi

Features: Satirical narrative, political absurdity, aliens

🍂 Stay Strong!

A meditative game about routine and the inner experience of someone going through a difficult time. No preaching — just repeated days filled with small acts of effort and emotion.

Genre: Atmospheric Simulator

Setting: Real life

Features: Metaphorical mini-games, emotional progression, growing cycles

🌸 BloomWake

A cozy fantasy simulator about magical flower breeding. Manage your own shop, bring life back to an industrial gray city, and rediscover beauty through creativity and kindness.

Genre: Flower breeding & shop management simulator

Setting: Miyazaki-style fantasy world

Features: Relaxing gameplay, collection, emotional storytelling

🌲 This is my stick

You find the perfect stick. Name it. Post it on a fake Reddit feed. Get upvotes. Explore forests, collect sticks, and earn the respect of your fellow stick fans.

Genre: Cozy exploration / Collection

Setting: Procedurally generated natural biomes

Features: Humor, attention to detail, relaxing pace

🏰 Kings and...

A simulator of leadership without absolute power. You are a regional ruler in an alternative version of early medieval Rus. Your party is your only true tool — use it wisely.

Genre: Strategy / Simulation

Setting: Alternative early-medieval Rus

Features: Limited resources, recon and raids, semi-autonomous world

Additional info

🎮 Platform: Windows

⏱️ Playtime: 15+ minutes per game

🧩 Genres: Simulators, Strategy, Adventure, Exploration, Meditative

🆓 Price: Free

👥 Developed by: Independent teams GD GUILD with the support of SUITD 'RESP' community

games.name: Ignitement
games.shortDescription: Shape your flame in this explosive roguelite and survivorslike inferno. Craft unique fire magic, unlock new masks and abilities, collect ancestral loot, and incinerate hordes of enemies in a never-ending battle against your inner demons.
games.aboutText:
Ignitement is an isometric horde survivor, roguelite, and bullet heaven where you burn away your inner demons using devastating fire magic. Don masks imbued with unique abilities, craft your spells in each run across devastated landscapes and dark dungeons. Loot ancestral gear, upgrade your abilities and stats, and sacrifice your blood for greater rewards.

Shape Your Flame

Craft calamitous fire magic by unlocking and upgrading new abilities and effects. Multiply your projectiles, add elemental damage effects, and hone in on your enemies. Or reshape the battlefield with comets that fall from the sky, flammable environments, and explosive chain reactions.

An Inner World of Pain

Ascend through a metaphysical underworld crafted from your own grief, regret, and rage. Uncover secrets and truths and make bargains with demons. No companions, mentors, or distractions. Your own voice is your only guide…questioning, remembering, and reckoning.

Adapt and Repeat

Progress your Fire Shaman between meditations. Spend ash on upgrades at the Tree of Knowledge and add heat to your spells in the Book of Wisdom. Sacrifice your blood to increase risk and reward. Combine and equip the gear of your ancestors. Return to each maelstrom stronger than you were before.

Every run is a spiritual trial. Every choice shapes your path. Will you master the flame…or be consumed by it?

games.name: Gladiator Command
games.shortDescription: Build a legendary gladiator school in ancient Rome. Recruit and develop unique fighters, manage the business behind the bloodshed and watch your decisions tested in brutal real-time arena combat.
games.aboutText:
In Gladiator Command , you take control of a struggling Ludus in ancient Rome and transform it into a school worthy of legend. Recruit promising fighters, shape their development, manage the business behind the bloodshed, and watch your decisions play out in brutal real-time arena combat.

A successful Ludus is built far from the cheering crowds. Manage your training grounds, hire staff, balance finances, oversee recovery, and decide how hard to push your fighters.

Every decision has consequences. Aggressive training can produce faster results, but exhausted or injured gladiators will not survive long in the arena.

Search for new talent and build a roster around your own strategy. Every gladiator arrives with different attributes, traits and potential but what they become is up to you.

Develop their skills, choose their specialisation, and turn inexperienced recruits into distinctive fighters. Build heavily protected defenders, agile duelists, relentless attackers, or specialists capable of controlling the arena.

Your gladiators are investments, warriors and individuals. Know when to develop them, when to sell them and when a valuable fighter is worth risking.

Once the arena gates open, preparation becomes performance.

Watch your gladiators fight in real time using the attributes, skills and specialisations you developed. Nets trap opponents, shields absorb punishment, weapons find openings, and a single decisive strike can end even the most promising career.

There are no meaningless victories. Every fight carries consequences for the gladiator and the Ludus that sent them into the sand.

Take on increasingly dangerous opponents, enter multi-round tournaments, earn prestige, and unlock greater opportunities for your school.

Victories bring money and recognition, but lasting success demands more than one champion. Build a roster capable of surviving injuries, changing circumstances and the relentless demands of Rome’s arenas.

Grow from an overlooked training school into a celebrated Ludus whose name and blood-soaked legacy will be remembered throughout the empire.

Recruit them. Shape them. Send them into the arena.

games.name: MineMogul
games.shortDescription: Design and build a factory deep underground in this physics-based automation sandbox. Mine resources, buy machines and master the chaos as you become the ultimate Mine Mogul!
games.aboutText:
Design and build a factory deep underground in this physics-based automation sandbox. Mine resources, buy machines and master the chaos as you become the ultimate Mine Mogul!

Build A Sprawling Factory

Enjoy the casual construction of massive, interconnected factories deep underground. Wind conveyors through twisting mineshafts, connect machines, and harness physics to automate your every need.

Explore The Unknown

Venture into the mysterious, hollowed shell of a forgotten cave system. Discover secrets, unearth hidden resources, and rebuild among the ruins of abandoned mining operations. Every cavern holds new opportunities for the ambitious mogul.

Manage The Chaos

As your factory grows, so does the madness! Conveyors overflow, parts scatter, and unexpected physics mishaps keep you on your toes. Tweak your designs, optimize machine placement, and find creative solutions to keep the gears turning and the chaos under control.

games.name: Coincidences?
games.shortDescription: After a sudden rent hike, you move into a suspiciously cheap house deep in the woods. The price is absurdly low and there’s work nearby-it seems like a stroke of luck. But you soon realize something is seriously wrong with the place...
games.aboutText:
Coincidences? is a first-person psychological horror game that combines elements of a classic walking simulator with dynamic gameplay sequences.

Story

You live an ordinary life until your landlord raises the rent. Looking for a new place to live, you move into a house near the forest with suspiciously cheap rent, while also getting a job at a local store.

As you progress through the game, you begin to realize that something is wrong with this place.

Key Features

- Dynamic gameplay sequences
In addition to exploring locations, the game features episodes with active gameplay.

- First-person cutscenes
Some character actions and story events are accompanied by short first-person cutscenes.

- Atmosphere
The game focuses on building tension through a combination of detailed interiors and carefully crafted locations.

Approximate playtime: ~90 minutes

games.name: Fawn The Florist
games.shortDescription: Fawn the Florist is a cozy idle game that sits at the bottom of your screen, acting as a peaceful, garden companion for you as you work, study, or relax.
games.aboutText:
Fawn the Florist is a cozy, idle game that sits at the bottom of your screen acting as your peaceful garden space you can tend to while you work, study or relax. Players are tasked with helping our dear friend, Fawn, to uncover wondrous new flowers whilst creating their own flourishing garden with the assistance of some friendly critters to create the garden of their dreams.

Unlock New Flowers

From the scorching fire of the Volcanic Zinnias to the calming droplets of the Hydrogenas, discover all the beautiful flowers along the way!

Enlist the Help of your Critter Companions

By building homes and providing care, you can befriend a cast of critter companions. In return for your love, they'll help you maintain your garden while you're busy or relaxing!

Complete Quests for Fawn

Take on simple tasks for Fawn and breathe new life into her gardens!

Position the Game to your Needs

Adjust the resolution position of your game to fit your purpose and needs to comfortably grow your garden from your desktop!

games.name: Blast Radius
games.shortDescription: Your goal: clear all fruits, avoid capture, and escape each level alive.
games.aboutText:
In Blast Radius , your mission is simple — collect every fruit in the maze and reach the exit without getting caught . Each level is a trap-filled labyrinth swarming with clever enemies that patrol, chase, and block your path.

To survive, you’ll need to plan your route, time your moves, and react fast. Grab special fruits to temporarily disable enemies, and collect mushrooms to rack up extra points. As the levels progress, mazes grow trickier, enemies get smarter, and your timing becomes everything.

Your goal: clear all fruits, avoid capture, and escape each level alive.

Why You'll Love It:

- 🎨 Colorful, polished arcade visuals

- ⚡ Fast, skill-based gameplay

- 👾 Smart enemies with unpredictable movement

- 🧠 Route-planning and quick decisions are key to survival

Can you outsmart the maze and collect it all? Get ready to run, dodge, and conquer every level in Blast Radius !

games.name: ShipCrafter
games.shortDescription: ShipCrafter is a naval sandbox simulation game. Build your ship, unlock new components and defeat increasingly powerful foes in the campaign, solo or in co-op !
games.aboutText:
Game description

ShipCrafter is a naval sandbox combat simulator. Build you ship, unlock new parts, and defeat increasingly powerful foes !

Challenge adversaries in the campaign and liberate europe, or battle your own creations in the custom battle mode, and try to come up with the most efficient and original design.

Realtime physics

We are making a game with accurate physics. As such we implemented a realtime buoyancy system based on weight and submerged volume. The ship density and center of mass is displayed in editor, allowing to fine tune your ship and even make submarines using ballasts !

Weaponery physics were particularly cared for as well, with fully simulated shell trajectories considering air pressure, changes in density through the atmosphere, and the influence of speed on shells drag value. Penetration calculations are based on armor thickness, angle of incidence, bounce probability, and shell speed and mass.

Features

- Realtime buoyancy simulation even considering ocean waves.

- Various armor thicknesses and accurate penetration calculation based on speed, mass and angle of incidence.

- Realistic ballistic trajectories even considering changes in the air pressure with altitude. Speeds and distances are however reduced to increase the nervosity of combats (in reality it would take more than a minute to hit a target at 20km).

- Adjustable ballasts for submarine designs.

- Physics based damages instead of healthbars. Turrets and engines will also lose performance if hit.

- Weather system and day cycles, including changes in ocean waves amplitude and rain.

- Campaign with more than 50 missions.

- Co-op campaign and ship building.

- Custom battle editor, including weather, time of day selection, and bots vs bots naval battles.

- Manual and automatic control mode for weaponery.

- Realtime fluid simulation.

- Visit your ship in first person view.

- Steam Workshop supported.

- Raytracing renderer to generate your most beautiful screenshots !

- Officially supported modding.

Steam workshop support

Battleships, cruisers, submarines : this game already supports the steam workshop ! You can share your creations with the community and download other people's ships this way !

Multiplayer mode

A sandbox mode is available in game ! Play with up to 10 people, and enable or disable damage to fight naval battles or simply to show off your ships to others.

Raytracing renderer

You can now create your own scene in ShipCrafter, allowing to modify the sun orientation, add fog and generate screenshots with outstanding quality thanks to raytracing.

Discord

Join the discord to post your creations or simply talk about WWII ships and connect with the community !

games.name: BLACK SOULS II
games.shortDescription: Despair. Fear, Madness, once again. An original work based on "Alice in Wonderland" and "Through the Looking-Glass." Dark Fairy Tale Fantasy x Psychological Horror RPG focusing on the themes of "Exploration of a Mad World" and "Life or Death Combat against Demonbeasts".
games.aboutText:
Despair. Fear, Madness, once again.

An original work based on "Alice in Wonderland" and "Through the Looking-Glass."

Dark Fairy Tale Fantasy x Psychological Horror RPG focusing on the themes of "Exploration of a Mad World" and "Life or Death Combat against Demonbeasts".

※Includes content from all 3 DLCs.

●Introduction

In this work, you'll meet 45 Heroines.

Almost all of them are the fun characters you may have met before in the famous tale "Alice's Adventures in Wonderland".

Though, now all of them are charming girls.

(However, the most important for you is Alice, of course, isn't that right?)

・The White Rabbit

・The Cheshire Cat

・The Hatter

・The March Hare

・The Dormouse

・The Duchess

・The Mock Turtle

・The Gryphon

・The Queen of Hearts

・The Red Queen

And many others...

●SEN System

All NPCs in this world can be killed. However, should you do so, your SEN would decrease. And as it gets too low:

・BGM will disappear.

・All the inhabitants will begin to talk in an incomprehensible language.

・Some things that should not be seen will become visible.

What a frightening ailment it is!

- A vast, open world made of many different and charming maps.

- Will you kill or will you be killed? Tactical and tense ATB combat.

- Explore the Wonderland end to end, gathering souls and raising your level.

- Death is not the end, merely a setback as you resume from the last bonfire.

- Many different endings

games.name: SOKO 1977: Anti-Terror Task Force
games.shortDescription: Take command of a special police task force in 1970s Germany. Uncover terrorist networks, coordinate operations, and make far-reaching decisions. Experience an intense, historically inspired scenario that explores the balance between security, freedom, and the rule of law.
games.aboutText:
From the creators of Through the Darkest of Times & The Darkest Files (Best German Game of 2026).

Have you seen the news?

We’re setting up a special investigation unit.

We need you to take charge.

The first game about a dramatic chapter in German history.

The Federal Republic of Germany in the 1970s is under pressure. Left-wing terrorist attacks are shaking the country, political tensions are rising, and the public is demanding answers. As the head of a special police task force, you find yourself at the center of this crisis.

All Eyes on You

In SOKO 1977: Anti-Terror Task Force, you take charge of investigations into terrorist cells. You gather clues, cross-reference information, interrogate suspects, and decide which leads to pursue. You rarely have all the facts—and often have little time.

Every decision counts. Mistakes have consequences—not only for the operation, but also for the trust in your work. Politicians and the media are watching your every move, and you must constantly weigh how far you can and are willing to go.

Every Playthrough is a New Challenge

The scenarios in the game are fictionalized but inspired by real events in the Federal Republic of Germany in the 1970s. Each playthrough tells a completely new investigative story through procedurally generated cases, events, and suspects. You must weigh risks and make decisions whose consequences will permanently alter the course of your investigation.

SOKO 1977 combines thrilling deduction and investigative work with the social conflicts of a defining era in Germany’s history. Caught between security and freedom, political and public pressure, and the principles of the rule of law, the responsibility lies with you.

Features

- Deduction gameplay meets roguelike: Every playthrough tells a new story. Analyze clues, connect information, create suspect profiles, and plan targeted police operations against terrorist cells.

- Lead your special task force: Get to know your team members, coordinate personnel and resources, plan operations, and respond to new developments as a crisis escalates.

- Keep an eye on the media and the public: Political pressure and critical scrutiny from the press will accompany your investigations. Maintain the public’s trust and justify your decisions at press conferences.

- A historically inspired, well-researched setting: Experience the political and social tensions of the 1970s in a fictional, carefully researched police environment. The story revolves around a special task force in Cologne and draws on real historical events.

- Decisions with Consequences: How far can a democratic state go to protect its citizens? Interrogations and operations repeatedly present you with difficult decisions that shape the course of your own investigation.

- Reflection on Social Issues: SOKO 1977 combines thrilling investigative work with an exploration of topics such as the tension between security and freedom, the limits of state power, and attacks on democracy.

Commissioned by:

games.name: Detective Bloodphobia
games.shortDescription: Detective Bloodphobia is a black-and-white noir visual novel with point-and-click investigations and deduction gameplay.
games.aboutText:
A Detective Who Faints at the Sight of Blood, and a Mysterious Murder Case

Detective Bloodphobia is a visual novel set in the late 20th century, following a protagonist who collapses at the sight of blood while pursuing a murder case.

With noir-inspired black-and-white graphics and a classic mystery narrative, the game delivers deep immersion in solving crimes.

Game Features

[ Investigation Part ]

Players click on objects in the background to uncover evidence.
Even the smallest clue may become the key that leads to the truth.

[ Deduction Part ]

Link together the collected evidence to challenge testimonies.

When contradictions are exposed, fragments of the truth are revealed.

In this process, players must dig into lies and connect clues to raise new suspicions.
The detective, together with his assistant, unravels the case and approaches the hidden truth.

Will he be able to solve the case to the very end?

games.name: Wish Upon a Cat
games.shortDescription: Embark on a delightful little romp through the worlds of various Odencat games to track down a dimension-diving cat in this short, heartwarming adventure.
games.aboutText:
"If I knew things were going to end up like this, I would've just apologized in the first place…"

It's your best friend's birthday—but after a recent fight with her, you're not exactly on speaking terms.

Before you even have a chance to wallow in regret, though, a burst of light erupts from your computer screen and sucks you into an alternate dimension—where a rather snarky mouse gives you the rundown.

A rogue cat with a bad attitude has been leaping between realities and causing all sorts of dimensional mayhem—and if something isn't done to stop it, it might very well cause another big bang. And you DEFINITELY don't want that.

With no other options available, you set off in pursuit of the feisty feline—not just to restore balance to the dimensions, but because it's the only way you'll ever make it back home.

In this short-but-sweet adventure, you'll journey through the many worlds of Odencat games like Bear's Restaurant and Meg's Monster, meeting dozens of familiar friends along the way on your search for the runaway cat.

Why did it throw the dimensions out of whack? What is it this little kitty-cat truly desires? And when all is said and done—what will YOU wish for?

games.name: Crushed In Time
games.shortDescription: Embark on an adventure with Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson on this surprising and elastic point-and-click game. Grab, pull, and release to help them solve a bizarre investigation full of humor and meta-time travel!
games.aboutText:
Panic at the development studio!

Just as the new Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson video game hit the market, one of its characters mysteriously went missing.

After their memorable appearance in the non-game There Is No Game: Wrong Dimension , our extravagant investigators are back in their own adventure.

Armed with their iconic ineptitude, they must solve a mystery that transcends the space-time boundaries of their world…

But they won’t succeed without your help!

Travel to the very heart of the game's creation and explore the various stages of its development to unravel the threads of this strange case.

Welcome to a wildly elastic and infinitely meta experience!

• Rediscover Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson, joined by a cast of new, endearing characters.

• Dialogue recorded by real humans. All natural. Non-GMO and additive-free.

• A completely meta story of time travel that will take you through the design stages of the game.

• Chock-full of humor and surprises (and bugs, probably).

• An offbeat point and click adventure offering fun and elastic gameplay.

• Loads of puzzles that will require up to three neurons (we couldn’t keep up beyond that).

• Beautiful 2D graphics. Sorry, I meant 3D… Hold on. Which one was it again?

games.name: Barrel Roll
games.shortDescription: Barrel Roll is a roguelike deckbuilder, turn based, taking place in a futuristic far west. The deck ? A 6 slot revolver barrel. Gather bullets with special effects, customize your revolver's barrel to create strong synergies and take down as much criminals as you can.
games.aboutText:
Barrel Roll is a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder. The deck ? A six slot revolver barrel.

Take down hordes of outlaws to get to their leaders. Collect bullets with special effects, trinkets and resources . Each of your bullets has its archetype (Damage, Shield, Initiative, Focus and Killer). It's up to you to customize your ideal barrel et create powerful synergies to counter your enemies !

Face groups of 3 to 5 bandits in turn based combats . After each of your shots, choose your next bullet between the 3 next and come up with mind blowing combos ! (Literally...)
Crush your opponents (at least their shield) to delay their next turn and use one of your 3 skills to show your mastery and turn the duel upside down.

Choose your next destination carefully to gain options for your next fights !
Some resources you’ll find on the road could be super useful at the saloon.

It’s up to you to write your own legend by building your perfect barrel.

In Barrel Roll you'll find...

- 64 bullets with powerful effects.

- 30 trinkets to change the way you play.

- 3 skills to get out of every situation.

- 9 bosses

- 5 Threat level to make sure you won't stand a chance to beat BARREL ROLL

games.name: Tango District
games.shortDescription: Tango District is a casual, puzzle-based city builder set in a neon-drenched dystopia. Balance spatial placement, manage corporate influence, and navigate corrupt events. Will you build a free paradise, or sell your skyline to the highest corporate bidder?
games.aboutText:
Tango District

Tango District is a casual, puzzle-based cyberpunk city-builder. Plan efficient layouts, chain adjacency bonuses, manage corporate influence, and navigate corrupt events. Can you build each district to its full potential?

Spatial Puzzle City Building

Every square meter matters. Position structures to trigger powerful proximity bonuses, boost your city's reputation, and unlock higher-tier building packs. Evolve simple concrete blocks into towering, neon-clad monuments to industry.

Corporate Influence vs. Independence

Megacorporation’s want a piece of your skyline. Grant them district control for massive economic buffs, or push back to protect city autonomy. Will you realize your vision, or let the corporations box you in?

High-Stakes Event Cards & Encounters

As your population grows, navigate hundreds of narrative events. Respond to corporate espionage, civil unrest, and street-level crime. Every decision alters your treasury and shifts the balance of political power.

Shape your district's skyline

No two play-throughs are identical. Random building drafts, unpredictable events, and strict bankruptcy mechanics mean every choice counts. Manage your funds carefully, a bad investment can send your city into total financial collapse.

Key Features

- Strategic Grid Placement - Combine building adjacency rules to maximize reputation and yield.

- Dynamic Faction Power - Decide which corporations dominate your economy and skyline.

- Play at Your Own Speed - Take your time to plan grid layouts and evaluate risks.

- Unique Buildings and Technology – Each building has a different area of influence and synergies. Evolve them to grant greater bonuses to your reputation. And watch them evolve from simple edifices into temples to neon, metal and industry.

- Be the Government You Want (To Be) - Hundreds of text based encounters will force you to make tough decisions.

- Randomized Urban Activity- Each play-through will feature different building unlocks, events, and results to your decisions. No two play-throughs will be quite the same.

- No Second Chances! - Once you run out of funds, you face the threat of bankruptcy. If you try to spend more, your game will be over! The threat of defeat adds importance and tension to every action.

games.name: 挂机手游模拟器
games.shortDescription: Idle farming for treasures, summoning heroes, collecting compendiums, crafting equipment, unlocking formations, researching technologies, sweeping maps, and competing for resources!
games.aboutText:
Idle Pay-to-Win Mobile Game Simulator
Ever dreamed of experiencing the thrill of popular idle pay - to - win mobile games without spending real money? Idle Pay - to - Win Mobile Game Simulator is the perfect fit for you!

No need for actual recharges. You can still enjoy the pay - to - win - level excitement of skyrocketing combat power and full - screen item drops . Enter redemption codes like VIP666 and VIP777 at the start, and luxurious gifts will be yours instantly for a smooth - sailing, thrilling gameplay!

It not only immersively simulates the exciting gameplay of idle mobile games but also precisely captures the core experience of “your time is extremely valuable”. It's a great way to relax and start an addictive idle journey anytime. Come and experience it on Steam right away!

Core Gameplay Highlights

1. Simulate Real - Player Competition and Recreate Mobile Game Ecosystem

- World BOSS and Competitive Ranking : Challenge the World BOSS, strive for a high rank in the competition, and fight for rare resources. It reproduces the intense sense of player competition in pay - to - win mobile games 1:1, letting you experience the most authentic “mobile game ecosystem” and see who can dominate the leaderboard!

2. Skyrocketing Combat Power + Map Looting, Full of Excitement

- Rocket - like Combat Power Surge : No need for in - game purchases. Achieve a crazy breakthrough in combat power through strategic combinations and cultivating spirit beings. The 数值 growth with red numbers flashing all over the screen will fully immerse you in the excitement!

- Map Looting + Idle Sweeping : Monsters drop abundant items. After clearing specific levels, you can “sweep the map”. Even when idling, you can collect rewards regularly! The higher the level, the more amazing the rewards. Who can resist the feeling of collecting resources while relaxing?

3. Summon Spirit Beings + Combine Synergies, Full of Strategy and Nostalgia

- Summon Ancient and Modern Spirit Beings : Gather ancient Chinese spirit beings to fight side by side! From Guan Yu and Zhao Yun of the Three Kingdoms, Wu Song and Yan Qing of the Water Margin, Yang Jian and Nezha of myths, to Zhang Liang, Xiang Yu, and Hua Mulan in history... So many classic figures will evoke your nostalgia!

- Combine Synergies + Strengthen and Cultivate : Different spirit beings can trigger exclusive synergy effects when combined. Strengthen and upgrade the spirit beings to create your own “overpowered team”. Strategic combinations determine the upper limit of your combat effectiveness!

4. Array Assistance + Exciting Lottery, Multi - dimensional Gameplay Expansion

- Nine Types of Arrays, Strategize : There are 9 types of arrays with different effects built - in. Switch arrays according to different enemies and “arrange troops and deploy formations” to achieve miraculous combat results, maximizing the strategic depth!

- Exciting Lottery, Everyone Can Be a Lucky Dog : Want to draw prizes but afraid of “going bankrupt from recharges”? Here, lottery tickets can be obtained for free by “grinding”! Enter WOSHIDALAO (I'm the Boss) at the start and get 100 free draws directly! Everyone can be a “lottery lucky dog” and enjoy the treatment of a boss as soon as you log in!

5. Research Technologies + Infinite New Games, Super Replayable

- 68 Types of Technologies, Free Research : There are 4 categories and 68 researchable technologies designed. Whether you want to focus on “maximizing drop rates” (full - screen drops in the later stage, one monster drops a full set of items), “fast - paced combat clearance” (clear levels quickly and get a head start in the next new game), or “idle and win” (strengthen idle rewards, a delight for lazy players), there's always a technology suitable for your playstyle!

- Infinite New Games, More Fun Each Time : All gameplay progress (tasks, kills, equipment, collections, lottery times...) will be converted into “start - up points” and inherited to the next new game after clearing the current one! Use the points to directly start the “high - speed level - clearing mode”, clearing one level per second and skipping the development stage. Each new game is a “peak start”, and the more you play, the more enjoyable it gets. Your combat power will always be on the “road to becoming overpowered”!

6. Collect Collections + Upgrade Artifacts, In - depth Cultivation

- Collect Collections, Strategize to Defeat Enemies : Each monster has unique skills. Collect collections to “know yourself and your enemies”, and combine lineups, synergies, and arrays to achieve “victory in every battle”, a paradise for strategy lovers!

- Upgrade Artifacts, Forge Divine Equipment : As a spirit master, you can upgrade artifacts to forge equipment of 10 major qualities and infinite levels, with attribute stats maxed out! Each point of “luck attribute” can also increase the monster drop rate, making “full - screen drops” easily achievable. The excitement of cultivation and looting is

games.name: Otterly Lost
games.shortDescription: Swim, dive, and explore as a curious sea otter far from home. Meet charming animals, discover hidden places, use tools, and solve light challenges as you make your way back with your favorite rock by your side.
games.aboutText:
Dive into a cozy, story-rich adventure about wonder, friendship, and finding where you belong

A curious sea otter named Otto was swept away from home after a mysterious event. Far from familiar waters,
you must find your way back. Meet friendly animals and explore a world full of places to discover.

Every step (or splash) uncovers something new: a story, a view, or a quiet moment to take in

Swim through kelp forests and hidden caves, glide over sunny shores, or climb rocky canyons.
Solve soft puzzles, help others and enjoy light platforming as you explore the open world.

Otters know a thing or two about tools, especially rocks!

Use your favorite rock to break through obstacles and discover new tools and treasures.
Upgrade your natural abilities to swim faster, jump higher, climb easier, and glide further.

Meet lovely creatures, from an ancient turtle to an aspiring frog singer

Some will need your help, while others will guide you on your journey. Get to know them and their
stories, lend a paw in their troubles, and slowly learn how everything is connected.

Going for cute, classy, or maybe a little chaotic? We fully support your choices!

Collect charming accessories and quirky hats by exploring the world, trading with a local
fisherman, or buying them in cosmetics shops.

games.name: A Thousand Cloys
games.shortDescription: A chill, exploration-based incremental game about harvesting and cleansing an alien planet of its radiation with a swarm of high-tech toasters.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Cloys Inc., the universe's leading toaster company, and your new family! You've been put in charge of cleansing Kalahari of its radiation. Harvest resources, import Cloys to work for you, and explore this mysterious alien planet to unearth the nodes of your upgrade tree.

The Best Toaster In The Universe​

In order to do your work, your employer thankfully provides you with Cloys, high-tech toasters able to toast bread, make phone calls and mine materials in hazardous conditions. Choose whether you want to play fully active, or idle while your Cloys work automatically.

Harvest all kinds of resources, improve your clicks and your Cloys, build new structures, and harvest more resources! The pace is steady, and the numbers remain understandable.

Explore An Alien Planet​

The planet you've been assigned to cleanse isn't just an empty field. Some weird structures stand, hidden between towering mountains, in the middle of acid lakes or behind mysterious doors... Explore its nooks and crannies in order to become always more efficient at your job!

The nodes of your upgrade tree are hidden throughout the world, and unearthing them as you explore further will make your task a lot easier! Lift the fog of radiation shrouding the planet and uncover pulsating fields, monoliths and other oddities. Study them, repair them, build them, upgrade them and become a true harvesting machine!

Restart stronger, faster

Once you've accumulated a big enough payout during a session, end it! Upgrade your permanent outposts, let the world rest, and start a new session to earn an even bigger payout!

Each new session will take you further, to discover new upgrades and resources. It also makes management happy, so...

~~~

Welcome to Cloys Inc., the universe's leading toaster company, and your new family!

You've joined our environmental arm, where we improve the universe, one planet at a time! We are delighted to have you with us, and we are sure you will find fulfillment in this vital mission.

You have been assigned a processed planet to be cleansed of its Klein radiation. The connection zone has been calculated and a portal is ready to be opened.

games.name: Tiny Shadows Interwoven Hearts
games.shortDescription: Programmer Lin Mo is tired of his monotonous life. One day, he meets a mysterious girl at a café who hides many secrets. As lies and true feelings intertwine, can this chance encounter save him from his numb existence? A visual novel filled with "love and hope".
games.aboutText:
An urban encounter, full of missteps and surprises, is quietly brewing in the sunlight of a coffee shop.

This is a visual novel about chance encounters, misunderstandings, and the intersection of the virtual and the real. It is a story full of "love and hope."

Synopsis

Lin Mo is an ordinary programmer.

Less than a year after graduating from college, his former enthusiasm has been worn away by the daily grind. His life has been compressed into a tedious and monotonous routine between three points: his company, his rented apartment, and a coffee shop he frequents.

He thought life would always be this way.

Until this afternoon, when a mysterious young girl, whose appearance seems inconsistent with her age, bursts into his unchanging daily life.

Because of a comical misunderstanding, he and this girl, named Su Youqing, cross paths. Lin Mo gradually discovers that this sharp-tongued, proud, and outwardly childish girl seems to be hiding many secrets that her appearance belies.

For Lin Mo, who has long lost his motivation for change, will this encounter that began in a coffee shop be the opportunity he needs to break free from his dull life?

Character Introduction

Su Youqing (CV: Qian Mingling):

Age: 23

A mysterious young woman whom Lin Mo encounters at a coffee shop near his company, where she is always drawing in a corner. She has a petite appearance, looking much younger than her actual age, but is in fact a university graduate and a working adult.

She has a mischievous, impish personality and loves to tease people with her sharp tongue and jokes, especially delighting in watching Lin Mo's flustered expressions after being teased. Although she always maintains a composed and proud demeanor, she immediately becomes flustered and reveals her vulnerable nature when sincerely praised or cared for.

As a highly talented freelance illustrator, once she picks up her digital tablet and enters a creative state, she becomes completely immersed in her own world, oblivious to her surroundings.

She regards Lin Mo as "the most amusing toy to tease," yet, without realizing it, she has also let down all her pretenses in front of him.

Lin Mo (Male Protagonist):

Age: 22

A programmer at an IT company. He has been working for half a year and is competent at his job, but is gradually feeling weary and longs for an event to break the monotony of his quiet life.

Game Information

Approximately 50,000 words, around 2.5 hours of gameplay.

6 CGs (not including variations).

2 SD CGs (not including variations).

CREDITS
