Scenario: Fraudster RL

Original Art: ula Cabbage

Cast:

Chinese: Qian Mingling

Japanese: Inori Marie

UI/PV: Cat in the Box

Japanese Localization: SakuyatheLonER

Promotional Art: Leng Dan

Programming: Sand Sculpture Block

Public Assets:

BGM: Ongaku no Tamago, Maou Damashii

Backgrounds: Koala, 33 Ancestral Coloring, Xiaoye Background House, Star Summer Not Sleeping, Background Specialty Store Minikuru, Pansy

Special Thanks: CnGal Database, Catnip Production Group, AozoraSoftware, Mirreams

games.name: Void of Lilly
games.shortDescription: Void of Lilly is an adventure in the world of the near future with JRPG elements and Bullet Hell battles! Help Ann to find her sister and uncover secrets of this world... Void of Lilly is coming on Steam for free!
games.aboutText:
Void of Lilly comes to Steam for free!

Long time ago, people faced the Black Fog disease. That's how Axis City became the last bastion of humanity. Years of progress within total isolation, and now it's a beautiful place, filled with advanced technologies. But you aren't really interested in all of this stuff, right? You just want to find your sister and bring her back!

This is a short story-focused game with a few JRPG elements, beautiful pixel art and BULLET-HELL-like battles!!!

- Help Ann to find her sister in a short 60-120 minutes adventure

- "Hack" your enemies in Bullet Hell fights

- Uncover the world's mystery

- Pet cats

games.name: The Mortal
games.shortDescription: 《下凡》是一款俯视角角色扮演模拟经营游戏。怀揣憧憬，你告别故土踏入喧嚣陌生的大城。前路万千，没有唯一的活法：务工谋生、寻玉赌石、卜算吉凶、赶海远航，在市井烟火与机缘变数里，邂逅羁绊，书写属于你的人间际遇。
games.aboutText:
这是一处和现实平行的市井世界。一名带着理想的青年，离开熟悉的故土，奔赴远方，来这里寻找机缘。

这里没有规定好的人生剧本。你可以选择一份工作踏实度日，也可以奔赴滩涂赶海垂钓，进山采掘原石，亲手开窗、切石，等待玉石揭晓的一刻；你可以前去卜问运势，时运高低会悄悄影响彩票、赌石等一切概率事件。骑上单车，沿着街道慢慢穿行，感受城市的烟火；去往渡口码头，扬帆出海，在海上捕鱼，去往远方无人的岛屿，解锁全新的海域故事。

旅途之中，你的身体状态、心绪起伏，都会时刻影响你的选择与结果。你会遇见数十位有各自心事与故事的普通人，和他们相识相伴，发展友情、恋爱关系，甚至一同改写命运。你可以先租房落脚，慢慢积攒财富，买下属于自己的房子，在这座城市拥有归宿。

《下凡》官方游戏交流群 ：752209909（满）

《下凡》官方游戏交流②群 ：77405808

游戏特色

- 多条差异化体验路线：务工、彩票、套圈弹珠、拾荒、赶海、垂钓、挖矿原石、开窗切石赌玉

- 特色运势卜算机制，机缘是贯穿游玩的核心变量

- 真实可操控自行车骑行，自由漫游城镇

- 航海出海玩法：码头渡口、远洋捕鱼、外岛探索

- 动态健康、情绪系统，大量随机市井事件

- 完整社交、恋爱长线剧情，角色故事独立饱满

- 租房、购房房产系统，体验安家的过程

- 开放自由模式，没有强制主线枷锁，人生选择由你掌控

games.name: War of Banners
games.shortDescription: War of Banners is a sandbox turn-based tactical RPG set in a medieval open world. Recruit companions, lead your army, and claim victory across brutal battlefields. From a wandering mercenary band to an empire-ruling sovereign — your fate is shaped by strategy and choice.
games.aboutText:
"Start with a handful of soldiers, and rise to become a warlord who shakes the battlefield!"

War of Banners is a sandbox, turn-based tactical RPG set in a realistic medieval open world.

Freely explore an era of chaos where war and intrigue never cease.

Recruit mercenaries, command your army to win brutal battles, expand your influence, and conquer new territories.

Whether leading a wandering mercenary band, serving as a loyal knight, ruling as a benevolent lord, or reigning as an empire—your strategies and choices will alter the course of the world.

Experience a true medieval battlefield in War of Banners, blending the realistic weight of warfare with deep tactical simulation.

Explore a Vast Medieval World

Roam freely across a vast continent and encounter diverse factions.

Choose to intervene or remain neutral in the wars between marauders, holy orders, merchant guilds, and kingdoms.

High-Freedom Mercenary Progression

Hire, train, and equip your mercenaries to prepare for the battlefield.

Your soldiers will grow and rank up, but they may also die or betray you.

Turn-Based Tactical Unit Combat

Dominate the battlefield by utilizing terrain and formations.

Every turn, your choices determine victory or defeat.

Overwhelm your enemies using strategic advantages such as flank attacks, high ground dominance, and encirclement.

Fief Conquest & Management

Develop conquered fiefs and expand your influence.

Construct buildings and manage resources to grow your fief with your own strategy.

Choose to bolster your defenses or maximize production.

Politics & Faction Expansion

Conquer cities, levy taxes, forge alliances, or declare war on other lords.

Even a single player can reshape the balance of power in the world.

games.name: Quarion
games.shortDescription: A short 2D pixel-style metroidvania where you explore, fight bosses, aquire items and abilities and find secrets. Inspired by games such as You Have to Win the Game and VVVVVV.
games.aboutText:
You crashland on an unknown planet and is unable to get back to your ship. Explore different environments, unlock new abilities, fight tough foes and find secrets in order to get back to your ship and return home

- A gameplay driven 2D platformer

- Explore a world and find new abilities

- Fight bosses

- Uncover secrets

A short and simple 2D platformer with many of the abilities you have come to expect from a metroidvania.

(Trailer music: AiRwolf by Djjaner)

games.name: Bound City
games.shortDescription: An action-packed and bittersweet adventure in a city of endless night. Explore the dying city and try to find your way to the tower that seems to be at the heart of it all. Nothing is quite as it appears to be, and only by facing death can you hope to understand the mysteries of Bound City.
games.aboutText:
The night doesn’t end. The tower rises up. Everyone feels its pull. The song echoes through the city . There are those who make pilgrimage to the base of the tower to be subsumed. There are those who go mad from fear or anticipation and attack all around them. There are those who merely struggle to survive and to retain their sense of self.

But Rain is the hero , awoken at last, to defeat evil and kill the endless night.

This is a story about the end of the world – or perhaps just an end of a world. Each mystery contains new secrets and each secret reveals new mysteries, and your deepest fears may be your only clues. Nothing is certain. Anything is possible. When there is no future, will there finally be room to build your own?

Once you deny death, what do you have left to fear?

- Navigate the intricate interconnected world of Bound City across 11 discrete sections. From its loneliest depths, to the heart of the dying city, to the peak of the tower of endless night...

- Find unique weapons, armors, and special tools with surprising traits and abilities that can be combined in unexpected ways.

- Meet curious characters exploring the city for their own reasons, each with their own personality and tale to tell.

- Uncover the mystery of life after death – or was it the other way around?

games.name: Deadline Escape
games.shortDescription: Deadline Escape is a Low Poly Extraction Looter Shooter that throws you into a Post-Apocalyptic World. Scavenge for valuable resources, face deadly enemies and fight for your survival as the clock ticks down toward the deadline.
games.aboutText:
The world has collapsed. Deadline Escape puts you in the middle of a relentless struggle for survival in a devastated post-apocalyptic setting. Every map you enter holds valuable loot, hidden dangers, and the constant risk of not making it back. Your only goal: stay alive long enough to escape.

Your Hideout is where survival begins. Here you’ll store supplies, manage your inventory, and prepare for your next Raid. Traders, missions, and progression systems provide you with the tools to keep moving forward if you can gather enough resources to return.

Once you step outside, safety disappears. Across 4 maps filled with threats, you’ll need to scavenge food, water, and equipment while facing undead, hostile survivors, and a world that doesn’t forgive mistakes. With Softcore and Hardcore modes, the choice is yours: a more forgiving survival, or a brutal test where every decision matters. Will you escape the deadline… or become just another casualty of the apocalypse?

- Survival Mechanics: Health, Stamina, Thirst and Hunger.

- Personal Hideout to storage items, trade.

- Grid Slot Inventory.

- Softcore and Hardcore mode.

- Secure Container.

- More than 300 items: Equipments, Storage Containers, Weapons, Attachments, Consumables, Materials, Keys, Quest Items.

- Explore 4 different Map Scenarios.

- Different types of enemies: Zombies, Rebels, Renegades and Bosses.

- Level Up to unlock, NPCs, Maps, Hideout functionalities.

- More than 200 Quests with different types.

- Shooting Range area.

- Day/Night and Weather Cycles.

- Game Statistics.

- Every map comes with its own countdown, Escape before the Deadline arrives.

games.name: Coffie Simulator - Prologue
games.shortDescription: In Coffie Simulator Prologue , run your own café, serve unique cusstomers, and master the art of coffee-making! Customize, upgrade, and manage your shop while handling orders with precision. Every choice matters. Can you succeed?
games.aboutText:
In Coffie Simulator Prologue , step into the world of coffee and experience the thrill (and chaos) of running your own café! Your dream? To own the best coffee shop in town. But it won’t be easy—you’ll need to master the art of coffee-making, keep your customers happy, and manage your shop like a pro.

- Design & Customize – Create the coffee shop of your dreams!

- Stock Up & Manage – Keep an eye on your supplies or risk running out when you need them most.

- Handle Your Finances – Every bean counts! Spend wisely and invest in upgrades.

- Expand & Upgrade – Improve your shop to attract more customers and build your coffee empire.

- Unique Customers – Each with their own personalities and preferences!

- Your Choices Matter – Treat customers well… or badly! Your reputation will shape how they react.

- Stay on Your Toes – Follow every order carefully; slow service or mistakes could drive customers away forever!

- From Simple to Complex – Learn and master recipes, from a basic espresso to the most intricate latte art.

- Realistic Brewing Mechanics – Use professional barista tools to craft the perfect cup.

- Master the Espresso Game – Precision is key! Extract, steam, and serve like a real barista.

- Every Save is Unique – No two playthroughs are the same! Customers, events, and challenges change with each game.

- Weather Affects Business – A rainy day might mean more customers—how will you adapt?

- Surprises Await – Uncover hidden events and unexpected twists as you grow your café.

games.name: Football Manager: Auto Chess
games.shortDescription: A football management game mixed with collection career play. You manage a themed club, schedule training, recruitment and league fixtures, then drag coach cards to command near-realtime matches as you climb from lower leagues to bigger stages.
games.aboutText:
Matches are more than simple stat checks. Players move, contest the ball, push forward, and look for openings on their own. Read the situation and drag Coach Skill Cards onto specific areas or players to trigger pressing, forward runs, quick counterattacks, and more. Time slows while dragging a card, giving you a moment to read the field before making your move.

Your squad isn't limited to modern football. Grassroots village players, Tang Dynasty poets, heroes of Liangshan, Three Kingdoms warlords, Knights of the Round Table, Vikings, and wuxia legends can all join your team. Recruit, train, and rotate players, then build lineups around their traits and synergies to create a team truly your own.

Away from the pitch, you'll manage the club's daily schedule. Train players at the training grounds, recruit and socialize in the reception hall, handle club affairs in the administration building, and prepare for the next match. As the season progresses, lead your team from the lowest leagues toward bigger stages.

Life at the club is just as exciting off the pitch!
Enjoy a variety of fun and relaxing activities with your players, such as playing cards and trying your luck with scratch-off lottery tickets. Beyond tactical planning and competitive matches, the game offers plenty of everyday activities that make managing your club even more lively and entertaining.

- Club management × near-real-time auto-battler matches

- Drag-and-drop Coach Skill Cards that directly influence the match

- Collect players across eras and cultures to build unique squads

- Synergy system with a wide variety of themed lineups

- Detailed club schedule: matches / training / social / administration

- Multiple starting teams, with new squads unlocked through league promotion

Collect legends, strengthen your synergies, and play the card that changes the match—then watch your team rise from a muddy village pitch all the way to the world stage.
Football Manager Auto Chess — collect, develop, command, and write your own championship story.

Development Notice: The game is still in active development and is not the final complete version. Gameplay, balance, content, and UI may change through future updates. Thank you for joining us early and sharing your feedback.

games.name: Duck Life 4 Classic
games.shortDescription: The Flash-era classic returns! Duck Life 4 Classic is the original, now in HD with modern quality-of-life polish. Grind training mini-games, crush races and tournaments, and build, name, and style a custom duck team. No browser needed, just pure nostalgia on PC
games.aboutText:
RELIVE THE ORIGINAL

Duck Life 4 Classic is a faithful remaster of the award-winning Flash hit played over 250 million times. For the first time since Flash support ended, the authentic original is back on PC - no browser, no plugins. The classic you remember from computer class, now running smoothly with modern quality-of-life upgrades.

BUILD YOUR TEAM & CUSTOMISE

Hatch and train multiple ducks, assemble your best trio for tournaments, and personalise your flock with names and cosmetic options to make every champion feel like yours.

TRAINING MINI-GAMES

Sharpen your skills across Running, Swimming, Flying, Climbing and for the first time in the series, Jumping. Play fast, replayable mini-games to earn coins and level up stats, building the perfect racer one session at a time.

RACES & TOURNAMENTS

Compete across 6 regions and train up your ducks to outpace rivals. Conquer multi-race tournaments—including classic 3-duck team events—on your way to championship glory.

UPDATES & MODERN FEATURES

- Multiple save slots

- Rebalanced XP for a smoother progression curve

- Skippable tutorial for returning players

- Pause anytime, custom key bindings, precise audio sliders

- Steam Cloud, and Steam Achievements

Whether you’re here for nostalgia or discovering it fresh, Duck Life 4 Classic is the definitive way to play the original—authentic Flash-era feel, modern conveniences, and zero hassle. Raise your duck, crush the mini-games, dominate the tournaments, and build a squad that wins it all.

games.name: Watamari Part2 - A Fake Marriage?
games.shortDescription: This is a yuri game where you as an angel of love must help guide the heroines. Do your best, little angel (you) and take care of your mistress's wellbeing!
games.aboutText:
NOTE: It is recommended to play Watamari Part1 - A Match Made in Heaven prior to playing this game!

Story

Yata Hime has infiltrated the academy on a mission to root out its secrets.

Hoshino Hikari is another spy sent to the school, and in order to cover for her careless comments, Hime starts a fake relationship with her. But due to a charm spell that Hikari cast unintentionally, Hime has fallen in love with her.

As she tries to accomplish her mission as a spy and looks for a way to break the spell, the feelings between Hikari and Hime begin to change...

The academy's problem child, Yakumo Nene, secretly uses her "imaginary angels" in order to make some of the women there fall in love with each other. And today, she orders one of her angels (you) to bring Hikari and Hime closer together.

Concept

A next-generation yuri visual novel game where the player is also a participant!

The player isn't the main character, but an angel that works for one of the game's other characters, who guides the main characters to the choices that they will make.

- Depending on the character involved, they might not listen to you even if you provide a choice

- The guidance you provide may change the story and potential routes

- But what does it mean if the player is able to interfere with the world of Watamari...?

Features

- Live2D animated character sprites that brings characters to life including each of their unique and cute mannerisms

- Yuri-focused UI that displays two character's feelings for each other as if reading a yuri manga

- Characters in this story are unleashed by the player! Even though each of the girls have their own lives, it isn't right that the player can only control the main heroine. A "certain voice" will help you guide these girls forward. The choice is in their hands.

- English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese language support

- Full Japanese audio support

games.name: Winemaker Simulator
games.shortDescription: Step into the Medieval Mediterranean and live the life of a winemaker. From growing your vineyard to harvesting, from crafting wine to trading, every decision shapes your future. Will you be the one who creates the most exquisite and valuable wine? 🍷
games.aboutText:
Step into an atmospheric simulation set in the Medieval Mediterranean. As a master vintner, you will experience every stage of the journey from grape harvesting to wine bottling, striving to create the finest wine with your own hands.

🌿 Medieval Atmosphere

Discover the authentic life and the joy of winemaking around your own vineyard and little home on the shores of the Mediterranean.

🎮 Interactive Minigames

Every stage of wine production requires attention and skill. Your moves in interactive mini games such as bottle filling and branch cutting directly affect the quality of the wine you produce and your overall gaming experience.

🍇 Grape Harvest and Sorting

Create the best soil and environment for your grapes, harvest at the right time, sort out the rotten berries and carefully complete each process to achieve the finest wine .

⚒️ Authentic Winemaking

Experience each stage of the craft pressing, fermentation, barrel aging, and bottling — through detailed mini-games and interactive tools. Choose between faster production with machines or meticulous results through traditional handwork.

🏡 Maintenance, Repair and Progression

Clean your vines, repair structures and upgrade your equipment. Take on new responsibilities over time, improve your skills and transform from an ordinary producer into a respected vineyard master. Your ultimate goal: crafting the most delicious and valuable wine with your own hands.

🌙 Day and Night Cycle

Dynamic day and night cycles and weather conditions directly affect the production process. Taking the right steps at the right time is decisive for the quality of your harvest.

Every harvest is a new effort, every bottle a new experience. Will you be the one who crafts the most delicious and valuable wine ? 🍷

games.name: Home
games.shortDescription: A game about the short journey of a boy who left home. Experience a dense story in around 2 hours, along with rhythm gameplay and music puzzles. Enjoy live acoustic sounds and a story that feels like a musical film!
games.aboutText:
Notice to All Players

- This game contains heavy themes, including domestic violence.
If you have trauma related to family or similar subjects, please proceed with caution.

A boy who ran away from home.

He settles beneath a bridge, spending his days busking.

In this new routine, he experiences new encounters and small, unexpected happenings.

Why did he leave home?

And what will await him at the end of this short journey?

Enjoy a story that feels like a short musical film, capturing a boy’s fleeting journey.

A short experience of around 2 hours, combining Visual Novel, Rhythm Game, and Adventure.

It features a linear story to follow along,

enriched with mini-games such as the rhythm game [Busking] and the music puzzle [Songwriting].

A Quiet and Restrained Story

This script is based on the developer’s real life.

It doesn’t try to force emotion—

it simply unfolds in a calm yet honest way.

An Original Live Acoustic Soundtrack

All tracks are written, composed, performed, and recorded by the developer.

From the protagonist’s own songs to in-world “hit songs” performed on busking stages,

experience music that connects directly with the story.

Solo Development

Every illustration, every line of writing, and every piece of music was created by the developer alone.

Because this story is entirely mine, I wanted it to be told only through me.

Streaming & Content Creation Guidelines

- There are no restrictions on live streaming this game,
and broadcasting the full game content, including the ending, is fully permitted.
Uploading gameplay footage or archived live stream videos is also allowed without limitation.

- There are also no restrictions on creating secondary content such as videos, reviews, or commentary related to the game.

- However, if edited, summarized, commentary-based, or review-style content
seriously misrepresents the game through false or misleading information ,
the developer may request that such content be removed or made private,
and content creators are expected to comply with this request.

- Additionally, if such produced content
contains spoilers related to major parts of the game ,
content creators are requested to clearly indicate the presence of spoilers
at least once in a visible location, such as the thumbnail, title,
or at the beginning of the content.

games.name: 星と塔と冒険者
games.shortDescription: A 2D × 3D fantasy RPG where you investigate a mysterious tower that suddenly appeared. Fight, explore, and uncover the truth of the world.
games.aboutText:
A massive tower suddenly appeared within the kingdom.
Adventurers flocked to challenge it, while the daily lives of the kingdom’s people began to change.
A dungeon full of intricate gimmicks, powerful bosses blocking the way, and encounters with those who know the tower’s secrets.
Fight, explore, and connect with others as you gradually uncover the truth of this world.

Explore the dungeon and investigate ancient relics

Each dungeon is filled with various mechanisms and puzzles.
Solve them as you uncover and study the relics within.

Prepare your gear and defeat mighty foes

To advance to the next floor, you must overcome powerful enemies.
Make sure you’re well-prepared before heading into battle.

Talk with the townsfolk and gather information

The people near the tower’s entrance hold a wealth of knowledge about it.
By speaking with them multiple times, you may learn unexpected secrets.

Why did the tower appear?
Why did the king order its investigation instead of its destruction?
Your choices and your adventure will shape the fate of this world.

games.name: Monster Forest 怪物森林
games.shortDescription: The ancient forest has been corrupted by void energy into a fleshy spawning ground of mutated beasts. Choose two exiles from different factions to form a pact, and wield two distinct card builds to fight your way out of the suffocating woodland depths!
games.aboutText:
《 Monster Forest 》is a dark-fantasy tactical roguelike blending 10-lane linear grid wargaming with deckbuilding card gameplay.

Corrupted by void power, the ancient woodland has turned into a gruesome cradle of mutated abominations. Pick two exiles from separate factions to seal a pact, and wield two unique card archetypes to slash your way through the suffocating cursed woods.

Death Range

Featuring an exclusive forward-push combat rule: units are forced to advance if their attack range falls short. Calculate positioning carefully, manipulate foes with movement spells, or lock down frontlines with tanky warriors. Guard your leader well — your expedition ends instantly upon their death.

Field Hazards

Terrain traps add critical positional depth to battles, turning hunters into prey in a single turn.

Mutated Horrors

These powerful forest abominations can shatter your entire defense in an instant. Always prepare for the worst to survive the onslaught.

games.name: Pixel Survivors: Defense
games.shortDescription: Pixel Survivors: Defense is a roguelite tower defense game. Stand your ground as a lone hero against hordes of monsters, combine auto-casting spells with 200+ items, and survive up to 40 waves of elites and bosses to protect your base.
games.aboutText:
Pixel Survivors: Defense is a roguelite tower defense where the tower is your hero. It never takes a step. Monsters march down the lanes toward you, your spells fire on their own, and every run comes down to what you build before the line breaks.

Build it wave by wave

Level up to pick new spells and upgrades, then spend your gold in the shop between waves. Hold up to 5 of 18 spells, and from wave 21 each one can evolve into something much bigger. Over 200 items let you push a build as far as it goes, and plenty of them ask for something back.

Then the monsters fight back

Elites show up with tricks of their own, 8 bosses stand in your way, and some maps send enemies at you from every side. Turn on Monsters' Ascension and every wave the monsters get a new item too.

Plenty to unlock

10 heroes, each with their own weapon and passive. 5 difficulties, Endless mode, meta upgrades, achievements and a codex of everything you've found.

games.name: Coconut Simulator 2
games.shortDescription: Coconut Simulator 2 is a game in which you can become a coconut.
games.aboutText:
Coconut Simulator 2 is a game in which you can become a coconut.

This game will give you a meditative gameplay. You can stand and contemplate the beauty of the beach around you living your life as a coconut. You can also perform actions that coconuts usually perform (stand in the same place).

New Features

- 5 playable characters

- Dynamic change of day and night

- Ambient sounds

- Music

- New visual effects

- New map

Canonical Features

- You're a coconut

- You're on the beach

- There are other coconuts around you

- And not only coconuts

Other Features

- 2 game mods: arcade and realistic

- Realistic graphics

- Simple control

games.name: Glisynth
games.shortDescription: Glisynth is a rhythm game that uses two types of notes. The Q row on the keyboard is used for yellow notes, while the A row is used for white notes.
games.aboutText:
When the game starts, notes fall down in sync with the music.

You must press the correct key at the right time, when the note reaches the judgment line, to process it.

There are two types of notes: White notes and yellow notes.

To process a yellow note, you should press a key in the Q row of the keyboard,

And to process a white note, you should press a key in the A row of the keyboard.

The more accurate your timing is when you press the key, the better your judgment will be.

You will gain or lose life depending on this judgment.

If the timing is correct but the keyboard row does not match the note color, an OFF judgment will be given.

You lose less life than a MISS, but be careful as it breaks your combo.

Long notes refer to notes with a tail.

You process them by holding down the key for the entire length of the tail.

If you finish the song with some life remaining, it will count as cleared. Pay attention to your life and try to complete each stage!

games.name: Island Market Simulator: Prologue
games.shortDescription: Island Market Simulator – In this strategy and economy simulation game set in an island town, build your trade empire by starting with a small market. Produce your goods through farming, livestock, and supply chain management, and expand your business with seasonal dynamics and festivals!
games.aboutText:
◆ Increase your reputation by decorating your home with 100 different items . Express your style with paintings, furniture, and decorative accessories. Market and home decorations directly affect your in-game prestige system!

◆ Diversify your income by offering 73 different products for sale. Showcase various product categories to expand your customer base. Reach maximum profit potential through strategic product placement!

◆ Discover the dynamics of the game with countless weather events brought by 4 different seasons . Effects like snow, rain, and scorching heat can impact everything from farming to trade. Each season brings new challenges and opportunities, adding life to the game!

◆ Diversify your farming by growing 47 different crops . Optimize the processes of sowing, watering, and harvesting to achieve maximum yield. Sell your produce at markets or use it in various recipes!

◆ Make your game even more colorful with events that appear on specific dates. These seasonal or special-day events offer rare rewards and surprise opportunities. Stay active to never miss out and benefit from every advantage!

◆ Raise 3 different types of animals to obtain various products like milk, wool, eggs, and meat. Take care of their health and happiness to increase productivity. Sell the products you collect or use them in your own production processes!

◆ Shape your in-game relationships by completing quests from the kingdom, pirates, and townsfolk . Each quest has its own story and reward. Through these missions, you can discover new areas and witness different storylines!

◆ Grab your hammer and head to the workshop! Use 10 different machines to craft 40 unique products! From cheese to fabric, jam to alcohol everything depends on your craftsmanship. You choose what to produce and shape the economy your way!

games.name: Avernum 4: Greed and Glory
games.shortDescription: The cult-classic saga is back! Battle for fame, power, and wealth in the subterranean nation of Avernum. Conquer an enormous underworld in this epic turn-based fantasy RPG. Features huge, clever dungeons, varied and cunning foes, 100s of artifacts to find or craft, and a really cool story.
games.aboutText:
Started in 1994, the cult-classic Avernum series is one of the great video game sagas! In this epic fantasy role-playing adventure, you explore and conquer an enormous underworld. Battle through huge dungeons, fight unique and cunning foes, collect, create, and bless hundreds of different artifacts, and enjoy a really good story.

Avernum is a nation underground. Kept alive by the courage and magic of its inhabitants, it stretches through many hundreds of miles of caverns, mines, and labyrinths. It is a wild frontier, attracting adventurers, explorers, brigands, and monsters, all racing to claim the wealth and knowledge in its caves.

You have come to the wild edges of the known underworld with your own goals. (Wealth? Freedom? Conquest?) Once there, you found disaster. Many powerful forces hunger for the riches of the underworld. Swarms of beasts attack. Cities fall into ruin. Your bad luck: You're the one who might save Avernum from its crisis. Can you do it? And what will you take as your reward?

Avernum 4: Greed and Glory features:

- Epic, turn-based fantasy adventure in a gigantic world, full of interesting characters, clever dungeons, and quests both grim and funny.

- Open-ended story, with multiple factions who plead for (or buy) your support. Practice politics with monsters and choose whether to bring a happy peace or a profitable disaster.

- Complex, open-ended game system full of tactical options and ways to build your party. Well over 100 abilities, traits, spells, and other ways to gain power.

- A unique fantasy world packed with lore, humor, and history. Not your standard elves and orcs.

Avernum 4: Greed and Glory is the beginning of Avernum's Great Trials Trilogy, and experience with previous Avernum games is completely unnecessary. This is a remaster of the original cult-classic, Avernum 4, which came out in 2005, and features a greatly expanded story and tons of new dungeons, characters, and quests.

games.name: Invokyr
games.shortDescription: A co-op survival horror game about a cursed board game. Play in a group of 6 players. Roll the dice, survive the horrors that are summoned, and beat the Gamemaster to win your freedom.
games.aboutText:
Every Roll Summons a New Surprise!

You’re trapped. The house groans around you. Cold. Dark. On the table sits a 1970s board game, dusty but humming with energy. You’d heard rumours, of course. About the board, the house. You look to your friends, and a voice, whimsical yet bitter, speaks: “Let’s play a game.”

Once a beloved toy, the Gamemaster now rules this abandoned house. Escape is possible but only if you play. You roll the dice, and another worldly sound echoes through the house. Will you win your freedom or be dragged into the darkness?

Beat the Gamemaster

Play the game and survive the unpredictable terrors, traps, and curses that are summoned. Reach the end and you’ll escape. Perhaps.

Face the Fear Together

Online co-op with up to 6 players. Work together… or leave someone behind. Death is not always the end.

Explore to Find Dice

Scour the house to recover the dice hidden within. Each can only be used once. Choose wisely.

Special Dice

Some dice offer powers to heal, hide, or hinder those who hunt you, but nothing comes without risk.

Try Not to Get Lost

The house is a labyrinth of rooms. Lose your way, and you may never make it back to the board.

Fear-filled Features:

- Immerse yourself in a co-op psychological horror, built around a cursed game that is desperate to be played.

- Face bizarre, unique creatures: each with their own way of hunting.

- Traps, curses, and chaos await every turn.

- The house has different biomes: jungle, ice mountain, oversized toy chest.

- Survive to earn rewards… and unlock more formidable challenges. Will you play again?

Come, friends, and play.

Live or die, who could say?

games.name: Murals
games.shortDescription: Express yourself through stylized combat in the hand-painted worlds of Murals, a twisted isometric action-adventure where fairytales have gone spectacularly wrong. These are not the tales you were told.
games.aboutText:
Sleeping Beauty hasn’t slept in weeks, Rapunzel’s hair is trying to kill her, and Rumpelstiltskin is… really into theater?

These are not the tales you were told.

You wake up in a twisted fairytale castle, with no memory of who you are or how you got there. Your sole companion, a sentient sketch named Loaf, has just informed you that not only is there no clear escape, but a bunch of monsters he’s named “The Distorted” have just turned up.

From talking swords to dwarven gloves to mystical dragon blasters, combine melee and ranged weapons as you battle through crooked castles, deceitful forests, living mazes, and more.

Complement your arsenal with 'Eeries' - powerful trinkets that wildly change how any fight plays out. Poison for your Wolfhammer? Lightning for Medusa’s shield? Step up to Magic Dave’s Vending Machine of Delights to discover a world of weirdness.

Defeat distorted legends from lore, as you fight toward a final confrontation with The Creator, a deceptively calm, definitely deadly, artist. But be warned, he's been watching your progress, and he likes what he sees.

Encounter characters far removed from the stories of your youth, brought to life and fully voiced by an incredible cast.

Enjoy a brand-new, fully orchestrated score from award-winning composer David Housden.

games.name: Dick Shortson. The Detective.
games.shortDescription: Dick Shortson – The Detective. You've been hired by a woman to find her missing mother. Grab your gun and uncover the secrets hidden in another godforsaken village. Shoot, solve puzzles, and catch the vibe.
games.aboutText:
Dick Shortson – The Detective.
You've been hired by a woman to find her missing mother. You've been hired by a woman to find her missing mother. Grab your gun and uncover the secrets hidden in another godforsaken village. Shoot, solve puzzles, and catch the vibe.

This is a first-person shooter inspired by old-school games, where the control system was often your biggest enemy.
Every weapon in the game is deadly — every shot could be your last, or your enemy’s.
Think twice before pulling the trigger. You're not a walking ammo dispenser, and Dick Shortson is far from the best gunslinger — maybe even the worst.

Look around — there might be a way forward that doesn’t involve violence. Or just charge in headfirst.

The game takes place in an old village.
A decaying little vilage — all the young people have long since moved to the cities, leaving behind only the elderly and those not too strong of mind or dependent on various substances. A perfect breeding ground for anyone looking to impose their ideas on others, isn’t it?

So, you want to shoot a bit, think a little, and vibe with stylized graphics? Then this detective adventure is for you.

games.name: Computer Sillow
games.shortDescription: A Clicker Game, with less waiting around and more green dogs!
games.aboutText:
Well, Its Your Computer, I suppose. Something about this familiar frontier seems a little... different? I dont think there was always a green dog in the middle of your screen, was there?? And ontop of that, is that a whole economy growing entirely inside your computer? something seems off.

SOMETHING has taken its spot front and center on your computer! suddenly, theres green dogs, shops, pets, mines, clothes?? phones??? minigames????? JOHN STONER??????? what is going ON.

The General Gameplay of Computer Sillow takes after the classic clicker games, but obviously with its own twists, like minigames and events! and it has a plot, for some reason. aside from the basics of clicking and automating your money gain, theres many other things to do! such as minigames, events, shops, people you can talk to, pet things? and more!

The game may seem complicated at first with all its features, but through the tutorial and the general ease of access to these features, you get the hang of them quite fast! making for a fun gameplay loop that gets more unique as it goes on...

All of this is accompanied by a wonderful OST composed by our wonderful musicians nevermaur, OJSTheCoder, and some guests!

Now, you may be wondering: "What do people who have already played this game think of it? give me an idea!"

games.name: CRYMELIGHT
games.shortDescription: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.
games.aboutText:
"You are all sinners."

This is Wonderland, a prison for the souls of the dead.

A girl bereft of her memories is granted the name "Alice" by her guide, the White Rabbit.

She is led to the site of a tea party.

There, Alice learns of a rule:

In this game, only those who can defeat the Queen are granted freedom.

And so, Alice joins forces with a mysterious girl called Mary and resolves to participate in the game to return to her world.

Whenever she comes into contact with the sins of her companions, she is able to see the painful pasts they experienced.

...Why did the Queen create this world?

And what awaits the victor? Salvation… or retribution?

"I'll make these sins mean something."

A world after death where one must face their destiny while burdened by sin, full of interesting characters.

Enjoy a fully voiced story in which you learn more about each girl, their regrets and penance.

Plot and Story Supervision by Naoki Hisaya. Music by Sakuzyo. Character design by YOGISYA.

Alice (Voiced by Sayaka Senbongi)

“Wishes? I don’t even remember anything about myself.”

Mary (Voiced by Hitomi Sekine)

“I hope I can return home someday...”

Cheshire (Voiced by Yukina Shuto)

“I hope I get to see my friend again.”

Mad (Voiced by Nao Ojika)

“Living is painful, isn't it? Death is salvation.”

March (Voiced by Yurina Amami)

“I just want to keep having tea parties...”

White Rabbit (Voiced by Yu Sasahara)

“Please, by all means, kill her... Kill the Queen of Hearts!”

♠ Roguelike Action

So begins a journey across the Queen's domain—Wonderland—avoiding opponents and battling to the death with her royal army.

♠ Wonder Dimension

The moment an enemy is slain, an indigo "Wonder Dimension" will spread across the field.

As the dimension expands, your abilities will grow stronger and the action will speed up.

Your acquired skills determine how quickly the dimension expands and the way in which your abilities are enhanced, changing the way you approach battles.

♠ Poker System

Collect 5 skill cards to form poker-style hands.

Stronger combinations result in stronger effects, changing the course of the battle with different attacks and tactics.

What cards do you hold onto? What hands will you aim for? Your choices will determine victory or defeat.

♠ Mode Select

Switch the camera between a close-up side-view or a wide overhead-view, and toggle the information UI on and off.

Whether you prioritize immersion in the world or want to check your game data, you can pick whichever best suits your playstyle.

♠ Repentance System

Confess the sins you have shouldered in your death battles and transform them into power.

Alice will take on the sins of the wayward souls she defeats along the way.

The tears of penitence will become power-up items for you to use.

♠ Powering Up

Use the materials you obtain through repentance to make your weapons and accessories more powerful.

Even if you are thrown back in time and lose your cards, you can keep some progress through this.

Next time, aim to go deeper; go farther.

♠ Tea Parties

Enjoy conversations with compatriots over some tea.

The girls may touch on various things such as their pasts and may even divulge surprising details about slain foes.

♠ Finally

Add CRYMELIGHT to your wishlist and look forward to the release date!

Please...give meaning to their sins.

Languages: Japanese / English / Simplified Chinese / Traditional Chinese / Korean

Voice: Japanese

games.name: Slot Machine Gun
games.shortDescription: A roguelike deckbuilder shooter where you wield an ever changing weapon : The Slot Machine Gun! Every reload spins up a fresh combo of guns and chaotic effects to create game breaking synergies.
games.aboutText:
Slot Machine Gun is a roguelike deckbuilder shooter where you wield an ever changing weapon : The Slot Machine Gun! Every reload spins up a fresh combo of guns and chaotic effects to create game breaking synergies.

Slot Machine Gun

Wield an ever-changing weapon : Half gun, half slot machine, each reload combines weapons and chaotic effects for an (not so) unpredictable result !

Build your weapon

With more than 1000+ combinations, build your slot machine using tons of weapons and effects, all synergizing with each other, and unleash new game breaking combinations to shoot your way through enemies and bosses !

Explore the city

Explore a crime-ridden chempunk city, meeting its weird inhabitants and facing its dangers, while trying to piece out the mysterious origin of the sentient SlotMachineGun !

Features :

- Wield an ever-changing weapon : Half Gun / Half Slot Machine

Every reload spins up a fresh combo of guns and chaotic effects.

Test your luck and learn to master the odds in your favor.

- Break the game, with 1000+ possibles builds

Tons of effects, combinations and game-breaking synergies.

Unlock new weapons and characters, each with their own special abilities.

- Be greedy and win big ! Or lose everything

Bet on your skill : Accept harder challenges for better loot.

Bet on your luck : Spend all your earned coin on, almost fair, slot machines.

games.name: 戦国英雄譚-Samurai Heroes-
games.shortDescription: This is a highly flexible command RPG set in Japan's Warring States period. There are over 85 playable factions and over 300 generals! All items have random titles and qualities! Enjoy collecting generals and items, and freely forming your troops!
games.aboutText:
This game is a command-based RPG set in the Warring States period, one of the most fascinating eras in Japanese history. Enjoy various elements that capture the atmosphere of the Warring States period.

●Freely choose your protagonist from 91 daimyo families or new warlords!

In this game, you can freely choose your protagonist from 91 daimyo houses or new warlords. Each daimyo house offers different protagonist abilities, the number and abilities of your retainers, the surrounding power dynamics, and the warlords who will join you in that region. This allows you to enjoy different story developments with each playthrough.

●Recruit over 300 warlords and freely form your army!

Numerous warlords who colored the Warring States period make an appearance. Over 300 of them!

Independent generals may join your service after defeating them in battle. Generals belonging to other factions can also potentially join you after you conquer their faction. Gather numerous talented vassals and aim for unification!

●Form your own army with your favorite generals!

You can form units at your faction's castle. You can also assign deputy commanders to generals in your units to enhance their abilities. Combine generals with various skills and abilities to form the strongest unit!

●Train the strongest unit and enhance generals through equipment treasure hunting!

In battle scenes, use attribute skills such as spear, cavalry, archery, and strategy, as well as powerful unique skills to overwhelm enemy units. Enemy levels become stronger the farther you are from your base. However, there are no penalties for being defeated, so keep trying (except for some event battles).

In this game, equipment can be obtained from enemy drops or certain events. Items are randomly assigned “quality” and “titles,” so enjoy treasure hunting for divine equipment!

●Conquer enemy castles in any order

The vast field map, based on an actual map of Japan, features enemy castles scattered across the landscape. Whether you choose to “start by defeating weaker forces to build your strength” or “take down that famous warlord first to obtain their equipment,” conquer enemy castles in any order you like and aim for national unification.

●Various events based on progress

Depending on your progress in conquering enemy forces, various events—both good and bad—will occur. Overcome them all and aim for national unification!

●Diverse features supporting freedom!

This game implements various features for comfortable gameplay.

・New Warlord Creation: Import original images, set warlord abilities and skills, and choose your starting region to play.

・Difficulty Adjustment: Choose between the standard Normal mode and the challenging Hard mode. For those seeking greater hardship, enjoy the solitary Lonely Mode with no subordinates.

・Domestic Affairs: Appoint warlords as domestic affairs officers to gain advantageous effects.

・Blacksmith Feature: Randomly generate equipment and regenerate item titles.

・Training Feature: Level up your favorite generals.

・Fast Travel Feature: Travel instantly to your faction's castles.

・New Game+ Feature: Carry over one set of equipment when starting a new playthrough. Enjoy playing as various factions!

Experience “Freedom in the Warring States Era!” in this game.

games.name: 5 nights at Timokha 5: Island
games.shortDescription: A NAUGHTY GUY SHOWED A PIE AND RUINED A VACATION ON A PARADISE BEACH!
games.aboutText:
Timofey Pirozhkov, also known as Timokha , is the biggest troublemaker on the planet!

This time, he has arrived straight from the army and turned a peaceful vacation on the Maldives into absolute chaos.
Save the island from Timokha and his gang… or he’ll show everyone his “big and tasty pie” 😄

Time is running out. Adventure awaits!
Dive into this crazy world as soon as possible.

This is not just a FNAF-style survival game…
It’s something MORE.

🎮 FEATURES

- 🌗 Day and Night Cycle

- 🏝️ Variety of Quests
(Underwater diving, night survival, helicopter boss fight, fishing)

- 🎨 Stylized and colorful graphics

- 😂 A LOT… no… an OCEAN of jokes about the “tasty pie”

🧠 Gameplay

The game is a point-and-click survival horror experience.

You play from a first-person perspective and must carefully manage your time — one wrong move and a terrifying jumpscare won’t take long to appear.

In addition, the game features free-roam quest sections , giving you more freedom beyond classic survival gameplay.

games.name: Azaran: The Demon Bottle
games.shortDescription: Explore cryptic puzzle dungeons in this short, retro, action-adventure!
games.aboutText:
It was the Golden Age of Heroes.

And in that time, the Sultan did decree: "Bringeth to me the Demon Bottle of Hatt-Zon."

Thus did Zahid Al-Azar set upon his quest.

A short dungeon crawler packed with monsters, traps, and cryptic puzzles - made in 3 weeks as a companion to Azaran: Islands of the Jinn.

games.name: Гвалт
games.shortDescription: Collect words, find powerful combinations of boosters, and achieve the highest score! In this dynamic word game, you will find dozens of artifacts, unusual upgrades, and colorful characters who are ready to raise a ruckus!
games.aboutText: Gvalt is a colorful word game in which you have to collect words from different letters, shout them out, and score as many points as possible. As you play, you will find artifacts, rules, and new letters that will strengthen your words and help you shout them out as loudly as possible!

games.name: Soba's Gunpaw
games.shortDescription: Soba’s Gunpaw is a Short Incremental - Bullet Heaven game. Destroy everything, collect resources, then choose upgrades from a massive skill tree! Designed to be completed in around 4 hours.
games.aboutText:
=== Stroll around with Soba and protect him from any danger ===

=== Socializing with other female cats ===

=== Upgrade the Skill Tree ===

=== Battle it OUT ===

Features

- Massive Skill Tree (200+ upgrades)

- Chaotic Bullet Heaven gameplay

- Lots of resources to gather

- Lots of progress bars to complete

- Short gameplay (4 hours to complete)

- Really BIG and satisfying numbers!

- Cute CATS ᓚ₍ ^. .^₎

games.name: Desktop Duck
games.shortDescription: Your desktop deserves a duck. It lives on your screen, perches on your windows, and reacts to you. Earn hats together, then trade, sell, or show them off.
games.aboutText:
Meet your new desktop companion

Desktop Duck is a lightweight virtual pet that lives right on your screen. It doesn't sit in a window waiting for you. It wanders your desktop, hops onto your windows, naps on the taskbar, and notices what you're up to.

It has a life of its own

- Reacts to you. Type and it gets busy with you. Go quiet and it finds its own fun.

- Keeps itself busy. It reads a book, plays with a virtual pet, bounces a ball, juggles a soccer ball, or just sneezes.

- Has feelings about its toys. Take one away and you'll hear about it.

- Loves attention. Pet it, pick it up, toss it across the screen, and set it down wherever you want its home to be.

Dress it up

Your duck brings you gifts as you spend time together. Unwrap hats and glasses, fill out your Collection, and turn duplicates into Feathers to spend on the pieces you're after. Every item is a real Steam item you can trade with friends.

A companion that also helps you focus

- Focus Mode. Start a session and your duck settles down and keeps you company quietly until you're done.

- Website Blocking. Tell your duck which sites to keep you off, and it will fly over and close the tab for you.

- Screen time stats. See where your day went, without the guilt trip.

Bring your friends' ducks over

Join friends online and their ducks show up on your desktop beside yours. Chat, send emotes, and watch them waddle around together.

Made to stay out of your way

Desktop Duck is light on your PC and never covers your full-screen games. Your activity stays on your computer, and all you need is Steam.

games.name: A Game About Breaking A Cube
games.shortDescription: Take on the role of a factory worker oppressed by an evil corporation. Break stranger and stranger cubes in pursuit of ore and truth. Upgrade your tools, explore the underground facility and learn the secret of NullCorp. Later, relax at home with a cold can of drinkable meat.
games.aboutText:
A Game About Breaking A Cube is a dystopian horror sim. Take on the role of the E.R.A.S.E.R. and take a ride underground to the mysterious underbelly of NullCorp. Project ERASURE cannot lead to anything bad... Right?

Break Cubes

There are dozens of different cubes to break, made of stone, metal, meat and even weirder stuff. Why are they making them? How are they making them? And what are you looking for inside?

Collect Strange Treasures Found Inside

Extract valuables from the cubes. Why are they getting so weird though? First ores, then teeth, now this... Where is all this stuff coming from?

Explore

It wouldn't hurt to take a break and walk around a little bit, stretch your legs. There is definitely nothing suspicious to find around. No secrets. No top secret stuff. Definitely nothing to see here.

Weird, Weird Lore

There must be answers to what's going on here. Break enough cubes, cross enough red tapes and be brave enough to find out what's really going on in Nullcorp.

games.name: How I Flex with AI
games.shortDescription: Guys, who gets it?! This is basically a mashup of The AI Show-Off Counterattack Guide for Socially Anxious Otakus and a Goofy Campus Sweet Romance Drama — I laughed so hard my abs cramped up!
games.aboutText:
Guys, who gets it?! This is basically a mashup of The AI Show-Off Counterattack Guide for Socially Anxious Otakus and a Goofy Campus Sweet Romance Drama — I laughed so hard my abs cramped up!

The protagonist Lin Fan is the peak of broke and socially anxious. He’s humiliated by wealthy second-gen Zhao Tianhao while munching on greens and tofu in the cafeteria, and he can’t even look up when talking to campus beauty Su Qingyue. But accidentally downloading a clownfish AI named Xiaoyu (holding a rose, no less) lands him a "lifetime show-off service" binding! This cheeky AI detects his charm level 5, wealth level 2, and negative favorability with the school beauty — then slaps him with a newbie mission: Get Su Qingyue’s WeChat in 24 hours, or suffer the ultimate social death penalty: broadcasting Meow Like a Cat over the school loudspeaker for an hour!

What follows are iconic scenes of the AI forcing the socially anxious Lin Fan to face his fears: In the library, the AI accurately predicts when Su Qingyue will get water, teaches Lin Fan to awkwardly praise her hairpin, then urgently switches to the "chat about One Hundred Years of Solitude " script — and somehow, fumbling through it, he actually gets her WeChat! In advanced math class, the AI solves complex formulas in seconds; Lin Fan reads them aloud, transforming from a sleepy slacker to a hidden master, leaving the professor blown away. Short on cash? The AI guides him to resell glow sticks: teaching him to play the sympathy card ("I have eight younger sisters to support") and market "Single Noble Edition" glow sticks with goofy tactics, letting him make a killing. It even forces him to upgrade his wardrobe for 300 yuan, turning him from a scruffy guy into a fresh-looking handsome dude — Su Qingyue’s eyes light up when she sees him!

The rest is a total power trip: In the debate club, the AI acts as his strategist, turning Lin Fan from a tongue-tied introvert into a master of verbal warfare who leaves opponents tongue-tied. When rival Zhao Tianhao maliciously reports him, Lin Fan crams with the AI’s help, scores 98 points to crush everyone, and publicly humiliates Zhao. When hooligans harass Su Qingyue off-campus, the AI instantly becomes a combat coach, turning Lin Fan into a kung fu guy protecting his girl — his boyfriend material level maxes out! For the rooftop confession, he has his roommates use a drone to display "Lin Fan ❤ Su Qingyue" with colored lights, mixing romance with absurdity.

Throughout the story, AI Xiaoyu is a total devil + comic relief: It tracks rivals with GPS-level precision, loads roast scripts in seconds, and handles everything from date topics to outfit plans to academic knowledge. It pushes Lin Fan from a "three-no otaku" (no social skills, no money, no charm) to campus hunk, top student, and aspiring entrepreneur — and he finally wins over Su Qingyue, marrying her after graduation and building a successful career, becoming a life winner!

The rivals are treated like NPCs getting crushed to social withdrawal: Zhao Tianhao goes from arrogant wealthy kid to a sour grape; Zhang Yang gets academically crushed and runs away; Li Zhe’s speech is ruined by Lin Fan’s goofy stand-up + PDA attack, forcing him to leave dejectedly. All I can say: With an AI cheat code, even socially anxious guys can show off, and poor boys can stage a comeback. This script is all about being "absurd yet addictive, silly yet adorable"!

games.name: Titanic
games.shortDescription: A simulator of the operation of the most famous ship Titanic. Become the owner and captain of the Titanic, sail around the world! Carry passengers and cargo, make money and prosper!
games.aboutText:
A simulator of the operation of the most famous ship Titanic. Become the owner and captain of the Titanic, sail around the world! Carry passengers and cargo, make money and prosper!

You are the owner of the famous ocean liner Titanic. Your company, the White Star Line, operates regular services around the world. Only you decide where your Titanic goes! Revive the famous Southampton to New York route and avoid the ice fields, or travel to Egypt, Australia and other destinations.

What's in store for you in the game

- The chance to travel around the world- Titanic carries 3 categories of passengers from the richest to the poorest

- Trading

- Events

- danger and adventure

games.name: EVERDAWN
games.shortDescription: EVERDAWN is a relaxing tile-based puzzle game where every placement shapes a living, evolving world. Stack scoring systems, combine biomes, unlock new and powerful Wonder tiles, and collect adorable Michis, little creatures that provide extra tiles.
games.aboutText:
EVERDAWN is a peaceful strategy and puzzle game where you place tiles to shape ever-growing, enchanting landscapes. Step into a serene world where nature flourishes, and take a quiet moment to unwind and build at your own pace.

Made by a lone developper, EVERDAWN is a unique mix of strategy and puzzle with a peaceful, immersive atmosphere. Shape an ever-expanding world tile by tile in EVERDAWN. Balance aesthetics, logic and score chasing as every placement matters. Whether you’re here to relax or looking for a challenge, create lush forests, harmonious villages or mysterious wilderness, your world, your rhythm, endless possibilities.

Each session begins with a stack of randomly generated tiles. Draw them one by one, rotate them, and connect forests, rivers, villages and more to shape a unique world. Smart placements earn points, unlock new tiles and extend your run. Create clusters and interconnected groups of tiles. The more elaborate your connections, the greater the rewards. Will you seize opportunities as they come, or plan carefully for the long term?

From the very start, take on random quests across three categories:
• Common: easy to complete, perfect for steady progress.
• Rare: more challenging but far more rewarding.
• Wonders: unique objectives granting access to one of 9 powerful Wonders that can radically change your strategy with unique bonuses.

Advance through Adventure mode to unlock new biomes, each changing the appearance and gameplay of your tiles. Create fresh combinations in every run and aim to have as many different biome tiles as possible to earn diversity score.

Find, collect, and choose your Michi, adorable little creatures that inhabit the world and may prove useful during your games.

Progression

• Expand your world tile by tile and complete optional objectives.
• Unlock biomes, new tiles, ground types, camera filters, mouse cursors, unique combinations and the Michis.
• Accumulate score to spend it on finds in the Michi shop. Exploration

• No timer: play at your own pace or chase the highest score in different game modes.
• Grow living landscapes with forests, fields, rivers, and much more. Gameplay

• Place and rotate tiles, form clusters, and complete quests to earn bonuses.
• Easy to pick up, hard to master: accessible yet deep. Atmosphere

• Soothing and immersive soundtrack, varying depending on the game mode.
• Colorful, evolving visuals that reflect the growth of your world. Replayability

• Random tile draws guarantee unique sessions.
• Simply create or push for the best score.

games.name: Thunder Spikes Volleyball
games.shortDescription: The most authentic volleyball feel ever made in 2D. One button, a whole playbook: spike, tip, block and serve with pixel-precise control. Build your club in Career mode, take on national teams in Arcade, or grab a gamepad and play co-op or versus with friends on the couch.
games.aboutText:
Thunder Spikes Volleyball is a 2D video game where you can perform every volleyball move: spikes, tips, blocks, serves, and spectacular diving saves.

Read the defense mid-air, pick your move, and score! Just as reading the attack well can help you pull off satisfying monster blocks .

- Local multiplayer ( or online streaming via Steam Remote Play Together)

- Over 1,500 frames of hand-drawn animations

- Arcade Mode : challenge and unlock all National Teams and win the cup

- More than 12 unique courts , from playgrounds and school gyms to stadiums and world-class arenas

games.name: Their Sky
games.shortDescription: Their Sky is an idle deck-builder. Select cards and strategies as you build decks that can win on their own. Rather than managing moves, Their Sky all in on deck building: turn your favorite cards into self-running engines.
games.aboutText:
Their Sky is an idler and a deck-builder. Instead of managing moves, players construct decks and automation rules to build decks that win on their own. While the decks automatically battle online, they will complete missions and challenges, earning card packs and rare card rewards. And with a growing collection of cards, players can build meta-defining decks, earning them a spot on the leaderboard.

Features:
- 300 powerful cards
- Playback of all automated matches
- Full automation rules to automate any strategy
- Leaderboard with rewards
- Missions that reward card packs
- Challenges that reward rare cards
- Full card analytics

games.name: BEERCRUSH
games.shortDescription: Enter the world of John Beer in this psychotic, fast-paced roguelike where you drink beer to stay alive! Dash as fast as you can through unique and crazy worlds to break the vicious cycle. So what are you waiting for!? LIVE LIFE. EVERY GOLDEN MINUTE OF IT!
games.aboutText:
WARNING: This game may potentially trigger seizures for people diagnosed with photosensitive epilepsy.

BEERCRUSH is a psychotic, fast-paced roguelike where you need to drink beer to stay alive!

Play as the profoundly average John Beer to jump, slide, and boost your way through crazy worlds! Use your incredible alcoholism to stay alive by chugging beer, gain new abilities by talking to Kyle, and get to the bottom of... whatever is going on here.

Improve your abilities with Bottlecaps!

Escaping a world will grant you an upgrade to your abilities, known as Bottlecaps ! Mix and match up to three of them to your liking to blow past future worlds with ease!

DRINK BEER!!

Every world has a unique beer drinking minigame. Some are easier than others... you'll need to master them all to stay alive and get to where you're going!

Features:

- 8+ frantic, procedurally generated worlds to chug beer in!

- 10+ Bottlecaps, equip these to gain new abilities ranging from a shield of beer to a shotgun!

- 3+ Gamemodes, each providing a unique take on John Beer's adventure.

- Unlockable Borders to customize your experience!

- A rockin' original soundtrack, perfect for getting your stomach pumped!

- There is also beer.

So go ahead! LIVE LIFE! EVERY GOLDEN MINUTE OF IT!!

games.name: Slimeward
games.shortDescription: Slimeward is an idle game where players build and upgrade a village, recruit heroes, and defeat Monster 'Slime' that fell in front of the house one day,
games.aboutText:
Monster 'Slime' that fell in front of the house one day, could you turn this crisis into an opportunity?

Slime can't easily get rid of it, the more you try to get rid of it, the myriad little slimes that pop out just despair you.

You should use these little slimes as your resources to strengthen your base.

Gather resources to build various buildings and gather courageous mercenaries! Only when your town becomes powerful can you defeat this heinous monster.

Make a stronger upgrade with various buildings and stronger upgradeendless challenges and colorful slides are waiting for you...

games.name: Familiar Findings
games.shortDescription: Summon and study witches’ familiars in this charming creature collection game. Gather dragons, spirits and more in your quest to complete your magical grimoire. Watch them enchant your screen without intruding while you work, study or relax. With over 100 variations there’s a favourite for everyone!
games.aboutText:
Familiar Findings is a charming and cozy idle game with a magical twist. Join Avia, an aspiring mythozoologist, as she seeks to write and complete a magical grimoire of witches’ familiars. Summon familiars, collect their mana and complete fusion spells to discover new combinations.

Unlock New Companions

Sleeping Elder Dragons, grumpy ghosts and elegant capycorns are just some of the many familiars that wander and rest at the bottom of your screen. Try new fusion combinations to discover exclusive colour variants and higher rarities. Click on them to interact, each type has its own unique animations!

Your new desktop companions will keep you company while you do other things, whether that’s streaming, writing assignments or getting lost in internet rabbit holes.

Complete your codex

Each new discovery aids you in your research and brings you one page closer in completing your grimoire. Learn new facts about your familiars, track your progress and read Avia’s notes and musings.

Play that doesn't get in your way

Your familiars live at the bottom of your screen, but they won't stop you from being able to use any of your desktop! Your menu is tucked away when you’re not using it to give you a streamlined experience. There’s no distracting notifications or demanding grind mechanics that ruin your relaxation. Click and drag to move a familiar out of the way or scroll on Avia to quickly size everything up and down. Toggle reduced opacity mode to make it even easier to see what's going on behind!

games.name: Onigiri Shop Simulator
games.shortDescription: Your own onigiri (rice ball) shop in Japan awaits! Serve perfect rice balls and crispy sides to hungry customers. As a solo operator, you'll manage inventory, perfect your cooking flow, and handle the rush. Can you turn your tiny stand into a beloved town eatery?
games.aboutText:
Streaming and video content allowed.

Monetization using this game is permitted.

Welcome to your cozy onigiri (rice ball) shop on a street corner in Japan.

From today, you're running the whole show yourself.

Craft the perfect onigiri with fluffy, warm rice and savory fillings, and serve your hungry customers with a smile.

Your menu also features delicious side dishes, like crispy croquettes and golden fried fish.

With a constant stream of orders, you'll need to think on your feet and keep your hands moving!

You're not just the owner—you're the chef and the cashier, too. With limited time and space, your success depends on smart decisions. Which ingredients do you stock up on? What do you cook first? Mastering inventory and perfecting your workflow is the secret to becoming the best onigiri shop in town.

games.name: 西游肉鸽：杨戬的100种死法
games.shortDescription: "Roguelike Journey to the West: 100 Ways to Slay Erlang Shen" is a 3D light-strategy roguelike that blends shooting, action, and tower defense into fast-paced gameplay. Gameplay:Auto-attack while equipping any 6 weapons—survive 20 waves, defeat all final bosses to win!
games.aboutText:
Description:
《Roguelike Journey to the West: 100 Ways to Kill Erlang Shen》 is a 3D light-strategy roguelike game blending shooting, action, and tower defense mechanics. The game is a rougelike game that can be networked online to form teams .Characters auto-attack while wielding 6 weapons and have 3 revives per run. With 184 weapons, 174 items, and 40 heroes , the game offers extreme roguelike freedom and endless build possibilities.

Story:
The balance of the Three Realms has been shattered by an unknown force, causing time-space distortions and chaotic spiritual energy. As a result, creatures across the world awaken— heroes from Journey to the West are revived, historical legends return, and even ordinary humans gain supernatural powers. Meanwhile, demons grow stronger and more violent, led by the fallen god Erlang Shen , who seeks to slaughter all realms. In this epic war , the awakened heroes must unite and defeat 100 incarnations of Erlang Shen to collect Spirit Crystals and save the world.

Game Features:

✔ Online: This game supports online play, you can play online with netizens, you can give each other props in online mode, you can rescue teammates, and end the game when all players die.

✔ One-Hand Friendly: Control movement to dodge and collect loot while your character auto-fires 6-12 weapons .
✔ Classes & Builds: Mix and match Ranged, Melee, Elemental, and Mechanical classes with countless weapons and items—discover the strongest combo!
✔ Stress Relief: Slay thousands of monsters across 20 waves per run—pure carnage fun!
✔ Weapons & Items: Over 50+ weapons & 170+ items —no unlocks needed, just luck!
✔ Rune System: Customize 8 runes per hero and upgrade them progressively.
✔ Divine Artifact Trial Cards: Struggling? Use Artifact Fragments (dropped in runs) to exchange for OP temporary gear —dominate from start to finish!

games.name: Lurking In Fear
games.shortDescription: Enjoy the love of zombie games without the feeling of being locked down to a story mode! Enjoy a open world zombie era, loot, and explore! OR if you want a change in pace, Play a new round based zombies mode that will keep you loving or Re Loving Round based zolmbies!
games.aboutText:
Lurking in fear has been a passion project of my own for the last few year, It is a game developed by a solo dev, Its all about enjoying the love of zombie games but without the feeling of being locked down by a story mode. JUST GO WHERE EVER YOU WANT!

Enjoy going to any towns or building you want when ever you want, Loot as much as you would like, and if you are getting tired of the open world style playing, just try out the Round based Zombies version!! Altho still W.I.P You can still have plenty of fun!

Round based Zombies does have a Upgrade Machine for all of your useable weapons, unlockable doors to different areas of the maps, and all around fun just grinding and seeing how far you can get!!!

games.name: Dicevaders
games.shortDescription: Dicevaders is a dice-based roguelike deckbuilder about leading the ultimate alien invasion. Set in the StarVaders universe, draft and manipulate the dice row, build an unstoppable army, and unleash adrenaline pumping combos through powerful synergies and strategic play.
games.aboutText:
Lead the Invasion. Master the Dice. Break the Game.

Humanity had a good run, Now it’s time to take back what’s yours. Dive into a dice-based roguelike deckbuilder where your tactical decisions, not luck, determine the fate of the planet.

Build your own Invasion

Build a growing alien force on a turn-based grid where every placement matters. Each turn you can acquire different units, artifacts, budges and chrono. Place your invaders strategically in the grid to enhance your scoring potential.

Manipulate the Dice

Dice aren’t a game of chance here, they’re your most powerful tool. With ‘Chrono’ you can strategically reroll your dice and restock the shop to draft your most vital units. You can transform a bad roll into an unstoppable chain reaction. Use ‘budge’ to manipulate your dice throw to build the exact combo you want. Even, align your dice in pairs, triples or quadruple to ignite devastating combos.

Be the Commander

Each commander brings a distinct strategic approach, specialized synergies and XP scaling possibilities unlocking new ways to dominate. Each equipped with unique perks and artifacts so each run gives you new ways to send your attack score into the stratosphere.

Earth won’t be destroyed without a fight. Beware, the legendary Pilots from StarVaders will show up to protect the planet, each armed with unique abilities designed to disrupt your invasion.

Break the game

Experiment with absurd synergies and push the game’s systems to their absolute limit. Discover a broken combo that launches your score into orbit and out smarts the pilots.

games.name: 港警成雙：來自城寨 Dual Fire Walled City
games.shortDescription: Dual Fire Walled City is a story-driven co-op game for two players. Featuring close friends who grew up together in the Kowloon Walled City, only to be pulled onto vastly different life paths by a twist of fate. Get ready to immerse yourself in a classic Hong Kong-style movie.
games.aboutText:
In Dual Fire Walled City, experience their intense careers firsthand through split-screen local co-op or Steam Remote Play.

Our game delivers a gripping narrative with diverse missions and gameplay, allowing you and your partner to cooperate through an emotional journey—just like playing through a classic Hong Kong crime thriller.

Play Together with Steam Remote Play

Only one copy of the game is needed—invite a friend online via Steam Remote Play and dive into the story together!

- Iconic Visual Style & Atmosphere

Travel through nostalgic old tong lau buildings, neon-lit streets, and the modren concrete jungle—all inspired by the gritty, glamorous look of classic Hong Kong action movies.

- Full Dual-Language Voiceover

The game features full voice acting in both Cantonese and Putonghua .

Switch freely between them to fully immerse yourself in the world of Dual Fire Walled City.

A Thrilling Cinematic & Cooperative Experience

Navigate the vibrant streets of Hong Kong and tackle thrilling missions together!

Every punch and kick lands with force

The operation won’t be easy; enemies won’t go down without a fight!

Play as Multiple Characters

As the story unfolds, you’ll step into different roles—even returning to their childhood —to explore the famous memorable Kowloon Walled City.

A Variety of Nostalgic Mini-Games

Play alongside your partner and enjoy our childhood favourite games.

Disclaimer :

The story,all names,characters and incident portrayed in the production are fictitious.

No identification with actual persons(living or dead),places,buildings or products is intended or should be inferred.

games.name: Revery Effect
games.shortDescription: Revery Effect is a 2D side-scrolling sandbox game. Players survive in a fantastical world and are free to destroy and build anything they can imagine.
games.aboutText:
In ancient times, humans discovered that some terrifying creatures were born from Revery and fed on Revery. These beings became known as Reverians. Lurking in the shadows, they gradually rivaled humanity and established an advanced magical civilization. However, due to human development leading to a decrease in nighttime, it became increasingly difficult to capture "Revery". To obtain an inexhaustible supply of "Revery", the ancient Reverians, with the help of unknown powers, created the incredible second world, "Kanatain"...

Somehow, you wake up on an ordinary morning in the wilderness of a new world.

Revery Effect is a 2D side-scrolling sandbox game. Players survive in a fantastical world, freely destroying and building anything imaginable. You can choose your own lifestyle—farming, fishing, mining, building, exploring, adventuring, or fighting—with a wealth of content to experience. Furthermore, as your adventure progresses, you'll encounter another fantastical side of the world: magic, fantastical creatures, and the legendary Reverians . Learning how to harness supernatural energy and exploring the histories of its inhabitants and the world itself are also important parts of your journey.

Multiplayer and mod support are included, too!

games.name: Consumption Line
games.shortDescription: "Consumption Line" is a short, fully free, experimental indie game about the food industry, deceptive advertising and the downsides of modern life. A sarcastic 30‑minute experience designed to make you reflect, not grind.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to your first day at the KindBroth® soup factory!

Consumption Line is a short, 100% free, experimental indie game about food systems, industrial production, deceptive advertising, and the erosion of meaning in a world obsessed with efficiency. You play as a factory worker operating two machines: one for broth, one for noodles. Your job is simple: meet your daily quota, follow the recipe, don't ask questions.

At first, it feels almost cozy. But as days pass, ingredients change. Machines get faster. Expectations rise. And something about the soup... feels slightly off.

Features

- Short and focused. Playable in one sitting (approx. 30 minutes).

- Assembly-line gameplay that evolves each day.

- No game over states, no collectibles, no grind. Just play and think.

- Unlimited soup!

What is this game exactly?

This is not a traditional game. There are no skill trees, boss fights, or deep systems. It's a tightly scoped, 30-minute experience meant to invite reflection. Over the course of five in-game days, your routine remains the same: leave your flat, take the subway, arrive at the production line, hit your quota, go home... Yet there are some changes, some funny and some bleak, that reveal issues in the world around you.

Fully free!

Consumption Line is 100% free and also ad-free. It was created as a personal, 'artsy' project to explore our relationship with ultra-processed foods, misleading marketing, and the ruthlessness of capitalism.

games.name: Until North Ends
games.shortDescription: Fight, farm, and forage as a new experience awaits in this open-world survival crafting adventure. Journey alone or with friends as you build your own safe haven to weather the harsh Nordic landscapes before you.
games.aboutText:
Until North Ends is an open-world survival crafting adventure with a low-poly stylized Nordic vibe for solo adventurers or groups. Embrace the harsh environments or savor the quiet tranquility of farm-life at your shelter; how you choose to survive is up to you.

Sail across the waters to find new islands, dive into caves and dungeons to plunder loot or travel through peaceful meadows. Explore procedurally generated worlds full of unique encounters.

Take down dangerous creatures in melee combat while dawning heavy armor, use distance to your advantage while shooting them with a bow, or harness a powerful chain lightning; it's up to you how you approach combat.

Construct your home to protect and prepare for your next adventure. Relax, watch your plants

grow, and decorate your cozy corner.
