To survive in this harsh world, you will need to craft the best equipment possible, and wooden swords will not cut it. Refine ores, combine materials, extract plants in the alchemy table, cure leather, and much more to gain access to rare materials.

Create your own character that will stand out. From hair color to tattoos, you and your fellow adventurers can customize your look to suit your style.

games.name: The Bestest Alchemist
games.shortDescription: Solve puzzles and brew potions in The Bestest Alchemist, a strategic puzzle roguelike! Freely arrange ingredients to create magical combinations, discover 100+ new recipes, and upgrade your collection to build powerful synergies. Your journey to becoming a master alchemist starts now!
games.aboutText:
About This Game

Class is in session at the Alchemist's Academy! Step into the shoes of Charlotte, a brilliant but easily flustered apprentice with a single goal: to become The Bestest Alchemist . To earn that title, you'll need wit, preparation, and a little bit of magic.

The Perfect Concoction

The Bestest Alchemist takes a spin on match-3 puzzles. Instead of simple swaps - here, you can freely rearrange ingredients to set up the perfect mix! But you’ll need to think fast as you race the clock while to satisfy each ingredient's particular requirements.

- Set Up Combos: Slide ingredients into the perfect position to maximize your score!

- Meet Complex Demands: Fulfill specific recipe requirements, like matching on certain tiles or in large groups, all while hitting your score goals.

- Think Fast: With limited turns and the clock ticking, every move counts!

Pack for Perfection

Success begins before the first match is even made. The ingredients you choose to bring to an exam directly determine the tiles that appear on your puzzle board.

- Upgrade Your Ingredients: Purchasing the same ingredient can upgrade them to higher levels.

- Strategic Loadouts: Will you bring just one color of ingredients for easy combos, or choose a lot of colors for the chance at better combos and bigger scores?

- Build Your Synergy: Select ingredients that work together. Some boost the power of others, while others have more utility or future benefits!

From Apprentice To Master

Experiment by mixing different ingredients to discover recipes for brand-new ones! Every time you complete a semester, you'll also gain a powerful bookmark for your grimoire, granting effects that can completely change your strategy.

- Discover 100+ Recipes: Use your alchemical knowledge on future runs to craft the exact ingredients you need.

- Acquire Powerful Bookmarks: Hunt down legendary bookmarks that grant game-changing passive abilities.

- Adapt or Fail: Each run presents new challenges. Apply the knowledge gained from previous attempts to finally reach graduation!

Features

- Endless Replayability: A roguelike structure ensures every semester brings new challenges and strategic decisions.

- Strategic Puzzles: A fresh take on the genre where board control and planning are key to victory.

- A Massive Grimoire: Fill your book by discovering recipes and unlocking powerful artifacts.

- Deep Strategic Customization: Your inventory directly defines the puzzle board, putting strategy at the forefront.

- A Charming Journey: Help the ambitious and lovable Charlotte on her quest to become... The Bestest Alchemist !

games.name: Skewer Squad
games.shortDescription: Skewer Squad is a cute yet chaotic tower defense roguelite. Step into the apron of a Grillmaster, draft random ingredients, mix wild seasonings, and build a squad of skewers that are both delicious and powerful to defend your grill.
games.aboutText:
🍗This might just be the most delicious, wackiest, and most addictive tower defense game ever made!🍗

​​The story begins at a mysterious BBQ stall

You have been chosen as the new Grillmaster! Your foes are not scary monsters, but a cheeky horde of mice drawn by the smell of your skewers.

Their goal is to nibble everything in sight. Your mission is to protect the grill and keep your skewers safe!

Your Skewers Are Your Towers

Drag, drop, and watch your tasty skewers jump into battle.

Shoot, bounce, and splash. You can even boop enemies right off the field.

Survive 20 minutes of fast-paced roguelite runs where your only goal is to defend your grill at all costs.

Choose Your Perfect Build

20+ Grillmasters, each with unique talents

Every Grillmaster can become the core of a different playstyle, letting you craft your own exclusive skewer squad!

40+ tasty and powerful foods

Whether they split, bounce, or knock enemies back,

combine these effects to master your signature playstyle!

100+ powerful seasonings and items spawn randomly,

adding constant depth to your playstyle

and making every run a brand new experience!

Blazing Fast, Thrilling Fun and Fresh Every Run!

A minute to learn, ten minutes to get hooked, twenty minutes to never stop!

Every match is unique, and every skewer brings surprises!

Hey Grill Masters, are you ready?

Grill Zone: No Hungry Creeps Allowed. Stay out, or you might become the next skewer!

games.name: Sherpa's Caravan
games.shortDescription: 🏔 🚐 ⛺️ 📦 🍳 🛶 Explore a cozy open world as a sherpa driver in your van! Deliver cargo, cook food, craft gear, and explore mountains, lakes, and hidden trails. Sail in boats and kayaks, dive underwater. Meet old friends and upgrade your van! A camping atmosphere and next-gen graphics
games.aboutText:
Key features in the game:

- Traveling in a camper van

- Relaxing natural atmosphere

- Carrying/arranging cargo, furniture, and in-game items

- Transporting goods between camps and towns

- Traveling by watercraft, including with cargo

- Rafting, hidden paths, and cave exploration

- Cooking using kitchen and camping equipment

- Crafting at special workstations

- Creating your own campsite

- Decorating

- Fishing

- Collecting mushrooms, plants, and other consumables

Your journey begins today!

Explore an open world in your camper van as a Sherpa driver, helping friends and tourists on adventures through picturesque landscapes!

Deliver parcels and cargo along mountain roads

Transport goods in your van across winding mountain paths between camps, and immerse yourself in the atmosphere of adventure in a handcrafted world.

Craft and cook food and coffee for adventurers!

Adventurers you meet along the way need help, supplies, and meals! Haul equipment and materials in your van to craft and cook for them.

Water transportation

Use boats, kayaks, and paddleboards to deliver cargo to islands and hard-to-reach areas inaccessible by land.

Explore mountains, rivers, lakes, and forests

Trek narrow trails and dive into water in search of hidden spots, caves, and secrets.

Earn, buy, and sell

Complete quests in camps and towns to earn money for new opportunities, goods, and van upgrades in the game world!

Get inspired by the atmosphere of hiking and mountain adventures in a handcrafted world

10x10 km² of stunning mountains, lakes, rivers, and forests, inspired by the landscapes of the Himalayas, Switzerland, Norway, Italy, and Georgia.

Reunite with old friends!

Your old friends live in the game world, and they’ll be happy to see you, ask for your help, and share stories together!

Indie next-gen

Expect realistic and cozy gameplay scenes with complex lighting setups, beautiful graphics, and advanced physics simulation systems.

About me and the studio

I’m a solo developer with 15 years of programming experience. I've taken on the ambitious challenge of optimizing an open world in Unreal Engine 5 by properly using Lumen, Nanite, Ray Tracing and complexity physics.

games.name: Food Processing Simulator
games.shortDescription: Build and manage your own food processing factory. Automate production with machines, work together with skilled employees to keep operations running smoothly, expand your facility, and keep inventory under control as you grow from a small workshop into a large scale production facility.
games.aboutText:
Step into the world of food production and grow your own processing facility from the ground up. Begin with a modest workshop, install machines to automate your workflow, and expand your factory into a fully functioning production line.

Automation

Set up and connect machines to handle different stages of production. Design your workflow, fine-tune your layout, and watch as your facility transforms into a smooth-running automated system.

Factory Expansion

Upgrade equipment, unlock new technologies, and expand your space to take on larger orders. Every expansion opens new opportunities to scale your business and push your production further.

Inventory Management

Keep track of raw ingredients, stored products, and shipping schedules. Smart inventory management ensures smooth operations and helps you deliver every order on time.

From a small workshop to a large-scale production empire, every decision shapes your path, whether you focus on efficiency, growth, or balance in building the ultimate food processing factory.

games.name: General Tactics: An Shi Rebellion
games.shortDescription: In November 755, An Lushan launched a rebellion against the Tang Empire. You will be appointed as the acting Military Governor of Shuofang. Conquer territories on a free-roaming world map, build your armies, develop cities, and navigate various events as you fight to quell the rebellion.
games.aboutText:
In November 755, An Lushan launched a rebellion against the Tang Empire, plunging the realm into crisis. You will be appointed as the acting Military Governor of Shuofang. Conquer territories on a free-roaming world map, build your armies, develop cities, and navigate various events as you fight to quell the rebellion.

- Classic turn-based strategy gameplay

- Explore and conquer on a free-roaming world map instead of following traditional level-based stages. Build and train your own army freely as you prepare for the challenges and events ahead.

- Freely mix and match Artifacts without character restrictions imposed by individual stages. Customize your army and create your own unique combinations.

- Unlock more possibilities through the Tech Tree.

games.name: Valdrin
games.shortDescription: A low-fantasy kingdom sim where you never command a single subject. Shape laws, set priorities, and watch an autonomous society build, trade, worship, and fight under your rule.
games.aboutText:
You don't command your people. You govern them.

Valdrin is a low-fantasy kingdom sim where you never control a single subject directly. You set the laws, wages, and decrees they live under. They choose where to work, what to study, whom to love, and when they've had enough.

The crown sends you to tame an untapped frontier, and the bill comes with you. Pay off the charter, meet the royal mandates, and grow a foothold into a living society, or gather enough strength to declare independence. Every subject has a name, a family, a faith, and a breaking point.

Prosperity and collapse are both one bad decree away.

Govern a living society

- Indirect control - Open positions and set wages; subjects apply, quit, or leave for better work. You steer the system, not the hands.

- Many races - Humans, elves, dwarves, orcs, minotaurs, giants and more, each with its own strengths, trades, and prejudices.

- Emergent lives - Subjects are born, form households, pass down surnames, gossip, grow old, and die. Their stories live on in your chronicles.

- Schooling and ambition - The young choose a trade by its wages and reputation. Fund stipends, charge fees, or decree compulsory schooling.

- Faith and dissent - Rival religions spread through belief and incentive. Send missionaries, hold inquisitions, or let heresy take root.

Build an economy that fights back

- Regional markets - Every province trades as its own market. Prices react to gluts, shortages, and merchants chasing the difference.

- Real coin - Coins are worth their metal plus trust in the faction that minted them. Debase a currency, or watch one collapse with its issuer.

- Death and taxes - Wages, tariffs, crown levies, and the ever-tightening grip of royal bureaucracy.

Defend your realm

- Raise retinues - Recruit soldiers and archers, form battle lines, and answer raids from factions who despise you.

- Conquest - March on rival provinces to plunder or seize them, until a whole faction falls.

- Adventurers and quests - Back wandering heroes, send them on quests, and raise them into legends.

- Justice - Imprison, exile, or execute outlaws and traitors, and live with the consequences.

Mod support through Steam Workshop. Playable on Steam Deck.

A different kind of strategy game

Fans of RimWorld, Dwarf Fortress, Frostpunk, and Manor Lords will feel at home, but Valdrin pulls you one step back. You don't play the people.

You play the system that governs them.

Valdrin is in active development. Wishlist and follow to shape the frontier as it grows.

games.name: Come out, cat
games.shortDescription: The hidden cat is waiting for your words.
games.aboutText:
Come Out, Cat is
a short and simple adventure game where you call out to a cat who's hiding away,
hoping to coax them back into the world.

🐈️ How to Play

- Choose two word cards — one action, one subject.

- Combine them to call out to the cat.

- Pay attention to how the cat reacts.

- Use those reactions to figure out the right words.

- When you find the right phrase, the cat will come out.

That’s all.

🖥️ Streaming / Videos / Fan Works

Feel free to stream, record, or create fan content —
as long as it’s within the bounds of common sense!

games.name: Kitty Haven
games.shortDescription: FInd the perfect spot for picky little furballs: whether they’re greedy, have sensitive noses, or keep getting into stubborn cat fights, arrange the space to bring back peace. Create your own haven by unlocking items and new residents. Solve puzzles and decorate the ideal sanctuary for your kittens!
games.aboutText:
Cats need your help! Everyone has their own likes and dislikes, as well as their own needs. People also have different relationships. Help cats of all ages find their favourite spot to keep the room peaceful. Some cats are very sensitive to smells and will not go near the litter box. Others get sad if they can't go outside in the sun. And watch out for cat fights, it's a real mess!

It's always good to give it a clean! Interact with the environment: move furniture, place plants, knock things over, turn on noisy machines or robot vacuums that move around, and see what the cats do. Everyone knows that a cardboard box can sometimes be a better home for your cat than a fancy cat tree!

And when you need to relax, go back to your special place. If you play the game, you can unlock cute decorations and upgrade options! Make life better for your residents, decorate with love, and create your own peaceful space.

We are a small team from the Caribbean. We want everyone to feel welcome. That's why we've tried to create relaxing spaces where you can unwind.

games.name: MONUMENTUM
games.shortDescription: Take control of a small rolling square and utilize long dormant mechanisms to ascend to the top. Watch your step!
games.aboutText:
DISCLAIMER: This game requires a gamepad controller and utilizes sustained button presses. If you feel that holding a button down for longer than 10-15 seconds at a time will be uncomfortable, you may want to try the demo before purchasing. Thank you!

MONUMENTUM is a metroidvania-rage-puzzle-platformer-pinball-like where you control both the environment and the player character. Overcome platforming challenges, climb upwards, and activate new mechanisms of movement to reach the top!

FEATURES

- 1-2 hours of playtime

- 100+ platforming challenges

- 5 mechanism abilities to discover and activate

Activate and utilize long dormant mechanisms to reach new heights. Enjoy an immersive, diegetic experience. Play without forced UI or tutorial interruptions. Experiment and forge your own path upwards! You can't die but you can and will fall. Try not to fall though. But you will, probably.

games.name: Torii: Beyond The Gates
games.shortDescription: The spirit realm has broken. Your brother has gone missing. Forge the path you were destined for. Explore the gates and find out why the links inside the spirit realm have been broken. Battle, discover and find the secrets, and make new connections in a beautiful hand-drawn 2D style.
games.aboutText:
Explore the Spirit Realm

The spirit realm has broken. Your brother has gone missing. Discover the path you were destined for. Explore the gates and find out why the links inside the spirit realm have been broken. Battle, discover and find the secrets, and make new connections in a beautiful hand-drawn 2D style.

Features

- Dodge, parry, dash and slash your way through different enemies and bosses.

- Classic platformer action in a beautiful hand-drawn 2D art style.

- Discover new gates and worlds, all connected together by the spiritual gates of the world.

- Decide your path. Make new friends. Find the secrets of the Spirit Realm.

- Learn new arts, skills and equipment. Find your way to your brother – perhaps he knows what is going on?

- Hand-painted landscapes – every single part of the game drawn by hand with care.

- Difficult obstacles, bosses and enemies, all with varying abilities. Study them closely, then strike when you are ready.

Hand Drawn with Love

Torii is a game where every piece of art is hand-drawn, from the characters to the entire world itself. There was no other way to express this world, and to bring it to life, Torii was made with careful attention to bringing back the traditional hand-drawn 2D art style that pioneered the genre as we know it today.

If you enjoy platformers and classic-style 2D art with a modern flair, Torii is ready for you!

games.name: Don Memo
games.shortDescription: Don Memo is a brave bull who embarks on one final journey across Costa Rica to rescue his granddaughter and confront Pisuicas. Fight against legends and shadows of the past in this 2D pixel platformer, while carrying the legacy of a family destined to protect the world from evil.
games.aboutText:
Don Memo is an old bull who lives with his wife and granddaughter, Milagro. He descends from a proud lineage of brave bulls marked by the legend of Malacrianza , the mythical bull who was the first to face the demon Pisuicas and managed to banish him to hell. Since then, Malacrianza’s descendants have inherited the responsibility of fighting Pisuicas, who returns whenever negativity in the world rises.

Don Memo also fought his battle in the past, successfully banishing Pisuicas. However, the demon quickly returned due to the growing hatred and despair in humanity. Years later, Don Memo’s son carried on the legacy and, alongside his wife, gave his life to banish Pisuicas once again. Since that tragedy, Don Memo has cared for his granddaughter Milagro.

Now, in the present, Pisuicas has returned sooner than expected—and this time, he has kidnapped Milagro. Burdened by the pain of his past and the weight of the years on his back, Don Memo sets out on one final journey across Costa Rica. He must face not only ancient legends and dangers, but also the weight of his legacy and the fear of failing once more.

- Machete Mastery: Wield Don Memo’s trusty machete to slash through enemies and break obstacles. Dodge roll out of danger, read enemy patterns, and collect scrap so Moncho can upgrade your blade with more reach, faster swings and a ranged slash wave.

- Betty’s Kitchen: Gather ingredients across Costa Rica, unlock all 23 recipes from Betty’s cookbook and cook dishes at the Fogón. Equip them before each level for boosts to combat or exploration.

- Platforming and Secrets: Run, jump and dodge through 21 levels across all seven provinces. Every level hides secret areas, alternate routes and collectibles, and new abilities let you return to earlier levels to reach places you couldn’t get to before.

- Folklore Boss Battles: Face legends of Costa Rican folklore corrupted by the Pisuicas: El Cadejos, La Llorona, La Cegua, El Viejo del Monte, El Padre sin Cabeza, La Bruja de Zárate and La Mano Peluda, before the final showdown at the summit of Cerro Chirripó.

- A Story with Tico Heart: The Pisuicas has kidnapped Milagro, Don Memo’s granddaughter, and fled in a red taxi. Travel from Guanacaste to Limón, meet unforgettable characters and discover a story about family, loss and empathy, full of Latin American humor.

games.name: Final Frontier Story
games.shortDescription: Dodge lasers and explore! Planetary Development Simulation
games.aboutText:
Build your very own warm and friendly intergalactic city in the cold vacuum of space!

Expect close encounters of the third, fourth, and maybe even fifth kind!

Aim to become the most desirable city in the galaxy by developing land so you can build shops and bases for your residents to live in comfort.

Build Convenience Stores and Parks to make daily life easier, or Takoyaki Stalls and Cinemas to bring in tourists and keep people entertained.

Find the perfect combination of facilities to astronomically boost the city's charm.

As you explore your new world, you'll encounter all kinds of monsters native to the planet.

Stay one step ahead of them by upgrading your Fighter Aircraft and training up your pilots.

And who knows, maybe you'll even make a few new friends along the way!

With the help of your newfound alien friends, hold outdoor events to bring in tourists from all over the galaxy!

Utilize a state-of-the-art autopilot system to help you fight through grueling space battles.

You can also give orders to your pilots to guide them to glorious victory.

So, do you think you have what it takes to build the best city in the entire galaxy?

Jump in the pilot's seat and begin your adventure into the unknown to find out!

--

Try searching for "Kairosoft" to see all of our games!!

Developer Homepages. Feel free to follow me♪

games.name: SeArena
games.shortDescription: Hoist the sails and prove who rules the waves! Pirate Arena is a fast-paced naval PvP brawler inspired by the chaotic fun of Sea of Thieves. One player becomes the Host, setting rules and map hazards, while rival captains trade broadsides, boarding actions, and daring maneuvers until only.
games.aboutText:
Pirate Arena is a competitive naval battler where helmsmanship, cannon aim, and fearless boarding decide the match. Every session begins with a Host who chooses the map, weather, tides, and match modifiers (thick fog, lightning storms, extra powder, sea monsters) and locks in the format. The other captains crew up, forge shaky alliances, and clash across tight, high-stakes rounds.

Trim the sails to catch the wind, swing your hull for the perfect firing angle, put out fires, patch the hull under pressure, and choose your style: sink foes from range or risk a close-quarters boarding to finish the job. When the smoke clears, only one banner will fly.

Features

- Host rules the seas: pick match rules, duration, respawns, hazards, and weather.

- Snappy naval combat: cannons, chain shot, grapeshot, fire barrels, and boarding play.

- Distinct arena maps: reefs, fortress batteries, whirlpools, and shifting wind lanes.

- Between-round progression (optional): scavenge supplies, upgrade sails, repairs, and ammo.

- Team play or free-for-all: nimble sloops vs. heavy, devastating galleons.

- Quick, replayable rounds: jump in, adapt your strategy, queue for the next skirmish.

Ready to raise your flag and become a legend of the arena?

games.name: Escape The Cradle
games.shortDescription: Escape the Cradle is an Incremental RPG with cute pixel art about a foxgirl trying to clear out the dungeon she was born in so she can leave with her mother and explore the outside world. She's animated with Live2d and you restore her hp between runs with headpats!
games.aboutText:
Escape the Cradle is an Incremental RPG about Hina, a foxgirl trying to clear out the dungeon she was born in so she can leave with her mother and explore the outside world.

The Cradle is a mysterious place that doesn't allow anyone inside it to perish.
Instead, Hina is safely delivered back into the arms of her mother at the bottom of the dungeon whenever she would expire.

Headpat Hina to restore her to full health,
Purchase Upgrades so she can come back stronger,
and Send her on her merry way again!

No one knows who or what made The Cradle...
No one knows what it's for...
Some say it's a training facility.
Some say a god made it to protect their child from the world.
Only one thing is certain...
The Cradle...
Doesn't want you to leave...

Features

A Headpat filled heartwarming story.

Cute pixel art and juicy gamefeel!

One Live2d animated Foxgirl to headpat to your hearts content!

30 Enemy riddled dungeon floors to conquer!

Skill trees! Exchange Crystals for new skills and stat ups!

Prestige system - reset your progress to turn levels into shards for even greater strength!

One happy ending!

Completion time roughly 3-4 hours

games.name: Cozy Lemonade Stand
games.shortDescription: Run the sweetest stand in town! 🍋 Start with harvesting produce like lemons, strawberries, and mint. Mix and serve fresh lemonade, attract happy customers, upgrade and decorate your stall, and make enough profit to turn your humble stand into the coziest spot on the block.
games.aboutText:
🍋 Run the sweetest stand in town!

Cozy Lemonade Stand is a wholesome shop sim about growing, mixing, and serving refreshing drinks on sunny afternoons. Harvest fresh ingredients, craft delightful recipes, decorate your stall, and turn a tiny sidewalk stand into the coziest spot on the block.

🌿 Harvest & Forage
Start simple and hands-on:
• Grow lemons, strawberries, and mint in your little garden plots
• Forage seasonal extras like blueberries or lavender
• Upgrade tools to harvest faster and keep produce fresh

🥤 Mix & Perfect Your Recipes
Balance sweetness, tartness, and aroma to match customer tastes:
• Combine fruits, herbs, syrups, and ice for unique blends
• Unlock special add-ons (sparkling water, honey, vanilla)
• Save favorite recipes and chase 5-Star “House Specials”

😊 Serve Customers (and learn their quirks)
Your neighbors each have a vibe:
• Kids love sweeter mixes; joggers want light and icy
• Office crowds rush at lunch—prep in advance for the rush
• Earn tips for fast service, perfect recipes, and cute presentation

🪴 Decorate & Upgrade Your Stall
Make it yours, piece by piece:
• Add awnings, fairy lights, chalkboards, planters, and crates
• Buy better juicers, coolers, dispensers, and prep space
• Unlock themed styles: Rustic, Garden, Festival, Seaside

⛅ Weather, Events & Daily Planning
Every day plays a little different:
• Heat waves boost demand (but melt ice faster!)
• Rain slows foot traffic—offer warm lemonade and samples
• Weekend fairs and markets bring crowds and special orders

📈 Grow Your Cozy Business
A gentle tycoon loop with no stress:
• Price smart, manage stock, and avoid waste
• Reinvest earnings into garden plots, tools, and décor
• Meet milestones to expand your menu and reputation

📒 Collections & Goals
• Recipe Book: track discoveries and seasonal flavors
• Customer Journal: remember preferences and stories
• Daily Goals: tiny challenges for bonus coins and décor

💛 Cozy at its core
Low-pressure, satisfying, and sunny—the joy of fresh ingredients, happy customers, and a stand that feels like home.

games.name: Rogue Reigns
games.shortDescription: Rogue Reigns is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder about trust and sacrifice. Lead selfish antiheroes through a world where death is no more, and something still hunts them. Build synergies that bind them or rivalries that break them. Nobody dies, some are sacrificed, but everybody is condemned.
games.aboutText:
A DARK FANTASY ROGUELIKE DECKBUILDER ABOUT TRUST AND SACRIFICE

A grieving bear, a guilty lion, a scheming cat, and a rabbit who knows too much.

Their abilities interlock. What one sets up, another finishes. Their motives don't.

Every card you give one is a card you took from another. Strengthen one and another starves.

Their synergies are fragile. Their resentment isn't.

The party holds together only as long as you force it;

and the run will force you to choose between them .

It doesn't wait at the end of the map. It stalks you across it.

The sky dims. The road goes quiet. Read the signs or get caught.

Every fall sends you back, scarred and stitched. But this one is different.

When it finds you, that fall is permanent.

A queen who fused with the dead to shelter them.

A prince who starved until he devoured the battlefield.

A princess who sewed her dead lover to her own flesh.

You learn who they were when they kill you.

PARTY DECKBUILDING

four decks, one fight. Combos and synergies run across your whole party

CROSS-CHARACTERS PAYOFFS
your finishers enter allies' decks. Your setup is their payoff

TRUST AND SACRIFICE
favor a champion and they grow. Neglect one and face the consequences

A STALKER
hunts you across the map. Miss the signs and fall for real

MULTIPLE ENDINGS
who you trusted and who you sacrificed determines how it ends

HAND-DRAWN CHARACTERS
every frame animated by hand

ANIMATED CARDS
every card brought to life with hand-crafted animation

games.name: Sundae Drive
games.shortDescription: Hit the road in your very own ice cream truck! 🍦 Explore a cute neighborhood, park in the perfect spot, and serve adorable animal customers their dream sundaes. Scoop, drizzle, and top to perfection. Upgrade your cute truck, restock supplies, and create your own ice cream flavors!
games.aboutText:
Sundae Drive is a cozy job simulator where you run your very own ice cream truck in a charming, animal-filled neighborhood. Hit the road, pick the perfect spot, and serve up sundaes that are as cute as they are delicious! 🚚 Drive, Park, and Serve

Choose where to set up shop each day by exploring a colorful city map. Park strategically in busy spots, then switch to first-person serving mode to craft each order to perfection. Scoop ice cream, drizzle syrups, add toppings, and hand over the sweetest treats to your chibi animal customers. 🐾 Meet Adorable Customers

From bunny kids with a sweet tooth to gourmet owls with refined taste, every customer has their own quirks, preferences, and patience levels. Learn their favorite flavors, keep them happy, and earn extra tips for perfect orders. 🍨 Build Your Ice Cream Empire

Restock at the market each morning, manage your supplies, and upgrade your truck with faster scooping, bigger storage, and stylish new designs. Unlock new ingredients, discover rare flavors, and even create your own ice cream combinations. 🌞 A Day in the Life

- Morning: Refuel and shop for fresh ingredients

- Afternoon: Explore the map, park, and serve customers

- Evening: Return to HQ, review your earnings, and plan your next route

✨ Features

- Drive and park in themed zones like the Beach, Park, and School

- Serve cute chibi animal customers in first-person ice cream crafting

- Manage fuel, stock, and time for the best results

- Upgrade your truck with new tools, storage, and cosmetic designs

- Unlock new flavors, syrups, and toppings to expand your menu

- Enjoy colorful 2D visuals and cheerful, jingly sound design

Climb into your colorful truck, turn up the jingle, and bring smiles to every corner of the neighborhood—one scoop at a time!

games.name: The Everything Building
games.shortDescription: Press up and down, elevator goes brrr! Deliver customers to the correct floor and max your score. Serve many customers including but not limited to surfers, astronauts, cars, ghosts, cheerleaders, horses, and cheerleader horses. 1-2 players! 50 different floors! HORSE MODE included!
games.aboutText:
Fight against an ever-growing tide of people needing to get to the elevator, going for max score in short 10 minute rounds! Overcrowding is inevitable, but it's the combos that you make on the way that count.

This simple pixel art game was ranked #1 in fun in Ludum Dare 34 game jam in 2015. Since then it has been biding its time, finally ready to be unleashed on the world in its new greatly expanded form!

Features

- Single player mode with 50 different floors to unlock

- More than 100 different customers, many with unique twists on the gameplay

- Local multiplayer: 2 player co-op and versus modes

- Bad walking animations

- Pop culture references

- Horse mode

Examples of customers

- Cat lady that collects cats, greatly increasing max combo

- Boxer that punches everyone trying to get on the elevator

- Ghost that scares away all but the most stoic customers

- Cheerleaders that make a human pyramid for incredible combos

- Scissor ninja that cuts the electricity, turning off lights

Get your up/down buttons ready for some elevator action!

games.name: Syrup 2: Candy Alchemy RPG
games.shortDescription: Syrup the Candy Alchemist is looking to expand the variety of delicious candies offered at her store, Atelier Sweets! Travel around the world with friends, collecting rare ingredients and battling adorable monsters along the way.
games.aboutText:
SYRUP 2: CANDY ALCHEMY RPG is a direct sequel to my 2015 visual novel, Syrup and the Ultimate Sweet. As the title implies, the series has evolved into a fully featured RPG! Synthesize candies, battle monsters, and complete quests while discovering more about the world beyond Atelier Sweets!

FEATURES

- 60+ candy recipes to synthesize

- Many unique enemies and heart-pounding boss encounters

- 6 recruitable party members to bond with

- 5+ hours to clear the main story (~60k word count)

- Guest appearances from other NomnomNami games (Lonely Wolf Treat, her tears were my light, BAD END THEATER)

CANDY ALCHEMY

Syrup is a Candy Alchemist, which means she can synthesize all sorts of wonderful sweets for her friends and customers to enjoy!

Collect unique ingredients from around the world. Bring a friend along to gather even more!

Once you return home, spend the evening crafting unique confections! Gumdrop will praise every one of your new creations~

BATTLE SYSTEM

Syrup and her friends will sometimes run into trouble during their adventures... Kick these magical enemies into submission and collect their parts to make more delicious candy!

The candies you craft can be used to aid you in battle. They'll give you everything from quick stat buffs to full revivals! Eating enough candy will make you unstoppable!!

Gain experience to level up, and your stats will grow even higher. Wow, Syrup, you're so strong~!

Is it really okay to play the sequel first...?

This game was made to be fun for fans both new and old! It's a title you can enjoy even if you've never played a single NomnomNami game before. I hope you'll fall in love with the characters in this world!

games.name: The seven days i spent with you
games.shortDescription: With the enigmatic girl who imprisoned you――seven days in an unfamiliar room.
games.aboutText:
Demo Version now available!

The demo includes content from Day 1 and Day 2.

Everyone can experience the flow, overall atmosphere, and story tone! (＞人＜;)

If you're interested after playing, please consider adding it to your wishlist! Thank you so much! For a small, unknown indie game like ours, this is really —incredibly important! Every single "+1" from everyone is the motivation that keeps us going!

Trapped for 7 Days with a Yandere Girl? Yandere Heroine × Anime Style GAL Game!

Awakening with lost memories,you found myself imprisoned in an unfamiliar room.

And before you appeared—a peculiar girl.

She declared you her most important person, insisting this room was your sanctuary.

This is a tale of a hollow amnesiac and a cage-weaving enigmatic girl—fates forever entwined.

❀ Shiro

A deceptively serene, pink-haired girl in white.

She mutters to herself, spirals into despair, then erupts into madness... Her emotions shift at terrifying speed, her psyche ever-unstable.

One misstep will trigger her rage...

Yet sometimes, sadness surfaces—for you, her most precious one, lost your memories.

She chains you with "protection" and honeyed words, sealing every exit.

What happened beyond these walls? What secrets does she hide?

"Stay here... Stay with Shiro forever and ever and ever and ever and ever and ever and ever."
"Why must you always leave me...?"
"...Tell me how to bring back your smile—the one you once gave only to me."
"Isn't this world, just for us two... pure bliss?"

"Watch only me... always..."
"Or this loneliness... will consume us both."

❀ Classic anime-inspired story! Make choices based on your preferences to advance the plot.

❀ Immersive environment! Features three time phases - Daytime, Dusk, and Night - that change and progress over time.

❀ Fully animated character art! This short visual novel comes with fully animated character sprites.

Spend seven days in this small room with Shiro. Observe her. Survive to the end—

游戏标签(TAGS) | prison,shiro,yandere,chinese,baddie,sleep,7days,7 days,purelove,Love,lovestory,visual novel,gal,galgame,avg,anime,bishoujo,Bishōjo,lsp,seifuku,cos,cosplay

games.name: Man from Hell. Exodus.
games.shortDescription: 3D first-person shooter with elements of survival horror and stealth action — "Man from the Underworld. Exodus."
games.aboutText:
Man from hell. Exodus. - is a spectacular 3D first-person shooter with elements of survival horror and stealth action with a gripping plot.

Game World

Web. The Kingdom of Darkness. A jungle of steel and concrete, where people have lived for generations. Hundreds of kilometers of corridors and galleries, where death awaits in the darkness, dimly gleaming with the metal of armor. And the House, the safest place, where the enemy, regularly testing people for strength, has not yet managed to break through.

What is the web? There is no information, only hypotheses and assumptions. How did people end up here, in this gloomy black underworld? Why did they come? And is it possible to get out?.. There is no answer.

You take on the role of a fighter of a special operations unit, ready to risk his life and go through all the horrors of the "Underworld" in order to achieve his goal - to save the people of the community from total destruction.

Throughout the story, you will have to solve various tasks and break through to the surface, fighting various enemies.

Features

- An original plot based on the book series "PEACE - HOME" by Denis Vladimirovich Shabalov, a Russian writer working in the post-apocalyptic genre.

- Hand-crafted atmospheric locations that contribute to deep immersion in the game world.

- Various opponents and allies.

- A variety of firearms on which you can install attachments.

- Well-developed shooting and damage system.

- Convenient inventory and equipment system.

- Weapon and armor damage system. The more worn out the weapon, the lower the shooting accuracy. Armor wear affects the protective characteristics. (can be disabled in the game settings)

- A well-developed system of game settings with which each individual player can individually customize the game for a comfortable passage.

- Survival system: hunger, thirst, endurance. (can be disabled in the game settings)

- System of repair and crafting items on the workbench.

- Excellent optimization.

games.name: Teach My Little Sister How To Drive
games.shortDescription: TEACH MY LITTLE SISTER HOW TO DRIVE is a chaotic simulation game where you have to teach your sister who's driving on deadly roads. Trapped in the passenger seat, the only thing you can do is to give proper directions to your sister through your voice.
games.aboutText:
TEACH MY LITTLE SISTER HOW TO DRIVE is a chaotic simulation game where you have to teach your sister who's driving on deadly roads.

Trapped in the passenger seat, the only thing you can do is to give proper directions to your sister through your voice.

But remember, no matter what you scream, the wheel is still in her hands!

Real-Time Voice Conversations

Talk directly to your sister and teach her how to drive.

Give her driving instructions with your voice and watch her react to what you say in real time.

A Variety of Driving Courses

From beginner courses to actual road driving, the lessons only get harder.

The more comfortable your sister gets behind the wheel, the more you'll have to teach her.

Tough Driving Challenges

The situations right in front of you will always be unpredictable.

Think fast, give clear instructions before your sister makes a mistake.

Danger Around Every Corner

You never know what might happen on the road.

Customize Your Little Sister

Use customization options to make your sister look just like you.

Game Features

- Voice-Driven Gameplay

- An Annoying Little Sister

- Passenger Seat Perspective

- Bunch of Driving Missions

- Character Customization

games.name: Database Detective: Minor Crimes Division
games.shortDescription: Solve criminal cases through the power of SQL queries! Help out the city of Los Zorangeles by becoming a Database Detective in this new (unpaid) work from home opportunity.
games.aboutText:
There’s been a backlog of unsolved cases piling up in the Minor Crimes Division of the Los Zorangeles Police Department and we’ll need a Database Detective to help solve them.

We’ll need you to analyze clues and manipulate data using SQL , a database querying language, to figure out who perpetrated crimes from as minor as littering to as serious as not checking out of a hotel after the check-out time.

Don’t worry! This role is intended to be accessible for those without any SQL experience , so each Database Detective is given an introductory textbook when they start! This short textbook is less than 20 pages and explains everything that’s needed to solve each case.

If you still have trouble writing queries, our comprehensive error messaging system will tell you exactly where your query went wrong, making it easy to correct your mistakes.

Still not enough? Each Database Detective is assigned an assistant who’s ready to answer any questions you might have, whether they be about the case itself or the SQL queries you’ll need to write!

Understanding how to manipulate data using SQL is not the only part of being a Database Detective ! Your job will also require you to piece together evidence and clues, just like a real detective! Further on in your Database Detective career, you’ll have to sleuth through the internet and piece cases together yourself.

Job benefits also include…

- Fully voice acted mission briefings at the beginning of each case!

- Fully hand drawn art for you to enjoy!

- More than 40 websites to explore!

- 10 cases for you to solve, each case getting longer and more complex!

- A total of around 8-10 hours of valuable work experience to add to your resume!

games.name: Nice Dice: Game of Throws
games.shortDescription: Some roll the dice. Not you, though. You turn them into weapons. Throw your dice into enemies' faces, knock them around, and conjure powerful spells from the face-up side. Upgrade your dice with magic and crazy physics to hold back endless waves of enemies. Welcome to the Game of Throws!
games.aboutText:
Some roll the dice. Not you, though. You turn them into weapons. Throw your dice into enemies' faces, knock them around, and conjure powerful spells from the face-up side. Upgrade your dice with magic and crazy physics to hold back endless waves of enemies. Welcome to the Game of Throws!

The Hardest Dice Game You Ever Played?

In Nice Dice , you defend the Evergamble Tree from swarms of walking, running, and even flying creatures in a roguelite survival.

You need sharp timing and aim, plus a strategic selection of dice spells and physics upgrades to succeed with your dice throws.

For example, you might craft a dice with slowing and stunning spells for your left hand, and a damage-over-time focused dice for your right. With countless spell and dice property combos, every attempt becomes a unique defense run.

Roguelite Dice Progress!

Defeating waves of enemies unlocks new spells for your dice sides: paralyzing thunderstorms, entangling vines, stone cascades, and more! The power of each spell scales with the number of dots on its side, so make sure you also invest in upgrading those!

For even more chaos and destruction, you can make your dice heavier to maximize impact damage, increase the effect radius, or even upgrade to loaded dice for more predictable spell outcomes.

And don't worry: even though each run starts with one weak dice (and later two), plenty of permanent upgrades carry over between runs!

games.name: 广式双马尾的报恩
games.shortDescription: "What do I look like?" On my way home from overtime, a dark figure suddenly appeared before me.
games.aboutText:
"What do I look like?"

On my way home from overtime, a dark figure suddenly appeared before me.

Faced with the figure's question, and looking at the twintails on her head, longer than my arms, I fell silent...

-----------------------------

"Cantonese Twintails' Repay of a Favor" is a youth romance galgame, a visual novel. Players can click on the screen to read the dialogue and story text.

This game is single-character, single-ending, and contains no choice branches. The total playtime is approximately 2.5 hours.

The game features four beautiful, independent animated CGs.

The female protagonist is fully voiced.

-----------------------------

Note: This game is a galgame (AVG - text game). It does not contain any other gameplay or systems. Just like reading a novel, you can only click on the screen and read text.

Note 2: All characters in the game are adults. The characters, stories, locations, plots, and world depicted are all fictional and have no connection to any real-life people or events.

games.name: Galaxy Defense War
games.shortDescription: 'Galaxy Defense War' is a roguelike tower defense game where you need to select suitable galactic principles from randomly dropped heroes and equipment to form a combat-ready team to resist alien invaders.
games.aboutText:
'Galaxy Defense War' - A interstellar tower defense game that combines strategy, building, and roguelike elements!

At the distant edge of the galaxy, alien invaders are surging forward. As a star commander, you will shoulder the heavy responsibility of protecting your homeland, building powerful defense towers, recruiting unique alien heroes, and using wisdom and strategy to create an impregnable defense line!

- 🌌 Deep Strategic Tower Defense: Deploy four types of heroes - Precision, Firepower, Psionic, and Warrior. Each hero possesses unique basic attacks and ultimate skills. Combine with modified heroes and artifacts to create your ultimate defense line.

- 🛸Roguelike Element Random Experience: Each game randomly drops heroes, equipment, and 'Galactic Principles'. Every choice will affect the battle situation, providing infinite replay value.

- 🧩 Rich Equipment and Abnormal System: Combine elemental abnormalities such as fire, poison, lightning, ice, etc., to trigger compound effects like explosions, soul separation, miasma, etc., with progressively deeper strategic layers.

- 🌟 Diverse Achievements and Challenges: Complete achievements, challenge endless mode, defeat powerful BOSSes, collect artifacts, summon ultimate units like phoenixes and ice dragons.

- 🎮 Multi-language Support and Community Interaction: Fully supports Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, and more than ten other languages. Join Discord and QQ groups to share strategies with global players!

Every invasion is a new beginning, every defense is a test of wisdom.
Can you become the ultimate guardian of the galaxy?

'Galaxy Defense War' is coming soon to Steam. Welcome to add it to your wishlist and experience this interstellar defense battle at the first opportunity!

games.name: Garden Hustle
games.shortDescription: Start your own gardening service in a charming neighborhood! 🌱 Take on relaxing jobs like mowing lawns, planting flowers, blowing leaves, cleaning backyard pools, and more with bite-sized mini-games. Earn money to upgrade your tools, unlock plants, and decorate your own garden between jobs!
games.aboutText:
Start your own gardening service in a charming neighborhood and bring life back to every yard you visit! 🌱 In Garden Hustle , you’ll take on a variety of wholesome, relaxing jobs, each as a bite-sized mini-game designed to be satisfying and stress-free.

Mow overgrown lawns in neat patterns while avoiding cheeky garden gnomes, plant colorful flowers exactly where your clients want them, blow autumn leaves into tidy piles, clean backyard pools until they sparkle, and much more. Every job feels different, and each is a chance to unwind while still keeping your business growing.

As you complete tasks and earn money, invest in better tools like faster mowers, bigger watering cans, and premium soil to work more efficiently and unlock new plants. Between jobs, head home to your own garden and decorate it however you like, showing off your favorite plants, furniture, and quirky garden ornaments.

With cozy hand-drawn visuals, gentle ambient music, and gameplay that’s all about taking your time, Garden Hustle is the perfect place to relax, get creative, and watch your business blossom one happy customer at a time.

FEATURES

• Relaxing, bite-sized mini-games for every job type

• A variety of tasks: mowing, planting, leaf blowing, pool cleaning, and more

• Upgrade tools and unlock new plants as you grow your business

• Decorate your own personal garden with plants and ornaments

• Cozy 2D art and peaceful garden soundscapes

• Wholesome, slow-paced gameplay with a touch of humor

🌼 Add Garden Hustle to your wishlist and be the first to know when it blooms onto Steam!

games.name: The Marsh Manor Mystery
games.shortDescription: Something strange happened in the old manor, but the Pond's premier puzzle-solver is here to uncover the truth. In this ribbiting and cozy mystery, explore the grounds, journey into the past, and unearth the secrets buried at Marsh Manor.
games.aboutText:
The once bustling manor is now deserted, its doors locked and its secrets buried within. What exactly happened on the night that Mr. Thornmeadow ordered the sudden evacuation?

Inspired by Return of the Obra Dinn and The Case of the Golden Idol, The Marsh Manor Mystery invites you to step into the role of an intrepid amphibious sleuth on a quest to unravel the enigma of Marsh Manor.

The manor may be empty, but each room offers a glimpse into the past. Explore moments frozen in time, analyze dialogue snippets, and sift through environmental details to understand what transpired. Investigate the lives of the quirky cast of frogs and uncover their stories.

Tackle handcrafted puzzles along your journey. Use your notebook to keep track of events and fill in the missing details. Decipher codes to unlock new areas of the manor and piece together Marsh Manor's hidden mysteries.

A cozy manor with two dozen rooms filled with clues and mysteries

A cast of 11 amphibious characters

Over twenty handcrafted puzzles requiring you to fill in the blanks or decipher codes

games.name: 星渊勇者 StarAbyss Heroes
games.shortDescription: Torn by an ancient cataclysm, the world lies in ruins. In this ARPG, play a hero exploring relics, looting treasures, forging weapons, and mastering skills on a decaying yet fantastical journey.
games.aboutText:
World Setting

During the Golden Age, magic and industry flourished, and human civilization reached unprecedented heights. But just as a new era dawned, the sky shattered, and mysterious crimson “Star Remnants” fell, seeping a red liquid across the land. Red Mist quickly spread, corrupting creatures and turning them into monsters.

From the shattered Star Remnants, chaotic energy crystallized into “Crimson Ore,” marking the catastrophe known as the Starfall Disaster, which reshaped the world’s laws.

After the calamity, much of the continent fell into chaos. Humans built fragmented camps to explore these lands, where heroes arrived to establish shelters. Though humble, these refuges offered warmth, with roaming crow merchants, magic tutors of the Azure Council,

technologically adept Mechanists, and above all, the “Leader” overseeing each territory.

Hero Profile

Weapon: Spirit Sepulcher

Wielding the Erosion-Marked Bone Bow, the Spirit Hunter is shrouded in lingering soul echoes. As one of the few who can resonate with lost souls in the Red Mist, her arrows always carry a wail and a piercing scream.

Weapon: Crimson Cinder

The Crimson Envoy wields a massive greatsword, able to alter its attack form and elemental damage through unique skills. This blood-red blade, as tall as its wielder, resounds in battle with a heartbeat-like thrum.

Combat System

The game features classic ARPG gameplay. As the “Hero,” you embark on an epic journey, honing your skills, upgrading talents, and facing ever-stronger foes in pursuit of the truth behind the “StarAbyss.”

games.name: NightMare King
games.shortDescription: Dive into a nightmare-ridden world in this fast-paced roguelite! Choose from 42 characters, 84 weapons, and 176 items to forge your own build. Battle through 8 maps, slay hordes of monsters, level up, collect gold, and upgrade. Can you survive the endless nightmare?
games.aboutText:
Overview

Nightmare King is a pixel-art roguelike bullet hell shooter where you choose a hero to enter dream maps. Survive wave after wave of monsters to become the “Nightmare King.”

Each hero possesses unique passive skills and starting weapons. Through combat, you can refresh the shop to upgrade weapons and gear, crafting your own specialized playstyle.

If you love pixel art, dazzling effects, satisfying mowing-down action, and strategic builds, don't miss out!

Game Features

- Auto-shooting for easy accessibility.

- Fast-paced action with 20 waves per session, totaling about 30 minutes.

- Shop freely to build your playstyle: melee blades, magic spells, ranged bows/guns, summoning, survival loot, and more.

- Survive by maneuvering to collect coins, XP, and healing apples—accumulate wealth through extreme survival.

- Hundreds of characters, each with unique mechanics for distinct combat feel.

- Collectible encyclopedia to unlock more weapons and gear.

- Multiple maps delivering varied monster pressures.

- Adjustable difficulty for endless self-improvement through trials.

Full Content List

- 42 distinctive playable characters: Dragonborn, Witch, Elf, Nun, Necromancer, and more.

- 80+ weapons: Greatswords, Staffs, Grimoires, Bows, Lasers, and more.

- 170+ pieces of gear: Stat boosts, counterattacks on damage, shop discounts, skill activation on pickup, and more.

- 8 arena maps: Catacombs, Sewers, Lawns, Cemeteries, Beaches, and more.

games.name: Beghost
games.shortDescription: BEGHOST is a narrative-heavy 2D action-adventure game set in the bowels of a haunted dungeon. Uncover the dungeon's darkest secrets with your ghost girl companion Bee, as you navigate your way through enemies, traps, and more, in a desperate attempt to escape!
games.aboutText:
FOR YOUR ACTS OF HERESY...

Alas! You have been thrown into the dungeon where the souls of all who are imprisoned become trapped... forever!

As you navigate the labyrinthian corridors, you meet a peculiar ghost girl named Bee, who promises to help you find the exit.

A CINEMATIC EXPERIENCE

BEGHOST is a narrative-heavy 2D action-adventure game set in the bowels of a haunted dungeon. Uncover the dungeon's darkest secrets alongside your companion Bee as you navigate your way through enemies, traps, and more in a desperate attempt to escape!

You may not believe in ghosts... but do you believe in Bee?

Developer's Statement Against the Use of AI Generated Content

BEGHOST is 100% human made and contains no AI generated content or code.

games.name: 荒岛钓鱼记
games.shortDescription: This is a desktop mini-game. Tim will be your desktop pet, fishing non-stop until he catches a palm-sized fish.You can put the caught items into the fish tank or sell them to exchange for costume items.
games.aboutText:
This is a little side project my studio and I put together in our spare time. It doesn’t have much gameplay, so we hope you’ll understand.

We also took this chance to get familiar with Steam’s various processes and features. More games will be launched on Steam in the future—follow our Bilibili account "EP Niu Juzhang" for updates on new releases (assuming we don’t sign with a publisher).

games.name: Click to Civ
games.shortDescription: Smash ancient rocks, collect civilization badges, and grow your hometown into a thriving hub of progress. This simple yet addictive incremental game with active clicking guides humanity from caves to the stars.
games.aboutText:
About This Game

An alien ship has crash-landed on prehistoric Earth. Stranded and far from home, the survivors find themselves surrounded by primitive humans. The only way back to the stars? Ignite the spark of civilization.

Click To Civ is an incremental game with active clicking where you collect ancient civilization badges and grow your hometown into a thriving hub of progress.

Gameplay Loops

Caves : Explore mysterious caves, strike monolith-like rocks, and uncover badges hidden within. Each smash carries a chance to reward you with fragments of long-lost knowledge.

Hometown : Place your collected badges in your settlement. The more you gather, the higher the badge level — and the more gold your village produces passively over time.

Also, you can click the badges to harvest gold instantly.

From Clicks to Automation

Your journey begins with manual clicks, but as your civilization advances, powerful automated systems take over. Develop technology that mines the caves for you, transforming your hard labor into a self-sufficient engine of progress. Witness your civilization's power grow as you shift from active clicking to strategic oversight, ensuring growth continues without finger fatigue.

Item System: Endless Variations

Start each game with a unique item loadout that reshapes your strategy and choices. No two playthroughs are the same — experiment with powerful item combinations and discover new ways to lead your civilization to greatness.

The Thrill of Discovery: Unlock Powerful Chests

The true engine of your advancement lies in the chests you unearth. Every chest you open reveals powerful **items** that are key to your progress. This core loop of discovery and reward is where strategy truly unfolds. Will you find an item that multiplies your click power or a schematic that skyrockets your automated production? Each chest opens a new path to the stars.

Progression Through Simplicity

Badges are the heart of your progress. Every badge you earn drives your hometown to grow faster, stronger, and richer.

Theme

From humble caves of stone to the dream of interstellar flight, guide humanity’s first steps into civilization. Your mission: help the survivors rebuild, advance, and one day launch a starship to return to their homeworld.

Key Features

- Addictive clicker-core gameplay, instantly easy to grasp

- A meaningful progression from active clicking to powerful automation

- A core loop of chest discovery that fuels your growth

- Randomized item system for dynamic replayability

- Relaxing yet rewarding progression

- A mix of mystery and sci-fi woven into a simple Stone Age setting

No clutter, no unnecessary complexity — just pure progression. Can you spark civilization and lead humanity back to the stars?

games.name: Grove Bound
games.shortDescription: Grove Bound is a cozy incremental woodcutting RPG where you chop, fish, cook, mine, and craft to explore a dark forest. Manage fatigue, light your way with a lantern, and upgrade tools while meeting quirky NPCs and uncovering secrets at your own pace.
games.aboutText:
Grove Bound is a cozy incremental woodcutting RPG with a twist there’s no combat .

Instead of fighting enemies, the world itself is the challenge. The grove is wrapped in darkness, lit only by your lantern and the occasional campfire. Some paths will be blocked, but with a bit of planning, better tools, and upgraded skills, you can work your way through and even shape the grove to your advantage.

There’s no rush here. No ticking clock. Just you, your axe, and a quiet forest to explore at your own pace.

Features

- Chop, Mine, Fish, Cook & Craft
Spend your days gathering, crafting, and slowly improving your tools as you settle into life in the grove.

- Find Your Favourite Gear
Discover and upgrade equipment that suits your playstyle some might even hold little secrets.

- Wander into the Grove
Take your lantern and explore at your own pace. The deeper you go, the more there is to find.

- Pack What Matters
Your bag is small, so choose carefully. Bring what you need and make the most of what you find.

- Meet the Neighbors
Get to know a cast of friendly, slightly odd locals. Help them out, and learn their stories over time.
Little Mysteries Everywhere
Poke around, try things out, and uncover hidden corners of the world.

- A Gentle Pace
Keep yourself fed and rested, but there’s no pressure take each day as it comes.
With cute pixel art visuals and a cozy mysterious atmosphere, Grove Bound is about progress, planning, and finding comfort in the unknown one tree at a time.

games.name: Rhombus
games.shortDescription: Rhombus is a first-person puzzle game where you build your path through panels controlling platforms. Explore and find your way through a compact environment in this small metroidbrainia.
games.aboutText:
Rhombus is a first-person puzzle game where you build your path through panels controlling platforms. Explore and find your way through a compact environment in this small metroidbrainia.

Features

- Unique puzzle mechanic that plays with perspective

- Compact 'open-world' environment with multiple paths & non-linear exploration

- Estimated length of 2-3 hours - perfect for a single evening/afternoon

games.name: Withering Age
games.shortDescription: Withering Age is a real-time strategy roguelike set in a dark fantasy, medieval world brimming with magic, danger, and decay. Build and expand your kingdom, train loyal troops and mighty champions, and defend your lands against relentless hordes.
games.aboutText:
Withering Age is a real-time strategy roguelite set in a dark fantasy, medieval world brimming with magic, danger, and decay.
Build and expand your kingdom, train loyal troops and mighty champions, and defend your lands against relentless hordes.
Each run offers new opportunities—collect powerful relics, master unique abilities, and adapt your strategy to survive the ever-changing threats of the Withering Age.

games.name: SKYSAVIOR Helicopter Services
games.shortDescription: Save the city from chaos! In the game, the player takes on the role of a helicopter pilot fulfilling objectives transmitted by the operations center.

games.name: Tornado Hunter
games.shortDescription: Become a Tornado Hunter! Join the thrilling race across the American plains to predict, track, and document the deadliest storms of the century. Risk everything in pursuit of perfect data, but be careful: one wrong move and you'll become a storm victim.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the heart of the storm. Tornado Hunter puts you in command of a high-stakes mission, where you take on the roles of both scientist and adventurer. Far from being just a game, it is a simulation of one of the world's most perilous pursuits.

Your adventure begins when you are nothing more than a novice storm chaser, armed with a beat-up car and a dream. The vast, dynamic open world of "Tornado Alley" becomes both your playground and your battlefield. By combining instinct, real-time weather data, and cutting-edge forecasting tools, you will analyze atmospheric instability, pinpoint potential supercell formations on your map, and race against time to intercept them.

The sun won't wait for you. Thanks to the dynamic day-night cycle, every chase is unique from golden sunrises over the plains to pitch darkness where the path is lit only by flashes of lightning.

Dominators. Pickups. And everything in between. Find your vehicle. Challenge the elements.

The versatile item system offers complete freedom: load up your VEHICLE with whatever you need. Tools, gear, supplies—if it fits, it’s yours. Choose your equipment wisely; the only limit here is available space.

Remember — you're the one who makes it all possible.

games.name: Quiet Express: Cabin 909
games.shortDescription: “Do you know anything about Cabin 909?” In Quiet Express: Cabin 909, you spend seven days on the titular train, journeying from one side of the continent to the other.
games.aboutText:
In Quiet Express: Cabin 909, you spend seven days on the titular train, journeying from one side of the continent to the other.

You're looking for Cabin 909, a cabin that shouldn't exist on the train.

As you do this, you'll meet the other passengers, all spending their week-long journey in different ways. And as you talk to them and help them out with their problems, you'll get ever closer to Cabin 909.

Puzzle Piece Cabins

You wake up in the rearmost cabin on the Quiet Express, and you make your way to the last cabin at the front.

Every time you open a door, you may find a different cabin... and you get to choose what cabin it is.
There are passenger cabins, restaurant cabins, storage cabins, and more. You get three choices, and by exploring, you may even find ways to get a different selection of choices, or an additional choice each time you open a door.

All cabins are all connected, and by changing the way that they are joined to each other, you may reach new places and learn something more about this strange train.
Why is that door locked?
Why doesn't that switch do anything?
What's that space above the ceiling?
The Quiet Express hides many a mystery.

Fellow Travelers

Every time the train stops, a fresh batch of passengers joins the convoy.

Some are half-human beasts, some are giants, some are homunculi... But the age of discrimination is over, and it's becoming easier for all of them to ride together, as equals.

However, along with their luggage, they all bring their own stories, their own destinations, and their own problems. Different races of beings surely have different worries and different regrets.

Maybe, if you talk with them, they'll share a bit of that with you. And by learning about how their life has led them to ride on the Quiet Express, you may help change the course of their journey... and perhaps, that of your own.

A Neverending Week

The Quiet Express usually takes a week to reach its destination. Unfortunately, this is not how things to this time.

Right before the last station, the train suffers a terrible accident, going up in flames. Nobody can come to help, and all of the passengers and crew lose their lives.

However, somehow, you wake up. And you find yourself back where you started, waiting to board the train. Time has been rewound by seven days, and the train is once again ready to bound west.

Unfortunately, seven days later, the same thing happens. The train goes up in flames again. You need to find a way to prevent it in time.

And as you repeat this journey, you'll get closer and closer to the reason why this tragic journey keeps repeating itself.

A Mystery Numbered 909

You're looking for Cabin 909, a cabin that shouldn't exist on the Quiet Express.
According to the passengers and even the conductor, there is no cabin with that number.

Where is it, then? And what happened there? Why are you even looking for it?
And there are even more mysteries surrounding the train.
Why does time loop every seven days? Why can you choose where cabins are placed?

Step by step, you'll unfold all of these mysteries, reaching the final destination: the truth.

Credits

Direction and Development: Kazuhide Oka
Scenario: Kazuhide Oka
Key Visuals: Moe Katakura
Trailer: Moe Katakura
Character Design and Modeling: Moe Katakura
Background Design and Modeling: Kohei Miyahara
Game Design: SparkWingGames
Concept Key Visuals: ASAMIYA KOBO
Soundtrack: ruichiro
Logo art: JEFF99
English Translation: Marco Godano
Simplified/Traditional Chinese Translation: flankoi
Korean Translation: TansanCoffee (TSCF)
Public Relations: roema, Shoya Kido, mri

games.name: Gata Guressi
games.shortDescription: Learn to communicate with the people of Hierre by speaking their languages and understanding their cultures in this sci-fi translation game. Use your translation skills to navigate Kallay Tirridor, uncovering its dark secrets while solving the sudden disappearance of your brother.
games.aboutText:
Gata Guressi is a sci-fi translation game where you learn to communicate with the people of the Hierre system by translating their languages and understanding their cultures. Build your knowledge of Hierre's history, culture, and planets, then put it to use to solve the mysterious disappearance of your brother and sell a rare resource to the rich patrons of Kallay Tirridor.

Use your translator to learn the dictionaries, worldviews, and cultures of 11 languages used by the peoples of Hierre. Dialogue will challenge you with foreign concepts and references; you'll need to understand the cultures and planets of Hierre to leverage your sales pitches, catch hidden meanings, and find your brother.

Kallay Tirridor, an upscale bar-turned-trade-port, hosts a variety of demographics from around the system: local Voenni, high-class patrons, tourists from other planets, and traders looking for any opportunity to make a quick buck. Kallay Tirridor isn't a massive place, and visitors usually don't come alone; how you respond to different situations may affect you later on.

You've brought a shipment of a valuable resource called ielsek to Kallay Tirridor, but to make sales, you'll need to understand how your potential customers speak and think. Your background as a Guressi (someone from the exiled planet of Guressen) may complicate sales and lead to unsavory interactions.

Read between the lines to discern hidden meanings and hints at a dark scheme surrounding Kallay Tirridor. Investigate by making the right friends, learning new definitions and slang phrases, and catching what people really mean by their words.

games.name: THE CANON OF BALLS
games.shortDescription: Hardcore, co-op (or solo) platformer. Dark Souls makes a baby with Super Monkey Ball. An easy-to-learn, hard-to-master experience to explore with your friends. All inside a vast open world, with each platforming course bringing its own twist.
games.aboutText:
THE CANON OF BALLS is the hardcore, first-person platforming experience you and your friends have been waiting for. Imagine putting Shadow of the Colossus' PS2 aesthetics and Monkey Ball's gameplay into a blender and mixing them thoroughly. What comes out is an easy-to-learn, hard-to-master open-world multiplayer experience to explore and master together with your friends. A vast open world, with each platforming track bringing its own interesting twist, is waiting for you — all of this with no hand-holding. There are no minimaps, quest markers, or tutorials.

The game can also be completed in offline solo mode. No friends required.

I put a lot of work into the sound design to give the BALLS as much weight as possible, all to create a snappy gameplay experience with memorable juice. The world is fully "handcrafted" to be a non-repetitive, non-modular open world. I purposely didn't build a modular "copy and paste" kit to craft the levels. All of the parkour courses feature a specific idea, twist, or thought to make sure everything feels fresh in a different way. No AI art assets have been used.

From the start, I knew THE CANON OF BALLS should be something to experience with friends. Without setting any rules or multiplayer objectives, the world provides its own platform to give birth to fun, memorable, virtual togetherness. The premise was the good old days of playing Minecraft parkour maps and talking about all kinds of things while you struggled together. You can be competitive and see who reaches a crystal first, or play more cooperatively, navigating together and waiting for each other. The freedom is in the hands of the group, and I can't wait to see how you all choose to play it. The word "co-op" might be a bit stretched for the game, as there are no real mechanics that require multiple players—it all works solo. However, the true social moments are what make this experience so special.

NOW GET IT AND START ROLLING!!!

games.name: Fishing at the Lake Full of Cats
games.shortDescription: Fishing at the Lake Full of Cats is a puzzle solving, cat collecting, fishing game where you uncover the secrets of Silly Lake in a quest to fish up every last one of its pointy eared denizens.
games.aboutText:
There is a lake of cats, and you have to catch all of them probably. Fishing at the Lake Full of Cats is a short, puzzle solving, cat collecting, fishing game set in a colorful stylized world. After finding a mysterious note in his cabin, Logan sets off on an adventure where you uncover the secrets of Silly Lake in a quest to fish up every last one of its pointy eared denizens.

Make use of the various bait types, tools, and ever useful "Catalogue" along with your deductive puzzle solving skills to catch over 20 unique cat types.

Featuring:

- A lake full of cats

- A different part of the lake, also full of cats

- A river full of cats

- A pond full of cats

- Ryan

- A cave pond full of cats

- Another pond full of cats

- Another river with only 1 cat

- Various other bodies of water, which are also full of cats

games.name: Tax It Easy
games.shortDescription: Uncover shady expenses as a full-time Tax Scrutinizer! Check tax files, spot suspicious invoices, and decide: approve, reject, or pocket a bribe in this satirical inspector sim. Upgrade your office, build connections with big companies, make the most money for the government... or for yourself!
games.aboutText:
Uncover shady expenses and balance ethics with survival in Tax It Easy , a satirical inspector sim where every invoice tells a story. As a full-time Tax Scrutinizer, it’s your job to check files, spot suspicious claims, and decide: approve, reject, or pocket a bribe. Inspect, Compare, Decide

Each day begins at your desk. Read the morning paper for new rules, then dive into piles of tax documents, income records, expense reports, bank statements, and more. Look for inconsistencies:

- Income vs. Expenses – Is a shopkeeper really spending more than they earn?

- Suspicious Expenses – Does a YouTuber really need a 1 million USD water bill?

- Hidden Income – Bank deposits that mysteriously don’t match the reports.

- Duplicate Invoices – The same laptop bought three times? Looks fishy.

Choices Have Consequences

Stamp the file Approved , Rejected , or mark it for further review. But beware:

- Bribes – Accept quick cash at your own risk. If the system catches you, it’s over.

- Political Pressure – High-profile clients may bring shady favors and threats.

- Relationships – Keep your balance with politicians, the state, and the public. Anger the wrong side, and your career (or life) may end abruptly.

Upgrade Your Office

Use your earnings to improve your workspace or… your connections. New tools, cozier offices, fancy décor, or backdoor deals and shadowy upgrades. Your choices shape your path. Multiple Endings

Your career can end in very different ways:

- Golden Inspector – Reject every bribe and become a legendary inspector.

- Cunning Inspector – Cozy up to politicians and trade your stamp for power.

- Secret Tycoon – Take the money, disappear abroad, and retire in luxury.

- Blacklisted – Get caught in a corruption scandal and vanish from the system.

The Tone

Whether played as a dark satire in the spirit of Papers, Please or as a lighter, more comical take on bureaucracy, Tax It Easy mixes humor, moral dilemmas, and cozy desk work into one unique experience.

Think you can balance the books, dodge shady deals, and keep your head above water?
Add Tax It Easy to your wishlist and prepare to stamp your way to glory… or infamy.

games.name: Alchemortis
games.shortDescription: Alchemortis is a roguelike inventory-management auto-battler about alchemy. Transmute and combine items to merge their stats, properties, and forms, then organize your inventory to unlock powerful synergies. Experiment, optimize, and craft the perfect build through the power of alchemy.
games.aboutText:
Every item in the game can be thrown into the pot.

Transmute and combine items in any configuration you like to merge their stats, properties, and forms — creating the perfect items. Take calculated risks, or embrace chaos and hope for the best. The possibilities are endless!

Your inventory is your build.

‎‎Arrange items in your inventory to unlock powerful effects, maximize synergies, and create devastating combos!
‎With limited space and items of all shapes and sizes, positioning is everything.

Once the encounter begins, all you can do is watch.

Let your strategic genius speak for itself. Is your build optimized? Are all synergies properly set up? Is positioning correct? There’s only one way to find out. With every turn, the battle moves closer to its resolution.

No two runs are the same.

Choose your path. Decide what matters most. A new item? An upgrade? A rare artifact? You can’t have it all.
Struggle toward the end — and when you inevitably fail, begin again from nothing. Such is the fate of an alchemist.

Once you unlock something, it stays with you forever.

Discover characters, items, and artifacts through sheer luck or by conquering challenges. New characters unlock entirely new playstyles, while items and artifacts expand possibilities and enhance synergies. Discover every secret of Alchemortis !

games.name: Push Push
games.shortDescription: Push Push is a cute and relaxing idle balloon game! Pump balloons, unlock adorable cats, and collect all kinds of quirky pumps and animal companions. Perfect for quick breaks and stress relief.
games.aboutText:
PushPush is a desktop idle balloon-pumping game! Keep inflating balloons, unlock adorable cats, and collect all kinds of quirky pumps and animal companions.

Perfect for daily relaxation and stress relief.

· An infinitely growing tree, plus over 100 cute cats, balloons, pumps, and accessories — your desktop just got livelier!

· No more boring idle! With Slacktail, Slackhoof, and other animal pals, you can arrange resources wisely and automate everything!

· Every cat has its own Stamina and Luck stats! The harder you pump, the faster stamina drops. Don't forget to farm and harvest on your desktop, and cook their favorite cat food cans!

· Island skins are fully customizable! Choose from a variety of scenes to satisfy your love for decoration and curiosity!

· The thrill of going all-in is a must! Rocket Gacha stays with you from early to late game — the more rare items you put in, the more powerful it becomes!

· Cats and their lab are always full of cute little stories! Take your time to explore and uncover them all!

· Popping balloons is the most direct way to earn Meow Coins — but it’s not that "simple" either. Balloons can overclock into Gold or even Prismatic ones, so you’ll need to make smart decisions based on your cats’ Luck stats!

· One-click hide – accompany your work and study!

games.name: CD-ROM
