games.shortDescription: 10 CDs, 10 passwords. Find hidden messages, text, numbers to unlock next CD to continue your steganography puzzle journey.
games.aboutText:
CD-ROM is a game features series of puzzles located inside 10 different themed CDs. Players progress by deciphering coded texts, analyzing images, finding hints from mini-games and many more! Each clue leads players to 8 digit password they require to unlock next CD. 10 CDs, 10 passwords.

CD-ROM is a game highly related with cryptography and steganography. Many messages are hid inside various data for players to explore. Use programs inside your CDs to overcome these challenges!

- The game offers complex but fun puzzles

- Mini-games

- Pixel art graphics

- Steam achievements

games.name: Island Beekeeper
games.shortDescription: Build your apiary on islands above the clouds, travel on your medocycle, crossbreed bees with unique traits and create a cozy home in the sky. Grow plants, explore islands and send healing honey down to Earth, where people still hope for your help.
games.aboutText:
Earth is dying from disease, famine and ruin. One of the few resources still helping people survive is honey from the floating islands.

You travel to the sky world to build a beekeeping farm, raise bees and establish honey shipments back down to Earth. Other beekeepers were sent there before you, but none of them ever returned. The more islands you discover, the closer you get to the answer to the main question: what happened to those who came before you?

🐝 Bees and Hybrids

Raise bees, care for hives and collect honey. Each type of bee has its own unique traits. Crossbreed different species to create hybrids with new properties. Over time, bees will become an important part of your farm and help automate part of the work at the apiary.

🍯🏠 Building

Create your own island: expand the territory, place hives, set up crop fields and build your apiary the way you want. Build a farm, a small house with hives or a large apiary that gradually grows together with your settlement.

🌼 Gardening

Grow flowers for the bees, as well as vegetables, fruits and other plants for yourself. Some crops will help attract the right types of bees and affect the quality of the honey, while others will be useful for cooking, crafting and everyday life on the island. Choose plants that suit your apiary and gradually expand your farm with new crops.

🐝🏍️ Medocycle

The Medocycle is a unique vehicle for traveling between islands. With it you can explore new islands, find rare locations and quickly return to your apiary. Upgrade the Medocycle to reach places that were previously inaccessible.

🌤️ World Exploration

Travel between islands with different biomes, plants, resources and bee species. Each new island may offer something useful for your apiary: a rare bee, a needed material or a new crop to grow. As you explore the islands, you will uncover traces of the beekeepers who came before you and gradually learn what happened to them.

👥 Multiplayer

Play solo or with friends: develop the apiary, grow plants, build and explore islands in a shared world. Divide up tasks or do everything together - one person cares for the bees, another shapes the island, and a third heads out to find new islands and bee species.

games.name: Lazy Witch's Factory
games.shortDescription: Your debt comes due in 30 minutes. Twist the rules through demonic contracts and survive impossible production quotas in this chaotic factory-building roguelite.
games.aboutText:
One Shift. One Factory. One Impossible Deadline.

『Lazy Witch’s Factory』 is a run-based rogue-lite factory builder.

You have only a short time to build a factory, make deals with demons, and repay a ridiculous amount of debt.

No time to take it easy.

Make the most of your limited time and resources.

Spaghetti lines and stopgap fixes are allowed.

If you fail to repay your debt before the deadline, you'll...

Actually, never mind.

Contracts Solve Everything (For a While)

Mine resources. Turn them into products. Sell them to pay off your debt.

Unfortunately, that won't be nearly enough. Make contracts with demons .

Short on raw materials? Rewrite the recipe.

Got too much iron ore? Transform it into a gem.

Short on cash? Just make some.

When your shift ends, everything resets. Except what you learned.

With each run, you'll get better at choosing the right contracts for the situation and building smarter synergies.

Middle management in hell is hell itself.

You play as Momoko , who signed up for “passive income” and ended up buried in debt.

Your workers are generally unmotivated and completely honest about their desires.

Whether they can be made to work properly depends entirely on how you manage them.

- Salamanders seem to think blacksmithing is part of a workout routine.

- Slimes enjoy the pain produced by distillation a little too much, and would rather make it last longer.

Eternal Life, Infinite Overtime

In the beginning, eternal life was the punishment cast upon sinners.

The manager Gehenna thought:

“Wonderful. This solves the overtime problem.”

You were cast down into a truly hellish work environment.

Still, not every demon in Hell wants to make your life worse.

Bored by immortality, the arch-demons now offer their help with your factory operations, each in their own highly questionable way.

- Leviathan , a researcher, can greatly improve productivity through experimentation. As a side effect, Hell's entire water supply becomes contaminated.

- Mammon , head of the infernal bank, can solve your cash-flow problems. Don't ask where the money came from.

Welcome to hell. Please clock in.

Game Features

- A frantic run to pay off your debt within a 30-minute time limit

- Highly replayable gameplay that inflates production power through factory design skills and randomized options for greater strategic depth.

- Diverse strategies based on sponsor character combinations

- Cute characters and sarcastic humor

Discord

Have feedback or requests about the game? Join us on Discord!

Feel free to share your thoughts about the game, and bug reports are always welcome, too.

games.name: In Falsus
games.shortDescription: In a world bound by truths: connect. In Falsus is a mesmerizing rhythm game tied to an intricate card system brought together through a layered narrative. Taking place in a near-future world, traverse an atmospheric soundscape through the eyes of 5 interconnected protagonists.
games.aboutText:
Tying music gameplay to a tale of lies and truth, 'In Falsus' guides players through seamless progression from flow to mastery, welcoming those new and experienced to surmount challenges and rise higher with each and every encounter.

Follow the separate perspectives of 5 girls making their way through high school in a near-future world, whose lives take a sharp turn one day as they are bid to join a strange government program, and soon are forced to face an undiscovered side of their reality.

Progression: With a signature control system of mouse and keyboard, In Falsus brings challenges across 4 difficulties, rising in intensity of incoming notes and a sweeping aerial Field.

Encounters: Every step forward brings a greater trial. Throughout their ordeals, the protagonists encounter characters who they must contend with or assist, with these key moments each tied to unique songs.

Songs: Produced by composers at the forefront of Japan's independent music scene as well as international artists, In Falsus features over 70 songs, over 40 of which are original, represented across a multitude of genres and styles.

Crafting: Overcome challenges to collect materials, craft unique Cards, and gain new advantages and approaches during song gameplay.

Blueprints: Integrate Cards by slotting earned materials into Blueprints, grids with a wide variety of choices in stat boosts and bonuses. Every Card crafted is different, and every Blueprint is a puzzle. How you choose to arrange materials within Blueprints shapes unique possibilities in solutions and effects.

Cards: Featuring artwork of characters met and unfolding narrative moments witnessed, illustrated by a range of skilled and renowned artists, equip up to 5 Cards to vary your approach when challenging the songs you come across.

A world where emotions are laid bare at the neck, and no lies are permitted.

Narrative: Through visual novel-styled narrative design, switch between the individual perspectives of 5 protagonists—all of whom are interconnected.

Immersion: Become drawn into a new world through expressive characters, captivating environments, and full Japanese voice acting.

Experience: Narrative is at the heart of In Falsus, with music gameplay, sound design, and themes reflecting and directly linked to the events of the game.

games.name: Black Cat Book Club
games.shortDescription: A magical library you can place on your desktop. Help the black cat study ancient tomes and learn spells in this cozy idle game.
games.aboutText:
Black Cat Book Club is an idle game about a cat reading all the books in the Sorceress' Library and learning Magic along the way.

THE ARCANE LIBRARY

- Unlock and read forgotten tomes, each granting a unique Upgrade

- Help the cat decipher ancient texts, inspired by real-world traditions: Glyphs will consume Focus and reveal their meaning, advancing your progress on a book.

- Learn and cast magic spells: sigils, summoning seals, alchemy, and astral magic.

MAKE IT YOURS

Choose from various fur patterns, eye colors and accessories for your cat and make every nook of the tower the coziest reading spot by unlocking magical artifacts and decorations.

DESKTOP COMPANION

The black cat will keep you company while you relax, work, or study. You can move and resize the library, zoom in to take a closer look, and be as active or chill as you wish.

games.name: Corban's Station
games.shortDescription: In this first-person puzzle exploration game, walk the liminal spaces of a long-abandoned service station. Reprogram aging computers, physically reroute damaged and fading connections and restore fragments of their waning memory.
games.aboutText:
Everything and everywhere forgets, eventually.

In this first-person puzzle exploration game, walk the liminal spaces of a long-abandoned service station. Reprogram aging computers, physically reroute damaged and fading connections and restore fragments of their waning memory.

Years have passed since the last visitor set foot in Corban's Station. You awaken as the last droid left in storage, alone, stirred by a mysterious signal from perhaps the last person who remembers you exist.

Who they are and what they want are as forgotten as the station you find yourself in.

Restore temporary order in station subsystems to unlock new areas. Navigate a world of fading memories, abandoned machinery and quietly resting spaces.

Corban’s Station is an exploration of the fragility of memory, the descent into obsolescence, and the ingress of entropy.

What will be left of everything we know in time?

Before the fade to black, can you help Corban's Station remember itself?

Restore broken machinery

Discover and reprogram declining machines and bring them back to life.

Reroute connections

Use physical cables to connect station subsystems, moving fragments of lost memory to where they are needed.

Build a chain of pathways to move memories across a disrupted network.

Adapt around failing hardware

Work around physical limitations, damaged slots, limited memory capacity and the erosive nature of time.

Discover a forgotten station

Experience a liminal world of decay, obsolescence and fading infrastructure.

Unlock and explore new areas and memories, piecing together the lost story of Corban's Station.

Unveil your intuition in keeping memories alive as you walk the halls of a world shaped by echoes.

games.name: Merry Crisis
games.shortDescription: Three loves. One week. Merry Crisis is an intimate, character-driven romance visual novel about love, loss, and belonging—is home what you left behind, or where you're headed?
games.aboutText:
Synopsis

After a break-up turns your world inside out, you return home for Christmas hoping the change in scenery will give you space to mend a broken heart.

Instead, the universe serves up: a charged encounter with your estranged first love, an unexpected visit from the ex you haven't quite gotten over, and an undeniable connection with the musician-next-door.

As the clock counts down to midnight on New Year's Eve, you'll need to choose: rebuild your life in New York, or return to the world you left behind in Singapore?

Features

- Story-rich, with choices that matter: Every decision affects the story—unlocking different relationship paths, special scenes, and unique endings.

- Unforgettable Cast of Characters: Each love interest is gender-selectable, with their own distinctive personality and storyline. Authentic LGBTQ+ and POC representation.

- Deep character customization: Define your gender identity, sexuality, backstory, family relationships, attitudes to New York/Singapore, which all affect the story that unfolds.

- Beautiful hand-drawn art that brings Singapore to life.

Characters

LOVE INTERESTS

Nat - the recent ex, current flatmate

Your ex. Your flatmate. Your best friend. Warm, funny, and generous to a fault, Nat used to be your 'forever person', until the cracks begin to show. Even after calling it quits, Nat's still right there —brewing coffee just the way you like it, leaving notes on the fridge, making you question if there's still something worth saving.

Shay — the neighbor (and Christmas fling?)

Your neighbor's new tenant is bold, full of roguish charm, and deliciously unconventional. Shay's the kind of trouble that looks like fun—perhaps the perfect antidote to heartbreak. But when this week comes to an end, how difficult will it be to say goodbye?

Qiu — the estranged first love

Aloof, ambitious, and intense, Qiu's the first person you fell in love with, and the first person to break your heart. After leaving for New York, you do your best to bury this part of your past. But when you meet again at the class reunion, however, you find yourself being sucked right back into Qiu's orbit...

SIDE CHARACTERS

Interact with a colorful cast of characters that bring Singapore to life—from your zany, affectionate best friend, Juni, to your family (hiding secrets of their own), Shay's bandmates, your kindly elderly neighbor, and more!

Team

Lead Writer & Developer

Allie Wu, Founder of Monsoon Games ( Author blog )

Artist s

- Crows, Lead character artist

- Maria, Lead background artist

Extended Team

- Silvia, Background artist

- Naz, Character artist

- Fie, Background artist

- Katheris, UI artist

- Exyl, Trailer producer

- Diane, Music composer

games.name: Sector Space
games.shortDescription: Explore a procedurally generated galaxy, mine asteroids, refine minerals, colonize planets, build stations, deploy drones, salvage rare items, construct gear, level up, improve your ship, assemble a fleet, engage in combat, and take on the void.
games.aboutText:
Sector Space is a cozy top-down single player space sandbox with retro graphics. The game takes place in a procedurally generated world with a seamless travel system. Each world represents a single galaxy in the void with hundreds of star systems and points of interest for the player to visit.

Characters pilot their own ship and depending on the chosen character class (profession) may have up to 6 fleet ships. As the character levels up they may select various secondary skills to further specialize and improve their ship. Skills are automatically passed onto your fleet ships but at a reduction proportional to their level. The primary means of upgrading and progressing is through selection of gear and ships of increasing tier level. The game contains hundreds of items which may have modifiers applied enhancing their function.

The character's ship and fleet can be moved between world files allowing you to generate different "galaxies" to explore. Most resources are renewable so typically you only need to play on one world. Some locations are unique and present in all generated galaxy although their position may change.

A world (galaxy) is divided up into a grid with each cell being a "sector". Characters can move from sector to sector continuously or take advantage of jump drives, jump gates, and wormholes to move larger distances. A sector can be an entire asteroid field, star system, nebula etc. There are combat areas and anomalous regions with more challenging enemies and better item drops. The character may be visited by NPC or ambushed in a random encounter while they move through dangerous regions of space. Make use of NPC stations and resources to progress, additionally characters may deploy their own stations and fortify the area with drones to protect against hostile invaders.

The typical game loop consists of levelling and acquiring gear through combat or gathering resources and crafting items which will also grant experience towards levelling up. Players can mine asteroids, refining the ore into pure elements and then craft components which are used in the construction of items and ships. Additional resources may be extracted from planets and colonies. Item's can vary in price by region and fluctuate over time which can make trading between stations a viable source of credits.

games.name: nophenia
games.shortDescription: a small dream explorer.
games.aboutText:
explore atmospheric dreams of vagrant but familiar memories.

there is …

- ... no game. you walk around and explore brutalist but also dream-like ​environments​.

- ... a dedicated sit [ C ] and howl [ H ] button because wolfgirls are super cool

other controls

- move : [ WASD ] : [↑ ← ↓ →]

- run : [ CTRL ] : [SHIFT]

- jump : [ SPACE ]

- interact : [ F ] : [Z] : [ENTER] : [Left Click]

- pause : [ P ] : [ESC]

(additionally, a camera can be accessed through the pause menu [ ESC ] allowing you to take pictures with…)

notice: while this program does not contain conventional “horror” elements, themes of liminality, isolation and escapism may still evoke unsettling feelings or generally be difficult topics to some so please, explore with caution.

games.name: Factomancer
games.shortDescription: The Order sends you on a mission. Armed with technology powered by magic, build production chains, plan, transform, optimize, and prepare for the unexpected. In this automation roguelite, the Eye of the Order watches your moves: failure is only a step toward perfection.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Karnor, a world where magic fuels the technology of a mysterious Order. Carry out Its will by traveling across Karnor to bring Progress to the rest of the world. Transform magical resources into goods, artifacts, and commodities to complete your mission’s many challenges: meet growing demand… or start again, wiser and more experienced.

"Factomancer, your next mission awaits"

Explore diverse territories and biomes to design, automate, and optimize your production chains. Process resources, artifacts, and trade goods to achieve the objectives set by the Order. Every run is unique: maps change with each playthrough, and events will put your strategies to the test.

"Magic in the service of your power"

Bring massive machines to life through magic and unlock the full potential of your creations with Relics and Spells provided by the Order. Increase your production capabilities and shape the land as you see fit.

"Every day counts"

Each day of the mission is time-limited. You must prioritize what matters most, react to the unexpected, and strike the right balance between planning and improvisation. Every decision becomes a strategic choice, every mistake a lesson… or even a new opportunity.

"Above you, the Eye watches"

Starting on untouched land, make your own choices and manage your economy to invest in what truly matters. Buy a new machine? Explore a new plot of land? Acquire a relic or cast a spell? The choice is yours. But whatever you do, the Eye is watching, and will report back to the Order.

Discover. Upgrade. Optimize. Master.

We think you'll love Factomancer if you enjoy…

Against the Storm, Satisfactory, Factorio, Oxygen Not Included, Dyson Sphere Program, shapez, shapez 2, Modulus, Tower Factory, ShapeHero Factory, Captain of Industry, Timberborn, The Riftbreaker, The King is Watching, Star Birds, Oddsparks, Diplomacy is not an option, Solarpunk, Corsair Cove, Mini Settlers.

games.name: Red Tide
games.shortDescription: Red Tide is an EXTRACTION FISHER set in the irradiated wastelands. Radioactive fish? Heavily armed Game Wardens? Exploring a vast open world with a rod in one hand and a rifle in the other? Scavenge what's left of the former nuclear site among the Calem Islands, alone or with friends.
games.aboutText:
Fish, Loot, and Fight in the Irradiated Exclusion Zone

The Collectors will pay a pretty penny for the mutated fish that can be found within radioactive waters in and around the Complex. Unfortunately, these aquatic oddities are not the only inhabitants you will encounter among the rolling hills and forests of the Calem Islands. So keep your rifle (and your rod) by your side, and go embark on the most dire fishing excursion of your life.

Red Tide Features:

- Open World Fishing, Exploration and Looting

- Vitals, including Hunger, Thirst, and Radiation

- Inventory Management

- Gunplay, Quests, Merchants, and Various Unsightly Enemies

- Day-Night and Season Cycle

and everything else you would expect in your typical extraction game.

Team Up with Others In a 5-Player Online Co-Op Experience

Whether you are a one-man army or a band of brothers, the inhospitable lands upon which the Complex once sprawled sit waiting to be explored. Though be warned, better adventurers before you have tried, and the luckiest among them left only with their life. Featuring lobbies supporting up to 5 players, bring your friends or go it on your own.

Sell Mutated Fish to the Collectors

Some glow in the dark, some have six eyes. Some possess Lovecraftian qualities beyond description. Each fish you catch is unique and worth more or less to the Collectors depending on the aforementioned strange yet remarkable characteristics. Try to collect them all, if the Islands don't chew you up and spit you back out first.

Dodge the Game Wardens Patrolling the Wasteland

Be warned, the Order has deemed your presence on the Islands to be unlawful. Plundering the natural (and not-so-natural) resources of land in and around Complex property comes with the heaviest of penalties: death. If you are going to fish among the competing presence of heavily armed conservation officers, you best take the time to properly equip yourself first.

In Red Tide, your progression is tied to your character, and you can expect a highly replayable experience each time you bring yourself back to the Islands. Strap in for random weather events, anomalies, cryptids, scavengers, and a plethora of strange scaly friends all eagerly awaiting your acquaintance. Do you have what it takes?

games.name: Leaf it Alone
games.shortDescription: Finally, it's that time of the year to clean up this leafy mess. It's been a while since the last time you've done it, so don't waste any second and derust your raking skills!
games.aboutText:
Leaves have been piling up for too long, and they aren't going anywhere on their own. Time to roll up your sleeves and get back to work.

You don't need much. A rake , a leaf blower , or sometimes even a mighty hand might become handy.

The plot changes slowly at first, but once you start upgrading your tools, the process becomes quick - and the yard begins to feel alive again.

Keep track of the progress in your journal, complete objectives, and unlock achievements along the way! Show your friends how it's done, thanks to the in-game leaderboards .

Every leaf you move brings the place closer to order. See what you will uncover...

games.name: Broom Broom
games.shortDescription: Grab your broom, fly over to people in need and brew them potions after a catastrophic snowstorm has hit your village! Talk to your lovely (but mostly grumpy) neighbours as you find your place in this short and cozy adventure.
games.aboutText:
Waking up after a sudden October snowstorm, your town is in shambles. Buildings have been snowed in, fallen trees and boulders are blocking the road... And as the only witch in town that people aren't afraid of, suddenly everyone depends on you.

Explore on your broom

- Soar through the skies, navigate between Witch Hoops

- Explore a mini open world at your own pace

- Find all the upgrades and collectibles

Talk to your neighbors

- Get all the latest gossip from your familiar

- Make friends, and accept not everyone likes witches

- Get to know the people of an Eastern-European folklore inspired world

Help your community

- Brew potions for the sick

- Clear up the rubble and unlock new paths

- Deliver mail on your broom

games.name: Hollowbrook - Apartments
games.shortDescription: Hollowbrook is a stylized horror experience told through multiple episodes. Each chapter immerses you in the life of a new character, blending personal backstories with chilling encounters that react to your decisions.
games.aboutText:
Hollowbrook is a horror game that will center around a long-running arc over several episodes. Each episode will spotlight a certain character that you will come to love, each with their own backstories.

Survive your first night in the apartments.

Hollowbrook - Apartments

In this story, you play as Jenny .

You just moved in to a new apartment last week and have few acquaintances.
One night, during a storm, a series of events unfold that you must successfully navigate.

Will you make the right choices , or are you destined for something else?

What you will experience

- Character-driven story that builds toward a tense grand finale.

- Hand-crafted immersive and atmospheric environment.

- Stylized aesthetic

- Secrets and things to explore and discover.

- Checkpoints for those that don't survive the night.

The apartment episode is a shorter episode, expected to last anywhere between 30 to 90 minutes.

games.name: Love Limit
games.shortDescription: Your blind date invades Earth!?
games.aboutText:
Story

In an effort to support her sister's future career as a matchmaker, Eiren Reeves agrees to a blind date her sister sets up. Several hours later, when her date's a no show...

The planet is invaded!?

But wait... the invader looks rather familiar? No, it couldn't be. There's no way Eiren's date is an alien invader that just put the fate of the world in her hands, right? Unless...?

Features

- Bestow a name upon the protagonist (technically)!

- Save earth from an alien overlord using romance!

- Enjoy an hilarious, ending collector rom-com that's over 45,000k words! (Approximately 3 hours of gameplay)

- Over 10 possible endings!

Content Warnings

Be advised that this game contains depictions of slapstick violence, profanity, and sexually suggestive content. Overall it's rated T for Teen. Player discretion is still advised.

games.name: The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon
games.shortDescription: You'd think that after 20+ cases, there'd be no crime left in Twin Lakes - but that's not how crime works, rookie. Six new mind-melting mysteries await Detective McQueen and Officer Dooley - just as soon as they get the mustard out of Dooley's gun.
games.aboutText:
Misdemeanours nap and corruption rarely gets out of bed but crime? Crime never sleeps...

That may be why Detective McQueen is so pale... But if not him, who else would keep Twin Lakes' arcane crooks and supernatural delinquents at bay? Nobody, that's who - because he and his trusted, if not trustworthy, sidekick Officer Dooley are The Darkside Division. Twin Lakes' crack(ed) force tasked with keeping the city's streets ghoul-free and

human-expensive.

Our dream(y) team are back and they're more ready than ever to put the zing in Van Helsing. Sadly for them, there are no vampire stories this time around. Still, they swore a vow to serve and protect so they will explore, gather, combine, point and click their way through whatever comes their way in six brand new standalone cases (we tried to just remaster a few of them but we didn't get away with that).

Werewolves, cursed items, awry rituals, treasure hunts, and perhaps most terrifying monster of all - rich people - will put our pixelated heroes to the test but with your help, they might come out on top.

Features

- Deductive Decipherings: Solve 6 new cases with Detective McQueen and Officer Dooley because, well, it’s their job - gotta earn the paycheck somehow.

- Perplexing Minigame puzzles : At least one per case because even McQueen and Dooley get union mandated breaks.

- Gorgeous Pixel Art: Nanny Dooley says it’s good enough to pin on her fridge.

- Music To Make Your Ears Happy: Based on popular new gaming fads, the game has music. This time from Clement Panchout (The Séance of Blake Manor and Clover Pit).

- Streamlined Interfaces: Simplified systems - pointing, clicking, minimal thinking - because life is hard enough already and we can’t code very well.

games.name: The Hambagu Shop
games.shortDescription: The Hambagu Shop is a cozy horror simulator where you work in a Japanese Hamburg Steak Shop. Cook Hamburg, serve customers, and upgrade your shop for more menu items.
games.aboutText:
The Hambagu Shop is a cozy horror simulator where you work in a Japanese Hamburg Steak Shop.

You play as Mari, who inherits her late grandfather’s Hamburg Shop, and she must learn to tend and care for the shop to keep the business thriving, no matter what the cost...

The Game Loop

Grill Hamburg patties, stack them on top of fragrant rice, and add additional toppings before serving this delicious Hamburg Ricebowl to your lovely customers.

As you grow your shop, you will unlock a variety of sides dishes and beverages, with increasingly complex recipes to satisfy the unique tastes of your regular customers.

Upgrading your shop

In order to run a successful business, you need to reinvest your profits into The Hambagu Shop to make even more money. That is probably the point of running a business anyway...

The Horror

It is not all sunshine and cozy vibes in The Hambagu Shop. While serving customers, you may see haunting visions in the shop which lead you to believe that the shop is haunted.

Fair warning: This game is not for the faint of heart. There will be creepy atmosphere, loud jumpscares, and an unsettling story that slowly unfolds.

Features

Gameplay: a simple yet engaging loop, grill hamburg, prepare side dishes and serve customers.

VHS Aesthetics: Experience the game through a creepy VHS filter that adds a nostalgic and eerie atmosphere.

Story: Uncover Mari's personal story as she works in a Japanese hamburg Steak shop

For Content Creators

You are free to create content from the game and monetize the gameplay by any means. There are no other restrictions from my side when playing the game

games.name: DJ Life Simulator: Learn to DJ for Real
games.shortDescription: Learn to DJ for real with a USB DJ controller or mouse and keyboard. Master beatmatching, EQ and effects in 26 interactive lessons, then rise from house parties to festival stages while a living crowd reacts to every mix you play.
games.aboutText:
About the Game

DJ Life Simulator is a DJ game that doesn't just let you play as a DJ: it teaches you how to become one for real, using the same techniques professional DJs use every night.

Play with mouse and keyboard, or plug in a compatible USB/MIDI DJ controller and mix on real hardware. Learn step by step in the Academy, then take your skills from house parties all the way to festival main stages, while a living crowd reacts to every transition you make.

Every mechanic was designed to work outside the game. Here, you don't just play: you learn, practice and grow as a real DJ.

Key Features

- 26 interactive lessons , from your first crossfader transition to mixing by ear with Sync off
- Career mode with 6 venues, 18 episodes and more than 100 missions
- A living crowd with music tastes, auras, fans and live comments about your set
- Real DJ controller support: Pioneer DJ (AlphaTheta) plug-and-play, plus Serato, Hercules, Numark and supported Traktor models
- 70+ included tracks from real independent artists, or import your own music and Rekordbox library
- Beat FX, filters, loops, harmonic mixing, gain control, headphone cue and more
- Online ranking , Steam Achievements and a shop to customize your DJ

Compatibility

DJ Life Simulator supports a wide range of MIDI-compatible DJ controllers.

Pioneer DJ (AlphaTheta) controllers work plug-and-play , with no configuration required. Controllers from Serato, Hercules, Numark, and supported Traktor models are also compatible and only require a one-time MIDI mapping.

Check the compatibility table below for the current list of tested devices. If your controller isn't listed, download the free demo and give it a try. If you need any help, our community on Discord is always happy to help.

Please note: Controller support keeps improving during Early Access. All core mixing features are supported, including headphone cue (pre-listening) . Some hardware-specific functions, such as Performance Pads , are still in development and will arrive in future updates.

Academy Mode: Learn for Real

Enter the DJ Academy and learn through 26 interactive lessons , split into Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced and Expert levels.

Learn about:

- Beats, bars and phrases
- Crossfader and volume fader transitions
- EQ and frequency control
- Gain and master volume control
- Filters
- Beat FX, including Echo and Reverb
- Harmonic mixing
- Loops
- Headphone cue
- Beatmatching by ear with Sync off
- Ending a set
- Track selection

All lessons are fully gamified and structured step by step, so complete beginners can start from zero while more advanced techniques are introduced gradually, like using Echo and Reverb Beat FX in transitions, build-ups, drops and set endings.

The game teaches you not only how to use these tools, but when to use them musically , rewarding proper timing and technique. Every skill you develop here is designed to transfer to real DJ equipment.

A DJ Setup That Evolves With You

You don't need to learn every control at once.

The DJ setup adapts to your current skill level : it starts with only the essential controls and unlocks new layouts as you progress, from Essential to Expert , adding EQs, loops, gain, filters and Beat FX along the way.

Career Mode: From House Parties to Festival Stages

Start by playing for your friends at a house party, land your first real gig at a smoking pub, and work your way through bigger and bigger clubs until you headline an open-air music festival.

Every venue brings its own episodes and real DJ problems to solve: drunk guests leaning on your gear, annoying song requests, a broken Sync button, a messy mixer left by the previous DJ, and even a festival with no waveforms where you'll have to beatmatch by ear.

Complete more than 100 missions , earn money, gain fans, unlock new gigs and build your reputation. Bigger events require better technique, better track selection and a stronger ability to read the dancefloor. The better you perform, the faster your career grows.

You will also face minigame challenges based on situations real DJs go through, training your attention and multitasking skills.

Performance Statistics

At the end of each set, get a detailed breakdown of your performance:

- Technique score and every trick you performed
- Completed missions
- Crowd reaction
- Technical mistakes
- Money and fame earned

You'll see exactly where you improved and where you still need to get better, so you grow with every set.

A Living Crowd: Learn to Read the Dancefloor

The crowd in DJ Life Simulator is not just a background animation. It is alive and it reacts to you.

Every person on the dancefloor has musical preferences, and you can spot them by the clothes they wear.

Play the right tracks to keep the energy high, experiment to win over different types of people, and learn how DJs read the dancefloor. The crowd's reaction reflects your technical and musical decisions through their dancing and their aura indicators.

And

games.name: Intersecta
games.shortDescription: "Intersecta" is an intense tactical top-down space combat game with a stylized sci-fi aesthetic. Devoid of humans, the game is set in another dimension where only cybernetic insects have evolved. The player takes control of an Intersecta fighter pilot hoping to survive an intergalactic invasion.
games.aboutText:
OVERVIEW>>>

Intersecta is an intense tactical top-down shooter with a distinct arcade feel. It blends fast, twitch-based gameplay with the intelligent use of tactics. With hand crafted 2D game artistry, FX and animations, the game has a unique audio-visual style, utilising the power of Unreal Engine 5 for a stunning 2.5D experience.

This is an indie game being solo developed by "11th Dan".

The full game will be released by the end of 2026 or early 2027. Please add to your Wishlist and spread the word.

A mosquito squadron in the hanger [from an animated cinematic]

STORYLINE>>>

There is a solar system, in another dimension, where insect life has evolved to be of the most intelligence. Humans know not of its existence, just as the insects know not of humans. Their paths will never cross… yet believe, that somewhere out there in the dark, there is a war going on. The insects have built machines, and vast colonies on several planets of a solar system if you can imagine.

The game setting begins as the hive planets are under threat from an invasion by the plague. The plague has amassed vast armies and fleets. “Intersecta” is the name of an elite fighter outfit and fleet that is thrown into action to intercept and intersect; to cut out any threat to the solar system. There are many pilots, but the player will only brush wings with some of them.

CHARACTERS>>>

You play as a cybernetic butterfly pilot named Intersecta One. A second player can join in as Intersecta Two, a moth character. There are more characters; NPCs that assist the player is several ways (as squadron wingmen, to drop power upgrades, to advise etc).

Intersecta One [from animated cinematic and in-game animation]

GAME PLAY>>>

The combat is 360 degrees. A core game mechanic is that the controls are based around 2 different flight modes with the ability to zoom out for longer range attacks and recon of the battle zone. "FREE FLIGHT" mode lets you fly in 360 degree space, whereas "RAID MODE" focuses your space ship to attack in one direction, with strafing... so you can concentrate on focusing an attack and evading fire more easily. Mastering the seamless transition between these two modes (with one stick click) will mean you become an ace.

The enemy AI was designed to be very organic, so each encounter is a unique experience.

GAME PLAY>>>

Between missions, you can customise your spaceship with 5 different fuselages and 5 types of wings, offering 25 unique configurations that alter your ship's speed, acceleration, handling, and armour. With 8 different colour schemes, there are 200 possible combinations to fine-tune your craft.

The game features three distinct weapon systems:

⦁ Laser: A standard forward-firing weapon. Requires the pilot to get in a position to shoot.

⦁ Swarm Laser: Can be aimed 360 degrees, can bend shot, and you can build up a swarm of lasers by altering their directions mid-flight and unleashing the swarm on the enemy.

⦁ Heavy Weapon: A powerful, chargeable weapon with three options that can be switched easily using the D-Pad: the energy ball, the fire and forget missile, and the electrical beam.

All weapons can be upgraded during a mission, giving the game a "rogue lite" element. Combat is a test of timing and skill, as weapons can jam if overused. You also have evasion moves and a temporary sphere shield to dodge attacks and protect your ship.

Mastering piloting your spaceship and using all the combat and defensive systems is key to survival.

A selection of the in-game spaceship sprites

GAME MODES>>>

There is an online stats system with scoreboards, and the final release will have the following:

⦁ Single player campaign (with local and online COOP).

⦁ Online Multiplayer (PvP and PvE).

⦁ Statistics galore (including scores, kills, deaths, K:D, weapon accuracy, hits and misses etc)

⦁ Achievements (unlock achievements during the game).

⦁ Objectives (mini challenges within levels that can be completed to get XP and rank up).

⦁ Game Difficulties to suit ability and challenge (Easy, Normal, Hard & Insane).

⦁ Training Zone - a 60 minute survival challenge.

SUPPORT DEVELOPMENT>>>

Please Wishlist the game and follow social media to support the development and get the latest updates.

games.name: Polly's Puzzle Box
games.shortDescription: As a small flea, explore a strange puzzle box full of secrets. Gather shapes and combine them to reveal hidden abilities. Polly is always watching… Can you escape?
games.aboutText:
In this handcrafted metroidBRAINIA , you find yourself trapped in a whimsical puzzle box shrouded in layers of mystery. Stalked by a giant parrot, you must collect shapes and other odd items with many secret powers that you discover along the way. Chart your own course through this world of childlike wonder, but be warned: Not everything is as it seems…

Uncover Layers of Secrets

- Explore a densely packed world with no distinct areas — Every room is different

- Use bizarre items — Craft tools like see-saws and boats from your arsenal of shapes

- Dig deeper into the box and unearth knowledge better left unknown

Learn the Rules of the Box

- Discover new ways to interact with the world that unlock the path forward

- Solve interconnected puzzles of all kinds — physics, spatial, perceptual, logic, and more…

Find Your Own Way Out

- Pursue a nonlinear path — encounter items and clues in a unique order

- Create your own solutions with clever use of your tools

You'll find lots around, if you'll just look and see.

games.name: What a Wonderful Venom World
games.shortDescription: "What a Wonderful Venom World" is a difficult survival sim. All food is poisoned, and you must find an antidote through endless trial and error. Face countless deaths and share info with other players to speed up your research. This game is for players who enjoy a serious challenge.
games.aboutText:
Humanity is on the brink of extinction. The food is all poisoned. Can you survive in this world?

It is a world of death, where all food for survival has been tainted with poison...

You will embark on a hopeless journey to save a dying humanity.

"What a Wonderful Venom World" is a high-difficulty simulation game where you must find a way to detoxify the unknown poisons to survive.

As you blindly search and experiment, you will face countless unreasonable deaths.

However, beyond that lies the only path to saving humanity.

What is required in this game is your wisdom and perseverance.

- Unreasonable deaths are a daily occurrence: In a world without right answers, you must relentlessly search for detoxification methods.

- Despair and hope at the end of trial and error: Each failure might lead to a new hint.

- Cooperation is key: By sharing seed values, you can exchange information with other players. You might find the collective wisdom to save all of humanity. It's also recommended to challenge it together on live streams.

This game is recommended for those who enjoy repeatedly challenging themselves, as you will face many unreasonable deaths.

Key Features

◆ Auto-Generated Maps

When you start the game, a map is automatically generated.

However, by setting a seed value , you can start on the same map, allowing you to challenge the same world over and over.

◆ Food Detoxification

Your settlement automatically gathers nearby food, but all food in this world is poisonous.

You must specify a detoxification method for the food to produce safe, edible supplies.

If people eat food that hasn't been detoxified, their lifespan will drastically decrease, and the settlement will perish faster.

◆ Settlement Movement

You can move your settlement.

However, food gathering stops during the move, so you should collect enough preserved food before you leave.

New lands may hold new types of food you've never seen before.

Having a variety of foods will also increase your settlement's happiness.

◆ Settlement Division

You can divide your settlement to create new ones.

Since there is a population cap for each settlement, expanding and dividing your settlements is key to increasing the number of humans.

◆ Hints Scattered Throughout the World

Your settlement may discover hints about detoxification during its journey.

Scouring the world will give you a chance to get closer to clearing the game.

◆ Cooperation with Other Players

This game requires a lot of trial and error.

Share your seed values and let other players help you uncover detoxification methods and explore the world.

◆Your Goal in this World

Your ultimate goal as a player is to increase your settlement's population to over 10,000 people .

Find detoxification methods for food, divide your settlements to increase the population, and save humanity from extinction.

games.name: Devoid
games.shortDescription: Devoid is an immersive journey into the medieval world of vampires who feed on human souls. You will have to put an end to their power with the help of sword and magic. Use an arsenal of tools and magical abilities on your way to defeat the most ancient evil.
games.aboutText:
Devoid is an immersive adventure for all fans of games like Dishonored, Thief, Gloomwood. Medieval cities are overrun, old kings are executed, and the surviving people are hiding in the slums - this marked the era of Vampires. Given a sword, shield, bow and other indispensable tools in battle, as well as magical powers, you will have to exterminate vampires, sneak behind their backs, solve puzzles for the sake of saving the human race.

The dark deity has endowed you with superpowers in return for depriving you of your soul, you will have to use them and various gadgets (bow, shield, magnetic tripwire, etc.)

Open combat is not terrible, because there is a reliable sword and different types of blows (light, heavy, falling, etc.)

Sneak around, distract enemies with various pick-up items, memorize their routes - all for the sake of a silent and quick elimination of the target.

games.name: Make The Dead Dead Again
games.shortDescription: Lux is dealing with a paranormal outbreak, and every loot drop could be a gun, a jacket or maybe a fresh dye job. She’ll prioritize accordingly. Clear the streets, then make her drop-dead gorgeous. Because the apocalypse is no excuse for a bad outfit.
games.aboutText:
Lux didn’t ask to have her DNA rewritten by a shadowy government agency, but since it’s done, she’s making it count. When a glitch hints that her missing mother might still be alive, Lux fights through the Redaction Commission’s undead army with guns, weaponized DNA and zero patience.

But loot doesn’t just mean bigger guns. Every fight unlocks clothing, hair, makeup, tattoos and more, so you decide exactly what “drop-dead gorgeous” means for Lux. Between missions, spend your spoils on furniture at Lux’s Place, hit the dancefloor at GeneSys, or farm more loot at The Grindhouse.

Try the free demo today.

games.name: Purrfect Collars
games.shortDescription: Purrfect Collars is a cozy single-player shopkeeping adventure. As a witch, design collars, enchant them with potions, manage your shop and meet interesting new customers! Each collar holds meaning, every cat a story!
games.aboutText:
Welcome to your witchy collar shop!

In this cozy pixel art game, you are the master craftsman behind the town’s most adorable cat collar shop. From the customer's order to the final delivery, every step is designed to be a relaxing experience.

Meet and get orders from a cast of colorful customers with emotional stories. Understand the bonds with their feline friends and see how a small accessory can make a big impact.

Create adorable collars for the customers’ cats. Turn your creative thought into reality with our intuitive drag-and-drop design table.

Brew potions to enchant collars . Different potions give cats different charms.

Pack your finished creations and deliver them to your waiting customers. Watch the joy on their faces as they see their beloved cats sporting your handcrafted masterpieces.

What “Purrfect Collars” offers

- Cozy atmosphere with soft pixel art, a pastel palette

- No timers, no high scores. The shop is very easy and relaxing to manage.

- A cast of customers with rich stories to explore

- Craft your own cat collars with loads of available designs

- Purchase recipes for potions, or mix up a storm using your own imagination!

games.name: Swarmdustry
games.shortDescription: Build a living factory and automate the Swarm. Harvest resources, construct mega factories, and grow a colony of specialized biomechanical bugs. Balance growth, efficiency, and creep spread before hostile robots squish you for trying to consume their world.
games.aboutText:
Swarmdustry is a factory building strategy game where you command the relentless evolution of the Swarm. Unlike machines of steel and wire, your production network is alive, fleshy and ever adapting. Hatch workers, harvest resources, carry energy, automate production, and weave sprawling colonies of organic industry.

Every structure, unit, and pathway you build is part of a living ecosystem. As your hive expands, you’ll unlock new genetic codes to accelerate growth, mutate workers into specialized types, and develop true automation.

But you’re not alone on this world. Enemy factions will challenge your expansion, striking at your hive. To survive, you must balance efficiency and ferocity while designing both production lines and defensive strategies that embody the hunger of the Swarm.

Will your hive wither under pressure, or spread across the planet like a living tide?

- Seed-based procedurally generated infinite map . You may enable or disable enemies, trees or even water. You may adjust enemy difficulty and scaling, the safe starting area, amount of trees and water, as well as the richness and frequency of resources.

- Build and grow your swarm . Mining and crafting manually can only get you so far. Build massive networks of trails and transit pads to deliver resources to your processors which come in different flavors.

- Manage your workers. Your industry will only work as long as it is manned by different swarm workers, such as Movers, Miners, Fireflies, Santchers, Acflies, Jumpers, and Drones. Each type of unit has its own single purpose to keep the swarm going.

- Distribute energy across the hive . Some swarm buildings require energy to function, while others require fuel such as coal and wood. Make sure fireflies deliver this energy to your buildings using the spire network that you will be designing carefully as they follow the path of least resistance.

- Unlock the full potential of the swarm . In order to evolve your swarm, you will have to unlock genetic codes at the Genetic Chamber. This will unlock much of industrial capacity of the hive.

- Automate building . Building a mega swarm base is possible thanks to Drones that will place buildings for you. You only have to copy and paste, and they will do the rest.

- Defend or attack . As your hive grows, so will the creep generated from your buildings will spread further and further. A robotic civilization living on the planet will form waves to attack your base. You must take care of them, or they will take care of you. Bloodflies and Feastlings may be used to overwhelm your foes. Remember, quantity over quality is the way of the swarm.

- Multi-threaded core gameplay loop . That's right. For fans of technical implementations, this game is designed to work not only on lower end machines, but also scale up the more cores your CPU has.

Add, remove or modify any recipe, building, unit and technology with integrated mod tools. Add your own basic or advanced scripts to run on top of the game's code easily. Modding Swarmdustry will feel very familiar if you've modded games before. You can upload to Steam workshop directly from within the game and even play with mods offline!

games.name: Iron Blight
games.shortDescription: Iron Blight is a survival horror game set in a cold, rainy Eastern Bloc town. You are trapped in a room as abominations claw at your door, with nowhere to run. You must survive the feverish night, uncover the horrors lurking in the shadows, and above all, find your wife, Valeria.
games.aboutText:
The world is dead. The state has collapsed. In a forgotten Eastern Bloc town, you are alone but not truly alone. Something stirs beyond the walls, and none of it means you well. You have only one reason to keep going: survive long enough to find your wife, Valeria. But in the cold and darkness of this unforgiving night, will you ever make it back to her?

In the hellish streets of this Eastern Bloc town, every bullet matters. There are ways to fight back, but survival demands more than firepower. Use the weapons at your disposal to clear a path, scavenge tools to overcome the obstacles ahead, and avoid unnecessary confrontations whenever you can.

Iron Blight aims to deliver an immersive gameplay experience built around atmosphere, vulnerability, and the crushing weight of isolation. Every bullet matters, and the sound of gunfire may draw even more horrors to your position. Even something as simple as opening a locked door demands thought. You must manage your food and medical supplies, move cautiously through the streets, and always consider what might be waiting around the next corner.

- True Survival Horror Gameplay: Navigate desolate streets and claustrophobic interiors, where danger lurks around every corner. Solve puzzles and face the terrors that will force a choice: fight, flee, or die.

- Resource Scarcity and Tension: Resources are scarce. Do you risk using your last bullet to take down a monster, or do you save it for a more critical moment and hope to slip past unnoticed?

- Diegetic Grid-Based Inventory: Every single item matters, and space is a luxury you can't afford. Carefully manage your limited inventory grid, making agonizing choices about what to carry and what to leave behind.

- No HUD, No Distractions: No health bars, no ammo counters, no intrusive menus. Every piece of information is conveyed through your character and the world around you. Your only interface is your own perception.

- A Unique Weapon System: Check your magazines manually, round by precious round, and reload with deliberate, step-by-step actions. Every firefight becomes a tense test of your nerves and skill.

- A Bleak and Oppressive Atmosphere: Rain-slick cobblestones and flickering fluorescent lights lead you deeper into a town that feels cold, hostile, and suffocating. The distant cries of things that should not exist echo through its desolate streets.

- A Return to Forgotten Horror Traditions: Fear comes from the atmosphere, the gnawing uncertainty, and the constant presence of death. The story is told through the environment itself, and combat is a slow, methodical dance where every shot matters.

games.name: Seres Universalis:Three Kingdoms
games.shortDescription: Return to the Three Kingdoms period. On the grand strategic tactical battlefield, use terrain for defense setup and resource allocation to shift the battle situation. Control the war via hexagonal grid movement and tactical ability activation, and unify the realm.
games.aboutText:
War

Counter the foe through the strengths and weaknesses of each troop type; break the deadlock with your generals’ battle arts; shatter ramparts with siege engines; seize advantage from forests, hills, and high ground. Spears check cavalry, cavalry breaks shields, shields hold against spears—each arm of the host restrains another. Bows command the distance, engines breach the walls, and every force has its appointed role. When rage reaches its height, battle arts are unleashed, allied skills converge, and peril may turn to deliverance. Forests sharpen the blow, walls soften the wound, and high ground looks down upon the field—victory lies not in numbers alone, but in how you read the enemy, master the terrain, and wield both orthodox and unorthodox strategy.

Generals

As mountains refuse no height and seas refuse no depth, so did the Duke of Zhou pause his meal to receive the worthy, winning the hearts under Heaven. In an age of chaos, those who win talent win power. Send envoys deep into distant mountains in search of hidden sages, or raise a Hall of Worthies and await the arrival of great minds. With the sincerity of three visits to the thatched cottage, even heroes from a thousand li away may enter your service. Command, Formation, Valor, Strategy, Governance, and Charisma each reveal a different gift; assign them well, and fierce generals will hold the line, master strategists will shape the plan, and virtuous officials will bring peace to the people.

Development

Store grain widely, raise walls high, and delay the claim of kingship. Promote farming and sericulture to fill the granaries, build storehouses against famine, strengthen city defenses against invasion, and establish laws to settle the people. Within each commandery city, coin, grain, population, and public sentiment sustain and restrain one another. Along the path of research, military affairs, livelihood, and governance advance side by side, letting you forge the singular character of your faction. Only those with deep foundations can march far without fear when rival lords contend—and move when the hour has come.

Romance

Complete different Romance branches and choose divergent event routes, so that three centuries of the late Han need not end as history decreed. The Oath of the Peach Garden, holding the Emperor to command the lords, the three-generation foundation of Jiangdong—each faction possesses exclusive events and unique rewards. Your grand strategy must shift with the changing tides, answering the storms of a fractured age. The Northern Expeditions may yet succeed; the capital may yet be restored. The regrets of old history may be rewritten by your hand.

games.name: How to Fish
games.shortDescription: A 1-4 player physics based fishing simulator. While drinking and boating you suddenly crash into a small island. To work your way back home you have to learn How to Fish.
games.aboutText:
A 1-4 player physics based fishing simulator. While drinking and boating you suddenly crash into a small island. To work your way back home you have to learn How to Fish.

Here is a gif:

What you do in the game:

- Fish fish, kill fish, sell fish

- Start off with no gear or weapons, earn money to buy better gear and weapons and stuff

- Complete quests and fight bosses to progress to new islands, where there are more dangerous creatures and better gear

- Try to collect the rare variant of all the different fish

- Hit trick shots for more money

- Gamble for even more money

games.name: Italian Pizza Simulator
games.shortDescription: Become a true pizzaiolo and bring joy to a small Italian village in Italian Pizza Simulator! Help bring back Grandma’s decrepit pizzeria to its former glory, surrounded by the sun-kissed hills of Tuscany, and serve colorful customers from all over the world!
games.aboutText:
Pizza is the key to happiness!

As a child, your village used to be as warm and vibrant as the surrounding Tuscan vineyards. Now, after years of absence, the key ingredient that bonded every villager is missing: the pizzeria. With your Grandmother gone, it is time for you to pick up the rolling pin and reignite the joy that lived in this small Tuscan village in Italian Pizza Simulator!

Prepare ingredients

Your pizzeria is prepared to stock every ingredient local to Tuscany that you may ever need to make pizza. The basement is cool enough to keep the ingredients fresh, while the kitchen has enough natural Tuscan light to maintain fresh herbs! Gather, cut, and chop the ingredients for your favorite toppings to make your favorite pizza.

Following the recipe

The kitchen has everything necessary to lead you through the process of making a pizza. Roll out your dough using the rolling pin, spread your sauce using a wooden spoon - every step needs your attention. Use Grandma’s original wood-fired pizza oven to bake the pizzas and package them in custom-made boxes to deliver to customers!

Meet and serve clients

Speaking of customers, your village is full of colorful characters that all want one thing: a good pizza. Becoming a more renowned pizzaiolo will attract even more people from beyond your immediate vicinity. Watch out, though – the more famous your skills are, the higher your customers' expectations will be!

games.name: Dungeon Antiqua 2
games.shortDescription: Relive the golden age of dungeon RPGs with Dungeon Antiqua 2! A retro 2D dungeon crawler bursting with SNES nostalgia. Hack, slash, and survive relentless side-view encounters! With 10 jobs and endless skill combos, forge the ultimate party and conquer the depths—if you dare!
games.aboutText:
Since then, countless moons have passed...
As people wove generations together,
she quietly continued to fulfill her duty.

But at last, the time came, and the silence was broken.
Old and weary, she gathered her last strength
and spread her wings to find out the hero...

About Dungeon Antiqua 2

Dungeon Antiqua 2 is a 2D dungeon hack-and-slash RPG featuring SNES-style pixel art and sound.
A retro-flavored adventure awaits you, blending strategic exploration with a highly flexible character building system.

§ Exploration

Players will explore six dungeons , navigating with a unique system where visibility of corridors and enemies depends on the character’s “vision" .
Dungeon Antiqua 2 uses a symbol encounter system —you can avoid battles by dodging enemies, or strike first and take the initiative. The path forward is yours to carve through skill and decision-making!

§ System

In addition to the eight jobs from the previous game, two new classes—Monk and Archer— have been added, bringing the total to ten .
Earn skill points from victorious battles; once they reach the required threshold, you’ll unlock job-specific skills .
Since changing jobs does not reset level , you can freely experiment with multiple jobs to create your own ultimate party!

note: Five jobs are available at the start of the game. The remaining five types will become available as you progress through the game.

§ Concept

Sometimes, why not take a step back and return to the cartridge era of gaming ?
By stripping away excessive story cutscenes and focusing on short, simple dialogue and text, the world is designed to spark your imagination—inviting you to create your own personal adventure.

§ Playtime

For a first playthrough, we estimate a playtime of approximately 10-12 hours.

Dungeon Antiqua

This game takes place hundreds of years after the story of Dungeon Antiqua.
You may even come across some familiar characters from the previous game…

Transferring Save Data from the Demo to the Full Version

Save data from the demo can be transferred to the full version.

On standard PCs (Windows/Mac), the save data files themselves are shared. Therefore, if you launch the full version after playing the demo, you can continue playing from where you left off in the demo.

For certain environments like Steam Deck, after launching the game, select “Inherit Data” > “Backup Save data” from the menu in the upper-right corner. Choose the data from after clearing the trial version to obtain a 6-digit code. Then, in the full version, select “Inherit Data” > “Restore Save data” and enter the obtained 6-digit code to transfer the save data.

Playing on Handheld Devices

Your download also includes an executable file for certain handheld consoles (see the official website for details).
From Settings > Manage > Browse Local Files , locate dungeon-antiqua2.pyxapp and transfer it to your device.

games.name: Dating 4 Girls
games.shortDescription: On the night of the comet, you unexpectedly enter a dating game, where three characters—Mona, Feifei, and Jiayi—are real. Mistaken for a criminal by policewoman Andy, you must find true love before the server shuts down, while a conspiracy quietly unfolds.
games.aboutText:
" Heartbroken Player " is a live action interactive video game. As a "cow and horse" in the company, on the night when the comet arrived, you unexpectedly traveled into a love game. In order to return to the real world before shutting down in seven days, you must complete the "love" task assigned by Police Flower Andy. You thought you were in love with the game characters you created, Mona, Feifei, and Heyi, so easy! However, they repeatedly encountered obstacles. With the help of your best friend Arlo, you step back into the world of girls and discover that the attributes you set at will have a huge impact on their lives. With deeper contact, you finally understand that 'although the characters are virtual, the love between you is real'. In the end, under your influence, the girls unexpectedly broke through the system settings and developed self-awareness. You decided to work together to prevent the game server from shutting down!

Please make your choice carefully!!!

Because every choice you make not only determines whether you can return to the real world, but also has an impact on the consciousness of the girls in the game. Whether to let them continue their NPC life step by step, or to awaken their consciousness and bravely say NO, the choice is yours!

1.Sexy and Hot Star - Mona

2.Cute and Soft Nurse - Feifei

3.Gentle and Intellectual Teacher - Jiayi

4.The Heroic and Brave Police Flower - Andy

Immersive experience

Filmed in ultra-high definition with a first-person perspective, it evokes a strong sense of romance.

"A play within a play"

This story adopts a "game within a game" plot structure. The world is fictional, but my love for you is real.

"Talking about the day after tomorrow"

The post-marriage plot module, independent of the main storyline, makes love not just end!

Skinning system

Independent changing module, with a plethora of exquisite designs, waiting for you to experience the real-life changing!

Throughout our journey, our hearts are filled with gratitude towards all our player partners. Thank you for your support. Without you, we could not have continued.

So far, we have launched " Secrets of the Heartbeat " and " Heartbeat in Thailand ". This work, " Dating 4 Girls ", is our third independently launched interactive video game.

Along this journey, every purchase, comment, dissemination, and discussion from every player is a tremendous support and help to us.

Our first video game, " Secrets of the Heartbeat ", was born in the early days of romantic video games. Now, looking back, it's inevitably rough and rudimentary. Through the comments from players, we have drawn nourishment and energy, striving to do better in our next work.

Our second independent work, " Heartbeat in Thailand ", has made significant progress compared to " Secrets of the Heartbeat " in various aspects. We have introduced post-game discussions and a costume change module. " Heartbeat in Thailand " has gained more players' love and attention, and we have received more support and criticism. We continue to communicate with players in the community and various places, and we want to go further.

Now, our third independent work, " Dating 4 Girls ", has been launched. As a full-process team, we strive to be a little better in every aspect compared to our previous works: a little better in plot, a little longer in story, a little better in lighting, a little better in shooting, a little better in costume and makeup, a little better in UI system, a little better in special effects, a little better in optimization... All these improvements are inseparable from the help of our partners and many friends in the film and game production team. All our efforts are aimed at satisfying our players and making them feel that playing our game is worthwhile.

We hope you enjoy our new game, " Dating 4 Girls ", and thank you for your support.

games.name: Titanic: Honor & Glory
games.shortDescription: Explore the entire Titanic inside and out, from the hull and promenades to every saloon, boiler room, and cabin in a rich and detailed 3D environment with the highest level of accuracy possible, situated beneath our virtual Arrol Gantry in our digital shipyard.
games.aboutText:
Titanic: Honor & Glory aims to recreate the entire Titanic inside and out, from the hull and promenades to every saloon, boiler room, and cabin. The ship will be fully explorable in a rich and detailed 3D environment with the highest level of accuracy possible. This recreation is situated beneath our virtual Arrol Gantry in our digital shipyard. The end goal for this project, as it has always been, is to recreate the Titanic in its entirety.

The THG Alpha is being constructed!

We have been working on a way to allow our fans, supporters, and enthusiasts to explore our Titanic recreation as it's being built. In a continuation of the vision we had for THG back in 2021, but in a way that's more appropriate for the way we're building the ship and the stage this process is at, the Titanic: Honor & Glory Alpha will be set in the shipyard in Belfast! Explore our virtual Titanic as we build it, in the gantry, in a recreation of the yard where it all came to be! And the best part? You'll be able to do so for free !

What are some things you'll be able to see and do in this Alpha?

Visit the Titanic as she was built, with the ability to walk her unfinished decks and climb around the structure. As we continue to develop the ship, we'll add more elements in future updates, letting players experience it firsthand.

Hop over to the Main Offices (in their 1912/1913 form), including the two famous drawing rooms. Here you can see plans in the drawing rooms or visit areas like the cozy Consultation Room, where you'll find information on THG and our process for building the ship.

Check out places like the Platers' Shed and the Cabinet Shop, facilities that were used to prepare the ship's steel plating and build furnishings. These areas will display structural elements and other large objects relevant to the ship, as well as smaller fittings and furnishings, serving as museum-like spaces for players to learn more about various aspects of Titanic and see what we're working on long before it's put on the ship.

Set the time of day to your liking! Day mode, night mode– ANY time you want!

Change the weather to whatever suits you, from rain and snow to foggy, cloudy, or clear days! Run around Titanic's towering structure as it snows, or relax and soak up the vibes on a rainy day at the shipyard.

Experience a world alive with the men who built Titanic ! Builders and foremen walking about and working on the ship, designers in the offices!

games.name: Fall of the Final Age
games.shortDescription: Take command of the last Stronghold of humanity, fighting back against the advancing monsters. Decide where to prioritize the forces of your Heroes, as the number of turns before the invasion is limited. A turn-based tactical strategy with RPG and roguelike elements.
games.aboutText:
Fall of the Final Age is a turn-based tactical strategy game with RPG and roguelike elements, in which you control the Stronghold, the last human settlement, in a world crumbling under the onslaught of monsters advancing from the Wildlands. Manage the Stronghold's resources wisely, as the yield is limited for a small settlement. Decide where to focus the efforts of your Heroes, as the number of turns before the monsters invade is limited. Develop the Stronghold, create new Heroes, expand your territory to harvest new resources, and prepare for the inevitable enemy attack. Prove yourself worthy of being the governor of the last Stronghold of humanity!

The game consists of a global map and battles . On the global map, you manage your Stronghold, building, crafting, scouting, and preparing Heroes for battle. Here, you decide where and when to conduct battles and which Heroes to send. When engaging an enemy, the game switches to the battle map, where the battle unfolds as a turn-based tactical confrontation.

The Wild Lands in the east of the continent have long been inhabited by creatures of terrifying power . The human kingdoms to the west avoided any contact with these territories. But something happened in the East, leading to a mass migration of monsters to the West. Monsters who saw humans only as food. Humanity was unprepared to face such a powerful enemy, and so all known civilization was destroyed in just a few months.

In one of the last human settlements, an inhuman alchemist , with the support of the governor of these lands, conducted vile experiments to imbue humans with the power and speed of monsters. These experiments became humanity's new hope in the battle against the unstoppable force of the creatures from the Wild Lands.

Capture, build, and craft to strengthen your Stronghold:

- Destroy enemies who have occupied valuable resource extraction sites. Hold these points to ensure a steady supply of resources.

- Construct new buildings in your settlement to obtain more resources and unlock the ability to craft new items.

- Craft to create new equipment, weapons, and consumables for your Heroes.

Create, develop, and equip Heroes:

- Create Heroes by entrusting settlement residents to the Mad Alchemist. Adjust the necessary qualities of new recruits using various combinations of mutagens and potions.

- Created Heroes have fixed basic attributes, but their skills develop through the use of relevant actions. Arm a fighter with a sword, and they will soon become a master swordsman; equip them with a bow, and they will learn to shoot without missing. If they survive that long.

- Heroes are endowed with their own talents, each with a greater propensity to develop certain skills. Each fighter also has a set of unique traits: they might be cowards, or, conversely, fly into a frenzy at the sight of blood.

- Each weapon has its own set of skills and is best suited to certain tasks. Arm groups of Heroes so they complement each other in battle.

Win in turn-based tactical battles:

- Plan your actions and adapt to changes: each character's actions are limited by their Action Points and Energy, and the sequence of their turns is determined by their Initiative stat.

- Enemies, like your Heroes, have their own strengths and weaknesses that you must identify and exploit. Different opponents require different approaches in combat: some are blessed with remarkable strength, some are clad in armor, and still others are incredibly resilient.

- Keep an eye on your characters' Morale. Both Heroes under your control and most enemies have it. A decrease in Morale results in a penalty to most combat stats, and a drop to zero will result in panic and loss of control .

- Surround your enemies and don't let them surround you. Attacking from the flanks or behind can overcome skill imbalances.

Defend the Stronghold and try to hold out until the final battle:

- The game consists of several stages , during which you must prepare for an assault on the Stronghold at the end of each.

- The game is designed for high difficulty . Defeat in battle is not the end of the game, but defeat in a battle during an invasion of the Stronghold ends the game. Be prepared to lose and be forced to restart until you find the optimal development paths and the most effective combat tactics.

games.name: Monster Alchemy
games.shortDescription: Create unique creatures, use them to gather rare resources, and fuse them into even more powerful beings! This RPG combines classic exploration with a deep crafting system where your monsters are your ultimate tool for looting, combat, and discovery.
games.aboutText:
Create unique creatures, use them to gather rare resources, and fuse them into even more powerful beings! This RPG combines classic exploration with a deep crafting system where your monsters are your ultimate tool for looting, combat, and discovery.

DON'T CATCH, CREATE

Forget catching monsters in the wild. Synthesize them from scratch! Combine ingredients, discover new recipes, and bring your unique visions to life. What will you create?

YOUR MONSTERS ARE YOUR TOOLS

Your creatures are multi-purpose tools. Send them to mine ore, chop wood, or craft potions for you. They level up their gathering skills, making them more efficient.

FUSE YOUR MONSTERS

The alchemy doesn't stop at creation. Fuse your monsters together to create bizarre, powerful, and entirely new species. Discover hidden recipes to unlock every possible combination and create the ultimate team.

TACTICAL TURN-BASED COMBAT

Engage in strategic battles where victory relies on smart team composition and synergy. Master a type system of elemental strengths and weaknesses, and unleash powerful attacks by cleverly pairing your monsters' abilities. Every monster you create is a new tactical piece for your arsenal.

A WORLD TO EXPLORE

Journey through diverse, hand-crafted environments, from sunny beaches to haunted graveyards, each filled with secrets to find, resources to gather, and charismatic characters to befriend (or battle).

A HEARTFUL ADVENTURE

Uncover a world-shaping lore where the lines between gods, monsters, and alchemists blur. Discover the ancient myths of creation, the forgotten deities who first forged life from essence, and the hidden truth behind the art of alchemy itself.

This project is the culmination of a lifelong passion for monster-taming adventures and deep, satisfying crafting systems, finally brought to life.

games.name: Car Rental Simulator: Prologue - Early Days
games.shortDescription: Free introduction to the full Car Rental Simulator game puts you behind the desk of a small-town rental office in Winston Springs. Manage customers, grow your fleet, and deal with surprises along the way
games.aboutText:
Car Rental Simulator Early Days is a free prologue to the full Car Rental Simulator game.

Do you remember Little Sam from Car Dealer Simulator? His son, Lazy Luke, received some unsold cars from his father and a few bucks to start a new business. Unfortunately, the owner lacks the skills to run it. This is your chance to prove your abilities.

Tailor your rental offer to the needs of Winston Springs residents and visitors. Take care of punctuality, vehicle cleanliness, and positive reviews that will attract new customers.

Be careful, as some orders will require you to modify cars for special occasions.

Also, remember that not all customers return vehicles clean and in good condition, so be prepared for cleaning and minor repairs.

Over time, increase the number and types of cars and other vehicles, invest in promotions, as well as employees and new buildings. A rich offer and a well-maintained company will attract more customers.
