Car Rental Simulator is an engaging business simulation with a realistic economic model. It allows you to grow a company, manage a fleet, and interact with customers.

Start your journey in the car rental world and turn Lazy Luke's business into the most magnificent rental service in Winston Springs.

games.name: DEATHLOOP 4 YOU
games.shortDescription: A university student, Hayato Ichijo, is trapped. In an endless prison of death.
games.aboutText:
July 22nd, 22:00.

Hayato's life is taken by an unknown assailant.

Using his "Return by Death" ability to escape this fatal destiny, he hunts down the mysterious figure who keeps killing him.

And Hayato will come to learn...

...for whose sake this endless loop of death was created.

▼ Game Features

A story-driven, first-person horror game.

A mystery where you repeat a death loop to uncover the truth behind the incident and the enigmatic figure who relentlessly murders the protagonist.

Various trials and errors utilizing the death loop:

What happens if you run far away?

What happens if you hide in the wardrobe?

What happens if you get a gun and fight back?

What happens if you doubt your friends?

What happens if you kill everyone around the house?

Three endings + an alternate ending.

▼ Playtime

Approx. 5-9 hours (depending on playstyle).

▼ Streaming and SNS Posting Guidelines

Individuals and corporations alike may stream this game without prior permission.

Monetization is permitted only through the functions provided by the video streaming platform.

We would appreciate it if you include the game's title in your video or stream title, and include a link to the Steam page in the description.

Furthermore, we assume no responsibility for any damages incurred as a result of streaming this game.

games.name: 请你把赤色的星星织成殓尸的丧布
games.shortDescription: This is a forgotten tale that took place in a now-extinct country.
games.aboutText:
Story Summary:

This is a forgotten tale that took place in a now-extinct country.

Game Introduction:

This game is a historical-themed 1v1 BG visual novel mainly aimed at female players (female-oriented), set in the Soviet Union from the late 1970s to the 1990s, featuring one narrative line and a total of 5 endings.

The game's narrative is primarily from the perspective of the female protagonist, with secondary perspectives from other characters.

Your choices will determine the fate and ending of the characters.

Important Notes:

1. This work is purely fictional and has no connection with any real people, events, groups, or organizations.

2. Contains mild blood or frightening scenes.

3. Demo playtime is about 1 hour, with 12 CGs. The full version playtime is about 2-3 hours, with 5 endings and 26 CGs (including 1 completion reward CG).

4. The game does not contain any sexual content; the tags are unrelated to the author.

Plot-Related Notes:

1. The protagonists have non-traditional personalities.

2. Contains a considerable degree of extreme settings and plot elements.

3. This game is made solely by the author and is wholly a personal project, so no expectations should be held.

4. If there are elements you dislike, please close the game immediately without further comment.

5. Your support is the author's motivation to continue creating!

games.name: Tad-Bubble!
games.shortDescription: Tad-Bubble is a boss rush shoot ‘em up for the Game Boy Color! Fight off waves of dangerous boss bugs, boss fish, and boss more in this brand-new retro experience.
games.aboutText:
Boss battles await on the Game Boy Color!

Tad-Bubble is a boss rush shoot ‘em up for the Game Boy Color! Fight off waves of dangerous boss bugs, boss fish, and boss more in this brand-new retro experience.

Experience a fresh take on that retro feel.

Tad-Bubble is a love letter to old-school handheld gaming, designed for quick pick-up-and-play sessions. Use the power of your Miracle Bubble to face off against 50+ unique bosses and try to make it all the way to the end, where your final challenge awaits…

Don’t underestimate these critters!

The journey to the end will be tough, but every setback comes with valuable experience! The more bosses you face, the more you’ll find your skills improving. You’ll get to heal up between fights, but be careful; your supply of healing items is limited!

Features:

- More than 50 unique bosses , each with their own patterns and quirks!

- Collect pages for your Bestiary as you face new bosses! Try to get them all!

- Records! How quickly can you get to the end? Try to beat your own score!

- Unlockable Infinite mode! Test your mettle against never-ending waves of bosses!

- Built-in music player to listen to an all-original chiptune soundtrack!

- A true retro experience, Tad-Bubble runs on real Game Boy Color hardware!

- Secret bosses…?!

games.name: Element TD 3 - Tower Defense
games.shortDescription: Element TD 3 takes the tradition of combining powerful elements for unique towers and adds heroes. Infinitely replayable and endless, this is a Tower Defense that blends classic gameplay with modern additions. Play with up to 8 players cooperatively or competitively.
games.aboutText:
Element TD was originally released in 2005 on WarCraft 3. Across the subsequent versions on StarCraft 2, Dota 2, Android/iOS, and Element TD 2 we've always aimed to add new things but stay true to the feel of the original. With the addition of heroes, Element TD 3 represents the capstone of the series.

Elements Assemble

You have six elements to combine that create 47 towers each with a unique ability. Because your towers are tied to your elements and their level, the choice you face is unlocking more types of towers versus higher levels for your existing ones. If you choose the latter and max out a tower, you unlock specializations for it. These allow you to change the nature and role of the tower.

Each element has its own strengths and weaknesses, so your choosing the right upgrade paths is crucial to winning. It's not just which towers you unlock and how far you upgrade them, what order you do it in matters too. The rock-paper-scissors nature of elemental damage means that you need a variety of towers to adapt and survive.

This is a game with an abundance of options for winning.

Heroes Arrive

Your Builder returns in Element TD 3 with a brand-new role: Hero. A longtime staple of the series, your Builder now enters the fray as a fully playable Hero for you. Stepping out from behind the construction hammer, your builder now wields new attacks, spell casts, and accumulated passives.

Choose between 12 Heroes with each wielding unique attacks and abilities. You also have a randomized additional pool of 60 spells tied to the elements to select from. As you gain and upgrade elements, you gain and upgrade spells for your hero from this pool. The end result is many different ways to play each hero.

Don't want to micromanage your spells? Stick them on smart autocast! Let your Hero cast spells on its own with optimal timing based on the situation.

Dynamic Battlefield

Every few waves the global weather randomly changes. It brings elemental boosts that you can synergize with. It also brings a unique elemental boss for you to kill. The creep wave order you face is also random. All of this allows for a true endless end game with variety. No two games play the same unless you want them to...

You can choose to set a custom random seed when you play. This seed controls the weather, the creep waves, and the abilities that you get to select from. You have control over the randomness in the game.

Cooperate to Survive

Play with up to 8 players to synergize your elemental choices, tower placements, and hero usage. Each of the 8 co-op maps has a recurring unique scenario that encourages your team to come together to overcome the challenge. Leaderboards allow you to see how your team stacks up to others.

Battle or Go Solo

There is also a ruthless game of survival for you to play. Try to outlast your opponents in the long run by turtling for income or go in hard and fast to rush them to their death. There are 10 free-for-all maps to compete on. Solo leaderboard play allows you to compete in singleplayer.

Features

- 47 Towers with unique abilities created through multiple elemental upgrade paths.

- 12 Heroes with distinct active and passive abilities.

- 60 elemental spells to select from.

- 6 Elements to empower your towers to create powerful diverse defenses.

- 10 Free-For-All and 8 Co-op maps to test your tactics on diverse layouts.

- Co-op mode lets up to 8 players team up at once.

- Leaderboards to compete against other players for top score.

- Replay support to showcase your victories and learn strategies from others.

games.name: Chronoscript: The Endless End
games.shortDescription: “Chronoscript: The Endless End” is an exploration-based action-adventure game where you, an editor trapped within a manuscript, must unravel a thousand-year story that writes itself beyond its end—across 2D pages and a 3D manor.
games.aboutText:
A thousand years of words… waiting for your final mark.

"Chronoscript: The Endless End" is an exploration-based action-adventure game where you, as an editor trapped within a manuscript, are to unravel the mystery of a thousand-year story that writes itself beyond its end.

◆ Prologue

The year is AD 2026.

After finally bringing his long-running series to an end, a certain Editor receives a mysterious summons from a new Author.

He makes his way to the Author's grand residence, sequestered deep in the mountains. There, he is bitten by a mosquito and instantly loses consciousness.

When he wakes, he finds himself trapped within The Endless End, a manuscript penned by the Vampire Mistress of the estate.

◆ Discover "Chronoscript: The Endless End"

Chronoscript: The Endless End is an innovative, exploration-based action-adventure game comprised of two worlds: a 3D rendered grand residence littered with thousands of manuscript pages, and the 2D pen-and-ink illustrated worlds within them.

Face off against the Ruined, twisted remnants of those who lost their lives in the waking world. Grow stronger through exploration and battle, and immerse yourself in the winding narrative of the Immortal Vampire and her Editor.

A unique approach to spatial perspective awaits you.

◆ Hard-hitting action

Inspired by the tough, action-packed combat of classic 2D platformers. Experience a dynamic combat system as you submerge in pools of ink, unlock unique abilities through exploration and combat, and feel yourself evolve as the game progresses.

◆ Eradicate the Ruined

Souls who met gruesome deaths in life have been resurrected and now stand in your way as twisted, corrupted versions of their past selves. Defeat them to unravel the tragic threads of their fate.

◆ Traverse the Many Eras Depicted within the Manuscript

The Vampire Author has lived for a millennium, and within her manuscript pages unfold stories she's recorded through time from all over the world.

◆ Intricate artwork

The story's protagonist, enemies, and backdrops are all hand-drawn with pen and ink. The frame-by-frame animation style gives them an eerie sense of life.

◆ Dramatis Personae

・ The Vampire: Viola S Chambers

An author cursed with immortality, she has been writing The Endless End for a millennium. Having lived for so many centuries, and undertaken so many stories, she has lost sight of the end.

Now, she calls upon our Editor in hopes that he will be able to uphold his ancestor's promise and finish the tale.

・ The Editor: Frederick G Muller

A taciturn editor who has brought many a long-running publication to a concise finish. After answering a summons to a secluded grand estate from a new author, he becomes trapped within the thousands of pages of her manuscript.

He must now dive deep to make sense of each bewildering story, while also attending to the Author's anguish and loneliness to bring The Endless End to its conclusion.

◆ Developer: DeskWorks Inc.

DeskWorks Inc. is a small development team specializing in unique art styles and gameplay experiences. With a deep love for and understanding of exploration-based action-adventure games as players, they now bring their best ideas to the genre as developers.

◆ Designer: Mari Shimazaki

Character designer for Bayonetta (1, 2 & 3), as well as Okami. Also the primary designer for the anime Princession Orchestra.

◆ Composer: Yasunori Mitsuda

Composer, arranger, and producer of Chrono Trigger, Chrono Cross, Xenogears, and titles from the Xenoblade Chronicles series.

Born on January 21, 1972, he joined Square (now known as Square Enix) in 1992, and made his musical debut with the game Chrono Trigger in 1995. After acting as the lead composer on Xenogears, he left the company in 1998 and became an independent creator. He worked as a freelancer for many years, then formed his own company, Procyon Studio, in 2001.

Now he creates scores for all kinds of media genres including television, film, anime, and games. He also composes for several well-known musicians, and has garnered experience as an album producer, assisting in organizing live performances and official recordings within Japan and abroad. He is also a published writer, and pursues many different projects outside of the musical scene.

His body of works more comprehensively includes Xenosaga Episode I: Der Wille zur Macht, Soma Bringer, Kid Icarus: Uprising, Soul Sacrifice Delta, the Inazuma Eleven series (1-3, GO, GO2: Chrono Stone, GO: Galaxy, Balance of Ares, and Orion no Kokuin), the Black Butler series (Book of Circus, Book of Murder, and Book of the Atlantic), Final Fantasy XV: Episode Ignis, Irina: The Vampire Cosmonaut, Soul Covenant, Delicious in Dungeon, and many more.

Our esteemed guest creators have fully joined forces with the team, giving their all towards development.

games.name: Cat Isle
games.shortDescription: Catch a train to Cat Isle! In this cozy pixel art management game, build restaurants, expand and decorate the town. Figure out your cats needs as they dine, shop, explore and turn the island into their purfect home.
games.aboutText:
Cat Isle is a cozy pixel art management game inspired by Japan’s famous Cat Islands. You’ll build and expand a tiny train platform island in the middle of the sea, turning it into lively town for cats.

Manage shops

Running a town full of curious cats takes careful observation. While some cats seek out fresh sashimi, others are happiest with tea and a nap in the sun. As the island's caretaker, it’s your job to figure out who wants what and create the perfect mix and balance of shop supplies.

Unlock decorations with the Gashapon

Spin the decoration Gashapon machine to unlock cute new decorations for your island. Each capsule gives you a little surprise from cozy plants to charming shop ornaments. Collect your favorites and slowly fill your town with personality and warmth.

Decorate your town

Each building is a chance to get creative. Add plants, lights and decorations to suit both your vision and your cats personalities. Every small detail matters, adding warmth to the town and helping your shops thrive.

Vibe and chill

Also, remember to slow down and enjoy the world you’ve built. Watch the cats explore, play, and relax. Sometimes, just observing is the sweetest reward.

Key features

- 4 levels with unique goals and themes

- 100+ Decorations(hand drawn pixel art)

- Sandbox mode

- Custom Decorations

- 17 unique buildings

- 2-4 hours of gameplay

games.name: Lost Wiki: Kozlovka
games.shortDescription: Explore a wikipedia-like database and solve a small town mystery in Eastern Europe. Step into the shoes of a journalist in the 90s as you sprawl through articles and uncover the secrets that have been laid in front of you.
games.aboutText:
Step into the shoes of a journalist as you uncover a mystery of a small town in Eastern Europe. Deduce and complete puzzles as you explore and uncover more articles in a sprawling wikipedia-like database.

Connect the dots of these interconnected web of articles. Use your skills of deduction to figure out the mystery and report back to your anonymous source. By completing puzzles, you’ve already gained knowledge for your next conundrum.

Something is wrong with the town you’re investigating. Flags continue to show as you delve deeper into their database. Figure out the connections, and the story will be laid bare.

games.name: Dressmaker
games.shortDescription: Become a dressmaker! Choose fabric, cut out pattern pieces and sew them all together to make the dresses of your dreams - in this cozy crafting game, inspired by real dressmaking.
games.aboutText:
Choose fabric, arrange and cut out patterns, sew garments and add decorations. Dressmaker is a cozy simulation game where every part of making a dress is under your control.

Whether your pattern is aligned to the grain or cut on bias, how you choose to arrange and cut out your fabric is what appears on the final dress. Take full control over what fabric to use for each panel of your garment.

Feed your fabric through the sewing machine to stitch it together.

Decorate your dress with buttons, bows and appliqué. Add lace trims and other accessories wherever you like with complete creative freedom.

Meet a whole town of people hoping to fill their wardrobes with custom-made dresses tailored specially to important events and their individual tastes. Create dresses to impress them, or display your own designs in your shop window and sell pre-made dresses off of the rack.

- Buy from a wide range of fabrics, including cotton, linen, wool, silk and velvet.

- Design and colour your dress in your sketchbook, adding fabric samples and appliqué.

- Arrange and cut out your dress pattern, preview them on a mannequin and sew them together.

- Turn in your dresses to your customers to gain both reputation and coin.

- Pet the kitty.

games.name: Pizzapocalypse: A Slice of Hope
games.shortDescription: Use your pizza to bounce, swing and dash in this 3D platformer! Explore different countries, and put a stop to the greedy corporation selling Pizza-in-a-can!
games.aboutText:
Pizzapocalypse: A Slice of Hope is an old-school 3D platformer with a modern take, and a pizza moveset that's fun for all skill levels! Use your trusty pizza to bounce, dash, parachute & swing your way through many beautiful countries !

PizzaCorp, lead by its greedy CEO, has forcefully taken over the world with its soulless product: Pizza-In-A-Can .

They play dirty, bending the law and eliminating competition, enforcing their rule by deploying their robot P.A.L.S , who are a lot more dangerous than they might seem!

After having his restaurant shut down by the Corp, Chef Basilio restores hope to the world on his travels!

Play your own way . Whether it's collecting everything, mastering your moves to improve times, or finding secrets !

Whether you enjoy exploring at your own pace, or mastering your abilities, you'll find something to sink your teeth into!

The cities you explore are full of secrets! Explore and collect special toppings to unlock new outfits & pizzas !
On his journey, Basilio may even find a comfortable bench to fall asleep on , where you'll gain access to a dream bonus level in his mind!

(The game formerly known as Pizzapocalypse 2)

games.name: Monk Took Book
games.shortDescription: A game about organizing, stacking and remembering where you put hundreds of books in a cozy-creepy medieval library. Play solo or with up to three fellow monks.
games.aboutText:
Welcome, Novice, to Holy Island, home to the greatest monastic library of the Dark Ages! You are tasked with running this revered place of learning, and completing our Legendary Collection...

Every morning new books are delivered, each bearing a distinct symbol upon their cover. Remember them well! Then place them upon shelves according to thine own design.

Cometh the night, you must deliver the Scribes their chosen tomes. Recall where thy books are placed, for this is a test of thine memory!

The Abbot shall reward thy toils with Blessings. Spend them on Perkes to Level Up thy Strength, Speed and Carpentry skill. Or expand the Collection by raising new and lofty shelves or unlocking new chambers.

After dark, vermin, spirits and all manner of beasts shall assail thy Collection. Take up thy dagger, crossbow or holy cross to preserve thy labours. Then use the quill to restore any damaged books. Note that thou can reduce or disable thy foes if a more chilled experience is desired.

Immerse thyself in a host of systems-based emergent gameplay, including simulated flame and combustion, water dousing by pail, the chaotic physics of tumbling and thrown books, a day and night cycle, ballistic weapons and melee combat.

Revel in a myriad of features and Quality of Life benefits with thy brethren:

- Explore a hand-crafted monastic library

- Carry books in great stacks or throw them vast distances

- Play first or third person

- Arachnophobia mode

- Up to four players

- Granular difficulty options: reduce, increase or disable some or all enemies

- Control book rates for a more chill experience

- Proximity voice chat

- Public and private lobby

- Steam invites

- Copy/paste lobby join codes

- In game text chat

- Full key rebinding

- Manual and autosave

- FoV slider

- Headbob slider

- Gamma slider

- Window or fullscreen mode

- Widescreen support

- Delight in the harmony of ordered shelves, the quiet rustle of parchment and the mirth of shared labour!

games.name: Temple Siege TD
games.shortDescription: Relaxing 3D fantasy tower defense game with an RPG/MOBA vibe: Hero-towers, distinct roles, unique abilities, powerful combos and rising challenge.
games.aboutText:
A casual and relaxing 3D fantasy tower defense game with an RPG/MOBA vibe where towers are Heroes. Each hero has a distinct role and unique abilities which in combination builds a strong defense squad. As enemies evolve and adapt, the challenge constantly increases.

Abilities Combos

- Combine abilities to create powerful synergies

- Control crowds, amplify damage, and turn the tide at critical moments

The more you experiment, the stronger your strategies become.

Enemy Waves

Enemies come in varied formations and escalate quickly.

- Multiple enemy types pressure different defenses

- Late waves demand constant attention and fast reactions

Surviving is about adaptation, not just numbers.

Enemies Fight Back

On later levels, enemies adapt to your defenses .

- Blocking paths can provoke direct attacks

- Defensive turtling is no longer safe

- You must balance offense, positioning, and risk

Standing still is not an option.

Continuous New Levels & Heroes (Post-Launch Support)

I’ll keep the world growing after release with regular content updates —including new levels , new Heroes and new strategic combinations to master.

games.name: Cafe Business Manager
games.shortDescription: Build, design and manage your own café in this detailed cafe management simulator. Hire staff, craft your menu, serve customers and grow your coffee shop business in a lively island city.
games.aboutText:
Build and manage your dream café!

Cafe Business Manager isn’t just a business simulation — it’s a deep life experience. Start from scratch in the heart of the island, hire your staff, train them, and set fair salaries.

Make your café unique with your decoration choices, shape your menu based on your customers’ preferences, and grow your business through smart daily decisions.

Each happy customer, wise investment, and good employee relationship brings you closer to becoming the island’s top café owner.

Discover your employees’ skills and help them grow.

Their motivation changes based on salary, work hours, and workload — assign tasks wisely and plan your team strategically.

Assign single or multiple roles: take orders, serve, clean tables, wash dishes, or organize the counter.

Manage effectively to maximize your café’s efficiency.

Design your café from scratch and fully customize it.

Choose from tables, chairs, coffee machines, ovens, and decorative items to create a unique space.

Add new floors, build a terrace, and expand your land to craft your dream café.

Show your style in every detail and impress your customers!

Explore the island freely and quickly restock your café’s needs.

Use express drone deliveries or drive your pickup to shop personally, stock shelves, and assign staff to handle supplies.

Every shopping trip brings deals and surprises — plan strategically and strengthen your café!

Create time-based menus and make sure orders are taken quickly and accurately.

Optimize food quality, temperature, and service time.

Offer both takeaway and table service experiences.

Handle sudden rushes of customers efficiently.

Take loans, set repayment terms, manage interest rates, and develop your own financial strategy.

Build a storage room, organize boxes on shelves, and access needed items instantly to speed up operations.

games.name: Sweatpants Savior: Worlds Beyond
games.shortDescription: Shipwrecked in Antarctica, survivors cross the frozen glaciers and step beyond an ice wall into the boundless Great Thousand Worlds. A sandbox RPG centered on exploration and experimentation, featuring deeper systems, a vastly expanded world, and long-term progression shaped by player choice.
games.aboutText:
Ming, the biggest loser of his graduating class, finds himself stranded in Antarctica after a disastrous ten-year class reunion trip. Beyond a towering ice wall lies an extraordinary new world where he finally has a shot at coming out on top.

Sweatpants Savior is an open-world isekai RPG where you decide who to become, how to grow stronger, and what to do with your newfound freedom.

- Open World Freedom: Explore freely, uncover hidden treasures, and complete over 100 side quests without being bound to a linear storyline.

- Hero or Villain: Shape your own morality and influence how the world responds to you.

- Eight Major Factions: Study magic, master lightning arts, join religious orders, or forge your own path as an independent adventurer.

- Randomized Loot: Discover thousands of unique items, hundreds of equipment affixes, legendary artifacts, and rune combinations.

- Seven-Tier Progression: Choose between quick and perfected breakthroughs, each with different long-term benefits.

- Flexible Builds: Mix and match combat techniques, breathing styles, and passive abilities to develop your own playstyle.

- Crafting and Professions: Collect recipes and blueprints to craft equipment, potions, food, and more.

- Search, Fight, Loot, Extract: Hunt for valuable loot and decide how far you're willing to push your luck.

- Fishing, Farming, and Housing: Reel in unexpected treasures, cultivate rare crops, and purchase your own home.

- Random Encounters: Discover rare beasts, powerful wanderers, and treasure-filled monsters.

- AFK Grinding: Grind actively or progress while you're away. Come back anytime to collect your rewards.

With countless builds, randomized loot, and secrets to uncover, no two adventures have to be alike.

Before downloading or launching the game, please temporarily disable antivirus or security software. Some programs may mistakenly quarantine the launcher, which can prevent the game from starting.

If the launcher is blocked or quarantined, open your security software, restore the file to its original location, add it to the trusted or allowed list, then relaunch the game with the antivirus disabled.

If your antivirus flags the file greenworks-win32.node , please mark it as trusted or temporarily disable the software . This file is required for communication with Steam services , including achievements and DLC functionality . Other mainstream antivirus programs do not report issues with this file.

Due to the large number of items, characters, and skills, the game may take 1–3 minutes to load on first launch. Please be patient during the initial loading process.

games.name: WORLD WAR V: LAST CALL
games.shortDescription: Lighthearted comic war action! Battle across voxel and pixel worlds to stop the V Empire’s ambition. Break terrain, uncover items, and face unique bosses. Behind the cute visuals lies a truly challenging game waiting for you!
games.aboutText:
World Overview

A lighthearted, comic take on war action!
In a world shifting between voxel battlefields and retro pixel scenes, stop the ambition of the V Empire!

Characters & Story

From the boastful Colonel Freak, to the sadistically charming Sophia, and the determined yet innocent Rena—
every character brings their own flavor. Their quirky personalities create a funny and entertaining scenario that keeps you hooked stage after stage.

Gameplay Features

Destroy terrain, uncover hidden items, and carve shortcuts across a voxelized battlefield.
Face off against varied enemy patterns and unforgettable bosses that test your skills.
Behind the cute visuals hides a seriously challenging difficulty !

Technical Features

Powered by our proprietary Voxel Perfect™ system, experience optimized voxel action that blends comic humor with explosive gameplay.

Demo Available

Try out the demo now and play up to Stage 2 . Please note that some content may differ in the final release.

About the Creator

HORANG is best known as the webtoon creator behind chilling works like Ok-su Station Ghost and Bongcheon-dong Ghost . But long before becoming famous as a storyteller, he had already lived as a web developer, tool maker, and game creator .

This unique blend of experiences fuels WORLD WAR V: Last Call . The game carries the playful comedy of his storytelling, the sharp visual timing of his webtoons, and the technical ingenuity of a self-made developer.

games.name: Amazon Warrior
games.shortDescription: A Puzzle with Bossfights! Join Tayana and save the Amazon exploring amazing Scenarios, Enemies and Bosses! An Evil is haunting the heart of the Amazon! Among breathtaking landscapes, forge powerful alliances and unleash divine powers to survive deadly trials and shape the fate of the forest.
games.aboutText:
A Puzzle game with Boss Fights. 🌱🐢

The Amazon is being threatened and you need to save it! Join Tayana, an Amazon Warrior with a lot of strength and The Enchanted to help her!

FIGHT BIG BOSSES!

TRANSLATIONS

Amazon Warrior supports English, Spanish and Portuguese! You can select them in game's menu.
Translations coming: Nheengatu (One of the thousands of indigenous languages of the Amazon)

DIVE INTO AN ENGAGING STORY!

Beyond the puzzles, Amazon Warrior features a linear storyline filled with powerful twists and unforgettable characters!

PLAY USING ONLY ARROW KEYS / WASD!

Looking for easy-to-play yet hard-to-master challenges? Amazon Warrior has been tested as accessible even for children as young as 8, but completing it will be a true trial of skill!

SAVE THE LAND OF THE AMAZONS!

Join Tayana, a strong Ykamiaba warrior, against the terrifying Nightmare Demon that plagues the land.

They are the original South American "Amazons" that named the River.

A TRULY AMAZONIAN GAME, MADE BY AMAZONIANS!

games.name: Ecopunk
games.shortDescription: Ecopunk is a survival and colony management simulation game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Balance survival, resource management, and hope as you guide your colony through the ruins of civilization.
games.aboutText:
Civilization has fallen.

Mutants and rogue machines roam the wasteland, carrying on the chaos that destroyed the old world.

But from the ashes, a new force rises: the Ecopunks.

United. Determined. Ready to heal the Earth… and crush anything that stands in their way.

SURVIVE OR DIE

Hunger. Disease. Scorching heat. Freezing cold.

The wasteland forgives no one.

Grow crops, hunt, and forage to keep your people alive.

Cure deadly illnesses—if you can find the right remedies.

Fight back against the elements with heating, cooling, and solid shelter.

Survival isn’t guaranteed. Prove you deserve it.

BUILD. CRAFT. THRIVE.

From ruins, build a future. From nothing, create a home.

Free-form building: design your colony tile by tile—walls, defenses, homes, the works.

Eight professions: cooking, tailoring, medicine, weapon-making… master them all.

Climate control: fireplaces, AC, insulation—keep the heat and cold at bay.

Comfort counts: furniture, rugs, plants—give your people a place worth living in.

THE MOTHER TREE

She is ancient. She is powerful. She is your only hope.

Plant ancient seeds to bring life back to the wasteland.

Sacrifice fallen enemies to earn her blessings.

Heal the climate, revive ecosystems, and unlock her full power.

The greener the world, the stronger you become.

FIGHT FOR YOUR FUTURE

The wasteland belongs to no one—until you take it.

Face mutants and rogue machines in deadly encounters.

Raid enemy camps for resources. Defend your own with everything you’ve got.

Arm your Ecopunks with one-shot pistols, heavy shotguns, armor—and whatever else you can craft.

RESEARCH & EVOLVE

Brains win wars too. Unlock new tech, craft better weapons, and make your colony unbreakable.

games.name: Escape: Immersion
games.shortDescription: Escape: Immersion is a cinematic 2.5D horror adventure set inside a collapsing underwater military base. Explore flooded corridors, solve environmental puzzles, evade deadly traps, and uncover your past.
games.aboutText:
You wake up in a collapsing underwater military base. You don’t know who you are, or why you’re here. The only thing you do know — time is running out.

Steel creaks. Water breaks in. Shadows move in the dark corridors. Every corner hides danger, and every decision can be your last.

In Escape: Immersion , survival is about reacting fast, adapting, and pushing forward. The environment is unpredictable, the threats are real, and your past will haunt you.

- Classic linear adventure game
- Unique VHS-styled visuals create an unfriendly, oppressive atmosphere
- Intense gameplay full of dynamic and unpredictable events
- Every mistake can be fatal — danger lurks at every step
- A variety of situations and countless ways they can unfold
- The base is almost completely absorbed by the ocean. Discover the secret of your past and try to escape before it’s too late
- Water is not your worst enemy. Darkness hides more than you can imagine

games.name: Mimix
games.shortDescription: Create equipment through synthesis and break out to face incoming heroes in this strategic roguelike auto-battler. With limited actions, choose and combine materials to build the optimal loadout. Battles are fully automatic, making preparation the key to victory.
games.aboutText:
Mimix is a strategic roguelike auto-battler where you create equipment through synthesis and break out to fight against incoming heroes.
Battles are fully automatic, and the decisions you make during preparation directly determine victory or defeat.

Game Flow

The game progresses in a cycle of Preparation Phase → Battle Phase .

Preparation Phase (limited actions)

Using the mysterious Mimic, you can perform the following actions:

- Break out : Split items into multiple materials

- Synthesis : Combine materials to create new items

- Monster Creation : Combine materials to summon monsters, defeat them, and obtain new items

- Equip : Set weapons, armor, and accessories to strengthen your forces

Within limited actions, plan the optimal equipment setup to prepare for the next battle.

Battle Phase

- One-on-one duels against heroes (fully automated)

- The equipment and strategy prepared beforehand decide the outcome

- Victory grants rewards and leads back to the Preparation Phase

World

After being defeated by the heroes, the Demon Lord escapes and discovers a dungeon inhabited by a mysterious Mimic.
By harnessing its power to forge equipment, you must defeat the heroes who relentlessly pursue you.

games.name: Box of Broken Nails
games.shortDescription: First-person psychological horror about ignorance and attempts. Protect yourself as a lone carpenter, hastily look for materials in your house to board up a door that shouldn’t exist. At any cost.
games.aboutText:
Protect yourself as long as you must in Box of Broken Nails - a surreal horror experience.

Use your hammer and nails to board up an unknown door with something breaking out. Find resources around your house and nail down planks in time. Don't let it open. No matter what.

There is only this one note, it reads:

"Since I started living here alone, the nights felt endless. I barely remember if my halls have been this way before. Lately I hear the sounds of my work from behind the walls. The plates are shattering over and over again. I’m just making things up again, am I not? There was never anything wrong with...
And even if, it changes nothing — what matters is that I simply must continue and make, make…
...Make it go away."

Game features

- No text notes, no audio logs. The story unfolds through the gameplay itself and what it evokes in you.

- A stressful game loop that changes over time.

- An unexpected turn of events.

- Only one outcome.

Box of Broken Nails contains flashing lights, strong camera shaking, and intentional visual distortion effects. Please use caution if you are affected by flashing or rapidly moving visuals.

games.name: Loss Prevention
games.shortDescription: Loss Prevention is a social deduction game where you can shoplift your local grocery store with up to five friends. Experience the joy of petty crime as a shoplifter, or keep your eyes peeled for suspicious activity as the shopkeeper. Can you grab all the items on the shopping list?
games.aboutText:
Roles

The Shopkeeper

Snuff out any shoplifters in the store. That means paying attention to anyone stashing items, listening to announcements from the security office, and just keeping your eyes peeled for suspicious activity.

Shoplifters

Work with your team to steal all the items on their shopping list before time runs out, all while trying to blend in with NPC shoppers.

Key Features

Blend in

Shoplifters must balance between blending in and moving fast but be careful—NPCs can alert the shopkeeper if they notice anything suspicious.

PA System & Sabotage

The store intercom periodically alerts the shopkeeper to suspicious shoppers. Shoplifters can temporarily sabotage the system by tampering with microphones.

Jail Break

If shoplifters are caught by the keeper, they can be freed by fellow teammates, but they must decide between completing the list or risk being caught trying to free their teammates.

K.O.

Watch the corners or risk getting a can of peas in your face. Both teams have their own weapons up their sleeves.

games.name: Echoes of Tomorrow
games.shortDescription: A post-apocalyptic action RPG where you play a banished cleric, falsely accused of the divine disease. Wield a robotic relic able to restore lost ruins and technology, face challenging combat and make consequential choices to expose the theocracy's lies, seeking a truth that may cost you everything.
games.aboutText:
Echoes of Tomorrow is an action RPG that blends intense, skill-based combat with survival and choice-driven mechanics. Aiming to bring greater depth to the modern post-apocalyptic adventures by grounding it in deep character conflict, moral ambiguity, and a unique world-restoration system designed to reward curiosity and challenge player assumptions around morality.

Venture into a detailed, unforgiving world where constant environmental exposure and scarce resources demand strategic management. Survival means more than just fighting; you must use crafted items to stave off sickness and rely on scattered campfires for sanctuary. Engage in combat against a mix of organic and cybernetic monsters, where some foes are reluctant and can be spared, forcing you to think before you strike.

Your journey is guided by Key2, an ancient robotic relic from the world before the collapse. Utilise Key2 to scan, reveal lore and restore lost ruins and technology using salvaged Crystals. This temporary restoration is key to solving puzzles, accessing pathways, and deploying powerful attacks from Key2—but these special actions deplete its energy, forcing you to choose when and where to use them.

As an amnesiac, banished cleric falsely accused of the Divine Disease, you are thrust into a society split between those who enjoy sanctuary and those who face monstrous ruin. As your memory returns, will you shatter the theocracy's illusion that maintains a fragile order, or protect the lives built upon a powerful lie?

Your companion Key2's loyalty to the lost, advanced society of the past leads it to judge current inhabitants as inferior, setting up constant moral debates that shape your actions and the world's outcome.

games.name: Laica
games.shortDescription: Live with Laica, a mysterious girl alone aboard a drifting space station, and explore the nightmare spreading beneath your quiet days together. A first-person sci-fi adventure that fuses survival horror with a slow-burn relationship. Is what waits ahead love, or despair?
games.aboutText:
Laica is a first-person survival horror adventure in which you live with Laica, a mysterious girl aboard a space station, explore a world of darkness where grotesque beings roam, and carry her story forward.

You wake up in HOME, a habitat drifting in space. There you meet Laica, a girl living there entirely on her own.

Share meals. Listen to music. Go on little adventures. Sometimes float together through zero gravity, just the two of you.

But beneath that calm, something is silently eating away at space itself. Return from the dangerous world of darkness and spend another ordinary day with Laica.

The more you cross between the two worlds, the more the strangeness seeps into the quiet life you share. A world that rots and loses its shape. Creatures that prowl the dark.

And in time, Laica herself begins to be consumed. Who is she?

What happened out here? And why are you here at all? Build your bond with Laica and reach the truth hidden in the darkness of space. Features

- Life in space with Laica
Live day to day with Laica aboard HOME. Talk, go out together, share small idle moments. Through countless little events, your distance from a girl who has only ever known solitude slowly begins to change.

- A loop between daily life and horror
Two parts of completely different character repeat: quiet cohabitation at HOME, and exploration of dangerous spaces where creatures wander. Explore, return, spend time with Laica. The story moves forward with each cycle.

- 3D exploration of a transformed station
A facility that once held human lives has been warped into something alien by an unknown force. Search the ruins, gather items, and press deeper while facing the creatures within.

- An everyday life that erodes, little by little
HOME was supposed to be the one place you could always return to. As you explore, the anomalies begin to surface in HOME, and in your life with Laica.

- An ending shaped by your choices
At the end of your exploration, the truth about Laica and this world comes into view. What you believe, and what you choose, leads to how this story ends.

games.name: Xenosensory
games.shortDescription: Xenosensory is a short incremental game with horror themes. Use your cursor to bust Xenos and save convicts then spend your research points on skill tree upgrades, actions, gadgets, and uncover the true horrifying nature of this space station nightmare.
games.aboutText:
~ Deep in the distant future, a primary space prison was attacked by unknown lifeforms. There were gruesome and terrifying reports. Monstrous Xeno forms stalk walkways, ripping apart or abducting the humans they can find. Bizarre and baffling Anomalies are also being reported. What nightmare is unfolding... ~

About

Xenosensory is a short incremental game that takes places on a space station prison and involves otherworldly themes of horror. You are tasked with aiding the convict evacuation by busting various predatory Xenos lifeforms and dealing with bizarre Anomalies along the way. Also.. apples...?

Gameplay

Sit back and simply hover your cursor over the Xenos to automatically bust them for Research Points and help the convicts reach the evacuation point. Spend meta points to gain perks, actions, gadgets, and other unlocks that add extra gameplay elements. Discover lore logs that reveal the true horrifying nature of this space station prison nightmare as well as the secrets to end it all for good.

Features

- Accessible: Simply hover the cursor over the Xenos threats which are then automatically busted for you.

- Incremental: Game rounds are short and at times frenetic where you earn different Meta Points to spend.

- Upgrade Tree: After each round spend your Meta Points on a variety of perks and gameplay additions.

- Grind Difficulty: Customise the amount of Xenos busting point grinding needed for the various Meta unlocks.

- Actions: Assign special actions to your buttons to be strategically used for best effects.

- Gadgets: Find gadgets that offer special boosts to tailor your play style but beware as you can only equip so many.

- Sectors: Progress through a variety of Sectors each with their own layouts, special Xenoforms, and Anomalies.

- A.I Pong: Sit back and idle away as the unlockable A.I. Pong mini-game nets in the meta points for you.

- Story: Along the way you'll unravel the nightmarish secrets of the prison station.

- Randomiser Mode: Unlock a special mode that fully randomises the Meta Tree and level mechanics.

- Apples: Find the secret apples!

games.name: Model Kit Studio
games.shortDescription: A rich and relaxing model-building simulator. Enjoy the meditative flow, meet fellow builders, and unwind to a soothing soundtrack as you build, pose, paint, and display your collection.
games.aboutText:
Your brother Alex, a renowned model builder, is on a work trip, and you’re looking after his plants. His place, however, happens to be a model builder’s paradise, and you’ve been left with all the tools to assemble, customise, and photograph your very own mecha model collection!

Ding dong , a delivery person hands you a package... A model robot with a note signed A.

What are you waiting for? Grab those sprues and get cutting!

- Realistic Model Making - Cut, file, and assemble your mecha step by step.

- Deep Customisation - Paint by hand with brushes or an airbrush. Add decals for extra detail.

- Photo Studio - Immortalise your mechas. Pose, create dioramas, and share your creations.

- Immersive Environment - Freely explore the loft studio and uncover a story.

- Original Models - Enjoy original mecha models explicitly designed for Model Kit Studio.

Follow the interactive instructions as you cut, file, assemble, and customise your mecha piece by piece. MKS offers a simple, realistic, intuitive, and richly crafted experience.

Open the manual and slip into a flow state as you craft and vibe to the music. Before you know it, your collection has grown even bigger.

Explore the environment and uncover a story that stems from the passion for model-building. Meet four intriguing characters – Ysé, Noémie, Dante and Kenji – who will immerse you in a world of enthusiasts.

Paint, pose, and photograph your models, then share them with the community. Be inspired by how others have customised their models.

We think you'll love Model Kit Studio if you enjoy...

Model Builder, Mech Builder, Last Call BBS, Unpacking, Warhammer, House Flipper 2, Hozy, House Builder, MakeRoom, Tiny Glade, PC Building Simulator

games.name: Syncblade
games.shortDescription: A rhythm game where you can play any song thanks to our advanced music analysis system, or create and share custom levels with players around the world. Play as Akemi, a unique samurai girl, and slash through waves of Zombeats to the beat of the music you love.
games.aboutText:
A rhythm game where you can play any song thanks to our advanced music analysis system, or create and share custom levels with players around the world. Play as Akemi, a unique samurai girl, and slash through waves of Zombeats to the beat of the music you love.

Play any song in seconds

Import your favorite tracks and jump straight into the action. Syncblade’s advanced music analysis system automatically generates enemies, events, and visual effects based on each song’s rhythm, intensity, and structure, turning every track into a unique challenge.

Multiple difficulty variations are created for every song, making it easy for both newcomers and experienced players to find the perfect level of challenge.

Battle hordes of enemies to the beat

The Zombeats move in perfect sync with the music. Strike at the right moment to maintain your combo, rack up points, and master the rhythm.

Whether you're chasing high scores or simply enjoying your favorite songs, every track becomes a unique experience as you step into the role of the mysterious samurai Akemi.

Simple controls

All you need are two simple inputs, one or more keys for individual enemies and one or more keys for enemies arranged in rings. You can choose whichever key configuration feels most comfortable for you. The challenge is to follow the music without having to wrestle with complicated controls. Let yourself get carried away by the rhythm and focus on the groove. You’ll face a wide variety of enemies, each with unique effects and mechanics that keep the gameplay fresh and engaging.

Create and share custom levels

Build entirely original levels using the integrated editor. Place enemies, design attack patterns, add visual effects, and craft unique experiences to share with the community through Steam Workshop.

Experience the original soundtrack

In addition to player-imported songs, Syncblade features a selection of handcrafted levels built around the game's original soundtrack.

Customize your experience

Choose your difficulty, arena, and visual effects. Add song lyrics, customize Akemi’s appearance, and modify enemy visuals to make every session your own.

Unlock new cosmetics

Play, discover new music, and earn rewards that unlock cosmetic items and customization options for your future runs.

Compete

Challenge other players' ghosts in ranked matches, improve your rank and climb the online leaderboards.

And much more!

Syncblade is coming soon. Add it to your wishlist and stay tuned for future updates.

games.name: CorgiSpace
games.shortDescription: CorgiSpace is a collection of 8-bit games that have short legs on purpose. This anthology includes more than a dozen action, adventure, arcade, and puzzle games, and each can be thoroughly explored in under an hour.
games.aboutText:
You are now entering CorgiSpace, where all the games have short legs on purpose. This collection by Adam 'Atomic' Saltsman includes more than a dozen action, adventure, arcade, and puzzle games, and each can be thoroughly explored in under an hour.

In CorgiSpace, you can play games like:

- Kuiper Cargo - a run-based puzzle game where the right upgrades make all the difference as you deliver cargo and raise your guild rank.

- Cave of Cards - a mini rogue-like where you have to clear a cave full of killer mushrooms by setting off bombs and making new resources from poker hands.

- Mole Mole - a sokoban puzzle with a twist (the twist is bombs).

- Dino Sort - A new logic puzzle where every dinosaur has to be in just the right spot. For example, some dinosaurs need to be next to their favorite food (plants) while others have to be near their favorite food (dinosaurs).

- Rat Dreams - a top-down souls-like with no walking, only dodge rolls.

CorgiSpace collects a year of original games full of new ideas, strange reveals, and unexpected delights, plus developer diaries about how each game was made. Some of the games can even save your progress. No secret stuff, though. Welcome to CorgiSpace!

Features

- Breaking out of jail (a lot)

- Being a pug

- Stabbing nazis

- Falling off stuff

- Terraforming a planet

- Drinking various popes

- Mushroom farming

games.name: Breezy Bakes Simulator
games.shortDescription: Run your own seaside Italian bakery, craft pizzas and breads, and enjoy, fun with up to 4 players online!
games.aboutText:
Step into the warm and bustling world of a seaside Italian bakery in this cooperative online simulation game! Whether you’re a master baker or just starting out, the oven is waiting for you.

Choose from a variety of pizzas and breads and start cooking. Make your dough. Fire up your oven. And delight your customers.

Have fun alone or with up to four friends. Divide tasks appropriately with your friends. Manage your bakery.

Perform thorough product inspections. If you can't deliver the product your customer wants on time, they'll be unhappy and leave. Buy the right products in the right quantity.

Are you ready to roll the dough, fire up the ovens, and create the ultimate seaside Italian bakery experience? Gather your friends, start baking, and serve up some delicious chaos!

games.name: 饲养染的30 DAYS
games.shortDescription: A story, a wish Everything seems to be nothing unusualBut realizing a wish always comes at a cost. The visual novel 『饲养染的30DAYS』will present you with a 'normal' ending. Find your 'puzzle' in story .
games.aboutText:
A story, a wish

Everything seems just ordinary

But fulfilling a wish always comes with a price

Yet we enjoy dreaming dreams that we don't want to awaken from in our daily lives

But this time'I' hope to bring 'you' home

The visual novel [饲养染的30DAYS] will bring an ordinary story.

Welcome to your play and valuable feedback.

『Game Introduction』

Every day, tormented by illness, you encounter her in an alley.

She says her name is RaN, and she wants to spend a few days in your home.

For some reason, you agree to her request.

You know that 30 days is long for her, yet also very short.

Sometimes you wish this was just a dream.

Sometimes you wish this was something truly real.

What is real? What is fake?

Does it really... matter?

Do you really have to make a "choice"?

『Character』

染 RaN

Preferences: Milk

Dislikes: Bright lights, Canned fish

"How are you?"

Transformed from a kitten into a human

The peculiarities about her go unnoticed by othersShe seems to know everything about you;

she always hopes you can live a more normal life

30 days is a long time for her

She has waited for you for too long...

塔斯 TARS

A companion who calls themselves 'pointer'

Only appears after DAY 20

She will bring you more chances to rewrite the ending

『Have you really forgotten me?』

『Even RaN have forgotten me??』

Staff List:

Character Art/UI Artist: 赤橙chio

Voice Actor CV (RaN/TARS): 恪诀

Copywriting/Programming: XiAoRaN_Channel

Public Assets CC0/CC-BY:

甘茶の音楽工房(Music)

みんちりえ (Backgrounds)

永远的空之女王 (Bubble UI)

Renpy Official Demo (Paper UI)

花间莉萝 (Code Reference)

Sincere thanks to all the creators ww

A few notes:

As an independent game, there are still many shortcomings in this visual novel, and the sparse CG images and illustrations will be followed up later.

As an independent game, this game follows the CC0/CC-BY license, and the sources of the materials have been credited within the game.

Special thanks to the character illustrator ChiOrange and the Bilibili uploader HuanJianLiLuo, as well as Ren'Py tutorials from the forever Queen of the Sky.

Thanks also to all members who participated in the game testing.

Thank you for playing this work.

Sincerely,

XiAoRaN

games.name: Normis Simulator
games.shortDescription: Playing as Normis, you are a typical representative of the mainstream with a traditional stable life, ironically referring to youth subcultures, avoiding conflicts and extreme actions, preferring routine and social adaptation.
games.aboutText:
Playing as Normis, you act as a typical representative of the mainstream — a person without any special subcultural or social extremes. Your special feature — this is the most "ordinary", stable and traditional life, which creates a contrast with the more radical youth movements and subcultures that you will encounter.

The main features of the game for Normis:

- You have to find a girl for your friend, after talking with a dozen applicants

- Solve the riddles of informals

- Go back to 2007 and deal with the Goths and punks

- Take off your rose-colored glasses and look at reality from the other side

- Immerse yourself in old and modern memes

- Defeat the developer of this game :-)

- Attitudes towards youth movements. You will have to come face to face with various pop cultures and come out victorious or prove that you don't wear the proud name Normis for nothing.

- Psychological stability and social adaptation. You find yourself in the brutal reality of the street, which you have to overcome.

- Game style. The game features various memes with an ironic approach to life, as well as various references.

Playing for Normis — It is an immersion in the role of a person who tries to maintain common sense and order in a world filled with a variety of youth movements, while maintaining sarcasm and irony as a tool for perception and interaction with the "mess" around him.

games.name: Orbit Run
games.shortDescription: Orbit Run is an arcade sci-fi game with roguelike elements, in which orbiting asteroids are your only weapons. Catch asteroids and combine them to unlock their run-altering abilities. Skillfully manoeuvre to dodge attacks and land massive asteroid strikes to defeat the ever-increasing waves of foes.
games.aboutText:
Orbit Run is an arcade sci-fi game with roguelike elements, in which you don’t shoot your enemies, but crush them with the asteroids that orbit you.

Use your ship’s magnet to pull asteroids into your orbit.

Masterfully navigate to smash through waves of enemies while skillfully dodging their attacks.

Fuse three base asteroid types into powerful new variants, each with special abilities that can reshape your fighting style.

Chart a path through three procedurally generated star systems, each with branching routes and hazards to overcome.

Upgrade your ship’s systems, strengthen your magnet, and manage asteroids that act as weapons, shields, and currency all at once.

Grow stronger to stand a chance against the final system’s boss encounter.

Features

Procedurally generated runs — every star system layout, route, and encounter is new.

Asteroid fusion system — unlock 3 tiers of recipes, creating hundreds of asteroid variants with special abilities.

5 star types — each system comes with unique modifiers like solar flares and asteroid storms.

23 enemies total — including 15 enemy types, 5 minibosses, and 3 bosses with distinct attack and movement patterns.

games.name: Chronigma
games.shortDescription: Master time in this time-bending sokoban-like puzzle game with a story. You travel back in time to be in two places at once, to solve puzzles impossible to complete alone. Your success hinges on your ability to collaborate with yourself. Can you learn to manipulate time to save humanity?
games.aboutText:
Who is this made for: Gamers who like taking their time to enjoy time manipulation sokoban-like puzzles with a text narrative story. The game starts out with traditional sokoban mechanics and then introduces the time manipulation mechanics at Level 6 (around 20 minutes into the game).

Story: They called it the Time War. A conflict where humanity's greatest achievement, time travel, became its tombstone. Born into a silent world, you are Cygnus, and your father, Kronos, has dedicated his life to one purpose: your training. This puzzle adventure is a series of his lessons (puzzles), each one a challenging test of your ability to manipulate time.

Game: This is a single-player, story-rich (text narrative), time-bending puzzle game. You use time travel to be in two places at once to solve increasingly complex puzzles. With the Chronigma device, you are never truly alone. You record your actions, travel back in time, and team up with your "Past Self" to solve puzzles impossible for a single person. Your success hinges on your ability to collaborate with yourself.

Controller Support: Chronigma supports Xbox, PlayStation, and Switch controllers natively, so no setup needed and Steam Input should be OFF. If you experience controller input not working, double inputs or wrong button icons, try disabling Steam Input (Library → Chronigma → Properties → Controller → "Disable Steam Input") and restart the game.

Key Features

- Completely free game. We built this game as a family hobby, fueled by our passion for Time Travel, Sci-Fi, Escape Rooms, and Puzzles, to be completely free from day one.

- Time Manipulation Puzzle Game: This is a sokoban-like puzzle game and is meant for those that enjoy time manipulation puzzles.

- Team Up With Yourself: Record your actions and collaborate with your own
"Past Self" to overcome obstacles no single person could.

- A Journey Through Time: Explore 60+ of handcrafted levels, from simple logic problems to multi-layered temporal challenges. Providing over 4 hours of mind-bending puzzle gameplay.

- Play the Game Your Way: Stuck on a tricky paradox? Get a nudge in the right direction with in-game help, or skip a level to come back to it later. You can also unlock all levels to explore the game at your own pace. And if you are not interested in text narrative stories, you can choose the Minimal Story mode.

- A Story of Hope at the End of Time: Uncover the secrets of the Time War and the heavy burden shared between a father and son, training to save a world they've never known.

- Bonus Challenge: For the truly dedicated, seek out and conquer difficult levels that will test your mastery of time to its absolute limit.

games.name: Tape Man
games.shortDescription: Tape Man is a puzzle platformer full of hidden mechanics. Throw your tape measure and set off into a vast maze built out of puzzles. The tape measure can serve as both a platform to stand on and a key to opening new paths — and it can do a lot more than that. You'll just have to find out.
games.aboutText:
Throw Your Tape and Cross the Maze!

Tape Man is a puzzle platformer full of hidden mechanics. Throw your tape measure and set off into a vast maze built out of puzzles. The tape measure can serve as both a platform to stand on and a key to opening new paths. And there's a lot more it can do — you'll just have to find out.

Key Features

- Cross the maze, collect more tape, and push on into places you've never been

- Not a single word of instruction — every answer is yours to work out

- An original soundtrack that keeps shifting as you explore

- A surprise waiting at the end of the maze

Learn More About the Tape Measure

Your tape can interact with all kinds of level elements — moving blocks, one-way platforms, and more. And the tape itself is hiding secrets too!

games.name: Crime Scene Clean: Paranormal
games.shortDescription: Crime Scene Clean is about Sector 7 hides the supernatural from the world. You’re their cleaner—erasing cursed symbols, demonic traces, and forbidden rituals. No fame, no questions. Just silence, speed and survival. Clean haunted scenes, contain threats, and bury the truth before it spreads.
games.aboutText:
Crime Scene Clean - When the veil between worlds begins to tear, Sector 7 sends you in—not to fight, but to erase. You’re a cleaner, tasked with scrubbing away cursed symbols, demonic residue, and forbidden rituals before the public ever finds out. You didn’t choose this life, but once you’re in, there’s no way out.

You’ll need nerves of steel to handle haunted crime scenes, occult disasters, and interdimensional anomalies. With your specialized gear—ritual scrubbers, spectral vacuums, and odor neutralizers—you’ll clean blood, pack up bodies, and silence the supernatural. All under pressure from ticking clocks, unstable portals, and agents watching your every move.

Key Features 🧼 Occult Cleanup – Mop up ritual circles, cleanse haunted spaces, and neutralize cursed artifacts. When the smell turns otherworldly, you’ll need more than bleach. 🔦 Gear Up – Upgrade your tools: stronger UV lamps, enhanced sigil erasers, and high-pressure sanctifiers. Prep before each mission—because failure isn’t an option. 💰 Moral Gray Zone – Sector 7 pays well, but temptation lurks. Some relics are too valuable to leave behind. Will you follow protocol or pocket the truth? 👁️ Buried Truths – You’re not just cleaning—you’re uncovering. Each mission reveals fragments of a deeper conspiracy. What is Sector 7 really hiding?

You’re not the hero. You’re the eraser. The last line between reality and chaos. So grab your mop, keep your head down, and clean like the world depends on it—because it does.

games.name: Fish to Cats: Catch & Feed
games.shortDescription: Loads of fish! Loads of cats! Sail out to sea, charm every furball on Cat Island with fresh catch. Live your cozy ocean cat life!
games.aboutText:
Step into a peaceful world of Fish and Cats!

9 oceans, 65 fish species.

Kitties are dying for fish!

Feed them to unlock epic fishing skills!

Summon trusty sidekicks to rake in cash while you AFK!

Cross paths with legendary leviathans? Hook 'em for exclusive ultimate skills!

And gacha?!

games.name: Myth Monkey Card
games.shortDescription: card game， Roguelike， deckbuilder， strategy,poker,myth,single-player,turn-based strategy
games.aboutText:
Short Description:

A unique blend of Texas Hold'em poker mechanics and Roguelike strategy. Forge your destiny across four distinct cultivation paths and challenge the gods of the Celestial Court. Will you master Artefacts for precise combos, or rely on the Self for a desperate comeback? In this mythic battle where the world is your card table, victory is yours to define.

About the Game:

Myth Monkey Card is a single-player card game that masterfully combines Texas Hold'em poker hand-building with Roguelike tower-climbing strategy. You play as the retired Great Sage, Sun Wukong, who, seeking new challenges, reunites with old friends and battles the heavens once more through a strategic card game.

Core Gameplay Mechanics:

- Forge Your Destiny Deck: Go beyond simple card collection. Skillfully combine standard cards with divine skill cards to form powerful poker hands like Straights and Four of a Kind during each match, activating game-changing special effects.

- Choose Your Cultivation Path: The game offers four unique progression paths, each representing a completely different strategic approach:

- Artefact Path: Manipulate your opening hand, transform key cards into specific Demon Kings, and execute sophisticated skill combos.

- Root Implement Path: Adopt a steady, resilient playstyle. Possess multiple lives and overwhelm opponents with superior resource management.

- Curio Path: Bend the rules. Double your rewards or avoid catastrophic losses at the settlement phase, enabling stunning comebacks.

- Self Path: Engage in high-stakes gambling. Disable all skills and rely purely on poker skill and the chance to reflect enemy abilities, experiencing high-risk, high-reward thrill.

- Challenge Iconic Mythological Bosses: From the Bull Demon King to the Buddha himself, each boss possesses unique skills and behaviors. Study their patterns and shatter their "Root Implement" shields to claim victory in this retirement showdown.

- Dynamically Generated Ascension Adventure: Each climb up the celestial tower is a new experience. Make choices across over 160 encounter nodes, facing random events, mysterious merchants, and resource mines where every decision matters.

Key Features:

- Deep Strategic Combination: A perfect fusion of poker's cerebral gameplay and deep deck-building (DBG) strategy, ensuring every match is filled with calculation and surprise.

- Exceptional Replayability: Four core paths create vastly different winning strategies, combined with Roguelike randomness, promising endless entertainment.

- A Uniquely Crafted Mythological Theme: Immerse yourself in a humorous and subversive take on Chinese mythology, witnessing how the retired Monkey King settles scores with cards.

Join the game now and begin your legendary retirement battle!

games.name: Holo vs Robo
games.shortDescription: Build a strong defense of hololive dolls to defeat a robot army in this exciting hololive-themed tower defense game!!
games.aboutText:
Oh no! Robots are attacking hololive! They must be stopped!!
With the energy of fans' cheers, bring holodolls to life and fight off hordes of robots in this hololive-themed lane-based tower defense!!

Features:

- A story with more than 40 levels

- Nearly 50 unlockable holodolls based on hololive members

- Fun minigames and survival modes

- Cute hand-drawn art

- Banging OST of hololive song remixes

- Gigi Murin Acrylic Stand (in game, not real life)

games.name: Loser Named Hana
games.shortDescription: Loser Named Hana is a friendship-building visual novel. You respond to an ad advertising $100 a week to be the lonely college student, Hana, friend.
games.aboutText:
About

You have found a strange ad at your local convenience store advertising $100 a week to be someone’s friend. The catch? The girl is an incredibly lonely girl named “Hana” with a strange, high-pitched voice. Regardless of how you treat Hana, one thing is for certain: she is desperate for friendship.

Your New Friend

Hana Mendoza

Birthday: October 13th 1999

Sexuality: Desperate (bi/pan)

Gender: Cis Woman She/Her

Age: 19

Height: 5’3’’

Personality: Sensitive, Clumsy, Lonely

Occupation: College Student

Features

- Ability to play as cis, trans, or various other genders (She/Her, They/Them, He/Him)

- 25K words of girl failure interaction

- About an hour and a half of gameplay

- 3 Endings

- Partially voiced

- Ability to mute voice acting

games.name: King's Lynn Leisure Farm
games.shortDescription: King's Lynn Leisure Farm is a farm idle game with racing driver theme. Here, you can collect a variety of cute animals, play with them, feed them, and send them out to work. You can also collect various vehicles to decorate your farm. Enjoy your time on the farm with your little animal friends!
games.aboutText:
This game is a PC port of the web-based "King's Lynn Leisure Farm". Save data is shared and the game is permanently free.

If you discovered this game through a Steam recommendation, here's something you should know: this is a fan game designed for F1 fans. We're not saying you can't play this game if you're not an F1 fan — but if you're part of the F1 fan community, or you know some of the drivers, or you're familiar with some racing memes, you'll have a much better experience here.

We welcome you to learn more about this motorsport full of passion and dreams!

King's Lynn Leisure Farm is a farm simulation idle game where you'll collect various animals, play with them, feed them, and send them out to work. You can also collect different vehicles to decorate your farm. Spend quality time on the farm with the animals!

The farm boasts over 30 collectible animals! Servals, bubble fish, frogs, koalas… Each has its own unique preferences and personality. You'll search for their favorite foods, teach them to talk, and buy them various special outfits. Grow alongside them!

Animals can form bonds with each other, and they can mate and lay eggs! After hatching, the eggs can give you a variety of amazing vehicles. Scooters, tractors, race cars, rockets, champagne, trophies…

the farm offers up to 80 different vehicles. Your animals can ride these vehicles, each with unique appearances and animations. Come collect all the fantastic vehicles!

The farm also features whimsical fairy-tale adventure stories starring your animals. Completing these stories unlocks corresponding fairy-tale costumes. During their free time, animals can also play padel to strengthen their bonds. You can assign the right animals to various jobs to earn money, which can be used to decorate your farm as you like… You’re in for a relaxing and joyful experience!

games.name: Wormies
games.shortDescription: Run your own cozy worm shop! Buy and breed hundreds of different wormies! Get to know your customers and fulfill their wormie orders to progress through different storylines!
games.aboutText:
Attention wormie enjoyers!

Ever wanted to start your own worm shop? Then wormies is the game for you!

Buy, breed, and discover hundreds of unique wormies!

Feed your wormies cookies to make them happy! Happy wormies will breed with other happy wormies to produce new combos, from basic to elusive, rare wormies

Manage your wormie collection! Whether you sell or keep them, it’s up to you

Get to know your returning customers as you fulfil their orders, then spend your hard earned profits on decorating and customizing your favourite wormies and their environments

Features

- Breed and discover hundreds of unique wormies

- Fulfill orders and get to know your customers

- Progress through various customer storylines

- Manage your profits to unlock upgrades

- Customize your wormies and their environments

- And most importantly, you can pet the wormies!

games.name: Internal Affairs: Love Parliament!
games.shortDescription: A lighthearted romantic-comedy visual novel set in the depths of bureaucratic hell! Meet four remarkable women—and dive into the absurd daily grind of a government office.
games.aboutText:
Betrayals, promotions, intrigues… Shredder? Or love?!

What will you choose along the way?

Parliament of Love is a romantic visual novel spiced with sharp satire on bureaucracy and office absurdity.
Step into the shoes of a newcomer at the enigmatic Ministry of Reflections (MoR) — a place where endless reports and pointless memos collide with friendship, intrigue, and—unexpectedly—real feelings.

Your goal is simple: blend into the team, survive the tangled web of office politics, and choose the one you’d like to walk this story with until the end.
Beneath the lighthearted tone lies a deeper story — about finding your place, taking responsibility, and discovering what it truly means to be close to someone.

Behind the piles of paperwork and absurd tasks lies a world full of questions:
💬 How do you find yourself in a system where everyone signs everything but nothing ever changes?
💬 What’s more important — sincerity or duty?
💬 And can true feelings exist in a paper-made world?

Don’t be fooled by the humor — beneath the satire hides a story about growing up, self-discovery, and fragile human connection.

Miss Ulyina

The princess everyone avoids. How can someone so sheltered, unfamiliar with the basics of everyday life, influence the fate of a nation? What secrets does her family hide? And if there’s a princess… could there also be a dragon?

Miss Mirovaya

The left hand of the Chief Secretary, a domineering and untamable fiery fury capable of putting anyone in their place. But what lies behind the mask of anger and defiance?

Nadezhda Polonskaya

A young woman burdened with responsibilities far beyond her years. The people’s welfare or the interests of the state? Heartfelt honesty or the honor of the uniform?

Lyuba Chaikina

The first female cosmonaut who now works within the state apparatus, yet keeps her soul among the stars. Reckless but sincere, warm-hearted and full of energy, she can’t shake the feeling that she’s in the wrong place .

⭐ Four independent routes with unique endings

⭐ A humorous, absurd world of red tape and office politics

⭐ Meaningful player choices that truly shape the story

⭐ Bright, memorable anime-style characters with carefully drawn sprites

⭐ Light romance with plenty of comedic moments

⭐ Over two hours of unique gameplay

⭐ 40+ beautifully illustrated CG scenes

⭐ An original soundtrack that touches the heart

Fill out the form. Blend in. And decide — who will you stay for in this paper-made world?

💌 We’re waiting for you in the Parliament of Love! 💌

games.name: Palmier Island
games.shortDescription: Cozy island RPG sim... but everyone only speaks French and you have to pay off your missing uncle's debt! Start a cafe, run a farm, fight demons in a school basement, go to court, and more as you discover each islander's lore and leave the island semi-fluent!
games.aboutText:
PALMIER ISLAND is a cozy island RPG sim that tricks you into learning French through pure play and no curriculum.

Plot: The economy is in shambles, and you're fresh outta college with no job and no prospects, so you fly to your millionaire uncle's island to catsit for the summer. However, when you arrive, you find out that all the islanders only speak French and you have to pay off your missing uncle's debt! Start a cafe, run a farm, fight demons in a school basement, go to court, and more as you discover each islander's lore and leave the island semi-fluent!

Core Gameplay Mechanic: Learn French through our core gameplay mechanic, Chattle, which is like a Pokemon battle where your words are Pokemon. You capture words from the Chattle into your vocabulary to navigate each conversational puzzle.

Minigames: Test your guessing skills through multiple minigames, such as shopping with only French labels, baking treats by recognizing vocabulary, and exploring alternative Chattle routes.

games.name: Combolands: Roguelike Citybuilder
games.shortDescription: A mini citybuilding roguelike. Place buildings, stack combos, and master deep strategy in short bursts to create a tiny thriving metropolis!
games.aboutText:
Combolands is a tiny roguelike citybuilder offering deep strategy in a bite-sized package! Grow your own mini metropolis: place buildings, unlock powerful synergies, and trigger cascading combos. With 21 possible guild combinations, Combolands offers strategic depth and a 'number-go-up' rush in satisfying 30 minute bursts.

Unlock new guilds as you play, each with unique identities, strengths and drawbacks. Every run will see you picking 2 different guilds to play with. You'll start with a brand-new, procedural map, and grow a tiny hamlet into a thriving city.

Break the game, refine your strategy, and build a city for the ages!

Features:

- Satisfying roguelike blend of deckbuilder and citybuilder mechanics

- A pantheon of 7 guilds with unique buildings and playstyles - pick 2 every run

- Procedurally generated islands

- 120+ buildings to construct your town

- 100+ passive heirlooms to further enhance your build

- Upgrades to manipulate your buildings' behaviour, and potions to manipulate the map

- Recruit from 13+ city councillors, each with their own progressions and abilities

- Work your way up 10 increasingly challenging ranks

games.name: Save My Scrap
games.shortDescription: "They mean everything to me. Please, make them whole again." An interactive visual novel puzzle game. By fixing the broken android, you may uncover the truth about your client's past.
games.aboutText:
You are a mechanic for androids who has received a request from a new client.
The client is a doctor named Miomaru and his personal android, an old, near-failing model named Harima.

As per your client's request, you begin repairing Harima. You connect the cords, trade out parts, and bring life back to the functions that had broken down. It was supposed to be a simple mechanical repair.

However, the more you deepen your bonds with Harima and Miomaru, the more you start to realize something.
You're not just repairing an android anymore. You're connecting the cords that spark their memories; ones that they'd tried to forget.

Once your job is finished, you will be forced to confront shocking truths and hear their heartrending pleas.

Gameplay

Android Repairs
