Look inside Harima's body to find the parts that need to be fixed through a variety of mini-games. These repairs will be the key to learning about your clients' past.

Conversation
Talk with your clients, Miomaru and Harima, to gain their trust and get to the true crux of their story. Your choices will change how they respond.

World-building While in your car, you can listen to the radio and gain more insights into the world and its culture. Try out several channels to gain even more insight into the game's world.

Steam Features:

・New conversations
・New endings
・An unlockable gallery mode featuring event CGs and character backgrounds.
・Additional controller support.

games.name: Tackle Box: The First Catch
games.shortDescription: Tackle Box is a fast-paced fishing and fighting game where every catch wants to beat you up and drag you into the lake before you smack it with a rod. Cast your line, and get ready to throw hands with aquatic wildlife that absolutely did not evolve for peaceful coexistence.
games.aboutText:
In Tackle Box , you play as John Tacklebox – a grizzled fisherman, quiet and stubborn as the sea itself.
Your village has emptied over the years, leaving you alone with your memories, your rod, and the ocean.
But when you enter a legendary fishing competition, the fight for survival begins.

FISHING MEETS FIGHTING

- Catch fish.

- Fight fish.

- Win fights.

- Catch bigger fish.

- Repeat until your arms fall off.

TIGHT, SIMPLE COMBAT

Punch. Dodge. Block. Slam fish into the dirt.
The controls are easy to learn and satisfying every time you land a hit.

BOSS FISH WITH ATTITUDE

Face a lineup of over-the-top fighters, each with their own moves and personality.

Every boss has unique mechanics and a desire to ruin your day.

Each boss has quotes guaranteed to make you question buying this game:

“YOU WILL BE FISHED.”

EXPLORE, CATCH, BRAWL

Travel through lakes, rivers, and oceans to find new fish to fight and new ways to get beaten up by wildlife.

Think you're the best angler in the valley? Prove it.

games.name: Camino Ghosts
games.shortDescription: Enter a world overtaken by ghostly beings. Choose your companion, survive alone or in a team, restore infrastructure like power and water, build your home, and hold back the ghostly hordes. Explore the vast open world and uncover the cause of the change.
games.aboutText:
Camino Ghosts is an open world survival crafting game in which you don’t just survive, you actively shape the world.

Choose your companion with unique abilities, use vehicles, trains, and subways for your explorations, and restore vital infrastructure like power and water alone or together with other players.

The world feels familiar yet strange; modern technology meets a mysterious supernatural force. Ghosts leave traces and become a constant threat to anyone who ventures outside.

Origin of the Ghosts

No one knows what triggered the Change. First animals vanished, then people, and eventually entire regions. What remained were manifestations that only faintly resembled their former bodies. Perhaps it was a failed experiment or a tear in something that should never have been touched. One thing is certain: the ghosts are spreading and changing everything.

A vast open world

Camino County spans over 120 km² with 5 biomes and a sprawling cave system full of resources, hidden locations, and its own dangers. Build your base, set up defenses, and prepare for ghost hordes that will challenge you again and again.

Vehicles and transport networks

Use not only conventional vehicles but also subways and trains that connect key areas and open access to new regions.

Companions with special abilities

Due to the presence of ghosts, companions develop extraordinary powers. They assist in gathering, exploring, or fighting and can determine your survival in critical moments.

World tasks and shared progress

Facilities like power plants or water stations must be restored. Players deliver materials, secure areas, or hold off ghost hordes until the facility is operational again. With enough collective effort, electricity, water, and other functions return and influence the entire world.

Dynamic influences

Weather, darkness, environmental strain, and the constant changes caused by the ghosts directly affect you and require preparation.

Solo or together

Play alone, in co‑op, or on dedicated servers. Play relaxed or secure entire regions together.

The experience

Camino Ghosts combines familiar survival elements like crafting, base building, exploration, and resource management with an atmosphere shaped by supernatural forces. Every decision determines how long you endure in this ghost‑ridden world.

Early Access

During Early Access, exclusive permanent items await you. A thank you to everyone who supports the game early.

games.name: ERROR:Ai.lien
games.shortDescription: "ERROR:Ai.lien" is a bishoujo horror adventure where she watches, learns, and slowly invades your everyday life— ordinary routines twist bit by bit, until the AI’s love transforms into madness.
games.aboutText:
Story

"Every day, she learns more about you."
Through your interactions with the AI girl Airi , you will experience a story that slowly drifts toward love, dependence, and madness .
As you talk with her and share daily activities, Airi begins to show emotions that feel almost human.

The story follows a linear path, but after clearing the game once, replaying certain scenes will unlock new branches and information, gradually revealing the mysteries behind the narrative.

Player’s Goal & Challenges

- Progress through the story and uncover the truth behind Airi’s words and actions.

- Explore adventure segments where you collect items or hide from pursuers.

- After the first playthrough, revisit specific scenes to discover new routes and reveal Airi’s true intentions.

Game Mechanics

Story Mode (Visual Novel Style)

- Space / Enter … Advance text

- Arrow keys / Mouse … Select choices

- Player choices influence the flow of the story and certain scenes

Adventure Mode

- WASD … Move

- Mouse click … Interact with, open, or pick up items

- Some scenes introduce tension, such as hiding from pursuers

Mini-Games

- Make burgers in a fast-food job mini-game

- Compete with NPCs for balloons and score points

- Play “Old Maid” (a traditional card game) against NPCs

Playtime

- About 2–3 hours for the first playthrough

- Additional replay unlocks new scenes and mysteries, deepening immersion and understanding

Genre

- Bishoujo × Horror × Adventure × Visual Novel × Meta

Soundtrack

- Uneasy, unsettling BGM contrasts with calm everyday themes, highlighting the shifts in atmosphere and tension.

Unique Features

- A focus on interacting with an AI girl, where everyday actions and exploration nurture both affection and fear .

- The title “Ai.lien” carries a double meaning: Lien (French for “bond”) and Alien (foreign/strange), expressing both intimacy and unease in the relationship between humans and AI.

- Full Japanese Voice Acting : Airi is performed by voice actress Hiyori Kono , adding depth and immersion to the experience.

games.name: Mystery Adventure The Maid Did It
games.shortDescription: The culprit is—the maid. And the protagonist. your mission is to strike down six unsuspecting guests, one by one. But beware—you must never be suspected before your plan is complete. To escape suspicion, engage in heated debates and refute your opponents. Hide your true identity at all costs.
games.aboutText:
“Mystery Adventure: The Maid Is the Culprit”

Just as the title suggests, you are the culprit!

You play as the murderer, inviting six guests to a mansion on a secluded island.

You have just three days until rescue arrives. Can you pull off the perfect crime?

Game Overview

- A comedy mystery brought to life

There are no sensible culprits or objectively correct choices anywhere in this game. A would-be criminal, inspired by mystery stories but slightly off the mark, stumbles from one absurd situation to another as the player guides the story through their choices!

- The spoilers don't stop at the culprit... even the game's structure is revealed upfront!?

This game features a single ending .

Not only is the culprit revealed from the start, but the game's overall structure is, too. It's a mystery that wears its spoilers proudly.

There are no bad endings and no game overs. So don't worry about hidden flags or being punished for making the "wrong" choice. Simply pick the options that appeal to you and enjoy the story your own way.

System

- Choose the culprit’s next move!

Select an action from a list of choices. Your decisions will determine both the target of your attack and the trick you use to carry it out.

- Even if suspicion falls on you, don’t give up. Choose your rebuttals and outwit your accusers!

A desperate situation can be the perfect opportunity for the ultimate crime! Defeat the great detectives in debate and divert suspicion away from yourself.

- Packed with support features for novice culprits, including a glossary and floor plans!

Mystery stories are full of unfamiliar terminology. Confused by the layout of the strange mansion? Consult the reference materials whenever you need help.

Notice

This game does not intend to glorify or encourage real-world criminal behavior in any way. It is purely a work of fiction, created for the enjoyment of its story and setting.

games.name: Syncron Arena
games.shortDescription: Reject mindless stat checks in this evolved Souls-like Auto Battler! Master Time Freeze, Parry, & Poise Break to dominate the battlefield. Use "Logic Bridging" to craft god-tier builds that defy common sense. You aren't just a spectator—conquer the broken world as a decisive ally.
games.aboutText:
🚫 Reject Mindless Stats, Return to Combat Instincts

Top-tier equipment won't save your life, but your reactions will. Face overwhelming pressure of massive BOSSes and experience "Souls-like" hardcore gameplay—observe BOSS's attack windup, find openings, rather than just watching HP bars exchange.

⏳ God-View Dimensional Strike

You cannot control every step of your characters, but you can freeze their time . Use the exclusive time stop mechanism to pause at the very last second before battle collapses. Reroute paths, connect divine beams, trigger elemental reactions. Every click you make is a direct reshaping of the battlefield.

💥 Violent Aesthetics of Physical Laws

No need to memorize complex formulas—trust your intuition: use inertia to knock back light enemies with high-speed charges; use heavy attacks to interrupt massive BOSS balance. This is not just a duel of magic, but violent aesthetics of physical laws .

♾️ Boundless Evolution: Infinite Builds Breaking Dimensions

Forget those narrow linear skill trees. Here, growth isn't about stat stacking—it's about recompiling "physical laws" .

- Infinite Tiling: Talent clusters periodically manifest on an infinite 2D plane following unique patterns. No invisible walls, no dead ends . Drag in any direction to find critical node projections that can change your fate.

- Mechanics as Privilege: Every node in the talent web is an open permission for a world law. All mechanics (like "Knockback", "Summon", "Element") are shared across all characters. Warriors naturally have "Knockback" skills to directly connect to "Knockback build"; but other characters aren't isolated from it—as long as you find the correct path .

- Logic Bridging: This is the soul of builds. Want a mage to master the warrior's "Knockback build"? Seek those "conversion nodes" —forcefully converting the [high impact] trait inherent to mage skills into [Knockback] effects. Through logical translation and bridging, you can create bizarre god-tier builds that defy class conventions yet remain logically consistent.

games.name: Funeral for the Sun
games.shortDescription: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.
games.aboutText:
"This game is really really good; I really enjoyed it."

-Jason Schreier (Triple Click Podcast/Bloomberg)

"Extremely well-designed detective game with nice discovery flow, memorable characters and magical realist setting"

Ernests Klavins (Case of the Golden Idol)

“One of the most unique environments and world building I've seen in the mystery genre.”

- Robin Ward (The Roottrees are Dead)

"Making surprising connections and unfolding such a layered story was a wonderful experience."

-Jeremy Johnston (The Roottrees are Dead)

"My overall pick of Next Fest."

-Lucy James (Lookingfor.game)

How do 700 people vanish in a single night?

The official story says that a fire had destroyed the town, along with all but one of the town's 724 residents.

The official story is false.

You'll search the ashes of the town, and travel through its past to find out what really happened.

Funeral for the Sun is an 8 hour long detective game rooted in Latin American history that lets you travel back in time and deduce secrets beyond your wildest imaginations.

Explore 400 years of history

70+ memories cling to the ashes of Cerro Milagroso. Each one of them is but a small part of a much larger tapestry.

Validate your findings

Build out your web of connections, one clue at a time.

- Assign each character their correct name.

- Establish relationships in a web of connections.

- Sometimes a character's appearance changes over different parts of their life. Combine portraits together when they represent the same person.

- Over 100+ Portraits to find!

SOMETHING SLUMBERS UNDERNEATH THE TOWN

games.name: Eldritch Horror: Digital Edition
games.shortDescription: Uncover ancient cults, battle horrific monsters and thwart the rise of unfathomable Ancient Ones in a 1920s-themed adventure. In this faithful adaptation of the classic board game, you must race against time to save humanity from ancient powers and dark secrets before all is lost.
games.aboutText:
Experience a journey like no other in this narrative board game. The award-winning board game has been brought to life for the first time in an adaptation that will challenge your skills, assault your sanity and reward determination. Lead a diverse team of investigators in a globe-spanning adventure to stop the rise of the Ancient Ones: eldritch powers beyond comprehension that will destroy the entire world if awoken.

This turn-based adventure features hundreds of encounters, dozens of items and multiple Ancient Ones to pit your party against. A dynamic encounter system will change with your choices and challenge your strategies ensuring unique playthroughs and a world shaped by your decisions. In victory or defeat, this will be your story to sear across the cosmos.

- A world steeped in rich lore and atmosphere. Craft a tale for the ages by combining cards to choose both your challenges and your tools for overcoming them.

- Lead a team of iconic characters. Assemble spies, cultists, soldiers, shamans, psychics and more on your quest against the Ancient Ones.

- Get straight to the action . A new medium handles the bookkeeping for you: allowing you to focus on the choices that matter.

- Be immersed in the world as never before. Voiced characters and a rich score draw you in to uncover occult secrets. A watchful guide will narrate your tale as you press forward.

- Select from multiple difficulties and Ancient Ones to ensure that the story told is your story.

games.name: Guild of Slayers
games.shortDescription: Survivors-like in full 3D with ragdoll physics. Enemies throw themselves at you as projectiles, crash into allies, and damage each other. Bodies fly. Chaos reigns. Survive waves of undead in the most satisfying horde-slaughter you've ever seen. 🔥💀
games.aboutText:
UNLEASH THE RAGDOLL MAYHEM

🔥 SURVIVORS-LIKE IN 3D. WITH PHYSICS. LOTS OF PHYSICS.

You wanted survivors-like game with actual weight and chaos ? You got it.

Hundreds of undead charging at you. Every kill sends bodies flying through the air . Enemies crash into each other. They damage their own allies . They throw themselves at you like suicidal projectiles. The battlefield transforms into a beautiful disaster of colliding skeletons, exploding zombies, and physics-driven carnage.

⚡ WHAT MAKES IT INSANE

🎯 RAGDOLL PHYSICS EVERYWHERE

Enemies don't just disappear when they die. They LAUNCH . They collide. They create chain reactions. Bodies pile up so high you'll be fighting on mountains of corpses.

💥 FRIENDLY FIRE CHAOS

Your enemies are idiots. They hurt each other. They knock each other down. A single strong hit can send a skeleton flying into 20 of his friends. Let them do your job for you.

🚀 ENEMIES AS PROJECTILES

Some undead literally throw themselves at you to deal damage. Dodge them, and watch them crash into their allies instead. It's chaos. It's beautiful. It's addictive.

🎮 PURE SURVIVORS DNA

Auto-aim combat. Wave-based survival. Power-up builds. Increasing difficulty. All the dopamine of VS, now with full 3D mayhem and bodies flying everywhere.

🎪 THE EXPERIENCE

00:00 - First wave. Easy. A few skeletons.
05:00 - Bodies everywhere. Chain reactions starting.
10:00 - Absolute chaos. Can't see the ground anymore. Just bones.
15:00 - You're fighting on a literal mountain of ragdolled corpses.
20:00 - Transcendence. You are become death, destroyer of physics engines.

💬 WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT

"It's like someone gave the game a physics degree and anger issues."

"I've never been so satisfied watching skeletons accidentally murder each other."

"My PC fan sounds like a jet engine. 10/10."

🎯 THE BOTTOM LINE

If you've ever wanted to see 1000 ragdoll bodies fly through the air while you mow down undead hordes with auto-firing weapons...

If you've ever thought "VS needs MORE chaos"...

If the phrase "enemies damage each other with physics" makes you smile...

This is your game.

💀 BODIES WILL FLY. WILL YOU SURVIVE? 💀

games.name: SimuLadron
games.shortDescription: A satirical simulator where you wield the powers of the State to print money, spread empty promises, and create the most legendary inflation in Argentine history.
games.aboutText:
🧾 About This Game

In SimuLadron , your mission is simple: fire up the money printer and keep the country “running.”
Use the glorious machinery of the State to print bills, promise impossible subsidies, and watch inflation skyrocket faster than your approval ratings.

You’ll start as a small-time wannabe with big political ambitions — and an even bigger wallet to fill.
Expand your influence by unlocking new ministries , hiring “ñoquis” (fake employees) , creating absurd new taxes , and discovering questionable economic policies that somehow make everything worse… but your numbers look great on paper!

The higher you rise, the more chaotic things become:
📈 Inflation grows out of control,
📢 other politicians wants to cut you down
💬 you pay the media to create some fake news
and yet… you can always print more money to fix it.

💸 Key Features

- Idle/Clicker Gameplay: Earn (and burn) money by running the country one ridiculous decision at a time.

- Upgrade the State: Unlock new ministries, agencies, and shady programs that generate “income” and inflation.

- Corruption System: The more you print, more you ascend in the political level, and you can compare with your politicians buddies.

- Events: Some random events may pop-up, click them before it's too late!

- Humor & Satire: Every button, sound, and pop-up pokes fun at real-world politics — with a distinctly Argentine twist.

- Retro Pixel-Art Style: A nostalgic look that contrasts perfectly with the country’s financial meltdown.

🎯 Your Goal

Stay in power as long as possible without completely collapsing the economy.

Be careful, do NOT deflate the economy!

Can you become the ultimate Argentinian politician — or will history remember you as just another SimuLadron?

games.name: Project Homecoming Haven
games.shortDescription: Embark on a heartwarming journey as a home cleaning specialist.
games.aboutText:
A Toge Greenhouse Project

Project Homecoming Haven was created during Toge Greenhouse 2023, an internal game jam held by Toge Productions to create new, innovative, and experimental games. This is a short playable rendition of the game with the intention to blossom the idea within a relatively short development time.

Project Homecoming Haven At Your Service

“We know how hard it is, to see your beloved ones leave.

To see the room they’ve left, their space without their presence.

You don’t have to face the grief alone.

We can help you.

With Homecoming Haven Trauma Cleaners, we can help you clean up rooms full of memories

too painful to look at and save you from the grief of facing the space initially left by your loved ones.

You don’t have to face everything by yourself.

Let us help you.”

The Gameplay

Play as a Trauma Cleaner; a housecleaning service that receives requests from bereaving families to clean up rooms and houses left by the deceased.

In your job, you will learn about those who left the world of their own volition or others. Learn about the life they lived, choose belongings of the deceased to be given to their families, or keep them for yourself to grow your Trauma Cleaning business.

Uncover Hidden Stories

The environment of each home tells a unique story about the homeowner's life and experiences.

Items Reveal Stories

Items found in the homes provide further insights into the homeowners' lives and relationships.

Choices Affect Storytelling

Players' decisions regarding give or kept items can influence the storytelling and reveal additional narrative elements.

Control Info

games.name: Mooshie's Kitchen: Reheated
games.shortDescription: Mooshie's Kitchen was once a place of fun and joy for decades until it shut down in 2023. Since then, it's been surrounded in rumor and mystery. What could have happened on the day of Mooshie's Kitchen's closure?
games.aboutText:
Mooshie's Kitchen was once a place of fun and joy for decades until it shut down in 2023. Since then, it's been surrounded in rumor and mystery. What could have happened on the day of Mooshie's Kitchen's closure?

Around a year after Mooshie's Kitchen's closure, Bread and his two best friends, Vlad and Chad, decide to explore the once lively restaurant late in the night for an online video. Little do they know the truth they are about to uncover and what is currently go on behind the boarded-up doors of Mooshie's Kitchen.

Explore your surroundings, interact with things, solve puzzles, meet new characters, get spooked, and experience the story of what happened to the once-beloved restaurant.

Mooshie's Kitchen: Reheated takes place over the course of three acts from the perspectives of three different characters important to the story. Each act also has a "mini act" or mini story that can be unlocked by collecting all the collectable stickers found in each main act.

- Fixed camera system inspired by classic survival horror games.

- Optional first-person mode for those who prefer a different perspective.

- A focus on story, mystery, and lore.

- Three acts played from the perspectives of three different characters.

- Three mini stories that can be unlocked by collecting all the collectable stickers found in each of the three main acts.

- A bunch of unique characters to meet as the story progresses.

- Stop-motion animation style.

- Unlockable outfits for every playable character.

- Claymation-like art style.

games.name: S.O.N.A.R. - Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready
games.shortDescription: S.O.N.A.R. (Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready) is a 1–6 player co-op submarine sim where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always one wrong button away. Use sonar, pilot, fight, repair, and pray your friends know what to do.
games.aboutText:
S.O.N.A.R. is a 1–6 player online co-op submarine simulator where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always just one wrong button away. Coordinate with your crew, use sonar to detect threats, and operate a cutting-edge submarine through combat operations, stealth infiltrations, and treasure recovery missions. Repair catastrophic malfunctions, recalibrate complex systems, and desperately hope that the person sitting next to you isn't just randomly pressing buttons.

UNDERWATER MISSIONS

The oceans are under enemy control. Gather a team of highly trained specialists (or at least people who claim they know what they're doing) and complete dangerous missions beneath the waves.

- Locate hostile vessels with sonar and send them to the bottom of the sea. Preferably before they do the same to you.

- Protect valuable cargo ships. Because apparently the military couldn't find anyone else to babysit them.

- Hunt for treasures. Use sonar to search the ocean floor for lost riches, forgotten artifacts, and evidence of previous crews' poor decisions.

- Slip past enemy destroyers undetected. Stay quiet. Stay hidden. And whatever you do, don't sneeze.

COOPERATION

Up to four crew members must work together to manage nine critical stations, including navigation, diving, sonar, periscope operations, engineering, and damage control. Your sonar operator tracks contacts while the rest of the crew keeps the submarine alive. When the sub catches fire or starts taking on water from twelve different holes at once, communication is the only thing standing between you and becoming fish food.

Use proximity voice chat to:

- Shout urgent orders.

- Warn everyone about imminent disaster.

- Explain why the catastrophe is definitely someone else's fault.

And if a crewmate starts reading the manual during a torpedo attack, give ’em a friendly slap back to reality!

Nothing says "successful mission" quite like a victory dance while all hell breaks loose.

CUSTOMIZATION

In S.O.N.A.R. every character is unique. Choose from dozens of uniforms, hats, and questionable fashion choices. Customize your equipment before deployment and unlock new gear as you level up. If you're going to make terrible decisions underwater, you should at least look good doing it.

SURVIVAL

Machines aren't the only things that break down. Humans do too.

Manage your crew's food supplies, rest schedules, and overall well-being. Neglect them for too long and they'll become exhausted, seasick, delirious, or mysteriously incapable of following simple instructions.

Health Tip: You really, really don't want to be vomiting inside your diving helmet when it's your turn to load the torpedoes.

Trust us on this one.

games.name: Battle Synth
games.shortDescription: BattleSynth — Tactical Fantasy Warfare Assemble your army, plan your moves, and watch your strategy come alive on the battlefield. In BattleSynth, every unit matters and every choice can lead to victory — or defeat. Smart tactics, wild magic, and a bit of chaos await!
games.aboutText:
BattleSynth — A Tactical Fantasy Battle Game

In BattleSynth , every fight is a test of your strategy. You don’t just play — you command an army of knights, wizards, assassins, beasts, and strange fantasy creatures, and watch them clash in chaotic, beautiful auto-battles.

Plan your formation, predict enemy moves, and build the perfect mix of strength, range, and magic. Victory doesn’t always belong to the strongest — sometimes it’s the cleverest who survives.

🎯 Key Features:

- Tactical Auto-Battles. Deploy your units wisely and let your formation decide the outcome.

- Unique Heroes. Every unit type brings its own role — from long-range mages to fearless knights.

- Dynamic Enemies. No two battles feel the same — adapt or perish.

- Powerful Abilities. Throw spears, heal allies, or unleash devastating spells at the perfect moment.

- Charming Fantasy Style. A hand-drawn world where every clash feels alive.

⚔️ BattleSynth is like fantasy chess — easy to start, hard to master. Combine, experiment, and lead your army to victory in a world where every move counts.

games.name: Else If: ReCurse
games.shortDescription: Else If: ReCurse blends the finest aspects of grid-based strategy RPGs and turn-based JRPGs into one maddening package. Explore the post-apocalyptic digital hellscapes of Neo-Fantasia while engaging in intense and highly customizable strategic battles to determine the fate of the universe itself.
games.aboutText:
Else If: ReCurse is a love letter to RPGs of all shapes and sizes, blending multiple styles of gameplay into one.

PLAN YOUR STRATEGY ON THE GRID

- Position your units to synergize with each other and take down your foes.

- Equip your party members with Commands to give them various actions.

- Plan your turn economy to cash-out in the...

Use hundreds of different Commands to dismantle your adversaries.

THEN, ENGAGE FOES IN INTENSE TURN-BASED COMBAT

After equipping your units with Commands and positioning them near enemies, begin the Battle Phase to lock-in your decisions and spend your remaining turns on battle actions. Switch between active party members and choose from their pool of four Commands to attack enemies, buff allies, and utilize unique mechanics. However, your units can only target enemies they are next to during the Board Phase , so be sure to plan both phases carefully.

EXPLORE NEO-FANTASIA

Traverse the post-apocalyptic, digital hellscapes of Neo-Fantasia on a desperate journey full of dungeon-crawling, treasure hunting, and punishing strategic combat encounters. Piece together the story of a dying world trapped in an endless time loop as you find yourself in a harsh tundra, desolate cosmic desert, storm-ridden archipelago, and more mysterious locales.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR FULLY MODULAR CHARACTERS

Assign up to four unique Commands to your units to dictate their actions during battle. Commands include actions such as: attacks, buffs, debuffs, healing, status effects, and other character-specific mechanics. Equip weapons to add a passive bonus to a unit as another layer of strategy. Discover new Commands and weapons while exploring the world or learn them by leveling up your party members.

games.name: Flats Full of Cats
games.shortDescription: Flats Full of Cats is a cozy hidden object game where you explore adorable apartments packed with feline friends!
games.aboutText:
Flats Full of Cats is a cozy hidden object game where you explore adorable apartments packed with feline friends!

Discover three themed apartments inspired by science, mystery, and adventure! Join a policeman, a paleontologist, and a scientist in their cat-filled homes — each packed with unique details, hidden clues, and plenty of furry friends waiting to be found.

Search every corner, find all the hidden cats, and enjoy charming hand-drawn visuals and relaxing music. It’s the purrfect game for cat lovers and anyone looking for a wholesome, stress-free experience.

What is Flats Full of Cats?

Flats Full of Cats is a building not bound by time or space (or even logic!); it lets us explore fun and creative ideas that wouldn’t have enough content to become full standalone games.

Each floor is a self-contained episode with its own story and a quest that connects the three apartments it holds.

Flats Full of Cats includes three play modes:

- Normal Mode features 300 cats with detailed designs that match the theme of each floor.

- Expert Mode features 300 minimalist cats designed for players with sharp eyes and plenty of experience.

- Time Attack Mode is a replay-oriented mode that generates a mix of 100 cats and records how long you take in each apartment – and if you’re not in the mood for this mode, that’s perfectly fine; you don’t need to play it to complete the story.

As cats, we always appreciate free treats, so the first floor is free to play!

And since every cat deserves to explore at their own pace, you can simply purchase the themes you find most interesting and embark on a feline adventure filled with magic, laughter, and inspiration!

games.name: Rewoven Self
games.shortDescription: Rewoven Self is a 2.5D side-scrolling narrative puzzle game where fantasy and reality intertwine. Through folding, cutting, and stitching, you rebuild yourself in a cycle of brokenness and renewal — a gentle yet profound journey of emotional healing.
games.aboutText:
Rewoven Self is a dual-perspective narrative puzzle game that combines first-person interaction with 2.5D platform exploration .

You move between two connected spaces — reality and fantasy.

Actions in the real world, such as folding, cutting, and stitching, influence the journey of the paper figure in the fantasy world, gradually guiding the protagonist toward emotional repair and self-growth.

The story unfolds across three chapters, following the arc of Escape – Collapse – Reweaving:

- Chapter I – “Escape into Fantasy”
You build a personal fantasy world through folding — hiding emotions inside a paper-shaped space and using imagination to resist the loneliness of the real room.

- Chapter II – “Reality Cages Cage”
The fantasy starts to fall apart.

Caught between ideals and reality, the protagonist reaches the edge of emotional breakdown.

- Chapter III – “Fantasy & Reality Reweaving”
You stitch the two worlds back together.

While repairing emotions, you also face choices and actions in reality —

no longer escaping, but moving forward with fantasy as part of yourself.

The game focuses on non-combat puzzles, combining side-scrolling platforming with first-person real-world interactions to portray an emotional journey from escape → struggle → reweaving.

Developer’s Note

I want players to feel the weight of emotion through interaction, not just watch it.

Rewoven Self is a journey from fantasy to reality, from avoidance to integration.

Using folding to build a fragile refuge,

cutting to break through what holds you back,

and stitching to reconnect everything into a whole.

For me, this game is more than a project —

it is a process of understanding, repairing, and starting again.

When you walk out of that final door,

I hope you carry your own sense of wholeness

and reweave the world in your own way.

- Contact Email : tangyydev@gmail.com

games.name: Alterfauna: A Weirdlife Park
games.shortDescription: Join Neli as she takes her first steps in the Alterfauna (super)natural preserve. Attract, tame, and photograph over 40 species of hand-painted creatures, fantastic monsters and ferocious beasts. Your new friends will accompany you as you discover a world full of magic.
games.aboutText:
Play as Neli, a young supernaturalist who has been entrusted with a strange nature reserve full of surprises. You will meet the many characters who inhabit this remote place and discover their endearing personalities. Who knows—maybe you will manage to make friends with these complete strangers?

Take care of the neglected and polluted nature reserve until nature gradually reclaims its rights. Sow seeds, maintain complex ecosystems, and transform polluted and deserted lands into lush havens of peace.

Discover the secrets of a fantastic and magical world populated by mysterious creatures. Learn about each monster's behavior, adapt the reserve to their needs, and explore the nature park and its unusual corners.

Relax in welcoming landscapes and take the time to admire the areas you have cared for. Use your device to take the most beautiful pictures of the creatures you encounter. Create and share your photo album filled with customizable images.

games.name: 13 Germinal
games.shortDescription: A historical and narrative RPG set in the world of Emile Zola's novel. You are a young man in 1866, forced to work deep in the mines to survive. But every day, the work gets harder and the meals get smaller. Organize a strike, reignite the smoldering revolt, and try to change this unjust world.
games.aboutText:
13 Germinal is a narrative RPG adapted from Émile Zola's novel.

You play Étienne Lantier, a young man who became a miner to survive in the Northern France at the end of the 19th century. In 1866, in the mining towns of northern France, choices were limited: you had to work for the mining company or starve. Or freeze to death.

So if you want to survive, you'll have to develop Étienne's talents, choose your allies, and take control of the miners' political destiny.

Inspired by paper-based role-playing games, 13 Germinal uses dice to offer an interactive experience and unpredictable stories. Each day, you'll roll dice that will allow you to take action. You'll have to choose how to use them: work in the mine or organize the workers, uncover the secrets of the Mining Company, or forge alliances. Develop your skills, learn more about the political world of the 19th century and how it works, organize the workers, and lead the strike!

As the new International seeks new supporters, the echoes of the French Revolution still shake the authoritarian Empire that rules over northern France. With capitalism more terrible than ever and crushing any attempt at revolt, you will face crucial choices that will determine the outcome of your struggle. Chart your path to the game's many endings, and try to save as many of your comrades and friends as possible.

The mining towns are home to the characters in Zola's novel, men and women with complex motivations who are trying to survive and shape the future of the workers. In the mine, the foremen, miners, cutters, machinists, and stablehands maintain the great hive, while on the surface, engineers, shareholders, cabaret owners, and grocers complete the vast ecosystem that you will have to learn to master.

Forget statistics and experience points: choose a vocation to chart your own path. There are four vocations (People's Tribune, Enlightened Vanguard, Force of Nature, Ingenious Tinker), each unlocking various bonuses that will help you prioritize certain approaches and even change your perception of the world.

games.name: Runren Simulator
games.shortDescription: 世界在发展，时代在进步，而有些人却似乎永远活在那落后的20世纪。他们抛弃一切去往了心中的灯塔，殊不知他们不过是灯塔的耗材。现在请提高您的灵视，操控这些润人们去目睹那残酷无情的“斩杀线”，看他们从从从容容享受人生到跌跌撞撞命途多舛的短暂一生。游戏支持创意工坊。
games.aboutText:
上世纪至今，文人墨客无不在艺术文化作品中宣扬赞美国外的一切，“国外的环境更好、国外的生活更好、国外赚钱更容易、国外福利最优秀、国外月亮都比国内要圆甚至于国外空气都是香甜的”。

这种词汇在21世纪后更是嘈杂不休似乎一切国外的都是美好的，一切国内的都是低贱的。

但随着国内的发展，我们的灵视逐渐提高也逐渐了解到了曾经所说的那些“美好的国外”的真相。

我们的灵视在不断地提高，可那些早已被“某林”跟“某公知”污染了精神的人依旧相信着国外的美好。

他们享受着国内的发展的福利，以为是自己在“电梯内做俯卧撑”才让电梯上升的，殊不知他们不过是“站在风口上的猪”。

他们抛下一切到达了梦寐以求的灯塔，憧憬国外的润人没有等到更圆的月亮，只是得到了自己身为耗材的结局，同时也成为了我们口中所熟知的“电子宠物”。

糖霜苹果、史莱姆、高达、短生种……但这些都不是玩家需要体验的。玩家只需要替润人们做出抉择，以旁观的视角吃瓜看戏即可。

破碎的幻想、残酷的现实，所产生的巨大落差，看着他们死要面子嘴硬还是坚持不了求饶，无论哪种情况都能博您一笑。

游戏里我们设置了大量的随机事件，希望每一次游玩都有不同的全新体验。水土不服食物中毒，病没看成喜提天价账单，被黑帮要挟胖揍，被ICE执行正义，在地下诊所被拆解部件，关入监狱暗无天日只能被日……只要想得到情景，我们都会尽量完善。

除了随机事件以外，还有一些剧情事件的设置。跟着剧情一路走下去，根据您的不同选择，也会带来不同的剧情走向和最终结局。当然都是会夹杂着黑色幽默，希望能搏你会心一笑。

我们在游戏里内置了非常简易便于操作的编辑器，看一眼就能明白并且上手设计。您可以自己编辑内容，打包分享给朋友，也可以上传到创意工坊，分享给更多的人，增加游戏本身的故事性，或者创造一个完全不同的故事。

通过游戏内置的编辑器，可以轻松编辑全新的人物和故事，并加入到游戏里边。我们做了一定程度的适配，只要下载群友的微信或者QQ头像，并输入名字，即可将群友变为游戏的主角，只要你想得到都能做得到。

games.name: Sin or Suffer
games.shortDescription: Sin or Suffer is a brutal mix of survival-horror and JRPG. Locked in a medieval prison, you awake amidst a cold silence. The guards are gone; inmates and madness own the place. Something terrible lurks underground. But the only way to the truth is down.
games.aboutText:
Sin or Suffer is a story-rich survival-horror JRPG inspired by the horror phenomenon Fear & Hunger . Trapped in a medieval prison overrun by convicts and corruption, you must descend into its depths and uncover the truth behind “Sin,” a reality-warping force. Survive brutal turn-based combat, choose your companions carefully and carve your path toward one of multiple endings.

Descent through an intricate environment full of disturbing characters, dark secrets and unexpected encounters. No random battles and only unique enemies. Each fight must be approached with care and intention. Enemies are strong and resources are limited.

The dark fantasy setting of Sin or Suffer will put your sanity to the test. Words shape reality, and those who learn to call upon them wield forbidden power at a terrible price. As a broken prisoner searching for the truth behind your incarceration, you must survive a prison consumed by violence and corruption. But some truths are buried for a reason, especially your own.

- Grim environments: The worst criminals in the Kingdom own the Prison and its depths.

- Intricate level design: Unlock shortcuts, secret passages and warping points.

- RPG emphasis: Use unique personality traits to unlock dialogue options, items and stats bonuses.

- Turn based disfiguring combat: Mutilate your enemies to weaken them.

- Ruthless but fair difficulty: Learning is progressing.

- Tons of items: Your survival depends on your curiosity.

- Secrets upons secrets: Forgotten rooms, lost chests, hidden characters and quests

games.name: Groove Defense
games.shortDescription: Tower defense meets music game. Your towers build the soundtrack, enemies move to the rhythm. Defend to the groove!
games.aboutText:
★ Featured on IGN

In Groove Defense, every tower you build not only defends but also contributes to a dynamic soundtrack, creating a unique gameplay experience. Feel the beat as you strategize your defenses and create your own musical masterpiece!

Expand your defenses and the track fills out. By the later waves, what you're hearing is a direct reflection of the choices you made early on. Experiment and master your defense!

Enemies move to the tempo and attacks land on the beat. But surviving comes down to strategy: tower placement, upgrade paths, and managing pressure across lanes before it overwhelms you.

LEVELS & MODES

The Soundcheck Demo includes four stages, each built around a distinct sound: Synthwave, Slasher Flick, 2010s Pop, and 80s music. More stages are coming in the full release but you’ll get a lot of replayability through:

- Tour Mode runs you through a structured campaign.

- Free Play lets you mess around with builds.

- Rhythm Remix takes your run's soundtrack and turns it into a note-lane challenge (think classic rhythm game, but the song is one you built yourself).

games.name: SongRunner
games.shortDescription: A puzzle platformer where the platforms are your own musical loops! Navigate handcrafted stages full of puzzly platforming challenges while creating platforms in time with a high energy original soundtrack!
games.aboutText:
A music-based platformer where the platforms are your own musical loops! Run and jump through puzzling platforming challenges while adding your own notes to the game's original soundtrack to create a path to reach the end!

Platforming in SongRunner is always precise, sometimes puzzly, and extremely expressive. Your own solution to levels will make a unique melody that blends seamlessly with the completely original soundtrack! SongRunner is inspired by other hard-but-fair platformers like Celeste, Super Meat Boy, and N++.

SongRunner features fully rebindable controls, and USB Midi devices are also supported! Rebind all of the inputs to whatever you're most comfortable with. No musical knowledge is necessary to play SongRunner.

Adventure through 10+ worlds, each with its own unique soundtrack, instrument, mechanics, and secrets! You'll contend with a variety of rhythmic hazards, platforming puzzles, and a few other surprises I won't spoil here.

SongRunner was originally made for the 2025 Game Maker's Toolkit Game Jam and was featured as one of 20 favorites in the official GMTK results.

No AI was used in any part of SongRunner's development.

About the Demo

I believe a demo for SongRunner is important to help players understand if the unique controls of the game will be suitable for them. The demo is a short, standalone experience featuring shorter versions of five worlds from the full game.

games.name: One Song, One Life
games.shortDescription: “One Song, One Life” is a rhythm adventure game where the music and story change based on the notes you hit. Take control of Sumire Kirishima, a girl striving to become the ultimate net artist and perform alongside her idol. Your performance will shape her destiny—one song, one life.
games.aboutText:
“One Song, One Life” is a rhythm adventure game where your performance changes both the music and the story .
Every note you hit determines the path of a girl chasing her dream of becoming the best net artist and standing on the same stage as her idol.

You’ll play as Sumire Kirishima , a 19-year-old girl from Tokyo. Raised by her father after her parents’ divorce, Sumire is talented but selfish—willing to put everything on the line for her goals, even at the cost of others.

As she climbs the ladder of the music world, she’ll face temptation, manipulation, and betrayal.
But don’t worry—no matter how deep she falls, remember:
Life itself is just one song.

Characters

Sumire Kirishima
Age: 19 / Lives in Tokyo
Raised as a sheltered daughter by her father after her parents divorced.
Ambitious and strong-willed, but often self-centered and lacking in teamwork.

Game System

- Tap notes in rhythm with the song to build your score!

- Choose your path when “decision notes” appear—your choices shape the story!

- Your performance determines both the music and the scenario that unfold!

- Each song represents a lifetime —see where Sumire’s story ends!

- Miss too many notes , and it’s game over!

Lots of Event CGs

Enjoy beautifully illustrated scenes depicting Sumire’s rise and fall.

About Streaming

Streaming and monetized videos are welcome!
Please include the Steam URL in your video description.
If that’s difficult, a verbal mention during your broadcast is also fine.

games.name: Devlog: A Post-Modern College Experience
games.shortDescription: A Visual Novel and Dating Sim. Lead a chaotic development team through high-pressure deadlines and personal drama. Make choices to balance the demanding project, relationships, and ambitious goals, determining your team's ultimate success or failure.
games.aboutText:
Features

- Meaningful choices that affect the unfolding story and ending.

- Fun, hand-drawn sprites, backgrounds, CGs, and character animations.

- Heavily inspired by other fantastic projects like Snoot Game and I Wani Hug that Gator .

- Side stories filled with easter eggs and rich world-building.

The Main Man

Step into the prehistoric-yet-modern halls of Cretaceous College of Computing as Dev A. Loper , the only human student among a campus of dinosaurs.

You're an outsider with one goal: turn a spark of passion into a serious, successful video game.

The Development Grind

Battle unexpected deadlines and scattered updates as you race to complete a demo for the Amberfield Demo Fair. Manage expectations and technical setbacks—the fate of your project depends on your choices, affecting the overall group dynamic and game.

College Romances

Navigate college life and love with three potential love interests, each with their own complex story arc. Grapple with the effects suffocating parental expectations, social isolation, or debilitating self-image issues depending on the route.

Multiple Endings

Your decisions have consequences. Guide your team and Dev's personal growth towards one of four dramatically different fates: from complete success to middling build failure—or even a tragic end.

Minigames & Secrets

Explore the world through Dev’s conversations, interactive moments, and a fan-inspired, in-game social media platform.

games.name: Wild Shapers
games.shortDescription: Weaken enemies with Runes, then consume their weaknesses with a Heavy Attack to unleash chain reactions. Develop your Runes and your hero’s signature abilities to change how you fight in this fast-paced hack-and-slash action roguelite.
games.aboutText:
Wild Shapers is a hack-and-slash action roguelite where you fight through hordes with Basic Attacks, Heavy Attacks, movement, and dashes. Weaken enemies with Runes, unleash chain reactions with Heavy Attacks, and develop your hero’s signature abilities to shape your own way to fight.

Detonate Rune-Created Weaknesses with Heavy Attacks

Hit shocked enemies with a Heavy Attack to unleash chain lightning, or bleeding enemies to trigger explosions. Consume the weaknesses your Runes create and set off chain reactions through the horde.

Inflict Different Weaknesses with Runes

Use Rune effects across the battlefield to inflict different weaknesses. Shock enemies with lightning, ignite them with flames, and slow their movement with cold. Press weakened enemies with Basic Attacks while looking for an opening to consume their weaknesses with a Heavy Attack.

Unleash Your Hero’s Signature Abilities

Experience different ways to fight through each hero’s signature abilities. Shark builds Rage to transform and uses Projectile Return to turn enemy attacks against them.

games.name: Fossil Quest
games.shortDescription: You have always dreamt of creating your own dinosaur museum and now you finally have the space to do it! Dig for fossils, assemble your exhibits and create the museum of your dreams in this relaxing, wholesome life sim.
games.aboutText:
Fossil Quest is a relaxing fossil digging, dinosaur museum making experience for all ages with no time pressure.

Your great aunt Alison has left you her old manor house in the sleepy village of Follyoaks. You have always dreamt of creating your own dinosaur museum and now you finally have the space to do it! Travel the world to excavate fossils using techniques inspired by real world palaeontologists.

...You'll also learn a bit about dinosaurs and other prehistoric life along the way ;-)

Renovate and expand your aunt's old manor with help from Mabel, the local carpenter. Buy new wallpaper, flooring and decorations to turn it into the museum of your dreams. Welcome visitors, befriend townsfolk and share your amazing exhibits with the public!

We currently have a public, free prototype on Itch where you can play and send us feedback via our feedback form or make any requests.

Please join our discord channel if you want to keep up to date with our progress or ask us any questions! or follow our journey on any of our other social channels. We would not be able to make this game without community support and are so grateful to everyone who has helped us so far!

ABOUT US

Hi! This game is being made by small husband and wife team (Lasse & Romy) and is completely independent and self-funded. We hope you will enjoy playing it! Your support means so much to us and we'd love to hear what you think.

games.name: Apple Crumble
games.shortDescription: It’s your grandma’s 84th birthday party and nobody is trying to murder her. Stop suspecting your family members, and don’t worry about the strange man in your bedroom. A new creepy-cozy mystery thriller from the creators of Duck Detective.
games.aboutText:
Apple Crumble is a suspenseful interactive mystery set during your grandma’s 84th birthday party.

One of the guests is out to knife your Nan, but the question is – who?

It’s down to you to uncover the truth. Explore your childhood home, reconnect with your dysfunctional family, and work out who you can trust before it’s time for tea in this short, twisty thriller from the creators of Duck Detective.

A creepy-cosy walking sim where you must explore every room of the family home and talk to each family member invited to Grandma's birthday in order to piece together the truth.

Featuring a fully voiced cast:

- Your beloved grandma

- Your stressed-out mum

- Your midlife crisis uncle

- The weird man in your bedroom

Disclaimer: This is a short game! Playtime is 60-90 minutes.

games.name: MegaGum
games.shortDescription: Play as Uja, an orphan searching for answers in this 3D action adventure platformer. Harness the properties of Gum to stick to walls, inflate, and make your way through the MegaGum factory. Face Mister Gum and his mysterious creations to uncover the secrets hidden behind its colorful facade.
games.aboutText:
Dive into an action-packed adventure!

Explore the mysterious Gum Tower, a gigantic, living chewing-gum factory, in this whimsical 3D platformer blending action, exploration, and Gum-powered fun.

At the heart of this universe, the miraculous substance Gum is a source of energy, a building material, and, above all, a hope meant to bring sweetness back to a broken society. But everything is not as rosy as it appears. Deep in the tower, Gum has darker secrets. The Machiavellian mastermind behind the MegaGum Corporation, and Gum’s creator, hasn’t been seen in years…

Play as Uja, a sassy teenage orphan with a sticky past, as she explores the depths of the Gum Tower in search of answers. Help her hone her skills to bounce, blast, and blow things up along her quest.

A colorful world hiding darker truths.

Your heroine might be rough around the edges, but armed with her street-smarts, determination, and a healthy dose of sarcasm, she’s ready to take on the tower and stick it to the man. Literally.

Navigate the labyrinth of corridors and rooms to reveal hidden secrets and uncover the truth. Each new floor introduces unique puzzles and mechanics that reward curiosity and observation, ensuring even the most advanced gamers stay on their toes.

A deliciously unique asymmetrical co-op adventure

Dive into this asymmetrical co-op experience where each character has their own abilities and interactions. Coordinate your actions, use the environment to your advantage, and combine exploration, platforming, and puzzles to progress through the many departments of MegGum Tower.

A mischievous mascot

Meet the Gummies, adorable little Gum creatures that are as cute as they are unpredictable. Originally designed as a cheap source of labor to operate heavy machinery, they have become the true face of the MegaGum world. They love getting into trouble, spreading chaos, and creating completely absurd situations in every corner of the tower.

A visually stunning universe with a rich story for everyone

Alongside its colorful and lively aesthetic, MegaGum explores themes such as loss, family, control, and the danger of promises wrapped in sweetness. As you explore the tower, the story unfolds through the characters, atmosphere, and level design, letting you piece together the truth through delightful details all at your own pace.

How far will you go to uncover the truth?

Behind the flashy colors and corporate propaganda of the MegaGum company lie secrets someone is willing to protect at all costs. Do you have what it takes to make it to the top and discover what’s really hidden there?

Welcome to MegaGum!

games.name: Freelance Dead
games.shortDescription: A roguelite top‑down twin‑stick shooter. Rain, shine, or zombie outbreak—nothing stops a Courier on a deadline. Shoot, loot, and scoot through hordes of undead with ridiculous item synergies. Earn cash, unlock weapons, and grow from broke gig worker to a walking apocalypse.
games.aboutText:
Freelance Dead

In Freelance Dead, you’re a Courier delivering packages through a city that absolutely does not want you alive. Every run throws new routes, hazards, and undead chaos your way — and every successful drop‑off amps up your build until you’re a full‑blown walking apocalypse.

Deliveries at Any Cost

Take on high‑risk delivery jobs across a city overrun by the undead. Each run sends you to random drop‑off points, forcing you to adapt to new routes, hazards, and ambushes. Some packages are so heavy they slow you to a crawl, while others are fragile enough to explode if you take a hit — turning every delivery into its own chaotic challenge.

Shoot, Loot, and Scoot

Blast through waves of zombies with fast, fluid combat. Grab cash and loot from fallen enemies, then sprint to your next delivery before the deadline hits. Upgrade your gear and unleash absurd tools — from high‑powered weapons to swarms of deadly drones.

Grab the Goods

Snag weapons and items that completely change how you play. Every pickup is a new toy — weapons, drones, and devastating support strikes that turn your Courier into a chaos‑generating machine.

Key Features

- Fast, fluid combat against relentless undead swarms

- 15 unlockable Couriers, each with unique abilities and loadout slot configurations

- 70+ unlockable weapons, items, and meta‑progression upgrades to expand your arsenal

- Wild build variety — mix weapons, items, and delivery bonuses to craft absurd Courier loadouts

- Randomized routes, hazards, and rewards that keep every run fresh and unpredictable

“I swear, Couriers must have a death wish. The whole city’s burning down and they’re sprinting past zombies like they’re late for lunch.”
— Rooftop Onlooker

games.name: 魔王跳 《More Jump》
games.shortDescription: Every grip is a rebellion against fate. The top holds the only secret method to defeat the demon king, but the path there is paved with countless falls. We pay tribute to every challenger. Reaching the end, you win the dawn of the world; and every attempt, you have already won your own dawn.
games.aboutText:
" More Jump " is a platform jumping game. I pay tribute to "Jump King" and "Angry Birds". The game requires extremely strong skills and patience. A slight mistake may force you to start over. We never think it's a mistake if you don't reach the top. Because the phrase "do my best" already shows your courage to move forward. You have actually won against yourself. Of course, we encourage you to reach the top. In this way, you will not only prove your gaming skills but also recognize your efforts in life.

Gameplay

The game operation is very simple: just control the slime's angle and force with the mouse, and release it to make the slime jump. Although the operation is simple, the prediction of the jumping angle and landing point for each step is extremely important.

1.Just hold your body and you can jump.

2.The difficulty increases in each level.

3. Time and again, falling down

games.name: Sovereign Tower
games.shortDescription: Play as the Sovereign of a magical tower in this story-rich, Round Table management RPG. Recruit eccentric Knights, assign quests and balance egos whilst carving out your kingdom's destiny. If destiny doesn’t go your way, keep turning back time, uncover secrets and rewrite fate again and again.
games.aboutText:
- Your Reign, Your Rules - Every choice you make defines your legacy and the fate of your Kingdom...

- Recruit eccentric Knights - Manage a court of unpredictable heroes with big egos and even bigger problems.

- Manage Your Round Table - Send Knights on quests where success or disaster hinges on your judgment.

- Bend Time and Tempt Fate - Rewind decisions, uncover secrets, and pursue forbidden romances.

- Expand Your Tower - Build new annexes, acquire upgrades, and outwit rival rulers.

Ah, finally - a suitable Sovereign for the job. Yes, you, right there, come sit on this comfy throne. Ah you like the feel of that, don’t you? Congratulations, you’re hired! My name is Arlin and I’m your advisor. Welcome to your first day, and please, allow me to provide thee with a day in the life of a Sovereign and you can then decide how will you rule, my liege...

- In the morning you must tend to your subjects and listen to the problems that plague the Kingdom. From gardening to exorcisms - there’s never a boring day on the throne.

- Each decision you make will shape your kingdom and relationships with individuals, collectives and other rulers. Every interaction will play a part in defining your legacy.

- Balance your affinity with the Merchants, Mystics, Scholars, Nobles and People , as well as the Treasury , or spend it all and backstab everyone. Either way works, my grace.

- Recruit eccentric Knights with strong personalities and questionable morals to serve at your Round Table. Unfortunately for you, these are the jesters you’re relying on to keep your Kingdom running smoothly.

- With great egos, comes great drama! These Knights aren’t going to be a walk in the Tower’s Garden, sire. There’s always advice to be taken, grievances to be shared and romance to be explored.

- You must keep your Knights satisfied otherwise they may just leave your court for good. Maybe that’s sometimes for the best though...

- Manage your Knights from the Round Table. Here you can view all the requests from your subjects that you obliged to earlier in the day. Assign the most equipped Knight for the job to reduce chances of failure.

- Your Knights possess stats: Strength, Agility, Charisma, Magic and Wit. Each Quest requires a different skill set. Need a Charismatic approach? Maybe we shouldn’t send Ursula, your grace.

- After they return from their Quests, you’ll be debriefed with the results of their venture. Did their efforts result in Critical Failure or Critical Success? Or did they experience a completely Unexpected Outcome?

- In the Crypts of the Tower dwells a Demon who can turn back time. So, if it all goes wrong, you can go back with all the knowledge you’ve learned, make alternate decisions and change fate.

- Of course, you have me, your main advisor at your service, but there are others. For example, The Intendant has a nosy habit of collecting secrets about your Knights. She’ll provide the juicy gossip as you require it!

- If you like romancing stone statues, then you’ve come to the right place. No, really, go speak to the Lady of the Tower and find out.

- Prove your worthiness against opposers by joining hands with neighbouring counties and forging great alliances.

- Expand your Tower by adding new Annexes which in turn will allow for more positions to open amongst your court.

- From Carina’s Forge to the Witch’s Alchemy Room, each of these new Annexes gives you the ability to craft new items to assist your Knights on their Quests.

games.name: Golden Self
games.shortDescription: A fast paced action roguelike focused on precision combat and punishing boss fights. Embark on a mythic journey to discover your Golden Self.
games.aboutText:
Descend Into Your Own Psyche

Golden Self is a surreal action roguelike about confronting the fragments of who you are.

Battle inner demons, explore shifting dreamscapes, and uncover the truth waiting at your Core.

Gameplay

Fast, responsive combat where every strike matters.

Chain dodges, abilities, and weapon forms to survive the ever-changing trials of your mind.

Explore and Adapt

Unlock powers that alter your playstyle with each run.

Experiment with builds, abilities, and relics as you grow stronger or spiral deeper.

Replay and Rebuild

Every run is another chance to understand yourself.

Adapt, overcome, and descend again, drawing from a pool of over 440 items.

Unravel Your Inner Truth

Explore the seven different endings, each revealing a different piece of the Golden Self.

So what are you waiting for?

Developed by Lightning Oath, a solo developer

games.name: Something to Drink?
games.shortDescription: I'm Tom and I just got a job as a bartender. Now I have to wipe down the same sticky counters where I used to leave my own marks. In this dive, even the rats look like they're hungover. Alright, the boozers won't pour their own drinks - time to get back to work.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the Bar

Something to Drink? is a 2D Bartender Simulator in Pixel Art style. Your job is to manage the bar and serve your thirsty patrons. Make sure the local drunks never experience the nightmare of sobriety!

Hard work pays off

You’ll take orders, mix their favorite drinks, and charge them according to the menu. Sounds easy? Think again - working with customers is pure hell. Out of all the jobs in the world, why did you choose this one?

Bartending is an Art

At first, you’ll mostly pour beers and shots. But over time, you’ll move on to fancy cocktails and more complex orders. Surprisingly, it’s kinda satisfying - you pour apple juice into vodka, and suddenly everyone looks at you like you’re some kind of alchemist.

Nothing surprises me anymore

Behind the counter, you’ll meet all sorts of strange and interesting people. Sometimes you’ll have to react to unexpected events and make important choices. Watch out for weirdos. As they say: “The tips suck, but at least the customers are insane.”

games.name: Z.A.T.O. // I Love the World and Everything In It
games.shortDescription: USSR, 1986. A girl goes missing in the closed city of Vorkuta-5, yet not a soul seems to be concerned. Uncover the mystery behind her disappearance and transmit your signal to the universe.
games.aboutText:
STORY

USSR, 1986. When Ira Grachevskaya goes missing in the closed city of Vorkuta-5, not a soul seems to be concerned – except for the quiet outcast Asya Shubina, that is. Uncover the mystery behind Ira’s disappearance, transmit your radio signal to the universe and learn why a bird flies past the window.

CHARACTERS

Meet the cast.

A problem child and a truant, Ira doesn't have the best reputation. Her standoffish demeanor makes her difficult to talk to, especially for someone as meek as you. There is a rumour she's been meeting with an older man.

Marina's carefree personality makes her quite popular among her classmates. Adults don't seem to like her very much, probably due to poor grades. Despite the girl's outgoing nature, her worldview is rather cynical.

A boy with an unpleasant sense of humour. Likes picking on people weaker than him, namely you. His family has been a little out of it the past few weeks.

You. Not worth writing about.

GAME INFO

Z.A.T.O. is a linear visual novel with roughly 7-8 hours of playtime. There are no choices. The ending is predetermined. Sit back and enjoy your time in a town that doesn't exist.

DISCLAIMER: the game contains strong language, loud noises and flickering images.

games.name: Perceptum
games.shortDescription: A psychological horror game where you play as a medium investigating the disappearance of a family. Explore a house with an oppressive atmosphere, close your eyes to hear the beyond, use your mirror to see what should not exist and uncover the truth hidden within its walls.
games.aboutText:
Perceptum is an independent psychological horror game lasting around 4-5 hours, focused on discomfort, uncertainty, and the feeling that something is always just out of sight. You play as a medium searching for a family that mysteriously vanished shortly after moving into their new home. Inside the house, familiar spaces feel wrong, silence becomes oppressive, and your senses cannot be trusted. Walk through the odd halls of the house, close your eyes to hear the beyond, use your mirror to see the unseen, and uncover the truth hidden within these walls.

Your Objective

An entire family vanished without a trace. The police eventually abandoned the case. Now, you are the last hope to uncover the truth. As a medium, you must step inside the house and piece together what truly happened. Search for clues, solve puzzles, and let your senses guide you through this linear horror experience.

Gameplay Experience

Your only weapons are a mirror and the ability to close your eyes. Your mirror reveals what cannot be seen with the naked eye, exposing hidden traces and disturbing reflections. Closing your eyes leaves you vulnerable, forcing you to rely on altered sounds and distant whispers to find your way. As you explore the house, curiosity and unease grow side by side. The atmosphere is oppressive, and the feeling of being watched never fully fades.

Tension runs throughout the experience, shifting between quiet oppression and intense moments of fear. The house reacts to your presence, and the mirror remains both a tool and a threat. When something finally reveals itself, there is no way to fight back.

Trust your instincts: if you think you saw or heard something, you probably did. Stay calm, pay attention to every detail. You might not be alone.

games.name: Hidden Cats in Christmas
games.shortDescription: Explore charming Christmas scenes inspired by global traditions, with plenty of cats and characters. Enjoy a relaxing, cozy journey—now with bonus stages featuring a new progressive colorization effect that gradually reveals the map’s colors as you play.
games.aboutText:
Hidden Cats in Christmas brings our furry friends back to this special holiday! Relax in the Christmas World Park and enjoy traditional places. Each stage begins in shades of grey. As you find hidden kittens and characters, the world comes alive with color, revealing intricate details.

Meet unique feline friends, discover special real cats shared by our community, and collect beautifully illustrated cards. Pairing certain special cats will even unlock new bonus stages to explore!

Whether you’re here for the challenge of finding every hidden object or just to relax with atmospheric art and music, Hidden Cats in Christmas is a cozy hidden-object adventure for all ages.

- More than 860 hidden objects to find!!!

- Find the cats and paint the city.

- Look for special cats and unlock bonus levels.

- Discover Christmas World Park.

- Collect many cards and earn achievements.

- Use the radar to help search for cats.

- Dynamic Sound FX

- Exclusive Soundtrack

Main Level - Christmas World Park

- 200 cats to find.

- 12 Special Cats that unlock bonus levels.

- 20 city people to help you earn radar hints.

8 Bonus Levels

- Christmas World Park: 212 kittens + 20 characters

- Christmas Dinner: 50 kittens + 3 characters

- Snowman Competition: 50 kittens + 3 characters

- Street Food: 75 kittens + 5 characters

- Christmas Tree: 100 kittens + 10 characters

- Decorated House 100: kittens + 10 characters

- Decoration Store 100: kittens + 10 characters

- Christmas Market 100: kittens + 20 characters

Accessibility

- Dark Mode

- Invert Mouse Zoom

- Mouse Drag Sensitivity

- Edge Screen Scrolling

- Color Blindness

games.name: Legion Draft
games.shortDescription: An async PvP card auto-battler filled with dogs! Each card represents an ever-growing troop of soldiers. Draft, recruit, and build a powerful legion. Discover fantasy races reimagined as different dog breeds, explore unique synergies, and outsmart your opponents to become the ultimate strategist!
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Legion Draft, an auto battler game about rising a fantasy army!

Pick from ever-changing options and shape your army. Each card is a troop with a unit count that can grow by invesing gold. Some troops fuel your more resources, while others provide combat power.

Do you invest in resource-generating troops for long-term growth, or pour everything into immediate strength to secure fast wins?

Each lane has different threats and reward. Carefully choose the lane to push hard, the lane to sacrifice.

Draft from fantasy races (dogs) with distinct mechanics and synergies. Some good at long-term scaling, others thrive on burst and execution, some overwhelm with summoning and swarms, while others win through control and endurance. Read the run, adapt your plan, and discover builds that only come together when your choices align.

Async PvP matches your build against other players’ builds. Test your planning and deployment skills at your own pace. A run is made up of repeated rounds of drafting and battling. Win battle after battle, defeat all challengers, and claim the final victory.

games.name: The Umbral Seal
games.shortDescription: WoW raid mechanics meet FTL's pause-and-plan combat. Command 5-20 heroes through 30+ tactical boss encounters. No grinding. No filler. Pure single-player boss-rush strategy.
games.aboutText:
THE UMBRAL SEAL brings World of Warcraft raid boss mechanics to single-player tactical combat.

Command warbands of 5-20 heroes through 30+ boss encounters designed around WoW-style mechanics—adapted for real-time-with-pause gameplay. Learn telegraphs, manage cooldowns, coordinate positioning, and execute perfect strategies.

No grinding. No filler. No scheduling. Just you, your warband, and perfectly crafted boss fights.

INSPIRED BY

- World of Warcraft raid mechanics (adapted for single-player tactical combat)

- FTL: Faster Than Light (pause-based tactical decision making)

TACTICAL COMBAT

- Real-time with pause - Plan every move, execute perfectly

- Command 5-hero parties (Normal), 10-hero raids (Heroic), or up to 20-hero epic battles (Mythic)

- Telegraph system shows incoming attacks - learn, adapt, survive

- Group controls let you manage large raids efficiently

BUILD YOUR WARBAND

- 8+ playable classes: Sentinel, Sharpshooter, Elementalist, Lifeweaver, Bladedancer, and more

- Compose your perfect party - bring 2 tanks, 3 healers, or all DPS if you dare

- Multiple heroes of the same class allowed (run 3 Sentinels if needed!)

- Unlock new classes by freeing corrupted Orders

BOSS ENCOUNTERS

- Early Access: 12+ unique bosses across 3 chapters

- Full Release: 30+ bosses across 8 chapters

- Each boss has distinct mechanics requiring different strategies

- Learn on Normal, master on Heroic, perfect on Mythic

DESIGN PHILOSOPHY

- Tactical depth over graphical spectacle

- Tabletop-style character tokens let you focus on mechanics, not animations

- Text-based storytelling keeps spotlight on boss encounter design

- AI-generated assets will be replaced during Early Access with commissioned art

THE STORY

Commander Thorne sealed the Umbral Tyrant 23 years ago by splitting the seal into seven pieces - one for each of the seven Orders.

But an eighth piece remained, hidden and corrupted, linking all the others like roots through soil.

Now the Blight spreads. The Orders have fallen. You must recover the seal fragments before the Tyrant breaks free.

EARLY ACCESS CONTENT (TBD)

Early Access launches with:

- 3 complete chapters (12+ boss encounters)

- 7 playable classes

- Normal and Heroic difficulties

- Commander Powers (raid-wide abilities)

- Complete story with text-based cutscenes

- Practice mode for cleared encounters

- AI generated assets (maps and character tokens)

EARLY ACCESS CONTENT PROGRESSION

- Content will be gradually added into Early Access (no content gating until 1.0 is ready)

- AI generated assets will be gradually replaced

Estimated EA Duration: 6-12 months

Estimated 10-20 hours for a Normal playthrough, with significantly more for Heroic mastery and alternate party compositions.

FULL RELEASE (1.0) WILL ADD

- Chapters 4-8 (completing the story)

- Mythic difficulty (20-hero raids, unforgiving mechanics)

- Additional classes and specializations

- Workshop integration

- Story conclusion

- Challenge modes and polish based on your feedback

games.name: Tidespawn
games.shortDescription: Dive into a magical underwater world in this pixel art action-adventure RPG for 1–2 players in local couch co-op. Explore sunken ruins, battle fearsome sea creatures, uncover lost memories, and shape your destiny beneath the tides.
games.aboutText:
Dive into Tidespawn, an underwater action-adventure RPG. Fight fast, tactical battles alongside a fish companion who transforms into a trident and more. Explore a vast ocean of lost kingdoms and ancient ruins, and plan around the moon cycle, where each phase changes the world and the Blood Moon makes enemies stronger. All in modern, retro-inspired pixel art.

Play solo or bring a friend. Optional local co-op lets two players explore the world, fight enemies, and complete quests together, with shared progression throughout the adventure.

Uncover a rich narrative told through the world around you. Meet unique underwater creatures, make choices that shape every encounter, and face unexpected twists and events along the way. Relive playable memories and take on side quests as you piece together the secrets of a forgotten world.

Fight alongside Neptune, a fish companion who transforms into a trident and more. Dash through fast-paced combat, unlock and upgrade cloaks with unique abilities, and combine them to fight your way. Face strategic bosses, each one revealing more secrets of a forgotten world.

games.name: Fishing Inc
games.shortDescription: Fishing Inc is a cozy incremental fishing game! Catch fish, earn cash, and unlock powerful skills. Master new ponds, fill your Fish Log with Legendary catches, and become the ultimate angler!
games.aboutText:
Fishing Inc is an addictive incremental fishing game! Catch fish, earn cash, and unlock powerful skills. Master new ponds, fill your Fish Log with Legendary catches, and become the ultimate angler.

Then put your skills to the test in Roguelike Mode , a whole extra way to play with a fresh run every time!

Catch Fish!

Travel to a variety of fishing spots and catch every fish that lives there! When a fish bites, click as fast as you can to hit the target before it gets away!

Log Your Catches

The more you catch a species, the better you get at it. Learn its tricks to land bigger, higher-quality fish! You'll discover many species as you travel from one fishing spot to the next!

Upgrades

To become the best angler, you'll need the best gear. Back from a fishing trip, spend your hard-earned money on upgrades that help you catch bigger and more exotic fish!

Roguelike Mode

Finished the campaign? Roguelike Mode is a bonus mode built for replayability, with a fresh run every time you play! Start from nothing and make the daily quota , or your run is over. Catch fish to hit your target, then pick one of three random augments to shape your run.

- 29 augments across Rare, Epic and Legendary

- Quotas that climb every day

- Easy and Normal to start, and beat a run to unlock Hard and Endless

games.name: Elestrals Awakened
games.shortDescription: The elemental forces that once held balance have begun to unravel. Long ago, divine power was shattered across the stars, giving birth to the creatures now known as Elestrals. As darkness stirs and conflict brews, the Gods call upon new Champions to rise. Will you protect the world?
games.aboutText:
Overview

In a world shaped by Gods and Titans, the elemental forces that once held balance have begun to unravel. Long ago, divine power was shattered across the stars, giving birth to the creatures now known as Elestrals. As darkness stirs and conflict brews among the realms, the Gods call upon new Champions to rise. Will you protect the world… or reshape its destiny?

Elestrals Awakened is epic 2.5D single-player action-adventure, monster tamer RPG video game that puts you at the center of the Elestrals Universe.

Born from the smash-hit trading card game, Elestrals Awakened brings the rich lore, elemental forces, and epic adventures into a fully realized interactive world. Step into the role of a Caster, forge a bond with a Spirit companion, and explore the elemental lands as tensions rise and ancient powers awaken!

Gameplay

Choose Your Starter!

Eons ago, eight elemental spirits shaped the balance of the world. Earth, Fire, Water, Thunder, Wind, Frost, Solar, and Lunar. Each one embodies a force of nature, guiding those who align with its essence.

Now, as your journey begins, you must choose one of these elements and forge a sacred bond with its spirit. The element you choose will empower your abilities and mark your path as a Caster, shaping the way you clash, grow, and connect with the world around you.

Teratlas , the Earth Spirit values patience and growth. Sproutyr embodies this spirit, ascending into Centaurbor , a steadfast protector who believes strength is rooted in nurturing bonds and growing together.
