Vipyro , the Fire Spirit burns with passion and loyalty. Necruff embodies this fierce devotion, ascending into the unstoppable guardian Trifernal , whose multiple heads watch over allies with unwavering determination. For Necruff, friendship is a flame that never dies!

Leviaphin , the Water Spirit flows with adaptability and calm. Sluggle embodies this laid-back nature, riding life's currents until ascending into Majesea , a serene yet formidable force beneath the waves. Sometimes the deepest waters run strongest!

Zaptor , the Thunder Spirit crackles with endless energy and excitement. Quackle embodies this electrifying spirit, playfully sparking chaos before ascending into Ohmperial , a majestic warrior whose elegance strikes like lightning. When opportunity calls, Quackle answers with a shock!

Lycarus, the Wind Spirit drifts with deceptive strength and resilience. Hydrake embodies this determination, appearing gentle yet unshakable in battle before ascending into Penterror , the five-headed tempest that refuses to be blown away. True power doesn't need to shout!

Flurrmine , the Frost Spirit thrives through adaptation and resilience. Kryoling embodies this cool confidence, loafing around until trouble freezes over, then ascending into Kryoscorch , a fearsome dragon whose icy fury leaves opponents cold. Chill today, conquer tomorrow!

Luminape , the Solar Spirit radiates joy and warmth under the brightest skies. Sundile embodies this sunny disposition, lazily while charging its inner light before ascending into Chronodile , a radiant protector of rivers and lakes. Every dawn brings new strength to shine!

Owlune , the Lunar Spirit glides silently through moonlit skies with grace. Fawnlit embodies this quiet elegance, treading softly through shadows before ascending into Posthumoose , a proud and heartfelt creature of the night. In darkness, courage shines brightest!

Bonding with an Elestral

Explore the world, clash against powerful Elestrals, and form lasting bonds with them. To bond successfully , time your moves carefully, press the directional keys in sync with the stars to strengthen your connection!

Stellar Elestrals

In Elestrals Awakened , players can embark on an exciting journey to discover Stellars : rare, alternate-color versions of Elestrals that shine with celestial brilliance.

Each Stellar isn’t just visually unique, they’re stronger than their standard counterparts, possessing an additional Spirit Core that grants them a second combat Trait , unlocking powerful new synergies and strategies.

Stellar Hunting Methods:

- Overworld Encounters: Stellars can appear naturally in the world for sharp-eyed adventurers to discover. These will have visual and audio queues.

- Tall Grass Battles: Rare encounters while exploring the wilds.

- Clash Chaining: Defeat an Elestral to instantly trigger another Clash, increasing your odds of finding a Stellar.

- Chain Fishing: Cast your line and maintain a streak to uncover aquatic Stellars.

- Nexus Discoveries: Use the Nexus mechanic to reveal hidden Stellars through elemental resonance.

Best of all, every Elestral in the game can be Stellar-hunted : no locks, no limits, just the thrill of discovery.

These Stellar Elestrals will be rare and rewarding and we can't wait to allow you to explore the brilliant world of Elestrals Awakened!

Game Modes

Once you finish the main story on any save file, you'll unlock special game modes. The

games.name: Flavio The Ghost Clown
games.shortDescription: Battle challenging bosses in this Run & Gun action game. Generate resources in a tycoon-style workshop and upgrade your equipment in the shop to guide Flavio through these bizarre battles!
games.aboutText:
Play as Flavio or Mimi in single-player or local co-op . Face intense boss fights , fast-paced " Run & Gun " and " Fly & Gun " levels. Manage your resources in a mini tycoon-style workshop and upgrade your gear, including bullet types, charms, and melee weapons.

Every battle demands preparation, gather and upgrade powerful equipment through exploration and the shop:

- 8 Different bullet types (Shooter).

- 10 Unique charms that grants or improve extra abilities (Charmer).

- 5 Different Melee weapons (Hitter).

- 3 Special Powers (Power).

Each part of the Circus hides a magical workshop . Build your own manual or automatic machines to gather resources and produce Souls . Use them as you wish, for survival, power, or social reputation.

Quests, currency & Karma point system:

In the Circus, Souls serve as currency, used in both the shop and the workshop. However, your choices in how you earn and spend them affect your Karma Points.

Your Karma defines your reputation across the Circus. Positive or negative Karma influences how others treat you and determines the special rewards you can unlock from the Karma Tester Machine.

Story:

Flavio awakens in a strange place, surrounded by the ruins of a vast circus. Fragments of memories rush through his mind, unclear, distant. Discover what happened, why he’s there, and how to escape.

games.name: Stillwell
games.shortDescription: Minesweeper meets horror. Deterministic grid puzzles with clear rules. Use your lantern, flashlight, and chalk to escape before your oxygen runs out.
games.aboutText:
STILLWELL – A Memorial in Darkness

Elena went missing investigating Stillwell Sanatorium. Now you're going in after her.

MINESWEEPER IN THE DARK

Each ward is a grid. Spirits are hidden. Every step costs oxygen.

Lantern - reacts to nearby spirits. Steady means safe. Trembling means caution. Extinguished means danger.
Flashlight - reveals what's hidden, but exposed spirits move. Information at a cost.
Chalk - marks confirmed danger without disturbing the board. Safe, but limited.

TENSION CURVE

Calm - Explore and gather information while resources are plentiful.
Strategy - Oxygen runs low, tools are limited, and every deduction matters.
Panic - Mistakes compound, visibility is scarce, and survival becomes urgent.

REMEMBER THE VICTIMS

Three record fragments per ward tell the story through bureaucratic documents and Elena's fragmented messages. Not all records survived. Connect the pieces yourself.

AN ATMOSPHERIC MEMORIAL

No jump scares. No combat. Only the weight of institutional failure and the stories of people who deserved better.

Stillwell does not ask you to fight. It asks you to witness, to document, and when you can, to offer mercy.

Complete Elena's work . Document the names.

games.name: Dream about yoU
games.shortDescription: A dashing blond partner drops in from the sky, declaring they're taking responsibility for you—but they need a small favor.Find them in your dreams, wake them up, and crack the dream maze. Sci-fi comedy, adventure starts now!
games.aboutText:
*All in-game text was localized by professional human translators for a natural, authentic experience.

Dream about yoU is a story-driven narrative puzzle game

You're free to choose the gender of both the protagonist and your partner

Your choices affect everything visible: character portraits, sprites, dialogue, forms of address, CGs, and more

IIn 204X, rising seas have swallowed the land. Humanity lives on artificial islands,

with the intelligent system ELYSION running society.

People believe everything will be *better*.

You will dive into dreams, traveling from mountain villages to underwater castles.

Fulfill people's heartfelt wishes and uncover the massive secret hidden within yourself.

games.name: Genome Guardian 2
games.shortDescription: COMBINE WEAPONS in the microscopic shooter with macroscopic depth. BUILD YOUR NANOBOT from hundreds of parts. SURVIVE the microbial onslaught once more in this psychedelic dive to the Abyss, full of mutations, minerals, anomalies and powerup polyps. SHMUP mode turns it into a vertical shoot 'em up!
games.aboutText:
Dive back into the microscopic world, radiating with bioluminescent life and unspeakable horrors.

Research permanent upgrades to survive a variety of microbes & modes in this massively expanded follow-up to Genome Guardian.

Build your own biomechanical death machine from different parts to define how it shoots, behaves & moves !

Make stationary turrets, psychic water sprinkler motorbikes, or maybe a dual-wielding fidget spinner Gundam.

- Easily recreate your favourite turrets from the first game…or combine em' all into one frankenstein monstrosity

- Save/Load 24 loadouts

- Paint & Pattern customization

Pair DNA nucleotides A (rapidfire) , C (precision) , G (spread) , T (explosive) to discover 70 hybrid bioweapons !

- Shotgun + Bomb mix explosives with spread for Blast Shotgun !

- SMG + Pistol make an accurate, fast-firing Scout Rifle !

- Blast Shotgun + Scout Rifle = something a whole lot crazier !

- 20-minute runs you can save & resume at any time + improved Endless Mode

- Complete side objectives during runs for extra cash

- Mine mineral deposits for resources

- Trigger powerful Gadget active abilities

- Test discovered weapons in the Database

- 100 bassy electronic tunes with in-game Jukebox accessible any time + Streamer Mode

- Auto aim/fire toggles

- Localization in 10 languages

- Full rebinding for keyboard & gamepad

- 400% better performance/framerate on high & low-end PCs

- Accessibility for colourblindness, motion sickness & arachnophobia

- 100 Steam achievements

- Cloud Save

- Plays great on Steam Deck!

games.name: VHOLUME
games.shortDescription: VHOLUME is a melancholic first-person parkour adventure set in a dystopian brutalist city where bureaucracy turns a simple task into an odyssey.
games.aboutText:
In the derelict capital of Afro-Eurasia, ruled by an all-controlling Ministry, Robert embarks on a bureaucratic quest to restore his family’s revoked ration tickets .

Movement-centric gameplay where the player can jump, run, climb and slide with great freedom . Environments challenge both agility and creativity .

Mastery-driven players can exploit momentum, discover shortcuts , and break the labyrinthine design, making each run a test of skill and efficiency as they chase target times .

Play solo, or join friends in multiplayer and experience every level together.

See other players’ ghosts, share your own, and discover new ways through each level.

Steam workshop support: Play levels made by the community or create your own.

games.name: Duola Mage
games.shortDescription: Duola Mage is a fast-paced roguelike action game: multiple characters × hundreds of weapons × randomized builds = a fresh mowing experience every run. Climb the roguelike ladder floor by floor, each layer more exhilarating. Out-of-run progression: level-60 cap + stat allocation + equipment forging!
games.aboutText:
【Duola Mage】 is an independently developed roguelike combat game. The core gameplay revolves around endlessly challenging the Spire—every wave of enemies you defeat raises your floor level by 1. The further you go, the stronger you become.

Objective: Climb the roguelike tower, forge equipment, level up, and grow stronger.

Combat Overview: The character possesses four core combat abilities: Special Skill, Ultimate Skill (Finisher), Execution, and Parry.

- Special Skill: Released when energy is fully charged. It is your most powerful source of damage.

- Finisher: When your combo count exceeds 50, continue using normal attacks—the final strike will automatically trigger the Finisher.

- Execution: When any enemy is stunned (their white posture bar is fully depleted), press R to execute them. The execution window lasts 7 seconds.

- Parry: Right-click at the moment of an enemy's attack to successfully parry. After a perfect parry, continuously right-click to launch a counterattack.

Weapons: Greatswords, katanas, bows, staves, gauntlets, and more—each weapon features unique skills. All weapons and equipment can be upgraded. We also pay homage to classic weapons from the Warcraft universe.

Characters: Players can own multiple characters simultaneously and switch between them freely during combat. Each character has a unique appearance and fighting style—such as a brutal and heavy-hitting female warrior, a nimble and agile elven archer, an elegant and carefree swordsman, and a flashy yet violent spacetime mage.

⚠️ Duola Mage is a small indie title slowly crafted by a solo developer — no big-studio funding, no top-tier art, and no way to measure up to leading anime blockbusters. We simply wanted to quietly make an adventure game with a different playstyle and a fresh, cute art style. If you happen to enjoy this kind of relaxing, heartwarming genre, choosing us is definitely the right call! Please consider carefully before purchasing and spend as needed. Thank you to every friend who supports indie games! ⚠️

● Trial Meat Pigeon Gameplay

Roguelike Trial Gameplay Each time you enter the roguelike dungeon, 2-3 random routes are generated, with random enemies and supply points distributed along each path. Completing a dungeon run rewards 2-3 types of crafting materials, which can be used at the Blacksmith in the main city to forge armor, weapons, and other equipment. The Buffs obtained in each roguelike dungeon run are completely random.

Classic 3-choice Buff selection, random Boss appears every 3 floors, and materials are chosen freely. Scenes switch randomly, so you'll never be stuck defending one place.

● BUFF Build

Build Buffs Roguelike Buffs: Defeat enemies to choose 1 of 3 random buffs. Minions drop Tier-1 buffs, Elites drop Tier-2 buffs. Most temporary buffs are time-limited food effects that provide immediate combat boosts during the current roguelike run. Build Buffs: Defeat Bosses to obtain Build Buffs—permanent buffs that persist across runs and greatly enhance character abilities. Press N at any time to view all active buffs. Buffs can be applied to normal attacks, special skills, finishers, and executions.

● Solo Boss Challenges

Solo Boss Challenges Currently there are 9 solo Boss challenge stages. Difficulties are divided into: Easy, Hard, and Hell. Ratings range from S/A/B/C/D, with rewards split into fixed stage rewards and rating-based rewards. The higher your rating, the more materials you receive. Rating factors include: completion time, buffs acquired, and optional objectives.

● Mounts

Adorable and cute mounts accompany you on your adventures..

● Super exciting battles with clearly defined classes

Izumi Nao

Samurai—requires precise skill: drawing the sword in one motion, instant dash slashes, timing attacks carefully, and using a cold blade to strike the throat.

Bella

Mage — a mobile turret, a bit fragile, but with Black Hole and Meteor, a godly clearing skill, perfect for mowing down enemies.

Andrew

Druid — transform into a werewolf, summon a storm eagle, and embody the explosive power of nature and beastliness.

Lucian

Elf Archer — Explosive Dragon Arrow, Dragon Capturing Kick, Agile Movements, Unerring Aim.

Deca

Phoenix — Summon fire dragons and the song of the phoenix, incorporating the art of flames into combat to scorch enemies.

Disi

Descendant of the Valkyrie — The Wrath of the War God confronts the dragon head-on.

● Weapon Special Skill

Each weapon has unique special skills, which you can match with characters as you like. There are over a hundred weapons to choose from, but only five are shown below.

Weapon Skill: [Adrian's Moonlight]

Weapon Skill: [Faith Rune] Passive Skill: [Faith Holy Light Arrow]

【Blood Sacrifice Greatsword】"Blood Extractor"

Weapon Skill: 【Blood Altar】 Passive Skill: 【Blood Mark】

【Skull Frost Staff】"A Song of Ice and Fire"

Weapon Skill: 【Summo

games.name: LineForgeBlackSmith
games.shortDescription: A blacksmith shop with a "line" of unique adventurers! Use your memory and timing mini-games to quickly identify each customer's preferred weapon and forge it. In the Battle Phase, your armed customers fight. Power up your regulars (MVPs) and defeat the bosses. Become the busiest blacksmith!
games.aboutText:
――Can you keep track of 100 regular customers?――

The Weaponsmith with a Line Out the Door Send 100 villagers into battle with your weapons.

◆A Blacksmith Simulation Where You Talk, Craft, and Send Troops into Battle

“Memory × Deduction × Timed Action”

Determine each villager’s “specialty weapon” through conversation, forge it at just the right moment, and send them into battle.

The more you learn, the more efficient you become—eventually, you’ll be able to send over 100 soldiers into battle with your own hands!

◆Villagers Who Fight with Your Weapons

The villagers you send out fight automatically. Their strength and performance vary depending on the weapon you choose.

Give “nicknames” to villagers who perform well so you can easily remember them as regulars.

◆A Story That Begins with a Dragon’s Carcass

The sudden appearance of a dragon’s carcass triggers a monster attack on a once-peaceful village.

This is the story of a girl who had given up on her dreams, but finds the strength to look forward once more.

Other Features

- Shop Feature: You can purchase power-ups to make your blacksmithing more efficient.

- Gacha Feature: Expand your roster of adventurers and enjoy filling out your encyclopedia.

- Encyclopedia Feature: Collect information on customers and weapons that appear in the game.

- Defeat the boss to clear a stage. Aim to clear all 4 stages.

The blacksmithing segment tests your memory and quick decision-making, while the battle segment directly depends on the quality of the weapons you craft. Aim to become the best weaponsmith and build a shop with a long line of customers!

games.name: Void Crawlers
games.shortDescription: Void Crawlers is a Top-down Rogue-Lite Incremental Shooter, there are 3 initial games modes, Arcade - Room to room combat, Gauntlet - 30 minute invasion, and Story - A combination of Arcade and Gauntlet mode with a story on top.
games.aboutText:
Message from the Developer:
*Due to the positive feedback from testing, and my very high standards, I have decided to push early access to sometime in 2027 , my apologies, please bear with me in my solo developer journey to finish this game.

You awaken, to the dim hum of your spaceship's emergency system, sparks fly from your console, as you look up through the windshield, you see a space station that appears to be non-functional, the vast emptiness is unsettling, complimented by an eerie feeling like something is watching you, firing up your spaceship and escaping is your main priority.

With your spaceship on the brink of failure, but functionally intact, you move through out the space station, heading from room to room, searching for some way out of here.

Arriving at a mechanical looking room, with what appears to be a switch, and upon activation, the space station starts to come to life, you witness the room light up and activate, that must've been the space station's core restarting, from the depths of the unknown you hear a scream.

This space station is alive! You need to find the exit, and fast. The room appears to be making what can only be described as a loud pulsating noise, looking over to the walls, you can see exactly what was making that noise, a throbbing, mutated organism, that has appeared to have embedded itself into the space station, what on earth could this monstrosity be?

The game consists of 3 game modes.

Arcade: You start off with a starter ship, that you then can customize with guns and exhausts (So far), then upon starting, the map is randomly generated complete with bonus rooms, this isn't just single rooms, some rooms can be stitched together for a bigger room, next, you go room to room, fighting enemies in a rogue-lite incremental gameplay, going down floors with tougher enemies, if the game is too tough, then you can take what you earned in game and start upgrading, if you die, you lose the ship you spawned in with.

Gauntlet: When you begin, you pick your ship, but this is where the similarities end with arcade mode, you are able to pick different open ended levels, unlocking each of these, and performing different tasks to unlock more ships, abilities and levels, each level has different types of modes from a typical wave base incremental style game, to defending the reactor from waves.

Story: A combination of the above 2 game modes, you start off with a crashed ship, you then make your way through rooms and arrive at to what the hub is, perform different tasks, the goal is to hit the core of the space station, to unravel what has happened to everything.

games.name: MioAquaria
games.shortDescription: Build and manage a cozy underwater sandbox aquarium run by cats. Discover fantasy sea creatures, research upgrades, send expeditions, and balance fish, staff, and visitor needs to become the world’s top aquarium.
games.aboutText:
Mio Aquaria is a cozy sandbox aquarium management game set in a whimsical world of water.
Build your aquarium from nothing, care for fantasy aquatic creatures from across the world , and lead a team of cat staff as you rise through the ranks to become the world’s greatest aquarium.

Core Challenge

Design freely, explore the depths, and solve the core challenge of Mio Aquaria :
balancing the needs of aquatic creatures and cats to create a thriving, attractive aquarium.

🐠 Build and Customize Your Aquarium

Create your aquarium your way using sandbox-style construction.
Build spaces, place facilities, and design tanks that balance water quality, temperature, and creature compatibility.

Hosting a diverse mix of aquatic creatures increases your aquarium’s attractiveness — but only if their needs are met.

🌊 Discover Fantasy Aquatic Creatures

Explore the world to discover new resources, materials, and new inhabitants for your tanks.
The creatures of Mio Aquaria are inspired by real aquatic life, but reimagined as fantasy beings with unique traits and requirements.

Some aquatic creatures can only be unlocked through exploration or research.

🐱 Manage Cats, Not Just Buildings

Your aquarium is run entirely by cats — staff and visitors alike.

- Staff cats need fair pay and comfortable working conditions

- Visitor cats come to see their favorite creatures, but also expect food, drinks, rest, leisure, and shopping

- Ignore their needs, and strikes or reputation loss may follow

Keeping cats happy is just as important as keeping aquatic creatures healthy.

🔬 Research, Progress, and Optimize

Research new policies and perks to improve your aquarium’s efficiency and appeal.

- Unlock new aquatic creatures and gameplay mechanics

- Increase visitor capacity, tips, and inventory space

- Improve staff effectiveness and aquarium operations

Multiple resources shape your strategy, including Coins, Materials, Research Points, and Hearts earned by satisfying visitors.

🏆 Compete for Reputation

Take part in regular aquarium contests and compete against rival aquariums.
Earn reputation, climb the global rankings, and challenge the industry giant Star V. Co.

To truly complete your journey, you’ll need to discover and host a legendary creature — the ultimate test of your aquarium mastery.

🌦 A Living World

Weather conditions such as cloudy or rainy days affect atmosphere, visitors, and aquarium operations, introducing unique challenges that require thoughtful planning and adaptation.

games.name: EverRail
games.shortDescription: An open world survival craft game for 1 to 4 players, set on a frozen exomoon where your base is a train carrying the last of humanity, and standing still is slowly killing it. Fight, scavenge, and craft your way to a train 1,000 wagons long. But every death costs you a passenger.
games.aboutText:
It's your base, your shelter, and everyone aboard's last chance at survival. Explore the exomoon Inara solo or in co-op with up to 4 players.

Your train is your only refuge in an endless frozen world. When you die, another passenger steps forward and takes your place. As long as survivors remain, your journey continues. Rescue trapped passengers scattered in abandoned facilities across Inara and build up your society one survivor at a time.

Your mission for survival lies above everything. Venture into dangerous locations filled with valuable resources, technology, hidden secrets, and unforgiving battles . But if you explore for too long, you may risk losing everything.

The train's battery recharges while it's moving and drains when it stands still . Every expedition and every decision you make revolves around this single rule. Manage your train's power, maintain its systems, and never let the battery reach zero or your journey ends. Move or freeze.

Conquer Inara by crafting new weapons, armor, tools, gliders, and essential machinery . Expand and upgrade your train as you push farther along the tracks. Attach hundreds of new wagons to increase storage, boost production, and build out your own logistics.

Your glider puts eyes in the sky over the frozen landscape before you ever set foot on it. Scout new locations, harvest rare isotopes for crafting, and identify threats from above by deploying scan drones into the depths of Inara.

Inara Never Looks the Same Twice

Abandoned facilities, deadly anomalies, and survivors waiting to be rescued are scattered across a procedurally generated world that never repeats. Every run brings new routes, new dangers, and new reasons to keep the train running.

Shape EverRail with us

The exomoon is called Inara because the community chose that name. The lore exists because players helped us refine it. Throughout Early Access, EverRail is built alongside the players. Features, systems, game balance, and story will continue to evolve based on the community that keeps the train running.

So join our Steam Community and Discord and shape the game with us!

games.name: Emissary One
games.shortDescription: Co-op horror (1 to 6+ players). The squad was sent to the next site, but contact was lost. Find them and team up for the current mission. It seems you're not alone here again.
games.aboutText:
The squad was sent to the next site, but contact was lost. Find them and team up for the current mission. It seems you're not alone here again.

- Various creepy monsters.

- Play the story campaign alone or with a company online (up to 6 players or more) or with splitscreen multiplayer (up to 2 people).

- A large changing location with lots of exploration. Explore the area and complete tasks. Use vehicles to reach hard-to-access areas more quickly. Adapt to changing weather.

- Communicate via voice chat in the game online.

- Invade other players’ worlds as hostile entities.

games.name: 我的机器人女友
games.shortDescription: This is a simulation game that combines nurturing with romance.You'll cultivate a one-of-a-kind robotic girlfriend while sharing romantic moments with multiple girls, each possessing distinct personalities.
games.aboutText:
- 情感沟通解锁隐藏剧情 -

与女友真诚而深入的交谈，加深彼此的羁绊。用心倾听，真诚的回应，将获得特殊道具，开启那些不为人知的隐藏故事线。

- 与不同的女孩每日约会 -

告别单一的剧情线！每天都可以选择与不同的女孩共度时光，每天都是一场全新的缘分探索。你的每一次选择，都将引领你走向截然不同的缘分终点。

- 多样的趣味互动游戏 -

多样化的互动小游戏，是你与女孩增进感情的催化剂。在轻松愉快的挑战中赢得女孩们的青睐，收获的不只是奖励，更是她脸颊上的一抹红晕。

- 养成你的专属机器人女友 -

不再是固定的程序设定，而是你亲手养成的伴侣。从零开始，通过日程训练，见证她的每一步成长，她的未来完全由你定义。

- 属于你的多重结局 -

故事每个阶段都会有你最心动的女孩，在与她们经历不同的故事后，你将做出选择。谁会成为你最终的羁绊，多种不同的结局，选择专属于你的最终篇章。

【致《我的机器人女友》玩家的一封信】

亲爱的玩家：

当你点开这封信时，或许正好奇这个充满温度的恋爱养成世界，背后藏着怎样的故事。其实，它源于三个40+技术宅男的执念——我们用了整整三年，在代码与像素的世界里，笨拙地追寻着年少时的心动。

小时候，《心跳回忆》里的青涩告白、《美少女梦工厂》中看着角色成长的欣慰，是刻在青春里的温暖印记。那时就悄悄许愿，若能将恋爱的细腻与养成的成就感结合，该多好。三年前，这个念头终于落地，可现实远比想象艰难：真人互影技术的反复调试、剧情节奏的无数次推翻、情感表达的精准拿捏，每一步都走得磕磕绊绊。有过连续通宵后的崩溃，有过技术瓶颈时的迷茫，但每当想起年少时握着手柄的雀跃，便又咬牙坚持。

我们深知，作为中年大叔，或许不懂当下年轻人的潮流，但对"用心"的坚持从未改变。这款游戏里，每一段对话的打磨、每一个互动的设计，都藏着我们对经典的致敬，更藏着对"陪伴"的理解。我们尝试用大量真人互影技术，让虚拟女友的笑容更真实，让养成的每一步都充满心跳感——就像当年我们在游戏里，期待着角色的每一次成长。

三个技术宅男，用三年时光，把青春的回忆与对恋爱养成的热爱，酿成了这款《我的机器人女友》。它或许不完美，但每一处细节都满含诚意。

最后，我们必须衷心感谢联合出品方：北京凤麟互娱科技有限公司，无锡春天文化有限公司，北京幂播文化传媒科技有限公司，杭州蓝鲸网络科技有限公司。在项目推进的日夜中，正是他们的信任与鼎力支持，让我们得以将这份“笨拙的热爱”转化为真实可触的世界，让梦想的微光终成燎原之火。

期待你能走进这个世界，与机器人女友共赴一场温柔的邂逅。也恳请你多一份包容与支持，你的每一次反馈，都是我们前行的动力。

《我的机器人女友》研发团队

三个坚守热爱的中年技术宅

2025.11

games.name: TROLLHEIM: GNOMES
games.shortDescription: Explore an ancient, living forest as a tiny gnome in this co-op PVE survival crafting adventure inspired by Nordic folklore. Gather, craft and build a home for your gnome family amongst the treetops, and encounter the Väsen, mythical beings both friendly and dangerous. Play solo or up to 8 players
games.aboutText:
The last Sprýg Gnomes in Midgård are driven from their home by Oden and his corruption, leaving them one place left to go: Trollheim, a magical realm of mythical beings where trolls, faeries and sirens are real. Set out into the unknown to reunite with your lost kin, and behold the untold tales of the Väsen who dwell in the Dark Forest alongside you.

TROLLHEIM: GNOMES is a PvE survival adventure where you must reunite your gnome companions to survive and thrive together in the Dark Forest. Explore an ancient Nordic wilderness, uncover its mysteries, encounter the Väsen - the mythical beings of Nordic folk belief, and make the forest your home. Play solo or with up to 7 friends in a procedurally grown forest sandbox.

The Dark Forest found you.

Into the Dark Forest

Step into an ancient forest through the eyes of a tiny gnome. Every tall pine, mossy hill and damp rock is a climb, and every climb is a challenge of its own. Stumble across scattered gnome dwellings, delve into mossy caverns and explore carefully curated biomes teeming with life.

The pressure to survive drives you forward, opening up new possibilities and discoveries as the Dark Forest reveals itself as a living world of mystery, wonder and danger. Cold, hunger and hidden threats push you to adapt. Gather blueberries and twigs, craft everything from arrows to musical instruments. This is a wilderness not just meant to be explored, but a place to understand and ultimately call home.

Live Among the Väsen

The Väsen: Trolls, faeries, sirens and other mythical beings also call the Dark Forest home, each one handcrafted and drawn from the World of Trollheim. Some will wander over and join you by the campfire. Some will attack on sight. Calm their nerves or offer them something in return, and they might even come and live with you.

Make the Forest Your Home

Let creativity shape your dwelling, wherever feels like home. Build idyllic housing in the treetops, within hollowed logs, tucked into rock crevices or by the mist-filled forest lakes. Add bridges, clad your walls in moss and set some low lighting, whether you're blending into nature or standing out as uniquely yours.

Survive and Thrive

TROLLHEIM: GNOMES is a place to connect with yourself, nature, and each other. It is fully playable solo offline or in co-op with friends, supporting up to 8 players.

For more adventures in the Dark Forest visit our website

Enter the Dark Forest and the untold tales of Väsen through an interconnected narrative spanning books, collectibles, music, games, and more.

games.name: The Plant Shop
games.shortDescription: A cozy horror game where you craft plants for late-night customers while you manage a small plant shop. Expand your plant collection, upgrade your shop & grow your business.
games.aboutText:
The Plant Shop is a cozy horror game where you manage a small plant shop.

Craft plants, serve late-night customers and grow your plant collection to attract more people.

You play as Silvia, a 26 years old girl who decides to open her own small plant shop on a late-night shift because she has a corporate job during the day.

Your job is to serve the customers coming to the shop. Depending on the order you will have to craft flowers, plants or cacti.

Crafting plants is easy. You just need a plant pot, soil, a seed and water.

The customers talk about a curse that struck the town 30 years ago. As you manage your shop, you begin to see and hear strange things. Is the curse real—or just an old legend?

FEATURES

- Gameplay: Narrative walking simulator with a simple game loop: take orders from customers, craft plants and serve them.

- VHS film aesthetics: Emulates the look of old CRT screens that adds an eerie atmosphere.

- Immersive Story: Experience Silvia’s journey and uncover the truth about The Plant Shop and the strange events happening in town.

- Multiple Endings.

GAME MODES

- Story Mode: Follow Silvia's dream of having a successful Plant Shop.

- Relaxed Mode: Manage your own cozy Plant Shop at your own pace.

- Endless Mode (with leaderboard) : Fulfill orders against the clock and try to survive as long as possible.

FOR CONTENT CREATORS

You are free to create content from the game and monetize the gameplay by any means.

games.name: Motorsport Park Manager
games.shortDescription: Build and customize your own motorsports park in this classic tycoon simulation. Start with local go-kart tracks and grassroots circuits, and grow into a world-renowned racing destination.
games.aboutText:
From simple skidpads to iconic racing venues, create the ultimate motorsports destination. Design detailed circuits, expand your facilities, and grow from a local track into a world-renowned racing destination.

Three Different Ways To Play!

- Test your business skills in Challenge Mode ! Start with a plot of land and pocket full of change, and work your way up from a small local track to a world class racing location

- Take it easy in Sandbox Mode ! Build to your hearts desire without any stress or pressure, and place every detail and decoration to make your dream racetrack.

- Or take on hand crafted challenges in Scenario Mode. Inherit a deserted racetrack overdue for rennovation, fight off old loans, and overcome challenges in a variety of unique scenarios.

Powerful Track Builder

- Your world is built around your racetracks. Carve circuits through forests, mountains, deserts, and more.

- Adjust your track width, camber, elevation, and curbing to build a huge variety of dynamic racetracks. Every aspect of your racetrack is analyzed and rated to give you access to every type of event!

For Every Kind of Racing Experience

Design everything from beginner-friendly go-kart circuits and autocross courses to muddy rallycross tracks and professional race circuits.

Or Don’t

Keep things local with a dirty drift track and autocross skid pad, or expand to see what heights you can reach, the choice is yours!

games.name: Neko Station
games.shortDescription: Sit back and relax with Neko Station, a cozy 2D Pixel Art Desktop Idle Game! Manage your very own 'cat train,' decorating it with the perfect furniture to attract a diverse cast of feline customers. Pick them up at various stations and build friendships in this heartwarming adventure.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Neko Station!

Ever dreamed of owning your own train... that's completely filled with cats? Neko Station is a 2D Pixel Art Cozy Desktop Idle game that transforms your screen into an adorable, moving cat paradise!

Desktop idle screen

Adorable cat actions
In this game, you take on the role of a cat train manager. Your duty is to travel to various stations, picking up a wide array of feline customers waiting to board your special, customized train.

Build Your Dream Train
Attracting feline clients isn't just about showing up. You must decorate your train cars with a huge selection of cute furniture and decorations. Each cat has its own unique preferences! Some might love a soft cushion, others a scratching post, and some might just want a simple cardboard box. The right layout will attract different types of cats, and maybe even rare, special ones!

Streaming integration

connect to Twitch, YouTube, Kick and let your chat join your train as a cat

Befriend Your Feline Passengers Once the cats are aboard, it's time to interact! You can:

- Pet them: Show your affection and help them relax.

- Feed them: Offer delicious treats to build your relationship.

- Take Photos: Capture their adorable moments for your collection.

The better you care for them, the deeper your bond will become.

Discover Special Cats Beyond decorations, the stations you visit also influence which cats will appear. Pay close attention! You might find special cats in unique costumes or even legendary felines waiting to be discovered, all depending on your train's setup and destination.

Key Features:

- A Relaxing Idle Experience: Runs comfortably on your desktop. Let the train run and watch the cats come and go.

- Adorable Pixel Art: Enjoy a heartwarming and charming 2D pixel art style.

- Endless Decoration: Choose from hundreds of furniture items to create a one-of-a-kind train.

- A Wide Variety of Cats: Meet countless cats of different breeds, each with unique personalities and preferences.

- Relationship System: Pet, feed, and photograph your way to friendship with every cat.

- Discovery & Secrets: Find special cats tied to specific decorations and stations.

Get ready, and let's begin a truly heartwarming journey on the Neko Station train!

games.name: Smoke and Steel
games.shortDescription: Lead a nation through early 18th-century Europe in Smoke and Steel, a turn-based wargame combining grand strategy with tactical battles. Choose diplomacy or war. Build your economy, forge alliances and negotiate trade deals, then command your armies in battle. Outthink, outflank, outlast.
games.aboutText:
Smoke and Steel is a turn-based wargame blending tactical battles with grand strategy set during the early 18th century , an age of disciplined musket lines, thundering cavalry charges and battlefields swallowed by cannon smoke.

Command the armies of Europe in tactical battles where formation, positioning and morale decide the outcome, then lead your nation through campaigns of war, diplomacy, trade and technological change.

Every volley counts. Every step matters.

- Turn-Based Tactical Battles : Command historical units of infantry, cavalry and artillery in combat where morale, terrain and flanking shape the outcome.

- Turn-Based Grand Campaign : Lead a nation through early 18th-century Europe. Build your economy, forge alliances, negotiate trade deals and wage war.

- Great Northern War Story Campaign : Follow Sweden and King Charles XII through linked battles, with progression between engagements and alternate-history endings.

- Single-Player and Multiplayer : Challenge the AI, face other players online or play locally in hotseat.

- Seven Playable Nations : Command historical European powers, each with its own roster of units and unique administration.

- Map Editor and Modding Support : Build campaign and battle maps, create custom units and add your own nations. Create entirely new worlds.

Fight historical engagements from the Battle of Blenheim to the Battle of Poltava , or create your own skirmishes. Play against the AI or challenge other players online or in local hotseat.

Break their will to fight. Maintain your battle line, protect your flanks and concentrate fire where it matters. Rally wavering troops and exploit weaknesses before the enemy can recover.

Morale is as important as manpower. Sustained fire, flanking attacks and the sight of nearby allies routing can cause troops to lose their nerve and retreat. A single unit breaking at the wrong moment can trigger a chain reaction, turning an orderly battle line into a rout.

Command historically inspired units including Line Infantry, Grenadiers, Dragoons, Cuirassiers, Hussars and Field Artillery , each with a distinct role on the battlefield.

Forge your own path through early 18th-century Europe in the turn-based Grand Campaign , taking command of one of Europe's great powers.

Build your economy , manage trade and diplomacy , secure strategic resources and develop new technologies . Raise armies and decide where and when to commit them.

Logistics sustain both your economy and your armies. Keep goods moving between cities and supplies reaching the front. Protect your transport routes and disrupt the enemy's to weaken their ability to wage war.

The decisions you make on the campaign map shape the armies you command on the battlefield.

Take command of the Swedish army under King Charles XII through the unfolding Great Northern War . From the shores of Denmark to the vast plains of Russia, victory will demand discipline, resolve and careful judgement. Every march takes your soldiers farther from home. Every battle leaves fewer veterans to face the next.

History remembers a campaign of extraordinary victories that ended in catastrophe at Poltava . But history need not repeat itself. With progression between battles and alternate-history endings , Sweden's fate is not yet sealed.

Take command of the armies and nations of early-18th-century Europe in battle and campaign modes:

Kingdom of Sweden

Tsardom of Russia

Kingdom of England

Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth

Kingdom of Prussia

Kingdom of Denmark-Norway

Kingdom of France

Built by a developer with roots in modding, Smoke and Steel is designed with modding in mind from the outset .

Create your own units, nations and maps and play them in single-player or multiplayer battles.

games.name: Carmencarmen
games.shortDescription: You wake up on the beach, with water crashing against your body. You don't remember anything, you don't know where you are, and everything hurts. The meaningless mass of flesh and metal seems to be breathing... It doesn't make sense, but it's breathing...
games.aboutText:
You wake up on the beach, with water crashing against your body. You don't remember anything, you don't know where you are, and everything hurts. The meaningless mass of flesh and metal seems to be breathing... It doesn't make sense, but it's breathing...

Despite everything, you are not alone. Talk to the beings of this fallen world and discover their stories as you help them with their deliveries. It's up to you whether you want to be kind to them or not. Have philosophical or banal conversations and don't forget to drift, ALWAYS drift. The road will hold you up.

The game lasts between 30 minutes and 1 hour and does not have a save system. It is designed to be played in a single session.

We recommend playing with a controller.

Controller:

- Left stick/D-pad: Steer.

- Right Stick: Move camera.

- R2: Accelerate.

- L2: Brake.

- L1: DRIFT.

- A button: Interact.

- B button: Horn.

- Y button: Inventory.

- X button: Headlights.

- Menu button (START): Pause menu.

Keyboard and mouse:

- WASD/Arrow keys: Move.

- Mouse: Move camera.

- Spacebar: Drift.

- E: Interact.

- F: Horn.

- I: Inventory.

- Q: Headlights.

- ESC: Pause menu.

games.name: Freefall '95
games.shortDescription: Chain massive trick combos, dodge deadly debris, and chase huge scores in this fast-paced arcade adventure. Earn coins, upgrade abilities, collect rare items, and uncover a wild time-bending narrative aboard this doomed flight in the year 1995
games.aboutText:
You're the sole survivor of a mid-air plane explosion, plummeting towards the earth. What do you do with the time you have left?

Might as well do some rad tricks.

Pull off huge combos, grab other people's falling luggage, and dodge dangerous debris to build up huge scores.

And then groundhog your way back to the plane and do it all again. Back on the plane you can interact with fellow passengers, buy stuff with your hard-earned coins, and take on quests to discover what might be causing this aviation nightmare.

Inspired by games like Tony Hawk's Pro Skater , SSX Tricky and other classic extreme sports games, Freefall '95 combines arcade score-chasing, exploration and an absurd time-bending story all wrapped in a heavily 90s-flavoured pixel-art world with a pumping soundtrack.

Features

- 5 sprawling levels evolving over 3 difficulty tiers, 15 stages in all, devolving into bullet hell mania

- A deep trick and combo system for chasing HUGE scores

- Arcade-style Challenge Levels for bite-sized, score-attack runs

- Roguelike Gauntlets: chain 3, 5, or 7 levels back-to-back on a single health bar, picking from 3 rewards when you achieve each goal

- An absurd, time-bending narrative

- Leaderboards, with friends-only and worldwide options

- Ability items that let you explore and experience levels in wild new ways

- Adjust your loadout with Traits and build a playstyle that works for you

games.name: Criticality
games.shortDescription: A short incremental game about splitting atoms and triggering exponentially growing chain reactions.
games.aboutText:
Criticality is a casual incremental clicker game about splitting atoms and creating chain reactions.

Click. Split. React. Dominate the chain reaction in a casual incremental blast of cold-war chaos!

You’re a hapless engineer caught dead-center in Cold War politics, stuck with a rickety reactor and a whole lot of very volatile atoms. No fancy degrees or top-secret training, just your screwdriver, a dream, and a ticking clock of bizarre, high-stakes situations.

Here’s how you go nuclear (without blowing up the lab… probably):

- Click to Unleash Neutrons - Tap to fire a single neutron, watch atoms absorb, split, and detonate in a cascading chain reaction. The longer the chain, the bigger the points haul, simple as that (until the atoms start getting tricky ).

- Upgrade your reactor, Unlock Chaos - Spend your hard-earned points for game-changing upgrades that supercharge your reactor. Unlock new mechanics, boost neutron output, and turn tiny fizzles into earth-shaking blasts that rack up points faster than you can say “critical mass.”

- Chase the Ultimate Reaction - Push your reactor to its breaking point, hit critical mass, and reap the rewards… if you don’t accidentally trigger a meltdown first. Every click brings you closer to nuclear glory (or a very awkward conversation with your supervisor).

Features:

- 4 Endings

- 300+ upgrades

- Prestige system with game changing mechanics

- Jazzy music

- Relaxing gameplay

- Satisfying atom popping

games.name: G Squad
games.shortDescription: Run the gauntlet with G Squad in this hand-crafted autobattler with roguelite and RPG elements, designed to scratch the strategy itch without the spreadsheets. 9 unique heroes, in-run rewards, permanent progression, and boss challenge modifiers to test yourself against.
games.aboutText:
A mysterious curse is taking over the land and G Squad are all that remains of the border scouts. Their only chance to warn the queen is to run from dawn to dusk. Are you up for the challenge?

9 unique heroes

Inventor. Tank. Assassin. Mage. Brawler. Summoner. Warlock. Healer. Archer.

Deploy and level up your heroes to overcome the shadow horde spreading across the land in this turn-based autobattler.

Roguelite progression

Guide G Squad through 5 unique environments, each guarded by more and more dangerous bosses. Every vanquished boss grants hero-specific equipment to enhance or drastically change your strategy.

Approachable strategy gameplay

Easy to dip in and out of, no spreadsheets required.

games.name: MUPO
games.shortDescription: Grab your keyboard and jump into the rhythm in MUPO. This fast-paced rhythm game is driven by skill, creativity, and community. Build maps, climb leaderboards, and shape the game’s future. And there’s so much more to come, stay tuned. Be part of the MUPO journey!
games.aboutText:
Welcome to MUPO , a rhythm game with a unique twist.
Your keyboard isn’t just an input device , it’s the game itself.

Hit notes, build maps, and claim your spot on the leaderboard.
Can you master the toughest maps and rise above your friends to become the ultimate MUPO champion?

MUPO offers a smooth and immersive rhythm experience where you can enjoy the music in your own way. You can play songs in various difficulties and use modifiers to tailor the challenge to your own preference.

MUPO thrives through its community. You can design and share your own maps, making the game a constantly evolving experience. The built-in level editor ensures there’s always new content to play and discover.

For anyone who likes a good challenge, MUPO features global leaderboards. Compete against friends and rhythm gamers worldwide, climb the rankings, and prove your skill.

MUPO will continue to evolve steadily and will expand with multiplayer modes, custom keyboard skins, and new layouts like Numpad, Arrow Keys, or a full 100% keyboard layout. Future updates will add more content and creative tools for a fully personalized rhythm experience.

games.name: Your Mom
games.shortDescription: Your mom is here, come quickly to play happily with your mom.
games.aboutText:
Your Mom is a desktop simulation game.

Feeling that your computer desktop is too plain? Want to find a gentle mom to keep you company? Then try this desktop mom!

Instructions:

Supports gaze tracking with the mouse, dragging, rotating and zooming in and out.

Drag with the left mouse button, rotate with the right mouse button and use the scroll wheel to zoom in and out.

Right-clicking on the character brings up menu options, which allow for changing costumes and making related settings.

Contents:

The game includes a gentle mom character and multiple costumes.

Productivity & Cozy Features:

Pomodoro Timer — Customize focus and break durations to build a comfortable rhythm for work or study.

To-Do List — Create tasks, organize them into categories, set priorities and track completion.

Smart Reminders — Schedule one-time or daily reminders for work, study plans, important dates and everyday tasks.

White Noise Player — Mix relaxing ambience such as rain, forests and cafés, with independent volume controls.

Cozy Music Player — Enjoy curated Cozy / Lofi tracks with categories, favorites, shuffle, repeat and a mini player.

Dance with Your Music:

Choose from the built-in dance collection, import your own VMD files, and play, loop or smoothly switch between dances whenever you like.

Link dances to the built-in music player: assign a specific dance to each song, use shuffle, or repeat the current dance.

Prefer Spotify, YouTube or another music app? Enable external music linking, choose which apps may trigger dancing, and she will start or stop with the music. The built-in player always takes priority.

Motion-aware effects and automatic expressions add a lively touch without stealing the spotlight.

games.name: Once Upon A Card
games.shortDescription: Help a royal child find their way through their dreams! Use cards to build paths, create combos, and adapt your strategy as each run brings new challenges and bosses. Will you let the nightmares take over? This game was created by students from the video game school ISART Digital
games.aboutText:
Once Upon A Card is a student-made game created in around 40 days by ISART Digital students as part of their final-year project , giving them the opportunity to put their skills and learning into practice. We hope you enjoy the experience they have created for you!

-------------

BUILD YOUR PATH

A Slavic fairy tale roguelike where you build the dungeon as you go.

Arrange the rooms to create your own path through the child's dreams. Combine them to defeat your nightmares, and progress further with each run.

Build your deck from unique cards with powerful effects.

RULES AND GAME MECHANICS

- Place rooms to progress across the grid.

- Engage enemies to earn currency or add new cards to your deck.

- Spend currency to expand and upgrade your deck.

- Optimize your deck, defeat enemies, and conquer the final boss.

- Replay runs to craft entirely new decks and strategies.

KEY QUALITIES

- Dive into a universe inspired by Slavic legends

- Enjoy a clever combination of real-time puzzles and deckbuilding.

- Play a roguelike game where building your deck allows you to express your creativity.

- A sharp, and empowering experience designed for mastery

games.name: Oriko Days
games.shortDescription: Oriko Days is a warm and cute life-sim inspired by classic virtual pet games! You get to look after your very own catgirl friend Oriko - Give her attention, feed her, decorate her apartment, and watch how she reacts. ₍^. .^₎Ⳋ
games.aboutText:
Oriko! ฅ^>⩊<^ ฅ

"Oriko Days" is a virtual pet simulator which lets you play with and take care of your friend Oriko!

Features (∩˃o˂∩)

In Oriko Days, you can...

Buy Oriko lots of different foods and drinks from the store!

(yum!)

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Watch Oriko show a variety of emotions!

(eek!)

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Wash and take care of Oriko!

(aww!)

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Buy items and decorate Oriko's apartment!

(wow!)

games.name: Low Poly Mouse Game
games.shortDescription: 2-4 Sneaky and squeaky low-poly mice face off against a lone cat in the battlefield of a human house. Mice use proximity chat to communicate with other players, while the cat hunts their noises. Will the mice perform enough tasks to destroy the house, or will the cat defeat enough mice to save it?
games.aboutText:
2-4 Sneaky and squeaky low-poly mice face off against a lone cat in the battlefield of a human house. Mice use proximity chat to communicate with other players, while the cat hunts their noises. Will the mice perform enough tasks to destroy the house, or will the cat defeat enough mice to save it?

Faction of Chaos - The Mice

- Win condition: Complete enough standard tasks, then complete both final tasks

- Perform tasks that ruin the household just for the love of the game

- Eat cheese to get a temporary speed boost

- Jump up small obstacles and utilize mouse tunnels to navigate the environment

- Communicate or spout nonsense with other mice utilizing proximity chat.

Sole Defender of The House - The Cat

- Win condition: Bring down the lives of the mouse team to 0

- Attack mice by pouncing or pawing them

- Utilize your superior movement with faster speed, a bigger jump, and a pounce.

- Track mice by audio cues and their trails.

- Sleep to revitalize, as energy drops throughout the game. Energy determines whether the cat moves fast or slow.

- In a house that boasts a lot of verticality and tricks, will the little rascals come on top, or will the cat prevail?

This game was made as a Senior Capstone project for RPI's Games and Simulation Arts and Sciences program.

games.name: Drunken Goddess Reflux
games.shortDescription: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.
games.aboutText:
Break the rules as you drink in this twisted game of Russian roulette, and push the demon till she spills it all!

"No one's ever done this to me before...

Ahh, you're incredible, darling."

A shot glass Russian roulette with a demon who loves you enough to kill you.

Survive the night, and savor seven flavors of ruin.

■The drunker you get, the wilder the game!

Drink until the rules stop mattering, and unleash drunken tricks only a true barfly could master to make it out alive!

■A soul-on-the-line drinking survival game where you spill your soul or make her spill!

A high-stakes roulette where every shot hits a little different!

Only one rule: get the demon wasted and make her spill her soul to win!

■Femme Soule

"Surrender your life to me, darling. Let's spend eternity together."

In Hell's bar, Pandemonium, a liquor-soaked demon awaits—one who loves you enough to kill you.

♥ Let's sink into Hell side by side!

Longing for a sip of madness and bliss? Down for a one-night stand with a demon? Hallelujah! Add Drunken Goddess Reflux to your wishlist and wait for the release half-drunk and smiling!
