games.name: Sublustrum
games.shortDescription: Enter a mysterious machine built to explore the human subconscious and complete your brother’s final experiment. Descend into a world where memories become places, solve sound-driven puzzles, and uncover a hidden truth in this first-person narrative adventure.
games.aboutText:
You arrive at your missing brother’s home. All that remains of him in the apartment is his final experiment: a strange machine he built to immerse a human being in the depths of the subconscious.

By repairing the machine and stepping inside, you follow him into the Flickering World — a shifting, surreal realm built from memories, where reality dissolves at the edges and only sound remains trustworthy.

Find out what your brother was looking for. Find out why he never came back.

Sound is more than atmosphere in Sūblústrum — it shapes both the gameplay and the narrative.

Audio carries the story and drives the puzzles. Tune frequencies, follow voices through the static, and interpret what you hear. One entire location is a vast musical instrument that must be played and tuned before it will let you through.

Originally imagined as an interactive music experience by the dark ambient project Anthesteria, co-composer of the Metro 2033 soundtrack, Sublustrum evolved into a psychological adventure built around sound from its very first note.

Explore the Flickering World — a surreal realm shaped by a troubled mind: dreamlike liminal spaces, ornate Victorian machinery, and hollow places where the dark feels inhabited. The world shifts, overlaps, and rewrites itself as a fractured psyche struggles to hold together.

Sublustrum is styled to evoke images shaped by vintage lenses and the grain of aged film — a visual language inspired by early cinema that captures the ephemeral feeling of auteur cinema and fragile dreams.

Inspired by Jungian psychology and Kafkaesque fiction, Sublustrum unfolds like a session of psychoanalysis. It is a story about grief, the impossibility of changing the past, and the long, difficult road to accepting it.

Ultimately, it becomes a story about learning to let go of someone and discovering what remains of them — and of yourself — when you finally do.

Sublustrum is a full reimagining of the 2008 cult classic, winner of Best Adventure Game and Best Sound Design at the KRI Awards. Rebuilt from the ground up by its original creators in fully explorable 3D with strikingly beautiful visuals, it preserves the surreal vision and sound-first design that made the original legendary.

The team behind it includes veterans with experience on PUBG and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, as well as at Ubisoft and Ice-Pick Lodge.

games.name: Gem and Tarot
games.shortDescription: 《Gem and Tarot》 is a strategy game that blends match-3 puzzles with deck-building. Build your deck, upgrade your abilities, and conquer challenging stages. Unlock new gems with unique powers by meeting certain conditions, making every run unique!
games.aboutText:
Game Description

Gems & Tarot is a strategic game that blends the fun of match-3 puzzles with deep deck-building. Here, your carefully crafted deck guides your every match, and each chain reaction brings hope for a breakthrough. Master the unique card-building and progression system to overcome increasingly tricky stages; complete hidden objectives to unlock gems with extraordinary powers and forge your own unique playstyle. It’s not just a battle of wits—it’s a dance with luck.

Game Features

🃏 Deep Deck-Building
Earn coins through engaging match-3 challenges and visit the shop to carefully select from 22 uniquely powerful Tarot cards. Each card can be upgraded across 3 levels, and the vast array of combinations allows for endless strategic possibilities—making every run feel fresh and exciting.

💎 Unlock Legendary Gems
Complete in-game achievements to unlock new gems with special abilities. Each gem can fundamentally reshape your strategy, paving the way for a playstyle that is entirely your own.

🏆 Challenge the Highest Scores
Use your wits, embrace a bit of luck, and continuously refine your ultimate deck as you aim for new high scores. Every playthrough is a new adventure!

Start now and enjoy a magical and relaxing experience!
Gem & Tarot — Easy to learn, endlessly fun.

games.name: Chrono Seoul
games.shortDescription: Chrono Seoul’s unique Time Table combat lets you use the hero’s mechanical arm and future-reading ability to predict enemy actions and respond with precise attacks, defense, and evasion. Each run offers new patterns, and at every chapter’s end, an Existence corrupted Seoul awaits.
games.aboutText:
Seoul, consumed by the Apocalypse

In the moment the city collapsed, the protagonist—once an ordinary citizen—awakened the ability to glimpse into the near future.
To reclaim the horrifying, Entities-infested remains of Seoul, and to recover something precious that was lost—

Chrono Seoul is a “Time Table” deck-building roguelike set in an apocalyptic reinterpretation of modern Seoul.

Fast and lethal “Time Table” combat

Your power is the ability to read the future .
Through your mechanical arm, fleeting moments of what’s to come appear before you—and these visions become the core strategic tool for placing cards and planning your combat turns.

Combat is fast, precise, and generates entirely different builds and flows in every run. At the end of each chapter, an Existence that has corrupted the region awaits you.

A distorted modern Seoul, and the mystery of the “Warping”

The city has been completely reshaped by fragments of sin.Dying citizens. An apocalypse swallowing the metropolis whole. And the truth behind the Entities that consumes everything—With each repeated loop, the pieces of that truth slowly come into view.

Power from the Entities, and endlessly evolving deck-building

The “Entities” scattered across Seoul take on many forms.
They test you, tempt you, and at times grant unique cards or relics—pulling you deeper into their trials.Each Existence offers completely different events depending on the nature they dominate.

Your card choices define your playstyle itself.

Will you pursue an agility build focused on evasive maneuvers? A high-impact counter build? Or craft a strange and experimental hybrid? Each loop is an entirely new decision.

A collapsing mind, and the ‘Nightmare’

In apocalyptic Seoul, enemy attacks do more than harm your body.

Whispers echo through warped spaces. Unseen gazes follow you. Endless loops of failure and struggle erode the mind.
As the protagonist’s sanity fractures, you will eventually confront the Nightmare .
But when you endure it—when you survive—you gain new abilities.

The Nightmare is not merely a penalty.It is a core system unique to Chrono Seoul: a space where risk and reward coexist . The moment your mind breaks is also the moment you can become stronger.

games.name: Devoris
games.shortDescription: Formerly known as Devora,now changed name to Devoris. You become a bird living in the sewers, killing and eating other inhabitants to fill your stomach. Of course, as an adventurer, you can choose to explore the underground world to obtain new weapons, new delicacies, discover the stories here.
games.aboutText:
You become a bird living in the sewers, killing and eating other inhabitants to fill your stomach. Of course, as an adventurer, you can choose to explore the underground world to obtain new weapons, new delicacies, discover the stories here, and even the secrets of the gods.

Features

Fast-paced, fluid hack-and-slash combat. Gain tactical advantages by dodging and devouring enemies to slay them. Survive each battle. Mistakes will lead to fierce sieges.

Stylized art and music

games.name: Antivirus Girl
games.shortDescription: Antivirus Girl is a defense shooter game where you become an inspector for the anti-malware Sentinel to protect computers from malware. Inspect files coming in from the network, let safe files pass through, and immediately eliminate malware. Can you survive the constantly evolving digital threats?
games.aboutText:
Antivirus Girl is a defense shooter game where you directly control a character to install modules and defend against oncoming enemies.

Become a new inspector for the advanced antivirus ‘Sentinel’ and protect computers from external threats.

First, deploy modules at key locations to set up the movement path. Once inspection begins, you must scan the files incoming from the external network.

If a file is safe, let it pass through; if it is malware, destroy it immediately. Malware with various unique characteristics will continuously threaten the client’s system. Flexible adaptability to the situation is essential!

Sentinel consists of various departments such as Scan, Clean, and Analysis. What kind of stories will unfold with the agents there?

games.name: Clockwork Cleanup
games.shortDescription: Clockwork cleanup is a auto-battler game where your actions are dictated by tiles of various shapes placed in a grid. Defeat waves of enemies to save the factory!
games.aboutText:
Goo creatures are running amok in the spell factory and its up to you and MAC (Magical Automatic Custodian) to stop them! Guide MAC through five waves of creatures with a boss at the end of each wave. Choose a reward after each fight to craft an unstoppable spell arsenal!

Clockwork Cleanup is an auto-battler where MAC's actions are defined by spell tiles placed in the central grid. The spell tiles are powered by elemental sources located on the perimeter of the grid. You must use pipes and splitters to route the energy to the tiles. Some tiles require multiple elements which can quickly create congestion. Space is limited, but there will be opportunities to expand the grid as you progress.

Modifier tiles can be attached to spell tiles to modify their behavior. A tile that may seem weak could shine with the right mods. Mix and match to find useful combinations.

Once per wave, the workshop offers you a chance to further modify your grid and tiles.

- Fuse two elements together to create a dual-element tile.

- Cut a tile into two smaller tiles.

- Re-arrange the location of input connectors on tiles.

- Increase the mod limit

- Heal up

- or just scavenge for resources in the recycling bins.

You must manage the grid space carefully to craft the right mix of offense, defense, and routing to save the factory!

Features:

- 34 spell (action) tiles

- 17 modifier tiles

- 5 special routing tiles and 4 pass-through tiles

- 35 fights split into 5 waves with a total of 22 enemy types

games.name: Hack '95
games.shortDescription: Return to 1995, become a hacker, save the Internet. Take down an evil tech startup and shadowy government agency with a deck of illicit scripts and compromised servers. Meet freaks, geeks, and a virtual pug with a split personality and lack of bowel control.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the dawn of the Internet. Your best friend, elite hacker mega_hurtz, is missing, presumed dead. All signs point to an assassination by the Federal Bureau of Cyber Security and the all-powerful Axis Megasystems . To uncover the truth, you'll need illegal scripts and righteous hardware to hack your way through the Bureau’s high-security House of Cards network.

Hack '95 is a card-based hacking adventure set inside Navigate '95 , a 'state-of-the-art' operating system featuring multitasking and CD-quality sound. Chat with the freaks and geeks of cyberspace’s underbelly, who task you with defeating security systems and snooping through compromised desktops. All to unravel a conspiracy more sinister than you could ever imagine.

No coding skills? No problem! All you need is a deck, a 56kbps modem, and a healthy disregard for authority.

Welcome to ‘95

Boot up Navigate ‘95, a pixel-perfect take on your favorite mid-90s OS complete with nostalgic apps, chat clients, flaming GIFs, and all the glorious weirdness of the early internet.

Play Your Cards Right

Build decks of illicit scripts and compromised servers, then deploy them in turn-based battles against enemy security systems. Get full access before they brick your rig!

You've Got Mail!

Meet an eccentric cast of cyber-misfits through NetChatty. Get mixed up in their sketchy business and bizarre requests, from changing school grades to stealing game prototypes.

Mind Your Own Business

Crack their security, then dig through their desktops. Poke around private files, uncover secrets, and find the leverage you need to bring a corporate conspiracy crashing down.

Thanks, Bert!

Bert is your friendly virtual pug assistant. One dodgy crack later and he's half corporate lapdog, half anarchic cybercriminal, but at least one side of him is always happy to help!

Upgrade Your Arsenal

Build your card library and max out your rig as you explore new strategies and powerful synergies to take down ever murkier and more lucrative targets.

Tune Into Hacker FM

Let DJ D-Billy soothe your frazzled synapses with crunchy beats and fully licensed 90s dance classics from artists including Paul Hartnoll (Orbital), Humanoid and Nookie.

games.name: FIND ALL: Christmas 2025 🎁🎄🔔
games.shortDescription: Ho ho ho! The Christmas season is here again! That means it's time to test your attentiveness by exploring the Christmas suburb and finding different objects to color in the black and white picture with colorful paints.
games.aboutText:
Test your observation skills in this exciting hidden object game. Explore a cozy suburb on Christmas Eve and find cleverly hidden items. Background music will immerse you in the atmosphere. Suitable for the whole family.

Game Features:

180 hidden items

There is a hint

The map is colorable

2.5D effect

Customize brightness

Saving progress

Scaling

Relaxing music

games.name: The Artisan of Glimmith
games.shortDescription: The Artisan of Glimmith is a cozy, relaxing puzzle game about coloring stained glass and restoring the artworks of a kingdom above the clouds. Explore a world of handcrafted puzzles designed with intent, where simple rules lead to delightful surprises.
games.aboutText:
You arrive in the lands of Glimmith, a kingdom above the clouds. Your newest benefactor has hired you, a famed stained glass artisan, to help him restore the area to its former glory. However, he has given you an unusual stipulation: use whatever colors you please, so long as you follow the rules!

A cozy hamlet, an enchanted forest, and a forlorn castle await. Keep your eyes open for hidden paths and secret puzzles nestled away for the most observant players.

- Curated, Not Generated: Experience a journey handcrafted by human puzzle designers.

- Variety: Discover over 20 unique rule types while you color, cut, and join beautiful stained glass artworks.

- Mastery: Optional finale puzzles put experts to the test. These challenges require you to use every trick you’ve learned to pass.

Create your own puzzles and share them with the community using the in-game level editor.

games.name: Finding Polka
games.shortDescription: Set off on a playful search to track down the wandering pup Polka in this game of exploration and serendipity. Meet charming characters, lend them a hand to make new friends, and explore a cozy world sketched in ballpoint pen. You don't need words on this adventure, just smiles and high-fives!
games.aboutText:
I have friends I want to see
I have family I want to see

Frendy lives a peaceful life with her beloved dog Jazz.

One day, in front of a flower shop, she spots a dog that looks just like Polka,

the dog Frendy had in her childhood.

Before she knew it, Frendy and Jazz were chasing after it ー

A cozy interactive adventure where you find Polka somewhere on the map.

A simple world drawn in ballpoint pen welcomes you with playful humor.

Unique characters await you at the end of your adventure!

You can high-five them and become friends.

Friends are reliable allies who will help and cheer you on when you face trouble.

No dialogue, no spoken words. The characters convey their feelings through expressions, subtle gestures, and sound effects.

Even without words, they laugh, they get surprised, and they become friends ー

Various mini games are available throughout the area, including putt-putt golf, whac-a-mole, soccer shootout, boat racing, watermelon splitting, and volleyball. These are not required for story progression and are optional side activities you can enjoy freely.

games.name: A taste of home
games.shortDescription: "A taste of home" is a short 3D exploration horror game set in the Japanese countryside.
games.aboutText:
【STORY】 "A taste of home" is a short 3D exploration horror game set in the Japanese countryside. Keita breaks a promise to his mother to go play at his friend's house. That was the beginning of everything.

【GAME FEATURES】

- A first-person walking simulator.

- Features three different endings.

- Set in a nostalgic Japanese countryside.

- Controller support.

【ABOUT GAME STREAMING】 Streaming and creating content for this game are welcome. While not mandatory, we appreciate it if you include this store page URL in your video or stream description.

games.name: Run from the Cops!
games.shortDescription: Run from the Cops! puts you behind the wheel in a high-speed chase for freedom and fortune. Take control of a clever troublemaker determined to score quick money and make a clean getaway through chaotic city streets.
games.aboutText:
Life’s too calm? Time to break the rules!

Run from the Cops! puts you behind the wheel in a high-speed chase for freedom and fortune. Take control of a clever troublemaker determined to score quick money and make a clean getaway through chaotic city streets.

Every escape is a test of reflexes and strategy — drift through corners, dodge roadblocks, and outsmart the police in fast-paced, arcade-style chases . You’ll need to find shortcuts, avoid collisions, and manage your timing perfectly to stay ahead of the law. The more you steal and the longer you survive, the bigger your reward.

Your mission:
Pull off daring robberies, jump into your getaway car, and escape relentless police pursuit across multiple environments. Drive smart, stay cool under pressure, and prove that no cop can catch you.

As you progress, unlock faster cars, tougher motorcycles, and new routes packed with hazards and surprises. Each level brings fresh challenges and smarter opponents, keeping every chase unpredictable and intense.

🏁 Game Features

- 🌆 3 unique chase environments: Parking Run, City Run & Winter Run

- 🚗 7 unlockable vehicles — 5 cars and 2 motorcycles with distinct handling

- 💵 Rob, escape, and upgrade — the faster you are, the richer you get

games.name: My Paradise Lagoon Fishing Simulator
games.aboutText:
My Paradise Lagoon is a first-person tropical fishing simulator built in Unreal Engine 5, where your lighthouse island becomes a home base for mastering rods, reels, lures, and advanced fishing techniques across a vibrant ocean ecosystem.

Here, the joy comes from realism, variety, and the feel of every cast.

🎣 Master Real Fishing Techniques
Cast from sandy shallows, reef edges, cliff drops, or your boat as exotic species glide under turquoise waves.
Each fish reacts with lifelike intelligence—darting, circling, diving, or making sudden runs based on species, weight, and temperament.

Use real angling techniques:

- Rod angle management

- Line tension control

- Drag tuning

- Hook sets and reel pumping

- Landing and lifting larger fish by hand

Every fight feels physical, cinematic, and earned.

🎣 Gear Matters: Rods, Reels, Lures & Tools
Build your perfect loadout with a full suite of fishing gear:

- Light, medium, and heavy rods

- Spinning, baitcasting, and trolling reels

- Line types with real stretch and strength differences

- Species-specific lures, baits, and rigs

- Utility tools like landing nets, gaffs, fish bags, and gloves

Upgrade each piece to unlock new casting distances, drag stability, and specialized techniques for deep sea, reef, or shallow fishing.

🏝️ Your Lighthouse, Your Angler’s Workshop
Your lighthouse becomes a functional fishing hub:
organize your rods, store trophies, repair gear, and craft new lures.
Explore deeper into the island to find hidden coves, coral lagoons, stormy cliffs, and offshore hotspots where rare species challenge your skills.

🌤️ Powered by Unreal Engine 5
The lagoon shines with tropical color and realism:
dynamic waves, volumetric clouds, shimmering water, and fish animations designed for smooth, lifelike motion.
Every cast and reeling sequence feels natural and immersive.

🎥 Designed for Pure Fishing Satisfaction
Physics-based fights, rod bends, tight lines, splashing surfaces, and wriggling catches make every moment highlight-worthy.
Perfect for relaxed sessions, ASMR reels, or showcasing rare catches.

🧺 Features

Advanced First-Person Angling: Rod angle, drag control, tension management.
Gear Depth: Multiple rods, reels, lures, lines, and angling tools.
Fish Behavior Simulation: Species-specific reactions and fight patterns.
Functional Lighthouse Home: Workshop, storage, upgrades, and gear crafting.
Multiple Biomes: Shallows, reefs, cliffs, coves, and offshore waters.
Relaxing Loop: No pressure, just skillful fishing at your own pace.

Cast deeper. Fight smarter. Build the perfect angler’s loadout.
Welcome home to My Paradise Lagoon, the ultimate tropical fishing simulator.

games.name: Pet-That-Vtuber!
games.shortDescription: A brutal and honest look into the reality of petting a cute girl on her head. Enjoy the digital warmth of simulated physical affection. Pet Zen on her head. Try different cute outfits. Having fun is encouraged.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the ultimate headpat experience! Dive into a cozy, interactive tribute where your simple goal is to show your appreciation through the universal language of headpats.

How it Works:

- Gentle Pats: Click on Zentreya's head to give her gentle, appreciative pats. Each pat earns you points!

- Unlock Goodies: Spend your well-earned points in the shop to unlock a delightful collection of outfits and backgrounds.

- Customize Freely: Change her outfits and the scenery at any time during gameplay to create your perfect, comfy scene.

This is a lightweight, free-to-play fan game. It's a simple, relaxing digital space where you can kick back, destress, and enjoy some wholesome interaction.

No complicated goals, no pressure. Just pure, patting relaxation.

Features:

- Satisfying headpat mechanics

- A variety of cute outfits to unlock

- Multiple scenic backgrounds to collect

- Instant outfit and background switching

- A chill, positive vibe

games.name: Break Shoot
games.shortDescription: Break Shoot combines the precision of billiards with roguelike builds. Stack powerful ball abilities and accessories to explode your score and crush each round's target!
games.aboutText:
Shoot the Ball, Beat the Score

Line up the perfect shot, trigger spectacular chain reactions, and smash past the target score before the round ends!

Every Round is a New Puzzle

No two tables ask the same question. Read each layout, find the right angle, and turn a tricky board into a scoring opportunity.

Build Your Own Strategy

Choose ball abilities and accessories that fit your playstyle. Combine their effects, refine your build, and create your own route to a high score.

games.name: Oomi’s Nook
games.shortDescription: Oomi’s Nook is a cozy and relaxing sticker decor game. Decorate a little room with hand-drawn style stickers according to the drawing or unleash your creativity! Follow the lighthearted everyday life of the adorable Oomi family and watch them live leisurely in the world you create!
games.aboutText:
Have you played with decor stickers before? This sticker game is both relaxing and therapeutic!

Use hand-drawn style stickers to build your dream world one sticker at a time.

Let go of your pressure and worries about failure—just have an enjoyable and relaxing time!

Unwind and follow the drawing to decorate the room effortlessly.

Or unleash your creativity, mixing and matching stickers freely to design a unique room!

30 chapters created by 20 artists:

A summer pool villa with a glass greenhouse, a mysterious black cat crystal ball fortune telling store, a tranquil and cozy mountain kitchen, a bizarre yet joyful zombie candy town, and more...

Come and build all kinds of warm and therapeutic dreamscapes!

You'll complete the main story in approximately 10 hours if you follow the drawings.

Alternatively, you can unleash your creativity and decorate freely in stages in the free mode.

Complete stages and collect stickers to decorate your dream home.

With more than 8,000 stickers to mix and match, let your imagination and creativity run free!

Come and meet the adorable Oomi family!

From visiting a tree hole in the middle of the night, to lying down and relaxing on the beach, attending new store openings, and going on underwater adventures,

their lives are carefree, comfortable, and full of surprises.

Follow their lighthearted and humorous everyday life, discover the secrets hidden behind the stickers,

and watch them live happily and contentedly in the little world you create.

games.name: NORMA: Story of One Platform
games.shortDescription: Explore the secrets of this world and discover what the local government, working alongside powerful corporations, has planned in its pursuit of complete control over the population.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the world of NORMA: Story of One Platform - a society divided between the rich and the poor, where people are physically separated according to their social class. A world that rewards only those willing to obey its rules and climb the social ladder. A world of individualism, where good intentions, comradeship, and care for others have no place… yet they still exist.

Explore the secrets of this world and discover what the local government, working alongside powerful corporations, has planned in its pursuit of complete control over the population. Dive into a world driven by a hunger for power and money, where every individual is merely a replaceable cog in a massive machine. Break free from the matrix, fight for freedom, and never surrender.

- Zona 4 - where those forgotten by society struggle to survive.

- Factory Zona - where the dreams of some come true while others break their backs.

- Zona 3 - where the taste of a better life keeps the majority endlessly running in a rat race.

- Office Zona - where major deals are made for the benefit of the chosen few.

- Zona 2 - where those in power shape policies and make the rules.

- Sky - where those who really rule

Step into the terminal – a fully integrated hacking mini-game within NORMA. Slip on your digital boots to breach systems, retrieve vital data, and uncover secrets that drive your missions forward. Every hack brings you closer to the truth hidden within the world of NORMA.

Dive into the dystopian world of NORMA and explore it from top to bottom. Although the game is story-driven at its core, you are free to explore a world with its own history and rules. You're not just following the story - you're becoming part of it, taking part in unfolding events and influencing what happens next.

Find powerful upgrades that expand your ability to hack systems, decrypt data, and gather even more intelligence. Enhance your Personal Assistant with new modules that unlock access to previously inaccessible places. Each module opens up new locations to explore and grants access to additional systems to hack, giving you greater freedom while exposing you to greater risks as you venture deeper into an increasingly dangerous world.

games.name: Horde of Distraction
games.shortDescription: An incremental game inspired by classic RPGs. Fight monsters, collect rare gear, progress through a vast skill tree, and defeat powerful bosses!
games.aboutText:
Horde of Distraction is an incremental game inspired by classic RPGs. Fight monsters, collect rare gear, progress through a vast skill tree, and defeat powerful bosses!

Cleanse the regions!

We designed the gameplay of Horde of Distraction to be relaxing and satisfying. Just hover your cursor over monsters or environment details - they’ll automatically take damage!

Skill tree!

Use your gold to upgrade your stats in a vast skill tree. The stronger your stats, the tougher the monsters you can defeat!

Character equipment!

Monsters drop gear items. Their stats depend on rarity - from junk to legendary! The better your equipment, the farther you’ll go!

Fight bosses!

Every new region is guarded by a unique boss. To defeat them, you’ll need solid gear and upgraded skills!

games.name: Forest Hustle
games.shortDescription: You are dropped into a forest with one goal - making money and paying off your 100k debt. Collect resources, make deals, upgrade, build and hire workers to do the job for you. 🐕
games.aboutText:
Hi gamers!

Welcome to Forest Hustle where your goal is to get rich ! It is an incremental 3D game where you scale up from chopping wood and mining stone to building bases and hiring workers to do your job . 🐕🐕🐕

Work on your strategy to strip mine the whole forest and making enough money to pay off your 100k debt! 💵

Features:

- Hire dogs. 🐕

- Gather resources: chop wood and mine stone.

- Make money: unlock traders and take or refuse deals to earn the most cash.

- Upgrade: tools and buildings.

- Build: bases and hire workers.

- Lo-Fi tracks for extra chill.

games.name: Our Brief Eternity
games.shortDescription: Our Brief Eternity is a visual novel in which you play as Lin Xiaocou, an ordinary office worker whose quiet life is turned upside down when two girls from another world unexpectedly move in. Amid the warmth, comedy, and chaos of everyday life together, can you find a happy ending for everyone?
games.aboutText:
“In this world, there are things we’re told we can’t do but are allowed to do anyway, and things we can do but shouldn’t.”

When an elegant Bloodkin and a clumsy witch suddenly enter your quiet life, how will an ordinary person like you learn to live with them?

Your brief but precious time under one roof is filled with laughter and surprises. Whether you’re out shopping, playing games together, or sharing what’s on your mind late at night, each little moment brings you closer.

Little by little, you come to understand one another. Three lives that once seemed worlds apart begin to intertwine through this chance encounter. You discover the warmth of having a place to call home, even as the gap between your lifespans and the pressures of everyday life put your bonds to the test.

Every choice you make shapes the story, leading to one of four very different endings.

Will you risk taking on an eternal life and become their companion? Or will you cherish the present and keep the promise you made to each other in the fleeting time you have together?

The choice is yours.

Voiced by w小璃 (Chinese) / 猫乃緒みみ (Japanese)
Age 300+
Birthday October 31
Height 147 cm
Race Bloodkin
Personality Proud, hates hassle, aloof on the outside but warm-hearted underneath

“Hmph. It’s not like I stayed in the human world just for you!”

A young Bloodkin lady who unexpectedly barges into Lin Xiaocou’s home. Elegant and haughty at first glance, she’s really a homebody who hates anything troublesome.

Proud and sharp-tongued, Elysia has a knack for pointing out exactly what makes Lin Xiaocou’s situation so awkward. She teases him from time to time and makes all sorts of requests that are “not exactly difficult, just a lot of trouble.” Beneath her icy exterior, she’s warm-hearted and struggles to say how she really feels. Whenever she’s unsure of herself, she hides it behind an air of arrogance. She enjoys spending time with Lin Xiaocou and feels most at ease around him.

After three hundred years, Elysia had grown tired of the same old routine in her ancient castle. She ran away from home and stumbled upon Lin Xiaocou’s place, which she decided would make a “rather decent temporary base.” She likes to play the detached observer, but as the days pass, she grows curious about the fleeting lives humans lead and finds herself growing attached to them.

Voiced by 舟玄 (Chinese) / 雪乃しろ (Japanese)
Age 100+
Birthday March 14
Height 145 cm
Race Witch
Personality Cheerful, clumsy, endlessly curious, and sensitive

“…I’m not an idiot. I just didn’t want to face a reality that was far too cruel.”

A witch who unexpectedly ends up in Lin Xiaocou’s home. A magical accident stopped her from growing.

Bright and cheerful, Stella is also clumsy and prone to causing trouble. Beneath her carefree demeanor lies a sensitive heart and a quiet sadness that’s easy to miss. She tends to solve problems with dazzling magic and hide her worries behind a smile.

She’s endlessly curious about the world and firmly believes that having fun is what matters most in life. When her emotions get the better of her, she can become surprisingly vulnerable, though sometimes she lets those feelings show in full force. She feels safe around Lin Xiaocou and gradually learns to show him who she really is.

Stella spent years training under a great witch. Once she could hold her own, she set off on her own travels. A teleportation accident sent her straight into Lin Xiaocou’s home. One taste of the desserts in his fridge was enough to make her decide to stay. She may cause the occasional mishap, but she’s always trying her best to fit into human life.

- Playtime 3–5 hours

- Script length Approximately 72,000 words

- CGs 16, excluding variations

- SD CGs 6, excluding variations

games.name: PANLINE
games.shortDescription: Welcome to post-scarcity! But you’re not on the list. Deliver to make a living off-grid while PANLINE, the abundance engine that keeps the city endlessly supplied, begins to change. Earn currency, favors, kit upgrades and work the runner scene to unlock new contacts and fixers.
games.aboutText:
Age of Abundance

PANLINE is the Civic Flow Engine that sustains abundance for all. A system of systems, integrating governance, economics, and public infrastructure to implement the best possible material conditions for the citizens of The City. All essential and most non-essential goods are produced at zero cost.

Edge of a New Hierarchy

Runners thrive in the value-inverted hierarchy, controlling the flow of information and the new seat of power.
You run with the Charter crew: A network of couriers, fixers and data brokers driving the new attention economy, built on identity and exclusivity. Between jobs, base is where favors get traded, introductions happen, and trust is built and broken.

A Skillset of Place

Movement is your language, and technique is everything: passed down by senior runners, refined on real routes, and guarded like tradecraft. Earn their approval, fold their knowledge into your lines and peel back The City in layers—new routes, new vantage points, new ways through previously closed spaces.

The City does not hand you its layout. Build your navigational skills by exploring sightlines and landmarks. Remember them. You will only have a compass to keep you oriented.

The Work That Still Exists

A secret contract economy runs beneath abundance. Jobs come in through anonymous forums and message boards, paying whatever is sought after. Access tokens and off-grid favors. Data and compute time.
Some runs are simple handoffs, others chain into multi-stop jobs where routes and delivery conditions matter as much as time or distance.

The equipment you bring defines the tier of contract you can take. Storage upgrades expand how much you can carry. Specialized kits protect high-value payloads and make riskier jobs viable.

A courier's life runs on jobs, salvage or whatever fits in their bag.

PANLET

Your piece of PANLINE.

An off-the-shelf device jailbroken and customized by your crew, turning it into the perfect runner’s keyring. It is also a physical kit, and can fail in the field. Bad landings and slips can crack it, forcing you to repair it before you can rely on it again. Firmware upgrades expand what it can do, opening up infrastructure access in The City.

- Falls wipe you: What you carry is what you risk, and progress only counts once you make it back to base.

- Learning New Movement: New techniques come from senior runners. Look for them on the rooftops.

- Non-linear, open city: Pick a direction and run. Don't forget the way you came from.

- Pure navigation: No map. Landmarks, memory and your compass is everything you need to keep yourself oriented.

- Day/Night structure: Run during the day and return to base at night to consolidate, until you get your Night Running Pass.

- Salvage: Items found in The City enable repairs, upgrades, and the ability to take riskier contracts.

- Inventory pressure: Limited space. Secured slots keep your most valuable cargo safe after slip-ups.

- Procedural jobs: Work appears dynamically through boards and contacts. Keep an eye out for the type of payout you need.

- PANLET Hacks: Bring up your PANLET and manipulate the city's infrastructure to suit your needs.

- District progression: New areas open when your movement, PANLET capability, and social reach are advanced enough to operate there.

- Runner's Hideout: Repair gear, upgrade your loadout, manage your stash and spend your favors at night to get ready for the next day.

games.name: The Hundredth Floor: Extraction
games.shortDescription: A 3D dungeon crawler ARPG blending looter-slasher & extraction mechanics. Delve into a 100-floor abyss where you must choose: play it safe or risk it all! Craft unique builds with massive talent trees & 1,000+ affixes. Defeat bosses and extract with epic loot, or lose everything to greed!
games.aboutText:
In The Hundredth Floor: Extraction , you are a QA tester trapped inside a virtual world by a critical system bug. To find your way back to reality, you must gear up, grow stronger, and conquer every floor of the abyss.

As a senior game tester caught in a bizarre accident, a fatal bug has disabled the logout button and sent this virtual world into complete chaos. Want to return to reality? Grab your weapons and hack your way through a collapsing, mutant-infested 100-floor abyss!

The core gameplay blends satisfying ARPG looter-slasher combat with nerve-wracking extraction mechanics. Explore 100 procedurally generated, biome-diverse dungeons. Will you extract with a backpack full of epic gear, or gamble your life for legendary drops deeper down? Remember: if you die, your hard-earned loot is deleted with you!

Break the game with a massive, unrestricted talent tree, dozens of base weapons, and over 1,000 random gear affixes. Whether it's explosive melee strikes, a bullet-hell barrage, or summoning a tide of magic, your wildest ideas can be transformed into unstoppable combat power.

Combine hundreds of spells and skills, triggering explosive chain reactions using elemental status effects like Ignite, Freeze, and Paralyze. Face off against complex abyss bosses with unique mechanics. Master dodges and skill combos to enjoy the perfect mix of satisfying hack-and-slash action and hardcore strategic depth.

On your journey to escape, you will encounter various NPCs stranded in the glitched code. Complete their quests, collect scattered clues, and unravel the shocking conspiracy behind the world's collapse. The truth is often more despairing than the abyss itself...

games.name: Cirno! Lifts a Boulder
games.shortDescription: Help Cirno get back into her home! A chill, bite-sized 3D platformer in which you explore a frozen Misty Lake and gain boulder-lifting strength.
games.aboutText:
A Boulder is No Match for This Fairy!

A mischievous group of fairies has locked Cirno out of her very own home by placing a huge boulder right in front of it. Luckily for Cirno, getting rid of it is simple: she just needs to get stronger .

How? By collecting Power items, of course!

Cirno! Lifts a Boulder is a short and relaxing 3D platformer and Touhou fangame in which the titular ice fairy explores a frozen-over Misty Lake in search of strength-granting items. As Cirno grows more powerful, she unlocks distinct abilities that help her navigate the snowy landscape and reach new areas.

- Explore the Misty Lake any way you like : you never know what you might run into!

- Set your own pace : There's no rush. Sprint across the ice, or take a leisurely walk along the lakeshore.

- Unlock abilities : As Cirno gets stronger, she gradually remembers what an ice fairy is truly capable of.

- Find hidden frogs : Several sneaky frogs are hiding around the lake. Can you find them all?

- Listen to some tunes : Get lost in the snow with an arranged soundtrack by lapspider45!

games.name: Ghost Justice
games.shortDescription: Lead elite operatives against ruthless cartels in a brutal narco conflict. Coordinate multiple tactical teams, plan ambushes, gather intelligence, and eliminate high-value targets through stealth-driven turn-based combat.
games.aboutText:
Hunt the Cartels from the Shadows!

Ghost Justice is a turn-based tactical strategy game set in a brutal narco conflict where governments have lost control and ruthless cartels dominate entire regions. Lead elite operatives through dangerous missions inspired by real-world anti-cartel operations across cities, remote settlements, and dense jungle territories.

Plan, Adapt, Survive

Gather intelligence, study enemy positions, and prepare your approach before the operation begins. Set up ambushes, coordinate your forces, and use the element of surprise to gain the upper hand.

Command Beyond a Single Squad

Coordinate multiple teams across the battlefield and execute operations from different directions. Synchronize movements, create opportunities, and solve challenges that would overwhelm a single unit acting alone.

Stealth Is Your Greatest Weapon

Track enemy movements, infiltrate hostile territory, eliminate key targets, and complete objectives before the enemy even realizes you were there. For skilled commanders, stealth can be more effective than firepower.

Spot. Track. Eliminate.

Use specialized operatives, including spotter and sniper teams, to identify, track, and eliminate high-value targets from a distance.

Build Your Task Force

Recruit and equip specialized operatives, adapting your team to emerging threats and mission objectives.

KEY FEATURES

- Coordinate multiple teams in advanced turn-based combat

- Plan operations and set up devastating ambushes

- Gather intelligence to gain tactical advantages

- Use stealth to infiltrate hostile territory and complete objectives undetected

- Utilize spotter and sniper tactics to eliminate high-value targets

- Recruit, equip, and develop specialized operatives

- Build your task force for different mission requirements

- Manage resources and prepare for increasingly dangerous operations

- Fight across urban districts, remote settlements, and dense jungle territories

- Face ruthless cartels inspired by real-world anti-cartel conflicts

games.name: Retail Hell
games.shortDescription: Trapped in an infinite shift, you are the sole clerk of purgatory’s only convenience store. Manage stock, pay your taxes and keep nightmarish creatures at bay as you uncover the secret of why your shift never ends. Clock in. Serve the dead. Survive the shift.
games.aboutText:
WELCOME TO RETAIL HELL

Clock in at the only convenience store in the liminal void between life and death. Juggle supernatural customer service, collapsing inventory, and unravel the truth behind your own damnation.

As an overworked clerk stuck in a literal dead-end job you'll have to deal with the unpredictable threats of the abyss and manage your stock in order to pay your debt to the faceless management.

In this psychological horror job simulator , the mundane is your lifeline. If the store goes under, your soul goes with it.

EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK

- Run your store
Keep the coffee brewing, make hot dogs, maintain your machinery and keep your store tidy. Be ready for anything.

- The customer is always right (even the dead ones)
Fulfil strange requests from a roster of grotesque entities while avoiding reality-warping curses and unexpected eldritch side effects.
Serve them quickly and you might get a tip, or upset them and face the consequences.

- Survive the shift
Manage your resources, trade for grisly upgrades, keep your shelves stocked and decipher cryptic orders from the dead.

UNCOVER YOUR PAST

This isn't just a job; it's a prison. Uncover the sins of your past life (and death) to understand why you’re trapped in this fluorescent-lit corner of the afterlife.

With multiple endings to discover, will you piece together the mystery of your purgatory and break the cycle, or are you doomed to forever be employee of the month?

games.name: Millennium Slumber
games.shortDescription: Survive 400,000 years on a planet infested with an alien calamity! Gather resources, build a base and defend against hordes of nocturnal monsters in this rogue-like with cryostasis mechanics.
games.aboutText:
Survive 400,000 years on a planet infested with an alien calamity! Gather resources, build a base, and protect your cryostasis machine against hordes of nocturnal monsters in this sci-fi base building, top down shooter roguelike.

Can you adapt to survive millennia of evolution?

Find resources across a randomly generated planet: plants, scrap metal, weird sentient crystals, everything can be used to survive. Resources can be collected in different ways: blow up a spaceship for some scrap metal, harvest your glowing potted plant, kill an alien dragon to get its eyes...

Build a base to protect your only way to survive through millennia: the cryostasis machine. Turrets, traps, mining drills, decoys... each building has its unique behaviour! Obtain new blueprints across your runs and experiment to find the best way to repel all the monsters.

Once the night has come, it's you, your base, and the monsters. Will you survive until sunrise? What would you do when the Forever Night will come?

Use everything you have to repel the alien abominations for the next hundred thousand years!

Once the planet is safe, enter cryostasis for a hundred thousand years nap. Climate change, evolution of species, meteorites, new civilizations... Who knows what the planets will be like when you'll wake up?

Can your actions change the future of this planet?

We think you will like Millennium Slumber if you like these games: Don't Starve, Wizard with a Gun, Cult of the Lamb.

games.name: Space Daram
games.shortDescription: Become a cute space chipmunk and manage your ship with companions as you explore alien planets, build and upgrade your base, and craft gear by generating power and refining resources. Meet unique alien species, grow your foothold in the universe, and play solo or with friends in multiplayer.
games.aboutText:
Become an adorable space squirrel and explore the vast reaches of space with your companions.

SPACE DARAM is an open-world survival game where you travel aboard your spaceship, explore new planets, gather resources, and build survival outposts and space bases.

Craft equipment, expand your ship, and create a place of your own across multiple planets. Set out on a new adventure through the vastness of space with your small but energetic companions!

🚀 Your Mobile Base, the Spaceship

Your spaceship is both a mobile base and a home where you and your companions live together.

Manage its power, expand its capabilities, and prepare for your next adventure!

But stay alert: mysterious enemies are tracking your ship's trail.

🌍 Unpredictable Planetary Exploration

Every planet features different terrain, climates, and hazards, offering a new kind of adventure each time.

Discover new resources, investigate unknown environments, and gradually expand the reaches of your exploration!

⚔️ Battles Across the Planets

Equip a variety of weapons and take on the combat robots you encounter while exploring the planets. Join forces with your companions, brave the dangers ahead, and venture into new regions!

🏠 Build Your Own Space Base

Install a Base Module and deploy its shield to lay the foundations of your base.

Place a variety of structures and production facilities to create a base that is truly your own.

With your companions helping out, your base will grow even faster!

🔋 From Power Generation to Crafting!

Spin the exercise wheel to generate power, then use that energy to keep production and crafting running.

Every little contribution helps your base operate faster and more efficiently!

👥 Small but Dependable Companions

Charming companions with tiny bodies and gently swaying tails will stay by your side.

They excel at exploration, combat, gathering, and production, working together as a team!

🤝 An Adventure to Enjoy Alone or Together

Set out alone to explore space at your own pace and take on the challenge of survival,

or team up with friends to expand your base and share the adventure in cooperative multiplayer.

games.name: Crystalia
games.shortDescription: Crystalia is a first-person tower defense game mixing automation, management and exploration set in a utopian sci-fi world built on crystal extraction. Dig into caves, build autonomous defense zones and uncover the history of a civilization shaped around crystals.
games.aboutText:
CRYSTALIA

A Tower Defense automation game.

Crystalia is a first-person tower defense game mixing automation, management and exploration set in a utopian sci-fi world built on crystal extraction.

Dig into caves, build autonomous defense zones and uncover the history of a civilization shaped around crystals.

Dig into caves and uncover hidden areas to reach new tower defense areas and explore mysterious environments!

- Dig freely and shape the underground

- Discover bonuses and hidden areas

- Solve environmental puzzles

Every extraction triggers the spawn of “antibodies” trying to stop your machines, use sentries to stop them!

- Place sentries on extractors to stop the enemies

- Survive waves to collect resources

- Upgrade your defenses

Design self-sustaining tower defense areas that work even while you explore elsewhere. Connect your machines into networks and maximize automation!

- Build network of machines to make your sentries autonomous

- Connect machines together to build a crystal network that periodically powers your defenses

- Expand networks to improve defenses

Receive a fixed income each cycle, shaping the game flow!

- Manage tower defense waves, with fixed income and taxes

- Complete optional objectives to get bonuses

Build systems. Automate defenses. Explore deeper.

🔹 Demo coming soon

games.name: The Recipe for Life: A Horror About (not) Saving Lives
games.shortDescription: Travel across a quietly dying world in your RV, helping people with suicidal thoughts. Dive into the icebergs of their trauma and decide whether each of them deserves salvation — and whether you deserve it too.
games.aboutText:
You are a wanderer with a fractured soul, traveling across a world consumed by a silent apocalypse in your RV.

Find those who, like you, have stared into the abyss, and engage them in deep conversations. Every dialogue is a psychological puzzle where a human life hangs in the balance.

- Explore deep branching dialogues and uncover the hidden layers of human trauma

- Face difficult moral dilemmas: does every character deserve a second chance?

- Explore taboo subjects and the darker sides of human nature

- Take care of yourself to avoid breaking under the weight of other people's stories: cook meals, earn a living, and manage your growing stress

- Travel through a slowly decaying world in your RV

- The farther you travel, the more unsettling, bizarre, and nightmarish the world becomes

games.name: Monster Prom 5: Monster Retreat
games.shortDescription: Get ready for the ultimate winter war in this hilarious narrative adventure with dashes of strategy and romance! Visit snowy locations, recruit from a pool of over 80 wacky characters onto your team, and destroy your opponents in a fierce snowball fight to the death. Oh, and date hot monsters too 😉
games.aboutText:
Get ready for a weird winter holiday with “Monster Prom 5: Monster Retreat”, a sequel that puts a chilling and thrilling new spin on the Monster Prom formula. At its core, this is a very similar game: a multiplayer narrative adventure full of colorful characters and fresh funny dialogues. But this time the main goal isn't getting a date (although you can date, if that's your thing), but winning a snowball fight. Wait, did I say fight? I meant WAR.

You and up to 3 friends will join Vera and Miranda, and explore a winter resort looking for the best recruits for your team. Do strange favors, commit a few crimes, and get involved in all kinds of wacky shenanigans with any of more than 80 different potential recruits; then build the right formations to turn your team into an unbeatable snowball army! They say all’s fair in love and war, so recruit as many characters as you can and try to score a date while you’re at it!

What can you expect from this anything-but-peaceful winter holiday?

- The signature style of the Monster Prom franchise: unique, charming characters and irreverent humor.

- Play with friends via couch and online multiplayer!

- Manage your stats as a team and prove you’re the best snowball war strategist.

- New mechanics! Recruit powerful allies and build unstoppable formations to unlock your team’s full potential.

- Bond through intimate conversations to get to know your favorite characters, which means…

- YES, YOU CAN DATE THEM! This time flirting is not the core of the game, but you can still get a date with Vera, Miranda, or one of several other characters by the end of the game!

- TONS of beautiful art like you've never seen before in these series (seriously, there's A LOT of art packed in here)

- You'll meet dozens of brand new characters, and a LOT of beloved characters from previous games will be making a comeback!

- Radio stations to choose from, with different music genres to build the perfect mood!

games.name: Blue Wyrm
games.shortDescription: Blue Wyrm is a psychedelic first-person souls-like with a retro aesthetic and skill-heavy combat system. Do you have what it takes to save your wife in the crypt of the Blue Wyrm?
games.aboutText:
Your wife - the Blue Knight Lucia did not return home from her journey to slay an ancient evil. Odd beings wreck havoc on the lands nearby. A rumor of a crypt unearthing is spread.

Find her in the crypt of the Blue Wyrm.

Blue Wyrm is a first-person skill-based action game, where you take upon the role of the Red Knight Gabriel, armed only with her trusty sword to fight off a tight, but varied roster of enemies in a nonsensical surreal dungeon. Learn the ways to use your movement and position, directional attack variety and timing to perfect your battle technique and succeed in your quest to save her.

- The game is 60~ minutes long and is not recommended for people suffering with Epilepsy .

- It includes a speedrun mode.

- There are secret rooms to find.

games.name: The Last Lodge
games.shortDescription: The Last Lodge is a medieval psychological horror game where you work as an innkeeper. Listen closely to your patrons' stories, prepare their orders, and ultimately, choose which traveller has visited their very last lodge.
games.aboutText:
The Last Lodge

A medieval choice-based psychological horror.

You are the master of The Last Lodge. A respected pillar of the community and a sanctuary for the weary. But behind the warmth of the hearth, a cold reality takes root.

Your duties are clear: serve the patrons and flawlessly prepare their orders.

Every guest brings a story; few bring the truth.

The safety of your family rests on the choices you make. Will you protect the innocent, or will you sacrifice your morality to keep your own blood safe?

The Scales are set. Make your choice.

games.name: Beauty Store Simulator - Prologue
games.shortDescription: Run your own beauty store in Beauty Store Simulator! Manage a variety of cosmetics, fashion items, jewelry, and more. Design your store, keep customers happy, and build a successful beauty empire. Can you become the ultimate beauty mogul?
games.aboutText:
Thanks to the Prologue, you will be able to experience the Beauty Simulator entry-level content and features. Don't forget to add to your wishlist and follow us for the full version of the game.

Beauty Store Simulator is a unique 3D simulation game where you step into the world of cosmetics, fashion, and luxury items. You’ll manage your very own beauty store, offering a wide range of products from makeup and skincare to jewelry, clothing, wigs, and more.

Design your store, attract customers, and become the go-to beauty destination in NY CITY.

Boost your store’s visibility by collaborating with popular beauty influencers for live streaming events. Watch as traffic soars and sales spike with every successful broadcast!

Hire janitorial staff to maintain a spotless shopping environment. A clean store not only pleases customers but also helps uphold your brand’s prestige.

Thieves occasionally lurk among shoppers. Employ security personnel to deter pickpockets and prevent losses, ensuring a safe experience for everyone.

Bring in restock assistants to keep shelves fully stocked and organized. Never miss a sale due to empty displays again!

Hire assistant managers to handle checkout efficiently, reduce waiting times, and even upsell products—making every transaction smooth and profitable.

Take your beauty empire to the next level by expanding into hair salons, spa treatments, and more! As your beauty store flourishes, diversify your offerings and dominate the beauty industry.

Whether you dream of becoming a beauty mogul or simply enjoy curating a stylish shopping experience, Beauty Store Simulator offers a fun, interactive, and richly detailed environment to build your dream store and dominate the world of beauty retail.

games.name: Setsuna
games.shortDescription: Play as "Setsuna," an android assassin. In this cyberpunk-themed 2D action-adventure game, traverse a futuristic metropolis ruled by a super-corp alongside your accompanying AI, clash with powerful enemies, collect abilities to explore the unknown, and search for the meaning of your existence.
games.aboutText:
Become an android assassin. After a failed assassination mission, your consciousness awakens again in a hibernation pod.

And the voice of your assassination target echoes in your mind.

What is going on?

- High-speed, interactive sword-fighting combat centered around "Clash".

- Rich character progression system: Collect runes and chips to build your own unique fighting style.

- Explore a vast cyberpunk futuristic city and meet a diverse cast of characters.

- Utilize your character's abilities and the hacking protocols of your accompanying robot to uncover secrets and treasures hidden in the city's corners.

- Fight to the death against dozens of ruthless and cunning enemies; daring to "Clash" offers a glimmer of hope.

- Experience a nuanced yet fast-paced storyline within a cyberpunk setting, and learn about the past of your mysterious companion——ES.

games.name: Immortal Rebirth
games.shortDescription: Hunt for treasure and face formidable foes in an ink-wash fantasy world. Fit your gear into a limited inventory to create powerful combinations, and forge your own playstyle with a wealth of affixes and an expansive talent tree.
games.aboutText:
Choose Your Weapon, Shape Your Build

Discover distinct attack styles with flying swords and weapons inspired by traditional Chinese arts. Combine gear affixes and talent choices to build a playstyle around your favorite weapon.

Hunt for Loot, Refine Your Gear

Collect magical gear on your adventures and seek out items and affix combinations that suit your build. Reroll affixes, upgrade your finds, and refine your gear to bring your build together.

Your Backpack Is Your Loadout

Fit gear of different shapes into your backpack, balancing limited space with powerful combinations. Arrange items around their effects and make use of adjacency bonuses to build a winning loadout.

games.name: RadCity: A Post-Apocalyptic Adventure
games.shortDescription: RadCity is a narrative-heavy, top-down journey through a dark, irradiated city. In a post-apocalyptic world, environmental storytelling and meaningful decisions shape your survival. Supplies are running out, the undead are everywhere, and it's hard to trust people anymore. Find a way out.
games.aboutText:
RadCity blends puzzles, stealth, zombie horror, thriller and cRPG elements into a bleak survival journey where knowledge is often more valuable than resources. Notes left by those who came before may contain the clues you need, while confrontation with the undead is a fight you are unlikely to win. Explore, read the signs, talk with the last living strangers, and stay hidden. Find a way out before there is nothing left to survive for.

Game Features

- A dark, grounded post-apocalyptic world.

- Inspired by real abandoned places.

- Search rooms, inspect forgotten objects, follow notes and piece together what happened.

- Food is running out, radiation blocks your path and nightfall brings new dangers.

- No constant hand-holding.

- Meet survivors, uncover their pasts, take on side stories and make choices that can change relationships.

- Radiation, hostile survivors and the undead transform familiar locations into threats.

- Point-and-click interaction, dialogue, puzzles and classic isometric cRPG influences meet a modern 3D top-down presentation.

Game Inspirations
Fallout, Chernobylite, Stalker, Metro, Mad Max, Atom RPG, Wasteland, Encased, UnderRail, Project Zomboid, Survival Log, Scavland, BEAUTIFUL DESOLATION, STASIS: BONE TOTEM

Before you buy

✅ you want to jump right in, explore without hand-holding and get immersed in a dark, atmospheric world, and you enjoy environment storytelling, side missions, puzzles and dialogues

❌ you want action, lots of guns and shooting up zombies or you expect a survival experience with looting and crafting

games.name: Too Deep To Quit
games.shortDescription: Grab your gear and your friends for a hilarious, golden-age co-op adventure! Dive into cursed temples, hunt for the ultimate treasure, and work together to stay alive. Beware of everything and everyone... after all, only the survivors get to split the gold!
games.aboutText:
Too Deep To Quit is a 1-4 player co-op survival exploration game. Gather your team of adventurers, brave the dangers of cursed temples, and claim the ultimate treasure.

A true adventurer knows how to improvise. These cursed temples hold a lot more than just gold, they’re packed with the leftovers of the poor saps who came before you. Check every dark corner for whatever keeps you breathing.

Sure, starving to death is bad, but getting squashed by the walls is definitely worse. Every hallway is a literal death trap waiting for the clumsy guy in your squad to mess up.

If the traps don’t get you, the locals will. These forgotten temples are the perfect breeding ground for anything that slithers, stings, or bites.

It belongs in a museum... but it’ll look way better in your bank account. Deep within these ruins lie priceless artifacts and solid gold idols just waiting to be claimed.

games.name: Silver Lake National Park
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Silver Lake National Park, where Ranger Logan keeps the trails clear, the campfires warm, and the supernatural community hidden in plain sight. He's a werebear who learned long ago not to fight what he is. These days he makes sure everyone feels at home, even when he can't always feel it.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Silver Lake National Park. The trails are clear, the campfires are warm, and Ranger Logan knows every regular by name. To the hikers and families who pass through, this is beautiful wilderness. To the others, the werebears and werewolves and supernatural folk who have nowhere else to go, it is a sanctuary hidden in plain sight.

Logan is one of those others, a werebear. Unlike the rest, he must stay, or risk losing control and hurting someone he loves. Again.

Silver Lake National Park is a companion to The Last Werewolf. A cozy, story-driven game about running a sanctuary, building connections, and learning that letting people in is not the same as losing control.

Features

- Manage the Park. Repair trails, restock supplies, and handle plant and animal conservation.

- Run Activities. Host hikes, campfire chats, creative workshops, and canoe hire for park visitors.

- A Hidden Sanctuary. The park is a safe haven for werebears, werewolves, and other supernatural beings.

- Build Relationships. Nurture relationships with family and friends, build connections with park visitors, and maybe find something more romantic, or choose to go solo.

- Monitor Your Inner Werebear. Balance the demands of running the park with managing Logan's limitations as a werebear.

games.name: An Automaton's Journey
games.shortDescription: Play as the ancient automaton Cecilia Immergreen as you explore the world for secrets, solve puzzles, delve into dungeons, fight other Hololive members as powerful bosses, help other members with side quests, and find powerful items to explore previously unavailable locations.
games.aboutText:
Explore the world

An open world filled with secrets that opens up as you advance through the game and find new items.

Explore dungeons and solve puzzles

Explore 8 different dungeons, each with unique enemies and puzzles.

Help your friends

Complete a variety of side quests, often culminating in exciting boss battles, and receive great rewards.

Obtain powerful items

Complete dungeons and side quests to extend your repertoire of items. The 15 unique items will unlock new fighting abilities and new ways to explore the world.

Fight familiar enemies

Your friends and their fans have gone mad by some an some kind of curse and you're the only one who can save them. With 13 bosses and over 40 different fan mascot enemies, there's a lot of work ahead of you. For Justice!

This game is published under CCMC Corp(※1)'s Indie game brand "holo Indie".(※2)

This game is allowed to be monetized under the examination and terms of "holo Indie".

Please note that any monetized derivative work games that include Cover Corp.'s content outside of holo Indie is not covered by these terms and is not allowed.

※1. About CCMC Corp.

CCMC Corp. is entrusted with website management (ex: steam) including, examination, publishing and other necessary tasks by Cover Corp.

※2. About "holo Indie"

holo Indie's objective is to cooperate with hololive production fans and creators.

It is a game brand that offers "Game Creator Support Program" for the derivative work games.

For more details about "holo Indie", Please refer to the Cover Corp.'s "Derivative work guidelines".

games.name: Karma Exorcist
games.shortDescription: The underworld lies in ruins, ravaged by evil karma. In this unknown and perilous realm of the dead, you must fight against demonic forces, collect mystical artifacts, face the Yama Kings and the Ghost Emperors, sever the Karma, and reforge the path of reincarnation.
games.aboutText:
The Netherworld Reimagined

Karma Exorcist is an Eastern mythology-themed side-scrolling Metroidvania action-adventure game.

Inspired by Chinese mythology, this game presents a fresh interpretation of the underworld: good and evil karma function like an invisible magnetic field, influencing the balance of the Three Realms. When evil karma spreads, disasters follow. To counter this, gods and buddhas gradually established the underworld—with Meng Po Soup (Potion of Oblivion) to erase memories, the Eighteen Levels of Hell to punish guilty souls, and more—all to maintain the cycle of existence. Here, you will explore a world of the dead that feels both familiar and strange.

Game Features

- Free Exploration, Multiple Paths: From the shores of the River of Forgetfulness adorned with fields of red spider lilies, to the endless deserts beyond the Ghost Gate, the serene Naihe Bridge, the magnificent Hall of Kings, and the distinct peaks of the Five Ghost Emperor Mountains—most of this kingdom of the dead is open for you to freely explore. There is never just one path to the ending; hidden stories and areas await discovery as you adventure onward.

- Dynamic Combat, React and Adapt: Wield a 360° Chain Hook alongside dashes, double jumps, rolls, and combat artifacts to outmaneuver enemies in fast-paced battles. Numerous monsters feature unique combat mechanics that demand keen observation and careful responses. Each boss encounter is meticulously designed with distinct styles, delivering intense and thrilling duels where you react and adapt—culminating in the supreme satisfaction of overcoming powerful foes.

- Myriad Artifacts, Shape Your Destiny: Collect various artifacts during your journey, each with its own unique combat module, allowing you to mix and match freely. Equip multiple Soul Gems to create a combat style that is uniquely yours. Additionally, utilize consumables such as talismans and elixirs to aid your travels through this perilous underworld.

games.name: BLOODSAINT 2
games.shortDescription: BLOODSAINT 2 is the most recent, barely playable, fast-paced, retro-hardcore, top-down arena-shooter minigame from Walter Machado.
games.aboutText:
BLOODSAINT 2 is the most recent, barely playable, fast-paced, retro-hardcore, top-down arena-shooter minigame from Walter Machado.

Crafted for the finest community of UBERMOSH, QUICKERFLAK, and BLOODSAINT, this sequel came guided by the priceless players' feedback and suggestions, pumped by a powerful soundtrack and vicious gameplay.

The game starts with you putting your reflexes to the test, as a cleric performing a ritual for a ruthless synthetic deity, evolving every 10 seconds of combat in a minigame that should have launched 3 decades ago.

Code, art, bass, guitars, and drums executed by the same hands.

Welcome back!

games.name: hop to bunny restaurant!
games.shortDescription: Start your desktop bakery! Begin with one cookie and a table. Decorate, cook, hire staff, and learn recipes. Serve lively bunny customers, meet quirky characters, and unlock their unique stories and dishes!
games.aboutText:
Run a Bunny Bakery—Right on Your Desktop!

A desktop management sim built for busy lives—docked at the bottom of your screen, never in the way of work！

Hire cute bunny staff, set your menu, and grow your shop your way.

Between tasks, restock, upgrade, and check the mailbox for customer reviews.

Discover mini-stories, satisfy picky customers, unlock new dishes.

Theme your restaurant!！

Minimalist or lavish? Flowers or stars? Market or jungle? Halloween or carnival...

Tons of theme sets to pick from! Each with special effects!

Boosts efficiency and decorates your desktop shop.

Arranging furniture is pure joy.

(Display only what you like—buffs aren't tied to theme furniture!)

Combine your skills!

Chain Petting, Customer Trading, Petting-to-Massage, Culinary Division...

Learn and upgrade all kinds of chef skills!

Flashy skills while idling—a feast for the eyes.

Don't forget! Hire bunny employees!

Food runners, cash collectors, customer wranglers, stove pokers,

matchmakers (?), spellcasters (??), and those who pet every customer on sight (???)

Each a master of their craft... but combos work miracles!

And! Upgrade your shop!

Better suppliers, bigger menus, staff training,

even a turbo engine for your spatula? ...

Lead your bunnies to better quality, service, and efficiency—go big!

Do poorly, and you can't escape the customers' ... feedback ...

Bunny customers leave reviews, though some are... emmm...

Don't underestimate them—they hold the key to improving your shop!

So earn rave reviews together!

New map，New experience!

Start in a remote flower field and make it rain gold!

Thanks to the Bunny Baroness, we've reached the B!G! S!E!A!

Cast wide, fish plenty! The sea offers specialty ingredients and high-value treasures to salvage and sell!

At last, the city—but we're new, no storefront. What now?

The sidewalk's roomy enough! Set up right in the middle of the road!

Note: the odds of a bunny trashing your shop are not zero...

The shop owner next door doesn't look so good?

And slacking off! We're professionals!

A one-click hide-the-whole-game feature disguised as a speed-up orb—switch between work and play in a flash!

Start your Bunny Kingdom bakery journey now!

games.name: Enemies Within
games.shortDescription: Battle corrupted enemies, liberate afflicted allies, and explore a modernly medieval world on the verge of self-destruction in this action-packed 2D side scrolling adventure.
games.aboutText:
Find your future

Beyond the mountainous borders of your small town rises a corrupting force that threatens to tear apart the fragile fabric that holds society together. As this corruption spreads, many succumb to the resulting afflictions, and many others become corrupting forces themselves. Will you have the strength to survive a hopeless world and liberate your allies from their afflictions? Or will you similarly succumb to the abyss?

Enemies Within is a pixel-art 2D action adventure that spans lush forests, twisting caves, alpine tundra, dark dungeons, and even a monstrous mega mall.

Expressive characters and enemies

Enemies Within is full of expressive characters in a charming pixel-art style. Each character and enemy has a unique personality and way of expressing themselves as they assist, advise, or attack you.

Explore unique environments in a fully interconnected world

Explore twisting caves, dark dungeons, and alpine tundra to solve the mystery of the spreading corruption. Each biome is full of unique enemies and obstacles that will put your skills of combat and evasion to the test. The world is fully connected to create a truly immersive experience.

Other game features

- Characters and environments brought alive with original human-made art, sound effects, and music.

- Intuitive combat system with attacks that can be chained together into multiple satisfying combos.

- Explore the world at your own pace and in your own way without being weighed down with chatty companions or constant reminders to play the game the "correct" way.

- Unlock unique forms as you progress and strategically switch forms to gain the upper hand against your opponents.

- Challenging boss battles that rewards a mastery of combat and motion.

- Multiple endings that are affected by the choices you make throughout the game.

- Dynamic world that changes with ongoing events and player decisions.

- Gauntlet mode is available for those who wish to hone their combat skills against a multitude of enemy arrangements.

- Sign wobble mini game. Can you beat my high score of 10 consecutive sign wobbles?

games.name: Debauchery & Magic
games.shortDescription: In Haven, magic thrives and debauchery is strictly forbidden. Defy a ruthless new ruler as you and your friends quest, loot, party, and battle your way across the kingdom to bring freedom back to its people.
games.aboutText:
In Debauchery & Magic , you find yourself in the world of Haven: A fantastical place filled to the brim of your wizard hat with never-ending celebrations and a bustling economy fueled by indulgence. As expected, the newly crowned Prince Baytre’s coronation was a party for the ages!

Or it was...until you woke up the next morning.

Debauchery has been outlawed. Revelry is banned. Shenanigans of all sorts are no longer tolerated by the royal family, by penalty of death.

That is, unless you step up.

Solo, or with up to 11 friends, take the fight to Haven’s shadow government and leave a blazing trail of indulgence in your wake.

Quest, loot, and fight the powers that be with a variety of magic and weaponry. Drink concoctions that empower your spells but ruin your coordination. Smoke alchemical blends that'll send you into next week. Gamble your life savings in gold against the house, or your friends, in a myriad of games hidden away in secretive casinos. Or just laze the day away fishing for exotic and uncouth aquatic creatures.

Along the way, you can even stunt on the townsfolk with your gnarly skateboard skills across the fantasy world of Haven.

Dive into a dark-fantasy world where spellcasting, danger, and indulgence collide. Explore cursed kingdoms, tavern hideouts, underground gambling halls, and halls of arcane corruption as you shape your destiny through equal parts mystical energy and reckless decision-making .

The royal family won’t know what hit them, until a fireball is headed their way.

It’ll take more than moxie and harsh words to free the people of Haven from their newfound tyranny – and that’s where your professions will shine. Sharpen your skills in a variety of professions to further embody the life debaucherous...the people need your guidance, after all.

- Alchemy

- Brewing

- Carpentry

- Fishing

- Gambling

- Herbalism

- Mining

- Smithing

- Woodcutting

Play as a Debaucherously Powerful Wizard
Be it as a close-range brawler or long range spellcaster, you choose how to take the fight to the tainted royals and defend the people of Haven. Live your ultimate wizard fantasy as a boundless hero...or an epic quest to restore debauchery to the land of Haven.

Dynamic Drinking & Drug Systems
Your magic is powerful—but so are your vices. Drinking, smoking, and all manners of indulgence directly influence your stats, abilities, and combat flow. Buffs, debuffs, hallucinations, and chaotic side effects…it’s all part of the lifestyle.

Procedurally Generated Dungeons & Weapons
Every dungeon run features new layouts, traps, loot, and spell modifiers. Weapons roll unique stats and magical properties, letting you build absurdly powerful or hilariously unstable loadouts.

Seamless Co-Op
Experience debauchery with friends. Drink together, gamble together, dive into dungeons together, and resurrect each other after terrible decisions.

Only the Gnarliest Mode of Transportation

Wizards shredding on skateboards? Kickflipping a horse? Radical!

3rd Shift Studios AI Usage Disclaimer

As a team of creatives who have worked in the game industry for several years, we understand that AI is a controversial topic and will continue to be so in the future. In light of this, we wanted to ensure we made clear how and where we use AI, and where we don't / won't.

- We DO use LLMs to assist in the creation of technical tools and programs that aid in network troubleshooting and performance optimization.

- We DO NOT use Generative AI to create any art, assets, voice modeling, or any creative product that could be produced or contracted out to real world artists.

games.name: The Element Of
games.shortDescription: The Element Of is an element bending roguelite dungeon crawler set in a strange fantasy world. Choose from a variety of elements all with their unique playstyles to fight through floors of enemies and gain rewards that make you and your element stronger.
games.aboutText:
An otherworldly being has entrusted you with the power of the elements to defeat the source of what caused the world to become what it is today. Clear randomly generated dungeons with the element of your choice and obtain gifts from mysterious sources to get stronger each floor before the final confrontation.

Unique Elements
