There are the four core elements (Water, Fire, Earth, Air) all with their unique playstyles that match their element theme. Each core element has two sub-elements that are unlocked in different ways. Each sub-element also has their own unique playstyle. After all the sub-elements are unlocked, perhaps there's more unique elements to be found?

- Water - Splash your enemies with rapid hitting attacks after building up tempo.

- Fire - Burn your enemies with fireballs that get stronger after getting fired up.

- Earth - Crush your enemies with attacks that grow from a pebble to a boulder.

- Air - Sweep away your enemies as you swiftly traverse the dungeon.

More than a twin-stick shooter

Each element has their unique projectiles, but that's not all. Each element has their own thematic dash/utility, active ability and passive that synergize with themselves.

Items, Synergies and Upgrades

Throughout the many dungeons you can encounter various items that provide a range of benefits, from a simple stat boost item to items that modify your projectile attack in unique ways. Many of these items can have unique interactions with each element. A moon themed item can have unique effects when playing with a water-based element.

Along with unique interactions with elements, items can have unique synergies with each other. There are over ## current synergies that are waiting to be discovered to help you in your venture to the end.

Items are not the only upgrades you can receive in 'The Element Of'. In each dungeon floor, you are able to further upgrade your element's potential with elemental upgrades . These are upgrades specific for your element that can improve your element's specific abilities or even completely modify it. There are endless combinations of items, synergies and element upgrades to discover.

games.name: Dice In You
games.shortDescription: A roguelike deck builder with dice. Fuse dice to create your own powerful custom dice, and aim for even higher scores!
games.aboutText:
Dice In You is a roguelike deck builder that uses dice.

Synopsis

You wake up in an unfamiliar room and realize you’re trapped in a sealed space with a mysterious girl.
The only way to escape is to operate the device in front of you and clear the game.

Dice Fusion

At the end of each round, you can obtain dice with special abilities.
Newly acquired dice can be fused with one of your existing dice to create your own powerful custom die.

The Girl’s Emotions

The girl’s emotions change depending on how you play.
Her shifting feelings may end up helping you.

Reach the end together with the girl—
and ESCAPE .

games.name: Tales of Fear - Episode Zero
games.shortDescription: Can you tell the difference between truth and tale? Experience three short horror stories and gather clues as to which are true and which are just part of our imagination. Immerse yourself in the protagonist's perspective and discover eerie tales from around the world.
games.aboutText:
Tales of Fear is a first-person horror adventure featuring playable retellings of various horror stories. Some of them are fictional, while others are based on real events, and it's up to you to figure out which ones are true.

Take on the role of the protagonist in each narrative and experience unique stories. Explore immersive, handcrafted locations on your own and encounter some frightening surprises along the way.

Case 01 - Enfield Encounter

Patrick McKelvy's relaxed evening turns out to be a dangerous nightmare that he is forced to endure while fearing for his life. He encounters a creature that does not exist in any history book and causes great chaos in his city.

Case 02 - Alice and Bob

An employee of a large tech company takes on a night shift with his colleague that will haunt him for a long time afterward. An experiment in artificial intelligence is supposed to take the company to the next level. When his coworker suddenly has an emergency, he is left alone with the experiment. It goes well, too well, until he loses control of the AI models.

Case 03 - Doai Station

Kaito, a freelance journalist chasing a rumor at Mount Tanigawa, decides to take the last train home. As the train arrives, he is on the phone with his brother, Haru, when the connection suddenly breaks. While waiting for Kaito's arrival, Haru becomes anxious, only to find out that the last train from Doai Station had already left hours before the phone call.

Key features

- Three playable cases with unique atmospheres

- Recreation of real locations

- Dynamic audio system

- Various tasks and mini-puzzles

- Guess which stories are true and compare your answers with other players

- Interactive dialogues

games.name: The Christmas Cackler
games.shortDescription: The Christmas Cackler is a first-person Christmas-themed Comedic Horror game where you play as little Jimmy, lying in bed on the night before Christmas, trying to finish drawing his mother's present and avoid getting grabbed by the Christmas Cackler!
games.aboutText:
The Christmas Cackler is a first-person Christmas-themed Comedic Horror game where you play as little Jimmy, lying in bed on the night before Christmas, trying to finish drawing his mother's present and avoid getting grabbed by the Christmas Cackler!

Fun Storyline! The night begins with your mother telling you the story of the Christmas Cackler, an evil entity that sneaks into naughty kids' rooms on Christmas Eve and steals them away! Can you make it to Christmas morning?

Big Scares! Players must stay vigilant to ensure the Christmas Cackler doesn't sneak into their room undetected. Keep the being at bay with your flashlight and turn off any malfunctioning electronics, or your mother will get stressed out!

Fantastic Art! While trying to survive, the player must multitask with drawing a wonderful Christmas present for their mother before morning. Ensure you make good progress on the drawing, otherwise, the Christmas Cackler will be the least of your problems!

Key Features

-First Person Static Horror Game

-Short and Sweet Christmasy Storyline

-Blend of Horror and Comedy

games.name: Sisters of Solitude
games.shortDescription: Explore a haunted convent with your EMF detector, tape recorder, and camera. Uncover the fate of four ghostly sisters and the mystery behind the murder they commited. Every room hides a clue, every shadow a warning, and the truth waits for those who dare to seek it.
games.aboutText:
THE DEAD DO NOT REST WITHIN THIS UNGODLY PLACE,

AND NEITHER SHALL YOU...

IF YOU DARE TO FACE...

THE SISTERS OF SOLITUDE.

Based on a chilling true story , Sisters of Solitude takes you inside the remains of an abandoned convent, The Order of Our Lady of Solitude. Decades ago, four sisters conspired in the dead of night to murder their Mother Superior in cold blood. Shortly after, the sisters were found dead under a shroud of mystery.

People say their hearts were turned so wicked by the deed that their souls remain bound to the convent by a dark, lingering magic. Now, you play as a teenager obsessed with the paranormal, as you enter the convent with one goal: Find proof. Take the photo.

A RETRO INVESTIGATION

Sisters of Solitude is an isometric, pixel art detective horror game inspired by the haunting aesthetic of late 80s and early 90s 8-bit classics. Through haunting chiptune inspired music and dream like pixel art, you will embark on a twisted investigation that will let you uncover the convent’s darkest and deepest secrets.

This isn't just a walk through a retro looking haunted house, it's a forensic deep dive into the supernatural.

EQUIPPED FOR THE HUNT

You are armed with only your wits and three essential ghost hunting tools. Use them wisely, your resources are not infinite.

- The EMF Detector: Track supernatural signatures. A click could lead you to a hidden diary... or a spirit waiting for you.

- The Tape Deck: Record the silence. Play back the white noise to hear the voices of the sisters whispering their secrets from the beyond.

- The Instant Camera: Your most vital asset. Capture spectral imprints and gather photographic evidence… but don't waste your precious film.

UNCOVER THE TRUTH

To find the ghosts and get the shot, you will need to understand the motive of the murder. Explore the entire compound, from the desecrated chapel, the greenhouse, the cemetery to the old theatre, and piece together a story of jealousy, hatred, and witchcraft.

- Investigate the Murder: Retrace the sisters steps and learn how and why Mother Superior met her end.

- A Living Journal: Document your findings, read forgotten diaries, and solve the mystery to unlock the convent's darkest secrets.

- Grave Digging & Dark Arts: When logic fails, you may have to dabble in the very rituals that trapped these souls in the first place.

KEY FEATURES

- Atmospheric Psychological Horror: Uncover a mystery inspired by a real-world haunted convent.

- High-Stakes Photography: With limited film, every shutter click could save you or help you find the missing key to the mystery.

- Non-Linear Exploration: Find secret doors, open every door and search every drawer. It is up to you to choose where to go and explore.

- Collect the evidence: Collect journals, EVP recordings and photographs to help you solve the mystery.

- Chilling Soundtrack: An original 8bit soundtrack by electronic artist Phormique.

games.name: Reel Tiny
games.shortDescription: Become the fisherman you were always meant to be in Reel Tiny. Experience life as a tiny creature in a big world as you catch fish and make friends. Trade with the town to upgrade your lures and fishing rod. Earn new fishing licenses to explore new sections of the creek and become an angling legend!
games.aboutText:
REEL TINY

Catch tiny fish, upgrade fishing gear, and live the quiet life in the cozy mountain town of Critter's Crick!

GAMEPLAY FEATURES

- Experience life as a cute little Shrew

- Complete your fishing journal by collecting a variety of tiny fish

- Trade for new rods and lures

- Unlock new areas of the river as you level up your fishing license

- Find hidden fishing spots

- Listen to a wonderful and atmospheric soundtrack

- Catch episodes of a nearby radio broadcast

FISHIN'

Get your fishing license and start your journey today! Trade fish for gear upgrades, level up your fishing license, and find hidden fishing spots.

Play with Reel Tiny’s one-of-a-kind fishing minigame! Designed to be welcoming for beginners with room for mastery.

QUITE THE JOURNEY

Enjoy several unique environments each packed with hours of fishing and exploration. Your journey will take you to places a shrew could only dream about. From a cozy mountain town, to a beachy resort, there’s plenty to explore.

TRASH OR TREASURE?

Use your favor with the townsfolk to trade for supplies scavenged from human garbage! A piece of hotdog can go a long way when you’re a tiny fisherman.

games.name: THROUGH TIME·SUMMER OF GIRL PUZZLE
games.shortDescription: On a summer beach, restore photo after photo as jigsaw puzzles to unlock new encounters and conversations with different girls. A light puzzle + romance game featuring multiple heroines, full voice-over.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to join us

Join our Discord

About the game

Puzzle + Romance Sim

On a summer beach, you run into several girls with very different personalities and backgrounds.
A college student working part-time at a stall, a diligent lifeguard, a quiet creator running her own little shop…
Every encounter is captured in a photo – and those photos are cut into puzzle pieces in your hands.

Complete the puzzles to unlock new conversations, choices, and events, and slowly get closer to how they really feel.

Features

● Restore photos with jigsaw puzzles

- Slice everyday beach moments and date snapshots into puzzle pieces

- Rotate and connect pieces to complete the image, with moderate difficulty and a relaxing pace

- Complexity gradually increases as you progress, keeping a small but steady challenge

● Multiple heroines with distinct personalities

- Cheerful and energetic, gentle and slow to warm up, cool but secretly flirty…

- Each heroine has her own little storyline and exclusive CGs

- The same scene can feel completely different depending on the choices you make

【Introduction of the Main Character】

Mirei Yamamoto, around 26, summer vacationer.

She shuts off work and escapes to the beach. Calm, gentle, and quietly inviting.

Sakura Tachibana, around 23, band vocalist.

Red hair, sunglasses, and a bold sense of rhythm. Confident, lively, and made for the stage.

Rin Nanami, around 20, seaside girl.

Bright blue twin braids and a shy smile. She loves shells, sunlight on the sea, and your attention.

Aoi Nagisa, around 25, beach lifeguard.

Tanned, energetic, and dependable. She may sound strict, but she is always watching over you.

Yuzu Shiraishi, around 22, fruit drink stand girl.

Sweet, cheerful, and full of citrus charm. Her smile makes summer feel even fresher.

● Gameplay

- Use special skills to help you complete puzzles

- Shuffle, combine, and match pieces to create your own arrangements

- Collect items by finishing each puzzle

- Review all the scenes you’ve already unlocked in the gallery

- More than 50 sets of fully dynamic CG jigsaw puzzles

- Full voice-over for all dialogues

games.name: Demons' Timeline
games.shortDescription: Cyber Detective L solves Paradoxes—bizarre incidents by supernatural Demons—via the social media giant Parrotter. The Cyber Detective Squad, L and his Demon partner Nyasuteria, wield elite hacking and psychic powers to take on the final Paradox investigation.
games.aboutText:
Supported Languages: Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese

* An unofficial Korean language patch created by the community is available.

“Determine the Truth of the Incident.”

Can you identify the culprit behind a supernatural murder using nothing but information from social media timelines—without ever leaving your room?

Humans with supernatural powers are known as “Demons” .
The bizarre incidents they cause are called “Paradoxes”.

Demons' Timeline is a mystery adventure game in which you investigate the truth behind these Paradoxes from the perspective of the Cyber Detective known as “L”.

Your partner, a Demon named Nyasuteria Hakouchi , assists your investigation with special abilities.

You will never visit a crime scene in the real world.
All clues exist online.

Using only information found on the internet, uncover the truth behind these strange and complex Paradoxes.

Investigation Gameplay

Players read through large amounts of information and solve deductions entirely through point-and-click interactions.

Each chapter features one or two timelines to investigate.

By analyzing witness statements, news posts, and social media messages, players complete multiple deduction tasks and gradually reveal the full picture behind each case.

Identifying the People Involved

Carefully read the information flowing through the timeline.

Deduce the owners of both public accounts and hidden alternate accounts , and connect them together.

Clues hidden within posts—such as age, gender, occupation, and relationships —help identify the people involved in the case.

Data Recovery & Post Citation

Recover deleted data by discovering the correct restoration passwords.

Progress through the investigation by correctly quoting posts that serve as evidence for your deductions.

Final Deduction

Use the hashtags obtained from the timeline to fill in the final deduction.

Complete the deduction and confirm the truth behind each case.

There are correct and incorrect answers during the investigation,
but there are no time limits and no game overs.

A hint system is available, allowing players to continue the story until the end.

Because of the large amount of information involved, the game offers a challenging detective experience that rewards careful reading, information filtering, and logical thinking.

Free Demo Available

A free demo is currently available, allowing you to play up to Chapter 1 .

・Chapter 1 out of 7 total chapters

・Estimated playtime: 1–2 hours

・Save data can be carried over to the full version

Also, this game allows unrestricted live streaming and video uploads (including monetized ones) — no permission needed from us!

However, since seeing the full story beforehand may reduce the enjoyment of purchasing and playing the game yourself, we kindly ask that you include spoiler warnings in titles, descriptions, thumbnails, etc. (e.g., "SPOILER ALERT" or "Full Story Spoilers Ahead").

games.name: Stitchlings
games.shortDescription: Play solo, or grab a friend and embark on a bite-sized co-op combat adventure fighting toy monsters, picking them apart, while you stitch together your uniquely customized Stitchlings!
games.aboutText:
Stitchlings is a singleplayer & couch co-op action game where the monsters you defeat become parts to stitch onto your character, allowing you to customize your combat style and dress up your Stitchling! Grab a friend and embark on a grand adventure to rekindle a fading world where all you have is each other.

- Experiment with different playstyles by swapping out 5 unique trinkets , dropped by enemies

- Customize your Stitchling and gain stat bonuses with 5 collectible cosmetic items

- Grab a friend!

- Designed for same-screen play

- Compatible with 2 controllers, keyboard/controller, and Steam Remote Play Together

- Explore The Workshop, a miniature - yet spectacularly grand - patchwork world

- Test your survival skills against fabric foes and challenging bosses

- Reclaim the world that was once yours - together!

games.name: Unbowed
games.shortDescription: Choose your fate in this single-player pirate Soulslike where you explore cursed lands, battle eldritch horrors, and pillage any treasure you find. Death is only a temporary setback on the path to mastering brutal combat.
games.aboutText:
• Explore Swashbuckling Pirate Lands Twisted by Eldritch Influence

The Twisted Lands are a cursed archipelago of danger, treasure, and eldritch ruin.

Explore uncharted coasts and take whatever you can carry. Smuggler’s hideouts, underwater ship graveyards, and coastal forts await those bold enough to plunder them, but their denizens will not part with their riches willingly.

Explore ship graveyards and forgotten coasts, each hiding secrets to plunder

• Master Challenging Combat

Battle through The Twisted Lands against enemies who punish hesitation and reward mastery.

Timing is critical. Parries, counterattacks, dodge rolls, and stance breaks create openings for decisive blows while passive play leads to death.

Parry at range with well-timed firearm shots to punish openings

• Choose Your Fate

Begin as one of five playable classes, each with their own passive and active abilities, weapon loadouts, and identity.

Whether you favor brutal melee, finesse hybrids with firearms and parries, or devious traps and snares, the choice is yours to make.

The Bruiser thrives in close combat as a stalwart brawler wielding a massive anchor

• Embrace Madness

Sanity is both a resource and a curse.

As it drops, you lose maximum health and the world shifts against you, but your power grows in terrifying ways. Some routes, secrets, and treasures are only revealed to those who risk their mind.

How far will you go before breaking?

As sanity frays, the world shifts: new foes, new treasure, new horrors

games.name: Reincarnated as a Dark Lord Before Taking Over the World with Power 999999999
games.shortDescription: A brutally challenging puzzle novel RPG. Reincarnate as a dark lord, plan your path, and conquer the world. *NOT a passive idle game*
games.aboutText:
You've been reincarnated as another world dark lord with the skill to be reborn again and again. Use experience from your past lives to choose the right paths to conquer everything.

Features

✨ What's in this game

- Play as an another world dark lord : Grow and absorb the mana around you. Devour everything you can to survive. Develop dark magic, create minions, or evolve into a powerful creature.

- Short Puzzle RPG: 5-10 hours of content with multiple story chapters, multiple endings, and secrets to discover.

- Deceptively Deep : Simple to start, brutal to master. Every click matters when time is running out to progress through the story. All choices are displayed as branching paths for you to explore and easily see an overview of your entire journey.

- Automation system : Command your shadow servants to work automatically or do it manually yourself. It's up to you.

- 1000000000% inspired from isekai anime

☠️ What's NOT in this game

- The Prestige system doesn't make you stronger , but it makes subsequent playthroughs faster and unlocks various gameplay helpers.

- No character control or walking and movement in the game.

- No cut scenes or voice acting of any kind.

This is NOT a relaxing idle game. Time limits are tight, decisions matter, and failure means starting the chapter over again.

games.name: Neidfyre
games.shortDescription: Neidfyre is a turn-based duel game forged in fire and steel. Step into a cursed land of no escape. Survive against those who stand in your way and fulfill your purpose.
games.aboutText:
Journey Towards Neidfyre

Become one of those who have set foot in Kurania, a land trapped in endless night. One seeks to purify the curse, another to find a lost sibling. Amidst maddened Crusaders, desperate forest dwellers, and all manner of creatures, you must survive to restore Neidfyre and end the eternal night.

Game Features

- Unique 1v1 Combat
Time, spacing, and initiative are the keys to victory. Maintain the optimal distance, exploit your opponent's weaknesses, and make split-second decisions to survive.

- Evade, Counter, and Control the Space
Parry enemy strikes and break their poise to deliver a fatal blow. Mind your positioning; being driven into a corner ensures a deadly outcome.

- Collect Artifacts and Construct Your Build
Your actions are determined by the artifacts you equip. Explore the dungeons to discover new relics and combine them to construct an optimized combat style unique to you.

- A Journey of Choices
Will you risk danger for a faster route, or take the long way for safety? The choice is yours. Seize the opportunities found within crises and fulfill your purpose.

- The Tale of a Cursed World
Experience deep lore crafted in stunning art. Uncover a tale forged in fire and steel, and the hidden stories of the characters within.

games.name: Wireworks
games.shortDescription: Design your defenses, build your module board, and manage your wires. Combine signals and create synergies to empower your weapons and survive in this base-defense roguelike auto-battler.
games.aboutText:
Wireworks is a base-defense roguelike auto-battler where your defenses are built and controlled using a module board. Manage your wires, fine tune your modules, combine signals and create synergies to survive incoming enemies and bosses.

- 200+ Items and Skills to mix, match, and discover new builds.

- 3 Unique Areas with varied enemies and boss fights.

- Unlockable Characters with special skills and starting kits.

- Ascending Difficulties for further challenge.

- Endless Mode to push your builds to their limits.

games.name: Kimbap Heaven Simulator
games.shortDescription: Run your own Korean restaurant in Kimbap Heaven Simulator. Dive into a realistic cooking experience—wash, blanch, and roll your way to success. Satisfy customers with delicious recipes, manage your finances, and expand your business to build a culinary empire.
games.aboutText:
Do You Know Kimbap Heaven?

In <Kimbap Heaven Simulator> , become the owner of Korea's most beloved restaurant. 'Kimbap Heaven' can be found in every neighborhood, serving Kimbap and various Korean dishes that everyone loves.

Now it's your turn to run one. Experience a real day in the life of a Kimbap Heaven owner - carefully prepping fresh ingredients, and handling a flood of orders.

Cook Everything from A to Z

You'll buy real seaweed, get a rolling mat, wash rice, and cook it. Slice pickled radish, stir-fry carrots, blanch spinach, and fry eggs. Place ingredients on the seaweed, roll it up tightly, and slice it into perfect pieces. Then finally, serve it to your customers.

Every step matters. Burn something and you'll waste ingredients. Make customers wait too long and they'll get angry. But cook everything perfectly? You'll earn rave reviews.

Manage, Grow, and Expand

Order ingredients through the supply console and manage your inventory. Buy too much and food spoils. Buy too little and you'll run out of stock. Earn honest reviews and star ratings from customers to build your restaurant's reputation.

You can increase your store grade by attracting many customers, establishing a professional and impressive interior, and maintaining a high reputation. Reach higher grades and unlock more dishes. Start with basic Kimbap, then progress to tuna Kimbap, ramen, donkatsu, and fried rice. Purchase better cooking equipment, upgrade your restaurant, and improve efficiency to build your ultimate Kimbap paradise.

Key Features

- Complete Kimbap Heaven Management Experience - From purchasing ingredients to cooking, serving, and managing

- Realistic Korean Cooking Simulation - Prep and cook various ingredients just like in real life

- Unlockable Ingredients - Expand your menu as you level up

- Authentic Kimbap Recipes - Learn real recipes while playing

- Beautifully Recreated Korean Streets - Immersive backgrounds filled with Korean culture

- ...And hidden mystery

Are you ready to ascend to paradise?

games.name: GemCraft - Legacy Collection
games.shortDescription: Forge and combine magical gems, build deadly defenses, and survive relentless waves in the Flash-era tower defense classics GemCraft, Chapter Zero, and Labyrinth. Now with up to 9x speed, new hotkeys, easier gem combining, and smoother performance.
games.aboutText:
Forge. Combine. Survive.

At the heart of GemCraft is a deep gem-combining system. Forge magical gems, fuse them into higher ranks, and slot them into towers and traps to build devastating defenses. Manage your mana carefully, summon extra waves for greater rewards, and push your strategy further with every level.

Massive Content and Legendary Difficulty

The GemCraft series is known for its challenging difficulty and lengthy gameplay. Expect over 100 hours of content from these three games! Explore many maps, level your wizard beyond belief, upgrade your skills, collect amulets, and more! The content that was paid or exclusive to ArmorGames is unlocked and included in this collection.

Original Experience, Upgraded for PC
Not a remake: the games you remember, with a long list of improvements shaped by the community.

- Hotkeys across all three games for speed, waves, combining and more, kept consistent wherever possible and in line with the newer GemCraft titles

- Smoother late-game performance, with adaptive graphics for huge waves

- Fast-forward up to 9x , with separate play, pause and fast-forward buttons, and act freely while paused

- Send waves early with one click, drag gems into towers to combine, and merge whole grades with Shift+Click

- Refund skill points instantly with Shift+Click

- 1080p, enhanced audio, Steam achievements and cloud saves

games.name: Idyll Isle
games.shortDescription: A cozy idle island sim for your desktop, in a slim window above the taskbar. Islanders of every trade farm, chop wood, fish, mine, and cook. Craft and place buildings, upgrade tools, and make the island the last livable place at sea. Then sail past the mist to rebuild five lost islands.
games.aboutText:
Idyll Isle runs in a slim, transparent window above your taskbar and never covers your work. While you work, study, or watch videos, the island keeps going at the bottom of the screen. A glance now and then to adjust your plans is all it takes.

The 2.0 major free update is out now, adding aid for the Veil Archipelago, island-wide power, Autumnwood Manor, and over two hundred pieces of furniture.

Islanders work on their own according to their trade: they farm, chop wood, fish, mine, and cook. You assign the work, plan where facilities go, and upgrade their tools. As the island grows, you can send expedition parties out to sea in search of collectibles, then build the Echo and sail past the Veiltide to the Veil Archipelago.

From Wheat Field to Production Chain

Start with a single wheat field and build up a full production chain. Crops and catches become meals at the Kitchen, ore is smelted into ingots and forged into tools at the Blacksmith Shop, and timber and stone bricks go into new facilities. Later on come island-wide power, Sprinklers, the Deep Drill, and the Tree Nursery, and flowers, mushrooms, and herbs can be turned into dried goods, expedition potions, and perfumes. With dozens of crops, recipes, ores, and catches, how they link into supply lines is up to you.

Build, Restore, and Expand

Buildings such as Farm Plots, Water Wells, Storage, Kitchens, Animal Pens, Blacksmith Shops, Gem Workshops, and Trading Posts can be placed anywhere on land. Layout affects efficiency: build Storage near a work area and islanders spend less time walking. Repair broken bridges, abandoned railways, and derelict facilities to open new areas with more fields, waters, and ore veins.

Tool Upgrades

Every trade has its own tools: sickles, buckets, axes, fishing rods, hammers, and spatulas. Tool quality sets work efficiency. A better sickle harvests more cleanly, and a better rod comes up empty less often. At the Blacksmith Shop, smelted ingots become new tools, from Primitive up to Advanced, with a fourth tier of Master tools later on. Accessories such as boots and gloves add further bonuses.

Animals and Trade

Wild animals appear on the island. Feed and tame them, and they move into Animal Pens to produce eggs, milk, and wool. Pair them to breed, and the offspring inherit their parents' quality. Repairing the Lighthouse opens trade routes, and Trading Post caravans carry goods out to sell and bring back the supplies you order.

Expeditions

Recruit adventurers at the Expedition Tavern, form a party, and follow the routes the Lighthouse lights up, across seven sea regions of rising danger. Compare your party's power with each sea's danger before setting out, because an underpowered party may come back empty-handed. Farther seas hold rarer finds, such as the Coastal Seashell, Weathered Compass, Abyssal Coral, and Tempest Lodestone, all recorded in the Codex, and the depths of the Veiltide also yield blueprints for Treasured furniture.

The Echo and the Veil Archipelago

Once the island prospers, the Shipyard on the shore can be put back to work. Gather Premium Boards, Sail Canvas, a Nautical Chart, and voyage supplies to build the Echo and sail past the Veiltide. Beyond it, five derelict islands remain in the Veil Archipelago, and your own island's output builds housing and facilities for them. The Freighter carries building materials, balloons carry staples and daily goods, and people adrift at sea come ashore to settle. As the islands prosper, merchants from afar return to live on your island and bring the Glass Greenhouse, Master tools, and new production lines.

The Manor and Furniture Collection

Once the last island prospers, the royal court sends you the deed and the key to Autumnwood Manor, west of the Lighthouse. The manor has one floor above ground and one below, both free to decorate. Over two hundred pieces of furniture come from blueprints bought with coins, expeditions, fishing, and drifting bottles, and some form sets. A cat and a dog also arrive as the archipelago develops.

The Stele and the Letters

The Echo Stele on the shore records the island's past and the background of each islander. Once the Lighthouse is lit, merchants from afar begin to visit, and their letters gradually reveal the forgotten history of these waters.

Who It's For

• Players who enjoy relaxed, pressure-free idle games where they still make the calls

• Anyone who likes watching little islanders and animals bustle around

• Anyone who wants an island of their own to tend between work and play

• Players who enjoy building production chains from scratch and watching efficiency climb

• Anyone who enjoys collecting furniture and decorating a house of their own

• Anyone curious about a game that doesn't fill the screen

• Fans of pixel art and gentle stories

Welcome to the island.

Join our community on Discord!

It's not Idle. It's Idyll.

※ Idyll Isle is developed by a solo indie developer, and the English text on this page

games.name: Rustown
games.shortDescription: Five years after the “idiot virus” pandemic, a letter arrives from the father you thought was dead. Rustown is a story-driven stealth adventure about finding him in a slum where the infected live. Evade watchful eyes, follow clues, and discover the stories of those caught up in the city's troubles.
games.aboutText:
A Letter After Three Years of Silence

The protagonist's father contracted the “idiot virus” during the pandemic, leaving him with impaired memory and diminished intelligence. He later disappeared. Three years after his disappearance, he sends the protagonist a letter.

To find him, the protagonist must go to Rustown, the city the letter came from. Rustown is a slum that formed as the infected gathered there, cast out by their families and society after their intelligence declined. Beyond the reach of the authorities, it is a lawless place where gangs of the uninfected clash with gangs of the infected.

Why did he disappear? What is happening in this city? The protagonist steps onto Rustown's streets in search of answers.

Stay Unseen as You Follow the Clues

Danger lies on the path to the truth. Observe your surroundings, choose your moment to move, and stay hidden as you slip past watchful eyes.

Use tricks and tools to create openings, then make smart decisions to put your plan into action.

People's Stories Connect the Dots

The search for the missing father leads to encounters with a range of people and factions. Some stand in the protagonist's way, while others offer help. Each tells the city's story from a different perspective.

Piecing together conversations and clues reveals the background to the events and the connections between people. As the protagonist draws closer to finding their father, they gradually come to understand Rustown's people and the world they live in.

Rustown: a story of life and kindness that endure in a broken city.

games.name: Brofish
games.shortDescription: Brofish is an autobattler roguelite with Tower Defense elements. Catch and upgrade bizarre fish, combine items, effects, and hold back waves of undead to save the village from the Sea King!
games.aboutText:
Fish to fight

Go fishing and reel in bizarre fish. Add one to your team, keep another in reserve, or sell a spare to fish for something new. Every choice shapes your run.

Feed, Power Up, Evolve

Food strengthens your team, and three matching copies evolve into a more powerful fish. Build around more than just stats: some fish inflict poison and set enemies on fire, while others summon allies, slow enemies, or revive your hero.

Create Broken Synergies

Combine fish, items, and trinkets to create a build that wipes everything off the screen. Your team attacks automatically, while you manually trigger active abilities at just the right moment.

Unique Runs, Biomes, and Bosses

Fight through five biomes, from a tranquil river to a blood-red sea. Defeat elite enemies and bosses, and unlock new creatures, items, challenges, Ascension levels, and Endless Mode.

- 60+ fish to collect, upgrade, and combine into powerful synergies

- 100+ items and trinkets for unusual combinations

- 3 characters, each with unique build options

- 5 biomes, each with unique elite enemies and bosses

- 20+ challenges, 60+ unlocks, 10 Ascension levels, and Endless Mode

games.name: Meaningless Random Numbers
games.shortDescription: Meaningless Random Numbers is an Incremental Horror Game about earning money through Random Number Generators but be cautious, God is Watching...
games.aboutText:
Incremental Money

- Click to Generate a Random Number.

- Each Number earns you Money.

- Patterns like Pairs, Three of Kind and Four of a Kind multiply your pay out!

Murder and Arson

- Load your Gun with Three of Kinds.

- Fill Gas Canisters with Four of a Kinds.

- Use Murder and Arson to increase Fear, Anger and Guilt to improve your Profits!

God is Watching

- In the Fish, Trees and Flowers… God’s eyes are everywhere.

- Do not commit sin while God is Watching or face the consequences.

- Pray for forgiveness if caught!

Pay the Devil

- Buy upgrades to increase your profits.

- Pay the Devil to get access to New Upgrades.

- Eventually Automate your Random Numbers.

games.name: Biryado
games.shortDescription: Biryado is a billiards roguelike deckbuilder where rules are made to be broken. Collect Billy’s bizarre artefacts, customize your balls with wild abilities and combine their effects into absurd combos. Master shifting tables, overcome eccentric bosses, and send your score into another dimension!
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Biryado! Bad news: you're stuck here now... Luckily, Billy has plenty of strange inventions, and an infinite amount of time to help you reinvent billiards.

Spend your money in Billy’s shop and collect artefacts that rewrite the rules of your run.

Create an enormous black hole, unleash shockwaves, endlessly generate balls or even turn every ball number into six!

Why settle for ordinary balls when Billy can get you something much worse?

Combine multiple properties to create balls that grow while rolling, pass through everything, move by themself, or even copy other balls!

Bosses change how you are allowed to play. Improvise around their rules, and defeat them before they turn the table against you!

Biryado can be played in its original bright palette or switched to dark mode for a darker set of colors. Choose whichever is best fit for you!

games.name: Loop Tower
games.shortDescription: Loop Tower tells the story of adventurers climbing an endless tower. Place it on a corner of your desktop and help them continue their ascent. Experience a fresh blend of desktop idle gameplay + roguelike + RPG right now!
games.aboutText:
All BGM in Loop Tower is original, and you are free to use it in streams and other content!

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Loop Tower is an incremental idle RPG where you endlessly climb a tower.

You can enjoy it on your desktop while working on other tasks.

Equip skills that match your playstyle and build your own character.

A wide variety of skills are available.

You can also fight other players in the tower.

Complete your own unique character.

Embark on an adventure toward the top of the tower. You might meet someone along the way.

It’s okay if you fall.

You just have to climb again.

Desktop idle + roguelike + RPG

[ Loop Tower ] is waiting for you.

games.name: Miracle Revolution
games.shortDescription: A fantastical Bullet Hell game where you absorb and control enemy bullets to create your own firepower! Manipulate food-infused bullets to break through any formation, and use the power of Eggs to overthrow the wicked food goddesses!
games.aboutText:
WARNING, WARNING!! The Earth was suddenly conquered by three Cuisine Goddesses who replaced everyone's diets with three wicked foods — Wine , Ice Cream , and Tea , the harbingers of intoxication, sweetness, and addiction.

Play as Miruka , the Champion of Eggs , and fight back against the wicked foods with your incredible egg-powered ship! Prove your worth to be recognized as a true Goddess of Eggs, and save the world from an unhealthy future!

Experience a brand new style of bullet hell!

- Absorb the enemy's colorful bullets without worry!

- Distort their bullets and slow them down to a halt!

- Reflect hundreds of bullets back at the enemy and send them crashing down!!

Wishlist Miracle Revolution on Steam now, and stay tuned for future developments!

games.name: Mushroom Nook
games.shortDescription: Mushrooms of all kinds—adorable, quirky, and even some with unique abilities—are spring up randomly on your computer! Collect and nurture them, then decorate with various objects to create your own cozy mushroom haven, keeping you company while you work, study, or simply unwind.
games.aboutText:
Collect

Your computer has started sprouting all sorts of adorable and whimsical mushrooms! (Currently featuring nearly 200 completely unique varieties—with more on the way!)

Cultivate

Each mushroom goes through multiple growth phases! Water them, wait patiently, and enjoy watching them evolve. The final form of some mushrooms might just surprise you!

Interact

Every mushroom responds to your touch with delightful reactions. Rare varieties even come with unique abilities!

Decorate

We’ve prepared a variety of charming decorations for you to place freely—you can even set mushrooms on top of them!

Ambience

Day turns to night, scenes change, and soothing music sets the tone. Your very own cozy mushroom garden is the perfect companion for work, study, or relaxation.

Wishing you joy every day!

games.name: Demon Castle Story
games.shortDescription: Demon Castle Building Dungeon Management Simulation
games.aboutText:
A management simulation in which you take an old, run-down castle and turn it into a dastardly demon stronghold! Recruit unique monsters as your minions and vanquish adventurers who dare to enter your realm!

Install gargoyles, ritual altars, and other devilish decor to boost your castle's mystique and attract more monsters your way. Gift them food and other items to help them grow, and garner their support to fend off pesky adventurers.

You can also send your monster minions out to explore nearby dungeons and towns. They'll bring you back items and other loot, and maybe even some new allies!

As you progress, you can also start merging monsters together to make new ones.

And don't forget traps—essential equipment for proper castle defense! Develop a range of traps like sleep-inducing gas and heavy washbowls to thwart any who cross the threshold of your demonic haven! By placing and combining traps in imaginative ways, you can make your fortress of fiendishness virtually impregnable!

Fend off attacks from mighty adventurers and keep your minions sweet to become the biggest and baddest demon overlord of all time!

--

Try searching for "Kairosoft" to see all of our games!!

Developer Homepages. Feel free to follow me♪

games.name: Dream Village
games.shortDescription: Immerse yourself in the cozy world of village life! Set up your home, buy groceries or order home delivery, cook delicious soups, manage your farm and earn real estate. Dream Village - dreams become reality!
games.aboutText:
Immerse yourself in the cozy world of village life! Set up your home, cook delicious soups, manage your farm, and earn money from real estate. Casual is a simulator where every day is a new adventure!

Set up your home: Create a cozy space by choosing and arranging furniture to your liking. Customize the lighting and decor so that every corner reflects your personality.

Explore the local shops, buying everything you need to live and work on the farm. Use the mobile app to order goods with delivery or go shopping yourself in your pickup truck. And if you have any surplus crops, sell them at the nearest farm and earn money!

If you want to feel like a real farmer, buy a pickup truck and bring the goods yourself — save time and money!

Grow and cook: Plant seeds, take care of plants and harvest crops. Prepare delicious soups and dishes using fresh produce from your farm or store. Delight yourself and your friends with culinary masterpieces!

Dynamic life: Taking care of your home and farm are not your only worries. Enjoy the alternation of day and night, as well as the varied weather that affects your business. Plan your day, taking into account all the nuances!

Expand your business: Save money to buy a second home! Renovate and rent it out, or equip and sell it at a bargain price. Open your store in the mall and attract customers with your unique products.

And for the ambitious, rent a space in the mall and open your own shop!

games.name: Typing Farmer
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Typing Farmer! This desktop idle healing game will make a corner of your screen a cozy farm. Your daily actions—typing and clicking—automatically foster crop growth, attract cute animals play with you. Let the healing charm of adorable creatures infuse your intense workdays~
games.aboutText:
We wanted to create a desktop idle game that fits naturally into your day.

—and thus, Typing Farmer was born!

Your keyboard and mouse power the farm! Every keystroke and click helps your crops grow.

As long as you're typing, your farm keeps working!

Sell your crops to earn gold and unlock new plants to grow.

A bountiful harvest will attract adorable animals to settle on your farm!

Enter Renovation Mode to customize your farm!

Change the designs of UI entrances such as Storage, Shop, and Mailbox, or purchase decorative items to make your farm truly your own.

Play together with up to 15 players!

Turn into cute little animals, visit each other’s farms, share the joy of harvest, and make your tiny farm world feel even more lively!

Stay organized with the built-in to-do list and Pomodoro timer, and plan your day at a glance.

The game also tracks your daily keyboard presses and mouse clicks.

While growing your farm, you’re also growing your routine!

games.name: Furniture Market
games.shortDescription: Manage every step of your furniture business. Unload containers with cranes, drive forklifts to organize stock, and design your store for customers. Handle logistics alone or with friends in co-op. A realistic simulation focused on deep mechanics, from port shipments to in-store sales.
games.aboutText:
About the Game

Furniture Supply & Market Simulator is a simulation game where you manage every stage of a furniture store, from port shipments to in-store sales. You don't just place products on shelves; you are personally involved in every step of the logistics operation.

Key Features

- Port & Shipment: Your orders arrive at the port in large containers. Operate giant cranes to unload containers from the ships.

- Vehicle Handling: Get behind the wheel of a forklift to transport products to the warehouse and arrange them on racks.

- Store Design: You decide the store layout. Choose where to display products and create an efficient shopping experience for your customers.

- Realistic Operations: Use lifts and other equipment to stack heavy furniture and keep your stock management under control.

- Co-Op (Multiplayer): Work in the same port with your friends. While one operates the crane, another can drive the forklift. Share the tasks and manage the business together.

Roadmap

The game will grow step-by-step based on community feedback with the following planned features:

- Home Delivery: Transport products with trucks and complete furniture assembly tasks at customers' houses.

- Staff Management: Hire drivers, warehouse workers, and assembly specialists to scale your business.

- Advanced Logistics: New vehicles including semis, trucks, and specialized cargo carriers.

- Dynamic Market: Competitive companies and fluctuating market prices that affect your profit.

- Mod Support: An open structure allowing players to add new products, vehicles, and custom maps.

games.name: Small Hero
games.shortDescription: Welcome to Small Hero! This is a fast-paced, entertaining light Roguelike action survival game. You will play as a lone hero, facing off against waves of monsters. Each round is a brand-new adventure: you must shop and strengthen yourself between waves, then face more intense battle for survival!
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the fantastical arena of Small Hero!
This is a fast-paced, entertaining light Roguelike action survival game. You will play as a lone hero, facing off against waves of monsters. Each round is a brand-new adventure: you must shop and strengthen yourself between waves, then dive into the next, even more intense battle for survival!

Will you become a crit-slashing Berserker or a sharpshooting Gunslinger? Each choice will shape your unique combat style. Survive, scavenge loot, unlock more content, and then... play just one more round!

Key Features

⚡ Fast-Paced Frenzied Combat
Each battle lasts 10-30 minutes, offering tight, action-packed, and immensely satisfying gameplay! Dodge through hordes of monsters and defeat all enemies within the limited time frame, testing your positioning and crowd-control skills.

🎭 Massive Roster, Unique Playstyles
Choose from a variety of beloved heroes, each with their own unique starting weapons, attributes, and playstyles! Whether it's the fist-wielding Boxer, the bullet-spamming Ammunition Expert, or the Mysterious Pirate, there's a hero for everyone.

🛠️ Infinite Build Possibilities
After each run, use collected materials to purchase new heroes and unlock talents in the shop, making your heroes progressively stronger. During combat, choose from hundreds of randomly appearing items, weapons, and skills. Stack critical chance for extreme damage or build defense to become the ultimate tank? Your build determines your survival!

📦 Vast Arsenal of Weapons & Items
Wield everything from melee swords to the ranged "Buddha's Palm," from fantasy bows to modern firearms. With over a hundred weapons to choose from and thousands of diverse items, every run is a fresh experience.

🔄 Light Roguelike, Ever-Fresh
Death is a new beginning! While your character dies at the end of a run, the resources you collect will help you progress further in your next adventure. Unlock new characters, weapons, and items to continuously expand your tactical options.

Game Modes

🗺️ Battle Mode
Embark on a challenging adventure! Conquer different levels, facing unique monsters and powerful stage bosses!

🌊 Endless Mode
Test your build's limits and see how many waves you can survive.

⚽ Match Mode
A great place to farm resources! Merge, survive, get stronger... and then go again!

🌌 Worldview
📜 Prologue: The Rift Descends, the Multiverse Collapses

In the distant ancient era, the multiverse flourished like a sprawling World Tree, countless parallel worlds revolving in harmonious order. Then came the catastrophe known to later ages as the Doomsday Calamity—a force from the deepest void tore through the fabric of the cosmos. This rift, named the Dark Rift, forcibly dragged, shattered, and recombined fragments of countless worlds, forging them into a single chaotic realm.

Once-great empires crumbled overnight into ruins teeming with monsters. Mighty imperial armies were torn apart by alien beasts from distant galaxies. The hulking remains of mecha littered the land. The guardians of magical worlds fell one by one in brutal trials of survival, reduced to ash on the wind—their souls forever trapped in this accursed land.

As ancient prophecies whispered among wizards smoldered in the embers of darkness, and as ferocious behemoths clawed their way from the earth of forgotten realms, the final fantasy crystals cast eerie light across radioactive wastelands—a voice, ancient and unwavering, pierced the barriers between dimensions and echoed in the heart of every survivor:

"Only the Tiny Heroes can cross the rift and become the final bulwark of this broken world."

You are one such lone hero, chosen by fate. You were not born into this age of chaos. Instead, when the rift tore through existence, you were drawn by a mysterious force from your own world and cast into this eternal battlefield.

Your strength comes from the fragments of countless worlds. Every hero carries the memories and purpose of a shattered realm. Your choices will decide the ultimate direction of this battle royale—this trial of survival.

⚔️ Hero Chronicles
In the eternal arena of the rift, each chosen Tiny Hero bears a unique destiny and power. They come from broken worlds, carrying their own obsessions and missions, writing their legends upon this chaotic land.

🥊 I. The Path of Fists – Awakened Martial Artists

- 🥚 Small Egg

Description:
💚 Max HP +5
🧺 Harvest +5
🏃 Move Speed +5%

Combat Style: A survival-focused hero, skilled at agile positioning and dodging attacks while using Harvest to gain more resources.

- 👊 Boxer

Description:
🥋 Kung Fu weapon damage +15
🌀 Dodge +15%
⚠️ Critical Hit Rate -10%
⚠️ Critical Damage -50%
⚠️ Ranged Damage -10
🎁 Initially carry an Arm Fist

Combat Style: A pure melee burst-damage hero focused on fist techniques. Sacrifices ranged combat and critical potential for high evasion and devastating fist attacks. Perfect for players who enjoy close-quarters combat and the thrill of face-t

games.name: WIRED TOKYO 2007
games.shortDescription: — Dive into Tokyo. Dive into the past. — WIRED TOKYO is a vertical 3D action game where you climb toward the vast skies above Tokyo. To unlock new abilities, you may have to deliberately “dive” from above. A climbing game where falling has meaning — that’s WIRED TOKYO.
games.aboutText:
Climbing isn’t the only way forward.

Dive into Tokyo .
Dive into the past.

WIRED TOKYO is a 3D vertical action game set high above a massive, surreal Tokyo skyline.

■ Core Experience

Unlock new costumes to gain new abilities.

Even within the same stage, different actions create different routes.
Each player finds their own way to climb.

An example of a traversal combo

Progress isn’t just about going up.

By intentionally diving from higher points,
you may reach places that were previously out of reach.

To move toward the future,
sometimes you must return at the past.

Falling is not failure —
it’s the beginning of a new strategy.

WIRED TOKYO is a 3D vertical action game
where going back has meaning .

■ Game Structure

- A single vast 3D stage with height, like Only Up !

- Real-time costume changes that alter your abilities

- All costumes are optional — the game can be cleared from the initial state

- ・Strategy that unlocks actions by searching in the opposite direction by falling

・Charge the dive gauge by falling and shortcut with unique traversal combos

- A time-themed story set in Tokyo, 2007

■ Story

Akihabara, 2007.

A girl working at a maid café notices a strange structure floating in the sky.

Driven by curiosity, she begins climbing toward the unknown above Tokyo.

What if looking back at the past

could change the future?

■ Estimated Playtime

Normal Ending: 6–8 hours
True Ending: 8–12 hours

■ Streaming & Video Policy

- Both individuals and companies may stream the game without prior permission.

- Monetization is allowed only through the official monetization features provided by the streaming platform.

- We would appreciate it if you include the game title in your video title and link the Steam page in the description.

【Notice】

This work is based on a strict climbing and athletic game where you can enjoy the tension of each step and route construction, with its own unique interpretation of the gameplay of 3D precision platformers such as 'OnlyUp'.

If you are expecting the following elements, there is a very high possibility that you will not be satisfied, so please refrain from purchasing:

- "High-speed parkour action" that allows you to move quickly with a single button

- Speedrun games that focus solely on exhilaration

- Playing for specific graphics (such as NSFW content) rather than the gameplay itself

We welcome the challenge of players who love meticulous controls and the sense of accomplishment from "conquering" stages on their own.

games.name: Touhou: Blossom Blade
games.shortDescription: Konpaku Youmu sets out to prove herself to Saigyouji Yuyuko, mistress of Hakugyokurou. Make use of her three skills and challenge the veteran incident resolver and shrine maiden, Hakurei Reimu. An exhilarating 3D bullet hell action game set in Gensokyo, the world of Touhou Project!
games.aboutText:
A remaster of the origin point for the doujin circle Ankake Spa, creators of Touhou: Scarlet Curiosity and Touhou: New World has hit the scene! Konpaku Youmu stars in a stage-based 3D bullet hell action game with an emphasize on simple but satisfying controls.

Story

Konpaku Youmu works as the gardener, security, and swordsmanship instructor for Saigyouji Yuyuko, mistress of Hakugyokurou.

One day, upon Youmu scolding her mistress for slacking off in her training, Yuyuko told her "with your lack of skill, there won't be any training."

Yuyuko then challenged her to prove herself by defeating the shrine maiden who'd resolved Gensokyo's incidents time and time again:

She was to go and defeat Hakurei Reimu.

Youmu wasn't happy with this, but showing awareness of her inexperience, she accepted her mistress's conditions and set off for Gensokyo.

Will she be able to overcome the dangers awaiting her, defeat Reimu, and prove her skills to Yuyuko?

Gameplay

Use Three Skills to Clear Stages and Beat Bosses!

Youmu has three skills that each have their own strong points – movement, area damage, and range, as well as high-damage Spell Card. They'll come in handy when clearing stages if used well!

For example, your dash skill can help extend your jump range as well as do damage, and your ranged skill can defeat troublesome foes waiting on the other side of gaps.

Farm Combos to Turn the Tides

Continuing to hit enemies will raise your combo counter, granting bonuses to your score and skill recharge rate.

The latter bonus lets you use your skills much more often, making battles much easier.

Difficulty Options

Play on Easy, Hard, or Normal; whichever suits your skill level.

Music

Touhou: Blossom Blade features Touhou arranges from Shoichiro Sakamoto, AKA Sound Sepher, to make stages feel even more alive.

What's New to the Steam Version?

Each Skill Has its Own Button!

Previously, you toggle between between Youmu's three skills as you fought, but the skill controls have been updated to be more intuitive.

Other Changes

- Steam Achievements

- Balance changes

- More breakable objects

- HUD additions

- No more fall penalty

- Graphics optimized for modern hardware

─────────────────────

This game is a Touhou Project fangame.

games.name: Bird Game 3
games.shortDescription: Bird Game 3 is a multiplayer peck and slash game where you and your flock fight other players and the most eliminations wins. Choose from a diverse roster of birds, each with unique abilities and playstyles.
games.aboutText:
Maps

Bird Game 3 features 4 handcrafted maps, each set in a totally unique biome. No two matches feel the same thanks to dynamic weather that shifts and evolves throughout the fight.

Birds

Choose from 9 playable birds, each packing two unique abilities and their own set of stats. Whether you want to be a powerful eagle or an agile hummingbird, there's a bird built for your playstyle.

Skins

Your playtime means something. Level up each bird and unlock 6 exclusive skins along the way, each one a badge of how far you've come.

Multiplayer

Jump into lobbies of up to 15 players and unleash absolute chaos with your friends. The more birds, the better.

games.name: Chrono Wing: Cats in Space!
games.shortDescription: Chrono Wing: Cats in Space!" is a 90s-inspired SHMUP. Master five action-packed stages and use your time-rewinding abilities to dodge the game-over screen and build huge combos.
games.aboutText:
An alien invasion! The cat homeworld of Pantharis has fallen under alien attack, and you’re their last shot at survival. Take control of Aurora, a bobcat mercenary piloting a custom ship equipped with time-rewind tech. Lead her daring counter-offensive through five stages of frantic combat, shredding enemy swarms and squaring off against brutal bosses.

Features:

- 5 stages of hectic action taking place across the universe. Take the fight back to the alien's home planet!

- Rebindable controls, gamepad support, and arcade fightstick compatible.

- Unique time-rewind game mechanic.

- Online leaderboards and steam achievements.

games.name: 时空传说2黑暗之路
games.shortDescription: This is an RPG game set against the backdrop of swords and magic, paying tribute to the gameplay of the Golden Sun, DQ series, and Heavy Armor series. The storyline continues from generation to generation, In the depths of the quicksand lies another kingdom, a ghost wandering in the depths of the Sea of Death, hatred towards the Blood...
games.aboutText:
Game communication QQ group: Group: 809430943 Group: 1049101110

What kind of work is this?

This is a Western fantasy themed RPG game that pays tribute to the Golden Sun in terms of gameplay. It features some ancient gameplay from the heavy equipment series, as well as various mazes and free exploration games! The sequel to Time and Space Legends

Operation method?

WSAD Mobile: Supports left mouse button in eight directions/Z/Enter/Space: Confirm/Dialogue/Survey

Right mouse button/X/ESC: Exit

Tab: Open the mini map (use directional keys to move)

QE battle amplification

Introduction to combat mechanism

The game uses traditional turn based combat, utilizing magic and swordsmanship, and draws inspiration from the eight party battle amplification gameplay, with elements such as light, dark, fire, water, earth, wind, and thunder set!

Added a battle system for Pok é mon, with free skill combinations for Pok é mon Independent equipment, forging system, etc

Overview of the story

From the birth of the universe to its destruction is an era! After countless epochs, the universe ........

The world is born from seven sources! Since the birth of the world, wars have also emerged!

The world's conflicts have lasted for thousands of years, and no one remembers when they started!

The Night Moon Mercenary Group has become an undeniable force, but can that legacy really be completed? In the depths of the quicksand lies another kingdom, a ghost wandering in the depths of the Sea of Death, hatred towards the Blood Wolf, a turbulent world, a divided dragon race, and many secrets of the continent. That heart is devouring everything you have worked hard for

Now, the cycle of time is turning again ...........

games.name: Fish Lab
games.shortDescription: A short incremental game where you collect fish for your lab. Synced to music.
games.aboutText:
A short incremental game where you collect fish for your lab. Synced to music.

100,000 fish on screen

Hover your cursor over fish to collect on the beat. Use a variety of tools to collect as many fish as you can.

The lab gets huge

Every fish you collect earns you money. As you play the lab automatically grows.

Choose how to power your tools

Decide which tools get extra power.

Upgrade your lab and equipment

Write grants to unlock big equipment upgrades on top of the 200+ upgrades in the tech tree.

Extra Game Modes

- Sandbox

- Endless

- Zen - installable as a real Windows screensaver

games.name: Detective INNA DUKE
games.shortDescription: Detective Inna Duke is a noir story-driven visual novel where you team up with lieutenant Inna Duke and her partner corporal Fernal to investigate the mysterious abduction of the popular streamer Oleh Hamston. But will you manage to track down the poor hamster in rainy city?
games.aboutText:
Detective Inna Duke

A small, fluffy streamer, Oleh Hamston, is suddenly kidnapped from his apartment right in the middle of a livestream. The case is taken on by an ambitious and fearless detective, Inna Duke. What secrets lie behind this crime? Will you be able to uncover the real culprit and save the poor hamster’s life? Help a brave turkey detective uncover the truth in the visual novel “Detective Inna Duke”.

What awaits you:

🔍 Immersive police investigation

Dive into the intricacies of fieldwork and surveillance. Learn how to follow leads and conduct searches. Not a single detail will escape Inna Duke!

🔍 Intriguing and unexpected plot twists

Uncover the mysterious past of the main characters and expose the dark secrets of a city drowning in corruption and impunity.

🔍 Humor

Meet quirky and colorful characters, pick up a few jokes, and spot plenty of clever references along the way.

🔍 Solving a variety of puzzles

You’ll work with an evidence board, pick locks, search for clues, and find your way through abandoned tunnels, as well as take on tasks in a café and more.

🔍 Choices that shape your path

Your decisions determine how the story ends. Will you manage to stay undercover without raising suspicion? What matters more: preserving your reputation or delivering justice? Who is truly guilty, and who has been wrongly accused?

games.name: Gardenhood
games.shortDescription: A cozy multiplayer gardening game where up to 8 players share one island. Grow rare mutated crops, fish the pond, build and decorate your home, and hang out with neighbors in drop-in public lobbies — or tend your garden solo. Plant something weird. Show it off.
games.aboutText:
Gardenhood is a cozy multiplayer gardening game where up to 8 players share one island. Claim a plot, grow something worth showing off, and wave to the neighbors — or play solo and keep the whole island to yourself.

ONE ISLAND, EIGHT GARDENERS Hop into a public lobby or invite your friends. You'll each tend your own plot side by side — watch the neighbors' gardens fill in while yours does, chat over the fence, show off your rarest harvest, and fish together while the crops come in. Prefer the quiet life? Everything in Gardenhood works solo too.

Gardening

FROM CARROT SEEDS TO CURIOSITIES Till the soil, plant your first humble seeds, and water them to hurry things along. Every harvest you sell unlocks rarer, stranger, more valuable seeds — and the cycle begins again. The question isn't whether your garden grows. It's what it grows into.

CHASE RARE MUTATIONS Sometimes a crop comes up... different. Mutated plants are rarer, worth more, and the pride of any plot. Sell them for a windfall — or keep them on display for the neighborhood to envy.

Fishing

GONE FISHING (WHILE THE CROPS COME IN) Seeds take time. Grab a rod, head to the pond, and fill the quiet moments between harvests — fishing pads your coin purse and makes a fine excuse to stand around chatting.

Building

BUILD A HOME WORTH VISITING Put your earnings into a house of your own, craft at your workbench, and decorate with cute furniture. On a shared island, your home isn't just where you live — it's part of the view.

Features

- Drop-in public lobbies for up to 8 players, or private islands with friends

- Fully playable solo — every system works offline-style, at your pace

- If the host leaves, the party keeps going

- Helpers who water and tend your plot while you're off fishing

- Character customization, quests, and a dynamic weather system

- More crops, mutations, and furniture on the way

Wishlist Gardenhood to catch the launch, try the free demo today, and join our Discord to help decide what grows next.

games.name: Corpus et Spiritus
games.shortDescription: Corpus et Spiritus is an alchemy deckbuilder, where you must break free of a demonic pact... before your partner kills you. Gather rare metals, then use your workshop to transform them into powerful cards and magical talismans, forming combos that will save your body, spirit and soul!
games.aboutText:
Corpus et Spiritus is a roguelite deckbuilder where your alchemical skill will decide your fate. You signed a pact with a Homunculus: a demon that will guide you on the path of alchemy, but at the cost of your life force. Use your workshop to craft new cards, transmute metals and discover magical talismans. Become smarter than your dangerous partner and break out of the pact before it kills you!

Unravel the secrets of alchemy

- Satisfy the Homunculus — Trade your life for great boons. Or don't, but beware the wrath of the Homunculus.

- Controlled randomness — Use your workshop to create cards and magical talismans. The metals you insert impact its output and what choices you have.

- Experiment — Seek new recipes, cards and talismans. Unravel the deepest secrets of the art of alchemy or die trying.

- The pact — At the start of a run, customize your pact by selecting boons and challenges that will help or hinder you. Get closer to breaking the pact and gain tokens that will unlock new alchemy stations and secret cards.

Master your deck-building skills

- Build the perfect deck — Choose cards from 7 different families of body, mind and soul, each with their own gameplay style.

- Assemble powerful combos — Cards and talismans combine to create increasingly stronger effects.

- Manage your resources — Metals aren't your only resource; keep your health, wits and stamina in balance against the demons attempt to consume them. Wise management leads to even greater knowledge.

games.name: SIFU Kidnapped! Adventure in the Women's Kingdom
games.shortDescription: Modern worker reborn as Golden Cicada in the all-female Land of Women. Unravel the Mother-Son River’s secrets, battle Demon King Mara, and bond with seven goddesses. Your choices shape many endings—balance enlightenment and love to rewrite the Three Realms.
games.aboutText:
A modern corporate slave wakes up to find himself reincarnated as the 100th incarnation of Golden Cicada! Stumbling into the all-female Western Liang Kingdom, he must unravel the earth-shaking conspiracy behind the polluted Mother-Son River while navigating deep emotional bonds with 7 goddess-level characters of distinct personalities—from the powerful and glamorous queen to the vengeance-driven Scorpion Demon, the innocent and impulsive monkey apprentice, the arrogant and willful Dragon Princess, the loyal and calm Sand Guardian, the fox demon who wields dream-invasion magic, and the cold yet compassionate Immortal.

This is the ultimate choice between Buddhist compassion and mortal desire! Assume the role of the protagonist Chen Yi in first-person perspective, making crucial decisions in demon-subduing puzzles and sweet interactions. Every conversation shapes favorability, and every choice alters the fate of the Three Realms. Will you honor the bet between Tathagata Buddha and the Demon King, sever earthly ties, and attain Buddhahood? Or follow your heart and spend a lifetime with your beloved?

Many distinct endings await—from achieving Buddhahood in the West to staying in the Women's Kingdom, from becoming a dragon palace son-in-law to wandering the world. Every step writes your unique time-travel adventure!

Key Character Introductions

- Mingkong : The powerful and glamorous queen of the Western Liang Kingdom. Devoted to her people's safety, she develops a special affection for the unexpectedly arrived Chen Yi.

- Sha Yue'er : Chen Yi's third apprentice. A calm and restrained bodyguard of the Western Liang Kingdom, she possesses agile skills and unwaveringly upholds her duty to protect her master.

- Su Qinglian : A foreign fox demon skilled in dream-invasion techniques. With enchanting beauty, she harbors an almost obsessive devotion to Chen Yi

- Sun Xiaoyao : Chen Yi's eldest apprentice. A naive and lively monster ruler from Flower and Fruit Mountain, she wields the Golden Cudgel with immense strength and is fiercely loyal and protective of her master.

- Ao Bing : Chen Yi's second apprentice. An arrogant and willful Dragon Princess of the West Sea, she exudes nobility and keeps others at arm's length due to past obsessions.

- Liu Niang : Known as the Purple Gold Queen, a Scorpion Demon with stunning beauty and a eccentric temperament. Driven by a vengeance obsession, she acts with ruthless determination.

- Immortal Lianxin : A cold yet compassionate cultivator, Ao Bing's master. Wielding a protective magic artifact, she is the key tester of Chen Yi's emotional tribulations.

Core Features

- 7 Unique Heroines & Immersive Bond Cultivation : Covering diverse settings such as queens, demons, immortals, and dragon princesses, each character has exclusive storylines and heartfelt interactions to satisfy different preferences.

- Highly Free Choices & Dual Narrative Branches : The Buddhist Path focuses on subduing demons and fulfilling destiny, while the Mortal Path delves into emotional bonds and unlocks exclusive endings—no forced plot direction.

- Fantasy Worldview + Puzzle Elements : Blending legends of the Women's Kingdom, the Buddha-Demon bet, and the Mother-Son River crisis, the game interweaves brain-teasing puzzles with romantic interactions for richer gameplay.

Game Highlights

- First-person perspective for enhanced immersion, featuring dialogue choices and specific free branches.

- A balanced mix of humor, sweetness, passion, and suspense, with a well-paced narrative.

- Richly crafted characters: Each heroine has exclusive backstories and personality highlights, avoiding "tool character" tropes.

games.name: Fishy Dish
games.shortDescription: Create and sell sushi in this roguelike inventory-management sushi-builder game. Collect fish, sauces, and tools, arrange them on a grid to trigger synergies, survive each round’s sales target, and build the ultimate sushi lineup.
games.aboutText:
Fishy Dish

A roguelike sushi-builder game where you combine rice, fish, sauces, and kitchen tools to create delicious dishes and sell them on a conveyor-belt sushi line.

Collect!

- Over +30 types of fish and rare ingredients. (There are even mermaids!)

- A wide range of sauces, recipes, and kitchen tools

- Each combination opens up new strategies and playstyles

Arrange!

- Place ingredients on the grid to activate powerful synergies and combos.

Survive!

- Meet the target sales to keep your sushi business running

- Purchase new ingredients and upgrades after every round

Build Your Ultimate Sushi

Fishy Dish is not just a cooking game— build your unique sushi that sells the most!

games.name: Pluffy Nightmare
games.shortDescription: Blast through a surreal nightmare in this fast-paced roguelike FPS with funny weapons! In Pluffy Nightmare, your mind is dragged into a doll´s body to battle possessed plushies, dolls, and toys in bizarre fantasy worlds.
games.aboutText:
A mischievous little devil has trapped you under its spell. In Pluffy Nightmare, you are Lilo, a soul trapped in a rag doll, fighting to reclaim your body. Traverse a surreal nightmare in this fast-paced roguelike FPS with hilarious weapons!

Blast your way through hundreds of enemies. Battle menacing plushies, dolls, or possessed toys. Run, dodge, and fire absurd weapons in this roguelike shooter where every match is a new chance to escape the dream.

- A fast-paced, first-person shooter, roguelike that keeps every match fresh and unpredictable.

- Surreal and fantastical environments, from dioramas and yarn worlds to spooky dreamscapes.

- Shoot paper airplanes, balloons, or springs that bounce off enemies—you can even use a rubber ducky as a voodoo doll.

- Simple yet skillful gameplay: shoot, run, dodge, and collect. One life per playthrough, but each attempt unlocks new surprises.

- Short, intense playthroughs (30-45 minutes). Perfect for quick sessions or deep dives.

- Hundreds of items with wild effects.

- Defeat bosses and unlock characters, weapons, and worlds.

Can you reclaim your body and survive the nightmare?

games.name: Mute
games.shortDescription: "Mutes" is a live-action mystery game. From a third-person perspective, you will make critical choices, engage in deductive reasoning to communicate for the protagonist, and perform quick-time reactions to survive a murder mystery.
games.aboutText:
"Mute" is a live-action mystery game. Its distinctive black-and-white visuals justify the "Colorless" title, while the "Silent" concept is revealed through gameplay. From a third-person perspective, you will make critical choices, engage in deductive reasoning to communicate for the protagonist, and perform quick-time reactions to survive a murder mystery.

Deduction ​

Players need to examine and search for various clues to uncover the truth of the entire event.

Choices ​

At key decision points, players must make choices that determine the direction of the story.

Judgment ​

During certain stages, players must decide how to respond to progress the plot.

Gestures ​

Throughout the game, players must learn sign language to solve puzzles at critical moments.

games.name: Gum Squad
games.shortDescription: Gum Squad is a co-op PvE shooter set in a quiet world gone sticky. Start with a peashooter, explore together, and gear up to survive the gum epidemic with up to 8 players!
games.aboutText:
Play Co-op PvE with up to 8 friends!!

The world is quiet… a little dusty… and very, very sticky. Gum Squad drops you into wide open fields and sleepy deserts where gum became the world’s favorite resource, and maybe its biggest mistake. With a humble peashooter and a few friends by your side, you’ll wander curious places, uncover what went wrong, and slowly build yourself up from whatever you can scavenge.

There’s no rush but the danger is real. Enemies move with intent, take cover, and push back when they spot you, turning calm exploration into sudden, focused firefights. Between trips, tune your loadout, manage your inventory, and customize your character before heading out again.

A quiet world, a sticky problem, and just enough trouble to keep things interesting.

Created by a human

Made by one silly gal named Fern, with the love and support of the whole FreshWaterFern community. This game was put together in 90 days as a silly experiment.

Key Features

- Online PvE - Start a world and jump right into the action with up to 8 friends !

- Character Customization - Make changes to your outfit with a large range of options or dress up with loot that you find on your adventure!

- Character Progression - Gain XP as you defeat enemies and level up various skills to build yourself into the gum demon of your dreams.

- Exciting Gun Fights - Go against NPCs that take cover, peek out to shoot at you, and fall back when they need to reload.

- Massive Game World - Explore a gummed-up world full of enemies, loot, and skateboards??

- In-depth Inventory Systems - Manage your carrying weight, organize your bag before going on trips.

games.name: 主角
games.shortDescription: Campus mystery hides conditioning. All act with scripts. Smiles, tears, hugs are props and hints. Surveillance and rules bind. Stay true, break free. Protagonist: an anti-conditioning game of disguise and self-redemption. The system writes, your principles decide. Newcomer, the show begins.
games.aboutText:
【Foreword】

All the world's a stage, yet homeward lies the heart.

This story is purely fictional. Any resemblance to reality—

may not be coincidence, but rather a reflection of choices we’ve all faced at similar crossroads in our lives.

Protagonist is an interactive game about anti-conditioning, portraying a theatrical journey of pretense and self-redemption. The script is written by the system, but the ending is determined by your own principles.

Campus performance mixed with light suspense forms the core of this story. It focuses on real-world growth, breaking away from conventional romance-driven storytelling.

It is, above all, a documentary poem dedicated to every young person struggling between ideals and reality.

The game revolves entirely around performance. It is about acting—but not only about acting.
