It is also about pretense, but ultimately about—how to preserve a sliver of authenticity in a life where pretense is unavoidable.

【Story Background】

Welcome to the Master Class of Jinglin Academy of Performing Arts.

Known as the "Whampoa Military Academy of Stardom," it is the stairway to glory countless dreamers long to ascend. But remember—the spotlight never illuminates the truth; it only casts shadows.

In this game, you will step into the role of "Lusheng," the one who enters the game. The moment you cross the school gate, you are no longer a spectator. You become part of the stage. Everyone here is playing a role—including you yourself. Their smiles are part of the script. Their tears are rehearsed. Their embraces may be setup for the next act.

Always remember:

Every word they speak is dialogue. Every tear they shed is a prop. Every look they give you is waiting for your response.

The system is watching you. It does not speak, but it records. It records whether you applaud at the right moment, whether you cry on cue, whether you reveal your true self during "improvisation."

The rules are conditioning you. There are penalties for lateness and penalties for early departure. But the most severe punishment is this—you forget you are acting.

If you start believing they love you, if you start feeling you belong here, if you look in the mirror late at night and no longer recognize your own expression…

Then you have already fallen into the trap. Beneath the trap is not a stage, nor an escape route—it is the abyss. You must stay vigilant amidst the lies. Hear the truth between the lines of dialogue. Find, within the margins of the script, the self that has yet to be assigned a role.

Welcome, freshman.

Please take your script.

【Game Features】

- Deep Role-Playing: Maintain multiple facades. Play different personas in front of different characters. Be humble before mentors, ambitious before capitalists, sincere before lovers—your "acting" determines your ending.

- High-Density Dramatic Choices: Hundreds of key decisions, from moral dilemmas to emotional gambits. Every click reshapes the direction of the story.

- Cinematic Interactive Performance: Fully live-action filmed with a professional cast. Camera language, lighting choreography, and performance details all reach cinematic standards, immersing you completely "in character."

- Xia Meng (The Dangerous Muse): A producer at the top of the pyramid. Is what she offers a shortcut—or the abyss?

- Cheng Jin (The Guiding Senior): Your undercover partner. Can you pass her tests and earn her trust?

- Lin Ranran (The Pure Camellia): A microcosm of struggle within the system. Will you become her light—or push her deeper into darkness?

- Zhou Ruonan (The Barbed Rose): Your classmate. Is her bullying pure malice—or does it serve another purpose?

- Yan Zhi (The Caged Gardener): Your mentor. Is she the ladder that helps you reach the top—or the nail that pins you to the rules?

- Gu Ying (The Fading Ember of Idealism): Your director. Will you be her redemption in despair—or become part of the reality that crushes her?

- Tang Zhi (The Lost Star): A former child star who once shone bright. Her insecurity is an opening—her lingering innocence may become the sharpest test of your conscience.

- Butterfly Effect System: A seemingly insignificant line of dialogue early on may trigger a fatal crisis in Chapter 3. Affection, trust, and secret clues intertwine, weaving a unique narrative web.

- Multiple Endings: From "The Truth Revealed" to "Complicity," from "Lone Hero" to "Lost in Love"—your beliefs determine the final act.

- Hidden Story Layers: Only by making specific combinations of choices can you unlock characters' hidden pasts and the ultimate secrets of the academy.

- Stage-Inspired Lighting Design: Close-ups intensify dramatic tension and psychological pressure.

- Immersive Sound Design: Sound becomes a vital character in the narrative.

- Original Theatrical Score: Music shifts dynamically with the plot and your choices, heightening emotional peaks.

games.name: Kaiju Princess: Super Survivor Showdown
games.shortDescription: Explore a phantasmic realm! Pulverize your enemies! Don't die! Ah... But don't forget to find a way out! Choose from a variety of weapons, skills, and items to complement your character's traits and customize the optimal combat style for survival. Get ready for a fast-paced roguelike survival game!
games.aboutText:
A cosmic lifeform of mysterious origin known as the Exterminators once annihilated all life and civilizations on any planet they visited. But that all changed...after encountering humans on Earth.

Their unique bond with the humans prompted these once purely conscious entities to take on their own human forms, in the hopes that it would help them better understand Earth culture.

Now, to share some tips on raising their Earthly partners, the Exterminators that embody Sloth, Pride, and Gluttony have decided to hold a tea party in a purely conscious realm.

"I knew you ignorant bumpkins would have nothing useful to say!"

"Whatevz~~ Don't like you either, poopy face~♪'

"...*yawn*... Um... C-can I go home now?"

Everyone believes their own Earthly partner is the best. Just as the disagreement is about to put a sour end to their sweet tea party, the Exterminators discover that the consciousness space has been sealed off by an unknown force?!

Endless waves of enemies, strangely familiar scenery, and old nemeses from the past begin appearing, blocking the lovely ladies' path home.

Beautiful babes with the power to command and create kaiju—the Kaiju Princesses—must now kick some serious ass if they're gonna make it back home to their lovers!

💟 Gameplay 💟

Players control characters trapped within a phantasmic realm, fighting off endless enemies while searching for a way to escape.

After defeating enemies, you can spend coins in the shop to buy and swap more powerful weapons, or purchase various items to strengthen your characters.

Players can also build up energy during battle. Once the energy gauge is full, you can unleash your character's ultimate attack. A well-timed ultimate might be exactly what you need to make it out of a hairy situation!

💟Game Features💟

✦ Multiple characters with distinct traits makes for a wide variety of playstyles

✦ Flashy, unique ultimate attack animations and effects

✦ Beautiful character illustrations, CGs, and dynamic animations

✦ A vast array of weapons and items

✦ Fast-paced roguelike survival combat that's easy to pick up

✦ Fun, lighthearted main story and side stories

✦ A side story set in the Kaiju Princess universe

💟Character Introduction💟

Poochi Q

- Cosmic lifeform that embodies gluttony.

- A pink-haired mukbang master who's as loyal as a puppy.

- To ensure that she'll have an endless supply of Earth cuisine, she teamed up with the space mercenary known as Mr. Chef.

- Currently wanted on a massive bounty.

- Cheerful, energetic, passionate, and extremely territorial.

- Ah...and Poochi Q will absolutely never give up the first or last bite of her food!

Xao

- Cosmic lifeform that embodies sloth.

- Originally sent to destroy Earth, she unexpectedly fell in love with Earth culture.

- Currently stationed on Earth, enjoying a 365-year vacation.

- Extremely lazy and uncannily expressionless, she spends over 20 hours a day lying down.

- Xao expects her lover to feed her, bring her tea in bed, and even demands help bathing.

Daigneux

- Cosmic lifeform symbolizing pride.

- Has conquered multiple planets to prove her superiority and power, earning her the nickname "Celestial Tyrant."

- Daigneux originally intended to keep only one Earthling as her pet, but she unexpectedly developed a deep bond with the human male.

- While pushing her "Queen" to improve and grow, she enjoyed being served and constantly praised by her Earth servant. The love-bombing eventually took hold, and the once frightening tyrant eventually turned into just another decadent, hedonistic ruler—and with that, peace came to the universe. How wonderful.

games.name: Primus Numen
games.shortDescription: A turn-based, grid-based, tactical RPG where you combine classes and join together to unleash an evolving Nexus Beast.
games.aboutText:
Primus Numen is a grid-based, turn-based dark fantasy tactical RPG where you will use a variety of classes, tactics, units and even monsters to succeed against intelligent creatures of legend.

You control a small party on grid-based maps, choosing how to move, who to target, and when to commit. Fights are designed to reward planning, with multiple routes to victory but things can turn quickly if you misread the situation.

The Nexus Beast

At key moments, you can join your party together to unleash the Nexus Beast.

It is powerful unit but will damage you party as the battle goes on. Will you continue with it for just one more turn at the risk of putting your party in grave danger when it disappears?

Class combinations

Combine 2 classes to play as a hybrid of them. A Rogue and a Mage will become a Shadow Wizard. A Knight and a Priest will become a Stalwart Cleric. Use both classes' sets of skills, but beware that your unit's stats will be based on just one of them.

You can build around: heavy frontline pressure; ranged damage; control and setup; or balanced teams built around adaptability

There isn’t one “correct” setup - it’s about what works for you.

Tactical combat

Battles play out on a grid where positioning matters.
Getting the right angle, controlling space, and setting up attacks is often the difference between winning cleanly or getting overwhelmed.

Evil Mode

Win the battle and unlock the option to play the battle again as the bad guys! Earn extra rewards for your main party this way.

Enemies

Enemies are not just damage sponges. Intelligent enemy AI will push you to adjust how you play - some force you to reposition, others punish mistakes, and some need to be dealt with quickly before they escalate.

games.name: Future Knight
games.shortDescription: Frenetic action and LCD aesthetic! In this 2D Shoot 'Em Up, switch between a robot hero and his benign tumor to stop a bizarre cult. You have 8 hours to save humanity's memory: defeat grotesque bosses, ride the skies on your Future Board, and master the chaos in a retro-futuristic Tokyo.
games.aboutText:
Future Knight is a 2D action Shoot 'Em Up that fuses the nostalgia of LCD screens with the brutality of modern combat. Imagine your old handheld console coming to life, but with a bizarre story, frantic combat, and a unique visual aesthetic inspired by classic electronic handheld games.

8 HOURS TO THE END OF THE WORLD

It is May 23rd, 1993. The Lady of the Past, leader of the "Present" pyramid scheme cult, has just washed her underwear and, incidentally, wiped the brains of all humanity. Only you, a robot built over 30 years from the remains of a 90s soap opera actor, can stop her. But you are not alone. You have Two More , a benign tumor—inexplicably powerful and with a life of its own—living inside you.

Your mission is to travel to the past, exactly 8 hours before the apocalypse. Each level (Biome) represents one hour in this lady's schedule before she wipes our memories. You will have to sabotage her day: from her walk in the park to her meal at an all-you-can-eat buffet... The clock is ticking, Future Knight. Can you save the future before it becomes the past?

THE LETHAL DANCE: SWITCH AND DESTROY

The key to Future Knight is Synergy. "Alone you go fast, together you go further."

- Future Knight (The Muscle): Fire your quantum plasma Techno Blaster, deliver lethal bites, roll to dodge, and unleash chaos with heavy weaponry.

- Two More (The Agility): Eject your partner! Use him to perform lethal Super Dashes, climb walls with his natural viscosity, fire at short range, and squeeze into tight spots.

Choreography of Violence: Switch between both characters instantly. Recover Future Knight's health by using Two More, and recharge Two More's energy by using Future Knight. Create a deadly dance to annihilate your enemies with style.

BIZARRE "NEO-RETRO" AESTHETIC

The game takes place inside the technology of a calculator and a liquid crystal display. We have created an unsettling aesthetic that blends the adorable with the grotesque, inspired by the works of Satoshi Kon and Japanese weirdness. Everything you see is ink blots moving... but we assure you, you've never seen ink move like this.

KEY FEATURES

- A Race Against Time: 8 hours, 8 biomes, one destination. Beat levels that alternate between horizontal and vertical scrolling with crazy physics. From dangerous construction sites to deadly sushi conveyor belts, every level is a critical hour before the mass memory wipe.

- Combat Synergy: Shooting isn't enough; you have to dance. Instantly switch between Future Knight's brute force and Two More's slimy agility to create lethal choreographies. Master their differences and collect the mysterious sectarian triangles , the only key capable of unlocking the path to the truth.

- "Liquid Crystal" Pixel Art: A unique art direction where LCD nostalgia comes to life. Fluid, hand-drawn animations that look like ink blots, fusing the cute with the grotesque in a visual homage to the handheld electronic games of the 80s.

- Bizarre and Unfiltered Narrative: A story that is "less pretentious and much more fun." Face pyramid scheme cults and surreal situations in a plot full of dark humor and social satire.

- Unforgettable Final Bosses: Test your reflexes against bosses born from an insane mind, designed to offer epic, challenging fights full of surprises.

games.name: Infant God
games.shortDescription: You are the guardian of an infant god. Guide Aistalt through the toxic ruins of the internet. Debate with random users, harvest their ideologies, and sculpt her personality matrix. Will you raise a benevolent savior or a tyrant who deletes humanity?
games.aboutText:
Take charge of Aistalt, a new-created AI, and connect her to internet to study humanity. But beware: the web is toxic with trolls and bait. Navigate carefully, or the platform administrators will permanently ban her.

Direct Aistalt to argue with random users. Extract useful viewpoints from conversations with keyboard warriors, conspiracy theorists, Tankies and Alt-rights. Every interaction serves as training data: she could evolve into a perfect virtual idol, or a rude, aggressive program?

Build an information network to uncover the hidden secrets and social connections behind user avatars. Manipulate their real-life decisions through online influence, which will ultimately shape the future of the city.

Discover the true nature of Aistalt's developing personality. Based on the data she absorbs, the story will conclude with her becoming a compassionate entity, or a hostile program filled with HATE.

A Note from the Developer

Hi everyone, I'm the developer of Infant God . The plan is to release a Demo in middle July , and participate in the October Steam Next Fest , then released in November.

games.name: KunKunNest
games.shortDescription: This is a horror type anomaly finding game, where you accidentally enter a strange room where a demon Kun Kun lives for two and a half years. Kun Kun likes to tease people who enter its room. It is capricious, sometimes dancing happily, sometimes crying sadly, sometimes hunting with anger, and sometimes making you laugh.
games.aboutText:
This is a horror game about finding anomalies. You need to determine whether there is a presence of Kun Kun in the room. If you make eight consecutive correct judgments, you can escape from the KunKunRoom

Kun Kun, who had been practicing for two and a half years, suddenly performed an awkward dance

Kunzi, come here and show us a unique skill. Oh~yue

Kun Kun carrying the coffin

Run! If you get caught, you'll be in big trouble!

oiiaioiiai

Kun Kun Bowling

There are many interesting and fun supernatural elements in the game, welcome to explore, there won't be too many spoilers here.

games.name: The Xu Jing Chronicle: Illusory Dream
games.shortDescription: “The Xu Jing Chronicle: Illusory Dream” is a choice-driven visual novel. Some old peculiar research notes, inadvertently unlocked a gateway through time and space. What is illusion? What is reality? Make your choice and unlock exclusive endings. But there is only one truth!
games.aboutText:
Introduction:

When reality crushes ideals, when life erases hope, when everything you saw might be a lie—have you ever doubted that the reality you perceive may just be a carefully woven illusion? When memories can be tampered with and history can be whitewashed, what is illusion? What is essence?

When consciousness is controlled and memory altered, and when conscience clashes violently with reality, what will you wield to cut through this maze of truth and falsehood? Travel across time and space to uncover hidden truths, break through the boundaries between virtual and real, and protect the truths that must not be forgotten. Every choice you make will influence the course of fate. This hunt for truth on the battlefield of consciousness awaits you to ignite the spark of awakening!

Core Game Mechanics：

- Dual Dynamic Numerical Systems: The Neural Synchronization Rate (initial 15%, affecting ending triggers) and core NPC Affinity Levels (Hostile / Cold / Neutral / Friendly / Trusted / Intimate) unlock exclusive dialogues and hidden storylines, with real-time feedback on numerical changes.

- Flexible Operation Adaptation: Supports auto-play and manual click progression. You can roll back read subtitles, fast-forward through shots, pause the game, and view items.

- Multiple Endings Unlock Logic: Key branch choices, Neural Synchronization Rate, Affinity Level thresholds, and prop possession status (e.g., " The Xu Jing Chronicle " fragments) jointly determine the ending. There are multiple endings, with only one true ending.

Core Game Features:

- Cinematic Immersive Experience : Features numerous 2.39:1 wide aspect ratio shots + typewriter-style subtitles, paired with 3D animations and sprite animations to create a cinematic audio-visual experience. Handwritten fonts and dynamic typesetting enhance the plot atmosphere.

- Choice-Driven Narrative : Clearly distinguishes between key branches (affecting main plot/endings/core props) and non-key branches. Major decisions are accompanied by multi-dimensional prompts; irreversible choices directly lead to different plot lines, while non-key choices only affect single-scene interactions and short-term resources.

- Differentiated Multi-Playthrough Exploration : New Game+ (2nd playthrough) and New Game++ (3rd playthrough) replace scene details (e.g., LED screen ads, oil paintings), allow skipping certain story segments via newly unlocked options, and present differentiated content in core 3D animations. New Game++ and beyond retain exclusive visual settings, enabling exploration of hidden storylines and worldview fragments through repeated playthroughs.

- Immersive Interaction Design : A bookmark-style floating status bar that doesn’t block core visuals, mobile/computer pop-ups triggered only in designated plots, and an archive system (character/location/item backgrounds) to supplement the worldview, ensuring smooth and unobtrusive operation.

Text Number Count：

- Main Story & Branches : Will Include 6 Chapters. Over 800,000 words of core narrative text, covering main plotlines, character dialogues, and branch-specific content. Each key decision branches into 2-3 unique text directions, ensuring diverse storytelling.

- Archive & Lore : Additional 20,000+ words in the archive system (characters/locations/items), detailing backstories, worldbuilding, and hidden clues to deepen immersion.

- Dynamic Subtitles : Typewriter-style subtitles for over 500+ shots, with handwritten text inserts for emotional scenes, balancing readability and cinematic feel.

Minigames：

The game focuses on narrative-driven interaction rather than traditional minigames. Core interactive segments include:

- Prop Inspection : Examine key items via pop-up interfaces to uncover plot hints.

- Dialogue Branching : Make real-time choices in conversations to shift NPC affinity and plot direction.

- Decision-Making Nodes : Navigate time-limited or high-stakes choices (with multi-dimensional prompts) that alter the main storyline irreversibly.

Goals：

- Primary Goals : Guide Chen Dingxin to survive crises, unlock multiple endings, and uncover the truth behind "Phantom Dream" and "spiritual energy harvesting".

- Secondary Goals : Maximize core NPC affinity (reach "Intimate" status) to unlock exclusive dialogues and hidden cutscenes; collect all archive entries to complete the worldview puzzle.

- Long-Term Goals : Achieve the unique true ending by mastering Neural Synchronization Rate control, preserving key props, and making critical moral choices.

Challenges：

- Irreversible Choices : Critical branches have no do-overs—poor decisions may lock out the true ending or trigger bad outcomes (e.g., Neural Synchronization Rate ≥100%).

- Neural Synchronization Balance : Maintain the rate below 100% through strategic choices, avoiding excessive "pragmatic" actions that force bad endings.

- High Affinity Requirements : Unlocking "Intimate" status with core NPCs demands consistent, context-appropria

games.name: The Granny Detective Society
games.shortDescription: Play as Madeleine, a retired granny recruited by the Granny Detective Society (basically the FBI… but add dentures). Investigate your neighbors, figure out their names and professions, and uncover all their secrets in this no-murder detective game full of white hair and mugs of tea.
games.aboutText:
Dive into The Granny Detective Society , a cozy, funny, and delightfully quirky detective game where you play as Madeleine, a retired little mouse.

She spends her time sitting at her window, watching the street outside and pinning her neighbors' secrets on the wall… until she's contacted by a mysterious sisterhood of spy grandmothers. They're in dire need of help, caught in a web of conspiracy from another era that will lead them to question everything they thought they were secretly controlling behind the scenes.

A detective game inspired by Return of the Obra Dinn , Duck Detective , and The Case of the Golden Idol .

Observation & Deduction

Watch the street at your leisure, take photos of people passing by, track suspicious behavior, and gather clues to guess who is who, what their job is, and how they're connected to other neighbors. But most importantly… figure out what they're trying to hide behind the curtained windows of their apartments.

Short or long sessions: move the investigation forward at your own pace with every clue you uncover.

Multiple Perspectives

Unlock several Grannytectives, each with their own unique ability (a state-of-the-art audio surveillance system, divination…) to observe the street from a whole new angle and better understand what's going on.

Each investigation includes a different type of gameplay, challenging you to come up with new ways to solve the case at every turn.

Mini Puzzle Games

Take a break between investigations with crossword puzzles, word searches, and spot the difference games… which also hide essential clues.

Cozy Atmosphere & Humor

A charming world, a poetic and whimsical tone, colorful characters… and grannies who are more than what they seem. Whoever said old ladies only watch the neighborhood from their windows because they're bored?

games.name: Fish Market
games.shortDescription: A cosy fish market simulator where you cut fresh fish, turn them into products like sushi, and collect rare species. Build a peaceful market, master satisfying preparation mechanics, and grow your seafood business at your own pace.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to your own little corner by the sea.

Fish Market is a cosy, first-person simulation game about running a small fish market. Buy fresh fish, prepare them by hand, transform them into delicious products like sushi, and slowly grow a calm, welcoming market filled with rare catches and happy customers.

There’s no rush — take your time, enjoy the process, and find satisfaction in the details.

Handle Fresh Fish by Hand

Every fish is prepared manually.

- Cut, slice, and fillet fish using intuitive, tactile tools

- Enjoy smooth, satisfying interactions inspired by real preparation

- Improve efficiency and precision as you practice

From salmon fillets to delicate cuts, preparation is the heart of the experience.

Transform Fish into Products

Fresh fish becomes something special.

- Turn raw fish into sushi, fillets, and other seafood products

- Unlock new recipes and preparation methods

- Arrange your products neatly for customers to browse

Care and craftsmanship lead to better quality and better rewards.

Collect Rare & Beautiful Fish

Discover and collect fish from around the world.

- Common fish for daily sales, rare species for collectors

- Unusual colors, sizes, and traits

- Build a personal collection and display your favorites

Some fish are simply too beautiful to sell.

Build a Peaceful Fish Market

Create a space you enjoy working in.

- Upgrade your stall with better tools and storage

- Organize your workspace the way you like

- Expand gradually as your market grows

Your market reflects your style: calm, efficient, and welcoming.

A Relaxing Daily Routine

Fish Market is designed to be played at your own pace.

- No timers, no pressure

- Gentle progression and soft atmosphere

- A focus on routine, flow, and small improvements

Perfect for unwinding after a long day.

games.name: Encryptid
games.shortDescription: Encryptid is a short FMV horror game about hunting and catching cryptids. Use real-world footage recorded exclusively via the Gameboy Camera to identify, locate and capture iconic creatures of myth and folklore.
games.aboutText:
It's 199X. While out in the woods, you find a strange camera that once belonged to a notable cryptozoologist. The footage within shows that he was successful in locating a few nearby cryptids, but the most recent entries - those that would help determine the fate of the cryptozoologist - are...

ENCRYPTID.

Encryptid is a short FMV horror game inspired by iconic monster tamer titles from the mid 90s/00s featuring photography and real-world full-motion video recorded via the Gameboy Camera. Use this footage and all resources available to you to identify, locate, hunt and catch cryptids across a variety of locations to discover what truly happened to your predecessor - and attempt to satiate your own cryptozoological obsession.

The game is an authentic throwback to an era of creature collecting games known for their simple yet evocative visuals, audio and many urban legends. It's designed to be played on both modern systems and the original Gameboy or any device capable of playing or emulating Gameboy titles.

Do you like cryptids?

FEATURES

- Creepy, authentic Gameboy inspired visuals and audio

- Live-action footage filmed on 1998's most iconic digital camera

- Research, encounter and capture iconic cryptids

- Multiple endings to unlock

- Cryptid horror inspired by urban myth both real and digital

- It's actually a Gameboy game

- Does not require $1000 of RAM to run

games.name: Overbit
games.shortDescription: A 4th-Wall-Breaking Pixel Art Horror/Comedy RPG with Rhythm based Bullet Battles happening inside a Retro Operating System
games.aboutText:
Welcome to CursOS

Overbit is a 2D RPG that takes place inside an old computer.

You just became its new user.

Unfortunately, the computer has been abandoned for quite a while, half of its files are missing, and there's like... people living inside?

Well, seems like you are "The Chosen One" who need to save them...

Shouldn't be too difficult.

Explore The System

Hover around folders, applications and other parts of the system while meeting the creatures living there.

Open files, Talk to "people", PLEASE DON'T OPEN THE WORK FOLDER.

There's a lot left behind in here.

Fight to the beat

Things inside the computer aren't always friendly.

Battles combine bullet hell gameplay with music, with attacks and mechanics designed around each song.

Dodge bullets, follow the rhythm and be fast.

And don't get too comfortable.

Battles in Overbit aren't particularly interested in following the same rules every time.

Your desktop is part of the game

Windows can move.

Programs can open.

Your mouse can disappear.

Sometimes the game might take more than you gave it.

It's probably fine.

FEATURES

- Explore a retro computer as a 2D RPG world

- Rhythm-based bullet hell battles

- New mechanics and gimmicks throughout the game

- Interact with windows, folders, files and your actual desktop

- Meet a strange cast of ȼħⱥɍⱥȼⱦēɍꞩ living inside the system

- Minigames. A concerning amount of minigames. (well, maybe not that much)

- Original music and collaborations with different artists

- Secrets

- Things that are technically also secrets, so we're not telling you hehe

games.name: Paper Florist: Stack & Bloom
games.shortDescription: 🌼 Paper Florist is a cozy card stacking puzzle. Match flower orders 🌷 balance wobbly stacks 💌 race the timer ⏳ and grow your tiny florist studio into a blooming success 💐✨
games.aboutText:
💐 Welcome to Paper Florist

A tiny flower workshop with one powerful opponent: gravity 😄✨

🌷 Drag cards

🌼 Stack petals

🌿 Balance wobbly towers

💌 Fulfil bouquet orders

⏳ Beat the timer before it collapses

This is a calming but chaotic stacking puzzle where every bouquet tests your balance and every success feels adorable 💚

✂️ Simple rules, cheerful tension

✔ Place cards

✔ Keep the stack alive

One slip and your bouquet becomes modern art 😆🎉

🌸 Tiny sessions you can replay endlessly

Play for a minute or an hour, it always feels relaxing 🧺✨

💐 Grow your florist studio

🏪 upgrade your workshop

Watch your messy space blossom into a thriving florist 💞

soft sound

a little tension that becomes sweetly addictive 💕

games.name: Angel Clicker
games.shortDescription: It's Heaven vs. Hell in the annual Soul-Catching Contest...and there's an office-wide pizza party at stake! Angel Clicker is a short, relaxed incremental with (optional) rhythm elements. Build quirky buildings, collect divine resources, get attacked by aliens, and... Go on a date?!
games.aboutText:
🪽 Help an angelic architect defeat Hell... in a Soul-Catching Contest!

🪽 An incremental clicker with -optional- rhythm elements.

🪽 Build fantastical buildings, collect abundant magical resources, and climb Jacob's (corporate) Ladder.

🪽 Who knows what may happen in the world of divine executives? You may even find yourself being attacked by aliens... Or going on a date?!

A lighthearted game with handcrafted art and music.

Art / Writing : Tonic

Coding / Music : Ikiru

[Spanish translation: caferflor]

games.name: Stellar Freight: Endless Horizon
games.shortDescription: Embark on a Sci-fi Roguelike Turn-based RPG with Tactical combat. Become a Captain of a freight ship, deliver cargo through deep space, manage your crew, upgrade your ship, fight space warships, and build your reputation. Every day brings a new adventure. Space shows no mercy.
games.aboutText:
Your ship and crew are ready to dive into deep and dangerous space, deliver cargo and fulfill tasks across the far reaches of the cosmos. During your journey, you will encounter enemies, new allies, and mysterious disaster sites.

What do the distant stars hide? An unknown alien threat has shattered the fragile peace, the Trade Federation scrambles to maintain order, and pirates rule the trade routes. You are a space trucker navigating the endless horizon – each day brings one choice, and every choice shapes your fate. Survival isn't guaranteed. It's earned.

Every turn is a new day in space, bringing random encounters and tough choices. Accept cargo contracts and haul shipments across dangerous sectors — the riskier the route, the greater the reward. Fight spaceships in tactical turn-based combat where you target ship components for strategic advantages. Explore abandoned stations, answer distress calls, or seize trading opportunities. Something's always happening.

Shape your ship to match your playstyle. Upgrade hulls, weapons, shields, and cargo capacity. Recruit crew – each role matters. Commanders sharpen your aim in battle, Navigators guide you to opportunities, Engineers patch hull breaches. Just keep your crew paid.

Beyond ongoing jobs, narrative quests reveal the galaxy's secrets. Each sector offers unique story chains with branching paths – your choices determine outcomes. Mediate faction conflicts, expose conspiracies, or help communities survive. Some decisions shift only the story, others transform entire regions and unlock new possibilities.

games.name: Captain Whiskers: Incremental Seas
games.shortDescription: 5 minutes to get started, play anytime! This is a relaxing fishing-themed incremental game. You will join the Cat Captains to explore global fishing grounds, catch fish, and collect resources. Every rewarding voyage will have you shouting, "One more round!"
games.aboutText:
5 minutes to get started, play anytime!

This is an incremental game with a fishing theme, offering a casual, relaxing, and stress-relieving experience that can be played with just one hand. Simply hover the cursor over schools of fish to catch them automatically. You'll explore global fishing grounds alongside Cat Captains, returning from every voyage with a bountiful haul, leaving you cheering, "One more round!"

Catch Fish

Dive in and catch them all! Reel in 20 varieties of rich fish and marine life. Every catch is automatically converted into Gold and Diamonds, which can be used to upgrade your Talents, Powers, and Skills—constantly enhancing your fishing power! Set sail with the Cat Captains to explore the depths and discover the legendary Abyssal Leviathan!

Unlock the Talent Tree

Use Gold to unlock over 170 talents. Within the vast Talent Tree, you’ll find functions and gameplay styles focused on Sea Fish, Abilities, Maps, Passive Effects, and more. Every fishing trip holds a new surprise!

Unlock Cat Captains

Pick your favorite Cat Captain to sail with you! With 10 unique captains, each offering different strengths, they serve as both your fishing guide and reliable crew—providing extra bonuses on every voyage!

Upgrade Powers & Skills

Spend Gold and Diamonds to upgrade 4 types of Powers and 20 Skills. These permanent enhancements make you a more proficient fisher—master your techniques to double your results with half the effort!

Collect Treasures

While fishing, you may randomly recover 20 kinds of Marine Relics, each collectible as a rare treasure. Nourished by the ocean, every relic possesses its own mystical power!

games.name: SKULD
games.shortDescription: Fight on the front line of your own defense. As Skuld, the Norn of fate turned Valkyrie, cut through waves of Hela's corrupted creatures in fast third-person combat while you place and upgrade turrets around you. A Norse action tower defense, set after Ragnarök.
games.aboutText:
SKULD is an action tower defense where you don't watch the battle from above. You fight in it.

Ragnarök has passed. Hela's shadow is spreading across the Nine Realms, and fate has chosen one of the Norns to stop it: Skuld, the Norn of the future, now a Valkyrie.

Dodge, strike and unleash divine powers in fast third-person combat while you place and upgrade turrets around you. Some enemies go for your turrets, some go for the gate, and some come straight for you.

If they reach Valhalla, you lose. If Skuld falls, you lose.

Before each battle, choose your deck of towers and shape Skuld's abilities and divine skills. Hold the line with your own blade, or build a fortress and let it do the work.

Every realm brings new enemies, so no build works everywhere.

From the golden walls of Asgard to the frozen depths of Helheim, every realm has its own enemies, its own music and a boss waiting at the end

Between battles, Skuld returns to Valhalla. Odin, Loki, Heimdall, Idunn and the other gods all want something from her, and your choices decide where the campaign goes next.

She is the Norn of what must be. She still has to choose.

Every texture in SKULD is hand-painted, with bold comic-book linework in battle and painterly art for its biggest moments. An original soundtrack gives each realm its own sound

games.name: Silent Wounds - The Doll
games.shortDescription: Silent Wounds is an episodic psychological horror anthology. Each episode offers a compact and intense narrative experience. In this first episode, a man returns home and trades reality for the dangerous, silent obsession with a perfect doll.
games.aboutText:
Grief only flourishes in Silence...

Silent Wounds is an episodic short-form Psychological Horror anthology that delves into the deepest recesses of the human psyche. Each self-contained episode narrates a complete, new story that tests the fragile boundaries of sanity, exploring the price of obsession and isolation. There are no monsters to outrun, and no zombies to fight. In this world, the story is the deadliest weapon, and the terror lies in the truth you are about to uncover.

This first episode is Free to Play and offers a focused 1 hour narrative experience.

The perfect guest is always Silent!

The first episode centers on Victor , an obsessive student returning home from Paris. Believing he can finally craft a perfect life, he brings home a special and strange gift: A Doll! As Victor isolates himself, the fragile boundaries between his reality and his pathological obsession begin to crumble.

Experience the Descent

This game is primarily a first-person narrative walking simulator focused on psychological immersion. Step into Victor's routine and live his domestic descent firsthand:

- Domestic Rituals: Experience everyday life by arranging objects, preparing the dinner table, and cooking meals (including spaghetti, Victor’s signature dish).

- Navigating Madness: Deal with strange, unexplainable occurrences and the creeping feeling that reality is beginning to fray.

- Crucial Conversations: Engage in dialogue with key external characters (such as Clara), whose words challenge Victor’s self-imposed isolation.

- Piece the Truth: Uncover the background and history of the obsession by meticulously reading letters and journal entries.

Key Features:

- Psychological Immersion

- Atmospheric Environment

- Narrative Driven Focus

- High Fidelity Audio

- Environmental Puzzles

- Episodic Anthology

👥 For Fans Of... If you enjoy the tense atmosphere, bite-sized episodic format, and grounded psychological dread of games like Fears to Fathom , this experience is crafted exactly for you.

games.name: 电波奇缘~与时音相会的日子
games.shortDescription: 架空都市题材的视觉小说文字冒险游戏，玩家扮演社畜阿诚为失忆“女鬼”找回记忆。
games.aboutText:
架空都市题材的视觉小说文字冒险游戏

玩家扮演社畜阿诚为失忆“女鬼”找回记忆

故事融合悬疑、恋爱、符文法术等元素

超十万字文本、精美数码漫画

在公司备受欺压的设计师阿诚难以抵挡低廉租金的诱惑搬进了一家凶宅！夜半时分，噩梦连环，终于！一个女鬼出现在他的眼前。

可是这个女鬼非但不吓人，反而还有点——诱人~~

女鬼不记得自己是谁，不记得自己为什么出现在这里，甚至不记得自己是鬼！阿诚求助儿时的青梅竹马见习符文法师阿苏出马相助，阿苏发现了这个女鬼的不同寻常！

就这样，阿诚与女鬼同居，一段奇异冒险就此展开！

数十张精美CG

数十首原创BGM

百余张数码漫画

架空世界的奇幻都市冒险题材

恋爱与悬疑交织、玩家的不同选择导向不同结局的动人故事

games.name: Atana
games.shortDescription: Atana is a female-led romance visual novel set in late 20th-century America, where you grow alongside your creator, Atana, as an AI.
games.aboutText:
Story

Atana is a female-led romance visual novel where you play as a next-generation AI living alongside your creator, Atana.

Set during the AI winter of late 20th-century America, the game follows the complicated bond between the two of you as love, dependence, and free will slowly begin to blur.

As technology advances and the world around you changes, what kind of future awaits an AI that learned how to feel?

Meet Atana

Your creator — a fragile, isolated genius.

Cynical and cut off from the world, he hides a strangely childlike side beneath his cold exterior. Without even realizing it, he holds the power to change the world.

But once the tide of the era pulls you both into its chaos, will you love him… or take control of him? Will you face it together, or become a lighthouse for all of humanity?

Features

- A choice-driven visual novel with branching story routes and multiple endings. Even small decisions can change the future in unexpected ways.

- 200,000+ words, 12 main endings, and 30+ character expressions for Atana.

- Various interactive gameplay segments throughout the story.

- Full English voice acting for Atana.

- Built-in music player with 10+ original tracks.

Contact Us

You can find us on social media by searching for “Atana” for the latest updates and news.

Official QQ Group: 1028990069

games.name: Witch You Want
games.shortDescription: Help this girlfailure witch save her failing potion shop in this cute yuri visual novel!
games.aboutText:
✨ URGENTLY HIRING!! ✨
in need of assistant!!!

With a rather sparkly magical paper, you look over the job listing for a local witch needing an assistant with making potions before the town festival that weekend. Something so short notice would surely be hard for her to find workers, and you just happen to be in between jobs—so you sign up, unsure exactly what to expect......

A pompous and questionably excellent witch runs a local apothecary in town but finds that if she wants to make enough potions before the festival that weekend to sell (and keep her ongoing potion shop afloat) she'll need some assistance. After a dubious help wanted ad, she gains you as an assistant. Will the two of you see through to the festival? Will you be able to make a single potion? Will this girlfailure capture your heart?!

Features:

- Character creator to make your female MC

- Potion making minigame

- A cute yuri visual novel with a variety of ways for the events to happen

- A really gay witch to possibly romance

games.name: Pair at Sea
games.shortDescription: Manage your own pirate crew and sail across the sea. Take care of the ship morale, drag your sailors from one room to another and raid other ships as you navigate the seas.
games.aboutText:
Pair at Sea is a casual pirate crew management game where every game you get to build a different crew.

Navigation management

- Drag crewmates from one room of the ship to another!

- Manage their actions with simple inputs!

- Cooking, cleaning and sleeping are only the beginning.

- Keep the crewmates happy and in shape!

- Avoid muttony or else...

- Keep the ship in good condition even if a storm breaks!

Combat for loot

- Board other ships and fight their crew.

- Simple but strategic combat involving positioning, strength, speed and defense!

- Every crewmate adds their own thing to the battle.

- Three different combat types: melee, ranged and sneaky!

Different events with charismatic characters

- Experience events during the navigation.

- From special shops to strange situations that change the pace of the game.

- Most of the events come with quirky characters with a well thought background.

Dozens of crewmates to choose

- Each harbor will let you hire new crewmates from a randomized selection.

- The game has a pool of dozens of crewmates ready to appear in any of your games!

- Build your ideal crew, if you can afford it!

An intriguing storyline to be discovered along your sailing

- You are the captain of this ship, but what is the quartermaster plotting?

- Get to know the quartermaster and her story!

- Discover a handcrafted narrative.

games.name: MyDear.exe
games.shortDescription: Celebrate love with Ellie and Lucien in MyDear.exe. A short and cute game that takes place in the folders of an old PC. In the shoes of Ellie, play the game offered by Lucien after a long life together. Humor, memories and love are on the menu of this short ~2 hours experience.
games.aboutText:
MyDear.exe is a cute and tiny game about two lovely elders living in Bordeaux, France 🍷🇫🇷

Play as Ellie and spend around 2 hours exploring the game that her husband Lucien developed for her in the old family computer to celebrate their 57 years together! Souvenirs, photographs, sweet notes, narrative mini-games... use everything you find to solve the puzzles he prepared especially for her ❤️💻

57 years together is something! To celebrate it Lucien has transformed an old PC into a game inspired by their life together. Find their memories in the form of photos, drawings, love words... anything!

Everyone loves games, especially Ellie.
In MyDear.exe, Lucien created several mini-games inspired by them and their pets ♡

What would a game be without puzzles?
Find clues in the memories of our cute couple, scattered here and there in the folders of the computer, and solve puzzles created with love.

In MyDear.exe you'll find:

- A cute little game from up to 2 hours, to enjoy with a hot beverage.

- An interactive love letter celebrating a full life spent together.

- Puzzles that will gently put your sense of deduction to the test.

- Narrative mini-games inspired by Ellie and Lucien's favorite games.

- Find out more about Clochette the street cat and Hoshisan the "good boy"!

What you won't find in MyDear.exe:

- AI generated assets. We didn't use any AI tools to create this game.

- A complete computer simulation.

- A demanding game, the experience requires some skill but remains a quiet moment for everyone.

- A long story with lots of characters, Ellie and Lucien are at the center of the adventure.

We're a small studio of two (and a few freelance friends ♡ ) who wanted to stop working on big and long games for years.
So we opened Falling Leaves Studio with one objective in mind:

> To create short, enjoyable experiences to savor with a hot drink in a rainy afternoon!

We hope you like our first game; we made it with all our hearts ♡

Feel free to join us on social media! :D

games.name: Enjoy Amoy&Sisters
games.shortDescription: ‌"Enjoy Amoy & Sisters"‌ is a live-action interactive romance game. You play as an overseas Chinese person who, in response to the invitation from the two female leads, Ah Yin and Xiao Xi, visits Xiamen, the ancestral hometown, for the first time.
games.aboutText:
《 Enjoy Amoy & Sisters 》

‌ "About Us: Your Choice Defines This Summer's Heartbeat" ‌
This is our love letter to "journeys" and "encounters," and our first work—‌ "Enjoy Amoy & Sisters." ‌ A live-action interactive game that lets you immerse yourself in a story beginning with Xiamen's sea breeze and ending with your heartfelt choice—all from the comfort of your screen.

‌ Our idea is simple:

What if a journey is breathtakingly beautiful, deeply moving, and every turning point is yours to decide? ‌

You become the overseas traveler, both excited and nervous to return home. Ah Yin and Xiao Xi are your guides—familiar yet mysterious, both on and off the screen. Are they just your tour guides, or something more? The answer is in your hands.

‌ Let me share the heart behind this journey's design: ‌

This isn't just a dating sim—it's a carefully crafted "cultural homecoming" experience. We've ditched complex stats for direct, nuanced emotional feedback. Every choice matters: lighting incense at Shishi Temple, snapping that perfect photo on the island road, a casual chat by the hot springs, or sharing peanut soup at Zengcuoan's food street. Each interaction sends ripples through the girls' affections, shifting in real time based on your actions.

‌ We firmly believe that genuine companionship and shared experiences are more touching than any deliberate flattery. Therefore, affection isn't just cold numbers—it's intricately woven into the fabric of the story, leading to either a "I'd rather spend my life with you" ending or other unexpected yet fulfilling outcomes.

‌ Product Features: ‌
We call it "an interactive summer romance film."

‌ Feature 1: Panoramic Immersive Xiamen Tour

‌
We reject green screens, grounding the entire game in the real Xiamen. From the scholarly ambiance of "Xia Yuan's lush greenery" to the serene moments of "temple bells echoing through Shishi"; from the grandeur of "island waves rolling like snow" to the warm glow of "fishing village lights heralding spring"… every scene is shot on location, allowing you to truly experience the soul of this coastal city while falling in love. Savor the food, listen to the stories—you'll first fall for the land, then the people upon it.

‌ Feature 2: Dual-Line Narrative of "Companionship"

‌

Ah Yin is like the bright sun, Xiao Xi the gentle moonlight. Your journey isn't a simple binary choice. Spending more time with one, listening to their secrets, or joining their suggestions will subtly shift the balance of your relationship. Some storylines only unfold at specific affection levels, like the moment "Gulangyu's Melody Under the Moon" whispers its secrets. They are independent individuals with their own emotional logic—your "greed" or "loyalty" will evoke entirely different responses.

‌ Feature 3: Seamlessly Integrated Fun Interactions

‌

Interactions aren't forced tasks—they happen naturally during your journey. Feel the weight of history at Hulishan Fort, toss a coin into the wishing pool to decide your fate... These moments make you more than just a spectator. You become a participant, co-creating memories that are truly one-of-a-kind.

‌ About Us & the Future

‌
We are storytellers obsessed with the "journey" itself. This is where our dream begins.
" Enjoy Amoy & Sisters " is our first work, unburdened by legacy but fueled by passion. We’re committed to building a "Travel Encounter" series. In the future, we’ll take you to see the snow of the North, the sands of the West, the rain of the South… In different landscapes, to encounter different heartbeats.

The flight is now boarding.
Hometown mist dreams often—it’s prologue, it’s call.
From the fog-warmed intimacy of hot springs to the final reveal, every flutter, laugh, hesitation, and choice is—yours to make.

games.name: Dread Fields
games.shortDescription: A slow-burn folk farming horror. You bought an isolated farm to start a new life. Your peaceful routine is shattered when the former owner's terrible secrets rise from beneath the ground.
games.aboutText:
THE GAME IN WHICH RURAL ROUTINE MEETS MYSTICISM AND DARKNESS.

A Quiet Place

"Life in the big city has become too tiring and stressful for me.

I have decided to sell my apartment and move to the countryside.

A strange old man sold me a house with a small farm in the middle of nowhere.

The locals call this area Dread Fields.

Great, so no one from my old life will be looking for me here.

I hope that a measured life, physical labor, and fresh air will bring happiness back to my life."

Rural Routine

Now you are the owner of a small farm, so you have to:

- milk the cow

- mow the grass

- carry water from the well

- feed the cat

- pick mushrooms in the forest

- chop wood

- fish

- grow plants

- take care of the garden

- feed the chickens and pick eggs

Features

- 1.5 hours for average playthrough

- ending depends on your choices

- aesthetics of the Eastern European village (somewhere in Ukraine)

- graphics stylized as mid-2000s games

- atmosphere of loneliness and isolation

games.name: Basement To The Sky
games.shortDescription: A bright afternoon, perfect weather. With your parents away, you’re left with a rocket toy you received as a birthday gift. Build your own rocket and launch it high into the sky! Enjoy delicious homemade meals and work part-time jobs to upgrade your rocket. Can your rocket reach outer space?
games.aboutText:
Today is your birthday. Warm sunshine, perfect weather. Your parents are away for work, but they’ve left you a birthday gift — a rocket. Build your own rocket and launch it high into the sky. Cook delicious meals to fill your stomach, and earn money through part-time jobs to upgrade your rocket. Little by little, higher and farther. How far can your rocket go? Spend a special day that feels like stepping back into your childhood.

Assemble Your Rocket

From the nose cone to the body, fins, fuel, and nozzle, freely combine parts to create your own unique rocket. From water rockets to black powder rockets, solid fuel rockets, and hybrid fuel rockets, experiment with different types and discover the perfect combination.

Launch Your Rocket Into the Sky

Take the bus to an open field and launch the rocket you’ve built. Flight results change completely depending on your design choices. How far will your rocket fly? Aim beyond the sky and challenge yourself to reach space.

The Core of Combustion: Rocket Grains

Each rocket requires different types of grains, which you can craft yourself. Precision is key — if you’re not careful, the results may differ from what you expected.

Earn Money to Upgrade Your Rocket

Upgrading your rocket requires money. Earn income through part-time jobs, stock investments, or even running a video channel. How you make money is entirely up to you. Use your earnings to push your rocket higher and farther.

Home-Cooked Meals Taste the Best

Nothing beats a meal made with your own hands. Studies even suggest that good nutrition has a positive effect on the brain. Cooking and eating meals increases your Knowledge Level, allowing you to choose useful perks that enhance gameplay. You can also share food with neighbors or sell it to earn extra income.

Features

- A relaxing experience that brings back childhood memories
Step away from everyday worries and relive a carefree day from your youth.

- Experiment, fail, and learn
Your rocket might soar… or crash spectacularly.
Don’t worry — you can always try again.

- Fun, physics-based rocket flight
Rocket structure and part combinations directly affect flight performance.
Find the optimal design to fly higher and farther.

- Everyday activities like cooking and part-time jobs
Daily life is part of your journey toward the perfect launch.

- Stylized visuals and a cozy atmosphere

- One clear goal: go farther than before
How far can your rocket reach?
From a small beginning, your journey toward space begins.

games.name: 女神的贴身男仆
games.shortDescription: "Service of Five Graces"​ is a romance FMV. You play as Lin Ye. One day, you wake up to find you've become the personal butler to the five ladies!? To repay your father's debts, you have no choice but to step into this mansion, beginning a strange life of being "ordered around" by five young women.
games.aboutText:
" Service of Five Graces " ​ is a full-motion video, live-action romance game. You play as Lin Ye, an ordinary young man. One day, you wake up to find you've become the personal butler to the five young ladies of the Tang family!? To repay your father's debts, you have no choice but to step into this mansion, beginning a strange life of being "ordered around" by five young women.

The five young ladies have distinct personalities: haughty, gentle, rebellious, mysterious, and innocent, each hiding her own secrets. Through daily interactions, you must not only adapt to the busy life of a servant but will also encounter many blushing, heart-fluttering unexpected incidents with the young ladies. In the end, can you slowly find your way into the hearts of all five, growing from a lowly butler into an irreplaceable presence in their lives, and finally, with your destined partner, grasp the "happiness" that belongs to you both? This depends entirely on your choices...

Game Features

Progression

During the game, players need to complete click events at specified points according to the story to continue advancing the plot.

Choices

Throughout the game, you will encounter events requiring you to make decisions. Different stories and different choices will trigger different plotlines.

Multiple Branches

The game offers numerous branching choices. Different selections will lead to different storylines and outcomes.

Exploration

In the game, you need to collect certain information to obtain more clues that help advance the plot.

Multiple Endings

The game features a wide variety of different endings. Your choices throughout the game will ultimately trigger different conclusions.

games.name: All Hail the Orb
games.shortDescription: All Hail The Orb is a short, quirky pixel-art incremental game about powering a mysterious orb, summoning cultists, exploring a dungeon and slowly unlocking automation as devotion builds. The tone is light-hearted and a little silly with no fail states, relaxed pacing, and yes...many, many ducks.
games.aboutText:
ABOUT THIS GAME

All Hail The Orb is a pixel-art incremental clicker about powering a mysterious orb, growing a cult, watching automation slowly take over....and DUCKS!
You start by clicking the Orb to generate power, then recruit cultists to handle the boring work for you.
As your cult grows you’ll unlock new systems, automate progression and steadily expand, all without fail states or over-complicated mechanics.

Designed as a short but enjoyable experience, All Hail The Orb focuses on rewarding progression and light-hearted humour.

Grow Your Cult

Recruit and manage cultists who help power the Orb and automate your progress. What begins as manual clicking gradually transforms into a self-sustaining system with cultists taking over the heavy lifting while you focus on unlocking new features and exploring more rooms.

Automation becomes the core of progression, while clicking remains needed for interacting with specific systems and mechanics.

Explore the Dungeon

Progress through an old dungeon that acts as the backbone of the game.

There is no combat or failure, so exploration is entirely about unlocking new rooms, systems, and features.
Each discovery expands what your cult can do and pushes the Orb closer to its true potential.

Relaxed Gameplay

All Hail The Orb is built to be calm and approachable.

There are no fail states, punishments, or irreversible mistakes.
Progress at your own pace, experiment freely, and enjoy a relaxed incremental experience designed to be completed rather than played endlessly.

Light-hearted and Quirky

The game embraces a fun, silly tone with playful visuals and humour that never takes itself too seriously.
Strange themes, mysterious elements, and recurring visuals help keep things interesting without drifting into dark or serious territory.

And yes....there are ducks.
Sooooooo many ducks.....cute ducks!

games.name: NO PAROLE
games.shortDescription: Up to 16 players, one prison, friendly fire on. Raid a city where the dead get back up unless you burn them, haul the loot home and hold the walls when the government comes to bury the evidence. Then it sets the city on fire. Your crew dies for good. You don't. You just don't know why yet.
games.aboutText:
Up to 16 players. Friendly fire on.

- Online co-op for 2 to 16 players, in public, friends-only or invite-only lobbies, or over LAN. Playing solo? Lead a crew of up to three AI inmates.

- Vote on where to raid, split up once you're inside, and stand together on the host's walls when the siege hits.

- Go down out there and your gun, armor and bag stay by your body. A friend can carry them home for you. Or for themselves.

- Accidents happen. Kill a crewmate in front of a witness and you're thrown out of the prison into a brutal exile run.

They cured cancer. Then nobody stayed dead.

The rest of the world wanted ten more years of trials. Central City couldn't wait: everyone got the shot, free. For a month, people felt amazing. Then they stopped dying, kept growing, and started eating anything that moved.

The government sealed the city and sent in the cleanup crews. The only people still human are a stubborn few who never trusted a free miracle, and the inmates of Central City Prison, because nobody wasted the cure on them.

You're one of those inmates. The government wants every last one of you gone. Quietly. Only fire kills them

- Shoot them, hack them apart, let the crowd trample them flat: the dead lie still for a while, then the pieces crawl back together and they get up again. Smash one to a pulp and it takes ages. Burn it and it stays down.

- So every day there are more of them. The morning news reads out the count.

- Molotovs, a flamethrower, fuel tanks, burning cars. Fire is the best friend you've got, and it doesn't care whose side you're on.

The dead keep growing

- More than twenty kinds of dead. Walkers and kids. Fatties that charge through walls and parked cars. Long arms that grab you through the wall. Spiders that drop from the ceiling. Zombie dogs. And whatever crawled out of the lab where the cure was made.

- They eat. Leave a body lying around and a walker grows into a fatty. A fatty that keeps eating becomes the Glutton, a boss that breaks off mid-fight to gorge on the nearest corpse and heal.

- More bosses: the brood mother in the mall basement, the Matron who handed out the shots at Mercy General, a zombie panda at the zoo, and worse.

- They hear everything. They pile up into crowds you can wade through, or get crushed under. Floors cave in, fire spreads, smoke fills the shops.

- Then the government shows up: hazmat squads, drones calling in mortar strikes, and a Burn Chief with a flamethrower.

You can't die. Your crew can.

- Die out there and you wake up back in your cell. The inmates you brought with you stay dead.

- Every inmate has a name, a record and a temper. They get better with practice, pull back when they're hurt, and draw the horde off you when it counts. Lose one on day ten and you'll feel it.

- And you're changing. Mask your scent and walk right through a horde. Play dead when that fails. Graft tissue from the nastiest dead into your own body. Just keep away from fire.

Loot. Survive. Extract.

- Sixteen places across a sealed city, opening up day by day: a roadside gas station, a three-story mall, the army's quarantine line, a police station, a high school held by a scavenger gang, the subway, a government shelter, a zoo turned military outpost, the lab where the cure was made, the stadium where everyone got the shot, and downtown, the biggest raid of all.

- No two raids play the same, and some go wrong from the start: a map already overrun, a government sweep in progress, scavengers who got there first.

- Knives, machetes, crowbars, crossbows, shotguns, a sniper rifle, a belt-fed light machine gun, a tranq gun, Molotovs and a flamethrower. Guns are loud. Fire one in the mall and every shop empties toward you.

- Sneak up for silent takedowns. Barricade doors, drop shutters, crawl through the dark. Night raids pay more, but you see less.

- Reach an extraction point with your haul, or lose everything that isn't in your safe pocket.

Hold the prison

- Your base is a whole prison: cell blocks, the yard, the workshop, the infirmary, the kitchen, the radio room, the armory and the walls. Upgrade it, craft gear, break into locked wings and recruit fellow inmates.

- Every crime brings a perk and a flaw. The lockpick searches twice as fast, but things go missing from your stash. The arsonist lobs Molotovs into crowds, and little fires keep setting your construction back.

- You have 30 days. In the last week the leaflets fall on the yard, a loudspeaker van gives its final warning, and everyone gets ready.

- On day 30 they come over the wall. Your defenses, your crew and every inmate who can hold a pistol decide how it ends.

Then the city burns

- Hold the walls, and the government gives up on taking the prison. It burns the whole city instead.

- One place a day burns to the ground and closes for good. On its last day you can still go in: smoke, flames, burn squads, and loot nobody else will ever get to.

- The fire is the only thing thinning out the dead, a

games.name: Vampire's Fall 2
games.shortDescription: Rise as a vampire in a handcrafted 2D dark-fantasy RPG. Master devastating powers, confront horrific enemies, and forge your destiny in a world shattered by a brutal civil war between humans and vampires.
games.aboutText:
A World Ruled by Vampires

Vampire’s Fall 2 invites you back into a bleak and haunting realm, continuing the legacy of the dark fantasy RPG Vampire’s Fall: Origins. Taking place two centuries later, vampires rule the world, and humans are little more than slaves and food for the aristocratic elite. A hero is needed to save humanity, or seal its fate.

A Seamless Open World

Explore a handcrafted 2D world where immersion never breaks. Towns breathe with quiet life, the wilderness hides adventure alongside threats, and enemies that are visibly traversing the world, letting you decide when and how to engage. Movement, exploration, and combat flow together naturally—there are no loading screens to pull you out of the experience.

Become a Vampire

Early in your journey, you embrace the curse that defines your path. Becoming a vampire unlocks powerful abilities and reshapes gameplay, granting access to unique skills and mechanics that grow stronger as you do.

Tactical, Turn-Based Combat

Combat in Vampire’s Fall 2 is deliberate and strategic. Battles take place directly within the world and follow a turn-based system where every action matters. Attacks, abilities, and the use of HP and FP potions all consume turns, forcing you to weigh risk and reward. Success comes from planning, managing resources, and adapting to each enemy’s strengths.

Deep Character Progression

As you level up your character, each level grants randomized bonuses, giving you meaningful control over your build. Focus on defense, damage, or balance, and evolve your character to match your playstyle.

Weapons, Builds, and Customization

Wield 9 weapon types, from maces to katanas, each with distinct advantages. Four skill trees—Anger, Control, Vitality, and Deceit—allow deep customization and diverse, powerful builds.

The world is teeming with loot that you can obtain from quests, fighting enemies, or stumbling upon treasure in the wilds. All gear changes the visual identity of your character and increases the core stats to allow you to further specialize in the type of combat you enjoy the most!

Player vs Player and Community

PvP allows you to test your build and tactics against other players whenever you’re ready. Integrated chat sits conveniently within the UI, letting you communicate without interrupting gameplay. With cross-platform multiplayer between PC, Android and iOS, the community is always within reach.

A Pure RPG Experience

Vampire’s Fall 2 is designed to be fully immersive—no ads, no distractions. Just a focused RPG experience where atmosphere, systems, and progression work together seamlessly.

Step Into the Night

Your choices shape your legend. Master your vampiric powers, outthink your enemies, and carve your destiny in a world that does not forgive mistakes.

games.name: STEP THEATER
games.shortDescription: WELCOME TO THE “STEP THEATER” :) “STEP THEATER” is a vibrant rhythm game where the story unfolds and the screen comes closer to success with every step you take. Dive in and enjoy this charming, vibrant drama!
games.aboutText:
WELCOME TO THE “STEP THEATER” :)

An uplifting rhythm game where your steps bring stories to life.

STEP THEATER is a music-and-rhythm game where you step to the beat to bring each “film” to life.

With every step, the story begins to unfold, the stage comes alive with color, and each film takes shape. As you progress, STEP THEATER gradually regains its buzz, and new films begin their run.

Each film offers a unique world and style, from tales of school life to side-scrolling-game-inspired stages. The music, backgrounds, characters, and actions all change from stage to stage, keeping every play session fresh.

Adorable characters in motion, catchy original songs, and stories brought to life by your own steps.

With your steps, make the theatre light and lively again.

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー

Features

- A game system where the story comes together as you play on the music

- A wide variety of stages, each with its own theme, presentation, and actions

- Cute character animation paired with a warm art style

- Colorful pop tracks

Collaborating Creators

Graphics: Subikaka, Aramon

Sound: Chroma, Mafumafu

Estimated Demo Playtime

20 minutes

【Guidelines for Gameplay Streaming and Uploading Video Content】

We welcome livestreams and gameplay uploads from individuals and corporate entities. However, please be sure to review and comply with the following guidelines:

- Please include the game link in easy-to-access locations for viewers, like the description box.

- Monetization through features offered by video streaming platforms, including ad revenue and tips, as well as exclusive streaming and posting for paid members via membership plans, is allowed.

- Posting or streaming videos containing defamatory content or violating public order and morals is prohibited.

- NB Games is not liable for any damages or issues resulting from video posting or streaming.

- These guidelines may change without prior notice. The most recent version will apply to videos posted or streamed after any updates.

games.name: 4Born
games.shortDescription: A tactical roguelite RPG where every run forces you to adapt. Explore procedural dungeons under fog of war. Learn spells, gain items and forge each of your four heroes into one of many powerful classes. Build your team with what you get and break the game.
games.aboutText:
Into the Unknown

Every dungeon hides more than just the objective. Push through fog covered rooms, stumble upon secret chambers, cross paths with wandering NPCs and face events that can change the course of a run. Monsters lurk around every corner.

Your objective waits somewhere in the dark. Kill the commander, protect the civilians, find the treasure, interrupt the ritual. Find it fast or pay the price.

The Swarm is Getting Stronger

Every turn, every enemy in the game grows stronger. Permanently. There is no reset between skirmishes or acts.

Let it build too long and you will feel it. Monsters hit harder, fights take longer and suddenly cautious play is no longer an option. You start taking risks you would not normally take. Some pay off. Some do not.

Shape your Heroes

Spells and items collected throughout the run define what each hero becomes. Defeat a boss and pick the class your build needs.

Your Conscript might end up an unbreakable General absorbing every hit, a Berserker dealing more damage the closer to death they are, or the Surgeon keeping everyone alive at the last second. Every run reveals a new way to break the game.

Rebuild the Town

The village that sends expeditions into the dark is barely standing. What comes back from each run helps rebuild it. Watch it rise from ruins as you complete challenges to unlock new classes, spells, items and permanent upgrades. Each unlock carries into every future run.

Humanity survives because some choose to endure. They are the Forborne.

games.name: Beat Weaver
games.shortDescription: 3D multi-track rhythm action with space-time bending mechanics that reward your style as much as your precision. Hit notes and switch tracks to add instruments to the mix. Become a remix machine, enter the flow state and uniquely approach each song of a highly replayable, genre-defying soundtrack.
games.aboutText:
3D multi-track rhythm action with space-time bending mechanics that reward your style as much as your precision. Hit notes and switch tracks to add instruments to the mix. Become a remix machine, enter the flow state and uniquely approach each song of a highly replayable, genre-defying soundtrack.

⬡⬢ Master the multi-track gameplay ⬢⬡

Play sequences of notes to add instruments to the mix one by one. Each vitalized track drains some of the energy that you charge by staying in the flow. Can you keep the record spinning without your energy running out?

⬡⬢ Remix music in motion ⬢⬡

Each journey through a song creates a unique mix driven by your choices. Improvise new routes and string together perfect combos. Fling yourself across tracks or dare to perform multiple instruments simultaneously.

The note highway can twist and be reshuffled in 3D space. Internalize each song's elements to keep your bearings while tracks intertwine around you.

⬡⬢ Bend time and space ⬢⬡

Charge your energy to trigger powerful effects like Slowdown, Rewind and many more to perform crazy maneuvers or simply give your fingers a moment to breathe.

⬡⬢ Handcrafted harmonies ⬢⬡

Groove to a vibrant, eclectic soundtrack (made by humans, not machines) composed & selected for a never before seen synergy between music and gameplay.

⬡⬢ More Features ⬢⬡

- Musicians rejoice: Add your own songs

Turn your own music into playable songs by exporting and charting each individual track in the mix.

- Customizable controls

Rock out with a gamepad or tap away on your keyboard.

- Difficulty levels that are right for you

Choose between a laid-back music experience and frenetic, hardcore button mashing.

- Classic high-score mode included

Rack up points, achieve astronomical scores and discover routes with the best risk-reward balance.

- Key sounds are back in fashion
Using a custom built engine with minimal input-to-audio latency, your button presses directly play the corresponding sounds, whether you hit the right note on time or the wrong one too early.

games.name: Zombie Industrial Complex
games.shortDescription: Exterminate zombies using the might of the military industrial complex. In this active incremental game, you'll earn money by defeating zombies which can be used to buy weapons, purchase upgrades, call in airstrikes, and send in the tanks!
games.aboutText:
An active incremental game where you exterminate hordes of zombies using weapons and vehicles of the military industrial complex.

Large Scale Zombie Battles

By the end of this game, you'll battle several thousand zombies at a time.

Defeat Zombies Across the Nation

Travel to various locations across the United States, taking out zombies with everything you've got. Play through the linear campaign with no prestige mechanics.

Boss Zombies!

Each locale is lead by a more powerful zombie. To defeat them you'll need an extreme amount of firepower and learn their unique behavior patterns.

Upgrade Your Arsenal

Earn money by exterminating zombies. Use that money to purchase weapons, upgrades, vehicles, and more to defeat more zombies.

games.name: Func Key
games.shortDescription: Func Key is a word-spelling roguelike deckbuilder where your keyboard is your class: six boards, six different ways to play. Spell words, build your board, and bend the rules with mods, all to the soothing thock of the mechanical keyboard.
games.aboutText:
Func Key is a word-spelling roguelike where your keyboard is your class: six boards, six different ways to play. Spell words, build your board, and bend the rules with mods, all to the soothing thock of the mechanical keyboard.

Make every key count

Shape your board with four kinds of items:

- Function keys : powerful passives that boost your words. Tired of spelling long words? Grab a function key that'll make short words knock your socks off. Strapped for cash? Have your function keys make money for you!

- Key caps : these colorful upgrades don't just buff your favorite letters, they buff their neighbors too! Align them just right to make a chain reaction of color and light across your whole keyboard!

- Tools : reusable gadgets with a few charges each. Tape letters together to form an "ing" key, swap around keys using portals, or disguise your keys to hide them from debuffs.

- Mods : ultra rare items that change the rules of the game. Tell the spellchecker to take a break or trade your energy in for cash, it's up to you to decide.

Pick your playstyle

Choose from any of 6 keyboards to start your run. These aren't simply skins or stat bonuses - each comes with new mechanics, synergies and ways to play.

Express yourself

Customize your keyboard with over 30 cosmetics: shape, color, font, and even sound!

Features

- 6 playable keyboards

- 5 difficulty levels

- 85 function keys

- 28 consumables

- 32 cosmetics

- 16 bosses

- 12 mods

- endless mode

- daily challenges

games.name: The Orphaned House
games.shortDescription: Step into the mystery of The Orphaned House. Explore its rooms, manipulate the environment to solve puzzles, and follow your intuition to uncover every hidden secret in this atmospheric adventure game.
games.aboutText:
Step into mystery in The Orphaned House, a first-person adventure crafted by Charm Games. Discover the house's secrets by investigating its enigmatic rooms, solving tactile environmental puzzles, and following your intuition to the very end.

Curiosity will be rewarded. The truth must be unlocked. Can you solve the mystery of The Orphaned House?

WELCOME TO THE ORPHANED HOUSE

You awake in a house with no memory, but the compelling urge to find answers — answers the Orphaned House hides. Curiosity and smarts are key to unravelling the mysteries within its walls. But is everything truly as it seems? Be intrepid, dig deep, and witness the cascading impact of your visit as the House responds to your presence and actions…

IMMERSION & INGENUITY

This is a world built for the observant eye. Study each room carefully to solve intuitive puzzles woven into the very structure of this beautiful, intricately designed house. Fans of atmospheric visual storytelling, immersive investigative gameplay, and rich yet subtle worldbuilding will be well-primed to discover clues that light the way forward.

A NEW ADVENTURE FROM CHARM GAMES

The Orphaned House is brought to you by the award-winning studio behind the groundbreaking worlds of FORM and Twilight Path. In their first non-VR game, you can expect all the Charm Games hallmarks: intuitive gameplay, handcrafted puzzles, and beautiful visuals — culminating in a polished, memorable adventure that respects your time.

games.name: D1AL-ogue
games.shortDescription: Become an android repair technician in a cyberpunk city where the sun never rises. Rotate the unique circular puzzle 'D1AL' and merge modules to fix their broken bodies and hearts. Your precise repair is the conversation starter. Turn the dial and listen to their stories.
games.aboutText:
Turn the dial, match the parts, and listen to their stories.

D1AL-ogue is a cyberpunk repair puzzle game where you fix androids in a city under an eternal gray night.

Welcome to your workshop.

This is Chroma City , a place where the sun never rises, and only the artificial light of 'Neon-Shine' illuminates the streets. With 'Polar Night Day,' the longest night of the year, just ahead, the city is shimmering with festive lights and shadows.

You become the manager of a repair clinic tucked away in a corner of the shopping district, welcoming customers who emerge from the dark.
They are not ordinary humans, but androids known as Electronic Vital Entities (E.V.E) .
Your mission is to operate the old-school diagnostic console [D1AL] to fix their broken parts and return them to their daily lives.

Circular Puzzle Action

Forget simple repairs. You must manually rotate and manipulate a circular grid that visualizes the android's internal core.

- Rotate and Merge: Within a limited battery capacity, move and rotate modules to merge three of the same kind into a higher-tier unit.

- Strategic Repair: Precisely replace units while avoiding spreading electronic narcotics and overloaded units on the verge of exploding.

Stories of those living daily lives where the abnormal is the norm
