Androids with unique charms and backstories will visit your workshop.

Instead of a warm cup of tea or a cocktail, serve them a perfect repair . The stories they share will change depending on your skills.

Key Features

- Circular Puzzle: A unique puzzle mechanism based on a circular grid.

- Light Narrative: Trivial yet deep daily stories within a cyberpunk universe.

- Retro Aesthetics: Pixel art visuals combining 98-era PC style with Neon Noir.

Now, turn the D1AL and connect with them.

-------------------------------------------------------------

All resources used in the game are either 100% hand-crafted or licensed assets.
Log collection is strictly limited to gameplay information for game improvement purposes.

games.name: SCREENSIDE FISHER
games.shortDescription: Sit back and relax with a desktop fishing game that stays in the corner of your screen. Catch fish, cook recipes, upgrade your gear, and complete your collection guide. Customize your character’s look and even design your very own custom fish to catch!
games.aboutText:
SCREENSIDE FISHER is a chill desktop fishing game you can enjoy in the corner of your screen.

Place your character anywhere you like and go about your work or daily tasks. When a fish bites, your character will signal you—and don't worry, the fish will wait until you're ready! Whenever you have a moment, reel it in through a timing mini-game.

Sell your catches or use them as ingredients for cooking. Combine various ingredients to discover new recipes, aim for higher star ratings, and complete both your Fish and Recipe Encyclopedias!

Use the money you earn to buy new fishing rods, upgrades, cooking ingredients, music, and ambient soundscapes. Meet shopkeepers and fulfill special conditions to unlock shops and bonus features.

Want to personalize your space? Use the built-in customization features! Decorate your character’s skin with your favorite images, and add your very own custom fish—setting personalized names, sizes, and custom artwork directly into the game.

games.name: Zero Stress King: Idle Defense
games.shortDescription: A short relaxing incremental game disguised as a tower defense, but enemies can’t reach your walls. Thanks to lava.
games.aboutText:
Enemies constantly run toward your walls. You buy defenders, upgrade production, and watch the waves grow.

But they can’t reach you. There is a river of lava at the end. Every enemy falls into it. Every time.

Your conquest map is your skill tree

Zero stress gameplay.

No losing. No pressure. No "restart the level" moments. Just numbers going up and enemies running.

Be the Zero Stress King

This is a tower defense where you already won. Sit back, relax, and enjoy the lava.

games.name: BREAKOUT BABY
games.shortDescription: BREAKOUT BABY is a blood-pumping, Pac-Man–infused, first-person horror roguelike where you must help a poor baby escape to the surface. Run from creatures, scoop up pellets, and shake your baby to survive.
games.aboutText:
BREAKOUT BABY is a Pac-Man–infused horror roguelike that rewards mastery of its mechanics and precise execution as you progress from floor to floor. Every step — every turn of the corner — matters. One slip-up and it’s all over, for you and your baby. Be careful out there, and don’t forget your Go-Go Juice.

Collect all the pellets on a floor to gain access to the next, but be careful! Your greed doesn’t go unnoticed.

The freaks are out to get you. Don't get too close, they bite.

Meet some new friends along the way and let them upgrade your abilities.

Don’t worry, they’re all very nice. Remember to say thank you!

Collect baby supplies like rattles, pacifiers and iPads for powerful effects.

You will need them.

Keep close watch on your baby to gain information on enemy positions.

Shake your baby awake when necessary.

Why not?

games.name: Pickupbal
games.shortDescription: A simple game all about picking up a ball.
games.aboutText:
Do you want to play my game?

Pickupbal is a simple arcade game about picking up a ball and trying to keep it in the air for as long as possible while avoiding enemies and juggling them.

- Easy to pick up, hard to master.

- Endless waves that increase in difficulty

- Cursor-based ball spinning for maximum style

- Cards that spice up each run

- Raise, collect and sell fish from the Fish Tank

- Unlockable cosmetics and backgrounds

- Global leaderboards

games.name: Abyss Prowler
games.shortDescription: Abyss Prowler is an arcade inspired top-down arena shooter where you should always stay on the move to survive. Dash, reposition and strike. Demo is available.
games.aboutText:
Demo Content

The demo consists of one level that introduces the core gameplay elements. It also serves as the tutorial level of the main game, ending with the demo's main boss fight.

Gameplay

It's a fast-paced top-down arena shooter that demands control. You'll need to reposition quickly, act and react fast in order to succeed.

Focus Mode

Focus mode allows you to slow-down time, giving you a brief moment to plan and execute your tactic.

Brought to you by the creator of games you've probably never heard of.

games.name: The Grade 5B Case Files
games.shortDescription: A narrative AVG focused on everyday mysteries from the lives of elementary school students. The two protagonists encounter ordinary yet unusual incidents at school, and through investigation and deduction, players uncover the truth together with them.
games.aboutText:
Open the notebook and explore seemingly ordinary yet mysterious incidents together with two girls!

Watsonia, a student in Grade 5, Class B at Seashell Elementary School, buys a notebook at a stationery store. At the time, she has no idea what she wants to write in it—she simply finds the cover cute and decides to buy it. This notebook becomes the starting point that brings Watsonia and her classmate Holmlyn together as a team of two, investigating and deducing unusual incidents hidden within daily school life.

To others, these incidents may seem like something trivial caused by children. But for Holmlyn and Watsonia, each one of them is a difficult “case” .

As the mysteries unfold one by one, a larger picture of life in school gradually emerges.With Holmlyn, who is a detailed-oriented and action-driven person, and Watsonia acting as her “assistant” who carefully records every clue, the two work together to uncover the truth behind each case. Along the way, classmates, teachers, and students from other grades all make their appearances, forming a fair-play mystery story set within the school.

As the player, you will collect clues, conduct investigations, think things through, and make correct deductions alongside them. Watsonia records all clues in her notebook—if you ever feel lost, try opening it and taking another look.

Watsonia:

A cheerful and innocent elementary school girl in Grade 5, Class B at Seashell Elementary School. She’s neither particularly noticeable nor invisible—just an ordinary student. She enjoys buying things she personally finds cute, though her taste isn’t always mainstream.

Holmlyn:

A quiet and reserved elementary school girl in Grade 5, Class B at Seashell Elementary School. She doesn’t have any especially close friends in class.

She is passionate about origami crafts and also has an interest in sprinting.

The game features a linear, chapter-based narrative structure, with seemingly ordinary incidents gradually forming a complete story.

- The game consists of 5 chapters, each taking about 1 hour to complete.

- Chapter 1 is released for free and offers a complete standalone story experience.

- Chapters 2–3 will be released simultaneously as DLC.

- Chapters 4–5 will be released later as DLC following the earlier chapters.

As the chapters progress, the story will gradually unfold.

This title also serves as the starting point of a series. Future works set in the same theme and setting are planned.
The series is expected to consist of multiple titles, each containing around five chapters, continuing to record mysteries hidden within everyday life.

- Press Shift to open the menu during dialogue or free investigation where you can check items or save game

- Press Z or Enter to confirm or investigate

- Press X or Esc to cancel or close the menu

- Press S to fast-forward

- Press Q or scroll to view the log

- Press F5 to quickly return to the title screen

- Use ↑↓←→ to move the character in explorable scenes

Scenario & Programming: Teacher Li（狸老师）

Art: 坐标zahyou

Publisher: Eternal Dream Studio

(Referenced materials are listed in the in-game credits)

games.name: Captain Capy - Roguelike Space Crafter
games.shortDescription: Blast through a cosmic junkyard as an intrepid capybara astronaut in this cozy yet action-packed 2D space shooter roguelike. Salvage scrap, craft upgrades, and outsmart a rogue AI amid the stars.
games.aboutText:
Captain Capy: Roguelike Space Crafter

Captain Capy: Roguelike Space Crafter puts you in the four-toed feet of the galaxy’s most unlikely hero, a capybara astronaut. Armed with a ramshackle ship and an endless sense of wonder, Captain Capy ventures into a dangerous asteroid belt filled with derelict ships, glittering salvage, and the lurking threat of a rogue AI. The game blends cozy charm with adrenaline-fueled action, delivering a classic roguelike experience with a whimsical twist.

As a 2D space shooter with rich crafting mechanics, gameplay revolves around exploration, improvisation, and intense combat. Each run through the asteroid field is unique, presenting new procedurally-generated challenges and surprises. Blast apart debris and enemy drones to collect scrap, then craft upgrades on the fly , turning piles of junk into potent weapons, shields, and gadgets.

Every piece of salvage can be repurposed into something useful, whether it’s a laser cannon built from spare parts or armor plating hammered out of old satellite panels. But beware: the rogue AI overseeing this sector isn’t about to let a capybara scavenge freely, and it will throw swarms of robotic foes and hulking boss ships in your path.

Persistence pays off. Between runs, you’ll return to your base to unlock permanent upgrades and tinker with your ship. Carry over precious materials or data to improve Captain Capy’s chances on the next expedition – new engine modules, stronger hulls, enhanced crafting blueprints, and more become available as you progress.

Each defeat is a learning experience, allowing you to dive back in a little stronger and a lot wiser. Whether you’re a hardcore roguelike fan or just love a good space adventure, Captain Capy offers a journey that is equal parts heartwarming and thrilling, combining the pulse-pounding replayability of an action roguelike with the cozy vibes of a lighthearted sci-fi tale .

games.name: Mazino
games.shortDescription: A neon-soaked casino twist on classic maze-chase action. Navigate glowing mazes as "Chip," dodge cunning Dealers, ride hot streaks, hit jackpots, and let the music-reactive visuals pull you into one more run. The house always wins... unless you're on a Blazing Streak.
games.aboutText:
THE HOUSE DOESN'T ALWAYS WIN

Welcome to MAZINO – where the casino floor is a maze and every corner could be your last. You are Chip, a lucky token trying to cash out big while evading the Dealers, relentless enforcers who patrol the neon corridors and don't let anyone leave a winner.

WHAT IS MAZINO?

Navigate maze-like casino floors, collect chips, avoid the Dealers, and survive long enough to bank your winnings. Simple to learn, impossible to put down. MAZINO blends arcade action with casino psychology, creating a feedback loop that keeps whispering "just one more run."

THE STREAK SYSTEM

Your performance builds momentum:

Cold – You're losing. Multipliers drop.

Neutral – Steady play. Standard rewards.

Warm – Getting hot. Bonuses increase.

Hot – On fire. Big multipliers kick in.

Blazing – Unstoppable. Maximum rewards, maximum risk.

One hit resets everything. Do you play it safe or push your luck?

CASINO MECHANICS

Mystery Chips – Scattered across the floor. Grab one for bonus chips, speed boosts, extra lives... or a nasty surprise. Risk and reward.

Jackpot Triggers – Hit the right combination and watch chips rain from the sky as the screen explodes in gold.

Wheel of Fortune – Fill the meter through skilled play, spin the wheel, claim your prize.

Near-Miss Bonuses – Almost got caught? The casino rewards the bold. Brush past danger for bonus chips.

Comp Points – Loyalty pays. Earn points just by playing and spend them on upgrades.

THE DEALERS

Four enforcers patrol the floor, each with unique hunting behavior:

The Chaser – Relentless. Follows your every move.

The Interceptor – Cunning. Predicts where you're going and cuts you off.

The Wildcard – Erratic. Works with others in unexpected ways.

The Drifter – Passive until you get close. Then suddenly deadly.

Learn their patterns. Exploit their weaknesses. Survive.

ADAPTIVE DIFFICULTY

MAZINO watches how you play. Dominating the floor? The Dealers speed up and coordinate. Struggling to survive? The pressure eases – just enough to give you hope before the next spike. Every session feels tailored to your skill level.

BOSS ENCOUNTERS

Every few floors, a Boss Dealer appears. These aren't standard enforcers – they have multiple attack phases, summon backup, and require pattern recognition to defeat. Take them down for massive rewards.

MUSIC-REACTIVE WORLD

The entire casino pulses to the soundtrack. Lights sync to the bass. Neon blooms on every beat drop. The floor isn't just a maze – it's a living, breathing rhythm experience.

VIP PROGRESSION

Rise through the ranks:

Bronze → Silver → Gold → Platinum → Diamond

Bank your chips between runs. Unlock permanent bonuses. Climb the global leaderboards. Your lifetime earnings determine your VIP status.

FEATURES

- Original arcade action with casino flair

- Deep economy system: chips, streaks, multipliers, banking

- Adaptive difficulty that responds to your skill

- Boss encounters with unique mechanics

- Music-reactive lighting and visual effects

- Full controller support with haptic feedback

- Steam Achievements and Global Leaderboards

- Daily Challenges with unique modifiers

- Ghost Replay – race against your best runs

ONE MORE RUN

MAZINO is a game about rhythm, risk, and the eternal question: do you bank your chips now, or push for the jackpot?

The floor is waiting. The Dealers are watching. Are you feeling lucky?

games.name: SharedScreen Wagons 2
games.shortDescription: Local multiplayer on one screen. Up to 8 players, 8 gamepads, 3 keyboards. Fast rounds, tournaments, friendship stress tests. Joy, suffering, victory — often in one round.
games.aboutText:
SharedScreen Wagons 2 is local multiplayer where order lasts exactly until someone presses Start. Fast matches, tournaments, and reaction tests — whoever moves first is right; whoever hesitates becomes cargo.

A loud, bright game for arguing over who builds fastest, who wrecks the enemy base first, and who survives traps and the spaghetti junction of everyone's trains — while still calling it "co-op."

Works solo, with friends, or at family night. Especially educational with kids nearby: you'll rediscover how creative your vocabulary can get.

SharedScreen Wagons 2 delivers the full emotional buffet: joy, sadness, laughter, suffering (mandatory), and victory euphoria — often in one round.

Verdict: hooks you in minutes, won't let go, sometimes visits your dreams. Leaves a good aftertaste and the thought "just one more match." Or ten.

The idea hatched before New Year 2021: can six people play on a projector? Yes. Since then: 200+ sessions of joy and pain, laughter and whining, screams and sniffles. Hope you get the same.

games.name: SILENT REALM
games.shortDescription: Free To Play Game, An atmospheric action horror experience set in a non-human realm governed by rules unlike our own. A world of skeletal entities and shifting remains, where forms assemble and decay endlessly, and death exists as an active, hostile force rather than an outcome.
games.aboutText:
SILENT REALM is a free-to-play, single-player, story-driven experience set in a non-human world where life has completely ended, governed by rules unlike those of our own reality.

This is not a land after catastrophe — it is a realm after existence itself has collapsed. Skeletal remains dominate the environment, structures feel unnatural and unstable, and silence replaces any recognizable sense of order. Nothing lives here, and nothing ever truly belonged.

The world is not empty — it is hostile. The environment itself functions as a threat, oppressive and dangerous, as if death has become a governing force rather than a consequence. Every movement reinforces the idea that survival is not expected, but resisted.

In this realm, death is active. Threats form and collapse from the remains of what once existed, forcing constant tension and confrontation. Combat is a necessity, not a choice, and awareness is as critical as firepower.

SILENT REALM focuses on atmosphere and world design, blending exploration with action-driven survival. The experience is built to feel relentless and unsettling — a journey through a place that should not exist, and actively resists anything that does.

Gameplay Overview:

The game is experienced from a first-person perspective, placing players directly inside a hostile and unfamiliar world where survival is never guaranteed.

Players take on the role of an individual searching for a missing brother, venturing into one of the most dangerous regions of this world. Progression is driven by exploration, environmental awareness, and constant threat management, pushing players deeper into increasingly dangerous areas.

Combat is a core element of the experience. Players rely on firearms while carefully managing limited ammunition, choosing when to fight and when to avoid confrontation. Specialized detection devices are used to locate threats, scan the environment, and navigate dangerous zones without drawing attention.

Survival depends on awareness, movement, and decision-making. Enemies are not meant to be confronted recklessly, and the environment itself often serves as an obstacle as dangerous as the entities within it.

games.name: SHORE
games.shortDescription: Stuck in the middle of the ocean, survive together on a fragile physics-based raft. Fight storms, tsunamis, sharks, and starvation as you find your way back home in SHORE, a 1-4-player co-op survival adventure.
games.aboutText:
The sea is hostile. Your raft is unstable. Your friends are (too) heavy. This is SHORE.

SHORE is a 1-4 player co-op adventure where teamwork keeps you alive.

Coordinate your paddling, rescue each other when disaster strikes, and try not to throw your friends overboard.

Out here, teamwork wins. Usually.

Your raft is fully physics-based.

Every wave tilts it. Every shift in weight changes its balance. Currents push it off course.

It's fragile, unpredictable, and somehow still your best option.

The ocean wants you dead.

Fight hunger and survive the dangers ahead. Every biome introduces new hazards, from towering icebergs and hungry sharks to deadly whirlpools and creatures of the deep.

No journey is ever the same. And that's exactly the problem.

Somewhere beyond the horizon lies civilization.
Chart your course through abandoned islands, drifting wreckage, sinking ships, and uncharted waters. Every landmark brings new opportunities, but also new risks.
Getting lost is easy.
Making it home is another story.

I'm building SHORE in public on social media. My username is Underdog. Comment on the devlogs and let me know what to add next (just like 2,000 of you did last month to help me shape the game!)

games.name: Take Care Of It.
games.shortDescription: Horror/thriller visual novel with RPG elements about two friends that explores guilt, co-dependency, and personal limits being pushed.
games.aboutText:
Austin and Riley are childhood friends. Despite their tumultuous friendship in high school, things are going pretty good now in college.

But that stability does not last.

Something happens. Old habits resurface.

Riley can fall back into old patterns, or he can draw a line.

Both choices leave marks.

Play as Riley as he grapples with guilt, responsibility, and personal limits.

games.name: Martyr
games.shortDescription: Rise as a Martyr in a plague-scarred, heretical Europe. Surrounded by disease, pagan rites, and relentless foes, you will fall and rise again and again. Death is not the end. Relics await based on your holy or heretical choices, and rival factions will hunt you according to your actions.
games.aboutText:
A DARK ARPG OF FAITH, SACRIFICE, AND VENGEANCE

Step into the shoes of a martyr reborn in a Europe ravaged by plague and heresy. Choose your path as a Footman, Penitent, Woodsman, or Gravekeeper , each a fallen saint seeking redemption, revenge, and justice in a world torn apart by war and disease.

HERESY AND SANCTITY IN YOUR HANDS

Embark on a series of quests that lead you ever closer to the heart of the blight. Every choice you make shapes not only your playstyle but also the dangers that pursue you. Walk the holy path and reap the world’s favor, or embrace heresy and awaken new, deadly threats. Every decision carries weight, choose wisely.

FIGHT, SURVIVE, AND SACRIFICE

Gather and wield powerful relics to enhance your skills, while your actions ripple through the world. Your Heresy and Sanctity Levels track your deeds. Act boldly in the name of faith and the world will hunt you mercilessly.

DYNAMIC, REPLAYABLE, AND IMMERSIVE

With countless dungeons, emergent builds, and a layered progression system, no two journeys are the same. Will you ascend as a legendary martyr or be forgotten to history? Every death, every choice, every battle matters.

games.name: Pigs and Wolf
games.shortDescription: Build. Survive. Drag your home. Lost piggies. A rolling home. Hungry wolves. Play solo or team up with friends to gather resources and survive the night in this chaotic fairy-tale survival adventure.
games.aboutText:
BUILD, SCRAMBLE, SURVIVE

Set off on your own or team up with your piggy crew to gather straw, wood, and all sorts of useful (and probably suspicious) resources.

Build, upgrade, and patch together your rolling wagon-home before chaos strikes. When the wolves come running, every wall, wheel, and defense could mean the difference between survival and total piggy disaster.

It’s not just a house. It’s your squeaky little lifeline.

WOBBLY PHYSICS, BIG CHAOS

Nothing ever goes exactly to plan.

Watch your wagon bounce, tip over, lose wheels, crash downhill, or somehow launch itself straight into disaster. Every trip is a messy, hilarious balancing act where physics can be just as dangerous as the wolves.

Hold on tight.

SURVIVE THE NIGHT

When the sun goes down, the real trouble begins.

Hungry wolves led by the Alpha Wolf will stop at nothing to tear your wagon apart. Defend your home, protect your piggy pals, and try not to end up as a ghostly spectator watching the chaos unfold.

TWISTED FAIRY-TALE ADVENTURES

Journey through strange storybook worlds where fairy tales spiraled into total chaos.

Explore magical kingdoms, dodge grumpy witches, uncover surprises, unlock quirky costumes, and face unpredictable challenges in every run.

No two piggy adventures are ever the same.

"Join the adorable, chaotic survival adventure with three little pigs and find your way home, alone or together!"

Features:

- Solo Play & 1–4 Player Online Co-op

- Chaotic Physics-Based Survival

- Gather, Build, and Upgrade Your Wagon

- Defend Against Nightly Wolf Raids

- Explore Twisted Storybook Worlds

- Unlock Costumes and Customisation

- Hilarious Physics-Based Chaos

- PvE Survival Adventure

🐷🐺 Streaming and content creation are welcome!

Don’t forget to include “Pigs and Wolf” in your video title!

Feel free to add the Steam link in your video description, and invite your friends to join the adventure and survive together!

Enjoy little piggies!

games.name: Photomaly
games.shortDescription: A PSX-style horror game where you manage a photo studio. Restock supplies, buy upgrades, photograph customers and print their order whilst encountering unexpected events.
games.aboutText:
Photomaly is PSX-style first-person horror game where you take over the photography studio your father left behind. Process orders from strange customers, decorate your studio and keep an eye out for things that don’t seem quite right...

Photography isn’t always as simple as pressing the shutter. Find the perfect angle, develop film under the right conditions, prepare the final photos, and make sure they end up in the right hands.

Greet and serve the local community. Each customer comes with their own unique requests, quirks, and stories. Get to know your patrons and fulfil their orders. Just make sure not to pry too deep…

When business is slow, customise and decorate your workspace. Hang your favourite prints on the wall or create the perfect wallpaper for your PC. Use your profits to unlock and purchase studio upgrades – better equipment, better setups, better results.

Developing films pays the bills, but something isn’t quite right. With every photo taken, you get a little bit closer to [REDACTED]. The [REDACTED] seems to know some things as well…

games.name: ペンギンウォーズ
games.shortDescription: This is an adventure novel game. Movement and object selection are possible using only keyboard input and mouse clicks on a PC. Experience the story of a girl strolling through the night town, enhanced by captivating movies and music.
games.aboutText:
【Story】

The final week before the stars perish.

What experiences will the girl have?

Where you want to go, who you want to talk to—spend your last night as you wish.

【Gameplay】

“Penguin Wars” is an exploration-based adventure game. Click on objects and movement points on the screen to move freely. The story unfolds with immersive visuals and sound.

【Soundtrack】

Includes all 19 tracks, excluding sound effects and jingles. Download MP3 versions of the guitar and piano pieces played by the protagonist, Kokoro-chan.

【Game Distribution/Play Videos】

“Do not reveal spoilers about the latter part of the story in titles or thumbnails.”

Feel free to share as long as you adhere to the above! ※Reaching all endings takes approximately 6-7 hours.

games.name: Colored Pencil Bakery
games.shortDescription: A bakery management game where I grow wheat, bake bread, and sell it to animal customers. I run a bakery by making bread and selling it to animals in the forest.
games.aboutText:
Let’s Open a Cute Bakery

This game is a simple bakery management game made for people who just want to play a bakery game.
I bake cute and delicious-looking bread and sell it to animals living in the forest.

In this game, I can enjoy the following features.

- I grow wheat to gather ingredients

- I make dough and bake bread in the oven

- I place freshly baked bread on shelves and sell it

- I can make various kinds of bread, cakes, sweets, and dishes

The Customers Are Forest Animals

Let’s Bake Delicious Bread!

games.name: Homgard
games.shortDescription: Homgard is a cosy, story-heavy nonogram (picross) adventure set after the end of a fading world. Solve logic puzzles with new nonogram rules, reveal the map beneath, and piece together a vast, whimsical place that refuses to be forgotten.
games.aboutText:
The world has ended. Homgard can’t be saved… but someone still needs to do the paperwork.

You move through the broken world by solving logic puzzles, each one revealing a little more of what was lost. Along the way you'll find heroes who hit snooze on destiny, gods who went to get snacks and never came back, and apocalyptic cults arguing over font sizes. Apparently, this is considered normal.

The story is already over.

So why does the world still feel like it’s waiting for you?

FEATURES

Solve puzzles to uncover what remains
Complete nonograms (also called picross) to reveal 25 unique regions and open new paths. It’s a world that’s happy to let you wander at your own pace.

675 handcrafted puzzles, with 6 new mechanics
A large collection of carefully handcrafted puzzles, from small and friendly to large and strange. Classic nonogram logic is expanded with varied grid shapes and coloured cells that play by different rules. Every puzzle is solvable without guessing.

Let the story unfold
Discover hundreds of short written stories that you slowly piece together into a greater mystery: royal conspiracies, ancient secrets beginning to stir, time agents meddling where they shouldn’t… and someone who's clearly here just for the drama. Read as much or as little as you like.

Cosy by default, as challenging as you like
No timers. No stress. Take it slow. Use optional assist features for a relaxed session, or turn them off for a purer logic challenge. Adjust colour palettes and font sizes to suit your eyes.

Book 1 of a larger saga
This is the first book in a four-part series: a complete, self-contained story, with much more waiting beyond the edges.

An in-world radio
Six different stations, each with its own vibe. Calm, strange, occasionally perfect.

games.name: Can Your Otaku Cabinet Grow a Beautiful Girl?
games.shortDescription: Players will take on the role of a savior transported to a miniature world, rescuing flowers through battles and trials, protecting and caring for them, and embarking on a new harem life in a perilous fantasy world.
games.aboutText:
You've unexpectedly been transported to a "special world"—the Ita-Kiosk.

In this cabinet, you encounter anthropomorphic flower fairies, each with unique forms and alluring charm. Saving them is your mission, and seemingly "caring for" the flowers has become your job. But is it really that simple?

Gameplay

- Traditional survivor combat: A+B=C. Combine items to create powerful skills and boost your combat strength.

- Equipment during battles. Wearing combined equipment grants powerful attribute and skill boosts, making monster slaying a breeze!

Character

- Paeoniaceae - Peony

The beauty of the peony lies in its graceful and luxurious appearance, surpassing all other flowers. Its layered petals are as delicate as brocade, some large and full, some shy and jade-like, some charming and dignified. Swaying gracefully in the wind, it displays the delicate beauty of the king of flowers.

- Liliaceae

Lilies stand tall, pure white; hyacinths, their rich fragrance creating a purple mist; daffodils float on the water, their reflections shimmering; irises flutter like blue butterflies. Some stand tall, some droop; some exude a subtle fragrance, others are dazzling in color. Though their origins differ, they all weave a vibrant tapestry of poetry with their stunning beauty.

- Rosaceae

In the bloom of roses, the rose carries a seductive, subtle fragrance; the crabapple spreads its branches with grandeur; while the peach blossom, with its maidenly shyness, lowers its pink petals, hesitant to speak in the spring breeze. One alluring, one youthful, one graceful, together they weave a beautiful spring scene.

Special Gameplay

Beautiful flowers need gentle care; daily watering is essential. Cared-for flowers will unlock new statuses and animated storylines.

The special storylines are presented in an animated style, vividly showcasing the beauty of the flowers before us.

Each flower has its own unique style; some are gentle, some fiery, some dazzling, and some icy.

Welcome to savor the taste of these flowers—

games.name: UNHUMAN
games.shortDescription: UNHUMAN is a 2D idle extraction shooter set in a cyberpunk dystopia. Raid hostile zones, loot valuable gear, fight enemies before extraction, and craft powerful weapons. Progress through a deep skill tree, install augments, and transcend humanity. Start as a scavenger. Become UNHUMAN.
games.aboutText:
UNHUMAN is a 2D idle extraction shooter set in a cyberpunk dystopia. Deploy into hostile zones and watch your character automatically navigate, loot, and fight. Extract before you die, or lose it all.

CORE GAMEPLAY

Deploy into raids where your character automatically navigates between loot locations. Search containers, hack terminals, pick locks - each location offers different rewards. Click on any location to direct your character where to go next.

ENDGAME

Push to higher Corruption Levels in the Nullpoint Abyss, an endless map. Fight for the leaderboards, hunt chase items and get overpowered.

COMBAT

- Weapons have heat, jams, and recoil - your gear matters. Each weapon type plays differently: SMGs spray fast, Shotguns slide and blast, Bolt Actions hit hard but slow.

- Unlock gameplay-changing keystones like Chop Chop (hook and pull enemies), Bull Rush (charge and stun), or Degenerate Gambler (throw bottles, fight with fists).

LOADOUT & STASH

Equip your gear, pack items into your backpack for the raid, and manage your stash.

SKILL TREE

A massive skill tree with hundreds of nodes, 5 distinct classes, and gameplay-changing keystones. Create unique builds and theorycraft in plan mode.

TECH TERMINAL

Chips define your weapon's true potential. Use the Tech Terminal to upgrade your gear:

- Module items from raids let you craft random affixes.

- Codes let you choose exactly which affix to apply.

- Set up a Mining Rig to earn passive BTC - and occasionally discover rare codes while mining.

AUGMENTS & COMPANION

- Install and upgrade cybernetic augments to unlock abilities like Scan and gain massive stat boosts.

- Your dog companion detects enemies before they ambush you and fetches extra loot during raids.

INSANITY MINIGAME

A corrupted arcade buried inside your terminal. Click your way through the static and farm Insanity , the currency behind mythic power:

- Battle endless waves and bosses . The deeper you go, the more Insanity you claim.

- Rebirth to multiply your damage and health, then push even further.

- Spend your earnings on boosts, permanent upgrades, and auto-clickers that grind for you.

- Crack open caches for rare rewards when the reels line up.

TRADERS

Five traders, each with their own specialty. Complete quests to build reputation - unlock discounts, better bargain prices, and coin flip for better rates.

games.name: BuGarden
games.shortDescription: BuGarden is a cozy flower garden that lives at the bottom of your screen! Plant seeds, water and fertilise them at your own pace, harvest cute fruits and flowers, and swat some pesky bugs. No stress, no mess. A friendly companion moving at a snail’s pace.
games.aboutText:
BuGarden is a tiny garden in the corner of your screen, where lovely flowers sway happily in the sunlight you bring them! Plant seeds and watch them slowly bloom as you work, study, or just hang out with your little snail companion.

Use water and fertilizer to nourish your seeds. Feeling lazy? No worries – the little snail will help water them for you too! As your garden grows you’ll unlock new seeds and tools, and even decorations for your desktop.

Rest assured – since this is a desktop companion, you can hide all the annoying stuff with a single click, leaving only your favorite flowers quietly keeping you company.

Features:

- An idle gardening game that lives at the corner of your screen

- Friendly snail companion with customizable shell

- Unlock tools, seeds and decorations as your garden grows

- Distraction-free mode for when you need to focus

- No stress, timers, fail state etc.

games.name: Screams of the Abyss
games.shortDescription: Descend into the abyss, following the trail of a vanished expedition. Piece together their story through the recordings they left behind and uncover why none of them ever returned to the surface.
games.aboutText:
Screams of the Abyss is a first-person narrative horror game driven by a dark and oppressive atmosphere, where exploration gradually takes you from an expedition at sea to the remains of a forgotten world.

Story :

Following the trail of his grandfather and the stories he left behind, Arthur sets out to sea in search of a mystery that has remained unanswered.

His journey soon leads him in the footsteps of a vanished scientific expedition that ventured far deeper than it ever should have.

DESCEND INTO THE UNKNOWN

Aboard your submarine, continue your descent through an increasingly strange environment, where unsettling phenomena begin to emerge.

YOU ARE NOT THE FIRST TO DESCEND THIS FAR.

A team of scientists explored these places before you. Find the recordings, computers, and traces they left behind to retrace their journey and understand what they discovered.

DISCOVER A FORGOTTEN WORLD

Continue your exploration through these forgotten places and gradually uncover the truth hidden within them.

games.name: Fast Food Architect
games.shortDescription: At the dawn of American fast food, build and manage your fast-food restaurant. Create your burgers, coordinate service, and grow your establishment over the decades.
games.aboutText:
CREATE YOUR OWN FORMULA

Build a fast-food restaurant that reflects your vision. In this management and simulation game, layout, product creation, and day-to-day management are closely connected . Your decisions affect your establishment’s efficiency, customer satisfaction, and financial results. DESIGN AN EFFICIENT ESTABLISHMENT

Design your rooms, place equipment, and plan the layout of each workstation. A well-designed kitchen reduces travel distances and speeds up order preparation. Freely rearrange the space to try new layouts. CREATE YOUR OWN PRODUCTS

Choose the ingredients for your burgers, drinks, fries... Put them together your way and set their prices. Find the right balance between cost, appeal, and profit margin . MASTER SERVICE AND FINANCES

Organize your employees’ work, track orders, and adapt to changes in customer traffic. Monitor each day’s revenue and expenses, fix what slows your establishment down, and reinvest your profits. JOURNEY THROUGH THE DECADES

The adventure begins in 1916, at the dawn of American fast food. Over time, new equipment, new ways to order, and changing consumer habits will transform how you manage your fast-food restaurant.

games.name: Life Inc.
games.shortDescription: You’re 16 with €500. 💼 Choose from 23 career paths. 🏠 Buy and rent property. 📈 Trade stocks. ₿ Invest in crypto. Pay taxes, manage loans, build a company into a holding, and leave a legacy for generations to come.
games.aboutText:
You’re 16 with €500. No qualifications. No assets. No place of your own—just a room in your parents’ home.

Life Inc. throws you into an unforgiving financial simulator where every month counts. Start as a shop assistant, DJ or streamer. Build toward investment portfolios, high-volatility crypto, rental properties and your own corporation.

But be careful: status costs money . To earn like an executive, you have to live like one... and take the risk that one bad run of loans or taxes can leave you on the street.

Start at the bottom and rise through administration, technology, finance, construction, sales and more. Education, time in the role and lifestyle requirements stand between you and the next promotion.

- DJ: Master four specialized courses and 14 career stages, from bedroom sets to elite residencies and your own record label.

- Content Creator: Script, record and edit videos; ride trends without fatiguing your audience, hire writers and editors, and secure sponsorships.

- Football Career: Unlock in later generations. Manage training, nutrition, rest, goals, transfers and contracts on the road to legend status.

- Education has a cost: Rent doesn't stop while you complete vocational courses, degrees, master's programs or coding bootcamps.

Build wealth outside your paycheck, but don't mistake it for a passive-income button.

- Stock Market & Dividends: Trade 11 companies and 2 indexes. Earnings, momentum, payout ratio and fixed dividend payout months affect every stock.

- Six Cryptocurrencies: A standalone high-volatility market with no dividends and its own risk dynamics.

- Authentic Real Estate: Buy garages, land, offices, residential and luxury properties; select tenant offers, renovate to raise value and yield, take mortgages, and hire a property manager as your portfolio scales.

- Financial Advisor: Unlock the desk, pick a strategy, and fund an automated monthly plan.

Step off the corporate ladder: launch your own business, run daily operations, and scale it into a corporate holding.

- Choose suburbs, city centre or financial district: location changes rent, foot traffic and hiring capacity.

- Set pricing, suppliers, marketing, payroll and hiring. Staff skills grow; underpaying the market carries consequences.

- Actively manage employee compensation until HR takes over.

- Invest in R&D, balance quality with demand, and handle tasks yourself until your team can carry the load.

- Build a genuinely profitable enterprise.

- Automation and Exit: Integrate your company into a holding group for full automation, or sell when the valuation peaks.

Loans and mortgages can accelerate a plan; debt payments and interest can just as easily break it. File annual taxes covering salary, rent, stocks and company profits. Property sales incur capital gains. At higher wealth tiers, Solidarity Wealth Tax kicks in.

The question isn't just what you're worth. It's whether you can still afford next month.

As your portfolio pays off, collect art and antiques, watches and jewellery, vehicles and yachts, aerospace assets, private islands and megastructures. Certain items among the 125 pieces unlock only in later generations.

At year 50, receive a comprehensive balance sheet of your lifetime: revenue, expenses, taxes paid and property returns. Draft your will. Your heir begins a fresh life with inherited capital, your collection, and new long-term objectives.

Play the guided tutorial, freeplay sandbox or an 11-chapter Story Mode. Sergio reacts to what you actually do: your first eviction, bankruptcy warnings, skipping dialogue repeatedly, reckless clicking, and decisions you might live to regret.

- Single-player life & business management simulator

- Guided tutorial, sandbox mode and Story Mode

- 66 Steam Achievements

- English, Spanish, German, Russian and Simplified Chinese

THE QUESTION ISN'T WHETHER YOU'LL SUCCEED.

IT'S HOW.

START BUILDING YOUR EMPIRE TODAY.

By the way: Life Inc. is still in Early Access , so many more surprises are on the way. I read every comment on Discord and Steam and work hard to turn the community's best ideas into game updates. I hope to see yours soon!

Sergio García

Life Inc.

games.name: Shorekeeper
games.shortDescription: You wake up on a quiet beach with empty pockets and a whole island to call home. Grow crops, fish off the pier, dig for treasure and cook something warm at sunset. Feeling brave? The caves are waiting. Take it slow, the island isn't going anywhere.
games.aboutText:
You washed up on a sleepy shore with nothing but the clothes you're wearing and a slightly soggy sense of optimism. In Shorekeeper , that's plenty. Light a campfire, pitch a tent and turn a little patch of sand into a home you'll want to come back to every evening.

Grow Your Own Garden

Plant seeds, water them in the morning and watch your little patch come to life. Every season brings new crops, so there's always something to look forward to.

Catch of the Day

Cast a line off the pier, wait for the bobber to dip and time your pull just right. Sardines are easy. Tuna will make you work for it.

Chop, Gather, Craft

Chop palms, cut grass and haul stones back to camp. Turn it all into sturdier tools, warm meals and new bridges to the islands next door.

Dig a Little Deeper

The mines go down further than you'd think. Swing your pickaxe at copper, iron and sparkly gems, then make it back to your tent before you fall asleep on your feet.

Things That Rattle in the Dark

Skeletons climb out of their graves on the beach and bats hang around in the caves. Keep a sword handy. They're more rattly than scary, mostly.

Dress for the Island

Pick a hairstyle, an outfit and maybe a fancy pair of glasses before you set off. Island fashion has no dress code.

Little by Little

Level up farming, fishing, foraging and mining, follow quests across the island and sell your extra harvest for coins. The tide comes in either way.

games.name: Dragon Tribe Chronicles
games.shortDescription: An epic strategy deck builder RPG where You play as one of the last True Dragons. A shapeshifting being capable of harnessing the power of slayed beings.
games.aboutText:
An epic strategy deck-building RPG where you play as one of the last True Dragons, a shapeshifting being capable of harnessing the power of slain enemies.

Explore a variety of Dragon Tribes and craft powerful builds by combining elemental abilities into the ultimate deck.

Defeat lesser foes to gain power and earn the opportunity to challenge formidable bosses, each with their own story and unique power fantasy.

Level up and invest points into the Celestial Constellation passive tree to unlock, augment, and enhance different playstyles.

Collect powerful crafting materials and create your own unique card variants using the Dragon Forge.

Customize every card with our deep crafting system. Change its element, augment its effects, and empower its affixes to unlock powerful synergies. Immerse yourself in a vibrant world filled with original fantastical creatures and memorable characters.

Experience deep, strategic turn-based combat and become a legendary dragon capable of protecting the world or destroying it.

games.name: Sweepcremental
games.shortDescription: minesweeper, but with a skill tree.
games.aboutText:
a short incremental minesweeper game with a skill tree

2 hours that dont devolve into a grind at the end

Sweep Mines

Buy Upgrades

Earn Money

games.name: The Demon Party
games.shortDescription: The Demon Lord has vanished, and the Demon Lord’s Castle has fallen into chaos. Become Lethe, a demon girl, dominate defeated monsters, form your own Demon Party, and raise a new demon army!
games.aboutText:
The Demon Lord has vanished, and the Demon Lord’s Castle has fallen into chaos as monsters wage civil war for the throne.

Become Lethe, the Demon Lord’s younger sister, and wield the power of domination!

Defeat hostile monsters, dominate the useful ones, and form a party that will fight by your side.

Gather the monsters you have dominated to build and develop your own stronghold, making your party even stronger.

Lead your completed Demon Party, subjugate the monsters seeking the throne, and discover Lethe’s fate!

Lethe can use her power of domination on monsters defeated in battle.

Dominated monsters will follow your commands and aid you in combat.

Even powerful boss monsters are no exception. Subjugate threatening foes and turn them into dependable minions!

Subjugated monsters each have different stats, traits, and skills.

Protect your allies with a sturdy monster that has high Defense and a Taunt skill,

or entrust your party’s survival to a monster with high Magic and a healing skill. Each monster can take on a different role.

Target and dominate the monsters that suit your playstyle, whether for offense, defense, or support, and form your own Demon Party!

The more monsters you dominate, the more your stronghold will grow.

Raise your monsters, strengthen your party, and prepare items to aid you in battle.

Gather more minions, develop your stronghold, and raise a new demon army!

games.name: Empire Water Works
games.shortDescription: A steam engine simulator based in a water pumping station. Operate and maintain your pumping station day and night, maintain city water pressure and fulfill contracts. Interact with realistic steam, coal-firing, and audio simulation in a vintage setting.
games.aboutText:
THE STEAM ENGINE IS YOURS TO CONTROL!

You control the speed (RPM) of the engine, fine-tune the valve gear duration and ensure that lubrication is up to snuff! Running low on bearing oil can cause power loss and bearing damage; running out of steam cylinder oil can damage the cylinder walls, resulting in massive steam leaks and power loss.

PUMP WATER RELENTLESSLY!

Your steam engine exists to pump as much water as possible to the town's three reservoirs: Residential , Municipal and Industrial , with the help of your two massive water pumps downstairs.

Check the reservoir pressures and pump water to maintain their water pressure within the prescribed pressure thresholds.

But be careful! Trying to push too much water flow through the system can cause your water pumps to moan, groan, hammer and experience bolt failures...such failures will need attention ASAP, otherwise critical events such as flooding can occur.

PERFORM 'COLD AND DARK' STARTS

At the beginning of each shift, you'll need to raise boiler pressure and warm-up the massive steam engine's cylinders and clear them of condensate before you can turn it over! You'll also have the opportunity to keep the engine warm overnight by following certain procedures before locking-up the night before...saving you time the next morning!

KEEP EVERYTHING OILED

The main bearings, valve gear linkages, and cylinders all require oil. Do your rounds and don't forget to check the levels frequently!

LOOK AFTER YOUR BOILER

The boiler is the heart of your pumping station...it supplies precious steam pressure to your steam engine! Make sure you clean out the fire tubes and keep it topped-up with water - you don't want an unscheduled explosion...

YOUR TELEPHONE IS YOUR LIFELINE

The phone will be ringing off the hook! Receive over 40 unique telephone calls, everything from reservoir pressure issues and leaks/fixes, to prank/joke/'foamer' calls and 'advisory' calls based on your current situation.

You'll also use your telephone to order supplies such as coal and steam oil , to keep your pumping operation buoyant!

FULFILL CONTRACTS AND MAKE MONEY TO STAY AFLOAT

Don't let that phone ring-out...you might miss a lucrative contract! Successfully pump the required 'contracted gallons' and score funding, reputation boost, and merit points which you can use to apply upgrades!

FEATURES

- Faithful depiction of a 1920s-era steam-powered water pumping station

- Operate and maintain a massive double-expansion steam engine from the bygone era, pumping water to the town's residential, municipal and industrial water reservoirs, to maintain sufficient water pressure

- Perform realistic 'cold and dark' startup procedures such as warming cylinder jackets and filling oil lubricators to ensure minimal wear on cylinder liners, main bearings and other components

- Interact with vintage machinery like boilers, generators, water pumps and bilge pumps

- Fine-tune your steam engine's operation, by adjusting the steam regulator, valve gears and boiler water feed

- Operate advanced steam equipment such as a jet condenser

- Perform maintenance on equipment such as cleaning boiler fire tubes and monitoring lubrication levels

- Monitor supply levels such as coal and steam oil and place orders in advance to replenish these before they deplete

- Complete event-based 'contract' challenges to supply reservoirs with a given amount of water and receive funding and reputation bonuses in return

- Earn 'merit' points which can be used to apply a range of upgrades to the pumping station

- Experience realistic audio recorded from a real vintage stationary steam engine

- Deal with critical events such as varying levels of reservoir leaks, steam leaks, flooding and machinery damage, including cylinder wear and boiler explosions

- Work a realistic day or night shift with a moving day and night cycle over 24 in-game hours

- Deal with ever-changing 'edicts' from the Mayor's office which impose variable conditions on how much water you can pump (whilst still dealing with water demands from the township!)

- Keep records about the running of the pumping station in your ledger - but be careful to ensure the records are accurate!

games.name: SONIC PICO PARK
games.shortDescription: The co-op action puzzle game series PICO PARK is back... and this time, we're teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! This collaboration is packed with co-op gameplay that combines the flair of Sonic with the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK! Play locally or online with 2 to 8 players!
games.aboutText:
Sonic dashes into the world of the hit indie game, PICO PARK!

Experience the multiplayer co-op action puzzle gameplay of the PICO PARK series like never before! In our latest entry, the PICO PARK series is teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog!

SONIC PICO PARK is a 2D action puzzle game where cooperation is essential!

The rules are simple: just reach the goal plate on the right side of each stage. But the only way to succeed is for everyone to work together.

This exciting crossover lets every playable character use Sonic's iconic Spin Dash, while adding classic Sonic-style gameplay elements such as rings, loops, and springs! Team up with your friends and take on these new challenges together!

Just like the rest of the series, the game supports 2 to 8 players locally or online. All content can be enjoyed with any number of players! Online play also supports cross-play, and up to 7 local players can join online from a single PC.

Combining the flair of Sonic and the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK, this one-of-a-kind collaboration is packed with fun for everyone... whether you experience it with family, friends, your partner, or even new teammates you meet online!

Gather your squad and try it today!

games.name: Escape from Ashville
games.shortDescription: Loot, fight and extract — or lose everything. A high-risk extraction shooter focused on survival, tactical combat, and meaningful decisions.
games.aboutText:
Escape From Ashville is a 3D extraction shooter focused on survival, tactical combat and high-risk decision-making. Enter dangerous zones, face deadly threats and secure valuable loot — but remember:

If you fail, you lose everything you brought with you.

Explore a Hostile World

Outside your shelter, there is no safety. Abandoned locations are filled with hostile factions, unpredictable enemies, and scarce resources. Each area offers multiple routes, constant threats, and rewards for those willing to move forward.

Manage your supplies, explore ruined environments, and adapt to situations that can change in seconds.

Fully Destructible Environments

Walls can be breached, cover can collapse, and entire areas can be reshaped during combat.

Use destruction to create new paths, expose hidden enemies, or force your way through blocked locations. Every firefight changes the battlefield, turning the environment itself into both a weapon and a threat.

Loot, Survive, Extract

Find weapons, gear, medical supplies, and valuable items. Everything you carry matters—death means losing it all.

Extract successfully, improve your loadout, and prepare to push into increasingly dangerous zones.

Solo or With Friends

Play solo or team up online with up to five players. Coordinate movements, share resources, and cover each other—because a single mistake can cost the entire mission.

Surviving together is easier… but the risk is shared.

Prepare or Die

Modify weapons, manage your inventory, and carefully choose what to bring into each expedition. Space is limited, and preparation often matters more than raw firepower.

Every run brings you one step closer to survival.

games.name: Big Dig
games.shortDescription: Big Dig is a short incremental narrative game about digging up artifacts to help Mayor Dog win the election! Recover artifacts, grow your museum, and upgrade your tools while building a highway across the Animal Republic!
games.aboutText:
Big Dig is a short incremental narrative game about digging up artifacts to help Mayor Dog build a highway across the Animal Republic!

Mayor Dog 's campaign is in full swing! He needs YOU to dig out any pesky historical artifacts in his way!

Mayor Dog 's highway will stretch through beaches, suburbs, lakes, middleschools, and more! Unfortunately, the land is filled with wonderous artifacts that Mayor Dog desperately needs removed.

As the road grows, so will your need for seriously capable tools. You can hire a crew of helpers, get new equipment like an excavator, and renovate your museum for increased profits!

You will get to showcase all the mysterious artifacts you find along the way, from tennisballs to dinosaurs! As the museum grows, you'll be able add decoration, new rooms and more!

Big Dig is created by two indie devs with some help from their friends! We're making Big Dig because we wanted to take a beloved genre and add a meaningful narrative with a (hopefully) satisfying conclusion.

A Short, Sweet, and Complete Experience

Big Dig is designed to be played in approximately 3-4 hours , perhaps even in a single sitting . It does not feature infinite prestige loops or time-gated idle grinding. It tells a complete story with a proper conclusion that'll make you laugh along the way.

games.name: Chef Knight
games.shortDescription: Cook what you kill in this cozy fantasy incremental game! Dive into dangerous dungeons, harvest fresh monster ingredients, and serve delicious dishes to hungry adventurers. Slay, cook, sell and upgrade your way to a sprawling dungeon-food empire!
games.aboutText:
Chef Knight is a cozy fantasy incremental game where monsters aren’t just enemies – they’re ingredients.

Dive into dangerous dungeons, defeat monsters to collect fresh ingredients, return to your kitchen to cook delicious meals, then sell your dishes to upgrade before your next run!

Explore top-down dungeons filled with monsters both deadly & delicious. Aim your attacks, dodge dangerous traps, and unlock powerful culinary weapons to handle the darkest depths of the dungeon!

Turn your spoils into scrumptious dishes back in the kitchen. Discover new ingredients, unlock recipes, and watch your monster cuisine grow from simple meals into highly sought-after delicacies!

Sell your dishes to passing adventurers and reinvest the profits into powerful upgrades from a vast skill tree. Improve how fast you fight, how efficiently you cook, and how far you can push each run!

games.name: ZeroPrompt
games.shortDescription: Every NPC in this game runs on a local LLM. Ask them anything. The internet is dying. You're a internet moderator. Filter out AI impostors from humanity's last clean network. Use investigation tools to detect deception. Every verdict shapes the internet.
games.aboutText:
In ZeroPrompt , you are a Verification Operator for the Megacorp called Syndicate. Your job is simple: verify accounts and control who gets to exist on the internet.

The internet is drowned in spam, ads, and AI-slop garbage. Syndicate is trying to clean the internet. As an Operator , you stand at the gate. Ban AIs, restore access to humans, and keep the network clean.

Engage with hand-crafted NPCs that are driven by live LLMs .Use investigation tools, logical traps, and document analysis to separate humans from machines. Deal with panicked refugees, corporate spies, or malfunctioning bots that argue, plead, and deceive.

Ask questions and analyze responses for machine-like patterns. Cross-reference documents, trace IPs, and search for inconsistencies. Accept humans, decline suspicious cases, or terminate confirmed AI threats.

100% Local. 100% Private.

- All AI models run locally on your machine . No cloud, no lag, no data collection.

- Your conversations never leave your device.

- No internet required after download.

- Requires 6GB VRAM .

games.name: Little Lilicia
games.shortDescription: A full-fledged farm life sim where you live as a rancher, socialize, and find love with heroines in the town of Kokotan, home of the Forest Goddess. Step into the shoes of the protagonist, Philo, who becomes a rancher by chance, and revitalize the run-down farm.
games.aboutText:
About Little Lilicia

Tend to crops, care for animals, go fishing and gathering, or explore the mines.
Enjoy a peaceful farm life while getting to know a cast of quirky characters
in this comprehensive farming simulation game.

Story

Philo (name changeable) moves to Kokotan for a fresh start.
However, due to a misunderstanding by Misty, the mayor's daughter,
the town assumes he has moved there specifically to revitalize the farm.

Philo had planned to live as an ordinary resident,
so he tries to explain the mix-up, but faced with Misty's beaming smile,
he can't bring himself to say no and reluctantly begins his life as a rancher.

As he deepens his bonds with the townspeople,
he gradually starts to feel that life on the farm isn't so bad after all.

Life as a Rancher

Plow the earth, sow seeds, water crops, and harvest your produce.
You can also raise chickens, cows, and sheep to collect fresh animal products.
Venture outside to gather herbs in the mountains, fish in the river, or mine for ore.

Romance girls and interact with the other residents

Deepen your intimacy with the 7 romanceable characters through conversation and gifts.
As you grow closer, you can ask them on dates and eventually become a couple.
Kokotan is home to over 20 unique characters.
Experience special events that reveal surprising new sides to your neighbors.

Romance Candidates

games.name: Taco Stand
games.shortDescription: A horror game where you manage a taco stand. Make tacos, serve customers, and get through each night.
games.aboutText:
Taco Stand is a psychological horror game where you run a small taco stand late at night.

Take orders, serve tacos, and get through your shift.

Add sauce to the tortilla, grill it, then fold it to complete each taco correctly. Follow customer requests carefully and keep the stand running smoothly through each night.

Customers arrive with different orders and attitudes. Some are impatient or rude, but it’s your job to take their requests, serve them quickly, and keep the line moving.

As each night passes, you start to see and hear things. It only gets creepier and scarier.

Is this happening inside your mind, or something else?

Controls

WASD — Move
Mouse — Look around
E — Interact

For Content Creators

You are fully allowed to create videos or streams of this game.
Monetization is 100% allowed , and content is encouraged.

games.name: Memories Loaming
games.shortDescription: A horror anthology about people working along a remote highway in Labrador, Canada. Try to remain balanced and lucid at your normal job. Also, there's a bear.
games.aboutText:
An Ancient Cosmic Evil Lives Along a Stretch of Highway in Labrador

In this horror anthology, you play as different people navigating a dramatic day in their lives while dealing with an ancient cosmic evil that lives along a forgotten stretch of Canadian highway. The game is divided into sections, each titled with a month.

In NOVEMBER: Warren works as a maintenance worker for remote facilities ever since he lost his job at a chemical reprocessing plant during an accident. Sixteen years later, Warren is winterizing a small regional airport and feels the familiar influence of the entity. He must complete his tasks anyway.

In OCTOBER: Jamie works as a forest ranger stationed along a stretch of highway close to an abandoned chemical reprocessing plant. During his first week, his boss tells him to head down the road to investigate some odd lights reported in a nearby sinkhole.

Features:

- An elaborate, physics-based tripping and falling system to give fast and frenetic chases

- Multiple perspectives on the strange entity that lives in the basin, experience the story through many witnesses

- An openly explorable remote Labrador location

- Your character's sanity is affected by looking at and experiencing unsettling events and a low sanity will couple into other systems, causing you to stumble, drop what you're holding and attract monsters

- Ten endings (in the demo, more in the full game)

- Questionably functional navigation equipment

- A terrain system that couples to the physics-based movement mechanics

- Learn the story a little bit more each time you come back and try another run. The airport shifts and changes with you.

- Bear

Keep Your Character Balanced and Lucid

An in-game balance system manages your gait, steadiness and ultimately how you fall over. You must take care of your psyche, too. The creatures in the area seem especially attracted to elevated emotional states.

There are ten different endings in the demo (more in the full game) that can be awarded based on how good you are at facing your fears and completing your job.

Each time you play the game you might earn MEMORIES, and if you acquire the right ones, you'll change the environments in subtle ways, unlock new enemies and learn the truth of Yetman's Basin. Eventually, even you might be remembered, too.

Also, there's a bear.

Manage your balance (mental and physical):

Recreate the classic Canadian experience of having a complete mental breakdown because you slipped on ice while taking out the trash. There's an involved balance system involving posture, terrain and gait, coming together to make frantic chases through the ice and snow as well as a sanity system that is influenced by the things you see or encounter.

Explore mode:

If challenging chases doesn't sound like your thing, there's also another complete mode designed around a slower more atmospheric experience. Here you can focus more on the cosmic horrors that are making your airport winterization job inconvenient rather than getting knocked down from stepping a shovel.

What is this thing that lives in the Basin?

The settlers called it a god, Doctor Moon calls it an illness, Victor calls it an investment and the analysts call it a Class O intrusive pattern. None of them are exactly wrong but I cannot bring myself to say they are right either.

Whatever we call it, one thing is clear: it must be closely monitored. The FCG analysts say it is now sleeping but that if the contagion were to spread it would constitute a civilization-ending threat. I'm not inclined to disagree with them.

In the DEMO, you can play the complete NOVEMBER story. In the FULL GAME, you can play the complete anthology (on launch I'll have two stories but I have some additional ideas).

What to expect in November:

Winterize Mealy Mountains Regional Airport. Complete a list of tasks before your shift ends. Try to survive. November is a standalone story set roughly a month after the main game's events.

If you play once: Expect a 15-30 minute ghost story. Your goal is simple: make it to morning and leave. We can't have a repeat of last year, Warren.

If you return: Expect a challenge. Winterizing the airport will not be easy and you'll need to understand more than you do now. Find out why you still feel.

What to expect in October:

A single night on a remote stretch of Canadian highway. Try to locate a missing person. Explore an open forest in Labrador with many threats and limited means to fight back - survival means avoidance, preparation, and knowledge.

If you play once: Expect a one-hour survival experience. Your goal is simple: make it to morning and escape via the rescue helicopter.

If you return: Expect a deeper mystery. The puzzles are designed for note-taking. Multiple endings unlock as your understanding grows.

Be careful that you don't bring something back with you.

Yetman's Basin, Labrador

"Yetman's Basin is an especially geologically anomalous region of the Canadian Shield. The ro

games.name: Trust Me, I Nailed It
games.shortDescription: <Trust Me, I Nailed It> is a turn-based strategy game where you edit video clips to make a screwed up warrior into a monster-slaying legend. Edit, stitch, and fake your way to epic battle videos. Make every fight look like a glorious win.
games.aboutText:
The world wasn’t saved by the hero’s blade, but by the editor’s mouse cursor.

You are a dedicated video editor tasked with manipulating battle footage of a hopeless warrior who can’t clear a dungeon. Hired by a warrior with no skill but endless ego, you must produce flashy “clear videos” that make it look like a flawless victory.

Analyze pre-battle intel that reveals enemy attack patterns, then place the warrior’s limited action clips on a timeline to write a scenario where victory is inevitable.

Satisfy both the cheering townsfolk and the dopamine-addicted Demon Lord, complete a fake heroic legend in seven days, and save the world.

Design the Win Before the Battle Begins

In the video editor, enemy attack patterns and disruptive actions are provided as pre-recorded footage.

Before the battle begins, players preview the timeline to identify exactly when attacks will occur and plan their countermeasures accordingly.

Clip Editing

Design the warrior's movements by placing 「Move」,「Melee Attack」,「Ranged Attack」, and 「Block」 clips onto an 8-tick timeline.

Visual Effects (VFX)

The highlight of editing is post-processing! Instantly transform a simple walk into a Teleport, or turn a weak jab into a Critical Hit to overwhelm your enemies.

Running low on memory? Don’t worry! Meet optimization goals such as "Fill All Timeline Slots," "Land 2+ Effective Hits," or "No Damage Taken" to increase your available memory capacity.

A Story Told Through FAKE Clear Videos

Enjoy the stark contrast between the warrior’s shameless request emails and the hero-worshipping news that pops up on your desktop.

In reality, the so-called hero is always running away—but turning them into the savior of the world through a nerve-wracking con is entirely up to you.

games.name: EXE.CUTOR
games.shortDescription: EXE.CUTOR is a game where you place data blocks to complete lines. Acquire various equipment and enhance your data blocks to build stronger lines and defeat virus hosts infesting cyberspace!
games.aboutText:
In the lower districts of a cyber city, a professional cleaner duo—the player and Hammy —receive an off-the-record request from the head of the data center.

A viral infection has begun to spread across the entire city. With no official response possible, they activate their custom-built execution system, EXE.CUTOR , to deal with the threat.

Place data blocks to complete lines and eliminate corrupted AIs and their hosts one by one!

Strategic combat built from data fragments

Place data blocks on an 8×8 grid and rotate 4×4 areas to complete lines. When a line is completed, equipment activates, triggering attacks, defenses, or various special effects.

The fun of equipment choice and synergy

Each piece of equipment has its own tier and category, and combining them creates powerful synergies. Which equipment to prioritize and which category to build around is entirely up to the player. Sometimes, a well-matched combination can change the battle more than a single powerful item.

An execution system that grows through choice

Gain equipment and data blocks through battles and stage events. Through recovery, enhancement, and decision nodes, carve out your own path of growth.

games.name: Legend of Idle
games.shortDescription: In this short incremental game, you must rebuild your kingdom! Gather resources, construct numerous buildings, and set out to conquer everything with your army! A game in the style of the SNES!
games.aboutText:
Rebuild your Kingdom!

Starting from zero you slowly build up your kingdom! With every upgrade your buildings

grow and bring visual changes!

Gather many resources!

Recruit little guys to gather resources automatically! The more you build and conquer, the

more you gain!

An army to conquer it all!

Rebuild your army to fight monsters and capture dungeons! Slowy the map opens up for you

with many new paths!

A Prestige System!

Restart and spend your earned points for various upgrades! Every run will be faster

and you will get further every time!

Become the mightiest ruler and build the greatest castle!

- An active short incremental game

- Meta Progression

- A lot of Upgrades and Exploration on the Map

- A definite end (and happy end)

games.name: Win the Date
games.shortDescription: A deckbuilder roguelite about gay dating. The dating world can be cruel. Don’t let those guys crush your self-esteem. Crush theirs first!
games.aboutText:
Win the Date is a single-player card game about going on dates.

Who are you?

Choose one of three personalities, each with its own playstyle.
Overwhelm them with your strength, never give them an opening with endless chatter, or predict their next move and use it against them.

Ready to date?

Pick your date and sit down for a card battle. Prove you’re the better man, shatter their self-esteem, and leave with yours intact.

Share energy

Control the tug-of-war energy system. Every card you play pushes the marker toward their side. The more you spend on your turn, the more they have on theirs.

Keep playing

After you've finished the game there is more to find, keep exploring the world of Win The Date, overcome tough challenges, gain decorations for your profile and find hidden surprises.

The "Queer & Weird"

At Bearly Fun Games we explore the queer experience. We experiment with how game mechanics can complement queer experiences, or be queer themselves.

That's how Win the Date was born. It’s a card battler, but it’s also a mirror held up to the ridiculous, painful, and hilarious reality of modern dating.

May the worst man win.

games.name: FISH
games.shortDescription: FISH is a Platformer Run & Gun Shooter where you play as an armed FISH violently exploring through multiple levels. The game features a funny, unique stylized artstyle that could get a chuckle out of you!
games.aboutText:
"Killer Fish!!"

FISH is a Platformer Run & Gun Shooter where you play as an armed FISH violently exploring through multiple levels. The game features a funny, unique stylized artstyle that could get a chuckle out of you!

Gameplay:

As an armed FISH , your duty is to kill as many enemies and smack up that BOSS ! At the end of each level you will be awarded with MONEY you can use in the next level to purchase deadly firearms!

Features:

"What does this game about a peculiar little armed fish have to offer me?" Well, it’s packed with some seriously awesome and rad stuff like:

- Fish With Gun.

- Awesome Weapons.

- Weird but unique artstyle!

- Fun classic Run & Gun gameplay!

- Terrific Bosses ..

- And more!!

games.name: Jibbers
games.shortDescription: Physics-driven ski game with fully simulated bodies and flexible skis. No trick buttons. Control, timing, and motion earn every move. Full customization, tunable physics, community maps, multiplayer.
games.aboutText:
What is it?

A physics-driven ski game focused on control and realism:

- Fully physics-based character and ski simulation

- Free, analog-style controls that are hard but intuitive

- Tricks are earned through motion and timing, not button combos

- Realistic body dynamics for setting tricks

- Full collision with terrain and objects

- Flexible, physically simulated skis

Current State

The project is in active development. Patreon-supported playtesting and early access are planned.

Planned Features

- Deep Customization: clothing, skis, poles, custom grabs & stances

- Extensive physics and feel tuning options

- Community-made custom maps

- Multiplayer

- Snowboards & Monoski

games.name: Starlight Farm
games.shortDescription: Build your pixel farm: sow seeds, tend crops, unlock rare qualities, and turn harvests into better tools. Explore the valley and meet its villagers through stories and commissions. Text available in Simplified Chinese, English, Russian, and Korean.
games.aboutText:
Start with a patch of soil

Sow seeds, water your crops, and bring home the harvest. Sell your produce, buy supplies, and plan what to grow next as the seasons change.

A little star makes a harvest special

Crops come in Normal, Silver, Gold, and Purple Star qualities. Keep harvesting each crop to unlock rarer qualities, then record your prized specimens in the crop guide.

Grow into better tools

Work your way from wooden tools to Purple Gold equipment. Explore the forest and mine, gather materials, and visit the smithy to prepare for your next day on the farm.

Get to know the valley

Visit the villagers, listen to their stories, and help with their commissions. Between harvests, follow the paths beyond your farm and find your place in this small pixel world.

games.name: Resonant
games.shortDescription: Transcend bodies, time, and worlds. In this narrative hybrid of Point & Click Adventure and 2D Platformer, you are a formless Traveler. Shift between post-apocalyptic ruins and neon cyberpunk cities. Solve puzzles, master platforming challenges, and unravel the nature of consciousness.
games.aboutText:
Beyond Bodies. Beyond Time. The Journey Begins.

RESONANT is not just a game about jumping between two worlds. It is a journey through the fabric of reality itself. You are a Traveler , a consciousness drifting through time, space, and hosts, guided by a shapeshifting narrator who watches your every move.

In this nostalgic hybrid of Point-and-Click Adventure and 2D Platformer , you solve puzzles, fight for survival, and uncover a deep narrative about the nature of existence.

Do you like what you see?

The development of RESONANT is a journey filled with passion by a solo developer.
If you want this project to become a reality:

Please add it to your wish list!

This helps enormously in gaining visibility. Thank you for your support!

The Demo: The First Rift

In the demo, you experience your first major jump. Torn between a rusted Post-Apocalypse where nature reclaims the ruins, and a cold, neon-drenched Cyberpunk Dystopia, you must navigate the glitch in reality. But this is just the beginning. The full journey will take you much further.

Key Features

- Genre-Fluid Gameplay : The soul of a 90s adventure meets the mechanics of a modern 2D action-platformer. Switch between investigative Point & Click puzzle-solving and reflex-based platforming.

- A Multiverse of Mystery : What is consciousness? Can machines truly feel? Remnant weaves a complex web of philosophy and sci-fi lore, filled with nods to real-world mysteries like John Titor and the IBM 5100.

- The Traveler : You are not bound to one form. Throughout the full game, you will slip into different bodies and timelines to find the answers you seek.

- Fully Voiced : Experience a complete English voice-over with a narrator who changes forms as often as you change worlds. (Subtitles available in German).

- Atmospheric Pixel Art: Handcrafted characters in pixel art environments bring the distinct atmospheres of every timeline to life.

- Achievements for explorers: Explore hidden secrets and collect Steam Achievements for your collection.

For Seekers of Truth

RESONANT is built for players who love atmosphere, classic adventure games and story. If you enjoy deep lore, hidden references to internet mysteries, and questions about where technology is leading us, step into the Rift.

games.name: HELLEVATOR
games.shortDescription: `·.¸¸.·´´¯`··._.·Welcome to the Hellevator·._.··`¯´´·.¸¸.·` Hellevator is a ballet hell (with an “a”) RPG. Your job is to deliver food to our most valued guest. How hard can that be?
games.aboutText:
`·.¸¸.·´´¯`··._.· Welcome to the Hellevator ·._.··`¯´´·.¸¸.·`
