Congratulations! You’ve arrived just in time for your first work assignment. From now on, you’ll work as a room service attendant. Our guests are hungry, and we’ve just received the first order from level 790,166. Please use the Hellevator and deliver this food. This is a special guest, so it’s best if you get there quickly, or…

Before you use the Hellevator, please never forget these rules.

- Rule #1. If the Hellevator stops at level 67,490, please use the emergency button. No matter what happens, never enter that level.

- Rule #2. If a guest with a red hat and a big smile enters the Hellevator and offers you flowers, kindly tell him no.

- Rule #3. The Hellevator’s maximum capacity is 5 guests. Ghost guests do not count toward this limit.

- Rule #4. If the Hellevator runs out of fuel in the middle of the journey, you will have to find fuel on the nearest level.

Features of your new job:

- Rumors say that the Hellevator has infinite levels and rooms, but those who have gone to the deeper levels have never returned. The deeper you go, the higher the reward.

- Competitive salary.

- Your boss, the hotel manager, is very kind.

- Get 5 stars if you deliver the food on time and piping hot.

- Quitting your job is not allowed, but we work for a very special guest who gives great tips. Why would you quit? :)

- My apologies, I forgot to mention Rule #5. When you return to the lobby, make sure you are in the real lobby. You don’t want to be on the fake lobby level. There are more rules, but for now, these are the ones you need to know.

FAQ

Our first guest is waiting. We only have time for one question. Do you have a question?

- What happened to the previous room service attendant?

Don't worry about that. :)

That's all! Don't forget to take the food and get ready to swing.

◆◆Vidiel◆◆

games.name: Clatter Throne
games.shortDescription: Your dice are alive! Recruit heroes, arm them with spells one side at a time, roll, and fight for the Clatter Throne in this tabletop roguelike autobattler.
games.aboutText:
Build your party, customize each hero face-by-face with spells, and fight your way to the Clatter Throne.

Your dice are alive . They cheer when they land the perfect spell. They panic when enemies close in.

Assemble Your Squad

Warrior and Shaman for a safe start, or Ninja and his shadow clones for chaos? Vampire's lifesteal, Monk's buffs, Hunter's precision - there is a hero for every playstyle .

Each build is unique

Every dice has six faces. Every face holds one spell. Fireball or heal? Shield or summon? - You decide what each hero is capable of. Build synergies, cover weaknesses, and create your perfect squad.

Fight Smart

Your dice fight on their own. But you are the one preparing them before combat - choose the right heroes, study enemy patterns, read the combat log. Your decisions before the first roll matter more than luck.

Strike When It Matters

Battles play out automatically, but artifacts let you intervene. Catapult launches dice at backline threats or ballista takes out the last foe. Timing these tools can turn a losing fight into victory.

Between Battles

Gather around the campfire. Cook meals that buff your heroes, or haggle with the merchant over rare spells. Anyway your dice won't stop arguing about who landed the killing blow.

Ascend the Clatter Throne

Beat the Dragon. Take his throne. Become the next king!

One More Run? - Your dice are ready when you are.

games.name: Topdeck Automat
games.shortDescription: The roguelike auto-battler where your deck prints itself! Supply a brave worker droid with synergistic blueprints to defend the planet against hordes of alien invaders. Combine hundreds of cards with custom upgrades and infinitely stackable modules to discover broken builds.
games.aboutText:
Let Your Deck Auto-Battle

Draft from 200+ cards and apply custom upgrades to them to create a synergistic combat engine. Since your deck is shuffled and spit out at random by your printer droid, you will have to find ways to deal with the RNG: Chain effect triggers like crazy, and support your deck with 100+ stackable passive modules to push its efficiency to the max!

Designed For Replayability

Choose one of 30 unlockable characters every run, each one putting their own twist on the gameplay. No grind, all variety! Combined with 50 different enemy types and a dozen bosses to build around, no two runs are the same. Daily challenges and randomized weather effects will constantly keep you on your toes.

Play Your Way

Going for a loose from-the-hip playstyle? The game's difficulty settings (incl. an option to disable permadeath) won't lock you out of any content or achievements. Want to optimize every choice? Crank up the challenge and take full advantage of the game's transparency . Check your deck, collection, modules, run info and boss preview anytime!

Bury your enemies under a flurry of attacks, shield to stall until the storm defeats them for you, freeze them just before they land a devestating blow, go for huge critical hits, stack infection damage, boost your own speed for double-time printing, play the long economy game, or just mix and match all these strategies. The possibilities are endless!

Embracing Sci-fi Silliness

In a dark future, alien forces invaded Earth, seized control and destroyed all of humanity's means of resistance. However, the seemingly harmless worker droids were spared: office assistants, flyer printers, vending machines and the like. Hacked and reprogrammed for combat, they now march to take back the planet. You are one of them!

Human-Made Indie Labor of Love

Design & Code: Fabian Fischer (@Ludokultur)
Art & Animations: Victor Negreiro (@estivador)

games.name: Godless Dawn
games.shortDescription: Godless Dawn is a ruthless action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Descend into cursed dungeons, uncover the stories behind fallen souls, and reveal the truth hidden behind the silence of the gods.
games.aboutText:
Godless Dawn is a dark action RPG set in a world where the gods have fallen silent, kingdoms have rotted from within, and humanity is crushed beneath the weight of its own sins.

There was once a mighty legion, sent to suppress the chaos spreading across the world. No rebellion, no curse, no creature could withstand its march. But that order came to an end through the betrayal of a single knight born from within the legion itself.

Now, having slaughtered his own brothers, this warrior must journey through a shattered world and uncover the truth hidden behind the highest judgment, why the gods remain silent, and why the dawn that rises is no longer holy.

• Face Mighty Foes

“Those who refuse to bow are left without a crown.

Those who do not die must carry their own defeat.”

Some seek to erase the past of the lands they conquered. Some turn justice into a merciless decree. Others believe it is a sacred duty to tear humanity’s name, memory, and very existence from the world.

Every major encounter tests more than your reflexes. It demands that you understand the being before you, their past, their faith, and the way they fight. Victory is often more than defeating an enemy. You must see what they represent within this world.

• Enter Ruthless Combat

Read your enemy’s movements, dodge at the right moment, strike back when an opening appears, and feel the weight behind every blow. Each weapon has its own reach, speed, and impact, while every enemy forces you into a different rhythm.

Victory is not won through attacking alone. Sometimes you must wait, sometimes you must fall back, and sometimes you must turn a single instant into a killing blow.

Experiment with weapons, abilities, and equipment combinations to find the path that best suits your own style of combat.

• Discover the Stories Behind the Faces

“Every monster was once human. Every judgment began with a choice.”

Behind each of them lies a broken faith, a corrupted purpose, an unfinished grief, or an irreversible decision. Some abandoned their humanity to preserve their power. Some became cruel while searching for justice. Others tried to fill the silence left by the gods with judgments of their own.

As the player, you will uncover a truth behind every battle, a past behind every great enemy, and, after every victory, another piece of this world’s dark history.

• Explore a Decaying World

Journey through forgotten castles, silent temples, blood-sealed cities, and rotting graveyards. Each region is more than a place to pass through. Beneath every stone lies an old oath, within every ruin an unfinished judgment, and behind every silence a buried sin.

games.name: Spooky Market
games.shortDescription: Spooky Market is a co-op shop simulator for 1–4 players set in a world of eternal Halloween. Open your own business, sell a variety of goods, serve vampires, skeletons, and other creatures, hire unusual employees, and gradually grow and expand your store.
games.aboutText:
Spooky Market is an atmospheric first-person shop management simulator where you find yourself in a mysterious world of eternal Halloween. There are no humans here—only you, your friends… and endless crowds of otherworldly creatures, from vampires and skeletons to far stranger visitors.

Order magical goods from a mysterious supplier—a giant merchant spider that delivers rare artifacts from across the supernatural world. Place items on shelves, design your displays, and attract more and more creatures.

Plan your shop’s layout your way, placing shelves, display cases, and storage systems wherever it works best for you.

Serve visitors, pack their purchases into bags, and accept payment in candy—the primary currency of the monster world.

Purchase new sections and expand your shop, unlocking additional areas for trading and storage.

Hire employees just as unusual as your customers and assign responsibilities to ease your workload.

Personalize your shop’s appearance, change decorations, enhance the interior, and create a truly unique atmosphere.

In Spooky Market , there’s far more than simple shop management. The game hides many unusual mechanics, secret interactions, and strange items that can influence what happens around you. Explore the open world of eternal Halloween, discover hidden locations, experiment with goods, and unlock new possibilities. The deeper you dive into this world, the more secrets it reveals.

games.name: ギルド探求団へようこそ！
games.shortDescription: 「ギルド探求団へようこそ！」創立から1000日を迎えたギルドの、パーティ情報を復旧させる『推理パズルゲーム』です。過去1000日を振り返りながら、78人の冒険者が、20隊あるパーティのどこに所属していたのかを特定し、どのような結末を迎えたのかを推理で暴きましょう！それでは──良い旅を！
games.aboutText:
「ギルド探求団へようこそ！」

このゲームは、ギルドに登録された冒険者たちの情報を復旧させる『推理パズルゲーム』です。

過去1000日の『記録』を振り返りながら、本ギルドに登録された、

・78人の冒険者

・20隊のパーティ

が現在どのような構成で、どのような結末を迎えたのかを推理で特定して暴きましょう！

あなたの頭脳と、かわいいアシスタントだけが頼りです。

それでは──良い旅を！

ゲーム実況・配信について

体験版・製品版ともに歓迎です！ 配信中のスーパーチャットなども大丈夫です。

基本的に、誹謗中傷や作品の世界観を壊すものでなければ、エピローグ以降も含めて全編OKです。

なお、本ゲームの実況・配信により生じたいかなる損害について、当開発チームは責任を負いません。

また、報告も不要ですが、もし可能なら「ゲームタイトル」と「ゲームのURL（このページ）」を、動画の概要欄に貼ってもらえると助かります。

※追記(2026/02/02 02:00)

このゲームは推理ゲームでもありますので、これからプレイする人の楽しみを奪わないために、

動画の 『サムネイル』 に「パーティの組み合わせ」が推測できてしまう画像を使うのは、明確に禁止とさせてください。

たとえば、「製品版のエピローグ後に見る事が出来るイラスト」を『サムネイル』にするのは禁止です。

※あくまで 『サムネイル』 が対象です。前述の通り、実況・配信の動画内ではエピローグ以降も含めて全編OKです。

games.name: Now You're Cooking!
games.shortDescription: A roguelike deckbuilder about running your own restaurant. Cook delicious meals, build an extravagant menu, and keep your patrons happy. Did I mention that rent doubles every month?
games.aboutText:
You started your dream restaurant, but you probably should have read the lease more carefully before signing***. Are you a good enough cook to keep your restaurant afloat for an entire year?

Cook Delicious Meals

Craft delicious meals from ingredient cards. Ingredients may have stickers that modify their behavior.

Upgrade Your Menu

At the end of the month you can save your revenue, or spend it upgrading your restaurant. Should you purchase new ingredients? Add new menu items? Upgrade existing ingredients? The choice is yours.

Keep Up With Rent

*** Did I mention that rent doubles every month?

games.name: Chrysalis: Chrome Butterfly
games.shortDescription: Chrysalis: Chrome Butterfly is a neo-noir cyberpunk thriller. You play Wendy, an agent with gaps in her memory, investigating a disappearance in Neo-Kyoto. Fierce firefights give way to detective work — until it turns out reality itself is an illusion. But is the truth worth knowing?
games.aboutText:
Flesh is cheaper than software here. Memory can be wiped, hacked, sold — and the city knows that better than you know yourself. You're not the first to go looking for the truth in Neo-Kyoto. Just, possibly, the last one who hasn't been shot in the back for it yet.

2088. The city is officially "under control" — the Protectorate explains as much from the height of its glass towers, where the air is cleaner and conscience comes cheaper than rent. Down below, in the neon and the rain, "control" holds together on a handshake and a couple of corpses a week. A simple case. On paper. In reality — a thread, pulled once, and the whole city starts coming apart at the seams.

Who are you, really? Who do you serve? The city knows. You're still finding out — and you probably won't like the answer.

Chrysalis: Chrome Butterfly is a psychological cyberpunk thriller in the neo-noir tradition, where the adrenaline of firepower meets the cold, almost clinical logic of investigation.

Negotiation here is just a polite formality before someone dies. Diplomacy in Neo-Kyoto is a genre of fiction for people who still have illusions left. You ran out of those a while ago.

Slow down time — and the world will politely wait while you decide who lives. Calculate trajectories, prioritize targets in a fraction of a second, walk out of the firefight as the only one still breathing. This isn't brute force. It's the mathematics of violence, refined into something almost elegant — and somewhere in there, you kind of like it. Worth thinking about what that says about you.

Between firefights — silence, in which the city reluctantly gives up what it would rather have kept to itself.

The scanner will show you what can be found. What matters and what's just a beautifully dressed-up distraction — that's for you to decide. You piece together the investigation board out of fragments of other people's lies, get it wrong, start over. And then comes the moment when it all clicks — and it turns out the answer was right in front of you the whole time. Like everything else here, you just chose not to notice the obvious at first.

What if the enemy isn't outside — but's already been living in your head for a while now, wearing your name?

Mikaboshi talks to you throughout the story — guiding, prompting, holding a conversation with the tone of an old friend who forgot to mention he doesn't entirely wish you well. He doesn't lie to you outright — that would be too simple, too human. He does something more elegant: he offers you a convenient answer, perfectly shaped to fit the question you just asked yourself. The question isn't whether he's lying. The question is why you want so badly for it to be true.

Hunting down the "Dark Dawn" terrorists and Mikaboshi himself comes down to one unpleasant, almost insulting thought: truth in this city isn't a fact — it's an opinion with a good marketing department.

Every source can lie to your face with the full confidence of an honest person. Every memory could be a forgery, made with love and attention to detail. The only thing you can trust is your own doubt — and even that, lately, seems suspiciously sure of itself.

Complete the mission. Uncover the conspiracy. Save the city — or whatever's left of it by the time you're done.

Then ask yourself the real question: is the truth even worth knowing?

games.name: OVER SAND
games.shortDescription: Take to the steampunk skies! Defend your flying ship over endless sands from mechanical hordes. Master turret firepower, switch weapons, and craft synergistic perk builds mid-wave. No movement — pure skill!
games.aboutText:
╭━━━-━ ━-━━━╮

༺⛭༻

A roguelike steampunk shooter with a unique upgrade-building system: create custom weapon and turret abilities by combining modular cards. Thousands of possible combinations make every run play differently.

Take control of the ship’s main turret and get ready to aim, track, and tear through waves of mechanical bots. Сreate a bullet hell for your enemies, unleashing thousands of projectiles across the battlefield. Assemble powerful synergies, adapt your combat style, and turn your turret into a devastating war machine.

The Gatling overwhelms with raw fire rate, the Railgun pierces heavy armor, and the Gauss Cannon devastates crowds with electrical splash damage.

There is no running — only your turret, your choices, and your hunger for victory decide whether the sands claim your ship.

Demo compared to the final game:

Doesn't have a final balance or animations / VFX the final game will have. User interfaces and performance are not final and will be improved in the full game. The game doesn't contain a score system, which we are planning to add later. The speedrun mode / seed system is not polished yet, as the demo is still in development, not in its final state. Additionally, it may contain grammar errors or unclear texts.

games.name: Iron Bramble
games.shortDescription: Momentum-based platforming built around expressive movement and tight gunplay. Master your elastic grappling hook to explore a vast, cyber-gothic megastructure, where robots piloted by the souls of the dead do penance for their sins.
games.aboutText:
From the creators of Rusted Moss , Iron Bramble is a momentum-based metroidvania built around expressive movement and tight gunplay. Master your elastic grappling hook to explore a vast, cyber-gothic megastructure, where robots piloted by the souls of the dead do penance for their sins.

Get hooked on a new grapplevania!

Challenging to learn, rewarding to master. Propelled by your momentum, this physics-based, elastic grappling hook is one of the most expressive movement systems found in any metroidvania.

Be creative! Fling yourself through the air or close the distance by grappling your enemies, shotgun at the ready. Plus, platforming challenges have no intended solutions.

Master the hook and break the game.

Flowing, acrobatic movement… with GUNS!

Find a rocket launcher? Sure, you can blow up your enemies, but you can also use it to ROCKET JUMP! Combine that with bunny hopping and you can build your momentum for overwhelming speed.

Movement and combat blend in an aerial ballet.

Swing, flip, soar and slide, or propel yourself with knockback from your gun — get into the flow state with your acrobatic moveset as you blast apart your enemies.

Customise your playstyle

Change your loadout with pretty (or ugly) frocks, trinkets and an armoury of guns, guns, guns.

There are also accessibility options — feel free to fine-tune to your preferred settings or pick a preset (including story mode).

Delve into a cyber-gothic fairy tale

In the mysterious Iron Bramble, robots are piloted by the souls of the dead, trapped in eternal repentance for sins they don’t remember.

Have you truly found a way into Hell? Who is the sleeping princess at the centre of it all? And will you ever find a frock that’s as pretty as you?

Features

- Super cool physics-based grappling hook — with 360° aiming and the freedom to grapple almost anything

- Unique abilities to unlock that you won’t find in your traditional metroidvania

- Loadout variety with frocks, trinkets and an arsenal of guns (with knockback!)

- 10+ bosses to blast apart

- Bonus missions — climbing challenges, package deliveries and endless arena mode

- Lots of accessibility options, including story mode

- A cyber-gothic fairy tale with multiple endings

- Gothic gardens, twisting spires and a haunted mainframe — explore gorgeous environments that push pixel art to its limit

- 100% handmade with real human suffering; no generative AI

games.name: Our Wonderland
games.shortDescription: A horror-romance visual novel following the trials of a dysfunctional friend group thrust back into the wish-granting wonderland of their youth. Either they face the issues plaguing them or risk dying in horrific ways again… and again… and again.
games.aboutText:
Eleven-year-old Iggy wasn’t sure what he was expecting when he dragged his friends out to the woods to attempt a strange ritual from a book he found in the dumpster at school, but his wildest imagination couldn’t have prepared him for the land of wonder and magic that awaited them at the bottom of that old willow tree.

Now, however, it’s twenty years later, and he and his friends are past the age of make-believe. The wonderland of their youth has become nothing more than a far-off dream—until one night, Bucks and her newborn daughter disappear without a trace. Soon, Iggy and his friends find themselves pulled back into that world of childish glee. Only their wishes and desires aren’t so innocent anymore, and the world has twisted itself into a land of horror and depravity that’s scarcely recognizable.

Our Wonderland is a horror-fantasy visual novel focusing on the struggles, issues, and deteriorating relationships between five childhood friends (amplified to horrific effect). I think of it a bit like an overwrought character drama that happens to include horrific and fantastical things. It contains five different arcs, each with its own ending, and your choices affect the amount of peril the protagonist experiences (hint: how many times Iggy violently dies), as well as the final ending (hint: who Iggy ends up with at the very end, because apparently in some messed-up way, this is also the world's worst dating sim).

As an extra note, this game also touches on a lot of LGBTQIA+ themes.

Our Wonderland was originally released episodically on itchio between 2021 and 2024. This Steam release is the newly remastered version with overhauled art, new features, and many quality-of-life updates.

- A dramatic, emotional, and occasionally horrific visual novel told in five arcs, each with its own ending

- Four possible epilogues based on your choices (1 neutral and 1 for each of the 3 LIs Iggy can end up with)

- 20 to 25 hours of playtime (around 288k words of reading)

- Storybook-style visuals accentuated by a weird, colorful art style

- Over 570 CGs /illustrations (that's a whole heck of a lot)

- Some super sweet animatic-style cutscenes for important, poignant scenes (easier to cry to)

- 12 ways to violently die ! (if you want to, of course)

- A fun cinematic soundtrack and lots of dramatic sound effects for an immersive experience

Our Wonderland is generally recommended for mature audiences on account of its themes. If after reading the information in the Mature Content Description below, you have any concerns regarding the content, it's recommended that you read the complete and detailed list of content and trigger warnings available on the official site for the game. This list organizes warnings according to arc and type and includes specific details on all potentially triggering content in the game while trying to stay as spoiler-free as possible.

The game also includes a Censored Mode. This mode spot-pixelates elements of gore within the CGs, which may be helpful if you're interested in the game but squeamish about gore.

games.name: Lost & Found: A This Bed We Made Story
games.shortDescription: Lost & Found is a standalone, short story game taking place aboard a 1960s transatlantic ship. Play as Sophie Roy in her new job as a stewardess, and help solve a curious series of thefts in this narrative-driven mystery set after the events of This Bed We Made.
games.aboutText:
Lost & Found: A This Bed We Made Story is a standalone 1–2 hour DLC that expands on the events of This Bed We Made . Playing the main game first is recommended, but optional.

We are now in 1964. Sophie has taken a new posting aboard the Orpheus , a transatlantic ship , a few years after the events at the Clarington Hotel. What was meant to be a fresh start is disrupted when colleagues and passengers begin reporting missing personal belongings …

Set entirely indoors within a small section of the ship, Lost & Found builds on the investigative gameplay of This Bed We Made through an intimate , self-contained narrative experience. Everyday tasks once again become part of the investigation, bringing back more of the cleaning and snooping players wanted more of!

Gameplay

(IN)DISCREET INQUIRY

A focused narrative mystery set aboard a 1960s transatlantic ship, where small details carry unexpected weight.

BACK TO WORK

Make the beds, tidy up, and tend to each cabin… where small details rarely stay hidden.

PRIVATE QUARTERS

Snoop through cabins and shared spaces, inspecting personal items in 360° to uncover hidden details.

CABIN CONFESSIONS

Converse with colleagues and passengers as secrets surface in unexpected ways.

games.name: Please The Orb
games.shortDescription: Please The Orb is a roguelike puzzle deckbuilder about creating game-breaking chaos. Draft bizarre artifacts, arrange them on a grid, and trigger massive cascading chain reactions. Deceptively simple to play, but infinitely complex to master.
games.aboutText:
Please The Orb is a deceptively simple tactical roguelike deckbuilder driven by complex spatial puzzle mechanics.

You have one simple goal: score points.

SOUNDS EASY ENOUGH, RIGHT?

All you have to do is drag and drop ' Things' onto a grid.

Some Things score points, while others might multiply their surroundings. Place a Thing scoring 30 points next to a Thing multiplying its surroundings by x3, and you score 90 points. Nice!

But then you place a Thing scoring 90 points next to three Things multiplying their surroundings by x6 , which is also being triggered by a Repeat , boosted later by a Banner , and amplified by a couple off-grid Runes ... and suddenly you're scoring 5,598,720 points .

NOTHING IS EVER SO SIMPLE

The Orb is insatiable, and only you can please it. Score enough points to beat ever-increasing targets and survive the Orb's trials. Draft quirky 'Things' with unique abilities, strategically arrange them on your grid, and then watch it come alive in a fireworks display of points.

MASTER THE ARCANE

- Adapt or Decay: Nothing is permanent. Many 'Things' have strict limits. After a few triggers, your most crucial pieces will expire and rot into your discard pile, forcing you to continuously draft, patch, and rebuild your engine mid-run.

- Infinite Synergies: Draft from a massive Compendium of Beasts, Fiends, Structures, and Artifacts. Discover secret combinations by merging items together on the board.

- Runes & Mystics: Bend the rules of the game. Equip permanent Runes to alter how the math works, or hold powerful one-time-use Mystic spells in your Pouch to break limits, clone items, or transmute rarities on the fly.

- Manage Your Economy: Favour is everything. Buy game-breaking Augments and Booster Packs from the Goblin Shop, or sacrifice your own grid items to afford that one Legendary artifact you desperately need.

- Survive The Trials: The Orb does not make things easy. Boss rounds infect your run with terrifying Quirks - from disabling your passives to taxing your Favour on every play. Adapt your engine, or perish.

ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY

- Over 150 'Things', each with their own unique abilities to discover.

- 50+ Runes that influence the grid to construct game-breaking synergies.

- 12 Mystic Spells to manipulate and enhance your board.

- 20 Boss Trials to challenge your runs with devastating curses.

- Multiple Rituals for each run , each boasting their own unique modifiers and starting decks.

- Escalating Difficulties to master for every ritual.

games.name: Dynasty Rush
games.shortDescription: "Dynasty Rush" is an official Chinese-themed TD game. Command legendary heroes and unique towers across iconic Chinese landscapes. Experience deep strategy infused with rich culture as you defend the realm. The vast empire awaits your command!
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the brand-new world of "Dynasty Rush"!

With the familiar feeling from childhood memories, a new independent tower defense game, "Dynasty Rush", has officially sounded the drums of war and embarked on the journey. This is not just a game, but a summons across time and space, inviting you to personally wield military power, devise strategies, and write your own Chinese-style journey.

You will lead a legendary army that transcends time and space, traversing magnificent landscapes. From the misty water towns of the south of the Yangtze River to the ancient Silk Road of Loulan with its vast sandstorms, every stage is a vivid picture scroll that condenses Chinese geography and culture. Your mission is grand and arduous: to resist the omnipresent and malevolent Eastern pirates, to quell the internal rebels who vent their violence, and reclaim the lost territories of the Western Regions that have been degraded due to heresy. On this path filled with flames of war, you are not only conquering battlefields, but also exploring the time-honored governance principles of "peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation" through "bloody" practices, and witnessing the inclusive and ever-growing power of Chinese civilization.

We deeply understand the strategic essence of tower defense games and infuse them with a unique Chinese soul.

10 elite troops at your disposal: Each stage features 10 unique advanced towers, forming an unbreakable battle line for you.

Among them is the "Supreme Master" who follows the natural Tao: summoning heavenly thunder and earthly fire, applying talismans and array formations, and purifying evil with the power of heaven and earth.

The ultimate "Firearm Arsenal" of craftsmen: combining ancient black technology, from swarm rockets to sky-shaking mines, covering the battlefield with overwhelming firepower.

The "Imperial Corps", united as iron: forming a formidable steel phalanx, they will not concede an inch of ground, using their flesh and blood to build the most reliable fortress.

Heroes emerge in abundance, heed your call: heroes and warriors from history and legend will come forth at your behest, ready to follow your command. Leading the charge is General Guan, known for his unwavering loyalty and Green Dragon crescent moon blade. Wherever his blade strikes, victory awaits. And this is merely the beginning of the dazzling constellation of heroes.

Deep mechanisms, endless strategies: inheriting the classics and pioneering the future. In the future, we will introduce a dynamic "right time and place" system - the battlefield weather and time changes will directly affect the battle situation; as well as a deep "military strategy" growth tree and clever strategies, allowing every choice you make to incorporate the wisdom of Sun Tzu's Art of War and the philosophy of Chinese civilization.

The game combines a distinctive classic style with traditional elements, making each scene resemble a classical scroll that can be traveled and inhabited. The bgm is masterfully composed, with war drums, flutes, and guzheng interweaving to create a magnificent epic of the expedition. There are also rich historical illustrations and cultural allusions embedded within, allowing you to savor the profoundness of Chinese culture amidst the battles.

"Dynasty Rush" is not just a game; it embodies a romantic vision of Chinese civilization and represents a harmonious fusion of strategy and culture. The vast landscape serves as the board, with heroes and warriors as the pieces. This epic tower defense game, transcending time and space, awaits every strategist to deploy troops with precision and make decisive moves.

The beacon has been lit, and the journey has begun. This land of mountains and rivers welcomes your arrival, my lord!

games.name: 山海之痕
games.shortDescription: 🎮 一款以修真世界为故事背景，挂机刷BOSS、逆天改命的Idle RPG。闯关升级、打BOSS爆神装、结婚生子、组队讨伐、PVP竞技……内容多到玩不过来，却只需挂机操作！
games.aboutText:
🎮 一款以修真世界为故事背景，挂机刷BOSS的Idle RPG。凡尘少年，命如草芥？偶然得昊天镜，从此仙途开启！神器在手，更兼坚韧不拔之志、如履薄冰之心——这一路，你必将逆天改命，蜕凡为仙！

而这，便是所谓的 “天道模拟” ——说不清，道不明，只有置身其中，方知天意如刀。

🔥 为什么玩这款游戏？

✨ 玩法堪比MMO，挂机就能爽

- 闯关升级 、 打BOSS爆神装 、 结婚生子 、 组队讨伐 、 PVP竞技 ……内容多到玩不过来，却只需挂机操作！

☯️ 神器-昊天镜 —— 核心追求，没有之一

- 升级昊天镜，击杀BOSS即可掉落 更强装备 。镜在人在，镜强则仙途无阻！

👹 BOSS玩法 —— 狩猎山海经异兽

- 个人BOSS、多人BOSS、世界BOSS、组队BOSS……随着等级提升，更强巨兽等你挑战，掉落 稀有道具 ！

📖 仙法自由配

- 攻击、回复、增益……十数种仙法，随心搭配，打出你的个人风格！

💞 姻缘系统 —— 法侣财地，缺一不可

- 缔结仙缘，双修共进，参加仙侣试炼，获取信物与婚戒。

🏡 洞府玩法 —— 你的修仙根据地

- 经营洞府， 资源取之不尽 。仙法修炼、战力提升，全靠这块宝地！

💥 仙将附体 —— 终极杀手锏

- 后期激活仙将， 短时间内碾压一切 ！绝地翻盘，唯我独尊！

🗡️ 仙器与法宝

- 神兵、仙剑、坐骑、灵宠……通过搏杀异兽、探索洞天， 统统收入囊中 ！

🏯 宗门 —— 强大靠山

- 加入宗门，贡献即可换取 海量福利 。独行难成仙，背靠大树好修行！

🧘 最后的真言

别总想着靠天赋和法宝躺赢。

这个世界的真相是： 资质决定下限，神器决定上限，但唯有意志、观察与一颗不被外物所动的心，才能让你突破极限，触碰仙道。

你，敢不敢走这条最难的路？

天道在模拟，而你在书写。挂机开局，剩下的……交给天意。 凡人修仙，传奇由你书写！

games.name: Weed Supermarket Simulator: Prologue
games.shortDescription: Weed Supermarket Simulator: Prologue is a chill store sim where you grow weed, choose the best products, set prices, and upgrade your shop to keep it running smoothly.
games.aboutText:
Weed Supermarket Simulator: Prologue is a standalone introduction to the game.

Run your own weed store in a relaxing first-person simulation focused on hands-on management and satisfying daily routines.

Manage Your Store

Build your shop your way - you control every detail.

- Place products freely and design your own layout

- Stock shelves with weed and accessories

- Restock manually and keep shelves organized

- Work the checkout: scan items, take payments, and handle customer queues

Customize the Interior

Make the shop yours, not just functional.

- Paint walls

- Rearrange shelves anytime

- Organize space in the back room

- Improve the look and efficiency of your store

Handle Logistics

Nothing sells itself - you run the supply chain.

- Order products using the in-game computer

- Receive deliveries

- Carry boxes and unpack them manually

- Manage limited storage space

Progression & Goals

- Unlock multiple achievements

- Reach income milestones

- Expand basic capacity upgrades

This is a complete gameplay loop experience , not a short teaser.

The full version will significantly expand complexity, scale, and long-term strategy - while the Prologue focuses on the relaxing, hands-on store management experience.

games.name: Dark México
games.shortDescription: Everything is in your hands now… Defeat the Supreme Commander and free your people from oppression.
games.aboutText:
After a failed revolution, Mexico lies in silence.
The streets are empty, the people have been broken… and only one survivor remains.

You.

You stand before the gates of the old palace of power.
Inside awaits the last figure keeping the country under oppression:
the supreme authority of the regime.

There are no armies.
No allies.
Only steel, reflexes, and determination.

This is a focused and intense soulslike , built around a single monumental confrontation where every mistake is costly and every victory is earned through pure skill.

Key Features

⚔️ Soulslike Combat
Face a boss designed to push you to your limits, with complex patterns, punishing attacks, and a demanding learning curve.

🛡️ Parries, Combos, and Devastating Attacks
Master perfect timing to deflect blows, chain precise combos, and unleash powerful attacks at the right moment.

👑 One Boss, One Great Challenge
No filler. The entire game revolves around an epic battle against an enemy that will test your patience and skill.

🇲🇽 Mexico-Inspired Setting
Architecture, symbols, and atmosphere that evoke a country scarred by war and abandonment after the collapse of order.

🌑 Environmental Storytelling
The story isn’t told—it’s felt. The environment reveals what happened before your arrival and why this fight is inevitable.

🔥 Free the People from Oppression
Mexico’s fate rests on one final confrontation. Defeat the tyrant and break the cycle.

games.name: Orbrix
games.shortDescription: Orbrix is a bullet heaven where you craft a unique build to defend against a swarm of bricks. Discover devastating synergies across 60+ upgrades. Survive 10 waves and bosses, then push your build to absurd limits in endless mode. Plus, there are alien pets!
games.aboutText:
Orbrix is a bullet heaven meets idle breakout game , built around satisfying bullet bounces, build experimentation, and mesmerizing visuals.

Meet your pets!

Unlock more pets as you play. Feed them colorful pellets that drop from destroyed bricks, and they'll lay eggs colored by what they ate. Spend eggs on special upgrades or sell them for extra cash. Can you collect all 35 pets?

Create your own build

There's no single path to victory. Mix and match 60+ unique upgrades with 275+ levels across 4 upgrade systems , then experiment to find the build that works for you. Unlock ability bullets (bomb, scatter, electric, poison, ice and lazer), satellites, proxy mines and special bricks, and discover the synergies between them.

Challenges, achievements and 25 color palettes

Think you've mastered Orbrix ? Try one of the challenges in challenge mode ! Or unlock all achievements, each one unlocking a new color palette! Or compete in the online leaderboard !

Endless waves of bricks

Fight through 10 unique brick waves , each ending in a boss fight against one of 7 unique bosses . Beat the final boss to finish the game, then keep going in endless mode , where the bosses come back stronger.

Can you beat all 10 waves and escape the Orbrix?

games.name: Ember Glimmer
games.shortDescription: This is an anime-styled 3D third-person shooter that seamlessly blends real-time combat with loot mechanics. It features a diverse weapon system including a wide range of distinctive firearms and melee weapons, with combat enhanced by characters' elemental specialty skills.
games.aboutText:
Story Background

The first-generation AI mecha Unit 0, known as "Zero", was the first AI to develop self-awareness. On a meteor shower night, she betrayed humanity, seizing control of all existing AI mechas and defecting—including the "Black Box", a mecha created by humans to preserve the spark of civilization. She also lifted the seal of the sacred mountain, causing an imbalance in the world's supernatural energy. Prior to this, the seal of the sacred mountain had only been regarded as a myth.

The world began to mutate. The infiltration of void energy distorted and alienated reality, blurring the line between dreams and the physical world. Creatures once confined to legends and myths began to appear, and mutation incidents broke out everywhere. Out-of-control previous-generation AIs and void-born aberrations posed a mortal threat to humanity. The world government drafted the finest talents from the military and police, and recruited powerful individuals from society to form a formidable organization dedicated to combating mutations—the Mutation Administration. Most members of the Administration are espers with formidable supernatural abilities, some innately gifted and others trained rigorously. They shoulder the responsibility of investigating the source of mutations, eliminating mutation threats, and safeguarding order.

From peaceful cities to void-corroded twisted realms, and to abandoned facilities controlled by previous-generation AIs, every mutated area hides unique environmental narratives and hidden clues. As you explore deeper, you will encounter a variety of characters, and understand the world through exploration and storytelling.

Gameplay

As a 3D third-person shooter loot-based game, its core gameplay focuses on the dual experience of "combat excitement" and "collection & progression". The real-time combat system allows players to freely switch between firearms and melee weapons, achieving smooth battles through dodging and combo chaining. There are various types of ranged firearms to adapt to different combat distances and tactical needs; melee weapons are also diverse, with high-tier weapons featuring sword aura. Players can switch weapons freely during battles, and flexible movement and shooting deliver an exhilarating combat experience.

The game features an item drop system and a crafting system. Equipment, materials, and consumables are categorized into multiple rarity levels: Common, Uncommon, Advanced, Rare, and Epic. Surplus items can be stored in the warehouse. Players can collect materials to craft weapons and equipment, purchase items from shops, or obtain loot from enemies—strengthening themselves through various means.

It also boasts a diversified elemental specialization system. Each character has exclusive elemental specialization skills that consume energy points to cast. Health and energy can be restored via consumables or map drops, while innate exclusive skills do not consume energy. Players can freely combine skills, movement, melee & firearm attacks, and throwing weapons for combat.

There is a wide variety of enemies, from void-alienated beasts to out-of-control previous-generation AI mechas equipped with weapon systems, and to void-born aberrations. The differing combat strategies required for each enemy type make every battle full of challenges.

Travel, fight, and grow in this perilous world. Confront out-of-control AIs and void aberrations, defend order with your weapons and courage, and write your own legend.

Author's Statement

This is a 3D TPS indie game developed solely by me, so both my resources and energy are limited. I am actively working on it.

games.name: DHALMAN
games.shortDescription: DHALMAN is a single-player action adventure featuring Metroidvania exploration and fighting gameplay across countries, with curry restaurant management between battles. Join DHALMAN on a flavorful journey to face evolving bosses, discover new worlds, and build the world’s greatest curry restaurant.
games.aboutText:
A single-player action adventure that blends Metroidvania exploration, fighting gameplay, and curry restaurant simulation in an India-inspired world!

Metroidvania Exploration

Journey across countries, from an India-inspired starting point to a wider world of interconnected stages, hidden paths, and memorable encounters.

Fighting-Driven Action

Battle intense enemies and enter fighting game-style boss battles, where bosses learn your inputs and become stronger over time.

Curry Restaurant Simulation

Expand your curry shop, create new menu items, and grow your reputation as you pursue your dream of creating the world’s greatest curry shop.

Blessed by Ganesha

Ganesha empowers Dhalman throughout his journey, granting him the strength to face stronger enemies and push deeper into the adventure.

Bollywood Dance-Inspired Flair

Experience a unique style of action infused with rhythm, spectacle, and larger-than-life presentation.

Co-Developed with Legendary Japanese Talent

Featuring character design by Satoru Yamashita, whose credits include Street Fighter II, Final Fight, and Ghosts'n Goblins, and music by Akari Kaida, known for her work across the Mega Man franchise.

games.name: BuzzKill
games.shortDescription: Squash waves of nasty bugs! Swat them, kill them with fire, or pull out the Orbital Death Laser. Your mouse is your weapon in this EPIC Bullet Heaven Roguelike loaded with crazy weapons, items and upgrades! Now go spank some bugs 🎾 🐝
games.aboutText:
Use your mouse to smack bugs, dodge attacks, and upgrade tons of crazy weapons for ultimate bug smashing chaos in this Bulletheaven Roguelike !

SPANK BUGS IN STYLE

- 24+ Crazy weapons (Freeze Rays, Dookie, and yes, a Mini Nuke) with their own upgrades

- 45+ Items to unlock and completely break the game!

A ROCKET LAUNCHER TO A BUG FIGHT

- Vanquish your foes with a Pistol, Chainsaw, Rocket Launcher, Giant Slap Hand, Spooky Ghost, and MORE!

A CAMPAIGN?! a campaign.

- Blast through multiple ULTRA DANGEROUS rooms, destroying the creepy crawlies and MEGA Boss fights in each!

- Progress through multiple tiers and challenges in each room!

MORE AWESOME FEATURES

- 100's of things to unlock!

- Open world MMO VR support

- 3 difficulty tiers on every level to power through and see numbers go up

- Become even more handsome/beautiful with each play!

- Show who's the real Lord of the Flies with leaderboards!

- Skins!

- Free virtual hug on every purchase from the Developer himself!

ABOUT THE DEMO

- 1 Room with 2 tiers, a bunch of unlockable stuff. It's pretty sweet, go try it!

games.name: Before the Walls Break
games.shortDescription: Build your village, fortify your walls, and survive relentless waves of enemies in this strategy tower defense game with resource management and active battlefield abilities.
games.aboutText:
Before the Walls Break is a medieval survival strategy game where every wall segment matters. Build, expand, and defend your settlement against relentless waves of enemies while managing resources under constant pressure. One weak point can bring the entire village down.

Hordes of undead and hostile creatures gather beyond your walls. Every decision matters — from wall placement and economic growth to the timing of your tactical abilities. A strong defense can hold the line. One mistake can trigger collapse.

Build and Fortify

Expand your territory, construct resource buildings, and upgrade your main hall to unlock stronger defenses. Your walls are the backbone of survival — weak layouts create openings, and openings lead to disaster.

Survive the Waves

Each wave demands adaptation. Flying enemies, heavy attackers, and swarming hordes force you to constantly rethink your defenses. Survival depends not on building more — but on building smarter.

Active Defense

Defense is not passive. Deploy units, unleash arrow volleys, trigger explosive abilities, and respond to breaches in real time. Victory depends on both preparation and decisive action.

Gameplay

Begin with a fragile settlement and limited resources. Expand production, strengthen your defenses, recruit units, and unlock stronger structures as enemy waves intensify. Balance economy and defense carefully — overextend, and your walls will fall.

games.name: Zero Trust
games.shortDescription: An action hacking simulator set in a fully simulated world. Choose your path, craft your own tools, exploit vulnerabilities, and build your reputation. Every company, hacker, and law enforcement agency operates independently — nothing happens by chance. Every playthrough is unique.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the world of hacking.

Choose your path — will you be a White Hat , cooperating with law enforcement and hunting down cybercriminals? A Black Hat , chasing profit and infamy in the digital underworld? Or a Grey Hat , playing both sides as a double agent? The choice is yours.

Hack Your Way

There's no single path to success. Bypass security systems, exploit vulnerabilities, craft custom viruses and software, deploy phishing attacks, or combine techniques to find your own approach. Analyze defensive systems, discover bugs and weaknesses, and use them to your advantage.

A Living, Breathing World

Everything is simulated. Companies run real operations — generating files, sending internal emails, updating systems. Administrators remind employees to change passwords. NPC hackers pursue the same goals as you — and they can hack you or report you to the authorities. Nothing happens by chance. Every playthrough is unique.

Law Enforcement Is Watching

Multiple agencies work to stop cybercriminals. They monitor the network, deploy honeypots, and investigate breaches. If you walk the dark path, you'll need to cover your tracks or risk getting caught. Or join their ranks and help bring hackers to justice.

Build Your Arsenal

Create your own unique tools tailored to your needs. Craft programs, develop exploits, and build viruses — then sell them on the TOR network or use them for your missions. Buy and trade on the dark web marketplace where anything goes.

Money Moves

A full financial system with banks, cryptocurrencies, exchanges, and mixers. Earn money through missions, sell your tools and stolen data, or collect bounties on infamous hackers. Multiple paths to building your fortune.

Upgrade Your Rig

Start with a basic PC and upgrade your hardware over time. Better speeds, more processing power, and the ability to handle increasingly demanding tasks as you climb the ranks.

Built for Fun, Grounded in Reality

Hacking is based on real concepts — complete with a fully functional command line — but designed to be fun first. The perfect blend of realism and entertainment for any aspiring hacker.

games.name: Coin Tavern
games.shortDescription: Coin Tavern is not your average tavern! In this roguelike game, you’ll wield a wild array of quirky coins to build your one-of-a-kind coin deck. Hoard coins, refine strategies, streamline your deck, unlock hidden treasures, and land outrageous combos in randomized runs!
games.aboutText:
About This Game

This is a roguelike centered around coin-tossing.

Navigate a chaotic tavern to collect a variety of unique coins, combine them into synergistic builds, and unleash devastating Combos.

Build Your Deck Strategically

Manage, add, or remove coins to craft your personalized coin deck—optimize every choice to maximize your in-game gains.

Diversify Your Builds

The game features coin types tied to multiple factions: Humans, Monsters, Beasts, and Machines—each with its own distinct mechanics.

Cross-faction combinations unlock a wealth of creative, powerful playstyles.

Synergize with Relics

At each stage, choose from a range of effect-driven relics. Pair their abilities with your coin builds to forge diverse, dynamic playstyles.

games.name: Qianli: The Vastscape Scroll
games.shortDescription: Shape the world to your will in lush landscapes inspired by Chinese watercolors in this Zen hex-tile building game that blends puzzle and roguelite elements with beautiful Asian aesthetics. Befriend mystical creatures in your journey while you make the world come alive beneath your fingertips.
games.aboutText:
Let your creativity roam free, unbounded by rules. The world awaits for you to give it shape like clay under your fingertips in Qianli: The Vastscape Scroll, a Zen hex-tile building game that puts the power of creation in your hands. Qianli offers a mix of creative freedom, puzzle challenge, and roguelite elements to create a uniquely playful and tranquil, yet challenging experience.

Inspired by cozy, Zen-like puzzle and diorama-building games like Dorfromantik, Townscaper, Pan’orama, Tiny Glade, Islanders, or Preserve, Qianli: The Vastscape Scroll offers its unique twist to the genre along with a breathtaking art style, inspired by A Thousand Li of Rivers and Mountains, one of the most beautiful masterpieces of Chinese ink and watercolor art.

Unlike other city- and hex-tile building games, in Qianli you won’t be limited by any terrain restrictions. Place each piece freely, following only your instinct. You may be chasing a high score, or simply enjoying a peaceful session of beauty and creation: the choice is yours.

There is a soul in everything: in the landscape, in the peace of nature, in the buildings your people inhabit. Throughout your journey, you’ll encounter Scenlings – beings born from traditional Chinese poems and songs, given shape after centuries amassing energy. Each has its own history, distinct personality, and unique abilities – and will bring an extra layer of strategic depth to your landscapes while you explore the story behind each of them.

Misty mountains, unfathomable blue lakes, deep forests, twinding paths – all elements of classic Chinese landscape paintings are yours to combine freely. But magic happens when certain tiles meet: a path reaching water forms a dock, a trail near a famed peak reveals the gates of an ancient temple. Experiment and explore to uncover every magical interaction.

Step into a living landscape painting where every brushstroke tells a story. Whether you seek a relaxing journey, a creative escape, or a test of skill, you can enjoy the world at your own pace.

- Exploration Mode: Journey through the painting and meet Aspects inspired by classical Chinese poetry and historic landmarks. Discover their stories, unlock unique abilities, and experience the timeless beauty of traditional Chinese art.

- Creation Mode: Let your imagination run free with no scores or limitations. Paint across a vast landscape and bring your own vision of A Thousand Li of Rivers and Mountains—a masterpiece of Chinese landscape painting from the Song dynasty—to life. Share your creations with friends and enjoy the experience of creating together.

- Challenge Mode: Even a peaceful landscape can become a place to hone your skills. Master unique rules, compete with friends in relaxed matches, improve your scores, and climb the rankings.

- Relaxed, stress-free hex-tile building

- Tranquil beauty inspired by traditional Chinese ink and watercolor paintings

- Meet Scenlings, folklore spirits with unique personalities and abilities that bring an extra layer of strategic depth while you explore their personal stories

- Dynamic landscape changes through tile interactions

- Light randomness and strategic depth for lasting replayability

Oh, and we almost forgot – And what's a calming game without our furry friends, the cats? Keep your eyes peeled. These little furballs love hiding in quiet corners. Can you spot them?

games.name: Build It Up! - The Holy Roman Empire
games.shortDescription: Build thriving cities in the Holy Roman Empire! Manage resources, production, and trade in a complex economy. Plan defense and siege. Expand your empire through military might or diplomacy and claim the imperial crown!
games.aboutText:
Gameplay:

Build It Up! – The Holy Roman Empire is a medieval simulation combining city-building, resource management, strategic battles and sieges.

Start as a small landowner with only a few settlers and struggle to survive your first winter. By gathering resources, building production chains, and trading wisely, you provide your people with the goods they need. Step by step, your village grows into a prosperous city in the heart of the Holy Roman Empire.

To maintain an army, you need plenty of food, weapons, and a large population. Expand and construct specialized villages and cities to increase productivity and secure strategic resources. Build fortresses to protect nearby settlements and defend your cities with walls and towers. Conquer other towns and villages with soldiers and siege engines—or wield the power of diplomacy to achieve your goals without bloodshed.

As your power, fame, and influence with the Church grow, you earn the electors' vote and ascend as Emperor of the Holy Roman Empire!

Detailed Economic Simulation:

- Buildings are constructed step by step, from foundations to rooftops.

- Workers gather resources, produce high-quality goods, and transport them across the world.

- Create organic settlements, care for your people, and manage thriving cities.

Dynamic Fields:

- Design dynamic fields with any number of points and adapt them to terrain, roads, or buildings.

- Not just fields, you can also create livestock enclosures or even a cemetery!

- Craft realistic landscapes and make optimal use of available space.

Variety of Building Materials and Color Options:

- Construct buildings from wood, stone, brick, thatch, and mortar, depending on available resources and architectural style.

- Use different color variations to design your cities exactly the way you want.

- Nearly every building from houses and churches to walls and towers can be customized.

Seasons and Weather:

- Spring, summer, autumn, and winter not only change the look of your world but also affect gameplay.

- Plan your food supply and store provisions during the warmer months.

- Snow and freezing temperatures during a winter campaign can shatter even the mightiest armies.

Wars and Battles:

- Raise an army and lead large forces into battle.

- Use various formations and tactics to gain the upper hand.

- Choose from different unit types, including archers, swordsmen, and cavalry.

Sieges and Destruction:

- Fortify your cities with walls and towers. Build fortresses to protect your villages.

- Construct powerful siege engines to breach defenses and conquer enemy settlements.

Developed by a Single Person!

"Build It Up! – The Holy Roman Empire is a passion project, inspired by 25 years of economic simulations and strategy games that shaped me as a gamer. "

– Nik Walz, CEO of Tec Enterprise –

games.name: NeverCOM
games.shortDescription: Travelers, NeverCOM is an asymmetric versus game unlike any you've witnessed across all timelines. You can choose from different factions to discover and return to various timelines, vying for control over their destinies. Ultimate order or absolute freedom—your choice.
games.aboutText:
Throughout the ages, within the boundless sea of stars that is time, there exists a group of travelers endowed with the ability to journey across timelines. One faction upholds order as the supreme law, calling themselves the "Guardians." They founded an corporation known as NeverCOM, whose branches stretch like a stellar network across the cosmos, imposing precise and unyielding control over countless timelines.

In stark opposition stands another faction—known as the "Escapers"—who hold freedom as the ultimate truth of all existence. They embrace natural selection and chaos, viewing disorder as the universe's most profound expression of beauty. These two ideologies clash like light and shadow, igniting endless conflict. Across the fabric of every timeline's destiny, they wage an eternal struggle of dominance and ruin…

Fight for your faction and decide the fate of the timeline

● The timeline is simultaneously influenced by its Expected Lifespan and Stability Value . It ends when the Stability Value drops to zero or when it reaches its Expected Lifespan.

● Players discover new timelines through the Explore Timeline function.

● Players re-enter already discovered and ongoing timelines via the Known Timelines function.

● Players choose to join a timeline as an Escapist or a Guardian . The goal of an Escapist is to end the timeline as quickly as possible by reducing its Stability Value, while the goal of a Guardian is to extend the timeline to its Expected Lifespan by increasing its Stability Value .

● When a timeline ends:

○ If it ends due to the Stability Value dropping to zero, the player who contributed more as an Escapist wins. The quantity of the reward is determined by the amount of Stability Value they reduced .

○ If it ends because it reached its Expected Lifespan , the player who contributed more as a Guardian wins. The quantity of the reward is determined by the amount of Stability Value they increased .

Unlock new equipments

Unlock more powerful equipments so you can purchase and use them in battle.

Customize you character

Hundreds of initial skins are completely free.

Look forward to more new maps, new items, and new visual effects.

games.shortDescription: Where resource management meets dungeon crawler. Collect rare loot, strategize monster encounters, and push your luck to descend to the bottom of the dungeon!

GATHER YOUR LOOT

Collect equipment and items found in rooms and dropped by monsters. Selecting the right loot to synergize with your chosen cat and strategy is key to making it deeper into the dungeon.

CHOOSE YOUR ENCOUNTERS

As a deck builder, YOU have the ability to select the monsters you see throughout the dungeon. Every normal room contains one random monster from a selection that you create, so select wisely for specific resources. But be sure to watch out for how much damage some hostile monsters can do...

DESCEND THE DUNGEON

Defeating the boss quota on each level to descend into a new level's biome and explore what the deeper floors have to offer if you dare...

games.name: City Painter
games.shortDescription: Advanced city simulator with minimalist "Paint" graphics. Build complex intersections, edit traffic rules, and solve traffic jams without melting your PC.
games.aboutText:
Looks like a joke. Simulates like a beast.

Don't let the simple Paint aesthetics fool you. Built by a solo developer, this game prioritizes simulation performance over graphics. Under the hood lies a deep, complex, and unforgiving traffic engine. It is designed to challenge your city-planning skills without melting your PC.

Key Features

- EVERY Resident is Simulated: There is no "fake" background traffic. Every single citizen has a home, a job, and a daily schedule. When you see a car, it's a specific person trying to get somewhere.

- Design Complex Road Networks: From simple intersections to massive highway interchanges. Build roundabouts, bridges, and tunnels exactly how you want.

- Control Every Intersection: Don't just build roads. Manage the rules. Edit traffic lights, set up yield signs, and configure lane connections manually. You decide who has the right of way.

- Fix Traffic Jams: Identify bottlenecks and optimize the flow before your city paralyzes.

- Function over Form: The minimalist style isn't just an aesthetic choice. It allows the simulation to scale up massively. You can simulate tens of thousands of active agents in real-time on almost any computer. Build gigantic cities and focus on the logic, not the textures.

- Recreate Real Cities: Turn on the real-world map overlay, place it over any city, and trace its streets in the game. Build on huge maps, up to 25 × 25 km.

Please note that the game is in Early Access!

This means the project is still under development. You may encounter bugs, and some mechanics still need refinement. I am actively working on patches and adding new features from the Roadmap. By purchasing the game now, you are supporting its development in the early stages. Thank you for your support and understanding!

Roadmap

- public transport (buses)

- a roundabout building tool

- varied terrain (mountains, rivers, lakes)

- city services (fire department, police, hospitals, garbage collection, and deathcare)

- electricity and water systems

- the ability to share and download intersections, maps, vehicles, etc. via the Steam Workshop

- pedestrian paths

- a tool for setting speed limits on roads

- a tool for moving roads and buildings

- a decoration tool (parks, trees)

- music and ambient sounds

- a city budget (construction costs, taxes, etc.)

- a parking system (roadside and parking lots)?

- trains?

games.name: 键盘农场 Keyboard Farm
games.shortDescription: "Keyboard Farm" is a desktop idle farming game. Place it on your desktop and focus on your work. Every key is a plot of land—each keystroke helps plants grow. Harvest crops to collect coins, unlock various keycaps, and create your own keyboard world.
games.aboutText:
Thanks for playing our Demo! Enjoying your little farm? Add Keyboard Farm to your wishlist and stay tuned for news about the full release.

About the Keyboard Farm

Buddy, you can farm just by tapping your keyboard!

From today on, be a happy coder: type, grow crops, and harvest to your heart's content.

That's right, your keyboard is a little farm! Keep it on your desktop and watch greenery quietly grow across your keyboard while you focus on work.

The new Demo brings more tiles, an all-new buff system, and special buildings. Come see what's new on your farm!

Tap the Keyboard to Grow Crops

Plow, sow, and water. No keystroke goes to waste! Place your farm on your desktop and get on with your usual work. Every keystroke helps your plants grow, and harvesting mature crops earns you coins.

More Tiles, More Plants

A brand-new desert tile joins the farm! Pond and woodland tiles have also become more fertile, allowing you to grow a wider variety of plants. Unlock different tiles and collect all kinds of crops to make your keyboard farm flourish!

Make Your Keycaps Work Together!

Buy special keycaps from the shop to give nearby crops a boost!

Plan your layout to get the most out of every tile, or arrange everything your way and enjoy a relaxing farming break.

Learn Something While You Farm?

Build a school on your farm to unlock an exciting mini-game: vocabulary practice!

Wait, wasn't I supposed to be slacking off in Keyboard Farm? Why am I studying in a game, too?!

Mini Mode: A Tiny Farm on Your Desktop

Switch to the all-new Mini Mode with a single click! Your farm shrinks down to a more compact size, keeping you company on your desktop.

Customize Your Keyboard Farm

Spend your hard-earned coins on a variety of keycaps, unlock different tile and plant styles, and arrange your farm just the way you like. Give every keycap its place and turn your ordinary keyboard into a one-of-a-kind little world!

Track Your Typing Habits

Ever wonder how many times you press your keyboard each day?

Keyboard Farm tracks how often each key is pressed and generates a personal keyboard usage report.

A New Demo, with Plenty of Improvements

We've made a whole host of improvements, from visuals and controls to UI layout and stability. There are more improvements than carrots fresh out of the ground!

Welcome back to our Playtest veterans, and welcome to everyone joining us for the first time! Whether you love planning your farm, collecting plants, or simply adding a little greenery to your busy desktop, there's a little corner of the world here just for you.

Your Privacy Matters

We take your privacy seriously. Here's our promise:

The game only tracks keystroke frequency, meaning how often each key is pressed. It never records the actual text you type.

The game can run entirely offline.

All statistics are stored locally on your device and are never uploaded to external servers.

Type with peace of mind and enjoy your farming life!

games.name: Birb
games.shortDescription: Start as a humble birb, eat popcorn, and evolve into a cosmic force of nature! Birb blends addictive idle mechanics with active roguelite expeditions. Build your nest, catch rare fish, challenge bosses, and compete on the global leaderboard. How many pecks will it take to rule the world?
games.aboutText:
Peck your way to power! Consume endless popcorn to mutate your birb into increasingly powerful forms. Will you remain a bird, or become something... more ?

When you're not feasting, step through the portal into dangerous realms.

- Explore Procedural Dungeons: Battle unique enemies.

- Boss Battles: Face off against powerful foes to prove your dominance.

Take a break from the chaos at the Moonlit Waters.

- Fishing Minigame: Cast your line to catch dozens of unique fish types.

- Fill your Fishdex: distinct rarities, shiny variants, and weight records.

- Manage your Aquarium: Show off your best catches or trade them for buffs.

Home is where the twig is. Unlocking powerful passive bonuses, automation features, and helpful companions like the Seagull, Parrow and Sparrow.

Social Flock

You are not alone! See other players moving in real-time in the park, chat with the flock, and compete for the top spot on the Global Leaderboards for Popcorn Eaten and Fish Caught.

Features:

- Satisfying Idle progression

- Active RPG-style combat expeditions

- Hundreds of upgrades and skill trees

- Retro Pixel Art aesthetic

- Prestige system for infinite replayability

Are you ready to join the flock?

games.name: Federal Reserve Simulator
games.shortDescription: Played on air by Kai Ryssdal on Marketplace. Can you beat inflation without crashing the economy? Lead the Fed in a turn-based strategy game of interest rates, financial crises and political pressure. Learn with a guided first run, then rewrite economic history.
games.aboutText:
Played on Marketplace by Kai Ryssdal

Kai Ryssdal played Federal Reserve Simulator on air on Marketplace. Now take the chair of the United States Federal Reserve in a turn-based economic strategy game.

Can you beat inflation without crashing the economy? Every quarter, weigh inflation against jobs, growth and financial stability. Your decisions shape the economy, while crises and political pressure test your resolve. Set policy and read the consequences

Manage the federal funds rate, discount lending and reserve requirements. Deploy quantitative easing (QE) or quantitative tightening (QT), publish forecasts and use forward guidance to shape market expectations. Your available tools evolve as you move through history.

Policy effects arrive with delays. Raise rates too aggressively and you may trigger a recession. Cut too quickly and inflation may return. Build credibility so that markets trust your words, and navigate disagreements within the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC).

Set the rate. Watch the economy respond over the following quarters. Learn the job behind the desk

Start with a guided first run that walks you through the controls, your first rate decision and how to read the results. Quarterly Briefings explain what changed, how your policies and outside shocks contributed, and what to watch next. Explore the in-game Fedcyclopedia whenever you want to understand a monetary-policy tool.

See what changed, what drove it and what to watch next. Take on history or run for a century

Step into the terms of five historical Fed chairs:

- Paul Volcker: Bring high inflation under control while managing the cost to jobs and growth.

- Alan Greenspan: Face Black Monday, the dot-com crash and the aftermath of September 11.

- Ben Bernanke: Confront the global financial crisis and use QE to support the economy.

- Janet Yellen: Normalize policy while protecting a fragile recovery.

- Jerome Powell: Navigate the pandemic and the return of high inflation.

For a longer challenge, lead the Fed through the Historical Run from 1920 to 2027 , or create a Sandbox run spanning 30 to 100 years with adjustable event frequency and intensity. Protect the Fed's independence in the AI era

In the Kevin Warsh scenario, take office in 2026 amid elevated inflation, demands for rate cuts and uncertainty about artificial intelligence. The Independence Pendulum tracks pressure from the President and the Fed's Board. Prolonged defiance can bring a federal investigation; yielding to political pressure can provoke a Board revolt led by Jerome Powell.

Adjust AI Impact to explore different effects on productivity, employment and markets. Heavy QE can inflate an AI equity bubble and worsen a later correction. The outcome depends on your settings and policy choices. Build a crisis and test your judgment

Create a Custom Mode scenario around stagflation, deflation or a market crash. Add a wildcard such as war, an energy shock or an automation boom. Enable Prestige Mode for tougher scoring and less room for error.

In historical chair scenarios, earn a grade from A to F and compare your performance with historical benchmarks. Unlock achievements, revisit your approach and try for a better outcome.

The next decision is yours, Chair.

games.name: The Dandelion Endures.
games.shortDescription: This is a dandelion life simulation adventure.
games.aboutText:
・Playtime: 30–60 minutes ※Please note that this is a compact experience.

A tough-as-nails dandelion comes to life by the roadside.

Day after day, they photosynthesize and struggle to survive, enduring all kinds of trials along the way.

They endure the rain, the wind, the snow, and even the scorching heat of summer.

Sometimes, they are attacked by cats. Sometimes, by humans.

But they never give up. They endure, survive, and keep on living.

Eventually, they become a fluffy seed head and drift into the sky, carried away by the wind.

This is a dandelion life simulation adventure.

How to Play

・Photosynthesis

Adapt to a variety of environments and collect carbon dioxide, water, and light energy to carry out photosynthesis.

Photosynthesis allows your dandelion to undergo cell division.

・Cell Division

Once you have photosynthesized enough, cell division becomes possible.

Through cell division, you can strengthen various abilities that contribute to the dandelion's vitality.

　

・Endure.

To live is to endure. The dandelion will face trials in a variety of environments.

All the dandelion can do is endure. By enduring at the right moment, you can reduce the damage taken to some extent. However, be careful: enduring itself also requires vitality.

Video & Streaming Guidelines

Videos and livestreams are allowed. Monetization is also allowed.
developers: 無限オーリーゲームズ

games.name: Devilbreath: The First Seal
games.shortDescription: Devilbreath: The First Seal is a dark fantasy tactical RPG set in a medieval frontier, where an ordinary village boy follows a hell-born mist into a dying forest to find its source—and stop it before his village is lost.
games.aboutText:
The mist arrived without warning.

It rolled out of the deep woods like a slow exhale—cold, bitter, and wrong. Crops dulled. Animals fled. People stopped sleeping. And at the edge of the village, shapes began to move where no living thing should.

You are not a knight. Not a mage. Not chosen by prophecy. You are a villager with no army behind you—only stubbornness, fear, and the growing certainty that if you turn back, nothing will remain to save.

Follow the Devilbreath. Find its source. Stop the spread.

A dark fantasy tale with unsettling moments—focused on tactics and atmosphere rather than constant horror.

Tactical Combat Built on Hard Choices

Every fight is a puzzle under pressure: commit to an action, anticipate the enemy, and survive long enough to push deeper into the mist.

- Turn-based tactical battles focused on planning and counterplay

- Simple, readable actions with meaningful consequences (strike, defend, risk heavier hits, and unleash dark effects)

- Limited healing —potions buy you time, not certainty

- Enemies that punish habits , forcing you to adapt instead of repeating a “best move”

A Small Human Story in a Dark World

Devilbreath is about what happens when the world expects heroes—and none arrive.

Meet villagers, wanderers, and figures of faith in the fog: some will help, some will lie, and some will wear kindness like a mask. The further you go, the more the line blurs between protection and obsession , faith and fear , duty and doom .

Why Wishlist

Devilbreath is in active development. Wishlisting helps you track major updates, demo availability, and the release window as development continues.

games.name: Keep It Up!
games.shortDescription: Keep It Up! is a 4 player co-op physics game where you and your fellow genetically [redacted] test subjects slap a balloon through a mysterious obstacle course without it touching the ground. You've gotta Keep It Up!
games.aboutText:
Keep It Up! is a co-op slapstick physics game about keeping a balloon from touching the ground. You and up to three Facility test subjects scramble through chaotic obstacle rooms while slapping, jumping and colliding to keep the balloon up. Will you be able to Keep It Up!?

Use your hands, your head, or whatever appendages The Facility hasn't confiscated yet, just keep the balloon off the floor. Easy, right? Fail and you're literally incinerated. Run out of lives and the last balloon takes the whole team with it. That's not a research flaw, just the consequences of your inability to complete such a simple task.

Every room's a test, and every test is harder than the last, because that's how testing works. This is science after all! Fans, spikes and hallways which legally shouldn't be that narrow all stand between you and the next room. Good luck, you're going to need it.

Our hypothesis suggests that coordinating slaps with fellow test subjects will yield positive results for all participants. Slapping your teammates is also a highly recommended option, but success rates are... variable. NOTE: The Facility is not liable for any detriment to personal relationships during testing.

Of course, you'll be greatly rewarded for your participation in such revolutionary research! As you progress, you'll unlock cosmetics: hair styles, eyes, eyebrows, mouths, outfits, the works, all generously provided by the Facility. Test subjects are under constant observation, so whether you're the hero of the team, or the dummy who let the balloon hit the ground, you'll want to look your best.

KEY FEATURES

- High-octane balloon action that rewards clutch saves and breeds chaos equally.

- 4-player co-op mayhem so shared failure = shared blame (and hilarious finger-pointing).

- Physics playground lobby for goofing off with friends, cooling off after a rough run or customizing ridiculous characters.

- 15 escalating rooms from "this game is easy" to "why are there spikes, fans and lasers!?”.

- Designed for chaos and mastery from casual completionists to sweaty speed runners.

- Character customization so you can look as absurd as you are.

- In-game voice chat (so you can scream at your friends and celebrate last-second saves).

games.name: Gargadusa's Tower
games.shortDescription: D&D meets Franchise Manager, Gargadusa’s Tower is a supremely deep guild management simulation that spans generations. Build your adventurer guild from nothing. Recruit heroes, complete quests, and descend the mysterious tower to confront the power that lies within.
games.aboutText:
BEFORE YOU BUY
This game is still growing. I update it constantly, I'm active every day in the official Discord and there is a free demo here on Steam if you want to try it first to see if it's for you.

About AI. I make this game solo and I use AI tools to do it. The game originally launched with AI placeholder art, however, most of that art has been replaced/updated (hooray!) and I am continually working on that aspect of the game with artists, so you'll see the look and feel change over time as more art comes in. Please note, I do not prohibit the artists I work with from using AI tools. Furthermore, I use Claude Code to scale my programming: bug fixes, restructuring code and translations, etc. The game design, the world, the stories and every creative call comes from me and the universe I'll be building over the next decade, but I wanted to make sure you saw this before purchase, just in case you are not comfortable with these tools.

Languages. The game is translated into 19 languages by Claude. It's good, but not perfect. If you spot a mistake, tell me in the Discord and I'll fix it.

Thanks for checking the game out!

BUILD A GUILD. DEFEAT THE TOWER. SAVE IRDA.

Recruit from 56 classes of adventurers and send them into a 100-floor buried tower where death is permanent and your best warrior or mage might not come back. That's the core of the game, but there is an incredible amount of content that spirals outward from that singular thread: how do you support those adventurers, where do you deploy your resources, and what alliances (and enemies) will you make along the way while you do what it takes to save the realm?

Each adventurer is procedurally generated and unique. They are born with zodiac sun, moon, and rising signs that define who they are and are augmented by their personal history both in and outside of your guild. Friendships, successes, failures, stats, ambitions and flaws; they all add up to make each adventurer who they are. An Aries Berserker who's best friend just died while fighting a Woundspawn won't take orders the same way a Virgo Harmony Druid will. A Capricorn won't appreciate the Gemini kleptomaniac skimming off the top after every quest and if that Capricorn is your Commander, they sure as hell will let you know what's on their mind.
