Your job is to empower those voices to row in the same direction in hopes of buildng a guild of great renown to keep fighting (or feeding) the Tower.

THE TOWER AWAITS

An ancient and immovable buried tower has awoken beneath the frontier town of Hiltcrest, spewing monsters across the realm. The Crown has authorized independent adventurer guilds to fight back.

You are one of many Guild Masters who answered the call and the world around you slowly and steadily unfolds over years (and decades) of play.

RECRUIT AND DEVELOP

• Scout and sign adventurers as they drift into Hiltcrest. Whether it be a common Archer or an ultra rare Oath Paladin, each adventurer brings something unique to the table to spark something special thanks to a deep chemistry and bond system that could turn a good group into the Party of Heroes if navigated just right.
• Train them, unlock traits through life-long milestones and watch raw recruits become legends who one day retire and perhaps join your staff as an instructor, scout, or even a cook.
• Run an Academy that empowers your instructors to develop talent in a homegrown system starting at the age of 14. Sign your best students at 18 and throw them into the fold or sell their contracts to a Rival Guild looking for that high potential ranged dps.

• Manage contracts, wages, chemistry and morale. Push them too hard and they walk. Coddle them and they won't survive the Tower. Put them in the wrong party and things get interesting fast.
• Earn their trust with quiet words between quests and watch rivalries and friendships form inside your own roster.

BUILD YOUR GUILD ACROSS GENERATIONS

• Raise more than 30 buildings: barracks, armory, infirmary, training yard, tavern, observatory, workshop and more.
• Hire staff: scouts to find talent, astrologers to read the stars, crafters to forge, enchant and brew your gear.
• Climb from a scrappy upstart to a guild the whole realm knows, then pick a specialization that shapes your late game.
• Lead the guild through your Commander, who reads the room, writes you letters and helps guide your guild through the hard times.

THE WORLD CHANGES

World Events and World Bosses disrupt your game in unforeseen ways that alter the course of each playthrough. A goblin horde descends from the mountains and burns everything in its wake, a great winter takes hold and brings all of the realm to a halt, or even an Ashen Stag, corrupted by the forces within the Tower, seeks to level the northern reaches with flame.

Send parties on quests from simple bounties to full raids and watch them fight in tactical auto-battlers. Descend 100 floors of deadly challenges, face their bosses and confront the power a

games.name: Burn-9
games.shortDescription: A spy thriller where you’re not the spy. Safe behind your screen, guide the last survivor of an elite black-ops team in a desperate attempt to salvage a mission gone horribly wrong. Caught between military command and your agent, information is your greatest weapon.
games.aboutText:
Burn-9 is a political spy thriller in the tradition of Hideo Kojima and Tom Clancy, but you are not the soldier on the ground. Instead, you’re the one in the chair, coordinating the mission from afar.

When a top secret military research facility in the Antarctic goes dark, an elite strike force of cybernetically-enhanced black-ops super soldiers is dispatched to investigate and secure Burn-9 at all costs. Minutes into the mission, the helicopter is shot down.

There is one survivor… and you’re her only lifeline.

As the team’s Operator, you are physically safe behind your computer screen - but the pressure is relentless. Caught between the demands of the top brass and the reality on the ground, every piece of intel you gather becomes a decision: what to share, what to hold back, and who to trust.

You’ll guide your agent, feeding her the information she needs to survive. At the same time, you’ll report up the chain of command, receiving orders that may conflict with what’s unfolding in front of you.

Your goal is simple: get your agent to the objective and complete the mission.

Whatever it takes.

Because there will be a cost.

A secret Antarctic base has gone silent. Your objective: secure Burn-9 at all costs.

This is your chance to prove you can handle the toughest assignments and make the calls no one else will.

You play as the Operator - managing logistics, counter-hacking, intelligence, and strategy as the voice in the ear and the eye in the sky. You’re miles away from the mission, connected to your team only through a laptop screen and a stream of biometric data.

You sit safely behind the glass sipping coffee … while they’re knee-deep in it.

As the eye in the sky, you have access to cutting-edge surveillance and intelligence systems - scanning for threats, collecting and collating data, and turning it into the real-time insight your agent needs in the field.

Then it’s on you to use that intel to guide her, direct her… and keep her alive.

As the Operator, you’re not just the eye in the sky - you’re inside their network. Breach their systems to disable cameras, unlock secure doors, and extract secrets you were never meant to see, turning every vulnerability into an advantage for your agent.

Use every black ops tool at your disposal to keep her alive. She’ll need every edge you can give her.

Epoch Base is meant to be an all-weather drone and vehicle research facility - operated by the United States, supposedly for the betterment of the world.

But beneath it lies a project no one is meant to know about: Burn-9.

No one will talk about it…

And everyone is willing to kill for it.

The field agent under your command is Dodo - the tip of the spear, the one who goes in first… and the one who gets hit first. Today, the weight of the world rests on her shoulders. Trapped, alone, and without support inside a secret Antarctic military base, she has no one else to rely on.

She may be under your command but she has a mind of her own.

You’ll have to earn her trust, manage her state of mind, and navigate the fact that she’s on the ground while you’re just in the chair.

The top brass are watching - and they’re the ones calling the shots.

- Morrigan: the CIA spymaster: no nonsense, no humour, no patience.

- The Admiral: commander of the carrier fleet: a navy man… the Navy man.

- The Politician: the President’s Chief of Staff: a politician through and through.

They’re tight-lipped and have their own priorities. They won’t tell you what Burn-9 is… and they’re not about to start now.

An elite military force controls the Antarctic base, led by a commander respected as much for his principles as his ruthlessness. At his side is a handpicked squad of specialists - some of the most dangerous operatives in the world.

But the deeper you dig, the less clear it becomes who the real enemy is.

And every single one of them is hunting Dodo.

As the truth behind Burn-9 begins to unravel, you’ll have to decide who deserves to know what you uncover. Your agent. Your superiors. Maybe no one at all.

Every choice shapes the mission - and the people trying to survive it.

Although you’re hundreds of miles from the action, you’re at the center of this mission, you’ll be the one making the critical calls.

Manage your agent, navigate the competing priorities of your bosses, uncover what’s really going on and ultimately decide what path to take.

Your choices might save the world… or end it.

ABOUT THE DEVELOPER

14 Hours Productions is an indie game studio that is run more like a co-op than a traditional company. Founded by Matthew Ritter, 14 Hours Productions aims to create games that don't already exist, trying to find new ways to tell interesting and compelling stories. We pledge to entertain you, inform you and engage you.

The 14 Hours Productions team has worked with companies like Telltale, Silver Volition, Dontnod, Teyon, and many more. Having worked on properties like Robocop, Streets of Rage, The Walking Dead,

games.name: Bumpers & Dragons
games.shortDescription: Drop balls. Slay dragons. Bumpers & Dragons is a pachinko roguelite where physics meets strategy. Engineer your luck, create wild combos, and crawl deeper into procedurally generated dungeons.
games.aboutText:
A pachinko roguelite dungeon crawler where every shot is a gamble, and every dragon another opportunity to break the board.

Drop balls. Deal damage. Slay dragons.

Launch balls onto a pachinko board to attack enemies. Where they land, what they hit, and how you've built your board determines whether you survive or start over.

PACHINKO COMBAT

Each enemy encounter plays out on a physics-driven board. To deal damage, drop your balls, watch them bounce through pins and bumpers triggering powerful effects along the way. Bumper types and positioning matter, but so does the chaos!

BUILD YOUR BUMPER DECK

Bumpers you place on your board are your arsenal, each with unique stats and abilities. Buy, sell, and rearrange them at shops like a deck-builder. Find synergies, craft combos, and make every drop count.

EXPLORE PROCEDURAL DUNGEONS

No two runs are the same. Navigate a randomized node map, battle monsters and dragons, discover events, and gear up for what's ahead at shops.

LOOT & EQUIP

Discover powerful artifacts that amplify your synergies. Double down on a single strategy or mix effects to create unexpected combinations, with countless builds waiting to be discovered.

ROGUELITE PROGRESSION

Die. Learn. Unlock. Every run earns permanent progress through upgrades and unlockable content.

games.name: Tidy Up
games.shortDescription: A peaceful cleaning and organizing game where you explore different locations, collect trash, clean stains, and arrange items to turn mess into perfection.
games.aboutText:
Tidy Up is a relaxing organization game where you turn mess into calm. Without stress or time limits. Tidy up your surroundings, clean up the mess, sit back and enjoy spaces that become more beautiful with every touch.

No Need to Rush There are no time constraints or a timer chasing you at Tidy Up. You can take as much time as you need and clean every corner at your own pace. Focus on the joy of organizing and cleaning; the end time is entirely up to you.

A New Experience Every Time Tidy Up automatically changes the locations of objects and the level of messiness every time you start a job. By selecting from four different levels of messiness, you can rediscover the same space with a different organization plan each time and create your own routine.

You will visit many places with different concepts. Each new job means different objects to clean and brand new environments to organize. Enjoy a different atmosphere each time in these various maps, each with its own theme.

games.shortDescription: "Who do you want to save? Or rather... who are you prepared to abandon?" A midnight "Unsend" trapped them in a rift in time, and awakened the dead "You." Become a "Ghost" inhabiting screens and surveillance feeds. Pry into perfect disguises and rotting hearts.
games.aboutText:
23:61 - The Triangle Paradox

When the clock strikes a nonexistent hour— Only "You," the sole Observer, hold their fate in your hands.

Is this an endless loop, or an unsolvable paradox? When two hands reach out to you simultaneously...

You must decide not only who survives, but who is forgotten.

Stay connected. Don't let the signal drop.

Every time you "Log Out," their timeline crumbles further.

- Realistic Phone Interface × Narrative Puzzle | More than a game; a voyeuristic experience into their private data.

- Real-Time Synchronization | Your reality dictates their day and night.

- Multiple Branching Endings | You can't save everyone... unless?

Save and Delete... or IMPRISON?

"You know it's impossible to save everyone... yet you still want to continue?"

"..."

"Then, I will trust you one last time."

games.name: Emerald Flower
games.shortDescription: A miraculous fuel, or a parasitic plague that spells the end of humanity? In a civilization collapsed by global war, fight for survival against the brain-controlling Emerald Flower, feral armies, and ruthless factions, each driven by their own desperate ideologies.
games.aboutText:
Emerald Flower tells the story of a 17-year-old boy who has lost everything in the war and is searching for a reason to live.

- Rich Gameplay: Craft useful items from the materials you gather from the environment using the crafting and inventory system.

- Diversified Combat Mechanics: Instead of just mashing buttons, find your enemy's weak point and strike there. Beware, those you thought were friends might actually be enemies. Carefully analyze every character you meet in this game.

- Deep Character Relationships: In a civilization destroyed by the Emerald Flower, every character you meet matters. From a man giving advice on the road to a simple janitor, everyone has a good or bad nature and a story to tell.

- Pixel Art Atmosphere: Feel this intimate yet ruthless world with 2D retro pixel art graphics.

Damlama Government Secret Archive Records: What is Known About the Emerald Flower Project

Biological Origin

The Emerald Flower ( Stapelia Smaragdina ) is a parasitic plant. It is a subspecies of Stapelia Gigantea . Although it is unknown exactly when and how it evolved, fossils dating back to the evolution of Homo heidelbergensis have been found. (Research is ongoing...)

Reproduction Strategy

While its cousin Stapelia Gigantea uses flies to reproduce, this subspecies, known as the Emerald Flower, uses mammals. Its infection strategy relies on emitting a dizzyingly beautiful scent to attract victims, especially chimpanzees and humans. When the victim smells the flower, the seeds attach to the brain's olfactory nerve. Since these seeds are microscopic in size, the victim walks away completely unaware of the parasite infection.

The seed slowly develops here by feeding on the moisture of the mucus and penetrates the brain. Once inside, the Emerald Flower accelerates its growth using glucose in the brain and extends its roots into the brain stem. These growing roots thin out to a microscopic level, splitting into nanofibers, and seep into the synaptic clefts, beginning to control all of the mammal's instincts. This process takes about 2 weeks. At the end of the 2 weeks, the fully possessed subject feels the need to consume about 4 times more food than normal and feels the urge to remove anything covering their skin, such as clothing.

If the infection reaches this stage, there is no turning back. From this point on, the victim must remain emotionally stable. If they suddenly experience emotions like fear, anxiety, or happiness, the hormones released from the victim's hypothalamus will cause the flower to activate. If the person can remain emotionally stable for a long period, the Emerald Flower completely takes over the brain and extends its roots into all of the victim's blood vessels, taking full control of the host.

If the flower activates before it has time to spread throughout the body, it constricts the Arteria Carotis (carotid artery) leading to the brain with its roots, cutting off blood flow and killing its host.

During the 3 hours following death, the Emerald Flower grows out of the victim's mouth and nose and blooms. This flower remains open for about 1 week; if it cannot find a new host, it withers and dies.

If another mammal approaches the corpse or tries to smell the flower during this time, the flower suddenly releases all its seeds into the air, attaching to that mammal's olfactory nerve and restarting the whole process.

Should We Be Worried?

Although the picture is alarming, humanity brought this Emerald Flower nightmare under control decades ago. All members of the flower were collected and burned, driving it to extinction. Only a single seed and its genetic code map were kept under high-security preservation at the ******** Laboratory. We celebrate the joy of being rid of this horrific parasite, which slaughtered millions of members of our species, globally every year in the first week of August as Emerald Flower Awareness Week. As long as humanity stands united, no organism can bring an end to our species.

(Edit 1) 12/02/2018

The last seed and genetic codes of the Emerald Flower were lost during an attack on the ******** Laboratory. Anyone who has seen the last seed or shares information about its whereabouts will be awarded 15 Million Rayet for themselves and their families. The world needs you...

(Edit 2) 04/08/2018

The Alpu Government has claimed responsibility for the theft of the Emerald Flower. They announced to the entire world that the flower had been reproduced and, through genetic modifications using advanced genetic technologies, its sap had been turned into a fuel 20 times more efficient than petroleum. The whole world is rejoicing that energy crises are ending and that we will achieve a new world order. The Alpu Government announced it is looking for human subjects for studies to prevent the Emerald Flower from infecting humans. Because it is suspected that the experiments will push ethical boundaries, our Government is putting political pressure on Alpu. The en

games.name: Isolated Island: After the flood
games.shortDescription: Survive in a world drowned by disaster. Explore by day, hide by night, fight zombies, scavenge resources, build your shelter, and trade with other factions. Your survival, your strategy.
games.aboutText:
Isolated Island: After the Flood is a 2.5D side-scrolling zombie survival game set in a world drowned by catastrophe.

After the collapse of civilization, toxic gas clouds poison the skies and rising seas have swallowed most of the land. You are one of the last survivors, navigating flooded ruins, scavenging supplies, building shelter, and facing the undead.

🌗 Dynamic Day-Night Survival

Zombies are mostly dormant during the day — but at night, they hunt. Plan your actions carefully:

- Explore and scavenge during daylight

- Fortify your shelter and craft supplies

- Avoid nighttime patrols or risk deadly encounters

-

🏚️ Shelter Building & Resource Management

Your shelter is your lifeline.

- Build facilities

- Grow crops

- Craft weapons and gear

- Upgrade defenses Every improvement increases your chance of survival.

🔫 Combat or Stealth — You Decide

Face the undead head-on with heavy weapons and loot their corpses for rare items. Or avoid combat entirely, sneaking through ruins and timing your scavenging runs. Multiple playstyles, one goal: stay alive.

🤝 Trade with Survivor Factions

Other survivor groups control rare resources and advanced blueprints. Engage in high-risk trading to unlock:

- Unique crafting recipes

- Powerful gear

- Strategic advantages But beware — not all factions are friendly.

🧭 Explore. Survive. Rebuild.

Whether you’re a combat-focused survivor, a strategic planner, or a scavenger at heart, Isolated Island: After the Flood offers a rich, atmospheric survival experience in a world reclaimed by water and death.

games.name: Worthy or Not
games.shortDescription: “Worthy or Not” is an FMV about Dating Agency. Players make choices across diverse in-game topics, which modify target characters’ latent attributes. The final matchmaking phase, based on accumulated latent value changes, unlocks multiple endings. You play as a matchmaking agency owner faced girls
games.aboutText:
“Worthy or Not” is a full-motion video (FMV) dating simulation game. Players will face various topics and make different choices throughout the game's storyline, and each choice will alter the target characters' hidden attributes. In the final matching stage, different matching plans—shaped by the accumulated changes in the targets' hidden values during gameplay—will lead to a multitude of distinct endings. In the story, you will take on the role of a matchmaking agency owner, engaging in one "verbal duel" after another.

Story Background

Hao Pei, a postgraduate from a top-tier "985 Project" university, skipped the corporate rat race right after graduation and dived straight into the blind dating scene. After navigating countless pitfalls, he decided to open Hehe Matchmaking Agency , a one-stop solution for all kinds of tricky relationship and marriage dilemmas!

This is no fairy-tale blind dating scene—only sharp, reality-baring confrontations. You’ll meet: the "wishful-thinking" goddesses demanding a million-yuan annual salary; the female programmers hiding their marital history and children; the "brother-subsidizing" women trapped by their families of origin; the elite descendants fixated on asset matching; the strong career women who admire power yet fear gold-digging men...

Every choice you make shapes the story’s path: will you snap clients out of their unrealistic dating fantasies, or help them find a well-matched partner? Confront real-world relationship conflicts—including betrothal gifts, housing and cars, and family of origin issues—and unlock N different endings. You can either personally matchmake perfect unions or witness heart-wrenching regrets. Step into the role of a top matchmaker, tackle these "difficult" clients, and explore the true meaning of "matching" amid absurd and eye-opening clashes of values!

Game Features

Quick-Time Events

During gameplay, players must complete quick-time events (QTEs) as prompted. Failure to complete these events will trigger alternate endings.

Critical Choices

As the storyline progresses, players will face pivotal decisions. Each choice will impact the characters' hidden attributes.

Event Responses

In certain special events, different responses will also determine the game’s final multiple endings.

Clue Collection

Through various dialogues in the game, players can collect different clues to sort out and understand the game’s content.

Multiple Endings

Based on numerous choices made throughout the game, players will face different ending options in the final stage.

games.name: Victorian Pier Tycoon
games.shortDescription: Build and manage your own Victorian seaside pier in this nostalgic pixel-art tycoon game. Construct steam-powered rides, balance the delicate needs of the Aristocracy against the Working Class, and maintain structural integrity. Will your resort become a world wonder, or crumble into the sea?
games.aboutText:
Victorian Pier Tycoon is a love letter to the isometric management classics of the late 90s. But this isn't just about building rollercoasters or managing a hospital; it's about engineering a marvel on the ocean, managing the delicate sensibilities of Victorian society, and keeping your empire afloat—literally.

🌊 Build Out Over the Waves

Start with a few planks at the water's edge and push your pier out to sea one tile at a time. Lay humble working planks or grand promenade decking, ironwork or oriental boards, sink iron support columns to carry the load, and run a steam railway right up to the pier gates. Every tile can only take so much weight. Build heavy without shoring it up, and the sea will have the lot.

🎡 A Pier Full of Wonderfully Odd Attractions

Helter skelters and big wheels sit alongside a Ghost House, a human cannonball, Professor Barnaby's Freak Show, a Two-Headed Oracle, a Left Luggage office built as a giant steamer trunk, and The World's Biggest Crab (measured and verified by the proprietor himself). Build across fourteen categories, from Amusements, Refreshments and Emporiums to Weird Science, Mystic & Magic and the World Showcase.

📊 Proper Tycoon Depth

Every attraction has its own management panel: set prices and quality, run marketing, buy upgrades, and check its Excitement, Intensity and Nausea ratings. Click any guest to see their class, their purse, their needs and their thoughts, including the ones who walked away because they couldn't afford your prices. Pick up troublemakers and eject them from the pier. Raise, lower and level the land, research your way from gas lamps to electric illuminations, and tackle scenarios with their own starting capital, difficulty and challenges.

🎩 Lord Pemberton Puts His Name on Everything

Your pier is the pride of Lord Reginald Pemberton III, who has never seen a stall he couldn't stamp his name on, from Pemberton's Genuine Seaside Rock to Pemberton's Crab Sandwich Stall. Lady Cordelia, meanwhile, quietly does the sums and keeps the whole thing from sinking.

🫖 Toffs, Tradesmen and Day-Trippers

Every guest has a class, a purse and an opinion. Keep Happiness high and Decency respectable, because the upper classes will not queue beside a fire-eater, and the working classes won't pay a shilling for a cup of tea. Shape your pier into an Entertainment Capital or a genteel resort, and watch the class mix change with it.

👮 Hire a Proper Victorian Workforce

Constables to deter pickpockets. Dippers to supervise sea bathing. Cleaners to keep cholera at bay. Groundskeepers to fight the salt air, Safety Inspectors in bowler hats, and Railway Touts to charm tourists off the train and onto your pier. Staff tire as they work, so look after them.

⛈️ The Sea Always Wins (Eventually)

Tides roll in and close the beach. Storms tear planks from the deck. Fires spread, salt air rots your timbers, and neglected rides break down. Engineering a pier is a constant battle with the ocean underneath it. 📰 Read All About It Every evening, The Evening Gazette lands on your desk with the day's takings, staff morale, the social class of your crowds, which districts are earning, and tomorrow's outlook, from the weather to which excursion trains are due: the Bank Holiday Special, the London Special or the Day-Tripper.

🎆 A Full Victorian Season

Plan your year around the Victorian calendar, from the Easter Parade and Whitsun Week to Regatta Week, the Band Contest, August Bank Holiday, Guy Fawkes Night and the Christmas Pantomimes. Watch for passing crazes too, as the Spiritualist Craze sweeps the nation.

💰 Borrow, Gamble, Expand

Take on the Town Council's daily commercial challenges, borrow from the Bank of Brighton or bring in investors to fund your next grand pavilion. Just don't miss a repayment, or the bank will start seizing assets.

⭐ Features

- Detailed isometric pixel art with a full day and night cycle

- Hundreds of Victorian guests, each with needs, money and thoughts you can inspect

- Pier engineering with weight limits, tides, storms and fire

- Staff, loans, investors, daily challenges and seasonal events

- Campaign across real British piers, plus a freeplay sandbox

- Standard and Hardcore modes

- Optional retro interface inspired by the 90s classics

Grab a ticket, mind the gaps between the planks, and build the greatest pier in Britain. 🎟️

games.name: Fugaz
games.shortDescription: Play a flute to solve puzzles and unlock secrets, looking for an exit of a dark place before the darkness consumes everything. In this dark immersive horror puzzle game, knowledge is key to put the pieces together. No music experience required.
games.aboutText:
Use flute songs to solve puzzles

With the music sheets of different songs, you will be able to play them on the flute to affect the world. Music knowledge is not required to play the game.

An immersive experience

The ambience of this short game, with its dark minimalist pixel art graphics and ominous music, grants a really immersive experience.

A non linear world to explore

Exploration is only tied to your knowledge. Discovering new rules will push you further, and with the map, you can check your findings any time.

A mysterious psychological horror background

Everything in the game has a meaning. Its themes and lore are almost a puzzle in itself.

games.name: Bottled by Bears
games.shortDescription: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.
games.aboutText:
Bottled By Bears is a cozy idle management game where you run a little honey farm with the Pawford bear family. Open bee packs to collect bees of all kinds, grow a flowery field that blooms day by day, and bottle the sweetest honey jars to sell at your stand.

At your own pace, get ready to:

- Open different bee packs to discover new and rarer bees. Can you collect them all?

- Manage your hives and bottling lines to keep up with honey production.

- Attract new customers and take on bigger honey orders as your reputation grows.

- Expand your farm, decorate it, and arrange the flower fields that keep blooming even while you're away.

Settle in with the Pawfords, manage and take care of the farm, and fill the hives with your favorite bees along the way!

games.name: VilaGod
games.shortDescription: VilaGod is a god simulator where you shape the destiny of civilizations on giant maps. Unlike other god games, every action generates dynamic chronicles: from political revolts to legendary discoveries, watch your world's history unfold in 14 different languages
games.aboutText:
VilaGod is a god simulator where you shape the destiny of civilizations on massive maps. Unlike other god games, every action here generates dynamic chronicles: from political revolts to legendary discoveries, watch the history of your world unfold in 14 languages.

Key Features:

• Deep civilization simulation: Watch kingdoms evolve from the Bronze Age to a high-tech future
• Dynamic prayer system: Gain divine power from your followers’ prayers to influence the world
• Divine hero creation: Generate unique heroes with special abilities inherited from both divine and human traits
• Devastating divine powers: Create natural disasters, summon storms, lightning, and meteors to shape your world
• Tactical warfare systems: Manage conflicts between kingdoms using strategic formations and battle priorities
• Stylized pixel-art graphics: Visually stunning art with intricate details across massive maps
• Realistic historical evolution: Civilizations progress through historical eras with autonomous governments and ideologies
• Heredity and diversity: Heroes inherit traits from divine and human parents, featuring racial representation
• Narrative consequences: Every divine action has lasting impact on the world and its civilizations
• Visual power systems: Impressive special effects for every type of heroic power

Witness the birth of myths and legends as you intervene—or simply observe—the development of your creations. From miraculous blessings to apocalyptic destruction, every decision shapes the course of history.

Will you be revered as a protective god or feared as a cosmic tyrant?

games.name: The Pactmaker
games.shortDescription: You are a professor who forged pacts with otherworldly entities to save your daughter. Dive into the memories of others, alter reality, and use your new supernatural abilities to uncover the truth in this dark point-and-click thriller.
games.aboutText:
Key Features

- A story of mystery, drama, and unexpected twists. Beyond the veil, otherworldly entities forge pacts with humans. What are their true intentions?

- Dive into memories. Unearth secrets and shift between realities.

- Richly Detailed Pixel Art: Travel to Edinburgh, Ireland, and Egypt... and to realms beyond this world.

Everyone matters. Everyone hides something.

The Story

You are Edward Wolfe, a professor at a prestigious institution. All your lofty philosophy means nothing when you have to see your 12-year-old daughter lying in a coma after an accident.

You will do whatever it takes to save her, even if it means summoning a supernatural being, known as a Goetic.

You must forge pacts and alliances with entities from this world and beyond, absorb and explore the memories of others, and uncover the truth.

Remember: everything comes with a price, and yours might just be too high to pay.

Gameplay

The Pactmaker delivers a unique take on the point-and-click adventure genre. It seamlessly blends classic, narrative-driven puzzle solving with supernatural mechanics, allowing you to shift between reality and memories, altering and manipulating events to uncover vital clues.

Explore deeply atmospheric locations inspired by real-world events, mysteries, and historical figures. Visit a prestigious library in Edinburgh, investigate a bizarre apparition in a remote Irish village, and uncover tales of reincarnation and ancient god-cults within Egyptian temples.

The supporting cast isn't just there to hand you puzzle pieces or blindly serve your quest. They have their own richly woven stories and inner conflicts. Everyone has lost something... just like you.

games.name: Guns, Princess and Braves
games.shortDescription: Fast-paced Roguelike: inventory management meets tower defense. As a princess in love with a dragon, strategically layout weapons in limited space. Take direct control in battle to crush "righteous" braves with flashy bullet!
games.aboutText:
Fast-paced Roguelike: inventory management meets tower defense. As a princess in love with a dragon, strategically layout weapons in limited space. Take direct control in battle to crush "righteous" braves with flashy bullet!

A princess crash-lands on an alien planet and is rescued by a dragon. But the "righteous" braves are coming to slay the beast and tear the lovers apart. To protect her dragon boyfriend, she will wield powerful weapons and crush the invaders with overwhelming firepower!

Before each wave, strategically arrange guns and items on your grid. Layout matters—only a smart placement can build an ironclad defense! Remember: what doesn't kill you only makes your defense stronger!

Tower defense is no longer just waiting! As the princess, you take direct control of the fight. With random loot drops after battle, you gain unique abilities. Will you go head-to-head with the braves or use agile movement to support your weapon? You decide!

Combine items to make them stronger, and trigger powerful synergies by grouping items with the same tags! But be careful—sometimes kee ping multiple items on the field is more effective than merging them!

Face endless tides of "heroic" braves! Experience the thrill of mowing down enemies in fast-paced combat. With randomly generated items and skills, every journey to protect your dragon is a brand-new challenge.

Experiment with exotic formations, master a massive arsenal, explore diverse builds, and defeat powerful bosses. More exciting content awaits!

games.name: Kintsugi
games.shortDescription: Accompany Kyō, a young apothecary, on his journey to repair a world shattered by mankind and uncover the origin of his newfound golden powers.
games.aboutText:
[THIS GAME IS A 10-MINUTE GAME EXPERIENCE DEVELOPED FOR STUDENT PROJECT.]

Project gold to repair and bring life back to a broken world in a 2D platformer inspired by the Japanese art and philosophy of Kintsugi.

A mysterious power has fallen upon the land, imbuing humans with gold.
You play as Kyō, a young, empathetic apothecary who has also been touched by this phenomenon. Through his new power to mend and restore, he will seek to understand its origin and to use it to heal the world.

Travel through gorgeous environments in search of the origin of your powers.

For millennia, the world and the creatures living in it have been gradually destroyed by men, satisfying their greed and personal well-being at the expense of their environment.

One day, a mysterious phenomenon suddenly spread on the planet, imbuing its inhabitants with gold.

Play as Kyō, a young apothecary isolated from the rest of the world, also touched by this event, discovering his new gold manipulation powers.

Embark on an adventure to understand the origin and functioning of these new powers and try to use them to fix the world.

Dive into a complete and original poetic experience.

- Project magical gold & use your mobility skills to progress through this fantastical world.

- Engage with the background to bring more life and beauty to the environment.

- Progress through different biomes to discover and understand the origin and working of your newfound powers.

- Enjoy an emotional ride by listening to an original soundtrack following the environmental storytelling of the game.

Can you bring back life to this broken world by using your new golden powers?

games.name: ONIGASHIMA: Awakening
games.shortDescription: A predictive deck-building RPG! Build your strategy from over 300 cards! Form powerful formations with unique animal companions! Master countless combinations and claim overwhelming victories! Your adventure to defeat the ONI begins now!
games.aboutText:
Know your opponent's actions before they happen! A deck-building RPG where victory comes from predicting the flow of battle and planning ahead!

Build your strategy from over 300 different cards!

Your adventure takes place on ONIGASHIMA, an island inhabited by the ONI.

Set out on a journey across ONIGASHIMA to defeat the ONI and protect your homeland from the threat they bring.

Recruit unique animal companions and customize your offensive options through deck building.

The protagonist and companions can develop in countless ways depending on how you build your decks, allowing you to create a party that is truly your own!

◆ Over 300 Deck-Building Options

Every character can be customized individually through skill selection, attack command setups, passive effect builds, and more.

All deck-building elements can be discovered while exploring ONIGASHIMA, making completion an adventure in itself!

◆ Strategic Turn-Based Auto Battles

All battles are fully automated.

Combat unfolds according to the attack commands you prepared beforehand, making strategic planning the key to victory.

Will you build a balanced party that can win safely, or risk everything on an overwhelming offensive strategy? The choice is yours!

◆ More Than 40 Unique Animal Companions

The animals that accompany you on your journey are not only adorable, but also dependable allies.

As you explore ONIGASHIMA, you will encounter many different animals. Recruit a wide variety of companions and build the party that suits your playstyle!

Note: This title is designed exclusively for mouse controls. All gameplay can be performed using only a mouse, so sit back, grab your mouse, and enjoy the adventure.

Note: All images shown are from a work in progress and may differ from the final product.

games.name: Rocksowers
games.shortDescription: Co-op Survival Sandbox meets Bullet Hell. Explore the corrupted surface on a moving base, scavenge for resources and craft GAME-BREAKING weapons using many unique modules to defeat ever-stronger foes. Fight to reclaim what The Bloom took from humanity!
games.aboutText:
Co-op Survival Sandbox meets Bullet Hell. Explore the corrupted surface on a moving base, scavenge for resources and craft GAME-BREAKING weapons using many unique modules to defeat ever-stronger foes. Fight to reclaim what The Bloom took from humanity!

IT'S rocksOVER...

Since The Bloom , the surface no longer belongs to humans. The ecosystem changed abruptly, forcing those who survived to seek shelter underground. Now, it's up to you to head back outside to harvest the power crystals that keep the bunkers alive.

Few ever get the chance to see the surface. What dangers lurk in this new world? What truly caused The Bloom ? Will you remain loyal to the corporation, or will you risk everything to uncover the truth?

The Base Moves With You

The world is too vast to remain stationary. Explore a procedurally-generated surface on a moving platform that carries you, your storage, and crafting stations through diverse biomes and ever-changing conditions.

Fight to Survive

Scavenge for resources while holding back waves of enemies. Defeat bosses to gather special materials or new weapons to get ready for even bigger foes.

Craft OP Builds

Install modules to drastically change your weapon's stats and mechanics. Tinker with countless combinations to find the perfect loadout and prepare for the unique threats of every biome.

Solo or CO-OP

It's always easier with a crew. Team up in 4-player online co-op. Join or leave whenever you want.

games.name: My Little Ranch
games.shortDescription: A cozy horse ranch that lives on your desktop while you work, or in full screen when you don't. Breed one-of-a-kind horses, send them running together, race for coins, hire ranch helpers and grow your ranch.
games.aboutText:
Turn the bottom of your screen into a small living ranch. Transparent and click-through, it stays out of the way while you work or browse. Prefer a regular window? Play it windowed or full screen with the mountain scenery and let it run.

Every horse is built from real coat colors and markings: bay, seal brown, black, gray and more, leg markings from a coronet up to full stockings, a star, stripe or bald face, tobiano and sabino patterns, and mealy or dark muzzles, plus mane, eye and hoof colors. All of it is rolled for each horse, with over 500,000 possible combinations, and horses come in three builds: the classic Stock horse, the big, sturdy Draft horse and the slim, quick Light horse. Rarity isn't a hidden number: it shows in how a horse looks. A Common horse is plain. A Legendary one wears the rarest traits.

- Foals you raise only show their coat. Their markings and rarity are revealed when they grow up.

- The Marketplace offers four new horses every hour. They arrive fully grown, and some come with a known pedigree.

- Buyers drop by, each looking for a specific kind of horse. Show them one you raised and get an offer above the market price, or try to haggle for more.

- Breed a mare and a stallion, and each foal inherits its traits from its parents. Before you pair them, the breeding screen shows the exact odds for every trait.

- Watch for surprise traits from a grandparent or a mutation, and follow every horse's family tree back to its grandparents.

Your horses graze, move, and react in real time.

Feed them hay, apples, oats and more, keep them happy, and watch your ranch flourish.

A tidy ranch is a happy ranch. Small actions lead to steady growth.

Your horses earn coins, and happy ones earn more. Collect them, or hire someone who will.

Ranch helpers clean, groom, feed and collect coins.

Send the whole group out on a run. They drift ahead and fall back like a real pack.

Runs earn Horseshoes, which you can spend on races.

Races play out on a small track, and before you enter, a prediction screen shows whether your horse is ready. Every horse keeps its own race record, and a winning record raises its price when you sell it.

Level up and expand your ranch, give each one a unique look with decorations from the Shop, and fill the Journal with every trait you've collected.

Milestones unlock Steam achievements.

From a tiny patch of grass to a thriving ranch.

My Little Ranch lives at the bottom of your screen, or fills all of it.

A calm companion to your daily routine while you work, study or relax.

Start small.

Grow peacefully.

Build your little ranch.

games.name: 5 Blocks of Happiness
games.shortDescription: When expecting mother Clementine is placed on strict bed rest, Julian decides to bring the world to her. Help him build a cozy neighborhood right outside their door. Fulfill your neighbors' daily cravings, stock adorable shops, and keep the town's Happiness high.
games.aboutText:
Build a community, one block at a time.
When Dr. Evi places Clementine on strict bed rest for the remainder of her pregnancy, expecting father Julian makes a life changing decision. If she can't go out into the world, he will bring the world to her. He sells his car, abandons his city commute, and opens a small neighborhood shop right outside their front door.

5 Blocks of Happiness is a cozy, story driven management simulation where you must help Julian build a vibrant, supportive town around their home. By fulfilling the daily cravings of your new neighbors and strategically stocking local shops, you will grow a thriving community to support this young family just in time for baby Raya's arrival. You aren't just placing buildings to fill empty space; your ultimate goal is to generate a miniature world that cares for each other.

Happiness is Everything

Your town revolves around one vital metric: the joy of its people. The success of your community depends entirely on the Town Average Happiness. Keep it above 50%, and new residents will eagerly pack their bags and move in! But be careful, if you fail to manage your shops and happiness drops, your citizens will pack up and leave.

Demand Driven Management

Listen to the locals! Every morning brings fresh challenges and randomized demands. If your neighbors wake up craving fresh milk, a new manga, or a matcha latte, you must provide it. Balance your daily budget and strategically stock your store shelves to meet their needs. Smart money management ensures no one goes home empty handed!

Expand and Upgrade (High Risk, High Reward!)
Every time a customer successfully visits a building, your town generates Vibrancy. Collect enough Vibrancy to unlock 12 unique commercial buildings, evolving your humble hamlet into a bustling heartful metropolis.

- Upgrade your businesses: Upgraded buildings provide massive Happiness bonuses to your villagers.

- Manage expectations: Higher tier buildings carry higher expectations. An empty shelf in a basic Shop is a minor annoyance, but an out of stock item at the fully upgraded Supermarket will deal a devastating blow to your town's mood!

A Cozy 3D Diorama

Enjoy a beautiful, relaxing aesthetic. Watch your little neighborhood come to life with bustling daytime activity, and take a moment to relax as the sun goes down, fireflies come out, and warm window lights illuminate the street. It’s a game about building not just a town, but a feeling.

games.name: FinCrementalOS
games.shortDescription: Blast away with a submarine’s cannon and sort your desktop for minigames in this incremental fish shooting and simulated operating system hybrid!
games.aboutText:
FincrementalOS is a hybrid incremental-fish-shooter and simulated operating system! Shoot down fish from the comfort of your submarine to collect and sell them on the market for money, then pour those funds back into your business to make more cash! Everything you need is easy to access in the built-in operating system, but configure carefully: The desktop is your window to the ocean, so the more windows you can see, the less fish you can shoot. Arrange your perfect desktop to optimize your fishing flow (Or just keep it all closed. Nothing’s stopping you)!

Combining the best parts of a punchy shooting gallery, number incrementing satisfaction, and fish collection and discovery, you use a massive submarine cannon to shoot down fish and collect them to sell on the market for profit. Use that profit to upgrade your submarine for more efficient collection, or put it into improving the ocean to uncover new types of fish and even new environments to go fishing in!

Everything you need to grow your fishing empire can be found on your submarine's built-in operating system. Open, close, and drag around the windows to your heart's content! But be careful: The only desktop you have is also your window to the open sea! Any spot a window covers is a spot you can’t shoot fish, so experiment, optimize, and create your own personalized perfect desktop to maximize your fishing flow.

Your OS has more than just business. Play a number of minigames that give unique effects ranging from paying out more money to granting consumable items that help you gather more fish! The more you can focus on at once, the more payout you’ll get. Your profits can also juice up these secondary games to make them even more profitable long-term. And maybe, if you poke around your OS enough, you’ll find out that there’s more to your submarine than meets the eye…

A number of minigames lie in wait within the submarine's computer, giving unique and powerful bonuses in exchange for your attention. Ranging from increased cash flow to consumable items, the yields are as good as the amount of time (and space) you give them. While you’re poking around the operating system and growing your fishing empire, you may also receive emails, which unravel the conspiracy behind the very submarine you’re piloting…

games.name: Split Happens
games.shortDescription: Manage an old, rundown nuclear power plant with up to 5 friends in online co-op. Fix hazards before you put the reactor in critical condition, manage the chaos to avoid a meltdown, and try not to get in the way of your coworkers.
games.aboutText:
Fix hazards using whatever tools you can get your hands on. Pipes will burst, systems will fail, and there’s never enough time to do things “the right way.” Luckily, duct tape, mops, and questionable engineering decisions are usually good enough to keep the reactor from exploding… for now.

Manage the reactor’s power by pulling the energy lever. The higher the output, the more unstable the reactor becomes, meaning more hazards, more panic, and more reasons for your coworkers to yell at you.

Not every minute has to be intense, radioactive chaos. If you manage to find a spare moment between disasters, take some time to mess around with your coworkers, dance, joke, and make a few questionable decisions that definitely won’t slow things down later.

games.name: SaviorS : Oath of the Blade
games.shortDescription: SaviorS: Oath of the Blade is a roguelite action RPG with flexible party building and deep, beat 'em up–style combat. Choose your path on the world map and combine companions, sword skills, spells, and gear to face powerful foes. Grow your favorite party and see the journey through together.
games.aboutText:
SaviorS: Oath of the Blade is a single-player roguelite action RPG featuring flexible party building and deep, beat 'em up–style combat.

Choose your destinations on a turn-based world map, then combine a diverse cast of companions, sword skills, spells, and gear to defeat the enemies in your way. Master your foes and your own abilities, and lead the party you've built to the end of your journey.

Build Your Party, Break Your Foes

Assemble your party from a diverse roster of companions, and shape your fighting style with skills, spells, and equipment. Tailor your lineup to the enemies ahead, or build around the companions you love most. Use positioning and technique on a battlefield with real depth, and stand with your allies against fearsome enemy hordes.

Your Journey, Your Route

Explore a turn-based world map and decide which region to visit next. Venture into dangerous distant lands early, or build your strength closer to home. How far can your current party go? Weigh the rewards you seek against the risks, and chart your own course.

A New World with Every Adventure

The world map, dungeon layouts, and guild quests are randomly generated. The main story anchors your journey, but the lands you explore and the quests you take on change with every run. Draw on what you learned in past adventures to plan your route and your party's growth in a brand-new world.

Find Your Breakthrough

A vast array of weapons and armor with random enchantments. Sword skills, spells, Relic Powers, buffs, and debuffs. Mix and match abilities to amplify your party's strengths and cover its weaknesses. A single new find or ability might change the way you fight next.

Learn from Defeat, Push Further

A dangerous enemy ability. A moment you weren't ready for. A combination that turned out stronger than you expected. Even when an adventure ends short of its goal, the knowledge you gain shapes your next decisions. Rethink your party, gear, route, and tactics, and return for the victory that slipped away.

Travel with Companions Who Come Alive

Pixel-art characters come alive with vivid animation, both in battle and on the road. Your companions are more than fighting strength. They're fellow travelers you'll talk with along the way. Enjoy your party's journey through the natural conversations and banter that unfold as you adventure together.

games.name: Slots & Diapers
games.shortDescription: Absurd incremental game where you turn even liquid assets into financial glory! Spin for jackpots and hire veteran gamblers to automate the madness. Use permanent upgrades and 'mishaps' to accelerate your progress! Simple. Messy. Addictive.
games.aboutText:
- Welcome to the most absurd incremental clicker game! In Slots & Diapers , you manage a casino where veteran gamblers dedicated to the spin. It’s not about luck, it’s about scaling your empire and turning every 'accident' into a calculated financial victory.

- Start with a classic machine and upgrade to high-velocity, industrial-grade slot machines. Every new tier brings bigger multipliers and faster cycles. Invest in better hardware to turn every single spin into a financial landslide.

- Why spin yourself when you can hire the pros? Recruit a crew of veteran seniors to automate the grind. They don’t need breaks; they just need a seat and a fresh 'under-layer' of protection. Let your crew handle the clicking while you watch the numbers go up!

- In this economy, everything is a resource. Your machines and seniors don't just pay out cash, they generate Liquid Assets . Don't let it go to waste! Trade your collected 'crapto-currencies' to activate powerful, limited-time boosters that supercharge your earnings!

- The rarest payout of all. Hit the elusive Mega Jackpot on any machine to extract RAM (Retired Adult Memories) . While cash and liquid assets keep the casino moving, RAM is the high-value data required for true evolution.

- The cycle of success never ends. Reset your current casino to trigger a Reboot . By closing your casino, you can spend your harvested RAM on a massive Perma-Skill Tree . Lose your machines, keep your power, and build your next empire faster, stronger, and filthier than before.

- Take your Liquid Assets to a specialized slot machine built directly inside your terminal. Risk your Assets for a chance to win all sorts of game-changing prizes and multipliers.

- Overhaul your entire financial empire according to your taste. Alter the look of your senior gamblers and change your casino floor to match your exact style.

- Is everything really as it seems? Look closely beneath the flashing lights and roaring jackpots. There is something deeper hidden behind the reels, waiting to be uncovered by those who keep playing.

- Track and rank your Liquid Asset holdings against players worldwide. Climb the global leaderboard, flex your wealth, and secure your spot at the absolute top of the financial food chain.

Don’t miss out the most absurd 'incremental' game release; wishlist today.

games.name: Robust Island
games.shortDescription: A relationship-driven farming sim with time pressure and consequences. Grow crops, raise animals, manage stamina, and build relationships while racing against daily deadlines that shape your success—or force you off the island.
games.aboutText:
A fresh start begins on Robust Island.

Leave the mainland behind and begin a new life in a close-knit island community, where farming is only the beginning of your story.

Settle into your new home, explore the island, meet its residents, and discover the rhythms of everyday life. Spend your days caring for your farm, visiting local businesses, uncovering new places, building friendships, and perhaps finding someone special along the way.

But Robust Island is more than a peaceful place to grow crops.

Every villager has a story. As you get to know the people around you, you’ll discover their hopes, struggles, families, friendships, disagreements, and dreams for the future. The island may be beautiful, but its people are still people—and your relationships with them can grow and change over time.

You’ll also begin your new life on a probationary period, giving you goals to work toward as you establish yourself within the community. Rather than simply counting the days, how you choose to spend your time—and the relationships you choose to nurture—helps shape your experience.

Farm. Explore. Build relationships. Find your place.

On Robust Island, a simpler life doesn’t mean an empty one.

Simple Days. Brighter Tomorrows.

games.name: Eilands
games.shortDescription: Create and explore your own islands. Sculpt the land, plant trees, draw paths, place and build houses. Inhabit your creations. There is no combat or management, just the joy of creating and experiencing your own island.
games.aboutText:
Eilands is a game of creative building and exploration . You shape the land and give it life using intuitive procedural generation tools. You can plant trees, draw paths, place pre-made buildings or design your own. But you do not have to admire your creations only from afar. You can jump into 3rd person mode to explore your islands up close!

CREATE YOUR OWN ISLANDS AND EXPLORE EVERY INCH

Shape the land to your liking

Plant lone trees or a whole bunch!

Carve paths through rocky cliffs or dense jungles

Place buildings and watch the landscape adapt effortlessly

Expect all this and possibly more as more features are added until release!

games.name: 光与影之恋 Chiaroscuro Lovers
games.shortDescription: A domineering CEO-like older sister who’s gentle only to her sister, a childhood friend who became her doctor, and a cheerful girl only she can see… Who was Chu Hebai before losing her memories, and how did she become entangled with them? A melancholic yuri AVG about regret and unspoken love.
games.aboutText:
Chiaroscuro Lovers is a story about memory, trauma, and love.

You will step into the world through the eyes of Chu Hebai,
entering a reality that is slowly falling apart.

Caught between memory and reality,
you will search for what has already been lost—
and what has yet to be lost.

And in the end, you may come to realize:

“This world… is a little kinder than you imagined.”

Story

“I”—Chu Hebai—lost my memory eleven years ago.

In that time, the world has changed beyond recognition.
A global catastrophe known as the “Great Collapse”
has left everything on the brink of ruin.

My family’s corporation thrived in the chaos,
gaining immense wealth—
and attracting endless conflict in return.

And yet, I alone remained abroad,
living a quiet, peaceful life for eleven years.

But that peace could never last.

The news of my grandfather’s death
calls me back to my homeland.

What awaits me there is not only loss—
but long-buried memories,
and a farewell that was never completed.

“Everyone knows Chu Hebai…except me.”

About the “Great Collapse”

A global geological disaster caused by increasingly intense tectonic activity.

Its effects continue to spread,
with no sign of stopping.

About the “Chu Group”

A powerful corporate conglomerate specializing in
extreme-environment protection technologies and biomedical science.

While it has profited greatly from the Great Collapse,
it has also become the target of both internal and external threats.

In recent years, new challenges continue to emerge.

About the “Lamplighter,” the “Psychologist,” and the “Consultation Room”

Figures and places that have lived within Chu Hebai’s mind for eleven years.

Each with their own intentions—
yet when danger comes,
they will not hesitate to light a guiding flame for her.

Features

- Emotion-driven narrative experience

- Multiple endings

- Beautiful CG artwork

Characters

Chu Hebai

CV: Linghun Monü
Age: 22

“You are the mirror of this world to me.”

The second daughter of the Chu family, once known as a prodigy.

Now suffering from psychogenic blindness,
she frequently experiences hallucinations — both auditory and visual.

Chu Heyu

CV: Yu Wei
Age: 23

“If you must hate someone… hate me.”

The eldest daughter of the Chu family and its current head.

A brilliant strategist, almost flawless in control.

She governs everything with precision—

except for certain things
she chooses not to confront.

She is gentle toward Hebai.
Perhaps… too gentle.

Yu Lin

CV: Qian Mingling
Age: 22

“You always say the strangest things…”

The current director of Chu Medical.

A rare medical genius, disciplined and deeply rational.

She believes in science, logic, and observable truth—

yet Hebai represents something she cannot fully explain.

And that uncertainty begins to change her.

The Lamplighter

CV: Yu Wei
Age: ??

“Hmm? You don’t like this story?”

A presence only Hebai can perceive.

Carefree, talkative, and endlessly amused.

She helps “illuminate” memories,
fills in the gaps,
and explains what doesn’t make sense.

She always seems to know more than she says.

And she never answers questions directly.

Some lights will be lit.

And some darkness, should not be forced into the light.
publishers: 北京黎羽科技有限公司

games.name: Rituals & War: Shan Hai
games.shortDescription: In the mountains and seas of pre-Qin myth, the way to Heaven is severed; the gods are silent. A turn-based tactical card game with hand-painted ink-wash art: read clues to enemy moves, sequence your actions each round, then cross swords on one shared timeline. One miscalculation can turn the tide.
games.aboutText:
Since the Severance of Heaven and Earth, the gods have remained silent and aberrant beasts roam unchecked.

The Lord presides over rites; the King wages war. She seeks answers from Heaven through ritual; he takes up arms and sets out on campaign.

Play as the King of ancient Shu, bound by your oath to the Lord, and set out to knock once more at the old gate to Heaven.

Play also as the Lord, who remains in Shu to ward off calamity and pray for rain, summoning the Spirit-Essences gathered on the King's journey to defend the realm.

Rituals & War: Shan Hai is a turn-based tactical card game with deckbuilding and hand-painted ink-wash art. Before each round, arrange your actions into a sequence. Once the exchange begins, your choices are final: both sides carry out their sequences along a shared timeline until the round ends.

Consider how to close the distance, when to strike, and at which step to evade — all before the first move is made.

I | Pre-set Commands · Simultaneous Resolution

Arrange your action cards to plan the round's advances, retreats, and strikes. Both sides then act along the same timeline. The order of your actions, and the distance your Stepwork opens or closes, both affect how later techniques play out.

You can use Stepwork to adjust your distance before following up with an attack. Or time a strike with the same Speed as your opponent's to trigger a Clash, canceling both attacks.
Choose each technique's place in the sequence with the enemy's intentions in mind.

II | Discernment and Communion

Your enemy does not reveal their intentions easily.

The King uses Discernment to reveal hidden enemy action cards; the Lord uses Communion to examine the opponent's card piles. Your strength relative to your opponent's determines how many cards you can reveal and how much information you can uncover.

Build your plan around what you have discovered. As for the cards still face down — how much room will you leave for the unexpected, and how much are you willing to risk?

III | Strike at the Six Pivots

Each enemy has six Parts that hold Qi — the Six Pivots — divided into Upper and Lower sections. Choose where to direct each strike. Breaking a Part with a Weak Point early can greatly weaken your opponent.

Each sword technique has its own reach. Choosing the Part is not enough: judge the distance at the moment of attack, or your blade will never find its mark.

IV | Yang Qi · Stance · Circulate Qi

Yang Qi : Chain techniques to stir your inner breath and convert Yin Qi into Yang Qi. Plan ahead so you have enough Yang Qi for a powerful technique at the moment you need it.

Stance : Your Stance grants bonuses, but you lose it when you become Qi-Severed. Restoring it takes up part of your action sequence, so you must find an opening amid the enemy's attacks.

Circulate Qi : Make room between attacks to circulate Qi through your Qi-Nodes and gain a bonus at the end of the path.

V | Build Your Thought-Stream

Sword techniques take the form of cards called Thoughts. Combine them into the Thought-Stream you bring into battle.

The four clans of ancient Shu each pass down a distinct sword tradition and a unique Stance: the Tsan's Toll, the Tsong's Cleave, the Yu's Skim, and the Fu's Thrust. As you unlock higher Stages, technique variants, and Clan Secrets, experiment with combinations of techniques and Stances to develop your own style of swordsmanship.

The two protagonists have distinct gifts, yet share a single fate.

The True Name talent tree deepens the King's mastery of Qi and the Lord's mastery of Form.

The Spirit-Essences the King gathers from the creatures he slays in Shan Hai pass to the Lord through Dream-Bestowal. With her Willow-Leaf Rite Blades, she summons them into battle.

VI | Fragments of the Truth

Broken slips of writing found among the ruins, cracks in tortoise shells, and strange tales told in the wilderness all hold clues to the distant past. Some come from mortals, some from beasts, and some from the silence of "Above."

The accounts are incomplete and often contradictory. All the clues you gather are recorded in the Codex, where you can revisit and compare them to piece together the truth. As your journey unfolds, words you have read before may take on new meaning.

Why were Heaven and Earth severed? And why, of all times, is the Blight rising now?

The way to Heaven is severed. Where shall our hearts turn?

Development Status

Rituals & War: Shan Hai is in development, with release planned for 2027. A demo will be available before launch. The interface and in-game text support English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.

Add the game to your wishlist, and we'll let you know when the demo is available.

games.name: WATERFUL: a tiny oasis builder
games.shortDescription: A relaxing puzzle game inspired by nature. Dig riverbeds to guide water through desert valleys and grow a variety of plants, then zoom in to discover hidden animals drawn to new habitats. Earn points for your discoveries and unlock new contraptions to transform the dry landscape into a lush oasis!
games.aboutText:
WATERFUL is a cozy nature-builder where you shape riverbeds to guide water through charming, procedurally generated desert valleys. Watch the sands slowly come alive as plants grow, animals return, and a tiny ecosystem blossoms on the shore.

Dig riverbeds, spread spring water and make plants grow!

Different river shapes and water levels create different vegetation. Since digging and filling is free, you can experiment freely and discover at your own pace.

Your plants will attract a variety of wild animals.

Some are easier to spot than others, and some only show up in special conditions.

You get a sticker for each new animal to add to your scrapbook, slowly turning it into a personal field guide. Will you find even the rarest animals and fill the entire book?

Water is your only real limitation, so use it well!

Connect new springs to reactivate them or upgrade existing ones to carry more water.
Unlock simple contraptions to guide water uphill and into new terrain.

Once you're happy with one valley, you can move on to the next. The terrain will grow slightly more difficult over time. Use water, contraptions, and a deepening understanding of the ecosystem to progress further and earn a high score.

There are tiny quests that you can complete to progress faster, but you’re always free to ignore them and just focus on creating a beautiful world, finding animals, and vibing.

There’s absolutely no time pressure or painstaking resource gathering in Waterful. Just you and your tiny nature diorama. If you like goal-oriented creativity at a gentle, relaxed pace, WATERFUL is the game for you!

✨ Features

🪏 Free and effortless river shaping

🌊 Satisfying water simulation

🌴 Different plant biomes & climates

🦊 Cute animals to discover & collect

📙 A sticker book for all your animals

⚙️ Simple strategic gameplay

🏜️ Tiny procedurally generated desert valleys

Hi! I'm Lenja, a solo indie dev from Berlin, Germany.

WATERFUL is my very first game - a small, personal project inspired by my travels, nature, and the idea that even dry and lost places can flourish with a little care.

It’s intentionally simple and made by just one person, so please expect a short,
focused experience rather than a large-scale simulation.

🎮 I think you will enjoy WATERFUL if you like games like:
Dorfromantik, Tiny Glade, Islanders, Terra Nil, Townscaper, or even if you don't play a lot of games at the moment. Seriously, I think your mom would probably like it too :)

Still not sure? Then wishlist now to get notified when the free demo is out, and try it for yourself!

Thanks! <3

games.name: Book Nook
games.shortDescription: Build miniature diorama scenes, piece by piece. Complete beautiful book nooks as you place furniture, decorations, and small details. Relax and enjoy the peaceful satisfaction of every detail falling into place, as you discover more about each moment in time.
games.aboutText:
Build tactile, satisfying miniature diorama scenes piece by piece in Book Nook. Complete beautiful book nooks as you place furniture, decorations, and tiny details. Relax and enjoy the peaceful reward of every detail falling into place, as you slowly unfold memories with each diorama you build.

Zen Puzzles

Take things slow and enjoy the process. There’s no timers, no pressure. Just the quiet pleasure of figuring out where each piece belongs and that gentle “click” when everything fits. Enjoy the satisfying snapping of beautifully hand drawn pieces in a comforting sensory experience. See it reveal itself over time like a jigsaw as you carefully select what goes where.

Diorama Assembly

Watch your miniature nook come together step by step. Position each element carefully, from larger furniture to delicate decorations, and see the scene gradually take shape in a soothing, hands-on way. All the satisfaction of a real craft kit, with none of the clutter.

Finishing Touches

Add personality with books, plants, ornaments, and small details. Arrange the final elements to complete each cozy corner and give every nook its own appeal. Add miniature details that add massive charm.

Learn what it means to build a life together, in this short, restful, cozy experience.

games.name: Naishitai: The parts I'm missing.
games.shortDescription: Accompany Nai in her normal Sunday routine of watching TV, eating ramen and ruminating on her past.
games.aboutText:
This is a short experience where you dwell into the mind of Nai, who is unable to let go of her past.

Naishitai is a pseudo-visual-novel that features unique mechanics to tell Nai's story. It touches on some harsh topics like suicide and self-harm in a way that might be uncomfortable for some players.

Features:

- ~30 minutes long.

- Unusual ramen eating mechanics with dynamic audio feedback system.

- Hand-drawn visuals in a pixel-perfect low resolution aesthetic mixed with live action video.

- Amazing music composed by Guest Guest and VH自杀.

games.name: False Echo
games.shortDescription: False Echo is a narrative cryptography thriller set in the darkest depths of the Stelantic, aboard a secret military submarine. Operate the Obscura machine, decode messages, and decide what gets through in a regime where even the smallest mistake means a huge death toll.
games.aboutText:
1942. The world is collapsing. War consumes everything.

You are aboard a classified submarine in the darkest depths of the Stelantic, serving in the navy of the Oppressian Empire, a military power bent on conquering the world. Your crew is cut off from the world. Cut off from the truth.

Operate the Obscura machine to process transmissions.

Adjust rotors, connect cables, align signals. Decipher the truth by the standards of the Oppressian Empire.

Use the ECHO system to classify messages as TRUE or FALSE.

Rules change every day. Orders contradict each other.

Truth has many forms, and you must find the one the regime will tolerate.

The crew is on high alert.

Conversations don’t match. Stories fall apart. No one fully trusts what they’re told.

Every interaction carries risk.

Transmissions keep coming.

If you slow down, you fall behind. If you make mistakes, others notice.

Being noticed is dangerous.

You are not here to save lives. You decide what gets through, and you live with the consequences.

Oppressia to Victory!

Features:

- Precision-based encoding and decoding

- Information control, censorship, and contradiction detection

- Constantly shifting rules and directives

- Multiple endings driven by your decisions

games.name: Bills Must Be Paid
games.shortDescription: You're broke, smash piggy banks, bills must be paid. A short active incremental game. Get money, upgrade, and get debt free!
games.aboutText:
Bills Must Be Paid is an active incremental game about paying your bills by smashing piggy banks.

Smash Piggy Banks

Smashing costs stamina. When your hand is getting tired the run is over.

Pay your bills

Bills show up. If you ignore them, bankruptcy will be your destiny. Pay them off to unlock perks that help you pay back your bills even faster.

Paying bills also gives you legacy points which you can spend on rings and bracelets to upgrade your hand after declaring bankruptcy.

Different piggy types

New types to discover. Some run away, some are too lazy to move, and others carry all the black money you never had :P...

Random loot

Piggies spawn random loot

You never know which one is holding the most, or do you?

Upgrades

A skill tree with multiple paths. Improve your grip strength, get addicted to caffeine, hit the gym, pump up your wrist, get more lucky, unlock abilities like rock rain, electrify your hammer, and more.

Different Hammers

Unlock different types of hammer. Some have higher crit chance and smaller radius, while others are super fast with big radius and less damage. Choose the one that better fits your own playstyle.

Collect rare coins

games.name: Mauled Horde
games.shortDescription: Mauled Horde is a free-to-play 1–3 player PvE horde shooter. Survive waves solo or in co-op, spend points at Citadels, and choose upgrades that change how your weapons, perks, and gadgets behave. Combine equipment to unlock build synergies and survive tougher enemies and bosses.
games.aboutText:
SURVIVE THE HORDE. BUILD YOUR WAY.

Mauled Horde is a free-to-play PvE horde shooter for 1–3 players . Fight through increasingly dangerous waves of zombies and other creatures, earn points, and spend them at Citadels to build your loadout.

Play solo or team up with friends in online co-op. Choose how to evolve your weapons, perks, and gadgets as the enemies become tougher.

CHOOSE YOUR UPGRADES

Your build develops throughout each run.

Merchant offers change between waves , so not every weapon, perk, or gadget is available at the same time. Spend your points carefully and adapt your plans to the equipment you find.

- Weapons: Each weapon offers four different upgrades, but you can install up to two. Add burning rounds, explosive effects, freezing attacks, gravity-based abilities, and more.

- Perks: Improve your character with abilities that affect health, reloading, movement, melee combat, and equipment. Each merchant perk has two alternative evolutions, but you can choose only one.

- Gadgets: Deploy combat drones, protective domes, automated turrets, and other support devices. Upgrade them to change how they behave in battle.

Your choices determine whether your build focuses on damage, crowd control, mobility, or survival.

UNLOCK BUILD SYNERGIES

Certain combinations of weapons, perks, and gadgets unlock additional effects automatically when you have the required equipment.

For example:

- Toxic Combustion: Combine Hellfire with the Neurotoxin Corruptor to create explosions when ignited enemies are caught in your poison.

- Close Quarters: Combine the Pump shotgun with Bonus Health to recover health from close-range kills.

- Overwatch: Mark enemies with the Widowmaker and let your Auto Turret finish them to trigger an explosion.

Experiment with different combinations to discover builds that complement your playstyle.

DEFEAT BOSSES. CHOOSE YOUR REWARDS.

Face special enemy waves, dangerous creatures, and boss encounters.

After defeating a boss, each player gets a personal choice of up to three boss perks at the end of the wave. These rewards remain active for the rest of the run and can become part of your build.

PLAY SOLO OR IN CO-OP

Fight alone or with up to two friends.

If no public lobbies are available, AI-Assisted Matchmaking lets you start a session with a companion bot. Other players can join, and the bot makes room when the team reaches three human players.

Switch between first-person and third-person views during gameplay.

SURVIVE LONGER

Fight across different arenas, use environmental traps, and adapt to a variety of enemies with different attacks and abilities.

Earn experience, unlock character skins through player progression, and challenge your personal records and Steam leaderboards.

FREE TO PLAY

Mauled Horde is planned to remain free-to-play. Optional in-game purchases are intended to be cosmetic character skins, without gameplay advantages.

TRY THE FREE DEMO

A free demo is available on Steam.

Mauled Horde is developed by a solo developer, and feedback on combat, progression, balance, and co-op gameplay helps guide its development.

Try the demo and add Mauled Horde to your wishlist to follow its progress.

STORY

In a world on the brink of collapse, dimensional portals have torn open the fabric of reality, unleashing endless waves of monstrous entities. You are one of the last defenders, fighting to contain the invasion and uncover the origin of the portals. Each wave brings stronger enemies and greater threats, pushing humanity closer to extinction. How long can you survive, and how many waves can you hold back before the darkness consumes everything?

ABOUT ELEMENTS GAMES

Mauled Horde is developed entirely by a single person who is passionate about creating an enjoyable and evolving experience. Despite being a one-man team, I’m committed to delivering regular updates and improvements based on community feedback.

JOIN THE COMMUNITY ON DISCORD

Stay connected, share feedback, and be part of the development journey.

Join the Mauled Horde Playtest now, and add the game to your wishlist to follow its development!

games.name: The Kingsward
games.shortDescription: Explore an open-world Sandbox RPG with isometric ARPG combat, a flexible hybrid class system, and an epic story with satirical humor. Create your own build and seek the legendary Kingsward.
games.aboutText:
The Kingsward combines an open-world RPG with isometric ARPG mechanics, delivering an epic adventure with a strong humorous and satirical tone.

Explore diverse ecosystems, discover a vast world with secrets around every corner , customize your character with a hybrid class system , gather resources, craft gear… and embark on the quest for the legendary Kingsward to save the kingdom from the king’s stupidity!

A Vast Open World to Explore

Explore a massive world filled with:

- Unique items hidden in remote corners of the map

- Dungeons, caves, and puzzles with distinct challenges

- More than 7 distinct macro-zones

- Hundreds of enemies
