Find a secret cave in a mountain , a one-of-a-kind magical ring inside a chest after leaping off a cliff, a magic sword buried beneath a waterfall, or a strange character with a unique quest in a cabin in the middle of nowhere.

The world is packed with things to discover!

Hybrid Class System

- 3 playable races

- 16 unlockable subclasses

Shape your own playstyle:

- Mix abilities across different classes

- Unlock new options as you level up

- Gain unique traits

- Train weapon masteries to define your combat style

No rigid builds. You decide how it plays:

A hypocritical paladin who uses zombies in combat
A stealthy hunter wearing 60 tons of iron armor
A mage who punches enemies with bare fists
A warrior addicted to magical staves

A true RPG!

Gather, Craft, and Trade

- Gather materials in the world, craft and upgrade your gear

- Level up your professions: mining, gathering, crafting, mercantilism.

- Create your own trade routes!

Hundreds of Items

- Swords, daggers, staves, hammers, spears, axes, two-handed axes, bows, two-handed swords, scythes, and fist weapons.

- Heavy, medium, and cloth armor.

- Every ring in the game has a unique, one-of-a-kind effect . No "+4 mana"—rings call down lightning on your enemies.

Epic Story… With a Twist

A narrative that avoids genre clichés.

Developed alongside stand-up comedians, The Kingsward delivers an epic, satirical story packed with memorable dialogue. Expect as much drama as comedy.

The game was written around a simple critique: characters in games rarely say anything interesting.

So every line of dialogue has been carefully crafted with intent!

Every NPC has something to say… and it’s worth hearing.

Optimized for PC and Handhelds

Designed to deliver a smooth experience on both desktop PCs and handheld devices.

We’re Not Here to Rip You Off!

- No microtransactions

- Affordable price

- No Artificial Intelligence

- Free updates

games.name: Someday Youll Get There(언젠가는 도착해)
games.shortDescription: All the monsters on the ground were defeated, yet the world was not at peace. With a beam of light rising over the field, the protagonist’s precious belongings—bag, sneakers, diary, even a hairpin—scattered into the sky. With everything gone upward, the only way left is to climb.
games.aboutText:
🎮 Story

After defeating all the monsters on the ground, the world seemed to have finally found peace.

However, a beam of light rose from the schoolyard, and with it, the protagonist’s precious belongings scattered into the sky.

To retrieve what she lost and return home, she begins her climb upward.

Toward the place she believes she will one day reach.

🎮 Game Features

✔ One Goal: Reach 1,111m

Keep climbing upward while collecting coins along the way.
Use the coins you gather to combine various buffs and create your own unique build.

Different buff combinations lead to entirely different play styles.
Climb faster and more efficiently than anyone else to reach the summit.

✔ Endless Battle Mode (Special Mode)

Relentless waves of monsters give you no time to rest.

In this never-ending battle,
develop your own strategy and set a new high score.

✔ Partner (Pet) System

You are not alone.

Upload your own image and climb together with your personalized partner (pet).

※ Supported formats: JPG / PNG / GIF (Maximum size: 300 × 300)

✔ Pixel Art + Analog Aesthetic

A charming world brought to life with cute pixel art.

Retro-inspired colors and smooth animations create a warm atmosphere,
even during intense battles.

games.name: Catrium
games.shortDescription: This idle anomaly management game is set in the bottom right corner of the screen and progresses at a leisurely pace. Grow and manage the mysterious cat-like substance "Catrium" at your leisure, earn money, and upgrade your lab.
games.aboutText:
「Catrium」は、画面の右下に設置されてゆっくりと進行していく、ながら放置型アノマリー管理ゲームです。

自由気侭で不思議な猫型物質「キャトリウム」を増やして管理して、お金を稼いで研究所をアップグレードしましょう。

プレイヤーは管理人となって、キャトリウムと研究所と、研究員の管理をする事になります。

◆キャトリウムをお迎えする

雨の日にバケツを置いておくと猫雨が溜まり、雨猫種のキャトリウムが自我を持ち、誕生します。

研究所に住み着いたキャトリウムは、自由気侭に生活し、家の中をうろついたり、家具を使って遊んだり寝たりします。

沢山増やして賑やかな家にしましょう。

しかし自由気侭なキャトリウム…思い通りには動いてくれないかもしれません。

◆研究所をアップグレードする

キャトリウムのための家具や研究所の設備を買うにはお金が必要です。

キャトリウムは晴れの日には家の外に出掛け、色々な物を拾ってきます。

売ってお金にして、更に良い環境作りをしていきましょう。

キャトリウムの幸せは人類の幸せ…。

◆キャトリウムを改変しよう

キャトリウムの色や柄、特性は、自我を持った瞬間に決まる。

しかしキャトリウム自身の想いとは関係なく決まってしまう。

キャトリウムは様々な色や特性を楽しみたいようです。

時には、管理人の好きなように改変するのも良いかもしれません。

games.name: Square Mining Builder
games.shortDescription: Build a village inside the mine of your dreams! Collect resources, catalog up to 200 different rare ores, manage your villagers and face random events, all in a procedural map with cozy pixel art!
games.aboutText:
ORGANIZE

In this game, you’re in control! Decide exactly what your villagers' work priorities will be.

BUILD, BUILD, AND... BUILD

A wide variety of buildings are available to customize your gameplay—from ore carts to roads and housing for your villagers.

MINE RARITIES

Discover 200+ different types of ores , categorized into classes that define their rarity and value.

LEVERAGE TECHNOLOGY

Unlock new technologies using your in-game experience, allowing you to customize and mold the gameplay to your liking.

FACE MONSTERS

From sneaky snakes to cavernous beasts, protect your villagers from threats and keep your workflow steady.

OVERCOME RANDOM EVENTS

Random events make every playthrough completely unique. Watch out for everything from cave-ins to accidental explosions!

games.name: One Must Rule
games.shortDescription: An empire-building auto-battler set in a harsh medieval settlement where every strategic command shapes your kingdom’s fate. Build your empire from the council table, discover game-breaking card synergies, and battle against rival players. Every choice counts, only one will rule!
games.aboutText:
Take control of your chosen ruler and guide their rise from a simple settlement to a massive empire. Rule from the council table, discover game-breaking synergies, and conquer the asynchronous PvP arena. Every choice carries weight, only one will stand!

Every decree you sign at the council table shapes the fate of your army on the open battlefield. Choose and upgrade your cards, combine powerful synergies, and bear the responsibility of your choices as your tactical decisions turn into chaotic victories or crushing defeats.

 

Select your leader and command unique starting values and Special Abilities. Adapt your strategy to each Ruler’s distinct strengths, leverage their advantages at the council table, and forge a tailored path to victory in every run.

games.name: Seven Nights Ghost 2
games.shortDescription: "This Love, This Curse — Only 7 Days Left" Live together with a flashy ghost girl for seven days—and survive her over-the-top love attacks. A stylish, slightly dark, yet heartfelt horror romance about youth, fear, and self-control.
games.aboutText:
This Love, This Curse — Only 7 Days Left

Live together with a flashy ghost girl for seven days—

and survive her over-the-top love attacks.

A stylish, slightly dark, yet heartfelt horror romance about youth, fear, and self-control.

A flashy high‑school girl ghost suddenly appears in your home and begins enjoying life with you—completely uninvited.

She will never take your life.

After all, for reasons unknown, she has fallen deeply in love with you.

But you are a high school teacher.

Any inappropriate incident would destroy your career and social standing.

Keep your distance, resist her advances, and survive seven nights without letting your life fall apart.

Explore your home in first-person and complete nightly missions to make it through each day.

The ghost is always looking for chances to get closer.

Too much physical contact is strictly forbidden—run away when necessary.

Stop her from bringing her belongings into your house

and from posting your photos on social media.

Protect your peaceful, ordinary life at all costs.

March, just before graduation.

Without warning, a ghost in a school uniform appears in your home.

The uniform belongs to a student from your school—

yet you don’t recognize her face.

As confusion sets in, the ghost gently takes your hand.

Inside is a short message:

“Just seven days.”

Can you protect your morals and your career?

And where will this bold ghost girl’s unwavering affection lead?

A strange seven-day cohabitation

where fear and affection slowly invade everyday life.

"Live Streaming Mode" for Streamers

A dedicated feature lets streamers prompt their viewers to send supportive comments, adding extra excitement to your broadcast.

Perfect for creators who want to engage their audience.

(The mode can be toggled on or off in the settings.)

games.name: Dubai Chewy Cookie Simulator
games.shortDescription: You opened a little dessert café, and now the line runs down the street! Make Dubai chewy cookies by hand, ring up every order, and run the whole place on your own in this hectic first-person management sim set in a Korean university neighborhood.
games.aboutText:
Dubai Chewy Cookie Simulator is a first-person management sim where you do it all: make the cookies, pack the orders, take the payments, and run the café. You're the owner, the cook, and the cashier. Can you keep it all running with just two hands?

Shell the pistachios and grind them down, melt the marshmallows, stir in the cocoa, then roll and coat each cookie by hand. From opening the delivery boxes to filling the tray, every step is yours.

Take the orders, ring them up on the POS, and get the cookies across the counter. Serve the customer in front of you, or make more cookies for the next one? Deciding what comes first is the job.

Order ingredients on your tablet, get them delivered to your door, and keep up with your loan repayments. How much to order, how many cookies to prepare, and where everything goes on the shelves is up to you.

A Korean university side street of low-rise apartments and little shops is your workplace, from day to night. It looks familiar, but a few odd moments are waiting between the orders.

Your customers are waiting, boss!

games.name: False Flame
games.shortDescription: Single player social deduction auto battler where YOU are the impostor. Steer two hidden cultists through a colony under siege: win your party’s trust, then murder whoever trusts you most. Kill too many and the siege takes you all. Plan the perfect kill, bluff your way out, then get away with it.
games.aboutText:
YOU are the impostors

False Flame is a single-player betrayal game where you control two hidden killers: build trust by day, murder the ones who trust you most, and bluff your way through court at night.

Gather the Party

Assign gear and upgrades to your party members, split them between two lanes, and venture forth to gather resources. Manage your relationships and defend the base from enemies. But your true objective is to...

Wear the Mask

In False Flame, the most valuable kills are the ones nobody saw coming.

The more the victim trusted you, the more valuable the kill and the closer you get to victory. Earn trust by fighting alongside them and smooth-talking them over dinner. Plan your kills wisely, because you just might need that person to survive the siege.

Build social capital in public. Create alibis by staying seen. Then spend that credibility on crimes that leave the colony staring at anyone but you.

Gaslight the Court

Accusations are based on memories of witnessed events, rumors, and relationships. Defend or denounce the accused in court to swing the votes.

After the verdict, see who voted which way and why. Learn the colony's logic… then exploit it the next night.

Key Features

* Single-player social deduction with NPCs with dynamic dialogue and memory

* Chat directly with your party in your own words: words spoken and actions judged by a locally embedded AI, playable offline

* Dual-body possession gameplay: control one Cultist directly while coordinating your second partner

* Alibis, rumors, and witness logic: build "innocence" on purpose, then weaponize it.

* A fixed cast: seven core characters with consistent personalities, tells, and breaking points, reshuffled roles and secrets every run

games.name: Pigs On Wings
games.shortDescription: Pigs On Wings is an open-world cooperative flight sim featuring extraction mechanics and global guerrilla warfare. Work together to pilot a temperamental aircraft: battle ground forces, deliver cargo, repair systems, and upgrade your gear.
games.aboutText:
Pigs on Wings is a hardcore cooperative flight sim with extraction mechanics. Set in an open world where medieval life is being upended by mysterious new forces, you must join the crew of a makeshift aircraft, defy the occupiers, and try to make it home alive.

KEY FEATURES:

Risk and Reward: Every sortie is a one-way ticket unless you make it back to base. Fight, complete missions, and scavenge for precious resources and blueprints in occupied lands. But beware: if you lose control or get shot down, your hard-earned loot will be buried under the wreckage.

Your Plane is Your Fortress: Repair the engine and patch up the wings mid-flight. Keep a constant eye on your fuel to reach the base, or make a gut-wrenching decision to crash-land and save what you can. Upgrade and modify your craft, transforming a "flying crate" into the terror of the skies.

True Camraderie: You’re not just a pilot; you’re part of a crew. While one mans the controls, another monitors the engine, and a third fends off attackers. Coordinate, communicate, and be ready for the engine to stall or the gunner to run dry at the worst possible moment.

A World of Secrets: Explore an open world held by an unknown army. The enemy is rapidly evolving their air defenses—don't be surprised if you face something... inhuman alongside bows and catapults. Who is behind this war? What strange magic powers their machines?

Freedom of Flight: From the moment you take off, the world is yours to explore. Take on peaceful errands for local farmers, deliver cargo, or engage in high-stakes assaults on fortified bastions. You define the difficulty of your own adventure.

Progression is Key: Master the invaders' technology, unlock new parts and aircraft upgrades, and expand your airbase infrastructure. Remember: every success in the sky is built on the tireless work of your ground engineers.

Can you spread your wings where others have fallen?

games.name: Perry's Pizzeria
games.shortDescription: Build the ultimate pizza deck! Collect ingredient cards, create delicious pizzas, discover massive flavor combos, satisfy quirky customers, unlock new chefs, and upgrade your restaurant in this tasty deckbuilding roguelike.
games.aboutText:
Perry's Pizzeria is a pizza deckbuilding roguelike where you collect ingredients, create delicious pizzas and satisfy hungry customers!

- The definitive pizza deckbuilding experience.

- Discover ingredient cards on your runs - bases, sauces, toppings, effects and appetizers!

- Do you serve a pizza now, or risk another turn to make it perfect before your customer’s hunger takes over?

- Combine positional effects and ingredient synergies to create enormous taste combos!

Meet and serve quirky customers, each with their own preferences and abilities. Put cigars on pizzas, navigate bizarre customer demands and attempt to satisfy a sentient cloud of flies!

- Build powerful decks around tasty synergies like meat, dairy, vegetables, fungi, and more!

- Discover varied encounters that let you grow, shape, and refine your deck of ingredients.

- Upgrade your restaurant between runs to create even more delicious pizzas and take on tougher customers!

- Unlock and train a cast of unique chefs, each with their own starting deck and playstyle!

games.name: Which Sausage, Mate?
games.shortDescription: You lost your coal mine job, now you're a cashier at Poland's landmark convenience store. Scan groceries, verify IDs, grill hot dogs, and try to feed your family on what's left. A dark comedy about surviving late stage capitalism, one receipt at a time.
games.aboutText:
You're Kazio , an ex-coal miner, husband, father, and the newest cashier at Żopka , the iconic neighbourhood convenience store chain. Your job is simple: serve the customers, follow the rules, don't get fired. The real challenge is harder: keep a family fed on a cashier's wage.

WORK THE REGISTER.

Scan stock from a catalogue of 800+ products across 24 categories, check documents, grill hot dogs, count out change down to the last grosz. Easy enough, until corporate starts piling on regulations. Suddenly you're enforcing the age limit on energy drinks, validating coupons and loyalty cards, charging for the plastic bag and catching expired student IDs. The queue grows, the clock runs down...

And the customers don't make it any easier. Over 100 unique characters: from smooth-talking businessmen and dealers offering a bribe, through impatient Karens, tracksuit philosophers paying in loose change and shoplifters, to a mohair-bereted grandma, a suspiciously large proboscis monkey and the winos camped outside the door. Every one of them there to test your patience.

WORK THE SYSTEM.

Your mother needs surgery, your son needs money for a school trip, winter is coming and the heating bill doubles. After each shift you take home whatever you earned and split it five ways: rent, food, medicine, school, heating.

...Or invest the profit back into the store, as befits a "co-owner". You start in the Shanty : a flickering fluorescent tube, wire shelving, cracked linoleum and 60 slots for stock. The shelves empty out mid-shift and the delivery rolls in right in the middle of the queue. The catalogue holds 40 upgrades, but only 24 fit in one store, and every level is a choice between two variants that change the way you play. At the end of the road stands the gleaming, neon-lit Cyber-Żopka with 140 shelf slots, the one corporate would be proud of.

CHECK THE DATE.

Six holidays, 85 days a year: on Fat Thursday the doughnuts are laid out on the counter, at Easter a butter lamb stands there instead, on the first of November grave candles burn in the window and customers you haven't seen here in a very long time drop in, and on New Year's Eve the sky above the estate lights up. Every holiday means 24 seasonal products on the shelves, its own interior decorations and a dressed-up main menu.

AND MAKE IT WORK WELL.

Accept the bribe or report it. Join the union or stay loyal. Save up for your mother's surgery or for a new counter. Over 30 days your decisions add up to one of 9 endings : some hopeful, some devastating, and one that crowns you emperor of Żopka. Each unlocks its own New Game Plus bonus, and the full set of nine earns you a tenth.

The ending isn't the end. Żopka Forever starts on day 31, no story and no finish line, with Steam leaderboards. I'm Hardcore switches on every regulation from day one and never lets you buy your way out of a citation. And two completely different stores are waiting in the menu: 1670 and 2077 , each with its own stock, its own cast and its own rules. In 1670 you sell oscypek cheese, starka and Capuchin friars' tobacco, and the freshest press on the counter is Merkuriusz Polski. Nobody orders a hot dog, because there is nothing yet to make one out of. In 2077 Żopka glows with neon, bread comes out of a printer, the kabanos is synthetic, and you never give change, because nobody here pays cash any more.

WHAT'S IN THE BOX

- A 30-day story campaign, from tutorial calm to full bureaucratic panic

- 15 policies piled on along the way, each one another chance to screw something up

- 800+ products across 24 categories, from oscypek cheese to bootleg DVDs, including over 100 regional specialities

- Document checks: six types, swapped photos, fake PESEL numbers and the legendary Bolsat Passport

- A budget system where every złoty makes a difference

- Three mini-games woven into the shift: counting out change, the grill and sorting parcels at the Paczkobox

- 40 store upgrades, 24 of them per playthrough, because every level is a choice between two

- Over 100 unique characters, from Karens and tracksuit philosophers to a proboscis monkey

- Six holidays from the real calendar, almost half a thousand seasonal products

- Two extra game modes, 1670 and 2077: different rules, different products, different customers

- 9 endings, each with a New Game Plus bonus, plus Żopka Forever and I'm Hardcore

- 125 items to find, 130 clickable nooks and crannies and 18 random events

- Steam leaderboards and 69 achievements

- Full gamepad support

- Translations into regional languages: Silesian, Kashubian, Poznań dialect

games.name: Spellogger
games.shortDescription: A slow-paced, cozy fantasy RPG where you play as a Wizard Lumberjack. Take on daily tasks and upgrade your character in a relaxing work cycle similar to Stardew Valley, while setting out on Elder Scrolls-style quests and exploration.
games.aboutText:
EXPLORE A SMALL BUT DENSE OPEN WORLD

Explore a roughly ~1.5 km² map. It's smaller than you average open world game, but far more dense and filled with secret items to be found. Think Skyrim -like exploration combined with the day-to-day tasks like Stardew Valley.

BUILD AND CULTIVATE YOUR HOMESTEAD

Build and repair your farm, gather materials in able to build new crafting stations. You can learn to fish, mining and even plant and harvest food which will all aid you in the main task of taking down tree's.

EXPERIENCE INCREMENTAL PROGRESSION IN A COZY FIRST-PERSON RPG

Level up through exploration, taking down tree's, doing quests and technically everything else you can do in the game. Master skill-trees like Lumbermancy, Sawmanism, Barkane Magic and many more, each unlocking unique powers!

AID NEIGHBORS IN ELDER SCROLLS-STYLE QUESTLINES

Accept multi-stage questlines from NPC's with real personalities, motivations and storylines. Learn about the mysterious land called the Dale, in where you find yourself living. Live your life in this seemingly perfect world in which you mysteriously woke up in.

games.name: Beat For Speed
games.shortDescription: Turn any song into a playable rhythm ride! Import your favorite music or play along with your device's audio in Live Audio Mode. Discover official tracks from indie artists, climb the leaderboards, create custom levels in the Level Editor, and explore endless community levels on Steam Workshop.
games.aboutText:
Indie Game × Indie Music

Music is at the heart of Beat For Speed and we believe great music deserves to find its audience. We're excited to bring you songs from independent artists and labels, including Epidemic Sound, Kitty Ray, Sunday Cruise and The Pom-Poms through Lauren Records, alongside indie rock band tears please and more.

Experience their music through handcrafted rhythm levels, and discover your next favorite artist along the way.

🐱 A Special Gift for Early Riders!

Purchase Beat For Speed and launch the game for the first time within the first 14 days after release to receive 1 of 6 randomly selected kitties as your little riding buddy!

Turn Any Song Into a High-Speed Rhythm Ride

Import your favorite songs and transform them into playable racing experiences.

Beat For Speed is a rhythm game where every beat becoms a challenge. Ride through dynamic tracks generated from your songs, from genres like Pop, K-Pop to Hip-Hop, Rock, EDM and more. Every song becomes a brand new ride.

Play Your Music, Ride in Real Time!

With Live Audio Mode , music playing on your PC becomes a rhythm ride in real time. Open your favorite music app or browser player, put on a playlist and start riding. No song import needed.

Prefer local files? You can also import your favorite songs and turn them into playable tracks.

We spent countless hours creating thousands of handcrafted levels and built our own system based on that experience. Designed to recognize musical structures, rhythmic patterns and energy changes across different music genres, it transforms your songs into unique tracks.

Create, Share and Discover Endless Community Content

With full Steam Workshop support, explore a growing library of community-created experiences or create your own. It never ends.

Steam Workshop & Editor

- Massive Custom Levels: Discover custom tracks created by players worldwide in Steam Workshop.

- Custom Protagonist Models: Personalize your experience by importing unique character models.

- Level Editor: Use our built-in Level Editor to manually craft rhythm masterpieces with frame-perfect precision.

Share your creations with the community!

Climb the Leaderboards

See how high you can score and compete with players all over the world. Whether you're climbing the rankings or beating your personal best, there's always another reason to ride again.

Find Your Flow Through Music

Every lane shift, collision, and dodge movement is synchronized with the rhythm. Put on something fast and test your reflexes, or pick something mellow and enjoy the scenery. Ride through cities, forests, coastlines and snowy mountains, with different weather and skies to match your mood.

Put on your favorite song. Let’s ride.

games.name: FluxWerks
games.shortDescription: Every block of this planet is real, including fluids! Dig it, flood it, process it. FluxWerks is a factory automation game on a fully destructible voxel world with physical fluid and heat simulation. Dig anywhere, automate everything, and survey a world that was supposed to be empty.
games.aboutText:
The terrain in FluxWerks is not just a static backdrop. Strip-mine a mountain into nothing, then build your factory down into its place. Dig below a lake and the water pours in behind you. Heat is fully simulated and crosses from block to block, and storms wear down every machine you leave in the open.

^^^ Try out the demo from the green banner above ^^^

Demo is always up to date and your demo save games can be continued on the full game. No progress is lost.

The scan said this world was empty

A long-range scan found a temperate, oxygen-rich, unoccupied world. You are the preparation unit, sent far ahead to raise an industrial base, survey the planet, and transmit everything home. The orders are simple. But a scan taken from that far away does not catch everything, and the closer you look at this world, the less empty it seems...

Key features

Total voxel freedom

Every block in the world can be mined, moved, or built over. Strip-mine a mountain with excavators, carve a bunker into deep rock, or build a platform across the open ocean and a tunnel underneath it.

Dynamic fluid simulation

Water, oil, lava and acid flow through the world and react where they meet. Water on lava makes obsidian. Water on hot ground boils away. Volcanoes erupt for real, and lava does not care what you built in its path.

Heat is physical

Waste heat does not just vanish away. It moves through the blocks around your machines, so how and where you build matters as much as what you build. Pipe the heat away, or turn it back into power.

Deep automation and logistics

Build dense assembly lines from belts, inserters and pipes, and cover long distances with cargo drones. Copy any working section of your factory as a blueprint and stamp it anywhere.

The nanobot swarm

You interact with the world through a nanobot swarm. Point it at terrain to clear it, at resources to harvest them, at a blueprint to print it.

Your exhaust does not just disappear

FluxWerks has no enemy factions, but the planet is affected by your actions. Pollute the air heavily enough and something dormant in the soil might awaken...

Explore a world with a past

Cross deserts, jungles, tundra and volcanic wastes, and dig into cave systems. Scan for ore and search points of interest scattered across the world, with story background to uncover.

Weather wears things down

Rain, blizzards, sandstorms and lightning cross the world on their own schedule, and machines wear out with exposure.

Research across eras

Climb from your first furnace to industrial chemistry and advanced electronics. Every research era requires a noticeably bigger factory than the last, and each one unlocks machines that change how you build, not just how fast you build.

The computing layer

Advanced machines draw on a shared computing reserve produced by your computer clusters. A starved factory slows down, and computers draw real power and put out real heat, so datacenter management becomes a real puzzle to solve.

Built for scale

FluxWerks is designed for large factories, while still simulating the heat and fluids across the whole map. Fly freely around the world while the factory keeps running.

games.name: Stinker Golf
games.shortDescription: An online 1-16 player destructive golf game where you build the course while you play. Annoy your friends without ruining the hole for yourself, all inside a fully physics simulated pixel world.
games.aboutText:
Stinker Golf is an online 1-16 player destructive golf game where you build the course while you play. Annoy your friends without ruining the hole for yourself, all inside a fully physics simulated pixel world.
Before every hole, players build obstacles, modify terrain, and place particles before playing the hole again. Each time becoming more chaotic as the course evolves into an unpredictable mess of hazards, destruction, and sabotage. GPU powered physics based pixel sandbox destruction. Blow holes through the the ground, place sand in the hole, or create a rain cloud that floods the course.

Build your own holes and courses, using the ingame editor. Share creations with friends and play community made maps for endless replayability.

- Online multiplayer for 1–16 players

- Fully destructible simulated pixel world

- Dozens of obstacles, terrains, particles, items, zones and more to annoy your friends

- Course editor and custom holes

- Thousands of golfer outfit customization combos

- Endless replayability through community content

games.name: Patchland
games.shortDescription: Patchland is a relaxing strategy game where you create your own world by building it from scratch using tiles. Connect various biomes, earn points, complete quests, and add animals to the map to create increasingly larger and more beautiful landscapes.
games.aboutText:
Patchland is a relaxing strategy game where you create your own world by building it from scratch using tiles. Connect various biomes, earn points, complete quests, and add animals to the map to create increasingly larger and more beautiful landscapes.

In Patchland you start with an empty space and a small supply of tiles. You slowly expand your landscape by adding more elements. It is a game without rush and without great challenges, perfect to sit down, relax, and occupy your mind with pleasant tile placement.

Match areas

The gameplay is based on a simple mechanic of placing tiles with different types of terrain. Every new element on the board means additional points on your account. If you care about a better score, try to connect the same areas together. The larger uniform terrain you create, the more points you will get.

Complete tasks to keep playing

Your initial supply of tiles is limited. For the fun to continue, you must collect points. After reaching a certain score, simple tasks will appear on the board. Complete them, and as a reward, you will receive more tiles for your pool. Thanks to this, you can calmly continue building.

Add animals

During the game, you will also achieve global goals. You receive special tokens for them, which you can exchange for animals. When you place them on your map, you will gain useful facilities and bonuses that will help you score and maintain the flow of the game.

Main features of the game:

- Your own world: Build from scratch and shape beautiful, unique landscapes from the available tiles.

- Peaceful pace: Play at your own rhythm, without stress, rush, or time limits.

- Pleasant puzzle: Connect matching terrains, earn points, and complete tasks so the game can last as long as possible.

- Living world: Collect tokens from global goals and bring the board to life with animals that will provide you with useful bonuses.

games.name: One Death at a Time
games.shortDescription: One Death at a Time is a first-person exploration game. You play as John, in the middle of a midlife crisis. A suspicious milk carton offers you a wish in exchange for 14 souls… but because you're a good person, you'll have to die yourself and explore the city in search of 14 ways to do it.
games.aboutText:
Death is a topic everyone tries to avoid. An inevitable end. Something that reminds us that everything comes to an end.

But what if the objective of a game were to die?

One Death at a Time © is a short game where you explore a large city to find funny, grotesque, and hilarious ways to die. Being run over by a car as if it were bowling… with you? Being brutally crushed by a piano? Or being ground up in a meat grinder?

It all starts when a suspicious milk carton makes you an offer: if you collect 14 souls who have died in different ways, he will grant you a wish. But since he knows you're a model citizen… he proposes a much simpler alternative: die yourself.

If you don't believe it, stop reading and see for yourself.

Features:

- Between half and an hour of gameplay

- A city full of places and buildings to explore

- Dark humor with a colorful aesthetic

- 14 different ways to die scattered throughout the city

- Surprises (and maybe a shock or two) in each new death you discover.

- An unexpected ending

games.name: Menhera Maiden
games.shortDescription: A ‘Landmine × Yuri’ Visual Novel. To complete your master's thesis, you are forced to interact with these landmine girls—a decision that may well prove to be the most disastrous of your life. Your dialogue and choices will not only shape your relationships with the heroines, but also your thesis.
games.aboutText:
【Synopsis】

June—a season when one feels faintly haunted by the spirits of spring.

To avoid total ruin, you have but one option: you must speak to a ‘Landmine-type Girl’!

As for why—“Understanding Yami Culture through ‘Landmine-type Girl’” is the title of your thesis.

A year ago, you—a self-proclaimed otaku—came to Japan to study, and now you are set to graduate this summer.

To graduate successfully, you must complete your master’s thesis.

With only 62 days remaining, you have never actually interacted with a ‘Landmine-type Girl’, and your progress stands at 【0】!

With time running out, you’ve come to Shukushin, determined to strike up a conversation with “girls who look like they might be ‘Landmine-type Girl’”.

You’ll encounter three girls… and this might just be the worst choice you’ve ever made.

※ In this work, the term “Landmine-type Girl” is used in its broadest sense.

【Heroines】

Three Landmine-type girls, each with their own distinct style.

・■■■■ (Pink): A girl with half her hair pink and half white.

・■■■■ (Blue): A girl dressed in what is known as ‘angel-style’ clothing.

・■■■■ (Purple): The ‘Landmine-type Girl’ you are most familiar with.

【Gameplay】

Traditional visual novel gameplay, text-based with branching dialogue options.

Your conversations and choices will not only affect your relationships with the heroines, but also determine the fate of your thesis.

【Staff】

Planning/Script: 月次少女病

Characters/CG/UI/LOGO: 深夜高速

Direction/Programming: 长山香奈

games.name: Crackheads
games.shortDescription: Explore the marvelous world of Crackheads alone or with up to 50 players. Team up, turn on your friends, make money, build your empire, scavenge trash for questionable meals, and stay high through all of it.
games.aboutText:
Steal Copper Pipes, Shopping Carts, Drugs, ROB ATM'S, STEAL TRASH

Do all kinds of stuff to break the law. Who's going to stop you?

Clubs, Houses, Meth Dens, Swamps, Construction Sites, PVE Survival aspects, EVENTS, ALIEN STUFF

Hand crafted areas with lots to do and things to discover. Or just cause chaos. Cook food to manager your energy, or sell it. Scavenge junk and sell it.

Pan Handling Stations, Achievements, Cosmetics, Gambling, COOKING, Side Walk Sales

Tons of ways to earn money, AND spend it. Cook your own food, live off the land.

Crack Rock, Special - k, H, Meth, Shrooms, Beer, Cheap Liquor

Tons of different drugs and alcohol with effects on your Crackhead. Hell even combine em, see what happens.

games.name: Idols of Ash
games.shortDescription: Grapple, clamber and fall thousands of meters down into a dark and ancient place in this first-person horror climbing game. You are being hunted.
games.aboutText:
Descend thousands of meters into a dark and ancient place.

You are being hunted.

Features

- First-person physics-based climbing system with a grappling hook

- Hunted by a huge monster in an ancient mega-structure

- Unlockable difficulty modes including additional content

- Atmospheric visuals and audio

- Approximately 20-40 minutes to complete on Normal

games.name: Beer Barons
games.shortDescription: From a small-time alcohol dealer to a beer baron, produce and distribute various types of beer throughout the city of Beerland. Expand your empire with real estate, businesses, employees, and more.
games.aboutText:
— Alcohol is a commodity that must be controlled by the state. Illegal production and trafficking of alcoholic beverages are prosecuted by law. Alcohol consumption is harmful to your health.

You are a talented beer enthusiast who is tired of the soulless camp "consumer goods". With an old friend and a couple of dusty tanks, you start your journey in a garage on the outskirts of the city. No recipe, no normal yeast, not even a normal sink.

Build your beer empire from scratch in the heart of a sleepy but full of hidden possibilities provincial town. Compete with local online monsters and bars to become a legend of the beer movement.

CRAFT A BEER

Produce a wide range of beers, from classic lagers to experimental IPAs and cask—aged stouts. Mix ingredients (malt, hops, yeast) to find unique recipes. Discover spices or strange additives to create beer with special properties that will drive local hipsters crazy.

MAKE A PROFIT

Sell your own beer. Get on your old bike or cargo moped and deliver bottles around the city. Over time, hire sales representatives to handle the distribution.

EXPAND

Buy new equipment (from simple fermentation tanks to automated filling lines), open new locations, hire staff, and gain credibility among loyal customers.

WE COOK TOGETHER

It's more fun together, especially when you need to fill up 50 kilograms of malt! Build an empire in co-op mode with your friends. Friends can help with cooking, deliver orders, or just sit at the bar and give "valuable advice", boosting the mood of other employees.

Are you ready to conquer the world of beer?

games.name: Cup and Counter: Coffee Shop Simulator
games.shortDescription: Build up your very own Cafe. Make a variety of Coffees to keep your customers happy. Keep your Coffee shop well-stocked, money flowing, and you will quickly expand and build the Cafe of your dreams.
games.aboutText:
Build and grow your own cafe in Cup and Counter. Learn to craft a wide range of drinks, serve a stream of customers, and shape your coffee shop into a space that feels truly yours.

Craft Delicious Drinks

Learn to make a wide range of drinks as new recipes and ingredients become available. Work quickly, follow customer preferences, and keep orders flowing during busy rushes.

Build your Dream Cafe

Start small and grow your cafe into a bustling local favorite. Buy new equipment, expand your floor space, and shape every part of your shop to match your vision.

Manage your Employees

As you grow, you will be able to hire and manage employees to help run your cafe. Give them free rein, or assign them the tasks you really don't want to do.

Serve Customers and Build Your Reputation

Fast service and well-made drinks keep customers happy and your reputation strong. Get orders wrong or keep people waiting too long, and your cafe will start to feel the pressure.

Manage Stock and Deliveries

Stay on top of your supplies so you are always ready for the next rush. Plan ahead to avoid badly timed deliveries, but be careful not to overorder. Food and coffee beans won't stay fresh forever.

Run the Business

A great cafe needs more than good drinks. Balance rent, stock costs, and expansion plans while adjusting prices to find the sweet spot between customer satisfaction and turning a profit.

games.name: ARCHIVIST: Tidy Up & Sort
games.shortDescription: A first-person archive work simulator. Sort through boxes of documents, arrange files on the shelves, and bring order to the archive by following its filing rules. Handle stacks of records, keep each section organized, and enjoy the satisfying process of restoring order step by step.
games.aboutText:
Step into the role of an archive worker and bring order back to a room full of misplaced documents. Open boxes, carry stacks of files, sort them by the archive’s rules, and return every file to its proper place on the shelves.

This is a first-person organizing simulator focused on calm, satisfying work. Learn how each shelf is arranged, keep categories in order, and place documents in the right sequence to restore the archive one section at a time. Sandbox Mode

In Sandbox Mode, you choose a level from the available selection and receive a series of archive-related tasks. To complete the level and earn rewards, you need to process a large number of incoming documents and place them correctly on the shelves. Some documents are already stored in boxes, while others must be found scattered throughout the location. Before starting, you receive work instructions that may vary from level to level.
Some tasks require sorting documents by date, others by number or category, while more complex levels may require you to organize files using several parameters at once.
As you work, you can track your progress and periodically receive rewards for completing parts of the job. These rewards come in the form of additional perks that can speed up or simplify the process — such as faster searching, quicker document placement, automatic sorting, and other optional improvements that support your preferred playstyle.

Campaign Mode

In Campaign Mode, you go through a series of short sessions structured around working days. Each day introduces new tasks and archive assignments. You will sort incoming documents, find and submit requested files, check and edit records, clean up the workspace, fix mistakes made by other employees, and complete other archive-related tasks.

Features

- Sort, carry, and shelve documents in a first-person archive workspace.

- Organize files by category, subcategory, and date as you bring order to the shelves.

- Take documents from boxes, move them by hand, and place them where they belong.

- Reorganize shelf rows and improve the layout as the archive slowly comes together.

- Handle special document requests while continuing your daily sorting work.

- Enjoy the satisfaction of turning a cluttered archive into a neat, orderly system.

- Whether you want to relax and tidy up at your own pace or work efficiently to restore order faster, the archive is waiting.

games.name: Upcreek
games.shortDescription: A short, cozy experience where you enjoy cleaning a lively nature park.
games.aboutText:
🌿A short, cozy experience where you explore the winding paths of Blue River park. 🌳 Solve puzzles and collect trash to restore the park to it's natural beauty! 🌞 Play at a leisurely pace, or speedrun 🏃 as fast as you can! It's completely up to you! 🌸

Features:

- 🎮 Play with mouse and keyboard or lean back with a controller!

- 🏆 A variety of achievements, can you get them all your first try?

- 🌎 A cozy, wholesome game that is fun for kids and adults alike!

- 🗑️ Explore a wide open physics sandbox. No rules, no pressure!

- 🥚 Easter eggs so well hidden, nobody know they exist!

- ✨ Tons of charming, memorable moments!

games.name: Incremental Fishing
games.shortDescription: A short incremental relaxing game about fishing across diverse ocean biomes and upgrading your ship.
games.aboutText:
A short relaxing incremental game about fishing across diverse ocean biomes and upgrading your ship.

Catch fishes

Have a lot of fun and chaos!

Buy Upgrades

Developer

Hi there,

This is my very first game on Steam. I built it working on it every day solo.

Making games has been my dream for as long as I can remember. I don’t have a big team or a big budget - just a strong desire to create worlds and stories that make people feel something.

This project is my first real step toward that dream - the path that I hope one day will lead me to create games inspired by titles like Frostpunk , IXION , Don’t Starve , Valiant Hearts , and It Takes Two .

If you decide to try it, thank you - truly.
Your support means more than you know. And so does your honest feedback.

Wishing you warmth, good adventures, and something that makes you smile today.

games.name: Chomp Garden
games.shortDescription: A bite-sized puzzle adventure in a garden full of deceptively cute plants. Play as a tiny glowing lamp and shape them with your light to make your way deeper and find your pup.
games.aboutText:
Chomp Garden is a puzzle game about guiding plants with light.

To catch up with your pup, you enter a garden full of strange plants.

Chomp Plants grow toward the light, Thief Plants move away from it, and Hidey Bushes can hide your light.

You are a tiny lamp. Use your light to shape plants, solve puzzles, open the way forward, explore the garden, and find your pup.

Features

- Thoughtfully crafted puzzles

- Fun and surprising plant behaviors

- Little secrets hidden throughout the garden

- A compact 1–2 hour puzzle experience

games.name: G.I.R.L.S. will be Girls
games.shortDescription: A grid based tactical tower defense game set in a fictional Post Apocalyptic world where androids roam the deserted lands. Inspired by the group ITZY and songs Girls will be Girls / Imaginary Friend.
games.aboutText:
GIRLS will be girls

Cute. Tactical. Unforgiving.

GIRLS will be girls is a top-down, 2D grid-based battler where positioning is everything and every turn matters. Command a team of unpredictable girls across tight, turn-based arenas where one bad move can cost the entire run.

Plan carefully. Adapt constantly. Survive the chaos.

Tactical Grid Combat

Every battle plays out on a clean, readable grid.
Movement, spacing, and turn order define survival.

- Turn-based enemy and player phases

- Smart positioning and zone control

- Knockback, freeze, and reactive effects

- Enemies that close distance and punish mistakes

This isn’t button-mashing — it’s calculated aggression.

Placements That Matter

Placements of players aren’t just numbers — they change how you play.

- Freeze enemies to delay their turns

- Control space with crowd effects

- Manage stacking debuffs and timing windows

- Turn defensive plays into lethal setups

Momentum swings fast. Control it.

Upgrade & Reward Progression

After each victory, choose carefully.

- Earn new upgrades mid-run

- Modify abilities and outcomes

- Adapt builds based on what you’re offered

- Push for stretch goals and higher difficulty clears

No two runs feel the same.

Designed for Quick, Strategic Runs

Perfect for:

- 10–20 minute tactical sessions

- High-score chasers

- Players who love “just one more run”

games.name: Moonlight Cornelia
games.shortDescription: Akane Riho’s peaceful student life changes when she awakens as the magical girl Moonlight Cornelia. Switch between school exploration and real-time combo battles, customize skills and crests, bond with companions, and stop the Demon Queen’s revival.
games.aboutText:
Akane Riho, an ordinary girl, was living a peaceful school life until a sudden incident drew her into the Demon Queen’s conspiracy. She awakens as the powerful magical girl “Moonlight Cornelia”.

The Demon Queen plans to revive herself by influencing the entire town through special electromagnetic waves and gathering energy. Together with her reliable companions, Riho moves between everyday school life and perilous battlefields. While protecting the peace of the town, she faces various events and growth decisions in her school days, ultimately defeating the Demon Queen’s ambition and restoring tranquility to the world.

The game features a dual-mode system that allows free switching between “School Life” and “Magical Girl Battle”.

School Life Mode ：

Exploration-focused gameplay. Freely move around the school, club rooms, game center, and other locations to experience rich daily school life, interact with companions, gather resources, and advance the story.

Magical Girl Battle Mode ：

An exhilarating real-time combo battle system. While “Mana” is active, you can perform continuous actions and combine skills to enjoy the thrill of defeating powerful enemies in a single turn.

Players can freely combine skills and strengthen companions. You can also create dishes and other items to gain advantageous effects in battle.

In addition, the game includes a rich variety of development elements such as the Constellation System (which grants unique abilities based on the player’s birthday), skill tree growth, and Crest assembly/combination , allowing each player to enjoy a unique and personalized adventure.

- A major title polished over 4 years ：Contains over 90 CGs and offers substantial, high-volume content.

- Exhilarating battle system ：Emphasizes high-speed combos and strategic combinations. The pace is brisk, easy for beginners to pick up, yet deep and rewarding.

- Varied support systems ：Multiple difficulty levels available. Easy Mode is beginner-friendly, hint functions help players understand the world setting, and the status screen clearly tracks progress.

- Highly freeform development mechanics ：The Constellation Skill Tree, cooking enhancements, and Crest Astrology System provide great freedom in character growth. Players can assemble crests of different colors, shapes, and sizes onto the corresponding panels to obtain various special ability bonuses.

- Heartwarming ensemble drama ：The protagonist fights alongside her younger sister, mother, childhood friend, and other companions. The story is filled with the warmth of daily life and the bonds forged through fighting together.

games.name: BLIGHTEN
games.shortDescription: BLIGHTEN is a survival horror fps set in an abandoned facility overrun by mindless creatures infected by the Blight. Scavenge for resources and do whatever it takes to survive the industrial hellscape you're isolated within.
games.aboutText:
BLIGHTEN is an intense first person survival horror game with grim retro style graphics.

Selected to eliminate the last rebels in the eastern wastes, you find yourself lost with your team slaughtered. Now alone you must navigate through the Blight ridden hallways of the facility, explore every room for resources and weapons in an extensive and explorable level based map.

Brutal Combat and Resource Management

Arm yourself with an extensive arsenal of various firearms from shotguns to assault rifles, a weapon perfect for every situation. Take part in dynamic and addictive gun play as you take down various mutated horrors throughout the mega structure. Find parts and ammo and make every shot count.

Key Features:

- Immersive Retro Atmosphere : Hand drawn enemy sprites and animation in a 3D retro world creates a unique and dynamic atmosphere while still being fateful to classic retro graphics.

- Deep and Dark Narrative : As you descend deeper into the decaying facility, an unseen evil lurks in the shadows of the facility, shaping the horrors around you. As you navigate this industrial nightmare, every Blightened creature slain is a grim reminder to what you've lost — and the things you're fighting for.

- Ammo Management : Ammo and resources are limited, make every shot count, your survival depends upon quick thinking and inventive thinking.

- Face Blightened Foes : Engage in combat with the blight ridden creatures navigating the facility, each with their own unique abilities and traits.

games.name: Casse-Croute Deckbuilder
games.shortDescription: A roguelike deckbuilder where you cook your strategy. As a Cook, manage your Hero’s Appetite and Cholesterol, and build powerful combos with food cards and kitchen tools.
games.aboutText:
FOOD IS YOUR WEAPON

Casse-Croute is a roguelike deckbuilder where food is your only weapon.

Build a deck of powerful food cards, play cards with limited energy (Appetite), manage your hero’s Cholesterol, and fight your way through the Burger Kingdom.

PLAY POWERFUL FOOD COMBOS

Move across the board, trigger card effects, and combine ingredients to create ridiculous combos.

Position, path, timing, and resources all matter.

DRAFT RARE CARDS AND TOOLS

Draft new food cards, collect kitchen tools, and shape your build as the run goes on.

Some cards boost your damage, some help you survive, and some tools can completely change how your run plays.

We think you’ll love Casse-Croute Deckbuilder if you enjoy…

Slay the Spire, Wildfrost, Monster Train, Balatro, Backpack Hero, Dicey Dungeons, Across the Obelisk, Griftlands, Into the Breach.

games.name: Rollout Inline
games.shortDescription: Rollout Inline is a brand new inline skating game created by a solo dev who is passionate about the sport. This game aims to scratch the itch for those who have been craving a new, modern, and intuitive inline skating game!
games.aboutText:
Overview

Rollout Inline is a brand new inline skating game created by a solo dev who is passionate about the sport. It aims to scratch the itch for those who have been craving a new , modern , and intuitive inline skating game!

Enjoy an immersive single-player experience that offers a simcade gameplay feel all about the sport of Inline skating. Whether you are a real-life blader or someone who enjoys extreme sports games, this one is for you!

Built for Controllers

Rollout Inline is built for controllers. While the core gameplay, such as steering and spinning, is on the left stick and jumping on the right stick , grinds and cess slides are performed with dual-stick controls , with each stick representing each foot.

Feature Overview:

Riding, Grinding, Cess Slides, Free Spinning & Flipping, Air Grabs, Toe/Heel Rolls, Handplants, Physics/Momentum-based Movement, Ragdoll, Balancing Mechanics (Optional), Multiple Maps, Intuitive Controls, Replay Editor, Original in-game Music/Radio, Challenges, Progression System, Difficulty Settings.

Dual Stick Grinds

This allows for a huge grind selection and all the creative freedom you could hope for while offering an intuitive gameplay feel! Alternative controls for spinning can be set up in the settings, unlocking even more control and freedom of movement for your skater!

Customization

Customize your character and skates in the in-game customization menu! Clothing items get unlocked by progressing in the game. You can freely customize your skates at any time - no unlocks needed!

Challenges & Progression System

Push your limits in various challenges and level up your maps while unlocking new clothing items to style your skater! Challenges will show up in every map, and once you complete a batch of challenges, your map level increases and a new set of challenges will appear, with each level increasing the difficulty! Challenges from an earlier level are always replayable.

Multiple Maps

Explore multiple maps with various challenges and features like massive gaps, long rails, vert ramps, pools, and more! 3 maps will be available on the day of the Early Access launch.

games.name: 你离开之后
games.shortDescription: 《你离开之后》是一款文字互动类乙女向游戏，再次醒来时你发现自已似乎已经是一缕魂魄了，你的爱人在你离开后变得敏感脆弱，而你的行为将会或直接或间接的影响到他，最终走向不同的结局。 一款美味的鳏夫文学，你的冷漠与无视会让向来冷静矜持的爱人在你面前发疯变得歇斯底里，你的捉弄会让他在梦里情难自已，你的一举一动都会让他改变，你离开之后，他活成了你的样子，或是你想要的样子。
games.aboutText:
《你离开之后》是一款文字互动类乙女向游戏。

再次醒来时你发现自已似乎已经是一缕魂魄了，你的爱人在你离开后变得敏感脆弱，而你的行为将会或直接或间接的影响到他，最终走向不同的结局。

一款美味的鳏夫文学，你的冷漠与无视会让向来冷静矜持的爱人在你面前发疯变得歇斯底里，你的捉弄会让他在梦里情难自已，你的一举一动都会让他改变，你离开之后，他活成了你的样子，或是你想要的样子。

1.主要玩法：

- 多结局：通过点击对话及选项影响故事走向，从而达成不同结局。

- 沉浸式体验：你可以选择让爱留在过去，只回忆你们的过往；也可以选择与他一起走向未知的未来。

2.特殊操作：

切换不同场景进行切换，通过点击触发相关剧情及信息（含有隐藏内容）

3.特殊玩法一：入梦（将在正式版发布）

满足一定条件时可进入他的梦境，不同于在现实中只有极少时刻可以产生实体触碰，在梦境中你们会像正常人类一样可以触摸到彼此，在梦中会触发很多现实中无法实现的事。

如果梦境有颜色，那一定是五彩斑斓的，尤其是黄色的。

4.特殊玩法二：附着物品触发过去的景象

满足一定条件时可附着在物品上看到过去的景象，你会看到你刚离开时他的故作坚强，你也会看到他在夜深时的崩溃大哭，更多时候是一个人孤单地思念你。

5.特殊玩法三：变成鬼后的捉弄（开发中）

满足一定条件时可触发（开发中）

games.name: SKINFACE
games.shortDescription: SKINFACE is a gruesome horror-thriller where you skin strangers alive to create the perfect disguise. Evade the police, earn your target’s trust and carry out the hit. Knock knock!
games.aboutText:
SKINFACE is a gruesome horror-thriller where you pick faces apart to create the perfect disguise. You are a faceless hitman trying to gain entry to your target’s apartment. Attack strangers, peel off their facial features , and build a skin mask that’ll win your target’s trust. Once you’re inside, it’s game over – for them. Though beware, there is more than meets the eye.

Explore a warren of brutalist soviet-era landscapes , use stealth to avoid police patrols, and brace yourself for a delirious nightmare of escalating violence from the creators of No Players Online. Knock knock!

Features

- Embody a faceless hitman!

- Mix and match face parts to become your target’s “friend”!

- Decorate the flesh canvas that is your face!

- Explore dark corners of the world to find your prey!

- 2 hours playtime, even more for completionists!

games.name: Lost Camp
games.shortDescription: After the death of your mother and with no other choice, you take the only job available: guarding and maintaining a lonely campsite in the mountains. But what seemed like a quiet place hides mysteries that will change everything.
games.aboutText:
Following the sudden passing of your mother and left with no other choice, you accept the only job available: caretaker of an isolated mountain campsite. What begins as a routine job of vigilance and maintenance soon transforms into an unsettling reality. The silence of the forest is far from empty; it conceals truths that were never meant to be uncovered. As you trek through remote mountain trails and winter begins to bury everything in snow, strange phenomena start to occur—unsettling signs, eerie coincidences, and whispers in the cold that feel disturbingly familiar. Soon, you begin to suspect that your mother's death was not an accident, and that this forgotten valley holds the missing answers.

- Walk and Endure the Cold: Gameplay is experienced entirely in first-person, focusing on immersive walking and exploration. Hike through isolated mountain trails, trudging through thick snow, braving harsh winter winds, and managing your footing across steep, frozen terrain.

- Get Lost in the Snowy Forest: Snowdrifts and dense pine trees quickly swallow up familiar paths. Getting lost in the vast mountain wilderness is an active gameplay challenge; with no objective markers, you must rely on natural landmarks, your compass, map, and flashlight to navigate your way back to safety.

- Stay in Touch with Chloe: Your only bridge to civilization is your friend Chloe. Throughout your long treks, you communicate with her regularly—sharing what you uncover, discussing local mysteries, and relying on her voice to keep you grounded as isolation and psychological tension mount.

- Investigate Forgotten Ruins: Explore abandoned cabins, frozen campsites, and snow-covered maintenance posts. Inspect interactive objects, read hidden logs, and piece together the dark past that the valley has kept buried.

- A Story-Driven Walking Simulator: Gameplay is simple, accessible, and grounded: hike through snowy trails, get lost in the dense mountain woods, navigate using basic tools (map, compass, flashlight), and talk to Chloe. There are no complex mechanics or stressful combat—the true core of the experience lies in its mystery, atmosphere, and discovering the dark secrets tied to your mother's past.

As the cold deepens and daylight fades, the boundary between memory and reality begins to fracture. The deeper you venture into the snowy wilderness, the more you realize you might not be as alone as you were promised.

Will you uncover the truth buried in the snow, or will the silence of the mountain swallow you whole?

games.name: Scream Operator: Haunted House Manager
games.shortDescription: Run a haunted dark ride from the control booth in this spooky horror management sim. Load guests, trigger scares, route carts, and keep the power alive as the queue surges. Earn cash and prestige to rebuild the mansion, automate the ride, and survive every shift.
games.aboutText:
One booth. One haunted ride. Every scream in your hands. Operate the entire attraction from a dark control room, moving guests through the lobby, pre-shows, carts, and scares while managing power, queues, cash, and Prestige. Miss the timing and the whole operation starts to jam.

Place props, lighting, and animatronics to raise the ride's Scare potential, then improve the queue, pre-shows, and station to deepen Immersion. Stronger scares create better payouts at the exit and more money to invest in the mansion.

Use cash to keep the doors open and Prestige to rebuild the decrepit mansion room by room. Improve vehicles, expand power capacity, and automate doors, loading, and dispatch so the operation can survive its busiest nights.

Each shift brings new pressure, failures, events, and scoring conditions. Prepare before opening, react when the systems fight back, and keep the attraction alive as Halloween pushes the crowd, power grid, and control booth to their limits.

- Operate the entire haunted dark ride from one control booth

- Manage queues, pre-shows, carts, doors, power, and dispatches under pressure

- Design rooms with props, lighting, and animatronics that raise Scare and Immersion

- Rebuild a decrepit mansion with cash, Prestige, vehicle upgrades, and automation

- Face special shifts with unique events, failures, and scoring challenges

- A single-player horror management campaign building toward Halloween

games.name: Gunja Tteokbokki
games.shortDescription: Orders pouring in, broth bubbling over, and the daily pressure of balancing the books! Manage your ingredients, cook tteokbokki to perfection, and run your very own shop in this culinary tycoon simulation game.
games.aboutText:
14 Days of Chaotic Tteokbokki Madness!

"Order up! Wait — we're out of mala sauce?!" Don't let the cute looks fool you! Welcome to Gunjа Tteokbokki — a full-on hardcore(?) tteokbokki tycoon where breathless order rushes and tight inventory management are all part of the job!

D-14. Prove yourself and earn that full-time position!

Our adorable manager 'Baepsae' has just opened a tteokbokki shop — but your fate is sealed in just 14 days. Survive the customers' picky orders, restock your empty ingredient bins, and hit your sales target before time runs out. Can you survive the threat of early termination and turn Gunja Tteokbokki into the hottest spot in town?

★ Baepsae (Manager): The heart and soul of this shop. Her cute charm brings the customers in — but when the receipts start piling up, she's practically steaming from the ears.

What Makes This Game Great

1. Non-Stop Real Shop Chaos!

- Check the flood of incoming orders, load your ingredients onto the burner, and cook! Answer phone orders on top of everything else — and put your multitasking skills to the ultimate test in this frantic kitchen.

2. Strategic Ingredient Ordering & Inventory Management

- It's not just about cooking! At the end of each day, you'll need to place orders for tomorrow's ingredients. Manage your fast-depleting stock wisely — and keep an eye out for bonus ingredients that only appear on special days!

3. 4 Different Endings Based on Your Performance!

- After the final tally on Day 14, your ending depends on Baepsae's total earnings, order success rate, and the number of ingredients you've unlocked. Watch out — if your sales are too low early on, you might face a dreaded early termination!

Controls Play your way — mouse or keyboard, whichever you prefer!

Developer's Note

"We wanted to go beyond a simple cooking tycoon and capture that real, nail-biting feeling of actually running a shop! We put an enormous amount of effort into the English localization so that players around the world can experience the charm of tteokbokki. (Endless thanks to our team member's family for the invaluable help with translation!) You might start playing with a casual mindset — and find yourself genuinely stressing over mara sauce inventory before you know it. We hope you have a wonderful time cooking alongside Manager Baepsae!"

games.name: Winter Whiskers
games.shortDescription: In this short, cozy snow-cleaning adventure, help bring Winterlight Harbor back to life after a sudden blizzard! Vacuum up snow, turn it into steam, and power the town. Melt icy paths, help your neighbors, and prepare for the Winter Festival!
games.aboutText:
Winter Whiskers is a cozy cleaning sim focused on clearing snow, fixing steam networks, and reconnecting a seaside town after an unexpected blizzard. As you clear roads and fulfill simple requests from your neighbors, you’ll bring warmth back to this littlel community - just in time for the annual Winter Festival!

Clear away the snow ❄️

Use your snow vacuum to clear snow drifts and make the town safe to traverse. Unlock new ways to clear icy obsticals and get to tricky spots.

Fix the Steam System 💨

Restore the town’s steam-powered network by fueling furnaces and reconnecting pipes. This helps melt the snow even faster, clears giant snow drifts, and ultimately warms up the town.

Help Your Friends 💖

The blizzard has disrupted everything! Help locals with small tasks—clearing storefronts, completeing important deliveries, and more—so that they can focus on the Winter Festival.

Features

✅ What Winter Whiskers offers:

- A short, laid-back adventure: Spend 2–3 hours exploring the four areas of Winterlight Harbor. Progress through the town as you reconnect key locations and help your friends prepare for the Winter Festival.

- Simple game mechanics: Linearly progress through areas as you vacuum up snow, restore warmth through steam-powered systems, and use a growing set of tools to clear stubborn obstacles.

- A warm and cozy vibe : A peaceful winter atmosphere with soft early morning light, colorful seaside homes, adorable characters, and a gentle soundtrack.

- There is no possibility of failure : play at your own pace!

❌ What Winter Whiskers does NOT offer:

- No open-world exploration : just 4 peaceful areas to explore.

- No time management or complex mechanics: just simple snow clearing, cozy steam puzzles, and requests from NPCs.

- No multiplayer of any kind.

About the Devs

Hiya! We're Axie and Leaf - the small team of Mango Leaf Games ! We're so excited to share our next game with you! We learned a lot after making our first game, Kokoro Kitchen, and we've used it to create a quiet, relaxed game centered around the beautiful stillness of a snowy day.

We're continuing to grow with each project and still consider ourselves beginners. Please be kind with your expectations, and know that we will do our best! We hope you enjoy our little cleaning sim, Winter Whiskers!

games.name: Thunder Tank: Iron Shield
games.shortDescription: A relaxing strategy idle shooter that blends bullet hell action with backpack-like inventory management. Pilot your vehicle through a desolate, post-modern world, conquer 20 difficulty levels, collect diverse weapons, and build the ultimate firepower lineup to survive the wasteland.
games.aboutText:
🚜 Game Overview

Thunder Tank: Iron Shield is a casual game set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, blending bullet hell action, backpack-like strategy, and idle progression . You will pilot a battle vehicle through a perilous, post-modern wasteland, facing endless waves of enemies, collecting weapon fragments, unlocking powerful gear, and gradually building your own mobile steel fortress.

The game features 20 difficulty levels , progressing from easy onboarding to hardcore challenges. Each level tests both your strategic combination skills and resource management—you must carefully arrange various weapons within your vehicle's limited grid space, using wit to crush your enemies and firepower to conquer the wasteland!

🔫 Core Gameplay: Backpack-Like + Bullet Hell

The core inspiration comes from backpack-like gameplay : your vehicle has limited grid slots, and each weapon occupies a different number of slots. Machine guns, flamethrowers, rockets, heavy cannons, shock towers, laser cannons... 13 unique weapons await your unlock. How you achieve the optimal configuration within limited space will directly impact your combat efficiency and survival.

Will you pursue extreme firepower or balanced defense? Will you focus on single-target burst or area-of-effect clearing? Every choice is a strategic gamble!

🧰 Weapon System: 13 Unique Weapons, Free Combination

The game features 13 distinctive weapons, each with unique attack methods and grid space requirements:

- Machine Gun : Sustained damage, ideal for crowd clearing

- Flamethrower : Area burn damage, bane of melee enemies

- Toolbox : Repair support, ensures endurance

- Rocket : High burst damage, formation-breaker

- Heavy Cannon : Long-range bombardment, one-shot killer

- Shock Tower : Chain lightning, crowd control

- Laser Cannon : Piercing damage, linear destruction

Strategically combining weapon loadouts is essential to overcoming enemy formations and level mechanics across different difficulties.

🚛 Tank System: Multiple Vehicles, Exclusive Skills

New vehicles are unlocked after Chapter 4! Each vehicle not only has a unique appearance but also possesses its own skill tree and upgrade path . Some specialize in firepower suppression, others lean toward defense and survival, while some focus on resource acquisition. Choose the vehicle that best fits your tactical style and forge your unique steel beast.

💰 Progression System: Relaxed Idling, Growing Stronger

Can't beat a level? Don't worry! The game employs a light idle progression mechanic . Each battle allows you to accumulate resources for:

- Equipment Drawing : Randomly obtain powerful weapons or accessories

- Purchasing Coins : Accelerate weapon and vehicle upgrades

- Unlocking Fragments : Permanently enhance weapon attributes

No need for intense grinding. Relax and idle your way to steady strength—perfect for casual players with fragmented playtime.

🌍 Wasteland Setting: Post-Modern Wasteland Exploration

The game is set in a post-apocalyptic, post-modern wasteland. Dilapidated cities, abandoned factories, sky-filling dust storms... every map is filled with desolation and danger. You will drive your tank across the wasteland, battling mutated creatures and mechanical enemies, seeking hope for survival amidst a hail of bullets.

🎯 Perfect for Players

- Love bullet hell action and exhilarating combat

- Are enthusiasts of backpack-like strategic combination

- Prefer idle progression and light, casual gaming

- Have a passion for post-apocalyptic wasteland and vehicle modification themes

🚀 Depart Now: The Conquest Begins in the Wasteland!

Drive your tank through the ruins of the apocalypse. Build your iron shield with wit and firepower. 20 difficulty levels, 13 weapons, multiple vehicles —your tactics will determine the fate of the wasteland!

Thunder Tank: Iron Shield – Your strategy, your survival.

games.name: The Red Pearls Of Borneo
games.shortDescription: A detective noir puzzle deduction game. Explore a non-linear timeline as a clairvoyant investigator in 1941 Borneo. Jump between time and locations to uncover motives and discover what truly happened in the Goodwill tobacco plantation that fateful night on the eve of the WW2 Japanese invasion.
games.aboutText:
A Colonial Noir Mystery

The Red Pearls of Borneo is an atmospheric deduction game inspired by Return of the Obra Dinn , The Case of the Golden Idol and Type Help . You are a clairvoyant investigator in 1948 London, exploring the psychic echoes of a tragedy that occurred seven years prior on a remote plantation in Borneo.

Your tools are simple: a box of old photographs, a map of the plantation and your unique ability to step into the past.

London, 1948

Jeremiah Goodwill's tobacco plantation was supposed to be a paradise. But on the night of December 16th, 1941, as the Japanese Imperial Navy loomed on the horizon, the estate fell into chaos.

Sort through the lies. Reveal the faces of the strangers. Discover what truly happened in the Goodwill plantation that fateful night.

Key Features:

- Echoes of the Past: Explore a non-linear timeline. Jump between witness perspectives and moments in time to uncover motives, secret meetings and fatal mistakes.

- The "Mind's Eye": Use a unique node-based deduction system to visualise the movement of guests across the island. Connect the dots to prove who was where, and when.

- Make notes of everything everywhere: You can keep notes on all aspects of the game. From characters and locations to items and snippets of text from clues.

- Learn about the rarely told history of Borneo on the eve of WW2 through the interactive glossary you will unlock as you go.

Can you piece together the truth before the memories fade? Identify the guests, determine their fates and solve the mystery of the Red Pearls!

games.name: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon
games.shortDescription: You're the Ski-E-O - build the cozy ski resort of your dreams in this management tycoon game. Adapt to ever-changing weather, paint trails, build lifts, and place the lodges and après bars that keep thousands of skiers warm, fed, and happy.
games.aboutText:
Build the Legendary Ski Resort you've always dreamed of.

You start with just a ticket office and a bit of cash. Transform an empty mountain into a Legendary Resort in this management tycoon game from an industry veteran and passionate skier.

No rigid grid system. Paint trails directly onto terrain built from real LiDAR data from around the world.

You need a variety of trails for all types of skiers: green circles for beginners, black diamonds for the brave.

Build cozy ski villages with lodges, restaurants, après bars, shopping, and more!

See to the needs of thousands of guests as they arrive at your resort - everyone wants something different, so make sure to keep them happy. Some are there to chill, others are there to shred.
Watch a Jerry wipe out on an expert trail he had no business entering! And make sure you have enough Ski Patrol hired to help him out after you’re done laughing.

Not everyone came to ski! Place buildings that satisfy a variety of guests, from waffle stands to spas, warming huts to five-star hotels.

Every peak is built from real-world elevation data: the actual ridgelines, fall lines, and the weather that comes with them.

- Snow falls, settles, melts, and drifts on a GPU-simulated snowpack, and skiers carve real grooves into the powder as they go.

- An El Niño year turns the storms warm and wet. Snow turns to rain and wipes out your trails.

- Drought means running snowblowers around the clock just to stay open.

- A big dump buries your buildings before the lifts even spin.

- A cool summer keeps your peaks soft and fluffy for the next season.

- The East is cold and icy, with little natural snow. Run your snowmakers to keep your guests from wiping out.

- Utah serves up light, consistent powder, the most forgiving place to build.

- The Sierras flip between massive blizzards that bury your mountains and stubborn dry spells that melt what's there.

- The Colorado Rockies pair dependable snowfall with brutal, high-altitude cold that tests how warm you keep your guests.

- And the Pacific Northwest never stops dumping deep, heavy snow, keeping your groomers working overtime.

Play across every major ski region on Earth - from the five US regions to Japan, the Alps, the Andes, Canada, Australia and New Zealand, and China.

games.name: Generations: Utopia
games.shortDescription: A secret Soviet research institute is conducting an experiment to create a utopian city. Develop your city, resolve generational conflicts, and overcome the challenges prepared by the institute.
games.aboutText:
Build a City. Prepare It for the Experiment.

GENERATIONS: Utopia is a city-building strategy game about creating the ideal Soviet society inside a secret experiment conducted by a classified Soviet research institute.

Build a miniature city where five generations live side by side.

- Build your city

- Create comfortable living conditions

- Monitor your citizens' wellbeing

- Resolve generational conflicts

But building the city is only the beginning.

The real challenge starts when the Institute launches its next experiment.

A Living Generational Simulation

Silent Generation · Baby Boomers · Generation X · Millennials · Generation Z

Each generation has its own unique traits and nine individual parameters.

A disease outbreak will hit older generations the hardest, while Generation X endures it more easily, and Gen Z may barely notice it. But when famine strikes, the older generations survive far better thanks to their gardens and food reserves, while younger generations struggle. What saves one generation may break another.

The Institute's Experiment

The Institute is constantly testing your Utopia. Some experiments are known in advance, while others remain a complete surprise.

Once an experiment begins, you can no longer interfere. All you can do is watch as each generation reacts in its own way. Every outcome is recorded in the Institute's log. Failure isn't the end—it's valuable data.

After each experiment, the city remains exactly as it survived. Rebuild. Adapt. Prepare for the next test.

Your city. Their generations. The Institute's experiment.

Build the city. Balance the generations. Prepare for the unknown.

games.name: DeadStuck
games.shortDescription: Take on the role of a sinner fighting for absolution against hordes of the damned. Inspired by arcade light gun shooters and boomer shooters, use your quick reflexes tools of divine condemnation to come out victorious!
games.aboutText:
Bound to the floor of a long forgotten battlefield. Fight against hordes of evil and twisted creatures with what limited capabilities you have. As you fail, grow stronger, take the blood of the fallen empower your weapons, your body and your spirit.

Survive the onslaught and face bigger, deadlier, uglier challenges til you are brought head to head with the leader of hell themself!

Fight hordes of horrific demons whilst BOUND TO THE FLOOR of a hellish arena in this take on the arena shooter! You may not be able to move but you can still fight!

- Choose between 5 Unique Characters each with a different Weapon and Skill Tree

- Master skills such as the Quick Turn, Active Reload and Screen Clearing Supers!

- Fail or succeed! Gain EXP to Unlock New Abilities and Boons that help shape each run in the arena.

- Accept help from above! Divine Angels provide strength that may change up how you tackle the hordes marching towards you!

Replayability is a key focus! Customise the challenge to suit your needs! Designed with a deep focus on accessibility!

- Modifiers can help or hinder ! Want to up the challenge or take it easy? The choice is yours!
