- Simple to Master controls, built with accessibility in mind. From controller to PC anyone should be able to play!

- Accessibility options such as auto reload, auto aim and in game modifiers help players customise their experience.

games.name: Anti-Anti-Cheat: a musical action game
games.shortDescription: This is a musical action game where you need to dodge many enemy bullets appearing to the rhythm of music. Can you defeat Anti-Cheat?
games.aboutText:
Anti-Anti-Cheat is a musical action game where you must dodge numerous enemy bullets that appear in rhythm with the music. Can you defeat the Anti-Cheat?

Game features:

- Dynamic, high-quality soundtrack

- The entire environment moves in rhythm with the music

- Numerous enemy bullets

games.name: Room Craft
games.shortDescription: Room Craft is a creative simulation game where you can bring your dream rooms to life. Design unique spaces with a variety of furniture, decorative objects, and interior details, and build rooms that reflect your own style.
games.aboutText:
Design your dream living space from the ground up.
Room Craft is a creative simulation experience that gives players the freedom to plan, build, and decorate their own rooms. It is not just about placing furniture — you can also create the core structure of the room yourself by drawing the layout through the UI. Whether you want a cozy workspace, a modern living area, or a completely unique layout, the choice is yours.

Plan and create your room.
Use the planning mode to draw walls, define the shape of your room, and build your space from scratch. Design areas in different sizes and layouts, then reshape them whenever you like.

Use an advanced wall editing system.
Room Craft goes beyond basic room setup. You can adjust wall lengths with greater precision, use fractional wall scaling for finer measurements, and build your space with a higher level of detail. This allows you to create more natural, controlled, and unique room layouts.

Place furniture freely.
Position furniture and decorative objects however you like. Rearrange your setup at any time, experiment with different combinations, and organize your space exactly the way you want.

Customize colors and surfaces.
Personalize walls, floors, and furniture with different colors and finishes. Experiment with different styles to create minimal, modern, warm, or eye-catching interiors.

Shape every detail individually.
With different wall surfaces, floor options, and decorative elements, you can completely change the identity of each room. Turn a small space into a clean minimalist office or transform a larger area into a detailed living space.

Key Features

- Create rooms by drawing the layout through the UI

- Plan and build rooms from scratch

- Fractional wall scaling and precise sizing

- Flexible room layout creation

- Free furniture and decoration placement

- Wall, floor, and furniture customization

- Create different styles and atmospheres

- Redesign your space anytime

games.name: HOLO-KINGDOM
games.shortDescription: This is a 3D action game where you control Hololive members and fight your way through enemies to clear each stage.Carefully read enemy attacks and overcome challenging trials using parries and evasive maneuvers.This game requires keyboard and mouse controls.
games.aboutText:
The kingdom stands on the brink of collapse.

To save the world—and the people who cherish Hololive—
a warrior takes up their weapon once more.

■ What is HoloKingdom?

This is a world kept in peace by the “Holomembers,” beings blessed with extraordinary powers.

However, a sudden invasion by a mysterious enemy has plunged the kingdom into its greatest crisis.

You must protect the last hope, Princess Luna, and lead this battle to victory.

■ What kind of game is it?

This is a 3D action game where you control Hololive members and fight your way through enemies to clear each stage.

Each of the four playable characters wields a unique weapon and combat style, challenging you to survive intense battles.

Learn skills rooted in the history of the Holo Kingdom and defeat incoming enemies with each character’s distinctive abilities.

Some stages also feature light puzzle elements that you must solve in order to progress.

games.name: Sandwich +1
games.shortDescription: Your sandwiches are getting out of hand. Stack food towers, sell them off to drinks with faces, and eventually hire flying workers until they're doing all the clicking. One evening, and a real ending.
games.aboutText:
Your only job? Stack food towers as high as they'll go. Sandwich +1 is a satisfying idle clicker where every click adds to the pile, and soon your kitchen runs itself. Stress is not on the menu. 🥪 Click, Stack, Grow

Every click drops a random ingredient. Build wobbling, towering sandwiches and send them off to thirsty, happy customers. The taller the tower, the bigger your payout!
🧑‍🍳 Automate Your Kitchen

Tired of clicking? Hire cute flying workers to do the work for you. Upgrade their speed, buy more boards, and watch your kitchen turn into a self-sustaining sandwich empire while you sit back and relax.
✨ Discover Legendary Ingredients

Unlock dozens of new ingredients to add to your random drop pool. Start with simple cheese and lettuce, and work your way up to legendary steak and caviar. Hit a special combo? Watch your customers react! 🛋️ No Stress. Seriously.

- Zero Stress: No timers, no failing, no burnt food. You can't lose.

- Play at Your Pace: Jump in for a 5-minute break or chill for an hour.

- Satisfying Progression: Constant upgrades, new boards, and numbers that only go up.

- Chill Vibe: Warm colors, satisfying "plop" sounds, and nothing but good vibes.

games.name: Hypnagogia 壊れた夢 Broken Dreams
games.shortDescription: A protector submerged, a mirror shattered, and a dreamscape left severed. Unravel a new, surreal dream mystery as you platform, solve puzzles, meet unique characters, and much more in this first-person exploration prequel to Hypnagogia: Boundless Dreams.
games.aboutText:
Welcome back to the world of Hypnagogia - a place wherein unusual things lurk between dreams, nightmares, and the spaces unseen...

After the events of the very first Hypnagogia game, but before the tale of the Dreamer in Boundless Dreams , a foreboding and mysterious torrent had been bubbling beneath the surface.

Gogi , the dream guardian, has awoken from his slumber and called upon once again to help get to the bottom of it. Dark and troubling forces manifesting within the dreamscape have caused the God Mirror to fracture, causing a nuclear-level communications disruption and has left all dream worlds completely isolated.

Evil, corrupted energy has now begun swirling, infecting and warping many of the different worlds. It's up to Gogi to scour each and find the source of the corruption all while keeping his own sanity intact.

- Explore, platform, and puzzle-solve your way through a ravaged, rodent-run city , a blood-filled underworld crypt , a soothing frozen hotspring , and more.

- All new mechanics: swim underwater and avoid draining your dream sanity as you navigate a handful of vibrant and colorful dream worlds.

- Pull levers, climb ladders, grab/stack/throw objects, and interact with your environment like you never have before in any previous Hypnagogia game.

- Complete controller support (and recommended ).

- Engaging, narrative-based single-player story.

- First-person exploration with light platforming and puzzle solving .

- Character conversation and decision making.

- Environmental interactions , swimming, and sanity management.

- Banging original soundtrack.

games.name: Candellum
games.shortDescription: Play as a candle warrior fighting to keep your flame alive in a world where fire means life and death. Steal wax from enemies to survive, wield your flame tactically in intense hack-and-slash combat, and uncover the dark secrets of a dormant wax factory filled with danger !
games.aboutText:
Candellum is a top down hack-and-slash where fire is everything. Trapped in a dormant wax factory crawling with hostile candle warriors, you must fight, think, and burn your way to the truth lurking in its darkest depths.

In this world, fire means life. And life means death.

You are a candle. A warrior. And you are always on the verge of melting away.

Your candle can be lit , hitting harder, burning brighter, but draining your wax with every second. Or unlit , preserving what's left of you, at the cost of your power. Neither state is safe. Neither can be ignored.

The twist? You throw your flame to switch states, and wherever it lands, it lands on an enemy. Ignite a foe to weaken them. Pull your flame back to slow your own decay. Every decision ripples across the battlefield.

Key Features

- MASTER THE FLAME THROW SYSTEM. Toggle between Lit and Unlit modes by throwing your flame mid-combat. Your enemies, fellow candle warriors, operate the same way. Learn to exploit their states before they exploit yours.

- STEAL WAX TO SURVIVE. Health doesn't regenerate on its own. Rip wax from defeated enemies to keep your candle burning.

- SLASH, THINK, REPEAT. Intense hack-and-slash combat meets environmental puzzles. Pure aggression will only get you so far sometimes you need to stop and think before you burn.

- EXPLORE A FORSAKEN FACTORY. Navigate the dark corridors of a dormant wax factory, uncovering the grim secrets buried within its walls. Not everything that's dormant stays that way.

- FACE DIVERSE THREATS. From nimble candle scouts to hulking wax brutes, each enemy type demands a different approach. Adapt or melt.

- CONFRONT THE FINAL BOSS. One last, formidable threat guards the factory's darkest secret. It knows fire too, perhaps better than you do.

Candellum is an award-winning student game, recognized with multiple prizes for its innovative dual-state gameplay and atmospheric design.

games.name: Heart of Ural
games.shortDescription: Heart of Ural is a pixel rhythm RPG based on the ancient epic Ural-Batyr and Bashkir myths. This is a deep story with many difficult decisions and unexpected twists, humor and drama. In this game, EVERYONE remembers what you did before.
games.aboutText:
Heart of the Urals is a narrative-driven pixel-art rhythm RPG in the spirit of Undertale , based on the ancient epic Ural-Batyr and Bashkir myths. It is a deep story filled with difficult choices and unexpected twists.

Charming and charismatic characters.

Encounter unique spirits and deities of Bashkir mythology across real and mythical locations. Help them overcome their personal traumas... or consume them to grow stronger.

The combat system — an unconventional rhythm game.

Fight not with your fists, but with the strength of your spirit. Deflect rhythm attacks with precise timing, build your own unique setup by combining artifacts and ancestral marks.

Everyone remembers.

Every character — even every object — remembers what you did in your previous playthrough! The world lives within a twisted three-act structure, but even beyond it... there is something more.

A wealth of humor and drama.

You'll have to figure out how a snake should properly wear pants, which pie shape is the tastiest, and also how to defeat an infinitely powerful demon capable of plunging the world into chaos.

A soundtrack in the best traditions of the genre.

Music that embodies Bashkir traditions alongside a modern gaming sound — it will earn a lasting place in your everyday playlist.

games.name: Control, I'm Not Coming Back
games.shortDescription: Control, I'm Not Coming Back is a short and emotional narrative game about a lost astronaut searching for a reason to keep going forward while facing the emptiness of space. Inspired by the Hopecore aesthetic, it’s a story about positivism, friendship and our human connection with Voyager 1.
games.aboutText:
Control, I'm Not Coming Back is a short and emotional narrative game about an astronaut drifting through the vastness of space, searching for a reason to keep going while struggling with the feeling that there may be no way back home. Inspired by the Hopecore aesthetic, the game explores despair, friendship and how we are able to move forward even in the deepest void of the cosmos.

A Hopecore-Inspired Storyline

After an accident leaves a young space cadet drifting alone in the void, his journey becomes an introspective and abstract encounter with the historic Voyager 1 probe, forming a bond that reflects humanity’s need to keep reaching towards new horizons.

Play Through In-Game Montages

Experience in-game montages with scene transitions in sync with the soundtrack. Changing the space around you to the rhythm of the music.

Constantly Changing Environment

Explore diverse environments across many distinct visual styles, blending retro graphics, abstract spaces, and real-world footage into a constantly shifting atmospheric journey.

Main Features

- Short narrative experience focused on emotions and atmosphere.

- Inspired on Hopecore aesthetics.

- Voyager 1 as a companion on your journey.

- Evocative and original scenery.

- Montages integrated in the gameplay, with scene transitions on the beat of the soundtrack.

- A story with branching paths based on your choices.

games.name: Studio Sim
games.shortDescription: Build a film and television empire in a living entertainment industry beginning in the 1980s. Create and manage productions, cast unique talent, outmaneuver rival studios, climb the box office and grab television ratings in this immersive, old-school tycoon sim.
games.aboutText:
Build your dream production studio and chase box office glory and television ratings in Studio Sim, an old school, densely packed, studio tycoon beginning in the cut-throat world of 1980's Hollywood.

- Layered film management system (pre-production, in-production, post-production, opening weekend, theatrical release, home video). Call the shots from the screenplay, through casting, all the way to marketing and release.

- Layered episodic television system (pre-production, pilot production, season production, post-season) that run for multiple seasons or limited series. Negotiate with networks for air-time or create pilots that fizzle into dust.

- The robust and unique World Simulation Engine (WSE) | (See below).

- Every action you take as a studio will accrue Studio Points . Points will grow your studio from Independent to Major and along the way unlock perks to better climb the entertainment ladder.

- Perks are broken into six main branches. Negotiation, Production, Marketing, Talent, Intelligence & Prestige . Each branch has another six options to choose from. Streamlined negotiations with talent, stronger marketing pushes, office upgrades, fire shots at rival studios and a lot more.

- Deal with important or unexpected production events during every step of production, including writing, filming and editing , affecting quality, hype, relationships, progress and much more.

- Compete against rival studios for box office dominance , television ratings and top industry awards in Film, Television and Pop Culture.

- Set up sequels to your projects or go bigger and create entire cinematic universes. These projects work in tandem with one another to bring more hype and draw bigger audiences.

- Leverage actor appearances on three late night talk shows. Each with a unique host, interview style and show identity. But be careful who you send. Volatile actors can can wreak havoc on the project they're promoting and the appearance itself.

- Follow the in-game Tabloids to keep up to date on the world.

- Manage project budgets . Every action taken for a project can add to the project budget, coming out of the studio's funds. Higher budgets need a stronger release and great marketing plan to make their money back, or a strong television run on a major network.

- Create/Edit/Save & Share custom databases with the in-game database editor.

- Reduced Motion options for better optimization on lower end hardware.

- Hold special crossover episodes between shows your studio has on air.

- Keep your television series alive well after it's original airing on syndication .

- Live poster generation . Every project will have an in-game poster created based on title and genres selected. All poster assets hand-drawn in Corel Draw by the developer. Optionally, upload your own custom poster at any time.

- Hidden Talent. A small number of actors with lower Fame will deliver the performance of a lifetime if you cast them, skyrocketing the actor into overnight stardom and making audiences come out in droves to see your project.

- Choose from a wide variety of screenplay modifiers to give your scripts more edge. The more modifiers a script has, the higher the parental rating will become, along with other potiental actions. (i.e. having Nudity in your script will require you to cast talent who agrees to go nude for your project, and will expect a premium.)

- A robust set of production additions , ranging from explosions, to CGI, to elaborate set design and everything in-between are available to enhance the project . Each adding an affect to the hype and quality of your project. Choices matter . Audiences going to see a romantic comedy probably do not want a bunch of stunts and explosions.

- Choose to sell your distribution rights in various locations around the world, bringing your costs down, but potientally losing out on revenue. Release films Globally, Internationally, Domestically or straight to Home Video .

- Don't worry if your film doesn't perform well at the Box Office . When the theatrical run is complete, set up your Home Video plan and you may just have the next cult classic.

- If your television shows need a boost, book special guest stars to try for a ratings bump .

- Create mid-credit and post-credit scenes , choosing the actors involved, to keep the audience hooked.

- Track television ratings across multiple demographics , Mass Audience, Adult Audience, Youth Audience, Critic Audience, Male Audience, Female Audience. Also, season by season or episode by episode and see how your show is doing compared to other shows in the same time-slot.

- Award season begins one month before an award show. Tabloids begin hyping the nominees in the major categories. On award show night, watch the show to see who won in live time, or skip the show and view the winners.

- Award categories are tiered and winning will provide Fame boosts. For example, winning Best Actor will provide a larger boost than winning Best Supportin

games.name: Unusual Tales: After Bark
games.shortDescription: You, a simple dog named Mr Peanut, find yourself in a weird cabin full of secrets... Will you be able to warn the family of the dangers? A horror game filled with mystery!
games.aboutText:
Unusual Tales is an episodic psychological horror game that follows a main character through what seems like a never ending nightmare. Will they make it to the end in one piece?

You are a good dog and you are part of a loving family that decide to go on a nice holiday vacation. While everything start pretty normally and without much events, it quickly turns into a nightmare to this poor family. Will you be able to warn them of what is hiding here?

This game features many things that might peak your attention such as:

- Over an hour long scary experience depending on pace

- A horror experience filled with scares

- Fun unique player mechanic

- Complete voice acting for each character

- Lighthearted writing and amusing moments

- A winter wonderland to experience and explore

- Environments to keep you on edge

- And much more!

What can a simple dog such as yourself can do to help?
Maybe they will understand your warning...
Or maybe they aren't paying attention to your cries...

games.name: STARCULT Night Twisted Age
games.shortDescription: ...Everyone suspects you of murder. Become the Villainess everyone thinks you are. Create or join a cult. Manipulate people using the Emotion Palette. Enjoy power and peaceful moments... until bigger problems arise.
games.aboutText:
...Everyone suspects you of murder. Become the villainess everyone thinks you are.

Manipulate people using the Emotion Palette.

Romance • Murder investigation • Cults • Relationships • Multiple endings

STARCULT Night Twisted Age is a dark fantasy visual novel with romance and horror elements, set in a mysterious world on the brink of catastrophe.

Explore the life of Silviya - an artist in a world where art extends far beyond paints and pastels. She married Hans Nebula, the young head of the family, hoping to start a new chapter in her life.

Instead, Hans is killed on their wedding night by an unknown monster, which devours half of his head.

MASTER THE EMOTION PALETTE

Use Silviya's 'Emotion Palette' to unlock her hidden potential, uncover the true feelings and intentions of friends and foes, influence the behaviour of those around her, make others do what you want, and walk the line between sweet madness and painful reality.

Escape the countless death endings hidden between your choices. Reveal the true nature of the world Silviya inhabits.

EXPLORE ROMANCES WITH COMPLEXITY & DEPTH

Choose from different types of relationships: passionate, romantic, toxic, sadistic, codependent, casual, open or platonic.

SHAPE YOUR OWN PATH

Shape the story through meaningful choices that lead to unique storylines: 'Detective', 'Hedonistic', 'Mystical', 'Nihilistic' and 'Ascension', as well as secret endings waiting to be discovered.

JOIN OR CREATE YOUR OWN CULT

Create your own star cult, join an existing one, or ignore the existence of the occult until the very end - the choice is yours.

MEET THE MAIN CHARACTERS

Decide who to trust and who to betray. Neutrality is not an option, and it's impossible to please everyone in a single playthrough.

CREATE YOUR OWN SCHEDULE

Choose what Silviya will do in the morning, afternoon and evening, and see how her activities affect the course of the story.

CHOICE MATTER

You can change dialogue options using the unique 'Emotion Palette' feature, which allows you to select up to 15 options within a single dialogue.

MULTIPLE PLAYTHROUGHTS

Replay to discover more. Star cult is created to be replayed. Experience Silviya's story from different angles and dictate her destiny.

About the developer

NOT A CAT STUDIOS is a small indie developer driven by a love for things that have a double meaning. This contrast is reflected in both our games and our mascot, the tentacle cat^^.

Credits
Liliia Sitailo - Art Direction, Character Art, Backgrounds, UI
Dmytro Ivanov - Game Design, Narrative Writing, Cinematography
Katie Benson - Narrative Writing, Editing

Andrew Shaposhkin - Character Art
SypherZent - Technical Engineer

French Translation - SEIGAKUTA INK

games.name: MOLDRISE
games.shortDescription: UP! UP! UP! It's the only thought you can still grasp. You have an infection that started in your foot, now it's in your head. Meet strange neighbours, make bad trades, learn about them. Everytime you fail, the building stays the same. What changes is what you know.
games.aboutText:
It started in your foot. Now it’s in your head.

You have only one clear thought left: GO UP.

The building you live in has thirty floors, you never cared for most of them so far.

But now you have to get your body up. But it has it's own needs: hunger, thirst, and an infection to survive.

Your body is about to give up, but your brain won't let it.

Meet your Neighbors.

This building is not haunted. There are no monsters. There are just people. If you manage to overcome the anxiety of talking to them, you'll find out that they want things.

Snacks, Trash, Favors, Loyalty.

Some of them know more than they should. And maybe what they know has something in common.

You are the one collecting the pieces, penetrating the buildings defense against your journey.

Learn. Adapt. Climb.

Death is not the end - and everytime you wake up, the building is going to be the same .

Neighbors will treat you the same, discoveries will be the same. The vending machine has the same stock. There is no randomness.

What changes is what you know.

Every try, you will learn something. Don't do the same mistake twice. Like a pathogen, your behaviour will mutate and you will endure and overcome. Maybe you will find out more than you need to know.

Original Soundtrack by Mike Klubnika.

MOLDRISE features a full-length original soundtrack, composed by Mike Klubnika, creator of Buckshot Roulette, s.p.l.i.t., and Machine Party.

games.name: Gaming Burnout Treatment Center
games.shortDescription: Digital ED Treatment Center is a random launcher for players in a gaming slump. We help you rediscover the joy of play and unearth hidden gems buried in your library. Click to start your treatment and reignite your gaming vigor!
games.aboutText:
Gaming ED Treatment Center

Gaming ED Treatment Center is a randomized game launcher specifically designed for players suffering from "Backlog Paralysis"—those who own a mountain of games but have lost the spark to actually play any of them.

Our mission? To dive deep into your dusty Steam library, unearth those "hidden gems" you bought during a 90% off sale and forgot existed, and help you rediscover your gaming vigor!

We know the truth: often, it’s not that the games aren’t good—it’s the mental exhaustion of Choice Overload .

Feeling "Drained"?

"Thousands of games in the library, yet I’m browsing the store for more. I spend thirty minutes scrolling through my search bar, only to give up and go to sleep."

If this sounds like you, we have bad news: you are in the mid-to-late stages of "Digital ED." Welcome to the Digital ED Treatment Center. It’s time for your recovery.

Start Your Treatment Immediately!

- Comprehensive Diagnosis: We perform a deep dive into your Steam library and play-time analytics to find the buried treasure in your collection.

- Rapid Therapy: Stop overthinking! Click "Start Treatment" and let the Hand of Fate pick the forgotten masterpiece you’re playing tonight.

- Surprise Check-ups: Did you pull a game you bought three years ago and never even installed? Congratulations—that might just be your next Game of the Year!

- Customized Prescriptions: Filter by installation status and more. Choose between a "Gentle Routine" or the highly effective "Shock Therapy." We have a mode for every patient.

- Minimalist UI: No social media clutter, no distractions. Just you, your library, and the button that decides your destiny.

- Customized Analysis Report: Generates an exclusive gamer personality analysis report based on the contents of your game library!

Note: This product is not a substitute for actual medical advice. Common side effects include, but are not limited to: sleep deprivation, sudden bursts of excitement, a massive spike in your electricity bill, and potential hardware overheating.

games.name: Oblivion Maiden
games.shortDescription: An exploration adventure set in St. Dorothia Academy, a magical educational institution hidden deep within a forest. A story that begins with an encounter with a girl named Lulunya, and unfolds through mysterious phenomena and dream worlds.
games.aboutText:
One day, you play a video.

The moment it begins, your consciousness is drawn into an unfamiliar academy.

The place where you awaken is St. Dorothia Academy , a school of magic hidden deep within a forest.

As you explore the academy, you encounter a mysterious girl named Lulunya Apathia .

She spends her days broadcasting toward the vast digital sea from a quiet corner of the academy.

With her guidance, you will journey through a world where the boundary between reality and dreams has begun to blur.

By touching the hearts of the students, you will uncover the truth behind a series of strange phenomena.

Explore a Magical Academy Hidden in the Forest

Discover St. Dorothia Academy , a magical institution surrounded by an ancient forest.

Attend classes, complete assignments, and meet the many people who inhabit the academy.

Experience everyday school life in a mysterious world while learning more about its students and secrets.

Dream Worlds Shaped by the Hearts of Students

A mysterious incident sweeps through the academy, trapping students within strange dream worlds.

Each dream realm is formed from its owner's memories, wishes, and emotions.

Understand their hearts and uncover the mysteries hidden within these dream-bound worlds.

A Fully Voiced Story

All major characters are fully voiced.

Through their performances, each character's emotions and personality come vividly to life.

Immerse yourself in the story woven within this fantastical academy.

Original Soundtrack

All music featured in the game was composed exclusively for Oblivion Maiden .

From peaceful academy life to dreamlike adventures and dramatic climaxes, a diverse soundtrack accompanies every moment of the journey.

Experience a world that exists only within Oblivion Maiden , brought to life through music.

A Girl Who Connects Reality and Fiction

Lulunya continues her broadcasts from a quiet corner of the academy.

Even outside the game, the world continues to expand through her streams and videos.

The story does not end when the game is over—it remains gently connected to you in the real world.

games.name: Farm & Feast
games.shortDescription: Grow fresh ingredients and run your own little restaurant. Enjoy a peaceful day that stretches from the field to the table. Plan a fresh menu for a delightful day, keep your pantry full, and make your customers happy. Earn your own money and build your little world step by step.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Farm & Feast! 🌿

Farm & Feast is a relaxing simulation game where a warm little farm meets an adorable cozy restaurant. Everything moves at your own pace. Your fields are waiting, your restaurant is open, and so are your customers. Every day something new grows, and every service turns into a little moment of happiness.

The more care you show your customers, the warmer your restaurant becomes. Every smile, every order made with love, builds a bond that reaches far beyond the tables.

Take a little break by the shore and cast your line into the gentle waves. Wait for that tiny tug, reel in your catch, and bring it fresh to your kitchen.

Harvest your golden wheat row by row and watch your little machines turn every grain into warm loaves of bread. From a single seed to your customers' tables, every step carries a little piece of your love.

Sometimes the loveliest moments are the quietest ones. A gentle breeze, a path winding between the fields, and a world that feels made just for you. As you gently tend the soil, time slows down; only you and the greenery growing day by day remain. Caring for your field isn't a chore, it's a quiet peace where you get to be alone with yourself.

Greet every guest with a warm smile and welcome them to a comfortable table. Even a small "Welcome" can set the tone for an entire day.

Every service has a rhythm of its own. Fill your tray with drinks, move from table to table, and leave each glass with just the right owner. As you carry the drinks, gather up the smiles along the way and savor that delightful flow that keeps your restaurant cozy and warm.

Bring the orders to your chefs, and they'll handle the rest. While the pans sizzle, sweep the floors and clear the tables at your own rhythm. A cozy restaurant is built with patience and care for the little details.

Taking the bill is the finale of every lovely moment you share with a customer. The warm bond you've built throughout the day, the care you've shown, and every little smile all pay off in this final moment. When your guests leave the table happy, those little tips they leave alongside the bill become the sweetest thank-you for your hard work.

Take every order with care and listen closely to your customers. A wrong dish or a forgotten request upsets your guest and casts a shadow over your restaurant's warm reputation.

Your day begins in the morning on your farm and ends in the evening with happy customers at your restaurant. No rush, no pressure, just your day.

FEATURES

🌾 Farming and Harvest - Plant your seeds, water your crops with love, and watch them grow. When harvest time comes, gather your fresh produce and send it off to your restaurant.

🎣 Fishing - Head down to the shore, cast your line into the gentle waves, and reel in fresh fish for your restaurant's kitchen.

🍽️ Restaurant Management - Greet your customers with a warm smile, seat them at their tables, and take their orders with care. Let every service turn into a little moment of happiness.

🎮 Mini Games - Add a little fun to your day with the charming mini games waiting for you at your restaurant.

🛒 Market - Pick up the seeds and supplies you need at the market and stock up on what's missing. Grow your little business step by step.

🌍 Your Little World - Find your own rhythm between the farm and the restaurant. Plan your day at a calm pace and savor every moment of it.

A warm little farm, an adorable restaurant, and a little world that belongs to you alone. Farm & Feast is waiting for you.

games.name: Painting PC
games.shortDescription: Painting PC is a relaxing painting game where you take on commissions, earn money, gain fans, unlock new tools, and work your way towards becoming a famous artist.
games.aboutText:
Start in a studio with one brush and absolutely no followers. Complete commissions, gain followers, unlock new tools, and work your way to becoming the next big thing on the Paintigraph app.

Turns out that art is subjective. One client thinks you’re Michelangelo, the next is completely confused. Just make it work, get ratings, and get paid.

As your followers grow, you'll unlock and expand the premium toolkit to paint even cooler masterpieces.

Take that sweet commission cash and spend it on cool furniture and decorations. Turn that minimalistic cabin into a studio that’s completely your vibe.

games.name: Luna's Room
games.shortDescription: An unfamiliar room. Vague memories. Explore Luna's room through the objects inside it in this intimate narrative experience about loss, told as a classic-style graphic adventure.
games.aboutText:
Luna's Room is a point-and-click exploration experience set in an unsettling and enigmatic room where every object carries meaning. As you interact with them, you will slowly piece together a story told through atmosphere, symbolism and emotional resonance.

- This is a game about introspection. About the weight of small things.

- You don’t fight enemies. You don’t solve complex puzzles.

- You observe and interpret.

- And slowly, you start to understand Luna.

FEATURES

- Luna's Room is a short interactive experience (50–80 minutes) entirely developed by DonutDroid.

- Pixel art visuals inspired by the aesthetics of the ’90s and by great classics of the graphic adventure genre.

- Emotional original soundtrack.

- Atmospheric sound effects.

games.name: Forgotten Station
games.shortDescription: Forgotten Station is a knowledge-based narrative game, where you travel aboard trains to find your way out of a time loop. Your curiosity and observation skills will be put to the test in this relaxing game, filled with atmospheric places to uncover, characters to meet, and real human stories.
games.aboutText:
You find yourself lost in a mysterious world, where you can only visit train stations and navigate between them through the help of trains. But something seems off about this place… Are things repeating here?

During your trips, you might encounter other travelers. With each of them having their own storyline, get to know them through discussions, and perhaps you will learn more about this world and your place within it.

The train system is filled with mysteries! Keep an eye on every detail and take notes of your discoveries. A curious mindset might help you better understand this strange network, and perhaps lead you to new stations.

You may stumble upon some letters at stations. More than 50 of them are writings of true stories. Friends, family members, strangers, all poured their hearts into giving you a glimpse at their lives. For them, this game serves as a time capsule for who they were when they wrote those letters. For you, they are a small way to connect to another traveler, who shares this world with you.

- Uncover the mysteries of this world through a knowledge-based progression system and a deep narrative

- Discover a variety of atmospheric train stations

- Meet lost travelers and try to find a way out together

- Collect stamps at each train station

- Find writings of real-world people and get a glimpse at a stranger's life and thoughts

games.name: Ember Express
games.shortDescription: Ember Express is a sci-fi light yuri narrative adventure. Step into the role of a junior researcher at megacorporation COSMIC, uncover the truth behind the "Ember" incident, and rekindle a buried memory with your mysterious superior.
games.aboutText:
Ember Express is a sci-fi themed light yuri narrative adventure game. In a new century on the brink of humanity's expansion into the cosmos, you step into the role of a junior researcher joining the megacorporation COSMIC. As you uncover the truth behind the "Ember" incident, you will find yourself rekindling a buried memory alongside a superior who seems like a stranger at first.

The intrusion event known as "Ember" caused widespread failures in networked devices, along with massive property damage and casualties. Our company has also suffered significant losses.

The intruder left behind no traceable evidence. Yet, inside a long-sealed secret facility, a giant regular icosahedron has appeared out of nowhere—now the only lead in the investigation.

...

Attention all employees: During the investigation, stay away from restricted laboratories.

...

Office romances are strictly prohibited.

- Rich Story — Undercurrents Beneath the Corporate Surface

You live and work inside a secluded, off-limits facility. As you analyze the equipment and piece together the mystery behind the "UD3718" hallucination phenomenon, you gradually uncover a secret the company's top brass are desperate to hide. In the end, you unravel a conspiracy that spans across time.

- Varied Gameplay — Inspired by Quantum Entanglement

In the early stages of the game, puzzles are built around the concept of "quantum entanglement". You'll control two particles with opposite spins, using mechanics such as altering "magnetic fields" and leveraging "electric fields" to guide each particle to its designated position.

Later in the game, as long-sealed experimental facilities are brought back to light, more diverse gameplay elements will gradually unlock—including deeper simulation management and bullet hell battles.

- Audiovisual Experience — A Distinctive Blend of Near-Future and Light Sci-Fi

With its exquisite 2D art style, the game masterfully combines pristine laboratory environments with a group of girls, each hiding their own secrets. The soundtrack features over twenty original synth instrumental pieces, plus an original song with vocals.

- Miallai Lumen — A Junior Researcher Who Lost Everything

"Before my mother passed away, she told me: when you see a spending train, come back to me as quickly as you can..."

A freshly graduated girl with little life experience, and a new recruit at COSMIC.

She says she's socially inept—often struggling to get the words out—but beneath that hesitance lies an unexpected well of courage.

Before the "Ember" incident, she joined COSMIC to follow in her father's footsteps.

She frequently dreams of a young woman who would be the same age as her team leader now...

- Octo — The Warm and Generous Team Leader

"Hey, maybe you'll be team leader one day...just not until I'm dead on the job."

The first person under 30 at COSMIC to become a team leader. Almost none of the projects she's led have ever failed.

She likes to joke around with her team, but when things get serious, she's always the first to step up.

She never talks about her past. There's always an unlabeled bottle of pills on her desk...

- Fleshy — The Quiet and Mysterious Senior

"Then again, in a place like COSMIC, speaking your mind isn't exactly a good thing."

She doesn't like talking to coworkers and absolutely hates rules and regulations.

Rumor has it she was placed here as a victim of another project...

games.name: Farm to Restaurant Simulator
games.shortDescription: Grow crops on your farm, cook delicious meals, and manage your own restaurant in this relaxing farm-to-restaurant simulation game.
games.aboutText:
Farm to Restaurant Simulator is a relaxing simulation game where you grow fresh ingredients on your farm and turn them into delicious meals in your restaurant.

Plant crops, harvest your produce, process ingredients, and cook a variety of meals for hungry customers. Manage both your farm and restaurant while expanding your business step by step.

Upgrade your equipment, unlock new recipes, and improve your restaurant to serve more customers and create the ultimate farm-to-table experience.

🌱 Grow Your Own Ingredients

Plant and harvest crops on your farm to supply your restaurant.

🍳 Cook and Serve Meals

Prepare dishes using the ingredients you produce and serve them to customers.

⚙️ Process Ingredients

Use machines to turn raw products into valuable cooking ingredients.

🏪 Manage Your Restaurant

Expand your restaurant, upgrade equipment, and improve efficiency.

📈 Expand Your Business

Unlock new recipes, machines, and upgrades as your restaurant grows.

games.name: Incremental RTS
games.shortDescription: Semi-idle incremental RTS. You don’t micro units. You build factories, pick upgrades and let your army flood the battlefield. Start with nothing, research tanks, artillery, flankers and mega units. Scale and survive enemy surges. Pure auto-battle chaos.
games.aboutText:
Build. Scale. Deploy.

Start with scraps. End with armies that flood the map.

In Incremental RTS you don’t command units. You build the production machine, pick the upgrades path, balance economics and decide how your army grows.

The classic RTS fantasy of just spawning a huge force and sending it, except the “sending it” part happens on its own.

Choose your path

Specialize in swarms, artillery, snipers, tanks, or massive unstoppable units. Mix them or go all-in. Every path scales differently, and the enemy always has challenges for you. Adapt or get overrun. Some runs collapse early. Others spiral into unstoppable chaos.

Every unit matters

Early units never fully retire. As the game progresses they unlock new abilities, synergies, and scaling hooks that can turn “trash” into core pieces of your late-game army. How well you keep them relevant is part of the decision-making.

Key Features

- Semi-idle RTS with zero micromanagement

- Massive auto-battles with hundreds to thousands of units

- Incremental scaling and exponential army growth

- Multiple distinct army archetypes and upgrade paths

- 300+ upgrades that actually change how you play

- Low-tier units remain relevant throughout the game

- Enemy surges that pressure every build

- Hand-drawn paper aesthetic

games.name: Chi Chi's Magic Wash
games.shortDescription: Help Chi Chi clean grime and master her magical cleaning prowess. Make her parents proud in this cozy witchy cleaning sim. Clean with a spell-powered wand, explore charming locations, find potions, and bring sparkle back to every corner of the enchanted world.
games.aboutText:
Help Chi Chi, a young witch, start her journey in learning her trade. Her magical studies aren’t like everyone else’s…
Instead of curses or fortune tellings, Chi Chi specializes in restorative cleaning enchantments —a gentle art that restores beauty to enchanted places.

In Chi Chi’s Magic Wash , relax by using a spell-powered wand to wash away grime, uncover hidden details, and bring life back into whimsical environments. Clean mystical statues, forgotten homes, overgrown mushrooms, and more as you explore a warm, enchanting world at your own pace.

Chill, unwind, and join Chi Chi on her cozy journey restoring the fantasy lands, one sparkle at a time.

games.name: Stellar Breach
games.shortDescription: Blast through massive waves and tough bosses in this chaotic sci-fi roguelite shooter. Guide the charming duo, Barnaby and C.A.T., through a branching narrative via multiple-choice interactions where your story decisions directly alter randomized loadouts and abilities on every run!
games.aboutText:
Buckle up for this chaotic adventure in the world of Stellar Breach , a fast-paced sci-fi roguelite where survival hinges entirely on your reflexes and your loadout. The universe is throwing everything it has at you, and you'll need to thread the needle through absolute cosmic mayhem to make it out alive.

Master the Dash, Own the Void Combat in Stellar Breach is completely built around precision timing and your core dash ability. You aren't just holding down the trigger; you're weaving through dense asteroid fields, chaining movements, and tethering through scrap to outmaneuver your enemies. Every encounter is a frantic dance of positioning where a perfectly timed dash means the difference between victory and becoming space dust.

Face Down Cosmic Nightmares The galaxy is not empty, and it is definitely not friendly. Prepare for brutally challenging gameplay anchored by intense boss battles. Whether you are dodging the overwhelming, neon-soaked bullet hell of the Maw of the Void, surviving an escort sequence against the Forge-Master, or trying to outrun the relentless Nebula Wraith, every boss requires you to learn their patterns and push your mechanics to the absolute limit.

Your Choices Shape the Run You aren't flying solo. Step into the paws of Barnaby, navigating the stars alongside your trusty, occasionally snarky AI companion, C.A.T. Between the frantic space battles, your choices matter and actively alter your game experience. The tactical decisions you make in dialogue drastically change how you play the game.

Endless Build Potential No two runs through the breach are ever the same. Thanks to the massive potential for various build types, you can tailor your ship to match your exact playstyle. Synergize your dash mechanics with wild, overlapping upgrades and lean into completely different combat routines every time you leave the hangar.

games.name: Idle Deepcore
games.shortDescription: Click a block, buy a jackhammer, never stop digging. Idle Deepcore is a pixel-art incremental game: build a row of drills, smelt ore into ingots, open mines across the world map, reach the planet's core 10 km down, then head to space.
games.aboutText:
It starts with a pickaxe.

Click a block. Get a stone. Click again. A few hundred clicks later you can afford a jackhammer, and it doesn't get tired.

Then the machines take over

Jackhammers, steam drills, seismic hammers, excavators, mechanical worms, all the way to the Annihilator. Each one hits harder and wider than the last, and you can run a whole row of them at once. The rock gets harder the deeper you go, so they'd better.

Smelt what you dig

Ore isn't worth much raw. Build furnaces, from a stone kiln to a fission furnace, turn copper and tin into bronze, iron into steel, crystals into lenses, uranium into fuel rods. Sell ingots, or feed them back into bigger machines.

One mine is never enough

Open new sites on the world map, each in its own biome with its own ores. They all keep digging while you look at another one.

10 km down, and then up

Reach the planet's core and start over stronger with the Mastery tree. Build a launch pad, send probes and drills to asteroids, mine uranium in orbit, and wrap the sun in a Dyson sphere.

Play it at your own pace. Leave it running in a corner of the screen while you work, or spend an evening tuning every furnace and every column. Either way the mine keeps going down, and there is always a bigger machine waiting a little deeper.

games.name: Sol One
games.shortDescription: A grounded open-world survival crafting game where you're stranded alone on Mars. Explore the red planet, extract resources, build a pressurized base, manage oxygen, power, and food, and construct the rocket that's your only way home.
games.aboutText:
You're alone on Mars.

The mission is over. Your crew left you behind. You've got a pressure suit, whatever you can pull out of the ground, and a long way to go before you see Earth again. There's a rocket between you and home. You just have to build it first.

Sol One is a first-person open-world survival game that tries to get the science right. It's for people who like grounded, science-driven survival where the problem-solving is the point. Your oxygen, power, and food all come from machines you set up and maintain, and keeping them running is a must for survival.

Build it up from the dirt

Mine iron, copper, silica, ice, and uranium out of the red planet. Run the raw materials through smelters and fabricators and manufacture the parts you need to turn a cramped shelter into a thriving base. The tech tree gives you a long road from scraping by to running a base that mostly takes care of itself.

A planet that wants you dead

Mars is doing its best to kill you the whole time. The surface runs out to the horizon in every direction, broken up by deep canyons, old craters, mountains, and fields of rock and coarse regolith you have to pick your way across. The sky behaves like the real thing, from rusty daylight to a cold blue sunset to the gorgeous Milky Way after dark. Dust storms brew on the horizon and roll in over the ridge, and your solar panels drop off, visibility closes in, and the comfortable margins you were working with are suddenly gone until it passes.

Beyond the airlock

Drive out across the surface to find what's worth finding, or send your autonomous rover ahead to scout and haul while you handle things back in your base. The planet is dotted with crashed spacecraft, earlier landing sites, and abandoned mission bases, and picking through them turns up materials, parts, and pieces of what happened here before you arrived. Getting somewhere far out and getting back alive is its own kind of problem when your oxygen and power are still ticking down the whole way.

The Only Way Home

All of it points at one goal. Mine enough, learn enough, and build enough to finish a rocket that flies, climb in, and return home.

Features

- Connected life support — Oxygen, power, and food all depend on each other, so a failure anywhere is felt everywhere

- Three crafting tiers — Extraction, processing, and fabrication, working up from raw regolith to finished parts

- Base building — Pressurized, oxygenated habitats running on a power grid you lay out and keep running

- Farming — Grow your own food, and since every crop is also a seed, you're always deciding whether to eat it or plant it

- Vehicles and exploration — Drive the surface yourself or send an autonomous rover ahead, and search crashed ships, landing sites, and old mission bases for what they left behind

- Dust storms — Storms roll in and take your power and visibility with them, so you're forced to plan around them or get caught out

- A full-scale Mars with a physically-based sky and an accurate Martian day/night cycle

About Early Access

I'm building Sol One on my own, and I want to get it right with the people who play it. That's why I'm launching into Early Access instead of holding everything back until it's done. The community's feedback matters a lot to me here — what players run into, what they like, what feels off, and what they want more of is going to steer where the game goes and what I build next. The demo covers the early survival loop, and the full game grows out from there: more systems, a more accurate planet, and the whole arc from crash site to launch. If a slower, more grounded Mars survival game sounds like your kind of thing, wishlist it, jump into the discussions, and help me build it.

games.name: Force Typhoon
games.shortDescription: Experience the chaos and intensity of high-speed combat in this atmospheric sci-fi vertical Shoot ’Em Up, rendered in full 3D. Blast your way through relentless waves of enemies as you unleash your arsenal to defend your home against overwhelming odds!
games.aboutText:
Photosensitivity Warning: “This game contains flashing lights and effects that may cause discomfort or seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy.”

---

When relentless waves of enemies appear and a barrage of incoming fire rains down, chaos ensues.

Panic floods the comms radio with desperate calls. Your focus increases as you enter the flow state.

There is no retreat. You are all that stands between hope and total annihilation.

---

[ FORCE TYPHOON ]

Immerse in intense and chaotic high-speed combat in this gritty, cinematic sci-fi vertical Shoot ’Em Up with striking visuals rendered in full 3D. Blast your way through 9 stages of enemy onslaught as you unleash the might of your firepower against the enemy and break the blockade forced upon your world.

[ FRENETIC SCI-FI ARCADE ACTION ]

Inspired by the classics of the 80s and 90s, Force Typhoon features pure arcade adrenaline, precise controls, immersive 3D visuals and a strong atmospheric edge - With an oppressive foe that grants minimal downtime between waves.

[ OUTFIT YOUR EXPERIMENTAL FIGHTER ]

Take control of the XF-5800 “Maren” experimental fighter, assigned to the elite Force Typhoon squadron. Outfit its six equipment banks with a wide range of weaponry and support modules, then dive into the fight.

[ REPEL THE THREAT ]

AWACS has just picked up multiple incoming contacts.

Alert-Five fighters are being scrambled.

You are cleared for launch. Defend your home.

-------------------------------------------------------------

~ Enter the Flow State ~ become One with your fighter.

-------------------------------------------------------------

[ FEATURES ]

- Modern 3D visuals meet classic 80s/90s shmup action

- Quick, responsive controls: No drift/inertia, no acceleration.

- Analog stick can be toggled between analog or digital mode

- 9 stages of high-intensity action across three difficulty levels (Novice / Normal / Expert)

- Local scoreboard & online leaderboards

- Supports both gamepad & keyboard with re-bindable controls

- Accessible for newcomers, deeper scoring for veterans

- No grind - There are no experience points or levels to gain.

- Your progress is saved after every level. Pick up right where you left off!

games.name: Monster Cuisine
games.shortDescription: Best a beast and serve a feast in Monster Cuisine, an action-RPG where you're a tavern keeper hunting fabled creatures in a forbidden forest to cook mythical meals and grow your business. Craft unique weapons and armor sets to take on stronger monsters that are as delicious as they are dangerous.
games.aboutText:
You like hunting monsters? Cooking them and selling them in your tavern? Crafting armour and weapons from their bones? Arm wrestling? Belly dancing?

Good. You are on the right page.

Slaughter, season, sear, and serve delicious dishes for your customers and master a recipe book that grows as your kill count (and price) climbs

Satisfy a diverse cast of patrons with cozy, addictive mini-games where you keep the mugs full and plates hot as chaos ensues

Choose your weapon and your playstyle before going toe-to-toe with mythical creatures in glorious combat

Experiment with your customizable armor sets as you forge the perfect build for your hunts

Hunt and forage on expeditions across five unique biomes, defeating the most dangerous denizens of the Forbidden Forest and bringing them home for dinner

games.name: Farmed & Dangerous
games.shortDescription: Not another farming game. Plant by night, then defend your crops from dawn to dusk in a first-person roguelite shooter, solo or in 3-player online co-op. Blast crop-hungry crows out of the sky with shotguns, turrets, air strikes and the occasional RPG. Miss the truck's order and the run is over.
games.aboutText:
Grandpa left you three things: the farm, a bag of carrot seeds, and his old revolver. You're going to need all three.

DEFEND THE HARVEST

Your farm is under siege from the sky. By day the crows come, wave after wave and more of them each morning, and you meet them in first person. Start with Grandpa's revolver and work up to shotguns, SMGs, a grenade launcher, an RPG and, for some reason, a katana. Back them up with auto turrets, sprinklers and scarecrows.

Keep everything watered while you shoot, because every peck and every dry hour is yield you never get back. Snatch a crow off your tomatoes and throw it. When it all goes wrong, radio in the Crop Duster or call down a nuke. Or just fire a rocket into a circling flock and watch the birds rain out of the sky.

PLANT BY NIGHT

When the sun goes down, the shooting stops. Night is safe and in no hurry: plant, harvest, shop and plan. Any crop that survives the day grows another stage.

FEED THE TRUCK

Farmed & Dangerous is a roguelite where killing earns you nothing (golden birds excepted): the crops are the economy, and you are their heavily armed babysitter. Sell your harvest to pay for seeds, turrets and air support, or stockpile it for the delivery truck that rolls in every few days demanding a bigger order. Miss the order and the run is over.

BRING FRIENDS

Up to three farmers can work the same farm in online co-op. You share one wallet and one truck order, with proximity voice chat for yelling across the cornfield. The flock grows with your crew.

BEND THE RUN

Three perk cards hit the table at nightfall. Pick one and bend the run your way. In co-op, the whole crew votes.

Feeling lucky? The farm's casino has slots, roulette and blackjack for the money you probably should have spent on sprinklers.

KEEP WHAT YOU GROW

Between runs, spend your hard-earned Cores on land that stays yours, new guns for the armory wall, and a basement grow room for the one crop the truck driver doesn't need to know about.

Then start again a little stronger, on a farm that gets a little louder every day.

games.name: Dear Passengers
games.shortDescription: Play in co-op as the crew of the world’s worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.
games.aboutText:
WORLD’S WORST AIRLINE IS HIRING!

You and your friends are the crew. Your job is to deliver passengers and cargo to their destination. Preferably in one piece. While one of you pilots the plane, the others keep the cabin together, serve the passengers, and deal with whatever goes wrong before it gets much worse.

WELCOME TO BUDGET PREMIUM!

Passengers expect food, drinks, and a smooth flight. Try to provide at least two of those.

MORE TROUBLE, MORE MONEY!

Before takeoff, choose which passengers and cargo to bring onboard. The bigger the payout, the more trouble it usually causes. Some cargo is hard to handle, some passengers are hard to please, and some flights start going wrong before you even leave the ground.

SAFETY IS OUR TOP-3 PRIORITY!

Trouble can start anywhere onboard. Keep the passengers under control, protect the cargo, and do whatever it takes to stop one problem from turning into a full-blown disaster. Not every solution is elegant, and not every passenger stays onboard.

ROUGH AIR AHEAD!

Weather can turn a normal flight into a disaster. Turbulence and air pockets throw passengers, luggage, and anything else that is loose around the cabin. One bad turn can send the whole plane into chaos.

KEY FEATURES

- Online co-op with friends

- Pilot the plane or work inside the cabin

- Physics-based passengers, cargo, and cabin chaos

- Dynamic weather, turbulence, and air pockets

- Risky passengers and high-paying cargo

games.name: All Rats on Deck
games.shortDescription: All Rats on Deck is an online co-op adventure game where you must navigate a paddle steam boat through dangerous waters. Forced to leave your home, you must work together to operate the boat, scour for resources, and overcome obstacles to reach the ocean.
games.aboutText:
All Rats on Deck is an online co-op adventure game where you must navigate a paddle steam boat through dangerous waters. Forced to leave your home, you must work together to operate the boat, scour for resources, and overcome obstacles to reach the ocean.

NAVIGATE YOUR SCRAPPY STEAMBOAT

You and your rat buddies have put together a steamboat made from scraps and loose parts. Navigate this pile of junk as you are forced to leave your home.

SURVIVE DANGEROUS WATERS

The waters ahead are treacherous, so take good care of your boat and don't just go full throttle down fast rapids (or do, it's pretty funny).

REACH THE OCEAN

Rats are being forced to leave their homes. You will need to find a way out of the swamps to reach the ocean.

WORK TOGETHER TO OVERCOME OBSTACLES

On your adventure, you will come across many obstacles. Working together with your friends will be essential in overcoming them while keeping the boat in one piece.

SCOUR FOR RESOURCES TO KEEP THE ENGINE FED

The engine needs to be fed. Luckily, it can take just about anything you get your hands on*.

*DISCLAIMER: we are not responsible for side effects and exploding engines, feed at YOUR OWN RISK.

Features:

- Navigate a Steamboat with up to 4 players

- Boat grapple gun

- Engine - can feed it anything (with potential side effects)

- Online co-op

- Proximity voice chat

games.name: Next Reign: Kingdom
games.shortDescription: Transform a tiny settlement into a thriving medieval kingdom in this incremental strategy game. Build your economy, command your army, and keep discovering new ways to grow with every milestone.
games.aboutText:
Begin your reign in Next Reign: Kingdom. What starts as a single field slowly grows into a thriving medieval kingdom filled with bustling industries, powerful magic, and tactical battles. Every milestone unlocks something new, while automation keeps your kingdom running and frees you to take on even greater challenges.

Gather resources, train your first workers, and lay the foundation of your kingdom.

Construct specialized buildings, unlock new industries, and expand your settlement into a prosperous medieval realm.

Craft increasingly valuable goods, optimize production chains, and automate your expanding economy.

Plan formations, command specialized units, and overcome increasingly powerful foes.

Key Features

- Claim the Throne: Master over a dozen deeply interconnected systems to build your economy

- Command the Battlefield: Unlock 5 distinct unit types with different tiers, find devastating synergies and crush your enemies

- Maximize Your Power: Optimize your kingdom through around 20 hours of progression, 100+ prestige upgrades and hundreds of upgrades during reigns

- Watch Your Empire Flourish: Grow your kingdom, collect dozens of resources, and unlock game-changing mechanics all the way up to the endgame

games.name: Things to Forget – Lighthouse
games.shortDescription: Adam Foster, a 23-year-old office worker whose life is turned upside down after a breakup with his girlfriend. In an attempt to escape from himself, he takes a job as a lighthouse keeper, hoping to clear his mind. He could never have imagined the horror he would have to endure at his new workplace.
games.aboutText:
Things to Forget - is an episodic horror game that immerses you in a world of the unknown. Each story is a new chilling episode, and there is no mysticism: only real events experienced by people.

“Things to Forget - Lighthouse” - The first episode in the series.

Adam Foster, a 23-year-old office worker whose life is turned upside down after a breakup with his girlfriend. In an attempt to escape from himself, he takes a job as a lighthouse keeper, hoping to clear his mind. He could never have imagined the horror he would have to endure at his new workplace...

Gameplay.

The game is a first-person walking simulator with mechanics of exploration, driving, and conversations.

Key Features.

- Atmospheric environment.

- Elements of psychological horror with unexpected plot twists.

- VHS aesthetic.

- Interactive dialogues with NPCs.

- Voice interaction with the game.

- Unique sound effects that increase the tension.

games.name: D-Extinction
games.shortDescription: D-Extinction is a first-person investigative horror game. A secret experiment went too far. Now the pre-historic predators are loose. Explore, investigate, and survive in a immersive horror experience where one mistake can kill.
games.aboutText:
You are hunted

They told you it was a research facility.

They didn’t tell you what they were researching.

You play as a rookie agent sent into a classified lab that has gone dark for weeks. What begins as a routine investigation quickly turns into a fight for survival.

Story & Gameplay:

A classified facility has gone silent. You’re sent in to investigate.

What you find inside was never meant to exist.

This is a bodycam-style horror experience where you investigate what went wrong and your survival depends on one thing— not being seen.
The facility is overrun by highly intelligent predators. They don’t forgive mistakes.

Move carefully.
Collect evidence.
Watch everything.

Because once they find you… there’s no escape.

Realistic graphics and high-quality 3D sound fully immerse you in the eerie atmosphere of moving with these prehistoric beasts.

games.name: IM:VVI Galaxy Runaway
games.shortDescription: Crash-land with Team VVI’s three mercenaries on a mysterious planet inhabited by strange birdfolk. Explore unique civilizations, face enemies in combat that blends rhythm and strategy, interact with curious locals, and uncover the conspiracy surrounding the planet’s nature spirit.
games.aboutText:
An accident sends three rookie mercenaries to a planet that was never meant to be found.

Virelle, Vyn, and IX-6 are three rookie mercenaries in Team VVI. While on a supply run, they crash-land on an unknown planet. Here, unique mythologies and civilizations coexist with adorable wildlife, distinctive planetary inhabitants, and a massive conspiracy surrounding Bloster, the planet's nature spirit.

Explore unfamiliar landscapes, interact with the locals, investigate unexpected events, and face enemies in combat that combines rhythm and strategy. Move between exploration, battles, casual puzzles, and a variety of mini-games as you piece together the truth hidden within this planet.

A missing companion. A planet gone awry. And strange magic circles beginning to appear. As the mystery unfolds, the three protagonists may be forced to confront their own choices and destinies. Your choices will shape how the story unfolds.

One planet. Three mercenaries. One runaway journey across the galaxy.

- Experience a distinctive art style filled with rich detail.

- Explore an unknown planet shaped by unique mythologies and civilizations.

- Face enemies in rhythm-and-strategy combat, with casual puzzles and a variety of mini-games along the way.

- Meet adorable wildlife and distinctive inhabitants from across the planet.

- Uncover the conspiracy surrounding Bloster and the planet while searching for your missing companion.

- Witness the growth of Virelle, Vyn, and IX-6 throughout their journey.

- Take part in a barbecue party held to rescue Vyn.

Ready to run away into the unknown?

IM:VVI Galaxy Runaway is planned for release in 2027. Add it to your wishlist on Steam now and get notified when the game becomes available.

games.name: Parry Survivor
games.shortDescription: Control an anime heroine in the Kun-Domain! Master Sekiro-style parries to deflect endless waves of Kuns, unleash cinematic executions, and upgrade your damage and weapons in this fast-paced action game.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the Kun-Domain.

Step into a surreal, high-stakes battleground where an anime heroine must face off against an endless, relentless onslaught of Kuns. In this fast-paced, rhythmic action game, survival isn’t just about slashing wildly—it is about absolute precision, perfect timing, and mastering the art of the deflect.

Are you ready to enter the domain and conquer the infinite rhythm of the Kun?

Key Features

- Deflect & Dominate ( Sekiro -Style Combat): Forget mindless button-mashing. The core of your survival rests on your ability to parry. Meet every single attack from the invading Kuns with a perfectly timed deflect. Break their posture, turn their momentum against them, and control the rhythm of the battlefield.

- Cinematic Executions: Reward your perfect defense with devastating offense. Once a Kun's guard is completely shattered, unleash flashy, high-satisfaction execution moves. Watch as dynamic camera angles and striking visual effects highlight your stylish finishes.

- Endless Waves of Kuns: The domain knows no rest. Face off against an infinitely spawning horde of Kuns that grow progressively more challenging. Test your reflexes and see how long your beautiful warrior can hold the line against the endless tide.

- Upgrade & Evolve: Collect resources from your fallen foes to access the in-game shop between waves. Invest in your survival by purchasing permanent damage boosts to cut through hordes faster, or unlock new, formidable weapons to completely change your aesthetic and combat efficiency.

games.name: Detective Turner: If Looks Could Kill
games.shortDescription: A point-and-click noir murder mystery where you literally read the room. Search for clues in text, photograph evidence, and interrogate suspects in visual novel-style conversations to solve the murder of a fashion icon.
games.aboutText:
Who killed Margot Voss? The founder of the fashion magazine Mirage was found dead at a private party in the Hamptons. As Detective Turner, you must question Margot’s guests about their version of her final evening. A closer reading of the room can help you catch what they may try to leave out.

There’s just one complication. One of the people you’re trying to read used to know you by heart.

Literally Read the Room

Follow the writing on the wall to find your way through Mirage ’s summer residence and uncover clues hidden in the text.

Photograph the Evidence

When something feels off, take a photo. Sometimes the best way to get a suspect talking is to show them what you found.

Check Your Notebook

Where did that detail come up before? Flip through your notebook to find out. It keeps a running record of the evidence you’ve discovered and the parts of the story each guest was willing to tell you.

Confront Suspects

Present the photos you’ve collected and ask suspects about the details that don’t add up. Their reaction might tell you as much as their answer.

games.name: Under A Groove
games.shortDescription: 'Under A Groove' is a rhythm game that's fun just to watch, even if you're only playing the music video. A stylish rhythm action game where visuals and music sync perfectly—simple to play, deeply satisfying to master.
games.aboutText:
“Under A Groove” is a fast-paced rhythm action game that anyone can jump into.

Just press the button in time with the beat.

Simple controls make it easy to start—but staying in the groove is where the real challenge begins.

Immerse yourself in a world where music and motion are perfectly synchronized.

Every beat drives vibrant, stylish animations, creating a satisfying audiovisual experience.

Feel the rhythm.

Stay in the groove.

Features

- Simple and intuitive controls

Just press the button in time with the rhythm—easy to learn, fun to master.

- Fully synchronized visuals and music

Experience seamless audiovisual feedback that enhances every beat.

- Catchy and energetic soundtrack

Music that makes you want to move.

- Dynamic animations that react to your performance

Your success changes what you see.

- Quick, replayable rhythm challenges

Perfect for both short sessions and long playtime.

games.name: Respect The Horde
games.shortDescription: You're outnumbered. Outsmart them. Lure hordes of zombies into deadly traps, shape their path with obstacles, and grow stronger with every kill. But know when to walk away before overconfidence and greed turn your strategy into uncontrollable chaos.
games.aboutText:
YOU'RE OUTNUMBERED. OUTSMART THEM.

Fighting hundreds of zombies head-on is a good way to run out of bullets.

In Respect the Horde, survival is about using the horde's predictable behavior against it. Build barriers to redirect its path, lure zombies where you want them, and funnel entire crowds into barbed wire, fire and deadly traps.

The bigger the horde, the more important your plan becomes.

EXPLORE. LOOT. PREPARE.

Explore abandoned locations for weapons, equipment and resources. Decide where to make your stand, then turn the environment into a defensive setup built to handle hundreds of infected at once.

Place obstacles to shape their path. Combine traps. Create bottlenecks. Keep an escape route open.

Because once the horde starts moving, changing the plan becomes a lot harder.

ONE MORE WAVE?

The more zombies you kill, the greater the rewards, but the further you push, the more dangerous the horde becomes.

You can extract when the objective is complete and bring your rewards home.

Or you can stay.

One more wave.

One more danger level.

One more chance to come back stronger.

The longer you push your luck, the more there is to gain, and the more spectacularly your carefully prepared strategy can fall apart.

The real challenge isn't surviving. It's knowing when to leave.

EVERY RUN MATTERS

Survivors who make it home gain experience and learn new skills. Recover new weapons and equipment, improve your base, and prepare your group for increasingly dangerous missions.

But death matters too. Lose a survivor in the field and they'll join the horde until you put an end to their misery.

Every extraction makes the group stronger. Every mistake can make the next mission harder.

RECLAIM THE ISLAND

Choose where to deploy from the island map, with each location offering different opportunities, advantages and dangers.

Push deeper into infected territory, reclaim regions one mission at a time, and build a path toward taking the island back from the dead.

You don't need enough bullets to kill every zombie. You just need a better plan.

KEY FEATURES

- Manipulate the Horde: Redirect hundreds of zombies using barriers, traps and environmental hazards.

- Loot, Build, Survive: Explore each area for weapons, ammunition and resources, then use what you find to prepare for the horde.

- Risk vs Reward: Stay longer to grow stronger and earn greater rewards, or extract before the horde overwhelms you.

- Permanent Progression: Unlock new skills, survivors and equipment to tackle increasingly dangerous missions.

- Reclaim the Island: Choose where to deploy next and gradually reclaim the island region by region.

games.name: Cozy Interiors
games.shortDescription: Ever dreamed of becoming an interior designer? Design cozy homes and get paid for it. Build and decorate charming interiors, unlock a wide variety of furniture, and create wholesome spaces filled with personality, furry friends, and perfect little details.
games.aboutText:
Design Your Dream Interiors! Ever dreamed of becoming an interior designer? Step into a cozy world where every space is a blank canvas waiting for your creativity. Design warm, inviting homes and get paid for your aesthetic touch.

Whether you are decorating a compact apartment, a peaceful bedroom, a cozy living room, or a charming family home, every project gives you a new space to shape. Choose how each room should feel, plan the layout, and create interiors that are both beautiful and satisfying to complete. 🛋️ Build, Decorate, Relax

Plan layouts, place furniture, adjust decorations, and make every corner feel intentional. Arrange sofas, beds, tables, shelves, plants, rugs, lamps, wall decor, and many other cozy details to bring each room together.

You can focus on clean and organized spaces, warm and lived-in homes, cute, colorful rooms, or stylish interiors with carefully matched furniture. Move things around, try different combinations, and find the setup that feels just right. 🧸 Endless Cozy Possibilities

Unlock a wide variety of furniture, colors, decorative items, and room themes as you progress. Mix and match different styles, experiment with layouts, and create interiors that feel personal instead of repeated.

Welcome adorable furry friends into your interiors and design around the small, wholesome moments they bring. A sunny pet corner, a cozy bed by the window, or a playful space can make your designs feel even warmer and more charming.

💼 A Relaxing Job Simulator

Take on design jobs, earn money, unlock new items, and grow your creative career at your own pace. Each job gives you a satisfying goal while still leaving room for your own style and creativity.

There is no pressure to rush. Cozy Interiors is about the relaxing joy of decorating, improving spaces, and watching empty rooms slowly turn into homes full of comfort, charm, and personality.

games.name: Ice Cream Simulator - Prologue
games.shortDescription: Prepare ice cream, serve customers, set your prices, and manage your shop in this limited-access prologue of ice cream simulator—get a taste of the full game.
games.aboutText: Step into the world of Ice Cream Simulator in this prologue, where you manage a small shop and explore the core gameplay. Serve a limited range of flavors, handle customers across four seasons, and manage your workflow with limited preparation slots. Each customer type brings unique behavior and expectations. Set your own prices and get a hands-on preview of what the full game will offer.

games.name: Sushiamo
games.shortDescription: Sushiamo is a roguelike deck-builder where you make sushi to reach absurd scores. Discover unique ingredients, sauces, game-changing tools, and navigate the map to break the game with insane combos!
games.aboutText:
Sushiamo is a Balatro-inspired roguelike deck-builder where you combine unique ingredients, tools, and sauces to create crazy sushi and trigger game-breaking combos.

Find the synergy

Every ingredient has a distinct bonus and synergy with other ingredients. Experiment to find the best combo!
Build your perfect kitchen by collecting the right ingredients, tools and sauces to progress through increasingly higher scoring requirements and become a sushi master.

Choose Your Path

Navigate through a map that changes every run, where every choice matters, take the safer path or risk it all for greater rewards.
Encounter unexpected events along the way that can grant you game-changing bonuses or set you back.

So much content to unlock

- 🌊 Over 300+ items to discover

- 🎐 A market to discover your perfect setup

- 🍥 Unlockable ingredients, tools, sauces and more

Credits: Trailer Music by " Won Jong Hwa "

games.name: War Room Football
games.shortDescription: Build a dynasty from the front office. Draft, trade, sign, and develop players across unlimited seasons. Scout prospects, manage the cap, hire coaches, then watch the league evolve around you.
games.aboutText:
Take the reins of a professional football franchise and prove you can build a dynasty.

You're the General Manager. Every roster decision, every draft pick, every contract negotiation runs through you. Build your roster, hire your coaching staff, manage the salary cap, and watch your team take the field, all while an owner demands results.

DRAFT YOUR FUTURE
