Scout hundreds of prospects each year through a multi-layered scouting system. Spend scouting points to reveal hidden attributes, attend the combine for measurables, conduct interviews to assess personality, and track college stats as they drop throughout the season. On draft night, field live trade offers and find your franchise cornerstone, or miss on a bust.

BUILD YOUR ROSTER

Manage a 53-man roster with a salary cap that mirrors real football economics where the cap and contracts grow. Structure contracts with signing bonuses, dead cap, and restructures. Navigate three waves of free agency. Flip players at the trade deadline. Even experiment with out-of-position conversions, slide a tight end to guard or a running back to receiver.

SCHEME MATTERS

Hire a coaching staff with real philosophical identity. Choose from 6 offensive and 6 defensive schemes that directly impact how your team plays on the field. An outside zone scheme needs athletic linemen and a back who can find cutback lanes. An air raid scheme needs four receivers who can win in space. On defense, a blitz-heavy front generates pressure but exposes the secondary. Your personnel has to match your philosophy. Your coordinators develop scheme mastery over time, but rival teams may try to poach them.

EVERY FACE TELLS A STORY

Every player on your roster has a unique procedurally generated pixel art portrait. A custom sprite system designed by an artist layers several components, including head shape, hairstyle, skin tone, eye color, facial hair, and accessories, then composites them into pixel art portraits with personality. With billions of possible combinations, you'll never see the same face twice.

WATCH IT PLAY OUT

Simulate games with a play-by-play engine calibrated against real professional football data. Watch drives unfold on a field view with live win probability chart, drive logs, and broadcast-style presentation. Every player attribute, from throw power to route running to block shedding, even a lineman's arm length or a running back's weight, feeds into outcomes on every snap.

DEVELOP YOUR PLAYERS

Players grow and decline on realistic career arcs with position-specific peak ages. Different development traits accelerate growth and training camp events create breakout moments. Watch a late-round pick blossom into an All-Pro, or a top prospect flame out.

THE LEAGUE LIVES

Follow the drama through Blitz, a social media feed where players talk trash, analysts debate your moves, and reporters break stories. Coaching carousels, contract holdouts, milestone celebrations, and playoff hype all generate dynamic storylines that make every season feel alive.

GO DEEPER

Place bets with calibrated spreads and over/unders. Track advanced stats like passer rating, yards per route run, and pressure-to-sack rate. Upgrade your scouting department, medical staff, and stadium by hitting owner goals and earning payouts. Save up steadily, or go all-in by betting your season's income on a championship underdog to cover. Chase Hall of Fame inductions across a 100-year franchise history. Satisfy your owner's goals, or get fired and start over with a new team.

KEY FEATURES

- Real-world schedule rotation tuned to realistic difficulty curves, informed by prior season performance

- 7-round draft with scouting reports, combine stats, player interviews, and live draft-day trades

- Full salary cap system with contracts, restructures, dead cap, and extensions

- 12 coaching schemes that shape how your team actually plays on the field

- A sim engine where 20+ attributes per position, from arm strength to hand size, shape every single play

- Multi-wave free agency with personality-driven negotiations that never feel scripted

- Blitz social feed with thousands of dynamic storylines that follow your franchise all season

- Calibrated betting lines with moneylines, spreads, and over/unders for every game

- Advanced analytics dashboard with deep team and position-specific metrics

- Hall of Fame, awards, and legacy tracking that spans your entire dynasty

- Unlimited seasons to build something that lasts decades

games.name: LUNAR PULSE
games.shortDescription: "LUNAR PULSE" is a single-player roguelite card game. Ultra-short battles decided within 60 seconds. Experience soulslike tension where a single move leads to instant death. It features a game system where players act simultaneously with hands revealed.
games.aboutText:
- 1-on-1 single-player card battles.

- Ultra-short battles are decided within 60 seconds.

- Simple yet deep rules with a 15-card deck and 5-card hand.

- Deck enhancement & customization through roguelite elements.

- Featuring Multiple Endings.

▼ GAME FEATURES

- High-speed card battles where you see each other's hands

Both you and your opponent play a card at the same time.

Read the opponent's choice from their revealed hand and choose the move that decides victory or defeat.

- "Soulslike" tension experienced through card battles

In this battle, a single strike leads directly to defeat.

Utilize DODGE, PARRY, and GUARD to seize victory through mind games.

- Roguelite elements that turn Lose into power

Every time you Lose, your deck grows stronger.

Unlock dozens of elements and hone your own unique fighting style.

- The stage: A deadly rite by thirteen witches

A world that belongs nowhere, submerged in an eternal moonlit night. There, a rite is about to be performed.

The protagonist, "Lilith of Heresy," who strayed into the thirteenth seat that should not exist, challenges twelve witches [Lilith] in a rite where their very existence is at stake.

- Is that choice Salvation or a price to pay? An endless story of branching paths.

Dozens of ending paths are available, branching based on the player's choices.

Who is Lilith of Heresy? What is the true nature of the rite?

With every ending reached, you draw closer to the truth of this world and herself.

▼ Characters

- Name: Lilith of Heresy

- Seat: Seat of the Foremost Hour

- Sin: Unknown

- CV：Nanahara Teiko

- Name: Lilith of Maidenhood

- Seat: Seat of the Sixth Hour

- Sin: The sin of vowing faith

- CV: Senga Hikari

- Name: Lilith of the Guardian

- Seat: Seat of the Tenth Hour

- Sin: The sin of excessive cowardice

- CV: Hiiragi Yuka

- Name: Lilith of Judgment

- Seat: Seat of the First Hour

- Sin: The sin of defining good and evil

- CV: Tanaka Neo

- Name: Lilith of Denial

- Seat: Seat of the Final Hour

- Sin: The sin of rejecting everything

- CV: ???

games.name: Depth-Bound
games.shortDescription: 🌊 A physics-based underwater 2D platformer. 🚀 Propel yourself out of the water, chain trajectories, and dive always more deeply. 📸 Photograph strange creatures and follow an expedition whose outcome remains uncertain.
games.aboutText:
🌊 THE ABYSS CALLS 🪼

No one has ever charted the unfathomable depths of the Under-Sea. But it’s time.

- 🕹️ Take control of your submersible and let yourself drift downward.

- 💦 Launch yourself out of the water, bounce from cavern to cavern, and dive ever deeper into the ocean’s depths.

- 🪸 Discover regions of the oceans, covered in coral or lined with wrecks, sometimes shaped by volcanic vents, sometimes glowing with phosphorescent rock.

📸 CATALOG THE NUMEROUS SPECIES 🐙

The Under-Sea teems with unknown creatures, which man has never yet been able to observe!

- 🦑 Photograph the species that inhabit this world to enrich your logbook.

- 🐠 Meet the strangest species of the seabed, between lively or furious fish, slimy sea snakes, shy transparent jellyfish… or silhouettes of the abyss with incomprehensible shapes.

✉️ THE CAPTAIN’S JOURNEY 🗺️

After so many years, the University of Oslo finally grants you the means to explore these depths. Direction: the depths.

- 📡 With the help of your sonar, find fragments of lost messages — vestiges of a previous voyage, or strange coded transmissions.

- 📜 Follow the epic of the captain, and sink yourself into the abyssal depths of the Under-Sea… without knowing if you will manage to come back up.

games.name: There's Something Wrong with the Hero's Choices
games.shortDescription: 「その選択肢、正気か？」シンプルなノベルゲームのはずなのに、とにかく“選択肢”がおかしい！？ 予想を超える展開が待ち受ける、奇想天外なテキストアドベンチャーゲーム！
games.aboutText:
シンプルなノベルゲームのはずなのに、とにかく“選択肢”がおかしい！？

予想を超える展開が待ち受ける、奇想天外なテキストアドベンチャーゲーム！

次々と現れるいちいちおかしな選択肢を選びながら勇者一行を魔王のもとへ導こう！

あらすじ

とある赤い月が輝く王国。

王様に魔王の討伐を言い渡された勇者一行は、魔王退治へと旅立った。

行く手を阻む断崖絶壁、襲い来る魔王の手下たち……

困難に直面するたびに、勇者は数々の選択を迫られる。

果たして勇者一行は魔王のもとへたどり着けるのか？

魔王退治へ向かう勇者一行

癒し魔法が得意なシェイラ。攻撃魔術が得意なジヴァン。

そして代々の勇者の血を引く、物理に特化したリーダー山田――

山田……？

ゲームの特徴

- 次々と現れるおかしな選択肢を選びながら物語を進めるテキストアドベンチャーゲーム

- 選んだ選択肢によって予想もしないストーリーへ発展したり、時にはエンディングへ直行する事も……？

- 2000枚を超える圧倒的なボリュームのイベントCGのほか、30を超えるエンディングを収録

- 任意のタイミングでセーブ可能、試行錯誤して理想のエンディングを目指そう

- ニコニコ自作ゲームフェス新人賞2020でPLAYISM賞を受賞し、2023年1月24日に初公開されたフリーゲーム版に新エピソードや設定資料集を追加

games.name: Oboro no Ichi
games.shortDescription: Build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow your space through memories and a cozy atmosphere.
games.aboutText:
[A Market Between Memories]

Welcome to Oboro no Ichi , a market suspended between memories, where lost souls seek peace.
Build, expand, and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, and shape a place that can grow alongside them.

[Build and Grow Your Market]

Freely design your space, connecting stalls, buildings, and pathways to create a lively and harmonious place.
Each structure has a specific role: produce resources, supply your stalls, and grow your market one step at a time.

(A Simple Yet Deep Gameplay Loop)

Find the right balance between beauty and functionality.
Organize production, manage sales, expand your market, and increase its appeal to welcome more and more spirits.
A relaxing cycle that is easy to grasp, yet full of choices, strategies, and combinations.

(A Calm and Cozy Experience)

In Oboro no Ichi , there is no rush.
Only the slow drifting of spirits, the sound of the wind…
and a market that grows alongside them.
Take your time.

games.name: Orblins
games.shortDescription: Orblins is a Marble-Matching Roguelike inspired by classic marble shooters like Zuma and Luxor. Create game-breaking builds with endless marbles and upgrades to defeat a host of Orblins and bosses. Choose from a large cast of characters or create your own custom class to personalize your run.
games.aboutText:
Orblins is the first marble-matcher roguelike. If you have nostalgia for classic marble-matching games like

Zuma , Luxor , or Tumblebugs , but crave something to keep the gameplay fresh and add depth,

then Orblins is a game for you.

Gameplay:

- Build a deck of powerful orbs to defeat trains of enemy Orblins which push their orbs towards the end of the track.

- Match 3 or more of the same color orb to deal damage, shield yourself, or earn gold.

- Fight bosses while dodging their projectiles, adding a whole new layer to the classic marble-matching formula.

Orblins plays like an action roguelite, with a surprisingly steep skill curve, that keeps you on your toes. If you let your mistakes pile up, the enemy marbles crawl closer and closer towards the end of the track threatening to end your run.

Match Blue and Red Marbles to deal damage to the enemy and clear the level.
Match Green Marbles to shield yourself from incoming damage.
Match Yellow Marbles to gain gold with which to build your deck and buy upgrade items.

Alongside the 4 main colors there are a host of unique special marbles with powerful and game-changing abilities.

Slow enemy trains with Anchor Marbles,
Shoot explosive Bombs to match multiple chains,
Buy yourself more time with Freeze and Stun Marbles,
Instantly kill enemy Orblins with Slayer Marbles,
and many more!

games.name: REWIND
games.shortDescription: 《REWIND》 is a hardcore text-based detective puzzle game containing nearly a hundred clues. Players need to carefully examine and deduce the clues to find the answer to the case.
games.aboutText:
A film crew booked the penthouse hotel last night, and this morning the director was found dead in the pool.
You need to investigate the scene. First, determine if it's murder. If so, identify any suspects among those present. Finally, you need to reconstruct the events of the case.

《REWIND》 is a hardcore text-based detective puzzle game containing nearly a hundred clues. Players need to carefully examine and analyze these clues to find the answer.

Game Features:
Gameplay: Click-to-solve puzzles; easy to pick up, but very difficult.
Puzzle Design: An open world within a sandbox setting; minimal guidance, requiring players to actively explore.
Suitable for: Deduction enthusiasts who enjoy reading and analyzing text.
Game Duration: Approximately 90 minutes to complete without a walkthrough.

Serious Reminder!!!
During the testing phase, some players did not complete the game successfully, indicating its high difficulty and suitability for all players.
However, some testers who completed the game have given positive feedback, so players may need to make their own decisions.
If you encounter a stuck level, you can find walkthroughs on our bilibili channel; they will be released in advance.
The game folder includes a full game walkthrough to help players avoid getting stuck.

games.name: Eslabong
games.shortDescription: Arena combat meets mercenary club management. Recruit from a dynamic market, build your squad, and compete season after season in leagues and cups.
games.aboutText:
Autobattle or control one fighter in fast-paced arena battles. Aim abilities, move, and react in real time to outplay your opponents through positioning and timing. Or step back, set tactics, and watch your team fight.

Win fights to earn gold and chests, buy and sell mercenaries, and strengthen your roster. Discover classes with unique abilities, shape your team, and upgrade it across seasons. Hire trainers and staff, and hunt for mercenary shiny versions.

Take on powerful clubs and their unique leaders in leagues and tournaments. Battles range from tense 1v1 duels to all-out 8v8 brawls. Recruit rare champions or help a rookie from your starting roster ascend to champion status, customizing their abilities and stats along the way.

Challenge your friends in asynchronous PvP battles, or compete in ranked matches against opponents with similar Elo ratings. For a different kind of test, take your strongest team into the Hall of Legends and face a series of late-game PvE challenges.

Welcome to Eslabong

games.name: HOPE 01
games.shortDescription: HOPE 01 is a single player extraction survival RPG with multiple endings. Explore, Loot, and Fight your way through the dangerous enemies and bosses of the hab cluster and solve the mystery of the legendary HAB 01.
games.aboutText:
EXPLORE THE HAB CLUSTER, FIND HAB 01!

Wake up in a deteriorating underground facility with nothing but a mysterious request to find HAB 01.

Explore the perilous interconnected labyrinth of what once was, help survivors, and ultimately dictate the fate of humanity with multiple endings.

SHOOT & DODGE YOUR WAY THROUGH DANGEROUS ENEMIES AND BOSSES

Utilize various items to dispatch the dangerous enemies that wander the halls of the hab cluster.

Equip yourself with variety of guns, gadgets, and usable items to build your ideal loadout for any situation!

FIND AND TEST OUT OVER 70+ WEAPONS

Weapons have various qualities, like rate of fire, muzzle velocity, reload time, and penetration! Experiment and find out which are best for what situations and build a kit that suits your current needs!

LOOT EQUIPMENT AND EXTRACT SAFELY

Find weapons, armor, and gadgets while exploring the facility to build your arsenal.

Survive to bring your spoils back to your hideout or... die and lose it all...

SCAN YOUR LOOT AND FABRICATE THEM LATER!

Collect over 200 useful items in your fabricator! Print them back at your hideout for a dangerous outing or prepare for a well equipped boss run!

games.name: walk
games.shortDescription: it's about walking
games.aboutText:
My partner and I love going on walks. So, I wanted to make a short game inspired by our daily strolls! It's basically a zipped version of our daily walks over a year.

The regular things we do every day, like grabbing a coffee or going down the stairs, are turned into interactive mini scenes here. There are over 40 of them to discover!

Playing them earns you points, which you can use to unlock new ones.

Features:

- You just click around (sometimes drag and drop)

- Over 40 mini scenes (can be unlocked in under an hour)

- Flipnote Studio 3D limitation visuals

- Play at your own pace

- You can draw on the background

Inspired by Kalamaja & Vanalinn (Tallinn), The Walking Man (Jiro Taniguchi), Vibes Quest (@onionboots)

Thank you! I hope this little game inspires you to take walks!

games.name: AMEN: The Quiet Exodus
games.shortDescription: Cursed the womb that bears emptiness beneath its heart. For twenty-five years children have been born without souls, and a soul can only be restored by taking another’s. Ilaya Cassette wants to know what’s wrong with her. A gothic visual novel, fully voiced in Russian. Prologue and Part I out now.
games.aboutText:
And in its very depths, amid lights gone out forever and streets fallen silent for good, there stood a city whose cold light could barely pierce the veil of the blizzard.

Hlasov. The twenty-fifth year after the Exodus.

Since the Exodus, children have been born with a veil upon their faces and no soul. They are called the Hollow. Victor Cassette was the first to place a human soul in one of the Hollow, and gave hope to every generation to come. The present one had to pay for it, though: to give one person a soul, you have to take it from another. These days, souls are the business of the ECHO Corporation.

AMEN: The Quiet Exodus is a gothic visual novel about a city where faith in progress has replaced faith in God.

Ilaya Cassette is twenty-four. She considers herself a defective product and is desperately trying to diagnose the fault, unaware that it has long since become an inseparable part of the fragile mechanism she calls herself. Now and then the Veil surfaces on her face, just as it does on the Hollow. Why that happens, Ilaya will have to find out for herself.

Ilaya often has to decide on the spot, and the others remember how she treated them. Your answers determine how those around her will regard her, and what is more, your actions affect the fate of an entire city.

- Daemon Veres. Possessor of a soul that is real, yet steeped in darkness. Equally versed in science and scripture, he despises the faithful of both.

- Cassian Tess. The ideal product. A dubious heir, yet an exceptionally good man.

- Dakota Schwartz. The big sister. A small cog in a vast machine. A desired victim and an impenetrable shield.

Content warning. The game contains scenes of cruelty and violence, including violence against the protagonist, graphic killings, blood, mutilation and dead bodies, humiliation and psychological abuse, and elements of horror. Strong language, smoking and alcohol use are also present.

At the moment, the game contains the Prologue and Part I. The game is purchased once: the next parts will be released as updates, and you won’t have to pay for them separately. Your playthrough results will carry over into the following parts.

- Full Russian voice acting; text in English and Russian

- Hand-drawn scenes with animation

- Choices, relationships and romance routes

- A glossary of 90-odd entries and a journal

- Save at any moment: quicksave and autosave

- Text and subtitle size settings, softened flashes, camera shake toggle

games.name: One Coin Museum
games.shortDescription: Explore, collect, and build your very own cozy museum! In One Coin Museum, travel across the seas and use your claw to grab hidden treasures. Display your finds to attract visitors, grow your reputation, and upgrade your boat to reach even more distant wonders.
games.aboutText:
Set sail as Toadz, a cute frog who dreams of opening a sea museum with their friend Charlotte. Explore vast oceans to uncover hidden treasures and display them in your museum. Complete your collection, meet new friends who will help you along the way, and see your museum come to life… You might even discover incredible things during your journey.

🌊 Explore the oceans 🌊

Sail across wide oceans and explore new areas as you go. The deeper you travel, the more treasures you’ll uncover… and the more there is to discover beneath the waves.

🧲 Retrieve treasures 🧲

Use your claw to retrieve treasures from the ocean floor.
From common finds to rarer pieces, every item you bring up can enrich your collection.

Master your aim, grab what you can, and see what comes up from the depths.

🏛️Build your museum 🏛️

Display your treasures in your museum to attract more visitors.
The more complete your collection, the more people will come to see it.

Bring your museum to life, one find at a time.

-------------------------------------

Features:

✨ What you can expect

- A light collectathon with a rewarding sense of completion as your museum slowly comes to life

- A short, cozy adventure designed to help you relax, with charming pixel art

- A simple storyline with cute characters to accompany you along your journey

- Easy-going mini-games like clawing, fishing, and more

❌ What One Coin Museum is not

- NOT a museum management game, your museum is mostly idle and not customizable

- No multiplayer.

-------------------------------------

About the dev 🤓

Hello! Toadzillart here 👋

It’s with great joy that I present my second game, One Coin Museum ! After exploring cozy idle gameplay with Whimside , I wanted to return with a slightly bigger adventure.

Inspired by the sense of discovery from the games of my childhood and my unconditional love for collecting, I hope this little project brings you as much joy as I had creating it.

A special thanks to Tadpoly for all the support, both with marketing and on a personal level 💚

games.name: Beyond Yardwork Simulator
games.shortDescription: Gardening has never been this rewarding! Use a full arsenal of tools – from lawnmowers to pressure washers – to transform properties and earn money to renovate your own home. With intuitive mechanics and beautiful visuals, it’s the perfect stress-free relaxation for everyone.
games.aboutText:
Get swept away by an immersive story in handcrafted narrative levels . And when you're craving more, dive into infinity with our Procedural Level Generation system.

Grab your tools and feel the relaxation that comes with tending to a garden. Your task list is clear and rewarding:

- Mowing lawns

- Trimming weeds

- Pressure washing

- Picking up litter

- Hauling bulk waste

- Waste sorting

- Leaf blowing and more

- Sweeper cleaning

Hard work pays off!

The money earned from client jobs can be invested into your own sanctuary . Renovate your house and backyard, turning a modest fixer-upper into a luxury estate . You decide how to spend every hard-earned coin.

Find your inspiration

Working for others is your chance to get inspired. As you complete contracts, you’ll unlock new flower species and unique decorations . Once unlocked, you can purchase them for your own garden. Create a space that serves as your ultimate calling card and proof of your mastery.

Level up your skills

Gain experience and earn access to specialized courses . Every completed training provides a powerful upgrade for your character, allowing you to work faster and more efficiently. Transform from a hobbyist into an undisputed expert !

games.name: MoeArmy vs SuArmy
games.shortDescription: MoeArmy vs SuArmy is a 2D auto-battle strategy game. Choose the Moe or Su faction, build structures to deploy formations, combine cards, gear, and commander skills to power up your troops, exploit armor counters in automatic combat, and destroy the enemy base to claim victory!
games.aboutText:
Current Game Issues, Prioritized

- Workshop and cloud saves not supported. (Need to investigate whether they can be enabled)

- Very rare stuttering and error reports on Intel processors. (Reported to Godot Engine forums)

Major Game Issues Already Resolved, Prioritized

- Campaign difficulty is now balanced! Feel free to enjoy! (The most strongly voiced player feedback)

- Tutorial and introductory levels completely redone; features and info are unlocked progressively level by level. (Second most common player feedback)

- Brand-new encyclopedia, pause now freezes time, and button tooltip guides added.

- Achievement system supported.

Post‑release updates: 20 times.

If you have any questions, leave a message in the Steam discussion boards—I'm basically always around!

The War Has Begun!

Moe Army and Su Army—two adorable yet fierce factions with wildly different styles—are officially at war! Smoke fills the battlefield as massive armies pour from their bases, clashing fiercely in the corridors. Dense barrages and spectacular skill effects light up the field—every building you construct and every unit you produce feeds into this grand-scale battle.

Build, Deploy, Auto-Battle

The core loop is simple: drag building cards from your hand onto the construction grid, and buildings automatically produce units for battle. Stack identical buildings to upgrade their star level—the higher the star, the stronger the units. From 1-star basic troops to 3-star elite forces, the power gap is enormous. Plan your layout wisely: focus on upgrading or spread your production? Every build decision shapes your army.

Two Factions, Two Playstyles

Moe Army excels with high-tech gear and elite units, while Su Army dominates with mechanized brute force. From light skirmishers to heavy fortresses, from ground assaults to aerial support, each faction has exclusive units and building cards. Choosing the right faction and composing the best unit combination is your first step toward victory.

The Trump Card

More Content Coming Soon

Configure combined arms assaults: frontline tanks absorb damage, backline DPS mops up, support units provide buffs—multiple unit types advancing together to tear through enemy defenses. We're continuously adding new content, including new Commanders, units, stages, and more surprises. Join us and be part of Moe Army vs Su Army's evolution!

games.name: Ah. Ah. Ah.
games.shortDescription: A wholesome voice-input action game that can be cleared in about 15 minutes.
games.aboutText:
■ A New Sensation of Voice Action: Merging Mic and Rhythm

This title is a rhythm action game where you clear stages using "your voice" instead of a controller.

*A microphone is required to play.

Intuitive Gameplay: Simply vocalize into the microphone in sync with the rhythm on the screen to control your character.

■ Can be cleared quickly

Since the game can be cleared in about 15 minutes, you won't have to strain your throat.

games.name: Arc of Icarus
games.shortDescription: Build and lead your colony on a lost ringworld, where deadly conditions await on both sides while the world keeps turning! Progress through technological evolution, survive cultural revolution, and govern with a wise and steady hand!
games.aboutText:
Build and lead your colony on a lost ringworld, where deadly conditions await on both sides while the world keeps turning! Progress through technological evolution, survive cultural revolution, and govern with a wise and steady hand!

BUILD & GROW

Extract, gather and process resources from the world surface to build and feed your civilization. Balance exploring new materials and buildings with sustaining what you already have. What will you build, and what will you leave behind?

SURVIVE & ADAPT

Migrate your people out of hazardous conditions and towards their next home. One side of the ring is close to the sun and too hot, while the other side is dark and freezing. Stay in the habitable zone, or adapt to the extremes!

EVOLVE & PROGRESS

Employ scholars to study the world and advance technology. Unlock new buildings or upgrade existing ones, reveal new resources or transform the ones you have. Can you fix the ring? Will you escape? Will you adapt? Or will you perhaps forage berries forever?

BEWARE OF THE REVOLUTION

As the population grows, and technology with it, ideas are born. Ideas become culture, and culture becomes the soul of the people. Will you embrace the ebb and flow of the public, or resist? Few leaders last long, none last forever.

games.name: Crownhold
games.shortDescription: Noble Rulers — grow your realm and expand your castle in this short incremental game! Manage resources, discover foreign lands and build up an army to lay siege to your enemies.
games.aboutText:
Build up your Castle

Crownhold is a beautiful incremental game that doesn't overstay its welcome. Start with a small castle and expand your realm.

Lay Siege to your enemies

Conquer your foes and grow the kingdom beyond its borders.

Discover Foreign Lands

Find trading partners, friends… and enemies. Prosperity attracts all kinds of company.

Grow your Realm

Lead your kingdom and forge the most powerful empire the world has ever known!

Prestige System

Start over stronger. Unlock a powerful meta-progression system and carry bonuses into your next run.

games.name: Animaly Bar: NO HUMANITY!
games.shortDescription: Run your bar as a gorilla and hunt down the humans in animal costumes hiding among your customers. Observe them closely, spot the clues that give their disguises away, test their slogans, and blow the imposters away with your shotgun. Choose your targets wisely... or become the hunted.
games.aboutText:
WELCOME TO ANIMALY BAR!

After animals won the war against humans, the world is now under their control. As a gorilla bartender at Animaly Bar, prepare drinks, carefully observe customers, and analyze their behavior. Because some of them may be humans in disguise.

Identify the suspects, wait for the right moment, and eliminate them. But be careful… choosing the wrong target or letting too many humans slip away can lead to serious consequences.

Defend your bar against nightly invasions, maintain order, and survive. In Animaly Bar, no one is as they seem.

Identify. Decide. Eliminate.

Carefully examine incoming customers. Some may be humans in disguise. If you suspect one, shoot… but don’t make a mistake.

Run the Bar

Collect stools, clean the floors, take out the trash, and restock drinks. Manage all the daily tasks of a real bar yourself.

Prepare Orders

Follow the given recipes to prepare drinks and serve orders completely and accurately.

Defend Your Bar

On some nights, humans wearing animal costumes attack your bar. Stop anyone who gets inside and don’t let anything be taken.

Fear-Filled Moments

Face the creature that haunts the bar!

FEATURES

- Identify Suspects
Carefully analyze humans hiding among animals and make the right decisions.

- Run Your Bar
Control all daily tasks from cleaning to inventory management.

- Follow Recipes
Prepare drinks using the correct recipes to fulfill orders.

- Defend Against Invasions
Some nights your bar is attacked. Stop intruders and protect your supplies.

- Your Choices Have Consequences
Wrong decisions can lead to financial loss and chaos.

- Playtime

Approximately 1.5–2 Hours of Gameplay

games.name: SAMURAI BRINGER - RAMPAGE -
games.shortDescription: SAMURAI BRINGER - RAMPAGE - is a deck-building auto battler where you strategically form your squad by arranging samurai units and combining weapons and abilities to suit your tactics. Build your own unique formation and unite the land under your rule!
games.aboutText:
Build your own unique formation and unite the land under your rule!

Form Your Army and Unite the Land

Match weapon types and abilities to trigger synergies that enhance your formation.

Adopt different strategies to add traits to your formation, focus on rushing the enemy early, or build up your strength over time.

Survey the enemy's formation and strategy, then rearrange your own forces to conquer the land!

Flashy Auto Battle Fights

Battles are fought automatically against formations created by players from around the world and saved on the server.

Enjoy chaotic battles with over-the-top, flashy attacks!

Abundant Content

-Hado (Supremacy): Fight against formations made by players worldwide, raise your military merits, and surpass the gods of war.

-Gido (Simulation): Relaxing mock battles. Find the key to victory that works for you.

-Armor Customization: Use the military merits you've earned to customize the appearance of your samurai general.

Equipped weapons and armor will can change the general's attributes.

Choose Your General

Each General offers different starting samurai and strategies.

Pick your favorite historical general, choose one whose strategy fits the formation you want to build, or even start from your preferred region.

You are in command!

games.name: Our Bad Ending
games.shortDescription: A ritual. A festering, unrequited love. Sink into a humid and visceral Southeast Asian horror about the pursuit of a doomed lesbian love. Is a bad ending better than no ending at all?
games.aboutText:
Syira and Huimin once made a wish to a banana tree spirit. It was a silly, childish ritual they had found on a blog. They wished to stay best friends forever. Except that Syira wished…

“I wished she would be mine.”

Years later, it turns out whatever demon or spirit they had spoken to doesn’t grant wishes. Huimin has been seeing a boyfriend for five years and they’ve even booked out a chalet to celebrate their anniversary. Syira’s wish might as well be a joke.

Until a frantic phone call arrives in the middle of the night — a lover’s quarrel had turned violent. Huimin begs Syira for help and slowly, a dark and malicious desire begins to take root in her head.

Maybe the spirit does listen after all.

Game features:

- 2 Bad endings to explore your darkest desires

- 3 full CGs and 15 partial CGs

- About 15-20 minutes of gameplay with 7k words

Note: Syira pronounced as "Shi-rah" or "Si-rah"(Arabic/Malay name) and Huimin pronounced as "Hwee-min" (Chinese name). FYI This is based on how I know them pronounced in Singapore, so it may vary for other regions!

Italian translation by Marianna Ricciardi, accesible through 'Preferences' menu.

games.name: The Concrete Sutra #1
games.shortDescription: A post-apocalyptic world. Two friends haven't seen each other for 5 years are heading back home on a bike. The first episode of an epic action jrpg by yeo.

games.name: Fallgrade
games.shortDescription: Bend gravity. Twist architecture. Survive the impossible. A first-person exploration game set in an analog concrete nightmare, where reality shifts around you and Karl waits for your next mistake.
games.aboutText:
Turn the world around you and use gravity to reach your goal. Run through concrete structures where there is no up or down. Collect strange orbs. Experience the contrast between the city and nature. Avoid the monstrous spider Karl, who is watching to make sure your desire for freedom turns into a free fall.

• rotate the buildings in the city
• move the sun in the forest
• avoid Karl

A first-person exploration game built around redefined physics…

…watch out!

games.name: Ikemen Big Bang: A Dating Game About Potentially Hot Guys
games.shortDescription: “That customer today might turn hot! Maybe you should trust your gut and try dating him!” Encouraged by your pet chinchilla, you start a trial relationship on a hunch! Will he actually turn hot… or not!? A romantic comedy Otome game. Fully voiced (except for the protagonist).
games.aboutText:
Over 10,000 downloads in its first week! Following the success of Can I Not Fall for Idols?(Aidame) , creator duo MIKIMAKI presents their second otome game!

This game’s biggest feature is a unique system that lets you choose whether to make the characters hot… or leave them exactly the way they are.

You can experience each ending with the character design you like best.

The illustrated CGs, full voice acting, and comedy elements loved in the previous game are back and better than ever, now with even more story content and event scenes to enjoy!

You are a 20-year-old girl helping out at the cafe run by your parents.

But on your birthday, something unbelievable happens.

Your pet chinchilla suddenly starts talking.

“The customer who came in today is going to turn hot. Why not trust your gut and start dating him?”

And just like that, you begin a “trial relationship” with a guy you just met that very same day…

Will he actually turn hot? Or…!?

Sasuke Hirokawa

“W-Wow… This really feels like we’re actually dating…”

A kind-hearted college student and incredibly talented artist who often comes to the cafe to work on his illustrations.

Under the online name “Fatigue Fracture,” he creates artwork for the virtual singer fandom community.

Kagetora Inokuma

“I just want to wear the clothes I make. That’s all. There’s no deeper meaning.”

A fashionable gyaru guy attending a design school near the cafe.

He enjoys wearing the clothes he makes himself and identifies as male.

Retsu Anzai

“If only I were ten… or at least five years older…”

A younger boy who visits the cafe to research sweets and desserts in hopes of becoming a pastry chef.

Called "Re-kun"
Note: Features social interaction routes only (no romance paths).

Chintaro

“I’ll always be watching over you…”

Your pet chinchilla and the cafe’s adorable mascot.

On your 20th birthday, he suddenly starts talking and begins giving you dating advice.

Yuni Nanahashi (Name can be changed)

The protagonist ? you.

A 20-year-old girl helping out at the cafe run by her parents.

While working at the dreamy, fairy tale-like cafe, she can’t help feeling disconnected from the ordinary life she lives.

■ Streaming & Video Guidelines

Anyone, individuals or companies, is free to stream or post videos of Ikemen Big Bang.

Monetized channels are fine too, and there's no need to ask or let us know beforehand.

[What you can stream]

- Free versions (demo): Everything

- Steam full version: "1st Bigbang" and "Extra" only

The "2nd Bigbang" story, which is only in the full version, may not be streamed or shown in videos.

Logos and background art for stream thumbnails are available on our official website. Feel free to use them.

(Revised November 2026)

🎮 Genre

Rom-com ADV / Visual Novel

📦 Content

Play Time: 2.5 hours

Number of Endings: 11

Fully voiced (full voice acting for all characters except the protagonist)

Steam Achievements Supported

Save / Load / Auto-play / Backlog / Skip functions included

💻 System Requirements

Platform: Windows

Controls: Mouse / Keyboard

Supported Language: Japanese (Voice / Subtitles / UI)

　　　　　English, Simplified Chinese, Korean (Subtitles / UI)

👩‍💻 About Development

This game is a completely original title created by Mikimaki.

games.name: Cozy Liora
games.shortDescription: Open your journal, pour your coffee, your little cat is already there. While Lo-Fi sounds drift into your room, your plants grow, your moments gather into a small world of their own. Here, time flows slowly, every line belongs to you. Did you forget that peace could be this simple? 🌿🐱
games.aboutText:
How was your day? Tell me about it...

Sometimes all you need is a notebook, a pen, and a cat purring beside you. While Lo-Fi sounds fill your room, you can pour out your thoughts, watch your plants grow, and settle into a little corner that's entirely your own.

That's exactly what this is.

Write Your Journal, Keep Your Moments Every new page every day. It doesn't matter what you write — were you happy today, tired, what was on your mind? Words gather into a small diary of memories that belongs only to you. Writing sometimes feels better than you'd expect.

🐱 Your Cat is Always There You can stop writing and give them some love. They understand you anyway.

🌿 Grow Your Plants, Bring Your Room to Life A tiny seed, a little care, a little time. Every corner is your choice, your story.

🏆 A Totem Every Day Every day you play, you earn a totem that's yours. A small reward, a small memory. Watching your days pile up into something visible... strange but beautiful.

✉️ Anonymous Letters — Reach Someone, Hear from Someone Sometimes you want to say something but don't know who to say it to. Write your letter, release it into the world. Someone, somewhere will read it. Maybe you'll find someone else's letter too. A stranger might have written exactly what you needed in that moment.

🎮 Mini Games from Your Room's Computer Time for a little break! Sit at the computer in your room and enjoy the mini games. A small surprise within your daily routine.

📚 Fill Your Bookshelf The things you do, the moments you live through earn you books. As your library grows, so does your story. Look at your shelf — see how far you've come.

📻 Choose Your Music from the Radio Set the atmosphere you want from the radio. The right sound, the right moment — writing becomes so much easier.

🛋️ A Room That's Entirely Yours This is your space, your peace.

While everything outside moves fast, time slows down here. A cup of tea, sweet music, a purring cat, and you. Ready to write? 🌙

games.name: Ship or Burn! Coop express
games.shortDescription: Someone’s order burned? At least the train made it! Explore a dangerous open world, deliver cargo, and protect it from zombies. Out of fuel? Toss someone’s parcel, a zombie, or your annoying friend into the firebox! Online co-op for 1 to 4 players.
games.aboutText:
The train runs as long as something's burning. Toss everything into the furnace.

You and your friends are couriers on a locomotive that only runs while something's burning in the firebox. Coal. Parcels. Zombies. Someone's wedding cake. Decide fast — the station won't wait.

Delivery, chaos and greed for 1–4 players

At every station you pick and deliver parcels: expensive, fragile, too heavy to carry alone, suspiciously wriggling. Load the cars, plot your route. The train devours fuel, zombies claw at your cargo, and the next station is still far away. You decide what matters more: delivering the order intact, or chucking it into the furnace to reach the next stop and cash in on something pricier.

Special Delivery: Chaos

Zombies want your cargo? Make them work for it. Shoot, kick and throw anything you can grab to keep them off your train. Your friends are throwable too, so try to agree on who’s fighting and who’s flying. And if a zombie gets too close, there’s always room in the furnace.

What will end up in your furnace?

Grab your friends. Grab the train. Grab more parcels than you can carry. Let's see how much you deliver, and how much burns along the way.

Add to wishlist so you don't miss the demo launch!

games.name: SHRIMP GAME: KRILL CONFIRMED
games.shortDescription: SHRIMP GAME: KRILL CONFIRMED is a solo or multiplayer third-person shooter RPG intro to SHRIMP GAME set in an abyssal realm. Pilot your SHRIMP platform to fight giant sea monsters, master elemental classes, and unearth secrets in a co-op campaign, or just krill your friends in multiplayer PVP!
games.aboutText:
SHRIMP GAME: KRILL CONFIRMED is an atmospheric third-person looter shooter RPG set in a decaying underwater world replete with horrific sea creatures and Lovecraftian Bosses . Experience the introduction to SHRIMP GAME by fighting through 2 deadly dungeons and their massive bosses.
Pilot your Submersible Hydrodynamic Research Integrated Marine Platform (SHRIMP), master the six elemental classes with powerful fusion abilities , and unlock specialized SHRIMP Platforms each with their own unique strengths and personalities.
Explore the sunken ruins solo or in 6-player co-op, or KRILL your friends in chaotic PvP modes like Shrimp Royale, Shrimp Tag, and Boss Mode!

- Battle massive bosses of the deep from volcano-bound hermit crabs to kaiju-sized electric eels

- Face swarms of aquatic fauna like murderous betta fish, dangerous dust crabs, and hostile sea sponges

- Fight and SHRIMP together across the entire campaign in multiplayer co-op up to 6 pilots

- Krill your friends in PVP with games such Royale, Tag, and Boss Mode

- Choose from 6 base elemental powers with the potential to create 2 dozen different element fusions like Magma, Smog, Moon, Demon, and Bone to complement your build

- Pick from 11 different Submersible Hydrodynamic Research Integrated Marine Platforms (SHRIMP) each with their own different strengths and play styles

- Customize your build with over 2 dozen weapons from heavy cannon shots, shotgun blasts, or machine-gun projectiles with added stat upgrades and rarities

- Explore and perhaps restore an underwater realm on the brink of destruction

- Discover ancient ruins, complete puzzles hiding treasures, and traverse cryptic domains

- Meet and help a variety of eccentric and interesting characters each with their own motivations

- Travel the depths with a watery Drum N' Bass inspired soundtrack with over a dozen songs

games.name: 天藻のモズクヒメ
games.shortDescription: In 20xx Japan, 200+ vacant mosques became mozuku farms! Play as Mozuku Hime, breed super strains with genetic algorithms, and turn every mosque into a glowing seaweed paradise!
games.aboutText:
20xx, Japan.After a certain event, more than 200 white square facilities across the country suddenly became unused.
The government, not wanting to waste them, tried every possible reuse idea… and finally settled on the ultimate dad joke:“Mozuku farming inside mosques.”

You are Mozuku Hime, the adorable guardian spirit of mozuku seaweed.
Your mission is to turn every former mosque in Japan into a thriving mozuku cultivation center.

Game Features

- Deep farming simulation with real genetic algorithms (inspired by AstoroNoka) — crossbreed strains, mutate them, and create powerful “local specialty” mozuku.

- Fast-paced 2D side-scrolling action — fight “Mosukuzu Monsters” using a glowing mozuku scythe.

- Explore and conquer all 47 prefectures, collecting rare local mozuku strains.

- Transform prayer halls into pools, minarets into light towers, and domes into massive greenhouses.

From “Mosukuso” to “Mosukumaji.”
Grow fast, grow strong… and turn Japan into a peaceful, mozuku-filled paradise.

※ This is a completely fictional, over-the-top Japanese comedy game.
No religious or political intent whatsoever. We just really want to grow mozuku peacefully and make everyone laugh.

games.name: Just Keep Fishing
games.shortDescription: A short incremental game about catching a lot of fish🎣
games.aboutText:
A short incremental game about catching a lot of fish🎣

Keep Fishing & Earn Silly Amounts

Just Keep Fishing

Buy Upgrades

games.name: Going my way?
games.shortDescription: You're a train conductor in a world that doesn't sleep anymore. People are losing their minds, and Wanderers hide among them. Your job sounds simple: get the train to the City, watch the passengers, and never forget that the train demands sacrifices.
games.aboutText:
You're new here, so remember these rules. Do as I say if you value your life.

LISTEN AND REMEMBER

Channel your inner detective. Use your brain if you've got one. Talk to people, pay attention to the small details, and never trust first impressions.

HUNT FOR WANDERERS

They look like ordinary passengers and say all the right things, but they always slip up. Identify them before they choose their next victim.

FEED THE TRAIN

The train runs on a very special kind of fuel. Wanderer or ordinary human, it doesn't care. It'll gladly devour either one.

MAINTAIN ORDER IN THE CAR

Seat passengers where they belong and serve the right tea. The right additive can loosen tongues, lower defenses, or protect against Wanderers. Choose wisely.

DON'T TEST MY PATIENCE

Follow my directives, don't ask unnecessary questions, and if you're lucky, you'll make it to the City.

N.N.

games.name: 500 FINGER FILLET
games.shortDescription: 500 STABS. 20 MINUTES TO ESCAPE. A horror roguelite about stabbing yourself in the hand 500 times to escape a deadly trap. Can you make it out with all your fingers? Or will you bleed out on the table?
games.aboutText:
TRAPPED IN A DEADLY MACHINE

500 FINGER FILLET is a horror roguelite about being handcuffed to a hand-stabbing machine that won't unlock itself until you've stabbed your hand 500 times. With 20 minutes on the clock, what lengths are you willing to go to to escape? Will you make it out with all your fingers, or will you bleed out on the table?

CHOOSE YOUR OWN STABBING IMPLEMENT

Your captor is not without mercy. Every so often, you get to choose what the machine stabs you with next, from the dull Rusty Fork to the all-seeing Ritual Knife. You'll earn pitiful amounts of money through stabbing your hand, which you can spend on items and rings to improve your chances.

ESCAPE AT ALL COSTS

You'll lose fingers. You'll black out from pain. You'll bleed and bleed and bleed until there's nothing left in you. Every stab carries a risk. Every stab brings you closer to salvation. You must beat the clock against all odds.

All that stands between you and freedom is 500 stabs. Do you have what it takes?

500 FINGER FILLET was made without the use of any generative AI tools.

games.name: National Transit
games.shortDescription: A sandbox strategy game. Build your nation's transport network, grow your economy, develop your cities, and raise your people's prosperity. Every map is procedurally generated and unique.
games.aboutText:
National Transit puts you in charge of a nation's entire transport infrastructure — from the first dirt road connecting two villages, to a rail network spanning your country, to international airports that transform your greatest cities.

Your goal is simple: build connections, grow your economy, raise your people's prosperity. The rest is up to you. It all starts with a freshly generated world — one nobody has ever seen before, and nobody ever will again.

Roll a New World
Set the dials — how mountainous, how wet, how scattered the coast — then let the world surprise you. You choose the broad strokes; the map decides the rest. Where the rivers run, where the natural harbors hide, which valley is begging for its first railway — none of it is revealed until the moment the world unfolds in front of you. Every new map is a fresh hand of cards: sometimes a mountain-locked inland nation, sometimes a long open coastline strewn with islands. Scout it like an explorer, find the place where your story begins — or roll again and see what the next world deals you.

Connect Your Cities
Place roads, railways (standard and high-speed), waterways, and air routes between cities of all sizes — from remote hamlets to bustling capitals. Terrain pushes back: rivers carve natural corridors, wide waters demand bridges or tunnels, and mountains make you choose between the long way around and the expensive way through. Every connection you build generates trade, moves people, and grows your economy.

Watch Your Economy Evolve
Transport infrastructure drives everything — trade, migration, and the growth of every city on the map. Enact city policies — special economic zones, free ports, university towns, stock exchanges — to steer each city's rise. Read it all in full financial statements, from monthly income to your nation's balance sheet.

Step Into Your Cities
Every city on the national map can be entered and shaped up close. Draw the streets yourself, lay out metro, light rail, tram, and bus lines, and watch districts fill in with buildings and the businesses that move in.
As your cities mature, logistics firms, financial institutions, and industrial conglomerates take root — and if you build well enough, world-class corporations and international organizations establish themselves in your largest metropolises and your capital. Then put your city to the test: pick any two doorsteps and navigate between them — on foot, by car, or riding the very transit lines you built, transfers and all. Watching a journey thread through your own metro map is the moment your city stops being a drawing and starts being a place.

Your Nation, Your Identity
Name your country. Choose its capital, its flag, its domain suffix. Draw and redraw your internal provinces as your nation grows. Every nation you build is uniquely yours — from its geography to its economy to the companies that bear your chosen name.

Key Features

- Roll a world nobody has ever seen — you set the dials, the map deals the hand

- Realistic terrain, rivers, and coastlines shape every strategic decision — bridges, tunnels, and river-valley corridors included

- Two map layers, eight transport modes:

- Macro map: road, rail (standard and high-speed), waterway, and aviation

- City map: road, rail, rail transit (including metro), bus

- Organic economic growth driven entirely by your infrastructure decisions

- Auto-generated companies and institutions — from local logistics firms to global corporations

- City Map: enter any city, design its streets and transit lines, then navigate them — walk, drive, or ride your own metro

- City policies across four development eras — from special economic zones to stock exchanges

- Nation customization: name, flag, capital, domain suffix, and editable province borders

- Full national accounts: income statements, balance sheets, annual reports, and loans

- A living history: revisit any month of your nation's past, or branch a new timeline from it

- Sandbox gameplay with no fail state — national milestones mark your progress and unlock lasting rewards, but nothing is ever forced

games.name: Joy Malignant
games.shortDescription: A surreal dice-based RPG in a cursed city of gut-wrenching suffering. Here, your choices shape your skills and your appearance. Survive the city's hellish trials, meet tortured characters, and develop your own unique identity. Every choice matters as your actions will literally shape you.
games.aboutText:
Joy Malignant is a short, surreal dice-based RPG where your past is a tool. In a cursed city filled with suffering, your past shapes your skills and your appearance. Survive the city's hellish trials, meet tortured characters, and develop your own unique indentity. Every choice matters as your actions will literally shape you.

Everyone wears their past on their sleeve. Except you.

In Visceria, your appearance is shaped by your past. As a faceless, your past has been erased. Through surviving in this hellish city, you will meet characters and make choices that will shape you, developing your personality, appearance, and abilities.

Dice Based Dread

Manage your resources, use dice to perform actions, and play to your personality's strengths to survive in the city. Do what you must to survive, and try not to lose yourself in the process.

Mosaics of Suffering

Everyone's appearance is shaped by their past. Meet tortured characters and analyze their history by seeing their Mosaic, then use it to your advantage.

Your Choices Shape You

Your mosaic starts out empty, then is shaped by your experiences. As you make choices, you will gain more parts of yourself. This will afffect your stats and abilities, as well as your appearance. Be careful, you can't change the past after its happened!

A Museum Of Agony

Life in Visceria is twisted and painful, especially for a faceless like you. Try to hold onto your sanity while frequenting dirty ruins, slaughterhouses, decrepit bars, bloody hospitals, and more.

games.name: Islecraft: Island Architect
games.shortDescription: Sail to uncharted isles and build settlements as an island architect in this minimalist city builder. Inspired by ISLANDERS.
games.aboutText:
Discover a chain of uncharted islands and shape them into thriving settlements. In Islecraft: Island Architect , you place buildings on procedurally generated maps, carefully considering positioning to maximize score and unlock new structures.

Each island presents a new layout, new constraints, and new opportunities. Thoughtful placement rewards efficiency, while experimentation leads to unique and unexpected designs. As your score grows, so does your toolkit—offering more ways to build, optimize, and express your architectural style.

When an island is complete, set sail for the next. Larger lands, fresh challenges, and new possibilities await.

Designed for a calm, focused experience, Islecraft emphasizes simple rules, meaningful decisions, and satisfying progression.

Features

- 25+ buildings in

- 8 packs

- infinite isles!

More buildings, packs and isle features being developed.

games.name: Don't Stop The Pop!
games.shortDescription: Ready to turn a single kernel into an unstoppable popcorn machine? Build your strategy with a massive Skill Tree; discover dozens of flavors from salty to chocolatey, spicy to salted caramel, and fill the screen with pops! Earn more, pop more! Don't Stop the Pop! 🍿
games.aboutText:
WHAT IS THIS GAME?

"Don’t Stop The Pop!" is a super satisfying incremental game where you can relax by popping popcorn—and won't be able to put down thanks to its time-based mechanics. Keep evolving and growing stronger with a deep skill tree. Sweep your cursor across the screen to pop popcorn, earning in-game cash with every single pop. Unlock delicious new popcorn flavors and expand your kitchen like never before!

UPGRADES

A free-form skill tree that lets you progress in whichever direction you choose. Evolve, grow, and keep popping with over 40 unique upgrades. Boost your damage, extend your time, multiply your earnings, and spawn more popcorn. Instead of popping 1 or 2 popcorns per hit, blast dozens of them all at once! And don't forget to unlock brand-new types of popcorn along the way.

SALTED, CHOCOLATE, SPICY... WHAT ARE YOU IN THE MOOD FOR?

Salted, chocolate, spicy, matcha, or blueberry popcorn... Buy them with your earnings, add them to your pan, and start popping!

SCRATCH, WIN, AND GO WILD!

Collect tickets as you play. Use your tickets in the Shop to buy any scratch card you want and start scratching. If luck is on your side, you might pull a Rare card or win a massive pile of cash. Even if you just win your ticket back, don't worry—give it another shot. You never know when luck will strike!

WHAT ELSE?

Curious about what else is in store? XP progression and awesome rewards, special card collecting, rare achievements... Now it’s time to pop some popcorn!

games.name: MindCleaver
games.shortDescription: Manipulate the minds of fully simulated NPCs as you and a rival sorcerer twist emotion, factions, and armies in a dark, emergent fantasy world.
games.aboutText:
Unleashed from your phylactery, burrow hexes deep into the minds of fully simulated NPCs. Watch their thoughts, factions, and armies twist in response as you and your nemesis duel for magical influence over an emergent fantasy world.

Everyone, from the lowliest peasant to the wealthiest king, runs on a real-time engine of behavior, memory, personality and dynamic societal structures. Quests are created , because factions know of your power and want to wield a fraction of it. Wars, hierarchies and plots form with or without your influence.

In this dark, emergent fantasy world, the gears of their minds keep turning until death…or domination.

- Your nemesis twists and manipulates the world against you. Their plans and grand designs, head-to-head against your own.

- Mortals, unlike the player, need to survive and structure societal hierarchies around it. Quests are created for accomplishing real goals, not for doing arbitrary chores.

- Factions are formed freshly from the unique leaders that rule them. Drive your influence with these groups, from waging wars, to igniting rebellion uprisings.

- No NPC is free from magical influence. Breach into their minds and enthrall friends and enemies alike.

A special thanks to my father, and the memory of the Mindguard book series he wrote.

games.name: Pitchfork Perfect
games.shortDescription: Jam to the tunes of Pitchfork Perfect - a Bullet Heaven Rogue-like Rhythm game. Press, tap and hold to the beat to cast spells and abilities to fight off swarms of heavenly forces led by oppressive bosses! Will you face the music? Or will you stay silent?
games.aboutText:
Pitchfork Perfect Is an experimental horde survival combining the fast paced action and build crafting of a bullet hell with the satisfying music and time presses of a traditional rhythm game.

Play as Luxx , a young archangel with a passion for music in a world where creativity is frowned upon. Use the power of song to manifest spells and abilitie s as you jam your way through Heaven on a grand tour for freedom!!

Dodge enemy attacks and projectiles while tapping along to the beat. Maintain your rhythm to cast spells and turn music into your greatest weapon.

Collect EXP from fallen enemies to upgrade your abilities . Choose upgrades that complement your playstyle and evolve your weapons as you progress.

Take on challenging boss battles that put your rhythm, positioning, and survival skills to the test. Dodge devastating attacks, and keep the beat as you battle new formidable foes.

Cast spells to build your CLIMAX meter. Fill it up to activate FEVER MODE and unleash a lightshow of your full musical power!

Experience a fun story with a colorful cast of characters, a unique art style, and a rockin' soundtrack that builds and evolves as you play.

✨ Wishlist on Steam and join our Discord to follow development, share your feedback, and be part of the journey.✨

Your song matters! So let yourself be heard!

games.name: Dog in the Machine
games.shortDescription: Train an AutoDog to escape a dystopian mecha-city in this tactical roguelite. Craft powerful modular attacks, plan every move with stress-free real-time previews, and unleash devastating chain reactions to outsmart hordes of killjoy robots!
games.aboutText:
Dog in the Machine is a tactical roguelite where you help an AutoDog escape a dystopian mecha-city and reunite with its exiled humans.
Battle through a series of encounters on compact grids filled with reactive elements, enemy guardians, and environmental hazards. Preview your actions, experiment with different strategies, and trigger the most satisfying chain reactions.
Between fights, meet quirky characters and craft a modular arsenal of attacks built around your favorite synergies.

Play as 8 different dog breeds across an infinite number of procedurally generated levels. Between runs, unlock permanent upgrades and features, and try to conquer every difficulty level!

💥 MASTER THE DOMINO EFFECT

Every battlefield is generated to be a chain-reaction playground . Domino effect collision systems, reactive enemies, conveyor belts, interactive buttons, explosive obstacles...

No boring fights : All these elements give players the opportunity to crack the perfect solution in each battle, destroying waves of enemies in a spectacular way.

🧠 DEEP TACTICS, ZERO FRUSTRATION

Thanks to a real-time preview system , you can see exactly how your instruction sequence will play out before committing. Smoothly try, cancel, retry , and build a solution without cognitive overload, experimenting freely until you find your favorite outcome.

If you lose, it will be due to a flaw in your strategy, not a careless mistake.

🦴 COMBINE YOUR TRICKS

After each battle, your AutoDog learns a new Trick . But more importantly, you will be able to train it to perform more complex Tricks , which you can create freely by combining two others .

You can follow blueprints or invent your own combinations . So by the end of the run, you will have created your own unique playstyle, based on powerful synergies .

👺 EXPAND YOUR ARSENAL

Between fights, meet a cast of quirky characters who reveal the story of the city-machine, each offering their own deck-building choices.
Buy, exchange, loot, upgrade, steal… every encounter is a new opportunity to expand your Trick Library and shape a build that's entirely your own.

games.name: Crack the Pack
games.shortDescription: Open booster packs, buy upgrades, and collect over 1001 cards and their variants. Build a true automated booster factory by endlessly multiplying production until you unlock cloning and nuclear fusion !
games.aboutText:
Crack the Pack is an incremental game all about opening card packs. Discover cards, sell your duplicates, and invest in a powerful upgrade tree.

Open your boosters !

Unlock up to 8 different types of boosters. From packs that improve with every use, to mega-packs containing dozens of cards, or even packs with a 50/50 chance of screwing you over, you’ll never run out of surprises !

Collect them all !

Every card comes in 7 increasingly rare and valuable variants , each with almost magical powers ! That’s a total of 1,001 collectible cards to discover.

Grow in power !

Over 60 upgrades will let you open packs on a massive scale, sell your cards for top dollar, and unlock new features such as employees, card battles, the Fusion Lab, the Museum, and more...

Can you collect all 1,001 cards ?

games.name: Plink Lab
games.shortDescription: A satisfying active plinko incremental where you drop and bounce fantastic creatures (tiny humans for starters) to clear pegs and earn a trillion $! Wacky balls, massive tech tree, total physics-based chaos, and a very chatty goblin shop owner.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Plink Lab! Play as Dr. Plink and drop kidnapped humans, griffins, cyclopes, along with many other wacky mythical creatures into the special plinko machine where they'll get smashed in cauldrons so you can earn loads of money. Clear enough pegs before time runs out to take on your next challenge.

Spend your hard-earned money wisely in Lou's shop, and unlock upgrades that create wild synergies. From splitter balls and chain lightning to poison and explosions, every new upgrade can push your plinko boards to the next level.

Explore 100+ Tech Tree nodes, discover powerful combos, and grab temporary pick-ups that can completely change the course of a run.

Featuring 20 challenging stages, 14 unique balls, 5 peg types with 3 modifiers, 5 multiplier buckets, and 8 powerful pick-ups, you are bound to experience a wild ride.

Get ready to send 1,000+ balls flying at once, bouncing through boards packed with 100+ pegs in a spectacular frenzy of bouncing, splitting, exploding madness, and walk away filthy rich.

games.name: Barnacle
games.shortDescription: Investigate an abandoned server frozen in time. Explore liminal, blocky spaces, uncover strange anomalies, and piece together what went wrong. The deeper you go, the more the world shifts, watching and reacting to your presence.
games.aboutText:
Investigate an abandoned multiplayer server frozen in time, where something clearly went wrong. What once felt familiar now feels empty, distorted, and watching.

This atmospheric walking simulator focuses on exploration, tension, and discovery. There are no hand-holding objectives. Instead, you are left to navigate liminal, blocky environments inspired by early multiplayer worlds, slowly uncovering what happened here.

Search for hidden items, uncover secrets, and piece together the story through environmental storytelling and scattered notes left behind. Every area holds fragments of the past, but not everything wants to be found.

As you explore deeper, the world begins to shift. Spaces loop, change, and react to your presence. You are not alone. Dangerous entities roam the server, and avoiding them may be the only way to survive.

Featuring a completely hand-crafted soundtrack by composer Nate Sassoon, with unique music created for every zone to capture the atmosphere, emotion, and identity of each area as you descend further into the server’s mystery.

What happened to this place—and why does it feel like it’s still alive?

games.name: Skymote
games.shortDescription: A tower defence deckbuilder with roguelike elements. Build a deck, raise towers, cast spells, and discover unexpected synergies to turn your floating island into a fortress the sky can't break.
games.aboutText:
The Great City of artisans and engineers is gone. All that remains is a mote: one fragment of a fallen civilisation, drifting through a hostile sky, and its own machines are coming to finish the job. Rebuild it, defend it, and take back the sky.

Skymote is a real-time tower defence deckbuilder. Play cards to build and upgrade towers, cast spells, and hold off waves of rogue automatons marching toward your core. Energy and new cards come to you on a timer, so you're always making fast choices under pressure.

- Play cards to raise towers, buff them with power-ups, and play tacticals mid-wave.

- Earn new cards and upgrade old ones as you go, reshaping your deck to counter the enemies.

- Find synergies between cards that stack into something far stronger than their parts.

- Build powerful monolith buildings that change the course of the whole run

- Reclaim lost fragments to expand your island and open up new ground to build on.

- Trade with wandering merchants for rare cards and black-market deals.

- Upgrade your cards to make them stronger, sometimes with unpredictable side effects.

Every run adds to the next. Hit milestones to permanently unlock new cards into your pool, giving future runs stronger options and bolder strategies. Lose a run, come back better equipped, push further.

The city fell once. Whether it stays broken is up to you and the deck you build to defend it.

games.name: How to Grow Your Sausage
games.shortDescription: Every [key]stroke makes your sausage bigger. Let it sit in the corner of your screen and watch it grow while you use your PC. Feed it different meats, upgrade your butcher, and see the magic happen. Have you ever dreamed of growing your sausage? Now it’s finally possible!
games.aboutText:
How to Grow Your Sausage is a desktop game where a sentient sausage takes control of a butcher’s mind to feed itself. With every key stroke, clicks and buttons pressed, your sausage is fed and grows, unlocking permanent upgrades, items and outfits!

Upgrades

Use your money to buy upgrades and improve your meat grinding process! Every upgrade will make your sausage growing activity more efficient.

Items

Purchase and equip different types of meats, grinders and cleavers to make your sausage grow even faster!

Unlockables

Every time your sausage grows, it will unlock bonuses, items or even new features.

Prestige

Reset part of your progress to obtain permanent multipliers and gain points to purchase exclusive items and upgrades.

Time Travel

A second layer of prestige that will insanely boost your sausage gains and help it reach its ultimate goal.

Costumes

Equip different types of hats, counters and skins.

games.name: RUNNING TRAIN | 走ル列車！
games.shortDescription: New realistic 3DCG Train Game is here! Step into the crew's cabin and immerse yourself as train operator. Navigate 40km+ across Japanese Rural Railway with breathtakingly detailed scenery through the seaside and heart of countryside.
games.aboutText:
HOP ON OPERATOR'S CABIN!

Start your journey along Coastal Hayamori Railway and Rural Kofuku Railway . both routes have distinct operational pattern and characteristic. Make sure that your passengers get from station to station safely!

EASY TO LEARN / HARD TO MASTER!

Love the challenge? turn on HARD-MODE, or NO-UI, or even NO-SPEEDOMETER mode for extra score!

FREE MODE!

Tired of driving and got punishing too much in scoring mode? Set back and relax, let AI driver drive the train and you can enjoy breathtaking environment along coastal and rural Japanese as both passenger and trainspotter.

GET CREATIVE!

Your vision, your train. Customize your liveries with open textures and bring your designs to life!

ELEVATE YOUR IMMERSION WITH CONTROLLER SUPPORT!

COMPLETE FEATURE LISTS:

- 4 Train type with different characteristic

- 2 Fictional Railway operator spanning 40km of meticulously handcrafted fully detailed route

- Railway Safety system such as Vigilance and Automatic Train Stop implemented

- Semi-realistic physics, arcade control and train motion

- Features over 40 diagrams both local and express train spanning early morning, afternoon, and nighttime operation.

- 2 seasons available: Sakura Spring and Snowy Winter

- Selectable weather and environment settings

- Master controller support

- Auto-drive mode, let you enjoy route scenery as passenger or trainspotter

- Open livery editor

- Photo mode

games.name: Mayhem À La Carte
games.shortDescription: Cook, fight, and serve under pressure in this chaotic 4-player co-op first-person cooking shooter. Prepare delicious meals, defend your kitchen from relentless enemies, and keep the orders flowing before everything falls apart.
games.aboutText:
Cook Under Fire

Your kitchen is under attack! Dinner still has to go out.

Chop, fry, bake, and plate. Fast, precise, together. While enemies crash through the windows and turn your restaurant into a battlefield.

The best chefs don't just cook fast. They know when to grab a frying pan, when to throw a cleaver, and when to reach for a shotgun.

Food Is Your Secret Weapon

Stun, freeze, shrink, or explode anyone invading your kitchen with ridiculous food-based attacks.

Burnt meals become explosive. Frozen desserts stop enemies cold.

Every failed recipe is a tactical opportunity waiting to happen. Every ingredient is a weapon.

Embrace the Chaos

No plan survives first contact with the dinner rush.

Pots boil over. Walls get shredded by gunfire. Giant lobsters escape.

Ingredients roll across the floor while enemies smash everything you've built.

Adapt, improvise, and laugh through total disaster.

Four Chefs. One Disaster.

Success is built on teamwork. So is a disaster.

Split responsibilities, communicate under pressure, and keep the kitchen running while everything falls apart.

Use proximity voice chat to shout instructions, celebrate victories, or blame your friends for every mistake.

Friendships will be tested. Great memories will be made.

A Culinary Trip Around the World

Every restaurant is a new adventure.

Master recipes inspired by cuisines from around the globe in kitchens packed with unique mechanics, hazards, and unexpected twists.

Learn new recipes. Unleash new disasters.

Become legendary chefs…if your kitchen survives long enough!

games.name: Historarium
games.shortDescription: Shape continents, civilizations, and see the rise and fall of empires. Follow individual characters as they rise to power. Or as mighty rulers fall to irrelevance. Create nations and see them evolve through the centuries. Or destroy it all and watch civilization react to your actions.
games.aboutText:
Historarium is a pure sandbox game with no goals. It offers you freedom to craft a world and let the game's various systems simulate it through time.

Shape the World

Generate a world. Import a map or use paint tools to shape the map.

Edit Civilization

Place down cities and customize entire kingdoms.

Character System

Characters drive politics and interact with other characters.

Watch History Unfold

Simulate years of history and see empires rise and fall.

games.name: Master Healer Kale with useless party
games.shortDescription: A short incremental game where you play as a Healer in a party. Your main job is to keep your party alive. Upgrade 200+ skills in a skill tree, from healing to party damage. Designed to be completed in around 4 hours.
games.aboutText:
Play as Kale, the Master Healer, on his journey to defeat the Demon King who terrorizes the Kingdom. Your main job is to keep your party alive by healing or buffing them. Accompanied by a tank who is always sleeping, a newbie archer, and a genius but mean magic user.

=== Keep your party alive ===

As a healer, it's your job to heal your party and keep them alive.

=== Upgrade Kale's healing spells or party's stats ===

You can upgrade Kale's ability to heal or your party's damage, maximum health, and other stats in a massive skill tree.

=== Defeat giant Boss ===

Eventually, your party will be able to defeat bosses (and maybe the Demon King itself).

=== Enjoy the fireworks ===

Well, your party is not so useless after all...

Features

- Massive skill tree (200+ upgrades)

- 18 active spells to support the party

- 16+ different dungeons

- Fight bosses with different strategies

- Short gameplay (~4 hours of playtime)

- Challenge post-game for more content

games.name: Widget Idle
games.shortDescription: Your desktop is its controller. Every click, keypress, and mouse movement helps it grow. Widget Idle lives quietly in the corner of your desktop while you get on with the more important things in life. Now with a little extra happiness :)
games.aboutText:
Always playing: your desktop is Widget Idle's controller!

Widget Idle turns everything you already do on your computer into game input. Every click, every keypress, every movement of your mouse comes with a little incremental sense of accomplishment.

Widget Idle gives every click a little extra oomph. Whether you're chatting, editing photos, or writing (copy-pasting) code, you're always growing your economy. Neat!

We take particular care in how the game collects and uses data. It only reads the bare minimum it needs to run, and never stores or uploads the context, content or intent of anything you do. (See the appendix)

Satisfying animations and gameplay!

We carefully designed every interaction you'll have in Widget Idle.

From big feature unlocks to the smallest page switch, we hope these animations and sounds are ones you'll never want to put down!

Ever-evolving desktop companions!

Collect 16 adorable desktop widgets and unlock their expected, and unexpected, new features!

(We are not responsible if you get too attached.)

Gotta have them all!

Explore hidden (and not-so-hidden) mechanics, and collect and curate 100+ unique achievement stamps . (Supports Steam's new achievement system at launch!)

Display them proudly, show them off to your friends, and tell them just how productive you've been.

Customize your experience!

Widget Idle is a carefully designed and curated experience. That said, we know everyone enjoys games in their own way.

You're free to adjust:

- Dark/light mode

- 14 accessible color palettes

- Window zoom, with quick switching

- Reduced motion

- High contrast mode

- Per-mechanic volume

- Privacy settings

- A boss key

- and more...!

Wishlist now!

Not interested? You can still add it...

What if you change your mind someday?

It's not like we're going anywhere.

Privacy appendix.

Here's exactly how Widget Idle handles your data.

- With background input turned on, the game reads: that a key was pressed, that a mouse button was pressed, that the mouse moved and how far, that the scroll wheel moved and how far.

- With a Photocopier, the game reads: that your clipboard changed.

- With a CPU Load Monitor, the game reads: your CPU load.

Widget Idle never sends anything you type anywhere or saves it to any files, and never reads your screen.

What Widget Idle sends: Steam achievements, Discord Rich Presence (can be turned off), and the city you choose for weather forecast, or (with your permission) the location of your IP for weather forecast.

games.name: Malk
games.shortDescription: You are Malk. You survived where you were meant to die. And now you are paying for it. Fanatics are hunting you. Aristocrats are playing with your life. And power is your only chance not to become dirt beneath someone else’s boots. Allies betray you. Patrons use you. No one gets a second chance.
games.aboutText:
