Have you ever wondered how great mages begin their journey? Malk is an Action RPG that lets you take the first steps on the path of a mage from the very beginning.

Become the master of your own destiny and choose how you will begin your ascent toward the heights of magical power. Will you follow the law, or will you take the winding roads of gentlemen of fortune?

Andalor does not forgive weakness or mistakes. Here, knowledge is worth more than money, and a wrong choice can close the path to the future. People, demons, and the intrigues of powerful mages will constantly test the hero’s determination to see his journey through to the end.

Master dynamic third-person combat where steel, magic, and power are woven into a single martial art. Fierce battles, swift strikes, defensive spells, and deadly mistakes await you. Develop Malk according to your own magical style: become a classic mage, a warrior, or an archer. Choose spells, runes, and artifacts. Victory depends not only on reaction, but also on preparation, knowledge, tactics, and the path you choose.

games.name: Judicial Designer
games.shortDescription: A management and tycoon game where you build and manage a courthouse. From a small-town traffic court to handling high-profile criminal cases. Build your courthouse, hire and manage staff, schedule cases and balance the pressures of efficiency and reputation.
games.aboutText:
Congratulations on your new job as your local courthouse's administrator! Build and expand the courthouse from a small town hearings court to handling high-profile criminal cases. Balance expansion, reputation and budget in a system relying on the slow bureaucracy of government and the complexities of the legal system.

All kinds of people pass through a courthouse, meet their varying needs and expectations. From defendants held in custody to plaintiffs, legal-teams, jurors and spectators, people have simulated needs that impact your overall reputation, and provide potential for further revenue raising.

Design your courthouse to support optimal operations and the integrity of the legal process. Select each individual detail, from jury-boxes and judge benches to a variety of decoration items. Build across multiple-floors and expand upwards, or expand into a sprawling suburban courthouse over a single level.

Balance the case backlog, choose to balance speed and efficiency or the importance of fair and just trials. Some management can be outsourced to your employees, but some cannot. Provide for the needs of both detained defendants, staff, visiting legal teams and spectators. Manage press relations and ensure that privacy is upheld within your courthouse.

Controlling outcomes is not a part of the job, except for the acceptance of the occasional bribe. Watch as your judges and juries hand down verdicts, and the 'cogs of justice' turn slowly through your courthouse.

Features

- Building tools that allow you to build and furnish your courthouse across multiple floor-levels

- Staff hiring, management and training

- Proceeding management (including trials, small claims hearings and criminal hearings)

- Simulated spectators, witnesses and legal teams

- Reputation in the form of public, defense and prosecution/plaintiff reputation.

- Progression through 'lobbying', resembling a research mechanic.

games.name: Fractal Flyers
games.shortDescription: Fractal Flyers let's you fly through Real-Time 3D fractals using FPV drone controls (or traditional winged controls) — Lose yourself in the music across multiple hand-animated challenge levels and soar through the leader-boards.
games.aboutText:
3D Fractals From a Whole New perspective

Fly through real-time 3D fractals as they warp and transform around you. There's 4 main types, and 4 advanced types, and more to come.

- Menger Sponge

- Menger Sphere

- Serpinski's Triangle

- Inverted Sphere

- Mandel Bulb

- Mandel Box

- Apollonian

- Serpinski's Tetrahedron

More will be added with time.

Push your piloting skill with the new challenge modes!

It's a game of 'Don't touch the fractal' in this competition inspired by the planets. Fly through Hand Animated fractals that move in time with an original Break-core / DNB soundtrack made by a human composer . Compete in different modes, survival and relativity race. Soar through weekly and all time leader-boards as you hone your FPV skill.

Multiple Flight Modes

Fly using FPV drone controls with either an arcade model or a realistic one. Alternatively, if you do not fly FPV drones, there's a wing option that flies more traditionally, with more alternate control option planned for a later date.

A drone radio running OpenTX is recommended, and standard game controllers work too.

Infinite Exploration, and Total Control

Explore endlessly in any direction in this truly infinite space. It's a freestyle pilots playground as you bob, weave and flip flop through an ever changing landscape.

While you can allow the automated / randomized animation to help explore, you have full access to all fractal variables, so you can search for the perfect infinite ripping location that suits your needs.

Helpful abilities

As you're flying, you may find yourself wanting to capture a moment, or stop and do some tricks on a particular fractal structure. Built in are abilities to help with UN-interupted exploration.

Record GIF - With the flick of a switch, capture a GIF, with configurable quality, to share with anyone!
Pause - Simply stops all fractal movement, so you can hit the cool gap... or whatever.
Set Spawn - Change spawn location to allow faster resets for practicing tricks.
Freeze - Freeze the camera where it is, and allow the animations to play through.

Join the Discord to stay up to date with the latest development news, ask questions, and share your fractals!

games.name: Farmastrophy With Friends
games.shortDescription: Farm. Cook. Deliver. Survive the cows. A chaotic co-op race against the clock - solo or with up to 4 friends!
games.aboutText:
🌱 Welcome to Farmastrophy — where farming meets total chaos!

You're a farmer on a mission. Grow crops, cook meals, and deliver everything to the tractor - before time runs out. Sounds simple? The cows have other plans.

🐄 FARM. COOK. DELIVER. SURVIVE.

- 🌾 Full farming loop - sow, water, and harvest your crops

- 🪵 Gather resources - chop wood and mine stone

- 🍳 Cook & process - turn raw crops into meals at the campfire

- 🚜 Delivery orders - fulfill the tractor's demands to win the round

- 🐄 Chaotic cows - hungry, unpredictable, and absolutely destructive

- 🥔 Potato throwing - your best (and only) weapon

- ⏱️ Race against the clock - every second counts

- 👨‍🌾 Online co-op - up to 4 players, divide the chaos together

🐄 THE COWS. Hungry. Unpredictable. Destructive.

They will trample everything you've worked for. Your only defense? Grab a potato. Throw it. Hope for the best.

💧 NEW BIOME: THE DESERT

Scorching heat. Faster crop decay. Use the sprinkler to keep your plants alive twice as long - and stay one step ahead.

🤝 BETTER WITH FRIENDS

Split the roles: one plants, one cooks, one handles the cows. Or completely ignore the plan and watch everything burn. Either way - it's better together.

🚧 Currently in development - more content and features coming with Early Access.

games.name: The NOexistenceN of Lilith
games.shortDescription: Lilith has returned from the fantasy world to become your desktop companion. Watch her wander freely across your screen with lively animations and dynamic real-time behaviors. Spend cozy everyday moments together as she keeps you company and eases the stress of daily life.
games.aboutText:
This is a desktop companion game

She is still the same Lilith, only this time she lives on your desktop

She breathes, zones out, and gradually comes alive right before your eyes.

She yawns, gets sleepy, and softly reminds you to rest late at night

She sits by the taskbar swinging her legs, wanders around now and then, just staying quietly in your world

games.name: AMPANIC
games.shortDescription: A hyper-fast shopkeeping game where every task is performed with your aim! Keep performing at your best by thinking carefully about efficiency and task order. Three difficulty levels, from mouse beginners to seasoned experts! Online co-op and versus multiplayer supported.
games.aboutText:
"Aiming Skill" × "Panic"

AMPANIC　(AIM × PANIC)

A shopkeeping game that puts your aiming skills to the test.

No time to rest. Ever.

Gather materials, process them, craft items, and serve customers――

A hyper-fast shopkeeping game where every task is performed with your aim!

Let a customer get away... and it’s game over.

Orders keep piling up, and customers keep flooding in.

Keep your shop running with efficient task prioritization, quick decisions, and precise flick aiming.

Every task is controlled with your aim!

First, grab passersby and bring them into your shop.

------------------

Once a customer places an order, it’s time to gather materials.

Fling your mouse around to collect materials from the field at lightning speed!

---------------------

Check the recipe, then get to processing.

Select the materials you need quickly and process them precisely.

------------------
Finally, crafting.

Combine materials with tracking aim to complete the customer’s order.

And of course, deliver it as soon as it’s ready.

Extreme pressure: Let them leave, and it’s over!

Even when your shop starts filling up with orders, taking your hand off the mouse is not an option.

Customers get angry as time passes and eventually leave.

As mentioned earlier, if a customer leaves, it’s game over.

The moment you lose your cool, your shop falls apart.

--------------

Chaos that changes with every stage

The further you progress, the more complicated the orders become.

Required materials, processing steps, and priorities.

Everything speeds up, putting your decision-making skills to the test.

The shop is overflowing with customers, and everything’s about to fall apart!

...That’s when you should use your skills .

Spend the mana you’ve collected to deal with customers.

Choose the skills that suit your playstyle and save your shop from disaster.

Some customers come with special orders or bring trouble of their own.

Your goal is to reach the sales target set for each stage.

Can you keep this chaotic tool shop running?

--------------

Online Co-op Multiplayer!

Work together... or get in each other’s way.

Online Versus Mode!

Whenever you process a customer, a new customer is sent to your opponent’s screen.

Keep going until your rival’s shop falls apart!

--------------

A Roguelike Game Mode, Too!

The final stage and versus mode use a roguelike format. Experiment with a variety of builds.
The high-difficulty mode supports leaderboards, letting you check scores and builds from players around the world.

Three Difficulty Levels to Choose From

From mouse beginners to seasoned experts

Features

- High-speed tool shop management controlled entirely with AIM

- Flick aiming and tracking aim are the keys to success

- Heart-pounding moments when you can't afford to lose a customer

- A frantic loop of gathering materials → processing → crafting → delivery

- Orders and difficulty change with every stage

- An extreme multitasking experience that’s all the more satisfying when things get chaotic

- Gameplay Videos and Streaming -

Gameplay videos and livestreams are welcome.

Note: Please include the game title, “AMPANIC,” in your video or stream title.

See you!

-AMPANIC-

games.name: Glitch Forest
games.shortDescription: A reverse bullet hell roguelite where weather reshapes the battlefield every 5 minutes! Combine active items, skills, and relics into game-breaking builds. Activate beacons, crush elites, and return to base stronger every run!
games.aboutText:
An action-packed reverse bullet hell roguelite.

The forest's code is corrupting. Freely combine active items, skills, and relics to craft devastating builds against relentless monster tides.

Survive 20 minutes of gales, storms, fog, and blood rain. Scavenge everything and blast your way out!

A New Battlefield Every 5 Minutes

Survive 4 stages of shifting weather—from torrential rain and blinding fog to howling gales.

Activate Anomaly Beacons for powerful relics, at the cost of making the environment even deadlier! Outlast the timer, crush the Elite, and push to the next stage.

Active Items That Turn the Tide

Your ultimate trump card in a pinch.

Unleash screen-wide slashes, drag energy orbs, chug infinite potions, deploy deflecting shields, or freeze time at the press of a button!

Meta-Progression That Changes Gameplay

Unlock character abilities, new skills, and more beacons to expand your tactical choices on every run.

Open battlefield portals to enter the in-run shop mid-combat and grab the final piece of your build!

games.name: Our Will
games.shortDescription: You are Astrid, a young girl tasked with leading a small company of warriors into an unknown and mystical land, in search of a cure to save your village. Be ready to face forces beyond human comprehension, titanic beasts and perhaps even the Gods themselves.
games.aboutText:
1. Nordic Narrative

Dive into a nordic saga or epic proportions, where you'll face both reality and myth in an unforgiving world inspired by Scandinavian folklore. From cold landscapes to dangerous creatures, everything will try to stopping you from reaching your destiny.

2. Consequential Choices

Every word, every action, every choice have consequences. Some minor, others that will impact your voyage through Jötunheim. You must think well before committing to any path, because you'll be judged by your companions and by the dangerous forces that surround your existence.

Depending on your choices the outcome of this adventure can change drastically.

3. Hand-Drawn Visuals

Experience the story through beautiful hand-drawn visuals that bring an epic saga to life. From mesmerizing landscapes to unique characters and creatures, Jötunheim is a world straight out of a fantasy book.

4. Turn-Based Combat

An intense turn-based combat that pits three heroes against monsters and creatures, taking turns to try and overpower each other. Be mindful of your decisions and strategize ahead, or you risk your adventure to come to a tragic end.

5. Hero Party

You have at your disposal eight different heroes, each with their unique set of skills, that can be further trained and specialized. Be mindful of whom you partner with in the fog of combat, because there are animosities between those who want to see this mission through and the choices you make will also impact each companion's strength in combat.

6. Team Ultimates

If you lead them right, this party of companions can cooperate and synergize in combat, unleashing untamed power and battle changing ultimate abilities that require specific-hero cooperation.

7. Dynamic Weaknesses

Experience a combat featuring an innovative weakness system that evolves throughout the battle, requiring you to anticipate and adapt in order to survive the perils Jötunheim hides.

There are five runes of combat, each representing one or tow companions. Those same runes are the weaknesses of the creatures you'll face, so make sure you chose your party right.

8. Survival Mode

If you seek a deeper combat challenge, you can play a complex survival mode, that forces you to face consecutive encounters, testing your combat abilities. This mode has several layers of difficulty, making each run unique and challenging.

games.name: Bravely Doomed
games.shortDescription: A deck-builder roguelike where you draft cards, explore fog-of-war dungeons, and fight in turn-based combat. Meet NPCs with dynamic dialogue, uncover deep lore, and conquer a mysterious dungeon floor by floor.
games.aboutText:
Bravely Doomed is a deck-builder roguelike set in a mysterious fantasy world. Draft your deck, descend into a deadly dungeon, and fight your way through turn-based card combat.

Key Features

- Strategic Deck Drafting — Each run begins by drafting cards and then collecting more throughout the run. Build synergies, adapt your strategy, and create a deck that fits your play style.

- Turn-Based Card Combat — Engage in tactical battles where every card matters. Manage your resources, time your plays, and outmaneuver enemies.

- Dungeon Exploration — Navigate fog-of-war floors, smash destructible props, collect crystals, find keys to unlock doors, and loot crates for valuable rewards.

- Rich Characters & Dynamic NPCs — Meet unique personalities with their own lore. NPCs remember your conversations and respond naturally — not from fixed dialogue trees.

- Deep Lore & Campaign — Descend deeper into the dungeon to uncover the ancient magic holding it together. Veteran adventurers share survival tips while mysterious beings reveal world-shaking secrets.

- Loot & Progression — Collect loot, unlock new cards, and grow your collection run after run.

Bravely Doomed is a solo-developed passion project with heart — a fantasy adventure that blends the strategic depth of deck-builders with the exploration and discovery of classic roguelikes.

games.name: Knuckle Creek
games.shortDescription: Knuckle Creek is a slapstick single player and multiplayer party game designed for chaotic fun, crazy characters and weapons galore. Complete an extensive solo campaign with hundreds of unlockables or party it up with friends in one of the many couch play or online party modes.
games.aboutText:
From the team who brought you the Overwhelmingly Positive rated Platypus Reclayed, Knuckle Creek is the ultimate clay-animated single player and party brawler for up to 8 players, offering chaotic couch play and online party modes. The solo campaign includes 48+ handcrafted levels and 100s of cosmetics to unlock, while multiplayer offers a multitude of configurable ways to play.

If you like slapstick brawling with friends from your sofa then this is the game for you. If you like them but nobody’s around tonight, this is still the game for you!

Grab a fish, rocket launcher, or even a chicken, and battle your opponents. Matches last minutes, the rules can change every round, and even knocked out players can be agents of chaos. Welcome to Knuckle Creek, home of the world famous Knuckle Sandwich.

KEY FEATURES

- 48+ levels Single Player campaign with Steam Friend leaderboard support

- Couch play and online party mode for up to 8 friends

- Character customisation with hundreds of cosmetics, voices, and more

- Full multiplayer game customisation

games.name: Damn Exam
games.shortDescription: You thought your job was to educate the youth? Think again. You are here to keep them in line. These brats have no intention of doing the exam the right way, instead they will just cheat, cheat, cheat! You are the last line of defense and must catch every cheating student.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the worst week of your teaching career

It's exam week. You’ll be here Monday through Friday, and your students have collectively transformed into a syndicate of academic dishonesty. The gall of youth! But you are not going to let them get away with it…

Meet your students (AKA suspects)

Each day introduces new problems and new students. Luckily, you come prepared to tackle the increasingly creative cheating methods they show up with.

Fail them all

Your goal is to fail every student that cheats. You also know that every students is going to cheat, so the only way for you to win, is to fail every single student . Failing them is simple enough, you just have to catch them in the act!

However, not every culprit is easy to spot. So you have to use your arsenal of gadgets to help you.

Spy on them with cameras or detect outside help with your detector device. Whatever it takes!

Custom Modes: Think you're good? Try survival mode where students keep coming back or custom setups to test how fast you can fail students under unique conditions.

Can you survive exam week without getting fired, or will your students outsmart you?

Good luck. You're going to need it.

games.name: Red Rising
games.shortDescription: Fight for dominance with up to 6 players in the official digital adaptation of the award-winning board game. Assemble a hand of followers, chain together powerful combos, and lead your house to victory in this clash of cards set in the dystopian world of Red Rising.
games.aboutText:
Red Rising is the official digital adaptation of the critically acclaimed board game, based on Pierce Brown’s bestselling sci-fi saga for 1 to 6 players . Players will step into the color caste system, forming their own House of unique followers, and fighting for dominance. The digital version faithfully recreates the original tabletop rules while adding stunning new visuals and convenience.

Take command of followers from rival houses in a game of hand management. Trigger powerful card effects, and battle for dominance across Mars and beyond. Every decision can help — or hinder — your opponents in the fight to be the house with ultimate power.

Draft unique characters from the Golds, Reds, Obsidians, and beyond, then chain their abilities into devastating combos that can turn the tide of battle in a single turn.

The physical game brought to life with stunning upgrades only possible in digital form. Watch every card come alive with stunning gold foils and refractions, dynamic effects, and custom voice-over performances. Enjoy exclusive digital tools that make the game faster and more immersive: instant scoring, rules on command, and a rich in-game codex that dives deeper into the Colors, Houses, and lore.

This is Red Rising as you’ve never experienced it before.

Every rule. Every card. Every strategic choice as you remember it from the tabletop. Emerald City Games is happy to partner with Stonemaier Games to bring the complete, board game experience to PC with all 112 unique character cards, beautifully recreated, and ready for deployment.

Key Features

- Faithful recreation of the original board game rules and all 112 unique cards

- Hand-management and combo-building gameplay that rewards planning and strategy

- Challenging AI for solo and multiplayer modes with adjustable difficulty

- Crossplay multiplayer (real-time and asynchronous) for 1–6 players

- Stunning digital enhancements including animated Gold foil effects, atmospheric board design, characters animations, and custom voice over bringing the cards to life.

- Special details exploring the Colors, Houses, and lore of the Red Rising universe.

Wishlist NOW to be notified the moment the demo drops. Secure your place in the Red Rising universe.

Red Rising launches on Steam in Q4 2026 .

games.name: The Bird of the North
games.shortDescription: In 1921: a kidnapping, a revolution... Investigate and uncover the truth behind a dark, mysterious story.
games.aboutText:
The Bird of the North is a deduction game with a playtime of 120–160 minutes.

Set in 1921, the Industrial Revolution has been brought to a halt by an ice age.

As the cold worsens, anger brews, and an expedition is organized to find a solution...

Visions with birds.

Explore scenes freely with a simple movement system.

A game of deduction.

One sentence per character: it’s up to you to understand the context and deduce what happens in each vision.

A chronological survey.

Using the characters and multiple scenes you explore, piece together the story by completing an investigation board based on locations, clues, and the timeline of the visions.

games.name: BOMBANANA!
games.shortDescription: Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode?
games.aboutText:
BOMBANANA! is a chaotic, explosively funny co-op multiplayer game for three, where each player has only part of the information - blind monkey, deaf monkey and mute monkey must work together to defuse a bomb, or everyone goes BOOM! Will your friendship survive the ultimate test?

MEET YOUR SQUAD!

🙈 Blind Monkey: You can’t see the bomb, but you can touch the bomb! 👍 Sadly, you can’t see colors or read screens. You’ll need to rely on your teammates for the rest.

🙊 Mute Monkey: You are the only one who can read the bomb disposal manual. If only you could tell the others what you know.

🙉 Deaf Monkey: You can see the bomb and you can see your friends as they frantically gesture at you. Sadly, you can’t hear a thing, but at this point, would you even want to?

As you gamble with your friends' lives, you must rely on each other and your monkeys' unique abilities. Communication is key, and there’s no one right way to defuse the bomb. We don’t impose any methods: wave, shout, throw bananas. Working out how you communicate is your job.

WARNING!

Players can and should expect peak amounts of misunderstanding, unjust accusations, and desperate body language, placing your friendships in jeopardy. Just because you keep talking, that doesn't mean nobody explodes. Even if you manage to survive the bomb, there's no guarantee your friendship will. Some might call this game "friendslop". We disagree. If anything, it's a new genre: anti-friendslop, or perhaps an argument simulator. 🤔

We’ll let you be the judge!

FEATURES!

- 3-Player Co-op - No more, no less. Exactly three monkeys required

- 3 Game Modes -

- Campaign - 30 handcrafted levels with increasing difficulty

- Endless - Procedurally generated, wave-based levels that keep getting harder

- Custom - Players create their own challenge by adjusting bomb difficulty, the timer, module types, environmental hazards, and how many mistakes are allowed

- Asymmetric Roles - Every player sees, hears, and acts differently

- Fun interactions - Point, wave, gesture or flail wildly. Your options are only limited by your imagination and each player's Emote wheel

- Slapping - Obviously an essential feature

- New Environments: We all know the trusty minivan, but what about a plane? What other environments can you defuse bombs in?

- Environmental Hazards: Navigate events like power outages, obstructions and loud interruptions

- Voice Chat - Some of you can talk, some of you can’t. You’ll figure it out

- Puzzle Modules - Each bomb has different modules and different rules, all of which are guaranteed to induce different kinds of panic

- Level System - Defuse the bomb to unlock new levels. The better you get, the harder they are

- Color Blind Mode - Just because the monkey is blind, doesn’t mean he can’t defuse a bomb! Colors used across objects and the UI have been adapted to support two different types of color blindness.

games.name: Papa's Mocharia Deluxe
games.shortDescription: Create delicious coffee drinks and cannoli in Papa's Mocharia Deluxe! Create stylish layered lattes in the coffeehouse for Papa Louie's loyal customers while earning tips, points, and Special Recipes. Take a trip in the Food Truck to design and serve your own eye-catching creations!
games.aboutText:
Papa Louie has opened a brand-new coffee shop in New Pepperton, serving up custom layered coffee drinks known as Papaccinos. After landing a job as the barista at Papa's Mocharia, you discover that a year-long documentary is being filmed about the new coffeehouse -- and you're now the main star! Under the watchful eye of the camera crew, you'll brew espresso, steam and froth milk, and craft eye-catching layered coffee drinks. Finish the lattes with whip and toppings, and serve them with delicious cannoli to your picky customers. You'll need to multitask between multiple areas in the coffeehouse, where each station is a unique hands-on experience.

Papa's Mocharia makes its PC debut! In this deluxe version, the original coffee-crafting experience has been reimagined for mouse controls and larger screens, delivering the classic hands-on gameplay to Papa's Mocharia for the first time. Even more customers have arrived in New Pepperton to try the famous layered Papaccinos, so you'll see some fresh faces along with your Mocharia regulars. Along with returning features like Daily Specials and helpful Score Detail breakdowns, this version adds new holiday ingredients, and introduces a Free Play mode with the Mocharia Food Truck!

Celebrate the seasons in the coffeehouse with delicious holiday flavors! As you reach new ranks, the seasons and holidays in New Pepperton will change, and your customers will start ordering holiday-themed drinks and cannoli. You'll unlock new syrups, powders, dairy, shakers, creams, and cannoli shells for each holiday of the year. You can also buy holiday clothing and decorate the lobby with seasonal decorations to show your holiday spirit!

After you hire a Driver, you can send them out across New Pepperton in your brand-new Mocharia Food Truck! Between workdays, use your imagination to craft your own unique layered lattes and cannoli, then serve them straight from the truck to see who shows up to try your creations. You can also mix and match ingredients from different holidays in the Food Truck for truly unique combinations!

- Hands-on gameplay for brewing coffee, steaming milk, layering drinks, and crafting cannoli

- Custom chefs and delivery drivers

- Food Truck for open-ended free play mode

- 12 separate holidays to unlock, each with more ingredients

- 7 exciting Mini-Games to play after each workday

- Tons of furniture and clothing to decorate your shop and workers

- Earn and master 40 unique Special Recipes

- View Score Details to learn from your mistakes

- Customer Coupons to entice customers to return

- 90 colorful Stickers to earn for completing tasks

- Unlock alternate outfits for every customer

- 154 customers to serve with unique orders

- 124 ingredients to unlock

games.name: PATIENCE IS A VIRTUE
games.shortDescription: Something's hiding in the cassette. Rearrange the words of your enemies to investigate a small-town conspiracy in this mystery puzzle game.
games.aboutText:
Static. Your body is foreign territory.

PATIENCE IS A VIRTUE is a cozy-meets-creepy puzzle game about communicating with people you don't understand.

College grad Louis has just moved back to his childhood home, but things seem worse this time around. He's chronically ill, struggling to find adequate healthcare, and can't seem to recognize the streets he was raised on. When he is attacked by a mysterious entity, communicating only through a cassette player, he must consult with it and the other townsfolk to discover the true nature of the assault.

- Consult with witnesses using only phrases they have already said in unique word-based puzzles.

- Unravel a supernatural conspiracy in a small town.

- Chat with the locals and distract yourself with their problems.

- Take pictures of the city's bugs for a friend!

PATIENCE IS A VIRTUE currently has:

- Full controller and keyboard support

- An optional in-game content warning system

- Dialogue auto-play

- Toggles to disable sensitive sounds

- Swappable fonts

- In-game hints and solutions

- Objective reminders and character summaries

- Limited voice acting

- Screen reader compatibility

This game contains sensitive content that some may find upsetting. Please check the mature content description below for details. The inclusion of this content is intended to create a meaningful, emotional experience, but please be mindful of your own comfort with this subject matter.

games.name: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil
games.shortDescription: Dodge the barrage, defeat the enemies, and brave the Scarlet Mist Incident. The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil returns with fresh music and graphics. Control the shrine maiden Reimu and the magician Marisa, weaving between bullets that fill up the screen. The soundtrack has been fully remade by ZUN.
games.aboutText:
*This title can only be purchased as part of a bundle. The price is the same, and the Classic version is included.

Dodge the barrage, defeat enemies, and brave the Scarlet Mist incident.

Touhou Koumakyou - The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil, with music and graphics remastered by an older and wiser creator (self-described).

Touhou Koumakyou - the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil is a vertical-scrolling 2D shoot-'em-up where you weave through dazzling curtains of bullets.

Take control of the shrine maiden Reimu or the magician Marisa, and set out to resolve the incident threatening Gensokyou. Dodge and slip your way forward through barrages of bullets dense enough to fill the entire screen.

Make full use of each character's unique shots to defeat your enemies—while keeping your life count from dropping to zero under their attacks. Every shot type plays differently: some automatically home in on enemies, while others deliver superior firepower in a head-on assault.

The New Classic edition features upscaled high-resolution graphics, with every track rearranged by ZUN.

It also adds a brand-new mode where you can take on the challenge with unlimited lives.

Controls

・Player movement: Move up, down, left, and right.

・Shot: Your standard attack.

・Bomb: A special attack. The type can be chosen during character select, and each has its own characteristics, so pick your favorite and have fun. It's a very powerful attack, but be careful—the number of uses is limited.

・Focus Mode: Slow your movement speed for finer control.

Gamepad button assignments can be changed via the Key Config in the game's Options menu.

Story

Gensokyou has been blanketed in a scarlet mist.

Hakurei Shrine maiden, Reimu Hakurei, and Marisa Kirisame, a magician living in the Forest of Magic, set out to resolve the incident.

She awaited them inside the Western-style mansion that materialized amidst the mist.

Players

Reimu Hakurei

The shrine maiden of the Hakurei Shrine.

Fights using high evasion capabilities and a wide attack range.

Marisa Kirisame

A magician living in the Forest of Magic.

Challenges the incident with a combat style specialized in high firepower.

You can also play the Classic version, which recreates the original 2002 gameplay as closely as possible.

*All text in the Classic version is in Japanese.

games.name: Witch Shop Simulator
games.shortDescription: Step behind the counter of your very own sorcery shop. Witch Shop Simulator is a cozy first-person shop management game where you invent and brew custom potions, manage your stock, and keep your shelves full of magical wonders for customers to buy.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to your shop. The cauldron is warm, the shelves are waiting, and customers will be here soon.

Witch Shop Simulator puts you in the apron of a witch running her very own sorcery store. Inspired by the magical worlds of games like Hogwarts Legacy, this is a cozy, first-person experience built around the quiet satisfaction of a well-managed shop and a perfectly brewed potion.

Brew Your Potions Gather ingredients, follow recipes, and craft a growing catalogue of magical concoctions. Each potion you brew is one more product ready to stock, and one more satisfied customer walking out the door.

Run Your Shop Keep your shelves organized, manage your inventory, and make sure nothing runs out. A good witch knows her stock as well as her spells.

Your Pace, Your Magic No combat, no pressure, just the gentle rhythm of a shop that’s yours to grow. Arrange your space, build your catalogue, and settle into the most magical small business in town.

A World That Feels Like Home Warm lighting, bubbling cauldrons, and shelves lined with curious bottles. Witch Shop Simulator is designed to feel like a cozy corner of a much bigger magical world.

If you’ve ever lost yourself in the potion-crafting loop of Potion Craft or the shop management depth of Potionomics, you’ll feel right at home here. Witch Shop Simulator channels that same slow-burn satisfaction of building a business from nothing — discovering recipes, fine-tuning your stock, and watching your little storefront grow one brew at a time.

Fans of cozy life sims like Stardew Valley and Coral Island will recognise the rhythm immediately: days that feel meaningful, a space that’s entirely your own, and a quiet sense of progress that never pressures you. Whether you came from the sun-soaked fields of Fields of Mistria or the fantasy islands of Sun Haven, the gentle pace of Witch Shop Simulator will feel like a natural home.

There’s something deeply satisfying about running your own shop — the same pull you feel in games like Travellers Rest, Tavern Master, or Cozy Keep, where every shelf stocked and every customer served feels like a small personal win. In Witch Shop Simulator, that feeling gets a magical twist: your shelves hold healing draughts and enchanted elixirs, and your most loyal regulars might just be a dragon or a wandering ghost.

The crafting heart of the game will be familiar to anyone who’s spent time with Potion Shop Simulator or Witchy Business — gather, combine, brew, and sell. But Witch Shop Simulator wraps that loop in a world rich with atmosphere and character, where even choosing which ingredients to stock feels like part of a bigger story.

If you enjoy the creative management challenge of games like Graveyard Keeper, My Time at Portia, or Dinkum — where you’re always balancing resources, unlocking new options, and making your corner of the world a little more special — you’ll find plenty to sink your evenings into here. The shop grows with you, and no two playthroughs need to look the same.

Players who loved the cooperative brewing chaos of Witchtastic or Potion Party will find a more relaxed solo take on the same magical fantasy: you’re the one witch in charge, setting your own pace, building your recipe book, and deciding which concoctions make the cut. No timer. No yelling. Just you, your cauldron, and the satisfying clink of a customer’s coins.

The world-building draws on that same sense of warmth and whimsy you find in games like Witchbrook, Little Witch in the Woods, and Wylde Flowers — places where magic is woven into the everyday, where tending a garden of enchanted herbs feels just as meaningful as the biggest magical discovery. There are stories in every corner of your shop, if you take the time to look.

For those who’ve explored the management depth of Inn Tycoon, Blacksmith Master, Tidehaven: Ale & Trade, or Shop Simulator: Supermarket, the familiar loop of stock management, customer satisfaction, and business growth is all here — just with a decidedly more magical flavour. You’re not running a grocery aisle or a forge; you’re the most enchanting shop in the entire village.

Life sim fans who’ve put hours into Rune Factory 4 Special, Moonstone Island, or Story of Seasons: Pioneers of Olive Town will find the gentle daily structure of Witch Shop Simulator instantly comfortable. Each in-game day brings new ingredients to gather, new recipes to try, and new customers to delight — a rhythm that’s easy to settle into and hard to put down.

Even players coming from the meditative calm of PowerWash Simulator or the island-hopping wonder of Dave the Diver will recognise that same ‘one more day’ pull — the quiet compulsion to just check the shelves one more time, brew one more batch, and see who walks through the door at opening.

The magical shopkeeper fantasy has lived on Roblox for years too. If you grew up running businesses in Wizard Tycoon, building your dream home in Brookhaven RP, or trading rare finds in Adopt Me!, Witch S

games.name: Agro Tycoon
games.shortDescription: In this management simulator with a charming isometric pixel art aesthetic, you are not just a farmer, but the CEO of your own operation. Start with a modest plot of land, invest your initial capital wisely, and transform a small plantation into a true agribusiness powerhouse.
games.aboutText:
Attach heavy plows to your tractor to clear residues and turn rough terrain into fertile soil. Match your tractor's horsepower to the implement's weight to avoid getting bogged down or spinning your wheels in the mud.

Load your industrial seeders with commercial crops like Wheat, Corn, Soy, Barley, Oats, Canola, or Beans. Strategically select your seeds and sow them across your isometric grid to kickstart the growth cycle.

Unfold massive spray booms and deploy self-propelled units to safeguard your investments. Keep invasive weeds at bay and maximize your crop yields through precision chemical and nutrient application.

Attach specialized headers to your combine harvesters and clear mature fields. Keep a close eye on your internal grain tank capacity—once you hit max storage, you'll need to haul the payload away to keep the operation running.

Transport your hard-earned harvest using weight-simulated trailers. Store your grains safely in your Shed’s silos to ride out bad market trends, or drive straight to the local Market to cash in on live price fluctuations.

Expand your industrial footprint by building Sheds and recruiting a specialized workforce. Automate tedious fieldwork cycles using a smart worker pathfinding system to scale your production to new heights.

Take on demanding mission contracts from local NPCs. Fulfill specialized delivery requests to earn extra capital, secure reliable regional partnerships, and establish yourself as the ultimate agricultural tycoon.

FROM DIRT TO DIGITAL AUTOMATION

Can you balance tight market margins, manage a heavy fleet, and orchestrate a perfectly automated crew? The fields are waiting, the market prices are shifting by the second, and your operational efficiency is the only thing between bankruptcy and massive profits. Stop dreaming about the quiet country life—it's time to build a synchronized agricultural empire.

Are you ready to become the next Agro Tycoon? Add to your Wishlist now!

games.name: Bloody Cleanup TOGETHER
games.shortDescription: Clean up the aftermath of terrible events in Bloody Cleanup Together, a co-op horror cleaning sim for up to 4 players. Remove blood, hide evidence, carry bodies, and restore every detail before anything is discovered.
games.aboutText:
Tired of typical cleaning simulators? Sick of mopping ordinary floors?

Introducing Bloody Cleanup Together - a unique co-op horror cleaning simulator featuring realistic physics and dark humor. You and your friends are the new stars of our cutting-edge cleaning company. Your mission is the flawless elimination of the aftermath of crimes, accidents, and mysterious disasters. Grab a mop and get ready to scrub away the dirtiest secrets!

Forget about police investigations - we solve problems before they even appear! Attention: absolute cleanliness is a mandatory condition of the contract! You won't be able to complete the level until you've scrubbed everything down to the last drop of blood. Dispose of mountains of trash, apply our patented chemicals, and restore locations to their pristine condition!

Tired of breaking your back all alone? Our realistic physics will force you to work as a team! Coordinate your actions, assign roles, and load bodies into the company vehicle together to finish the job faster and avoid costly mistakes.

Only at our company - a terrifying variety of workspaces! From a circus buried under tons of trash to a gloomy bunker and a ransacked bank. And that's not all! Every room is filled with interactive details. Rearrange the furniture, return items to their original positions, and make sure absolutely nothing is left where it doesn't belong!

You might ask: how can I make some extra cash? A true pro clears the room of everything unnecessary, including forgotten stacks of money! You can "dispose" of this cash straight into your own pocket! But be careful: this offer comes with risks! If the client notices the missing funds, staggering fines will hit your entire team's wallets!

Start with basic mops, and then discover the world of elite cleaning! Spend your hard-earned money in our company store! Buy ultra-powerful vacuums, highly effective cleaning agents, and bottomless trash containers. More gadgets mean more serious contracts - and higher income!

games.name: SeaColony
games.shortDescription: SeaColony is a survival colony-builder set on the open sea. Build and expand a floating colony, manage colonists, research technologies, and develop farming, fishing, production, and power systems. Trade with merchant ships and survive pirate raids, fires, and harsh weather as your colony grows.
games.aboutText:
🌊 SeaColony

SeaColony is a survival colony-builder set on the open sea. Build and expand a floating settlement, manage your colonists, develop production systems, and survive the challenges of life far from land.

Start with limited space and resources, then gradually turn your small platform into a self-sustaining colony. Every expansion matters as you balance food, water, power, production, storage, and the needs of your colonists.

Research new technologies, establish farms and fishing systems, trade with passing merchant ships, and prepare your colony for pirate raids, fires, harsh weather, and other unexpected events.

⚓ Key Features

🏗️ Build & Expand Your Colony

Expand your floating platform and design a colony that can support a growing population. Plan where you place housing, production buildings, storage, farms, and essential infrastructure.

👥 Manage Your Colonists

Assign work priorities and manage the daily needs of your colonists. Keep them fed, hydrated, rested, and productive as your settlement grows.

⚙️ Production & Resources

Gather resources and build production systems to create food, water, materials, medicine, and other supplies your colony needs to survive.

🌾 Farming & Fishing

Grow crops and harvest food from the sea. Combine farming, fishing, and other food sources to maintain a reliable supply for your colony.

🔬 Research & Technology

Unlock new buildings, equipment, production methods, and power systems through research as your colony develops.

⚡ Power Your Colony

Generate and manage electricity using different power sources. Build batteries and balance energy production and consumption as your infrastructure expands.

💰 Trade with Merchant Ships

Trade surplus resources with passing merchant ships and obtain materials that may be difficult to produce on your own.

🌧️ Survive the Open Sea

Face changing weather, fires, pirate raids, resource shortages, and other events that can threaten the stability of your colony.

📦 Build a Self-Sustaining Settlement

Balance resource production, storage, consumption, and expansion. Every new colonist and every new structure puts additional pressure on your colony's systems.

games.name: Wiseman: No More Breakups
games.shortDescription: Fight through a moving train in a stylish rhythm-combat boss rush where timed four-button inputs become your attacks. Defeat absurd bosses, survive relationship chaos, and help August Wiseman get his phone back.
games.aboutText:
She took his phone. He just wants it back. The train has other plans.

This is not a rhythm game about dancing. This is a rhythm game about surviving a relationship.

Hit your inputs: you attack. Miss the window: you bleed.

Arcade rhythm combat. Four buttons. No mercy. Miss enough — everything resets. Every boss. Every car. Back to zero.

No checkpoints. No shortcuts. Just the next attempt.

WHAT'S ON THE TRAIN

Her best friend. Her brother. Her exes. Her pet. Her biker gang. Her mother. Her father.

Choose your order. Fight them all. Lose and start over.

Every boss talks. Every conversation chips away at August's very convincing lie that he doesn't care.

THE SOUND Jazz. All of it. No exceptions. Not a mechanic — a warning.

THE LOOK Anime UI. Spray can energy. A HUD with opinions.

games.name: Wheat and Wrath
games.shortDescription: Guide a clan of strawfolk through the dawn of agriculture in this fantasy city-builder. Appease gods for favour and knowledge, while avoiding their wrath. Manage your economy, trade with neighbouring villages, and survive raider attacks. Will your village prosper, or wither, burn, and be forgotten?
games.aboutText:
The Woven are a people made of straw, brought to life through the magic of their one and only deity, The Mother Woven. For time immemorial they have wandered the world in small clans, occasionally gathering wild wheat to re-stuff their bodies with fresh straw. But the world has changed, and the wheat fields are vanishing. Guide your clan as they build a village and learn to farm the wheat they need to survive.

The changing environment will force your people into new beliefs and new gods. But the gods you choose will shape what your village becomes. Choose wisely.

A Fragile Straw Existence: The Strawconomy

In a world of living straw people, straw is sustenance, sacrifice, and currency.

Re-stuff and Survive : Villagers maintain their health by replacing some of their straw every three months. This requires healthy stores of straw.

Rituals

Perform an ancient ritual at the Temple of Life to construct new straw villagers.

Master the Elements & Seasons

Straw comes from wheat, and when the wild wheat runs out, you need to grow it on farms. Your wheat crops are at the mercy of the dynamic weather, the soil conditions and the rhythms of the seasons.

- Foraging to Farming : Start by gathering from the last wild wheat patches before becoming fully dependent on annual crop harvests.

- Terrain Suitability : Farm productivity depends on soil quality. Place your farms carefully to maximize yields.

- Dynamic Weather : Roving rain clouds water your farms, improving the crop yield.

Appease the Gods (or Suffer Their Wrath)

You cannot please everyone. Balance devotion across a pantheon of demanding deities: Life, Grain, Sky, and Fire.

- Divine Moods : Hold festivals, build temples, and offer sacrifices to maintain divine favor.

- Generous Gods : Generous gods grant blessings: increased rainfall, better soil fertility, or new technologies.

- Wrathful Gods : Neglected gods lash out with catastrophic plagues of locusts, diseases, giant predatory birds, lightning strikes, and fires.

Production and Trade

Reduce your dependence on fickle gods and unpredictable weather by diversifying your “strawconomy”.

- Temple Factories : Turn sacred spaces into primitive workshops. Assign workers to craft products like Textiles, Beer, and Spears.

- Trade Caravans : Establish a Market, send or receive traders, and trade with neighboring villages, but beware the hazards of the road.

Defend Your Harvest

While some adapt to the changing world by settlement and growth, others have chosen roaming and raiding. Maintain your independence by fighting off the raiders, or buy your peace by paying tribute.

Grow A City State

Every city state needs a patron god, who is their champion and their saviour. As your village grows, your choices will drive your people towards one god who will emerge as your champion.

- Patron God : Erect a massive temple to crown your chief god, transforming your humble village into a true city-state.

games.name: Buitopia DVD
games.shortDescription: It’s Jess’s Birthday! Explore a labyrinth of DVD menus to find her the perfect birthday gift. Just don’t get distracted. Play as a standalone PC game or burn it to DVD yourself! What could go wrong…?
games.aboutText:
It's Jess's Birthday

Make choices, solve puzzles and discover secrets as you explore the surreal world of Buitopia DVD.
A game about nostalgia, escapism and what lurks inside 'dead' physical media. Created by animator Ben Wheele.

Note: Press M or 'select button' to enter the main menu.
Here you can toggle Subtitles, Volume and Rumble.

Features

- Animated interactive fiction

- Short duration

- Original soundtrack

- Voice acting

- Light puzzle elements

- Various endings

- It's a nightmare, never ever put this in your DVD player

It's a DVD game...?

Yes this is actually a real DVD game! This digital edition makes it playable on PC, but this is still a DVD.
Expect lofi video, interlaced visuals and classic DVD-menu navigation.

As a bonus, the DVD file is also included; burn it to disc yourself for the full DVD experience! Enjoy the whirring, chugging sounds of your DVD player struggling through the menus.

It's been 20 Years

Originally started back in 2006... the project was abandoned and lost for many years... only to be re-discovered and now finally completed.

Physical Edition

The 'collectors' physical edition DVD is available to purchase separately, which includes a Steam key.

games.name: Buffet Simulator
games.shortDescription: Build your buffet empire! Grow your restaurant from the ground up and expand to become the biggest buffet by yourself or in co-op with up to 4 players. Handle the cooking, cleaning, customers, and staffing as you create the most expansive menu possible!
games.aboutText:
Build the Biggest Spread

Lead your local buffet from humble beginnings into an all-you-can-eat empire as you grow your business to cater to every culinary desire your clientele may have! With 60+ dishes across 5 distinct styles of food, it's your choice on what kind of restaurant to run. As long as it's endless, the customers will love it!

Handle the Rush Alone or With Friends

Handle customers on your own (or with up to 4 players) to make sure no one leaves hungry! Automate the daily grind with staff so you can focus on the important parts of running a business.

Make It Your Own

Set the layout to what fits your style the best. Just make sure to leave space for the customer to get more plates!

games.name: Full Belly Breakout
games.shortDescription: Navigate the hidden dangers lurking within a wide variety of dishes, savor every bite, fill your stomach, and escape from a terrifying cell. An overwhelming dining experience where eyeballs crawl out of plain rice, sharks burst from soup, and entire universes unfold upon your plate.
games.aboutText:
You’ve been captured.

Your only way out… is to eat.

Every dish placed before you hides a deadly secret.

Identify the danger, finish every bite, and escape.

Full Belly Breakout is a mystery-solving dining escape adventure.

FPS — First Person Supper

Experience immersive first-person gameplay that makes you feel like you’re truly eating.

Uncover the dangers hidden in your meals

There is always a safe way to eat.

Study each dish carefully, and muster the courage to take a bite.

And don’t forget your pre- and post-meal rituals.

A wide variety of dishes

A bizarre selection of meals from across time and cultures awaits you.

No picky eating allowed.

Unlikely allies

Companions who will aid in your escape.

Whether they’re parasites or not even human… don’t worry about it.

Multiple endings

Your eating habits will shape the outcome.

What awaits at the end of this strange escape…?

games.name: Farm Factory Simulator
games.shortDescription: Grow crops, automate production, and manage your own store. Turn fresh harvests into valuable products and create a wide range of goods. Optimize your workflow with efficient production chains and smart business decisions. Expand your facilities and build the fully automated farm-to-market business.
games.aboutText:
Start with a small plot of land and a handful of crops. Grow fresh produce, process them into valuable goods, automate your production lines, and stock your own store shelves. As your business expands, you'll unlock new technologies, optimize workflows, and transform a humble farm into a successful farm business.

🌱 Grow Your Farm

Plant and harvest a variety of crops across compact, highly efficient farming plots. Improve productivity with better tools, equipment, and farming techniques.

⚙️ Automate Production

Turn raw harvests into profitable products using automated machines and production lines. Design efficient workflows, reduce bottlenecks, and maximize output as your operation grows.

🛒 Run Your Own Store Automatically

Manage a charming farm shop where customers come to buy your products. Set prices, organize displays, keep shelves stocked, and expand your business to attract more shoppers.

📈 Optimize Your Business

Balance farming, manufacturing, and retail operations. Invest profits into automation, unlock upgrades, and continuously improve efficiency to build a successful business.

🧑‍🌾 Meet Special Visitors

As your farm grows, unique characters will come to visit. They will offer helpful guidance and special quests that support your progress, helping you unlock new opportunities and develop your farm further.

games.name: Theorycraft: Raiding Guild Simulator
games.shortDescription: Theorycraft is a single-player raiding guild simulator. Recruit raiders, tune gear and spell priorities, and command authentic MMO-style boss fights with encounter replays, win rate prediction, deep strategy, and rich combat data.
games.aboutText:
What if running a raiding guild was a single player game...

Theorycraft puts you in the raid leader chair and lets you play the full progression loop: recruit a roster, shape builds and policies, navigate social dynamics, and execute difficult encounters where every pull is an opportunity to learn and progress.

Theorycraft focuses on practical raid decision-making: who to recruit, how to gear, how to adjust individual's priorities, and whether your current plan is likely to work. Use encounter replays, combat logs, meters, threat tables, and a live win rate prediction to turn uncertainty into clear next steps.

Whether you prefer pausing to micro-manage key moments or letting the raiders play themselves, Theorycraft is built around one fantasy: the strategy, pressure, and stories of progression raiding without scheduling 40+ humans.

Note: Theorycraft is actively evolving. Expect regular updates, new encounters, UI polish, and quality-of-life improvements as core systems mature. See developer roadmap in-game.

Developed by a solo indie dev.

Key Features

- Raid Leader Sandbox: Build your party composition, define priorities, and pressure-test plans across distinct encounters and bosses.

- Hotseat Any Raider: Take direct control of individual raiders and manage their rotation and cooldowns.

- Win-Rate Prediction Analysis: Use win rate prediction alongside logs and meters to evaluate strategy changes before committing to the next pull.

- Rich Character Systems: Personalities, Social Stat Consequences, Class spellbooks, specializations, deep gear options, imbues, and policy tuning support different playstyles, compositions, and strategies.

- Guild Management Layer: Recruit, manage the raid roster, equip characters, trade, upgrade, and resolve progression bottlenecks between fights.

- Evolving Guild Hall: Progression unlocks new recruits and guild hall functionality, opening up new preparation, management, and optimization choices between encounters.

- Save/Load and Autosave: Persistent guild progression with robust save workflows for long-form campaigns. Save anytime.

- Readable Combat Intelligence: Raid frames, boss target panel, combat log, DPS/HPS meters, and threat panel keep the fight very legible.

- Encounter Replays: Replay and review pulls to analyze execution, compare strategy changes, and prepare smarter next attempts.

- Steam-Ready Integration: Achievements, Cloud Save Sync, Rich Presence support, and Steam Overlay.

games.name: Malignus
games.shortDescription: A dungeon colony sim where you play the dungeon itself: its Boss, its minions and the beasts in its caves. Dig out halls, wire deadly traps, and raid the world above for treasure. Then hold your hoard against the heroes who come to take it back. Play alone or in 2–4 player co-op.
games.aboutText:
You are the dungeon.

Inspired by Dungeon Keeper and RimWorld.

Your Boss rules from the throne. Your minions dig the halls, haul the loot and guard the prisoners, and they have opinions about all of it. Your caves fill with creatures to tame or eat. Raid the settlements above for treasure, then hold it against the adventurers who come to take it back.

Rule together. Build one shared dungeon in 2–4 player co-op.

- Carve out your dungeon. Dig through solid rock, shape rooms, and fill them with workshops, beds, thrones, altars and traps.

- Command six monster races. Goblins, kobolds, orcs, gnolls, bugbears and ogres each bring their own strengths.

- Manage a dungeon full of personalities. Dozens of traits, grumbles and breakdowns mean your minions won't always behave.

- Turn your halls into a deathtrap. Dart throwers, spinning blades, flamethrowers, gas, electric coils and webs. Wire them to pressure plates, tripwires, sensors, levers and timers.

- Hold what you stole. Invasions grow larger and deadlier, with 6 adventurer races, 10 classes and more than 40 traits.

- Keep plenty of prisoners. Chain up the survivors and interrogate them for secrets. Your minions expect a proper dungeon to have captives.

- Raid the world above. Send your minions across the overworld, command every raid in real time, and face a world that remembers what you did.

- Choose your Boss. Rule with one of four Boss monsters whose powers grow with your hoard.

- Practice the dark arts. Cast Pyromancy, Electromancy, Necromancy and Shadowmancy spells, perform rituals, and bargain with dark gods for boons.

- Tame what lurks below. More than 30 wild creatures live in the caves. Build one of nine lair types, tame them as pets, or hunt them for food.

- Keep the dungeon running. Feed your minions, give them beds, craft their gear, and keep order through disasters and tempers.

Make it your own. Steam Workshop support comes during Early Access.

THE ART OF MALIGNUS
The world of Malignus is brought to life through the artwork of @khem_.t , whose work gives our creatures, characters, and dungeons their distinctive visual identity.

Join us on Discord. Chat about the game, report bugs and talk with the developer.

games.name: 捉迷藏 - Hide and Seek
games.shortDescription: 长泽小学的一年级女生结奈，和青梅竹马的好朋友真也约好了一起玩捉迷藏。但是，最近他们的身边似乎出现了可疑的人物，街道的氛围也变得紧张了起来。即便如此，今天放学后也要去公园玩捉迷藏哦……
games.aboutText:
- 在青森公园寻找藏起来的好朋友，然后和他一起回家吧！

如果自己一个人睡不着的话，那就再聊一会天好了。

- 自己的生日就快到了，今年会收到什么样的礼物呢？

弄丢的小兔子和四叶草的挂饰，是不是再也找不到第二个了？

- 陌生的邻居向自己搭话了，要不要理会他呢……？

在某双黑暗中的眼睛的注视下，命运将在此导向不同的分歧……

黑羽 结奈：

长泽小学一年级的女生，文静乖巧，却有着不服输的个性。

百江 真也：

结奈的同班同学兼青梅竹马，有着动画英雄一般的正义感。

伊波 莲：

最近才搬来的邻居上班族，似乎在暗中关注着结奈。

- 制作&美术：黛惠

- CG绘制&立绘监修：星羽樱

- Logo：克拉格特

结局：1BE+1TE

时长：45min

操作：

Z/Enter 调查 & 确认

X/Esc 菜单 & 取消

↑↓←→ 行走 & 选择

↑↓←→+Shift 奔跑

游戏不支持鼠标操作

警示：游戏含有轻微的恐怖表现

games.name: Pygmalion and the Kingdom of Rot
games.shortDescription: A strategy game that blends side-scrolling defense, deckbuilding, and light roguelite progression. Choose from different playable characters, deploy buildings, traps, and tactical cards against zombie hordes attacking from multiple entrances, hold your ground, and push ever deeper underground.
games.aboutText:
Pygmalion and the Kingdom of Rot is a strategy game built around side-scrolling base defense, deckbuilding, and roguelite decision-making .

You must survive and defend yourself on a side-scrolling battlefield filled with height differences, slopes, ledges, pits, and buildable positions. Enemies attack from multiple directions and steadily push toward your core area. Your job is not simply to stand still and deal damage, but to quickly build, reinforce, and adapt your defenses based on the terrain, available resources, and the pressure of each incoming horde.

The core gameplay revolves around three main elements:

- First, choose your character.
The game is not built around a single fixed protagonist. Players can fight as different playable characters, with more characters planned for future expansion. Each character brings different combat options, pressure-handling tools, and deckbuilding directions.

- Second, play cards to build your defensive line.
Your main combat tools come from cards. Cards can be used to deploy buildings, place traps, use one-time tactical items, enhance weapons or defensive structures, or provide temporary status effects and resource cycling at critical moments. During each run, you need to gradually shape your deck into a system that can truly come online.

- Third, hold back wave after wave of zombie hordes.
Enemies do not attack from just one route. Different terrain layouts change how enemies approach and also change how you should defend. You need to decide where to place firepower, where to build obstacles, which areas should delay enemies, and which zones must be heavily defended. As the battle progresses, you must keep repairing your line, reallocating resources, and preparing for the next wave before the pressure overwhelms you.

- The game uses a light rogue lite progression structure.
After each survival round, you can gain new cards, upgrades, relics, or route choices, gradually improving your deck and combat system. You can lean into building suppression, trap-based control, burst tactics through items, or unique strategies built around a specific character. Every push deeper underground becomes a new deckbuilding process.

The focus of the game is not complex storytelling.
It is about using limited resources under escalating pressure to build a defensive system that actually works.

Key Features

- Side-scrolling defense meets deckbuilding
This is not a traditional tower defense game, nor is it a pure card game. You must play cards under real-time pressure to deploy defenses, reinforce your position, and respond tactically.

- Multiple playable characters
The game is not designed around one fixed protagonist. Different characters provide different combat experiences, and future updates can expand the game with more playstyle routes.

- Multiple entrances, varied terrain, multi-lane pressure
Enemies approach from several directions. Slopes, high ground, ledges, pits, and buildable areas all directly affect how you plan your defenses.

- Buildings, traps, upgrades, and items all shape your deck
You do not win by relying on a single type of turret. Buildings establish your defensive line, traps control and weaken enemies, items provide emergency burst power, and upgrades determine whether your build can truly come online.

- Light roguelite progression
Each run gives you new cards, upgrades, and relics, allowing you to form different build directions and improving replicability.

- Decision-making over raw numbers
What matters most is how you use terrain, resources, and your deck to organize a defensive line before the zombie hordes grow out of control.

games.name: Little Writer Desktop Companion
games.shortDescription: Your little companion is an ambitious writer with very little discipline. Type, and they'll write too. Every keystroke moves their work forward. In this productivity game, help them become a renowned author while you get things done.
games.aboutText:
Privacy Policy : What you type is not recorded and does not leave your device. Only save data is sent to the Steam cloud to provide synced saves across devices.

Your little companion is an ambitious writer with very little discipline. Type, and they'll write too. Every keystroke moves their work forward.

In this idle productivity game, help them become a renowned author while you get things done.

Give them a project suited to their skill level, keep them motivated, and help them finish their work to earn money.

Then, spend their hard-earned cash to develop their skills:

• Increase their typing speed to complete future projects faster.

• Improve their writing quality to boost sales.

• Expand their scope handling to unlock larger and more ambitious projects.

Finally, help them achieve their goals. You can also use their earnings to unlock new work locations and outfits.

games.name: Sellsword
games.shortDescription: Become a Sellsword in a magical kingdom. Take contracts from rival factions, battle for gold and reclaim territory in the name of mighty overlords. Forge your path through a living sandbox where no two journeys unfold alike, and every deed is etched into a growing book of legends.
games.aboutText:
FORGE YOUR PATH, A UNIQUE STORY EVERY RUN

Enter a vast fantasy world shaped by war, ambition, and shifting alliances. In Sellsword , you are not a chosen hero, but a mercenary forging your own path.

Choose your character, develop your build, and decide how you survive, fight, and earn your place in a world at war. Everything you do is recorded in your journal. Death can come often, but every life leaves behind a unique story.

A KINGDOM AT WAR

Explore an interconnected world divided between rival kingdoms and factions. Take contracts from lords, settlements, and powerful groups as you travel through dangerous territories.

Fight bandits, creatures, and enemy forces. Explore ruins, caves, and contested lands in search of wealth and opportunity.

PROCEDURAL QUESTS & MAIN STORY

Choose who to serve and complete different quests on every run. Your actions, choices, and encounters shape the story of your current character.

Follow the main story or create your own path through a world where no two lives unfold the same way.

KEY FEATURES

- Choose from different characters with unique playstyles

- Build your character around melee, ranged, or hybrid combat

- Explore a large interconnected world

- Take contracts from factions, lords, and settlements

- Fight bandits, creatures, and organized forces

- Navigate shifting alliances and rival factions

- Build your reputation through your actions

- Enjoy sandbox freedom combined with quest-driven progression

- Create a unique story with every run

games.name: Galaxy Scavengers
games.shortDescription: Mine, build, upgrade, and extract. Scavenge planets in a base-building resource management sim. Gather materials, construct facilities, and order units to survive in a hostile galaxy. Launch your base to the next zone before planetary threats overwhelm you.
games.aboutText:
Mine, build, upgrade, and extract. Scavenge planets in a base-building resource management sim. Gather materials, construct facilities, and order units to survive in a hostile galaxy. Launch your base to the next zone before planetary threats overwhelm you.

Mine, Process and Automate

Gather raw materials from the planet's surface and process them into high-tier resources through automated systems. Build efficient supply chains, research advanced technologies, and expand your base.

Manage the Base & Units

Maximize operational efficiency by assigning specialized tasks to your units. Balance power distribution between expanding structures and powering your workforce to keep production lines active.

Scale Up Production in Orbit

Unpredictable terrain and limited landing areas constrain ground expansion. Overcome space limitations by constructing modular factory platforms and launching them into orbit to optimize your base.

Expand with Caution

Every action you take generates Noise, which attracts hostile creatures. Balance expansion against survival, and launch your base to the next zone before you’re overwhelmed.

Upgrade & Unlock

Return to the Mothership between expeditions to unlock permanent skills. Upgrade your workforce, and reveal new planets. Uncover hidden secrets as you prepare for more deeper explorations.

games.name: Everfront
games.shortDescription: Lead a nation through a roguelike strategy campaign where borders grow continuously. Choose your path, unlock technology and push the front.
games.aboutText:
Lead a nation through a roguelike strategy campaign where borders grow continuously. Choose your path, unlock technology and push the front.

Click to Expand

The core verb in Everfront is clicking tiles to activate expansion. Click again to deactivate.

Concentrate forces

Your strength is dispersed along your active front line. Expanding in several tiles at the same comes at a penalty.

Terrain

There are various terrain modifiers in Everfront, such as Forest, Mountains, Lakes, Rivers, and Roads. In this example we see the different expansion rates between Plains, Forest and Mountains.

Upgrades

Everfront has hundreds of upgrades that change how you interact with the map. For example, the Encirclements Corps upgrade for the Blitz doctrine triggers rapid expansion along the boundary of activated tiles.

games.name: Far Mining
games.shortDescription: Far Mining is a short and relaxing incremental game about mining asteroids. Mine resources, upgrade your ship, unlock new tools, and find your way out of deep space.
games.aboutText:
Far Mining is a short and relaxing incremental game about mining asteroids. Mine resources, upgrade your ship, unlock new tools, and find your way out of deep space.

Mine Asteroids

The core mechanics of asteroid mining are simple and easy to learn. Your ship will automatically fire at nearby asteroids, and you just need to stay close to them.

Upgrades

Explore and upgrade the technology tree to increase your ship's power. Unlock new tools, upgrade existing ones, and don't leave those asteroids a chance.

Features

- Relaxing, repetitive gameplay

- Large upgrade tree

- A short and enjoyable experience (~2.5–3 hours of playtime)

games.name: Cats In The Shell
games.shortDescription: Provoke explosive chain reactions and experiment ever-evolving combat strategies in this mech-building roguelike auto battler. Mix and match components and mech modules to discover powerful synergies, then watch each creation spring to life in satisfying combat sequences.
games.aboutText:
Cats in the Shell is a build-crafting roguelike auto-battler centered around mech assembly. Recruit feline pilots, each with their own abilities and strategic focuses, then construct a custom battle machine from a robust arsenal of parts and upgradable modules. Pair different components to create specialized builds that will lead to a wide array of combat strategies. Unlock distinct progression paths by synergizing different parts and archetypes. Adapt to random events, limited resources, and formidable enemies while constantly refining the mecha’s loadout. Put each configuration to the test in automated battles, and experience the satisfaction of watching epic chain reactions, satisfying synergies, and strong upgrades snowball into the unstoppable war machines.

Assemble battle machines by selecting and equipping new parts throughout each run. Combine mech components and enhancement modules to create distinctive builds, unlock powerful synergies, and continuously strengthen the machine during and between battles.

Mix and match a vast selection of parts, modules, and archetypes to discover countless possibilities. Strategically adapt to random events and shop offerings, as each decision will shape the outcome of the run. Every playthrough delivers a fresh mech assembly experience.

Watch every design choice come to life in spectacular automated battles. Put each build to the test through explosive clashes of steel and firepower, then witness increasingly powerful machines unleash devastating chain reactions as the run progresses.

Challenge battle machines assembled by other players around the world without the pressure of real-time matchmaking. Test builds against the creations of other pilots, overcome new strategic challenges, and discover fresh ideas for future runs.

games.name: Hachishakusama | 八尺様がいた夏休み
games.shortDescription: 『She Is Always Right Beside You』 The fate of one summer — a boy beloved by the eight-feet-tall Hachishakusama, the urban legend. A heartwarming yet terrifying Japanese horror game.
games.aboutText:
"She Is Always Right Beside You"
Due to his father’s circumstances, a young boy, Saku, finds himself visiting the rural village of Kibuse with him.

There, he ended up captivating a mysterious Ghost that dwells in the land—Hachishakusama, the eight-feet-tall urban legend.
From that moment on, his summer begins to change.

She is always by his side, never leaving.

Is it fear… or something else?

Trapped in days with no escape, what choice will the boy make?

This is a heartwarming yet terrifying Japanese horror game.

《 Controls 》

- WASD – Move

- E – Interact

- Tab – View Tasks

- ESC – Settings

- Mouse – Camera / Look

- Left Click – Advance Text

《 The Adventure 》

Left behind in the village after his father departs, promising to return for him later, a young boy named Saku finds himself all alone. As he completes errands for his grandfather and interacts with a girl he meets there, the gears of fate begin to turn.

《 A Peaceful Countryside 》

Experience a story set within a soothing atmosphere, featuring scenery that shifts with the passing of time and the gentle sounds of nature.

《 Escape 》

Hachishakusama loves to play. Hide from her sight, run for your life, and find a way to outsmart her to survive the encounter.

《 Streaming & Content Creation 》

Game captures and live streams are more than welcome!
If you enjoy the game, we would be incredibly grateful if you could include the URL to this page in your video description.

games.name: a weird game about sausage
games.shortDescription: This is a clicker game about a sausage.
games.aboutText:
A 3D tribute to my favorite game, Bacon – The Game.

Sausage on Everything

Just click the left mouse button.

Click the left mouse button to toss the sausage into the air. Leave the rest to Newton and this elastic meat product.

While the controls are incredibly simple, some levels can be quite... challenging :)

games.name: KAELIS: Seraph Protocol
games.shortDescription: Become an Executor of Serenos Academy in KAELIS, an academy sci-fantasy JRPG where you investigate Noise incidents, fight turn-based Lumina battles, and build bonds with the Guardians who stand beside you.
games.aboutText:
KAELIS is an academy sci-fantasy JRPG that combines the character attachment and relationship-driven appeal of subculture games with the deep narrative immersion of a single-player JRPG.

The name Kaelis is inspired by the Latin caelum — “sky” or “heaven” — and caelis, evoking the celestial realm.

Players take on the role of Kaito, a citizen of Kaelis who becomes an Executor of Serenos Academy.
With his academy companions, he investigates Noise incidents, and his choices, field decisions, and enforcement actions shape his relationships and the flow of each case.

Two hundred years ago, the world was swallowed by the flames of war, and everything turned to ash.

There, beneath the ashes, humanity found a small and faint glow—a light they named "Lumina."

Drawing close to that light, they built their last city: Kaelis. A city filled with Lumina, peaceful and beautiful even now.

And yet, behind all that order, the light would sometimes waver, ever so faintly— a distortion no one could explain, the thing people came to call "Noise."

Shirakawa Kaito was an utterly ordinary boy, one who had always kept the necklace his father left him close to his heart—until, from one day on, the city itself stopped recognizing him as an "ordinary citizen."

Caught up in that strange change, Kaito finds himself stepping onto the field as an 〈Executor〉 of Serenos Academy, the body that handles the city's Noise.

Together with the Academy's own Guardians, he sets out toward a truth about this city that no one yet knows—

and now, the story begins to move.

Meet Your Guardians.

As Kaito’s journey through Kaelis unfolds, he will meet new Guardians who become companions in his fight against the Noise.

Each Guardian belongs to one of Serenos Academy’s specialized divisions, carries their own Lumina attributes, and brings a different role to the party.
