Build affinity with your companions through the story, conversations, and time spent together at Serenos Academy.

As your bonds deepen, new sides of each Guardian begin to emerge, and the way they fight alongside Kaito may change through coordinated attacks, support actions, and party synergy.

Fight alongside the Guardians of Serenos Academy in turn-based battles with up to four active party members.

Every Guardian and every Noise is shaped by one of eight Lumina Spectrums: Ignis, Glacies, Fulgur, Terra, Lumina, Umbra, Void, and Aether.

Each Spectrum has its own strengths, weaknesses, and reactions. Observe how the Noise responds to your attacks, identify its Spectrum, and bring the right Guardians to the front.

As Kaito’s bonds with his companions deepen, coordinated attacks can be unlocked, opening new ways for the team to act together in battle.

As an Executor, Kaito can activate the Executor Device to seal and recover Noise Cores from the field.

Recovered Cores can be brought back to Serenos Academy, where they are analyzed and used to support Lumina Disc development, facility upgrades, and Guardian growth.

Kaito’s choices, bonds, and discoveries can leave traces on each case, shaping the path an incident takes before its outcome is decided.

- The Armillary Sphere

At decisive moments, the Armillary Sphere turns, and fate is cast through a roll of the dice.

Kaito’s bonds, discoveries, and field decisions can shift the conditions of that roll, influencing how an incident unfolds.

- Choices and Field Decisions

In conversations and quieter moments, choose how Kaito responds. His words can strengthen bonds, change the tone of a scene, and reveal different sides of the people around him.

Noise is a distortion born from Lumina — a sign that something within Kaelis has begun to change.

Follow each case with the Guardians of Serenos Academy, gather clues, and enter unstable fields where Noise takes form.

As Kaito investigates these incidents, he and his companions are drawn deeper into the emotions, choices, and conflicts shaping the city.

At the heart of Kaelis stands Serenos Academy, the central base for investigating Noise incidents and responding to Lumina distortion across the city.

As an Executor of Serenos Academy, Kaito receives missions, reviews case information, enters unstable fields, and leads the Guardians through Noise encounters.

The Academy is divided into four specialized divisions:

Strike — Field operations, direct engagement, and combat response.

Record — Noise data, case evidence, and abnormal field analysis.

Harmony — Resonance stability, team coordination, and operational support.

Veritas — Lumina research, tuning technologies, and the hidden principles behind each incident.

Between missions, spend time with your companions, strengthen your bonds, analyze and refine recovered Noise Cores, develop Lumina Discs, and upgrade Academy facilities to support Guardian training, research, and ability growth before heading back into the field.

Within Kaelis, Lumina appears as eight distinct Spectrums. Each Guardian resonates with up to two of them, s

games.name: Babel Legacy
games.shortDescription: An idle game where you gather resources and grow your city. Sit back and watch your city expand!
games.aboutText:
An idle game where you gather resources and grow your city. Sit back and watch your city expand! Mine ores to gather the resources needed for construction.

Develop your civilization using the legacy left behind by the city.

Forge your own city-building strategy.

Grow your city.

Build a wonder.

Collect legacies to complete an immortal civilization.

games.name: While 1
games.shortDescription: Don't touch the walls. While 1 is a minimalist mouse-only action game centered around this simple concept. Create a loop around the level while avoiding obstacles synchronized to the music.
games.aboutText:
Don't touch the walls. While 1 is a minimalist mouse-only action game centered around this simple concept. Create a loop around the level while avoiding obstacles synchronized to the music.

- One rule: don't touch the walls.

- Create a loop around the level. If you touch any of the walls, you must start over.

- Inspired by games in the Flash-era, While 1 recreates the satisfaction of this genre of gameplay as a complete experience.

- Designed to be played entirely with a mouse, the game tests your precision and coordination.

- Some levels will require quick movements and careful timing to overcome.

- Particles are collectibles that appear throughout some levels.

- All particles must be collected before finishing the loop.

- If you hit a wall, the level can be restarted instantly by just returning to the start point, making attempts feel riskless.

- Each song will have 2 levels sets: Normal & Expert.

- Enjoy the music in Normal mode for a more casual experience, or take on the Expert levels for an even greater challenge.

games.name: Impermanence
games.shortDescription: A father. A condemned theatre. A son’s voice from beyond. Step into a narrative horror game about grief, obsession, and refusing to let go as a force older than love pushes back.
games.aboutText:
The Orpheum Theatre should have stayed abandoned.

Instead, you return night after night.

Carrying boxes of toys, photographs, trophies, drawings.

Fragments of a life.

You're not here to remember your son.

You're here to bring him back.

Rebuild what you remember.

Jumping off the bed.

Giggles coming from inside the closet.

Give him a place to come back to.

Find the frequency.

You turn up the volume.

Sweep the frequencies.

What was once fleeting can be captured.

Forced into structure.

And then—

you hear his voice.

But something is fighting back.

The theatre changes.

Objects shift.

Memories decay.

Your work is being undone.

Some things cannot be brought back.

But you promised you'd fix it.

So you keep going.

Further than you should.

Further than anyone should.

Impermanence is a first-person psychological horror experience about grief, obsession, and refusing to let go.

No weapons.

No monsters waiting in the dark.

Only the slow realization that the universe is trying to correct what you've done.

games.name: Exodrift
games.shortDescription: Exodrift is a rhythm action roguelite where you are a space delivery driver on the run. Deliver packages, destroy enemies on the beat, and escape hazardous procedurally generated planets.
games.aboutText:
Exodrift is a rhythm action roguelite where you are a space delivery driver on the run. Deliver packages, destroy enemies on the beat, and escape hazardous procedurally generated planets.

HIT ENEMIES TO THE BEAT OF THE SYNTH

Gain extra damage by hitting enemies with the beat of the song. Each song is a hardcore synthwave track.

DELIVER THE PACKAGES AT ALL COSTS

Deliver packages to gain gems: this galaxy's currency for all your gun-running needs.

UPGRADE YOURSELF

Buy perks to upgrade yourself each run. Perks can be offensive or defensive.

USE YOUR ABILITIES

Use one of the several abilities to your advantage, including boost, slow-mo, shields, and more.

FIGHT DANGEROUS BOSSES

You must trigger a boss in order to escape the planet. These mechs won't go down easy.

AVOID HAZARDOUS CONDITIONS

Stay on a planet too long and the weather will start working against you. Don't forget your umbrella.

games.name: Gathera
games.shortDescription: Gather, craft, build and explore alone or with up to 3 friends. Unlock new land, collect resources, build and decorate your home, farm, fish, automate production, upgrade your character, and defend against optional enemy raids.
games.aboutText:
Gathera is a cozy crafting and survival sandbox for 1–4 players about gathering resources, building a home, and slowly unlocking more of the world around you.

Start small. Gather what you can find, craft your first tools and structures, and use them to reach new resources, recipes, technologies, and pieces of land. The more you discover, the more things you can build — and the more ways you have to make gathering easier.

Play alone or invite up to 3 friends and build your world together. You can focus on collecting and decorating, farming and fishing, exploring, automation, combat, or a mixture of everything.

Gather, Craft & Explore

Wood, stone, plants, ores, food, fish and plenty of stranger things are scattered around the world.

Gather resources, turn them into useful tools and materials, unlock new recipes, and open new parts of the world to find even more things to work with.

Build a Place of Your Own

Build wherever you want and turn an empty piece of land into a home.

Make a practical workshop, a cozy house, a storage-filled mess that only you understand, or spend far too much time making every corner look nice. Furniture, decorations, collections and useful structures can all become part of your base.

Play Alone or With Friends

Everything can be played solo or together in online co-op for up to 4 players.

Explore in different directions, gather resources together, share a base, work on different projects, or collectively spend twenty minutes deciding where a chest should go.

Farm, Fish & Collect

Not everything has to be about rushing toward the next upgrade.

Grow crops, gather food, go fishing, collect useful and unusual items, and improve your little corner of the world at your own pace.

Build Production & Automation

As your world grows, doing everything by hand starts to become a lot of work.

Process resources, build machines, connect production together, and unlock technologies that can handle some of that work for you. What starts as a few crafting stations can eventually become a much larger production setup.

Grow Stronger

Unlock upgrades and improve your character as you play. Increase things like movement speed, health, damage, inventory space and other useful stats that make exploring, gathering and fighting easier.

Better tools, equipment and technologies will also give you more ways to deal with the world around you.

Defend Your Home if you want

If you want some danger in your world, enemy raids can put your equipment and defences to the test.

Prepare your base, improve your gear, fight back and collect additional rewards from the enemies that attack you.

And if that isn't the kind of game you want to play, raids are optional. Turn them off and keep things peaceful.

Make the World Yours

There isn't one correct way to play Gathera.

Build something efficient. Build something pretty. Collect everything you come across. Automate half the island. Go fishing instead of doing any of that. Bring a few friends and somehow make an even bigger mess.

Gather what you find, make something useful out of it, and see where it takes you next.

games.name: GloveUp!
games.shortDescription: GloveUp! is a singleplayer anime-themed female boxing game featuring realistic and physics-driven animations. Create and customize a roster of fighters, shape unique fighting styles through abilities, unlock outfits, level up and take on tougher opponents and challenges.
games.aboutText:
Supports Gamepad (Xbox controller Recommended, PS 4/5 controller with Steam Input)
Supports Keyboard/Mouse

Enter the ring in a physics-based anime boxing game built around fast decision-making, player expression, and satisfying knockouts.

Create your own boxers, develop your fighting styles, and take on opponents of all shapes, sizes, and difficulties. Level up, learn new abilities, unlock stylish attire, and build fighters that play exactly the way you want.

CHOOSE YOUR GAME MODE

Enhanced
Experience GloveUp! as intended. Level up your boxer, unlock powerful new abilities, and build a fighting style that evolves as you progress. Mix traditional boxing with unique skills that can turn the momentum of a fight.

Realism
Prefer to keep things grounded? Realism Mode keeps the same leveling and stat system, but removes abilities from combat. Win through timing, movement, defense, stamina management, and clean punches—no special abilities, just you and your opponent.

CREATE YOUR BOXER

Build the fighter you want to bring into the ring. GloveUp! features a deep character customization system that lets you create a boxer that truly feels like your own.

- Face — Customize your fighter’s face, eyes, irises, eyeliner, eyebrows, and more to create the look you want

- Hair — Find the hairstyle that fits your fighter. Every hairstyle has its own unique look, with customizable color sections for even more variety

- Body — Short, average, or tall? Fast, powerful, or durable? Shape your fighter’s build and attributes to match your preferred fighting style

- Clothing — Mix and match shoes, socks, shorts, headbands, dresses, tattoos, and more to create a look that stands out in the ring

-

LEVEL UP - STATS - ABILITIES

Earn Stats as you level up and distribute them however you like. Whether you want to be a hard-hitting knockout artist, a lightning-fast counterpuncher, or an unstoppable endurance fighter, the choice is yours.

Unlock powerful Abilities as you progress, giving you the edge when you need it most. Whether you're looking to overwhelm your opponent, survive a brutal exchange, or stage an incredible comeback, the right abilities can turn the tide of any fight.

STEP INTO THE RING

Duck, punch, weave, counter, and clinch your way through every fight. Read your opponent, learn their habits, and discover what works against different opponents. Control the pace, pick your openings, and knock your opponent out!

UNQIUE VENUES

Immerse yourself in the fantasy world that is GloveUp! From floating fruits in the sky to a relaxing 5 star cruise ship, bring the fight whereever you go!

games.name: SuperReap
games.shortDescription: Super Reap is a cozy active incremental harvesting game where you swing your scythe through wildly overgrown crops, sell resources for coins, unlock talents, skill cards, gear, and new harvesting methods, and transform a rundown farm into an efficient reaping paradise.
games.aboutText:
Super Reap is a wildly satisfying, hands-on incremental harvesting game. Cut through fields of overgrown plants, enjoy the satisfying impact of every swing, and transform a battered old scythe into an unstoppable harvesting machine.

Featuring:

- 🌾 Satisfying harvesting across fields of diverse crops

- 🌳 A massive skill tree that takes your harvesting power to new heights

- 🎴 Exciting talent card draws and build-defining combinations

- 🐔 Restore a neglected farmyard, plant crops, and reap the rewards

- 🦊 Befriend charming animals and unlock new tools, weapons, and items

- 🎨 Warm and nostalgic pixel art

Wildly satisfying, stress-relieving crop harvesting

Pick One of Three and Shape Your Build

Choose one of three talent cards with every draw. Powerful talents can dramatically increase your harvesting abilities, while different combinations allow you to create a build of your own.

A Skill Tree That Literally Grows

Increase the number of crops in each field, unlock new crop varieties, improve your tools, and discover new weapons, items, and friends as the skill tree continues to grow.

Every Crop Remains Valuable

Different crops form an interconnected resource system, so even the most basic plants remain useful throughout the game. Trade your harvest for coins, then spend them on new weapons, equipment, and useful items.

A Peaceful Farm That Keeps Producing

Restore your farmyard and plant crops of your own. The farm continues producing resources while you take a break, giving you plenty to harvest when you return.

games.name: Sheepscape
games.shortDescription: Sheepscape is a cozy, focused sheep-farming sim. Send your dog to round up the flock, shear them in a hands-on minigame, then sell the wool and breed a finer flock season after season. It's the whole craft of shepherding: from your first muddy field to the open hills.
games.aboutText:
You, one dog, and a field full of sheep.

Sheepscape is a small, focused farming sim that pours all of its care into one thing: a flock of sheep, and the craft of raising them well. Take a handful of muddy ewes and build them into a prize-winning herd, one season at a time: a complete, satisfying loop you can see all the way through.

- Herd a real, flowing flock with a faithful Border Collie.

- Shear every sheep yourself in a satisfying, hands-on minigame.

- Sell the wool and breed a better flock, generation after generation.

- Watch the seasons turn and your farm quietly come to life.

Work the dog

Your flock won't pen itself. Walk your shepherd to the kennel, send the dog out, and watch the sheep break and flow. Read the herd, push from the right angle, and funnel them through the gate into the pen. As your farm grows, run more than one dog and sandwich the flock between them.

Shear them yourself

Get a wool-heavy ewe into the shed and the clippers come out. Shearing is a hands-on minigame: clip the fleece, watch it peel away in a cloud of dust, and chase a clean, high-grade cut. The finer the animal and the tidier your work, the more your wool is worth at market.

Build a better flock

Sell your wool, then put the money to work. Buy fresh stock at the livestock market, or breed your own; in autumn the rams go to work, and come spring the lambs arrive, trailing their mothers across the field. Nine breeds to raise, from classic Suffolks and piebald Jacobs to Herdwicks on the high fells, each with its own look and temperament. As the flock grows, the grind doesn't; shear them yourself when you want the craft, or let the shed and the troughs tick over so you can focus on the herd.

One thing, done well

All the depth of a working hill farm: herding, husbandry, wool, and the economy that ties them together, in a clean, minimalist top-down style. A complete, satisfying loop you can settle into for an evening, and truly master over a few.

From one field to the open hills

Start with five sheep on a Welsh smallholding and work your way north across four farms: Home Farm, Hill Farm and finally Borders Pasture. Each farm takes a chore off your hands, with piped water, hired shepherds and more dogs, and asks something new of you in return. Grow your flock to a hundred sheep to finish the game, then keep farming as long as you like.

Music

Sheepscape is scored by some brilliant folk bands. Please give them a listen:

- Breabach : "Knees Up" and "Prince's Strand". Find them on Bandcamp and Spotify.

- The Magpies : "Marigold's" and "Shuffle Set". Find them on Bandcamp and Spotify.

- The Trials of Cato : "Libanus" and "Difyrrwch", courtesy of Wipe Out Music. Find them on Spotify.

Sheepscape is made by a solo dev. Thank you for playing, and if you enjoy it, a review really helps.

games.name: Seaside Wash
games.shortDescription: Seaside Wash is a cozy job simulator where you clean, repair, and restore ships from rust and barnacles to pristine condition. Upgrade tools, grow your business, discover rare finds, build your own ship, and enjoy peaceful seaside activities.
games.aboutText:
Seaside Wash pairs immersive cleaning sounds with a soothing soundtrack to create a tranquil and engaging experience . Every job delivers a satisfying sense of progress as rusty, worn ships slowly return to pristine condition.

Different surfaces and dirt require different tools. Pick wisely for maximum efficiency as each cleaning task demands the right equipment, and approach to achieve the best results.

Improve your efficiency by upgrading and repairing your tools to handle tougher and more rewarding jobs. Unlock better tools and refine your approach as restoration tasks become more demanding

Work on a variety of vessels , from small fishing boats to massive cargo freighters. Each ship features its own structure, scale, and cleaning challenges waiting to be restored.

Clean every part of the ship , from the hull and bow to the mast, deck, and interior spaces. Explore detailed work areas filled with grime, hidden spots, and satisfying restoration opportunities.

Tackle layers of salt , rust , and stubborn barnacles that require different cleaning strategies. Learn how each type of grime behaves and choose the best method to remove it effectively.

Take on jobs at your own pace, choosing tasks that fit your tools, your strategy, and your time. Progress freely through a variety of tasks while building your reputation and improving your workshop.

Between jobs, unwind with relaxing mini games like fishing and cooking at your cozy seaside home. Enjoy peaceful seaside moments that offer a refreshing break from your daily restoration work.

FEATURES

🛥️ Restore a variety of ships across immersive and detailed work environments

🧰 Use specialized tools and workshop systems to handle challenging restoration tasks

🔧 Upgrade and expand your workspace through rewarding progression mechanics

🏠 Work across multi-level indoor and outdoor seaside areas

🌤️ Experience dynamic weather, day–night cycles, and relaxing seaside events

Get ready, and don’t forget to join our Discord to stay updated with the latest news and updates for Seaside Wash!

games.name: Apology Video
games.shortDescription: An FMV Choose-Your-Own-Adventure that'll leave you wanting to like and subscribe!
games.aboutText:
Uh oh! Everyone's favorite content creator, Joey Clicks, is in hot water! How's he gonna get out of this one?

Looks like it's time for an...

This is a choose-your-own FMV game where you'll make the best (or worst) influencer apology you can muster! With 14 possible endings that'll leave you wanting to like and subscribe!

This is my first time making a game like this, so lemme know what you guys think! It was a lot of fun to put together, and I hope you enjoy it!

- Ethan

games.name: Hakimi's Ocean Drift
games.shortDescription: A survival shooter game set at sea, where players must gather supplies, locate hidden shelters, and build rafts to survive. On the ocean surface, you'll need to fish with a rod, diligently collect drifting supplies with hooks, construct rafts, and grow food to stay alive.
games.aboutText: In the future, the sea will submerge the world, and you can only survive on a raft. You need to fish with a fishing rod, use hooks to collect materials floating from the sea, and build rafts. At the same time, search for clues at sea, obtain shelter maps, break into shelters, obtain more blueprints, unlock props, collect supplies, and strive to survive. The monsters in the shelter all have weapons, and you need to modify them to fight against them. The battle belongs to a fast-paced top-down shooting game.

games.name: Cielle is Not Happy
games.shortDescription: Cielle is Not Happy is a psychological horror RPG in which you play as a girl named Cielle, who encounters erratic events throughout her journey, leading her to uncover cryptic secrets about herself and the world around her.
games.aboutText:
Tales of Judgement

A sick girl lives in a world beyond meaning, seeing things no one else can. To encounter Judge Nothing, she must converse with its people, decipher its mysteries, and do the work of the Archons, while monsters from the House of Eyes begin to emerge.

Control your emotions. Face your trauma, depression, and stress. Fall in love. And uncover the truth about yourself and the world you live in.

A World of Deceit

Live in a world consumed by corruption, political deception, and economic manipulation and carve your way through the corruption to reach your ultimate goal.

The Hungry Eyes

Chain of Eyes allows you to land heavy attacks with a moderate chance. Logic is used to analyze enemies, thoughts, and weaknesses, while Concentrate increases the power of your attacks and abilities. Fight them, and watch your eyes carefully, for they are desperately needed.

The Lives We Carry

Talk to each character and learn about their lives. Then, delve into your own mind and life, confronting your inner struggles and hardships.

A Story, Written by Dana Khedri or The Great Pineapple (Tegep)

Dana Khedri (The Great Pineapple) is the writer of this game's story.

It's Always Legacy First.

games.name: Gunk
games.shortDescription: Gunk is an endless rouge-lite wave survival game. Fight off hordes of enemies and level up your skills to increase your chance of survival, and save the world from the Gunk invasion. Their only weakness is rocks, and you are the last hope for humanity. Can you save us all?
games.aboutText:
The world has been overrun. They are coming for everything you love, your mother, your father, your children, but most importantly they're coming for you. Their only weakness is rocks, and you are the last hope for humanity. Can you save us all?

In the world of gunk, the only thing between you and total annihilation, is sheer determination, and lots of rocks. From the creator of Gunk, comes Gunk. A total reimagining of the hit Gunk type game, Gunk.

Gunk has everything you know and love from Gunk, including Gunk. But Gunk also has even more, including more Gunks, such as the Short Gunk, and Crawling Gunk.

SAVE THE WORLD

Gunk is an endless rouge-lite wave survival game. Fight off hordes of enemies and level up your skills to increase your chance of survival, and save the world from the Gunk invasion.

LEVEL UP YOUR SKILLS

Gain experience to level up, upgrade your skills, and become more powerful. With more than FIVE unique skills to upgrade.

They are coming. You are our last hope. Save us all.

games.name: Dead Sector
games.shortDescription: Run your own data center. Design server boards component by component and use your boards space wisely. Wire power and network throughout your floor to form specialized clusters, and dispatch contracts to your custom hardware. Scale from a single rack to a massive redundant, multi-cluster operation.
games.aboutText:
One empty floor. One client. Build it into the backbone of the cloud

You begin with a bare room and a single server you assembled by hand. Grow it into a sprawling enterprise data center: rows of hundreds of racks, redundant power and networking, massive storage fabric, and a steady stream of clients pushing heavy workloads across hardware you designed yourself every day.

Design your own servers

You do not buy servers off a shelf. You build them.

- Choose every piece of hardware and where it goes: processors, memory, storage drives, network cards, GPUs, and enterprise AI accelerators, each with its own cost, performance, and power draw.

- Build the right server for the work. A server tuned for log processing is wasted money on an AI training run.

- Unlock new chassis, board form factors, appliances and more as you grow, from compact single socket nodes to dense intertwined GPU, CPU and storage clusters.

Build out the facility

A great server is nothing without the room around it, and this is where the real engineering begins.

- Lay out your floor rack by rack and slot your servers into place.

- Feed them power through UPS units and distribution panels, but mind your circuits, because a single overloaded run can make an entire aisle of servers go dark.

- Stitch it all together using network appliances and cables, storage fabrics and more to form the networks and clusters each workload demands.

Sign clients. Deliver uptime

Customers arrive with real workloads: web hosting, video rendering, cold storage, financial trading, cloud gaming, and more. Take on what your hardware can actually deliver, place it on the right server, and collect the revenue. Staying online is the hard part.

- Hardware wears out and fails. Storage drives die, and the RAID level you chose decides whether that is a minor event or a data loss disaster.

- Fall behind on the power bill and the utility starts cutting your supply.

- Hire technicians to repair and maintain the floor once it grows beyond what you can manage on your own.

Hyperscale

- Tie dozens of racks together into a single compute cluster for specialized and lucrative high performance workloads requiring thousands of CPU cores.

- Stand up GPU clusters for AI training and inference, the workloads everyone is racing to host.

- Pool storage across racks into massive petabyte sized pools. Don't forget to protect yourself by configuring your drive arrays properly and setting up replication mirrors for redundancy.

- Your job as the datacenter architect is to balance system load, uptime, cost, and resiliency to keep your clients happy.

Run it your way

A limited research budget and four specialization paths (Compute, Storage, AI, and Operations) mean every facility you build turns out different. Go all in on raw compute, become a storage provider, chase the AI boom, or squeeze every watt and every dollar with operational efficiency.

Built for the IT minded

If you have ever racked a server, argued about RAID levels, or run a home lab just because you could, this one is for you. Name your servers, query your fleet, and fire off batch commands from the built in terminal CLI if you are an experienced tech. It is the data center you always wanted to run, without the noise, the heat, or the power bill.

Features

- Build servers part by part, balancing performance, power, and cost

- Plan a real facility: power, networking, cooling, and structured cabling

- Manage system configurations in detail to create complex clusters and networks

- Dozens of client workloads, from quick batch jobs to long term tenants paying daily

- A living simulation of hardware faults, drive failures, power crises, and repairs

- Compute clusters, GPU and AI systems, and multi rack storage at the high end

- Four specialization paths that reshape how your facility grows

- 100 operator ranks of new hardware and capabilities

- An optional command line terminal for power users

- Single player, played at your own pace

Wishlist Dead Sector and start planning your floor.

games.name: Sinheritance
games.shortDescription: Sinheritance is a terrifying and mind-bending puzzle game. Explore every corner in an intensely oppressive atmosphere to piece together a chilling story. Every step must be taken with caution, for the deepest fears often stem from your own choices and your gradually crumbling sanity.
games.aboutText:
Do you believe in curses?

An invitation from the Ignis Hotel shatters Allen's peace...

Behind every door lies a completely different world...

A puppet singing theater lullabies,

Scattered limbs in a circus,

A human-shaped ice sculpture splattered with paint in the snow-covered forest...

Countless fragmented cases are piecing together a shocking conspiracy connected to Allen!

The game boasts a complete and logically sound storyline, divided into six interconnected and progressively unfolding chapters. Each chapter is intricately plotted, with foreshadowing and unexpected twists that gradually propel the main story forward. From a fog-shrouded beginning to a complex web of clues and intricate plot developments, the game ultimately unveils the ultimate truth, maintaining a fast-paced and engaging narrative. A complete playthrough takes approximately 12 hours. Each chapter features its own unique world, core puzzles, and subplots, with a well-balanced difficulty level that caters to both casual players seeking an immersive cinematic experience and hardcore puzzle enthusiasts seeking deductive reasoning.

The game utilizes a unique American oil painting style to create cinematic, immersive environments, crafting a mysterious, oppressive, and atmospheric suspense world. The retro, dark color palette, the hand-drawn details concealing clues, and the atmosphere perfectly complementing the plot's twists and turns ensure that every exploration is filled with the unknown and mystery. This game abandons meaningless filler puzzles; all mechanism solving, clue gathering, and logical reasoning are deeply integrated with the main storyline. Players must piece together fragmented clues, solve scene-specific mechanisms, and gradually peel back layers of fog to uncover the lies and secrets hidden beneath the surface.

A journey to uncover the truth, exclusively for you, has begun. Through repeated interactions with the scenes, you await to unravel the long-forgotten mysteries of time and space...

games.name: FD's Industry Tycoon
games.shortDescription: Build a global industrial empire from a 1990s desktop. A retro business management sim, hand-drawn in pixel art. Alone or in MP: open factories worldwide, broker supply deals across continents, and acquire rivals when they falter. Markets shift, empires grow, and the CRT flickers.
games.aboutText:
Build a Global Empire from a 1990s Desktop!

The CRT flickers. The modem chirps. The fax machine hums. Across 100+ rival companies and dozens of global cities, your industrial empire is waiting to be built.

FD's Industry Tycoon is a business management sim inside a 1990s desktop. Build factories, turn materials into goods, ship across continents, and buy out rivals who fall behind, through the windows of a vintage OS, scanlines and all.

The World Is Your Supply Chain

Source ore on one continent, refine it on another, sell it on a third. Own every link, or buy from whoever's cheapest.

- More than 250 products run through a six-stage chain, from raw crops, timber, and ore to packaged food, clothing, electronics, and household goods. Specialize in a single rung, or own every step from the soil to the shelf.

- Cities differ: Mumbai's tropical climate and cheap labor reward industries that wealthy, temperate New York won't.

- Buy land in a city's pricey core or cheap outskirts, raise a small building, and upgrade it as demand grows.

100+ Rivals, Each With Their Own Playbook

The market never sits still. One rival bets everything on quality, another wins on rock-bottom prices, a predator grows only by swallowing weaker firms while a cautious one hoards cash for the crash. Some run a chain of stores, some forge goods for everyone else, some own it all from field to storefront.

- Stock a rival's shelves for a cut, or choke their supply and watch it run dry. Every deal is yours to make or break.

- Watch the books. When a rival weakens, buy their stock and absorb the company, factories, research, and brand.

- Grow from the ground up or grow by takeover — the biggest empires do both.

A Desk That Feels Like the 90s

You don't run this empire through sleek modern dashboards, but the way they did back then: clicking through stacked windows, skimming the morning's headlines, pulling up a far-off city on a monitor that flickers the longer you stare.

- Hundreds of hand-drawn pixel-art assets, every building, all 250-plus products, and each company's logo.

- Every new game reshuffles the board: a different spread of cities, resources buried in new corners, rivals dug in where you least expect, and a fresh tangle of who owns whom.

- A full CRT shader: scanlines, screen curve, color bleed, and vignette wrap the whole screen.

- Kkooni, your office dog, naps through every boom and bust.

Boot up. Build your empire.

games.name: Touhou Defense Tale ~ AI Test in Touhou ~
games.shortDescription: A 2D Touhou fan game combining tower defense, tower merging, RTS-style control, and chaotic bullet-filled battles. Merge Touhou characters, build your defense, and compete for the fastest clear time on the leaderboard.
games.aboutText:
Touhou Defense Tale ~ AI Test in Touhou ~ is a 2D tower defense game that combines tower merging mechanics with RTS-style unit control, set in the Touhou Project fan universe.

Summon towers, merge them into stronger units, and strategically reposition your forces in real time to withstand increasingly powerful enemy waves. Master unique fusion systems and unleash flashy skills in chaotic bullet-filled battles.

Features

- Tower merging and upgrade progression system

- RTS-style unit control and manual targeting

- Unique EX / PH / Arcana fusion systems

- Anime-style 2D visuals inspired by Touhou

- Intense bullet-hell inspired combat

- Replay-focused wave defense gameplay

- Time Attack Leaderboard

Build your own strategy and protect the shrine’s offertory box from endless waves of enemies.

Clear all 80 waves as fast as possible and compete with other players for the best completion time. Optimize your tower composition, merge routes, and resource management to achieve the fastest clear time.

games.name: REDLINE — Strings of Fate
games.shortDescription: A sci-fi otome game where your choices shape love — and the future of society.
games.aboutText:
REDLINE is a sci-fi romance visual novel set in a near-future coastal city in southern Japan where gifted individuals can perceive, interpret, and influence human emotions — abilities now at the center of scientific research and corporate ambition.

You play as a university student with the rare ability to perceive emotional connections as red threads. As you become entangled in a secretive research program and drawn toward five distinct love interests, your choices will shape not only your relationships, but the fate of society itself.

Souta Aihara

CA: Kieran Regan

Souta used to look out for you long before either of you knew where life would lead. After years spent apart, that hasn’t really changed. He has always been a constant in your life, even when distance turned him into an edge case and timing pushed him out of context. Now that the parameters have changed, you’re stepping into the next chapter together. Almost like before…

Rei Minzuki

CA: Corey Wilder

As a martial arts ace with a laid-back demeanor, Rei has earned his place as Redhaven University’s campus favorite without ever appearing to try. Considering how little effort he seems to invest in his studies, one can’t help but wonder how he ended up at RHU at all. Then again, it hardly matters.

Leiv Kazama

CA: Jimmie Yamaguchi

Whether in academic circles or within the boardrooms of the country’s leading tech corporations, the name Leiv Kazama is hard to overlook. At twenty-seven, he stands at the intersection of research, power, and responsibility. A junior professor by title, a CEO by profession, and a man whose decisions tend to shape more than just his own future.

Takuma Shinonome

CA: Brian Timothy Anderson

Fresh out of medical school yet already deeply embedded in the research halls of SYNEVIS, Takuma is far more at home in the quiet solitude of his laboratory than in crowded rooms. Between the infimum and supremum of light, human emotion registers as chromatic outliers — patterns he can observe with precision, though not always interpret.

Aziel Viré

CA: John Patneaude

Following in the footsteps of his uncle who once led SYNEVIS, Aziel now stands at the helm of the institute’s future. Where his predecessor earned loyalty through trust, Aziel, it seems, prefers something more reliable. After all, when you understand the thread that moves a heart, guiding it becomes almost effortless.

Planned for the full release:

- Five routes with 9 endings in total

- Additional CG illustrations, backgrounds, and original music

- Character editor with selectable skin tones and hair colors

- Integrated mini-game

- In-game chat system

- Character diaries and unlockable insights for each love interest

- CG Gallery and wiki

- Sprite variations (outfits, poses and expressions)

- Voice acting

Note:

The full scope of REDLINE, including voice acting, additional features and content such as backgrounds and music, as well as further possibilities like an animated opening and localization, will depend on the success of a Kickstarter campaign following the demo release.

REDLINE is developed by a small independent team based in Germany, led by Marleen gollan (Moteru Games). Character art, additional game design input, and voice direction are created and provided by Moona and Amalia, forming the core team. The project is further supported by contributors across background art, music, and voice acting.

games.name: NOSTRA
games.shortDescription: A dark fantasy RPG where side-view party battles turn on timing: build Boost, raise a Ward, parry on the frame and break the guard. Loot rolls with affixes, sets and runewords. Three kingdoms hold a fragile peace while something older stirs. Play the alpha demo now.
games.aboutText:
Lead your party through turn-based battles in side view, where every fight is decided by position, timing and what you are willing to spend. Build up Boost to turn a routine strike into the one that breaks a guard. Raise a Ward and take the hit on your terms. Parry on the frame and the counter is yours. Runic Power fuels the strikes that end fights, and it does not come back on its own.

Bandits on the road are one thing. What waits in the crypts under the old church is another, and it does not fight like anything the kingdoms trained their soldiers against.

Your knight is not a class you pick once. Specializations branch as you go, each with its own weapons, its own rhythm in a fight and its own way out of trouble.

Gear drops with rolled affixes and sockets, sets reward the pieces that belong together, and runewords turn the right stones into something more. The good finds are worth rebuilding a whole approach around.

The NOSTRA alpha demo is out now: an early build of the opening hours that grows with every update until release.

Grünthal and its people, the village where it all begins.

The woods beyond, the old cathedral and what comes through them.

The old pilgrim road through the Woods of Alyria, a bandit camp and a hideout to rest and save.

A dungeon with several levels beneath the bandit camp.

Hard Mode and Hardcore after your first run.

Click Download NOSTRA Demo on this page to play.

Nostra is an island continent, ringed by an ocean no ship has ever crossed and returned from. Three kingdoms stand on it. Calum holds the centre where three rivers meet, a realm of order, trade and parade-ground glory. Dorneval keeps the southern coast, where scholars argue in the shade and the blood sports fill the arenas. Vargheim holds the northern mountains, its warriors and its deep crystal mines. Each is certain the other two will break the peace first.

Beneath the politics, something older has begun to stir. Portals open where no one built one, and roads that were safe for a generation are not safe now. You begin far from all of it, in a village that has never mattered to anyone. Where the road takes you, and what you become on it, is yours to find out.

Day turns to night on its own clock. Lanterns come on, shutters close, and the roads empty. Weather rolls in across the land rather than switching on. Footsteps answer the ground you are walking on, and sound sits in the space around you instead of in front of you. Nostra reacts, down to details you are not meant to notice.

An original orchestral score, written for this world, from a single melody in an empty village to the themes that carry a boss to the end of its last phase.

NOSTRA is the first game from Runecraft Studios, built by one developer with a small circle of freelance artists and musicians. New regions, new stories and new mysteries arrive as the world grows.

Add NOSTRA to your wishlist and follow the journey from the start.

games.name: Cthulhu Go Teaching
games.shortDescription: Go has never been so accessible! With Lord Cthulhu to guide you, playing Go becomes much more enjoyable. Whether you want to get started with Go, improve your skills, or tackle Life and death problems, Lord Cthulhu will keep you company forever!
games.aboutText:
✨ Go has never been… so accessible with its “tentacles”

This is a game that combines Cthulhu elements with traditional Go.

The game is no longer boring—you’re not just playing Go; you’re competing against a stubborn Cthulhu.

🐙 Playing against Cthulhu

Cthulhu uses its tentacles to grab stones from the void—this eerie style makes every game feel like a ritual.

At some point, Lord Cthulhu removed his right brain and installed the most powerful Go AI on Earth— KataGo .

- Powerful Go AI: Supports real-time analysis, win rate prediction, and coaching.

- 5–19-square free board: You can use boards of different sizes to unlock faster, more intense matches.

- 6 levels of difficulty: Whether you’re a beginner with no experience in Go or a seasoned player, Cthulhu will be a strong opponent.

🍡 Stones stick together

The softest feature in the world of Go—stones form sticky connections with each other. Stones at adjacent, diagonal, or knight’s move positions exhibit different types of connections.

Each stone has its own “expression”.

- You can interact with the stones; they have life.

- When a stone has barely any liberties left, it shows “tension”.

- When you atari a opponent’s stone, it shows “confidence”.

This is actually a clever and compassionate idea from Cthulhu. By observing the expressions, you can understand the situation.

😈 You can definitely get started with Go

The game offers complete teaching and practice materials, and future plans include a “Creative Workshop” where you can freely import question banks.

As long as you follow the complete teaching process by Kusuro and practice regularly with question banks, getting started with Go will be easy.

- More than a dozen exclusive textbooks: These include basic Go knowledge that beginners need to understand, such as eyes, ladders, points, openings, net attacks, snapbacks, etc.

- Over a thousand Life and Death Problems: Specialized exercises and practice questions for different types of games.

- Valuable ancient Go books: You can draw from blind boxes to obtain real ancient Go texts and see the great moves of past players.

- Collectible term cards: You can gather beautiful Go term cards.

🎵 Drawing a blind box

When playing, remember to throw your captures into the hot pot—Cthulhu insists you remember this.

Then you can draw a blind box and receive Cthulhu’s rewards, including: chess books, term cards, vinyl records, and… stockings!

You can even dress the tentacles in different styles of stockings, and you can even touch the tentacles and adjust the length of the stockings.

“Hmph, if this makes you interested in playing chess, I can wear anything…”

🎮 Future development plans

Current features:

Human-machine match: Competing with KataGo-driven Kukuru

Local matches: Playing against friends face to face on the screen

Teaching: Complete beginner’s lessons in Go

Books: Practice exercises to improve specific skills through training

Emerging features:

Multi-player: Invite Steam friends to play together

Creative workshop: Free creation of Go-related content

games.name: Hyperspin
games.shortDescription: Hyperspin is an experimental rhythm game where you control a circle that spins on a circle, and you tap circles. There are lots of circles.
games.aboutText:
Spin to win!

Hyperspin is a free experimental rhythm game in which you control a circle that spins on a circle, and you tap circles. There are lots of circles.

Key features

- Mods to make the game harder, easier, or more interesting

- Use a versatile level editor to create the maps of your dreams

- Choose between mouse or *almost* any button on your keyboard that suits your playstyle

- Develop your skills using practice mode

- Built from scratch in a custom game engine to support a low-latency and buttery-smooth experience

- Free!

games.name: MobMower
games.shortDescription: Enter the chaos of MobMower! Shred through endless hordes of lethal monsters to claim back your land in this intense auto-shooter. Choose your hero, drift through enemy waves, and manage an arsenal of spellbooks and weapons. Rescue companions, rebuild your village, and unlock powerful synergies!
games.aboutText:
Step into the world of Mob Mower – a gripping bullet heaven where the battlefield becomes your private lawn for mowing down enemies. Choose your hero, grab powerful weapons, magic spellbooks, and legendary artifacts to literally mow down endless hordes of monsters. Rescue imprisoned companions, rebuild your village, develop talents, and unlock powerful, magical synergies!

KEY FEATURES

- Become an Elite Mower: Unlock all heroes – from mighty mages wielding fire to agile warriors. Each character comes with their own unique starting bonuses and signature starting weapon.

- Discover a Vast Arsenal: Experiment with a wide variety of weapons. Evolve your armament mid-run by combining it with mystical spellbooks to turn the battlefield into a true bullet hell.

- Ancient Spellbooks & Artifacts: Collect and read magical volumes that boost your battlefield capabilities. Equip your character with legendary artifacts that modify your skills and create unstoppable synergies.

- Rebuild the Village & Gain Power: Rescue your companions and unlock new buildings. Use the resources gathered during your runs to expand the settlement, securing permanent talents and steady meta-progression.

games.name: Hotel Is Hungry
games.shortDescription: The world ended. You got a hotel job. Check guests in, serve their orders, keep them away from killers, and decide who the hotel eats. A horror hotel management game.
games.aboutText:
The contract is signed. What's done cannot be undone. The hotel does not tolerate hunger.

Hotel Is Hungry is a claustrophobic hotel management and psychological horror game. After a

solar flare turns the world into a radioactive nightmare, you run the front desk of a hotel that's

secretly a living, hungry monster, and you decide who survives the night.

Talk to guests at the front desk each morning and place them in rooms based on what they ask for.

At night, grab your flashlight and face what your choices brought into the dark.

Every guest secretly plays a role: victim, sheriff, or killer. Place them in rooms Tetris-style. Get it

wrong, and you might be the one who gets them killed.

If a guest won't talk, look through the keyhole. But something might be looking back. Decide who

to feed to the hotel based on what you witness.

BLACKOUT

You manage the power grid each night. Leave a room dark, and its guest becomes the hotel's prey.

RUN TO THE LIGHT

If a guest attacks, your only chance is sprinting to the lit Bar at the end of the hall. Monsters can't

follow you into the light.

ROOM SERVICE

Guests knock with requests: coffee, beer, something microwaved. Dash to the bar, prepare it, and

deliver it before the trip back gets you killed.

UPGRADES

Use your earnings to unlock new floors and rooms, and upgrade your flashlight and generator to

survive longer.

NEVER THE SAME NIGHT

Generators flicker, guests roam, rules shift. Every choice leaves a permanent mark. No two nights

are the same.

The hotel is hungry. Feed it, or become the menu.

games.name: Panic 64
games.shortDescription: Panic Porcupine returns in a high-speed 3D platformer that blends classic run n' jump mechanics with racing elements!
games.aboutText:
Panic Porcupine returns in a next-gen platformer straight out of '98. Every quill on Panic's back will quiver with anxiety as he's thrust into the 3rd dimension.

Dr. Proventriculus has returned with a fiendish plan for the chickabirbs, and it's up to Panic to conquer new depths, new heights, and new fully polygonal hazards in this high speed platformer!

Features:

- 8 linear stages with two missions each

- 4 boss battles!

- Grading and scoring system. Great for speed runners and completionists alike.

- Crack open CRTs for new powerups like the egg magnet and boost soda.

- Use Panic's new Quill Qrush for tight platforming, and his drift ability for boosting out of tight corners!

- No you don't need glasses, those are blurry low-res textures!

games.name: JUJUTSU KAISEN RUMBLE: SURVIVATON
games.shortDescription: Survive, Exorcise, Change the game JUJUTSU KAISEN RUMBLE: SURVIVATON is a survivors royale where you battle cursed spirits and rival sorcerers, growing stronger throughout the match. Outscore your rivals and fight to be the last player standing victorious.
games.aboutText:
About JUJUTSU KAISEN RUMBLE: SURVIVATON

From the creator of Vampire Survivors Luca Galante and Shueisha Games, a new take on the genre. A poncle production set in the world of Jujutsu Kaisen, creating a new genre.

Survive, Exorcise, Change the game

JUJUTSU KAISEN RUMBLE: SURVIVATON is a survivors royale where you battle cursed spirits, rivals, and grow stronger throughout the match. Outscore other contestants on your way to the final showdown.

Defeat enemies, build your loadout, unlock rule-changing effects, and fight to become the last player standing victorious.

Online play supports up to 8 players. Solo play mode available.

◆ Earn Points and Overwhelm Your Rivals!

Cut through waves of cursed spirits, rack up points, and keep pace with your rivals' as the match grows more intense.

Your attacks trigger automatically, so the focus is on movement, positioning, and choosing the right moment to strike back with rule-changing effects.

At 100 points, activate a "Rule Addition" to disrupt your opponents, steal momentum, and climb the rankings.

In the end, the top 2 players face off in a 1v1 duel, where only one will emerge victorious.

◆ A roster of 20＋ characters from Jujutsu Kaisen!

Play as 20+ characters from the world of Jujutsu Kaisen, each with their own skills and playstyle.

Unlock new fighters by meeting specific conditions, experiment with different strengths, and find the character that fits your approach.

Powerful BOSSES can also appear mid-battle, turning the match into an even more chaotic clash of Jujutsu Sorcerers, Curse Users, and Cursed Spirits.

◆ Overwhelm Your Rivals with Unique Special Moves

Build up your gauge in battle, then unleash devastating character-specific techniques at the perfect moment.

Activate techniques iconic to JUJUTSU KAISEN from Domain Expansion, Black Flash, and beyond. These powerful moves can turn the tide of a match in an instant.

Special Moves can expose nearby rivals and can be directly targeted to a variety of game-altering attacks from the caster for the duration.

◆ Every Choice is Yours. Skills That Change with Every Run.

Collect EXP from defeated cursed spirits and level up throughout the match.

As players level up, they can not only strengthen the skills of their chosen character, but also incorporate the techniques of other characters into their own build through " Unite Build" .

Each level gives you new skill options to shape your build on the fly: strengthen what you already have, add new abilities, and discover powerful synergies that can carry you to victory.

◆ About JUJUTSU KAISEN

Created by Gege Akutami, JUJUTSU KAISEN was serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump from Issue 14 of 2018 (March 5, 2018) through Issue 44 of 2024 (September 30, 2024), spanning 30 volumes. Curses. Sinister forces born from negative human emotions, such as hardship, regret, and shame, are driving people toward death. When the seal on a powerful “Cursed Object” is broken, high school student Yuji Itadori steps into a world of battles surrounding curses...! A groundbreaking new frontier in dark fantasy, opened by a singular talent!

The manga spans 30 volumes, with Volume 0 also available as JUJUTSU KAISEN 0: Tokyo Metropolitan Curse Technical School. The series has surpassed 150 million copies incirculation (including digital editions)Worldwide. Season 1 of the TV anime aired from October 2020 to March 2021. Released in December 2021, JUJUTSU KAISEN 0: The Movie became a major hit, grossing 26.5 billion yen worldwide and becoming a cultural phenomenon. Season 2 of the TV anime, which aired from July to December 2023, was also widely acclaimed for its exceptional quality. In May 2025, JUJUTSU KAISEN: Hidden Inventory / Premature Death was released theatrically as a compilation film. That October saw a theatrical re-release of JUJUTSU KAISEN 0, followed in November by the theatrical release of JUJUTSU KAISEN: Execution. Season 3 of the TV anime, JUJUTSU KAISEN: Culling Game Part 1, aired from January to late March 2026.

games.name: Your Fiancée
games.shortDescription: An all-in-one desktop companion with a stylish mature avatar, productivity tools, collection and growth features, and a lively desktop ecosystem. Customize her look and outfits while she helps with hardware monitoring, planning, finances, music, pets, desktop effects, and more.
games.aboutText:
🎉 Major update: “Your Fiancée – AI Companion Expansion DLC” is now available for free!

《Your Fiancée》

Your personal desktop companion, by your side every day

She is more than ordinary software.

She is an elegant, mature companion who lives on your desktop—
there while you work, study, or unwind, and ready to help organize daily life.

Customize her appearance and outfits freely to make her a truly one-of-a-kind desktop companion.

From hardware monitoring, task planning, and money management to pet collecting, music, and desktop decoration...

She will become the most special presence on your PC.

✨ Create your own elegant companion

She has a distinctive charm that is elegant, mature, and alluring.

Customize her:

◆ Hair color
◆ Eye color
◆ Earrings
◆ Many other appearance details

A rich outfit system is included too:

👗 Mix and match a wide range of signature outfits

Try a different style every day and keep your desktop feeling fresh.

🖥️ Powerful hardware monitoring

She is not only good company; she is also your PC assistant.

Choose between two hardware-monitoring layouts:

Simple Mode

Ideal for everyday use:

- CPU usage

- GPU usage

- Memory status

- Temperature monitoring

- Drive status

- Network status

See how your PC is running at a glance.

Advanced Hardware Monitoring

Built for power users.

View more detailed data:

- Detailed CPU information

- Real-time GPU status

- Video memory usage

- Core clock speeds

- Temperature graphs

- Power consumption

- System status analysis

Turn your desktop companion into a professional PC monitoring tool.

🌟 Steam Workshop — Expand Your Desktop World Without Limits

Your desktop companion can be so much more.

With Steam Workshop , explore a wealth of content created by players around the world:

🎀 A huge collection of anime-style characters
🎀 Personalized desktop-pet designs
🎀 Unique outfits and styles
🎀 Original player creations

Simply subscribe to add a favorite character to your desktop and keep your desktop world feeling alive and new.

✨ Subscribe to characters you love

In the Workshop, you can:

- Browse character creations shared by other players

- Subscribe to a favorite desktop pet with one click

- Download and apply it to the game automatically

- Switch your desktop companion whenever you like

A new character may be waiting every day.

Your desktop never has to look the same twice.

🎨 Create your own desktop companion

If inspiration strikes, you can become a creator too.

The game includes a convenient Steam Workshop upload tool :

Upload characters you have made and share them with players around the world.

Create:

- Unique character designs

- Personalized desktop pets

- Original anime-style characters

- A desktop companion of your own

Bring your creations to desktops around the world.

⏰ A little helper for better productivity

She helps you manage your time and get more out of every day.

🍅 Pomodoro Timer

Use the classic Pomodoro method:

Focus → Take a timed break → Stay at your best

Build a steadier rhythm for work and study.

🔔 Smart Reminders

Set reminders for anything you do not want to forget:

- Work reminders

- Study plans

- Important dates

- Everyday tasks

She will remind you when the time is right.

🖼️ Image Motion Workshop

games.name: Bub
games.shortDescription: A narrative adventure game about turning your memories into art while you still can. Made with slashes of ink and paint and thousands of cut paper pieces, Bub is a deeply personal, living, breathing game world.
games.aboutText:
Bub is the story of an artist in New York City. He paints, sculpts and makes worlds for people to explore. But he’s losing his gift, you see. He's sick. Bub is the story of an artist turning his memories into art while he still can. Bub’s journey through his past is mirrored by changes in artistic style and mood, from ink drawings to rough cut paper puppets to abstracted slashes of paint. Thousands of cut paper pieces, painted frames and collages form the uniquely textured and layered stop-motion world of ‘Bub.’ The result is something personal and unique, analog artworks that create a living, breathing game world.

Bub's the artistic project of Case and Todd, two friends in Brooklyn. Over the years and through life's complexities, the game has became a record of personal experience, a kind of memory palace if you will. Expect artistic style, mood and sonic feeling to fluidly change as the story unfolds through the stream of conscious musings of Bub, voiced by Whitmer Thomas, fresh off his supporting role in the critically acclaimed film 'Weapons.'

Adam Schatz, of bands Landlady and Japanese Breakfast, has laid down a stunning blanket of music and sound to bring the world of Bub to life. Asher Kurtz of Old Feels has contributed beautiful and textured guitar arrangements, while the duo of Somepoint Sound have contributed a broad range of effects and sound design to immerse the player into the memories and streets and intimate spaces of Bub.

Coming 2027.

games.name: Heartbeat Under One Roof
games.shortDescription: Sakura, the protagonist’s childhood friend, gets scouted by a talent agency and begins her journey as an idol. She moves in with the protagonist, who works in Tokyo. With his support, can Sakura rise to become a top idol with one million fans?
games.aboutText:
As a regular office worker living in the bustling city, one day you receive a call from your aunt. She tells you that your childhood friend is coming to stay with you.

She has dreamed of becoming a sparkling top idol since she was little, and has finally been officially signed by an agency, ready to start her idol career. However, she hasn’t found a place to live yet, so she temporarily moves into your home.

Although you’ve both been busy these past few years and drifted apart, the moment she stands in front of you again with that familiar warm smile and slightly blushing cheeks, it feels like you’ve gone back in time. This cohabitation life is incredibly sweet — making your heart race — with just a hint of thrilling “danger.”

Together, you’ll spend the next 100 weeks supporting each other, growing side by side, and facing the challenges and temptations of the idol world. From initial shyness and hesitation, to gradually opening your hearts and deepening your bond… you’ll create many warm and precious memories. In the end, you’ll help her reach her dream of a million fans, while enjoying multiple heartwarming and healing endings.

This is a simulation game centered around sweet cohabitation and idol training, focusing on interactions and dream-chasing between childhood friends.

The game uses a weekly simulation training system:

- Weekdays : Decide the heroine’s training focus (singing, dancing, acting, etc.) or arrange part-time jobs and leisure activities.

- Weekends : Core interaction time. Chat with her, go out to play, do live streams, and more to raise her affection.

- Every 4 weeks, a live performance is held using a card-based system. Fan growth depends on her trained abilities and combo triggers.

Your goal is to help her reach 1 million fans within 100 weeks.

- Extremely Sweet Interactions:

Enjoy a super sweet cohabitation life filled with rich, anytime interactions that create an immersive “feels like real love” experience full of warmth and healing.

- High-Quality Hand-Drawn 2D Animations:

Over 1,000 beautiful hand-drawn animations vividly bring everyday moments and emotional expressions to life with smooth, natural visuals.

- Seamless Idol Training & Daily Life:

Perfectly blends idol activities with cozy cohabitation moments, giving you a wonderful sense of achievement as you watch her grow.

games.name: Love in Summer
games.shortDescription: Summer nears. A campus photo job brings you to caring beauty Liu Shilin, aloof yet warm artist Li Feier, mischievous model Xia Wei, and childhood friend Le Tong. Together, you plan graduation shoots, each lending your talents, as your own summer romance with four unique girls quietly begins.
games.aboutText:
Love in Summer is a fully dynamic live-action interactive romance simulation. This summer vacation, you will embark on a lighthearted youth journey with four young women of distinct personalities. Within this summer, there is ambiguity, tension, laughter, and touching moments.

There will be many summers in life, yet none will burn as bright as this one.

Gentle, thoughtful and intelligent senior school beauty — Liu Shilin Co-founder of "Heta" Photography Studio, in charge of daily studio operations. "Where are we all bound for? Such a silly question, yet no one has the answer."

Cool on the surface, warm at heart artistic senior — Li Feier Co-founder of "Heta" Photography Studio, responsible for the studio’s artistic creation. "Trapped by this unsolvable mundane life. Sorrow runs on forever, just like the river flowing east."

Whimsical and mischievous young model — Xia Wei Exclusive model of "Heta" Photography Studio, talented in singing and dancing. "You wave your hands in delight, while I stare blankly, lost in your sweet smile."

Cute and innocent childhood sweetheart next door — Le Tong The most reliable backup member of "Heta" Photography Studio. After the college entrance exam, she sneaks to campus to meet you without telling her family. "I was eighteen that year. My heart skipped a beat the moment I laid eyes on you."

First-Person Immersion Filmed in first-person perspective to boost scene and narrative immersion, delivering a fully immersive romantic interactive experience.

Branching Choices & Multiple Endings Every choice you make shapes how the seniors and underclasswomen feel about you, and ultimately determines your endings with each of them.

Authentic Youth & Subtle Emotions Centered on ordinary college campus life. It tells a genuine, nuanced coming-of-age story in a grounded, realistic style.

Youth is when a group of people gather and wholeheartedly pursue one thing. Regrets may come along the way, but no matter how things turn out, the journey itself holds meaning.

In an era flooded with diverse interactive film games, we chose to slow down, return to basics, and craft a pure, simple story rooted in campus youth. We hope you enjoy this work.

games.name: Anomalous Coffee Machine 3
games.shortDescription: You're a broke freelance artist who just found a reality-bending coffee machine in your apartment stairwell. Discover anomalous drinks, dominate social media, sell your anomalous creations online, and spread the weirdness.
games.aboutText:
Before the alleyway, before the incidents, there was just an artist trying to make rent.

In this prequel to the Anomalous Coffee Machine series, you play as Horu, a work-from-home game artist struggling to keep her head above water. Everything changes when a mysterious, outdated coffee machine appears in the liminal stairwell between the 12th and 13th floors of your high-rise apartment. Drop in a coin, type in a word, and watch as the machine dispenses a drink that defies the laws of physics.

What do you do with a machine that brews literal anomalies? You monetize it.

Key Features:

- Brew the Impossible: Insert coins and type words into the mysterious machine to generate completely unique, anomalous drinks. Keep experimenting to discover new vocabulary and unlock different types of beverages.

- The E-Commerce Anomaly: Box up your reality-bending coffees and sell them online to unsuspecting customers to pay your bills and fund your operations.

- Consequence-Driven Reviews: Read the bizarre, hilarious, and horrifying ratings left on your shop page as your customers experience unexplainable transformations from your drinks.

- Social Media Hustle: Build your online empire. Post selfies, gain followers, and rack up likes and comments to boost your sales and market reach.

- Meet the Neighbors: Step away from your desk to explore your apartment complex. Share your anomalous brews with your neighbors and watch the local chaos unfold.

games.name: CHEEKY CHEERHYTHM
games.shortDescription: "Wanna crush my pride? No way, you wimp!♡" Coach your proud student Iroha, designed by Asanagi, in this physical rhythm game! No matter your flawless timing, you'll get cheeky banter. Yet, your coaching works: her smooth Live2D animations react in real-time to your rhythm!
games.aboutText:
“Wanna make me understand? Impossible♡ You weakling♡”

The new sensation fitness rhythm action game “CHEEKY CHEERHYTHM” is coming to Tokyo Game Show 30th!

As “Sensei”, you coach the cheer dance of the prideful high-school girl Iroha Shishikura (CV: Hinata Yuka), designed by world-renowned illustrator Asanagi.

Controls are simple — just use dual gyro motion controllers as pom-poms and keep the rhythm! No matter how accurately you play, Iroha will keep throwing cheeky taunts at you (a rich variety of fully original voice lines). On top of that, her willful body reacts smoothly in real-time Live2D animation linked to your performance!

Follow our Steam publisher page so you do not miss the next update.

Game Overview

As Sensei, you produce the cheer dance of the prideful high-school girl Iroha Shishikura and her willful body. Your goal is to create the ultimate cheer performance, restore the school sports club’s results, and make her acknowledge your coaching skills.

Highlights

Physical Rhythm Action Using Gyro Controllers

Supports dual motion controllers with gyro sensors. Wave them like pom-poms and move your body to the beat — a brand-new physical rhythm action experience.

Asanagi’s Visuals × Cutting-edge Live2D

Overwhelming body lines designed by world-renowned illustrator Asanagi come to life with smooth real-time Live2D animation. Her movements change according to your play accuracy.

Tons of Cheeky Voice Line Variations by Hinata Yuka

Fully original recorded taunting voice lines in tons of variations! Lines like “Weakling♡ Trying so hard♡ So weak♡ Your face is all red♡” keep flying at you throughout the game.

Character Introduction

Iroha Shishikura

肉倉 色羽（ししくら いろは）

CV: Hinata Yuka (陽向葵ゅか)

With her cute fang and willful body, she is the object of admiration among the boys. Extremely prideful, she is always teasing the boys.

She had no experience with cheerleading, but under Sensei’s coaching she begins to awaken to her talent. During practice she never stops teasing and calling Sensei a “weakling”.

In reality she is innocent, and her body is honest. She reacts obediently to accurate rhythm input — that gap is what makes her charming.

games.name: NecroFlux
games.shortDescription: NecroFlux:A dark fantasy single-player game. 2nd-person fight view (not 1st/3rd). Combat-focused. Rhythm-based Simultaneous Turn + Tactics, Survival & Loot. Move/stance-switch, auto-attacks; combo keys to command units. Play as a resurrected soul, fight hordes to reclaim lost memories.
games.aboutText:
Gameplay & Story Introduction

One soul, awakens in a strange realm; two undead, band together to fight off endless swarming foes.

- NecroFlux is a single-player turn-based survival loot ARPG with fast, tight combat. Gameplay leans hard into tactical fights rather than lengthy story sequences, centered around a distinct Second-Person Perspective Battlefield system you won’t see elsewhere.

- This game is currently in Early Access, with an estimated playable runtime of 5–10 hours.

- You play as a reanimated skull. A mysterious skeletal girl stands beside you as you scrape by and wage unceasing war across the shadowed world of the NecroFlux.

- Each night loops through three gameplay phases: daily phase, prep phase, and combat phase. Beat powerful bosses and clear repeated short level runs to advance the main plot toward its conclusion. Throughout the journey, the protagonist gathers spirit-related resources to gradually recover their lost memories, reconstruct their physical form and regain their human body. In the end, they return to the world they originally came from.

What makes our Second-Person Perspective Battlefield mechanic unique?

On the battlefield, your skeletal male avatar comes with a fully free-floating camera, letting you pan and survey the entire field from any angle.

At the same time, you direct the skeletal girl: WASD moves her, left/right mouse buttons swap combat stances, and she automatically strikes foes that wander into her attack radius. This dual-control second-person setup forms the core of our distinct combat loop.

Streamlined Allied Gear System

Most games lock each character to a separate equipment menu, but our unified UI holds gear slots for dozens of allied units all on one screen. Within this single interface, you can freely adjust the skeletal girl’s loadout alongside equipment for every other ally under your command.

Critical Note for Players

This game is neither roguelike nor roguelite. It does not include core genre staples like random branching upgrade paths or procedurally generated maps.

games.name: Sardoinky
games.shortDescription: Sardoinky is a weird, chill, hand drawn clicker about opening cans of sardines. Buy a can, crack it open and sell whatever is inside. Spend the cash on better cans and upgrades. Collect every fish and find out what the company is hiding.
games.aboutText:
Sardoinky is a weird, chill, hand drawn clicker about opening cans of sardines. You work for a company that opens cans of sardines. That's it... That's the whole job.

Buy a can, SPAM THE BUTTON, peel it open and sell the nice fish inside. The cash buys more cans and upgrades. It's not really about the money, though. It's about the fish!!

You never know what's in a can until the lid comes off. Usually it's a sardine. Sometimes it's a foiled, stickered rarity worth a hundred times what you paid. Sometimes there's nothing in it at all.

As in any realistic gambling scenario, the odds are against you. Luckily, the company sells upgrades for that. Everything has a price. Even luck.

Sardines are just the start. There are weird fish, rare fish and a few things that have no business being in a can. Catch them all and fill out your collection.

What are you waiting for? Your shift starts now!

games.name: Sandwatch
games.shortDescription: Sandwatch is a rhythm game where you hit two types of notes falling from above with perfect timing. Freely bind and press your keys as you follow the trajectory of the hourglass.
games.aboutText:
Sandwatch is a rhythm game where you hit two types of notes falling from above with perfect timing.

Glass Notes fall freely and feature strict, precise judgment windows.

Sand Notes follow a specific trajectory and feature more generous, lenient judgment.

Through custom keybindings, you can assign up to 6 keys for Glass Notes and up to 4 keys for Sand Notes.

Once configured, you simply need to press the designated keys to the beat—regardless of the note's horizontal position.

The game also features unique note types:

- Long Notes: Require you to hold down the key inputs.

- Catch Notes: Cleared by pressing the key at any time, regardless of precision timing.

Break free from traditional boundaries, play with total freedom, and begin your journey through the desert.

games.name: Leviathan: Rhino
games.shortDescription: Live through the final days of an old man in a small village threatened by an approaching giant Leviathan. An existential horror game about inevitability, loneliness, and a man with nowhere to go and no reason to leave.
games.aboutText:
There are things beyond our control. Changes that cannot be resisted. Sometimes, all we can do is leave, or stay and watch everything we loved disappear.

In this world, leviathans, colossal creatures of Lovecraftian scale, have long since become part of everyday life. They cannot be stopped. Humanity can only track their movements and get out of their way in time. But for some, there is nowhere left to go and no reason to leave.

Explore a small village from a first-person perspective, talk to its residents, and carry out simple everyday tasks.

Feed the cow. Visit your neighbor. Listen to the news. Remember the past. Wait.

Leviathan: Rhino is an existential horror game about inevitability, attachment, loneliness, guilt, and the fragile hope that even at the very end, there may still be light.

games.name: Ticker Panic: Stock Market Simulator
games.shortDescription: Trade in a chaotic stock market sim where absurd headlines, hype cycles, crashes, and liquidity traps can make or break your portfolio. Start small, survive the chaos, and take over the market.
games.aboutText:
Ticker Panic is a chaotic stock trading game where fake companies, absurd headlines, other traders, and your own orders can move the market.

Start with a small account, read the charts, react to breaking news, and try to grow your portfolio without panic-selling directly into your own regret.

Trade Through Market Chaos

Stocks do not all behave the same. Some drift steadily, some swing wildly, and some are only one bad headline away from feeling personal.

Learn how each stock reacts, watch the market mood, and decide whether the current move is an opportunity, a trap, or the start of something worse.

Trade Against More Than a Chart

The market is not just a line moving up and down. Other traders are buying, selling, chasing hype, losing confidence, and adding pressure to the same stocks you are trying to trade.

Thin liquidity, limited supply, and large orders can turn a winning position into an exit problem. Sometimes the question is not only whether a stock will move. It is whether enough buyers or sellers are still there when you need them.

Events You Can Act On

Market events can shift momentum, increase volatility, change sector behavior, and turn a safe-looking trade into a problem.

Read the news, follow ticker highlights, check the chart, and decide whether the market is overreacting or whether you are about to become the overreaction.

Built Around Readable Panic

Ticker Panic is built around readable charts, quick trade controls, visible portfolio feedback, event cards, watchlists, stock profiles, heat maps, and ledger views that help you understand what just happened.

You will still make bad decisions. They will just be easier to understand afterward.

Features

- Trade fake stocks, funds, crypto, and speculative assets with different personalities, risks, volatility, and event reactions.

- React to market events that can shift momentum, increase volatility, change sector behavior, and send tickers into hype or panic.

- Trade against other market participants whose buying, selling, confidence, and panic can affect price movement.

- Watch liquidity, limited supply, order flow, hype, panic, and trade size turn simple decisions into bigger problems.

- Use a clean trading-terminal UI with readable charts, fast trade controls, event cards, watchlists, stock profiles, heat maps, and portfolio feedback.

- Track realized and unrealized P/L, recent transactions, ledger history, achievements, saves, unlocks, and music/theme progression.

games.name: Dragon's Chronicles~双星のレギンレイヴ~
games.shortDescription: A super-authentic hardcore strategy simulation fantasy that blends respect for tradition with a challenge to the unknown, nostalgic yet new.
games.aboutText:
A Hardcore Tactical SRPG Where Respect for Tradition Meets Bold New Ideas!

Inspired by the challenging strategy RPGs of the 1990s and 2000s,
