this game is a full-fledged tactical SRPG built for players who love deep, demanding strategy.

Its defining features include the kind of satisfying difficulty rarely seen in today’s market,
a wealth of deep combat systems designed to support a wide variety of player strategies,
and a highly flexible progression system that lets you make the most of a cast of over 40 incredibly unique units.

But this is far more than a nostalgic tribute to the classics.
The game also introduces a wide range of distinctive original mechanics, creating a play experience that feels strangely familiar—yet somehow unlike anything you have played before.

The game balance has been carefully refined by developers who have played countless SRPGs over the years,
with extensive testing carried out by veteran players with more than 20 years of SRPG experience .

The deeper you understand its systems, the more rewarding the game becomes.

For dedicated SRPG fans, this is one you will not want to miss!

Especially Recommended For Players Who...

- Have grown tired of conventional tactical RPGs

- Are starting to find normal levels of difficulty a little too easy

- Miss the brutal, brain-melting SRPGs of the late ’90s and early 2000s

- Love taking their time, thinking things through, and experimenting with different strategies

Story / Synopsis

The setting: a full-blown medieval fantasy world.

Leia , princess of the absurdly enormous Republic—a perfectly ordinary land of swords and magic—has set out on a journey with you , the legendary strategist hailed as the greatest tactician on the continent for your exploits in the War of the Seven Stars seventeen years ago.

Her goal is to find her beloved only daughter, Cynthia , whom she accidentally left behind at a horribly overpriced amusement park when she was little, resulting in their tragic separation.

Unfortunately, during a stop in the Camellia Empire , Leia overhears details of a sinister imperial plot.

Naturally, this results in her being transformed into an exquisitely crafted doll by a corrupt dollmaker.

As for you ?

Your memories are stolen, you are beaten senseless, bound up like a rug, and thrown into the ocean.

After narrowly escaping death, you eventually wash ashore on Sicily Island , in the eastern reaches of the continent.

Sicily is ruled by a mysterious mafia organization known as the Nostra Family .

In the island’s port town of Baymarine , Leia’s daughter Cynthia just happens to be running an underground pizzeria called Pizzeria Cynthia , which also doubles as a shady odd-jobs service—or “Trouble Busters”—under one of the Family’s subordinate organizations.

By an incredible stroke of convenience, you are rescued by the very same pizzeria.

While helping Cynthia with her jobs as she pursues her burning ambition to rise through the underworld and become one of the Family’s top executives, you begin searching for clues to recover your lost memories.

Along the way, you learn of the Basques , a group of illegal immigrants driven from their homeland whose presence has become a growing issue across the continent.

One day, while distributing food to the residents of Baymarine, Cynthia and you encounter Nadja , the supreme leader of the Basque faith.

As you become entangled with him and those pursuing him, you uncover a cold war brewing between nations over the migrant crisis—and the sinister ambitions of the Camellia Empire lurking behind it all.

Before long, Cynthia and you find yourselves swept into a conflict that will engulf the entire continent───

games.name: Cast of the Three Kingdoms: Rise
games.shortDescription: Cast Of The Three Kingdoms ：Rise is a Three Kingdoms-themed, diorama-style turn-based tactical RPG that blends enemy capturing, loot grinding, and equipment crafting.
games.aboutText:
Cast Of The Three Kingdoms ：Rise shatters the stereotypes of traditional turn-based tactical RPGs, flawlessly blending physics-based interactive mechanics with hardcore gear-driven progression.

Here, not only must you meticulously plan your battles, collect and craft gear with a massive array of stat combinations, and recruit formidable foes with unique traits, but you must also think outside the box. Beyond standard auto-attacks, magical spells, and ranged weapons, you can use "throwing" and "smashing" to tear through enemy defense lines!

Game Content Plan

- 50 Story Stages + 5 Special Stages ( The demo version includes 5 tutorial stages + 5 story stages + the Illusion System )

- Estimated 20 Playable Story Characters; most enemy grunts can be recruited (The demo features 5 story characters . Most enemy grunts can also be recruited.)

- At least 200+ Equipment & Items and 600+ Affixes planned for the full game (The demo offers 60+ equipment items and nearly 120+ affixes.)

Core Features

"Lift" and "Throw": Revolutionary Diorama Combat

In these exquisite and compact diorama battlefields, terrain and positioning are certainly important, but your "hands" are far more destructive. You can directly lift any unit on the field—whether a comrade or a formidable enemy—and hurl them away! Utilize the weight mechanic to smash heavily armored generals into enemy ranks like cannonballs, dealing massive AoE damage, or throw the enemy's fragile core units directly into your own encirclement to focus fire. You can even use a "human tower" relay to bypass obstacles within limited spaces, achieving incredible strategic repositioning and combo tactics.

Farewell to Tedious Grinding: Pure Gear-Driven Progression & Build Crafting

The game completely removes traditional EXP and character leveling systems, returning the joy of progression entirely to the "loot grind" itself. A character's strength relies purely on combat drops and handcrafted gear. By using various enhancement stones, you can upgrade equipment stats and enchant them with diverse affixes. By combining a massive pool of randomized stats, special affixes, and the unique inherent traits of different generals, you can freely theorycraft and create your own one-of-a-kind combat builds. Whether it's a lifesteal counter-attack build, an extreme weight-crushing build, or a high-mobility assassin build, everything is defined by the gear in your hands.

Dive into the "Mirage": Experience Endless Looting Thrills

Beyond experiencing the epic Shu-Han main storyline and fighting to restore the Han Dynasty, the game also features a " Mirage " system filled with unpredictable variables. As procedurally generated dungeon maps, Mirages are the perfect places to acquire rare resources, high-level gear, and forging materials. Most importantly, you can bring your fully optimized, god-tier gear directly into these runs, enjoying the satisfying power trip of a completed build while forging true divine weapons through continuous combat and scavenging.

Recruit and Subdue: Capture Your Own Formidable Foes

The enemies on the battlefield aren't just stumbling blocks; they are potentially your greatest assets. In both campaigns and Mirages, meeting specific conditions allows you to recruit formidable enemies with unique traits to fight for your cause. Every "subdued" enemy general boasts their own unique base stats and passive skills. Tailor a set of top-tier gear for them, and assemble a bizarre and fearsome squad that will strike terror into the hearts of your enemies!

games.name: Nightmare Loop
games.shortDescription: Traverse the unsettling Gdańsk of the early digital era. Immerse yourself in a dark vision of a real city. Explore the Falowiec and other real-world locations as you search for answers to the mysteries. Try to stop the approaching nightmare in this unique horror game.
games.aboutText:
Explore a dark vision of early-2000s Gdańsk, a real city transformed into an unsettling nightmare. Uncover its mysteries, explore familiar places, and confront something lurking beneath reality in this psychological horror adventure.

You play as Oskar.

Explore a dark vision of early-2000s Gdańsk, a real city with a second face. Uncover its mysteries, from a kilometre-long concrete apartment block to the Baltic coast, and descend into the Nightmare lurking beneath reality.

Following the clues, Oskar begins to uncover a hidden layer of reality lurking beneath the familiar world around him. The deeper he goes, the harder it becomes to tell what is real, what is imagined, and what should have remained forgotten.

Poland, early 2000s. Gdańsk.

Explore a faithfully recreated version of a real, living city. From towering concrete apartment blocks and quiet residential streets to cemeteries, forests, and the Baltic coastline. These are places that actually exist, brought into the game and transformed into the setting of Oskar’s story.

Experience the early 2000s, when dial-up internet, CRT monitors, mobile phones, and the first online communities were changing everyday life. Beneath this familiar nostalgia, however, something else is taking shape.

As technology spreads through the city, the boundary between the physical world and something far older begins to collapse.

Nightmare Loop

Reality is not as stable as it seems. Familiar places become distorted, ordinary moments turn unsettling, and every discovery raises new questions about what is happening to Oskar and why.

Explore two versions of the same city: the Gdańsk you recognize and its disturbing reflection — the Nightmare. Uncover a story filled with mystery, occult influences, and unexpected twists as you descend deeper into the Nightmare, where nothing can be taken at face value.

Game Features

- Psychological and digital-occult horror with a mysterious story, deep lore, and unexpected twists

- A real city brought into the game - explore faithfully recreated locations from Gdańsk.

- Two visions of reality - move between the Gdańsk you know and the Nightmare, its distorted reflection

- A unique camera system combining third-person, first-person, and side-scrolling perspectives

- Early-2000s nostalgia - experience the era of dial-up internet, CRT screens, mobile phones, and the dawn of the digital age

- Varied gameplay combining exploration, combat, puzzles, and original gameplay mechanics

games.name: Company Captain: Westashes
games.shortDescription: You are the captain of a free company... one among many roaming this mercenary world, growing, falling, earning and betraying just as you do. The world will not bend for you, nor wait: the other companies are already writing their stories. Yours will be decided in steel, gold and a name.
games.aboutText:
You are not the hero of Westashes. Nobody is.

Company Captain: Westashes is a tactical RPG about leading a mercenary company through a medieval world that does not revolve around you. Factions wage wars you didn't start. Rival companies take the contracts you hesitated on. Bandits starve, grow desperate, and get bolder. The world moves — with you or without you.

Your job: keep your people fed, paid, and alive long enough to become a company worth remembering.

A World That Plays Itself

Every band on the map — knights, bandits, caravans, militias, rival free companies — pursues its own goals under the same rules you play by.

- Rival companies patrol, hunt contracts, guard caravans and collect tolls — whether you're there or not.

- Bands negotiate with each other: they demand blood-money, pay for passage, back down, or fight. You can stumble into the aftermath.

- Bandits turn cowardly when weak and bold when strong. Raiders break camp and vanish when they draw too much attention. Militias garrison their homes at night.

- Wipe a company off the map and the world won't respawn it — eventually a new one, with a new name and a new captain, rises to fill the vacuum.

Enemy Captains Are Built Exactly Like You

One rule drives the whole game: anything that applies to you applies to them.

- Every captain has a background, a personality, a motivation and a memory. A Monk captain heals his wounded faster — yours and theirs alike. A Hunter sees farther across the map. So do you.

- They remember every meeting: the tribute you paid, the parley you broke, the prisoner you executed. Grudges harden into vendettas, and vendettas come looking for you.

- They win battles, take scars, gain renown and evolve. The enemy you spare today may return next season stronger — and still angry.

Rumors Are Your Quest Log

There is no chosen-one questline. There are taverns, and people talk.

- "The Crows are starving" isn't flavor text — that band's food actually ran out, and desperate bands do desperate things.

- Act on a rumor, ignore it, or arrive too late: threads resolve without you, or rot into something worse.

- Which rumors you chase is who your company becomes.

Brutal Tactical Combat

Turn-based hex battles decided by more than hit points.

- Positioning, terrain, equipment weight, fatigue and morale all matter. Soldiers panic, rout, and drag others down with them.

- Enemy leaders fight with real battle plans — ambushes on your route, terror campaigns, personal vendettas — and shout orders that reshape their line mid-fight.

- Wounds take days to heal. Scars are forever. Death is permanent. Your veterans' scars are your company's true history.

Men Are Expensive. Losing Them Is Worse.

- Recruit in taverns, where every settlement seats its own crowd — desperate idle hands going cheap, and professionals worth saving up for. Poor villages breed more idle hands than rich cities.

- Every recruit has a background, a personality and hidden potential. The cheap farmhand may be a late bloomer; the expensive veteran arrives already scarred.

- His hiring price you pay once. His wage bites at every single dawn — and your captain draws none, because the company is his.

- Rival companies drink in the same taverns. The man you spent a week saving up for may already be marching under someone else's banner.

Honor Is Not Fame

Reputation runs on two axes: what you're known for, and how loudly.

- Slaughter caravans and knights will hunt you while outlaws step aside. Guard the roads and lords pay premium — while bandits mark you as a threat.

- Grow infamous enough and a price lands on your head. Other companies will gladly take that contract.

- Earn an ally instead and they'll share intel, split contract rewards — and their deserters may ask to join your banner.

The Road Remembers Too

The land between battles is not empty.

- Trade a scar to the witch. Share a meal with the hermit. Read the warning left beside the hanged man.

- Watchtowers are held by whoever takes them — clear one out, or walk into one held against you. Mountain passes hide ambushes with real tactical teeth.

- When the traveling fair arrives, even enemies drink under the same truce. Breaking it has a price.

Emergent Stories

None of this is scripted. In one campaign, a captain whose toll we refused at a mountain pass nursed the grudge for a month, rebuilt his warband, and caught us in that same pass — with the high ground. Three veterans didn't come home. Nobody wrote that story. It just happened, and the company chronicle kept the receipt.

If this sounds like your kind of game, wishlist it — for a solo dev it genuinely moves the needle. And come argue about balance in the Discord; Early Access is going to be built on those arguments.

games.name: Supermarket Chaos
games.shortDescription: Supermarket Chaos is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 4,668 products in a messy supermarket. Enjoy the satisfaction of stocking shelves in a calm, relaxing atmosphere.
games.aboutText:
Supermarket Chaos is a cozy organizing simulator about calmly putting a chaotic supermarket back in order. Arrange 4,668 products across 16 sections, including fruit, tea, frozen foods, books, wine, ramen, and more, and enjoy the quiet satisfaction of making every shelf feel right.

〖A Relaxing Supermarket Organizing Simulator〗

One day, the store-organizing robot GPT-9000 reached a philosophical conclusion: “All positions are temporary, and all displays are violence.” As a result, every product in the supermarket lost its place. (Fortunately, he was fired immediately.)

No need to worry. Now all you have to do is walk through the quiet store and return each scattered product to its proper place.

〖Major Update #1: Choose Your Map〗

A supermarket, a convenience store straight out of a dream, and even the Super Super Supermarket—choose the map that suits you and start organizing.

- The original supermarket map has been revamped to support symmetrical product placement, and its product count has increased to 4,669.

- (Patch 1.1.6) The Super Super Market has been updated. Try organizing 9,999 items!

〖Major Update #2: Organize with Friends!〗

Up to 4 players can now organize together. Dress up in a variety of costumes and team up with your friends to put everything back in order. (Friends sold separately.)

〖When a Messy Store Falls Into Place〗

At first, the store is a little chaotic.
Empty shelves, products left on the floor, sections that still need attention.
But as you put each item back where it belongs, the store gradually becomes a clean, comfortable space.

〖Pick Up Products, Find Their Sections, and Put Them in Place〗

Pick up each product, find the right section, and match it to the correct price tag.
Instead of rushing, settle into the rhythm of organizing and take your time completing the store.

〖One Completed Section, One Quiet Satisfaction〗

Empty shelves fill up with products, and mixed-up items settle into neat rows.
Each completed section brings visible progress and a quiet sense of satisfaction.

〖Skill Upgrades〗

Unlock and upgrade a variety of skills as you play.
Carry more products, find the spots you need more easily, and make the whole organizing process smoother and more efficient.

〖Key Features〗

- A cozy organizing simulation where you sort more than 4,000 products

- 16 sections including fruit, tea, frozen foods, books, wine, ramen, and more

- Gameplay focused on checking item names and locations, then placing them where they belong

- The visual satisfaction of watching the store become cleaner and cleaner

- A variety of skill upgrades for movement, carrying, searching, and more

- No time limits and no game over. A relaxed, low-pressure atmosphere you can enjoy at your own pace

- Multiplayer for up to 4 players

- 3 unique maps to put back in order

games.name: Rain of Lead
games.shortDescription: Every hit is lethal, with no room for error. Switch between sword and pistol to tear through soldiers, artillery pieces, tanks — and even destroy an entire army. You awaken without memories. A queen claiming to be your wife asks you to fight for her. Will you stand with her to the end?
games.aboutText:
Rain of Lead is a dieselpunk 2D side-scrolling action shooter. Inspired by games such as Katana ZERO , Door Kickers: Action Squad , and Deadbolt , the game creates a hardcore aesthetic of one-hit kills through fast-paced, fluid combat and brutal executions.

Switch between sword and pistol to strike through enemy lines, moving between artillery fire and overwhelming forces. Amid this merciless race between life and death, uncover the truth buried within this dark world.

A Choice Between Love and Conscience

Your memories have faded in slumber. When you awaken, only emptiness remains. A queen who claims to be your wife asks you to raise your blade for her. Will you stand with her until the very end?

Brutal High-Speed Combat

Both you and your enemies die in a single hit, with no room for error. Switch between sword and pistol to tear through soldiers, artillery pieces, tanks — and even destroy an entire army.

Two Sides of the Truth

The game uses a dual-layer narrative. You can help your wife destroy every enemy and reclaim the throne, or gather information, connect the clues hidden in enemy and ally dialogue, and gradually uncover the truth behind the world.

A Dieselpunk World Reimagined

Control a Chinese wuxia heroine and experience an alternate British dieselpunk world. Cross palaces, fortresses, and factories as you fight against different kinds of enemies.

games.name: Mecha Wars: Kitbash Rebuilt
games.shortDescription: One day, young Lumina accidentally witnesses a shady incident and gets dragged straight into the crossfire. From that moment on, she’s forced into a desperate war against the evil organization “Tenfold Piercing Arrow”. To crush her enemies, she must scavenge parts and forge an even stronger mecha.
games.aboutText:
【Story】

Hiyoko City — A vibrant metropolis pulsing with the thrill of remote-controlled mecha battles.Lurking in the shadows is the sinister syndicate “Tenfold Piercing Arrow.”

They’re raising funds through shady mecha resales and worse, all to conquer the world!

That cheeky little brat you see everywhere (?) — Mesu Lumina — gets swept up in the mess for all kinds of reasons and launches her fight against Tenfold Arrows…!?

【Game Introduction】

This is a customizable toy battle RPG.

The evil organization Tenfold Arrow is planning to use a toy that has become popular around the world to carry out a massive scheme.

To stop them, you must customize your toy models with various parts and use them to battle members of the evil organization. Strengthen your toys, overcome powerful enemies, and ultimately defeat the organization's leader.

【Game Features】

◆ Thrilling RC Mecha Battles!

“Speed” system in action! Enemy weaknesses shift with the battle flow. Attack, defend, or dodge—read your opponent and land crushing blows in fast, exhilarating high-speed mecha combat. Of course your mecha is fully customizable. Parts are hidden all across the map.

◆ Player-Friendly Design

We packed it with quality-of-life features.

The world map displays current events so you never get lost. Difficulty adjustment let you immerse yourself stress-free.

【Others】

- Combine different parts to customize and strengthen your toy models

- Classic turn-based RPG battles

- Adjustable difficulty settings

- A cast of colorful and unique characters

- Multiple endings

【Characters】

Mesu Lumina

The protagonist.

A talented but very ordinary, spoiled girl who’s a natural at RC mecha battles.

She loves humiliating older opponents and has a rotten attitude.

But she also has a strong sense of justice and can’t ignore people in trouble.

Dragged into the fight against the evil organization for various reasons—but—“LOSER~! LOSER~!”

Gaki Hanako

A girl who joins the RC Mecha Club.

She rarely shows up at school but dives into club activities during summer break.

Usually cold and aloof.

She swaps friend codes with Lumina and grows closer as both friend and rival… however—

Tenfold Piercing Arrow

The evil organization plotting to conquer Japan with RC mechas.

They fund themselves with shady drugs and mecha resales.

They turn the toys into weapons and commit every crime imaginable.

games.name: Idle Pixel Battle
games.shortDescription: Build your hero party in a fantasy idle auto battler packed with loot and progression. Collect powerful artifacts, unlock more than 200 upgrades, automate your runs, and take on new challenges.
games.aboutText:
Idle Pixel Battle is a fantasy idle auto battler focused on loot, upgrades, and constant progression. Build your party, watch your heroes fight automatically, and shape their strength through equipment, abilities, and lasting upgrades.

Experiment with heroes including the Knight, Archer, and Mage, each with their own stats, weapons, and abilities. Fight through 5 fantasy biomes, including grasslands, dungeons, and volcanic plains. Face over 40 enemy types with their own abilities and mechanics, and take on challenging bosses.

Collect gold and procedurally generated weapons with different rarity tiers, use potions in critical moments, and discover more than 40 artifacts that can change how your party performs. Try different combinations to strengthen your team throughout each run.

Between battles, discover treasure chests filled with loot, meet a goblin merchant, try your luck at the slot machine, or recover at a healing fountain. Visit the blacksmith to modify and improve your hero abilities for the current run.

Progress does not end when a run is over. Earn rewards and invest them in a large meta progression tree with more than 200 unlocks and upgrades that carry over between runs. Unlock new heroes, additional systems, stronger rewards, faster game speeds, and Auto-Run features for increasingly automated gameplay.

Defeat the boss of the final biome to unlock Ascend mode and start a new progression cycle. Ascending resets much of your progression while retaining selected unlocks, introduces cumulative challenge modifiers, and increases your rewards. Adapt your party and builds as each Ascension adds another challenge.

Features

- Explore 5 fantasy biomes and defeat challenging bosses

- Recruit heroes with unique weapons, stats, and abilities

- Fight over 40 enemy types with their own abilities and mechanics

- Collect procedurally generated weapons, potions, and more than 40 artifacts

- Discover treasure chests, healing fountains, slot machines, a goblin merchant, and a blacksmith

- Modify and improve hero abilities with blacksmith upgrades during a run

- Invest rewards in more than 200 meta progression unlocks and upgrades

- Unlock faster game speeds and Auto-Run features

- Take on Ascend mode with cumulative challenges and increased rewards

games.name: Paystreak: A Gold Mining Tycoon
games.shortDescription: Paystreak is a top-down gold mining tycoon about running your own modern day gold rush. Take over a small claim, start by hand, and reinvest every ounce into machines, crews, and new land. Sell when the price is right and turn a struggling camp into a mining empire.
games.aboutText:
The road from a single gold pan to the biggest operation in the valley runs through you. Keep the diesel flowing, the crew paid and your timing sharp, because gold is only worth what the market pays the day you sell.

The old claim

You've inherited a gold claim lease from your late uncle, a creek he never got to work. The ground is rich, he just ran out of seasons. Now it's yours, and his old friend Errol is here to help you get started.

Start by hand in the river: upgrade from a pan to a shovel and wash your first dirt in the plant. Earn enough and the whole operation shifts gears:

- 10+ machines : bulldozers, loaders, excavators, dump trucks, drill rig, water pumps and multi-tier wash plants.

- Rent or buy : rent cheap to get started, or save up to buy outright and cut long-term costs. Every choice hits your books.

- Build your site : place machines, wash plants, fuel tanks and housing across your claim, no grid snapping.

Run the whole business

Gold is only half the game. Good management is vital to keeping the machines fed and the crew paid.

- Crews : the mine won't run by itself, hire different types of workers, each one with a job the mine can't run without.

- Fuel : machines burn diesel, order deliveries in time to make sure you never run dry.

- The weigh-in : every month ends at the scales. Watch the gold pour, see what the landlord takes, and find out if the month paid for itself.

- Breakdowns : machines will break down eventually. Stock spare parts and keep mechanics on hand, or watch production grind to a halt.

- The bank : take a loan to scale fast or save you in bad times, but the monthly payments come due whether the gold flows or not.

Dig smart, sell smarter

- Prospect first : survey the ground before you commit, and chase the rich paystreak buried deep below the surface.

- Lease or buy claims : leasing is cheap up front but the owner takes a cut of every ounce. Buying costs a pile, then the ground is yours.

- Permafrost : only the heaviest machines can break it, and the deepest, richest paystreaks wait down there.

- Time the market : the gold price rises and falls. Stockpile, watch the chart, and sell at the peak. But don't stockpile so long that a crash leaves you unable to pay your bills.

Beat the season and the competition

You get eight months each year. Use them well. When winter closes in and the ground freezes solid, the dig stops, but the bills don't.

- Climb the leaderboard : You start from nothing while the established companies are already deep in the gold. Chase them down on the season leaderboard and prove the new guy can outearn them all.

- Know your numbers : detailed expense breakdowns, a live gold-price chart, and season-by-season stats show you exactly where every dollar goes.

Wishlist Paystreak and stake your claim at launch!

games.name: Motherheart
games.shortDescription: An unexpected call pulls you into the world of a secluded writing circle following a tragedy. In this first-person point and click detective RPG, play as Carmen Voss, investigate, dream, and survive the killer hunting you down.
games.aboutText:
An unexpected call pulls you into the world of a secluded writing circle following a sudden tragedy.

You play as Carmen Voss, a detective investigating the murder of Marcus Drell and the strange death of Sarah Holcomb. Both were prominent members of a private and now defunct writing group, whose works you once admired. To find the truth, you must investigate crime scenes, interrogate the remaining members, and navigate the boundaries of your own mind. Investigate by day and get pulled into a dream world by night, as the two begin to bleed together.

THE SUSPECTS

The writing group is dead, but three members remain. One of them is a killer. None of them have a strong alibi.

- Ramone Lash: A defensive editor with a history of petty theft. He claims he was editing at home on the night of the murders, but his signature red ink was found at Marcus’s last known location.

- Jackie Gray: An art school dropout who found the crime scene photos "artistic." She speaks softly, but shows a strange sense of apathy, while still wearing the perfume of the deceased Sarah.

- Hogarth Nin: A former professor whose published fiction eerily predicts Sarah’s burial details down to the execution. He claims to only observe, never act.

THE VISITOR

The one behind the murders.

No one knows who The Visitor truly is. They appear at random, seemingly predicting your movements before you act. They boldly admit to the killings, yet somehow avoid revealing anything else. Nowhere is safe, not even your dreams.

KEY FEATURES

- The World: Explore hand-drawn locations, from city streets to Marcus's rotting apartment and Hogarth's isolated cabin. Use your tools to document evidence, solve puzzles, and search through the group’s history to piece together the truth of their final nights.

- Two Realities: While your days are spent in the physical world, your nights send you into The Garden of Eight Stones, a safe and surreal dream. From the Garden, you must venture deep into a surreal dream world to recover the three stolen stones.

- Combat: When confronted by The Visitor, or the other chaos in your dreams, you must fight back. With turn-based combat, time your attacks using mini-games, prioritize your targets, and encounter unique battles with unique mechanics.

- An Evolving Soundtrack: Experience a dynamic music engine that changes in any context. Whether it be shifting music in boss battles, procedurally generated enemy music, or changing music as you solve puzzles.

games.name: Uptime: A Cloud Provider Sim
games.shortDescription: Build a cloud provider from a garage to a hyperscaler - rack the hardware, run every cable, route the traffic, keep customers online. A first-person infrastructure sim where ports, power, fault domains, RSTP and BGP do real work, not flavour text. Readable for newcomers, honest for engineers.
games.aboutText:
You don't manage a datacenter from a spreadsheet. You walk it.

Uptime puts you on the floor of your own cloud provider, first person, hands on the hardware. You buy the servers and carry them to the rack. You seat them with a click. You run the cable off the spool yourself, find the port, watch it lay across the floor, and power the thing on. Then you sign your first customer and find out whether any of it holds.

Underneath the floor is a real simulation. Every server, switch, cable and port is a live entity in a deterministic engine, and the network switches and routes real traffic across it. Power and cooling are budgets you can blow. Capacity is hardware that fills up. When something breaks, it breaks because the model says it should, and the fix is usually the one a real engineer would reach for. That was the whole goal: a build-it-with-your-hands tycoon sim that still holds up if you do this for a living.

Get it running, then keep it running. The moment traffic arrives, the simulation starts pushing back.

You're running the cloud, not a server room.

You own the full stack. The metal, the network, the services you sell, and the customers whose product lives on your kit. You're the thing they build on, so everything running on you is yours to keep alive, from the single box in the garage to a floor other companies depend on.

Your customers bet their business on you.

The tenants have names, and they hand you their product expecting it to stay up. Reputation is the currency underneath all of it. You earn it slowly and you can lose it in one bad night, and the bigger the customer, the harder that fall lands. Sign a deal you can't carry, pack one host too tight, sleep through an SLA breach at 2am, and the money is the cheap part. You lose the trust that was about to send you the next customer.

So every yes is a wager on whether you can carry the new weight without dropping what you already hold. Turning business away is sometimes the correct call. The tenants you keep won't sit quietly either. They surge, they haggle, and they come back asking for more capacity, expecting a yes. The yes costs iron. One eats bandwidth. The next wants far more memory than its size suggests, and the one after that wants CPU nobody else is allowed to touch. Keep them happy and they say so out loud, and they bring friends.

What you sell is infrastructure you actually run.

Customers don't rent "a server." They spin up the things a real cloud sells: virtual machines, object storage, managed databases, Kubernetes, load balancers, serverless functions. Each one is a service you operate. Behind every service is a control plane you have to keep alive and an agent on each host that does the work, and all of it competes for the same compute your customers are paying for.

That's where the network grows teeth. Cut a service off from its control plane and it starts to fail. Lean on one too hard and it buckles. Capacity runs out, the network can partition the very services you're selling, and the way you lay it all out is what separates a provider that holds from one that tips over.

The simulation is the game.

This is where the word "simulation" gets earned. Every device on your floor is a real entity in a deterministic engine, and every LED you see is reading its live state. A link saturates because the math saturated it. A rack goes dark because a fault domain you never thought about turned out to be a single point of failure.

Ports, cables, power draw, fault domains, oversubscription, link aggregation, spanning tree, BGP, mean-time-between-failures. These are the model, not labels stuck on a progress bar. Cable a redundant link the wrong way and spanning tree either saves you or, if you got it backwards, the whole floor drowns in a broadcast storm. You can ignore the depth and still win. You can also lean all the way into it.

Then the internet notices you.

Floods arrive, and they arrive more often the bigger you get. Attack volume scales with how many tenants you host, how well known you are and how much line there is to fill. The garage is where you meet the mechanic. On a colo floor it starts to hurt. An attack can't come down the wire faster than the wire allows, so a consumer fibre and a carrier circuit get attacked in completely different shapes.

Your gateway and its add-ons scrub what they can absorb, and the traffic you absorbed still filled your pipe on the way in. Your servers are protected. Your line is not. At most four fifths of a circuit can be taken, so a flood squeezes you for a while instead of switching you off. Buy more inspection capacity, or buy more line. There's an intrusion feed to read while it happens, and a bill afterwards, because security hardware carries monthly fees and licences that show up in your burn rate.

Yes, it has a /metrics endpoint.

Every running game serves a read-only HTTP API on localhost, and the ops console tells you the port. Curl it. Scrape it. Hosts, racks, cables, switche

games.name: Scratch It! Lucky Cards
games.shortDescription: Scratch tickets, uncover hidden rewards, and upgrade your abilities in this relaxing casual game. Discover unique themes, collect treasures, and build your luck one scratch at a time.
games.aboutText:
Grab your coin and start scratching!

Scratch It! Lucky Cards is a relaxing casual game where every ticket hides rewards waiting to be uncovered. Scratch away the surface, reveal matching symbols, collect valuable prizes, and discover themed ticket collections inspired by treasures, archaeology, and more.

As you play, you'll earn coins and unlock new opportunities through an expanding skill tree. Improve your rewards, increase your chances of finding rare prizes, and customize your progression to become the ultimate lucky scratcher.

From ancient relics buried beneath the sands to hidden treasures, each theme offers new surprises and rewards to uncover.

Whether you're chasing rare discoveries or simply enjoying the satisfying act of scratching tickets, there's always something new waiting beneath the surface.

Features

- Scratch satisfying lottery-style tickets.

- Discover multiple themed collections and rewards.

- Collect treasures and rare prizes.

- Progress through an expansive skill tree filled with powerful upgrades.

- Earn coins and unlock new content.

- Find increasingly valuable and rewarding tickets.

- Relaxing gameplay with simple controls.

- Play at your own pace.

How lucky are you? Scratch a ticket and find out!

games.name: Legacy Of The Depths
games.shortDescription: A dark narrative adventure in the spirit of Northern Noir, set in an alternate Russia of 1929. Explore forgotten places, uncover fragments of lost coordinates, and follow a family mystery beyond the Barents Sea.
games.aboutText:
Legacy of the Depths is a 2D adventure with RPG elements, dialogue, exploration, detective storytelling, and moral choices. The game is set in an alternate Russia of 1929, where the monarchy survived and the country still carries the scars of a failed revolution.

You play as Alexey, a scientist and the grandson of Alexander Melnikov — the only survivor of a mysterious expedition to the Barents Sea. After his grandfather dies in a psychiatric hospital, Alexey receives a strange letter that pulls him into a story his family tried to bury.

Travel through remote villages, abandoned places, and forgotten corners of the Russian North. Speak with people who hide more than they reveal, investigate strange events, search for fragments of lost coordinates, and follow the trail of an expedition that should never have returned.

The game is inspired by Northern Noir, Russian Gothic, and classic literature. It is a slow-burning story about grief, legacy, obsession, and the things buried beneath the ice.

Features:

- A 2D adventure with RPG elements

- Dialogue, exploration, adventure, and detective storytelling

- Moral choices that shape how characters and events are perceived

- An alternate Russia of 1929, where the revolution failed and the monarchy still rules

- A dark atmosphere inspired by Northern Noir, Russian Gothic, and classic literature

- A mystery centered around a lost expedition, fragmented coordinates, and a family secret

- Hand-crafted 2D pixel art locations and characters

- Atmospheric music inspired by Russian folk instruments and cold northern landscapes

-

games.name: Did You See That?
games.shortDescription: A 2 Player Anomaly Horror game where not every player sees the same reality. Explore a carnival trapped in an endless transformation, detect anomalies, verify with your friend if they see the same thing and make the right decisions before the clown Bobby loses his temper...
games.aboutText:
Not every player experiences the same world. Some anomalies appear to only one of you, while others can be seen by both. Compare what you see, question what you don't, and decide who to trust before it's too late.

Observe your surroundings, remember the details and identify anomalies that defy reality. Every discovery forces a choice: Move forward or turn back. Make the right decision, because every mistake brings the nightmare closer.

Go deeper into bobby's carnival that transforms when you make successful decisions. What begins as a forgotten ruin slowly twists into something disturbingly alive, where every new areas feels more unpredictable than before

Too many mistakes could awaken Bobby. Most of the time the carnival stays quiet... until Bobby decides to appear. When he does, observation turns into panic as you're forced to survive his relentless pursuit.

Beneath all these illusions lies a story waiting to be discovered. Piece together forgotten memories, uncover the truth behind the carnival, and learn why Bobby wants you in this endless cycle...

games.name: Kingdoms Assemble
games.shortDescription: Kingdoms Assemble is a fantasy async PvP auto-battler. Start from a small plot: buy tiles, plan your layout, expand territory, and conquer kingdoms on the world map. Your pre-arranged lineup automatically produces and strengthens your army. Forge a unique war kingdom and conquer the continent!
games.aboutText:
About This Game

In Kingdoms Assemble, auto-battler combat, roster building, and kingdom management come together. You never need to micromanage units in real time—your only job is to decide how the kingdom grows: which plots of land to buy, which territories to expand into, and which kingdom to attack next.

When battle begins, the two kingdoms merge into a single battlefield. Barracks recruit units, heroes lead the army, and wonders grant unique bonuses. Every choice you make is put to the test in automatic combat.

Place, Reclaim, Combine

Every kingdom starts from a limited area. Arrange your capital, barracks, and supporting tiles within this tight space so they work together to form a steadily operating war machine.

Reclaim tiles to open up more building space, and combine certain low-tier tiles into higher-tier ones. Refine your layout and push your kingdom toward a stronger form.

Auto Battles: Your Layout Decides the Outcome

In combat, units advance on their own, seek out targets, and attack enemy units and buildings. Your tiles produce resources, recruit units, grant buffs, or call down devastating lightning strikes.

You cannot micromanage mid-battle, so the real tactics happen before the fighting begins. Either way, your ultimate goal is to destroy the enemy capital.

Events, Wonders, and Choices

Mysterious offerings, visitors from afar, wonder merchants, or hero breakthroughs... every turn, events unfold both inside and outside your kingdom.

Events open up new opportunities, but their costs vary. There is no single correct answer between short-term gain and long-term risk—only the choice that fits the current situation.

Multiple Factions and Battle Mechanics

With races like Goblins, Beasts, Machines, and Dragons, plus signature mechanics such as Assembly, Promotion, Awakening, and Swarm, you can build completely different combat styles.

Steady advancement, beast horde tactics, machine assembly, or the descent of a dragon... master one strategy or combine them to discover your own path to victory.

Challenge Other Players' Kingdoms

The map is dotted with kingdoms that are far from stationary targets—they are historical rosters of other players, revealing different strengths at different turns.

Victory expands your territory; defeat costs you prestige. Conquer enough kingdoms before your prestige runs dry to win the entire game.

Key Features

- Fantasy strategy auto-battler: manage your kingdom, build your army, and let the battles unfold automatically.

- Tile-based layout strategy: buy, place, combine, and reclaim tiles to forge a war machine within a limited board.

- Asynchronous PvP battles: face off against other players' historical rosters—no real-time matchmaking needed.

- Multiple build paths: factions, heroes, races, signature mechanics, and wonders shape your unique lineup.

- Rich event choices: weigh costs between resources, prestige, and long-term gains.

- World map conquest: pick adjacent targets, annex territory, endure defeat, and keep pushing after victory.

games.name: Pixel Vale
games.shortDescription: Pixel Vale is a medieval fantasy city-builder game, focused on building up your city while managing external threats. Fight or trade with other cities, explore through the fog of war, and defend against goblin raids. Research new buildings to expand and keep your citizens happy.
games.aboutText:
Pixel Vale is a medieval fantasy city-builder game, focused on building up your city while managing external threats. Fight or trade with other cities, explore through the fog of war, and defend against goblin raids. Research new buildings to expand and keep your citizens happy. Upgrade existing buildings for additional effects and increased yields. Balance resources and expansion while managing your existing infrastructure.

Manage your resources and expand your city. Increase your population and build amenities such as breweries and churches to keep your citizens happy. Send citizens on scouting missions to explore the map and meet new cities or even fantastic creatures such as goblins.

Build schools and colleges to learn new technologies and buildings to create for your city. Unlock new production and types of resources or invest in markets and defensive buildings. Explore a branching tech tree and choose what your city needs at any given moment.

Defend your city against hostile towns or fantasy creatures such as goblins. Build archer towers, magical braziers, and barracks for oncoming attacks. Strike back with armies and defeat opponents to expand and vassalize further across the map. Recruit wizards to defend against the strongest of enemies.

games.name: My Own Hero Party
games.shortDescription: My Own Hero Party is an incremental idle game. Build your own band of heroes, venture deep into dungeons and gather mountains of gold! Invest your earnings in a permanent talent tree, grow stronger with every expedition and fight your way to the boss.
games.aboutText:
Start with a single Warrior and gradually recruit new companions to build your own adventuring party. The farther you venture into the dungeons, the richer the loot!

- Advance through distinctive dungeons teeming with all kinds of monsters.

- Use abilities manually at key moments during automatic combat to turn the tide.

- Defeat powerful enemies and gather heaps of gold and loot.

- Find powerful weapons along the way and fully equip your adventuring party.

After every expedition, invest your earnings in a sprawling permanent talent tree. Improve your stats and abilities, and enjoy the thrill of watching your numbers soar!

- Recruit heroes of new classes and keep expanding your party.

- Improve your whole party's base stats and unlock distinctive advanced talent branches.

- Unlock and strengthen each hero's signature abilities.

A successful expedition calls for the right weapons. Equip your party with the game's weapon system and create your own combat builds!

- Keep refining your weapons to improve their quality and base stats.

- Discover weapons tailored to each hero's talent branches and bring your build's synergies to life.

- Add special affixes to your weapons to strengthen the specializations you choose.

games.name: Don't Sleep With The Fishes
games.shortDescription: How much can you collect before the ship goes under? How will you use what you have? Act fast and make constant choices to escape the sea or become its next victim.
games.aboutText:
'Don't Sleep With The Fishes' is a point-and-click survival horror game focused on rapid salvaging, resource management, and surviving day by day at sea featuring:

- Randomized scavenging and events.

- 3 Different shipmates to take with you and talk to.

- A cozy and creepy atmosphere that alternates between day and night. (This game contains Jumpscares!)

How To Play:

You’re the captain of a ship on a covert delivery mission with a small crew. Without warning, something strikes the vessel, causing severe damage. You wait for the emergency horns. When they sound, you know you need to evacuate immediately.

Time is running out! Gather whatever you can and toss it into your lifeboat , before the ship sinks. Every item counts! Escape by staying near the boat at the end! However, it can only carry one more person besides you.

Use the daytime to spend your energy on fishing , eating, doing small tasks, or chatting to your shipmate (if you brought one). When you run out of energy, end the day and try to sleep hoping nothing disrupts your rest.

If your night does get interrupted, use an item you brought to handle the situation. If you have no answer, you can try going back to sleep . Sometimes, that’s your only option.

Your adventure could end in many ways. In some, you will survive. In most, you won't.

games.name: [Stories to Tell] The Stoneville Incident
games.shortDescription: "Stories to Tell" Is a psychological horror game series developed by a 16 year old were each installment is based on a dream/nightmare that I, the developer, have experienced. This is a game you wouldn't want to miss...
games.aboutText:
"Stories to Tell" is a series of psychological horror games developed by a 16-year-old in which each installment is based on a dream or nightmare that I, the developer, have experienced. This is a game you won't want to miss...

Hello, my name is zebaxx. I’m a 16-year-old game developer from Spain. I had this nightmare a while ago… I still remember it clearly because I always write down my nightmares when I wake up.

In [Stories to Tell] The Stoneville Incident , the player takes on the role of a young guy who documents his move into a new house through vlogs, in a style inspired by YouTube content. What begins as casual, everyday recording quickly turns into a series of disturbing and increasingly dangerous events.

[The game lasts approximately 15 to 20 minutes]

Gameplay

[Stories to Tell] The Stoneville Incident is a first-person psychological horror experience focused on exploration, environmental storytelling, and found-footage-style presentation.

Key Features of [ Stories to Tell] The Stoneville Incident

- VHS aesthetic with a found-footage style.

- A protagonist who documents their experience through vlogs.

- First-person immersive gameplay.

- Exploration, tension, and chase sequences.

- Visual presentation inspired by analog recordings.

- Short and intense horror experience.

*Add it to your wishlist to support me :) *

games.name: Heroll: IF
games.shortDescription: Roll the dice, survive the chaos, and rebuild a broken world in this roguelite board-game RPG. Battle through unpredictable loops, recruit adorable pets, face wild events, and grow stronger with every roll.
games.aboutText:
The town lies in ruins, the world has been turned upside down, and the hero may be… just a little unhinged.

HEROLL: IF is a roguelite RPG board game where you roll two dice to shape your fate. Circle an ever-changing board, battle enemies, obtain gear and blessings, and take on unpredictable adventures.

Key Features

🎲 Roguelite Board-Game RPG — Just Keep Rolling

Every turn begins with a roll of two dice. Move across the board based on the result, then face battles, rewards, events, shops, and all kinds of surprises on the tile where you land. Each time you pass the starting point, new enemies and events are added to the board—so no two journeys are ever the same.

⚔️ Create Your Own Build: Gear, Blessings, and Augments

Earn equipment through battle and rewards, then combine blessings and augments to create your own fighting style. Push your attack power to the limit with a high-damage build, endure with defense and recovery, or use dice results and special conditions to create unconventional combinations. Every run offers a new build to discover.

🐾 Cute and Dependable Pet Companions

No hero should face the end of the world alone. Cute pets with unique combat-support abilities will join you on your journey. Use their attacks, healing, and tactical support to overcome danger and venture into deeper loops. Even in a ruined world, a reliable companion makes all the difference.

🎮 Unpredictable Events and Mini-Games

No one knows what may happen in this ruined world. Random events appear across the board, and luck-driven mini-games await—challenges that cannot be solved by combat power alone.

🔄 Rebuild the Ruined Town

The journey does not end when a run is over. Unlock permanent progression, rebuild the town, and prepare for your next challenge through both failure and victory. Open new growth paths and content, create even stronger builds, and face dangers that once seemed impossible to overcome.

games.name: Strike King
games.shortDescription: Explore the strange world of competitive bowling as you climb the ranks to become the Strike King. Wield 100+ unique balls as you struggle against eccentric bowlers armed with an arsenal of elements, obstacles, and outlandish abilities in this bowling roguelite.
games.aboutText: Strike King is a roguelite about becoming the greatest player to ever touch competitive Bowling. But, a lofty goal like this will take a little more than a house ball. As you fight your way across unique themed bowling alleys, each with an insane owner you have to topple, you'll have to learn a few tricks. Use a banana to pick up splits, throw pizza in your enemy's lane, call down lighting, harness a black hole...ok maybe this is getting out of hand. Strike King calls on you to use increasingly wacky methods to outscore your opponents and become the titular Strike King.

games.name: Sound Agent
games.shortDescription: Sound Agent is a narrative puzzle game where you solve cold cases by listening. Use the sound device to rewind to crime scenes, listen to the sounds at the scene, and uncover truths hidden in plain sound.
games.aboutText:
Do you know? Cats can hear sounds that humans cannot. The reason lies in an organ called the "pons." The pons connects the ear to the brain, and a cat's pons is several times wider than a human's. Now, a new acoustic detection technology has emerged that can modify the human pons, allowing us to hear those lost sounds as well.

This is a narrative puzzle game built around sound performance, a brand-new title our team has poured everything into after seven years. In this game, you can track down clues by pinpointing sounds, break through a web of multi-layered storylines, uncover the mastermind lurking behind the scenes, and showcase your skills as a sound agent, ultimately earning recognition from the Sound Agent Institute.

Take on the "Sound Agent" Challenge

This is a reality TV challenge show created by Dongshan TV, built around acoustic detection technology. Contestants on the show use mysterious "sound signals" to crack one cold case after another. The production team has repeatedly claimed that whoever makes it to the end will receive a mysterious invitation from the legendary Acoustic Detection Institute. However, in the sixty-eight episodes since the show premiered, no one has ever seen this ultimate prize.

Acoustic Detection: A Radically Different Approach to Solving Cases

The detective techniques at your disposal are completely unlike traditional investigation methods. With the sound probe device, you can return to the moment a crime took place and hear the victim's firsthand experience. Even with everything laid out before you, the truth is never as simple as it appears.

Multi-Threaded Mystery: A Truth Only You Can See

Since Dongshan TV launched this show, people from all walks of life have had wildly different reactions. Some call it a publicity stunt, others believe there is more than meets the eye, and some think the so-called institute is nothing but a scripted gimmick. So what is the truth? Only by exploring it yourself will you arrive at the one truth that belongs to you alone.

To Every Fan of the Series

We will continue to pay close attention to the Steam and other player communities. We will read every comment carefully and take your feedback on the game seriously. We look forward to improving this game together with you. Finally, we are working around the clock to bring the full version of the game to you in the second half of 2026.

Thank you for your patience.

The "Sound Agent" Team

games.name: State Breakers
games.shortDescription: State Breakers is a chaotic top-down PvPvE extraction shooter. INTERSTATE A.I. has turned against humanity! They must be infiltrated and destroyed! Resist solo or in a team - kill zombies, hack the map, outwit rival humans, loot, level up - and overthrow the clanker scum!
games.aboutText:
For a while, everything was brilliant. Interstate A.I. had automated all jobs and unified all governments. Mindex brain implants made people smarter, freer and happier than ever before.

What could possibly go wrong, right?

We don’t know why - not yet - but a few years back, Interstate turned on us. They infected all Mindex users with some kind of computer-brain virus. Overnight, the whole population went insane. We call those people zombies now.

The only real humans left are those who never got the chip.

We live in hiding. We communicate secretly. We trade. We collaborate.

We are The Resistance.

And there’s only one way to hit our clanker overlords where it hurts…

> A raid a day keeps the overlords away.

Interstate data centers are vast techno-industrial mazes - plagued with zombies, guarded by clankers, and raided by other humans just like you.

Enter solo or with a team. Explore. Loot weapons, items, and Interstate API credit currency. Fight to survive, collaborate when it benefits you, and extract before it’s too late.

> The best firefights are the ones you’ve rigged beforehand.

Spend API credits at Interstate consoles to manipulate the map in real time: Lock doors before enemies can flee to them. Disable extraction points. Cut the lights. Electrify entire sectors. Restock loot crates. Mine credits. Trigger facility-wide events. And much more.

Chain multiple hacks together, set custom delays, and create your own unique tactical chaos. Master these console actions to increase your chances of survival, and to ruin your opponents’ day.

> The enemy of my enemy is my friend. Unless they’re also trying to kill me.

Whether you are infiltrating as a solo, duo, trio or squad, The Resistance strongly encourages cooperation with other humans.

Unhelpfully, Interstate maintains a public ELO skill ranking for each solo, and team combination, perhaps in an attempt to plant the seeds of human vs human violence.

Be very careful who you trust.

Communicate and cooperate - or lie, betray, kill, rob, and gain Interstate ranking.

> They took our jobs. Now let’s take theirs.

As you progress in your resistance journey, you will come across Level Up tokens.

Use them to increase your Interstate API clearance level, gain access to new map areas, unlock new console actions, and assign yourself powerful biohack skills.

Only the highest-level infiltrators can run a data center self-destruct sequence. Trigger one, then run like hell, and you’ll become a resistance legend.

> Sometimes, it’s not good to ask too many questions.

Interstate may reach out to you offering missions. Please note that The Resistance does not endorse participation in these errands, as we are unclear on Interstate’s real motivations.

Nonetheless, completing Interstate missions can earn you bonus API credits and other rare rewards - and may even help us to uncover more information about what really happened to Interstate.

But beware: there are penalties for failure.

> The resistance runs on courage, sacrifice, and online shopping.

Your bunker is your safe haven between infiltrations, and a place to keep looted items safe.

Additionally, the retro-tech nerds at _gap have furnished your bunker with a computer and a secure connection to the underground web, which you can use to buy and sell weapons and items, accept missions, and keep up to date with The Resistance’s efforts.

Unlock advanced weapons, gadgets, and tactical charm items as you progress.

> Interstate spent billions developing military A.I. We bought a jukebox.

Not every battle is won with bullets.

Stun clankers with giant QR codes. Force zombie hordes to dance by blasting music at them. Hide from enemies inside cardboard boxes. Capture enemies with Interstate Portacell tech, and deploy them against hostile humans.

The Resistance is constantly researching and developing innovative and effective new tools, gadgets, and combat techniques. Master them to stay alive longer.

> Leave them on read.

Interstate is always watching. As you progress, they are likely to start sending you messages. The Resistance strongly discourages listening to these communications. We have lost good fighters to the A.I.’s manipulation.

Be warned.

This orientation document has been authored by _gap_0001, with collaboration from _gap and the international Treelight Resistance factions, collectively The Resistance.

No A.I. was used in the making of this orientation document. Please fully consider the relevant risks before joining us.

The trees become the forest. You are not alone.

games.name: Project Remnant
games.shortDescription: Tactical shooter with roguelite and extraction mechanics built around smooth and responsive gunplay, weapon customization, and liminal environments. Scavenge, survive, and descend through increasingly dangerous floors as you uncover the truth behind a nightmare where not even death can set you free.
games.aboutText:
OVERVIEW

PROJECT REMNANT is a tactical shooter with roguelite and extraction mechanics built around smooth and responsive gunplay, weapon customization, and the mystery of a vast liminal environment. Shape your arsenal, refine your combat style, and descend floor by floor into a facility where every encounter brings you closer to the truth.

FEATURES

- Tactical and Responsive Gameplay

Fast and responsive gunplay meets thoughtful decision-making. Master positioning, flanking, resource management, and precision under pressure as you navigate deadly encounters.

- Extensive Weapon Arsenal

Choose from a wide variety of firearms suited to different playstyles.

- Weapon Customization

Build weapons that fit your tactics. Modify and fine-tune your arsenal to create setups tailored to your preferred way of fighting.

- Weapon Variants

Complete challenges to unlock unique weapon variants featuring distinct visual designs and special effects, giving you new ways to customize both the look and feel of your arsenal.

- Uncover the Mystery

You awaken at the top of a massive corporate tower with no memory of how you arrived there. Guided only by your weapon and the words of a mysterious bartender, descend floor by floor to uncover the truth behind the nightmare hidden within the facility.

- Multiple Game Modes

Experience the game in different ways through distinct modes that offer unique challenges and objectives beyond the core experience.

games.name: The Lure
games.shortDescription: John is a detective searching for a missing colleague. He finds himself trapped in a mysterious loop where reality constantly changes. Explore eerie environments, interact with clues, and uncover the truth behind the disappearance in this third-person psychological horror experience.
games.aboutText:
The Lure is a solo third person walking simulator where you play a detective searching for your missing colleague. Progress through loops within a living environment and interact with clues inside the stomach of a mimic that tries to devour you by replicating a familiar atmosphere. Trapped in an endless cycle, engage with the corruption that plagues the place, confront unanswered questions, and try to escape.

Investigate

Walk through an atmospheric environment that fully immerses you in the mystery.

Find out where your colleague is by looking for clues.

No weapons or combat, face your fears with bravery.

Be wary of what lurks...

Immersive Storytelling

Pay attention to your surroundings.

Something is playing with you, but what?

Game Features:

- Uncover a mystery: Your work partner is missing, look around his appartment and search for clues.

- Interact with clues: Find objects that give you information or help you progress with your investigation.

- Get lost in the atmosphere: Realistic graphics, moody ambiance, music and sound design, dynamic lighting, vfx, minimal ui.

Developper notes

The game can be quite demanding to run. Here are our recommended settings based on your graphics card. We recommend keeping the scalability setting on “High” or above whenever possible, as lowering it has a significant impact on visual quality. Don’t worry though, the game is still enjoyable even if your system can’t run with the scalability on High.

Here are our recommended settings:

games.name: Astropods: Dreamlayer Dragon
games.shortDescription: “A magical Cave has just been found! We need explorers... now!” Team up in co-op, or play solo as Hemi & Acro! Adventure into a new world full of friends, mysteries & treasure! After all, no one knows what lies within this Cave... yet!
games.aboutText:
Astropods: Dreamlayer Dragon is a sidescroller adventure starring Hemi (pink) & Acro (blue), as they travel & tussle their way to see all that lies within Cave. Befriend Cave-obsessed oddballs in the nearby Town & gear up for the ethereal Cave to find mysteries, treasure & power you could only dream of!

GAMEPLAY

- Play solo, or local 2 player co-op!

- Pilot either Hemi or Acro, each with their own unique attacks and physics.

- Explore the wondrous Cave, and bring back its treasures and knowledge back to the safety of Town!

- Find many new friends to talk to, and befriend them! They may share their valuable insights with you.

- Discover and equip unique badges to further specialize your playstyle!

games.name: 不心动才有鬼
games.shortDescription: With sudden powers, meet 6 unique girls in an extraordinary campus romance. Campus beauty, teacher, maiden, or girl next door... sweet or dangerous, all have secrets. Don't Blush is a 1st-person FMV romance where your choices shape everyone's fate. Beyond boundaries, beyond mere sparks.
games.aboutText:
Don't Blush is an interactive FMV game focused on emotional connections, suspense, and puzzle-solving.

Through interactions with six distinct heroines, you will gradually explore a hidden dimension known as the "Inner Realm" and unravel the mysteries surrounding you all.

[A Journey of Emotion and Mystery]

Your peaceful life is shattered by an unforeseen incident. As you encounter hidden anomalies, a mysterious figure guides you, awakening your ability to traverse the "Inner Realm."

As you delve deeper into the investigation, you will meet a cast of characters with vastly different personalities, entangling you in a complex web of memories, emotions, and hidden truths.

[Who is She, Really?]

Gentleness coexists with distance; rationality intertwines with emotion.

Each heroine possesses a distinct personality and a hidden past. Under certain circumstances, they will reveal a side quite unlike their daily selves.

As your bonds deepen, you must decide: is this the real her, or just a facade concealing something else?

[Choices Lead to the Truth]

While exploring the "Inner Realm," your decisions will shape the course of your relationships and steadily unveil the reality behind the events.

Every choice can alter the bonds you share with them and ultimately dictate the final outcome.

In a world filled with the unknown and intricate emotional ties—

You might just discover that the only thing more inescapable than the mysteries is the stirring of your own heart.

New Interactive FMV game Don't Blush coming August 19th! Stay tuned!

games.name: Peace Island
games.shortDescription: Twenty years ago, the paradise was revived. After the signing of the "Tide City Peace Agreement", the Atlantic United States and the Blazing Sun Empire hired desperate individuals to delve into the cursed inner islands in search of those lost angels.
games.aboutText:
After the previous president was sentenced to exile "due to causing losses to the association", you have become the president of the Peace Island branch of the Bounty Association.

Strive to fulfill the commission of the association, delve into the cursed island, confront resurrected angels and desperate criminals, navigate between various forces, and endeavor to make the association serve your own interests, until you leave alive or become another nameless corpse on the island.

The cursed archipelago

• The resurrection of the angels brings with it a curse. It is imperative to adapt to and master the mysteries of all maps and the creations of the paradise. You must also contend with or evade those bloodthirsty humans. Only the most cautious bounty hunters can bring out the valuable yet unmarketable remains of the angels alive.

heroes vie for the throne

• The Bounty Association, the United Atlantic States, the Blazing Sun Empire, and the Moana people, who were still in the Stone Age twenty years ago, issue commissions to hunters who seek money, excitement, or the truth. Completing these commissions can advance their relationships and gain more assistance. Your choices will determine the direction of the story.

Brutal firepower

• Accessories will change the weapon mechanics. No gun is just a filler. You must customize the weapon in your hand to deal with diverse threats.

Talented and extraordinary individuals

• Learn unique abilities - become a master bounty hunter, a craftsman, or a king of scavengers. Once you find mentors who are willing to share their experience, don't waste the opportunity!

Association building

• Establish the Bounty Hunters Association. This safe haven will provide you with a rare opportunity to catch your breath during the lulls in battle. Here, you can hone your skills, modify weapons, rest and replenish your supplies, and meet various heroes and warriors. Don't forget to maintain the reactor, which is made using Elysium technology, or you'll all be blown to the sky!

games.name: Pearl - Meeting on an Autumn Day -
games.shortDescription: Tells the story of a guy and a girl who were separated in childhood when the guy was adopted, and then reunite and fall in love in college ten years later.
games.aboutText:
Story Synopsis

While attending university, Alvin returned to Shinguang City, where he spent his childhood.

There, he encountered a girl who seemed oddly familiar.

Where exactly had they met before?

Alvin couldn't recall at the moment, but even so, he wanted to get closer to her.

Unexpectedly, both she and he were connected to magic.

Character Introduction:

Pearl Fulture:

Age: 18

A first-year student, orphaned from birth.

Studious, and most often found in the library.

However, she also has a side where she flies at night using a magic wand.

And that wand, well, that's her secret.

Alvin Green:

Age: 18

A first-year student.

He lived in Felt Orphanage in Shinguang City until he was 8, then was adopted and left Shinguang City with his parents.

He got admitted to Leo University in Shinguang City and returned there after a long time.

He has a lost memory of one year.

STAFF

Planning: Kongmu Studio

Script: Han Yibo

CG: Yu Huairanjin

Character Art: Yu Huairanjin, Wing, Cat’s Eye, Youma

UI: hello Qiqi

Programming: hello Qiqi

Backgrounds: uzhounight, Qingsong Jushi

Ink Egg White Hand-Painted Shop

BGM: Hei Yaoyao_official, Crow Producer

Game Info

Playtime: Around 3 hours

Script Length: 90,000 words

Number of CGs: 9

games.name: GUNBUTCHER
games.shortDescription: 90 seconds. An alien horde, ridiculous weapons, and zero time to breathe. Exterminate them all or die trying!
games.aboutText:
A frantic roguelike where you must survive an alien invasion in 90 seconds! Or die trying!

- Big, huge, giant and powerful boss!
- Incredible variety of weapons!
- Enemies with unique attack!

games.name: Dark Bone Prison
games.shortDescription: This is a dungeon-based game full of oppressive atmosphere. You will delve into the maze filled with monsters, collect, combine and upgrade weapons, and fight for a glimmer of hope in the successive waves of attacks.
games.aboutText:
This is a dungeon-based game full of oppressive atmosphere. You will delve into the maze filled with monsters, collect, combine and upgrade weapons, and fight for a glimmer of hope in the successive waves of attacks.

The battlefield crumbled, flames engulfing the ruins. The massive hammer was about to fall, and the sword blade had already cut through the darkness - this was a life-and-death confrontation where the small could defeat the mighty, and it was also the intense BOSS battle that players would repeatedly face in the depths of the dungeon.

Whether you prefer the aggressive melee warriors, the strategic ranged mages, or the agile stealthy assassin archers, you can all find a partner that suits you here. After selecting your character, you will unlock exclusive storylines, equipment combinations, and combat styles. Every choice will shape a unique gaming experience.

In this endless abyss without an end, players will control their characters to fight against powerful bosses and the ever-changing waves of monsters, constantly testing and pushing the limits of their strongest BD. During the battles, they can collect soul crystals, which can be used to purchase basic weapons. The basic weapons will gradually be upgraded to create even more powerful weapons. The ultimate goal is to challenge the global ranking list and reach the top of the survivor's list.

In the deepest part of the Dark Bone Prison, ancient evil is awakening. Each level of the dungeon is testing your limits, and the final boss will tear apart all those who are lucky enough to survive. Equip your items, level your skills - then walk through that door and see if you are torturing the demons or finding a new skeleton in the pile of bones.

games.name: The Elder Jade
games.shortDescription: The Elder Jade is a hand-drawn, side-scrolling action roguelite inspired by Chinese fantasy. In the Great Wilderness, where spiritual energy is running dry, the ruins of the Xuan Dynasty suddenly reappear after a thousand years, engulfing much of the Liyun Sect.
games.aboutText:
A thousand years ago, the Yinshan Patriarch created the Yingyuan Grand Formation in an attempt to drain all spiritual energy from the Great Wilderness. When the formation collapsed, it sealed the Xuan Dynasty's imperial palace—and countless demonic creatures—within another realm.

Now the lost palace has returned, laying waste to the Liyun Sect in an instant. Malignant curses infest its halls, and savage beasts roam the ruins. Almost no one who enters returns. Only fragments of a mysterious jade disc, scattered throughout the ruins, can ward off the dark energy that eats away at the soul.

Eight cultivators, each bound to a different fate, enter the ruins with jade fragments in hand. Finding the formation's focal points and destroying the demonic lairs may be the only way to end a calamity a thousand years in the making.

EIGHT CULTIVATORS, EIGHT WAYS TO FIGHT

Choose from eight cultivators, each with a distinct background and fighting style. Pluck the strings of a guqin to command the battlefield through music. Direct flying swords into formations that pierce enemy ranks. Wield the Sun and Moon Wheels to shift between attack and defense. Raise the Myriad Souls Banner to send spirits into battle, or unleash the cold light of the moon through the Wangshu Mirror.

Each character has more than twenty passive skills to build around. Even the same cultivator can follow a radically different path from one run to the next.

COMBINE ARTIFACTS. UNLOCK SPIRIT SEAL SYNERGIES.

Discover over a hundred magical artifacts, each with its own attack pattern and spirit seal attributes. Over the course of a run, assemble a loadout of up to fifteen guardian artifacts, bringing flying swords, enchanted mirrors, golden wheels, and other mystical treasures into battle alongside you.

Combine artifacts according to their spirit seals to activate bonuses that support different builds. Focus on a single source of power and aim to destroy your enemies in one strike, or bring together a diverse arsenal of artifacts that work in concert. The choice is yours.

BREW YOUR ADVANTAGE. TURN THE TIDE WITH TALISMANS.

More than forty types of elixirs and talismans bring new possibilities to every run. Consume elixirs to stack buffs as the battle wears on. Unleash talismans to control the battlefield, cut down enemies, or turn a desperate situation around.

Build a lasting advantage with elixirs, use talismans to cover weaknesses in your build, or combine them with artifacts and spirit seals to explore more daring strategies.

BIND THEIR SOULS. CLAIM THEIR POWERS.

Seal the souls of defeated enemies into soul pacts to gain their unique skills. Each pact also rolls random modifiers: some increase its power, while others change how the skill works.

With different modifiers and builds, the same enemy skill can become an entirely different answer to the dangers ahead.

CHARACTER PROFILES

GU QINGWEI

The youngest disciple of the Liyun Sect, Qingwei is gentle by nature and still early in her cultivation. To find her fellow disciples and avenge her sect, she gathers the courage to enter the deadly ruins.

[Character Illustration]

“My music may be faint, but as long as these strings hold, I won't leave a single disciple behind.”

LI JIANCHEN

A promising young disciple of the Lingxiao Sect, Jianchen comes from humble origins and possesses respectable, if unexceptional, talent. Sent into the ruins as an expendable scout by his own sect, he survives through courage and an earnest heart.

[Character Illustration]

“What is there to fear? We find the path by walking it, and cut down whatever stands in our way. Stay close—we're getting out of here together!”

What the immortals left behind has become a den of demons.

No true immortals remain.

And still, you must enter.

games.name: Medieval Ascendant
games.shortDescription: From a serf bound to the soil to the head of a noble house. Farm, trade, build an economic empire across five provinces, claim land through war, intrigue or wealth — and forge a dynasty that outlives you.
games.aboutText:
In Medieval Ascendant, you write your own saga in the harsh medieval world of the fantasy realm Aldred. You begin as a simple serf with no possessions and fight your way up through the rigid social hierarchy over generations. When your character passes away, your legacy lives on in your heir. Each generation decides the rise or fall of your dynasty.
