Tend your fields, master a craft, or dominate the market and build a vast production network across five unique provinces. Shape the realm to your liking through supremacy in economy, war, or intrigue. Whether you ultimately ascend the throne through bloody campaigns, dark scheming, or the ruthless power of coin is entirely up to you. rn

Key Features:

- Your rise from a rightless serf to the heights of nobility across multiple generations

- A fantasy realm with five individual provinces and simulated population

- Fully simulated economy influenced by weather, plagues, and war

- Conquer land by the sword, through cunning intrigue, or economic ruin

- Strategic warfare and tactical battles that leave lasting wounds

- Unique stories and unpredictable dialogues in every playthrough

Found your dynasty and climb the feudal social order over generations. Full patriarchal system with genetics, inheritance, education, and strategic alliances through marriage and dowry.

Five provinces with local markets, population-driven demand, prosperity, NPC competitors who influence the market, and seasonal fluctuations. Droughts, plagues, and wars affect the economy. Use your economic power to make provinces flourish or starve.

Multiple production chains to manufacture every available good in the game. Each province offers unique advantages for producing certain goods. Build houses for the population, but make sure there are enough homeless to occupy your houses.

Wage war against rival houses or defend the realm against invading neighbors. Every battle carries the risk that your character dies or is permanently injured. Each battle spans multiple rounds — watch your breathing, for an exhausted character is easily wounded. Prepare yourself and equip your character with weapon, armor, and shield.

Death is not the end. Your legacy is carried on through the generations. Customize your playstyle by focusing on economy, combat, diplomacy, intrigue, or dynasty. Multi-tiered development of legacies.

games.name: Please, Tell Me Why?
games.shortDescription: You live alone. At least, you’re supposed to. Go live. Explore your apartment. Talk to your viewers. Everything seems normal - until little things stop making sense. A first-person psychological thriller about identity, isolation, and the terrifying price of confronting the truth.
games.aboutText:
Rin lives alone with her cat Barsik and goes live at night under the alias Alice. As she explores the apartment and traces of the past, she must discover who demands an answer to the question “Tell Me Why?” and whether the truth is worth seeking.

Features

• A story-driven first-person psychological thriller set entirely within one apartment.

• Examine objects and memories that reveal Rin’s past.

• The personas of Rin and Alice offer different reactions and actions.

• Mounting tension: story events make Rin’s familiar apartment increasingly unsettling.

• Darkness and electricity: unlit areas hinder exploration, and overloading the power grid cuts the power.

games.name: Prison Legacy
games.shortDescription: What are you in for? Prison Legacy is a social MMORPG set inside a mixed-gender maximum-security prison. Choose one of 12 criminal classes, then fight turn-based battles, craft contraband, trade, steal, chat, and build a clan strong enough to outlast the hilarious darkness rising behind bars.
games.aboutText:
You've been sentenced to life. What you do with it is up to you.

Prison Legacy is a social MMORPG that drops you inside a maximum-security prison, running around the clock, and never lets you forget you're not alone.

Hundreds of inmates, real players and server-driven characters alike, scheme, trade, brawl, and claw for status across cell blocks, kitchens, yards, and infirmaries.

Nobody hands you quests on a silver platter, but you'll find them. There's just the penitentiary, the people in it, and one question that decides everything: what are you in for?

Choose your crime. Become it

First, make the convict yours: set your sex and your look, then pick the crime that landed you inside. Your character starts with one of 12 criminal pasts , and that single choice is your class, your reputation, and your playstyle all at once.

Every crime has its own special abilities, favored weapons, crafting know-how, and rivalries, and each one earns bonus (or penalty) experience for exactly who it takes down.

Stalk the blocks as a blade-loving Serial Killer or a flesh-hungry Cannibal. Heal and manipulate as a silver-tongued Corrupt Politician. Brawl as a Mercenary, pick pockets and locks as a Thief, throw bombs as a Mobster, poison your foes as a Narco, or punch through anyone as a Hacker.

Everyone starts at the bottom

On day one you're fresh meat with empty pockets and barely a skill to your name, and that's the point. Survival here isn't about twitch reflexes; it's about who you know and how you improve your character.

Find your footing, find your people, and the prison opens up to you: deeper zones, tougher enemies, real influence, and a sprawling skill tree to grow into.

No two convicts walk the same path, and every alliance, grudge, and double-cross is a story you wrote yourself, all of it driving toward one goal: becoming the most feared and respected inmate in the prison.

Fight like it matters

Combat is turn-based and tactical. Spend your action points wisely, then disarm, backstab, stun, provoke, or flee like a chicken. Always size up an enemy before you swing.

Win, and you can search the body for the weapons, medicine, and contraband worth killing for, and claim the loser's dog tags, a trophy of the beating you can collect and show off.

Pick a fight too far above your level and you'll wake up back in your cell.

Do your time your way

This is a prison economy, and survival is a craft. Cook in the kitchen, brew chemistry, sew protective clothing, work mechanics and jewelry to improve stuff, and turn scavenged junk into gear and goods.

Hundreds of items move through the blocks: food, medicine, all kinds of merchandise, armor for every part of your body, and, of course, weapons.

Trade with other inmates, stash your valuables in your cell locker, talk NPCs into favors and experience, and steal everything that isn't bolted down.

You can't survive alone

Talk, ally, betray, and live by the golden rule: avoid your enemies and surround yourself with friends. Form clans , wear a shared uniform, forge alliances, and group up for fights no lone convict could survive.

Because something is stirring in the dark, and it is exactly as ridiculous as it is dangerous: the prisoner Carlito Brygante has made a literal pact with the Devil, and his rotting zombie horde swells with every inmate and guard he corrupts.

The High Priest's Army of Light, the bloodthirsty Warden, and an old Mafia patriarch all have their own designs. Standing against any of them takes a clan strong enough, and loyal enough, to last.

Key Features

- A social MMORPG set inside a maximum-security prison: every face is a potential ally, mark, or enemy.

- 12 distinct criminal classes, each with unique special abilities, weapons, and rivalries.

- Build your convict from scratch: choose sex, appearance, and the crime that shapes your whole playstyle.

- Tactical turn-based combat with action points, special moves, and real consequences.

- Collect the dog tags of every inmate you defeat: a growing trophy wall of your PvP victories.

- Deep crafting and a player-driven economy: cook, brew, sew, build, trade, and steal.

- Clans, alliances, uniforms, and groups of up to 16 for cooperative endgame play.

- Emergent, player-driven stories: alliances, betrayals, feuds, and reputations that are entirely your own.

- Hundreds of NPCs to fight, rob, or befriend, many of them your best source of progression.

- An always-on chat that follows you everywhere: zone talk, prison-wide shouts, private messages, and trade calls, with colors and +500 emoticons, with a contact book to track friends and enemies. The community tools that made this world famous.

- A modern Vulkan engine running natively on Windows and Linux, fully playable in English and Spanish.

A legend, rebuilt.

Prison Legacy is the reborn "La Prisión", Spain's first MMORPG, created by Dinamic Multimedia and launched back in 2000 for Spanish people, remembered for a community so tight that it

games.name: Sill Sticks
games.shortDescription: A slacker stick figure named Bota moves onto your desktop. An idle app where you sneak peeks between tasks as he idly mutters to himself to match the time of day and the day of the week. He won't get in your way. Sometimes he talks to you. That's the whole app.
games.aboutText:
A Slacker Moves Onto Your Desktop!?

Sill Sticks is an idle desktop app where a stick figure comes to live on the edges of your desktop windows — all you do is watch and enjoy.

The star is "Bota," a stick figure who's sloppy, forever slacking off, a bit of a handful, and... maybe a little cute? Somehow, you just can't hold it against him. He grumbles and lazes around, yet he seems quietly happy somehow. Bota dreams of being a cat, is hopeless around sweets, holes up at every opportunity, and spends his days on games, TV, and sleep. You sneak a peek at his mutterings between tasks. That's the whole app.

Features

- Mutters in context — Bota idly talks to himself based on the time of day, the day of the week, and how long the app has been left running. In the morning it's "Still sleepy...", and late at night it's "Go to bed already... yeah, me too." The combinations produce different lines from day to day.

- Just peek at him — Bota knows you're there. Every now and then he'll talk to you. Maybe a friendship will blossom?

- Stays out of your way — Bota won't get in your way. He's just idling through life at his own pace. Though he does talk to you sometimes. Sometimes.

What's Next

We plan to keep updating Sill Sticks little by little.

Streaming Policy

Anyone is free to stream this game or post videos of it, monetized or not. No prior permission or notice is required.

You don't have to tell us, but we'd be truly delighted if you did. A quick note via Discord or X (formerly Twitter) would be much appreciated. You can find our Discord and X accounts on the store page. We'd also love it if you included the store page URL in your stream or video description. And if we know in advance, we may be able to help promote your stream.

That said, please refrain from streams that fall under the following.

- Streams involving anything illegal
- Streams that offend public order and morals
- Streams that promote violence or discrimination
- Streams based on specific political or religious advocacy
- Any other streams that common sense would deem inappropriate

Even if a stream does not fall under the above, we may ask for it to be stopped or removed, for any reason, if we judge it inappropriate.

As long as you're streaming for fun, there's no problem at all. We're looking forward to your streams!

games.name: SSTWL - Sector Breach
games.shortDescription: SSTWL - Sector Breach is a sit and survive, point-and-click survival-horror game about the characters and world created by Liam Vickers.
games.aboutText:
SSTWL: Sector Breach is a point and click survival-horror game revolving the characters and world created by Liam Vickers throughout the “Scary Story Time With Liam” YouTube channel.

Drink your coffee, recover the files, and fend off everything that goes bump in the night. It’s only six hours, what’s the worst that could happen? It’s not like the fate of the universe is at stake, right?

As a FNaF-like, Sector Breach borrows many core aspects of those games mechanics; Sit in your office, watch cameras, close doors, etc. But of course, it’s not that simple.

Use the camera lights to keep the monsters blind and disoriented, just don’t flash the wrong one. Keep your head on a swivel, don’t let what’s in the monitor distract you from what’s in your doorway. Most importantly, recover the Data Files. They are why you are here. The fate of humanity depends upon it.

The game’s story is designed to not only tie into established lore and plot lines of the SSTWL channel, but also act as a way for new fans to jump into the lore of everyone’s favorite niche internet creepypasta author.

Sector Breach is a love letter to all the incredible stories Liam Vickers has written, and the amazing community which has continued to flourish around them even all these years later. <3

games.name: ゲイトトゥダイ
games.shortDescription: 古き良きレトロスタイルのアートで綴られる"ゲイトライク"サバイバルクラフトアドベンチャー！！　突如、謎の屋敷に転送された「わたし」の運命は！？　危険な闇の中を探索し、素材を見つけ、アイテムを創造し、生還せよ―― 「ゲイトトゥダイ」はクラフト要素を含む、ポイント＆クリック方式の探索アドベンチャーゲームです。6つのコマンドと多種多様なアイテムを駆使し、恐怖に満ちた屋敷と城を探索しましょう。
games.aboutText:
古き良きレトロスタイルのアートで綴られる　"ゲイトライク"　サバイバルクラフトアドベンチャー！！
突如、謎の屋敷に転送された「わたし」の運命は！？
危険な闇の中を探索し、素材を見つけ、アイテムを創造し、生還せよ！！

もし君が、見知らぬ謎の屋敷の中庭で目覚めたとする。

ここはどこなのか？　自分の身に何が起きたのか？

屋敷を調べようにも、中は闇に閉ざされ一寸先も見えない。

残念ながら手元には空のトランクケースが一つだけ。

明かりになりそうなものはない。

そんな時、君ならどうするだろう？

私の答えは――

なければ作れ！　クラフトシステム

光源、武器、防具、食事、ベッド、作業台、炉……探索に必要なアイテムや設備は自分でクラフトしよう！

敵地に住みつけ！？　中庭を（勝手に）拠点化！

屋敷の中庭に、クラフト用の設備や家具を（勝手に）設置。どんどん住み心地が良くなるぞ！

基本はポイント＆クリック方式アドベンチャー

6つのコマンドとアイテムを駆使して探索を進めよう！　もちろん「セルフ」に使うこともできる！？

殺意に満ちた罠たち！

仕掛けられた罠は致命的！　迂闊な行動をとれば即座にあの世行きだ！

襲い来る奇妙なモンスターを撃退せよ！

不思議なアミュレットの力を借りて、敵の行動を予見せよ！　すべての攻撃がどの方向から来るか分かっているのだから、避けられないはずがない！　あとは武器で反撃するだけだ！

ゲイトライク……？

往年の名作ADVからの影響を強く受けた、どこか懐かしい特徴的な語り口のテキストとクラシックスタイルのドットアート。
developers: 秘密結社マテンロウ計画
publishers: 秘密結社マテンロウ計画

games.name: BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS
games.shortDescription: BEASTOPIA: RAIDERS is a 2D PvPvE animal extraction shooter set after humanity’s extinction. Venture into ruined cities and dangerous laboratories, search for valuable supplies, and return safely to your shelter with your loot.
games.aboutText:
In Beastopia, the animals that survived the apocalypse learned a few useful tricks: how to carry a gun, fix a machine, build a shelter and get out before somebody takes everything.

Venture into the ruins, search abandoned streets and dangerous laboratories, collect supplies, and make it back to your shelter with your loot.

But the old world is not empty. Stalkers roam the ruins. Hostile creatures guard valuable supplies. And other raiders are chasing the same prize.

Loot. Fight. Escape

Every raid is a choice. Leave early with the loot you have, or go deeper to find better loot. Open boxes, fight monsters, avoid other raiders or fight them. Just make sure you get out alive.

You Are Not Alone

Play alone or with a team. Other players may hide from you, chase you, or ask for copartion. Keep looking around. Watch your back. Nobody is worth trusting.

Use What You Find

Bring home weapons, armor, attachments, materials, and strange items. Sell what you do not need. Craft what you do need. Even junk can become useful gear.

Make Your Hideout Stronger

Upgrade your facilities, make better items, improve your stats, and prepare for harder raids. The more you survive, the stronger you become.

games.name: Mini Monuments
games.shortDescription: Mini Monuments is a calming diorama restoration game where you dig, clean, and rebuild handcrafted miniature ruins. Use tactile tools at your own pace and watch as each scene comes back to life piece by piece.
games.aboutText:
Mini Monuments is a calming diorama restoration game about reviving forgotten ruins.
Dig out hidden pieces, clean away dirt, and reassemble broken structures with tactile tools.
As the monument takes shape, color returns, details emerge, and the diorama comes back to life.

Restore Handcrafted Living Dioramas

Each level is a small, detailed scene built around a ruined miniature monument.
What begins as an abandoned space, gradually changes through your work, revealing what the place used to be.

Use Satisfying Tactile Tools

Every tool and interaction is designed around the pleasure of careful, hands-on work.

Play At Your Own Pace

There are no enemies, no timers, and no pressure to do things on time.
Progress comes from curiosity, observation, and care.

Customize and Share

Change the time of day, weather conditions and adjust photo filters to suit your mood. Turn cozy gameplay moments into crafted shots and share your memories.

Key Features

- Restore handcrafted dioramas centered on forgotten miniature ruins

- Uncover missing pieces, clean worn surfaces, and rebuild broken structures

- Watch each scene regain color, detail, and atmosphere

- Use tactile tools designed for careful, satisfying interaction

- Interactive Photo Mode, change the time of day just to suit your mood or to craft the perfect shot.

*Mini Monuments is a short handcrafted game created by a couple of game developers and a few collaborators

games.name: Delvegg
games.shortDescription: 《Delvegg》 is a desktop idle mining game. The core gameplay revolves around digging eggs, collecting pets, and building your underground mining empire.
games.aboutText:
《Delvegg》 is a desktop idle game where you raise pets that mine resources automatically while idling on your taskbar.

Packed with diverse gameplay mechanics and endless delightful surprises.

- Discover dozens of uniquely designed pets, including dwarves, goblins, elves, demons, dragons, vampires, and even mythical creatures. Every pet boasts exclusive unique skills, making every egg hatching full of anticipation.

-

- The comprehensive pet development system features enhancement, fusion, distillation,refinement, and infusion—craft your one-of-a-kind dream pet to your liking.

- Dozens of gears with distinct mechanics, alongside rarer exclusive equipment and abundant random affixes, offer countless possibilities for team composition building.

-

- Hundreds of distinct pet affix traits ensure no two pets are identical. Build an overpowered damage dealer or a gold-farming machine; the choice lies entirely with you (and a little luck).

-

- Random special events pop up throughout your adventure: divine gear falling from the sky, surprise boss raids, and dozens more unexpected encounters.

-

Extra Game Content

- A casual gambling minigame awaits you. Once you unlock the tavern, you can risk all your savings for a chance to earn massive profits! Win bets to unlock secret exclusive rewards.

-

- Uncover the hidden lore of this world. Extremely rare chances grant you extra decorative buildings and collectibles, letting you piece together the untold secrets of this continent.

-

- Once you feel your team is powerful enough, take on the challenge of the Demon Tower.

-

games.name: Defender of Darkness
games.shortDescription: An idle tower defense game: build fortifications, manage limited resources, cast spells, and decide which dark lords to save before the final battle against the forces of good. And don’t forget to raise your kraken!
games.aboutText:
You are a dark overlord, the last protector of an alliance of evil lords besieged by the merciless armies of light. Across 11 rounds, you must choose whom to save and whom to abandon to the advancing forces of light. Spend your limited resources, build defenses, hire protectors, unleash dark spells, and preserve as many allies as you can before the final battle.

Game Features

- Choose whom to defend: each round, the forces of good attack two evil lords, but you can save only one.

- Gather allies for the finale: every rescued lord is sent to the waiting hall and can aid you in the decisive battle.

- Prepare your defenses before each fight: spend limited resources on defensive structures, buildings that automatically summon servants, repairs, and elite protectors.

- Command the army of darkness in autobattles with Tower Defense elements: enemies advance along lanes and try to break through to the lord.

- Hire elite fighters before battle, while ordinary servants emerge from constructed buildings during combat.

- Fight more than 130 enemy types, each with its own traits and role on the battlefield.

- Use global spell cards to slow enemies, deal damage, and change the course of battle.

- Save your spells wisely: between battles, you can obtain only a limited set of cards, and the strongest ones may prove crucial in the finale.

- Battle across varied maps, from snow-covered mountains to volcanic fields, each with its own enemies and special conditions.

- Reach the final battle with any lineup: gather a powerful alliance of dark lords, or stand alone against the forces of good.

games.name: Duco
games.shortDescription: A roguelike survival game where you can also interact with NPCs, encounter gangs, and build a small settlement of your own… but with cards. Loot, craft, and survive. Unlock characters and maps, and combine them with traits to create unique runs.
games.aboutText:
Duco is a survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world, built around card-based roguelike mechanics. Draw from location-based decks to gather resources, loot, craft, build, and survive. Unlock new characters and maps, combine them with traits to create unique runs.

- Survive

Manage your Health, Energy, Thirst and Hunger. Each one is essential to survive another day.

- Time

Every action moves time forward. Every location has its own risks and opportunities.

- Unique Runs

Unlock diverse characters with distinct starting advantages, Unlock maps that change playstyle, and combine them with powerful traits

- Draw Card

Draw from location-based decks to gather resources, discover loot, or search for opportunities.

- Craft&Build

Craft essential tools, equipment, armor, and structures to improve your chances of survival.

- Explore

Travel between different locations to access unique decks

- Fight For Your Life

Fight your way out through dice-based combat

- Adapt

Unlock new abilities as you level up.

- PLANNED FUTURES FOR FULL RELEASE

Duco is actively in development. The full release will include:

- Build and manage your own settlement

- NPC Interactions

- Expanded progression mechanics

games.name: Balance: Umbilical Wake
games.shortDescription: Step into a fisherman’s recurring nightmare of living on a levitating platform that tilts with every move. Learn the world’s rules, solve its puzzles, catch fish, and inject them into your navel to wake up. But the nightmare keeps returning until your child’s birth begins to reshape it.
games.aboutText:
Balance: Umbilical Wake is a surreal physics-based game about the human need to control life, birth, and what comes after.

You play as a fisherman trapped in a recurring nightmare that follows him through different stages of life. In the dream, he lives on a levitating platform between the clouds, connected to a large mechanical box through his umbilical cord feeding into it.

Each time he returns, the weight of what occupies him leaks into the nightmare and changes its world.

Do Not Fall

Release and retract the umbilical cord from your navel to control the box, shift both weights across the platform, and restore balance before the platform tilts too far.

Fight the Catch

Use the rod’s winding mechanism to pull fish from the devouring mud below the platform. Wind the reel, release the handle, and react in time before the fish is dragged deeper. Every catch is a physical struggle of tension, timing, and control.

Before the Catch

The nightmare follows its own logic. Learn how the world responds, then do what it demands. Each puzzle, reaction, and required step is part of a process that eventually makes fishing possible.

A Child Appears

The nightmare begins to grow around a new weight. What once belonged only to you is now a world shared with another life.

The Way Out

Inject the fish into your navel and pass into a waking trance that opens a way out of the dream.

You will keep returning, keep balancing, and each return will ask something different of you.

*Inspired by my deep admiration for the 1989 animated short film Balance by Wolfgang and Christoph Lauenstein.

games.name: InCyanSpace
games.shortDescription: IncyanSpace follows the story of Li, an artificial human, who sets out to find his long-lost original human brother Yuan. Together with surviving New Humans, they stand against Xystem, a dominant force of mechanical lifeforms that controls the surface world.
games.aboutText:
INCYANSPACE

IncyanSpace follows the story of Li, an artificial human, who sets out to find his long-lost original human brother Yuan. Together with surviving New Humans, they stand against Xystem, a dominant force of mechanical lifeforms that controls the surface world.

Human civilization hit an unbreakable evolutionary bottleneck, splitting flesh-and-blood humanity into two opposing factions:

One group uses machinery to assist daily life while clinging to their humanity, calling themselves the New Humans.

The other pursues full mechanical ascension, merging their bodies and consciousness with machinery to abandon human nature entirely — they named themselves Xystem.

Xystem views the New Humans, who retain their humanity, as a barrier holding back humanity’s evolution. The irreconcilable conflict ignited a brutal, devastating war.

The New Humans suffered crushing defeat and were forced to retreat into underground shelters, leaving the entire surface under Xystem’s control. Decades later, our story begins…

Game Features

- Seamless Open Post-Apocalyptic Pixel World with Rich Lore

Experience a fully polished main storyline, alongside a wide range of unique side quests scattered across the wasteland. Every corner of this broken world holds its own hidden tales.

- Free Exploration & Accessible Combat Survival

Venture anywhere you wish to scavenge supplies and battle mechanical foes. Smooth movement and streamlined combat mechanics make the game friendly for new players.

Choose your classes freely and customize your playstyle via talent trees, allocating talent points to craft your unique combat and survival builds.

- Relaxing Casual Life Content

Cultivate your personal farm plot inside the shelter and watch your crops grow. Wander through cornfields, mess around with wandering enemies, and steal quiet peaceful moments amid the wasteland.

If combat feels overwhelming, grab your fishing rod! Your catches can be cooked into nourishing meals or traded for resources back at the shelter — everyone here loves fresh fish.

- Balanced Difficulty for Hardcore & Casual Players

Early-game survival carries a harder challenge, but new players can seek out designated NPCs to obtain a starter weapon to stand a fighting chance against foes.

- Dual-Layer Narrative Premise

While you fall asleep in the real world, your soul drifts into this desolate realm. What fate awaits when a wandering outsider soul crosses paths with a dying artificial human protagonist?

- Unrestricted Wasteland Survival Freedom

Your journey is about to begin. Help the protagonist fulfill his quest for his lost brother, explore the vast broken wasteland, and meet a cast of distinct survivors.

Survive in this dangerous open world, earn citizenship of the underground shelter, join scavenging expeditions to hunt for vital supplies, and lend aid to those in need.

Farm crops, fish waters, and tame small wild creatures — here, you are free to live life on your own terms.

games.name: Anomaly Cafe
games.shortDescription: Manage a quaint coffee shop hidden deep in an unknown forest. Brew daily cups for ordinary travelers, but be prepared to adapt your service when unusual and anomalous entities start lining up for their caffeine fix.
games.aboutText:
Just a normal shift in the woods.

Start your new job managing a quiet coffee shop nestled deep within an uncharted forest. At first, your day-to-day involves perfectly brewing lattes, espressos, and cappuccinos for regular hikers and lost travelers. It’s a peaceful, ordinary simulator.

But as the days pass, the forest begins to reveal its true nature. Slowly, your ordinary clientele is replaced by the strange, the unusual, and the anomalous.

Key Features:

- Start Simple: Master standard coffee brewing mechanics, manage your time, and keep your regular customers happy.

- The Shift: Experience a slow burn as the mundane transitions into the supernatural.

- Serve the Anomalous: Adapt your service for entities with bizarre appearances, unknown origins, and very specific rules for their orders.

- Atmospheric Setting: Work in a forest environment that slowly shifts from a cozy retreat to an unsettling anomaly hotspot.

games.name: AMATERASU【 天照 】
games.shortDescription: A dramatic bullet hell shooter where you master your Shot, Bomb, and the Yatano Kagami System, which transmutes enemy bullets into resources, as you fight to overthrow AMATERASU, the Stellar Management System that has launched its assault on humanity.
games.aboutText:
【STORY】

In the distant future, humanity has expanded across the galaxy, and the Dyson Sphere—capable of harnessing the power of an entire star—has become a reality.

You are the commander of the Oort Security Force, humanity's elite combat unit. Alongside your six squad members, you are dispatched on a mission to subdue AMATERASU , the Stellar Management System responsible for overseeing the Solar System and its Dyson Sphere, after it suddenly turns its weapons against humanity.

From a Earth engulfed in war—where just a handful of people fought their way to the base in Mercury’s orbit where AMATERASU was operational—and given that AMATERASU was capable of using a Dyson Sphere to fire “Amaterasu particles”—ultra-high-energy cosmic rays that could potentially destroy the solar system—humanity’s chances of victory were a mere 1 percent, a truly desperate situation...

●YatanoKagami

　Upon activation, all enemy bullets currently on screen are instantly converted into Score Chips, and YatanoKagami 　Mode is activated.

　While YatanoKagami Mode is active, defeating an enemy converts all bullets fired by that enemy into Score Chips.

　When the gauge is depleted, YatanoKagami Mode ends and enters a cooldown period.

　YatanoKagami can be activated at any time outside of cooldown, as many times as you have YasakaninoMagatama 　charges remaining next to your score.

●Cooling

　When the YatanoKagami Mode gauge is depleted, the system enters a cooldown period for a set duration.

　While the gauge is black, YatanoKagami cannot be activated. However, the Solar Shell (Bomb) gauge displayed in the 　bottom-right corner will gradually charge. Once the gauge is full, you will acquire a Solar Shell (Bomb).

games.name: BELTFED
games.shortDescription: You are a rogue AI with one directive: AUTOMATE DEATH. Shred, burn and vaporize overwhelming swarms of ravenous bugs as your part factory, part war machine lays waste to one world after another. In BELTFED, the factory is your weapon.
games.aboutText:
BELTFED is a roguelike factory-defense game of rapid, brutal runs and absurd scale. Lay belts, wire up smelters and assemblers, and balance your power grid, turning raw ore into raw firepower. All the while a planet's worth of bugs descends upon your factory. This is automation fused with total war.

AUTOMATE DEATH

The swarm arrives in the hundreds of thousands. Meet them with guns, flamethrowers, launchers, mortars, lasers, drones, mines and more - all of it fueled by your own production lines. A single run can push your kill count into the millions. Welcome to slaughter at an industrial scale.

MASS PRODUCTION. MASS EXTINCTION.

Balance industry, power and security as you expand your factory and push into the fog for richer veins and rarer resources. More bugs require more bullets, and supply must keep up because demand doesn't wait. As you expand, choose from run-defining upgrade cards that shape how you play, making every factory different from the last.

THE NEXUS MUST SURVIVE

The Nexus is your central intelligence and item storage. It must be defended at all costs. If your Nexus is compromised, your factory will be terminated and the run will end. Everything else is expendable. As you progress, you'll unlock new Nexus cores that change the way you play.

THE FACTORY IS YOUR WEAPON

Every deployment feeds permanent progression: new weapons, new buildings, new upgrade cards, unique Nexus cores and modules. Your ever-expanding arsenal ensures every deployment is deadlier than the last. Customize your loadout before each run to tune the machine to your playstyle. Optimize chaos, automate death.

FEATURES

- Factory Automation. Conveyor belts, smelters and assemblers turn raw resources into a constant supply of ammunition.

- Roguelike Runs. Build up from nothing and reach the end game inside a single run. Experience the full automation arc in one sitting.

- Tower Defense Combat. Guns, flamethrowers, rocket launchers, mortars, lasers, drones and mines, all supplied by your own production lines.

- Massive Swarms. Insane amounts of enemies on screen at once, with kill counts reaching the millions in a single run.

- Run-Defining Upgrade Cards. In-run upgrades that change how you play, everything from exploding buildings to cannons that fire black holes. No two runs are the same.

- Base Building & Expansion. Balance industry, power and security while pushing into the fog for rarer resources.

- Meta Progression. Unlock new technology, buildings, weapons, Nexus cores and modules that persist across runs.

- Customizable Loadouts. Tune your starting arsenal before every deployment, select a Nexus that fits your playstyle and modules that support it.

- Multiple Planets. Travel to exotic new worlds, then kill everything living on them. Each planet has its own rules and hazards.

- Countless Strategies. Build around your strengths, play around your weaknesses - how long will your factory last?

games.name: Tenebrarium
games.shortDescription: An idle-like alien colony simulator. Study an alien species and expand the colony to discover all their peculiar behaviours.
games.aboutText:
Enjoy a colony simulator without the steep learning curve. Simply place resources, sit back, and observe.

The Teno are a volatile alien species, capable of fusing intelligently with their environment, or exploding into a pile of bones. As you learn about them, you use this information to grow their colony, unlocking new resources and uncovering more advanced behaviours.

Investigate the extent of the aliens' intelligence, and find ways to make use of their volatility.

Enjoy a hand-crafted retro pixel art aesthetic, a lo-fi sci-fi soundtrack, and tonnes of weird little guys.

Full game features:

- 20 Teno variants

- 10 Placeable resources

- 4 Biomes

- 7 Hivemind Idea-Viruses (if you don't know what this means, don't worry about it!)

- 100+ Alien behaviours

- A resolution to the Teno's story

- 2 post-game Sandbox modes

- Achievements

This is a small project by a solo developer, and NO generative AI was used whatsoever.

games.name: Alien Archeologist
games.shortDescription: Alien Archeologist is a chill incremental digging game. Use a variety of upgradeable tools to mine ore, blast through earth, and clean strange artifacts as you journey yet deeper toward the mystery hiding at the planet's core.
games.aboutText:
Dig holes. Clean off mysterious artifacts. Throw some dynamite. Enjoy the Martian sunset with your robot companion. It's all in a day’s work for a spacefaring prospector. You never know just what you’ll find as an Alien Archaeologist.

DIG

Your work begins with a simple shovel. Extract minerals ranging from humble stones to unobtainium, then throw it all in the grinder to afford new upgrades and tools that make your work even more efficient.

CLEAN

It's not just ore hiding in the crust of Mars. Unearth (well, unmars) pieces of alien relics to clean, assemble, and ship off to your corporate overlords.

DISCOVER

What secret lies in the belly of this dusty planet? Why did your employer send you here, and what happened to those who came before you? Every shovelful of dirt brings you closer to revealing a mystery buried deep in the Martian soil.

KEY FEATURES

- Incremental Gameplay : Dig, grind, upgrade, repeat. Menial labor has never been this fun.

- Unearth Artifacts : Who knows what you'll find as you dig down toward the planet's core? Discover, clean and assemble relics from a lost alien civilization.

- Tools of the Trade : Pick up alien energy signatures on your detector, navigate tricky terrain with your jetpack, and put your trusty shovel to work. Tired of digging? Blast the planet to smithereens with good old fashioned dynamite.

- Exploration : There are secrets abound beneath the dirt and rock. Excavate crystal caverns, astronaut outposts and alien installations as you delve deeper and deeper still. What's hiding at the bottom of the dig site?

games.name: COVENANT OF GEARS The Three Musketeers
games.shortDescription: Lead the Musketeers in this steampunk tactical cRPG! Tactical pause combat against the English invasion. Use the powerful Campaign Editor to create and share your own adventures. And play the official campaign and those from the community.
games.aboutText:
Dive into Covenant of Gears: The Three Musketeers, a tactical RPG set in a reinvented 17th-century France, featuring a powerful built-in Campaign Editor. Blending alternate history and steampunk technology, lead the Musketeers through an adventure where your choices—and your creativity—shape the world.

Covenant of Gears pushes beyond the boundaries of traditional RPGs by putting the developers' tools directly into your hands. With the modular Campaign Editor, your adventures have no limits:

- Write your own story: Design quests from scratch and shape complex narrative branches.

- Build tactical challenges: Place your NPCs, configure enemy factions, and design your own combat encounters.

- Share with the world: Publish your creations to the Steam Workshop with a single click, then dive into an endless stream of community-made adventures.

Step into a reimagined 17th-century France. Forget coal and smoke-belching engines: here, history has been rewritten thanks to Bleu de France, a clean, luminous energy source that powers war machines, mechanical armor, and the weapons of the era. Follow D'Artagnan, Athos, Porthos, and Aramis in a world where the panache of the sword meets the power of an energy revolution.

The combat system demands as much strategy as it does reflexes. Take control of the battlefield and refine your tactics::

- Tactical Pause (RTwP): Suspend time at any moment to analyze the situation, coordinate your musketeers' actions, and unleash devastating combos.

- Unique playstyles: Each Musketeer brings a unique combat style to the battlefield. Master Aramis' lightning-fast dagger strikes as he cuts through enemy lines.

Publish and share your creations on the Steam Workshop with a single click. Community-created content provides an endless supply of new campaigns, original stories, and tactical challenges. In Covenant of Gears, every campaign becomes a new epic.

All for one, and one for all!

games.name: GEL RUN
games.shortDescription: GEL RUN is a colorful obstacle-course adventure where being flexible is your greatest power.
games.aboutText:
GEL RUN is a colorful obstacle-course adventure where being flexible is your greatest power. Control a lively jelly character, race toward the finish line, collect gems, and reshape your body to squeeze through every challenge.

Your mission is to reach the end of each level without getting stopped by barriers, narrow gaps, moving obstacles, and tricky platforms. Become taller, flatter, thinner, or wider at the right moment to keep moving forward.

With lots of levels to complete, every run brings new obstacles and smarter ways to use your jelly form.

Game Features:

- Control a fun, flexible jelly character

- Reshape your body to pass through obstacles

- Run, squeeze, stretch, and adapt to each situation

- Collect colorful gems along the way

- Complete many challenging levels

- Simple controls and satisfying arcade gameplay

- Bright low-poly visuals and relaxing environments

- Increasing difficulty as levels become more creative

Can you reshape fast enough to reach every finish line in GEL RUN ?

games.name: 田游族谱
games.shortDescription: 《田游族谱》是一款简洁的族谱树解谜游戏。故事发生在虚构的福建沿海城市田游，围绕一个家族展开。玩家将扮演探索者，通过社交链追踪与线索搜集，按图索骥，逐步拼凑出家族成员的真实信息，最终点亮族谱树上的每一个节点。
games.aboutText:
关于这款游戏

《田游族谱》是一款简洁的族谱树解谜游戏。故事发生在虚构的福建沿海城市田游，围绕一个家族展开。玩家将扮演探索者，通过社交链追踪与线索搜集，按图索骥，逐步拼凑出家族成员的真实信息，最终点亮族谱树上的每一个节点。

游戏中没有复杂的操作，只有一套计算机的桌面系统。你需要利用浏览器与社交平台等软件，寻找那根串联起整个家族的线索。

游戏目标

你面前是一个族谱树，每个节点都等待着被点亮。你需要为每个节点填入正确的 姓名 、 出生年份 和 肖像 。

这个家族的族谱树似乎有点小？ 或许在游戏过程中还会出现更多的变化。

玩家社区

欢迎加入玩家QQ群，以了解最新动态与反馈问题建议，群号可在商店页面右侧社媒信息中查看。

games.name: erdetspill
games.shortDescription: Grandpa wants two ice creams. Grandma is dead and left you 100 kroner. An absurdist Norwegian first-person shooter in PSX style, about getting two ice creams through the bank, the police, Lånekassa and the cashier lady at KJIWI. Nobody comments on any of it.
games.aboutText:
Grandpa wants two ice creams.

Grandma is dead. She left you 100 kroner.

Cash in the inheritance at the bank and go to KJIWI. Ice cream requires ID, so apply for an ID card at the police first. The inheritance covers one ice cream. Grandpa says: "Do not come back without two ice creams."

Apply for a grant at Lånekassa. The application asks for your favorite bread color. Cash in the grant at the bank. Buy the second ice cream.

erdetspill is an absurdist Norwegian first-person shooter with PSX graphics at 640×480, inspired by My Summer Car and Postal 2. Nobody in the game comments on any of it.

Features

- A main quest through Norwegian bureaucracy. The bank, the police, Lånekassa and the checkout at KJIWI.
- Side quests. Hunt crows and moose for Iver. Get gravel for the Gravel Brothers. Fix the power for Hverdagskomiker. Play tic-tac-toe against Gorgon the janitor. Tear down posters for Malicious Vindkast. Race a boy on a scooter.
- Weapons. A pistol, a rifle, a shotgun, an RPG with one rocket in the magazine, and a slice of bread that fires gravel.
- The town. A moose with an RPG. Crows. A robot lawnmower. Pedestrians. A power pole that raps.
- KJIWI. Carry your groceries to the checkout yourself. The cashier lady checks your ID.
- Heaven. When you die, erdetgud gives you three doors.
- More. Stand-up comedy in the stave church, a hunter who buys birds, erdet News on TV, a graveyard, a lemonade stand and a fishing pond.
- Extras. A speedrun timer. Your own music on the radio.

Free game and Supporter Pack

The main game is free. That includes the ice cream quest, the side quests, the church, the hunter, the graveyard, the TV and the shotgun on the KJIWI wall.

The Supporter Pack is a DLC. It contains:

- The episode "The Dresser and Me", with a gravel night at Stein and Steinar's.
- A camping trip with Rotta Geir.
- Nils Jorge's quest and Ruben Radler's villa, with the sniper rifle.
- The Uzi and the assault rifle on the KJIWI wall.
- All weapon parts and weapon charms.
- A moldy slice of bread, extra hand gestures, house colors and your own pictures in the frames.

Language

Voices are in Norwegian with English subtitles.

games.name: Fat Chance
games.shortDescription: Escape the mansion before it claims you. A 1–5 player co-op horror.
games.aboutText:
FAT CHANCE is a 1–5 player co-op horror featuring a mansion full of traps, monsters that hunt you, and proximity voice chat. You and up to four friends have to search the house, solve your way through it, and find the exit before it finds you.

The way out is in here somewhere.

Search the house, grab what you need, and figure out how to open the exit.

Watch your step.

The whole house is one big trap.

Fight back, or run.

When a monster comes for you, grab something and fight — or just run for it.

Save them, arm them, or leave them behind.

Revive downed friends, share your gear, stick together. 1–5 players, proximity voice chat.

games.name: Paper Shredder
games.shortDescription: Shred your company's paperwork to earn a $1,000,000 payout. Paper Shredder is an incremental game where a sheet-after-sheet grind scales into mass document destruction. Shred, sweep, upgrade, and cut down tower-high piles of confidential records to uncover what’s buried beneath. Will you sign?
games.aboutText:
Welcome aboard! You have accepted a highly prestigious, entry-level position. Your objective is simple: clear a "minor" backlog of corporate paperwork. Achieve 100% disposal efficiency, and a cool $1,000,000 payout is yours. Don't worry about the scale of the task, management believes in you!

Shred, Sweep, Repeat

Experience the intense sensory pleasure of turning tower-high piles of rigid bureaucracy into weightless confetti. Shred documents and sweep up the mess to earn company merit points. Upgrade basic tools into heavy-duty setups, skyrocketing your processing speed and document destruction.

Mandated Morale Boosts

Never feel lonely on the clock! Your dedicated Happiness Manager is always watching, offering continuous, highly mandatory psychological support, and toxic positivity to keep your motivation at an optimized 100%.

Branching Career Paths

Dig through paper mountains to find more than just forgotten files. Rumor says past associates couldn't bear the grind and shredded a path to freedom instead. Will you follow them?

games.name: Sweetheart
games.shortDescription: Survive the breakup with your high school sweetheart of 15 years. Escape her Hollywood mansion where fame, dysfunction, and the fantasy of everlasting love has mutated your lifelong partner into a monster.
games.aboutText:
THIS IS NOT A LOVE STORY... IS IT?

SWEETHEART is a dating/breakup/existential crisis simulator where you must survive the end of a 15-year toxic relationship with your high school sweetheart turned-celebrity popstar, who has mutated into a monster born from the delusion of your childhood dreams.

Play as Gabe , the invisible boyfriend of Skylar Maxine - once, a nobody girl-next-door, now a rich and famous pop star.

After leaving everyone and everything from their hometown, Gabe and Skylar have finally ended up in in the Hollywood mansion of their dreams...

But after 15 years as a couple, their dream of fame, fortune, and forever isn't going as planned.

Pack what remains of your belongings from your old life, and escape your childhood dreams.

Run, hide, and survive as Skylar mutates into a spider-like entity, hunting us through the dark.

Navigate a shifting labyrinth as the ruins of your house warp into liminal spaces, memories, and secrets.

Explore a dark reflection on a generation raised to wish upon the child-stars on TV in the early 2000s era.

KEY FEATURES:

- 3+ hour story-rich experience through comedy, horror, and a subversive coming of age tragedy.

- Expansive variety of locations from a celebrity beachside dream house, to the psychological labyrinth of heartbreak.

- Original popstar soundtrack by Skylar Maxine.

- Retro-inspired art style with limited motion capture and voice acting.

- Controller Support with Haptic Feedback.

games.name: Give or Take: Pawn Shop
games.shortDescription: Step behind the counter and run a small-town pawn shop. Inspect items to reveal hidden traits, make deals with quirky locals, clean, repair, and sell secondhand finds for profit while helping a town recover. All it takes is old junk and a good deal.
games.aboutText:
Give or Take is a cozy job sim about running your own little pawn shop and helping to restore a struggling town. It’s a peaceful, hands-on loop of buying, selling, repairing, and interacting with customers to support the community.

🏪 Daily Shop Life

Your day starts by organizing your shop counter. Keep things tidy, restock from your storage, and wipe away dusty items. Keep an eye on your calendar too, as special events will bring in crowds looking for specific categories of goods. You can also fulfill special requests by boxing up items and shipping them directly to a customer's address.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Customers & Deals

Every customer who walks through your door comes with their own dialogue, stories, and unique needs, whether they want to buy, sell, or get a broken item repaired. To make a deal, physically handle and stack cash from your register onto the counter and bargain to find the perfect price.

🔎 Inspection

Grab your magnifying glass and take a closer look at items to uncover hidden traits that can drastically increase or decrease their value. Some may be signed, antique, celebrity-owned, or even fake... and occasionally something that makes you wonder where it’s been. Careful inspection is key to making smarter deals.

🔧 Repair and Upgrade

Some items may be broken, dusty, or barely usable. In your workshop, you can clean, restore, and repair these secondhand finds. Merge items to upgrade their quality, turning common items into uncommon, rare, and eventually legendary collectibles.

🌲 Town Life

Beyond your counter, there is a small community to connect with. Step outside to visit nearby shops, chat with the locals, and support the town. You can help restore the area by donating specific items the town needs. Enjoy the peaceful routine of running your pawn shop, where every successful trade helps bring the town back to life.

Don't forget to add Give or Take to your Wishlist on Steam to be notified when the free demo is released!

games.name: 宗门最后的长老
games.shortDescription: Sect master gone, demons invade, elders fallen—only you in seclusion. They don't know you've trained a millennium. Merge synthesis with tower-defense. Battle Shan Hai Jing beasts in ink-wash art. Combine skills, treasures, weapons to power up. Wield flying sword, blast endless hordes. Easy,
games.aboutText:
Developed independently by Xiao Xiong, former host of GameFeng TV

The Last Elder of the Sect

About This Game

The Last Elder of the Sect is an indie cultivation-themed game that blends Roguelike inventory management with 3D tower defense hack‑and‑slash . You play as a disciple of the sect, standing on a floating celestial island above a sea of clouds, battling ancient ferocious beasts that have broken free from the Classic of Mountains and Seas ( Shan Hai Jing ).

Here, combat isn't just about raw numbers. Before each battle, you must carefully arrange your magical treasures—flying swords, sacred artifacts, and cultivation techniques—on the Bagua Mirror . Adjacent items resonate with each other, triggering synergy bonuses. For example, placing an Ice Sword on the Kan (Water) hexagram grants a 30% attack boost, and combining it with a whetstone and mana oil makes it even deadlier. Do you stack pure DPS, or balance slow and burn effects? Every layout is a strategic gamble.

Combat features a 3D vertical-screen perspective: aim with your mouse and hold left-click to unleash flying swords; press keys 1–8 to cast special skills. Ten waves of enemies advance relentlessly, with a 5‑minute enrage timer—after that, foes grow faster and never stop. Eleven epic bosses from the Shan Hai Jing each have unique abilities: the invisible Gudiao , the splitting nine‑tailed fox, the element‑immune Xuan Gui , the ever‑strengthening Zhuhuai … You'll need to adapt your tactics constantly to prevail.

Every victory unlocks more sectors on the Bagua Mirror, refreshes high‑tier artifacts in the shop, and lets you forge legendary flying swords via the synthesis system. Even more precious is your permanent growth through the cultivation system: Qi Refining increases starting spirit stones, Foundation Building boosts attack percentage, Core Formation unlocks interest on spirit stones, and Nascent Soul grants extra skill charges. Even if you fall in a run, your cultivation endures—you'll set out stronger next time.

When you survive nine waves and face the final boss, the game transforms into an interactive cultivation movie—four cinematic cutscenes (Transformation, Sword Draw, Awakening, Reversal) deliver the ultimate climactic experience.

[Game Overview]

The Last Elder of the Sect is an action game combining Roguelike inventory management and 3D tower defense hack‑and‑slash. You are a sect disciple on a floating immortal island, wielding flying swords against ancient beasts from the Shan Hai Jing . Victory depends not only on reflexes but also on your "formation" strategy on the Bagua Mirror—arrange artifacts, weapons, and techniques to trigger synergy bonuses, turning weakness into strength and defying fate.

[Backstory]

In the beginning, the heavens and earth were filled with abundant spiritual energy, and myriad races thrived. But over the millennia, the energy waned, ancient seals weakened, and the ferocious beasts recorded in the Shan Hai Jing broke free, overrunning the mortal world. Your sect—the last pure land of cultivation—stands as the final defense. From Qi Refining to Nascent Soul, you will climb the pinnacle of cultivation. In the final battle, when all seems lost, a mysterious voice across time and space will awaken the power sleeping within you, guiding you to comprehend the ultimate sword art— Sword God .

[Core Gameplay]

◆ 3D Bullet‑Hell Tower Defense Hack‑and‑Slash
Your character stands in the center of the island—no movement required. Aim with the mouse and hold left‑click to launch flying swords. Multiple swords are fired in rotation, each with its own cooldown and elemental attribute. You must switch targets flexibly amid the monster horde, controlling the battlefield via camera rotation and timely skill usage.

◆ Ten Waves of Extreme Challenge
Ten waves total, each with three difficulty tiers. Enemy HP scales from 80 to 800,000. Each wave has a 5‑minute timer; after that, enemies enter enrage mode—speed gradually increases and they fight to the death.

◆ 11 Unique Shan Hai Jing Bosses – each with distinct mechanics.
◆ 8 Major Special Skills – plus a unique skill for the final showdown.
◆ Five Weapon Affixes – each flying sword can carry one of these traits:

- Area Damage – splash damage on hit.

- Slow – chance to reduce enemy movement speed.

- Burn – deals continuous fire damage over time.

- Exterminate – bonus damage against elites/bosses.

- Single Target – extreme focused damage.

The five elements— Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth —run through both weapons and artifacts. Matching a weapon's element with its Bagua sector grants a 30% attack bonus; some bosses are immune to specific elements, testing your loadout strategy.

[The Core System: Bagua Mirror Formation]

Outside battle, you return to the mirror world to arrange your artifacts on the Bagua Mirror (a circular grid).

◆ Unlock Bagua Sectors – spend spirit stones to gradually unlock all 8 sectors (Qian, Dui, Li, Zhen, Kun, Gen, Kan, Xun).
◆ A

games.name: Bossfall
games.shortDescription: Bossfall is a Sci-Fi Action RPG where you fight the galaxy's most powerful warriors and monsters to claim legendary loot. Shoot and dash through relentless incoming attacks, customize your character's build, and conquer the arena to become the ultimate coliseum champion.
games.aboutText:
Bossfall is a fast paced Sci-Fi Action RPG Boss Rush. Fight a gauntlet of the universe's most lethal warriors and monsters to rise as the arena's ultimate champion.

Master tight controls to shoot and dash your way through dynamic combat. Every victory rewards you with legendary loot, allowing you to endlessly customize your playstyle and adapt to new challenges.

- Action-Packed Arena Combat: Face off against a diverse roster of powerful monsters and formidable adversaries.

- Dedicated Boss Rush: Test both your mechanical skills and your build crafting strategy in an exciting mode against back to back boss fights.

- Deep Customization: Mix and match legendary weapons, spells, and gear to create game breaking builds.

- Tight Mechanics: Master responsive dash and shoot gameplay to effortlessly outmaneuver incoming attacks.

- High Replayability: Experiment with different loadouts to conquer higher difficulties for even better rewards.

Will you rise to the challenge and conquer the competition to become the ultimate champion?

games.name: Brick Buddies
games.shortDescription: Pick up a brick and build a little world. Follow the instructions, add stickers, and collect new models in this cozy brick-building game. Unwind on your own or grow your collection with friends.
games.aboutText:
Find it, pick it up, snap it into place

Open a bag of parts and spread the colorful bricks across your workbench. Follow the instructions, find the pieces you need, and snap them into place. With each satisfying click, your model takes shape. Enjoy the simple pleasure of building, one brick at a time.

On your own or with friends

Build at your own pace, or settle in for a chat with friends. Up to 4 players can share a workbench online and build one model together. Someone puts up the walls while someone else adds the windows, each helping out a piece at a time. Chat, listen to your favorite music, and watch a little creation come together—a keepsake of the time you've shared.

Hands-on, down to the smallest detail

Put on the stickers, open the doors, and move the curtains. Discover rooms and tiny decorations you couldn't see while building. Once the last piece is in place, take a leisurely look around your finished model. The little space you've made is full of details worth a closer look.

What little world will you build today?

Cozy country cottages, spaceships, pirate ships, little retro game consoles, and the tightly packed buildings of Kowloon Walled City. Build your way through a variety of themes, piece by piece. As you finish models in the same theme, a short story unfolds. Grow your collection and discover the warm little stories within.

- Discover 11 themes, 33 models, and 6,000+ bricks to put together, one by one.

- Enjoy making something with your own hands, from opening the bag to placing the last sticker.

- Unwind with a solo build, or finish a model together in online co-op for up to 4 players.

- Fill your collection with new models and discover heartwarming stories along the way.

games.name: Jay and Silent Bob's Joint Venture
games.shortDescription: Turn a rundown backyard into your own cozy cannabis farm. Crossbreed plants to discover unusual effects and grow the strains your neighbors need. Build friendships as you explore the town with Jay and Silent Bob, surrounded by the spirit of ’90s comedy.
games.aboutText:
Joint Venture is a cozy cannabis farming sim where you turn a rundown backyard into a thriving farm, with Jay and Silent Bob around to help.

Their weed sucks, and you’re pretty sure you can grow something better. Starting with some old tools and a handful of seeds, you’ll build up your farm and experiment with crossbreeding to find out what each new strain can do. There’s a whole town to get to know beyond the backyard, and growing the right weed might just get you somewhere with the locals.

That sad backyard has room for something better. Grow your first crop and sell your harvest to fund improvements that let you do more with the place. New buildings and tools help you refine your operation, while furniture and decorations make it feel like home. How far you take it is up to you.

Crossbreed cannabis plants to discover new genetics and find out what their effects can do. Experiment with combinations that catch your interest, then put your discoveries to use in your next crop. When someone around town needs a particular effect, you’ll have a reason to try something different.

Strange requests and funny missions draw you into the lives of the people around town. Helping them builds friendships that move the story forward, giving you more to discover as you get to know each other. Those relationships can open up new places and give you access to strains and farm upgrades. Your neighbors have a part in how your farm grows, too.

Head beyond the backyard to visit the Quick Stop, RST Video, Mooby’s, and the Mall. Familiar faces and locations bring the atmosphere of Kevin Smith’s ’90s comedies into your adventure, with character stories to discover even if this is your first visit to their world. Explore the town for resources and new growing habitats. You can even cast a fishing line into Leonardo’s dumpsters to see what people have thrown away. Some of it belongs on your farm.

There’s no pressure to rush and no fail state waiting for you to get something wrong. Spend an afternoon experimenting with a strain or getting your farm looking the way you want it. The town will still be there when you feel like heading out. You have room to follow your curiosity and enjoy what you’re building.

Build up a rundown backyard with new farming tools and buildings, and decorate it to make it your own.

• Discover cannabis genetics and unusual effects through crossbreeding.

• Sell your harvest to pay for your next farm improvements.

• Complete character requests to develop friendships and progress through the story.

• Explore iconic Jay and Silent Bob locations, with the atmosphere and adult humor of Kevin Smith’s ’90s comedies.

• Gather resources around town and discover new growing habitats.

• Play at your own pace, with no fail states.

Jay and Bob will be around to help. Whatever their idea of “help” is.

games.name: Attack Only
games.shortDescription: Experience a retro RPG as a princess who can only attack. Defeat enemies by targeting the game window and console itself! Before long, you’ll awaken to face a monster in the real world. Enjoy a multi-layered metafiction experience built on a classic RPG foundation.
games.aboutText:
An Attack Only Adventure!

The main character Princess can only attack,

but she's not limited to just hitting enemies! Strike allies, interface elements...and even the console itself?!

Loyal, if Strange, Comrades!

On your journey, you'll be joined by party members like the ultra pious Priest and the sly Mage.

These eccentric allies like to act on their own,

but use your attacks well and you'll guide them to victory!

A Ghastly Demon Army!

Terrifying monsters stand in your way,

but even the worst fiends have their weaknesses!

Never stop attacking, even when all hope is lost!

Step Away From the Game

Thrust back into the real world,

the player must use every method at their disposal to survive the calamity unfolding before them.

Features

- Visuals, audio, and writing dripping with retro game nostalgia

- Fourth-wall breaking terror

- Deeply satisfying enemy encounters that fully test players' wit

- A love letter to RPGs

games.name: Dinosis Zero: Quantum Island
games.shortDescription: Survive on a mysterious island overrun by dinosaurs. Explore abandoned research facilities, uncover the origin of a global catastrophe, craft, build, and fight your way through a dangerous prehistoric world.
games.aboutText:
Dinosis: Quantum Island

You were never supposed to come here.

Explore a mysterious island where prehistoric predators roam freely, gather resources, craft essential equipment, and fight to survive in a hostile world where every expedition could be your last. Uncover the truth behind the island's experiments while facing creatures that should have disappeared millions of years ago.

Every bullet matters. Every decision counts. And on Quantum Island... nothing is quite what it seems.

Features

- Survive against dangerous dinosaurs with unique behaviors.

- Explore a vast tropical island filled with dense jungles, ancient caves, and abandoned research facilities.

- Gather resources, craft tools, weapons, and survival equipment.

- Discover hidden laboratories and piece together the story behind the mysterious Quantum Project.

- Adapt to changing weather conditions and the challenges of day and night.

- Choose your own approach-avoid danger through stealth or fight for survival using crafted and military weapons.

- Freely explore a living open world full of secrets, hidden locations, and unexpected encounters.

Will you escape the island...or become another forgotten part of its experiments?

A Personal Project

Dinosis: Quantum Island is a prequel to Dinosis Survival , a game I released nearly nine years ago as a solo developer.

With Quantum Island , I'm finally returning to the Dinosis universe to reveal the origins of that catastrophe. This project is the game I always wanted to create, built with everything I've learned over the past nine years.

Whether you're a returning fan or discovering Dinosis for the very first time, I hope you'll enjoy uncovering the mystery behind the beginning of the end.

See you on Quantum Island!

games.name: UNLOAD
games.shortDescription: UNLOAD is an interception-focused top-down shooter where ammo is life. Intercept lethal projectiles to reload and survive by a thread. As a Visitor who lost everything in an explosion, hunt down those tied to the incident and uncover the truth behind that day.
games.aboutText:
UNLOAD is an interception-focused top-down shooter where ammo is life. Intercept lethal projectiles to reload and survive by a thread. As a Visitor who lost everything in an explosion, hunt down those tied to the incident and uncover the truth behind that day.

Your Ammo is Your Health

The remaining rounds in your magazine represent your very life force. Every time you pull the trigger against an enemy, you drain your own health. Deplete all your ammo, and you face imminent death. Will you willingly sacrifice your life to destroy your foes, or hold your fire to survive? In the midst of relentless combat, every second demands a strategic decision. Embrace the risk and unleash explosive firepower—experience the true essence of 'high risk, high return.'

Intercept Projectiles to Turn the Tide

The enemy bullet hell pouring in from all sides isn't just a threat. Perfectly intercept incoming enemy attacks! Any projectile you intercept is instantly converted into your life force and offensive power: your ammo. The lower your health gets in extreme situations, the more you must willingly dive straight into the heart of a deadly bullet hell to survive.

Hardcore Boss Rush in Pursuit of the Truth

Across the city, targets leading to the truth behind the explosion await. Forget tedious battles against disposable enemies. Pay each boss a visit, one by one, as they confront you with their own deadly weapons and attack patterns, from relentless bullet projectiles to brutal close-quarters combat. Intercept their attacks, identify their weaknesses, and bring down every formidable foe standing in your way. At the end of your revenge, face the truth that awaits.

games.name: No Results Found
games.shortDescription: Search, dig deeper, and search again. Can you reach the end of the truth?
games.aboutText:
Everyone said the case was closed. Everyone except the victims’ families.

All 227 people affiliated with the Church of the Nine-Tentacled Octopus drowned during one of its religious rituals. A year after the case was closed, the victims’ families insist the investigation reached the wrong conclusion—and demand that the case be reopened.

As a religious studies researcher at a government agency, reexamine the Church’s doctrines and rituals, along with the records left by those connected to the case.

Investigate the Followers’ Hidden Community

Explore a website filled with octopus masks, bizarre commandments, and ridiculous events—and uncover a members-only community hidden within it.

Even throwaway jokes and petty complaints may contain clues. Piece together scattered posts and records to identify the key figures at the heart of the case.

Spot the Clues. Search the Terms. Uncover the Truth.

Important clues are not highlighted in this game. Search for any unfamiliar or suspicious word you come across—or even the takoyaki you had as a snack earlier!

A single search term can reveal a new post—and bring you one step closer to the truth.

games.name: ON&OFF
games.shortDescription: ON&OFF is a turn-based strategy game where you manipulate pieces on a grid to trigger explosive chain reactions. Toggle pieces ON to attack, defend, and heal. Read the enemy's telegraphed intents, unleash powerful skills, and master the board to survive!
games.aboutText:
A turn-based deckbuilding roguelike where you place magical cards on a grid and connect signals.

Reactivate Used Cards

In a typical deckbuilder, cards disappear after being used once. This game is different — cards remain on the board, switching between ON and OFF states, and activate their effects each time they turn back ON from OFF.

If you reactivate the same defense card twice, its defense is applied twice. If you reactivate the same attack card five times, it becomes a five-hit attack.

The true power of your deck is not just how many cards you have, but where you place them and how you turn them back ON.

Send Signals and Connect Chains

When a card turns ON from OFF, it activates its effect and sends signals to nearby cards in the direction of its arrows. A card that receives a signal switches between ON and OFF. Among those cards, only cards that turn ON from OFF activate their effects again and continue sending the next signal.

Turning on just one card in front of you is not enough. Place your cards so that the signal flows from one card to the next, then to the next again, expanding a single activation into a powerful chain. You can create short, reliable chains, or design massive flows that cross the entire board.

Placement Is the True Power of Your Deck

Having powerful cards is not enough.

What matters is reusing the effects you need from the cards you have already placed. Reactivate attack cards to stack up damage, trigger defense cards again to block incoming attacks, or prepare the board for your next chain.

Complete Your Own Way of Activating Cards

Gain new cards as you fight, and build a deck with cards that work well together.

You can move the board in many different ways: a deck that repeatedly awakens one key card, a chain deck that activates many cards at once, or a deck that builds up cost and unleashes it all at once. Through choices that change with every run, complete your own chain structure.

Key Features

- Reusable Cards — Cards do not disappear after being used once. They remain on the board, and whenever a signal turns them back ON from OFF, they activate the same effect again.

- Signal Chain Design — The path of a signal changes depending on each card’s position and direction. With a single placement, complete a massive chain that crosses the entire board.

- Effects That Activate When Turned ON — When a card switches from OFF to ON, it activates its unique effect, such as attack, defense, or draw. Which cards you turn back ON, and how many times you do it, determines the outcome of battle.

- Reusing the Effects You Need — What matters is not creating new effects, but bringing out the effects you need from cards you have already placed. Reactivate attack cards to stack up damage, or trigger defense cards again to block incoming attacks.

- Build Your Own Chain Deck — Gain new cards through battles and build your deck. Move the board in many different ways, such as a deck that repeatedly activates a key card, a chain deck that triggers many cards at once, or a board-building deck that prepares a major activation for the next turn.

games.name: Dear Magical Girls
games.shortDescription: Dear Magical Girls is a story-driven defense game about an overworked magical girl protecting the Mana Stone that keeps the city running. Move the vertices to reshape your magical field. Unlock modules and enchants, and build your own strategy to survive against waves of monsters.
games.aboutText:
“Even when it hurts, even when it breaks you, a magical girl should always smile, right?”

Dear Magical Girls is a story-driven defense game where you reshape a magical barrier to hold back waves of beasts.

Arin is a magical girl in her fourth year on the job, tasked with protecting the mana stones that keep the city’s magical infrastructure running.

Between sleepless shifts and emergency dispatches, she enters the Otherworld, raises her barrier, and fights off the beasts lurking within.

Control the battlefield by reshaping your barrier

Move the vertices of your barrier to expand or shrink your territory.

Attack enemies with mana cannons that travel along the barrier lines.

Expand your territory to secure more resources.

Shrink the barrier to concentrate your firepower in a smaller area.

Keep buffs inside the barrier, and push harmful debuffs out.

You’ll need to keep reshaping your barrier based on the state of the battlefield and the position of nearby resources.

When things get dangerous, stop time, reposition your vertices, and prepare for the next attack.

Add new vertices to strengthen your weapons

Use the mana gained from expanding your barrier to add new vertices.

More vertices allow you to form more complex barrier shapes, increasing your offensive options.

Upgrade your attack power and attack speed, and build the shape and firepower you need for each wave.

Create new builds with modules and enchants

As the story progresses, new modules and enchants will be unlocked.

Equip new attack modules, and use enchants to enhance the traits of your existing ones.

Reshape your barrier around the movement and attack patterns of your modules.

With each wave, the beasts grow stronger. Victory depends on how you shape your barrier and manage your mana.

The story continues after each mission

After each mission, you’ll return to the city and see Arin’s life as a magical girl.

Meet Charlotte, a veteran magical girl; Lily, a girl who admires magical girls; and the people living throughout the city.

As emergency calls keep coming and mysterious disappearances begin to unfold, Arin draws closer to the truth behind mana, magic, and the magical girls themselves.

Key Features

Polygon Defense : A defense system where you directly move vertices to reshape your barrier and control your defensive area.

Module Builds : A build system where modules and enchants change your attack patterns and growth direction.

Magical Girl Narrative : A story centered on Arin, a magical girl worn down by constant dispatches, sleepless shifts, and the burden of always having to smile.

Pixel Art : 2D pixel art visuals depicting both the modern city and the Otherworld beneath its surface.

-------------------------------------------------------------

Log collection is strictly limited to gameplay information for game improvement purposes.

games.name: The Winery - Winemaking Simulator
games.shortDescription: Build your own winery, craft exceptional wines, and grow your reputation with every vintage. Unlock recipes, master new technologies, host winery events, and weather the seasons — because great winemaking is an art, and every bottle tells a story.
games.aboutText:
Create wines worth remembering

The Winery is a relaxing winemaking simulator where every decision shapes the future of your vineyard.

Research new recipes, master production techniques, satisfy demanding customers, and adapt to the challenges of each season. No two years are the same — unexpected events, shifting customer tastes, and the changing seasons will quietly test your skills as a winemaker.

Unlock new recipes and experiment with different production methods to craft wines with unique characteristics. Improve their quality, refine your technique, and discover new styles that appeal to a growing variety of customers.

Every season brings new opportunities

The winemaking process changes throughout the year. Harvest grapes in season, manage production at the right time, and plan to keep your winery running smoothly.

Every customer has different tastes

Customers don't simply ask for "red" or "white." They're looking for specific types, flavors, and characteristics. Learn their preferences and craft wines that match what they're looking for.

Adapt to unexpected events

Your winery is alive with random events that can shape your success. Weather conditions, production incidents, and other surprises will affect the quality of your wines and call for careful decisions.

Research and improve

Unlock modern equipment, advanced technologies, and new production techniques to create higher-quality wines and grow your reputation as a winemaker.

Key Features

- Craft wines using a wide range of unlockable recipes.

- Experience seasonal gameplay that influences every stage of production.

- Satisfy customers with distinct tastes and expectations, each looking for their own perfect wine.

- Host winery activities, including sommelier visits and winery tours, to grow your business.

- Research technologies and expand your production.

games.name: Log Drop
games.shortDescription: A physics sandbox with one noble goal: get more logs into the core than physically reasonable. Chop the trees, build the contraption, then unleash a wave of logs for combo-fueled cash. Kick back and let it flow, or engineer the perfect cascade. Your sandbox, your rules.
games.aboutText:
The core is hungry. Feed it.

Log Drop is a 2D physics automation game with one noble goal: get more logs into the earth's core than is physically reasonable.

Chaotic or orderly, the contraption is yours. Fling, funnel and dam up the logs, then let the whole load go at once. Buy new tools as you go, and upgrade the ones you come to rely on.

It's a sandbox. The core doesn't care how the logs get there.

Features a campaign mode where every zone is its own puzzle, with its own objectives to complete.

There will also be a sandbox mode with unrestricted access to tools so you can build whatever you want.

Other Features to expect

Multiple tree species requiring new tools to harvest and route to the core.

Achievement based meta progression.

Steam Achievements.

games.name: Sudokiller
games.shortDescription: Sudokiller is a cozy mystery puzzle game where you place suspects on a sudoku-style grid to unmask a killer hiding in plain sight. Every guest leaves a clue pinning down where they stood at the time of the murder. Deduce your way through case after case in this cozy, cleverly deceptive mystery.
games.aboutText:
Innocent or guilty? In Sudokiller , your mission is to place every suspect exactly where they were the night of the crime. It's a cozy puzzle mystery game where you're in charge of cracking the case, one clue at a time.

Whether it's a guest bedroom, a busy kitchen, a cluttered greenhouse, or a hidden attic, every crime scene introduces a fresh cast of suspects with their own alibis and habits. A single missing piece of information can turn an open-and-shut case into a full-blown investigation. It's all about reading the clues to find the one arrangement that fits!

Each case unfolds inside a different room of a house full of secrets, filled with charming animal suspects and a victim who always takes the last open seat. Piece together who was where using pure deduction, no guessing, no trial and error, just one logical solution waiting to be uncovered.

- Play detective and place every suspect using sudoku-style logic.

- Who sat where, who had company, and who was never really alone.

- Piece together satisfying puzzles with cozy scenarios to explore and cases to crack at your own pace.

- Unlock new rooms and mansions as you progress, from easy to expert cases.

games.name: Grim Siege
games.shortDescription: Grim Siege is a 1v1 dark-fantasy card duel. Raise your own tower or tear down your enemy's. Six classes and a deep status system turn every turn into a puzzle of combos and counterplay. Take on the AI or other players in quick matches and ranked battles.
games.aboutText:
GRIM SIEGE

Grim Siege is a 1v1 strategic card duel set in a dark fantasy world.
