Raise your own tower to the skies — or crush your enemy's into dust. Every turn is a choice between defense, growth, and merciless assault.

⚔️ The Art of Siege

A wall stands before your tower - the enemy has to break through it first. The whole economy of the game revolves around three resources:
🪨 Stone — defense, walls, shields
🩸 Blood — magic, statuses, and your tower
⛓️ Slaves — aggression and swift strikes

Manage your income, hoard resources and decide where to invest — but beware inflation: you can't hoard forever, tempo is king.

🛡️ Six Classes — Six Strategies
six strategies Each class has strengths and weaknesses that a well-built deck can and should bring out.

- Siege Master - the benchmark besieger with no bonuses and no weaknesses

- Plague Lord - rot and slow decay, but weak direct damage

- Zealot Cultist - damages itself to boost the power of its attacks

- Warlord - swift onslaught and the first strike

- Architect - defense that turns into tower growth

- Dusk Baron - a predator who robs the enemy blind

🃏 Build Your Deck
Build a deck around your class and playstyle - from an impenetrable defense to a merciless rush. Hundreds of decisions, dozens of combinations. Stuff the enemy's deck with all sorts of junk, spam them with rot or madness, or simply bring brute force down on them.

🔥 Statuses & Combos
A deep effect system turns every turn into a puzzle: Rot, Veil, Silence, Chains, Shield, Spikes, Cleanse, Madness, Ward - apply, combine and wreck the enemy's plans with counterplay.

🌐 Game Modes

- Versus AI - several difficulty levels for solo play, a story mode (coming soon), Saga (roguelite)

- Quick matches and ranked PvP - online duels against real players

- Private lobbies - invite a friend to a duel with an invite code

games.name: Camping Keeper
games.shortDescription: Build your campground from the ground up: tent sites, cabins, showers, pools, and the pipes and power lines behind them. Watch autonomous campers live, complain... and review you. Set prices, hire staff, and climb from a muddy one-star field to a five-star resort.
games.aboutText:
Pitch the first tent. Build an outdoor empire.

Camping Keeper is a management game where every camper is a little character living their own life: they arrive, check in at reception, settle in, take a shower, grab an ice cream, grumble when the restrooms are dirty... then leave a review that will make or break your reputation.

Guests bring their own home (tent, caravan, camper van) or rent a fully equipped cabin. A bare tent site earns little but costs almost nothing. Rentals earn big but demand investment and upkeep. Packed budget campground or upscale resort: you decide your campground's identity!

Build the campground, run the pipes

A shaded site near the restrooms but away from the noisy pool is worth far more than a bare patch in the blazing sun. Cram them in for revenue, space them out for satisfaction. Every meter counts, and a single tree or hedge shifts a site's value.

Then comes the part the brochure never shows: water and power don't appear by magic. Run pipes and lines out to your sites and restrooms, place meters and hookups, treat waste water at the treatment plant, and watch for overload as the campground grows. And everything you build, from reception to showers to the pool, needs access, utilities and upkeep.

Watch them live their holiday

Every camper thinks, feels and follows their own desires. Families, retirees, young groups or backpackers: four guest profiles with conflicting expectations. The young partygoer wants noise and life; the retiree wants peace and shade. Put them side by side and you'll hear about it! Your campers tell you at a glance how well your campground is running.

And the sky has its say. Sun, rain, heatwave, storm: the weather sets the tone of the day. A downpour drives the swimmers away and fills the common room; a storm turns the paths to mud and threatens flooding; a heatwave sends everyone hunting for shade and a cold drink. Four seasons pace the year, and your campers adapt before your eyes.

Manage prices, staff and upkeep

Guests pay a fixed fee on arrival. From there, everything rides on the stay you give them, and on a payroll that never stops.

- Staff: receptionists, cleaners, technicians, each with their own tasks

- Cleanliness: overflowing bins, restrooms and sites to clean

- Catering: four tiers, from vending machines to a full restaurant

- Dynamic pricing: weekends, demand, occupancy

- Leisure: pool, supervised swimming, water slide, campfires, barbecues, playgrounds

- Repairs: broken equipment stays unusable until a technician gets to it

Prosper: from one star to five

Every stay ends in a rated, commented online review, and those reviews build your reputation, which is what brings in the next guests. Keep your facilities running and your star rating climbs; let the restrooms rot and it falls just as fast.

Each scenario is a campground of its own, with missions to complete and Bronze, Silver and Gold trophies to earn. Reinvest your profits, expand the grounds, and take a muddy one-star field all the way to a five-star destination. Rather build with nobody watching? Sandbox mode is there for that.

Build. Manage. Prosper.

In development

Camping Keeper is in active development. Already on the roadmap: dedicated activities (dance nights, pétanque , kids' club), an eco-friendly label, pet management, security and gatecrashers, special groups, and more to come.

games.name: No Such Person
games.shortDescription: 一款以清末民初的上海为时代背景的社会派推理游戏。你在一台历史悬案核查终端前接手这项任务：为墙中无名遗骸重建家族谱系。翻阅泛黄的婚书、讣告与老照片，看清旧秩序崩塌之际每个人的选择与挣扎。
games.aboutText:
一具遗骸没有姓名。要确认他是谁，你必须先还原一个消失近百年的家族。

上海一座老宅翻修时，工人在墙体夹层中发现了一具无名遗骸。没有能够证明身份的随身物品，没有明确对应的户籍或迁葬记录，也没有可供比对的亲缘样本。

案件被移交到历史悬案核查机构，而你，是负责认定其身份的法医族谱调查员。

从档案中寻找一个人

在办案终端中检索姓名、地点与事件，阅读旧照片、家书、讣告、报纸和官方档案。

记录不会直接告诉你答案。同一个人可能在不同材料中使用不同称呼；一份档案留下的空白，也许要从另一封信或另一张照片中补全。

重建盛氏家族

辨认照片中的人物，将姓名、照片和生卒年份填入族谱，判断他们之间的婚姻、血缘与代际关系。

每一次正确认定都会缩小剩余答案的范围，并带来新的证物、人物与调查方向。

让证据彼此印证

你掌握的每份材料都可能不完整，甚至彼此矛盾。

比对年代、称谓与人物关系，排除误导，让散落在不同记录中的事实彼此印证。遇到困难时，渐进式提示系统会由浅入深地提供帮助，由你决定需要多少提示。

墙中的遗骸究竟是谁？

这个名字，又为什么没有留在盛氏家族的记录中？

games.name: Can you cook my last meal?
games.shortDescription: A game where you become a prison chef and cook the final meals of death row inmates. Read each prisoner’s profile, choose ingredients, prepare the meal, and talk with them.
games.aboutText:
In Torsia, a nation where the Enhanced Death Penalty System is in effect, Shoton Prison is one of its execution sites.

You are assigned as a chef responsible for preparing meals for death row inmates.

You will meet them before their executions.

Read each prisoner’s profile.

Choose which ingredients to cook with.

Prepare the meal and serve it to the death row inmate.

When the meal is over, send them on to the final procedure.

In the moments before execution, how will you treat the death row inmate?

What will you say to them?

The Chef’s Story

How did he become a prison chef?

What is he waiting for in this place?

And how will his story end?

The Prisoners’ Stories

What will death row inmates say when death is near?

Will they claim injustice? Will they give up and accept death?

What will their final moments look like?

Your Story

You will meet people who are about to die—people sentenced for crimes judged worthy of death.

Is their death unjust? Do they deserve to die?

Do they deserve to be served one final meal? Or is even that more than they deserve?

What will you choose?

games.name: The Fledge
games.shortDescription: Lost adrift in the Antarctic, your hatchling is all that matters. Hunt, evade predators, feed and protect your only offspring in this short, atmospheric penguin survival experience. Each day is a race to stay alive, as the frozen oceans you once called home are overwhelmed by unfamiliar forces.
games.aboutText:
Lost adrift in the Antarctic, your hatchling is all that matters. Hunt, evade predators, feed and protect your only offspring in this short, atmospheric penguin survival experience. Each passing day is a race to stay alive, as the frozen oceans you once called home are overwhelmed by unfamiliar forces.

- Hunt for food

- Carry your hatchling to safety

- Evade dangerous predators

- Protect your hatchling from hazards

- Adapt to the changing environment

games.name: Amara
games.shortDescription: Manage and grow your cozy café from scratch in a world full of adorable talking cats. Craft authentic coffee drinks inspired by real barista techniques, upgrade your shop, serve your fluffy customers, and become beloved by all.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to your dream café!

What could be better than spending your days making coffee for adorable cats?

Play as Rebeca, a young woman who suddenly wakes up in a world full of talking cats. Spend the next 30 days helping a cozy café flourish as you make cute drinks, serve charming feline customers, and master recipes inspired by real barista techniques. Every shift brings new faces, new recipes, and another chance to become beloved by all.

Brew Coffee

Coffee is at the heart of Amara .

Learn techniques inspired by real-world baristas as you grind coffee beans, pull espresso shots, steam milk, and prepare a variety of delicious drinks. Every recipe is crafted to capture the satisfying process of making coffee by hand.

Meet Your Feline Customers

No café is complete without its regulars.

Serve a cast of adorable cat customers, each with their own favorite drinks and unique personalities. Keep everyone happy, earn money to improve the café, and watch new faces become familiar ones.

Help the Café Thrive

As the café becomes more popular, unlock new ingredients, recipes, equipment, and expansions to serve even more customers. Manage your stock carefully—running out of coffee beans in the middle of a busy day is every barista's nightmare.

Unwind After Every Shift

When the workday is over, head to your bedroom to reflect on your day.

Write in your diary, order supplies for tomorrow, and get some well-earned rest before another morning behind the espresso machine.

More Than Just a Cozy Café...

Some dreams feel too perfect to last forever.

As the days pass, Rebeca begins to notice that not everything is quite as peaceful as it seems. Beneath the comforting routine of brewing coffee and serving smiling customers lies a story waiting to unfold.

Features

- Prepare coffee drinks inspired by real barista techniques.

- Serve charming feline customers with their favorite orders.

- Unlock new recipes, ingredients, equipment, and café expansions.

- Manage your inventory and keep the café running smoothly.

- Relax after every workday by writing in your diary and preparing for tomorrow.

- Experience a heartfelt narrative hidden beneath a cozy routine.

games.name: Cleaning Up The Puzzle Gallery
games.shortDescription: Cleaning Up The Puzzle Gallery is a cozy first-person organization simulator about cleaning up 5000+ puzzle pieces scattered across a gallery of ~200 famous paintings. Whether you want to relax and solve jigsaw puzzles to classical music, or min-max the fastest times, the gallery needs cleaning.
games.aboutText:
Synopsis

When's the worst time to be the janitor of a puzzle gallery? After an earthquake, of course! You play as the janitor of a puzzle gallery, and an earthquake has scattered all of the 5000+ puzzle pieces everywhere. Your job is to use your puzzling skills (and some added enhancements) to put all of the pieces back in their place.

The Ultimate Challenge or the Coziest Simulator

Listen to classical music and admire famous paintings as you solve nearly 200 jigsaw puzzles of varying shapes, subjects, and sizes. Whether you want to see how fast you can solve every one by min-maxing various abilities and sprinting across the gallery, or you just want to chill and work on some puzzles, this clean up simulator is right for you.

A Gallery Of Masterpieces...

The gallery is home to nearly 200 paintings from over 20 famous artists such as Monet, Van Gogh, Hokusai, and more, ensuring each piece and section is visually unique and distinctive from the others. Each of the paintings was sourced from Public Domain scans and photographs of their museum originals.

... Or Curated by YOU

Upload your images and turn them into puzzles! You can solve them one at a time and adjust their size, or fill the entire gallery with your own curated selection in the My Puzzles game mode, providing you with full customization and endless gameplay.

But You Aren't The ONLY Janitor

The My Puzzles Custom Gallery Mode now supports up to 4 players, so whether you want to handle the mess as a solo job or bring some friends, for your own curated gallery or the classic paintings, it all gets cleaned by the end of the day.

Key Features

- Intuitive controls and visuals such as ghost previews on hover and shimmering piece lock-in effects make the act of solving a puzzle both satisfying and exciting.

- Skill upgrades to different areas of your brain that help you find, manipulate, and solve puzzles quicker with each puzzle you complete.

- Challenge Modes for those puzzlers that don't need any extra assistance, or are looking for different challenges to make the game feel totally different such as a Black & White Mode and "The Big White" (1024 pieces of pure white).

- Turn any image you want into puzzles of varying shapes and sizes so that, whether you want to create a greater challenge with a 1000 piece landscape, or just turn your pet into a 50 piece easy solve, you can solve as many puzzles as you want!

- Want to curate your own gallery? You can upload up to 500 images and fill the gallery with memes, custom artwork, or really anything (so long as it's a png, jpg, webp, or other common image format).

games.name: Thimbleweed Park 2
games.shortDescription: Agents Ray and Reyes are investigating a murder at the Mansion. In a spoof of a classic whodunit, everyone is a suspect and the murderer will be confronted…... If you can find them. Not really a sequel. Not really a prequel. It’s more Thimbleweed Park and just as weird.
games.aboutText:
Welcome back to Thimbleweed Park.

Thimbleweed Park 2 is coming in 2028, and it’s more Thimbleweed Park than ever.

This time the dead body is at the Edmund Mansion, and Agents Ray and Reyes are back to investigate… or are they?

In a point-and-click spoof of a classic whodunit, everyone in the Mansion is a suspect and the murderer will be confronted by our detectives. If you can find them. Spoiler: It’s not the butler.

By the end of another long, strange night in Thimbleweed Park, you’ll have more questions than answers.

Not really a sequel. Not really a prequel. It’s more Thimbleweed Park and just as weird.

And just like last time, in a town like Thimbleweed Park, a dead body is the least of your problems.

Wishlist today, and follow along with behind-the-scenes dev blogs at the Thimbleweed Park 2 website!

ABOUT THIMBLEWEED PARK

The original Thimbleweed Park came out in 2017 following a Kickstarter from Maniac Mansion co-creators Ron Gilbert and Gary Winnick. (Ron is also the creator of the Monkey Island series… maybe you’ve heard of it?) Thimbleweed Park is a point & click adventure in the classic LucasArts style with five playable characters, a zany supporting cast, distinctive pixel art, and an absurd mystery storyline that gets weirder with every twist. A free Thimbleweed Park mini-adventure, Delores , came out in 2020.

games.name: Me and You
games.shortDescription: Me and You is a co-op puzzle game inspired by the acclaimed “Baba Is You”. Create, change and break the rules of each level to solve it together.
games.aboutText:
Connect the word

Push scraps of paper, rocks, and walls to form the rules of the level. Characters transform, walls crumble, and keys appear out of nowhere

Together we'll get through anything

Every level is designed to be solved co-op. Only teamwork and constant communication will get you to the end.

Unexpected solutions

Turn your friend into a door, a rock, or a wall — who knows what it'll take to crack the next puzzle.

games.name: The Backrooms : Threshold
games.shortDescription: A 1–4 player co-op investigation horror game where you enter the Backrooms through an experimental gateway. Explore procedurally generated environments, document anomalies, recover valuable artifacts, and survive the unknown.
games.aboutText:
Backrooms: Threshold

The Backrooms have been breached.

An experimental gateway has opened a path into the Backrooms, an endlessly generated labyrinth of impossible architecture.

Enter alone or with your team to map unexplored spaces, document unexplained phenomena, recover anomalous objects, and investigate entities that should not exist.

Every expedition takes you somewhere different. Familiar corridors can give way to vast chambers, split levels, sunken spaces, bridges, overlooks, and strange structures formed by the procedural architecture itself.

You never know what lies beyond the next wall. (or beneath it)

Explore a Procedurally Generated Backrooms

The architecture itself is generated.

Every expedition begins with a randomized seed, creating a new world from the ground up. Not from prebuilt rooms, but from procedurally generated spaces, connections, elevations, and structures.

With over 18 quintillion possible seeds, each generating an effectively infinite world , every portal can open somewhere entirely different. From the moment you step through, you can encounter spaces and structures that no other player has ever seen before.

Familiar corridors can open into vast chambers, split across multiple levels, or continue into strange spaces above and below you.

Every expedition is a journey into a Backrooms that may have never existed before.

Investigate the Unknown

Every expedition is an opportunity to discover something new.

Bring specialized research equipment into the Backrooms to document entities, uncover hidden anomalies, and gather evidence of the unexplained.

- Capture entities and strange phenomena with your camcorder.

- Photograph anomalous objects and environments.

- Use specialized instruments to detect what can't be seen.

- Map the world around you as you explore.

- Return with evidence, samples, and discoveries to advance your research.

Not everything you discover can be brought back. Sometimes, the evidence is all you'll have.

games.name: CASHKET
games.shortDescription: Make a fortune off the dead. Open stolen coffins for an evil company, sell the loot, and gamble your finds for bigger rewards. Automate the dirty work, unlock the coffins of giants and titans, and crack open rocks to uncover ancient fossils.
games.aboutText:
You're working for an evil company. Some people take their valuables to the grave. Your employer calls that wasted inventory.

CRACK OPEN YOUR NEXT PAYDAY

Buy stolen coffins, pry off their lids, and search the remains for valuables. You’ve already paid. Now find out whether it was worth it.

SELL. REINVEST. GO BIGGER.

Sell your finds and fund your next delivery. Progress from ordinary coffins to those of giants and monsters. Bigger coffins mean more work before payday.

FOSSILS PAY THE BILLS

The company soon sets its sights on the oldest coffins of all: rocks. Crack them open, uncover fossils of all kinds, and turn prehistoric remains into serious profits.

PUT YOUR LOOT ON THE LINE

When money gets tight, try your luck with the upgrader. Place an item inside and choose a multiplier. Bigger rewards come with lower odds. Win something more valuable, or lose the item you could’ve sold.

INVEST IN YOURSELF

Put your profits into personal upgrades. Move faster, jump higher, and get the job done quicker. The next coffin isn’t going to open itself.

games.name: Cult Of Echoes
games.shortDescription: Use echolocation to hunt your friends down in an asymmetrical horror game where SOUND IS EVERYTHING. Work together with your friends to banish the demon and escape the ritual!
games.aboutText:
Use ECHOLOCATION to hunt your friends down in an asymmetrical horror game where SOUND is everything.

The Echolocation Killer!

As COUNTDOWN, hunt your friends by tracking their soundwaves, find and use powerful occult traps and weapons, and use your special abilities to outwit and crush your friends' hopes of escaping in one piece. Terrify your friends in proximity chat with a horrifically distorted booming voice. Light up your surroundings with sound by screaming bloody murder, or stay silent and stalk your prey in the dark.

1 Killer + Up To 8 Survivors in Online Multiplayer!

Your friends whoopsied and summoned an eldritch clockwork abomination into one of their bodies. Solve puzzles, craft tools and trinkets, and STAY UNHEARD to survive and banish COUNTDOWN. Play with up to eight players in a lobby, and either randomly roll for the monster, or step into the summoning circle to elect yourself for the curse! Work together as survivors or split up: either way, you're all on the run.

Solve Puzzles While Staying Unheard!

COUNTDOWN sees the world through sound, but between you and your escape stand puzzles requiring teamwork and communication. Remaining unheard is key, but you'll have to risk talking to solve problems together and collect the gears required to banish the monster.

Distract COUNTDOWN with RC Cars, Firework Launchers, and other Gizmos!

Find and construct powerful tools to distract, confuse, and deter COUNTDOWN. Remote-Controlled Cars which project your voice, Walkie Talkies that can be left on as bait, Firework guns to overload the monster's senses--use everything at your disposal to gain an advantage!

No Generative AI

Cult of Echoes contains no Generative AI content, every sprite, model, and line of code is lovingly crafted by our two-person team. We're doing our best to make games the way they should be made, and we hope you enjoy it!

Keep up with Cult of Echoes' development by joining our Discord Server!

games.name: Idle Fleet
games.shortDescription: Command a mining fleet that never clocks out. Train 7 skills, automate them with drones, trade on a player-driven market, and forge the legendary Vanguard hull — all server-side, so your fleet keeps working while you sleep. Log in to progress you actually earned.
games.aboutText:
Idle Fleet is a persistent, server-authoritative idle skilling game set in a quiet corner of deep space. Mine asteroid belts, strip wrecks, refine alloys, fabricate modules, run combat zones, haul contracts, and launch day-long deep-space expeditions. Every activity levels up separately; milestones permanently speed up the work.

The server settles your fleet whether your PC is on or not. Come back to a welcome report, not a catch-up screen. Buy up to six autonomous drones and park them on any unlocked activity — they work around the clock at their own efficiency.

A Grand-Exchange-style order book with no NPC prices: every price is set by players, taxed by the exchange, guarded by price bands. Ore feeds refineries, alloys feed fabricators, ammo feeds combat — low-tier materials stay valuable forever.

Every subsystem tier is welded visibly onto your hull. Endgame: commission the Vanguard, a second hull forged from the entire economy.

One shared world, one ladder, no resets. Race to the first 99 and the Grandmaster cape.

Everything is computed server-side from a single settlement engine — no client math, no cheats, no rollback wipes. What the ladder shows is what happened.

games.name: PAPER.VOID
games.shortDescription: Pilot a paper plane through an infinite monochrome dimension. Collect VOID Cubes, survive your own deadly trail, and face the END of reality.
games.aboutText:
Enter The VOID...

Navigate an infinite monochrome dimension where many mysteries are yet to be discovered. You are merely a paper plane, flying through space as you destroy universes collect VOID Cubes which further distort the world around you...

The VOID may be infinite, but as you progress further, it becomes increasingly challenging to navigate as you leave behind a permanent deadly trail of light. Your sense of scale, gravity, and depth do not exist here.

When reality reaches its END, can you survive your own self-made labyrinth? Or will your journey lead to an inevitable PAPER CUT...

Features

- Fly through an ever-changing monochrome dimension

- Leave behind a permanent deadly trail

- Survive escalating Void Forms that distort reality

- Collect VOID Cubes to unlock new paper planes

- Experience an original atmospheric soundtrack

- Challenge your skills with the unpredictable bonus RGB shards

Customise your Experience...

Piloting The VOID questions everything. Purpose. Presence. Goals. Reality itself. However, you also have the ability to do so in style. The more VOID Cubes you collect, the more plane skins you unlock. Only the best of the best VOIDFALLERS reach the highest of heights... Or rather, the deepest of depths.

The Future...

Your journey through this reality begins here, but it never truly ends. This is a mere Demonstration of the full truth behind The VOID. Planned future updates will include:

- Global leaderboards and achievements

- The " FALL. " Void Form + " HYPERCORE. " Story Finale alongside other newer forms

- The VOID EDITOR mode, where flight becomes art and The VOID is your canvas. Create your own stories and share with the universe

- The ENDLESS mode, a roguelike experience with even more reality distorting Void Forms

- And finally, the most important of all. Friends.

If you choose to enter The VOID, it may just become your home. Enjoy your journey through this infinite dimension.

A time may come where you may choose to be finished with The VOID.

However.

So long as you live within it....

The VOID is never finished with you.

games.name: Global Plates
games.shortDescription: Build food factories that keep a cat café purring. Plan at your own pace, serve fresh dishes through the rush and turn your best days into upgrades. Travel through ten kitchens in a cozy cooking-automation game about tasty efficiency.
games.aboutText:
🍕 Build Delicious Factories

Cook your way around the world, one cat café at a time. Connect machines with conveyor belts and watch recipes come together. Plan at your own pace: nothing scores or spoils.

🐾 A Café Full of Opinions

Open for a timed service day and a hungry rush. Cats comment on meals, waits and furniture. Fresh plates and fast service earn more coins, which decide your rating. Chase three stars: every cat served, every plate fresh, nobody kept waiting.

🥬 Keep It Fresh

Early kitchens let you settle in without spoilage. From Sushi onward, food ages during service from the moment it is made, on belts, in machines and on the counter. Stale dishes dull, smoke and draw flies. A disappointed cat even names the ingredient that went stale, helping you rethink the line.

🌍 Travel the World

Ten handcrafted kitchens will take you from Pasta in Italy to Chicken Tikka Masala in India. Explore a hand-drawn travel-journal map and collect regional passport stamps.

📖 Discover, Tinker, Improve

Experiment to uncover your Discovery Journal's recipe tree. Spend coins on cozy furnishings, decorations and speed upgrades that work in every kitchen. Shape clever routes with fast belts, splitters, joiners and a Filter Arm, plus cookers with two independent slots.

💛 Pull Up a Cushion

A cozy cooking-automation game about tasty efficiency, made by a solo developer. Play in 10 languages. Try the free demo and wishlist the full game.

games.name: A Life as the Ming Fades
games.shortDescription: A narrative strategy game set in late Ming China. Follow a scholar or a military household’s heir through seventeen years of change. Develop towns, resolve disputes, bring relief, manage supplies and command battles as you care for family, help your neighbors and shape your own life.
games.aboutText:
A Life as the Ming Fades is a historical narrative strategy game set in late Ming China, combining character growth, town management and battlefield command. The Early Access version includes complete Local and Frontier story routes. The game currently supports Simplified Chinese only.

◆ A life begins in the first year of Chongzhen

After years of study, a young scholar finally leaves his books behind to put what he has learned into practice. Before him lie a town in need of recovery, farmers hoping for a good harvest, and neighbors waiting for someone to hear their side of a dispute.

Another story begins with a military household in Xuanfu. With an aging father and an elder brother who never returned, you take up the family's old armor and the responsibility of caring for your loved ones and protecting your home.

Across the seventeen years of the Chongzhen era, personal lives are entwined with a changing world. You will find friends willing to help, but also scarce supplies, disasters, war and disagreements among those working beside you. How will you support your family, help your neighbors and contribute to the place you call home?

◆ The Local route: put learning into practice

Agriculture, trade, crafts, education and defenses all shape everyday life. Allocate limited funds and grain, develop local production, support education, strengthen defenses and organize relief so displaced families have a chance to settle again.

Local responsibilities also involve investigating cases and resolving disputes. Arguments over land, money and grain each have people and circumstances behind them. Establishing the facts and reaching a fair decision takes patience, and every decision carries consequences.

As your experience grows, you will travel to new places and face new challenges. The ideals you formed as a student will be tested through the people you meet and the work you undertake.

◆ The Frontier route: stand together and protect a community

Set out from Xuanfu and travel through the borderlands and the Central Plains. Thirteen regional strategy maps follow the changing circumstances of the late Ming era.

Scout enemy movements, cultivate farmland, gather supplies and train troops. How you distribute provisions, care for local people and coordinate with your comrades will affect the battles ahead.

Command real-time battles with shield infantry, spearmen, archers, crossbowmen, cavalry, firearm troops and artillery. Adapt to terrain and enemy formations while balancing opportunity, supply lines and the safety of your soldiers.

Meet historical figures such as Lu Xiangsheng, Sun Chuanting and Cao Wenzhao. Shared experiences can build friendships or reveal differences. Holding a town, supporting an allied force or bringing more people home safely may change what happens next.

◆ Letters from home

Family remains part of your journey. Your sister's marriage, your younger brother's studies and interests, and your relatives' livelihoods and destinations change with time and your choices.

Letters carried across long distances bring hopes of reunion and requests for help. How a family supports one another through upheaval is an important part of this life.

◆ Key features

- Two life paths : experience local affairs or frontier life through the different backgrounds of a scholar and a military household's heir.

- Management and investigation : develop towns, respond to disasters and investigate cases while gaining practical experience.

- Regional strategy and real-time battles : gather supplies, farm, scout, deploy and command different troop types together.

- Growth and relationships : study, learn and form connections through the people you meet and the responsibilities you share.

- Personal lives within history : follow the late Ming historical timeline as individual choices interact with a changing world.

- Multiple endings : your actions shape the lives of your family, comrades and communities, and become the story of your own life.

◆ Seventeen years to write your story

From a student's aspirations to the lessons of experience; from caring for one family to doing what you can for a whole community.

Through difficult times, find something worth standing by, people you can rely on, and the strength to help others.

games.name: High Roller Penny
games.shortDescription: A bold pachinko-inspired roguelike. With bunny girls. Build your best pegboard with special pegs, balls and passive effects to reach legendary scores. Lose and get executed on the spot. Oh did we mention this is a death game?
games.aboutText:
Highroller Penny is a pachinko-inspired roguelike about creating big numbers for your freedom and the happiness of your Bunny Girl.

Drop a ball down your pegboard and watch it fly, with every peg hit adding points to your score. Overcome the quota, and you'll live to see another round. But strike out, and you're literally dead!

Procure powerful pegs, create cascading combos, and see your score soar - then do it all over again with new pegs and balls to go even further!

- Hypnotic ball physics and dopamine hits with every peg you pop!

- Win tickets and purchase powerful pegs and balls for better builds and synergies

- Everything comes at a price. You can sell off everything you own, your tickets, your pegs, even your precious balls.. just be sure you can recoup them!

- A seedy casino teeming with debt-addled individuals to bet against, each with their own special tricks

- Bouncy bunny girls. Boing!

-

Enter Yami-Pachi, a shady, underground organization that runs illegal, life-or-death gambling games - using their debtors as the players. With immense control over most casinos and money beyond your imagination, it’s the corrupted, beating heart that pumps dirty money through the undercity.

You are a pathetic debtor who was beaten over the head by Penny, a Bunny Girl and debtor handler who abducted you to Yami-Pachi. Unfortunately for you, Penny’s not like the other Bunny Girls - she’s a lunatic who cares for nothing but the High Roller.

Penny is invoking the High Roller Rule! Under Yami-pachi's watch, a High Roller game pits two bunny girls against each other.

Man does your luck suck.

As the challenger, your goal is to defeat all other bunny girls and rise to the top of the ranks! If you win, Penny claims her glory and your debts are fully repaid. If you lose... well, it's best not to think about it.

Either way, you don't have much of a choice. Go big... or get executed on the spot!

games.name: Granule
games.shortDescription: A physics sandbox about Murray, who didn't let a witch merge onto the highway. She sent him to The Granule, and something already lives there. You. Burn, freeze, shock, slice, and mend him. None of it is scripted, and the room is not all there is.
games.aboutText:
Granule is a physics sandbox built around a ragdoll who won't stay dead. Break, bleed, burn, and dismember him with a growing set of tools, powers, and more.

It all starts with Murray, a man who, on a particularly bad day, did not let a certain driver merge onto the highway. That driver was a witch. In her rage, she sent Murray to The Granule: a dimension beyond death, but not beyond torment. Unknown to the witch and Murray, something already lives there. You.

Everything in the room is simulated, and the fun is in what happens when the systems meet. Water fills the room and drains out. Fire spreads along anything that burns. Ice forms in the cold and melts near the heat. Lightning runs through water and through whoever is standing in it. Portals pass anything through, limbs included. It all runs at once, so things happen that were never built on purpose.

Some of what you can do to him is simple: a blade, a bat, a gun. The rest goes further. You can flood the room, turn off gravity, open holes in the walls, split him into smaller copies of himself, or reach into his head. There is far more than any list here could cover, and it keeps growing.

Murray has a working body under the skin. He bleeds, chokes, burns, freezes, and blacks out, and the diagram shows all of it as it happens. There is no game over. There's just whatever state you left him in.

The room is where you keep him. It is not all there is. The Granule is more vast than he could ever imagine, and you are not its only occupant. Some of the others have already taken notice.

Granule is in Early Access, with lots more items, mod support, building, saving rooms, and more creatures and places still to come.

games.name: 群侠传：幸存者
games.shortDescription: Survive 20 waves in this wuxia action roguelite. Master 153 martial arts, collect 247 items, and face 55 enemy types from 8 factions. Combine Outer, Inner, and Movement Arts, then snowball your build with Resonance, Stored Power, Combos, and training bonuses to become a martial arts master.
games.aboutText:
A Martial Arts Take on the Survivors-like Roguelite

Qunxia Survivor is a survivors-like action roguelite set in a world of wuxia: martial artists, rival sects, and wandering heroes. If you enjoy surviving hordes and crafting builds in Vampire Survivors or Brotato, discover a familiar loop built around martial arts, inner cultivation, and treasures from the jianghu.

Choose your character, sect, and martial style. Your Outer Arts activate automatically in the order you arrange them. Keep moving, dash out of danger, and collect the coins and loot scattered across the battlefield.

Core Gameplay

- Automatic attacks, hands-on survival : Your Outer Arts activate in the sequence you set. Plan your attack order, then use movement and well-timed dashes to stay alive.

- 20 waves : Between waves, train your attributes, shop for martial arts manuals and unusual items, and rearrange your Outer Arts, Inner Arts, and Movement Arts.

- Martial Arts Resonance : Combine arts from the same sect or martial style to unlock Resonance bonuses. Shape your build around the combinations you discover.

- Snowball to mastery : Level up your arts and combine Resonance, Stored Power, Combos, and training bonuses. Invest your earnings in new manuals and items, and turn a promising build into a path to mastery.

What's in the Game Right Now

- 153 martial arts, including Outer Arts, Inner Arts, and Movement Arts

- 247 items to discover and build around

- 55 enemy types from 8 factions

The game is in active development — more martial styles and more content are planned for future updates.

From the Developer

There is just one human on this game's "team": me.

Most of the code, art, animation, and music was created with AI tools: Codex and Claude Code for programming; GPT-IMAGE-2 and Nano Banana for characters, environments, and UI; Seedance for animation; Suno for music; and ElevenLabs for voices and sound effects.

I handle the game design, balance, and game feel, testing and adjusting things over hundreds of playtest sessions.

I've been playing games for almost twenty years. I opened a game engine for the first time in April 2026, and this is the first game with my name in the "developer" field. I hope you enjoy this little corner of the jianghu.

If you like what you see, adding the game to your wishlist would mean a lot to a developer who is still learning the ropes.

games.name: Songs of the Shoals
games.shortDescription: Cast a line, sail between islands, and bring your catch home in a single-player fishing adventure. Sell fish, take harbor commissions, upgrade your gear, and explore coastal villages under changing skies. Take a seaplane flight for a new view of the sea.
games.aboutText:
A fishing rod, a sea breeze, and somewhere new to go

Songs of the Shoals is a single-player fishing and island-travel adventure. Leave the harbor, cast from shore or stop your boat over promising water, and enjoy the moment of waiting for a bite. Bring your catch home to sell, complete commissions, improve your gear, and let the next voyage take you a little farther.

Find the rhythm of the catch

Watch for a bite, time your response, and follow the fish's rhythm to land your catch. Notice how fishing spots, depth, weather, and time of day change what you can find. Fill your fishing handbook, make another trip to the harbor for better gear, or spend an afternoon at a favorite cove.

- Fish from the shore or from a stopped boat.
- Sell your catch, complete harbor commissions, and upgrade your rod and boat.
- Choose your next fishing ground and set your own pace.

Follow the sea breeze to another island

Sail through different bays and islands, then come ashore to wander through villages. Discover docks, lighthouses, a seaside cafe, and the people and scenery along the way. Daylight and weather change the water around you and offer new clues about where to fish next.

See the sea from above

When you want a different perspective, take a seaplane over the shore and islands. Look back at the route you sailed and see the archipelago beneath the passing clouds.

Calm water and changing skies

Sunshine, clouds, rain, and sea mist give each voyage a different mood. Waves, boat wakes, and shifting cloud cover shape the journey; when a storm arrives, the distant sea reveals a more mysterious side.

games.name: Three Kingdoms The Mainland
games.shortDescription: 在群雄割据的三国乱世中，从零开始建设村庄，发展势力、抵御敌军，最终统一天下。
games.aboutText:
在群雄割据的三国乱世中，从零开始建设村庄，发展势力、抵御敌军，最终统一天下。

🪓 砍树、采矿、种田、建造，打造属于自己的三国城池。

🌾 自动工作的村民 AI，合理安排每位武将的职责。

⚔️ 黄巾军、山贼、诸侯不断来袭，守护你的家园。

👥 招募三国名将，每位英雄拥有独特能力和性格。

📜 科技、建筑、农业、军事同步发展，体验从村庄到王朝的成长。

🏯 在开放地图中扩张势力，最终完成统一天下的霸业。

games.name: Arcane Abyss
games.shortDescription: A pixel-art, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder where your cards are swords, axes and spears, and you throw them. Thrown weapons stay on the board: hit one with another to trigger Resonance, a combo attack that chains to nearby weapons. Synthesis moves abilities between weapons.
games.aboutText:
Weapons are meant to be thrown.

Arcane Abyss is a pixel-art, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder where you fight by throwing weapons.

Swords, axes, spears—throw them straight from your hand of cards to attack monsters.

Transfer abilities through weapon synthesis, then combine them with Skill Cards to find your own way to fight.

Make weapons collide to trigger Resonance and get even more out of the abilities you've added.

Delve into the Abyss in search of rare weapons!

Resonance: throw a weapon into a weapon

Thrown weapons remain on the board. Hit one with another weapon to trigger Resonance , drawing out both weapons' abilities. Strike groups of monsters with wide-area attacks and special attacks.

When a Resonance attack catches other weapons in its path, it triggers further Resonance. Even simply scattering weapons around the board can lead to an unexpectedly powerful attack.

Keep an eye on weapon abilities that activate repeatedly through Resonance, too. As Resonance triggers again and again, synergies make those abilities more and more powerful.

It's the perfect chance to test the weapons you've enhanced through synthesis alongside your skills. Take advantage of terrain altered by elemental effects and aim to wipe out every monster.

Synthesis: move abilities to your favorite weapon

There's more to a new weapon than simply using it as it is. Use it as synthesis material to transfer its abilities to another weapon.

For example, add an ability that draws a card when you deal damage to a weapon you use often. Now you can replenish your hand with your next weapon while attacking enemies.

Will you choose raw attack power, or an ability that fits your current build? Even a weapon you'd normally overlook might hold the missing piece of the combination you've been looking for.

Skill Cards: passive perks that work on their own

Skill Cards grant passive abilities that take effect automatically once acquired. There's no need to activate them manually in battle.

MP Efficiency makes weapons with high MP costs easier to use. HP Drain restores HP based on the damage you deal. Sword Mastery enables sword attacks to land critical hits—and that's just the beginning.

Do you want more attacks, a reliable source of healing, or one devastating blow?

Combine weapon abilities and skills to shape your fighting style. With synthesis and Skill Cards, the possibilities for growing stronger are endless.

Every run, a new build

Choose four abilities through runes before setting out, and your adventure begins.

Choose your route through a branching map and work toward defeating the boss. Alongside weapons dropped by monsters, the armory lets you pick one weapon from three options. Put your build together through synthesis and skills.

Pursue the combination you had in mind, or change course to suit the weapons you find—the choice is yours. An ability you ignored last time might become the centerpiece of your build this time around.

Story: the day her home became a dungeon

One day, apprentice mage Elly comes home to find that her house has turned into a dungeon. She knows only one combat spell: channeling magic into a weapon and throwing it. Her fight against the monsters leads her down into the Abyss. The story unfolds in illustrated, picture-book-style scenes, and the Black Cat Shop awaits you at the hub.

- Available in 10 languages
- Single-player
- Free demo: play all of Areas 1 and 2
- Full release: November 2026

Gameplay Videos and Livestreaming

Let's Plays, video uploads, and livestreams of Arcane Abyss are welcome. Monetization is also permitted, and you do not need to contact us in advance.

games.name: Japanese Ramen Simulator
games.shortDescription: Japanese Ramen Simulator is a ramen shop management sim for up to six players. Prepare ingredients, cook noodles, and arrange toppings to craft the perfect bowl. Create original dishes, design your kitchen and dining area, and build your ramen restaurant with friends or on your own!
games.aboutText:
About Japanese Ramen Simulator

Japanese Ramen Simulator is a ramen shop management simulator for up to six players.

Experience every part of running a ramen shop, from preparing ingredients and cooking to serving food, looking after customers, and cleaning up. Create a menu you can be proud of, design a shop to your taste, and run it your way.

Switch between a first-person view that lets you immerse yourself in cooking and a third-person view that lets you see your character and surroundings. If you're prone to motion sickness when playing in first person, you can choose a view based on your preferences and comfort.

Prepare, Cook, and Serve

Prepare the soup, cook the noodles, and arrange the toppings to make each bowl just as your customers ordered.

Show your skills through the texture of the noodles, the temperature of the soup, the aroma and Umami of your ingredients, and the time it takes to serve each order. Different soup ingredients and physics-based plating give every bowl its own finish.

Recreate your favorite ramen or try making a bowl unlike anything anyone has seen before. Let your imagination guide you as you create your signature dish.

More Than Ramen

Offer gyoza, rice bowls, beer, and other menu items to enjoy alongside your ramen.

Watch the browning on your gyoza and pour beer with just the right balance of liquid and foam. Serve the ingredients you prepared for ramen over rice to make dishes such as Char Siu Don.

Expect the Unexpected

A demanding ramen critic may visit your shop. Fine-tune the aroma, Umami, and toppings to serve a bowl that earns their approval.

During business hours, thieves may target the money in your cash register, and fires can break out without warning. Use shuriken, fire extinguishers, and other items to get your shop out of trouble.

Or perhaps you could try your luck at the gambling hall and win a fortune...

Arrange Your Space and Create a Shop of Your Own

Place cooking equipment, furniture, storage, and decorations to arrange your kitchen and dining area just the way you like. Build an efficient shop that handles orders smoothly or a distinctive restaurant worth taking pictures of.

Use My Designs to apply your own drawings to posters, noren curtains, ramen bowls, and more. Visit a friend's shop and leave your autograph. You'll also find unusual interactive fixtures and equipment, including toilets and gas cylinders.

Customize your outfit, body shape, and emotes, as well as your noodle-draining animations. Apply your own designs to clothing and create matching uniforms with your friends.

Unlock new ingredients and equipment as your Shop Level rises. Use the money you earn to expand your shop, add to your menu, and improve your dining area.

Online Multiplayer for Up to Six Players

Divide ingredient preparation, cooking, serving, customer service, and cleaning among your friends, and work together to handle the orders as they pour in.

In-game spatial voice chat is supported. Distance and walls affect how voices sound, making it feel as though you're working together in the same shop.

You can also hire part-time NPC staff and take your time running the shop solo.

Your Perfect Bowl, Served in Your Perfect Shop

Pursue the ultimate flavor. Perfect your efficiency. Build a bustling restaurant with friends.

Create a one-of-a-kind ramen shop filled with your own ideas and passion.

games.name: That Cozy Cat Game
games.shortDescription: A relaxing online co-op game where you and your friends explore a colorful island as customizable CATS. Go fishing, chat, find new discoveries, earn kibbles, and dress up your cat.
games.aboutText:
Be a cat. Catch fish. Make yourself at home.

That Cozy Cat Game is a relaxing online co-op game where you and your friends explore a colorful island as customizable cats. Go fishing, chat, find new discoveries, earn kibbles, and dress up your cat. Enjoy the world at your own pace.

Catch and Collect Fish

Cast your line into ponds and rivers to discover fish of different rarities. Fill out your collection, keep track of everything you have caught, and sell your fish to earn kibbles.

Create Your Cat

Choose your fur pattern and colors, collect hats, glasses, backpacks, and other accessories to create a cat that feels like your own.

Relax With Friends

Play alone or create an online server for your friends or anyone to join. Explore together, fish side by side, show off your outfits, use emotes, or place a boombox and listen to music nearby.

Explore a Cozy Island

Wander through bright beaches and peaceful outdoor areas, meet local characters, visit shops, and discover new activities around the island.

That Cozy Cat Game is being developed as a laid-back experience with no pressure to rush. Whether you want to complete your fish collection or just spend time being a cat with friends, the island is yours to enjoy.

games.name: The Ash Remembers
games.shortDescription: The ash forgets nothing. A dark idle RPG that keeps running offline: 21 skills to level 100, 110 foes, 11 world bosses, 11 titans, over 1,000 items — and a game that tells you what you are dying of. Buy once, play everything: no energy bars.
games.aboutText:
The ash forgets nothing.

Since the oldest chronicles, ash has fallen over Veyr — on roofs, on roads, on the names of the dead. The embers beneath keep glowing, patient and awake. You come through the gates of Emberwake a stranger they call Wanderer, and you do not remember why.

The Ash Remembers is an idle dark fantasy RPG that keeps running while you do something else — offline, in the background, overnight. Nothing is handed to you. Buy once, play everything: no energy bars, no waiting time you could pay away. New in 1.7.1: The Ash Demands

Every run now brings demands of the Ash that you can meet yourself. Each one is written into the Ash Book, which keeps its 120 entries across every Ashfall, and at six crossroads you choose one gift of two. Plus grade gifts, four new gemstones (opal, emerald, garnet, onyx) and new achievements. New in 1.7.0: The Ember Grades

From your third Ashfall on, you set how hard your endgame bosses hit, and the ladder goes on until you fail. Anvil-master Hral forges your relics on and on, the Stillstring awakens as the 20th relic, and beyond Kholmoss three new Titans of Ash wait, each with their own film and narrated story. New: The Ash Wound

After the first Ashfall, the ground gives way. Below lies what stayed buried for four hundred and twelve years: a sunken city, woven through by roots that breathe. And whatever waits down there knows the way up.

- 25 new foes in five layers — from the Rootground down to the Beneath. Each layer tears open only with your next Ashfall, and each foe rises only once you have beaten the one before it often enough.

- Hours of the Wound : every full hour the depth changes its mood. Sometimes it holds fast and hits harder, sometimes it gives — stronger foes, double loot.

- 25 uniques, 5 depth relics and 8 blueprints — among them the Beneath Blade and Ash Cages, built from what the foes of the Wound leave behind.

- The Chronicle of the Ash Wound : 11 voiced chapters that write themselves onward with every leader you defeat — plus 14 new achievements.

New in 1.3.0: the shaft, the ground and the chamber

- The Shaft of Names — the sixth dungeon, down in the Wound. It opens with your first Ashfall, in all three depths: normal, heroic, mystic. Five bosses, from the Deep Warden to Ohm'Kessa, the Last Voice, plus an armour set of its own and the Amulet of the Unspoken as its rarest drop.

- Ehl'Vurun, the First Ground — the eleventh world boss and the strongest enemy in the game. He lies at the very bottom of the Ash Wound and does not stir until Vhar'Esh has fallen.

- A fifth attack for each of the six heroes , one that leaves a wound and keeps burning. You unlock it with the Seal of the Last Voice: it drops only from Ohm'Kessa and belongs to the hero you break it with — permanently, across every Ashfall.

- The laboratory, The Silent Chamber : Mara wants to look at the creatures before you kill them. 45 creatures can be caught alive — beasts, vermin, aberrations, undead, works and colossi. In the chamber you first gather their loot, then Mara draws the anatomy and dissects: 45 drawn anatomy plates and 45 dissection plates. Research one to the end and you strike its kind harder, take less from it and find more on it, for good.

Six heroes, each with light and shadow

Kaelen, Dorn, Veyl, Sera, Nyx and Liraël — each brings their own strength and pays for it with their own weakness. Seven garments per hero: six earned by level, the seventh only after your third Ashfall. Earned, never bought. 21 skills, each to level 100

Mining, Woodcutting, Fishing, Smithing, Cooking, Firemaking, Fletching, Cultivating, Crafting, Thieving, Hunting, Alchemy, Gem Cutting, Cremating, Emberhunt, Runecarving — plus Melee, Ranged, Summoning, Hitpoints and Defence. Master a skill to 100 and you carry its title on your badge. A world that hits back

- 110 enemies , each with its own loot table and its own weakness. Kill one often enough and its entire loot lies open — weakness included.

- 7 dungeons, 35 bosses across three tiers — normal, heroic, mystic. Every boss with its own story and its own best time; the Mystic Depth opens after your first Ashfall.

- 11 world bosses that grow harder with every rebirth. Ur'Vahel, the First Calling, breaks his seal only once the six world bosses before him and the first eight titans have fallen.

- 11 titans across eight tiers : four rotate week by week, and beyond Kholmoss the three Titans of Ash awaken with later Ashfalls. If that is not enough, the Ember Grades let you turn up the heat yourself.

- Over 1,000 items with affixes, sockets and tempering — from the Rat Mother's Crown to the Unmade Core Shard.

- 67 uniques : one one-of-a-kind piece per enemy, each with its own story — extremely rare, yet guaranteed after 2,000 hunts of the same foe. And 129 named pieces carry the Mark — 29 legendary, 93 mythic and 7 of apex tier — each with a fixed power drawn from its own lore.

- The boss forge : from the material a fallen titan or

games.name: Sky Homestead
games.shortDescription: Sky Homestead is a cozy farming and automation game set on floating islands. Rebuild a shattered sky-kingdom: raise crops, chain machines into production lines, hire a crew who work while you explore, and sail cargo balloons between the isles you bring back to life.
games.aboutText:
Sky Homestead is a cozy farming and automation game set on a chain of floating islands.

Three hundred years ago the Skychain shattered. The bridges fell, the beacons went dark, and the islands drifted apart. Someone has left you a letter, a rickety cottage on the last lit isle, and a very old to-do list.

Farm the floating fields

Till, plant, water, harvest. Fifteen crops, from honest pumpkins to crystalbuds that only grow where the Hum runs strong — the current of crystal energy that once held the Skychain together.

Automate the cozy way

Chop the wood yourself, or build a line that does it while you're somewhere else. Over 35 machines — furnaces, crafters, smelteries, mills — chain into production lines, fed by haulers and powered by the Hum. Start with one furnace. End with an island that runs itself.

A crew with names

Pip the Lumberjack. Tansy the Farmer. Hire helpers who arrive with their own tools, pay them in gold and hot meals, and watch them walk home to their cottages at dusk. They keep working whether you're watching or not.

Rebuild the Skychain

Multiple hand-built islands, each holding ruins that remember what they were. Fund the Restoration Board, watch bridges rebuild themselves plank by plank, and meet the villagers who come home when the lights come back on. Over 100 objectives across roughly 30 hours.

Sail the sky

Chart routes for cargo balloons hauling bulk freight between islands, and send nimble drones point-to-point. A frozen crest, a witchwood, a volcanic forge-isle — each with its own economy to wake up.

Delve when you dare

Beneath the oldest island lies the Deep Barrow: procedurally generated, unlit, and full of things that were left down there for a reason. Bring a sword, bring a lantern, come home with soul crystals. Or don't go at all — the farm doesn't mind.

A note from the one-person crew

Sky Homestead is made by a single developer. Everything you see here — screenshots, trailer, all of it — is the game as it stands today, and it will keep getting better right up to launch and beyond. If these little islands speak to you, a wishlist genuinely moves the needle for a solo project.

games.name: Codru
games.shortDescription: A realistic first-person survival game about real bushcraft. Spin fire from a hand drill, fell and split trees, whittle sticks to make your own arrows, hunt with a bow and build your camp while hunger, cold and storms wear you down. The woods provide. Then they come to collect.
games.aboutText:
codru (Romanian, n.) — a deep, old forest.

You arrive from mainland with only what you could afford. Everything else, the forest offers you: fire from a spinning stick, shelter from the trees you fell, food from what you hunt. CODRU is a realistic first-person survival game about real bushcraft — slow, demanding and quietly beautiful.

The woods provide. Explore

Before the forest, the shop. The money is short and the list is long: an axe, a knife, a backpack, a lighter… Every item you can't afford is one you'll have to make yourself.

Didn't bring a lighter? Spin a hand drill until the wood smokes, catch the ember in a nest of dry grass and breathe it into a flame. Then keep it alive — a heavy rain will drown it.

Every swing bites where you aim it. Chips fly, the notch grows, and the trunk comes down for real. Split it into logs and firewood — the forest is your lumberyard.

Whittle a branch down, shaving by shaving. The knife cuts exactly where you carve. You need arrows after all, right?

Lash a tripod over the fire, stretch a tarp to catch the rain, or stack log after log into walls. Freestyle building lets you place every piece by hand. If freestyle is overwhelming, blueprints are also available. Or simply combine both

Draw your bow on a rabbit, wolf or other forrest critter. Skin the catch with your knife and cook it in a pot over a fire you made yourself. Just remember you're not the only hunter out here.

Hunger, thirst, fatigue and cold wear you down, day after day. Storms roll in fast — lightning tears the sky open, and the rain goes for your fire first. In addition there is also a fear mechanic (no spoilers).

Find your way with a real compass (if you brought one), and keep what you learn in a handwritten notebook — recipes, objectives, and everything the forest teaches you.

- Real bushcraft — friction fire, whittling, rope and hand-crafted tools

- Tree felling with real physics — chop, fell and split

- Bow hunting — track, shoot, skin and cook

- Freestyle and blueprint building — from a fire tripod to log cabin. With freestyle mode, sky's the limit on what can be built

- Survival needs — hunger, thirst, fatigue, fear and body warmth

- Dynamic weather — rain, storms and lightning; rain puts out your fire

- Day and night cycle — the forest changes after dark

- A big open forest to explore on foot

- Gear up before you go — buy your starting kit on a tight budget

Some nights the forest goes quiet. Not the good kind of quiet.

games.name: Lumsprout Isle
games.shortDescription: Lumsprout Isle is a 2D top-down pixel farming game. The world is veiled in a pale grey mist and the sea routes are sealed. Take up your hoe, fishing rod, and weapons, sail through the mining lands, the snowy isle, and the lava isle, and bring the sleeping world back to life.
games.aboutText:
Lumsprout Isle is a 2D top-down pixel farming game.

The world is a sea chart: Lumsprout Isle lies at the center, ringed by the Mining Isle, Frost Isle, Lava Isle, Magic Isle, and the Slime Nest. What separates the islands isn't distance—it's the sea mist.

Core Loop

Till the soil, sow the seeds, and water the crops, then sail out to the Mining Isle to strike the ore. Return at dusk: toss the ore into the furnace, lay your gear on the anvil. Sell a basket of harvest, set the coins aside, and buy the next island.

Features

Farming— Grow 29 crops, from corn, tomatoes, and carrots to starfruit and dragon fruit. Till → sow → water → ripen, with its own action feedback at every step. Harvests carry quality ratings, and once in a while a rainbow variant will grow.

Fishing— 40 species across five rarities, from tiny minnows to the ocean sunfish. After casting, it takes 5–15 seconds for a bite.

Combat— Enemies include slimes, orcs, demons, blood monsters, bats, and yetis, along with the Slime King in the depths of the nest. Swords for melee, staves for range.

Characters & Trade— The Guide, Witch, Fisherman, and Blacksmith each keep an island. Shops buy your crops, fish, and ore, and sell seeds, tools, and materials.

Collection — Fish and crops are sorted by rarity in the compendium. Rainbow versions earn a star on the original entry.

games.name: The Pineapple Conspiracy
games.shortDescription: An impostor survival reality show for 4 to 10 players. Craft a raft in twenty minutes while impostors work against you in secret. Survive, betray, and find the Golden pineapple!
games.aboutText:
The new season of The Pineapple Conspiracy reality show !

Survivors, impostors, a volcanic island, twenty minutes of live television.

The only way out: a raft they must build together.

But who is helping? And who isn’t?

Some survivors are working against you.

Take the mic and accuse at the confessional.

Don’t forget to vote. Impostors will not.

A deserted island. A small camp. A very active volcano.

Craft, build, explore, and try not to die along the way.

Oh, and you need to leave before everything goes boom.

Be careful of the falling volcanic rocks

Dont get lost in the caves

Fight off the jungle's wildlife

Death in not the end: reincarnate as a gorilla or a chicken and have fun

A procedurally generated island every match.

Up to 10 players online with proximity chat.

Unlockable cosmetics to stand out on camera.

games.name: Tidy Wizard: A Place For Every Plate
games.shortDescription: A relaxing organizing simulator set in a massive wizarding dining hall. Collect over 2,000 hand-crafted plates, wash them in an enchanted water sphere, and sort them onto shelves by family crest, color, and material. Unlock new spells to help organize the chaos at your pace!
games.aboutText:
In the grand dining hall of a high wizards' castle, an uncontrolled spell has scattered more than 2,000 prized plates belonging to highly regarded wizard families, coating them in a chaotic magical jelly. The glamorous life of advanced spellcasting will have to wait. Today, as an apprentice wizard, you are on cleanup duty!

FROM MAGICAL CHAOS TO WIZARDING ORDER

Turn the mess into a gleaming masterpiece through a deeply satisfying workflow:

- Gather: Search the floor and use magic to gently levitate the scattered, jelly-covered plates directly to your hands.

- Wash: Toss the dirty plates into a massive, levitating magical sphere of water that scrubs away the arcane goo.

- Shelve: Observe Search the hall to find the correct dressers. Match the plates based on their material, color, and mystical family symbol, then place them in perfect sequence on their designated shelves.

UNLOCK ARCANE EFFICIENCY

Every complete shelf earns points to unlock new utility spells. These magical upgrades turn your cleanup into an effortlessly satisfying flow:

- Increased Capacity: Upgrade your magic to lift and carry towering stacks of plates at a single time.

- Plate Attraction: Magically draw matching sets from across the room directly into your hands.

- Auto-Sorting: Watch the plates automatically organize themselves in your hands as you carry them.

- Auto-Placement: Effortlessly send plates flying across the room to place themselves onto the correct shelf automatically.

- And more!

KEY FEATURES

- Relaxing First-Person Organizing: Experience the pure satisfaction of turning chaos into perfect order at your own pace.

- A Massive Sorting Puzzle: Discover, wash, and meticulously organize an expansive collection of plates belonging to the realm's most prestigious wizarding families.

- Rich Visual Variety: Sort through beautiful, hand-drawn sets forged from prestigious materials and marked by mystical family crests, offering an engaging organizational challenge.

- Evolving Magic: Unlock helpful new spells as you progress to make every action feel seamless and rewarding.

games.name: Horror Mahjong
games.shortDescription: Expect the unexpected! Play mahjong and stay alive in a haunted tea house. Pretend you can't see them—good thing you're well armed. Stock up, shoot, throw tiles, revive friends, and win your hand to get up and cover them. Survive until dawn and escape together, or keep watch with paper tablemates.
games.aboutText:
May the Mahjong God watch over us tonight.

A mahjong table waits for you in the middle of the room. Cold drafts creep in from all four sides. You start to play, then hear something behind you. Are you sure you want to look...?

Play your hand. Stay alive.

Draw, discard, pong, kong, win—take the win when you can. Shoot, slash, chop, thrust, blast—kill every ghost you can. You watch the tiles. I'll watch your back.

Play around the table with friends and cover each other. When the monsters come, grab a gun, swing a peachwood sword, or throw a mahjong tile if you have to. Stock up, revive fallen teammates, and make it through the night. You can also play with computer tablemates.

Dress up for the next round

Create your own character: pick a hairstyle, put together an outfit, and choose your colors. At least you'll look good in the screenshots when you go down.

Kongoto presents.

games.name: Sort Inc.
games.shortDescription: Help Nina sort customers' items into boxes! A cozy and tactile sorting game where you play as Nina, the neighborhood’s dedicated sorter. Meet charming customers, play item-themed minigames, organize their messy piles into the correct boxes, get paid, and build a beloved sorting business.
games.aboutText:
Sort Inc. is a cozy and tactile sorting game where you play as Nina, the neighborhood’s dedicated sorter. Customers arrive at your shop with boxes full of mixed-up belongings, and it is your job to bring order to the chaos.

Pour each pile onto the table, pick up the items one by one, and place them into their correct boxes. Complete the request, get paid, and prepare for the next customer. Sort Every Last Item

Each request begins with a messy pile containing items from a customer’s daily life, hobby, or profession. Buttons, tools, art supplies, yarn, toys, mail, seeds, and many more objects can all end up mixed together.

Study the items carefully, decide where each one belongs, and sort the entire pile into the correct boxes.

The rules are simple, but the requests become increasingly challenging as you progress:

- Play fun minigames before sorting each customer’s items

- Sort larger piles with more items

- Manage more boxes at the same time

- Identify similar-looking objects that require closer attention

- Discover new item collections based on each customer’s profession

- Complete bigger and more demanding requests from returning customers

Meet the Neighborhood

Get to know a colorful cast of recurring customers, each with their own personality, profession, and collection of belongings.

Help Mia organize her tailoring supplies, clean up Hank’s overflowing toolbox, separate Lola’s art materials, sort Iris’s mountain of mail, and handle increasingly chaotic requests from the rest of the neighborhood.

Customers return as their lives and businesses develop, bringing more items and more difficult piles with every visit.

Bring order to every pile, get to know the neighborhood, and help Nina build a beloved sorting business.

Add Sort Inc. to your wishlist and get ready to sort!

games.name: Dustlings: The Hidden Wilds
games.shortDescription: You stumble into a mysterious, uninhabited wilderness—but you're not alone. The little beings that glow at night will be your closest companions. Bond with extraordinary plants and animals, build a home together, explore the wilds, and follow scattered diary pages to uncover the truth.
games.aboutText:
Sent by your mother to check on your grandmother, you find yourself lost in a mysterious and forgotten land. Everything here seems familiar, yet something feels deeply wrong. With only a handful of supplies, you must struggle to survive in this abandoned wilderness. Where did your grandmother disappear to? What secrets lie within her diary? And can you uncover the truth and find your way back home?

A few things to know before venturing into the wilds:

- Farming is a vital path to securing a steady food supply. While exploring the wilderness, you'll stumble across wild fruits and vegetables—though their flavor, yield, and quality are often quite mediocre. Bring their seeds back to carefully cultivate across generations, and you might just harvest far superior produce!

- A balanced diet is essential to staying healthy. Never eat raw meat or drink unpurified water, as disease can strike easily. That makes mastering culinary skills just as crucial. Cooking here is completely freeform: mix and match any ingredients at your disposal. The better their flavor and quality, the more potent and beneficial the dishes you create.

- No one survives alone—having companions by your side makes the wilderness far less grueling. Here, every living creature has the potential to become your companion. Keep an extra sharp eye out for the animals and plants that glow in the dark, and try approaching them—you never know what wonderful connections might spark!

- Explore diverse biomes, each teeming with distinct ecosystems. As you venture forth, you may also encounter unique plant and animal NPCs. Strike up an interaction with them, and you might walk away with unexpected rewards!

In the wild, beast attacks are an everyday reality. Your companions will step up to protect you and fight on your behalf. Your role is to orchestrate tactical positioning and allocate the right items to minimize the damage your companions take in combat.

- In battle, different companions can form 【Synergies】 , while companions of the same kind form a 【Species】 —both granting distinct buffs.

- In combat, setting an ambush to strike first gives you a massive tactical edge, allowing your formation to encircle the enemy. However, if you are the one ambushed, you'll find yourself in a much tighter spot.

- The trees, flora, and rocks around the battlefield can all be turned to your advantage.

- Many more battle strategies and tactics await your discovery.

- You've surely picked up plenty of survival skills by now, but grandma still knows best. Her diary holds a wealth of practical survival wisdom, though several pages have been lost to time. Recovering these lost pages during your expeditions will give your survival a massive boost.

- To do great work, you need the right tools. Crafting practical tools will dramatically boost your efficiency compared to bare-handed labor. In your downtime, remember to build storage containers to organize your hard-earned resources, and place decorations to spruce up your homestead. After all, life is meant to be lived in full color.

games.name: Infinite Loop: Incremental
games.shortDescription: A purely minimalist, text-based idle incremental game! Focused on time management and strategic planning, carefully prioritize your action queue under strict time limits. Death is inevitable, but every loop makes you stronger. Build your automation routines and break the infinite loop!
games.aboutText:
Infinite Loop: Incremental is a text-based idle RPG. You play as a traveler stranded in a strange world, trapped in an endless cycle of rebirth. Through each reincarnation, you will travel across time, alter fate, and write your own story, until you finally break free from the loop and find your way home.

Choice and Automation

On your journey, you will face countless choices: gather, craft, fight, explore. Plan the order of your actions in advance, and the game will carry them out according to your strategy. Every action can be automated after you complete it once in full. Arrange your automation priorities, and let your strategy run itself. But strategy is only the beginning. Death cannot be escaped.

Meta Progression

Each death rewards you with Time Marks based on what you accomplished in that life. Spend them freely on the upgrades you want, making every rebirth stronger than the last, allowing you to overcome the obstacles that once stopped you. And Time Marks have other uses beyond raw strength.

Unlock New Content

After each rebirth, you can use Time Marks to unlock new actions, gaining access to more resources, experiencing different stories, and pushing further than ever before. Some unlocks will reshape the world, introduce people and discoveries you have never encountered, alter the course of the story, and even rewrite history and destiny itself.

Adventure in the Otherworld

You arrive in a strange and dangerous world. You have come into possession of an artifact imbued with the power of time and space. Before you can even understand what is happening, hunger and monster attacks strike one after another.

As your journey unfolds, you will meet the people of this land, face its disasters together, and uncover the truth of this world, step by step.

Every rebirth erases your memories of what came before. But in every rebirth, you never lose sight of why you began.

Early Access

The current Early Access build contains Chapters 1 to 3, where players can experience the story of the Western Continent. The full version is planned to further expand the gameplay with more chapters and content. More content will be released gradually throughout Early Access.

Wishlist now!

games.name: Mana Alchemy
games.shortDescription: An open-world bullet heaven RPG. Explore a cursed island, forge spells via alchemy, and arrange them in your grimoire like a puzzle. Mow down monster hordes and hunt your 7 ruling sisters. Your final choice—execute or forgive them—determines the ending of this dark fantasy.
games.aboutText:
◆ A Tale of Revenge and Choices

Eight daughters were born to the Great Witch Dawed.

Among them, only one girl possessed no magical talent.

On the night of her fifth birthday, Dawed abandoned the useless girl, casting her away into the darkness to die.

However, thanks to the power of a mysterious talking grimoire named "Harley," the girl barely survived.

This is a journey of rebellion taken by a girl who was stripped of everything.

Will her final choice be "Revenge," or "Forgiveness"――?

◆ An Open-World Bullet Heaven RPG

The island of "Shudal" is ruled by the Great Witch.

Overrun by endless hordes of monsters, combat on this island is inevitable.

Cast spells set in your Grimoire to mow down countless enemies.

Merlin must battle and explore her way across this vast island.

◆Spell Builds x Magic Alchemy

Equipping spells in your grimoire determines your attack patterns.

You can craft entirely new spells through alchemy by combining gathered materials and magic you've already acquired.

◆ Key Features

- Explore a vast, seamless world! Traverse the interconnected island of Shudal without loading screens. Carve your own path from lush plains to rushing waters.

- Exhilarating bullet heaven action. Just move—your spells cast automatically. No complex inputs required. Obliterate swarming monster hordes with your very own spell barrage!

- Craft and puzzle your spells! Use gathered materials to perform "Alchemy" and forge new spells. Slot them into your grimoire, Harley, like a puzzle to discover the ultimate build.

- The ultimate choice of life and death. Stand against your 7 ruling sisters. After defeating them, will you execute or forgive them? Your decision drastically alters the fate of this dark fantasy.

- A powerless girl's brutal rebellion. Play as Merlin, a talentless girl stripped of everything and cast into darkness. Experience a heavy tale of revenge as you rise against the almighty witches.

- Accessible for casuals, deep in strategy. Enjoy the effortless thrill of wiping out screens of enemies, while mastering a spell combination system with infinite tactical depth.

games.name: Mapping Creator
games.shortDescription: Draw maps, make nations fight and create historical or fantasy timelapses with Mapping Creator: a tool to unleash creativity!
games.aboutText:
Mapping Creator: Draw history the way YOU always wanted!

In Mapping Creator, you are unconstrained by the complex mechanics of other grand strategy games. The world is truly yours to paint, the wars are yours to recreate in detail, and history is what you make of it.

Paint the map the way you want!

Use a wide variety of tools to customise the colours, shapes, names and flags of countries, and make their borders pixel perfect with a brush.

Recreate conflicts in detail!

Click, rotate and drag units on the map to make them advance, form a front line and fight other nations. The location, size and outcome of each engagement is up to you!

Assemble it all for a glorious final timelapse!

Automatically record your gameplay to compile it into a video with no need for additional software.

If you’ve always wanted to decide history down to the smallest details, show how your dream conflict idea would go, and display the final product quickly and easily, this is the game for you!

games.name: Trovador
games.shortDescription: A musician from the future is stranded in the Spanish Golden Age.
