Live the stories of the people you meet and turn each into a romance — an old Spanish ballad — piecing together its verse, composing its music through rhythm play, then performing it as a living tale. A narrative rhythm game.
games.aboutText:
Some songs outlive the empires that sang them.

Trovador is a narrative rhythm game about Tomás, a musician from the future thrown, by accident, into the year 1600 — the height of the Spanish Golden Age — with no way home. Stranded five centuries from everything he knows, he survives the only way he can: by listening. And the lives he falls into — their loves and betrayals, their wars and wonders — become romances , the sung ballads that once carried a people's stories from town to town.

Discover

Move through a living Golden Age Spain — its streets and taverns, its plazas and war camps — and fall in with the people you meet. Follow a doomed love, a soldier's boast, a crime, a skirmish on the frontier, a rumor of the marvelous, and draw from it the events and the verses of a new romance.

Recreate

At the heart of the game, you build each ballad's music by hand. Pluck four strings in time and choose the colors and instruments of your accompaniment, composing one layer at a time until the romance comes alive.

Perform

Then you stage it. The finished romance unfolds like a storybook in motion, its tale advancing with every beat — and you pass it on, adding your version to a tradition that has always survived by being retold.

Chapter by chapter, Tomás's own long road home threads through the stories he turns into song. Two musical worlds meet along the way: the romances you compose and the traditional songs still sung by the people around you. Trovador treats the romancero with genuine respect — grounded in real folk scholarship — while making it something you can pick up, play, and feel.

From the heart of the city to the roads and camps beyond it, Trovador is a love letter to a living tradition, and an invitation to carry it forward.

Features

- A story told in chapters — each one lived, composed, and performed

- A living Golden Age Spanish world to explore, from city streets to war camps

- An original four-string rhythm-composition system

- Music that blends a futuristic instrument with 500-year-old ballads

- Romances rooted in the real Castilian tradition — love and betrayal, frontier and legend, tragedy and wonder

- A hand-illustrated world

games.name: BORE
games.shortDescription: A survival horror game for 1–4 players. Operate a giant drilling machine. Explore caves, collect valuables, and escape the creatures below. Return to the surface to sell what you found and buy upgrades and equipment. Play solo or in online co-op.
games.aboutText:
BORE is a survival horror game for 1–4 players. Play alone or work together online to operate a giant drilling machine. Explore four underground regions: Overgrown Caves, Crystal Caves, Lava Caves, and Deep Dark Caves. Collect minerals, relics, and other valuables. Your employer sets a required payment. Collect and sell enough valuables to pay it.

Work together at the machine's controls. Steer the drill, control its speed, watch its temperature, and load coolant cartridges. Use the cabin's map and instruments to guide teammates exploring the caves. The Core Recovery station lets you collect extra valuables from material cut by the drill. Automatic speed control helps you operate the machine when playing alone.

Stop drilling, open the door, and search the caves for valuables. Mine deposits with a pickaxe or explosives, and carry what you find back to the drill. Creatures can notice your footsteps, mining, and voice. Use lights and distractions to avoid some threats. Defend yourself against others with tools or stun devices. Different creatures need different tactics, and some cannot be killed.

The longer you stay underground, the more dangerous the caves become. Return before the cave collapses, bring your valuables inside the drilling machine, and close the door to keep pursuing creatures out. Decide whether to return to the surface and sell, or drill deeper to search for more valuable treasure. Equipment and valuables inside the machine stay aboard as you travel.

Sell your valuables at the surface depot. Use the money to make the required payment and buy supplies. Choose from 33 equipment and upgrade options at the shop. Buy lights, mining tools, radios, and implants that improve your abilities. Better drill bits unlock deeper regions. You can also bring back dead creatures to sell. Between trips, restock your supplies and feed or pet the depot cat.

- Online co-op for up to four players, with voice chat that depends on distance. Use walkie-talkies or the cabin speaker to reach players farther away.

- Operate physical levers, controls, and instruments inside the drilling machine. Manage drill speed, heat, and coolant while your crew works.

- Changing cave layouts across four regions. Try the Daily Dig and compete on leaderboards based on the value you sell, with separate groups for each crew size.

- 28 creature types with different behaviors. Some hunt by sound, some react to light, and some copy your crewmates' appearance or voices.

- 46 types of valuables to collect and sell, including eight from Core Recovery. Selling a new type adds information to your collection record. The required payment increases as you progress.

- Revive dying crewmates before time runs out. Recover dead crewmates' bodies and bring them back to the depot. If you die, you can watch the surviving players.

- Carry heavy valuables together, throw tools and objects, and drag bodies. Items and characters react to impacts, falls, and collisions.

- An interactive tutorial, training videos, controller support, customizable keyboard controls, sound captions, colorblind-friendly map markers, and a setting for players with a fear of swarming creatures.

games.name: ESCAPE FROM TOUHOU
games.shortDescription: A single-player top-down extraction shooter where you command Reimu, Marisa, and Nitori-crash-landed in a war-torn desert-by switching between them in real time. Secure supplies to survive, and with the allied forces' help, restore the dimensional transporter and return to Gensokyo.
games.aboutText:
The girls of Gensokyo fall into the heart of a battlefield

When Nitori's dimensional transporter goes haywire, Reimu, Marisa, and Nitori crash-land in the red desert of an unfamiliar world. Cut off from Gensokyo, they lose most of their familiar magic and their ability to fly, and all around them are armed factions and abandoned military supplies.

There is only one way to survive. Aid the operations of the local allied forces and recover the supplies and dimensional components scattered across the battlefield to complete Nitori's dimensional transporter.

A three-member squad, commanded solo

Reimu, Marisa, and Nitori always deploy as a single squad. Switch between the three characters instantly during combat, and let the AI handle covering fire and fighting for whoever you aren't directly controlling.

Rescue teammates in danger and switch to the right character at the right moment to bring out the strength of all three-on your own.

It's only real loot if you carry it out

Explore a desert battlefield that is freshly generated every deployment, and dig up weapons, ammo, medical supplies, food, and crafting materials from buildings, supply crates, and fallen enemies. But stuffing your bag isn't the end of it. Only by reaching the extraction point alive does the loot truly become yours.

Deeper, more dangerous zones hold more valuable supplies. Weigh your wounded squad, your dwindling ammo, and your full bag, and decide: pull out now, or search just one more spot?

In the desert, thirst is an enemy too

On the scorching battlefield, hunger and thirst press on your squad as well. Carry water and food to manage your survival status, and judge how to divide ammo, medical supplies, and loot across your limited bag. There are moments when a single bottle of water to drink right now matters more than a precious component.

Firearms and overwhelming fire support

Equip modern firearms such as rifles, machine guns, and sniper rifles, and combine them with each character's unique magic. Secure signal flares and target markers to call in close air support from the allied forces. One precise call can turn a losing engagement around-but explosions don't tell friend from foe.

Everything you pick up has a use

Once you make it back safely, store or sell your loot and prepare gear and consumables for the next deployment. Even ordinary junk like scrap metal and wiring is reborn at the crafting bench as ammo, medical supplies, special equipment, and fire-support flares.

Deploy and extract again and again to arm a squad that started with nothing, and build the strength to take on more dangerous zones.

Complete the transporter and return to Gensokyo

Use the rare dimensional components recovered from the battlefield to restore the dimensional core at your base. As the core nears completion, Reimu and her companions reclaim lost powers and gain new abilities, opening up more dangerous operation zones and the next chapter of the story.

Finish all your preparations, break through the final operation, and send the three of them safely back to Gensokyo.

Key Features

- A single-player three-member squad of Reimu, Marisa, and Nitori

- Top-down combat combining real-time character switching with AI teammates

- A mix of firearms, character-unique magic, throwables, and close air support

- Search, engagement, and extraction across a battlefield that changes every deployment

- The risk of losing your loot on death, and the choice to reach for greater rewards

- Survival elements that juggle hunger and thirst alongside ammo and injuries

- Crafting, storage, and gear progression that make use of looted materials

- Ability unlocks, story, and endings that advance as you restore the transporter

[hr][/hr] 月影工房 Work No. 6

This game is a fan-made derivative work of Touhou Project by Team Shanghai Alice. It is not an official Touhou Project product.

games.name: Pfand Raiders
games.shortDescription: Dash and ride through a rock festival in this absurd, music-driven co-op runner! Dodge obstacles to the beat, loot empty cans ("Pfand"), cash them in for beer and burp everything out of your way. Will you make it to The Butcher Sisters' show in time?
games.aboutText:
Picture this: You wake up in your camping chair. Sunburned, hungover, with no beer left. Your buddy yells: Bro, TBS is on stage! FOMO kicks in. So does the thirst.

The festival accepts empty cans (so-called "Pfand") as currency. The campground has plenty of it lying around. And it doesn't belong to ANYONE (right?)

RAID IT!

TRADE IT!

CHUG IT!

RELEASE IT!

FEATURES

- Absurd co-op campaign starring Stroppo and Amazing Alex

- Each level is built on a song by The Butcher Sisters

- Online and local co-op for two players

- Solo mode: Control Alex and his dog Raya simultaneously

- Level editor: Turn any song into a level

- Endless mode with playlists and leaderboards

- Minigames like Beer Pong and Rage Cage

Leave no can Pfand behind.

games.name: Fish Them All!
games.shortDescription: Aim for 100 million fish! Catch fish, earn money, and unlock skills as your hauls grow and your fishing speeds up. Recruit divers, drones, and UFOs in this short pixel-art incremental fishing game, and reel in the very last fish in 4–5 hours.
games.aboutText:
100 million fish in the sea. Catch them all.

Catch fish, earn money, learn skills, and catch even more. Fish Them All! is an incremental fishing game where your hauls get bigger and your fishing gets faster with every upgrade.

Your goal: 100 million fish in total . It sounds impossible at first, but every catch and every upgrade brings it steadily within reach.

Catch fish → Spend your earnings on skills → Catch even more!

Move your boat left and right, drop your hook where you want, and reel in groups of fish swimming below. Head out again and again on fishing runs lasting about 60 seconds each.

Upgrade your movement speed, the number of fish you can reel in at once, and the size of your hook to bring home a bigger haul next time. Every new skill makes you want the next one. Keep upgrading and take your fishing to a whole new scale.

Divers, drones, and even UFOs.

Learn skills to unlock helpers that gather fish for you. Divers, drones, and UFOs join in to help with your catch.

Chain combos and clear whole schools of fish with explosions. With your helpers at your side, keep reeling in the fish that fill the sea.

4–5 hours, all the way to the last fish.

Teleporting sea urchins, squid with sudden bursts of speed, and enormous sharks. A pixel-art sea full of unusual fish awaits. Collect treasures from the seabed as you work toward the very last fish.

Expect around 4–5 hours of play. Enjoy the satisfaction of stacking upgrades and watching your catches grow dramatically in a short adventure that carries you all the way to the ending.

games.name: Sudoku Mansion
games.shortDescription: A story-driven Sudoku adventure by puzzle setter Nurator, featured on Cracking the Cryptic. Explore a mysterious mansion of handcrafted Sudoku variants, master increasingly intricate puzzles, and uncover the secret hidden beyond the grid.
games.aboutText:
Sudoku Mansion is a story-driven puzzle adventure where you explore a mysterious mansion and solve increasingly challenging Sudoku puzzles.

From the Puzzle Creator Nurator

Sudoku Mansion is created by Nurator , a puzzle setter known for his Sudoku variants.

Nurator's puzzles have been featured multiple times on Cracking the Cryptic, one of the world's best-known Sudoku and logic puzzle channels. Check out the Youtube Link on the right side for an example.

If you've encountered Nurator's puzzles before, you'll find that same love of unusual logic and elegant mechanics throughout the mansion.

Enter Sudoku Mansion

The invitation arrives without warning.

No name, no seal.

Only rushed references to missing servants, unstable rooms and a strange invention.

Two sentences have been underlined twice:

"I have found a way to reach beyond the grid. I no longer know whether that is our salvation or our ruin."

Step inside a mysterious mansion where every room is a handcrafted Sudoku variant. Uncover forgotten inventions as you unravel a mystery hidden deep inside the mansion.

Every Room Teaches Something New

Sudoku Mansion is built around one simple idea:

Every room introduces exactly one new concept.

What begins with familiar Sudoku principles gradually evolves into increasingly sophisticated puzzles. New mechanics are introduced one at a time, allowing every discovery to feel earned while constantly expanding the possibilities.

Every puzzle has been handcrafted. There are no randomly generated levels.

Built for Comfortable Play

Logic should be the challenge, not the interface.

Sudoku Mansion includes a variety of accessibility options to help you focus on solving puzzles your way. Adjust text sizes for comfortable reading, choose alternative color themes, enable colorblind-friendly visuals and customize the appearance of puzzle elements to suit your preferences.

The game is fully playable with only a mouse or only a keyboard and you can freely rebind all hotkeys in the game.

Whether you're settling in for a quick puzzle or an evening of exploration, the mansion is designed to be comfortable to play in.

Knowledge Changes the Mansion

As you explore, you'll unlock powerful puzzle classes that completely change how you interpret familiar rooms.

A puzzle once solved as a German Whisperer may later reveal an entirely different solution as a Region Sum Ambassador . The layout remains unchanged. But the rules and the logic transform completely.

And those are only two of the disciplines waiting to be discovered.

Each new class unlocks another perspective, rewarding players who revisit earlier rooms with fresh eyes.

Secrets Hide Behind Every Door

The mansion rewards curiosity.

Closed Vaults.

Traps you better be very careful around.

Some puzzles exist only for those willing to question what they've already learned.

The greatest mysteries are never placed on the main path.

A Mystery Beyond the Grid

The mansions servants have vanished.

Piece together what actually happened as you uncover the truth behind Sudoku Mansion.

Features

- Over 50 handcrafted logic puzzles

- Explore a mysterious interconnected mansion

- Unlock multiple puzzle classes that transform familiar challenges into entirely new experiences

- Discover secret rooms and hidden vaults

- Solve unforgettable boss encounters that test your mastery

- Atmospheric soundtrack

The invitation is waiting.

games.name: The Attic: A Mystery Puzzle Game
games.shortDescription: Help Jess to organize, repair and restore retro objects - cassettes, cartridges, cameras - while you solve riddles and puzzles hidden in an attic full of memories. A cozy story with hints of mystery where you'll unveil who Matt really was and who Destiny was.
games.aboutText:
Your brother has left for university and the attic where he kept all his things - and spent most of his time - is now yours. Very quickly you realize something's off. Matt was hiding something. Who's Destiny and why is this the first time you've ever heard that name?

The Attic is an adventure in which you'll have to solve riddles, puzzles, and repair objects from the ‘80s and ‘90s to unveil the secret your brother and his mysterious friend, Destiny, were hiding.

Hideouts, secret spots, locked chests, mysterious videogame cartridges… A cozy adventure with hints of mystery inspired by escape rooms and the classic point-and-click adventure games.

FEATURES:

- Solve a wide variety of riddles, puzzles and minigames.

- Repair and restore retro objects from the 80s and 90s.

- Unveil the truth about your brother and why you had never met his friend Destiny.

games.name: Brew & Bottle
games.shortDescription: A cozy first-person alchemy game where every potion is made by hand. Crack a gem in the mortar, chop, press and stir - then decipher recipes written as riddles and sell what you brew to a village full of customers.
games.aboutText:
Tucked at the edge of a village, your alchemy shop is waking up. The cauldron is cold, the shelves are dusty, and the first customer is already wandering up the path. Time to light the fire.

Brew & Bottle is a cozy alchemy game about making potions by hand. Grind, cut and press your ingredients, heat the cauldron, stir, and distil the result into a bottle - then sell it to the townsfolk who come knocking.

Work the ingredients yourself

Nothing here is made by pressing a button.

Chop ingredients on the board.

Drop a gem in the mortar and break it with the pestle - crack it, split it, grind the pieces down to powder.

Crank the press for extracts.

Stir the cauldron and watch the colour turn.

The closer you follow a recipe, the better the potion.

Read the book

Your grandfather's recipe book sits open on its stand. Turn the pages, study each entry, and work out what it's really asking for - recipes are written as riddles, not instructions. Unlock new bases, and learn to read what a customer actually needs.

Make what doesn't grow

The best ingredients aren't sold anywhere. You have to make them.

Feed two things to the combiner and watch them circle each other as the rings turn - what comes out is a third ingredient, something neither of them was. How they went in matters: ground coal and cut coal are not the same input.

Set something spinning in the purifier and walk away while it works. What comes back is purer - its own colour, its own uses - and it can go round again.

Nothing hands you the list. An experiment that doesn't work costs you both ingredients, which is what makes the ones that do work feel like yours.

Serve the village

A town full of characters comes to your counter, each with their own request. Hear them out, brew the right potion, and hand it over yourself. The better you serve, the busier the shop becomes.

Send heroes on adventures

Hire adventurers and send them after ingredients you can't grow at home. They'll come back with rare materials, new recipes and gold - but make sure they're ready before they go. They'll be asking you for potions of their own.

Live a cozy life

Roam a warm village. Trade with vendors, take on errands, and upgrade your workshop one piece at a time.

games.name: Cozy Banker
games.shortDescription: The bank is drowning in cash. Sort eight currencies, organize over 30,000 banknotes, fill 34 safe-deposit boxes, and turn financial chaos into cozy order.
games.aboutText:
The vault is a mess. Banknotes and coins from eight different currencies are scattered everywhere, and each safe-deposit box has its own specific request. Pick up, count, sort, and place every piece of money into the correct box until all 34 are complete.

With over 30,000+ banknotes waiting to be organized, there is plenty of financial chaos to clean up. Work at your own pace and use a variety of practical tools to bring the chaos under control.

SORT 8 DIFFERENT CURRENCIES

Organize banknotes and coins from USD, EUR, TRY, GBP, JPY, KRW, CNY, and RUB.

ATTRACT COINS WITH THE MAGNET

Pull scattered coins toward you and quickly collect pieces spread across the vault.

MOVE CASH WITH THE BLOWER

Use the blower to push loose money across the floor and gather it into manageable piles.

COUNT EVERY STACK

Keep track of how much money you have collected and make sure each box receives exactly what it needs.

There is no timer and no furious bank manager breathing down your neck. Just you, a mountain of cash, and the oddly satisfying task of putting every last coin where it belongs. Grab your tools, take your time, and make the vault look like someone actually works here.

games.name: X Killerz
games.shortDescription: A fast, bloody Y2K arena war built from three connected game types: hovercraft racing, close-quarters FPS, and a fortress-assault MOBA that run back to back in a single match. Nine stages at launch. Kills are both your score and your currency. LAN, online, or bots.
games.aboutText:
X Killerz

X Killerz launches with four deathmatch stages and one large MOBA battleground.

DEATHMATCH

Movement is built for speed: a dash to close distance or escape assaults and a slam-down for vertical kills. Weapons available: rocket launcher, sniper rifle, automatic rifle, shotgun, and a rare homing missile for an auto tracked barrage. Each weapon features a unique subweapon. Other modes like CTF can be played in these Deathmatch stages,

MOBA

The MOBA mode features a large fortress map where hovercraft and infantry fight in the same space. Kill each other or work together to take the enemy stronghold. Their mini bosses are scattered across the map and all of them have to fall before the final boss is exposed while your own mini bosses and main boss need defending. The minimap shows where all the action is happening.

On foot without a vehicle, catapults launch you anywhere on the map and let you pick your own landing point. The MOBA stage also brings in the aerial craft: slower than a hovercraft, but provides a superior view from above.

THEATER MODE

Every kill you land gets recorded. After the match you cut your own compilation. Perfect for social media killstreak videos.

SHOP

Points from killz go into character customization, custom music, and player and vehicle decals.

games.name: System Arrival
games.shortDescription: Top-down co-op survival action RPG for 1–4 players in a world the System turned into a game. Earn levels, quests and psychic powers, scavenge the ruins, fight zombies and build an underground bunker for survivors — then find out what the System really wants.
games.aboutText:
System Arrival is a top-down survival action RPG you can play solo or in online co-op with up to four players. Fight your way through a ruined world, bring supplies back to your underground bunker and turn a fragile shelter into a home for survivors.

Survive together

Invite friends into your story game and share one world, one bunker and a common quest progression. Take control of different survivors, head out on expeditions, gather supplies and develop your base together. Keep track of your teammates on the map and use shared markers to coordinate your next move.

Play together on one PC in two-player local co-op, with split-screen or two monitors. Use a keyboard and mouse plus a controller, or two controllers. Online co-op supports up to four players; local co-op supports two.

The world is now a game

The System arrived without warning. It gave some people quests, levels and psychic powers, turned others into monsters — and now it keeps score. Among the ruins of modern-day North America, meet survivors, complete the System's quests and choose your responses in conversations. Decide whom to trust: humanity, Earth's AI or the System itself.

Inspired by LitRPG and System Apocalypse stories. LitRPG was born from games — we brought it back.

Build your bunker

Build and furnish rooms underground. Turn supplies from your expeditions into equipment and base improvements, unlock technologies and expand what your shelter can do.

Look after your survivors

Assign survivors to gather resources, watch their needs and train their skills. Between expeditions, life goes on in the bunker: its residents need both work and recovery.

Fight with weapons and psychic powers

Aim your shots, strike in melee and dodge incoming attacks. Combine weapons with psychic abilities to protect your character and hit groups of monsters with powerful attacks.

Prepare your defenses

Place barricades and defensive installations, prepare your positions and repel attacks on the bunker. Plan your defenses before the enemy reaches your fortifications.

Choose your moment to strike

Sneak up on enemies and watch for signs that you have been spotted. Reposition in combat and respond to pressure from groups of enemies: the deeper you venture, the harder it becomes to return with your supplies.

Develop your character and study DNA

Combine Intelligence, Constitution, Strength and Agility with skills, equipment and random mutations to find your own playstyle. Study monster DNA to unlock implants, abilities and crafting recipes, and improve armor and bunker technologies.

games.name: Real Zombie Survivors
games.shortDescription: Real Zombie Survivors is a co-op top-down arena shooter where you fight relentless hordes of zombies on real-world maps generated from OpenStreetMap data. Choose unique classes, upgrade your arsenal, call in combat robots, and survive the apocalypse solo or with friends on Steam!
games.aboutText:
Real Zombie Survivors is an intense 2D post-apocalyptic survivors-like and top-down arena shooter that blends fast-paced action with procedural world generation powered by real OpenStreetMap (OSM) data. Choose any location on the globe - your hometown, the streets of New York, Paris, or Tokyo - and face unstoppable zombie hordes in a dark, atmospheric night setting.

Play solo or team up with friends in Steam P2P co-op. Tactical positioning, map awareness, and squad synergy are vital - if even a single teammate falls, the entire team is defeated!

Key features of the game:
Real-world OpenStreetMap map generation - Play anywhere on Earth: The game engine pulls real-time data from OpenStreetMap (buildings, streets, sidewalks, water bodies, street names) and immediately generates a playable world complete with physical obstacles, 2D light occlusion, and navigation meshes.
- Tactical urban terrain: Narrow alleys, intersections, abandoned car wrecks, and trash/rubble barricades force continuous maneuvering and using urban architecture to funnel enemy hordes.

Unique character classes and active abilities - Soldier (DPS): Firearms specialist dealing high damage. Active skill: Combat Fury (massive temporary boost to movement speed and fire rate).
- Medic (Support): Crucial squad member deploying a Medkit healing circle to restore injured teammates during intense combat.
- Bodyguard (Tank): Heavy frontline defender with increased health, damage reduction, and a powerful knockback Shockwave.
- Engineer and Grenadier: Area control via automated defense turrets, damaging auras, and devastating fragmentation grenades.
- Dash: Every character has a dynamic dash with invulnerability frames (i-frames) to escape deadly traps in clutch moments.

Extensive arsenal and supply crates - Auto-firing and line-of-sight targeting: Primary weapons continuously fire at the nearest visible targets while accounting for terrain obstacles and building walls.
- 9 distinct secondary weapons: Discovered in weapon supply crates (including Auto Grenade, Ricochet Sawblade, Mortar Strike, Cryo Nova, Orbital Shield, Combat Drone, Flamethrower, Lightning Strike, Toxic Aura).
- Levels II-V: Each secondary weapon features a 5-tier upgrade tree that enhances damage, range, fire rate, and special effects.

Dual-layer progression system - In-run upgrades: Collect gold coins dropped by defeated zombies and immediately purchase stat upgrades (damage, speed, fire rate, projectile count, magnet radius, maximum health) in the side panel.
- Permanent meta-progression: Collect green crystals by slaying bosses, rescuing trapped civilians, and claiming achievements. Spend skill points across extensive class-specific skill trees in the main menu.

Technological support and map events - Combat robot airdrops: Dropships deliver devastating mechanical allies onto the battlefield: Goliath (heavy combat mech with pulse laser) and Tarantula (10,000 HP mega-tank fortress with a continuous lock-on laser beam).
- Civilian rescue missions: Randomized, timed rescue events on city streets rewarding players with valuable crystals upon successful extraction.
- Crate sonar radar: A 45-degree tactical scanning radar built into the interface to detect and locate ammo, health, weapon, and magnet supply crates.

Steam co-op and Sudden Death - Steam P2P multiplayer: Server lobby browser, public and private games, and direct friend invitations through the Steam overlay.
- True team survival: Cooperative matches feature Sudden Death - the death of any player instantly triggers defeat for the entire team, demanding close teamwork and mutual protection.

Atmospheric setting and dynamic lighting - Night atmosphere: True survival tension with limited visibility, player flashlights, and real-time shadows cast by building walls.
- Clean interface: Modern industrial UI featuring off-screen objective indicators, meta XP progress bar, and sonar readout.

games.name: Hive Havoc 3D
games.shortDescription: Secure the future of the hive in this silly third-person bee experience. Explore hostile locations like the desert, underground labs, and an asteroid. Invade hornet airspace or visit your isolationist juche ant neighbors to steal their nearby resources! This is what they don't want you to know.
games.aboutText:
Due to the previous year's rather meager harvest and a long winter the hive has depleted most of it's resources. Originally, the hive was one of a few hives created in an experiment to increase and automate honey production, but this experiment failed. The last remnants of the inhabitants were forced to relocate by a dark multi-legged entity. To make things worse, due to 5G towers being constructed nearby, the local ant and hornet population have gained sentience and have gotten more aggressive and defensive.

You are a next generation "drone" created from an unholy ritual to collect resources and carry out a variety of work for the future and betterment of the hive, or destroy it...

Due to your short-term memory loss every new day feels like you're in a different location!

FEATURES

- "Authentic" 3D bee gameplay

- Bee yourself and customize your Beevatar with various clothing options

- Toggle between First-Person and Third-Person Camera perspectives

- Infinite days to fly around and do bee related activities as long as you contribute to the hive

- A small variety of large farm locations and their subvariants to explore

- Commit regicide and take the crown (and gain some things)

- An unlockable survival mode that may be very familiar to some

- An unlockable hover car with a 5-star safety rating! (it won't save you from the bird)

- Optional bee friendly weapons, including a heat-seeking rocket launcher!

- Listen to your own music at radios or the car by dropping them in the "user_music" folder (access from the options menu)

- Gibbing can be toggled on or off

- Controller support

NOTES

- Loading the game for the first time may be longer than usual

games.name: Arcostate
games.shortDescription: Arcostate is a sci-fi roguelike set in a post-post-cataclysmic earth still bearing the scars that led to its ruin. Explore a handcrafted map with both unique locations and procedurally generated zones, discover hundreds of items to aid your journey, and lose yourself in a retro-future world.
games.aboutText:
DEMO IS NOW RELEASED!

What is Arcostate?

Arcostate is a sci-fi roguelike set in a post-post-cataclysmic earth still bearing the scars that led to its ruin. Heavily inspired by the likes of Caves of Qud, Brogue, Elin, and others, this game aims to bring a little bit of everything together. Explore a ruined planet holding technological marvels that once promised a bright future for humanity.

You arrive in a foreign land, your memories gone and only your skills to aid you. The earth is scarred and hostile, evidence of a great cataclysm found in the many scattered ruins. Across to the south, a bright blue dome dominates the horizon. Aathman, the last surviving arcology on the planet, seemingly stands as a shining beacon that defends against the many dangers in the wastes. Will you survive and uncover the secrets that led to Earth's ruin, or be one of many to perish in these unforgiving lands?

What is this game?

Arcostate aims to be a blend of classic roguelike gameplay and also bring in features of deep character customization and roleplay. It is turn-based, with elements of survival and exploration with simulation and emergent systems. Choose between a classic mode for true permadeath or roleplaying mode to save and load freely.

Full controller support, playable on Steam Deck.

World & exploration

- Overworld map you can travel across, with sector-based zones.

- Hand-authored and procedural locations.

- Caves that descend forever, with new hazards and stronger enemies the deeper you go.

- A derelict monorail network beneath the surface, with a rideable car.

- A drivable salvaged car.

- Random encounters while traveling, on the map or on foot.

- A bounty board with repeatable contracts to hunt down.

- Day/night cycle, character aging that affects stats, and weather.

Home & building

- Buy land deeds and claim a sector.

- Build walls, floors, doors, windows, and furnishings, or dig down and expand underground.

- Fell trees, mine rock, and salvage glass, then craft kits, furniture, and work stations at your own crafting table.

- Hire guards and shopkeepers through a home terminal.

NPCs & simulation

- Full daily scheduling for NPCs.

- Faction system with grudges and witness reactions.

- Companions/pets, wandering groups, ambushes, and squad behavior; enemies shout for allies when they spot you.

- NPCs use cybernetics of their own, and augments can be cut out of corpses.

Character system

- Points-based character creation.

- 6 attributes, category-based, multi-rank skills with usage progression.

- Cybernetics: installable augments gated by a compute-power budget.

- Psychic powers: wield psychic powers and upgrade them through the skill tree.

- Full character customization including appearance and age. Stats affect character description.

- Player sprite that dynamically changes with equipment and appearance.

Combat & items

- Tactical turn combat: percentage damage reduction armor and dice weapon damage.

- Momentum physics: entities can be pushed via a force, momentum effects duration of travel and damage taken.

- Stealth: sneak and crouch to slip past sightlines driven by each NPC's perception.

- Over 500 items: 53 weapons, 137 armor pieces, 71 consumables, 46 cybernetics, 26 weapon mods, plus ammo and magazines, crafting materials, valuables, and gadgets.

- Drug crafting with a full toxicity system: drugs give useful buffs and abilities with a possibility of overdoses and withdrawals.

- Inventory and encumbrance, loot, and a codex: a permanent gallery of every item and creature you catalog.

Dynamic Equipment Sprites

Arcostate is proud to include a robust 'paper doll' sprite system! Every piece of clothing and weapons the player or other humanoid npcs can wear is shown directly on the sprite. While it was a challenge to balance the layering of sprites and keeping in style with the rest of the game, it was deemed important enough to the player's immersion to include in this classic roguelike experience.

DISCLAIMER

This game is currently in its early stages and not at its fully realized potential. While bugs are constantly being ironed out, please note that there will be bugs and if found, I would really appreciate reports. No AI was used in any artwork or music present in the game.

Please join my discord server and leave any feedback or reports there, I regularly post updates there with progress!

games.name: just volleyball
games.shortDescription: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with unique yet intuitive controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!
games.aboutText:
just volleyball is an arcade-style action volleyball game that aims to bring a freeform, addicting, and simple volleyball experience to PC, with full online & offline play. with a cursor-based aiming system and fully manual movement, the game may seem simple to pick up, but has a steep and rewarding learning curve.

features:

- 1v1s, 2v2s, 3v3s, 4v4s, 5v5s... and 6v6! play whichever format of volleyball you enjoy the most!

- offline & online play: practice by yourself with bots, or head online!

- character customization: personalize your player with a simple yet dynamic avatar creation system.

- replay mode: review your highlights & capture cinematic moments!

games.name: I Hear the Forest
games.shortDescription: A slow-burn folk horror. You play as a forest ranger who finds himself surrounded by talking trees, flying witches' heads, and cursed dryads. You'll be very lucky if you make it out of the forest alive.
games.aboutText:
A game in which an ordinary forest ranger's routine is disrupted by a mystical curse.

Ranger's Activities

- picking mushrooms

- gathering medicinal herbs

- brewing potions

- fishing

- cooking food in a cauldron

- shooting pests that are destroying the forest

- use of magical amulets

- talking to animals

- looking for ways to lift the curse and save yourself

Features

- various endings that depend on your choices

- graphics styled after games from the 2000s

- a thick, lingering atmosphere of fear

- several hours of an immersive experience as a forest ranger

- the ability to explore locations and complete optional activities

games.name: The Death Game Report
games.shortDescription: Investigate how each participant in a death game passed away, and report the details.
games.aboutText:
"Submit your report as soon as possible."

The Record Management Bureau has been tasked with one, simple objective.
Recover and submit a report on the death game that took place on a deserted island a few days ago.

All you have are the records left behind by the deceased, and a single computer terminal.
Investigate each record one by one and uncover the truth behind every death...

About the Game

Your only form of input is through a single, outdated terminal.

Enter Record Names to recover the corrupted data and read the last words left by the deceased.
Cross-reference the clues scattered throughout each record with the student roster and a map of the island. Use this to piece together the details of each death, from the cause of death, to the murder weapon, to the perpetrator.

Finalize each report by confirming all three elements.
Each record you complete leads to another, thoroughly forming a web of death.

- 📒 All clues can be found in the Records, Student Roster, and Map

- 🔍 Identify the cause, weapon, and perpetrator of each death

- ❓ Includes a hint feature to help solve each case

- 🎮 Estimated playtime between 3 to 4 hours

Live Streaming Rules

Live commentary and streaming from both companies and individuals are encouraged. Monetization is permitted.
Inclusion of the store page URL in the description of videos and streams is appreciated.
Please take care to avoid including key spoilers in thumbnails when possible.

games.name: Yuoh　～Escape from the Empire～
games.shortDescription: A sleek, fast-paced vertical bullet-hell shooter. Harness a vast arsenal of gear and shatter the tactics of the relentless enemies closing in.
games.aboutText:
“I will leave this country.”

Freedom is a right—one that only becomes real when it is claimed.

This is the story of those who fight to assert and exercise that freedom.

A simple and light bullet-hell simulator—now unleashed!

No advanced techniques or pattern memorization required!

Let your instincts run wild!

You can dodge enemy fire on your own,

shoot down incoming bullets,

and even guard with a shield.

Play smart and learn enemy patterns,

or go feral and wreak havoc without a second thought!

Supports every kind of playstyle!

Build your own strategies

and experience the thrill of taking down powerful foes!

● Extensive Customization

Create your own unique craft

using a wide variety of distinctive ships and weapons.

● No tedious exploration

Clear each difficulty to unlock suitable gear in the shop,

making it easy to challenge higher levels.

● Just keep destroying the enemies in front of you

And the path shall open before you.

games.name: Walk in PENUMBRA
games.shortDescription: An alien who commands the shadows. His goal: to destroy that star hanging in the sky…? Stretch the shadows. Hide in them. Strike from them. A top-down roguelite shooter.
games.aboutText:
A Creature of Shadow

You are an alien who commands the shadows. In the light you grow weak; in the dark, you come into your own.

Your target is the star burning overhead — and the path to it runs across an unknown planet.

Double Damage in the Dark

In this game, the most important decision is where you stand.

Shadows cast by buildings, by terrain, by clouds drifting overhead.

Things that have always been set dressing become tactical ground here.

While you stand in shadow, your attacks deal double damage.

Some abilities only work there.

Create shadows of your own, and turn enemy shadows to your advantage.

Reading the field isn't just about enemies and items — it's about where the darkness falls.

Which shadow you travel through, and where you shoot from, are the same decision.

Shoot From the Dark, Short Them Out

The planet is patrolled by self-guided war machines.

Attacks landed from shadow drain a Short Gauge on top of enemy HP.

Empty that gauge and the enemy seizes up, leaving it wide open.

The strongest option available: striking from behind while standing in shadow.

Carry It Back, or Push On

Maps are procedurally generated, with a powerful boss waiting at the far edge.

Loot you bring back upgrades your weapons and unlocks new branches of the skill tree.

But fall in battle and everything you collected is gone.

What to carry and what to leave behind —

that decision weighs as much as the fighting does.

games.name: The Cozy Funemployment
games.shortDescription: Take a well-deserved break before searching for your next job! Spend time doing all the things you've always wanted to: cook delicious meals, relax, collect cute figurines, chat with friends, and enjoy life at your own pace. Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the coziest vacation of your life. Wake up whenever you want, cook your favorite meals, decorate your apartment, spend time with friends, and don't rush back to work. After all... you're just taking a little break . What could possibly go wrong?

Plenty of Cozy Activities

Play the guitar, practice yoga, cook comforting meals, binge your favorite shows, sleep until noon, peek at your neighbors, count the last few coins in your wallet... and always find one more little thing to do.

A Smartphone Full of Apps

Chat with friends in a cozy messenger, order delicious food, collect cute figurines, take selfies, try your luck at the casino... Sometimes a little treat really does make you feel better.

And your bank balance...? Don't worry about it. You've saved enough not to think about it.

Decorate and Dress Up

Buy the adorable outfits you've always wanted. Fill your apartment with shelves, fairy lights, plants, and paintings. Make it so warm and cozy that you'll never want to leave.

Find the Job That's Right for You

Don't rush into taking the first job you see. You deserve to find the one that's truly right for you. There are plenty of opportunities out there - don't worry, the perfect one will come along. You're a valuable professional . There's no need to rush.

Don't worry.

You'll find a job.

But first... just get some rest.

games.name: The Sirius Device
games.shortDescription: Your battleship is the last line of defense against a mysterious fleet attacking the solar system. Powered by the mysterious Sirius Device, you will gain levels in your own custom class, craft and equip new ship modules, and fight against numerous enemies in this new Action RPG- Space Sim hybrid.
games.aboutText:
The Sirius Device is an action-RPG and space dog-fighting hybrid game with complex character customization and loot where you control a battleship to save the solar system from mysterious invaders.

Go from an already powerful battleship to a mighty dreadnought and destroy fleets of enemy ships to gain powerful ship parts and clues leading you to their leaders.

Deep character customization

Mix and match equipment and skill trees from the three main factions and three hybrid sub-factions and build up your own battleship with shields, missiles, kinetic and energy weapons, armor, decoys and more!

Progress the story however suits you

Various threats are at hand, chose which leads to follow depending on your gearing needs or your personal preference.

Run missions against the Legion to progress the main story or maybe chase their special operations team to help the pirates from the inner belt and gain more loot from their vendor. Or maybe you will want to help your research team investigate the mysterious "colors" possessing some enemies in order to gain more crafting options.

You are the boss here

Let your subordinates gather all your loot, and build a massive research space station to sort through it and upgrade it.

Add special modules to your ship to go into battle with your fleet of escort ships.

games.name: Cuervito Fumanchu: Pitiados
games.shortDescription: A chaotic 4-player arena run & gun brawler based on El Cuervito Fumanchú, Ecuador's iconic comic strip. Grab a weapon, pick your fighter, and brawl it out — local or online via Steam Remote Play Together.
games.aboutText:
PITIADOS is a chaotic 4-player arena run & gun brawler where every round ends in beautiful, comic-book mayhem.

Based on El Cuervito Fumanchú — a beloved Ecuadorian comic strip with over 20 years of history — PITIADOS brings its iconic characters into explosive head-to-head combat. Pick your fighter, grab your weapon, and settle it in the arena.

Up to 4 players. One winner. No excuses.

KEY FEATURES

- Arena Brawler Combat — Fast, punishing, and deeply satisfying run & gun fights across hand-crafted arenas

- Local Multiplayer — Couch co-op and vs. for up to 4 players

- Steam Remote Play Together — Play with friends anywhere, no extra copy needed

- Iconic Characters — Fight as the legendary cast of El Cuervito Fumanchú, reimagined for battle

- Hand-Drawn Art Style — Every frame crafted in the original comic's bold, expressive style

games.name: Go Next!
games.shortDescription: Your weapons fire on their own. Your job is to keep moving. Wall-run, dash and bunny-hop through hordes of monsters across 11 worlds, and turn 71 weapons and 131 items into an unstoppable build. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.
games.aboutText:
YOUR WEAPONS FIRE THEMSELVES. EVERYTHING ELSE IS ON YOU.

Go Next is a third-person horde survivor where the guns are automatic and the movement isn't. Hundreds of monsters come at you from every side, and your weapons shred them without you lifting a finger. Your job is to stay alive. Run up the walls, chain a dash into a slide into a bunny-hop, and never stand still.

- 11 worlds

- 71 weapons

- 131 items

- 22 playable characters

- Online co-op for up to 4 players

- Ranked seasons and Steam leaderboards

MOVEMENT IS THE MECHANIC

Most horde survivors give you a joystick and a flat field. Go Next gives you fortress ramparts, pyramid walls, city rooftops and a set of moves built to use all of them.

- Wall-run, wall-climb, vault. Run along a wall, sprint straight up it, vault over the top. Walls are routes, not obstacles.

- Dash, slide, dive-slam. Your momentum carries from one move into the next. Slam down from the air into the middle of the horde.

- Quake-style bunny-hopping. Time your jumps right and you keep gaining speed.

- An earned double jump to get over the crowd, not through it.

Speed is survival. Standing still is how runs end.

START WEAK. END ABSURD.

Every level-up offers three cards and you pick one. A run starts with one weapon and ends with the screen full of planets, lightning and black holes.

- 4 weapon slots. Each weapon levels up to 50, and further at the anvil. There are 11 rarity tiers, from Common to Galaxy.

- 71 weapons with personality: a Solar System that orbits up to 30 planets around you, Zeus Lightning, a pocket Black Hole, a Wheel of Fortune, Heads or Tails, Mjolnir, a Goblin Catapult, a Dragon Egg and more.

- 131 items across 10 tiers, from Common to Galaxy.

- Armour that grows with you. Hat, ring, belt and trousers level up from armour cards, rank up from elite drops and follow you from map to map.

THE MAP IS FULL OF DEALS

You can't win standing in one spot, so the map gives you reasons to move.

- Totem challenges that test you: chase it, defend it, overcharge it.

- Shrines that offer a clear deal: trade HP for gold, gamble on a capsule machine, or jump the clock a minute ahead and pocket its kills.

- Cursed chests with better loot, guarded by elites.

- Kill altars, parachute airdrops, a wandering merchant and the anvil .

- Resources to harvest. Every world and its monsters drop their own resources, which you spend to unlock new weapons and items.

11 WORLDS, EACH WITH ITS OWN RULES

- Every world has its own bosses, and some have a superboss.

- At 10:00, the monsters stop walking. Every regular enemy takes off and flies straight at you.

- They swim, too. Water is not a safe zone.

- On the Extraterrestrial Base, a black hole starts eating the planets, one per minute.

22 CHARACTERS, NO LOCKED WEAPONS

A gangster who settles everything with a coin toss, an 80s gym-rat Zeus, a plague doctor, a game-show host with a wheel on his back, a scientist who carries a black hole, and 17 more. Each one has a unique passive, their own strengths and weaknesses, and a signature starting weapon. Any character can find any weapon.

PROGRESSION THAT CARRIES OVER

Every world drops its own resources. Spend them between runs:

- In the Upgrade Tree : one branch per world, opening up new weapons, new items and 52 passives.

- In Unlocks : browse your whole collection and keep the weapons and items you don't want out of your runs.

Everything starts locked, so every run opens up something new.

BRING YOUR FRIENDS, THEN BEAT THEM

- Online co-op for up to 4 players through Steam lobbies, public or friends-only, with invites straight from Steam.

- Leaderboards for solo, duo, trio and squad runs.

- Ranked seasons , from Bronze to Grandmaster.

Full controller support · 19 languages

Survive. Snowball. Go next.

games.name: DinoBones: Tidy Up the Museum
games.shortDescription: DinoBones: Tidy Up the Museum! is a cozy skeleton restoration sim. Identify, collect, and piece together around 2,000 scattered dinosaur bones. Feel chaos turn into order, and with every skeleton you rebuild, the museum reveals another secret.
games.aboutText:
Museum messed up! Something happened here. Crates are tipped over, and skulls, ribs, and vertebrae lie scattered across the halls. You're the only one around to put nine skeletons back together. Well, you and a cat.

TURN CHAOS INTO ORDER

Collect - Pick up bones from the floor, the stairs, and wherever the crates spilled them

Identify - Every bone starts as “Unknown”. Figure out which skeleton it belongs to

Assemble - Find the right slot and click it into place, one bone at a time

MAKE A MESS, LEARN THE BONES

Open crates, tip them over, or just throw them, and start rebuilding. Each dinosaur's bones have their own look, color, texture, wear, and the more you place them, the faster you recognize them. No skill trees, no upgrades. Just you getting better.

WAKE UP THE MUSEUM

As skeletons come together, you'll trigger special events around the museum. Each one leaves something behind: little rewards, toys, and surprises that make the place feel like yours.

games.name: Schedule: Rehab Business
games.shortDescription: Play in co-op at the worst rehab center in town. Manage patients, deal with disasters, and try to help everyone recover without losing control.
games.aboutText:
WELCOME TO THE BEST REHAB CENTER IN TOWN

You and your friends are the staff of a rehab center where patients don’t exactly want to get better. Keep them under control, deal with constant escapes, and do whatever it takes to get them clean.

DRUGS? NOT ON OUR WATCH

Some patients will do anything to get their hands on drugs. Keep them tied down, stop them from getting their fix, and do whatever it takes to keep them clean.

COME BACK HERE

Patients will take every opportunity to run. Keep an eye on the windows, lock the doors, and drag runaway patients back to the clinic before they disappear for another smoke.

GROW YOUR OWN SOLUTIONS

Running a rehab center is hard work and what better way to help others quit than growing and using drugs yourselves?

KEY FEATURES

- Online co-op with friends

- Stop patients from escaping

- Physics based chaos and interactions

- Grow and use your own drugs

- Customize your own character

games.name: Burn It Back
games.shortDescription: A survival RTS in a frozen taiga. Settle the surface for the bunker below, meet its quotas, and every night burn back a living tissue that grows, adapts and remembers.
games.aboutText:
The shaft opens. Someone has to go up.

For generations the bunker has lived underground. Now its coal is running low, and the people it can spare are sent up the shaft into a taiga buried in snow. Up here the old world lies in ruins under the drifts, and something has grown in the quiet: a red, living tissue that spreads across the ground, melts the snow beneath it and swallows anything it reaches.

You do not command an army. You keep a settlement alive.

Build and survive.

Cut timber, strip scrap from the ruins, dig coal. Raise bunkhouses, stoves and a cookhouse; keep people fed, warm and healthy, or lose them.

Answer to the bunker.

It sends quotas, not requests. Meet them and supplies and new settlers keep coming up the lift. Fall behind and the rules get harder.

Hold the night.

Each day you work; each night the tissue comes. Fences, searchlights, rifles, heavy machine guns and flamethrowers are all that stand between it and your people.

Burn it back!

Bullets make it split. Fire makes it die. Hold the fence until dawn, then walk out with the BURNERS and take the ground back, yard by yard, until nothing red is left in the snow.

It evolves

The tissue is a single organism, and it learns. It changes between nights, and its nests in the forest grow from saplings into a beating heart. Build a lab, read the mutation tree, so you can see where it is heading before it gets there.

Features

- Real-time strategy around a fragile settlement: gather, build, feed, keep warm.

- A day and night rhythm: calm days to prepare, nights of tissue surges.

- A cold bunker with quotas and standing.

- A simulated tissue that spreads, splits, burns and swallows across a snow-covered map.

- An enemy that adapts to the way you fight it, and a mutation tree you can study.

- Three shaft tiers and a settlement that grows from a hatch in the snow to a fortified outpost.

games.name: Here Comes the Horde
games.shortDescription: Here Comes the Horde is an incremental auto-battler where your vast armies defend your castle against hordes of undead enemies. Survive the attacks, unlock new units, obtain powerful abilities, and fill the screen with thousands of troops.
games.aboutText:
FEATURES:

- AUTO-BATTLER WITH TENS OF THOUSANDS OF UNITS

- INCREMENTAL GAMEPLAY WITH HUNDREDS OF UPGRADES TO UNLOCK

- 30 LEVELS WITH EVER-GROWING UNDEAD HORDES

- FULLY VOICED BANTER BETWEEN KING RICHARD AND NECROMANCER MORIANA

You are King Richard, and the evil necromancess Moriana has invaded your realm. Gather your army and defeat the invaders… before they behead you.

Fight through 30 levels , each a bigger threat to your castle walls than the last. Recruit peasants, archers, knights, cavalry, mages, and more until TENS OF THOUSANDS of units clash on the battlefield.

Earn gold by slaying undead enemies and spend it on buildings that send more and more soldiers onto the battlefield. The rest is in their hands… and swords. Watch them die in your name as they try to stop the immense waves of zombies.

Use the souls of defeated foes to unlock new units and improvements between levels , strengthening both your colossal armies and your castle walls. Tip the scales in your favor with hundreds of upgrades waiting to be unlocked , and grow stronger with every battle.

Unlock special abilities to unleash chaos upon your enemies. Man your walls with ranged units, summon tornadoes, or even… explode sheep!

Relax and unwind in this fantasy incremental auto-battler while your loyal and devoted troops fight for you. Fill the screen with your armies, rule the battlefield, and don’t let your enemies get anywhere near your precious castle!

games.name: Hack You
games.shortDescription: Desktop hacking and social engineering in a moral thriller. Write viruses, hide them in game builds, crack other people's PCs — to get to the former friend who stole your life and built a new success on its ruins.
games.aboutText:
The Story

Ares and Logan grew up in a poor town and built the crypto startup Midas together. Logan gambled away other people's money and saved himself by pinning all the blame on his partner. You play as Ares, and you're ready to do anything for revenge.

Hack You shows how hackers get to ordinary people

- Viruses in games. How attackers hide malware inside game builds.

- Social media hacking. How hackers gain access to your accounts, chats, photos and personal files. In the game, these are Kisscord and Kissgram, parodies of Discord and Telegram, along with the tricks attackers really use.

- Infected documents. How an ordinary Wort text document becomes a trap that gives full access to your PC: your webcam, your screen and even your crypto wallets.

- How a virus lives in the system. What happens the moment it launches, where malware hides, how it survives a reboot, and what an ordinary virus can do without even needing administrator rights.

- And much more.

Real terminology, not made-up "movie hacking"

The code and interface show things close to real techniques: authorization tokens, LevelDB, Local State, DPAPI decryption (CryptUnprotectData), the AES-GCM algorithm, the tdata archive, Task Scheduler, bot APIs, paths like %AppData% and much more.

All the techniques shown in the game are current as of 2026 and will be educational for aspiring cybersecurity specialists.

Play as a hacker and find out how vulnerable you are yourself.

All characters, companies and apps in the game are fictional.

games.name: RELICTUM
games.shortDescription: Become the Messenger of God and descend into the endless abyss to defeat powerful enemies and bosses while fulfilling the divine command in this 2D Metroidvania action adventure.
games.aboutText:
Explore the Endless Abyss and Uncover Forgotten Truths

RELICTUM is a 2D Metroidvania action adventure where exploration and character progression go hand in hand.

As the Messenger of God, descend into the endless abyss, defeat powerful enemies and bosses, and embark on a journey to fulfill God's command.

Each new ability unlocks previously unreachable areas, revealing hidden paths, secrets, and new challenges.

■ Exploration

Journey through diverse regions, each with its own atmosphere, enemies, and environmental challenges.

Discover hidden passages, uncover secrets, and expand your adventure as new abilities open the way forward.

■ Combat

Face powerful bosses with unique attack patterns.

Master movement, timing, and precision to overcome increasingly difficult encounters.

■ Progression

Collect relics and unlock new abilities that enhance both combat and exploration.

Return to previous areas to discover hidden routes and rewards.

■ Story

Deep beneath the surface lies a forgotten truth waiting to be uncovered.

Meet mysterious characters throughout your journey and piece together the history of the abyss.

Features

- 2D Metroidvania Action Adventure

- Explore Diverse Regions

- Discover Hidden Paths and Secrets

- Challenging Boss Battles

- Ability-Based Progression

- Relic Collection System

- Full Korean & English Language Support

games.name: Pack Ripper
games.shortDescription: Pack Ripper is a hands-on trading card incremental game. Rip open packs, fill your binder, and level up your packs for better pulls. Will you sell the hit or keep it?
games.aboutText:
Pack Ripper is a hands-on trading card incremental game where every pack is yours to tear open, and the next big pull is always one rip away.

Drag along the seal to rip each pack yourself, then flick through your pulls one card at a time. Sell the junk for quick cash, or lock your hits into the binder for good and watch it fill up page by page.

Unlock the Auto-Ripper, a tireless helper that tears through the bulk for you. It rips steady but never perfect, so save your own hands for the packs that matter.

As your collection grows, level up your packs to tilt the pulls your way:

- Better foil odds

- Guaranteed rares

- God packs where every card is foil

But every rip is on you. Trace the line clean and your cards can come out Gem Mint. Slip, and even your best pull comes out scuffed and worth less. Will you rip with a surgeon's hands or tear in like a kid on their birthday?

When you're ready for a fresh start, Prestige to begin a new series. Your money, packs and upgrades reset, but the binder stays. The fuller it is, the more Rep you earn to spend on permanent upgrades that change the rules.

Pack Ripper is a dangerously tactile collecting game, where every rip is a little thrill and the card you're missing is always one more pack away.

games.name: Seconds Until You Die
games.shortDescription: Incremental survival game where you add seconds to your life by eating and drinking increasingly surreal foods, while trying to avoid getting burnt, crushed, dehydrated, distorted, destroyed, and many other things.
games.aboutText:
SECONDS UNTIL YOU DIE is an incremental survival game about adding more seconds to your life

You can fight unique bosses to get unique effects,

Explore legally distinct concepts,

And play online with your friends!

games.name: Family Time
games.shortDescription: Build a family of thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!
games.aboutText:
You're a Father Now

All of a sudden you have to take care of dozens of wolf children! Every night their number grows! Fail to do so and your partner, the Wolf Mama, will kill you! How many can you sustain?

Shelter Your Family!

Build houses for them, or command them to build them for you!

Feed your Family!

Farm food for them or go out hunting with them!

Pamper your Family!

Keep them snug in their own beds to not anger the Wolf Mama!

Can you support 10 children? 100? 1000? 10,000?

Find out.

games.name: Carpet Daddy
games.shortDescription: Turn filthy carpets into satisfying clean stripes in this first-person cleaning simulator. Vacuum, pre-spray, agitate and extract with professional tools, treat stubborn stains, and move furniture to reach every dirty corner.
games.aboutText:
MAKE FILTHY CARPETS CLEAN AGAIN

Carpet Daddy is a first-person carpet cleaning simulator built around satisfying transformations. Take on cleaning contracts, work through the mess with professional tools, and reveal a fresh carpet one careful pass at a time.

Assess the room, move furniture out of the way, and choose the right treatment for the dirt in front of you. Different messes need different tools, so a great result starts before the extractor touches the carpet.

USE THE RIGHT TOOL FOR THE JOB

- Vacuum loose debris to prepare the carpet.

- Pre-spray dirty areas before the deeper clean.

- Agitate the carpet fibres to work treatment into stubborn dirt.

- Spot-treat stains that need extra attention.

- Extract dirt and cleaning solution to reveal the clean surface underneath.

WORK THE WHOLE ROOM

The dirt does not stop at the edge of the sofa. Move furniture, reach awkward corners, and work across the room until the carpet is properly clean. Watch the contrast grow between the mess you arrived to and the clean stripes left by each pass.

COMPLETE CONTRACTS AND RETURN TO YOUR WORKSHOP

Take on jobs with different rooms, layouts and cleaning challenges. Finish the work, earn payment and reviews, then return to your workshop to prepare for the next contract.

ENJOY THE PROCESS

Find the dirty spots, choose your tools, and settle into the sounds and rhythm of cleaning. The reward is a room you can look back on and see how much has changed.

Wishlist Carpet Daddy to follow development and hear when the full game is ready.

games.name: Griefborn
games.shortDescription: Destroy hordes of unholy creatures using firearms and magical abilities. Create your own build, upgrade your weapons, and unlock new levels!
games.aboutText:
Griefborn - is a bloody boomer shooter set in a medieval world with extraction elements.

Slaughter hordes of enemies, gain experience, and level up. Create your own build, upgrade your weapons, and unlock new magical abilities. Combine guns and magic however you like

There will be enemies. Lots of them. A whole lot. And at the end of each run, a final boss awaits — if you can survive long enough to reach it.

Shoot, cast spells, grow stronger, and leave mountains of corpses in your wake.

games.name: Journey TD
games.shortDescription: Journey TD is a roguelite tower defense where your towers are the maze. Pick your elements and draft from 168 towers. Combine power-ups, gear, runes and three skill trees into deadly builds. Every week, battle other players on the same seed to top the leaderboard.
games.aboutText:
Journey TD is a roguelite tower defense where your towers are the maze. Pick your elements and draft from 168 towers – Fire, Ice, Storm, Poison and Darkness each play completely differently. Combine power-ups, gear, runes and three skill trees into deadly builds.

A run ends, your progress doesn't. Your Builder gains experience after every run and keeps everything it found. Every win unlocks the next difficulty on that map, all the way up to Git Gud. And every week you battle everyone else on the same seed for first place on the leaderboard: in the Colosseum with nothing but your skill, in Supremacy with everything you've earned.

168 Towers

Each of the 168 towers has its own abilities. Together, they get even stronger: when two elements meet on the same enemy, they trigger combos – Fire hitting a frozen target sets off a Thermal Shock. And the further you level up both elements, the harder the combo hits.

Mazing

You decide where the enemies go. There is no fixed path: your towers are the walls, and the enemies have to take the route you build for them. The longer the detour, the longer they stay under fire.

For the Competitive Ones

A new round starts every week, and everyone plays the same seed: same map, same waves, same offers. In the Colosseum you start from zero – no Builder level, gear, skill trees, runes or collection cards. All that counts is how well you play. In Supremacy you bring everything you've earned. Both modes have their own leaderboard. Make the top 100 and you get a badge for your profile and some bragging rights ;-)

Six Elements

Fire burns, Ice freezes, Storm leaps from enemy to enemy, Poison slowly eats away – and Darkness … well, you'll see. Discover their combos, and maybe one day you'll stumble upon the sixth.

Every Run Is Different

Every map is rerolled for every run, so you plan your maze from scratch each time. The draft decides which towers you get, and if you don't like the offer, you reroll. Along the way you pick power-up cards that make your towers stronger where it counts, and three identical towers merge into one that's far more powerful. No two runs play alike – only in the competitive modes does everyone play the same seed.

Three Maps, Seven Difficulties

150 waves, 300 waves or Endless – on three maps and seven difficulties. Git Gud waits at the top. And if that's still too easy for you, crank up the sliders in the Book of Madness.

DPS Arena

At fixed waves it's off to the DPS Arena. All that counts there is how much damage your towers really deal, first against a boss, then against an entire horde. The stronger your build, the better the chest you take home.

The Builder

Your Builder is what stays with you from every run. Equip it with powerful items that make all your towers stronger, and spend its points across three skill trees. On top of that, you pick a fitting title and a skin for it, from noble to utterly ridiculous.

For Hunters and Gatherers

Hunt 27 extremely rare Power Runes, awaken 6 god towers, fill your Collection Album with 168 tower cards and earn more than 300 achievements.

Steam Leaderboards

How good is your build really? Every map has its own leaderboard for every difficulty and every mode. And so you don't have to wait until the end to know where you stand, the game shows you wave by wave whether you're ahead of your best run and who on the leaderboard you'll overtake next.

And so much more <3

A Reliquary full of artifacts, a black market full of potions for your towers, a free Journey Pass with 150 tiers, a compendium that explains everything … and a few surprises I'm not telling you about yet.

games.name: Fireboy & Watergirl 2: The Light Temple
games.shortDescription: Help Fireboy and Watergirl explore the Light Temple, the second game in the series. Play solo or team up with a friend locally or via Steam's Remote Play Together!
games.aboutText:
Fireboy & Watergirl 2: The Light Temple is the second chapter of the classic puzzle-platformer series.

Solve the puzzles, beat the clock and collect all the diamonds!

Play solo or with a friend to join Fireboy and Watergirl in their second adventure!

You can play with a friend on the same device or with Steam's Remote Play Together.

games.name: Maiden Party
games.shortDescription: Maiden Party, an anime waifu idle card RPG. Collect hundreds of Live2D maidens, build decks for tactical battles and gain rewards offline. Explore fantasy dungeons, farm & fish in your homestead, raid world bosses with guildmates and unlock character bonds.
games.aboutText:
Gift Codes:

tm-Fate111

tm-Fate222

tm-Fate333

tm-Fate444

tm-Fate555

tm-Fate666

tm-Fate777

tm-Fate888

Contact customer service to receive more gift codes (Note: Maiden Party)

Email: ouzeming0506@outlook.com

Maiden Party

Hundreds of original anime maidens are waiting for you! Beastgirls, elves, demons and humans, including cute lolis, elegant senpais, battle heroines and shrine maidens. Every maiden features Live2D illustration, exclusive voice lines, unique backstories and bond events. Collect and raise them to form your dream team.

Maiden Party is an anime idle card RPG combining tactical deck battles, homestead simulation and guild raids. It caters to waifu collectors, deck builders and casual players who love cozy farming gameplay.

💥 Tactical Card Battles & Idle Rewards

Turn-based card combat allows flexible team building and skill synergy. Auto battle and offline idle gains are supported. No mandatory grind; you can develop your strategy and collect rewards in your spare time.

🗺️ Fantasy Exploration & New Companions

Journey through misty forests, ancient ruins, crystal labyrinths and shadow dungeons. Hunt hidden treasures, trigger side quests and unlock more maidens while uncovering the secrets of this fantasy world.

🏡 Cozy Homestead Life

Unwind after intense battles at your private homestead. Farm, mine and fish to gather upgrade materials, enjoy peaceful moments alongside your maidens.

👥 Guild & World Boss Raids

Join a guild, meet other adventurers, help each other with character progression, and team up to defeat powerful world bosses for rare pulls and valuable loot.

We hope Maiden Party is more than just a gacha and battle game. You can enjoy the thrill of tactical deck-building challenges, while also finding moments of tranquility in your homestead. There is no pressure to rush through progression. Take your time to meet and learn about each maiden, and embark on your adventure at your own pace. May this journey through the fantasy world bring you both thrilling battles and gentle companionship.

games.name: Rip It! Card Collector
games.shortDescription: A single-player incremental game where you rip open boosters and complete the ultimate card collection. Sell dupes, upgrade your gear, and automate your setup to pull more cards, quicker! Fill every page in a satisfying 3-5 hour session. Your binder is waiting!
games.aboutText:
Congratulations, recruit. Team Ballistic has selected you for an extremely important assignment: collect cards. Lots of them.

From your desk, you’ll rip packs, sort through your hits, and build the finest collection of Critkin cards. Drew a duplicate? Sell it! New card? Flip through the binder pages to find the right spot and lock it in! Celebrate god-tier pulls, enjoy the thrill, and make your collection grow.

1,809 Cards. One Binder.

Start simple: open packs by hand, inspect your best pulls up close, and find a home for every new addition. Discover variants, hunt down exclusive promo cards from our community art competition, and buy higher value packs like the First Edition Boosters, and fill each binder page. Every Critkin you find is logged in your CritDex, and the stats screen keeps score of just how deep the obsession goes.

Can’t get your hands on special cards? Take your chances at the Black Market, see what’s on sale, and unlock Black Market upgrades to tip the odds in your favor. For extra income, shake your piggy bank and make it rain!

Unlock a Better Way to Rip

Your humble desk won’t stay humble for long. Grow your arsenal of strange gadgets by spending Gadget Points.

Load packs, boxes or even entire cases into the Rip Rig, speed it up, then add an auto slot so it refills itself. Put the Binder Bot to work moving cards from your mat straight into the binder, and slash its cooldown until it barely stops. Every new card you place in your binder earns XP, with rare cards getting you much closer to the next level and a fresh GP!

Your Rhythm. Your Playstyle.

There are no timers and no pressure to get the job done quickly. Take your time as you inspect card art, vibe to the music, and find your groove. Need something for idle hands between packs? Fidget the seal, mash some buttons, or give the skateboard a spin.

Play in your own style: randomly draw cards from a huge pile to move through your latest haul, arrange them neatly on your desk before you slot them, or upgrade those gadgets to automate the process. Let’s scratch that collector’s itch!

Features

● Fill your binder and complete sets one card at a time

● 1,809 hand-drawn cards across 209 unique Critkin

● Track every find in the CritDex and your personal stats screen

● Automate the grind with an auto-loading Rip Rig and a tireless Binder Bot

● Rip packs, sell duplicates and reinvest the profits

● Upgrade a retro-futuristic workstation that expands with your collection

● Relaxing, low-pressure incremental progression

● Wacky gear and upgrades available through the Black Market

● A radio, how retro!

● Your very own piggy bank - Oink! Oink!

games.name: Cairnforge
games.shortDescription: A sandbox based fantasy survival game. Invent. Craft. Use. Flourish.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to Cairnforge!

What's Special About Cairnforge?

At heart, Cairnforge is a survival/crafting game. Like other games you gather materials, and craft tools and weapons to hunt and survive.

But what's different?
In Cairnforge, the game doesn't know what a pick-axe, a spear, or anything is.

What does this mean?

You gather raw elements... wood, metals, crystals. Then you can go to an invention screen where you literally design those tools and weapons, and you can craft them and use them. This mean's your imagination is the limit.

Cairnforge trusts the player.

You get to decide how your tools work! The game knows how pointy and object is, how heavy it is. It knows the materials. You can create chains. You can build homes. Eventually you will use intelligent fluid dynamics and motors, and... the sky is the limit.

Other Game Goals.

- Measured classes — Become a Mage, Barbarian, or something in between through play, not a character-select screen

- Hands-on crafting & materials — Experiment in the world: build fires, test specimens, and learn what matter can do

- Voxel world & invention — Author structures and articulated inventions from parts that behave like real matter

- Skill-driven progression — Grow through practice across crafting, survival, and emerging tech trees

Let's Shape this Game Together!

I'm giving myself till the end of 2027 to build a game that we can all love together. Please join the playtests, and the discord server, and through discussion and ideas together we will shape the lore and direction of the game.

games.name: Nature Hike
games.shortDescription: Where will the trail lead you? Join your new friend Tendou on a hiking date and find out in this short and sweet fully voice-acted Visual Novel!
games.aboutText:
You'd never have imagined yourself going on a day-long hiking date, much less with local tanuki hunk and recent friend Tendou Ishikawa! You had no idea he felt that way about you, and you barely knew you felt that way about him... but you're looking forward to finding out what awaits at the end of the journey.

A short and sweet cozy visual novel!
