- Each hiking route takes just about 30 minutes, with a total gameplay time of 1-2 hours depending on your reading speed.

Unforgettable voice-acting!

- Tendou's a total dreamboat, and who could be better furry boyfriend material than Sean Chiplock himself?! His soft bass and his charming, vulnerable delivery will immerse you completely in your date with Tendou.

Hilarious yet poignant writing!

- From the Maxi that brought you The Hayseed Knight comes: more romance, more comedy, and just a hint of human drama to tie up this adorable little experience.

Absolutely gorgeous art!

- I don't think I need to tell you how good JEIBON's art is, but SHE DESERVES TO HEAR IT ALL THE SAME!

Super chill OST!

- You won't stop nodding along the relaxing beats that elevate every scene thanks to Tancla's country-pop inspired guitar score.

games.name: Operation Blackwaste
games.shortDescription: Scavenge, fight, and survive in a zombie-ravaged wasteland. Build your safe house, take quests, manage hunger and thirst, craft your build with gear and ability trees, clear wave-based Purge stages — or let auto-combat grind for you. Every sortie and extraction makes you stronger.
games.aboutText:
In the ruined wasteland, survive first — then grow stronger.

The dead roam and supplies are scarce. Starting from a single safe house, you must carve out a life in the apocalypse.

Run Your Safe House
Talk to the shopkeeper and quest NPCs, trade weapons and supplies, and take on contracts. Build and expand your base until the safe house becomes a true home in the wasteland. Every return restores your strength and prepares you for the next sortie.

Sortie, Scavenge, Extract
Explore procedurally generated cities and villages, scavenge loot, and fight mutated enemies and bosses. Manage hunger, thirst and stamina — and when your backpack fills up, every choice matters. Loot only truly belongs to you once you reach the extraction point.

Build Your Way
Deep gear stats and an ability tree with freely allocated attribute points; skills can even auto-cast per slot. Tank the horde in heavy armor or melt it with raw firepower — the choice is yours.

Purge Mode
A wave-based dungeon mode separate from the main story: pick a stage, survive escalating waves, earn Purge Points, and unlock harder challenges.

Auto-Combat Idle Grinding
Want loot without the micro? Turn on auto-combat — your character fights, moves, picks up gear and repairs automatically. Take manual control whenever you like.

A Complete Survival Loop
Quest tracking, world map and minimap markers, three save slots with character profiles, and a full journey from tutorial to boss fights.

games.name: Highways & Co.
games.shortDescription: Do you hate building cities but love managing traffic? Design the perfect road network in this traffic simulator. Build interchanges, roundabouts, bridges, and tunnels with powerful road-building tools. Keep traffic flowing, solve congestion, and avoid a pile-up!
games.aboutText:
Ever wish traffic was the whole game?

Ever played Cities: Skylines and wished you could spend less time building a city and more time figuring out how to make its roads actually work?

Highways & Co. is a traffic simulator game about designing road networks, solving traffic problems, and finding out whether your solution holds up under pressure.

Build the road. Open it to traffic. Find the problem. Fix it. Repeat.

Build the road you want

Create smooth highway ramps and functional slip roads. Build an expensive bridge over the railway, or settle for a level crossing. Upgrade a 2 lane road to a 3 lane road, or build a 3+2 lane asymmetrical road.

Build roundabouts or traffic lights. Manage lane connections and priority. Use different road types and elevations to create the network you need.

There is rarely just one way to solve a problem.

Then see if it works

When you're ready, open the network and let the traffic flow.

Every vehicle has a route, and its own driving behavior. Traffic merges, changes lanes, queues, and reacts to the network you've built.

Every destination has a required traffic threshold. Keep the network moving well enough to meet them all.

When something goes wrong, figure out why. Add capacity. Change a connection. Reroute traffic. Rebuild the junction.

KEY FEATURES

- Ten road types, from country lanes and streets to four lane motorways

- Set lane counts independently for each direction

- Seven height levels, including cuttings, tunnels and viaducts

- Signals, give way junctions, roundabouts and channelized slip roads

- Precise lane connections and priority controls

- Widen roads, convert them to one way, and change their class without rebuilding them

- Railways and level crossings

- A hand crafted campaign of challenging sites

- Deterministic traffic simulation

games.name: Dub Night Live
games.shortDescription: Grab a mic and redub the internet. Dub Night Live mutes the cast of a short clip and hands the roles to you and up to 8 friends. Everyone records at once, nobody hears anyone, then the whole party watches the finished cut together. Build your own clips with the in-app editor.
games.aboutText:
The show starts when the original voices stop

Dub Night Live takes a short clip, strips the cast out of it, and puts a microphone in front of you. You get the picture, you get the music, you get the line you have to hit. Whatever comes out of your mouth becomes the new official version.

No typing. No text to speech. Your actual voice, your actual bad accent, on a real cue.

Party night, up to 8 players

Invite your friends, hand out the roles, roll tape. Everybody performs their own characters at the same time and nobody hears anybody else while it is happening, so the first time you hear the whole thing is the first time everyone hears it.

Wrap your lines and you drop into the green room with the people who already finished, where you can talk trash while the stragglers sweat through take four. When the last person is done, the lights go down, the curtains open, and the party watches the finished cut together with little speaker portraits over the frame so you know exactly who to blame.

The casting desk

Before a word is recorded, the host casts the clip. Drag a player onto a character and the part is theirs. One player can take several characters, so two people can cover a four-hander, and anyone left uncast watches as a spectator.

Running a lineup? The casting carries over to the next episode, with KEEP LAST CASTING, AUTO-CAST and SHUFFLE waiting for you, plus a countdown so nobody has to say "ready" out loud.

Then you vote. Best performance takes the night.

Or take the booth alone

Solo runs line by line. Listen to the original, hit record, play it back, do it again if you can do better. Star the take you want, then sit through your own premiere like a real actor. Line up a few clips into a lineup and the next one starts on its own, so the show never stops for a menu.

The Cutting Room

Every clip in the game is made by players, and the tools ship inside the game.

Drop in a video, pull the voices out of the soundtrack so the music and the explosions survive, mark your lines on the timeline, cast your characters, grab their portraits straight off a frame, and send the whole thing to the Workshop.

You can test play your own clip in the real stage before you publish it, which is usually where you discover a line is two seconds too short.

Channel surfing

The Clip Browser is the front page of everything the community uploads. Sort by what is hot today, what is hot this week, or what has survived all of it. Filter by length, cast size, language or age rating, subscribe with one click, and it lands in your library ready to perform.

In the box

- Mic dubbing with per line takes, retakes and a best take pick

- Online parties for up to 8 with invite codes, voice chat, spectators and host migration

- A cinema style premiere of the finished cut, plus best performance voting

- Versus mode: two players take the same character and the premiere plays both cuts back to back so the party can pick a winner

- Foley lines, for when the job is not a voice but a door slam

- A full clip editor with vocal separation, timeline editing, portrait grabbing and one click Workshop publishing

- Steam Workshop clips and lineups, sorting, filters, favourites and voting

- A mic check wizard that measures your own recording delay so your takes land on the beat

Bring a microphone. Bring friends. Take the dub.

games.name: BOYKISSER IS COMING
games.shortDescription: A simple tower defense game where you need to protect your house from Boykissers
games.aboutText:
BOYKISSER IS COMING is a Tower Defense game where Boykissers are heading for your house. Build and upgrade your towers, put together your defense, and stop the growing waves of Boykissers.

Earn money by destroying Boykissers and spend it on building and upgrading towers. Collect materials from Boykissers and use them in the skill tree to unlock new towers and upgrades, then return to the map with a stronger defense.

Features

- 10 levels and 100 waves

- 6 tower types

- Massive waves of Boykissers

- A skill tree with permanent upgrades

games.name: Foxy's Potion Shop
games.shortDescription: Join Foxy in its little cabin in the middle of the Magical Forest as the new potion crafter! All the inhabitants of the Forest are thrilled that you moved in to perform the art of brewing in a cauldron!
games.aboutText:
Join Foxy in its little cabin in the middle of the Magical Forest as the new potion crafter !

All the inhabitants of the Forest are thrilled that you moved in to perform the art of brewing in a cauldron !

Customize your interior with furniture, objects, souvenirs and of course all your potion crafting and ingredients!

Meet and discuss with the people of the forest. Answer their requests.

Unlock new ingredients to create new potions. Sell them.

Collect all the cards of the different characters and finish the game!
Expected time to finish the game: 1hour.

This game is made with The Foxy Guiz, my concept artist intern. She produced all the visuals of the game for this original concept :)

games.name: One More Planet
games.shortDescription: Mine asteroids, build defenses, and conquer planets across distant galaxies. Explore open space, complete missions, unlock new technologies, and defend your settlements against attackers. One More Planet is an action & exploration game set in a physics-driven 2D space sandbox.
games.aboutText:
One More Planet is a space exploration game where you mine resources, build planetary defenses, grow your economy, and conquer new planets and galaxies. Most runs last just few minutes, feeding into a deep progression system that unlocks new mechanics and enables powerful builds.

Multiple mission types

Mine asteroids, defend planets from enemy waves and meteor storms, conquer hostile worlds, deliver valuable cargo, escort allied ships, and explore the far reaches of each galaxy.

Complete missions at your own pace, or ignore them for a while and head into space simply to explore, experiment, and gather resources. There is no pressure to follow a fixed path.

Multiple ship types with over 20 unique abilities

Choose between a versatile all-rounder, a heavy mining vessel, a fast combat ship, and a physics-bending ship that can capture, crush, and launch asteroids. Combine more than 20 active and passive abilities to create specialized loadouts for mining, exploration, or combat.

Three galaxies and 22 planets

Explore three distinct galaxies, each with its own visual identity, hazards, enemies, resources, and progression. Every planet has a unique upgrade tree that can unlock new buildings, defenses, abilities, missions, and economic opportunities.

The campaign offers at least 10 hours of progression, discoveries, special events, and increasingly dangerous challenges.

Simple controls, surprisingly deep mechanics

One More Planet is easy to pick up, but its interconnected systems create plenty of room for experimentation. Ship physics, asteroid collisions, cargo towing, planetary gravity, active abilities, passive sidearms, resource production, and defensive construction all interact in unexpected ways.

Every short expedition gives you something to bring home, and every upgrade changes what becomes possible on the next run.

games.name: Weeping Souls
games.shortDescription: "Weeping Souls" is a visual novel game. The player takes on the role of the protagonist and chooses the right path to ensure the safety of themselves and their friends. The game features multiple endings, determined by your choices.
games.aboutText:
Story Experience:

"Weeping Souls" is a Chinese-style horror text adventure game. Set against the stage of the "Spirit Realm," the game casts the player as the chosen college student Shen Qingci, who must move through the interweaving of the Spirit Realm and reality, experiencing one eerie event after another built from obsession and resentment. With 180,000 words of non-repeating text, different endings and different choices will lead to entirely different truths and paths of return. While carrying on the traditions of horror, suspense, and tightly woven storytelling, the game devotes even greater effort to portraying the human hearts and emotions that struggle in the darkness.

Visual Effects:

In terms of visual effects, we strive to create striking atmospheric contrasts. The reality sections adopt a clean and bright Korean-style anime flat-color rendering, while the Spirit Realm sections shift into a cyberpunk Chinese-horror realistic thick painting style, using dark green tones, mist, talismans, and cold light to build an oppressive and eerie otherworld. We pay close attention to the detailed depiction of both the modern city and the Spirit Realm scenes, seeking to strike a balance between horror and beauty.

Shen Qingci

Shen Qingci is the character played by the player. He is a junior-year college student. On the surface he is an ordinary young man, but he is also a one-in-a-million "Night God." To stay alive, and for the sake of the trapped spirits, he chooses to become a Spirit Realm Walker.

Old Lin

Old Lin, Shen Qingci's college roommate and his best friend.

Lu Xiaoyu

Lu Xiaoyu, a kind-hearted high school girl, yet trapped in the Spirit Realm and turned into a weeping soul.

Grandfather

Shen Qingci's grandfather, who has passed away. He left a diary for Shen Qingci.

Lin Yue

Team Leader Lin, the enforcement captain of the Control Unit and a loyal henchman of Uncle Li. There are many others who serve Uncle Li just as faithfully.

Sound Effects

In terms of audio, we pursue a sound expression that resonates highly with the game's character. All of the female characters in the game are voiced by a professional live-actor team, striving to match the emotions and fates of each character. The key male characters are likewise performed by live actors. Moreover, every Spirit Realm is equipped with its own exclusive, brand-new background music, never repeated, all to let players truly sink into the experience. Both the score and the sound effects are independently designed for each Spirit Realm scene, controlling every detail from the warmth of everyday life to the oppression of the Spirit Realm.

Adult Content Description

This game contains some adult content elements, as follows: horror and psychological horror scenes, violent acts, depictions of blood and gore, corpses and skeletons, death and suicide themes, criminal behavior, bullying and persecution, and derogatory language. The game contains no nudity, sexual violence, or depictions of sexual acts, nor any alcohol-related content. All such representations are conveyed primarily through text narration, static imagery, and atmosphere-building, and do not include realistic bloodshed or depictions of harm.

games.name: Incident 24
games.shortDescription: （This game does not use AI.）A hand-drawn 2D action platformer set in a sci-fi world. Explore the perilous Ancient Ruins No. 24, master fluid movement to dodge deadly traps, and utilize precise combat mechanics to fight mutated monsters for survival.
games.aboutText:
In the year 2400, a mysterious energy suddenly reawakens, and you become separated from your teammates during a reconnaissance mission. Your equipment is running low, a powerful magnetic field is interfering with electronic signals, and the return route is blocked by thick snow. You have no choice but to bravely venture into the unknown wilderness. To survive, you must gather crucial resources, use precise platforming to dodge deadly environmental traps, and defeat mutated creatures that block your path.

Game Features: Engage in highly demanding, hardcore combat and face ferocious mutated monsters head-on. Master enemy attack patterns and utilize precise parries, dodges, and attack timings to defeat your enemies in thrilling and suspenseful battles.

Defeat monsters to obtain the resources you need.

Resource Management and Wilderness Survival: In harsh, frigid environments, energy and supplies are extremely scarce. You must wisely manage limited resources, gather essential items, and ensure your continued progress through the perilous ruins.

Backpack Resource and Health Regeneration Mechanism.

Fly skills consume health.

games.name: SPSPSP
games.shortDescription: SPSPSP is a shoot 'em up deckbuilder where you draft your own targets. Chain enemy synergies to inflate their scrap value, then shoot them down to cash out. Survive the wave you just empowered. The toll rises every cycle. Greed is the difficulty slider.
games.aboutText:
To make money, you have to invite more enemies

One rocket, drawn in ballpoint pen. A toll you can't afford.

And a swarm you called down on yourself.

1. Draft your enemies

Each cycle opens with three cards. Whatever you pick joins your deck. Not as an ally — as an income stream.

2. Synergies set the price

Placed pieces raise each other's value through adjacency. A sun starved by its neighbors swells into a red supergiant and goes supernova. Enough cultists around a summoning circle, and something older answers. The Prince finds his fox, then his rose.

Trigger cascading synergies for massive payouts. Stack lasting value over time or cash in on explosive bursts — the deeper the chain, the more your payout multiplies.

3. Then they come for you

Everything you just made valuable spawns in the combat phase — stronger, and in greater numbers. The better your economy runs, the thicker the screen gets.

Your payout structure is the bullet pattern.

4. The toll doesn't wait

The bill climbs every cycle. Cash out now and move on safely, or slot in one more piece and raise the payout. Miss a payment and the run is over.

Themed decks

Solar System — stellar evolution, supernovae, orbital adjacency

Cthulhu — cultists and summoning circles calling down worse

The Little Prince — fox, rose, and the asteroid they orbit

UFO — stacks abduction counters on other pieces and converts them

Quantum — probability, superposition, and pieces that refuse to settle

Also included

Weapons assembled from three axes: projectile form, modifier, on-hit effect

Seeded runs — the same seed plays out the same way

Replay recording and playback

Hand-drawn pixel art on paper texture

games.name: Trash to Trees: Tidy up the forest!
games.shortDescription: Clean up, sort, recycle, and restore the forest in this cozy tidy-up simulator with over 10,000 trash items. Unlock abilities to improve your efficiency. Enjoy the satisfying experience of bringing the forest back to life at your own pace, alone or with friends.
games.aboutText:
Trash to Trees: Tidy up the forest! is a cozy first-person cleaning and organizing simulator set in a polluted forest.

A once-thriving forest has been overwhelmed by years of litter and illegal dumping. Bottles, cans, bags, and countless pieces of forgotten rubbish are scattered across the forest floor, with thousands upon thousands of items waiting to be found, sorted, and recycled.

Clean up the mess, and watch as nature slowly returns.

Piece by piece, turn trash into trees.

Explore the forest and pick up trash scattered across paths, between trees and throughout heavily polluted areas. Fill your backpack and return to the recycling station when you’re ready to unload.

Empty your collection onto the sorting table and separate items into categories: Plastic, Glass, Metal, Paper.

Correct sorting earns money for upgrades.

Restore : Every piece of trash removed contributes to the recovery of the forest. Damaged ground becomes greener, flowers grow, birds begin singing and wildlife slowly returns.

A Relaxing Experience : Explore, clean, organize and enjoy watching the world become a little more beautiful with every trip working at your own pace.

As you recycle trash and earn money, unlock upgrades that make larger cleanups faster and more satisfying.

Multi-Pickup : Collect several nearby pieces of trash at once.

Backpack Upgrades : Carry larger hauls before returning to the recycling station.

Sorting Upgrades : Expand your workspace and introduce equipment that helps process trash more efficiently.

Trash Scanner : Send out a pulse that highlights remaining trash throughout the forest, helping you track down those final hidden pieces.

Explore. Clean. Recycle. Restore.

You didn’t just clean a forest.

You brought it back to life.

Made by People, Not AI

games.name: Windrest Chronicle: Dragonport Diner
games.shortDescription: Your hometown rests on a great sea dragon. Farm, fish, forage, and explore as it carries your town across the ocean. Gather ingredients, cook for locals and travelers, restore the diner, discover recipes, make friends, and fall in love. Make Dragonport the warmest light on the sea.
games.aboutText:
Start Your New Life on the Back of an Ancient Sea Dragon

A land of opportunities awaits on the back of a majestic sea dragon.

Clear the untamed land, till the soil, sow seeds, tend to your crops, and reap a bountiful harvest. As you progress, you’ll unlock more unique crops and process your yields into essential ingredients for your diner.

Level up your skills through everyday activities like farming and crafting to unlock new production methods and abilities, transforming a wild patch of land into a flourishing, self-sustaining farm!

From Farm to Table: Run Your Very Own Floating Diner

Turn your harvested crops into refined ingredients, then cook them up into mouthwatering signature dishes for your guests!

Through daily farming, fishing, and cooking, you’ll earn experience, unlock skill trees, and access brand-new production recipes and handy survival abilities.

Meet Over 18 Townsfolk — And Maybe Find Someone Special

The town built on the sea dragon's back is home to at least 18 unique residents with distinct personalities.

Some run their own shops, others care for their families, and many hold unique perspectives on the dragon, the sea, and the town's forgotten past.

Talk with them, send thoughtful gifts, and get to know their stories through daily interactions. As your bonds deepen, they will open their hearts to you and invite you to share in the moments that matter most to them.

Among them are 8 romanceable candidates with whom you can build deeper relationships.

Go from strangers to friends, and perhaps lovers, as you nurture your connections through everyday conversations, gift-giving, and exclusive story events.

Life in town shifts naturally with the changing seasons. Take part in festive events, encounter random occurrences, and spend peaceful yet unforgettable days alongside familiar faces.

Heal the Sea Dragon and Uncover Ancient Bonds

The sea dragon is more than just the giant creature supporting your farm, diner, and town—it’s a companion that needs your care.

As your farm and diner expand, you'll channel the healing powers of nature and the ocean to aid its recovery, piece by piece uncovering the forgotten history between humans, deep-sea races, and the ancient sea dragon.

Explore Beyond the Town to Discover Secrets and Resources

There is far more to explore beyond fields and kitchens. Step outside the town to venture into diverse regions—gather rare materials, delve into mysterious caves, fish in exotic spots, and bring your treasures home.

As your journey takes you deeper, you’ll uncover the hidden secrets of this world and reveal an ancient, forgotten legacy shared by humanity, deep-sea dwellers, and the ancient sea dragon.

games.name: President FC: Football Club Owner
games.shortDescription: Build a football club from the lower leagues up. As the owner, hire your manager, discover players and develop young talent. Explore a detailed football world and shape your club over decades. Leave the team and tactics to your manager or have your say before each match.
games.aboutText:
Build a club with a future.

In President FC, you run the club as its owner. Choose its name, crest and kit, start at the bottom of your chosen country's league system and work your way up. Hire the manager, build the squad and choose where to invest.

Explore a football world full of promising youngsters, rival clubs and competitions at home and abroad. Your manager prepares the team for each match. Trust his choices or step in with your own line-up and tactics.

Put your faith in the next generation

Follow the youngsters in your academy as their promise becomes clearer. Improve their training environment and decide who earns a professional contract. Once they turn professional, combine training with suitable playing opportunities to help them work towards the first team.

Use the reserves and loans to give young professionals playing time. Develop a future regular, give a late bloomer time or sell a youngster to fund your next move.

Find young talent beyond your borders

Grow your academy to unlock youth camps abroad. Camps bring local youngsters into your youth system and uncover prospects at clubs in that country. Choose where to build, upgrade your camps and decide which youngsters to bring into your academy. Build your own network of clubs

Buy affiliate clubs as your resources grow. Their managers run the teams, while you invest in their academies and training grounds. Send players on loan with priority for the starting line-up when fit and available. Affiliate clubs can also send their best final-year academy prospect to your academy each season, provided there is space. Discover your next signing

Your club does not start out knowing every player. Send scouts to discover new names, narrow their searches by age, position and country, and build your shortlist.

Commission reports to learn more about a player's potential. Compare candidates and weigh up fees, wages and contract terms. Find a prospect to develop, an experienced player to lead the side or the missing piece for a promotion push.

Get to know the player behind the rating

Look through player profiles for form, competition statistics, development, traits and contract details. Compare players side by side to see what each could bring to your squad.

Career records track seasons, clubs, appearances and goals, alongside transfers, honours and milestones. Follow careers as they unfold and revisit past seasons through records and summaries.

Choose your manager. Make your own calls.

Hire a manager whose approach suits your club. Let him pick the team, give standing instructions or change the formation, players and tactics before a match. Save your plans to use again.

Fitness, morale and squad depth all matter when choosing the team. Watch the match unfold or skip to the result and get back to running the club.

Give your club room to grow

A new signing, better training facilities or more seats for supporters: your budget has to cover more than the next match. Develop your academy, training and fitness facilities, expand the ground and compare sponsorship offers.

Use the ledger and forecast to keep track of cash, wages and future commitments. Invest in this season without losing sight of the next.

Your decisions and results also shape how supporters feel about you and your manager.

Explore football beyond your own league

Browse tables, fixtures, results and player statistics across leagues and cups. Follow a title race abroad, inspect a rival squad or look back at past winners. Continental club competitions, national teams and international tournaments are part of the world too.

Your players can earn international call-ups. Follow their progress for their country and plan around their availability for your club.

Build a club that lasts

Promotions, trophies and memorable players become part of your club's story. Revisit them in the museum, hall of fame and season archive.

Develop your president's skills to support the way you play, and plan for the generation that will follow today's first team. Your first promotion is just the beginning.

Your president gains experience too. Start another career with the same president to carry that experience into a new club.

Find your way through the detail

Go from a league table to a club, from its squad to a player, and back again. Search for players, clubs and competitions. Filter and sort tables, then save column layouts that keep the information you need close at hand. Keep your career moving

Designed for quick day-to-day simulation and careers that span decades. Use instant results and holiday controls to move ahead, or take your time over a scouting report, a transfer or the season's statistics.

Set automatic responses for selected manager requests and media enquiries, leaving you more time for the decisions you want to handle yourself. Make the football world your own

Use the built-in editor to customise clubs, players and managers, including names, colours and kits. Adjust the league

games.name: The Cardkov
games.shortDescription: Turn poker hands into weapons in this single-player, top-down extraction shooter. Collect discarded cards in the city's cold back alleys, build a hand, and use your new weapon to uncover the factory's secrets. Grab one more card, or make it back alive with the hand you've got.
games.aboutText:
Turn poker hands into weapons. Make it back alive.

The Cardkov is a single-player casual extraction shooter where poker hands become weapons.

Scavenge discarded cards in the city's cold back alleys, then turn the hands you build into weapons and fight your way through.

Why are there so many discarded cards in this city?

Venture deep into the sprawling card factory and uncover its secret.

Build a Hand, Craft a Weapon

Pick up five cards and build a poker hand.

From one pair to a royal flush, the hand you play determines the weapon you get.

Play the same hand back to back to make that weapon stronger.

Grab Your Cards and Get Out

Make your way through the city's back alleys to the sprawling card factory.

Push deeper for more cards, or head for the exit with the hand you've got.

Make it back alive and you can use the cards you brought home on your next run.

One Card Can Get You Out of Trouble

♠ Spades give you ammo, ♥ Hearts restore health, ♦ Diamonds grant armor, and ♣ Clubs boost your luck.

Spend a card now to get out of a tight spot, or hold on to it for a stronger hand. The choice is yours.

Gear Up at the Hideout

Back at the hideout, cash in your haul.

Find out what you've picked up at the Appraiser and trade for new cards at the Exchange.

Upgrade your cards and weapons at the Workbench, then see how much deeper you can go on your next run.

games.name: SinEater
games.shortDescription: Climb and parkour through procedurally generated towers of memories in search of your own sins in this third-person exploration platformer. Survive in the world after the second great flood. Manage resources and needs, scavenge and trade with fellow sin-eaters.
games.aboutText:
MEMORY TOWERS

All levels are randomly generated, offering a fresh experience every playthrough with mysteries of the past to uncover, natural and unnatural dangers to avoid, old machinery to fix and other climbers to talk and trade with.

Level modifiers and biomes spice it up even more, bringing different weather conditions, giant beings hunting you down, resource scarcities and unique to biomes structures and items into play

CLIMBERS

You are a sin-eater, a new life form born from the skeleton of a long gone person, using your natural agility and wings to ascend the towers in search of answers hidden in your past life.

Jump, wall-jump, long-jump, vault, glide and flap your wings to get around, watch your head and don't slip. Manage your stamina and don't let afflictions consume it.

The climb will require you to be thoughtful of your resources, your path and your surroundings.

TRUSTY BACKPACK

Every sin-eater has their trusty backpack with them. You are no exception. Space is limited; carrying too much will burden you, lowering stamina. You have to be thoughtful of what you bring along.

There are many useful items to find and trade for, so plan ahead and make choices in what you keep, be it extra food or tech parts to repair that jump pad with.

FEATURES

- Randomly generated towers with a history to discover, 3 biomes to explore and a handful of modifiers to spice it up

- Story and Infinite climb gamemodes, optional difficulty settings (permadeath and level time limit)

- Easier difficulty option with more forgiving survival mechanics for those interested in a more casual experience

- Parkour with a number of different moves, a stamina to look out for and dangers to avoid

- Useful items and resources to find and manage, avoiding over encumbrance

- Weird and aggressive flora and fauna, waiting to feed on you

- Survival elements with many afflictions to deal with (concussions from hitting your head too hard included)

- Atmospheric and bumpy soundtracks by the very talented Hohenheim and Zorrio

- 1-2 hour long story campaign to go through and an infinite climb mode

- Cute guy with outfits to find and wear, poses to hit and a free camera mode for some cool screenshots

games.name: The Grand Book Archive: Tidy Up
games.shortDescription: Restore The Grand Book Archive by sorting 2,990 books onto their rightful shelves. Use your observation and magical spells to organize the collection as quickly as possible. Explore a variety of book themes and discover endless possibilities within the archive.
games.aboutText:
The Grand Book Archive

You are invited to help restoring The Grand Book Archive, a timeless haven preserving the books of human history. Use your observation and magical spells to organize the collection as quickly as possible.

Sort and Upgrade

The game combines satisfying book sorting with diverse incremental progression. Complete shelves to earn coins, which you can spend on powerful spells and upgrades that make your sorting faster and more efficient over time.

Each completed run unlocks permanent meta-progression, giving you new ways to improve your abilities and make future runs more efficient. Increase the number of bots working alongside you, multiply the coins you earn, or unlock unique triggers that let you fill multiple shelves at once. With every upgrade, you’ll become faster, more powerful, and one step closer to becoming the ultimate archivist.

Various Themes and Covers

The game offers a wide variety of themes and book covers to choose from, along with the option to create your own custom theme. With hundreds of hours of gameplay, you can continue discovering new ways to enjoy it. The possibilities are truly endless.

Master of the Archive

Earn coins, unlock unique upgrades, and discover all new ways to streamline your sorting as you work your way through the Grand Book Archive.

games.name: I Am Plague
games.shortDescription: I Am Plague is a dark incremental roguelite with automatic combat and permanent progression. Lead a horde of rats, collect mutations, create powerful synergies, and devour your enemies as you climb 200+ floors of a vast underground fortress. Every death makes you stronger.
games.aboutText:
For centuries, a colony of rats has been growing in the darkness beneath a grand capital, unnoticed by the people above. Thousands of rats, driven by a single desire: to reach the surface. They think as one and answer to a single will. Humanity's desperate resistance will not stop them. Soldiers and priests, alchemists and mechanical constructs, parasites, monsters, and even angels stand in their way. The rats will devour their flesh, claim the skulls of the fallen, and grow stronger.

I Am Plague is an incremental game with automatic combat and roguelite elements. Your horde fights using its mutations and abilities. The outcome depends on the build you bring into battle.

As you climb, choose one of three mutations on each floor, buy more in shops, and combine their effects to create devastating synergies.

Upgrade strength, attack speed, health, and defense. Boost critical hits, evasion, and health regeneration. Picking the same mutation again further strengthens your build.

How you reach the surface is up to you. At every fork, weigh the dangers against the potential rewards and choose your next move.

Your horde starts out weak. Your first run may end almost as soon as it begins. But death is part of growing stronger.

Back in your lair, spend the flesh and skulls collected in the fortress on the Tree of Flesh and Tree of Bones. Permanently boost your horde's base stats and unlock new mutations.

Newly unlocked mutations can appear in future runs. The further you progress, the more options you have to shape your build.

With each floor, the horde uncovers more of the fortress's secrets. Fragments of memories that are not its own. Voices from the abyss. Fear among the fortress's defenders.

The horde is destined to fulfill a prophecy humanity once kept from coming true. But postponing fate is not the same as escaping it.

The closer the horde comes to the truth, the harder it becomes to tell whether it will avert the apocalypse or unleash it.

The full game will feature:

- 200+ dungeon floors

- 50+ mutations across multiple rarity tiers

- Permanent upgrades to your horde's base stats

- New enemy types as you ascend

- Shops, text-based events, and branching routes

- Increasingly dangerous bosses

The higher you climb, the less the dungeon resembles the place where your journey began. And more and more people recognize the horde as something they thought had been destroyed centuries ago...

games.name: ZOMBILLIONAIRE
games.shortDescription: Incremental FPS game where Millions of Zombies came from the dead... AND THEY ARE FULL OF OIL!!!!!! Demolish Millions of Zombies. Buy Insane Weapons. and become a Zombie Oil Billionaire
games.aboutText:
BECOME A ZOMBIE OIL BILLIONAIRE!

Millions of zombies rose from the dead... AND THEY ARE FULL OF OIL!

Enlist to demolish them and you could take a real part in the emerging zombie oil industry

MILLIONS OF ZOMBIES

- Overwhelming swarms of zombies

- Machine guns

- Planes

MASSIVE UPGRADE TREE

- More weapons

- More ammo

- Sell loot you get from zombies to get stronger

BUILD YOUR BASE

- Turrets

- Mortars

- Flamethrowers

games.name: Can 'Em All
games.shortDescription: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.
games.aboutText:
Oh look, the truck is here.

A truck delivers a fresh batch of adorable creatures straight to your factory.

Unfortunately for them, they're also your main source of income.

First, you need them dead.

Grab your weapons and clear out the factory.

Now turn them into something useful.

Grab the bodies and throw them into the crusher.

Get those cans into the tube.

Your freshly processed cans still need to be sold.

Reinvest in the business.

Get stronger weapons. Upgrade your vacuum. Unlock machines. Build conveyors. Increase production. Bring in more creatures. Automate the factory.

games.name: Dragons Invasion
games.shortDescription: Dragons Invasion is a Souls 'Em Up. A 2D horizontal shooter where you roll like Dark Souls and swap colors like Ikaruga. Absorb shots, fill your power gauge, and destroy dragons — solo or in local co-op.
games.aboutText:
GAME OVERVIEW

Dragons Invasion is a 2D horizontal shooter, playable solo or in local co-op. Master the Dash and Color Swap — slay dragons or absorb their shots to charge your power gauge. Match their color. Unleash your power. Destroy them all. Be tough. Be skilled. Save the land.

ARCADE SPIRIT

Grab a friend. Take on a sky full of dragons. Share the glory. 2-player local co-op available at launch.

STORY

The kingdom is under attack by dragons. It's up to you to set it free! Choose one of four unlikely heroes and fight your way across the entire kingdom — from the devastated city to the haunted mines, through mysterious swamps and all the way to the castle.

HERO — THE ROOSTER KNIGHT

His blade never stops. Unleash sword volleys that evolve from a single precise strike into a devastating four-blade cross barrage.

ARROWEN — THE ARROW BREATHER

Riding her trusty owl, Arrowen strikes with deadly precision. Fire straight shots, diagonal spreads, and homing arrows. At full power, she unleashes a gigantic arrow that stretches across the entire screen.

GAMEPLAY - 3 magical colors, red, blue, green. Match the enemy color to kill it.

- Swap Colors → autoshoot destroys enemies

- Power Gauge (5 levels): your color halo absorbs matching fire → fills your gauge → boosts your shots. Get hit → gauge and powers drop

- Dash: multidirectional agility skill

- Piercing Attack: hits in front of you during a dash (hits all enemies, even colorless)

- Roll: invincible move ending with a finishing strike (hits all enemies, even colorless)

- Invocation: A priest gives you a scroll that lets you summon a powerful warrior spirit for a devastating attack.

- Rewards: Defeat a boss, pick one of three items to power up your current run: faster movement, quicker attacks, raw power, and more.

games.name: Foole's World
games.shortDescription: An absurd personality testing experience with a whole lot of questions for you.
games.aboutText:
Look upon the fantastical world of the Astronomical Foole, who just so happens to be yours truly!

- Approximately an hour of playtime, though it might be much more if you are an indecisive specimen.

- Over half a hundred questions to ponder, with your answers culminating in a designated alignment.

- Over ten unique areas to look around, masterfully crafted by the one and only me.

- Dynamic dialogue which changes depending on previous answers, thanks to my excellent conversational skills.

- A glimpse into my origins, shrouded in secrecy though they may be.

games.name: TunaSweeper
games.shortDescription: A top-down PvE looter shooter that alternates between peaceful life at the base and dangerous expeditions. Explore for supplies, fight enemies, and decide what to take and when to return.
games.aboutText:
Luna wakes up in an unfamiliar base.

Inside, life is peaceful. She eats, sorts her gear, and prepares for the next expedition. Outside, however, abandoned facilities, forgotten belongings, and dangerous creatures await.

TunaSweeper is a top-down PvE looter shooter that alternates between peaceful life at the base and dangerous expeditions into the outside world.

Head Out, Loot, and Make It Back

Explore different areas outside the base, search for useful supplies, and fight off enemies along the way.

Choose what equipment to bring before heading out, then decide what is worth taking home once you're in the field. You can risk staying longer to fill your inventory, or return early to protect what you've already found.

What you bring, what you take, and when you decide to head back all matter.

Life Goes On Back at the Base

Make it home safely, sort through what you've collected, and prepare for your next expedition.

Spend time with the others who live at the base, or simply take a moment to rest. Unlike the dangerous world outside, life at the base moves at a quiet, relaxed pace.

Combat and exploration are only part of TunaSweeper. Making it home safely and returning to everyday life is just as important.

Discover the World at Your Own Pace

The game won't tell you everything about this world or what happened to it from the start.

Old facilities, strange machinery, forgotten objects, and subtle changes in your surroundings gradually reveal more about the world as Luna explores it.

Key Features

- Top-down PvE shooting combat

- Exploration, looting, and inventory management

- Venture into dangerous areas and return safely to your base

- Peaceful everyday life between expeditions

- Cute, stylized 3D visuals

- A world that gradually reveals itself through exploration and environmental details

games.name: Unharvest
games.shortDescription: Drain the life from everything around you in this reverse-farming incremental game. Infect all that grows, upgrade your plagues, and wither the world until nothing living remains.
games.aboutText:
The soil has grown stagnant and weak. The harvest is long overdue. You've come to collect it.

Touch it and it dies.

Upgrade your plagues.

Spread faster, reach wider.

The land fades, and so does everything on it.

Features

- A beautiful, relaxing soundtrack and atmosphere

- Multiple unique environments to wither, beyond wheat fields

- Numerous plague upgrades for spreading, speed and reach

- A mysterious story told through the world around you

- A world that visibly and audibly changes as you play

games.name: Vortex Force
games.shortDescription: Control a growing force of heroes in this tactical RPG where retro-style combat meets modern, roguelike design. Jump to new alien worlds as you gather allies and resources to combat a mysterious threat to the galaxy!
games.aboutText:
Abominations burning with void energy are invading the realm, emerging through portals of unknown origin. A small force of heroes embark on a quest to extinguish this mysterious threat by gathering allies and resources from across the galaxy!

Welcome to Vortex Force, a tactical RPG combining retro-style combat with modern roguelike design. While the heroes begin the adventure in a traditional high fantasy setting, they continue through the portals to unpredictable worlds: a bizarre biome, a post-apocalyptic ruin, a remote asteroid mining operation...

Do you have what it takes to survive this quest into the unknown?

- Pick your starting force roster of four heroes

- Select a powerful relic that amplifies your force and can fundamentally change your strategy, and adapt your build as you acquire more relics from boss drops, secrets, and shops

- Choose between encounters to prioritize battle, loot, rest, or restocking supplies as you progress between fixed story beats

- Step through a portal to another world from a pool of fantasy, sci-fi, and horror settings each with their own stories, creatures, characters, and environmental mechanics

- Push yourself to reach challenging milestones that unlock characters and relics for future runs

- Master a nostalgic turn-based combat system with a grid-based battle map and head-to-head action sequences

- Outmaneuver your opponents on the complex terrain of obstacles, cover, hazards, and planetary effects

- Control up to eight characters in battle , leveraging their unique defenses, spells, and special attacks

- Protect your party leader or face annihilation!

- Recruit new heroes , enlist hirelings, and summon spawns to expand your force

- Level up your characters as they earn combat experience, increasing their base stats and unlocking new spells and special abilities

- Unlock powerful promotions for veteran heroes that fundamentally shift their class abilities

- Conserve your resources carefully, as hit points and mana are not restored between encounters, slowly wearing down your force

games.name: Eldritch Wildlife Tours
games.shortDescription: Eldritch Wildlife Tours is a cozy, Lovecraftian 2-player co-op / solo exploration and adventure game where one role charts a course to cosmic sea creatures based on collective sightings and takes promotional photos while the other safely steers a tour boat full of paying passengers.
games.aboutText:
OVERVIEW

Eldritch Wildlife Tours is a 2-player co-op (split screen-friendly) or solo adventure about running a sightseeing charter on a sea that does not want to be sightseen. A brother and sister have returned back to their home of Chesham-by-the-sea, Massachusetts to start this risky venture together. One of you takes the helm. The other takes the map and a camera. In solo mode, a player can swap between both roles at will.

Every run is a tour : cast off from the lighthouse, carry a boat full of paying passengers out into the dark, come back with photographs worth sharing on socials, and with still-living passengers. The payout funds the boat, the boat reaches further water, and the further water holds more formidable (but more lucrative) entities. Between voyages you admire your findings, improve your boat, and set out again.

It's a small game about a big ocean: two players, one boat, a stretch of coastal waters, and unknown terrors lurking beneath the waves.

THE CAPTAIN

The captain plays in an isometric view of the whole boat and the water around it . Throttle and rudder, a fuel tank that only burns while the engine is open, and a steerable spotlight that sheds light on the creatures of the deep... to improve photo quality, of course.

The helm is a constant risk-reward challenge. Passengers pay by the head and by how far out you dared to take them, but every creature strike knocks people over the rail and grinds down a hull that carries its damage between voyages. A worn hull boards fewer passengers, makes less speed and burns more fuel. Run aground, and it costs you all three.

The captain also owns the quiet half of the game: mooring at the dock to fish and hauling in the bottles that drift out in the open water.

THE PHOTOGRAPHER

The photographer plays in first person on the deck , and their work starts before the boat moves. Below in the cabin sits the abyssal survey terminal , which reads out every sonar contact as a size class and a grid square, along with a running sonar clock and any flotsam on the surface.

Up top they raise a hand-marked sea chart , inking squares safe or dangerous themselves, building a picture of a sea that shifts every tour, and pinging locations of interest.

Then there's the camera. A voyage's film roll is finite , and a photograph scores on how much of the creature you framed, how much of it the captain's spotlight actually revealed, and how close the boat dared to approach. Repeat shots of the same animal are worth steeply less; the money is in finding new things , not in parking next to one. There's also a bait pellet : one per voyage, dropped into the right grid square, raising a hidden being that is faster, meaner and worth considerably more.

FEATURES

- True 2-Player Co-op, Split Screen or Online — Share a couch on one screen or play online with each crewmate getting their own full screen role. Swap stations mid-voyage without leaving the run.

- Two Distinct Roles — The captain never sees the terminal; the photographer never touches the wheel. Neither of you has the whole picture, so be sure to communicate.

- Photos from the Deep — A finite film roll, scored on framing, lighting and nerve. The best shot you ever take of a creature becomes immortalized in the Compendium.

- Improve your Boat — Five upgrade tracks across engine, fuel, spotlight, passenger capacity and film. Roughly 25 purchases and three hours of voyages.

- Hull Damage That Follows You Home — Integrity persists between runs and costs you speed, range and paying customers until you pay the yard to fix it.

- Chart the Sea Yourself — Read contacts off the terminal, mark the grid by hand, and ping bearings to the helm. Nothing is revealed for you.

- Messages in a Bottle — 25 pieces of lore about this coast and its inhabitants, two or three drifting per voyage, out in the empty water between territories.

- Fishing from the Dock — A full cast-and-land minigame with 35 species across three difficulty bands.

- A Compendium Worth Filling — Three collections in one book: every fish landed, every message read, and every creature photographed, each illustrated by your own best photograph of it, credited to whoever took it.

games.name: Kiosco Simulator
games.shortDescription: Kiosco Simulator is a management sim where you run a 24-hour kiosco in Greater Buenos Aires, Argentina. Serve customers, manage stock, survive the night, and build your reputation as you earn money to upgrade your shop and expand your business.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the night shift, where every customer is an opportunity... or a problem.

Kiosco Simulator is a management sim where you work the night shift at a neighborhood kiosco in Greater Buenos Aires, Argentina, serving customers through a walk-up window.

Serve customers, manage stock, and build your reputation. Keeping the kiosco running means dealing with surprises and making decisions that can change the course of each shift, all while earning money to upgrade your shop and grow your business.

Manage your stock, buy products, and upgrade your shop to keep the business afloat.

Face the unexpected night after night, and keep an eye on the counter.

Get the water boiling, make hot dogs, and add condiments. Be quick. Some customers won’t wait long.

Key features

Progression and expansion. Start with a makeshift kiosco and build it up. Invest in upgrades, unlock new products, and become the neighborhood’s go-to shop.

Expect the unexpected on every shift. Be ready for power outages, heat waves, sporting events, and whatever else comes your way.

Change the walls and flooring, arrange products however you like, put stickers on your thermos, paint decorative pennants, and more.

games.name: Stonebloom
games.shortDescription: In a far future where people are gone, little dolls called Poppets wake with threads of life inside. Rebuild your body from parts others teach you, untangle worlds woven from memory, and bring sound and flowers back to a silent land, in an action adventure where your body is your instrument.
games.aboutText:
■ Your body is your instrument — and your weapon

Poppets are dolls made of 13 materials: wood, bamboo, paper, iron, rubber and more. Swap arms, legs, heads, wings and tails one by one, and both your fighting style and your sound change. Press a rubber belly: poof. Strike with an iron fist: clang.

■ Every room has a body that fits

Blades for soft foes, blows for brittle ones, binding for the heavy. A part you learned in one room becomes the key to the next. The order is yours to choose.

■ Worlds woven from memory

A summer festival frozen in time, the surface of the moon at one-sixth gravity, the flat pages of a picture book — worlds woven by fairy Puppeteers from memories of the people they lost. Each one changes a single law.

■ Your band writes your song

The music at every rest changes with the bodies in your band. Every sound comes from a body on screen.

■ Real places

The foot of Mt. Fuji, a misty castle, ruins in the sand — a textured world built from real terrain.

games.name: Third Bloc
games.shortDescription: A text-based political management sandbox set in the Cold War. Balance the budget, recruit experts, bargain with rival powers, answer telegrams, and drag a poor new republic into the space age. Or bury it in a nuclear one. All in animated ASCII.
games.aboutText:
A Small Republic Between Two Superpowers

It’s 1945. Your republic has little industry, few trained specialists and no international recognition. The United States and Soviet Union have rather more to work with.

Third Bloc is a text-based political sandbox about running that country through 45 years of the Cold War. Build an economy, set the laws and get hold of technology that nobody at home knows how to make. You’ll probably need foreign help at first. What you’re willing to accept in return is up to you.

With enough progress, you can challenge the superpowers in space, develop nuclear weapons or establish your own bloc. Moving the capital to Mars is also an option.

Launches, landings, weapons tests and failures play out in detailed animated ASCII.

Build the Republic

There’s a lot to build and room for one major national project each turn.

Your facilities supply electricity, materials, consumer goods and transport. Money comes from exports. Construction draws on your material stockpile; when that runs short, imports come out of the budget. A facility also needs trained staff, who may already be needed elsewhere.

The 42 facilities range from basic infrastructure to the foundations of your space and nuclear programs. What you build first determines how soon you can afford the rest.

Beyond the economy, you choose the republic’s laws and shape its regime. Prestige projects open further paths for the country, if you can spare the resources.

Send Agents Abroad

Other countries already have much of what you need. Your agents can help you get it.

Recruit named agents with individual stats and post them abroad. They keep working without new orders every turn, handling routine matters themselves and putting important findings in your dossier.

Those findings can lead to scientists, specialists, plans and technology. Some can be obtained openly; some have to be stolen. Several advanced facilities won’t become available until your agents find the right people or knowledge. After that, finding the money and materials is your problem.

Play Both Sides

Your first diplomatic problem is getting recognized. Foreign capitals send conditions, and an early decision determines who acknowledges your republic.

Washington and Moscow can offer aid, but their demands come with deadlines. Accept or refuse, knowing that support from one side can reduce what the other is prepared to give you.

Smaller states have their own interests and requests. As your prestige grows, they may become partners in a bloc of your own. You’ll need willing members and enough independence from both superpowers to make it happen.

Race Into Space

Develop a space program with 20 missions across Earth, the Moon, Mars, asteroids and Jupiter. Early probes and flights lead to landings, crewed missions and eventually a colony.

The Americans and Soviets keep advancing while you prepare. Whether you can afford to chase them is another matter: a launch uses money and a turn that could have gone toward something the country needs at home.

On Mars, you can keep building after the colony is established. Complete its three further developments and you can move the capital there, with an ending that lets the republic’s future continue beyond Earth.

Build the Bomb

Develop nuclear weapons through research, construction and testing, then build the means to deliver them. Foreign governments take an increasing interest as your program advances.

The six-stage program eventually reaches a continental shelter. Along the way, you’ll face the changing conditions of the Cold War, from the Cuban Missile Crisis to test bans and arms-control agreements.

You can select targets and issue a nuclear order once your arsenal is ready. What follows is a war story, without a combat minigame. There are six possible nuclear endings, including survival in a shelter or the continuation of a colony on Mars.

Your Decisions Come Back

The State Telegraph Office receives letters from 312 named people. Scientists ask for support, defectors seek asylum, and foreign contacts bring demands and opportunities.

Your replies affect later correspondence. A choice may prompt someone else to write several turns later; other people approach you because of your record. The connection won’t always be immediate.

There are 936 decision letters across the campaign. As they accumulate, the telegraph office keeps a dated history of who asked you for what, how you answered and what followed.

45 Years in 90 Turns

Reach 1990 and receive a final account of your republic, from its industry and alliances to its achievements in space. A peaceful future on Mars is possible. So are bankruptcy and a nuclear war that ends the campaign with a very different story.

- 90 turns, from 1945 to 1990

- 42 facilities and an economy based on production, exports and material supplies

- Laws, regimes and prestige projects

- 20 space missions across five destinations

- A Mars colony that can become your capital

games.name: Chief? About That File...
games.shortDescription: Step into an atmospheric 1990s police archive. Inspect, classify, and organize 3,360 unique criminal dossiers, crack safes, and uncover crime syndicates in this immersive first-person archival detective simulator.
games.aboutText:
WELCOME TO THE ARCHIVE, DETECTIVE

The year is 1995. Behind the heavy reinforced doors of the central precinct lies decades of unsolved crimes, forgotten evidence, and chaotic stacks of confidential files.

As the precinct's new archival investigator, your duty is to restore absolute order to its records—and uncover the secrets hidden between the lines.

KEY FEATURES

- Process 3,360 Unique Criminal Dossiers: Inspect detailed police files, identify each crime category, assess its severity, determine its public notoriety level, and place every case in its designated location.

- Experience a 1990s Police Archive: Explore a fully interactive 3D precinct filled with CRT terminals, fluorescent-lit archive aisles, metal filing cabinets, and satisfying retro soundscapes.

- Crack Safes & Discover Hidden Compartments: Decode combination locks, find forgotten keys, and unlock classified evidence compartments tucked deep within the archive.

- Uncover Crime Syndicates & Group Crimes: Piece together cases involving organized groups, match gang members to their ringleaders using visual markers and color-coded clues, and discover hidden details in special dossiers.

- Play at Your Own Pace: Enjoy a satisfying organizing experience without stressful time limits, combat, or failure states.

BRING ORDER TO THE CHAOS

Grab your keys, power on the archive terminal, and begin sorting through the precinct's forgotten cases.

Every file has a place. Some files have a story.

games.name: Outblight
games.shortDescription: "Nothing down there is what the stories say." A turn-based clash roguelite where you operate skills against the enemy's in queue and manipulate of it's order. Between of catastrophe of the dying world, there lives Kirs, who is looking for creatures of the abyss in order to survive
games.aboutText:
Core Features

- Clash-combat battle system which is inspired by Library of Ruina and Limbus Company

- Turn-based combat with different archetypes builds and combinations between

- Hand-drawn artwork in a painterly style in dark fantasy setting

- Juicy battle animations and stylish finishers

- Ultimates with its own cutscenes

- A touching story about Kirs and other characters she will meet along the way

- Narrative progression of minor characters

- Multiple main story endings

- Separate Boss fights between runs to progress the main story

- Challenging "Endless mode" with in-game rewards and other features

- Steam Workshop integration

Story

The world is on the brink of falling into the abyss. The chains that have held it together for centuries are beginning to crumble, and Abyss Holes are appearing across the world. From them, terrifying creatures emerge, destroying everything in their path. The Order, an organization created by an alliance of royal houses, was created to combat the looming threat.

games.name: Bio Inc. Total Defense
games.shortDescription: Bio Inc. Total Defense is an incremental tower defense game set inside your body. Command your immune system against massive hordes of viruses, bacteria, and other pathogens. Upgrade your defenses, place them wisely, and fight for every inch of your body.
games.aboutText:
Your body is the map. Defend it.

Bio Inc. Total Defense is an incremental tower defense game inside the human body. No waves, no breaks. Pathogens pour in from every entrance as soon as a stage starts. Place your defenses in the vessels, protect your organs, and try to keep up.

Start with hundreds of enemies in a capillary. Work your way up to over a hundred thousand across the whole body.

Build your immune system

Eleven defenses to unlock and upgrade. White blood cells and macrophages hunt down invaders. Tissue walls and mucus slow the spread. Fever blasts, acid glands, and antibody cannons handle the rest.

Placement matters. So does knowing when to use septic shock.

Every run makes you stronger

Spend Bio Points on over 150 upgrade nodes for damage, range, defense count, and new behaviors. Earn Research Points by winning to unlock more defenses.

Another 75 health factors let you tune your build with extra ability charges, stronger immunity, crowd control, and perks like Chain Reaction and Last Stand.

games.name: Because It's There
games.shortDescription: An engineering/survival game where you summit the tallest mountain in a vast, uncharted world. For the journey, carefully construct flying wooden bases with realistic structural failures. Brave thunderstorms, freezing temperatures, bears and wolves. Answer the call of the untamed wilderness.
games.aboutText:
Dangerous land, dangerous skies

- Treacherous storms and high winds can tear your craft apart, and when you land, deadly wildlife smells the food you carry. Getting to the summit is a matter of avoiding and overcoming weather systems with well-designed craft, and avoiding or overcoming predators.

Build with real engineering

- To build a cabin or flying vessel in Because It's There , you first build its log frame. These structural frames are evaluated using a physics engine that rewards smart bracing, weight management, and load distribution.

- Craft that are built well can withstand the elements and carry the resources (food, water, fuel, etc.) needed for a summit push. Poorly designed craft may suffer partial or catastrophic structural failures in high winds or hard landings, or may not be efficient enough to give you distance or altitude when you need it.

Realistic, country-sized worlds

- Each world can be up to 60,000 square kilometers, which is larger than Croatia or Costa Rica.

- Worlds are procedurally generated using a variety of sophisticated techniques that produce realistic mountains, river networks, climate simulations, and moisture simulations. Ecosystems and weather patterns are emergent from these simulations, creating worlds that feel real in a way rarely achieved by procedural generation.

- Ecosystems vary depending on local conditions, and dozens of plant species, birds, fish, and mammals of many shapes and sizes can be found in different biomes.

games.name: MAR: Millions Are Rising
games.shortDescription: Millions of monsters are escaping the hole. Stop them with a unique arsenal of towers, nukes, and deep upgrades in this incremental tower defense game.
games.aboutText:
An incremental tower defense game about destroying millions of creatures trying to escape a hole. Unlock dozens of towers and new mechanics to clear out these monsters.

- Massive Skill Tree: No filler nodes, every upgrade completely empowers you.

- Aerial Skills: Unlock powerful abilities to unleash upon the creatures, including missiles, airstrikes, and even nukes.

- Towers: A massive variety of towers to choose from to build your arsenal around.

- Loot: Rarely, these creatures drop unique loot to further improve your defenses.

- Base Building: Discover new buildings and completely transform how the game is played.

- And TONS of content!

games.name: Aldmark Calls for Aid
games.shortDescription: A medieval siege-defence strategy game where a rival crown comes for your city. Command your troops on the walls and in the field, and between rounds light beacons to choose which allies will march to your aid. Win or lose, every battle earns renown to make Aldmark stronger.
games.aboutText:
Aldmark Calls for Aid is a medieval siege-defence game with no base-building and no resource management. Command your troops directly, and between rounds choose where to light the beacons that call allies to your aid. Every battle earns renown, win or lose, to spend on unlocking and upgrading troops, enhancing your realm, strengthening your defences, and more. Maps are procedurally generated, each level bigger than the last, and victory doesn't have to be the end: keep fighting and see how long you can withstand the siege of Aldmark.

- Command: manoeuvre your troops around the battlefield, man the walls to prevent the enemy reaching the city, and protect your supply lines to ensure that the city doesn't starve.

- Survive: the enemy will bring battering rams to break through your gate, ladders to scale your walls, and catapults to destroy them.

- Scout: preview the lands around Aldmark to see what allies you can call on before committing to placing a beacon.

- Light: place and light the beacon to call upon your allies. The further away they are, the longer they take to reach you.

- Renown: win or lose, every battle earns renown which is spent on perks in the Muster.

- Muster: spend renown to upgrade your soldiers, unlock new troops, build fortifications, recruit mercenary companies, and more.

- Map: switch the battlefield from the default colour mode to a sepia style that mimics a parchment campaign map look. The same can be done for soldiers or you can mix and match.

- Soldiers: change the colours of soldiers or even turn them into shapes. These options can be helpful for visibility or just for a more abstract play style.

- Monarchs: create up to 3 profiles which keep track of your progress; your current siege, level unlocks, renown, and muster perks.

- Edicts: choose how you want to play; disable gore, adjust the size of the HUD interface, change key bindings, and more.

games.name: Get Stronger! Auto‑Chess
games.shortDescription: This is an auto-chess game. By combining units' skills, passive abilities, and synergies, units can grow infinitely stronger.
games.aboutText:
This is an auto-chess game. By combining units' skills, passive abilities, and synergies, units can grow infinitely stronger.

Each unit has 1 passive skill and 2 active skills. The passive skills and synergy effects of different characters form skill trigger chains, creating a 1+1>2 effect. The game also features various equipment and food items that can trigger various effects and synergize with units' passive skills and synergies.

The game has Normal Mode and Roguelike Mode. In Normal Mode, you purchase units from the shop; in Roguelike Mode, you choose 1 unit out of 3. After each clear, you can continue to challenge Endless Mode, facing increasingly stronger enemies. See how many waves you can survive.

games.name: CRUMB Advanced
games.shortDescription: The follow-up to the hit circuit simulator. Build anything from an LED to an 8-bit CPU, code microcontrollers, play guitar live through your circuits and drive robot arms with real physics. Make any part in the component editor and share it on Steam Workshop. If you can build it, CRUMB can run it.
games.aboutText:
The follow-up to the hugely popular CRUMB Circuit Simulator, loved by over 100,000 makers, students and engineers.

CRUMB Advanced sets a new benchmark for circuit simulation. Wire up real components, write code for real microcontrollers, play live audio through your circuits and watch motors, gears and robot arms move under real physics. Design it here, then build it for real on your bench.

Start with a single LED and work all the way up to a full 8-bit computer. Wire parts straight to each other, lay them out on a breadboard or solder them onto perfboard. Every chip, wire and resistor is simulated as a real electrical part, so your circuit behaves the way it would on your desk.

- Megahertz-level analog simulation for fast, accurate circuits

- Time-stepped electro-physical simulation that keeps electrical and mechanical behaviour in step

- Built to scale , from a handful of parts to an 8-bit CPU

Write code in the built-in IDE, flash it to a microcontroller and watch it run on the virtual hardware, with a library of boards that keeps growing. And yes, it runs DOOM.

- Full microcontroller emulation with displays, sensors, SPI and I2C

- Built-in IDE for C# and C++ with code completion and hints

- Real-world projects such as RFID readers, LCD readouts and sensor dashboards

RGB LED matrices, TFT and OLED screens, LCDs and LEDs light up with realistic glow and colour, so your builds look as good as they run. Want something special? Write your own shaders for custom materials.

Motors, servos, gears and linkages are real physical bodies driven by your circuit. Build a robot arm, a robot car or a geared mechanism and watch it come to life.

- Deterministic physics , so the same circuit gives the same result every time

- Real gear trains, cranks and linkages , not scripted animation

Plug in a guitar, a microphone or any audio source and run it through circuits you built yourself. Design a fuzz pedal, tune a valve amp and hear every change in real time.

Drop your sensors into an interactive environment, move the light source and watch your sun tracker lock on. Change the conditions around your circuit and see exactly how your design responds.

See exactly what your circuit is doing. Probe any point with the oscilloscope, multimeter and FFT analyser, and switch between voltage, current and logic views at a glance.

- Oscilloscope, multimeter and FFT analysis built in

- Voltage, current and logic views that show your circuit working

- Perfboards and soldering for permanent builds

Missing a part? Make it. The built-in component editor lets you build, script and shade your own components, with hot reloading so every edit appears instantly. Share your parts on Steam Workshop and tap into a growing worldwide library.

- Every component has its own unique ID , so shared designs pull in the parts they need from the Workshop automatically

- Parts that aren't on the Workshop travel inside the save file

Every circuit you build in CRUMB is a digital twin of the real thing. Design and test it in the sim, build the same circuit on your bench and run the same code on both. Plug a real microcontroller straight into CRUMB to program it, and go from idea to working prototype without switching tools.

Guided challenges take you from your first circuit to advanced builds, earning Steam Achievements along the way. Open any example build to see how it works, then make it your own.

CRUMB Advanced is coming to Windows, macOS and Linux. Wishlist now and start building on day one.

games.name: Worst Class Ever
games.shortDescription: 1 Teacher vs 7 Students. Hide. Prank. Survive. Up to 8-player asymmetric party chaos! Mischievous students blend into dozens of NPC classmates, secretly snacking, texting, and causing trouble, while the teacher must spot these wannabe delinquents and restore complete order to the classroom.
games.aboutText:
Worst Class Ever is an asymmetric party game set in a chaotic classroom, supporting up to 8 players! One player takes on the role of the strict teacher, while the other seven play as mischievous students. The troublemakers must blend in among dozens of NPC classmates and secretly pull off pranks like gobbling snacks, passing notes, and playing on their phones... all without getting caught! The teacher, armed with sharp eyes and a no-nonsense attitude, has to spot every last wannabe delinquent hiding in the crowd and restore perfect order to the classroom.

What if everyday school life turned into pure classroom chaos? Play as a mischievous student, gobbling snacks in secret and pulling pranks right under the teacher's watchful nose. Or take on the role of the strict teacher, activate sharp-eyed detection mode, and hunt down every last troublemaker hiding in the crowd. Every match is a ridiculous, high-energy showdown between teacher and students.

Step into the shoes of a natural-born troublemaker. Blend in, evade the teacher's attention, and go wild the second they turn their back. Your mission? Prank until there's no tomorrow and create pure classroom chaos. Be bold and do your worst... but above all, don't get caught. That constant tension mixed with the pure satisfaction of a successful prank? Nothing hits quite like it.

"You're the worst class I've ever taught!" Step into the role of the strict teacher. Use your sharp observation skills to catch every tiny slip: forced movements, panicked glances, or anything that feels off. Nothing escapes your eagle eyes. Identify the mischief makers, shut down their pranks, and restore absolute order. There's nothing quite like the feeling of singling the little troublemakers out.

Bright daytime classrooms, late-night study halls, computer labs packed with screens… Multiple maps rotate in, each with its own unique hideouts, exclusive prank tasks, and interactive mechanics. Every classroom brings fresh hiding strategies and brand-new ways to cause trouble. Different settings mean constantly changing matches so that no two games ever feel the same.

Smoke bombs, tranquilizer guns, drones… A whole arsenal of wild and creative items that take the pranks and counterplay to the next level! Mischievous students can unlock all kinds of chaotic tools to quietly set traps, create mayhem, and mess with the teacher's vision... anything to evade detection. Teachers get their own exclusive items to quickly lock onto students in hiding, see through disguises, and uncover every trick. Mix and match freely for flexible, ever-changing gameplay, or switch on random combinations for nonstop hilarious moments that'll have you in stitches!

games.name: The Extractors
games.shortDescription: A co-op horror experience where you and your team explore dangerous environments, collect valuable items, and fight to survive. Work together, take risks, and make it back before it’s too late.
games.aboutText:
The Extractors is a co-op horror game set between a Bazaar in space and dangerous locations on Earth. Team up with your crew, travel to hostile areas, collect valuable loot, hunt terrifying creatures, and escape before time runs out.

Return to the Bazaar, sell what you recovered, upgrade your equipment, and prepare for your next expedition. Every trip brings new risks, rewards, and unexpected encounters.

Explore dangerous locations with your crew

- Collect valuable loot and extract in time

- Hunt and survive deadly creatures

- Sell your haul and upgrade your gear

- Play solo or in online co-op

THE CREW NOTEBOOK

Everything you need to survive is written in the ship's notebook: the rules, the creatures, the Bazaar and the Arena. Read it before you land... or learn the hard way.

FRIENDSHIP HAS ITS LIMITS

Your hands are empty and your friend is standing right at the edge. One push is all it takes. Co-op has never been this dangerous.

A FOUR-PERSON CREW

Up to 4 players, one ship, one quota. Gear up together, stand together, and try to come back together.

DOWNTIME AT THE BAZAAR

Between missions the Bazaar is yours: trade your loot, buy new gear and shoot some hoops with your crew under an alien sky.

LOOK UP
