Some things wait on the ceiling. If you hear something above you in a quiet corridor, it is already too late.

games.name: Just Weeding
games.shortDescription: Pull 100,000 weeds! Zone out solo or chill and chat with up to 6 players in this endless weeding sim. Feed your goat to earn cash and unlock better weeding gear!
games.aboutText:
Just pull weeds. Clear all 100,000 weeds growing across the vast area.

🌱 Weeding

Just mindlessly pull the weeds in front of you. Forget the hustle and bustle of daily life and lose yourself in the act of weeding.

💰 Sell

Turn the weeds you collect into cash.

🛠️ Buy

Buy tools to boost your efficiency.

🤝 With Friends

Pull weeds with your friends, exactly however you like.

games.name: School Girl RPG
games.shortDescription: Mio was just an ordinary schoolgirl until an accident on her commute transported her to another world. There, she is hailed as the chosen Hero! To find a way back home, she must fulfill her heroic destiny. She must defeat the Demon Emperor and her wicked subordinates who plot to conquer the realm!
games.aboutText:
【Story】

Mio was just an ordinary schoolgirl until an accident on her commute transported her to another world.

There, she is hailed as the chosen Hero! To find a way back home, she must fulfill her heroic destiny. She must defeat the Demon Emperor and her wicked subordinates who plot to conquer the realm!

【Game Introduction】

This is a classic Japanese-style RPG.

Players will explore a vast world, engage various enemies in turn-based battles.

As the adventure progresses, players will face increasingly powerful enemies, gradually making their way toward the Demon Emperor's lair.

【Characters】

Protagonist: Mio

An ordinary schoolgirl attending an all-girls academy.

Just as she was feeling anxious about her mundane daily life and uncertain future, she gets swept up in an accident and transported to another world. Little does she know what kind of trials await her there...

Marian the Magician

Living on the outskirts of town to avoid prying eyes.

Sera the Priestess

A young girl who prayed for the Hero's arrival to save this world from crisis.

games.name: Winds of Viridia
games.shortDescription: Explore the valley of the towering Grantree, battle grand beasts, and find out what’s driving the creatures in these forgotten lands mad. Discover secrets, make new friends, and find powerful lost relics. Take on fearsome bosses, and uncover the truth of the wild frenzy.
games.aboutText:
Explore the Wild Unknown

Explore the valley of the towering Grantree, battle grand beasts, and find out what’s driving the creatures in these forgotten lands mad. Discover secrets, make new friends, and find powerful lost relics. Face down fearsome bosses, and uncover the truth of the wild frenzy.

Features

- Explore a wild, handcrafted world - Discover mountain glades, hidden grottos and vast ancient ruins as you adventure toward the mysterious Grantree.

- Move fast and free - Roll, slide, flip and grapple through the seamless world in style. Learn about strange plants that can help you jump higher, launch further and explore deeper.

- Fight frenzied beasts - Face dozens of unique creatures affected by the frenzy in fast, agile combat.

- Meet new friends - Befriend a companion Mothbug to assist in exploration and combat. Help the residents of Sanctuary and join them for a meal, and find bolder explorers deeper into the wilds.

- Challenge grand bosses - Battle gigantic beasts, living statues, and great guardians of the past.

- Equip powerful totems - Find lost relics and treasures to use as totems. Combine them to customize your playstyle.

- Hear the call of the wild - Experience a sweeping orchestral score from legendary composers Kevin Penkin and Christopher Larkin.

games.name: Noroi Ayashi: The ∞th Oddity
games.shortDescription: "Noroi Ayashi: The ∞th Oddity" is a Time-loop horror RTA stealth action adventure Game, Seira steps into the school at midnight to which seven mysteries and the brutal curse of the cursed doll, Aya await her there, Break free from this inescapable loop of death and escape this night of terror.
games.aboutText:
If this urban legend is true, someone must step forward to put a stop to it.

But I am just an ordinary sixth-former; I simply do not possess that sort of power.

So, in order to confirm whether this urban legend is true or false, I tried cursing myself using several different rituals.

Regrettably, I cannot be certain which ritual was the correct one, but the night before last, Aya appeared in my dream.

If I, too, meet a mysterious death tonight, it will mean that the urban legend of the ‘Cursed Doll Aya’ is indeed true.

When that time comes…

When that time comes, I beg you—whoever you may be.

Please unravel the mystery of this urban legend.

13 July 20XX (Fri) Yuriko

We—the U High School News Club—who received this diary from her bereaved family, have decided to investigate the urban legend of the ‘Cursed Doll Aya’ in order to honour our dear friend’s final wishes.

■Character Profiles

【Seira】

The heroine of this story. A member of the U High School Journalism Club.

Following the mysterious death of a close friend, she sets out to uncover the truth alongside her fellow club members.

However, she soon becomes separated from her friends and finds herself alone in the school building late at night.

【Hime】

A member of the U High School Journalism Club.

A headstrong and wayward young woman who marches to the beat of her own drum.

Rumours circulate around the school that she is involved in compensated dating.

【Tae】

A member of the U High School Journalism Club.

The club president, who possesses an insatiable thirst for knowledge.

She is usually a model student with a perpetual smile, but deep down…

Exploration and Sealing the Mysteries

Each of the Seven Mysteries lurking within the school has its own unique method of avoidance and sealing procedure.
Crawl through the pitch-black school and scour every nook and cranny for clues to help you survive.

The Fastest Way to Survival: Making Death as Your Fuel

Surviving in your first encounter is virtually impossible.
Learn from the relentless ‘deaths’ you suffer again and again, and develop a strategy that strips away all unnecessary action.
Armed with knowledge, charge along the shortest route and break the endless cycle of death.

Development Team

< Rensuke Oshikir >

His coming-of-age "boy meets girl" manga "Hi Score Girl", set in the arcade scene of the 1990s, became a massive hit and was adapted into an anime.

He has created numerous horror manga, including "LiverLeaf" and "Sayuri", many of which have been adapted for film and television.

He pioneered a refreshingly new style of horror-comedy manga characterised by ‘beating the hell out of monsters’; at the same time, he has explored a wide range of genres, from traditional horror and psychological horror to grotesque suspense, establishing himself as a manga artist well-versed in all forms of ‘horror’.

<Sohei Niikawa / Roman Kitayama>

He previously worked at Nippon Ichi Software, where he contributed to the company’s flagship titles such as "Rhapsody: A Musical Adventure", "Disgaea" and "Hayarigami: Keishichō Kaii Jiken File". He went independent in 2022.

He made his debut under the pen name ‘Roman Kitayama’ with the novel "Etrange Overlord".

Since then, he has been involved in the creation of numerous works, including "DEMONS' NIGHT FEVER", "Magic Scavenger" and "Super Floppins", and is a creator who combines the roles of novelist, screenwriter and content producer.

games.name: Cash & Stash: A Vaultkeeper Story
games.shortDescription: After a failed robbery attempt, the bank has been torn apart and left in complete chaos. Now, as the Vaultkeeper, you must sort through more than 16,000 scattered items, return everything to its proper place, and uncover the stories behind the bank’s clients and their valuables.
games.aboutText:
RESTORE THE VAULT

You are the keeper of a vast bank vault left in complete disarray after a heist.

More than 16,000 bundles of cash, bars, documents, and other valuables are scattered throughout the vault. Clear the clutter, identify every item you find, return it to its proper place, and gradually restore order to the entire vault.

EVERY VALUABLE HAS A STORY

This is not just a vault for money–it is a vault of stories.

Alongside the bank's reserves of currency, gold, and silver, it holds clients' personal savings. Every safe-deposit box belongs to a specific character, and their case file tells a small story about where their money came from and what they were saving it for.

Collect scattered client dossiers, track down the valuables that belong to them, and restore their safe-deposit boxes. Find them all to discover the stories behind their owners!

FIND RARE AND UNIQUE ITEMS

Rare discoveries are hidden among thousands of ordinary bundles and valuables.

Look for collectible banknote variants and other one-of-a-kind pieces. Examine them and gradually build your own collection as you explore the vault.

GROW ALONGSIDE THE VAULT

The farther you progress, the more capable the keeper becomes.

Unlock new equipment, tools, and abilities to help you locate important items, navigate thousands of valuables faster, and sort the vault's contents more efficiently.

Begin with overwhelming chaos – and finish with a fully restored vault, where every bundle, every bar, and every personal story is back in its rightful place.

games.name: Zombies Aren't Real
games.shortDescription: Zombies Aren't Real is a horde-defense, strategy game where you deploy military forces in an attempt to quell a quick-spreading zombie infection and save as many civilians as you can!
games.aboutText:
Zombies Aren't Real is a horde-defense, strategy game where you attempt to control a quick-spreading zombie infection in real-world cities by commanding military forces.

You're given a bird's eye view of a city and time to prepare for the outbreak. With limited resources, carefully choose how you will respond to the infection and establish a plan to save as many civilians as possible.

Once you're ready the chaos begins. The zombies will fan out and begin to infect the population. You are able to adapt your plan on the fly. If the zombies break through your perimeter you can call in air support such as bombers or gatling gun helicopters to attempt to stop the spread before it gets out of control.

If you're able to eliminate all the zombies you win and your score is determined by how many civilians you saved.

Features

- Play in real-world cities

- Deploy specialized ground forces against the spreading horde, such as snipers, turrets, mortar squads and garrisons

- Call in air strikes when things get out of hand, but be careful to aim them well to minimize civilian casualties

- Place safe zones, gates, and more to protect the civilian population

- Steam Workshop support for custom maps

- Play with one other friend in Online Co-op Multiplayer

Multiplayer (2-player online)

Invite a friend to survive the horde with you! In co-op, players split their resources, plan defenses side by side, and call in battle abilities in real time to quell the horde. Each player owns their own budget and buildings, but victory depends on working together.

Is "Zombies Aren't Real" for you?

"Zombies Aren't Real" is highly strategic and winning will push you to think cleverly and experiment with different combinations of units, buildings and upgrades. It is not an incremental game. Losing is fun! We encourage you to retry often, restarting a scenario once defeat is inevitable to adjust your strategy. The fun is in figuring out how to best defend the city!

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, Overture Maps Foundation, TomTom, Microsoft (Open Database License, Esri Community Maps contributors, Google Open Buildings, work derived from BTN 2024 ign.es (CC BY 4.0, postal codes: GeoNames (CC BY 4.0).

games.name: 687 Days on Mars - First Steps
games.shortDescription: Take your first steps on Mars and face the challenge of surviving alone on the Red Planet. Build your first shelter, secure vital resources, grow food, research new technologies, and explore the hostile Martian landscape. Your survival starts here.
games.aboutText:
687 Days on Mars: First Steps is an introduction to real survival on Mars, where you’ll take your first steps on the Red Planet, establish a shelter, and learn how to survive in its hostile environment.

Featuring:

- Approximately 30 minutes of gameplay

- Building a shelter from scratch

- Producing energy, oxygen, and water

- Extracting iron and copper regolith

- Crafting basic building materials

- Researching the first technologies

- Growing potatoes and lettuce

- Crafting your first meals on Mars

- Exploring Mars by vehicle

- Save system

Manage your oxygen, water, and food supplies while keeping radiation and energy levels under control. Prepare for dust storms and solar storms that can damage equipment and make even a short trip outside the base dangerous.

Build a shelter and gradually transform it into a self-sufficient Martian base. Construct solar panels, storage units, oxygen generators, and water extractors to secure essential resources. Every upgrade increases your chances of survival.

Use drones to mine Martian regolith, build mines, and process resources into components needed to construct new buildings. Use automated transport drones to manage resources throughout your base.

Conduct research and unlock new technologies, from extracting water from underground ice deposits and producing fertilizers to advanced radar and weather systems. Every new technology opens up new possibilities.

Grow crops such as potatoes and tomatoes. Using aeroponic methods, you can cultivate plants without soil and overcome the challenges of Mars. Improve your crops with proper lighting and fertilizers.

Leave the safety of your base and explore the vast surface of Mars. Search for supply drops previously sent from Earth and resource deposits needed for further development. Every expedition can bring valuable resources, new technologies, and more answers.

games.name: Dangerous Delivery
games.shortDescription: As summer vacation is almost over, schoolgirl Rina still has one final assignment left: part-time job experience. Not knowing where to look, she spots a delivery job ad that says “No age limit, flexible hours!” So Rina decides to start her delivery work…!
games.aboutText:
⏹︎ Summer Homework!?

As summer vacation is almost over, schoolgirl Rina still has one final assignment left: part-time job experience.

Not knowing where to look, she spots a delivery job ad that says “No age limit, flexible hours!”

So Rina decides to start her delivery work…!

⏹︎ Check Your Gear

Before heading out, equip all kinds of helpful items to make your deliveries go smoother than ever.

⏹︎ Dangerous Enemies on the Route!

Along the way you’ll pass through quiet, empty areas where enemies are waiting.

Dodge these enemies and get the order safely to the customer!

When a enemy grabs you, it’s time for a desperate escape struggle!

Press at the perfect moment to shove them away with all your strength!

⏹︎ Features

- A level-based RPG centered around delivery missions

- 4 Stages

- Navigate stages with different types of terrain

- Encounter various enemies and obstacles

games.name: A Place for Every Potion
games.shortDescription: A cozy potion-sorting puzzle game. Pour scrambled liquids until every bottle runs pure, then shelve each one where it belongs. Fill 4,160 potions across 52 shelves. No timers, no fail state, no rush.
games.aboutText:
Your grandfather's new auto-sorting spell backfired.

Every potion in the apothecary tipped off its shelf. Every finished potion unravelled back into raw essence, and the loose colors pooled together in one enormous pile in the middle of the lab.

He chuckled. "Ah, it does that sometimes." Then he pulled on his coat for the annual Alchemists Gathering and asked you to mind the place while he is away.

He'll be gone about a month. There is no rush at all.

Two puzzles

Every potion needs two things done to it.

Decant. Pour the scrambled liquids from bottle to bottle until each one holds a single pure color. If you have ever played a water-sort puzzle, your hands already know this part.

Shelve. Carry the finished potion across the lab to the shelf it belongs on. Color gets you to the right wall. The sigil on its label picks the exact shelf.

You can only levitate a few bottles at a time, so the two puzzles compete for the same hands. Pour greedily and you have nothing free to carry with. Carry too much and you have nothing free to pour into. Deciding what to hold is the game.

One laboratory. 4,160 potions.

A gothic stone rotunda, two floors, tall arched windows and warm afternoon light. 52 shelved sections across thirteen families of potion.

Every one of the 4,160 potions is in that pile from the moment you start. Nothing respawns, nothing refills, nothing quietly re-stirs itself behind your back. The mess only ever gets smaller.

The room is the progress bar. The floor clears. The shelves fill and light up. A dark, dusty laboratory slowly becomes a glowing apothecary.

Relaxing is the whole point

No timers. No pressure. No penalties. No fail state. There is nothing here you can lose.

Warm window light, a quiet score, and the sound of glass and liquid. Put a potion on the wrong shelf and nothing scolds you. No buzzer, no shake, nothing taken away. Set a bottle down mid-pour, walk off, and come back next week to exactly where you left it.

Skills make the work easier. They never make it disappear.

Sorting earns XP, XP earns levels, and every level buys a skill point. There are 47 of them, across a board of 24 nodes.

A wider hand. A longer reach. Deeper buffers to work into, and sight that pulls a workable set out of the pile.

What none of them do is play for you. Nothing pours, carries or shelves on your behalf, and nothing sits on a cooldown. You get better tools and a bigger workspace. The satisfying part stays yours.

Three numbers, counted all the way down

52 sections. 364 shelf rows. 4,160 potions.

The game keeps all three counters and you can switch them on or off. No hidden progress and no rounding. Every potion you finish and shelve moves a number you can watch.

The lab is done when the pile is gone and all 52 cabinets are full. A finite game with a real ending, not a loop that farms you.

Features

- Two interlocking puzzles: water-sort decanting and tidy-up shelving

- 4,160 potions across 52 sections and 364 shelf rows, in one continuous laboratory of 2 floors

- No fail state, no timers, no penalties

- A 24-node skill board that hands you better tools and never plays for you

- Full input rebinding, an FOV slider, and a HUD you can switch off

- Autosaves after every pour and every placement

- Unlike the free mobile versions of this genre: buy it once. No ads, no energy timers, no shop, no dark patterns.

games.name: Archechord
games.shortDescription: Tap out rhythm patterns on the beat, unleashing skills to break through the swarm. In this rhythm roguelite, experience a musical journey through each character's inner world.
games.aboutText:
Your Beat Is Your Firepower

Only a single attack button is needed. You don't have to aim manually, just hit the beats on time. Tapping out different rhythm patterns triggers distinct skills; the harder the rhythm, the stronger the skill. As long as you stay on beat, your skills automatically track targets.

Build Momentum & Strike Back

Every rhythm pattern you land builds up Flow Energy. Once full, you can activate Flow at any time. During Flow, the surrounding swarm slows to a near standstill, and every skill you play is saved up and released all at once on the beat when Flow ends.

Ride the Ebb and Flow of the Music

When the swarm surges in and when it pulls back to give you a breather all follow the phrasing of the music.

games.name: One Last Fish
games.shortDescription: A cozy fishing idle game that sits anywhere on your desktop. Catch rare fish, buy upgrades and customize your island while you study, work or relax!
games.aboutText:
A cozy fishing idler that lives right on your desktop.

Meet Pops, a lonely old fisherman who'll happily cast a line while you work, study, or just chilling. Inspired by Ropuka's Idle Island and Cornerpond.

Catch, sell, upgrade!

- Reel in all kinds of fish and strange sea creatures, including rare ones

- Sell your haul and buy better tools

- Customize your island to your liking

Your co-working buddy

Resize Pops' little world to any size and place it anywhere on your screen. It stays out of your way and keeps you company while you get things done.

Lofi Soundtrack

Enjoy custom-made lofi tracks to set the mood, or turn the music off and enjoy the quiet while you focus on your work.

games.name: Engagement
games.shortDescription: Command a capital ship alone or up to 4 players co-op and hold the Belt of Ashes against the Hollow and more until relief arrives. Every upgrade is a turret bolted to a hardpoint you can see, your escorts you recruit keep their names and kills, and every fight has variety to make it new.
games.aboutText:
RELIEF IS FIFTEEN MINUTES OUT. THE HOLLOW ARE ALREADY HERE.

Command solo or bring friends, with up to four flagships deploying at once. Play a single run or an entire campaign together over Steam. Pick your own flagships, builds, and doctrines, then cover each other's weaknesses against the horde. Have a bigger crew? Extra players can join your ship to man weapons and stations.

As a flagship, you never fight alone. Recruit escort ships, issue orders, and promote the survivors. Once they earn enough rank, you can fuse compatible hulls into new classes of ships, or group three seasoned escorts into specialized wings. When an escort goes down, rescue its ejected pilot pod before it's too late, or add their callsign, rank, and kills to your memorial wall.

Face down the Hollow, a swarming threat that escalates its attacks the longer you survive. Rival factions like the Goblites, Alves, and Custodians can crash the battle at any moment, injecting fresh chaos into every run. From incoming beams to torpedoes and boarding craft, every threat is telegraphed, giving you the time you need to respond.

React, adapt, and overcome!

NO "+8% DAMAGE" CARDS

BUILD YOUR SHIP IN REAL TIME

Everything you destroy drops salvage. Spend it to upgrade your systems and bolt new hardware directly onto your ship's hardpointst, from flak batteries and rail cannons to tesla coils, drone hangars, and more! Every module is physically mounted on your hull, actively tracking targets, firing, and defending your ship as you command the fight. As a run progresses, your flagship visibly transforms into a custom warship built for your playstyle. And when the going gets tough, each flagship has an Ultimate ability you can use to turn the tide.

THE FIELD KEEPS CHANGING

Between the bosses, the fight keeps throwing new problems at you. A Concord capital drops out of the jump under fire and needs covering until her drive spools. A prison hulk runs for the edge with captured crews in its hold. An artillery spire unfolds and starts shelling your wing, Hollow included. Two claimers race you to a supply canister, a hunter pack jumps in behind the fleet looking for your best pilot, and some runs a harnessed leviathan with a Concord bridge bolted to its back swims in to fight beside you. There are more than twenty kinds of field event, and each one pays for going and costs you for ignoring it. And when holding a position isn't enough, Titan Escort puts a slow, enormous Concord Titan in your care, gate to gate, with a Hollow mothership hunting her.

FEATURES

• Online Co-Op & Drop-In Play: Deploy up to four flagships side by side across single runs or the full campaign, each with its own build, doctrine, and fleet. Extra players can crew stations aboard your ship, and anyone can drop in or out mid-fight.

• 25+ Playable Flagships: Unlock new hulls from the shipyard, build custom warships, or capture ships directly from the bosses who fly them. Every flagship features a unique Ultimate ability, custom hardpoint layout, and a tree of signature refits (100+ total).

• Deep Build & Fleet Customization: Combine 50+ modules, 50+ evolutions, and dozens of mega-evolutions. Recruit 10+ escort classes, fuse compatible ships into 10+ hybrid hulls, and drill them into multiple squad formations.

• 20+ Bridge Crew Officers: Assign officers to manage guns, reactors, helm, damage control, and flight orders—and watch them form friendships or rivalries across a campaign.

• Multiple Factions & Dynamic Alliances: Battle 20+ Hollow ship types, 10+ asteroid-carved Goblite vessels, and 10+ ancient Custodian warships that shift allegiances to aid the losing side at higher difficulty levels. Even Alve flights can join as temporary allies—or be toggled into rivals.

• 10+ Distinct Sectors: Adapt to unique environmental hazards—take cover behind asteroids during solar flares, throttle down through shard storms, dodge collapsing moon debris, and fight through crosswinds that push ships and projectiles off course.

• 15+ Bosses & Secret Encounters: Face unique multi-phase bosses across every run, plus massive hidden threats—like the Kraken and the Hollow Queen—that only emerge at higher difficulty tiers.

• Arcade or Tactical Pacing: Play in real-time action, or switch to Tactical mode to pause the fight, set formations, and target specific enemy subsystems.

• Replayable Modes & Progression: Tackle a branching three-act campaign, Titan Escort missions, Endless, Boss Rush, Daily runs, and custom Challenges. Climb 40+ Command ranks, unlock multiple doctrines, and purchase 25+ permanent drydock upgrades.

• Full Audio & QoL Support: Features a reactive soundtrack, voiced pilot radio, an automated missile-warning computer, chase or bridge cameras, photo mode, Steam Deck presets, and 100+ achievements.

• Comprehensive Accessibility: Includes colorblind palettes, HUD/text scaling, reduced motion/flashes, toggle/hold options, remappable controls, aim assist, adjustable damage taken,

games.name: VtuberCompanySimulator
games.shortDescription: Take your place as the head of a VTuber agency, run the company, and guide your VTubers as they grow in this management simulation. Type what you want to say, choose how the company responds, and handle each crisis your way.
games.aboutText:
Instead of Choosing from Preset Options, Type What You Want to Say.

From crisis response to one-on-one meetings, you decide what to say to your VTubers. Generative AI draws on each VTuber's personality, their current state, and the relationship you've built so far to create a reply for that moment. From Their Name to the Way They Speak, Create the VTuber You've Imagined.

Choose their name and appearance, how they refer to themselves, how they speak, their opening and sign-off for streams, and even the name of their fandom. Add recurring phrases and sentence endings to complete their unique personality.

The concept you create carries into streams and conversations. Watch them introduce themselves, address their fans by the name you chose, and react to what's happening in the speaking style you chose. Watch the VTuber you imagined make their debut and build a fandom of their own. Don't Miss the Subtle Signs.

Each VTuber has their own preferred activities, a pace they can sustain, and relationships with their peers. Stress and frustration can build even when results are strong, surfacing through subtle changes in the way they speak, stream, and relate to others. Focus only on the numbers and keep pushing the schedule, and you may miss the moment that matters.

Hear them out in one-on-one meetings, give them rest and support, or adjust your management approach. Respond to their needs in time and keep your promises to build trust; missed signs can turn into conflict and crises, eventually leading to a graduation announcement or an impulsive action. Protecting both performance and relationships means knowing when to push and when to stop. You Decide How They Grow.

Each week, review how your VTubers are doing and the opportunities available, schedule streams, lessons, and rest, and decide which activities and investments each one needs. When the streams end, performance, fandom response, revenue, and stress reveal the results of your week. Review what worked and plan the week ahead—the heart of running your company.

Once streams have built a fandom and raised funds, you can take on new ventures such as albums and merchandise. As the company grows, a wider recruitment pool, competitions, a company festival, and global expansion open up in turn. Choose which activities to prioritize and how far to expand the business, and build the agency you want to run.

games.name: CyberSprawl: Survivors
games.shortDescription: Cyberpunk survivors action with loot extraction. Build outrageous weapon combinations, tear through hordes, and hunt for gear. Leave with your haul or risk it for more. Extract to keep new equipment and give your next run a new direction.
games.aboutText:
CyberSprawl: Survivors is a cyberpunk survivors game with loot extraction. In this single-player bullet heaven, build outrageous weapon combinations, overwhelm hordes, and choose: leave with your haul or risk it for more. Extract to keep new equipment, gear up, and give your next run a new direction. SURVIVE THE HORDE. EXTRACT THE LOOT.

A strong build gets you to the reward. Getting out lets you keep it. Leave early with your haul, fight through to the mission lift, or stay for the Final Claim and chase another payout.

Fall before extraction and lose the new equipment carried on that run, plus part of that run's credits payout. Your secured stash, equipped gear and banked credits stay yours. OUTBUILD THE HORDE

Start with a weapon and turn it into a crowd-clearing build. Stack upgrades, pair weapons with boosts, and unleash evolutions that change the way your attacks fill the field.

Your weapons attack automatically. You choose the upgrades and steer through the danger. Get close with claws, command a drone swarm, or send lightning through the crowd. Find a combat style that makes you want another run. EXPLORE THE SPRAWL

Put that firepower to work. Fight toward equipment sites, trigger dynamic encounters and take a detour for a reward worth protecting. The route you choose gives the build a job.

Push farther for tougher fights and a chance at stronger gear. Then decide whether to keep exploring or head back with what you have. FIND YOUR NEXT BUILD

Recover equipment cases, reveal your finds, and compare weapons, armor and accessories with different bonuses. Look for an item that fits your plan—or gives you a reason to try a new one.

Equip secured gear for a later attempt. Your in-run weapon levels start fresh; the equipment you brought home gives you something new to build around. HUNT SOMETHING WORTH BUILDING AROUND

As relic hunts unlock, take on optional guardians for prizes with distinct effects. Afterimage Bracer echoes close attacks behind you. Scrap Brood adds a supporting drone swarm.

Choose a hunt, claim its relic and extract to secure it. Bring that effect into a later compatible build and see what it changes. COME BACK WITH A NEW PLAN

Recruit more operators, install permanent upgrades and open new systems through chapter progression. Weapon evolutions, equipment, Loadouts and relic hunts add new decisions as you play.

Return with a useful find, a different loadout or a tougher goal. The next run starts with an idea. Optimized for Steam Deck.

games.name: PSyChE DiVE
games.shortDescription: In this 2D shoot ‘em up, you play as Caroline, a psychologist that uses her meditation powers to help people! One day she meets a strange “person”, it will make her go through challenges before her life returns to normality! How will this story end?
games.aboutText:
About the game!

PSyChE DiVE is a 2D shoot ‘em up game where the story is told between levels in a Visual Novel format!

(Though, if you only want to play the shmup part, you can do it through the “Arcade” option!)

You play as Caroline, she is a psychologist that helps her patients through meditation . …How that work?

Well, thanks to her meditative powers, she can project herself and enter people’s minds. This way she can go directly to the person’s mind and help them in a more direct way, but the path to reach the mind can be a dangerous one, it depends how severe the mental illness of the patient is!

And that’s her job, normally goes with no trouble, but one day while meditating she meets a strange “person” . After that encounter, it limits Caroline’s power, making her job harder… Now she is wondering how to get her powers back while she keeps helping people!

(I’m still working on this, the description will change when I have a more complete game!)

This game will have:

- 5 different levels

- Achievements

- Available in English and Spanish (Hopefully one day I'll be able to add Japanese to the list!)

- (And more stuff I won’t put until I can really make sure those will be in the game haha! I'll put a monthly post to show the progress of the game. :) )

Gameplay

One thing that makes this game a little different is the bomb, in this game it repels bullets and after the bombs run out, it explodes making all bullets disappear!

(The idea came from the theme of “Shrink”, as shrinking away the bullets, also the reason Caroline is a psychologist.)

When the rest of the mechanics are done, I’ll expand this more! For now a clip of the 1st boss :D

Story

If you pick to play the “Story” option, before and after each level, there will be a part of the story, it will tell how Caroline gets it power restricted and how she will manage to recover it while going through 4 “challenges”, each one harder (and mentally ill) than the last one!

(I put 2 clips of how it can look, the story will be changed so those 2 clips don't show the final text!)

games.name: Deleted Wiki: Clean Up the Lost Files
games.shortDescription: A cozy incremental sorting game. A vandal deleted all 10,324 items from a 2007 fan wiki, and you're the new Moderator. Drag each item into its category, sub-folder and row, earn userscripts that automate the work, and watch the broken pages come back.
games.aboutText:
Deleted Wiki: Clean Up the Lost Files is a cozy incremental sorting game. A vandal has wiped every item page from a 2007 fan wiki, and you're the new Moderator putting all 10,324 of them back, one drag at a time.

At 3:12 AM on 14 March 2007, a user called Nullbane emptied the Item Vault of The unOfficial Embercraft Wiki: two years of fan work cataloguing every item in the 2004 MMO Plains of Embercraft: Online . All 10,324 items, deleted in one pass.

Nothing is actually gone. Every item is still in the deletion log, waiting for someone patient enough to put them back.

That someone is you. Congratulations on the promotion! You are the wiki's new Moderator.

Drag items out of the Trash onto the seven Category folders: Weapons, Armor, Consumables, Materials, Skills & Status, Interface and Curios. Work out where each one belongs yourself, until scripts start showing you exactly where everything goes.

On each Category page, drag the unsorted pile into the right Sub-Category. Swords onto Swords, Debuffs onto Debuffs. Every item you sort earns Sorting Points .

Open a Sub-Category and drop each item onto its exact row. Fill a whole row to earn a Completion Point , which buys the strongest scripts on the wiki.

Wren runs the wiki and has no intention of sorting any of this himself. He writes userscripts instead. Spend your points on them to multiselect whole stacks, pull scattered copies together, and eventually hand the heavy lifting to SortBot and AutoRestore.

Keep an eye on your talk page: news from The Embercraft Herald , updates from Wren, guild drama you weren't invited to, extremely legitimate offers from extremely legitimate companies… and maybe some people you weren't expecting to hear from.

- 10,324 items to restore across 7 categories

- 12 userscripts to earn, from Multiselect to AutoRestore

- 3 challenge modes, and one secret mode

- 10 music tracks and 3 save profiles

10,324 items are waiting in the log, Moderator .

games.name: Kiss Magic Curse:the accursed child
games.shortDescription: One sneeze turns you—a young noble heir—into a stunning woman?! Now, a loyal knight, an elegant fiancée, a sharp-tongued tutor, and a mysterious wizard are turning your life upside down! Uncover secrets, find love, and shape your destiny in this gender-bending rom-com VN with BL & BG routes!
games.aboutText:
[About the Game] "I'm supposed to inherit a noble title—not turn into a gorgeous woman every time I sneeze!"

Welcome to Kiss Magic Curse , a charming gender-bending rom-com visual novel by Maiden Rose Studio! Get swept up in unexpected romances, hilarious misunderstandings, and magical mishaps as you navigate a world where noble obligations clash with matters of the heart.

[The Story] As the heir to a prestigious noble house, your life was mapped out long before you had a say in it: uphold the family name, honor your engagement, and inherit the title. A perfectly respectable, predictable life.

Then, one little sneeze changes everything .

Thanks to a mysterious curse, a single sneeze now transforms you into a breathtaking woman! Suddenly, your carefully arranged future is hanging by a thread. How can you claim your birthright when you can't even keep your own appearance under control? And what happens if your rivals discover the truth?

As if hiding a magical identity crisis weren't hard enough, the people closest to you have started acting strangely:

- The Loyal Knight: Is his unwavering devotion really just a matter of duty?

- The Elegant Fiancée: What genuine emotions hide beneath her flawless composure?

- The Cunning Tutor: Why does this sharp-tongued mentor know more than he’s willing to admit?

- The Mysterious Wizard: Just when things couldn't get more chaotic, he arrives to stir the pot—holding the very secrets of your curse.

Between awkward encounters, unexpected affection, and the occasional disastrous sneeze, familiar relationships begin to shift in ways you never imagined. Everyone seems to know who you should be, but what do you truly want? When even your gender can change in a heartbeat, who will you choose to become—and who will you choose to love?

[Game Features]

- 💘 The Gender Balance Scale: Take control of your protagonist's form! Whether you're craving BL or BG romance, enjoy the ultimate freedom to experience love without boundaries.

- 🌹 An Immersive, Heart-Throbbing Narrative: Deeply intertwined bonds and branching storylines gradually draw you into the most tender, guarded—and dangerous—corners of each character's heart.

- ✨ Breathtaking Artwork & Visuals: Featuring a captivating art style and expressive character sprites, every scene brims with romantic tension you won't be able to look away from.

- 🔮 Multiple Endings: Every choice shapes your destiny, and every skip of your heartbeat leads toward a radically different conclusion.

games.name: OUTLIER
games.shortDescription: OUTLIER is an online hide-and-seek game for up to 16 players, set in an uncharted zone of the Backrooms where strange symptoms have begun to appear. Blend into a crowd of identical hazmat suits and secretly let out the unbearable urge. The Overseer is watching. Can you act normal to the end?
games.aboutText:
An online hide-and-seek game for up to 16 players. Crews sent into an unmapped zone of the Backrooms have begun reporting symptoms. Blend into the crowd, relieve your symptoms in secret, and don't let the Overseer notice.

HIDE IN THE CROWD

Act Natural. Drop into a level full of crew members in identical hazmat suits. Walk like them, stop like them, sit when they sit. One wrong move and you stand out.

YOUR SYMPTOMS WON'T WAIT

Relieve It in Secret! Dance. Moonwalk. Fart. Breakdance. Stagger around drunk. Beatbox. And it only gets weirder. The urge keeps building. Relieve it behind the Overseer's back, or it bursts out in front of everyone.

THE OVERSEER IS WATCHING

Eyes Everywhere. Overseers patrol with guns, looking for anyone who acts a little off. Get caught and you hit the floor. They can order a roll call at any time. Don't forget to salute!

PICK YOUR RULES

• Normal : Relieve your symptoms in secret and survive until time runs out. The Overseers are hunting for anyone showing symptoms, and they won't stop until every last one of you is caught.

• Infection : Get caught and you stand right back up as an Overseer. The hunt snowballs, and your friends become the problem.

• Free-for-all : No Overseers, no guns. The level is full of real crew members and players pretending to be crew. Suspect everyone and kick anyone who looks off! But get it wrong, and everyone around you just watched you do the one thing real crew members never do: a dropkick. Last one standing wins.

Three levels are open: Level 0, the Backrooms. Level 5, a mall. Level 6, a park.

FEATURES

- 2–16 players online

- Up to 160 crew members in the crowd

- Normal, Infection and Free-for-all modes

- In-game voice chat

- Streamer mode with copyright-free music and a hidden server code

- 14 languages

STREAMING & VIDEOS

Gameplay videos and streams are welcome, and you're free to monetize them. Solo or with an agency, no need to ask first. Just two small requests:

• Put "OUTLIER" in your video title.

• Link this Steam page in your description. (Optional)

games.name: ESC ape, You died?
games.shortDescription: ESC ape, You died? started as a project to recreate a game that fits on a single floppy disk (1.44 MB): a platformer where you solve puzzles with the ESC (menu) settings UI and every other piece of UI.
games.aboutText:
ESC ape, You died? started as a project to recreate a game that fits on a single floppy disk (1.44 MB).

'ESC ape' is a pun on Escape: a game built around the ESC (menu) key. It is a puzzle-platformer you solve with the settings window and the UI itself.

Brightness, volume, resolution and keybinds are the keys to every puzzle, and the UI itself can block enemy attacks or strike back.

Even the OS window is fair game. In this game, truly anything can become a weapon or a shield. Perhaps even tampering with the client files could be a hint.

Solve the puzzles of each stage and use every UI and trick to overthrow the ADMIN.

games.name: ARUS-1
games.shortDescription: Your rescue pod crashes on Mars at night. Survive alone or with up to 3 friends in online co-op, reach the habitat, expand your base, weather deadly sandstorms – and find out who else is out there on this planet.
games.aboutText:
Crash-landed on Mars

Your rescue pod slams into the Martian surface in the middle of the night. Outside: dust, freezing cold and an oxygen supply that won't last forever. Fight your way to the habitat by rover – and turn an abandoned outpost into your survival base. Solo or with up to 3 friends

ARUS-1 is built for online co-op. Split the work: one of you scouts with the rover, one expands the power grid, one keeps the drill running. Or face Mars on your own. A world waiting to be explored

Beyond your base lies a vast, open Martian landscape: layered cliffs, mesas, craters and endless rock fields. On foot or by rover, you push ever deeper into uncharted territory – searching for resources, answers and whatever Mars is hiding. Build. Supply. Survive.

- Explore ARUS Valley on foot and by rover – cliffs, craters and rock fields with a realistic Martian look.

- Build solar arrays, batteries, drills and refineries and connect them into working supply networks.

- Extract water from ice and secure oxygen and power for your base.

- Research new technologies and prepare your own satellite missions.

Research opens new paths

What begins as emergency life support grows into a true colony. Through research you unlock new buildings, facilities and technologies step by step – and with them, ever more ways to expand your base and venture further into Mars. When the sandstorm hits

Mars doesn't forgive mistakes. Sandstorms black out the sky and cripple your solar fields. Now you have to decide which systems keep their power – and which don't. You are not alone

A strange drone. Traces of a mission nobody was ever supposed to know about. ARUS, your base AI, has questions – and Mars has answers you won't like.

ARUS-1 is being developed by a solo developer in Unreal Engine 5. Add it to your wishlist so you don't miss any news.

games.name: Golden Trivia Show
games.shortDescription: Enter a quiz show solo or with friends. Divide your gold bars among the possible answers; those placed on a wrong answer will fall into a piranha pool. Will you make it to the end?
games.aboutText:
Golden Trivia Show is a quiz game presented as a TV show that you can play solo or cooperatively with your friends online (up to 4 players). You start with a pile of gold bars and need to avoid losing them. Each question has 4 possible answers, and you can choose to divide your gold bars among them. Only the gold bars placed on the correct answer will remain with you; the rest will fall into a pool filled with piranhas. If you manage to make it to the end and win some gold, you can spend it on cool new suits and cosmetics.

· Enter a TV-style quiz show

· 1–4 players (online co-op)

· Special rounds with chaotic modifiers

· 1,000+ questions with both text and images

· Not sure which is the correct answer? Divide your gold bars among them

· Win gold and customize your character

games.name: Houston, We Have a Spungus
games.shortDescription: A living space fungus is eating our colonies, and it grows back faster than you can shoot it. Build turrets, call in orbital strikes, combine flamethrowers, tiny suns and lightning, and hold the line until HQ nukes the source.
games.aboutText:
The spungus is one living organism, and it wants your colony. It creeps forward, ripens and blooms, and devours everything in its path. Shoot a hole in it and the hole fills back in. You can't kill it. Holding it off is the job.

Your first assignment: build the line. Pick where every tower stands and what it covers. The spungus will chew through some of it, and replacements cost requisition tokens, so plan before you place. Welcome aboard.

Your station's artillery reaches anywhere on the map. Every shell blows a hole in the spungus. Every hole fills back in. Keep clicking or invest in the automated shooting. Ammo is on the company.

Flamethrowers sweep burning arcs through the front and set it alight. Fireball Launchers throw tiny suns into the thick of it. And if those don't help – you can always microwave it. The spungus burns great... 75% of the time.

Beam Cutters fire straight through your own barriers and come out the far side wider. Pylon Launchers throw pylons that link into a web of lightning. Protect company property by any means necessary.

Towers have synergy. Fire a sun through a flamethrower and it grows. Push it with a Breach Gun. Hit it with a laser and it bursts into a firestorm. It's mesmerizing to watch, but remember – the spungus will find a way to backstab you.

The spungus comes in four strains, each tough against a different kind of damage. Chaotic barely feels energy weapons. Iron barely feels bullets. Read the map and don't bring a flamethrower to a lava fight.

You're paid for every bit of spungus you destroy, so even a failed shift earns you something. Spend it in a research web of hundreds of upgrades: new towers, new abilities, bigger everything. We believe in career growth.

Nine abilities, delivered on request: strafing runs, napalm, an orbital laser you steer by hand, hellbombs. Stand back and enjoy the view.

You can't shoot the spungus to death. You hold out until HQ's nuke is ready. Then it hits the source, a red wave rolls out, and every last spore dies. Then HQ reassigns you somewhere worse.

Key Features

✪ One huge living organism instead of waves of enemies

✪ Simulated on your GPU, cell by cell

✪ 15 towers in 5 schools

✪ 9 abilities called down from orbit

✪ 4 strains, each tough against a different damage type

✪ Weapons that combine

✪ Hundreds of upgrades

✪ Permanent progress from every run, win or lose

✪ Stations across the galaxy

✪ One nuke per level

✪ Hazard pay (pending approval)

games.name: How to Hunt
games.shortDescription: A 1-4 player physics based hunting simulator. You and your friends crash your boat while on vacation. You must survive till you find a way back home.
games.aboutText:
A 1-4 player physics based hunting simulator. You and your friends crash your boat while on vacation. You must survive till you find a way back home.

Hunt animals, cook them, eat them, sell them, fight bosses, and upgrade your gear in this chaotic physics based experience.

games.name: Everlasting Curse
games.shortDescription: Enter the witch’s hidden house, explore mysterious parallel worlds, switch between day and night, solve unique puzzles and minigames, uncover dark secrets, and break an ancient curse.
games.aboutText:
Years ago, the witch of Hidden Town mysteriously disappeared. Adria has followed her trail and finally discovered her new hideout. Enter the witch’s house and break the curse that keeps Delian and Meridia trapped. This may be your last chance to defeat her. Do you dare face her?

Explore strange worlds hidden within the house in the swamp, switch between day and night, and solve puzzles to move forward. Every place hides clues, secrets, and new pieces of a story that is far from over. But reaching the witch won’t be easy… and she may already be waiting for your return.

Explore new locations, discover parallel worlds, and face completely new mechanisms, puzzles, and minigames. Every place within the house has its own rules, secrets, and dangers.

New Mechanics, New Worlds

In Everlasting Curse, you’ll discover new ways to solve puzzles and progress through the story. Switch between day and night, interact with strange mechanisms, and venture into parallel worlds where the same place may hide something entirely different.

Pay attention to every detail, experiment with the objects you find, and discover how the different locations are connected. Some answers will be right in front of you. Others will require you to see the world from a completely different perspective.

A New Visual Evolution for Dark Dome  

Step into an adventure with a completely renewed and immersive art style, featuring more detailed environments, more polished animations, and a visual atmosphere designed to bring every corner of the witch’s house to life.

Original Soundtrack  

The adventure features a completely original soundtrack, specially created to accompany every location, every discovery, and every moment of tension. The music evolves alongside the story and the places you visit, building a mysterious atmosphere that will follow you throughout your journey.

Shadow Challenge  

Nine shadows are hidden in the most unexpected places. Some will be right in front of you, while others will demand your full attention.

Find them all as you explore the house and its strange worlds. If you want to complete the challenge, you’ll need to search every corner.

Free the 9 Trapped Souls  

Throughout the adventure, you’ll also encounter nine souls that have yet to leave this world behind.

Each one has its own small story and a special challenge. Find them, complete their minigames, and help them finally find peace.

Will you be able to find all 9 shadows and 9 souls before leaving the house?

How to Play  

Explore the environments, interact with objects, find clues, and combine items to solve the different puzzles. Pay attention to everything around you: even the smallest detail may hide the solution you need.

Download Everlasting Curse and experience a new adventure filled with mystery, puzzles, and secrets in Hidden Town.

Dive back into the universe of Dark Dome escape games and discover a story that continues to expand the mysteries of Hidden Town.

games.name: Five Star Crew
games.shortDescription: Run a tour boat with up to three friends through waters full of deadly sea life. Steer, cook, patch leaks and protect your guests on the way to the next dock. They paid for five-star service. Try to keep them alive long enough to leave a review.
games.aboutText:
LEN IS HIRING

Len has a boat and nobody to run it.

Guests get on at the dock. You take them out, and you bring them back. Then they rate the trip out of five.

Crew of 1 to 4. Online co-op. No experience needed.

GUEST REQUESTS

Guests may ask for a drink, lunch or a photo. Merv would like a portrait.

LOCAL WILDLIFE

The islands are home to a lot of local wildlife. Please keep your hands inside the boat.

THE GALLEY

Lunch is included with every trip.

THE BOAT

You can buy a pool.

SAFETY

There is a life ring on board, and the crew knows where it is.

THE PAY

Every trip is rated out of five. Good ratings get Len a bigger boat, with richer guests who expect more.

THE TEAM

Voice chat is proximity based. The engine room cannot hear the deck, and nobody can hear you in the water.

FEATURES

- 1 to 4 players, online co-op

- Proximity voice chat

- Physics on everything that can fall over, crew included

- Guests rate every trip out of five

- The captain can make the trip worse on purpose

TO APPLY

Add Five Star Crew to your wishlist. Len will be in touch.

games.name: GUNBUTCHER: RELOADED
games.shortDescription: 90 seconds and a completely crazy card roulette! Pile up the chaos and try to get out alive.
games.aboutText:
A frantic roguelike where you only have 90 seconds to survive an alien invasion. The plot? A crazy roulette that keeps spinning, dealing cumulative and unpredictable cards!

Big, huge, giant, and powerful bosses!
Incredible variety of weapons!
Enemies with unique attacks!
Random cards.
Unique NPCs.

games.name: My Penguin Friend
games.shortDescription: Jump into the adorable flippers of Dindim. Think like a penguin and tackle tricky physics puzzles across the gorgeous deep waters and sunny beaches of a tropical fishing village. Leave little footprints as you build a cosy nest, and gather keepsakes to discover a heartwarming story about friendship.
games.aboutText:
Play as Dindim, a charmingly curious and clever little penguin washed up in a human-sized world after a storm sweeps him off course.

Rescued by local fisherman João, you'll splash, squawk, squish, nudge, honk, poop, and waddle your way through the beautiful, sun-drenched fishing village of Ilha Grande. Enjoy a cozy, mischievous penguin adventure about exploring, collecting, and making a home as you find your way into João’s heart.

🐟 Become a Penguin Puzzler and cause a little chaos! A coastal village built around humans is a giant obstacle course for a two-and-a-half-foot bird. You’ll need a determined spirit to experiment with everyday objects, invent your own creative solutions, and overcome tricky, tactile physics challenges. Will it roll? Will it wobble? What if you give it a push or a pull? Poke your beak into the action just to see what happens in a world made for hands, not flippers.

🐟 Waddle off the beaten path. Explore this pretty, vibrant world at your own pace. Leave your little feetie prints across beautiful golden beaches, clamber up rugged coastal cliffs, swing into the village, jump into sparkling pools, and dive into the deep waters of Ilha Grande. Follow your curiosity and find your own favorite corner of this gorgeous tropical world.

🐟 Collect, build your nest, and bond. Gather scattered keepsakes, and help keep the shores clean by collecting washed-up plastic bottles and litter to build a cozy nest you can call your own. Inspired by a heartwarming true story, discover the extraordinary bond between a grizzled fisherman and an adorable penguin, each searching for their place in the world.

We’re Good Gate Media, an indie team creating games and stories we love. This one’s about a penguin.

games.name: Brewhaven
games.shortDescription: Brew magic combat beers that power up your village. Discover hundreds of recipes, run the tavern each night to keep your villagers juiced and happy, then have them work in the village and defend the town from enemy raids, if they can still walk.
games.aboutText:
After a botched execution by your former king, who apparently does not take a joke very well, you are saved through a soul bond to the weakened god of brews. Confined to a dangerous valley full of hostile creatures and the king's men, work to unlock your new power. Build your own village, with taverns, shops, and guilds. And one day, take vengeance on the king who tried to kill you.

Brew

Mash, ferment, and cultivate your own yeast strains using foraged and farmed materials to craft hundreds of unique recipes. With every brew there comes a choice: offer it up to unlock new powers, drink it for its properties, or distribute it to your villagers.

Drink

Unlock and consume your brews to charge powerful effects.

Build

Use locally sourced materials and a little magic to create buildings in your village. Recruit citizens and put them to work.

Serve

Open the tavern to your village and keep the villagers happy, and more importantly, keep them filled with stocks of power for when they need it.

Share

If they aren't having the nightly special, feel free to just spray it directly into their mouths. You know what's best.

Defend

Protect your village from enemy attacks, hopefully everyone's had a few drinks and can work together, if they can still walk.

Grow
Expand the village, customize houses, build a logistics network, and hire adventurers! One day, maybe everyone can work together to get vengeance on the king, so you can focus on a more peaceful life, with a few less jerks in the world.

games.name: SkyAid
games.shortDescription: Pilot your aircraft and dive into the disaster zone. Flames, ruins, floods — every corner holds someone waiting to be saved. Fly. Scan. Locate. Find every survivor before the clock runs out. Heal the wounded, transport the rescued, use supplies — every choice you make decides their fate.
games.aboutText:
Tagline

Pilot your aircraft and save every life you can from the disaster.

Genre

Top-down flight simulation × Disaster documentary

Core Gameplay

- Disaster events (natural disasters, man-made accidents, beast attacks, etc.) occur in each level, with multiple NPCs in danger. Players pilot an aircraft to search the map for all NPCs in need of assistance and help them escape.

- Players can use various skills, including reconnaissance drones, thermal imaging scanning, speed boost, and air support calls, to locate trapped NPCs or restore their own energy. Once an NPC is found, players interact with them using designated keys. Depending on the NPC's condition, different rescue actions can be performed, such as healing, transporting, delivering items, or equipping gear.

- Each level features randomly generated NPCs with different conditions and corresponding rescue points. NPCs requiring transport can be taken to rescue points to complete the rescue; those needing healing or items can be assisted directly through interaction.

- Players start each level with basic equipment. Additionally, supply drops (containing healing items or tools) are delivered by helicopter during the level. Each level has a countdown timer (approximately 3–5 minutes), and players must complete all rescues or keep NPCs alive before time runs out.

Highlights

- Realistic visuals powered by Unreal Engine

- Immersive disaster scenes and tense search-and-rescue atmosphere

- Strong sense of accomplishment upon successful rescues

- Procedurally generated levels — every playthrough offers a unique challenge

Visual Style

Realistic art direction with a low-saturation color palette to convey the oppressive tension of disaster zones; clean and restrained UI that doesn't obstruct flight visibility.

This game is planned to support English, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Spanish, Russian, and more. Additional languages are planned for future updates.

games.name: LAKESIDE HEAVEN
games.shortDescription: For every long story, there is also a short one.LAKESIDE HEAVEN is a short game rooted in dystopian science fiction, packed with a variety of gameplay experiences within its relatively brief runtime.
games.aboutText:
■ Features

A straightforward 3D action game where you fight your way through enemies using both swords and guns.

・Simple Controls and Combat

No complicated combos or lightning-fast reflexes are required.

We don't believe that keeping the controls simple has to come at the cost of making the game monotonous.

・A Variety of Gameplay Experiences

The game offers a variety of gameplay experiences, including car chases, battles against robots, and fights against massive bosses.

■ Story Overview

Once a magnificent and prosperous megacity, LAKESIDE HEAVEN has now collapsed, and not a single resident remains.

With no administrator left to control it, the city began indiscriminately consuming and contaminating the surrounding areas, continuing to expand without end.

Yet within this abandoned megacity lies a priceless treasure.

A miraculous AI—the technology behind the seemingly impossible advancements of LAKESIDE HEAVEN .

To steal the prompt that created it, one lone human ventures into the city.

Japanese language only.

games.name: Hazard Shift
games.shortDescription: A third-person PvE extraction shooter for 1–4 players. Fight corrupted machines, scavenge gear, and reclaim city sectors. Harvest corruption to power your squad’s weapons and equipment, every shot drains your shared energy. Extract with your loot and build up your base for the next shift.
games.aboutText:
HAZARD SHIFT is a third-person PvE extraction shooter for 1–4 players. Enter city sectors consumed by a mysterious corruption, fight the machines defending it, and bring valuable equipment back to your base.

Your squad shares the energy that powers its weapons and devices. To keep fighting, you’ll need to harvest the very corruption you came to destroy.

ONE SQUAD. ONE ENERGY SUPPLY.

Extract RAW energy from corrupted nodes and refine it into usable power. Every shot draws from the same supply your team needs to operate its equipment. Spend too freely, and you may leave your squad short when it matters most.

Coordinate your efforts: cover a teammate, keep the devices running, or push forward to secure another source of energy.

RECLAIM THE CITY

Explore abandoned buildings, search for supplies, and clear corruption from the sector. Repair devices you discover and deploy equipment to support your operation.

Corrupted machines will fight back. Target their weak spots, watch for reinforcements, and protect the equipment keeping your squad in the fight.

FIND SOMETHING WORTH BRINGING HOME

Discover weapons, tools, backpacks, and crafting materials. Limited inventory space means choosing what to carry and what to leave behind.

Survive and extract to secure your haul. Fall during the expedition, and you risk losing the equipment you brought and the loot you found.

MAKE THE NEXT SHIFT COUNT

Back at your tower, turn recovered materials into new equipment, research upgrades, and develop your base. Prepare your loadout and expedition support before heading back into the city.

GO ALONE OR WORK TOGETHER

Take on a sector solo or form a squad of up to four players in online co-op. Share the workload, adapt your equipment, and take on different roles as the situation changes. Every expedition is PvE: the threat comes from the corrupted city and its machines.

games.name: Heartfall — A Tale in Three Lives
games.shortDescription: From making new friends — or enemies — to exploring this island for secrets, how will your story end? Play as Grian in this visual-novel RPG and encounter new, shocking twists that you wouldn’t expect!
games.aboutText:
Heartfall - a Tale in Three Lives follows Grian as he wakes up on a mysterious island. Explore, encounter 12+ characters, partake in fatal-but-temporary shenanigans, and reveal one of the many story routes! Every route diverges wildly — you may find yourself becoming a detective, cheating on your first alliance, or discovering secrets that were best left forgotten!

Within the game’s 400k+ words of dialogue, 450+ cut in artworks, and 50+ original music tracks you'll find our creative hearts beating. Seventy collaborators brought their unique styles and passion to this project in order to realize their visions for ‘what if’ scenarios branching off of the YouTube series 3rd Life . This project was a labor of love! Passion breathed this Life Series fangame into being! No knowledge of 3rd Life is required to play.

Heartfall is a collaborative fangame based on 3rd Life , made with love and dedication! After one year of preparation and programming, the stories, artwork, and music were created by seventy contributors in just seven months.

The game is a visual novel RPG with diverging story paths written, illustrated, and designed by separate creative teams! Every story path is completely different!

Please check out everyone that contributed on our website!

Heartfall - a Tale in Three Lives is an independent and not-for-profit fan project . The game is unaffiliated with Grian and the 3rd Life SMP cast.

All content contained within are our own interpretations and do not represent the opinions, thoughts, or vision of the 3rd Life SMP cast.

Content Advisory
Heartfall is intended for teen and up audiences . Sudden Noises, Flashing, Bright Colors , and Swearing are toggleable in settings. Additional content warnings apply and will contain spoilers . These are accessible from the info menu when playing or on our website.

General Content Warnings: Explosions, Fantasy Violence, Blood, Animal Death, Character Death, Trauma, Injury, Suicide.

Check out our website for more information & FAQ!

games.name: One Million Coins
games.shortDescription: A short, focused first-person incremental mining game. Dig through a vault of one million coins, bank your haul, buy better tools, and build an ever-faster gold-collecting operation.
games.aboutText:
One Million Coins is a short, first-person incremental game about turning a pile of coins into a fully upgraded excavation operation.

You begin with empty pockets and your bare hands in a vault containing exactly one million coins. Collect gold directly from the enormous coin pile, carry it to a deposit station, and use your banked earnings to buy better equipment. Every upgrade makes the next haul faster, bigger, and more satisfying.

Start by scooping coins by hand, then unlock a growing set of increasingly powerful tools. Buy pouches and backpacks to carry larger loads, invest in a 250+ node skill tree that improves movement, reach, collection speed, tool strength, capacity, and deposit rate, and excavate deeper into the bunker to restore its infrastructure.

One Million Coins is designed as a short, focused experience. Most players should be able to work their way through the vault in around 2 hours .

Bank Every Haul

Bring your collected gold to the deposit station, turn it into spendable funds, and prepare for your next upgrade.

Shape Your Excavation Build

Spend your earnings across an 250+ node skill tree to improve speed, capacity, reach, tool power, and deposit efficiency.

Become a Gold-Collecting Machine

Build toward high-powered late-game tools that pull in huge waves of coins and transform the vault into your personal gold rush.

- First-person, hands-on coin collecting

- A finite vault containing exactly 1,000,000 coins

- Incremental progression with increasingly powerful collection tools

- An 250+ node skill tree across seven upgrade paths

- Expand your carry capacity with bags and skill upgrades

- Restore deposit stations, cargo lifts, conveyors, and bunker infrastructure

- Dig deeper into the underground vault at your own pace

- Work toward collecting every last coin and emptying the bunker completely

games.name: Potato Please
games.shortDescription: A first-person potato peeling game. You have a knife. You have a bucket. You have a mountain of potatoes. Peel them with real physics. Cut thin, waste nothing. Buy better tools. Finish the pile.
games.aboutText:
Congratulations, Comrade. The nation has entrusted you with a vital responsibility: keeping the army fed. Peel the potatoes, prepare the supply, and improve your operation in service of the greater good. Work hard, work efficiently, and remember: the army is hungry.

PEEL THE POTATOES

Your job is simple: peel the potatoes and get them into the water.

Pick them up, peel them by hand, and toss them in one by one.

FINISH THE PILE

Clear the pile and find faster ways to get the job done.

What starts as manual work gradually turns into a much more efficient operation.

AUTOMATE THE PROCESS

Turn repetitive work into a system.

Collect potatoes in bulk, use machines to process them, and automate more of the job as your operation grows.

games.name: Dirt Town
games.shortDescription: Use incredible physics to create roads by pushing dirt, felling trees, moving rocks, hauling gravel. Dig a pit for resources, build a race track for the dirt bike! Get paid and buy more machines. Multiplayer for up to four players
games.aboutText:
In Dirt Town you drive heavy machinery and move dirt. Create roads by felling trees, moving rocks, hauling gravel, digging ditches. Dig for resources and build a race track for the dirt bike!

Its a sandbox with multiplayer -- earn money by completing missions and harvesting resources, buy better machines -- and reach even further into the territory.

Revolutionary simulation

The whole site is one simulation. Everything you do, stays forever (in your save). You have not felt dirt like this in a game before. The simulation includes:

- Being able to plow, dig and stack material anywhere on the map, always

- Different materials, layered on each other. Sand is very different from clay in every way

- Everything is destructible, some are just very hard

- Moisture that affects grip and dirt movement

- Water that flows and rain creating creeks and puddles

- Rocks and trees interacting with the dirt and vehicles in realistic ways

Gameplay

We launch with a first map focused on mining and extracting resources, with lots of cool side missions. Find your way through the wilderness, break a road for the hauler, find the sources, and start shipping it out. Buy new vehicles and conveyors to make it easier.

Do side missions to spice things up:

- Build a dirt bike track and race it with your friends

- Jump the truck down a huge cliff

- Crush gravel to improve your roads

- Buy a compactor for even easier transport

- Drain a swamp to find even more resources

Selection of cool features

- Auto leveling system with slopes and curves. Set sticks, auto level with the dozer

- Chains for towing -- multiplayer awesomeness

- Get out on foot and climb -- both terrain and machines

- Drill into rocks to hook them

- Crush trees and brush

- Attachments with real hooking system

System support

You need a decent computer to always have 60+ fps -- see the system requirements

We support most peripherals from gamepads to joysticks and wheels

Where we are going

We launch with a mining focused map, and are aiming to do a major update for snow shortly after.

games.name: The Dust Remembers
games.shortDescription: A fallen world. On the wasteland, survival is all that matters. You walked alone—until you met them. Together or against, Trust or doubt, Closer or apart. Every choice leaves a mark, changing the story and your ending. Your decisions define this journey.
games.aboutText:
This is a story set in the end times：

A catastrophe—part man-made, part natural—turned the world into a wasteland. Order collapsed, resources ran dry, and mutated creatures roam the ruins. Survival has become the only thing everyone must face each day.

You have been walking alone through this world for a long time.

Along the way, you will meet them. You will travel together, and you will contend with them; you will trust, and you will doubt; you will draw near, and you will leave. And every choice will leave a trace on the wasteland, leading to a different ending.

Five romanceable characters:

They carry their own pasts, scars, and purposes as they meet you, travel with you, contend with you, and even stand against you. One is covered in oil yet smiles brightly; one is covered in scars yet still wants to trust; one stands above others yet hides fragility... Trust, use, protect, betray—the relationship is yours to define.

What you will see:

A cinematic 3D realistic world

We built this wasteland piece by piece with Unreal Engine. The broken bridge in thick fog, the camp beside the campfire, the dust-covered relics... We want this world to feel so real that, at some moment, you will believe it truly existed.

A branching story with multiple endings

The game is driven by dialogue choices and action decisions. Each of the five romanceable characters has an independent storyline and multiple endings. Who you trust, who you let go, who you become—your decisions lead to different fates.

Exploration, Collection, and Light Interaction

Search for clues and collect meaningful items in the ruins, gradually piecing together the truth of the world and unlocking hidden stories. Depending on the story, light gameplay elements such as timed choices and simple puzzles will be interspersed to enrich the pacing.

We are a tiny team of two, pouring our hearts into this world. A playable demo is in the works. Adding it to your wishlist would mean a lot to us.

"The Dust Remembers" — we look forward to meeting you.

games.name: Fish Wrangler
games.shortDescription: The idle fishing RPG that has been running since 2008. Cast your line, walk away, and let your crew keep fishing while life happens. Catch and collect 2,200+ species across 111 towns, level up ridiculous poles, and find out what Cousin Earl keeps in the bait shed.
games.aboutText:
Drop a line in the water and let the fish come to you.

Fish Wrangler is an idle fishing RPG that has been running since 2008. Cast your line, walk away, and come back to see what bit. Your crew keeps fishing while you are gone, and the night crew works the lines while you sleep. Nothing stops when you close the window.

Catch over 2,200 species across 111 towns, from the shallows around Waterport to the ice of Icelantica and much stranger water past that. Every fish you land goes in your collection, and some of them take years to find.

WHAT YOU DO

- Cast, wait, collect. This is a passive game. It respects that you have a life happening around it.

- Level up poles, from a busted oak branch to rigs held together with bait twine and a prayer.

- Sail to new islands, each with its own fish, its own locals and its own trouble.

- Run quests, cook the catch, and work out which chum brings which fish in.

- Fish with a crew of real people who take each other out on trips.

- Enter daily tournaments and seasonal contests against the whole lake.

WHY PEOPLE STAY

Some wranglers have been fishing here for more than fifteen years. It is not a reskin and it is not a clicker that runs dry after a weekend. There is a whole world in here, and it is still being added to every month.

Voted Best Facebook Game at Mashable's 2009 Open Web Awards, back when Facebook games were the future. Facebook moved on. We kept fishing.

One account everywhere: your wrangler follows you between Steam, the web and your phone.

Free to play, with optional support for the folks who keep the boat afloat.

games.name: Quiet Bloom
games.shortDescription: Quiet Bloom is a cozy idle game. Awaken the wind, dig wells, and call the rain to tend your land for you. Gather wood, stone, and water, raise wind vanes and solar panels, and watch a cracked desert slowly bloom into a luxuriant green oasis.
games.aboutText:
Quiet Bloom is a cozy idle game. Awaken the wind, dig wells, and call the rain to bring a cracked desert back to life as a luxuriant green oasis.

Let the elements work for you

Awaken the wind, dig your wells, and call the rain, then let them run. Ambient gusts shake the trees and sweep up your resources, wells fill, and rain soaks the soil, all on their own. You guide the elements, and they quietly tend the land for you.

Bloom a desert into an oasis

Watch a lifeless desert slowly turn green. Bare dirt darkens into grass, herbs spread, the first flower opens, and a lake fills the low ground. As your land grows richer, new life finds its way in. You never read a progress bar, you watch it happen.

Grow through one deep skill tree

Every force and building flows from a single branching skill tree. Sharpen the wind's speed, radius, and reach, fork it into many gusts and make it return, upgrade your own tap, and rebuild the well from a cracked ruin into a roofed stone well. Always one clear next step.

Features

- 140+ skill tree upgrades across one deep, branching tree.

- Elemental automation. Wind, wells, and rain that work while you rest.

- Renewable energy. Wind vanes and solar panels powering the bloom.

- A living desert that blooms into a luxuriant green oasis.

- Offline growth. Your oasis keeps blooming while you are away.

Wishlist Quiet Bloom and be there when the first flower opens. One purchase, no ads, no microtransactions.

```

games.name: Path to Transcendence（追境）
games.shortDescription: Path to Transcendence : a Chinese story driven auditory puzzle game. The story takes place in the Northern Song Dynasty, spanning 30 years from Qinling Mountains to Bianjing. The narrative mainly revolves around light puzzles. Make an appointment to follow and wait for good news.
games.aboutText:
【游戏简介】

《追境》是一款中国本土题材的剧情向听觉解谜游戏。故事横跨三十载光阴，从秦岭深山到江陵府，再到汴京宫阙，带你步入北宋年间那段充满诗意与遗憾的往事。

【故事背景】

北宋年间，宫廷乐正明道因“恃才轻肆，变乱雅乐”被逐出京师。“终身有琴，而不得有弦。”一个以琴为命的人，从此只能对着一张空琴，沉默余生。

他隐居秦岭，在一个风雪夜收养了一名弃婴，取名云生。故事由此展开，跨越三十载光阴，故人旧事在历史的尘烟中渐渐清晰。

【核心特色】

用耳朵“观看”的中式美学叙事
万物皆有声。游戏以沉浸式环境音与组合式谜题，带你体验一场东方美学之旅。更重要的是，解谜绝不为难玩家——声音识别以视觉波形辅助，音准判断以图形匹配引导，节奏同步以呼吸圈提示。一切交互设计皆为叙事体验服务，你不需要懂音乐，只需要愿意听。

剧情为主，轻解谜为辅
游戏以剧情叙事为主线，轻解谜交互为辅。在北宋文人雅士的生活质感与宫廷礼乐制度中，体会市井烟火与人物命运的动人交织。

国风绘卷，市井烟火
游戏采用精致的国风画面，细腻还原北宋时期的山川风貌与宫廷市井。从秦岭的深山风雪，到汴京的繁华宫阙，每一帧皆可入画。

【开发状态】

《追境》目前正处于开发阶段。如果您对这段北宋听觉解谜之旅感兴趣，请将本作加入愿望单。

预约关注 · 静候佳音

games.name: No Light at Sea
games.shortDescription: Turn an abandoned lighthouse into your last refuge. Salvage, fish and craft alone or in online co-op for up to 4 players. Brave the storms, rebuild floor by floor and uncover what lurks behind the legends of Brittany. Bring back the light. Before you lose your bearings.
games.aboutText:
Bring back the light. Before you lose your bearings.

A shipwreck. A dark lighthouse. The sea as far as you can see. No Light At Sea is a survival crafting adventure for 1–4 players , set off the coast of Brittany. Turn a crumbling tower into a refuge and work your way up to the lantern. Your best hope of rescue is above you. Everything you need is out in the waves. One more haul before nightfall

Cast your grappling hook for drifting wreckage, fish for your next meal and explore the rocks exposed at low tide. That distant piece of salvage could be just what you need.
