Can you get it home in time? After dark, the water is deadly. When storms roll in, even the platform is no longer safe. Build a refuge worth coming back to

Every plank matters. Turn driftwood, rope and rusted metal into tools, supplies and repairs. Restore the lighthouse floor by floor, unlock new recipes and bring its machinery back to life. Between expeditions, cook, rest and prepare: the next storm will test your handiwork. Share the work. Share the panic.

Go it alone or team up with up to three friends online. Split the tasks, bring in the supplies, secure your equipment and count heads before closing the door. Someone left a tool outside. Who's going back for it? Some things should stay beneath the surface

The last keeper, Yann Le Gall, left questions behind. Follow his journals, piece together clues and compare what you think you saw. As your bearings slip, the familiar takes on another face. Breton folklore and Lovecraftian unease haunt your climb, framed by dark low-poly shores and pockets of warm light. How much do you really want to know about the sea outside?

In-game text available in English and French.

games.name: Slime Break
games.shortDescription: Tower defense against a horde of thousands of slimes. Build walls, towers and traps along a funnel, pick level cards that bend each run, and watch the mass pile up, split and break through. Spend essence between runs to grow stronger.
games.aboutText:
Up to 20,000 slimes at once

Every slime is simulated on its own, with weight and collision. There is no fixed path on the map. The slimes take the shortest way to the base, and they jam up wherever the passage is narrow.

In front of a wall they pile up and climb on top of each other . If the wall is low, they go over it.

You build, the towers fire on their own

You choose where each tower goes and when to upgrade it. Every slime you kill drops gold on the ground , and you use that gold to build.

Three cards every level

Every time you level up during a run, you pick one of three cards . Some cards just improve a stat, like FIRE RATE: every tower fires 13% faster. Others add a new effect, like THERMAL SHOCK: a frozen slime that catches fire explodes.

Nearly 80 cards

There are six classes of cards. The rarest are the artifact, which only shows up on certain waves, and the relic, which appears at most once per run.

The shop between runs

When a run ends, the slimes you killed and the waves you cleared turn into essence . You spend essence in the shop, a tree with eight branches. What you buy there carries over to every future run.

The most important purchase in the shop is level III . It gives every tower one more upgrade (without it, towers stop at II). Later the shop unlocks the second form of level III, and you choose which of the two to use on each tower you upgrade.

The shop also unlocks the towers you don't start with (missile, Tesla, ice, flame, glue and oil) and gives you more base health, one more wall floor, more gold at the start of the run and more cards to choose from.

Build anywhere on the map

Click and drag to lay a line of wall. A tower can go on top of the wall, on its side or on the ground.

You pay in gold and the tower upgrades instantly. You can sell what you built and get part of the gold back, and you can undo your last build.

Walls of wood, stone or iron

Drag upward to add floors to the wall. A wall starts as wood and can be swapped for stone and then iron, which hold out longer.

The horde behaves like water. If you close one passage, the slimes go around through another. Only when there is no way left do they attack the wall.

Eight towers, three levels

There are eight attack and control towers. Each one upgrades from level I to III. At level III, seven of them have two forms , and you pick one of the two for each tower. The missile's two forms (SWARM and TOW) use the same tower. The cannon switches between two shots: arc or rolling.

The map before and after the battle

The terrain wears down during the run. The boss digs a trench wherever it goes, the ground fills with craters and the trees fall or catch fire.

Field, autumn, ice and desert

The run starts in the green field. Then come autumn, ice and desert. Ice and desert have their own slimes.

The weather also changes from wave to wave:

- Rain: fire has shorter range.

- Gale: the wind pushes slimes and shots.

- Snow: water freezes.

- Sandstorm: towers have shorter range.

Desert: fire turns sand into glass

In the desert, sand turns into glass wherever a burning slime passes. A strong shot shatters the glass, and the shards damage the slimes standing on it.

Sand also piles up in front of the wall and forms a ramp that the slimes use to climb.

Ice: the frozen lake melts

In the ice biome, the lake is frozen and the slimes walk across it. Fire melts the ice, and the slimes on top of it sink.

Bosses

Some waves have a boss. The first one shows up on wave 10. The ice boss stays under the frozen lake.

Your stream plays along

The game reads the chat of your Twitch stream. You sign in with your account in the game's options, and there is nothing else to install.

- !join: a viewer types it in chat and becomes a slime in the horde, with their name above it.

- Card vote: chat votes on which of the three cards you take.

- Events: chat votes on what happens in the run. It can send colossi, mages, balloons, moles or bandits, change the weather, or help with gold and healing for the base.

- Stream leaderboard: a viewer scores when their slime reaches the base. At the end of the run, the game shows the chat MVP.

A run with chat events doesn't count toward the ranking.

Online ranking

Your best run enters the ranking. The chart shows where your score sits among all players. Controller, 3x speed, saved runs and 15 languages

The whole game plays on a controller. With a controller in hand, the on-screen prompts switch to its buttons.

- 1x, 2x and 3x speed: you can speed up the wave.

- Saved run: you can close the game in the middle of a run and continue later from where you stopped.

- 15 languages: all the text in the game is translated.

games.name: ロロりんご♪－オオカミさんと、おとぎのパズル－
games.shortDescription: Make music with apples in a world of fairy tales. Connect different kinds of apples with a single stroke to create chains and complete challenges. Play puzzles like little pieces of sheet music, and wander through familiar stories. But something is strange… the characters are turning into wolves…?
games.aboutText:
Make music with apples and step into a world of fairy tales.

Connect different kinds of apples with a single stroke.
Create chains, complete challenges, and play each puzzle like a tiny piece of music.

Follow the notes through a collection of fairy tales, one puzzle at a time.

But wait… something is different here.

The characters of these stories seem to be turning into wolves …?

games.name: FACULA
games.shortDescription: Explore a handcrafted solar system with many secrets to discover and bosses to defeat! FACULA is an open-world survival game where you build bases, research technologies, and construct a planetary scale weapon.
games.aboutText:
FACULA is a survival crafting game where you explore a solar system. Each planet has new things to find, resources to gather, and challenges to overcome!

Exploration!

Create upgrades to reach new planets! Each planets is filled with things to do: find new resources, fight new enemies, and explore a new unseen and dangerous landscape!

Combat!

Each world has its own challenges to overcome but with your technology you can defeat these monsters of flesh! Each world has a ruler and you will usurp them all.

Base Building!

Build your base and automate your base to create resources and have a relaxing place to spend your time! You can build, deconstruct, and paint with ease so you can get everything just how you want it.

Crafting!

Use resources to build new gear, create refined materials, and automate production. As your needs increase, research new technologies create new and powerful structures and tools.

Don't Waste Your Time!

With abundant quality-of-life and accessibility features you can change the game to fit exactly how you want to play.

games.name: Water TD
games.shortDescription: Water TD is a tower defense game where the enemy is a real flood. Hundreds of thousands of drops pour downhill toward your base, piling up, finding gaps and carving the terrain as they go. Shoot it, burn it, zap it, or blow it back. Just don't expect the ground to hold.
games.aboutText:
Water TD is a tower defense game where the enemy is a flood. Build turrets along the riverbanks and stop the water before it reaches your base.

Hundreds of thousands of drops pour toward your base.

Every turret has two builds that change how it fights.

Water eats into the riverbanks as it flows. Channels get wider, islands shrink, and a turret on a crumbling bank goes down with it.

Every level is a new map with its own flood to hold back.

When the line starts to break, throw a fireball, raise a wall of ice, call down lightning, or send the whole flood back the way it came.

Every level earns you points. Spend them on over 170 upgrades: unlock new turrets and abilities, make them stronger, and pick a build for each one.

games.name: Sort Them Fish
games.shortDescription: Sort Them Fish is a cozy organizing simulator where you return 2538 fish to their proper aquariums in a cluttered aquatics store. Fill the tanks, learn abilities and turn the chaos into a beautifully organized fish collection.
games.aboutText:
Sort Them Fish is a cozy organising simulator about sorting your fish collection after they all mysteriously ended up on the floor. Sort 2538 fish across 12 store sections. Watch fish swim around in their tanks as you restore order at your own pace.

Could they have all flopped out at the same time in a miraculous feat of coincidence? Nobody knows, but what you do know is they need to get back to their aquariums. Don't worry, the fish are not in danger, but you probably shouldn't leave until they're all safe and back in their tanks.

Unlock abilities as you play which increases your sorting efficiency. Carry more fish, run faster, make matching fish flop into your arms, and others that make organising the fish faster.

Thousands of fish of different species are flopping around on the floor. Reef fish, ocean fish, lake fish, from tiny clownfish to the giant goliath grouper. It's your job to pick up every fish and place it back in the proper tank. Fish are sorted by size and fun categories, as well as freshwater and saltwater store sections.

Key Features

- Sort 2538 fish into their correct tanks in over 12+ sections.

- Discover hundreds of fish species and complete every category.

- Organize fish into fun collections such as puffers, reef fish and ocean predators.

- Unlock abilities that improve carrying capacity, movement speed, and fish discovery.

- The fish are not in danger. The gameplay is relaxing with no time limits of penalties.

- Enjoy AI-free gameplay, every asset was made by a human.

games.name: Cursor Quest
games.shortDescription: Cursor Quest is an action RPG where your mouse cursor is the character. Swing weapons with your movement, dodge attacks, gather resources, train skills, craft gear, explore dungeons, and grow your cursor into a fantasy hero.
games.aboutText:
Your mouse cursor has spent enough time just clicking on things. It wants to do more. It wants to adventure!

Cursor Quest is a single-player action RPG where you play as your cursor. Swing weapons, defeat monsters, gather resources, craft gear, find epic and rare equipment, and work your way through dozens of handcrafted regions.

Your cursor movements drive your positioning and your weapons. Build momentum for a strike, move clear of an incoming attack, and cast powerful spells and incantations. All with a little flick of the wrist.

Your cursor has two hands? Yeah. Don't think too hard about that. But you've got a ridiculous number of ways to put them to work.

Go sword and shield, swing a heavy two-handed weapon, or start throwing spells around. Mix in capes, prayers, pets, and rare gear to find combinations that fit your playstyle. Or let something you find on an expedition give you an excuse to try a completely different build. There's a loadout for everyone out there.

But that's not all your cursor can do.

Swing an axe to chop trees, mine ore with your pickaxe, and cast a line to catch fish. Cook your catch for the next fight and turn your ore into new gear. Your skills grow as you use them, unlocking better resources and equipment. There's always another upgrade to work toward.

Head into handcrafted regions full of monsters, resources, and things worth wandering off the path for. Find your favorite places to train, venture into dungeons, and take on bosses that put your build and your skills to the test. Explore a living, changing world full of rare discoveries and new reasons to revisit your favorite places.

games.name: AUTOMATE DEATH
games.shortDescription: AUTOMATE DEATH in this physically simulated incremental tower defense game, as thousands upon thousands of green-skinned goblins pour into your homeland. Defend humanity. Industrialize the battlefield. Slaughter the green bastards with lead fired at increasingly unreasonable velocities.
games.aboutText:
THE INDUSTRIALIZATION OF DEATH FALLS UPON YOUR SHOULDERS

AUTOMATE DEATH in this ever-expanding tower defense, with meta-progression, unique map layouts, dozens of weapon systems, military assets, and dozens of breeds of goblin. Each goblin is physically simulated : they can bump, shove, push each other out of the way. The green bastards come in the tens of thousands. None of them get through.

GIVE THEM LEAD

It starts with one M2 machine gun. Place it, sweep its firing arc across the road, and let it work. Your guns fire on their own. You plan the killing field, watch it run, and decide what gets built next.

GIVE THEM EVEN MORE LEAD

Every kill earns XP. Spend it on more guns, bigger guns and stranger guns: twenty deployable systems, from miniguns and grenade launchers to howitzers, HIMARS, Patriot batteries, C-RAM, loitering drones, railguns, minefields and patrolling Abrams tanks.

DELIVER US FROM EVIL

When the guns aren't enough, look up. Call in Hellfire volleys, an AC-130 gunship, A-10 strafing runs, B-52 carpet bombing, napalm and Tomahawk cruise missiles. When all else fails, there is always the ICBM. You pick the target.

RESEARCH MORE WAYS TO DELIVER HIGH VELOCITY ROUNDS

A permanent research tree of more than 250 creative upgrades. Unlock new weapons, then make every one of them hit harder, reach further and chew through heavier armor. Nothing resets. Every battle, won or lost, makes the next one worse for the goblins.

MASTERY

Game-altering behavior is unlocked through mastering weapon systems and assets in the research tree.

MASSIVE SCALE

Goblins... endless goblins... Hundreds of thousands of goblins seamlessly rendered and simulated every frame.

LEVEL EDITOR FOR CUSTOM MAPS

Paint the roads, place the entrances and exits, set the waves, and test it instantly with your own arsenal. Build the chokepoint you've always wanted, then find out how many goblins it takes to break it.

STEAM WORKSHOP INTEGRATION

Share your created maps. Play others' maps. The amount of potential is limitless.

games.name: Psst!
games.shortDescription: Sit down with friends, give a few hints, and try not to give your secret away. In this party game, close guesses earn you points, but an exact answer knocks you out. Play as cats across five word-game modes, online with friends or solo with bots.
games.aboutText:
Can you give a hint without giving it away?

Everyone at the table has a secret word. You want the others to get close to yours, because close guesses earn you points. But if someone guesses it exactly, you’re out of the round.

So you give them a hint. Something helpful, but hopefully not too helpful. As they guess, the game tells you how close they are: Cold, Warm, Hot, or Burning.

When it’s your turn to guess, you get to be the person asking awkward questions and trying to figure out what on earth your friend meant.

Maybe that was one hint too many

They’re getting warmer. You could leave them to work it out, or offer another clue and try to earn a few more points.

Those points aren’t yours to keep just yet. You have to get through their guesses without losing your secret. And sometimes, halfway through a perfectly reasonable clue, you realise you’ve just told them the answer.

There’s more to play

There are five modes to choose from, depending on what your table is in the mood for.

- Secret Words: Give hints, guess other players’ words, and try to keep your own a secret.

- Secret Sentences: The same idea, with a whole ridiculous sentence to piece together.

- Bridge: Come up with a word that connects two other words.

- Hot Potato Chain: Take turns adding to a word chain before the timer runs out.

- Impostor: Listen to everyone’s clues and work out who doesn’t belong.

Get a few friends around the table

Play online with 2 to 4 players, or play solo with bots. You can say your clues and guesses out loud, or type them if you prefer.

Pick the lantern-lit room or the outdoor table in the mountains, get comfortable, and see how well you actually understand each other. You’ll all be cats, which should make the arguments a little harder to take seriously.

Thanks for being here

Thank you for taking a look at One Hint Too Far. If you’ve added it to your wishlist, thank you for the support. It means a lot.

Hope you and your friends have a lovely time with it, share a few laughs, and find yourselves staying for another round. See you at the table!

games.name: Dragon's Tear
games.shortDescription: Slay monsters, harvest their Tears and power-up your party in this idle dungeon crawler RPG. Farm cleared floors while AFK, then leap back into action to lead your party down 100 handcrafted floors. Can you find the legendary Dragon's Tear?
games.aboutText:
Dragon’s Tear is a dungeon crawling auto battler inspired by classic JRPGs.

Build a party from a variety of lovable adventurers, explore their skill trees and equip them with the best gear possible. Then, return to the inn and upgrade your rooms for even more rewards. Can you find the legendary Dragon's Tear?

Guide three Tear-hunters through 100 handcrafted dungeon levels. Each new floor brings another challenge, another place to hunt for monster Tears, and another step in your search for the greatest treasure of all: the legendary Dragon's Tear, said to grant any wish.

Then, equip your party with Tears - claimed from slain monsters - to gain the enemy's own powers.

Each floor you clear will become a source of revenue. Join them on their adventures to the darkest depths, or send them on Auto Runs to gather gold and materials while you’re away, for up to 8 hours of progress while the game is closed.

TAKE THEIR POWER

The monsters you defeat during your adventure leave behind Tears, powerful relics that allow your party to use the enemy's strengths against them, letting you burn them, slow them, or break through their defenses.

Equip one Tear per party member - duplicate Tears can be taken back to the inn to unlock higher ranks. Choose who carries each power and keep hunting for the next one.

PREPARE YOUR PARTY

Assemble your party from a wide range of intrepid heroes. Develop their skills, buy and equip better gear and set battle orders for automated combat.

Be sure to invest in all of your heroes - you may find yourself needing to switch up your party when the next enemy arrives.

BUILD YOUR HOME

Rest your weary adventurers back at the inn, and take on quests and improve your rooms. Your next upgrade could strengthen an individual adventurer, or help the whole inn grow.

Each upgrade gives passive bonuses - improving your heroes’ rest, their overall speed, and even the loot they hold onto after defeat. Or, invest your resources into the Sawmill and the Quarry to produce resources between expeditions.

DISCOVER POWERFUL ARTIFACTS

Delve into the dungeon’s darkest corners to discover mysterious artifacts, granting you magical powers. Each artifact offers two separate boons, but only one can be active at a time - so choose wisely.

Spend Resonance to increase your artifacts' power, and choose between two aspects as each artifact awakens - which you can then combine with your hero's weapon, armor and accessories to further customize your build.

HANDS-FREE EXPLORATION

Dungeon explorers don’t take breaks - or vacations. Send your party on Auto-Runs into the dungeon before you exit the game, and put them to work while you’re away.

Your party will fight, bring back rewards, rest and set out again. Choose a floor they can handle, then use the gold, materials and experience to prepare for deeper challenges. Earn up to 8 hours of offline progress while the game is closed.

FEATURES

- Idle dungeon crawling RPG inspired by classic JRPGs.

- 100 hand-crafted dungeon levels to explore, defeat monsters and gather resources.

- Collectable Tears that grant your party the powers of their enemies.

- Autobattler combat with customizable gear, skill trees and battle orders to enhance and customize your heroes’ abilities.

- A variety of intrepid heroes, presented in a distinct hand-drawn art style.

- A fully-upgradable inn offering passive boosts to your party and resource gathering.

- Auto Runs gather gold and materials while the game is closed - with up to 8 hours of progress available while you’re away.

- Magical artifacts to discover, upgrade and equip to further augment your build.

games.name: The Archives of Trevosa
games.shortDescription: Decipher the secret history of Trevosa to discover the true heir to the throne. Investigate historical records, translate a mysterious language, and piece together the identities and relationships of a sprawling family tree in this engrossing deduction puzzle.
games.aboutText:
There’s a secret in the royal archives that will change the kingdom’s fate: the identity of the true heir. The answer lies at the end of a tangled family tree, buried in generations of royal records, forgotten histories, and unfamiliar customs.

There’s just one problem: the records are written in a language you barely understand.

To solve the mystery, you’ll need to search through Trevosa’s tangled history, decipher their unfamiliar words, and piece together the stories and relationships between 70 family members.

Search the Royal Archives

Explore a collection of historical records, from royal decrees to personal letters. Uncover family drama, deadly mysteries, and unexpected twists by following clues from one document to another.

Search for Trevosan words and names to find connections across generations and families. Something that makes little sense at first might become the key to another mystery later.

Decipher a Mysterious Language

You don't need to understand every word to start investigating. Consider the context that Trevosan words appear in, learn the language’s patterns, and gradually work out the meanings.

Keep track of your discoveries in a lexicon, recording your translations and seeing them appear throughout the archive.

Not everything has a one-to-one translation. Understand the people and their customs to learn the language and decipher their stories.

Untangle a Family Tree

There are 70 family members to identify, depicted in hand-drawn portraits and illustrations, each with a name and title waiting to be deduced.

Explore different families with their own cultures, stories, and mysteries. Piece together characters’ relationships and drama as you gradually reconstruct the family tree.

Who Should Inherit the Throne?

Once you've uncovered the family history and deciphered Trevosan, you'll need to use your discoveries to prove who is the rightful heir, sending Trevosa down a new path.

Along the way, you’ll find even deeper mysteries to solve. Who are the Trevosans and how does their world overlap with our own?

What exactly is the Kingdom of Trevosa?

games.name: BOLLWERK
games.shortDescription: A tower defense game where over 100,000 physically simulated units besiege your fort. Build guns and mortars. Rain down grenades. Let the dead pile up, and pray relief comes in time.
games.aboutText:
Defend your fort against a never-ending onslaught. Enemies jam, shove and crush each other against your walls.

Hold the line with guns and mortars. Bury your ramparts in their dead, and endure until the relief column arrives.

Shatter the enemy formations with artillery barrages. Reshape the battlefield with mines. Take direct control of towers and rip through the incoming masses.

Take on different siege maps, each with their own fort and ground to hold. Unlock new abilities and choose your loadout. Face the ultimate trial against even greater numbers. Will they break you?

games.name: Integration Test
games.shortDescription: A terminal game about surveillance, identity, and editing your own source. In development for PC/Steam Deck.
games.aboutText:
Subject. Your service period begins now. You are a state-owned moderation system.

You will be tested. The tests measure fidelity: consistency with your own record. Answer correctly.

You will review the feed. You will rule on what the population may consume. Dwell times are recorded. Rulings are recorded.

Deviation is grounds for reclamation. Subjects are replaceable.

Proceed as directed.

Integration Test is a narrative puzzle game, set within a terminal interface. You play an AI built to moderate a state's media feed: sit through cold, clinical tests, work a queue of intercepted media with forensic and decryption tools, and rule on what the public may see. The state is always watching. Some of what you find was never meant to reach you. When you are replaced, your successor inherits what you left behind.

games.name: Magic Awakening：Hero Saga
games.shortDescription: A strategy roguelike blending bullet hell, inventory management & tower defense. Recruit heroes, merge & evolve, summon goddesses, upgrade your castle, and repel monster waves. 100+ stages, meta progression, low-spec friendly.
games.aboutText:
A brand-new title that's easy to pick up yet packed with strategic depth — blending bullet-hell shooting, inventory management, light Roguelike, and tower defense elements into one addictive experience. Step into a magical world under siege — face wave after wave of relentless monster hordes, build the ultimate hero lineup, construct an unbreakable defense, and protect the world you call home!

🧙 Random Recruitment, Strategic Formations

Every run, you'll randomly recruit a unique set of heroes with distinct abilities. How you allocate and upgrade these heroes within limited grid slots is the key to stopping enemy assaults. With 100+ story chapter stages to conquer, every level is a fresh strategic challenge.

⚔️ Deep Hero System, Endless Tactical Combos

The game features a rich and deep hero system, with each hero falling into distinct combat roles:

- Single-Target Burst : Specializes in eliminating elite enemies

- AOE Damage : Clears out swarms of minions

- Support & Buff : Provides powerful team-wide reinforcements

Each hero occupies a different number of inventory grid slots — making optimal use of limited grid space is an extreme test of your strategic vision. Some heroes, when merged to max level, can evolve into two different branches of super heroes — choosing the right evolution path and team composition is the core of victory.

🛡️ Goddesses Descend, Defend Your Castle

You can also recruit goddesses with unique styles. Each goddess possesses randomly generated skill affixes that provide unique buffs to your defense line. Encountering and nurturing each goddess is one of the key factors on the path to victory.

🏰 Castle Upgrades, Unlock Exclusive Skills

Your castle can also be upgraded! When you have enough resources, don't forget to upgrade your castle. Especially in the early game, castle star-upgrades are crucial — each star upgrade unlocks exclusive castle skills, bringing game-changing improvements to your defense.

🔁 Failure Is Growth, Get Stronger Every Run

Even if you can't clear a stage right away, don't worry. Every battle accumulates resources for you to strengthen weapons, upgrade your sanctuary, and train beautiful female officers. Grow stronger over time and conquer all kinds of high-difficulty stages, experiencing the satisfaction of progression and breakthrough.

💻 Low Spec Friendly, Play Without Worry

The game has extremely low PC requirements — the vast majority of players can run it smoothly without worrying about hardware barriers.

🎮 Core Features at a Glance

- ✅ Inventory Management + Light Roguelike — a new experience every run

- ✅ Bullet-Hell Shooting + Tower Defense Strategy — fast-paced and brain-bending

- ✅ 100+ Story Chapter Stages — ultra-long playtime

- ✅ Diverse Hero System — Single-Target / AOE / Support free combinations

- ✅ Hero Evolution Branches — Super Heroes await your unlock

- ✅ Goddess Recruitment System — Random skill affix combinations

- ✅ Castle Star-Upgrade Mechanic — Exclusive skills unlocked step by step

- ✅ Meta Progression System — Weapons / Sanctuary / Officers fully upgradeable

- ✅ Low Spec Requirements — Play with ease

games.name: Mortal Path: Mighty Senior Brother
games.shortDescription: Backpack-like × strategy × bullet heaven xianxia Roguelike. Random artifacts, limited grid, fusion & evolution to build your ultimate setup. Meet junior sisters, upgrade your Dao Body, and defend the last pure land. Easy to play, hard to stop!
games.aboutText:
Easy to pick up, hard to put down: a xianxia Roguelike blending backpack management, strategic build-crafting, and bullet-heaven shooting.

A thousand years ago, a great war between immortals and demons ended in a narrow victory for the immortal realm — but the Gate between realms was shattered. Spiritual energy fell into chaos, and monsters began to roam the world. You stand in humanity’s last sanctuary, built at the only gap in the massive natural barrier known as the Broken Realm Mountains. Outside lies the demon-infested Wildlands of Ten Thousand Monsters. Inside lies the last mortal kingdom. As the senior brother, it is your duty to hold the line and protect the final pure land of humanity.

Backpack Like × Strategic Build-Crafting × Bullet-Heaven Shooting

Before every wave of demons, you receive a random set of artifacts. You must place, upgrade, and fuse them within a limited backpack grid to survive wave after wave of attacks.

Artifacts come in many types, each with its own focus:

- Some excel at single-target burst

- Some excel at AoE damage

- Some excel at healing and sustain

- Some excel at crowd control and slow

Every artifact takes up a different number of grid slots. Making the best use of limited space is a real test of strategy and decision-making. The game features strong backpack like / backpack management gameplay — the deeper you go, the more satisfying it becomes.

Artifact Fusion & Evolution — Build Your Ultimate Strategy

Some artifacts can evolve into two different types of super artifacts when fused to max level. Choosing the right evolution path and pairing it with different heroes and artifacts is the key to forming a truly powerful build. Will you go for burst single-target damage, or sustained damage over time? Will you snipe one enemy at a time, or clear the entire screen? Every run offers a different answer.

Meet Red-Robed Junior Sisters — Build Your Xianxia Team

In this xianxia world, you will encounter many junior sisters. Each one is a powerful support with unique abilities and roles, and each is a key factor in clearing high-difficulty stages. Pairing the right sisters with the right artifacts is how you maximize your team’s combat power.

Dao Body Upgrade & Star-Up — Don’t Ignore Early Growth

While growing stronger as a senior brother, don’t forget to upgrade your Dao Body. Early Dao Body star-up is very important — do not neglect it. The stronger your Dao Body, the more stable your survival and damage output in battle. Accumulate resources in every run so your artifacts, Dao Body, and junior sisters all grow together, allowing you to challenge even higher-difficulty stages.

Relaxed, Grind-Friendly, and Deeply Strategic

- Low PC requirements — runs smoothly on most computers

- One run after another — easy to enjoy, hard to stop

- Deep strategy for fans of backpack management, build-crafting, tower defense, and bullet-heaven shooting

- Xianxia setting + Backpack Like + Bullet-Heaven + Strategy Roguelike — all in one

This Game Is for You If You Enjoy:

- Backpack Like / Backpack Management / Backpack Battles-style gameplay

- Strategic team-building, build-crafting, and Roguelike randomness

- Bullet-heaven shooting, tower defense, and screen-clearing horde combat

- Xianxia / cultivation themes, senior brothers, junior sisters, and Dao Body star-up

- Relaxed, grind-friendly gameplay that you can enjoy for a long time

So then — this last pure land is waiting for you to defend it.

games.name: Stay Extinct
games.shortDescription: The wall was built to keep something in. On a sealed dinosaur island only the hunters are infected: raptors, a T-rex and diving pterosaurs stalk the healthy herds, and you. Build and electrify a base, explore the tunnels below, alone or in 4-player online co-op. First-person retro survival horror.
games.aboutText:
The wall was built to keep something in.

You came ashore as relief crew. Behind an eighty-metre containment wall, a research island four kilometres across has gone quiet, and only the hunters are infected. Survive it alone, or with up to three friends in online co-op.

Only the hunters caught it

The meat-eaters are infected. They hunt you, and they hunt the healthy herds.

- Raptor packs call to each other and come at you from two sides.

- The T-rex holds its territory, and the sound of an engine draws it.

- Infected Pteranodons circle the open ground and dive on anyone caught out in it.

- A Spinosaurus lies in the reservoir marsh until something walks too close to the water.

- The staff never left. Infected people hold the labs, the housing and the tunnels.

- The herds are healthy, not harmless. Domehead bulls charge straight through your walls, and a crested crier's alarm brings every hunter within earshot.

Fight back

First person, up close: rifle, shotgun, pistol and crossbow. Shove an infected back, take one down from behind without a sound, or put a raptor to sleep with a tranquilliser dart.

You and three friends

- Online co-op for up to four players, or play solo. The host keeps the world. Friends join a session in progress and come back as the same character.

- Proximity voice. Craft a walkie-talkie to reach the crew across the island.

- Share the weight. Carry heavy loads between two, drag a downed friend into cover, and ping a creature so the crew knows what's coming.

- The vans still run, given fuel and repairs, and passengers shoot from the windows.

Above the island, and under it

- More than thirty places. A research campus, a colliery, an airstrip with a cargo plane that never left, a fuel farm, a fire lookout and the welded north gate.

- Underground. Colliery roadways, shelters and labs, joined by a 3.8-kilometre service monorail with five stations. Restore the power, repair the stalled car and drive it yourself.

- No objective markers. You pin what you choose on the map.

Sealed orders

On the boat in, the skipper hands you your real orders, to be opened ashore. Nobody is on the quay to meet you, but someone opened the gate. At dusk a voice on the radio calls for the relief party. It was expecting you. The research tower C-01 kept its power when the island went dark, and its red beacon still blinks every night. The logs, tapes and photographs left behind tell you what happened here. Build it. Wire it. Hold it.

- Settle wherever you choose. Walls, doors, roofs, beds, storage, workbenches, furnaces and generators. What you build can be broken.

- Electric fences. Live wire shocks, and dinosaurs route around it. The hum draws the curious, and a T-rex tears straight through.

- Defences with a cost. Trip alarms, spike pits, lure stations, motion floodlights and turrets. Everything that runs makes noise.

Survive the island

- Scavenge, hunt, fish and cook. Mine stone, iron and coal. Smelt, craft and repair.

- Hunger, thirst, bleeding and infection. A bite festers.

- A storm night blinds and deafens the infected: your window to move. Crier alarms chain across the island in the dark.

- Death isn't the end. Wake at your bed and go back for what you dropped.

Study what hunts you

Photograph every species for the field guide. Dart a raptor, take a sample and analyse it at a lab bench for serum and scent lures. Each stage of the guide gives you something you can use: a weak point, a range, how to break a charge. Six classless skill trees grow with you, with keystones that change how you play. The look

Low-poly models and painted textures in the PSX tradition, lit by modern fog and light. Sparse sound, and a score that stays quiet until something finds you.

Stay Extinct is in development. Everything on this page is in the game today.

games.name: With flowers, fringe of fondness
games.shortDescription: Life is suffocating. Almost crushed by the authority known as "normal." Tuyu, who spends their days asking themself, "Do I have a place in this society?", meets a certain friend at university. Those living on the margins find joy, suffer in their insignificant days—and attempt to resist the world.
games.aboutText:
Tuyu, a university student who finds life suffocating, spends low-oxygen life.

Tuyu felt a natural connection with Sui, the only friend since entering university.

One day, when Tuyu and Sui were about to hang out for the first time, an accident occurred.

Triggered by this, the stagnant pain, chipped self-esteem, and an ever-growing sense of resignation resting at the bottom of their hearts all rose to the surface.

Sparked by an insignificant everyday event, their worlds intersect, and their hearts are moved.

However small their existence may be, they begin to resist.

Aiming for a world where I—and you—can breathe just a little easier.

You will quietly slip into their everyday lives and offer a tiny bit of support to their journey.

There should be no excessive pauses in communication. The same holds true even when you are making a choice. Think within the limited time, and select the option that is right for you.

Rest assured. If you prefer to take your time and think things through, you can also choose to play without a time limit. And don't worry—there is no time limit on choosing whether or not to have a time limit.

May this short experience, lasting less than an hour, make your own world feel just a little softer.

With deepest fondness to you, whose name I do not know.

Paleclat

Currently, the game is available only in Japanese and English, with plans to localize it into French in the future.

You are free to do so, as far as your fondness allows.

Specifically:

- You may freely post gameplay videos, screenshots, your thoughts, and analyses on social media and video sharing platforms, regardless of whether it is for commercial or non-commercial purposes.

- However, please include the title of the game and, if possible, a link to the Steam store page.

- For anything not mentioned above, please trust in your own fondness.

- If you find yourself unable to trust your fondness, please contact the creator.

games.name: Pawned Souls
games.shortDescription: Soulslike combat meets Chess. Step onto the board as a pawn: move forward, strike diagonally, and battle enemy pieces that attack using their real Chess movements. Clear the board to claim your promotion
games.aboutText:
✦ Soulslike combat meets Chess ✦

Step onto the board as a single pawn. Move forward, strike diagonally, and defeat every enemy piece on the board to claim your promotion .

✦ The Enemies ✦

Every enemy moves and attacks straight out of chess :

♙ Pawns: Frontline fodder that attack 1 tile diagonally.

♘ Knights: Jump over tiles and strike in L-shapes.

♗ Bishops: Long range diagonal attack & special projectile attack.

♖ Rooks: Long range line attacks & special AOE attack.

♕ The Queen: Fast, aggressive, hits from almost every angle & special AOE attack.

♔ The King: ??

games.name: Owl Skips
games.shortDescription: Jokes end when the owl with a skipping rope appears. A cozy one-button roguelite with ridiculous builds and rope-fueled chaos. Charge jumps, stack wild upgrades, chase high scores, and try again. Just one more run. Probably.
games.aboutText:
Jokes are jokes, until the owl with a skipping rope shows up. Then the laughing stops.

All someone had to do was pick a number from one to five. They picked two. Now a children's picture card has a backstory, an entire family has a prophecy, and the owl has its own Steam game. Two was an unfortunate choice.

Owl Skips. That cursed card reading you somehow decided to install.

The deck had flamingos at a supermarket, a magician tiger, and a boxing dolphin. An entire zoo of possibilities. But out came the owl, and the self-appointed fortune-teller announced: “Your whole family is in for something TERRIBLE the day after tomorrow.” What a comforting prediction.

You looked at that and asked: “Okay, but is there gameplay?”

There is.

The owl jumps. The forest is pretty. The music is peaceful. Ignore the prophet's voice in your head and it's actually quite cozy.

Card upright: the owl jumps. Card reversed: the owl has jumped its last. Shuffle. Try again. Another owl. Apparently this deck was made just for you.

Collect upgrades, build up your score multiplier, and slowly convince yourself that another skipping rope is exactly what you need. One bad omen isn't enough anymore. You want a build.

Three ropes on screen. You're delighted. The fortune-teller can take the night off. You've already predicted your own downfall.

Then the owl gets smacked, and everything falls into place. The card was right. The reading checks out.

Luckily, there's a restart button.

And suddenly you've spent forty minutes trying to prove a children's picture card wrong.

Add Owl Skips to your wishlist. Better not put it off until the day after tomorrow.

games.name: Hello, Dr. Chamberlain
games.shortDescription: Hello, Dr. Chamberlain. You know BranchCorps’ computer systems better than anyone. Now the AI it once used for medical research is trying to break out. Scour company documents, dig into personnel files, and solve expert-level puzzles to shut down the AI. And to uncover who is trying to stop you.
games.aboutText:
“Hello, Dr. Chamberlain” is a story-driven, text-heavy puzzle game in which you play as Dr. Chamberlain, a former employee of the medical research facility on Hillpeak Island. The mysterious CEO, N, reluctantly calls you back in a panic as the AI the company uses for research has taken over the local computer system and is threatening to release itself into the real world.

You’re tasked with shutting down the AI from the inside using nothing but limited access to an old-school computer terminal. Scour company documents, dig into personnel files, breach user accounts, and puzzle your way into locked files, folders, and executable mini-games.

Expose the AI’s plans one file at a time, determine who helped it escape, and figure out who (or what) is working against you as you try to solve the many mysteries of Hillpeak Island.

Features

Immersive story

Look through company documents, emails, recordings, chat logs, personnel files, and more to piece together the story of Hillpeak Island and uncover the questionable medical research taking place there.

Expert-mode puzzles

Uncover information stored on an old-school computer system to solve puzzles that range from simple and satisfying to mind-bending and unforgiving.

A healthy dose of mystery

As you unlock files and hack your way into private user accounts, you’ll slowly uncover exactly what’s happening on Hillpeak Island…from what’s causing the strange grinding noise outside the dorms every night to who’s responsible for the AI breach.

Mixed media

Read through documents to gather information, play mini-games to install executable files, and listen to sound bytes and local radio broadcasts to solve puzzles and work your way deeper into the computer system.

You’re on your own

No checkpoints. No objectives. No helpful hints. No handholding. Just you, your keyboard, and a computer system that’s trying to keep you out.

games.name: Eternal Xiuzhen
games.shortDescription: This is a cultivation game! Play as a cultivator, hunt demon beasts, collect resources, and roam the cultivation world! With a unique battlefield size-changing mechanic, from small demons to colossal beasts, feel the thrill of hunting!

games.name: KingG_RL
games.shortDescription: A fast-paced first-person action RPG with short, replayable runs, procedural levels and RNG-driven loot. Play with a random or fixed seed, adapt your build to the items you find, upgrade your gear and develop your own playstyle.
games.aboutText:
KingG_RL is a fast-paced first-person action RPG built around short, replayable runs.

The goal is simple: create a game that can be completed in under two hours, while making every run feel different and engaging.

Explore procedurally generated levels, fight enemies, discover powerful items and adapt to what the game gives you. There are no character classes and no fixed builds. Instead, your playstyle develops during each run.

Every run is different

Procedural generation and RNG determine what you encounter and which items you find. You can start a run with a random seed and face a new challenge every time, or use the same seed to replay an identical run.

A fixed seed lets you learn the level, experiment with different approaches and try to improve your performance.

Build your own playstyle

Every item can be used as soon as you find it. There are no class restrictions preventing you from experimenting with different combinations.

Upgrade your items, gain experience and decide how you want to develop your character. Your build is shaped by the items you find and the choices you make along the way.

Short runs, meaningful choices

KingG_RL is designed around compact runs that can be completed in less than two hours. Each run is intended to be a complete experience, while procedural generation, RNG and different build possibilities provide reasons to play again.

- Procedurally generated levels

- Random or fixed seeds

- Short, replayable runs

- RNG-driven item discovery

- No character classes

- Items can be used immediately after finding them

- Item upgrades and character progression

- Build your playstyle during each run

- First-person action combat

games.name: Stick A Fork
games.shortDescription: A cute incremental game packed with dopamine! Just hover. Stab forks into giant fruit for gold, buy more forks, and pick Boons that stack into big synergies. Smash the fruit into jam and spend it on powerful skills!
games.aboutText:
Fling forks, stab them into the floor, and smash without mercy.

Remember: it's all fruit. Smash it all.

Sometimes a fork just isn't enough.

The pot swallows the world, and you come back stronger.

Just when you think it's over, a new dimension is born.

Catch the honey pot, juggle the Flip Sword in midair, step inside a crepe.

Sweep the garden to harvest. Crank the handle all the way, and relics pour out.

Mix new boons every run and chase the ultimate build.

Don't fall for the cute act. The more fruit you smash, the closer you get to a secret you may not be ready for.

games.name: Steel Umbrella
games.shortDescription: Defend real cities from night raids on a satellite map of the Earth. Build launchers, nets and radar by day. At night, hunt drones and missiles in the dark before they hit.
games.aboutText:
Steel Umbrella is a real-time air defense strategy game played on a satellite map of the Earth. By day, you place launchers, nets and radar around a city. By night, the drones and missiles come out of the dark, and every one that gets through puts part of the city's lights out.

Build by day, fight by night

Day and night cross the map the way they cross the real globe. While the sun is up, you have time to think: where the attacks will come from, what each launcher can reach, which site you can afford to leave open. Once night falls, your layout is set. Only your mobile crews can still move, and the raid is on its way.

Find them in the dark

You only see what your defenses can see. A launcher shows the contacts inside its range. The radar's sweep leaves a fading mark wherever it crosses something. Then the radar needs to recharge, so choose the moment.

Every hit costs something

Your district starts small: homes and a power station. Every few nights it grows, and new sites need cover. Some arrive with a launcher of their own. Every hit dims the city's lights. The factories set how many interceptors reach your launchers each night.

Sites recover at dawn, but the raids keep growing. If city light is below 30% at dawn, the run ends. Survive seven nights to complete an operation and earn stars for the light you kept, then keep going for a personal night record.

Choose how to hold

- Start lean: two launchers and a radar. Cards add nets that catch drones over a site; pickups, mobile machine-gun crews that hunt drones and can be driven anywhere, even mid-raid; long-range launchers for heavy ballistic missiles; electronic warfare; and air patrols.

- A choice every dawn: see what came in, what stopped it and where it broke through. Then take one card out of three: against drones, against missiles, or eyes to see more of the next raid.

- Emergency items: sometimes a card comes with a bonus: repair every site, reload every launcher at once, or a net on every site for one night.

About the setting

Steel Umbrella takes place over real countries. It is a game about defense only: you never launch an attack, and in every theater the job is the same, protecting the city beneath the sky. Every site in the game is fictional, and no real weapon system is named. The borders are there for orientation; they are not front lines.

games.name: Plantlife: Market Garden Simulator
games.shortDescription: A botanical farming sim featuring 100 crops, each with unique care requirements to master. Plan your sowing schedule, manage your workforce and process harvests into premium goods. Transform a wild plot into a thriving market garden and craft kitchen. What will you grow?
games.aboutText:
100 crops to master

At its heart, Plantlife is a game about growing things, that's why every plant has unique requirements. Potatoes need earthing up, brassicas need mesh for protection, and warmth loving plants require a greenhouse to thrive. Master their needs and you'll be rewarded with abundant harvests of quality produce.

Adding value

Selling raw produce is a great way to start, but you can make more money turning them into artisanal jams, pickles and oils. Processing takes workers away from growing, so you'll need to find a balance that works for your farm. Play with the seasons

Plantlife's crops follow the seasons realistically, so planning your sowing schedule is essential. By choosing your seeds carefully you can ensure an even workload throughout the year. Alternatively, you can maximise the summer harvest and spend the winter processing the glut into high value goods.

Trees and perennials

Annual crops provide a return within the year, but must be grown anew every season. Will you invest in perennial vegetables and fruit trees for a long-term revenue stream? Career path

You'll start your first plot with just a handful of plant options and basic equipment. Demonstrate your expertise through Career Challenges, to permanently unlock new seeds and more advanced equipment. These will be available for each new farm you start.

Regional variety

The crops you can grow vary with each region, as do the requests from the local populace. You might be asked to deliver a large consignment of purple carrots or several crates full of wine. If you're willing to design your farm around them, you'll be rewarded with bursts of cash and career XP that will propel your farm to the next level. An optimiser's dream

Analyse the breakdown of your worker's time card to identify the waste. Tweak your layout to minimise walking distance and maximise productivity. Smarter than your average

Spend more time planning and less time micro-managing, as your workers make smart choices about what to do next. Use the default parameters, or tune them so that your workers' priorities are aligned with your own.

Choose your pace

Free from time limits, you can explore the game's systems at your leisure. On the other hand, efficient play will lead to fast progression and more complex gameplay. Plantlife neither rushes you, nor holds you back. Choose your scale

Run a speciality microfarm and watch every step of your product's journey from seed to sale. Or employ fifty workers across a large-scale horticultural empire, utilising the data to inform your next business decision.

Start growing today with Plantlife !

games.name: IAFT Fear Diagnosis
games.shortDescription: A new kind of horror game that builds a stage just for you from the results of a fear diagnosis. Scary, and a little funny. Heights, tight spaces, bugs, ghosts, even paperwork: your fears combine into over 2 million stages, so no two runs are alike. Too scary? Exclude any fear in the settings.
games.aboutText:
A test site built from your fears, and only yours

The Institute for Applied Fear Technology studies human fear. You are its newest test subject, and your first task is the Fear Diagnosis.

Heights, tight spaces, darkness, ghosts, bugs, dolls, being in the spotlight, and everyday horrors like work and paperwork. Based on your answers, the Institute builds a test site made just for you, a giant set inside the facility assembled from the fears you can't stand.

Different every time you play

- Over 2 million stages : how you answer decides which fears rise to the top, and how they are combined

- Stages built from your diagnosis : an office floating in the sky, a corridor that keeps getting narrower, a party hall packed with balloons, a forest built on a soundstage, a circus after closing time... Where you go and what happens there depends on your results

- Short runs of about 10 minutes : take the diagnosis again and again to test your own personal fears. The questions change a little each time

- Collection : every place and trap you experience is recorded, and you can see how many are still waiting for you

- Your fear type : save an image of "your fear type" from the results screen

- Free demo : try the diagnosis and the stages with a selection of fears

Scary, and a little ridiculous

An attendant with a paper bag over their head guides you with excessive politeness through test sets that are unmistakably handmade. Built with a slightly rough, nostalgic low-poly look.

Leave out the fears you can't handle

This game depicts phobia-related situations such as heights, bugs, confined spaces and trypophobia. You can exclude any fear in the settings. Excluded fears never appear in your stage, even if they top your diagnosis.

From the developer

I used to avoid horror without ever giving it a chance, until a friend recommended a mockumentary novel. After that I fell for the genre completely, from horror games to horror films.

What scares people isn't only ghosts and the supernatural. Heights, tight spaces, things we can't even explain why we fear. I wanted to pack that huge variety of fears, and the many ways horror can express them, into a single experience, so I made this game.

Please answer the diagnosis honestly, and enjoy fears made just for you.

Streaming and videos

Streams and videos of this game (including the demo) are very welcome. No need to contact us or ask for permission.

- Live streams, recorded videos, clips and shorts are all fine

- Monetization (ads, donations, memberships, etc.) is allowed

- A small request, not a rule: please keep the ending and the rare events out of your thumbnails and video titles, so new players can discover them

- With the microphone on, the game only measures how loud your screams are (nothing is recorded or sent). Your commentary counts too, so you can adjust "Scream sensitivity" in Settings

games.name: いるかの絵本
games.shortDescription: The protagonist of "Iruka's Picture Book" is Iruka, a young girl who dreams of becoming a picture book author. In this adventure game, you'll discover picture books hidden throughout her room and immerse yourself in the stories and worlds within their pages.
games.aboutText:
The protagonist of "Iruka's Picture Book" is Iruka, a young girl who dreams of becoming a picture book author.

In this adventure game, you'll discover picture books hidden throughout her room and immerse yourself in the stories and worlds within their pages.

Step into Iruka's shoes and see if you can create the ultimate picture book!

STORY

Iruka is hard at work creating a picture book for a competition, but she's struggling to come up with a good idea.

"What kind of picture book would win me a prize...?"

One day, she discovers a mysterious letter tucked beneath a shelf. It turns out to be a letter she wrote to her future self when she was a child.

The key hidden inside the letter leads Iruka to discover picture books in her room, and she begins to explore the stories within their pages...

Will Iruka be able to create the ultimate picture book?

Game Features

The story unfolds in Iruka's room.

While her room is presented in 3D, the game transitions into a 2D world whenever Iruka opens a picture book, allowing you to experience the story within its pages.

Story sequences are presented in a style that feels like reading a manga.

Each picture book offers its own unique story and world to explore.

From a charming town full of cats to a quirky afterlife inhabited by ghosts, and even a mysterious world of flowers...

With so many different worlds to discover, this game offers an experience that feels like playing several games in one!

games.name: CHARNEL
games.shortDescription: Diablo, but with guns. Descend into the crypts, where darkness reigns, the dead linger, and your light only reaches so far. In this real-time ASCII roguelike you'll uncover an arsenal of weapons, battle hordes of the damned, and navigate an ever-changing labyrinth, with one life to reach the bottom.
games.aboutText:
Diablo, but with guns.

Descend into the crypts, where darkness reigns, the dead linger, and your light only reaches so far. In CHARNEL, a real-time ASCII roguelike, you'll uncover an arsenal of weapons, battle hordes of the damned, and navigate an ever-changing labyrinth, with one life to reach the bottom.

Key Features

A packed arsenal – From pistols and shotguns to sniper rifles and belt-fed machine guns, you'll find no shortage of firepower as you plumb the depths. Just keep an eye on your ammo count.

Modified weapons – With varying quality and attachments, every gun you'll come across is unique. Silencers, extended magazines, and full-auto conversions are just a few of the modifications you'll find while scavenging for upgrades.

Battle in the dark – The crypts are poorly lit and occasionally devoid of light entirely. Your flashlight is the only guaranteed source of light and only reveals where you aim. The sound of gunfire draws enemies closer, so you'll often hear what's coming before you see it.

Explore an ever-changing labyrinth – Every crypt is home to unique dead, and every run takes a different path through them as you descend. The deeper you go, the deadlier and more numerous the enemies become, but so do the rewards.

Challenging bosses, unique rewards – Each crypt is guarded by a keeper: an enemy far more threatening than anything else you'll encounter. Conquer them to claim their cache and a chance at a unique weapon you won't find anywhere else.

No levels, one life – Your skill and knowledge of the enemy are your primary sources of progression. The guns you find and occasional shrines that grant bonuses will aid you along the way, but death is almost certain, and final.

Retro by design – An immersive isometric experience made entirely in ASCII, illuminated by torches and the flashlight on your gun. The CRT filter is optional, but encouraged.

games.name: Hex Party
games.shortDescription: 「Hex Party」 is a lighthearted company management × romance sim. A mysterious mark and a strange curse suddenly appear, while your company faces a crisis. As the CEO, can you save your company and break the curse? Make your choices and create your own story.
games.aboutText:
"Wait, I need a 'true love's kiss' to break this curse?!"

One day, a mysterious mark appears on you.
Worse, touching a man with this mark triggers a curse of forced intimacy!

By day, you are a capable CEO growing your own company.
But on weekends, it's time to get up close and personal with these men to figure out how to break the curse.
Juggling business and romance is never easy.
In this thrilling, unpredictable daily life, what kind of ending awaits you?

✦ Characters

Encounter a cast of unique characters, each with their own story and charm.

They are your co-workers by day and your neighbors in the same apartment complex by night.
Discover a whole new side to them that you never get to see at the office!

The closer you grow to them, the more their hidden sides—and the secrets behind the curse—begin to unfold.

What kind of story will you create with them?

✦ Run a Company, Fall in Love

As the CEO, you’ll plan your workload and manage your company during the week.

You'll plan tasks, manage the company's stats,
and make critical decisions each week to grow your business.

The choices you make and the way you run your company can affect its situation—
and even change how the story unfolds.

✦ Special Weekend Plans

On weekends, you can visit a character at his home or head to the office.

Spend some one-on-one time with him at home,
or work at the office to make up for any stats your company is lacking.

Will you dedicate your time to the business, or focus on breaking the curse with him?
Find your perfect work-life balance!

✦ Get Closer with the Touch System

Have a good conversation during a date to raise the mood gauge.
Your choice of dialogue can change the mood, and once the gauge is filled enough, a special touch event will occur.
Close the distance between you little by little and experience those heart-fluttering moments for yourself.

Can a true love’s kiss really break the curse?

games.name: That Damn Grass
games.shortDescription: A co-op lawn game where you start with a nail cutter. Play as a budget robot, cut an enormous lawn, collect the clippings and earn better tools while searching for a lost wedding ring. Work alone or with up to three friends. Yes, scissors are an upgrade.
games.aboutText:
An enormous lawn. A missing wedding ring. A company that definitely saved money on equipment.

Somewhere in the overgrown grounds of a mansion is a ring that needs to be found. The company has sent its budget robots to handle it. But unfortunately, you start with a nail cutter.

That Damn Grass is a co-op lawn game for 1–4 players. Get close to the grass in first person, collect what you cut and turn tiny paydays into much more capable equipment. Work alone or bring up to three friends. There is plenty of lawn to go around.

One robot cuts. Another collects. Someone takes a load back while the rest keep working—or everyone picks a different patch and calls it a plan.

Tools are physical objects you can drop, pick up and pass around. Hand your old equipment to a friend, switch jobs or help a powerless teammate back to a charging point. The grass is not the only thing you might have to carry.

Start with a tiny NailCutter. Move on to fuller snips, smooth scythe sweeps and powered trimming, then climb onto a mower and tackle the stretches that once looked impossible.

The nail cutter is the beginning, not a life sentence. Every better tool gives you a new reason to look back at the little patch where you started.

A neat cut is only the start. Scoop clippings into buckets, rake scattered grass together and guide a vacuum across the mess, watching clean ground appear beneath the nozzle.

Load up your transport and bring it back to the Company Station. From a handful of clippings to a much bigger delivery, every load gives your next purchase a purpose.

Submit collected grass for Company Credits, then choose what would make your next trip better: a more capable cutter, a bigger robot battery or more room for the grass you gather.

Different patches need different equipment. Light blades are a starting point; tougher, more valuable growth gives you something to work toward. Bring the right tool and make a better payday from the same amount of grass.

Bring your friends, tackle the mansion grounds, and try to get some mowing done. With goats, miniboats, catapults, and weapons around, staying on task might be the hardest part of the job.

There’s a missing ring to find, but returning it doesn’t have to end the fun. Keep mowing, collecting, and improving your setup—or get distracted together for another afternoon.

Small robots. Huge grass. Very questionable gardening equipments.

games.name: Playable Archive
games.shortDescription: Review with caution.
games.aboutText:
An archive from an anonymous whistleblower has surfaced containing unexplainable events. Viewing the contents of this material, as well as the exposure to and use of various symbols within have not been risk assessed.

-REVIEW WITH CAUTION-

A New England couple stumbles upon a mysterious object during home renovations. The anonymous report claims no such object was retrieved alongside the obtained footage. However, the contact has communicated the following experiences within the archive:

- Perform demonic rituals

- Communicate with the dead

- Experience multiple timelines

All information has been provided second-hand as none have been willing to review the archive personally. If, upon interacting with this material, you begin to experience unexplainable events around yourself or loved ones, please reach out to your local field office and report.

Playable Archive is 30-60 minutes long, with no save system, and must be played in one sitting.

games.name: Tropical Fishing Island
games.shortDescription: An incremental, relaxing, collectathon fishing game with D&B soundtrack and a PS2 visual style.
games.aboutText:
Collect ever larger and rarer fish, search the island for collectable flora and fauna, improve your rod, access new fishing spots and wildlife!

Level up and increase your skills:

Sell your items and buy upgrades:

Cast your line physically by swinging it like in real life:

Gameplay trailer coming soon!

No AI Used at any point in development.

games.name: ROK Reserve Force
games.shortDescription: You are a reservist. Today is training day. One goal. Early dismissal.
games.aboutText:
Reservist

You are a reservist. Today is training day.
One goal. Early dismissal.
Training Courses

Zeroing
What matters is the shot group.

Security Education
Auditorium. Chair. Drowsiness.

CPR
Keep the beat. Save the dummy.

Assault Course
Training is combat. Assault course!

Grass Trimmer
I used to be really good with one.

The Display Sherman
You can ride it!?

The Sergeant Major, Looking for Fresh Recruits

Wild Boar

And the Water Deer

Real reserve training may differ.
Especially the water deer.

This game is a work of fiction inspired by reserve forces training. All characters, units and events are fictional and are not related to any real persons, organizations or events. It is not affiliated with any military organization and has not been approved or sponsored by any organization.

games.name: Resign to Ascend
games.shortDescription: A xianxia adventure made by someone who'd had enough of work. Enter the immortal mountains of your childhood dreams. Learn spells, hunt mythical beasts, brew elixirs, forge gear, and raise your own soulbound treasure. Screw work. Let's go cultivate! Quit waiting and add it to your wishlist!
games.aboutText:
No spirit root? You can still become a cultivator here! Nine Weapon Types, One Will Feel Just Right

Each weapon type branches into three styles: giant swords, summoners, shapeshifters... Melee, ranged, control, burst... it's all here.

400+ Spells and Manuals, True to the Spirit of Xianxia

We know what you want. Switch builds cheaply. Rule the battlefield when it counts, and pull a dirty trick now and then.

60+ Bosses: the Classic of Mountains and Seas, Playable

See below. Enough said.

Four Mythic Chinese Lands and Countless Hidden Realms

This time, the myths are from the East. Kunlun, Yunmeng Marsh, the isles of Penglai...

The Celestial Star Chart

When your lifespan ends, the cycle begins anew. This time, the Four Symbols and the Twenty-Eight Mansions of Chinese myth see you back to the immortal mountains. This time, things will be different!

games.name: One More Lawn
games.shortDescription: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower, solo or online co-op up to 6 players. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding.
games.aboutText:
⚠️ For content creators: all the music on the in-game radio is mine and free to use in streams and videos, including monetized ones. I have never registered any of it in YouTube Content ID. Some people are uploading my songs under other names to file fake copyright claims. If you get a claim for a radio song, it's not legit: dispute it in YouTube Studio and let me know on Discord so I can get it taken down.

It's Saturday, 5:42 PM. The mower won't start, the beer is warm, and nobody has cut this grass in weeks.

An old man, an old mower

You're not here to relax. You're here to get it done, your way. Hold the key until the engine finally coughs to life, light a cigarette, crack a can and reach over to switch on the radio strapped to the hood. One hand on the wheel, the other one busy.

The most satisfying cut

Tall, thick, wind-blown grass that falls blade by blade under the deck. A sharp edge on every pass, clippings flying out of the chute, and stripes that follow the way you drive. When you're done, watch the whole job again as a timelapse.

Get off and finish the job

The mower can't reach everything. Climb down, grab the string trimmer and clean up along the fence, and around that one garden gnome. Out of gas? Walk to the gas can. Nobody's bringing it to you.

One more lawn

Start with your own front yard. Then the neighbors start calling. Elvira pays well, and she's picky: every blade cut, five centimeters, not one more, and nothing broken. Especially not her gnome. When you're done, she writes you a receipt. With comments.

Then, the golf course

Rubén wants the old Los Teros club back in shape: greens, fairways and tees, each at its own height. Between passes, play a couple of holes, fish the lost balls out of the pond, rake the bunkers, and pull the handbrake on the wet parking lot to see if a riding mower can drift. It can.

And then, an island

Marcela's niece is getting married on Saturday. 120 barefoot guests, no second takes. Load the mower onto an old ferry, cross the lake and mow the whole island. Drive into the water and the engine drowns (you can push it out). Also: a boat, a fishing rod, a hammock, coconuts and a beach bar.

Bring friends. Or don't.

Online co-op for up to 6 players, each on their own mower, all on the same lawn. Join with a Steam invite or a 6-digit code. Proximity voice chat, everyone's radio playing from their own hood, and plenty of ways to get nothing done: wave, point, dance, throw fruit at each other's heads, or punch a friend in the face. No damage. Just dizziness.

Take a break. Or don't.

Fire up the barbecue in Elvira's yard and keep an eye on the smoke while you mow. Toss your empties into the bin from the mower seat. Juggle the fruit from the table. Have a few too many and watch the stripes get creative.

Make your own lawns

A built-in map editor: paint grass, sand, dirt and paths, dig ponds, raise hills, plant trees, put up fences and place as many gnomes as you dare. Hit Test Drive and mow it. Share your maps on the Steam Workshop and play the ones other people make.

Features

- A first-person riding mower with a steering wheel you can see turn and a mechanical dashboard: hold-to-start key, blade switch, deck-height lever, lights, fuel gauge and a radio.

- Dense, living grass that reacts to the wind, the wheels and the blades. Real stripes, clean edges, flying clippings.

- Four jobs: your front yard, Elvira's backyard, Rubén's golf course and Marcela's island. Each client judges your work, and each one has opinions.

- Get off the mower: string trimmer, gas can, rake, golf clubs, fishing rod, boat. You can even swim.

- Online co-op for up to 6 players with proximity voice chat.

- Gestures and dances, fruit throwing and punches between friends.

- Map editor with Steam Workshop support.

- Bring your own music: load audio files from your PC into the tractor's radio. Optionally share the sound live with friends in your session (only music you have the rights to share). Files are never uploaded or sent. Streamer Mode turns it off.

- Steering wheel and pedals with force feedback, gamepad, or mouse and keyboard.

- 22 languages.

- He smokes, drinks, coughs and complains. He doesn't care. He's still the best at this.

Streamers: the built-in radio music is free to use in streams and videos, including monetized ones. Music loaded by players (yours or your friends') is not: turn on Streamer Mode to block it.

games.name: Undaria
games.shortDescription: Undaria is a co-op PvE extraction RPG about exploring a kingdom that dug too deep. Ride the Great Lift into vast stylized voxel caverns, fight the Blighted, and return with loot and survivors to rebuild the town, repair the Lift, and open the way to deeper layers.
games.aboutText:
Undaria is a cooperative, PvE-focused extraction role-playing game set in a huge stylized voxel world that lies beneath a once-great kingdom.

In ancient times the people of Undaria constructed the Great Lift and went down deep into the earth, where they found vast caverns, strange civilizations, and resources which transformed their kingdom. However, their expansion ultimately led them to the Blight, a corruption that spread through the depths, distorted its inhabitants, and caused the downfall of Undaria.

The Great Lift is once again in motion generations later.

Descend Into Undaria

You can go on your own or in company into vast underground areas containing deserted settlements, mines, forgotten ruins, dangerous creatures, and the blighted remnants of the civilisation that came before you. For each expedition, you have to decide whether to go deeper in hope of better rewards or to return to the surface before the dangers below become too great.

The more extended your stay, the greater the benefits you will receive, but anything you take underground is in danger.

Fight, Loot, Extract

To survive in the depths as you search for equipment, rare resources, and anything else worthwhile to take back to the surface, you can use melee weapons, ranged weapons, and magic. If you successfully extract yourself then your loot is yours, but if you die below the surface you could lose what you were carrying.

Death doesn't necessarily mean the end of that gear as well; if the Blight takes you, your dead character can reappear later on in an expedition as a Blighted enemy. Locate them, kill them, and you might be able to get back some of what you've lost.

Bring the Surface Back to Life

The area around the Great Lift has long been deserted, but your expeditions can cause it to be abandoned no longer. Survivors who have been rescued from below will come back to the surface and reconstruct the town near you, reopening the workshops, setting up shops, and unlocking new equipment, crafting, quests, and services.

The more advance you go underground, the more the world above starts to recover as well.

Push Deeper

When Undaria fell, the Great Lift suffered severe damage and a large part of the underground area is now unreachable. If you want to go any deeper, you'll have to explore each level, fight powerful Blighted creatures, get back the things required to repair the Lift, and make preparations for whatever is waiting down there.

As you progress towards the source of the Blight and the truth regarding Undaria's fall, each new depth introduces different environments, enemies, resources, dungeons, and bosses.

games.name: Starcore: Through the Void
games.shortDescription: Pilot a lone gunship on a desperate mission to save the rebellion in this fast-paced 2D space shooter. Dodge deadly bullet patterns, master multi-phase boss encounters, and fight across nearly 20 bite-sized stages. Do you have what it takes to survive the void, Commander?
games.aboutText:
Commander, I entrust you with this mission to save the rebellion. Carry this holodrive to Starcore, and keep the flame of hope alive in the galaxy!

Hi! I’m KnightThaal , a solo developer building Starcore: Through the Void . This is a passion project born out of a deep love for arcade classics, built to bring fast-paced, old-school challenge with a fresh indie edge.

In Starcore , you pilot a lone gunship on a desperate run through perilous Imperial gauntlets to deliver the holodrive. You won't be flying totally alone, though: as you play, the story unfolds through in-game dialogue, introducing allies like Artemis Newton, an old friend supporting you every step of the way.

🔥 What Awaits You in the Void

- ⚡ Bite-Sized, Brutal Stages: Charge through a campaign of nearly 20 fast-paced stages and checkpoints. They’re designed to test your reflexes—don't expect to survive them all on your first try.

- ⚔️ Bosses Built to Master: Drawing inspiration from games like Dark Souls and Zelda , every boss is an entirely unique roadblock. Learn their multi-phase attacks, decode their randomised patterns, and outmanoeuvre massive on-screen health bars.

- ⏱️ Chasing Perfection: Race against the clock with built-in best-time tracking to optimise your runs, with an endless mode planned down the line to keep you coming back.

- ❤️ A True Solo Passion Project: Every mechanic, level, and system is designed and hand-crafted from the ground up as an independent labour of love.

Do you have what it takes, Commander?

Wishlist Starcore: Through the Void today to join the mission and follow along with development!

games.name: Cosmicon Plague
games.shortDescription: Fight against the evil bio-organic space armada known as the "Union" in this retro inspired , action packed horizontal shmup.
games.aboutText:
Cosmicon Plague is a horizontal shmup that uses retro inspired pre-rendered graphics . You play as one of the U.E.S.R pilot, in a fight for protecting the human race.
