Your ship is fragile, but it lacks in defense. It makes it up for maximum offense . Every enemy ship you destroy will drop blue crystal that charge up your main ship weapon or weapons selected.

You also receive green gold ( velodium ) that can be used to change your weapons and get various

Other tools.

Each tool is situational, and purchasing tools is not needed to complete the game. But depending on your playstyle you might prefer more main weapons , assist turrets , bombs or more retries

However the Union will not go down without a fight, each level is filled with various enemies that are unique to that level and with the support of their super-weapons

PREPARE FOR ANNIHILATION

Humanity on its last leg against a Super Cosmic empire known as the "Union", you are a U.E.S.R pilot who is gifted and one of the best in the whole fleet

However due to many "incidents" you where deemed unstable. too expensive to let go and waste, you are forced to live at a isolated checkpoint. with only some pets to keep you company and not lose your sanity.

now the Union has planned an invasion force heading to earth. you and a small commanding force are all that stands between extinction.

-5 action packed levels

-Gallery

-Unlockables

-Different Game Modes

-Changeable bullet colors

-Scoring system

-Multiple weapon types

-Pre-rendered graphics

-Brutal Bossfights

-And More.......

games.name: Deadgate
games.shortDescription: Bir sözleşme al ve zombilerin istila ettiği karantina altındaki adaya gir. Ganimet topla, rakip takımlara karşı hayatta kal ve gece yarısından önce tahliye noktasına ulaş. Aksi takdirde yanında getirdiğin her şeyi kaybedersin. 32 oyunculu bir extraction shooter. Sözleşme yoksa çıkış da yok.
games.aboutText:
DEADGATE is a first-person extraction shooter for up to 32 players, set on a quarantined island overrun by the dead. You go in with a contract and the gear you chose to risk. Finish the job, take what you can carry and reach your exit before midnight. If you die, everything you brought stays on the island.

The free closed alpha started on October 30, 2026 and runs for about four months. It is multiplayer from the first day. Sign-ups are open on our website; you will find it in the links on this page.

Five skies, one island

Weather is rolled at the start of every raid: clear, scattered clouds, haze, overcast or rain. The same forest road is a different place each time. Fog and rain cut how far you can see, and a squad you would spot from two hundred metres on a clear day can be on top of you before you make out their shapes.

No contract, no exit

Every raid starts with a contract: download data from two terminals, carry a fuse to a power panel, collect a sample, scout three observation points, deliver a supply bag or switch on two radio relays. Your quarantine gate stays locked until the job is done. Contracts change every raid. On a chained contract, the next search area appears on your map only after you finish the current step. Rush contracts pay 50% more credits if you finish before 16:00. In a squad, the whole team works the same contract, and any member can complete a step.

- Contract complete: your quarantine gate opens. Extract with your loot, XP and credits.

- 16:40: the metro stations open as emergency exits. You keep your loot but earn no XP.

- Midnight: the island closes. Anyone still inside loses everything they carry.

The dead hear you

Hundreds of zombies roam the island, and they are placed differently every match. They see you, hear your footsteps and come for the sound of gunfire. Some shuffle, some run. A well-placed shot can take off a limb or drop one where it stands, but every shot also tells everyone nearby where you are.

Your squad

Play solo or in a squad of up to four with your Steam friends. Teammates are marked above their heads and on your compass, so you can tell them apart from strangers in the fog. Proximity voice carries about 40 metres and anyone close enough can hear it; the squad radio reaches across the island. Friendly fire is on: a stray round hurts your teammate, so mind your lines when the swarm comes through the trees.

Other squads want out too

Every other team is working its own contract, and sooner or later your routes cross. Firefights are loud, and the dead come to the noise. Their names are never shown to you; a figure moving between the cars is a question until it raises a weapon.

Pack for the risk

- Pistols, revolvers, shotguns, an SMG, assault and battle rifles, a crossbow and a scoped hunting rifle, plus knives, bats and fire axes.

- Light, medium and heavy armor, helmets, backpacks and a chest rig.

- Everything you carry counts toward a 30 kg limit. The heavier your load, the slower you move and the sooner you run out of breath.

- Search homes, shops, the hospital, military sites and abandoned car trunks for food, water, medicine, ammo and valuables. Some of the best gear can't be bought; you have to find it.

Wounds need treatment

Six body regions can be injured or badly injured. Bleeding drains a separate blood reserve, and hunger and thirst wear you down. Treating a wound takes a few seconds, lowers your weapon and slows you down; if you are hit, the treatment stops and nothing is used up. The HUD shows a compass, the time and your ammo. Your health and gear live in the inventory.

The island

The island is about 1.5 km across, with nearly 2 km² of land and roughly 6 km of coastline, half cliffs and half beaches. It is split into 25 named areas: a valley city, a high-rise district with two towers you can climb, villages, farms and greenhouses, an industrial zone, a quarry, a military camp, a state hospital, a cemetery, a stadium, a shantytown, a landfill, a solar plant and a wind farm. A river runs through the middle of the island into a lake and on to the sea. Four quarantine gates and three metro stations are the only ways out.

Between the settlements the island is late-autumn forest: pine and spruce still green, oaks and birches bare, dry fern and bracken along the roads. It hides you as well as it hides everything else.

This is the map you carry in a raid. It shows your contract areas and the exits, never your position: you find your way by landmarks and the compass.

Day into night

Every raid runs from 10:00 to midnight on the island clock, about 42 minutes. The sun goes down while you work. There is no electricity left on the island: after dark the streets are lit by the moon and stars only, and there is no flashlight in your kit. The last hours are played in the dark, with the dead closing in on every sound.

Climb the ranks

Extracting earns rank points and dying costs them. Climb seven tiers in ranked seasons. Your stash, cre

games.name: Corner Cutters
games.shortDescription: Top-down racing for people who love a good fight for a corner. AI drivers defend and make mistakes. Tyres wear and grip best when warm. Rubber builds up on the line, and in changing weather the track dries where the cars drive. Best played with a controller. Race a season or go online.
games.aboutText:
Corner Cutters is top-down racing for people who love a good fight for a corner. Up to twenty cars on the grid, and nobody gives one up for free.

Drivers who fight back

They race for real: they look for gaps, defend their place and try the inside when you leave room. Sometimes they get it wrong. Push someone off or cut a corner, and the stewards will notice.

Best played with a controller

The triggers give you full control of the throttle and the brake, and the rumble tells you what the tyres are doing. You feel a wheel lock under braking, the tail start to slide, the kerbs, the grass, a worn tyre and a flat one. In another car's slipstream, the pad shakes in the turbulent air. You can also drive with a keyboard, and every menu works with a controller.

Tyres and pit stops

Soft, medium, hard, intermediate and wet. Your tyres wear out and need the right temperature to grip. You choose when to pit, and the crew does the rest: new tyres, and repairs if you need them.

Dynamic track

With changing weather on, rain can start in the middle of a race, and stop again. When it stops, every car's tyres push the water off the track, so a dry line appears where the cars actually drive, with more grip than the wet track beside it. Stay out on wets, or gamble on slicks?

In a dry race, the track starts clean. Every car leaves rubber where it drives, most of all in the corners where the tyres work hard. Lap by lap the line gets darker and gives a little more grip, so you can get on the power earlier. The AI drivers feel it too.

Three classes of car

- Formula: open-wheel cars, the fastest. A flap on the rear wing opens on the straights.

- GT: heavy cars, with the engine in the front, the middle or the back. They slide more.

- Roadster: small cars with little power. If you brake too much, it takes a long time to get your speed back.

Eleven circuits

Race through a harbour, a neon city at night, a desert canyon, sand dunes by the sea and a bowl with steep banked corners. Seen from above, one circuit is shaped like a raven. And one is a figure of eight that crosses itself on a bridge, because why not.

Championships

Pick your circuits and race a season of 2 to 20 rounds, with a team-mate and a teams' title to fight for. Finish on the podium and there's champagne.

Online

Host a room on Steam or on your local network for up to twenty people, and fill the empty places with AI drivers if you like. Every room has text chat and can run its own championship. On Steam you can turn on voice chat: you hear the drivers near you on track, and a team-mate over the radio.

Time trials

Set your best lap alone on any circuit, and race against your own ghost to find the last tenth.

Good to know

- Replays: watch your races back and follow any car you like.

- Liveries: paint your car in your own colours, with 18 patterns, some earned with achievements.

- Your own music: music is personal. Turn the game's music off, or drop your own songs in a folder and they play in the menus and the races.

- Camera: set it as close or as far as you like, also during a race, and choose whether it zooms out as you go faster.

- Steering wheels are not supported, and the game is in English.

Win something. Anything.

A note from me

Hi, I'm Ferdi! I've been making games for over twenty years, and I love motorsport. Watching a race, sim racing, a day of karting with friends: for me, nothing beats a good fight for a corner. That's what I wanted in a game, so I made Corner Cutters: easy to pick up, with racing that's real. I've driven thousands of laps on these circuits during development, and I'm still finding faster lines. If something feels off, or you just want to say hi, let me know. I read everything.

I hope you have as much fun racing it as I do.

games.name: Nyaukimoe
games.shortDescription: Nyaukimoe is an anime and pixel art style catgirl Metroidvania platformer. Play as Nyaukimoe, fighting and exploring dark areas with a Cat Scratcher and glowsticks, searching for her lost sister.
games.aboutText:
Nyaukimoe is a cute catgirl Metroidvania platformer with anime and pixel art styles. Play as the adorable catgirl Nyaukimoe as she searches for her lost sister, exploring night forests, underground passages, and abandoned ruins.

The story takes place in dark nights and shadowy indoor facilities. The catgirl carries glowsticks, carefully navigating through dimly lit environments.

Explore interconnected areas, using your glowsticks and newly acquired abilities to open new paths and venture deeper into unknown places.

You can use the Cat Scratcher that you find as a melee weapon to knock thrown glowsticks away. The high-speed glowsticks will deal higher damage.

You can also toss a glowstick into the air, then use the Cat Scratcher to strike it downward and launch yourself onto higher platforms.

Features

• Classic platforming and Metroidvania exploration

• Throwing glowsticks and Cat Scratcher melee combat

• Various combo moves using the Cat Scratcher and glowsticks

• Cute Chibi catgirl characters

• Hand-drawn pixel art scenes

games.name: No Trail Back
games.shortDescription: Survive a wild valley in the Polish mountains from golden October into deep winter. Fell trees, carry the logs and build your own log cabin by hand, keep your fire alive through blizzards and long nights, explore the old mines, and keep an eye on the treeline. You are not alone here.
games.aboutText:
Whoever leaves the trail belongs to the mountain.

No Route Back is a survival game in a valley in the Polish mountains: a big lake at the bottom, meadows and forest, small ponds, rocky peaks all around, and old mines deep under them.

The game starts on the 15th of October and goes all the way into deep winter. Every tree loses its leaves at its own pace. Rain, fog and the halny, the warm wild wind of the Polish mountains, which melts the snow and can break whole trees. The first snow comes in patches, then covers everything; you leave footprints that new snow slowly fills. The lakes freeze over, and the blizzards leave you almost blind. The sun moves as it does over a real town in the Polish mountains: in winter the days get short and the nights get long.

Warmth is a need, like food and water. At night your fire is your only light and your heat, and when the cold wins, you start losing health. Snow settles on your clothes on the side the wind comes from, and melts by the fire.

Collect sticks, stones and branches, fell trees with your axe and carry the logs one by one. Make a camp with a campfire, a tent and a bedroll, or build a real log cabin with no blueprint: lay the floor from split logs, raise the walls log on log wherever you want, then cut out a door and a window with your axe.

Old forest roads with puddles, stone huts you can walk into, places with things to find, and old mines that broke into a natural cave, with rails, carts and a hut deep underground. There are useful things down there. It is also dangerous.

Wolves come for the meat you carry, circle your camp and react to what you do. And there are people in this valley: a band of cannibals that lives in the woods. Fight back with your axe, or stay out of their sight.

An original map we draw ourselves, built on what we made from real data of the Beskids and the Tatras.

Coming next

More places to find, more in the mines, and co-op, so you can survive the valley with a friend.

games.name: Lost Bitcoin
games.shortDescription: Lost Bitcoin is a digging and automation game set in a gigantic junkyard. Collect scrap, burn it for coins, buy upgrades and build a factory that works for you. Crack crates and safes, and check every USB stick to find your lost Bitcoin wallet.
games.aboutText:
Somewhere beneath this gigantic junkyard lies your Bitcoin USB stick. Find the right one among many.

1. Collect and Burn

Pull scrap out, carry it to the furnace and throw it in. Every piece pays coins. The deeper you dig, the more it pays.

2. Buy Upgrades

More than 60 upgrades in a skill tree, and more are planned.

3. Collect More and Burn More

Suck up a whole tank of scrap and shoot it into the furnace. And there are many more ways to farm more efficiently and progress faster.

4. Build a Factory

Up on the deck you build a factory of your own. Cranes lift scrap out, belts and sorting gates send it on, and machines turn it into rubber ducks, piggy banks, arcade machines and little robots. It earns money while you dig.

5. Check USB Sticks and Find Treasures

USB sticks are everywhere, and they all look the same. Only the computer on the platform tells you what is on one. Along the way you find crates, safes, golden pieces and an entire sailing ship buried under the scrap. Cut your way in. Maybe you'll find your Bitcoins and get rich.

6. Wishlist This Game

Wishlist Lost Bitcoin so you don’t miss the release.

games.name: Last Truck Out
games.shortDescription: Ride in with up to 4 friends, loot a zombie-infested town to hit the cash quota, and get back to the truck before the horde takes the zone. Proximity voice, monsters that make everyone run, and a truck that will not wait forever.
games.aboutText:
The truck drops you off. The truck leaves. The truck comes back. Be on it.

Last Truck Out is a top-down co-op extraction horror game for 1 to 4 players. Your crew rolls into a zombie-infested town, splits up to scavenge anything worth cash, and races to haul it back to the pickup before the run turns into a horde. Three runs. One quota. Miss it and the whole crew is done. Scavenge together

Search houses, stores, wrecked cars and crashed helicopters for cash loot, weapons, ammo and medical supplies. Heavy loot like safes takes two hands, so somebody has to carry while somebody covers. Noise gets you killed

Zombies hunt by sound. Gunfire, sprinting and that airhorn you just found all pull them in. Quiet melee keeps you alive. Panicking does not. Everybody run

Monsters break the routine. The Charger rams anything in its path, the Grabber drags friends into the dark, and the Screamer calls every zombie in town to your location. Survive long enough and something bigger comes looking for you. Hear your friends scream

Proximity voice chat means you only hear the people near you, so the friend who wandered off to loot one more house is on their own. Find the truck

The pickup parks at a new extraction point every run, and nothing points to it. Load the loot in the bed, spend it at the truck shop on guns, ammo, armor and upgrades, then decide: leave now, or risk one more house. Features

- 1 to 4 player online co-op through Steam (invite your friends), or play solo

- A new town every run: procedural streets, buildings, wrecks and loot

- 3 runs per match against a cash quota, with a scoreboard at the end

- 6 zombie types, 3 monsters and 2 bosses

- Zone events: supply drops, bounties, boss nests, vault heists and survivors to rescue, with legendary loot

- Guns, melee, grenades, flares and a flamethrower, with upgrades from the truck shop

- Day and night, rain, snow and fog

- Hand-painted 2D art by the artists at CraftPix, put together and extended for this game by SizilStank

- Full controller support and rebindable keys

games.name: Kingdom.py
games.shortDescription: A town builder you play in real Python. Write the scripts your heroes run: build, farm, collect taxes, fight off bandits, trade with six islands. Then script the townsfolk too, down to personalities their children inherit.
games.aboutText:
You don't click to build. You write Python.

You start on a small island with one hero, a town hall and a file called main.py:

change_profession(Builder)
build(House, 3, 4)
build(House, 3, 8)

Press Run. The hero walks to the plot and builds, one line at a time, while the editor lights up the line being run. If a line is wrong, the game points at it and says why in plain words.

A town builder whose economy runs on your scripts

Houses pay taxes, but only when someone comes to collect. Lumberyards stop when their groves run out. Fields have to be sown, then harvested before the grain rots. Bakeries turn grain and wood into bread, mines eat bread, smithies turn iron into tools. Bandits row in and rob homes unless a guard gets there first, and merchant ships sail off if your goods aren't on the pier in time.

Each of these is a small program, and the story walks you through them. Its chapters open Python step by step, the way the tree opens buildings: variables, while loops, if, for, lists and dicts, functions, modules. One collect() becomes a loop, the loop learns to check the stock, the check becomes a function, and one day four heroes run four programs that split the work through a shared database.

Then the townsfolk move in

They take jobs at your workplaces, get paid, shop at the market and pay taxes. They chat on street corners, fall in love, marry, have children and grow old. Some of them steal, and some of the watch take bribes. The dead wander the streets as friendly ghosts until you build a graveyard.

You can script them too:

- Every trade follows a shift program you write. shifts/farmer.py tells the farmers where to help, when to carry and when to rest. Run two versions on alternate shifts and compare the reports.

- town.people() reads the whole town. Arrest a suspect, play matchmaker with town.match(), issue decrees.

- Each person's personality is six small Python functions: love, work, hands, conscience, warmth and temper. Children take each one from their mother or their father, and now and then something new turns up. Write a rule of your own, have the Ministry of Propaganda announce it, and watch it spread through the generations.

Six islands, one market

Build the Trade Guild and trade with six neighbouring islands at live prices. Storms, strikes and festivals move the market. Sell by hand with market.sell(Wood, 50), or write a trading bot that reads the news wire. The islands also send commissions and, if you turn git on, pull requests to your scripts. Read the diff before you merge.

A real coding desk

- Code windows float over the island or tile like an IDE, with highlighting, autocomplete, snippets and a Python console that answers questions about the town.

- ps, top, kill and cron in the console. Every program in the kingdom is a process, even the crabs'.

- Git with commits, branches, merges and tests that run before every commit.

- The real numpy, pandas, matplotlib and requests. The requests are carried by pigeons.

- An algorithms room where ten algorithms run step by step next to your own version.

- Your scripts are plain .py files. Edit them in VS Code and the game picks up the change.

Never coded? The story is written for you.

Short chapters, a Code School with examples you can run, hints, and a reference solution for every chapter. A newcomer needs about eight hours for the story. After it come the grand projects: a lighthouse, an observatory, a great granary, a cathedral and a royal palace, each costing a small fortune.

games.name: One Last Dance Please!
games.shortDescription: A rhythm-driven incremental game where every beat builds a bigger party. Rally your dance crew, earn cash and go wild with upgrades. Draw your own characters and bring your favorite music. The bills can wait for one last dance... right?
games.aboutText:
Just one song, you said. So why is the dance floor full again?

One Last Dance Please! is a pixel party that gets bigger with every beat. Mix rhythm gameplay with incremental upgrades, rally your dancers and turn stage earnings into an even wilder night. Bring your favorite music and characters you draw yourself. This is your dance floor.

Tap in. Get down.

Catch the beat and get those little dancers moving! Tap, grab, release and drag as new dancers bring their own moves to the party. One more round? Of course.

Why dance solo when you can bring the whole crew?

Gather dancers of the same color and send a whole crew onto the stage. Chase the spotlight, soak up the cheers and watch the cash roll in. Think that crew was big? Wait for the next one.

Dance. Upgrade. Do it bigger.

Unlock dancers, explore the upgrade tree and turn a little dance hall into a packed pixel party. Bigger crews, flashier stage effects, extra steps and encores: there is always another combo to try.

Draw a dancer. Start a party.

Your dance floor needs a new star. Draw your own character with the in-game pixel editor—even their dance poses are yours to design! Cool, cute or wonderfully weird: watch your creation bounce to the beat. Your favorite song is on next

Bring your own music into the game and dance to the songs you love. Your characters, your soundtrack, your kind of party. Please, just one last dance!

The floor is packed. The bills are piling up. Time to get the crew back on stage and turn that farewell into an encore. This really is the last dance. Probably.

games.name: Orbit Wreck
games.shortDescription: Blast through waves of enemies in OrbitWreck, a fast-paced 2D space shooter! Pilot unique ships, dodge deadly attacks, collect Scrap, and unleash powerful special abilities.
games.aboutText:
SURVIVE THE CHAOS OF SPACE

Enter the battlefield in OrbitWreck , a fast-paced 2D space shooter developed by Lunarhellgames.

Pilot your ship, face waves of hostile enemies, dodge incoming attacks, and manage your weapon heat to stay in the fight. Collect Scrap during combat and unleash powerful special abilities when the situation gets dangerous.

Every encounter is a chance to improve your skills, discover your ship's strengths, and push your survival limits.

FEATURES

- Fast-Paced 2D Combat: Fight waves of enemies in intense arcade-style battles.

- Multiple Game Modes: Play Campaign, Endless, Tutorial, or Duel against AI opponents.

- Distinctive Ships: Choose your ship and make use of its unique special ability.

- Heat Management: Keep firing, but watch your weapon heat to avoid overheating.

- Scrap-Based Specials: Collect Scrap and spend it to unleash devastating attacks.

- Enemy Variety: Face different enemy types and adapt to their attack patterns.

- Progression and Unlocks: Work toward unlocking more content and expanding your available options.

TAKE CONTROL. STAY ALIVE. FIGHT BACK.

Choose your ship, master its abilities, and see how far you can go.

Welcome to OrbitWreck .

games.name: プライマリ・ブルーム
games.shortDescription: 高度なAI技術の発展により、大きく変化した世界。主人公のザニアはただ一人、人の手から生み出された植物たちを取り戻すため、研究を続けています。部屋で植物を育て、咲いた花をSNSで世界に広めていく、ドット絵・横スクロールのSF×ガーデンシミュレーションです。
games.aboutText:
人の手で、もう一度花を咲かせる

高度なAI技術の発展により、大きく変化した世界。赤毛の少女の学者ザニア・トワイライトは、人の手から生み出された植物たちを取り戻すため、ただ一人で研究を続けています。目標は、もう一度人の手で花を咲かせ、その花を世界に広めることです。 部屋で花を育て、世界へ届ける

舞台はザニアの部屋です。展示・育成・休息の3つのスペースが横に並び、キャラクターが歩いて行き来します。

- 育成スペースで、シャベルや水、肥料を使って植物を育てる

- アシストAIのロボット「ベル」をグレードアップして、作業を楽にする

- 育てた花は、部屋のパソコンからゲーム内のSNSに投稿して広める

- 窓の外を見ると、投稿が街にどう影響したかがわかる

- 本棚では図鑑やキャラクター紹介を読める

登場人物

- ザニア・トワイライト ：主人公。園芸の知識は完璧ですが、それ以外はからっきし。母からもらった植物辞典を大切にしています。

- ルカ・モルフォニア ：ガスマスクをつけた「遺物商人」の少女。世界から消えたモノを扱い、腐れ縁のザニアに協力しています。

- ベル ：D.E.M社製のアシストAIのロボット。人と同じ動きができ、喜怒哀楽まで再現されています。

キャラクターたちの掛け合いにも注目してください。

games.name: NUMISMATOR
games.shortDescription: A cozy digging and coin-collecting game with the three felt puppets of the Balanzone Troupe. Dig to a rhythm while your companions race each coin to the bucket, or teleport it there. Every coin is real history, with a museum photo and its own story in the troupe's travel log.
games.aboutText:
NUMISMATOR

The Balanzone Troupe Lives Underground

The Balanzone Troupe lives underground.

Three felt puppets of the Commedia dell'arte ride a basket down the well...

they dig through the mounds and write every coin they find into the troupe's travel log.

Numismator is a cozy single-player digging and collecting game.

You choose who goes down...

the other two become your companions.

Every coin you find is a real piece of history.

DIG TO THE RHYTHM

Break the soil, wait for the red, strike and stamp...

Keep the rhythm and the coin rises from the mound.

YOUR COMPANIONS DO THE RUNNING

The nearest companion snatches the coin from your hands.

Send them racing to the bucket, or teleport them there through the portal.

At the well, take aim and throw...

hit, and the bucket rises with a receipt; miss, and try again.

FILL THE TRAVEL LOG

Every coin opens its own page...

a museum photograph, a pencil drawing,

and that mysterious story of where it was struck and whose hands it passed through.

You travel to Rome, Byzantium and many more eras...

41 coins in all...

Every era has its own chapter...

RARE COINS GET A SHOW

Find a special coin and the troupe puts up a stage in the square.

Raise the coin high, or pass it from hand to hand...

The puppets haggle...

boast,

bow.

You can skip the show. (But don't. This is where the fun is.)

DOORS, PUZZLES, DARK WATER

The tunnels are divided by doors.

Every door has its price and its code.

The layered eras in the walls, rotten planks and coin slots open the way.

Deep below, a stage covered in colourful patches...

a rusty key...

a dark canal crossed by boat...

are waiting for you...

THE TROUPE

Arlecchino

Nimble and never still.

Never loses his way.

Dottore

The troupe's scholar...

Tells a coin's century at a glance,

if he can find his monocle. (He's easily flustered. Help him out.)

Capitano

All moustache and swagger.

Breaks through stone walls...

afraid of nothing,

except almost everything.

Each of them has their own little routines: their lazzi.

Each one meets whatever happens in their own way.

P.S.

BEFORE SUNRISE

The clock runs until sunrise. Coins not yet in the bucket turn into little birds and fly away.

Scattered into eternity...

On the next expedition, the troupe picks up where it left off.

FEATURES

- Single-player, with two puppet companions

- 41 real historical coins, each with its own story and drawing

- Rhythm digging, no combat

- Doors, codes and puzzles from every era

- A hand-made travel log with period chapters

- The puppets speak Commedia-style gibberish (grammelot)

- Buy once: no in-game purchases, no ads

WHERE THE JOURNEY STANDS...

Numismator is being made by a small independent studio in Istanbul.

Release is planned for early 2027, with a demo before launch.

Wishlist to hear when it's ready.

Our aim is to bring different disciplines of art together into one shared story...

games.name: Hillbilly Yacht Club: Fishing
games.shortDescription: A free fishing game made by one guy who has been making fishing games since 2008. Catch 100+ weird fish for the fridge door, work your way up from an Oak Branch to the Necro-pole, win the weekly derbies, beat real players 1v1, and tune the deck radio: 4 stations, DJs and 160+ original songs.
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the Hillbilly Yacht Club. Nobody hands you a membership. You earn it on the water: land bigger, weirder fish than everybody else, and prove it in the derbies.

One guy has been making fishing games since 2008, and this is the new one. You start in a row boat with an Oak Branch for a pole and a bucket of chum. You are going to catch something big anyway.

Toss chum, watch the slick spread, and see what rises out of the murk. Shapes in the water, a bobber that twitches, then the strike. Set the hook and fight it home.

A mime. A chainsaw marlin. A ninja. A shark painted red as a devil. 106 of them swim in 3D today, more join every update, and over 2,000 are already drawn and waiting their turn. Every one you land gets its photo stuck on the fridge door, and every one you haven't is a shadow on it.

Crates, steamer trunks, army footlockers, iron strongboxes and sunken pirate chests come up on the line. Pry them open with the crowbar for bucks and parts. Take the parts and bucks to Earl's workshop, and he levels up your pole so it can land bigger fish. Five poles to start, from an Oak Branch to a Necro-pole, and eleven more on the ladder.

Weekly and monthly derbies: the biggest fish wins, and chests go out by rank. Take on other players' real catches in Rival matches, and bring your crew in with a link.

Bluegrass, swamp blues, island and rock, with DJs, callers and ads for things nobody should buy.

games.name: Escape the Walls
games.shortDescription: You're surrounded by walls. All you have on you is your hands. You have to punch your way through, no other choice.
games.aboutText:
Escape the Walls is an incremental game, where you start with only your fists and punch your way through walls

Punch. Upgrade. Fight Enemies. Go deeper each time

Danger hides behind every wall

The only way is forward

Try to Escape the Walls!

games.name: Shelter for Stalkers
games.shortDescription: Lead a community of survivors in a post-apocalyptic bunker. Overcome scarcity, grow the economy, earn money, and choose your own path in politics and governance. Make your shelter thrive: money and influence are not the goal, but the means to fulfill your ultimate mission—saving the world
games.aboutText:
After the nuclear catastrophe, children stopped being born. But a rumor spreads across the wasteland that a child was born in an underground bunker. By the time you find it, the bunker is abandoned.

Survival is only the first step. Your main goal is to find a laboratory that could restore humanity’s ability to have children.

Build an Underground State

Protect your people from hunger and cold, stockpile supplies for natural disasters, and turn an abandoned bunker into a functioning base. The bigger your shelter grows, the harder it is to govern. Each social class has its own demands, and each political faction has its own interests. Decide whose demands to meet, who to negotiate with, and who to stand up to.

Lead a Shelter Where Stalkers Live Their Own Lives

Shelter for Stalkers is a 2D sandbox that simulates each stalker individually. Every resident has their own needs, skills, and money. Stalkers find jobs, work their shifts, spend what they earn, and take care of themselves. You decide what to build, how much to pay, and what to charge. The stalkers handle the day-to-day work.

Fight Your Way to the Lab

Track down the bunker’s former residents and find out what they know about the lab. Getting there will cost a fortune. Turn a profit through trade, compete for supplies on the market, outfit expeditions, and fight battles in the wasteland. Once you find the lab, decide how to get its equipment. Negotiate a handover, buy it outright, or take it by force.

games.name: Shimagurashi: Island Life
games.shortDescription: Move to a quiet island in southern Japan and take life at your own pace. Drive your little kei truck along the coast, go fishing, carry lumber to build a home, and shop at the corner store. A slow-life game about bringing the lights back to a fading island, one house at a time.
games.aboutText:
Take it easy on a small island.

Shimagurashi: Island Life is a slow-life game about moving to a small island whose people have slowly moved away, living at your own pace, and bringing the lights back to the island one by one.

Drive the coast road, go fishing, build a home, and shop at the local store. When something catches your eye, take a little detour. Enjoy everyday life on the island. Things to do on the island

Drive

Cruise the coast road in a kei truck, coast downhill on a bicycle, or cross the bay by boat. If a road looks interesting, go see where it leads.

Fish

Drop a line from the breakwater or the rocks. Eat your catch or sell it. Waiting for a bite while you watch the sea is part of the fun.

Build

Carry boards and walls by hand and put them together to build a house. When the sun goes down, the lights come on in the home you made yourself.

Shop and sell

Sell the fish you caught, and pick tools and everyday goods off the shelves at the Shiokaze Store. Anything you order arrives on the ferry.

Grow

Till a field and plant rice in the paddies. As your crops grow and the seasons turn, the island changes color.

Play

Line up empty cans and knock them down with a stone. Skip stones across the sea. Stack things up, or float them on the water. Play with whatever is around, just like when you were a kid. An island that never rushes you

The islanders are living their own days, too. You might see them dropping by the store or pass them on the road. As time goes by, the island's scenery and where its people spend their time change as well.

Spend the whole day fishing, or just drive along the coast. Rainy days have their own things to do.

Watch the sunset and head home to a house with its lights on. How you spend today is up to you. The island I remember, inside a game

I grew up in the Goto Islands in Nagasaki, Japan.

Driving the island roads, gazing at the sea, dropping by the shops I knew. I wanted to make a game where you could spend that kind of island time.

This island is layered with the scenery and the everyday life I remember. What I always wanted to make was a game where you could spend that kind of time.

games.name: How They Built the Pyramids
games.shortDescription: A chaotic online co-op building game for 1–8 players. Make bricks, build a giant pyramid and turn a small operation into a massive automated production line. Work together, hire help and find increasingly ridiculous ways to get those bricks to the top.
games.aboutText:
There are plenty of theories about how the pyramids were built.

You and your friends have one too. It involves 23,426 bricks, a lot of hard work and probably a few questionable decisions.

How They Built the Pyramids is an online co-op building game for 1–8 players. Start by making bricks from Nile clay, then work together to build a 65-metre pyramid, one block at a time.

It's a lot of work. Luckily, you don't have to do it all by hand.

MAKE BRICKS. LOTS OF THEM.

It all starts with a bit of mud. Turn raw clay into bricks, improve their quality and find ways to make the whole process faster. You'll be making a lot of them.

GET THEM UP THERE

Carry bricks, toss them to your friends or find your own way of getting them to the top. Just make sure you're not standing underneath when something comes crashing down.

MANY HANDS MAKE LIGHT WORK

Bring your friends along, split up the work and get a proper operation going. Still need more hands? Hire some Shabti to help out. Just remember to keep them happy.

BUILD YOUR EMPIRE

What starts as a few people carrying bricks eventually becomes something much bigger. Build, connect and automate your production. Let the machines do the heavy lifting while you focus on getting that pyramid finished.

THERE ARE EASIER WAYS. BUT WHERE'S THE FUN?

Launch your friends across the pyramid. Send bricks flying through the air. Experiment with some rather unconventional construction methods. There is more than one way to get a brick where it needs to go.

ONE VERY BIG PYRAMID

26 layers. 65 metres tall. 23,426 blocks.

Finish the pyramid together, then keep building. Raise monuments, earn blessings and see just how far your little operation can go.

FEATURES

- 1–8 player online co-op. Build together, divide the work or get in each other's way.

- 23,426 blocks to place. One giant pyramid, built by your crew.

- Build and automate. Turn a small brick-making operation into a fully running production line.

- Get some help. Recruit little workers to take care of the less exciting jobs.

- Find creative solutions. Carry, toss, launch and transport bricks in all sorts of ways.

- Grow stronger. Improve your abilities and carry more as your operation grows.

games.name: House of Open Hands
games.shortDescription: Build and manage a temporary home for people facing difficult times. Hire and train a care team, get to know your residents, and make choices with lasting consequences in a social-care management game where progress takes many forms.
games.aboutText:
A place to stay can be the start of something more.



In House of Open Hands, you run a temporary home for people navigating difficult periods in their lives. Give them somewhere to settle, bring together a capable care team, and decide how to use limited space, money, and time.



Behind every management decision is a person who needs something different.



Build the space for better support

Start with a small home and expand across multiple floors. Add residential rooms, offices, counseling spaces, kitchens, and shared facilities. Choose what to build and when: a larger home can welcome more residents, but it also needs staff and resources to support them.



Get to know your residents

Residents have strengths, personalities, and challenges that reveal themselves over time. Help someone prepare for an interview, navigate practical responsibilities, or rebuild a daily routine. What you learn about each person can change which approaches are available.



Choose a team that fits

Hire workers with different skills, traits, and specializations, then assign them to residents. Develop their abilities through training and balance their energy and caseloads. The right combination of people and facilities gives you more ways to respond.



Make choices and live with the consequences

Care rarely offers a perfect answer. Choose how to respond to personal problems and unexpected events, and see the effects on residents and the wider home. Some outcomes arrive days later. Progress, setbacks, firm boundaries, and continued support all have a place.



Guide the home through each day

Watch residents and staff follow daily routines as day turns to night. Pause to plan or adjust the game speed as your home grows. Research new facilities and insights, manage finances and reputation, and work toward campaign milestones before continuing in sandbox play.



Success can mean a step toward independent living, a steadier routine, or simply being ready to try again.

games.name: DataCenter Tycoon
games.shortDescription: Build your own Data Center, from a single rack in a garage to a hall full of the latest Hardware. Wire power, cooling and network by hand, keep the machines running, vibe code Products and launch your own AI platform to finance the whole thing. Solo or in online co-op with up to three friends.
games.aboutText:
From one rack in a garage to a hall full of the latest hardware.

DataCenter Tycoon is a first-person tycoon game about running a Datacenter.
You start with a single server rack in a garage. Every rack you place, every GPU you install and every cable you lay is your own work, and every one of them earns the money for the next.

Build it by hand

Place server racks

Fit them with CPUs, GPUs, memory and power supplies.

Power everything and keep it cool.

Run power cables, coolant hoses and network lines yourself, with distributors and junctions to keep the aisles tidy.

Run an AI company

- Plan AI products in Agent Ops, put your racks to work on them and take them live.

- Train your own model generations and launch your own AI platform.

- Grow your business. More Racks, better hardware, bigger locations

Keep it running

Generators break down and networks drop out, gotta take care of that.

Better with friends

Play solo or invite up to three friends. Split the work: one manages the hardware, one watches the money. And in between there is coffee.

Want to take part in the development journey? Join Our Discord!

DataCenter Tycoon is still in active development, and we want to build it together with you. Join our Discord to sign up for playtests, share your feedback and bug reports, and pitch your own ideas for new hardware, features and mechanics. Every suggestion gets read, and the best ones end up in the game.

games.name: Townlet
games.shortDescription: A tiny medieval village lives on top of your taskbar. Every file you delete falls from the sky, and its little villagers turn your digital trash into new ideas, buildings and festivals. Watch a lone campfire grow into a walled town while you work.
games.aboutText:
A village that lives on your desktop

Townlet is a tiny pixel-art village that lives in a thin strip just above your Windows taskbar. It only shows when your desktop does, never steals focus and never pops up notifications. Seven-pixel villagers chop wood, hammer at the forge, gossip in the square and head home when night falls, while you get on with your day.

Your trash is their treasure

Every time you delete a file, it drops into the village from the sky. The villagers carry it to the square, study it and turn it into knowledge. Pictures inspire artists, documents fill the scribe's shelves, music brings minstrels to town. Discoveries unlock new buildings, decorations and events, so no two villages grow the same way. Townlet never opens, moves or deletes your files. It only notices what kind of file landed in the Recycle Bin and how big it was. Nothing ever leaves your computer.

From campfire to walled town

Start with a single campfire and grow through village, town and city into a walled town with its own castle

Real seasons and a real day-night cycle: blossoms in spring, snow in winter, lantern light at night

Rain, storms, fog and starry skies

Markets, fairs, a town crier with the news, travelling minstrels and many small surprises

Pick up a villager and drop them somewhere else, just to see what they say

Decorate the village your way and design its banner

Keep a village ledger of your discoveries, history and the events you've seen

Take a picture of your village and share it

Calm by design

Nothing ever goes wrong in Townlet. No deaths, no famine, no fires, no lost progress. The village only ever grows. A soft seasonal soundtrack plays while your desktop is in view, and the village quietly fades out the moment you open a full-screen window.

games.name: 가문의 영광
games.shortDescription: A single-player RPG focused on hunting and loot. Hunt automatically or take control in an anime-style world, collect and enhance rare gear, and grow through transformations, doll companions, family traits, and rebirth. No extra payments for progression or draws.
games.aboutText:
Hunt and farm at your own pace

Develop a Knight, Elf, Mage, or Dark Elf and explore five regions across 50 floors. Farm through auto hunting in an anime-style 2D world, then take direct control of movement and skills whenever you want to face a boss.

Rare gear, crafting, and enhancement

Turn materials found on monsters into weapons and armor, enhance your equipment, and fill your collections. Regional clear chests, artifacts, blessed reflection armor, and enhanceable talismans offer more goals to work toward. Collect transformations and dolls without extra payments

Discover new forms through transformation contracts and companions through doll races. Draws consume tokens earned in the game or bought with Aden. Fuse four duplicate transformations or dolls of the same grade for a chance at a higher grade. After buying the game, progression requires no extra payments, and there is no real-money gacha. Grow your family, then begin again

Combine character nodes, family nodes, and family traits unlocked through level 90. Select one unlocked family trait for each of the four classes. Choosing another replaces it, and the four selected effects are combined across the account. At level 100, use a Rebirth Potion to grow again from level 1 while building permanent bonuses.

Challenge battles with your family's characters

Face enemies and bosses with your family's characters in the Endless Arena and Dungeon. Change the conditions of Custom Maps with equipped stones and their combinations. In the Infinite Tower, choose cards, upgrade facilities, and protect the guardian tower from incoming enemies.

A world to enjoy solo

Talk with AI guildmates and buy supplies or list spare items on the NPC market. Choose Dopamine, Easy, Normal, or Hard to suit your preferred pace. Each difficulty has its own separate save space.

games.name: SHRED A BILLION
games.shortDescription: SHRED A BILLION is a first-person incremental game about a mountain of money! Grab bills by hand, scoop them with a bucket, level up and feed a billion dollars to the shredder. Only 999,999,999 bills left to go!
games.aboutText:
One billion dollars. One shredder. You.

A gigantic bank vault is buried under money up to the ceiling — mountains of bills and bundles. Your job is simple and glorious: dig through all that wealth and feed it to the shredder. Every bill pays out, every upgrade makes you faster, and the mountain keeps shrinking.

Grab, scoop, suck it up

Start with your bare hands: grab bills one by one and carry them to the shredder. Then go bigger: a bucket, a shovel and a powerful vacuum that pulls money in a swirling vortex. When your hands get tired, launch drones — they mine and haul the cash without you.

Upgrades you can't put down

- Over 100 upgrades for your tools, the shredder and your drones

- A skill tree with branches for your play style

- Boosts, relics and golden banknotes for the long run

- Numbers climb from your first dollars to trillions — and beyond

A secret at the bottom of the vault

The vault goes five levels deep. The deeper you dig, the bigger the bills. Shred every last bill, pick up the golden key and open the massive door at the bottom. What's behind it? Find out for yourself.

Better together

Play solo or invite up to three friends to online co-op. Shared progress, one shared mountain of money, voice and text chat — dig together, argue about who buys the next upgrade, and shred a billion as a team.

Features

- A cozy first-person incremental game

- Exactly one billion banknotes in the vault, counted down to the very last one

- Online co-op for up to 4 players with voice chat

- Drone automation — up to 16 drones dig and haul the cash on their own

- Five signature moves: ARMFUL, HEAVE, GROUND POUND, OVERLOAD and RALLY

- The jetpack lifts you out of any pit

- Customize your thief and find hats in buried chests

- A Steam leaderboard for the fastest vault clear, solo and in co-op

- 100 Steam achievements

- Fully localized into 30 languages

games.name: Forsakia
games.shortDescription: Gear up at your hideout and fly into the exclusion zone in this top-down pixel-art extraction shooter. Search mission areas solo, or team up with up to three friends for co-op raids. Bring your loot home by helicopter.
games.aboutText:
After the Silent Shutdown, the freight zone was evacuated and sealed. At the freight yard, a radio still broadcasts. At the Core Foundry, the furnace never went out. The Greyline contractors guard the facilities worth holding, scavengers pick through what was left behind, and old machines keep carrying out orders nobody is there to cancel.

In Forsakia, a top-down pixel-art extraction shooter, you play a bounty hunter working out of an old railway station. The Returners keep the hideout supplied and the rescue flights running. Take a job, board the helicopter, and decide how far into the zone you're willing to go for a payout. Explore regular mission areas solo, or tackle raids alone or in online co-op with up to three other players.

Deploy, search, extract

Pick your loadout, fly into the zone, and chart a route through freight sheds, factory corridors, or the streets and courtyards of the Broken-Bridge District. Beyond them lie a jungle relay station, a frozen observatory, and the Windworn Quarry, each with its own terrain and weather. Take a detour for a promising cache or head for an open extraction zone and wait for pickup. On a regular sortie, you can bring home a worthwhile haul without clearing the map.

Fight your way through

The same footsteps that warn you of a patrol can give away your position. Nearby enemies investigate gunfire and movement. Break line of sight with walls, doors, or smoke, then decide whether to go around or fight with firearms, melee weapons, and throwables. In raids, use a pass card to get through the sealed gate, complete the objectives, and defeat the boss to open the final exit.

Loot and prepare

Unidentified loot first appears as an outline in your inventory. Identify it, rotate bulky equipment, and split ammo stacks to make room for medicine or spoils. The next crate might hold a useful part, but every extra stop is time spent inside the zone.

Back at the depot, turn in contracts, trade with the residents, and stash what you want to keep. Fit compatible sights and attachments at the gunsmith's bench, test them at the range, and build your next loadout around armor, runes, and perks. Some contracts turn up clues about what happened during the evacuation. The next job takes you back into the zone with better gear and a better idea of what to look for.

games.name: Gnomageddon
games.shortDescription: Roguelike tower defense meets the gnome apocalypse. Pick upgrades, build towers and defend your garden from hundreds of thousands of gnomes.
games.aboutText:
A roguelike tower defense set in the gnome apocalypse. You are the last human alive: place towers, choose upgrades, and defend your garden from hundreds of thousands of gnomes.

Before each run, design your starting garden and choose the buildings that best fit your strategy. You can pick buildings that give you passive boosts to stack synergies, or go for active abilities.

Defend against increasingly large hordes of gnomes. Kill enemies to earn XP, strengthen your towers, and choose upgrade cards that transform your defenses. There are different gnome species, each with their own weaknesses, so your tower selection has to account for all of them.

After each wave, select a new hexagonal tile to expand your garden. Every tile has its pros and cons, so choose wisely how you want to expand.

Your starting buildings, upgrade cards, towers, and expansion choices all work together. Discover synergies between different systems, experiment with new combinations, and develop increasingly powerful strategies to survive the gnome apocalypse.

- Hundreds of thousands of gnomes to slaughter

- Three gnome species, each with different weaknesses

- A variety of towers with different damage types and effects

- Customizable starting gardens with passive and active buildings

- Upgrade cards and tons of possible synergies

- Procedural hexagonal map expansions with strategic trade-offs

- Powerful active abilities, including nuclear strikes

- Destructible buildings and voxel-based destruction

games.name: Bad Company
games.shortDescription: Never enough firepower or room for loot? This multiplayer extraction shooter has the cure! Form a convoy with friends or quirky AI buddies. Start with basic rifles, storm forts in tanks, and haul maps clean with heavy trucks. Backpack full? Drive off with the crates and the vehicle!
games.aboutText:
Think bigger! Take a wild gamble from scavenger squad to mechanized army!

In this dangerous, absurd exclusion zone, looting on foot just doesn't cut it anymore. Beneath the cute exterior, heavy artillery meets armored might. Lurk in the shadows as a lone-wolf ambusher and pick off passing convoys, or build up an armored force in the late game and enjoy steamrolling the battlefield. But remember: if your squad gets wiped, those painstakingly customized guns and fully loaded trucks become someone else's loot!

Key Features

- Round up the crew: real friends and questionable AI buddies Forget the despair of fighting entire squads alone, or waiting for friends to come online! Bring your real-life buddies along, or hire and train AI companions with wildly different personalities. Have them cover your advance, soak up enemy fire, carry your loot, or man vehicle-mounted machine guns. These dependable—and occasionally troublesome—digital lifesavers let you field a full tactical squad whenever you want.

- Heavy-duty extraction: tanks lead, semitrucks haul! Think a stuffed hiking backpack counts as a big haul? Think again! Our arsenal goes from deep gun customization all the way to heavily armed vehicles:

- Serious gun customization: Mix and match hundreds of attachments. Build an ergonomic close-range bullet hose or embrace the absurd with a blinding monstrosity sporting five tactical flashlights. Make it your own.

- Firepower unleashed: Unlock true beasts of steel in the late game! Bring infantry fighting vehicles and even main battle tanks into combat. Blast open the heart of the restricted zone with heavy machine guns and tank cannons, crushing its defenses head-on!

- Loot like a moving company: Out of backpack slots? Back a heavy semitruck straight into the warehouse! With a tank clearing the road, turn your squad into a battlefield moving company and haul away the entire map's high-value supplies in one truckload!

- A dangerous, dynamic battlefield: brilliant tactics, spectacular disasters Huge maps built for infantry–tank cooperation and convoy raids deliver danger and comedy in equal measure. The more firepower you bring, the deadlier the hunters you attract. Watch for rival squads hijacking your convoy, rampaging scavengers carrying anti-tank rocket launchers, and giant bosses lurking deep inside fortresses. Hardcore ballistic penetration and physics-based vehicle damage can turn any operation into pitch-black comedy. One moment you're leading a textbook CQB breach; the next, a buddy has rolled your loot-packed semitruck into a ditch, leaving the whole squad scrambling to salvage the haul just short of extraction!

- Industrial hideouts and black-market empires: from scavenger to arms tycoon Want to keep an armored convoy running? Build a logistics empire first! Manage and expand your private underground base between raids. Start with a basic medical station and gun workbench, then upgrade to heavy-vehicle service garages, ammunition production lines, and enormous freight warehouses. Sell the truckloads of loot you bring home on the open black market and flea market. Influence prices, buy low, sell high, and rise from a penniless dumpster diver to an industrial arms magnate dominating the exclusion zone.

Your shopping list is ready:

- Gather the crew: Call up your real friends, or pick a few AI partners in crime back at base.

- Gear up: Finish your dream gun build, load the tank with armor-piercing shells, and fill the semitruck with diesel.

- Clean them out: Smash through the blockade, level the boss's lair, cram everything you can into the trailer, and floor it toward extraction!

Hands on the wheel, main gun loaded—may your haul be rich, convoy commander!

games.name: Taenera's Offer
games.shortDescription: A sci-fi extraction shooter on a dying desert planet. Scavenge weapons, supplies and valuables, take risky contracts, and fight your way to extraction. Use precise aiming, acrobatic dodges and physics-driven tricks to survive — and earn enough to escape.
games.aboutText:
A DYING PLANET. ONE WAY OUT.

The planet is falling apart. You're a mercenary trying to earn enough to leave it behind. Taenera, a mysterious organization controlling access to valuable locations, offers a way to make money — if you're willing to take the risks.

RAID. LOOT. EXTRACT.

Explore abandoned facilities and hostile settlements. Search for weapons, ammunition, supplies, equipment and valuables. Fight androids, the infected and other threats, collect what you can carry, and make it out alive.

Sell your haul, manage your resources, upgrade your capabilities and unlock new locations. Every expedition is a chance to get richer — or lose your gains.

FIGHT YOUR WAY

Aim for different body parts, switch between weapons and use dodges, rolls and jumps to evade attacks. Enemies have different strengths and weaknesses, so standing still and holding the trigger won't always be enough.

Grenades roll and bounce through the environment. Knives follow ballistic trajectories. Explosions can destroy targets and trigger environmental interactions.

Experiment with the tools around you and turn the battlefield to your advantage.

TAKE THE CONTRACT — OR GO YOUR OWN WAY

Taenera offers contracts with specific objectives, logistical support, transport and extraction. Complete the assignment to earn your reward.

Prefer to operate on your own terms? Pay for your own expedition and go after whatever you find, without contract objectives.

But every trip costs money, and every decision carries risk. Choose your gear, decide what to take with you, and know when it's time to get out.

HOW MUCH ARE YOU WILLING TO RISK?

Earn money. Improve your equipment. Unlock new opportunities. Get closer to your escape from a dying world.

Taenera has an offer for you. Make it count.

games.name: Crystal Surge
games.shortDescription: Crystal Surge is a top-down extraction shooter with roguelite elements. Scavenge ruins, combine gear and random blessings, plan routes and deploy turrets. Fight with guns and powers, then extract to trade loot and grow stronger. Leave now or face a boss? Die and lose everything you carry.
games.aboutText: Crystal Surge is a top-down extraction shooter with roguelite elements. After an alien invasion forces humanity to retreat to base, fighters empowered by crystal cores venture back into the ruins. Search monster-infested streets for supplies, collect gear, and combine random blessings to shape your build. Plan your scavenging route, deploy turrets, and take on powerful enemies with guns and supernatural abilities. Bring your loot back to base to trade for resources and grow stronger. Extract with what you've found, or take on a boss? Careful: go down out there, and you'll lose everything you're carrying...

games.name: Home Sweet Bunker: Bunker Tycoon
games.shortDescription: A darkly funny bunker management sim. Build down, admit survivors at the gate and pray none of them is infected. Every night something new tests your layout: diggers from below, crawlers in the vents, spores in the air, screamers drawn to your generators.
games.aboutText:
LET THEM IN. FIND OUT LATER.

The world ended on a Tuesday. You've got a hole in the backyard, a shovel and a line of strangers at the gate. Some of them are carpenters, cooks and nurses. Some of them are hiding a bite.

SINCE LAUNCH

Eight free updates in the first ten days, nearly all of them from what players reported:

- Specialists at the gate: a field surgeon, a master builder, a combat veteran and more, worth taking a chance on

- Pick each guard's gun, send a second scavenging team out, and treat people in their quarantine cell

- A memorial wall for the people you lost, and an album that keeps the photos of your run

- A stray dog that follows the family in, and roofs that go on by themselves over what you build in the yard

- The bolt gun, steel walls, a drill rig, and wishes from your people to grant

- A gentler first week, and four more languages: 20 in all

CHECK EVERYONE AT THE GATE

Look them over, take their temperature, read their papers and go through their bags. Then stamp it: Admit, Quarantine or Turn Away. Everyone has a story. Some of them are even true. Get it wrong and you'll find out days later, in the middle of dinner. The checks are hands-on. Shine the penlight in their eyes, put the stethoscope to their chest, run the UV lamp over their hands and see if anything glows green. Whatever you find gets pinned on their chart, and R&D and the workbench get you better tools.

BUILD DOWN

Dig through soil and rock, pour concrete, raise walls and hang blast doors. Build dormitories, a mess hall, hydroponic farms, generators, air filters, water purifiers, a med bay and a quarantine ward. Start in a backyard shelter for six and work your way down to a ten-level mega-bunker for three hundred. Mine the rock for stone, iron, copper, silver and gold, cut down the trees on your lot, and turn it all into wood, concrete, steel and parts at a saw bench, a cement mixer, a furnace and a workbench.

PICK YOUR NEXT SHELTER

On the way down, move into a shopping mall's basement, a county hospital's or an army base's bunker. The mall comes with the stores' stock and more walkers out shopping at night. The hospital has a med bay and more of the sick at its gate. The base has an armory, and its nights hit harder.

SEND THEM OUT

Send a couple of your people out for supplies: the Gas-N-Go on Route 9, Kessler's Hardware, the sheriff's office. When something goes wrong out there they radio in, and you decide whether they pry the door or walk away. You can watch them on the county map the whole way.

KEEP THEM ALIVE

Food, water, power, sleep, morale - and air. Every survivor breathes, and every generator is loud. Give people jobs, set the daily schedule and keep an eye on who's coughing.

EVERY MONSTER TESTS SOMETHING DIFFERENT

Walkers pile up at the door. Diggers tunnel up through the floor. Vent crawlers come in through the air ducts. Spore carriers poison the air. Screamers follow the noise of your generators. And some nights, everything comes at once. Your radio warns you before dark. Use the time. HOLD THE NIGHT

Turrets, traps, sandbags, searchlights and guards with very little training. Combat runs on its own, and you can take control of your guards when it counts. In the morning, count the losses, patch the walls and open the gate again.

BREAK IT

In the sandbox, turn the threat up a hundred times and watch thousands of them press in round one hatch. Ring the yard with diesel trenches and light the lawn. Lay a field of blast mines and press the button. Then look at the whole bunker at once, ten levels deep, everyone in it going about their day. Photo mode hides the interface for the screenshot. A DARK COMEDY OF THE APOCALYPSE

A clean isometric cutaway of a 1980s civil defense bunker: hazard paint, lamplight, CRT terminals and a shelter kit from a company that promises everything will be fine. It won't. But the monsters are cartoony, and nobody's insides end up on the outside.

OUT NOW

The hatch is open. Start digging, or try the free demo with the backyard shelter first.

games.name: Mad Rat Cafe
games.shortDescription: Top-down roguelite about a post-apocalyptic cafe where you cook orders and shoot your way through mutant waves. Fix broken kitchen machines and stack wild upgrades to survive every shift.
games.aboutText:
You are working in a last-standing cafe , armed with a spatula in one hand and a gun in the other. Find a way around dealing with orders, mutants, and breaking machines at the same time!

COOK AND SHOOT

Prepare dishes, play machine minigames and fix machines that break mid-shift, all while gunning down the mutant waves flooding your cafe.

PICK YOUR KITCHEN

At every location, you draft a new machine. Arrange your kitchen setup, unlock new dishes, and use active machine skills that power up both cooking and combat.

SPEND YOUR EARNINGS

Complete orders to earn cash and bonuses, then spend it in the shop on upgrades that power up both your cooking and your shooting.

MAKE BROKEN BUILDS

Combine upgrades into broken builds that can turn your whole cafe into an unstoppable bullet-hell machine!

games.name: Last Skull
games.shortDescription: Take a ship into hostile waters, plunder islands, wrecks and rival captains, then make it out before your time runs out. Whatever you bring home is yours to keep. Sink, and what you carried is left floating for someone else.
games.aboutText:
LAST SKULL is a pirate game about greed and getting away with it.

Every voyage starts in port. You fit out your ship, load your cannons and sail into waters shared with up to nine other captains and whole fleets of hostile ships. You have thirty minutes to find what you came for and reach a way out, and every other sail on the horizon could be the one that sends you down.

Bring your haul home and it is yours. Go down and it is left floating for whoever finds it first.

-

Raid wrecks, sea chests and islands, take on towers and rival fleets, and pick through the barrels other captains leave floating behind them.

-

A nimble Sloop carries one mast and one cannon, a balanced Brigatte two of each and a heavy Galleon three. Fit them with the sails and cannons you choose, line up your broadside, lead your shots and break a rival's masts before they break yours.

-

The way home is never free. Reach an escape point such as Echo Cave with your hold full and your hull in one piece, or become another wreck on somebody else's map.

-

Everything you carry home feeds the next voyage. Craft cannons, sails and hulls, take on work from the traders in port, grow your skills to learn better recipes and raise your Skull Level to command bigger ships.

-

Dye your sails and fly your own emblem from the Shipyard. Upgrade to paint the whole ship, open every emblem and sail with your canvas torn as a warning.

LAST SKULL sails into Early Access in 2027. Add it to your wishlist to hear the moment the seas open.

games.name: Starfell
games.shortDescription: Classic JRPG exploration meets modern beat ’em up combat. Explore a stylized fantasy world, unlock powerful abilities and battle the armies of Varkhaul to save Eldoria.
games.aboutText:
Slay orcs, unlock abilities and face menacing bosses as you defend Eldoria from the armies of Varkhaul. Starfell combines classic JRPG exploration with fast-paced, beat ’em up-inspired combat.

Fight the Dark Lord’s armies in brutal, fast-paced combat.

Stand against monstrous foes and the dark power of Varkhaul. Eldoria won’t fall without a fight.
Unleash devastating magic and powerful special attacks. Make the enemy fear you.

Rest by the campfire, wander through bustling towns, make new friends and discover the rich world beyond the battlefield.

games.name: Afterglow Interstate
games.shortDescription: A relaxing synthwave motorbike ride through neon cities, glowing seas, desert dunes, aurora skies and zero-gravity tubes, all moving to an expanding soundtrack. Just drive, or take on the beat, your echo, and your friends whenever you feel like it.
games.aboutText:
You know the feeling of driving with a song you love turned up, streetlights sliding past, and nowhere you need to be?

Afterglow Interstate is built around that feeling. It's a synthwave motorbike game where the city glows in time with the music, the sun hangs low overhead, and the only thing asking for your attention is the road.

This is where most rides begin, and where a lot of them stay. There's no score or timer, so you can pick a song, settle into a lane and ride towards the setting sun.

Every so often the road has something waiting for you. A ramp might send you up through a line of rings in the sky, or a portal might drop you onto a looping track floating among the stars. Sometimes a helicopter swings in to follow you with its spotlight, at least until you open the throttle and leave it behind.

Every piece of the environment changes with the music and pulses with the beat, with new environments being procedurally created as you travel.

Stay on the road long enough and the skyline starts to thin out. Maybe the towers give way to sand dunes, or the road rises onto a causeway over a sea that glows wherever it meets the shore. Maybe it dips into a tunnel and brings you out into snow, with the northern lights rippling overhead.

There are wind farms whose turbines turn with the tempo, red rock canyons, and a network of tubes where you can ride the walls all the way round. The order is different every time, so it's hard to say what's waiting past the next bend.

The music came first, and everything else was made to follow it. Towers light up on the kick drum, lamp posts pulse down the road one after another, and the song lifts a little as you pick up speed, then settles again when you ease off. When a track starts to build, the traffic builds with it.

The game has its own soundtrack of original synthwave. If you would rather ride to your own music, add it from your PC and the road will learn the beat and adapt the game to the new music.

Some days you might want something to aim for. Flow rewards keeping your speed up and slipping neatly through traffic. Beat lays gates along the rhythm of the song for you to ride through, from Easy for a relaxed run to Hard if you want a real challenge. Echo Race puts a hologram of your best run beside you, and each time you beat it, it waits a little further ahead on your next try.

It's nice to have company on the road. Up to four of you can ride the same song together as glowing holograms. Whoever has ridden furthest when the music ends takes the win. Invite friends through Steam, or jump into a quick match with global matchmaking.

Every ride earns some Chrome to spend in the Garage. Paint the bike candy red or teal pearl, pick your neon, and choose a trail, from a spray of sparks to an oscilloscope that draws the song onto the road behind you. Your echo wears your colours too, and your friends see them whenever you ride together.

We made Afterglow Interstate as a family, to help us deal with some heavy things. It's meant to be somewhere to go when you need a minute, to zone out or unwind. Somewhere to put some music on and give your head a bit of room.

The whole game is built with positive mental health in mind, and it tries to gently remind you that it's okay to not be okay.

games.name: Americana: The Dead Years
games.shortDescription: Fight zombies and hostile survivors in a first-person voxel survival sandbox. Scavenge fallen towns, repair vehicles and smash through destructible buildings. Build a home, rebuild bridges, hunt, fish and farm to stay alive.
games.aboutText:
The dead roam the streets. The living shoot back.

Americana: The Dead Years is a first-person voxel survival sandbox set across the towns, farms and back roads of a fallen American county. Fight for supplies, get a vehicle running and find a place to call home. When a wall stands in your way, break through it.

Fight for every supply run

Face zombies and hostile survivors with firearms, bows and melee weapons. A quiet search can become a firefight, and staying alive means knowing when to push forward and when to retreat.

Take the back roads

Salvage parts, repair abandoned vehicles and take the fight onto the road. Fuel, batteries, engines and tyres matter. Keep your ride running and drive through the dead on your way to the next town.

Break your own way in

Smash windows, tear through walls and carve routes through destructible voxel buildings. Scavenge what you need, open an escape route or bring the place down around you.

Build beyond survival

Raise a home in the wilderness, reinforce your shelter and barricade its openings. Rebuild broken bridges to reconnect your routes across the county. Turn the materials you salvage into somewhere worth returning to.

Live off the land

Pursue wildlife through the woods, cast a line by the river and plant a garden. Cook your catch, collect rainwater and boil it before drinking. Keep food, water and shelter in reach as the weather and seasons change.

games.name: One Last Cast
games.shortDescription: One Last Cast "is a tabletop game. Place the scenery of lakes and mountains in a corner of the screen, and let your friends accompany you to leisurely fish and collect fish species from various places. Encounter rare and exotic fish, complete local commissions, and upgrade fishing equipment
games.aboutText:
Place a fishing trip in a corner of the table.

The work has come to an end, and the fishing float has just started to move. The orange cat that accompanies you sits on the shore, and the underwater fish swim slowly - what will you catch this time?

"One Last Cast "is a pixel style desktop AFK fishing game. Let the fishing scene accompany you through daily life, watch the harvest and organize equipment when you want to rest, and then prepare for the next stop. You can fish slowly, or you can carefully consider throwing the rod next time for a desired fish.

Leisurely hanging up, there are also worth pondering next steps

Let the character automatically fish and come back to check the fish basket during busy breaks. Sell fish catches to accumulate coins, purchase fishing equipment, and gradually challenge more substantial goals. Different fishing spots, fish species, and water layers require suitable bait and equipment; Find the right combination to add more anticipation to the wait.

Follow the fishing float to different places

From West Lake in Hangzhou to Lake Biwa, and then to distant lakes and wetlands, each stop has different scenery, fish species, and local commissions. Get to know the fish here and collect anecdotes that belong here, making each stop a memory on the journey.

Collect fish species and wait for unexpected surprises

Gradually light up the fish encyclopedia, break your weight record, and also pay attention to those rare and colorful fish. The next time you harvest, it may be a familiar old friend, or it may be a harvest worth stopping to appreciate.

Accept the commission and ensure that every harvest has a destination

After receiving the local commission, newly caught fish that meet the conditions will be prioritized in the commission schedule, while other harvests can be arranged freely. Complete the commission, receive rewards, and then decide whether to strengthen existing equipment or save money for the next journey.

I have companions fishing with me, and I also have manuals to collect and reminisce about

Unlock companions and make the shore more lively; Leave your favorite fish in the aquarium and en joy it slowly. Open the travel manual, review the scenery and records along the way, or save the current page as a picture to share your fishing trip story.

Don't rush to the finish line, there are still new possibilities hidden in the water in front of you.

Did you agree on the final shot? Another billion rods.

games.name: YATAI: A STREET COOK'S TALE
games.shortDescription: Cook Japanese street food with your own hands: toss noodles in a wok, grill yakitori, fold gyoza. Start with a tiny cart by the station, feed the city through rain, snow and festivals, and work your way up from a humble stall to an elite restaurant.
games.aboutText:
A Knife Instead of a Sword

His whole life, the father raised his son to become a martial arts master. But the son wants only one thing — to be the best cook. "Then go and cook," says the father. And you leave home with nothing but a wooden cart.

Hands-On Cooking

You make every dish with your mouse, just like in a real kitchen: chop vegetables with a knife, toss noodles in a wok, turn skewers on the grill, fold gyoza and spin takoyaki.

Your Menu Grows With Your Cart

Buy equipment and arrange it yourself on your cramped counter. New dishes mean more customers and more money. Shop for ingredients in the morning, work through the day, count the takings in the evening.

A City With a Life of Its Own

Office workers rush to catch their trains, tourists snap the shinkansen from the footbridge, someone bows at a tiny shrine. When people get hungry, they come to you — just don't keep them waiting too long. Seasons and weather change, and so does what your customers want to order.

Festivals

In summer and winter, it's matsuri time. In the evening the festival grounds fill with crowds in yukata, lanterns, fireworks and a special menu.

Earn reputation and money to swap your little cart for a big yatai, open your own shop, then a restaurant — and, in the end, an elite restaurant.

games.name: Sundered Reach
games.shortDescription: Rise from cadet to commander in a living star system. Build your warband, fight real-time fleet battles, board enemy flagships and lead sieges with up to 1,500 soldiers per side, while something stirs at the edge of the Reach.
games.aboutText:
Sundered Reach is a space strategy RPG inspired by the sandbox campaign of Mount & Blade, the battles of Total War, the space and ground war of Star Wars: Empire at War and the relationships of Mass Effect.

Start as a cadet. Earn your ship. Build a warband and decide which of the great powers you fight for, or against.

Every war in the Reach is fought twice: by fleets in orbit and by armies on the ground. Win the battle above a world, send down your troops and take it wall by wall.

- Your story starts on foot at the Ilith Academy.

- Train at the shooting range, race in the Ilith Cup and go on missions with your squad.

- Voiced story scenes with your mentors.

- Graduate, and take command of your own ship.

- One star system and a hundred worlds: mining planets, research stations, ice moons and the wreckage of shattered planets.

- Planets move on real orbits. Recruit troops in every settlement, trade and take contracts.

- 104 map events, pirates, raids and wars between 11 factions.
