- Three great powers: the industrial Karthan Combine, the scientific Aurelian Concord and the alien Threnn Shoal.

- Encounters become fleet battles in real time.

- 13 ship classes, from fighters to dreadnoughts, with shields, beams, missiles and point defence.

- Command the whole fleet or take the helm yourself.

- Board their flagship with boarding pods.

- Battles and sieges with up to 1,500 soldiers per side and 30 troop types.

- Shield wall, testudo and phalanx. When the lines meet, every soldier finds his own opponent.

- Shield domes, trenches, ladders and gates. Walls break, and the artillery needs its crew.

- Human war machines: the Foreman mech, the Anvil tank, the Jackal buggy and the Derrick walker.

- The Threnn bring living ones: the Kharrak, the Ossuun, the Shael and the giant Thuulmar.

- Fight on forest worlds, ice, steppe and the red sands of Mars.

- 36 lords, notables and companions who remember what you did.

- Contracts, favours, intrigue and diplomacy.

- Calls from your bridge. Key scenes are voiced.

Freighters stop coming home. Stations fall silent. People blame pirates, or the Threnn.

Over the course of the campaign the Vesk rise from the edge of the system, and the war for the Reach becomes a fight for survival.

Sundered Reach launches in Early Access. At launch you play the human factions, and more factions will follow as DLC.

The game is built for modding: factions, troops, events, items, vehicles, characters and dialogue are already plain data files, and full mod support is a core goal. Multiplayer, controller support and more languages are planned during Early Access.

games.name: Driving At Night
games.shortDescription: And the lights　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 Of the city at night　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 Go by like beacons in space　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 And our fears　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 Feel a lot like hope　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 When seen this way
games.aboutText:
Driving at night
We lost ourselves in the road
Threw our fears out the window
And watched them spin away

An endless highway where the road and the world around your car adapts in real time to any music you're listening to. Terrain slopes away as intensity increases, streetlights pass on beat, and the painted world pulses in time with everything.

Supports Spotify, YouTube, local files, or anything else your PC can play locally. The game reads in audio from your own system.

More intense music creates a more intense driving experience. Try to improve your ranking on a song, or simply relax and drive.

Driving at night
We found some time to breathe
Shone our brief headlights
Over this black sea

Driving At Night is a full driving sim, not an on-rails audio visualiser. Drive your car with keyboard, controller, or racing wheel. The world adapts to your driving, so your driving doesn't have to adapt to the world.

I also make my own music under the name Balatran. An album of music comes with the game, which you can listen to if you're not listening to anything else.

This is a small single-developer project that I've wanted to make for some time. Thank you for checking it out.

Driving at night
The past was our direction
And somewhere in reflection
A glimpse of what might be

games.name: Flarefall
games.shortDescription: Flarefall is a co-op horde RTS for 1–4 players. Land on the Florida coast, build one shared base by day and hold it by night against the horde, with present-day infantry, armour, boats, helicopters, air strikes and a destroyer's guns.
games.aboutText:
Land. Build. Hold the night.

Palm City, Florida, has fallen. Your task force comes ashore by landing craft with a few hours of daylight to dig in. When the sun goes down, the city comes for you: the horde, drawn by noise, light and scent, piling against your walls and climbing over each other to get in.

Up to 4 commanders, one base

Play solo or with up to three friends. Every commander leads their own forces, but the base, the walls and the supplies are shared. Split the work, gift units to whoever needs them, and drop in or out mid-operation.

Build by day

- Engineers raise HESCO walls, gates, MG nests, watchtowers, floodlights and mortar pits.

- Rescue survivors, salvage scrap, keep your vehicles fuelled and keep enough power for the guns and lights.

- Research upgrades, and take your veterans into the next operation.

Hold by night

The horde is simulated, not faked: every zombie moves, piles up and spills over your defences. Runners, Screamers and Brutes break the rhythm.

Light the perimeter, hold the gate and keep the ammunition moving.

Call in land, sea and air

- Riflemen, snipers, flamethrowers, Humvees, Bradleys and Abrams tanks.

- Landing craft, patrol boats, transport and attack helicopters, and drones.

- Off-map support: a destroyer's fire missions, F-15E gun runs and bombs, and an AC-130 gunship at night.

Three operations in Palm City

Landfall, Boardwalk and Mercy General: a beachhead, the seafront and a hospital overrun by a nest of the infected. Present-day, grounded and realistic, with no magic and no super-soldiers.

games.name: Tidesong
games.shortDescription: Trade your office job for a brass diving helmet and a little farm on the sea floor. Grow kelp and sea grapes, raise urchins and tuna, befriend the merfolk of Coral Cove and wake a bleached old reef back to life in this cozy underwater farming game, alone or with a friend in online co-op.
games.aboutText:
All your life you've yearned for the deep. Then an unsigned advert offers a farm on the seabed for a single sand dollar, and at last you put on the brass helmet.

Far below the waves lies Coral Cove, a village of divers, merfolk and fishfolk gathered around the Old Coral, a great coral that has bleached white and gone quiet. Make the run-down farm your home, get to know your new neighbours, and find out what it will take to make the reef sing again.

Farming, the underwater way

- Rake the sand and grow 29 crops, from sea lettuce and nori to giant kelp, sea grapes, glowing algae and luminous coral.

- There's no watering down here: silt drifts over your crops every night, so mornings start with your brush.

- Four ocean currents take the place of seasons, each with its own crops, weather and festivals, all the way to snow drifting down onto the seabed in the Deep Cold.

- Raise purple urchins, spider crabs and bluefin tuna, bring up a seahorse foal you can ride, and keep a baby octopus, a googly-eyed urchin or a round little seal pup as your pet.

- Dry, press and polish your harvest in machines you build yourself, cook 38 dishes on a stove inside an air bubble, and age sea-grape wine in your own cellar.

- Build out your diving-bell home with a new wing, a glass dome and a bathysphere annex, and furnish it your way.

A village to call home

- Meet more than a dozen neighbours, each with a home, a daily routine and a story of their own: a fellow diver who never takes off her helmet, a dreamy mermaid who sings out over the reef, an old octopus chef with a twirly moustache, a gloomy blobfish librarian and a barracuda scientist in his tower.

- Win them over with gifts and conversation, and their friendship opens up scenes, secrets and stories.

- Every neighbour speaks in a voice of their own, and the whole town talks about what you've been up to.

- Six of them can be courted. Go on dates, propose with a ring you make yourself, and share your home.

- Celebrate two festivals every current, from Coral Spawning Night and the Seahorse Run to a lantern maze on Deepnight and the Spear Derby.

- Browse the wares of Old Maud, an ancient sea turtle who carries her market stall on her shell.

Wake the Old Coral

Gather offerings from your farm, the open sea and the deep to restore the reef section by section. With every section, a limb of the Old Coral takes back its colour, Coral Cove brightens around it and the shops fill their shelves. But even when the reef has its body back, it still needs its song.

Into the deep

- Dive into the Rift, a trench ninety levels deep. Mine ore, gather treasure and keep an eye on your air as you fend off its creatures, down past vent fields, glass gardens, brine lakes and bell hollows into the hadal dark, and face the three great creatures that keep its depths.

- Explore a sunken ship room by room, with locked doors to open and secrets to find.

- Follow torn sea charts that wash up in bottles to twelve buried treasures.

- Spear 43 kinds of fish through your helmet's porthole, five legends among them, and forage the Seagrass Meadow, the Kelp Forest and beyond.

- Upgrade your tools to copper, cobalt, gold and tidesilver, earn your diver certifications, and strap on Dr. Cuda's bubble jet pack.

Dive together

- Invite a friend through Steam and farm the sea floor together in online co-op for two.

- Share the farm, the purse and the town, while each of you keeps your own backpack, tools, certifications and friendships.

- Your friend moves into a bunk room built onto your diving bell.

- Dive the Rift side by side, or split up: one of you tends the crops while the other goes spearfishing.

games.name: HOLD THE DOCK
games.shortDescription: HOLD THE DOCK is a wave defense game with roguelite elements. Defend the dock gate. The mutants are out to smash it! Gun them down, build a loadout of weapons, modifiers and skills that activate on their own, fortify your position and keep the swarm from breaking through until the cargo arrives.
games.aboutText:
DEFENDER! Your post is a cargo receiving dock at the edge of the platform. Mutants are crawling in from beyond the horizon, and the only thing standing between them and the warehouse is the dock gate. And you. Hold the line wave after wave, put together a build of weapons and skills that activate on their own (your skill slots grow from three to seven), and don't let the swarm break through. Hold out to the end, and the gate will open to let the long-awaited cargo finally roll into the dock.

Briefing:

- Choose a fighter that suits your tactics.

- Take the shots yourself or let auto-fire handle it — your call.

- Remember! Every gun has its own unique weapon skill.

- Pick up your coins! Whatever you leave behind is lost. Spend them in the shop and upgrade your build between battles!

- Fortify your position: build defenses on the platform.

- Choose skills — they activate on their own: auras, auto-guns, turrets, mines, grenades, barricades and much more.

- Choose modifiers — shape your build by combining them with skills!

- Find blueprints that merge two skills into a single, more powerful one.

- Pick a difficulty you can handle! The higher the difficulty, the tougher the enemies and the bigger the rewards.

- Earn permanent upgrades: turn in Lost Cargo at the Container Drop-Off — you can even get a helper drone there!

- Fight, complete achievements and unlock new weapons, classes, skills and modifiers!

- If the gate falls, don't despair — the Lost Cargo you've collected will make you stronger!

Good luck, defender!

games.name: Veggie Warfare - Feast of Fury
games.shortDescription: The veggies have snapped! Blast through endless waves of enraged carrots, onions, and mutant tomatoes in this fast-paced rogue-like FPS. Collect upgrades, unlock new arenas, and survive the Feast of Fury — where dinner fights back!
games.aboutText:
Welcome to the Feast of Fury , where your food fights you .

In this chaotic rogue-like first-person shooter, armies of walking vegetables have come to life — and they’re out for revenge.

Before each run, set your own challenge: turn up the heat with Hard Mode , make every veggie wear ridiculous chef hats , or activate Bouncy Mode to watch them ricochet around like popcorn in a pan.

Then choose your battleground — from abandoned kitchens and overgrown farms to glowing greenhouses and mutant markets. Each arena has hazards that can be used to your advantage: gas leaks that explode, broken ovens that overheat, and conveyor belts that send enemies flying.

Armed with just a pistol, you’ll face waves of aggressive veggies that sprint, shoot seeds, explode, or shield themselves with frying pans. Destroy them, collect glowing orbs, and level up to pick powerful upgrades — increase your firepower, speed, or ammo efficiency, or call in weapon drops for extra punch.

The longer you survive, the tougher the horde becomes — hulking pumpkins, charging potatoes, and explosive chili peppers swarm in faster and hit harder.

Survive long enough, and you’ll unlock new arenas, more modifiers, and even greater mayhem for your next serving of chaos.

Gameplay

Before your run begins you have to choose a difficulty.

You lock in your pick and head to the first arena — The Deadly Supermarket . Aisles stretch out under flickering fluorescent lights, shelves half-stocked and toppled in places. Shopping carts lie scattered, and mist drifts from broken freezer units. You spawn with a basic pistol in hand, standing between checkout counters and glowing refrigerators — the air quiet except for the hum of the lights… until you hear footsteps approaching from the produce aisle.

A mutated carrot spawns at the entrance right behind you. It has arms and legs and is our for your flesh. Behind it, onions waddle in with shields, and tomatoes roll in, ready to explode. You raise your pistol and open fire.

Your first shots splatter the tomato across the wall, leaving behind a glowing experience orb. You dodge, reload, and collect it just as more enemies pour in. Some sprint, others bounce, some lob seeds or hot oil. Shoot, dodge, reload, collect experience, repeat. After a handful of takedowns, you level up.

An upgrade menu pops up:
• Stat boosts (damage, reload speed, movement speed)
• Passive perks (extra XP, stamina recovery, faster orbs)
• One-time spawns (ammo drop or new weapon)

You grab a weapon drop and rush to the pickup — a shotgun lying near a broken oven. With the upgrade in hand, your rhythm shifts. You blast apart crowds at close range, shattering peppers and turning carrots into puree.

Each wave ramps up the intensity. Bigger and stronger vegetables start showing up — armored potatoes that soak multiple hits, bouncing zucchinis that ricochet off walls, and chili peppers that explode in fiery bursts.

Positioning becomes key. You kite groups around tables, draw them toward leaking gas tanks, then shoot the tanks to trigger massive explosions. The kitchen becomes a weapon — one you have to use smartly to survive.

Wave after wave, you level up again. You boost raw damage, faster reloads, and sprint endurance, turning yourself into a veggie-pulverizing machine. The arena fills with glowing orbs, broken dishes, and flying vegetable chunks.

You manage target priority: popping explosive peppers from a safe distance, timing reloads between onion charge attacks, and blasting flying corn kernels before they bombard you.

Eventually, the kitchen becomes a full-blown food fight. You get cornered — maybe you run out of ammo, maybe a wave of bouncing zucchinis cuts off your escape. The swarm closes in, and your run ends in glorious, crunchy chaos.

But progress carries forward. You’ve unlocked the next battleground — The Veggie Swamp — and new modifiers to try next time.

You wipe the pulp off your visor, reload, and dive back in. The Feast of Fury has only begun

games.name: Tidy Up Christmas Shop
games.shortDescription: 5,434 Christmas items are scattered across the shop. Put them back where they belong and enjoy the wonderful order. No timer, no stress. Upgrade your skills with the candy you earn and arrange colourful, twinkling Christmas items on the shelves of a huge two-storey shop as you like. Merry Christmas!
games.aboutText:
Tomorrow is opening day for a magical Christmas shop, but inside it looks like a battlefield. Twinkling baubles, sparkling bells, crystal ornaments, ribboned gift boxes and thousands more are scattered everywhere. If every item makes it back to its own shelf, the shop's magic will return.

Pick up the items on the floor and put them in the right category. You can carry a stack of up to eight items in your hands.

Put an item on the right shelf and it glows green. Yellow means another kind has slipped into that compartment; red means the item is on the wrong shelf.

Every corner of this huge, magical two-storey shop has been lovingly prepared to be decked out with twinkling decorations.

And don't forget to ring the bell on the counter. It might just come in handy.

- 5,434 items, 499 kinds, 40 categories

- No timer, no penalties: play at your own pace

- Twinkling, enchanting, handcrafted 3D Christmas ornaments

- A snowy night, warm lights and a giant fir tree

games.name: Shellcrushers
games.shortDescription: Shellcrushers is a stylized horde tower defense game: tens of thousands of roaches pour in at once, and you meet them with six turrets, RPG-deep upgrade trees and procedurally generated maps, so no two fights play the same.
games.aboutText:
Shellcrushers is a stylized tower defense game about a roach swarm the size of a river, turrets you build up like RPG characters, and maps that are never the same twice.

The Shellcrushers are an elite squad of small aliens who already lost their home world to the swarm. Now the roaches on Earth are waking up, and the Extermination Service sends crews in before the humans notice. Clear the site, collect the biomass, file the report in triplicate. The end of the world is no excuse to skip the paperwork.

Before the wave, place every turret by hand: turn its firing sector, pull it closer or push it farther, and a drop pod brings it down.

Tens of thousands of roaches flow toward your base like a river. Every one that slips through costs you.

A toothpick machine gun, a cannon, a flamethrower, a tesla coil, a railgun and a rocket launcher. Each turret picks one of its four ascendancies, and that choice changes how it fights: shells that punch through a whole line, rockets that leave a poison cloud, toothpicks that set the crowd on fire. The sets differ from turret to turret, drawn from five elements: physical, fire, ice, poison and lightning.

You fire too: click anywhere on the map and the HQ howitzer hits that spot.

At level 5 every turret unlocks its own ability. You aim it, and all turrets of that type fire together. In Coordinate Salvo, for example, every rocket launcher hits the point you pick, however far away it stands.

Three campaigns of five maps each: a kitchen, a restaurant and a warehouse. A job board of procedurally generated maps in five tiers, with skull modifiers to make them harder. And the sewers: 100 levels down, each one harder than the last. The task board keeps three tasks open and brings new ones every 30 minutes.

Every turret has its own big tree of upgrades with branches and builds to plan. Between runs, spend what you scrape off the roaches and shape each turret your way. On the toothpick machine gun alone, one build chases crits and ricochets, another lets the barrel heat up so every shot hits harder.

Each turret's own tree has about 300 nodes. Masteries let you take one rule out of several, and sockets hold modules: items with random properties, each rolled in one of five tiers. Legendary modules bring rules of their own. Modules drop in battle.

Elements react to each other. Ice on a burning roach puts the fire out and stuns it, lightning on a poisoned roach jumps to one more, and a heavy hit shatters a frozen roach into shards that cut its neighbours. Sixteen reactions in all. What's inside

- Six turrets , each with its own upgrade tree of about 300 nodes and four ascendancies

- Masteries and modules : rules to pick in the tree and items with random properties for its sockets

- 16 elemental reactions

- Three campaigns of five maps: a kitchen, a restaurant and a warehouse

- A job board of procedurally generated maps in five tiers, with skull modifiers

- The sewers : 100 levels down, each harder than the last

- A task board with new tasks every 30 minutes

- 73 Steam achievements and a leaderboard

- 15 languages

games.name: Good Boy Good Waves
games.shortDescription: Set out on a relaxing paddleboard journey across scenic island waters with your faithful canine companion. Catch the rhythm of gentle waves, balance your board, explore peaceful coastlines, and uncover tranquil island secrets together.
games.aboutText: Good Boy Good Waves is a relaxing 3D ocean adventure where you paddle through scenic island waters alongside your faithful canine companion. Key Features: - Rhythmic Paddling: Catch the rhythm of gentle waves and find your paddling flow. - Balance & Flow: Keep your balance on the board as you navigate shifting currents and tranquil waters. - Island Exploration: Journey across peaceful coastlines, discover hidden coves, and uncover island secrets together. - Cozy Atmosphere: Enjoy a calm, heartwarming journey surrounded by soothing ocean breezes.

games.name: Voretsk
games.shortDescription: Voretsk is a 3D First Person Extraction Shooter where you play as civilians trapped in the middle of a war zone. Alone or with a friend venture into the cruel Voretsk Zone, fight or hide, scavenge and get back. Complete missions, uncover a way out, and leave the Zone behind and reclaim your life.
games.aboutText:
Voretsk is a 3D First Person Shooter, Extraction game. You play as civilians that got stuck in a warzone called "VORETSK". Venture into the Voretsk, do what must be done and you may get out of this hopeless war zone.

Game can be played from start to finish with a friend. Team up with a friend to face the dangers of Voretsk together. However alone or not, survival is never guaranteed.

With procedurally generated maps, changing weather and generally a tense environment you will never feel safe in Voretsk nor you should. Danger can leap out of any corner and can be anything. You never know what lies ahead, sometimes, the safest choice is not to move at all.

As developers of Voretsk our favourite part. We designed enemies with love one can say. Human enemies in the game are more than just basic soldiers, they have their own goals and quests that they are trying to accomplish and they don't actively hunt the player. If they happen to cross paths with the player then yes they will attack but even in combat they analyze and decide on the spot thus adapt. They may take a cover, do a suppressive fire or even just silenlty camp at the door so when player comes they can blast you and many more.

For mutant enemies they each have their own gimmick that player needs to learn and adapt to. Mutant enemies are very protective and if any human happens to get close they will attack so as a player you are not the center of everything. Mutants and humans will fight each other, they have their own ambitions, you are just passing by and trying to survive.

Your base is your only safe location in Voretsk also your line of production. Use the resources you gather during your expeditions to improve your base to make it cozier and productive.

Your survival depends on more than just what you find in the field. It also depends on who is your friend and who is not. Interact with the people at Camp Yuri, make use of their services and expertise. Work with engineer to repair and modify your equipment, work with scientist to better understand anormal side of Voretsk and many more

games.name: If you die, you die!
games.shortDescription: A one-life horror game inside the corpse of God. Photograph what lives in the dark. Die, and you can never play again.
games.aboutText:
You have only one chance to beat this game. No saves, no extra lives. When you die, you cannot play this game again.

God died and fell to Earth. His head lies half-buried on a plateau, thirty-one metres tall, split open by the fall. Calvaria Station has drilled a bore through the crown.

You are sealed into an iron sphere and lowered into the dark.

ONE DESCENT

No saves. No checkpoints. If your probe is lost, the game is over for you.

Come back alive, and you may go down again.

Closing the game during a descent counts as death.

PHOTOGRAPH WHAT YOU FIND

Eight sites wait inside the body. Only photographs count as evidence, and the photographs show things the live feed does not.

THE PROBE WILL NOT LAST

At first, the hull holds but you have limited time to finish your work and get back to the bore.

ONE GOAL FOR EVERY PILOT

The research board on the main menu is live and shared by every player in the world: probes not returned, probes returned, and the samples still needed to finish the research.

FEATURES

- One life. Die once and the game is over.

- One descent of thirty minutes at most.

- A sealed cabin of physical buttons, levers, dials and screens, with low-res, dithered, grainy camera feeds.

- A true 3D descent through chambers and tunnels: dive, climb and watch the pressure.

- A live global research board shared by all players, and a final revelation that unlocks for everyone at once.

Find out what killed God.

games.name: Desperate City
games.shortDescription: The primary objective involves entering a battlefield where a toxic zone continuously shrinks, forcing you to contend with over a hundred other enemies—you must evade them and attempt to eliminate everyone else to secure victory.
games.aboutText:
The primary objective involves entering a battlefield where a toxic zone continuously shrinks, forcing you to contend with over a hundred other enemies—you must evade them and attempt to eliminate everyone else to secure victory.

Players can switch between first-person and third-person perspectives, exploring the world to acquire gear for combat against enemies.

Game Features:

1. In addition to the main combat mode, various casual modes are also available.

2. A vast map with high replayability.

3. A straightforward combat system that allows players to deal damage even without weapons.

4. A wide variety of vehicles, making it easy to escape from intense enemy fire.

games.name: RUGGED
games.shortDescription: RUGGED is first-person survival for one to four players. Fell trees, haul logs back to camp, craft tools, and hunt for food. Build a cabin on your own or host your existing world for friends through online or LAN co-op.
games.aboutText:
You start with an axe. Pick a spot by the river or head into the pines, cut your first tree, and carry the logs home. RUGGED is first-person wilderness survival for one to four players.

Build a place to come back to

Start with a fire and a place to sleep. Haul logs to your blueprint and add walls, doors, and a roof as you go. Gather stone and fiber, make a pickaxe, and use a workbench to turn what you bring back into better gear.

Hunt, forage, and explore

Follow rivers through wooded hills and look for supplies at abandoned camps. Elk flee when you get close. Bears defend their territory, and hostile hunters guard some camps. Bring a bow or rifle when you head out, then cook what you catch back at your fire.

Open your world to friends

Keep playing a solo save or host it for up to three friends through an online room code or LAN. Split up to gather supplies, build one base together, and return to the same world next session. The host keeps the save. Friendly fire is enabled.

games.name: Dokimon Frontier
games.shortDescription: The first FREE Dokimon experience: a monster-taming roguelike! Discover up to 100 Dokimon, find rare items, and unlock Character Classes from your Ranger Skill Tree. Level up and battle to your heart's content!
games.aboutText:
Every Run is a Unique Adventure

Start the game with a selection of your favorite starter Dokimon. If you’re rich enough, purchase extra monsters to bring along from the very start of a run. Catch new Dokimon along your travels until you reach the final floor, Boss Fight, and repeat! Unlock items and new Dokimon as you play, gain character levels and dosh as you level up your character, and turn up the heat with Character Classes and a Ranger Skill Tree.

Meet Captain Lumi

Your guide on the S.S. Bluefin: Captain Lumi, is an expert on Dokimon adventures and the inner workings of the ship that Rangers and Space Rangers come from far and wide to be apart of.

Dokimon! Battles! Items!

Not every Dokimon is created equal of course, some are stronger than others, and for that reason every tamer needs an edge. Items you can find or pick via Free Pick events and collect throughout the run make every dive unique. Shops let you purchase a greater range of items, heal up, and take a rest from the chaos.

Get the new, full, improved experience of Dokimon battling, with endless Dokimon and item combinations to enjoy.

Ranger Levels, The Skill Tree, Classes

As you play the game and level your ranger, you have a skill tree that gives your Dokimon buffs, chances of rare items appearing, and other fun passives. Level up your Ranger Skill Tree enough to unlock classes. Pick a class and unlock new skills and passives to give yourself a new edge in your adventures.

Game Modes

- Rogue-like: The main one, pick an area to adventure in, and defeat the boss to return back to your home ship. Unlock new areas and levels as you play.

- Boss Rush: Defeat a world and unlock the Boss Rush mode, based on the Bosses you defeated in each world.

- Frontier Streak: Back to back battles with fun different Challenge Modes. Get Star Credits to use for outfits and accessories at the shop!

Download and play at absolutely no cost to start battling and fill your evening with fun adventures!

games.name: Ash Company
games.shortDescription: A command-and-management game about running a mercenary company. Hire mercs, fit their gear, mark routes on the op map and send them into the ruins. During an op, the only way to intervene is by radio. Loot carried out by the squad pays wages and grows the base.
games.aboutText:
Raids and Looting

Send a squad into ruins held by raiders, rival crews and security bots. Search crates and bodies to fill packs.

- Only loot carried out through an exit counts as company income

- Heavy packs slow the squad down

- A merc carried out wounded leaves his gear behind

Op Map and Radio Command

No direct control. The player handles the plan and the calls.

- Before each op, mark the route, loot targets and exit on the op map

- Set standing orders, e.g. return when packs are full, don't chase retreating enemies

- In combat, mercs use the tactics they learned at the training ground

- During the op, radio in moves, searches, fall-backs, mortars, drones and supply drops

- Radio calls arrive late, and each call costs command points

- When a situation set to "ask me" comes up, the squad leader radios in for a decision

Running the Company

Loot is the income. Payroll is the main cost.

- Hire applicants on negotiated contract terms

- Fit guns, armor, rigs and packs; train mercs and assign roles

- Place 27 facilities on a grid: infirmary, workshop, armory, lab, helipad and more

- Sell loot to traders; take contracts and local jobs

- On off days, command another company's squad for a fee

- Wages are daily pay plus a per-op bonus; long stretches in the red make mercs leave

Injuries and Losses

- Per-limb wounds, bleeding and fractures

- Armor resolved by class and penetration; durability drops with each hit

- Downed mercs don't die, but lose the gear they carried and spend days in the infirmary

Contents

- 7 operation areas

- Up to 8 mercs per op

- 5-act campaign, 2 endings

- 30 research projects, 14 tactics, 196 crafting recipes

- Day and night ops, night vision

- Korean and English

games.name: Explode
games.shortDescription: Explode is a 1-4 player co-op FPS where you wreck swarms of robots with a ridiculous arsenal, grab the loot, and haul it all back to the van.
games.aboutText:
Your employer has a simple business model: drive a van full of crash-test dummies to an abandoned site, open the door, and keep whatever makes it back. The sites are guarded by security robots, and the robots keep coming.

Grab the TV, the safe, the payroll chest, anything worth money, and haul it to the van before the clock runs out. Loot takes both hands, so the rest of the crew had better clear the way.

THE JOB

- 60 seconds per round. Guards wait around the loot when the van door opens. Then the waves arrive, each one bigger than the last, until the final rush on the van.

- Make the quota. Whatever reaches the van gets banked. Meet the quota after three rounds and the crew gets paid. Miss it and the run is over.

- It only goes up. Every mission raises the quota and sends tougher robots. How long can your crew keep the job?

FEATURES

- A ridiculous arsenal - Rocket launchers, grenade launchers, miniguns, shotguns, sniper rifles, land mines and frags. Pick your weapon at the start of the run and make a mess with it.

- Swarms of robots - Packs of patrol bots, charging bruisers, laser gunners, chaingun suppressors and ninjas faster than you are.

- Blast your way around - Rocket-jump over the horde, then slide, grapple, jetpack and dash back to the van. Your friends' explosions launch you too, usually by accident.

- Spend the paycheck - Between missions, the crew splits the money and shops for armor, a bigger backpack, jump boots, damage and blast boosters, and special upgrades that change how your weapon works.

- Solo or 1-4 player online co-op - With proximity voice chat, so you can hear exactly how the TV carrier feels about the situation.

Clock in. Grab the loot. Explode.

games.name: Tessera
games.shortDescription: Tessera is an open-world sandbox fantasy RPG. Customize your own character, explore a vast continent, gather and craft, take on dungeons, and grow your own territory. Play solo or with friends.
games.aboutText:
Tessera is an open-world sandbox fantasy RPG played from a quarter-view perspective. Building

Gather materials, build your home piece by piece, and decorate it however you like. Combat

Take on creatures and powerful foes across the continent in real-time action combat. Dodge their attacks and strike when they leave an opening. Gathering & Crafting

Chop trees and mine stone to gather materials, then craft gear and furniture. Your Own Territory

Till fields and grow crops, then craft goods and sell them. Bring home the companions you meet on your travels, and they'll live with you and lend a hand. Start with a small cabin and grow it into a village of your own. Your Own Character

Customize everything from your race to your hair, eye shape, skin and eye color, then mix and match classes freely to create an adventurer like no other. Explore a Vast Continent

Green fields, moonlit forests, red mesas, frozen highlands, mossy swamps. Every region has its own scenery, creatures and resources. Set out toward whatever you see on the horizon. Conquer Dungeons

Venture deep into dungeons, defeat powerful foes and claim your rewards. Solo or Together

Take it easy on your own, or invite friends to adventure together and build up your territory. Key Features

- A vast open world of distinct, connected regions

- Your own territory, grown together with your companions

- Character customization: mix race, appearance and class

- Gathering, crafting and home building

- Dungeons and real-time action combat

- Single-player and online co-op

- Controller support

games.name: Barely a Village
games.shortDescription: Grow a tiny village on floating tiles,. Every day you only have a few actions, so use them wisely. Enemies hunt your villagers, smash your buildings and infect your land. When your village falls, unlock new research and try again.
games.aboutText:
Cozy turn-based strategy game about growing a tiny village on floating tiles. Every day you only get a few actions. Spend them wisely, because the danger keeps growing.

You begin with a single tile and a small cabin, floating above the clouds. Build new tiles and watch them rise out of the void.

Each day you start with three actions: build, harvest or upgrade. Give villagers a home and they’ll give you more actions in return.

Every run earns points. Spend them on the research board to unlock new buildings, animals, weapons, armor and spells. Each run your village starts a little stronger.

The longer you survive, the harder it gets. Bigger waves, stronger enemies and bosses that test everything you’ve built. How far can your village go?

- Turn-based strategy with limited actions per day

- A village that grows tile by tile on a hex grid

- Farming, livestock, mining and crafting

- Four enemy types, each with its own target

- Boss fights that grow stronger the longer you survive

- Villagers that give you more actions

- Roguelite research board with permanent unlocks

- A colourful low-poly world floating above the clouds

games.name: Amalga
games.shortDescription: You wake in a ring of purple light with no memory of who you are, and a voice that says you were chosen. A dark dungeon crawler with a hidden-intent card battler at its core: every blow aimed at a body part, every body a choice, and the strongest cards are what will change you.
games.aboutText:
You wake in a ring of purple light with no memory of who you are, and a voice that says you were chosen. A dark dungeon crawler with a hidden-intent card battler at its core: every blow aimed at a body part, every body a choice, and the strongest cards are what will change you.

Fight where it's weak

Both sides see each other's whole hand, but not which cards will be played. Plan your turn, lock it in, and everything plays all at once. Every attack is aimed at the head, body, arm or legs; every guard covers one of them. A blow to the head leaves your enemy dazed, a gut wound bleeds, a broken arm makes you weaker. Read the fight, or be read.

Every body is a decision

Strip it for what it carried. Eat its strength and keep it, at a price in blood. Make it a card for your deck. Or spare it, and quiet the voice a little.

Borrow his cards

The Guide's deck is stronger than yours, and he will lend it gladly. Each card costs corruption. Corruption slowly builds, and you transform as you gain more of it.

Descend

Hand-built floors, each with its own dead, its own residents and a thing standing between you and the way down. Chests, inscriptions, strangers who want something, and campfires to rest at before whatever comes next.

Features

- Hidden-intent, simultaneous card battles aimed at body parts, with wounds that affect the fight

- A corruption system that tempts you with the strongest cards in the game, and kills you at 100

- Four choices over every body (salvage, absorb, make a card, or spare) that shape your run

- Hand-built floors to explore tile by tile, lit one room at a time

- Cards that rot in your hand, and draw piles that punish long fights

- A deck you choose from everything you have taken off the dead

games.name: Brennia
games.shortDescription: Brennia is a fantasy RPG featuring turn-based combat and an open world. Explore biomes, solve puzzles, and craft gear for your next dungeon run! Between expeditions, grow crops and expand your island. Play solo or with up to three friends.
games.aboutText:
In combat, the tile you stand on matters. Out in the world, you’re free to roam, plant crops, fish, and fix up your own island. Brennia is a fantasy RPG where you can set out on adventures solo or with up to three friends.

Fight on a tactical grid
Use obstacles to your advantage, knock enemies into walls, or combine elements for new effects. Weapons, gear sets, spells, and passive skills all shape how you play. Revisit dungeons with modifiers that change the rules of combat and offer better rewards.

A world full of adventure
Explore forests, wetlands, old burial grounds, and deserts. And that’s all on the first island! A message in a bottle or a chat with a local might lead you to a hidden burrow, a puzzle, or a secret reward. Follow the clues to discover what’s happening as the Void spreads through the natural world.

Make your island your own
Repair a boat to unlock your own island. Between expeditions, grow crops, go fishing, and craft gear. Use the materials you gather to expand your garden, fix up your house, and eventually add a grove or a mine.

Keep an eye on the calendar!
The world changes as the seasons turn, day gives way to night, and the weather shifts. Check the in-game calendar for world events and the occasional festival.
